      InitialVelocityConditionPeriodic u₀ ∧ ForceConditionPeriodic f ∧
      ¬ (∃ v p, NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothnessPeriodic nu u₀ f v p))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hIC : InitialVelocityCondition (0 : ℝ³ → ℝ³) :=
    ⟨fun x => divergence_zero x, contDiff_const⟩
  have hdec : InitialVelocityConditionDecay (0 : ℝ³ → ℝ³) := by
    refine ⟨hIC, ?_⟩
    intro m K
    refine ⟨0, fun x => ?_⟩
    have : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (0 : ℝ³ → ℝ³) x = 0 := by
      have h : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun _ : ℝ³ => (0 : ℝ³)) = 0 := iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero
      exact congrFun h x
    rw [this, norm_zero, zero_div]
  have hper : InitialVelocityConditionPeriodic (0 : ℝ³ → ℝ³) := ⟨hIC, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  
  obtain ⟨R₁, u₁, p₁, hR₁, hu₁, hp₁, hvan₁, hdiv₁, hunb₁, hGs, hGvan, hGc⟩ :=
    ns_blowup_flat_residual
  obtain ⟨F₁, hF₁s, hF₁eq, hF₁R, hF₁S⟩ :=
    smooth_extension_past_terminal_time 1 R₁ (nsResidual 1 u₁ p₁) hGs
      (fun x t ht hx => hGvan x t ht (Or.inl hx)) hGc
  have hpkg : BlowupPackage 1 1 R₁ u₁ p₁ F₁ := by
    refine ⟨one_pos, hR₁, hu₁, hp₁, hF₁s, fun x t ht hx => hvan₁ x t ht (Or.inl hx),
      fun x => (hvan₁ x 0 one_pos (Or.inr le_rfl)).1, ?_, hF₁S,
      fun x t ht => (hF₁eq x t ht).symm, hdiv₁, hunb₁⟩
    intro x t h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact hF₁R x t h
    · have ht : t < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt h one_pos
      rw [hF₁eq x t ht]
      exact hGvan x t ht (Or.inr h)
  
  have hC : ∃ (u₀ : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (f : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³),
      InitialVelocityConditionDecay u₀ ∧ ForceConditionDecay f ∧
      ¬ (∃ v p, NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothnessRn nu u₀ f v p) := by
    obtain ⟨T, u, p, f, hpk⟩ :=
      blowup_package_rescale 1 nu 1 R₁ u₁ p₁ F₁ one_pos hnu hpkg 1 one_pos
    obtain ⟨hT, _, hu, hp, hf, hvan, hinit, hfvan, ⟨S, hfS⟩, hres, hdiv, hunb⟩ := hpk
    refine ⟨0, f, hdec,
      force_decay_of_compact_support f 1 S hf (fun x t hx => hfvan x t (Or.inl hx)) hfS, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨v, P, h⟩
    have heq := rn_weak_strong_uniqueness nu T 1 u v p P f hnu hT hu hp hvan
      (fun x t _ ht => hres x t ht) (fun x t _ ht => hdiv x t ht)
      h.velocity_smooth h.pressure_smooth h.navier_stokes h.div_free h.integrable
      h.globally_bounded_energy (fun x => by simp [h.initial_condition x, hinit x])
    have hK : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ³) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
      (isCompact_closedBall 0 1).prod isCompact_Icc
    have hsub : Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ³) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) T ⊆ univ ×ˢ Ici 0 :=
      fun z hz => ⟨mem_univ _, hz.2.1⟩
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (h.velocity_smooth.continuousOn.mono hsub)
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (norm_nonneg _)
      (hM ((0 : ℝ³), (0 : ℝ)) ⟨Metric.mem_closedBall_self zero_le_one, le_rfl, hT.le⟩)
    obtain ⟨x, t, ht0, htT, hgt⟩ := hunb M
    by_cases hx : 1 ≤ ‖x‖
    · rw [(hvan x t htT hx).1, norm_zero] at hgt
      linarith
    · have hmem : (x, t) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ³) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) T := by
        refine ⟨?_, ht0, htT.le⟩
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
        linarith
      have hb : ‖v x t‖ ≤ M := hM (x, t) hmem
      rw [← heq x t ht0 htT] at hgt
      exact (not_le.mpr hgt) hb
  
  have hD : ∃ (u₀ : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (f : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³),
      InitialVelocityConditionPeriodic u₀ ∧ ForceConditionPeriodic f ∧
      ¬ (∃ v p, NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothnessPeriodic nu u₀ f v p) := by
    obtain ⟨T, u, p, f, hpk⟩ :=
      blowup_package_rescale 1 nu 1 R₁ u₁ p₁ F₁ one_pos hnu hpkg (1/4) (by norm_num)
    have hT : 0 < T := hpk.1
    obtain ⟨U, Pu, F, S, hU, hPu, hF, hUper, hPuper, hFper, hUinit, hres, hdiv, hFS, hFbd,
      hunb⟩ := periodize_blowup_package nu T u p f hpk
    refine ⟨0, F, hper, force_periodic_of_bounded_derivs F S hF hFper hFS hFbd, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨v, P, h⟩
    have heq := torus_energy_uniqueness nu T U v Pu P F hnu hT hU hPu
      (fun t _ ht => hUper t ht) (fun t _ ht => hPuper t ht)
      (fun x t _ ht => hres x t ht) (fun x t _ ht => hdiv x t ht)
      h.velocity_smooth h.pressure_smooth h.isOnePeriodic_velocity h.isOnePeriodic_pressure
      h.navier_stokes h.div_free (fun x => by simp [h.initial_condition x, hUinit x])
    have hK : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ³) (1/4) ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
      (isCompact_closedBall 0 (1/4)).prod isCompact_Icc
    have hsub : Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ³) (1/4) ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) T ⊆ univ ×ˢ Ici 0 :=
      fun z hz => ⟨mem_univ _, hz.2.1⟩
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (h.velocity_smooth.continuousOn.mono hsub)
    obtain ⟨x, t, ht0, htT, hx, hgt⟩ := hunb M
    have hmem : (x, t) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ³) (1/4) ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) T := by
      refine ⟨?_, ht0, htT.le⟩
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      exact hx
    have hb : ‖v x t‖ ≤ M := hM (x, t) hmem
    rw [← heq x t ht0 htT] at hgt
    exact (not_le.mpr hgt) hb
  exact ⟨hC, hD⟩

navier_stokes_breakdown.definitions:
noncomputable def nsResidual (ν : ℝ) (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) : ℝ³ :=
  deriv (fun s => u x s) t + fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) x (u x t)
    - ν • Δ (fun y => u y t) x + gradient (fun y => p y t) x


def BlowupPackage (ν T R : ℝ) (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) : Prop :=
  0 < T ∧ 0 < R ∧
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) ∧
  ContDiff ℝ ∞ (↿f) ∧
  (∀ x t, t < T → R ≤ ‖x‖ → u x t = 0 ∧ p x t = 0) ∧
  (∀ x, u x 0 = 0) ∧
  (∀ x t, (R ≤ ‖x‖ ∨ t ≤ 0) → f x t = 0) ∧
  (∃ S : ℝ, ∀ x t, S ≤ t → f x t = 0) ∧
  (∀ x t, t < T → nsResidual ν u p x t = f x t) ∧
  (∀ x t, t < T → divergence (fun y => u y t) x = 0) ∧
  (∀ M : ℝ, ∃ x t, 0 ≤ t ∧ t < T ∧ M < ‖u x t‖)

subgoal_signatures.name: ns_blowup_flat_residual
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∃ (R : ℝ) (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < R ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) (univ ×ˢ Iio 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) (univ ×ˢ Iio 1) ∧ (∀ x t, t < 1 → (R ≤ ‖x‖ ∨ t ≤ 0) → u x t = 0 ∧ p x t = 0) ∧ (∀ x t, t < 1 → divergence (fun y => u y t) x = 0) ∧ (∀ M : ℝ, ∃ x t, 0 ≤ t ∧ t < 1 ∧ M < ‖u x t‖) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(nsResidual 1 u p)) (univ ×ˢ Iio 1) ∧ (∀ x t, t < 1 → (R ≤ ‖x‖ ∨ t ≤ 0) → nsResidual 1 u p x t = 0) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ t₀ < 1, ∀ x : ℝ³, ∀ t t' : ℝ, t₀ < t → t < 1 → t₀ < t' → t' < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(nsResidual 1 u p)) (x, t) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(nsResidual 1 u p)) (x, t')‖ < ε)

subgoal_signatures.name: smooth_extension_past_terminal_time
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (T₁ R : ℝ) (G : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) (univ ×ˢ Iio T₁) → (∀ x t, t < T₁ → R ≤ ‖x‖ → G x t = 0) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ t₀ < T₁, ∀ x : ℝ³, ∀ t t' : ℝ, t₀ < t → t < T₁ → t₀ < t' → t' < T₁ → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿G) (x, t) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿G) (x, t')‖ < ε) → ∃ F : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (↿F) ∧ (∀ x t, t < T₁ → F x t = G x t) ∧ (∀ x t, R ≤ ‖x‖ → F x t = 0) ∧ (∃ S : ℝ, ∀ x t, S ≤ t → F x t = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: blowup_package_rescale
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (ν₀ ν T R : ℝ) (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³), 0 < ν₀ → 0 < ν → BlowupPackage ν₀ T R u p f → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ∃ (T' : ℝ) (u' : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p' : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (f' : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³), BlowupPackage ν T' ρ u' p' f'

subgoal_signatures.name: force_decay_of_compact_support
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (f : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (R S : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ (↿f) → (∀ x t, R ≤ ‖x‖ → f x t = 0) → (∀ x t, S ≤ t → f x t = 0) → ForceConditionDecay f

subgoal_signatures.name: force_periodic_of_bounded_derivs
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (F : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (S : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ (↿F) → (∀ t, IsOnePeriodic (fun x => F x t)) → (∀ x t, S ≤ t → F x t = 0) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (x, t)‖ ≤ M) → ForceConditionPeriodic F

subgoal_signatures.name: periodize_blowup_package
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (ν T : ℝ) (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³), BlowupPackage ν T (1/4) u p f → ∃ (U : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (P : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (F : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (S : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿P) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (↿F) ∧ (∀ t, t < T → IsOnePeriodic (fun x => U x t)) ∧ (∀ t, t < T → IsOnePeriodic (fun x => P x t)) ∧ (∀ t, IsOnePeriodic (fun x => F x t)) ∧ (∀ x, U x 0 = 0) ∧ (∀ x t, t < T → nsResidual ν U P x t = F x t) ∧ (∀ x t, t < T → divergence (fun y => U y t) x = 0) ∧ (∀ x t, S ≤ t → F x t = 0) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (x, t)‖ ≤ M) ∧ (∀ M : ℝ, ∃ x t, 0 ≤ t ∧ t < T ∧ ‖x‖ ≤ 1/4 ∧ M < ‖U x t‖)

subgoal_signatures.name: rn_weak_strong_uniqueness
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (ν T R : ℝ) (u v : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p P : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³), 0 < ν → 0 < T → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) → (∀ x t, t < T → R ≤ ‖x‖ → u x t = 0 ∧ p x t = 0) → (∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → t < T → nsResidual ν u p x t = f x t) → (∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → t < T → divergence (fun y => u y t) x = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿v) (univ ×ˢ Ici 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿P) (univ ×ˢ Ici 0) → (∀ x, ∀ t ≥ 0, derivWithin (v x ·) (Ici 0) t + fderiv ℝ (v · t) x (v x t) = ν • Δ (v · t) x - gradient (P · t) x + f x t) → (∀ x, ∀ t ≥ 0, divergence (v · t) x = 0) → (∀ t ≥ 0, MemLp (fun x => ‖v x t‖) 2) → (∃ E, ∀ t ≥ 0, (∫ x, ‖v x t‖ ^ 2) < E) → (∀ x, v x 0 = u x 0) → ∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → t < T → v x t = u x t

subgoal_signatures.name: torus_energy_uniqueness
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (ν T : ℝ) (U v : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (Pu P : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³), 0 < ν → 0 < T → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Pu) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) → (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t < T → IsOnePeriodic (fun x => U x t)) → (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t < T → IsOnePeriodic (fun x => Pu x t)) → (∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → t < T → nsResidual ν U Pu x t = f x t) → (∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → t < T → divergence (fun y => U y t) x = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿v) (univ ×ˢ Ici 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿P) (univ ×ˢ Ici 0) → (∀ t ≥ 0, IsOnePeriodic (v · t)) → (∀ t ≥ 0, IsOnePeriodic (P · t)) → (∀ x, ∀ t ≥ 0, derivWithin (v x ·) (Ici 0) t + fderiv ℝ (v · t) x (v x t) = ν • Δ (v · t) x - gradient (P · t) x + f x t) → (∀ x, ∀ t ≥ 0, divergence (v · t) x = 0) → (∀ x, v x 0 = U x 0) → ∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → t < T → v x t = U x t

  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³, u = fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A' w s) y + Bv' y s :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ, p = fun y s => c y s * P y s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hslice : ∀ (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)), IsOpen O → ∀ (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), (y, s) ∈ O →
      {w : ℝ³ | (w, s) ∈ O} ∈ nhds y := fun O hO y s h =>
    (hO.preimage (Continuous.prodMk continuous_id (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ³ => s))).mem_nhds h
  have hcurl_congr : ∀ (F₁ F₂ : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (x : ℝ³), F₁ =ᶠ[nhds x] F₂ → curl3 F₁ x = curl3 F₂ x := by
    intro F₁ F₂ x h
    simp only [curl3, h.fderiv_eq]
  have hsl : ∀ (G : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) W → (x, t) ∈ W →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w => G w t) x := by
    intro G x t hG hxt
    exact (hG.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hxt)).comp x
      ((contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt)
  have hF0 : ∀ z : ℝ³ × ℝ, z.2 < 1 → z ∈ W ∨ z ∈ V := by
    intro z hz
    by_cases h : z ∈ V
    · exact Or.inr h
    · left
      rw [hV] at h
      simp only [mem_union, mem_setOf_eq, not_or, not_lt] at h
      rw [hW]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, hz⟩
      · rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]; linarith [h.1]
      · show 1 - τ₀ < z.2; linarith [h.2]
  have hinV : ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (ρ ≤ ‖x‖ ∨ t ≤ 0) → ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ V := by
    intro x t h
    rw [hV]
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (show ρ / 2 < ‖x‖ by linarith)
    · exact Or.inr (show t < 1 - τ₀ / 2 by linarith)
  have hglue : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (g : ℝ³ × ℝ → F),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W → (∀ z ∈ V, g z = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (univ ×ˢ Iio 1) := by
    intro F _ _ g hgW hgV
    apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    intro z hz
    rcases hF0 z hz.2 with h | h
    · exact ⟨W, hWo, h, hgW.mono inter_subset_right⟩
    · exact ⟨V, hVo, h, (contDiffOn_const (c := (0 : F))).congr (fun w hw => hgV w hw.2)⟩
  
  have hcV : ∀ y s, ((y, s) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ V → c y s = 0 := by
    intro y s h
    rw [hV] at h
    exact hc0 y s h
  have hAsW0 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿A) W := by rw [hW]; exact hAs
  have hBsW0 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Bv) W := by rw [hW]; exact hBs
  have hAsW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿A') W := by
    rw [hA', hW]; exact hcs.contDiffOn.smul hAs
  have hBsW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Bv') W := by
    rw [hBv', hW]; exact hcs.contDiffOn.smul hBs
  have hpW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) W := by
    rw [hp, hW]; exact hcs.contDiffOn.mul hPs
  have huW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) W := by
    rw [hu]; exact (curl_field_contDiffOn_bounded A' Bv' W W hWo subset_rfl hAsW hBsW).1
  
  have huV : ∀ y s, ((y, s) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ V → u y s = 0 := by
    intro y s h
    have hev : (fun w => A' w s) =ᶠ[nhds y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ³) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hslice V hVo y s h)
        (fun w hw => by simp only [hA', hcV w s hw, zero_smul])
    simp only [hu, hBv', hcV y s h, zero_smul, add_zero]
    rw [hcurl_congr _ _ y hev]
    simp [curl3]
  have hpV : ∀ y s, ((y, s) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ V → p y s = 0 := by
    intro y s h
    simp only [hp, hcV y s h, zero_mul]
  
  have hu_sm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) (univ ×ˢ Iio 1) :=
    hglue (↿u) huW (fun z hz => huV z.1 z.2 hz)
  have hp_sm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) (univ ×ˢ Iio 1) :=
    hglue (↿p) hpW (fun z hz => hpV z.1 z.2 hz)
  
  have hdiv : ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → divergence (fun y => u y t) x = 0 := by
    intro x t ht
    rcases hF0 (x, t) ht with h | h
    · have hxW := h
      rw [hW] at h
      have hx : ‖x‖ < ρ := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp h.1
      have ht1 : 1 - τ₀ < t := h.2.1
      have hA2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun w => A' w t) x :=
        (hsl A' x t hAsW hxW).of_le (by norm_num)
      obtain ⟨hcd, hcdiv⟩ := curl3_differentiable_divergence_zero (fun w => A' w t) x hA2
      have hcdx : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => c w t) x :=
        ((hcs.comp (contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const)).differentiable (by norm_num)) x
      have hBx : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => Bv w t) x :=
        (hsl Bv x t hBsW0 hxW).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have hfun : (fun y => u y t) = fun y => curl3 (fun w => A' w t) y + c y t • Bv y t := by
        funext y; simp only [hu, hBv']
      have hcB : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => c y t • Bv y t) x := hcdx.smul hBx
      rw [hfun, divergence_add hcd hcB, hcdiv,
        divergence_smul_field (fun w => c w t) (fun w => Bv w t) x hcdx hBx]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hBdiv x t hx ht1 ht
      rw [h1, hctan x t (Bv x t) h2]
      simp
    · have hev : (fun y => u y t) =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ³) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hslice V hVo x t h) (fun w hw => huV w t hw)
      rw [divergence, hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp
  
  have hNu : ∀ y s, ‖y‖ < ρ / 4 → 1 - τ₀ / 4 < s →
      u y s = curl3 (fun w => A w s) y + Bv y s := by
    intro y s hy hs
    have hev : (fun w => A' w s) =ᶠ[nhds y] fun w => A w s :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr hy))
        (fun w hw => by simp only [hA', hc1 w s (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hw) hs, one_smul])
    simp only [hu, hBv', hc1 y s hy hs, one_smul]
    rw [hcurl_congr _ _ y hev]
  have hNp : ∀ y s, ‖y‖ < ρ / 4 → 1 - τ₀ / 4 < s → p y s = P y s := by
    intro y s hy hs
    simp only [hp, hc1 y s hy hs, one_mul]
  
  have hunb' : ∀ M : ℝ, ∃ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t ∧ t < 1 ∧ M < ‖u x t‖ := by
    intro M
    obtain ⟨x, t, hx, ht1, ht2, hM⟩ :=
      hunb M (min (ρ / 4) (τ₀ / 4)) (lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith))
    have h3 := min_le_left (ρ / 4) (τ₀ / 4)
    have h4 := min_le_right (ρ / 4) (τ₀ / 4)
    have hx' : ‖x‖ < ρ / 4 := by linarith
    have ht' : 1 - τ₀ / 4 < t := by linarith
    refine ⟨x, t, by linarith, ht2, ?_⟩
    rw [hNu x t hx' ht']
    exact hM
  
  have hGs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(nsResidual 1 u p)) (univ ×ˢ Iio 1) :=
    (nsResidual_contDiffOn_eq_jet 1 u p _ (isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Iio) hu_sm hp_sm).1
  have hGV : ∀ z ∈ V, (↿(nsResidual 1 u p)) z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    have := nsResidual_local_and_zero.1 1 u (fun _ _ => (0 : ℝ³)) p (fun _ _ => (0 : ℝ)) V hVo
      (fun w hw => huV w.1 w.2 hw) (fun w hw => hpV w.1 w.2 hw) z hz
    rw [this]
    exact nsResidual_local_and_zero.2 1 z.1 z.2
  
  have hNo : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) (ρ / 4) ×ˢ Ioi (1 - τ₀ / 4)) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.prod isOpen_Ioi
  have hGN : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) (ρ / 4) ×ˢ Ioi (1 - τ₀ / 4),
      (↿(nsResidual 1 u p)) z =
        (↿(nsResidual 1 (fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A w s) y + Bv y s) P)) z :=
    nsResidual_local_and_zero.1 1 u _ p P _ hNo
      (fun z hz => hNu z.1 z.2 (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hz.1) hz.2)
      (fun z hz => hNp z.1 z.2 (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hz.1) hz.2)
  have hflatG : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), ‖x‖ < δ →
      1 - δ < t → t < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(nsResidual 1 u p)) (x, t)‖ < ε := by
    intro m ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδb⟩ := hflat m ε hε
    refine ⟨min δ (min (ρ / 4) (τ₀ / 4)), lt_min hδ (lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)), ?_⟩
    intro x t hx ht1 ht2
    have h1 := min_le_left δ (min (ρ / 4) (τ₀ / 4))
    have h2 := min_le_right δ (min (ρ / 4) (τ₀ / 4))
    have h3 := min_le_left (ρ / 4) (τ₀ / 4)
    have h4 := min_le_right (ρ / 4) (τ₀ / 4)
    have hmem : ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) (ρ / 4) ×ˢ Ioi (1 - τ₀ / 4) :=
      ⟨mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr (by linarith), show 1 - τ₀ / 4 < t by linarith⟩
    have hev : (↿(nsResidual 1 u p)) =ᶠ[nhds (x, t)]
        ↿(nsResidual 1 (fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A w s) y + Bv y s) P) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hNo.mem_nhds hmem) hGN
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
    exact hδb x t (by linarith) (by linarith) ht2
  
  have hbdG : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C t₁ : ℝ, t₁ < 1 ∧ ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), δ ≤ ‖x‖ →
      t₁ < t → t < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(nsResidual 1 u p)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C := by
    intro δ hδ m
    obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ),
        S = {z | δ ≤ ‖z.1‖ ∧ ‖z.1‖ ≤ ρ / 2 ∧ 1 - τ₀ / 2 < z.2 ∧ z.2 < 1} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hSW : S ⊆ W := by
      intro z hz
      rw [hS] at hz
      rw [hW]
      exact ⟨mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr (by linarith [hz.2.1]),
        show 1 - τ₀ < z.2 by linarith [hz.2.2.1], hz.2.2.2⟩
    have hbA : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿A) z‖ ≤ C ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿Bv) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿P) z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbd δ hδ k
      refine ⟨C, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      rw [hS] at hz
      exact hC z.1 z.2 hz.1 hz.2.1 (by linarith [hz.2.2.1]) hz.2.2.2
    have hbc : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿c) z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hcbd k
      exact ⟨C, fun z _ => hC z⟩
    have hbA' : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿A') z‖ ≤ C := by
      have e : (↿A') = fun z =>
          (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) ((↿c) z) ((↿A) z) := by
        funext z
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, hA'] <;> rfl
      rw [e]
      exact iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on _ (↿c) (↿A) W S hWo hSW hcs.contDiffOn hAsW0
        hbc (fun k => (hbA k).imp (fun C hC z hz => (hC z hz).1))
    have hbB' : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿Bv') z‖ ≤ C := by
      have e : (↿Bv') = fun z =>
          (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) ((↿c) z) ((↿Bv) z) := by
        funext z
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, hBv'] <;> rfl
      rw [e]
      exact iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on _ (↿c) (↿Bv) W S hWo hSW hcs.contDiffOn hBsW0
        hbc (fun k => (hbA k).imp (fun C hC z hz => (hC z hz).2.1))
    have hbp : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿p) z‖ ≤ C := by
      have hPsW0 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿P) W := by rw [hW]; exact hPs
      have e : (↿p) = fun z =>
          (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) ((↿c) z) ((↿P) z) := by
        funext z
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hp] <;> rfl
      rw [e]
      exact iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on _ (↿c) (↿P) W S hWo hSW hcs.contDiffOn hPsW0
        hbc (fun k => (hbA k).imp (fun C hC z hz => (hC z hz).2.2))
    have hbu : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿u) z‖ ≤ C := by
      rw [hu]
      refine (curl_field_contDiffOn_bounded A' Bv' W S hWo hSW hAsW hBsW).2 ?_
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C1, h1⟩ := hbA' k
      obtain ⟨C2, h2⟩ := hbB' k
      exact ⟨max C1 C2, fun z hz =>
        ⟨(h1 z hz).trans (le_max_left _ _), (h2 z hz).trans (le_max_right _ _)⟩⟩
    have hbup : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿u) z‖ ≤ C ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿p) z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C1, h1⟩ := hbu k
      obtain ⟨C2, h2⟩ := hbp k
      exact ⟨max C1 C2, fun z hz =>
        ⟨(h1 z hz).trans (le_max_left _ _), (h2 z hz).trans (le_max_right _ _)⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := nsJet_iteratedFDeriv_bounded_on 1 u p W S hWo hSW huW hpW hbup m
    have hjet := (nsResidual_contDiffOn_eq_jet 1 u p W hWo huW hpW).2
    refine ⟨max C₀ 0, 1 - τ₀ / 2, by linarith, ?_⟩
    intro x t hx ht1 ht2
    by_cases hxr : ‖x‖ ≤ ρ / 2
    · have hzS : ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ S := by rw [hS]; exact ⟨hx, hxr, ht1, ht2⟩
      have hev : (↿(nsResidual 1 u p)) =ᶠ[nhds (x, t)] nsJet 1 u p :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hWo.mem_nhds (hSW hzS)) hjet
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
      exact (hC₀ _ hzS).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · have hzV : ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ V := by
        rw [hV]
        exact Or.inl (show ρ / 2 < ‖x‖ by linarith [not_le.mp hxr])
      have hev : (↿(nsResidual 1 u p)) =ᶠ[nhds (x, t)] fun _ => (0 : ℝ³) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hVo.mem_nhds hzV) hGV
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
      exact le_max_right _ _
  
  have hcauchy := uniform_cauchy_of_flat_and_bounded (↿(nsResidual 1 u p)) hGs hflatG hbdG
  
  exact ⟨ρ, u, p, hρ, hu_sm, hp_sm,
    fun x t _ h => ⟨huV x t (hinV x t h), hpV x t (hinV x t h)⟩, hdiv, hunb', hGs,
    fun x t _ h => hGV (x, t) (hinV x t h), hcauchy⟩

ns_blowup_flat_residual.definitions:
noncomputable def curl3 (F : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (x : ℝ³) : ℝ³ :=
  (fderiv ℝ F x (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) 2 - fderiv ℝ F x (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
  (fderiv ℝ F x (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) 0 - fderiv ℝ F x (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) 2) • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
  (fderiv ℝ F x (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) 1 - fderiv ℝ F x (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) 0) • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)


noncomputable def nsJet (ν : ℝ) (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (z : ℝ³ × ℝ) : ℝ³ :=
  fderiv ℝ (↿u) z ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ)) + fderiv ℝ (↿u) z ((↿u) z, (0 : ℝ))
    - ν • ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿u)) z (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))
        (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))
    + ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (↿p) z (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)

and_nodes.definitions_block:
noncomputable def curl3 (F : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (x : ℝ³) : ℝ³ :=
  (fderiv ℝ F x (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) 2 - fderiv ℝ F x (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
  (fderiv ℝ F x (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) 0 - fderiv ℝ F x (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) 2) • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
  (fderiv ℝ F x (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) 1 - fderiv ℝ F x (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) 0) • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)


noncomputable def nsJet (ν : ℝ) (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (z : ℝ³ × ℝ) : ℝ³ :=
  fderiv ℝ (↿u) z ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ)) + fderiv ℝ (↿u) z ((↿u) z, (0 : ℝ))
    - ν • ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿u)) z (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))
        (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))
    + ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (↿p) z (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)

subgoal_signatures.name: ns_local_blowup_field
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∃ (ρ τ₀ : ℝ) (A Bv : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (P : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ρ ∧ 0 < τ₀ ∧ τ₀ < 1 ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿A) (Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) ρ ×ˢ Ioo (1 - τ₀) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Bv) (Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) ρ ×ˢ Ioo (1 - τ₀) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿P) (Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) ρ ×ˢ Ioo (1 - τ₀) 1) ∧ (∀ x t, ‖x‖ < ρ → 1 - τ₀ < t → t < 1 → divergence (fun y => Bv y t) x = 0 ∧ inner ℝ x (Bv x t) = (0 : ℝ)) ∧ (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, δ ≤ ‖x‖ → ‖x‖ ≤ ρ / 2 → 1 - τ₀ < t → t < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿A) (x, t)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Bv) (x, t)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿P) (x, t)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x t, ‖x‖ < δ → 1 - δ < t → t < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(nsResidual 1 (fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A w s) y + Bv y s) P)) (x, t)‖ < ε) ∧ (∀ M δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ x t, ‖x‖ < δ ∧ 1 - δ < t ∧ t < 1 ∧ M < ‖curl3 (fun w => A w t) x + Bv x t‖)

subgoal_signatures.name: nsResidual_contDiffOn_eq_jet

proof.tactics:
by
  intro T₁ R G hGs hGv hGc
  have hO : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Iio T₁ : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Iio
  
  obtain ⟨N, hNU, hNR⟩ :=
    jet_limits_of_uniform_cauchy T₁ R (↿G) hGs (fun x t ht hx => hGv x t ht hx) hGc
  
  obtain ⟨hNrel, hNsm⟩ := jet_limits_smooth T₁ (↿G) N hGs hNU
  
  have hFjs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => N j x (fun _ => ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ)))) := by
    intro j
    exact (ContinuousMultilinearMap.apply ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => ℝ³ × ℝ) ℝ³
      (fun _ => ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ)))).contDiff.comp (hNsm j)
  have hFjR : ∀ j x, R ≤ ‖x‖ → N j x (fun _ => ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ))) = 0 := by
    intro j x hx
    rw [hNR j x hx]
    rfl
  
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦs, hΦR, hΦS, hΦjet⟩ :=
    borel_extension T₁ R (fun j x => N j x (fun _ => ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ)))) hFjs hFjR
  
  have hΦc := smooth_jet_uniform_left_continuity R T₁ Φ hΦs hΦR
  
  obtain ⟨hMrel, -⟩ :=
    jet_limits_smooth T₁ Φ (fun m x => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Φ (x, T₁)) hΦs.contDiffOn hΦc
  
  have hKsym := iteratedFDeriv_symm_of_contDiffOn (univ ×ˢ Iio T₁) (↿G) hO hGs
  have hNsym : ∀ m x (w : Fin m → ℝ³ × ℝ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)),
      N m x (w ∘ σ) = N m x w := by
    intro m x w σ
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun t => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿G) (x, t))
        (nhdsWithin T₁ (Iio T₁)) (nhds (N m x)) := by
      rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds]
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀, h⟩ := hNU m ε hε
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsLT ht₀] with t ht
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      exact h x t ht.1 ht.2
    have hT : ∀ v : Fin m → ℝ³ × ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun t => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿G) (x, t) v)
        (nhdsWithin T₁ (Iio T₁)) (nhds (N m x v)) := by
      intro v
      exact ((continuous_eval_const v).tendsto (N m x)).comp h1
    refine tendsto_nhds_unique (hT (w ∘ σ)) ?_
    refine (hT w).congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht
    exact (hKsym (x, t) ⟨mem_univ _, ht⟩ m w σ).symm
  have hMsym : ∀ m x (w : Fin m → ℝ³ × ℝ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)),
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Φ (x, T₁) (w ∘ σ) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Φ (x, T₁) w :=
    fun m x w σ => iteratedFDeriv_symm_of_contDiffOn univ Φ isOpen_univ hΦs.contDiffOn
      (x, T₁) (mem_univ _) m w σ
  
  have hNM := jet_eq_zero_of_time_jet_zero (fun m x => N m x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Φ (x, T₁))
    (by
      intro m x
      have := (hNrel m x).sub (hMrel m x)
      convert this using 1
      ext v w
      simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryLeft_apply])
    (by
      intro m x w σ
      simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.sub_apply]
      rw [hNsym m x w σ, hMsym m x w σ])
    (by
      intro m x
      simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.sub_apply]
      rw [hΦjet m x]
      exact sub_self _)
  have hNeq : ∀ m x, N m x = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Φ (x, T₁) := fun m x => sub_eq_zero.mp (hNM m x)
  
  let W : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ³ := fun z => if z.2 < T₁ then (↿G) z - Φ z else 0
  have hWeq : ∀ z ∈ (univ ×ˢ Iio T₁ : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)), W z = (↿G) z - Φ z :=
    fun z hz => if_pos hz.2
  have hWs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ W (univ ×ˢ Iio T₁) := (hGs.sub hΦs.contDiffOn).congr hWeq
  have hW0 : ∀ x t, T₁ ≤ t → W (x, t) = 0 := fun x t ht => if_neg (not_lt.mpr ht)
  have hWflat : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ t₀ < T₁, ∀ x : ℝ³, ∀ t : ℝ, t₀ < t → t < T₁ →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m W (x, t)‖ < ε := by
    intro m ε hε
    obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁, h1⟩ := hNU m (ε / 2) (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨t₂, ht₂, h2⟩ := hΦc m (ε / 2) (by linarith)
    refine ⟨max t₁ t₂, max_lt ht₁ ht₂, fun x t ht htc => ?_⟩
    have hmem : (x, t) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Iio T₁ : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) := ⟨mem_univ _, htc⟩
    have hev : W =ᶠ[nhds (x, t)] fun z => (↿G) z - Φ z :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hmem) hWeq
    have hGat : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (↿G) (x, t) := hGs.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hmem)
    have hD : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m W (x, t) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿G) (x, t) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Φ (x, t) := by
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
      exact iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply (hGat.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        ((hΦs.contDiffAt).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    rw [hD]
    have e1 := h1 x t (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) ht) htc
    have e2 := h2 x t (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) ht) htc
    rw [hNeq] at e1
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿G) (x, t) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Φ (x, t)‖
        = ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿G) (x, t) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Φ (x, T₁)) -
            (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Φ (x, t) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Φ (x, T₁))‖ := by
          congr 1; abel
      _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿G) (x, t) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Φ (x, T₁)‖ +
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Φ (x, t) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Φ (x, T₁)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ < ε := by linarith
  
  have hWsm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W := flat_glue_contDiff T₁ W hWs hW0 hWflat
  
  refine ⟨fun x t => Φ (x, t) + W (x, t), ?_, ?_, ?_, ⟨T₁ + 1, ?_⟩⟩
  · have hfun : (↿(fun x t => Φ (x, t) + W (x, t))) = fun z => Φ z + W z := by
      funext z
      rfl
    rw [hfun]
    exact hΦs.add hWsm
  · intro x t ht
    show Φ (x, t) + (if t < T₁ then G x t - Φ (x, t) else 0) = G x t
    rw [if_pos ht]
    abel
  · intro x t hx
    show Φ (x, t) + (if t < T₁ then G x t - Φ (x, t) else 0) = 0
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [hGv x t h hx, hΦR x t hx]
      simp
    · rw [hΦR x t hx]
      simp
  · intro x t ht
    show Φ (x, t) + W (x, t) = 0
    rw [hΦS x t ht, hW0 x t (by linarith)]
    simp

signature.statement: ∀ (ν₀ ν T R : ℝ) (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³), 0 < ν₀ → 0 < ν → BlowupPackage ν₀ T R u p f → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ∃ (T' : ℝ) (u' : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p' : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (f' : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³), BlowupPackage ν T' ρ u' p' f'

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ν₀ ν T R u p f hν₀ hν hP ρ hρ
  unfold BlowupPackage at hP
  obtain ⟨hT, hR, hu, hp, hf, hvan, hinit, hfvan, ⟨S, hfS⟩, hres, hdiv, hunb⟩ := hP
  
  have hG : ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (G : ℝ³ → E) (c k : ℝ),
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => c • G (k • z)) = fun z => (c * k) • fderiv ℝ G (k • z) := by
    intro E _ _ G c k
    have h1 : (fun z => c • G (k • z)) = c • (fun z => G (k • z)) := rfl
    rw [h1, fderiv_const_smul_field]
    funext z
    rw [Pi.smul_apply, fderiv_comp_smul, smul_smul]
  
  have hLap : ∀ (v : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (c k : ℝ) (x : ℝ³),
      Δ (fun z => c • v (k • z)) x = (c * k * k) • Δ v (k • x) := by
    intro v c k x
    rw [InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_orthonormalBasis (fun z => c • v (k • z))
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ),
      InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_orthonormalBasis v
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)]
    simp only [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
    have e1 : fderiv ℝ (fun z => c • v (k • z)) = fun z => (c * k) • fderiv ℝ v (k • z) :=
      hG v c k
    have e2 : fderiv ℝ (fun z => (c * k) • fderiv ℝ v (k • z))
        = fun z => (c * k * k) • fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) (k • z) := hG (fderiv ℝ v) (c * k) k
    rw [e1, e2]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, Finset.smul_sum]
  
  have hGrad : ∀ (q : ℝ³ → ℝ) (c k : ℝ) (x : ℝ³),
      gradient (fun z => c • q (k • z)) x = (c * k) • gradient q (k • x) := by
    intro q c k x
    have e1 : fderiv ℝ (fun z => c • q (k • z)) = fun z => (c * k) • fderiv ℝ q (k • z) :=
      hG q c k
    simp only [gradient, e1]
    rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.map_smulₛₗ]
    simp
  
  have hDiv : ∀ (v : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (c k : ℝ) (x : ℝ³),
      divergence (fun y => c • v (k • y)) x = (c * k) * divergence v (k • x) := by
    intro v c k x
    have e1 : fderiv ℝ (fun z => c • v (k • z)) = fun z => (c * k) • fderiv ℝ v (k • z) :=
      hG v c k
    simp only [divergence, e1]
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  
  obtain ⟨k, hkdef⟩ : ∃ k : ℝ, k = R / ρ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨a, hadef⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = ν * k / ν₀ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨μ, hμdef⟩ : ∃ μ : ℝ, μ = a * k := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hk : 0 < k := by rw [hkdef]; exact div_pos hR hρ
  have ha : 0 < a := by rw [hadef]; exact div_pos (mul_pos hν hk) hν₀
  have hμ : 0 < μ := by rw [hμdef]; exact mul_pos ha hk
  have hkρ : k * ρ = R := by rw [hkdef]; field_simp
  have haν : ν * k = a * ν₀ := by rw [hadef]; field_simp
  have hτ : ∀ t : ℝ, t < T / μ → μ * t < T := by
    intro t ht
    have := (lt_div_iff₀ hμ).1 ht
    linarith
  have hσ : ∀ x : ℝ³, ρ ≤ ‖x‖ → R ≤ ‖k • x‖ := by
    intro x hx
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hk.le, ← hkρ]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx hk.le
  
  have hNS : ∀ x t, nsResidual ν (fun y s => a • u (k • y) (μ * s))
      (fun y s => (a ^ 2) • p (k • y) (μ * s)) x t
      = (a ^ 2 * k) • nsResidual ν₀ u p (k • x) (μ * t) := by
    intro x t
    have e1 : deriv (fun s => a • u (k • x) (μ * s)) t
        = (a * μ) • deriv (fun s => u (k • x) s) (μ * t) := by
      have h1 : (fun s => a • u (k • x) (μ * s)) = a • (fun s => u (k • x) (μ * s)) := rfl
      rw [h1, deriv_const_smul_field, deriv_comp_mul_left μ (u (k • x)) t, smul_smul]
    have hGu : fderiv ℝ (fun z => a • u (k • z) (μ * t))
        = fun z => (a * k) • fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y (μ * t)) (k • z) :=
      hG (fun y => u y (μ * t)) a k
    have e2 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => a • u (k • y) (μ * t)) x (a • u (k • x) (μ * t))
        = (a * k * a) • fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y (μ * t)) (k • x) (u (k • x) (μ * t)) := by
      rw [hGu]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul, smul_smul]
      rw [mul_comm a (a * k)]
    have e3 : Δ (fun y => a • u (k • y) (μ * t)) x
        = (a * k * k) • Δ (fun y => u y (μ * t)) (k • x) :=
      hLap (fun y => u y (μ * t)) a k x
    have e4 : gradient (fun y => (a ^ 2) • p (k • y) (μ * t)) x
        = (a ^ 2 * k) • gradient (fun y => p y (μ * t)) (k • x) :=
      hGrad (fun y => p y (μ * t)) (a ^ 2) k x
    have c1 : a * μ = a ^ 2 * k := by rw [hμdef]; ring
    have c2 : a * k * a = a ^ 2 * k := by ring
    have c3 : ν * (a * k * k) = a ^ 2 * k * ν₀ := by linear_combination (a * k) * haν
    show deriv (fun s => a • u (k • x) (μ * s)) t
        + fderiv ℝ (fun y => a • u (k • y) (μ * t)) x (a • u (k • x) (μ * t))
        - ν • Δ (fun y => a • u (k • y) (μ * t)) x
        + gradient (fun y => (a ^ 2) • p (k • y) (μ * t)) x
      = (a ^ 2 * k) • (deriv (fun s => u (k • x) s) (μ * t)
        + fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y (μ * t)) (k • x) (u (k • x) (μ * t))
        - ν₀ • Δ (fun y => u y (μ * t)) (k • x) + gradient (fun y => p y (μ * t)) (k • x))
    rw [e1, e2, e3, e4, c1, c2, smul_smul, c3]
    module
  
  have hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (k • z.1, μ * z.2)) :=
    (contDiff_fst.const_smul k).prodMk (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_snd)
  have hsmooth : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (g : ℝ³ → ℝ → F) (c : ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) => c • g (k • x) (μ * t))) (univ ×ˢ Iio (T / μ)) := by
    intro F _ _ g c hg
    have hmaps : MapsTo (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (k • z.1, μ * z.2)) (univ ×ˢ Iio (T / μ))
        (univ ×ˢ Iio T) := by
      rintro ⟨x, t⟩ ⟨_, ht⟩
      refine ⟨mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      have ht' : t < T / μ := ht
      exact hτ t ht'
    exact (hg.comp hφ.contDiffOn hmaps).const_smul c
  refine ⟨T / μ, fun x t => a • u (k • x) (μ * t), fun x t => (a ^ 2) • p (k • x) (μ * t),
    fun x t => (a ^ 2 * k) • f (k • x) (μ * t), ?_⟩
  unfold BlowupPackage
  refine ⟨div_pos hT hμ, hρ, hsmooth u a hu, hsmooth p (a ^ 2) hp, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (hf.comp hφ).const_smul (a ^ 2 * k)
  · intro x t ht hx
    obtain ⟨hu0, hp0⟩ := hvan (k • x) (μ * t) (hτ t ht) (hσ x hx)
    simp [hu0, hp0]
  · intro x
    simp [hinit]
  · intro x t h
    have h' : R ≤ ‖k • x‖ ∨ μ * t ≤ 0 := by
      rcases h with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (hσ x h)
      · right; nlinarith
    simp [hfvan _ _ h']
  · refine ⟨S / μ, fun x t ht => ?_⟩
    have h1 : S ≤ t * μ := (div_le_iff₀ hμ).1 ht
    have h2 : S ≤ μ * t := by linarith
    simp [hfS _ _ h2]
  · intro x t ht
    rw [hNS x t, hres _ _ (hτ t ht)]
  · intro x t ht
    have h2 : divergence (fun y => a • u (k • y) (μ * t)) x
        = a * k * divergence (fun z => u z (μ * t)) (k • x) := hDiv (fun z => u z (μ * t)) a k x
    show divergence (fun y => a • u (k • y) (μ * t)) x = 0
    rw [h2, hdiv _ _ (hτ t ht), mul_zero]
  · intro M
    obtain ⟨x₀, t₀, ht0, htT, hM⟩ := hunb (M / a)
    refine ⟨k⁻¹ • x₀, t₀ / μ, div_nonneg ht0 hμ.le, div_lt_div_of_pos_right htT hμ, ?_⟩
    show M < ‖a • u (k • (k⁻¹ • x₀)) (μ * (t₀ / μ))‖
    have e : μ * (t₀ / μ) = t₀ := by field_simp
    rw [smul_inv_smul₀ hk.ne', e, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ha.le]
    have hMa : M = a * (M / a) := by field_simp
    rw [hMa]
    exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hM ha

signature.name: force_decay_of_compact_support
signature.statement: ∀ (f : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (R S : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ (↿f) → (∀ x t, R ≤ ‖x‖ → f x t = 0) → (∀ x t, S ≤ t → f x t = 0) → ForceConditionDecay f

proof.tactics:
by
  intro f R S hF hR hS
  have hU : ∀ z : ℝ³ × ℝ, (R < ‖z.1‖ ∨ S < z.2) → ∀ m : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) z = 0 := by
    intro z hz m
    let U : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ) := {w | R < ‖w.1‖} ∪ {w | S < w.2}
    have hUo : IsOpen U :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_norm.comp continuous_fst)).union
        (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_snd)
    have hFU : ∀ w ∈ U, (↿f) w = (fun _ => (0 : ℝ³)) w := by
      rintro ⟨y, τ⟩ hw
      rcases hw with hw | hw
      · exact hR y τ (le_of_lt hw)
      · exact hS y τ (le_of_lt hw)
    have hev : (↿f) =ᶠ[nhds z] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ³)) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hz) hFU
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
    rfl
  have hm : ∀ m : ℕ, (m : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := fun m => by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hs : UniqueDiffOn ℝ (univ ×ˢ Ici (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) :=
    uniqueDiffOn_univ.prod (uniqueDiffOn_Ici 0)
  refine ⟨⟨hF.contDiffOn⟩, fun m K => ?_⟩
  have hcont : Continuous fun z => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) z :=
    hF.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (hm m)
  have hQ : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (0:ℝ³) |R| ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) |S|) :=
    (isCompact_closedBall 0 |R|).prod isCompact_Icc
  obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := hQ.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hcont.continuousOn
  have hM : 0 ≤ max M₀ 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hL : 1 ≤ 1 + |R| + |S| := by
    have := abs_nonneg R
    have := abs_nonneg S
    linarith
  refine ⟨max M₀ 0 * (1 + |R| + |S|) ^ |K|, fun x t ht => ?_⟩
  have ht' : (0:ℝ) ≤ t := ht
  have hb : 1 ≤ 1 + ‖x‖ + t := by
    have := norm_nonneg x
    linarith
  have hb0 : 0 < 1 + ‖x‖ + t := by linarith
  have hbK : 0 < (1 + ‖x‖ + t) ^ K := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hb0 K
  have hmemS : ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ici (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) :=
    ⟨mem_univ x, show t ∈ Ici (0:ℝ) from ht'⟩
  rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_iteratedFDeriv hs (hF.contDiffAt.of_le (hm m)) hmemS]
  by_cases hc : R < ‖x‖ ∨ S < t
  · rw [hU (x, t) hc m, norm_zero]
    exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hM (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)) hbK.le
  · push_neg at hc
    obtain ⟨hx, htS⟩ := hc
    have hxR : ‖x‖ ≤ |R| := hx.trans (le_abs_self R)
    have htS' : t ≤ |S| := htS.trans (le_abs_self S)
    have hmem : (x, t) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0:ℝ³) |R| ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) |S| := by
      refine ⟨?_, ht', htS'⟩
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      exact hxR
    have h1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) (x, t)‖ ≤ max M₀ 0 :=
      (hM₀ _ hmem).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have key : (1 + ‖x‖ + t) ^ K ≤ (1 + |R| + |S|) ^ |K| :=
      (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hb (le_abs_self K)).trans
        (Real.rpow_le_rpow hb0.le (by linarith) (abs_nonneg K))
    refine h1.trans ?_
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hbK]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left key hM

signature.name: force_periodic_of_bounded_derivs
signature.statement: ∀ (F : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (S : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ (↿F) → (∀ t, IsOnePeriodic (fun x => F x t)) → (∀ x t, S ≤ t → F x t = 0) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (x, t)‖ ≤ M) → ForceConditionPeriodic F

proof.tactics:
by
  intro F S hF hper hS hbd
  refine { smooth := hF.contDiffOn, isOnePeriodic := fun t _ => hper t, decay := ?_ }
  intro m K
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hbd m
  set M' : ℝ := max M 0 with hM'
  have hM'0 : 0 ≤ M' := le_max_right M 0
  refine ⟨M' * (1 + |S|) ^ |K|, ?_⟩
  intro x t ht
  have hC : 0 ≤ M' * (1 + |S|) ^ |K| :=
    mul_nonneg hM'0 (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _)
  have hUD : UniqueDiffOn ℝ ((univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Ici (0:ℝ)) :=
    uniqueDiffOn_univ.prod (uniqueDiffOn_Ici 0)
  have hCA : ContDiffAt ℝ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) (↿F) (x, t) :=
    hF.contDiffAt.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hmem : (x, t) ∈ (univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Ici (0:ℝ) := ⟨mem_univ x, ht⟩
  rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_iteratedFDeriv hUD hCA hmem]
  have h1t : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + t := by linarith
  have hw : 0 < (1 + t) ^ K := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith) K
  rcases le_or_gt t S with hts | hst
  · have hb : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (x, t)‖ ≤ M' := le_trans (hM x t ht) (le_max_left M 0)
    refine le_trans hb ?_
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hw]
    have h2 : (1 + t) ^ K ≤ (1 + t) ^ |K| := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h1t (le_abs_self K)
    have h3 : (1 + t) ^ |K| ≤ (1 + |S|) ^ |K| :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow (by linarith) (by linarith [le_abs_self S]) (abs_nonneg K)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_trans h2 h3) hM'0
  · have hU : IsOpen {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | S < z.2} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_snd
    have hev : (↿F) =ᶠ[nhds (x, t)] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ³)) := by
      filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds (show (x, t) ∈ {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | S < z.2} from hst)] with z hz
      exact hS z.1 z.2 (le_of_lt hz)
    have hz : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (x, t) = 0 := by
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
      rfl
    rw [hz, norm_zero]
    exact div_nonneg hC hw.le

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (ν T : ℝ) (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³), BlowupPackage ν T (1/4) u p f → ∃ (U : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (P : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (F : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (S : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿P) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (↿F) ∧ (∀ t, t < T → IsOnePeriodic (fun x => U x t)) ∧ (∀ t, t < T → IsOnePeriodic (fun x => P x t)) ∧ (∀ t, IsOnePeriodic (fun x => F x t)) ∧ (∀ x, U x 0 = 0) ∧ (∀ x t, t < T → nsResidual ν U P x t = F x t) ∧ (∀ x t, t < T → divergence (fun y => U y t) x = 0) ∧ (∀ x t, S ≤ t → F x t = 0) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (x, t)‖ ≤ M) ∧ (∀ M : ℝ, ∃ x t, 0 ≤ t ∧ t < T ∧ ‖x‖ ≤ 1/4 ∧ M < ‖U x t‖)

signature.name: periodize_blowup_package
signature.statement: ∀ (ν T : ℝ) (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³), BlowupPackage ν T (1/4) u p f → ∃ (U : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (P : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (F : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (S : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿P) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (↿F) ∧ (∀ t, t < T → IsOnePeriodic (fun x => U x t)) ∧ (∀ t, t < T → IsOnePeriodic (fun x => P x t)) ∧ (∀ t, IsOnePeriodic (fun x => F x t)) ∧ (∀ x, U x 0 = 0) ∧ (∀ x t, t < T → nsResidual ν U P x t = F x t) ∧ (∀ x t, t < T → divergence (fun y => U y t) x = 0) ∧ (∀ x t, S ≤ t → F x t = 0) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (x, t)‖ ≤ M) ∧ (∀ M : ℝ, ∃ x t, 0 ≤ t ∧ t < T ∧ ‖x‖ ≤ 1/4 ∧ M < ‖U x t‖)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ν T u p f h
  obtain ⟨hT, -, hu, hp, hf, hvan, hinit, hfvan, ⟨S, hfS⟩, hres, hdiv, hunb⟩ := h
  
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ σ : ℝ³ → ℝ³, ∀ x j, (σ x).ofLp j = (round (x.ofLp j) : ℝ) :=
    ⟨fun x => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => (round (x.ofLp j) : ℝ)), fun x j => rfl⟩
  
  have hK2 : ∀ (y : ℝ) (n : ℤ), |y - n| < 1/2 → round y = n := by
    intro y n hy
    rw [round_eq, Int.floor_eq_iff]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hy
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hcoord : ∀ (x : ℝ³) (j : Fin 3), |x.ofLp j| ≤ ‖x‖ := by
    intro x j
    have := PiLp.norm_apply_le x j
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
  
  have hper : ∀ (x : ℝ³) (i : Fin 3),
      (x + EuclideanSpace.single i 1) - σ (x + EuclideanSpace.single i 1) = x - σ x := by
    intro x i
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro j
    simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.add_apply, hσ]
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst hji
      simp [round_add_one]
    · simp [hji]
  
  have hsmall : ∀ x : ℝ³, ‖x‖ < 1/2 → σ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro j
    have hlt : |x.ofLp j - ((0 : ℤ) : ℝ)| < 1/2 := by
      rw [Int.cast_zero, sub_zero]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hcoord x j) hx
    rw [hσ, hK2 _ _ hlt]
    simp
  
  have hloc : ∀ {E : Type} [Zero E] (G : ℝ³ → ℝ → E) (I : Set ℝ), IsOpen I →
      (∀ x t, t ∈ I → 1/4 ≤ ‖x‖ → G x t = 0) → ∀ (x₀ : ℝ³) (t₀ : ℝ), t₀ ∈ I →
      (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => G (z.1 - σ z.1) z.2) =ᶠ[nhds (x₀, t₀)]
        (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => G (z.1 - σ x₀) z.2) := by
    intro E _ G I hI hG x₀ t₀ ht₀
    have hN : Metric.ball x₀ (1/8) ×ˢ I ∈ nhds (x₀, t₀) :=
      prod_mem_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ (by norm_num)) (hI.mem_nhds ht₀)
    filter_upwards [hN] with z hz
    rw [Set.mem_prod] at hz
    obtain ⟨hz1, hz2⟩ := hz
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz1
    show G (z.1 - σ z.1) z.2 = G (z.1 - σ x₀) z.2
    by_cases hk : σ z.1 = σ x₀
    · rw [hk]
    · have ha : 1/4 ≤ ‖z.1 - σ z.1‖ := by
        by_contra hlt
        push_neg at hlt
        apply hk
        apply PiLp.ext
        intro j
        rw [hσ, hσ]
        have h1 := hcoord (z.1 - σ z.1) j
        have h2 := hcoord (z.1 - x₀) j
        rw [PiLp.sub_apply, hσ] at h1
        rw [PiLp.sub_apply] at h2
        obtain ⟨e1, e1'⟩ := abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt h1 hlt)
        obtain ⟨e2, e2'⟩ := abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt h2 hz1)
        have : round (x₀.ofLp j) = round (z.1.ofLp j) :=
          hK2 _ _ (by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith)
        rw [this]
      have hb : 1/4 ≤ ‖z.1 - σ x₀‖ := by
        by_contra hlt
        push_neg at hlt
        apply hk
        apply PiLp.ext
        intro j
        rw [hσ, hσ]
        have h1 := hcoord (z.1 - σ x₀) j
        rw [PiLp.sub_apply, hσ] at h1
        have e1 := lt_of_le_of_lt h1 hlt
        have : round (z.1.ofLp j) = round (x₀.ofLp j) := hK2 _ _ (by linarith)
        rw [this]
      rw [hG _ _ hz2 ha, hG _ _ hz2 hb]
  
  have htr : ∀ (U : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (P : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (k x₀ : ℝ³) (t₀ : ℝ),
      (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => U z.1 z.2) =ᶠ[nhds (x₀, t₀)] (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => u (z.1 - k) z.2) →
      (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => P z.1 z.2) =ᶠ[nhds (x₀, t₀)] (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => p (z.1 - k) z.2) →
      nsResidual ν U P x₀ t₀ = nsResidual ν u p (x₀ - k) t₀ ∧
        divergence (fun y => U y t₀) x₀ = divergence (fun y => u y t₀) (x₀ - k) := by
    intro U P k x₀ t₀ hU hP
    have hcx : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ³ => (y, t₀)) (nhds x₀) (nhds (x₀, t₀)) :=
      (Continuous.prodMk_left t₀).tendsto x₀
    have hct : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (x₀, s)) (nhds t₀) (nhds (x₀, t₀)) :=
      (Continuous.prodMk_right x₀).tendsto t₀
    have h1 : (fun y => U y t₀) =ᶠ[nhds x₀] (fun y => u (y - k) t₀) := hU.comp_tendsto hcx
    have h2 : (fun s => U x₀ s) =ᶠ[nhds t₀] (fun s => u (x₀ - k) s) := hU.comp_tendsto hct
    have h3 : (fun y => P y t₀) =ᶠ[nhds x₀] (fun y => p (y - k) t₀) := hP.comp_tendsto hcx
    have h4 : U x₀ t₀ = u (x₀ - k) t₀ := hU.eq_of_nhds
    have hD : fderiv ℝ (fun y => U y t₀) x₀ = fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t₀) (x₀ - k) := by
      rw [h1.fderiv_eq]
      exact fderiv_comp_sub (f := fun y => u y t₀) k
    have hG : gradient (fun y => P y t₀) x₀ = gradient (fun y => p y t₀) (x₀ - k) := by
      rw [h3.gradient_eq]
      unfold gradient
      rw [fderiv_comp_sub (f := fun y => p y t₀) k]
    have hL : Δ (fun y => U y t₀) x₀ = Δ (fun y => u y t₀) (x₀ - k) := by
      rw [(laplacian_congr_nhds h1).eq_of_nhds]
      rw [laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_stdOrthonormalBasis,
        laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_stdOrthonormalBasis]
      have := iteratedFDeriv_comp_sub (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun y => u y t₀) 2 k x₀
      simp only [this]
    have hd : deriv (fun s => U x₀ s) t₀ = deriv (fun s => u (x₀ - k) s) t₀ := h2.deriv_eq
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold nsResidual
      rw [hd, hD, h4, hL, hG]
    · unfold divergence
      rw [hD]
  
  have hcd : ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (g G : ℝ³ × ℝ → E)
      (I : Set ℝ) (k : ℝ³) (z₀ : ℝ³ × ℝ), IsOpen I → z₀.2 ∈ I → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (univ ×ˢ I) →
      G =ᶠ[nhds z₀] (fun z => g (z.1 - k, z.2)) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ G z₀ := by
    intro E _ _ g G I k z₀ hI hz hg hG
    have hτ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (z.1 - k, z.2)) :=
      (contDiff_fst.sub contDiff_const).prodMk contDiff_snd
    have hmem : (z₀.1 - k, z₀.2) ∈ (univ ×ˢ I : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) := by
      rw [Set.mem_prod]
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, hz⟩
    have hgat : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g (z₀.1 - k, z₀.2) :=
      hg.contDiffAt ((isOpen_univ.prod hI).mem_nhds hmem)
    have hcomp : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => g (z.1 - k, z.2)) z₀ := hgat.comp z₀ hτ.contDiffAt
    exact hcomp.congr_of_eventuallyEq hG
  
  have hit : ∀ (g G : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ³) (k : ℝ³) (z₀ : ℝ³ × ℝ) (m : ℕ),
      G =ᶠ[nhds z₀] (fun z => g (z.1 - k, z.2)) →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m G z₀ = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g (z₀.1 - k, z₀.2) := by
    intro g G k z₀ m hG
    rw [(hG.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
    have e : (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => g (z.1 - k, z.2)) = fun z => g (z - ((k, 0) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) := by
      funext z
      congr 1
      exact Prod.ext (by simp) (by simp)
    rw [e, iteratedFDeriv_comp_sub (f := g) m ((k, 0) : ℝ³ × ℝ) z₀]
    congr 1
    exact Prod.ext (by simp) (by simp)
  
  have hbd : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ z : ℝ³ × ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) z‖ ≤ M := by
    intro m
    have hcs : HasCompactSupport (↿f) := by
      apply HasCompactSupport.intro
        ((isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℝ³) (1/4)).prod (isCompact_Icc (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := S)))
      intro z hz
      show f z.1 z.2 = 0
      by_contra hne
      apply hz
      rw [Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_Icc, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · by_contra hc
        exact hne (hfvan _ _ (Or.inl (not_le.mp hc).le))
      · by_contra hc
        exact hne (hfvan _ _ (Or.inr (not_le.mp hc).le))
      · by_contra hc
        exact hne (hfS _ _ (not_le.mp hc).le)
    exact (hcs.iteratedFDeriv m).exists_bound_of_continuous
      (ContDiff.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (m := m) (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hf)
  
  have gU : ∀ x₀ t₀, t₀ < T → (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => u (z.1 - σ z.1) z.2) =ᶠ[nhds (x₀, t₀)]
      (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => u (z.1 - σ x₀) z.2) := fun x₀ t₀ ht =>
    hloc u (Iio T) isOpen_Iio (fun x t ht hx => (hvan x t ht hx).1) x₀ t₀ ht
  have gP : ∀ x₀ t₀, t₀ < T → (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => p (z.1 - σ z.1) z.2) =ᶠ[nhds (x₀, t₀)]
      (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => p (z.1 - σ x₀) z.2) := fun x₀ t₀ ht =>
    hloc p (Iio T) isOpen_Iio (fun x t ht hx => (hvan x t ht hx).2) x₀ t₀ ht
  have gF : ∀ x₀ t₀, (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => f (z.1 - σ z.1) z.2) =ᶠ[nhds (x₀, t₀)]
      (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => f (z.1 - σ x₀) z.2) := fun x₀ t₀ =>
    hloc f univ isOpen_univ (fun x t _ hx => hfvan x t (Or.inl hx)) x₀ t₀ (mem_univ _)
  refine ⟨fun x t => u (x - σ x) t, fun x t => p (x - σ x) t, fun x t => f (x - σ x) t, S,
    ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_prod] at hz
    exact (hcd (↿u) (↿(fun x t => u (x - σ x) t)) (Iio T) (σ z.1) z isOpen_Iio hz.2 hu
      (gU z.1 z.2 hz.2)).contDiffWithinAt
  · intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_prod] at hz
    exact (hcd (↿p) (↿(fun x t => p (x - σ x) t)) (Iio T) (σ z.1) z isOpen_Iio hz.2 hp
      (gP z.1 z.2 hz.2)).contDiffWithinAt
  · exact contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.2 (fun z =>
      hcd (↿f) (↿(fun x t => f (x - σ x) t)) univ (σ z.1) z isOpen_univ (mem_univ _)
        hf.contDiffOn (gF z.1 z.2))
  · intro t _ x i
    show u (x + EuclideanSpace.single i 1 - σ (x + EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) t = u (x - σ x) t
    rw [hper]
  · intro t _ x i
    show p (x + EuclideanSpace.single i 1 - σ (x + EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) t = p (x - σ x) t
    rw [hper]
  · intro t x i
    show f (x + EuclideanSpace.single i 1 - σ (x + EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) t = f (x - σ x) t
    rw [hper]
  · intro x
    exact hinit _
  · intro x t ht
    rw [(htr (fun x t => u (x - σ x) t) (fun x t => p (x - σ x) t) (σ x) x t
      (gU x t ht) (gP x t ht)).1]
    exact hres _ _ ht
  · intro x t ht
    rw [(htr (fun x t => u (x - σ x) t) (fun x t => p (x - σ x) t) (σ x) x t
      (gU x t ht) (gP x t ht)).2]
    exact hdiv _ _ ht
  · intro x t ht
    exact hfS _ _ ht
  · intro m
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hbd m
    refine ⟨M, fun x t _ => ?_⟩
    rw [hit (↿f) (↿(fun x t => f (x - σ x) t)) (σ x) (x, t) m (gF x t)]
    exact hM _
  · intro M
    obtain ⟨x, t, ht0, htT, hgt⟩ := hunb (max M 0)
    have hx : ‖x‖ < 1/4 := by
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      rw [(hvan x t htT hc).1, norm_zero] at hgt
      linarith [le_max_right M 0]
    have hs : σ x = 0 := hsmall x (by linarith)
    refine ⟨x, t, ht0, htT, hx.le, ?_⟩
    show M < ‖u (x - σ x) t‖
    rw [hs, sub_zero]
    linarith [le_max_left M 0]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (ν T R : ℝ) (u v : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p P : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³), 0 < ν → 0 < T → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) → (∀ x t, t < T → R ≤ ‖x‖ → u x t = 0 ∧ p x t = 0) → (∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → t < T → nsResidual ν u p x t = f x t) → (∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → t < T → divergence (fun y => u y t) x = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿v) (univ ×ˢ Ici 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿P) (univ ×ˢ Ici 0) → (∀ x, ∀ t ≥ 0, derivWithin (v x ·) (Ici 0) t + fderiv ℝ (v · t) x (v x t) = ν • Δ (v · t) x - gradient (P · t) x + f x t) → (∀ x, ∀ t ≥ 0, divergence (v · t) x = 0) → (∀ t ≥ 0, MemLp (fun x => ‖v x t‖) 2) → (∃ E, ∀ t ≥ 0, (∫ x, ‖v x t‖ ^ 2) < E) → (∀ x, v x 0 = u x 0) → ∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → t < T → v x t = u x t

signature.name: rn_weak_strong_uniqueness
signature.statement: ∀ (ν T R : ℝ) (u v : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p P : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³), 0 < ν → 0 < T → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) → (∀ x t, t < T → R ≤ ‖x‖ → u x t = 0 ∧ p x t = 0) → (∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → t < T → nsResidual ν u p x t = f x t) → (∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → t < T → divergence (fun y => u y t) x = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿v) (univ ×ˢ Ici 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿P) (univ ×ˢ Ici 0) → (∀ x, ∀ t ≥ 0, derivWithin (v x ·) (Ici 0) t + fderiv ℝ (v · t) x (v x t) = ν • Δ (v · t) x - gradient (P · t) x + f x t) → (∀ x, ∀ t ≥ 0, divergence (v · t) x = 0) → (∀ t ≥ 0, MemLp (fun x => ‖v x t‖) 2) → (∃ E, ∀ t ≥ 0, (∫ x, ‖v x t‖ ^ 2) < E) → (∀ x, v x 0 = u x 0) → ∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → t < T → v x t = u x t

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ν T R u v p P f hν hT hu hp hvan hres hdivu hv hP hns hdivv hL2 hEx hinit x₀ t₀ ht₀ ht₀T
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := hEx
  
  obtain ⟨T₁, hT₁pos, hT₁T, ht₀T₁⟩ : ∃ T₁ : ℝ, 0 < T₁ ∧ T₁ < T ∧ t₀ ≤ T₁ :=
    ⟨(t₀ + T) / 2, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hsubIio : (univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Icc 0 T₁ ⊆ (univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Iio T :=
    fun z hz => ⟨mem_univ _, lt_of_le_of_lt hz.2.2 hT₁T⟩
  have hsubIci : (univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Icc 0 T₁ ⊆ (univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Ici 0 :=
    fun z hz => ⟨mem_univ _, hz.2.1⟩
  have huI : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) (univ ×ˢ Icc 0 T₁) := hu.mono hsubIio
  have hpI : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) (univ ×ˢ Icc 0 T₁) := hp.mono hsubIio
  have hvI : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿v) (univ ×ˢ Icc 0 T₁) := hv.mono hsubIci
  have hPI : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿P) (univ ×ˢ Icc 0 T₁) := hP.mono hsubIci
  have hwI : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x t => v x t - u x t)) (univ ×ˢ Icc 0 T₁) := hvI.sub huI
  have hπI : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x t => P x t - p x t)) (univ ×ˢ Icc 0 T₁) := hPI.sub hpI
  have slice : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (G : ℝ³ → ℝ → F)
      (S : Set ℝ) (t : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) (univ ×ˢ S) → t ∈ S →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y t) := by
    intro F _ _ G S t hG ht
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => (y, t)) := contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const
    exact contDiffOn_univ.mp (hG.comp h1.contDiffOn (fun y _ => ⟨mem_univ _, ht⟩))
  have hcomp : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ G : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) (univ ×ˢ Icc 0 T₁) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun y s => G y s i)) (univ ×ˢ Icc 0 T₁) := by
    intro i G hG
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hG
  have hgI : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (↿(fun y s => v y s i * v y s j - u y s i * u y s j)) (univ ×ˢ Icc 0 T₁) := by
    intro i j
    exact (((hcomp i v hvI).mul (hcomp j v hvI)).sub ((hcomp i u huI).mul (hcomp j u huI)))
  have hIT : ∀ t, t ∈ Icc 0 T₁ → t < T := fun t ht => lt_of_le_of_lt ht.2 hT₁T

rn_weak_strong_uniqueness.definitions:
noncomputable def pd (i : Fin 3) (F : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) : ℝ := fderiv ℝ F x (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)


noncomputable def newtonKernel (z : ℝ³) : ℝ := (4 * Real.pi * ‖z‖)⁻¹


noncomputable def newtonPot (g : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) : ℝ := ∫ y, newtonKernel (x - y) * g y


noncomputable def stressPressure (g : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, ∑ j, pd i (pd j (newtonPot (g i j))) x


noncomputable def bump12 : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ³) := ⟨1, 2, one_pos, one_lt_two⟩


noncomputable def cutPhi (R : ℝ) (x : ℝ³) : ℝ := bump12 (R⁻¹ • x)


noncomputable def hessKernel (i j : Fin 3) (z : ℝ³) : ℝ :=
  (3 * z i * z j - (if i = j then 1 else 0) * ‖z‖ ^ 2) / (4 * Real.pi * ‖z‖ ^ 5)

subgoal_signatures.name: stress_pressure_flux_bound

subgoal_signatures.name: gronwall_zero

    rw [fderiv_fun_smul ha hF]

      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_smulRight, map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.trace_smulRight, smul_eq_mul,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe]
    ring
  
  have c2 : ∀ (c : Fin 3 → ℝ³ → ℝ), (∀ j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (c j) x) →
      divergence (fun y => ∑ j : Fin 3, c j y • EuclideanSpace.single j (1:ℝ)) x
        = ∑ j : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (c j) x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) := by
    intro c hc
    unfold divergence
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (A := fun j y => c j y • EuclideanSpace.single j (1:ℝ))
      (fun j _ => (hc j).smul_const _)]
    have h : ∀ j, fderiv ℝ (fun y => c j y • EuclideanSpace.single j (1:ℝ)) x
        = (fderiv ℝ (c j) x).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single j (1:ℝ)) :=
      fun j => fderiv_smul_const (hc j) _
    simp only [h, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_sum, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_smulRight, map_sum,
      LinearMap.trace_smulRight, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe]
  
  have c6 : ∀ (A B C : ℝ³ → ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ A x → DifferentiableAt ℝ B x →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ C x →
      divergence (fun y => A y + B y - ν • C y) x
        = divergence A x + divergence B x - ν * divergence C x := by
    intro A B C hA hB hC
    unfold divergence
    have hAB : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => A y + B y) x := hA.add hB
    have hνC : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ν • C y) x := hC.const_smul ν
    rw [fderiv_fun_sub hAB hνC, fderiv_fun_add hA hB, fderiv_fun_const_smul hC ν]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_sub, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_add,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_smul, map_sub, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have c4 : ∀ h : ℝ³, fderiv ℝ (fun y => ‖w y‖ ^ 2 / 2) x h = inner ℝ (w x) (fderiv ℝ w x h) := by
    intro h
    have H : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ‖w y‖ ^ 2 * 2⁻¹)
        ((2⁻¹ : ℝ) • (2 • (innerSL ℝ (w x)).comp (fderiv ℝ w x))) x :=
      ((hwd x).hasFDerivAt.norm_sq).mul_const _
    have e : (fun y => ‖w y‖ ^ 2 / 2) = fun y => ‖w y‖ ^ 2 * 2⁻¹ := by
      funext y; ring
    rw [e, H.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      innerSL_apply_apply, smul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have c5 : ∀ u h : ℝ³, fderiv ℝ (fun y => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w y u) (w y)) x h
      = inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y u) x h) (w x)
        + inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w x u) (fderiv ℝ w x h) := by
    intro u h
    have hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y u) x :=
      (hDd x).clm_apply (differentiableAt_const u)
    rw [fderiv_inner_apply ℝ hf (hwd x) h]
    ring
  
  have c3 : Δ w x = ∑ j : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) x
      (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) := by
    rw [congrFun (InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_orthonormalBasis w
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)) x]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]
    rw [fderiv_clm_apply (hDd x) (differentiableAt_const _)]
    simp
  
  have hcj : ∀ j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun y => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w y (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w y)) x :=
    fun j => ((hDd x).clm_apply (differentiableAt_const _)).inner ℝ (hwd x)
  have hN : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ‖w y‖ ^ 2 / 2) x := (((hw.of_le (by simp) : ContDiff ℝ 1 w).norm_sq ℝ).div_const 2).differentiable (by simp) x
  have hA : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (‖w y‖ ^ 2 / 2) • V y) x := hN.smul (hVd x)
  have hB : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => q y • w y) x := (hqd x).smul (hwd x)
  have hC : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w y (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w y)) • EuclideanSpace.single j (1:ℝ)) x := by
    exact DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun j _ => (hcj j).smul_const _)
  have hgq : fderiv ℝ q x (w x) = inner ℝ (gradient q x) (w x) := (inner_gradient_left).symm
  rw [c6 _ _ _ hA hB hC, c1 _ _ hN (hVd x), c1 _ _ (hqd x) (hwd x), c2 _ hcj, c4, hgq]
  simp only [c5]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← sum_inner, ← c3]
  simp only [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, inner_add_right, inner_sub_right, inner_neg_right,
    real_inner_smul_right]
  rw [real_inner_comm (w x) (gradient q x), real_inner_comm (w x) (Δ w x)]
  ring

signature.name: periodic_divergence_integral_zero
signature.statement: ∀ Φ : ℝ³ → ℝ³, ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → IsOnePeriodic Φ → IntegrableOn (fun y => divergence Φ (WithLp.toLp 2 y)) (Icc (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1) ∧ ∫ y in Icc (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1, divergence Φ (WithLp.toLp 2 y) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Φ hΦ hper
  set eO : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) ≃L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ) :=
    PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) with heO
  set f : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → (Fin 3 → ℝ) := fun y => eO (Φ (eO.symm y)) with hfdef
  have hfC : ContDiff ℝ 1 f := eO.contDiff.comp (hΦ.comp eO.symm.contDiff)
  have hΦd : Differentiable ℝ Φ := hΦ.differentiable one_ne_zero
  have hfd : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt f ((eO : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ)).comp
      ((fderiv ℝ Φ (eO.symm y)).comp
        (eO.symm : (Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)))) y := by
    intro y
    exact eO.hasFDerivAt.comp y ((hΦd _).hasFDerivAt.comp y eO.symm.hasFDerivAt)
  have hsingle : ∀ i : Fin 3, eO.symm (Pi.single i 1) = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 := by
    intro i
    rfl
  have hG : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ f y (Pi.single i 1) i
      = divergence Φ (WithLp.toLp 2 y) := by
    intro y
    rw [(hfd y).fderiv]
    unfold divergence
    rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_sum_inner _ (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe, hsingle,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, map_one, one_mul]
    rfl
  have hfper : ∀ y (i : Fin 3), f (y + Pi.single i 1) = f y := by
    intro y i
    simp only [hfdef, map_add, hsingle]
    rw [hper]
  have hGc : Continuous (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ f y (Pi.single i 1) i) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fderiv ℝ f) := hfC.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero
    exact continuous_finset_sum _ (fun i _ =>
      (continuous_apply i).comp (hc.clm_apply continuous_const))
  have hInt : IntegrableOn (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ f y (Pi.single i 1) i)
      (Icc (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1) := hGc.integrableOn_Icc
  have key := MeasureTheory.integral_divergence_of_hasFDerivAt_off_countable (n := 2)
    (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1 (fun _ => zero_le_one) f (fderiv ℝ f) ∅ countable_empty
    hfC.continuous.continuousOn
    (fun x _ => (hfC.differentiable one_ne_zero x).hasFDerivAt) hInt
  have hface : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ z : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      f (Fin.insertNth (α := fun _ => ℝ) i ((1 : Fin 3 → ℝ) i) z)
        = f (Fin.insertNth (α := fun _ => ℝ) i ((0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) i) z) := by
    intro i z
    have h := Fin.insertNth_add (α := fun _ => ℝ) i (0 : ℝ) (1 : ℝ) z 0
    rw [Fin.insertNth_zero_right, zero_add, add_zero] at h
    have e : Fin.insertNth (α := fun _ => ℝ) i ((1 : Fin 3 → ℝ) i) z
        = Fin.insertNth (α := fun _ => ℝ) i ((0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) i) z + Pi.single i 1 := by
      simpa using h
    rw [e, hfper]
  have hGfun : (fun y => divergence Φ (WithLp.toLp 2 y))
      = fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ f y (Pi.single i 1) i :=
    funext fun y => (hG y).symm
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hGfun]; exact hInt
  · rw [hGfun, key]
    simp_rw [hface, sub_self]
    simp

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (a b : ℝ), a < b → ContinuousOn (↿g) (univ ×ˢ Icc a b) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (univ ×ˢ Ioo a b) → ContinuousOn (fun s => ∫ y in Icc (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1, ‖g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) s‖ ^ 2) (Icc a b) ∧ ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b, IntegrableOn (fun y => 2 * inner ℝ (g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) s) (deriv (fun r => g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) r) s)) (Icc (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1) ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ y in Icc (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1, ‖g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) s‖ ^ 2) (∫ y in Icc (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1, 2 * inner ℝ (g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) s) (deriv (fun r => g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) r) s)) s

signature.name: slice_energy_hasDerivAt
signature.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (a b : ℝ), a < b → ContinuousOn (↿g) (univ ×ˢ Icc a b) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (univ ×ˢ Ioo a b) → ContinuousOn (fun s => ∫ y in Icc (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1, ‖g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) s‖ ^ 2) (Icc a b) ∧ ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b, IntegrableOn (fun y => 2 * inner ℝ (g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) s) (deriv (fun r => g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) r) s)) (Icc (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1) ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ y in Icc (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1, ‖g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) s‖ ^ 2) (∫ y in Icc (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1, 2 * inner ℝ (g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) s) (deriv (fun r => g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) r) s)) s

proof.tactics:
by
  intro g a b hab hc hd
  have hφ : Continuous (fun p : (Fin 3 → ℝ) × ℝ => ((WithLp.toLp 2 p.1 : ℝ³), p.2)) :=
    ((PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 _).comp continuous_fst).prodMk continuous_snd
  have hG : ContinuousOn (fun p : (Fin 3 → ℝ) × ℝ => g (WithLp.toLp 2 p.1) p.2) (univ ×ˢ Icc a b) :=
    hc.comp hφ.continuousOn (fun p hp => ⟨mem_univ _, hp.2⟩)
  have hslice : ∀ s ∈ Icc a b, Continuous (fun y : Fin 3 → ℝ => g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) s) := by
    intro s hs
    have h : ContinuousOn (fun y : Fin 3 → ℝ => g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) s) univ :=
      hG.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn (fun y _ => ⟨mem_univ _, hs⟩)
    exact continuousOn_univ.mp h
  have htime : ∀ y : Fin 3 → ℝ, ContinuousOn (fun s => g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) s) (Icc a b) := by
    intro y
    exact hG.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn (fun s hs => ⟨mem_univ _, hs⟩)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc :
        IsCompact ((Icc (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1) ×ˢ Icc a b)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        (hG.mono (prod_mono (subset_univ _) subset_rfl))
    refine continuousOn_of_dominated (F := fun s y => ‖g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) s‖ ^ 2)
      (bound := fun _ => C ^ 2) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro s hs
      exact (((hslice s hs).norm.pow 2).continuousOn).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Icc
    · intro s hs
      refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Icc (fun y hy => ?_)
      have h1 : ‖g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) s‖ ≤ C := hC (y, s) ⟨hy, hs⟩
      show ‖‖g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) s‖ ^ 2‖ ≤ C ^ 2
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h1 2
    · exact continuousOn_const.integrableOn_compact isCompact_Icc
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ((htime y).norm.pow 2))
  · intro s₀ hs₀
    have hO : IsOpen ((univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Ioo a b) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hdiff : ∀ (x : ℝ³), ∀ r ∈ Ioo a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿g) (x, r) := fun x r hr =>
      (hd.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds ⟨mem_univ _, hr⟩)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have s2 : ∀ (x : ℝ³), ∀ r ∈ Ioo a b,
        HasDerivAt (fun r => g x r) (fderiv ℝ (↿g) (x, r) ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ))) r := by
      intro x r hr
      have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun r' : ℝ => (x, r')) ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ)) r :=
        (hasDerivAt_const r x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' r)
      exact (hdiff x r hr).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt r hγ
    have s3 : ContinuousOn (fun p : (Fin 3 → ℝ) × ℝ =>
        fderiv ℝ (↿g) (WithLp.toLp 2 p.1, p.2) ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ))) (univ ×ˢ Ioo a b) := by
      have h1 : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (↿g)) ((univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Ioo a b) :=
        hd.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO (by simp)
      have h2 : ContinuousOn (fun p : (Fin 3 → ℝ) × ℝ => fderiv ℝ (↿g) (WithLp.toLp 2 p.1, p.2))
          (univ ×ˢ Ioo a b) :=
        h1.comp hφ.continuousOn (fun p (hp : p ∈ (univ : Set (Fin 3 → ℝ)) ×ˢ Ioo a b) =>
          ⟨mem_univ _, hp.2⟩)
      exact h2.clm_apply continuousOn_const
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, δ = min (s₀ - a) (b - s₀) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hm1 := min_le_left (s₀ - a) (b - s₀)
    have hm2 := min_le_right (s₀ - a) (b - s₀)
    have hδpos : 0 < δ := by
      have := lt_min (sub_pos.mpr hs₀.1) (sub_pos.mpr hs₀.2)
      linarith
    have hJsub : Icc (s₀ - δ) (s₀ + δ) ⊆ Ioo a b := by
      intro r hr
      have := hs₀.1
      have := hs₀.2
      exact ⟨by linarith [hr.1], by linarith [hr.2]⟩
    have hJ : Icc (s₀ - δ) (s₀ + δ) ∈ nhds s₀ := Icc_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hH : ContinuousOn (fun p : (Fin 3 → ℝ) × ℝ => 2 * inner ℝ (g (WithLp.toLp 2 p.1) p.2)
        (fderiv ℝ (↿g) (WithLp.toLp 2 p.1, p.2) ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ)))) (univ ×ˢ Ioo a b) :=
      continuousOn_const.mul ((hG.mono (prod_mono subset_rfl Ioo_subset_Icc_self)).inner s3)
    obtain ⟨C', hC'⟩ := (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc :
        IsCompact ((Icc (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1) ×ˢ Icc (s₀ - δ) (s₀ + δ))).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        (hH.mono (prod_mono (subset_univ _) hJsub))
    have hF'eq : ∀ r ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ y : Fin 3 → ℝ,
        2 * inner ℝ (g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) r) (deriv (fun r => g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) r) r)
          = 2 * inner ℝ (g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) r)
              (fderiv ℝ (↿g) (WithLp.toLp 2 y, r) ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ))) := by
      intro r hr y
      rw [(s2 _ r hr).deriv]
    refine hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (μ := volume.restrict (Icc (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1)) (x₀ := s₀)
      (F := fun r y => ‖g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) r‖ ^ 2)
      (F' := fun r y => 2 * inner ℝ (g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) r) (deriv (fun r => g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) r) r))
      (bound := fun _ => C') hJ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact Filter.eventually_of_mem hJ (fun r hr =>
        (((hslice r (Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hJsub hr))).norm.pow 2).continuousOn).aestronglyMeasurable
          measurableSet_Icc)
    · exact ((hslice s₀ (Ioo_subset_Icc_self hs₀)).norm.pow 2).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact
        isCompact_Icc
    · have heq : (fun y : Fin 3 → ℝ => 2 * inner ℝ (g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) s₀)
            (deriv (fun r => g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) r) s₀))
          = fun y => (fun p : (Fin 3 → ℝ) × ℝ => 2 * inner ℝ (g (WithLp.toLp 2 p.1) p.2)
              (fderiv ℝ (↿g) (WithLp.toLp 2 p.1, p.2) ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ)))) (y, s₀) :=
        funext (fun y => hF'eq s₀ hs₀ y)
      show AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y : Fin 3 → ℝ => 2 * inner ℝ (g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) s₀)
            (deriv (fun r => g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) r) s₀)) _
      rw [heq]
      exact (hH.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
        (fun y _ => ⟨mem_univ _, hs₀⟩)).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Icc
    · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Icc (fun y hy r hr => ?_)
      show ‖2 * inner ℝ (g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) r) (deriv (fun r => g (WithLp.toLp 2 y) r) r)‖ ≤ C'
      rw [hF'eq r (hJsub hr) y]
      exact hC' (y, r) ⟨hy, hr⟩
    · exact continuousOn_const.integrableOn_compact isCompact_Icc
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y r hr => ?_)
      exact ((s2 _ r (hJsub hr)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt).norm_sq

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (E E' : ℝ → ℝ) (K t : ℝ), ContinuousOn E (Icc 0 t) → (∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 t, HasDerivAt E (E' s) s) → (∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 t, E' s ≤ K * E s) → E 0 = 0 → (∀ s ∈ Icc 0 t, 0 ≤ E s) → ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 t, E s = 0

signature.name: gronwall_zero
signature.statement: ∀ (E E' : ℝ → ℝ) (K t : ℝ), ContinuousOn E (Icc 0 t) → (∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 t, HasDerivAt E (E' s) s) → (∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 t, E' s ≤ K * E s) → E 0 = 0 → (∀ s ∈ Icc 0 t, 0 ≤ E s) → ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 t, E s = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro E E' K t hc hd hle h0 hnn s hs
  set G : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => Real.exp (-K * r) * E r with hG
  set G' : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => Real.exp (-K * r) * (E' r - K * E r) with hG'
  have hGc : ContinuousOn G (Icc 0 t) := by
    have he : Continuous (fun r : ℝ => Real.exp (-K * r)) := by fun_prop
    exact he.continuousOn.mul hc
  have hGd : ∀ r ∈ Ioo 0 t, HasDerivAt G (G' r) r := by
    intro r hr
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => -K * r) (-K) r := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id r).const_mul (-K)
    have h2 := h1.exp.mul (hd r hr)
    convert h2 using 1
    simp only [hG']
    ring
  have hGn : ∀ r ∈ Ioo 0 t, G' r ≤ 0 := by
    intro r hr
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.exp_pos _).le (sub_nonpos.mpr (hle r hr))
  have hanti : AntitoneOn G (Icc 0 t) := by
    apply antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos (convex_Icc 0 t) hGc
    · intro x hx
      rw [interior_Icc] at hx ⊢
      exact (hGd x hx).hasDerivWithinAt
    · intro x hx
      rw [interior_Icc] at hx
      exact hGn x hx
  have h0mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 t := ⟨le_rfl, hs.1.trans hs.2⟩
  have hle0 : G s ≤ G 0 := hanti h0mem hs hs.1
  have hG0 : G 0 = 0 := by simp [hG, h0]
  rw [hG0] at hle0
  have hpos := Real.exp_pos (-K * s)
  have hEs : E s ≤ 0 := by
    by_contra hcon
    have : 0 < G s := mul_pos hpos (not_le.mp hcon)
    linarith
  exact le_antisymm hEs (hnn s hs)

signature.name: periodic_zero_of_integral_sq_zero

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h hcont hper hint x
  
  have hshift : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (k : ℤ) (z : ℝ³),
      h (z + (k : ℝ) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = h z := by
    intro i k
    induction k using Int.induction_on with
    | zero => intro z; simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro z
      have e : z + (((n : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)
          = (z + ((n : ℤ) : ℝ) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) + EuclideanSpace.single i 1 := by
        push_cast
        rw [add_smul, one_smul, add_assoc]
      rw [e, hper, ih]
    | pred n ih =>
      intro z
      have e : z + ((-(n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)
          + EuclideanSpace.single i 1 = z + ((-(n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) := by
        push_cast
        rw [sub_smul, one_smul]
        abel
      have e2 := hper (z + ((-(n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) i
      rw [e] at e2
      rw [← e2, ih]
  
  have hdec : x = ((WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => Int.fract (x.ofLp j))
      + ((⌊x.ofLp 0⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) • EuclideanSpace.single 0 (1 : ℝ))
      + ((⌊x.ofLp 1⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) • EuclideanSpace.single 1 (1 : ℝ))
      + ((⌊x.ofLp 2⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) • EuclideanSpace.single 2 (1 : ℝ) := by
    ext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp
  have hx : h x = h (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => Int.fract (x.ofLp j))) := by
    calc h x = h (((WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => Int.fract (x.ofLp j))
          + ((⌊x.ofLp 0⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) • EuclideanSpace.single 0 (1 : ℝ))
          + ((⌊x.ofLp 1⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) • EuclideanSpace.single 1 (1 : ℝ))
          + ((⌊x.ofLp 2⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) • EuclideanSpace.single 2 (1 : ℝ)) := congrArg h hdec
      _ = _ := by rw [hshift, hshift, hshift]
  have hyIcc : (fun j => Int.fract (x.ofLp j)) ∈ Icc (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1 :=
    ⟨fun j => Int.fract_nonneg _, fun j => (Int.fract_lt_one _).le⟩
  
  have hF : Continuous (fun y : Fin 3 → ℝ => ‖h (WithLp.toLp 2 y)‖ ^ 2) :=
    ((hcont.comp (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 _)).norm).pow 2
  have hInt : IntegrableOn (fun y : Fin 3 → ℝ => ‖h (WithLp.toLp 2 y)‖ ^ 2) (Icc 0 1) :=
    hF.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_Icc
  have hae := (setIntegral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => by positivity)) hInt).mp hint
  have hsub : Icc (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1 ⊆ closure (interior (Icc 0 1)) := by
    rw [← Set.pi_univ_Icc, interior_pi_set Set.finite_univ, closure_pi_set]
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_pi, Set.mem_univ, true_implies, Pi.zero_apply, Pi.one_apply] at hz ⊢
    intro j
    rw [interior_Icc, closure_Ioo zero_ne_one]
    exact hz j
  have heq := Measure.eqOn_of_ae_eq hae hF.continuousOn continuous_zero.continuousOn hsub
  have h0 := heq hyIcc
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at h0
  rw [hx]
  exact norm_eq_zero.mp (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp h0)
