signature.name: spatial_fderiv_bound_on_cube
signature.statement: ∀ (U : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (T t : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) → t < T → ∃ L : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1, ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 t, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => U z s) (WithLp.toLp 2 y)‖ ≤ L

proof.tactics:
by
  intro U T t hU htT
  have hΩ : IsOpen ((univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Iio T) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Iio
  have hDc : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (↿U)) ((univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Iio T) :=
    hU.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ (by simp)
  have hDiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ (↿U) ((univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Iio T) :=
    hU.differentiableOn (by simp)
  have hchain : ∀ (z : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), s < T →
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z' => U z' s) z‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (↿U) (z, s)‖ := by
    intro z s hs
    have hmem : (z, s) ∈ (univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Iio T := ⟨mem_univ _, hs⟩
    have hA : HasFDerivAt (↿U) (fderiv ℝ (↿U) (z, s)) (z, s) :=
      (hDiff.differentiableAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hmem)).hasFDerivAt
    have hB : HasFDerivAt (fun e : ℝ³ => (e, s)) (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) z :=
      hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left z s
    have hC : HasFDerivAt (fun z' => U z' s)
        ((fderiv ℝ (↿U) (z, s)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)) z :=
      by
        have h := hA.comp z hB
        exact h
    rw [hC.fderiv]
    calc ‖(fderiv ℝ (↿U) (z, s)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)‖
        ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (↿U) (z, s)‖ * ‖ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (↿U) (z, s)‖ * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_inl_le_one ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖fderiv ℝ (↿U) (z, s)‖ := mul_one _
  have hK : IsCompact (Icc (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) t) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  have hι : Continuous (fun p : (Fin 3 → ℝ) × ℝ => ((WithLp.toLp 2 p.1 : ℝ³), p.2)) :=
    ((PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 _).comp continuous_fst).prodMk continuous_snd
  have hmaps : MapsTo (fun p : (Fin 3 → ℝ) × ℝ => ((WithLp.toLp 2 p.1 : ℝ³), p.2))
      (Icc (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) t) ((univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Iio T) :=
    fun p hp => ⟨mem_univ _, lt_of_le_of_lt hp.2.2 htT⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hDc.comp hι.continuousOn hmaps)
  refine ⟨C, fun y hy s hs => ?_⟩
  exact (hchain _ s (lt_of_le_of_lt hs.2 htT)).trans (hC (y, s) ⟨hy, hs⟩)

informal_problem.statement: ∃ (ρ τ₀ : ℝ) (A Bv : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (P : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ρ ∧ 0 < τ₀ ∧ τ₀ < 1 ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿A) (Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) ρ ×ˢ Ioo (1 - τ₀) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Bv) (Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) ρ ×ˢ Ioo (1 - τ₀) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿P) (Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) ρ ×ˢ Ioo (1 - τ₀) 1) ∧ (∀ x t, ‖x‖ < ρ → 1 - τ₀ < t → t < 1 → divergence (fun y => Bv y t) x = 0 ∧ inner ℝ x (Bv x t) = (0 : ℝ)) ∧ (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, δ ≤ ‖x‖ → ‖x‖ ≤ ρ / 2 → 1 - τ₀ < t → t < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿A) (x, t)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Bv) (x, t)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿P) (x, t)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x t, ‖x‖ < δ → 1 - δ < t → t < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(nsResidual 1 (fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A w s) y + Bv y s) P)) (x, t)‖ < ε) ∧ (∀ M δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ x t, ‖x‖ < δ ∧ 1 - δ < t ∧ t < 1 ∧ M < ‖curl3 (fun w => A w t) x + Bv x t‖)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨h, qs, Xe, Xin, c, e0, γ, ℓ, K, A, Bv, P, hh0, hh1, hqs0, hqs1, hXin, hXe, he0, hγ, hAF⟩ :=
    ns_approximate_family
  have hS : SimScaleProps h := simScale_props h hh0 hh1
  have hH : HeatExteriorProps h c := heat_exterior_field h c hh0 hh1
  obtain ⟨A', Bv', P', hLP⟩ :=
    approx_family_summation h qs Xe Xin c e0 γ ℓ K A Bv P hh0 hh1 hqs0 hqs1 hXin hXe he0 hγ hS hAF
  exact local_package_box h qs Xe Xin c e0 A' Bv' P' hh0 hh1 hqs0 hqs1 hXin hXe he0 hS hH hLP

ns_local_blowup_field.definitions:
noncomputable def simScale (h z τ : ℝ) : ℝ := sInf {q : ℝ | 0 < q ∧ τ ≤ q - z ^ 2 * q ^ (2 * h)}


noncomputable def simDomain (h qs : ℝ) : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ) :=
  {w | w.2 < 1 ∧ simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) < qs}


noncomputable def heatProfile (h Z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (Real.Gamma (1 + h))⁻¹ * ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h)


noncomputable def heatSwirl (h c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) : ℝ³ :=
  (c * (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) ^ (-(1 + h)) * heatProfile h (4 * (1 - t) / (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2))) •
    (-(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))


noncomputable def heatPressure (h c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(c ^ 2 / 2) * ∫ s in Ioi (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2), s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (4 * (1 - t) / s) ^ 2

def SimScaleProps (h : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ z τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → 0 < simScale h z τ ∧ simScale h z τ - z ^ 2 * simScale h z τ ^ (2 * h) = τ) ∧
  (∀ z τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ ≤ simScale h z τ ∧ z ^ 2 < simScale h z τ ^ (1 - 2 * h)) ∧
  (∀ z τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → simScale h z τ ≤ 2 * τ + (2 * z ^ 2) ^ (1 / (1 - 2 * h))) ∧
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → simScale h z τ ≤ 1 →
     ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (z, τ)‖ ≤ C * simScale h z τ ^ (1 - (k : ℝ)))

def HeatExteriorProps (h c : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(heatSwirl h c)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ∧ w.2 < 1} ∧
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(heatPressure h c)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ∧ w.2 < 1} ∧
  (∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → t < 1 →
     nsResidual 1 (heatSwirl h c) (heatPressure h c) x t = 0 ∧
     divergence (fun y => heatSwirl h c y t) x = 0 ∧ inner ℝ x (heatSwirl h c x t) = (0:ℝ) ∧
     heatSwirl h c x t 2 = 0) ∧
  (∀ r₀ : ℝ, 0 < r₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), r₀ ^ 2 ≤ x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 →
     x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 ≤ 1 → 0 < t → t < 1 →
     ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(heatSwirl h c)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(heatPressure h c)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C)

def ApproxFamily (h qs Xe Xin c e0 γ : ℝ) (ℓ K : ℕ → ℝ) (A Bv : ℕ → ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (P : ℕ → ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ j : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(A j)) (simDomain h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(Bv j)) (simDomain h qs) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(P j)) (simDomain h qs)) ∧
  (∀ (j : ℕ) x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs →
    divergence (fun y => Bv j y t) x = 0 ∧ inner ℝ x (Bv j x t) = (0 : ℝ) ∧ Bv j x t 2 = 0) ∧
  (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs →
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(A 0)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K m) ∧
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(Bv 0)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K m) ∧
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(P 0)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K m)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs →
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(A j)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * j - ℓ m) ∧
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(Bv j)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * j - ℓ m) ∧
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(P j)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * j - ℓ m)) ∧
  (∀ J m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs →
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(nsResidual 1
        (fun y s => curl3 (fun w => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), A j w s) y + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), Bv j y s)
        (fun y s => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), P j y s))) (x, t)‖
      ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * J - K m)) ∧
  (∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → 2 * Xe * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 →
    A 0 x t = 0 ∧ Bv 0 x t = heatSwirl h c x t ∧ P 0 x t = heatPressure h c x t ∧
    ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → A j x t = 0 ∧ Bv j x t = 0 ∧ P j x t = 0) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs →
    x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 < 4 * Xin * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) → A j x t = 0 ∧ Bv j x t = 0 ∧ P j x t = 0) ∧
  (∃ τ₁ : ℝ, 0 < τ₁ ∧ ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ < τ₁ →
    2 * e0 * τ ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤
      ‖curl3 (fun w => A 0 w (1 - τ)) (Real.sqrt (2 * Xin * τ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) +
        Bv 0 (Real.sqrt (2 * Xin * τ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) (1 - τ)‖)

def LocalPackage (h qs Xe Xin c e0 : ℝ) (A Bv : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (P : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿A) (simDomain h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Bv) (simDomain h qs) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿P) (simDomain h qs) ∧
  (∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs →
    divergence (fun y => Bv y t) x = 0 ∧ inner ℝ x (Bv x t) = (0 : ℝ)) ∧
  (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C κ : ℝ, 0 ≤ κ ∧ ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs →
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿A) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-κ) ∧
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Bv) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-κ) ∧
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿P) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-κ)) ∧
  (∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → 2 * Xe * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 →
    A x t = 0 ∧ Bv x t = heatSwirl h c x t ∧ P x t = heatPressure h c x t) ∧
  (∀ m N : ℕ, ∃ C δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < δ →
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(nsResidual 1 (fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A w s) y + Bv y s) P)) (x, t)‖
      ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ N) ∧
  (∃ τ₁ : ℝ, 0 < τ₁ ∧ ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ < τ₁ →
    e0 * τ ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤
      ‖curl3 (fun w => A w (1 - τ)) (Real.sqrt (2 * Xin * τ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) +
        Bv (Real.sqrt (2 * Xin * τ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) (1 - τ)‖)

def HeatExteriorProps (h c : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(heatSwirl h c)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ∧ w.2 < 1} ∧
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(heatPressure h c)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ∧ w.2 < 1} ∧
  (∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → t < 1 →
     nsResidual 1 (heatSwirl h c) (heatPressure h c) x t = 0 ∧
     divergence (fun y => heatSwirl h c y t) x = 0 ∧ inner ℝ x (heatSwirl h c x t) = (0:ℝ) ∧
     heatSwirl h c x t 2 = 0) ∧
  (∀ r₀ : ℝ, 0 < r₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), r₀ ^ 2 ≤ x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 →
     x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 ≤ 1 → 0 < t → t < 1 →
     ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(heatSwirl h c)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(heatPressure h c)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C)

def ApproxFamily (h qs Xe Xin c e0 γ : ℝ) (ℓ K : ℕ → ℝ) (A Bv : ℕ → ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (P : ℕ → ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ j : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(A j)) (simDomain h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(Bv j)) (simDomain h qs) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(P j)) (simDomain h qs)) ∧
  (∀ (j : ℕ) x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs →
    divergence (fun y => Bv j y t) x = 0 ∧ inner ℝ x (Bv j x t) = (0 : ℝ) ∧ Bv j x t 2 = 0) ∧
  (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs →
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(A 0)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K m) ∧
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(Bv 0)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K m) ∧
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(P 0)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K m)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs →
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(A j)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * j - ℓ m) ∧
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(Bv j)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * j - ℓ m) ∧
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(P j)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * j - ℓ m)) ∧
  (∀ J m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs →
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(nsResidual 1
        (fun y s => curl3 (fun w => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), A j w s) y + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), Bv j y s)
        (fun y s => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), P j y s))) (x, t)‖
      ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * J - K m)) ∧
  (∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → 2 * Xe * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 →
    A 0 x t = 0 ∧ Bv 0 x t = heatSwirl h c x t ∧ P 0 x t = heatPressure h c x t ∧
    ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → A j x t = 0 ∧ Bv j x t = 0 ∧ P j x t = 0) ∧

    x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 < 4 * Xin * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) → A j x t = 0 ∧ Bv j x t = 0 ∧ P j x t = 0) ∧
  (∃ τ₁ : ℝ, 0 < τ₁ ∧ ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ < τ₁ →
    2 * e0 * τ ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤
      ‖curl3 (fun w => A 0 w (1 - τ)) (Real.sqrt (2 * Xin * τ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) +
        Bv 0 (Real.sqrt (2 * Xin * τ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) (1 - τ)‖)

def LocalPackage (h qs Xe Xin c e0 : ℝ) (A Bv : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (P : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿A) (simDomain h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Bv) (simDomain h qs) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿P) (simDomain h qs) ∧
  (∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs →
    divergence (fun y => Bv y t) x = 0 ∧ inner ℝ x (Bv x t) = (0 : ℝ)) ∧
  (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C κ : ℝ, 0 ≤ κ ∧ ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs →
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿A) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-κ) ∧
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Bv) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-κ) ∧
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿P) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-κ)) ∧
  (∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → 2 * Xe * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 →
    A x t = 0 ∧ Bv x t = heatSwirl h c x t ∧ P x t = heatPressure h c x t) ∧
  (∀ m N : ℕ, ∃ C δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < δ →
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(nsResidual 1 (fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A w s) y + Bv y s) P)) (x, t)‖
      ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ N) ∧
  (∃ τ₁ : ℝ, 0 < τ₁ ∧ ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ < τ₁ →
    e0 * τ ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤
      ‖curl3 (fun w => A w (1 - τ)) (Real.sqrt (2 * Xin * τ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) +
        Bv (Real.sqrt (2 * Xin * τ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) (1 - τ)‖)

  obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ : ∃ χ : ℝ³ → ℝ,
      χ = fun y => Real.smoothTransition ((ρ ^ 2 / 4 - ‖y‖ ^ 2) / (3 * ρ ^ 2 / 16)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ : ∃ η : ℝ → ℝ,
      η = fun s => Real.smoothTransition ((s - (1 - τ₀ / 2)) / (τ₀ / 4)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hχs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ := by
    rw [hχ]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp ((contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_norm_sq ℝ)).div_const _)
  have hηs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ η := by
    rw [hη]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp ((contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).div_const _)
  have hχ0 : ∀ y : ℝ³, ρ / 2 < ‖y‖ → χ y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hχ]
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    apply div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
    · nlinarith [norm_nonneg y]
    · positivity
  have hχ1 : ∀ y : ℝ³, ‖y‖ < ρ / 4 → χ y = 1 := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hχ]
    apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg y]
  have hη0 : ∀ s : ℝ, s < 1 - τ₀ / 2 → η s = 0 := by
    intro s hs
    rw [hη]
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    apply div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
    · linarith
    · linarith
  have hη1 : ∀ s : ℝ, 1 - τ₀ / 4 < s → η s = 1 := by
    intro s hs
    rw [hη]
    apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]
    linarith
  have hχb : ∀ y, ‖χ y‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    rw [hχ, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _)]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.le_one _
  have hηb : ∀ s, ‖η s‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro s
    rw [hη, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _)]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.le_one _
  have hχloc : ∀ x, x ∉ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ³) (ρ / 2) → χ =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => χ x := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : ρ / 2 < ‖x‖ := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hx
      exact hx
    have hU : {w : ℝ³ | ρ / 2 < ‖w‖} ∈ nhds x :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).mem_nhds hx'
    filter_upwards [hU] with w hw
    rw [hχ0 w hw, hχ0 x hx']
  have hηloc : ∀ s, s ∉ Icc (1 - τ₀ / 2) (1 - τ₀ / 4) → η =ᶠ[nhds s] fun _ => η s := by
    intro s hs
    rw [mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at hs
    rcases hs with hs | hs
    · filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hs] with w hw
      rw [hη0 w hw, hη0 s hs]
    · filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hs] with w hw
      rw [hη1 w hw, hη1 s hs]
  obtain ⟨Cχ, hCχ⟩ : ∃ C : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ i x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i χ x‖ ≤ C i := by
    choose C hC using hgen χ _ hχs (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℝ³) (ρ / 2)) hχloc hχb
    exact ⟨C, hC⟩
  obtain ⟨Cη, hCη⟩ : ∃ C : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ i x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i η x‖ ≤ C i := by
    choose C hC using hgen η _ hηs (isCompact_Icc (a := 1 - τ₀ / 2) (b := 1 - τ₀ / 4)) hηloc hηb
    exact ⟨C, hC⟩
  refine ⟨fun y s => χ y * η s, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => χ z.1 * η z.2)
    exact (hχs.comp contDiff_fst).mul (hηs.comp contDiff_snd)
  · intro y s h
    show χ y * η s = 0
    rcases h with h | h
    · rw [hχ0 y h, zero_mul]
    · rw [hη0 s h, mul_zero]
  · intro y s hy hs
    show χ y * η s = 1
    rw [hχ1 y hy, hη1 s hs, one_mul]
  · intro y s v hv
    show fderiv ℝ (fun w => χ w * η s) y v = 0
    have hh0 : ContDiff ℝ 1
        (fun r : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition ((ρ ^ 2 / 4 - r) / (3 * ρ ^ 2 / 16))) :=
      Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp ((contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id).div_const _)
    have hh : Differentiable ℝ
        (fun r : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition ((ρ ^ 2 / 4 - r) / (3 * ρ ^ 2 / 16))) :=
      hh0.differentiable (by norm_num)
    have hF := (hh (‖y‖ ^ 2)).hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt y
      (hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq y).hasFDerivAt
    have hχd : fderiv ℝ χ y v = 0 := by
      have e : χ = (fun r : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition ((ρ ^ 2 / 4 - r) / (3 * ρ ^ 2 / 16))) ∘
          (fun w : ℝ³ => ‖w‖ ^ 2) := by
        rw [hχ]; rfl
      rw [e, hF.fderiv]
      simp [hv]
    rw [fderiv_mul_const (hχs.differentiable (by norm_num) y), ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, hχd,
      smul_zero]
  · intro k
    refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cχ i| * |Cη (k - i)|, fun z => ?_⟩
    have hf1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => χ z.1) := hχs.comp contDiff_fst
    have hg1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => η z.2) := hηs.comp contDiff_snd
    have hb1 : ∀ i : ℕ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => χ z.1) z‖ ≤ |Cχ i| := by
      intro i
      have e : (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => χ z.1) = χ ∘ ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := rfl
      rw [e, ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right _ hχs z (by exact_mod_cast le_top)]
      refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
      have hp : ∏ _j : Fin i, ‖ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Finset.prod_const]
        exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_fst_le _ _ _)
      calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i χ ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) z)‖ * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (norm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ |Cχ i| := by rw [mul_one]; exact (hCχ i _).trans (le_abs_self _)
    have hb2 : ∀ i : ℕ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => η z.2) z‖ ≤ |Cη i| := by
      intro i
      have e : (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => η z.2) = η ∘ ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := rfl
      rw [e, ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right _ hηs z (by exact_mod_cast le_top)]
      refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
      have hp : ∏ _j : Fin i, ‖ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ³ ℝ‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Finset.prod_const]
        exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_snd_le _ _ _)
      calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i η ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) z)‖ * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (norm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ |Cη i| := by rw [mul_one]; exact (hCη i _).trans (le_abs_self _)
    show ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => χ z.1 * η z.2) z‖ ≤ _
    refine (norm_iteratedFDeriv_mul_le hf1 hg1 z (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).trans ?_
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb1 i) (by positivity)) (hb2 (k - i))
      (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (φ : ℝ³ → ℝ) (V : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (x : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ φ x → DifferentiableAt ℝ V x → divergence (fun y => φ y • V y) x = φ x * divergence V x + fderiv ℝ φ x (V x)

signature.name: divergence_smul_field
signature.statement: ∀ (φ : ℝ³ → ℝ) (V : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (x : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ φ x → DifferentiableAt ℝ V x → divergence (fun y => φ y • V y) x = φ x * divergence V x + fderiv ℝ φ x (V x)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro φ V x hφ hV
  rw [divergence, fderiv_fun_smul hφ hV, ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_add,
    ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_smul, map_add, map_smul, divergence, smul_eq_mul]
  congr 1
  have h : ((fderiv ℝ φ x).smulRight (V x) : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ³) =
      (fderiv ℝ φ x : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (V x) := rfl
  rw [h, LinearMap.trace_smulRight]
  rfl

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (F : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (x : ℝ³), ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F x → DifferentiableAt ℝ (curl3 F) x ∧ divergence (curl3 F) x = 0

signature.name: curl3_differentiable_divergence_zero
signature.statement: ∀ (F : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (x : ℝ³), ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F x → DifferentiableAt ℝ (curl3 F) x ∧ divergence (curl3 F) x = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro F x hF
  have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ F) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x) x :=
    ((hF.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
  have hsymm : ∀ v w, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x v w = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x w v := by
    have := hF.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField])
    intro v w; exact this v w
  have hg : ∀ a b : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (EuclideanSpace.single a 1) b)
      (((EuclideanSpace.proj b).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ³ (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)))).comp
          (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x)) x := by
    intro a b
    have := (((EuclideanSpace.proj b).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ³ (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)))).hasFDerivAt
        (x := fderiv ℝ F x)).comp x h1
    exact this
  have hc := ((((hg 1 2).fun_sub (hg 2 1)).smul_const (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))).fun_add
    (((hg 2 0).fun_sub (hg 0 2)).smul_const (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)))).fun_add
    (((hg 0 1).fun_sub (hg 1 0)).smul_const (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)))
  have hc' : HasFDerivAt (curl3 F) _ x := hc
  refine ⟨hc'.differentiableAt, ?_⟩
  rw [divergence, hc'.fderiv, LinearMap.trace_eq_sum_inner _ (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)]
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
  rw [hsymm (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1),
    hsymm (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1),
    hsymm (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1)]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ {E F G H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] H) (f : E → F) (g : E → G) (O S : Set E), IsOpen O → S ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g O → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z‖ ≤ C) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g z‖ ≤ C) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) z‖ ≤ C

signature.name: iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on
signature.statement: ∀ {E F G H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] H) (f : E → F) (g : E → G) (O S : Set E), IsOpen O → S ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g O → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z‖ ≤ C) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g z‖ ≤ C) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) z‖ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro E F G H _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ B f g O S hO hSO hf hg hbf hbg k
  choose Cf hCf using hbf
  choose Cg hCg using hbg
  refine ⟨‖B‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
      (k.choose i : ℝ) * max (Cf i) 0 * max (Cg (k - i)) 0, fun z hz => ?_⟩
  have hzO : z ∈ O := hSO hz
  have hU : UniqueDiffOn ℝ O := hO.uniqueDiffOn
  have key := ContinuousLinearMap.norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_le_of_bilinear B hf hg hU hzO
    (n := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hO hzO] at key
  refine key.trans ?_
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg B)
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
  rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO hzO, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (k - i) hO hzO]
  have h1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f z‖ ≤ max (Cf i) 0 := (hCf i z hz).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have h2 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) g z‖ ≤ max (Cg (k - i)) 0 :=
    (hCg (k - i) z hz).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k.choose i := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 h0) h2 (norm_nonneg _)
    (mul_nonneg h0 (le_max_right _ _))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (ν : ℝ) (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (O S : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)), IsOpen O → S ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) O → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿u) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿p) z‖ ≤ C) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (nsJet ν u p) z‖ ≤ C

signature.name: nsJet_iteratedFDeriv_bounded_on
signature.statement: ∀ (ν : ℝ) (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (O S : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)), IsOpen O → S ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) O → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿u) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿p) z‖ ≤ C) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (nsJet ν u p) z‖ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ν u p O S hO hSO hu hp H
  have hnhds : ∀ z ∈ S, O ∈ nhds z := fun z hz => hO.mem_nhds (hSO hz)
  
  have hlin : ∀ {F G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G]
      [NormedSpace ℝ G] (L : F →L[ℝ] G) (f : ℝ³ × ℝ → F), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z‖ ≤ C) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => L (f z)) O ∧
        ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => L (f z)) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro F G _ _ _ _ L f hf hb
    refine ⟨hf.continuousLinearMap_comp L, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hb k
    refine ⟨‖L‖ * C, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have h1 := L.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left (hf.contDiffAt (hnhds z hz)) (n := k)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    exact h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC z hz) (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg L))
  
  have hder : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : ℝ³ × ℝ → F),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z‖ ≤ C) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) O ∧
        ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ f) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro F _ _ f hf hb
    refine ⟨hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hO (by simp), fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hb (k + 1)
    exact ⟨C, fun z hz => by rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]; exact hC z hz⟩
  
  have hadd : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f g : ℝ³ × ℝ → F),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g O →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z‖ ≤ C) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g z‖ ≤ C) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => f z + g z) O ∧
        ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => f z + g z) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro F _ _ f g hf hg hbf hbg
    refine ⟨hf.add hg, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C1, h1⟩ := hbf k
    obtain ⟨C2, h2⟩ := hbg k
    refine ⟨C1 + C2, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have af : ContDiffAt ℝ k f z :=
      (hf.contDiffAt (hnhds z hz)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have ag : ContDiffAt ℝ k g z :=
      (hg.contDiffAt (hnhds z hz)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    show ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (f + g) z‖ ≤ C1 + C2
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_add_apply af ag]
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (h1 z hz) (h2 z hz))
  
  have hbil : ∀ {F G K : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G]
      [NormedSpace ℝ G] [NormedAddCommGroup K] [NormedSpace ℝ K] (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] K)
      (f : ℝ³ × ℝ → F) (g : ℝ³ × ℝ → G), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g O →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z‖ ≤ C) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g z‖ ≤ C) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) O ∧
        ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro F G K _ _ _ _ _ _ B f g hf hg hbf hbg
    refine ⟨(hf.continuousLinearMap_comp B).clm_apply hg, fun k => ?_⟩
    choose Cf hCf using hbf
    choose Cg hCg using hbg
    refine ⟨‖B‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
        (k.choose i : ℝ) * max (Cf i) 0 * max (Cg (k - i)) 0, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hzO : z ∈ O := hSO hz
    have hU : UniqueDiffOn ℝ O := hO.uniqueDiffOn
    have key := ContinuousLinearMap.norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_le_of_bilinear B hf hg hU hzO
      (n := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hO hzO] at key
    refine key.trans ?_
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg B)
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO hzO, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (k - i) hO hzO]
    have h1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f z‖ ≤ max (Cf i) 0 := (hCf i z hz).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have h2 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) g z‖ ≤ max (Cg (k - i)) 0 :=
      (hCg (k - i) z hz).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k.choose i := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 h0) h2 (norm_nonneg _)
      (mul_nonneg h0 (le_max_right _ _))
  
  have Hu : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿u) z‖ ≤ C :=
    fun k => (H k).imp (fun C hC z hz => (hC z hz).1)
  have Hp : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿p) z‖ ≤ C :=
    fun k => (H k).imp (fun C hC z hz => (hC z hz).2)
  obtain ⟨hDu, HDu⟩ := hder (↿u) hu Hu
  obtain ⟨hD2u, HD2u⟩ := hder (fderiv ℝ (↿u)) hDu HDu
  obtain ⟨hDp, HDp⟩ := hder (↿p) hp Hp
  
  let e : Fin 3 → ℝ³ := fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)
  let L₁ : (ℝ³ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) →L[ℝ] ℝ³ := ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ³ ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ))
  let B : (ℝ³ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) →L[ℝ] (ℝ³ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (ℝ³ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³)
  let L₃ : (ℝ³ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) →L[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
    -(ν • ∑ i : Fin 3, (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ³ (e i, (0 : ℝ))).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (ℝ³ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) (e i, (0 : ℝ))))
  let L₄ : (ℝ³ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
    ∑ i : Fin 3, (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ (e i)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ (e i, (0 : ℝ)))
  obtain ⟨hw, Hw⟩ := hlin (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) (↿u) hu Hu
  obtain ⟨s1, b1⟩ := hlin L₁ _ hDu HDu
  obtain ⟨s2, b2⟩ := hbil B _ _ hDu hw HDu Hw
  obtain ⟨s3, b3⟩ := hlin L₃ _ hD2u HD2u
  obtain ⟨s4, b4⟩ := hlin L₄ _ hDp HDp
  obtain ⟨s12, b12⟩ := hadd _ _ s1 s2 b1 b2
  obtain ⟨s123, b123⟩ := hadd _ _ s12 s3 b12 b3
  obtain ⟨_, b1234⟩ := hadd _ _ s123 s4 b123 b4
  have hL3 : ∀ Ψ : ℝ³ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³,
      L₃ Ψ = -(ν • ∑ i : Fin 3, Ψ (e i, (0 : ℝ)) (e i, (0 : ℝ))) := by
    intro Ψ
    show (-(ν • ∑ i : Fin 3, (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ³ (e i, (0 : ℝ))).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (ℝ³ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) (e i, (0 : ℝ))))) Ψ = _
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_sum', Finset.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply]
  have heq : nsJet ν u p = fun z =>
      ((L₁ (fderiv ℝ (↿u) z) + B (fderiv ℝ (↿u) z) (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ ((↿u) z)))
        + L₃ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿u)) z)) + L₄ (fderiv ℝ (↿p) z) := by
    funext z
    rw [hL3]
    simp [nsJet, L₁, B, L₄, e, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [heq]
  exact b1234

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (A Bv : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (O S : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)), IsOpen O → S ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿A) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Bv) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A w s) y + Bv y s)) O ∧ ((∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿A) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿Bv) z‖ ≤ C) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A w s) y + Bv y s)) z‖ ≤ C)

signature.name: curl_field_contDiffOn_bounded
signature.statement: ∀ (A Bv : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (O S : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)), IsOpen O → S ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿A) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Bv) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A w s) y + Bv y s)) O ∧ ((∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿A) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿Bv) z‖ ≤ C) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A w s) y + Bv y s)) z‖ ≤ C)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro A Bv O S hO hS hA hB
  let ev : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ((ℝ³ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³) →L[ℝ] ℝ := fun a b =>
    (EuclideanSpace.proj b).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ³ ((EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ) : ℝ³), (0:ℝ)))
  let L : ((ℝ³ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³) →L[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
    (ev 1 2 - ev 2 1).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) +
    (ev 2 0 - ev 0 2).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) +
    (ev 0 1 - ev 1 0).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))
  have hLapp : ∀ Φ : (ℝ³ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³, L Φ =
      (Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1, 0) 2 - Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1, 0) 1) •
          EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
        (Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1, 0) 0 - Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, 0) 2) •
          EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
        (Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, 0) 1 - Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1, 0) 0) •
          EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) := by
    intro Φ
    rfl
  have hslice : ∀ z ∈ O, ∀ v : ℝ³,
      fderiv ℝ (fun w => A w z.2) z.1 v = fderiv ℝ (↿A) z (v, 0) := by
    intro z hz v
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿A) z :=
      (hA.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hd' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿A) (z.1, z.2) := hd
    have he : (fun w => A w z.2) = (↿A) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ => (w, z.2)) := rfl
    rw [he, fderiv_comp z.1 hd' (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left z.1 z.2).differentiableAt,
      (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left z.1 z.2).fderiv]
    rfl
  let G : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ³ := fun z => L (fderiv ℝ (↿A) z) + (↿Bv) z
  have hE : ∀ z ∈ O, (↿(fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A w s) y + Bv y s)) z = G z := by
    intro z hz
    show curl3 (fun w => A w z.2) z.1 + Bv z.1 z.2 = L (fderiv ℝ (↿A) z) + Bv z.1 z.2
    rw [hLapp]
    simp only [curl3, hslice z hz]
  have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿A)) O := hA.fderiv_of_isOpen hO (by simp)
  have hLf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => L (fderiv ℝ (↿A) z)) O := hfd.continuousLinearMap_comp L
  have hGs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G O := hLf.add hB
  refine ⟨hGs.congr hE, ?_⟩
  intro H k
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := H (k + 1)
  obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂⟩ := H k
  refine ⟨‖L‖ * C₁ + C₂, fun z hz => ?_⟩
  have hzO : O ∈ nhds z := hO.mem_nhds (hS hz)
  have hev : (↿(fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A w s) y + Bv y s)) =ᶠ[nhds z] G :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hzO hE
  rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
  have hkle : ((k : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hF : ContDiffAt ℝ k (fun z => L (fderiv ℝ (↿A) z)) z :=
    (hLf.contDiffAt hzO).of_le hkle
  have hG : ContDiffAt ℝ k (↿Bv) z := (hB.contDiffAt hzO).of_le hkle
  have hsplit : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k G z =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => L (fderiv ℝ (↿A) z)) z + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿Bv) z :=
    iteratedFDeriv_add_apply hF hG
  rw [hsplit]
  have h1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => L (fderiv ℝ (↿A) z)) z‖ ≤
      ‖L‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ (↿A)) z‖ :=
    L.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left (hfd.contDiffAt hzO) hkle
  rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv] at h1
  calc _ ≤ _ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ ‖L‖ * C₁ + C₂ :=
      add_le_add (h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC₁ z hz).1 L.opNorm_nonneg))
        (hC₂ z hz).2

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (G : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ³), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (univ ×ˢ Iio 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x t, ‖x‖ < δ → 1 - δ < t → t < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m G (x, t)‖ < ε) → (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C t₁ : ℝ, t₁ < 1 ∧ ∀ x t, δ ≤ ‖x‖ → t₁ < t → t < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m G (x, t)‖ ≤ C) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ t₀ < 1, ∀ x : ℝ³, ∀ t t' : ℝ, t₀ < t → t < 1 → t₀ < t' → t' < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m G (x, t) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m G (x, t')‖ < ε

signature.name: uniform_cauchy_of_flat_and_bounded
signature.statement: ∀ (G : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ³), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (univ ×ˢ Iio 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x t, ‖x‖ < δ → 1 - δ < t → t < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m G (x, t)‖ < ε) → (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C t₁ : ℝ, t₁ < 1 ∧ ∀ x t, δ ≤ ‖x‖ → t₁ < t → t < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m G (x, t)‖ ≤ C) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ t₀ < 1, ∀ x : ℝ³, ∀ t t' : ℝ, t₀ < t → t < 1 → t₀ < t' → t' < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m G (x, t) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m G (x, t')‖ < ε

proof.tactics:
by
  intro G hG hflat hbd m ε hε
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hδb⟩ := hflat m (ε / 2) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨C, t₁, ht₁, hC⟩ := hbd δ₀ hδ₀ (m + 1)
  obtain ⟨C', hC'⟩ : ∃ C' : ℝ, C' = max C 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hC'0 : 0 ≤ C' := hC' ▸ le_max_right _ _
  have hCC' : C ≤ C' := hC' ▸ le_max_left _ _
  obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ : ∃ η : ℝ, η = ε / (2 * (C' + 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hηpos : 0 < η := by rw [hη]; positivity
  have hηe : 2 * (C' + 1) * η = ε := by
    rw [hη]; field_simp
  obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀⟩ : ∃ t₀ : ℝ, t₀ = max (max (1 - δ₀) t₁) (1 - η) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have h1 : max (1 - δ₀) t₁ ≤ t₀ := ht₀ ▸ le_max_left _ _
  have h2 : 1 - η ≤ t₀ := ht₀ ▸ le_max_right _ _
  have h3 := le_max_left (1 - δ₀) t₁
  have h4 := le_max_right (1 - δ₀) t₁
  refine ⟨t₀, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ht₀]; exact max_lt (max_lt (by linarith) ht₁) (by linarith)
  intro x t t' ht ht1 ht' ht'1
  rcases lt_or_ge ‖x‖ δ₀ with hx | hx
  · have a := hδb x t hx (by linarith) ht1
    have b := hδb x t' hx (by linarith) ht'1
    calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m G (x, t)‖ + ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m G (x, t')‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ < ε := by linarith
  · have hopen : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Iio (1:ℝ) : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Iio
    have hS : Convex ℝ (({x} : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Ioo t₀ 1) :=
      (convex_singleton x).prod (convex_Ioo t₀ 1)
    have hdiff : ∀ z ∈ (({x} : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Ioo t₀ 1),
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m G) z := by
      intro z hz
      have hz1 : z ∈ (univ ×ˢ Iio (1:ℝ) : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) := ⟨mem_univ _, hz.2.2⟩
      exact (hG.contDiffAt (hopen.mem_nhds hz1)).differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv
        (by exact_mod_cast ENat.natCast_lt_top m)
    have hbound : ∀ z ∈ (({x} : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Ioo t₀ 1),
        ‖fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m G) z‖ ≤ C' := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := z
      obtain ⟨hz1, hz2a, hz2b⟩ := hz
      simp only [mem_singleton_iff] at hz1
      subst hz1
      rw [norm_fderiv_iteratedFDeriv]
      exact (hC z1 z2 hx (by linarith) hz2b).trans hCC'
    have key := hS.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hdiff hbound
      (show ((x, t') : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ ({x} : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Ioo t₀ 1 from ⟨rfl, ht', ht'1⟩)
      (show ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ ({x} : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Ioo t₀ 1 from ⟨rfl, ht, ht1⟩)
    have hnorm : ‖((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) - (x, t')‖ = |t - t'| := by
      rw [Prod.mk_sub_mk, sub_self, Prod.norm_mk, norm_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact max_eq_right (abs_nonneg _)
    rw [hnorm] at key
    have habs : |t - t'| < η := by
      rw [abs_sub_lt_iff]; constructor <;> linarith
    have hm : C' * |t - t'| ≤ C' * η := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left habs.le hC'0
    nlinarith

informal_problem.statement: (∀ (ν : ℝ) (u₁ u₂ : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p₁ p₂ : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)), IsOpen O → (∀ z ∈ O, (↿u₁) z = (↿u₂) z) → (∀ z ∈ O, (↿p₁) z = (↿p₂) z) → ∀ z ∈ O, (↿(nsResidual ν u₁ p₁)) z = (↿(nsResidual ν u₂ p₂)) z) ∧ (∀ (ν : ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), nsResidual ν (fun _ _ => (0 : ℝ³)) (fun _ _ => (0 : ℝ)) x t = 0)

signature.name: nsResidual_local_and_zero
signature.statement: (∀ (ν : ℝ) (u₁ u₂ : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p₁ p₂ : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)), IsOpen O → (∀ z ∈ O, (↿u₁) z = (↿u₂) z) → (∀ z ∈ O, (↿p₁) z = (↿p₂) z) → ∀ z ∈ O, (↿(nsResidual ν u₁ p₁)) z = (↿(nsResidual ν u₂ p₂)) z) ∧ (∀ (ν : ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), nsResidual ν (fun _ _ => (0 : ℝ³)) (fun _ _ => (0 : ℝ)) x t = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ν u₁ u₂ p₁ p₂ O hO hu hp ⟨x, t⟩ hz
    have hNt : {s : ℝ | ((x, s) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ O} ∈ nhds t :=
      (hO.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mem_nhds hz
    have hNx : {y : ℝ³ | ((y, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ O} ∈ nhds x :=
      (hO.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mem_nhds hz
    have E1 : (fun s => u₁ x s) =ᶠ[nhds t] (fun s => u₂ x s) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hNt (fun s hs => hu (x, s) hs)
    have E2 : (fun y => u₁ y t) =ᶠ[nhds x] (fun y => u₂ y t) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hNx (fun y hy => hu (y, t) hy)
    have E3 : (fun y => p₁ y t) =ᶠ[nhds x] (fun y => p₂ y t) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hNx (fun y hy => hp (y, t) hy)
    have E0 : u₁ x t = u₂ x t := hu (x, t) hz
    have h4 : deriv (fun s => u₁ x s) t = deriv (fun s => u₂ x s) t := E1.deriv_eq
    have h5 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => u₁ y t) x = fderiv ℝ (fun y => u₂ y t) x := E2.fderiv_eq
    have h6 : Δ (fun y => u₁ y t) x = Δ (fun y => u₂ y t) x :=
      (InnerProductSpace.laplacian_congr_nhds E2).eq_of_nhds
    have h7 : gradient (fun y => p₁ y t) x = gradient (fun y => p₂ y t) x := E3.gradient_eq
    show nsResidual ν u₁ p₁ x t = nsResidual ν u₂ p₂ x t
    unfold nsResidual
    rw [h4, h5, h6, h7, E0]
  · intro ν x t
    unfold nsResidual
    have h1 : Δ (fun _ : ℝ³ => (0 : ℝ³)) = 0 := InnerProductSpace.laplacian_const
    simp [h1, gradient_fun_const]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (c R : ℝ) (K : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ K (univ ×ˢ Iio c) → (∀ x t, t < c → R ≤ ‖x‖ → K (x, t) = 0) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ t₀ < c, ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ∀ t t' : ℝ, t₀ < t → t < c → t₀ < t' → t' < c → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (x, t) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (x, t')‖ < ε) → ∃ N : (m : ℕ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ t₀ < c, ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ∀ t : ℝ, t₀ < t → t < c → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (x, t) - N m x‖ < ε) ∧ (∀ m x, R ≤ ‖x‖ → N m x = 0)

signature.name: jet_limits_of_uniform_cauchy
signature.statement: ∀ (c R : ℝ) (K : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ K (univ ×ˢ Iio c) → (∀ x t, t < c → R ≤ ‖x‖ → K (x, t) = 0) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ t₀ < c, ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ∀ t t' : ℝ, t₀ < t → t < c → t₀ < t' → t' < c → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (x, t) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (x, t')‖ < ε) → ∃ N : (m : ℕ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ t₀ < c, ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ∀ t : ℝ, t₀ < t → t < c → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (x, t) - N m x‖ < ε) ∧ (∀ m x, R ≤ ‖x‖ → N m x = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro c R K hK hvan hC
  have hO : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Iio c : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ)) :=
    isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Iio
  
  have hZ : ∀ (m : ℕ) (U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ)) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ),
      IsOpen U → z ∈ U → (∀ w ∈ U, K w = 0) → iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K z = 0 := by
    intro m U z hU hz hKU
    have h : K =ᶠ[nhds z] fun _ => (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hz) hKU
    rw [(h.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
    rfl
  have hout : ∀ (m : ℕ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) (t : ℝ), t < c → R < ‖x‖ →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (x, t) = 0 := by
    intro m x t ht hx
    refine hZ m {w | R < ‖w.1‖ ∧ w.2 < c} (x, t) ?_ ⟨hx, ht⟩ ?_
    · exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_norm.comp continuous_fst)).inter
        (isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const)
    · rintro ⟨y, s⟩ ⟨hy, hs⟩
      exact hvan y s hs hy.le
  have hvanD : ∀ (m : ℕ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) (t : ℝ), t < c → R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (x, t) = 0 := by
    intro m x t ht hx
    by_cases hR : R ≤ 0
    · refine hZ m (univ ×ˢ Iio c) (x, t) hO ⟨mem_univ _, ht⟩ ?_
      rintro ⟨y, s⟩ ⟨-, hs⟩
      exact hvan y s hs (le_trans hR (norm_nonneg _))
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hx with hlt | heq
    · exact hout m x t ht hlt
    · push_neg at hR
      have hmem : (x, t) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Iio c : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ)) :=
        ⟨mem_univ _, ht⟩
      have hcont : ContinuousAt (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K) (x, t) :=
        (hK.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hmem)).continuousAt_iteratedFDeriv
          (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have ha : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
        have := (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat).const_add (1 : ℝ)
        rwa [add_zero] at this
      have hz : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (((1 : ℝ) + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) • x, t))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (x, t)) := by
        have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((1 : ℝ) + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) • x)
            Filter.atTop (nhds x) := by
          have := ha.smul_const x
          rwa [one_smul] at this
        exact h1.prodMk_nhds tendsto_const_nhds
      have hlim := hcont.tendsto.comp hz
      have hzero : ∀ n : ℕ,
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (((1 : ℝ) + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) • x, t) = 0 := by
        intro n
        apply hout m _ t ht
        have hp : 0 < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by linarith), ← heq]
        nlinarith
      have h0 : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun n : ℕ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (((1 : ℝ) + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) • x, t))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
        (Filter.tendsto_congr hzero).mpr tendsto_const_nhds
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique hlim h0
  have hlim : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ L : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ
      (fun _ : Fin m => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)),
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ t₀ < c, ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ∀ t : ℝ, t₀ < t → t < c →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (x, t) - L x‖ < ε := by
    intro m
    haveI : CompleteSpace (ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ
        (fun _ : Fin m => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))) :=
      ContinuousMultilinearMap.instCompleteSpace
    have hex : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ∃ a, Filter.Tendsto
        (fun t => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (x, t)) (nhdsWithin c (Iio c)) (nhds a) := by
      intro x
      apply cauchy_map_iff_exists_tendsto.mp
      rw [Metric.cauchy_iff]
      refine ⟨Filter.map_neBot, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀, h⟩ := hC m ε hε
      refine ⟨(fun t => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (x, t)) '' Ioo t₀ c,
        Filter.image_mem_map (Ioo_mem_nhdsLT ht₀), ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ _ ⟨t', ht', rfl⟩
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      exact h x t t' ht.1 ht.2 ht'.1 ht'.2
    choose L hL using hex
    refine ⟨L, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀, h⟩ := hC m (ε / 2) (by linarith)
    refine ⟨t₀, ht₀, fun x t ht htc => ?_⟩
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun t' => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (x, t) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (x, t')‖)
        (nhdsWithin c (Iio c)) (nhds ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (x, t) - L x‖) :=
      ((hL x).const_sub _).norm
    have h2 : ∀ᶠ t' in nhdsWithin c (Iio c),
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (x, t) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (x, t')‖ ≤ ε / 2 := by
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsLT ht₀] with t' ht'
      exact (h x t t' ht htc ht'.1 ht'.2).le
    have h3 := le_of_tendsto h1 h2
    linarith
  choose N hN using hlim
  refine ⟨N, hN, fun m x hx => ?_⟩
  by_contra hne
  have hpos : 0 < ‖N m x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hne
  obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀, h⟩ := hN m _ hpos
  have h4 := h x ((t₀ + c) / 2) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  rw [hvanD m x _ (by linarith) hx, zero_sub, norm_neg] at h4
  exact lt_irrefl _ h4

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (c : ℝ) (K : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) (N : (m : ℕ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ K (univ ×ˢ Iio c) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ t₀ < c, ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ∀ t : ℝ, t₀ < t → t < c → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (x, t) - N m x‖ < ε) → (∀ m x, HasFDerivAt (N m) ((N (m+1) x).curryLeft.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ)) x) ∧ (∀ m, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (N m))

signature.name: jet_limits_smooth
signature.statement: ∀ (c : ℝ) (K : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) (N : (m : ℕ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ K (univ ×ˢ Iio c) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ t₀ < c, ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ∀ t : ℝ, t₀ < t → t < c → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (x, t) - N m x‖ < ε) → (∀ m x, HasFDerivAt (N m) ((N (m+1) x).curryLeft.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ)) x) ∧ (∀ m, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (N m))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro c K N hK hUC
  have hO : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Iio c : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ)) :=
    isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Iio
  have hΛ : ∀ (m : ℕ) (A : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ
      (fun _ : Fin (m+1) => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))),
      ‖A.curryLeft.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ)‖ ≤ ‖A‖ := by
    intro m A
    calc _ ≤ ‖A.curryLeft‖ * ‖ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖A‖ * 1 := by
          rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryLeft_norm]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_inl_le_one _ _ _)
            (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖A‖ := mul_one _
  have hΛsub : ∀ (m : ℕ) (A B : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ
      (fun _ : Fin (m+1) => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))),
      A.curryLeft.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ) -
        B.curryLeft.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ) =
        (A - B).curryLeft.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ) := by
    intro m A B
    ext v w
    simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryLeft_apply]
  have h1 : ∀ m x, HasFDerivAt (N m) ((N (m+1) x).curryLeft.comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ)) x := by
    intro m
    set t : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => c - 1 / ((n:ℝ) + 1) with ht_def
    have htc : ∀ n, t n < c := by
      intro n
      have : (0:ℝ) < 1 / ((n:ℝ)+1) := by positivity
      simp only [ht_def]
      linarith
    have hev : ∀ t₀ < c, ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, t₀ < t n := by
      intro t₀ ht₀
      obtain ⟨n₀, hn₀⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt (sub_pos.mpr ht₀)
      rw [Filter.eventually_atTop]
      refine ⟨n₀, fun n hn => ?_⟩
      have : 1 / ((n:ℝ)+1) ≤ 1 / ((n₀:ℝ)+1) := by
        apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
        have : (n₀:ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
        linarith
      simp only [ht_def]
      linarith
    have hder : ∀ n x, HasFDerivAt (fun y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (y, t n))
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m+1) K (x, t n)).curryLeft.comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ)) x := by
      intro n x
      have hmem : (x, t n) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Iio c : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ)) :=
        ⟨mem_univ _, htc n⟩
      have hKat : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ K (x, t n) := hK.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hmem)
      have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K) (x, t n) :=
        hKat.differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (ENat.coe_lt_top m))
      have h2 : HasFDerivAt (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K)
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m+1) K (x, t n)).curryLeft (x, t n) := by
        have := hdiff.hasFDerivAt
        rw [fderiv_iteratedFDeriv] at this
        exact this
      exact h2.comp x (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left x (t n))
    have hU : TendstoUniformly
        (fun n y => (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m+1) K (y, t n)).curryLeft.comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ))
        (fun y => (N (m+1) y).curryLeft.comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ)) Filter.atTop := by
      have hd : ∀ ε > 0, ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, ∀ y,
          dist ((N (m+1) y).curryLeft.comp
            (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ))
          ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m+1) K (y, t n)).curryLeft.comp
            (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ)) < ε := by
        intro ε hε
        obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀, h⟩ := hUC (m+1) ε hε
        filter_upwards [hev t₀ ht₀] with n hn
        intro y
        have e := dist_eq_norm ((N (m+1) y).curryLeft.comp
            (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ))
          ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m+1) K (y, t n)).curryLeft.comp
            (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ))
        refine lt_of_eq_of_lt e ?_
        rw [hΛsub]
        refine lt_of_le_of_lt (hΛ _ _) ?_
        rw [norm_sub_rev]
        exact h y (t n) hn (htc n)
      exact Metric.tendstoUniformly_iff.mpr hd
    have hP : ∀ y, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (y, t n)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (N m y)) := by
      intro y
      rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds]
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀, h⟩ := hUC m ε hε
      filter_upwards [hev t₀ ht₀] with n hn
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      exact h y (t n) hn (htc n)
    intro x
    exact hasFDerivAt_of_tendstoUniformly
      (f := fun n y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m K (y, t n)) (g := N m) hU hder hP x
  refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
  have hk : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ m, ContDiff ℝ k (N m) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro m
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, contDiff_zero]
      exact continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x => (h1 m x).continuousAt
    | succ k ih =>
      intro m
      rw [Nat.cast_succ, contDiff_succ_iff_hasFDerivAt]
      refine ⟨fun x => (N (m+1) x).curryLeft.comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ), ?_, h1 m⟩
      have hcl : ContDiff ℝ k (fun A : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ
          (fun _ : Fin (m+1) => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) =>
            A.curryLeft) := by
        apply IsBoundedLinearMap.contDiff
        refine IsLinearMap.with_bound ⟨fun A B => ?_, fun r A => ?_⟩ 1 fun A => ?_
        · refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun x => ContinuousMultilinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
          simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryLeft_apply]
        · refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun x => ContinuousMultilinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
          simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryLeft_apply]
        · rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryLeft_norm, one_mul]
      have hL : ContDiff ℝ k (fun x => (N (m+1) x).curryLeft) := hcl.comp (ih (m+1))
      exact hL.clm_comp contDiff_const
  intro m
  exact contDiff_infty.mpr fun k => hk k m

informal_problem.statement: ∀ {E V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (U : Set E) (f : E → V), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ (m : ℕ) (w : Fin m → E) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)), iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z (w ∘ σ) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z w

signature.name: iteratedFDeriv_symm_of_contDiffOn
signature.statement: ∀ {E V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (U : Set E) (f : E → V), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ (m : ℕ) (w : Fin m → E) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)), iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z (w ∘ σ) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z w

proof.tactics:
by
  intro E V _ _ _ _ U f hU hf z hz m w σ
  
  have hperm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (n : ℕ)
      (A : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => E) W),
      (∀ (i : Fin n) (w : Fin (n + 1) → E), A (w ∘ Equiv.swap i.castSucc i.succ) = A w) →
      ∀ (w : Fin (n + 1) → E) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))), A (w ∘ σ) = A w := by
    intro W _ _ n A hA w σ
    have hσ : σ ∈ Submonoid.closure (Set.range fun i : Fin n => Equiv.swap i.castSucc i.succ) := by
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mclosure_swap_castSucc_succ]; exact Submonoid.mem_top σ
    induction hσ using Submonoid.closure_induction generalizing w with
    | mem x hx => obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx; exact hA i w
    | one => rfl
    | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
      rw [Equiv.Perm.coe_mul, ← Function.comp_assoc, hy, hx]
  
  have Q : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (g : E → W),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ (u : Fin (k + 2) → E) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (k + 2))),
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2) g y (u ∘ τ) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2) g y u := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro W _ _ g hg y hy u τ
      refine hperm 1 (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 g y) ?_ u τ
      intro i v
      have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst hi
      have hS : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ g y :=
        (hg.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)).isSymmSndFDerivAt
          (by rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]; exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply, iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      have h0 : Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 1).castSucc (0 : Fin 1).succ 0 = 1 := by decide
      have h1 : Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 1).castSucc (0 : Fin 1).succ 1 = 0 := by decide
      rw [h0, h1]
      exact hS.eq _ _
    | succ k ih =>
      intro W _ _ g hg y hy u τ
      have hgy : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g y := hg.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
      
      have hzero : ∀ v : Fin (k + 2 + 1) → E,
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y
            (v ∘ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (k + 2)).castSucc (0 : Fin (k + 2)).succ) =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y v := by
        intro v
        have hg' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ g) U :=
          ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).mp hg).2
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right (n := k + 2), iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right (n := k + 2)]
        have hlast : (v ∘ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (k + 2)).castSucc (0 : Fin (k + 2)).succ)
            (Fin.last (k + 2)) = v (Fin.last (k + 2)) := by
          simp only [Function.comp_apply]
          rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne]
          · apply Fin.ne_of_val_ne; simp
          · apply Fin.ne_of_val_ne; simp
        have hinit : Fin.init (v ∘ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (k + 2)).castSucc (0 : Fin (k + 2)).succ) =
            Fin.init v ∘ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (k + 1)).castSucc (0 : Fin (k + 1)).succ := by
          funext l
          simp only [Fin.init, Function.comp_apply]
          congr 1
          rw [Function.Injective.map_swap (Fin.castSucc_injective _)]
          congr 1
        rw [hlast, hinit]
        exact congrArg (fun A => A (v (Fin.last (k + 2))))
          (ih (fderiv ℝ g) hg' y hy (Fin.init v)
            (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (k + 1)).castSucc (0 : Fin (k + 1)).succ))
      
      have hsucc : ∀ (j : Fin (k + 1)) (v : Fin (k + 2 + 1) → E),
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y (v ∘ Equiv.swap j.succ.castSucc j.succ.succ) =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y v := by
        intro j v
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left (n := k + 2), iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left (n := k + 2)]
        have h0 : (v ∘ Equiv.swap j.succ.castSucc j.succ.succ) 0 = v 0 := by
          simp only [Function.comp_apply]
          rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne]
          · rw [← Fin.succ_castSucc]; exact (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm
          · exact (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm
        have htail : Fin.tail (v ∘ Equiv.swap j.succ.castSucc j.succ.succ) =
            Fin.tail v ∘ Equiv.swap j.castSucc j.succ := by
          funext l
          simp only [Fin.tail, Function.comp_apply]
          rw [Function.Injective.map_swap (Fin.succ_injective _), Fin.succ_castSucc]
        rw [h0, htail]
        have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2) g) y :=
          hgy.differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv
            (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (ENat.natCast_lt_top (k + 2)))
        rw [← fderiv_continuousMultilinear_apply_const_apply hd
              (Fin.tail v ∘ Equiv.swap j.castSucc j.succ) (v 0),
            ← fderiv_continuousMultilinear_apply_const_apply hd (Fin.tail v) (v 0)]
        congr 1
        apply Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq
        filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hy] with y' hy'
        exact ih g hg y' hy' _ _
      show iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y (u ∘ τ) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y u
      refine hperm (k + 2) (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y) ?_ u τ
      intro i v
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · exact hzero v
      · exact hsucc j v
  
  rcases m with _ | _ | k
  · congr 1; funext i; exact Fin.elim0 i
  · congr 1; funext i; simp only [Function.comp_apply]; congr 1
    exact Fin.ext (by have := (σ i).isLt; have := i.isLt; omega)
  · exact Q k f hf z hz w σ

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (D : (m : ℕ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))), (∀ m x, HasFDerivAt (D m) ((D (m+1) x).curryLeft.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ)) x) → (∀ m x (w : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)), D m x (w ∘ σ) = D m x w) → (∀ m x, D m x (fun _ => ((0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), (1 : ℝ))) = 0) → ∀ m x, D m x = 0

signature.name: jet_eq_zero_of_time_jet_zero
signature.statement: ∀ (D : (m : ℕ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))), (∀ m x, HasFDerivAt (D m) ((D (m+1) x).curryLeft.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ)) x) → (∀ m x (w : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)), D m x (w ∘ σ) = D m x w) → (∀ m x, D m x (fun _ => ((0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), (1 : ℝ))) = 0) → ∀ m x, D m x = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro D hD hS hT
  have key : ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ
      (fun _ : Fin (n+1) => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))),
      (∀ (w : Fin (n+1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n+1))),
        A (w ∘ σ) = A w) →
      (∀ (h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) (v : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ),
        A (Fin.cons ((h, (0:ℝ)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ) v) = 0) →
      A (fun _ => ((0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), (1 : ℝ))) = 0 → A = 0 := by
    intro n A hSym hCons hTime
    refine ContinuousMultilinearMap.ext (fun w => ?_)

      fun i => ((0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), (w i).2) with hb
    have hw : w = a + b := by
      funext i
      ext <;> simp [a, b]
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.zero_apply, hw, A.map_add_univ]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro s _
    rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hs | ⟨i, hi⟩
    · subst hs
      rw [Finset.piecewise_empty]
      have hb' : b = fun i => (w i).2 • ((0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), (1 : ℝ)) := by
        funext i
        ext <;> simp [b]
      rw [hb', A.map_smul_univ, hTime, smul_zero]
    · rw [← hSym (s.piecewise a b) (Equiv.swap 0 i)]
      have h0 : (s.piecewise a b ∘ Equiv.swap 0 i) 0 = ((w i).1, (0:ℝ)) := by
        rw [Function.comp_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_left, Finset.piecewise_eq_of_mem _ _ _ hi]
      have hu : (s.piecewise a b ∘ Equiv.swap 0 i) =
          Fin.cons ((w i).1, (0:ℝ)) (Fin.tail (s.piecewise a b ∘ Equiv.swap 0 i)) := by
        rw [← h0]
        exact (Fin.cons_self_tail _).symm

      exact hCons _ _
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro x
    refine ContinuousMultilinearMap.ext (fun w => ?_)
    have hw : w = fun _ => ((0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), (1 : ℝ)) := Subsingleton.elim _ _

  | succ n IH =>
    intro x

    intro h v
    have h0 : D n = fun _ => 0 := funext IH
    have hd := hD n x

    have hL := hd.unique (hasFDerivAt_const 0 x)
    have := congrArg (fun L => L h v) hL
    simpa [ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryLeft_apply] using this

signature.name: borel_extension
signature.statement: ∀ (c R : ℝ) (F : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F j)) → (∀ j x, R ≤ ‖x‖ → F j x = 0) → ∃ Φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ ∧ (∀ x t, R ≤ ‖x‖ → Φ (x, t) = 0) ∧ (∀ x t, c + 1 ≤ t → Φ (x, t) = 0) ∧ (∀ (j : ℕ) x, iteratedFDeriv ℝ j Φ (x, c) (fun _ => ((0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), (1 : ℝ))) = F j x)

by
  intro c R F hF hR
  have hsmall : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ lam : ℝ, 1 ≤ lam ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, k < j →
      ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ =>
        (Real.smoothTransition (4/3 * (1 - (lam * (z.2 - c))^2)) * (z.2 - c)^j / (j.factorial : ℝ)) • F j z.1) z‖
        ≤ (1/2 : ℝ)^j :=
    fun j => borel_term_small c R ((1/2 : ℝ)^j) j (F j) (hF j) (hR j) (by positivity)
  choose lam hlam1 hlam using hsmall
  have hprops := fun j => borel_term_props c R (lam j) j (F j) (hF j) (hR j) (hlam1 j)
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ : ∃ φ : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
      φ = fun j z => (Real.smoothTransition (4/3 * (1 - (lam j * (z.2 - c))^2)) * (z.2 - c)^j
        / (j.factorial : ℝ)) • F j z.1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsm : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (φ j) := fun j => by rw [hφ]; exact (hprops j).1
  have hbd : ∀ j k, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (φ j) z‖ ≤ M :=
    fun j => by rw [hφ]; exact (hprops j).2.2.2
  choose M hM using hbd
  have hlow : ∀ j k, k < j → ∀ z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (φ j) z‖ ≤ (1/2 : ℝ)^j :=
    fun j => by rw [hφ]; exact hlam j
  let v : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun k j => if k < j then (1/2 : ℝ)^j else M j k
  have hv : ∀ k j z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (φ j) z‖ ≤ v k j := by
    intro k j z
    by_cases h : k < j
    · simp only [v, if_pos h]; exact hlow j k h z
    · simp only [v, if_neg h]; exact hM j k z
  have hvs : ∀ k, Summable (v k) := by
    intro k
    have h1 : Summable (fun j : ℕ => (1/2 : ℝ)^j) := summable_geometric_two
    have h2 : Summable (fun j : ℕ => if k < j then (0 : ℝ) else M j k - (1/2 : ℝ)^j) := by
      apply summable_of_ne_finset_zero (s := Finset.range (k+1))
      intro b hb
      have hkb : k < b := by
        simp only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hb
        omega
      simp [hkb]
    convert h1.add h2 using 1
    funext j
    simp only [v, Pi.add_apply]
    split_ifs <;> ring

    intro j x t hx
    rw [hφ]
    exact (hprops j).2.1 x t hx
  have hzero_c : ∀ j x t, c + 1 ≤ t → φ j (x, t) = 0 := by
    intro j x t ht
    rw [hφ]
    exact (hprops j).2.2.1 x t ht

    intro n j x
    have e := borel_term_jet c (lam n) n j (F n) (hF n) x
    rw [hφ]
    refine e.trans ?_
    by_cases h : n = j
    · subst h; simp
    · simp [h, Ne.symm h]
  refine ⟨fun z => ∑' j, φ j z, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact contDiff_tsum (N := ⊤) (fun i => hsm i) (fun k _ => hvs k) (fun k i x _ => hv k i x)
  · intro x t hx
    simp only [hzero_R _ x t hx, tsum_zero]
  · intro x t ht
    simp only [hzero_c _ x t ht, tsum_zero]
  · intro j x
    have h1 := iteratedFDeriv_tsum_apply (N := ⊤) (fun i => hsm i) (fun k _ => hvs k)
      (fun k i x _ => hv k i x) (k := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top) (x, c)
    rw [h1]
    haveI hcs : CompleteSpace (ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ)
        (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))) := ContinuousMultilinearMap.instCompleteSpace
    have hsum : Summable (fun n => iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (φ n) (x, c)) :=
      Summable.of_norm_bounded (hvs j) (fun n => hv j n (x, c))
    have h2 := (ContinuousMultilinearMap.apply ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ)
      (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) (fun _ => ((0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), (1 : ℝ)))).map_tsum hsum
    simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.apply_apply] at h2
    rw [h2]
    simp only [hjet]
    exact tsum_ite_eq j (fun n => F n x)

subgoal_signatures.name: borel_term_jet

        _ ≤ ε * ‖h‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hε.le
  
  have hD : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ x t, c ≤ t → iteratedFDeriv ℝ m W (x, t) = 0 := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro x t ht
      ext v
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply, hW0 x t ht]
      simp
    | succ k ih =>
      intro x t ht
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left, Function.comp_apply,
        (hC k ih (x, t) ht).fderiv, LinearIsometryEquiv.map_zero]
  
  have hE : ∀ m : ℕ, Differentiable ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m W) := by
    intro m z
    by_cases hz : z.2 < c
    · exact hA m z hz
    · exact (hC m (hD m) z (not_lt.mp hz)).differentiableAt
  exact contDiff_of_differentiable_iteratedFDeriv (fun m _ => hE m)

signature.statement: ∀ (c R ε : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → (∀ x, R ≤ ‖x‖ → f x = 0) → 0 < ε → ∃ lam : ℝ, 1 ≤ lam ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, k < j → ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ => (Real.smoothTransition (4/3 * (1 - (lam * (z.2 - c))^2)) * (z.2 - c)^j / (j.factorial : ℝ)) • f z.1) z‖ ≤ ε

proof.tactics:
by
  intro c R ε j f hf hR hε
  
  set h : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => Real.smoothTransition (4/3 * (1 - s^2)) * s^j / (j.factorial : ℝ) with hh_def
  have hsm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ h := by
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (4/3 * (1 - s^2))) :=
      Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_id.pow 2)))
    exact (h1.mul (contDiff_id.pow j)).div_const _
  have hcs : HasCompactSupport h := by
    apply HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (-1:ℝ) 1))
    intro s hs
    simp only [mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le] at hs
    have : 1 < s^2 := by rcases hs with hs | hs <;> nlinarith
    simp only [hh_def]
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by nlinarith)]
    simp
  have hb : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ C, ∀ s, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i h s‖ ≤ C := by
    intro i
    exact (hsm.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).bounded_above_of_compact_support
      (hcs.iteratedFDeriv i)
  choose C hC using hb
  obtain ⟨H, hH_def⟩ : ∃ H : ℕ → ℝ, H = fun i => max (C i) 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hH0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ H i := fun i => by rw [hH_def]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hHb : ∀ (i : ℕ) (s : ℝ), ‖iteratedDeriv i h s‖ ≤ H i := by
    intro i s
    rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, hH_def]
    exact (hC i s).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  
  have hfcs : HasCompactSupport f := by
    apply HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) (max R 0))
    intro x hx
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hx
    exact hR x ((le_max_left R 0).trans hx.le)
  have hbf : ∀ l : ℕ, ∃ C, ∀ x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l f x‖ ≤ C := by
    intro l
    exact (hf.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).bounded_above_of_compact_support
      (hfcs.iteratedFDeriv l)
  choose Cf hCf using hbf
  obtain ⟨B, hB_def⟩ : ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ, B = fun l => max (Cf l) 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hB0 : ∀ l, 0 ≤ B l := fun l => by rw [hB_def]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hBb : ∀ (l : ℕ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l f x‖ ≤ B l := by
    intro l x
    rw [hB_def]
    exact (hCf l x).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  
  have scal : ∀ lam : ℝ, lam ≠ 0 → ∀ (i : ℕ) (t : ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv i (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (4/3 * (1 - (lam * (t - c))^2)) * (t - c)^j
        / (j.factorial : ℝ)) t = (lam ^ j)⁻¹ * lam ^ i * iteratedDeriv i h (lam * (t - c)) := by
    intro lam hlam i t
    have e1 : (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (4/3 * (1 - (lam * (t - c))^2)) * (t - c)^j
        / (j.factorial : ℝ)) = fun t => (lam^j)⁻¹ * h (lam * (t - c)) := by
      funext t
      simp only [hh_def, mul_pow]
      field_simp
    have e2 : iteratedDeriv i (fun t => h (lam * (t - c))) t
        = iteratedDeriv i (fun u => h (lam * u)) (t - c) :=
      congrFun (iteratedDeriv_comp_sub_const i (fun u => h (lam * u)) c) t
    have e3 : iteratedDeriv i (fun u => h (lam * u)) (t - c)
        = lam ^ i * iteratedDeriv i h (lam * (t - c)) :=
      congrFun (iteratedDeriv_comp_const_mul (hsm.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)) lam) (t - c)
    rw [e1, iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field, e2, e3]
    ring
  
  have leib : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ => g z.2 • f z.1) z‖ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k+1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedDeriv i g z.2‖ *
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) f z.1‖ := by
    intro g hg k z
    have hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ => g z.2) := hg.comp contDiff_snd
    have hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ => f z.1) := hf.comp contDiff_fst
    refine (norm_iteratedFDeriv_smul_le hG hF z (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).trans ?_
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    have h1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ => g z.2) z‖
        ≤ ‖iteratedDeriv i g z.2‖ := by
      have : (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ => g z.2)
          = g ∘ ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ) := rfl
      rw [this, ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right _ hg z (by exact_mod_cast le_top)]
      refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
      rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
      simp only [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      apply mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _)
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_snd_le ℝ _ ℝ)
    have h2 : ∀ m : ℕ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ => f z.1) z‖
        ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z.1‖ := by
      intro m
      have : (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ => f z.1)
          = f ∘ ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ) := rfl
      rw [this, ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right _ hf z (by exact_mod_cast le_top)]
      refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
      simp only [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      apply mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _)
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_fst_le ℝ _ ℝ)
    gcongr
    exact h2 _
  
  obtain ⟨A, hA_def⟩ : ∃ A : ℕ → ℝ,
      A = fun k => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k+1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * H i * B (k - i) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ A k := by
    intro k
    rw [hA_def]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hH0 i)) (hB0 _))
  obtain ⟨S, hS_def⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, S = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range j, A k := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ S := by rw [hS_def]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => hA0 k)
  obtain ⟨lam, hlam_def⟩ : ∃ lam : ℝ, lam = 1 + S / ε := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hSe : 0 ≤ S / ε := div_nonneg hS0 hε.le
  have hlam1 : 1 ≤ lam := by rw [hlam_def]; linarith
  have hlam0 : 0 < lam := by linarith
  refine ⟨lam, hlam1, ?_⟩
  intro k hk z
  have hgsm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (4/3 * (1 - (lam * (t - c))^2)) * (t - c)^j
      / (j.factorial : ℝ)) := by
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (4/3 * (1 - (lam * (t - c))^2))) :=
      Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_const.sub
        ((contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)).pow 2)))
    exact (h1.mul ((contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).pow j)).div_const _
  refine (leib _ hgsm k z).trans ?_
  calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k+1), (k.choose i : ℝ) *
          ‖iteratedDeriv i (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (4/3 * (1 - (lam * (t - c))^2)) * (t - c)^j
            / (j.factorial : ℝ)) z.2‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) f z.1‖
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k+1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * H i * B (k - i) / lam := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        have hik : i + 1 ≤ j := by
          rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
          omega
        have hfac : (lam ^ j)⁻¹ * lam ^ i ≤ 1 / lam := by
          rw [inv_mul_eq_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hlam0 j) hlam0]
          have := pow_le_pow_right₀ hlam1 hik
          rw [pow_succ] at this
          linarith
        have hgi : ‖iteratedDeriv i (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (4/3 * (1 - (lam * (t - c))^2))
            * (t - c)^j / (j.factorial : ℝ)) z.2‖ ≤ H i / lam := by
          rw [scal lam hlam0.ne' i z.2, norm_mul, norm_mul,
            Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 (pow_pos hlam0 j).le),
            Real.norm_of_nonneg (pow_pos hlam0 i).le]
          calc (lam ^ j)⁻¹ * lam ^ i * ‖iteratedDeriv i h (lam * (z.2 - c))‖
              ≤ (1 / lam) * H i :=
                mul_le_mul hfac (hHb i _) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
            _ = H i / lam := by ring
        calc (k.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedDeriv i (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition
              (4/3 * (1 - (lam * (t - c))^2)) * (t - c)^j / (j.factorial : ℝ)) z.2‖ *
              ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) f z.1‖
            ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * (H i / lam) * B (k - i) :=
              mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgi (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) (hBb _ _) (norm_nonneg _)
                (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (div_nonneg (hH0 i) hlam0.le))
          _ = (k.choose i : ℝ) * H i * B (k - i) / lam := by ring
    _ = A k / lam := by rw [hA_def, Finset.sum_div]
    _ ≤ S / lam := by
        apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hlam0.le
        rw [hS_def]
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => hA0 k) (Finset.mem_range.2 hk)
    _ ≤ ε := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hlam0, hlam_def]
        have : ε * (S / ε) = S := by field_simp
        nlinarith

by
  intro c R lam j f hf hR hlam
  have hσ0 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ |t - c| →
      Real.smoothTransition (4/3 * (1 - (lam * (t - c))^2)) * (t - c)^j / (j.factorial : ℝ) = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    have h1 : 1 ≤ (t - c)^2 := (one_le_sq_iff_one_le_abs _).mpr ht
    have h2 : 1 ≤ lam^2 := by nlinarith
    have h3 : 1 ≤ (lam * (t - c))^2 := by rw [mul_pow]; nlinarith
    have h4 : 4/3 * (1 - (lam * (t - c))^2) ≤ 0 := by nlinarith
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos h4, zero_mul, zero_div]
  set φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) := fun z =>
    (Real.smoothTransition (4/3 * (1 - (lam * (z.2 - c))^2)) * (z.2 - c)^j / (j.factorial : ℝ)) • f z.1
    with hφ
  have hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ := by
    have g1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ => 4/3 * (1 - (lam * (z.2 - c))^2)) := by
      fun_prop
    have g2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ =>
        Real.smoothTransition (4/3 * (1 - (lam * (z.2 - c))^2))) :=
      (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := ⊤)).comp g1
    have g3 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ =>
        Real.smoothTransition (4/3 * (1 - (lam * (z.2 - c))^2)) * (z.2 - c)^j / (j.factorial : ℝ)) :=
      (g2.mul ((contDiff_snd.sub contDiff_const).pow j)).div_const _
    exact g3.smul (hf.comp contDiff_fst)
  have hK : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) (max R 0) ×ˢ Set.Icc (c - 1) (c + 1)) :=
    (isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod isCompact_Icc
  have hcs : HasCompactSupport φ := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro hK ?_
    intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_prod, not_and_or] at hz
    rcases hz with hz | hz
    · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hz
      have : f z.1 = 0 := hR _ (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hz.le)
      simp only [hφ, this, smul_zero]
    · rw [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at hz
      have h1 : 1 ≤ |z.2 - c| := by
        rcases hz with hz | hz
        · rw [le_abs]; right; linarith
        · rw [le_abs]; left; linarith
      simp only [hφ, hσ0 z.2 h1, zero_smul]

  · intro x t hx
    rw [hR x hx, smul_zero]

      funext s
      simp [g, a]

      ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right g hΦ' c (by exact_mod_cast le_top),
      ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right]
    simp [g, a]

    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × ℝ =>
        Real.smoothTransition (4/3 * (1 - (lam * (z.2 - c))^2))) :=

  have hev : ∀ᶠ t in nhds c, Real.smoothTransition (4/3 * (1 - (lam * (t - c))^2)) = 1 := by
    have hδ : (0:ℝ) < 1 / (2 * (|lam| + 1)) := by positivity
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds c hδ] with t ht
    apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] at ht

        linarith
