    have hu0 : 0 ≤ |lam| * |t - c| := by positivity
    rw [hsq]
    nlinarith
  
  have hmono : iteratedDeriv i (fun t : ℝ => (t - c) ^ j / (j.factorial : ℝ)) c = if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
    have h1 := congrFun (iteratedDeriv_comp_sub_const i (fun u : ℝ => u ^ j / (j.factorial : ℝ)) c) c
    simp only [sub_self] at h1
    rw [h1, iteratedDeriv_div_const (fun u : ℝ => u ^ j), iteratedDeriv_pow]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst h
      have hf0 : (i.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero i)
      simp [Nat.descFactorial_self, hf0]
    · rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne h with h' | h'
      · rw [zero_pow (by omega)]
        simp
      · rw [Nat.descFactorial_eq_zero_iff_lt.mpr h']
        simp
  
  rw [hline _ hΦ]
  have hq : ContDiffAt ℝ (i : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun s : ℝ => (s - c) ^ j / (j.factorial : ℝ)) c :=
    (((contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).pow j).div_const _).contDiffAt
  refine (Filter.EventuallyEq.iteratedDeriv_eq i
    (g := fun s : ℝ => ((s - c) ^ j / (j.factorial : ℝ)) • f x) ?_).trans ?_
  · filter_upwards [hev] with s hs
    rw [hs, one_mul]
  · rw [iteratedDeriv_smul_const hq (f x), hmono]
    split_ifs <;> simp

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (ν T R : ℝ) (u v : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p P : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³), 0 < T → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) → (∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → t < T → nsResidual ν u p x t = f x t) → (∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → t < T → divergence (fun y => u y t) x = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿v) (univ ×ˢ Ici 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿P) (univ ×ˢ Ici 0) → (∀ x, ∀ t ≥ 0, derivWithin (v x ·) (Ici 0) t + fderiv ℝ (v · t) x (v x t) = ν • Δ (v · t) x - gradient (P · t) x + f x t) → (∀ x, ∀ t ≥ 0, divergence (v · t) x = 0) → ∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → t < T → (derivWithin (fun s => v x s - u x s) (Ici 0) t + fderiv ℝ (fun y => v y t - u y t) x (v x t) + fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) x (v x t - u x t) = ν • Δ (fun y => v y t - u y t) x - gradient (fun y => P y t - p y t) x) ∧ (0 < t → ∀ i : Fin 3, deriv (fun s => v x s i - u x s i) t + ∑ j, pd j (fun y => v y t i * v y t j - u y t i * u y t j) x = ν * (Δ (fun y => v y t - u y t) x) i - pd i (fun y => P y t - p y t) x) ∧ divergence (fun y => v y t - u y t) x = 0

signature.name: rn_difference_equations
signature.statement: ∀ (ν T R : ℝ) (u v : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p P : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³), 0 < T → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) → (∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → t < T → nsResidual ν u p x t = f x t) → (∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → t < T → divergence (fun y => u y t) x = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿v) (univ ×ˢ Ici 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿P) (univ ×ˢ Ici 0) → (∀ x, ∀ t ≥ 0, derivWithin (v x ·) (Ici 0) t + fderiv ℝ (v · t) x (v x t) = ν • Δ (v · t) x - gradient (P · t) x + f x t) → (∀ x, ∀ t ≥ 0, divergence (v · t) x = 0) → ∀ x t, 0 ≤ t → t < T → (derivWithin (fun s => v x s - u x s) (Ici 0) t + fderiv ℝ (fun y => v y t - u y t) x (v x t) + fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) x (v x t - u x t) = ν • Δ (fun y => v y t - u y t) x - gradient (fun y => P y t - p y t) x) ∧ (0 < t → ∀ i : Fin 3, deriv (fun s => v x s i - u x s i) t + ∑ j, pd j (fun y => v y t i * v y t j - u y t i * u y t j) x = ν * (Δ (fun y => v y t - u y t) x) i - pd i (fun y => P y t - p y t) x) ∧ divergence (fun y => v y t - u y t) x = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ν T R u v p P f hT hu hp hres hdivu hv hP hNS hdivv x t ht0 htT
  
  have comp_fderiv : ∀ (V : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (y h : ℝ³) (i : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ V y →
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => V z i) y h = fderiv ℝ V y h i := by
    intro V y h i hV
    have hh := ((EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp y hV.hasFDerivAt).fderiv
    have e : (fun z => V z i) = (EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ V := rfl
    rw [e, hh]
    rfl
  have grad_comp : ∀ (F : ℝ³ → ℝ) (y : ℝ³) (i : Fin 3), gradient F y i = pd i F y := by
    intro F y i
    have hh := EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right i (1:ℝ) (gradient F y)
    simp only [map_one, one_mul, RCLike.conj_to_real] at hh
    rw [← hh, gradient, InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply]
    rfl
  have dfa : ∀ (V : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (y : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ V y → divergence V y = 0 →
      ∀ i : Fin 3, ∑ j, pd j (fun z => V z i * V z j) y = fderiv ℝ V y (V y) i := by
    intro V y hV hdiv i
    have hc : ∀ k, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => V z k) y := fun k =>
      (EuclideanSpace.proj k : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).differentiableAt.comp y hV
    have hpd : ∀ j, pd j (fun z => V z i * V z j) y
        = V y i * fderiv ℝ V y (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) j
          + V y j * fderiv ℝ V y (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) i := by
      intro j
      unfold pd
      rw [fderiv_fun_mul (hc i) (hc j)]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [comp_fderiv V y _ i hV, comp_fderiv V y _ j hV]
    have htr : ∑ j, fderiv ℝ V y (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) j = 0 := by
      rw [← hdiv]
      unfold divergence
      rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_sum_inner _ (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)]
      simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
    have hexp : V y = ∑ j, V y j • EuclideanSpace.single j (1:ℝ) := by
      ext k
      fin_cases k <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.single_apply]
    have happ : fderiv ℝ V y (V y) i
        = ∑ j, V y j * fderiv ℝ V y (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) i := by
      have h2 : fderiv ℝ V y (∑ j, V y j • EuclideanSpace.single j (1:ℝ)) i
          = ∑ j, V y j * fderiv ℝ V y (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) i := by
        simp [map_sum, map_smul]
      rw [← hexp] at h2
      exact h2
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hpd j), Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, htr,
      happ]
    ring
  
  have slice : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (g : ℝ³ → ℝ → F)
      (S : Set ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (univ ×ˢ S) → t ∈ S → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => g y t) := by
    intro F _ _ g S hg hs'
    have h : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((↿g) ∘ (fun y : ℝ³ => (y, t))) univ :=
      hg.comp (contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffOn (fun y _ => ⟨mem_univ _, hs'⟩)
    exact contDiffOn_univ.mp h
  have ht0' : t ∈ Ici (0:ℝ) := ht0
  have hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => v y t) := slice v (Ici 0) hv ht0'
  have hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => u y t) := slice u (Iio T) hu htT
  have hPs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => P y t) := slice P (Ici 0) hP ht0'
  have hps : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => p y t) := slice p (Iio T) hp htT
  have hVd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => v y t) x := hV.differentiable (by simp) x
  have hUd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => u y t) x := hU.differentiable (by simp) x
  have hN2 : (univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Iio T ∈ nhds (x, t) :=
    prod_mem_nhds Filter.univ_mem (Iio_mem_nhds htT)
  have hγ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun r : ℝ => (x, r)) t :=
    (differentiableAt_const x).prodMk differentiableAt_id
  have hud : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun r => u x r) t :=
    ((hu.contDiffAt hN2).differentiableAt (by simp)).comp t hγ
  have hvdw : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ (fun r => v x r) (Ici 0) t := by
    have h1 : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ (↿v) (univ ×ˢ Ici 0) (x, t) :=
      hv.differentiableOn (by simp) (x, t) ⟨mem_univ _, ht0⟩
    exact h1.comp t hγ.differentiableWithinAt (fun r hr => ⟨mem_univ _, hr⟩)
  have e2 : derivWithin (fun s => v x s - u x s) (Ici 0) t
      = derivWithin (fun s => v x s) (Ici 0) t - deriv (fun s => u x s) t := by
    rw [derivWithin_fun_sub hvdw hud.differentiableWithinAt,
      hud.derivWithin (uniqueDiffOn_Ici (0:ℝ) t ht0)]
  have e3 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => v y t - u y t) x
      = fderiv ℝ (fun y => v y t) x - fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) x := fderiv_fun_sub hVd hUd
  have e4 : Δ (fun y => v y t - u y t) x = Δ (fun y => v y t) x - Δ (fun y => u y t) x :=
    ContDiffAt.laplacian_sub (hV.contDiffAt.of_le (by simp)) (hU.contDiffAt.of_le (by simp))
  have e5 : gradient (fun y => P y t - p y t) x
      = gradient (fun y => P y t) x - gradient (fun y => p y t) x := by
    simp only [gradient]
    rw [fderiv_fun_sub (hPs.differentiable (by simp) x) (hps.differentiable (by simp) x), map_sub]
  have h1 := hNS x t ht0
  have h2 := hres x t ht0 htT
  unfold nsResidual at h2
  have ha : derivWithin (fun r => v x r) (Ici 0) t
      = ν • Δ (fun y => v y t) x - gradient (fun y => P y t) x + f x t
        - fderiv ℝ (fun y => v y t) x (v x t) := eq_sub_of_add_eq h1
  have hb : deriv (fun r => u x r) t
      = f x t - fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) x (u x t) + ν • Δ (fun y => u y t) x
        - gradient (fun y => p y t) x := by
    rw [← h2]; abel
  have C1 : derivWithin (fun s => v x s - u x s) (Ici 0) t
      + fderiv ℝ (fun y => v y t - u y t) x (v x t)
      + fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) x (v x t - u x t)
      = ν • Δ (fun y => v y t - u y t) x - gradient (fun y => P y t - p y t) x := by
    rw [e2, e3, e4, e5, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, map_sub, smul_sub, ha, hb]
    abel
  have C3 : divergence (fun y => v y t - u y t) x = 0 := by
    have hv0 := hdivv x t ht0
    have hu0 := hdivu x t ht0 htT
    unfold divergence at hv0 hu0 ⊢
    rw [e3, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_sub, map_sub, hv0, hu0, sub_zero]
  refine ⟨C1, ?_, C3⟩
  intro htpos i
  have hN1 : (univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Ici (0:ℝ) ∈ nhds (x, t) :=
    prod_mem_nhds Filter.univ_mem (Ici_mem_nhds htpos)
  have hvd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun r => v x r) t :=
    ((hv.contDiffAt hN1).differentiableAt (by simp)).comp t hγ
  have hwd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s => v x s - u x s) t := hvd.sub hud
  have Et : deriv (fun s => v x s i - u x s i) t
      = derivWithin (fun s => v x s - u x s) (Ici 0) t i := by
    rw [derivWithin_of_mem_nhds (Ici_mem_nhds htpos)]
    exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hwd.hasDerivAt).deriv
  have Eg : gradient (fun y => P y t - p y t) x i = pd i (fun y => P y t - p y t) x :=
    grad_comp _ _ _
  have hprod : ∀ (W : ℝ³ → ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ W x → ∀ j : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => W y i * W y j) x := by
    intro W hW j
    exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).differentiableAt.comp x hW).mul
      ((EuclideanSpace.proj j : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).differentiableAt.comp x hW)
  have hfv := dfa (fun y => v y t) x hVd (hdivv x t ht0) i
  have hfu := dfa (fun y => u y t) x hUd (hdivu x t ht0 htT) i
  simp only at hfv hfu
  have Eflux : ∑ j, pd j (fun y => v y t i * v y t j - u y t i * u y t j) x
      = fderiv ℝ (fun y => v y t) x (v x t) i - fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) x (u x t) i := by
    have hs : ∀ j, pd j (fun y => v y t i * v y t j - u y t i * u y t j) x
        = pd j (fun y => v y t i * v y t j) x - pd j (fun y => u y t i * u y t j) x := by
      intro j
      unfold pd
      rw [fderiv_fun_sub (hprod _ hVd j) (hprod _ hUd j)]
      rfl
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hs j), Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hfv, hfu]
  have hC1i := congrArg (fun z : ℝ³ => z i) C1
  simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, e3,
    ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, map_sub] at hC1i
  rw [Et, Eflux, ← Eg]
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (T₁ T R E : ℝ) (u v : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³), 0 < T₁ → T₁ < T → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) → (∀ x t, t < T → R ≤ ‖x‖ → u x t = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿v) (univ ×ˢ Ici 0) → (∀ t ≥ 0, MemLp (fun x => ‖v x t‖) 2) → (∀ t ≥ 0, (∫ x, ‖v x t‖ ^ 2) < E) → ∃ M L C₀ C₁ : ℝ, (∀ x t, t ∈ Icc 0 T₁ → ‖u x t‖ ≤ M) ∧ (∀ x t, t ∈ Icc 0 T₁ → ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) x‖ ≤ L) ∧ (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T₁, MemLp (fun x => v x t - u x t) 2 ∧ (∫ x, ‖v x t - u x t‖ ^ 2) ≤ C₀) ∧ (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T₁, ∀ i j : Fin 3, Integrable (fun x => v x t i * v x t j - u x t i * u x t j) ∧ (∫ x, |v x t i * v x t j - u x t i * u x t j|) ≤ C₁)

signature.name: rn_uniform_bounds
signature.statement: ∀ (T₁ T R E : ℝ) (u v : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³), 0 < T₁ → T₁ < T → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) → (∀ x t, t < T → R ≤ ‖x‖ → u x t = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿v) (univ ×ˢ Ici 0) → (∀ t ≥ 0, MemLp (fun x => ‖v x t‖) 2) → (∀ t ≥ 0, (∫ x, ‖v x t‖ ^ 2) < E) → ∃ M L C₀ C₁ : ℝ, (∀ x t, t ∈ Icc 0 T₁ → ‖u x t‖ ≤ M) ∧ (∀ x t, t ∈ Icc 0 T₁ → ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) x‖ ≤ L) ∧ (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T₁, MemLp (fun x => v x t - u x t) 2 ∧ (∫ x, ‖v x t - u x t‖ ^ 2) ≤ C₀) ∧ (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T₁, ∀ i j : Fin 3, Integrable (fun x => v x t i * v x t j - u x t i * u x t j) ∧ (∫ x, |v x t i * v x t j - u x t i * u x t j|) ≤ C₁)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro T₁ T R E u v hT₁ hT₁T hu hvan hv hL2 hE
  have hO : IsOpen ((univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Iio T) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Iio
  have hK : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ³) R ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) T₁) :=
    (isCompact_closedBall 0 R).prod isCompact_Icc
  have hKO : Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ³) R ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) T₁ ⊆ (univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Iio T :=
    fun z hz => ⟨mem_univ _, lt_of_le_of_lt hz.2.2 hT₁T⟩
  obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hu.continuousOn.mono hKO)
  have hfc : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (↿u)) ((univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Iio T) :=
    hu.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hfc.mono hKO)
  have hIT : ∀ t, t ∈ Icc 0 T₁ → t < T := fun t ht => lt_of_le_of_lt ht.2 hT₁T
  have hmemK : ∀ x t, t ∈ Icc 0 T₁ → ‖x‖ ≤ R →
      (x, t) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ³) R ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) T₁ := by
    intro x t ht hx
    refine ⟨?_, ht⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    exact hx
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ max M₀ 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hM : ∀ x t, t ∈ Icc 0 T₁ → ‖u x t‖ ≤ max M₀ 0 := by
    intro x t ht
    by_cases hx : ‖x‖ ≤ R
    · exact le_trans (hM₀ (x, t) (hmemK x t ht hx)) (le_max_left _ _)
    · rw [hvan x t (hIT t ht) (le_of_lt (not_le.mp hx)), norm_zero]
      exact hM0
  have hL : ∀ x t, t ∈ Icc 0 T₁ → ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) x‖ ≤ max L₀ 0 := by
    intro x t ht
    by_cases hx : ‖x‖ ≤ R
    · have hmem := hmemK x t ht hx
      have hxO := hKO hmem
      have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿u) (x, t) :=
        (hu.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds hxO)
      have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun y => u y t)
          ((fderiv ℝ (↿u) (x, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)) x := by
        have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun e : ℝ³ => (e, t)) (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) x :=
          hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left x t
        have h1 : HasFDerivAt (↿u) (fderiv ℝ (↿u) (x, t)) ((fun e : ℝ³ => (e, t)) x) :=
          hdiff.hasFDerivAt
        exact h1.comp x h2
      rw [hcomp.fderiv]
      calc ‖(fderiv ℝ (↿u) (x, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)‖
          ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (↿u) (x, t)‖ * ‖ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ‖ :=
            ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (↿u) (x, t)‖ * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_inl_le_one ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) (norm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ max L₀ 0 := by
            rw [mul_one]
            exact le_trans (hL₀ (x, t) hmem) (le_max_left _ _)
    · have hU : IsOpen {y : ℝ³ | R < ‖y‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
      have hxU : x ∈ {y : ℝ³ | R < ‖y‖} := not_le.mp hx
      have heq : (fun y => u y t) =ᶠ[nhds x] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ³)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hxU)
          (fun y hy => hvan y t (hIT t ht) (le_of_lt hy))
      rw [heq.fderiv_eq, fderiv_const_apply, norm_zero]
      exact le_max_right _ _
  
  set M := max M₀ 0 with hMdef
  set V := (volume : Measure ℝ³).real (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ³) R) with hVdef
  set ι : ℝ³ → ℝ := (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ³) R).indicator (fun _ => M ^ 2) with hιdef
  have hι : Integrable ι := by
    rw [hιdef, integrable_indicator_iff measurableSet_closedBall]
    exact integrableOn_const measure_closedBall_lt_top.ne
  have hιint : ∫ x, ι x = V * M ^ 2 := by
    rw [hιdef, integral_indicator_const _ measurableSet_closedBall, smul_eq_mul]
  have hvc : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Continuous (fun x => v x t) := fun t ht =>
    hv.continuousOn.comp_continuous
      (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const : Continuous fun y : ℝ³ => (y, t))
      (fun y => ⟨mem_univ _, ht⟩)
  have huc : ∀ t, t < T → Continuous (fun x => u x t) := fun t ht =>
    hu.continuousOn.comp_continuous
      (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const : Continuous fun y : ℝ³ => (y, t))
      (fun y => ⟨mem_univ _, ht⟩)
  have hbι : ∀ x t, t ∈ Icc 0 T₁ → ‖u x t‖ ^ 2 ≤ ι x := by
    intro x t ht
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ³) R
    · rw [hιdef, Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hM x t ht) 2
    · rw [hιdef, Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hx
      rw [hvan x t (hIT t ht) hx.le, norm_zero]
      norm_num
  have hco : ∀ (c : ℝ³) (i j : Fin 3), |c i * c j| ≤ ‖c‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro c i j
    have hi : |c i| ≤ ‖c‖ := by
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le c i
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have hj : |c j| ≤ ‖c‖ := by
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le c j
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    rw [abs_mul, sq]
    exact mul_le_mul hi hj (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
  refine ⟨M, max L₀ 0, 2 * E + 2 * M ^ 2 * V, E + M ^ 2 * V, hM, hL, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    have ha : MemLp (fun x => v x t) 2 :=
      (memLp_norm_iff (hvc t ht.1).aestronglyMeasurable).mp (hL2 t ht.1)
    have hb : MemLp (fun x => u x t) 2 :=
      (huc t (hIT t ht)).memLp_of_hasCompactSupport
        (HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall 0 R) (fun x hx => by
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hx
          exact hvan x t (hIT t ht) hx.le))
    have hab : MemLp (fun x => v x t - u x t) 2 := ha.sub hb
    refine ⟨hab, ?_⟩
    have int1 : Integrable (fun x => ‖v x t - u x t‖ ^ 2) := hab.norm.integrable_sq
    have inta : Integrable (fun x => ‖v x t‖ ^ 2) := (hL2 t ht.1).integrable_sq
    have int2 : Integrable (fun x => 2 * ‖v x t‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ι x) :=
      (inta.const_mul 2).add (hι.const_mul 2)
    have pw : ∀ x, ‖v x t - u x t‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖v x t‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ι x := by
      intro x
      have h1 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_sub_le (v x t) (u x t)) 2
      have h2 := hbι x t ht
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖v x t‖ - ‖u x t‖)]
    have hmono := integral_mono int1 int2 pw
    rw [integral_add (inta.const_mul 2) (hι.const_mul 2), integral_const_mul,
      integral_const_mul, hιint] at hmono
    have hE' := hE t ht.1
    nlinarith
  · intro t ht i j
    have hvc' := hvc t ht.1
    have huc' := huc t (hIT t ht)
    have hg : Continuous (fun x => v x t i * v x t j - u x t i * u x t j) := by fun_prop
    have inta : Integrable (fun x => ‖v x t‖ ^ 2) := (hL2 t ht.1).integrable_sq
    have int3 : Integrable (fun x => ‖v x t‖ ^ 2 + ι x) := inta.add hι
    have pw : ∀ x, |v x t i * v x t j - u x t i * u x t j| ≤ ‖v x t‖ ^ 2 + ι x := by
      intro x
      have h1 := abs_sub (v x t i * v x t j) (u x t i * u x t j)
      have h2 := hco (v x t) i j
      have h3 := hco (u x t) i j
      have h4 := hbι x t ht
      linarith
    have hint : Integrable (fun x => v x t i * v x t j - u x t i * u x t j) :=
      Integrable.mono' int3 hg.aestronglyMeasurable
        (ae_of_all _ (fun x => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact pw x))
    refine ⟨hint, ?_⟩
    have hmono := integral_mono hint.abs int3 pw
    rw [integral_add inta hι, hιint] at hmono
    have hE' := hE t ht.1
    nlinarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (ν T₁ C₀ C₁ : ℝ) (w : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (π : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (g : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < T₁ → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿w) (univ ×ˢ Icc 0 T₁) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿π) (univ ×ˢ Icc 0 T₁) → (∀ i j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(g i j)) (univ ×ˢ Icc 0 T₁)) → (∀ x t, t ∈ Ioo 0 T₁ → ∀ i : Fin 3, deriv (fun s => w x s i) t + ∑ j, pd j (fun y => g i j y t) x = ν * (Δ (fun y => w y t) x) i - pd i (fun y => π y t) x) → (∀ x t, t ∈ Icc 0 T₁ → divergence (fun y => w y t) x = 0) → (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T₁, MemLp (fun x => w x t) 2 ∧ (∫ x, ‖w x t‖ ^ 2) ≤ C₀) → (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T₁, ∀ i j, Integrable (fun x => g i j x t) ∧ (∫ x, |g i j x t|) ≤ C₁) → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), t ∈ Ioo 0 T₁ → ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ x, π x t = stressPressure (fun i j y => g i j y t) x + c

signature.name: stress_pressure_identification
signature.statement: ∀ (ν T₁ C₀ C₁ : ℝ) (w : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (π : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (g : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < T₁ → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿w) (univ ×ˢ Icc 0 T₁) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿π) (univ ×ˢ Icc 0 T₁) → (∀ i j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(g i j)) (univ ×ˢ Icc 0 T₁)) → (∀ x t, t ∈ Ioo 0 T₁ → ∀ i : Fin 3, deriv (fun s => w x s i) t + ∑ j, pd j (fun y => g i j y t) x = ν * (Δ (fun y => w y t) x) i - pd i (fun y => π y t) x) → (∀ x t, t ∈ Icc 0 T₁ → divergence (fun y => w y t) x = 0) → (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T₁, MemLp (fun x => w x t) 2 ∧ (∫ x, ‖w x t‖ ^ 2) ≤ C₀) → (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T₁, ∀ i j, Integrable (fun x => g i j x t) ∧ (∫ x, |g i j x t|) ≤ C₁) → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), t ∈ Ioo 0 T₁ → ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ x, π x t = stressPressure (fun i j y => g i j y t) x + c

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ν T₁ C₀ C₁ w π g hT₁ hw hπ hg hEQ hdiv hC₀ hC₁
  have h2 : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by simp
  have h0 : (0:ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 T₁ := ⟨le_rfl, hT₁.le⟩
  have hC₀nn : 0 ≤ C₀ := le_trans (integral_nonneg (fun x => by positivity)) (hC₀ 0 h0).2
  have hC₁nn : 0 ≤ C₁ := le_trans (integral_nonneg (fun x => abs_nonneg _)) (hC₁ 0 h0 0 0).2
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρs, hρ1, hMVP⟩ := mean_value_kernel_exists
  obtain ⟨K₁, hK₁0, hK₁⟩ := mollifier_scaling_bounds ρ hρs hρ1
  obtain ⟨K₂, hK₂0, hK₂⟩ := mollified_stress_pressure_bound ρ hρs hρ1
  have hρc : Continuous ρ := hρs.continuous
  have hρcs : HasCompactSupport ρ := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℝ³) 1) (fun z hz => hρ1 z ?_)
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hz
    exact hz.le
  have hint : ∀ φ : ℝ³ → ℝ, Continuous φ → Integrable (fun u => ρ u * φ u) := fun φ hφ =>
    (hρc.mul hφ).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hρcs.mul_right (f' := φ))
  have hshift : ∀ (x : ℝ³) (L : ℝ) (Ψ : ℝ³ → ℝ), Continuous Ψ →
      Continuous (fun u : ℝ³ => Ψ (x + L • u)) := fun x L Ψ hΨ =>
    hΨ.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_const_smul L))
  have slice : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (G : ℝ³ → ℝ → F)
      (S : Set ℝ) (t : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) (univ ×ˢ S) → t ∈ S →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y t) := by
    intro F _ _ G S t hG ht
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => (y, t)) := contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const
    exact contDiffOn_univ.mp (hG.comp h1.contDiffOn (fun y _ => ⟨mem_univ _, ht⟩))
  have hcomp : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun y s => w y s i)) (univ ×ˢ Icc 0 T₁) :=
    fun i => (EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hw
  have hcontΔ : ∀ f : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → Continuous (Δ f) := by
    intro f hf
    rw [InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_orthonormalBasis f
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)]
    refine continuous_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => ?_)
    exact (hf.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (by simp)).eval_const _
  have hcontpd : ∀ (j : Fin 3) (f : ℝ³ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → Continuous (pd j f) := by
    intro j f hf
    show Continuous (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))
    exact (hf.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hcdpd : ∀ (j : Fin 3) (f : ℝ³ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pd j f) := by
    intro j f hf
    show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))
    exact (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hf).2.clm_apply contDiff_const
  have htri : ∀ a b c : ℝ, |a - b - c| ≤ |a| + |b| + |c| := fun a b c => by
    have e1 := abs_sub (a - b) c
    have e2 := abs_sub a b
    linarith
  
  have key : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (x : ℝ³), ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T₁,
      pd i (fun y => π y t - stressPressure (fun k l z => g k l z t) y) x = 0 := by
    intro i x
    obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℝ, E = K₁ * Real.sqrt C₀ + |ν| * (K₁ * Real.sqrt C₀)
        + 3 * (K₁ * C₁) + K₂ * (9 * C₁) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hmain : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 T₁,
        |∫ u, ρ u * w (x + ((n:ℝ)+1) • u) s i| ≤ E / ((n:ℝ)+1) ∧
        |pd i (fun y => π y s - stressPressure (fun k l z => g k l z s) y) x
          + ∫ u, ρ u * deriv (fun r => w (x + ((n:ℝ)+1) • u) r i) s| ≤ E / ((n:ℝ)+1) := by
      intro n s hs
      obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = (n:ℝ) + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      rw [← hLdef]
      have hL : 1 ≤ L := by rw [hLdef]; linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg n : (0:ℝ) ≤ n)]
      have hLpos : 0 < L := by linarith
      have hsI : s ∈ Icc 0 T₁ := ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2.le⟩
      
      have hws : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => w y s) := slice w _ s hw hsI
      have hwis : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => w y s i) := slice (fun y s => w y s i) _ s (hcomp i) hsI
      have hπs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => π y s) := slice π _ s hπ hsI
      have hGs : ∀ k l, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => g k l y s) :=
        fun k l => slice (g k l) _ s (hg k l) hsI
      have hGsI : ∀ k l, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ((fun k l z => g k l z s) k l) ∧
          Integrable ((fun k l z => g k l z s) k l) := fun k l => ⟨hGs k l, (hC₁ s hsI k l).1⟩
      obtain ⟨hSPs, hSPΔ⟩ := stress_pressure_laplacian (fun k l z => g k l z s) hGsI
      have hHs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => π y s - stressPressure (fun k l z => g k l z s) y) :=
        hπs.sub hSPs
      
      have hΔH : ∀ y, Δ (fun y => π y s - stressPressure (fun k l z => g k l z s) y) y = 0 := by
        intro y
        have e1 : (fun y => π y s - stressPressure (fun k l z => g k l z s) y)
            = (fun y => π y s) - stressPressure (fun k l z => g k l z s) := rfl
        rw [e1, ContDiffAt.laplacian_sub (hπs.contDiffAt.of_le h2) (hSPs.contDiffAt.of_le h2),
          hSPΔ y, pressure_laplacian_of_conservative_eq ν T₁ w π g hw hπ hg hEQ hdiv y s hs]
        simp
      have hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pd i (fun y => π y s - stressPressure (fun k l z => g k l z s) y)) :=
        hcdpd i _ hHs
      have hFΔ : ∀ y, Δ (pd i (fun y => π y s - stressPressure (fun k l z => g k l z s) y)) y = 0 := by
        intro y
        rw [laplacian_pd_comm _ hHs i y]
        have e2 : Δ (fun y => π y s - stressPressure (fun k l z => g k l z s) y) = fun _ => 0 :=
          funext hΔH
        rw [e2]
        simp [pd]
      have hMV := hMVP _ hF hFΔ x L hLpos
      
      have hπd : Differentiable ℝ (fun y => π y s) := hπs.differentiable (by simp)
      have hSPd : Differentiable ℝ (stressPressure (fun k l z => g k l z s)) :=
        hSPs.differentiable (by simp)
      have hpt0 : ∀ y, pd i (fun y => π y s - stressPressure (fun k l z => g k l z s) y) y
            + deriv (fun r => w y r i) s
          = ν * Δ (fun z => w z s i) y - ∑ j, pd j (fun z => g i j z s) y
            - pd i (stressPressure (fun k l z => g k l z s)) y := by
        intro y
        have e3 : pd i (fun y => π y s - stressPressure (fun k l z => g k l z s) y) y
            = pd i (fun y => π y s) y - pd i (stressPressure (fun k l z => g k l z s)) y := by
          simp only [pd]
          rw [fderiv_fun_sub (hπd y) (hSPd y), ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
        have e4 : (Δ (fun z => w z s) y) i = Δ (fun z => w z s i) y :=
          (ContDiffAt.laplacian_CLM_comp_left (l := (EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ))
            (hws.contDiffAt.of_le h2)).symm
        have e5 := hEQ y s hs i
        rw [e4] at e5
        rw [e3]
        linarith
      
      have hc1 : Continuous (fun u => pd i (fun y => π y s - stressPressure (fun k l z => g k l z s) y)
          (x + L • u)) := hshift x L _ hF.continuous
      have hc2 : Continuous (fun u => Δ (fun z => w z s i) (x + L • u)) :=
        hshift x L _ (hcontΔ _ hwis)
      have hc3 : ∀ j, Continuous (fun u => pd j (fun z => g i j z s) (x + L • u)) :=
        fun j => hshift x L _ (hcontpd j _ (hGs i j))
      have hc4 : Continuous (fun u => pd i (stressPressure (fun k l z => g k l z s)) (x + L • u)) :=
        hshift x L _ (hcontpd i _ hSPs)
      have hc8 := mollifier_time_deriv T₁ L x ρ (fun y s => w y s i) (hcomp i) hρc hρ1 s hs
      have he : Integrable (fun u => ρ u * deriv (fun r => w (x + L • u) r i) s) :=
        hc8.2.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hρcs.mul_right (f' := fun u => deriv (fun r => w (x + L • u) r i) s))
      have hia : Integrable (fun u => ν * (ρ u * Δ (fun z => w z s i) (x + L • u))) :=
        (hint _ hc2).const_mul ν
      have hib : Integrable (fun u => ∑ j, ρ u * pd j (fun z => g i j z s) (x + L • u)) :=
        integrable_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => hint _ (hc3 j))
      have hiab : Integrable (fun u => ν * (ρ u * Δ (fun z => w z s i) (x + L • u))
          - ∑ j, ρ u * pd j (fun z => g i j z s) (x + L • u)) := hia.sub hib
      have hI : ∫ u, (ρ u * pd i (fun y => π y s - stressPressure (fun k l z => g k l z s) y) (x + L • u)
            + ρ u * deriv (fun r => w (x + L • u) r i) s)
          = ∫ u, (ν * (ρ u * Δ (fun z => w z s i) (x + L • u))
            - ∑ j, ρ u * pd j (fun z => g i j z s) (x + L • u)
            - ρ u * pd i (stressPressure (fun k l z => g k l z s)) (x + L • u)) := by
        congr 1
        funext u
        have h1 := hpt0 (x + L • u)
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
        linear_combination ρ u * h1
      rw [integral_add (hint _ hc1) he, integral_sub hiab (hint _ hc4), integral_sub hia hib,
        integral_const_mul ν, integral_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => hint _ (hc3 j)), hMV] at hI
      
      have hwiL : MemLp (fun y => w y s i) 2 :=
        (EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp_memLp' (hC₀ s hsI).1
      have hnormInt : Integrable (fun y => ‖w y s‖ ^ 2) :=
        (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (hC₀ s hsI).1.aestronglyMeasurable).mp (hC₀ s hsI).1
      have hwi2 : ∫ y, (w y s i) ^ 2 ≤ C₀ := by
        refine le_trans (integral_mono hwiL.integrable_sq hnormInt (fun y => ?_)) (hC₀ s hsI).2
        show (w y s i) ^ 2 ≤ ‖w y s‖ ^ 2
        have h := PiLp.norm_apply_le (w y s) i
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
        nlinarith [sq_abs (w y s i), abs_nonneg (w y s i)]
      have hsq : (∫ y, (w y s i) ^ 2) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) ≤ Real.sqrt C₀ := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (integral_nonneg (fun y => sq_nonneg _)) hwi2 (by norm_num)
      have hLp : ∀ p : ℝ, 1 ≤ p → L ≤ L ^ p := fun p hp => by
        simpa using Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hL hp
      have hL4 : L ≤ L ^ 4 := le_self_pow₀ hL (by norm_num)
      have hK1C0 : 0 ≤ K₁ * Real.sqrt C₀ := mul_nonneg hK₁0 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      obtain ⟨-, hKb, hKc⟩ := hK₁ (fun y => w y s i) x L hwis hL
      have hmb : |∫ u, ρ u * w (x + L • u) s i| ≤ K₁ * Real.sqrt C₀ / L := by
        calc |∫ u, ρ u * w (x + L • u) s i|
            ≤ K₁ * (∫ y, (w y s i) ^ 2) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) / L ^ ((3:ℝ)/2) := hKb hwiL
          _ ≤ K₁ * Real.sqrt C₀ / L ^ ((3:ℝ)/2) :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hK₁0)
              (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hLpos _).le
          _ ≤ K₁ * Real.sqrt C₀ / L :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hK1C0 hLpos (hLp _ (by norm_num))
      have hAb : |∫ u, ρ u * Δ (fun z => w z s i) (x + L • u)| ≤ K₁ * Real.sqrt C₀ / L := by
        calc |∫ u, ρ u * Δ (fun z => w z s i) (x + L • u)|
            ≤ K₁ * (∫ y, (w y s i) ^ 2) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) / L ^ ((7:ℝ)/2) := hKc hwiL
          _ ≤ K₁ * Real.sqrt C₀ / L ^ ((7:ℝ)/2) :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hK₁0)
              (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hLpos _).le
          _ ≤ K₁ * Real.sqrt C₀ / L :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hK1C0 hLpos (hLp _ (by norm_num))
      have hBb : ∀ j, |∫ u, ρ u * pd j (fun z => g i j z s) (x + L • u)| ≤ K₁ * C₁ / L := by
        intro j
        have h1 := (hK₁ (fun z => g i j z s) x L (hGs i j) hL).1 (hC₁ s hsI i j).1 j
        calc |∫ u, ρ u * pd j (fun z => g i j z s) (x + L • u)|
            ≤ K₁ * (∫ y, |g i j y s|) / L ^ 4 := h1
          _ ≤ K₁ * C₁ / L ^ 4 :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC₁ s hsI i j).2 hK₁0)
              (by positivity)
          _ ≤ K₁ * C₁ / L := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg hK₁0 hC₁nn) hLpos hL4
      have hDb : |∫ u, ρ u * pd i (stressPressure (fun k l z => g k l z s)) (x + L • u)|
          ≤ K₂ * (9 * C₁) / L := by
        have h1 := hK₂ (fun k l z => g k l z s) hGsI i x L hL
        have hsum : ∑ k, ∑ l, ∫ y, |g k l y s| ≤ 9 * C₁ := by
          calc ∑ k, ∑ l, ∫ y, |g k l y s| ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, C₁ :=
                Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun l _ => (hC₁ s hsI k l).2))
            _ = 9 * C₁ := by
                simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
                push_cast
                ring
        calc |∫ u, ρ u * pd i (stressPressure (fun k l z => g k l z s)) (x + L • u)|
            ≤ K₂ * (∑ k, ∑ l, ∫ y, |g k l y s|) / L ^ 4 := h1
          _ ≤ K₂ * (9 * C₁) / L ^ 4 :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum hK₂0) (by positivity)
          _ ≤ K₂ * (9 * C₁) / L :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg hK₂0 (by linarith)) hLpos hL4
      have hn1 : 0 ≤ |ν| * (K₁ * Real.sqrt C₀) := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hK1C0
      have hn2 : 0 ≤ K₁ * C₁ := mul_nonneg hK₁0 hC₁nn
      have hn3 : 0 ≤ K₂ * (9 * C₁) := mul_nonneg hK₂0 (by linarith)
      have hEL : E / L = K₁ * Real.sqrt C₀ / L + |ν| * (K₁ * Real.sqrt C₀ / L)
          + 3 * (K₁ * C₁ / L) + K₂ * (9 * C₁) / L := by
        rw [hE]; ring
      have hnn : 0 ≤ K₁ * Real.sqrt C₀ / L := div_nonneg hK1C0 hLpos.le
      have hnn2 : 0 ≤ |ν| * (K₁ * Real.sqrt C₀ / L) :=
        mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hnn
      have hnn3 : 0 ≤ K₁ * C₁ / L := div_nonneg hn2 hLpos.le
      have hnn4 : 0 ≤ K₂ * (9 * C₁) / L := div_nonneg hn3 hLpos.le
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hEL]; linarith
      · rw [hI]
        have hsumB : |∑ j, ∫ u, ρ u * pd j (fun z => g i j z s) (x + L • u)|
            ≤ 3 * (K₁ * C₁ / L) := by

subgoal_signatures.name: laplacian_pd_comm

subgoal_signatures.name: pressure_laplacian_of_conservative_eq

subgoal_signatures.name: deriv_zero_of_uniform_approx

subgoal_signatures.name: flux_cutoff_beta
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∃ c₁ : ℝ, 0 < c₁ ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → (∀ x y : ℝ³, |cutPhi R y ^ 6 - cutPhi R x ^ 6| ≤ min 1 (3 * c₁ / R * ‖x - y‖) * (cutPhi R x ^ 3 + cutPhi R y ^ 3)) ∧ ∀ w : ℝ³ → ℝ³, ContDiff ℝ ∞ w → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fluxBeta R w) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fluxBeta R w) ∧ (∀ x, |fluxBeta R w x| ≤ 8 * c₁ / R * cutPhi R x * ‖w x‖) ∧ (∀ x, inner ℝ (w x) (gradient (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) x) = cutPhi R x ^ 6 * fluxBeta R w x)

subgoal_signatures.name: stressPressure_duality
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (g : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ³ → ℝ) (b : ℝ³ → ℝ), (∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (g i j)) → (∀ i j, Integrable (g i j)) → ContDiff ℝ ∞ b → HasCompactSupport b → ∫ x, stressPressure g x * b x = ∑ i, ∑ j, ∫ x, g i j x * pd i (pd j (newtonPot b)) x

subgoal_signatures.name: cutoff_profile
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∃ c₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ c₁ ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (cutPhi R) ∧ HasCompactSupport (cutPhi R) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ cutPhi R x ∧ cutPhi R x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ R → cutPhi R x = 1) ∧ (∀ x, 2 * R ≤ ‖x‖ → cutPhi R x = 0) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) ∧ (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) x‖ ≤ 8 * c₁ / R * cutPhi R x ^ 7) ∧ (∀ x, ‖x‖ < R → fderiv ℝ (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) x = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: transport_term_bound

subgoal_signatures.name: localized_energy_identity

        mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hq0.ne'] at hs
      exact hs
    have hres := iteratedFDeriv_diag_rescale (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) q
      (q ^ (-((1 - 2 * h) / 2))) q⁻¹ (z, τ) k hq0 hc1 hc12 hev
    have hθpos : 0 < q ^ (1 - 2 * h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _
    have hηsq : (q ^ (-((1 - 2 * h) / 2)) * z) ^ 2 < 1 := by
      rw [hiv, div_lt_one hθpos]; exact h2
    have hηabs : |q ^ (-((1 - 2 * h) / 2)) * z| < 1 := (sq_lt_one_iff_abs_lt_one _).mp hηsq
    have hτeq : q⁻¹ * τ = 1 - (q ^ (-((1 - 2 * h) / 2)) * z) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← hiii, ← hq, inv_mul_eq_div]
    have hmem : (q ^ (-((1 - 2 * h) / 2)) * (z, τ).1, q⁻¹ * (z, τ).2) ∈
        (fun η : ℝ => (η, 1 - η ^ 2)) '' Icc (-1) 1 ∩ {w : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < w.2} := by
      refine ⟨⟨q ^ (-((1 - 2 * h) / 2)) * z, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · linarith [(abs_lt.mp hηabs).1]
      · linarith [(abs_lt.mp hηabs).2]
      · simp only [hτeq]
      · show 0 < q⁻¹ * τ
        exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hq0) hτ
    have hb := hM _ hmem
    have hnn : 0 ≤ q * q⁻¹ ^ k := mul_nonneg hq0.le (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le) k)
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (z, τ)‖
        ≤ q * q⁻¹ ^ k * M := hres.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hnn)
      _ = M * q ^ (1 - (k : ℝ)) := by rw [hvi k, mul_comm]
  unfold SimScaleProps
  exact ⟨hP1, hP2, hP3, hP4, hP5⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ h c : ℝ, 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → HeatExteriorProps h c

signature.name: heat_exterior_field
signature.statement: ∀ h c : ℝ, 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → HeatExteriorProps h c

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h c hh _
  
  obtain ⟨hH1, hH2, hH3⟩ := heatProfile_props h hh (fun β Z hβ hZ => heatK_deriv_bound β Z hβ hZ)
    (fun Z hZ => heatK_ode h Z hh hZ)
  obtain ⟨hQ1, hQ2, hQ3⟩ := heatQ_props h hh hH1 hH2
  
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ), D = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ∧ w.2 < 1} :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hσc : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2) := by fun_prop
  have hDo : IsOpen D := by
    rw [hD]
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const hσc).inter (isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const)
  
  obtain ⟨FH, hFH⟩ : ∃ FH : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ, FH = fun z => (z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2) ^ (-(1 + h)) *
      heatProfile h (4 * (1 - z.2) / (z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨FQ, hFQ⟩ : ∃ FQ : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ, FQ = fun z => (z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2) ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) *
      heatQ h (4 * (1 - z.2) / (z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ³, J = fun z => -(z.1 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
      z.1 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hFHs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ FH D := by
    rw [hFH, hD]; exact (profile_field_smooth_bounded (heatProfile h) (-(1 + h)) hH1 hH2).1
  have hFHb : ∀ r₀ : ℝ, 0 < r₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), r₀ ^ 2 ≤ x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 →
      x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 ≤ 1 → 0 < t → t < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m FH (x, t)‖ ≤ C := by
    rw [hFH]; exact (profile_field_smooth_bounded (heatProfile h) (-(1 + h)) hH1 hH2).2
  have hFQs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ FQ D := by
    rw [hFQ, hD]; exact (profile_field_smooth_bounded (heatQ h) (-(1 + 2 * h)) hQ1 hQ2).1
  have hFQb : ∀ r₀ : ℝ, 0 < r₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), r₀ ^ 2 ≤ x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 →
      x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 ≤ 1 → 0 < t → t < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m FQ (x, t)‖ ≤ C := by
    rw [hFQ]; exact (profile_field_smooth_bounded (heatQ h) (-(1 + 2 * h)) hQ1 hQ2).2
  have hJs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J := by rw [hJ]; exact jfield_bounds.1
  have hJb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℝ³ × ℝ, z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k J z‖ ≤ C := by
    rw [hJ]; exact jfield_bounds.2
  
  have hSweq : (↿(heatSwirl h c)) = fun z => (c * FH z) • J z := by
    funext z
    show heatSwirl h c z.1 z.2 = _
    simp only [heatSwirl, hFH, hJ, mul_assoc]
  
  have hPeq : ∀ z ∈ D, (↿(heatPressure h c)) z = -(c ^ 2 / 2) * FQ z := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hD] at hz
    show heatPressure h c z.1 z.2 = _
    simp only [heatPressure, hFQ]
    rw [heatPressure_integral_eq h _ _ hz.1]
  
  have hprof : ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (α : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ (Ioi 0) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 ^ α * φ (4 * (1 - p.2) / p.1)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Iio 1) := by
    intro φ α hφ
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 ^ α) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Iio 1) :=
      contDiff_fst.contDiffOn.rpow_const_of_ne (fun p hp => (hp.1 : (0:ℝ) < p.1).ne')
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 4 * (1 - p.2) / p.1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Iio 1) :=
      (contDiffOn_const.mul (contDiffOn_const.sub contDiff_snd.contDiffOn)).div
        contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun p hp => (hp.1 : (0:ℝ) < p.1).ne')
    have h3 : MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 4 * (1 - p.2) / p.1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Iio 1) (Ioi 0) := by
      intro p hp
      have hp1 : (0:ℝ) < p.1 := hp.1
      have hp2 : p.2 < 1 := hp.2
      show (0:ℝ) < 4 * (1 - p.2) / p.1
      exact div_pos (by linarith) hp1
    exact h1.mul (hφ.comp h2 h3)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [hSweq, ← hD]
    exact (contDiffOn_const.mul hFHs).smul hJs.contDiffOn
  · 
    rw [← hD]
    exact (contDiffOn_const.mul hFQs).congr hPeq
  · 
    intro x t hS ht
    have hA : (0:ℝ) < 4 * (1 - t) := by linarith
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, f = fun σ s => c * σ ^ (-(1 + h)) * heatProfile h (4 * (1 - s) / σ) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Pf, hPf⟩ : ∃ Pf : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, Pf = fun σ s => -(c ^ 2 / 2) *
        ∫ s' in Ioi σ, s' ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (4 * (1 - s) / s') ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hsw : heatSwirl h c = fun y s => f (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) s •
        (-(y 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + y 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) := by
      rw [hf]; try rfl
    have hpr : heatPressure h c = fun y s => Pf (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) s := by
      rw [hPf]; try rfl
    have hFs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Iio 1) := by
      rw [hf]
      exact (contDiffOn_const.mul (hprof (heatProfile h) (-(1 + h)) hH1)).congr (fun p _ => by
        show c * p.1 ^ (-(1 + h)) * heatProfile h (4 * (1 - p.2) / p.1) =
          c * (p.1 ^ (-(1 + h)) * heatProfile h (4 * (1 - p.2) / p.1))
        ring)
    have hPs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Pf) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Iio 1) := by
      rw [hPf]
      exact (contDiffOn_const.mul (hprof (heatQ h) (-(1 + 2 * h)) hQ1)).congr (fun p hp => by
        show -(c ^ 2 / 2) * (∫ s' in Ioi p.1, s' ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (4 * (1 - p.2) / s') ^ 2) =
          -(c ^ 2 / 2) * (p.1 ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) * heatQ h (4 * (1 - p.2) / p.1))
        rw [heatPressure_integral_eq h _ _ (hp.1 : (0:ℝ) < p.1)])
    have hB1 : deriv (fun s => f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) s) t - 4 * (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) *
        deriv (fun σ => deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) σ) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) -
        8 * deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) = 0 := by
      rw [hf]
      exact swirl_profile_heat_eq h c t _ (heatProfile h) hS ht hH1 hH3
    have hY : (0:ℝ) < 4 * (1 - t) / (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) := div_pos hA hS
    have hQd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (heatQ h) (4 * (1 - t) / (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2)) :=
      (hQ1.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hY)
    have hB2 : 2 * deriv (fun ρ => Pf ρ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) - f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) t ^ 2 = 0 := by
      have hev : (fun ρ => Pf ρ t) =ᶠ[nhds (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2)]
          (fun σ : ℝ => -(c ^ 2 / 2) * σ ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) * heatQ h (4 * (1 - t) / σ)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hS) (fun ρ hρ => by
          rw [hPf]
          show -(c ^ 2 / 2) * (∫ s' in Ioi ρ, s' ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (4 * (1 - t) / s') ^ 2) =
            -(c ^ 2 / 2) * ρ ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) * heatQ h (4 * (1 - t) / ρ)
          rw [heatPressure_integral_eq h _ _ (hρ : (0:ℝ) < ρ)]
          ring)
      rw [hev.deriv_eq, pressure_profile_balance h c _ _ (heatProfile h) (heatQ h) hA hS hQd (hQ3 _ hY)]
      simp only [hf, sub_self]
    have hdt := swirl_div_tangent f x t hFs hS ht
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hsw, hpr, swirl_residual_formula f Pf x t hFs hPs hS ht, hB1, hB2]
      simp
    · rw [hsw]; exact hdt.1
    · rw [hsw]; exact hdt.2.1
    · rw [hsw]; exact hdt.2.2
  · 
    intro r₀ hr₀ m
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : ∃ R : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ), R = {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | r₀ ^ 2 ≤ z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2 ∧
        z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ 1 ∧ 0 < z.2 ∧ z.2 < 1} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hr2 : 0 < r₀ ^ 2 := pow_pos hr₀ 2
    have hRD : R ⊆ D := by
      intro z hz
      rw [hR] at hz
      rw [hD]
      exact ⟨by linarith [hz.1], hz.2.2.2⟩
    have hfb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ R, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => c * FH z) z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hFHb r₀ hr₀ k
      refine ⟨‖c‖ * C, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      have hca : ContDiffAt ℝ k FH z :=
        contDiffAt_infty.mp (hFHs.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds (hRD hz))) k
      rw [show (fun z => c * FH z) = fun z => c • FH z from rfl, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply' hca,
        norm_smul]
      rw [hR] at hz
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC z.1 z.2 hz.1 hz.2.1 hz.2.2.1 hz.2.2.2) (norm_nonneg c)
    have hgb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ R, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k J z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hJb k
      refine ⟨C, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      rw [hR] at hz
      exact hC z hz.2.1
    obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on
      (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) (fun z => c * FH z) J D R hDo hRD
      (contDiffOn_const.mul hFHs) hJs.contDiffOn hfb hgb m
    have heq : (fun z => (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) (c * FH z) (J z)) =
        ↿(heatSwirl h c) := by
      rw [hSweq]
      funext z
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply]
    rw [heq] at hC1
    obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := hFQb r₀ hr₀ m
    refine ⟨max C1 (‖-(c ^ 2 / 2)‖ * C2), fun x t h1 h2 h3 h4 => ?_⟩
    have hz : ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ R := by rw [hR]; exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
    refine ⟨(hC1 _ hz).trans (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
    have hev : (↿(heatPressure h c)) =ᶠ[nhds ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ)] fun w => (-(c ^ 2 / 2)) • FQ w :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hDo.mem_nhds (hRD hz)) (fun w hw => hPeq w hw)
    have hca : ContDiffAt ℝ m FQ (x, t) :=
      contDiffAt_infty.mp (hFQs.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds (hRD hz))) m
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply' hca, norm_smul]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC2 x t h1 h2 h3 h4) (norm_nonneg _)).trans (le_max_right _ _)

heat_exterior_field.definitions:
noncomputable def heatK (β Z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-v) * v ^ β * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-β)

noncomputable def heatQ (h Y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ w in Ioi (1:ℝ), w ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (Y / w) ^ 2

and_nodes.definitions_block:
noncomputable def heatK (β Z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-v) * v ^ β * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-β)

noncomputable def heatQ (h Y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ w in Ioi (1:ℝ), w ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (Y / w) ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: heatK_deriv_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ β Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → 0 < Z → HasDerivAt (fun Y => heatK β Y) (-β * heatK (β + 1) Z) Z ∧ |heatK β Z| ≤ Real.Gamma (β + 1)

subgoal_signatures.name: heatK_ode
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h Z : ℝ, 0 < h → 0 < Z → (h + 1) * Z ^ 2 * heatK (h + 2) Z - (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * heatK (h + 1) Z + (1 + h) * heatK h Z = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: heatProfile_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → (∀ β Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → 0 < Z → HasDerivAt (fun Y => heatK β Y) (-β * heatK (β + 1) Z) Z ∧ |heatK β Z| ≤ Real.Gamma (β + 1)) → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → (h + 1) * Z ^ 2 * heatK (h + 2) Z - (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * heatK (h + 1) Z + (1 + h) * heatK h Z = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv k (heatProfile h) Z| ≤ C) ∧ (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → Z ^ 2 * deriv (deriv (heatProfile h)) Z + (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * deriv (heatProfile h) Z + h * (1 + h) * heatProfile h Z = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: heatQ_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv k (heatProfile h) Z| ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatQ h) (Ioi 0) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → |iteratedDeriv k (heatQ h) Y| ≤ C) ∧ (∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → (1 + 2 * h) * heatQ h Y + Y * deriv (heatQ h) Y = heatProfile h Y ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: heatPressure_integral_eq
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h A S : ℝ, 0 < S → ∫ s in Ioi S, s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (A / s) ^ 2 = S ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) * heatQ h (A / S)

subgoal_signatures.name: swirl_profile_heat_eq
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h c t S : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < S → t < 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ (Ioi 0) → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → Z ^ 2 * deriv (deriv φ) Z + (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * deriv φ Z + h * (1 + h) * φ Z = 0) → deriv (fun s => c * S ^ (-(1 + h)) * φ (4 * (1 - s) / S)) t - 4 * S * deriv (fun σ => deriv (fun ρ => c * ρ ^ (-(1 + h)) * φ (4 * (1 - t) / ρ)) σ) S - 8 * deriv (fun ρ => c * ρ ^ (-(1 + h)) * φ (4 * (1 - t) / ρ)) S = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: pressure_profile_balance
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h c A S : ℝ) (φ ψ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < A → 0 < S → DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ (A / S) → (1 + 2 * h) * ψ (A / S) + A / S * deriv ψ (A / S) = φ (A / S) ^ 2 → 2 * deriv (fun σ => -(c ^ 2 / 2) * σ ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) * ψ (A / σ)) S = (c * S ^ (-(1 + h)) * φ (A / S)) ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: swirl_residual_formula
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (f Pf : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Iio 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Pf) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Iio 1) → 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → t < 1 → nsResidual 1 (fun y s => f (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) s • (-(y 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + y 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) (fun y s => Pf (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) s) x t = (deriv (fun s => f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) s) t - 4 * (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * deriv (fun σ => deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) σ) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) - 8 * deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2)) • (-(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) + (2 * deriv (fun ρ => Pf ρ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) - f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) t ^ 2) • (x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 1 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))

subgoal_signatures.name: swirl_div_tangent
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Iio 1) → 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → t < 1 → divergence (fun y => f (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) t • (-(y 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + y 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) x = 0 ∧ inner ℝ x (f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) t • (-(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) = (0:ℝ) ∧ (f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) t • (-(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) 2 = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: jfield_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement: ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => -(z.1 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + z.1 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℝ³ × ℝ, z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => -(z.1 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + z.1 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) z‖ ≤ C

subgoal_signatures.name: iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on

    have hu := hC7 x (1 - τ) hmem hcore

    have hsw := (hB5 x (1 - τ) hmemB hrpos).1
    have hsimX : simX h x (1 - τ) = Xa / 2 := by
      unfold simX
      rw [hqτ, hr2]

    have hsimEta : simEta h x (1 - τ) = 0 := by
      unfold simEta
      rw [hx2]
      simp
    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) = ρ := by

    have hexp : τ ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤ τ ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) :=

    rw [hsw, hnaz] at hinner

      have hh : ρ * (τ ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * Eb τ (Xa / 2) 0) ≤

          nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hEb.le hP.le]

ns_approximate_family.definitions:
noncomputable def simX (h : ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) / (2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t))

noncomputable def simEta (h : ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  x 2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))

noncomputable def azVec (x : ℝ³) : ℝ³ :=
  -(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)

noncomputable def radVec (x : ℝ³) : ℝ³ :=
  x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 1 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)

noncomputable def logLift (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := f (Real.exp w.1) w.2.1 w.2.2

noncomputable def edgeWeight (Xa Xb aa ab X : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if Xa < X ∧ X < Xb then Real.exp (-(aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2) - ab / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2) else 0

noncomputable def edgeDist (Xa Xb X : ℝ) : ℝ := min 1 (min (Real.log (X / Xa)) (Real.log (Xb / X)))

noncomputable def shearA (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ := -2 * X * deriv (fun Y => F Y η) X / F X η

noncomputable def shearB (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (2 * X) * deriv (fun Y => U Y η) X / F X η

noncomputable def stressDivField (h : ℝ) (Tth Tz : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) : ℝ³ :=
  (-(simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(2 + h)) *
      (deriv (fun Y => Tth (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) Y (simEta h x t)) (simX h x t)
        + Tth (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) / simX h x t))) • azVec x
  + (-(Real.sqrt (2 * simX h x t) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(3 / 2 + h)) *
      (deriv (fun Y => Tz (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) Y (simEta h x t)) (simX h x t)
        + Tz (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) / (2 * simX h x t)))) •
      EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)

def BackgroundProps (h Xa Xb Xext m1 m2 lam cpatch qB c aa ab : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (AB BvB : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (PB : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (Eb Ub Vb Tth Tz : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (0 < h ∧ h < 1 / 100 ∧ 0 < Xa ∧ Xa < m1 ∧ m1 < m2 ∧ m2 < Xb ∧ Xb ≤ Xext ∧
      0 < qB ∧ qB ≤ 1 ∧ 0 < lam ∧ 0 < cpatch ∧ 0 < aa ∧ 0 < ab) ∧
  (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η) ∧
    (∀ X₀ X₁ : ℝ, 0 < X₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₀ ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)) ∧
  (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿T0th) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿T0z) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → (X ≤ Xa ∨ Xb ≤ X) → T0th X η = 0 ∧ T0z X η = 0) ∧
    (∃ c₀ : ℝ, 0 < c₀ ∧ ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      c₀ * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X ≤ Real.sqrt (T0th X η ^ 2 + T0z X η ^ 2)) ∧
    (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿T0th) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿T0z) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N)) ∧
    (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => T0th w.1 w.2 / Real.sqrt (T0th w.1 w.2 ^ 2 + T0z w.1 w.2 ^ 2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => T0z w.1 w.2 / Real.sqrt (T0th w.1 w.2 ^ 2 + T0z w.1 w.2 ^ 2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧
    (∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ κ < 2 ∧ ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      κ ≤ F X η ∧ κ ≤ shearA F X η ∧
      κ ≤ shearA F X η * (1 + (shearB F U X η / shearA F X η) ^ 2) - 2 ∧
      κ * Real.sqrt (T0th X η ^ 2 + T0z X η ^ 2) ≤ T0th X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * T0z X η ∧
      (shearA F X η * (1 + (shearB F U X η / shearA F X η) ^ 2) - 2) *
          (T0z X η + shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * T0th X η) ^ 2 ≤
        (2 - κ) * (T0th X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * T0z X η) ^ 2)) ∧
  (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿AB) (simDomain h qB) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿BvB) (simDomain h qB) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿PB) (simDomain h qB)) ∧
  (∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qB →
    divergence (fun y => BvB y t) x = 0 ∧ inner ℝ x (BvB x t) = (0 : ℝ) ∧ BvB x t 2 = 0) ∧
  (∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qB → 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 →
    inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => AB w t) x + BvB x t) (azVec x) =
        Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) *
          Eb (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) ∧
    (curl3 (fun w => AB w t) x + BvB x t) 2 =
        simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * Ub (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) ∧
    inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => AB w t) x + BvB x t) (radVec x) =
        Vb (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t)) ∧
  (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift Eb) (Iio (Real.log qB) ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift Ub) (Iio (Real.log qB) ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift Vb) (Iio (Real.log qB) ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧
    ∀ X₀ X₁ : ℝ, 0 < X₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → q < qB → X₀ ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ →
      -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift Eb w - Real.sqrt (2 * w.2.1) * F w.2.1 w.2.2)
          (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C * q ^ (2 * h) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift Ub w - U w.2.1 w.2.2) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤
          C * q ^ (2 * h) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift Vb) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧
  (∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → q < qB → m1 ≤ X → X ≤ m2 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
    Eb q X η = cpatch * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam)) ∧ Ub q X η = 0) ∧
  (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift Tth) (Iio (Real.log qB) ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift Tz) (Iio (Real.log qB) ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧
    (∀ q X η : ℝ, (X ≤ Xa ∨ Xb ≤ X) → Tth q X η = 0 ∧ Tz q X η = 0) ∧
    (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → q < qB → Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift Tth w - T0th w.2.1 w.2.2) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤
          C * q ^ h * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift Tz w - T0z w.2.1 w.2.2) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤
          C * q ^ h * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N))) ∧
  (∀ m N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qB →
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ) =>

noncomputable def simX (h : ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) / (2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t))

noncomputable def simEta (h : ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  x 2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))

noncomputable def azVec (x : ℝ³) : ℝ³ :=
  -(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)

noncomputable def radVec (x : ℝ³) : ℝ³ :=
  x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 1 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)

noncomputable def logLift (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := f (Real.exp w.1) w.2.1 w.2.2

noncomputable def edgeWeight (Xa Xb aa ab X : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if Xa < X ∧ X < Xb then Real.exp (-(aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2) - ab / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2) else 0

noncomputable def edgeDist (Xa Xb X : ℝ) : ℝ := min 1 (min (Real.log (X / Xa)) (Real.log (Xb / X)))

noncomputable def shearA (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ := -2 * X * deriv (fun Y => F Y η) X / F X η

noncomputable def shearB (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (2 * X) * deriv (fun Y => U Y η) X / F X η

noncomputable def stressDivField (h : ℝ) (Tth Tz : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) : ℝ³ :=
  (-(simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(2 + h)) *
      (deriv (fun Y => Tth (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) Y (simEta h x t)) (simX h x t)
        + Tth (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) / simX h x t))) • azVec x
  + (-(Real.sqrt (2 * simX h x t) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(3 / 2 + h)) *
      (deriv (fun Y => Tz (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) Y (simEta h x t)) (simX h x t)
        + Tz (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) / (2 * simX h x t)))) •
      EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)

def BackgroundProps (h Xa Xb Xext m1 m2 lam cpatch qB c aa ab : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (AB BvB : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (PB : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (Eb Ub Vb Tth Tz : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (0 < h ∧ h < 1 / 100 ∧ 0 < Xa ∧ Xa < m1 ∧ m1 < m2 ∧ m2 < Xb ∧ Xb ≤ Xext ∧
      0 < qB ∧ qB ≤ 1 ∧ 0 < lam ∧ 0 < cpatch ∧ 0 < aa ∧ 0 < ab) ∧
  (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η) ∧
    (∀ X₀ X₁ : ℝ, 0 < X₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₀ ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)) ∧
  (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿T0th) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿T0z) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → (X ≤ Xa ∨ Xb ≤ X) → T0th X η = 0 ∧ T0z X η = 0) ∧
    (∃ c₀ : ℝ, 0 < c₀ ∧ ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      c₀ * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X ≤ Real.sqrt (T0th X η ^ 2 + T0z X η ^ 2)) ∧
    (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿T0th) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿T0z) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N)) ∧
    (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => T0th w.1 w.2 / Real.sqrt (T0th w.1 w.2 ^ 2 + T0z w.1 w.2 ^ 2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => T0z w.1 w.2 / Real.sqrt (T0th w.1 w.2 ^ 2 + T0z w.1 w.2 ^ 2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧
    (∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ κ < 2 ∧ ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →

          (T0z X η + shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * T0th X η) ^ 2 ≤
        (2 - κ) * (T0th X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * T0z X η) ^ 2)) ∧
  (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿AB) (simDomain h qB) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿BvB) (simDomain h qB) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿PB) (simDomain h qB)) ∧
  (∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qB →

    inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => AB w t) x + BvB x t) (radVec x) =

    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift Vb) (Iio (Real.log qB) ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧

      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift Ub w - U w.2.1 w.2.2) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤
          C * q ^ (2 * h) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift Vb) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧
  (∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → q < qB → m1 ≤ X → X ≤ m2 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
    Eb q X η = cpatch * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam)) ∧ Ub q X η = 0) ∧

    (∀ q X η : ℝ, (X ≤ Xa ∨ Xb ≤ X) → Tth q X η = 0 ∧ Tz q X η = 0) ∧

  (∀ m N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qB →

  have hQle1 : ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≤ 1 := by
    intro x t hxt

  have hcut : ∀ j m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs →

      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun y s => simCut h a y s • Bv j y s)) (x, t)‖ ≤

      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun y s => simCut h a y s • P j y s)) (x, t)‖ ≤

    intro j m
    by_cases hj : 1 ≤ j
    · obtain ⟨C1, h1⟩ := cutoff_product_bound h qs (γ * (j : ℝ)) ℓ (A j) hh0 hh1 hqs0 hqs1 hS (hsm j).1
        (fun m => (hbj j hj m).imp fun C hC x t hxt => (hC x t hxt).1) m
      obtain ⟨C2, h2⟩ := cutoff_product_bound h qs (γ * (j : ℝ)) ℓ (Bv j) hh0 hh1 hqs0 hqs1 hS (hsm j).2.1
        (fun m => (hbj j hj m).imp fun C hC x t hxt => (hC x t hxt).2.1) m
      obtain ⟨C3, h3⟩ := cutoff_product_bound h qs (γ * (j : ℝ)) ℓ (P j) hh0 hh1 hqs0 hqs1 hS (hsm j).2.2
        (fun m => (hbj j hj m).imp fun C hC x t hxt => (hC x t hxt).2.2) m
      refine ⟨|C1| + |C2| + |C3|, fun _ a ha x t hxt => ?_⟩
      have e : γ * (j : ℝ) - Ls m = γ * (j : ℝ) - ((m : ℝ) + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |ℓ i|) := by

        (h2 a ha x t hxt).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hq),
        (h3 a ha x t hxt).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hq)⟩
      · linarith [le_abs_self C1, abs_nonneg C2, abs_nonneg C3]
      · linarith [abs_nonneg C1, le_abs_self C2, abs_nonneg C3]
      · linarith [abs_nonneg C1, abs_nonneg C2, le_abs_self C3]
    · exact ⟨0, fun h1 => absurd h1 hj⟩

  have hsupp : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ j → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs →

      rw [le_div_iff₀ (hapos j)]

    have hs := hasmall j hj k hk _ hq hqa
    have e : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * (j : ℝ) - Ls k) =
        simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * (j : ℝ) / 2) *
          simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * (j : ℝ) / 2 - Ls k) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [e] at hX
    have h1 : 0 ≤ simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * (j : ℝ) / 2 - Ls k) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    have h2 : 0 ≤ simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * (j : ℝ) / 2) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    calc X ≤ Ch j k * (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * (j : ℝ) / 2) *
          simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * (j : ℝ) / 2 - Ls k)) := hX
      _ = (Ch j k * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * (j : ℝ) / 2)) *
          simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * (j : ℝ) / 2 - Ls k) := by ring
      _ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ j * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * (j : ℝ) / 2 - Ls k) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) h2) hs) h1
  have hglob : ∀ (j k : ℕ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → ∀ X : ℝ,
      X ≤ Ch j k * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * (j : ℝ) - Ls k) →
      X ≤ |Ch j k| * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (- Ls k) := by
    intro j k x t hxt X hX
    have hq := hQpos x t hxt
    have hq1 := hQle1 x t hxt
    have hγj : 0 ≤ γ * (j : ℝ) := mul_nonneg hγ.le (Nat.cast_nonneg j)
    have e1 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * (j : ℝ) - Ls k) ≤

      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq hq1 (by linarith)
    calc X ≤ Ch j k * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * (j : ℝ) - Ls k) := hX
      _ ≤ |Ch j k| * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * (j : ℝ) - Ls k) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _)
      _ ≤ |Ch j k| * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (- Ls k) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e1 (abs_nonneg _)
  
  obtain ⟨hA1, hA2, hA3⟩ := cutSum_props h qs γ Ls a A hh0 hh1 hqs0 hqs1 hγ hS ha1 ha2

  obtain ⟨hB1, hB2, hB3⟩ := cutSum_props h qs γ Ls a Bv hh0 hh1 hqs0 hqs1 hγ hS ha1 ha2
    (fun j => (hsm j).2.1)
    (fun j hj k hk x t hxt hsup =>

    (fun j => (hsm j).2.2)

    (fun j hj k => ⟨|Ch j k|, fun x t hxt => hglob j k x t hxt _ (hCh j k hj (a j) (hapos j) x t hxt).2.2⟩)
  refine ⟨cutSum h a A, cutSum h a Bv, cutSum h a P, ?_⟩
  unfold LocalPackage
  refine ⟨hA1, hB1, hP1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    exact cutSum_div_tangent h qs a Bv hh0 hh1 hqs0 hqs1 hS ha1 ha2 (fun j => (hsm j).2.1) hdivAF
  · 
    intro m
    obtain ⟨C0, h0⟩ := hb0 m
    obtain ⟨CA, hCA⟩ := hA2 m
    obtain ⟨CB, hCB⟩ := hB2 m
    obtain ⟨CP, hCP⟩ := hP2 m
    refine ⟨|C0| + |CA| + |CB| + |CP|, max (max (K m) (Ls m)) 0, le_max_right _ _,

    have hq := hQpos x t hxt
    have hq1 := hQle1 x t hxt

      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq hq1
        (neg_le_neg ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _)))
    have eL : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-Ls m) ≤
        simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-max (max (K m) (Ls m)) 0) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq hq1
        (neg_le_neg ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _)))
    have nK := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le (-K m)
    have nL := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le (-Ls m)
    have nκ := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le (-max (max (K m) (Ls m)) 0)
    have comb : ∀ (N N0 C1 C2 : ℝ),
        N ≤ N0 + C2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-Ls m) →
        N0 ≤ C1 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K m) →
        |C1| + |C2| ≤ |C0| + |CA| + |CB| + |CP| →
        N ≤ (|C0| + |CA| + |CB| + |CP|) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-max (max (K m) (Ls m)) 0) := by
      intro N N0 C1 C2 hN hN0 hT
      have a1 : C1 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K m) ≤
          |C1| * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-max (max (K m) (Ls m)) 0) :=
        le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) nK)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left eK (abs_nonneg _))
      have a2 : C2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-Ls m) ≤
          |C2| * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-max (max (K m) (Ls m)) 0) :=
        le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) nL)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left eL (abs_nonneg _))
      have a3 : (|C1| + |C2|) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-max (max (K m) (Ls m)) 0) ≤
          (|C0| + |CA| + |CB| + |CP|) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-max (max (K m) (Ls m)) 0) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hT nκ

    obtain ⟨b1, b2, b3⟩ := h0 x t hxt
    refine ⟨comb _ _ C0 CA (hCA x t hxt) b1 ?_, comb _ _ C0 CB (hCB x t hxt) b2 ?_,
      comb _ _ C0 CP (hCP x t hxt) b3 ?_⟩
    · linarith [abs_nonneg CB, abs_nonneg CP]
    · linarith [abs_nonneg CA, abs_nonneg CP]
    · linarith [abs_nonneg CA, abs_nonneg CB]
  · 
    intro x t hxt hr
    obtain ⟨e1, e2, e3, e4⟩ := hext x t hxt hr
    have zA : ∀ j : ℕ, simCut h (a (j + 1)) x t • A (j + 1) x t = 0 := fun j => by
      rw [(e4 (j + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 j)).1, smul_zero]
    have zB : ∀ j : ℕ, simCut h (a (j + 1)) x t • Bv (j + 1) x t = 0 := fun j => by
      rw [(e4 (j + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 j)).2.1, smul_zero]
    have zP : ∀ j : ℕ, simCut h (a (j + 1)) x t • P (j + 1) x t = 0 := fun j => by
      rw [(e4 (j + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 j)).2.2, smul_zero]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [cutSum, zA, tsum_zero, add_zero, e1]
    · simp only [cutSum, zB, tsum_zero, add_zero, e2]
    · simp only [cutSum, zP, tsum_zero, add_zero, e3]
  · 
    exact flat_residual_of_tail h qs Xe Xin c e0 γ ℓ K Ls A Bv P (cutSum h a A) (cutSum h a Bv)
      (cutSum h a P) a hh0 hh1 hqs0 hqs1 hγ hS hAF0 ha1 hA1 hB1 hP1
      (fun J k hk x t hxt hJ => ⟨hA3 J k hk x t hxt hJ, hB3 J k hk x t hxt hJ, hP3 J k hk x t hxt hJ⟩)

    obtain ⟨τ₁, hτ₁, hg⟩ := hgrow
    refine ⟨min τ₁ qs, lt_min hτ₁ hqs0, fun τ hτ hτ1 => ?_⟩
    have hτa : τ < τ₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le hτ1 (min_le_left _ _)
    have hτq : τ < qs := lt_of_lt_of_le hτ1 (min_le_right _ _)
    have hsub : (1 : ℝ) - (1 - τ) = τ := by ring

      hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.comp_continuous (f := fun y : ℝ³ => ((y 2, τ) : ℝ × ℝ))

    have hs0 : simScale h 0 τ = τ := by
      have := (hS.1 0 τ hτ).2
      simpa using this
    obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U : Set ℝ³, U = {y : ℝ³ | simScale h (y 2) τ < qs ∧

    have hUo : IsOpen U := by
      rw [hU]
      exact (isOpen_lt hScont continuous_const).inter
        (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) (continuous_const.mul hScont))
    have hx2 : (Real.sqrt (2 * Xin * τ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) 2 = 0 := by simp
    have hx0 : (Real.sqrt (2 * Xin * τ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) 0 =
        Real.sqrt (2 * Xin * τ) := by simp
    have hx1 : (Real.sqrt (2 * Xin * τ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) 1 = 0 := by simp
    have hxU : Real.sqrt (2 * Xin * τ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) ∈ U := by
      rw [hU]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · show simScale h _ τ < qs
        rw [hx2, hs0]
        exact hτq
      · show _ < 4 * Xin * simScale h _ τ
        rw [hx2, hs0, hx0, hx1, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
        nlinarith
    have hvan : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → A j y (1 - τ) = 0 ∧ Bv j y (1 - τ) = 0 ∧ P j y (1 - τ) = 0 := by
      intro y hy j hj
      rw [hU] at hy
      have hmem : (y, 1 - τ) ∈ simDomain h qs := by
        show 1 - τ < 1 ∧ simScale h (y 2) (1 - (1 - τ)) < qs
        rw [hsub]
        exact ⟨by linarith, hy.1⟩
      exact hint j hj y (1 - τ) hmem (by rw [hsub]; exact hy.2)

      intro y hy
      have zA : ∀ j : ℕ, simCut h (a (j + 1)) y (1 - τ) • A (j + 1) y (1 - τ) = 0 := fun j => by
        rw [(hvan y hy (j + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 j)).1, smul_zero]
      simp only [cutSum, zA, tsum_zero, add_zero]
    have hcB : ∀ y ∈ U, cutSum h a Bv y (1 - τ) = Bv 0 y (1 - τ) := by
      intro y hy
      have zB : ∀ j : ℕ, simCut h (a (j + 1)) y (1 - τ) • Bv (j + 1) y (1 - τ) = 0 := fun j => by
        rw [(hvan y hy (j + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 j)).2.1, smul_zero]
      simp only [cutSum, zB, tsum_zero, add_zero]
    have hev : (fun w => cutSum h a A w (1 - τ)) =ᶠ[nhds
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Xin * τ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))]

      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hxU) (fun y hy => hcA y hy)

        (Real.sqrt (2 * Xin * τ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) =
        curl3 (fun w => A 0 w (1 - τ))
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Xin * τ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) := by
      unfold curl3
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    rw [hcurl, hcB _ hxU]
    have hp : 0 < τ ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hτ _

approx_family_summation.definitions:
noncomputable def simCut (h a : ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * (a * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)))

noncomputable def cutSum {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    (h : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ³ → ℝ → V) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) : V :=
  F 0 x t + ∑' j : ℕ, simCut h (a (j + 1)) x t • F (j + 1) x t

and_nodes.definitions_block:
noncomputable def simCut (h a : ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * (a * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)))

noncomputable def cutSum {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    (h : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ³ → ℝ → V) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) : V :=
  F 0 x t + ∑' j : ℕ, simCut h (a (j + 1)) x t • F (j + 1) x t

subgoal_signatures.name: cutoff_product_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h qs β : ℝ) (ℓ : ℕ → ℝ) {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (F : ℝ³ → ℝ → V), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → SimScaleProps h → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (simDomain h qs) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (β - ℓ m)) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun y s => simCut h a y s • F y s)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (β - ((m : ℝ) + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |ℓ i|))

subgoal_signatures.name: flat_residual_of_tail
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h qs Xe Xin c e0 γ : ℝ) (ℓ K L : ℕ → ℝ) (A Bv : ℕ → ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (P : ℕ → ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (A' Bv' : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (P' : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → 0 < γ → SimScaleProps h → ApproxFamily h qs Xe Xin c e0 γ ℓ K A Bv P → (∀ j, 1 ≤ a j) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿A') (simDomain h qs) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Bv') (simDomain h qs) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿P') (simDomain h qs) → (∀ J k : ℕ, k ≤ J → ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → a J * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < 1 / 2 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => (↿A') z - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), (↿(A j)) z) (x, t)‖ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ J * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * ((J : ℝ) + 1) / 2 - L k) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => (↿Bv') z - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), (↿(Bv j)) z) (x, t)‖ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ J * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * ((J : ℝ) + 1) / 2 - L k) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => (↿P') z - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), (↿(P j)) z) (x, t)‖ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ J * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * ((J : ℝ) + 1) / 2 - L k)) → ∀ m N : ℕ, ∃ C δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < δ → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(nsResidual 1 (fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A' w s) y + Bv' y s) P')) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ N

subgoal_signatures.name: cutSum_props
