proof.tactics:
by
  intro h qs Xe Xin c e0 A₀ Bv₀ P₀ hh0 hh1 hqs0 hqs1 hXin hXe he0 hS hH hLP
  unfold SimScaleProps at hS
  unfold HeatExteriorProps at hH
  unfold LocalPackage at hLP
  obtain ⟨hAs, hBs, hPs, hdivB, hpoly, hext, hflat, hgrow⟩ := hLP
  obtain ⟨hS1, hS2, hS3, hS4, _⟩ := hS
  have hθ : 0 < 1 - 2 * h := by linarith
  have hθne : (1 - 2 * h) ≠ 0 := hθ.ne'
  have hinv : ∀ a : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → (a ^ (1 - 2 * h)) ^ (1 / (1 - 2 * h)) = a := by
    intro a ha
    rw [one_div]
    exact Real.rpow_rpow_inv ha hθne
  have hN1 : ∀ x : ℝ³, ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  
  have hsmall : ∀ η z τ : ℝ, 0 < η → 0 < τ → τ < η / 4 → 2 * z ^ 2 < (η / 2) ^ (1 - 2 * h) →
      simScale h z τ < η := by
    intro η z τ hη hτ hτη hz
    have h1 := hS3 z τ hτ
    have h2 : (2 * z ^ 2) ^ (1 / (1 - 2 * h)) < ((η / 2) ^ (1 - 2 * h)) ^ (1 / (1 - 2 * h)) :=
      Real.rpow_lt_rpow (by positivity) hz (one_div_pos.mpr hθ)
    rw [hinv (η / 2) (by positivity)] at h2
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨τ₀, hτ₀⟩ : ∃ τ₀ : ℝ, τ₀ = min (1 / 2) (qs / 4) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hτ0 : 0 < τ₀ := by rw [hτ₀]; exact lt_min (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  have hτhalf : τ₀ ≤ 1 / 2 := by rw [hτ₀]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hτqs : τ₀ ≤ qs / 4 := by rw [hτ₀]; exact min_le_right _ _
  have hτ1 : τ₀ < 1 := by linarith
  have ha0 : 0 < (qs / 2) ^ (1 - 2 * h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith) _
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ : ∃ ρ : ℝ, ρ = min 1 (Real.sqrt ((qs / 2) ^ (1 - 2 * h) / 2)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hρ0 : 0 < ρ := by
    rw [hρ]; exact lt_min one_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity))
  have hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1 := by rw [hρ]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hρsq : ρ ^ 2 ≤ (qs / 2) ^ (1 - 2 * h) / 2 := by
    have h1 : ρ ≤ Real.sqrt ((qs / 2) ^ (1 - 2 * h) / 2) := by rw [hρ]; exact min_le_right _ _
    have := pow_le_pow_left₀ hρ0.le h1 2
    rwa [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)] at this
  have hbox : ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), ‖x‖ < ρ → 1 - τ₀ < t → t < 1 → (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs := by
    intro x t hx ht1 ht2
    show t < 1 ∧ simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < qs
    refine ⟨ht2, ?_⟩
    apply hsmall qs (x 2) (1 - t) hqs0 (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hn := hN1 x
    have hxx : ‖x‖ ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2 := pow_lt_pow_left₀ hx (norm_nonneg _) two_ne_zero
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0), sq_nonneg (x 1)]
  have hsub : Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) ρ ×ˢ Ioo (1 - τ₀) 1 ⊆ simDomain h qs := by
    rintro ⟨x, t⟩ ⟨hx, ht1, ht2⟩
    exact hbox x t (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hx) ht1 ht2
  
  have hunb : ∀ M δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ x t, ‖x‖ < δ ∧ 1 - δ < t ∧ t < 1 ∧
      M < ‖curl3 (fun w => A₀ w t) x + Bv₀ x t‖ := by
    intro M δ hδ
    obtain ⟨τ₁, hτ₁, hg⟩ := hgrow
    have hM1 : 0 < |M| + 1 := by positivity
    have hb : 0 < e0 / (|M| + 1) := div_pos he0 hM1
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ : ∃ μ : ℝ,
        μ = min (min τ₁ δ) (min (δ ^ 2 / (2 * Xin)) ((e0 / (|M| + 1)) ^ 2)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hμ0 : 0 < μ := by
      rw [hμ]; exact lt_min (lt_min hτ₁ hδ) (lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity))
    have e1 : μ ≤ τ₁ := by rw [hμ]; exact (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
    have e2 : μ ≤ δ := by rw [hμ]; exact (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
    have e3 : μ ≤ δ ^ 2 / (2 * Xin) := by rw [hμ]; exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
    have e4 : μ ≤ (e0 / (|M| + 1)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hμ]; exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
    have hτ0' : 0 < μ / 2 := by linarith
    refine ⟨Real.sqrt (2 * Xin * (μ / 2)) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ), 1 - μ / 2,
      ?_, by linarith, by linarith, ?_⟩
    · rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_lt' hδ]
      have h1 : 2 * Xin * (μ / 2) < 2 * Xin * (δ ^ 2 / (2 * Xin)) := by
        apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left _ (by positivity); linarith
      have h2 : 2 * Xin * (δ ^ 2 / (2 * Xin)) = δ ^ 2 := by field_simp
      linarith
    · have hgr := hg (μ / 2) hτ0' (by linarith)
      have hsq : Real.sqrt (μ / 2) < e0 / (|M| + 1) := (Real.sqrt_lt' hb).mpr (by linarith)
      have hsp : 0 < Real.sqrt (μ / 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hτ0'
      have hrw : (μ / 2) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) = (Real.sqrt (μ / 2))⁻¹ := by
        rw [Real.rpow_neg hτ0'.le, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
      have h3 : |M| + 1 < e0 * (Real.sqrt (μ / 2))⁻¹ := by
        rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, lt_div_iff₀ hsp]
        rw [lt_div_iff₀ hM1] at hsq
        linarith
      rw [hrw] at hgr
      have := le_abs_self M
      linarith
  
  have hbd : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, δ ≤ ‖x‖ → ‖x‖ ≤ ρ / 2 → 1 - τ₀ < t →
      t < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿A₀) (x, t)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Bv₀) (x, t)‖ ≤ C ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿P₀) (x, t)‖ ≤ C := by
    intro δ hδ m
    obtain ⟨C, κ, hκ, hCb⟩ := hpoly m
    obtain ⟨CH, hCH⟩ := hH.2.2.2 (δ / 2) (half_pos hδ) m
    have hXe0 : 0 < Xe := by linarith
    have hc1 : 0 < (δ ^ 2 / 4) ^ (1 / (1 - 2 * h)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) _
    have hc2 : 0 < δ ^ 2 / (4 * Xe) := by positivity
    obtain ⟨cc, hcc⟩ : ∃ cc : ℝ,
        cc = min ((δ ^ 2 / 4) ^ (1 / (1 - 2 * h))) (δ ^ 2 / (4 * Xe)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hcc0 : 0 < cc := by rw [hcc]; exact lt_min hc1 hc2
    have hcc1 : cc ≤ (δ ^ 2 / 4) ^ (1 / (1 - 2 * h)) := by rw [hcc]; exact min_le_left _ _
    have hcc2 : cc ≤ δ ^ 2 / (4 * Xe) := by rw [hcc]; exact min_le_right _ _
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ B : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ), B = Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) ρ ×ˢ Ioo (1 - τ₀) 1 :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hBo : IsOpen B := by rw [hB]; exact Metric.isOpen_ball.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hgc : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
        w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 - 2 * Xe * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) B := by
      have hq : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) B := by
        have hφ : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)) := by fun_prop
        refine hS4.continuousOn.comp hφ.continuousOn ?_
        rintro ⟨x, t⟩ hw
        rw [hB] at hw
        exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - t by linarith [hw.2.2]⟩
      have hc0 : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2) := by fun_prop
      exact hc0.continuousOn.sub (continuousOn_const.mul hq)
    obtain ⟨O, hO⟩ : ∃ O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ), O = B ∩ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
        w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 - 2 * Xe * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ⁻¹' Ioi 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hOo : IsOpen O := by rw [hO]; exact hgc.isOpen_inter_preimage hBo isOpen_Ioi
    have hOext : ∀ w ∈ O, (↿A₀) w = 0 ∧ (↿Bv₀) w = (↿(heatSwirl h c)) w ∧
        (↿P₀) w = (↿(heatPressure h c)) w := by
      rintro ⟨y, s⟩ hw
      rw [hO, hB] at hw
      obtain ⟨⟨hy, hs1, hs2⟩, hg⟩ := hw
      have hg' : 2 * Xe * simScale h (y 2) (1 - s) < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 := by

      exact hext y s (hbox y s (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hy) hs1 hs2) hg'
    refine ⟨max (|C| * cc ^ (-κ)) (max CH 0), ?_⟩
    intro x t hx1 hx2 ht1 ht2
    have hρ2 : ‖x‖ < ρ := by linarith
    have hΩ := hbox x t hρ2 ht1 ht2
    have hτ : 0 < 1 - t := by linarith
    have hq0 := (hS1 (x 2) (1 - t) hτ).1
    by_cases hcase : cc ≤ simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)
    · have hpow : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-κ) ≤ cc ^ (-κ) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hcc0 hcase (by linarith)
      have hpos : 0 < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-κ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _

              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) hpos.le

      obtain ⟨b1, b2, b3⟩ := hCb x t hΩ
      exact ⟨b1.trans key, b2.trans key, b3.trans key⟩
    · push_neg at hcase
      have hz : x 2 ^ 2 < δ ^ 2 / 4 := by
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        have h1 := (hS2 (x 2) (1 - t) hτ).2
        have h2 : (δ ^ 2 / 4) ^ (1 / (1 - 2 * h)) <
            (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (1 - 2 * h)) ^ (1 / (1 - 2 * h)) :=
          Real.rpow_lt_rpow (by positivity) (lt_of_le_of_lt hcon h1) (one_div_pos.mpr hθ)
        rw [hinv _ hq0.le] at h2
        linarith
      have hn := hN1 x
      have hxsq : δ ^ 2 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hδ.le hx1 2
      have hr : 3 * δ ^ 2 / 4 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := by linarith
      have hqc : 2 * Xe * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < δ ^ 2 / 2 := by
        have h1 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < δ ^ 2 / (4 * Xe) := lt_of_lt_of_le hcase hcc2
        rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at h1
        linarith
      have hmem : ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ O := by
        rw [hO, hB]
        refine ⟨⟨mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr hρ2, ht1, ht2⟩, ?_⟩
        simp only [mem_preimage, mem_Ioi]
        nlinarith
      have hnhds := hOo.mem_nhds hmem
      have evA : (↿A₀) =ᶠ[nhds (x, t)] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ³)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hnhds (fun w hw => (hOext w hw).1)
      have evB : (↿Bv₀) =ᶠ[nhds (x, t)] ↿(heatSwirl h c) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hnhds (fun w hw => (hOext w hw).2.1)
      have evP : (↿P₀) =ᶠ[nhds (x, t)] ↿(heatPressure h c) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hnhds (fun w hw => (hOext w hw).2.2)
      have hx1' : ‖x‖ ≤ 1 := by linarith
      have hxle : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]
      have hd2 : (δ / 2) ^ 2 = δ ^ 2 / 4 := by ring
      obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := hCH x t (by rw [hd2]; linarith [sq_nonneg δ])
        (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 2)]) (by linarith) ht2
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [(evA.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
        simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
        exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
      · rw [(evB.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
        exact hb1.trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _))
      · rw [(evP.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
        exact hb2.trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _))
  
  have hfl : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x t, ‖x‖ < δ → 1 - δ < t → t < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(nsResidual 1 (fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A₀ w s) y + Bv₀ y s) P₀))
        (x, t)‖ < ε := by
    intro m ε hε
    obtain ⟨C, δ₁, hδ₁, hC⟩ := hflat m 1
    have hC1 : 0 < |C| + 1 := by positivity
    obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ : ∃ η : ℝ, η = min δ₁ (ε / (|C| + 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hη0 : 0 < η := by rw [hη]; exact lt_min hδ₁ (div_pos hε hC1)
    have hη1 : η ≤ δ₁ := by rw [hη]; exact min_le_left _ _
    have hη2 : η ≤ ε / (|C| + 1) := by rw [hη]; exact min_le_right _ _
    have ha : 0 < (η / 2) ^ (1 - 2 * h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith) _
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ,
        δ = min (min ρ τ₀) (min (η / 4) (Real.sqrt ((η / 2) ^ (1 - 2 * h) / 2))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hsq0 : 0 < Real.sqrt ((η / 2) ^ (1 - 2 * h) / 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
    have hδ0 : 0 < δ := by
      rw [hδ]; exact lt_min (lt_min hρ0 hτ0) (lt_min (by linarith) hsq0)
    have d1 : δ ≤ ρ := by rw [hδ]; exact (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
    have d2 : δ ≤ τ₀ := by rw [hδ]; exact (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
    have d3 : δ ≤ η / 4 := by rw [hδ]; exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
    have d4 : δ ≤ Real.sqrt ((η / 2) ^ (1 - 2 * h) / 2) := by
      rw [hδ]; exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
    have d4' : δ ^ 2 ≤ (η / 2) ^ (1 - 2 * h) / 2 := by
      have := pow_le_pow_left₀ hδ0.le d4 2
      rwa [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)] at this
    refine ⟨δ, hδ0, ?_⟩
    intro x t hx ht1 ht2
    have hΩ := hbox x t (by linarith) (by linarith) ht2
    have hτ : 0 < 1 - t := by linarith
    have hn := hN1 x
    have hxx : ‖x‖ ^ 2 < δ ^ 2 := pow_lt_pow_left₀ hx (norm_nonneg _) two_ne_zero
    have hq := hsmall η (x 2) (1 - t) hη0 hτ (by linarith)
      (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0), sq_nonneg (x 1)])
    have hq0 := (hS1 (x 2) (1 - t) hτ).1
    have hb := hC x t hΩ (by linarith)
    rw [pow_one] at hb
    have hq2 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) * (|C| + 1) < ε := by
      have h1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hq hη2
      rwa [lt_div_iff₀ hC1] at h1
    calc _ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) := hb
      _ ≤ |C| * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) hq0.le
      _ < ε := by nlinarith
  refine ⟨ρ, τ₀, A₀, Bv₀, P₀, hρ0, hτ0, hτ1, hAs.mono hsub, hBs.mono hsub, hPs.mono hsub,
    fun x t hx ht1 ht2 => hdivB x t (hbox x t hx ht1 ht2), hbd, hfl, hunb⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∃ c₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ c₁ ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (cutPhi R) ∧ HasCompactSupport (cutPhi R) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ cutPhi R x ∧ cutPhi R x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ R → cutPhi R x = 1) ∧ (∀ x, 2 * R ≤ ‖x‖ → cutPhi R x = 0) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) ∧ (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) x‖ ≤ 8 * c₁ / R * cutPhi R x ^ 7) ∧ (∀ x, ‖x‖ < R → fderiv ℝ (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) x = 0)

signature.name: cutoff_profile
signature.statement: ∃ c₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ c₁ ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (cutPhi R) ∧ HasCompactSupport (cutPhi R) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ cutPhi R x ∧ cutPhi R x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ R → cutPhi R x = 1) ∧ (∀ x, 2 * R ≤ ‖x‖ → cutPhi R x = 0) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) ∧ (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) x‖ ≤ 8 * c₁ / R * cutPhi R x ^ 7) ∧ (∀ x, ‖x‖ < R → fderiv ℝ (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) x = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hbC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (⇑bump12) := bump12.contDiff
  have hbS : HasCompactSupport (⇑bump12) := bump12.hasCompactSupport
  have hDc : Continuous (fderiv ℝ (⇑bump12)) := hbC.continuous_fderiv (by simp)
  have hDS : HasCompactSupport (fderiv ℝ (⇑bump12)) := hbS.fderiv ℝ
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hDS.exists_bound_of_continuous hDc
  refine ⟨max c 0, le_max_right _ _, fun R hR => ?_⟩
  have hc' : ∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ (⇑bump12) y‖ ≤ max c 0 :=
    fun y => le_trans (hc y) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hRpos : 0 < R := by linarith
  have hRinv : 0 < R⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hRpos
  have hnorm : ∀ x : ℝ³, ‖R⁻¹ • x‖ = R⁻¹ * ‖x‖ := fun x => by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hRinv]
  have hφeq : cutPhi R = fun x => bump12 (R⁻¹ • x) := rfl
  have hφC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (cutPhi R) := by
    rw [hφeq]; exact hbC.comp (contDiff_const_smul R⁻¹)
  have hφS : HasCompactSupport (cutPhi R) := by
    rw [hφeq]; exact hbS.comp_smul (inv_ne_zero hRpos.ne')
  have hφb : ∀ x, 0 ≤ cutPhi R x ∧ cutPhi R x ≤ 1 :=
    fun x => ⟨bump12.nonneg, bump12.le_one⟩
  have hφ1 : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ R → cutPhi R x = 1 := by
    intro x hx
    show bump12 (R⁻¹ • x) = 1
    apply bump12.one_of_mem_closedBall
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, hnorm]
    show R⁻¹ * ‖x‖ ≤ 1
    rw [inv_mul_le_iff₀ hRpos, mul_one]
    exact hx
  have hφ0 : ∀ x, 2 * R ≤ ‖x‖ → cutPhi R x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    show bump12 (R⁻¹ • x) = 0
    apply bump12.zero_of_le_dist
    rw [dist_zero_right, hnorm]
    show (2:ℝ) ≤ R⁻¹ * ‖x‖
    rw [le_inv_mul_iff₀ hRpos]
    linarith
  have hχC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) := hφC.pow 8
  have hχS : HasCompactSupport (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) :=
    hφS.comp_left (g := fun t : ℝ => t ^ 8) (by norm_num)
  have hDφ : ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (cutPhi R) x‖ ≤ max c 0 / R := by
    intro x
    rw [hφeq, fderiv_comp_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hRinv, div_eq_inv_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hc' _) hRinv.le
  have hχd : ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) x‖ ≤ 8 * max c 0 / R * cutPhi R x ^ 7 := by
    intro x
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (cutPhi R) x := hφC.differentiable (by simp) x
    have h0 : 0 ≤ cutPhi R x := (hφb x).1
    have h7 : 0 ≤ cutPhi R x ^ 7 := pow_nonneg h0 7
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) x = (8 * cutPhi R x ^ 7) • fderiv ℝ (cutPhi R) x := by
      rw [(hd.hasFDerivAt.pow 8).fderiv]
      norm_num
    rw [hfd, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    calc 8 * cutPhi R x ^ 7 * ‖fderiv ℝ (cutPhi R) x‖ ≤ 8 * cutPhi R x ^ 7 * (max c 0 / R) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hDφ x) (by positivity)
      _ = 8 * max c 0 / R * cutPhi R x ^ 7 := by ring
  have hχz : ∀ x, ‖x‖ < R → fderiv ℝ (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have hU : Metric.ball (0:ℝ³) R ∈ nhds x :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]; exact hx)
    have hev : (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) =ᶠ[nhds x] (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) := by
      filter_upwards [hU] with y hy
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hy
      rw [hφ1 y hy.le, one_pow]
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    exact fderiv_const_apply _
  exact ⟨hφC, hφS, hφb, hφ1, hφ0, hχC, hχS, hχd, hχz⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (χ : ℝ³ → ℝ) (g : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (T : ℝ), 0 < T → Continuous χ → HasCompactSupport χ → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (univ ×ˢ Icc 0 T) → ContinuousOn (fun s => ∫ x, χ x * ‖g x s‖ ^ 2) (Icc 0 T) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun s => ∫ x, χ x * (2 * inner ℝ (g x s) (deriv (fun r => g x r) s))) (Ioo 0 T) ∧ ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 T, HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ x, χ x * ‖g x s‖ ^ 2) (∫ x, χ x * (2 * inner ℝ (g x s) (deriv (fun r => g x r) s))) s

signature.name: weighted_energy_regularity
signature.statement: ∀ (χ : ℝ³ → ℝ) (g : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (T : ℝ), 0 < T → Continuous χ → HasCompactSupport χ → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (univ ×ˢ Icc 0 T) → ContinuousOn (fun s => ∫ x, χ x * ‖g x s‖ ^ 2) (Icc 0 T) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun s => ∫ x, χ x * (2 * inner ℝ (g x s) (deriv (fun r => g x r) s))) (Ioo 0 T) ∧ ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 T, HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ x, χ x * ‖g x s‖ ^ 2) (∫ x, χ x * (2 * inner ℝ (g x s) (deriv (fun r => g x r) s))) s

proof.tactics:
by
  intro χ g T hT hχ hχs hg
  have hOopen : IsOpen ((univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Ioo (0:ℝ) T) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hO : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) ((univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Ioo (0:ℝ) T) :=
    hg.mono (fun z hz => ⟨hz.1, Ioo_subset_Icc_self hz.2⟩)
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : ℝ³ × ℝ, e = ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have s1 : ∀ x : ℝ³, ∀ s ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) T,
      HasDerivAt (fun r => g x r) (fderiv ℝ (↿g) (x, s) e) s := by
    intro x s hs
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿g) (x, s) :=
      (hO.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hOopen.mem_nhds ⟨mem_univ x, hs⟩)
    have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => (x, r)) e s := by
      rw [he]
      exact (hasDerivAt_const s x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id s)
    exact hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s hγ
  have hcont_fd : ContinuousOn (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿g) z e) ((univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Ioo (0:ℝ) T) :=
    (hO.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hOopen (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have s2 : ∀ (h : ℝ → ℝ³ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ), ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry h) (S ×ˢ univ) →
      ContinuousOn (fun s => ∫ x, χ x * h s x) S := by
    intro h S hh
    apply continuousOn_integral_of_compact_support hχs.isCompact
    · have : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ³ => χ p.2 * Function.uncurry h p) (S ×ˢ univ) :=
        (hχ.comp continuous_snd).continuousOn.mul hh
      exact this
    · intro p x _ hx
      simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx]
  have hA : ContinuousOn (fun s => ∫ x, χ x * ‖g x s‖ ^ 2) (Icc 0 T) := by
    apply s2 (fun s x => ‖g x s‖ ^ 2) (Icc 0 T)
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ³ => (↿g) p.swap) (Icc 0 T ×ˢ univ) :=
      hg.continuousOn.comp continuous_swap.continuousOn (fun p hp => ⟨mem_univ _, hp.1⟩)
    exact h1.norm.pow 2
  have hB : ContinuousOn (fun s => ∫ x, χ x * (2 * inner ℝ (g x s) (deriv (fun r => g x r) s)))
      (Ioo 0 T) := by
    apply s2 (fun s x => 2 * inner ℝ (g x s) (deriv (fun r => g x r) s)) (Ioo 0 T)
    have hmap : MapsTo Prod.swap (Ioo (0:ℝ) T ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ³))
        ((univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Ioo (0:ℝ) T) := fun p hp => ⟨mem_univ _, hp.1⟩
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ³ => (↿g) p.swap) (Ioo 0 T ×ˢ univ) :=
      hO.continuousOn.comp continuous_swap.continuousOn hmap
    have h2 : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ³ => fderiv ℝ (↿g) p.swap e) (Ioo 0 T ×ˢ univ) :=
      hcont_fd.comp continuous_swap.continuousOn hmap
    have h3 : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ³ =>
        2 * inner ℝ ((↿g) p.swap) (fderiv ℝ (↿g) p.swap e)) (Ioo 0 T ×ˢ univ) :=
      continuousOn_const.mul (h1.inner h2)
    refine h3.congr ?_
    rintro ⟨s, x⟩ ⟨hs, -⟩
    simp only [Function.uncurry_apply_pair]
    rw [(s1 x s hs).deriv]
    rfl
  have hC : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 T, HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ x, χ x * ‖g x s‖ ^ 2)
      (∫ x, χ x * (2 * inner ℝ (g x s) (deriv (fun r => g x r) s))) s := by
    intro s₀ hs₀
    obtain ⟨h0, hT0⟩ := hs₀
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, δ = min s₀ (T - s₀) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hmin : 0 < min s₀ (T - s₀) := lt_min h0 (by linarith)
    have hδpos : 0 < δ := by rw [hδ]; linarith
    have hJ : Metric.closedBall s₀ δ ⊆ Ioo 0 T := by
      intro s hs
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, Real.dist_eq, abs_le] at hs
      have h1 := min_le_left s₀ (T - s₀)
      have h2 := min_le_right s₀ (T - s₀)
      constructor <;> linarith [hs.1, hs.2]
    have hball : Metric.ball s₀ δ ⊆ Ioo 0 T := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hJ
    have hKcc : IsCompact (tsupport χ ×ˢ Metric.closedBall s₀ δ) :=
      hχs.isCompact.prod (isCompact_closedBall s₀ δ)
    have hKcO : tsupport χ ×ˢ Metric.closedBall s₀ δ ⊆ (univ : Set ℝ³) ×ˢ Ioo (0:ℝ) T :=
      fun z hz => ⟨mem_univ _, hJ hz.2⟩
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hKcc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hO.continuousOn.mono hKcO)
    obtain ⟨M', hM'⟩ := hKcc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hcont_fd.mono hKcO)
    have hbint : Integrable (fun x => 2 * M * M' * |χ x|) := by
      have : Integrable (fun x => ‖χ x‖) := (hχ.norm).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hχs.norm
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this.const_mul (2 * M * M')
    have hslice : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) T, Continuous (fun x => g x s) := fun s hs =>
      hg.continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
        (fun x => ⟨mem_univ x, hs⟩)
    have hFcont : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) T, Continuous (fun x => χ x * ‖g x s‖ ^ 2) := fun s hs =>
      hχ.mul ((hslice s hs).norm.pow 2)
    have hF's0 : (fun x => χ x * (2 * inner ℝ (g x s₀) (deriv (fun r => g x r) s₀)))
        = fun x => χ x * (2 * inner ℝ (g x s₀) (fderiv ℝ (↿g) (x, s₀) e)) := by
      funext x; rw [(s1 x s₀ ⟨h0, hT0⟩).deriv]
    have hfdcont : Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ (↿g) (x, s₀) e) :=
      hcont_fd.comp_continuous (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
        (fun x => ⟨mem_univ x, ⟨h0, hT0⟩⟩)
    have key := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (μ := volume)
      (F := fun s x => χ x * ‖g x s‖ ^ 2)
      (F' := fun s x => χ x * (2 * inner ℝ (g x s) (deriv (fun r => g x r) s)))
      (bound := fun x => 2 * M * M' * |χ x|)
      (Metric.ball_mem_nhds s₀ hδpos) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hbint ?_
    · exact key.2
    · filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds s₀ hδpos] with s hs
      exact (hFcont s (Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hball hs))).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact (hFcont s₀ ⟨h0.le, hT0.le⟩).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hχs.mul_right
    · show AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun x => χ x * (2 * inner ℝ (g x s₀) (deriv (fun r => g x r) s₀))) volume
      rw [hF's0]
      exact (hχ.mul (continuous_const.mul
        ((hslice s₀ ⟨h0.le, hT0.le⟩).inner hfdcont))).aestronglyMeasurable
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x s hs => ?_)
      show ‖χ x * (2 * inner ℝ (g x s) (deriv (fun r => g x r) s))‖ ≤ 2 * M * M' * |χ x|
      rw [(s1 x s (hball hs)).deriv]
      by_cases hx : x ∈ tsupport χ
      · have hz : (x, s) ∈ tsupport χ ×ˢ Metric.closedBall s₀ δ :=
          ⟨hx, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hs⟩
        have h1 : ‖g x s‖ ≤ M := hM (x, s) hz
        have h2 : ‖fderiv ℝ (↿g) (x, s) e‖ ≤ M' := hM' (x, s) hz
        have h3 := abs_real_inner_le_norm (g x s) (fderiv ℝ (↿g) (x, s) e)
        have h4 : ‖g x s‖ * ‖fderiv ℝ (↿g) (x, s) e‖ ≤ M * M' :=
          mul_le_mul h1 h2 (norm_nonneg _) (le_trans (norm_nonneg _) h1)
        simp only [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_two]
        have h5 : |χ x| * (2 * |inner ℝ (g x s) (fderiv ℝ (↿g) (x, s) e)|)
            ≤ |χ x| * (2 * (M * M')) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (abs_nonneg _)
        linarith
      · rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx]; simp
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x s hs => ?_)
      have hd := s1 x s (hball hs)
      have := (hd.norm_sq).const_mul (χ x)
      show HasDerivAt (fun s => χ x * ‖g x s‖ ^ 2)
        (χ x * (2 * inner ℝ (g x s) (deriv (fun r => g x r) s))) s
      rw [hd.deriv]
      exact this
  exact ⟨hA, hB, hC⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (φ : ℝ³ → ℝ) (w : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (c₁ R : ℝ), 0 < R → 0 ≤ c₁ → ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x ∧ φ x ≤ 1) → (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x‖ ≤ 8 * c₁ / R * φ x ^ 7) → ContDiff ℝ ∞ w → MemLp w 2 → |∫ x, (‖w x‖ ^ 2 / 2) * fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x (w x)| ≤ 4 * c₁ / R * ((∫ x, ‖w x‖ ^ 2) ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) * (∫ x, φ x ^ 24 * ‖w x‖ ^ 6) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4))

signature.name: transport_term_bound
signature.statement: ∀ (φ : ℝ³ → ℝ) (w : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (c₁ R : ℝ), 0 < R → 0 ≤ c₁ → ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x ∧ φ x ≤ 1) → (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x‖ ≤ 8 * c₁ / R * φ x ^ 7) → ContDiff ℝ ∞ w → MemLp w 2 → |∫ x, (‖w x‖ ^ 2 / 2) * fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x (w x)| ≤ 4 * c₁ / R * ((∫ x, ‖w x‖ ^ 2) ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) * (∫ x, φ x ^ 24 * ‖w x‖ ^ 6) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro φ w c₁ R hR hc₁ hφ hφS hφb hχd hw hwL
  have hφc : Continuous φ := hφ.continuous
  have hwc : Continuous w := hw.continuous
  have hk0 : 0 ≤ 4 * c₁ / R := div_nonneg (by positivity) hR.le
  
  have hcs : ∀ F : ℝ³ → ℝ, (∀ x, φ x = 0 → F x = 0) → HasCompactSupport F := by
    intro F hF
    apply hφS.mono
    intro x hx h0
    exact hx (hF x h0)
  
  have CS : ∀ g : ℝ³ → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) →
      ∫ x, ‖w x‖ * g x ≤ (∫ x, ‖w x‖ ^ 2) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * (∫ x, g x ^ 2) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := by
    intro g hgc hgS hg0
    have h := MeasureTheory.integral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq_of_nonneg (μ := volume)
      Real.HolderConjugate.two_two
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => norm_nonneg (w x)))
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hg0)
      (by rw [ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat]; exact hwL.norm)
      (hgc.memLp_of_hasCompactSupport hgS)
    simpa only [Real.rpow_two] using h
  
  have chain : ∀ (S X Y Z : ℝ), 0 ≤ S → 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ Z →
      Y ≤ S ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * Z ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) → Z ≤ S ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * X ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) →
      Y ≤ S ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) * X ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4) := by
    intro S X Y Z hS hX hZ h1 h2
    have a : Z ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ≤ (S ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * X ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow hZ h2 (by norm_num)
    have q : (1 : ℝ) / 2 * ((1 : ℝ) / 2) = (1 : ℝ) / 4 := by norm_num
    rw [Real.mul_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hS _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hX _), ← Real.rpow_mul hS,
      ← Real.rpow_mul hX, q] at a
    have e : S ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) = S ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * S ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add' hS (by norm_num)]; norm_num
    calc Y ≤ S ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * Z ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := h1
      _ ≤ S ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * (S ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4) * X ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a (Real.rpow_nonneg hS _)
      _ = S ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) * X ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4) := by rw [e, mul_assoc]
  
  have hpt : ∀ x, ‖(‖w x‖ ^ 2 / 2) * fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x (w x)‖
      ≤ 4 * c₁ / R * (φ x ^ 6 * ‖w x‖ ^ 3) := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hφb x
    have hL := (fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x).le_opNorm (w x)
    have hd := hχd x
    have hp : φ x ^ 7 ≤ φ x ^ 6 := pow_le_pow_of_le_one h0 h1 (by norm_num)
    have ha := norm_nonneg (w x)
    rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs (‖w x‖ ^ 2 / 2), abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    calc ‖w x‖ ^ 2 / 2 * ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x (w x)‖
        ≤ ‖w x‖ ^ 2 / 2 * (‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x‖ * ‖w x‖) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hL (by positivity)
      _ ≤ ‖w x‖ ^ 2 / 2 * ((8 * c₁ / R * φ x ^ 7) * ‖w x‖) := by gcongr
      _ = 4 * c₁ / R * (φ x ^ 7 * ‖w x‖ ^ 3) := by ring
      _ ≤ 4 * c₁ / R * (φ x ^ 6 * ‖w x‖ ^ 3) := by gcongr
  
  have hg0c : Continuous (fun x => 4 * c₁ / R * (φ x ^ 6 * ‖w x‖ ^ 3)) := by fun_prop
  have hint : Integrable (fun x => 4 * c₁ / R * (φ x ^ 6 * ‖w x‖ ^ 3)) :=
    hg0c.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hcs _ (fun x h => by simp [h]))
  have hY : |∫ x, (‖w x‖ ^ 2 / 2) * fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x (w x)|
      ≤ ∫ x, 4 * c₁ / R * (φ x ^ 6 * ‖w x‖ ^ 3) := by
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hint (ae_of_all _ hpt)
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hY
  
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x, ‖w x‖ ^ 2 := integral_nonneg (fun x => by positivity)
  have hX0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x, φ x ^ 24 * ‖w x‖ ^ 6 :=
    integral_nonneg (fun x => by have := (hφb x).1; positivity)
  have hZ0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x, φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 4 :=
    integral_nonneg (fun x => by have := (hφb x).1; positivity)
  have h1 : (∫ x, φ x ^ 6 * ‖w x‖ ^ 3)
      ≤ (∫ x, ‖w x‖ ^ 2) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * (∫ x, φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 4) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := by
    have h := CS (fun x => φ x ^ 6 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2) (by fun_prop) (hcs _ (fun x h => by simp [h]))
      (fun x => by have := (hφb x).1; positivity)
    have e1 : (∫ x, φ x ^ 6 * ‖w x‖ ^ 3) = ∫ x, ‖w x‖ * (φ x ^ 6 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2) := by
      congr 1; funext x; ring
    have e2 : (∫ x, φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 4) = ∫ x, (φ x ^ 6 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
      congr 1; funext x; ring
    rw [e1, e2]; exact h
  have h2 : (∫ x, φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 4)
      ≤ (∫ x, ‖w x‖ ^ 2) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * (∫ x, φ x ^ 24 * ‖w x‖ ^ 6) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := by
    have h := CS (fun x => φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 3) (by fun_prop) (hcs _ (fun x h => by simp [h]))
      (fun x => by have := (hφb x).1; positivity)
    have e1 : (∫ x, φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 4) = ∫ x, ‖w x‖ * (φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 3) := by
      congr 1; funext x; ring
    have e2 : (∫ x, φ x ^ 24 * ‖w x‖ ^ 6) = ∫ x, (φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 3) ^ 2 := by
      congr 1; funext x; ring
    rw [e1, e2]; exact h
  
  have hYX := chain _ _ _ _ hS0 hX0 hZ0 h1 h2
  exact hY.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hYX hk0)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (ν c : ℝ) (w u D : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (π q χ : ℝ³ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ w → ContDiff ℝ ∞ u → ContDiff ℝ ∞ π → ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ → HasCompactSupport χ → (∀ x, divergence w x = 0) → (∀ x, divergence u x = 0) → (∀ x, fderiv ℝ χ x (u x) = 0) → (∀ x, π x = q x + c) → (∀ x, D x + fderiv ℝ w x (w x + u x) + fderiv ℝ u x (w x) = ν • Δ w x - gradient π x) → ∫ x, χ x * (2 * inner ℝ (w x) (D x)) = 2 * ((∫ x, (‖w x‖ ^ 2 / 2) * fderiv ℝ χ x (w x)) + (∫ x, q x * inner ℝ (w x) (gradient χ x)) - ν * (∫ x, ∑ j : Fin 3, inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w x) * fderiv ℝ χ x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) - ν * (∫ x, χ x * ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖ ^ 2) - (∫ x, χ x * inner ℝ (w x) (fderiv ℝ u x (w x))))

signature.name: localized_energy_identity
signature.statement: ∀ (ν c : ℝ) (w u D : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (π q χ : ℝ³ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ w → ContDiff ℝ ∞ u → ContDiff ℝ ∞ π → ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ → HasCompactSupport χ → (∀ x, divergence w x = 0) → (∀ x, divergence u x = 0) → (∀ x, fderiv ℝ χ x (u x) = 0) → (∀ x, π x = q x + c) → (∀ x, D x + fderiv ℝ w x (w x + u x) + fderiv ℝ u x (w x) = ν • Δ w x - gradient π x) → ∫ x, χ x * (2 * inner ℝ (w x) (D x)) = 2 * ((∫ x, (‖w x‖ ^ 2 / 2) * fderiv ℝ χ x (w x)) + (∫ x, q x * inner ℝ (w x) (gradient χ x)) - ν * (∫ x, ∑ j : Fin 3, inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w x) * fderiv ℝ χ x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) - ν * (∫ x, χ x * ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖ ^ 2) - (∫ x, χ x * inner ℝ (w x) (fderiv ℝ u x (w x))))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ν c w u D π q χ hw hu hπ hχ hχS hdivw hdivu hχu hπq hD
  
  have hχ1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 χ := hχ.of_le (by simp)
  have hw1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 w := hw.of_le (by simp)
  have hu1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 u := hu.of_le (by simp)
  have hπ1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 π := hπ.of_le (by simp)
  have hDw1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ w) := hw.fderiv_right (by simp)
  have hχd : Differentiable ℝ χ := hχ1.differentiable one_ne_zero
  have hDχc : Continuous (fderiv ℝ χ) := hχ1.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero
  have hDwc : ∀ j : Fin 3, Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) :=
    fun j => (hw1.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hqeq : q = fun x => π x - c := funext fun x => by rw [hπq x]; ring
  have hqc : Continuous q := by rw [hqeq]; exact hπ.continuous.sub continuous_const
  
  have hsuppD : ∀ G : ℝ³ → ℝ, (∀ x, fderiv ℝ χ x = 0 → G x = 0) → HasCompactSupport G := by
    intro G hG
    apply hχS.mono'
    intro x hx
    apply support_fderiv_subset ℝ
    exact Function.mem_support.mpr (fun h0 => (Function.mem_support.mp hx) (hG x h0))
  have intχ : ∀ g : ℝ³ → ℝ, Continuous g → Integrable (fun x => χ x * g x) := fun g hg =>
    (hχ1.continuous.mul hg).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hχS.mul_right
  have intD : ∀ (g : ℝ³ → ℝ) (v : ℝ³ → ℝ³), Continuous g → Continuous v →
      Integrable (fun x => g x * fderiv ℝ χ x (v x)) := by
    intro g v hg hv
    refine (hg.mul (hDχc.clm_apply hv)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hsuppD _ ?_)
    intro x h0
    simp [h0]
  
  have hsum : ∀ v : ℝ³, ∑ k : Fin 3, v k • EuclideanSpace.single k (1:ℝ) = v := fun v => by
    have h := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr v
    simpa [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply] using h
  
  have ibp : ∀ Φ : ℝ³ → ℝ³, ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ →
      Integrable (fun x => χ x * divergence Φ x) ∧
        ∫ x, χ x * divergence Φ x = -∫ x, fderiv ℝ χ x (Φ x) := by
    intro Φ hΦ
    have hΦd : Differentiable ℝ Φ := hΦ.differentiable one_ne_zero
    have hcoordC : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun y => Φ y k) := fun k =>
      (EuclideanSpace.proj k : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp hΦ
    have hfd : ∀ k : Fin 3, ∀ x, fderiv ℝ (fun y => Φ y k) x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)
        = (fderiv ℝ Φ x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) k := by
      intro k x
      have h : HasFDerivAt (fun y => Φ y k)
          ((EuclideanSpace.proj k : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp (fderiv ℝ Φ x)) x :=
        (EuclideanSpace.proj k : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp x (hΦd x).hasFDerivAt
      rw [h.fderiv]
      rfl
    have hdiv : ∀ x, divergence Φ x
        = ∑ k : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun y => Φ y k) x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) := by
      intro x
      unfold divergence
      rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_sum_inner _ (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      rw [hfd k x, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
      simp
    have hexp : ∀ x, fderiv ℝ χ x (Φ x)
        = ∑ k : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ χ x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) * Φ x k := by
      intro x
      conv_lhs => rw [← hsum (Φ x)]
      rw [map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
    have hk : ∀ k : Fin 3,
        Integrable (fun x => χ x * fderiv ℝ (fun y => Φ y k) x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) ∧
        Integrable (fun x => fderiv ℝ χ x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) * Φ x k) ∧
        ∫ x, χ x * fderiv ℝ (fun y => Φ y k) x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)
          = -∫ x, fderiv ℝ χ x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) * Φ x k := by
      intro k
      have hc1 : Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => Φ y k) x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) :=
        ((hcoordC k).continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
      have I1 := intχ _ hc1
      have I2 : Integrable (fun x => fderiv ℝ χ x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) * Φ x k) := by
        have := intD (fun x => Φ x k) (fun _ => EuclideanSpace.single k 1)
          (hcoordC k).continuous continuous_const
        exact this.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => mul_comm _ _))
      have I3 := intχ _ (hcoordC k).continuous
      refine ⟨I1, I2, ?_⟩
      exact integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable I2 I1 I3
        (fun x _ => hχd x) (fun x _ => (hcoordC k).differentiable one_ne_zero x)
    have hP : (fun x => χ x * divergence Φ x)
        = fun x => ∑ k : Fin 3, χ x * fderiv ℝ (fun y => Φ y k) x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) := by
      funext x
      rw [hdiv x, Finset.mul_sum]
    have hE : (fun x => fderiv ℝ χ x (Φ x))
        = fun x => ∑ k : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ χ x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) * Φ x k := funext hexp
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hP]
      exact integrable_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => (hk k).1)
    · rw [hP, hE, integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => (hk k).1),
        integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => (hk k).2.1), ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => (hk k).2.2)
  
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩ : ∃ Ψ : ℝ³ → ℝ³, Ψ = fun y => (‖w y‖ ^ 2 / 2) • (w y + u y) + π y • w y
      - ν • ∑ j : Fin 3, (inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w y (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w y))
          • EuclideanSpace.single j 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΨ1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 Ψ := by
    have h3 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun y => ∑ j : Fin 3, (inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w y
        (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w y)) • (EuclideanSpace.single j 1 : ℝ³)) := by
      apply ContDiff.sum
      intro j _
      exact ((hDw1.clm_apply contDiff_const).inner ℝ hw1).smul contDiff_const
    rw [hΨ]
    exact ((((hw1.norm_sq ℝ).div_const 2).smul (hw1.add hu1)).add (hπ1.smul hw1)).sub
      (h3.const_smul ν)
  
  have eflux : ∀ (V w : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (q : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³), ContDiff ℝ ∞ V → ContDiff ℝ ∞ w →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ q → inner ℝ (w x) (-(fderiv ℝ w x (V x)) + ν • Δ w x - gradient q x)
        = -divergence (fun y => (‖w y‖ ^ 2 / 2) • V y + q y • w y - ν • ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w y (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w y)) • EuclideanSpace.single j 1) x
          - ν * ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖ ^ 2
          + (‖w x‖ ^ 2 / 2) * divergence V x + q x * divergence w x := by
    intro V w q x hV hw hq
    have hVd : Differentiable ℝ V := hV.differentiable (by simp)
    have hwd : Differentiable ℝ w := hw.differentiable (by simp)
    have hqd : Differentiable ℝ q := hq.differentiable (by simp)
    have hD1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ w) := hw.fderiv_right (by simp)
    have hDd : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) := hD1.differentiable (by simp)
    have c1 : ∀ (a : ℝ³ → ℝ) (F : ℝ³ → ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ a x → DifferentiableAt ℝ F x →
        divergence (fun y => a y • F y) x = fderiv ℝ a x (F x) + a x * divergence F x := by
      intro a F ha hF
      unfold divergence
      rw [fderiv_fun_smul ha hF]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_add, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_smul,
        ContinuousLinearMap.coe_smulRight, map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.trace_smulRight, smul_eq_mul,
        ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe]
      ring
    have c2 : ∀ (c : Fin 3 → ℝ³ → ℝ), (∀ j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (c j) x) →
        divergence (fun y => ∑ j : Fin 3, c j y • EuclideanSpace.single j (1:ℝ)) x
          = ∑ j : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (c j) x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) := by
      intro c hc
      unfold divergence
      rw [fderiv_fun_sum (A := fun j y => c j y • EuclideanSpace.single j (1:ℝ))
        (fun j _ => (hc j).smul_const _)]
      have h : ∀ j, fderiv ℝ (fun y => c j y • EuclideanSpace.single j (1:ℝ)) x
          = (fderiv ℝ (c j) x).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single j (1:ℝ)) :=
        fun j => fderiv_smul_const (hc j) _
      simp only [h, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_sum, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_smulRight, map_sum,
        LinearMap.trace_smulRight, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe]
    have c6 : ∀ (A B C : ℝ³ → ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ A x → DifferentiableAt ℝ B x →
        DifferentiableAt ℝ C x →
        divergence (fun y => A y + B y - ν • C y) x
          = divergence A x + divergence B x - ν * divergence C x := by
      intro A B C hA hB hC
      unfold divergence
      have hAB : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => A y + B y) x := hA.add hB
      have hνC : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ν • C y) x := hC.const_smul ν
      rw [fderiv_fun_sub hAB hνC, fderiv_fun_add hA hB, fderiv_fun_const_smul hC ν]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_sub, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_add,
        ContinuousLinearMap.coe_smul, map_sub, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have c4 : ∀ h : ℝ³, fderiv ℝ (fun y => ‖w y‖ ^ 2 / 2) x h = inner ℝ (w x) (fderiv ℝ w x h) := by
      intro h
      have H : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ‖w y‖ ^ 2 * 2⁻¹)
          ((2⁻¹ : ℝ) • (2 • (innerSL ℝ (w x)).comp (fderiv ℝ w x))) x :=
        ((hwd x).hasFDerivAt.norm_sq).mul_const _
      have e : (fun y => ‖w y‖ ^ 2 / 2) = fun y => ‖w y‖ ^ 2 * 2⁻¹ := by
        funext y; ring
      rw [e, H.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
        innerSL_apply_apply, smul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have c5 : ∀ u h : ℝ³, fderiv ℝ (fun y => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w y u) (w y)) x h
        = inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y u) x h) (w x)
          + inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w x u) (fderiv ℝ w x h) := by
      intro u h
      have hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y u) x :=
        (hDd x).clm_apply (differentiableAt_const u)
      rw [fderiv_inner_apply ℝ hf (hwd x) h]
      ring
    have c3 : Δ w x = ∑ j : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) x
        (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) := by
      rw [congrFun (InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_orthonormalBasis w
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)) x]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply (hDd x) (differentiableAt_const _)]
      simp
    have hcj : ∀ j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun y => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w y (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w y)) x :=
      fun j => ((hDd x).clm_apply (differentiableAt_const _)).inner ℝ (hwd x)
    have hN : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ‖w y‖ ^ 2 / 2) x :=
      (((hw.of_le (by simp) : ContDiff ℝ 1 w).norm_sq ℝ).div_const 2).differentiable (by simp) x
    have hA : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (‖w y‖ ^ 2 / 2) • V y) x := hN.smul (hVd x)
    have hB : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => q y • w y) x := (hqd x).smul (hwd x)
    have hC : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w y (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w y)) • EuclideanSpace.single j (1:ℝ)) x := by
      exact DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun j _ => (hcj j).smul_const _)
    have hgq : fderiv ℝ q x (w x) = inner ℝ (gradient q x) (w x) := (inner_gradient_left).symm
    rw [c6 _ _ _ hA hB hC, c1 _ _ hN (hVd x), c1 _ _ (hqd x) (hwd x), c2 _ hcj, c4, hgq]
    simp only [c5]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← sum_inner, ← c3]
    simp only [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, inner_add_right, inner_sub_right, inner_neg_right,
      real_inner_smul_right]
    rw [real_inner_comm (w x) (gradient q x), real_inner_comm (w x) (Δ w x)]
    ring
  
  have hpt : ∀ x, inner ℝ (w x) (D x) = -divergence Ψ x
      - ν * ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖ ^ 2
      - inner ℝ (w x) (fderiv ℝ u x (w x)) := by
    intro x
    have hflux := eflux (fun y => w y + u y) w π x (hw.add hu) hw hπ
    have hdivwu : divergence (fun y => w y + u y) x = 0 := by
      rw [divergence_add (hw1.differentiable one_ne_zero x) (hu1.differentiable one_ne_zero x),
        hdivw x, hdivu x, add_zero]
    have hDx : D x = (-(fderiv ℝ w x (w x + u x)) + ν • Δ w x - gradient π x)
        - fderiv ℝ u x (w x) := by
      have h := hD x
      calc D x = (D x + fderiv ℝ w x (w x + u x) + fderiv ℝ u x (w x))
            - fderiv ℝ w x (w x + u x) - fderiv ℝ u x (w x) := by abel
        _ = _ := by rw [h]; abel
    have hflux' : inner ℝ (w x) (-(fderiv ℝ w x (w x + u x)) + ν • Δ w x - gradient π x)
        = -divergence Ψ x - ν * ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖ ^ 2
          + (‖w x‖ ^ 2 / 2) * divergence (fun y => w y + u y) x + π x * divergence w x := by
      rw [hΨ]
      exact hflux
    rw [hDx, inner_sub_right, hflux', hdivwu, hdivw x]
    ring
  
  have hgradχ : ∀ x, inner ℝ (w x) (gradient χ x) = fderiv ℝ χ x (w x) := fun x => by
    rw [real_inner_comm, inner_gradient_left]
  have hQ : ∀ x, fderiv ℝ χ x (Ψ x) = (‖w x‖ ^ 2 / 2) * fderiv ℝ χ x (w x)
      + q x * inner ℝ (w x) (gradient χ x) + c * fderiv ℝ χ x (w x)
      - ν * ∑ j : Fin 3, inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w x)
          * fderiv ℝ χ x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) := by
    intro x
    rw [hΨ, hgradχ x]
    simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_smul, map_sum, smul_eq_mul, hχu x, hπq x]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨IΨ, eqΨ⟩ := ibp Ψ hΨ1
  have Zw : ∫ x, fderiv ℝ χ x (w x) = 0 := by
    have h := (ibp w hw1).2
    simp only [hdivw, mul_zero, integral_zero] at h
    linarith
  
  have IS : Integrable (fun x => χ x * ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖ ^ 2) :=
    intχ _ (continuous_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => ((hDwc j).norm).pow 2))
  have IL : Integrable (fun x => χ x * inner ℝ (w x) (fderiv ℝ u x (w x))) :=
    intχ _ (hw.continuous.inner ((hu1.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply hw.continuous))
  have Itr : Integrable (fun x => (‖w x‖ ^ 2 / 2) * fderiv ℝ χ x (w x)) :=
    intD (fun x => ‖w x‖ ^ 2 / 2) w ((hw.continuous.norm.pow 2).div_const 2) hw.continuous
  have Ip : Integrable (fun x => q x * inner ℝ (w x) (gradient χ x)) := by
    have := intD q w hqc hw.continuous
    refine this.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_))
    simp only [hgradχ x]
  have Ic : Integrable (fun x => c * fderiv ℝ χ x (w x)) :=
    intD (fun _ => c) w continuous_const hw.continuous
  have Iv : Integrable (fun x => ∑ j : Fin 3, inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w x)
      * fderiv ℝ χ x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) :=
    integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => intD (fun x => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w x
      (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w x)) (fun _ => EuclideanSpace.single j 1)
      ((hDwc j).inner hw.continuous) continuous_const)
  
  have hL : (fun x => χ x * (2 * inner ℝ (w x) (D x)))
      = fun x => (-2) * (χ x * divergence Ψ x)
        - (2 * ν) * (χ x * ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖ ^ 2)
        - 2 * (χ x * inner ℝ (w x) (fderiv ℝ u x (w x))) := by
    funext x
    rw [hpt x]
    ring
  have I1 : Integrable (fun x => (-2) * (χ x * divergence Ψ x)
      - (2 * ν) * (χ x * ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖ ^ 2)) :=
    (IΨ.const_mul _).sub (IS.const_mul _)
  have e1 : ∫ x, χ x * (2 * inner ℝ (w x) (D x))
      = (-2) * (∫ x, χ x * divergence Ψ x)
        - (2 * ν) * (∫ x, χ x * ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖ ^ 2)
        - 2 * (∫ x, χ x * inner ℝ (w x) (fderiv ℝ u x (w x))) := by
    rw [hL, integral_sub I1 (IL.const_mul _), integral_sub (IΨ.const_mul _) (IS.const_mul _),
      integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
  have hR : (fun x => fderiv ℝ χ x (Ψ x)) = fun x => (‖w x‖ ^ 2 / 2) * fderiv ℝ χ x (w x)
      + q x * inner ℝ (w x) (gradient χ x) + c * fderiv ℝ χ x (w x)
      - ν * ∑ j : Fin 3, inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w x)
          * fderiv ℝ χ x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) := funext hQ
  have I12 : Integrable (fun x => (‖w x‖ ^ 2 / 2) * fderiv ℝ χ x (w x)
      + q x * inner ℝ (w x) (gradient χ x)) := Itr.add Ip
  have I123 : Integrable (fun x => (‖w x‖ ^ 2 / 2) * fderiv ℝ χ x (w x)
      + q x * inner ℝ (w x) (gradient χ x) + c * fderiv ℝ χ x (w x)) := I12.add Ic
  have e2 : ∫ x, fderiv ℝ χ x (Ψ x)
      = (∫ x, (‖w x‖ ^ 2 / 2) * fderiv ℝ χ x (w x)) + (∫ x, q x * inner ℝ (w x) (gradient χ x))
        + c * (∫ x, fderiv ℝ χ x (w x))
        - ν * (∫ x, ∑ j : Fin 3, inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w x)
          * fderiv ℝ χ x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) := by
    rw [hR, integral_sub I123 (Iv.const_mul ν), integral_add I12 Ic, integral_add Itr Ip,
      integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
  rw [e1, eqΨ, e2, Zw]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (φ : ℝ³ → ℝ) (w : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (c₁ R ν : ℝ), 0 < R → 0 ≤ ν → ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x ∧ φ x ≤ 1) → (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x‖ ≤ 8 * c₁ / R * φ x ^ 7) → ContDiff ℝ ∞ w → MemLp w 2 → |ν * ∫ x, ∑ j : Fin 3, inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w x) * fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)| ≤ ν * ((1 / 4) * (∫ x, φ x ^ 8 * ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖ ^ 2) + 192 * c₁ ^ 2 / R ^ 2 * ∫ x, ‖w x‖ ^ 2)

signature.name: viscous_cross_term_bound
signature.statement: ∀ (φ : ℝ³ → ℝ) (w : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (c₁ R ν : ℝ), 0 < R → 0 ≤ ν → ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x ∧ φ x ≤ 1) → (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x‖ ≤ 8 * c₁ / R * φ x ^ 7) → ContDiff ℝ ∞ w → MemLp w 2 → |ν * ∫ x, ∑ j : Fin 3, inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w x) * fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)| ≤ ν * ((1 / 4) * (∫ x, φ x ^ 8 * ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖ ^ 2) + 192 * c₁ ^ 2 / R ^ 2 * ∫ x, ‖w x‖ ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro φ w c₁ R ν hR hν hφC hφS hφb hχd hwC hw2
  
  have hterm : ∀ (x : ℝ³) (j : Fin 3),
      |inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w x) *
          fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)| ≤
        (1 / 4) * φ x ^ 8 * ‖fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖ ^ 2 +
          64 * c₁ ^ 2 / R ^ 2 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro x j
    have ha₀ : 0 ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hN : 0 ≤ ‖w x‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hp0 : 0 ≤ φ x := (hφb x).1
    have hp1 : φ x ≤ 1 := (hφb x).2
    have hin : |inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w x)| ≤
        ‖fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖ * ‖w x‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
    have hsingle : ‖(EuclideanSpace.single j (1:ℝ) : ℝ³)‖ = 1 := by simp
    have hD : |fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)| ≤
        8 * c₁ / R * φ x ^ 7 := by
      rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖
          ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x‖ * ‖(EuclideanSpace.single j (1:ℝ) : ℝ³)‖ :=
            ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
        _ = ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x‖ := by rw [hsingle, mul_one]
        _ ≤ 8 * c₁ / R * φ x ^ 7 := hχd x
    have h1 : |inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w x) *
          fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)| ≤
        ‖fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖ * ‖w x‖ * (8 * c₁ / R * φ x ^ 7) := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul hin hD (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg ha₀ hN)
    have alg : ∀ a N p k : ℝ, 0 ≤ p → p ≤ 1 →
        a * N * (k * p ^ 7) ≤ (1 / 4) * p ^ 8 * a ^ 2 + k ^ 2 * N ^ 2 := by
      intro a N p k hp0 hp1
      have h2 : a * N * (k * p ^ 7) ≤ (1 / 4) * p ^ 8 * a ^ 2 + k ^ 2 * p ^ 6 * N ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p ^ 4 * a / 2 - k * p ^ 3 * N)]
      have hp6 : p ^ 6 ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hp0 hp1
      have hkN : 0 ≤ k ^ 2 * N ^ 2 := by positivity
      have h3 : k ^ 2 * p ^ 6 * N ^ 2 ≤ k ^ 2 * N ^ 2 := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp6 hkN
        nlinarith
      linarith
    have hk : (8 * c₁ / R) ^ 2 = 64 * c₁ ^ 2 / R ^ 2 := by
      rw [div_pow]; ring
    have := alg ‖fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖ ‖w x‖ (φ x) (8 * c₁ / R) hp0 hp1
    rw [hk] at this
    linarith
  
  have hpt : ∀ x : ℝ³,
      |∑ j : Fin 3, inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w x) *
          fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)| ≤
        (1 / 4) * (φ x ^ 8 * ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖ ^ 2) +
          192 * c₁ ^ 2 / R ^ 2 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans
      ((Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hterm x j)).trans (le_of_eq ?_))
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have hA : Integrable (fun x : ℝ³ =>
      φ x ^ 8 * ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖ ^ 2) := by
    apply Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
    · have hfd : Continuous (fderiv ℝ w) := hwC.continuous_fderiv (by simp)
      refine (hφC.continuous.pow 8).mul ?_
      refine continuous_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => ?_)
      exact ((hfd.clm_apply continuous_const).norm).pow 2
    · have h8 : HasCompactSupport (fun x => φ x ^ 8) :=
        hφS.comp_left (g := fun t : ℝ => t ^ 8) (by norm_num)
      exact h8.mul_right
        (f' := fun x => ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖ ^ 2)
  have hB : Integrable (fun x : ℝ³ => ‖w x‖ ^ 2) :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hw2.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hw2
  have hg : Integrable (fun x : ℝ³ =>
      (1 / 4) * (φ x ^ 8 * ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)‖ ^ 2) +
        192 * c₁ ^ 2 / R ^ 2 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2) :=
    (hA.const_mul _).add (hB.const_mul _)
  
  have hmono := integral_mono_of_nonneg
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => abs_nonneg
      (∑ j : Fin 3, inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (w x) *
          fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)))) hg
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpt)
  rw [integral_add (hA.const_mul _) (hB.const_mul _), integral_const_mul,
    integral_const_mul] at hmono
  
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hν]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hν
  exact (abs_integral_le_integral_abs).trans hmono

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (χ : ℝ³ → ℝ) (w u : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (L : ℝ), Continuous χ → HasCompactSupport χ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x) → ContDiff ℝ ∞ w → ContDiff ℝ ∞ u → (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ u x‖ ≤ L) → |∫ x, χ x * inner ℝ (w x) (fderiv ℝ u x (w x))| ≤ L * ∫ x, χ x * ‖w x‖ ^ 2

signature.name: linear_term_bound
signature.statement: ∀ (χ : ℝ³ → ℝ) (w u : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (L : ℝ), Continuous χ → HasCompactSupport χ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x) → ContDiff ℝ ∞ w → ContDiff ℝ ∞ u → (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ u x‖ ≤ L) → |∫ x, χ x * inner ℝ (w x) (fderiv ℝ u x (w x))| ≤ L * ∫ x, χ x * ‖w x‖ ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro χ w u L hχc hχs hχ0 hw hu hL
  have hwc : Continuous w := hw.continuous
  have hgc : Continuous (fun x => L * (χ x * ‖w x‖ ^ 2)) :=
    continuous_const.mul (hχc.mul (hwc.norm.pow 2))
  have hgs : HasCompactSupport (fun x => L * (χ x * ‖w x‖ ^ 2)) :=
    (hχs.mul_right (f' := fun x => ‖w x‖ ^ 2)).mul_left
  have hgi : Integrable (fun x => L * (χ x * ‖w x‖ ^ 2)) :=
    hgc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hgs
  have hpt : ∀ x, ‖χ x * inner ℝ (w x) (fderiv ℝ u x (w x))‖ ≤ L * (χ x * ‖w x‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hχ0 x)]
    have h1 : |inner ℝ (w x) (fderiv ℝ u x (w x))| ≤ ‖w x‖ * ‖fderiv ℝ u x (w x)‖ :=
      abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
    have h2 : ‖fderiv ℝ u x (w x)‖ ≤ L * ‖w x‖ :=
      le_trans ((fderiv ℝ u x).le_opNorm (w x))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hL x) (norm_nonneg _))
    have h3 : ‖w x‖ * ‖fderiv ℝ u x (w x)‖ ≤ ‖w x‖ * (L * ‖w x‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (norm_nonneg _)
    calc χ x * |inner ℝ (w x) (fderiv ℝ u x (w x))|
        ≤ χ x * (‖w x‖ * (L * ‖w x‖)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_trans h1 h3) (hχ0 x)
      _ = L * (χ x * ‖w x‖ ^ 2) := by ring
  have hmain := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hgi (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpt)
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hmain
  rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact hmain

by
  intro ν c₁ C₀ C K L R E a X S Jtr Jp Jvc Jlin hν hc₁ hR ha hX hS hSC h8 h9 h10 h11 h12 h13
  have hRpos : 0 < R := by linarith
  
  have s1 : a ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) ≤ 1 + a := by
    rcases le_total a 1 with h | h
    · have := Real.rpow_le_one ha h (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 3 / 4)
      linarith
    · have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h (by norm_num : (3:ℝ) / 4 ≤ 1)
      rw [Real.rpow_one] at this
      linarith
  
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ X ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 6) := Real.rpow_nonneg hX _
  have hy2 : (X ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 6)) ^ 2 = X ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hX]; norm_num
  have hs2 : (a ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) ^ 2 = a := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul ha]; norm_num
  have hq : X ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4) ≤ 1 + X ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
    have h3 : 0 ≤ X ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := Real.rpow_nonneg hX _
    rcases le_total X 1 with h | h
    · have := Real.rpow_le_one hX h (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4)
      linarith
    · have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) / 4 ≤ 1 / 3)
      linarith
  have hyK : (X ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 6)) ^ 2 ≤ (K * (1 + a ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2))) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ hy0 h8 2
  have hK2 : (K * (1 + a ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2))) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * K ^ 2 * (1 + a) := by
    set s := a ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) with hs
    have e1 : K ^ 2 * s ^ 2 = K ^ 2 * a := by rw [hs2]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg K) (sq_nonneg (s - 1)), e1]
  have hQ : X ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4) ≤ 1 + 2 * K ^ 2 * (1 + a) := by linarith
  
  have hP : S ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) ≤ C₀ ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) := Real.rpow_le_rpow hS hSC (by norm_num)
  have hS34 : 0 ≤ S ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) := Real.rpow_nonneg hS _
  have hX14 : 0 ≤ X ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4) := Real.rpow_nonneg hX _
  have hPQ : S ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) * X ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4)
      ≤ C₀ ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) * (1 + 2 * K ^ 2 * (1 + a)) :=
    mul_le_mul hP hQ hX14 (le_trans hS34 hP)
  have hc : 0 ≤ 4 * c₁ / R := by positivity
  have hTr : Jtr ≤ 4 * c₁ / R * (C₀ ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) * (1 + 2 * K ^ 2 * (1 + a))) :=
    le_trans (le_abs_self _) (le_trans h9 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hPQ hc))
  
  have hM : C ≤ max C 0 := le_max_left _ _
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ max C 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have ha34 : 0 ≤ a ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) := Real.rpow_nonneg ha _
  have hPr : Jp ≤ max C 0 / R * (2 + a) := by
    have h1 : C / R * (1 + a ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4)) ≤ max C 0 / R * (1 + a ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4)) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by linarith)
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hM hRpos.le
    have h2 : max C 0 / R * (1 + a ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4)) ≤ max C 0 / R * (2 + a) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by positivity)
    linarith [le_abs_self Jp]
  
  have hV : -Jvc ≤ ν * ((1 / 4) * a + 192 * c₁ ^ 2 * C₀ / R) := by
    have h1 : 192 * c₁ ^ 2 / R ^ 2 * S ≤ 192 * c₁ ^ 2 * C₀ / R := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hRpos]
      have hc2 : 0 ≤ 192 * c₁ ^ 2 := by positivity
      have hC0 : 0 ≤ C₀ := le_trans hS hSC
      have a1 : 192 * c₁ ^ 2 * S ≤ 192 * c₁ ^ 2 * C₀ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSC hc2
      have a2 : R ≤ R ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      calc 192 * c₁ ^ 2 * S * R ≤ 192 * c₁ ^ 2 * C₀ * R :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right a1 hRpos.le
        _ ≤ 192 * c₁ ^ 2 * C₀ * R ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a2 (by positivity)
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add_left h1 ((1 / 4) * a)) hν.le
    linarith [neg_le_abs Jvc]
  
  have hLin : -Jlin ≤ L * E := le_trans (neg_le_abs Jlin) h12
  
  have h3ν : 0 < 3 * ν := by linarith
  have hZ : 4 * (8 * c₁ * C₀ ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) * K ^ 2 + max C 0) ≤ R * (3 * ν) :=
    (div_le_iff₀ h3ν).mp h13
  have hZa : (8 * c₁ * C₀ ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) * K ^ 2 + max C 0) / R * a ≤ 3 * ν / 4 * a := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ ha
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hRpos]; linarith
  
  have e1 : 4 * c₁ / R * (C₀ ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) * (1 + 2 * K ^ 2 * (1 + a)))
      + max C 0 / R * (2 + a) + ν * ((1 / 4) * a + 192 * c₁ ^ 2 * C₀ / R)
      = (4 * c₁ * C₀ ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) * (1 + 2 * K ^ 2) + 2 * max C 0
          + 192 * ν * c₁ ^ 2 * C₀) / R
        + (8 * c₁ * C₀ ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) * K ^ 2 + max C 0) / R * a + ν * (1 / 4) * a := by
    field_simp
    ring
  have e2 : 2 * (4 * c₁ * C₀ ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) * (1 + 2 * K ^ 2) + 2 * max C 0
      + 192 * ν * c₁ ^ 2 * C₀) / R = 2 * ((4 * c₁ * C₀ ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) * (1 + 2 * K ^ 2)
      + 2 * max C 0 + 192 * ν * c₁ ^ 2 * C₀) / R) := by ring
  rw [e2]

proof.tactics:

  intro f a b hf hae t0 ht0
  by_contra hpos
  push_neg at hpos

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (E E' : ℝ → ℝ) (T α β : ℝ), 0 ≤ α → 0 ≤ β → ContinuousOn E (Icc 0 T) → (∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 T, HasDerivAt E (E' s) s) → (∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 T, E' s ≤ α * E s + β) → E 0 ≤ 0 → ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 T, E s ≤ β * T * Real.exp (α * T)

signature.name: linear_gronwall_bound
signature.statement: ∀ (E E' : ℝ → ℝ) (T α β : ℝ), 0 ≤ α → 0 ≤ β → ContinuousOn E (Icc 0 T) → (∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 T, HasDerivAt E (E' s) s) → (∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 T, E' s ≤ α * E s + β) → E 0 ≤ 0 → ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 T, E s ≤ β * T * Real.exp (α * T)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro E E' T α β hα hβ hcont hderiv hle h0 s hs
  set G : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => Real.exp (-(α * r)) * E r - β * r with hGdef
  set G' : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => Real.exp (-(α * r)) * (-(α * 1)) * E r
    + Real.exp (-(α * r)) * E' r - β * 1 with hG'def
  have hGc : ContinuousOn G (Icc 0 T) := by
    have h1 : Continuous (fun r : ℝ => Real.exp (-(α * r))) := by fun_prop
    have h2 : Continuous (fun r : ℝ => β * r) := by fun_prop
    exact (h1.continuousOn.mul hcont).sub h2.continuousOn
  have hGd : ∀ r ∈ interior (Icc 0 T), HasDerivWithinAt G (G' r) (interior (Icc 0 T)) r := by
    intro r hr
    rw [interior_Icc] at hr
    have he : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => Real.exp (-(α * r)))
        (Real.exp (-(α * r)) * (-(α * 1))) r :=
      (((hasDerivAt_id r).const_mul α).neg).exp
    have hm := (he.mul (hderiv r hr)).sub ((hasDerivAt_id r).const_mul β)
    exact hm.hasDerivWithinAt
  have hGn : ∀ r ∈ interior (Icc 0 T), G' r ≤ 0 := by
    intro r hr
    rw [interior_Icc] at hr
    have hepos : 0 < Real.exp (-(α * r)) := Real.exp_pos _
    have hele : Real.exp (-(α * r)) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]
      have : 0 ≤ α * r := mul_nonneg hα hr.1.le
      linarith
    have hl := hle r hr
    simp only [hG'def]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hepos.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hl), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hele) hβ]
  have hanti : AntitoneOn G (Icc 0 T) :=
    antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos (convex_Icc 0 T) hGc hGd hGn
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := le_trans hs.1 hs.2
  have h0mem : (0:ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 T := ⟨le_rfl, hT⟩
  have hGs : G s ≤ G 0 := hanti h0mem hs hs.1
  have hG0 : G 0 = E 0 := by simp [hGdef]
  have hkey : Real.exp (-(α * s)) * E s ≤ β * s := by
    have : G s ≤ 0 := by linarith
    simp only [hGdef] at this
    linarith
  have hprod : Real.exp (α * s) * Real.exp (-(α * s)) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Real.exp_zero]
  have hexpos : 0 < Real.exp (α * s) := Real.exp_pos _
  have hEs : E s ≤ β * s * Real.exp (α * s) := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkey hexpos.le
    calc E s = Real.exp (α * s) * (Real.exp (-(α * s)) * E s) := by
            rw [← mul_assoc, hprod, one_mul]
      _ ≤ Real.exp (α * s) * (β * s) := h
      _ = β * s * Real.exp (α * s) := by ring
  have hbs : β * s ≤ β * T := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs.2 hβ
  have hexp : Real.exp (α * s) ≤ Real.exp (α * T) :=
    Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs.2 hα)
  have hfin : β * s * Real.exp (α * s) ≤ β * T * Real.exp (α * T) :=
    mul_le_mul hbs hexp hexpos.le (mul_nonneg hβ hT)
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ β Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → 0 < Z → HasDerivAt (fun Y => heatK β Y) (-β * heatK (β + 1) Z) Z ∧ |heatK β Z| ≤ Real.Gamma (β + 1)

signature.name: heatK_deriv_bound
signature.statement: ∀ β Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → 0 < Z → HasDerivAt (fun Y => heatK β Y) (-β * heatK (β + 1) Z) Z ∧ |heatK β Z| ≤ Real.Gamma (β + 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro β Z hβ hZ
  set μ : Measure ℝ := volume.restrict (Ioi (0:ℝ)) with hμ
  let F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun Y v => Real.exp (-v) * v ^ β * (1 + Y * v) ^ (-β)
  let F' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun Y v =>
    -β * (Real.exp (-v) * v ^ (β + 1) * (1 + Y * v) ^ (-(β + 1)))
  have hFm : ∀ Y, Measurable (F Y) := by
    intro Y
    exact ((Real.measurable_exp.comp measurable_neg).mul (measurable_id.pow_const β)).mul
      ((measurable_const.add (measurable_const.mul measurable_id)).pow_const (-β))
  have hF'm : ∀ Y, Measurable (F' Y) := by
    intro Y
    exact measurable_const.mul (((Real.measurable_exp.comp measurable_neg).mul
      (measurable_id.pow_const (β + 1))).mul
      ((measurable_const.add (measurable_const.mul measurable_id)).pow_const (-(β + 1))))
  have hg1 : Integrable (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-v) * v ^ ((β + 1) - 1)) μ :=
    Real.GammaIntegral_convergent (by linarith)
  have hg2 : Integrable (fun v : ℝ => β * (Real.exp (-v) * v ^ ((β + 2) - 1))) μ :=
    (Real.GammaIntegral_convergent (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < β + 2)).const_mul β
  have key : ∀ Y v : ℝ, 0 < Y → 0 < v → ∀ γ : ℝ, 0 ≤ γ →
      0 < 1 + Y * v ∧ 0 ≤ (1 + Y * v) ^ (-γ) ∧ (1 + Y * v) ^ (-γ) ≤ 1 := by
    intro Y v hY hv γ hγ
    have h1 : 1 ≤ 1 + Y * v := by nlinarith [mul_pos hY hv]
    exact ⟨by linarith, Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _,
      Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos h1 (by linarith)⟩
  have hdomF : ∀ᵐ v ∂μ, ‖F Z v‖ ≤ Real.exp (-v) * v ^ ((β + 1) - 1) := by
    refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).mpr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun v hv => ?_)
    have hv' : (0:ℝ) < v := hv
    obtain ⟨_, h2, h3⟩ := key Z v hZ hv' β hβ
    have hA : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-v) * v ^ β :=
      mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.rpow_nonneg hv'.le _)
    have he : (β + 1) - 1 = β := by ring
    rw [he, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hA h2)]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right hA h3
  have hFint : Integrable (F Z) μ := hg1.mono' (hFm Z).aestronglyMeasurable hdomF
  have hball : ∀ Y ∈ Metric.ball Z (Z / 2), 0 < Y := by
    intro Y hY
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] at hY
    have := (abs_sub_lt_iff.mp hY).2
    linarith
  have hdomF' : ∀ᵐ v ∂μ, ∀ Y ∈ Metric.ball Z (Z / 2),
      ‖F' Y v‖ ≤ β * (Real.exp (-v) * v ^ ((β + 2) - 1)) := by
    refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).mpr
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun v hv Y hY => ?_)
    have hv' : (0:ℝ) < v := hv
    obtain ⟨_, h2, h3⟩ := key Y v (hball Y hY) hv' (β + 1) (by linarith)
    have hA : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-v) * v ^ (β + 1) :=
      mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.rpow_nonneg hv'.le _)
    have he : (β + 2) - 1 = β + 1 := by ring
    rw [he, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    show |-β * (Real.exp (-v) * v ^ (β + 1) * (1 + Y * v) ^ (-(β + 1)))| ≤ _
    rw [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hβ, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hA h2)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_of_le_one_right hA h3) hβ
  have hderiv : ∀ᵐ v ∂μ, ∀ Y ∈ Metric.ball Z (Z / 2),
      HasDerivAt (fun Y => F Y v) (F' Y v) Y := by
    refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).mpr
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun v hv Y hY => ?_)
    have hv' : (0:ℝ) < v := hv
    obtain ⟨h1, _, _⟩ := key Y v (hball Y hY) hv' β hβ
    have hd : HasDerivAt (fun Y => 1 + Y * v) (1 * v) Y :=
      ((hasDerivAt_id Y).mul_const v).const_add 1
    have hd2 := (hd.rpow_const (p := -β) (Or.inl h1.ne')).const_mul (Real.exp (-v) * v ^ β)
    convert hd2 using 1
    show -β * (Real.exp (-v) * v ^ (β + 1) * (1 + Y * v) ^ (-(β + 1))) =
      Real.exp (-v) * v ^ β * (1 * v * -β * (1 + Y * v) ^ (-β - 1))
    rw [Real.rpow_add_one hv'.ne', show -β - 1 = -(β + 1) by ring]
    ring
  have hL := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (μ := μ) (F := F) (F' := F')
    (x₀ := Z) (Metric.ball_mem_nhds Z (half_pos hZ))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun Y => (hFm Y).aestronglyMeasurable)
    hFint (hF'm Z).aestronglyMeasurable hdomF' hg2 hderiv
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have hv : ∫ a, F' Z a ∂μ = -β * heatK (β + 1) Z := by
      simp only [F']
      rw [integral_const_mul]
      rfl
    rw [← hv]
    exact hL.2
  · have hb := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hg1 hdomF
    rw [← Real.Gamma_eq_integral (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < β + 1)] at hb
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hb

informal_problem.statement: ∀ h Z : ℝ, 0 < h → 0 < Z → (h + 1) * Z ^ 2 * heatK (h + 2) Z - (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * heatK (h + 1) Z + (1 + h) * heatK h Z = 0

signature.name: heatK_ode
signature.statement: ∀ h Z : ℝ, 0 < h → 0 < Z → (h + 1) * Z ^ 2 * heatK (h + 2) Z - (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * heatK (h + 1) Z + (1 + h) * heatK h Z = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Z hh hZ
  
  have hint : ∀ β : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → Integrable (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-v) * v ^ β * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-β))
      (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)) := by
    intro β hβ
    have hG : Integrable (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-v) * v ^ β) (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)) := by
      have := Real.GammaIntegral_convergent (s := β + 1) (by linarith)
      have h2 : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-x) * x ^ β) (Ioi 0) := by simpa using this
      exact h2
    refine hG.mono' ?_ ?_
    · refine ContinuousOn.aestronglyMeasurable ?_ measurableSet_Ioi
      intro v hv
      have hv' : (0:ℝ) < v := hv
      apply ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      have h1 : (0:ℝ) < 1 + Z * v := by positivity
      have hc1 : ContinuousAt (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-v)) v := by fun_prop
      have hc2 : ContinuousAt (fun v : ℝ => v ^ β) v :=
        Real.continuousAt_rpow_const v β (Or.inl hv'.ne')
      have hc3 : ContinuousAt (fun v : ℝ => (1 + Z * v) ^ (-β)) v :=
        ContinuousAt.rpow_const (f := fun v : ℝ => 1 + Z * v) (by fun_prop) (Or.inl h1.ne')
      exact (hc1.mul hc2).mul hc3
    · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi ?_
      intro v hv
      have hv' : (0:ℝ) < v := hv
      have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + Z * v := by nlinarith
      have hq0 : 0 ≤ (1 + Z * v) ^ (-β) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have hq1 : (1 + Z * v) ^ (-β) ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos h1 (by linarith)
      have hp : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-v) * v ^ β :=
        mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.rpow_nonneg hv'.le _)
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hp hq0)]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_right hp hq1
  have J2 := hint (h + 2) (by linarith)
  have J1 := hint (h + 1) (by linarith)
  have J0 := hint h hh.le
  
  have hderiv : ∀ v ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ), HasDerivAt
      (fun w : ℝ => Real.exp (-w) * w ^ (1 + h) * (1 + Z * w) ^ (-(1 + h)))
      ((h + 1) * Z ^ 2 * (Real.exp (-v) * v ^ (h + 2) * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-(h + 2)))
        - (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * (Real.exp (-v) * v ^ (h + 1) * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-(h + 1)))
        + (1 + h) * (Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h))) v := by
    intro v hv
    have hv' : (0:ℝ) < v := hv
    have hW : (0:ℝ) < 1 + Z * v := by positivity
    have d1 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℝ => Real.exp (-w)) (Real.exp (-v) * (-1)) v :=
      (hasDerivAt_neg v).exp
    have d2 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℝ => w ^ (1 + h)) ((1 + h) * v ^ (1 + h - 1)) v :=
      Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl hv'.ne')
    have d3i : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℝ => 1 + Z * w) Z v := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul Z).const_add 1
    have d3 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℝ => (1 + Z * w) ^ (-(1 + h)))
        (Z * (-(1 + h)) * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-(1 + h) - 1)) v :=
      d3i.rpow_const (Or.inl hW.ne')
    have d : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℝ => Real.exp (-w) * w ^ (1 + h) * (1 + Z * w) ^ (-(1 + h)))
        ((Real.exp (-v) * (-1) * v ^ (1 + h) + Real.exp (-v) * ((1 + h) * v ^ (1 + h - 1)))
          * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-(1 + h))
          + Real.exp (-v) * v ^ (1 + h) * (Z * (-(1 + h)) * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-(1 + h) - 1))) v :=
      (d1.mul d2).mul d3
    convert d using 1
    have e1 : v ^ (1 + h) = v ^ h * v := by rw [add_comm, Real.rpow_add_one hv'.ne']
    have e2 : v ^ (1 + h - 1) = v ^ h := by rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
    have e3 : v ^ (h + 2) = v ^ h * v ^ 2 := by rw [Real.rpow_add hv', Real.rpow_two]
    have e4 : v ^ (h + 1) = v ^ h * v := Real.rpow_add_one hv'.ne' h
    have f1 : (1 + Z * v) ^ (-(1 + h)) = (1 + Z * v) ^ (-(h + 2)) * (1 + Z * v) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add_one hW.ne']; congr 1; ring
    have f2 : (1 + Z * v) ^ (-(1 + h) - 1) = (1 + Z * v) ^ (-(h + 2)) := by
      congr 1; ring
    have f3 : (1 + Z * v) ^ (-(h + 1)) = (1 + Z * v) ^ (-(h + 2)) * (1 + Z * v) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add_one hW.ne']; congr 1; ring
    have f4 : (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h) = (1 + Z * v) ^ (-(h + 2)) * (1 + Z * v) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_two, ← Real.rpow_add hW]; congr 1; ring
    rw [e1, e2, e3, e4, f1, f2, f3, f4]
    ring
  
  have hcont : ContinuousWithinAt
      (fun w : ℝ => Real.exp (-w) * w ^ (1 + h) * (1 + Z * w) ^ (-(1 + h))) (Ici 0) 0 := by
    apply ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have c1 : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ => Real.exp (-w)) 0 := by fun_prop
    have c2 : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ => w ^ (1 + h)) 0 :=
      Real.continuousAt_rpow_const 0 (1 + h) (Or.inr (by linarith))
    have c3 : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ => (1 + Z * w) ^ (-(1 + h))) 0 :=
      ContinuousAt.rpow_const (f := fun w : ℝ => 1 + Z * w) (by fun_prop) (Or.inl (by simp))
    exact (c1.mul c2).mul c3
  have hlim : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun w : ℝ => Real.exp (-w) * w ^ (1 + h) * (1 + Z * w) ^ (-(1 + h))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hT := tendsto_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_atTop_nhds_zero (1 + h) 1 one_pos
    refine squeeze_zero' ?_ ?_ hT
    · filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with w hw
      have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + Z * w := by nlinarith
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.rpow_nonneg hw.le _))
        (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
    · filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with w hw
      have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + Z * w := by nlinarith
      have hq1 : (1 + Z * w) ^ (-(1 + h)) ≤ 1 :=
        Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos h1 (by linarith)
      have hp : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-w) * w ^ (1 + h) :=
        mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.rpow_nonneg hw.le _)
      calc Real.exp (-w) * w ^ (1 + h) * (1 + Z * w) ^ (-(1 + h))
          ≤ Real.exp (-w) * w ^ (1 + h) * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq1 hp
        _ = w ^ (1 + h) * Real.exp (-1 * w) := by rw [neg_one_mul]; ring
  
  have key := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hcont hderiv
    (((J2.const_mul ((h + 1) * Z ^ 2)).sub (J1.const_mul (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z))).add
      (J0.const_mul (1 + h))) hlim
  have hsplit : (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ),
      ((h + 1) * Z ^ 2 * (Real.exp (-x) * x ^ (h + 2) * (1 + Z * x) ^ (-(h + 2)))
        - (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * (Real.exp (-x) * x ^ (h + 1) * (1 + Z * x) ^ (-(h + 1)))
        + (1 + h) * (Real.exp (-x) * x ^ h * (1 + Z * x) ^ (-h)))) =
      (h + 1) * Z ^ 2 * heatK (h + 2) Z - (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * heatK (h + 1) Z
        + (1 + h) * heatK h Z := by
    unfold heatK
    rw [integral_add, integral_sub, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
    all_goals first
      | exact J2.const_mul _
      | exact J1.const_mul _
      | exact J0.const_mul _
      | exact (J2.const_mul _).sub (J1.const_mul _)
  rw [← hsplit, key, Real.zero_rpow (by linarith)]
  simp

informal_problem.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → (∀ β Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → 0 < Z → HasDerivAt (fun Y => heatK β Y) (-β * heatK (β + 1) Z) Z ∧ |heatK β Z| ≤ Real.Gamma (β + 1)) → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → (h + 1) * Z ^ 2 * heatK (h + 2) Z - (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * heatK (h + 1) Z + (1 + h) * heatK h Z = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv k (heatProfile h) Z| ≤ C) ∧ (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → Z ^ 2 * deriv (deriv (heatProfile h)) Z + (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * deriv (heatProfile h) Z + h * (1 + h) * heatProfile h Z = 0)

signature.name: heatProfile_props
signature.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → (∀ β Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → 0 < Z → HasDerivAt (fun Y => heatK β Y) (-β * heatK (β + 1) Z) Z ∧ |heatK β Z| ≤ Real.Gamma (β + 1)) → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → (h + 1) * Z ^ 2 * heatK (h + 2) Z - (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * heatK (h + 1) Z + (1 + h) * heatK h Z = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv k (heatProfile h) Z| ≤ C) ∧ (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → Z ^ 2 * deriv (deriv (heatProfile h)) Z + (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * deriv (heatProfile h) Z + h * (1 + h) * heatProfile h Z = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h hh H1 H2
  have hdef : heatProfile h = fun Y => (Real.Gamma (1 + h))⁻¹ * heatK h Y := rfl
  have hform : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ a : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z →
      iteratedDeriv k (heatProfile h) Z = a * heatK (h + (k : ℝ)) Z := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      refine ⟨(Real.Gamma (1 + h))⁻¹, fun Z _ => ?_⟩
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, hdef]
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨a * (-(h + k)), fun Z hZ => ?_⟩
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
      have hev : iteratedDeriv k (heatProfile h) =ᶠ[nhds Z] fun Y => a * heatK (h + (k:ℝ)) Y :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hZ) (fun Y hY => ha Y hY)
      rw [hev.deriv_eq]
      have hβ : (0:ℝ) ≤ h + k := add_nonneg hh.le (Nat.cast_nonneg k)
      rw [((H1 (h + k) Z hβ hZ).1.const_mul a).deriv]
      have hc : h + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = h + k + 1 := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hc]
      ring
  have hdiffK : ∀ (a β : ℝ), 0 ≤ β → DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun Y => a * heatK β Y) (Ioi 0) :=
    fun a β hβ Y hY => ((H1 β Y hβ hY).1.const_mul a).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply contDiffOn_of_differentiableOn_deriv
    intro m _
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hform m
    refine (hdiffK a (h + m) (add_nonneg hh.le (Nat.cast_nonneg m))).congr ?_
    intro Y hY
    rw [iteratedDerivWithin_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioi hY, ha Y hY]
  · intro k
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hform k
    refine ⟨|a| * Real.Gamma (h + k + 1), fun Z hZ => ?_⟩
    rw [ha Z hZ, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (H1 (h + k) Z (add_nonneg hh.le (Nat.cast_nonneg k)) hZ).2 (abs_nonneg a)
  · intro Z hZ
    have hd1 : ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → deriv (heatProfile h) Y =
        (Real.Gamma (1 + h))⁻¹ * (-h * heatK (h + 1) Y) := by
      intro Y hY
      rw [hdef]
      exact ((H1 h Y hh.le hY).1.const_mul (Real.Gamma (1 + h))⁻¹).deriv
    have hev : deriv (heatProfile h) =ᶠ[nhds Z]
        fun Y => (Real.Gamma (1 + h))⁻¹ * (-h * heatK (h + 1) Y) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hZ) hd1
    have hd2 : deriv (deriv (heatProfile h)) Z =
        (Real.Gamma (1 + h))⁻¹ * (-h * (-(h + 1) * heatK (h + 1 + 1) Z)) := by
      rw [hev.deriv_eq]
      exact (((H1 (h + 1) Z (by linarith) hZ).1.const_mul (-h)).const_mul
        (Real.Gamma (1 + h))⁻¹).deriv
    have h2 : h + 1 + 1 = h + 2 := by ring
    rw [h2] at hd2
    have h0 : heatProfile h Z = (Real.Gamma (1 + h))⁻¹ * heatK h Z := rfl
    rw [hd2, hd1 Z hZ, h0]
    linear_combination ((Real.Gamma (1 + h))⁻¹ * h) * H2 Z hZ

informal_problem.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv k (heatProfile h) Z| ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatQ h) (Ioi 0) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → |iteratedDeriv k (heatQ h) Y| ≤ C) ∧ (∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → (1 + 2 * h) * heatQ h Y + Y * deriv (heatQ h) Y = heatProfile h Y ^ 2)
