signature.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv k (heatProfile h) Z| ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatQ h) (Ioi 0) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → |iteratedDeriv k (heatQ h) Y| ≤ C) ∧ (∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → (1 + 2 * h) * heatQ h Y + Y * deriv (heatQ h) Y = heatProfile h Y ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h hh hHs hHb
  
  have hTmeas : ∀ (c : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (y : ℝ), DifferentiableOn ℝ φ (Ioi 0) → 0 < y →
      AEStronglyMeasurable (fun w : ℝ => w ^ (-c) * φ (y / w)) (volume.restrict (Ioi (1:ℝ))) := by
    intro c φ y hd hy
    apply ContinuousOn.aestronglyMeasurable _ measurableSet_Ioi
    apply ContinuousOn.mul
    · exact continuousOn_id.rpow_const (fun w hw => Or.inl (ne_of_gt (lt_trans one_pos hw)))
    · refine hd.continuousOn.comp
        (continuousOn_const.div continuousOn_id (fun w hw => ne_of_gt (lt_trans one_pos hw))) ?_
      intro w hw
      exact div_pos hy (lt_trans one_pos hw)
  have hTmeas' : ∀ (c : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (y : ℝ),
      AEStronglyMeasurable (fun w : ℝ => w ^ (-c) * deriv φ (y / w)) (volume.restrict (Ioi (1:ℝ))) :=
    fun c φ y => ((measurable_id.pow_const _).mul
      ((measurable_deriv φ).comp (measurable_const.div measurable_id))).aestronglyMeasurable
  
  have hTint : ∀ (c : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (M Y : ℝ), 1 < c →
      AEStronglyMeasurable (fun w : ℝ => w ^ (-c) * φ (Y / w)) (volume.restrict (Ioi (1:ℝ))) →
      (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |φ Z| ≤ M) → 0 < Y →
      IntegrableOn (fun w : ℝ => w ^ (-c) * φ (Y / w)) (Ioi 1) := by
    intro c φ M Y hc hmeas hb hY
    have hg : IntegrableOn (fun w : ℝ => M * w ^ (-c)) (Ioi 1) :=
      (integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) one_pos).const_mul M
    refine Integrable.mono' hg hmeas ?_
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi (fun w hw => ?_)
    have hw0 : (0:ℝ) < w := lt_trans one_pos hw
    have hp : 0 < w ^ (-c) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hw0 _
    show ‖w ^ (-c) * φ (Y / w)‖ ≤ M * w ^ (-c)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hp, mul_comm M]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb _ (div_pos hY hw0)) hp.le
  
  have hT2 : ∀ (c : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (M : ℝ), 1 < c → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |φ Z| ≤ M) →
      ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → |∫ w in Ioi (1:ℝ), w ^ (-c) * φ (Y / w)| ≤ M / (c - 1) := by
    intro c φ M hc hb Y hY
    have hg : IntegrableOn (fun w : ℝ => M * w ^ (-c)) (Ioi 1) :=
      (integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) one_pos).const_mul M
    have h1 := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hg
      (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi (fun w (hw : w ∈ Ioi (1:ℝ)) => by
        have hw0 : (0:ℝ) < w := lt_trans one_pos hw
        have hp : 0 < w ^ (-c) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hw0 _
        show ‖w ^ (-c) * φ (Y / w)‖ ≤ M * w ^ (-c)
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hp, mul_comm M]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb _ (div_pos hY hw0)) hp.le))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    refine h1.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) one_pos, Real.one_rpow]
    have hc1 : c - 1 ≠ 0 := (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < c - 1).ne'
    have hc2 : -c + 1 ≠ 0 := (by linarith : -c + 1 < 0).ne
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hT1 : ∀ (c : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (M : ℝ), 1 < c → DifferentiableOn ℝ φ (Ioi 0) →
      (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |φ Z| ≤ M ∧ |deriv φ Z| ≤ M) → ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y →
      HasDerivAt (fun y => ∫ w in Ioi (1:ℝ), w ^ (-c) * φ (y / w))
        (∫ w in Ioi (1:ℝ), w ^ (-(c + 1)) * deriv φ (Y / w)) Y := by
    intro c φ M hc hd hb Y hY
    have hball : Metric.ball Y (Y / 2) ∈ nhds Y := Metric.ball_mem_nhds Y (by linarith)
    have hpos : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball Y (Y / 2), 0 < y := by
      intro y hy
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] at hy
      have := (abs_lt.mp hy).1
      linarith
    have h := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (μ := volume.restrict (Ioi (1:ℝ)))
      (F := fun y w => w ^ (-c) * φ (y / w)) (F' := fun y w => w ^ (-(c + 1)) * deriv φ (y / w))
      (bound := fun w => M * w ^ (-(c + 1))) hball
      (by filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hY] with y hy using hTmeas c φ y hd hy)
      (hTint c φ M Y hc (hTmeas c φ Y hd hY) (fun Z hZ => (hb Z hZ).1) hY)
      (hTmeas' (c + 1) φ Y)
      (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi (fun w hw y hy => by
        have hw0 : (0:ℝ) < w := lt_trans one_pos hw
        have hyw : 0 < y / w := div_pos (hpos y hy) hw0
        have hp : 0 < w ^ (-(c + 1)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hw0 _
        show ‖w ^ (-(c + 1)) * deriv φ (y / w)‖ ≤ M * w ^ (-(c + 1))
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hp, mul_comm M]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb _ hyw).2 hp.le))
      ((integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) one_pos).const_mul M)
      (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi (fun w hw y hy => by
        have hw0 : (0:ℝ) < w := lt_trans one_pos hw
        have hyw : 0 < y / w := div_pos (hpos y hy) hw0
        have hφ : HasDerivAt φ (deriv φ (y / w)) (y / w) :=
          (hd.differentiableAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hyw)).hasDerivAt
        have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun y => w ^ (-c) * φ (y / w))
            (w ^ (-c) * (deriv φ (y / w) * (1 / w))) y :=
          (hφ.comp y ((hasDerivAt_id' y).div_const w)).const_mul (w ^ (-c))
        refine h2.congr_deriv ?_
        rw [show -(c + 1) = -c + -1 by ring, Real.rpow_add hw0, Real.rpow_neg_one]
        ring))
    exact h.2
  
  have hT3 : ∀ (c : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (M : ℝ), 1 < c → DifferentiableOn ℝ φ (Ioi 0) →
      (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |φ Z| ≤ M ∧ |deriv φ Z| ≤ M) → ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y →
      (c - 1) * (∫ w in Ioi (1:ℝ), w ^ (-c) * φ (Y / w)) +
        Y * (∫ w in Ioi (1:ℝ), w ^ (-(c + 1)) * deriv φ (Y / w)) = φ Y := by
    intro c φ M hc hd hb Y hY
    have hI0 : IntegrableOn (fun w : ℝ => w ^ (-c) * φ (Y / w)) (Ioi 1) :=
      hTint c φ M Y hc (hTmeas c φ Y hd hY) (fun Z hZ => (hb Z hZ).1) hY
    have hI1 : IntegrableOn (fun w : ℝ => w ^ (-(c + 1)) * deriv φ (Y / w)) (Ioi 1) :=
      hTint (c + 1) (deriv φ) M Y (by linarith) (hTmeas' (c + 1) φ Y) (fun Z hZ => (hb Z hZ).2) hY
    have hcont : ContinuousWithinAt (fun w : ℝ => w ^ (1 - c) * φ (Y / w)) (Ici 1) 1 := by
      apply ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      apply ContinuousAt.mul
      · exact Real.continuousAt_rpow_const 1 (1 - c) (Or.inl one_ne_zero)
      · have h1 : ContinuousAt φ (Y / 1) := by
          rw [div_one]; exact (hd.differentiableAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hY)).continuousAt
        exact h1.comp (continuousAt_const.div continuousAt_id one_ne_zero)
    have hderiv : ∀ w ∈ Ioi (1:ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun w : ℝ => w ^ (1 - c) * φ (Y / w))
        (-(c - 1) * (w ^ (-c) * φ (Y / w)) - Y * (w ^ (-(c + 1)) * deriv φ (Y / w))) w := by
      intro w hw
      have hw0 : (0:ℝ) < w := lt_trans one_pos hw
      have hYw : 0 < Y / w := div_pos hY hw0
      have hφ : HasDerivAt φ (deriv φ (Y / w)) (Y / w) :=
        (hd.differentiableAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hYw)).hasDerivAt
      have hq : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Y / x) (Y * (-(w ^ 2)⁻¹)) w := by
        have e : (fun x : ℝ => Y / x) = fun x => Y * x⁻¹ := by funext x; ring
        rw [e]; exact (hasDerivAt_inv hw0.ne').const_mul Y
      have hr : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1 - c)) ((1 - c) * w ^ (1 - c - 1)) w :=
        Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl hw0.ne')
      have h2 := hr.mul (hφ.comp w hq)
      refine h2.congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [show (1:ℝ) - c - 1 = -c by ring, show (1:ℝ) - c = -c + 1 by ring,
        Real.rpow_add_one hw0.ne', show -(c + 1) = -c + -1 by ring, Real.rpow_add hw0,
        Real.rpow_neg_one]
      field_simp
      ring
    have htend : Filter.Tendsto (fun w : ℝ => w ^ (1 - c) * φ (Y / w)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have hlim : Filter.Tendsto (fun w : ℝ => M * w ^ (-(c - 1))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        have := (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop (by linarith : 0 < c - 1)).const_mul M
        simpa only [mul_zero] using this
      refine squeeze_zero_norm' ?_ hlim
      filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_gt_atTop (0:ℝ)] with w hw0
      have hp : 0 < w ^ (1 - c) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hw0 _
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hp, show -(c - 1) = 1 - c by ring, mul_comm M]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb _ (div_pos hY hw0)).1 hp.le
    have hFTC := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hcont hderiv
      ((hI0.const_mul (-(c - 1))).sub (hI1.const_mul Y)) htend
    rw [integral_sub (hI0.const_mul _) (hI1.const_mul _), integral_const_mul,
      integral_const_mul] at hFTC
    simp only [Real.one_rpow, div_one, one_mul, zero_sub] at hFTC
    linear_combination -hFTC
  
  have key : ∀ (c : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), 1 < c → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ (Ioi 0) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv k φ Z| ≤ C) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => ∫ w in Ioi (1:ℝ), w ^ (-c) * φ (Y / w)) (Ioi 0) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y →
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => ∫ w in Ioi (1:ℝ), w ^ (-c) * φ (Y / w)) Y| ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → (c - 1) * (∫ w in Ioi (1:ℝ), w ^ (-c) * φ (Y / w)) +
        Y * deriv (fun Y => ∫ w in Ioi (1:ℝ), w ^ (-c) * φ (Y / w)) Y = φ Y) := by
    intro c φ hc hs hb
    choose G hG using hb
    have hF1 : ∀ k : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k φ) (Ioi 0) := by
      intro k
      have hlt : ((k : WithTop ℕ∞)) < ∞ := by exact_mod_cast ENat.natCast_lt_top k
      exact (hs.differentiableOn_iteratedDerivWithin hlt (uniqueDiffOn_Ioi 0)).congr
        (fun Y hY => (iteratedDerivWithin_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioi hY).symm)
    have hF3 : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv k φ Z| ≤ max (G k) (G (k + 1)) ∧
        |deriv (iteratedDeriv k φ) Z| ≤ max (G k) (G (k + 1)) := by
      intro k Z hZ
      refine ⟨(hG k Z hZ).trans (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
      rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ]
      exact (hG (k + 1) Z hZ).trans (le_max_right _ _)
    have hcm : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 < c + (k : ℝ) := fun k => by
      have := Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k; linarith
    have hR : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y →
        iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => ∫ w in Ioi (1:ℝ), w ^ (-c) * φ (Y / w)) Y =
          ∫ w in Ioi (1:ℝ), w ^ (-(c + (k : ℝ))) * iteratedDeriv k φ (Y / w) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro Y hY
        simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero]
      | succ k ih =>
        intro Y hY
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        have hev : iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => ∫ w in Ioi (1:ℝ), w ^ (-c) * φ (Y / w)) =ᶠ[nhds Y]
            fun y => ∫ w in Ioi (1:ℝ), w ^ (-(c + (k : ℝ))) * iteratedDeriv k φ (y / w) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hY) (fun y hy => ih y hy)
        rw [hev.deriv_eq, (hT1 (c + k) (iteratedDeriv k φ) _ (hcm k) (hF1 k) (hF3 k) Y hY).deriv,
          ← iteratedDeriv_succ]
        rw [show (c + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) = c + k + 1 by push_cast; ring]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply contDiffOn_of_differentiableOn_deriv
      intro m _
      have hdm : DifferentiableOn ℝ
          (fun y => ∫ w in Ioi (1:ℝ), w ^ (-(c + (m : ℝ))) * iteratedDeriv m φ (y / w)) (Ioi 0) :=
        fun Y hY => (hT1 (c + m) (iteratedDeriv m φ) _ (hcm m) (hF1 m) (hF3 m) Y
          hY).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      refine hdm.congr ?_
      intro Y hY
      rw [iteratedDerivWithin_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioi hY, hR m Y hY]
    · intro k
      refine ⟨G k / (c + k - 1), fun Y hY => ?_⟩
      rw [hR k Y hY]
      exact hT2 (c + k) (iteratedDeriv k φ) (G k) (hcm k) (hG k) Y hY
    · intro Y hY
      have hd0 : DifferentiableOn ℝ φ (Ioi 0) := by simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hF1 0
      have hb0 : ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |φ Z| ≤ max (G 0) (G (0 + 1)) ∧
          |deriv φ Z| ≤ max (G 0) (G (0 + 1)) := by
        simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hF3 0
      rw [(hT1 c φ _ hc hd0 hb0 Y hY).deriv]
      exact hT3 c φ _ hc hd0 hb0 Y hY
  
  have hgs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Z => heatProfile h Z ^ 2) (Ioi 0) := hHs.pow 2
  have hgb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z →
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun Z => heatProfile h Z ^ 2) Z| ≤ C := by
    choose C hC using hHb
    intro k
    refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |C i| * |C (k - i)|, fun Z hZ => ?_⟩
    have hca : ContDiffAt ℝ k (heatProfile h) Z :=
      (contDiffAt_infty.mp (hHs.contDiffAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hZ))) k
    have e : (fun Z => heatProfile h Z ^ 2) = heatProfile h * heatProfile h := by
      funext Z; simp [sq]
    rw [e, iteratedDeriv_mul hca hca]
    refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, Nat.abs_cast]
    have h1 := (hC i Z hZ).trans (le_abs_self _)
    have h2 := (hC (k - i) Z hZ).trans (le_abs_self _)
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) h2 (abs_nonneg _)
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _))
  have hc : (1:ℝ) < 2 + 2 * h := by linarith
  obtain ⟨A1, A2, A3⟩ := key (2 + 2 * h) (fun Z => heatProfile h Z ^ 2) hc hgs hgb
  refine ⟨A1, A2, fun Y hY => ?_⟩
  have := A3 Y hY

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (f Pf : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Iio 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Pf) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Iio 1) → 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → t < 1 → nsResidual 1 (fun y s => f (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) s • (-(y 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + y 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) (fun y s => Pf (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) s) x t = (deriv (fun s => f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) s) t - 4 * (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * deriv (fun σ => deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) σ) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) - 8 * deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2)) • (-(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) + (2 * deriv (fun ρ => Pf ρ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) - f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) t ^ 2) • (x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 1 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))

signature.name: swirl_residual_formula
signature.statement: ∀ (f Pf : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Iio 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Pf) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Iio 1) → 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → t < 1 → nsResidual 1 (fun y s => f (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) s • (-(y 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + y 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) (fun y s => Pf (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) s) x t = (deriv (fun s => f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) s) t - 4 * (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * deriv (fun σ => deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) σ) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) - 8 * deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2)) • (-(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) + (2 * deriv (fun ρ => Pf ρ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) - f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) t ^ 2) • (x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 1 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro f Pf x t hf hPf hS ht
  
  have hpj : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (v : ℝ³), (EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) v = v i := fun i v => rfl
  have hc : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (y : ℝ³), HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ³ => w i)
      (EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) y := fun i y => PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply 2 y i
  
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³, ∀ v : ℝ³, L v = -(v 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + v 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) :=
    ⟨-(EuclideanSpace.proj 1 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) +
      (EuclideanSpace.proj 0 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)),
      fun v => by simp [hpj]⟩
  have hJ : ∀ y : ℝ³, HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ³ => -(w 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + w 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) L y := by
    intro y
    have e : (fun w : ℝ³ => -(w 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + w 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) = L := by
      funext w; rw [hL]
    rw [e]; exact L.hasFDerivAt
  
  obtain ⟨Dσ, hDσ⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ³ → (ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ), ∀ y v, D y v = 2 * y 0 * v 0 + 2 * y 1 * v 1 :=
    ⟨fun y => (2 * y 0) • (EuclideanSpace.proj 0 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) + (2 * y 1) • (EuclideanSpace.proj 1 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ),
      fun y v => by simp [hpj]; try ring⟩
  have hσ : ∀ y : ℝ³, HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ³ => w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (Dσ y) y := by
    intro y
    have h := ((hc 0 y).pow 2).add ((hc 1 y).pow 2)
    convert h using 1
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
    rw [hDσ]; simp [hpj]; try ring
  have hcomp : ∀ (h : ℝ → ℝ) (h' : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), HasDerivAt h h' (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) →
      HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ³ => h (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2)) (h' • Dσ y) y :=
    fun h h' y hh => hh.comp_hasFDerivAt y (hσ y)
  have hG : ∀ (h : ℝ → ℝ) (h' : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), HasDerivAt h h' (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) →
      HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ³ => h (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) • (-(w 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + w 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)))
        (h (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) • L + (h' • Dσ y).smulRight (-(y 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + y 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) y := by
    intro h h' y hh
    exact (hcomp h h' y hh).smul (hJ y)
  have hGv : ∀ (h : ℝ → ℝ) (y v : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ h (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) →
      fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ => h (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) • (-(w 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + w 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) y v =
        h (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) • L v + (deriv h (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) * Dσ v y) • (-(y 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + y 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) := by
    intro h y v hh
    rw [(hG h _ y hh.hasDerivAt).fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [show Dσ y v = Dσ v y by rw [hDσ, hDσ]; ring]
  
  have hlap : ∀ (g : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (x : ℝ³), Δ g x = ∑ i : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) := by
    intro g x
    have h := congrFun (InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_orthonormalBasis g
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)) x
    rw [h]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  have hgrad : ∀ (g : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³), gradient g x = ∑ i : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ g x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) := by
    intro g x
    have h := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr' (gradient g x)
    rw [← h]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    simp only [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
    congr 1
    rw [real_inner_comm]
    exact InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply
  
  have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ρ => f ρ t) (Ioi 0) := by
    have hm : MapsTo (fun ρ : ℝ => ((ρ, t) : ℝ × ℝ)) (Ioi 0) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Iio 1) := fun ρ hρ => ⟨hρ, ht⟩
    exact hf.comp (contDiffOn_id.prodMk contDiffOn_const) hm
  have hPg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ρ => Pf ρ t) (Ioi 0) := by
    have hm : MapsTo (fun ρ : ℝ => ((ρ, t) : ℝ × ℝ)) (Ioi 0) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Iio 1) := fun ρ hρ => ⟨hρ, ht⟩
    exact hPf.comp (contDiffOn_id.prodMk contDiffOn_const) hm
  have ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s => f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) s) (Iio 1) := by
    have hm : MapsTo (fun s : ℝ => ((x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2, s) : ℝ × ℝ)) (Iio 1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Iio 1) :=
      fun s hs => ⟨hS, hs⟩
    exact hf.comp (contDiffOn_const.prodMk contDiffOn_id) hm
  have hg' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t)) (Ioi 0) :=
    hg.deriv_of_isOpen (m := ∞) isOpen_Ioi (by simp)
  have hgd : ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun ρ => f ρ t) ρ := fun ρ hρ =>
    (hg.contDiffAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hρ)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hg'd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t)) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) :=
    (hg'.contDiffAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hS)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hPd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun ρ => Pf ρ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) :=
    (hPg.contDiffAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hS)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have had : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s => f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) s) t :=
    (ha.contDiffAt (Iio_mem_nhds ht)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have hGsm : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ => f (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) t • (-(w 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + w 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) x := by
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ => f (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) t) x :=
      ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun ρ => f ρ t) x (hg.contDiffAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hS))
        ((by fun_prop : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ => w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2)).contDiffAt)
    exact h1.smul ((by fun_prop : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ => -(w 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + w 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))).contDiffAt)
  have hDG : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ => f (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) t • (-(w 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + w 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)))) x :=
    (hGsm.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by simp)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hsec : ∀ v : ℝ³, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ => f (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) t • (-(w 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + w 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)))) x v v =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ => f (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) t • (-(w 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + w 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) y v) x v := by
    intro v
    rw [fderiv_clm_apply hDG (differentiableAt_const v)]
    simp
  have hU : {y : ℝ³ | 0 < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2} ∈ nhds x :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).mem_nhds hS
  have hev : ∀ v : ℝ³, (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ => f (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) t • (-(w 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + w 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) y v) =ᶠ[nhds x]
      fun y => f (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) t • L v + (deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) * Dσ v y) • (-(y 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + y 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) := by
    intro v
    filter_upwards [hU] with y hy
    exact hGv (fun ρ => f ρ t) y v (hgd _ hy)
  have hH : ∀ v : ℝ³, HasFDerivAt (fun y => f (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) t • L v + (deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) * Dσ v y) • (-(y 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + y 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)))
      ((deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) • Dσ x).smulRight (L v) +
        ((deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * Dσ v x) • L +
          (deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) • Dσ v + Dσ v x • (deriv (fun σ => deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) σ) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) • Dσ x)).smulRight
            (-(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)))) x := by
    intro v
    have hA : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => f (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) t • L v)
        ((deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) • Dσ x).smulRight (L v)) x :=
      (hcomp (fun ρ => f ρ t) _ x (hgd _ hS).hasDerivAt).smul_const (L v)
    have hB1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) * Dσ v y)
        (deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) • Dσ v + Dσ v x • (deriv (fun σ => deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) σ) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) • Dσ x)) x :=
      (hcomp (deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t)) _ x hg'd.hasDerivAt).mul (Dσ v).hasFDerivAt
    have hB : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => (deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) * Dσ v y) • (-(y 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + y 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)))
        ((deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * Dσ v x) • L +
          (deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) • Dσ v + Dσ v x • (deriv (fun σ => deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) σ) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) • Dσ x)).smulRight
            (-(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) x :=
      hB1.smul (hJ x)
    exact hA.add hB
  
  have T1 : deriv (fun s => f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) s • (-(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) t =
      deriv (fun s => f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) s) t • (-(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) :=
    deriv_smul_const had _
  have T2 := hGv (fun ρ => f ρ t) x (f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) t • (-(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) (hgd _ hS)
  have T3 : Δ (fun w : ℝ³ => f (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) t • (-(w 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + w 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) x =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ((deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) • Dσ x).smulRight (L (EuclideanSpace.single i (1:ℝ))) +
        ((deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * Dσ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1:ℝ)) x) • L +
          (deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) • Dσ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1:ℝ)) + Dσ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1:ℝ)) x • (deriv (fun σ => deriv (fun ρ => f ρ t) σ) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) • Dσ x)).smulRight
            (-(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)))) (EuclideanSpace.single i (1:ℝ)) := by
    rw [hlap]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [hsec, (hev _).fderiv_eq, (hH _).fderiv]
  have T4 : gradient (fun y : ℝ³ => Pf (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) t) x = ∑ i : Fin 3,
      (deriv (fun ρ => Pf ρ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) • Dσ x) (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) := by
    rw [hgrad, (hcomp (fun ρ => Pf ρ t) _ x hPd.hasDerivAt).fderiv]
  show deriv (fun s => f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) s • (-(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) t +
      fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ => f (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) t • (-(w 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + w 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) x
        (f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) t • (-(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) -
      (1:ℝ) • Δ (fun w : ℝ³ => f (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) t • (-(w 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + w 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) x +
      gradient (fun y : ℝ³ => Pf (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) t) x = _
  rw [T1, T2, T3, T4]
  ext k
  fin_cases k <;>
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, hL, hDσ, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] <;> ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Iio 1) → 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → t < 1 → divergence (fun y => f (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) t • (-(y 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + y 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) x = 0 ∧ inner ℝ x (f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) t • (-(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) = (0:ℝ) ∧ (f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) t • (-(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) 2 = 0

signature.name: swirl_div_tangent
signature.statement: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Iio 1) → 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → t < 1 → divergence (fun y => f (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) t • (-(y 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + y 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) x = 0 ∧ inner ℝ x (f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) t • (-(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) = (0:ℝ) ∧ (f (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) t • (-(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) + x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) 2 = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro f x t hf hS ht
  have hsmul : ∀ (φ : ℝ³ → ℝ) (V : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (x : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ φ x →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ V x →
      divergence (fun y => φ y • V y) x = φ x * divergence V x + fderiv ℝ φ x (V x) := by
    intro φ V x hφ hV
    rw [divergence, fderiv_fun_smul hφ hV, ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_add,
      ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_smul, map_add, map_smul, divergence, smul_eq_mul]
    congr 1
    have h : ((fderiv ℝ φ x).smulRight (V x) : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ³) =
        (fderiv ℝ φ x : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (V x) := rfl
    rw [h, LinearMap.trace_smulRight]
    rfl
  have c00 : (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) 0 = 1 := by simp
  have c01 : (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) 1 = 0 := by simp
  have c02 : (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) 2 = 0 := by simp
  have c10 : (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) 0 = 0 := by simp
  have c11 : (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) 1 = 1 := by simp
  have c12 : (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) 2 = 0 := by simp
  generalize EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) = e0 at c00 c01 c02 ⊢
  generalize EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) = e1 at c10 c11 c12 ⊢
  have hO : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Iio (1:ℝ)) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Iio
  have hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun σ => f σ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) :=
    (hf.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds
      (show ((x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2, t) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Iio (1:ℝ) from ⟨hS, ht⟩))).comp
      (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) ((contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt)
  have hgd : HasDerivAt (fun σ => f σ t) (deriv (fun σ => f σ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2))
      (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) :=
    (hg.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasDerivAt
  have h0 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => y 0) (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) x :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
  have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => y 1) (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) x :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
  have hn1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => -(y 1))
      (-(EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)) x := h1.neg
  have hSd : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2)
      ((2 * x 0) • (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) +
        (2 * x 1) • (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)) x := by
    convert (h0.pow 2).add (h1.pow 2) using 1
    simp
  have hφd : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => f (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) t)
      (deriv (fun σ => f σ t) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) •

    intro R E U n Z W Y CJ' D' c' hc' hn hZ hW hZY hZW hE0 hU0 hR hE hU

    have h3 : (n * (Z + Z + Z)) * (1 + n * (|D'| * W + |D'| * W + W + W)) =

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h qs γ : ℝ) (L : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (F : ℕ → ℝ³ → ℝ → V), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → 0 < γ → SimScaleProps h → (∀ j, 1 ≤ a j) → (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) → (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(F j)) (simDomain h qs)) → (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ j → ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → a j * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≤ 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(fun y s => simCut h (a j) y s • F j y s)) (x, t)‖ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ j * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * (j : ℝ) / 2 - L k)) → (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(fun y s => simCut h (a j) y s • F j y s)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (- L k)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(cutSum h a F)) (simDomain h qs) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(cutSum h a F)) (x, t)‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(F 0)) (x, t)‖ + C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (- L k)) ∧ (∀ J k : ℕ, k ≤ J → ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → a J * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < 1 / 2 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => (↿(cutSum h a F)) z - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), (↿(F j)) z) (x, t)‖ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ J * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * ((J : ℝ) + 1) / 2 - L k))

signature.name: cutSum_props
signature.statement: ∀ (h qs γ : ℝ) (L : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (F : ℕ → ℝ³ → ℝ → V), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → 0 < γ → SimScaleProps h → (∀ j, 1 ≤ a j) → (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) → (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(F j)) (simDomain h qs)) → (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ j → ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → a j * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≤ 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(fun y s => simCut h (a j) y s • F j y s)) (x, t)‖ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ j * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * (j : ℝ) / 2 - L k)) → (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(fun y s => simCut h (a j) y s • F j y s)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (- L k)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(cutSum h a F)) (simDomain h qs) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(cutSum h a F)) (x, t)‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(F 0)) (x, t)‖ + C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (- L k)) ∧ (∀ J k : ℕ, k ≤ J → ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → a J * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < 1 / 2 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => (↿(cutSum h a F)) z - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), (↿(F j)) z) (x, t)‖ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ J * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * ((J : ℝ) + 1) / 2 - L k))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h qs γ L a V _ _ F hh0 hh1 hqs0 hqs1 hγ hS ha1 ha2 hF hsupp hglob
  
  have lf_tsum : ∀ (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (G : ℕ → ℝ³ × ℝ → V), IsOpen O → (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (G j) O) →
      (∀ w ∈ O, ∃ U ∈ nhds w, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ j, n ≤ j → ∀ z ∈ U, G j z = 0) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∑' j, G j z) O ∧
      ∀ w ∈ O, ∀ U ∈ nhds w, ∀ n : ℕ, (∀ j, n ≤ j → ∀ z ∈ U, G j z = 0) → ∀ k : ℕ,
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => ∑' j, G j z) w = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (G j) w := by
    intro O G hO hG hlfG
    have key : ∀ U : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ), ∀ n : ℕ, (∀ j, n ≤ j → ∀ z ∈ U, G j z = 0) → ∀ z ∈ U,
        ∑' j, G j z = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, G j z := by
      intro U n hU z hz
      apply tsum_eq_sum
      intro b hb
      exact hU b (by simpa using hb) z hz
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨U, hU, n, hn⟩ := hlfG w hw
      refine ⟨interior U, isOpen_interior, mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr hU, ?_⟩
      have hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, G j z) O :=
        ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ => hG j)
      exact (hs.mono inter_subset_left).congr (fun z hz => key U n hn z (interior_subset hz.2))
    · intro w hw U hU n hn k
      have hev : (fun z => ∑' j, G j z) =ᶠ[nhds w] (fun z => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, G j z) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hU (fun z hz => key U n hn z hz)
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
      have h2 : (fun z => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, G j z) = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, G j := by
        funext z; simp [Finset.sum_apply]
      rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hO hw, h2,
        iteratedFDerivWithin_sum_apply hO.uniqueDiffOn hw
          (fun j _ => ((hG j) w hw).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hO hw)
  have hgeom : ∀ n : ℕ, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (i + 1) ≤ 1 := by
    intro n
    simp_rw [pow_succ]
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    have := sum_geometric_two_le n
    linarith
  
  set Q : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ := fun w => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) with hQdef
  have hS1o : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
  have hQs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Q {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
    have hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      ((contDiff_piLp_apply 2 (i := (2 : Fin 3))).comp contDiff_fst).prodMk
        (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd)
    exact hS.2.2.2.1.comp hΦ.contDiffOn
      (fun w hw => ⟨mem_univ _, show (0 : ℝ) < 1 - w.2 by have : w.2 < 1 := hw; linarith⟩)
  have hΩS1 : simDomain h qs ⊆ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := fun w hw => hw.1
  have hΩo : IsOpen (simDomain h qs) :=
    hQs.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hS1o (isOpen_Iio (a := qs))
  have hQpos : ∀ w ∈ simDomain h qs, 0 < Q w ∧ Q w ≤ 1 := by
    intro w hw
    have h1 : w.2 < 1 := hw.1
    have h2 : Q w < qs := hw.2
    exact ⟨(hS.1 (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) (by linarith)).1, by linarith⟩
  
  have hcut1 : ∀ (b : ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), b * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≤ 1 / 2 →
      simCut h b x t = 1 := by
    intro b x t hb
    unfold simCut
    exact Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith)
  have hcut0 : ∀ (b : ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), 1 ≤ b * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) →
      simCut h b x t = 0 := by
    intro b x t hb
    unfold simCut
    exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
  have hcs : ∀ b : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(simCut h b)) (simDomain h qs) := by
    intro b
    have hin : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => 2 - 2 * (b * Q w)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
      contDiffOn_const.sub (contDiffOn_const.mul (contDiffOn_const.mul hQs))
    exact ((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := ⊤)).comp_contDiffOn hin).mono hΩS1
  
  set T : ℕ → ℝ³ × ℝ → V := fun j => ↿(fun y s => simCut h (a j) y s • F j y s) with hTdef
  have hTs : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (T j) (simDomain h qs) := fun j => (hcs (a j)).smul (hF j)
  have hapow : ∀ j : ℕ, (2 : ℝ) ^ j ≤ a j := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => simpa using ha1 0
    | succ j ih => rw [pow_succ]; linarith [ha2 j]
  have hamono : Monotone a := monotone_nat_of_le_succ (fun j => by linarith [ha1 j, ha2 j])
  have hlf : ∀ w ∈ simDomain h qs, ∃ U ∈ nhds w, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ j, n ≤ j → ∀ z ∈ U, T j z = 0 := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨hq0, -⟩ := hQpos w hw
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := pow_unbounded_of_one_lt (2 / Q w) (one_lt_two : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
    refine ⟨{w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩ Q ⁻¹' Ioi (Q w / 2), ?_, n, ?_⟩
    · exact (hQs.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hS1o isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds
        ⟨hw.1, show Q w / 2 < Q w by linarith⟩
    · intro j hj z hz
      have hz2 : Q w / 2 < Q z := hz.2
      have h2n : (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤ a j := (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hj).trans (hapow j)
      have e : 2 / Q w * (Q w / 2) = 1 := by field_simp
      have hprod : 1 < (2 : ℝ) ^ n * (Q w / 2) := by
        have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hn (show 0 < Q w / 2 by linarith)
        rw [e] at this
        exact this
      have hle : (2 : ℝ) ^ n * (Q w / 2) ≤ a j * Q z :=
        mul_le_mul h2n hz2.le (by linarith) (by linarith [ha1 j])
      have hc : simCut h (a j) z.1 z.2 = 0 :=
        hcut0 (a j) z.1 z.2 (by show 1 ≤ a j * Q z; linarith)
      show simCut h (a j) z.1 z.2 • F j z.1 z.2 = 0
      rw [hc, zero_smul]
  
  have hstar : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ j → ∀ w ∈ simDomain h qs,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (T j) w‖ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ j * Q w ^ (γ * (j : ℝ) / 2 - L k) := by
    intro j hj k hk w hw
    by_cases hc : a j * Q w ≤ 1
    · exact hsupp j hj k hk w.1 w.2 hw hc
    · push_neg at hc
      have hVo : IsOpen (simDomain h qs ∩ (fun z => a j * Q z) ⁻¹' Ioi 1) :=
        (continuousOn_const.mul (hQs.continuousOn.mono hΩS1)).isOpen_inter_preimage hΩo isOpen_Ioi
      have hev : T j =ᶠ[nhds w] fun _ => (0 : V) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hVo.mem_nhds ⟨hw, hc⟩) (fun z hz => by
          have hz2 : 1 < a j * Q z := hz.2
          show simCut h (a j) z.1 z.2 • F j z.1 z.2 = 0
          rw [hcut0 (a j) z.1 z.2 hz2.le, zero_smul])
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Real.rpow_nonneg (hQpos w hw).1.le _)
  
  have hcutSum_eq : ↿(cutSum h a F) = fun z => ↿(F 0) z + ∑' i : ℕ, T (i + 1) z := by
    funext z; rfl
  have hT1lf : ∀ w ∈ simDomain h qs, ∃ U ∈ nhds w, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ i, n ≤ i → ∀ z ∈ U,
      T (i + 1) z = 0 := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨U, hU, n, hn⟩ := hlf w hw
    exact ⟨U, hU, n, fun i hi z hz => hn (i + 1) (by omega) z hz⟩
  obtain ⟨hsum1, hder1⟩ := lf_tsum (simDomain h qs) (fun i => T (i + 1)) hΩo
    (fun i => hTs (i + 1)) hT1lf
  have hi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(cutSum h a F)) (simDomain h qs) := by
    rw [hcutSum_eq]; exact (hF 0).add hsum1
  
  have hii : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(cutSum h a F)) (x, t)‖ ≤
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(F 0)) (x, t)‖ + C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (- L k) := by
    intro k
    have hglob' := fun j (hj : 1 ≤ j) => hglob j hj k
    choose! C0 hC0 using hglob'
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, |C0 j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by rw [hM]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    refine ⟨1 + 2 ^ k * M, fun x t hw => ?_⟩
    have hq := hQpos (x, t) hw
    have hq0 : 0 < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) := hq.1
    have hq1 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≤ 1 := hq.2
    obtain ⟨U, hU, n, hn⟩ := hT1lf (x, t) hw
    have hD := hder1 (x, t) hw U hU n hn k
    have hA : ContDiffAt ℝ k (↿(F 0)) (x, t) :=
      ((hF 0).contDiffAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hw)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hB : ContDiffAt ℝ k (fun z => ∑' i : ℕ, T (i + 1) z) (x, t) :=
      (hsum1.contDiffAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hw)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e : (fun z => ↿(F 0) z + ∑' i : ℕ, T (i + 1) z) =
        ↿(F 0) + (fun z => ∑' i : ℕ, T (i + 1) z) := rfl
    rw [hcutSum_eq, e, iteratedFDeriv_add_apply hA hB, hD]
    refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add le_rfl ?_)
    refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : ℝ, p = simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-L k) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := by rw [hp]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
    have h2kM : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * M := by positivity
    have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (T (i + 1)) (x, t)‖ ≤
        (1 / 2) ^ (i + 1) * ((1 + 2 ^ k * M) * p) := by
      intro i _
      by_cases hki : k ≤ i + 1
      · have h1 := hstar (i + 1) (by omega) k hki (x, t) hw
        have h2 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 - L k) ≤ p := by
          rw [hp]
          apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1
          have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ γ * ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 := by positivity
          linarith
        calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (T (i + 1)) (x, t)‖
            ≤ (1 / 2) ^ (i + 1) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 - L k) := h1
          _ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ (i + 1) * p := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (by positivity)
          _ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ (i + 1) * ((1 + 2 ^ k * M) * p) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by nlinarith) (by positivity)
      · push_neg at hki
        have h1 := hC0 (i + 1) (by omega) x t hw
        have h2 : |C0 (i + 1)| ≤ M := by
          rw [hM]
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |C0 j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
            (Finset.mem_range.mpr hki)
        have h3 : M ≤ (1 / 2) ^ (i + 1) * (2 ^ k * M) := by
          have e2 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (i + 1) * 2 ^ (i + 1) = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
          have h4 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (i + 1) ≤ 2 ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hki.le
          have h5 : (0 : ℝ) < (1 / 2) ^ (i + 1) := by positivity
          have h6 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 2) ^ (i + 1) * 2 ^ k := by nlinarith
          nlinarith
        calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (T (i + 1)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C0 (i + 1) * p := by rw [hp]; exact h1
          _ ≤ |C0 (i + 1)| * p := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hp0
          _ ≤ M * p := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 hp0
          _ ≤ ((1 / 2) ^ (i + 1) * (2 ^ k * M)) * p := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h3 hp0
          _ = (1 / 2) ^ (i + 1) * (2 ^ k * M * p) := by ring
          _ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ (i + 1) * ((1 + 2 ^ k * M) * p) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by nlinarith) (by positivity)
    have hCp : 0 ≤ (1 + 2 ^ k * M) * p := by positivity
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (T (i + 1)) (x, t)‖
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (1 / 2) ^ (i + 1) * ((1 + 2 ^ k * M) * p) := Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
      _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (i + 1)) * ((1 + 2 ^ k * M) * p) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      _ ≤ 1 * ((1 + 2 ^ k * M) * p) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hgeom n) hCp
      _ = (1 + 2 ^ k * M) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-L k) := by rw [hp]; ring
  
  have hiii : ∀ J k : ℕ, k ≤ J → ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs →
      a J * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < 1 / 2 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => (↿(cutSum h a F)) z - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), (↿(F j)) z)
          (x, t)‖ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ J * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * ((J : ℝ) + 1) / 2 - L k) := by
    intro J k hkJ x t hw hJ
    have hNo : IsOpen (simDomain h qs ∩ (fun z => a J * Q z) ⁻¹' Iio (1 / 2)) :=
      (continuousOn_const.mul (hQs.continuousOn.mono hΩS1)).isOpen_inter_preimage hΩo isOpen_Iio
    have hclaimA : ∀ z ∈ simDomain h qs ∩ (fun z => a J * Q z) ⁻¹' Iio (1 / 2), ∀ j, j ≤ J →
        T j z = ↿(F j) z := by
      intro z hz j hj
      have hz2 : a J * Q z < 1 / 2 := hz.2
      have hqz := (hQpos z hz.1).1
      have : a j * Q z ≤ a J * Q z := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hamono hj) hqz.le
      show simCut h (a j) z.1 z.2 • F j z.1 z.2 = F j z.1 z.2
      rw [hcut1 (a j) z.1 z.2 (by show a j * Q z ≤ 1 / 2; linarith), one_smul]
    have hTJlf : ∀ w ∈ simDomain h qs, ∃ U ∈ nhds w, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ i, n ≤ i → ∀ z ∈ U,
        T (i + J + 1) z = 0 := by
      intro w hw'
      obtain ⟨U, hU, n, hn⟩ := hlf w hw'
      exact ⟨U, hU, n, fun i hi z hz => hn (i + J + 1) (by omega) z hz⟩
    obtain ⟨-, hderJ⟩ := lf_tsum (simDomain h qs) (fun i => T (i + J + 1)) hΩo
      (fun i => hTs (i + J + 1)) hTJlf
    have hclaimB : ∀ z ∈ simDomain h qs ∩ (fun z => a J * Q z) ⁻¹' Iio (1 / 2),
        (↿(cutSum h a F)) z - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), (↿(F j)) z = ∑' i, T (i + J + 1) z := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨U', hU', n', hn'⟩ := hT1lf z hz.1
      have hsum : Summable (fun i => T (i + 1) z) := by
        apply summable_of_ne_finset_zero (s := Finset.range n')
        intro b hb
        exact hn' b (by simpa using hb) z (mem_of_mem_nhds hU')
      have e1 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range J, T (i + 1) z + ∑' i, T (i + J + 1) z = ∑' i, T (i + 1) z :=
        hsum.sum_add_tsum_nat_add J
      have e2 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range J, T (i + 1) z = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range J, (↿(F (i + 1))) z :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => hclaimA z hz (i + 1) (by simp at hi; omega))
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', congrFun hcutSum_eq z]
      show (↿(F 0)) z + ∑' i : ℕ, T (i + 1) z - _ = _
      rw [← e1, e2]
      abel
    have hev : (fun z => (↿(cutSum h a F)) z - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), (↿(F j)) z)
        =ᶠ[nhds (x, t)] (fun z => ∑' i, T (i + J + 1) z) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hNo.mem_nhds ⟨hw, hJ⟩) hclaimB
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
    obtain ⟨U, hU, n, hn⟩ := hTJlf (x, t) hw
    rw [hderJ (x, t) hw U hU n hn k]
    refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
    have hq := hQpos (x, t) hw
    have hq0 : 0 < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) := hq.1
    have hq1 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≤ 1 := hq.2
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * ((J : ℝ) + 1) / 2 - L k) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := by rw [hr]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
    have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (T (i + J + 1)) (x, t)‖ ≤
        (1 / 2) ^ J * ((1 / 2) ^ (i + 1) * r) := by
      intro i _
      have h1 := hstar (i + J + 1) (by omega) k (by omega) (x, t) hw
      have h2 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * ((i + J + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 - L k) ≤ r := by
        rw [hr]
        apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1
        push_cast
        have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ γ * (i : ℝ) := by positivity
        linarith
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (T (i + J + 1)) (x, t)‖
          ≤ (1 / 2) ^ (i + J + 1) *
              simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * ((i + J + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 - L k) := h1
        _ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ (i + J + 1) * r := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (by positivity)
        _ = (1 / 2) ^ J * ((1 / 2) ^ (i + 1) * r) := by ring
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (T (i + J + 1)) (x, t)‖
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (1 / 2) ^ J * ((1 / 2) ^ (i + 1) * r) := Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
      _ = (1 / 2) ^ J * ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (i + 1)) * r) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ J * (1 * r) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hgeom n) hr0) (by positivity)
      _ = (1 / 2) ^ J * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (γ * ((J : ℝ) + 1) / 2 - L k) := by
          rw [hr, one_mul]
  exact ⟨hi, hii, hiii⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h qs : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (Bv : ℕ → ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → SimScaleProps h → (∀ j, 1 ≤ a j) → (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) → (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(Bv j)) (simDomain h qs)) → (∀ (j : ℕ) x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → divergence (fun y => Bv j y t) x = 0 ∧ inner ℝ x (Bv j x t) = (0 : ℝ) ∧ Bv j x t 2 = 0) → ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → divergence (fun y => cutSum h a Bv y t) x = 0 ∧ inner ℝ x (cutSum h a Bv x t) = (0 : ℝ)

signature.name: cutSum_div_tangent
signature.statement: ∀ (h qs : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (Bv : ℕ → ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → SimScaleProps h → (∀ j, 1 ≤ a j) → (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) → (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(Bv j)) (simDomain h qs)) → (∀ (j : ℕ) x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → divergence (fun y => Bv j y t) x = 0 ∧ inner ℝ x (Bv j x t) = (0 : ℝ) ∧ Bv j x t 2 = 0) → ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → divergence (fun y => cutSum h a Bv y t) x = 0 ∧ inner ℝ x (cutSum h a Bv x t) = (0 : ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h qs a Bv hh0 hh1 hqs0 hqs1 hS ha1 ha2 hBv hdiv x t hxt
  have ht : t < 1 := hxt.1
  have hτ : (0:ℝ) < 1 - t := by linarith
  
  have hScont : Continuous (fun y : ℝ³ => simScale h (y 2) (1 - t)) :=
    hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.comp_continuous (f := fun y : ℝ³ => ((y 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ))
      (by fun_prop) (fun y => ⟨mem_univ _, hτ⟩)
  
  have hΩ : IsOpen (simDomain h qs) := by
    have hc : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.comp
        (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ))).continuousOn
        (fun w hw => ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 by have : w.2 < 1 := hw; linarith⟩)
    exact hc.isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const) isOpen_Iio
  
  have hBd : ∀ j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => Bv j y t) x := by
    intro j
    have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => Bv j y t) x :=
      ((hBv j).contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hxt)).comp x
        ((contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt)
    exact hc.differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have hcut : ∀ c : ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => simCut h c y t) x ∧
      ∀ v : ℝ³, v 2 = 0 → fderiv ℝ (fun y => simCut h c y t) x v = 0 := by
    intro c
    have hgd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => simScale h z (1 - t)) (x 2) := by
      have hc0 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ((x 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) :=
        hS.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt ((isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds
          (show ((x 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ univ ×ˢ Ioi 0 from ⟨mem_univ _, hτ⟩))
      have hc1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ => ((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ)) (x 2) :=
        (contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt
      exact (hc0.comp (x 2) hc1).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => 2 - 2 * (c * simScale h z (1 - t))) (x 2) :=
      (differentiableAt_const _).sub ((differentiableAt_const _).mul ((differentiableAt_const _).mul hgd))
    have hψd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * (c * simScale h z (1 - t)))) (x 2) :=
      ((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).differentiable (by norm_num) _).comp (x 2) h1
    have hproj : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => y 2) (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) x :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
    have hF : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => simCut h c y t)
        (deriv (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * (c * simScale h z (1 - t)))) (x 2) •
          (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)) x :=
      HasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt (f := fun y : ℝ³ => y 2)
        (h₂ := fun z => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * (c * simScale h z (1 - t)))) x
        hψd.hasDerivAt hproj
    refine ⟨hF.differentiableAt, fun v hv => ?_⟩
    rw [hF.fderiv]
    simp [hv]
  
  have ha_pow : ∀ j : ℕ, (2:ℝ) ^ j ≤ a j := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => simpa using ha1 0
    | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ]; linarith [ha2 k]
  obtain ⟨q0, hq0⟩ : ∃ q0, q0 = simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hq0pos : 0 < q0 := by rw [hq0]; exact (hS.1 (x 2) (1 - t) hτ).1
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := pow_unbounded_of_one_lt (2 / q0) (one_lt_two : (1:ℝ) < 2)
  have hUn : {y : ℝ³ | q0 / 2 < simScale h (y 2) (1 - t)} ∈ nhds x :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const hScont).mem_nhds (by show q0 / 2 < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t); rw [← hq0]; linarith)
  have hzero : ∀ y ∈ {y : ℝ³ | q0 / 2 < simScale h (y 2) (1 - t)}, ∀ j, n ≤ j → simCut h (a j) y t = 0 := by
    intro y hy j hj
    have hy' : q0 / 2 < simScale h (y 2) (1 - t) := hy
    have h2j : (2:ℝ) ^ n ≤ a j := (pow_le_pow_right₀ one_le_two hj).trans (ha_pow j)
    have hprod : 1 < a j * simScale h (y 2) (1 - t) := by
      have e : 2 / q0 * (q0 / 2) = 1 := by field_simp
      calc (1:ℝ) = 2 / q0 * (q0 / 2) := e.symm
        _ < 2 ^ n * (q0 / 2) := by apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hn; positivity
        _ ≤ a j * (q0 / 2) := by apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2j; positivity
        _ < a j * simScale h (y 2) (1 - t) := by
          apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy'; linarith [ha1 j]
    unfold simCut
    exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
  
  have hEq : ∀ y ∈ {y : ℝ³ | q0 / 2 < simScale h (y 2) (1 - t)}, cutSum h a Bv y t =
      Bv 0 y t + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, simCut h (a (i + 1)) y t • Bv (i + 1) y t := by
    intro y hy
    simp only [cutSum]
    congr 1
    apply tsum_eq_sum
    intro b hb
    rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hb
    rw [hzero y hy (b + 1) (by omega), zero_smul]
  have hev : (fun y => cutSum h a Bv y t) =ᶠ[nhds x]
      (fun y => Bv 0 y t + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, simCut h (a (i + 1)) y t • Bv (i + 1) y t) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hUn hEq
  
  have hTd : ∀ i : ℕ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => simCut h (a (i + 1)) y t • Bv (i + 1) y t) x :=
    fun i => (hcut (a (i + 1))).1.smul (hBd (i + 1))
  have hTdiv : ∀ i : ℕ, divergence (fun y => simCut h (a (i + 1)) y t • Bv (i + 1) y t) x = 0 := by
    intro i
    have dsf : ∀ (φ : ℝ³ → ℝ) (V : ℝ³ → ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ φ x → DifferentiableAt ℝ V x →
        divergence (fun y => φ y • V y) x = φ x * divergence V x + fderiv ℝ φ x (V x) := by
      intro φ V hφ hV
      rw [divergence, fderiv_fun_smul hφ hV, ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_add,
        ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_smul, map_add, map_smul, divergence, smul_eq_mul]
      congr 1
      have hh : ((fderiv ℝ φ x).smulRight (V x) : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ³) =
          (fderiv ℝ φ x : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (V x) := rfl
      rw [hh, LinearMap.trace_smulRight]
      rfl
    have key := dsf (fun y => simCut h (a (i + 1)) y t) (fun y => Bv (i + 1) y t)
      (hcut (a (i + 1))).1 (hBd (i + 1))
    rw [key]
    obtain ⟨d1, -, d3⟩ := hdiv (i + 1) x t hxt
    rw [d1, (hcut (a (i + 1))).2 _ d3]
    simp
  have hsum : ∀ s : Finset ℕ,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ∑ i ∈ s, simCut h (a (i + 1)) y t • Bv (i + 1) y t) x ∧
      divergence (fun y => ∑ i ∈ s, simCut h (a (i + 1)) y t • Bv (i + 1) y t) x = 0 := by
    intro s
    refine Finset.induction_on s ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Finset.sum_empty]
      exact ⟨differentiableAt_const _, divergence_const _ _⟩
    · intro i s hi ih
      have e : (fun y => ∑ j ∈ insert i s, simCut h (a (j + 1)) y t • Bv (j + 1) y t) =
          fun y => simCut h (a (i + 1)) y t • Bv (i + 1) y t +
            ∑ j ∈ s, simCut h (a (j + 1)) y t • Bv (j + 1) y t := by
        funext y
        rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]
      rw [e]
      exact ⟨(hTd i).add ih.1, by rw [divergence_add (hTd i) ih.1, hTdiv i, ih.2, add_zero]⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have hdeq : divergence (fun y => cutSum h a Bv y t) x =
        divergence (fun y => Bv 0 y t + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, simCut h (a (i + 1)) y t • Bv (i + 1) y t) x := by
      unfold divergence
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    rw [hdeq, divergence_add (hBd 0) (hsum (Finset.range n)).1, (hdiv 0 x t hxt).1,
      (hsum (Finset.range n)).2, add_zero]
  · rw [hEq x (mem_of_mem_nhds hUn), inner_add_right, inner_sum, (hdiv 0 x t hxt).2.1, zero_add]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i _
    rw [real_inner_smul_right, (hdiv (i + 1) x t hxt).2.1, mul_zero]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (F : ℝ³ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → ∀ (i : Fin 3) (x : ℝ³), Δ (pd i F) x = pd i (Δ F) x

signature.name: laplacian_pd_comm
signature.statement: ∀ (F : ℝ³ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → ∀ (i : Fin 3) (x : ℝ³), Δ (pd i F) x = pd i (Δ F) x

proof.tactics:
by
  have A1 : ∀ (j : Fin 3) (f : ℝ³ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pd j f) := by
    intro j f hf
    show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))
    exact (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hf).2.clm_apply contDiff_const
  have A2 : ∀ (G : ℝ³ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ G → ∀ (a b : Fin 3) (y : ℝ³),
      pd a (pd b G) y = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ G) y (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)
        (EuclideanSpace.single b 1) := by
    intro G hG a b y
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ G) y :=
      ((contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hG).2.differentiable (by simp)) y
    show fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ G z (EuclideanSpace.single b 1)) y
      (EuclideanSpace.single a 1) = _
    rw [fderiv_clm_apply hd (differentiableAt_const _)]
    simp
  have S1 : ∀ (H : ℝ³ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ H → ∀ (a b : Fin 3) (y : ℝ³),
      pd a (pd b H) y = pd b (pd a H) y := by
    intro H hH a b y
    rw [A2 H hH, A2 H hH]
    have hs : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ H y :=
      hH.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField])
    exact hs _ _
  have S2 : ∀ (G : ℝ³ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ G → ∀ y, Δ G y = ∑ k : Fin 3, pd k (pd k G) y := by
    intro G hG y
    rw [InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_orthonormalBasis G
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    rw [A2 G hG, iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
    simp
  intro F hF i x
  have hpk : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pd k (pd k F)) := fun k => A1 k _ (A1 k F hF)
  have hΔF : Δ F = fun y => ∑ k : Fin 3, pd k (pd k F) y := funext (S2 F hF)
  have hswap : ∀ k, pd k (pd i F) = pd i (pd k F) := fun k => funext (S1 F hF k i)
  rw [S2 _ (A1 i F hF) x, hΔF]
  have hsum : pd i (fun y => ∑ k : Fin 3, pd k (pd k F) y) x
      = ∑ k : Fin 3, pd i (pd k (pd k F)) x := by
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∑ k : Fin 3, pd k (pd k F) y) x (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) = _
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun k _ => ((hpk k).differentiable (by simp)) x),
      ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
    rfl
  rw [hsum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
  rw [hswap k]
  exact S1 (pd k F) (A1 k F hF) k i x

signature.name: stress_pressure_laplacian
signature.statement: ∀ (G : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ³ → ℝ), (∀ k l, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (G k l) ∧ Integrable (G k l)) → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (stressPressure G) ∧ ∀ x, Δ (stressPressure G) x = - ∑ k, ∑ l, pd k (pd l (G k l)) x

proof.tactics:
by
  intro G hG
  have h2 : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by simp
  obtain ⟨hKs, hK1, -, hKd⟩ := far_kernel_basic
  set K : ℝ³ → ℝ := fun z => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z with hKdef
  set Kn : ℝ³ → ℝ := fun z => newtonKernel z - K z with hKndef
  
  have hKn0 : ∀ z : ℝ³, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → Kn z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    show newtonKernel z - K z = 0
    rw [show K z = newtonKernel z from hK1 z hz, sub_self]
  have hKcont : Continuous K := hKs.continuous
  have hKnInt : Integrable Kn := by
    have hΓ : IntegrableOn newtonKernel (Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) 1) :=
      (newton_kernel_ball_integral 1 one_pos).1
    have hKon : IntegrableOn K (Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) 1) :=
      (hKcont.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℝ³) 1)).mono_set
        Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
    have hsub : IntegrableOn Kn (Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) 1) := hΓ.sub hKon
    refine (integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset ?_).mp hsub
    intro z hz
    rw [Function.mem_support] at hz
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
    by_contra hc
    exact hz (hKn0 z (not_lt.mp hc))
  
  have hNewton : ∀ g : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → Integrable g →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (newtonPot g) ∧ ∀ x, Δ (newtonPot g) x = - g x := by
    intro g hg hgi
    obtain ⟨hFarInt, hFarS, hFarΔ⟩ := conv_bounded_deriv_kernel g K hgi hKs hKd
    have hloc : ∀ x₀ : ℝ³, ∃ H : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ H ∧ newtonPot g =ᶠ[nhds x₀] H ∧
        Δ H x₀ = - g x₀ := by
      intro x₀
      obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ : ∃ η : ContDiffBump x₀, η.rIn = 2 :=
        ⟨⟨2, 3, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩, rfl⟩
      have hη1 : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ 2, η y = 1 := fun y hy =>
        η.one_of_mem_closedBall (by rw [hη]; exact Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy)
      set h : ℝ³ → ℝ := fun y => η y * g y with hhdef
      have hh : ContDiff ℝ ∞ h := η.contDiff.mul hg
      have hhc : HasCompactSupport h := η.hasCompactSupport.mul_right (f' := g)
      have hhd : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n h z‖ ≤ C := fun n =>
        (hh.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (m := n) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).bounded_above_of_compact_support
          (hhc.iteratedFDeriv n)
      obtain ⟨hNearInt, hNearS, hNearΔ⟩ := conv_bounded_deriv_kernel Kn h hKnInt hh hhd
      have hagree : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ 1, ∀ t : ℝ³, Kn t * h (x - t) = Kn t * g (x - t) := by
        intro x hx t
        by_cases ht : 1 ≤ ‖t‖
        · rw [hKn0 t ht, zero_mul, zero_mul]
        · push_neg at ht
          have hmem : x - t ∈ Metric.ball x₀ 2 := by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hx ⊢
            calc ‖x - t - x₀‖ = ‖(x - x₀) - t‖ := by congr 1; abel
              _ ≤ ‖x - x₀‖ + ‖t‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
              _ < 2 := by linarith
          show Kn t * (η (x - t) * g (x - t)) = Kn t * g (x - t)
          rw [hη1 _ hmem, one_mul]
      refine ⟨(fun x => ∫ t, Kn t * h (x - t)) + (fun x => ∫ t, g t * K (x - t)),
        hNearS.add hFarS, ?_, ?_⟩
      · refine Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds x₀ one_pos) (fun x hx => ?_)
        show newtonPot g x = (∫ t, Kn t * h (x - t)) + ∫ t, g t * K (x - t)
        have e1 : newtonPot g x = ∫ t, newtonKernel t * g (x - t) := by
          have := integral_sub_left_eq_self (fun t => newtonKernel t * g (x - t))
            (volume : Measure ℝ³) x
          simp only [sub_sub_cancel] at this
          exact this
        have e2 : (∫ t, g t * K (x - t)) = ∫ t, g (x - t) * K t := by
          have := integral_sub_left_eq_self (fun t => g t * K (x - t)) (volume : Measure ℝ³) x
          simp only [sub_sub_cancel] at this
          exact this.symm
        have hI2 : Integrable (fun t => g (x - t) * K t) := by
          have := (hFarInt x).comp_sub_left x
          simp only [sub_sub_cancel] at this
          exact this
        rw [e1, e2, ← integral_add (hNearInt x) hI2]
        congr 1
        funext t
        rw [hagree x hx t]
        show newtonKernel t * g (x - t) = (newtonKernel t - K t) * g (x - t) + g (x - t) * K t
        ring
      · rw [ContDiffAt.laplacian_add (hNearS.contDiffAt.of_le h2) (hFarS.contDiffAt.of_le h2),

subgoal_signatures.name: conv_bounded_deriv_kernel
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (A B : ℝ³ → ℝ), Integrable A → ContDiff ℝ ∞ B → (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n B z‖ ≤ C) → (∀ x, Integrable (fun t => A t * B (x - t))) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ t, A t * B (x - t)) ∧ ∀ x, Δ (fun x => ∫ t, A t * B (x - t)) x = ∫ t, A t * Δ B (x - t)

subgoal_signatures.name: newton_kernel_ball_integral
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → IntegrableOn newtonKernel (Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) r) ∧ ∫ z in Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) r, newtonKernel z = r ^ 2 / 2

subgoal_signatures.name: far_kernel_basic
subgoal_signatures.statement: ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z) ∧ (∀ z : ℝ³, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z = newtonKernel z) ∧ (∀ z : ℝ³, 0 ≤ Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z ∧ Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z ≤ newtonKernel z) ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℝ³, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z : ℝ³ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z) z‖ ≤ C

subgoal_signatures.name: green_local
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ³ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → ∀ x : ℝ³, (∫ y, (newtonKernel (x - y) - Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel (x - y)) * Δ g y) + (∫ y, Δ (fun z : ℝ³ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z) (x - y) * g y) = - g x
