  have hVsum : ∑ i, pd i (fun y => (Δ (fun z => w z t) y) i) x = 0 := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, hV 0, hV 1, hV 2, hpdlap _ (hwti 0) 0,
      hpdlap _ (hwti 1) 1, hpdlap _ (hwti 2) 2]
    refine lap3 _ _ _ (hcdpd 0 _ (hwti 0)) (hcdpd 1 _ (hwti 1)) (hcdpd 2 _ (hwti 2))
      (fun y => ?_)
    have := hdivsum _ y (hwt.differentiable (by simp) y)
    rw [hdiv y t htI, Fin.sum_univ_three] at this
    linarith
  
  have hGt : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => g i j y t) := fun i j => slice (g i j) _ t (hg i j) htI
  have hπt : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => π y t) := slice π _ t hπ htI
  have hstar : ∀ i : Fin 3, pd i (fun y => deriv (fun s => w y s i) t) x
      + ∑ j, pd i (pd j (fun y => g i j y t)) x
      - ν * pd i (fun y => (Δ (fun z => w z t) y) i) x + pd i (pd i (fun y => π y t)) x = 0 := by
    intro i
    have hE : (fun y => deriv (fun s => w y s i) t + ∑ j, pd j (fun y => g i j y t) y
        - ν * (Δ (fun z => w z t) y) i + pd i (fun y => π y t) y) = fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
      funext y
      have := hEQ y t ht i
      linarith
    have hd1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => deriv (fun s => w y s i) t) x :=
      (htime (fun y s => w y s i) ((hcomp i).mono hsub) i).1
    have hd2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ∑ j, pd j (fun y => g i j y t) y) x :=
      (ContDiff.sum (fun j _ => hcdpd j _ (hGt i j))).differentiable (by simp) x
    have hd3 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (Δ (fun z => w z t) y) i) x := by
      rw [hV i, show Δ (fun y => w y t i) = fun y => ∑ k, pd k (pd k (fun y => w y t i)) y
        from funext (hlap _ (hwti i))]
      exact (ContDiff.sum (fun k _ => hcdpd k _ (hcdpd k _ (hwti i)))).differentiable (by simp) x
    have hd4 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd i (fun y => π y t)) x :=
      (hcdpd i _ hπt).differentiable (by simp) x
    have hH : HasFDerivAt (fun y => deriv (fun s => w y s i) t + ∑ j, pd j (fun y => g i j y t) y
        - ν * (Δ (fun z => w z t) y) i + pd i (fun y => π y t) y)
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => deriv (fun s => w y s i) t) x
          + fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∑ j, pd j (fun y => g i j y t) y) x
          - ν • fderiv ℝ (fun y => (Δ (fun z => w z t) y) i) x
          + fderiv ℝ (pd i (fun y => π y t)) x) x :=
      ((hd1.hasFDerivAt.add hd2.hasFDerivAt).sub (hd3.hasFDerivAt.const_mul ν)).add hd4.hasFDerivAt
    rw [hE] at hH
    have hz := hH.unique (hasFDerivAt_const (0:ℝ) x)
    have hz2 := congrArg (fun L : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) hz
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => (hcdpd j _ (hGt i j)).differentiable (by simp) x)] at hz2
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply] at hz2
    exact hz2
  
  rw [hlap _ hπt x]
  have s0 := hstar 0
  have s1 := hstar 1
  have s2 := hstar 2
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hTsum hVsum
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at s0 s1 s2 ⊢
  linear_combination s0 + s1 + s2 - hTsum + ν * hVsum

informal_problem.statement: ∃ ρ : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ρ ∧ (∀ z : ℝ³, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → ρ z = 0) ∧ ∀ F : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → (∀ y, Δ F y = 0) → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (L : ℝ), 0 < L → ∫ u, ρ u * F (x + L • u) = F x

signature.name: mean_value_kernel_exists
signature.statement: ∃ ρ : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ρ ∧ (∀ z : ℝ³, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → ρ z = 0) ∧ ∀ F : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → (∀ y, Δ F y = 0) → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (L : ℝ), 0 < L → ∫ u, ρ u * F (x + L • u) = F x

proof.tactics:
by
  have s2 : ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → (∀ s : ℝ, 1 ≤ s → ψ s = 0) → ∀ F : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → (∀ y, Δ F y = 0) → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (L : ℝ), ∫ u, 2 * deriv ψ (‖u‖ ^ 2) * fderiv ℝ F (x + L • u) u = 0 := by
    intro ψ hψ hψ1 F hF hΔ x L
    have hψd : Differentiable ℝ ψ := hψ.differentiable (by simp)
    have hΨs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u : ℝ³ => ψ (‖u‖ ^ 2)) := hψ.comp (contDiff_norm_sq ℝ)
    have hΨcs : HasCompactSupport (fun u : ℝ³ => ψ (‖u‖ ^ 2)) := by
      refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℝ³) 1) (fun z hz => hψ1 _ ?_)
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hz
      exact one_le_pow₀ hz.le
    have hΨd : Differentiable ℝ (fun u : ℝ³ => ψ (‖u‖ ^ 2)) := hΨs.differentiable (by simp)
    have hgrad : ∀ (u : ℝ³) (k : Fin 3), fderiv ℝ (fun u : ℝ³ => ψ (‖u‖ ^ 2)) u (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) = 2 * deriv ψ (‖u‖ ^ 2) * u k := by
      intro u k
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun u : ℝ³ => ψ (‖u‖ ^ 2)) (deriv ψ (‖u‖ ^ 2) • (2 • innerSL ℝ u)) u :=
        (hψd (‖u‖ ^ 2)).hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt u (hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq u).hasFDerivAt
      rw [h1.fderiv]
      simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
      ring
    have hexp : ∀ (A : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (u : ℝ³), A u = ∑ k, u k * A (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) := by
      intro A u
      conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr u]
      simp [map_sum, map_smul]
    have hF1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hF).2
    have hP : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) :=
      fun k => hF1.clm_apply contDiff_const
    have haffs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u : ℝ³ => x + L • u) := contDiff_const.add (contDiff_id.const_smul L)
    have hG : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u : ℝ³ => fderiv ℝ F (x + L • u) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) :=
      fun k => (hP k).comp haffs
    have hGd : ∀ k : Fin 3, Differentiable ℝ (fun u : ℝ³ => fderiv ℝ F (x + L • u) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) :=
      fun k => (hG k).differentiable (by simp)
    have hPder : ∀ (k : Fin 3) (y v : ℝ³), fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) y v = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y v (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) := by
      intro k y v
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply ((hF1.differentiable (by simp)) y) (differentiableAt_const _)]
      simp
    have hGder : ∀ (k : Fin 3) (u : ℝ³), fderiv ℝ (fun u : ℝ³ => fderiv ℝ F (x + L • u) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) u (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) = L * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) (x + L • u) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) := by
      intro k u
      have haff : HasFDerivAt (fun u : ℝ³ => x + L • u) (L • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ³) u := by
        simpa using ((hasFDerivAt_id u).const_smul L).const_add x
      have h2 := ((hP k).differentiable (by simp) (x + L • u)).hasFDerivAt.comp u haff
      rw [show (fun u : ℝ³ => fderiv ℝ F (x + L • u) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) = (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) ∘ (fun u : ℝ³ => x + L • u) from rfl, h2.fderiv]
      simp [hPder]
    have hlap : ∀ y, Δ F y = ∑ k : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) := by
      intro y
      rw [InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_orthonormalBasis F (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)]
      simp [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
    have hint : ∀ g h : ℝ³ → ℝ, Continuous g → Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → Integrable (fun u => g u * h u) :=
      fun g h hg hh hcs => (hg.mul hh).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hcs.mul_left (f := g))
    have hdΨc : ∀ k : Fin 3, Continuous (fun u => fderiv ℝ (fun u : ℝ³ => ψ (‖u‖ ^ 2)) u (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) :=
      fun k => (hΨs.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hdΨcs : ∀ k : Fin 3, HasCompactSupport (fun u => fderiv ℝ (fun u : ℝ³ => ψ (‖u‖ ^ 2)) u (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) :=
      fun k => hΨcs.fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) _
    have hdGc : ∀ k : Fin 3, Continuous (fun u => fderiv ℝ (fun u : ℝ³ => fderiv ℝ F (x + L • u) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) u (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) :=
      fun k => ((hG k).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hIBP : ∀ k : Fin 3, ∫ u, fderiv ℝ F (x + L • u) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) * fderiv ℝ (fun u : ℝ³ => ψ (‖u‖ ^ 2)) u (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) = -∫ u, (L * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) (x + L • u) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) * ψ (‖u‖ ^ 2) := by
      intro k
      rw [integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (hint _ _ (hdGc k) hΨs.continuous hΨcs) (hint _ _ (hG k).continuous (hdΨc k) (hdΨcs k)) (hint _ _ (hG k).continuous hΨs.continuous hΨcs) (fun u _ => hGd k u) (fun u _ => hΨd u)]
      congr 1
      refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun u => ?_))
      simp only [hGder]
    have hpt : ∀ u : ℝ³, 2 * deriv ψ (‖u‖ ^ 2) * fderiv ℝ F (x + L • u) u = ∑ k : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ F (x + L • u) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) * fderiv ℝ (fun u : ℝ³ => ψ (‖u‖ ^ 2)) u (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) := by
      intro u
      rw [hexp (fderiv ℝ F (x + L • u)) u, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      rw [hgrad]
      ring
    have hH : ∀ k : Fin 3, Continuous (fun u : ℝ³ => L * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) (x + L • u) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) := by
      intro k
      have h2 : Continuous (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F)) := hF1.continuous_fderiv (by simp)
      exact continuous_const.mul (((h2.comp haffs.continuous).clm_apply continuous_const).clm_apply continuous_const)
    calc ∫ u, 2 * deriv ψ (‖u‖ ^ 2) * fderiv ℝ F (x + L • u) u
        = ∫ u, ∑ k : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ F (x + L • u) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) * fderiv ℝ (fun u : ℝ³ => ψ (‖u‖ ^ 2)) u (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) := integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpt)
      _ = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∫ u, fderiv ℝ F (x + L • u) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) * fderiv ℝ (fun u : ℝ³ => ψ (‖u‖ ^ 2)) u (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) :=
          integral_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => hint _ _ (hG k).continuous (hdΨc k) (hdΨcs k))
      _ = ∑ k : Fin 3, -∫ u, (L * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) (x + L • u) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) * ψ (‖u‖ ^ 2) := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => hIBP k)
      _ = -∫ u, ∑ k : Fin 3, (L * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) (x + L • u) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) * ψ (‖u‖ ^ 2) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, integral_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => hint _ _ (hH k) hΨs.continuous hΨcs)]
      _ = 0 := by
          simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← hlap, hΔ]
          simp
  have s3 : ∀ (ρ₀ : ℝ³ → ℝ), Continuous ρ₀ → (∀ z : ℝ³, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → ρ₀ z = 0) → ∀ F : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (L : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ∫ u, ρ₀ u * F (x + t • u)) (∫ u, ρ₀ u * fderiv ℝ F (x + L • u) u) L := by
    intro ρ₀ hρ hv F hF x L
    have hcsOf : ∀ g : ℝ³ → ℝ, (∀ z : ℝ³, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → g z = 0) → HasCompactSupport g := by
      intro g hg
      refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℝ³) 1) (fun z hz => hg z ?_)
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hz
      exact hz.le
    have hcs : HasCompactSupport ρ₀ := hcsOf ρ₀ hv
    have hFc : Continuous F := hF.continuous
    have hdF : Continuous (fderiv ℝ F) := hF.continuous_fderiv (by simp)
    have hFd : Differentiable ℝ F := hF.differentiable (by simp)
    have haff : ∀ t : ℝ, Continuous (fun u : ℝ³ => x + t • u) := fun t => continuous_const.add (continuous_id.const_smul t)
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℝ³) (‖x‖ + |L| + 1)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hdF.continuousOn
    have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hC 0 (Metric.mem_closedBall_self (by positivity)))
    have key := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (μ := volume)
      (F := fun t u => ρ₀ u * F (x + t • u))
      (F' := fun t u => ρ₀ u * fderiv ℝ F (x + t • u) u) (x₀ := L) (bound := fun u => |ρ₀ u| * C)
      (Metric.ball_mem_nhds L one_pos)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => (hρ.mul (hFc.comp (haff t))).aestronglyMeasurable))
      ((hρ.mul (hFc.comp (haff L))).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hcs.mul_right))
      ((hρ.mul ((hdF.comp (haff L)).clm_apply continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable)
      ?_
      ((hρ.abs.mul continuous_const).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (hcsOf _ (fun z hz => by simp [hv z hz])))
      ?_
    · exact key.2
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun u t ht => ?_)
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      by_cases hu : 1 ≤ ‖u‖
      · rw [hv u hu]; simp
      · have hu' : ‖u‖ < 1 := lt_of_not_ge hu
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (abs_nonneg _)
        have ht' : |t| < |L| + 1 := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] at ht
          have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub t L
          linarith
        have htu : |t| * ‖u‖ ≤ |t| := by
          have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu'.le (abs_nonneg t)
          linarith
        have hmem : x + t • u ∈ Metric.closedBall (0:ℝ³) (‖x‖ + |L| + 1) := by
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
          calc ‖x + t • u‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖t • u‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ = ‖x‖ + |t| * ‖u‖ := by rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
            _ ≤ ‖x‖ + |L| + 1 := by linarith
        calc ‖fderiv ℝ F (x + t • u) u‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ F (x + t • u)‖ * ‖u‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
          _ ≤ C * 1 := mul_le_mul (hC _ hmem) hu'.le (norm_nonneg _) hC0
          _ = C := mul_one C
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun u t _ => ?_)
      have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => x + t • u) u t := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const u).const_add x
      exact ((hFd (x + t • u)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hγ).const_mul (ρ₀ u)
  
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψs, hψz, hψnn, hψ0, s₀, hs₀, hs₀pos⟩ : ∃ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ ∧ (∀ s : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ s → ψ s = 0) ∧ (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ deriv ψ s) ∧ (∀ s : ℝ, 1 / 2 < s → deriv ψ s = 0) ∧ ∃ s₀ : ℝ, 0 < s₀ ∧ 0 < deriv ψ s₀ := by
    refine ⟨fun s : ℝ => -Real.smoothTransition (1 - 2 * s), ?_⟩
    set ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun s : ℝ => -Real.smoothTransition (1 - 2 * s) with hψdef
    have hψs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ :=
      ((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := ⊤)).comp (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id))).neg
    have hz : ∀ s : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ s → ψ s = 0 := by
      intro s hs
      simp only [hψdef]
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), neg_zero]
    have hmono : Monotone ψ := by
      intro a b hab
      simp only [hψdef, neg_le_neg_iff]
      exact Real.smoothTransition.monotone (by linarith)
    refine ⟨hψs, hz, fun s => hmono.deriv_nonneg, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro s hs
      have hev : ψ =ᶠ[nhds s] (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hs] with y hy
        exact hz y (le_of_lt hy)
      rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
    · have hd : Differentiable ℝ ψ := hψs.differentiable (by simp)
      obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀, hder⟩ := exists_deriv_eq_slope ψ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/2)
        hd.continuous.continuousOn (fun x _ => (hd x).differentiableWithinAt)
      refine ⟨s₀, hs₀.1, ?_⟩
      rw [hder, hz (1/2) le_rfl]
      have h0 : ψ 0 = -1 := by
        simp only [hψdef]
        rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by norm_num)]
      rw [h0]; norm_num
  
  have hφs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (deriv ψ) := (contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.mp hψs).2
  obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀⟩ : ∃ ρ₀ : ℝ³ → ℝ, ρ₀ = fun u => 2 * deriv ψ (‖u‖ ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hρ₀s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ρ₀ := by
    rw [hρ₀]
    exact contDiff_const.mul (hφs.comp (contDiff_norm_sq ℝ))
  have hρ₀v : ∀ z : ℝ³, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → ρ₀ z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hρ₀]
    show 2 * deriv ψ (‖z‖ ^ 2) = 0
    rw [hψ0 (‖z‖ ^ 2) (by nlinarith [norm_nonneg z]), mul_zero]
  have hρ₀cs : HasCompactSupport ρ₀ := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℝ³) 1) (fun z hz => hρ₀v z ?_)
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hz
    exact hz.le
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = ∫ u, ρ₀ u := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hcpos : 0 < c := by
    rw [hc]
    refine Continuous.integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
      (x := Real.sqrt s₀ • EuclideanSpace.single (0:Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) hρ₀s.continuous hρ₀cs (fun u => ?_) ?_
    · simp only [hρ₀, Pi.zero_apply]
      linarith [hψnn (‖u‖ ^ 2)]
    · have hn : ‖Real.sqrt s₀ • EuclideanSpace.single (0:Fin 3) (1:ℝ)‖ ^ 2 = s₀ := by
        rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), Real.sq_sqrt hs₀.le]
      rw [hρ₀]
      show 2 * deriv ψ (‖Real.sqrt s₀ • EuclideanSpace.single (0:Fin 3) (1:ℝ)‖ ^ 2) ≠ 0
      rw [hn]
      exact ne_of_gt (by linarith)
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hcpos
  refine ⟨fun u => ρ₀ u / c, hρ₀s.div_const c, fun z hz => by simp [hρ₀v z hz], ?_⟩
  intro F hF hΔ x L _
  have hM : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ∫ u, ρ₀ u * F (x + t • u)) 0 t := by
    intro t
    have h := s3 ρ₀ hρ₀s.continuous hρ₀v F hF x t
    have h0 : ∫ u, ρ₀ u * fderiv ℝ F (x + t • u) u = 0 := by
      rw [hρ₀]
      exact s2 ψ hψs (fun s hs => hψz s (by linarith)) F hF hΔ x t
    rwa [h0] at h
  have hconst := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun t => (hM t).differentiableAt) (fun t => (hM t).deriv) L 0
  simp only [zero_smul, add_zero] at hconst
  rw [integral_mul_const, ← hc] at hconst
  show ∫ u, ρ₀ u / c * F (x + L • u) = F x
  calc ∫ u, ρ₀ u / c * F (x + L • u) = (∫ u, ρ₀ u * F (x + L • u)) / c := by
        rw [← integral_div]
        congr 1
        funext u
        ring
    _ = F x := by
        rw [hconst]
        field_simp

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hpd_cd : ∀ (j : Fin 3) (F : ℝ³ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pd j F) := by
    intro j F hF
    show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))
    exact (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hF).2.clm_apply contDiff_const
  have hpd_cs : ∀ (j : Fin 3) (F : ℝ³ → ℝ), HasCompactSupport F → HasCompactSupport (pd j F) :=
    fun j F hF => HasCompactSupport.fderiv_apply ℝ hF (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)
  have haff : ∀ (x : ℝ³) (L : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u : ℝ³ => x + L • u) :=
    fun x L => contDiff_const.add (contDiff_id.const_smul L)
  have A2 : ∀ (G : ℝ³ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ G → ∀ (a b : Fin 3) (y : ℝ³),
      pd a (pd b G) y = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ G) y (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)
        (EuclideanSpace.single b 1) := by
    intro G hG a b y
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ G) y :=
      ((contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hG).2.differentiable (by simp)) y
    show fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ G z (EuclideanSpace.single b 1)) y
      (EuclideanSpace.single a 1) = _
    rw [fderiv_clm_apply hd (differentiableAt_const _)]
    simp
  have S2 : ∀ (G : ℝ³ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ G → ∀ y, Δ G y = ∑ k : Fin 3, pd k (pd k G) y := by
    intro G hG y
    rw [InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_orthonormalBasis G
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    rw [A2 G hG, iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
    simp
  have hchain : ∀ (F : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (L : ℝ) (u v : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ F (x + L • u) →
      fderiv ℝ (fun w => F (x + L • w)) u v = L * fderiv ℝ F (x + L • u) v := by
    intro F x L u v hF
    have hA : HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ³ => x + L • w) (L • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ³) u :=
      ((hasFDerivAt_id u).const_smul L).const_add x
    have h := (hF.hasFDerivAt.comp u hA).fderiv
    rw [show (fun w => F (x + L • w)) = F ∘ (fun w => x + L • w) from rfl, h]
    simp
  
  have c1 : ∀ (φ : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (L : ℝ), 0 < L →
      ∫ u, φ (x + L • u) = (∫ y, φ y) / L ^ 3 := by
    intro φ x L hL
    have h1 := Measure.integral_comp_smul (volume : Measure ℝ³) (fun v => φ (x + v)) L
    rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin] at h1
    have h2 : ∫ u, φ (x + L • u) = |(L ^ 3)⁻¹| • ∫ v, φ (x + v) := h1
    rw [h2, integral_add_left_eq_self φ x, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (pow_pos hL 3)), smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have c2 : ∀ (ψ F : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (L : ℝ) (j : Fin 3), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → 0 < L →
      ∫ u, ψ u * pd j F (x + L • u) = -(∫ u, pd j ψ u * F (x + L • u)) / L := by
    intro ψ F x L j hψ hψc hF hL
    have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u => F (x + L • u)) := hF.comp (haff x L)
    have hFd : Differentiable ℝ F := hF.differentiable (by simp)
    have hψd : Differentiable ℝ ψ := hψ.differentiable (by simp)
    have hgd : Differentiable ℝ (fun u => F (x + L • u)) := hg.differentiable (by simp)
    have hder : ∀ u, fderiv ℝ (fun w => F (x + L • w)) u (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)
        = L * pd j F (x + L • u) :=
      fun u => hchain F x L u _ (hFd _)
    have hcontg : Continuous (fun u => F (x + L • u)) := hg.continuous
    have hcontdg : Continuous
        (fun u => fderiv ℝ (fun w => F (x + L • w)) u (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) :=
      (hg.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hcontdψ : Continuous (fun u => fderiv ℝ ψ u (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) :=
      (hψ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    have i1 : Integrable (fun u => fderiv ℝ ψ u (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) * F (x + L • u)) :=
      (hcontdψ.mul hcontg).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        ((HasCompactSupport.fderiv_apply ℝ hψc (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)).mul_right)
    have i2 : Integrable
        (fun u => ψ u * fderiv ℝ (fun w => F (x + L • w)) u (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) :=
      (hψ.continuous.mul hcontdg).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hψc.mul_right
    have i3 : Integrable (fun u => ψ u * F (x + L • u)) :=
      (hψ.continuous.mul hcontg).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hψc.mul_right
    have hibp := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable i1 i2 i3
      (fun u _ => hψd u) (fun u _ => hgd u)
    have e1 : (∫ u, ψ u * fderiv ℝ (fun w => F (x + L • w)) u (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))
        = L * ∫ u, ψ u * pd j F (x + L • u) := by
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      congr 1
      funext u
      rw [hder u]
      ring
    rw [e1] at hibp
    show _ = -(∫ u, fderiv ℝ ψ u (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) * F (x + L • u)) / L
    rw [eq_div_iff hL.ne']
    linear_combination hibp
  
  have c3 : ∀ (ψ F : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (L : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → 0 < L →
      ∫ u, ψ u * Δ F (x + L • u) = (∫ u, Δ ψ u * F (x + L • u)) / L ^ 2 := by
    intro ψ F x L hψ hψc hF hL
    have hcc : ∀ (φ G : ℝ³ → ℝ), Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → Continuous G →
        Integrable (fun u => φ u * G (x + L • u)) :=
      fun φ G hφ hφc hG =>
        (hφ.mul (hG.comp (haff x L).continuous)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hφc.mul_right
    have hcont2 : ∀ (k : Fin 3) (G : ℝ³ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ G → Continuous (pd k (pd k G)) :=
      fun k G hG => (hpd_cd k _ (hpd_cd k G hG)).continuous
    have hterm : ∀ k : Fin 3, ∫ u, ψ u * pd k (pd k F) (x + L • u)
        = (∫ u, pd k (pd k ψ) u * F (x + L • u)) / L ^ 2 := by
      intro k
      rw [c2 ψ (pd k F) x L k hψ hψc (hpd_cd k F hF) hL,
        c2 (pd k ψ) F x L k (hpd_cd k ψ hψ) (hpd_cs k ψ hψc) hF hL]
      ring
    calc ∫ u, ψ u * Δ F (x + L • u)
        = ∫ u, ∑ k : Fin 3, ψ u * pd k (pd k F) (x + L • u) := by
          congr 1; funext u; rw [S2 F hF, Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∫ u, ψ u * pd k (pd k F) (x + L • u) :=
          integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => hcc ψ _ hψ.continuous hψc (hcont2 k F hF))
      _ = ∑ k : Fin 3, (∫ u, pd k (pd k ψ) u * F (x + L • u)) / L ^ 2 :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => hterm k)
      _ = (∑ k : Fin 3, ∫ u, pd k (pd k ψ) u * F (x + L • u)) / L ^ 2 :=
          (Finset.sum_div _ _ _).symm
      _ = (∫ u, ∑ k : Fin 3, pd k (pd k ψ) u * F (x + L • u)) / L ^ 2 := by
          rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => hcc _ F (hcont2 k ψ hψ)
            (hpd_cs k _ (hpd_cs k ψ hψc)) hF.continuous)]
      _ = (∫ u, Δ ψ u * F (x + L • u)) / L ^ 2 := by
          congr 2; funext u; rw [S2 ψ hψ u, Finset.sum_mul]
  
  have c4 : ∀ (φ F : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (L : ℝ), Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      Continuous F → MemLp F 2 → 0 < L →
      |∫ u, φ u * F (x + L • u)|
        ≤ (∫ u, φ u ^ 2) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) * (∫ y, F y ^ 2) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) / L ^ ((3:ℝ)/2) := by
    intro φ F x L hφ hφc hF hF2 hL
    have hgc : Continuous (fun u => F (x + L • u)) := hF.comp (haff x L).continuous
    have hsqi : Integrable (fun u => F (x + L • u) ^ 2) :=
      (hF2.integrable_sq.comp_add_left x).comp_smul hL.ne'
    have hg2 : MemLp (fun u => F (x + L • u)) 2 :=
      (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hgc.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr hsqi
    have hφ2 : MemLp φ 2 := hφ.memLp_of_hasCompactSupport hφc
    have hH := integral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq_of_nonneg (μ := volume) Real.HolderConjugate.two_two
      (f := fun u => |φ u|) (g := fun u => |F (x + L • u)|)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun u => abs_nonneg _))
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun u => abs_nonneg _))
      (by rw [ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat]; exact hφ2.abs) (by rw [ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat]; exact hg2.abs)
    simp only [Real.rpow_two, sq_abs] at hH
    have hs : ∫ u, F (x + L • u) ^ 2 = (∫ y, F y ^ 2) / L ^ 3 := c1 (fun y => F y ^ 2) x L hL
    have hS : 0 ≤ ∫ y, F y ^ 2 := integral_nonneg (fun y => sq_nonneg _)
    have hL32 : (L ^ 3) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) = L ^ ((3:ℝ)/2) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast_mul hL.le]; norm_num
    calc |∫ u, φ u * F (x + L • u)| ≤ ∫ u, |φ u * F (x + L • u)| := abs_integral_le_integral_abs
      _ = ∫ u, |φ u| * |F (x + L • u)| := by congr 1; funext u; exact abs_mul _ _
      _ ≤ (∫ u, φ u ^ 2) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) * (∫ u, F (x + L • u) ^ 2) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) := hH
      _ = (∫ u, φ u ^ 2) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) * (∫ y, F y ^ 2) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) / L ^ ((3:ℝ)/2) := by
          rw [hs, Real.div_rpow hS (pow_pos hL 3).le, hL32, mul_div_assoc]
  
  have c5 : ∀ (φ F : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (L M : ℝ), Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      (∀ u, |φ u| ≤ M) → Continuous F → Integrable F → 0 < L →
      |∫ u, φ u * F (x + L • u)| ≤ M * (∫ y, |F y|) / L ^ 3 := by
    intro φ F x L M hφ hφc hM hF hFi hL
    have hgc : Continuous (fun u => F (x + L • u)) := hF.comp (haff x L).continuous
    have hgi : Integrable (fun u => F (x + L • u)) := (hFi.comp_add_left x).comp_smul hL.ne'
    have hpi : Integrable (fun u => φ u * F (x + L • u)) :=
      (hφ.mul hgc).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hφc.mul_right
    have hs : ∫ u, |F (x + L • u)| = (∫ y, |F y|) / L ^ 3 := c1 (fun y => |F y|) x L hL
    calc |∫ u, φ u * F (x + L • u)| ≤ ∫ u, |φ u * F (x + L • u)| := abs_integral_le_integral_abs
      _ ≤ ∫ u, M * |F (x + L • u)| := by
          refine integral_mono hpi.abs (hgi.abs.const_mul M) (fun u => ?_)
          show |φ u * F (x + L • u)| ≤ M * |F (x + L • u)|
          rw [abs_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hM u) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = M * (∫ y, |F y|) / L ^ 3 := by rw [integral_const_mul, hs, mul_div_assoc]
  
  intro ρ hρ hρ1
  have hρc : HasCompactSupport ρ := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℝ³) 1) (fun z hz => hρ1 z ?_)
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hz
    exact hz.le
  have hbd : ∀ j : Fin 3, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ u, ‖pd j ρ u‖ ≤ C := fun j =>
    (hpd_cd j ρ hρ).continuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support (hpd_cs j ρ hρc)
  choose C hC using hbd
  have hMb' : ∀ j : Fin 3, ∀ u, |pd j ρ u| ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, |C k| := by
    intro j u
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact (hC j u).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans
      (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => |C k|) (fun k _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ j)))
  obtain ⟨M, hM0, hMb⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ j : Fin 3, ∀ u, |pd j ρ u| ≤ M :=
    ⟨_, Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => abs_nonneg _), hMb'⟩
  have hΔρeq : Δ ρ = fun u => ∑ k : Fin 3, pd k (pd k ρ) u := funext (S2 ρ hρ)
  have hΔρc : Continuous (Δ ρ) := by
    rw [hΔρeq]
    exact continuous_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => (hpd_cd k _ (hpd_cd k ρ hρ)).continuous)
  have hΔρcs : HasCompactSupport (Δ ρ) := by
    rw [hΔρeq]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    exact ((hpd_cs 0 _ (hpd_cs 0 ρ hρc)).add (hpd_cs 1 _ (hpd_cs 1 ρ hρc))).add
      (hpd_cs 2 _ (hpd_cs 2 ρ hρc))
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hA0⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = (∫ u, ρ u ^ 2) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) ∧ 0 ≤ A :=
    ⟨_, rfl, Real.rpow_nonneg (integral_nonneg (fun _ => sq_nonneg _)) _⟩
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hB0⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = (∫ u, Δ ρ u ^ 2) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) ∧ 0 ≤ B :=
    ⟨_, rfl, Real.rpow_nonneg (integral_nonneg (fun _ => sq_nonneg _)) _⟩
  refine ⟨M + A + B, by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro f x L hf hL
  have hLpos : 0 < L := by linarith
  have hfc : Continuous f := hf.continuous
  have hN2 : 0 ≤ (∫ y, f y ^ 2) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) :=
    Real.rpow_nonneg (integral_nonneg (fun _ => sq_nonneg _)) _
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hfi j
    have hN1 : 0 ≤ ∫ y, |f y| := integral_nonneg (fun _ => abs_nonneg _)
    rw [c2 ρ f x L j hρ hρc hf hLpos, abs_div, abs_neg, abs_of_pos hLpos]
    have h5 := c5 (pd j ρ) f x L M (hpd_cd j ρ hρ).continuous (hpd_cs j ρ hρc) (hMb j) hfc hfi
      hLpos
    calc |∫ u, pd j ρ u * f (x + L • u)| / L ≤ M * (∫ y, |f y|) / L ^ 3 / L :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h5 hLpos.le
      _ = M * (∫ y, |f y|) / L ^ 4 := by rw [div_div, ← pow_succ]
      _ ≤ (M + A + B) * (∫ y, |f y|) / L ^ 4 :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hN1)
            (pow_pos hLpos 4).le
  · intro hf2
    have h4 := c4 ρ f x L hρ.continuous hρc hfc hf2 hLpos
    rw [← hA] at h4
    calc |∫ u, ρ u * f (x + L • u)| ≤ A * (∫ y, f y ^ 2) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) / L ^ ((3:ℝ)/2) := h4
      _ ≤ (M + A + B) * (∫ y, f y ^ 2) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) / L ^ ((3:ℝ)/2) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hN2)
            (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hLpos _).le
  · intro hf2
    rw [c3 ρ f x L hρ hρc hf hLpos, abs_div, abs_of_pos (pow_pos hLpos 2)]
    have h4 := c4 (Δ ρ) f x L hΔρc hΔρcs hfc hf2 hLpos
    rw [← hB] at h4
    have hexp : L ^ ((3:ℝ)/2) * L ^ 2 = L ^ ((7:ℝ)/2) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast L 2, ← Real.rpow_add hLpos]
      norm_num
    calc |∫ u, Δ ρ u * f (x + L • u)| / L ^ 2
        ≤ B * (∫ y, f y ^ 2) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) / L ^ ((3:ℝ)/2) / L ^ 2 :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h4 (pow_pos hLpos 2).le
      _ = B * (∫ y, f y ^ 2) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) / L ^ ((7:ℝ)/2) := by rw [div_div, hexp]
      _ ≤ (M + A + B) * (∫ y, f y ^ 2) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) / L ^ ((7:ℝ)/2) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hN2)
            (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hLpos _).le

by
  intro ρ hρ hρ1
  
  
  
  have kernel_part : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ b : ℝ³, ∫⁻ u in Metric.closedBall (0:ℝ³) 1,
      ENNReal.ofReal (newtonKernel (b + u)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C := by

            (continuous_id.div_const _).continuousOn).integrable_indicator measurableSet_Icc
        refine hI.integrableOn.congr_fun (fun r hr => ?_) measurableSet_Ioi

        · rw [indicator_of_mem (show r ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1 from ⟨hr.le, h1⟩), hf]

          simp [h1]
      have heq : ∫⁻ y in Metric.closedBall (0:ℝ³) 1, ENNReal.ofReal (newtonKernel y)
          = ∫⁻ y : ℝ³, ENNReal.ofReal (f ‖y‖) := by
        rw [← lintegral_indicator measurableSet_closedBall]
        congr 1; funext y
        by_cases h : ‖y‖ ≤ 1
        · rw [indicator_of_mem (mem_closedBall_zero_iff.2 h), hf]; simp [h, newtonKernel]
        · rw [indicator_of_notMem (fun h' => h (mem_closedBall_zero_iff.1 h')), hf]; simp [h]
      rw [heq]; exact hfi.lintegral_lt_top
    obtain ⟨CE, hCE⟩ : ∃ CE : ENNReal, CE = (∫⁻ y in Metric.closedBall (0:ℝ³) 1,

          volume (Metric.closedBall (0:ℝ³) 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩

      rw [hCE]

ns_background_exists.definitions:
noncomputable def profRadInt (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, f x η

noncomputable def profRadAvg (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, f (s * X) η

noncomputable def profEtaD (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ := deriv (fun e => g X e) η

noncomputable def leadPi (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ := -∫ x in Ioi X, F x η ^ 2

noncomputable def leadW (h : ℝ) (U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * profRadAvg U X η - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadAvg U) X η

noncomputable def leadQs (h : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -leadW h U X η +
    ((1 - h) * profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) X η
      - (1 / 2 - h) * η * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) X η
      - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))) X η
      + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * η * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) X η) /
    (X * (2 * X * F X η))

noncomputable def leadNs (h : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -leadW h U X η * U X η +
    ((1 / 2 - h) * (profRadInt U X η - η * profEtaD (profRadInt U) X η)
      + 4 * h * η * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) X η
      - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)) X η) / X
    + 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * leadPi F X η - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (leadPi F) X η

noncomputable def leadStressTh (h : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  F X η * (X * leadQs h F U X η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) - shearA F X η)

noncomputable def leadStressTz (h : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  F X η * (X * leadNs h F U X η / ((1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η)) + shearB F U X η)

def LeadingProfile (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (0 < h ∧ h < 1 / 100 ∧ 0 < lam ∧ 0 < cinf ∧ 0 < cpatch ∧ 0 < aa ∧ 0 < ab ∧
      0 < Xa ∧ Xa < p1 ∧ p1 < p2 ∧ p2 < m1 ∧ m1 < m2 ∧ m2 < Xv ∧ Xv < Xc ∧ Xc < Xb) ∧
  (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η) ∧
    (∀ X₀ X₁ : ℝ, 0 < X₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₀ ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →

  (∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧

    (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →

noncomputable def profRadInt (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, f x η

noncomputable def profRadAvg (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, f (s * X) η

noncomputable def profEtaD (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ := deriv (fun e => g X e) η

noncomputable def leadPi (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ := -∫ x in Ioi X, F x η ^ 2

noncomputable def leadW (h : ℝ) (U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * profRadAvg U X η - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadAvg U) X η

noncomputable def leadQs (h : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -leadW h U X η +
    ((1 - h) * profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) X η
      - (1 / 2 - h) * η * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) X η
      - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))) X η
      + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * η * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) X η) /
    (X * (2 * X * F X η))

noncomputable def leadNs (h : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -leadW h U X η * U X η +
    ((1 / 2 - h) * (profRadInt U X η - η * profEtaD (profRadInt U) X η)
      + 4 * h * η * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) X η
      - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)) X η) / X
    + 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * leadPi F X η - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (leadPi F) X η

noncomputable def leadStressTh (h : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  F X η * (X * leadQs h F U X η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) - shearA F X η)

noncomputable def leadStressTz (h : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  F X η * (X * leadNs h F U X η / ((1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η)) + shearB F U X η)

def LeadingProfile (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (0 < h ∧ h < 1 / 100 ∧ 0 < lam ∧ 0 < cinf ∧ 0 < cpatch ∧ 0 < aa ∧ 0 < ab ∧
      0 < Xa ∧ Xa < p1 ∧ p1 < p2 ∧ p2 < m1 ∧ m1 < m2 ∧ m2 < Xv ∧ Xv < Xc ∧ Xc < Xb) ∧
  (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η) ∧
    (∀ X₀ X₁ : ℝ, 0 < X₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₀ ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)) ∧
  (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿T0th) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿T0z) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → (X ≤ Xa ∨ Xb ≤ X) → T0th X η = 0 ∧ T0z X η = 0) ∧
    (∃ c₀ : ℝ, 0 < c₀ ∧ ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      c₀ * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X ≤ Real.sqrt (T0th X η ^ 2 + T0z X η ^ 2)) ∧
    (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿T0th) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿T0z) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N)) ∧
    (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => T0th w.1 w.2 / Real.sqrt (T0th w.1 w.2 ^ 2 + T0z w.1 w.2 ^ 2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => T0z w.1 w.2 / Real.sqrt (T0th w.1 w.2 ^ 2 + T0z w.1 w.2 ^ 2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧
    (∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ κ < 2 ∧ ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      κ ≤ F X η ∧ κ ≤ shearA F X η ∧
      κ ≤ shearA F X η * (1 + (shearB F U X η / shearA F X η) ^ 2) - 2 ∧
      κ * Real.sqrt (T0th X η ^ 2 + T0z X η ^ 2) ≤ T0th X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * T0z X η ∧
      (shearA F X η * (1 + (shearB F U X η / shearA F X η) ^ 2) - 2) *
          (T0z X η + shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * T0th X η) ^ 2 ≤
        (2 - κ) * (T0th X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * T0z X η) ^ 2)) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      T0th X η = leadStressTh h F U X η ∧ T0z X η = leadStressTz h F U X η) ∧
  (∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F 0 η) ∧
    (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)) ∧
  (∃ Xan ρ : ℝ, Xa < Xan ∧ Xan < p1 ∧ 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ Fc Uc Pc : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ,
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Fc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Uc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Pc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xan →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Fc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Uc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Pc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      (∀ w : ℂ, |w.im| < ρ → -1 - ρ < w.re → w.re < 1 + ρ →
        ‖Fc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Uc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Pc k X w‖ ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
        Fc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => F Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Uc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => U Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Pc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => leadPi F Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ))) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, Xb ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → U X η = 0 ∧
      Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η = cinf * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X)) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, Xv ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → U X η = 0 ∧ profRadInt U X η = 0) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, ((p1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ p2) ∨ (m1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ m2)) → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      U X η = 0 ∧ Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η = cpatch * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam))) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), U x η * (2 * x * F x η)) = 0 ∧
      (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2)) = 0 ∧
      (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (2 * x * F x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))) = 0) ∧
  (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xc ≤ X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) * F w.1 w.2 -
          cinf * w.1 ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - w.2 ^ 2) / w.1)) (X, η)‖ ≤
        C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N))

  B.PB x t + (if corrOn B l0 x t then pmP5 B G l0 S (ptOf x t Y) +
    qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-2 * Aex B.h) * waveS5 B G S.pw (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y) else 0)
noncomputable def fA5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³ := evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) 0
noncomputable def fP5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ := evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) 0
noncomputable def fU5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³ :=
  fun y s => curl3 (fun w => fA5 B G l0 S w s) y + fB B G l0 S y s
noncomputable def fRes5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³ :=

noncomputable def EthP5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  let b : Cyl → ℝ := fun η => ubase B η 0
  let V : Cyl → ℝ := fun η => ubase B η 1
  let Gz : Cyl → ℝ := fun η => ubase B η 2

  let v : Cyl → ℝ := mcor5 B G l0 S 1
  let γz : Cyl → ℝ := mcor5 B G l0 S 2
  let W := Wcov5 B G l0 S
  dT v ξ + dR B.h (fun η => b η * v η + β η * V η + β η * v η + W 0 1 η) ξ
    + 2 * (b ξ * v ξ + β ξ * V ξ + β ξ * v ξ + W 0 1 ξ) / ξ.1
    + dZ (fun η => Gz η * v η + V η * γz η + γz η * v η + W 2 1 η) ξ

noncomputable def EzP5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=

    + dZ (fun η => 2 * Gz η * γz η + γz η ^ 2 + W 2 2 η + pmP5 B G l0 S η) ξ

noncomputable def calJth5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (z t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  radMom (fun η => ubase B η 2 * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η + ubase B η 1 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η
                   + mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 1 η) 2 z t
noncomputable def calJz5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (z t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  radMom (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 2 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η ^ 2 + Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 2 η) 1 z t
  - (1/2) * radMom (grP5 B G l0 S) 2 z t
noncomputable def velW5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (a : WC) : WC := fun γ m => velC5 B G a γ m
noncomputable def meanResP5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  ![dR B.h (pmP5 B G l0 S) ξ - grP5 B G l0 S ξ, EthP5 B G l0 S ξ, EzP5 B G l0 S ξ]
noncomputable def radRem5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  dR B.h (pmP5 B G l0 S) ξ - grP5 B G l0 S ξ + rhoP B ξ * calP5 B G l0 S ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1
def StOrd5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (bw ca cm cd : ℝ) : Prop :=
  InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 S.Aw ∧ InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 S.pw ∧ InM B (qsOf l0) (1/2) S.Psi ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) (1/2) S.bdir ∧ ShellSupp B S.Psi ∧ ShellSupp B S.bdir ∧
  (∃ (f : WC) (Fl : Ext ℝ³), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) bw f ∧ FlatX B (qsOf l0) Fl ∧
    ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t →
      resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (PX5 B G l0 S) x t Y - thAvgVec (resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (PX5 B G l0 S)) x t Y =

  InM B (qsOf l0) cm (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (EthP5 B G l0 S)) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) cm (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (EzP5 B G l0 S)) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) ca (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (yAvg (EthP5 B G l0 S))) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) ca (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (yAvg (EzP5 B G l0 S))) ∧

  InS B (qsOf l0) cd (nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h - 3/2) (calJth5 B G l0 S)) ∧
  InS B (qsOf l0) cd (nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h - 1) (calJz5 B G l0 S)) ∧
  (∀ m N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) → 0 < rad x →
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun y s => radRem5 B G l0 S (ptOf y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y₀)))) (x, t)‖
      ≤ C * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (N : ℝ)) ∧
  InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1/2) (velW5 B G S.Aw) ∧ InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 0.68 (velW5 B G S.Aw - W0h4 B G) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) 0.9 (nrm B (Aex B.h) (mcor5 B G l0 S 1)) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) 0.9 (nrm B (Aex B.h) (mcor5 B G l0 S 2)) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) 0.9 (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (pmP5 B G l0 S)) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) 1.9 (nrm B (Aex B.h) (mcor5 B G l0 S 0)) ∧

  (∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 → radMom (mcor5 B G l0 S 2) 1 z t = 0)
def Incr5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S S' : CState) (o : ℝ) : Prop :=
  InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) o (S'.Aw - S.Aw) ∧ InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) o (velW5 B G (S'.Aw - S.Aw)) ∧
  InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) o (S'.pw - S.pw) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) o (S'.Psi - S.Psi) ∧ InM B (qsOf l0) o (S'.bdir - S.bdir) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) o (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (fun ξ => pmP5 B G l0 S' ξ - pmP5 B G l0 S ξ)) ∧

  InM B (qsOf l0) o (nrm B (Aex B.h) (fun ξ => mcor5 B G l0 S' 2 ξ - mcor5 B G l0 S 2 ξ))
def GeomPrim5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) : Prop :=
  (0 < G.r0 ∧ G.r0 ≤ 1/100 ∧ 0 < G.ustar ∧ 0 < G.Crep ∧ 40 ≤ G.lmin) ∧
  (∀ γ γ' : Lab, γ ≠ γ' → G.lmin ≤ γ.1 → G.lmin ≤ γ'.1 →
     (∃ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 ∧ etaL B.h γ' ξ ≠ 0) →
     Disjoint (closure (rectAbs B G γ (2 * G.r0))) (closure (rectAbs B G γ' (2 * G.r0)))) ∧
  (∀ γ, ActiveL4 B G γ → B.Xa ≤ (G.rep γ).1 ∧ (G.rep γ).1 ≤ B.Xb ∧ |(G.rep γ).2.1| ≤ 1 - Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) ∧
     1/2 ≤ (G.rep γ).2.2 ∧ (G.rep γ).2.2 ≤ 2 ∧ ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 →
       |XC B.h ξ - (G.rep γ).1| + |etaC B.h ξ - (G.rep γ).2.1| + |qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 - (G.rep γ).2.2|
         ≤ G.Crep * Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) ∧
  (∃ ηm : ℝ, 0 < ηm ∧ ∀ γ, ActiveL4 B G γ → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 →
     B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
     B.T0th (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) * (Nfr5 B G γ).1 + B.T0z (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) * (Nfr5 B G γ).2
       ≤ -ηm * eN (B.T0th (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ), B.T0z (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ)) ∧
     |c0f5 B G γ| * |B.T0th (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) * (Kfr5 B G γ).1 + B.T0z (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) * (Kfr5 B G γ).2|
       ≤ (1 - ηm) * (G.ustar / Real.sqrt (1 + G.ustar ^ 2)) *
         |B.T0th (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) * (Nfr5 B G γ).1 + B.T0z (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) * (Nfr5 B G γ).2|) ∧
  (∀ γ, ¬ ActiveL4 B G γ → ∀ s v, G.tH γ s v = 0) ∧
  (∀ γ, ActiveL4 B G γ → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) G.r0 ξ.2.2.2 →
     HasDerivAt (G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1))
       ((APhi5 B G γ ξ).mulVec (G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2))
         - dDamp5 B G γ ξ • G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2))
       (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) ∧
     (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 = 0 → G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) 0 = Penv5 B G γ 0 • Bcol5 B G γ ξ 1)) ∧
  (∀ γ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => G.tH γ w.1 w.2)
     {w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ | 0 < w.1.1 ∧ w.1.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h w.1.2.1 (1 - w.1.2.2) < B.qB})
def MeanId5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Prop :=
  ∃ Fl : Ext ℝ³, FlatX B (qsOf l0) Fl ∧ ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t →
    thAvgVec (resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (PX5 B G l0 S)) x t Y = cyl2cart x (meanResP5 B G l0 S (ptOf x t Y)) + Fl x t Y

structure BG where
  (h Xa Xb Xext m1 m2 lam cpatch qB c aa ab : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
  (AB BvB : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (PB : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (Eb Ub Vb Tth Tz : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)

def BG.ok (B : BG) : Prop := SimScaleProps B.h ∧ BackgroundProps B.h B.Xa B.Xb B.Xext B.m1 B.m2 B.lam
  B.cpatch B.qB B.c B.aa B.ab B.F B.U B.T0th B.T0z B.AB B.BvB B.PB B.Eb B.Ub B.Vb B.Tth B.Tz


noncomputable def kapS : ℝ := 1 / 100000
noncomputable def bgc : ℝ := Real.sqrt 2 - 1
noncomputable def Tgc : ℝ := 4 + Real.sqrt 2
noncomputable def Lgc : ℝ := 4 - Real.sqrt 2
noncomputable def vrv : ℝ × ℝ := (1, -bgc)
noncomputable def vtv : ℝ × ℝ := (bgc, 1)
noncomputable def drx (h : ℝ) : ℝ := 2 * ((1 + h) * (Real.log Lgc / Real.log Tgc) - h * kapS)
noncomputable def Jpow (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ :=
  ((Lgc ^ n * ((Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2))) • vrv) + ((Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2))) • vtv)
noncomputable def bandIdx (h : ℝ) (l : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  ⌊Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2))⌋
noncomputable def bandOf (q : ℝ) : ℕ := ⌈Real.logb 2 (1 / q)⌉₊
noncomputable def coarseIdx (h q : ℝ) : ℤ := bandIdx h (bandOf q - 4)
def IsDeck (h q : ℝ) (a : ℝ × ℝ) : Prop := ∃ n m : ℤ, Jpow (coarseIdx h q) a = ((n : ℝ), (m : ℝ))


abbrev Cyl := ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)
noncomputable def qC (h : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := simScale h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1)
noncomputable def XC (h : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC h ξ)
noncomputable def etaC (h : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := ξ.2.1 * qC h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - h))
noncomputable def SC (h : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := (1 + |Real.log (qC h ξ)|) ^ 2
noncomputable def rad (x : ℝ³) : ℝ := Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2)
noncomputable def Yph (h r t : ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ := (r ^ drx h) • vrv + t • vtv
noncomputable def eR (x : ℝ³) : ℝ³ := (rad x)⁻¹ • radVec x
noncomputable def eTh (x : ℝ³) : ℝ³ := (rad x)⁻¹ • azVec x
noncomputable def eZ : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 2 1
noncomputable def cyl2cart (x : ℝ³) (c : Fin 3 → ℝ) : ℝ³ := c 0 • eR x + c 1 • eTh x + c 2 • eZ
noncomputable def thetaOf (x : ℝ³) : ℝ := Complex.arg (⟨x 0, x 1⟩ : ℂ)
noncomputable def rotPt (r θ z : ℝ) : ℝ³ :=
  (r * Real.cos θ) • EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 + (r * Real.sin θ) • EuclideanSpace.single 1 1 +
    z • EuclideanSpace.single 2 1
abbrev Ext (V : Type) := ℝ³ → ℝ → (ℝ × ℝ) → V
noncomputable def evOff {V : Type} (h : ℝ) (F : Ext V) (Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ³ → ℝ → V :=
  fun x t => F x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y₀)
noncomputable def curlX (h : ℝ) (A : Ext ℝ³) : Ext ℝ³ :=
  fun x t Y => curl3 (fun y => evOff h A (Y - Yph h (rad x) t) y t) x
noncomputable def resX (h : ℝ) (u : Ext ℝ³) (p : Ext ℝ) : Ext ℝ³ :=
  fun x t Y => nsResidual 1 (evOff h u (Y - Yph h (rad x) t)) (evOff h p (Y - Yph h (rad x) t)) x t
noncomputable def dR {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (h : ℝ) (f : Cyl → V) (ξ : Cyl) : V :=
  fderiv ℝ f ξ (1, 0, 0, (drx h * ξ.1 ^ (drx h - 1)) • vrv)
noncomputable def dZ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V) (ξ : Cyl) : V :=
  fderiv ℝ f ξ (0, 1, 0, 0)
noncomputable def dT {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V) (ξ : Cyl) : V :=
  fderiv ℝ f ξ (0, 0, 1, vtv)
noncomputable def thAvg (g : ℝ³ → ℝ) (r z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g (rotPt r θ z)
noncomputable def yAvg (f : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), f (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y)
noncomputable def radMom (f : Cyl → ℝ) (e : ℕ) (z t : ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ e * yAvg f (r, z, t, 0)


noncomputable def JpowL (n : ℤ) : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).smulRight (Jpow n (1, 0)) +
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).smulRight (Jpow n (0, 1))
noncomputable def Lnorm (h : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl :=
  (Real.sqrt (qC h ξ) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
   ((qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
    ((qC h ξ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (JpowL (-(coarseIdx h (qC h ξ))))))
noncomputable def NB {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (h : ℝ) (f : Cyl → V) (k : ℕ)
    (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖
def DomC (h qs : ℝ) : Set Cyl := {ξ | 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC h ξ < qs}
def shY (ξ : Cyl) (a : ℝ × ℝ) : Cyl := (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, ξ.2.2.2 + a)
def InM {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (B : BG) (qs α : ℝ) (f : Cyl → V) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) ∧
  (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ a, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) a → f (shY ξ a) = f ξ) ∧
  (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b d : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
    NB B.h f k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
      edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d)
def InS (B : BG) (qs α : ℝ) (F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F {w | w.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qs} ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qs →
    ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F w).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ =>
        (simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
        (simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖
      ≤ C * simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ^ (B.h * α) * (1 + |Real.log (simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2))|) ^ (2 * b)


abbrev Lab := ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) × Bool
noncomputable def Qb (l : ℕ) : ℝ := (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l:ℝ))
noncomputable def epsb (h : ℝ) (l : ℕ) : ℝ := Qb l ^ h
noncomputable def Sb (l : ℕ) : ℝ := (l:ℝ) ^ 2
noncomputable def cib (h : ℝ) (l : ℕ) : ℝ := Tgc ^ (bandIdx h l) * Qb l ^ (1 + h)
noncomputable def kb (h : ℝ) (l : ℕ) : ℕ := ⌈epsb h l ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))⌉₊
noncomputable def sgn (σ : Bool) : ℝ := if σ then 1 else -1
noncomputable def bumpR (s : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.smoothTransition (1 - s ^ 2)
noncomputable def sqPart (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  bumpR (s / μ - j) / Real.sqrt (∑' n : ℤ, bumpR (s / μ - n) ^ 2)
noncomputable def chartR (h : ℝ) (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (Qb l)
noncomputable def chartZ (h : ℝ) (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := ξ.2.1 / Qb l ^ (1/2 - h)
noncomputable def chartT (h : ℝ) (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := (1 - ξ.2.2.1) / Qb l
noncomputable def etaL (h : ℝ) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  sqPart 1 (-(γ.1:ℤ)) (Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ)) *
  (sqPart (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.1 (chartR h γ.1 ξ) * sqPart (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.1 (chartZ h γ.1 ξ) *
   sqPart (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.2 (chartT h γ.1 ξ))
noncomputable def lamR (w : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := (w.1 - bgc * w.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)
noncomputable def lamT (w : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := (bgc * w.1 + w.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)
noncomputable def frac0 (y : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ := (y.1 - ((round y.1 : ℤ) : ℝ), y.2 - ((round y.2 : ℤ) : ℝ))
noncomputable def rectW (h : ℝ) (γ : Lab) (c : ℝ × ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ :=
  frac0 (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c)
noncomputable def xiG (h : ℝ) (γ : Lab) (c : ℝ × ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := lamR (rectW h γ c Y)
noncomputable def etG (h : ℝ) (γ : Lab) (c : ℝ × ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := lamT (rectW h γ c Y)
def inRect (h : ℝ) (γ : Lab) (c : ℝ × ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ) : Prop :=
  |xiG h γ c Y| ≤ ρ ∧ |etG h γ c Y| ≤ ρ
noncomputable def Lsb (h r0 : ℝ) (l : ℕ) : ℝ := 2 * r0 / cib h l
noncomputable def vco (h r0 : ℝ) (γ : Lab) (c : ℝ × ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := (etG h γ c Y + r0) / cib h γ.1
noncomputable def chig (r0 s : ℝ) : ℝ := bumpR (4 * s / r0)
noncomputable def psiT (Ls v : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.smoothTransition ((Ls/3 - |v - Ls/2|) / (Ls/3 - Ls/5))
noncomputable def dVdir (h : ℝ) (l : ℕ) : Cyl := (0, 0, 0, (cib h l * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx h l))) • vtv)


structure CorrGeom where
  lmin : ℕ
  r0 : ℝ
  ctr : Lab → ℝ × ℝ
  rep : Lab → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ
  ustar : ℝ
  Crep : ℝ
  tH : Lab → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)
def rectAbs (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ρ : ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {Y | inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ρ Y}
def ActiveL (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : Prop :=
  G.lmin ≤ γ.1 ∧ ∃ ξ : Cyl, etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 ∧ B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb



noncomputable def eN (w : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := Real.sqrt (w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2)
noncomputable def uB (B : BG) : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³ := fun x t => curl3 (fun w => B.AB w t) x + B.BvB x t
noncomputable def baseC (B : BG) (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  fun i => Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * inner ℝ (uB B (rotPt ξ.1 0 ξ.2.1) ξ.2.2.1)
    (![eR (rotPt ξ.1 0 ξ.2.1), eTh (rotPt ξ.1 0 ξ.2.1), eZ] i)
noncomputable def RC (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (Qb l)
noncomputable def Fang (B : BG) (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := baseC B l ξ 1 / RC l ξ
noncomputable def DrC {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (B : BG) (l : ℕ) (f : Cyl → V)
    (ξ : Cyl) : V := Real.sqrt (Qb l) • dR B.h f ξ
noncomputable def DzC {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (B : BG) (l : ℕ) (f : Cyl → V)
    (ξ : Cyl) : V := Real.sqrt (Qb l) • dZ f ξ
noncomputable def DtC {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (B : BG) (l : ℕ) (f : Cyl → V)
    (ξ : Cyl) : V := Qb l ^ (1 + B.h) • dT f ξ
noncomputable def F0r (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ := B.F (G.rep γ).1 (G.rep γ).2.1
noncomputable def g0r (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ × ℝ :=
  F0r B G γ • (-(shearA B.F (G.rep γ).1 (G.rep γ).2.1), shearB B.F B.U (G.rep γ).1 (G.rep γ).2.1)
noncomputable def Nfr (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ × ℝ := (eN (g0r B G γ))⁻¹ • g0r B G γ
noncomputable def Kfr (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ × ℝ := (-(Nfr B G γ).2, (Nfr B G γ).1)
noncomputable def lam0 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (-(2 * F0r B G γ * (Nfr B G γ).1) * (2 * F0r B G γ * (Nfr B G γ).1 + eN (g0r B G γ)))
noncomputable def c0f (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ := lam0 B G γ / (2 * F0r B G γ * (Nfr B G γ).1)
noncomputable def Bs (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (lam0 B G γ / (epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ))^2 * (1 + G.ustar^2) ^ (3/2:ℝ)))
noncomputable def sco (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sgn γ.2.2 * (G.ustar / 2 + G.ustar * v / Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1)
noncomputable def R0r (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * (G.rep γ).1 * (G.rep γ).2.2)
noncomputable def ptil (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ := R0r B G γ * Bs B G γ *
  ((Kfr B G γ).1 - sgn γ.2.2 * G.ustar * (g0r B G γ).1 / (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 * eN (g0r B G γ) ^ 2))
noncomputable def pzr (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ := Bs B G γ *
  ((Kfr B G γ).2 - sgn γ.2.2 * G.ustar * (g0r B G γ).2 / (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 * eN (g0r B G γ) ^ 2))
noncomputable def pint (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℤ :=
  if round ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * ptil B G γ) = 0 then 1 else round ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * ptil B G γ)
noncomputable def pang (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ := (pint B G γ : ℝ) / (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ)
noncomputable def phiL (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  pzr B G γ * chartZ B.h γ.1 ξ / epsb B.h γ.1 + sgn γ.2.2 * Bs B G γ * G.ustar / 2 * RC γ.1 ξ
  - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 * (pang B G γ * Fang B γ.1 ξ + pzr B G γ * baseC B γ.1 ξ 2)
noncomputable def nPhi (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  ![DrC B γ.1 (phiL B G γ) ξ, pang B G γ / RC γ.1 ξ, DzC B γ.1 (phiL B G γ) ξ]
noncomputable def dV (B : BG) (l : ℕ) (f : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := fderiv ℝ f ξ (dVdir B.h l)
noncomputable def Kmat (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  !![0, -2 * Fang B γ.1 ξ, 0;
     2 * Fang B γ.1 ξ + RC γ.1 ξ * DrC B γ.1 (Fang B γ.1) ξ, 0, 0;
     DrC B γ.1 (fun η => baseC B γ.1 η 2) ξ, 0, 0]
noncomputable def nPhiP (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  fun i => dV B γ.1 (fun η => nPhi B G γ η i) ξ
noncomputable def APhi (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  -Kmat B G γ ξ + (dotProduct (nPhi B G γ ξ) (nPhi B G γ ξ))⁻¹ •
    Matrix.vecMulVec (nPhi B G γ ξ) (Matrix.vecMul (nPhi B G γ ξ) (Kmat B G γ ξ) - nPhiP B G γ ξ)
noncomputable def dDamp (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ))^2 * dotProduct (nPhi B G γ ξ) (nPhi B G γ ξ)
noncomputable def ntan (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt ((nPhi B G γ ξ 1)^2 + (nPhi B G γ ξ 2)^2)
noncomputable def Bcol (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) (σ' : ℝ) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  let Ka : Fin 3 → ℝ := ![0, nPhi B G γ ξ 1 / ntan B G γ ξ, nPhi B G γ ξ 2 / ntan B G γ ξ]
  let Na : Fin 3 → ℝ := ![0, Ka 2, -(Ka 1)]
  let sa := nPhi B G γ ξ 0 / ntan B G γ ξ
  let sv := sco B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)
  (![1, 0, 0] - sa • Ka) + (σ' * c0f B G γ * Real.sqrt (1 + sv^2)) • Na
noncomputable def Penv (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (∫ w in (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2)..v,
    (lam0 B G γ / Real.sqrt (1 + sco B G γ w ^ 2)
      - epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ))^2 * Bs B G γ ^ 2 * (1 + sco B G γ w ^ 2)))
noncomputable def Hcol (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ :=
  ((1 + bgc^2) / 2 * (∫ u in (-G.r0)..G.r0, chig G.r0 u ^ 2) * cib B.h γ.1) •
    ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..(Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), (psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) v ^ 2 * (G.tH γ s v) 0) •
      ((G.tH γ s v) 1, (G.tH γ s v) 2)
noncomputable def T0star (B : BG) (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ × ℝ :=
  (Qb l / qC B.h ξ) ^ (1 + B.h) • (B.T0th (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ), B.T0z (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ))
noncomputable def yAmp (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  let s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ := (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)
  let Hp := Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) s
  let Hm := Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) s
  let T := T0star B γ.1 ξ
  let det := Hp.1 * Hm.2 - Hm.1 * Hp.2
  if γ.2.2 then (Hm.2 * T.1 - Hm.1 * T.2) / det else (Hp.1 * T.2 - Hp.2 * T.1) / det
open Classical in
noncomputable def W0c (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  if ActiveL B G γ ∧ inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (2 * G.r0) ξ.2.2.2 then
    (Real.sqrt (epsb B.h γ.1) / 2 * etaL B.h γ ξ * Real.sqrt (max (yAmp B G γ ξ) 0) *
      chig G.r0 (xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) * psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)) •
      G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)
  else 0

abbrev WC := Lab → ℤ → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)
abbrev WS := Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ
noncomputable def qsOf (l0 : ℕ) : ℝ := Qb l0
def SuppW (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : Prop :=
  ActiveL B G γ ∧ ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL B.h γ) ∧ |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ G.r0 / 4 ∧
  |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ G.r0 ∧ B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb
def InWg {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (qs α : ℝ)
    (a : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → V) : Prop :=
  (∃ H : Finset ℤ, (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧ ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → a γ m = 0) ∧
  (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (a γ m) (DomC B.h qs)) ∧
  (∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ c, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c → a γ m (shY ξ c) = a γ m ξ) ∧
  (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs → a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b d : ℝ, ∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
    NB B.h (a γ m) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ b *
      Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) *
      Penv B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)
noncomputable def ephase (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (θ : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℂ :=
  Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((pint B G γ : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ) + (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL B G γ ξ : ℂ)))
noncomputable def waveV (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (a : WC) (θ : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  fun i => (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, a γ m ξ i * ephase B G γ m θ ξ).re
noncomputable def waveS (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (a : WS) (θ : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, a γ m ξ * ephase B G γ m θ ξ).re
noncomputable def velC (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (Cc : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℂ :=
  let n : Fin 3 → ℂ := fun i => (nPhi B G γ ξ i : ℂ)
  let C := Cc γ m ξ
  let ikm : ℂ := Complex.I * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ)
  let Dr : Fin 3 → ℂ := fun i => DrC B γ.1 (fun η => Cc γ m η i) ξ
  let Dz : Fin 3 → ℂ := fun i => DzC B γ.1 (fun η => Cc γ m η i) ξ
  ![ikm * (n 1 * C 2 - n 2 * C 1) - Dz 1,
    ikm * (n 2 * C 0 - n 0 * C 2) + Dz 0 - Dr 2,
    ikm * (n 0 * C 1 - n 1 * C 0) + Dr 1 + C 1 / (RC γ.1 ξ : ℂ)]
structure CState where
  Aw : WC
  pw : WS
  Psi : Cyl → ℝ
  bdir : Cyl → ℝ
noncomputable def Aex (h : ℝ) : ℝ := 1/2 + h
def corrOn (B : BG) (l0 : ℕ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < rad x ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0
noncomputable def ptOf (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ) : Cyl := (rad x, x 2, t, Y)
open Classical in
noncomputable def AX (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Ext ℝ³ := fun x t Y =>
  B.AB x t + (if corrOn B l0 x t then
    qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h) • (cyl2cart x (waveV B G S.Aw (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))
      + S.Psi (ptOf x t Y) • eTh x) else 0)
open Classical in
noncomputable def BX (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Ext ℝ³ := fun x t Y =>
  B.BvB x t + (if corrOn B l0 x t then (qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) * S.bdir (ptOf x t Y)) • eTh x else 0)


noncomputable def uX (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Ext ℝ³ :=
  fun x t Y => curlX B.h (AX B G l0 S) x t Y + BX B G l0 S x t Y
noncomputable def frameAt (θ : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℝ³ :=
  ![eR (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1), eTh (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1), eZ]
noncomputable def ucyl (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (θ : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (a : Fin 3) : ℝ :=
  inner ℝ (uX B G l0 S (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) ξ.2.2.1 ξ.2.2.2) (frameAt θ ξ a)
noncomputable def thA (f : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), f θ
noncomputable def ubase (B : BG) (ξ : Cyl) (a : Fin 3) : ℝ :=
  inner ℝ (uB B (rotPt ξ.1 0 ξ.2.1) ξ.2.2.1) (frameAt 0 ξ a)
noncomputable def mcor (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (a : Fin 3) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  thA (fun θ => ucyl B G l0 S θ ξ a) - ubase B ξ a
noncomputable def Wcov (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (a b : Fin 3) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  thA (fun θ => (ucyl B G l0 S θ ξ a - thA (fun θ' => ucyl B G l0 S θ' ξ a)) *
               (ucyl B G l0 S θ ξ b - thA (fun θ' => ucyl B G l0 S θ' ξ b)))
noncomputable def sBase (B : BG) (a : Fin 3) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  inner ℝ (stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz (rotPt ξ.1 0 ξ.2.1) ξ.2.2.1) (frameAt 0 ξ a)
noncomputable def lap0 (h : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  dR h (dR h f) ξ + dR h f ξ / ξ.1 + dZ (dZ f) ξ
noncomputable def grP (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  let b : Cyl → ℝ := fun η => ubase B η 0
  let V : Cyl → ℝ := fun η => ubase B η 1
  let Gz : Cyl → ℝ := fun η => ubase B η 2
  let β : Cyl → ℝ := mcor B G l0 S 0
  let v : Cyl → ℝ := mcor B G l0 S 1
  let γz : Cyl → ℝ := mcor B G l0 S 2
  let W := Wcov B G l0 S
  (0:ℝ) - dT β ξ - (dR B.h (fun η => 2 * b η * β η + β η ^ 2 + W 0 0 η) ξ
             + (2 * b ξ * β ξ + β ξ ^ 2 + W 0 0 ξ) / ξ.1)
  - dZ (fun η => b η * γz η + Gz η * β η + β η * γz η + W 2 0 η) ξ
  + (2 * V ξ * v ξ + v ξ ^ 2 + W 1 1 ξ) / ξ.1 + (lap0 B.h β ξ - β ξ / ξ.1 ^ 2)
noncomputable def chiM (B : BG) (X : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.smoothTransition ((X - B.m1) / (B.m2 - B.m1))
noncomputable def rhoHat (B : BG) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  bumpR ((s - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) / ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2)) /
    ∫ u in (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1))..(Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)),
      bumpR ((u - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) / ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2))
noncomputable def rhoP (B : BG) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * rhoHat B (ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))
noncomputable def pathPt (h : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (r' : ℝ) : Cyl :=
  (r', ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, ξ.2.2.2 + (r' ^ drx h - ξ.1 ^ drx h) • vrv)
noncomputable def Icut (B : BG) (g : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  (∫ r' in (0:ℝ)..ξ.1, g (pathPt B.h ξ r')) - chiM B (XC B.h ξ) * ∫ r' in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), g (pathPt B.h ξ r')
noncomputable def calP (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (z t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  radMom (grP B G l0 S) 0 z t
noncomputable def pmP (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  Icut B (fun η => grP B G l0 S η - rhoP B η * calP B G l0 S η.2.1 η.2.2.1) ξ
open Classical in
noncomputable def PX (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Ext ℝ := fun x t Y =>
  B.PB x t + (if corrOn B l0 x t then pmP B G l0 S (ptOf x t Y) +
    qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-2 * Aex B.h) * waveS B G S.pw (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y) else 0)
noncomputable def fA (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³ := evOff B.h (AX B G l0 S) 0
noncomputable def fB (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³ := evOff B.h (BX B G l0 S) 0
noncomputable def fP (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ := evOff B.h (PX B G l0 S) 0
noncomputable def fU (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³ :=
  fun y s => curl3 (fun w => fA B G l0 S w s) y + fB B G l0 S y s
noncomputable def fRes (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³ :=
  nsResidual 1 (fU B G l0 S) (fP B G l0 S)
noncomputable def EthP (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  let b : Cyl → ℝ := fun η => ubase B η 0
  let V : Cyl → ℝ := fun η => ubase B η 1
  let Gz : Cyl → ℝ := fun η => ubase B η 2
  let β : Cyl → ℝ := mcor B G l0 S 0
  let v : Cyl → ℝ := mcor B G l0 S 1
  let γz : Cyl → ℝ := mcor B G l0 S 2
  let W := Wcov B G l0 S
  dT v ξ + dR B.h (fun η => b η * v η + β η * V η + β η * v η + W 0 1 η) ξ
    + 2 * (b ξ * v ξ + β ξ * V ξ + β ξ * v ξ + W 0 1 ξ) / ξ.1
    + dZ (fun η => Gz η * v η + V η * γz η + γz η * v η + W 2 1 η) ξ
    - (lap0 B.h v ξ - v ξ / ξ.1 ^ 2) + sBase B 1 ξ
noncomputable def EzP (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  let b : Cyl → ℝ := fun η => ubase B η 0
  let Gz : Cyl → ℝ := fun η => ubase B η 2
  let β : Cyl → ℝ := mcor B G l0 S 0
  let γz : Cyl → ℝ := mcor B G l0 S 2
  let W := Wcov B G l0 S
  dT γz ξ + dR B.h (fun η => b η * γz η + β η * Gz η + β η * γz η + W 0 2 η) ξ
    + (b ξ * γz ξ + β ξ * Gz ξ + β ξ * γz ξ + W 0 2 ξ) / ξ.1
    + dZ (fun η => 2 * Gz η * γz η + γz η ^ 2 + W 2 2 η + pmP B G l0 S η) ξ
    - lap0 B.h γz ξ + sBase B 2 ξ
noncomputable def calJth (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (z t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  radMom (fun η => ubase B η 2 * mcor B G l0 S 1 η + ubase B η 1 * mcor B G l0 S 2 η
                   + mcor B G l0 S 2 η * mcor B G l0 S 1 η + Wcov B G l0 S 2 1 η) 2 z t
noncomputable def calJz (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (z t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  radMom (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 2 * mcor B G l0 S 2 η + mcor B G l0 S 2 η ^ 2 + Wcov B G l0 S 2 2 η) 1 z t
  - (1/2) * radMom (grP B G l0 S) 2 z t


noncomputable def nrm (B : BG) (e : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ) : Cyl → ℝ := fun ξ => qC B.h ξ ^ e * f ξ
noncomputable def nrmS (B : BG) (e : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ :=
  fun w => simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ^ e * F w.1 w.2
noncomputable def W0h (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) : WC :=
  fun γ m ξ => if m = 1 ∨ m = -1 then (fun i => ((W0c B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) else 0
noncomputable def velW (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (a : WC) : WC := fun γ m => velC B G a γ m
def FlatX (B : BG) (qs : ℝ) (Fl : Ext ℝ³) : Prop :=
  ∀ m N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain B.h qs →
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(evOff B.h Fl Y₀)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (N : ℝ)
noncomputable def meanResP (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  ![dR B.h (pmP B G l0 S) ξ - grP B G l0 S ξ, EthP B G l0 S ξ, EzP B G l0 S ξ]
def ShellSupp (B : BG) (f : Cyl → ℝ) : Prop := ∀ ξ, (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0
noncomputable def thAvgVec (F : Ext ℝ³) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ³ :=
  cyl2cart x (fun a => thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (F (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)))
noncomputable def radRem (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  dR B.h (pmP B G l0 S) ξ - grP B G l0 S ξ + rhoP B ξ * calP B G l0 S ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1
def StOrd (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (bw ca cm cd : ℝ) : Prop :=
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) 1 S.Aw ∧ InWg B G (qsOf l0) 1 S.pw ∧ InM B (qsOf l0) (1/2) S.Psi ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) (1/2) S.bdir ∧ ShellSupp B S.Psi ∧ ShellSupp B S.bdir ∧
  (∃ (f : WC) (Fl : Ext ℝ³), InWg B G (qsOf l0) bw f ∧ FlatX B (qsOf l0) Fl ∧
    ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t →
      resX B.h (uX B G l0 S) (PX B G l0 S) x t Y - thAvgVec (resX B.h (uX B G l0 S) (PX B G l0 S)) x t Y =
        (qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2))) • cyl2cart x (waveV B G f (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))
          + Fl x t Y) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) cm (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (EthP B G l0 S)) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) cm (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (EzP B G l0 S)) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) ca (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (yAvg (EthP B G l0 S))) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) ca (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (yAvg (EzP B G l0 S))) ∧
  InS B (qsOf l0) cd (nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h) (calP B G l0 S)) ∧
  InS B (qsOf l0) cd (nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h - 3/2) (calJth B G l0 S)) ∧
  InS B (qsOf l0) cd (nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h - 1) (calJz B G l0 S)) ∧
  (∀ m N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) → 0 < rad x →
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun y s => radRem B G l0 S (ptOf y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y₀)))) (x, t)‖
      ≤ C * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (N : ℝ)) ∧
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (1/2) (velW B G S.Aw) ∧ InWg B G (qsOf l0) 0.68 (velW B G S.Aw - W0h B G) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) 0.9 (nrm B (Aex B.h) (mcor B G l0 S 1)) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) 0.9 (nrm B (Aex B.h) (mcor B G l0 S 2)) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) 0.9 (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (pmP B G l0 S)) ∧

  (∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 → radMom (mcor B G l0 S 2) 1 z t = 0)
def Incr (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S S' : CState) (o : ℝ) : Prop :=
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) o (S'.Aw - S.Aw) ∧ InWg B G (qsOf l0) o (velW B G (S'.Aw - S.Aw)) ∧

  InM B (qsOf l0) o (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (fun ξ => pmP B G l0 S' ξ - pmP B G l0 S ξ)) ∧

  InM B (qsOf l0) o (nrm B (Aex B.h) (fun ξ => mcor B G l0 S' 2 ξ - mcor B G l0 S 2 ξ))


def GeomPrim (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) : Prop :=
  (0 < G.r0 ∧ G.r0 ≤ 1/100 ∧ 0 < G.ustar ∧ 0 < G.Crep ∧ 40 ≤ G.lmin) ∧
  (∀ γ γ' : Lab, γ ≠ γ' → G.lmin ≤ γ.1 → G.lmin ≤ γ'.1 → (∃ ξ, etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 ∧ etaL B.h γ' ξ ≠ 0) →
     Disjoint (closure (rectAbs B G γ (2 * G.r0))) (closure (rectAbs B G γ' (2 * G.r0)))) ∧
  (∀ γ, ActiveL B G γ → B.Xa ≤ (G.rep γ).1 ∧ (G.rep γ).1 ≤ B.Xb ∧ |(G.rep γ).2.1| ≤ 1 - Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) ∧
     1/2 ≤ (G.rep γ).2.2 ∧ (G.rep γ).2.2 ≤ 2 ∧ ∀ ξ, etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 →
       |XC B.h ξ - (G.rep γ).1| + |etaC B.h ξ - (G.rep γ).2.1| + |qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 - (G.rep γ).2.2|
         ≤ G.Crep * Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) ∧
  (∃ ηm : ℝ, 0 < ηm ∧ ∀ γ, ActiveL B G γ → ∀ ξ, etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
     B.T0th (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) * (Nfr B G γ).1 + B.T0z (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) * (Nfr B G γ).2
       ≤ -ηm * eN (B.T0th (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ), B.T0z (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ)) ∧
     |c0f B G γ| * |B.T0th (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) * (Kfr B G γ).1 + B.T0z (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) * (Kfr B G γ).2|
       ≤ (1 - ηm) * (G.ustar / Real.sqrt (1 + G.ustar ^ 2)) *
         |B.T0th (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) * (Nfr B G γ).1 + B.T0z (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) * (Nfr B G γ).2|) ∧
  (∀ γ, ¬ ActiveL B G γ → ∀ s v, G.tH γ s v = 0) ∧
  (∀ γ, ActiveL B G γ → ∀ ξ : Cyl, etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) G.r0 ξ.2.2.2 →
     HasDerivAt (G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1))
       ((APhi B G γ ξ).mulVec (G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2))
         - dDamp B G γ ξ • G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2))
       (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) ∧
     (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 = 0 → G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) 0 = Penv B G γ 0 • Bcol B G γ ξ 1)) ∧
  (∀ γ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => G.tH γ w.1 w.2))

BackgroundProps reads T0th/T0z only at |eta| < 1, so B' := B with T0(X*, 1) := (-1, 0) still satisfies B'.ok. For B', GP4 forces Nfr.1 >= etam > 0, but g0r.1 = -F*shearA < 0 at every rep GP3 allows. So no G exists for B' (I re-derived this by hand; see nodes/correction_geometry/findings.md). The children cannot repair it, because GeomPrim is fixed in this node's START_DEFINITIONS. Required fix, and nothing else: (1) ActiveL: change 'exists xi' to 'exists xi in DomC B.h B.qB'. (2) GeomPrim: restrict GP2's exists-xi and the forall-xi in GP3, GP4 and GP5b to xi in DomC B.h B.qB; on DomC, t < 1 gives |etaC| < 1, where B.ok controls T0. (3) GP5c: change it from global ContDiff to ContDiffOn of (w => G.tH gamma w.1 w.2) on the slow-variable domain {0 < w.1.1, w.1.2.2 < 1, simScale B.h w.1.2.1 (1 - w.1.2.2) < B.qB}, or make tH vanish off that domain with a cutoff. Children only use GeomPrim on DomC (qsOf l0), which lies inside DomC qB, so the downstream steps should be unaffected. Check that the s2/s3x blueprints do not use GP at t = 1. Keep every other definition verbatim (BG, StOrd, Incr, MeanId, telD, InM/InWg/InS, classes); stOrd_antitone and incr_trans are already proved against them and must be re-cited by name, not re-proved. With that edit applied, I would approve the same split.

def ActiveL4 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : Prop :=
  G.lmin ≤ γ.1 ∧ ∃ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 ∧ B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb

noncomputable def T0star4 (B : BG) (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ × ℝ :=
  (Qb l / qC B.h ξ) ^ (1 - B.h) • (B.T0th (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ), B.T0z (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ))
noncomputable def yAmp4 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  let s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ := (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)
  let Hp := Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) s
  let Hm := Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) s
  let T := T0star4 B γ.1 ξ
  let det := Hp.1 * Hm.2 - Hm.1 * Hp.2
  if γ.2.2 then (Hm.2 * T.1 - Hm.1 * T.2) / det else (Hp.1 * T.2 - Hp.2 * T.1) / det
open Classical in
noncomputable def W0c4 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  if ActiveL4 B G γ ∧ inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (2 * G.r0) ξ.2.2.2 then
    (Real.sqrt (epsb B.h γ.1) / 2 * etaL B.h γ ξ * Real.sqrt (max (yAmp4 B G γ ξ) 0) *
      chig G.r0 (xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) * psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)) •
      G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)
  else 0
noncomputable def W0h4 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) : WC :=
  fun γ m ξ => if m = 1 ∨ m = -1 then (fun i => ((W0c4 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) else 0

       ≤ -ηm * eN (B.T0th (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ), B.T0z (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ)) ∧
     |c0f B G γ| * |B.T0th (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) * (Kfr B G γ).1 + B.T0z (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) * (Kfr B G γ).2|
       ≤ (1 - ηm) * (G.ustar / Real.sqrt (1 + G.ustar ^ 2)) *
         |B.T0th (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) * (Nfr B G γ).1 + B.T0z (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) * (Nfr B G γ).2|) ∧
  (∀ γ, ¬ ActiveL4 B G γ → ∀ s v, G.tH γ s v = 0) ∧

       ((APhi B G γ ξ).mulVec (G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2))

       (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) ∧
     (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 = 0 → G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) 0 = Penv B G γ 0 • Bcol B G γ ξ 1)) ∧

The defect: F0r := B.F rep.1 rep.2.1 has no rho_c^-(1+h) factor, while the GP5b ODE coefficients do carry it. By (B5), baseC1 = rho^-A sqrt(2X) F, and RC = sqrt(2X) rho^(1/2), so Fang = rho^-(1+h) F with rho = q/Qb; Kmat and DrC therefore carry rho^-(1+h). lam0, Bs and Penv are built from F0r alone, so the growth balances the damping only at rho_c = 1. Elsewhere tH/Penv drifts by exp(+-c(rho_c) Ls) with Ls ~ l^2, and GP3 forces rho_c ~ q/Qb to range over [1/2,2] in every band. So no G works, StOrd4 (through InWg 1/2 of W0h4) is unsatisfiable, and correction_initial_state_v4 is false. I re-derived the exponent algebra by hand. It matches the numerics in primary_amplitude_nondegenerate_v4 and correction_initial_state_v4 (see their findings and mine). Required fix, nothing else: F0r5 := (G.rep g).2.2^(-(1+B.h)) * B.F (G.rep g).1 (G.rep g).2.1, or equivalently scale lam0 alone. Add _5 copies of everything downstream that reaches the statements: lam0/c0f/Bs/ptil/pzr/pint/pang/phiL/nPhi/APhi/dDamp/Bcol/Penv/Hcol/yAmp/W0c/W0h/InWg-if-needed/GeomPrim/StOrd/PrimNondegAt. With exactly that edit and the same 11-child split, I would approve.
