      hT.preimage (continuous_id.add continuous_const)
    have hg₁ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun y : ℝ × ℝ => (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h p.1 p.2) (y + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))))
        ((fun y : ℝ × ℝ => y + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) ⁻¹' (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ))) :=
      hS4.comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const).contDiffOn (fun y hy => hy)
    have hLw : L₀ w ∈ (fun y : ℝ × ℝ => y + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) ⁻¹' (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)) := by
      rw [Set.mem_preimage, hΦ w]
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, mem_Ioi.mpr (sub_pos.mpr hw)⟩
    have hLso : IsOpen (L₀ ⁻¹' ((fun y : ℝ × ℝ => y + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) ⁻¹' (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)))) :=
      hso.preimage L₀.continuous
    have key := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L₀ hg₁ hso.uniqueDiffOn
      hLso.uniqueDiffOn hLw (i := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hLso (show w ∈ L₀ ⁻¹' _ from hLw),
      iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hso hLw] at key
    have htr := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun p : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h p.1 p.2)
      k ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) (L₀ w)
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) w‖
        = ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h p.1 p.2)
            (L₀ w + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)))).compContinuousLinearMap fun _ => L₀‖ := by
          rw [hfun, key, htr]
      _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h p.1 p.2) (L₀ w + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)))‖ *
            ∏ _i : Fin k, ‖L₀‖ :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h p.1 p.2) (L₀ w + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)))‖ := by
          rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
          exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hLn)
      _ ≤ C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1 - (k : ℝ)) := by
          rw [hΦ w]
          exact hC _ _ (sub_pos.mpr hw) hq1
  obtain ⟨hQa, hΩ, hQpos, hQd⟩ := simQ
  have hUo : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
  have hΩU : simDomain h qs ⊆ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := fun w hw => hw.1
  have hQc : ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 →
      ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) w :=
    fun w hw => hQa.continuousOn.continuousAt (hUo.mem_nhds hw)
  have hGs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun σ : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ)) :=
    Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id))
  
  have hP : ∀ (a : ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (a * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≤ 1 / 2 → simCut h a x t = 1) ∧
      (1 ≤ a * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) → simCut h a x t = 0) ∧ 0 ≤ simCut h a x t ∧
      simCut h a x t ≤ 1 := by
    intro a x t
    unfold simCut
    refine ⟨fun h1 => ?_, fun h1 => ?_, Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _,
      Real.smoothTransition.le_one _⟩
    · exact Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith)
    · exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
  
  have hfs : ∀ a : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => a * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2))
      (simDomain h qs) := fun a => contDiffOn_const.mul (hQa.mono hΩU)
  have hi : ∀ a : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(simCut h a)) (simDomain h qs) := fun a =>
    hGs.comp_contDiffOn (hfs a)
  
  have hiii : ∀ (a : ℝ) (w : ℝ³ × ℝ), w ∈ simDomain h qs →
      1 < a * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) → (↿(simCut h a)) =ᶠ[nhds w] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
    intro a w hw h1
    have hev : ∀ᶠ z in nhds w, (1 : ℝ) < a * simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) :=
      continuousAt_const.eventually_lt (continuousAt_const.mul (hQc w hw.1)) h1
    exact hev.mono fun z hz => (hP a z.1 z.2).2.1 hz.le
  
  have hiv : ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ j, 1 ≤ a j) → (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) →
      ∀ w ∈ simDomain h qs, ∃ U ∈ nhds w, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ j, n ≤ j → ∀ z ∈ U,
        (↿(simCut h (a j))) z = 0 := by
    intro a ha1 ha2 w hw
    have hpow : ∀ j : ℕ, (2 : ℝ) ^ j ≤ a j := by
      intro j
      induction j with
      | zero => simpa using ha1 0
      | succ j ih => rw [pow_succ]; linarith [ha2 j]
    have hq0 : 0 < simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) := hQpos w hw.1
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := pow_unbounded_of_one_lt (2 / simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2))
      (one_lt_two : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
    refine ⟨{z | simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) / 2 < simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)}, ?_, n, ?_⟩
    · exact continuousAt_const.eventually_lt (hQc w hw.1) (by linarith)
    · intro j hj z hz
      have hz' : simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) / 2 < simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) := hz
      have h2n : (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤ a j := (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hj).trans (hpow j)
      have hn' : 2 < 2 ^ n * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) := by
        rwa [div_lt_iff₀ hq0] at hn
      have hzpos : 0 < simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) := by linarith
      apply (hP (a j) z.1 z.2).2.1
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2n hzpos.le,
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz' (pow_pos (two_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2) n)]
  
  have hv : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(simCut h a)) (x, t)‖ ≤
        M * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(k : ℝ)) := by
    intro k
    have hQd' : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ i → ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 →
        simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) w‖ ≤
          C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1 - (i : ℝ)) := by
      intro i
      by_cases hi1 : 1 ≤ i
      · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hQd i hi1
        exact ⟨C, fun _ => hC⟩
      · exact ⟨0, fun h1 => absurd h1 hi1⟩
    choose Cq hCq using hQd'
    have hGb : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ σ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun σ : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ)) σ‖ ≤ B := by
      intro i
      exact isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        ((hGs.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).continuousOn)
    choose B hB using hGb
    obtain ⟨C', hC'⟩ : ∃ C' : ℝ, C' = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cq i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Cg, hCg⟩ : ∃ Cg : ℝ, Cg = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |B i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hC'1 : 1 ≤ C' := by
      have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1)) => abs_nonneg (Cq i))
      linarith
    have hCqle : ∀ i ≤ k, |Cq i| ≤ C' := by
      intro i hi
      have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cq i|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
      linarith
    have hBle : ∀ i ≤ k, ∀ σ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun σ : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ)) σ‖ ≤ Cg := by
      intro i hi σ hσ
      have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |B i|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
      rw [hCg]
      exact (hB i σ hσ).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans this)
    have hCg0 : 0 ≤ Cg := by
      rw [hCg]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg (B i))
    refine ⟨(k.factorial : ℝ) * Cg * C' ^ k, ?_⟩
    intro a ha x t hxt
    have ht : t < 1 := hxt.1
    have hq0 : 0 < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) := hQpos (x, t) ht
    have hq1 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≤ 1 := by have := hxt.2; linarith
    have hC'0 : 0 ≤ C' := by linarith
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) * Cg * C' ^ k := by positivity
    by_cases hcase : 1 < a * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)
    · have hev := hiii a (x, t) hxt hcase
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg hM0 (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)
    · push_neg at hcase
      have hg : ∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i
          (fun σ : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ)) univ
          (a * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t))‖ ≤ Cg := by
        intro i hi
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_univ]
        exact hBle i hi _ ⟨(mul_pos ha hq0).le, hcase⟩
      have hf : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i
          (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => a * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) (simDomain h qs) (x, t)‖ ≤
          (C' * (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t))⁻¹) ^ i := by
        intro i hi1 hik
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩ hxt]
        have hfeq : (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => a * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) =
            a • (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) := by
          funext w; simp [smul_eq_mul]
        rw [hfeq, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply
          ((hQa.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds ht)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)),
          norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ha.le]
        have hQb : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) (x, t)‖
            ≤ Cq i * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (1 - (i : ℝ)) := hCq i hi1 (x, t) ht hq1
        have e1 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (1 - (i : ℝ)) =
            simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) * (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t))⁻¹ ^ i := by
          rw [Real.rpow_sub hq0, Real.rpow_one, Real.rpow_natCast, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
        rw [e1] at hQb
        have hP0 : 0 < (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t))⁻¹ ^ i := by positivity
        have hC'i : C' ≤ C' ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hC'1 (by omega)
        have hCqi := hCqle i hik
        rw [mul_pow]
        have h1 : a * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) (x, t)‖
            ≤ a * (|Cq i| * (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) * (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t))⁻¹ ^ i)) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ ha.le
          exact hQb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (by positivity))
        calc _ ≤ _ := h1
          _ = |Cq i| * (a * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) * (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t))⁻¹ ^ i := by
            ring
          _ ≤ |Cq i| * 1 * (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t))⁻¹ ^ i := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hP0.le
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcase (abs_nonneg _)
          _ ≤ C' ^ i * (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t))⁻¹ ^ i := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hP0.le
            linarith
      have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hGs.contDiffOn (hfs a)
        (by exact_mod_cast le_top) uniqueDiffOn_univ hΩ.uniqueDiffOn (mapsTo_univ _ _) hxt hg hf
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hΩ hxt] at key
      have e2 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(k : ℝ)) = (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t))⁻¹ ^ k := by
        rw [Real.rpow_neg hq0.le, Real.rpow_natCast, inv_pow]
      rw [e2]
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(simCut h a)) (x, t)‖ =
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((fun σ : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ)) ∘
            (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => a * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2))) (x, t)‖ := rfl
        _ ≤ _ := key
        _ = _ := by rw [mul_pow]; ring
  
  have hvi : ∀ (a : ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) (v : ℝ³), t < 1 → v 2 = 0 →
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => simCut h a y t) x v = 0 := by
    intro a x t v ht hv
    have hS4 := hS.2.2.2.1
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ : ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ,
        φ = fun z => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * (a * simScale h z (1 - t))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hcomp : (fun y : ℝ³ => simCut h a y t) =
        φ ∘ (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) := by
      rw [hφ]; rfl
    have hι : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ => simScale h z (1 - t)) (x 2) := by
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (x 2, 1 - t) :=
        hS4.contDiffAt ((isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds
          ⟨mem_univ _, show (0 : ℝ) < 1 - t by linarith⟩)
      exact ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2)
        (f := fun z : ℝ => (z, 1 - t)) (x 2) h1 (contDiffAt_id.prodMk contDiffAt_const)
    have hφd : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ (x 2) := by
      have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ => a * simScale h z (1 - t)) (x 2) :=
        (hι.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).const_mul a
      rw [hφ]
      exact (hGs.differentiable (by norm_num) _).comp (x 2) h2
    rw [hcomp, fderiv_comp x hφd
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).differentiableAt,
      ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
    show (fderiv ℝ φ _) (v 2) = 0
    rw [hv, map_zero]
  exact ⟨hi, hP, hiii, hiv, hv, hvi⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∃ c₁ : ℝ, 0 < c₁ ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → (∀ x y : ℝ³, |cutPhi R y ^ 6 - cutPhi R x ^ 6| ≤ min 1 (3 * c₁ / R * ‖x - y‖) * (cutPhi R x ^ 3 + cutPhi R y ^ 3)) ∧ ∀ w : ℝ³ → ℝ³, ContDiff ℝ ∞ w → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fluxBeta R w) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fluxBeta R w) ∧ (∀ x, |fluxBeta R w x| ≤ 8 * c₁ / R * cutPhi R x * ‖w x‖) ∧ (∀ x, inner ℝ (w x) (gradient (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) x) = cutPhi R x ^ 6 * fluxBeta R w x)

signature.name: flux_cutoff_beta
signature.statement: ∃ c₁ : ℝ, 0 < c₁ ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → (∀ x y : ℝ³, |cutPhi R y ^ 6 - cutPhi R x ^ 6| ≤ min 1 (3 * c₁ / R * ‖x - y‖) * (cutPhi R x ^ 3 + cutPhi R y ^ 3)) ∧ ∀ w : ℝ³ → ℝ³, ContDiff ℝ ∞ w → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fluxBeta R w) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fluxBeta R w) ∧ (∀ x, |fluxBeta R w x| ≤ 8 * c₁ / R * cutPhi R x * ‖w x‖) ∧ (∀ x, inner ℝ (w x) (gradient (fun y => cutPhi R y ^ 8) x) = cutPhi R x ^ 6 * fluxBeta R w x)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hbC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (⇑bump12) := bump12.contDiff
  have hbS : HasCompactSupport (⇑bump12) := bump12.hasCompactSupport
  have hDc : Continuous (fderiv ℝ (⇑bump12)) := hbC.continuous_fderiv (by simp)
  have hDS : HasCompactSupport (fderiv ℝ (⇑bump12)) := hbS.fderiv ℝ
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hDS.exists_bound_of_continuous hDc
  have hc1pos : 0 < max c 0 + 1 := by positivity
  refine ⟨max c 0 + 1, hc1pos, fun R hR => ?_⟩
  have hc' : ∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ (⇑bump12) y‖ ≤ max c 0 + 1 :=
    fun y => by have := le_max_left c 0; have := hc y; linarith
  have hRpos : 0 < R := by linarith
  have hRinv : 0 < R⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hRpos
  have hφeq : cutPhi R = fun x => bump12 (R⁻¹ • x) := rfl
  have hφC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (cutPhi R) := by
    rw [hφeq]; exact hbC.comp (contDiff_const_smul R⁻¹)
  have hφS : HasCompactSupport (cutPhi R) := by
    rw [hφeq]; exact hbS.comp_smul (inv_ne_zero hRpos.ne')
  have hφb : ∀ x, 0 ≤ cutPhi R x ∧ cutPhi R x ≤ 1 :=
    fun x => ⟨bump12.nonneg, bump12.le_one⟩
  have hd : ∀ x, DifferentiableAt ℝ (cutPhi R) x := fun x => hφC.differentiable (by simp) x
  have hDφ : ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (cutPhi R) x‖ ≤ (max c 0 + 1) / R := by
    intro x
    rw [hφeq, fderiv_comp_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hRinv, div_eq_inv_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hc' _) hRinv.le
  have hlip : ∀ x y : ℝ³, |cutPhi R y - cutPhi R x| ≤ (max c 0 + 1) / R * ‖x - y‖ := by
    intro x y
    have := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (s := univ) (fun z _ => hd z)
      (fun z _ => hDφ z) convex_univ (mem_univ x) (mem_univ y)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_sub_rev y x] at this
    exact this
  refine ⟨fun x y => ?_, fun w hw => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨ha0, ha1⟩ := hφb x
    obtain ⟨hb0, hb1⟩ := hφb y
    have hL := hlip x y
    generalize cutPhi R x = a at ha0 ha1 hL ⊢
    generalize cutPhi R y = b at hb0 hb1 hL ⊢
    have hd0 : 0 ≤ ‖x - y‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hq0 : 0 ≤ b ^ 2 + a * b + a ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hq3 : b ^ 2 + a * b + a ^ 2 ≤ 3 := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_one₀ ha1 hb0 hb1, mul_le_one₀ ha1 ha0 ha1, mul_le_one₀ hb1 hb0 hb1]
    have hcube : |b ^ 3 - a ^ 3| ≤ 3 * (max c 0 + 1) / R * ‖x - y‖ := by
      rw [show b ^ 3 - a ^ 3 = (b - a) * (b ^ 2 + a * b + a ^ 2) by ring, abs_mul,
        abs_of_nonneg hq0]
      calc |b - a| * (b ^ 2 + a * b + a ^ 2) ≤ ((max c 0 + 1) / R * ‖x - y‖) * 3 :=
            mul_le_mul hL hq3 hq0 (by positivity)
        _ = 3 * (max c 0 + 1) / R * ‖x - y‖ := by ring
    have ha3 : a ^ 3 ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ ha0 ha1
    have hb3 : b ^ 3 ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hb0 hb1
    have ha3' : 0 ≤ a ^ 3 := pow_nonneg ha0 3
    have hb3' : 0 ≤ b ^ 3 := pow_nonneg hb0 3
    have hone : |b ^ 3 - a ^ 3| ≤ 1 := by
      rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
    rw [show b ^ 6 - a ^ 6 = (b ^ 3 - a ^ 3) * (a ^ 3 + b ^ 3) by ring, abs_mul,
      abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ a ^ 3 + b ^ 3)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_min hone hcube) (by positivity)
  · have hβeq : fluxBeta R w = fun x => 8 * cutPhi R x * fderiv ℝ (cutPhi R) x (w x) := rfl
    have hDφC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (cutPhi R)) := hφC.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hβeq]
      exact (contDiff_const.mul hφC).mul (hDφC.clm_apply hw)
    · rw [hβeq]
      have : (fun x => 8 * cutPhi R x * fderiv ℝ (cutPhi R) x (w x)) =
          (fun x => cutPhi R x * (8 * fderiv ℝ (cutPhi R) x (w x))) := by
        funext x; ring
      rw [this]
      exact hφS.mul_right
    · intro x
      rw [hβeq]

signature.statement: ∀ (g : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ³ → ℝ) (b : ℝ³ → ℝ), (∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (g i j)) → (∀ i j, Integrable (g i j)) → ContDiff ℝ ∞ b → HasCompactSupport b → ∫ x, stressPressure g x * b x = ∑ i, ∑ j, ∫ x, g i j x * pd i (pd j (newtonPot b)) x

by
  intro g b hg hgi hb hbc
  
  have hpd : ∀ (k : Fin 3) (F : ℝ³ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pd k F) := by
    intro k F hF
    exact (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hF).2.clm_apply contDiff_const
  have hpdc : ∀ (k : Fin 3) (F : ℝ³ → ℝ), HasCompactSupport F → HasCompactSupport (pd k F) := by
    intro k F hF
    exact hF.fderiv_apply ℝ _
  
  have hK : LocallyIntegrable newtonKernel volume := by
    rw [locallyIntegrable_iff]
    intro k hk
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hk.isBounded.subset_closedBall (0 : ℝ³)
    refine IntegrableOn.mono_set ?_ hr
    rw [← integrable_indicator_iff Metric.isClosed_closedBall.measurableSet]
    have heq : (Metric.closedBall (0:ℝ³) r).indicator newtonKernel =
        fun x => (fun s : ℝ => if s ≤ r then (4 * Real.pi * s)⁻¹ else 0) ‖x‖ := by
      funext x
      simp only [Set.indicator, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, newtonKernel]
    rw [heq]
    refine (integrable_fun_norm_addHaar (volume : Measure ℝ³)
      (f := fun s : ℝ => if s ≤ r then (4 * Real.pi * s)⁻¹ else 0)).mpr ?_
    have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ => y / (4 * Real.pi)) (Icc 0 r) :=
      (continuous_id.div_const _).integrableOn_Icc
    have h2 : IntegrableOn ((Icc 0 r).indicator (fun y : ℝ => y / (4 * Real.pi))) (Ioi 0) :=
      (h1.integrable_indicator measurableSet_Icc).integrableOn
    refine h2.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Ioi
    intro y hy
    have hy0 : (0:ℝ) < y := hy
    simp only [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, smul_eq_mul, Set.indicator, Set.mem_Icc]
    by_cases hyr : y ≤ r
    · rw [if_pos ⟨hy0.le, hyr⟩, if_pos hyr]
      field_simp
    · rw [if_neg (fun h => hyr h.2), if_neg hyr, mul_zero]
  
  have hconv : ∀ h : ℝ³ → ℝ,
      newtonPot h = convolution newtonKernel h (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume := by
    intro h
    funext x
    rw [convolution_def, newtonPot]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← integral_sub_left_eq_self (fun t => newtonKernel t * h (x - t)) volume x]
    simp only [sub_sub_cancel]
  
  have hs3 : ∀ c : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ c → HasCompactSupport c → ∀ (k : Fin 3) (x : ℝ³),
      pd k (newtonPot c) x = newtonPot (pd k c) x := by
    intro c hc hcc k x
    have hd := hcc.hasFDerivAt_convolution_right (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) hK
      (hc.of_le (by simp)) x
    rw [← hconv c] at hd
    show fderiv ℝ (newtonPot c) x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) = _
    rw [hd.fderiv, convolution_precompR_apply (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) hK (hcc.fderiv ℝ)
      ((contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hc).2.continuous) x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1), hconv]
    rfl

      ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∫ x, pd i (pd j F) x * c x = ∫ x, F x * pd i (pd j c) x := by
    intro F c hF hc hcc i j
    have hint' : ∀ u v : ℝ³ → ℝ, Continuous u → Continuous v → HasCompactSupport u →
        Integrable (fun x => u x * v x) :=
      fun u v hu hv huc => (hu.mul hv).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport huc.mul_right

    have cjF := (hpd j F hF).continuous
    have cijF := (hpd i _ (hpd j F hF)).continuous
    have cc := hc.continuous
    have cic := (hpd i c hc).continuous
    have cjic := (hpd j _ (hpd i c hc)).continuous
    have hic := hpdc i c hcc
    have hjic := hpdc j _ hic
    have e1 : ∫ x, c x * fderiv ℝ (pd j F) x (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) =
        -∫ x, fderiv ℝ c x (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) * pd j F x :=
      integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (hint' _ _ cic cjF hic)
        (hint' _ _ cc cijF hcc) (hint' _ _ cc cjF hcc)
        (fun x _ => hc.differentiable (by simp) x)
        (fun x _ => (hpd j F hF).differentiable (by simp) x)
    have e2 : ∫ x, pd i c x * fderiv ℝ F x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) =
        -∫ x, fderiv ℝ (pd i c) x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) * F x :=
      integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (hint' _ _ cjic cF hjic)
        (hint' _ _ cic cjF hic) (hint' _ _ cic cF hic)
        (fun x _ => (hpd i c hc).differentiable (by simp) x)
        (fun x _ => hF.differentiable (by simp) x)
    have hsym : ∀ x, pd j (pd i c) x = pd i (pd j c) x := by
      intro x
      have hdc : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ c) :=
        ((contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hc).2).differentiable (by simp)
      have key : ∀ v w : ℝ³, fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ c y v) x w =
          fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ c) x w v := by
        intro v w
        rw [fderiv_clm_apply (hdc x) (differentiableAt_const _)]
        simp
      have hs := (hc.contDiffAt (x := x)).isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp)
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ c y (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) x
          (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) =
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ c y (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) x
          (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)
      rw [key, key]
      exact hs _ _
    calc ∫ x, pd i (pd j F) x * c x
        = ∫ x, c x * fderiv ℝ (pd j F) x (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) := by
          congr 1; funext x; rw [mul_comm]; rfl
      _ = -∫ x, pd i c x * fderiv ℝ F x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) := by rw [e1]; rfl
      _ = ∫ x, pd j (pd i c) x * F x := by rw [e2, neg_neg]; rfl

      ∫ x, newtonPot G x * h x = ∫ y, G y * newtonPot h y := by

    obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ := hhc.bounded_above_of_compact_support hhcs

    have hmeasK : Measurable newtonKernel := by unfold newtonKernel; fun_prop
    have hΦm : AEStronglyMeasurable

        (hGc.measurable.comp measurable_snd)).mul (hhc.measurable.comp measurable_fst)

    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply'] at hc1
    have hb1 := (hc1.const_mul H).norm
    have hb2 : Integrable (fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ³ => (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (|h p.1| * |G p.2|))
        (volume.prod volume) :=
      (hhi.abs.mul_prod hGi.abs).const_mul _
    have hΦi : Integrable (Function.uncurry fun x y => newtonKernel (x - y) * G y * h x)
        (volume.prod volume) := by
      refine Integrable.mono' (hb1.add hb2) hΦm (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_)
      rintro ⟨x, y⟩
      simp only [Function.uncurry_apply_pair, Pi.add_apply]
      have hK0 : 0 ≤ newtonKernel (x - y) := by unfold newtonKernel; positivity
      have hHx : |h x| ≤ H := by have := hH x; rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      have hH0 : 0 ≤ H := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hHx
      have hpos : 0 ≤ (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (|h x| * |G y|) := by positivity
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul,
        abs_of_nonneg hK0, abs_of_nonneg hH0]
      by_cases hz : ‖x - y‖ ≤ 1
      · have hi : (Metric.closedBall (0:ℝ³) 1).indicator newtonKernel (x - y) =
            newtonKernel (x - y) := by
          exact Set.indicator_of_mem (by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall] using hz) _
        rw [hi, abs_of_nonneg hK0]
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hHx (mul_nonneg hK0 (abs_nonneg (G y)))]
      · have hi : (Metric.closedBall (0:ℝ³) 1).indicator newtonKernel (x - y) = 0 := by
          exact Set.indicator_of_notMem (by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall] using hz) _
        rw [hi, abs_zero, mul_zero, mul_zero, zero_add]
        have hle : newtonKernel (x - y) ≤ (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ := by
          unfold newtonKernel
          apply inv_anti₀ (by positivity)
          push_neg at hz
          nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle
          (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg (G y)) (abs_nonneg (h x)))]
    have hswap := integral_integral_swap hΦi
    have e1 : (∫ x, newtonPot G x * h x) = ∫ x, ∫ y, newtonKernel (x - y) * G y * h x :=
      integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
        simp only [newtonPot]; rw [integral_mul_const])
    have e2 : (∫ y, G y * newtonPot h y) = ∫ y, ∫ x, newtonKernel (x - y) * G y * h x :=
      integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => by
        simp only [newtonPot]
        rw [← integral_const_mul]
        congr 1
        funext x
        rw [newtonKernel, newtonKernel, norm_sub_rev]
        ring)
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact hswap
  
  have hN : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (newtonPot (g i j)) :=
    fun i j => newtonPot_contDiff_of_integrable (g i j) (hg i j) (hgi i j)
  have hTint : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun x => pd i (pd j (newtonPot (g i j))) x * b x) := fun i j =>
    ((hpd i _ (hpd j _ (hN i j))).continuous.mul hb.continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      hbc.mul_left
  have hsplit : (fun x => stressPressure g x * b x) =
      fun x => ∑ i, ∑ j, pd i (pd j (newtonPot (g i j))) x * b x := by
    funext x
    simp only [stressPressure, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [hsplit, integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hTint i j))]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hTint i j)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
  have hjb := hpd j b hb
  have hjbc := hpdc j b hbc
  have hNb : newtonPot (pd j b) = pd j (newtonPot b) := funext fun x => (hs3 b hb hbc j x).symm
  rw [hs4 _ b (hN i j) hb hbc i j, hfub (g i j) (pd i (pd j b)) (hg i j).continuous
    (hgi i j) (hpd i _ hjb).continuous (hpdc i _ hjbc)]
  congr 1
  funext y
  rw [← hs3 (pd j b) hjb hjbc i y, hNb]

      _ = Real.pi⁻¹ * (‖z‖⁻¹) ^ 3 * (4 * Real.pi * r ^ 5) := by
        field_simp
  
  
  
  have dsmooth : ∀ h : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ h → ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pd k h) :=
    fun h hh k => (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hh).2.clm_apply contDiff_const
  have dcs : ∀ h : ℝ³ → ℝ, HasCompactSupport h → ∀ k, HasCompactSupport (pd k h) :=
    fun h hh k => hh.fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) _
  have hdiff : ∀ h : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ h → Differentiable ℝ h :=
    fun h hh => hh.differentiable (by simp)
  
  
  
  have star : ∀ (G : ℝ³ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ G → HasCompactSupport G → ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (x : ℝ³),
      ‖∫ y, newtonKernel (x - y) * pd i (pd j G) y‖ₑ ≤
        ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖⁻¹) ^ 3 * |G y|) := by
    intro G hG hGc i j x
    have hg := dsmooth _ (dsmooth G hG j) i
    have hgc := dcs _ (dcs G hGc j) i
    have hlim := s4 _ x hg.continuous (s1b _ hg.continuous hgc x)
    have hlim' := (continuous_enorm.tendsto _).comp hlim
    refine le_of_tendsto' hlim' (fun n => ?_)
    have hεn : (0:ℝ) < 1 / ((n:ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
    show ‖∫ y, (4 * Real.pi * Real.sqrt (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2))⁻¹ *
      pd i (pd j G) y‖ₑ ≤ _
    rw [s3 G x _ i j hG hGc hεn]
    refine (enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm _).trans (lintegral_mono_ae ?_)
    filter_upwards [(Set.countable_singleton x).ae_notMem volume] with y hy
    have hxy : x - y ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun h => hy (by simp [h]))
    rw [Real.enorm_eq_ofReal_abs, abs_mul]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (s5 _ i j (x - y) hxy) (abs_nonneg _)
  
  
  
  intro χ b hχ hb hbc i j x
  have hχb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => χ y * b y) := hχ.mul hb
  have hχbc : HasCompactSupport (fun y => χ y * b y) := hbc.mul_left
  have T : ∀ h : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ h → HasCompactSupport h →
      pd i (pd j (newtonPot h)) = newtonPot (pd i (pd j h)) := by
    intro h hh hhc
    rw [s2 h hh hhc j, s2 _ (dsmooth h hh j) (dcs h hhc j) i]
  have hlin : ∀ (k : Fin 3) (F1 F2 : ℝ³ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), Differentiable ℝ F1 →
      Differentiable ℝ F2 → pd k (fun y => F1 y - c * F2 y) y = pd k F1 y - c * pd k F2 y := by
    intro k F1 F2 c y h1 h2
    unfold pd
    rw [fderiv_fun_sub (h1 y) ((h2 y).const_mul c), fderiv_const_mul (h2 y)]
    simp
  obtain ⟨G, hGdef⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ³ → ℝ, G = fun y => (χ y - χ x) * b y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G := by rw [hGdef]; exact (hχ.sub contDiff_const).mul hb
  have hGc : HasCompactSupport G := by rw [hGdef]; exact hbc.mul_left
  have hGeq : G = fun y => χ y * b y - χ x * b y := by
    rw [hGdef]; funext y; ring
  have hpd1 : pd j G = fun y => pd j (fun y => χ y * b y) y - χ x * pd j b y := by
    rw [hGeq]
    exact funext fun y => hlin j (fun y => χ y * b y) b (χ x) y (hdiff _ hχb) (hdiff _ hb)
  have hGpd : ∀ y, pd i (pd j G) y =
      pd i (pd j (fun y => χ y * b y)) y - χ x * pd i (pd j b) y := by
    intro y
    rw [hpd1]
    exact hlin i (pd j (fun y => χ y * b y)) (pd j b) (χ x) y (hdiff _ (dsmooth _ hχb j))
      (hdiff _ (dsmooth _ hb j))
  rw [T _ hχb hχbc, T _ hb hbc]
  unfold newtonPot
  rw [← integral_const_mul, ← integral_sub
    (s1b _ (dsmooth _ (dsmooth _ hχb j) i).continuous (dcs _ (dcs _ hχbc j) i) x)
    ((s1b _ (dsmooth _ (dsmooth _ hb j) i).continuous (dcs _ (dcs _ hbc j) i) x).const_mul (χ x))]
  have hfun : (fun y => newtonKernel (x - y) * pd i (pd j (fun y => χ y * b y)) y -
      χ x * (newtonKernel (x - y) * pd i (pd j b) y)) =
      fun y => newtonKernel (x - y) * pd i (pd j G) y := by
    funext y; rw [hGpd y]; ring
  rw [hfun]
  refine (star G hG hGc i j x).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro y
  rw [hGdef]
  simp only [abs_mul, mul_assoc]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (C₀ M Ru K c₁ : ℝ), 0 < c₁ → ∃ C₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ ∀ (w u : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (φ β τ : ℝ³ → ℝ) (R I : ℝ) (i j : Fin 3), 1 ≤ R → 0 ≤ I → Continuous w → Continuous u → Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x ∧ φ x ≤ 1) → Continuous β → MemLp w 2 → (∫ x, ‖w x‖ ^ 2) ≤ C₀ → (∀ x, ‖u x‖ ≤ M) → (∀ x, Ru ≤ ‖x‖ → u x = 0) → (∀ x, |β x| ≤ 8 * c₁ / R * φ x * ‖w x‖) → MemLp τ 2 → (∫ x, τ x ^ 2) ≤ ∫ x, β x ^ 2 → (∫ x, φ x ^ 24 * ‖w x‖ ^ 6) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 6) ≤ K * (1 + I ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) → (∫⁻ x, ‖w x i * w x j + w x i * u x j + u x i * w x j‖ₑ * ‖φ x ^ 6 * τ x‖ₑ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C₁ / R * (1 + I ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4)))

signature.name: flux_main_term_estimate
signature.statement: ∀ (C₀ M Ru K c₁ : ℝ), 0 < c₁ → ∃ C₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ ∀ (w u : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (φ β τ : ℝ³ → ℝ) (R I : ℝ) (i j : Fin 3), 1 ≤ R → 0 ≤ I → Continuous w → Continuous u → Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x ∧ φ x ≤ 1) → Continuous β → MemLp w 2 → (∫ x, ‖w x‖ ^ 2) ≤ C₀ → (∀ x, ‖u x‖ ≤ M) → (∀ x, Ru ≤ ‖x‖ → u x = 0) → (∀ x, |β x| ≤ 8 * c₁ / R * φ x * ‖w x‖) → MemLp τ 2 → (∫ x, τ x ^ 2) ≤ ∫ x, β x ^ 2 → (∫ x, φ x ^ 24 * ‖w x‖ ^ 6) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 6) ≤ K * (1 + I ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) → (∫⁻ x, ‖w x i * w x j + w x i * u x j + u x i * w x j‖ₑ * ‖φ x ^ 6 * τ x‖ₑ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C₁ / R * (1 + I ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4)))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro C₀ M Ru K c₁ hc₁
  refine ⟨8 * c₁ * Real.sqrt (8 * Real.sqrt (max C₀ 0) * max C₀ 0 * max K 0 ^ 3
    + 8 * M ^ 2 * max C₀ 0 ^ 2), mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), ?_⟩
  intro w u φ β τ R I i j hR hI hw hu hφ hφcs hφ01 _hβc hwL2 hW hM _hu0 hβ hτ hτle hSob
  have hR0 : (0 : ℝ) < R := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hR
  have habs : ∀ (v : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (k : Fin 3) (x : ℝ³), |v x k| ≤ ‖v x‖ := fun v k x => by
    have := PiLp.norm_apply_le (v x) k
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
  have hsq : ∀ r : ℝ, ‖r‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) = ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ 2) := fun r => by
    rw [Real.enorm_eq_ofReal_abs, ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (abs_nonneg r) (by norm_num),
      Real.rpow_two, sq_abs]
  have hWint : Integrable (fun x => ‖w x‖ ^ 2) := hwL2.integrable_norm_pow two_ne_zero
  have hScs : HasCompactSupport (fun x => φ x ^ 24 * ‖w x‖ ^ 6) :=
    HasCompactSupport.mul_right (f' := fun x => ‖w x‖ ^ 6)
      (hφcs.comp_left (g := fun t : ℝ => t ^ 24) (by norm_num))
  have hSint : Integrable (fun x => φ x ^ 24 * ‖w x‖ ^ 6) :=
    (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun x => φ x ^ 24 * ‖w x‖ ^ 6)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hScs
  have hS0' : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x ^ 24 * ‖w x‖ ^ 6 := fun x =>
    mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (hφ01 x).1 24) (by positivity)
  set W := ∫ x, ‖w x‖ ^ 2 with hWdef
  set S := ∫ x, φ x ^ 24 * ‖w x‖ ^ 6 with hSdef
  have hW0 : 0 ≤ W := integral_nonneg fun x => by positivity
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ S := integral_nonneg hS0'
  have hWlin : ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (‖w x‖ ^ 2) = ENNReal.ofReal W :=
    (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hWint (ae_of_all _ fun x => by positivity)).symm
  have hSlin : ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (φ x ^ 24 * ‖w x‖ ^ 6) = ENNReal.ofReal S :=
    (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hSint (ae_of_all _ hS0')).symm
  
  have hmom : ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 4)
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (W ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * S ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) := by
    have h1 : ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 4) = ∫⁻ x,
        ((fun x => ENNReal.ofReal ‖w x‖) * (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 3))) x := by
      refine lintegral_congr fun x => ?_
      simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (norm_nonneg _)]
      congr 1
      ring
    have hH := ENNReal.lintegral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq volume Real.HolderConjugate.two_two
      (f := fun x => ENNReal.ofReal ‖w x‖) (g := fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 3))
      (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun x => ‖w x‖)).measurable.ennreal_ofReal.aemeasurable
      (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun x => φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 3)).measurable.ennreal_ofReal.aemeasurable
    beta_reduce at hH
    have h2 : ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal ‖w x‖ ^ (2 : ℝ) = ENNReal.ofReal W := by
      rw [← hWlin]
      refine lintegral_congr fun x => ?_
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num), Real.rpow_two]
    have h3 : ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 3) ^ (2 : ℝ) = ENNReal.ofReal S := by
      rw [← hSlin]
      refine lintegral_congr fun x => ?_
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (hφ01 x).1 12) (by positivity))
        (by norm_num), Real.rpow_two]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [h1]
    refine hH.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [h2, h3, ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg hW0 (by norm_num),
      ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg hS0 (by norm_num), ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.rpow_nonneg hW0 _)]
  have hX0 : 0 ≤ 2 * (W ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * S ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) + 8 * M ^ 2 * W :=
    add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hW0 _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hS0 _)))
      (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hW0)
  
  have hA : ∫⁻ x, ‖φ x ^ 6 * (w x i * w x j + w x i * u x j + u x i * w x j)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ)
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (W ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * S ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) + 8 * M ^ 2 * W) := by
    have hpt : ∀ x, (φ x ^ 6 * (w x i * w x j + w x i * u x j + u x i * w x j)) ^ 2
        ≤ 2 * (φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 4) + 8 * M ^ 2 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro x
      have e1 := habs w i x
      have e2 := habs w j x
      have e3 : |u x i| ≤ M := (habs u i x).trans (hM x)
      have e4 : |u x j| ≤ M := (habs u j x).trans (hM x)
      have hg : |w x i * w x j + w x i * u x j + u x i * w x j| ≤ ‖w x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * M * ‖w x‖ := by
        calc _ ≤ |w x i * w x j| + |w x i * u x j| + |u x i * w x j| := abs_add_three _ _ _
          _ = |w x i| * |w x j| + |w x i| * |u x j| + |u x i| * |w x j| := by simp only [abs_mul]
          _ ≤ ‖w x‖ * ‖w x‖ + ‖w x‖ * M + M * ‖w x‖ :=
              add_le_add (add_le_add (mul_le_mul e1 e2 (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
                (mul_le_mul e1 e4 (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)))
                (mul_le_mul e3 e2 (abs_nonneg _) ((norm_nonneg _).trans (hM x)))
          _ = _ := by ring
      have hg2 : (w x i * w x j + w x i * u x j + u x i * w x j) ^ 2
          ≤ (‖w x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * M * ‖w x‖) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hg 2
      have hq : (‖w x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * M * ‖w x‖) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖w x‖ ^ 4 + 8 * M ^ 2 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖w x‖ ^ 2 - 2 * M * ‖w x‖)]
      have hp0 : 0 ≤ φ x ^ 12 := pow_nonneg (hφ01 x).1 12
      have hp1 : φ x ^ 12 ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (hφ01 x).1 (hφ01 x).2
      have hn : 0 ≤ 8 * M ^ 2 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
      calc (φ x ^ 6 * (w x i * w x j + w x i * u x j + u x i * w x j)) ^ 2
          = φ x ^ 12 * (w x i * w x j + w x i * u x j + u x i * w x j) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ φ x ^ 12 * (2 * ‖w x‖ ^ 4 + 8 * M ^ 2 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hg2.trans hq) hp0
        _ = 2 * (φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 4) + φ x ^ 12 * (8 * M ^ 2 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2) := by ring
        _ ≤ 2 * (φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 4) + 8 * M ^ 2 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2 := by
            have := mul_le_of_le_one_left hn hp1
            linarith
    have hm1 : Measurable (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 4))) :=
      (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun x => 2 * (φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 4))).measurable.ennreal_ofReal
    have hI1 : ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 4))
        = 2 * ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 4) := by
      rw [← lintegral_const_mul' 2 _ (by simp)]
      refine lintegral_congr fun x => ?_
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat]
    have hI2 : ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (8 * M ^ 2 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2) = ENNReal.ofReal (8 * M ^ 2 * W) := by
      rw [hWdef, ← integral_const_mul]
      exact (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hWint.const_mul _)
        (ae_of_all _ fun x => by positivity)).symm
    calc ∫⁻ x, ‖φ x ^ 6 * (w x i * w x j + w x i * u x j + u x i * w x j)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ)
        = ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal ((φ x ^ 6 * (w x i * w x j + w x i * u x j + u x i * w x j)) ^ 2) :=
          lintegral_congr fun x => hsq _
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ x, (ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 4))
            + ENNReal.ofReal (8 * M ^ 2 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2)) :=
          lintegral_mono fun x => (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hpt x)).trans ENNReal.ofReal_add_le
      _ = (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 4)))
            + ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (8 * M ^ 2 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2) :=
          lintegral_add_left hm1 (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (8 * M ^ 2 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2))
      _ = 2 * (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (φ x ^ 12 * ‖w x‖ ^ 4)) + ENNReal.ofReal (8 * M ^ 2 * W) := by
          rw [hI1, hI2]
      _ ≤ 2 * ENNReal.ofReal (W ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * S ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2))
            + ENNReal.ofReal (8 * M ^ 2 * W) := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by
          rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add (mul_nonneg (by norm_num)
              (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hW0 _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hS0 _)))
              (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hW0),
            ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat]
  
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ 8 * c₁ / R := by positivity
  have hB : ∫⁻ x, ‖τ x‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((8 * c₁ / R) ^ 2 * W) := by
    have hpt : ∀ x, β x ^ 2 ≤ (8 * c₁ / R) ^ 2 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro x
      have h1 : |β x| ≤ 8 * c₁ / R * ‖w x‖ := by
        have := hβ x
        have h2 : 8 * c₁ / R * φ x * ‖w x‖ ≤ 8 * c₁ / R * ‖w x‖ := by
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hφ01 x).2) (mul_nonneg ha0 (norm_nonneg (w x)))]
        linarith
      rw [← sq_abs, ← mul_pow]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h1 2
    calc ∫⁻ x, ‖τ x‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) = ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (τ x ^ 2) := lintegral_congr fun x => hsq _
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, τ x ^ 2) :=
          (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hτ.integrable_sq (ae_of_all _ fun x => sq_nonneg _)).symm
      _ ≤ _ := by
          apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
          refine hτle.trans ?_
          rw [hWdef, ← integral_const_mul]
          exact integral_mono_of_nonneg (ae_of_all _ fun x => sq_nonneg _) (hWint.const_mul _)
            (ae_of_all _ hpt)
  
  have harith : (2 * (W ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * S ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) + 8 * M ^ 2 * W) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)
      * ((8 * c₁ / R) ^ 2 * W) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)
      ≤ 8 * c₁ * Real.sqrt (8 * Real.sqrt (max C₀ 0) * max C₀ 0 * max K 0 ^ 3
        + 8 * M ^ 2 * max C₀ 0 ^ 2) / R * (1 + I ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4)) := by
    have hC0 : 0 ≤ max C₀ 0 := le_max_right _ _
    have hKp0 : 0 ≤ max K 0 := le_max_right _ _
    have hWC : W ≤ max C₀ 0 := hW.trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have hQ0 : 0 ≤ 8 * Real.sqrt (max C₀ 0) * max C₀ 0 * max K 0 ^ 3
        + 8 * M ^ 2 * max C₀ 0 ^ 2 :=
      add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) hC0)
        (pow_nonneg hKp0 3)) (by positivity)
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ I ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4) := Real.rpow_nonneg hI _
    have hs2 : I ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) = (I ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hI]; norm_num
    have hs3 : I ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4) = (I ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4)) ^ 3 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hI]; norm_num
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ S ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 6) := Real.rpow_nonneg hS0 _
    have hSt : S ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) = (S ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 6)) ^ 3 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hS0]; norm_num
    have htle : S ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 6) ≤ max K 0 * (1 + (I ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4)) ^ 2) := by
      rw [← hs2]
      exact hSob.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _)
        (by have := Real.rpow_nonneg hI ((1 : ℝ) / 2); linarith))
    have hv : W ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (max C₀ 0) := by
      rw [← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]; exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hWC
    rw [hs3, hSt]
    generalize I ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4) = s at hs0 htle ⊢
    generalize S ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 6) = t at ht0 htle ⊢
    generalize hvdef : W ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) = v at hv ⊢
    have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := by rw [← hvdef]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg hW0 _
    generalize max C₀ 0 = C at hC0 hWC hQ0 hv ⊢
    generalize max K 0 = Kp at hKp0 hQ0 htle ⊢
    have hJ1 : 1 ≤ 1 + s ^ 3 := by have := pow_nonneg hs0 3; linarith
    have hpoly : (1 + s ^ 2) ^ 3 ≤ 4 * (1 + s ^ 3) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (1 - s ^ 2)) (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + s ^ 2),
        pow_nonneg hs0 3]
    have hkey : (2 * (v * t ^ 3) + 8 * M ^ 2 * W) * W
        ≤ (8 * Real.sqrt C * C * Kp ^ 3 + 8 * M ^ 2 * C ^ 2) * (1 + s ^ 3) ^ 2 := by
      have h1 : v * W ≤ Real.sqrt C * C := mul_le_mul hv hWC hW0 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      have h2 : t ^ 3 ≤ Kp ^ 3 * (4 * (1 + s ^ 3) ^ 2) := by
        calc t ^ 3 ≤ (Kp * (1 + s ^ 2)) ^ 3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ ht0 htle 3
          _ = Kp ^ 3 * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ 3 := by ring
          _ ≤ Kp ^ 3 * (4 * (1 + s ^ 3) ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpoly (pow_nonneg hKp0 3)
      have h3 : v * W * t ^ 3 ≤ Real.sqrt C * C * (Kp ^ 3 * (4 * (1 + s ^ 3) ^ 2)) :=
        mul_le_mul h1 h2 (pow_nonneg ht0 3) (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hC0)
      have h4 : M ^ 2 * W ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2 * C ^ 2 * (1 + s ^ 3) ^ 2 := by
        calc M ^ 2 * W ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2 * C ^ 2 :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ hW0 hWC 2) (sq_nonneg M)
          _ ≤ M ^ 2 * C ^ 2 * (1 + s ^ 3) ^ 2 :=
              le_mul_of_one_le_right (by positivity) (one_le_pow₀ hJ1)
      have e1 : (2 * (v * t ^ 3) + 8 * M ^ 2 * W) * W
          = 2 * (v * W * t ^ 3) + 8 * (M ^ 2 * W ^ 2) := by ring
      have e2 : (8 * Real.sqrt C * C * Kp ^ 3 + 8 * M ^ 2 * C ^ 2) * (1 + s ^ 3) ^ 2
          = 2 * (Real.sqrt C * C * (Kp ^ 3 * (4 * (1 + s ^ 3) ^ 2)))
            + 8 * (M ^ 2 * C ^ 2 * (1 + s ^ 3) ^ 2) := by ring
      rw [e1, e2]
      linarith
    have hX0' : 0 ≤ 2 * (v * t ^ 3) + 8 * M ^ 2 * W :=
      add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (mul_nonneg hv0 (pow_nonneg ht0 3)))
        (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hW0)
    generalize 2 * (v * t ^ 3) + 8 * M ^ 2 * W = X at hX0' hkey ⊢
    generalize 8 * Real.sqrt C * C * Kp ^ 3 + 8 * M ^ 2 * C ^ 2 = Q at hQ0 hkey ⊢
    generalize 1 + s ^ 3 = J at hJ1 hkey ⊢
    have hJ0 : 0 ≤ J := by linarith
    rw [← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.sqrt_mul hX0']
    rw [show 8 * c₁ * Real.sqrt Q / R * J = Real.sqrt ((8 * c₁ / R) ^ 2 * Q * J ^ 2) by
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hQ0), Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _),
        Real.sqrt_sq ha0, Real.sqrt_sq hJ0]
      ring]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    calc X * ((8 * c₁ / R) ^ 2 * W) = (8 * c₁ / R) ^ 2 * (X * W) := by ring
      _ ≤ (8 * c₁ / R) ^ 2 * (Q * J ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkey (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := by ring
  
  have hgc : Continuous (fun x => φ x ^ 6 * (w x i * w x j + w x i * u x j + u x i * w x j)) := by
    fun_prop
  have hHol := ENNReal.lintegral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq volume Real.HolderConjugate.two_two
    (f := fun x => ‖φ x ^ 6 * (w x i * w x j + w x i * u x j + u x i * w x j)‖ₑ)
    (g := fun x => ‖τ x‖ₑ) hgc.aestronglyMeasurable.enorm hτ.aestronglyMeasurable.enorm
  beta_reduce at hHol
  have hLHS : (∫⁻ x, ‖w x i * w x j + w x i * u x j + u x i * w x j‖ₑ * ‖φ x ^ 6 * τ x‖ₑ)
      = ∫⁻ x, ((fun x => ‖φ x ^ 6 * (w x i * w x j + w x i * u x j + u x i * w x j)‖ₑ)
          * (fun x => ‖τ x‖ₑ)) x := by
    refine lintegral_congr fun x => ?_
    simp only [Pi.mul_apply, enorm_mul]
    ring
  have hfin : (∫⁻ x, ‖φ x ^ 6 * (w x i * w x j + w x i * u x j + u x i * w x j)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ))
        ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * (∫⁻ x, ‖τ x‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ)) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * (W ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * S ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) + 8 * M ^ 2 * W)
          ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * ((8 * c₁ / R) ^ 2 * W) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) := by
    calc _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (W ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * S ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) + 8 * M ^ 2 * W)
            ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * ENNReal.ofReal ((8 * c₁ / R) ^ 2 * W) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) :=
          mul_le_mul' (ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow hA (by norm_num)) (ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow hB (by norm_num))
      _ = _ := by
          rw [ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg hX0 (by norm_num),
            ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hW0) (by norm_num),
            ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.rpow_nonneg hX0 _)]
  rw [hLHS]
  exact hHol.trans (hfin.trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal harith))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (C₀ M Ru K c₁ : ℝ), 0 < c₁ → ∃ C₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₂ ∧ ∀ (w u : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (φ β : ℝ³ → ℝ) (R I : ℝ) (i j : Fin 3), 1 ≤ R → 0 ≤ I → Continuous w → Continuous u → Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x ∧ φ x ≤ 1) → Continuous β → MemLp w 2 → (∫ x, ‖w x‖ ^ 2) ≤ C₀ → (∀ x, ‖u x‖ ≤ M) → (∀ x, Ru ≤ ‖x‖ → u x = 0) → (∀ x, |β x| ≤ 8 * c₁ / R * φ x * ‖w x‖) → (∀ x y, |φ y ^ 6 - φ x ^ 6| ≤ min 1 (3 * c₁ / R * ‖x - y‖) * (φ x ^ 3 + φ y ^ 3)) → (∫ x, φ x ^ 24 * ‖w x‖ ^ 6) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 6) ≤ K * (1 + I ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) → (∫⁻ x, ‖w x i * w x j + w x i * u x j + u x i * w x j‖ₑ * ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖⁻¹) ^ 3 * |φ y ^ 6 - φ x ^ 6| * |β y|)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C₂ / R * (1 + I ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4)))

signature.statement: ∀ (C₀ M Ru K c₁ : ℝ), 0 < c₁ → ∃ C₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₂ ∧ ∀ (w u : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (φ β : ℝ³ → ℝ) (R I : ℝ) (i j : Fin 3), 1 ≤ R → 0 ≤ I → Continuous w → Continuous u → Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x ∧ φ x ≤ 1) → Continuous β → MemLp w 2 → (∫ x, ‖w x‖ ^ 2) ≤ C₀ → (∀ x, ‖u x‖ ≤ M) → (∀ x, Ru ≤ ‖x‖ → u x = 0) → (∀ x, |β x| ≤ 8 * c₁ / R * φ x * ‖w x‖) → (∀ x y, |φ y ^ 6 - φ x ^ 6| ≤ min 1 (3 * c₁ / R * ‖x - y‖) * (φ x ^ 3 + φ y ^ 3)) → (∫ x, φ x ^ 24 * ‖w x‖ ^ 6) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 6) ≤ K * (1 + I ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) → (∫⁻ x, ‖w x i * w x j + w x i * u x j + u x i * w x j‖ₑ * ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖⁻¹) ^ 3 * |φ y ^ 6 - φ x ^ 6| * |β y|)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C₂ / R * (1 + I ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 4)))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro C₀ M Ru K c₁ hc₁
  have hV0 : 0 ≤ (volume (Metric.ball (0:ℝ³) Ru)).toReal := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hC' : 0 ≤ max C₀ 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hM' : 0 ≤ max M 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hK' : 0 ≤ max K 0 := le_max_right _ _
  refine ⟨2 * ((48 * Real.pi * c₁) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) / Real.pi) * (8 * c₁) * (2 * (max C₀ 0 + 2 * max M 0 * ((volume (Metric.ball (0:ℝ³) Ru)).toReal + max C₀ 0)) * max C₀ 0 ^ ((1:ℝ)/8) * max K 0 ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) + 2 ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) * (2 * max C₀ 0 ^ ((9:ℝ)/8) * max K 0 ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) + 2 * max M 0 * ((volume (Metric.ball (0:ℝ³) Ru)).toReal + max C₀ 0) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * max C₀ 0 ^ ((1:ℝ)/2))), ?_, ?_⟩
  · positivity
  intro w u φ β R I i j hR hI hw hu hφ hφc hφ01 hβ hwL2 hW hM hu0 hβb hsplit hSob
  have hR0 : (0:ℝ) < R := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hR
  have hpi : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.pi⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr Real.pi_pos.le
  have ha : (0:ℝ) < 3 * c₁ / R := by positivity
  have hA8 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 8 * c₁ / R := by positivity
  have hW0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x, ‖w x‖ ^ 2 := integral_nonneg fun x => by positivity
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x, φ x ^ 24 * ‖w x‖ ^ 6 :=
    integral_nonneg fun x => mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (hφ01 x).1 _) (by positivity)
  have hJ0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 + I ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) := add_nonneg zero_le_one (Real.rpow_nonneg hI _)
  
  obtain ⟨hg1, hg2⟩ := flux_comm_g_moments (max M 0) Ru w u φ i j hw hu hφ hφc hφ01 hwL2
    (fun x => (hM x).trans (le_max_left _ _)) hu0
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := flux_beta_moments (8 * c₁ / R) w φ β hA8 hw hφ hβ hφc hφ01 hwL2 hβb
  have hk3 := kernel_four_thirds_integral (3 * c₁ / R) ha
  have harith := flux_comm_arith (max C₀ 0) (max M 0) (max K 0) c₁
    (volume (Metric.ball (0:ℝ³) Ru)).toReal R (∫ x, ‖w x‖ ^ 2) (∫ x, φ x ^ 24 * ‖w x‖ ^ 6) I
    hC' hM' hK' hc₁ hV0 hR hW0 (hW.trans (le_max_left _ _)) hS0 hI
    (hSob.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hJ0))
  
  obtain ⟨g, hgdef⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ³ → ℝ, ∀ x, g x = w x i * w x j + w x i * u x j + u x i * w x j :=
    ⟨_, fun x => rfl⟩
  simp only [← hgdef] at hg1 hg2 ⊢
  have hcomp : ∀ (v : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (k : Fin 3), Continuous v → Continuous (fun y => v y k) :=
    fun v k hv => (EuclideanSpace.proj k : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.comp hv
  have hgc : Continuous g := by
    have e : g = fun x => w x i * w x j + w x i * u x j + u x i * w x j := funext hgdef
    rw [e]
    exact (((hcomp w i hw).mul (hcomp w j hw)).add ((hcomp w i hw).mul (hcomp u j hu))).add
      ((hcomp u i hu).mul (hcomp w j hw))
  
  obtain ⟨kk, hkk⟩ : ∃ kk : ℝ³ → ENNReal, ∀ z,
      kk z = ENNReal.ofReal ((‖z‖⁻¹) ^ 3 * min 1 (3 * c₁ / R * ‖z‖)) := ⟨_, fun z => rfl⟩
  have hE : ∀ z : ℝ³, 0 ≤ (‖z‖⁻¹) ^ 3 * min 1 (3 * c₁ / R * ‖z‖) := fun z =>
    mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg _)) 3)
      (le_min zero_le_one (mul_nonneg ha.le (norm_nonneg _)))
  have hkm : Measurable kk := by
    have e : kk = fun z => ENNReal.ofReal ((‖z‖⁻¹) ^ 3 * min 1 (3 * c₁ / R * ‖z‖)) := funext hkk
    rw [e]
    exact (((measurable_norm.inv).pow_const 3).mul
      (measurable_const.min (measurable_const.mul measurable_norm))).ennreal_ofReal
  have hFm : Measurable fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (φ x ^ 3 * |g x|) :=
    ((hφ.pow 3).mul hgc.abs).measurable.ennreal_ofReal
  have hGm : Measurable fun x => ENNReal.ofReal |g x| := hgc.abs.measurable.ennreal_ofReal
  have hH1m : Measurable fun y => ENNReal.ofReal |β y| := hβ.abs.measurable.ennreal_ofReal
  have hH2m : Measurable fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (φ y ^ 3 * |β y|) :=
    ((hφ.pow 3).mul hβ.abs).measurable.ennreal_ofReal
  
  have hpt : ∀ x y, ‖g x‖ₑ * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖⁻¹) ^ 3 * |φ y ^ 6 - φ x ^ 6| * |β y|)
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal Real.pi⁻¹ * (ENNReal.ofReal (φ x ^ 3 * |g x|) * kk (x - y) * ENNReal.ofReal |β y|
        + ENNReal.ofReal |g x| * kk (x - y) * ENNReal.ofReal (φ y ^ 3 * |β y|)) := by
    intro x y
    have hP : 0 ≤ φ x ^ 3 := pow_nonneg (hφ01 x).1 3
    have hQ : 0 ≤ φ y ^ 3 := pow_nonneg (hφ01 y).1 3
    have hγ : 0 ≤ |g x| := abs_nonneg _
    have hb : 0 ≤ |β y| := abs_nonneg _
    have hEm := hE (x - y)
    have hreal : |g x| * (Real.pi⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖⁻¹) ^ 3 * |φ y ^ 6 - φ x ^ 6| * |β y|)
        ≤ Real.pi⁻¹ * ((φ x ^ 3 * |g x|) * ((‖x - y‖⁻¹) ^ 3 * min 1 (3 * c₁ / R * ‖x - y‖)) * |β y|
          + |g x| * ((‖x - y‖⁻¹) ^ 3 * min 1 (3 * c₁ / R * ‖x - y‖)) * (φ y ^ 3 * |β y|)) := by
      have h1 := hsplit x y
      have h2 : |g x| * (Real.pi⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖⁻¹) ^ 3 * |φ y ^ 6 - φ x ^ 6| * |β y|)
          ≤ |g x| * (Real.pi⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖⁻¹) ^ 3 *
            (min 1 (3 * c₁ / R * ‖x - y‖) * (φ x ^ 3 + φ y ^ 3)) * |β y|) := by
        gcongr
      calc _ ≤ _ := h2
        _ = _ := by ring
    calc ‖g x‖ₑ * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖⁻¹) ^ 3 * |φ y ^ 6 - φ x ^ 6| * |β y|)
        = ENNReal.ofReal (|g x| * (Real.pi⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖⁻¹) ^ 3 * |φ y ^ 6 - φ x ^ 6| * |β y|)) := by
          rw [Real.enorm_eq_ofReal_abs, ENNReal.ofReal_mul hγ]
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi⁻¹ * ((φ x ^ 3 * |g x|) * ((‖x - y‖⁻¹) ^ 3 * min 1 (3 * c₁ / R * ‖x - y‖)) * |β y|
          + |g x| * ((‖x - y‖⁻¹) ^ 3 * min 1 (3 * c₁ / R * ‖x - y‖)) * (φ y ^ 3 * |β y|))) :=
          ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hreal
      _ = _ := by
          rw [hkk, ENNReal.ofReal_mul hpi,
            ENNReal.ofReal_add (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hP hγ) hEm) hb)
              (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hγ hEm) (mul_nonneg hQ hb)),
            ENNReal.ofReal_mul (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hP hγ) hEm), ENNReal.ofReal_mul (mul_nonneg hP hγ),
            ENNReal.ofReal_mul (mul_nonneg hγ hEm), ENNReal.ofReal_mul hγ]
  
  have hstep1 : (∫⁻ x, ‖g x‖ₑ * ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖⁻¹) ^ 3 * |φ y ^ 6 - φ x ^ 6| * |β y|))
      ≤ ∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal Real.pi⁻¹ * (ENNReal.ofReal (φ x ^ 3 * |g x|) * kk (x - y) * ENNReal.ofReal |β y|
        + ENNReal.ofReal |g x| * kk (x - y) * ENNReal.ofReal (φ y ^ 3 * |β y|)) := by
    refine lintegral_mono fun x => ?_
    try dsimp only
    rw [← lintegral_const_mul' (‖g x‖ₑ) _ enorm_ne_top]
    exact lintegral_mono fun y => hpt x y
  have hA : ∀ x, Measurable fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (φ x ^ 3 * |g x|) * kk (x - y) * ENNReal.ofReal |β y| :=
    fun x => (measurable_const.mul (hkm.comp (measurable_const.sub measurable_id))).mul hH1m
  have hIA : Measurable fun x => ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (φ x ^ 3 * |g x|) * kk (x - y) * ENNReal.ofReal |β y| :=
    Measurable.lintegral_prod_right'
      (f := fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ³ => ENNReal.ofReal (φ p.1 ^ 3 * |g p.1|) * kk (p.1 - p.2) * ENNReal.ofReal |β p.2|)
      (((hFm.comp measurable_fst).mul (hkm.comp (measurable_fst.sub measurable_snd))).mul
        (hH1m.comp measurable_snd))
  have hstep2 : (∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal Real.pi⁻¹ * (ENNReal.ofReal (φ x ^ 3 * |g x|) * kk (x - y) * ENNReal.ofReal |β y|
        + ENNReal.ofReal |g x| * kk (x - y) * ENNReal.ofReal (φ y ^ 3 * |β y|)))
      = ENNReal.ofReal Real.pi⁻¹ * ((∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (φ x ^ 3 * |g x|) * kk (x - y) * ENNReal.ofReal |β y|)
        + ∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal |g x| * kk (x - y) * ENNReal.ofReal (φ y ^ 3 * |β y|)) := by
    calc _ = ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal Real.pi⁻¹ * ((∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (φ x ^ 3 * |g x|) * kk (x - y) * ENNReal.ofReal |β y|)
          + ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal |g x| * kk (x - y) * ENNReal.ofReal (φ y ^ 3 * |β y|)) :=
          lintegral_congr fun x => by
            rw [lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top, lintegral_add_left (hA x)]
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal Real.pi⁻¹ * ∫⁻ x, ((∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (φ x ^ 3 * |g x|) * kk (x - y) * ENNReal.ofReal |β y|)
          + ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal |g x| * kk (x - y) * ENNReal.ofReal (φ y ^ 3 * |β y|)) :=
          lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
      _ = _ := by rw [lintegral_add_left hIA]
  
  have hKk : (∫⁻ z, kk z ^ ((4:ℝ)/3)) = ENNReal.ofReal (16 * Real.pi * (3 * c₁ / R)) := by
    rw [← hk3]
    exact lintegral_congr fun z => by rw [hkk, ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (hE z) (by norm_num)]
  have hF43eq : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (φ x ^ 3 * |g x|) ^ ((4:ℝ)/3))
      = ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal ((φ x ^ 3 * |g x|) ^ ((4:ℝ)/3)) :=
    lintegral_congr fun x =>
      ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (hφ01 x).1 3) (abs_nonneg _)) (by norm_num)
  have hH1eq : (∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal |β y| ^ (2:ℝ)) = ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (β y ^ 2) :=
    lintegral_congr fun y => by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num), Real.rpow_two, sq_abs]
  have hH2eq : (∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (φ y ^ 3 * |β y|) ^ (4:ℝ))
      = ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal ((φ y ^ 3 * |β y|) ^ 4) :=
    lintegral_congr fun y => by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (hφ01 y).1 3) (abs_nonneg _)) (by norm_num)]
      congr 1
      rw [show (4:ℝ) = ((4:ℕ):ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_natCast]
  have hTa := trilinear_young_four_thirds (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (φ x ^ 3 * |g x|)) kk
    (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal |β y|) hFm hkm hH1m
  have hTb := trilinear_holder_one_four (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal |g x|) kk
    (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (φ y ^ 3 * |β y|)) hGm hkm hH2m
  have hTa' := hTa.trans (mul_le_mul' (mul_le_mul'
    (ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow (hF43eq.le.trans hg2) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ (3:ℝ)/4))
    (ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow hKk.le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ (3:ℝ)/4)))
    (ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow (hH1eq.le.trans hb1) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ (1:ℝ)/2)))
  have hTb' := hTb.trans (mul_le_mul' (mul_le_mul' hg1
    (ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow hKk.le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ (3:ℝ)/4)))
    (ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow (hH2eq.le.trans hb2) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ (1:ℝ)/4)))
  have key : ∀ (Ta Tb : ENNReal) (X5 X3 Y2 Y4 Kc : ℝ), 0 ≤ X5 → 0 ≤ X3 → 0 ≤ Y2 → 0 ≤ Y4 → 0 ≤ Kc →
      Ta ≤ ENNReal.ofReal X5 ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * ENNReal.ofReal Kc ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * ENNReal.ofReal Y2 ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) →
      Tb ≤ ENNReal.ofReal X3 * ENNReal.ofReal Kc ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * ENNReal.ofReal Y4 ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) →
      ENNReal.ofReal Real.pi⁻¹ * (Ta + Tb) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi⁻¹ * Kc ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) *
        (X5 ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * Y2 ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) + X3 * Y4 ^ ((1:ℝ)/4))) := by
    intro Ta Tb X5 X3 Y2 Y4 Kc h5 h3 h2 h4 hk hTa hTb
    have e : Real.pi⁻¹ * Kc ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * (X5 ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * Y2 ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) + X3 * Y4 ^ ((1:ℝ)/4))
        = Real.pi⁻¹ * (X5 ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * Kc ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * Y2 ^ ((1:ℝ)/2)
          + X3 * Kc ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * Y4 ^ ((1:ℝ)/4)) := by ring
    have p5 := Real.rpow_nonneg h5 ((3:ℝ)/4)
    have pk := Real.rpow_nonneg hk ((3:ℝ)/4)
    have p2 := Real.rpow_nonneg h2 ((1:ℝ)/2)
    have p4 := Real.rpow_nonneg h4 ((1:ℝ)/4)
    rw [e, ENNReal.ofReal_mul hpi,
      ENNReal.ofReal_add (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p5 pk) p2) (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg h3 pk) p4),
      ENNReal.ofReal_mul (mul_nonneg p5 pk), ENNReal.ofReal_mul p5,

    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv] at h
    exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hεE (m + 1) (by omega)) hn10)
  have bT5 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun q => L₃ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ε) q)) z‖ ≤ n3 * (K * E) := by
    have h := hlin L₃ n3 hn3e.symm (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ε)) m hD2ε
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv, norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv] at h
    exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hεE (m + 1 + 1) (by omega)) hn30)
  have bT6 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun q => L₄ (fderiv ℝ dp q)) z‖ ≤ n4 * E := by
    have h := hlin L₄ n4 hn4e.symm (fderiv ℝ dp) m (hfd dp hdps)
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv] at h
    exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdpE hn40)
  have bT2 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun q => B (fderiv ℝ (↿u₀) q) (ι (ε q))) z‖ ≤
      nB * 2 ^ m * ((K * U) * (nι * (K * E))) :=
    hbil B nB hnBe.symm (fderiv ℝ (↿u₀)) (fun q => ι (ε q)) (K * U) (nι * (K * E)) (hfd _ hu₀s)
      (hεs.continuousLinearMap_comp ι)
      (fun i hi => by rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]; exact hu₀U (i + 1) (by omega))
      (fun i hi => (hlin ι nι hnιe.symm ε i hεs).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hεE i (by omega)) hnι0))
  have bT3 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun q => B (fderiv ℝ ε q) (ι ((↿u₀) q))) z‖ ≤
      nB * 2 ^ m * ((K * E) * (nι * (K * U))) :=
    hbil B nB hnBe.symm (fderiv ℝ ε) (fun q => ι ((↿u₀) q)) (K * E) (nι * (K * U)) (hfd _ hεs)
      (hu₀s.continuousLinearMap_comp ι)
      (fun i hi => by rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]; exact hεE (i + 1) (by omega))
      (fun i hi => (hlin ι nι hnιe.symm (↿u₀) i hu₀s).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hu₀U i (by omega)) hnι0))
  have bT4 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun q => B (fderiv ℝ ε q) (ι (ε q))) z‖ ≤
      nB * 2 ^ m * ((K * E) * (nι * (K * U))) :=
    hbil B nB hnBe.symm (fderiv ℝ ε) (fun q => ι (ε q)) (K * E) (nι * (K * U)) (hfd _ hεs)
      (hεs.continuousLinearMap_comp ι)
      (fun i hi => by rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]; exact hεE (i + 1) (by omega))
      (fun i hi => (hlin ι nι hnιe.symm ε i hεs).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hεU i (by omega)) hnι0))
  obtain ⟨s2, b2⟩ := hadd _ _ _ _ sT1 sT2 bT1 bT2
  obtain ⟨s3, b3⟩ := hadd _ _ _ _ s2 sT3 b2 bT3
  obtain ⟨s4, b4⟩ := hadd _ _ _ _ s3 sT4 b3 bT4
  obtain ⟨s5, b5⟩ := hadd _ _ _ _ s4 sT5 b4 bT5
  obtain ⟨_, b6⟩ := hadd _ _ _ _ s5 sT6 b5 bT6
  have hfin : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Dj z‖ ≤ c1 * E + c2 * (E * U) := by
    rw [hDj]
    refine b6.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [hc1, hc2]
    ring
  have hmain := norm_le_norm_add_norm_sub' (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(nsResidual 1 u₁ P₁)) z)
    (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(nsResidual 1 u₀ P₀)) z)
  rw [hRR] at hmain
  have x1 := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc10 hE0) hU0
  have x2 := mul_nonneg hc20 hE0
  have hid2 : (c1 + c2) * E * (1 + U) = c1 * E + c2 * (E * U) + (c1 * E * U + c2 * E) := by ring
  rw [hid2]
  linarith only [hmain, hfin, x1, x2]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h qs Xe Xin c e0 γ : ℝ) (ℓ K : ℕ → ℝ) (A Bv : ℕ → ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (P : ℕ → ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → 0 < γ → SimScaleProps h → ApproxFamily h qs Xe Xin c e0 γ ℓ K A Bv P → ∀ J M : ℕ, ∃ D : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ M → ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), (↿(A j)) z) (x, t)‖ ≤ D * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), (|K i| + |ℓ i|))) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), (↿(Bv j)) z) (x, t)‖ ≤ D * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), (|K i| + |ℓ i|))) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), (↿(P j)) z) (x, t)‖ ≤ D * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), (|K i| + |ℓ i|)))

signature.name: approx_partial_sum_bound
signature.statement: ∀ (h qs Xe Xin c e0 γ : ℝ) (ℓ K : ℕ → ℝ) (A Bv : ℕ → ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (P : ℕ → ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → 0 < γ → SimScaleProps h → ApproxFamily h qs Xe Xin c e0 γ ℓ K A Bv P → ∀ J M : ℕ, ∃ D : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ M → ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), (↿(A j)) z) (x, t)‖ ≤ D * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), (|K i| + |ℓ i|))) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), (↿(Bv j)) z) (x, t)‖ ≤ D * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), (|K i| + |ℓ i|))) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), (↿(P j)) z) (x, t)‖ ≤ D * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), (|K i| + |ℓ i|)))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h qs Xe Xin c e0 γ ℓ K A Bv P hh0 hh1 hqs0 hqs1 hγ hS hAF J M
  obtain ⟨hsm, -, hb0, hbj, -, -, -, -⟩ := hAF
  have hΩ : IsOpen (simDomain h qs) := by
    have hU : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h v.1 v.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hf : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hg : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
      refine h1.comp hf.continuousOn ?_
      intro w hw
      have hw' : w.2 < 1 := hw
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 by linarith⟩
    exact hg.isOpen_inter_preimage hU isOpen_Iio
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ : ∃ κ : ℝ, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), (|K i| + |ℓ i|) = κ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [hκ]
  have hKk : ∀ k, k ≤ M → |K k| + |ℓ k| ≤ κ := by
    intro k hk
    rw [← hκ]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |K i| + |ℓ i|) (fun i _ => by positivity)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  have tr : ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs → ∀ (e C₀ X : ℝ), -κ ≤ e →
      X ≤ C₀ * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ e → X ≤ |C₀| * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-κ) := by
    intro x t hxt e C₀ X he hX
    have ht : t < 1 := hxt.1
    have hq0 : 0 < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) := (hS.1 (x 2) (1 - t) (by linarith)).1
    have hq1 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≤ 1 := by
      have : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < qs := hxt.2
      linarith
    exact hX.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1 he) (abs_nonneg _)))
  have hterm : ∀ j k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ (k ≤ M → ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain h qs →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(A j)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-κ) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(Bv j)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-κ) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(P j)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-κ)) := by
    intro j k
    by_cases hj : j = 0
    · subst hj
      obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hb0 k
      refine ⟨|C₀|, abs_nonneg _, fun hk x t hxt => ?_⟩
      have he : -κ ≤ -K k := by
        have := hKk k hk
        linarith [le_abs_self (K k), abs_nonneg (ℓ k)]
      obtain ⟨b1, b2, b3⟩ := hC₀ x t hxt
      exact ⟨tr x t hxt _ _ _ he b1, tr x t hxt _ _ _ he b2, tr x t hxt _ _ _ he b3⟩
    · obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hbj j (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hj) k
      refine ⟨|C₀|, abs_nonneg _, fun hk x t hxt => ?_⟩
      have he : -κ ≤ γ * (j : ℝ) - ℓ k := by
        have := hKk k hk
        have := mul_nonneg hγ.le (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) j)
        linarith [le_abs_self (ℓ k), abs_nonneg (K k)]
      obtain ⟨b1, b2, b3⟩ := hC₀ x t hxt
      exact ⟨tr x t hxt _ _ _ he b1, tr x t hxt _ _ _ he b2, tr x t hxt _ _ _ he b3⟩
  choose Ch hCh0 hCh using hterm
  have hsumle : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : ℕ → ℝ³ × ℝ → F)
      (k : ℕ) (z : ℝ³ × ℝ), (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f j) (simDomain h qs)) → z ∈ simDomain h qs →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), f j w) z‖ ≤
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (f j) z‖ := by
    intro F _ _ f k z hf hz
    have e : (fun w => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), f j w) = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), f j :=
      (Finset.sum_fn _ _).symm
    rw [e, iteratedFDeriv_sum_apply (fun j _ =>
      ((hf j).contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hz)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
    exact norm_sum_le _ _
  refine ⟨∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), ∑ k' ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), Ch j k', fun k hk x t hxt => ?_⟩
  have ht : t < 1 := hxt.1
  have hW : 0 ≤ simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-κ) :=
    Real.rpow_nonneg (hS.1 (x 2) (1 - t) (by linarith)).1.le _
  have hcol : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), Ch j k ≤
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), ∑ k' ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), Ch j k' :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k' => Ch j k')
      (fun k' _ => hCh0 j k') (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk)))
  have fin : ∀ (g : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℝ), N ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), g j →
      (∀ j, g j ≤ Ch j k * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-κ)) →
      N ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), ∑ k' ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), Ch j k') *
        simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-κ) := by
    intro g N hN hg
    calc N ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), g j := hN
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), Ch j k * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-κ) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hg j)
      _ = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), Ch j k) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-κ) :=
          (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcol hW
  refine ⟨fin _ _ (hsumle (fun j => ↿(A j)) k (x, t) (fun j => (hsm j).1) hxt)
      (fun j => (hCh j k hk x t hxt).1),
    fin _ _ (hsumle (fun j => ↿(Bv j)) k (x, t) (fun j => (hsm j).2.1) hxt)
      (fun j => (hCh j k hk x t hxt).2.1),
    fin _ _ (hsumle (fun j => ↿(P j)) k (x, t) (fun j => (hsm j).2.2) hxt)
      (fun j => (hCh j k hk x t hxt).2.2)⟩
