proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨h, lam, Pst, ab, Rst, Pax, hD, hlam, _hab, _hR, hO⟩ := outer_axis_datum
  obtain ⟨R0, hA⟩ := axis_profile_exists h Pst Pax hD
  obtain ⟨cpatch, cinf, Xg, Xg2, r1, r2, p1, p2, m1, m2, Xv, Xc, Xb, Fo, Uo, hOP⟩ :=
    hO (max Rst R0) (le_max_left _ _)
  obtain ⟨Xa, Xan, Xa1, Xa2, Xh1, aa, Fi, Ui, hAP⟩ := hA (max Rst R0) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hJ := join_profiles h lam Pst (max Rst R0) cpatch cinf ab Xg Xg2 r1 r2 p1 p2 m1 m2 Xv Xc Xb
    Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 Xh1 aa Pax Fo Uo Fi Ui hD hlam hOP hAP
  obtain ⟨FN, UN, hM⟩ := modulation_family shear_loop_exists lead_ps_regularity
    _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hJ
  obtain ⟨F', U', hL⟩ := repair_assembly moment_patch_repair lead_ps_regularity ps_perturbation
    cone_gap_quadratic _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ FN UN hJ hM
  exact ⟨h, lam, cinf, cpatch, Xa, Xb, Xv, Xc, p1, p2, m1, m2, aa, ab, F', U', _, _, hL⟩

leading_profile_exists.definitions:
noncomputable def psLead1 (h : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ := X * leadQs h F U X η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)

noncomputable def psLead2 (h : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  X * leadNs h F U X η / ((1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η))

noncomputable def coneUp (P J : ℝ) : ℝ := P + J ^ 2 / 4 - |J| * Real.sqrt ((P - 2) / 2 + J ^ 2 / 16)

noncomputable def refFin (Pst XR X η : ℝ) : ℝ := Pst * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (X / XR) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (2 * X)

def RelaxCone (h μ : ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
    μ ≤ F X η ∧ μ ≤ shearA F X η ∧
    μ ≤ psLead1 h F U X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * psLead2 h F U X η - 2 ∧
    μ ≤ coneUp (psLead1 h F U X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * psLead2 h F U X η)
          (psLead2 h F U X η + shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * psLead1 h F U X η)
        - shearA F X η * (1 + (shearB F U X η / shearA F X η) ^ 2)

def AdmBlk (h : ℝ) (w δ : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∃ c₀ : ℝ, 0 < c₀ ∧ ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      c₀ * w X ≤ Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U X η ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F U X η ^ 2)) ∧
  (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTh h F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * w X * δ X ^ (-N) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTz h F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * w X * δ X ^ (-N) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTz h F U z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧
  (∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ κ < 2 ∧ ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      κ ≤ F X η ∧ κ ≤ shearA F X η ∧
      κ ≤ shearA F X η * (1 + (shearB F U X η / shearA F X η) ^ 2) - 2 ∧
      κ * Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U X η ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F U X η ^ 2) ≤
        leadStressTh h F U X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * leadStressTz h F U X η ∧
      (shearA F X η * (1 + (shearB F U X η / shearA F X η) ^ 2) - 2) *
          (leadStressTz h F U X η + shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * leadStressTh h F U X η) ^ 2 ≤
        (2 - κ) * (leadStressTh h F U X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * leadStressTz h F U X η) ^ 2)

def AxDatum (h Pst : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < h ∧ h < 1 / 100 ∧ 0 < Pst ∧ Real.exp 10 < Pst ∧
  (∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ Pc : ℂ → ℂ,
     DifferentiableOn ℂ Pc {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
     ∀ η : ℝ, -1 - ρ < η → η < 1 + ρ → Pc (η : ℂ) = ((Pax η : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, Pax (-η) = Pax η) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → Pax η ≤ -(5 / 2) * Pst ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → η ≠ 0 → 0 < η * deriv Pax η)

def OutProf (h lam Pst XR cpatch cinf ab Xg Xg2 r1 r2 p1 p2 m1 m2 Xv Xc Xb : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ)
    (Fo Uo : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (0 < cpatch ∧ 0 < cinf ∧ 0 < ab ∧ 0 < XR ∧ XR < Xg ∧ Xg < Xg2 ∧ Xg2 < r1 ∧ r1 < r2 ∧ r2 < p1 ∧
      p1 < p2 ∧ p2 < m1 ∧ m1 < m2 ∧ m2 < Xv ∧ Xv < Xc ∧ Xc < Xb) ∧
  (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Fo) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Uo) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < Fo X η) ∧
    (∀ X₀ X₁ : ℝ, 0 < X₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₀ ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Fo) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Uo) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ XR → -1 < η → η < 1 → Uo X η = 4 * η ∧ Fo X η = refFin Pst XR X η) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, ((r1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ r2) ∨ (p1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ p2) ∨ (m1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ m2)) → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      Uo X η = 0 ∧ Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Fo X η = cpatch * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam))) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, Xb ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → Uo X η = 0 ∧
      Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Fo X η = cinf * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X)) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, Xv ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → Uo X η = 0 ∧ profRadInt Uo X η = 0) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      IntegrableOn (fun x => Uo x η * (2 * x * Fo x η)) (Ioi 0) ∧
      IntegrableOn (fun x => Uo x η ^ 2 - x * Fo x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧
      IntegrableOn (fun x => 2 * x * Fo x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) (Ioi 0) ∧
      IntegrableOn (fun x => Fo x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧
      (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), Uo x η * (2 * x * Fo x η)) = 0 ∧
      (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (Uo x η ^ 2 - x * Fo x η ^ 2)) = 0 ∧
      (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (2 * x * Fo x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))) = 0 ∧
      leadPi Fo 0 η = Pax η) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => Uo x η) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * Fo x η) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => Uo x η * (2 * x * Fo x η)) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => Uo x η ^ 2 - x * Fo x η ^ 2) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => Fo x η ^ 2) volume 0 X) ∧
  (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xc ≤ X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) * Fo w.1 w.2 -
          cinf * w.1 ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - w.2 ^ 2) / w.1)) (X, η)‖ ≤
        C * Real.exp (-(ab / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2)) * (min 1 (Real.log (Xb / X))) ^ (-N)) ∧
  ((∀ X η : ℝ, Xb ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      leadStressTh h Fo Uo X η = 0 ∧ leadStressTz h Fo Uo X η = 0) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTh h Fo Uo)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTz h Fo Uo)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    AdmBlk h (fun X => Real.exp (-(ab / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2))) (fun X => min 1 (Real.log (Xb / X)))
      (Ico Xg Xb) Fo Uo ∧
    (∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ RelaxCone h μ (Icc (XR * Real.exp (-5)) Xg2) Fo Uo))

def AxProf (h Pst XR Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 Xh1 aa : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Fi Ui : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (0 < XR ∧ 0 < aa ∧ 0 < Xa ∧ Xa < Xan ∧ Xan < Xa1 ∧ Xa1 < Xa2 ∧ Xa2 < Xh1 ∧
      Xh1 < XR * Real.exp (-5)) ∧
  (∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Fi) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Ui) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < Fi X η) ∧
    (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Fi) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Ui) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, Xh1 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → Ui X η = 4 * η ∧ Fi X η = refFin Pst XR X η) ∧
  (∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ Fc Uc Pc : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ,
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Fc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Uc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Pc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xan →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Fc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Uc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Pc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      (∀ w : ℂ, |w.im| < ρ → -1 - ρ < w.re → w.re < 1 + ρ →
        ‖Fc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Uc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Pc k X w‖ ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
        Fc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => Fi Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Uc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => Ui Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Pc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => Pax η + profRadInt (fun x e => Fi x e ^ 2) Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ))) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
     profRadInt Ui (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η = profRadInt (fun _ e => 4 * e) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η ∧
     profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * Fi x e) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η =
       profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * refFin Pst XR x e) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η ∧
     profRadInt (fun x e => Ui x e * (2 * x * Fi x e)) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η =
       profRadInt (fun x e => 4 * e * (2 * x * refFin Pst XR x e)) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η ∧
     profRadInt (fun x e => Ui x e ^ 2 - x * Fi x e ^ 2) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η =
       profRadInt (fun x e => (4 * e) ^ 2 - x * refFin Pst XR x e ^ 2) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η ∧
     profRadInt (fun x e => Fi x e ^ 2) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η =
       profRadInt (fun x e => refFin Pst XR x e ^ 2) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η) ∧
  (∀ F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < XR → -1 < η → η < 1 → F X η = Fi X η ∧ U X η = Ui X η) →
    (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ leadPi F 0 η = Pax η) →
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ Xa → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        leadStressTh h F U X η = 0 ∧ leadStressTz h F U X η = 0) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTh h F U)) (Ioo 0 XR ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTz h F U)) (Ioo 0 XR ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    AdmBlk h (fun X => Real.exp (-(aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2))) (fun X => min 1 (Real.log (X / Xa)))
      (Ioc Xa Xa2) F U ∧
    (∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ RelaxCone h μ (Icc Xa1 (XR * Real.exp (-5))) F U))

def JoinProf (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xan Xm Xm2 Xp2 Xp r1 r2 : ℝ)
    (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (0 < h ∧ h < 1 / 100 ∧ 0 < lam ∧ 0 < cinf ∧ 0 < cpatch ∧ 0 < aa ∧ 0 < ab ∧
      0 < Xa ∧ Xa < p1 ∧ p1 < p2 ∧ p2 < m1 ∧ m1 < m2 ∧ m2 < Xv ∧ Xv < Xc ∧ Xc < Xb ∧
      Xa < Xan ∧ Xan < Xm ∧ Xm < Xm2 ∧ Xm2 < Xp2 ∧ Xp2 < Xp ∧ Xp < r1 ∧ r1 < r2 ∧ r2 < p1) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, r1 ≤ X → X ≤ r2 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      U X η = 0 ∧ Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η = cpatch * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam))) ∧
  ((∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → (X ≤ Xa ∨ Xb ≤ X) → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      leadStressTh h F U X η = 0 ∧ leadStressTz h F U X η = 0) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTh h F U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTz h F U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧
  AdmBlk h (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab) (edgeDist Xa Xb) (Ioc Xa Xm2 ∪ Ico Xp2 Xb) F U ∧
  (∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ RelaxCone h μ (Icc Xm Xp) F U) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * F x η) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η * (2 * x * F x η)) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => F x η ^ 2) volume 0 X) ∧
  (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η) ∧
    (∀ X₀ X₁ : ℝ, 0 < X₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₀ ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)) ∧
  (∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F 0 η) ∧
    (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)) ∧
  (∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ Fc Uc Pc : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ,
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Fc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Uc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Pc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xan →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Fc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Uc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Pc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      (∀ w : ℂ, |w.im| < ρ → -1 - ρ < w.re → w.re < 1 + ρ →
        ‖Fc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Uc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Pc k X w‖ ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
        Fc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => F Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Uc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => U Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Pc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => leadPi F Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ))) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, Xb ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → U X η = 0 ∧
      Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η = cinf * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X)) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, Xv ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → U X η = 0 ∧ profRadInt U X η = 0) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, ((p1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ p2) ∨ (m1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ m2)) → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      U X η = 0 ∧ Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η = cpatch * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam))) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), U x η * (2 * x * F x η)) = 0 ∧
      (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2)) = 0 ∧
      (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (2 * x * F x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))) = 0) ∧
  (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xc ≤ X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) * F w.1 w.2 -
          cinf * w.1 ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - w.2 ^ 2) / w.1)) (X, η)‖ ≤
        C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N))

noncomputable def patchF0 (lam cpatch η x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  cpatch * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam)) / Real.sqrt (2 * x)

def repU (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (c : Fin 5 → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ := c 0 * β 0 x + c 1 * β 1 x

noncomputable def repF (lam cpatch : ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ) (c : Fin 5 → ℝ) (η x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  patchF0 lam cpatch η x + c 2 * γ 0 x + c 3 * γ 1 x + c 4 * γ 2 x

def LoopProperty : Prop :=
  ∀ μ A δ0 : ℝ, 0 < μ → 0 < A → 0 < δ0 →
  ∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ ∃ aL bL : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => aL z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2.1 z.2.2.2.1 z.2.2.2.2)
      {z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | μ / 2 < z.1 ∧ |z.2.2.2.1| < 2 * A} ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => bL z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2.1 z.2.2.2.1 z.2.2.2.2)
      {z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | μ / 2 < z.1 ∧ |z.2.2.2.1| < 2 * A} ∧
    (∀ a b p1 p2 : ℝ, μ / 2 < a → |p2| < 2 * A →
      (∀ φ : ℝ, aL a b p1 p2 (φ + 1) = aL a b p1 p2 φ ∧ bL a b p1 p2 (φ + 1) = bL a b p1 p2 φ) ∧
      (∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..1, aL a b p1 p2 φ) = a ∧ (∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..1, bL a b p1 p2 φ) = b ∧
      (2 + δ0 ≤ a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) → ∀ φ : ℝ, aL a b p1 p2 φ = a ∧ bL a b p1 p2 φ = b)) ∧
    (∀ a b p1 p2 φ : ℝ, μ ≤ a → a ≤ A → |b| ≤ A → |p1| ≤ A → |p2| ≤ A →
      μ ≤ p1 - b / a * p2 - 2 →
      μ ≤ coneUp (p1 - b / a * p2) (p2 + b / a * p1) - a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) →
      κ ≤ aL a b p1 p2 φ ∧
      κ ≤ aL a b p1 p2 φ * (1 + (bL a b p1 p2 φ / aL a b p1 p2 φ) ^ 2) - 2 ∧
      κ ≤ p1 - bL a b p1 p2 φ / aL a b p1 p2 φ * p2 - 2 ∧
      κ ≤ coneUp (p1 - bL a b p1 p2 φ / aL a b p1 p2 φ * p2)
            (p2 + bL a b p1 p2 φ / aL a b p1 p2 φ * p1)
        - aL a b p1 p2 φ * (1 + (bL a b p1 p2 φ / aL a b p1 p2 φ) ^ 2))

def RepairProperty : Prop :=
  ∀ lam cpatch r1 r2 : ℝ, 0 < lam → 0 < cpatch → 0 < r1 → r1 < r2 →
  ∃ (s1 s2 δ C : ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ) (Φ : (Fin 5 → ℝ) → ℝ → (Fin 5 → ℝ)),
    r1 < s1 ∧ s1 < s2 ∧ s2 < r2 ∧ 0 < δ ∧
    (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (β i)) ∧ (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (γ j)) ∧
    (∀ i x, (x ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ x) → β i x = 0) ∧ (∀ j x, (x ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ x) → γ j x = 0) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : (Fin 5 → ℝ) × ℝ => Φ p.1 p.2)
      (Metric.ball (0 : Fin 5 → ℝ) δ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) ∧
    (∀ η : ℝ, Φ 0 η = 0) ∧
    ∀ (d : Fin 5 → ℝ) (η : ℝ), ‖d‖ < δ → -2 < η → η < 2 →
      ‖Φ d η‖ ≤ C * ‖d‖ ∧
      (∫ x in r1..r2, repU β (Φ d η) x) = d 0 ∧
      (∫ x in r1..r2, 2 * x * (repF lam cpatch γ (Φ d η) η x - patchF0 lam cpatch η x)) = d 1 ∧
      (∫ x in r1..r2, repU β (Φ d η) x * (2 * x * repF lam cpatch γ (Φ d η) η x)) = d 2 ∧
      (∫ x in r1..r2, (repU β (Φ d η) x ^ 2 - x * repF lam cpatch γ (Φ d η) η x ^ 2
          + x * patchF0 lam cpatch η x ^ 2)) = d 3 ∧
      (∫ x in r1..r2, (repF lam cpatch γ (Φ d η) η x ^ 2 - patchF0 lam cpatch η x ^ 2)) = d 4 ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, r1 ≤ x → x ≤ r2 → patchF0 lam cpatch η x / 2 ≤ repF lam cpatch γ (Φ d η) η x

def ProfileReg (h cinf Xb ε : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η) ∧
    (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧
    (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0)) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, Xb ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → U X η = 0 ∧
      Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η = cinf * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X))

def LeadPsRegularity : Prop :=
  ∀ (h cinf Xb ε : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 < Xb → 0 < ε →
    ProfileReg h cinf Xb ε F U →
    (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(psLead1 h F U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(psLead2 h F U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTh h F U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTz h F U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧
    (∀ X₁ X₂ c : ℝ, 0 < X₁ → 0 < c → (∀ X η : ℝ, X₁ ≤ X → X ≤ X₂ → -1 < η → η < 1 → c ≤ F X η) →
      ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₁ ≤ X → X ≤ X₂ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(psLead1 h F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(psLead2 h F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTh h F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTz h F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)

def PsPerturbation : Prop :=
  ∀ (h cinf Xb ε X₁ X₂ c : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 < Xb → 0 < ε →
    0 < X₁ → X₁ ≤ X₂ → 0 < c → ProfileReg h cinf Xb ε F U →
    (∀ X η : ℝ, X₁ ≤ X → X ≤ X₂ → -1 < η → η < 1 → c ≤ F X η) →
    ∃ C δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ ∀ (F' U' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (δ : ℝ), ProfileReg h cinf Xb ε F' U' → δ ≤ δ₀ →
      (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → leadPi F' 0 η = leadPi F 0 η) →
      (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₂ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        |F' X η - F X η| ≤ δ ∧ |U' X η - U X η| ≤ δ ∧
        |deriv (fun e => F' X e) η - deriv (fun e => F X e) η| ≤ δ ∧
        |deriv (fun e => U' X e) η - deriv (fun e => U X e) η| ≤ δ) →
      ∀ X η : ℝ, X₁ ≤ X → X ≤ X₂ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        |psLead1 h F' U' X η - psLead1 h F U X η| ≤ C * δ ∧
        |psLead2 h F' U' X η - psLead2 h F U X η| ≤ C * δ

def ConeGapQuadratic : Prop :=
  (∀ κ W P J v : ℝ, 0 < κ → 2 + κ ≤ P → v ≤ coneUp P J - κ → P - v ≤ W →
    κ ≤ P - v ∧ (v - 2) * J ^ 2 ≤ (2 - min 1 (2 * κ ^ 2 / W ^ 2)) * (P - v) ^ 2) ∧
  (∀ κ W P J v : ℝ, 0 < κ → κ ≤ 2 → 2 ≤ P → κ ≤ P - v → (v - 2) * J ^ 2 ≤ (2 - κ) * (P - v) ^ 2 →
    P - v ≤ W → |J| ≤ W → κ ^ 3 / (4 * W + W ^ 2) ≤ coneUp P J - v)

def ModulatedFamily (h Xm Xp : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (FN UN : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (Xm' Xp' κ C : ℝ) (N0 : ℕ), Xm < Xm' ∧ Xm' < Xp' ∧ Xp' < Xp ∧ 0 < κ ∧ 1 ≤ N0 ∧
  ∀ N : ℕ, N0 ≤ N →
    (∀ X η : ℝ, (X ≤ Xm' ∨ Xp' ≤ X) → FN N X η = F X η ∧ UN N X η = U X η) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(FN N)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(UN N)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < FN N X η) ∧
    (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C' : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(FN N)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C' ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(UN N)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C') ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      |FN N X η - F X η| ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ∧ |UN N X η - U X η| ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ∧
      |deriv (fun e => FN N X e) η - deriv (fun e => F X e) η| ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ∧
      |deriv (fun e => UN N X e) η - deriv (fun e => U X e) η| ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ∧
      κ ≤ shearA (FN N) X η ∧ shearA (FN N) X η ≤ 1 / κ ∧ |shearB (FN N) (UN N) X η| ≤ 1 / κ ∧
      κ ≤ shearA (FN N) X η * (1 + (shearB (FN N) (UN N) X η / shearA (FN N) X η) ^ 2) - 2 ∧
      κ ≤ psLead1 h F U X η - shearB (FN N) (UN N) X η / shearA (FN N) X η * psLead2 h F U X η - 2 ∧
      κ ≤ coneUp (psLead1 h F U X η - shearB (FN N) (UN N) X η / shearA (FN N) X η * psLead2 h F U X η)
            (psLead2 h F U X η + shearB (FN N) (UN N) X η / shearA (FN N) X η * psLead1 h F U X η)
          - shearA (FN N) X η * (1 + (shearB (FN N) (UN N) X η / shearA (FN N) X η) ^ 2))

and_nodes.definitions_block:
noncomputable def leadPs1 (h : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  X * leadQs h F U X η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)

noncomputable def leadPs2 (h : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  X * leadNs h F U X η / ((1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η))

noncomputable def coneUpper (P J : ℝ) : ℝ := P + J ^ 2 / 4 - |J| * Real.sqrt ((P - 2) / 2 + J ^ 2 / 16)

noncomputable def refF (Pst XR X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Pst * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (X / XR) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (2 * X)

def RelaxedCone (h μ : ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
    μ ≤ F X η ∧ μ ≤ shearA F X η ∧
    μ ≤ leadPs1 h F U X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * leadPs2 h F U X η - 2 ∧
    μ ≤ coneUpper (leadPs1 h F U X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * leadPs2 h F U X η)
          (leadPs2 h F U X η + shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * leadPs1 h F U X η)
        - shearA F X η * (1 + (shearB F U X η / shearA F X η) ^ 2)

def AdmBlock (h : ℝ) (w δ : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∃ c₀ : ℝ, 0 < c₀ ∧ ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      c₀ * w X ≤ Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U X η ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F U X η ^ 2)) ∧
  (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTh h F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * w X * δ X ^ (-N) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTz h F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * w X * δ X ^ (-N) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTz h F U z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧
  (∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ κ < 2 ∧ ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      κ ≤ F X η ∧ κ ≤ shearA F X η ∧
      κ ≤ shearA F X η * (1 + (shearB F U X η / shearA F X η) ^ 2) - 2 ∧
      κ * Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U X η ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F U X η ^ 2) ≤
        leadStressTh h F U X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * leadStressTz h F U X η ∧
      (shearA F X η * (1 + (shearB F U X η / shearA F X η) ^ 2) - 2) *
          (leadStressTz h F U X η + shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * leadStressTh h F U X η) ^ 2 ≤
        (2 - κ) * (leadStressTh h F U X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * leadStressTz h F U X η) ^ 2)

def AxisDatum (h Pst : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < h ∧ h < 1 / 100 ∧ 0 < Pst ∧
  (∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ Pc : ℂ → ℂ,
     DifferentiableOn ℂ Pc {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
     ∀ η : ℝ, -1 - ρ < η → η < 1 + ρ → Pc (η : ℂ) = ((Pax η : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, Pax (-η) = Pax η) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → Pax η ≤ -(5 / 2) * Pst ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → η ≠ 0 → 0 < η * deriv Pax η)

def OuterProfile (h lam Pst XR cpatch cinf ab Xg Xg2 r1 r2 p1 p2 m1 m2 Xv Xc Xb : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ)
    (Fo Uo : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (0 < cpatch ∧ 0 < cinf ∧ 0 < ab ∧ 0 < XR ∧ XR < Xg ∧ Xg < Xg2 ∧ Xg2 < r1 ∧ r1 < r2 ∧ r2 < p1 ∧
      p1 < p2 ∧ p2 < m1 ∧ m1 < m2 ∧ m2 < Xv ∧ Xv < Xc ∧ Xc < Xb) ∧
  (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Fo) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Uo) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < Fo X η) ∧
    (∀ X₀ X₁ : ℝ, 0 < X₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₀ ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Fo) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Uo) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ XR → -1 < η → η < 1 → Uo X η = 4 * η ∧ Fo X η = refF Pst XR X η) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, ((r1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ r2) ∨ (p1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ p2) ∨ (m1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ m2)) → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      Uo X η = 0 ∧ Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Fo X η = cpatch * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam))) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, Xb ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → Uo X η = 0 ∧
      Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Fo X η = cinf * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X)) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, Xv ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → Uo X η = 0 ∧ profRadInt Uo X η = 0) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      IntegrableOn (fun x => Uo x η * (2 * x * Fo x η)) (Ioi 0) ∧
      IntegrableOn (fun x => Uo x η ^ 2 - x * Fo x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧
      IntegrableOn (fun x => 2 * x * Fo x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) (Ioi 0) ∧
      IntegrableOn (fun x => Fo x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧
      (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), Uo x η * (2 * x * Fo x η)) = 0 ∧
      (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (Uo x η ^ 2 - x * Fo x η ^ 2)) = 0 ∧
      (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (2 * x * Fo x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))) = 0 ∧
      leadPi Fo 0 η = Pax η) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => Uo x η) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * Fo x η) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => Uo x η * (2 * x * Fo x η)) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => Uo x η ^ 2 - x * Fo x η ^ 2) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => Fo x η ^ 2) volume 0 X) ∧
  (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xc ≤ X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) * Fo w.1 w.2 -
          cinf * w.1 ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - w.2 ^ 2) / w.1)) (X, η)‖ ≤
        C * Real.exp (-(ab / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2)) * (min 1 (Real.log (Xb / X))) ^ (-N)) ∧
  ((∀ X η : ℝ, Xb ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      leadStressTh h Fo Uo X η = 0 ∧ leadStressTz h Fo Uo X η = 0) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTh h Fo Uo)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTz h Fo Uo)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    AdmBlock h (fun X => Real.exp (-(ab / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2))) (fun X => min 1 (Real.log (Xb / X)))
      (Ico Xg Xb) Fo Uo ∧
    (∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ RelaxedCone h μ (Icc (XR * Real.exp (-5)) Xg2) Fo Uo))

def AxisProfile (h Pst XR Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 Xh1 aa : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Fi Ui : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (0 < XR ∧ 0 < aa ∧ 0 < Xa ∧ Xa < Xan ∧ Xan < Xa1 ∧ Xa1 < Xa2 ∧ Xa2 < Xh1 ∧
      Xh1 < XR * Real.exp (-5)) ∧
  (∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Fi) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Ui) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < Fi X η) ∧
    (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Fi) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Ui) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, Xh1 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → Ui X η = 4 * η ∧ Fi X η = refF Pst XR X η) ∧
  (∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ Fc Uc Pc : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ,
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Fc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Uc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Pc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xan →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Fc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Uc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Pc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      (∀ w : ℂ, |w.im| < ρ → -1 - ρ < w.re → w.re < 1 + ρ →
        ‖Fc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Uc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Pc k X w‖ ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
        Fc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => Fi Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Uc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => Ui Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Pc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => Pax η + profRadInt (fun x e => Fi x e ^ 2) Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ))) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
     profRadInt Ui (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η = profRadInt (fun _ e => 4 * e) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η ∧
     profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * Fi x e) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η =
       profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * refF Pst XR x e) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η ∧
     profRadInt (fun x e => Ui x e * (2 * x * Fi x e)) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η =
       profRadInt (fun x e => 4 * e * (2 * x * refF Pst XR x e)) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η ∧
     profRadInt (fun x e => Ui x e ^ 2 - x * Fi x e ^ 2) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η =
       profRadInt (fun x e => (4 * e) ^ 2 - x * refF Pst XR x e ^ 2) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η ∧
     profRadInt (fun x e => Fi x e ^ 2) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η =
       profRadInt (fun x e => refF Pst XR x e ^ 2) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η) ∧
  (∀ F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < XR → -1 < η → η < 1 → F X η = Fi X η ∧ U X η = Ui X η) →
    (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ leadPi F 0 η = Pax η) →
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ Xa → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        leadStressTh h F U X η = 0 ∧ leadStressTz h F U X η = 0) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTh h F U)) (Ioo 0 XR ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTz h F U)) (Ioo 0 XR ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    AdmBlock h (fun X => Real.exp (-(aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2))) (fun X => min 1 (Real.log (X / Xa)))
      (Ioc Xa Xa2) F U ∧
    (∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ RelaxedCone h μ (Icc Xa1 (XR * Real.exp (-5))) F U))

def JoinedProfile (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xan Xm Xm2 Xp2 Xp r1 r2 : ℝ)
    (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (0 < h ∧ h < 1 / 100 ∧ 0 < lam ∧ 0 < cinf ∧ 0 < cpatch ∧ 0 < aa ∧ 0 < ab ∧
      0 < Xa ∧ Xa < p1 ∧ p1 < p2 ∧ p2 < m1 ∧ m1 < m2 ∧ m2 < Xv ∧ Xv < Xc ∧ Xc < Xb ∧
      Xa < Xan ∧ Xan < Xm ∧ Xm < Xm2 ∧ Xm2 < Xp2 ∧ Xp2 < Xp ∧ Xp < r1 ∧ r1 < r2 ∧ r2 < p1) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, r1 ≤ X → X ≤ r2 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      U X η = 0 ∧ Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η = cpatch * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam))) ∧
  ((∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → (X ≤ Xa ∨ Xb ≤ X) → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      leadStressTh h F U X η = 0 ∧ leadStressTz h F U X η = 0) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTh h F U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTz h F U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧
  AdmBlock h (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab) (edgeDist Xa Xb) (Ioc Xa Xm2 ∪ Ico Xp2 Xb) F U ∧
  (∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ RelaxedCone h μ (Icc Xm Xp) F U) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * F x η) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η * (2 * x * F x η)) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => F x η ^ 2) volume 0 X) ∧
  (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η) ∧
    (∀ X₀ X₁ : ℝ, 0 < X₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₀ ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)) ∧
  (∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F 0 η) ∧
    (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)) ∧
  (∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ Fc Uc Pc : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ,
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Fc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Uc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Pc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xan →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Fc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Uc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Pc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      (∀ w : ℂ, |w.im| < ρ → -1 - ρ < w.re → w.re < 1 + ρ →
        ‖Fc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Uc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Pc k X w‖ ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
        Fc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => F Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Uc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => U Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Pc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => leadPi F Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ))) ∧

noncomputable def psLead1 (h : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ := X * leadQs h F U X η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)

noncomputable def psLead2 (h : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  X * leadNs h F U X η / ((1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η))

noncomputable def coneUp (P J : ℝ) : ℝ := P + J ^ 2 / 4 - |J| * Real.sqrt ((P - 2) / 2 + J ^ 2 / 16)

noncomputable def refFin (Pst XR X η : ℝ) : ℝ := Pst * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (X / XR) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (2 * X)

def RelaxCone (h μ : ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
    μ ≤ F X η ∧ μ ≤ shearA F X η ∧
    μ ≤ psLead1 h F U X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * psLead2 h F U X η - 2 ∧
    μ ≤ coneUp (psLead1 h F U X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * psLead2 h F U X η)
          (psLead2 h F U X η + shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * psLead1 h F U X η)
        - shearA F X η * (1 + (shearB F U X η / shearA F X η) ^ 2)

  (∃ c₀ : ℝ, 0 < c₀ ∧ ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      c₀ * w X ≤ Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U X η ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F U X η ^ 2)) ∧

      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTh h F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * w X * δ X ^ (-N) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTz h F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * w X * δ X ^ (-N) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTz h F U z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧

          (leadStressTz h F U X η + shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * leadStressTh h F U X η) ^ 2 ≤

  (∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ Fc Uc Pc : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ,
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Fc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Uc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Pc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xan →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Fc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Uc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Pc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      (∀ w : ℂ, |w.im| < ρ → -1 - ρ < w.re → w.re < 1 + ρ →
        ‖Fc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Uc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Pc k X w‖ ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
        Fc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => F Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Uc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => U Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Pc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => leadPi F Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ))) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, Xb ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → U X η = 0 ∧
      Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η = cinf * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X)) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, Xv ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → U X η = 0 ∧ profRadInt U X η = 0) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, ((p1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ p2) ∨ (m1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ m2)) → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      U X η = 0 ∧ Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η = cpatch * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam))) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), U x η * (2 * x * F x η)) = 0 ∧
      (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2)) = 0 ∧
      (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (2 * x * F x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))) = 0) ∧
  (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xc ≤ X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) * F w.1 w.2 -
          cinf * w.1 ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - w.2 ^ 2) / w.1)) (X, η)‖ ≤
        C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N))

noncomputable def patchF0 (lam cpatch η x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  cpatch * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam)) / Real.sqrt (2 * x)

def repU (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (c : Fin 5 → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ := c 0 * β 0 x + c 1 * β 1 x

noncomputable def repF (lam cpatch : ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ) (c : Fin 5 → ℝ) (η x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  patchF0 lam cpatch η x + c 2 * γ 0 x + c 3 * γ 1 x + c 4 * γ 2 x

def LoopProperty : Prop :=
  ∀ μ A δ0 : ℝ, 0 < μ → 0 < A → 0 < δ0 →
  ∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ ∃ aL bL : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => aL z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2.1 z.2.2.2.1 z.2.2.2.2)
      {z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | μ / 2 < z.1 ∧ |z.2.2.2.1| < 2 * A} ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => bL z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2.1 z.2.2.2.1 z.2.2.2.2)
      {z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | μ / 2 < z.1 ∧ |z.2.2.2.1| < 2 * A} ∧
    (∀ a b p1 p2 : ℝ, μ / 2 < a → |p2| < 2 * A →
      (∀ φ : ℝ, aL a b p1 p2 (φ + 1) = aL a b p1 p2 φ ∧ bL a b p1 p2 (φ + 1) = bL a b p1 p2 φ) ∧
      (∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..1, aL a b p1 p2 φ) = a ∧ (∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..1, bL a b p1 p2 φ) = b ∧
      (2 + δ0 ≤ a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) → ∀ φ : ℝ, aL a b p1 p2 φ = a ∧ bL a b p1 p2 φ = b)) ∧
    (∀ a b p1 p2 φ : ℝ, μ ≤ a → a ≤ A → |b| ≤ A → |p1| ≤ A → |p2| ≤ A →
      μ ≤ p1 - b / a * p2 - 2 →
      μ ≤ coneUp (p1 - b / a * p2) (p2 + b / a * p1) - a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) →
      κ ≤ aL a b p1 p2 φ ∧
      κ ≤ aL a b p1 p2 φ * (1 + (bL a b p1 p2 φ / aL a b p1 p2 φ) ^ 2) - 2 ∧
      κ ≤ p1 - bL a b p1 p2 φ / aL a b p1 p2 φ * p2 - 2 ∧
      κ ≤ coneUp (p1 - bL a b p1 p2 φ / aL a b p1 p2 φ * p2)
            (p2 + bL a b p1 p2 φ / aL a b p1 p2 φ * p1)
        - aL a b p1 p2 φ * (1 + (bL a b p1 p2 φ / aL a b p1 p2 φ) ^ 2))

def RepairProperty : Prop :=
  ∀ lam cpatch r1 r2 : ℝ, 0 < lam → 0 < cpatch → 0 < r1 → r1 < r2 →
  ∃ (s1 s2 δ C : ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ) (Φ : (Fin 5 → ℝ) → ℝ → (Fin 5 → ℝ)),
    r1 < s1 ∧ s1 < s2 ∧ s2 < r2 ∧ 0 < δ ∧
    (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (β i)) ∧ (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (γ j)) ∧
    (∀ i x, (x ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ x) → β i x = 0) ∧ (∀ j x, (x ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ x) → γ j x = 0) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : (Fin 5 → ℝ) × ℝ => Φ p.1 p.2)
      (Metric.ball (0 : Fin 5 → ℝ) δ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) ∧
    (∀ η : ℝ, Φ 0 η = 0) ∧
    ∀ (d : Fin 5 → ℝ) (η : ℝ), ‖d‖ < δ → -2 < η → η < 2 →
      ‖Φ d η‖ ≤ C * ‖d‖ ∧
      (∫ x in r1..r2, repU β (Φ d η) x) = d 0 ∧
      (∫ x in r1..r2, 2 * x * (repF lam cpatch γ (Φ d η) η x - patchF0 lam cpatch η x)) = d 1 ∧
      (∫ x in r1..r2, repU β (Φ d η) x * (2 * x * repF lam cpatch γ (Φ d η) η x)) = d 2 ∧
      (∫ x in r1..r2, (repU β (Φ d η) x ^ 2 - x * repF lam cpatch γ (Φ d η) η x ^ 2
          + x * patchF0 lam cpatch η x ^ 2)) = d 3 ∧
      (∫ x in r1..r2, (repF lam cpatch γ (Φ d η) η x ^ 2 - patchF0 lam cpatch η x ^ 2)) = d 4 ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, r1 ≤ x → x ≤ r2 → patchF0 lam cpatch η x / 2 ≤ repF lam cpatch γ (Φ d η) η x

def ProfileReg (h cinf Xb ε : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η) ∧
    (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧
    (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0)) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, Xb ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → U X η = 0 ∧
      Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η = cinf * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X))

def LeadPsRegularity : Prop :=
  ∀ (h cinf Xb ε : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 < Xb → 0 < ε →
    ProfileReg h cinf Xb ε F U →
    (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(psLead1 h F U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(psLead2 h F U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTh h F U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTz h F U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧
    (∀ X₁ X₂ c : ℝ, 0 < X₁ → 0 < c → (∀ X η : ℝ, X₁ ≤ X → X ≤ X₂ → -1 < η → η < 1 → c ≤ F X η) →
      ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₁ ≤ X → X ≤ X₂ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(psLead1 h F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(psLead2 h F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTh h F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTz h F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)

def PsPerturbation : Prop :=
  ∀ (h cinf Xb ε X₁ X₂ c : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 < Xb → 0 < ε →
    0 < X₁ → X₁ ≤ X₂ → 0 < c → ProfileReg h cinf Xb ε F U →
    (∀ X η : ℝ, X₁ ≤ X → X ≤ X₂ → -1 < η → η < 1 → c ≤ F X η) →
    ∃ C δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ ∀ (F' U' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (δ : ℝ), ProfileReg h cinf Xb ε F' U' → δ ≤ δ₀ →
      (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → leadPi F' 0 η = leadPi F 0 η) →
      (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₂ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        |F' X η - F X η| ≤ δ ∧ |U' X η - U X η| ≤ δ ∧
        |deriv (fun e => F' X e) η - deriv (fun e => F X e) η| ≤ δ ∧
        |deriv (fun e => U' X e) η - deriv (fun e => U X e) η| ≤ δ) →
      ∀ X η : ℝ, X₁ ≤ X → X ≤ X₂ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        |psLead1 h F' U' X η - psLead1 h F U X η| ≤ C * δ ∧
        |psLead2 h F' U' X η - psLead2 h F U X η| ≤ C * δ

def ConeGapQuadratic : Prop :=
  (∀ κ W P J v : ℝ, 0 < κ → 2 + κ ≤ P → v ≤ coneUp P J - κ → P - v ≤ W →
    κ ≤ P - v ∧ (v - 2) * J ^ 2 ≤ (2 - min 1 (2 * κ ^ 2 / W ^ 2)) * (P - v) ^ 2) ∧
  (∀ κ W P J v : ℝ, 0 < κ → κ ≤ 2 → 2 ≤ P → κ ≤ P - v → (v - 2) * J ^ 2 ≤ (2 - κ) * (P - v) ^ 2 →
    P - v ≤ W → |J| ≤ W → κ ^ 3 / (4 * W + W ^ 2) ≤ coneUp P J - v)

def ModulatedFamily (h Xm Xp : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (FN UN : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (Xm' Xp' κ C : ℝ) (N0 : ℕ), Xm < Xm' ∧ Xm' < Xp' ∧ Xp' < Xp ∧ 0 < κ ∧ 1 ≤ N0 ∧
  ∀ N : ℕ, N0 ≤ N →
    (∀ X η : ℝ, (X ≤ Xm' ∨ Xp' ≤ X) → FN N X η = F X η ∧ UN N X η = U X η) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(FN N)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(UN N)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < FN N X η) ∧
    (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C' : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(FN N)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C' ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(UN N)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C') ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      |FN N X η - F X η| ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ∧ |UN N X η - U X η| ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ∧
      |deriv (fun e => FN N X e) η - deriv (fun e => F X e) η| ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ∧
      |deriv (fun e => UN N X e) η - deriv (fun e => U X e) η| ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ∧
      κ ≤ shearA (FN N) X η ∧ shearA (FN N) X η ≤ 1 / κ ∧ |shearB (FN N) (UN N) X η| ≤ 1 / κ ∧
      κ ≤ shearA (FN N) X η * (1 + (shearB (FN N) (UN N) X η / shearA (FN N) X η) ^ 2) - 2 ∧
      κ ≤ psLead1 h F U X η - shearB (FN N) (UN N) X η / shearA (FN N) X η * psLead2 h F U X η - 2 ∧
      κ ≤ coneUp (psLead1 h F U X η - shearB (FN N) (UN N) X η / shearA (FN N) X η * psLead2 h F U X η)
            (psLead2 h F U X η + shearB (FN N) (UN N) X η / shearA (FN N) X η * psLead1 h F U X η)
          - shearA (FN N) X η * (1 + (shearB (FN N) (UN N) X η / shearA (FN N) X η) ^ 2))

background_of_leading_profile.definitions:
noncomputable def leadV (h : ℝ) (U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  X / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) *
    (2 * η * U X η - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * profRadAvg U X η - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadAvg U) X η)

noncomputable def bgAn (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (S : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) : ℝ³ :=
  ((1 / 2) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) *
    S (simX h x t) (simEta h x t)) • azVec x

noncomputable def bgBn (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) : ℝ³ :=
  (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * G (simX h x t) (simEta h x t)) • azVec x

noncomputable def bgPn (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (W : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 + 2 * h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * W (simX h x t) (simEta h x t)

noncomputable def bgTsum (h : ℝ) (T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (N : ℕ) (q X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=

    have h2 : IntegrableOn ((Icc 0 r).indicator (fun y : ℝ => y / (4 * Real.pi))) (Ioi 0) :=
      (h1.integrable_indicator measurableSet_Icc).integrableOn
    refine h2.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Ioi
    intro y hy
    have hy0 : (0:ℝ) < y := hy
    simp only [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, smul_eq_mul, Set.indicator, Set.mem_Icc]
    by_cases hyr : y ≤ r
    · rw [if_pos ⟨hy0.le, hyr⟩, if_pos hyr]
      field_simp
    · rw [if_neg (fun h => hyr h.2), if_neg hyr, mul_zero]
  
  have hKcont : Continuous K := hKs.continuous
  have hKn0 : ∀ z : ℝ³, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → newtonKernel z - K z = 0 := fun z hz => by
    show newtonKernel z - Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z = 0
    rw [hKeq z hz, sub_self]
  have hKni : Integrable (fun z => newtonKernel z - K z) := by
    have h1 : IntegrableOn newtonKernel (Metric.closedBall (0:ℝ³) 1) :=
      hLI.integrableOn_isCompact (isCompact_closedBall 0 1)
    have h2 : IntegrableOn K (Metric.closedBall (0:ℝ³) 1) :=
      hKcont.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall 0 1)
    have h3 := h1.sub h2
    rw [← integrable_indicator_iff Metric.isClosed_closedBall.measurableSet] at h3
    convert h3 using 1
    funext z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0:ℝ³) 1
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hz]
      rfl
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hz]
      apply hKn0
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hz
      exact hz.le
  
  obtain ⟨hF1, hF2, -⟩ := conv_bounded_deriv_kernel G K hGi hKs hKb
  
  rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
  intro x₀
  let η : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨2, 3, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
  set h : ℝ³ → ℝ := fun y => η y * G y with hhdef
  have hhs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ h := η.contDiff.mul hG
  have hhc : HasCompactSupport h := η.hasCompactSupport.mul_right
  have hhb : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n h z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro n
    exact (hhs.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).bounded_above_of_compact_support
      (hhc.iteratedFDeriv n)
  obtain ⟨hN1, hN2, -⟩ := conv_bounded_deriv_kernel (fun z => newtonKernel z - K z) h hKni hhs hhb
  have hP : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ 1, ∀ y,
      (newtonKernel (x - y) - K (x - y)) * h y = (newtonKernel (x - y) - K (x - y)) * G y := by
    intro x hx y
    by_cases hxy : 1 ≤ ‖x - y‖
    · rw [hKn0 _ hxy, zero_mul, zero_mul]
    · push_neg at hxy
      have hy : y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ η.rIn := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hx
        have e : y - x₀ = (y - x) + (x - x₀) := by abel
        have h1 := norm_add_le (y - x) (x - x₀)
        rw [← e, norm_sub_rev y x] at h1
        show ‖y - x₀‖ ≤ 2
        linarith
      have h1 := η.one_of_mem_closedBall hy
      simp only [hhdef, h1, one_mul]
  have hEq : newtonPot G =ᶠ[nhds x₀]
      fun x => (∫ t, (newtonKernel t - K t) * h (x - t)) + ∫ t, G t * K (x - t) := by
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds x₀ one_pos] with x hx
    have ha : ∫ y, (newtonKernel (x - y) - K (x - y)) * h y =
        ∫ t, (newtonKernel t - K t) * h (x - t) := by
      have := integral_sub_left_eq_self (fun t => (newtonKernel t - K t) * h (x - t)) volume x
      simp only [sub_sub_cancel] at this
      exact this
    have hb : Integrable (fun y => (newtonKernel (x - y) - K (x - y)) * G y) := by
      have := (hN1 x).comp_sub_left x
      simp only [sub_sub_cancel] at this
      exact this.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => hP x hx y)
    have hc : newtonPot G x =
        (∫ y, (newtonKernel (x - y) - K (x - y)) * G y) + ∫ y, G y * K (x - y) := by
      rw [← integral_add hb (hF1 x)]
      unfold newtonPot
      congr 1
      funext y
      ring
    rw [hc, ← ha]
    congr 1
    exact integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => (hP x hx y).symm)
  exact ((hN2.add hF2).contDiffAt).congr_of_eventuallyEq hEq

proof.tactics:
by
  intro A B hA hB hb
  have hInt : ∀ (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (B : ℝ³ → F) (C₀ : ℝ),
      Continuous B → (∀ z, ‖B z‖ ≤ C₀) → ∀ x, Integrable (fun t => A t • B (x - t)) := by
    intro F _ _ B C₀ hBc hBb x
    refine Integrable.mono' (hA.norm.mul_const C₀) ?_ (ae_of_all _ (fun t => ?_))
    · exact hA.aestronglyMeasurable.smul
        ((hBc.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable)
    · rw [norm_smul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hBb _) (norm_nonneg _)
  have hDer : ∀ (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (B : ℝ³ → F) (C₀ C₁ : ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ 1 B → (∀ z, ‖B z‖ ≤ C₀) → (∀ z, ‖fderiv ℝ B z‖ ≤ C₁) →
      ∀ x, HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∫ t, A t • B (y - t)) (∫ t, A t • fderiv ℝ B (x - t)) x := by
    intro F _ _ B C₀ C₁ hB1 hB0 hBd x
    have hBc : Continuous B := hB1.continuous
    have hdc : Continuous (fderiv ℝ B) := hB1.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero
    have hBdiff : Differentiable ℝ B := hB1.differentiable one_ne_zero
    refine hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (s := univ)
      (F := fun y t => A t • B (y - t)) (F' := fun y t => A t • fderiv ℝ B (y - t)) (x₀ := x)
      (bound := fun t => ‖A t‖ * C₁) Filter.univ_mem ?_ (hInt F B C₀ hBc hB0 x) ?_ ?_
      (hA.norm.mul_const C₁) ?_
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => hA.aestronglyMeasurable.smul
        ((hBc.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable))
    · exact hA.aestronglyMeasurable.smul
        ((hdc.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable)
    · refine ae_of_all _ (fun t y _ => ?_)
      rw [norm_smul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hBd _) (norm_nonneg _)
    · refine ae_of_all _ (fun t y _ => ?_)
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => B (y - t)) (fderiv ℝ B (y - t)) y := by
        have := (hBdiff (y - t)).hasFDerivAt.comp y (hasFDerivAt_sub_const t)
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_id] at this
        exact this
      exact h1.const_smul (A t)
  have hDer' : ∀ (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (B : ℝ³ → F),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ B → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m B z‖ ≤ C) →
      ∀ x, HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∫ t, A t • B (y - t)) (∫ t, A t • fderiv ℝ B (x - t)) x := by
    intro F _ _ B hB hb x
    obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hb 0
    obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := hb 1
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 B := hB.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    exact hDer F B C₀ C₁ h1 (fun z => by have := hC₀ z; rwa [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] at this)
      (fun z => by have := hC₁ z; rwa [norm_iteratedFDeriv_one] at this) x
  have hcl : ∀ (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (B : ℝ³ → F),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ B → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m B z‖ ≤ C) →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ B) ∧
        (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fderiv ℝ B) z‖ ≤ C) := by
    intro F _ _ B hB hb
    refine ⟨(contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hB).2, fun m => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hb (m + 1)
    exact ⟨C, fun z => by rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]; exact hC z⟩
  have hK : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (B : ℝ³ → F),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ B → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m B z‖ ≤ C) →
      ContDiff ℝ n (fun x => ∫ t, A t • B (x - t)) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro F _ _ B hB hb
      have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ (fun x => ∫ t, A t • B (x - t)) := fun x =>
        (hDer' F B hB hb x).differentiableAt
      have h0 : ContDiff ℝ 0 (fun x => ∫ t, A t • B (x - t)) :=
        contDiff_zero.mpr hdiff.continuous
      exact_mod_cast h0
    | succ n ih =>
      intro F _ _ B hB hb
      obtain ⟨hB1s, hb1⟩ := hcl F B hB hb
      rw [Nat.cast_succ, contDiff_succ_iff_hasFDerivAt]
      exact ⟨fun x => ∫ t, A t • fderiv ℝ B (x - t), ih _ (fderiv ℝ B) hB1s hb1,
        fun x => hDer' F B hB hb x⟩
  have hu : (fun x => ∫ t, A t * B (x - t)) = fun x => ∫ t, A t • B (x - t) := by
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  obtain ⟨hB1s, hb1⟩ := hcl ℝ B hB hb
  obtain ⟨hB2s, hb2⟩ := hcl _ (fderiv ℝ B) hB1s hb1
  refine ⟨fun x => ?_, ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hb 0
    have := hInt ℝ B C₀ hB.continuous
      (fun z => by have := hC₀ z; rwa [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] at this) x
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using this
  · rw [hu]
    exact contDiff_infty.mpr (fun n => hK n ℝ B hB hb)
  · rw [hu]
    have hD1 : fderiv ℝ (fun x => ∫ t, A t • B (x - t))
        = fun x => ∫ t, A t • fderiv ℝ B (x - t) :=
      funext (fun x => (hDer' ℝ B hB hb x).fderiv)
    have hD2 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x => ∫ t, A t • B (x - t)))
        = fun x => ∫ t, A t • fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ B) (x - t) := by
      rw [hD1]
      exact funext (fun x => (hDer' _ (fderiv ℝ B) hB1s hb1 x).fderiv)
    have hlap : ∀ (f : ℝ³ → ℝ) (y : ℝ³), Δ f y = ∑ i : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) y (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) := by
      intro f y
      rw [InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_orthonormalBasis f
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)]
      simp [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
    rw [hlap (fun x => ∫ t, A t • B (x - t)) x, hD2]
    obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂⟩ := hb2 0
    have hφ := hInt _ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ B)) C₂ hB2s.continuous
      (fun z => by have := hC₂ z; rwa [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] at this) x
    have hψ : ∀ i : Fin 3, Integrable (fun t =>
        (A t • fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ B) (x - t)) (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) :=
      fun i => hφ.apply_continuousLinearMap _
    have hχ : ∀ i : Fin 3, Integrable (fun t =>
        A t * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ B) (x - t) (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) := by
      intro i
      have := (hψ i).apply_continuousLinearMap (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)
      simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using this
    have heval : ∀ i : Fin 3, (∫ t, A t • fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ B) (x - t))
        (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)
        = ∫ t, A t * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ B) (x - t) (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) := by
      intro i
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply hφ, ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply (hψ i)]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => heval i), ← integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hχ i)]
    congr 1
    funext t
    rw [hlap B (x - t), Finset.mul_sum]

signature.statement: ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → IntegrableOn newtonKernel (Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) r) ∧ ∫ z in Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) r, newtonKernel z = r ^ 2 / 2

by
  intro r hr
  set f : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => if s < r then (4 * Real.pi * s)⁻¹ else 0 with hfdef
  have hpi : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  
  have hind : (Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) r).indicator newtonKernel = fun z => f ‖z‖ := by

  have h1int : IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2 * f y) (Set.Ioi 0) :=

    ring

  · rw [← integrable_indicator_iff measurableSet_ball, hind]

by
  set K : ℝ³ → ℝ := fun z : ℝ³ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z

    unfold newtonKernel; positivity
  have hb : ∀ z : ℝ³, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → K z = newtonKernel z := by
    intro z hz
    show Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z = newtonKernel z
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by nlinarith), one_mul]
  have hc : ∀ z : ℝ³, 0 ≤ K z ∧ K z ≤ newtonKernel z := fun z =>
    ⟨mul_nonneg (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _) (hΓnn z),
     mul_le_of_le_one_left (hΓnn z) (Real.smoothTransition.le_one _)⟩
  have hq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ => 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 - 1) :=
    (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_norm_sq ℝ)).sub contDiff_const
  have hst : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Real.smoothTransition := Real.smoothTransition.contDiff
  have ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ K := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro z
    rcases lt_or_ge (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) 0 with h | h
    · have hU : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ | 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 - 1 < 0} :=
        isOpen_lt hq.continuous continuous_const
      have hev : K =ᶠ[nhds z] (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds h) (fun w hw => by

        rintro rfl
        simp at h
        linarith
      have hnz : 0 < ‖z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hz
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 - 1)) z :=
        (hst.comp hq).contDiffAt
      have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ => 4 * Real.pi * ‖w‖) z :=
        contDiffAt_const.mul (contDiffAt_norm ℝ hz)
      have h3 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ => (4 * Real.pi * ‖w‖)⁻¹) z :=
        h2.inv (mul_pos (by positivity) hnz).ne'
      exact h1.mul h3
  have hhom : ∀ (c : ℝ) (z : ℝ³), 1 ≤ c → 1 < ‖z‖ → K (c • z) = c⁻¹ * K z := by
    intro c z hc hz
    have hn : ‖c • z‖ = c * ‖z‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
    rw [hb _ hz.le, hb _ (by rw [hn]; nlinarith)]
    unfold newtonKernel
    rw [hn, show 4 * Real.pi * (c * ‖z‖) = c * (4 * Real.pi * ‖z‖) by ring, mul_inv]
  have hd : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℝ³, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n K z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro n
    have hn : (n : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
    have hcont : Continuous (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n K) := ha.continuous_iteratedFDeriv hn
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
      (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℝ³) 2).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hcont.continuousOn
    have hscale : ∀ (c : ℝ) (z : ℝ³), 1 ≤ c → 1 < ‖z‖ →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n K (c • z)‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n K z‖ := by
      intro c z hc hz
      have hcpos : 0 < c := by linarith
      set L : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ := c • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ³ with hL
      have hLapp : ∀ y, L y = c • y := fun y => rfl
      have hU : IsOpen {y : ℝ³ | 1 < ‖y‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
      have hev : (K ∘ L) =ᶠ[nhds z] (fun y => c⁻¹ • K y) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hz) (fun y hy => by
          show K (L y) = c⁻¹ • K y
          rw [hLapp, smul_eq_mul]
          exact hhom c y hc hy)
      have e1 := (hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ n).eq_of_nhds
      rw [L.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right ha z hn,
        iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply' (ha.contDiffAt.of_le hn)] at e1
      have hm : ∀ m : Fin n → ℝ³, c ^ n * iteratedFDeriv ℝ n K (c • z) m
          = c⁻¹ * iteratedFDeriv ℝ n K z m := by
        intro m
        have e2 := congrArg (fun A : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin n => ℝ³) ℝ => A m) e1
        simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, hLapp,
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at e2
        rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.map_smul_univ, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ,
          Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul] at e2
        exact e2
      refine ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (norm_nonneg _) (fun m => ?_)
      have hcn : 1 ≤ c ^ n := one_le_pow₀ hc
      have hci : c⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hc
      have hle := (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n K z).le_opNorm m
      have hA : 0 ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n K (c • z) m‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have hB : 0 ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n K z m‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have hnorm := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => ‖x‖) (hm m)
      simp only [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_inv, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hcpos] at hnorm
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hA hB hle ⊢
      calc |iteratedFDeriv ℝ n K (c • z) m|
          ≤ c ^ n * |iteratedFDeriv ℝ n K (c • z) m| := le_mul_of_one_le_left hA hcn
        _ = c⁻¹ * |iteratedFDeriv ℝ n K z m| := hnorm
        _ ≤ |iteratedFDeriv ℝ n K z m| := mul_le_of_le_one_left hB hci
        _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n K z‖ * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := hle
    refine ⟨C, fun w => ?_⟩
    by_cases hw : ‖w‖ ≤ 2
    · exact hC w (mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mpr hw)
    · push_neg at hw
      set c : ℝ := 2 * ‖w‖ / 3 with hcdef
      have hc1 : 1 ≤ c := by rw [hcdef]; linarith
      have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by linarith
      have hzn : ‖c⁻¹ • w‖ = 3 / 2 := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_of_pos (by linarith), hcdef]
        field_simp
      have hwz : c • (c⁻¹ • w) = w := smul_inv_smul₀ hc0 w
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n K w‖ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n K (c • (c⁻¹ • w))‖ := by rw [hwz]
        _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n K (c⁻¹ • w)‖ := hscale c _ hc1 (by rw [hzn]; norm_num)
        _ ≤ C := hC _ (mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mpr (by rw [hzn]; norm_num))
  exact ⟨ha, hb, hc, hd⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ³ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → ∀ x : ℝ³, (∫ y, (newtonKernel (x - y) - Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel (x - y)) * Δ g y) + (∫ y, Δ (fun z : ℝ³ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z) (x - y) * g y) = - g x

signature.name: green_local
signature.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ³ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → ∀ x : ℝ³, (∫ y, (newtonKernel (x - y) - Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel (x - y)) * Δ g y) + (∫ y, Δ (fun z : ℝ³ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z) (x - y) * g y) = - g x

proof.tactics:
by
  intro g hg x
  have h2 : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by simp
  have hcontΔ : ∀ f : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → Continuous (Δ f) := by
    intro f hf
    rw [InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_orthonormalBasis f
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)]
    refine continuous_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => ?_)
    exact (hf.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (by simp)).eval_const _
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ³ → ℝ,
      K = fun z => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hgoal : ((∫ y, (newtonKernel (x - y) - Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 - 1)
        * newtonKernel (x - y)) * Δ g y) + (∫ y, Δ (fun z : ℝ³ => Real.smoothTransition
        (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z) (x - y) * g y))
      = (∫ y, (newtonKernel (x - y) - K (x - y)) * Δ g y) + ∫ y, Δ K (x - y) * g y := by
    subst hK; rfl
  rw [hgoal]
  have hKs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ K := by rw [hK]; exact far_kernel_basic.1
  have hK1 : ∀ z : ℝ³, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → K z = newtonKernel z := by
    rw [hK]; exact far_kernel_basic.2.1
  have hKb : ∀ z : ℝ³, 0 ≤ K z ∧ K z ≤ newtonKernel z := by
    rw [hK]; exact far_kernel_basic.2.2.1
  have hNKm : Measurable newtonKernel := by unfold newtonKernel; fun_prop
  
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ : ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ,
      φ = fun s : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * s - 1) * (4 * Real.pi * Real.sqrt s)⁻¹ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hφs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ := by rw [hφ]; exact far_kernel_profile.1
  have hφK : ∀ z : ℝ³, K z = φ (‖z‖ ^ 2) := by rw [hK, hφ]; exact far_kernel_profile.2.1
  have hφtail : ∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → 4 * s * deriv (deriv φ) s + 6 * deriv φ s = 0 := by
    rw [hφ]; exact far_kernel_profile.2.2.1
  have hφ4 : deriv φ 4 = -(64 * Real.pi)⁻¹ := by rw [hφ]; exact far_kernel_profile.2.2.2
  have hΔKform : ∀ z : ℝ³,
      Δ K z = 4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 * deriv (deriv φ) (‖z‖ ^ 2) + 6 * deriv φ (‖z‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro z
    have e : K = fun w : ℝ³ => φ (‖w‖ ^ 2) := funext hφK
    rw [e]; exact radial_laplacian_sq φ z hφs
  have hP1 : ∀ u : ℝ³, 1 < ‖u‖ → Δ K u = 0 := by
    intro u hu
    rw [hΔKform u]
    exact hφtail _ (by nlinarith [norm_nonneg u])
  have hP2 : ∫ u, Δ K u = -1 := by
    calc ∫ u, Δ K u
        = ∫ u : ℝ³, (4 * ‖u‖ ^ 2 * deriv (deriv φ) (‖u‖ ^ 2) + 6 * deriv φ (‖u‖ ^ 2)) :=
          integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hΔKform)
      _ = 64 * Real.pi * deriv φ 4 := radial_laplacian_integral φ hφs hφtail
      _ = -1 := by
          rw [hφ4, mul_neg, mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity)]
  have hΔKc : Continuous (Δ K) := hcontΔ K hKs
  
  obtain ⟨M₂, hM₂⟩ :=
    (isCompact_closedBall x 1).exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hcontΔ g hg).continuousOn
  obtain ⟨M₁, hM₁⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall x 1).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    (hg.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).continuousOn
  have hxmem : x ∈ Metric.closedBall x 1 := Metric.mem_closedBall_self zero_le_one
  have hM₂0 : 0 ≤ M₂ := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hM₂ x hxmem)
  have hM₁0 : 0 ≤ M₁ := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hM₁ x hxmem)
  have hM₂' : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x 1, |Δ g y| ≤ M₂ := fun y hy => by
    have := hM₂ y hy
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = ∫ u, |Δ K u| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := by rw [hC]; exact integral_nonneg (fun u => abs_nonneg _)
  
  have hIa : Integrable (fun y => (newtonKernel (x - y) - K (x - y)) * Δ g y) :=
    (truncated_newton_bound (fun z => newtonKernel z - K z) (Δ g) x 1 M₂ one_pos
      (hNKm.sub hKs.continuous.measurable)
      (fun z => ⟨by linarith [(hKb z).2], by linarith [(hKb z).1]⟩)
      (fun z hz => by show newtonKernel z - K z = 0; rw [hK1 z hz, sub_self])
      (hcontΔ g hg) hM₂').1
  have hId : Integrable (fun y => Δ K (x - y) * g y) := by
    refine Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      ((hΔKc.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).mul hg.continuous) ?_
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall x 1) (fun y hy => ?_)
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, not_le, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] at hy
    show Δ K (x - y) * g y = 0
    rw [hP1 _ hy, zero_mul]
  
  have hmain : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 →
      |(∫ y, (newtonKernel (x - y) - K (x - y)) * Δ g y) + (∫ y, Δ K (x - y) * g y) + g x|
        ≤ ε * (M₂ / 2 + M₁ * C) := by
    intro ε hε hε1
    obtain ⟨Kε, hKε⟩ : ∃ Kε : ℝ³ → ℝ, Kε = fun w => ε⁻¹ * K (ε⁻¹ • w) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hKεs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Kε := by
      rw [hKε, hK]; exact (scaled_far_kernel ε hε).1
    have hKεb : ∀ z : ℝ³, 0 ≤ Kε z ∧ Kε z ≤ newtonKernel z := by
      rw [hKε, hK]; exact (scaled_far_kernel ε hε).2.1
    have hKεt : ∀ z : ℝ³, ε ≤ ‖z‖ → Kε z = newtonKernel z := by
      rw [hKε, hK]; exact (scaled_far_kernel ε hε).2.2
    have hFs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => K z - Kε z) := hKs.sub hKεs
    have hF0 : ∀ z : ℝ³, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → (fun z => K z - Kε z) z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      show K z - Kε z = 0
      rw [hK1 z hz, hKεt z (le_trans hε1 hz), sub_self]
    have hL1 := laplacian_ibp_shift (fun z => K z - Kε z) g x 1 hFs hg hF0
    have hΔF : ∀ w, Δ (fun z => K z - Kε z) w = Δ K w - (ε ^ 3)⁻¹ * Δ K (ε⁻¹ • w) := by
      intro w
      have e : (fun z => K z - Kε z) = K - Kε := rfl
      rw [e, ContDiffAt.laplacian_sub (hKs.contDiffAt.of_le h2) (hKεs.contDiffAt.of_le h2), hKε,
        laplacian_rescale K ε hKs hε.ne' w]
    have hMε : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x ε, |Δ g y| ≤ M₂ := fun y hy =>
      hM₂' y (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hε1 hy)
    obtain ⟨hIb, hAb⟩ := truncated_newton_bound (fun z => newtonKernel z - Kε z) (Δ g) x ε M₂ hε
      (hNKm.sub hKεs.continuous.measurable)
      (fun z => ⟨by linarith [(hKεb z).2], by linarith [(hKεb z).1]⟩)
      (fun z hz => by show newtonKernel z - Kε z = 0; rw [hKεt z hz, sub_self])
      (hcontΔ g hg) hMε
    obtain ⟨hIe, hBb⟩ :=
      scaled_kernel_limit (Δ K) g x ε M₁ hΔKc hP1 (hg.of_le (by simp)) hε hε1 hM₁
    have e1 : ∫ y, (fun z => K z - Kε z) (x - y) * Δ g y
        = (∫ y, (newtonKernel (x - y) - Kε (x - y)) * Δ g y)
          - ∫ y, (newtonKernel (x - y) - K (x - y)) * Δ g y := by
      rw [← integral_sub hIb hIa]
      congr 1
      funext y
      show (K (x - y) - Kε (x - y)) * Δ g y = _
      ring
    have e2 : ∫ y, Δ (fun z => K z - Kε z) (x - y) * g y
        = (∫ y, Δ K (x - y) * g y) - ∫ y, (ε ^ 3)⁻¹ * Δ K (ε⁻¹ • (x - y)) * g y := by
      rw [← integral_sub hId hIe]
      congr 1
      funext y
      rw [hΔF]
      ring
    have key : (∫ y, (newtonKernel (x - y) - Kε (x - y)) * Δ g y)
          - (∫ y, (newtonKernel (x - y) - K (x - y)) * Δ g y)
        = (∫ y, Δ K (x - y) * g y) - ∫ y, (ε ^ 3)⁻¹ * Δ K (ε⁻¹ • (x - y)) * g y := by
      rw [← e1, ← e2]
      exact hL1
    have hBb' : |(∫ y, (ε ^ 3)⁻¹ * Δ K (ε⁻¹ • (x - y)) * g y) + g x| ≤ ε * M₁ * C := by
      have h := hBb
      rw [hP2, ← hC] at h
      rwa [neg_one_mul, sub_neg_eq_add] at h
    have hsplit : (∫ y, (newtonKernel (x - y) - K (x - y)) * Δ g y) + (∫ y, Δ K (x - y) * g y)
          + g x
        = (∫ y, (newtonKernel (x - y) - Kε (x - y)) * Δ g y)
          + ((∫ y, (ε ^ 3)⁻¹ * Δ K (ε⁻¹ • (x - y)) * g y) + g x) := by
      linarith
    have hε2 : M₂ * (ε ^ 2 / 2) ≤ ε * (M₂ / 2) := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hM₂0 hε.le) (sub_nonneg.mpr hε1)]
    rw [hsplit]
    calc _ ≤ |∫ y, (newtonKernel (x - y) - Kε (x - y)) * Δ g y|
          + |(∫ y, (ε ^ 3)⁻¹ * Δ K (ε⁻¹ • (x - y)) * g y) + g x| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ M₂ * (ε ^ 2 / 2) + ε * M₁ * C := add_le_add hAb hBb'
      _ ≤ ε * (M₂ / 2 + M₁ * C) := by nlinarith
  
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ Q : ℝ, Q = M₂ / 2 + M₁ * C := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hQ0 : 0 ≤ Q := by
    rw [hQ]
    have := mul_nonneg hM₁0 hC0
    linarith
  rw [← hQ] at hmain
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ,
      D = |(∫ y, (newtonKernel (x - y) - K (x - y)) * Δ g y) + (∫ y, Δ K (x - y) * g y) + g x| :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hD] at hmain
  have hD0 : D = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hDpos : 0 < D := lt_of_le_of_ne (by rw [hD]; exact abs_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hne)
    have hpos : 0 < D / (2 * (Q + 1)) := by positivity
    have hεpos : 0 < min 1 (D / (2 * (Q + 1))) := lt_min one_pos hpos
    have h1 := hmain _ hεpos (min_le_left _ _)
    have h2' : min 1 (D / (2 * (Q + 1))) * Q ≤ D / (2 * (Q + 1)) * Q :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right _ _) hQ0
    have h3 : D / (2 * (Q + 1)) * Q < D := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith
    linarith
  rw [hD] at hD0
  have := abs_eq_zero.mp hD0
  linarith

subgoal_signatures.name: far_kernel_basic
subgoal_signatures.statement: ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z) ∧ (∀ z : ℝ³, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z = newtonKernel z) ∧ (∀ z : ℝ³, 0 ≤ Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z ∧ Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z ≤ newtonKernel z) ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℝ³, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z : ℝ³ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z) z‖ ≤ C

subgoal_signatures.name: laplacian_ibp_shift
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (F h : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (R : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → ContDiff ℝ ∞ h → (∀ z : ℝ³, R ≤ ‖z‖ → F z = 0) → ∫ y, F (x - y) * Δ h y = ∫ y, Δ F (x - y) * h y

subgoal_signatures.name: laplacian_rescale
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (F : ℝ³ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → ε ≠ 0 → ∀ z : ℝ³, Δ (fun w : ℝ³ => ε⁻¹ * F (ε⁻¹ • w)) z = (ε ^ 3)⁻¹ * Δ F (ε⁻¹ • z)

subgoal_signatures.name: radial_laplacian_sq
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (z : ℝ³), ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → Δ (fun w : ℝ³ => φ (‖w‖ ^ 2)) z = 4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 * deriv (deriv φ) (‖z‖ ^ 2) + 6 * deriv φ (‖z‖ ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: radial_laplacian_integral
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → (∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → 4 * s * deriv (deriv φ) s + 6 * deriv φ s = 0) → ∫ z : ℝ³, (4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 * deriv (deriv φ) (‖z‖ ^ 2) + 6 * deriv φ (‖z‖ ^ 2)) = 64 * Real.pi * deriv φ 4

subgoal_signatures.name: far_kernel_profile
subgoal_signatures.statement: ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * s - 1) * (4 * Real.pi * Real.sqrt s)⁻¹) ∧ (∀ z : ℝ³, Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z = (fun s : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * s - 1) * (4 * Real.pi * Real.sqrt s)⁻¹) (‖z‖ ^ 2)) ∧ (∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → 4 * s * deriv (deriv (fun s : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * s - 1) * (4 * Real.pi * Real.sqrt s)⁻¹)) s + 6 * deriv (fun s : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * s - 1) * (4 * Real.pi * Real.sqrt s)⁻¹) s = 0) ∧ deriv (fun s : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * s - 1) * (4 * Real.pi * Real.sqrt s)⁻¹) 4 = -(64 * Real.pi)⁻¹

subgoal_signatures.name: truncated_newton_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (k D : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (r M : ℝ), 0 < r → Measurable k → (∀ z : ℝ³, 0 ≤ k z ∧ k z ≤ newtonKernel z) → (∀ z : ℝ³, r ≤ ‖z‖ → k z = 0) → Continuous D → (∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x r, |D y| ≤ M) → Integrable (fun y => k (x - y) * D y) ∧ |∫ y, k (x - y) * D y| ≤ M * (r ^ 2 / 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: scaled_kernel_limit
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (Ψ g : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (ε M : ℝ), Continuous Ψ → (∀ u : ℝ³, 1 < ‖u‖ → Ψ u = 0) → ContDiff ℝ 1 g → 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 → (∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x 1, ‖fderiv ℝ g y‖ ≤ M) → Integrable (fun y => (ε ^ 3)⁻¹ * Ψ (ε⁻¹ • (x - y)) * g y) ∧ |(∫ y, (ε ^ 3)⁻¹ * Ψ (ε⁻¹ • (x - y)) * g y) - (∫ u, Ψ u) * g x| ≤ ε * M * ∫ u, |Ψ u|

subgoal_signatures.name: scaled_far_kernel
