signature.name: newtonPot_decay_of_integral_zero
signature.statement: LocallyIntegrable newtonKernel volume → ∀ g : ℝ³ → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → (∫ x, g x) = 0 → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ³, |newtonPot g x| ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro hΓ g hg hgs hg0
  
  obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀⟩ := hgs.isCompact.isBounded.subset_closedBall (0 : ℝ³)
  obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, R = max R₀ 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hR1 : 1 ≤ R := hRdef ▸ le_max_right _ _
  have hRR₀ : R₀ ≤ R := hRdef ▸ le_max_left _ _
  have hR0 : 0 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hR1
  have hsupp : ∀ y : ℝ³, R < ‖y‖ → g y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
    intro hmem
    have h1 := hR₀ hmem
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at h1
    linarith
  
  have hid : newtonPot g = convolution newtonKernel g (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) volume := by
    funext x
    rw [convolution_eq_swap]
    simp [newtonPot]
  have hcont : Continuous (newtonPot g) := by
    rw [hid]; exact hgs.continuous_convolution_right _ hΓ hg
  
  obtain ⟨B₀, hB₀⟩ :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℝ³) (2 * R)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hcont.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨B, hBdef⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = max B₀ 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := hBdef ▸ le_max_right _ _
  have hnear : ∀ x : ℝ³, ‖x‖ ≤ 2 * R → |newtonPot g x| ≤ B := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := hB₀ x (by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]; exact hx)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact le_trans h1 (hBdef ▸ le_max_left _ _)
  
  obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = ∫ y, |g y| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := hMdef ▸ integral_nonneg (fun y => abs_nonneg _)
  have hgi : Integrable g := hg.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hgs
  have hpi : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  
  have hker : ∀ x y : ℝ³, ‖y‖ ≤ R → 2 * R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      |newtonKernel (x - y) - newtonKernel x| ≤ R / (2 * Real.pi * ‖x‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro x y hy hx
    have ha : 0 < ‖x‖ := by linarith
    have hb1 : ‖x‖ - ‖y‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖ := norm_sub_norm_le x y
    have hb : ‖x‖ / 2 ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by linarith
    have hb0 : 0 < ‖x - y‖ := by linarith
    have hab : |‖x‖ - ‖x - y‖| ≤ R := by
      have h1 := abs_norm_sub_norm_le x (x - y)
      rw [sub_sub_cancel] at h1
      linarith
    have heq : newtonKernel (x - y) - newtonKernel x =
        (‖x‖ - ‖x - y‖) / (4 * Real.pi * ‖x‖ * ‖x - y‖) := by
      unfold newtonKernel
      field_simp
    rw [heq, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 4 * Real.pi * ‖x‖ * ‖x - y‖),
      div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    have h1 : |‖x‖ - ‖x - y‖| * (2 * Real.pi * ‖x‖ ^ 2) ≤ R * (2 * Real.pi * ‖x‖ ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hab (by positivity)
    have h2 : 2 * Real.pi * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * Real.pi * ‖x‖ * ‖x - y‖ := by
      have h3 := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi) ha.le)
        (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * ‖x - y‖ - ‖x‖)
      nlinarith
    exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hR0.le)
  
  have hfar : ∀ x : ℝ³, 2 * R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      |newtonPot g x| ≤ R * M / (2 * Real.pi * ‖x‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro x hx
    have hKi : Integrable (fun y => newtonKernel (x - y) * g y) := by
      have h1 := ((hgs.convolutionExists_right (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) hΓ hg) x).integrable_swap
      simpa using h1
    have hci : Integrable (fun y => newtonKernel x * g y) := hgi.const_mul _
    have hzero : ∫ y, newtonKernel x * g y = 0 := by
      rw [integral_const_mul, hg0, mul_zero]
    have hrep : newtonPot g x = ∫ y, (newtonKernel (x - y) - newtonKernel x) * g y := by
      have h1 : (∫ y, (newtonKernel (x - y) - newtonKernel x) * g y) =
          ∫ y, (newtonKernel (x - y) * g y - newtonKernel x * g y) := by
        congr 1; funext y; ring
      rw [h1, integral_sub hKi hci, hzero, sub_zero]
      rfl
    rw [hrep, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hbound : ∀ y, ‖(newtonKernel (x - y) - newtonKernel x) * g y‖ ≤
        R / (2 * Real.pi * ‖x‖ ^ 2) * |g y| := by
      intro y
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      by_cases hy : R < ‖y‖
      · rw [hsupp y hy]; simp
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hker x y (not_lt.mp hy) hx) (abs_nonneg _)
    calc ‖∫ y, (newtonKernel (x - y) - newtonKernel x) * g y‖
        ≤ ∫ y, R / (2 * Real.pi * ‖x‖ ^ 2) * |g y| :=
          norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (hgi.abs.const_mul _) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hbound)
      _ = R * M / (2 * Real.pi * ‖x‖ ^ 2) := by
          rw [integral_const_mul, hMdef]; ring
  
  refine ⟨max (B * (1 + 2 * R) ^ 2) (9 * R * M / (8 * Real.pi)), fun x => ?_⟩
  have hs : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ := norm_nonneg x
  have hpos : 0 < 1 + ‖x‖ := by linarith
  rw [Real.rpow_neg hpos.le, Real.rpow_two, ← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  rcases le_or_gt ‖x‖ (2 * R) with h | h
  · have h1 := hnear x h
    have h2 : (1 + ‖x‖) ^ 2 ≤ (1 + 2 * R) ^ 2 := by gcongr
    calc |newtonPot g x| * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ 2 ≤ B * (1 + 2 * R) ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul h1 h2 (by positivity) hB
      _ ≤ _ := le_max_left _ _
  · have h1 := hfar x h.le
    have hs2 : 2 ≤ ‖x‖ := by linarith
    have hx0 : 0 < ‖x‖ := by linarith
    have h2 : (1 + ‖x‖) ^ 2 ≤ 9 / 4 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hRM : 0 ≤ R * M / (2 * Real.pi * ‖x‖ ^ 2) :=
      div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hR0.le hM) (by positivity)
    calc |newtonPot g x| * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ 2
        ≤ R * M / (2 * Real.pi * ‖x‖ ^ 2) * (9 / 4 * ‖x‖ ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul h1 h2 (by positivity) hRM
      _ = 9 * R * M / (8 * Real.pi) := by field_simp; ring
      _ ≤ _ := le_max_right _ _

informal_problem.statement: LocallyIntegrable newtonKernel volume → ∀ b : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ b → HasCompactSupport b → ∀ x : ℝ³, ∑ k : Fin 3, newtonPot (pd k (pd k b)) x = - b x

signature.name: newtonPot_green_identity
signature.statement: LocallyIntegrable newtonKernel volume → ∀ b : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ b → HasCompactSupport b → ∀ x : ℝ³, ∑ k : Fin 3, newtonPot (pd k (pd k b)) x = - b x

proof.tactics:
by
  intro hΓ b hb hbs x
  have hpi : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have hfr : Module.finrank ℝ ℝ³ = 3 := finrank_euclideanSpace_fin
  
  have hpow : ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∀ (p : ℝ) (n : ℕ), p = (n : ℝ) / 2 → A ^ (-p) = (√A ^ n)⁻¹ := by
    intro A hA p n hp
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hA.le, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hA.le, hp]
    congr 2
    ring
  
  have hpdC : ∀ g : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pd k g) := by
    intro g hg k
    show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ g x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1))
    exact (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hg).2.clm_apply contDiff_const
  have hpdS : ∀ g : ℝ³ → ℝ, HasCompactSupport g → ∀ k : Fin 3, HasCompactSupport (pd k g) := by
    intro g hg k
    exact HasCompactSupport.fderiv_apply ℝ hg _
  have hdiff : ∀ g : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → Differentiable ℝ g :=
    fun g hg => hg.differentiable (by simp)
  have hintc : ∀ f g : ℝ³ → ℝ, Continuous f → Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g →
      Integrable (fun x => f x * g x) :=
    fun f g hf hg hgs => (hf.mul hg).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hgs.mul_left
  
  have hibp : ∀ F : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → ∀ k : Fin 3,
      (∫ y, F y * pd k (pd k b) y) = ∫ y, pd k (pd k F) y * b y := by
    intro F hF k
    have h1 := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := volume) (f := F)
      (g := pd k b) (v := EuclideanSpace.single k 1)
      (hintc _ _ (hpdC F hF k).continuous (hpdC b hb k).continuous (hpdS b hbs k))
      (hintc _ _ hF.continuous (hpdC _ (hpdC b hb k) k).continuous (hpdS _ (hpdS b hbs k) k))
      (hintc _ _ hF.continuous (hpdC b hb k).continuous (hpdS b hbs k))
      (fun x _ => hdiff F hF x) (fun x _ => hdiff _ (hpdC b hb k) x)
    have h2 := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := volume) (f := pd k F)
      (g := b) (v := EuclideanSpace.single k 1)
      (hintc _ _ (hpdC _ (hpdC F hF k) k).continuous hb.continuous hbs)
      (hintc _ _ (hpdC F hF k).continuous (hpdC b hb k).continuous (hpdS b hbs k))
      (hintc _ _ (hpdC F hF k).continuous hb.continuous hbs)
      (fun x _ => hdiff _ (hpdC F hF k) x) (fun x _ => hdiff b hb x)
    have e1 : (∫ y, F y * pd k (pd k b) y) = -∫ y, pd k F y * pd k b y := h1
    have e2 : (∫ y, pd k F y * pd k b y) = -∫ y, pd k (pd k F) y * b y := h2
    rw [e1, e2, neg_neg]
  
  have hderiv : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) ∧
      ∀ y : ℝ³, ∑ k : Fin 3, pd k (pd k (fun y : ℝ³ => (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)))) y
        = -(c ^ 3 * (3 / (4 * Real.pi) * (1 + ‖c • (x - y)‖ ^ 2) ^ (-(5 / 2 : ℝ)))) := by
    intro c hc
    have hc2 : 0 < (c ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
    have hQpos : ∀ y : ℝ³, 0 < ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹ := fun y => by positivity
    have hQc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
      ((contDiff_norm_sq ℝ).comp (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id)).add contDiff_const
    have hQd' : ∀ y : ℝ³, ∃ L : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) L y ∧
        ∀ k : Fin 3, L (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) = -2 * (x k - y k) := by
      intro y
      refine ⟨_, (((hasFDerivAt_id y).const_sub x).norm_sq).add_const ((c ^ 2)⁻¹), fun k => ?_⟩
      simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
      ring
    choose L hQd hQe using hQd'
    have hP : ∀ (p : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ p)
        ((p * (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (p - 1)) • L y) y :=
      fun p y => (hQd y).rpow_const (Or.inl (hQpos y).ne')
    have hproj : ∀ (k : Fin 3) (y : ℝ³),
        HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => x k - y k) (-(EuclideanSpace.proj k : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)) y := by
      intro k y
      exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj k : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt (x := y)).const_sub (x k)
    have hpd1 : ∀ k : Fin 3, pd k (fun y : ℝ³ => (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)))
        = fun y => (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ((x k - y k) * (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ))) := by
      intro k
      funext y
      unfold pd
      rw [((hP (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) y).const_mul (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹).fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, hQe, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
        show -(1 / 2 : ℝ) - 1 = -(3 / 2) by norm_num]
      ring
    have hpd2 : ∀ (k : Fin 3) (y : ℝ³), pd k (pd k (fun y : ℝ³ => (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)))) y
        = (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (3 * (x k - y k) ^ 2 * (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (-(5 / 2 : ℝ))
            - (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ))) := by
      intro k y
      rw [hpd1 k]
      unfold pd
      have hm : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ((x k - y k) * (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)))) _ y :=
        ((hproj k y).mul (hP (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) y)).const_mul (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹
      rw [hm.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, hQe,
        ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [show -(3 / 2 : ℝ) - 1 = -(5 / 2) by norm_num]
      simp
      ring
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact contDiff_const.mul (hQc.rpow_const_of_ne (fun y => (hQpos y).ne'))
    · intro y
      simp only [hpd2]
      have hn : ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 = (x 0 - y 0) ^ 2 + (x 1 - y 1) ^ 2 + (x 2 - y 2) ^ 2 := by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        simp
      have hsm : ‖c • (x - y)‖ ^ 2 = c ^ 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [norm_smul, mul_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      have h1 : 1 + ‖c • (x - y)‖ ^ 2 = c ^ 2 * (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
        rw [hsm]; field_simp; ring
      rw [h1, hpow (c ^ 2 * (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹)) (by positivity) (5 / 2) 5 (by norm_num),
        hpow _ (hQpos y) (5 / 2) 5 (by norm_num), hpow _ (hQpos y) (3 / 2) 3 (by norm_num),
        Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg c), Real.sqrt_sq hc.le, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      have hs2 : √(‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 = ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
        Real.sq_sqrt (hQpos y).le
      have hsp : 0 < √(‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hQpos y)
      generalize √(‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) = s at hs2 hsp ⊢
      have hn2 : (x 0 - y 0) ^ 2 + (x 1 - y 1) ^ 2 + (x 2 - y 2) ^ 2 = s ^ 2 - (c ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        rw [← hn]; linarith
      have : (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (3 * (x 0 - y 0) ^ 2 * (s ^ 5)⁻¹ - (s ^ 3)⁻¹) +
          (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (3 * (x 1 - y 1) ^ 2 * (s ^ 5)⁻¹ - (s ^ 3)⁻¹) +
          (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (3 * (x 2 - y 2) ^ 2 * (s ^ 5)⁻¹ - (s ^ 3)⁻¹) =
          (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (3 * ((x 0 - y 0) ^ 2 + (x 1 - y 1) ^ 2 + (x 2 - y 2) ^ 2) * (s ^ 5)⁻¹
            - 3 * (s ^ 3)⁻¹) := by ring
      rw [this, hn2]
      field_simp
      ring
  
  have hdct : ∀ h : ℝ³ → ℝ, Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun c : ℝ => ∫ y, (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * h y)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (newtonPot h x)) := by
    intro h hc hs
    have hint : Integrable (fun y => newtonKernel (x - y) * h y) := by
      have := (hs.convolutionExists_right (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) hΓ hc x).integrable_swap
      simpa using this
    unfold newtonPot
    refine tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence (fun y => ‖newtonKernel (x - y) * h y‖)
      ?_ ?_ hint.norm ?_
    · filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with c hc0
      have hQ : ∀ y : ℝ³, 0 < ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹ := fun y => by positivity
      refine Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      refine (continuous_const.mul ?_).mul hc
      exact ((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).norm.pow 2 |>.add continuous_const).rpow_const
        (fun y => Or.inl (hQ y).ne')
    · filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with c hc0
      filter_upwards [Measure.ae_ne volume x] with y hy
      have hd : 0 < ‖x - y‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hy))
      have hd2 : 0 < ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
      have hle : (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤ (‖x - y‖ ^ 2) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hd2 (by have : 0 < (c ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
                                            linarith) (by norm_num)
      rw [hpow _ hd2 (1 / 2) 1 (by norm_num), Real.sqrt_sq hd.le, pow_one] at hle
      have hnn : 0 ≤ (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _
      have hK : (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤ newtonKernel (x - y) := by
        rw [newtonKernel, mul_inv (4 * Real.pi) ‖x - y‖]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle (by positivity)
      have hK0 : 0 ≤ (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by positivity
      calc ‖(4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * h y‖
          = ((4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) * ‖h y‖ := by
            rw [norm_mul _ (h y), Real.norm_of_nonneg hK0]
        _ ≤ newtonKernel (x - y) * ‖h y‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = ‖newtonKernel (x - y) * h y‖ := by
            rw [norm_mul _ (h y), Real.norm_of_nonneg (hK0.trans hK)]
    · filter_upwards [Measure.ae_ne volume x] with y hy
      have hd : 0 < ‖x - y‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hy))
      have hd2 : 0 < ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
      have h0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun c : ℝ => (c ^ 2)⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
        tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp (Filter.tendsto_pow_atTop (by norm_num))
      have h1 := ((h0.const_add (‖x - y‖ ^ 2)).rpow_const (p := -(1 / 2 : ℝ))
        (Or.inl (by rw [add_zero]; exact hd2.ne'))).const_mul (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ |>.mul_const (h y)
      rw [add_zero, hpow _ hd2 (1 / 2) 1 (by norm_num), Real.sqrt_sq hd.le, pow_one] at h1
      have hN : newtonKernel (x - y) = (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ‖x - y‖⁻¹ := by
        rw [newtonKernel, mul_inv (4 * Real.pi) ‖x - y‖]
      rw [hN]
      exact h1
  
  have hradial : (∫ y in Ioi (0:ℝ), y ^ (3 - 1) • (3 / (4 * Real.pi) * (1 + y ^ 2) ^ (-(5 / 2 : ℝ))))
      = (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ := by
    have ht0 : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < √(1 + y ^ 2) := fun y => Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
    have hGc : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (y / √(1 + y ^ 2)) ^ 3) := by
      refine continuous_const.mul ((continuous_id.div ?_ (fun y => (ht0 y).ne')).pow 3)
      exact (continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2)).sqrt
    have hGd : ∀ y ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (y / √(1 + y ^ 2)) ^ 3)
        (y ^ (3 - 1) • (3 / (4 * Real.pi) * (1 + y ^ 2) ^ (-(5 / 2 : ℝ)))) y := by
      intro y _
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => 1 + y ^ 2) (2 * y) y := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 y).const_add 1)
      have h2 := h1.sqrt (by positivity)
      have h3 := (hasDerivAt_id' y).div h2 (ht0 y).ne'
      have h4 := (h3.pow 3).const_mul (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹
      simp only [Pi.div_apply, Pi.pow_apply] at h4
      convert h4 using 1
      rw [hpow (1 + y ^ 2) (by positivity) (5 / 2) 5 (by norm_num)]
      have htp : 0 < √(1 + y ^ 2) := ht0 y
      have ht2 : √(1 + y ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 + y ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
      generalize √(1 + y ^ 2) = t at htp ht2 ⊢
      simp only [smul_eq_mul, show (3:ℕ) - 1 = 2 from rfl, Nat.cast_ofNat]
      have htne : t ≠ 0 := htp.ne'
      have hk : 1 * t - y * (2 * y / (2 * t)) = t⁻¹ := by
        field_simp
        nlinarith [ht2]
      rw [hk]
      field_simp
    have hnn : ∀ y ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ), 0 ≤ y ^ (3 - 1) • (3 / (4 * Real.pi) * (1 + y ^ 2) ^ (-(5 / 2 : ℝ))) := by
      intro y _
      rw [smul_eq_mul]
      have : 0 ≤ (1 + y ^ 2) ^ (-(5 / 2 : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _
      have : 0 ≤ y ^ (3 - 1) := by norm_num; positivity
      positivity
    have hlim : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (y / √(1 + y ^ 2)) ^ 3) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹) := by
      have hu : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => 1 - (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
        have : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => 1 + y ^ 2) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
          Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_left _ _ (Filter.tendsto_pow_atTop (by norm_num))
        simpa using (tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp this).const_sub 1
      have hv : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => y / √(1 + y ^ 2)) Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
        have hs := hu.sqrt
        rw [Real.sqrt_one] at hs
        refine hs.congr' ?_
        filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 0] with y hy
        have hpos : (0:ℝ) < 1 + y ^ 2 := by positivity
        rw [show 1 - (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ = y ^ 2 / (1 + y ^ 2) by field_simp; ring,
          Real.sqrt_div (sq_nonneg y), Real.sqrt_sq hy]
      have := (hv.pow 3).const_mul (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹
      simpa using this
    rw [integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_nonneg hGc.continuousWithinAt hGd hnn hlim]
    simp
  have hmass : (∫ z : ℝ³, 3 / (4 * Real.pi) * (1 + ‖z‖ ^ 2) ^ (-(5 / 2 : ℝ))) = 1 := by
    have hvol : (volume : Measure ℝ³).real (Metric.ball 0 1) = 4 * Real.pi / 3 := by
      rw [measureReal_def, EuclideanSpace.volume_ball_fin_three, ENNReal.ofReal_one, one_pow,
        one_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity)]
      ring
    rw [integral_fun_norm_addHaar (volume : Measure ℝ³)
      (fun r => 3 / (4 * Real.pi) * (1 + r ^ 2) ^ (-(5 / 2 : ℝ))), hfr, hvol, hradial]
    rw [smul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul]
    push_cast
    field_simp
  have htail : Filter.Tendsto (fun z : ℝ³ => ‖z‖ ^ Module.finrank ℝ ℝ³ *
      (3 / (4 * Real.pi) * (1 + ‖z‖ ^ 2) ^ (-(5 / 2 : ℝ)))) (Bornology.cobounded ℝ³) (nhds 0) := by
    rw [hfr]
    have hr : Filter.Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => r ^ 3 * (3 / (4 * Real.pi) * (1 + r ^ 2) ^ (-(5 / 2 : ℝ))))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have hb : Filter.Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => 3 / (4 * Real.pi) * r⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.const_mul (3 / (4 * Real.pi))
      refine squeeze_zero' ?_ ?_ hb
      · filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 0] with r hr
        have : 0 ≤ (1 + r ^ 2) ^ (-(5 / 2 : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _
        positivity
      · filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with r hr
        rw [hpow (1 + r ^ 2) (by positivity) (5 / 2) 5 (by norm_num)]
        have ht2 : √(1 + r ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 + r ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
        have ht1 : 1 ≤ √(1 + r ^ 2) := Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le (by nlinarith)
        have hrt : r ≤ √(1 + r ^ 2) := Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le (by nlinarith)
        generalize √(1 + r ^ 2) = t at ht2 ht1 hrt ⊢
        have hr0 : 0 < r := by linarith
        have hc : 0 < 3 / (4 * Real.pi) := by positivity
        rw [show r ^ 3 * (3 / (4 * Real.pi) * (t ^ 5)⁻¹) = 3 / (4 * Real.pi) * (r ^ 3 / t ^ 5) by ring]
        gcongr
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        have : r ^ 4 ≤ t ^ 4 := by gcongr
        have : t ^ 4 ≤ t ^ 5 := pow_le_pow_right₀ ht1 (by norm_num)
        calc r ^ 3 = r⁻¹ * r ^ 4 := by field_simp
          _ ≤ r⁻¹ * t ^ 5 := by gcongr; linarith
    exact hr.comp tendsto_norm_cobounded_atTop
  have hψnn : ∀ z : ℝ³, 0 ≤ 3 / (4 * Real.pi) * (1 + ‖z‖ ^ 2) ^ (-(5 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
    intro z
    have : 0 ≤ (1 + ‖z‖ ^ 2) ^ (-(5 / 2 : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _
    positivity
  
  have happrox := tendsto_integral_comp_smul_smul_of_integrable' (μ := (volume : Measure ℝ³))
    (φ := fun z : ℝ³ => 3 / (4 * Real.pi) * (1 + ‖z‖ ^ 2) ^ (-(5 / 2 : ℝ))) hψnn hmass htail
    (g := b) (x₀ := x) (hb.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hbs) hb.continuous.continuousAt
  
  have hA : Filter.Tendsto (fun c : ℝ => ∑ k : Fin 3,
      ∫ y, (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * pd k (pd k b) y)
      Filter.atTop (nhds (∑ k : Fin 3, newtonPot (pd k (pd k b)) x)) :=
    tendsto_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => hdct _ (hpdC _ (hpdC b hb k) k).continuous
      (hpdS _ (hpdS b hbs k) k))
  
  have hB : Filter.Tendsto (fun c : ℝ => ∑ k : Fin 3,
      ∫ y, (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * pd k (pd k b) y)
      Filter.atTop (nhds (-b x)) := by
    refine happrox.neg.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with c hc
    obtain ⟨hKc, hsum⟩ := hderiv c hc
    have hE : ∀ k : Fin 3,
        (∫ y, (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * pd k (pd k b) y)
          = ∫ y, pd k (pd k (fun y : ℝ³ => (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)))) y * b y :=
      fun k => hibp _ hKc k
    have hint : ∀ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)), Integrable (fun y =>
        pd k (pd k (fun y : ℝ³ => (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + (c ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)))) y * b y) :=
      fun k _ => hintc _ _ (hpdC _ (hpdC _ hKc k) k).continuous hb.continuous hbs
    simp only [hE]
    rw [← integral_finsetSum _ hint, ← integral_neg]
    congr 1
    funext y
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, hfr]
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hsum y]
    ring
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hA hB

informal_problem.statement: ∀ U : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ U → (∀ k : Fin 3, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ³, |pd k U x| ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ)) → (∀ k l : Fin 3, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ³, |pd k (pd l U) x| ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ)) → (∀ k l m : Fin 3, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ³, |pd k (pd l (pd m U)) x| ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ)) → (∀ (i j : Fin 3) (x : ℝ³), pd i (pd j U) x = pd j (pd i U) x) → (∀ (i j k : Fin 3) (x : ℝ³), pd i (pd j (pd k U)) x = pd j (pd i (pd k U)) x) → ∀ i j : Fin 3, MemLp (pd i (pd j U)) 2 ∧ (∫ x, (pd i (pd j U) x) ^ 2) = ∫ x, pd i (pd i U) x * pd j (pd j U) x

signature.name: hessian_sq_integral_eq_of_decay
signature.statement: ∀ U : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ U → (∀ k : Fin 3, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ³, |pd k U x| ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ)) → (∀ k l : Fin 3, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ³, |pd k (pd l U) x| ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ)) → (∀ k l m : Fin 3, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ³, |pd k (pd l (pd m U)) x| ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ)) → (∀ (i j : Fin 3) (x : ℝ³), pd i (pd j U) x = pd j (pd i U) x) → (∀ (i j k : Fin 3) (x : ℝ³), pd i (pd j (pd k U)) x = pd j (pd i (pd k U)) x) → ∀ i j : Fin 3, MemLp (pd i (pd j U)) 2 ∧ (∫ x, (pd i (pd j U) x) ^ 2) = ∫ x, pd i (pd i U) x * pd j (pd j U) x

proof.tactics:
by
  intro U hU hd1 hd2 hd3 hs2 hs3 i j
  have hpdC : ∀ g : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pd k g) := by
    intro g hg k
    show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ g x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1))
    exact (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hg).2.clm_apply contDiff_const
  have hdiff : ∀ g : ℝ³ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → ∀ x, DifferentiableAt ℝ g x :=
    fun g hg x => (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hg).1 x
  have hdom : Integrable (fun x : ℝ³ => (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-(4:ℝ))) := by
    apply integrable_one_add_norm
    simp
    norm_num
  have hprod : ∀ F G : ℝ³ → ℝ, Continuous F → Continuous G →
      (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ³, |F x| ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ)) →
      (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ³, |G x| ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ)) →
      Integrable (fun x => F x * G x) := by
    rintro F G hF hG ⟨C₁, h₁⟩ ⟨C₂, h₂⟩
    refine (hdom.const_mul (C₁ * C₂)).mono' (hF.mul hG).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_)
    have hpos : (0:ℝ) < 1 + ‖x‖ := by positivity
    have ha : (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-(4:ℝ)) = (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-2:ℝ) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-2:ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hpos]; norm_num
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, ha]
    calc |F x| * |G x| ≤ (C₁ * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-2:ℝ)) * (C₂ * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-2:ℝ)) :=
          mul_le_mul (h₁ x) (h₂ x) (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans (h₁ x))
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hU1 : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pd k U) := fun k => hpdC U hU k
  have hU2 : ∀ k l, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pd k (pd l U)) := fun k l => hpdC _ (hU1 l) k
  have hU3 : ∀ k l m, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pd k (pd l (pd m U))) := fun k l m => hpdC _ (hU2 l m) k
  have P1 := hprod _ _ (hU2 i j).continuous (hU2 i j).continuous (hd2 i j) (hd2 i j)
  have P2 := hprod _ _ (hU3 i i j).continuous (hU1 j).continuous (hd3 i i j) (hd1 j)
  have P3 := hprod _ _ (hU2 i j).continuous (hU1 j).continuous (hd2 i j) (hd1 j)
  have P4 := hprod _ _ (hU2 j j).continuous (hU2 i i).continuous (hd2 j j) (hd2 i i)
  have P5 := hprod _ _ (hU1 j).continuous (hU3 j i i).continuous (hd1 j) (hd3 j i i)
  have P6 := hprod _ _ (hU1 j).continuous (hU2 i i).continuous (hd1 j) (hd2 i i)
  have hmem : MemLp (pd i (pd j U)) 2 := by
    rw [memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq (hU2 i j).continuous.aestronglyMeasurable]
    simpa [pow_two] using P1
  refine ⟨hmem, ?_⟩
  have E1 : (∫ x, pd i (pd j U) x * pd i (pd j U) x) =
      -∫ x, pd i (pd i (pd j U)) x * pd j U x :=
    integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := volume)
      (f := pd i (pd j U)) (g := pd j U) (v := EuclideanSpace.single i 1) P2 P1 P3
      (fun x _ => hdiff _ (hU2 i j) x) (fun x _ => hdiff _ (hU1 j) x)
  have hsym : ∀ x, pd i (pd i (pd j U)) x = pd j (pd i (pd i U)) x := by
    intro x
    rw [show pd i (pd j U) = pd j (pd i U) from funext (hs2 i j)]
    exact hs3 i j i x
  have E2 : (∫ x, pd j U x * pd j (pd i (pd i U)) x) =
      -∫ x, pd j (pd j U) x * pd i (pd i U) x :=
    integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := volume)
      (f := pd j U) (g := pd i (pd i U)) (v := EuclideanSpace.single j 1) P4 P5 P6
      (fun x _ => hdiff _ (hU1 j) x) (fun x _ => hdiff _ (hU2 i i) x)
  calc (∫ x, (pd i (pd j U) x) ^ 2) = ∫ x, pd i (pd j U) x * pd i (pd j U) x := by
        congr 1; funext x; ring
    _ = -∫ x, pd i (pd i (pd j U)) x * pd j U x := E1
    _ = -∫ x, pd j U x * pd j (pd i (pd i U)) x := by
        congr 2; funext x; rw [hsym x]; ring
    _ = ∫ x, pd i (pd i U) x * pd j (pd j U) x := by
        rw [E2, neg_neg]; congr 1; funext x; ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ f k h : ℝ³ → ENNReal, Measurable f → Measurable k → Measurable h → (∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ y, f x * k (x - y) * h y) ≤ (∫⁻ x, f x ^ ((4:ℝ)/3)) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * (∫⁻ z, k z ^ ((4:ℝ)/3)) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * (∫⁻ y, h y ^ (2:ℝ)) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2)

signature.name: trilinear_young_four_thirds
signature.statement: ∀ f k h : ℝ³ → ENNReal, Measurable f → Measurable k → Measurable h → (∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ y, f x * k (x - y) * h y) ≤ (∫⁻ x, f x ^ ((4:ℝ)/3)) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * (∫⁻ z, k z ^ ((4:ℝ)/3)) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * (∫⁻ y, h y ^ (2:ℝ)) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro f k h hf hk hh
  have split : ∀ a b c : ENNReal, a * b * c = (a ^ ((4:ℝ)/3) * b ^ ((4:ℝ)/3)) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) * (b ^ ((4:ℝ)/3) * c ^ (2:ℝ)) ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) * (a ^ ((4:ℝ)/3) * c ^ (2:ℝ)) ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) := by
    intro a b c
    rw [ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num), ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num),
      ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num)]
    simp only [← ENNReal.rpow_mul]
    have ea : a = a ^ ((4:ℝ)/3 * (1/2)) * a ^ ((4:ℝ)/3 * (1/4)) := by
      rw [← ENNReal.rpow_add_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]; norm_num
    have eb : b = b ^ ((4:ℝ)/3 * (1/2)) * b ^ ((4:ℝ)/3 * (1/4)) := by
      rw [← ENNReal.rpow_add_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]; norm_num
    have ec : c = c ^ ((2:ℝ) * (1/4)) * c ^ ((2:ℝ) * (1/4)) := by
      rw [← ENNReal.rpow_add_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]; norm_num
    calc a * b * c = (a ^ ((4:ℝ)/3 * (1/2)) * a ^ ((4:ℝ)/3 * (1/4))) *
          (b ^ ((4:ℝ)/3 * (1/2)) * b ^ ((4:ℝ)/3 * (1/4))) *
          (c ^ ((2:ℝ) * (1/4)) * c ^ ((2:ℝ) * (1/4))) := by rw [← ea, ← eb, ← ec]
      _ = _ := by ring
  have combine : ∀ A K H : ENNReal, (A * K) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) * (K * H) ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) * (A * H) ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) = A ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * K ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * H ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) := by
    intro A K H
    rw [ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num), ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num),
      ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num)]
    have e1 : A ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) = A ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) * A ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) := by
      rw [← ENNReal.rpow_add_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]; norm_num
    have e2 : K ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) = K ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) * K ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) := by
      rw [← ENNReal.rpow_add_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]; norm_num
    have e3 : H ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) = H ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) * H ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) := by
      rw [← ENNReal.rpow_add_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]; norm_num
    rw [e1, e2, e3]
    ring
  have holder3 : ∀ (F G H : ℝ³ × ℝ³ → ENNReal), AEMeasurable F ((volume : Measure ℝ³).prod volume) →
      AEMeasurable G ((volume : Measure ℝ³).prod volume) → AEMeasurable H ((volume : Measure ℝ³).prod volume) →
      (∫⁻ z, F z ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) * G z ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) * H z ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) ∂((volume : Measure ℝ³).prod volume)) ≤
        (∫⁻ z, F z ∂((volume : Measure ℝ³).prod volume)) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) *
        (∫⁻ z, G z ∂((volume : Measure ℝ³).prod volume)) ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) *
        (∫⁻ z, H z ∂((volume : Measure ℝ³).prod volume)) ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) := by
    intro F G H hF hG hH
    have e : ∀ z, F z ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) * G z ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) * H z ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) =
        F z ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) * (G z ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) * H z ^ ((1:ℝ)/2)) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) := by
      intro z
      rw [ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num), ← ENNReal.rpow_mul, ← ENNReal.rpow_mul, mul_assoc,
        show (1:ℝ)/2 * (1/2) = 1/4 by norm_num]
    rw [lintegral_congr e]
    have hP : AEMeasurable (fun z => G z ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) * H z ^ ((1:ℝ)/2)) ((volume : Measure ℝ³).prod volume) :=
      (hG.pow_const _).mul (hH.pow_const _)
    calc _ ≤ (∫⁻ z, F z ∂((volume : Measure ℝ³).prod volume)) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) *
          (∫⁻ z, G z ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) * H z ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) ∂((volume : Measure ℝ³).prod volume)) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) :=
          ENNReal.lintegral_mul_norm_pow_le hF hP (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ (∫⁻ z, F z ∂((volume : Measure ℝ³).prod volume)) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) *
          ((∫⁻ z, G z ∂((volume : Measure ℝ³).prod volume)) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) *

signature.statement: ∀ f k h : ℝ³ → ENNReal, Measurable f → Measurable k → Measurable h → (∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ y, f x * k (x - y) * h y) ≤ (∫⁻ x, f x) * (∫⁻ z, k z ^ ((4:ℝ)/3)) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * (∫⁻ y, h y ^ (4:ℝ)) ^ ((1:ℝ)/4)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro f k h hf hk hh
  set C : ENNReal := (∫⁻ z, k z ^ ((4:ℝ)/3)) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * (∫⁻ y, h y ^ (4:ℝ)) ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) with hCdef
  have s1 : ∀ a b : ENNReal, a * b = (a ^ ((4:ℝ)/3)) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * (b ^ (4:ℝ)) ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) := by
    intro a b
    rw [← ENNReal.rpow_mul, ← ENNReal.rpow_mul,
      show (4:ℝ)/3 * (3/4) = 1 by norm_num, show (4:ℝ) * (1/4) = 1 by norm_num,
      ENNReal.rpow_one, ENNReal.rpow_one]
  have hin : ∀ x, (∫⁻ y, k (x - y) * h y) ≤ C := by
    intro x
    have hF : Measurable fun y => k (x - y) ^ ((4:ℝ)/3) :=
      (hk.pow_const _).comp (measurable_const.sub measurable_id)
    have hG : Measurable fun y => h y ^ (4:ℝ) := hh.pow_const _

        = ∫⁻ y, (k (x - y) ^ ((4:ℝ)/3)) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * (h y ^ (4:ℝ)) ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) :=
          lintegral_congr fun y => s1 _ _
      _ ≤ (∫⁻ y, k (x - y) ^ ((4:ℝ)/3)) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * (∫⁻ y, h y ^ (4:ℝ)) ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) :=
          ENNReal.lintegral_mul_norm_pow_le (f := fun y => k (x - y) ^ ((4:ℝ)/3))
            (g := fun y => h y ^ (4:ℝ)) hF.aemeasurable hG.aemeasurable
            (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      _ = C := by
          rw [hCdef, lintegral_sub_left_eq_self (fun z => k z ^ ((4:ℝ)/3)) x]
  have s3 : ∀ x, (∫⁻ y, f x * k (x - y) * h y) = f x * ∫⁻ y, k (x - y) * h y := by
    intro x
    have hm : Measurable fun y => k (x - y) * h y :=

    _ = _ := by rw [hCdef, mul_assoc]

  intro a ha

    rw [← hU]; exact hN.union hF

    rw [← hU, setIntegral_union Set.Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same measurableSet_Ioi hN hF, vN, vF]

by
  intro M Ru w u φ i j hw hu hφ hφcs hφ01 hwL2 hM hu0

      have e3 : |u x i| ≤ M := (habs u i x).trans (hM x)
      have e4 : |u x j| ≤ M := (habs u j x).trans (hM x)
      calc _ ≤ |w x i * w x j| + |w x i * u x j| + |u x i * w x j| := abs_add_three _ _ _
        _ = |w x i| * |w x j| + |w x i| * |u x j| + |u x i| * |w x j| := by simp only [abs_mul]
        _ ≤ ‖w x‖ * ‖w x‖ + ‖w x‖ * M + M * ‖w x‖ :=
            add_le_add (add_le_add (mul_le_mul e1 e2 (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
              (mul_le_mul e1 e4 (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)))
              (mul_le_mul e3 e2 (abs_nonneg _) hM0)
        _ = _ := by ring
    · rw [hvdef, Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
      have hx' : Ru ≤ ‖x‖ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, not_lt] at hx
        exact hx
      have hux : u x = 0 := hu0 x hx'
      have hui : u x i = 0 := by simp [hux]
      have huj : u x j = 0 := by simp [hux]
      rw [hui, huj, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, add_zero, add_zero, abs_mul]
      calc |w x i| * |w x j| ≤ ‖w x‖ * ‖w x‖ := mul_le_mul e1 e2 (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = _ := by ring
  
  have hind : Integrable ((Metric.ball (0:ℝ³) Ru).indicator (1 : ℝ³ → ℝ)) :=
    (integrableOn_const measure_ball_lt_top.ne).integrable_indicator measurableSet_ball
  have hball : ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p → p ≤ 2 →
      ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (v x ^ p) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * M) ^ p * (V + W)) := by
    intro p hp hp2
    have hc : 0 ≤ (2 * M) ^ p := Real.rpow_nonneg h2M p
    have hpt : ∀ x, v x ^ p ≤
        (2 * M) ^ p * ((Metric.ball (0:ℝ³) Ru).indicator (1 : ℝ³ → ℝ) x + ‖w x‖ ^ 2) := by
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.ball (0:ℝ³) Ru
      · rw [hvdef, Set.indicator_of_mem hx, Set.indicator_of_mem hx, Pi.one_apply]
        beta_reduce
        rw [Real.mul_rpow h2M (norm_nonneg _)]
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hc
        rcases le_total ‖w x‖ 1 with h1 | h1
        · have := Real.rpow_le_one (norm_nonneg (w x)) h1 hp.le
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖w x‖]
        · have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h1 hp2

      · rw [hvdef, Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, Real.zero_rpow hp.ne']
        exact mul_nonneg hc (by positivity)
    have hF : Integrable (fun x =>
        (2 * M) ^ p * ((Metric.ball (0:ℝ³) Ru).indicator (1 : ℝ³ → ℝ) x + ‖w x‖ ^ 2)) :=
      (hind.add hWint).const_mul _
    have hFint : ∫ x, (2 * M) ^ p * ((Metric.ball (0:ℝ³) Ru).indicator (1 : ℝ³ → ℝ) x + ‖w x‖ ^ 2)
        = (2 * M) ^ p * (V + W) := by
      rw [integral_const_mul, integral_add hind hWint,
        integral_indicator_one (measurableSet_ball : MeasurableSet (Metric.ball (0:ℝ³) Ru)),
        measureReal_def]
    calc ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (v x ^ p)
        ≤ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * M) ^ p *
            ((Metric.ball (0:ℝ³) Ru).indicator (1 : ℝ³ → ℝ) x + ‖w x‖ ^ 2)) :=
          lintegral_mono fun x => ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hpt x)
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, (2 * M) ^ p *
            ((Metric.ball (0:ℝ³) Ru).indicator (1 : ℝ³ → ℝ) x + ‖w x‖ ^ 2)) :=
          (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hF (ae_of_all _ fun x => mul_nonneg hc
            (add_nonneg (Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) x) (by positivity)))).symm

      Real.holderConjugate_iff.mpr ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩

      have hn := norm_nonneg (w x)

      have h2 : (‖w x‖ ^ 2) ^ ((4:ℝ)/3) = ‖w x‖ ^ ((5:ℝ)/3) * ‖w x‖ := by

      (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun x => φ x ^ 4 * ‖w x‖)).measurable.ennreal_ofReal.aemeasurable
    have hH := ENNReal.lintegral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq volume hpq hfm hgm
    beta_reduce at hH
    have hL : ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal ((φ x ^ 3 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2) ^ ((4:ℝ)/3))

            * (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (φ x ^ 4 * ‖w x‖))) x := by
      refine lintegral_congr fun x => ?_
      simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
      rw [hid x, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)]
    have h2 : ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (‖w x‖ ^ ((5:ℝ)/3)) ^ ((6:ℝ)/5) = ENNReal.ofReal W := by
      rw [← hWlin]
      refine lintegral_congr fun x => ?_
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _) (by norm_num),
        ← Real.rpow_mul (norm_nonneg _)]
      congr 1
      rw [show (5:ℝ)/3 * (6/5) = ((2:ℕ):ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_natCast]

      rw [← hSlin]
      refine lintegral_congr fun x => ?_
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (hφ01 x).1 4) (norm_nonneg _))

      congr 1

    refine hH.trans (le_of_eq ?_)

    norm_num
  
  have hball1 := hball 1 one_pos (by norm_num)
  simp only [Real.rpow_one] at hball1
  have hm1 : Measurable (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (‖w x‖ ^ 2)) :=
    (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun x => ‖w x‖ ^ 2)).measurable.ennreal_ofReal
  have hX1 : 0 ≤ 2 * M * (V + W) := mul_nonneg h2M (add_nonneg hV0 hW0)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · calc _ ≤ ∫⁻ x, (ENNReal.ofReal (‖w x‖ ^ 2) + ENNReal.ofReal (v x)) :=
          lintegral_mono fun x => (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hg x)).trans ENNReal.ofReal_add_le

      _ = _ := (ENNReal.ofReal_add hW0 hX1).symm
  
  · have h43 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 4/3 := by norm_num
    have hpt : ∀ x, ENNReal.ofReal
        ((φ x ^ 3 * |w x i * w x j + w x i * u x j + u x i * w x j|) ^ ((4:ℝ)/3))
        ≤ 2 ^ ((4:ℝ)/3 - 1) * (ENNReal.ofReal ((φ x ^ 3 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2) ^ ((4:ℝ)/3))
          + ENNReal.ofReal (v x ^ ((4:ℝ)/3))) := by
      intro x

      calc _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((φ x ^ 3 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2 + v x) ^ ((4:ℝ)/3)) :=

            rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add ha (hv0 x),

      ENNReal.rpow_ne_top_of_nonneg (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have hball43 := hball ((4:ℝ)/3) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

    calc _ ≤ ∫⁻ x, 2 ^ ((4:ℝ)/3 - 1) * (ENNReal.ofReal ((φ x ^ 3 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2) ^ ((4:ℝ)/3))

      _ = 2 ^ ((4:ℝ)/3 - 1) * ((∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal ((φ x ^ 3 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2) ^ ((4:ℝ)/3)))

          rw [lintegral_const_mul' _ _ hc2, lintegral_add_left hm2]
      _ ≤ 2 ^ ((4:ℝ)/3 - 1) * (ENNReal.ofReal (W ^ ((5:ℝ)/6) * S ^ ((1:ℝ)/6))

          mul_le_mul' le_rfl (add_le_add hhol hball43)

          rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add hX hY, show (4:ℝ)/3 - 1 = 1/3 by norm_num,
            ← ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat 2, ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (by norm_num) (by norm_num),

    have hF2 : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal ‖w x‖ ^ (2:ℝ)) = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, ‖w x‖ ^ 2) := by

      Real.mul_rpow hK (by linarith)
    have h4 : (1 + I ^ ((1:ℝ)/2)) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) ≤ 1 + I ^ ((3:ℝ)/8) := by
      have := Real.rpow_add_le_add_rpow zero_le_one hI12 (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 3/4)
        (by norm_num : (3:ℝ)/4 ≤ 1)
      rw [Real.one_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul hI] at this
      have e : (1:ℝ)/2 * (3/4) = 3/8 := by norm_num
      rw [e] at this

    have h5 : I ^ ((3:ℝ)/8) ≤ 1 + I ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) := by
      rcases le_total I 1 with hI1 | hI1
      · have := Real.rpow_le_one hI hI1 (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 3/8); linarith
      · have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hI1 (by norm_num : (3:ℝ)/8 ≤ 3/4); linarith
    calc S ^ ((1:ℝ)/8) ≤ K ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * (1 + I ^ ((3:ℝ)/8)) := by
          rw [e1]
          calc _ ≤ _ := h2
            _ = _ := h3
            _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 hK34
      _ ≤ K ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * (2 * (1 + I ^ ((3:ℝ)/4))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hK34

  have hb : 0 ≤ 8 * c / R := by positivity
  have hb2 : ((8 * c / R) ^ 2 * W) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) = (8 * c / R) * W ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) := by
    rw [Real.mul_rpow (pow_nonneg hb 2) hW]

    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hb]; norm_num
  have hb4 : ((8 * c / R) ^ 4 * (W ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) * S ^ ((1:ℝ)/2))) ^ ((1:ℝ)/4)
      = (8 * c / R) * (W ^ ((1:ℝ)/8) * S ^ ((1:ℝ)/8)) := by

    congr 1
    · rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hb]; norm_num

  have hQ : Real.pi⁻¹ * (16 * Real.pi * (3 * c / R)) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4)

    have h3 := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) h2 (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 3/4)

          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (inv_nonneg.mpr hpi.le)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ Real.pi⁻¹ * (16 * Real.pi * (3 * c / R)) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) := by positivity
  
  have hT1 : (2 ^ ((1:ℝ)/3) * (W ^ ((5:ℝ)/6) * S ^ ((1:ℝ)/6) + (2 * M) ^ ((4:ℝ)/3) * (V + W)))
        ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * W ^ ((1:ℝ)/2)
      ≤ 2 ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) * (2 * C₀ ^ ((9:ℝ)/8) * K ^ ((3:ℝ)/4)
        + 2 * M * (V + C₀) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * C₀ ^ ((1:ℝ)/2)) * (1 + I ^ ((3:ℝ)/4)) := by
    have ha : 0 ≤ W ^ ((5:ℝ)/6) * S ^ ((1:ℝ)/6) :=
      mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hW _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hS _)
    have h2M : 0 ≤ 2 * M := by linarith
    have hVW0 : 0 ≤ V + W := by linarith
    have hd : 0 ≤ (2 * M) ^ ((4:ℝ)/3) * (V + W) := mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg h2M _) hVW0

        = 2 ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) * (W ^ ((5:ℝ)/6) * S ^ ((1:ℝ)/6) + (2 * M) ^ ((4:ℝ)/3) * (V + W))

    have e2 : (W ^ ((5:ℝ)/6) * S ^ ((1:ℝ)/6)) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) = W ^ ((5:ℝ)/8) * S ^ ((1:ℝ)/8) := by

    have e3 : ((2 * M) ^ ((4:ℝ)/3) * (V + W)) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) = 2 * M * (V + W) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) := by
      rw [Real.mul_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg h2M _) hVW0, ← Real.rpow_mul h2M]

    have hW98 : W ^ ((9:ℝ)/8) ≤ C₀ ^ ((9:ℝ)/8) := Real.rpow_le_rpow hW hWC (by norm_num)

    have hVW : (V + W) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) ≤ (V + C₀) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) :=

    have hX : W ^ ((9:ℝ)/8) * S ^ ((1:ℝ)/8)

    have hY : 2 * M * (V + W) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * W ^ ((1:ℝ)/2)

      calc _ ≤ 2 * M * (V + C₀) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * C₀ ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) :=
            mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hVW h2M) hW12 (Real.rpow_nonneg hW _)

    have h214 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) := by positivity
    calc _ = 2 ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) * ((W ^ ((5:ℝ)/6) * S ^ ((1:ℝ)/6) + (2 * M) ^ ((4:ℝ)/3) * (V + W))
            ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * W ^ ((1:ℝ)/2)) := by rw [e1]; ring
      _ ≤ 2 ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) * ((W ^ ((5:ℝ)/8) * S ^ ((1:ℝ)/8) + 2 * M * (V + W) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4))
            * W ^ ((1:ℝ)/2)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsub (Real.rpow_nonneg hW _)) h214
      _ = 2 ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) * (W ^ ((9:ℝ)/8) * S ^ ((1:ℝ)/8)
            + 2 * M * (V + W) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * W ^ ((1:ℝ)/2)) := by rw [e4]; ring
      _ ≤ 2 ^ ((1:ℝ)/4) * (2 * C₀ ^ ((9:ℝ)/8) * K ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * (1 + I ^ ((3:ℝ)/4))
            + 2 * M * (V + C₀) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * C₀ ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) * (1 + I ^ ((3:ℝ)/4))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add hX hY) h214
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hT1n : 0 ≤ (2 ^ ((1:ℝ)/3) * (W ^ ((5:ℝ)/6) * S ^ ((1:ℝ)/6)
      + (2 * M) ^ ((4:ℝ)/3) * (V + W))) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) * W ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) :=
    mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (add_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hW _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hS _))
      (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _) (by linarith)))) _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hW _)

  rw [hb2, hb4]
  rw [show 2 * ((48 * Real.pi * c) ^ ((3:ℝ)/4) / Real.pi) * (8 * c) * (2 * (C₀ + 2 * M * (V + C₀))

proof.tactics:
by

  have hbdF : ∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →

  obtain ⟨-, -, hP1, -⟩ := bg_field_smooth_div h 0 (leadPi F) hS (hPsm.mono (hIci ε' hε'))

  have hext := bg_exterior_order_zero h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z hS hL

  have hK2 : K₂ ≤ K := by rw [hK]; exact (le_max_right K₁ K₂).trans (le_max_left _ _)

    have hcont2 : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => 2 * Xb * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) (x, t) :=
      continuousAt_const.mul hcont
    have hcont3 : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2) (x, t) := by fun_prop

bg_positive_expansion.definitions:
noncomputable def pdX (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ := deriv (fun Y => f Y η) X

noncomputable def pdE (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ := deriv (fun e => f X e) η

noncomputable def simTop (h b : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (-b * f X η + (1 / 2 - h) * η * pdE f X η + X * pdX f X η) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)

noncomputable def simZop (h b : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 * b * η * f X η + (1 - η ^ 2) * pdE f X η - 2 * η * X * pdX f X η) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)

noncomputable def bgUz (S : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ := S X η + X * pdX S X η

noncomputable def bgVx (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (S : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 * η * bgUz S X η - 2 * (1 / 2 - h + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * η * S X η - (1 - η ^ 2) * pdE S X η) /
    (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)

noncomputable def bgResTh (h : ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  simTop h (-(1 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) (G k) X η
    - 2 * (X * pdX (pdX (G k)) X η + 2 * pdX (G k) X η)
    + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
        (bgVx h i (S i) X η * (G (k - i) X η + X * pdX (G (k - i)) X η)
          + bgUz (S i) X η * simZop h (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) (G (k - i)) X η)
    - (if 1 ≤ k then simZop h (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h))
        (simZop h (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) (G (k - 1))) X η else 0)

noncomputable def bgResZ (h : ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  simTop h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) (bgUz (S k)) X η
    + simZop h (-(1 + 2 * h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) (W k) X η
    - 2 * (X * pdX (pdX (bgUz (S k))) X η + pdX (bgUz (S k)) X η)
    + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
        (X * bgVx h i (S i) X η * pdX (bgUz (S (k - i))) X η

    - (if 1 ≤ k then simZop h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h))

  simTop h (-1 + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) (bgVx h k (S k)) X η
    - 2 * (X * pdX (pdX (bgVx h k (S k))) X η + 2 * pdX (bgVx h k (S k)) X η)
    + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),

    - (if 1 ≤ k then simZop h (-1 + 2 * ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h))

noncomputable def stressPrimTh (r : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=

def BgCoeffSeq (h Xm Xs m1 m2 : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=

    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(W n)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧
  (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 →

noncomputable def bgTthSeq (h : ℝ) (T0 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ :=
  if n = 0 then (fun X η => if 0 < X then T0 X η else 0) else stressPrimTh (bgResTh h S G W n)

noncomputable def bgTzSeq (h : ℝ) (T0 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ :=

search_metadata.last_error: Approved at the commit gate. The crux (reference Lemmas 5.1/5.2, the profile-only coefficient construction) sits in the named child bg_coeff_seq_exists, verbatim from blueprint s1 and packaged through the BgCoeffSeq predicate, a good API boundary. The other seven children are calculus/verification lemmas that I checked term by term: curl identities with exponent 2nh; regularity; FTC stress primitives in the paired form; the backward edge bound; bgResTh_1 = -ZZF beyond max(Xs,Xv), closed by L10 and the s7 null identity; the vanishing facts V1/V2; and the (P5) remainder. Each one is used in the compiled glue, none duplicates §10 or an ancestor, and the findings record where the divergences went (s2/s3/s5/s7 folded into the consumers rather than flattened, an eta guard added to stressPrim). Blueprint §4 has explicit numerics E1-E5 and §5 has real adversarial cases (axis, large r, the divergent k=1 moment, truncation order 2N+2). Notes for the children are in findings.md: bg_residual_remainder should decompose along s2/s3/s5/s7, and bg_res_one_edge should share bg_coef_regular as a DAG child.

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z S G Uc Vc W Tth Tz hS hL hO hP
  have hL' := hL
  have hO' := hO
  have hP' := hP
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, hh1, hlam, hcinf, hcpatch, haa, hab, hXa, hXap1, hp12, hp2m1, hm12, hm2Xv, hXvXc,
    hXcXb⟩, hL1, hL2, -, -, -, -, -, hL8, -, -⟩ := hL'
  obtain ⟨⟨hO1a, hO1b, hO1c⟩, hO2, hO3, hO4, hO5, -⟩ := hO'
  obtain ⟨⟨hS0, hG0, hU0, hV0, hW0, -⟩, ⟨Xm, Xp, hXam, hmp, hpb, -, hvanXp, hpatch, -, -⟩,
    hP2, -, hP4, -⟩ := hP'
  have hh2 : h < 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have hγ : 0 < 2 * h := by linarith
  have hsub : simDomain h 1 ⊆ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := fun w hw => hw.1
  have hQpos : ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 → 0 < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) := by
    intro x t hxt
    have ht : t < 1 := hxt.1
    exact (hS.1 (x 2) (1 - t) (by linarith)).1
  have hQle1 : ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 → simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≤ 1 := by
    intro x t hxt
    have hlt : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < 1 := hxt.2
    linarith
  have hsmA : ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgAn h n (S n))) (simDomain h 1) := by
    intro n
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · rw [hS0]; exact hO1a.mono hsub
    · exact (bg_field_smooth_div h n (S n) hS (hP2 n (by omega)).1).1.mono hsub
  have hsmB : ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgBn h n (G n))) (simDomain h 1) := by
    intro n
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · rw [hG0]; exact hO1b.mono hsub
    · exact (bg_field_smooth_div h n (G n) hS (hP2 n (by omega)).2.1).2.1.mono hsub
  have hsmP : ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgPn h n (W n))) (simDomain h 1) := by
    intro n
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · rw [hW0]; exact hO1c.mono hsub
    · exact (bg_field_smooth_div h n (W n) hS (hP2 n (by omega)).2.2.1).2.2.1.mono hsub
  have hdivB' : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → divergence (fun y => bgBn h n (G n) y t) x = 0 := by
    intro n x t ht
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · rw [hG0]; exact hO2 x t ht
    · exact (bg_field_smooth_div h n (G n) hS (hP2 n (by omega)).2.1).2.2.2 x t ht
  have hazB : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), inner ℝ x (bgBn h n (G n) x t) = (0 : ℝ) ∧
      bgBn h n (G n) x t 2 = 0 := by
    intro n x t
    unfold bgBn azVec
    constructor
    · simp [inner_add_right, inner_smul_right, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
      ring
    · simp
  have hbdj : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(bgAn h j (S j))) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) - ((k : ℝ) + 2)) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(bgBn h j (G j))) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) - ((k : ℝ) + 2)) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(bgPn h j (W j))) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) - ((k : ℝ) + 2)) := by
    intro j hj k
    obtain ⟨sS, sG, sW, -, -, -, -, bnd⟩ := hP2 j hj
    obtain ⟨C1, h1⟩ := bg_field_scaled_bounds h Xp j (S j) hS hh0 hh2 sS
      (fun m => (bnd m).imp fun C hC X η hX e1 e2 => (hC X η hX e1 e2).1)
      (fun X η hX => (hvanXp j hj X η hX).1) k
    obtain ⟨C2, h2⟩ := bg_field_scaled_bounds h Xp j (G j) hS hh0 hh2 sG
      (fun m => (bnd m).imp fun C hC X η hX e1 e2 => (hC X η hX e1 e2).2.1)
      (fun X η hX => (hvanXp j hj X η hX).2.1) k
    obtain ⟨C3, h3⟩ := bg_field_scaled_bounds h Xp j (W j) hS hh0 hh2 sW
      (fun m => (bnd m).imp fun C hC X η hX e1 e2 => (hC X η hX e1 e2).2.2.1)
      (fun X η hX => (hvanXp j hj X η hX).2.2.2.2) k
    refine ⟨|C1| + |C2| + |C3|, fun x t hxt => ?_⟩
    have hq := Real.rpow_nonneg (hQpos x t hxt).le (2 * h * (j : ℝ) - ((k : ℝ) + 2))
    refine ⟨((h1 x t hxt).1).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hq),
      ((h2 x t hxt).2.1).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hq),
      ((h3 x t hxt).2.2).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hq)⟩
    · linarith [le_abs_self C1, abs_nonneg C2, abs_nonneg C3]
    · linarith [abs_nonneg C1, le_abs_self C2, abs_nonneg C3]
    · linarith [abs_nonneg C1, abs_nonneg C2, le_abs_self C3]
  obtain ⟨Ls, hLs⟩ : ∃ Ls : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ m, Ls m = (m : ℝ) + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |(fun i : ℕ => (i : ℝ) + 2) i| :=
    ⟨_, fun m => rfl⟩
  have hcut : ∀ j m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun y s => simCut h a y s • bgAn h j (S j) y s)) (x, t)‖ ≤
          C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) - Ls m) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun y s => simCut h a y s • bgBn h j (G j) y s)) (x, t)‖ ≤
          C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) - Ls m) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun y s => simCut h a y s • bgPn h j (W j) y s)) (x, t)‖ ≤
          C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) - Ls m) := by
    intro j m
    by_cases hj : 1 ≤ j
    · obtain ⟨C1, h1⟩ := cutoff_product_bound h 1 (2 * h * (j : ℝ)) (fun i : ℕ => (i : ℝ) + 2)
        (bgAn h j (S j)) hh0 hh2 one_pos le_rfl hS (hsmA j)
        (fun m => (hbdj j hj m).imp fun C hC x t hxt => (hC x t hxt).1) m
      obtain ⟨C2, h2⟩ := cutoff_product_bound h 1 (2 * h * (j : ℝ)) (fun i : ℕ => (i : ℝ) + 2)
        (bgBn h j (G j)) hh0 hh2 one_pos le_rfl hS (hsmB j)
        (fun m => (hbdj j hj m).imp fun C hC x t hxt => (hC x t hxt).2.1) m
      obtain ⟨C3, h3⟩ := cutoff_product_bound h 1 (2 * h * (j : ℝ)) (fun i : ℕ => (i : ℝ) + 2)
        (bgPn h j (W j)) hh0 hh2 one_pos le_rfl hS (hsmP j)
        (fun m => (hbdj j hj m).imp fun C hC x t hxt => (hC x t hxt).2.2) m
      refine ⟨|C1| + |C2| + |C3|, fun _ a ha x t hxt => ?_⟩
      have e : 2 * h * (j : ℝ) - Ls m =
          2 * h * (j : ℝ) - ((m : ℝ) + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |(fun i : ℕ => (i : ℝ) + 2) i|) := by
        rw [hLs]
      have hq := Real.rpow_nonneg (hQpos x t hxt).le (2 * h * (j : ℝ) - Ls m)
      rw [e] at hq ⊢
      refine ⟨(h1 a ha x t hxt).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hq),
        (h2 a ha x t hxt).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hq),
        (h3 a ha x t hxt).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hq)⟩
      · linarith [le_abs_self C1, abs_nonneg C2, abs_nonneg C3]
      · linarith [abs_nonneg C1, le_abs_self C2, abs_nonneg C3]
      · linarith [abs_nonneg C1, abs_nonneg C2, le_abs_self C3]
    · exact ⟨0, fun h1 => absurd h1 hj⟩
  choose Cf hCf using hcut
  obtain ⟨Cq, hCq⟩ := bg_profile_sums h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z
    S G Uc Vc W Tth Tz hS hL hO hP
  obtain ⟨Cr, hCr⟩ := bg_flatness h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z
    S G Uc Vc W Tth Tz hS hL hO hP hbdj
  obtain ⟨a, ha1, -, ha2, hasmall⟩ :=
    cut_scale_choice (2 * h) 1 (fun j m => |Cf j m| + |Cq j m| + |Cr j m|) hγ one_pos
  have hapos : ∀ j, 0 < a j := fun j => lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (ha1 j)
  have hsm_of : ∀ D : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ, (∀ j m, |D j m| ≤ |Cf j m| + |Cq j m| + |Cr j m|) →
      ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ j → ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1 / a j →
      |D j m| * q ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) / 2) ≤ (1 / 2) ^ j := by
    intro D hD j hj m hm q hq hqa
    have h0 : 0 ≤ |Cf j m| + |Cq j m| + |Cr j m| := by positivity
    have hs := hasmall j hj m hm q hq hqa
    rw [abs_of_nonneg h0] at hs
    exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hD j m) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _)) hs
  have hsmF := hsm_of Cf (fun j m => by linarith [abs_nonneg (Cq j m), abs_nonneg (Cr j m)])
  have hsmQ := hsm_of Cq (fun j m => by linarith [abs_nonneg (Cf j m), abs_nonneg (Cr j m)])
  have hsmR := hsm_of Cr (fun j m => by linarith [abs_nonneg (Cf j m), abs_nonneg (Cq j m)])
  have hsupp : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ j → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 →
      a j * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≤ 1 → ∀ X : ℝ,
      X ≤ Cf j k * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) - Ls k) →
      X ≤ (1 / 2) ^ j * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) / 2 - Ls k) := by
    intro j hj k hk x t hxt hsup X hX
    have hq := hQpos x t hxt
    have hqa : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≤ 1 / a j := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (hapos j)]
      linarith
    have hs := hsmF j hj k hk _ hq hqa
    have e : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) - Ls k) =
        simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) / 2) *
          simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) / 2 - Ls k) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [e] at hX
    have h1 : 0 ≤ simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) / 2 - Ls k) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    have h2 : 0 ≤ simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) / 2) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    calc X ≤ Cf j k * (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) / 2) *
          simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) / 2 - Ls k)) := hX
      _ = (Cf j k * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) / 2)) *
          simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) / 2 - Ls k) := by ring
      _ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ j * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) / 2 - Ls k) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) h2) hs) h1
  have hglob : ∀ (j k : ℕ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 → ∀ X : ℝ,
      X ≤ Cf j k * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) - Ls k) →
      X ≤ |Cf j k| * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (- Ls k) := by
    intro j k x t hxt X hX
    have hq := hQpos x t hxt
    have hq1 := hQle1 x t hxt
    have hγj : 0 ≤ 2 * h * (j : ℝ) := by positivity
    have e1 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) - Ls k) ≤
        simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (- Ls k) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq hq1 (by linarith)
    calc X ≤ Cf j k * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) - Ls k) := hX
      _ ≤ |Cf j k| * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) - Ls k) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _)
      _ ≤ |Cf j k| * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (- Ls k) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e1 (abs_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨hA1, hA2, hA3⟩ := cutSum_props h 1 (2 * h) Ls a (fun n => bgAn h n (S n)) hh0 hh2 one_pos le_rfl
    hγ hS ha1 ha2 hsmA
    (fun j hj k hk x t hxt hsup =>
      hsupp j hj k hk x t hxt hsup _ (hCf j k hj (a j) (hapos j) x t hxt).1)
    (fun j hj k => ⟨|Cf j k|, fun x t hxt => hglob j k x t hxt _ (hCf j k hj (a j) (hapos j) x t hxt).1⟩)
  obtain ⟨hB1, hB2, hB3⟩ := cutSum_props h 1 (2 * h) Ls a (fun n => bgBn h n (G n)) hh0 hh2 one_pos le_rfl
    hγ hS ha1 ha2 hsmB
    (fun j hj k hk x t hxt hsup =>
      hsupp j hj k hk x t hxt hsup _ (hCf j k hj (a j) (hapos j) x t hxt).2.1)
    (fun j hj k => ⟨|Cf j k|, fun x t hxt => hglob j k x t hxt _ (hCf j k hj (a j) (hapos j) x t hxt).2.1⟩)
  obtain ⟨hP1, hP2', hP3⟩ := cutSum_props h 1 (2 * h) Ls a (fun n => bgPn h n (W n)) hh0 hh2 one_pos le_rfl
    hγ hS ha1 ha2 hsmP
    (fun j hj k hk x t hxt hsup =>
      hsupp j hj k hk x t hxt hsup _ (hCf j k hj (a j) (hapos j) x t hxt).2.2)
    (fun j hj k => ⟨|Cf j k|, fun x t hxt => hglob j k x t hxt _ (hCf j k hj (a j) (hapos j) x t hxt).2.2⟩)
  obtain ⟨hB6, hB8⟩ := hCq a ha1 ha2 hsmQ
  refine ⟨1, cutSum h a (fun n => bgAn h n (S n)), cutSum h a (fun n => bgBn h n (G n)),
    cutSum h a (fun n => bgPn h n (W n)), bgEb h a G, bgSum h a Uc, bgVb h a S Vc, bgSum h a Tth,
