      Real.rpow_neg (by linarith)]
  have hev : ∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → φ =ᶠ[nhds s] (fun t => (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * t ^ (-(1/2):ℝ)) :=
    fun s hs => Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hs) (fun t ht => hT t (le_of_lt ht))
  have hD1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 < t →
      deriv φ t = (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ((-(1/2):ℝ) * t ^ ((-(1/2):ℝ) - 1)) := by
    intro t ht
    rw [(hev t ht).deriv_eq]
    exact ((Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl (by linarith : t ≠ 0))).const_mul _).deriv
  have hD2 : ∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → deriv (deriv φ) s
      = (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ((-(1/2):ℝ) * (((-(1/2):ℝ) - 1) * s ^ ((-(1/2):ℝ) - 1 - 1))) := by
    intro s hs
    have he : deriv φ =ᶠ[nhds s]
        (fun t => (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ((-(1/2):ℝ) * t ^ ((-(1/2):ℝ) - 1))) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hs) (fun t ht => hD1 t ht)
    rw [he.deriv_eq]
    exact (((Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl (by linarith : s ≠ 0))).const_mul _).const_mul
      _).deriv
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro s
    rcases lt_or_ge s (1/2) with hs | hs
    · have hev0 : φ =ᶠ[nhds s] (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Iio_mem_nhds hs) (fun t ht => by
          have ht' : t < 1/2 := ht
          simp only [hφ]
          rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), zero_mul])
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev0
    · have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h] at hs; norm_num at hs
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1)) s :=
        (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp
          ((contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id).sub contDiff_const)).contDiffAt
      have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun t : ℝ => 4 * Real.pi * Real.sqrt t) s :=
        contDiffAt_const.mul (Real.contDiffAt_sqrt hs0)
      have hne : 4 * Real.pi * Real.sqrt s ≠ 0 := by
        have : 0 < Real.sqrt s := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
        positivity
      exact h1.mul (h2.inv hne)
  · intro z
    simp only [hφ, newtonKernel, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg z)]
  · intro s hs
    rw [hD1 s hs, hD2 s hs]
    have hs0 : (0:ℝ) < s := by linarith
    have e2 : ((-(1/2):ℝ) - 1 - 1) = (-(5/2):ℝ) := by norm_num
    have e1 : ((-(1/2):ℝ) - 1) = (-(5/2):ℝ) + 1 := by norm_num
    rw [e2, e1, Real.rpow_add_one hs0.ne']
    ring
  · rw [hD1 4 (by norm_num)]
    have e : (4:ℝ) ^ ((-(1/2):ℝ) - 1) = 8⁻¹ := by
      rw [show ((-(1/2):ℝ) - 1) = -((1/2:ℝ) + 1) by norm_num, Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num),
        Real.rpow_add_one (by norm_num), ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow,
        show (4:ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]
      norm_num
    rw [e]
    field_simp
    ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (k D : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (r M : ℝ), 0 < r → Measurable k → (∀ z : ℝ³, 0 ≤ k z ∧ k z ≤ newtonKernel z) → (∀ z : ℝ³, r ≤ ‖z‖ → k z = 0) → Continuous D → (∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x r, |D y| ≤ M) → Integrable (fun y => k (x - y) * D y) ∧ |∫ y, k (x - y) * D y| ≤ M * (r ^ 2 / 2)

signature.name: truncated_newton_bound
signature.statement: ∀ (k D : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (r M : ℝ), 0 < r → Measurable k → (∀ z : ℝ³, 0 ≤ k z ∧ k z ≤ newtonKernel z) → (∀ z : ℝ³, r ≤ ‖z‖ → k z = 0) → Continuous D → (∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x r, |D y| ≤ M) → Integrable (fun y => k (x - y) * D y) ∧ |∫ y, k (x - y) * D y| ≤ M * (r ^ 2 / 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro k D x r M hr hkm hkb hk0 hD hM
  have hball : IntegrableOn newtonKernel (Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) r) ∧
      ∫ z in Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) r, newtonKernel z = r ^ 2 / 2 := by
    set f : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => if s < r then (4 * Real.pi * s)⁻¹ else 0 with hfdef
    have hpi : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
    have hind : (Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) r).indicator newtonKernel = fun z => f ‖z‖ := by
      funext z
      by_cases h : ‖z‖ < r
      · have hz : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) r := mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr h
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hz]
        simp only [hfdef, if_pos h, newtonKernel]
      · have hz : z ∉ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) r := fun hz => h (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hz)
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hz]
        simp only [hfdef, if_neg h]
    set g : ℝ → ℝ := (Set.Iio r).indicator (fun y : ℝ => y / (4 * Real.pi)) with hgdef
    have hEq : Set.EqOn (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2 * f y) g (Set.Ioi 0) := by
      intro y hy
      have hy0 : 0 < y := hy
      by_cases h : y < r
      · simp only [hfdef, if_pos h, hgdef, Set.indicator_of_mem (show y ∈ Set.Iio r from h)]
        field_simp
      · simp only [hfdef, if_neg h, hgdef, Set.indicator_of_notMem (show y ∉ Set.Iio r from h),
          mul_zero]
    have hgint : IntegrableOn g (Set.Ioi 0) := by
      rw [hgdef, integrableOn_indicator_iff measurableSet_Iio]
      have : IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ => y / (4 * Real.pi)) (Set.Icc 0 r) :=
        (continuous_id.div_const _).integrableOn_Icc
      exact this.mono_set (fun y hy => ⟨le_of_lt hy.2, le_of_lt hy.1⟩)
    have h1int : IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2 * f y) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hgint.congr_fun hEq.symm measurableSet_Ioi
    have h1val : ∫ y in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), y ^ 2 * f y = r ^ 2 / (8 * Real.pi) := by
      rw [setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi hEq, hgdef, setIntegral_indicator measurableSet_Iio,
        Set.Ioi_inter_Iio, ← integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hr.le,
        intervalIntegral.integral_div, integral_id]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hfr : Module.finrank ℝ ℝ³ = 3 := finrank_euclideanSpace_fin
    have hFint : Integrable (fun z : ℝ³ => f ‖z‖) := by
      rw [integrable_fun_norm_addHaar (volume : Measure ℝ³), hfr]
      exact h1int
    have hvol : (volume : Measure ℝ³).real (Metric.ball 0 1) = 4 * Real.pi / 3 := by
      rw [measureReal_def, EuclideanSpace.volume_ball_fin_three, ENNReal.ofReal_one, one_pow,
        one_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity)]
      ring
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← integrable_indicator_iff measurableSet_ball, hind]
      exact hFint
    · rw [← integral_indicator measurableSet_ball, hind,
        integral_fun_norm_addHaar (volume : Measure ℝ³) f, hfr, hvol]
      have h2 : ∫ y in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), y ^ (3 - 1) • f y = r ^ 2 / (8 * Real.pi) := h1val
      rw [h2, smul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul]
      push_cast
      field_simp
      ring
  obtain ⟨hIon, hval⟩ := hball
  set Φ : ℝ³ → ℝ := fun t => k t * D (x - t) with hΦdef
  set G : ℝ³ → ℝ := fun t => M * (Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) r).indicator newtonKernel t with hGdef
  have hrefl : (fun y => k (x - y) * D y) = (fun y => Φ (x - y)) := by
    funext y
    simp only [hΦdef, sub_sub_cancel]
  have hGi : Integrable G :=
    ((integrable_indicator_iff measurableSet_ball).mpr hIon).const_mul M
  have hGint : ∫ t, G t = M * (r ^ 2 / 2) := by
    simp only [hGdef]
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_indicator measurableSet_ball, hval]
  have hΦm : AEStronglyMeasurable Φ := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ³ => D (x - t)) := hD.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)
    exact (hkm.mul hc.measurable).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hdom : ∀ t, ‖Φ t‖ ≤ G t := by
    intro t
    simp only [hΦdef, hGdef, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hkb t).1]
    by_cases ht : t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ³) r
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem ht]
      have hmem : x - t ∈ Metric.closedBall x r := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, sub_sub_cancel_left, norm_neg]
        rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at ht
        exact ht.le
      have h1 := mul_le_mul (hkb t).2 (hM _ hmem) (abs_nonneg _) (le_trans (hkb t).1 (hkb t).2)
      linarith [mul_comm (newtonKernel t) M]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem ht]
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, not_lt] at ht
      rw [hk0 t ht]
      simp
  have hΦi : Integrable Φ := hGi.mono' hΦm (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hdom)
  have hb : ‖∫ t, Φ t‖ ≤ ∫ t, G t :=
    norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hGi (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hdom)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hrefl]
    exact hΦi.comp_sub_left x
  · rw [hrefl, integral_sub_left_eq_self Φ (volume : Measure ℝ³) x, ← hGint, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hb

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (Ψ g : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (ε M : ℝ), Continuous Ψ → (∀ u : ℝ³, 1 < ‖u‖ → Ψ u = 0) → ContDiff ℝ 1 g → 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 → (∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x 1, ‖fderiv ℝ g y‖ ≤ M) → Integrable (fun y => (ε ^ 3)⁻¹ * Ψ (ε⁻¹ • (x - y)) * g y) ∧ |(∫ y, (ε ^ 3)⁻¹ * Ψ (ε⁻¹ • (x - y)) * g y) - (∫ u, Ψ u) * g x| ≤ ε * M * ∫ u, |Ψ u|

signature.name: scaled_kernel_limit
signature.statement: ∀ (Ψ g : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (ε M : ℝ), Continuous Ψ → (∀ u : ℝ³, 1 < ‖u‖ → Ψ u = 0) → ContDiff ℝ 1 g → 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 → (∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x 1, ‖fderiv ℝ g y‖ ≤ M) → Integrable (fun y => (ε ^ 3)⁻¹ * Ψ (ε⁻¹ • (x - y)) * g y) ∧ |(∫ y, (ε ^ 3)⁻¹ * Ψ (ε⁻¹ • (x - y)) * g y) - (∫ u, Ψ u) * g x| ≤ ε * M * ∫ u, |Ψ u|

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Ψ g x ε M hΨc hΨs hg hε hε1 hM
  have hxmem : x ∈ Metric.closedBall x 1 := Metric.mem_closedBall_self zero_le_one
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hM x hxmem)
  have hgc : Continuous g := hg.continuous
  have hI : Integrable (fun y => (ε ^ 3)⁻¹ * Ψ (ε⁻¹ • (x - y)) * g y) := by
    refine Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport ?_ ?_
    · exact (continuous_const.mul
        (hΨc.comp ((continuous_const_smul ε⁻¹).comp
          ((continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : ℝ³ => x)).sub continuous_id)))).mul hgc
    · refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall x 1) (fun y hy => ?_)
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, not_le, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] at hy
      have h1 : 1 < ‖ε⁻¹ • (x - y)‖ := by
        rw [norm_smul_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hε.le), inv_mul_eq_div, one_lt_div hε]
        linarith
      show (ε ^ 3)⁻¹ * Ψ (ε⁻¹ • (x - y)) * g y = 0
      rw [hΨs _ h1, mul_zero, zero_mul]
  refine ⟨hI, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ : ∃ H : ℝ³ → ℝ, H = fun u => Ψ u * g (x - ε • u) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hcov : ∫ y, (ε ^ 3)⁻¹ * Ψ (ε⁻¹ • (x - y)) * g y = ∫ u, H u := by
    have e1 := integral_sub_left_eq_self
      (fun y => (ε ^ 3)⁻¹ * Ψ (ε⁻¹ • (x - y)) * g y) (volume : Measure ℝ³) x
    simp only [sub_sub_cancel] at e1
    rw [← e1]
    have e2 : (fun y => (ε ^ 3)⁻¹ * Ψ (ε⁻¹ • y) * g (x - y))
        = fun y => (ε ^ 3)⁻¹ * H (ε⁻¹ • y) := by
      funext y
      rw [hH]
      simp only [smul_inv_smul₀ hε.ne']
      ring
    rw [e2, integral_const_mul, Measure.integral_comp_inv_smul_of_nonneg volume H hε.le,
      finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ (pow_ne_zero 3 hε.ne')]
  rw [hcov]
  have hsupp : ∀ φ : ℝ³ → ℝ, Continuous φ → Integrable (fun u => Ψ u * φ u) := by
    intro φ hφ
    refine (hΨc.mul hφ).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport ?_
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℝ³) 1) (fun u hu => ?_)
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hu
    show Ψ u * φ u = 0
    rw [hΨs u hu, zero_mul]
  have hshc : Continuous (fun u : ℝ³ => g (x - ε • u)) :=
    hgc.comp (continuous_const.sub (continuous_const_smul ε))
  have hHi : Integrable H := by rw [hH]; exact hsupp _ hshc
  have hGi : Integrable (fun u => Ψ u * g x) := hsupp _ continuous_const
  have hAi : Integrable (fun u => |Ψ u| * (ε * M)) := by
    have h1 : Integrable (fun u => Ψ u * 1) := hsupp _ continuous_const
    simp only [mul_one] at h1
    exact h1.abs.mul_const _
  have hDi : Integrable (fun u => |Ψ u * (g (x - ε • u) - g x)|) :=
    (hsupp _ (hshc.sub continuous_const)).abs
  have hdiff : (∫ u, H u) - (∫ u, Ψ u) * g x = ∫ u, Ψ u * (g (x - ε • u) - g x) := by
    rw [← integral_mul_const, ← integral_sub hHi hGi]
    congr 1
    funext u
    rw [hH]
    ring
  rw [hdiff]
  have hpt : ∀ u, |Ψ u * (g (x - ε • u) - g x)| ≤ |Ψ u| * (ε * M) := by
    intro u
    by_cases hu : 1 < ‖u‖
    · rw [hΨs u hu]; simp
    · push_neg at hu
      have hz : x - ε • u ∈ Metric.closedBall x 1 := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, sub_sub_cancel_left, norm_neg,
          norm_smul_of_nonneg hε.le]
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg u]
      have hmvt := (convex_closedBall x 1).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
        (fun y _ => (hg.differentiable one_ne_zero).differentiableAt) hM hxmem hz
      rw [sub_sub_cancel_left, norm_neg, norm_smul_of_nonneg hε.le, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hmvt
      rw [abs_mul]
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (abs_nonneg _)
      calc |g (x - ε • u) - g x| ≤ M * (ε * ‖u‖) := hmvt
        _ ≤ ε * M := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hM0 hε.le]
  calc |∫ u, Ψ u * (g (x - ε • u) - g x)|
      ≤ ∫ u, |Ψ u * (g (x - ε • u) - g x)| := abs_integral_le_integral_abs
    _ ≤ ∫ u, |Ψ u| * (ε * M) := integral_mono hDi hAi hpt
    _ = ε * M * ∫ u, |Ψ u| := by rw [integral_mul_const]; ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ => ε⁻¹ * (Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖ε⁻¹ • z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel (ε⁻¹ • z))) ∧ (∀ z : ℝ³, 0 ≤ ε⁻¹ * (Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖ε⁻¹ • z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel (ε⁻¹ • z)) ∧ ε⁻¹ * (Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖ε⁻¹ • z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel (ε⁻¹ • z)) ≤ newtonKernel z) ∧ (∀ z : ℝ³, ε ≤ ‖z‖ → ε⁻¹ * (Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖ε⁻¹ • z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel (ε⁻¹ • z)) = newtonKernel z)

signature.name: scaled_far_kernel
signature.statement: ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ => ε⁻¹ * (Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖ε⁻¹ • z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel (ε⁻¹ • z))) ∧ (∀ z : ℝ³, 0 ≤ ε⁻¹ * (Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖ε⁻¹ • z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel (ε⁻¹ • z)) ∧ ε⁻¹ * (Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖ε⁻¹ • z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel (ε⁻¹ • z)) ≤ newtonKernel z) ∧ (∀ z : ℝ³, ε ≤ ‖z‖ → ε⁻¹ * (Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖ε⁻¹ • z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel (ε⁻¹ • z)) = newtonKernel z)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ε hε
  set K : ℝ³ → ℝ := fun z : ℝ³ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z
    with hKdef
  have hΓnn : ∀ z : ℝ³, 0 ≤ newtonKernel z := fun z => by
    unfold newtonKernel; positivity
  have hK1 : ∀ z : ℝ³, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → K z = newtonKernel z := by
    intro z hz
    show Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel z = newtonKernel z
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by nlinarith), one_mul]
  have hKb : ∀ z : ℝ³, 0 ≤ K z ∧ K z ≤ newtonKernel z := fun z =>
    ⟨mul_nonneg (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _) (hΓnn z),
     mul_le_of_le_one_left (hΓnn z) (Real.smoothTransition.le_one _)⟩
  have hq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ => 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 - 1) :=
    (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_norm_sq ℝ)).sub contDiff_const
  have hst : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Real.smoothTransition := Real.smoothTransition.contDiff
  have hKs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ K := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro z
    rcases lt_or_ge (2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1) 0 with h | h
    · have hU : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ | 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 - 1 < 0} :=
        isOpen_lt hq.continuous continuous_const
      have hev : K =ᶠ[nhds z] (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds h) (fun w hw => by
          show Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel w = 0
          rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hw), zero_mul])
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    · have hz : z ≠ 0 := by
        rintro rfl
        simp at h
        linarith
      have hnz : 0 < ‖z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hz
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 - 1)) z :=
        (hst.comp hq).contDiffAt
      have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ => 4 * Real.pi * ‖w‖) z :=
        contDiffAt_const.mul (contDiffAt_norm ℝ hz)
      have h3 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ => (4 * Real.pi * ‖w‖)⁻¹) z :=
        h2.inv (mul_pos (by positivity) hnz).ne'
      exact h1.mul h3
  have hnorm : ∀ z : ℝ³, ‖ε⁻¹ • z‖ = ε⁻¹ * ‖z‖ := by
    intro z
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hε)]
  have hhom : ∀ z : ℝ³, ε⁻¹ * newtonKernel (ε⁻¹ • z) = newtonKernel z := by
    intro z
    unfold newtonKernel
    rw [hnorm z, show 4 * Real.pi * (ε⁻¹ * ‖z‖) = ε⁻¹ * (4 * Real.pi * ‖z‖) by ring,
      mul_inv, inv_inv, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hε.ne', one_mul]
  have hinv : 0 ≤ ε⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hε.le
  refine ⟨?_, fun z => ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun z hz => ?_⟩
  · have hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ => ε⁻¹ • z) := contDiff_const_smul ε⁻¹
    exact contDiff_const.mul (hKs.comp hc)
  · exact mul_nonneg hinv (hKb (ε⁻¹ • z)).1
  · calc ε⁻¹ * (Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖ε⁻¹ • z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel (ε⁻¹ • z))
        ≤ ε⁻¹ * newtonKernel (ε⁻¹ • z) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hKb (ε⁻¹ • z)).2 hinv
      _ = newtonKernel z := hhom z
  · have h1 : 1 ≤ ‖ε⁻¹ • z‖ := by
      rw [hnorm z]
      exact (one_le_inv_mul₀ hε).mpr hz
    calc ε⁻¹ * (Real.smoothTransition (2 * ‖ε⁻¹ • z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * newtonKernel (ε⁻¹ • z))
        = ε⁻¹ * K (ε⁻¹ • z) := rfl
      _ = ε⁻¹ * newtonKernel (ε⁻¹ • z) := by rw [hK1 (ε⁻¹ • z) h1]
      _ = newtonKernel z := hhom z

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profRadAvg g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(profRadAvg g)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → X * profRadAvg g X η = profRadInt g X η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * profRadAvg g Y η) (g X η) X)

signature.name: profRadAvg_props
signature.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profRadAvg g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(profRadAvg g)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → X * profRadAvg g X η = profRadInt g X η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * profRadAvg g Y η) (g X η) X)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hIoc : uIoc (0:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Icc 0 1 := by
    rw [uIoc_of_le zero_le_one]; exact Ioc_subset_Icc_self
  
  have s1 : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
      (k : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → F) (O : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (V : Set (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))), IsOpen O → IsOpen V →
      Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ O ⊆ V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ k V → ∀ p ∈ O,
      HasFDerivAt (fun q => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, k (s, q))
        (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, (fderiv ℝ k (s, p)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))) p := by
    intro F _ _ _ k O V hO hV hsub hk p₀ hp₀
    obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, hIu, hpv, huv⟩ := generalized_tube_lemma isCompact_Icc
      (isCompact_singleton (x := p₀)) hV
      (fun z hz => hsub ⟨hz.1, by rw [mem_singleton_iff.mp hz.2]; exact hp₀⟩)
    obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hv p₀ (hpv (mem_singleton p₀))
    have hδpos : 0 < δ₀ / 2 := by positivity
    have hT : Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Metric.closedBall p₀ (δ₀ / 2) ⊆ V := by
      intro z hz
      apply huv
      exact ⟨hIu hz.1, hball (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith) hz.2)⟩
    have hTc : IsCompact (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Metric.closedBall p₀ (δ₀ / 2)) :=
      isCompact_Icc.prod (isCompact_closedBall p₀ _)
    have hk'c : ContinuousOn
        (fun z => (fderiv ℝ k z).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))) V :=
      (hk.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hV (by simp)).clm_comp continuousOn_const
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hTc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hk'c.mono hT)
    have hkc : ContinuousOn k V := hk.continuousOn
    have hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (δ₀ / 2),
        HasFDerivAt (fun x => k (t, x))
          ((fderiv ℝ k (t, x)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))) x := by
      intro t ht x hx
      have hmem : (t, x) ∈ V := hT ⟨ht, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx⟩
      have hd : HasFDerivAt k (fderiv ℝ k (t, x)) (t, x) :=
        ((hk.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hV.mem_nhds hmem)).hasFDerivAt
      exact hd.comp x (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_right t x)
    have hcont_t : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (δ₀ / 2),
        ContinuousOn (fun t => k (t, x)) (Icc 0 1) := by
      intro x hx
      exact hkc.comp ((continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const :
        Continuous fun t : ℝ => (t, x)).continuousOn) (fun t ht => hT ⟨ht, hx⟩)
    have hcont'_t : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (δ₀ / 2),
        ContinuousOn (fun t => (fderiv ℝ k (t, x)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)))
          (Icc 0 1) := by
      intro x hx
      exact hk'c.comp ((continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const :
        Continuous fun t : ℝ => (t, x)).continuousOn) (fun t ht => hT ⟨ht, hx⟩)
    have hp₀c : p₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (δ₀ / 2) := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hδpos.le
    refine intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ)
      (μ := volume) (s := Metric.ball p₀ (δ₀ / 2)) (bound := fun _ => B)
      (F := fun x t => k (t, x))
      (F' := fun x t => (fderiv ℝ k (t, x)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)))
      (Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hδpos) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ intervalIntegrable_const ?_
    · filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hδpos] with x hx
      exact ((hcont_t x (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx)).mono hIoc).aestronglyMeasurable
        measurableSet_uIoc
    · exact (hcont_t p₀ hp₀c).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one
    · exact ((hcont'_t p₀ hp₀c).mono hIoc).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall
        (fun t ht x hx => hB (t, x) ⟨hIoc ht, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx⟩)
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht x hx => hderiv t (hIoc ht) x hx)
  
  have s2 : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
      (k : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → F) (O : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (V : Set (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))), IsOpen O → IsOpen V →
      Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ O ⊆ V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ k V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun p => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, k (s, p)) O := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro F _ _ _ k O V hO hV hsub hk
      rw [Nat.cast_zero, contDiffOn_zero]
      intro p hp
      exact (s1 k O V hO hV hsub hk p hp).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    | succ n ih =>
      intro F _ _ _ k O V hO hV hsub hk
      have hk' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
          (fun z => (fderiv ℝ k z).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))) V :=
        (hk.fderiv_of_isOpen hV (by simp)).clm_comp contDiffOn_const
      have hD := ih _ O V hO hV hsub hk'
      rw [Nat.cast_succ, contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO]
      refine ⟨fun p hp => (s1 k O V hO hV hsub hk p hp).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt,
        by simp, ?_⟩
      exact hD.congr (fun p hp => (s1 k O V hO hV hsub hk p hp).fderiv)
  
  have s3 : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
      (k : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → F) (O : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (V : Set (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))), IsOpen O → IsOpen V →
      Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ O ⊆ V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ k V → ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ) (C : ℝ), p ∈ O →
      (∀ s ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun q => k (s, q)) p‖ ≤ C) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun q => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, k (s, q)) p‖ ≤ C := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro F _ _ _ k O V hO hV hsub hk p C hp hC
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]
      have := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := 0) (b := 1) (C := C)
        (f := fun s => k (s, p)) (fun s hs => by
          have h := hC s (hIoc hs)
          rwa [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] at h)
      simpa using this
    | succ m ih =>
      intro F _ _ _ k O V hO hV hsub hk p C hp hC
      have hk' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
          (fun z => (fderiv ℝ k z).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))) V :=
        (hk.fderiv_of_isOpen hV (by simp)).clm_comp contDiffOn_const
      rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
      have hev : fderiv ℝ (fun q => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, k (s, q)) =ᶠ[nhds p]
          (fun q => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1,
            (fderiv ℝ k (s, q)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hp)
          (fun q hq => (s1 k O V hO hV hsub hk q hq).fderiv)
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
      refine ih _ O V hO hV hsub hk' p C hp ?_
      intro s hs
      have hN : IsOpen {q : ℝ × ℝ | (s, q) ∈ V} :=
        hV.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
      have hpN : p ∈ {q : ℝ × ℝ | (s, q) ∈ V} := hsub ⟨hs, hp⟩
      have hev2 : fderiv ℝ (fun q => k (s, q)) =ᶠ[nhds p]
          (fun q => (fderiv ℝ k (s, q)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))) := by
        filter_upwards [hN.mem_nhds hpN] with q hq
        have hd : HasFDerivAt k (fderiv ℝ k (s, q)) (s, q) :=
          ((hk.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hV.mem_nhds hq)).hasFDerivAt
        exact (hd.comp q (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_right s q)).fderiv
      rw [← (hev2.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
      exact hC s hs
  intro g ε hε hg
  have hO : IsOpen (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  
  have s4 : ∀ (m : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ), 0 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 →
      (s * p.1, p.2) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => g (s * q.1) q.2) p‖ ≤
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (s * p.1, p.2)‖ := by
    intro m s p hs0 hs1 hp
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ, ∀ q, L q = (s * q.1, q.2) :=
      ⟨(s • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).prod (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ),
        fun q => by simp⟩
    have hfun : (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => g (s * q.1) q.2) = (↿g) ∘ L := by
      funext q
      show g (s * q.1) q.2 = ↿g (L q)
      rw [hL]
      rfl
    have hW : IsOpen (L ⁻¹' (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) := hO.preimage L.continuous
    have hLp : L p ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := by rw [hL]; exact hp
    have hcomp := L.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right hg hO.uniqueDiffOn hW.uniqueDiffOn
      (x := p) hLp (i := m) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hW hLp,
      iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hO hLp] at hcomp
    have hLnorm : ‖L‖ ≤ 1 := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound L zero_le_one (fun q => ?_)
      rw [hL, one_mul]
      simp only [Prod.norm_def, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      refine max_le_max ?_ le_rfl
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hs0]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) hs1
    rw [hfun, hcomp, ← hL p]
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _)
      (by rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
          exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hLnorm)
  
  have s5 : ∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → X * profRadAvg g X η = profRadInt g X η ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * profRadAvg g Y η) (g X η) X := by
    intro X η hX hη1 hη2
    have hid : ∀ Y : ℝ, Y * profRadAvg g Y η = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Y, g x η := by
      intro Y
      by_cases hY : Y = 0
      · subst hY; simp
      · unfold profRadAvg
        have := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right (fun x => g x η) hY (a := 0) (b := 1)
        simp only [zero_mul, one_mul, smul_eq_mul] at this
        rw [this, mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hY]
    have hfeq : (fun Y => Y * profRadAvg g Y η) = fun Y => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Y, g x η := funext hid
    refine ⟨hid X, ?_⟩
    have hφ : ContinuousOn (fun x => g x η) (Ioi (-ε)) :=
      hg.continuousOn.comp ((continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const :
        Continuous fun x : ℝ => (x, η)).continuousOn) (fun x hx => ⟨hx, hη1, hη2⟩)
    rw [hfeq]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
    · apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      refine hφ.mono (fun y hy => ?_)
      rw [mem_uIcc] at hy
      show -ε < y
      rcases hy with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;> linarith
    · exact hφ.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter isOpen_Ioi X hX
    · exact hφ.continuousAt (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds hX)
  
  have hφc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => (z.1 * z.2.1, z.2.2)) :=
    (contDiff_fst.mul (contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_snd)).prodMk (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd)
  have hV : IsOpen ((fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => (z.1 * z.2.1, z.2.2)) ⁻¹'
      (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) := hO.preimage hφc.continuous
  have hk : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => g (z.1 * z.2.1) z.2.2)
      ((fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => (z.1 * z.2.1, z.2.2)) ⁻¹' (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) :=
    hg.comp hφc.contDiffOn (mapsTo_preimage _ _)
  have htube : Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) ⊆
      (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => (z.1 * z.2.1, z.2.2)) ⁻¹' (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    rintro ⟨s, X, η⟩ ⟨⟨hs0, hs1⟩, hX, hη⟩
    refine ⟨?_, hη⟩
    show -ε < s * X
    have hX' : -ε < X := hX
    rcases le_or_gt 0 X with h | h
    · have := mul_nonneg hs0 h; linarith
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hs1) (neg_nonneg.mpr h.le)]
  have hS : (↿(profRadAvg g)) = fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1,
      (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => g (z.1 * z.2.1) z.2.2) (s, p) := rfl
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, s5⟩
  · rw [hS]
    exact contDiffOn_infty.mpr (fun n => s2 n _ _ _ hO hV htube hk)
  · rintro X₁ m ⟨C, hC⟩
    refine ⟨C, fun X η hX hX1 hη1 hη2 => ?_⟩
    rw [hS]
    have hεX : -ε < X := by linarith
    refine s3 m _ _ _ hO hV htube hk (X, η) C ⟨hεX, hη1, hη2⟩ ?_
    intro s hs
    have hsX : 0 ≤ s * X := mul_nonneg hs.1 hX
    have hmem : (s * X, η) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
      ⟨show -ε < s * X by linarith, hη1, hη2⟩
    refine (s4 m s (X, η) hs.1 hs.2 hmem).trans ?_
    exact hC _ _ hsX ((mul_le_of_le_one_left hX hs.2).trans hX1) hη1 hη2

signature.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadPi F)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadPi F)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z hL
  obtain ⟨⟨h0, -, -, -, -, -, -, hXa, hXap1, hp12, hp2m1, hm12, hm2Xv, hXvXc, hXcXb⟩, -, -, -,
    ⟨ε, hε, hFε, -, -, hbd⟩, -, hL6, -, -, -, -⟩ := hL
  have hXb : 0 < Xb := by linarith
  have hle : ∀ k : ℕ, (k : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := fun k => WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
  have hO : IsOpen (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hSO : ∀ X₁ : ℝ, Icc 0 X₁ ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
    fun X₁ z hz => ⟨show -ε < z.1 by linarith [hz.1.1], hz.2⟩
  
  have hcpt : ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (φ : ℝ × ℝ → E),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → ∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc 0 X₁ ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k φ z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro E _ _ φ hφ X₁ k
    have hK : IsCompact (Icc 0 X₁ ×ˢ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (ContDiff.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (m := k) (hle k) hφ).continuousOn
    exact ⟨C, fun z hz => hC z ⟨hz.1, Ioo_subset_Icc_self hz.2⟩⟩
  
  have hcomp : ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (G : E → ℝ) (t : Set E)
      (φ : ℝ × ℝ → E), IsOpen t → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G t → ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ →
      MapsTo φ (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) t → ∀ X₁ : ℝ,
      (∀ i : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc 0 X₁ ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G (φ z)‖ ≤ C) →
      ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc 0 X₁ ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (G ∘ φ) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro E _ _ G t φ ht hG hφ hmap X₁ hGb m
    choose Cg hCg using hGb
    choose Dφ hDφ using hcpt φ hφ X₁
    refine ⟨(m.factorial : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Cg i|) *
      (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Dφ i|) ^ m, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hzO := hSO X₁ hz
    rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := G ∘ φ) m hO hzO]
    refine norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hG hφ.contDiffOn (hle m) ht.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hmap hzO ?_ ?_
    · intro i hi
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i ht (hmap hzO)]
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G (φ z)‖ ≤ Cg i := hCg i z hz
        _ ≤ |Cg i| := le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Cg j| :=
            Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cg j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
              (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
    · intro i hi1 him
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO hzO]
      have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Dφ j| :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
      have hD1 : 1 ≤ 1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Dφ j| := by linarith
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i φ z‖ ≤ Dφ i := hDφ i z hz
        _ ≤ |Dφ i| := le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Dφ j| :=
            Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Dφ j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
              (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
        _ ≤ 1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Dφ j| := by linarith
        _ ≤ (1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Dφ j|) ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
  
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, g = fun x e => F x e ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hgs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    rw [hg]; exact hFε.pow 2
  have hgbd : ∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C := by
    intro X₁ m
    have hbF : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc 0 X₁ ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿F) z‖ ≤ C := fun k =>
      (hbd X₁ k).imp fun C hC z hz => (hC z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2).1
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) (↿F) (↿F)
      (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) _ hO (hSO X₁) hFε hFε hbF hbF m
    have he : (↿g) = fun z : ℝ × ℝ => ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ ((↿F) z) ((↿F) z) := by
      funext z
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply', hg]
      show F z.1 z.2 ^ 2 = F z.1 z.2 * F z.1 z.2
      ring
    refine ⟨C, fun X η h1 h2 h3 h4 => ?_⟩
    rw [he]
    exact hC (X, η) ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩
  obtain ⟨hSsm, hSbd, hSid⟩ := profRadAvg_props g ε hε hgs
  
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩ : ∃ Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, Ψ = fun p => p.1 * profRadAvg g p.1 p.2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΨsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    rw [hΨ]; exact contDiffOn_fst.mul hSsm
  have hΨbd : ∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc 0 X₁ ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Ψ z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro X₁ m
    have hb1 := hcpt (Prod.fst : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) contDiff_fst X₁
    have hb2 : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc 0 X₁ ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(profRadAvg g)) z‖ ≤ C := fun k =>
      (hSbd X₁ k (hgbd X₁ k)).imp fun C hC z hz => hC z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ)
      (Prod.fst : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (↿(profRadAvg g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) _ hO (hSO X₁)
      contDiffOn_fst hSsm hb1 hb2 m
    have he : Ψ = fun z : ℝ × ℝ => ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ z.1 ((↿(profRadAvg g)) z) := by
      rw [hΨ]; funext z; rw [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply']; rfl
    refine ⟨C, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    rw [he]
    exact hC z hz
  
  obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ, A = fun p => (Xb, p.2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A := by rw [hAdef]; fun_prop
  have hmapA : MapsTo A (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    intro p hp
    rw [hAdef]
    exact ⟨show -ε < Xb by linarith, hp.2⟩
  have hΦsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Ψ ∘ A) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
    hΨsm.comp hA.contDiffOn hmapA
  have hΦbd : ∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc 0 X₁ ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (Ψ ∘ A) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro X₁
    refine hcomp Ψ _ A hO hΨsm hA hmapA X₁ (fun i => ?_)
    refine (hΨbd Xb i).imp fun C hC z hz => hC (A z) ?_
    rw [hAdef]
    exact ⟨⟨hXb.le, le_rfl⟩, hz.2⟩
  
  obtain ⟨hHsm, hHbd, -⟩ := heatProfile_props h h0
    (fun β Z hβ hZ => heatK_deriv_bound β Z hβ hZ) (fun Z hZ => heatK_ode h Z h0 hZ)
  obtain ⟨hQsm', hQbd', -⟩ := heatQ_props h h0 hHsm hHbd
  obtain ⟨ι, hιdef⟩ : ∃ ι : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ι = fun p => 2 * (1 - p.2 ^ 2) / Xb := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hι : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ι := by rw [hιdef]; fun_prop
  have hmapι : MapsTo ι (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Ioi 0) := by
    intro p hp
    have h1 : -1 < p.2 := hp.2.1
    have h2 : p.2 < 1 := hp.2.2
    rw [hιdef]
    show 0 < 2 * (1 - p.2 ^ 2) / Xb
    apply div_pos _ hXb
    nlinarith
  have hQsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatQ h ∘ ι) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
    hQsm'.comp hι.contDiffOn hmapι
  have hQbd : ∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc 0 X₁ ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (heatQ h ∘ ι) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro X₁
    refine hcomp (heatQ h) (Ioi 0) ι isOpen_Ioi hQsm' hι hmapι X₁ (fun i => ?_)
    refine (hQbd' i).imp fun C hC z hz => ?_
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hC _ (hmapι (hSO X₁ hz))
  
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ : ∃ κ : ℝ, κ = -(cinf ^ 2 / 2) * Xb ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hH1 : ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → heatProfile h Z ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    intro Z hZ
    have hK := (heatK_deriv_bound h Z h0.le hZ).2
    have hG : 0 < Real.Gamma (1 + h) := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (by linarith)
    have hK' : |heatK h Z| ≤ Real.Gamma (1 + h) := by rw [add_comm 1 h]; exact hK
    have e : heatProfile h Z = (Real.Gamma (1 + h))⁻¹ * heatK h Z := rfl
    have habs : |heatProfile h Z| ≤ 1 := by
      rw [e, abs_mul, abs_inv, abs_of_pos hG, inv_mul_le_iff₀ hG, mul_one]
      exact hK'
    rw [sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one]
    exact habs
  have hcore : ∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      leadPi F X η = X * profRadAvg g X η - Xb * profRadAvg g Xb η +
        κ * heatQ h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / Xb) := by
    intro X η hX hη1 hη2
    have hfc : ContinuousOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi (-ε)) := by
      have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun x => F x η) (Ioi (-ε)) :=
        hFε.continuousOn.comp (Continuous.continuousOn (by fun_prop : Continuous fun x : ℝ => (x, η)))
          (fun x hx => ⟨hx, hη1, hη2⟩)
      exact h1.pow 2
    have hpt : ∀ s : ℝ, Xb ≤ s → F s η ^ 2 =
        cinf ^ 2 / 2 * (s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / s) ^ 2) := by
      intro s hs
      have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith
      have hFs := (hL6 s η hs hη1 hη2).2
      have hsq : Real.sqrt (2 * s) ^ 2 = 2 * s := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
      have hpw : s ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * s ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) = s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * s := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hs0, ← Real.rpow_add_one hs0.ne']; congr 1; ring
      have h2s : (2:ℝ) * s ≠ 0 := by positivity
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ h2s
      linear_combination (Real.sqrt (2 * s) * F s η +
          cinf * s ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / s)) * hFs -
        F s η ^ 2 * hsq + cinf ^ 2 * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / s) ^ 2 * hpw
    have hIb : IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi Xb) := by
      have hmaj : IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => cinf ^ 2 / 2 * s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h))) (Ioi Xb) :=
        Integrable.const_mul (integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) hXb) _
      refine Integrable.mono' hmaj
        ((hfc.mono (Ioi_subset_Ioi (by linarith))).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi) ?_
      refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi (fun s hs => ?_)
      have hs' : Xb < s := hs
      have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith
      have hsr : 0 ≤ s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hs0.le _
      have hZ : 0 < 2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / s := by
        apply div_pos _ hs0
        nlinarith
      have hH := hH1 _ hZ
      have hc : 0 ≤ cinf ^ 2 / 2 := by positivity
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _), hpt s hs'.le]
      calc cinf ^ 2 / 2 * (s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / s) ^ 2)
          ≤ cinf ^ 2 / 2 * (s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * 1) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hH hsr) hc
        _ = cinf ^ 2 / 2 * s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) := by ring
    have hTb : ∫ x in Ioi Xb, F x η ^ 2 =
        cinf ^ 2 / 2 * (Xb ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) * heatQ h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / Xb)) := by
      have e1 : ∫ x in Ioi Xb, F x η ^ 2 = ∫ x in Ioi Xb,
          cinf ^ 2 / 2 * (x ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) ^ 2) :=
        setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun s hs => hpt s (le_of_lt hs))
      rw [e1, integral_const_mul, heatPressure_integral_eq h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2)) Xb hXb]
    have hIX : IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi X) := by
      rcases le_or_gt Xb X with hle' | hlt
      · exact hIb.mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi hle')
      · rw [← Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hlt.le]
        refine IntegrableOn.union ?_ hIb
        have hc2 : ContinuousOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Icc X Xb) :=
          hfc.mono (fun x hx => show -ε < x by linarith [hx.1])
        exact hc2.integrableOn_Icc.mono_set Ioc_subset_Icc_self
    have hII : ∀ Y : ℝ, -ε < Y → IntervalIntegrable (fun x => F x η ^ 2) volume 0 Y := by
      intro Y hY
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      apply hfc.mono
      intro x hx
      rw [mem_uIcc] at hx
      show -ε < x
      rcases hx with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;> linarith
    have e2 := intervalIntegral.integral_interval_add_Ioi hIX hIb
    have e3 := intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hII Xb (by linarith)) (hII X hX)
    have e4 := (hSid X η hX hη1 hη2).1
    have e5 := (hSid Xb η (by linarith) hη1 hη2).1
    have e4' : profRadInt g X η = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, F x η ^ 2 := by rw [hg]; rfl
    have e5' : profRadInt g Xb η = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xb, F x η ^ 2 := by rw [hg]; rfl
    show -∫ x in Ioi X, F x η ^ 2 = X * profRadAvg g X η - Xb * profRadAvg g Xb η +
        κ * heatQ h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / Xb)
    rw [hκ]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨G, hGdef⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, G = (Ψ - Ψ ∘ A) + κ • (heatQ h ∘ ι) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hGsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    rw [hGdef]; exact (hΨsm.sub hΦsm).add (hQsm.const_smul κ)
  have hid : ∀ p ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, (↿(leadPi F)) p = G p := by
    intro p hp
    have hp1 : -ε < p.1 := hp.1
    have hp2 : -1 < p.2 := hp.2.1
    have hp3 : p.2 < 1 := hp.2.2
    rw [hGdef]
    show leadPi F p.1 p.2 = Ψ p - Ψ (A p) + κ • heatQ h (ι p)
    simp only [hΨ, hAdef, hιdef, smul_eq_mul]
    exact hcore p.1 p.2 hp1 hp2 hp3
  
  refine ⟨ε, hε, hGsm.congr hid, ?_⟩
  intro X₁ m
  obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hΨbd X₁ m
  obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := hΦbd X₁ m
  obtain ⟨C3, hC3⟩ := hQbd X₁ m
  refine ⟨C1 + C2 + |κ| * C3, fun X η hX0 hXX1 hη1 hη2 => ?_⟩
  have hz : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 X₁ ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨⟨hX0, hXX1⟩, hη1, hη2⟩
  have hzO := hSO X₁ hz
  have hnhds : Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ∈ nhds ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) := hO.mem_nhds hzO
  have hev : (↿(leadPi F)) =ᶠ[nhds ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ)] G := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hnhds hid
  rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
  have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ m Ψ (X, η) := (hΨsm.contDiffAt hnhds).of_le (hle m)
  have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ m (Ψ ∘ A) (X, η) := (hΦsm.contDiffAt hnhds).of_le (hle m)
  have h3 : ContDiffAt ℝ m (heatQ h ∘ ι) (X, η) := (hQsm.contDiffAt hnhds).of_le (hle m)
  have h12 : ContDiffAt ℝ m (Ψ - Ψ ∘ A) (X, η) := h1.sub h2
  have h3' : ContDiffAt ℝ m (κ • (heatQ h ∘ ι)) (X, η) := h3.const_smul κ
  rw [hGdef, iteratedFDeriv_add_apply h12 h3', iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply h1 h2,
    iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply h3]
  have b1 := hC1 _ hz
  have b2 := hC2 _ hz
  have b3 := hC3 _ hz
  calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Ψ (X, η) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (Ψ ∘ A) (X, η) +
        κ • iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (heatQ h ∘ ι) (X, η)‖
      ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Ψ (X, η) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (Ψ ∘ A) (X, η)‖ +
        ‖κ • iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (heatQ h ∘ ι) (X, η)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Ψ (X, η)‖ + ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (Ψ ∘ A) (X, η)‖) +
        |κ| * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (heatQ h ∘ ι) (X, η)‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          linarith [norm_sub_le (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Ψ (X, η)) (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (Ψ ∘ A) (X, η))]
    _ ≤ C1 + C2 + |κ| * C3 :=
          add_le_add (add_le_add b1 b2) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b3 (abs_nonneg κ))

subgoal_signatures.name: profRadAvg_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profRadAvg g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(profRadAvg g)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → X * profRadAvg g X η = profRadInt g X η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * profRadAvg g Y η) (g X η) X)

subgoal_signatures.name: iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {E F G H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] H) (f : E → F) (g : E → G) (O S : Set E), IsOpen O → S ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g O → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z‖ ≤ C) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g z‖ ≤ C) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) z‖ ≤ C

subgoal_signatures.name: heatK_deriv_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ β Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → 0 < Z → HasDerivAt (fun Y => heatK β Y) (-β * heatK (β + 1) Z) Z ∧ |heatK β Z| ≤ Real.Gamma (β + 1)

subgoal_signatures.name: heatK_ode
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h Z : ℝ, 0 < h → 0 < Z → (h + 1) * Z ^ 2 * heatK (h + 2) Z - (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * heatK (h + 1) Z + (1 + h) * heatK h Z = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: heatPressure_integral_eq
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h A S : ℝ, 0 < S → ∫ s in Ioi S, s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (A / s) ^ 2 = S ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) * heatQ h (A / S)

subgoal_signatures.name: heatProfile_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → (∀ β Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → 0 < Z → HasDerivAt (fun Y => heatK β Y) (-β * heatK (β + 1) Z) Z ∧ |heatK β Z| ≤ Real.Gamma (β + 1)) → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → (h + 1) * Z ^ 2 * heatK (h + 2) Z - (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * heatK (h + 1) Z + (1 + h) * heatK h Z = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv k (heatProfile h) Z| ≤ C) ∧ (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → Z ^ 2 * deriv (deriv (heatProfile h)) Z + (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * deriv (heatProfile h) Z + h * (1 + h) * heatProfile h Z = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: heatQ_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv k (heatProfile h) Z| ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatQ h) (Ioi 0) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → |iteratedDeriv k (heatQ h) Y| ≤ C) ∧ (∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → (1 + 2 * h) * heatQ h Y + Y * deriv (heatQ h) Y = heatProfile h Y ^ 2)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ici 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgAn h n g)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgBn h n g)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgPn h n g)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧ ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → divergence (fun y => bgBn h n g y t) x = 0

signature.name: bg_field_smooth_div
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ici 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgAn h n g)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgBn h n g)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgPn h n g)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧ ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → divergence (fun y => bgBn h n g y t) x = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h n g hS hg
  obtain ⟨SP1, SP2, -, SP4, -⟩ := hS
  have hΩo : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
  have p0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.1 0) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp contDiff_fst
  have p1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.1 1) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp contDiff_fst
  have p2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.1 2) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp contDiff_fst
  have hα : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2 : ℝ), 1 - w.2)) :=
    p2.prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd)
  have hQ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
    have := SP4.comp hα.contDiffOn (fun w (hw : w.2 < 1) =>
      (⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 by linarith⟩ : ((w.1 2 : ℝ), 1 - w.2) ∈ univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)))
    exact this
  have hQpos : ∀ w ∈ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1}, 0 < simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' : w.2 < 1 := hw
    exact (SP1 (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) (by linarith)).1
  have hprof : ∀ b : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
      simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ b * g (simX h w.1 w.2) (simEta h w.1 w.2))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
    intro b
    have hQb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ b)
        {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := hQ.rpow_const_of_ne (fun w hw => (hQpos w hw).ne')
    have hX : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simX h w.1 w.2) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
      have hnum : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2) :=
        (p0.pow 2).add (p1.pow 2)
      have := hnum.contDiffOn.div (contDiffOn_const.mul hQ)
        (fun w hw => mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (hQpos w hw).ne')
      exact this
    have hE : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simEta h w.1 w.2) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
      have := p2.contDiffOn.mul (hQ.rpow_const_of_ne (p := -(1 / 2 - h))
        (fun w hw => (hQpos w hw).ne'))
      exact this
    have hmaps : MapsTo (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (simX h w.1 w.2, simEta h w.1 w.2))
        {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} (Ici 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
      intro w hw
      have hw' : w.2 < 1 := hw
      have hq := hQpos w hw
      have hz := (SP2 (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) (by linarith)).2
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · show 0 ≤ simX h w.1 w.2
        unfold simX
        exact div_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity)
      · show simEta h w.1 w.2 ∈ Ioo (-1) 1
        unfold simEta
        have hr : 0 < simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _
        have hr2 : simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) *
            simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) *
            simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1 - 2 * h) = 1 := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hq, ← Real.rpow_add hq]
          have e : -(1 / 2 - h) + -(1 / 2 - h) + (1 - 2 * h) = (0:ℝ) := by ring
          rw [e, Real.rpow_zero]
        have key : (w.1 2 * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 < 1 := by
          have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hz (mul_pos hr hr)
          calc (w.1 2 * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2
              = w.1 2 ^ 2 * (simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) *
                  simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) := by ring
            _ < simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1 - 2 * h) *
                (simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) *
                  simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) := this
            _ = 1 := by rw [mul_comm]; exact hr2
        exact abs_lt.mp ((sq_lt_one_iff_abs_lt_one _).mp key)
    have hcomp := hg.comp (hX.prodMk hE) hmaps
    exact hQb.mul hcomp
  have hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
      -(w.1 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
        w.1 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) :=
    (p1.neg.smul contDiff_const).add (p0.smul contDiff_const)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine (((contDiffOn_const (c := (1 / 2 : ℝ))).mul
      (hprof (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h))).smul hJ.contDiffOn).congr (fun w _ => ?_)
    show ((1 / 2) * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) *
      g (simX h w.1 w.2) (simEta h w.1 w.2)) • azVec w.1 = _
    rw [mul_assoc]
    rfl
  · exact ((hprof (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h)).smul hJ.contDiffOn).congr (fun w _ => rfl)
  · exact (hprof (-(1 + 2 * h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h)).congr (fun w _ => rfl)
  · intro x t ht
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ : ∃ φ : ℝ³ → ℝ, φ = fun y =>
        simScale h (y 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * g (simX h y t) (simEta h y t) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hfun : (fun y => bgBn h n g y t) = fun y => φ y •
        (-(y 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
          y 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) := by
      rw [hφ]; rfl
    have hmem : ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := ht
    have hca := ((hprof (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h)).contDiffAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hmem)).comp x
      ((contDiff_id.prodMk (contDiff_const (c := t))).contDiffAt)
    have hφd : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ x := by
      rw [hφ]
      exact hca.differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have hinv : ∀ y : ℝ³, y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → y 2 = x 2 → φ y = φ x := by
      intro y hy hy2
      rw [hφ]
      simp only [simX, simEta]
      rw [hy, hy2]
    have hsmul : ∀ (ψ : ℝ³ → ℝ) (V : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (x : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ x →
        DifferentiableAt ℝ V x →
        divergence (fun y => ψ y • V y) x = ψ x * divergence V x + fderiv ℝ ψ x (V x) := by
      intro ψ V x hψ hV
      rw [divergence, fderiv_fun_smul hψ hV, ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_add,
        ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_smul, map_add, map_smul, divergence, smul_eq_mul]
      congr 1
      have h : ((fderiv ℝ ψ x).smulRight (V x) : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ³) =
          (fderiv ℝ ψ x : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (V x) := rfl
      rw [h, LinearMap.trace_smulRight]
      rfl
    rw [hfun]
    have c00 : (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) 0 = 1 := by simp
    have c01 : (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) 1 = 0 := by simp
    have c02 : (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) 2 = 0 := by simp
    have c10 : (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) 0 = 0 := by simp
    have c11 : (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) 1 = 1 := by simp
    have c12 : (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) 2 = 0 := by simp
    generalize EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) = e0 at c00 c01 c02 ⊢
    generalize EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) = e1 at c10 c11 c12 ⊢
    have h0 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => y 0) (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) x :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => y 1) (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) x :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
    have hn1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => -(y 1))
        (-(EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)) x := h1.neg
    have hJd0 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => -(y 1) • e0)
        ((-(EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)).smulRight e0) x :=
      hn1.smul_const e0
    have hJd1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => y 0 • e1)
        ((EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight e1) x :=
      h0.smul_const e1
    have hJx : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => -(y 1) • e0 + y 0 • e1) x :=
      (hJd0.add hJd1).differentiableAt
    have hdivJ : divergence (fun y : ℝ³ => -(y 1) • e0 + y 0 • e1) x = 0 := by
      rw [divergence_add hJd0.differentiableAt hJd1.differentiableAt]
      have k1 := hsmul (fun y : ℝ³ => -(y 1)) (fun _ => e0) x hn1.differentiableAt
        (differentiableAt_const _)
      have k2 := hsmul (fun y : ℝ³ => y 0) (fun _ => e1) x h0.differentiableAt
        (differentiableAt_const _)
      rw [k1, k2, hn1.fderiv, h0.fderiv]
      simp [c01, c10]
    
    have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun θ : ℝ => x + ((Real.cos θ - 1) • (x 0 • e0 + x 1 • e1) +
        Real.sin θ • (-(x 1) • e0 + x 0 • e1))) (-(x 1) • e0 + x 0 • e1) 0 := by
      have k1 := ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos 0).sub_const 1).smul_const (x 0 • e0 + x 1 • e1)
      have k2 := (Real.hasDerivAt_sin 0).smul_const (-(x 1) • e0 + x 0 • e1)
      have k3 := (k1.add k2).const_add x
      convert k3 using 1
      simp
    have hγ0 : (fun θ : ℝ => x + ((Real.cos θ - 1) • (x 0 • e0 + x 1 • e1) +
        Real.sin θ • (-(x 1) • e0 + x 0 • e1))) 0 = x := by
      simp
    have hl : HasFDerivAt φ (fderiv ℝ φ x)
        ((fun θ : ℝ => x + ((Real.cos θ - 1) • (x 0 • e0 + x 1 • e1) +
          Real.sin θ • (-(x 1) • e0 + x 0 • e1))) 0) := by
      rw [hγ0]; exact hφd.hasFDerivAt
    have hc := hl.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ) hγ
    have hconst : (φ ∘ fun θ : ℝ => x + ((Real.cos θ - 1) • (x 0 • e0 + x 1 • e1) +
        Real.sin θ • (-(x 1) • e0 + x 0 • e1))) = fun _ => φ x := by
      funext θ
      simp only [Function.comp]
      apply hinv
      · have a0 : (x + ((Real.cos θ - 1) • (x 0 • e0 + x 1 • e1) +
            Real.sin θ • (-(x 1) • e0 + x 0 • e1))) 0 =
            Real.cos θ * x 0 - Real.sin θ * x 1 := by
          simp [c00, c10]; ring
        have a1 : (x + ((Real.cos θ - 1) • (x 0 • e0 + x 1 • e1) +
            Real.sin θ • (-(x 1) • e0 + x 0 • e1))) 1 =
            Real.cos θ * x 1 + Real.sin θ * x 0 := by
          simp [c01, c11]; ring
        rw [a0, a1]
        have hsc := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ
        calc (Real.cos θ * x 0 - Real.sin θ * x 1) ^ 2 + (Real.cos θ * x 1 + Real.sin θ * x 0) ^ 2
            = (Real.sin θ ^ 2 + Real.cos θ ^ 2) * (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) := by ring
          _ = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := by rw [hsc, one_mul]
      · simp [c02, c12]
    rw [hconst] at hc
    have hzero : fderiv ℝ φ x (-(x 1) • e0 + x 0 • e1) = 0 :=
      hc.unique (hasDerivAt_const (0:ℝ) (φ x))
    rw [hsmul _ _ x hφd hJx, hdivJ, hzero]
    simp

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h ε : ℝ) (U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → (curl3 (fun w => bgAn h 0 (profRadAvg U) w t) x) 2 = simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * U (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) ∧ inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => bgAn h 0 (profRadAvg U) w t) x) (radVec x) = leadV h U (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) ∧ inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => bgAn h 0 (profRadAvg U) w t) x) (azVec x) = (0 : ℝ)

signature.name: bg_curl_order_zero
signature.statement: ∀ (h ε : ℝ) (U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → (curl3 (fun w => bgAn h 0 (profRadAvg U) w t) x) 2 = simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * U (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) ∧ inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => bgAn h 0 (profRadAvg U) w t) x) (radVec x) = leadV h U (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) ∧ inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => bgAn h 0 (profRadAvg U) w t) x) (azVec x) = (0 : ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h ε U hS h0 hh hε hU x t ht hr
  obtain ⟨hSsm, -, hSder⟩ := profRadAvg_props U ε hε hU
  have hτ : (0:ℝ) < 1 - t := by linarith
  
  have hP : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => y i) (EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) x := by
    intro i
    have := (EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt (x := x)
    exact this
  
  have s3 : ∀ (σ : ℝ³ → ℝ) (σ' : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ), HasFDerivAt σ σ' x →
      curl3 (fun y => σ y • azVec y) x =
        (-(x 0) * σ' (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1)) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
        (-(x 1) * σ' (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1)) • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
        (2 * σ x + x 0 * σ' (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) + x 1 * σ' (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1)) •
          EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) := by
    intro σ σ' hσ
    have h1 := ((hP 1).neg).smul_const (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))
    have h0 := (hP 0).smul_const (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))
    have hA := (h1.add h0).congr_of_eventuallyEq (f₁ := azVec)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => by simp [azVec])
    have hF := hσ.fun_smul hA
    unfold curl3
    rw [hF.fderiv]
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [azVec] <;> ring
  
  have hQpos : 0 < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) := (hS.1 (x 2) (1 - t) hτ).1
  have hQne : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≠ 0 := hQpos.ne'
  have hQd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => simScale h z (1 - t)) (x 2) := by
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (x 2, 1 - t) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt (prod_mem_nhds Filter.univ_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hτ))
    have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ => ((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ)) (x 2) :=
      (contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt
    exact (h1.comp (x 2) h2).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨Q', hQh⟩ : ∃ Q', HasDerivAt (fun z => simScale h z (1 - t)) Q' (x 2) :=
    ⟨_, hQd.hasDerivAt⟩
  have hphi := hQh.sub ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 (x 2)).mul (hQh.rpow_const (p := 2 * h) (Or.inl hQne)))
  have hconst : ((fun z => simScale h z (1 - t)) - (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2) *
      fun z => simScale h z (1 - t) ^ (2 * h)) = fun _ => 1 - t := by
    funext z; simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply]; exact (hS.1 z (1 - t) hτ).2
  rw [hconst] at hphi
  have hrel := hphi.unique (hasDerivAt_const (x 2) (1 - t))
  have hz2 := (hS.2.1 (x 2) (1 - t) hτ).2
  
  have hpos_p : 0 < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQpos _
  have hR4 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h - 1) = (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hQpos.le]
    congr 1; push_cast; ring
  have hR5 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h) =
      simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) * (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 := by
    have e : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h) =
        simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (1:ℝ) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h - 1) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hQpos]; congr 1; ring
    rw [e, Real.rpow_one, hR4]
  have hprod : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (1 - 2 * h) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h - 1) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hQpos, show 1 - 2 * h + (2 * h - 1) = (0:ℝ) by ring, Real.rpow_zero]
  have hmp : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) *
      (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) = 1 := by
    have e1 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) =
        simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 1) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_add hQpos, Real.rpow_one]
    rw [← mul_assoc, e1, ← Real.rpow_add hQpos,
      show -(1 / 2 + h) + 1 + -(1 / 2 - h) = (0:ℝ) by ring, Real.rpow_zero]
  
  have heta2 : (simEta h x t) ^ 2 < 1 := by
    have : (simEta h x t) ^ 2 = x 2 ^ 2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h - 1) := by
      rw [hR4]; unfold simEta; ring
    rw [this]
    calc x 2 ^ 2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h - 1)
        < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (1 - 2 * h) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h - 1) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hz2 (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQpos _)
      _ = 1 := hprod
  have heta_abs : |simEta h x t| < 1 := (sq_lt_one_iff_abs_lt_one _).mp heta2
  have hX0 : 0 < simX h x t := by unfold simX; positivity
  have hmem : (simX h x t, simEta h x t) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
    ⟨show -ε < simX h x t by linarith, (abs_lt.mp heta_abs).1, (abs_lt.mp heta_abs).2⟩
  have hGd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿(profRadAvg U)) (simX h x t, simEta h x t) :=
    (hSsm.contDiffAt ((isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo).mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨G', hG⟩ : ∃ G', HasFDerivAt (↿(profRadAvg U)) G' (simX h x t, simEta h x t) :=
    ⟨_, hGd.hasFDerivAt⟩
  have hGab : ∀ a b : ℝ, G' (a, b) = a * G' (1, 0) + b * G' (0, 1) := by
    intro a b
    have : ((a, b) : ℝ × ℝ) = a • ((1, 0) : ℝ × ℝ) + b • ((0, 1) : ℝ × ℝ) := by
      ext <;> simp
    rw [this, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hgX : HasDerivAt (fun Y => profRadAvg U Y (simEta h x t)) (G' (1, 0)) (simX h x t) := by
    have hl : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, simEta h x t)) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) (simX h x t) :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' _).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const _ _)
    have := hG.comp_hasDerivAt (simX h x t) hl
    exact this
  have hgE : HasDerivAt (fun e => profRadAvg U (simX h x t) e) (G' (0, 1)) (simEta h x t) := by
    have hl : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => (simX h x t, e)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) (simEta h x t) :=
      (hasDerivAt_const _ _).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' _)
    have := hG.comp_hasDerivAt (simEta h x t) hl
    exact this
  have hEtaD : profEtaD (profRadAvg U) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) = G' (0, 1) := by
    unfold profEtaD; exact hgE.deriv
  
  have hUid : U (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) =
      profRadAvg U (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) + simX h x t * G' (1, 0) := by
    have h1 := (hSder (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) (by linarith) (abs_lt.mp heta_abs).1
      (abs_lt.mp heta_abs).2).2
    have h2 := (hasDerivAt_id' (simX h x t)).mul hgX
    have := h1.unique h2
    rw [this]; ring
  
  have hQf : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => simScale h (y 2) (1 - t))
      (Q' • (EuclideanSpace.proj 2 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)) x := by
    have := HasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt (h₂ := fun z => simScale h z (1 - t)) x hQh (hP 2)
    exact this
  have hm := hQf.rpow_const (p := -(1 / 2 + h)) (Or.inl hQne)
  have hp := hQf.rpow_const (p := -(1 / 2 - h)) (Or.inl hQne)
  have hr2 := ((hP 0).pow 2).add ((hP 1).pow 2)
  have hinv := HasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt (h₂ := fun y : ℝ => y⁻¹) x
    (hasDerivAt_inv (by positivity : (2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) ≠ 0)) (hQf.const_mul 2)
  have hX := (hr2.mul hinv).congr_of_eventuallyEq (f₁ := fun y : ℝ³ => simX h y t)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => by simp [simX, div_eq_mul_inv])
  have hEta := ((hP 2).mul hp).congr_of_eventuallyEq (f₁ := fun y : ℝ³ => simEta h y t)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => by simp [simEta])
  have hSc := hG.comp x (hX.prodMk hEta)
  have hσ := (hm.const_mul (1 / 2)).mul hSc
  have hfun : (fun w => bgAn h 0 (profRadAvg U) w t) =
      fun w => (((fun y : ℝ³ => 1 / 2 * simScale h (y 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) *
        (↿(profRadAvg U) ∘ fun y : ℝ³ => (simX h y t, simEta h y t))) w) • azVec w := by
    funext w
    simp only [bgAn, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
    rfl
  rw [hfun]
  obtain ⟨g1, hg1⟩ : ∃ g, G' (1, 0) = g := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨g2, hg2⟩ : ∃ g, G' (0, 1) = g := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hGe : G' = g1 • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ + g2 • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ := by
    ext <;> simp [← hg1, ← hg2]
  rw [hg1] at hUid
  rw [hg2] at hEtaD
  have hm1 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) - 1) =
      simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) / simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) := Real.rpow_sub_one hQne _
  have hp1 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h) - 1) =
      simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) / simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) := Real.rpow_sub_one hQne _
  have hinvx : ((fun y : ℝ => y⁻¹) ∘ fun y : ℝ³ => 2 * simScale h (y 2) (1 - t)) x =
      (2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t))⁻¹ := rfl
  have hr2x : ((fun y : ℝ³ => y 0 ^ 2) + fun y : ℝ³ => y 1 ^ 2) x = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := rfl
  have hSx : (↿(profRadAvg U) ∘ fun y : ℝ³ => (simX h y t, simEta h y t)) x =
      profRadAvg U (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) := rfl
  rw [hm1, hp1, hinvx, hr2x, hSx, hGe] at hσ
  have hσx : ((fun y : ℝ³ => 1 / 2 * simScale h (y 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) *
        (↿(profRadAvg U) ∘ fun y : ℝ³ => (simX h y t, simEta h y t))) x =
      1 / 2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * profRadAvg U (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) := rfl
  have hXdef : simX h x t = (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) / (2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) := rfl
  have hEdef : simEta h x t = x 2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) := rfl
  have hL : 0 < 1 - 2 * h * (x 2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 := by
    have h1 := heta2
    rw [hEdef] at h1
    have h2 : 0 ≤ (1 - 2 * h) * (x 2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _)
    nlinarith
  
  rw [s3 _ _ hσ]
  simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, radVec, azVec, leadV, hEtaD, hUid, hσx]
  rw [hR4, hR5] at hrel
  generalize profRadAvg U (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) = S at *
  simp only [hXdef, hEdef]
  generalize simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) = m at hmp ⊢
  generalize simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) = p at hmp hrel hL hpos_p ⊢
  generalize simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) = Q at hmp hrel hL hQpos hQne ⊢
  have hpne : p ≠ 0 := hpos_p.ne'
  have hLne : 1 - 2 * h * (x 2 * p) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := hL.ne'
  have hm' : m = (Q * p)⁻¹ := eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left hmp
  have hQ' : Q' = 2 * x 2 * Q * p ^ 2 / (1 - 2 * h * (x 2 * p) ^ 2) := by
    rw [eq_div_iff hLne]
    simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at hrel
    norm_num at hrel
    linear_combination hrel
  subst hm' hQ'
  simp
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · field_simp
    ring
  · have hL2 : 1 - p ^ 2 * x 2 ^ 2 * h * 2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hc; apply hLne; linear_combination hc
    field_simp
    ring_nf
    field_simp
    ring
  · ring

subgoal_signatures.name: profRadAvg_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profRadAvg g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(profRadAvg g)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → X * profRadAvg g X η = profRadInt g X η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * profRadAvg g Y η) (g X η) X)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → 2 * Xb * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → bgAn h 0 (profRadAvg U) x t = 0 ∧ bgBn h 0 F x t = heatSwirl h (2 ^ (1 / 2 + h) * cinf) x t ∧ bgPn h 0 (leadPi F) x t = heatPressure h (2 ^ (1 / 2 + h) * cinf) x t

signature.name: bg_exterior_order_zero
signature.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → 2 * Xb * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → bgAn h 0 (profRadAvg U) x t = 0 ∧ bgBn h 0 F x t = heatSwirl h (2 ^ (1 / 2 + h) * cinf) x t ∧ bgPn h 0 (leadPi F) x t = heatPressure h (2 ^ (1 / 2 + h) * cinf) x t

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z hS hL x t ht hext
  obtain ⟨⟨h0, -, -, hcinf, -, -, -, hXa, hXap1, hp12, hp2m1, hm12, hm2Xv, hXvXc, hXcXb⟩,
    -, -, -, -, -, hL6, hL7, -, -, -⟩ := hL
  have hXb0 : 0 < Xb := by linarith
  have hXvXb : Xv < Xb := by linarith
  have hτ : 0 < 1 - t := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hq, hSP1⟩ := hS.1 (x 2) (1 - t) hτ
  obtain ⟨-, hSP2⟩ := hS.2.1 (x 2) (1 - t) hτ
  have hXv : simX h x t = (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) / (2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) := rfl
  have hηv : simEta h x t = x 2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) := rfl
  simp only [bgAn, bgBn, bgPn, heatSwirl, heatPressure, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
  set q := simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) with hqd
  set X := simX h x t with hXd
  set η := simEta h x t with hηd
  set r2 := x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 with hr2d
  have hqne : q ≠ 0 := hq.ne'
  
  have hr2pos : 0 < r2 := by
    have := mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2) hXb0) hq
    linarith
  have h2q : 0 < 2 * q := by linarith
  have h2qX : 2 * q * X = r2 := by rw [hXv]; field_simp
  have hXgt : Xb < X := by
    rw [hXv, lt_div_iff₀ h2q]
    linarith
  have hX0 : 0 < X := by linarith
  have hee : q ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) * q ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) = q ^ (2 * h - 1) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hq, show -(1 / 2 - h) + -(1 / 2 - h) = 2 * h - 1 by ring]
  have hq2h : q ^ (2 * h) = q ^ (2 * h - 1) * q := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add_one hqne, show 2 * h - 1 + 1 = 2 * h by ring]
  have hinv : q ^ (1 - 2 * h) * q ^ (2 * h - 1) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hq, show 1 - 2 * h + (2 * h - 1) = 0 by ring, Real.rpow_zero]
  have hη2 : η ^ 2 = x 2 ^ 2 * q ^ (2 * h - 1) := by rw [hηv, ← hee]; ring
  have hqdd : q * (1 - η ^ 2) = 1 - t := by
    rw [hη2]; linear_combination hSP1 + x 2 ^ 2 * hq2h
  have hηsq : η ^ 2 < 1 := by
    rw [hη2]
    have hP : 0 < q ^ (2 * h - 1) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _
    have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hSP2 hP
    linarith [hinv]
  have hη1 : -1 < η := by nlinarith
  have hη1' : η < 1 := by nlinarith
  have hPI : ∀ A S : ℝ, 0 < S → ∫ s in Ioi S, s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (A / s) ^ 2 =
      S ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) * heatQ h (A / S) := by
    intro A S hS
    have hSne : S ≠ 0 := hS.ne'
    have hc : ∫ w in Ioi (1:ℝ), (S * w) ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (A / (S * w)) ^ 2 =
        S⁻¹ * ∫ s in Ioi S, s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (A / s) ^ 2 := by
      have := MeasureTheory.integral_comp_mul_left_Ioi
        (fun s => s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (A / s) ^ 2) 1 hS
      rw [mul_one, smul_eq_mul] at this
      exact this
    have hc2 : ∫ w in Ioi (1:ℝ), (S * w) ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (A / (S * w)) ^ 2 =
        ∫ w in Ioi (1:ℝ), S ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * (w ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (A / S / w) ^ 2) := by
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun w hw => ?_)
      have hw0 : (0:ℝ) < w := lt_trans one_pos hw
      rw [Real.mul_rpow hS.le hw0.le, div_div]
      ring
    rw [hc2, integral_const_mul] at hc
    have hSS : S ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) = S * S ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) := by
      rw [show -(1 + 2 * h) = 1 + -(2 + 2 * h) by ring, Real.rpow_add hS, Real.rpow_one]
    rw [hSS, show heatQ h (A / S) =
      ∫ w in Ioi (1:ℝ), w ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (A / S / w) ^ 2 from rfl]
    have hSi : S * S⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hSne
    linear_combination (-S) * hc -
      (∫ s in Ioi S, s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (A / s) ^ 2) * hSi
  have harg : 2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X = 4 * (1 - t) / r2 := by
    rw [div_eq_div_iff hX0.ne' hr2pos.ne']
    linear_combination (-2 * (1 - η ^ 2)) * h2qX + 4 * X * hqdd
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have hS0 : profRadAvg U X η = 0 := by
      have h7 := (hL7 X η (by linarith) hη1 hη1').2
      have hc := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right (fun y => U y η) hX0.ne' (a := 0) (b := 1)
      simp only [zero_mul, one_mul] at hc
      show (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, U (s * X) η) = 0
      rw [hc]
      show X⁻¹ • profRadInt U X η = 0
      rw [h7, smul_zero]
    rw [hS0, mul_zero, zero_smul]
  · 
    rw [show (-(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
        x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) = azVec x from rfl]
    congr 1
    have hF := (hL6 X η hXgt.le hη1 hη1').2
    rw [harg] at hF
    have hs : Real.sqrt (2 * X) = (2:ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * X ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) hX0.le]
    have hXs : X ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) = X ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * X ^ (-(1 + h)) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hX0]; congr 1; ring
    have hr2p : r2 ^ (-(1 + h)) = (2:ℝ) ^ (-(1 + h)) * q ^ (-(1 + h)) * X ^ (-(1 + h)) := by
      rw [← h2qX, Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) hX0.le, Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) hq.le]
    have hpow2 : (2:ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 + h) * (2:ℝ) ^ (-(1 + h)) * (2:ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2), ← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2),
        show 1 / 2 + h + -(1 + h) + 1 / 2 = (0:ℝ) by ring, Real.rpow_zero]
    rw [hs, hXs] at hF
    rw [hr2p]
    have hne : (2:ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * X ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hne
    linear_combination q ^ (-(1 + h)) * hF -
      (cinf * q ^ (-(1 + h)) * X ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * X ^ (-(1 + h)) *
        heatProfile h (4 * (1 - t) / r2)) * hpow2
  · 
    have hint : ∫ s in Ioi X, F s η ^ 2 = ∫ s in Ioi X,
        cinf ^ 2 / 2 * (s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / s) ^ 2) := by
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun s hs => ?_)
      have hs' : X < s := hs
      have hs0 : 0 < s := lt_trans hX0 hs'
      have hFs := (hL6 s η (by linarith) hη1 hη1').2
      have hsq : Real.sqrt (2 * s) ^ 2 = 2 * s := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
      have hpw : s ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * s ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) = s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * s := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hs0, ← Real.rpow_add_one hs0.ne']; congr 1; ring
      have h2s : (2:ℝ) * s ≠ 0 := by positivity
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ h2s
      linear_combination (Real.sqrt (2 * s) * F s η +
          cinf * s ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / s)) * hFs -
        F s η ^ 2 * hsq + cinf ^ 2 * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / s) ^ 2 * hpw
    rw [integral_const_mul, hPI (2 * (1 - η ^ 2)) X hX0, harg] at hint
    rw [hPI (4 * (1 - t)) r2 hr2pos]
    rw [show leadPi F X η = -∫ s in Ioi X, F s η ^ 2 from rfl, hint]
    have hr2p : r2 ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) =
        (2:ℝ) ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) * q ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) * X ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) := by
      rw [← h2qX, Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) hX0.le, Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) hq.le]
    have hpow3 : (2:ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 + h) * (2:ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 + h) * (2:ℝ) ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2), ← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2),
        show 1 / 2 + h + (1 / 2 + h) + -(1 + 2 * h) = (0:ℝ) by ring, Real.rpow_zero]
    rw [hr2p]
    linear_combination (cinf ^ 2 / 2 * q ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) * X ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) *
      heatQ h (4 * (1 - t) / r2)) * hpow3

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h ε M : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < ε → 0 < M → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≤ 1 → x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 ≤ M * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgAn h n g)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgBn h n g)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgPn h n g)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K)

signature.name: bg_field_interior_bounds

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h ε M n g hS h0 hh2 hε hM hg hgb m
  
  obtain ⟨Ω, hΩ⟩ : ∃ Ω : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ), Ω = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hSd⟩ : ∃ S : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ), S = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1 ∧
      simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 ∧
      w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ M * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ Q : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ, Q = fun w => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ : ∃ Φ : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ, Φ = fun z => (simX h z.1 z.2, simEta h z.1 z.2) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
