subgoal_signatures.name: wt_bilinear_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {E F G H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] H) (f : E → F) (g : E → G) (ρ : E → ℝ) (Ω S : Set E), IsOpen Ω → S ⊆ Ω → (∀ w ∈ S, 0 < ρ w ∧ ρ w ≤ 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g Ω → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) Ω ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)

subgoal_signatures.name: wt_comp_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {E F G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (g : F → G) (f : E → F) (ρ : E → ℝ) (Ω S : Set E) (T : Set F), IsOpen Ω → IsOpen T → S ⊆ Ω → MapsTo f Ω T → (∀ w ∈ S, 0 < ρ w ∧ ρ w ≤ 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g T → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (f w)‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (g ∘ f) Ω ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (g ∘ f) w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)

subgoal_signatures.name: ball_iteratedFDeriv_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (p : ℝ³ × ℝ → F), ContDiff ℝ ∞ p → ∀ (B : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, ‖w‖ ≤ B → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k p w‖ ≤ C

subgoal_signatures.name: bg_interior_region_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h M : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < M → ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → (0 < simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ∧ 0 ≤ simX h w.1 w.2 ∧ -1 < simEta h w.1 w.2 ∧ simEta h w.1 w.2 < 1) ∧ (simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 → w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ M * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) → ‖w‖ ≤ M + 1 ∧ simX h w.1 w.2 ≤ M / 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: simScale_rpow_wt_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h p : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ p) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ p) w‖ ≤ C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K)

subgoal_signatures.name: simXEta_wt_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h M : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < M → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (simX h z.1 z.2, simEta h z.1 z.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 → w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ M * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (simX h z.1 z.2, simEta h z.1 z.2)) w‖ ≤ C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K)

    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : (ℝ³ × ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (ℝ³ × ℝ), ∀ w, L w = (lam • w.1, lam ^ 2 * w.2) :=
      ⟨(LinearEquiv.smulOfNeZero ℝ ℝ³ lam hlam.ne').toContinuousLinearEquiv.prodCongr
        (LinearEquiv.smulOfNeZero ℝ ℝ (lam ^ 2) hl2).toContinuousLinearEquiv, fun w => rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ³ × ℝ, b = ((0 : ℝ³), 1 - lam ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hΦ : ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, ((lam • w.1, 1 - lam ^ 2 * (1 - w.2)) : ℝ³ × ℝ) = L w + b := by
      intro w
      rw [hL, hb]
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_ <;> simp <;> ring
    have hcomp : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => f (lam • w.1, 1 - lam ^ 2 * (1 - w.2))) z =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (L z + b)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => (L : (ℝ³ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ³ × ℝ))) := by
      have e1 : (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => f (lam • w.1, 1 - lam ^ 2 * (1 - w.2))) =
          (fun y => f (y + b)) ∘ L := by
        funext w
        show f (lam • w.1, 1 - lam ^ 2 * (1 - w.2)) = f (L w + b)
        rw [hΦ]
      rw [e1]
      have := L.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right (fun y => f (y + b)) uniqueDiffOn_univ (mem_univ (L z)) m
      rw [Set.preimage_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ] at this
      rw [this, iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right]
    have hsm : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => f (lam • w.1, 1 - lam ^ 2 * (1 - w.2))) z =
        lam ^ (-a) • iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z := by
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
      exact iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply' hf
    have hLn : ‖(L : (ℝ³ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ³ × ℝ))‖ ≤ max lam (lam ^ 2) := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (le_max_of_le_left hlam.le)
      intro w
      have h1 : ‖w.1‖ ≤ ‖w‖ := norm_fst_le w
      have h2 : ‖w.2‖ ≤ ‖w‖ := norm_snd_le w
      have hw : (L : (ℝ³ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ³ × ℝ)) w = (lam • w.1, lam ^ 2 * w.2) := hL w
      rw [hw, Prod.norm_def]
      show max ‖lam • w.1‖ ‖lam ^ 2 * w.2‖ ≤ _
      apply max_le
      · rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hlam]
        exact mul_le_mul (le_max_left _ _) h1 (norm_nonneg _) (le_max_of_le_left hlam.le)
      · rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < lam ^ 2)]
        exact mul_le_mul (le_max_right _ _) h2 (norm_nonneg _) (le_max_of_le_left hlam.le)
    have key : lam ^ (-a) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z‖ ≤
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (L z + b)‖ * (max lam (lam ^ 2)) ^ m := by
      have e := hsm.symm.trans hcomp
      have hn := congrArg norm e
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hlam _)] at hn
      rw [hn]
      refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
      simp only [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hLn m) (norm_nonneg _)
    rw [hΦ z]
    have hpa : 0 < lam ^ a := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hlam a
    have hinv : lam ^ a * lam ^ (-a) = 1 := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hlam]; simp
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z‖ = lam ^ a * (lam ^ (-a) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z‖) := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, hinv, one_mul]
      _ ≤ lam ^ a * (‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (L z + b)‖ * (max lam (lam ^ 2)) ^ m) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left key hpa.le
      _ = _ := by ring
  
  have hwt : ∀ (a K R ρ lam : ℝ), 0 < a → a + 2 * (m : ℝ) ≤ 2 * K → 0 < R → 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ 1 →
      0 < lam → lam ^ 2 = ρ / R → lam ^ a * (max lam (lam ^ 2)) ^ m ≤ 1 + R ^ (-K) := by
    intro a K R ρ lam ha haK hR hρ hρ1 hlam hl2
    have hRK : 0 ≤ R ^ (-K) := Real.rpow_nonneg hR.le _
    rcases le_or_gt lam 1 with hl | hl
    · have hmax : max lam (lam ^ 2) = lam := max_eq_left (by nlinarith)
      rw [hmax]
      have h1 : lam ^ a ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one hlam.le hl ha.le
      have h2 : lam ^ m ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hlam.le hl
      have h3 : lam ^ a * lam ^ m ≤ 1 := by
        calc lam ^ a * lam ^ m ≤ 1 * 1 :=
              mul_le_mul h1 h2 (pow_nonneg hlam.le m) zero_le_one
          _ = 1 := by ring
      linarith
    · have hmax : max lam (lam ^ 2) = lam ^ 2 := max_eq_right (by nlinarith)
      rw [hmax]
      have hK : 0 < K := by have : (0:ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.cast_nonneg m; linarith
      have e1 : (lam ^ 2) ^ m = lam ^ (2 * (m : ℝ)) := by
        rw [← pow_mul, ← Real.rpow_natCast]; norm_num
      rw [e1, ← Real.rpow_add hlam]
      have e2 : lam ^ (a + 2 * (m:ℝ)) ≤ lam ^ (2 * K) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hl.le haK
      have e3 : lam ^ (2 * K) = ρ ^ K * R ^ (-K) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_mul hlam.le, show lam ^ (2:ℝ) = ρ / R by rw [Real.rpow_two]; exact hl2,
          Real.div_rpow hρ.le hR.le, Real.rpow_neg hR.le, div_eq_mul_inv]
      have e4 : ρ ^ K ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one hρ.le hρ1 hK.le
      have e5 : ρ ^ K * R ^ (-K) ≤ R ^ (-K) := by
        calc ρ ^ K * R ^ (-K) ≤ 1 * R ^ (-K) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right e4 hRK
          _ = R ^ (-K) := one_mul _
      linarith
  
  obtain ⟨hSs, hPs, -, hBox⟩ := hH
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρdef⟩ : ∃ ρ : ℝ, ρ = min 1 M := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hρ0 : 0 < ρ := by rw [hρdef]; exact lt_min one_pos hM
  have hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1 := by rw [hρdef]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hρM : ρ ≤ M := by rw [hρdef]; exact min_le_right _ _
  have hr0 : 0 < Real.sqrt ρ := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hρ0
  have hr0sq : Real.sqrt ρ ^ 2 = ρ := Real.sq_sqrt hρ0.le
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hBox (Real.sqrt ρ) hr0 m
  have hcR : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2) := by fun_prop
  have hV : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2} :=
    isOpen_lt continuous_const hcR
  have hU : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ∧ w.2 < 1} :=
    hV.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const)
  refine ⟨max C₀ 0, 1 + 2 * h + m, by have : (0:ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.cast_nonneg m; linarith, ?_⟩
  intro x t ht hR
  have hτ : 0 < 1 - t := by linarith
  have hRpos : 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := lt_trans (mul_pos hM hτ) hR
  obtain ⟨lam, hlamdef⟩ : ∃ lam : ℝ, lam = Real.sqrt (ρ / (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hlam : 0 < lam := by rw [hlamdef]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (div_pos hρ0 hRpos)
  have hl2 : lam ^ 2 = ρ / (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) := by
    rw [hlamdef]; exact Real.sq_sqrt (div_pos hρ0 hRpos).le
  have hrad : (lam • x) 0 ^ 2 + (lam • x) 1 ^ 2 = ρ := by
    have e0 : (lam • x) 0 = lam * x 0 := by simp
    have e1 : (lam • x) 1 = lam * x 1 := by simp
    rw [e0, e1, show (lam * x 0) ^ 2 + (lam * x 1) ^ 2 = lam ^ 2 * (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) by ring, hl2]
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hRpos.ne'
  have ht1 : 0 < 1 - lam ^ 2 * (1 - t) := by
    rw [hl2]
    have : ρ * (1 - t) < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hρM hτ.le) hR
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, sub_pos, div_lt_one hRpos]
    exact this
  have ht2 : 1 - lam ^ 2 * (1 - t) < 1 := by
    have : 0 < lam ^ 2 * (1 - t) := by positivity
    linarith
  obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := hC₀ (lam • x) (1 - lam ^ 2 * (1 - t)) (le_of_eq (by rw [hrad, hr0sq]))
    (by rw [hrad]; exact hρ1) ht1 ht2
  have hz : ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ∧ w.2 < 1} := ⟨hRpos, ht⟩
  have hmle : ((m : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hcdS : ContDiffAt ℝ m (↿(heatSwirl h c)) (x, t) :=
    (hSs.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)).of_le hmle
  have hcdP : ContDiffAt ℝ m (↿(heatPressure h c)) (x, t) :=
    (hPs.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)).of_le hmle
  have hevS : (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (↿(heatSwirl h c)) (lam • w.1, 1 - lam ^ 2 * (1 - w.2))) =ᶠ[nhds (x, t)]
      (fun w => lam ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) • (↿(heatSwirl h c)) w) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV.mem_nhds hRpos) (fun w hw => hsw lam w.1 w.2 hlam hw)
  have hevP : (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (↿(heatPressure h c)) (lam • w.1, 1 - lam ^ 2 * (1 - w.2))) =ᶠ[nhds (x, t)]
      (fun w => lam ^ (-(2 + 4 * h)) • (↿(heatPressure h c)) w) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV.mem_nhds hRpos) (fun w hw => hpr lam w.1 w.2 hlam hw)
  have hS3 := htr (↿(heatSwirl h c)) lam (1 + 2 * h) (x, t) hlam hcdS hevS
  have hP3 := htr (↿(heatPressure h c)) lam (2 + 4 * h) (x, t) hlam hcdP hevP
  have hW1 := hwt (1 + 2 * h) (1 + 2 * h + m) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) ρ lam (by linarith) (by linarith)
    hRpos hρ0 hρ1 hlam hl2
  have hW2 := hwt (2 + 4 * h) (1 + 2 * h + m) (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) ρ lam (by linarith) (by linarith)
    hRpos hρ0 hρ1 hlam hl2
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ max C₀ 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hfac : ∀ a : ℝ, 0 ≤ lam ^ a * (max lam (lam ^ 2)) ^ m := fun a =>
    mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hlam a).le (pow_nonneg (le_max_of_le_left hlam.le) m)
  constructor
  · exact hS3.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (b1.trans (le_max_left _ _)) (hfac _)).trans
      ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hW1 hC0).trans (le_of_eq (mul_comm _ _))))
  · exact hP3.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (b2.trans (le_max_left _ _)) (hfac _)).trans
      ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hW2 hC0).trans (le_of_eq (mul_comm _ _))))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h ε : ℝ) (U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadV h U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadV h U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C

signature.name: leadV_smooth_bounds
signature.statement: ∀ (h ε : ℝ) (U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadV h U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadV h U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h ε U hh0 hh1 hε hU hbdU
  have hOo : IsOpen (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hO'o : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hO'O : Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 :=
    fun p hp => ⟨lt_trans (neg_lt_zero.mpr hε) hp.1, hp.2⟩
  obtain ⟨hSsm, hSbd, -⟩ := profRadAvg_props U ε hε hU
  
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ × ℝ, v = ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿(profRadAvg U))) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
    hSsm.fderiv_of_isOpen hOo (by simp)
  have hTeq : ∀ p ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, (↿(profEtaD (profRadAvg U))) p =
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿(profRadAvg U))) p := by
    rintro ⟨X, η⟩ hp
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿(profRadAvg U)) (X, η) :=
      (hSsm.contDiffAt (hOo.mem_nhds hp)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => ((X, e) : ℝ × ℝ)) v η := by
      rw [hv]; exact (hasDerivAt_const η X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id η)
    have hc := HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt η hd.hasFDerivAt hγ
    rw [Function.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply]
    exact hc.deriv
  have hTsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profEtaD (profRadAvg U))) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hfd).congr hTeq
  have hTbd : ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : ℝ × ℝ), p ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(profEtaD (profRadAvg U))) p‖ ≤
        ‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) (↿(profRadAvg U)) p‖ := by
    intro k p hp
    have hev : (↿(profEtaD (profRadAvg U))) =ᶠ[nhds p]
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿(profRadAvg U))) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hOo.mem_nhds hp) hTeq
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds, ← norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left _ (hfd.contDiffAt (hOo.mem_nhds hp))
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  
  have hKW : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, -1 ≤ p.2 → p.2 ≤ 1 → 0 < 1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2 := by
    intro p h1 h2
    have h3 : p.2 ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith
  have hWo : IsOpen {p : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < 1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2} :=
    isOpen_lt continuous_const (show Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2) by fun_prop)
  have hcoef : ∀ P : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ P → ∀ c : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
      c = (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 * P p.2 / (1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
      ∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ p.1 → p.1 ≤ X₁ → -1 ≤ p.2 → p.2 ≤ 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k c p‖ ≤ C := by
    intro P hP c hc
    subst hc
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 * P p.2 / (1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2))
        {p : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < 1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2} :=
      ContDiffOn.div (f := fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 * P p.2) (g := fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2)
        (contDiff_fst.mul (hP.comp contDiff_snd)).contDiffOn
        (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_snd.pow 2))).contDiffOn
        (fun p hp => ne_of_gt hp)
    refine ⟨hsm.mono (fun p hp => hKW p hp.2.1.le hp.2.2.le), fun X₁ k => ?_⟩
    have hcont : ContinuousOn
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 * P p.2 / (1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2)))
        {p : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < 1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2} :=
      (hsm.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hWo.uniqueDiffOn).congr
        (fun p hp => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hWo hp).symm)
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hcont.mono (fun p (hp : p ∈ Icc 0 X₁ ×ˢ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1) => hKW p hp.2.1 hp.2.2))
    exact ⟨C, fun p h1 h2 h3 h4 => hC p ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨cA, hcA⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
      c = fun p => p.1 * (2 * p.2) / (1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨cB, hcB⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
      c = fun p => p.1 * (-(2 * (1 / 2 - h) * p.2)) / (1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨cC, hcC⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
      c = fun p => p.1 * (-(1 - p.2 ^ 2)) / (1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hAs, hAb⟩ := hcoef (fun e => 2 * e) (by fun_prop) cA hcA
  obtain ⟨hBs, hBb⟩ := hcoef (fun e => -(2 * (1 / 2 - h) * e)) (by fun_prop) cB hcB
  obtain ⟨hCs, hCb⟩ := hcoef (fun e => -(1 - e ^ 2)) (by fun_prop) cC hcC
  
  have hid : (↿(leadV h U)) = fun p => (cA p * (↿U) p + cB p * (↿(profRadAvg U)) p) +
      cC p * (↿(profEtaD (profRadAvg U))) p := by
    funext p
    rw [hcA, hcB, hcC]
    show leadV h U p.1 p.2 = (p.1 * (2 * p.2) / (1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2) * U p.1 p.2 +
      p.1 * (-(2 * (1 / 2 - h) * p.2)) / (1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2) * profRadAvg U p.1 p.2) +
      p.1 * (-(1 - p.2 ^ 2)) / (1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadAvg U) p.1 p.2
    unfold leadV
    ring
  have hUO' := hU.mono hO'O
  have hSO' := hSsm.mono hO'O
  have hTO' := hTsm.mono hO'O
  have hpA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => cA p * (↿U) p) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := hAs.mul hUO'
  have hpB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => cB p * (↿(profRadAvg U)) p) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
    hBs.mul hSO'
  have hpC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => cC p * (↿(profEtaD (profRadAvg U))) p)
      (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := hCs.mul hTO'
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hid]; exact (hpA.add hpB).add hpC
  · intro X₁ m
    have hBsub : {p : ℝ × ℝ | p ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ∧ p.1 ≤ X₁} ⊆
        Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := fun p hp => hp.1
    have bcoef : ∀ c : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ p.1 → p.1 ≤ X₁ →
        -1 ≤ p.2 → p.2 ≤ 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k c p‖ ≤ C) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ,
        ∀ z ∈ {p : ℝ × ℝ | p ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ∧ p.1 ≤ X₁},
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k c z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro c hc k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hc X₁ k
      exact ⟨C, fun z hz => hC z (le_of_lt hz.1.1) hz.2 hz.1.2.1.le hz.1.2.2.le⟩
    have bU : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ {p : ℝ × ℝ | p ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ∧ p.1 ≤ X₁},
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿U) z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbdU X₁ k
      exact ⟨C, fun z hz => hC z.1 z.2 (le_of_lt hz.1.1) hz.2 hz.1.2.1 hz.1.2.2⟩
    have bS : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ {p : ℝ × ℝ | p ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ∧ p.1 ≤ X₁},
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(profRadAvg U)) z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hSbd X₁ k (hbdU X₁ k)
      exact ⟨C, fun z hz => hC z.1 z.2 (le_of_lt hz.1.1) hz.2 hz.1.2.1 hz.1.2.2⟩
    have bT : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ {p : ℝ × ℝ | p ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ∧ p.1 ≤ X₁},
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(profEtaD (profRadAvg U))) z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hSbd X₁ (k + 1) (hbdU X₁ (k + 1))
      refine ⟨‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v‖ * C, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      exact (hTbd k z (hO'O hz.1)).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (hC z.1 z.2 (le_of_lt hz.1.1) hz.2 hz.1.2.1 hz.1.2.2) (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg _))
    obtain ⟨C1, h1⟩ := iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) cA (↿U)
      _ _ hO'o hBsub hAs hUO' (bcoef cA hAb) bU m
    obtain ⟨C2, h2⟩ := iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) cB
      (↿(profRadAvg U)) _ _ hO'o hBsub hBs hSO' (bcoef cB hBb) bS m
    obtain ⟨C3, h3⟩ := iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) cC
      (↿(profEtaD (profRadAvg U))) _ _ hO'o hBsub hCs hTO' (bcoef cC hCb) bT m
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply'] at h1 h2 h3
    refine ⟨C1 + C2 + C3, fun X η hX hX1 hη1 hη2 => ?_⟩
    have hzB : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ {p : ℝ × ℝ | p ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ∧ p.1 ≤ X₁} :=
      ⟨⟨hX, hη1, hη2⟩, hX1⟩
    have hn : Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ∈ nhds ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) := hO'o.mem_nhds hzB.1
    have hm : ((m : ℕ) : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
    have dA := (hpA.contDiffAt hn).of_le hm
    have dB := (hpB.contDiffAt hn).of_le hm
    have dC := (hpC.contDiffAt hn).of_le hm
    rw [hid]
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun p => (cA p * (↿U) p + cB p * (↿(profRadAvg U)) p) +
        cC p * (↿(profEtaD (profRadAvg U))) p) (X, η) =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun p => cA p * (↿U) p) (X, η) +
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun p => cB p * (↿(profRadAvg U)) p) (X, η)) +
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun p => cC p * (↿(profEtaD (profRadAvg U))) p) (X, η) := by
      rw [← iteratedFDeriv_add_apply dA dB]
      exact iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (dA.add dB) dC
    rw [e1]
    have t1 := h1 _ hzB
    have t2 := h2 _ hzB
    have t3 := h3 _ hzB
    have n1 := norm_add_le (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun p => cA p * (↿U) p) (X, η) +
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun p => cB p * (↿(profRadAvg U)) p) (X, η))
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun p => cC p * (↿(profEtaD (profRadAvg U))) p) (X, η))
    have n2 := norm_add_le (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun p => cA p * (↿U) p) (X, η))
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun p => cB p * (↿(profRadAvg U)) p) (X, η))
    linarith

subgoal_signatures.name: profRadAvg_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profRadAvg g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(profRadAvg g)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → X * profRadAvg g X η = profRadInt g X η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * profRadAvg g Y η) (g X η) X)

subgoal_signatures.name: iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {E F G H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] H) (f : E → F) (g : E → G) (O S : Set E), IsOpen O → S ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g O → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z‖ ≤ C) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g z‖ ≤ C) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) z‖ ≤ C

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → ∃ (Xm Xs : ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), Xa < Xm ∧ Xm < Xs ∧ Xs < Xb ∧ BgCoeffSeq h Xm Xs m1 m2 F U S G W

signature.name: bg_coeff_seq_exists
signature.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → ∃ (Xm Xs : ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), Xa < Xm ∧ Xm < Xs ∧ Xs < Xb ∧ BgCoeffSeq h Xm Xs m1 m2 F U S G W

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z hS hLP
  have hLP' := hLP
  unfold LeadingProfile at hLP'
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, hh1, hlam, hcinf, hcp, haa, hab, hXa, hXap1, hp12, hp2m1, hm12, hm2Xv, hXvXc,
    hXcXb⟩, -, -, -, ⟨εL, hεL, hFεL, hUεL, -, -⟩, ⟨Xan, ρ, hXaXan, hXanp1, hρ, Fc, Uc, Pc, hFc⟩,
    -⟩ := hLP'
  
  obtain ⟨Xm, hXm⟩ : ∃ Xm : ℝ, Xm = Xa + (Xan - Xa) / 4 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Xs, hXs⟩ : ∃ Xs : ℝ, Xs = (Xc + Xb) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ε, hεd⟩ : ∃ ε : ℝ, ε = min εL 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hε : 0 < ε := by rw [hεd]; exact lt_min hεL one_pos
  have hε1 : ε ≤ 1 := by rw [hεd]; exact min_le_right _ _
  have hεL' : ε ≤ εL := by rw [hεd]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hXan0 : 0 < Xan := by linarith
  have hXm0 : 0 < Xm := by rw [hXm]; linarith
  have hXaXm : Xa < Xm := by rw [hXm]; linarith
  have hXmXan : Xm < Xan := by rw [hXm]; linarith
  have hXmXs : Xm < Xs := by rw [hXm, hXs]; linarith
  have hXvXs : Xv < Xs := by rw [hXs]; linarith
  have hXsXb : Xs < Xb := by rw [hXs]; linarith
  have hsubε : Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (-εL) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 :=
    prod_mono (fun x hx => by simp only [mem_Ioi] at hx ⊢; linarith) subset_rfl
  have hFε : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := hFεL.mono hsubε
  have hUε : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := hUεL.mono hsubε
  
  have hAF : BgAnalytic Xan F := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hcF, -, -, hX⟩ := hFc k
    refine ⟨ρ, C, Fc k, hρ, hcF.mono (prod_mono Ioo_subset_Icc_self (fun w hw => hw)),
      fun X h0 h1 => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hd, -, -, hb, hid⟩ := hX X h0.le h1.le
    refine ⟨hd, fun w hw => ?_, fun η e1 e2 => (hid η e1 e2).1⟩
    simp only [cStrip, mem_setOf_eq] at hw
    exact (hb w hw.1 hw.2.1 hw.2.2).1
  have hAU : BgAnalytic Xan U := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, -, hcU, -, hX⟩ := hFc k
    refine ⟨ρ, C, Uc k, hρ, hcU.mono (prod_mono Ioo_subset_Icc_self (fun w hw => hw)),
      fun X h0 h1 => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨-, hd, -, hb, hid⟩ := hX X h0.le h1.le
    refine ⟨hd, fun w hw => ?_, fun η e1 e2 => (hid η e1 e2).2.1⟩
    simp only [cStrip, mem_setOf_eq] at hw
    exact (hb w hw.1 hw.2.1 hw.2.2).2.1
  
  have hAtr : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X < Xan → g X η = f X η) →
      BgAnalytic Xan f → BgAnalytic Xan g := by
    intro f g hfg hf k
    obtain ⟨ρ', C, fc, hρ', hcont, hX⟩ := hf k
    refine ⟨ρ', C, fc, hρ', hcont, fun X h0 h1 => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := hX X h0 h1
    refine ⟨a, b, fun η e1 e2 => ?_⟩
    have hev : (fun Y => f Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X] (fun Y => g Y η) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds h0 h1] with Y hY
      exact (hfg Y η hY.1.le hY.2).symm
    rw [c η e1 e2, hev.iteratedDeriv_eq k]
  
  have hOKc : ∀ (S G W S' G' W' : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ),
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → S' i = S i ∧ G' i = G i ∧ W' i = W i) →
      BgOrdOK h ε Xm Xs Xan m1 m2 S G W k → BgOrdOK h ε Xm Xs Xan m1 m2 S' G' W' k := by
    intro S G W S' G' W' k hag hok
    obtain ⟨eS, eG, eW⟩ := hag k le_rfl
    have hR : ∀ X η : ℝ, bgResTh h S' G' W' k X η = bgResTh h S G W k X η ∧
        bgResZ h S' G' W' k X η = bgResZ h S G W k X η ∧
        bgResRad h S' G' W' k X η = bgResRad h S G W k X η := fun X η =>
      bgRes_local h S' G' W' S G W k univ isOpen_univ (fun i hi p _ => by
        obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := hag i hi
        exact ⟨by rw [a], by rw [b], by rw [c]⟩) (X, η) (mem_univ _)
    have hR1 : ∀ X η : ℝ, bgResTh h S' G' W' k X η = bgResTh h S G W k X η :=
      fun X η => (hR X η).1
    have hR2 : ∀ X η : ℝ, bgResZ h S' G' W' k X η = bgResZ h S G W k X η :=
      fun X η => (hR X η).2.1
    have hR3 : ∀ X η : ℝ, bgResRad h S' G' W' k X η = bgResRad h S G W k X η :=
      fun X η => (hR X η).2.2
    unfold BgOrdOK BgOrdPre at hok ⊢
    simpa only [eS, eG, eW, hR1, hR2, hR3] using hok
  
  have hLowUpd : ∀ (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (Sn Gn Wn : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ n →
      BgLower h ε Xm Xs Xan m1 m2 F U S G W n →
      BgLower h ε Xm Xs Xan m1 m2 F U (Function.update S n Sn) (Function.update G n Gn)
        (Function.update W n Wn) n := by
    intro S G W n Sn Gn Wn hn hL
    unfold BgLower at hL ⊢
    obtain ⟨⟨h0S, h0G, h0W⟩, hlow⟩ := hL
    have hn0 : (0:ℕ) ≠ n := by omega
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, fun k hk1 hkn => hOKc S G W _ _ _ k (fun i hi => ?_) (hlow k hk1 hkn)⟩
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hn0]; exact h0S
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hn0]; exact h0G
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hn0]; exact h0W
    · have hin : i ≠ n := by omega
      exact ⟨Function.update_of_ne hin _ _, Function.update_of_ne hin _ _,
        Function.update_of_ne hin _ _⟩
  
  have hSTEP : ∀ (n : ℕ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ n →
      BgLower h ε Xm Xs Xan m1 m2 F U S G W n →
      ∃ Sn Gn Wn : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, BgOrdOK h ε Xm Xs Xan m1 m2 (Function.update S n Sn)
        (Function.update G n Gn) (Function.update W n Wn) n := by
    intro n S G W hn hL
    obtain ⟨Si, Gi, Wi, hSi, hGi, hWi, hbd, hASi, hAGi, hres⟩ :=
      bg_inner_solve h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab ε Xm Xs Xan F U T0th T0z
        S G W n hS hLP hε hXan0 hAF hAU hn hL
    obtain ⟨gS, hgS, hgSe, hgSb⟩ := seeley_extend_strip Si Xan hXan0 hSi
      (fun X1 hX1 m => (hbd X1 hX1 m).imp fun C hC X η h1 h2 h3 h4 => (hC X η h1 h2 h3 h4).1)
    obtain ⟨gG, hgG, hgGe, hgGb⟩ := seeley_extend_strip Gi Xan hXan0 hGi
      (fun X1 hX1 m => (hbd X1 hX1 m).imp fun C hC X η h1 h2 h3 h4 => (hC X η h1 h2 h3 h4).2.1)
    obtain ⟨gW, hgW, hgWe, hgWb⟩ := seeley_extend_strip Wi Xan hXan0 hWi
      (fun X1 hX1 m => (hbd X1 hX1 m).imp fun C hC X η h1 h2 h3 h4 => (hC X η h1 h2 h3 h4).2.2)
    have hbdg : ∀ X1 : ℝ, X1 < Xan → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿gS) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿gG) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿gW) (X, η)‖ ≤ C := by
      intro X1 hX1 m
      obtain ⟨C1, h1⟩ := hgSb X1 hX1 m
      obtain ⟨C2, h2⟩ := hgGb X1 hX1 m
      obtain ⟨C3, h3⟩ := hgWb X1 hX1 m
      refine ⟨max C1 (max C2 C3), fun X η a b c d => ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · exact (h1 X η a b c d).trans (le_max_left _ _)
      · exact (h2 X η a b c d).trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _))
      · exact (h3 X η a b c d).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _))
    have hres' : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xan → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        bgResRad h (Function.update S n gS) (Function.update G n gG) (Function.update W n gW) n X η = 0 ∧
        bgResTh h (Function.update S n gS) (Function.update G n gG) (Function.update W n gW) n X η = 0 ∧
        bgResZ h (Function.update S n gS) (Function.update G n gG) (Function.update W n gW) n X η = 0 := by
      intro X η h0 h1 e1 e2
      have hloc := bgRes_local h (Function.update S n gS) (Function.update G n gG)
        (Function.update W n gW) (Function.update S n Si) (Function.update G n Gi)
        (Function.update W n Wi) n (Ioo 0 Xan ×ˢ univ) (isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ)
        (fun i _ p hp => by
          rcases eq_or_ne i n with rfl | hin
          · simp only [Function.update_self]
            exact ⟨hgSe p.1 p.2 hp.1.1.le hp.1.2, hgGe p.1 p.2 hp.1.1.le hp.1.2,
              hgWe p.1 p.2 hp.1.1.le hp.1.2⟩
          · refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [Function.update_of_ne hin]) (X, η) ⟨⟨h0, h1⟩, mem_univ _⟩
      obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := hres X η h0 h1 e1 e2
      exact ⟨hloc.2.2.trans a, hloc.1.trans b, hloc.2.1.trans c⟩
    obtain ⟨Sn, Gn, Wn, hPre, hMom⟩ :=
      bg_extend_order h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab ε Xm Xs Xan F U T0th T0z
        S G W n gS gG gW hLP hε hε1 hFε hUε hXm0 hXmXan hXanp1 hXvXs hn hL hgS hgG hgW hbdg
        (hAtr Si gS hgSe hASi) (hAtr Gi gG hgGe hAGi) hres'
    refine ⟨Sn, Gn, Wn, ?_⟩
    unfold BgOrdOK
    exact ⟨hPre, bg_conservation h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab ε Xm Xs Xan
      F U T0th T0z _ _ _ n hS hLP hε hXvXs hXsXb hn (hLowUpd S G W n Sn Gn Wn hn hL) hPre hMom⟩
  
  have hSTEP' : ∀ (n : ℕ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      ∃ T : (ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) × (ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) × (ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      1 ≤ n → BgLower h ε Xm Xs Xan m1 m2 F U S G W n →
      BgOrdOK h ε Xm Xs Xan m1 m2 (Function.update S n T.1) (Function.update G n T.2.1)
        (Function.update W n T.2.2) n := by
    intro n S G W
    by_cases hc : 1 ≤ n ∧ BgLower h ε Xm Xs Xan m1 m2 F U S G W n
    · obtain ⟨Sn, Gn, Wn, hok⟩ := hSTEP n S G W hc.1 hc.2
      exact ⟨(Sn, Gn, Wn), fun _ _ => hok⟩
    · exact ⟨(S n, G n, W n), fun h1 h2 => absurd ⟨h1, h2⟩ hc⟩
  choose R hR using hSTEP'
  
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ0, hΦs⟩ : ∃ Φ : ℕ → (ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) × (ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) × (ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      Φ 0 = (fun _ => profRadAvg U, fun _ => F, fun _ => leadPi F) ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, Φ (k + 1) =
        (Function.update (Φ k).1 (k + 1) (R (k + 1) (Φ k).1 (Φ k).2.1 (Φ k).2.2).1,
          Function.update (Φ k).2.1 (k + 1) (R (k + 1) (Φ k).1 (Φ k).2.1 (Φ k).2.2).2.1,
          Function.update (Φ k).2.2 (k + 1) (R (k + 1) (Φ k).1 (Φ k).2.1 (Φ k).2.2).2.2) :=
    ⟨fun n => Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => (ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) × (ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) × (ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ))
      (fun _ => profRadAvg U, fun _ => F, fun _ => leadPi F)
      (fun k P => (Function.update P.1 (k + 1) (R (k + 1) P.1 P.2.1 P.2.2).1,
        Function.update P.2.1 (k + 1) (R (k + 1) P.1 P.2.1 P.2.2).2.1,
        Function.update P.2.2 (k + 1) (R (k + 1) P.1 P.2.1 P.2.2).2.2)) n, rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
  
  have hB : ∀ k m : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k →
      (Φ m).1 i = (Φ k).1 i ∧ (Φ m).2.1 i = (Φ k).2.1 i ∧ (Φ m).2.2 i = (Φ k).2.2 i := by
    intro k m hkm
    induction m, hkm using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => intro i _; exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    | succ m' hle ih =>
      intro i hi

def cStrip (ρ : ℝ) : Set ℂ := {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}

def BgAnalytic (Xi : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ (ρ C : ℝ) (fc : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ), 0 < ρ ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => fc p.1 p.2) (Ioo 0 Xi ×ˢ cStrip ρ) ∧
    ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fc X) (cStrip ρ) ∧ (∀ w ∈ cStrip ρ, ‖fc X w‖ ≤ C) ∧
      ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → fc X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => f Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ)

def BgOrdPre (h ε Xm Xs Xi m1 m2 : ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(S k)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(G k)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(W k)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧
  (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(S k)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(G k)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(W k)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, Xs ≤ X → S k X η = 0 ∧ G k X η = 0 ∧ W k X η = 0) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, m1 ≤ X → X ≤ m2 → G k X η = 0 ∧ bgUz (S k) X η = 0) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → bgResRad h S G W k X η = 0) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ Xm → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      bgResTh h S G W k X η = 0 ∧ bgResZ h S G W k X η = 0) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → (∫ X in Ioi (0:ℝ), X * G k X η) = 0) ∧
  BgAnalytic Xi (S k) ∧ BgAnalytic Xi (G k)

def BgOrdOK (h ε Xm Xs Xi m1 m2 : ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  BgOrdPre h ε Xm Xs Xi m1 m2 S G W k ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      (∫ X in Ioi (0:ℝ), X * bgResTh h S G W k X η) = 0 ∧ (∫ X in Ioi (0:ℝ), bgResZ h S G W k X η) = 0)

def BgLower (h ε Xm Xs Xi m1 m2 : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (S 0 = profRadAvg U ∧ G 0 = F ∧ W 0 = leadPi F) ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k < n → BgOrdOK h ε Xm Xs Xi m1 m2 S G W k

def BgMom (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
    (∫ X in Ioi (0:ℝ), X * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), bgUz (S i) X η * G (k - i) X η) = 0 ∧
    (∫ X in Ioi (0:ℝ), ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), bgUz (S i) X η * bgUz (S (k - i)) X η) + W k X η)) = 0

  have hz2 := (hS.2.1 (x 2) (1 - t) hτ).2
  
  have hpos_p : 0 < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQpos _
  have hR4 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h - 1) = (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hQpos.le]
    congr 1; push_cast; ring
  have hR5 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h) =
      simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) * (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 := by
    have e : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h) =
        simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (1:ℝ) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h - 1) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hQpos]; congr 1; ring
    rw [e, Real.rpow_one, hR4]
  have hprod : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (1 - 2 * h) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h - 1) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hQpos, show 1 - 2 * h + (2 * h - 1) = (0:ℝ) by ring, Real.rpow_zero]
  have hk : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) =
      simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) *
      (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) := by
    have e1 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) =
        simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h + 1) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_add hQpos (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) 1, Real.rpow_one]
    rw [← mul_assoc, e1, ← Real.rpow_add hQpos]
    congr 1; ring
  
  have heta2 : (simEta h x t) ^ 2 < 1 := by
    have : (simEta h x t) ^ 2 = x 2 ^ 2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h - 1) := by
      rw [hR4]; unfold simEta; ring
    rw [this]
    calc x 2 ^ 2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h - 1)
        < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (1 - 2 * h) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h - 1) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hz2 (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQpos _)
      _ = 1 := hprod
  have heta_abs : |simEta h x t| < 1 := (sq_lt_one_iff_abs_lt_one _).mp heta2
  have hX0 : 0 < simX h x t := by unfold simX; positivity
  have hmem : (simX h x t, simEta h x t) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
    ⟨show -ε < simX h x t by linarith, (abs_lt.mp heta_abs).1, (abs_lt.mp heta_abs).2⟩
  have hGd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿S) (simX h x t, simEta h x t) :=
    (hSsm.contDiffAt ((isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo).mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨G', hG⟩ : ∃ G', HasFDerivAt (↿S) G' (simX h x t, simEta h x t) :=
    ⟨_, hGd.hasFDerivAt⟩
  have hgX : HasDerivAt (fun Y => S Y (simEta h x t)) (G' (1, 0)) (simX h x t) := by
    have hl : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, simEta h x t)) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) (simX h x t) :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' _).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const _ _)
    have := hG.comp_hasDerivAt (simX h x t) hl
    exact this
  have hgE : HasDerivAt (fun e => S (simX h x t) e) (G' (0, 1)) (simEta h x t) := by
    have hl : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => (simX h x t, e)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) (simEta h x t) :=
      (hasDerivAt_const _ _).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' _)
    have := hG.comp_hasDerivAt (simEta h x t) hl
    exact this
  have hpdE : pdE S (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) = G' (0, 1) := by
    unfold pdE; exact hgE.deriv
  have hpdX : pdX S (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) = G' (1, 0) := by
    unfold pdX; exact hgX.deriv
  
  have hQf : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => simScale h (y 2) (1 - t))
      (Q' • (EuclideanSpace.proj 2 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)) x := by
    have := HasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt (h₂ := fun z => simScale h z (1 - t)) x hQh (hP 2)
    exact this
  have hm := hQf.rpow_const (p := -(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (Or.inl hQne)
  have hp := hQf.rpow_const (p := -(1 / 2 - h)) (Or.inl hQne)
  have hr2 := ((hP 0).pow 2).add ((hP 1).pow 2)
  have hinv := HasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt (h₂ := fun y : ℝ => y⁻¹) x
    (hasDerivAt_inv (by positivity : (2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) ≠ 0)) (hQf.const_mul 2)
  have hX := (hr2.mul hinv).congr_of_eventuallyEq (f₁ := fun y : ℝ³ => simX h y t)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => by simp [simX, div_eq_mul_inv])
  have hEta := ((hP 2).mul hp).congr_of_eventuallyEq (f₁ := fun y : ℝ³ => simEta h y t)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => by simp [simEta])
  have hSc := hG.comp x (hX.prodMk hEta)
  have hσ := (hm.const_mul (1 / 2)).mul hSc
  have hfun : (fun w => bgAn h n S w t) =
      fun w => (((fun y : ℝ³ => 1 / 2 * simScale h (y 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h)) *
        (↿S ∘ fun y : ℝ³ => (simX h y t, simEta h y t))) w) • azVec w := by
    funext w
    simp only [bgAn]
    rfl
  rw [hfun]
  obtain ⟨g1, hg1⟩ : ∃ g, G' (1, 0) = g := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨g2, hg2⟩ : ∃ g, G' (0, 1) = g := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hGe : G' = g1 • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ + g2 • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ := by
    ext <;> simp [← hg1, ← hg2]
  rw [hg1] at hpdX
  rw [hg2] at hpdE
  have hm1 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1) =
      simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) / simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) :=
    Real.rpow_sub_one hQne _
  have hp1 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h) - 1) =
      simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) / simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) := Real.rpow_sub_one hQne _
  have hinvx : ((fun y : ℝ => y⁻¹) ∘ fun y : ℝ³ => 2 * simScale h (y 2) (1 - t)) x =
      (2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t))⁻¹ := rfl
  have hr2x : ((fun y : ℝ³ => y 0 ^ 2) + fun y : ℝ³ => y 1 ^ 2) x = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := rfl
  have hSx : (↿S ∘ fun y : ℝ³ => (simX h y t, simEta h y t)) x =
      S (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) := rfl
  rw [hm1, hp1, hinvx, hr2x, hSx, hGe] at hσ
  have hσx : ((fun y : ℝ³ => 1 / 2 * simScale h (y 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h)) *
        (↿S ∘ fun y : ℝ³ => (simX h y t, simEta h y t))) x =
      1 / 2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) *
        S (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) := rfl
  have hXdef : simX h x t = (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) / (2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) := rfl
  have hEdef : simEta h x t = x 2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) := rfl
  have hL : 0 < 1 - 2 * h * (x 2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 := by
    have h1 := heta2
    rw [hEdef] at h1
    have h2 : 0 ≤ (1 - 2 * h) * (x 2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _)
    nlinarith
  
  rw [s3 _ _ hσ]
  simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, radVec, azVec, bgUz, bgVx, hpdX, hpdE, hσx]
  rw [hR4, hR5] at hrel
  rw [hk]
  generalize S (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) = s0 at *
  simp only [hXdef, hEdef]
  generalize simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) = m
  generalize simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) = p at hrel hL hpos_p ⊢
  generalize simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) = Q at hrel hL hQpos hQne ⊢
  have hpne : p ≠ 0 := hpos_p.ne'
  have hLne : 1 - 2 * h * (x 2 * p) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := hL.ne'
  have hQ' : Q' = 2 * x 2 * Q * p ^ 2 / (1 - 2 * h * (x 2 * p) ^ 2) := by
    rw [eq_div_iff hLne]
    simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at hrel
    norm_num at hrel
    linear_combination hrel
  subst hQ'
  simp
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · field_simp
    ring
  · have hL2 : 1 - p ^ 2 * x 2 ^ 2 * h * 2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hc; apply hLne; linear_combination hc
    have hL3 : 1 - x 2 ^ 2 * p ^ 2 * h * 2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hc; apply hLne; linear_combination hc
    field_simp
    ring_nf
    field_simp
    ring
  · ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → BgCoeffSeq h Xm Xs m1 m2 F U S G W → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgResTh h S G W k)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgResZ h S G W k)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgUz (S k))) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun (X η : ℝ) => X * bgVx h k (S k) X η)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X1 : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgResTh h S G W k)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgResZ h S G W k)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgUz (S k))) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun (X η : ℝ) => X * bgVx h k (S k) X η)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)

signature.name: bg_coef_regular
signature.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → BgCoeffSeq h Xm Xs m1 m2 F U S G W → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgResTh h S G W k)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgResZ h S G W k)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgUz (S k))) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun (X η : ℝ) => X * bgVx h k (S k) X η)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X1 : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgResTh h S G W k)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgResZ h S G W k)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgUz (S k))) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun (X η : ℝ) => X * bgVx h k (S k) X η)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs F U T0th T0z S G W hSc hL hB
  unfold LeadingProfile at hL
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, hh1, -⟩, -, -, -, ⟨εL, hεL, hFs, hUs, -, hFU⟩, -⟩ := hL
  unfold BgCoeffSeq at hB
  obtain ⟨⟨hS0, hG0, -⟩, ⟨εB, hεB, hBsm⟩, hBbd, hBsupp, -⟩ := hB
  obtain ⟨ε, hεdef⟩ : ∃ ε : ℝ, ε = min εL εB := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hε : 0 < ε := by rw [hεdef]; exact lt_min hεL hεB
  have hεL' : ε ≤ εL := by rw [hεdef]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hεB' : ε ≤ εB := by rw [hεdef]; exact min_le_right _ _
  have hΩ : IsOpen (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hle : ∀ m : ℕ, ((m : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := fun m => by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hmem : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
    fun X η h0 h1 h2 => ⟨show -ε < X by linarith, h1, h2⟩
  
  have hcongr : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → (∀ X η, f X η = g X η) → bgCoefGood ε g := by
    intro f g hf hfg
    have : f = g := funext fun X => funext fun η => hfg X η
    subst this
    exact hf
  
  have hadd : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε g →
      bgCoefGood ε (fun X η => f X η + g X η) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.add hg.1, ?_⟩
    intro X1 m
    obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hf.2 X1 m
    obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := hg.2 X1 m
    refine ⟨C1 + C2, fun X η h0 h1 h2 h3 => ?_⟩
    have hz := hΩ.mem_nhds (hmem X η h0 h2 h3)
    have e : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun X η => f X η + g X η)) (X, η) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) (X, η) + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η) :=
      iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((hf.1.contDiffAt hz).of_le (hle m)) ((hg.1.contDiffAt hz).of_le (hle m))
    rw [e]
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hC1 X η h0 h1 h2 h3) (hC2 X η h0 h1 h2 h3))
  have hsub : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε g →
      bgCoefGood ε (fun X η => f X η - g X η) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.sub hg.1, ?_⟩
    intro X1 m
    obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hf.2 X1 m
    obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := hg.2 X1 m
    refine ⟨C1 + C2, fun X η h0 h1 h2 h3 => ?_⟩
    have hz := hΩ.mem_nhds (hmem X η h0 h2 h3)
    have e : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun X η => f X η - g X η)) (X, η) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) (X, η) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η) :=
      iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply ((hf.1.contDiffAt hz).of_le (hle m)) ((hg.1.contDiffAt hz).of_le (hle m))
    rw [e]
    exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hC1 X η h0 h1 h2 h3) (hC2 X η h0 h1 h2 h3))
  
  have hmul : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε g →
      bgCoefGood ε (fun X η => f X η * g X η) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.mul hg.1, ?_⟩
    intro X1 m
    have hS : Icc (0 : ℝ) X1 ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
      fun z hz => hmem z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.2.1 hz.2.2
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) (↿f) (↿g)
      (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) (Icc (0 : ℝ) X1 ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) hΩ hS hf.1 hg.1
      (fun k => (hf.2 X1 k).imp fun C hC z hz => hC z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2)
      (fun k => (hg.2 X1 k).imp fun C hC z hz => hC z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2) m
    have e : (fun z => (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) ((↿f) z) ((↿g) z)) =
        ↿(fun X η => f X η * g X η) := by
      funext z
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply']
      rfl
    refine ⟨C, fun X η h0 h1 h2 h3 => ?_⟩
    rw [← e]
    exact hC (X, η) ⟨⟨h0, h1⟩, h2, h3⟩
  
  have hbasic : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (V : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) V →
      (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ V) → bgCoefGood ε f := by
    intro f V hV hf hsubV
    refine ⟨hf.mono (fun z hz => hsubV z.1 z.2 hz.1 hz.2.1.le hz.2.2.le), ?_⟩
    intro X1 m
    have hK : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) X1 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    have hKV : Icc (0 : ℝ) X1 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ V :=
      fun z hz => hsubV z.1 z.2 (by linarith [hz.1.1]) hz.2.1 hz.2.2
    have hc : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f)) V :=
      (hf.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (hle m) hV.uniqueDiffOn).congr
        (fun z hz => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hV hz).symm)
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hc.mono hKV)
    exact ⟨C, fun X η h0 h1 h2 h3 => hC (X, η) ⟨⟨h0, h1⟩, h2.le, h3.le⟩⟩
  have hconst : ∀ c : ℝ, bgCoefGood ε (fun _ _ => c) := fun c =>
    hbasic (fun _ _ => c) univ isOpen_univ contDiffOn_const (fun _ _ _ _ _ => mem_univ _)
  have hX : bgCoefGood ε (fun X _ => X) :=
    hbasic (fun X _ => X) univ isOpen_univ contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun _ _ _ _ _ => mem_univ _)
  have hη : bgCoefGood ε (fun _ η => η) :=
    hbasic (fun _ η => η) univ isOpen_univ contDiff_snd.contDiffOn (fun _ _ _ _ _ => mem_univ _)
  have hinv : bgCoefGood ε (fun _ η => (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
    refine hbasic _ {w : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < 1 - 2 * h * w.2 ^ 2}
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)) ?_ ?_
    · exact ((contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_snd.pow 2))).contDiffOn).inv
        (fun w hw => ne_of_gt hw)
    · intro X η _ h1 h2
      have hη2 : η ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
      show 0 < 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2
      nlinarith
  
  have hpd : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (v : ℝ × ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), bgCoefGood ε f →
      (∀ X η, ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 → g X η = fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η) v) →
      bgCoefGood ε g := by
    intro f v g hf hgv
    have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hf.1.fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ le_rfl
    have hDg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿f))
        (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hD
    have heq : ∀ z ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1,
        (↿g) z = ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿f)) z := by
      intro z hz
      have := hgv z.1 z.2 hz
      exact this
    refine ⟨hDg.congr heq, ?_⟩
    intro X1 m
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hf.2 X1 (m + 1)
    refine ⟨‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v‖ * C, fun X η h0 h1 h2 h3 => ?_⟩
    have hz := hmem X η h0 h2 h3
    have hev : (↿g) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)] ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿f)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hΩ.mem_nhds hz) heq
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (X, η)‖
        ≤ ‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (X, η)‖ :=
          (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v).norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left
            (hD.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hz)) (hle m)
      _ = ‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) (↿f) (X, η)‖ := by
          rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
      _ ≤ ‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v‖ * C :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC X η h0 h1 h2 h3) (by positivity)
  have hpdX : ∀ f, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (pdX f) := by
    intro f hf
    refine hpd f ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) (pdX f) hf (fun X η hz => ?_)
    have hd : HasFDerivAt (↿f) (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η)) (X, η) :=
      ((hf.1.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => ((Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) X :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X η)
    exact (hd.comp_hasDerivAt X hc).deriv
  have hpdE : ∀ f, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (pdE f) := by
    intro f hf
    refine hpd f ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) (pdE f) hf (fun X η hz => ?_)
    have hd : HasFDerivAt (↿f) (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η)) (X, η) :=
      ((hf.1.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => ((X, e) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) η :=
      (hasDerivAt_const η X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' η)
    exact (hd.comp_hasDerivAt η hc).deriv
  have hsum : ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ i ∈ s, bgCoefGood ε (f i)) →
      bgCoefGood ε (fun X η => ∑ i ∈ s, f i X η) := by
    intro s f
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => intro _; exact hcongr _ _ (hconst 0) (fun X η => by simp)
    | @insert a s ha ih =>
      intro hf
      exact hcongr _ _ (hadd _ _ (hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s))
        (ih fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))) (fun X η => by rw [Finset.sum_insert ha])
  
  have hUz : ∀ f, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (bgUz f) := fun f hf =>
    hcongr _ _ (hadd _ _ hf (hmul _ _ hX (hpdX f hf))) (fun X η => rfl)
  have hVx : ∀ (n : ℕ) f, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (bgVx h n f) := by
    intro n f hf
    have A1 := hmul _ _ (hmul _ _ (hconst 2) hη) (hUz f hf)
    have A2 := hmul _ _ (hmul _ _ (hconst (2 * (1 / 2 - h + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h))) hη) hf
    have A3 := hmul _ _ (hsub _ _ (hconst 1) (hmul _ _ hη hη)) (hpdE f hf)
    refine hcongr _ _ (hmul _ _ (hsub _ _ (hsub _ _ A1 A2) A3) hinv) (fun X η => ?_)
    simp only [bgVx]
    ring
  have hTop : ∀ (b : ℝ) f, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (simTop h b f) := by
    intro b f hf
    have A1 := hmul _ _ (hconst (-b)) hf
    have A2 := hmul _ _ (hmul _ _ (hconst (1 / 2 - h)) hη) (hpdE f hf)
    have A3 := hmul _ _ hX (hpdX f hf)
    refine hcongr _ _ (hmul _ _ (hadd _ _ (hadd _ _ A1 A2) A3) hinv) (fun X η => ?_)
    simp only [simTop]
    ring
  have hZop : ∀ (b : ℝ) f, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (simZop h b f) := by
    intro b f hf
    have A1 := hmul _ _ (hmul _ _ (hconst (2 * b)) hη) hf
    have A2 := hmul _ _ (hsub _ _ (hconst 1) (hmul _ _ hη hη)) (hpdE f hf)
    have A3 := hmul _ _ (hmul _ _ (hmul _ _ (hconst 2) hη) hX) (hpdX f hf)
    refine hcongr _ _ (hmul _ _ (hsub _ _ (hadd _ _ A1 A2) A3) hinv) (fun X η => ?_)
    simp only [simZop]
    ring
  
  have hsubL : Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (-εL) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
    prod_mono (fun x hx => by simp only [mem_Ioi] at hx ⊢; linarith) subset_rfl
  have hsubB : Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (-εB) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
    prod_mono (fun x hx => by simp only [mem_Ioi] at hx ⊢; linarith) subset_rfl
  have hSg : ∀ n, bgCoefGood ε (S n) := by
    intro n
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · rw [hS0]
      obtain ⟨hsm, hbd, -⟩ := profRadAvg_props U εL hεL hUs
      exact ⟨hsm.mono hsubL, fun X1 m => hbd X1 m
        ((hFU X1 m).imp fun C hC X η a b c d => (hC X η a b c d).2)⟩
    · exact ⟨(hBsm n hn).1.mono hsubB, fun X1 m =>
        (hBbd n hn m).imp fun C hC X η a _ c d => (hC X η a c d).1⟩
  have hGg : ∀ n, bgCoefGood ε (G n) := by
    intro n
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · rw [hG0]
      exact ⟨hFs.mono hsubL, fun X1 m =>
        (hFU X1 m).imp fun C hC X η a b c d => (hC X η a b c d).1⟩
    · exact ⟨(hBsm n hn).2.1.mono hsubB, fun X1 m =>
        (hBbd n hn m).imp fun C hC X η a _ c d => (hC X η a c d).2.1⟩
  have hWg : ∀ n, 1 ≤ n → bgCoefGood ε (W n) := by
    intro n hn
    exact ⟨(hBsm n hn).2.2.mono hsubB, fun X1 m =>
      (hBbd n hn m).imp fun C hC X η a _ c d => (hC X η a c d).2.2⟩
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  
  have hRTh : bgCoefGood ε (bgResTh h S G W k) := by
    have R1 := hTop (-(1 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) _ (hGg k)
    have R2 := hmul _ _ (hconst 2) (hadd _ _ (hmul _ _ hX (hpdX _ (hpdX _ (hGg k))))
      (hmul _ _ (hconst 2) (hpdX _ (hGg k))))
    have R3 := hsum (Finset.range (k + 1))
      (fun i X η => bgVx h i (S i) X η * (G (k - i) X η + X * pdX (G (k - i)) X η)
          + bgUz (S i) X η * simZop h (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) (G (k - i)) X η)
      (fun i _ => hadd _ _ (hmul _ _ (hVx i (S i) (hSg i))
          (hadd _ _ (hGg (k - i)) (hmul _ _ hX (hpdX _ (hGg (k - i))))))
        (hmul _ _ (hUz _ (hSg i)) (hZop _ _ (hGg (k - i)))))
    have R4 := hZop (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h)) _
      (hZop (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) _ (hGg (k - 1)))
    refine hcongr _ _ (hsub _ _ (hadd _ _ (hsub _ _ R1 R2) R3) R4) (fun X η => ?_)
    simp only [bgResTh, if_pos hk]
  have hRZ : bgCoefGood ε (bgResZ h S G W k) := by
    have Z1 := hTop (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) _ (hUz _ (hSg k))
    have Z2 := hZop (-(1 + 2 * h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) _ (hWg k hk)
    have Z3 := hmul _ _ (hconst 2) (hadd _ _ (hmul _ _ hX (hpdX _ (hpdX _ (hUz _ (hSg k)))))
      (hpdX _ (hUz _ (hSg k))))
    have Z4 := hsum (Finset.range (k + 1))
      (fun i X η => X * bgVx h i (S i) X η * pdX (bgUz (S (k - i))) X η
          + bgUz (S i) X η * simZop h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) (bgUz (S (k - i))) X η)
      (fun i _ => hadd _ _ (hmul _ _ (hmul _ _ hX (hVx i (S i) (hSg i)))
          (hpdX _ (hUz _ (hSg (k - i)))))
        (hmul _ _ (hUz _ (hSg i)) (hZop _ _ (hUz _ (hSg (k - i))))))
    have Z5 := hZop (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h)) _
      (hZop (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) _ (hUz _ (hSg (k - 1))))
    refine hcongr _ _ (hsub _ _ (hadd _ _ (hsub _ _ (hadd _ _ Z1 Z2) Z3) Z4) Z5) (fun X η => ?_)
    simp only [bgResZ, if_pos hk]
  have hU := hUz _ (hSg k)
  have hXV := hmul _ _ hX (hVx k (S k) (hSg k))
  refine ⟨hRTh.1, hRZ.1, hU.1, hXV.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro X1 m
    obtain ⟨C1, h1⟩ := hRTh.2 X1 m
    obtain ⟨C2, h2⟩ := hRZ.2 X1 m
    exact ⟨max C1 C2, fun X η a b c d =>
      ⟨(h1 X η a b c d).trans (le_max_left _ _), (h2 X η a b c d).trans (le_max_right _ _)⟩⟩
  · intro m
    obtain ⟨C1, h1⟩ := hU.2 Xs m
    obtain ⟨C2, h2⟩ := hXV.2 Xs m
    refine ⟨max (max C1 C2) 0, fun X η h0 hη1 hη2 => ?_⟩
    by_cases hXs : X ≤ Xs
    · exact ⟨(h1 X η h0 hXs hη1 hη2).trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _)),
        (h2 X η h0 hXs hη1 hη2).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _))⟩
    · push_neg at hXs
      have hsk : ∀ X η : ℝ, Xs ≤ X → S k X η = 0 := fun X η hX => (hBsupp k hk X η hX).1
      have hclaim : ∀ X' η' : ℝ, Xs < X' →
          bgUz (S k) X' η' = 0 ∧ X' * bgVx h k (S k) X' η' = 0 := by
        intro X' η' hX'
        have hs : S k X' η' = 0 := hsk X' η' hX'.le
        have hpX : pdX (S k) X' η' = 0 := by
          unfold pdX
          have hev : (fun Y => S k Y η') =ᶠ[nhds X'] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
            Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hX') (fun Y hY => hsk Y η' (le_of_lt hY))
          rw [hev.deriv_eq]
          simp
        have hpE : pdE (S k) X' η' = 0 := by
          unfold pdE
          have he : (fun e => S k X' e) = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := funext fun e => hsk X' e hX'.le
          rw [he]
          simp
        constructor
        · simp [bgUz, hs, hpX]
        · simp [bgVx, bgUz, hs, hpX, hpE]
      have hO : IsOpen (Ioi Xs ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_univ
      have hzO : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi Xs ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) := ⟨hXs, mem_univ _⟩
      have ev1 : (↿(bgUz (S k))) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hzO) (fun z hz => (hclaim z.1 z.2 hz.1).1)
      have ev2 : (↿(fun (X η : ℝ) => X * bgVx h k (S k) X η)) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hzO) (fun z hz => (hclaim z.1 z.2 hz.1).2)
      rw [(ev1.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, (ev2.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds,
        iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
      exact ⟨le_max_right _ _, le_max_right _ _⟩

bg_coef_regular.definitions:

  ∀ X1 : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) (X, η)‖ ≤ C

subgoal_signatures.name: profRadAvg_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profRadAvg g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(profRadAvg g)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → X * profRadAvg g X η = profRadInt g X η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * profRadAvg g Y η) (g X η) X)

subgoal_signatures.name: iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {E F G H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] H) (f : E → F) (g : E → G) (O S : Set E), IsOpen O → S ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g O → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z‖ ≤ C) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g z‖ ≤ C) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) z‖ ≤ C

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (r1 r2 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε X0 X1 : ℝ), 0 < ε → 0 < X0 → X0 < X1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿r1) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿r2) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿r1) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿r2) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ X0 → -1 < η → η < 1 → r1 X η = 0 ∧ r2 X η = 0) → (∀ X η : ℝ, X1 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → r1 X η = 0 ∧ r2 X η = 0) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → (∫ X in Ioi (0:ℝ), X * r1 X η) = 0 ∧ (∫ X in Ioi (0:ℝ), r2 X η) = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(stressPrimTh r1)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(stressPrimZ r2)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(stressPrimTh r1)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(stressPrimZ r2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → deriv (fun Y => stressPrimTh r1 Y η) X + stressPrimTh r1 X η / X = -r1 X η ∧ Real.sqrt (2 * X) * (deriv (fun Y => stressPrimZ r2 Y η) X + stressPrimZ r2 X η / (2 * X)) = -r2 X η) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, (X ≤ X0 ∨ X1 ≤ X) → stressPrimTh r1 X η = 0 ∧ stressPrimZ r2 X η = 0)

signature.name: stress_prim_props
signature.statement: ∀ (r1 r2 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε X0 X1 : ℝ), 0 < ε → 0 < X0 → X0 < X1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿r1) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿r2) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿r1) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿r2) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ X0 → -1 < η → η < 1 → r1 X η = 0 ∧ r2 X η = 0) → (∀ X η : ℝ, X1 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → r1 X η = 0 ∧ r2 X η = 0) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → (∫ X in Ioi (0:ℝ), X * r1 X η) = 0 ∧ (∫ X in Ioi (0:ℝ), r2 X η) = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(stressPrimTh r1)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(stressPrimZ r2)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(stressPrimTh r1)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(stressPrimZ r2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → deriv (fun Y => stressPrimTh r1 Y η) X + stressPrimTh r1 X η / X = -r1 X η ∧ Real.sqrt (2 * X) * (deriv (fun Y => stressPrimZ r2 Y η) X + stressPrimZ r2 X η / (2 * X)) = -r2 X η) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, (X ≤ X0 ∨ X1 ≤ X) → stressPrimTh r1 X η = 0 ∧ stressPrimZ r2 X η = 0)

by
  intro r1 r2 ε X0 X1 hε hX0 hX01 hr1 hr2 hbd hin hout hint
  have hΩo : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hΩsub : Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 :=
    prod_mono (fun x hx => by simp only [mem_Ioi] at hx ⊢; linarith) subset_rfl
  
  have heqd : ∀ (f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (V : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (z : ℝ × ℝ) (m : ℕ), IsOpen V → z ∈ V →
      (∀ p ∈ V, f p = g p) → iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g z := by
    intro f g V z m hVo hz hfg
    have hev : f =ᶠ[nhds z] g := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hVo.mem_nhds hz) hfg
    exact (hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds
  have hzero : ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (V : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (z : ℝ × ℝ) (m : ℕ), IsOpen V → z ∈ V →
      (∀ p ∈ V, f p = 0) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z‖ = 0 := by
    intro f V z m hVo hz hf
    rw [heqd f (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) V z m hVo hz hf, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
    simp
  have hcpt : ∀ (φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (U K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ U → IsCompact K →
      K ⊆ U → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k φ z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro φ U K hUo hφ hK hKU k
    have h1 := hφ.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (m := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      hUo.uniqueDiffOn
    have h2 : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k φ) U :=
      h1.congr (fun p hp => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hUo hp).symm)
    exact hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (h2.mono hKU)
  have hbd1 : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿r1) (X, η)‖ ≤ C :=
    fun m => (hbd m).imp (fun C hC X η a b c d => (hC X η a b c d).1)
  have hbd2 : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿r2) (X, η)‖ ≤ C :=
    fun m => (hbd m).imp (fun C hC X η a b c d => (hC X η a b c d).2)
  
  have hV : ∀ X η : ℝ, (X ≤ X0 ∨ X1 ≤ X) → stressPrimTh r1 X η = 0 ∧ stressPrimZ r2 X η = 0 := by
    intro X η hX
    by_cases hg : 0 < X ∧ -1 < η ∧ η < 1
    · obtain ⟨hX0', hη1, hη2⟩ := hg
      have key : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, x * r1 x η) = 0 ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, r2 x η) = 0 := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hX0'.le, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hX0'.le]
        rcases hX with hX | hX
        · constructor
          · apply setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
            intro x hx
            rw [(hin x η hx.1 (hx.2.trans hX) hη1 hη2).1, mul_zero]
          · apply setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
            intro x hx
            exact (hin x η hx.1 (hx.2.trans hX) hη1 hη2).2
        · have hsub : Ioc 0 X ⊆ Ioi (0:ℝ) := Ioc_subset_Ioi_self
          have hdiff : ∀ x ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) \ Ioc 0 X, X1 < x := by
            intro x hx
            simp only [mem_diff, mem_Ioi, mem_Ioc, not_and, not_le] at hx
            exact lt_of_le_of_lt hX (hx.2 hx.1)
          constructor
          · rw [← setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi hsub]
            · exact (hint η hη1 hη2).1
            · intro x hx
              rw [(hout x η (hdiff x hx) hη1 hη2).1, mul_zero]
          · rw [← setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi hsub]
            · exact (hint η hη1 hη2).2
            · intro x hx
              exact (hout x η (hdiff x hx) hη1 hη2).2
      rw [stressPrimTh, stressPrimZ, if_pos ⟨hX0', hη1, hη2⟩, if_pos ⟨hX0', hη1, hη2⟩, key.1,
        key.2, mul_zero, mul_zero]
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · rw [stressPrimTh, stressPrimZ, if_neg hg, if_neg hg]
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  
  have hg1s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e => x * r1 x e)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    have : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 * (↿r1) p) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
      contDiffOn_fst.mul hr1
    exact this
  have hg1b : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun x e => x * r1 x e)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C := by
    have hS0 : Icc 0 X1 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 :=
      prod_mono (fun x hx => by
        simp only [mem_Icc] at hx; simp only [mem_Ioi]; linarith [hx.1]) subset_rfl
    have hfst : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc 0 X1 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (Prod.fst : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hcpt Prod.fst univ (Icc 0 X1 ×ˢ Icc (-1) 1) isOpen_univ
        contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc) (subset_univ _) k
      exact ⟨C, fun z hz => hC z ⟨hz.1, Ioo_subset_Icc_self hz.2⟩⟩
    have hr1S : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc 0 X1 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿r1) z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbd1 k
      exact ⟨C, fun z hz => hC z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2⟩
    have hB := iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) Prod.fst (↿r1)
      (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc 0 X1 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo) hS0
      contDiff_fst.contDiffOn hr1 hfst hr1S
    have hfun : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ z.1 ((↿r1) z)) =
        ↿(fun x e => x * r1 x e) := by
      funext z
      rfl
    intro m
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hB m
    refine ⟨C, fun X η h0 h1 h2 h3 => ?_⟩
    rw [← hfun]
    exact hC (X, η) ⟨⟨h0, h1⟩, h2, h3⟩
  obtain ⟨P1, P2, P3⟩ := profRadAvg_props (fun x e => x * r1 x e) ε hε hg1s
  obtain ⟨Q1, Q2, Q3⟩ := profRadAvg_props r2 ε hε hr2
  set A1 := profRadAvg (fun x e => x * r1 x e) with hA1
  set A2 := profRadAvg r2 with hA2
  have hrepθ : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → stressPrimTh r1 X η = -A1 X η := by
    intro X η hX h1 h2
    have h := (P3 X η (by linarith) h1 h2).1
    have hI : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, x * r1 x η) = X * A1 X η := by rw [h]; rfl
    rw [stressPrimTh, if_pos ⟨hX, h1, h2⟩, hI, neg_mul, ← mul_assoc, one_div,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ hX.ne', one_mul]
  have hTsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(stressPrimTh r1)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
    (P1.mono hΩsub).neg.congr (fun p hp => hrepθ p.1 p.2 hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2)
  have hTbd : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(stressPrimTh r1)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := P2 X1 m (hg1b m)
    refine ⟨C, fun X η hX hX1 h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    rw [heqd (↿(stressPrimTh r1)) (-(↿A1 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)) _ (X, η) m hΩo ⟨hX, h1, h2⟩
      (fun p hp => hrepθ p.1 p.2 hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2), iteratedFDeriv_neg_apply, norm_neg]
    exact hC X η hX.le hX1 h1 h2
  have hTd : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      deriv (fun Y => stressPrimTh r1 Y η) X + stressPrimTh r1 X η / X = -r1 X η := by
    intro X η hX h1 h2
    have hJ := (P3 X η (by linarith) h1 h2).2
    have hD : HasDerivAt (fun Y => -((Y * A1 Y η) / Y))
        (-((X * r1 X η * X - X * A1 X η * 1) / X ^ 2)) X :=
      (hJ.div (hasDerivAt_id' X) hX.ne').neg
    have hev : (fun Y => stressPrimTh r1 Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X] (fun Y => -((Y * A1 Y η) / Y)) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hX] with Y hY
      rw [hrepθ Y η hY h1 h2, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (ne_of_gt hY)]
    rw [(hD.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).deriv, hrepθ X η hX h1 h2]
    have hXne := hX.ne'
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hrepZ : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      stressPrimZ r2 X η = -(X / Real.sqrt (2 * X)) * A2 X η := by
    intro X η hX h1 h2
    have h := (Q3 X η (by linarith) h1 h2).1
    have hI : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, r2 x η) = X * A2 X η := by rw [h]; rfl
    rw [stressPrimZ, if_pos ⟨hX, h1, h2⟩, hI]
    ring
  have hUo : IsOpen {p : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < p.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst
  have hφs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => -(p.1 / Real.sqrt (2 * p.1)))
      {p : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < p.1} := by
    have hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1)) {p : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < p.1} :=
      (contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_fst).sqrt
        (fun p (hp : 0 < p.1) => (mul_pos two_pos hp).ne')
    have := (contDiffOn_fst.div hs
      (fun p (hp : 0 < p.1) => Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (mul_pos two_pos hp))).neg
    exact this
  have hΩU : Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ {p : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < p.1} := fun p hp => hp.1
  have hZsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(stressPrimZ r2)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
    ((hφs.mono hΩU).mul (Q1.mono hΩsub)).congr
      (fun p hp => hrepZ p.1 p.2 hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2)
  have hZbd : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(stressPrimZ r2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C := by
    have hOo : IsOpen (Ioi (X0/2) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hSO : Icc X0 X1 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (X0/2) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
      prod_mono (fun x hx => by
        simp only [mem_Icc] at hx; simp only [mem_Ioi]; linarith [hx.1]) subset_rfl
    have hOU : Ioi (X0/2) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ {p : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < p.1} := fun p hp => by
      have : X0/2 < p.1 := hp.1
      show 0 < p.1
      linarith
    have hOΩ : Ioi (X0/2) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 :=
      prod_mono (fun x hx => by simp only [mem_Ioi] at hx ⊢; linarith) subset_rfl
    have hφb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc X0 X1 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => -(p.1 / Real.sqrt (2 * p.1))) z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hcpt _ _ (Icc X0 X1 ×ˢ Icc (-1) 1) hUo hφs
        (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)
        (fun p hp => by
          have : X0 ≤ p.1 := hp.1.1
          show 0 < p.1
          linarith) k
      exact ⟨C, fun z hz => hC z ⟨hz.1, Ioo_subset_Icc_self hz.2⟩⟩
    have hAb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc X0 X1 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿A2) z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := Q2 X1 k (hbd2 k)
      exact ⟨C, fun z hz => hC z.1 z.2 (by linarith [hz.1.1]) hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2⟩
    have hB := iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) _ (↿A2) _ _
      hOo hSO (hφs.mono hOU) (Q1.mono hOΩ) hφb hAb
    intro m
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hB m
    refine ⟨C, fun X η hX0' hX1' h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    have hXpos : 0 < X := by linarith
    rw [heqd (↿(stressPrimZ r2))
      (fun z => ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ (-(z.1 / Real.sqrt (2 * z.1))) ((↿A2) z)) _ (X, η) m
      hΩo ⟨hXpos, h1, h2⟩ (fun p hp => hrepZ p.1 p.2 hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2)]
    exact hC (X, η) ⟨⟨hX0', hX1'⟩, h1, h2⟩
  have hZd : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      Real.sqrt (2 * X) * (deriv (fun Y => stressPrimZ r2 Y η) X + stressPrimZ r2 X η / (2 * X))
        = -r2 X η := by
    intro X η hX h1 h2
    have hJ := (Q3 X η (by linarith) h1 h2).2
    have h2X : (2:ℝ) * X ≠ 0 := (mul_pos two_pos hX).ne'
    have hs := ((hasDerivAt_id' X).const_mul (2:ℝ)).sqrt h2X
    have hsne : Real.sqrt (2 * X) ≠ 0 := Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (mul_pos two_pos hX)
    have hD : HasDerivAt (fun Y => -((Y * A2 Y η) / Real.sqrt (2 * Y)))
        (-((r2 X η * Real.sqrt (2 * X) - X * A2 X η * (2 * 1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (2 * X))))
          / Real.sqrt (2 * X) ^ 2)) X :=
      (hJ.div hs hsne).neg
    have hev : (fun Y => stressPrimZ r2 Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X]
        (fun Y => -((Y * A2 Y η) / Real.sqrt (2 * Y))) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hX] with Y hY
      rw [hrepZ Y η hY h1 h2]
      ring
    rw [(hD.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).deriv, hrepZ X η hX h1 h2]
    have hs2 : Real.sqrt (2 * X) ^ 2 = 2 * X := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
    set s := Real.sqrt (2 * X) with hsdef
    rw [← hs2]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  refine ⟨hTsm, hZsm, ?_, fun X η hX h1 h2 => ⟨hTd X η hX h1 h2, hZd X η hX h1 h2⟩, hV⟩
  intro m
  obtain ⟨Ct, hCt⟩ := hTbd m
  obtain ⟨Cz, hCz⟩ := hZbd m
  refine ⟨max (max Ct Cz) 0, fun X η hX h1 h2 => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · by_cases hX1 : X ≤ X1
    · exact (hCt X η hX hX1 h1 h2).trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _))
    · rw [hzero (↿(stressPrimTh r1)) {p : ℝ × ℝ | X1 < p.1} (X, η) m
        (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst) (show X1 < X from not_le.mp hX1)
        (fun p hp => (hV p.1 p.2 (Or.inr (le_of_lt (show X1 < p.1 from hp)))).1)]
      exact le_max_right _ _
  · by_cases hXa : X < X0
    · rw [hzero (↿(stressPrimZ r2)) {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 < X0} (X, η) m
        (isOpen_lt continuous_fst continuous_const) hXa
        (fun p hp => (hV p.1 p.2 (Or.inl (le_of_lt (show p.1 < X0 from hp)))).2)]
      exact le_max_right _ _
    · by_cases hX1 : X ≤ X1
      · exact (hCz X η (not_lt.mp hXa) hX1 h1 h2).trans
          ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _))
      · rw [hzero (↿(stressPrimZ r2)) {p : ℝ × ℝ | X1 < p.1} (X, η) m
          (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst) (show X1 < X from not_le.mp hX1)
          (fun p hp => (hV p.1 p.2 (Or.inr (le_of_lt (show X1 < p.1 from hp)))).2)]
        exact le_max_right _ _

subgoal_signatures.name: profRadAvg_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profRadAvg g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(profRadAvg g)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → X * profRadAvg g X η = profRadInt g X η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * profRadAvg g Y η) (g X η) X)

subgoal_signatures.name: iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {E F G H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] H) (f : E → F) (g : E → G) (O S : Set E), IsOpen O → S ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g O → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z‖ ≤ C) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g z‖ ≤ C) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) z‖ ≤ C

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (Xa Xb aa ab Xm ε : ℝ) (r1 r2 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xa → Xa < Xm → Xm < Xb → 0 < aa → 0 < ab → 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿r1) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿r2) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ Xm → -1 < η → η < 1 → r1 X η = 0 ∧ r2 X η = 0) → (∀ X η : ℝ, Xb < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → r1 X η = 0 ∧ r2 X η = 0) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → (∫ X in Ioi (0:ℝ), X * r1 X η) = 0 ∧ (∫ X in Ioi (0:ℝ), r2 X η) = 0) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿r1) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿r2) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N)) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(stressPrimTh r1)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(stressPrimZ r2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N)

signature.name: stress_edge_bound
signature.statement: ∀ (Xa Xb aa ab Xm ε : ℝ) (r1 r2 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xa → Xa < Xm → Xm < Xb → 0 < aa → 0 < ab → 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿r1) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿r2) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ Xm → -1 < η → η < 1 → r1 X η = 0 ∧ r2 X η = 0) → (∀ X η : ℝ, Xb < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → r1 X η = 0 ∧ r2 X η = 0) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → (∫ X in Ioi (0:ℝ), X * r1 X η) = 0 ∧ (∫ X in Ioi (0:ℝ), r2 X η) = 0) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿r1) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿r2) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N)) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(stressPrimTh r1)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(stressPrimZ r2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have quasi : ∀ (Xa Xm Xb aa ab N : ℝ), 0 < Xa → Xa < Xm → Xm < Xb → 0 < aa → 0 < ab →
      0 ≤ N → ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ X x : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ x → x < Xb →
        edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab x * edgeDist Xa Xb x ^ (-N) ≤
          K * (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N)) := by
    intro Xa Xm Xb aa ab N hXa hXam hXmb haa hab hN
    obtain ⟨am, ham_def⟩ : ∃ am, am = Real.log (Xm / Xa) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have ham : 0 < am := by
      rw [ham_def]; exact Real.log_pos (by rw [lt_div_iff₀ hXa]; linarith)
    obtain ⟨d, hd_def⟩ : ∃ d, d = min (min 1 am) (ab / (N + 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
