      rintro ⟨Y, e⟩ ⟨hY, he1, he2⟩
      show stressPrimTh r1 Y e = _
      unfold stressPrimTh
      rw [if_pos ⟨hY, he1, he2⟩, backrep (fun x => x * r1 x e) ε Xb hε hXb0
        (hcont _ hg1 e he1 he2) (fun x hx => hg1z x e hx he1 he2) (hint e he1 he2).1 Y hY]
      beta_reduce
      ring
    have b1 : ∀ j, j ≤ m → ∀ x, X ≤ x → x < Xb →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (↿(fun x e : ℝ => x * r1 x e)) (x, η)‖ ≤
          2 ^ m * A1 * Cs * K * (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-Ns)) := by
      intro j hj x hXx hx
      have hxm : Xm ≤ x := hXm.trans hXx
      have hxU : (x, η) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨show -ε < x by linarith, hη1, hη2⟩
      have hxK : (x, η) ∈ Icc Xm Xb ×ˢ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨⟨hxm, hx.le⟩, hη1.le, hη2.le⟩
      have e1 : (↿(fun x e : ℝ => x * r1 x e)) =
          fun q : ℝ × ℝ => (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1) q * (↿r1) q := rfl
      have hm := mulb (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1) (↿r1) _ (x, η) j A1
        (Cs * (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab x * edgeDist Xa Xb x ^ (-Ns))) hU hxU
        contDiff_fst.contDiffOn hr1 (fun i hi => hA1 i (hi.trans hj) _ hxK)
        (fun i hi => (hnorm i (hi.trans hj) x η (by linarith) hx hη1 hη2).1)
      rw [e1]
      have hWx := hK X x hXm hXx hx
      have h2j : (2:ℝ) ^ j ≤ 2 ^ m := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hj
      have hWx0 := hW_nn Ns x (by linarith) hx
      calc _ ≤ 2 ^ j * A1 * (Cs * (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab x * edgeDist Xa Xb x ^ (-Ns))) := hm
        _ ≤ 2 ^ m * A1 * (Cs * (K * (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-Ns)))) :=
            mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2j hA10)
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hWx hCs0) (mul_nonneg hCs0 hWx0) (by positivity)
        _ = _ := by ring
    have P1 := hgen (fun x e : ℝ => x * r1 x e) (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => Xb / q.1)
      (↿(stressPrimTh r1)) A2 _ hg1 hg1z ha2 hA2 rep1 (by positivity) b1
    
    have rep2 : ∀ q ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, (↿(stressPrimZ r2)) q =
        (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => Xb / Real.sqrt (2 * q.1)) q *
          ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, r2 (q.1 + Xb * s) q.2 := by
      rintro ⟨Y, e⟩ ⟨hY, he1, he2⟩
      show stressPrimZ r2 Y e = _
      unfold stressPrimZ
      rw [if_pos ⟨hY, he1, he2⟩, backrep (fun x => r2 x e) ε Xb hε hXb0
        (hcont _ hr2 e he1 he2) (fun x hx => (hout x e hx he1 he2).2) (hint e he1 he2).2 Y hY]
      beta_reduce
      ring
    have b2 : ∀ j, j ≤ m → ∀ x, X ≤ x → x < Xb →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (↿r2) (x, η)‖ ≤
          Cs * K * (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-Ns)) := by
      intro j hj x hXx hx
      have hWx := hK X x hXm hXx hx
      calc _ ≤ Cs * (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab x * edgeDist Xa Xb x ^ (-Ns)) :=
            (hnorm j hj x η (by linarith) hx hη1 hη2).2
        _ ≤ Cs * (K * (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-Ns))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hWx hCs0
        _ = _ := by ring
    have P2 := hgen r2 (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => Xb / Real.sqrt (2 * q.1)) (↿(stressPrimZ r2))
      A3 _ hr2 (fun x e hx he1 he2 => (hout x e hx he1 he2).2) ha3 hA3 rep2 (by positivity) b2
    constructor
    · calc _ ≤ _ := P1
        _ = 2 ^ m * A2 * (2 ^ m * A1 * Cs * K) *
              (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-Ns)) := by ring
        _ ≤ Cc * (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-Ns)) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hWX
            rw [hCc]; linarith
    · calc _ ≤ _ := P2
        _ = 2 ^ m * A3 * (Cs * K) *
              (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-Ns)) := by ring
        _ ≤ Cc * (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-Ns)) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hWX
            rw [hCc]; linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → Xa < Xm → Xm < Xs → Xs < Xb → BgCoeffSeq h Xm Xs m1 m2 F U S G W → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgResTh h S G W 1)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgResZ h S G W 1)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N)

signature.name: bg_res_one_edge
signature.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → Xa < Xm → Xm < Xs → Xs < Xb → BgCoeffSeq h Xm Xs m1 m2 F U S G W → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgResTh h S G W 1)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgResZ h S G W 1)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs F U T0th T0z S G W hS hL hXam hXms hXsb hB
  have hL' := hL
  unfold LeadingProfile at hL'
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, hh1, -, hcinf, -, haa, hab, hXa0, hXap1, hp12, hp2m1, hm12, hm2v, hXvc, hXcb⟩,
    ⟨hFs, -, -, -⟩, -, -, -, -, -, hL8, -, -, hL10⟩ := hL'
  have hB' := hB
  unfold BgCoeffSeq at hB'
  obtain ⟨⟨hS0, hG0, -⟩, -, -, hBsupp, -, -, hBin, -⟩ := hB'
  
  have T1 : ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (U K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w‖ ≤ C := by
    intro f U K hU hK hKU hf k
    have hc : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k f U) U :=
      hf.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hU.uniqueDiffOn
    have hc' : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f) U :=
      hc.congr (fun w hw => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hU hw).symm)
    exact hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hc'.mono hKU)
  
  have hed : ∀ X, Xa < X → X < Xb → 0 < edgeDist Xa Xb X ∧ edgeDist Xa Xb X ≤ 1 := by
    intro X h1 h2
    have hX0 : 0 < X := by linarith
    have l1 : 0 < Real.log (X / Xa) := Real.log_pos (by rw [lt_div_iff₀ hXa0]; linarith)
    have l2 : 0 < Real.log (Xb / X) := Real.log_pos (by rw [lt_div_iff₀ hX0]; linarith)
    exact ⟨lt_min one_pos (lt_min l1 l2), min_le_left _ _⟩
  have hew0 : ∀ X, 0 ≤ edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X := by
    intro X; unfold edgeWeight; split_ifs <;> positivity
  have hpow_mono : ∀ X N N' : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → N ≤ N' →
      edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) ≤ edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N') := fun X N N' h1 h2 hN =>
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge (hed X h1 h2).1 (hed X h1 h2).2 (by linarith)
  have hpow_one : ∀ X N : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → 0 ≤ N → 1 ≤ edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) :=
    fun X N h1 h2 hN => Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos (hed X h1 h2).1 (hed X h1 h2).2
      (by linarith)
  have hpow_nn : ∀ X N : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → 0 ≤ edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) :=
    fun X N h1 h2 => Real.rpow_nonneg (hed X h1 h2).1.le _
  
  have unif : ∀ (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (X1 : ℝ), Xa < X1 → edgeFlatOn Xa Xb aa ab X1 g → ∀ m : ℕ,
      ∃ C N : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 ≤ N ∧ ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ X η : ℝ, X1 ≤ X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) := by
    intro g X1 hX1 hg m
    choose Cf Nf hf using hg
    refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Cf i|, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Nf i|,
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _), Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _), ?_⟩
    intro j hj X η h1 h2 h3 h4
    have hjm : j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
    have hXa : Xa < X := by linarith
    have hC : |Cf j| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Cf i| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cf i|) (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) hjm
    have hN : |Nf j| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Nf i| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Nf i|) (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) hjm
    have e1 := hew0 X
    have e2 := hpow_mono X (Nf j) (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Nf i|) hXa h2 ((le_abs_self _).trans hN)
    have e3 := hpow_nn X (Nf j) hXa h2
    calc _ ≤ Cf j * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-Nf j) := hf j X η h1 h2 h3 h4
      _ ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Cf i|) * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X *
            edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Nf i|)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ((le_abs_self _).trans hC) e1) e2 e3
        exact mul_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)) e1
  
  have T3 : ∀ (X0 X1 : ℝ) (a g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), X0 < X1 → Xa < X1 →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a (Ioi X0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Ioi X0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ A : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X1 ≤ X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k a (X, η)‖ ≤ A) →
      edgeFlatOn Xa Xb aa ab X1 g → edgeFlatOn Xa Xb aa ab X1 (fun w => a w * g w) := by
    intro X0 X1 a g hX01 hXa1 ha hg hab hge m
    have hO : IsOpen (Ioi X0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
    choose A hA using hab
    obtain ⟨C, N, hC0, -, hCg⟩ := unif g X1 hXa1 hge m
    obtain ⟨Am, hAm⟩ : ∃ Am : ℝ, Am = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |A i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hAm0 : 0 ≤ Am := by rw [hAm]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
    refine ⟨(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ)) * Am * C, N, ?_⟩
    intro X η h1 h2 h3 h4
    have hw : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi X0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨show X0 < X by linarith, h3, h4⟩
    have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le ha hg hO.uniqueDiffOn hw (n := m)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => a y * g y) m hO hw] at key
    refine key.trans ?_
    calc _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) *
          (Am * (C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N))) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          have hi' : i ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := a) i hO hw,
            iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := g) (m - i) hO hw]
          have e1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i a (X, η)‖ ≤ Am := by
            refine (hA i X η h1 h2 h3 h4).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans ?_)
            rw [hAm]
            exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |A i|) (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) hi
          have e2 := hCg (m - i) (Nat.sub_le m i) X η h1 h2 h3 h4
          rw [mul_assoc]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul e1 e2 (norm_nonneg _) hAm0) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul]; ring
  
  have T3s : ∀ (X0 X1 : ℝ) (g1 g2 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), X0 < X1 → Xa < X1 →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g1 (Ioi X0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g2 (Ioi X0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      edgeFlatOn Xa Xb aa ab X1 g1 → edgeFlatOn Xa Xb aa ab X1 g2 →
      edgeFlatOn Xa Xb aa ab X1 (fun w => g1 w + g2 w) := by
    intro X0 X1 g1 g2 hX01 hXa1 h1s h2s h1e h2e m
    have hO : IsOpen (Ioi X0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
    obtain ⟨C1, N1, hC1, hN1, b1⟩ := unif g1 X1 hXa1 h1e m
    obtain ⟨C2, N2, hC2, hN2, b2⟩ := unif g2 X1 hXa1 h2e m
    refine ⟨C1 + C2, N1 + N2, ?_⟩
    intro X η k1 k2 k3 k4
    have hw : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi X0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨show X0 < X by linarith, k3, k4⟩
    have hXa : Xa < X := by linarith
    have d1 : ContDiffAt ℝ m g1 (X, η) :=
      (h1s.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hw)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have d2 : ContDiffAt ℝ m g2 (X, η) :=
      (h2s.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hw)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e := iteratedFDeriv_add_apply d1 d2
    rw [show (fun w => g1 w + g2 w) = g1 + g2 from rfl, e]
    have p1 := hpow_mono X N1 (N1 + N2) hXa k2 (by linarith)
    have p2 := hpow_mono X N2 (N1 + N2) hXa k2 (by linarith)
    have q1 := b1 m le_rfl X η k1 k2 k3 k4
    have q2 := b2 m le_rfl X η k1 k2 k3 k4
    have ew := hew0 X
    calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g1 (X, η)‖ + ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g2 (X, η)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ C1 * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-(N1 + N2)) +
          C2 * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-(N1 + N2)) :=
        add_le_add (q1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left p1 (mul_nonneg hC1 ew)))
          (q2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left p2 (mul_nonneg hC2 ew)))
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hO : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have slices : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ∀ Y e : ℝ, 0 < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 →
        HasDerivAt (fun Y' => g Y' e) (fderiv ℝ (↿g) (Y, e) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) Y ∧
        HasDerivAt (fun e' => g Y e') (fderiv ℝ (↿g) (Y, e) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) e := by
    intro g hg Y e hY h1 h2
    have hw : ((Y, e) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨hY, h1, h2⟩
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿g) (Y, e) :=
      (hg.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hw)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    constructor
    · have k : HasDerivAt (fun Y' : ℝ => (Y', e)) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) Y :=
        (hasDerivAt_id' Y).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const Y e)
      exact hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt Y k
    · have k : HasDerivAt (fun e' : ℝ => (Y, e')) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) e :=
        (hasDerivAt_const e Y).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' e)
      exact hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt e k
  
  have T4 : ∀ (X1 b : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < X1 → Xa < X1 → X1 < Xb →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → edgeFlatOn Xa Xb aa ab X1 (↿f) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(simZop h b f)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
        edgeFlatOn Xa Xb aa ab X1 (↿(simZop h b f)) := by
    intro X1 b f hX1 hXa1 hX1b hf hfe
    have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hO (by simp)
    have part : ∀ (v : ℝ × ℝ) (p : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
        (∀ w ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, (↿p) w = fderiv ℝ (↿f) w v) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ edgeFlatOn Xa Xb aa ab X1 (↿p) := by
      intro v p hp
      have hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿f))
          (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hfd
      have heq : ∀ w ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
          (↿p) w = (⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿f)) w := fun w hw => hp w hw
      refine ⟨hs.congr heq, ?_⟩
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C, N, hb⟩ := hfe (k + 1)
      refine ⟨‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v‖ * C, N, ?_⟩
      intro X η h1 h2 h3 h4
      have hw : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨show (0:ℝ) < X by linarith, h3, h4⟩
      have hev : (↿p) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)] (⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿f)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hw) heq
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
      have e1 := (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v).norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left
        (hfd.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hw)) (n := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv] at e1
      calc _ ≤ _ := e1
        _ ≤ ‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v‖ *
            (C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb X η h1 h2 h3 h4) (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = _ := by ring
    have hpX := part ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) (pdX f)
      (fun w hw => (slices f hf w.1 w.2 hw.1 hw.2.1 hw.2.2).1.deriv)
    have hpE := part ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) (pdE f)
      (fun w hw => (slices f hf w.1 w.2 hw.1 hw.2.1 hw.2.2).2.deriv)
    obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ : ∃ V : Set (ℝ × ℝ), V = {w | 2 * h * w.2 ^ 2 < 1} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hVo : IsOpen V := by rw [hV]; exact isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
    have hden : ∀ w ∈ V, 1 - 2 * h * w.2 ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [hV] at hw

    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, N, hb⟩ := hL10 k
    exact ⟨C, N, fun X η k1 k2 k3 k4 => hb X η (by linarith) k2 k3 k4⟩
  have hRid : ∀ w ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, (↿R) w = a w * Dl w := by
    intro w hw
    rw [hadef, hDldef]
    exact (hRv' w.1 w.2).trans (hRv w.1 w.2 hw.1)
  have hRe : edgeFlatOn Xa Xb aa ab X1 (↿R) := by
    have hprod := T3 0 X1 a Dl hX1pos hXaX1 (has.mono hsub) hDls habd hDle
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, N, hb⟩ := hprod k
    refine ⟨C, N, fun X η k1 k2 k3 k4 => ?_⟩
    have hw : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨show (0:ℝ) < X by linarith, k3, k4⟩
    have hev : (↿R) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)] (fun w => a w * Dl w) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hw) hRid
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
    exact hb X η k1 k2 k3 k4
  have hT1 := T4 X1 (-(1 + h)) R hX1pos hXaX1 hX1b hRs hRe
  have hT2 := T4 X1 (-(1 + h) - (1 / 2 - h)) (simZop h (-(1 + h)) R) hX1pos hXaX1 hX1b hT1.1 hT1.2
  have hZZe := hT2.2
  
  have hThnorm : ∀ (k : ℕ) (X η : ℝ), Xs < X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(bgResTh h S G W 1)) (X, η)‖ =
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(simZop h (-(1 + h) - (1 / 2 - h)) (simZop h (-(1 + h)) R))) (X, η)‖ := by
    intro k X η hX h1 h2
    have hΩ : IsOpen (Ioi Xs ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hw : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi Xs ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨hX, h1, h2⟩
    have hev : (↿(bgResTh h S G W 1)) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)]
        -(↿(simZop h (-(1 + h) - (1 / 2 - h)) (simZop h (-(1 + h)) R))) := by
      apply Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hΩ.mem_nhds hw)
      intro w hw'
      have hws : Xs < w.1 := hw'.1
      have hw0 : 0 < w.1 := by linarith
      show bgResTh h S G W 1 w.1 w.2 = -(simZop h _ (simZop h _ R) w.1 w.2)
      rw [tailTh w.1 w.2 hws hw'.2.1 hw'.2.2, hZZ w.1 w.2 hw0 hw'.2.1 hw'.2.2]
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_neg_apply, norm_neg]
  have zeroZ : ∀ (k : ℕ) (X η : ℝ), X1 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(bgResZ h S G W 1)) (X, η) = 0 := by
    intro k X η hX h1 h2
    have hΩ : IsOpen (Ioi (max Xs Xv) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hmx : max Xs Xv < X := max_lt (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hw : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (max Xs Xv) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨hmx, h1, h2⟩
    have hev : (↿(bgResZ h S G W 1)) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
      apply Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hΩ.mem_nhds hw)
      intro w hw'
      have hm : max Xs Xv < w.1 := hw'.1
      exact tailZ w.1 w.2 (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hm)
        (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hm) hw'.2.1 hw'.2.2
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
    exact congrFun iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero (X, η)
  have zeroI : ∀ (k : ℕ) (X η : ℝ), 0 < X → X < Xm → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(bgResTh h S G W 1)) (X, η) = 0 ∧
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(bgResZ h S G W 1)) (X, η) = 0 := by
    intro k X η hX0 hXm h1 h2
    have hΩ : IsOpen (Ioo 0 Xm ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hw : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioo 0 Xm ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨⟨hX0, hXm⟩, h1, h2⟩
    have hev1 : (↿(bgResTh h S G W 1)) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)] fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hΩ.mem_nhds hw)
        (fun w hw' => (hBin 1 le_rfl w.1 w.2 hw'.1.1 hw'.1.2.le hw'.2.1 hw'.2.2).1)
    have hev2 : (↿(bgResZ h S G W 1)) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)] fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hΩ.mem_nhds hw)
        (fun w hw' => (hBin 1 le_rfl w.1 w.2 hw'.1.1 hw'.1.2.le hw'.2.1 hw'.2.2).2)
    rw [(hev1.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds, (hev2.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
    exact ⟨congrFun iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero (X, η), congrFun iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero (X, η)⟩
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = Real.exp (-(aa / Real.log (Xm / Xa) ^ 2) - ab / Real.log (Xb / X1) ^ 2) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hcpos : 0 < c := by rw [hc]; exact Real.exp_pos _
  have hcle : ∀ X, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → c ≤ edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X := by
    intro X hX1' hX2'
    have hX0 : 0 < X := by linarith
    unfold edgeWeight
    rw [if_pos ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, hc]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have l1 : 0 < Real.log (Xm / Xa) := Real.log_pos (by rw [lt_div_iff₀ hXa0]; linarith)
    have l2 : Real.log (Xm / Xa) ≤ Real.log (X / Xa) :=
      Real.log_le_log (div_pos (by linarith) hXa0) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hX1' hXa0.le)
    have l3 : 0 < Real.log (Xb / X1) := Real.log_pos (by rw [lt_div_iff₀ hX1pos]; linarith)
    have l4 : Real.log (Xb / X1) ≤ Real.log (Xb / X) :=
      Real.log_le_log (div_pos (by linarith) hX1pos) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hX0 hX2')
    have q1 : aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2 ≤ aa / Real.log (Xm / Xa) ^ 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left haa.le (pow_pos l1 2) (pow_le_pow_left₀ l1.le l2 2)
    have q2 : ab / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2 ≤ ab / Real.log (Xb / X1) ^ 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hab.le (pow_pos l3 2) (pow_le_pow_left₀ l3.le l4 2)
    linarith
  
  intro m
  obtain ⟨ε8, hε8, hR8⟩ := bg_coef_regular h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs
    F U T0th T0z S G W hS hL hB
  obtain ⟨B, hBd⟩ := (hR8 1 le_rfl).2.2.2.2.1 X1 m
  obtain ⟨C3, N3, h3⟩ := hZZe m
  refine ⟨max (max B 0 / c) (max C3 0), max N3 0, ?_⟩
  intro X η hX1' hX2' h1 h2
  have hCnn : 0 ≤ max (max B 0 / c) (max C3 0) := le_max_of_le_right (le_max_right _ _)
  have hew := hew0 X
  have hp1 := hpow_one X (max N3 0) hX1' hX2' (le_max_right _ _)
  have hpn := hpow_nn X (max N3 0) hX1' hX2'
  have hnn : 0 ≤ max (max B 0 / c) (max C3 0) * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X *
      edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-max N3 0) := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCnn hew) hpn
  rcases lt_or_ge X Xm with hXm | hXm
  · obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := zeroI m X η (by linarith) hXm h1 h2
    rw [z1, z2, norm_zero]
    exact ⟨hnn, hnn⟩
  rcases le_or_gt X X1 with hXX1 | hXX1
  · obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := hBd X η (by linarith) hXX1 h1 h2
    have hc1 := hcle X hXm hXX1
    have key : max B 0 ≤ max (max B 0 / c) (max C3 0) * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X *
        edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-max N3 0) := by
      calc max B 0 = max B 0 / c * c := (div_mul_cancel₀ _ hcpos.ne').symm
        _ ≤ max (max B 0 / c) (max C3 0) * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X :=
          mul_le_mul (le_max_left _ _) hc1 hcpos.le hCnn
        _ = max (max B 0 / c) (max C3 0) * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp1 (mul_nonneg hCnn hew)
    exact ⟨b1.trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans key), b2.trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans key)⟩
  · constructor
    · rw [hThnorm m X η (by linarith) h1 h2]
      calc _ ≤ C3 * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N3) := h3 X η hXX1.le hX2' h1 h2
        _ ≤ max C3 0 * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N3) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hew)
            (hpow_nn X N3 hX1' hX2')
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) hew)
            (hpow_mono X N3 (max N3 0) hX1' hX2' (le_max_left _ _)) (hpow_nn X N3 hX1' hX2')
            (mul_nonneg hCnn hew)
    · rw [zeroZ m X η hXX1 h1 h2, norm_zero]
      exact hnn

subgoal_signatures.name: bg_coef_regular
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → BgCoeffSeq h Xm Xs m1 m2 F U S G W → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgResTh h S G W k)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgResZ h S G W k)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgUz (S k))) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun (X η : ℝ) => X * bgVx h k (S k) X η)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X1 : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgResTh h S G W k)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgResZ h S G W k)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgUz (S k))) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun (X η : ℝ) => X * bgVx h k (S k) X η)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)

subgoal_signatures.name: heatK_deriv_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ β Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → 0 < Z → HasDerivAt (fun Y => heatK β Y) (-β * heatK (β + 1) Z) Z ∧ |heatK β Z| ≤ Real.Gamma (β + 1)

subgoal_signatures.name: heatK_ode
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h Z : ℝ, 0 < h → 0 < Z → (h + 1) * Z ^ 2 * heatK (h + 2) Z - (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * heatK (h + 1) Z + (1 + h) * heatK h Z = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: heatProfile_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → (∀ β Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → 0 < Z → HasDerivAt (fun Y => heatK β Y) (-β * heatK (β + 1) Z) Z ∧ |heatK β Z| ≤ Real.Gamma (β + 1)) → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → (h + 1) * Z ^ 2 * heatK (h + 2) Z - (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * heatK (h + 1) Z + (1 + h) * heatK h Z = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv k (heatProfile h) Z| ≤ C) ∧ (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → Z ^ 2 * deriv (deriv (heatProfile h)) Z + (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * deriv (heatProfile h) Z + h * (1 + h) * heatProfile h Z = 0)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → Xa < Xm → Xm < Xs → Xs < Xb → BgCoeffSeq h Xm Xs m1 m2 F U S G W → ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ X η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → (Xb < X ∨ (2 ≤ n ∧ Xs < X)) → bgResTh h S G W n X η = 0 ∧ bgResZ h S G W n X η = 0

signature.name: bg_res_vanish
signature.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → Xa < Xm → Xm < Xs → Xs < Xb → BgCoeffSeq h Xm Xs m1 m2 F U S G W → ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ X η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → (Xb < X ∨ (2 ≤ n ∧ Xs < X)) → bgResTh h S G W n X η = 0 ∧ bgResZ h S G W n X η = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs F U T0th T0z S G W hS hL hXam hXms
    hXsb hB n hn X η h1 h2 hcase
  unfold BgCoeffSeq at hB
  obtain ⟨⟨hS0, hG0, -⟩, -, -, hBsupp, -⟩ := hB
  unfold LeadingProfile at hL
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, -, -, hcinf, -, -, -, hXa0, hXap1, hp12, hp2m1, hm12, hm2v, hXvc, hXcb⟩,
    ⟨hFs, -, -, -⟩, -, -, -, -, hL7, hL8, -, -, -⟩ := hL
  
  have loc : ∀ (a : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → f Y e = 0) →
      ∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → pdX f Y e = 0 ∧ pdE f Y e = 0 := by
    intro a f hf Y e hY he1 he2
    constructor
    · unfold pdX
      have hev : (fun Y' => f Y' e) =ᶠ[nhds Y] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hY] with Y' hY'
        exact hf Y' e hY' he1 he2
      rw [hev.deriv_eq]
      simp
    · unfold pdE
      have hev : (fun e' => f Y e') =ᶠ[nhds e] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds he1 he2] with e' he'
        exact hf Y e' hY he'.1 he'.2
      rw [hev.deriv_eq]
      simp
  
  have clo : ∀ (a : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → f Y e = 0) →
      (∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → pdX f Y e = 0) ∧
      (∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → bgUz f Y e = 0) ∧
      (∀ (i : ℕ) (Y e : ℝ), a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → bgVx h i f Y e = 0) ∧
      (∀ (b Y e : ℝ), a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → simTop h b f Y e = 0) ∧
      (∀ (b Y e : ℝ), a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → simZop h b f Y e = 0) := by
    intro a f hf
    refine ⟨fun Y e hY he1 he2 => (loc a f hf Y e hY he1 he2).1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro Y e hY he1 he2
      simp [bgUz, hf Y e hY he1 he2, (loc a f hf Y e hY he1 he2).1]
    · intro i Y e hY he1 he2
      simp [bgVx, bgUz, hf Y e hY he1 he2, (loc a f hf Y e hY he1 he2).1,
        (loc a f hf Y e hY he1 he2).2]
    · intro b Y e hY he1 he2
      simp [simTop, hf Y e hY he1 he2, (loc a f hf Y e hY he1 he2).1,
        (loc a f hf Y e hY he1 he2).2]
    · intro b Y e hY he1 he2
      simp [simZop, hf Y e hY he1 he2, (loc a f hf Y e hY he1 he2).1,
        (loc a f hf Y e hY he1 he2).2]
  have hXsX : Xs < X := by
    rcases hcase with h' | ⟨_, h'⟩
    · linarith
    · exact h'
  have ZS : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ Y e : ℝ, Xs < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → S j Y e = 0 :=
    fun j hj Y e hY _ _ => (hBsupp j hj Y e hY.le).1
  have ZG : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ Y e : ℝ, Xs < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → G j Y e = 0 :=
    fun j hj Y e hY _ _ => (hBsupp j hj Y e hY.le).2.1
  have ZW : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ Y e : ℝ, Xs < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → W j Y e = 0 :=
    fun j hj Y e hY _ _ => (hBsupp j hj Y e hY.le).2.2
  
  have hZS0 : ∀ Y e : ℝ, Xv < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → profRadAvg U Y e = 0 := by
    intro Y e hY he1 he2
    have hY0 : 0 < Y := by linarith
    have h3 : Y * profRadAvg U Y e = profRadInt U Y e := by
      have := intervalIntegral.mul_integral_comp_mul_right (a := 0) (b := 1)
        (f := fun x => U x e) Y
      simpa [profRadAvg, profRadInt] using this
    rw [(hL8 Y e hY.le he1 he2).2] at h3
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h3 with h' | h'
    · linarith
    · exact h'
  have hXb0 : 0 < Xb := by linarith
  have hFd : ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y' => F Y' 0) Y := by
    intro Y hY
    have hmem : (Y, (0:ℝ)) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨hY, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
    have hopen : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hc := (hFs.contDiffAt (hopen.mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y' : ℝ => (Y', (0:ℝ))) Y :=
      differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const _)
    exact DifferentiableAt.comp (g := ↿F) Y hc h2
  have hFeq : ∀ Y e : ℝ, Xb < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 →
      F Y e = cinf / Real.sqrt 2 * Y ^ (-(1 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / Y) := by
    intro Y e hY he1 he2
    have hY0 : 0 < Y := by linarith
    have hL := (hL7 Y e hY.le he1 he2).2
    have hs2 : 0 < Real.sqrt 2 := by positivity
    have hsY : 0 < Real.sqrt Y := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hY0
    have hsq : Real.sqrt (2 * Y) = Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt Y := Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num) Y
    have hpow : Y ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) = Y ^ (-(1 + h)) * Real.sqrt Y := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_add hY0]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [hsq, hpow] at hL
    have e1 : F Y e = (Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt Y * F Y e) / (Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt Y) := by
      field_simp
    rw [e1, hL]
    field_simp
  
  have hHd : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z → z < 2 / Xb → DifferentiableAt ℝ (heatProfile h) z := by
    intro z hz hzb
    have h2z : 0 < 2 / z := by positivity
    have hgd : DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun w : ℝ => Real.sqrt 2 / cinf * (2 / w) ^ (1 + h) * F (2 / w) 0) z := by
      have hd1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ => 2 / w) z :=
        (differentiableAt_const _).div differentiableAt_id hz.ne'
      have hd2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ => (2 / w) ^ (1 + h)) z :=
        hd1.rpow_const (Or.inl h2z.ne')
      have hd3 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ => F (2 / w) 0) z :=
        (hFd (2 / z) h2z).comp z hd1
      exact (hd2.const_mul _).mul hd3
    apply hgd.congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds hz hzb] with w hw
    have hw0 : 0 < w := hw.1
    have hY : Xb < 2 / w := by
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ hw0]
      have := (lt_div_iff₀ hXb0).mp hw.2
      linarith
    have hFw := hFeq (2 / w) 0 hY (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have harg : 2 * (1 - (0:ℝ) ^ 2) / (2 / w) = w := by
      rw [show (1:ℝ) - 0 ^ 2 = 1 by norm_num]
      field_simp
    rw [harg] at hFw
    rw [hFw]
    have hp : 0 < (2 / w) ^ (1 + h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by positivity)]
    have hs2 : 0 < Real.sqrt 2 := by positivity
    field_simp
  have hZF : ∀ Y e : ℝ, Xb < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → simZop h (-(1 + h)) F Y e = 0 := by
    intro Y e hY he1 he2
    have hY0 : 0 < Y := by linarith
    have hd : 0 < 1 - e ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hz : 0 < 2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / Y := by positivity
    have hzb : 2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / Y < 2 / Xb := by
      rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ hY0 hXb0]
      have he2' : 0 ≤ e ^ 2 := sq_nonneg e
      nlinarith
    obtain ⟨H', hH⟩ : ∃ H', HasDerivAt (heatProfile h) H' (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / Y) :=
      ⟨_, (hHd _ hz hzb).hasDerivAt⟩
    have hX1 : HasDerivAt (fun Y' : ℝ => 2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / Y')
        ((0 * Y - 2 * (1 - e ^ 2) * 1) / Y ^ 2) Y :=
      (hasDerivAt_const Y (2 * (1 - e ^ 2))).div (hasDerivAt_id' Y) hY0.ne'
    have hX2 : HasDerivAt (fun Y' : ℝ => Y' ^ (-(1 + h))) (-(1 + h) * Y ^ (-(1 + h) - 1)) Y :=
      Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl hY0.ne')
    have hXF : HasDerivAt
        (fun Y' : ℝ => cinf / Real.sqrt 2 * Y' ^ (-(1 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / Y'))
        (cinf / Real.sqrt 2 * (-(1 + h) * Y ^ (-(1 + h) - 1)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / Y) +
          cinf / Real.sqrt 2 * Y ^ (-(1 + h)) * (H' * ((0 * Y - 2 * (1 - e ^ 2) * 1) / Y ^ 2))) Y :=
      (hX2.const_mul (cinf / Real.sqrt 2)).mul (hH.comp Y hX1)
    have hE1 : HasDerivAt (fun e' : ℝ => 2 * (1 - e' ^ 2) / Y) (-(4 * e) / Y) e := by
      have := (((hasDerivAt_pow 2 e).const_sub 1).const_mul 2).div_const Y
      convert this using 1
      norm_num
      ring
    have hEF : HasDerivAt
        (fun e' : ℝ => cinf / Real.sqrt 2 * Y ^ (-(1 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e' ^ 2) / Y))
        (cinf / Real.sqrt 2 * Y ^ (-(1 + h)) * (H' * (-(4 * e) / Y))) e :=
      (hH.comp e hE1).const_mul _
    have hpdX : pdX F Y e =
        cinf / Real.sqrt 2 * (-(1 + h) * Y ^ (-(1 + h) - 1)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / Y) +
          cinf / Real.sqrt 2 * Y ^ (-(1 + h)) * (H' * ((0 * Y - 2 * (1 - e ^ 2) * 1) / Y ^ 2)) := by
      unfold pdX
      have hev : (fun Y' => F Y' e) =ᶠ[nhds Y]
          (fun Y' : ℝ => cinf / Real.sqrt 2 * Y' ^ (-(1 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / Y')) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hY] with Y' hY'
        exact hFeq Y' e hY' he1 he2
      rw [hev.deriv_eq]
      exact hXF.deriv
    have hpdE : pdE F Y e = cinf / Real.sqrt 2 * Y ^ (-(1 + h)) * (H' * (-(4 * e) / Y)) := by
      unfold pdE
      have hev : (fun e' => F Y e') =ᶠ[nhds e]
          (fun e' : ℝ => cinf / Real.sqrt 2 * Y ^ (-(1 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e' ^ 2) / Y)) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds he1 he2] with e' he'
        exact hFeq Y e' hY he'.1 he'.2
      rw [hev.deriv_eq]
      exact hEF.deriv
    unfold simZop
    rw [hpdX, hpdE, hFeq Y e hY he1 he2, Real.rpow_sub_one hY0.ne']
    rw [div_eq_zero_iff]
    left
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hThfin : simZop h (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h))
      (simZop h (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) (G (n - 1))) X η = 0 := by
    by_cases h2n : 2 ≤ n
    · have hj : 1 ≤ n - 1 := by omega
      have Z1 := (clo Xs _ (ZG (n - 1) hj)).2.2.2.2 (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h)
      exact (clo Xs _ Z1).2.2.2.2 _ X η hXsX h1 h2
    · have hX : Xb < X := by
        rcases hcase with h' | ⟨h', _⟩
        · exact h'
        · omega
      have hn1 : n - 1 = 0 := by omega
      have hb : -(1 + h) + 2 * ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h = -(1 + h) := by
        rw [hn1]
        simp
      rw [hb, hn1, hG0]
      exact (clo Xb _ hZF).2.2.2.2 _ X η hX h1 h2
  have hZfin : simZop h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h))
      (simZop h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) (bgUz (S (n - 1)))) X η = 0 := by
    by_cases h2n : 2 ≤ n
    · have hj : 1 ≤ n - 1 := by omega
      have Z0 := (clo Xs _ (ZS (n - 1) hj)).2.1
      have Z1 := (clo Xs _ Z0).2.2.2.2 (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h)
      exact (clo Xs _ Z1).2.2.2.2 _ X η hXsX h1 h2
    · have hX : Xb < X := by
        rcases hcase with h' | ⟨h', _⟩
        · exact h'
        · omega
      have hn1 : n - 1 = 0 := by omega
      rw [hn1, hS0]
      have Z0 := (clo Xv _ hZS0).2.1
      have Z1 := (clo Xv _ Z0).2.2.2.2 (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h)
      exact (clo Xv _ Z1).2.2.2.2 _ X η (by linarith) h1 h2
  have hGn := ZG n hn
  have cG := clo Xs _ hGn
  have cpG := clo Xs _ cG.1
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold bgResTh
    rw [if_pos hn, hThfin]
    have hsum : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (bgVx h i (S i) X η * (G (n - i) X η + X * pdX (G (n - i)) X η)
          + bgUz (S i) X η * simZop h (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((n - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) (G (n - i)) X η) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i _
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with hi | hi
      · subst hi
        simp only [Nat.sub_zero]
        rw [hGn X η hXsX h1 h2, cG.1 X η hXsX h1 h2, cG.2.2.2.2 _ X η hXsX h1 h2]
        ring
      · rw [(clo Xs _ (ZS i (by omega))).2.2.1 i X η hXsX h1 h2,
          (clo Xs _ (ZS i (by omega))).2.1 X η hXsX h1 h2]
        ring
    rw [hsum, cG.2.2.2.1 _ X η hXsX h1 h2, cpG.1 X η hXsX h1 h2, cG.1 X η hXsX h1 h2]
    ring
  · unfold bgResZ
    rw [if_pos hn, hZfin]
    have cS := clo Xs _ (ZS n hn)
    have cU := clo Xs _ cS.2.1
    have cpU := clo Xs _ cU.1
    have hsum : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (X * bgVx h i (S i) X η * pdX (bgUz (S (n - i))) X η
          + bgUz (S i) X η * simZop h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((n - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * h)
              (bgUz (S (n - i))) X η) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i _
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with hi | hi
      · subst hi
        simp only [Nat.sub_zero]
        rw [cU.1 X η hXsX h1 h2, cU.2.2.2.2 _ X η hXsX h1 h2]
        ring
      · rw [(clo Xs _ (ZS i (by omega))).2.2.1 i X η hXsX h1 h2,
          (clo Xs _ (ZS i (by omega))).2.1 X η hXsX h1 h2]
        ring
    rw [hsum, cU.2.2.2.1 _ X η hXsX h1 h2, (clo Xs _ (ZW n hn)).2.2.2.2 _ X η hXsX h1 h2,
      cpU.1 X η hXsX h1 h2, cU.1 X η hXsX h1 h2]
    ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → Xa < Xm → Xm < Xs → Xs < Xb → BgCoeffSeq h Xm Xs m1 m2 F U S G W → ∃ Kr : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ N m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ) => nsResidual 1 (fun y' s' => curl3 (fun w => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgAn h n (S n) w s') y' + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgBn h n (G n) y' s') (fun y' s' => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgPn h n (W n) y' s') y s - stressDivField h (bgTsum h (bgTthSeq h T0th S G W) N) (bgTsum h (bgTzSeq h T0z S G W) N) y s)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * ((N : ℝ) + 1) - Kr m)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs F U T0th T0z S G W hS hL hXam hXms hXsb hB
  have hL' := hL
  unfold LeadingProfile at hL'
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, hh1, -, -, -, -, -, hXa, hXp1, hp12, hp2m1, hm12, hm2v, hXvc, hXcb⟩, -, -, -, -,
    -, -, hXv, -⟩ := hL'
  have hB' := hB
  unfold BgCoeffSeq at hB'
  obtain ⟨⟨hS0, hG0, hW0⟩, -, -, hBsupp, -, -, -, -⟩ := hB'
  have hh2 : h < 1 / 2 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, -, hεres⟩ :=
    bg_trunc_coef_regular h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs F U T0th T0z S G W hS hL hB
  have hΩo : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
  have hup : ∀ {f : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ³} {z : ℝ³ × ℝ} (k : ℕ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f z → ContDiffAt ℝ k f z :=
    fun k hf => hf.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hS0van : ∀ Y e : ℝ, Xv < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → profRadAvg U Y e = 0 := by
    intro Y e hY h1 h2
    have hY0 : 0 < Y := by linarith
    have hcv : profRadAvg U Y e = Y⁻¹ * profRadInt U Y e := by
      unfold profRadAvg profRadInt
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right (fun x => U x e) hY0.ne', zero_mul, one_mul,
        smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hcv, (hXv Y e hY.le h1 h2).2, mul_zero]
  refine ⟨fun m => 2 + 2 * h + (m : ℝ), ?_⟩
  intro N m
  
  have hTr : ∀ (T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ), j ≤ N → bgTrunc N T j = T j :=
    fun T j hj => by simp [bgTrunc, hj]
  have hTr0 : ∀ (T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ), ¬ j ≤ N → bgTrunc N T j = fun _ _ => 0 :=
    fun T j hj => by simp [bgTrunc, hj]
  
  have hvan : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∀ X η : ℝ, Xb < X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      bgResRad h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k X η = 0 ∧
      bgResTh h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k X η = 0 ∧
      bgResZ h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k X η = 0 := by
    refine bg_res_tail_vanish_generic h Xb (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro Y e hY h1 h2
      rw [hTr S 0 (Nat.zero_le N), hS0]
      exact hS0van Y e (by linarith) h1 h2
    · intro Y e hY h1 h2
      rw [hTr G 0 (Nat.zero_le N), hG0]
      exact lead_F_axial_null_ext h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z hL Y e
        hY h1 h2
    · intro j hj Y e hY h1 h2
      by_cases hjN : j ≤ N
      · rw [hTr S j hjN, hTr G j hjN, hTr W j hjN]
        exact hBsupp j hj Y e (by linarith)
      · rw [hTr0 S j hjN, hTr0 G j hjN, hTr0 W j hjN]
        exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℝ, E = 2 * h * ((N : ℝ) + 1) - (2 + 2 * h + (m : ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ → (ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ³ → ℝ³) → ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ³,
      P = fun b c v z => (simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ b * c (simX h z.1 z.2) (simEta h z.1 z.2)) • v z.1 :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hterm : ∀ (b : ℝ) (c : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (v : ℝ³ → ℝ³),
      (v = radVec ∨ v = azVec ∨ v = fun _ => EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿c) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      (∀ X η : ℝ, Xb < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → c X η = 0) →
      (∀ m' : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m' (↿c) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) →
      2 * h * ((N : ℝ) + 1) - (2 + 2 * h) ≤ b →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (P b c v) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (P b c v) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ E := by
    intro b c v hv hc hcv hbd hb
    obtain ⟨hsm, hbnd⟩ := sim_frame_field_bound h hh0 hh2 hS c b ε Xb v hε hc hcv hbd hv
    rw [hP]
    refine ⟨hsm, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbnd m
    refine ⟨max C 0, fun x t hxt => ?_⟩
    have hxt' : t < 1 ∧ simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < 1 := hxt
    have hq0 : 0 < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) := (hS.1 (x 2) (1 - t) (by linarith [hxt'.1])).1
    have hpow : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (b - (m : ℝ)) ≤ simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ E :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hxt'.2.le (by rw [hE]; linarith)
    have hp0 : 0 ≤ simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (b - (m : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ b *
            c (simX h z.1 z.2) (simEta h z.1 z.2)) • v z.1) (x, t)‖
        ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (b - (m : ℝ)) := hC x t hxt
      _ ≤ max C 0 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (b - (m : ℝ)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hp0
      _ ≤ max C 0 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ E := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (le_max_right _ _)
  
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : ℕ → ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ³, T = fun (k : ℕ) (z : ℝ³ × ℝ) =>
      P (-(2 + 2 * h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) (bgResRad h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k) radVec z +
      P (-(2 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) (bgResTh h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k) azVec z +
      P (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) (bgResZ h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k)
        (fun _ => EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hadd3 : ∀ (f1 f2 f3 : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ³) (z : ℝ³ × ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ m f1 z → ContDiffAt ℝ m f2 z →
      ContDiffAt ℝ m f3 z → iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w => f1 w + f2 w + f3 w) z =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f1 z + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f2 z + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f3 z := by
    intro f1 f2 f3 z h1 h2 h3
    have h12 : ContDiffAt ℝ m (f1 + f2) z := h1.add h2
    rw [show (fun w => f1 w + f2 w + f3 w) = f1 + f2 + f3 from rfl, iteratedFDeriv_add_apply h12 h3,
      iteratedFDeriv_add_apply h1 h2]
  have hkT : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico (N + 1) (2 * N + 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (T k) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (T k) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ E := by
    intro k hk
    have hk' := Finset.mem_Ico.mp hk
    have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
    have hkR : (N : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk'.1
    have hkh : ((N : ℝ) + 1) * h ≤ (k : ℝ) * h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hkR hh0.le
    obtain ⟨hR, hTh, hZ, hbd⟩ := hεres N k hk1
    obtain ⟨s1, C1, hC1⟩ := hterm (-(2 + 2 * h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h)
      (bgResRad h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k) radVec (Or.inl rfl) hR
      (fun X η hX h1 h2 => (hvan k hk1 X η hX h1 h2).1)
      (fun m' => (hbd Xb m').imp fun C hC X η a1 a2 a3 a4 => (hC X η a1 a2 a3 a4).1) (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨s2, C2, hC2⟩ := hterm (-(2 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h)
      (bgResTh h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k) azVec (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)) hTh
      (fun X η hX h1 h2 => (hvan k hk1 X η hX h1 h2).2.1)
      (fun m' => (hbd Xb m').imp fun C hC X η a1 a2 a3 a4 => (hC X η a1 a2 a3 a4).2.1) (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨s3, C3, hC3⟩ := hterm (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h)
      (bgResZ h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k)
      (fun _ => EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)) hZ
      (fun X η hX h1 h2 => (hvan k hk1 X η hX h1 h2).2.2)
      (fun m' => (hbd Xb m').imp fun C hC X η a1 a2 a3 a4 => (hC X η a1 a2 a3 a4).2.2) (by linarith)
    have hTk : T k = fun z =>
        P (-(2 + 2 * h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) (bgResRad h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k) radVec z +
        P (-(2 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) (bgResTh h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k) azVec z +
        P (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) (bgResZ h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k)
          (fun _ => EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) z := by
      rw [hT]
    rw [hTk]
    refine ⟨(s1.add s2).add s3, C1 + C2 + C3, fun x t hxt => ?_⟩

  rw [hsplit, show ∀ a b : ℝ, ‖B‖ * a * b = ‖B‖ * (a * b) from fun a b => mul_assoc _ _ _,
    Finset.sum_mul]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg B)
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_
  have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
  rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩ hwΩ, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (k - i) hΩ hwΩ]
  have hKf : Kf i ≤ Af := by
    rw [hAf]
    exact (le_max_left _ _).trans
      (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => max (Kf j) 0) (fun j _ => le_max_right _ _) hi)
  have hKg : Kg (k - i) ≤ Ag := by
    rw [hAg]
    exact (le_max_left _ _).trans
      (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => max (Kg j) 0) (fun j _ => le_max_right _ _)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)))
  have hp1 : 0 < ρ w ^ (-Kf i) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr0 _
  have hp2 : 0 < ρ w ^ (-Kg (k - i)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr0 _
  have hpA : 0 < ρ w ^ (-Af) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr0 _
  have h1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f w‖ ≤ max (Cf i) 0 * ρ w ^ (-Af) :=
    (hCf i w hw).trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hp1.le).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmono _ _ hKf) (le_max_right _ _)))
  have h2 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) g w‖ ≤ max (Cg (k - i)) 0 * ρ w ^ (-Ag) :=
    (hCg (k - i) w hw).trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hp2.le).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmono _ _ hKg) (le_max_right _ _)))
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k.choose i := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  calc (k.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f w‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) g w‖
      ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * (max (Cf i) 0 * ρ w ^ (-Af)) *
          (max (Cg (k - i)) 0 * ρ w ^ (-Ag)) :=
        mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 h0) h2 (norm_nonneg _)
          (mul_nonneg h0 (mul_nonneg (le_max_right _ _) hpA.le))
    _ = (k.choose i : ℝ) * max (Cf i) 0 * max (Cg (k - i)) 0 *
          (ρ w ^ (-Af) * ρ w ^ (-Ag)) := by ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ {E F G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (g : F → G) (f : E → F) (ρ : E → ℝ) (Ω S : Set E) (T : Set F), IsOpen Ω → IsOpen T → S ⊆ Ω → MapsTo f Ω T → (∀ w ∈ S, 0 < ρ w ∧ ρ w ≤ 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g T → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (f w)‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (g ∘ f) Ω ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (g ∘ f) w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)

signature.name: wt_comp_bound
signature.statement: ∀ {E F G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (g : F → G) (f : E → F) (ρ : E → ℝ) (Ω S : Set E) (T : Set F), IsOpen Ω → IsOpen T → S ⊆ Ω → MapsTo f Ω T → (∀ w ∈ S, 0 < ρ w ∧ ρ w ≤ 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g T → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (f w)‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (g ∘ f) Ω ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (g ∘ f) w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro E F G _ _ _ _ _ _ g f ρ Ω S T hΩ hT hSΩ hmaps hρ hg hf hgb hfb
  refine ⟨hg.comp hf hmaps, ?_⟩
  choose Cg Kg hCg using hgb
  choose Cf Kf hCf using hfb
  intro k
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cg i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨K₁, hK₁⟩ : ∃ K₁ : ℝ, K₁ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Kg i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cf i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨K₂, hK₂⟩ : ∃ K₂ : ℝ, K₂ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Kf i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsingle : ∀ (c : ℕ → ℝ) (i : ℕ), i ≤ k →
      |c i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |c j| := by
    intro c i hi
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |c j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  have hK₂0 : 0 ≤ K₂ := by rw [hK₂]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hB1 : 1 ≤ B := by
    have : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cf i| :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    linarith
  refine ⟨(k.factorial : ℝ) * A * B ^ k, K₁ + (k : ℝ) * K₂, fun w hw => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hr0, hr1⟩ := hρ w hw
  have hwΩ : w ∈ Ω := hSΩ hw
  have hfw : f w ∈ T := hmaps hwΩ
  have hmono : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → ρ w ^ (-a) ≤ ρ w ^ (-b) := fun a b hab =>
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hr0 hr1 (by linarith)
  have hpos : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ ρ w ^ c := fun c => (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr0 c).le
  have hgbound : ∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i g T (f w)‖ ≤ A * ρ w ^ (-K₁) := by
    intro i hi
    have hA' : |Cg i| ≤ A := by rw [hA]; exact hsingle Cg i hi
    have hK' : Kg i ≤ K₁ := by rw [hK₁]; exact (le_abs_self _).trans (hsingle Kg i hi)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hT hfw]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g (f w)‖ ≤ Cg i * ρ w ^ (-(Kg i)) := hCg i w hw
      _ ≤ |Cg i| * ρ w ^ (-(Kg i)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (hpos _)
      _ ≤ |Cg i| * ρ w ^ (-K₁) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmono _ _ hK') (abs_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ A * ρ w ^ (-K₁) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hA' (hpos _)
  have hD1 : 1 ≤ B * ρ w ^ (-K₂) := by
    have : 1 ≤ ρ w ^ (-K₂) :=
      Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hr0 hr1 (by linarith)
    nlinarith
  have hfbound : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k →
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i f Ω w‖ ≤ (B * ρ w ^ (-K₂)) ^ i := by
    intro i hi1 hi
    have hB' : |Cf i| ≤ B := by rw [hB]; linarith [hsingle Cf i hi]
    have hK' : Kf i ≤ K₂ := by rw [hK₂]; exact (le_abs_self _).trans (hsingle Kf i hi)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩ hwΩ]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f w‖ ≤ Cf i * ρ w ^ (-(Kf i)) := hCf i w hw
      _ ≤ |Cf i| * ρ w ^ (-(Kf i)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (hpos _)
      _ ≤ |Cf i| * ρ w ^ (-K₂) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmono _ _ hK') (abs_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ B * ρ w ^ (-K₂) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB' (hpos _)
      _ ≤ (B * ρ w ^ (-K₂)) ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
  have hle : ((k : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hg hf hle hT.uniqueDiffOn
    hΩ.uniqueDiffOn hmaps hwΩ hgbound hfbound
  rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hΩ hwΩ] at hFdB
  refine hFdB.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  have e1 : (ρ w ^ (-K₂)) ^ k = ρ w ^ (-((k : ℝ) * K₂)) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hr0.le]
    congr 1; ring
  have e2 : ρ w ^ (-K₁) * ρ w ^ (-((k : ℝ) * K₂)) = ρ w ^ (-(K₁ + (k : ℝ) * K₂)) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hr0]; congr 1; ring
  rw [mul_pow, e1, ← e2]; ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (p : ℝ³ × ℝ → F), ContDiff ℝ ∞ p → ∀ (B : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, ‖w‖ ≤ B → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k p w‖ ≤ C

signature.name: ball_iteratedFDeriv_bound
signature.statement: ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (p : ℝ³ × ℝ → F), ContDiff ℝ ∞ p → ∀ (B : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, ‖w‖ ≤ B → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k p w‖ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro F _ _ p hp B k
  have hk : ((k : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hc : Continuous (fun w => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k p w) := hp.continuous_iteratedFDeriv hk
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℝ³ × ℝ) B).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    hc.continuousOn
  refine ⟨C, fun w hw => hC w ?_⟩
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
  exact hw

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h M : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < M → ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → (0 < simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ∧ 0 ≤ simX h w.1 w.2 ∧ -1 < simEta h w.1 w.2 ∧ simEta h w.1 w.2 < 1) ∧ (simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 → w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ M * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) → ‖w‖ ≤ M + 1 ∧ simX h w.1 w.2 ≤ M / 2)

signature.name: bg_interior_region_facts
signature.statement: ∀ (h M : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < M → ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → (0 < simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ∧ 0 ≤ simX h w.1 w.2 ∧ -1 < simEta h w.1 w.2 ∧ simEta h w.1 w.2 < 1) ∧ (simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 → w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ M * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) → ‖w‖ ≤ M + 1 ∧ simX h w.1 w.2 ≤ M / 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h M hS h0 hh hM w hw
  have hτ : 0 < 1 - w.2 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hq, -⟩ := hS.1 (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) hτ
  obtain ⟨hτq, hz⟩ := hS.2.1 (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) hτ
  have hXdef : simX h w.1 w.2 =
      (w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2) / (2 * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) := rfl
  have hEdef : simEta h w.1 w.2 =
      w.1 2 * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) := rfl
  have hb : 0 < simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1 / 2 - h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _
  have hb2 : (simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1 / 2 - h)) ^ 2 =
      simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1 - 2 * h) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hq.le]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have hzb := abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq' (hz.trans_eq hb2.symm) hb.le
  have hE : simEta h w.1 w.2 = w.1 2 / simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1 / 2 - h) := by
    rw [hEdef, Real.rpow_neg hq.le, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
  have hη1 : -1 < simEta h w.1 w.2 := by
    rw [hE, lt_div_iff₀ hb]
    linarith [hzb.1]
  have hη2 : simEta h w.1 w.2 < 1 := by
    rw [hE, div_lt_one hb]
    exact hzb.2
  have h2q : 0 < 2 * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) := by linarith
  have hX0 : 0 ≤ simX h w.1 w.2 := by
    rw [hXdef]
    exact div_nonneg (by positivity) h2q.le
  refine ⟨⟨hq, hX0, hη1, hη2⟩, fun hq1 hr => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · have ht0 : 0 ≤ w.2 := by linarith
    have hq12 : simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1 - 2 * h) ≤ 1 :=
      Real.rpow_le_one hq.le hq1 (by linarith)
    have hMq : M * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ M * 1 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq1 hM.le
    have hrM : w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ M := by linarith
    have hn2 : ‖w.1‖ ^ 2 = w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 + w.1 2 ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have hsq : ‖w.1‖ ^ 2 ≤ (M + 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hn : ‖w.1‖ ≤ M + 1 := by
      have := abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' hsq (by linarith)
      exact this.2
    rw [Prod.norm_def]
    refine max_le hn ?_
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht0]
    linarith
  · rw [hXdef, div_le_iff₀ h2q]
    linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h p : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ p) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ p) w‖ ≤ C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K)

signature.name: simScale_rpow_wt_bound
signature.statement: ∀ (h p : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ p) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ p) w‖ ≤ C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h p hS hh0 hh1
  
  have simQ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧ (∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → 0 < simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) w‖ ≤ C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1 - (k : ℝ))) := by
    obtain ⟨hS1, -, -, hS4, hS5⟩ := hS
    obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀def⟩ : ∃ L : (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
        L = ((EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ)).prod
          (-(ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hL₀ : ∀ v : ℝ³ × ℝ, L₀ v = (v.1 2, -v.2) := by
      intro v; rw [hL₀def]; rfl
    have hΦ : ∀ v : ℝ³ × ℝ, L₀ v + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) = (v.1 2, 1 - v.2) := by
      intro v
      rw [hL₀, Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero]
      congr 1
      ring
    have hfun : (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) =
        (fun y : ℝ × ℝ => (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h p.1 p.2) (y + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)))) ∘ L₀ := by
      funext v
      simp only [Function.comp]
      rw [hΦ v]
    have hT : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
    have ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2))
        {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
      rw [hfun]
      refine hS4.comp ((contDiff_id.add contDiff_const).comp L₀.contDiff).contDiffOn ?_
      intro w hw
      show L₀ w + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) ∈ _
      rw [hΦ w]
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, mem_Ioi.mpr (sub_pos.mpr hw)⟩
    have hc : ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → 0 < simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) :=
      fun w hw => (hS1 (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) (sub_pos.mpr hw)).1
    have hLn : ‖L₀‖ ≤ 1 := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun x => ?_)
      rw [hL₀, one_mul, Prod.norm_def, Prod.norm_def]
      simp only [norm_neg]
      exact max_le_max (PiLp.norm_apply_le x.1 2) le_rfl
    refine ⟨ha, hc, ?_⟩
    intro k hk
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hS5 k hk
    refine ⟨C, fun w hw hq1 => ?_⟩
    have hso : IsOpen ((fun y : ℝ × ℝ => y + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) ⁻¹' (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ))) :=
      hT.preimage (continuous_id.add continuous_const)
    have hg₁ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun y : ℝ × ℝ => (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h p.1 p.2) (y + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))))
        ((fun y : ℝ × ℝ => y + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) ⁻¹' (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ))) :=
      hS4.comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const).contDiffOn (fun y hy => hy)
    have hLw : L₀ w ∈ (fun y : ℝ × ℝ => y + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) ⁻¹' (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)) := by
      rw [Set.mem_preimage, hΦ w]
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, mem_Ioi.mpr (sub_pos.mpr hw)⟩
    have hLso : IsOpen (L₀ ⁻¹' ((fun y : ℝ × ℝ => y + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) ⁻¹' (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)))) :=
      hso.preimage L₀.continuous
    have key := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L₀ hg₁ hso.uniqueDiffOn
      hLso.uniqueDiffOn hLw (i := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hLso (show w ∈ L₀ ⁻¹' _ from hLw),
      iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hso hLw] at key
    have htr := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun p : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h p.1 p.2)
      k ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) (L₀ w)
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) w‖
        = ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h p.1 p.2)
            (L₀ w + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)))).compContinuousLinearMap fun _ => L₀‖ := by
          rw [hfun, key, htr]
      _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h p.1 p.2) (L₀ w + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)))‖ *
            ∏ _i : Fin k, ‖L₀‖ :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h p.1 p.2) (L₀ w + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)))‖ := by
          rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]

  intro h M hS h0 hh2 hM
  obtain ⟨Ω, hΩ⟩ : ∃ Ω : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ), Ω = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hSd⟩ : ∃ S : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ), S = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1 ∧
      simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 ∧
      w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ M * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΩo : IsOpen Ω := by rw [hΩ]; exact isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const

    intro w hw
    rw [hSd] at hw
    rw [hΩ]
    exact hw.1
  have hreg := bg_interior_region_facts h M hS h0 hh2 hM
  have hρ : ∀ w ∈ S, 0 < simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ∧ simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 := by
    intro w hw
    rw [hSd] at hw
    exact ⟨(hreg w hw.1).1.1, hw.2.1⟩
  have hball : ∀ w ∈ S, ‖w‖ ≤ M + 1 := by
    intro w hw
    rw [hSd] at hw
    exact ((hreg w hw.1).2 hw.2.1 hw.2.2).1

        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k p w‖ ≤ C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K) := by
    intro p hp
    refine ⟨hp.contDiffOn, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := ball_iteratedFDeriv_bound p hp (M + 1) k
    refine ⟨C, 0, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    rw [neg_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]

      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ p) Ω ∧

    obtain ⟨C, K, hCK⟩ := hb k
    refine ⟨C, K, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    rw [hSd] at hw
    exact hCK w hw.1 hw.2.1
  have hP1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2) / 2) :=
    (((hc 0).pow 2).add ((hc 1).pow 2)).div_const 2
  obtain ⟨hXs, hXb⟩ := wt_bilinear_bound (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ)
    (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2) / 2)
    (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-1 : ℝ))
    (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) Ω S hΩo hSΩ hρ
    (hpoly _ hP1).1 (hpow _).1 (hpoly _ hP1).2 (hpow _).2
  obtain ⟨hEs, hEb⟩ := wt_bilinear_bound (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ)
    (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => z.1 2)
    (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)))
    (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) Ω S hΩo hSΩ hρ
    (hpoly _ (hc 2)).1 (hpow _).1 (hpoly _ (hc 2)).2 (hpow _).2
  have eX : (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simX h z.1 z.2) = fun z => ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ
      ((z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2) / 2) (simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-1 : ℝ)) := by
    funext z
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply', Real.rpow_neg_one]
    unfold simX
    ring
  have eE : (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simEta h z.1 z.2) = fun z => ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ

    funext z
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply']
    rfl
  have hXs' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simX h z.1 z.2) Ω := by
    rw [eX]; exact hXs
  have hEs' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simEta h z.1 z.2) Ω := by
    rw [eE]; exact hEs
  have hXb' : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simX h z.1 z.2) w‖ ≤
        C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K) := by
    rw [eX]; exact hXb
  have hEb' : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simEta h z.1 z.2) w‖ ≤

    rw [eE]; exact hEb

  · have hpr := hXs'.prodMk hEs'

    exact hpr

    obtain ⟨CX, KX, hX⟩ := hXb' k
    obtain ⟨CE, KE, hE⟩ := hEb' k
    refine ⟨|CX| + |CE|, max KX KE, fun w h1 h2 h3 => ?_⟩

    rw [iteratedFDeriv_prodMk (hXs'.contDiffAt hwΩ) (hEs'.contDiffAt hwΩ)

    have hqK0 : 0 ≤ simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-max KX KE) :=
      (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _).le
    have hgen : ∀ Ci Ki : ℝ, Ki ≤ max KX KE → |Ci| ≤ |CX| + |CE| →

          (|CX| + |CE|) * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-max KX KE) := by
      intro Ci Ki hKi hCi
      calc Ci * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-Ki)
          ≤ |Ci| * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-Ki) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _).le
        _ ≤ |Ci| * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-max KX KE) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1 (by linarith)) (abs_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ (|CX| + |CE|) * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-max KX KE) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCi hqK0
    exact max_le

  have key0 : ∀ (C q a a' : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → a' ≤ a →
      C * q ^ (B.h * a) ≤ |C| * q ^ (B.h * a') := by
    intro C q a a' hq0 hq1' haa
    calc C * q ^ (B.h * a) ≤ |C| * q ^ (B.h * a) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)
      _ ≤ |C| * q ^ (B.h * a') :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1'
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left haa hh.le)) (abs_nonneg C)
  have hEW : ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X := by
    intro X
    unfold edgeWeight
    split_ifs
    · positivity
    · exact le_rfl
  have hED : ∀ X : ℝ, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb → 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X := by
    intro X h1 h2
    have hX0 : 0 < X := lt_trans hXa h1
    unfold edgeDist
    exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr h1))
      (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr h2)))
  have hSC : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (b : ℝ), 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ b := by
    intro ξ b
    exact Real.rpow_nonneg (by unfold SC; positivity) b
  have hM : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V) (α α' : ℝ),
      α' ≤ α → InM B (qsOf l0) α f → InM B (qsOf l0) α' f := by
    intro V _ _ f α α' hαα hf
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hf
    refine ⟨h1, h2, h3, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, b, d, hC⟩ := h4 k
    refine ⟨|C|, b, d, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
    have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hpos ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 hξ'.2.1
    have hq1' : qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 := le_trans hξ'.2.2.le hq1
    refine le_trans (hC ξ hξ hX1 hX2) ?_
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hED _ hX1 hX2) _).le
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (hEW _)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (key0 C _ α α' hq0 hq1' hαα) (hSC ξ b)
  have hW : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (a : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → V) (α α' : ℝ),
      α' ≤ α → InWg B G (qsOf l0) α a → InWg B G (qsOf l0) α' a := by
    intro V _ _ a α α' hαα ha
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := ha
    refine ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, b, d, hC⟩ := h5 k
    refine ⟨|C|, b, d, fun γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
    have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hpos ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 hξ'.2.1
    have hq1' : qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 := le_trans hξ'.2.2.le hq1
    refine le_trans (hC γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2) ?_
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by unfold Penv; exact (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hED _ hX1 hX2) _).le
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (key0 C _ α α' hq0 hq1' hαα) (hSC ξ b)
  have hS : ∀ (F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (α α' : ℝ), α' ≤ α → InS B (qsOf l0) α F → InS B (qsOf l0) α' F := by
    intro F α α' hαα hF
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hF
    refine ⟨h1, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := h2 k
    refine ⟨|C|, b, fun w hw1 hw2 => ?_⟩
    have hq0 := hpos w.1 w.2 hw1
    refine le_trans (hC w hw1 hw2) ?_
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (key0 C _ α α' hq0 (le_trans hw2.le hq1) hαα)
      (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _)
  unfold StOrd at hSt ⊢
  obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, ⟨f, Fl, hf, hFl, hEq⟩, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16,
    c17, c18, c19, c20, c21, c22, c23⟩ := hSt
  exact ⟨c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, ⟨f, Fl, hW f bw bw' hbw hf, hFl, hEq⟩,
    hM _ cm cm' hcm c8, hM _ cm cm' hcm c9, hM _ ca ca' hca c10, hM _ ca ca' hca c11,
    hS _ cd cd' hcd c12, hS _ cd cd' hcd c13, hS _ cd cd' hcd c14,
    c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20, c21, c22, c23⟩

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S S' S'' : CState) (o o' o'' : ℝ), B.ok →
    Incr B G l0 S S' o → Incr B G l0 S' S'' o' → o'' ≤ o → o'' ≤ o' → Incr B G l0 S S'' o''

signature.name: incr_trans
signature.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S S' S'' : CState) (o o' o'' : ℝ), B.ok →
    Incr B G l0 S S' o → Incr B G l0 S' S'' o' → o'' ≤ o → o'' ≤ o' → Incr B G l0 S S'' o''

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 S S' S'' o o' o'' hok hI1 hI2 ho ho'
  have hh0 : 0 ≤ B.h := hok.2.1.1.le
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4 : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3 := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩
        exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3
  have hDq : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < qC B.h ξ ∧ qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 ∧ 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨-, h2, h3⟩ := hξ
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
    refine ⟨hq0, by linarith, ?_⟩
    unfold SC
    have : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| := by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))]
    exact one_le_pow₀ this
  have hDsh : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ a, shY ξ a ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := fun ξ hξ _ => hξ
  
  have hEdge : ∀ X : ℝ, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb → 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X ∧
      0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ∧ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ≤ 1 := by
    intro X h1 h2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, min_le_left _ _⟩
    · unfold edgeWeight
      split_ifs
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      · exact le_rfl
    · have hX : 0 < X := lt_trans hXa h1
      have l1 : 0 < Real.log (X / B.Xa) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr h1)
      have l2 : 0 < Real.log (B.Xb / X) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr h2)
      exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min l1 l2)
  
  have hW : ∀ (q Sv E e P C1 C2 b1 b2 d1 d2 α α1 α2 N1 N2 : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → 1 ≤ Sv → 0 ≤ E →
      0 < e → e ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ P → α ≤ α1 → α ≤ α2 →
      N1 ≤ C1 * q ^ (B.h * α1) * Sv ^ b1 * E * e ^ (-d1) * P →
      N2 ≤ C2 * q ^ (B.h * α2) * Sv ^ b2 * E * e ^ (-d2) * P →
      N1 + N2 ≤ (|C1| + |C2|) * q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P := by
    intro q Sv E e P C1 C2 b1 b2 d1 d2 α α1 α2 N1 N2 hq0 hq1 hS1 hE he0 he1 hP ha1 ha2 hN1 hN2
    have key : ∀ (C b d αi N : ℝ), α ≤ αi → N ≤ C * q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P →
        b ≤ max b1 b2 → d ≤ max d1 d2 →
        N ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) := by
      intro C b d αi N hα hN hb hd
      have f1 : q ^ (B.h * αi) ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hα hh0)
      have f2 : Sv ^ b ≤ Sv ^ (max b1 b2) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 hb
      have f3 : e ^ (-d) ≤ e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge he0 he1 (neg_le_neg hd)
      have p1 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * αi) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
      have p2 : 0 ≤ Sv ^ b := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have p3 : 0 ≤ e ^ (-d) := Real.rpow_nonneg he0.le _
      have p1' : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
      have p2' : 0 ≤ Sv ^ (max b1 b2) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have m1 : q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) := mul_le_mul f1 f2 p2 p1'
      have m2 : q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right m1 hE
      have m3 : q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) ≤
          q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) :=
        mul_le_mul m2 f3 p3 (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p1' p2') hE)
      have hWi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right m3 hP
      have hWi0 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p1 p2) hE) p3) hP
      calc N ≤ C * q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P := hN
        _ = C * (q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P) := by ring
        _ ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) hWi0
        _ ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hWi (abs_nonneg C)
    have k1 := key C1 b1 d1 α1 N1 ha1 hN1 (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
    have k2 := key C2 b2 d2 α2 N2 ha2 hN2 (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
    have e : (|C1| + |C2|) * q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P =
        |C1| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) +
        |C2| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) := by ring
    rw [e]
    linarith
  
  have hNB : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f1 f2 g : Cyl → V) (k : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl),
      ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f1 (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f2 (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), g η = f1 η + f2 η) → NB B.h g k ξ ≤ NB B.h f1 k ξ + NB B.h f2 k ξ := by
    intro V _ _ f1 f2 g k ξ hξ hf1 hf2 heq
    have hn : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∈ nhds ξ := hDopen.mem_nhds hξ
    have hev : g =ᶠ[nhds ξ] f1 + f2 := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hn (fun η hη => heq η hη)
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g ξ = iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ := by
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
      exact iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((hf1.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        ((hf2.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    unfold NB
    rw [e1]
    have e2 : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) +
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) := by
      ext m
      simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e2]
    exact norm_add_le _ _
  
  have hvel_add : ∀ (a1 a2 : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl),
      (∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => a1 γ m η i) ξ) →
      (∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => a2 γ m η i) ξ) →
      velW B G (a1 + a2) γ m ξ = velW B G a1 γ m ξ + velW B G a2 γ m ξ := by
    intro a1 a2 γ m ξ hd1 hd2
    have hfd : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (v : Cyl), fderiv ℝ (fun η => a1 γ m η i + a2 γ m η i) ξ v =
        fderiv ℝ (fun η => a1 γ m η i) ξ v + fderiv ℝ (fun η => a2 γ m η i) ξ v := by
      intro i v
      rw [fderiv_fun_add (hd1 i) (hd2 i), ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [velW, velC, DrC, DzC, dR, dZ, hfd, hd1, hd2] <;> ring
  have hvel_zero : ∀ (a : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), a γ m = 0 → velW B G a γ m = 0 := by
    intro a γ m h0
    funext ξ j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [velW, velC, DrC, DzC, dR, dZ, h0]
  
  have hInM : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (α α1 α2 : ℝ) (f1 f2 g : Cyl → V),
      InM B (qsOf l0) α1 f1 → InM B (qsOf l0) α2 f2 → α ≤ α1 → α ≤ α2 →
      (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), g ξ = f1 ξ + f2 ξ) → InM B (qsOf l0) α g := by
    intro V _ _ α α1 α2 f1 f2 g h1 h2 ha1 ha2 heq
    obtain ⟨s1, d1, z1, b1⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨s2, d2, z2, b2⟩ := h2
    refine ⟨(s1.add s2).congr heq, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro ξ hξ a ha
      rw [heq _ (hDsh ξ hξ a), heq ξ hξ, d1 ξ hξ a ha, d2 ξ hξ a ha]
    · intro ξ hξ hX
      rw [heq ξ hξ, z1 ξ hξ hX, z2 ξ hξ hX, add_zero]
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨C1, c1, e1, hb1⟩ := b1 k
      obtain ⟨C2, c2, e2, hb2⟩ := b2 k
      refine ⟨|C1| + |C2|, max c1 c2, max e1 e2, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hq0, hq1, hS1⟩ := hDq ξ hξ
      obtain ⟨hE, he0, he1⟩ := hEdge _ hX1 hX2
      have hn := hNB f1 f2 g k ξ hξ s1 s2 heq
      have := hW (qC B.h ξ) (SC B.h ξ) (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ))
        (edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ)) 1 C1 C2 c1 c2 e1 e2 α α1 α2 (NB B.h f1 k ξ) (NB B.h f2 k ξ)
        hq0 hq1 hS1 hE he0 he1 zero_le_one ha1 ha2
        (le_of_le_of_eq (hb1 ξ hξ hX1 hX2) (mul_one _).symm)
        (le_of_le_of_eq (hb2 ξ hξ hX1 hX2) (mul_one _).symm)
      exact le_trans hn (le_of_le_of_eq this (mul_one _))
  
  have hInWg : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (α α1 α2 : ℝ)
      (a1 a2 c : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → V),
      InWg B G (qsOf l0) α1 a1 → InWg B G (qsOf l0) α2 a2 → α ≤ α1 → α ≤ α2 →
      (∃ H : Finset ℤ, (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧ ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → c γ m = 0) →
      (∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), c γ m ξ = a1 γ m ξ + a2 γ m ξ) → InWg B G (qsOf l0) α c := by
    intro V _ _ α α1 α2 a1 a2 c h1 h2 ha1 ha2 hfr heq
    obtain ⟨-, s1, d1, u1, b1⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨-, s2, d2, u2, b2⟩ := h2
    refine ⟨hfr, fun γ m => ((s1 γ m).add (s2 γ m)).congr (heq γ m), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro γ m ξ hξ a ha
      rw [heq γ m _ (hDsh ξ hξ a), heq γ m ξ hξ, d1 γ m ξ hξ a ha, d2 γ m ξ hξ a ha]
    · intro γ m ξ hξ hne
      rw [heq γ m ξ hξ] at hne
      by_cases h : a1 γ m ξ = 0
      · rw [h, zero_add] at hne
        exact u2 γ m ξ hξ hne
      · exact u1 γ m ξ hξ h
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨C1, c1, e1, hb1⟩ := b1 k
      obtain ⟨C2, c2, e2, hb2⟩ := b2 k
      refine ⟨|C1| + |C2|, max c1 c2, max e1 e2, fun γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hq0, hq1, hS1⟩ := hDq ξ hξ
      obtain ⟨hE, he0, he1⟩ := hEdge _ hX1 hX2
      have hn := hNB (a1 γ m) (a2 γ m) (c γ m) k ξ hξ (s1 γ m) (s2 γ m) (heq γ m)
      have hP : 0 ≤ Penv B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by
        unfold Penv
        exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      have := hW (qC B.h ξ) (SC B.h ξ) (Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)))
        (edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ)) (Penv B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2))
        C1 C2 c1 c2 e1 e2 α α1 α2 _ _ hq0 hq1 hS1 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) he0 he1 hP ha1 ha2
        (hb1 γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2) (hb2 γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2)

  obtain ⟨A1, V1, P1, Ps1, Bd1, Pm1, M01, M21⟩ := hI1
