noncomputable def bHatE (B : BG) (e : ℕ) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  rhoHat B s / ∫ u in (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1))..(Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)), u ^ e * rhoHat B u
noncomputable def bE (B : BG) (e : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  qC B.h ξ ^ (-(((e:ℝ) + 1) / 2)) * bHatE B e (ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))
noncomputable def FE (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (e : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  if e = 2 then yAvg (EthP B G l0 S) ξ else yAvg (EzP B G l0 S) ξ
noncomputable def ME (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (e : ℕ) (z t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ e * FE B G l0 S e (r, z, t, 0)
noncomputable def sigE (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (e : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  -(ξ.1 ^ e)⁻¹ * ∫ r' in (0:ℝ)..ξ.1, r' ^ e *
     (FE B G l0 S e (r', ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0) - bE B e (r', ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0) * ME B G l0 S e ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1)
noncomputable def sigPair (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ × ℝ :=
  (sigE B G l0 S 2 ξ, sigE B G l0 S 1 ξ)
noncomputable def sigAmp (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  let s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ := (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)
  let Hp := Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) s
  let Hm := Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) s
  let T := (qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h) * Qb γ.1 / epsb B.h γ.1) • sigPair B G l0 S ξ
  let det := Hp.1 * Hm.2 - Hm.1 * Hp.2
  (if γ.2.2 then (Hm.2 * T.1 - Hm.1 * T.2) / det else (Hp.1 * T.2 - Hp.2 * T.1) / det) /
    (2 * Real.sqrt (yAmp B G γ ξ))
open Classical in
noncomputable def LSc (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  if ActiveL B G γ ∧ inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (2 * G.r0) ξ.2.2.2 ∧ 0 < yAmp B G γ ξ then
    (Real.sqrt (epsb B.h γ.1) / 2 * etaL B.h γ ξ * sigAmp B G l0 S γ ξ *
      chig G.r0 (xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) * psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)) •
      G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)
  else 0
noncomputable def crossC (a b : Fin 3 → ℂ) : Fin 3 → ℂ :=
  ![a 1 * b 2 - a 2 * b 1, a 2 * b 0 - a 0 * b 2, a 0 * b 1 - a 1 * b 0]
noncomputable def potW (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (c : Lab → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) : WC := fun γ m ξ =>
  if m = 1 ∨ m = -1 then
    (Complex.I / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) * ((dotProduct (nPhi B G γ ξ) (nPhi B G γ ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ))) •
      crossC (fun i => (nPhi B G γ ξ i : ℂ)) (fun i => (c γ ξ i : ℂ))
  else 0
noncomputable def presW (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (c : Lab → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) : WS := fun γ m ξ =>
  if m = 1 ∨ m = -1 then
    (Complex.I / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ))) *
      ((((dotProduct (nPhi B G γ ξ) ((Kmat B G γ ξ).mulVec (c γ ξ))
         - dotProduct (nPhiP B G γ ξ) (c γ ξ)) / dotProduct (nPhi B G γ ξ) (nPhi B G γ ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ))
  else 0
noncomputable def stressStep (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : CState :=
  { Aw := S.Aw + potW B G (LSc B G l0 S), pw := S.pw + presW B G (LSc B G l0 S),
    Psi := S.Psi, bdir := S.bdir }
noncomputable def LSh (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : WC :=
  fun γ m ξ => if m = 1 ∨ m = -1 then (fun i => ((LSc B G l0 S γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) else 0
noncomputable def hDetC (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).1 * (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).2
  - (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).1 * (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).2
noncomputable def tPart (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (c : Lab → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (γ : Lab) (θ : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl)
    (a : Fin 3) : ℝ :=
  qC B.h ξ ^ (-B.h) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * 2 *
    Real.cos ((pint B G γ : ℝ) * θ + (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * phiL B G γ ξ) * c γ ξ a
noncomputable def covT (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (c c' : Lab → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (a b : Fin 3) (θ : ℝ)
    (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, tPart B G c γ θ ξ a) * (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, tPart B G c' γ θ ξ b)
def StressIn (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (Bo : ℝ) : Prop :=
  StOrd B G l0 S (Bo + 2/5) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS)
def StressTargetOK (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (Bo : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ e : ℕ, (e = 1 ∨ e = 2) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) →
      sigE B G l0 S e ξ = 0) ∧
  (∀ e : ℕ, (e = 1 ∨ e = 2) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      dR B.h (sigE B G l0 S e) ξ + (e : ℝ) / ξ.1 * sigE B G l0 S e ξ =
        -FE B G l0 S e ξ + bE B e ξ * ME B G l0 S e ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1) ∧
  (∀ e : ℕ, (e = 1 ∨ e = 2) →
      InM B (qsOf l0) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (sigE B G l0 S e))) ∧
  (∀ e : ℕ, (e = 1 ∨ e = 2) → InM B (qsOf l0) (Bo + 3/2 - kapS)
      (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun ξ => bE B e ξ * ME B G l0 S e ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1)))
def PrimNondegAt (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l1 : ℕ) (c : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b d : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), l1 ≤ γ.1 → ActiveL B G γ → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 →
    ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → 0 < ξ.1 → B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
    c / Sb γ.1 ≤ |hDetC B G γ ξ| ∧
    c * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) ≤ yAmp B G γ ξ ∧
    NB B.h (yAmp B G γ) k ξ ≤
      C * SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) ∧
    NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (hDetC B G γ η)⁻¹ • (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1),
        Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1))) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b
def SignedClass (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (Bo : ℝ) : Prop :=
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo - kapS) (LSh B G l0 S) ∧
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) (potW B G (LSc B G l0 S)) ∧
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo - kapS) (velW B G (potW B G (LSc B G l0 S))) ∧
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo + 1/2 - 2 * kapS) (velW B G (potW B G (LSc B G l0 S)) - LSh B G l0 S) ∧
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) (presW B G (LSc B G l0 S))
def StressMeansSame (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Fin 3) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → mcor B G l0 (stressStep B G l0 S) a ξ = mcor B G l0 S a ξ
def SignedCov (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Prop :=

noncomputable def sigAmp (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  let s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ := (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)
  let Hp := Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) s
  let Hm := Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) s
  let T := (qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h) * Qb γ.1 / epsb B.h γ.1) • sigPair B G l0 S ξ
  let det := Hp.1 * Hm.2 - Hm.1 * Hp.2
  (if γ.2.2 then (Hm.2 * T.1 - Hm.1 * T.2) / det else (Hp.1 * T.2 - Hp.2 * T.1) / det) /
    (2 * Real.sqrt (yAmp B G γ ξ))
open Classical in
noncomputable def LSc (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  if ActiveL B G γ ∧ inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (2 * G.r0) ξ.2.2.2 ∧ 0 < yAmp B G γ ξ then
    (Real.sqrt (epsb B.h γ.1) / 2 * etaL B.h γ ξ * sigAmp B G l0 S γ ξ *
      chig G.r0 (xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) * psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)) •
      G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)
  else 0
noncomputable def crossC (a b : Fin 3 → ℂ) : Fin 3 → ℂ :=
  ![a 1 * b 2 - a 2 * b 1, a 2 * b 0 - a 0 * b 2, a 0 * b 1 - a 1 * b 0]
noncomputable def potW (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (c : Lab → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) : WC := fun γ m ξ =>
  if m = 1 ∨ m = -1 then
    (Complex.I / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) * ((dotProduct (nPhi B G γ ξ) (nPhi B G γ ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ))) •
      crossC (fun i => (nPhi B G γ ξ i : ℂ)) (fun i => (c γ ξ i : ℂ))
  else 0
noncomputable def presW (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (c : Lab → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) : WS := fun γ m ξ =>
  if m = 1 ∨ m = -1 then
    (Complex.I / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ))) *
      ((((dotProduct (nPhi B G γ ξ) ((Kmat B G γ ξ).mulVec (c γ ξ))
         - dotProduct (nPhiP B G γ ξ) (c γ ξ)) / dotProduct (nPhi B G γ ξ) (nPhi B G γ ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ))
  else 0
noncomputable def stressStep (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : CState :=
  { Aw := S.Aw + potW B G (LSc B G l0 S), pw := S.pw + presW B G (LSc B G l0 S),
    Psi := S.Psi, bdir := S.bdir }
noncomputable def LSh (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : WC :=
  fun γ m ξ => if m = 1 ∨ m = -1 then (fun i => ((LSc B G l0 S γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) else 0
noncomputable def hDetC (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).1 * (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).2
  - (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).1 * (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).2
noncomputable def tPart (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (c : Lab → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (γ : Lab) (θ : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl)
    (a : Fin 3) : ℝ :=
  qC B.h ξ ^ (-B.h) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * 2 *
    Real.cos ((pint B G γ : ℝ) * θ + (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * phiL B G γ ξ) * c γ ξ a
noncomputable def covT (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (c c' : Lab → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (a b : Fin 3) (θ : ℝ)
    (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, tPart B G c γ θ ξ a) * (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, tPart B G c' γ θ ξ b)
def StressIn (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (Bo : ℝ) : Prop :=
  StOrd B G l0 S (Bo + 2/5) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS)
def StressTargetOK (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (Bo : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ e : ℕ, (e = 1 ∨ e = 2) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) →
      sigE B G l0 S e ξ = 0) ∧
  (∀ e : ℕ, (e = 1 ∨ e = 2) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      dR B.h (sigE B G l0 S e) ξ + (e : ℝ) / ξ.1 * sigE B G l0 S e ξ =
        -FE B G l0 S e ξ + bE B e ξ * ME B G l0 S e ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1) ∧
  (∀ e : ℕ, (e = 1 ∨ e = 2) →
      InM B (qsOf l0) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (sigE B G l0 S e))) ∧
  (∀ e : ℕ, (e = 1 ∨ e = 2) → InM B (qsOf l0) (Bo + 3/2 - kapS)
      (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun ξ => bE B e ξ * ME B G l0 S e ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1)))
def PrimNondegAt (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l1 : ℕ) (c : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b d : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), l1 ≤ γ.1 → ActiveL B G γ → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 →
    ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → 0 < ξ.1 → B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
    c / Sb γ.1 ≤ |hDetC B G γ ξ| ∧
    c * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) ≤ yAmp B G γ ξ ∧
    NB B.h (yAmp B G γ) k ξ ≤
      C * SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) ∧
    NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (hDetC B G γ η)⁻¹ • (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1),
        Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1))) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b
def SignedClass (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (Bo : ℝ) : Prop :=
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo - kapS) (LSh B G l0 S) ∧
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) (potW B G (LSc B G l0 S)) ∧
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo - kapS) (velW B G (potW B G (LSc B G l0 S))) ∧
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo + 1/2 - 2 * kapS) (velW B G (potW B G (LSc B G l0 S)) - LSh B G l0 S) ∧
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) (presW B G (LSc B G l0 S))
def StressMeansSame (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Fin 3) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → mcor B G l0 (stressStep B G l0 S) a ξ = mcor B G l0 S a ξ
def SignedCov (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Prop :=
  ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
    yAvg (fun η => thA (fun θ => covT B G (W0c B G) (LSc B G l0 S) 0 1 θ η +
      covT B G (LSc B G l0 S) (W0c B G) 0 1 θ η)) ξ = sigE B G l0 S 2 ξ ∧
    yAvg (fun η => thA (fun θ => covT B G (W0c B G) (LSc B G l0 S) 0 2 θ η +
      covT B G (LSc B G l0 S) (W0c B G) 0 2 θ η)) ξ = sigE B G l0 S 1 ξ

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (S G Uc Vc : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → SimScaleProps h → (∀ j, 1 ≤ a j) → (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) → (∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgAn h n (S n))) (simDomain h 1)) → (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 → 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → (curl3 (fun w => bgAn h n (S n) w t) x) 2 = simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Uc n (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) ∧ inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => bgAn h n (S n) w t) x) (radVec x) = simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Vc n (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) ∧ inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => bgAn h n (S n) w t) x) (azVec x) = (0 : ℝ)) → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 → 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => cutSum h a (fun n => bgAn h n (S n)) w t) x + cutSum h a (fun n => bgBn h n (G n)) x t) (azVec x) = Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * bgEb h a G (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) ∧ (curl3 (fun w => cutSum h a (fun n => bgAn h n (S n)) w t) x + cutSum h a (fun n => bgBn h n (G n)) x t) 2 = simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * bgSum h a Uc (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) ∧ inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => cutSum h a (fun n => bgAn h n (S n)) w t) x + cutSum h a (fun n => bgBn h n (G n)) x t) (radVec x) = bgVb h a S Vc (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t)

signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (S G Uc Vc : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → SimScaleProps h → (∀ j, 1 ≤ a j) → (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) → (∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgAn h n (S n))) (simDomain h 1)) → (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 → 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → (curl3 (fun w => bgAn h n (S n) w t) x) 2 = simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Uc n (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) ∧ inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => bgAn h n (S n) w t) x) (radVec x) = simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Vc n (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) ∧ inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => bgAn h n (S n) w t) x) (azVec x) = (0 : ℝ)) → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 → 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => cutSum h a (fun n => bgAn h n (S n)) w t) x + cutSum h a (fun n => bgBn h n (G n)) x t) (azVec x) = Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * bgEb h a G (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) ∧ (curl3 (fun w => cutSum h a (fun n => bgAn h n (S n)) w t) x + cutSum h a (fun n => bgBn h n (G n)) x t) 2 = simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * bgSum h a Uc (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) ∧ inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => cutSum h a (fun n => bgAn h n (S n)) w t) x + cutSum h a (fun n => bgBn h n (G n)) x t) (radVec x) = bgVb h a S Vc (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h a S G Uc Vc hh0 hh1 hS ha1 ha2 hsmA hC x t hxt hr
  have ht : t < 1 := hxt.1
  have hτ : (0:ℝ) < 1 - t := by linarith
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ Q, Q = simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hQpos : 0 < Q := by rw [hQ]; exact (hS.1 (x 2) (1 - t) hτ).1
  have hQne : Q ≠ 0 := hQpos.ne'
  
  have hΩ : IsOpen (simDomain h 1) := by
    have hc : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.comp
        (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ))).continuousOn
        (fun w hw => ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 by have : w.2 < 1 := hw; linarith⟩)
    exact hc.isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const) isOpen_Iio
  have hKd : ∀ n : ℕ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => bgAn h n (S n) y t) x := by
    intro n
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (↿(bgAn h n (S n))) (x, t) := (hsmA n).contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hxt)
    have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => ((y, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) x :=
      (contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt
    exact (h1.comp x h2).differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have hQd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => simScale h z (1 - t)) (x 2) := by
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (x 2, 1 - t) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt (prod_mem_nhds Filter.univ_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hτ))
    have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ => ((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ)) (x 2) :=
      (contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt
    exact (h1.comp (x 2) h2).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨Q', hQh⟩ : ∃ Q', HasDerivAt (fun z => simScale h z (1 - t)) Q' (x 2) :=
    ⟨_, hQd.hasDerivAt⟩
  
  have hst : Differentiable ℝ Real.smoothTransition :=
    (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hΨdiff : Differentiable ℝ (fun σ : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ)) := by fun_prop
  have hcut : ∀ c : ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => simCut h c y t)
      ((deriv (fun σ : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ)) (c * Q) * (c * Q')) •
        (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)) x := by
    intro c
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun z => c * simScale h z (1 - t)) (c * Q') (x 2) := hQh.const_mul c
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * (c * simScale h z (1 - t))))
        (deriv (fun σ : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ)) (c * Q) * (c * Q')) (x 2) := by
      rw [hQ]
      exact (hΨdiff _).hasDerivAt.comp (x 2) h1
    exact HasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt (f := fun y : ℝ³ => y 2)
      (h₂ := fun z => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * (c * simScale h z (1 - t)))) x h2
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
  have hφd : ∀ c : ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => simCut h c y t) x :=
    fun c => (hcut c).differentiableAt
  have hφv : ∀ (c : ℝ) (v : ℝ³), fderiv ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => simCut h c y t) x v =
      deriv (fun σ : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ)) (c * Q) * (c * Q') * v 2 := by
    intro c v
    rw [(hcut c).fderiv]
    simp
  
  have s3 : ∀ (φ : ℝ³ → ℝ) (K : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (k : ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ φ x → DifferentiableAt ℝ K x →
      fderiv ℝ φ x (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) = 0 → fderiv ℝ φ x (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) = 0 →
      K x = k • azVec x →
      curl3 (fun y => φ y • K y) x =
        φ x • curl3 K x - (fderiv ℝ φ x (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) * k) • radVec x := by
    intro φ K k hφ hK h0 h1 hKx
    unfold curl3
    rw [fderiv_fun_smul hφ hK]
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [h0, h1, hKx, azVec, radVec] <;> ring
  
  have hadd : ∀ F1 F2 : ℝ³ → ℝ³, DifferentiableAt ℝ F1 x → DifferentiableAt ℝ F2 x →
      curl3 (fun y => F1 y + F2 y) x = curl3 F1 x + curl3 F2 x := by
    intro F1 F2 h1 h2
    unfold curl3
    rw [fderiv_fun_add h1 h2]
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp <;> ring
  have hsumcurl : ∀ (F : ℕ → ℝ³ → ℝ³), (∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (F i) x) → ∀ s : Finset ℕ,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ∑ i ∈ s, F i y) x ∧
      curl3 (fun y => ∑ i ∈ s, F i y) x = ∑ i ∈ s, curl3 (F i) x := by
    intro F hF s
    refine Finset.induction_on s ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Finset.sum_empty]
      refine ⟨differentiableAt_const _, ?_⟩
      simp [curl3]
    · intro i s hi ih
      have e : (fun y => ∑ j ∈ insert i s, F j y) = fun y => F i y + ∑ j ∈ s, F j y := by
        funext y; rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]
      rw [e, Finset.sum_insert hi]
      refine ⟨(hF i).add ih.1, ?_⟩
      rw [hadd (F i) (fun y => ∑ j ∈ s, F j y) (hF i) ih.1, ih.2]
  have hcurl_congr : ∀ F₁ F₂ : ℝ³ → ℝ³, F₁ =ᶠ[nhds x] F₂ → curl3 F₁ x = curl3 F₂ x := by
    intro F₁ F₂ hF
    simp only [curl3, hF.fderiv_eq]
  
  have hScont : Continuous (fun y : ℝ³ => simScale h (y 2) (1 - t)) :=
    hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.comp_continuous (f := fun y : ℝ³ => ((y 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ))
      (by fun_prop) (fun y => ⟨mem_univ _, hτ⟩)
  have ha_pow : ∀ j : ℕ, (2:ℝ) ^ j ≤ a j := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => simpa using ha1 0
    | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ]; linarith [ha2 k]
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := pow_unbounded_of_one_lt (2 / Q) (one_lt_two : (1:ℝ) < 2)
  have hUn : {y : ℝ³ | Q / 2 < simScale h (y 2) (1 - t)} ∈ nhds x :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const hScont).mem_nhds
      (by show Q / 2 < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t); rw [← hQ]; linarith)
  have hxU : x ∈ {y : ℝ³ | Q / 2 < simScale h (y 2) (1 - t)} := mem_of_mem_nhds hUn
  have hbig : ∀ y ∈ {y : ℝ³ | Q / 2 < simScale h (y 2) (1 - t)}, ∀ j, N ≤ j →
      1 < a j * simScale h (y 2) (1 - t) := by
    intro y hy j hj
    have hy' : Q / 2 < simScale h (y 2) (1 - t) := hy
    have h2j : (2:ℝ) ^ N ≤ a j := (pow_le_pow_right₀ one_le_two hj).trans (ha_pow j)
    have e : 2 / Q * (Q / 2) = 1 := by field_simp
    calc (1:ℝ) = 2 / Q * (Q / 2) := e.symm
      _ < 2 ^ N * (Q / 2) := by apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hN; positivity
      _ ≤ a j * (Q / 2) := by apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2j; positivity
      _ < a j * simScale h (y 2) (1 - t) := by
        apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy'; linarith [ha1 j]
  have hzero : ∀ y ∈ {y : ℝ³ | Q / 2 < simScale h (y 2) (1 - t)}, ∀ j, N ≤ j →
      simCut h (a j) y t = 0 := by
    intro y hy j hj
    have := hbig y hy j hj
    unfold simCut
    exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
  have hbc : ∀ c : ℝ, simCut h c x t = bgCut c Q := by intro c; rw [hQ]; rfl
  have hcz : ∀ j, N ≤ j → bgCut (a j) Q = 0 := fun j hj => by rw [← hbc]; exact hzero x hxU j hj
  have hdz : ∀ j, N ≤ j → deriv (fun σ : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ)) (a j * Q) = 0 := by
    intro j hj
    have hgt : 1 < a j * Q := by have := hbig x hxU j hj; rwa [← hQ] at this
    have hev : (fun σ : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ)) =ᶠ[nhds (a j * Q)] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hgt] with σ hσ
      have : (1:ℝ) < σ := hσ
      exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
    rw [hev.deriv_eq]
    simp
  
  have hEqA : ∀ y ∈ {y : ℝ³ | Q / 2 < simScale h (y 2) (1 - t)},
      cutSum h a (fun n => bgAn h n (S n)) y t =
        bgAn h 0 (S 0) y t + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, simCut h (a (i + 1)) y t • bgAn h (i + 1) (S (i + 1)) y t := by
    intro y hy
    simp only [cutSum]
    congr 1
    apply tsum_eq_sum
    intro b hb
    rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hb
    rw [hzero y hy (b + 1) (by omega), zero_smul]
  have hBx : cutSum h a (fun n => bgBn h n (G n)) x t =
      bgBn h 0 (G 0) x t + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, simCut h (a (i + 1)) x t • bgBn h (i + 1) (G (i + 1)) x t := by
    simp only [cutSum]
    congr 1
    apply tsum_eq_sum
    intro b hb
    rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hb
    rw [hzero x hxU (b + 1) (by omega), zero_smul]
  
  have hTd : ∀ i : ℕ, DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun y => simCut h (a (i + 1)) y t • bgAn h (i + 1) (S (i + 1)) y t) x :=
    fun i => (hφd (a (i + 1))).smul (hKd (i + 1))
  have hFS := hsumcurl (fun i y => simCut h (a (i + 1)) y t • bgAn h (i + 1) (S (i + 1)) y t) hTd
    (Finset.range N)
  have hterm : ∀ i : ℕ, curl3 (fun y => simCut h (a (i + 1)) y t • bgAn h (i + 1) (S (i + 1)) y t) x =
      simCut h (a (i + 1)) x t • curl3 (fun y => bgAn h (i + 1) (S (i + 1)) y t) x -
      (deriv (fun σ : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ)) (a (i + 1) * Q) * (a (i + 1) * Q') *
        (1 / 2 * Q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) *
          S (i + 1) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t))) • radVec x := by
    intro i
    have hk : bgAn h (i + 1) (S (i + 1)) x t =
        (1 / 2 * Q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) *
          S (i + 1) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t)) • azVec x := by
      rw [hQ]; rfl
    rw [s3 (fun y => simCut h (a (i + 1)) y t) (fun y => bgAn h (i + 1) (S (i + 1)) y t) _
      (hφd _) (hKd _) (by rw [hφv]; simp) (by rw [hφv]; simp) hk, hφv]
    simp
  have hcA : curl3 (fun w => cutSum h a (fun n => bgAn h n (S n)) w t) x =
      curl3 (fun y => bgAn h 0 (S 0) y t) x + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N,
        (simCut h (a (i + 1)) x t • curl3 (fun y => bgAn h (i + 1) (S (i + 1)) y t) x -
          (deriv (fun σ : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ)) (a (i + 1) * Q) * (a (i + 1) * Q') *
            (1 / 2 * Q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) *
              S (i + 1) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t))) • radVec x) := by
    rw [hcurl_congr _ _ (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hUn hEqA), hadd _ _ (hKd 0) hFS.1, hFS.2]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hterm i)
  
  have hQne0 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≠ 0 := by rw [← hQ]; exact hQne
  have hphi := hQh.sub ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 (x 2)).mul (hQh.rpow_const (p := 2 * h) (Or.inl hQne0)))
  have hconst : ((fun z => simScale h z (1 - t)) - (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2) *
      fun z => simScale h z (1 - t) ^ (2 * h)) = fun _ => 1 - t := by
    funext z; simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply]; exact (hS.1 z (1 - t) hτ).2
  rw [hconst] at hphi
  have hrel := hphi.unique (hasDerivAt_const (x 2) (1 - t))
  rw [← hQ] at hrel
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p, p = Q ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hppos : 0 < p := by rw [hp]; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQpos _
  have hR4 : Q ^ (2 * h - 1) = p ^ 2 := by
    rw [hp, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hQpos.le]
    congr 1; push_cast; ring
  have hR5 : Q ^ (2 * h) = Q * p ^ 2 := by
    have e : Q ^ (2 * h) = Q ^ (1:ℝ) * Q ^ (2 * h - 1) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hQpos]; congr 1; ring
    rw [e, Real.rpow_one, hR4]
  have hprod : Q ^ (1 - 2 * h) * Q ^ (2 * h - 1) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hQpos, show 1 - 2 * h + (2 * h - 1) = (0:ℝ) by ring, Real.rpow_zero]
  have hz2 : x 2 ^ 2 < Q ^ (1 - 2 * h) := by
    have := (hS.2.1 (x 2) (1 - t) hτ).2; rwa [← hQ] at this
  have heta2 : (x 2 * p) ^ 2 < 1 := by
    have e : (x 2 * p) ^ 2 = x 2 ^ 2 * Q ^ (2 * h - 1) := by rw [hR4]; ring
    rw [e]
    calc x 2 ^ 2 * Q ^ (2 * h - 1) < Q ^ (1 - 2 * h) * Q ^ (2 * h - 1) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hz2 (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQpos _)
      _ = 1 := hprod
  have hL : 0 < 1 - 2 * h * (x 2 * p) ^ 2 := by
    have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left heta2 (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * h)
    linarith
  have hLne : 1 - 2 * h * (x 2 * p) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := hL.ne'
  rw [hR4, hR5] at hrel
  have hQ' : Q' = 2 * x 2 * Q * p ^ 2 / (1 - 2 * h * (x 2 * p) ^ 2) := by
    rw [eq_div_iff hLne]
    simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at hrel
    norm_num at hrel
    linear_combination hrel
  have hXdef : simX h x t = (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) / (2 * Q) := by rw [hQ]; rfl
  have hEdef : simEta h x t = x 2 * p := by rw [hp, hQ]; rfl
  have hk : ∀ n : ℕ, Q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) = Q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * (Q * p) := by
    intro n
    have e1 : Q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Q = Q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h + 1) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_add hQpos (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) 1, Real.rpow_one]
    rw [hp, ← mul_assoc, e1, ← Real.rpow_add hQpos]
    congr 1; ring
  have hcrux : ∀ (c D s : ℝ) (n : ℕ),
      D * (c * Q') * (1 / 2 * Q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * s) * (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) =
        Q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * (2 * simEta h x t / (1 - 2 * h * simEta h x t ^ 2) * (c * Q) * D *
          (simX h x t * s)) := by
    intro c D s n
    rw [hk n, hXdef, hEdef]
    generalize Q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) = M
    rw [hQ']
    field_simp
    try ring
  
  have hin : ∀ v w : ℝ³, inner ℝ v w = v 0 * w 0 + v 1 * w 1 + v 2 * w 2 := by
    intro v w
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
    ring
  have he2 : ∀ v : ℝ³, v 2 = inner ℝ v (EuclideanSpace.single 2 (1:ℝ)) := by
    intro v; rw [hin]; simp
  have i_ra : inner ℝ (radVec x) (azVec x) = (0:ℝ) := by rw [hin]; simp [azVec, radVec] <;> ring
  have i_ar : inner ℝ (azVec x) (radVec x) = (0:ℝ) := by rw [hin]; simp [azVec, radVec] <;> ring
  have i_aa : inner ℝ (azVec x) (azVec x) = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := by
    rw [hin]; simp [azVec] <;> ring
  have i_rr : inner ℝ (radVec x) (radVec x) = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := by
    rw [hin]; simp [radVec] <;> ring
  have i_re : inner ℝ (radVec x) (EuclideanSpace.single 2 (1:ℝ)) = (0:ℝ) := by
    rw [← he2]; simp [radVec]
  have i_ae : inner ℝ (azVec x) (EuclideanSpace.single 2 (1:ℝ)) = (0:ℝ) := by
    rw [← he2]; simp [azVec]
  
  have hCx : ∀ n : ℕ, (curl3 (fun y => bgAn h n (S n) y t) x) 2 =
        Q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Uc n (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) ∧
      inner ℝ (curl3 (fun y => bgAn h n (S n) y t) x) (radVec x) =
        Q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Vc n (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) ∧
      inner ℝ (curl3 (fun y => bgAn h n (S n) y t) x) (azVec x) = (0:ℝ) := by
    intro n; rw [hQ]; exact hC n x t hxt hr
  have hCz : ∀ n : ℕ, inner ℝ (curl3 (fun y => bgAn h n (S n) y t) x) (EuclideanSpace.single 2 (1:ℝ)) =
      Q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Uc n (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) := by
    intro n; rw [← he2]; exact (hCx n).1
  have hCr : ∀ n : ℕ, inner ℝ (curl3 (fun y => bgAn h n (S n) y t) x) (radVec x) =
      Q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Vc n (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) := fun n => (hCx n).2.1
  have hCa : ∀ n : ℕ, inner ℝ (curl3 (fun y => bgAn h n (S n) y t) x) (azVec x) = (0:ℝ) :=
    fun n => (hCx n).2.2
  
  have hBn : ∀ n : ℕ, bgBn h n (G n) x t =
      (Q ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * G n (simX h x t) (simEta h x t)) • azVec x := by
    intro n; rw [hQ]; rfl
  
  have hgen : ∀ v : ℝ³, inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => cutSum h a (fun n => bgAn h n (S n)) w t) x +
      cutSum h a (fun n => bgBn h n (G n)) x t) v =
      inner ℝ (curl3 (fun y => bgAn h 0 (S 0) y t) x) v + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N,
        (simCut h (a (i + 1)) x t * inner ℝ (curl3 (fun y => bgAn h (i + 1) (S (i + 1)) y t) x) v -
          (deriv (fun σ : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ)) (a (i + 1) * Q) * (a (i + 1) * Q') *
            (1 / 2 * Q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) *
              S (i + 1) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t))) * inner ℝ (radVec x) v) +
      ((Q ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) * G 0 (simX h x t) (simEta h x t)) * inner ℝ (azVec x) v +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, simCut h (a (i + 1)) x t *
          ((Q ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) * G (i + 1) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t)) *
            inner ℝ (azVec x) v)) := by
    intro v
    rw [hcA, hBx]
    simp only [hBn, inner_add_left, sum_inner, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left]
  
  have hsumG : ∀ T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgSum h a T Q (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) =
      T 0 (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
        bgCut (a (n + 1)) Q * Q ^ (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h) * T (n + 1) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) := by
    intro T
    unfold bgSum
    congr 1
    apply tsum_eq_sum
    intro b hb
    rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hb
    rw [hcz (b + 1) (by omega), zero_mul, zero_mul]
  have hsumV : bgVb h a S Vc Q (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) =
      Vc 0 (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, Q ^ (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h) *
        (bgCut (a (n + 1)) Q * Vc (n + 1) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) -
          2 * simEta h x t / (1 - 2 * h * simEta h x t ^ 2) * (a (n + 1) * Q) *
            deriv (fun σ : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ)) (a (n + 1) * Q) *
              (simX h x t * S (n + 1) (simX h x t) (simEta h x t))) := by
    unfold bgVb
    congr 1
    apply tsum_eq_sum
    intro b hb
    rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hb
    rw [hcz (b + 1) (by omega), hdz (b + 1) (by omega)]
    ring
  have hcast : ∀ i : ℕ, 2 * ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h = 2 * ((i : ℝ) + 1) * h := by
    intro i; push_cast; ring
  have h0A : Q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) = Q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) := by simp
  have h0B : Q ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) = Q ^ (-(1 + h)) := by simp
  have h0V : Q ^ (2 * ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) = 1 := by simp
  
  have hfac : ∀ Y : ℝ, Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * Q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) *
      (Real.sqrt (2 * simX h x t) * Y) = (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * Q ^ (-(1 + h)) * Y := by
    intro Y
    have h2X : 2 * simX h x t = (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) / Q := by rw [hXdef]; field_simp
    have hsq : Real.sqrt (2 * simX h x t) = Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) / Real.sqrt Q := by
      rw [h2X, Real.sqrt_div hr.le]
    have hQh2 : Q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) = Q ^ (-(1 + h)) * Real.sqrt Q := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_add hQpos]; congr 1; ring
    have hne : Real.sqrt Q ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQpos).ne'
    have hrr : Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 :=
      Real.mul_self_sqrt hr.le
    rw [hsq, hQh2]
    calc Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * (Q ^ (-(1 + h)) * Real.sqrt Q) *
          (Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) / Real.sqrt Q * Y)
        = (Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2)) * Q ^ (-(1 + h)) *
            (Real.sqrt Q / Real.sqrt Q) * Y := by ring
      _ = (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * Q ^ (-(1 + h)) * Y := by rw [hrr, div_self hne, mul_one]
  
  rw [← hQ]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [hgen (azVec x)]
    simp only [hCa, i_ra, i_aa, mul_zero, sub_self, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add]
    unfold bgEb
    rw [hsumG G, hfac, h0B]
    conv_rhs => rw [mul_add, Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    · ring
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [hbc, hcast i, Real.rpow_add hQpos]
      ring
  · 
    rw [he2 (curl3 (fun w => cutSum h a (fun n => bgAn h n (S n)) w t) x +
      cutSum h a (fun n => bgBn h n (G n)) x t), hgen]
    simp only [hCz, i_re, i_ae, mul_zero, sub_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
    rw [hsumG Uc, h0A]
    conv_rhs => rw [mul_add, Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [hbc, hcast i, Real.rpow_add hQpos]
      ring
  · 
    rw [hgen (radVec x)]
    simp only [hCr, i_rr, i_ar, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
    rw [hsumV]
    congr 1
    · rw [h0V, one_mul]
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [hcrux (a (i + 1)) _ _ (i + 1), hbc, hcast i]
      ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G Uc Vc W Tth Tz : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → BgOrderZero h Xb cinf F U → BgPositive h Xa Xb m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z S G Uc Vc W Tth Tz → ∃ Cp : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ, ∀ a : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ j, 1 ≤ a j) → (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) → (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ j → ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1 / a j → |Cp j m| * q ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) / 2) ≤ (1 / 2) ^ j) → (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift (bgEb h a G)) (Iio (Real.log 1) ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift (bgSum h a Uc)) (Iio (Real.log 1) ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift (bgVb h a S Vc)) (Iio (Real.log 1) ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ∀ X₀ X₁ : ℝ, 0 < X₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → q < 1 → X₀ ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift (bgEb h a G) w - Real.sqrt (2 * w.2.1) * F w.2.1 w.2.2) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C * q ^ (2 * h) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift (bgSum h a Uc) w - U w.2.1 w.2.2) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C * q ^ (2 * h) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift (bgVb h a S Vc)) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift (bgSum h a Tth)) (Iio (Real.log 1) ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift (bgSum h a Tz)) (Iio (Real.log 1) ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ (∀ q X η : ℝ, (X ≤ Xa ∨ Xb ≤ X) → bgSum h a Tth q X η = 0 ∧ bgSum h a Tz q X η = 0) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → q < 1 → Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift (bgSum h a Tth) w - T0th w.2.1 w.2.2) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C * q ^ h * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift (bgSum h a Tz) w - T0z w.2.1 w.2.2) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C * q ^ h * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N)))

signature.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G Uc Vc W Tth Tz : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → BgOrderZero h Xb cinf F U → BgPositive h Xa Xb m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z S G Uc Vc W Tth Tz → ∃ Cp : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ, ∀ a : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ j, 1 ≤ a j) → (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) → (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ j → ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1 / a j → |Cp j m| * q ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) / 2) ≤ (1 / 2) ^ j) → (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift (bgEb h a G)) (Iio (Real.log 1) ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift (bgSum h a Uc)) (Iio (Real.log 1) ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift (bgVb h a S Vc)) (Iio (Real.log 1) ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ∀ X₀ X₁ : ℝ, 0 < X₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → q < 1 → X₀ ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift (bgEb h a G) w - Real.sqrt (2 * w.2.1) * F w.2.1 w.2.2) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C * q ^ (2 * h) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift (bgSum h a Uc) w - U w.2.1 w.2.2) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C * q ^ (2 * h) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift (bgVb h a S Vc)) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift (bgSum h a Tth)) (Iio (Real.log 1) ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift (bgSum h a Tz)) (Iio (Real.log 1) ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ (∀ q X η : ℝ, (X ≤ Xa ∨ Xb ≤ X) → bgSum h a Tth q X η = 0 ∧ bgSum h a Tz q X η = 0) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → q < 1 → Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift (bgSum h a Tth) w - T0th w.2.1 w.2.2) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C * q ^ h * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift (bgSum h a Tz) w - T0z w.2.1 w.2.2) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C * q ^ h * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N)))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z S G Uc Vc W Tth Tz hS hL hO hP
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, hh1, -, -, -, -, -, hXa, -⟩, ⟨hFs, hUs, -⟩, ⟨hT0s, hT0zs, -⟩, -⟩ := hL
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, ⟨hLVs, hLVb⟩⟩ := hO
  obtain ⟨⟨-, hG0, hU0, hV0, -, hT0⟩, ⟨Xm, Xp, hXam, hmp, hpb, hTsupp, -, -, hTm, hTp⟩, hP2, hP3, -⟩ := hP
  have hh2 : h < 1 / 2 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨⟨hχs, hχ0, hχM⟩, ⟨hψs, hψ0, hψM⟩⟩ := bps_cut_profiles
  have hsq := bps_sqrt_profile
  have hbd : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(S n)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(G n)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(W n)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(Uc n)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(Vc n)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(Tth n)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(Tz n)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C := fun n hn => (hP2 n hn).2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  have hconv : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ m → ∀ X η : ℝ,
      (X, η) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (↿f) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * 1 := by
    intro f hf m
    choose C hC using hf
    refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |C i|, fun i hi X η hXη => ?_⟩
    have h1 := hC i X η hXη.1 hXη.2.1 hXη.2.2
    have h2 : |C i| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |C i| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |C i|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
    rw [mul_one]
    linarith [le_abs_self (C i)]
  have hew0 : ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X := by
    intro X
    unfold edgeWeight
    split_ifs
    · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
    · exact le_rfl
  have hed0 : ∀ X : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → 0 < edgeDist Xa Xb X := by
    intro X h1 h2
    unfold edgeDist
    have hX : 0 < X := by linarith
    refine lt_min one_pos (lt_min ?_ ?_)
    · exact Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).2 h1)
    · exact Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).2 h2)
  have hD' : Ioo Xa Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
    fun p hp => ⟨lt_trans hXa hp.1.1, hp.2⟩
  have hO_sub : Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ici 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 :=
    prod_mono Ioi_subset_Ici_self subset_rfl
  
  obtain ⟨Cp1, hCp1⟩ := bps_log_tail h bpsChi G (fun _ _ => 1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) hh0 hχs hχ0 hχM
    (fun n hn => (hP2 n hn).2.1.mono hO_sub) subset_rfl (fun _ _ _ _ => zero_le_one)
    (fun n hn => hconv (G n) (fun m => (hbd n hn m).imp fun C hC X η h1 h2 h3 => (hC X η h1 h2 h3).2.1))
  obtain ⟨Cp2, hCp2⟩ := bps_log_tail h bpsChi Uc (fun _ _ => 1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) hh0 hχs hχ0 hχM
    (fun n hn => (hP2 n hn).2.2.2.1) subset_rfl (fun _ _ _ _ => zero_le_one)
    (fun n hn => hconv (Uc n) (fun m => (hbd n hn m).imp fun C hC X η h1 h2 h3 => (hC X η h1 h2 h3).2.2.2.1))
  obtain ⟨Cp3, hCp3⟩ := bps_log_tail h bpsChi Vc (fun _ _ => 1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) hh0 hχs hχ0 hχM
    (fun n hn => (hP2 n hn).2.2.2.2.1) subset_rfl (fun _ _ _ _ => zero_le_one)
    (fun n hn => hconv (Vc n) (fun m => (hbd n hn m).imp fun C hC X η h1 h2 h3 => (hC X η h1 h2 h3).2.2.2.2.1))
  have hR := bps_Rcoef_bounds h S hh0 hh2 (fun n hn => (hP2 n hn).1)
    (fun n hn m => (hbd n hn m).imp fun C hC X η h1 h2 h3 => (hC X η h1 h2 h3).1)
  obtain ⟨Cp4, hCp4⟩ := bps_log_tail h bpsPsi (bpsRcoef h S) (fun _ X => 1 + X) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)
    hh0 hψs hψ0 hψM (fun n hn => (hR n hn).1) subset_rfl
    (fun _ X η hX => by
      show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 + X
      have : (0:ℝ) < X := hX.1
      linarith)
    (fun n hn m => by
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (hR n hn).2 m
      exact ⟨C, fun i hi X η hX => hC i hi X η hX.1 hX.2.1 hX.2.2⟩)
  have hSWth := bps_stress_weight Xa Xb Xm Xp aa ab Tth hXa hXam hmp hpb
    (fun n hn => (hP2 n hn).2.2.2.2.2.1)
    (fun n hn m => (hbd n hn m).imp fun C hC X η h1 h2 h3 => (hC X η h1 h2 h3).2.2.2.2.2.1)
    (fun n hn X η hX => (hTm n hn X η hX).1) (fun n hn X η hX => (hTp n hn X η hX).1)
    (fun m => (hP3 m).imp fun C hC => hC.imp fun N hN X η h1 h2 h3 h4 => (hN X η h1 h2 h3 h4).1)
  have hSWz := bps_stress_weight Xa Xb Xm Xp aa ab Tz hXa hXam hmp hpb
    (fun n hn => (hP2 n hn).2.2.2.2.2.2.1)
    (fun n hn m => (hbd n hn m).imp fun C hC X η h1 h2 h3 => (hC X η h1 h2 h3).2.2.2.2.2.2)
    (fun n hn X η hX => (hTm n hn X η hX).2) (fun n hn X η hX => (hTp n hn X η hX).2)
    (fun m => (hP3 m).imp fun C hC => hC.imp fun N hN X η h1 h2 h3 h4 => (hN X η h1 h2 h3 h4).2)
  choose N0th hN0th using hSWth
  choose N0z hN0z using hSWz
  obtain ⟨Cp5, hCp5⟩ := bps_log_tail h bpsChi Tth
    (fun m X => edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-(max (N0th m) (N0z m))))
    (Ioo Xa Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) hh0 hχs hχ0 hχM (fun n hn => (hP2 n hn).2.2.2.2.2.1) hD'
    (fun m X _ hX => mul_nonneg (hew0 X) (Real.rpow_nonneg (hed0 X hX.1.1 hX.1.2).le _))
    (fun n hn m => by
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hN0th m (max (N0th m) (N0z m)) (le_max_left _ _) n hn
      exact ⟨C, fun i hi X η hX => hC i hi X η hX.1.1 hX.1.2 hX.2.1 hX.2.2⟩)
  obtain ⟨Cp6, hCp6⟩ := bps_log_tail h bpsChi Tz
    (fun m X => edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-(max (N0th m) (N0z m))))
    (Ioo Xa Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) hh0 hχs hχ0 hχM (fun n hn => (hP2 n hn).2.2.2.2.2.2.1) hD'

bg_profile_sums.definitions:
noncomputable def bpsChi (σ : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ)

noncomputable def bpsPsi (σ : ℝ) : ℝ := σ * deriv (fun σ' : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ')) σ

noncomputable def bpsTail (h : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' n : ℕ, φ (a (n + 1) * Real.exp w.1) * Real.exp w.1 ^ (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h) * T (n + 1) w.2.1 w.2.2

noncomputable def bpsRcoef (h : ℝ) (S : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(2 * η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)) * (X * S n X η)

and_nodes.definitions_block:
noncomputable def bpsChi (σ : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ)

noncomputable def bpsPsi (σ : ℝ) : ℝ := σ * deriv (fun σ' : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ')) σ

noncomputable def bpsTail (h : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' n : ℕ, φ (a (n + 1) * Real.exp w.1) * Real.exp w.1 ^ (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h) * T (n + 1) w.2.1 w.2.2

noncomputable def bpsRcoef (h : ℝ) (S : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(2 * η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)) * (X * S n X η)

subgoal_signatures.name: bps_cut_profiles

  have hglob : ∀ (j k : ℕ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 → ∀ X : ℝ,

    obtain ⟨CB, hCB⟩ := hgB k

    obtain ⟨CΨ, hCΨ⟩ := hΨG k
    refine ⟨|C0| + |CA| + |CB| + |CP| + |CΨ|, max K0 (max (L k) (LΦ k)), fun x t hxt => ?_⟩

noncomputable def axPi (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Pax η + profRadInt (fun x e => F x e ^ 2) X η

noncomputable def axNs (h : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -leadW h U X η * U X η +
    ((1 / 2 - h) * (profRadInt U X η - η * profEtaD (profRadInt U) X η)
      + 4 * h * η * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) X η
      - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)) X η) / X
    + 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * axPi Pax F X η - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (axPi Pax F) X η

noncomputable def axPs2 (h : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  X * axNs h Pax F U X η / ((1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η))

noncomputable def axTz (h : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  F X η * (axPs2 h Pax F U X η + shearB F U X η)

noncomputable def axSq (h : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -leadW h U X η * (1 + X * deriv (fun Y => F Y η) X / F X η) - h * (1 - 2 * η * U X η)
    - ((1 / 2 - h) * η + (1 - η ^ 2) * U X η) * deriv (fun e => F X e) η / F X η

noncomputable def axSn (h : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -leadW h U X η * (X * deriv (fun Y => U Y η) X) - (1 / 2 + h) * (1 - 2 * η * U X η) * U X η
    - ((1 / 2 - h) * η + (1 - η ^ 2) * U X η) * deriv (fun e => U X e) η
    - (1 - η ^ 2) * deriv (fun e => axPi Pax F X e) η + 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * axPi Pax F X η
    + 2 * η * X * F X η ^ 2

def AxCone (h μ : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=

    μ ≤ F X η ∧ μ ≤ shearA F X η ∧
    μ ≤ psLead1 h F U X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * axPs2 h Pax F U X η - 2 ∧
    μ ≤ coneUp (psLead1 h F U X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * axPs2 h Pax F U X η)
          (axPs2 h Pax F U X η + shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * psLead1 h F U X η)
        - shearA F X η * (1 + (shearB F U X η / shearA F X η) ^ 2)

def AxAdm (h : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (w δ : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∃ c₀ : ℝ, 0 < c₀ ∧ ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      c₀ * w X ≤ Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U X η ^ 2 + axTz h Pax F U X η ^ 2)) ∧
  (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTh h F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * w X * δ X ^ (-N) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(axTz h Pax F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * w X * δ X ^ (-N) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + axTz h Pax F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => axTz h Pax F U z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + axTz h Pax F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧
  (∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ κ < 2 ∧ ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      κ ≤ F X η ∧ κ ≤ shearA F X η ∧
      κ ≤ shearA F X η * (1 + (shearB F U X η / shearA F X η) ^ 2) - 2 ∧
      κ * Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U X η ^ 2 + axTz h Pax F U X η ^ 2) ≤
        leadStressTh h F U X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * axTz h Pax F U X η ∧
      (shearA F X η * (1 + (shearB F U X η / shearA F X η) ^ 2) - 2) *
          (axTz h Pax F U X η + shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * leadStressTh h F U X η) ^ 2 ≤
        (2 - κ) * (leadStressTh h F U X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * axTz h Pax F U X η) ^ 2)

noncomputable def axHs (h j0 η : ℝ) : ℝ := (1 / 2 - h) * η + (1 - η ^ 2) * (4 * η + j0)

noncomputable def axZs (h j0 : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(1 / 2 + h) * (1 - 2 * η * (4 * η + j0)) * (4 * η + j0) - 4 * axHs h j0 η
    - (1 - η ^ 2) * deriv Pax η + 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * Pax η

def AxData (h j0 σ δ ρ : ℝ) (Pc : ℂ → ℂ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < σ ∧ 0 < δ ∧ 0 < ρ ∧ ρ ≤ 1 / 50 ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ Pc {w : ℂ | |w.im| < 2 * ρ ∧ -1 - 2 * ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + 2 * ρ} ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 - 2 * ρ < η → η < 1 + 2 * ρ → Pc (η : ℂ) = ((Pax η : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
  (∀ w : ℂ, |w.im| ≤ ρ → -1 - ρ ≤ w.re → w.re ≤ 1 + ρ →
      ((1 / 2 - (h : ℂ)) * w + (1 - w ^ 2) * (4 * w + (j0 : ℂ))) ^ 2 + ((σ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 ≠ 0 ∧
      1 - 2 * (h : ℂ) * w ^ 2 ≠ 0) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 - ρ ≤ η → η ≤ 1 + ρ → |axZs h j0 Pax η| ≤ δ → 99 * σ ^ 2 < axHs h j0 η ^ 2) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 - ρ ≤ η → η ≤ 1 + ρ → 14 / 5 < 3 - 8 * h * η ^ 2 + (1 - 2 * h) * j0 * η)

def AxProfI (h Pst XR Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 Xh1 aa : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Fi Ui : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (0 < XR ∧ 0 < aa ∧ 0 < Xa ∧ Xa < Xan ∧ Xan < Xa1 ∧ Xa1 < Xa2 ∧ Xa2 < Xh1 ∧
      Xh1 < XR * Real.exp (-5)) ∧
  (∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Fi) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Ui) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < Fi X η) ∧
    (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Fi) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Ui) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, Xh1 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → Ui X η = 4 * η ∧ Fi X η = refFin Pst XR X η) ∧
  (∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ Fc Uc Pc : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ,
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Fc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Uc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Pc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xan →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Fc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Uc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Pc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      (∀ w : ℂ, |w.im| < ρ → -1 - ρ < w.re → w.re < 1 + ρ →
        ‖Fc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Uc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Pc k X w‖ ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
        Fc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => Fi Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Uc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => Ui Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Pc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => Pax η + profRadInt (fun x e => Fi x e ^ 2) Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ))) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
     profRadInt Ui (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η = profRadInt (fun _ e => 4 * e) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η ∧
     profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * Fi x e) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η =
       profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * refFin Pst XR x e) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η ∧
     profRadInt (fun x e => Ui x e * (2 * x * Fi x e)) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η =
       profRadInt (fun x e => 4 * e * (2 * x * refFin Pst XR x e)) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η ∧
     profRadInt (fun x e => Ui x e ^ 2 - x * Fi x e ^ 2) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η =
       profRadInt (fun x e => (4 * e) ^ 2 - x * refFin Pst XR x e ^ 2) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η ∧
     profRadInt (fun x e => Fi x e ^ 2) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η =
       profRadInt (fun x e => refFin Pst XR x e ^ 2) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η) ∧
  ((∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ Xa → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      leadStressTh h Fi Ui X η = 0 ∧ axTz h Pax Fi Ui X η = 0) ∧
   AxAdm h Pax (fun X => Real.exp (-(aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2))) (fun X => min 1 (Real.log (X / Xa)))
      (Ioc Xa Xa2) Fi Ui ∧
   ∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ AxCone h μ Pax (Icc Xa1 (XR * Real.exp (-5))) Fi Ui)

def AxInner (h : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (ε Bd C Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ : ℝ) (ℓ G : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (0 < Xa ∧ Xa < Xan ∧ Xan < Xa1 ∧ Xa1 < Xa2 ∧ Xa2 < 110 * Real.exp (-τ) ∧ 0 < τ ∧ 0 < aa ∧ 1 ≤ C) ∧
  (∃ ε' : ℝ, 0 < ε' ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η) ∧
    (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C' : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C' ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C')) ∧
  (∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ Fc Uc Pc : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ,
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Fc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Uc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Pc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xan →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Fc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Uc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Pc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      (∀ w : ℂ, |w.im| < ρ → -1 - ρ < w.re → w.re < 1 + ρ →
        ‖Fc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Uc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Pc k X w‖ ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
        Fc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => F Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Uc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => U Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Pc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => Pax η + profRadInt (fun x e => F x e ^ 2) Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ))) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, 110 * Real.exp (-τ) ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      U X η = G η ∧ F X η = Real.exp (ℓ η) * (X / 110) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) / (C * Real.sqrt (2 * X))) ∧
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ℓ (Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |ℓ η| ≤ Bd ∧ |deriv ℓ η| ≤ Bd ∧ |G η - 4 * η| ≤ ε ∧ |deriv G η - 4| ≤ ε ∧
      -(1 / 2) ≤ -((1 / 2 - h) * η + (1 - η ^ 2) * G η) * deriv ℓ η) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 110 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      |U X η - 4 * η| ≤ ε ∧ |deriv (fun e => U X e) η - 4| ≤ ε ∧
      C * F X η ≤ Bd ∧ |C * deriv (fun e => F X e) η| ≤ Bd) ∧
  ((∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ Xa → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      leadStressTh h F U X η = 0 ∧ axTz h Pax F U X η = 0) ∧
   AxAdm h Pax (fun X => Real.exp (-(aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2))) (fun X => min 1 (Real.log (X / Xa)))
      (Ioc Xa Xa2) F U ∧
   ∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ AxCone h μ Pax (Icc Xa1 110) F U)

def AxStressLocal : Prop :=
  (∀ (h X1 : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (F U F' U' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → F' X η = F X η ∧ U' X η = U X η) →
    ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      leadQs h F' U' X η = leadQs h F U X η ∧ axNs h Pax F' U' X η = axNs h Pax F U X η ∧
      shearA F' X η = shearA F X η ∧ shearB F' U' X η = shearB F U X η) ∧
  (∀ (h : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
    (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ leadPi F 0 η = Pax η) →
    ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → leadNs h F U X η = axNs h Pax F U X η)

def AxStressSmooth : Prop :=
  ∀ (h ε : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < ε →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Pax (Ioo (-1) 1) →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTh h F U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axTz h Pax F U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)

def AxSourceId : Prop :=
  ∀ (h ε : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < ε →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Pax (Ioo (-1) 1) →
    ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * (2 * Y * F Y η) * leadQs h F U Y η) (2 * X * F X η * axSq h F U X η) X ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * axNs h Pax F U Y η) (axSn h Pax F U X η) X

def ConeUpGtTwo : Prop := ∀ P J : ℝ, 2 < P → 2 < coneUp P J

def AxRepairIdeal : Prop :=
  ∀ Pst x1 x2 : ℝ, 0 < Pst → 0 < x1 → x1 < x2 →
  ∃ (s1 s2 δ C : ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ) (Φ : (Fin 5 → ℝ) → ℝ → (Fin 5 → ℝ)),
    x1 < s1 ∧ s1 < s2 ∧ s2 < x2 ∧ 0 < δ ∧
    (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (β i)) ∧ (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (γ j)) ∧
    (∀ i x, (x ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ x) → β i x = 0) ∧ (∀ j x, (x ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ x) → γ j x = 0) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : (Fin 5 → ℝ) × ℝ => Φ p.1 p.2) (Metric.ball (0 : Fin 5 → ℝ) δ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) ∧
    (∀ η : ℝ, Φ 0 η = 0) ∧
    ∀ (d : Fin 5 → ℝ) (η : ℝ), ‖d‖ < δ → -2 < η → η < 2 →
      let c := Φ d η
      let E0 : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => Pst * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)
      let Uc : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => 4 * η + (c 0 * β 0 x + c 1 * β 1 x)
      let Ec : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => E0 x + (c 2 * γ 0 x + c 3 * γ 1 x + c 4 * γ 2 x)
      ‖c‖ ≤ C * ‖d‖ ∧
      (∫ x in x1..x2, (Uc x - 4 * η)) = d 0 ∧
      (∫ x in x1..x2, Real.sqrt (2 * x) * (Ec x - E0 x)) = d 1 ∧
      (∫ x in x1..x2, (Uc x * (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * Ec x) - 4 * η * (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * E0 x))) = d 2 ∧
      (∫ x in x1..x2, ((Uc x ^ 2 - Ec x ^ 2 / 2) - ((4 * η) ^ 2 - E0 x ^ 2 / 2))) = d 3 ∧
      (∫ x in x1..x2, (Ec x ^ 2 - E0 x ^ 2) / (2 * x)) = d 4 ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, x1 ≤ x → x ≤ x2 → E0 x / 2 ≤ Ec x

def AxDatumSmooth : Prop :=
  ∀ (h Pst : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ), AxDatum h Pst Pax → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Pax (Ioo (-1 - ρ) (1 + ρ))

noncomputable def axPi (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Pax η + profRadInt (fun x e => F x e ^ 2) X η

noncomputable def axNs (h : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -leadW h U X η * U X η +
    ((1 / 2 - h) * (profRadInt U X η - η * profEtaD (profRadInt U) X η)
      + 4 * h * η * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) X η
      - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)) X η) / X
    + 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * axPi Pax F X η - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (axPi Pax F) X η

noncomputable def axPs2 (h : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  X * axNs h Pax F U X η / ((1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η))

noncomputable def axTz (h : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  F X η * (axPs2 h Pax F U X η + shearB F U X η)

noncomputable def axSq (h : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -leadW h U X η * (1 + X * deriv (fun Y => F Y η) X / F X η) - h * (1 - 2 * η * U X η)
    - ((1 / 2 - h) * η + (1 - η ^ 2) * U X η) * deriv (fun e => F X e) η / F X η

noncomputable def axSn (h : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -leadW h U X η * (X * deriv (fun Y => U Y η) X) - (1 / 2 + h) * (1 - 2 * η * U X η) * U X η
    - ((1 / 2 - h) * η + (1 - η ^ 2) * U X η) * deriv (fun e => U X e) η
    - (1 - η ^ 2) * deriv (fun e => axPi Pax F X e) η + 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * axPi Pax F X η
    + 2 * η * X * F X η ^ 2

def AxCone (h μ : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
    μ ≤ F X η ∧ μ ≤ shearA F X η ∧
    μ ≤ psLead1 h F U X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * axPs2 h Pax F U X η - 2 ∧
    μ ≤ coneUp (psLead1 h F U X η - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * axPs2 h Pax F U X η)
          (axPs2 h Pax F U X η + shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * psLead1 h F U X η)
        - shearA F X η * (1 + (shearB F U X η / shearA F X η) ^ 2)

def AxAdm (h : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (w δ : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∃ c₀ : ℝ, 0 < c₀ ∧ ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      c₀ * w X ≤ Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U X η ^ 2 + axTz h Pax F U X η ^ 2)) ∧
  (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTh h F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * w X * δ X ^ (-N) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(axTz h Pax F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * w X * δ X ^ (-N) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + axTz h Pax F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => axTz h Pax F U z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + axTz h Pax F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧

subgoal_signatures.name: profRadAvg_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profRadAvg g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(profRadAvg g)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → X * profRadAvg g X η = profRadInt g X η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * profRadAvg g Y η) (g X η) X)

subgoal_signatures.name: iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {E F G H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] H) (f : E → F) (g : E → G) (O S : Set E), IsOpen O → S ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g O → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z‖ ≤ C) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g z‖ ≤ C) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) z‖ ≤ C

subgoal_signatures.name: heatK_deriv_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ β Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → 0 < Z → HasDerivAt (fun Y => heatK β Y) (-β * heatK (β + 1) Z) Z ∧ |heatK β Z| ≤ Real.Gamma (β + 1)

subgoal_signatures.name: heatK_ode
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h Z : ℝ, 0 < h → 0 < Z → (h + 1) * Z ^ 2 * heatK (h + 2) Z - (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * heatK (h + 1) Z + (1 + h) * heatK h Z = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: heatProfile_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → (∀ β Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → 0 < Z → HasDerivAt (fun Y => heatK β Y) (-β * heatK (β + 1) Z) Z ∧ |heatK β Z| ≤ Real.Gamma (β + 1)) → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → (h + 1) * Z ^ 2 * heatK (h + 2) Z - (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * heatK (h + 1) Z + (1 + h) * heatK h Z = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv k (heatProfile h) Z| ≤ C) ∧ (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → Z ^ 2 * deriv (deriv (heatProfile h)) Z + (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * deriv (heatProfile h) Z + h * (1 + h) * heatProfile h Z = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: heatQ_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv k (heatProfile h) Z| ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatQ h) (Ioi 0) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → |iteratedDeriv k (heatQ h) Y| ≤ C) ∧ (∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → (1 + 2 * h) * heatQ h Y + Y * deriv (heatQ h) Y = heatProfile h Y ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: heatPressure_integral_eq
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h A S : ℝ, 0 < S → ∫ s in Ioi S, s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (A / s) ^ 2 = S ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) * heatQ h (A / S)

    have hFd : ∀ η y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun η : ℝ => c y ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * ϑ y))
        (-4 * η * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (ϑ y * c y ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * ϑ y))) η := by
      intro η y
      have h := ((hbd η).rpow_const (p := 2 * ϑ y) (Or.inl (hb0 η).ne')).const_mul (c y ^ 2)
      convert h using 1
      rw [Real.rpow_sub_one (hb0 η).ne']
      have := (hb0 η).ne'
      field_simp
      ring
    have hmc : Measurable (fun y => c y ^ 2) := hc.pow_const 2
    have hmf : ∀ η : ℝ, Measurable (fun y => ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * ϑ y)) := fun η =>
      measurable_const.pow (hϑ.const_mul 2)
    have key := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (μ := volume)
      (F := fun η y => c y ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * ϑ y))
      (F' := fun η y => -4 * η * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (ϑ y * c y ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * ϑ y)))
      (x₀ := η₀) (bound := fun y => 4 * (|η₀| + 1) * c y ^ 2) (s := Metric.ball η₀ 1)
      (Metric.ball_mem_nhds η₀ one_pos)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun η => (hmc.mul (hmf η)).aestronglyMeasurable))
      (by
        refine hI.mono' (hmc.mul (hmf η₀)).aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ (fun y => ?_))
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (hpow η₀ y).1)]
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (sq_nonneg _) (hpow η₀ y).2)
      ((measurable_const.mul ((hϑ.mul hmc).mul (hmf η₀))).aestronglyMeasurable)
      (ae_of_all _ (fun y η hη => by
        have hη' : |η - η₀| < 1 := by rw [← Real.dist_eq]; exact hη
        have habs : |η| ≤ |η₀| + 1 := by
          have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub η η₀
          linarith
        have h1 := (hb2 y).1
        have h2 := (hb2 y).2
        have h3 := (hpow η y).1
        have h4 := (hpow η y).2
        have h5 := sq_nonneg (c y)
        have h6 := (hb0 η).le
        have h7 := hb1 η
        have hX : 0 ≤ ϑ y * c y ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * ϑ y) := by positivity
        have hX1 : ϑ y * c y ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * ϑ y) ≤ c y ^ 2 := by
          calc ϑ y * c y ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * ϑ y) ≤ 1 * c y ^ 2 * 1 := by gcongr
            _ = c y ^ 2 := by ring
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hX, abs_of_nonneg h6]
        have : |(-4 : ℝ)| = 4 := by norm_num
        rw [this]
        calc 4 * |η| * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (ϑ y * c y ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * ϑ y))
            ≤ 4 * (|η₀| + 1) * 1 * c y ^ 2 := by gcongr
          _ = 4 * (|η₀| + 1) * c y ^ 2 := by ring))
      (hI.const_mul _)
      (ae_of_all _ (fun y η _ => hFd η y))
    have h2 := key.2.const_mul (-(1 / 2) : ℝ)
    have hfun : (fun η => -(1 / 2) * ∫ y, c y ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * ϑ y)) = shapeDatum c ϑ := by
      funext η; rfl
    rw [hfun] at h2
    convert h2 using 1
    rw [integral_const_mul]
    ring
  
  refine ⟨⟨1 / 4, by norm_num, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨Pc, hdiff, hval⟩ := hcx
    exact ⟨Pc, hdiff, fun η _ _ => hval η⟩
  · intro η
    unfold shapeDatum
    rw [neg_sq]
  · intro η _ _
    have := (hlb η).1
    show -(1 / 2) * ∫ y, c y ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * ϑ y) ≤ _
    linarith
  · intro η _ _ hη0
    rw [(hder η).deriv]
    have hf : 0 < (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
    have hJ : 0 < ∫ y, ϑ y * c y ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * ϑ y) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) (hlb η).2
    have hηη : 0 < η * η := mul_self_pos.mpr hη0
    have : η * (2 * η * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∫ y, ϑ y * c y ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * ϑ y)) =
        2 * (η * η) * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∫ y, ϑ y * c y ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * ϑ y) := by ring
    rw [this]
    positivity

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h cinf ρ Xb : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), TailForm h cinf ρ Xb F U → ∀ X η : ℝ, Xb ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → leadStressTh h F U X η = 0 ∧ leadStressTz h F U X η = 0

signature.name: tail_stress_zero
signature.statement: ∀ (h cinf ρ Xb : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), TailForm h cinf ρ Xb F U → ∀ X η : ℝ, Xb ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → leadStressTh h F U X η = 0 ∧ leadStressTz h F U X η = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h cinf ρ Xb F U hT X η hX hη1 hη2
  have hT' := hT
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hc0, hXb0, -, -, -, -, hFpos, htail, -⟩ := hT'
  have hX0 : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hXb0 hX
  
  have c7a : ∀ (c p H0 H1 F0 F1 I0 I1 : ℝ), 0 < c → 0 < p → F0 ≠ 0 →
      F0 = c / Real.sqrt 2 * (p / X) * H0 →
      F1 = c / Real.sqrt 2 * (p / X ^ 2) * (-(1 + h) * H0 - 2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X * H1) →
      I0 = Real.sqrt 2 * c * (X * p) / (1 - h) * ((2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X) ^ 2 * H1 + (1 + (1 + h) * (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X)) * H0) →
      I1 = Real.sqrt 2 * c * (X * p) * (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X * H1 + (1 + h) * H0) * (-(4 * η) / X) →
      X * (-1 + ((1 - h) * I0 - (1 / 2 - h) * η * I1) / (X * (2 * X * F0))) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) = -2 * X * F1 / F0 := by
    intro c p H0 H1 F0 F1 I0 I1 hc hp hF0 eF0 eF1 eI0 eI1
    have hs : (0:ℝ) < Real.sqrt 2 := by positivity
    have hsq : Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt 2 = 2 := Real.mul_self_sqrt (by norm_num)
    have hc2 : c / Real.sqrt 2 = c * Real.sqrt 2 / 2 := by
      rw [div_eq_div_iff hs.ne' two_ne_zero, mul_assoc, hsq]
    have hd : 0 < 1 - η ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hL : 0 < 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have h1h : 0 < 1 - h := by linarith
    have hH0 : H0 ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      apply hF0
      rw [eF0]
      ring
    have hXne := hX0.ne'
    have hLne := hL.ne'
    have h1hne := h1h.ne'
    have hsne := hs.ne'
    have hcne := hc.ne'
    have hpne := hp.ne'
    rw [hc2] at eF0 eF1
    rw [div_eq_iff hLne]
    subst eF0 eF1 eI0 eI1
    field_simp
    ring
  have c7b : ∀ (c p H0 Q1 Q2 S0 S1 P0 P1 : ℝ),
      S0 = c ^ 2 / 2 * Q1 →
      S1 = c ^ 2 / 2 * (((1 - (1 + 2 * h)) * Q1 + p ^ 2 * H0 ^ 2) / (2 * (1 - η ^ 2)) * (-(4 * η))) →
      P0 = -(c ^ 2 / 2 * Q2) →
      P1 = -(c ^ 2 / 2 * (((1 - (2 + 2 * h)) * Q2 + p ^ 2 / X * H0 ^ 2) / (2 * (1 - η ^ 2)) * (-(4 * η)))) →
      (4 * h * η * S0 - (1 - η ^ 2) * S1) / X + 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * P0 - (1 - η ^ 2) * P1 = 0 := by
    intro c p H0 Q1 Q2 S0 S1 P0 P1 eS0 eS1 eP0 eP1
    have hd : 0 < 1 - η ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hXne := hX0.ne'
    have hdne := hd.ne'
    subst eS0 eS1 eP0 eP1
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hXt : Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) < X := by
    have he : Real.exp (-(11 / 4 : ℝ)) < 1 := by
      have := Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (show (-(11 / 4 : ℝ)) < 0 by norm_num)
      rwa [Real.exp_zero] at this
    nlinarith
  have ha0 : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → 0 < 2 * (1 - e ^ 2) := by
    intro e he1 he2
    nlinarith
  have hY : 0 < 2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X := div_pos (ha0 η hη1 hη2) hX0
  have h1hne : (1 : ℝ) - h ≠ 0 := by
    have : h < 1 := by linarith
    linarith
  have hXne : X ≠ 0 := hX0.ne'
  have hp : 0 < X ^ (-h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hX0 _
  have hXp : X ^ (1 - h) = X * X ^ (-h) := by
    rw [show (1:ℝ) - h = 1 + -h by ring, Real.rpow_add hX0, Real.rpow_one]
  have hXp2 : X ^ (1 - (1 + 2 * h)) = (X ^ (-h)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [sq, ← Real.rpow_add hX0]; congr 1; ring
  have hXp3 : X ^ (1 - (2 + 2 * h)) = (X ^ (-h)) ^ 2 / X := by
    rw [sq, ← Real.rpow_add hX0, ← Real.rpow_sub_one hX0.ne']; congr 1; ring
  
  obtain ⟨hP1, hP2, hP3⟩ :=
    heatProfile_props h hh0 heatK_deriv_bound (fun Z hZ => heatK_ode h Z hh0 hZ)
  obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := hP2 0
  obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hP2 1
  simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero] at hC0
  simp only [iteratedDeriv_one] at hC1
  have hHc : ContinuousOn (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) := hP1.continuousOn
  have hHd : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → HasDerivAt (heatProfile h) (deriv (heatProfile h) y) y := fun y hy =>
    ((hP1.contDiffAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasDerivAt
  have hP1' : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (deriv (heatProfile h)) (Ioi 0) :=
    hP1.deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioi (by simp)
  have hH'd : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y →
      HasDerivAt (deriv (heatProfile h)) (deriv (deriv (heatProfile h)) y) y := fun y hy =>
    ((hP1'.contDiffAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasDerivAt
  
  have hPhi : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → HasDerivAt
      (fun z => z ^ 2 * deriv (heatProfile h) z + (1 + (1 + h) * z) * heatProfile h z)
      ((1 - h) * (y * deriv (heatProfile h) y + (1 + h) * heatProfile h y)) y := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 := ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 y).mul (hH'd y hy)).add
      ((((hasDerivAt_id y).const_mul (1 + h)).const_add 1).mul (hHd y hy))
    refine h1.congr_deriv ?_
    try simp only [id]
    linear_combination hP3 y hy
  have hCb : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z → |heatProfile h z| ≤ max C0 C1 ∧ |deriv (heatProfile h) z| ≤ max C0 C1 :=
    fun z hz => ⟨(hC0 z hz).trans (le_max_left _ _), (hC1 z hz).trans (le_max_right _ _)⟩
  have hK : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z → |heatProfile h z - 1| ≤ h * (1 + h) * z :=
    fun z hz => heat_near_one h z hh0 hz
  
  have hΘ : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 →
      ∫ x in Ioi X, x ^ (-h) * (heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) - 1) =
        -(X ^ (1 - h) * ((2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / X) ^ 2 * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / X) +
          (1 + (1 + h) * (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / X)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / X) - 1)) / (1 - h) :=
    fun e he1 he2 => (heat_tail_integral (heatProfile h) h (max C0 C1) (h * (1 + h)) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2)) X
      hh0 (by linarith) (ha0 e he1 he2) hX0 hHc hCb hK hPhi).2
  
  have ha : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => 2 * (1 - e ^ 2)) (-(4 * η)) η := by
    have := ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 η).const_sub 1).const_mul 2
    convert this using 1
    norm_num <;> ring
  have hg : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => 2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / X) (-(4 * η) / X) η := ha.div_const X
  
  have hrep := tail_backward_reps h cinf ρ Xb F U hT X η hX hη1 hη2
  
  have hI0 : profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) X η =
      Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * (X * X ^ (-h)) / (1 - h) *
        ((2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X) ^ 2 * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X) +
          (1 + (1 + h) * (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X)) := by
    rw [hrep.2.2.2.2, hΘ η hη1 hη2, hXp]
    ring
  have hI : HasDerivAt (fun e => profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) X e)
      (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * (X * X ^ (-h)) *
        (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X) +
          (1 + h) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X)) * (-(4 * η) / X)) η := by
    have hc := ((((((hPhi _ hY).comp η hg).sub_const 1).const_mul (X ^ (1 - h))).neg.div_const
      (1 - h)).const_mul (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf)).const_sub (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * X ^ (1 - h) / (1 - h))
    refine (hc.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_).congr_deriv ?_
    · filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2] with e he
      exact ((tail_backward_reps h cinf ρ Xb F U hT X e hX he.1 he.2).2.2.2.2).trans
        (by rw [hΘ e he.1 he.2] <;> rfl)
    · rw [hXp]
      field_simp
  
  have hkc : ContinuousOn (fun z => heatProfile h z ^ 2) (Ioi 0) := hHc.pow 2
  have hkb : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z → |(fun z => heatProfile h z ^ 2) z| ≤ C0 ^ 2 := by
    intro z hz
    have h1 := hC0 z hz
    have h2 := abs_nonneg (heatProfile h z)
    show |heatProfile h z ^ 2| ≤ C0 ^ 2
    rw [abs_pow]
    nlinarith
  have hΨ1 := power_tail_integral_deriv (fun z => heatProfile h z ^ 2) (C0 ^ 2) (1 + 2 * h)
    (2 * (1 - η ^ 2)) X (by linarith) (ha0 η hη1 hη2) hX0 hkc hkb
  have hΨ2 := power_tail_integral_deriv (fun z => heatProfile h z ^ 2) (C0 ^ 2) (2 + 2 * h)
    (2 * (1 - η ^ 2)) X (by linarith) (ha0 η hη1 hη2) hX0 hkc hkb
  have hS : HasDerivAt (fun e => profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) X e)
      (cinf ^ 2 / 2 * (((1 - (1 + 2 * h)) *
          (∫ x in Ioi X, x ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) ^ 2) +
        (X ^ (-h)) ^ 2 * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X) ^ 2) / (2 * (1 - η ^ 2)) * (-(4 * η)))) η := by
    have hc := (hΨ1.comp η ha).const_mul (cinf ^ 2 / 2)
    refine (hc.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_).congr_deriv ?_
    · filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2] with e he
      exact (tail_backward_reps h cinf ρ Xb F U hT X e hX he.1 he.2).2.2.1
    · rw [hXp2] <;> rfl
  have hP : HasDerivAt (fun e => leadPi F X e)
      (-(cinf ^ 2 / 2 * (((1 - (2 + 2 * h)) *
          (∫ x in Ioi X, x ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) ^ 2) +

    have hc := ((hΨ2.comp η ha).const_mul (cinf ^ 2 / 2)).neg

    · filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2] with e he

    · rw [hXp3] <;> rfl
  
  obtain ⟨hF0eq, hFd⟩ :=
    tail_F_deriv h cinf ρ Xb X η F U hT sigA_flat (hHd _ hY).differentiableAt hX hη1 hη2
  
  have hWv : leadW h U X η = 1 := by
    have hev : (fun e => profRadAvg U X e) =ᶠ[nhds η] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by

    rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const, hrep.1]
    ring

  have hJ1 : profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))) X η = 0 := by
    have hev : (fun e => profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) X e) =ᶠ[nhds η]

      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2] with e he

    unfold profEtaD
    rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
  have hU0 : U X η = 0 := (htail X η hXt.le hη1 hη2).1

  have hM1 : profEtaD (profRadInt U) X η = 0 := by
    have hev : (fun e => profRadInt U X e) =ᶠ[nhds η] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by

    unfold profEtaD
    rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
  have hsB : shearB F U X η = 0 := by
    have hev : (fun Y => U Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hXt] with Y hY
      exact (htail Y η (le_of_lt hY) hη1 hη2).1
    unfold shearB
    rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
    simp
  
  have hc7a := c7a cinf (X ^ (-h)) (heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X))
    (deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X)) (F X η) (deriv (fun Y => F Y η) X)
    (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) X η)
    (profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) X η)
    hc0 hp (hFpos X η hX0 hη1 hη2).ne' hF0eq hFd.deriv hI0 hI.deriv
  have hc7b := c7b cinf (X ^ (-h)) (heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X))
    (∫ x in Ioi X, x ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) ^ 2)
    (∫ x in Ioi X, x ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) ^ 2)
    (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) X η)
    (profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)) X η)
    (leadPi F X η) (profEtaD (leadPi F) X η)
    hrep.2.2.1 hS.deriv hrep.2.2.2.1 hP.deriv
  constructor
  · unfold leadStressTh leadQs shearA
    rw [hWv, hJ0, hJ1]
    linear_combination (F X η) * hc7a
  · have hNs : leadNs h F U X η = 0 := by
      unfold leadNs
      rw [hWv, hU0, hM0, hM1]
      linear_combination hc7b
    unfold leadStressTz
    rw [hNs, hsB]
    simp

subgoal_signatures.name: heatK_deriv_bound

subgoal_signatures.name: heatK_ode
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h Z : ℝ, 0 < h → 0 < Z → (h + 1) * Z ^ 2 * heatK (h + 2) Z - (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * heatK (h + 1) Z + (1 + h) * heatK h Z = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: heatProfile_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → (∀ β Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → 0 < Z → HasDerivAt (fun Y => heatK β Y) (-β * heatK (β + 1) Z) Z ∧ |heatK β Z| ≤ Real.Gamma (β + 1)) → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → (h + 1) * Z ^ 2 * heatK (h + 2) Z - (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * heatK (h + 1) Z + (1 + h) * heatK h Z = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv k (heatProfile h) Z| ≤ C) ∧ (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → Z ^ 2 * deriv (deriv (heatProfile h)) Z + (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * deriv (heatProfile h) Z + h * (1 + h) * heatProfile h Z = 0)

tail_collar_admblk.definitions:
noncomputable def tailHt (h cinf x η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x)

noncomputable def tailEh (h cinf x η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x)

noncomputable def collarTth (h cinf ρ Xb X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  tailHt h cinf X η * deriv (tailFac ρ Xb) X +
    (∫ x in X..Xb, (2 * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) *
        (tailHt h cinf x η - x * deriv (fun y => tailHt h cinf y η) x) + x * tailHt h cinf x η) *
        deriv (tailFac ρ Xb) x) / (2 * X * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2))

noncomputable def collarTz (h cinf ρ Xb X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2 * η * (∫ s in X..Xb, (s - X) * tailEh h cinf s η ^ 2 * tailFac ρ Xb s * deriv (tailFac ρ Xb) s) /
    ((1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (2 * X))
