        (fun x hx => ⟨hx, h1, h2⟩)
    obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := hbF2 0
    have hI1 : IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 1) := by
      refine Integrable.mono'
        (Integrable.const_mul (integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by norm_num : -(6 / 5 : ℝ) < -1) one_pos) C0)
        ((hcont.mono (fun x (hx : 1 < x) => show (0:ℝ) < x from lt_trans one_pos hx)).aestronglyMeasurable
          measurableSet_Ioi) ?_
      refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x hx => ?_)
      have := hC0 x η (le_of_lt hx) h1 h2
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero] at this
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact this
    have hIX : IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi X) := by
      have hIcc : IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Icc X 1) :=
        (hcont.mono (fun x (hx : x ∈ Icc X 1) => show (0:ℝ) < x from lt_of_lt_of_le hX' hx.1)).integrableOn_Icc
      refine (hIcc.union hI1).mono_set ?_
      intro x hx
      by_cases hx1 : x ≤ 1
      · exact Or.inl ⟨le_of_lt hx, hx1⟩
      · exact Or.inr (lt_of_not_ge hx1)
    have := intervalIntegral.integral_Ioi_sub_Ioi' hI1 hIX
    beta_reduce at this
    unfold leadPi
    linarith
  
  have havg : ∀ X η : ℝ, X ≠ 0 → profRadAvg U X η = X⁻¹ * profRadInt U X η := by
    intro X η hX
    have := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right (a := 0) (b := 1) (fun x => U x η) hX
    simp only [zero_mul, one_mul, smul_eq_mul] at this
    simp only [profRadAvg, profRadInt]
    exact this
  have hdavg : ∀ X η : ℝ, X ≠ 0 →
      profEtaD (profRadAvg U) X η = X⁻¹ * profEtaD (profRadInt U) X η := by
    intro X η hX
    have hfun : (fun e => profRadAvg U X e) = fun e => X⁻¹ * profRadInt U X e :=
      funext fun e => havg X e hX
    show deriv (fun e => profRadAvg U X e) η = X⁻¹ * deriv (fun e => profRadInt U X e) η
    rw [hfun]
    exact congrFun (deriv_const_mul_field' (𝕜 := ℝ) (v := fun e => profRadInt U X e) X⁻¹) η
  
  have hD : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, p ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 → 0 < 1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2 := by
    intro p hp
    have a1 : -1 < p.2 := hp.2.1
    have a2 : p.2 < 1 := hp.2.2
    have hsq : p.2 ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith
  have assemble : ∀ (Fv Uv i1 di1 i2 di2 i3 di3 i4 di4 pv dpv fx ux : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Fv p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Uv p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => i1 p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => di1 p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => i2 p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => di2 p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => i3 p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => di3 p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => i4 p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => di4 p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => pv p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => dpv p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => fx p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ux p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      (∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, p ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 → 0 < Fv p.1 p.2) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Fv p.1 p.2 * (p.1 * (-(1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * p.2 *
          (p.1⁻¹ * i1 p.1 p.2) - (1 - p.2 ^ 2) * (p.1⁻¹ * di1 p.1 p.2)) +
          ((1 - h) * i2 p.1 p.2 - (1 / 2 - h) * p.2 * di2 p.1 p.2 - (1 - p.2 ^ 2) * di3 p.1 p.2 +
            2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * p.2 * i3 p.1 p.2) / (p.1 * (2 * p.1 * Fv p.1 p.2))) /
          (1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2) - -2 * p.1 * fx p.1 p.2 / Fv p.1 p.2)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Fv p.1 p.2 * (p.1 * (-(1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * p.2 *
          (p.1⁻¹ * i1 p.1 p.2) - (1 - p.2 ^ 2) * (p.1⁻¹ * di1 p.1 p.2)) * Uv p.1 p.2 +
          ((1 / 2 - h) * (i1 p.1 p.2 - p.2 * di1 p.1 p.2) + 4 * h * p.2 * i4 p.1 p.2 -
            (1 - p.2 ^ 2) * di4 p.1 p.2) / p.1 +
          4 * (1 / 2 + h) * p.2 * pv p.1 p.2 - (1 - p.2 ^ 2) * dpv p.1 p.2) /
          ((1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt (2 * p.1) * Fv p.1 p.2)) +
          Real.sqrt (2 * p.1) * ux p.1 p.2 / Fv p.1 p.2)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    intro Fv Uv i1 di1 i2 di2 i3 di3 i4 di4 pv dpv fx ux hFv hUv hi1 hdi1 hi2 hdi2 hi3 hdi3 hi4 hdi4
      hpv hdpv hfx hux hFv0
    constructor
    · fun_prop (disch := (intro p hp
                          have h0 : 0 < p.1 := hp.1
                          have h1 := hFv0 p hp
                          have h2 := hD p hp
                          positivity))
    · fun_prop (disch := (intro p hp
                          have h0 : 0 < p.1 := hp.1
                          have h1 := hFv0 p hp
                          have h2 := hD p hp
                          positivity))
  
  have hF' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := hF
  have hU' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => U p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := hU
  have hg2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * p.1 * F p.1 p.2) _
    fun_prop
  have hg3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => U p.1 p.2 * (2 * p.1 * F p.1 p.2)) _
    fun_prop
  have hg4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => U p.1 p.2 ^ 2 - p.1 * F p.1 p.2 ^ 2) _
    fun_prop
  have hI1 := radSmooth U hU hbU
  have hI2 := radSmooth (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) hg2 hb2F
  have hI3 := radSmooth (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) hg3 hbU2F
  have hI4 := radSmooth (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) hg4 hbU2
  obtain ⟨hTh, hTz⟩ := assemble F U (profRadInt U) (profEtaD (profRadInt U))
    (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) (profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)))
    (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)))
    (profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))))
    (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2))
    (profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)))
    (leadPi F) (profEtaD (leadPi F))
    (fun X η => deriv (fun Y => F Y η) X) (fun X η => deriv (fun Y => U Y η) X)
    hF hU hI1 (s1 _ hI1).2.1 hI2 (s1 _ hI2).2.1 hI3 (s1 _ hI3).2.1 hI4 (s1 _ hI4).2.1
    hPi (s1 _ hPi).2.1 (s1 F hF).1 (s1 U hU).1
    (fun p hp => hFpos p.1 p.2 hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2)
  refine ⟨hTh.congr ?_, hTz.congr ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨X, η⟩ ⟨hX, h1, h2⟩
    have hX0 : X ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hX
    show leadStressTh h F U X η = _
    simp only [leadStressTh, leadQs, leadW, shearA, havg X η hX0, hdavg X η hX0]
  · rintro ⟨X, η⟩ ⟨hX, h1, h2⟩
    have hX0 : X ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hX
    show leadStressTz h F U X η = _
    simp only [leadStressTz, leadNs, leadW, shearB, havg X η hX0, hdavg X η hX0]

subgoal_signatures.name: profRadAvg_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profRadAvg g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(profRadAvg g)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → X * profRadAvg g X η = profRadInt g X η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * profRadAvg g Y η) (g X η) X)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ ρ0 ε0 X0 : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ h, 0 < ρ0 h ∧ 0 < ε0 h ∧ 0 < X0 h) → ∃ (h lam Pst Rst : ℝ) (c ϑ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h ∧ h < 1 / 100 ∧ 0 < lam ∧ Real.exp 10 < Pst ∧ 0 < Rst ∧ ShapeData Pst c ϑ ∧ ∀ XR : ℝ, Rst ≤ XR → ∃ (cpatch cinf ρ Xg Xg2 r1 r2 p1 p2 m1 m2 Xv Xc Xb : ℝ) (Fo Uo : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ρ ∧ ρ ≤ ρ0 h ∧ X0 h ≤ Xb ∧ Xb * Real.exp (-(5 / 2)) < Xc ∧ (0 < cpatch ∧ 0 < cinf ∧ 0 < XR ∧ XR < Xg ∧ Xg < Xg2 ∧ Xg2 < r1 ∧ r1 < r2 ∧ r2 < p1 ∧ p1 < p2 ∧ p2 < m1 ∧ m1 < m2 ∧ m2 < Xv ∧ Xv < Xc ∧ Xc < Xb) ∧ (∀ X₀ X₁ : ℝ, 0 < X₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₀ ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Fo) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Uo) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ XR → -1 < η → η < 1 → Uo X η = 4 * η ∧ Fo X η = refFin Pst XR X η) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, ((r1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ r2) ∨ (p1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ p2) ∨ (m1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ m2)) → -1 < η → η < 1 → Uo X η = 0 ∧ Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Fo X η = cpatch * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam))) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, Xv ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → Uo X η = 0 ∧ profRadInt Uo X η = 0) ∧ (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → leadPi Fo 0 η = shapeDatum c ϑ η) ∧ TailForm h cinf ρ Xb Fo Uo ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) ≤ X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Fo X η ≤ ε0 h) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => Fo x e) η| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧ |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => Uo x e) η| ≤ C) ∧ AdmBlk h (fun X => Real.exp (-(4 / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2))) (fun X => min 1 (Real.log (Xb / X))) (Ico Xg (Xb * Real.exp (-(5 / 2)))) Fo Uo ∧ (∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ RelaxCone h μ (Icc (XR * Real.exp (-5)) Xg2) Fo Uo)

signature.name: outer_core_construction
signature.statement: ∀ ρ0 ε0 X0 : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ h, 0 < ρ0 h ∧ 0 < ε0 h ∧ 0 < X0 h) → ∃ (h lam Pst Rst : ℝ) (c ϑ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h ∧ h < 1 / 100 ∧ 0 < lam ∧ Real.exp 10 < Pst ∧ 0 < Rst ∧ ShapeData Pst c ϑ ∧ ∀ XR : ℝ, Rst ≤ XR → ∃ (cpatch cinf ρ Xg Xg2 r1 r2 p1 p2 m1 m2 Xv Xc Xb : ℝ) (Fo Uo : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ρ ∧ ρ ≤ ρ0 h ∧ X0 h ≤ Xb ∧ Xb * Real.exp (-(5 / 2)) < Xc ∧ (0 < cpatch ∧ 0 < cinf ∧ 0 < XR ∧ XR < Xg ∧ Xg < Xg2 ∧ Xg2 < r1 ∧ r1 < r2 ∧ r2 < p1 ∧ p1 < p2 ∧ p2 < m1 ∧ m1 < m2 ∧ m2 < Xv ∧ Xv < Xc ∧ Xc < Xb) ∧ (∀ X₀ X₁ : ℝ, 0 < X₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₀ ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Fo) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Uo) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ XR → -1 < η → η < 1 → Uo X η = 4 * η ∧ Fo X η = refFin Pst XR X η) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, ((r1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ r2) ∨ (p1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ p2) ∨ (m1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ m2)) → -1 < η → η < 1 → Uo X η = 0 ∧ Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Fo X η = cpatch * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam))) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, Xv ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → Uo X η = 0 ∧ profRadInt Uo X η = 0) ∧ (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → leadPi Fo 0 η = shapeDatum c ϑ η) ∧ TailForm h cinf ρ Xb Fo Uo ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) ≤ X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Fo X η ≤ ε0 h) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => Fo x e) η| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧ |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => Uo x e) η| ≤ C) ∧ AdmBlk h (fun X => Real.exp (-(4 / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2))) (fun X => min 1 (Real.log (Xb / X))) (Ico Xg (Xb * Real.exp (-(5 / 2)))) Fo Uo ∧ (∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ RelaxCone h μ (Icc (XR * Real.exp (-5)) Xg2) Fo Uo)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ρ0 ε0 X0 hpos
  obtain ⟨h, lam, Pst, ρ, cp, ci, xg, xg2, r1, r2, k1, k2, p1, p2, m1, m2, xv, xb, μ, c, ϑ, F, U,
    hPst, hSD, hρle, hRP⟩ := ref_profile_exists ρ0 ε0 (fun h => ⟨(hpos h).1, (hpos h).2.1⟩)
  obtain ⟨e1, μ', Fh, Uh, hNF⟩ := ref_heat_family _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hRP
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, hh1, hlam, he1, he1le, hμ0, hμ1, hcp, hci, hρ0, hρ1, hxg, hxg2, hxr1, hr12, hr2p1,
    hp12, hp2m1, hm12, hm2v, hvb⟩, hfam⟩ := hNF
  obtain ⟨κ, P0, c0, hκ0, hκ2, hP0, hc0, hcone⟩ := cone_pointwise μ' hμ0 hμ1
  have hxb : 0 < xb := by
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    have := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hc (Real.exp_pos (-(11 / 4 : ℝ))).le
    linarith
  have hvb2 : xv < xb * Real.exp (-2) :=
    lt_trans hvb (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (by norm_num)) hxb)
  have hexp2 : Real.exp (-2) < 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_zero]; exact Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (by norm_num)
  have hexp11 : Real.exp 1 * Real.exp (-1) = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
  have hexp55 : Real.exp (5 / 2) * Real.exp (-(5 / 2)) = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
  have hexp1 : 1 ≤ Real.exp 1 := Real.one_le_exp (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨h, lam, Pst, max (max 1 e1⁻¹) (max P0 (X0 h / xb)), c, ϑ, hh0, hh1, hlam, hPst,
    lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)), hSD, ?_⟩
  intro XR hXR
  have hXR1 : 1 ≤ XR := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hXR
  have hXRe : e1⁻¹ ≤ XR := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hXR
  have hXRP : P0 ≤ XR := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hXR
  have hXRX : X0 h / xb ≤ XR := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hXR
  have hXR0 : 0 < XR := by linarith
  have he0 : 0 < XR⁻¹ := inv_pos.2 hXR0
  have hee1 : XR⁻¹ ≤ e1 := by rw [inv_le_comm₀ hXR0 he1]; exact hXRe
  obtain ⟨hNB, htail, hMT⟩ := hfam XR⁻¹ he0 hee1
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, hNMr, hNMa⟩ := hNB
  obtain ⟨Fo, hFo⟩ : ∃ Fo : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, Fo = fun X η => Real.sqrt XR⁻¹ * Fh XR⁻¹ (XR⁻¹ * X) η :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Uo, hUo⟩ : ∃ Uo : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, Uo = fun X η => Uh XR⁻¹ (XR⁻¹ * X) η := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hcomp, hinner, hpatch, hXv, hPi, hTF, hcollar, hwt, hcov⟩ :=
    scale_transfer h lam Pst ρ cp ci xg xg2 r1 r2 p1 p2 m1 m2 xv xb (ε0 h) μ' XR c ϑ (Fh XR⁻¹)
      (Uh XR⁻¹) Fo Uo hh0 hh1 hci hxb hρ0.le hρ1 hXR1 hvb
      ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩ (hfam XR⁻¹ he0 hee1).1 htail hMT
      (fun X η => by rw [hFo]) (fun X η => by rw [hUo])
  have hTF' := hTF
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, hFos, hUos, hFopos, -, -⟩ := hTF'
  have hsq : 0 < Real.sqrt XR⁻¹ := Real.sqrt_pos.2 he0
  
  have hpt : ∀ (S : Set ℝ) (adm : Prop), NMargin h μ' S (Fh XR⁻¹) (Uh XR⁻¹) adm →
      ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → XR⁻¹ * X ∈ S → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      Real.sqrt XR⁻¹ * μ' ≤ Fo X η ∧ κ ≤ shearA Fo X η ∧
      κ ≤ psLead1 h Fo Uo X η - shearB Fo Uo X η / shearA Fo X η * psLead2 h Fo Uo X η - 2 ∧
      κ ≤ coneUp (psLead1 h Fo Uo X η - shearB Fo Uo X η / shearA Fo X η * psLead2 h Fo Uo X η)
            (psLead2 h Fo Uo X η + shearB Fo Uo X η / shearA Fo X η * psLead1 h Fo Uo X η)
          - shearA Fo X η * (1 + (shearB Fo Uo X η / shearA Fo X η) ^ 2) ∧
      c0 * Fo X η ≤ Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h Fo Uo X η ^ 2 + leadStressTz h Fo Uo X η ^ 2) ∧
      (adm → κ ≤ shearA Fo X η * (1 + (shearB Fo Uo X η / shearA Fo X η) ^ 2) - 2 ∧
        κ * Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h Fo Uo X η ^ 2 + leadStressTz h Fo Uo X η ^ 2) ≤
          leadStressTh h Fo Uo X η - shearB Fo Uo X η / shearA Fo X η * leadStressTz h Fo Uo X η ∧
        (shearA Fo X η * (1 + (shearB Fo Uo X η / shearA Fo X η) ^ 2) - 2) *
            (leadStressTz h Fo Uo X η + shearB Fo Uo X η / shearA Fo X η * leadStressTh h Fo Uo X η) ^ 2 ≤
          (2 - κ) * (leadStressTh h Fo Uo X η - shearB Fo Uo X η / shearA Fo X η *

def MomTot (h ci : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
    IntegrableOn (fun x => U x η * (2 * x * F x η)) (Ioi 0) ∧
    IntegrableOn (fun x => U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧
    IntegrableOn (fun x => 2 * x * F x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * ci * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) (Ioi 0) ∧
    IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧
    (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), U x η * (2 * x * F x η)) = 0 ∧
    (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2)) = 0 ∧
    (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (2 * x * F x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * ci * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))) = 0 ∧
    ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * F x η) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η * (2 * x * F x η)) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => F x η ^ 2) volume 0 X

def NMargin (h μ : ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (adm : Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
    μ ≤ F x η ∧ μ ≤ shearA F x η ∧ shearA F x η ≤ 1 / μ ∧ |shearB F U x η| ≤ 1 / μ ∧
    μ ≤ psLead1 h F U x η ∧ |psLead2 h F U x η| ≤ psLead1 h F U x η / μ ∧
    μ ≤ shearA F x η - shearB F U x η * (psLead2 h F U x η / psLead1 h F U x η) ∧
    μ ≤ 2 - 2 * shearB F U x η * (psLead2 h F U x η / psLead1 h F U x η)
          - shearB F U x η ^ 2 / shearA F x η
          - (shearA F x η - 2) * (psLead2 h F U x η / psLead1 h F U x η) ^ 2 ∧
    (adm → μ ≤ shearA F x η * (1 + (shearB F U x η / shearA F x η) ^ 2) - 2)

def NormBase (h lam Pst cp xg xg2 r1 r2 p1 p2 m1 m2 xv xb eps μ : ℝ) (c ϑ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
  (∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F x η) ∧
  (∀ x₀ x₁ : ℝ, 0 < x₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, x₀ ≤ x → x ≤ x₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
     ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (x, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (x, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧
  (∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ 1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → U x η = 4 * η ∧ F x η = refFin Pst 1 x η) ∧
  (∀ x η : ℝ, ((r1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ r2) ∨ (p1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ p2) ∨ (m1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ m2)) → -1 < η → η < 1 →
     U x η = 0 ∧ Real.sqrt (2 * x) * F x η = cp * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam))) ∧
  (∀ x η : ℝ, xv ≤ x → -1 < η → η < 1 → U x η = 0 ∧ profRadInt U x η = 0) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → leadPi F 0 η = shapeDatum c ϑ η) ∧
  (∀ x η : ℝ, xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) ≤ x → x < xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →

  (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 →
     |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => F x e) η| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧
     |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => U x e) η| ≤ C) ∧

  have hLs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2) Ω :=
    contDiffOn_const.sub (contDiffOn_const.mul (contDiffOn_snd.pow 2))
  have hR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1)) Ω :=
    (contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_fst).sqrt (fun p hp => (mul_pos two_pos hp.1).ne')
  have hW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => leadW h U p.1 p.2) Ω := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * p.2 * profRadAvg U p.1 p.2
      - (1 - p.2 ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadAvg U) p.1 p.2) Ω
    exact (contDiffOn_const.sub ((contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_snd).mul a)).sub
      ((contDiffOn_const.sub (contDiffOn_snd.pow 2)).mul a')
  constructor
  · 
    have hQ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => leadQs h F U p.1 p.2) Ω := by
      show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => -leadW h U p.1 p.2 +
        ((1 - h) * profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) p.1 p.2
          - (1 / 2 - h) * p.2 * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) p.1 p.2
          - (1 - p.2 ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))) p.1 p.2
          + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * p.2 * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) p.1 p.2) /
        (p.1 * (2 * p.1 * F p.1 p.2))) Ω
      refine hW.neg.add (ContDiffOn.fun_div ?_ ?_ ?_)
      · exact (((contDiffOn_const.mul I).sub ((contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_snd).mul I')).sub
          ((contDiffOn_const.sub (contDiffOn_snd.pow 2)).mul J')).add
          ((contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_snd).mul J)
      · exact contDiffOn_fst.mul ((contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_fst).mul f)
      · intro p hp
        exact (mul_pos hp.1 (mul_pos (mul_pos two_pos hp.1) (hFp p hp))).ne'
    have hSa : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => shearA F p.1 p.2) Ω := by
      show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => -2 * p.1 * pdX F p.1 p.2 / F p.1 p.2) Ω
      exact ((contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_fst).mul fx).fun_div f (fun p hp => (hFp p hp).ne')
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2 *
      (p.1 * leadQs h F U p.1 p.2 / (1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2) - shearA F p.1 p.2)) Ω
    exact f.mul (((contDiffOn_fst.mul hQ).fun_div hLs (fun p hp => (hLp p hp).ne')).sub hSa)
  · 
    have hNs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => axNs h Pax F U p.1 p.2) Ω := by
      show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => -leadW h U p.1 p.2 * U p.1 p.2 +
        ((1 / 2 - h) * (profRadInt U p.1 p.2 - p.2 * profEtaD (profRadInt U) p.1 p.2)
          + 4 * h * p.2 * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) p.1 p.2
          - (1 - p.2 ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)) p.1 p.2) / p.1
        + 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * p.2 * axPi Pax F p.1 p.2 - (1 - p.2 ^ 2) * profEtaD (axPi Pax F) p.1 p.2) Ω
      have hnum : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
          (1 / 2 - h) * (profRadInt U p.1 p.2 - p.2 * profEtaD (profRadInt U) p.1 p.2)
          + 4 * h * p.2 * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) p.1 p.2
          - (1 - p.2 ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)) p.1 p.2) Ω :=
        ((contDiffOn_const.mul (M.sub (contDiffOn_snd.mul M'))).add
          ((contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_snd).mul S)).sub
          ((contDiffOn_const.sub (contDiffOn_snd.pow 2)).mul S')
      exact (((hW.neg.mul u).add (hnum.fun_div contDiffOn_fst (fun p hp => (ne_of_gt hp.1)))).add
        ((contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_snd).mul hPi)).sub
        ((contDiffOn_const.sub (contDiffOn_snd.pow 2)).mul hPi')
    have hPs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => axPs2 h Pax F U p.1 p.2) Ω := by
      show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 * axNs h Pax F U p.1 p.2 /
        ((1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt (2 * p.1) * F p.1 p.2))) Ω
      refine (contDiffOn_fst.mul hNs).fun_div (hLs.mul (hR.mul f)) ?_
      intro p hp
      exact (mul_pos (hLp p hp) (mul_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (mul_pos two_pos hp.1)) (hFp p hp))).ne'
    have hSb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => shearB F U p.1 p.2) Ω := by
      show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1) * pdX U p.1 p.2 / F p.1 p.2) Ω
      exact (hR.mul ux).fun_div f (fun p hp => (hFp p hp).ne')
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2 *
      (axPs2 h Pax F U p.1 p.2 + shearB F U p.1 p.2)) Ω
    exact f.mul (hPs.add hSb)

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profRadAvg g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(profRadAvg g)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → X * profRadAvg g X η = profRadInt g X η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * profRadAvg g Y η) (g X η) X)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h ε Pax F U hh0 hh1 hε hF hU hFpos hPax X η hX hη1 hη2
  have hΩ : IsOpen (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hXε : -ε < X := by linarith
  
  have etap : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) →
      ∃ gη : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn (↿gη) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ∀ x e : ℝ, -ε < x → -1 < e → e < 1 → HasDerivAt (fun e' => g x e') (gη x e) e := by
    intro g hg
    refine ⟨fun x e => fderiv ℝ (↿g) (x, e) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · show ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => fderiv ℝ (↿g) p ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) _
      exact (hg.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ (by norm_num)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
    · intro x e hx he1 he2
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿g) (x, e) :=
        (hg.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds (show ((x, e) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 from
          ⟨hx, he1, he2⟩))).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have hc : HasDerivAt (fun e' : ℝ => ((x, e') : ℝ × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) e :=
        (hasDerivAt_const e x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' e)
      exact hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt e hc
  have hsubI : ∀ Y : ℝ, -ε < Y → uIcc 0 Y ⊆ Ioi (-ε) := by
    intro Y hY x hx
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_min (by linarith) hY) hx.1
  
  have ftc : ∀ k : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn (↿k) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) →
      ∀ Y e : ℝ, -ε < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 →
        HasDerivAt (fun Z => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Z, k x e) (k Y e) Y := by
    intro k hk Y e hY he1 he2
    have hcs : ContinuousOn (fun x => k x e) (Ioi (-ε)) :=
      hk.comp (f := fun x : ℝ => ((x, e) : ℝ × ℝ)) (by fun_prop) (fun x hx => ⟨hx, he1, he2⟩)
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right ((hcs.mono (hsubI Y hY)).intervalIntegrable)
      (hcs.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter isOpen_Ioi Y hY) (hcs.continuousAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hY))
  
  have param : ∀ k kη : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn (↿k) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) →
      ContinuousOn (↿kη) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ x e : ℝ, -ε < x → -1 < e → e < 1 → HasDerivAt (fun e' => k x e') (kη x e) e) →
      ∀ Y e : ℝ, -ε < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 →
        HasDerivAt (fun e' => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Y, k x e') (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Y, kη x e) e := by
    intro k kη hk hkη hder Y e hY he1 he2
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hr1, hr2⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r ≤ (1 - e) / 2 ∧ r ≤ (1 + e) / 2 :=
      ⟨min ((1 - e) / 2) ((1 + e) / 2), lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith),
        min_le_left _ _, min_le_right _ _⟩
    have hball : ∀ e' ∈ Metric.closedBall e r, -1 < e' ∧ e' < 1 := by
      intro e' he'
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, Real.dist_eq, abs_le] at he'
      constructor <;> linarith [he'.1, he'.2]
    have hsub := hsubI Y hY
    have hK : IsCompact (uIcc 0 Y ×ˢ Metric.closedBall e r) :=
      isCompact_uIcc.prod (isCompact_closedBall e r)
    have hKΩ : uIcc 0 Y ×ˢ Metric.closedBall e r ⊆ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
      fun p hp => ⟨hsub hp.1, hball p.2 hp.2⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hkη.mono hKΩ)
    have hslice : ∀ m : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn (↿m) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) →
        ∀ e' : ℝ, -1 < e' → e' < 1 → ContinuousOn (fun x => m x e') (uIcc 0 Y) :=
      fun m hm e' h1 h2 => hm.comp (f := fun x : ℝ => ((x, e') : ℝ × ℝ)) (by fun_prop)
        (fun x hx => ⟨hsub hx, h1, h2⟩)
    have hmeas : ∀ m : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn (↿m) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) →
        ∀ e' : ℝ, -1 < e' → e' < 1 →
          AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => m x e') (volume.restrict (uIoc 0 Y)) :=
      fun m hm e' h1 h2 =>
        ((hslice m hm e' h1 h2).mono uIoc_subset_uIcc).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
    have key := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (μ := volume) (a := 0) (b := Y) (bound := fun _ => C)
      (F := fun (e' : ℝ) (x : ℝ) => k x e') (F' := fun (e' : ℝ) (x : ℝ) => kη x e') (x₀ := e)
      (Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds e hr)
      (Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds e hr)
        (fun e' he' => hmeas k hk e' (hball e' he').1 (hball e' he').2))
      ((hslice k hk e he1 he2).intervalIntegrable)
      (hmeas kη hkη e he1 he2)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht e' he' => hC (t, e') ⟨uIoc_subset_uIcc ht, he'⟩))
      intervalIntegrable_const
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht e' he' =>
        hder t e' (hsub (uIoc_subset_uIcc ht)) (hball e' he').1 (hball e' he').2))
    exact key.2
  
  have pkg : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) →
      HasDerivAt (fun Y => profRadInt g Y η) (g X η) X ∧
      (∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun e => g X e) v η →
        HasDerivAt (fun Y => profEtaD (profRadInt g) Y η) v X) ∧
      (∀ Y : ℝ, -ε < Y → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e => profRadInt g Y e) η) := by
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨gη, hgηc, hgd⟩ := etap g hg
    have hgc : ContinuousOn (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := hg.continuousOn
    refine ⟨ftc g hgc X η hXε hη1 hη2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro v hv
      have hval : gη X η = v := (hgd X η hXε hη1 hη2).unique hv
      have heq : (fun Y => profEtaD (profRadInt g) Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X]
          (fun Y => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Y, gη x η) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hXε] with Y hY
        exact (param g gη hgc hgηc hgd Y η hY hη1 hη2).deriv
      have h2 := ftc gη hgηc X η hXε hη1 hη2
      rw [hval] at h2
      exact h2.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
    · intro Y hY
      exact (param g gη hgc hgηc hgd Y η hY hη1 hη2).differentiableAt
  
  have slice : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) →
      HasDerivAt (fun Y => g Y η) (deriv (fun Y => g Y η) X) X ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun e => g X e) (deriv (fun e => g X e) η) η := by
    intro g hg
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿g) (X, η) :=
      (hg.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds (show ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 from
        ⟨hXε, hη1, hη2⟩))).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => ((Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) X :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X η)
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => ((X, e) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) η :=
      (hasDerivAt_const η X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' η)
    have k1' := hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt X h1
    have k2' := hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt η h2
    have k1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y => g Y η) X := k1'.differentiableAt
    have k2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e => g X e) η := k2'.differentiableAt
    exact ⟨k1.hasDerivAt, k2.hasDerivAt⟩
  have hF0 : ∀ Y, 0 < Y → F Y η ≠ 0 := fun Y hY => (hFpos Y η hY.le hη1 hη2).ne'
  have hI : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * p.1 * F p.1 p.2) _
    exact (contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_fst).mul hF
  have hJ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)))
      (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => U p.1 p.2 * (2 * p.1 * F p.1 p.2)) _
    exact hU.mul ((contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_fst).mul hF)
  have hS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2))
      (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => U p.1 p.2 ^ 2 - p.1 * F p.1 p.2 ^ 2) _
    exact (hU.pow 2).sub (contDiffOn_fst.mul (hF.pow 2))
  have hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e => F x e ^ 2)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2 ^ 2) _
    exact hF.pow 2
  obtain ⟨hFY, hFe⟩ := slice F hF
  obtain ⟨hUY, hUe⟩ := slice U hU
  have sq : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (f' x : ℝ), HasDerivAt f f' x →
      HasDerivAt (fun y => f y ^ 2) (2 * f x * f') x := by
    intro f f' x hf
    have e1 : (fun y => f y ^ 2) = fun y => f y * f y := funext fun y => pow_two _
    rw [e1]
    exact (hf.mul hf).congr_deriv (by ring)
  obtain ⟨hUa, hUb, -⟩ := pkg U hU
  obtain ⟨hIa, hIb, -⟩ := pkg _ hI
  obtain ⟨hJa, hJb, -⟩ := pkg _ hJ
  obtain ⟨hSa, hSb, -⟩ := pkg _ hS
  obtain ⟨hPa, hPb, hPc⟩ := pkg _ hP
  have hUb' := hUb _ hUe
  have hIb' := hIb _ (hFe.const_mul (2 * X))
  have hJb' := hJb _ (hUe.mul (hFe.const_mul (2 * X)))
  have hSb' := hSb _ ((sq _ _ _ hUe).sub ((sq _ _ _ hFe).const_mul X))
  have hPb' := hPb _ (sq _ _ _ hFe)
  have hPaxd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Pax η :=
    (hPax.contDiffAt (Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  
  have hW : ∀ Y, 0 < Y → Y * leadW h U Y η =
      Y - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * profRadInt U Y η - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt U) Y η := by
    intro Y hY
    have key : ∀ e, -1 < e → e < 1 → Y * profRadAvg U Y e = profRadInt U Y e := by
      intro e _ _
      unfold profRadAvg profRadInt
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right (fun x => U x e) hY.ne', zero_mul, one_mul,
        smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hY.ne', one_mul]
    have hev : (fun e => Y * profRadAvg U Y e) =ᶠ[nhds η] (fun e => profRadInt U Y e) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2] with e he
      exact key e he.1 he.2
    have hd : Y * profEtaD (profRadAvg U) Y η = profEtaD (profRadInt U) Y η := by
      unfold profEtaD
      rw [← hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const_mul_field']
    have hk := key η hη1 hη2
    unfold leadW
    linear_combination (-(2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η)) * hk + (-(1 - η ^ 2)) * hd
  have hPiη : ∀ Y, -ε < Y → profEtaD (axPi Pax F) Y η =
      deriv Pax η + profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => F x e ^ 2)) Y η := by
    intro Y hY
    exact (hPaxd.hasDerivAt.add (hPc Y hY).hasDerivAt).deriv
  have hQrw : ∀ Y, 0 < Y → Y * (2 * Y * F Y η) * leadQs h F U Y η =
      -(2 * Y * F Y η) * (Y * leadW h U Y η) +
      ((1 - h) * profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) Y η
        - (1 / 2 - h) * η * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) Y η
        - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))) Y η
        + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * η * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) Y η) := by
    intro Y hY
    have hY0 := hY.ne'
    have hFY0 := hF0 Y hY
    unfold leadQs
    field_simp
  have hNrw : ∀ Y, 0 < Y → Y * axNs h Pax F U Y η =
      -(Y * leadW h U Y η) * U Y η +
      ((1 / 2 - h) * (profRadInt U Y η - η * profEtaD (profRadInt U) Y η)
        + 4 * h * η * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) Y η
        - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)) Y η)
      + Y * (4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * axPi Pax F Y η - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (axPi Pax F) Y η) := by
    intro Y hY
    have hY0 := hY.ne'
    unfold axNs
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hV := ((hasDerivAt_id' X).sub (hUa.const_mul (2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η))).sub
    (hUb'.const_mul (1 - η ^ 2))
  have hfQ := ((((hasDerivAt_id' X).const_mul 2).mul hFY).neg.mul hV).add
    ((((hIa.const_mul (1 - h)).sub (hIb'.const_mul ((1 / 2 - h) * η))).sub
      (hJb'.const_mul (1 - η ^ 2))).add (hJa.const_mul (2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * η)))
  have hfN := (((hV.neg).mul hUY).add ((((hUa.sub (hUb'.const_mul η)).const_mul (1 / 2 - h)).add
      (hSa.const_mul (4 * h * η))).sub (hSb'.const_mul (1 - η ^ 2)))).add
    ((hasDerivAt_id' X).mul ((((hasDerivAt_const X (Pax η)).add hPa).const_mul
      (4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η)).sub (((hasDerivAt_const X (deriv Pax η)).add hPb').const_mul
        (1 - η ^ 2))))
  have hWX := hW X hX
  have hF0X := hF0 X hX
  have hX0 := hX.ne'
  have hSq : 2 * X * F X η * axSq h F U X η =
      -(2 * X * leadW h U X η * (F X η + X * deriv (fun Y => F Y η) X))
        - 2 * X * F X η * h * (1 - 2 * η * U X η)
        - 2 * X * ((1 / 2 - h) * η + (1 - η ^ 2) * U X η) * deriv (fun e => F X e) η := by
    unfold axSq
    field_simp
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · refine (hfQ.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_).congr_deriv ?_
    · filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hX] with Y hY
      have hY' : 0 < Y := hY
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.neg_apply]
      linear_combination (hQrw Y hY') + (-(2 * Y * F Y η)) * (hW Y hY')
    · rw [hSq]
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.neg_apply]
      linear_combination (2 * F X η + 2 * X * deriv (fun Y => F Y η) X) * hWX
  · refine (hfN.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_).congr_deriv ?_
    · filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hX] with Y hY
      have hY' : 0 < Y := hY
      rw [hNrw Y hY', hPiη Y (by linarith)]
      simp only [axPi, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.neg_apply]
      linear_combination (-(U Y η)) * (hW Y hY')
    · unfold axSn
      rw [show deriv (fun e => axPi Pax F X e) η =
        deriv Pax η + profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => F x e ^ 2)) X η from hPiη X hXε]
      simp only [axPi, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.neg_apply]
      linear_combination (deriv (fun Y => U Y η) X) * hWX

  obtain ⟨P, hPd⟩ : ∃ P : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ, P = fun i i' => ∫ x in x1..x2, β i x * β i' x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQd⟩ : ∃ Q : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ, Q = fun j l => ∫ x in x1..x2, γ j x * γ l x := ⟨_, rfl⟩

  have hGij : ∀ i j, (∫ x in x1..x2, fU i x * (fU j x * ψU x)) = G i j := fun i j => by rw [hG]

  have hinj : ∀ v : Fin 5 → ℝ, (∀ i, ∑ j, a i j * v j = 0) → v = 0 := by

  have hδ0 : 0 < δ := by rw [hδ]; exact lt_min (div_pos hr hK0) (div_pos hx1p hpos2)
  have hδ1 : δ ≤ r / K := by rw [hδ]; exact min_le_left _ _

  obtain ⟨zf, hzf⟩ : ∃ zf : (Fin 5 → ℝ) → ℝ → (Fin 5 → ℝ), zf = fun d η =>

        ((1 + η ^ 2) / Pst) ^ 2 * d 4] := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hzc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : (Fin 5 → ℝ) × ℝ => zf p.1 p.2) := by
    rw [hzf]

    rcases hF5 i with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    all_goals simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two,

  have hzb : ∀ d η, -2 < η → η < 2 → ‖zf d η‖ ≤ K * ‖d‖ := by
    intro d η h1 h2

    have hη : |η| ≤ 2 := abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

    have hlin : ∀ (i j : Fin 5) (m : ℝ), |m| ≤ 16 → |d i - m * d j| ≤ 17 * ‖d‖ := by

    have hsqb : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 17 * ‖d‖ → |κ ^ 2 * t| ≤ K * ‖d‖ := by
      intro t ht

      calc κ ^ 2 * |t| ≤ κm ^ 2 * (17 * ‖d‖) := mul_le_mul hκsq ht (abs_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
        _ = 17 * κm ^ 2 * ‖d‖ := by ring
        _ ≤ K * ‖d‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hKb hD
    have hlinb : ∀ i, |κ * d i| ≤ K * ‖d‖ := by
      intro i
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hκ0]

noncomputable def axLam (T : ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 - Real.smoothTransition ((Real.log (X / 110) - 1) / T)) * ℓ η +
    Real.smoothTransition ((Real.log (X / 110) - 1) / T) * Real.log ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹)

noncomputable def axFm (Pst C T : ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ → ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ)
    (c : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if X ≤ 110 then F X η else
    (Real.exp (axLam T ℓ X η) * (X / 110) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) / C +
      (c η 2 * γ 0 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) + c η 3 * γ 1 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) +
        c η 4 * γ 2 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)))) / Real.sqrt (2 * X)

noncomputable def axUm (Pst C : ℝ) (G : ℝ → ℝ) (U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ)
    (c : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if X ≤ 110 then U X η else
    G η + Real.smoothTransition (Real.log (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) + 8) * (4 * η - G η) +
      (c η 0 * β 0 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) + c η 1 * β 1 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)))

noncomputable def axDisc (Pst XR : ℝ) (F0 U0 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (η : ℝ) : Fin 5 → ℝ :=
  ![-(profRadInt U0 (XR * Real.exp (-6)) η - profRadInt (fun _ e => 4 * e) (XR * Real.exp (-6)) η) / XR,
    -(profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F0 x e) (XR * Real.exp (-6)) η
        - profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * refFin Pst XR x e) (XR * Real.exp (-6)) η) / XR ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ),
    -(profRadInt (fun x e => U0 x e * (2 * x * F0 x e)) (XR * Real.exp (-6)) η
        - profRadInt (fun x e => 4 * e * (2 * x * refFin Pst XR x e)) (XR * Real.exp (-6)) η) / XR ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ),
    -(profRadInt (fun x e => U0 x e ^ 2 - x * F0 x e ^ 2) (XR * Real.exp (-6)) η
        - profRadInt (fun x e => (4 * e) ^ 2 - x * refFin Pst XR x e ^ 2) (XR * Real.exp (-6)) η) / XR,
    -(profRadInt (fun x e => F0 x e ^ 2) (XR * Real.exp (-6)) η
        - profRadInt (fun x e => refFin Pst XR x e ^ 2) (XR * Real.exp (-6)) η)]

def AxBumps (s1 s2 : ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  Real.exp (-6) < s1 ∧ s1 < s2 ∧ s2 < Real.exp (-5) ∧
  (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (β i)) ∧ (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (γ j)) ∧
  (∀ i x, (x ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ x) → β i x = 0) ∧ (∀ j x, (x ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ x) → γ j x = 0)

def AxCoef (θ : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c (Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
  (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedDeriv m c η‖ ≤ K) ∧
  ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖c η‖ ≤ θ ∧ ‖deriv c η‖ ≤ θ

def AxReg (Fi Ui : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Fi) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧

    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < Fi X η) ∧

def AxA3 (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Xan : ℝ) (Fi Ui : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=

    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Fc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Uc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Pc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xan →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Fc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Uc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Pc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      (∀ w : ℂ, |w.im| < ρ → -1 - ρ < w.re → w.re < 1 + ρ →
        ‖Fc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Uc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Pc k X w‖ ≤ C) ∧

        Fc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => Fi Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧

def AxGlue (h Pst : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (ε Bd C T θ Kb Ks MP s1 s2 : ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ)

    (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  AxDatum h Pst Pax ∧ AxInner h Pax ε Bd C Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ ℓ G F U ∧ 0 < ε ∧ ε ≤ 1 / 100 ∧
  AxBumps s1 s2 β γ ∧ (∀ i x, |β i x| ≤ Kb ∧ |x * deriv (β i) x| ≤ Kb) ∧
  (∀ j x, |γ j x| ≤ Kb ∧ |x * deriv (γ j) x| ≤ Kb) ∧
  AxCoef θ c ∧ 0 ≤ θ ∧ ε + 2 * θ * Kb ≤ 1 / 50 ∧ 3 * θ * Kb ≤ Pst / 1000 ∧
  (∀ x, |deriv Real.smoothTransition x| ≤ Ks) ∧ 40 * Ks * (|Bd| + 1) + 1 ≤ T ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |Pax η| ≤ MP ∧ |deriv Pax η| ≤ MP) ∧
  (Ks * ε + 2 * θ * Kb) * (200 + 4 * MP + 30 * Pst ^ 2) * 1000000 ≤ Pst ^ 2 ∧
  110 * Real.exp (1 + T) ≤ 110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10 * Real.exp (-9) ∧
  30 * (|Bd| + 2) * Real.exp (2 * |Bd| + 2 + 2 * T) * (1 + 110 * Bd ^ 2) ≤ C * ε
