  · obtain ⟨⟨c₀, hc₀, hlow⟩, hder, ⟨κ, hκ0, hκ2, hk⟩⟩ := hadm
    refine ⟨⟨c₀, hc₀, ?_⟩, ?_, ⟨κ, hκ0, hκ2, ?_⟩⟩
    · intro X hX η hη1 hη2
      have ha : 0 < X := by linarith [hX.1]
      have hb : X < XR := by linarith [hX.2]
      obtain ⟨-, -, -, k4, k5, -, -⟩ := key X η ha hb hη1 hη2
      rw [k4, k5]
      exact hlow X hX η hη1 hη2
    · intro m
      obtain ⟨C, N', hCN⟩ := hder m
      refine ⟨C, N', fun X hX η hη1 hη2 => ?_⟩
      have ha : 0 < X := by linarith [hX.1]
      have hb : X < XR := by linarith [hX.2]
      rw [tr _ _ hTh m X η ha hb hη1 hη2, tr _ _ hTz m X η ha hb hη1 hη2,
        tr _ _ hR1 m X η ha hb hη1 hη2, tr _ _ hR2 m X η ha hb hη1 hη2]
      exact hCN X hX η hη1 hη2
    · intro X hX η hη1 hη2
      have ha : 0 < X := by linarith [hX.1]
      have hb : X < XR := by linarith [hX.2]
      obtain ⟨k1, k2, k3, k4, k5, -, -⟩ := key X η ha hb hη1 hη2
      rw [k1, k2, k3, k4, k5]
      exact hk X hX η hη1 hη2
  · intro X hX η hη1 hη2
    have ha : 0 < X := by linarith [hX.1]
    have hb : X < XR := by linarith [hX.2]
    obtain ⟨k1, k2, k3, -, -, k6, k7⟩ := key X η ha hb hη1 hη2
    rw [k1, k2, k3, k6, k7]
    exact hcone X hX η hη1 hη2

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h Xh : ℝ) (F₁ U₁ F₂ U₂ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xh → (∀ X η : ℝ, Xh < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → F₁ X η = F₂ X η ∧ U₁ X η = U₂ X η) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U₁ x η) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U₂ x η) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * F₁ x η) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * F₂ x η) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U₁ x η * (2 * x * F₁ x η)) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U₂ x η * (2 * x * F₂ x η)) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U₁ x η ^ 2 - x * F₁ x η ^ 2) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U₂ x η ^ 2 - x * F₂ x η ^ 2) volume 0 X) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → profRadInt U₁ Xh η = profRadInt U₂ Xh η ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F₁ x e) Xh η = profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F₂ x e) Xh η ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => U₁ x e * (2 * x * F₁ x e)) Xh η = profRadInt (fun x e => U₂ x e * (2 * x * F₂ x e)) Xh η ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => U₁ x e ^ 2 - x * F₁ x e ^ 2) Xh η = profRadInt (fun x e => U₂ x e ^ 2 - x * F₂ x e ^ 2) Xh η) → ∀ X η : ℝ, Xh < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → leadQs h F₁ U₁ X η = leadQs h F₂ U₂ X η ∧ leadNs h F₁ U₁ X η = leadNs h F₂ U₂ X η ∧ leadStressTh h F₁ U₁ X η = leadStressTh h F₂ U₂ X η ∧ leadStressTz h F₁ U₁ X η = leadStressTz h F₂ U₂ X η

signature.name: lead_stress_local
signature.statement: ∀ (h Xh : ℝ) (F₁ U₁ F₂ U₂ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xh → (∀ X η : ℝ, Xh < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → F₁ X η = F₂ X η ∧ U₁ X η = U₂ X η) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U₁ x η) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U₂ x η) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * F₁ x η) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * F₂ x η) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U₁ x η * (2 * x * F₁ x η)) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U₂ x η * (2 * x * F₂ x η)) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U₁ x η ^ 2 - x * F₁ x η ^ 2) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U₂ x η ^ 2 - x * F₂ x η ^ 2) volume 0 X) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → profRadInt U₁ Xh η = profRadInt U₂ Xh η ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F₁ x e) Xh η = profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F₂ x e) Xh η ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => U₁ x e * (2 * x * F₁ x e)) Xh η = profRadInt (fun x e => U₂ x e * (2 * x * F₂ x e)) Xh η ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => U₁ x e ^ 2 - x * F₁ x e ^ 2) Xh η = profRadInt (fun x e => U₂ x e ^ 2 - x * F₂ x e ^ 2) Xh η) → ∀ X η : ℝ, Xh < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → leadQs h F₁ U₁ X η = leadQs h F₂ U₂ X η ∧ leadNs h F₁ U₁ X η = leadNs h F₂ U₂ X η ∧ leadStressTh h F₁ U₁ X η = leadStressTh h F₂ U₂ X η ∧ leadStressTz h F₁ U₁ X η = leadStressTz h F₂ U₂ X η

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Xh F₁ U₁ F₂ U₂ hXh hag hint hmom X η hX h1 h2
  have hX0 : 0 < X := lt_trans hXh hX
  
  have transport : ∀ (g₁ g₂ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (e : ℝ), (∀ x : ℝ, Xh < x → g₁ x e = g₂ x e) →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => g₁ x e) volume 0 X →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => g₂ x e) volume 0 X →
      profRadInt g₁ Xh e = profRadInt g₂ Xh e → profRadInt g₁ X e = profRadInt g₂ X e := by
    intro g₁ g₂ e hg hi₁ hi₂ hm
    unfold profRadInt at hm ⊢
    have hXhm : Xh ∈ Set.uIcc 0 X := Set.mem_uIcc.mpr (Or.inl ⟨hXh.le, hX.le⟩)
    have hs1 : Set.uIcc 0 Xh ⊆ Set.uIcc 0 X := Set.uIcc_subset_uIcc Set.left_mem_uIcc hXhm
    have hs2 : Set.uIcc Xh X ⊆ Set.uIcc 0 X := Set.uIcc_subset_uIcc hXhm Set.right_mem_uIcc
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hi₁.mono_set hs1) (hi₁.mono_set hs2),
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hi₂.mono_set hs1) (hi₂.mono_set hs2), hm]
    congr 1
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
    refine MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun x hx => ?_)
    rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hX.le] at hx
    exact hg x hx.1
  
  have avg : ∀ (g₁ g₂ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (e : ℝ), profRadInt g₁ X e = profRadInt g₂ X e →
      profRadAvg g₁ X e = profRadAvg g₂ X e := by
    intro g₁ g₂ e hr
    unfold profRadAvg
    have e1 := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right (fun x => g₁ x e) hX0.ne' (a := 0) (b := 1)
    have e2 := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right (fun x => g₂ x e) hX0.ne' (a := 0) (b := 1)
    simp only [zero_mul, one_mul] at e1 e2
    rw [e1, e2]
    unfold profRadInt at hr
    rw [hr]
  
  have rPi : ∀ e, -1 < e → e < 1 → leadPi F₁ X e = leadPi F₂ X e := by
    intro e he1 he2
    unfold leadPi
    congr 1
    apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
    intro x hx
    simp only [(hag x e (lt_trans hX (mem_Ioi.mp hx)) he1 he2).1]
  
  have etaD : ∀ (G₁ G₂ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ e, -1 < e → e < 1 → G₁ X e = G₂ X e) →
      profEtaD G₁ X η = profEtaD G₂ X η := by
    intro G₁ G₂ hG
    unfold profEtaD
    apply Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq
    exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2) (fun e he => hG e he.1 he.2)
  
  have rU : ∀ e, -1 < e → e < 1 → profRadInt U₁ X e = profRadInt U₂ X e := fun e he1 he2 =>
    transport U₁ U₂ e (fun x hx => (hag x e hx he1 he2).2) (hint e he1 he2 X hX0.le).1
      (hint e he1 he2 X hX0.le).2.1 (hmom e he1 he2).1
  have rF : ∀ e, -1 < e → e < 1 → profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F₁ x e) X e =
      profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F₂ x e) X e := fun e he1 he2 =>
    transport _ _ e (fun x hx => by simp only [(hag x e hx he1 he2).1])
      (hint e he1 he2 X hX0.le).2.2.1 (hint e he1 he2 X hX0.le).2.2.2.1 (hmom e he1 he2).2.1
  have rUF : ∀ e, -1 < e → e < 1 → profRadInt (fun x e => U₁ x e * (2 * x * F₁ x e)) X e =
      profRadInt (fun x e => U₂ x e * (2 * x * F₂ x e)) X e := fun e he1 he2 =>
    transport _ _ e
      (fun x hx => by simp only [(hag x e hx he1 he2).1, (hag x e hx he1 he2).2])
      (hint e he1 he2 X hX0.le).2.2.2.2.1 (hint e he1 he2 X hX0.le).2.2.2.2.2.1
      (hmom e he1 he2).2.2.1
  have rUF2 : ∀ e, -1 < e → e < 1 → profRadInt (fun x e => U₁ x e ^ 2 - x * F₁ x e ^ 2) X e =
      profRadInt (fun x e => U₂ x e ^ 2 - x * F₂ x e ^ 2) X e := fun e he1 he2 =>
    transport _ _ e
      (fun x hx => by simp only [(hag x e hx he1 he2).1, (hag x e hx he1 he2).2])
      (hint e he1 he2 X hX0.le).2.2.2.2.2.2.1 (hint e he1 he2 X hX0.le).2.2.2.2.2.2.2
      (hmom e he1 he2).2.2.2
  
  have hF : F₁ X η = F₂ X η := (hag X η hX h1 h2).1
  have hU : U₁ X η = U₂ X η := (hag X η hX h1 h2).2
  have hdF : deriv (fun Y => F₁ Y η) X = deriv (fun Y => F₂ Y η) X :=
    Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq
      (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hX) (fun Y hY => (hag Y η hY h1 h2).1))
  have hdU : deriv (fun Y => U₁ Y η) X = deriv (fun Y => U₂ Y η) X :=
    Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq
      (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hX) (fun Y hY => (hag Y η hY h1 h2).2))
  have hA : shearA F₁ X η = shearA F₂ X η := by unfold shearA; rw [hdF, hF]
  have hB : shearB F₁ U₁ X η = shearB F₂ U₂ X η := by unfold shearB; rw [hdU, hF]
  
  have hW : leadW h U₁ X η = leadW h U₂ X η := by
    unfold leadW
    rw [avg U₁ U₂ η (rU η h1 h2),
      etaD (profRadAvg U₁) (profRadAvg U₂) (fun e he1 he2 => avg U₁ U₂ e (rU e he1 he2))]
  have hQ : leadQs h F₁ U₁ X η = leadQs h F₂ U₂ X η := by
    unfold leadQs
    rw [hW, rF η h1 h2,
      etaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F₁ x e)) (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F₂ x e)) rF,
      rUF η h1 h2,
      etaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U₁ x e * (2 * x * F₁ x e)))
        (profRadInt (fun x e => U₂ x e * (2 * x * F₂ x e))) rUF, hF]
  have hN : leadNs h F₁ U₁ X η = leadNs h F₂ U₂ X η := by
    unfold leadNs
    rw [hW, hU, rU η h1 h2, etaD (profRadInt U₁) (profRadInt U₂) rU, rUF2 η h1 h2,
      etaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U₁ x e ^ 2 - x * F₁ x e ^ 2))
        (profRadInt (fun x e => U₂ x e ^ 2 - x * F₂ x e ^ 2)) rUF2,
      rPi η h1 h2, etaD (leadPi F₁) (leadPi F₂) rPi]
  refine ⟨hQ, hN, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold leadStressTh; rw [hQ, hA, hF]
  · unfold leadStressTz; rw [hN, hB, hF]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h lam Pst XR cpatch cinf ab Xg Xg2 r1 r2 p1 p2 m1 m2 Xv Xc Xb Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 Xh1 aa : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Fo Uo Fi Ui F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), OutProf h lam Pst XR cpatch cinf ab Xg Xg2 r1 r2 p1 p2 m1 m2 Xv Xc Xb Pax Fo Uo → AxProf h Pst XR Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 Xh1 aa Pax Fi Ui → (∀ X e : ℝ, F X e = if X < XR then Fi X e else Fo X e) → (∀ X e : ℝ, U X e = if X < XR then Ui X e else Uo X e) → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → (∀ X : ℝ, Xh1 < X → F X η = Fo X η ∧ U X η = Uo X η) ∧ (profRadInt U Xh1 η = profRadInt Uo Xh1 η ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) Xh1 η = profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * Fo x e) Xh1 η ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) Xh1 η = profRadInt (fun x e => Uo x e * (2 * x * Fo x e)) Xh1 η ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) Xh1 η = profRadInt (fun x e => Uo x e ^ 2 - x * Fo x e ^ 2) Xh1 η) ∧ (∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * F x η) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η * (2 * x * F x η)) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => F x η ^ 2) volume 0 X) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ leadPi F 0 η = Pax η ∧ (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), U x η * (2 * x * F x η)) = 0 ∧ (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2)) = 0 ∧ (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (2 * x * F x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))) = 0 ∧ (∀ X : ℝ, Xv ≤ X → profRadInt U X η = 0)

signature.name: jp_join_moments
signature.statement: ∀ (h lam Pst XR cpatch cinf ab Xg Xg2 r1 r2 p1 p2 m1 m2 Xv Xc Xb Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 Xh1 aa : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Fo Uo Fi Ui F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), OutProf h lam Pst XR cpatch cinf ab Xg Xg2 r1 r2 p1 p2 m1 m2 Xv Xc Xb Pax Fo Uo → AxProf h Pst XR Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 Xh1 aa Pax Fi Ui → (∀ X e : ℝ, F X e = if X < XR then Fi X e else Fo X e) → (∀ X e : ℝ, U X e = if X < XR then Ui X e else Uo X e) → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → (∀ X : ℝ, Xh1 < X → F X η = Fo X η ∧ U X η = Uo X η) ∧ (profRadInt U Xh1 η = profRadInt Uo Xh1 η ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) Xh1 η = profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * Fo x e) Xh1 η ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) Xh1 η = profRadInt (fun x e => Uo x e * (2 * x * Fo x e)) Xh1 η ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) Xh1 η = profRadInt (fun x e => Uo x e ^ 2 - x * Fo x e ^ 2) Xh1 η) ∧ (∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * F x η) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η * (2 * x * F x η)) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => F x η ^ 2) volume 0 X) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ leadPi F 0 η = Pax η ∧ (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), U x η * (2 * x * F x η)) = 0 ∧ (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2)) = 0 ∧ (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (2 * x * F x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))) = 0 ∧ (∀ X : ℝ, Xv ≤ X → profRadInt U X η = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h lam Pst XR cpatch cinf ab Xg Xg2 r1 r2 p1 p2 m1 m2 Xv Xc Xb Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 Xh1 aa Pax Fo Uo Fi Ui F U
    hO hA hF hU η h1 h2
  
  have G1 : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (g₁ g₂ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → IntervalIntegrable g₁ volume 0 b →
      IntervalIntegrable g₂ volume 0 b → (∀ x : ℝ, a < x → x ≤ b → g₁ x = g₂ x) →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..a, g₁ x) - (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..a, g₂ x) =
        (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..b, g₁ x) - (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..b, g₂ x) := by
    intro a b g₁ g₂ ha hab hi1 hi2 heq
    have hb : 0 ≤ b := ha.trans hab
    have s1 : uIcc 0 a ⊆ uIcc 0 b := by
      rw [uIcc_of_le ha, uIcc_of_le hb]; exact Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hab
    have s2 : uIcc a b ⊆ uIcc 0 b := by
      rw [uIcc_of_le hab, uIcc_of_le hb]; exact Icc_subset_Icc ha le_rfl
    have e1 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hi1.mono_set s1) (hi1.mono_set s2)
    have e2 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hi2.mono_set s1) (hi2.mono_set s2)
    have e3 : (∫ x in a..b, g₁ x) = ∫ x in a..b, g₂ x := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
      refine ae_of_all _ (fun x hx => ?_)
      rw [uIoc_of_le hab] at hx
      exact heq x hx.1 hx.2
    linarith
  
  have G2 : ∀ (a : ℝ) (g g₁ g₂ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ a → ContinuousOn g₁ (Icc 0 a) →
      (∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable g₂ volume 0 X) → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ a → g x = g₁ x) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, a < x → g x = g₂ x) → ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 X := by
    intro a g g₁ g₂ ha hc hi2 he1 he2 X hX
    have hAa : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 a := by
      have : IntervalIntegrable g₁ volume 0 a := by
        apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
        rw [uIcc_of_le ha]; exact hc
      refine this.congr ?_
      intro x hx
      rw [uIoc_of_le ha] at hx
      exact (he1 x hx.1.le hx.2).symm
    rcases le_or_gt X a with hXa | hXa
    · refine hAa.mono_set ?_
      rw [uIcc_of_le ha, uIcc_of_le hX]; exact Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hXa
    · have hB : IntervalIntegrable g volume a X := by
        have : IntervalIntegrable g₂ volume a X := by
          refine (hi2 X hX).mono_set ?_
          rw [uIcc_of_le hXa.le, uIcc_of_le hX]; exact Icc_subset_Icc ha le_rfl
        refine this.congr ?_
        intro x hx
        rw [uIoc_of_le hXa.le] at hx
        exact (he2 x hx.1).symm
      exact hAa.trans hB
  
  have G3 : ∀ (a : ℝ) (g₁ g₂ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ a → (∀ x : ℝ, a < x → g₁ x = g₂ x) →
      IntegrableOn g₂ (Ioi 0) → IntervalIntegrable (fun x => g₁ x - g₂ x) volume 0 a →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..a, (g₁ x - g₂ x)) = 0 →
      IntegrableOn g₁ (Ioi 0) ∧ (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), g₁ x) = ∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), g₂ x := by
    intro a g₁ g₂ ha heq hg2 hd hd0
    have hUn : Ioc 0 a ∪ Ioi a = Ioi (0:ℝ) := Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi ha
    have hdI : IntegrableOn (fun x => g₁ x - g₂ x) (Ioc 0 a) :=
      (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le ha).mp hd
    have hdT : IntegrableOn (fun x => g₁ x - g₂ x) (Ioi a) := by
      refine (integrableOn_zero).congr_fun (fun x hx => ?_) measurableSet_Ioi
      simp [heq x hx]
    have hdAll : IntegrableOn (fun x => g₁ x - g₂ x) (Ioi 0) := by
      rw [← hUn]; exact hdI.union hdT
    have hg1 : IntegrableOn g₁ (Ioi 0) := by
      refine (hdAll.add hg2).congr_fun (fun x _ => ?_) measurableSet_Ioi
      simp
    refine ⟨hg1, ?_⟩
    have hs : (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (g₁ x - g₂ x)) =
        (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), g₁ x) - ∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), g₂ x :=
      integral_sub hg1 hg2
    have hsplit : (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (g₁ x - g₂ x)) =
        (∫ x in Ioc 0 a, (g₁ x - g₂ x)) + ∫ x in Ioi a, (g₁ x - g₂ x) := by
      rw [← hUn]; exact setIntegral_union (Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same) measurableSet_Ioi hdI hdT
    have hT : (∫ x in Ioi a, (g₁ x - g₂ x)) = 0 := by
      rw [setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ))
        (fun x hx => by simp [heq x hx])]
      simp
    have hI : (∫ x in Ioc 0 a, (g₁ x - g₂ x)) = 0 := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ha]; exact hd0
    linarith
  
  have G4 : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (g gi go gr : ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → IntervalIntegrable gi volume 0 b →
      IntervalIntegrable go volume 0 b → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ a → g x = gi x) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, a < x → x ≤ b → gi x = gr x) → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ b → go x = gr x) →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..b, gi x) = (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..b, gr x) →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..a, g x) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..a, go x := by
    intro a b g gi go gr ha hab hi ho hg hir hor hm
    have hb : 0 ≤ b := ha.trans hab
    have e1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..b, gr x) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..b, go x := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
      refine ae_of_all _ (fun x hx => ?_)
      rw [uIoc_of_le hb] at hx
      exact (hor x hx.1 hx.2).symm
    have e2 := G1 a b gi go ha hab hi ho
      (fun x hx1 hx2 => by rw [hir x hx1 hx2, hor x (lt_of_le_of_lt ha hx1) hx2])
    have e3 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..a, g x) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..a, gi x := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x hx
      rw [uIcc_of_le ha] at hx
      exact hg x hx.1 hx.2
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨⟨-, -, -, hXR, hXRg, hgg2, hg2r1, hr12, hr2p1, hp12, hp2m1, hm12, hm2v, -, -⟩, -, hO2, -, -,
    hO5, hO6, hO7, -, -⟩ := hO
  obtain ⟨⟨-, -, hXa, hXan, hXan1, hXa12, hXa2h1, hXh1h⟩, ⟨ε, hε, hFiS, hUiS, -, -⟩, hA2, -, hA4, -⟩ := hA
  obtain ⟨hO6a, hO6b, hO6c, hO6d, hO6e, hO6f, hO6g, hO6h⟩ := hO6 η h1 h2
  obtain ⟨hA4a, hA4b, hA4c, hA4d, hA4e⟩ := hA4 η h1 h2
  have he5 : Real.exp (-5) < 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_zero]; exact Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by norm_num)
  have hXhR : XR * Real.exp (-5) < XR := mul_lt_of_lt_one_right hXR he5
  have hXh1R : Xh1 < XR := lt_trans hXh1h hXhR
  have hXh1pos : 0 < Xh1 := by linarith
  have hXh0 : 0 ≤ XR * Real.exp (-5) := by linarith
  have hXRv : XR < Xv := by linarith
  have hFin : ∀ X e : ℝ, X < XR → F X e = Fi X e := fun X e hX => by rw [hF, if_pos hX]
  have hUin : ∀ X e : ℝ, X < XR → U X e = Ui X e := fun X e hX => by rw [hU, if_pos hX]
  have hFout : ∀ X e : ℝ, XR ≤ X → F X e = Fo X e := fun X e hX => by
    rw [hF, if_neg (not_lt.mpr hX)]
  have hUout : ∀ X e : ℝ, XR ≤ X → U X e = Uo X e := fun X e hX => by
    rw [hU, if_neg (not_lt.mpr hX)]
  
  have hcont : ∀ b : ℝ, ContinuousOn (fun x => Ui x η) (Icc 0 b) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun x => 2 * x * Fi x η) (Icc 0 b) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun x => Ui x η * (2 * x * Fi x η)) (Icc 0 b) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun x => Ui x η ^ 2 - x * Fi x η ^ 2) (Icc 0 b) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun x => Fi x η ^ 2) (Icc 0 b) := by
    intro b
    have hmap : MapsTo (fun x : ℝ => ((x, η) : ℝ × ℝ)) (Icc 0 b) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
      fun x hx => ⟨show -ε < x by linarith [hx.1], h1, h2⟩
    have cF : ContinuousOn (fun x => Fi x η) (Icc 0 b) :=
      hFiS.continuousOn.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn hmap
    have cU : ContinuousOn (fun x => Ui x η) (Icc 0 b) :=
      hUiS.continuousOn.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn hmap
    refine ⟨cU, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (continuousOn_const.mul continuousOn_id).mul cF
    · exact cU.mul ((continuousOn_const.mul continuousOn_id).mul cF)
    · exact (cU.pow 2).sub (continuousOn_id.mul (cF.pow 2))
    · exact cF.pow 2
  have hcII : ∀ b : ℝ, 0 ≤ b → ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn f (Icc 0 b) →
      IntervalIntegrable f volume 0 b := fun b hb f hf => by
    apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
    rw [uIcc_of_le hb]; exact hf
  obtain ⟨cXh1, cXh2, cXh3, cXh4, cXh5⟩ := hcont (XR * Real.exp (-5))
  obtain ⟨cA1, cA2, cA3, cA4, cA5⟩ := hcont Xh1
  obtain ⟨oXh1, oXh2, oXh3, oXh4, oXh5⟩ := hO7 η h1 h2 (XR * Real.exp (-5)) hXh0
  
  have AG : ∀ X : ℝ, Xh1 < X → F X η = Fo X η ∧ U X η = Uo X η := by
    intro X hX
    by_cases hXR' : X < XR
    · obtain ⟨hu, hf⟩ := hA2 X η hX.le h1 h2
      obtain ⟨hu', hf'⟩ := hO2 X η (by linarith) hXR'.le h1 h2
      exact ⟨by rw [hFin X η hXR', hf, hf'], by rw [hUin X η hXR', hu, hu']⟩
    · exact ⟨hFout X η (not_lt.mp hXR'), hUout X η (not_lt.mp hXR')⟩
  have hin : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ Xh1 → F x η = Fi x η ∧ U x η = Ui x η :=
    fun x _ hx => ⟨hFin x η (by linarith), hUin x η (by linarith)⟩
  
  have II : ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * F x η) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η * (2 * x * F x η)) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => F x η ^ 2) volume 0 X := by
    intro X hX
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact G2 Xh1 (fun x => U x η) (fun x => Ui x η) (fun x => Uo x η) hXh1pos.le cA1
        (fun Y hY => (hO7 η h1 h2 Y hY).1)
        (fun x hx0 hx => by simp only [(hin x hx0 hx).2])
        (fun x hx => by simp only [(AG x hx).2]) X hX
    · exact G2 Xh1 (fun x => 2 * x * F x η) (fun x => 2 * x * Fi x η) (fun x => 2 * x * Fo x η)
        hXh1pos.le cA2
        (fun Y hY => (hO7 η h1 h2 Y hY).2.1)
        (fun x hx0 hx => by simp only [(hin x hx0 hx).1])
        (fun x hx => by simp only [(AG x hx).1]) X hX
    · exact G2 Xh1 (fun x => U x η * (2 * x * F x η)) (fun x => Ui x η * (2 * x * Fi x η))
        (fun x => Uo x η * (2 * x * Fo x η)) hXh1pos.le cA3
        (fun Y hY => (hO7 η h1 h2 Y hY).2.2.1)
        (fun x hx0 hx => by simp only [(hin x hx0 hx).1, (hin x hx0 hx).2])
        (fun x hx => by simp only [(AG x hx).1, (AG x hx).2]) X hX
    · exact G2 Xh1 (fun x => U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2) (fun x => Ui x η ^ 2 - x * Fi x η ^ 2)
        (fun x => Uo x η ^ 2 - x * Fo x η ^ 2) hXh1pos.le cA4
        (fun Y hY => (hO7 η h1 h2 Y hY).2.2.2.1)
        (fun x hx0 hx => by simp only [(hin x hx0 hx).1, (hin x hx0 hx).2])
        (fun x hx => by simp only [(AG x hx).1, (AG x hx).2]) X hX
    · exact G2 Xh1 (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (fun x => Fi x η ^ 2) (fun x => Fo x η ^ 2) hXh1pos.le cA5
        (fun Y hY => (hO7 η h1 h2 Y hY).2.2.2.2)
        (fun x hx0 hx => by simp only [(hin x hx0 hx).1])
        (fun x hx => by simp only [(AG x hx).1]) X hX
  obtain ⟨jU, j2F, jUF, jQ, jF2⟩ := II Xh1 hXh1pos.le
  obtain ⟨oU, o2F, oUF, oQ, oF2⟩ := hO7 η h1 h2 Xh1 hXh1pos.le
  
  have M1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xh1, U x η) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xh1, Uo x η :=
    G4 Xh1 (XR * Real.exp (-5)) (fun x => U x η) (fun x => Ui x η) (fun x => Uo x η)
      (fun _ => 4 * η) hXh1pos.le hXh1h.le
      (hcII _ hXh0 _ cXh1) oXh1
      (fun x hx0 hx => by simp only [(hin x hx0 hx).2])
      (fun x hx1 _ => by simp only [(hA2 x η hx1.le h1 h2).1])
      (fun x hx0 hx => by simp only [(hO2 x η hx0 (by linarith) h1 h2).1])
      hA4a
  have M2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xh1, 2 * x * F x η) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xh1, 2 * x * Fo x η :=
    G4 Xh1 (XR * Real.exp (-5)) (fun x => 2 * x * F x η) (fun x => 2 * x * Fi x η)
      (fun x => 2 * x * Fo x η) (fun x => 2 * x * refFin Pst XR x η) hXh1pos.le hXh1h.le
      (hcII _ hXh0 _ cXh2) oXh2
      (fun x hx0 hx => by simp only [(hin x hx0 hx).1])
      (fun x hx1 _ => by simp only [(hA2 x η hx1.le h1 h2).2])
      (fun x hx0 hx => by simp only [(hO2 x η hx0 (by linarith) h1 h2).2])
      hA4b
  have M3 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xh1, U x η * (2 * x * F x η)) =
      ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xh1, Uo x η * (2 * x * Fo x η) :=
    G4 Xh1 (XR * Real.exp (-5)) (fun x => U x η * (2 * x * F x η))
      (fun x => Ui x η * (2 * x * Fi x η)) (fun x => Uo x η * (2 * x * Fo x η))
      (fun x => 4 * η * (2 * x * refFin Pst XR x η)) hXh1pos.le hXh1h.le
      (hcII _ hXh0 _ cXh3) oXh3
      (fun x hx0 hx => by simp only [(hin x hx0 hx).1, (hin x hx0 hx).2])
      (fun x hx1 _ => by simp only [(hA2 x η hx1.le h1 h2).1, (hA2 x η hx1.le h1 h2).2])
      (fun x hx0 hx => by
        simp only [(hO2 x η hx0 (by linarith) h1 h2).1, (hO2 x η hx0 (by linarith) h1 h2).2])
      hA4c
  have M4 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xh1, U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2) =
      ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xh1, Uo x η ^ 2 - x * Fo x η ^ 2 :=
    G4 Xh1 (XR * Real.exp (-5)) (fun x => U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2)
      (fun x => Ui x η ^ 2 - x * Fi x η ^ 2) (fun x => Uo x η ^ 2 - x * Fo x η ^ 2)
      (fun x => (4 * η) ^ 2 - x * refFin Pst XR x η ^ 2) hXh1pos.le hXh1h.le
      (hcII _ hXh0 _ cXh4) oXh4
      (fun x hx0 hx => by simp only [(hin x hx0 hx).1, (hin x hx0 hx).2])
      (fun x hx1 _ => by simp only [(hA2 x η hx1.le h1 h2).1, (hA2 x η hx1.le h1 h2).2])
      (fun x hx0 hx => by
        simp only [(hO2 x η hx0 (by linarith) h1 h2).1, (hO2 x η hx0 (by linarith) h1 h2).2])
      hA4d
  have M5 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xh1, F x η ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xh1, Fo x η ^ 2 :=
    G4 Xh1 (XR * Real.exp (-5)) (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (fun x => Fi x η ^ 2) (fun x => Fo x η ^ 2)
      (fun x => refFin Pst XR x η ^ 2) hXh1pos.le hXh1h.le
      (hcII _ hXh0 _ cXh5) oXh5
      (fun x hx0 hx => by simp only [(hin x hx0 hx).1])
      (fun x hx1 _ => by simp only [(hA2 x η hx1.le h1 h2).2])
      (fun x hx0 hx => by simp only [(hO2 x η hx0 (by linarith) h1 h2).2])
      hA4e
  
  have T45 : IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧
      (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), F x η ^ 2) = ∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), Fo x η ^ 2 :=
    G3 Xh1 (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (fun x => Fo x η ^ 2) hXh1pos.le
      (fun x hx => by simp only [(AG x hx).1]) hO6d (jF2.sub oF2)
      (by
        show (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xh1, (F x η ^ 2 - Fo x η ^ 2)) = 0
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub jF2 oF2, M5, sub_self])
  have T5 : leadPi F 0 η = Pax η := by
    rw [← hO6h]
    show -(∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), F x η ^ 2) = -(∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), Fo x η ^ 2)
    rw [T45.2]
  
  have T6e : (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), U x η * (2 * x * F x η)) =
      ∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), Uo x η * (2 * x * Fo x η) :=
    (G3 Xh1 (fun x => U x η * (2 * x * F x η)) (fun x => Uo x η * (2 * x * Fo x η)) hXh1pos.le
      (fun x hx => by simp only [(AG x hx).1, (AG x hx).2]) hO6a (jUF.sub oUF)
      (by
        show (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xh1, (U x η * (2 * x * F x η) - Uo x η * (2 * x * Fo x η))) = 0
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub jUF oUF, M3, sub_self])).2
  
  have T7e : (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2)) =
      ∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (Uo x η ^ 2 - x * Fo x η ^ 2) :=
    (G3 Xh1 (fun x => U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2) (fun x => Uo x η ^ 2 - x * Fo x η ^ 2) hXh1pos.le
      (fun x hx => by simp only [(AG x hx).1, (AG x hx).2]) hO6b (jQ.sub oQ)
      (by
        show (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xh1, ((U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2) - (Uo x η ^ 2 - x * Fo x η ^ 2))) = 0
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub jQ oQ, M4, sub_self])).2
  
  have eT8 : (fun x : ℝ => (2 * x * F x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) -
      (2 * x * Fo x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))) =
      fun x : ℝ => 2 * x * F x η - 2 * x * Fo x η := by
    funext x; ring
  have T8e : (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (2 * x * F x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))) =
      ∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (2 * x * Fo x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) :=
    (G3 Xh1 (fun x => 2 * x * F x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))
      (fun x => 2 * x * Fo x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) hXh1pos.le
      (fun x hx => by simp only [(AG x hx).1]) hO6c
      (by
        show IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => (2 * x * F x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf *
          x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) - (2 * x * Fo x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))))
          volume 0 Xh1
        rw [eT8]; exact j2F.sub o2F)
      (by
        show (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xh1, (fun x : ℝ => (2 * x * F x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf *
          x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) - (2 * x * Fo x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))) x) = 0
        rw [eT8, intervalIntegral.integral_sub j2F o2F, M2, sub_self])).2
  
  have T9 : ∀ X : ℝ, Xv ≤ X → profRadInt U X η = 0 := by
    intro X hX
    have hX0 : 0 ≤ X := by linarith
    have e : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xh1, U x η) - (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xh1, Uo x η) =
        (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, U x η) - (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, Uo x η) :=
      G1 Xh1 X (fun x => U x η) (fun x => Uo x η) hXh1pos.le (by linarith) (II X hX0).1
        (hO7 η h1 h2 X hX0).1 (fun x hx _ => (AG x hx).2)
    have z : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, Uo x η) = 0 := (hO5 X η hX h1 h2).2
    show (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, U x η) = 0
    linarith
  exact ⟨AG, ⟨M1, M2, M3, M4⟩, II, T45.1, T5, T6e.trans hO6e, T7e.trans hO6f, T8e.trans hO6g, T9⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h K : ℝ) (w w' δ δ' : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < K → (∀ X ∈ S, 0 ≤ w' X ∧ w' X ≤ w X ∧ w X ≤ K * w' X ∧ 0 < δ' X ∧ δ' X ≤ δ X ∧ δ X ≤ 1) → AdmBlk h w δ S F U → AdmBlk h w' δ' S F U

signature.name: jp_adm_weight_mono
signature.statement: ∀ (h K : ℝ) (w w' δ δ' : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < K → (∀ X ∈ S, 0 ≤ w' X ∧ w' X ≤ w X ∧ w X ≤ K * w' X ∧ 0 < δ' X ∧ δ' X ≤ δ X ∧ δ X ≤ 1) → AdmBlk h w δ S F U → AdmBlk h w' δ' S F U

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h K w w' δ δ' S F U hK hS hadm
  obtain ⟨⟨c₀, hc₀, hA⟩, hB, hC⟩ := hadm
  refine ⟨⟨c₀, hc₀, ?_⟩, ?_, hC⟩
  · intro X hX η h1 h2
    obtain ⟨_, hww, -⟩ := hS X hX
    exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hww hc₀.le) (hA X hX η h1 h2)
  · intro m
    obtain ⟨C, N, hCN⟩ := hB m
    have hCp : 0 ≤ max C 0 := le_max_right _ _
    have hKp : 0 ≤ max K 1 := le_trans zero_le_one (le_max_right _ _)
    have hCC : C ≤ max C 0 * max K 1 :=
      calc C ≤ max C 0 := le_max_left _ _
        _ = max C 0 * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
        _ ≤ max C 0 * max K 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right _ _) hCp
    refine ⟨max C 0 * max K 1, max N 0, fun X hX η h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hw', hww, hwK, hδ', hδδ, hδ1⟩ := hS X hX
    have hδ : 0 < δ X := lt_of_lt_of_le hδ' hδδ
    have hw : 0 ≤ w X := le_trans hw' hww
    have key : ∀ b : ℝ, b ≤ C * w X * δ X ^ (-N) →
        b ≤ max C 0 * max K 1 * w' X * δ' X ^ (-(max N 0)) := by
      intro b hb
      have s1 : C * w X * δ X ^ (-N) ≤ max C 0 * w X * δ X ^ (-N) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hw)
          (Real.rpow_nonneg hδ.le _)
      have s2 : δ X ^ (-N) ≤ δ X ^ (-(max N 0)) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hδ hδ1 (neg_le_neg (le_max_left _ _))
      have s3 : δ X ^ (-(max N 0)) ≤ δ' X ^ (-(max N 0)) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hδ' hδδ (neg_nonpos.mpr (le_max_right _ _))
      have hwK' : w X ≤ max K 1 * w' X :=
        le_trans hwK (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hw')
      have s4 : max C 0 * w X * δ X ^ (-N) ≤ max C 0 * (max K 1 * w' X) * δ' X ^ (-(max N 0)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hwK' hCp) (s2.trans s3)
          (Real.rpow_nonneg hδ.le _)
        exact mul_nonneg hCp (mul_nonneg hKp hw')
      calc b ≤ C * w X * δ X ^ (-N) := hb
        _ ≤ max C 0 * w X * δ X ^ (-N) := s1
        _ ≤ max C 0 * (max K 1 * w' X) * δ' X ^ (-(max N 0)) := s4
        _ = max C 0 * max K 1 * w' X * δ' X ^ (-(max N 0)) := by ring
    obtain ⟨b1, b2, b3, b4⟩ := hCN X hX η h1 h2
    exact ⟨key _ b1, key _ b2, b3.trans hCC, b4.trans hCC⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (w δ : ℝ → ℝ) (S₁ S₂ : Set ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ X ∈ S₁ ∪ S₂, 0 ≤ w X ∧ 0 < δ X ∧ δ X ≤ 1) → AdmBlk h w δ S₁ F U → AdmBlk h w δ S₂ F U → AdmBlk h w δ (S₁ ∪ S₂) F U

signature.name: jp_adm_union
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (w δ : ℝ → ℝ) (S₁ S₂ : Set ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ X ∈ S₁ ∪ S₂, 0 ≤ w X ∧ 0 < δ X ∧ δ X ≤ 1) → AdmBlk h w δ S₁ F U → AdmBlk h w δ S₂ F U → AdmBlk h w δ (S₁ ∪ S₂) F U

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h w δ S₁ S₂ F U hwd A₁ A₂
  unfold AdmBlk at A₁ A₂ ⊢
  obtain ⟨⟨c₁, hc₁, L₁⟩, D₁, ⟨κ₁, hκ₁0, hκ₁2, K₁⟩⟩ := A₁
  obtain ⟨⟨c₂, hc₂, L₂⟩, D₂, ⟨κ₂, hκ₂0, hκ₂2, K₂⟩⟩ := A₂
  have key : ∀ (b Ci Ni C N wX d : ℝ), Ci ≤ C → 0 ≤ C → Ni ≤ N → 0 ≤ wX → 0 < d → d ≤ 1 →
      b ≤ Ci * wX * d ^ (-Ni) → b ≤ C * wX * d ^ (-N) := by
    intro b Ci Ni C N wX d hC hC0 hN hw hd0 hd1 hb
    have e1 : d ^ (-Ni) ≤ d ^ (-N) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hd0 hd1 (neg_le_neg hN)
    have e0 : 0 ≤ d ^ (-Ni) := Real.rpow_nonneg hd0.le _
    calc b ≤ Ci * wX * d ^ (-Ni) := hb
      _ ≤ C * wX * d ^ (-Ni) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC hw) e0
      _ ≤ C * wX * d ^ (-N) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e1 (mul_nonneg hC0 hw)
  refine ⟨⟨min c₁ c₂, lt_min hc₁ hc₂, ?_⟩, ?_,
    ⟨min κ₁ κ₂, lt_min hκ₁0 hκ₂0, min_lt_of_left_lt hκ₁2, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro X hX η h1 h2
    have hw := (hwd X hX).1
    rcases hX with hX | hX
    · exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left _ _) hw) (L₁ X hX η h1 h2)
    · exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right _ _) hw) (L₂ X hX η h1 h2)
  · intro m
    obtain ⟨C₁, N₁, E₁⟩ := D₁ m
    obtain ⟨C₂, N₂, E₂⟩ := D₂ m
    have hC0 : 0 ≤ max (max C₁ 0) (max C₂ 0) := le_trans (le_max_right C₁ 0) (le_max_left _ _)
    have hC1 : C₁ ≤ max (max C₁ 0) (max C₂ 0) := le_trans (le_max_left C₁ 0) (le_max_left _ _)
    have hC2 : C₂ ≤ max (max C₁ 0) (max C₂ 0) := le_trans (le_max_left C₂ 0) (le_max_right _ _)
    refine ⟨max (max C₁ 0) (max C₂ 0), max N₁ N₂, ?_⟩
    intro X hX η h1 h2
    obtain ⟨hw, hd0, hd1⟩ := hwd X hX
    rcases hX with hX | hX
    · obtain ⟨b1, b2, b3, b4⟩ := E₁ X hX η h1 h2
      exact ⟨key _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hC1 hC0 (le_max_left _ _) hw hd0 hd1 b1,
        key _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hC1 hC0 (le_max_left _ _) hw hd0 hd1 b2, b3.trans hC1, b4.trans hC1⟩
    · obtain ⟨b1, b2, b3, b4⟩ := E₂ X hX η h1 h2
      exact ⟨key _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hC2 hC0 (le_max_right _ _) hw hd0 hd1 b1,
        key _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hC2 hC0 (le_max_right _ _) hw hd0 hd1 b2, b3.trans hC2, b4.trans hC2⟩
  · intro X hX η h1 h2
    rcases hX with hX | hX
    · obtain ⟨k1, k2, k3, k4, k5⟩ := K₁ X hX η h1 h2
      have hk : min κ₁ κ₂ ≤ κ₁ := min_le_left _ _
      exact ⟨hk.trans k1, hk.trans k2, hk.trans k3,
        le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) k4,
        le_trans k5 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _))⟩
    · obtain ⟨k1, k2, k3, k4, k5⟩ := K₂ X hX η h1 h2
      have hk : min κ₁ κ₂ ≤ κ₂ := min_le_right _ _
      exact ⟨hk.trans k1, hk.trans k2, hk.trans k3,
        le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) k4,
        le_trans k5 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _))⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h c : ℝ) (w δ : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (F₁ U₁ F₂ U₂ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), S ⊆ Ioi c → (∀ X η : ℝ, c < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → F₁ X η = F₂ X η ∧ U₁ X η = U₂ X η ∧ leadStressTh h F₁ U₁ X η = leadStressTh h F₂ U₂ X η ∧ leadStressTz h F₁ U₁ X η = leadStressTz h F₂ U₂ X η) → AdmBlk h w δ S F₂ U₂ → AdmBlk h w δ S F₁ U₁

signature.name: jp_adm_congr
signature.statement: ∀ (h c : ℝ) (w δ : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (F₁ U₁ F₂ U₂ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), S ⊆ Ioi c → (∀ X η : ℝ, c < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → F₁ X η = F₂ X η ∧ U₁ X η = U₂ X η ∧ leadStressTh h F₁ U₁ X η = leadStressTh h F₂ U₂ X η ∧ leadStressTz h F₁ U₁ X η = leadStressTz h F₂ U₂ X η) → AdmBlk h w δ S F₂ U₂ → AdmBlk h w δ S F₁ U₁

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h c w δ S F₁ U₁ F₂ U₂ hS hEq hA
  obtain ⟨⟨c₀, hc₀, hlow⟩, hder, ⟨κ, hκ0, hκ2, hcone⟩⟩ := hA
  have hO : IsOpen (Ioi c ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  
  have hpt : ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      F₁ X η = F₂ X η ∧ U₁ X η = U₂ X η ∧
      leadStressTh h F₁ U₁ X η = leadStressTh h F₂ U₂ X η ∧
      leadStressTz h F₁ U₁ X η = leadStressTz h F₂ U₂ X η :=
    fun X hX η h1 h2 => hEq X η (mem_Ioi.mp (hS hX)) h1 h2
  
  have hshear : ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      shearA F₁ X η = shearA F₂ X η ∧ shearB F₁ U₁ X η = shearB F₂ U₂ X η := by
    intro X hX η h1 h2
    have hXc : c < X := mem_Ioi.mp (hS hX)
    have hevF : (fun Y => F₁ Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X] (fun Y => F₂ Y η) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds hXc)
        (fun Y hY => (hEq Y η (mem_Ioi.mp hY) h1 h2).1)
    have hevU : (fun Y => U₁ Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X] (fun Y => U₂ Y η) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds hXc)
        (fun Y hY => (hEq Y η (mem_Ioi.mp hY) h1 h2).2.1)
    have e := hEq X η hXc h1 h2
    constructor
    · unfold shearA
      rw [hevF.deriv_eq, e.1]
    · unfold shearB
      rw [hevU.deriv_eq, e.1]
  
  have hit : ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ∀ m : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTh h F₁ U₁)) (X, η) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTh h F₂ U₂)) (X, η) ∧
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTz h F₁ U₁)) (X, η) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTz h F₂ U₂)) (X, η) ∧
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTh h F₁ U₁ z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F₁ U₁ z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F₁ U₁ z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) (X, η) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTh h F₂ U₂ z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F₂ U₂ z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F₂ U₂ z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) (X, η) ∧
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTz h F₁ U₁ z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F₁ U₁ z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F₁ U₁ z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) (X, η) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTz h F₂ U₂ z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F₂ U₂ z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F₂ U₂ z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) (X, η) := by
    intro X hX η h1 h2 m
    have hXc : c < X := mem_Ioi.mp (hS hX)
    have hmem : Ioi c ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 ∈ nhds ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) := hO.mem_nhds ⟨hXc, h1, h2⟩
    have ev1 : (↿(leadStressTh h F₁ U₁)) =ᶠ[nhds ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ)] (↿(leadStressTh h F₂ U₂)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hmem (fun z hz => (hEq z.1 z.2 hz.1 hz.2.1 hz.2.2).2.2.1)
    have ev2 : (↿(leadStressTz h F₁ U₁)) =ᶠ[nhds ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ)] (↿(leadStressTz h F₂ U₂)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hmem (fun z hz => (hEq z.1 z.2 hz.1 hz.2.1 hz.2.2).2.2.2)
    have ev3 : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTh h F₁ U₁ z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F₁ U₁ z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F₁ U₁ z.1 z.2 ^ 2))
        =ᶠ[nhds ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ)] (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTh h F₂ U₂ z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F₂ U₂ z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F₂ U₂ z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hmem (fun z hz => by
        have e := hEq z.1 z.2 hz.1 hz.2.1 hz.2.2
        simp only [e.2.2.1, e.2.2.2])
    have ev4 : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTz h F₁ U₁ z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F₁ U₁ z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F₁ U₁ z.1 z.2 ^ 2))
        =ᶠ[nhds ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ)] (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTz h F₂ U₂ z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F₂ U₂ z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F₂ U₂ z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hmem (fun z hz => by
        have e := hEq z.1 z.2 hz.1 hz.2.1 hz.2.2
        simp only [e.2.2.1, e.2.2.2])
    exact ⟨(ev1.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, (ev2.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds,
      (ev3.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, (ev4.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds⟩
  refine ⟨⟨c₀, hc₀, fun X hX η h1 h2 => ?_⟩, fun m => ?_, ⟨κ, hκ0, hκ2, fun X hX η h1 h2 => ?_⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨-, -, e3, e4⟩ := hpt X hX η h1 h2
    rw [e3, e4]
    exact hlow X hX η h1 h2
  · obtain ⟨C, N, hb⟩ := hder m
    refine ⟨C, N, fun X hX η h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3, i4⟩ := hit X hX η h1 h2 m
    rw [i1, i2, i3, i4]
    exact hb X hX η h1 h2
  · obtain ⟨e1, -, e3, e4⟩ := hpt X hX η h1 h2
    obtain ⟨sA, sB⟩ := hshear X hX η h1 h2
    rw [sA, sB, e1, e3, e4]
    exact hcone X hX η h1 h2

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h μ₁ μ₂ a b c d : ℝ) (F₁ U₁ F₂ U₂ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < μ₁ → 0 < μ₂ → c < b → (∀ X η : ℝ, c < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → F₁ X η = F₂ X η ∧ U₁ X η = U₂ X η ∧ leadQs h F₁ U₁ X η = leadQs h F₂ U₂ X η ∧ leadNs h F₁ U₁ X η = leadNs h F₂ U₂ X η) → RelaxCone h μ₁ (Icc a b) F₁ U₁ → RelaxCone h μ₂ (Icc b d) F₂ U₂ → ∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ RelaxCone h μ (Icc a d) F₁ U₁

signature.name: jp_relax_cone_glue
signature.statement: ∀ (h μ₁ μ₂ a b c d : ℝ) (F₁ U₁ F₂ U₂ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < μ₁ → 0 < μ₂ → c < b → (∀ X η : ℝ, c < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → F₁ X η = F₂ X η ∧ U₁ X η = U₂ X η ∧ leadQs h F₁ U₁ X η = leadQs h F₂ U₂ X η ∧ leadNs h F₁ U₁ X η = leadNs h F₂ U₂ X η) → RelaxCone h μ₁ (Icc a b) F₁ U₁ → RelaxCone h μ₂ (Icc b d) F₂ U₂ → ∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ RelaxCone h μ (Icc a d) F₁ U₁

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h μ₁ μ₂ a b c d F₁ U₁ F₂ U₂ hμ₁ hμ₂ hcb hag R1 R2
  refine ⟨min μ₁ μ₂, lt_min hμ₁ hμ₂, ?_⟩
  have m1 : min μ₁ μ₂ ≤ μ₁ := min_le_left _ _
  have m2 : min μ₁ μ₂ ≤ μ₂ := min_le_right _ _
  intro X hX η h1 h2
  rcases le_or_gt X b with hXb | hXb
  · obtain ⟨r1, r2, r3, r4⟩ := R1 X ⟨hX.1, hXb⟩ η h1 h2
    exact ⟨le_trans m1 r1, le_trans m1 r2, le_trans m1 r3, le_trans m1 r4⟩
  · have hcX : c < X := lt_trans hcb hXb
    obtain ⟨e1, -, e3, e4⟩ := hag X η hcX h1 h2
    have hnhds : Ioi c ∈ nhds X := isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds hcX
    have d1 : deriv (fun Y => F₁ Y η) X = deriv (fun Y => F₂ Y η) X :=
      (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hnhds (fun Y hY => (hag Y η hY h1 h2).1)).deriv_eq
    have d2 : deriv (fun Y => U₁ Y η) X = deriv (fun Y => U₂ Y η) X :=
      (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hnhds (fun Y hY => (hag Y η hY h1 h2).2.1)).deriv_eq
    have hA : shearA F₁ X η = shearA F₂ X η := by
      unfold shearA; rw [d1, e1]
    have hB : shearB F₁ U₁ X η = shearB F₂ U₂ X η := by
      unfold shearB; rw [d2, e1]
    have hP1 : psLead1 h F₁ U₁ X η = psLead1 h F₂ U₂ X η := by
      unfold psLead1; rw [e3]
    have hP2 : psLead2 h F₁ U₁ X η = psLead2 h F₂ U₂ X η := by
      unfold psLead2; rw [e4, e1]
    obtain ⟨r1, r2, r3, r4⟩ := R2 X ⟨hXb.le, hX.2⟩ η h1 h2
    rw [hA, hB, hP1, hP2, e1]
    exact ⟨le_trans m2 r1, le_trans m2 r2, le_trans m2 r3, le_trans m2 r4⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (R ε η : ℝ) (F Fi : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < ε → (∀ X : ℝ, X < R → F X η = Fi X η) → ContinuousOn (fun x => Fi x η) (Ioi (-ε)) → IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) → ∀ Y : ℝ, -ε < Y → Y < R → leadPi F Y η = leadPi F 0 η + profRadInt (fun x e => Fi x e ^ 2) Y η

signature.name: jp_leadPi_axis_identity
signature.statement: ∀ (R ε η : ℝ) (F Fi : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < ε → (∀ X : ℝ, X < R → F X η = Fi X η) → ContinuousOn (fun x => Fi x η) (Ioi (-ε)) → IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) → ∀ Y : ℝ, -ε < Y → Y < R → leadPi F Y η = leadPi F 0 η + profRadInt (fun x e => Fi x e ^ 2) Y η

proof.tactics:
by
  intro R ε η F Fi hR hε hFin hcont hint Y hY1 hY2
  unfold leadPi profRadInt
  have hE : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Y, F x η ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Y, Fi x η ^ 2 := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro x hx
    rcases Set.mem_uIcc.mp hx with h | h
    · show F x η ^ 2 = Fi x η ^ 2
      rw [hFin x (by linarith [h.2])]
    · show F x η ^ 2 = Fi x η ^ 2
      rw [hFin x (by linarith [h.2])]
  rcases le_or_gt 0 Y with hY | hY
  · have h1 := intervalIntegral.integral_Ioi_sub_Ioi hint hY
    simp only []
    linarith
  · have hIcc : IntegrableOn (fun x => Fi x η ^ 2) (Icc Y 0) := by
      apply ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc
      apply ContinuousOn.pow
      exact hcont.mono (fun x hx => show -ε < x by linarith [hx.1])
    have hIoc : IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioc Y 0) := by
      apply (hIcc.mono_set Ioc_subset_Icc_self).congr_fun _ measurableSet_Ioc
      intro x hx
      show Fi x η ^ 2 = F x η ^ 2
      rw [hFin x (by linarith [hx.2])]
    have hint' : IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi Y) := by
      rw [← Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hY.le]
      exact hIoc.union hint
    have h1 := intervalIntegral.integral_Ioi_sub_Ioi hint' hY.le
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm] at h1
    simp only []
    linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ K : ℝ, ∃ (h : ℝ → ℝ) (H : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ h ∧ Function.Periodic h 1 ∧ (∀ u, -1 ≤ h u) ∧ (∀ u, |h u| ≤ H) ∧ (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, h u) = 0 ∧ (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u) * h u) = 0 ∧ K ≤ ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, h u ^ 2

signature.name: spike_profile
signature.statement: ∀ K : ℝ, ∃ (h : ℝ → ℝ) (H : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ h ∧ Function.Periodic h 1 ∧ (∀ u, -1 ≤ h u) ∧ (∀ u, |h u| ≤ H) ∧ (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, h u) = 0 ∧ (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u) * h u) = 0 ∧ K ≤ ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, h u ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∀ k : ℕ, (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ^ (2 * k)) =
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (2 * (i:ℝ) + 1) / (2 * (i:ℝ) + 2) := by
    intro k
    have := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left (fun x => Real.sin x ^ (2 * k))
      (a := 0) (b := 1) Real.pi_pos.ne'
    simp only [mul_zero, mul_one] at this
    rw [this, integral_sin_pow_even, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ Real.pi_pos.ne']
  
  have s2 : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (2 * (i:ℝ) + 1) / (2 * (i:ℝ) + 2)) ∧
      (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (2 * (i:ℝ) + 1) / (2 * (i:ℝ) + 2)) ^ 2 * (2 * (k:ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 ∧
      1 ≤ (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (2 * (i:ℝ) + 1) / (2 * (i:ℝ) + 2)) ^ 2 * (4 * (k:ℝ) + 1) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨hp, hu, hl⟩ := ih
      rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]
      set W := ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (2 * (i:ℝ) + 1) / (2 * (i:ℝ) + 2)
      have hk : (0:ℝ) ≤ k := Nat.cast_nonneg k
      have hd : (0:ℝ) < 2 * k + 2 := by linarith
      push_cast
      rw [mul_pow, div_pow]
      refine ⟨mul_pos hp (div_pos (by linarith) hd), ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [show W ^ 2 * ((2 * (k:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / (2 * k + 2) ^ 2) * (2 * (k + 1) + 1) =
            (W ^ 2 * (2 * k + 1)) * ((2 * k + 1) * (2 * k + 3)) / (2 * k + 2) ^ 2 by
              field_simp; ring]
        rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
        have h1 : 0 ≤ (2 * (k:ℝ) + 1) * (2 * k + 3) := by positivity
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hu h1]
      · rw [show W ^ 2 * ((2 * (k:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / (2 * k + 2) ^ 2) * (4 * (k + 1) + 1) =
            W ^ 2 * ((2 * k + 1) ^ 2 * (4 * k + 5)) / (2 * k + 2) ^ 2 by
              field_simp; ring]
        rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        have e : (2 * (k:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * (4 * k + 5) = (2 * k + 2) ^ 2 * (4 * k + 1) + 1 := by ring
        rw [e]
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hl (sq_nonneg (2 * (k:ℝ) + 2)), sq_nonneg W]
  
  have s3 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ), (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u) *
      (Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ^ (2 * n) / c - 1)) = 0 := by
    intro n c
    let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u) * (Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ^ (2 * n) / c - 1)
    have hsym : ∀ u, g (1 - u) = - g u := by
      intro u
      simp only [g]
      rw [show Real.pi * (1 - u) = Real.pi - Real.pi * u by ring, Real.sin_pi_sub,
        show 2 * Real.pi * (1 - u) = 2 * Real.pi - 2 * Real.pi * u by ring, Real.sin_two_pi_sub]
      ring
    have h1 := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_left g (1:ℝ) (a := 0) (b := 1)
    simp only [sub_zero, sub_self] at h1
    have h2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, g (1 - x)) = - ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, g x := by
      simp only [hsym, intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
    show (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, g u) = 0
    linarith
  
  intro K
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, n = ⌈2 * (|K| + 1) ^ 2⌉₊ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hnK : 2 * (|K| + 1) ^ 2 ≤ (n:ℝ) := by rw [hn]; exact Nat.le_ceil _
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ, W = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (2 * (i:ℝ) + 1) / (2 * (i:ℝ) + 2) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨W2, hW2⟩ : ∃ W2 : ℝ,
      W2 = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (2 * n), (2 * (i:ℝ) + 1) / (2 * (i:ℝ) + 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hWp, hWu, -⟩ := s2 n
  obtain ⟨hW2p, -, hW2l⟩ := s2 (2 * n)
  rw [← hW] at hWp hWu
  rw [← hW2] at hW2p hW2l
  have hI1 : (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ^ (2 * n)) = W := by rw [hW]; exact s1 n
  have hI2 : (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ^ (2 * (2 * n))) = W2 := by
    rw [hW2]; exact s1 (2 * n)
  have hc1 : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ^ (2 * n)) := by fun_prop
  have hc2 : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ^ (2 * (2 * n))) := by fun_prop
  refine ⟨fun u => Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ^ (2 * n) / W - 1, 1 / W + 1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · fun_prop
  · intro u
    simp only
    rw [show Real.pi * (u + 1) = Real.pi * u + Real.pi by ring, Real.sin_add_pi, pow_mul, pow_mul,
      neg_sq]
  · intro u
    have h0 : 0 ≤ Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ^ (2 * n) := by rw [pow_mul]; positivity
    have : 0 ≤ Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ^ (2 * n) / W := div_nonneg h0 hWp.le
    simp only
    linarith
  · intro u
    have h0 : 0 ≤ Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ^ (2 * n) := by rw [pow_mul]; positivity
    have h1 : Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ^ (2 * n) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [pow_mul]
      apply pow_le_one₀ (sq_nonneg _)
      rw [sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one]
      exact Real.abs_sin_le_one _
    have h2 : Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ^ (2 * n) / W ≤ 1 / W := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 hWp.le
    have h3 : 0 ≤ Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ^ (2 * n) / W := div_nonneg h0 hWp.le
    have h4 : 0 < 1 / W := by positivity
    simp only
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith
  · rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub ((hc1.div_const W).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      intervalIntegrable_const,
      intervalIntegral.integral_div, hI1]
    simp [hWp.ne']
  · exact s3 n W
  · have hpt : ∀ u : ℝ, (Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ^ (2 * n) / W - 1) ^ 2 =
        Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ^ (2 * (2 * n)) * (1 / W ^ 2) -
          (2 / W) * Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ^ (2 * n) + 1 := by
      intro u
      rw [show 2 * (2 * n) = (2 * n) * 2 by ring, pow_mul]
      field_simp
      ring
    simp only [hpt]
    have i1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun u : ℝ => Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ^ (2 * (2 * n)) * (1 / W ^ 2))
        volume 0 1 := (hc2.mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have i2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun u : ℝ => 2 / W * Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ^ (2 * n))
        volume 0 1 := (continuous_const.mul hc1).intervalIntegrable _ _
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (i1.sub i2) intervalIntegrable_const,
      intervalIntegral.integral_sub i1 i2,
      intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hI1, hI2]
    simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, one_mul]
    have hx : 0 < W ^ 2 := by positivity
    have e : W2 * (1 / W ^ 2) - 2 / W * W + 1 = W2 / W ^ 2 - 1 := by field_simp; ring
    rw [e]
    have hcast : ((2 * n : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2 * (n:ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [hcast] at hW2l
    have hn0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    have ha : 0 < |K| + 1 := by positivity
    have hA : (|K| + 1) ^ 2 ≤ n / 2 := by linarith
    have hB : (W ^ 2) ^ 2 * (2 * n + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      have := mul_le_mul hWu hWu (by positivity) zero_le_one
      nlinarith
    have hC : (n / 2) * (8 * n + 1) ≤ (2 * (n:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have h1 : (|K| + 1) ^ 2 * (W ^ 2) ^ 2 * (8 * n + 1) ≤ W2 ^ 2 * (8 * n + 1) := by
      calc (|K| + 1) ^ 2 * (W ^ 2) ^ 2 * (8 * n + 1)
          ≤ (n / 2) * (W ^ 2) ^ 2 * (8 * n + 1) := by gcongr
        _ = (W ^ 2) ^ 2 * ((n / 2) * (8 * n + 1)) := by ring
        _ ≤ (W ^ 2) ^ 2 * (2 * n + 1) ^ 2 := by gcongr
        _ ≤ 1 := hB
        _ ≤ W2 ^ 2 * (4 * (2 * n) + 1) := hW2l
        _ = W2 ^ 2 * (8 * n + 1) := by ring
    have h2 : ((|K| + 1) * W ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ W2 ^ 2 := by
      have h8 : (0:ℝ) < 8 * n + 1 := by linarith
      have : ((|K| + 1) * W ^ 2) ^ 2 * (8 * n + 1) ≤ W2 ^ 2 * (8 * n + 1) := by
        calc ((|K| + 1) * W ^ 2) ^ 2 * (8 * n + 1) = (|K| + 1) ^ 2 * (W ^ 2) ^ 2 * (8 * n + 1) := by
              ring
          _ ≤ _ := h1
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right this h8
    have key : (|K| + 1) * W ^ 2 ≤ W2 :=
      (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (by positivity) hW2p.le two_ne_zero).mp h2
    have : |K| + 1 ≤ W2 / W ^ 2 := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hx]; exact key
    linarith [le_abs_self K]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (U : Set E) (h : ℝ → ℝ) (Q : ℝ) (al ts s c : E → ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiff ℝ ∞ h → Function.Periodic h 1 → (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, h u) = 0 → (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u) * h u) = 0 → (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, h u ^ 2) = Q → 0 ≤ Q → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ al U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ts U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ s U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c U → (∀ p ∈ U, 0 < al p) → ∃ θ : E → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : E × ℝ => θ z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) ∧ ∀ p ∈ U, (∀ φ : ℝ, θ p (φ + 1) = θ p φ + 1) ∧ (∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..1, al p * (1 + ts p ^ 2 + s p ^ 2) / (1 + (ts p + s p * ((Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * θ p φ) + c p * h (θ p φ)) / Real.sqrt (1 + c p ^ 2 * Q))) ^ 2)) = al p ∧ (∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..1, -(ts p + s p * ((Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * θ p φ) + c p * h (θ p φ)) / Real.sqrt (1 + c p ^ 2 * Q))) * (al p * (1 + ts p ^ 2 + s p ^ 2) / (1 + (ts p + s p * ((Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * θ p φ) + c p * h (θ p φ)) / Real.sqrt (1 + c p ^ 2 * Q))) ^ 2))) = -(al p * ts p)

signature.name: loop_reparam
signature.statement: ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (U : Set E) (h : ℝ → ℝ) (Q : ℝ) (al ts s c : E → ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiff ℝ ∞ h → Function.Periodic h 1 → (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, h u) = 0 → (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u) * h u) = 0 → (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, h u ^ 2) = Q → 0 ≤ Q → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ al U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ts U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ s U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c U → (∀ p ∈ U, 0 < al p) → ∃ θ : E → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : E × ℝ => θ z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) ∧ ∀ p ∈ U, (∀ φ : ℝ, θ p (φ + 1) = θ p φ + 1) ∧ (∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..1, al p * (1 + ts p ^ 2 + s p ^ 2) / (1 + (ts p + s p * ((Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * θ p φ) + c p * h (θ p φ)) / Real.sqrt (1 + c p ^ 2 * Q))) ^ 2)) = al p ∧ (∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..1, -(ts p + s p * ((Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * θ p φ) + c p * h (θ p φ)) / Real.sqrt (1 + c p ^ 2 * Q))) * (al p * (1 + ts p ^ 2 + s p ^ 2) / (1 + (ts p + s p * ((Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * θ p φ) + c p * h (θ p φ)) / Real.sqrt (1 + c p ^ 2 * Q))) ^ 2))) = -(al p * ts p)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro E _ _ _ U h Q al ts s c hU hhs hhp hh0 hhsin hQ hQ0 _hal hts hs hc _hal0
  have hhc : Continuous h := hhs.continuous
  
  have prim : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → Function.Periodic g 1 →
      ∃ G : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ G ∧ (∀ u, HasDerivAt G (g u) u) ∧
        (∀ u, G (u + 1) = G u + ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..1, g v) ∧ G 0 = 0 := by
    intro g hg hper
    have hgc : Continuous g := hg.continuous
    have hd : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun u => ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..u, g v) (g u) u :=
      fun u => (hgc.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 u).hasDerivAt
    refine ⟨fun u => ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..u, g v, ?_, hd, ?_, intervalIntegral.integral_same⟩
    · rw [contDiff_infty_iff_deriv]
      refine ⟨fun u => (hd u).differentiableAt, ?_⟩
      have e : deriv (fun u => ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..u, g v) = g := funext fun u => (hd u).deriv
      rw [e]; exact hg
    · intro u
      have := hper.intervalIntegral_add_eq_add 0 u (fun t₁ t₂ => hgc.intervalIntegrable t₁ t₂)
      rw [zero_add] at this
      exact this
  
  have h2p : (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hsin_int : (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u)) = 0 := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left Real.sin h2p, integral_sin]
    simp
  have hsin2_int : (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u) ^ 2) = 1 / 2 := by
    have e : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x) ^ 2) =
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ • ∫ x in (2 * Real.pi * 0)..(2 * Real.pi * 1), Real.sin x ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left (fun x => Real.sin x ^ 2) h2p
    rw [e, integral_sin_sq]
    simp only [mul_zero, mul_one, Real.sin_zero, Real.sin_two_pi, zero_mul, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul,
      zero_add]
    field_simp
  have hsper : ∀ u : ℝ, Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * (u + 1)) = Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u) := by
    intro u; rw [mul_add, mul_one, Real.sin_add_two_pi]
  
  obtain ⟨S1, hS1s, hS1d, hS1p, hS10⟩ := prim (fun v => Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * v)) (by fun_prop)
    (fun u => hsper u)
  obtain ⟨H1, hH1s, hH1d, hH1p, hH10⟩ := prim h hhs hhp
  obtain ⟨S2, hS2s, hS2d, hS2p, hS20⟩ := prim (fun v => Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * v) ^ 2) (by fun_prop)
    (fun u => by simp only [hsper])
  obtain ⟨M, hMs, hMd, hMp, hM0⟩ := prim (fun v => Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * v) * h v) (by fun_prop)
    (fun u => by simp only [hsper, hhp u])
  obtain ⟨H2, hH2s, hH2d, hH2p, hH20⟩ := prim (fun v => h v ^ 2) (by fun_prop)
    (fun u => by simp only [hhp u])
  beta_reduce at hS1d hS2d hMd hH2d hS1p hS2p hMp hH2p
  simp only [hsin_int, add_zero] at hS1p
  simp only [hh0, add_zero] at hH1p
  simp only [hsin2_int] at hS2p
  simp only [hhsin, add_zero] at hMp
  simp only [hQ] at hH2p
  
  have hR : ∀ p, 0 < 1 + c p ^ 2 * Q := fun p =>
    add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg one_pos (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hQ0)
  have hN : ∀ p, 0 < 1 + ts p ^ 2 + s p ^ 2 := fun p => by positivity
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ : ∃ ρ : E → ℝ, ∀ p, ρ p = Real.sqrt (1 + c p ^ 2 * Q) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hρpos : ∀ p, 0 < ρ p := fun p => by rw [hρ]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hR p)
  have hρ2 : ∀ p, ρ p ^ 2 = 1 + c p ^ 2 * Q := fun p => by rw [hρ]; exact Real.sq_sqrt (hR p).le
  have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : E → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ p u, T p u =
      ts p + s p * ((Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u) + c p * h u) / ρ p) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : E → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ p u, w p u = (1 + T p u ^ 2) / (1 + ts p ^ 2 + s p ^ 2) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hwpos : ∀ p u, 0 < w p u := fun p u => by rw [hw]; exact div_pos (by positivity) (hN p)
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩ : ∃ Ψ : E → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ p u, Ψ p u =
      ((1 + ts p ^ 2) * u + 2 * ts p * s p / ρ p * (Real.sqrt 2 * S1 u + c p * H1 u) +
        s p ^ 2 / ρ p ^ 2 * (2 * S2 u + 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * c p * M u + c p ^ 2 * H2 u)) /
        (1 + ts p ^ 2 + s p ^ 2) := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hΨd : ∀ p u, HasDerivAt (Ψ p) (w p u) u := by
    intro p u
    have e : Ψ p = fun y => ((1 + ts p ^ 2) * y + 2 * ts p * s p / ρ p * (Real.sqrt 2 * S1 y + c p * H1 y) +
        s p ^ 2 / ρ p ^ 2 * (2 * S2 y + 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * c p * M y + c p ^ 2 * H2 y)) /
        (1 + ts p ^ 2 + s p ^ 2) := funext fun y => hΨ p y
    rw [e]
    refine (((((hasDerivAt_id' u).const_mul (1 + ts p ^ 2)).add
      ((((hS1d u).const_mul (Real.sqrt 2)).add ((hH1d u).const_mul (c p))).const_mul
        (2 * ts p * s p / ρ p))).add
      (((((hS2d u).const_mul 2).add ((hMd u).const_mul (2 * Real.sqrt 2 * c p))).add
        ((hH2d u).const_mul (c p ^ 2))).const_mul (s p ^ 2 / ρ p ^ 2))).div_const
        (1 + ts p ^ 2 + s p ^ 2)).congr_deriv ?_
    rw [hw, hT]
    congr 1
    linear_combination (-(s p ^ 2 / ρ p ^ 2 * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u) ^ 2)) * hs2
  have hΨper : ∀ p u, Ψ p (u + 1) = Ψ p u + 1 := by
    intro p u
    have k1 : s p ^ 2 / ρ p ^ 2 * (2 * (1 / 2) + c p ^ 2 * Q) = s p ^ 2 := by
      rw [hρ2 p, show (2:ℝ) * (1 / 2) + c p ^ 2 * Q = 1 + c p ^ 2 * Q by ring,
        div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hR p).ne']
    calc Ψ p (u + 1) = Ψ p u + ((1 + ts p ^ 2) + s p ^ 2 / ρ p ^ 2 * (2 * (1 / 2) + c p ^ 2 * Q)) /
          (1 + ts p ^ 2 + s p ^ 2) := by
          rw [hΨ, hΨ, hS1p, hH1p, hS2p, hMp, hH2p]; ring
      _ = Ψ p u + 1 := by rw [k1, div_self (hN p).ne']
  have hΨ0 : ∀ p, Ψ p 0 = 0 := fun p => by
    rw [hΨ, hS10, hH10, hS20, hM0, hH20]; simp
  have hΨ1 : ∀ p, Ψ p 1 = 1 := fun p => by
    have := hΨper p 0; rwa [zero_add, hΨ0 p, zero_add] at this
  have hΨs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : E × ℝ => Ψ z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ univ) := by
    have e : (fun z : E × ℝ => Ψ z.1 z.2) = fun z => ((1 + ts z.1 ^ 2) * z.2 +
        2 * ts z.1 * s z.1 / ρ z.1 * (Real.sqrt 2 * S1 z.2 + c z.1 * H1 z.2) +
        s z.1 ^ 2 / ρ z.1 ^ 2 * (2 * S2 z.2 + 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * c z.1 * M z.2 + c z.1 ^ 2 * H2 z.2)) /
        (1 + ts z.1 ^ 2 + s z.1 ^ 2) := funext fun z => hΨ _ _
    rw [e]
    have hρs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ρ U := by
      rw [show ρ = fun p => Real.sqrt (1 + c p ^ 2 * Q) from funext hρ]
      exact (contDiffOn_const.add ((hc.pow 2).mul contDiffOn_const)).sqrt (fun p _ => (hR p).ne')
    have hfst : MapsTo (Prod.fst : E × ℝ → E) (U ×ˢ univ) U := fun z hz => hz.1
    have A1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : E × ℝ => ts z.1) (U ×ˢ univ) := hts.comp contDiffOn_fst hfst
    have A2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : E × ℝ => s z.1) (U ×ˢ univ) := hs.comp contDiffOn_fst hfst
    have A3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : E × ℝ => c z.1) (U ×ˢ univ) := hc.comp contDiffOn_fst hfst
    have A4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : E × ℝ => ρ z.1) (U ×ˢ univ) := hρs.comp contDiffOn_fst hfst
    have B0 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : E × ℝ => z.2) (U ×ˢ univ) := contDiffOn_snd
    have B1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : E × ℝ => S1 z.2) (U ×ˢ univ) :=
      (hS1s.comp contDiff_snd).contDiffOn
    have B2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : E × ℝ => H1 z.2) (U ×ˢ univ) :=
      (hH1s.comp contDiff_snd).contDiffOn
    have B3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : E × ℝ => S2 z.2) (U ×ˢ univ) :=
      (hS2s.comp contDiff_snd).contDiffOn
    have B4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : E × ℝ => M z.2) (U ×ˢ univ) :=
      (hMs.comp contDiff_snd).contDiffOn
    have B5 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : E × ℝ => H2 z.2) (U ×ˢ univ) :=
      (hH2s.comp contDiff_snd).contDiffOn
    exact ((((contDiffOn_const.add (A1.pow 2)).mul B0).add
      ((((contDiffOn_const.mul A1).mul A2).div A4 (fun z _ => (hρpos z.1).ne')).mul
        ((contDiffOn_const.mul B1).add (A3.mul B2)))).add
      (((A2.pow 2).div (A4.pow 2) (fun z _ => pow_ne_zero 2 (hρpos z.1).ne')).mul
        (((contDiffOn_const.mul B3).add ((contDiffOn_const.mul A3).mul B4)).add
          ((A3.pow 2).mul B5)))).div
      ((contDiffOn_const.add (A1.pow 2)).add (A2.pow 2)) (fun z _ => (hN z.1).ne')
  
  have hmono : ∀ p, StrictMono (Ψ p) := fun p => strictMono_of_hasDerivAt_pos (hΨd p) (hwpos p)
  have hsurj : ∀ p, Function.Surjective (Ψ p) := by
    intro p
    have hcont : Continuous (Ψ p) :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun u => (hΨd p u).continuousAt
    have hshift : ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : ℝ), Ψ p (u + n) = Ψ p u + n := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => intro u; simp
      | succ k ih => intro u; rw [Nat.cast_succ, ← add_assoc, hΨper, ih]; ring
    intro φ
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt |φ - Ψ p 0|
    have h1 : Ψ p (-n) = Ψ p 0 - n := by
      have := hshift n (-n); rw [neg_add_cancel] at this; linarith
    have h2 : Ψ p n = Ψ p 0 + n := by
      have := hshift n 0; rwa [zero_add] at this
    have hab := abs_lt.mp hn
    obtain ⟨u, -, hu⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (show (-(n:ℝ)) ≤ n by linarith)
      hcont.continuousOn ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    exact ⟨u, hu⟩
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ⟩ : ∃ θ : E → ℝ → ℝ, θ = fun p => Function.invFun (Ψ p) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΨθ : ∀ p φ, Ψ p (θ p φ) = φ := fun p φ => by
    rw [hθ]; exact Function.invFun_eq (hsurj p φ)
  have hθΨ : ∀ p u, θ p (Ψ p u) = u := fun p u => by
    rw [hθ]; exact Function.leftInverse_invFun (hmono p).injective u
  
  have hθs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : E × ℝ => θ z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ univ) := by

    have hk : μ ^ 7 / 8 * (P ^ 2 * (4 * m ^ 6)) = P ^ 2 * μ / 2 := by
      have : μ ^ 7 / 8 * (P ^ 2 * (4 * m ^ 6)) = P ^ 2 * μ / 2 * (μ * m) ^ 6 := by ring
      rw [this, hμm]; ring
    have h1 : μ ^ 7 / 8 * (P * c - v) ^ 2 ≤ μ ^ 7 / 8 * (P ^ 2 * (4 * m ^ 6)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_trans hRle hPc2) hκ0.le
    have k1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hG (sq_nonneg P)
    have k2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcv hP0
    have k3 := mul_nonneg hP0 (sub_nonneg.2 hPμ)
    have k4 := sq_nonneg v
    rw [hq]
    linarith
  have hvi : 1 + t ^ 2 ≤ (P * c - v) ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : (46 * m ^ 5) ^ 2 ≤ (P * c - v) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) hR 2
    have e : (46 * m ^ 5) ^ 2 = 2116 * m ^ 10 := by ring
    linarith
  
  have E1 : s * p1 - t * (s * (w * p1)) = P * c := by rw [hP, hc]; ring
  have E2 : s * (w * p1) + t * (s * p1) = P * j := by rw [hP, hj]; ring
  have E3 : F * (s * p1 - a) - t * (F * (s * (w * p1) + t * a)) = F * (P * c - v) := by
    rw [hP, hc, hv]; ring
  have E4 : F * (s * (w * p1) + t * a) + t * (F * (s * p1 - a)) = F * (P * j) := by
    rw [hP, hj]; ring
  have Rot : (F * (s * p1 - a) - t * (F * (s * (w * p1) + t * a))) ^ 2
      + (F * (s * (w * p1) + t * a) + t * (F * (s * p1 - a))) ^ 2
      = (1 + t ^ 2) * ((F * (s * p1 - a)) ^ 2 + (F * (s * (w * p1) + t * a)) ^ 2) := by ring
  rw [E3, E4] at Rot
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : ℝ, N = (F * (s * p1 - a)) ^ 2 + (F * (s * (w * p1) + t * a)) ^ 2 :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hN] at Rot
  have hN0 : 0 ≤ N := by rw [hN]; positivity
  rw [E1, E2, E3, E4, ← hv, ← hN]
  have hFN : F ^ 2 ≤ N := by
    have h1 : (1 + t ^ 2) * F ^ 2 ≤ (1 + t ^ 2) * N := by
      rw [← Rot]
      have k1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hvi (sq_nonneg F)
      have k2 := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg F) (sq_nonneg (P * j))
      have e : (F * (P * c - v)) ^ 2 + (F * (P * j)) ^ 2
          = F ^ 2 * (P * c - v) ^ 2 + F ^ 2 * (P * j) ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [e]
      linarith
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h1 (by positivity)
  refine ⟨by linarith, hii, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := hcone (P * c) (P * j) (v + μ ^ 7 / 8) (by linarith)
      (by linarith [sq_nonneg (P * j)]) hiv
    linarith
  · rw [one_mul]
    exact (Real.le_sqrt hF.le hN0).2 hFN
  · intro hadm
    refine ⟨by linarith, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hK1 : μ * (P * j) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (P * c - v) ^ 2 := by
        have k1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hadm (sq_nonneg (P * j))
        have k2 := mul_nonneg hκ0.le (sq_nonneg (P * c - v))
        linarith
      have hk2 : (μ ^ 7 / 8) ^ 2 * ((P * c - v) ^ 2 + (P * j) ^ 2) ≤ (P * c - v) ^ 2 := by
        have h1 : μ ^ 13 * (μ * (P * j) ^ 2) ≤ μ ^ 13 * (2 * (P * c - v) ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hK1 hμ13p.le
        have h2 : μ ^ 13 * (P * c - v) ^ 2 ≤ (P * c - v) ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg _) hμ13
        have h3 : μ ^ 14 * (P * c - v) ^ 2 ≤ (P * c - v) ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg _) hμ14
        have e1 : (μ ^ 7 / 8) ^ 2 * ((P * c - v) ^ 2 + (P * j) ^ 2)
            = μ ^ 14 * (P * c - v) ^ 2 / 64 + μ ^ 13 * (μ * (P * j) ^ 2) / 64 := by ring
        have h4 := sq_nonneg (P * c - v)
        rw [e1]
        linarith
      have hk3 : (μ ^ 7 / 8) ^ 2 * N ≤ (F * (P * c - v)) ^ 2 := by
        have h1 : (μ ^ 7 / 8) ^ 2 * N ≤ (μ ^ 7 / 8) ^ 2 * ((1 + t ^ 2) * N) := by
          have k := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (μ ^ 7 / 8)) (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg t) hN0)
          have e : (μ ^ 7 / 8) ^ 2 * ((1 + t ^ 2) * N)
              = (μ ^ 7 / 8) ^ 2 * N + (μ ^ 7 / 8) ^ 2 * (t ^ 2 * N) := by ring
          rw [e]
          linarith
        rw [← Rot] at h1
        have h2 : F ^ 2 * ((μ ^ 7 / 8) ^ 2 * ((P * c - v) ^ 2 + (P * j) ^ 2))
            ≤ F ^ 2 * (P * c - v) ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk2 (sq_nonneg F)
        have e1 : (μ ^ 7 / 8) ^ 2 * ((F * (P * c - v)) ^ 2 + (F * (P * j)) ^ 2)
            = F ^ 2 * ((μ ^ 7 / 8) ^ 2 * ((P * c - v) ^ 2 + (P * j) ^ 2)) := by ring
        have e2 : (F * (P * c - v)) ^ 2 = F ^ 2 * (P * c - v) ^ 2 := by ring
        rw [e1] at h1
        rw [e2]
        linarith
      have hL0 : 0 ≤ μ ^ 7 / 8 * Real.sqrt N := mul_nonneg hκ0.le (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      have hR0' : 0 ≤ F * (P * c - v) := mul_nonneg hF.le hR0
      rw [← pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ hL0 hR0' two_ne_zero, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hN0]
      exact hk3
    · have k := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv5 (sq_nonneg F)
      have e1 : (v - 2) * (F * (P * j)) ^ 2 = F ^ 2 * ((v - 2) * (P * j) ^ 2) := by ring
      have e2 : (2 - μ ^ 7 / 8) * (F * (P * c - v)) ^ 2
          = F ^ 2 * (2 * (P * c - v) ^ 2) - F ^ 2 * (μ ^ 7 / 8 * (P * c - v) ^ 2) := by ring
      have e3 : F ^ 2 * (2 * (P * c - v) ^ 2 - (v - 2) * (P * j) ^ 2)
          = F ^ 2 * (2 * (P * c - v) ^ 2) - F ^ 2 * ((v - 2) * (P * j) ^ 2) := by ring
      rw [e1, e2]
      rw [e3] at k
      linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h lam Pst ρ cp ci xg xg2 r1 r2 p1 p2 m1 m2 xv xb eps μ XR : ℝ) (c ϑ : ℝ → ℝ) (F U Fo Uo : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 < ci → 0 < xb → 0 ≤ ρ → ρ < 1 → 1 ≤ XR → xv < xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) → (0 < r1 ∧ 0 < p1 ∧ 0 < m1) → NormBase h lam Pst cp xg xg2 r1 r2 p1 p2 m1 m2 xv xb eps μ c ϑ F U → (∀ x η : ℝ, xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) ≤ x → -1 < η → η < 1 → Real.sqrt (2 * x) * F x η = ci * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) * XR⁻¹ / x) * tailFac ρ xb x) → MomTot h ci F U → (∀ X η : ℝ, Fo X η = Real.sqrt XR⁻¹ * F (XR⁻¹ * X) η) → (∀ X η : ℝ, Uo X η = U (XR⁻¹ * X) η) → (∀ X₀ X₁ : ℝ, 0 < X₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₀ ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Fo) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Uo) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ XR → -1 < η → η < 1 → Uo X η = 4 * η ∧ Fo X η = refFin Pst XR X η) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, ((XR * r1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ XR * r2) ∨ (XR * p1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ XR * p2) ∨ (XR * m1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ XR * m2)) → -1 < η → η < 1 → Uo X η = 0 ∧ Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Fo X η = cp * XR ^ (1 / 2 + lam) * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam))) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, XR * xv ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → Uo X η = 0 ∧ profRadInt Uo X η = 0) ∧ (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → leadPi Fo 0 η = shapeDatum c ϑ η) ∧ TailForm h (ci * XR ^ (1 / 2 + h)) ρ (XR * xb) Fo Uo ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, XR * xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) ≤ X → X < XR * xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Fo X η ≤ eps) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => Fo x e) η| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧ |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => Uo x e) η| ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → shearA Fo X η = shearA F (XR⁻¹ * X) η ∧ shearB Fo Uo X η = shearB F U (XR⁻¹ * X) η ∧ psLead1 h Fo Uo X η = XR * psLead1 h F U (XR⁻¹ * X) η ∧ psLead2 h Fo Uo X η = XR * psLead2 h F U (XR⁻¹ * X) η)
