signature.statement: ∀ (h lam Pst ρ cp ci xg xg2 r1 r2 p1 p2 m1 m2 xv xb eps μ XR : ℝ) (c ϑ : ℝ → ℝ) (F U Fo Uo : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 < ci → 0 < xb → 0 ≤ ρ → ρ < 1 → 1 ≤ XR → xv < xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) → (0 < r1 ∧ 0 < p1 ∧ 0 < m1) → NormBase h lam Pst cp xg xg2 r1 r2 p1 p2 m1 m2 xv xb eps μ c ϑ F U → (∀ x η : ℝ, xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) ≤ x → -1 < η → η < 1 → Real.sqrt (2 * x) * F x η = ci * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) * XR⁻¹ / x) * tailFac ρ xb x) → MomTot h ci F U → (∀ X η : ℝ, Fo X η = Real.sqrt XR⁻¹ * F (XR⁻¹ * X) η) → (∀ X η : ℝ, Uo X η = U (XR⁻¹ * X) η) → (∀ X₀ X₁ : ℝ, 0 < X₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₀ ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Fo) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Uo) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ XR → -1 < η → η < 1 → Uo X η = 4 * η ∧ Fo X η = refFin Pst XR X η) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, ((XR * r1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ XR * r2) ∨ (XR * p1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ XR * p2) ∨ (XR * m1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ XR * m2)) → -1 < η → η < 1 → Uo X η = 0 ∧ Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Fo X η = cp * XR ^ (1 / 2 + lam) * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam))) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, XR * xv ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → Uo X η = 0 ∧ profRadInt Uo X η = 0) ∧ (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → leadPi Fo 0 η = shapeDatum c ϑ η) ∧ TailForm h (ci * XR ^ (1 / 2 + h)) ρ (XR * xb) Fo Uo ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, XR * xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) ≤ X → X < XR * xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Fo X η ≤ eps) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => Fo x e) η| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧ |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => Uo x e) η| ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → shearA Fo X η = shearA F (XR⁻¹ * X) η ∧ shearB Fo Uo X η = shearB F U (XR⁻¹ * X) η ∧ psLead1 h Fo Uo X η = XR * psLead1 h F U (XR⁻¹ * X) η ∧ psLead2 h Fo Uo X η = XR * psLead2 h F U (XR⁻¹ * X) η)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h lam Pst ρ cp ci xg xg2 r1 r2 p1 p2 m1 m2 xv xb eps μ XR c ϑ F U Fo Uo hh0 hh1 hci hxb hρ0 hρ1
    hXR1 hxv hpos1 hNB htail hMom hFo hUo
  obtain ⟨hFs, hUs, hFpos, hcomp, hinner, hpatch, hxvz, hPi0, hcol, hwt, -, -⟩ := hNB
  obtain ⟨hr1, hp1, hm1⟩ := hpos1
  have hXR0 : 0 < XR := by linarith
  have hXRne : XR ≠ 0 := hXR0.ne'
  have he : 0 < XR⁻¹ := inv_pos.2 hXR0
  have he1 : XR⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hXR1
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt XR⁻¹ := Real.sqrt_pos.2 he
  have hs1 : Real.sqrt XR⁻¹ ≤ 1 := Real.sqrt_le_one.2 he1
  have hss : Real.sqrt XR⁻¹ * Real.sqrt XR⁻¹ = XR⁻¹ := Real.mul_self_sqrt he.le
  have hinv : (Real.sqrt XR⁻¹)⁻¹ * XR⁻¹ = Real.sqrt XR⁻¹ := by
    rw [inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul₀ hs.ne']; exact hss.symm
  have hinv1 : (Real.sqrt XR⁻¹)⁻¹ * Real.sqrt XR⁻¹ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hs.ne'
  have hXy : ∀ X : ℝ, XR * (XR⁻¹ * X) = X := fun X => mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hXRne X
  have SQ : ∀ X : ℝ, Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Real.sqrt XR⁻¹ = Real.sqrt (2 * (XR⁻¹ * X)) := by
    intro X; rw [← Real.sqrt_mul' _ he.le]; ring_nf
  have RP : ∀ a X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → (XR⁻¹ * X) ^ (-a) = XR ^ a * X ^ (-a) := by
    intro a X hX
    rw [Real.mul_rpow he.le hX, Real.inv_rpow hXR0.le, Real.rpow_neg hXR0.le, inv_inv]
  have PT : ∀ X η : ℝ, Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Fo X η =
      Real.sqrt (2 * (XR⁻¹ * X)) * F (XR⁻¹ * X) η := by
    intro X η; rw [hFo, ← mul_assoc, SQ]
  
  have S1 : ∀ (c : ℝ) (G Go : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      (∀ X η : ℝ, Go X η = c * G (XR⁻¹ * X) η) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Go) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Go) (X, η)‖ ≤ |c| * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿G) (XR⁻¹ * X, η)‖ := by
    intro c G Go hG hGo
    have hΩo : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
    let L : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ :=
      (XR⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)
    have hL : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, L p = (XR⁻¹ * p.1, p.2) := fun p => rfl
    have hpre : L ⁻¹' (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) = Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := by
      ext ⟨X, η⟩
      simp only [mem_preimage, hL, mem_prod, mem_Ioi, mem_Ioo]
      rw [mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left he]
    have hfun : (↿Go) = c • ((↿G) ∘ L) := by
      funext ⟨X, η⟩
      simp [Function.HasUncurry.uncurry, hGo, hL]
    have hcomp' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((↿G) ∘ L) (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
      refine hG.comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn ?_
      intro p hp; rw [← hpre] at hp; exact hp
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hfun]; exact hcomp'.const_smul c
    · intro m X η hX h1 h2
      have hp : (X, η) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨hX, h1, h2⟩
      have hLp : L (X, η) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := by
        rw [← mem_preimage, hpre]; exact hp
      have hu : UniqueDiffOn ℝ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := hΩo.uniqueDiffOn
      have hm : ((m : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
      rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hΩo hp, hfun,
        iteratedFDerivWithin_const_smul_apply ((hcomp'.contDiffWithinAt hp).of_le hm) hu hp]
      have key := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L hG hu
        (by rw [hpre]; exact hu) hLp (i := m) hm
      rw [hpre] at key
      rw [key, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hΩo hLp, hL, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (abs_nonneg c)
      have hLn : ‖L‖ ≤ 1 := by
        refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound L zero_le_one ?_
        intro v
        rw [hL, one_mul, Prod.norm_def, Prod.norm_def]
        refine max_le_max ?_ le_rfl
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos he]
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) he1
      refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
      refine mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) ?_
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hLn
  
  have H1 : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (X : ℝ),
      ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, g (XR⁻¹ * x) = XR * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..(XR⁻¹ * X), g x := by
    intro g X
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left g he.ne', mul_zero, inv_inv, smul_eq_mul]
  have H2 : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (X : ℝ),
      ∫ x in Ioi X, g (XR⁻¹ * x) = XR * ∫ x in Ioi (XR⁻¹ * X), g x := by
    intro g X
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_comp_mul_left_Ioi g X he, inv_inv, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have A1 : ∀ x η : ℝ, 2 * x * Fo x η =
      (Real.sqrt XR⁻¹)⁻¹ * (2 * (XR⁻¹ * x) * F (XR⁻¹ * x) η) := by
    intro x η; rw [hFo]; linear_combination (-(2 * x * F (XR⁻¹ * x) η)) * hinv
  have A2 : ∀ x η : ℝ, Uo x η * (2 * x * Fo x η) =
      (Real.sqrt XR⁻¹)⁻¹ * (U (XR⁻¹ * x) η * (2 * (XR⁻¹ * x) * F (XR⁻¹ * x) η)) := by
    intro x η; rw [hUo, A1]; ring
  have A3 : ∀ x η : ℝ, Uo x η ^ 2 - x * Fo x η ^ 2 =
      U (XR⁻¹ * x) η ^ 2 - (XR⁻¹ * x) * F (XR⁻¹ * x) η ^ 2 := by
    intro x η; rw [hUo, hFo]; linear_combination (-(x * F (XR⁻¹ * x) η ^ 2)) * hss
  have A4 : ∀ x η : ℝ, Fo x η ^ 2 = XR⁻¹ * F (XR⁻¹ * x) η ^ 2 := by
    intro x η; rw [hFo]; linear_combination (F (XR⁻¹ * x) η ^ 2) * hss
  
  have PR : ∀ (φ ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℝ), (∀ x η : ℝ, φ x η = k * ψ (XR⁻¹ * x) η) →
      ∀ X η : ℝ, profRadInt φ X η = k * XR * profRadInt ψ (XR⁻¹ * X) η := by
    intro φ ψ k hφ X η
    unfold profRadInt
    have h1 := H1 (fun y => ψ y η) X
    simp_rw [hφ]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, h1]; ring
  have PD : ∀ (φ ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (c X y : ℝ), (∀ η : ℝ, φ X η = c * ψ y η) →
      ∀ η : ℝ, profEtaD φ X η = c * profEtaD ψ y η := by
    intro φ ψ c X y hφ η
    unfold profEtaD
    have : (fun e => φ X e) = fun e => c * ψ y e := funext hφ
    rw [this, deriv_const_mul_field']
  have PRI : ∀ X η : ℝ, profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * Fo x e) X η =
      (Real.sqrt XR⁻¹)⁻¹ * XR * profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) (XR⁻¹ * X) η :=
    PR _ _ _ (fun x η => A1 x η)
  have PRJ : ∀ X η : ℝ, profRadInt (fun x e => Uo x e * (2 * x * Fo x e)) X η =
      (Real.sqrt XR⁻¹)⁻¹ * XR * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) (XR⁻¹ * X) η :=
    PR _ _ _ (fun x η => A2 x η)
  have PRS : ∀ X η : ℝ, profRadInt (fun x e => Uo x e ^ 2 - x * Fo x e ^ 2) X η =
      1 * XR * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) (XR⁻¹ * X) η :=
    PR _ _ _ (fun x η => by rw [one_mul]; exact A3 x η)
  have PRU : ∀ X η : ℝ, profRadInt Uo X η = 1 * XR * profRadInt U (XR⁻¹ * X) η :=
    PR _ _ _ (fun x η => by rw [one_mul]; exact hUo x η)
  have LP : ∀ X η : ℝ, leadPi Fo X η = leadPi F (XR⁻¹ * X) η := by
    intro X η
    unfold leadPi
    have h2 := H2 (fun y => F y η ^ 2) X
    simp_rw [A4]
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, h2, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hXRne]
  have PDL : ∀ X η : ℝ, profEtaD (leadPi Fo) X η = profEtaD (leadPi F) (XR⁻¹ * X) η := by
    intro X η
    unfold profEtaD
    rw [show (fun e => leadPi Fo X e) = fun e => leadPi F (XR⁻¹ * X) e from
      funext fun e => LP X e]
  have PA : ∀ X η : ℝ, profRadAvg Uo X η = profRadAvg U (XR⁻¹ * X) η := by
    intro X η
    unfold profRadAvg
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun t _ => ?_)
    show Uo (t * X) η = U (t * (XR⁻¹ * X)) η
    rw [hUo, mul_left_comm]
  have LW : ∀ X η : ℝ, leadW h Uo X η = leadW h U (XR⁻¹ * X) η := by
    intro X η
    unfold leadW
    have : profEtaD (profRadAvg Uo) X η = profEtaD (profRadAvg U) (XR⁻¹ * X) η := by
      unfold profEtaD
      rw [show (fun e => profRadAvg Uo X e) = fun e => profRadAvg U (XR⁻¹ * X) e from
        funext fun e => PA X e]
    rw [PA X η, this]
  have hk : (Real.sqrt XR⁻¹)⁻¹ * XR ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero hs.ne') hXRne
  have keyQ : ∀ (L E N Den D k : ℝ), k ≠ 0 → Den = k * D → E = k * N →
      L + E / Den = L + N / D := by
    intro L E N Den D k hk h1 h2; rw [h1, h2, mul_div_mul_left _ _ hk]
  have LQ : ∀ X η : ℝ, leadQs h Fo Uo X η = leadQs h F U (XR⁻¹ * X) η := by
    intro X η
    unfold leadQs
    rw [LW X η, PRI X η, PRJ X η,
      PD _ _ _ X (XR⁻¹ * X) (fun η' => PRI X η') η, PD _ _ _ X (XR⁻¹ * X) (fun η' => PRJ X η') η]
    refine keyQ _ _ _ _ _ _ hk ?_ ?_
    · rw [A1 X η]
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, XR⁻¹ * X = y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hX : X = XR * y := by rw [← hy, hXy]
      rw [hy, hX]; ring
    · ring
  have keyN : ∀ (L E N Xd D R M P : ℝ), R ≠ 0 → Xd = R * D → E = R * N →
      L + E / Xd + M - P = L + N / D + M - P := by
    intro L E N Xd D R M P hR h1 h2; rw [h1, h2, mul_div_mul_left _ _ hR]
  have LN : ∀ X η : ℝ, leadNs h Fo Uo X η = leadNs h F U (XR⁻¹ * X) η := by
    intro X η
    unfold leadNs
    rw [LW X η, hUo X η, PRU X η, PRS X η, LP X η, PDL X η,
      PD _ _ _ X (XR⁻¹ * X) (fun η' => PRU X η') η, PD _ _ _ X (XR⁻¹ * X) (fun η' => PRS X η') η]
    refine keyN _ _ _ _ _ XR _ _ hXRne (hXy X).symm ?_
    ring
  
  have DF : ∀ X η : ℝ, deriv (fun Y => Fo Y η) X =
      Real.sqrt XR⁻¹ * (XR⁻¹ * deriv (fun Y => F Y η) (XR⁻¹ * X)) := by
    intro X η
    have e1 : (fun Y => Fo Y η) = fun Y => Real.sqrt XR⁻¹ * F (XR⁻¹ * Y) η :=
      funext fun Y => hFo Y η
    rw [e1, deriv_const_mul_field']
    show Real.sqrt XR⁻¹ * deriv (fun Y => F (XR⁻¹ * Y) η) X = _
    rw [deriv_comp_mul_left XR⁻¹ (fun Z => F Z η) X, smul_eq_mul]
  have DU : ∀ X η : ℝ, deriv (fun Y => Uo Y η) X = XR⁻¹ * deriv (fun Y => U Y η) (XR⁻¹ * X) := by
    intro X η
    have e1 : (fun Y => Uo Y η) = fun Y => U (XR⁻¹ * Y) η := funext fun Y => hUo Y η
    rw [e1, deriv_comp_mul_left XR⁻¹ (fun Z => U Z η) X, smul_eq_mul]
  have keyD : ∀ (A B N D k : ℝ), k ≠ 0 → A = k * N → B = k * D → A / B = N / D := by
    intro A B N D k hk h1 h2; rw [h1, h2, mul_div_mul_left _ _ hk]
  have S7 : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → shearA Fo X η = shearA F (XR⁻¹ * X) η ∧
      shearB Fo Uo X η = shearB F U (XR⁻¹ * X) η ∧
      psLead1 h Fo Uo X η = XR * psLead1 h F U (XR⁻¹ * X) η ∧
      psLead2 h Fo Uo X η = XR * psLead2 h F U (XR⁻¹ * X) η := by
    intro X η _
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold shearA
      rw [DF X η, hFo X η]
      refine keyD _ _ _ _ _ hs.ne' ?_ rfl
      ring
    · unfold shearB
      rw [DU X η, hFo X η, ← SQ X]
      refine keyD _ _ _ _ _ hs.ne' ?_ rfl
      linear_combination (-(Real.sqrt (2 * X) * deriv (fun Y => U Y η) (XR⁻¹ * X))) * hss
    · unfold psLead1
      rw [LQ X η]
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, XR⁻¹ * X = y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hX : X = XR * y := by rw [← hy, hXy]
      rw [hy, hX]; ring
    · unfold psLead2
      rw [LN X η, hFo X η, ← mul_assoc (Real.sqrt (2 * X)), SQ X]
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, XR⁻¹ * X = y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hX : X = XR * y := by rw [← hy, hXy]
      rw [hy, hX]; ring
  
  have S5 : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => Fo x e) η| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧
      |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => Uo x e) η| ≤ C := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hwt m
    have hC0 : 0 ≤ max C 0 := le_max_right _ _
    have hXX : 1 ≤ XR * XR := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hXR1 hXR1
    refine ⟨max C 0 * (XR * XR), fun x η hx h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    have hy : 0 < XR⁻¹ * x := mul_pos he hx
    obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := hC (XR⁻¹ * x) η hy h1 h2
    have eF : (fun e => Fo x e) = fun e => Real.sqrt XR⁻¹ * F (XR⁻¹ * x) e :=
      funext fun e => hFo x e
    have eU : (fun e => Uo x e) = fun e => U (XR⁻¹ * x) e := funext fun e => hUo x e
    rw [eF, eU, iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hs]
    have hA : 0 ≤ (XR⁻¹ * x) ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hy.le _
    have hB : 0 ≤ (1 + XR⁻¹ * x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    have hP1 : (XR⁻¹ * x) ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) ≤ XR * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) := by
      rw [RP _ _ hx.le]
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Real.rpow_nonneg hx.le _)
      calc XR ^ (2 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ XR ^ (1 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hXR1 (by norm_num)
        _ = XR := Real.rpow_one XR
    have hP2 : (1 + XR⁻¹ * x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ≤ XR * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) := by
      have hl : XR⁻¹ * (1 + x) ≤ 1 + XR⁻¹ * x := by rw [mul_add, mul_one]; linarith
      calc (1 + XR⁻¹ * x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ≤ (XR⁻¹ * (1 + x)) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (mul_pos he (by linarith)) hl (by linarith)
        _ = XR ^ (3 / 5 + h) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) := RP _ _ (by linarith)
        _ ≤ XR * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
            calc XR ^ (3 / 5 + h) ≤ XR ^ (1 : ℝ) :=
                  Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hXR1 (by linarith)
              _ = XR := Real.rpow_one XR
    constructor
    · calc Real.sqrt XR⁻¹ * |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => F (XR⁻¹ * x) e) η|
          ≤ 1 * |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => F (XR⁻¹ * x) e) η| :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs1 (abs_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ C * (XR⁻¹ * x) ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + XR⁻¹ * x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) := by
            rw [one_mul]; exact b1
        _ ≤ max C 0 * (XR⁻¹ * x) ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + XR⁻¹ * x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hA) hB
        _ ≤ max C 0 * (XR * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ))) * (XR * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h))) :=
            mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP1 hC0) hP2 hB
              (mul_nonneg hC0 (mul_nonneg hXR0.le (Real.rpow_nonneg hx.le _)))
        _ = max C 0 * (XR * XR) * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) := by ring
    · calc |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => U (XR⁻¹ * x) e) η| ≤ C := b2
        _ ≤ max C 0 := le_max_left _ _
        _ ≤ max C 0 * (XR * XR) := le_mul_of_one_le_right hC0 hXX
  
  have INT : ∀ (g φ : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℝ), IntegrableOn g (Ioi 0) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → φ x = k * g (XR⁻¹ * x)) → IntegrableOn φ (Ioi 0) := by
    intro g φ k hg hφ
    have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun x => g (XR⁻¹ * x)) (Ioi 0) :=
      (integrableOn_Ioi_comp_mul_left_iff g 0 he).2 (by rw [mul_zero]; exact hg)
    have h2 : IntegrableOn (fun x => k * g (XR⁻¹ * x)) (Ioi 0) :=
      MeasureTheory.Integrable.const_mul h1 k
    exact h2.congr_fun (fun x hx => (hφ x hx).symm) measurableSet_Ioi
  have TOT : ∀ (g φ : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℝ), (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), g x) = 0 →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → φ x = k * g (XR⁻¹ * x)) → (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), φ x) = 0 := by
    intro g φ k hg hφ
    rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun x hx => hφ x hx),
      MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, H2 g 0, mul_zero, hg]
    ring
  have II : ∀ (g φ : ℝ → ℝ) (k X : ℝ), 0 ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 (XR⁻¹ * X) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, φ x = k * g (XR⁻¹ * x)) → IntervalIntegrable φ volume 0 X := by
    intro g φ k X hX hg hφ
    have h1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => g (XR⁻¹ * x)) volume 0 X := by
      have := (IntervalIntegrable.comp_mul_left_iff (f := g) (a := 0) (b := XR⁻¹ * X) he.ne').2 hg
      rwa [zero_div, mul_div_cancel_left₀ X he.ne'] at this
    have h2 := h1.const_mul k
    have : φ = fun x => k * g (XR⁻¹ * x) := funext hφ
    rw [this]; exact h2
  have hMT : MomTot h (ci * XR ^ (1 / 2 + h)) Fo Uo := by
    intro η h1 h2
    obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3, i4, t1, t2, t3, ii⟩ := hMom η h1 h2
    have P3 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 2 * x * Fo x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * (ci * XR ^ (1 / 2 + h)) *
        x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) = (Real.sqrt XR⁻¹)⁻¹ *
        ((fun y => 2 * y * F y η - Real.sqrt (2 * y) * ci * y ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) (XR⁻¹ * x)) := by
      intro x hx
      show _ = (Real.sqrt XR⁻¹)⁻¹ * (2 * (XR⁻¹ * x) * F (XR⁻¹ * x) η -
        Real.sqrt (2 * (XR⁻¹ * x)) * ci * (XR⁻¹ * x) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))
      rw [hFo, ← SQ x, RP _ _ hx.le]
      linear_combination (-(2 * x * F (XR⁻¹ * x) η)) * hinv +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * ci * XR ^ (1 / 2 + h) * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) * hinv1
    refine ⟨INT _ _ _ i1 (fun x _ => A2 x η), INT _ _ 1 i2 (fun x _ => by rw [one_mul]; exact A3 x η),
      INT _ _ _ i3 P3, INT _ _ _ i4 (fun x _ => A4 x η), TOT _ _ _ t1 (fun x _ => A2 x η),
      TOT _ _ 1 t2 (fun x _ => by rw [one_mul]; exact A3 x η), TOT _ _ _ t3 P3, fun X hX => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨j1, j2, j3, j4, j5⟩ := ii (XR⁻¹ * X) (mul_nonneg he.le hX)
    exact ⟨II _ _ 1 X hX j1 (fun x => by rw [one_mul]; exact hUo x η),
      II _ _ _ X hX j2 (fun x => A1 x η), II _ _ _ X hX j3 (fun x => A2 x η),
      II _ _ 1 X hX j4 (fun x => by rw [one_mul]; exact A3 x η), II _ _ _ X hX j5 (fun x => A4 x η)⟩
  
  obtain ⟨S1F, S1Fb⟩ := S1 (Real.sqrt XR⁻¹) F Fo hFs hFo
  obtain ⟨S1U, S1Ub⟩ := S1 1 U Uo hUs (fun X η => by rw [hUo, one_mul])
  have tr1 : ∀ a X : ℝ, XR * a ≤ X → a ≤ XR⁻¹ * X := fun a X hX => (le_inv_mul_iff₀ hXR0).2 hX
  have tr2 : ∀ a X : ℝ, X ≤ XR * a → XR⁻¹ * X ≤ a := fun a X hX => (inv_mul_le_iff₀ hXR0).2 hX
  have tr3 : ∀ a X : ℝ, X < XR * a → XR⁻¹ * X < a := fun a X hX => (inv_mul_lt_iff₀ hXR0).2 hX
  have TU : ∀ X η : ℝ, XR * xv ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → Uo X η = 0 ∧ profRadInt Uo X η = 0 := by
    intro X η hX h1 h2
    obtain ⟨u1, u2⟩ := hxvz (XR⁻¹ * X) η (tr1 _ _ hX) h1 h2
    exact ⟨by rw [hUo, u1], by rw [PRU, u2, mul_zero]⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, TU, ?_, ?_, ?_, S5, S7⟩
  · intro X₀ X₁ hX₀ m
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hcomp (XR⁻¹ * X₀) (XR⁻¹ * X₁) (mul_pos he hX₀) m
    refine ⟨max C 0, fun X η hX0 hX1 h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    have hX : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hX₀ hX0
    obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := hC (XR⁻¹ * X) η (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hX0 he.le)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hX1 he.le) h1 h2
    constructor
    · refine (S1Fb m X η hX h1 h2).trans ?_
      rw [abs_of_pos hs]
      calc Real.sqrt XR⁻¹ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (XR⁻¹ * X, η)‖
          ≤ 1 * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (XR⁻¹ * X, η)‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs1 (norm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ max C 0 := by rw [one_mul]; exact c1.trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · refine (S1Ub m X η hX h1 h2).trans ?_
      rw [abs_one, one_mul]; exact c2.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  · intro X η hX hXR h1 h2
    have hy : 0 < XR⁻¹ * X := mul_pos he hX
    obtain ⟨u1, f1⟩ := hinner (XR⁻¹ * X) η hy ((inv_mul_le_one₀ hXR0).2 hXR) h1 h2
    refine ⟨by rw [hUo, u1], ?_⟩
    have hsX : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * X) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by linarith)
    rw [hFo, f1]
    unfold refFin
    rw [div_one, ← SQ X, div_eq_inv_mul X XR]
    field_simp
  · intro X η hX h1 h2
    have hcase : (r1 ≤ XR⁻¹ * X ∧ XR⁻¹ * X ≤ r2) ∨ (p1 ≤ XR⁻¹ * X ∧ XR⁻¹ * X ≤ p2) ∨
        (m1 ≤ XR⁻¹ * X ∧ XR⁻¹ * X ≤ m2) := by
      rcases hX with ⟨a, b⟩ | ⟨a, b⟩ | ⟨a, b⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨tr1 _ _ a, tr2 _ _ b⟩
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨tr1 _ _ a, tr2 _ _ b⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨tr1 _ _ a, tr2 _ _ b⟩)
    have hX0 : 0 ≤ X := by
      rcases hX with ⟨a, _⟩ | ⟨a, _⟩ | ⟨a, _⟩ <;>
        linarith [mul_pos hXR0 hr1, mul_pos hXR0 hp1, mul_pos hXR0 hm1]
    obtain ⟨u1, f1⟩ := hpatch (XR⁻¹ * X) η hcase h1 h2
    refine ⟨by rw [hUo, u1], ?_⟩
    rw [PT, f1, RP _ _ hX0]; ring
  · intro η h1 h2
    rw [LP 0 η, mul_zero]; exact hPi0 η h1 h2
  · unfold TailForm
    refine ⟨hh0, hh1, mul_pos hci (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hXR0 _), mul_pos hXR0 hxb, hρ0, hρ1, S1F, S1U,
      ?_, ?_, hMT⟩
    · intro X η hX h1 h2
      rw [hFo]; exact mul_pos hs (hFpos _ η (mul_pos he hX) h1 h2)
    · intro X η hX h1 h2
      have hXt : xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) ≤ XR⁻¹ * X := tr1 _ _ (by rw [← mul_assoc]; exact hX)
      have hX0 : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos (mul_pos hXR0 hxb) (Real.exp_pos _)) hX
      have hv : XR * xv ≤ X := by
        have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hxv hXR0
        rw [← mul_assoc] at this
        linarith
      obtain ⟨u1, u2⟩ := TU X η hv h1 h2
      refine ⟨u1, u2, ?_⟩
      have harg : 2 * (1 - η ^ 2) * XR⁻¹ / (XR⁻¹ * X) = 2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X := by
        rw [mul_comm XR⁻¹ X, mul_div_mul_right _ _ (inv_ne_zero hXRne)]
      have htf : tailFac ρ xb (XR⁻¹ * X) = tailFac ρ (XR * xb) X := by
        unfold tailFac
        rw [show XR⁻¹ * X / xb = X / (XR * xb) by field_simp]
      rw [PT, htail _ η hXt h1 h2, RP _ _ hX0.le, harg, htf]; ring
  · intro X η hX1 hX2 h1 h2
    rw [PT]
    exact hcol _ η (tr1 _ _ (by rw [← mul_assoc]; exact hX1)) (tr3 _ _ hX2) h1 h2

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (T1 T2 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (Ω S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen Ω → S ⊆ Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿T1) Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿T2) Ω → ∀ c0 : ℝ, 0 < c0 → (∀ z ∈ S, c0 ≤ Real.sqrt (T1 z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + T2 z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿T1) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿T2) z‖ ≤ C) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => T1 z.1 z.2 / Real.sqrt (T1 z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + T2 z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => T2 z.1 z.2 / Real.sqrt (T1 z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + T2 z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) z‖ ≤ C

signature.name: unit_dir_bounds
signature.statement: ∀ (T1 T2 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (Ω S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen Ω → S ⊆ Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿T1) Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿T2) Ω → ∀ c0 : ℝ, 0 < c0 → (∀ z ∈ S, c0 ≤ Real.sqrt (T1 z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + T2 z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿T1) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿T2) z‖ ≤ C) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => T1 z.1 z.2 / Real.sqrt (T1 z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + T2 z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => T2 z.1 z.2 / Real.sqrt (T1 z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + T2 z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) z‖ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro T1 T2 Ω S hΩ hSΩ hT1 hT2 c0 hc0 hlow hbd
  
  have hprod : ∀ (O : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (u v : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen O → S ⊆ O →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v O →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k u z‖ ≤ C) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k v z‖ ≤ C) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => u z * v z) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro O u v hO hSO hu hv hbu hbv k
    choose Cu hCu using hbu
    choose Cv hCv using hbv
    refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cu i| * |Cv (k - i)|,
      fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hzO := hSO hz
    have h1 := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hu hv hO.uniqueDiffOn hzO (n := k)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hO hzO] at h1
    refine h1.trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO hzO, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (k - i) hO hzO]
    have a1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i u z‖ ≤ |Cu i| := (hCu i z hz).trans (le_abs_self _)
    have a2 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) v z‖ ≤ |Cv (k - i)| :=
      (hCv (k - i) z hz).trans (le_abs_self _)
    have hc : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a1 hc) a2 (norm_nonneg _)
      (mul_nonneg hc (abs_nonneg _))
  have hb1 : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿T1) z‖ ≤ C :=
    fun k => (hbd k).imp fun C hC z hz => (hC z hz).1
  have hb2 : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿T2) z‖ ≤ C :=
    fun k => (hbd k).imp fun C hC z hz => (hC z hz).2
  
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, q = fun z => T1 z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + T2 z.1 z.2 ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hqe : q = (fun z => (↿T1) z * (↿T1) z) + (fun z => (↿T2) z * (↿T2) z) := by
    rw [hq]; funext z; simp only [Pi.add_apply, sq]; rfl
  have hqs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q Ω := by
    rw [hqe]; exact (hT1.mul hT1).add (hT2.mul hT2)
  have hqb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k q z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hprod Ω _ _ hΩ hSΩ hT1 hT1 hb1 hb1 k
    obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := hprod Ω _ _ hΩ hSΩ hT2 hT2 hb2 hb2 k
    refine ⟨C1 + C2, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hzΩ := hSΩ hz
    rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hΩ hzΩ, hqe,
      iteratedFDerivWithin_add_apply
        (((hT1.mul hT1).contDiffWithinAt hzΩ).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        (((hT2.mul hT2).contDiffWithinAt hzΩ).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        hΩ.uniqueDiffOn hzΩ,
      iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hΩ hzΩ, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hΩ hzΩ]
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hC1 z hz) (hC2 z hz))
  
  obtain ⟨a, ha_def⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = c0 ^ 2 / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ha : 0 < a := by rw [ha_def]; positivity
  have hψb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y : ℝ, a ≤ y → ∀ i ≤ k,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) y‖ ≤ C := by
    intro k
    refine ⟨∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
      |Polynomial.eval (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) (descPochhammer ℝ j)| * a ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) - j),
      fun y hy i hi => ?_⟩
    have hy0 : 0 < y := lt_of_lt_of_le ha hy
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate,
      Real.iter_deriv_rpow_const, norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hy0 _)]
    have hi0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg i
    have hle : y ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) - i) ≤ a ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) - i) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos ha hy (by linarith)
    calc |Polynomial.eval (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) (descPochhammer ℝ i)| * y ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) - i)
        ≤ |Polynomial.eval (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) (descPochhammer ℝ i)| * a ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) - i) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle (abs_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun j : ℕ => |Polynomial.eval (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) (descPochhammer ℝ j)| *
            a ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) - j))
          (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg ha.le _))
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
  
  obtain ⟨Ω', hΩ'⟩ : ∃ O : Set (ℝ × ℝ), O = Ω ∩ q ⁻¹' Ioi a := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΩ'o : IsOpen Ω' := by
    rw [hΩ']; exact hqs.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hΩ isOpen_Ioi
  have hΩ'Ω : Ω' ⊆ Ω := by rw [hΩ']; exact inter_subset_left
  have hqa : ∀ z ∈ Ω', a < q z := by
    intro z hz; rw [hΩ'] at hz; exact hz.2
  have hSΩ' : S ⊆ Ω' := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hΩ']
    refine ⟨hSΩ hz, ?_⟩
    show a < q z
    have hqz : q z = T1 z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + T2 z.1 z.2 ^ 2 := by rw [hq]
    have h1 := hlow z hz
    have hq0 : 0 ≤ T1 z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + T2 z.1 z.2 ^ 2 := by positivity
    have h2 : c0 ^ 2 ≤ T1 z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + T2 z.1 z.2 ^ 2 := by
      have := pow_le_pow_left₀ hc0.le h1 2
      rwa [Real.sq_sqrt hq0] at this
    have h3 : 0 < c0 ^ 2 := by positivity
    rw [hqz, ha_def]
    linarith
  have hψs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) (Ioi a) := fun y hy =>
    (Real.contDiffAt_rpow_const_of_ne (ne_of_gt (lt_trans ha hy))).contDiffWithinAt
  have hhs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => q z ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) Ω' :=
    hψs.comp (hqs.mono hΩ'Ω) (fun z hz => hqa z hz)
  
  have hhb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => q z ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨Cψ, hCψ⟩ := hψb k
    choose Cq hCq using hqb
    refine ⟨k.factorial * Cψ * (1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cq j|) ^ k, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hzO := hSΩ' hz
    have hD1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cq j| :=
      le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have hg : ∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) (Ioi a)
        (q z)‖ ≤ Cψ := by
      intro i hi
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i isOpen_Ioi (hqa z hzO)]
      exact hCψ (q z) (le_of_lt (hqa z hzO)) i hi
    have hf : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i q Ω' z‖ ≤
        (1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cq j|) ^ i := by
      intro i hi1 hik
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩ'o hzO]
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i q z‖ ≤ Cq i := hCq i z hz
        _ ≤ |Cq i| := le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cq j| :=
            Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cq j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
              (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hik))
        _ ≤ 1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cq j| := le_add_of_nonneg_left zero_le_one
        _ ≤ _ := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
    have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hψs (hqs.mono hΩ'Ω) (n := k)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top) (uniqueDiffOn_Ioi a) hΩ'o.uniqueDiffOn
      (fun w hw => hqa w hw) hzO hg hf
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hΩ'o hzO] at key
    exact key
  
  intro m
  obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hprod Ω' _ _ hΩ'o hSΩ' (hT1.mono hΩ'Ω) hhs hb1 hhb m
  obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := hprod Ω' _ _ hΩ'o hSΩ' (hT2.mono hΩ'Ω) hhs hb2 hhb m
  have heq : ∀ w ∈ Ω', ∀ t : ℝ,
      t / Real.sqrt (T1 w.1 w.2 ^ 2 + T2 w.1 w.2 ^ 2) = t * q w ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
    intro w hw t
    have hqw : q w = T1 w.1 w.2 ^ 2 + T2 w.1 w.2 ^ 2 := by rw [hq]
    have h0 : 0 ≤ q w := le_of_lt (lt_trans ha (hqa w hw))
    rw [← hqw, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.rpow_neg h0, div_eq_mul_inv]
  refine ⟨max C1 C2, fun z hz => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · have hev : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => T1 z.1 z.2 / Real.sqrt (T1 z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + T2 z.1 z.2 ^ 2))
        =ᶠ[nhds z] (fun z => (↿T1) z * q z ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hΩ'o.mem_nhds (hSΩ' hz)) (fun w hw => heq w hw _)
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
    exact (hC1 z hz).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  · have hev : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => T2 z.1 z.2 / Real.sqrt (T1 z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + T2 z.1 z.2 ^ 2))
        =ᶠ[nhds z] (fun z => (↿T2) z * q z ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hΩ'o.mem_nhds (hSΩ' hz)) (fun w hw => heq w hw _)
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
    exact (hC2 z hz).trans (le_max_right _ _)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η) → (∀ X₀ X₁ : ℝ, 0 < X₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₀ ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => F x e) η| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧ |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => U x e) η| ≤ C) → ∀ X₁ X₂ c : ℝ, 0 < X₁ → 0 < c → (∀ X η : ℝ, X₁ ≤ X → X ≤ X₂ → -1 < η → η < 1 → c ≤ F X η) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₁ ≤ X → X ≤ X₂ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTh h F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTz h F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C

signature.name: outer_stress_bounds
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η) → (∀ X₀ X₁ : ℝ, 0 < X₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₀ ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => F x e) η| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧ |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => U x e) η| ≤ C) → ∀ X₁ X₂ c : ℝ, 0 < X₁ → 0 < c → (∀ X η : ℝ, X₁ ≤ X → X ≤ X₂ → -1 < η → η < 1 → c ≤ F X η) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₁ ≤ X → X ≤ X₂ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTh h F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTz h F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h F U hh0 hh1 hF hU hFpos hcomp hw X₁ X₂ c hX₁ _hc _hFc m
  
  have good_add : ∀ (W S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen W → S ⊆ W →
      osbGood W S f → osbGood W S g → osbGood W S (fun z => f z + g z) := by
    intro W S f g hW hS hf hg
    obtain ⟨hf1, hf2⟩ := hf
    obtain ⟨hg1, hg2⟩ := hg
    refine ⟨hf1.add hg1, fun m => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C1, h1⟩ := hf2 m
    obtain ⟨C2, h2⟩ := hg2 m
    refine ⟨C1 + C2, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hzW := hS hz
    have e : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z => f z + g z) z =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g z :=
      iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((hf1.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hzW)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        ((hg1.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hzW)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    rw [e]
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (h1 z hz) (h2 z hz))
  have good_mul : ∀ (W S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen W → S ⊆ W →
      osbGood W S f → osbGood W S g → osbGood W S (fun z => f z * g z) := by
    intro W S f g hW hS hf hg
    obtain ⟨hf1, hf2⟩ := hf
    obtain ⟨hg1, hg2⟩ := hg
    refine ⟨hf1.mul hg1, fun m => ?_⟩
    choose Cf hCf using hf2
    choose Cg hCg using hg2
    have hMf : ∀ i ≤ m, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f z‖ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m+1), |Cf j| :=
      fun i hi z hz => (hCf i z hz).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans
        (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cf j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))))
    have hMg : ∀ i ≤ m, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g z‖ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m+1), |Cg j| :=
      fun i hi z hz => (hCg i z hz).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans
        (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cg j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))))
    have hMf0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m+1), |Cf j| := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    refine ⟨2 ^ m * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m+1), |Cf j|) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m+1), |Cg j|),
      fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hzW := hS hz
    rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hW hzW]
    refine (norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hf1 hg1 hW.uniqueDiffOn hzW (n := m)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).trans ?_
    calc _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m+1), (m.choose i : ℝ) *
            ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m+1), |Cf j|) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m+1), |Cg j|) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          have hi' : i ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hW hzW, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (m-i) hW hzW,
            mul_assoc]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul (hMf i hi' z hz)
            (hMg (m-i) (Nat.sub_le m i) z hz) (norm_nonneg _) hMf0) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
          congr 1
          exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose m
  have good_congr : ∀ (W S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen W → S ⊆ W →
      osbGood W S f → (∀ z ∈ W, g z = f z) → osbGood W S g := by
    intro W S f g hW hS hf heq
    refine ⟨hf.1.congr heq, fun m => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hf.2 m
    refine ⟨C, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hev : g =ᶠ[nhds z] f := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds (hS hz)) heq
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
    exact hC z hz
  have good_mono : ∀ (W W' S S' : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), W' ⊆ W → S' ⊆ S →
      osbGood W S f → osbGood W' S' f := by
    intro W W' S S' f hW hS hf
    refine ⟨hf.1.mono hW, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hf.2 k
    exact ⟨C, fun z hz => hC z (hS hz)⟩
  have good_coef : ∀ (V K W S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen V → IsCompact K →
      S ⊆ K → K ⊆ V → W ⊆ V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V → osbGood W S f := by
    intro V K W S f hV hK hSK hKV hWV hf
    refine ⟨hf.mono hWV, fun m => ?_⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f) V :=
      (hf.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hV.uniqueDiffOn).congr
        (fun z hz => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hV hz).symm)
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hc.mono hKV)
    exact ⟨C, fun z hz => hC z (hSK hz)⟩
  have good_fderiv : ∀ (W S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (H : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (v : ℝ × ℝ), ‖v‖ ≤ 1 →
      IsOpen W → S ⊆ W → osbGood W S H → osbGood W S (fun p => fderiv ℝ H p v) := by
    intro W S H v hv hW hS hH
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hH
    have hd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ H) W := h1.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (m := ∞) (by simp)
    refine ⟨hd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const, fun m => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h2 (m+1)
    refine ⟨max C 0, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hzW := hS hz
    have e : (fun p => fderiv ℝ H p v) = (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ (fderiv ℝ H) := by
      funext p; simp
    have hL : ‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v‖ ≤ 1 :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun φ => by
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply, one_mul]
        exact (φ.le_opNorm v).trans (mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) hv))
    rw [e]
    refine (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left _ (hd.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hzW))
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).trans ?_
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
    calc _ ≤ 1 * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m+1) H z‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ max C 0 := by rw [one_mul]; exact (hC z hz).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have good_partials : ∀ (W S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen W → S ⊆ W →
      osbGood W S (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => G p.1 p.2) →
      osbGood W S (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => deriv (fun Y => G Y p.2) p.1) ∧
      osbGood W S (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => profEtaD G p.1 p.2) := by
    intro W S G hW hS hG
    have hdiff : ∀ p ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => G p.1 p.2) p :=
      fun p hp => (hG.1.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hp)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    constructor
    · refine good_congr W S _ _ hW hS (good_fderiv W S _ (1, 0) (by simp) hW hS hG) ?_
      rintro ⟨X, η⟩ hp
      exact ((hdiff _ hp).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt X
        ((hasDerivAt_id X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X η))).deriv
    · refine good_congr W S _ _ hW hS (good_fderiv W S _ (0, 1) (by simp) hW hS hG) ?_
      rintro ⟨X, η⟩ hp
      exact ((hdiff _ hp).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt η
        ((hasDerivAt_const η X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id η))).deriv
  
  have good_eta_int : ∀ (Sx : Set ℝ) (D : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), MeasurableSet Sx →
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (η : ℝ), -1 < η → η < 1 → ContinuousOn (fun x => D m x η) Sx) →
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (x η : ℝ), x ∈ Sx → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        HasDerivAt (fun e => D m x e) (D (m + 1) x η) η) →
      (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ b : ℝ → ℝ, IntegrableOn b Sx ∧
        ∀ x η : ℝ, x ∈ Sx → -1 < η → η < 1 → |D m x η| ≤ b x) →

      (fun z hz => ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hX₁ hz.1.1, by linarith [hz.2.1], by linarith [hz.2.2]⟩)
      (fun z hz => ⟨lt_trans ha hz.1, by linarith [hz.2.1], by linarith [hz.2.2]⟩) hf
  have ga : ∀ f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, osbGood (Ioi a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc X₁ X₂ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) f →
      osbGood (Ioi a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc X₁ X₂ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) g →
      osbGood (Ioi a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc X₁ X₂ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (fun z => f z + g z) :=
    fun f g => good_add _ _ f g hWa hSW
  have gm : ∀ f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, osbGood (Ioi a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc X₁ X₂ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) f →
      osbGood (Ioi a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc X₁ X₂ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) g →
      osbGood (Ioi a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc X₁ X₂ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (fun z => f z * g z) :=
    fun f g => good_mul _ _ f g hWa hSW
  have cX : osbGood (Ioi a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc X₁ X₂ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.1) :=
    gc _ (by fun_prop)
  have cXi : osbGood (Ioi a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc X₁ X₂ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.1⁻¹) :=
    gc _ (by fun_prop (disch := (intro p hp; exact (show (0:ℝ) < p.1 from hp.1).ne')))
  have cLi : osbGood (Ioi a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc X₁ X₂ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)
      (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (1 - 2 * h * z.2 ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
    gc _ (by fun_prop (disch := (intro p hp; exact (hLV p hp).ne')))
  have cS : osbGood (Ioi a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc X₁ X₂ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)
      (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * z.1)) :=
    gc _ (by fun_prop (disch := (intro p hp; have h0 : (0:ℝ) < p.1 := hp.1; positivity)))
  have cSi : osbGood (Ioi a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc X₁ X₂ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)
      (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (Real.sqrt (2 * z.1))⁻¹) :=
    gc _ (by fun_prop (disch := (intro p hp; have h0 : (0:ℝ) < p.1 := hp.1; positivity)))
  have cE : osbGood (Ioi a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc X₁ X₂ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.2) :=
    gc _ (by fun_prop)
  have cK : ∀ k : ℝ, osbGood (Ioi a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc X₁ X₂ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => k) :=
    fun k => gc _ contDiffOn_const
  have cE2 : osbGood (Ioi a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc X₁ X₂ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)
      (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => 1 - z.2 ^ 2) := gc _ (by fun_prop)
  
  have hETh : osbGood (Ioi a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc X₁ X₂ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (fun z : ℝ × ℝ =>
      (-1 * (z.1 * (1 - 2 * h * z.2 ^ 2)⁻¹)) * (F z.1 z.2 * (1 + (-(1 - 2 * h) * z.2 * z.1⁻¹) *
        profRadInt U z.1 z.2 + (-1 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2) * z.1⁻¹) * profEtaD (profRadInt U) z.1 z.2)) +
      (1 / 2 * z.1⁻¹ * (1 - 2 * h * z.2 ^ 2)⁻¹) *
        ((1 - h) * profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) z.1 z.2 +
          (-(1 / 2 - h) * z.2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) z.1 z.2 +
          (-1 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2)) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))) z.1 z.2 +
          ((4 * h - 1) * z.2) * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) z.1 z.2) +
      (2 * z.1) * deriv (fun Y => F Y z.2) z.1) := by
    repeat
      first
      | exact hFa | exact hUa | exact hFX | exact hUX | exact hI1 | exact hI2
      | exact hI3 | exact hI4 | exact hPi | exact hdI1 | exact hdI2 | exact hdI3 | exact hdI4
      | exact hdPi | exact cX | exact cXi | exact cLi | exact cS | exact cSi | exact cE | exact cE2
      | exact cK _ | refine ga _ _ ?_ ?_ | refine gm _ _ ?_ ?_
  have hETz : osbGood (Ioi a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc X₁ X₂ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (fun z : ℝ × ℝ =>
      (z.1 * (1 - 2 * h * z.2 ^ 2)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (2 * z.1))⁻¹) *
        (-1 * ((1 + (-(1 - 2 * h) * z.2 * z.1⁻¹) * profRadInt U z.1 z.2 +
            (-1 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2) * z.1⁻¹) * profEtaD (profRadInt U) z.1 z.2) * U z.1 z.2) +
          z.1⁻¹ * ((1 / 2 - h) * profRadInt U z.1 z.2 +
            (-(1 / 2 - h) * z.2) * profEtaD (profRadInt U) z.1 z.2 +
            (4 * h * z.2) * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) z.1 z.2 +
            (-1 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2)) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)) z.1 z.2) +
          (4 * (1 / 2 + h) * z.2) * leadPi F z.1 z.2 + (-1 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2)) * profEtaD (leadPi F) z.1 z.2) +
      Real.sqrt (2 * z.1) * deriv (fun Y => U Y z.2) z.1) := by
    repeat
      first
      | exact hFa | exact hUa | exact hFX | exact hUX | exact hI1 | exact hI2
      | exact hI3 | exact hI4 | exact hPi | exact hdI1 | exact hdI2 | exact hdI3 | exact hdI4
      | exact hdPi | exact cX | exact cXi | exact cLi | exact cS | exact cSi | exact cE | exact cE2
      | exact cK _ | refine ga _ _ ?_ ?_ | refine gm _ _ ?_ ?_
  
  have havg : ∀ X η : ℝ, X ≠ 0 → profRadAvg U X η = X⁻¹ * profRadInt U X η := by
    intro X η hX
    have := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right (a := 0) (b := 1) (fun x => U x η) hX
    simp only [zero_mul, one_mul, smul_eq_mul] at this
    simp only [profRadAvg, profRadInt]
    exact this
  have hdavg : ∀ X η : ℝ, X ≠ 0 →
      profEtaD (profRadAvg U) X η = X⁻¹ * profEtaD (profRadInt U) X η := by
    intro X η hX
    have hfun : (fun e => profRadAvg U X e) = fun e => X⁻¹ * profRadInt U X e :=
      funext fun e => havg X e hX
    show deriv (fun e => profRadAvg U X e) η = X⁻¹ * deriv (fun e => profRadInt U X e) η
    rw [hfun]
    exact congrFun (deriv_const_mul_field' (𝕜 := ℝ) (v := fun e => profRadInt U X e) X⁻¹) η
  have algTh : ∀ (X η f fx i1 di1 i2 di2 i3 di3 : ℝ), X ≠ 0 → f ≠ 0 →
      1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 ≠ 0 →
      f * (X * (-(1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * (X⁻¹ * i1) - (1 - η ^ 2) * (X⁻¹ * di1)) +
        ((1 - h) * i2 - (1 / 2 - h) * η * di2 - (1 - η ^ 2) * di3 + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * η * i3) /
          (X * (2 * X * f))) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) - -2 * X * fx / f) =
      (-1 * (X * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)⁻¹)) * (f * (1 + (-(1 - 2 * h) * η * X⁻¹) * i1 +
        (-1 * (1 - η ^ 2) * X⁻¹) * di1)) +
      (1 / 2 * X⁻¹ * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)⁻¹) * ((1 - h) * i2 + (-(1 / 2 - h) * η) * di2 +
        (-1 * (1 - η ^ 2)) * di3 + ((4 * h - 1) * η) * i3) + (2 * X) * fx := by
    intro X η f fx i1 di1 i2 di2 i3 di3 hX hf hL
    field_simp
    ring
  have algTz : ∀ (X η f u ux i1 di1 i4 di4 pv dpv : ℝ), 0 < X → f ≠ 0 →
      1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 ≠ 0 →
      f * (X * (-(1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * (X⁻¹ * i1) - (1 - η ^ 2) * (X⁻¹ * di1)) * u +
        ((1 / 2 - h) * (i1 - η * di1) + 4 * h * η * i4 - (1 - η ^ 2) * di4) / X +
        4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * pv - (1 - η ^ 2) * dpv) /
          ((1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * f)) + Real.sqrt (2 * X) * ux / f) =
      (X * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (2 * X))⁻¹) *
        (-1 * ((1 + (-(1 - 2 * h) * η * X⁻¹) * i1 + (-1 * (1 - η ^ 2) * X⁻¹) * di1) * u) +
          X⁻¹ * ((1 / 2 - h) * i1 + (-(1 / 2 - h) * η) * di1 + (4 * h * η) * i4 +
            (-1 * (1 - η ^ 2)) * di4) + (4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η) * pv + (-1 * (1 - η ^ 2)) * dpv) +
      Real.sqrt (2 * X) * ux := by
    intro X η f u ux i1 di1 i4 di4 pv dpv hX hf hL
    have hs : Real.sqrt (2 * X) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by linarith)).ne'
    have hX0 : X ≠ 0 := hX.ne'
    field_simp
    ring
  have hL1 : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro η h1 h2
    have hsq : η ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith
  have hTh := good_congr _ _ _ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTh h F U p.1 p.2) hWa hSW hETh (by
    rintro ⟨X, η⟩ ⟨hX, h1, h2⟩
    have hX0 : 0 < X := lt_trans ha hX
    have := algTh X η (F X η) (deriv (fun Y => F Y η) X) (profRadInt U X η)
      (profEtaD (profRadInt U) X η) (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) X η)
      (profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) X η)
      (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) X η)
      (profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))) X η) hX0.ne'
      (hFpos X η hX0 h1 h2).ne' (hL1 η h1 h2)
    show leadStressTh h F U X η = _
    simp only [leadStressTh, leadQs, leadW, shearA, havg X η hX0.ne', hdavg X η hX0.ne']
    exact this)
  have hTz := good_congr _ _ _ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTz h F U p.1 p.2) hWa hSW hETz (by
    rintro ⟨X, η⟩ ⟨hX, h1, h2⟩
    have hX0 : 0 < X := lt_trans ha hX
    have := algTz X η (F X η) (U X η) (deriv (fun Y => U Y η) X) (profRadInt U X η)
      (profEtaD (profRadInt U) X η) (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) X η)
      (profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)) X η)
      (leadPi F X η) (profEtaD (leadPi F) X η) hX0
      (hFpos X η hX0 h1 h2).ne' (hL1 η h1 h2)
    show leadStressTz h F U X η = _
    simp only [leadStressTz, leadNs, leadW, shearB, havg X η hX0.ne', hdavg X η hX0.ne']
    exact this)
  obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hTh.2 m
  obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := hTz.2 m
  refine ⟨max C1 C2, fun X η hX1 hX2 h1 h2 => ?_⟩
  have hmem : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Icc X₁ X₂ ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨⟨hX1, hX2⟩, h1, h2⟩
  exact ⟨(hC1 _ hmem).trans (le_max_left _ _), (hC2 _ hmem).trans (le_max_right _ _)⟩

outer_stress_bounds.definitions:
def osbGood (W S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z‖ ≤ C

and_nodes.definitions_block:
def osbGood (W S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z‖ ≤ C

subgoal_signatures.name: profRadAvg_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profRadAvg g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(profRadAvg g)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → X * profRadAvg g X η = profRadInt g X η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * profRadAvg g Y η) (g X η) X)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ ρ0 ε0 : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ h, 0 < ρ0 h ∧ 0 < ε0 h) → ∃ (h lam Pst ρ cp ci xg xg2 r1 r2 k1 k2 p1 p2 m1 m2 xv xb μ : ℝ) (c ϑ : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), Real.exp 10 < Pst ∧ ShapeData Pst c ϑ ∧ ρ ≤ ρ0 h ∧ RefProf h lam Pst ρ cp ci xg xg2 r1 r2 k1 k2 p1 p2 m1 m2 xv xb (ε0 h) μ c ϑ F U

signature.name: ref_profile_exists
signature.statement: ∀ ρ0 ε0 : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ h, 0 < ρ0 h ∧ 0 < ε0 h) → ∃ (h lam Pst ρ cp ci xg xg2 r1 r2 k1 k2 p1 p2 m1 m2 xv xb μ : ℝ) (c ϑ : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), Real.exp 10 < Pst ∧ ShapeData Pst c ϑ ∧ ρ ≤ ρ0 h ∧ RefProf h lam Pst ρ cp ci xg xg2 r1 r2 k1 k2 p1 p2 m1 m2 xv xb (ε0 h) μ c ϑ F U

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ρ0 ε0 hpos
  
  obtain ⟨M6, hM6, G6⟩ := rfp_relaxed_strict
  obtain ⟨M7, hM7, G7⟩ := rfp_pulse_strict
  obtain ⟨M8, hM8, G8⟩ := rfp_exterior_strict
  obtain ⟨Md, hMd⟩ : ∃ Md : ℝ, Md = max (max M6 M7) (max M8 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hMd6 : M6 ≤ Md := by rw [hMd]; exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hMd7 : M7 ≤ Md := by rw [hMd]; exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hMd8 : M8 ≤ Md := by rw [hMd]; exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hMd1 : 1 ≤ Md := by rw [hMd]; exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hMd0 : 0 < Md := by linarith
  obtain ⟨P1, G1⟩ := rfp_moment_closure Md hMd0
  obtain ⟨P6, G6⟩ := G6 Md hMd6
  obtain ⟨P7, G7⟩ := G7 Md hMd7
  obtain ⟨P8, G8⟩ := G8 Md hMd8
  obtain ⟨Pst, hPst⟩ : ∃ Pst : ℝ,
      Pst = max (max (max P1 P6) (max P7 P8)) 0 + Real.exp (Real.exp Md + 10) + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hEx : 0 < Real.exp (Real.exp Md + 10) := Real.exp_pos _
  have hq0 := le_max_right (max (max P1 P6) (max P7 P8)) 0
  have hq1 := le_max_left (max (max P1 P6) (max P7 P8)) 0
  have hq2 := le_max_left (max P1 P6) (max P7 P8)
  have hq3 := le_max_right (max P1 P6) (max P7 P8)
  have hPst1 : P1 ≤ Pst := by rw [hPst]; linarith [le_max_left P1 P6]
  have hPst6 : P6 ≤ Pst := by rw [hPst]; linarith [le_max_right P1 P6]
  have hPst7 : P7 ≤ Pst := by rw [hPst]; linarith [le_max_left P7 P8]
  have hPst8 : P8 ≤ Pst := by rw [hPst]; linarith [le_max_right P7 P8]
  have hPstE : Real.exp (Real.exp Md + 10) < Pst := by rw [hPst]; linarith
  have hPst10 : Real.exp 10 < Pst :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by linarith [Real.exp_pos Md])) hPstE
  obtain ⟨l1, hl1, G1⟩ := G1 Pst hPst1
  obtain ⟨l6, hl6, G6⟩ := G6 Pst hPst6
  obtain ⟨l7, hl7, G7⟩ := G7 Pst hPst7
  obtain ⟨l8, hl8, G8⟩ := G8 Pst hPst8
  obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ : ∃ lam : ℝ, lam = min (min l1 l6) (min l7 l8) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hlam0 : 0 < lam := by rw [hlam]; exact lt_min (lt_min hl1 hl6) (lt_min hl7 hl8)
  have hlam1 : lam ≤ l1 := by rw [hlam]; exact le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hlam6 : lam ≤ l6 := by rw [hlam]; exact le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hlam7 : lam ≤ l7 := by rw [hlam]; exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hlam8 : lam ≤ l8 := by rw [hlam]; exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  obtain ⟨g1, hg1, G1⟩ := G1 lam hlam0 hlam1
  obtain ⟨g6, hg6, G6⟩ := G6 lam hlam0 hlam6
  obtain ⟨g7, hg7, G7⟩ := G7 lam hlam0 hlam7
  obtain ⟨g8, hg8, G8⟩ := G8 lam hlam0 hlam8
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ : ∃ h : ℝ, h = min (min g1 g6) (min g7 g8) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hh0 : 0 < h := by rw [hh]; exact lt_min (lt_min hg1 hg6) (lt_min hg7 hg8)
  have hh1 : h ≤ g1 := by rw [hh]; exact le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hh6 : h ≤ g6 := by rw [hh]; exact le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hh7 : h ≤ g7 := by rw [hh]; exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hh8 : h ≤ g8 := by rw [hh]; exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hε : 0 < ε0 h := (hpos h).2
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ : ∃ ρ : ℝ, ρ = min (ρ0 h) (h / 800) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hρ0 : 0 < ρ := by rw [hρ]; exact lt_min (hpos h).1 (by positivity)
  have hρle : ρ ≤ ρ0 h := by rw [hρ]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hρh : ρ ≤ h / 800 := by rw [hρ]; exact min_le_right _ _
  
  obtain ⟨T1, hT1⟩ : ∃ T1 : ℝ, T1 = max (4 * Real.log (1 / h))
      (2 / 3 * (rfpL5 Md Pst lam - Real.log ((1 - ρ) * ε0 h))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hT1a : 4 * Real.log (1 / h) ≤ T1 := by rw [hT1]; exact le_max_left _ _
  have hT1b : 2 / 3 * (rfpL5 Md Pst lam - Real.log ((1 - ρ) * ε0 h)) ≤ T1 := by
    rw [hT1]; exact le_max_right _ _
  
  obtain ⟨P, hPMd, hPPst, hPlam, hPh, hPρ, hPT1, hReg, hClos⟩ :=
    G1 h ρ T1 hh0 hh1 hρ0 hρh hT1a
  have S6 := G6 P hPMd hPPst hPlam (by rw [hPh]; exact hh6) hReg hClos
  have S7 := G7 P hPMd hPPst hPlam (by rw [hPh]; exact hh7) hReg hClos
  have S8 := G8 P hPMd hPPst hPlam (by rw [hPh]; exact hh8) hReg hClos
  subst hPMd hPPst hPlam hPh hPρ hPT1
  have hh100 : P.h < 1 / 100 := by
    have hReg' := hReg
    obtain ⟨-, -, hl0, hl100, -, hhl, -⟩ := hReg'
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl100 hl0.le]
  have hρ1 : P.ρ < 1 := by linarith
  
  obtain ⟨⟨o1, o2, o3, o4, o5, o6, o7, o8, o9, o10, o11, o12, hcp, hci⟩, sIn, sPat, sXv, sTail,
    sShape, sPi, sCol, sPos⟩ := rfp_profile_identities P hReg hClos
  obtain ⟨hFs, hUs, sCpt, sW, sInt⟩ := rfp_profile_regular P hReg hClos
  
  obtain ⟨hC1, hC2, hC3, hC4⟩ :=

structure RfpPar where
  (Md Pst lam h ρ T1 Lh : ℝ) (Amp c1 c2 ca : ℝ → ℝ)

noncomputable def rfpY2 (Md : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.exp Md + 11

noncomputable def rfpY3 (Md lam : ℝ) : ℝ := rfpY2 Md + 1 + 60 * Real.log (1 / lam)

noncomputable def rfpY4 (Md lam : ℝ) : ℝ := rfpY3 Md lam + 13 / lam

noncomputable def rfpY5 (Md lam : ℝ) : ℝ := rfpY4 Md lam + 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / lam)

noncomputable def rfpYb (Md lam T1 Lh : ℝ) : ℝ := rfpY5 Md lam + 2 + T1 + Lh + 3

noncomputable def rfpSigI (t : ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, sigA s

noncomputable def rfpBmp (t : ℝ) : ℝ := sigA (1 + t / (3 / 20)) * sigA (1 - t / (3 / 20))

noncomputable def rfpLam (P : RfpPar) (y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log P.Pst + y / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y - P.lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 P.Md)
    - (1 - P.lam) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam)
    + (1 - P.h) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1)
    - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) * Real.log 2
    + Real.log (tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) / (1 - P.ρ))

noncomputable def rfpL5 (Md Pst lam : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log Pst + rfpY5 Md lam / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI (rfpY5 Md lam)
    - lam * rfpSigI (rfpY5 Md lam - rfpY2 Md) - Real.log 2

noncomputable def rfpTh (P : RfpPar) (y : ℝ) : ℝ := 1 - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60)

noncomputable def rfpKa (P : RfpPar) : ℝ :=
  (∫ y, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3)) /
    (∫ y, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1))

noncomputable def rfpPsi (P : RfpPar) (y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3) - rfpKa P * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)

noncomputable def rfpR0 (ξ : ℝ) : ℝ := (∫ v in (0:ℝ)..ξ, sigA (50 * v)) * (1 - sigA (ξ - 10))

noncomputable def rfpRb (P : RfpPar) (y η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  P.Amp η * rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) + P.c1 η * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3)
    + P.c2 η * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1)

noncomputable def rfpK (Md y : ℝ) : ℝ := if y ≤ 1 then 4 else 4 * (1 - sigA (Real.log y / Md))

noncomputable def rfpE (P : RfpPar) (y η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (rfpLam P y) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y) * Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y)

noncomputable def rfpF (P : RfpPar) (x η : ℝ) : ℝ := rfpE P (Real.log x) η / Real.sqrt (2 * x)

noncomputable def rfpU (P : RfpPar) (x η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  η * rfpK P.Md (Real.log x) + rfpE P (Real.log x) η * rfpRb P (Real.log x) η

noncomputable def rfpCp (P : RfpPar) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (rfpLam P (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) + (1 / 2 + P.lam) * (rfpY2 P.Md + 1))

noncomputable def rfpCi (P : RfpPar) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (rfpLam P (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh - 3) +
    (1 / 2 + P.h) * (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh - 3)) / (1 - P.ρ)

noncomputable def rfpXg (P : RfpPar) : ℝ := Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1)

noncomputable def rfpXg2 (P : RfpPar) : ℝ := Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 2)

noncomputable def rfpXk (P : RfpPar) (k : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.exp (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam - k)

noncomputable def rfpXv (P : RfpPar) : ℝ := Real.exp (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)

noncomputable def rfpXb (P : RfpPar) : ℝ := Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)

def RfpRegime (P : RfpPar) : Prop :=
  0 < P.Md ∧ Real.exp (Real.exp P.Md + 10) < P.Pst ∧ 0 < P.lam ∧ P.lam ≤ 1 / 100 ∧ 0 < P.h ∧
    P.h ≤ P.lam ^ 2 ∧ 0 < P.ρ ∧ P.ρ ≤ P.h / 800 ∧ 4 * Real.log (1 / P.h) ≤ P.T1 ∧ 0 ≤ P.Lh

def RfpClos (P : RfpPar) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P.Amp (Ioo (-2) 2) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P.c1 (Ioo (-2) 2) ∧
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P.c2 (Ioo (-2) 2) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P.ca (Ioo (-2) 2) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → 9 / 10 ≤ P.Amp η ∧ P.Amp η ≤ 6 / 5 ∧
    |deriv P.Amp η| ≤ Real.sqrt P.lam ∧ |P.c1 η| + |deriv P.c1 η| ≤ P.lam ^ 20 ∧
    |P.c2 η| + |deriv P.c2 η| ≤ P.lam ^ 20) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -2 < η → η < 2 → |P.ca η| + |deriv P.ca η| ≤ P.lam ^ 20 ∧
    ∀ y : ℝ, |P.ca η * rfpPsi P y| ≤ 1 / 2) ∧
  P.ca 0 = 0 ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
    (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..rfpXv P, rfpU P x η) = 0 ∧
    (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), rfpU P x η * (2 * x * rfpF P x η)) = 0 ∧
    (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (rfpU P x η ^ 2 - x * rfpF P x η ^ 2)) = 0 ∧
    (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (2 * x * rfpF P x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * rfpCi P * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + P.h)))) = 0 ∧
    (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam), 2 * x * rfpF P x η) =
      ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam), 2 * x * rfpF P x 0)

def RfpStrict (adm : Prop) (h : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (x η : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < F x η ∧ 0 < shearA F x η ∧ 0 < psLead1 h F U x η ∧
  0 < shearA F x η - shearB F U x η * (psLead2 h F U x η / psLead1 h F U x η) ∧
  0 < 2 - 2 * shearB F U x η * (psLead2 h F U x η / psLead1 h F U x η)
        - shearB F U x η ^ 2 / shearA F x η
        - (shearA F x η - 2) * (psLead2 h F U x η / psLead1 h F U x η) ^ 2 ∧
  (adm → 2 < shearA F x η * (1 + (shearB F U x η / shearA F x η) ^ 2))

def rfpPref (Q : RfpPar → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ M0 : ℝ, 0 < M0 ∧ ∀ Md : ℝ, M0 ≤ Md → ∃ P0 : ℝ, ∀ Pst : ℝ, P0 ≤ Pst →
    ∃ l0 : ℝ, 0 < l0 ∧ ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → lam ≤ l0 → ∃ h0 : ℝ, 0 < h0 ∧
      ∀ P : RfpPar, P.Md = Md → P.Pst = Pst → P.lam = lam → P.h ≤ h0 →
        RfpRegime P → RfpClos P → Q P

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (H : ℝ → ℝ) (h C K a X : ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 → 0 < a → 0 < X → ContinuousOn H (Ioi 0) → (∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z → |H z| ≤ C ∧ |deriv H z| ≤ C) → (∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z → |H z - 1| ≤ K * z) → (∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → HasDerivAt (fun z => z ^ 2 * deriv H z + (1 + (1 + h) * z) * H z) ((1 - h) * (y * deriv H y + (1 + h) * H y)) y) → IntegrableOn (fun x => x ^ (-h) * (H (a / x) - 1)) (Ioi X) ∧ ∫ x in Ioi X, x ^ (-h) * (H (a / x) - 1) = -(X ^ (1 - h) * ((a / X) ^ 2 * deriv H (a / X) + (1 + (1 + h) * (a / X)) * H (a / X) - 1)) / (1 - h)

subgoal_signatures.name: tailHt_calculus

subgoal_signatures.name: collar_I_rep

collar_factorization.definitions:
noncomputable def sqFlat (y : ℝ) : ℝ := if y ≤ 0 then 0 else Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2)

noncomputable def sqFlatD (y : ℝ) : ℝ := if y ≤ 0 then 0 else 2 / y ^ 3 * Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2)

noncomputable def collarG (u : ℝ) : ℝ := (sqFlat u + sqFlat (1 - u))⁻¹

noncomputable def collarGam (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 * sqFlat (1 - u) + u ^ 3 * sqFlatD (1 - u)) / (sqFlat u + sqFlat (1 - u)) ^ 2

def collarGood (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (Ioo 0 (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
  ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Ioo 0 (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f p‖ ≤ C

noncomputable def collarFlatInt (ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-t) * ψ (p.1 / Real.sqrt (1 + p.1 ^ 2 * t), p.2)

noncomputable def collarXu (Xb v : ℝ) : ℝ := Xb * Real.exp (-(2 * v))

noncomputable def collarPsiTh (h cinf Xb : ℝ) (q : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  collarGam q.1 * (2 * (1 - 2 * h * q.2 ^ 2) * (tailHt h cinf (collarXu Xb q.1) q.2 -

          ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ (i - l) β Ωu p‖ ≤ (i.choose l : ℝ) * (A * 2 ^ n * E * B) := by
      intro l hl
      have hli : l ≤ i := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hl)
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen l hΩuo hp, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (i - l) hΩuo hp]
      have h1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => φ k q.1) p‖ ≤ A * 2 ^ n * E := by
        refine (hfst l p hu0).trans ((hCφ l p.1 hu0 hu2).trans ?_)
        have hCA : |Cφ l| ≤ A := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun l => |Cφ l|)
          (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
        have hq := hpow p.1 hu0 hu2 (k + 3 * l) n (by omega)
        have he := Real.exp_pos (-(1 / p.1 ^ 2))
        calc Cφ l * Real.exp (-(1 / p.1 ^ 2)) * (p.1 ^ (k + 3 * l))⁻¹
            ≤ A * Real.exp (-(1 / p.1 ^ 2)) * (2 ^ n * (p.1 ^ n)⁻¹) :=
              mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ((le_abs_self _).trans hCA) he.le) hq
                (inv_nonneg.2 (pow_nonneg hu0.le _)) (mul_nonneg hA0 he.le)
          _ = A * 2 ^ n * E := by rw [hE]; ring
      have h2 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (i - l) β p‖ ≤ B := by
        refine (hBβ (i - l) p hp).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans ?_)
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun r => |Bβ r|) (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
      have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ i.choose l := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      calc (i.choose l : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => φ k q.1) p‖ *
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (i - l) β p‖
          ≤ (i.choose l : ℝ) * (A * 2 ^ n * E) * B :=
            mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hc) h2 (norm_nonneg _)
              (mul_nonneg hc (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hA0 (by positivity)) hE0))
        _ = (i.choose l : ℝ) * (A * 2 ^ n * E * B) := by ring
    rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩuo hp]
    refine (norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hfs hβs hΩuo.uniqueDiffOn hp (hle i)).trans ?_
    refine (Finset.sum_le_sum hterm).trans ?_
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    have hsum : (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose l : ℝ)) = 2 ^ i := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose i
    rw [hsum]
    have h2i : (2:ℝ) ^ i ≤ 2 ^ m := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hi
    calc (2:ℝ) ^ i * (A * 2 ^ n * E * B) ≤ 2 ^ m * (A * 2 ^ n * E * B) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2i hAEB
      _ = _ := by ring
  
  set a := Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) with ha
  have ha0 : 0 < a := mul_pos hXb (Real.exp_pos _)
  set χ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ := fun w => (Real.log (Xb / w.1) / 2, w.2) with hχ
  have hχs : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, 0 < w.1 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ χ w := by
    intro w hw
    exact ((((contDiffAt_const (c := Xb)).fun_div contDiffAt_fst hw.ne').log
      (div_pos hXb hw).ne').div_const 2).prodMk contDiffAt_snd
  set K : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Icc a Xb ×ˢ Icc (-1) 1 with hK
  have hKc : IsCompact K := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  have hcont : ∀ i : ℕ, ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i χ) K := fun i w hw =>
    ((hχs w (lt_of_lt_of_le ha0 hw.1.1)).iteratedFDeriv_right (m := 0)
      (by rw [zero_add]; exact hle i)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  choose b hb using fun i => hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hcont i)
  set D := 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |b i| with hD
  have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by
    have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1)) => abs_nonneg (b i))
    linarith
  have hDb : ∀ w ∈ K, ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i χ w‖ ≤ D ^ i := by
    intro w hw i hi1 him
    have h1 : |b i| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |b i| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |b i|) (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i χ w‖ ≤ b i := hb i w hw
      _ ≤ D := by linarith [le_abs_self (b i)]
      _ ≤ D ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
  
  set Ωc : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Ioo a Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 with hΩc
  have hΩco : IsOpen Ωc := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hlog : ∀ X : ℝ, a < X → X < Xb → 0 < Real.log (Xb / X) ∧ Real.log (Xb / X) < 11 / 4 := by
    intro X hX1 hX2
    have hX0 : 0 < X := ha0.trans hX1
    refine ⟨Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).2 hX2), ?_⟩
    rw [Real.log_lt_iff_lt_exp (div_pos hXb hX0), div_lt_iff₀ hX0]
    have e : Real.exp (11 / 4) * a = Xb := by
      rw [ha, mul_left_comm, ← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
    have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hX1 (Real.exp_pos (11 / 4))
    rw [e] at this
    linarith
  have hmaps : MapsTo χ Ωc Ωu := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hlog w.1 hw.1.1 hw.1.2
    exact ⟨⟨show 0 < Real.log (Xb / w.1) / 2 by linarith,
      show Real.log (Xb / w.1) / 2 < 11 / 8 by linarith⟩, hw.2⟩
  have hχc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ χ Ωc := fun w hw => (hχs w (ha0.trans hw.1.1)).contDiffWithinAt
  have hsq : ∀ L : ℝ, 1 / (L / 2) ^ 2 = 4 / L ^ 2 := by
    intro L; rw [div_pow, one_div_div]; norm_num
  have hid : (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Real.exp (-(4 / Real.log (Xb / w.1) ^ 2)) *
      ((Real.log (Xb / w.1) / 2) ^ k)⁻¹ * β (Real.log (Xb / w.1) / 2, w.2)) =
      (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => φ k q.1 * β q) ∘ χ := by
    funext w
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, hχ, hφdef, hsq]
  refine ⟨Nat.factorial m * (2 ^ m * A * B * 2 ^ n) * D ^ m * 2 ^ n, n, ?_⟩
  intro X η hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2
  have hae : a < Xb * Real.exp (-(5 / 2)) :=
    mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (by norm_num)) hXb
  have hxc : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ωc := ⟨⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hae hX1, hX2⟩, hη1, hη2⟩
  have hxK : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ K := ⟨⟨(lt_of_lt_of_le hae hX1).le, hX2.le⟩, hη1.le, hη2.le⟩
  have hδ := hlog X (lt_of_lt_of_le hae hX1) hX2
  have hχxu : χ (X, η) ∈ Ωu := hmaps hxc
  have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hΦs hχc (hle m) hΩuo.uniqueDiffOn
    hΩco.uniqueDiffOn hmaps hxc
    (C := 2 ^ m * A * B * 2 ^ n * (Real.exp (-(1 / (χ (X, η)).1 ^ 2)) * ((χ (X, η)).1 ^ n)⁻¹))
    (D := D)
    (fun i hi => by
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩuo hχxu]
      exact hΦb _ hχxu i hi)
    (fun i hi1 him => by
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩco hxc]
      exact hDb _ hxK i hi1 him)
  rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hΩco hxc, ← hid] at hFdB
  refine hFdB.trans ?_
  have hχ1 : (χ (X, η)).1 = Real.log (Xb / X) / 2 := rfl
  rw [hχ1, hsq]
  set δ := Real.log (Xb / X) with hδdef
  have hδ0 : 0 < δ := hδ.1
  have hmin0 : 0 < min 1 δ := lt_min one_pos hδ0
  have hu : ((δ / 2) ^ n)⁻¹ ≤ 2 ^ n * (min 1 δ) ^ (-(n : ℝ)) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hmin0.le, Real.rpow_natCast, div_pow, inv_div, div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (inv_anti₀ (pow_pos hmin0 n)
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ hmin0.le (min_le_right _ _) n)) (by positivity)
  have hP0 : 0 ≤ (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) * (2 ^ m * A * B * 2 ^ n) * D ^ m *
      Real.exp (-(4 / δ ^ 2)) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hK10) (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _))
      (Real.exp_pos _).le
  calc (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) * (2 ^ m * A * B * 2 ^ n * (Real.exp (-(4 / δ ^ 2)) *
        ((δ / 2) ^ n)⁻¹)) * D ^ m
      = ((Nat.factorial m : ℝ) * (2 ^ m * A * B * 2 ^ n) * D ^ m * Real.exp (-(4 / δ ^ 2))) *
        ((δ / 2) ^ n)⁻¹ := by ring
    _ ≤ ((Nat.factorial m : ℝ) * (2 ^ m * A * B * 2 ^ n) * D ^ m * Real.exp (-(4 / δ ^ 2))) *
        (2 ^ n * (min 1 δ) ^ (-(n : ℝ))) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu hP0
    _ = _ := by ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (Xb : ℝ) (r : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xb → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ r (Ioo 0 (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Ioo 0 (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m r p‖ ≤ C) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xb * Real.exp (-(5 / 2)) ≤ X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => (Real.sqrt (1 + r (Real.log (Xb / w.1) / 2, w.2) ^ 2))⁻¹) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => r (Real.log (Xb / w.1) / 2, w.2) * (Real.sqrt (1 + r (Real.log (Xb / w.1) / 2, w.2) ^ 2))⁻¹) (X, η)‖ ≤ C

signature.name: direction_transfer
signature.statement: ∀ (Xb : ℝ) (r : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xb → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ r (Ioo 0 (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Ioo 0 (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m r p‖ ≤ C) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xb * Real.exp (-(5 / 2)) ≤ X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => (Real.sqrt (1 + r (Real.log (Xb / w.1) / 2, w.2) ^ 2))⁻¹) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => r (Real.log (Xb / w.1) / 2, w.2) * (Real.sqrt (1 + r (Real.log (Xb / w.1) / 2, w.2) ^ 2))⁻¹) (X, η)‖ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xb r hXb hr hbd
  have hΩuo : IsOpen (Ioo (0:ℝ) (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  
  have outer : ∀ (σ : ℝ → ℝ) (U : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ σ → IsOpen U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ U, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f p‖ ≤ C) →
      ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ U, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun p => σ (f p)) p‖ ≤ C := by
    intro σ U f hσ hU hf hfb m
    obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := hfb 0
    choose B hB using hfb
    have hcont : Continuous (fun s => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i σ s‖) := by
      apply continuous_finset_sum
      intro i _
      exact (hσ.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).norm
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := -C0) (b := C0)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      hcont.continuousOn
    have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |B i| :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have hD1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |B i| := by linarith
    refine ⟨m.factorial * A * (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |B i|) ^ m, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    have hgb : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i σ univ (f p)‖ ≤ A := by
      intro i hi
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_univ]
      have hfp : f p ∈ Icc (-C0) C0 := by
        have := hC0 p hp
        rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
        exact abs_le.1 this
      have h1 : ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j σ (f p)‖‖ ≤ A := hA (f p) hfp
      have h2 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i σ (f p)‖ ≤
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j σ (f p)‖ :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j σ (f p)‖)
          (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
      linarith [le_abs_self (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j σ (f p)‖)]
    have hfb' : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i f U p‖ ≤
        (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |B i|) ^ i := by
      intro i hi1 him
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hU hp]
      have h1 := hB i p hp
      have h2 : |B i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |B j| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |B j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
      have h3 : (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |B i|) ≤
          (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |B i|) ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
      linarith [le_abs_self (B i)]
    have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le (g := σ) (f := f) (n := m) (s := U) (t := univ)
      (x := p) (N := ∞) hσ.contDiffOn hf (by exact_mod_cast le_top) uniqueDiffOn_univ
      hU.uniqueDiffOn (mapsTo_univ _ _) hp hgb hfb'
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hU hp] at key
    exact key
  
  have inner : ∀ g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Ioo 0 (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Ioo 0 (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g p‖ ≤ C) →
      ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xb * Real.exp (-(5 / 2)) ≤ X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => g (Real.log (Xb / w.1) / 2, w.2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C := by
    intro g hg hgb m
    let χ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ := fun w => (Real.log (Xb / w.1) / 2, w.2)
    have hV : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_univ
    have hχ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ χ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) := by
      refine ContDiffOn.prodMk ?_ contDiffOn_snd
      exact ((contDiffOn_const.div contDiffOn_fst
        (fun w hw => (show (0:ℝ) < w.1 from hw.1).ne')).log
        (fun w hw => (div_pos hXb (show (0:ℝ) < w.1 from hw.1)).ne')).div_const 2
    have ha0 : 0 < Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) := mul_pos hXb (Real.exp_pos _)
    have hab : Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) < Xb * Real.exp (-(5 / 2)) :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (by norm_num)) hXb
    have hmaps : MapsTo χ (Ioo (Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4))) Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)
        (Ioo 0 (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
      rintro ⟨X, η⟩ ⟨⟨hX1, hX2⟩, hη⟩
      have hX0 : 0 < X := ha0.trans hX1
      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, hη⟩
      · have : 0 < Real.log (Xb / X) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).2 hX2)
        show 0 < Real.log (Xb / X) / 2
        linarith
      · have e1 : Real.log (Xb / X) = Real.log Xb - Real.log X := Real.log_div hXb.ne' hX0.ne'
        have e2 : Real.log (Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4))) = Real.log Xb + (-(11 / 4)) := by
          rw [Real.log_mul hXb.ne' (Real.exp_pos _).ne', Real.log_exp]
        have e3 : Real.log (Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4))) < Real.log X := Real.log_lt_log ha0 hX1
        show Real.log (Xb / X) / 2 < 11 / 8
        linarith
    have hcontχ : ∀ i : ℕ, ContinuousOn (fun w => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i χ w‖)
        (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) := fun i =>
      ((hχ.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hV.uniqueDiffOn).congr
        (fun w hw => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hV hw).symm)).norm
    have hKV : Icc (Xb * Real.exp (-(5 / 2))) Xb ×ˢ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) :=
      fun w hw => ⟨show (0:ℝ) < w.1 from (ha0.trans hab).trans_le hw.1.1, mem_univ _⟩
    have hΨ : ContinuousOn (fun w => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i χ w‖)
        (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) :=
      continuousOn_finset_sum (f := fun i w => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i χ w‖) (Finset.range (m + 1))
        (fun i _ => hcontχ i)
    obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc :
      IsCompact (Icc (Xb * Real.exp (-(5 / 2))) Xb ×ˢ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hΨ.mono hKV)
    choose B hB using hgb
    refine ⟨m.factorial * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |B i|) * (1 + |E|) ^ m, ?_⟩
    intro X η hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2
    have hwc : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioo (Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4))) Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
      ⟨⟨hab.trans_le hX1, hX2⟩, hη1, hη2⟩
    have hwK : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Icc (Xb * Real.exp (-(5 / 2))) Xb ×ˢ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
      ⟨⟨hX1, hX2.le⟩, hη1.le, hη2.le⟩
    have hΩc : IsOpen (Ioo (Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4))) Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
      isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hcV : Ioo (Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4))) Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) :=
      fun w hw => ⟨show (0:ℝ) < w.1 from ha0.trans hw.1.1, mem_univ _⟩
    have hgB : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i g (Ioo 0 (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (χ (X, η))‖ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |B i| := by
      intro i hi
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩuo (hmaps hwc)]
      have h2 : |B i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |B j| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |B j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
      linarith [hB i _ (hmaps hwc), le_abs_self (B i)]
    have hχB : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m →
        ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i χ (Ioo (Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4))) Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (X, η)‖ ≤
          (1 + |E|) ^ i := by
      intro i hi1 him
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩc hwc]
      have h1 : ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j χ (X, η)‖‖ ≤ E := hE _ hwK
      have h2 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i χ (X, η)‖ ≤
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j χ (X, η)‖ :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j χ (X, η)‖)
          (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
      have h3 : (1 + |E|) ≤ (1 + |E|) ^ i :=
        le_self_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg E]) (by omega)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
      linarith [le_abs_self E,
        le_abs_self (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j χ (X, η)‖)]
    have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le (g := g) (f := χ) (n := m) (N := ∞) hg
      (hχ.mono hcV) (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hΩuo.uniqueDiffOn hΩc.uniqueDiffOn hmaps hwc
      hgB hχB
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hΩc hwc] at key
    exact key
  
  have hq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => 1 + s ^ 2) := contDiff_const.add (contDiff_id.pow 2)
  have hσ1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (1 + s ^ 2))⁻¹) :=
    (hq.sqrt (fun s => by positivity)).inv (fun s => (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)).ne')
  have hσ2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => s * (Real.sqrt (1 + s ^ 2))⁻¹) := contDiff_id.mul hσ1
  
  intro m
  obtain ⟨C1, h1⟩ := inner (fun p => (Real.sqrt (1 + r p ^ 2))⁻¹) (hσ1.comp_contDiffOn hr)
    (outer _ _ r hσ1 hΩuo hr hbd) m
  obtain ⟨C2, h2⟩ := inner (fun p => r p * (Real.sqrt (1 + r p ^ 2))⁻¹) (hσ2.comp_contDiffOn hr)
    (outer _ _ r hσ2 hΩuo hr hbd) m
  exact ⟨max C1 C2, fun X η hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2 =>
    ⟨(h1 X η hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2).trans (le_max_left _ _),
      (h2 X η hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2).trans (le_max_right _ _)⟩⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: heatK_deriv_bound

signature.name: collar_ratio_bound
