signature.name: heat_near_one
signature.statement: ∀ h Z : ℝ, 0 < h → 0 < Z → |heatProfile h Z - 1| ≤ h * (1 + h) * Z

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Z hh hZ
  
  have bern : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
      0 < (1 + t) ^ (-h) ∧ (1 + t) ^ (-h) ≤ 1 ∧ 1 - h * t ≤ (1 + t) ^ (-h) := by
    intro t ht
    have h1 : (0:ℝ) < 1 + t := by linarith
    refine ⟨Real.rpow_pos_of_pos h1 _,
      Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by linarith) (by linarith), ?_⟩
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos h1]
    have e1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (Real.log (1 + t) * (-h))
    have e2 : Real.log (1 + t) ≤ 1 + t - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos h1
    have e3 : h * Real.log (1 + t) ≤ h * t := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hh.le
    nlinarith
  
  have hG0 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    have := Real.GammaIntegral_convergent (show (0:ℝ) < 1 + h by linarith)
    have e : 1 + h - 1 = h := by ring
    rw [e] at this
    exact this
  have hG0i : ∫ v in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h = Real.Gamma (1 + h) := by
    have := Real.Gamma_eq_integral (show (0:ℝ) < 1 + h by linarith)
    have e : 1 + h - 1 = h := by ring
    rw [e] at this
    exact this.symm
  have hG1 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-v) * v ^ (h + 1)) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    have := Real.GammaIntegral_convergent (show (0:ℝ) < h + 2 by linarith)
    have e : h + 2 - 1 = h + 1 := by ring
    rw [e] at this
    exact this
  have hG1i : ∫ v in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-v) * v ^ (h + 1) = (1 + h) * Real.Gamma (1 + h) := by
    have := Real.Gamma_eq_integral (show (0:ℝ) < h + 2 by linarith)
    have e : h + 2 - 1 = h + 1 := by ring
    rw [e] at this
    rw [← this, show h + 2 = (1 + h) + 1 by ring, Real.Gamma_add_one (by linarith)]
  
  have hw : ∀ v : ℝ, 0 < v → 0 ≤ Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h := fun v hv =>
    mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.rpow_nonneg hv.le _)
  
  have hf : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h)) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.mono' hG0 ?_ ?_
    · have : Measurable (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h)) := by
        fun_prop
      exact this.aestronglyMeasurable
    · filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with v hv
      have hv0 : (0:ℝ) < v := hv
      obtain ⟨p1, p2, -⟩ := bern (Z * v) (by positivity)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hw v hv0) p1.le)]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (hw v hv0) p2
  
  have hΓ : 0 < Real.Gamma (1 + h) := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (by linarith)
  have hupper : ∫ v in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h)
      ≤ Real.Gamma (1 + h) := by
    rw [← hG0i]
    refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on hf hG0 measurableSet_Ioi ?_
    intro v hv
    have hv0 : (0:ℝ) < v := hv
    obtain ⟨-, p2, -⟩ := bern (Z * v) (by positivity)
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (hw v hv0) p2
  have hlower : Real.Gamma (1 + h) - h * Z * ((1 + h) * Real.Gamma (1 + h))
      ≤ ∫ v in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h) := by
    have hlowI : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h - h * Z * (Real.exp (-v) * v ^ (h + 1))) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hG0.sub (hG1.const_mul (h * Z))
    have hval : ∫ v in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), (Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h - h * Z * (Real.exp (-v) * v ^ (h + 1)))
        = Real.Gamma (1 + h) - h * Z * ((1 + h) * Real.Gamma (1 + h)) := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_sub hG0 (hG1.const_mul _), MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
        hG0i, hG1i]
    rw [← hval]

    have hv0 : (0:ℝ) < v := hv

    have hwv := hw v hv0
    rw [Real.rpow_add_one hv0.ne']
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left p3 hwv]
  unfold heatProfile
  have hle1 : (Real.Gamma (1 + h))⁻¹ *
      (∫ v in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h)) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [inv_mul_le_iff₀ hΓ]
    linarith
  have hge : 1 - h * (1 + h) * Z ≤ (Real.Gamma (1 + h))⁻¹ *
      (∫ v in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h)) := by
    rw [le_inv_mul_iff₀ hΓ]
    linarith
  have hpos : 0 ≤ h * (1 + h) * Z := by positivity
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

by
  intro H h C K a X hh0 hh1 ha hX hHc hCb hK hΦ

      · exact ContinuousOn.rpow_const continuousOn_id (fun x hx => Or.inl (hpos x hx).ne')
      · apply ContinuousOn.sub _ continuousOn_const
        refine hHc.comp (continuousOn_const.div continuousOn_id (fun x hx => (hpos x hx).ne')) ?_
        intro x hx
        exact div_pos ha (hpos x hx)
    have hmaj : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => (K * a) * x ^ (-h - 1)) (Ioi X) :=
      (integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) hX).const_mul (K * a)
    refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.mono' hmaj (hcont.aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi) ?_
    refine (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_)
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : 0 < x := hpos x hx
    have hp : 0 < x ^ (-h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hx0 _
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hp]

      have h1 := hK 1 one_pos

      linarith
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = a ^ 2 * C + (1 + h) * a * C + K * a := ⟨_, rfl⟩

    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos h1h, abs_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos ht0 _), e,

    calc t * t ^ (-h) * |(a / t) ^ 2 * deriv H (a / t) + (1 + (1 + h) * (a / t)) * H (a / t) - 1|
        ≤ t * t ^ (-h) * (M * t⁻¹) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hΦb (by positivity)
      _ = M / (1 - h) * t ^ (-h) * (1 - h) := by field_simp
  
  have hderiv : ∀ x ∈ Ici X, HasDerivAt (fun t => t ^ (1 - h) * ((a / t) ^ 2 * deriv H (a / t) +
      (1 + (1 + h) * (a / t)) * H (a / t) - 1) / (1 - h)) (x ^ (-h) * (H (a / x) - 1)) x := by
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hX hx
    have hy : 0 < a / x := div_pos ha hx0
    have hin : HasDerivAt (fun t => a / t) (-(a / x ^ 2)) x := by
      have := (hasDerivAt_inv hx0.ne').const_mul a
      convert this using 1
      · funext t; rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
      · field_simp
    have hcomp := (hΦ (a / x) hy).comp x hin
    have hpow := Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (p := 1 - h) (Or.inl hx0.ne')
    have hall := (hpow.mul (hcomp.sub_const 1)).div_const (1 - h)
    convert hall using 1
    · rfl
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [show (1:ℝ) - h - 1 = -h by ring]
    have e : x ^ (1 - h) = x * x ^ (-h) := by
      rw [show (1:ℝ) - h = 1 + -h by ring, Real.rpow_add hx0, Real.rpow_one]
    rw [e]
    have hx0' := hx0.ne'
    have h1h' := h1h.ne'
    field_simp
    ring
  have hftc := MeasureTheory.integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto' hderiv hint hlim
  refine ⟨hint, ?_⟩
  rw [hftc]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (k : ℝ → ℝ) (C β a X : ℝ), 1 < β → 0 < a → 0 < X → ContinuousOn k (Ioi 0) → (∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z → |k z| ≤ C) → HasDerivAt (fun b => ∫ x in Ioi X, x ^ (-β) * k (b / x)) (((1 - β) * (∫ x in Ioi X, x ^ (-β) * k (a / x)) + X ^ (1 - β) * k (a / X)) / a) a

signature.name: power_tail_integral_deriv
signature.statement: ∀ (k : ℝ → ℝ) (C β a X : ℝ), 1 < β → 0 < a → 0 < X → ContinuousOn k (Ioi 0) → (∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z → |k z| ≤ C) → HasDerivAt (fun b => ∫ x in Ioi X, x ^ (-β) * k (b / x)) (((1 - β) * (∫ x in Ioi X, x ^ (-β) * k (a / x)) + X ^ (1 - β) * k (a / X)) / a) a

proof.tactics:
by
  intro k C β a X hβ ha hX hk hkC
  set f : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => y ^ (-β) * k (1 / y) with hf_def
  
  have hscale : ∀ b : ℝ, 0 < b → ∫ x in Ioi X, x ^ (-β) * k (b / x) =
      b ^ (1 - β) * ∫ y in Ioi (X / b), f y := by
    intro b hb
    have h1 := MeasureTheory.integral_comp_mul_left_Ioi (fun x => x ^ (-β) * k (b / x)) (X / b) hb
    have hbX : b * (X / b) = X := by field_simp
    rw [hbX] at h1
    have h2 : ∫ y in Ioi (X / b), (fun x => x ^ (-β) * k (b / x)) (b * y) =
        ∫ y in Ioi (X / b), b ^ (-β) * f y := by
      apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      intro y hy
      have hy0 : 0 < y := lt_trans (div_pos hX hb) hy
      simp only [hf_def]
      rw [Real.mul_rpow hb.le hy0.le]
      have : b / (b * y) = 1 / y := by field_simp
      rw [this]
      ring
    rw [h2, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, smul_eq_mul] at h1
    have hb1 : b ^ (1 - β) = b * b ^ (-β) := by
      rw [show (1:ℝ) - β = 1 + -β by ring, Real.rpow_add hb, Real.rpow_one]
    rw [hb1, mul_assoc, h1, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hb.ne', one_mul]
  
  have hfc : ContinuousOn f (Ioi 0) := by
    apply ContinuousOn.mul
    · exact ContinuousOn.rpow_const continuousOn_id (fun y hy => Or.inl (ne_of_gt hy))
    · apply hk.comp (continuousOn_const.div continuousOn_id (fun y hy => ne_of_gt hy))
      intro y hy
      have hy' : (0:ℝ) < y := hy
      exact one_div_pos.mpr hy'
  have hint : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn f (Ioi c) := by
    intro c hc
    have hp : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (-β)) (Ioi c) :=
      integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) hc
    refine (hp.const_mul C).mono' ?_ ?_
    · exact (hfc.mono (Ioi_subset_Ioi hc.le)).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi
    · refine (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).mpr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_)
      intro y hy
      have hy0 : 0 < y := lt_trans hc hy
      simp only [hf_def, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hy0.le _)]
      have h3 := hkC (1 / y) (one_div_pos.mpr hy0)
      have hp0 := Real.rpow_nonneg hy0.le (-β)
      nlinarith
  
  have hH : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → HasDerivAt (fun t => ∫ y in Ioi t, f y) (-f s) s := by
    intro s hs
    have hc : 0 < s / 2 := by linarith
    have hcs : s / 2 < s := by linarith
    have hev : (fun t => ∫ y in Ioi t, f y) =ᶠ[nhds s]
        fun t => (∫ y in Ioi (s / 2), f y) - ∫ y in (s / 2)..t, f y := by
      filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hcs] with t ht
      have := intervalIntegral.integral_interval_add_Ioi (hint _ hc) (hint t (lt_trans hc ht))
      linarith
    have hftc : HasDerivAt (fun t => ∫ y in (s / 2)..t, f y) (f s) s := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
      · apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
        apply hfc.mono
        intro y hy
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hcs.le] at hy
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hc hy.1
      · exact hfc.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter isOpen_Ioi s hs
      · exact hfc.continuousAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hs)
    exact (hftc.const_sub _).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  
  have hXa : 0 < X / a := div_pos hX ha
  have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun b : ℝ => X / b) (X * (-(a ^ 2)⁻¹)) a := by
    convert (hasDerivAt_inv ha.ne').const_mul X using 1
    funext b
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  have hcomp : HasDerivAt (fun b => ∫ y in Ioi (X / b), f y)
      (-f (X / a) * (X * (-(a ^ 2)⁻¹))) a :=
    (hH (X / a) hXa).comp a hinner
  have hpow : HasDerivAt (fun b : ℝ => b ^ (1 - β)) ((1 - β) * a ^ (1 - β - 1)) a :=
    Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl ha.ne')
  have hprod := hpow.mul hcomp
  have hev : (fun b => ∫ x in Ioi X, x ^ (-β) * k (b / x)) =ᶠ[nhds a]
      fun b => b ^ (1 - β) * ∫ y in Ioi (X / b), f y := by
    filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds ha] with b hb
    exact hscale b hb
  refine (hprod.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).congr_deriv ?_
  rw [hscale a ha]
  simp only [hf_def]
  have hP : 0 < a ^ (-β) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos ha _
  have hQ : 0 < X ^ (-β) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hX _
  have e1 : a ^ (1 - β - 1) = a ^ (-β) := by congr 1; ring
  have e2 : a ^ (1 - β) = a * a ^ (-β) := by
    rw [show (1:ℝ) - β = 1 + -β by ring, Real.rpow_add ha, Real.rpow_one]
  have e3 : X ^ (1 - β) = X * X ^ (-β) := by
    rw [show (1:ℝ) - β = 1 + -β by ring, Real.rpow_add hX, Real.rpow_one]
  have e4 : (X / a) ^ (-β) = X ^ (-β) / a ^ (-β) := Real.div_rpow hX.le ha.le _
  have e5 : 1 / (X / a) = a / X := one_div_div X a
  rw [e1, e2, e3, e4, e5]
  field_simp

informal_problem.statement: ∀ z : ℝ, 1 ≤ z → HasDerivAt sigA 0 z

signature.name: sigA_flat
signature.statement: ∀ z : ℝ, 1 ≤ z → HasDerivAt sigA 0 z

proof.tactics:
by
  intro z hz
  have hE5 : (5:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 4 := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (4:ℝ)]
  have hEpos : 0 < Real.exp 4 := Real.exp_pos 4
  have hz1 : sigA z = 1 := by
    unfold sigA
    rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hz]
  have hexpinv : ∀ v : ℝ, 0 < v → Real.exp (-v) ≤ 1 / v := by
    intro v hv
    rw [Real.exp_neg, one_div]
    have h1 : v + 1 ≤ Real.exp v := Real.add_one_le_exp v
    exact inv_anti₀ hv (by linarith)
  have hB : ∀ w : ℝ, |sigA w - 1| ≤ Real.exp 4 * (w - z) ^ 2 := by
    intro w
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs with h0 h1
    · rw [show (0:ℝ) - 1 = -1 by norm_num, abs_neg, abs_one]
      have h2 : 1 ≤ (w - z) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg (z - w - 1)]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 4 - 1 by linarith)
        (show (0:ℝ) ≤ (w - z) ^ 2 - 1 by linarith)]
    · rw [sub_self, abs_zero]
      positivity
    · push_neg at h0 h1
      have he1p : 0 < Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) := Real.exp_pos _
      have he2p : 0 < Real.exp (-1 / (1 - w) ^ 2) := Real.exp_pos _
      have hsum : 0 < Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - w) ^ 2) := by linarith
      have heq : Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) / (Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - w) ^ 2)) - 1
          = -(Real.exp (-1 / (1 - w) ^ 2) /
              (Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - w) ^ 2))) := by
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [heq, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (div_pos he2p hsum)]
      by_cases hw : w ≤ 1 / 2
      · have hle1 : Real.exp (-1 / (1 - w) ^ 2) /
            (Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - w) ^ 2)) ≤ 1 :=
          (div_le_one hsum).mpr (by linarith)
        have h2 : 1 / 4 ≤ (w - z) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg (z - w - 1 / 2)]
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 4 - 4 by linarith)
          (show (0:ℝ) ≤ (w - z) ^ 2 - 1 / 4 by linarith)]
      · push_neg at hw
        have hw2 : 0 < w ^ 2 := by positivity
        have he1b : Real.exp (-4) ≤ Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) := by
          apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
          rw [le_div_iff₀ hw2]
          nlinarith
        have hE1 : 1 ≤ Real.exp 4 * Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) := by
          have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he1b hEpos.le
          rwa [← Real.exp_add, show (4:ℝ) + -4 = 0 by norm_num, Real.exp_zero] at h3
        have hstep : Real.exp (-1 / (1 - w) ^ 2) /
            (Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - w) ^ 2)) ≤
            Real.exp 4 * Real.exp (-1 / (1 - w) ^ 2) := by
          rw [div_le_iff₀ hsum]
          nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE1 he2p.le, mul_pos hEpos (mul_pos he2p he2p)]
        have hs : 0 < (1 - w) ^ 2 := by
          have : 0 < 1 - w := by linarith
          positivity
        have he2b : Real.exp (-1 / (1 - w) ^ 2) ≤ (1 - w) ^ 2 := by
          rw [neg_div]
          have h4 := hexpinv (1 / (1 - w) ^ 2) (by positivity)
          rwa [one_div_one_div] at h4
        have hsq : (1 - w) ^ 2 ≤ (w - z) ^ 2 := by
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ z - 1 by linarith)
            (show (0:ℝ) ≤ z + 1 - 2 * w by linarith)]
        calc Real.exp (-1 / (1 - w) ^ 2) /
              (Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - w) ^ 2))
            ≤ Real.exp 4 * Real.exp (-1 / (1 - w) ^ 2) := hstep
          _ ≤ Real.exp 4 * (1 - w) ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he2b hEpos.le
          _ ≤ Real.exp 4 * (w - z) ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hEpos.le
  apply HasDerivAt.of_isLittleO
  rw [Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
  intro c hc
  rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff]
  refine ⟨c / Real.exp 4, div_pos hc hEpos, ?_⟩
  intro w hw
  rw [Real.dist_eq] at hw
  simp only [hz1, smul_zero, sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  calc |sigA w - 1| ≤ Real.exp 4 * (w - z) ^ 2 := hB w
    _ = Real.exp 4 * |w - z| * |w - z| := by rw [← sq_abs]; ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp 4 * (c / Real.exp 4) * |w - z| := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (abs_nonneg _)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw.le hEpos.le
    _ = c * |w - z| := by field_simp

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h cinf ρ Xb : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), TailForm h cinf ρ Xb F U → ∀ X η : ℝ, Xb ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → profRadAvg U X η = 0 ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) X η = 0 ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) X η = cinf ^ 2 / 2 * ∫ x in Ioi X, x ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) ^ 2 ∧ leadPi F X η = -(cinf ^ 2 / 2 * ∫ x in Ioi X, x ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) ^ 2) ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) X η = Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * X ^ (1 - h) / (1 - h) - Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * ∫ x in Ioi X, x ^ (-h) * (heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) - 1)

signature.name: tail_backward_reps
signature.statement: ∀ (h cinf ρ Xb : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), TailForm h cinf ρ Xb F U → ∀ X η : ℝ, Xb ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → profRadAvg U X η = 0 ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) X η = 0 ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) X η = cinf ^ 2 / 2 * ∫ x in Ioi X, x ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) ^ 2 ∧ leadPi F X η = -(cinf ^ 2 / 2 * ∫ x in Ioi X, x ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) ^ 2) ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) X η = Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * X ^ (1 - h) / (1 - h) - Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * ∫ x in Ioi X, x ^ (-h) * (heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) - 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h cinf ρ Xb F U hT X η hX hη1 hη2
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hc0, hXb0, -, -, -, -, -, htail, hint⟩ := hT
  have hX0 : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hXb0 hX
  have hexp : Real.exp (-(11 / 4 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by norm_num)
  have hXt : ∀ x, Xb ≤ x → Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) ≤ x := fun x hx =>
    le_trans (mul_le_of_le_one_right hXb0.le hexp) hx
  
  have hpt : ∀ x, Xb ≤ x → U x η = 0 ∧
      Real.sqrt (2 * x) * F x η =
        cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hU, -, hE⟩ := htail x η (hXt x hx) hη1 hη2
    refine ⟨hU, ?_⟩
    have hfac : tailFac ρ Xb x = 1 := by
      have hl : 0 ≤ Real.log (x / Xb) := Real.log_nonneg ((one_le_div hXb0).2 hx)
      have hy : 1 ≤ (Real.log (x / Xb) + 2) / 2 := by linarith
      unfold tailFac sigA
      rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hy]
      ring
    rw [hE, hfac, mul_one]
  have hsqrt : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x →
      Real.sqrt (2 * x) * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) = Real.sqrt 2 * x ^ (-h) := by
    intro x hx
    rcases hx.lt_or_eq with hx | hx
    · rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2) x, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow x, mul_assoc,
        ← Real.rpow_add hx, show (1 / 2 : ℝ) + -(1 / 2 + h) = -h by ring]
    · subst hx
      rw [Real.zero_rpow (ne_of_lt (by linarith : -(1 / 2 + h) < (0:ℝ))),
        Real.zero_rpow (ne_of_lt (by linarith : -h < (0:ℝ)))]
      simp
  
  have hP : ∀ x, Xb ≤ x →
      U x η = 0 ∧ U x η * (2 * x * F x η) = 0 ∧
      U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2 =
        -(cinf ^ 2 / 2 * (x ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) ^ 2)) ∧
      F x η ^ 2 = cinf ^ 2 / 2 * (x ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) ^ 2) ∧
      2 * x * F x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) =
        Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * (x ^ (-h) * (heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) - 1)) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hXb0 hx
    obtain ⟨hU, hsF⟩ := hpt x hx
    have hs2 : Real.sqrt (2 * x) ^ 2 = 2 * x := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
    have hQ : x ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) = x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hx0]; congr 1; ring
    have hR : x ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) = x ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * x := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add_one hx0.ne']; congr 1; ring
    have hsP := hsqrt x hx0.le
    set s := Real.sqrt (2 * x)
    set P := x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))
    set Q := x ^ (-(1 + 2 * h))
    set R := x ^ (-(2 + 2 * h))
    set H := heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x)
    set T := x ^ (-h)
    set f := F x η
    rw [hU]
    refine ⟨rfl, by ring, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hQ]
      linear_combination (f ^ 2 / 2) * hs2 - ((s * f + cinf * P * H) / 2) * hsF
    · have h1 : x * f ^ 2 = cinf ^ 2 / 2 * (Q * H ^ 2) := by
        rw [hQ]
        linear_combination -(f ^ 2 / 2) * hs2 + ((s * f + cinf * P * H) / 2) * hsF
      rw [hR] at h1
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ hx0.ne'
      linear_combination h1
    · linear_combination (-f) * hs2 + s * hsF + cinf * (H - 1) * hsP
  
  have split : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, IntegrableOn g (Ioi 0) →
      ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, g x = (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), g x) - ∫ x in Ioi X, g x := by
    intro g hg
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hX0.le, ← Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hX0.le,
      MeasureTheory.setIntegral_union Set.Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same measurableSet_Ioi
        (hg.mono_set Set.Ioc_subset_Ioi_self) (hg.mono_set (Set.Ioi_subset_Ioi hX0.le))]
    ring
  obtain ⟨iJ, iS, iI, -, tJ, tS, tI, hII⟩ := hint η hη1 hη2
  obtain ⟨-, i2F, -, -, -⟩ := hII X hX0.le
  have hXI : ∀ x ∈ Ioi X, Xb ≤ x := fun x hx => hX.trans (le_of_lt hx)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have h0 : profRadInt U X η = 0 := (htail X η (hXt X hX) hη1 hη2).2.1
    unfold profRadInt at h0
    unfold profRadAvg
    have hc := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right (fun x => U x η) (a := 0) (b := 1) hX0.ne'
    simp only [zero_mul, one_mul, smul_eq_mul] at hc
    rw [hc, h0, mul_zero]
  · 
    show ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, U x η * (2 * x * F x η) = 0
    have e : ∫ x in Ioi X, U x η * (2 * x * F x η) = ∫ x in Ioi X, (0:ℝ) :=
      setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun x hx => (hP x (hXI x hx)).2.1)
    rw [split _ iJ, tJ, e]
    simp
  · 
    show ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, (U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2) = _
    have e : ∫ x in Ioi X, (U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2) = ∫ x in Ioi X,
        -(cinf ^ 2 / 2 * (x ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) ^ 2)) :=
      setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun x hx => (hP x (hXI x hx)).2.2.1)
    rw [split _ iS, tS, e, integral_neg, integral_const_mul]
    ring
  · 
    unfold leadPi
    have e : ∫ x in Ioi X, F x η ^ 2 = ∫ x in Ioi X,
        cinf ^ 2 / 2 * (x ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) ^ 2) :=
      setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun x hx => (hP x (hXI x hx)).2.2.2.1)
    rw [e, integral_const_mul]
  · 
    show ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, 2 * x * F x η = _
    have hg0 : EqOn (fun x : ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))
        (fun x => Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h)) (uIcc 0 X) := by
      intro x hx
      rw [uIcc_of_le hX0.le] at hx
      show Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) = Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h)
      have := hsqrt x hx.1

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h cinf ρ Xb X η F U hT hσ hHd hX hη1 hη2
  obtain ⟨hh0, -, hc0, hXb0, -, -, -, -, -, htail, -⟩ := hT
  have hX0 : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hXb0 hX
  have he : Real.exp (-(11 / 4 : ℝ)) < 1 := by
    have := Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (show (-(11 / 4 : ℝ)) < 0 by norm_num)
    rwa [Real.exp_zero] at this
  have hXt : Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) < X := by
    have : Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) < Xb := mul_lt_of_lt_one_right hXb0 he
    linarith
  
  have hform : ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y →
      Real.sqrt (2 * Y) * F Y η =
        cinf * Y ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / Y) * tailFac ρ Xb Y →
      F Y η = cinf / Real.sqrt 2 *
        (Y ^ (-h) / Y * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / Y) * tailFac ρ Xb Y) := by
    intro Y hY hE
    have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt Y := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hY
    have hss : Real.sqrt Y * Real.sqrt Y = Y := Real.mul_self_sqrt hY.le
    have h2 : 0 < Real.sqrt 2 := by positivity
    have hsq2 : Real.sqrt (2 * Y) = Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt Y := Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num) Y
    have hrp : Y ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) = Y ^ (-h) / Real.sqrt Y := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_sub hY]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [hsq2, hrp] at hE
    have key : F Y η * (Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt Y) =
        cinf * (Y ^ (-h) / Real.sqrt Y) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / Y) * tailFac ρ Xb Y := by
      rw [← hE]; ring
    have hF := eq_div_of_mul_eq (mul_pos h2 hs).ne' key
    have hYd : Y ^ (-h) / Y = Y ^ (-h) / (Real.sqrt Y * Real.sqrt Y) := by rw [hss]
    rw [hF, hYd]
    field_simp
  
  have hu1 : 1 ≤ (Real.log (X / Xb) + 2) / 2 := by
    have := Real.log_nonneg ((one_le_div hXb0).2 hX)
    linarith
  have hsig1 : sigA ((Real.log (X / Xb) + 2) / 2) = 1 := by
    unfold sigA
    rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hu1]
  have hT1 : tailFac ρ Xb X = 1 := by
    unfold tailFac
    rw [hsig1]
    ring
  have hTd : HasDerivAt (fun Y => tailFac ρ Xb Y) 0 X := by
    have hdiv : HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y / Xb) (1 / Xb) X := (hasDerivAt_id' X).div_const Xb
    have hlog := hdiv.log (div_pos hX0 hXb0).ne'
    have hu := (hlog.add_const 2).div_const 2
    have hs : HasDerivAt sigA 0 ((Real.log (X / Xb) + 2) / 2) := hσ _ hu1
    have hc := (((hs.comp X hu).const_sub 1).const_mul ρ).const_sub 1
    unfold tailFac
    exact hc.congr_deriv (by ring)
  
  have hp : HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y ^ (-h)) (-h * X ^ (-h - 1)) X :=
    Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl hX0.ne')
  have hq := hp.div (hasDerivAt_id' X) hX0.ne'
  have hav := (hasDerivAt_const X (2 * (1 - η ^ 2))).div (hasDerivAt_id' X) hX0.ne'
  have hH := hHd.hasDerivAt.comp X hav
  have hG := ((hq.mul hH).mul hTd).const_mul (cinf / Real.sqrt 2)
  have hev : (fun Y => F Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X] (fun Y => cinf / Real.sqrt 2 *
      (Y ^ (-h) / Y * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / Y) * tailFac ρ Xb Y)) := by
    filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hXt] with Y hY
    have hY0 : 0 < Y := lt_trans (mul_pos hXb0 (Real.exp_pos _)) hY
    exact hform Y hY0 (htail Y η (le_of_lt hY) hη1 hη2).2.2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hform X hX0 (htail X η hXt.le hη1 hη2).2.2, hT1]
    ring
  · refine (hG.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.div_apply]
    rw [hT1, Real.rpow_sub_one hX0.ne']
    field_simp
    ring

by

    rw [Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
    intro c hc
    rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff]
    refine ⟨c / Real.exp 4, div_pos hc hEpos, ?_⟩
    intro w hw

    · exact continuousOn_const.div continuousOn_id (fun x hx => (hX.trans hx).ne')
    · intro x hx; exact hz η x hη1 hη2 hx
    · exact continuousOn_const.div continuousOn_id (fun x hx => (hX.trans hx).ne')
  have hbF : ∀ x : ℝ, X < x → ‖p x * k (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x)‖ ≤ C * C * x ^ (-β) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    have h1 := hpb x hx
    have h2 := (hkd _ (hz η x hη1 hη2 hx)).2.1
    calc |p x| * |k (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x)| ≤ (C * x ^ (-β)) * C :=
          mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) (le_trans (abs_nonneg _) h1)
      _ = C * C * x ^ (-β) := by ring
  have hb4 : ∀ e x : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → X < x → |-(4 * e) / x| ≤ 4 / X := by
    intro e x h1 h2 hx
    have hx0 : 0 < x := hX.trans hx
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hx0, abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 4)]
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hx0 hX]
    have : |e| ≤ 1 := abs_le.2 ⟨h1.le, h2.le⟩
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg e]
  have hbF' : ∀ x : ℝ, X < x → ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 →
      ‖p x * (k' (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) * (-(4 * e) / x))‖ ≤ C * C * (4 / X) * x ^ (-β) := by
    intro x hx e h1 h2
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul]
    have h1' := hpb x hx
    have h2' := (hkd _ (hz e x h1 h2 hx)).2.2
    have h3' := hb4 e x h1 h2 hx
    have hA : |k' (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x)| * |-(4 * e) / x| ≤ C * (4 / X) :=
      mul_le_mul h2' h3' (abs_nonneg _) hC
    calc |p x| * (|k' (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x)| * |-(4 * e) / x|) ≤ (C * x ^ (-β)) * (C * (4 / X)) :=
          mul_le_mul h1' hA (by positivity) (le_trans (abs_nonneg _) h1')
      _ = C * C * (4 / X) * x ^ (-β) := by ring
  have hder : ∀ x : ℝ, X < x → ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 →
      HasDerivAt (fun e => p x * k (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x))
        (p x * (k' (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) * (-(4 * e) / x))) e := by
    intro x hx e h1 h2
    have hin : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => 2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) (-(4 * e) / x) e := by
      have := (((hasDerivAt_pow 2 e).const_sub 1).const_mul 2).div_const x
      convert this using 1
      norm_num
      ring
    have hout := (hkd _ (hz e x h1 h2 hx)).1
    exact (hout.comp e hin).const_mul (p x)
  have hs : Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ∈ nhds η := Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2
  have hmeas : ∀ᶠ e in nhds η, AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun x => p x * k (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x)) (volume.restrict (Ioi X)) := by
    filter_upwards [hs] with e he
    exact (hcontF e he.1 he.2).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi
  have hint : Integrable (fun x => p x * k (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x)) (volume.restrict (Ioi X)) := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (hgi.const_mul (C * C))
      ((hcontF η hη1 hη2).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi) ?_
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi]
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx => hbF x hx)
  have hbound_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => C * C * (4 / X) * x ^ (-β))
      (volume.restrict (Ioi X)) :=
    hgi.const_mul (C * C * (4 / X))
  have hbd : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Ioi X)), ∀ e ∈ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
      ‖p x * (k' (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) * (-(4 * e) / x))‖ ≤ C * C * (4 / X) * x ^ (-β) := by
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi]
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx e he => hbF' x hx e he.1 he.2)
  have hdd : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Ioi X)), ∀ e ∈ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
      HasDerivAt (fun e => p x * k (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x))
        (p x * (k' (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) * (-(4 * e) / x))) e := by
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi]
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx e he => hder x hx e he.1 he.2)
  have key := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (μ := volume.restrict (Ioi X))
    (F := fun e x => p x * k (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x))
    (F' := fun e x => p x * (k' (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) * (-(4 * e) / x)))
    (x₀ := η) (bound := fun x => C * C * (4 / X) * x ^ (-β)) hs hmeas hint
    (hcontF'.aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi) hbd hbound_int hdd
  exact ⟨hint, key.1, key.2⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (H H' f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (h c a X Xb C : ℝ), 0 < h → 0 < a → 0 < X → ContinuousOn H (Ioi 0) → ContinuousOn H' (Ioi 0) → ContinuousOn f' (Ioi 0) → (∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z → HasDerivAt H (H' z) z ∧ |H z| ≤ C ∧ |H' z| ≤ C) → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → HasDerivAt f (f' x) x ∧ |f x| ≤ 1) → (∀ x : ℝ, Xb ≤ x → f' x = 0) → IntegrableOn (fun x => (c * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * f x) ^ 2 * (H (a / x) ^ 2 + (x - X) * (-(2 * (1 / 2 + h)) * H (a / x) ^ 2 / x + 2 * H (a / x) * H' (a / x) * (-(a / x ^ 2))))) (Ioi X) ∧ ∫ x in Ioi X, (c * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * f x) ^ 2 * (H (a / x) ^ 2 + (x - X) * (-(2 * (1 / 2 + h)) * H (a / x) ^ 2 / x + 2 * H (a / x) * H' (a / x) * (-(a / x ^ 2)))) = -(2 * ∫ x in X..Xb, (x - X) * (c * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * H (a / x)) ^ 2 * f x * f' x)

signature.statement: ∀ (H H' f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (h c a X Xb C : ℝ), 0 < h → 0 < a → 0 < X → ContinuousOn H (Ioi 0) → ContinuousOn H' (Ioi 0) → ContinuousOn f' (Ioi 0) → (∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z → HasDerivAt H (H' z) z ∧ |H z| ≤ C ∧ |H' z| ≤ C) → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → HasDerivAt f (f' x) x ∧ |f x| ≤ 1) → (∀ x : ℝ, Xb ≤ x → f' x = 0) → IntegrableOn (fun x => (c * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * f x) ^ 2 * (H (a / x) ^ 2 + (x - X) * (-(2 * (1 / 2 + h)) * H (a / x) ^ 2 / x + 2 * H (a / x) * H' (a / x) * (-(a / x ^ 2))))) (Ioi X) ∧ ∫ x in Ioi X, (c * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * f x) ^ 2 * (H (a / x) ^ 2 + (x - X) * (-(2 * (1 / 2 + h)) * H (a / x) ^ 2 / x + 2 * H (a / x) * H' (a / x) * (-(a / x ^ 2)))) = -(2 * ∫ x in X..Xb, (x - X) * (c * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * H (a / x)) ^ 2 * f x * f' x)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro H H' f f' h c a X Xb C hh ha hX hHc hH'c hf'c hH hf hf0
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ → ℝ, G = fun x => (c * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * f x) ^ 2 * (H (a / x) ^ 2 + (x - X) * (-(2 * (1 / 2 + h)) * H (a / x) ^ 2 / x + 2 * H (a / x) * H' (a / x) * (-(a / x ^ 2)))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ → ℝ, K = fun x => (x - X) * (c * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * H (a / x)) ^ 2 * f x * f' x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ : ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℝ, Φ = fun y => (y - X) * (c * y ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * f y) ^ 2 * H (a / y) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hx0 : ∀ x ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ), x ≠ 0 := fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx
  have hfc : ContinuousOn f (Ioi 0) := fun x hx => (hf x hx).1.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hrp : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) (Ioi 0) := fun x hx =>
    (Real.continuousAt_rpow_const x _ (Or.inl (ne_of_gt hx))).continuousWithinAt
  have hdv : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => a / x) (Ioi 0) := continuousOn_const.div continuousOn_id hx0
  have hmp : MapsTo (fun x : ℝ => a / x) (Ioi 0) (Ioi 0) := fun x hx => div_pos ha hx
  have hHa : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => H (a / x)) (Ioi 0) := hHc.comp hdv hmp
  have hH'a : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => H' (a / x)) (Ioi 0) := hH'c.comp hdv hmp
  have hGc : ContinuousOn G (Ioi 0) := by
    rw [hG]
    apply ContinuousOn.mul
    · exact ((continuousOn_const.mul hrp).mul hfc).pow 2
    · apply ContinuousOn.add (hHa.pow 2)
      apply ContinuousOn.mul (continuousOn_id.sub continuousOn_const)
      apply ContinuousOn.add
      · exact (continuousOn_const.mul (hHa.pow 2)).div continuousOn_id hx0
      · exact ((continuousOn_const.mul hHa).mul hH'a).mul
          ((continuousOn_const.div (continuousOn_id.pow 2)
            (fun x hx => pow_ne_zero 2 (hx0 x hx))).neg)
  have hKc : ContinuousOn K (Ioi 0) := by
    rw [hK]
    exact (((continuousOn_id.sub continuousOn_const).mul
      (((continuousOn_const.mul hrp).mul hHa).pow 2)).mul hfc).mul hf'c
  
  have hderiv : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → HasDerivAt Φ (G x + 2 * K x) x := by
    intro x hx
    have hxne : x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hx
    have hax : 0 < a / x := div_pos ha hx
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))
        ((-(1 / 2 + h)) * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) - 1)) x := Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl hxne)
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => a / y) (-(a / x ^ 2)) x := by
      have := (hasDerivAt_inv hxne).const_mul a
      convert this using 1
      · ext y; simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
      · field_simp
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun y => H (a / y)) (H' (a / x) * (-(a / x ^ 2))) x :=
      (hH (a / x) hax).1.comp x h2
    have h4 := (hf x hx).1
    have hg := (h1.const_mul c).mul h4
    have hΦd := (((hasDerivAt_id' x).sub_const X).mul (hg.pow 2)).mul (h3.pow 2)
    rw [hΦ]
    refine hΦd.congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [hG, hK, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.pow_apply, Real.rpow_sub_one hxne]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hGi : IntegrableOn G (Ioi X) := by
    have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable G (volume.restrict (Ioi X)) :=
      (hGc.mono (Ioi_subset_Ioi hX.le)).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi
    have hdom : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => c ^ 2 * (C ^ 2 * (1 + 2 * (1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (a / X))) *
        x ^ (-(1 + 2 * h))) (Ioi X) :=
      (integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) hX).const_mul _
    refine Integrable.mono' hdom hmeas ?_
    refine (ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi).mono fun x hx => ?_
    have hxp : 0 < x := lt_trans hX (mem_Ioi.mp hx)
    have hxX : X < x := mem_Ioi.mp hx
    have hr2 : (x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) ^ 2 = x ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) := by
      rw [sq, ← Real.rpow_add hxp]; congr 1; ring
    have hax : 0 < a / x := div_pos ha hxp
    obtain ⟨-, hu, hv⟩ := hH (a / x) hax
    have hF := (hf x hxp).2
    have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hu
    have hq : H (a / x) ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hu 2
    have hq0 : 0 ≤ H (a / x) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    have hw : |H (a / x) * H' (a / x)| ≤ C ^ 2 := by
      rw [abs_mul, sq]; exact mul_le_mul hu hv (abs_nonneg _) hC0
    have hF2 : f x ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← sq_abs]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg (f x)]
    set t := (x - X) / x with ht
    set s := a / x with hs
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := div_nonneg (by linarith) hxp.le
    have ht1 : t ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hxp).mpr (by linarith)
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := hax.le
    have hs1 : s ≤ a / X := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left ha.le hX hxX.le
    have hB : H s ^ 2 + (x - X) * (-(2 * (1 / 2 + h)) * H s ^ 2 / x + 2 * H s * H' s * (-(a / x ^ 2)))
        = H s ^ 2 - 2 * (1 / 2 + h) * (t * H s ^ 2) - 2 * (t * s * (H s * H' s)) := by
      rw [ht, hs]; field_simp; ring
    have e1 : t * H s ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have e1' : 0 ≤ t * H s ^ 2 := mul_nonneg ht0 hq0
    have e2 : |t * s * (H s * H' s)| ≤ a / X * C ^ 2 := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg ht0 hs0)]
      have : t * s ≤ a / X := by nlinarith
      exact mul_le_mul this hw (abs_nonneg _) (le_trans (mul_nonneg ht0 hs0) this)
    have e3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e1 hh.le
    have e4 := mul_nonneg hh.le e1'
    have haX : 0 ≤ a / X * C ^ 2 := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) e2
    have hBb : |H s ^ 2 - 2 * (1 / 2 + h) * (t * H s ^ 2) - 2 * (t * s * (H s * H' s))|
        ≤ C ^ 2 * (1 + 2 * (1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (a / X)) := by
      rw [abs_le]
      obtain ⟨l2, u2⟩ := abs_le.mp e2
      constructor <;> nlinarith
    rw [hG]
    simp only
    rw [hB, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    have hcr : (c * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * f x) ^ 2 ≤ c ^ 2 * x ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) := by
      rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, hr2]
      have : 0 ≤ c ^ 2 * x ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hxp.le _)
      nlinarith
    calc (c * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * f x) ^ 2 *
          |H s ^ 2 - 2 * (1 / 2 + h) * (t * H s ^ 2) - 2 * (t * s * (H s * H' s))|
        ≤ (c ^ 2 * x ^ (-(1 + 2 * h))) * (C ^ 2 * (1 + 2 * (1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (a / X))) :=
          mul_le_mul hcr hBb (abs_nonneg _)
            (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hxp.le _))
      _ = c ^ 2 * (C ^ 2 * (1 + 2 * (1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (a / X))) * x ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) := by ring
  
  have hlim : Filter.Tendsto Φ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hm : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => c ^ 2 * C ^ 2 * y ^ (-(2 * h))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop (by linarith : 0 < 2 * h)).const_mul (c ^ 2 * C ^ 2)
    refine squeeze_zero_norm' ?_ hm
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop X] with y hy
    have hyp : 0 < y := lt_of_lt_of_le hX hy
    have hr2 : (y ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) ^ 2 = y ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) := by
      rw [sq, ← Real.rpow_add hyp]; congr 1; ring
    have hyy : y ^ (-(2 * h)) = y * y ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) := by
      rw [show -(2 * h) = 1 + (-(1 + 2 * h)) by ring, Real.rpow_add hyp, Real.rpow_one]
    have hay : 0 < a / y := div_pos ha hyp
    obtain ⟨-, hu, -⟩ := hH (a / y) hay
    have hF := (hf y hyp).2
    have hq : H (a / y) ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hu 2
    have hF2 : f y ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← sq_abs]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg (f y)]
    have hR : 0 ≤ y ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hyp.le _
    have hcr : (c * y ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * f y) ^ 2 ≤ c ^ 2 * y ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) := by
      rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, hr2]
      have : 0 ≤ c ^ 2 * y ^ (-(1 + 2 * h)) := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hR
      nlinarith
    rw [hΦ]
    simp only
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity), hyy]
    calc (y - X) * (c * y ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * f y) ^ 2 * H (a / y) ^ 2
        ≤ y * (c ^ 2 * y ^ (-(1 + 2 * h))) * C ^ 2 := by
          apply mul_le_mul _ hq (sq_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hyp.le (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hR))
          exact mul_le_mul (by linarith) hcr (sq_nonneg _) hyp.le
      _ = c ^ 2 * C ^ 2 * (y * y ^ (-(1 + 2 * h))) := by ring
  
  have hK0 : ∀ x : ℝ, Xb ≤ x → K x = 0 := fun x hx => by rw [hK]; simp only; rw [hf0 x hx, mul_zero]
  have hKi1 : IntegrableOn K (Ioc X (max X Xb)) :=
    ((hKc.mono (fun x hx => lt_of_lt_of_le hX hx.1)).integrableOn_Icc).mono_set Ioc_subset_Icc_self
  have hKi2 : IntegrableOn K (Ioi (max X Xb)) :=
    (integrableOn_zero).congr_fun
      (fun x hx => (hK0 x (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_of_lt hx))).symm) measurableSet_Ioi
  have hKi : IntegrableOn K (Ioi X) := by
    rw [← Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi (le_max_left X Xb)]
    exact hKi1.union hKi2
  have hKint : ∫ x in Ioi X, K x = ∫ x in X..Xb, K x := by
    have hz1 : ∫ x in Ioi (max X Xb), K x = 0 :=
      setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
        (fun x (hx : x ∈ Ioi (max X Xb)) => hK0 x (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_of_lt hx)))
    rw [← Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi (le_max_left X Xb),
      setIntegral_union Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same measurableSet_Ioi hKi1 hKi2, hz1, add_zero]
    rcases le_total X Xb with hle | hle
    · rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hle, max_eq_right hle]
    · have hz2 : ∫ x in Ioc Xb X, K x = 0 :=
        setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero (fun x (hx : x ∈ Ioc Xb X) => hK0 x hx.1.le)
      rw [max_eq_left hle, Ioc_self, Measure.restrict_empty, integral_zero_measure,
        intervalIntegral.integral_symm, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hle, hz2, neg_zero]
  
  have hftc := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto (f := Φ) (f' := fun x => G x + 2 * K x)
    (a := X) (m := 0) ((hderiv X hX).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
    (fun x hx => hderiv x (lt_trans hX hx)) (hGi.add (hKi.const_mul 2)) hlim
  have hΦX : Φ X = 0 := by rw [hΦ]; simp
  rw [integral_add hGi (hKi.const_mul 2), integral_const_mul, hΦX] at hftc
  have key : IntegrableOn G (Ioi X) ∧ ∫ x in Ioi X, G x = -(2 * ∫ x in X..Xb, K x) :=
    ⟨hGi, by rw [← hKint]; linarith⟩
  subst hG hK
  exact key

signature.statement: ContDiff ℝ 1 sigA

proof.tactics:
by
  have hm : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun w : ℝ => w * |w|) (2 * |y|) y := by
    intro y
    rcases lt_trichotomy y 0 with hy | hy | hy
    · have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℝ => -(w ^ 2)) (2 * |y|) y := by
        have := (hasDerivAt_pow 2 y).neg
        convert this using 1
        rw [abs_of_neg hy]; push_cast; ring
      refine h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hy] with w hw
      rw [abs_of_neg hw]; ring
    · subst hy
      rw [hasDerivAt_iff_isLittleO, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
      intro c hc
      filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0:ℝ) hc] with w hw
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at hw
      simp only [abs_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero, smul_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_abs]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hw.le (abs_nonneg w)
    · have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℝ => w ^ 2) (2 * |y|) y := by
        convert hasDerivAt_pow 2 y using 1
        rw [abs_of_pos hy]; push_cast; ring
      refine h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hy] with w hw
      rw [abs_of_pos hw]; ring
  have hmC : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun w : ℝ => w * |w|) := by
    rw [contDiff_one_iff_deriv]
    refine ⟨fun y => (hm y).differentiableAt, ?_⟩
    have hd : deriv (fun w : ℝ => w * |w|) = fun y => 2 * |y| := funext fun y => (hm y).deriv
    rw [hd]
    exact continuous_const.mul continuous_abs
  obtain ⟨q, hq_def⟩ : ∃ q : ℝ → ℝ, q = fun y => expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hqC : ContDiff ℝ 1 q := by
    rw [hq_def]
    exact expNegInvGlue.contDiff.comp hmC
  have hq1C : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun y => q (1 - y)) := hqC.comp (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id)
  have hDC : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun y => q y + q (1 - y)) := hqC.add hq1C
  have qpos_arg : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → 0 < y * |y| := fun y hy => by
    rw [abs_of_pos hy]; exact mul_pos hy hy
  have qa : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → q y = 0 := fun y hy => by
    rw [hq_def]
    exact expNegInvGlue.zero_of_nonpos (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hy (abs_nonneg y))
  have qb : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → 0 < q y := fun y hy => by
    rw [hq_def]
    exact expNegInvGlue.pos_of_pos (qpos_arg y hy)
  have qc : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ q y := fun y => by
    rw [hq_def]
    exact expNegInvGlue.nonneg _
  have qd : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → q y = Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hq_def]
    show expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) = _
    rw [expNegInvGlue, if_neg (not_le.mpr (qpos_arg y hy)), abs_of_pos hy]
    congr 1
    rw [neg_div, one_div, sq]
  have hDpos : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < q y + q (1 - y) := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : 0 < y
    · exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (qb y hy) (qc _)
    · exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (qc y) (qb _ (by linarith [not_lt.mp hy]))
  have heq : sigA = fun y => q y / (q y + q (1 - y)) := by
    funext y
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · rw [qa y h1, zero_div]
    · have hy : 0 < y := not_le.mp h1
      rw [qa (1 - y) (by linarith), add_zero, div_self (qb y hy).ne']
    · have hy : 0 < y := not_le.mp h1
      rw [qd y hy, qd (1 - y) (by linarith [not_le.mp h2])]
  rw [heq]
  exact hqC.div hDC (fun y => (hDpos y).ne')

informal_problem.statement: ∀ ρ Xb : ℝ, 0 < Xb → ContDiff ℝ 1 sigA → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → HasDerivAt (tailFac ρ Xb) (deriv (tailFac ρ Xb) x) x) ∧ ContinuousOn (deriv (tailFac ρ Xb)) (Ioi 0) ∧ ContinuousOn (tailFac ρ Xb) (Ioi 0) ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, Xb ≤ x → tailFac ρ Xb x = 1

signature.name: tailFac_facts
signature.statement: ∀ ρ Xb : ℝ, 0 < Xb → ContDiff ℝ 1 sigA → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → HasDerivAt (tailFac ρ Xb) (deriv (tailFac ρ Xb) x) x) ∧ ContinuousOn (deriv (tailFac ρ Xb)) (Ioi 0) ∧ ContinuousOn (tailFac ρ Xb) (Ioi 0) ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, Xb ≤ x → tailFac ρ Xb x = 1

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ρ Xb hXb hσ
  have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun X : ℝ => (Real.log (X / Xb) + 2) / 2) (Ioi 0) := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun X : ℝ => X / Xb) (Ioi 0) :=
      (contDiffOn_id.div_const Xb)
    exact ((h1.log (fun x hx => (div_pos (Set.mem_Ioi.mp hx) hXb).ne')).add
      contDiffOn_const).div_const 2
  have hσg := hσ.comp_contDiffOn hg
  have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (tailFac ρ Xb) (Ioi 0) := by
    have := contDiffOn_const (c := (1:ℝ)) |>.sub
      ((contDiffOn_const (c := ρ)).mul ((contDiffOn_const (c := (1:ℝ))).sub hσg))
    refine this.congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    simp only [tailFac, Function.comp_apply]
  refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, hf.continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioi le_rfl, hf.continuousOn, ?_⟩
  · exact ((hf.contDiffAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero).hasDerivAt
  · intro x hx
    have hl : 0 ≤ Real.log (x / Xb) := Real.log_nonneg ((one_le_div hXb).2 hx)
    have hy : 1 ≤ (Real.log (x / Xb) + 2) / 2 := by linarith
    unfold tailFac sigA
    rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hy]
    ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h cinf x e : ℝ), 0 < x → -1 < e → e < 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → Z ^ 2 * deriv (deriv (heatProfile h)) Z + (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * deriv (heatProfile h) Z + h * (1 + h) * heatProfile h Z = 0) → HasDerivAt (fun y => tailHt h cinf y e) (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h) / x * (-(h * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x)) - 2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x))) x ∧ HasDerivAt (fun e' => tailHt h cinf x e') (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h) * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) * (-(4 * e) / x)) e ∧ HasDerivAt (fun y => 2 * (1 - 2 * h * e ^ 2) * (tailHt h cinf y e - y * deriv (fun z => tailHt h cinf z e) y) + y * tailHt h cinf y e) ((1 - h) * tailHt h cinf x e - (1 / 2 - h) * e * (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h) * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) * (-(4 * e) / x))) x ∧ ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * y ^ (-h) * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y) * (-(4 * e) / y)) (Ioi 0)

signature.name: tailHt_calculus
signature.statement: ∀ (h cinf x e : ℝ), 0 < x → -1 < e → e < 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → Z ^ 2 * deriv (deriv (heatProfile h)) Z + (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * deriv (heatProfile h) Z + h * (1 + h) * heatProfile h Z = 0) → HasDerivAt (fun y => tailHt h cinf y e) (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h) / x * (-(h * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x)) - 2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x))) x ∧ HasDerivAt (fun e' => tailHt h cinf x e') (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h) * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) * (-(4 * e) / x)) e ∧ HasDerivAt (fun y => 2 * (1 - 2 * h * e ^ 2) * (tailHt h cinf y e - y * deriv (fun z => tailHt h cinf z e) y) + y * tailHt h cinf y e) ((1 - h) * tailHt h cinf x e - (1 / 2 - h) * e * (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h) * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) * (-(4 * e) / x))) x ∧ ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * y ^ (-h) * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y) * (-(4 * e) / y)) (Ioi 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h cinf x e hx he1 he2 hP hODE
  have ha : 0 < 2 * (1 - e ^ 2) := by nlinarith
  have hPd : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z → HasDerivAt (heatProfile h) (deriv (heatProfile h) z) z := fun z hz =>
    ((hP.contDiffAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasDerivAt
  have hP1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (deriv (heatProfile h)) (Ioi 0) :=
    hP.deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioi (by simp)
  have hP'd : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      HasDerivAt (deriv (heatProfile h)) (deriv (deriv (heatProfile h)) z) z := fun z hz =>
    ((hP1.contDiffAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasDerivAt
  have hP'c : ContinuousOn (deriv (heatProfile h)) (Ioi 0) := hP1.continuousOn
  have chain : ∀ (H : ℝ → ℝ) (c a y H1 : ℝ), 0 < y → HasDerivAt H H1 (a / y) →
      HasDerivAt (fun y => c * y ^ (-h) * H (a / y))
        (c * y ^ (-h) / y * (-(h * H (a / y)) - a / y * H1)) y := by
    intro H c a y H1 hy hH
    have hp : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (-h)) ((-h) * y ^ (-h - 1)) y :=
      Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl hy.ne')
    have hq : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => a / y) (a * -(y ^ 2)⁻¹) y := by
      convert (hasDerivAt_inv hy.ne').const_mul a using 1
      funext z
      exact div_eq_mul_inv a z
    have hc := (hp.const_mul c).mul (hH.comp y hq)
    refine hc.congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    generalize H (a / y) = Hv
    rw [Real.rpow_sub_one hy.ne']
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hHx : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → HasDerivAt (fun z => tailHt h cinf z e)
      (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * y ^ (-h) / y * (-(h * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y)) -
        2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y))) y := by
    intro y hy
    exact chain (heatProfile h) (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2)) y _ hy
      (hPd _ (div_pos ha hy))
  have hZ : 0 < 2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x := div_pos ha hx
  
  have hae : HasDerivAt (fun e' : ℝ => 2 * (1 - e' ^ 2)) (-(4 * e)) e := by
    have := ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 e).const_sub 1).const_mul 2
    convert this using 1
    norm_num <;> ring
  have hge : HasDerivAt (fun e' : ℝ => 2 * (1 - e' ^ 2) / x) (-(4 * e) / x) e := hae.div_const x
  have hii : HasDerivAt (fun e' => tailHt h cinf x e')
      (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h) * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) *
        (-(4 * e) / x)) e := by
    have := ((hPd _ hZ).comp e hge).const_mul (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h))
    refine this.congr_deriv ?_
    ring
  
  have hB : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y →
      2 * (1 - 2 * h * e ^ 2) * (tailHt h cinf y e - y * deriv (fun z => tailHt h cinf z e) y) +
          y * tailHt h cinf y e =
        2 * (1 - 2 * h * e ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * y ^ (-h) *
          ((1 + h) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y) +
            2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y))) +
          y * tailHt h cinf y e := by
    intro y hy
    have hyy : y * y⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hy.ne'
    rw [(hHx y hy).deriv]
    unfold tailHt
    linear_combination (2 * (1 - 2 * h * e ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * y ^ (-h)) *
      (h * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y) +
        2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y))) * hyy
  have hg' : HasDerivAt (fun z => (1 + h) * heatProfile h z + z * deriv (heatProfile h) z)
      ((1 + h) * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) +
        (1 * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) +
          2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x * deriv (deriv (heatProfile h)) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x)))
      (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) :=
    ((hPd _ hZ).const_mul (1 + h)).add ((hasDerivAt_id' _).mul (hP'd _ hZ))
  have hBd := chain _ (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2)) x _ hx hg'
  have hK := (hBd.const_mul (2 * (1 - 2 * h * e ^ 2))).add ((hasDerivAt_id' x).mul (hHx x hx))
  have hiii : HasDerivAt (fun y => 2 * (1 - 2 * h * e ^ 2) *
      (tailHt h cinf y e - y * deriv (fun z => tailHt h cinf z e) y) + y * tailHt h cinf y e)
      ((1 - h) * tailHt h cinf x e - (1 / 2 - h) * e * (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h) *
        deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) * (-(4 * e) / x))) x := by
    refine (hK.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_).congr_deriv ?_
    · filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hx] with y hy
      exact hB y hy
    · have hode := hODE _ hZ
      have hxx : x * x⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hx.ne'
      unfold tailHt
      beta_reduce
      linear_combination (-(2 * (1 - 2 * h * e ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h)) * x⁻¹)) * hode +
        (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h) * (-(h * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x)) -
          2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x))) * hxx
  
  have hiv : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * y ^ (-h) *
      deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y) * (-(4 * e) / y)) (Ioi 0) := by
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (-h)) (Ioi 0) :=
      continuousOn_id.rpow_const (fun y hy => Or.inl (ne_of_gt hy))
    have h2 : ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ => 2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y) (Ioi 0) :=
      continuousOn_const.div continuousOn_id (fun y hy => ne_of_gt hy)
    have h3 : ContinuousOn (fun y => deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y)) (Ioi 0) :=
      hP'c.comp h2 (fun y hy => div_pos ha hy)
    have h4 : ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ => -(4 * e) / y) (Ioi 0) :=
      continuousOn_const.div continuousOn_id (fun y hy => ne_of_gt hy)
    exact ((continuousOn_const.mul h1).mul h3).mul h4
  exact ⟨hHx x hx, hii, hiii, hiv⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h cinf ρ Xb : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), TailForm h cinf ρ Xb F U → ContinuousOn (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) → Continuous sigA → ∀ X e : ℝ, Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) < X → -1 < e → e < 1 → profRadAvg U X e = 0 ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) X e = 0 ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) X e = Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * X ^ (1 - h) / (1 - h) - Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * (∫ x in Ioi X, x ^ (-h) * (heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) - 1)) - ∫ x in X..Xb, tailHt h cinf x e * (tailFac ρ Xb x - 1)

signature.name: collar_I_rep
signature.statement: ∀ (h cinf ρ Xb : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), TailForm h cinf ρ Xb F U → ContinuousOn (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) → Continuous sigA → ∀ X e : ℝ, Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) < X → -1 < e → e < 1 → profRadAvg U X e = 0 ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) X e = 0 ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) X e = Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * X ^ (1 - h) / (1 - h) - Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * (∫ x in Ioi X, x ^ (-h) * (heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) - 1)) - ∫ x in X..Xb, tailHt h cinf x e * (tailFac ρ Xb x - 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h cinf ρ Xb F U hT hP hσ X e hX he1 he2
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hc0, hXb0, hρ0, hρ1, -, -, -, htail, hint⟩ := hT
  have hXt0 : 0 < Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) := mul_pos hXb0 (Real.exp_pos _)
  have hX0 : 0 < X := hXt0.trans hX
  have ha : 0 < 2 * (1 - e ^ 2) := by nlinarith
  have hIoi : ∀ x ∈ Ioi X, Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) ≤ x := fun x hx => le_of_lt (hX.trans hx)
  
  have hfac : ∀ x, Xb ≤ x → tailFac ρ Xb x = 1 := by
    intro x hx
    have hl : 0 ≤ Real.log (x / Xb) := Real.log_nonneg ((one_le_div hXb0).2 hx)
    have hy : 1 ≤ (Real.log (x / Xb) + 2) / 2 := by linarith
    unfold tailFac sigA
    rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hy]
    ring
  have hsqrt : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x →
      Real.sqrt (2 * x) * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) = Real.sqrt 2 * x ^ (-h) := by
    intro x hx
    rcases hx.lt_or_eq with hx | hx
    · rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2) x, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow x, mul_assoc,
        ← Real.rpow_add hx, show (1 / 2 : ℝ) + -(1 / 2 + h) = -h by ring]
    · subst hx
      rw [Real.zero_rpow (ne_of_lt (by linarith : -(1 / 2 + h) < (0:ℝ))),
        Real.zero_rpow (ne_of_lt (by linarith : -h < (0:ℝ)))]
      simp
  
  have hpt : ∀ x, Xb * Real.exp (-(11 / 4)) ≤ x → U x e = 0 ∧ U x e * (2 * x * F x e) = 0 ∧
      2 * x * F x e - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) =
        Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * (x ^ (-h) * (heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) - 1)) +
          tailHt h cinf x e * (tailFac ρ Xb x - 1) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : 0 < x := hXt0.trans_le hx
    obtain ⟨hU, -, hsF⟩ := htail x e hx he1 he2
    have hs2 : Real.sqrt (2 * x) ^ 2 = 2 * x := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
    have hsP := hsqrt x hx0.le
    unfold tailHt
    rw [hU]
    refine ⟨rfl, by ring, ?_⟩
    linear_combination (-F x e) * hs2 + Real.sqrt (2 * x) * hsF +
      cinf * (heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) * tailFac ρ Xb x - 1) * hsP
  
  have hrc : ContinuousOn (fun x => tailHt h cinf x e * (tailFac ρ Xb x - 1)) (Ioi 0) := by
    have c1 : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (-h)) (Ioi 0) :=
      continuousOn_id.rpow_const (fun x hx => Or.inl (ne_of_gt hx))
    have c2 : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x)) (Ioi 0) :=
      hP.comp (continuousOn_const.div continuousOn_id (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx))
        (fun x hx => div_pos ha hx)
    have c3 : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => tailFac ρ Xb x) (Ioi 0) := by
      have cl : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => Real.log (x / Xb)) (Ioi 0) :=
        (continuousOn_id.div_const Xb).log (fun x hx => div_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hx) hXb0.ne')
      have cs : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => sigA ((Real.log (x / Xb) + 2) / 2)) (Ioi 0) :=
        hσ.comp_continuousOn ((cl.add continuousOn_const).div_const 2)
      unfold tailFac
      exact continuousOn_const.sub (continuousOn_const.mul (continuousOn_const.sub cs))
    unfold tailHt
    exact ((continuousOn_const.mul c1).mul c2).mul (c3.sub continuousOn_const)
  
  have compact : ∀ r : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn r (Ioi 0) → (∀ x, Xb ≤ x → r x = 0) →
      IntegrableOn r (Ioi X) ∧ ∫ x in Ioi X, r x = ∫ x in X..Xb, r x := by
    intro r hrc' hr0
    have hM1 : X ≤ max X Xb := le_max_left _ _
    have hM2 : Xb ≤ max X Xb := le_max_right _ _
    have hrM : EqOn (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) r (Ioi (max X Xb)) := fun x hx =>
      (hr0 x (hM2.trans (le_of_lt hx))).symm
    have hrIM : IntegrableOn r (Ioi (max X Xb)) :=
      (integrableOn_zero).congr_fun hrM measurableSet_Ioi
    have hrIc : IntegrableOn r (Ioc X (max X Xb)) :=
      ((hrc'.mono (fun x hx => lt_of_lt_of_le hX0 hx.1)).integrableOn_Icc).mono_set
        Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self
    have hzero : ∫ x in Ioi (max X Xb), r x = 0 := by
      rw [setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi hrM.symm]
      simp
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hM1]
      exact hrIc.union hrIM
    · rw [← Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hM1,
        MeasureTheory.setIntegral_union Set.Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same measurableSet_Ioi hrIc hrIM,
        hzero, add_zero, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hM1]
      rcases le_total X Xb with hXX | hXX
      · rw [max_eq_right hXX]
      · rw [max_eq_left hXX, intervalIntegral.integral_same]
        have : ∫ x in X..Xb, r x = ∫ x in X..Xb, (0:ℝ) := by
          refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x hx => ?_)
          rw [uIcc_of_ge hXX] at hx
          exact hr0 x hx.1
        rw [this]
        simp
  obtain ⟨hrI, hrE⟩ := compact (fun x => tailHt h cinf x e * (tailFac ρ Xb x - 1)) hrc
    (fun x hx => by simp only [hfac x hx, sub_self, mul_zero])
  
  have split : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, IntegrableOn g (Ioi 0) →
      ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, g x = (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), g x) - ∫ x in Ioi X, g x := by
    intro g hg
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hX0.le, ← Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hX0.le,
      MeasureTheory.setIntegral_union Set.Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same measurableSet_Ioi
        (hg.mono_set Set.Ioc_subset_Ioi_self) (hg.mono_set (Set.Ioi_subset_Ioi hX0.le))]
    ring
  obtain ⟨iJ, -, iI, -, tJ, -, tI, hII⟩ := hint e he1 he2
  obtain ⟨-, i2F, -, -, -⟩ := hII X hX0.le
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have h0 : profRadInt U X e = 0 := (htail X e hX.le he1 he2).2.1
    unfold profRadInt at h0
    unfold profRadAvg
    have hc := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right (fun x => U x e) (a := 0) (b := 1) hX0.ne'
    simp only [zero_mul, one_mul, smul_eq_mul] at hc
    rw [hc, h0, mul_zero]
  · 
    show ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, U x e * (2 * x * F x e) = 0
    have e0 : ∫ x in Ioi X, U x e * (2 * x * F x e) = ∫ x in Ioi X, (0:ℝ) :=
      setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun x hx => (hpt x (hIoi x hx)).2.1)
    rw [split _ iJ, tJ, e0]
    simp
  · 
    show ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, 2 * x * F x e = _
    have hg0 : EqOn (fun x : ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))
        (fun x => Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h)) (uIcc 0 X) := by
      intro x hx
      rw [uIcc_of_le hX0.le] at hx
      show Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) = Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h)
      have := hsqrt x hx.1
      linear_combination cinf * this
    have i0' : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h)) volume 0 X :=
      (intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_rpow' (by linarith)).const_mul _
    have i0 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))
        volume 0 X :=
      i0'.congr (fun x hx => (hg0 (Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hx)).symm)
    have v0 : ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) =
        Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * X ^ (1 - h) / (1 - h) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr hg0, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        integral_rpow (Or.inl (by linarith)),
        Real.zero_rpow (ne_of_gt (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < -h + 1)),
        show -h + 1 = 1 - h by ring]
      ring
    have hsub := intervalIntegral.integral_sub i2F i0
    have hAI : IntegrableOn
        (fun x => Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * (x ^ (-h) * (heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) - 1)))
        (Ioi X) :=
      ((iI.mono_set (Set.Ioi_subset_Ioi hX0.le)).sub hrI).congr_fun (fun x hx => by
        have := (hpt x (hIoi x hx)).2.2
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
        linarith) measurableSet_Ioi
    have e1 : ∫ x in Ioi X, (2 * x * F x e - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) =
        ∫ x in Ioi X, (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * (x ^ (-h) * (heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) - 1)) +
          tailHt h cinf x e * (tailFac ρ Xb x - 1)) :=
      setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun x hx => (hpt x (hIoi x hx)).2.2)
    have hspl := split _ iI
    rw [tI, e1, integral_add hAI hrI, integral_const_mul, hrE] at hspl
    linarith [hsub, hspl, v0]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h cinf ρ Xb X η C1 : ℝ), 0 < X → 0 < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |deriv (heatProfile h) Z| ≤ C1) → ContinuousOn (tailFac ρ Xb) (Ioi 0) → HasDerivAt (fun e => ∫ x in X..Xb, tailHt h cinf x e * (tailFac ρ Xb x - 1)) (∫ x in X..Xb, Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h) * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) * (-(4 * η) / x) * (tailFac ρ Xb x - 1)) η

signature.name: collar_Jc_deriv
signature.statement: ∀ (h cinf ρ Xb X η C1 : ℝ), 0 < X → 0 < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |deriv (heatProfile h) Z| ≤ C1) → ContinuousOn (tailFac ρ Xb) (Ioi 0) → HasDerivAt (fun e => ∫ x in X..Xb, tailHt h cinf x e * (tailFac ρ Xb x - 1)) (∫ x in X..Xb, Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h) * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) * (-(4 * η) / x) * (tailFac ρ Xb x - 1)) η

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h cinf ρ Xb X η C1 hX hXb hη1 hη2 hP hC1 hf
  have hsub : uIcc X Xb ⊆ Ioi 0 := by
    intro y hy
    rcases Set.mem_uIcc.1 hy with hy' | hy'
    · exact lt_of_lt_of_le hX hy'.1
    · exact lt_of_lt_of_le hXb hy'.1
  have hsub' : uIoc X Xb ⊆ Ioi 0 := Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc.trans hsub
  have hPc : ContinuousOn (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) := hP.continuousOn
  have hP'c : ContinuousOn (deriv (heatProfile h)) (Ioi 0) :=
    hP.continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioi (by simp)
  have hPd : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z → HasDerivAt (heatProfile h) (deriv (heatProfile h) z) z := fun z hz =>
    ((hP.contDiffAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasDerivAt
  have hC1nn : 0 ≤ C1 := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hC1 1 one_pos)
  have hpos : ∀ e : ℝ, e ∈ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 → ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < 2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x := by
    intro e he x hx
    have : 0 < 2 * (1 - e ^ 2) := by nlinarith [he.1, he.2]
    exact div_pos this hx
  have hrp : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (-h)) (Ioi 0) :=
    ContinuousOn.rpow_const continuousOn_id (fun x hx => Or.inl (ne_of_gt hx))
  have hinv : ∀ c : ℝ, ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => c / x) (Ioi 0) := fun c =>
    continuousOn_const.div continuousOn_id (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
  have hmaps : ∀ e : ℝ, e ∈ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
      MapsTo (fun x : ℝ => 2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) (Ioi 0) (Ioi 0) :=
    fun e he x hx => hpos e he x hx
  have hFc : ∀ e : ℝ, e ∈ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
      ContinuousOn (fun x => tailHt h cinf x e * (tailFac ρ Xb x - 1)) (Ioi 0) := by
    intro e he
    unfold tailHt
    exact ((continuousOn_const.mul hrp).mul (hPc.comp (hinv _) (hmaps e he))).mul
      (hf.sub continuousOn_const)
  have hF'c : ∀ e : ℝ, e ∈ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
      ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h) *
        deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) * (-(4 * e) / x) * (tailFac ρ Xb x - 1))
        (Ioi 0) := by
    intro e he
    exact (((continuousOn_const.mul hrp).mul (hP'c.comp (hinv _) (hmaps e he))).mul
      (hinv _)).mul (hf.sub continuousOn_const)
  have hbc : ContinuousOn
      (fun x => 4 * C1 * |Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h) * (tailFac ρ Xb x - 1) / x|) (Ioi 0) :=
    continuousOn_const.mul ((((continuousOn_const.mul hrp).mul (hf.sub continuousOn_const)).div
      continuousOn_id (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)).abs)
  have hηs : η ∈ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨hη1, hη2⟩
  refine (intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (a := X) (b := Xb) (x₀ := η) (s := Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)
    (F := fun e x => tailHt h cinf x e * (tailFac ρ Xb x - 1))
    (F' := fun e x => Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h) * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) *
      (-(4 * e) / x) * (tailFac ρ Xb x - 1))
    (bound := fun x => 4 * C1 * |Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h) * (tailFac ρ Xb x - 1) / x|)
    (Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2) ?hm ((hFc η hηs).mono hsub).intervalIntegrable
    (((hF'c η hηs).mono hsub').aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc)
    (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun t ht e he => ?hb)) ((hbc.mono hsub).intervalIntegrable)
    (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun t ht e he => ?hd))).2
  case hm =>
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2] with e he
    exact ((hFc e he).mono hsub').aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
  case hb =>
    have ht0 : 0 < t := hsub' ht
    have hPb := hC1 _ (hpos e he t ht0)
    have he4 : |(-(4 * e))| ≤ 4 := by
      rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [he.1, he.2]
    show ‖Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * t ^ (-h) * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / t) *
        (-(4 * e) / t) * (tailFac ρ Xb t - 1)‖ ≤
      4 * C1 * |Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * t ^ (-h) * (tailFac ρ Xb t - 1) / t|
    have eq : Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * t ^ (-h) * deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / t) *
        (-(4 * e) / t) * (tailFac ρ Xb t - 1) =
        deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / t) * (-(4 * e)) *
          (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * t ^ (-h) * (tailFac ρ Xb t - 1) / t) := by ring
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, eq, abs_mul, abs_mul]
    have hA := abs_nonneg (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * t ^ (-h) * (tailFac ρ Xb t - 1) / t)
    calc _ ≤ C1 * 4 * |Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * t ^ (-h) * (tailFac ρ Xb t - 1) / t| :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul hPb he4 (abs_nonneg _) hC1nn) hA
      _ = _ := by ring
  case hd =>
    have ht0 : 0 < t := hsub' ht
    have ha : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => 2 * (1 - e ^ 2)) (-(4 * e)) e := by
      have := ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 e).const_sub 1).const_mul 2
      convert this using 1
      norm_num <;> ring
    have hg := ha.div_const t
    have hc := (((hPd _ (hpos e he t ht0)).comp e hg).const_mul
      (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * t ^ (-h))).mul_const (tailFac ρ Xb t - 1)
    have hc' := hc.congr_deriv (show _ = Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * t ^ (-h) *
      deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / t) * (-(4 * e) / t) * (tailFac ρ Xb t - 1) by ring)
    exact hc'

informal_problem.statement: ContDiff ℝ ∞ sigA ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ collarG ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ collarGam ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → 1 - sigA (1 - u) = Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) * collarG u) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → HasDerivAt sigA (Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) / u ^ 3 * collarGam u) (1 - u)) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → 0 ≤ collarGam u) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → u ≤ 1 / 2 → Real.exp (-4) / 2 ≤ collarGam u)

signature.name: sigA_collar_facts
signature.statement: ContDiff ℝ ∞ sigA ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ collarG ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ collarGam ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → 1 - sigA (1 - u) = Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) * collarG u) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → HasDerivAt sigA (Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) / u ^ 3 * collarGam u) (1 - u)) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → 0 ≤ collarGam u) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → u ≤ 1 / 2 → Real.exp (-4) / 2 ≤ collarGam u)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ,
      F = fun j z => if z ≤ 0 then (0 : ℝ) else (z ^ j)⁻¹ * Real.exp (-1 / z ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hflat : ∀ (j : ℕ) (z : ℝ), 0 < z → z ≤ 1 →
      (z ^ j)⁻¹ * Real.exp (-1 / z ^ 2) ≤ ((j + 1).factorial : ℝ) * z ^ 2 := by
    intro j z hz hz1
    have hx : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / z ^ 2 := by positivity
    have h1 := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp _ hx (j + 1)
    have hA : (0 : ℝ) < ((j + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos _
    have hE : Real.exp (-1 / z ^ 2) = (Real.exp (1 / z ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
      rw [← Real.exp_neg]; ring_nf
    have hEpos := Real.exp_pos (1 / z ^ 2)
    have hzj : z ^ j ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hz.le hz1
    have hzjpos : 0 < z ^ j := pow_pos hz j
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hA] at h1
    have h2 : (1 / z ^ 2) ^ (j + 1) * (z ^ 2) ^ (j + 1) = 1 := by
      rw [← mul_pow]; field_simp; simp
    have h3 : 1 ≤ ((j + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (z ^ 2) ^ (j + 1) * Real.exp (1 / z ^ 2) := by
      calc (1 : ℝ) = (1 / z ^ 2) ^ (j + 1) * (z ^ 2) ^ (j + 1) := h2.symm
        _ ≤ (Real.exp (1 / z ^ 2) * ((j + 1).factorial : ℝ)) * (z ^ 2) ^ (j + 1) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (by positivity)
        _ = _ := by ring
    have h4 : (z ^ 2) ^ (j + 1) ≤ z ^ 2 * z ^ j := by
      calc (z ^ 2) ^ (j + 1) = z ^ 2 * z ^ j * z ^ j := by ring
        _ ≤ z ^ 2 * z ^ j * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hzj (by positivity)
        _ = z ^ 2 * z ^ j := by ring
    have key : 1 ≤ ((j + 1).factorial : ℝ) * z ^ 2 * (z ^ j * Real.exp (1 / z ^ 2)) := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 (le_of_lt (mul_pos hA hEpos))
      nlinarith
    rw [hE, ← mul_inv, ← one_div, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    exact key
  
  have hFcont0 : ∀ j, ContinuousAt (F j) 0 := by
    intro j
    have h0 : F j 0 = 0 := by simp only [hF]; rw [if_pos le_rfl]
    rw [ContinuousAt, h0]
    apply squeeze_zero_norm' (a := fun z => ((j + 1).factorial : ℝ) * z ^ 2)
    · filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℝ) one_pos] with z hz
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at hz
      simp only [hF]
      split_ifs with h
      · rw [norm_zero]; positivity
      · push_neg at h
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
        exact hflat j z h (by linarith [le_abs_self z])
    · exact (continuous_const.mul (continuous_pow 2)).tendsto' 0 0 (by simp)
  
  have hpos : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ), 0 < y →
      HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => (z ^ k)⁻¹ * Real.exp (-1 / z ^ 2))
        (-(k : ℝ) * ((y ^ (k + 1))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2)) +
          2 * ((y ^ (k + 3))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2))) y := by
    intro k y hy
    have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := hy.ne'
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => (z ^ k)⁻¹) (-(k : ℝ) * (y ^ (k + 1))⁻¹) y := by
      have := (hasDerivAt_pow k y).inv (pow_ne_zero k hy0)
      convert this using 1
      rcases k with _ | m
      · simp
      · simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
        field_simp
        ring
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => -1 / z ^ 2) (2 / y ^ 3) y := by
      have := (hasDerivAt_const y (-1 : ℝ)).div (hasDerivAt_pow 2 y) (pow_ne_zero 2 hy0)
      convert this using 1
      field_simp
      ring
    have h3 := h1.mul h2.exp
    convert h3 using 1
    field_simp
    ring
  have hFd : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ), HasDerivAt (F k) (-(k : ℝ) * F (k + 1) y + 2 * F (k + 3) y) y := by
    have hneg : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ), y < 0 →
        HasDerivAt (F k) (-(k : ℝ) * F (k + 1) y + 2 * F (k + 3) y) y := by
      intro k y hy
      have hev : F k =ᶠ[nhds y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hy] with z hz
        simp only [hF]
        rw [if_pos (le_of_lt hz)]
      have hv : -(k : ℝ) * F (k + 1) y + 2 * F (k + 3) y = 0 := by
        simp only [hF]
        rw [if_pos hy.le, if_pos hy.le]
        ring
      rw [hv]
      exact (hasDerivAt_const y (0 : ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    have hposF : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ), 0 < y →
        HasDerivAt (F k) (-(k : ℝ) * F (k + 1) y + 2 * F (k + 3) y) y := by
      intro k y hy
      have hev : F k =ᶠ[nhds y] fun z => (z ^ k)⁻¹ * Real.exp (-1 / z ^ 2) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hy] with z hz
        simp only [hF]
        rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr (show (0 : ℝ) < z from hz))]
      have hv1 : F (k + 1) y = (y ^ (k + 1))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) := by
        simp only [hF]; rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr hy)]
      have hv3 : F (k + 3) y = (y ^ (k + 3))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) := by
        simp only [hF]; rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr hy)]
      rw [hv1, hv3]
      exact (hpos k y hy).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    intro k y
    rcases lt_trichotomy y 0 with hy | hy | hy
    · exact hneg k y hy
    · subst hy
      have hg : ContinuousAt (fun z => -(k : ℝ) * F (k + 1) z + 2 * F (k + 3) z) 0 :=
        (continuousAt_const.mul (hFcont0 (k + 1))).add (continuousAt_const.mul (hFcont0 (k + 3)))
      exact hasDerivAt_of_hasDerivAt_of_ne (f := F k)
        (g := fun z => -(k : ℝ) * F (k + 1) z + 2 * F (k + 3) z)
        (fun z hz => by
          rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hz with h | h
          · exact hneg k z h
          · exact hposF k z h) (hFcont0 k) hg
    · exact hposF k y hy
  
  have hFsmooth : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F k) := by
    have hdiff : ∀ k, Differentiable ℝ (F k) := fun k y => (hFd k y).differentiableAt
    have hderiv : ∀ k, deriv (F k) = fun y => -(k : ℝ) * F (k + 1) y + 2 * F (k + 3) y :=
      fun k => funext fun y => (hFd k y).deriv
    have hn : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ n (F k) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => intro k; exact contDiff_zero.mpr (hdiff k).continuous
      | succ n ih =>
        intro k
        rw [Nat.cast_succ, contDiff_succ_iff_deriv]
        refine ⟨hdiff k, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro h; exact absurd h (by simp)
        · rw [hderiv k]
          exact (contDiff_const.mul (ih (k + 1))).add (contDiff_const.mul (ih (k + 3)))
    intro k
    exact contDiff_infty.mpr (fun n => hn n k)
  
  have hsq : sqFlat = F 0 := by
    funext y; simp only [hF, sqFlat, pow_zero, inv_one, one_mul]
  have hsqD : sqFlatD = fun y => 2 * F 3 y := by
    funext y; simp only [hF, sqFlatD]; split_ifs <;> ring
  have hS : ContDiff ℝ ∞ sqFlat := by rw [hsq]; exact hFsmooth 0
  have hSD : ContDiff ℝ ∞ sqFlatD := by rw [hsqD]; exact contDiff_const.mul (hFsmooth 3)
  have hSd : ∀ y, HasDerivAt sqFlat (sqFlatD y) y := by
    intro y
    have := hFd 0 y
    rw [hsq, hsqD]
    convert this using 1
    simp
  have hsq_nn : ∀ y, 0 ≤ sqFlat y := by intro y; unfold sqFlat; split_ifs <;> positivity
  have hsq_le : ∀ y, sqFlat y ≤ 1 := by
    intro y; unfold sqFlat; split_ifs
    · norm_num
    · rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff, show (-1 : ℝ) / y ^ 2 = -(1 / y ^ 2) by ring]
      have : 0 ≤ 1 / y ^ 2 := by positivity
      linarith
  have hsqD_nn : ∀ y, 0 ≤ sqFlatD y := by
    intro y; unfold sqFlatD; split_ifs with h
    · exact le_rfl
    · push_neg at h
      exact mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (by norm_num) (pow_pos h 3).le) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hD : ∀ y, 0 < sqFlat y + sqFlat (1 - y) := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ≤ 0
    · have : sqFlat (1 - y) = Real.exp (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2) := by
        unfold sqFlat; rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr (by linarith))]
      linarith [hsq_nn y, Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)]
    · have : sqFlat y = Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) := by
        unfold sqFlat; rw [if_neg hy]
      linarith [hsq_nn (1 - y), Real.exp_pos (-1 / y ^ 2)]
  have hsig : ∀ y, sigA y = sqFlat y / (sqFlat y + sqFlat (1 - y)) := by
    intro y
    unfold sigA sqFlat
    by_cases h0 : y ≤ 0
    · simp only [if_pos h0, zero_div]
    · by_cases h1 : 1 ≤ y
      · have h2 : 1 - y ≤ 0 := by linarith
        simp only [if_neg h0, if_pos h1, if_pos h2, add_zero]
        rw [div_self (Real.exp_pos _).ne']
      · have h2 : ¬ (1 - y ≤ 0) := not_le.mpr (by linarith)
        simp only [if_neg h0, if_neg h1, if_neg h2]
  have hval : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → sqFlat u = Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) ∧
      sqFlatD u = 2 / u ^ 3 * Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) := by
    intro u hu
    unfold sqFlat sqFlatD
    rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr hu), if_neg (not_le.mpr hu)]
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  have hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ => 1 - y) := contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id
  have hS1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => sqFlat (1 - y)) := hS.comp hr
  have hSD1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => sqFlatD (1 - y)) := hSD.comp hr
  have hDc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => sqFlat y + sqFlat (1 - y)) := hS.add hS1
  have hD0 : ∀ y, sqFlat y + sqFlat (1 - y) ≠ 0 := fun y => (hD y).ne'
  have hsigeq : sigA = fun y => sqFlat y / (sqFlat y + sqFlat (1 - y)) := funext hsig
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hsigeq]; exact hS.div hDc hD0
  · have e : collarG = fun u => (sqFlat u + sqFlat (1 - u))⁻¹ := rfl
    rw [e]; exact hDc.inv hD0
  · have e : collarGam = fun u => (2 * sqFlat (1 - u) + u ^ 3 * sqFlatD (1 - u)) /
        (sqFlat u + sqFlat (1 - u)) ^ 2 := rfl
    rw [e]
    exact ((contDiff_const.mul hS1).add ((contDiff_id.pow 3).mul hSD1)).div (hDc.pow 2)
      (fun u => pow_ne_zero 2 (hD0 u))
