      rw [show (-1 - (i:ℤ)) = -((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow, one_mul, norm_inv, norm_pow,
        Real.norm_natCast, Real.norm_of_nonneg hy.le]
    refine ⟨(n.factorial : ℝ) * ((n.factorial : ℝ) * (c⁻¹ + 1) ^ (n + 1)) *
      (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |A i|) ^ n, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    have hD1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |A i| :=
      le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _))
    have hC : ∀ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (Inv.inv : ℝ → ℝ) (Ioi 0) (f p)‖ ≤
        (n.factorial : ℝ) * (c⁻¹ + 1) ^ (n + 1) := by
      intro i hi
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i isOpen_Ioi (show f p ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) from hpos p hp),
        hgd i (f p) (hpos p hp)]
      have hfi : (i.factorial : ℝ) ≤ n.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le hi
      have hci : 0 ≤ c⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.2 hc.le
      have hy : (f p ^ (i + 1))⁻¹ ≤ (c⁻¹ + 1) ^ (n + 1) := by
        have h1 : (f p ^ (i + 1))⁻¹ ≤ (c ^ (i + 1))⁻¹ :=
          inv_anti₀ (pow_pos hc _) (pow_le_pow_left₀ hc.le (hlow p hp) _)
        have h2 : (c ^ (i + 1))⁻¹ = (c⁻¹) ^ (i + 1) := (inv_pow c (i + 1)).symm
        have h3 : (c⁻¹) ^ (i + 1) ≤ (c⁻¹ + 1) ^ (i + 1) :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ hci (by linarith) _
        have h4 : (c⁻¹ + 1) ^ (i + 1) ≤ (c⁻¹ + 1) ^ (n + 1) :=
          pow_le_pow_right₀ (by linarith) (by omega)
        linarith
      exact mul_le_mul hfi hy (inv_nonneg.2 (pow_nonneg (hpos p hp).le _)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    have hD : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n →
        ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i f (Ioo (0:ℝ) (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) p‖ ≤
          (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |A i|) ^ i := by
      intro i hi1 hin
      rw [hW f i p hp]
      have h1 := hA i p hp
      have h2 : |A i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |A j| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |A j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
      have h3 : (1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |A j|) ≤
          (1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |A j|) ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
      linarith [le_abs_self (A i)]
    have hmaps : MapsTo f (Ioo (0:ℝ) (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Ioi 0) := fun p hp => hpos p hp
    have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hgs hf.1 (hN n) isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn hΩu
      hmaps hp hC hD
    rw [← hW _ n p hp]
    exact key
  
  have hglob : ∀ φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → collarGood φ := by
    intro φ hφ
    refine ⟨hφ.contDiffOn, fun m => ?_⟩
    have hK : IsCompact (Icc (0:ℝ) (11 / 8) ×ˢ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
      hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hφ.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (hN m)).continuousOn
    exact ⟨C, fun p hp => hC p ⟨Ioo_subset_Icc_self hp.1, Ioo_subset_Icc_self hp.2⟩⟩
  exact ⟨hmul, hadd, hsub, hinv, hglob⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ h cinf ρ Xb : ℝ, 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 < cinf → 0 < Xb → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ContinuousOn (fun x => tailHt h cinf x η) (Ioi 0) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => deriv (fun y => tailHt h cinf y η) x) (Ioi 0) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => tailEh h cinf x η) (Ioi 0)) ∧ ContinuousOn (tailFac ρ Xb) (Ioi 0) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (collarPsiTh h cinf Xb) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (collarPsiE h cinf ρ Xb) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (collarPsiXE h cinf ρ Xb) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ collarGood (collarPsiTh h cinf Xb) ∧ collarGood (collarPsiE h cinf ρ Xb) ∧ collarGood (collarPsiXE h cinf ρ Xb) ∧ collarGood (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => tailHt h cinf (collarXu Xb p.1) p.2) ∧ collarGood (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => tailEh h cinf (collarXu Xb p.1) p.2)

signature.name: collar_chart_regularity
signature.statement: ∀ h cinf ρ Xb : ℝ, 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 < cinf → 0 < Xb → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ContinuousOn (fun x => tailHt h cinf x η) (Ioi 0) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => deriv (fun y => tailHt h cinf y η) x) (Ioi 0) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => tailEh h cinf x η) (Ioi 0)) ∧ ContinuousOn (tailFac ρ Xb) (Ioi 0) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (collarPsiTh h cinf Xb) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (collarPsiE h cinf ρ Xb) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (collarPsiXE h cinf ρ Xb) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ collarGood (collarPsiTh h cinf Xb) ∧ collarGood (collarPsiE h cinf ρ Xb) ∧ collarGood (collarPsiXE h cinf ρ Xb) ∧ collarGood (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => tailHt h cinf (collarXu Xb p.1) p.2) ∧ collarGood (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => tailEh h cinf (collarXu Xb p.1) p.2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h cinf ρ Xb hh0 _hh1 _hc0 hXb0
  obtain ⟨HP1, HP2, HP3⟩ :=
    heatProfile_props h hh0 heatK_deriv_bound (fun Z hZ => heatK_ode h Z hh0 hZ)
  have HP1' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (deriv (heatProfile h)) (Ioi 0) :=
    ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioi).1 HP1).2
  have HP2' : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv k (deriv (heatProfile h)) Z| ≤ C := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := HP2 (k + 1)
    exact ⟨C, fun Z hZ => by rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']; exact hC Z hZ⟩
  obtain ⟨hσ, -, hγ, -⟩ := sigA_collar_facts
  obtain ⟨hmul, hadd, -, -, hglob⟩ := collarGood_algebra
  have hΩo : IsOpen (Ioo (0:ℝ) (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  
  have hcomp : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (Z : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Ioi 0) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z → |iteratedDeriv k g z| ≤ C) → ContDiff ℝ ∞ Z →
      (∀ p ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, 0 < Z p) → collarGood (fun p => g (Z p)) := by
    intro g Z hg hgb hZ hZpos
    have hmaps : MapsTo Z (Ioo (0:ℝ) (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Ioi 0) := fun p hp => hZpos p hp
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (g ∘ Z) (Ioo (0:ℝ) (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
      hg.comp hZ.contDiffOn hmaps
    refine ⟨hsm, fun n => ?_⟩
    have hK : IsCompact (Icc (0:ℝ) (11 / 8) ×ˢ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    have hM : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) (11 / 8) ×ˢ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i Z x‖ ≤ M := fun i =>
      hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        ((hZ.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).continuousOn)
    choose M hM using hM
    choose Cg hCg using hgb
    refine ⟨n.factorial * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |Cg i|) *
      (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |M i|) ^ n, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    have hpK : p ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) (11 / 8) ×ˢ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
      ⟨Ioo_subset_Icc_self hp.1, Ioo_subset_Icc_self hp.2⟩
    have hgbd : ∀ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i g (Ioi 0) (Z p)‖ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |Cg i| := by
      intro i hi
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i isOpen_Ioi (hmaps hp),
        norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc |iteratedDeriv i g (Z p)| ≤ Cg i := hCg i (Z p) (hmaps hp)
        _ ≤ |Cg i| := le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |Cg j| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cg j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
            (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
    have hD : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |M j| :=
      le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _))
    have hZbd : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n →
        ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i Z (Ioo (0:ℝ) (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) p‖ ≤
          (1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |M j|) ^ i := by
      intro i hi1 hin
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩo hp]
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i Z p‖ ≤ M i := hM i p hpK
        _ ≤ |M i| := le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |M j| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |M j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
            (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
        _ ≤ 1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |M j| := le_add_of_nonneg_left zero_le_one
        _ ≤ _ := le_self_pow₀ hD (by omega)
    have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hg hZ.contDiffOn (n := n)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top) isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn hΩo.uniqueDiffOn hmaps hp hgbd hZbd
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hΩo hp] at key
    exact key
  
  have hcongr : ∀ f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, collarGood f →
      (∀ p ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, g p = f p) → collarGood g := by
    intro f g hf heq
    refine ⟨hf.1.congr heq, fun m => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hf.2 m
    refine ⟨C, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    have hev : g =ᶠ[nhds p] f := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hΩo.mem_nhds hp) (fun q hq => heq q hq)
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
    exact hC p hp
  
  have hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => collarXu Xb p.1) := by unfold collarXu; fun_prop
  have hQpos : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, 0 < collarXu Xb p.1 := fun p => mul_pos hXb0 (Real.exp_pos _)
  have hQh : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => collarXu Xb p.1 ^ (-h)) :=
    hQ.rpow_const_of_ne (fun p => (hQpos p).ne')
  have hQe : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => collarXu Xb p.1 ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) :=
    hQ.rpow_const_of_ne (fun p => (hQpos p).ne')
  have hZ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * (1 - p.2 ^ 2) / collarXu Xb p.1) :=
    (by fun_prop : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * (1 - p.2 ^ 2))).div hQ (fun p => (hQpos p).ne')
  have hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => collarGam p.1) := hγ.comp contDiff_fst
  have hS : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => sigA (1 - p.1)) :=
    hσ.comp (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_fst)
  have hL : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * (1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2)) := by fun_prop
  have hpos1 : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → 0 < 1 - e ^ 2 := by
    intro e h1 h2
    have : 0 < (1 - e) * (1 + e) := mul_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
    nlinarith
  have hZposS : ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ, -1 < q.2 → q.2 < 1 → 0 < 2 * (1 - q.2 ^ 2) / collarXu Xb q.1 :=
    fun q h1 h2 => div_pos (by linarith [hpos1 q.2 h1 h2]) (hQpos q)
  have hmapS : MapsTo (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * (1 - q.2 ^ 2) / collarXu Xb q.1)
      (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Ioi 0) := fun q hq => hZposS q hq.2.1 hq.2.2
  have hHZS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => heatProfile h (2 * (1 - q.2 ^ 2) / collarXu Xb q.1))
      (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := HP1.comp hZ.contDiffOn hmapS
  have hH'ZS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - q.2 ^ 2) / collarXu Xb q.1))
      (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := HP1'.comp hZ.contDiffOn hmapS
  have GH : collarGood (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => heatProfile h (2 * (1 - q.2 ^ 2) / collarXu Xb q.1)) :=
    hcomp (heatProfile h) (fun q => 2 * (1 - q.2 ^ 2) / collarXu Xb q.1) HP1 HP2 hZ
      (fun p hp => hZposS p hp.2.1 hp.2.2)
  have GH' : collarGood
      (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - q.2 ^ 2) / collarXu Xb q.1)) :=
    hcomp (deriv (heatProfile h)) (fun q => 2 * (1 - q.2 ^ 2) / collarXu Xb q.1) HP1' HP2' hZ
      (fun p hp => hZposS p hp.2.1 hp.2.2)
  
  have hA1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => collarGam q.1 * (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * collarXu Xb q.1 ^ (-h)) *
      (2 * (1 - 2 * h * q.2 ^ 2) * (1 + h) + collarXu Xb q.1)) :=
    (hΓ.mul (contDiff_const.mul hQh)).mul ((hL.mul contDiff_const).add hQ)
  have hA2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => collarGam q.1 * (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * collarXu Xb q.1 ^ (-h)) *
      (2 * (1 - 2 * h * q.2 ^ 2) * (2 * (1 - q.2 ^ 2) / collarXu Xb q.1))) :=
    (hΓ.mul (contDiff_const.mul hQh)).mul (hL.mul hZ)
  have hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => collarGam q.1 * (cinf * collarXu Xb q.1 ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) ^ 2 *
      (1 - ρ * (1 - sigA (1 - q.1)))) :=
    (hΓ.mul ((contDiff_const.mul hQe).pow 2)).mul
      (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_const.sub hS)))
  
  have hidθ : ∀ (Γ x e : ℝ), 0 < x → -1 < e → e < 1 →
      Γ * (2 * (1 - 2 * h * e ^ 2) * (tailHt h cinf x e - x * deriv (fun y => tailHt h cinf y e) x) +
        x * tailHt h cinf x e) =
      Γ * (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h)) * (2 * (1 - 2 * h * e ^ 2) * (1 + h) + x) *
          heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) +
        Γ * (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h)) * (2 * (1 - 2 * h * e ^ 2) * (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x)) *
          deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) := by
    intro Γ x e hx h1 h2
    rw [(tailHt_calculus h cinf x e hx h1 h2 HP1 HP3).1.deriv]
    simp only [tailHt]
    generalize x ^ (-h) = P
    generalize heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) = A
    generalize deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / x) = B
    have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := hx.ne'
    field_simp
    ring
  have hfac : ∀ v : ℝ, tailFac ρ Xb (collarXu Xb v) = 1 - ρ * (1 - sigA (1 - v)) := by
    intro v
    unfold tailFac collarXu
    rw [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hXb0.ne', Real.log_exp]
    have e : (-(2 * v) + 2) / 2 = 1 - v := by ring
    rw [e]
  have eθ : ∀ q ∈ univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, collarPsiTh h cinf Xb q =
      collarGam q.1 * (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * collarXu Xb q.1 ^ (-h)) *
          (2 * (1 - 2 * h * q.2 ^ 2) * (1 + h) + collarXu Xb q.1) *
          heatProfile h (2 * (1 - q.2 ^ 2) / collarXu Xb q.1) +
        collarGam q.1 * (Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * collarXu Xb q.1 ^ (-h)) *
          (2 * (1 - 2 * h * q.2 ^ 2) * (2 * (1 - q.2 ^ 2) / collarXu Xb q.1)) *
          deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - q.2 ^ 2) / collarXu Xb q.1) :=
    fun q hq => hidθ _ _ _ (hQpos q) hq.2.1 hq.2.2
  have eE : ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ, collarPsiE h cinf ρ Xb q =
      collarGam q.1 * (cinf * collarXu Xb q.1 ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) ^ 2 * (1 - ρ * (1 - sigA (1 - q.1))) *
        (heatProfile h (2 * (1 - q.2 ^ 2) / collarXu Xb q.1) *
          heatProfile h (2 * (1 - q.2 ^ 2) / collarXu Xb q.1)) := by
    intro q
    unfold collarPsiE
    rw [hfac]
    unfold tailEh
    ring
  have eXE : ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ, collarPsiXE h cinf ρ Xb q = collarXu Xb q.1 * collarPsiE h cinf ρ Xb q := by
    intro q
    unfold collarPsiXE collarPsiE
    ring
  
  have sθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (collarPsiTh h cinf Xb) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
    ((hA1.contDiffOn.mul hHZS).add (hA2.contDiffOn.mul hH'ZS)).congr eθ
  have sE : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (collarPsiE h cinf ρ Xb) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
    (hB.contDiffOn.mul (hHZS.mul hHZS)).congr (fun q _ => eE q)
  have sXE : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (collarPsiXE h cinf ρ Xb) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
    (hQ.contDiffOn.mul sE).congr (fun q _ => eXE q)
  
  have gθ : collarGood (collarPsiTh h cinf Xb) :=
    hcongr _ _ (hadd _ _ (hmul _ _ (hglob _ hA1) GH) (hmul _ _ (hglob _ hA2) GH'))
      (fun q hq => eθ q ⟨mem_univ _, hq.2⟩)
  have gE : collarGood (collarPsiE h cinf ρ Xb) :=
    hcongr _ _ (hmul _ _ (hglob _ hB) (hmul _ _ GH GH)) (fun q _ => eE q)
  have gXE : collarGood (collarPsiXE h cinf ρ Xb) :=
    hcongr _ _ (hmul _ _ (hglob _ hQ) gE) (fun q _ => eXE q)
  have gHt : collarGood (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => tailHt h cinf (collarXu Xb p.1) p.2) :=
    hmul (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * collarXu Xb p.1 ^ (-h))
      (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => heatProfile h (2 * (1 - q.2 ^ 2) / collarXu Xb q.1))
      (hglob _ (contDiff_const.mul hQh)) GH
  have gEh : collarGood (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => tailEh h cinf (collarXu Xb p.1) p.2) :=
    hmul (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => cinf * collarXu Xb p.1 ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))
      (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => heatProfile h (2 * (1 - q.2 ^ 2) / collarXu Xb q.1))
      (hglob _ (contDiff_const.mul hQe)) GH
  
  have hcont : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ContinuousOn (fun x => tailHt h cinf x η) (Ioi 0) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun x => deriv (fun y => tailHt h cinf y η) x) (Ioi 0) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun x => tailEh h cinf x η) (Ioi 0) := by
    intro η h1 h2
    have hzc : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => 2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) (Ioi 0) :=
      continuousOn_const.div continuousOn_id (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
    have hzm : MapsTo (fun x : ℝ => 2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) (Ioi 0) (Ioi 0) :=
      fun x hx => show 0 < 2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x from
        div_pos (by linarith [hpos1 η h1 h2]) (show (0:ℝ) < x from hx)
    have HZc : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x)) (Ioi 0) :=
      HP1.continuousOn.comp hzc hzm
    have H'Zc : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x)) (Ioi 0) :=
      HP1'.continuousOn.comp hzc hzm
    have powh : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (-h)) (Ioi 0) :=
      continuousOn_id.rpow_const (fun x hx => Or.inl (ne_of_gt hx))
    have powe : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) (Ioi 0) :=
      continuousOn_id.rpow_const (fun x hx => Or.inl (ne_of_gt hx))
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x)) (Ioi 0)
      exact (continuousOn_const.mul powh).mul HZc
    · have hc : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * x ^ (-h) / x *
          (-(h * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x)) -

      (fun x => (pow_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (hsq1 t x ht)) _).ne'))
  have hfd : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ (a k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), HasDerivAt (f t a k)
      ((a : ℝ) * f t (a - 1) k x - ((2 * k + 1 : ℝ) * t) * f t (a + 1) (k + 1) x) x := by
    intro t ht a k x
    have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 + x ^ 2 * t) := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (hsq1 t x ht)
    have hs' : Real.sqrt (1 + x ^ 2 * t) ≠ 0 := hs.ne'
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => 1 + y ^ 2 * t) (2 * x * t) x := by
      have := ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 x).mul_const t).const_add 1
      convert this using 1
      norm_num
    have h2 := (h1.sqrt (lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (hpos t x ht)).ne').pow (2 * k + 1)
    have h3 := h2.inv (pow_ne_zero _ hs')
    have h4 := (hasDerivAt_pow a x).mul h3
    rw [hfdef]
    convert h4 using 1
    simp only [Pi.pow_apply, Pi.inv_apply, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  have hderiv : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ a k : ℕ, deriv (f t a k) =
      fun x => (a : ℝ) * f t (a - 1) k x - ((2 * k + 1 : ℝ) * t) * f t (a + 1) (k + 1) x := by
    intro t ht a k
    funext x
    exact (hfd t ht a k x).deriv
  
  have hbd : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ a k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ t v : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → |v| ≤ 2 →
      |iteratedDeriv j (f t a k) v| ≤ M * (1 + t) ^ j := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro a k
      refine ⟨2 ^ a, fun t v ht hv => ?_⟩
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, pow_zero, mul_one, hfdef]
      simp only []
      have hS := hsq1 t v ht
      have hP : 1 ≤ (Real.sqrt (1 + v ^ 2 * t)) ^ (2 * k + 1) := one_le_pow₀ hS
      have hI : 0 < ((Real.sqrt (1 + v ^ 2 * t)) ^ (2 * k + 1))⁻¹ := inv_pos.2 (by linarith)
      have hI1 : ((Real.sqrt (1 + v ^ 2 * t)) ^ (2 * k + 1))⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hP
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hI, abs_pow]
      calc |v| ^ a * ((Real.sqrt (1 + v ^ 2 * t)) ^ (2 * k + 1))⁻¹ ≤ 2 ^ a * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul (pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg v) hv a) hI1 hI.le (by positivity)
        _ = 2 ^ a := mul_one _
    | succ j ih =>
      intro a k
      obtain ⟨M₁, h₁⟩ := ih (a - 1) k
      obtain ⟨M₂, h₂⟩ := ih (a + 1) (k + 1)
      refine ⟨(a : ℝ) * |M₁| + (2 * k + 1 : ℝ) * |M₂|, fun t v ht hv => ?_⟩
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hderiv t ht a k]
      rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_sub ((contDiff_const.mul (hfs t ht (a - 1) k)).contDiffAt.of_le (hle j))
        ((contDiff_const.mul (hfs t ht (a + 1) (k + 1))).contDiffAt.of_le (hle j))]
      rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field, iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field]
      have ha := h₁ t v ht hv
      have hb := h₂ t v ht hv
      have hT : 0 ≤ (1 + t) ^ j := by positivity
      have hs : (1 + t) ^ (j + 1) = (1 + t) ^ j * (1 + t) := pow_succ _ _
      set X := iteratedDeriv j (f t (a - 1) k) v
      set Y := iteratedDeriv j (f t (a + 1) (k + 1)) v
      have hX : |X| ≤ |M₁| * (1 + t) ^ j :=
        ha.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hT)
      have hY : |Y| ≤ |M₂| * (1 + t) ^ j :=
        hb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hT)
      have hk : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * k + 1 := by positivity
      have ha0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ a := Nat.cast_nonneg a
      calc |(a : ℝ) * X - (2 * k + 1 : ℝ) * t * Y|
          ≤ |(a : ℝ) * X| + |(2 * k + 1 : ℝ) * t * Y| := abs_sub _ _
        _ = (a : ℝ) * |X| + (2 * k + 1 : ℝ) * t * |Y| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha0, abs_of_nonneg hk, abs_of_nonneg ht]
        _ ≤ (a : ℝ) * (|M₁| * (1 + t) ^ j) + (2 * k + 1 : ℝ) * t * (|M₂| * (1 + t) ^ j) := by
            gcongr
        _ ≤ ((a : ℝ) * |M₁| + (2 * k + 1 : ℝ) * |M₂|) * (1 + t) ^ (j + 1) := by
            rw [hs]
            nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha0 (abs_nonneg M₁)) hT) ht,
              mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hk (abs_nonneg M₂)) hT]
  
  have hw : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → (fun x : ℝ => x / Real.sqrt (1 + x ^ 2 * t)) = f t 1 0 := by
    intro t ht
    funext x
    rw [hfdef]
    simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
  have hΦb : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, |p.1| ≤ 2 → 1 ≤ i →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => (q.1 / Real.sqrt (1 + q.1 ^ 2 * t), q.2)) p‖ ≤
        M * (1 + t) ^ i := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := hbd i 1 0
    refine ⟨|M₀| + 1, fun t ht p hp hi => ?_⟩
    have hwc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => x / Real.sqrt (1 + x ^ 2 * t)) := by
      rw [hw t ht]; exact hfs t ht 1 0
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 / Real.sqrt (1 + q.1 ^ 2 * t)) p :=
      (hwc.comp contDiff_fst).contDiffAt
    have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.2) p := contDiff_snd.contDiffAt
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_prodMk h1 h2 (hle i), ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_prod]
    have hT1 : 1 ≤ (1 + t) ^ i := one_le_pow₀ (by linarith)
    have hT : 0 ≤ (1 + t) ^ i := by positivity
    apply max_le
    · have e : (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 / Real.sqrt (1 + q.1 ^ 2 * t)) =
          (fun x : ℝ => x / Real.sqrt (1 + x ^ 2 * t)) ∘ ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) := rfl
      rw [e, ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right _ hwc p (hle i)]
      refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
      have hprod : ∏ _i : Fin i, ‖ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Finset.prod_const]
        exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_fst_le ℝ ℝ ℝ)
      calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun x : ℝ => x / Real.sqrt (1 + x ^ 2 * t))
              ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) p)‖ * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = |iteratedDeriv i (f t 1 0) ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) p)| := by
            rw [mul_one, norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, hw t ht, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        _ ≤ M₀ * (1 + t) ^ i := hM₀ t p.1 ht hp
        _ ≤ (|M₀| + 1) * (1 + t) ^ i :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [le_abs_self M₀]) hT
    · have e : (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.2) = (id : ℝ → ℝ) ∘ ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) := rfl
      rw [e, ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right _ contDiff_id p (hle i)]
      refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
      have hprod : ∏ _i : Fin i, ‖ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Finset.prod_const]
        exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_snd_le ℝ ℝ ℝ)
      have hid : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (id : ℝ → ℝ) ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) p)‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_id, if_neg (show i ≠ 0 by omega)]
        split_ifs <;> simp
      calc _ ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul hid hprod (by positivity) zero_le_one
        _ ≤ (|M₀| + 1) * (1 + t) ^ i := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg M₀]
  
  choose Cψ hCψ using hb
  choose Mc hMc using hΦb
  set Ωu : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Ioo 0 (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 with hΩu
  have hΩuo : IsOpen Ωu := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  set C := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |Cψ i| with hC
  set K := 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |Mc i| with hK
  have hK1 : 1 ≤ K := by
    have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1)) => abs_nonneg (Mc i))
    linarith
  refine ⟨(n.factorial : ℝ) * C * K ^ n, fun t ht p hp => ?_⟩
  have hpos' : ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ, 0 < 1 + q.1 ^ 2 * t := fun q =>
    lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (hpos t q.1 ht)
  have hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => (q.1 / Real.sqrt (1 + q.1 ^ 2 * t), q.2)) := by
    refine ContDiff.prodMk ?_ contDiff_snd
    refine contDiff_fst.div ((contDiff_const.add ((contDiff_fst.pow 2).mul contDiff_const)).sqrt
      (fun q => (hpos' q).ne')) ?_
    intro q
    exact (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hpos' q)).ne'
  have hmaps : MapsTo (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => (q.1 / Real.sqrt (1 + q.1 ^ 2 * t), q.2)) Ωu Ωu := by
    intro q hq
    have h1 : 0 < q.1 := hq.1.1
    have h2 : q.1 < 11 / 8 := hq.1.2
    have hs := hsq1 t q.1 ht
    exact ⟨⟨div_pos h1 (by linarith), lt_of_le_of_lt (div_le_self h1.le hs) h2⟩, hq.2⟩
  have hψΩ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ Ωu := hψ.mono (fun q hq => ⟨mem_univ _, hq.2⟩)
  have hΦp : (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => (q.1 / Real.sqrt (1 + q.1 ^ 2 * t), q.2)) p ∈ Ωu := hmaps hp
  have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hψΩ hΦ.contDiffOn (hle n) hΩuo.uniqueDiffOn
    hΩuo.uniqueDiffOn hmaps hp (C := C) (D := K * (1 + t))
    (fun i hi => by
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩuo hΦp]
      refine (hCψ i _ hΦp).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans ?_)
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cψ i|) (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega)))
    (fun i hi1 hin => by
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩuo hp]
      have hp1 : |p.1| ≤ 2 := by
        rw [abs_of_pos hp.1.1]; linarith [hp.1.2]
      refine (hMc i t ht p hp1 hi1).trans ?_
      have hMK : Mc i ≤ K := by
        have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Mc i|) (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.2 (show i < n + 1 by omega))
        linarith [le_abs_self (Mc i)]
      have hKi : K ≤ K ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hK1 (by omega)
      rw [mul_pow]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hMK.trans hKi) (by positivity))
  rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hΩuo hp] at hFdB
  have e : (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ψ (q.1 / Real.sqrt (1 + q.1 ^ 2 * t), q.2)) =
      ψ ∘ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => (q.1 / Real.sqrt (1 + q.1 ^ 2 * t), q.2)) := rfl
  rw [e]
  refine hFdB.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [mul_pow]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (U : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun q => G q t) U) → (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ p ∈ U, ContinuousOn (fun t => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun q => G q t) p) (Ioi 0)) → (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ b : ℝ → ℝ, IntegrableOn b (Ioi 0) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ p ∈ U, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun q => G q t) p‖ ≤ b t) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => ∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), G p t) U ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ U, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun p => ∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), G p t) p‖ ≤ C) ∧ ∀ p ∈ U, IntegrableOn (G p) (Ioi 0)

signature.name: param_integral_contDiffOn
signature.statement: ∀ (U : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun q => G q t) U) → (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ p ∈ U, ContinuousOn (fun t => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun q => G q t) p) (Ioi 0)) → (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ b : ℝ → ℝ, IntegrableOn b (Ioi 0) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ p ∈ U, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun q => G q t) p‖ ≤ b t) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => ∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), G p t) U ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ U, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun p => ∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), G p t) p‖ ≤ C) ∧ ∀ p ∈ U, IntegrableOn (G p) (Ioi 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro U G hU h1 h2 h3
  choose b hbI hb using h3
  have hcl : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ g : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ,
      continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ g = g.curryLeft := by
    intro m g
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun v => ContinuousMultilinearMap.ext (fun w => ?_))
    rw [continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv_apply, ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryLeft_apply]
  have hInt : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ p ∈ U,
      IntegrableOn (fun t => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun q => G q t) p) (Ioi 0) := by
    intro n p hp
    refine Integrable.mono' (hbI n) ((h2 n p hp).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi) ?_
    exact (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).2
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht => hb n t ht p hp))
  have hGint : ∀ p ∈ U, IntegrableOn (G p) (Ioi 0) := by
    intro p hp
    have hc : ContinuousOn (G p) (Ioi 0) := by
      have := (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) ℝ).continuous.comp_continuousOn (h2 0 p hp)
      refine this.congr (fun t _ => ?_)
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, continuousMultilinearCurryFin0_apply, iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply]
    refine Integrable.mono' (hbI 0) (hc.aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi) ?_
    refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht => ?_))
    have := hb 0 t ht p hp
    rwa [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] at this
  have hder : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ x ∈ U, HasFDerivAt (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun q => G q t))
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) (fun q => G q t) x).curryLeft) x := by
    intro m t ht x hx
    have hca : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun q => G q t) x := (h1 t ht).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
    have hd := hca.differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv (m := m)
      (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.2 (ENat.natCast_lt_top m))
    have := hd.hasFDerivAt
    rw [fderiv_iteratedFDeriv, Function.comp_apply, hcl] at this
    exact this
  have hstep : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ x₀ ∈ U,
      HasFDerivAt (fun x => ∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun q => G q t) x)
        ((∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) (fun q => G q t) x₀).curryLeft) x₀ := by
    intro m x₀ hx₀
    have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun t => (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) (fun q => G q t) x₀).curryLeft)
        (volume.restrict (Ioi (0:ℝ))) := by
      have := (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ).continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable
        (hInt (m + 1) x₀ hx₀).aestronglyMeasurable
      refine this.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => ?_))
      simp only [hcl]
    have key := hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
      (μ := volume.restrict (Ioi (0:ℝ)))
      (F := fun x t => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun q => G q t) x)
      (F' := fun x t => (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) (fun q => G q t) x).curryLeft)
      (bound := b (m + 1)) (hU.mem_nhds hx₀)
      (Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hx₀) (fun x hx => (hInt m x hx).aestronglyMeasurable))
      (hInt m x₀ hx₀) hmeas ?_ (hbI (m + 1)) ?_
    · have hcomm : ∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) (fun q => G q t) x₀).curryLeft =
          (∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) (fun q => G q t) x₀).curryLeft := by
        have := ContinuousLinearEquiv.integral_comp_comm (𝕜 := ℝ)
          (E := ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ)
          (F := (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ)
          (μ := volume.restrict (Ioi (0:ℝ)))
          (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ).toContinuousLinearEquiv
          (fun t => iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) (fun q => G q t) x₀)
        simpa only [LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_toContinuousLinearEquiv, hcl] using this
      rw [hcomm] at key
      exact key
    · refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht x hx => ?_))
      rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryLeft_norm]
      exact hb (m + 1) t ht x hx
    · exact (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).2
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht x hx => hder m t ht x hx))
  have hT : HasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn ∞ (fun p => ∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), G p t)
      (fun x m => ∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun q => G q t) x) U := by
    refine HasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn.mk ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro x hx
      rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.curry0_apply, ContinuousMultilinearMap.integral_apply (hInt 0 x hx)]
      simp only [iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply]
    · intro m _ x hx
      exact (hstep m x hx).hasFDerivWithinAt
    · intro m _ x hx
      exact (hstep m x hx).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  refine ⟨hT.contDiffOn, ?_, hGint⟩
  intro n
  refine ⟨∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), b n t, fun p hp => ?_⟩
  rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hU hp,
    ← hT.eq_iteratedFDerivWithin_of_uniqueDiffOn (WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top) hU.uniqueDiffOn hp]
  exact norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (hbI n)
    ((ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t ht => hb n t ht p hp))

signature.name: param_partial_iteratedFDeriv_contDiffOn
signature.statement: ∀ (H : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → ℝ) (W : Set ((ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ)), IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H W → ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => H (q, z.2)) z.1) W

proof.tactics:
by
  intro H W hW hH n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have e : (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => H (q, z.2)) z.1) =
        ⇑(continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) ℝ).symm ∘ H := by
      funext z
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp]
      rfl
    rw [e]
    exact (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) ℝ).symm.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hH
  | succ n ih =>
    set K := fun z : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => H (q, z.2)) z.1 with hK
    have e : (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => H (q, z.2)) z.1) =
        fun z => (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ).symm
          (fderiv ℝ (fun q => K (q, z.2)) z.1) := by
      funext z
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left]
      rfl

        ∑ i, ∑ i', cU i * cU i' * ∫ x in x1..x2, β i x * β i' x :=
      H2 2 cU (fun i i' x => β i x * β i' x) (fun i i' => ((hβ i).mul (hβ i')).continuousOn)
    have hC : ∫ x in x1..x2, ∑ j, cE j * (x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) * γ j x) =
        ∑ j, cE j * ∫ x in x1..x2, x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) * γ j x :=
      H1 3 cE (fun j x => x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) * γ j x) (fun j => (cp.mul (hγ j)).continuousOn)
    have hD : ∫ x in x1..x2, ∑ j, ∑ l, cE j * cE l * (γ j x * γ l x) =
        ∑ j, ∑ l, cE j * cE l * ∫ x in x1..x2, γ j x * γ l x :=
      H2 3 cE (fun j l x => γ j x * γ l x) (fun j l => ((hγ j).mul (hγ l)).continuousOn)
    have cA : Continuous (fun x => 8 * η * ∑ i, cU i * β i x) :=
      continuous_const.mul (continuous_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => continuous_const.mul (hβ i)))
    have cB : Continuous (fun x => ∑ i, ∑ i', cU i * cU i' * (β i x * β i' x)) :=
      continuous_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => continuous_finset_sum _
        (fun i' _ => continuous_const.mul ((hβ i).mul (hβ i'))))
    have cC : Continuous (fun x => k * ∑ j, cE j * (x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) * γ j x)) :=
      continuous_const.mul (continuous_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => continuous_const.mul (cp.mul (hγ j))))
    have cD : Continuous (fun x => 1 / 2 * ∑ j, ∑ l, cE j * cE l * (γ j x * γ l x)) :=
      continuous_const.mul (continuous_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => continuous_finset_sum _
        (fun l _ => continuous_const.mul ((hγ j).mul (hγ l)))))
    rw [← hA, ← hB, ← hC, ← hD, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_add (hIc _ cA) (hIc _ cB),
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub ((hIc _ cA).add (hIc _ cB)) (hIc _ cC),
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (((hIc _ cA).add (hIc _ cB)).sub (hIc _ cC)) (hIc _ cD)]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    simp only [Uc, Ec, E0, cU, cE, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
      Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons]
    ring
  · 
    have hpx : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) / x * γ j x) (Set.uIcc x1 x2) :=
      fun j => (cp.continuousOn.div₀ continuous_id'.continuousOn
        (fun x hx => (hpos x hx).ne')).mul (hγ j).continuousOn
    have hgg : ∀ j l, ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => γ j x * γ l x / x) (Set.uIcc x1 x2) :=
      fun j l => ((hγ j).mul (hγ l)).continuousOn.div₀ continuous_id'.continuousOn
        (fun x hx => (hpos x hx).ne')
    have hP : ∫ x in x1..x2, ∑ j, cE j * (x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) / x * γ j x) =
        ∑ j, cE j * ∫ x in x1..x2, x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) / x * γ j x :=
      H1 3 cE (fun j x => x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) / x * γ j x) hpx
    have hQ : ∫ x in x1..x2, ∑ j, ∑ l, cE j * cE l * (γ j x * γ l x / x) =
        ∑ j, ∑ l, cE j * cE l * ∫ x in x1..x2, γ j x * γ l x / x :=
      H2 3 cE (fun j l x => γ j x * γ l x / x) hgg
    have iP : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => k * ∑ j, cE j * (x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) / x * γ j x))
        MeasureTheory.volume x1 x2 :=
      hIo _ (continuousOn_const.mul (continuousOn_finset_sum _
        (fun j _ => continuousOn_const.mul (hpx j))))
    have iQ : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 1 / 2 * ∑ j, ∑ l, cE j * cE l * (γ j x * γ l x / x))
        MeasureTheory.volume x1 x2 :=
      hIo _ (continuousOn_const.mul (continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun j _ =>
        continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun l _ => continuousOn_const.mul (hgg j l)))))
    rw [← hP, ← hQ, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_add iP iQ]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    simp only [Ec, E0, cE, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons]
    ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) (b : Fin n → Fin n → Fin n → ℝ), (∀ v : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, ∑ j, a i j * v j = 0) → v = 0) → ∃ (r L : ℝ) (g : (Fin n → ℝ) → (Fin n → ℝ)), 0 < r ∧ 0 ≤ L ∧ g 0 = 0 ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Metric.ball 0 r) ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin n → ℝ) r, (∀ i, ∑ j, a i j * g z j + ∑ j, ∑ l, b i j l * g z j * g z l = z i) ∧ ‖g z‖ ≤ L * ‖z‖

signature.name: quad_map_local_inverse
signature.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) (b : Fin n → Fin n → Fin n → ℝ), (∀ v : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, ∑ j, a i j * v j = 0) → v = 0) → ∃ (r L : ℝ) (g : (Fin n → ℝ) → (Fin n → ℝ)), 0 < r ∧ 0 ≤ L ∧ g 0 = 0 ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Metric.ball 0 r) ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin n → ℝ) r, (∀ i, ∑ j, a i j * g z j + ∑ j, ∑ l, b i j l * g z j * g z l = z i) ∧ ‖g z‖ ≤ L * ‖z‖

proof.tactics:
by
  intro n a b hinj
  set F : (Fin n → ℝ) → (Fin n → ℝ) :=
    fun v i => ∑ j, a i j * v j + ∑ j, ∑ l, b i j l * v j * v l with hFdef
  have hn : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F := by
    rw [hFdef]
    refine contDiff_pi.2 (fun i => ?_)
    exact ContDiff.add (ContDiff.sum fun j _ => contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ j))
      (ContDiff.sum fun j _ => ContDiff.sum fun l _ =>
        (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ j)).mul (contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ l))
  have hF0 : F 0 = 0 := by
    funext i; simp [hFdef]
  
  let A' : (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ) :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun i => ∑ j, a i j • ContinuousLinearMap.proj j)
  have hA' : ∀ w i, A' w i = ∑ j, a i j * w j := by
    intro w i; simp [A']
  have hD : HasFDerivAt F A' 0 := by
    rw [hasFDerivAt_pi']
    intro i
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun v : Fin n → ℝ => ∑ j, a i j * v j)
        (∑ j, a i j • ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) 0 := by
      apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum
      intro j _
      exact (hasFDerivAt_apply j 0).const_mul (a i j)
    have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun v : Fin n → ℝ => ∑ j, ∑ l, b i j l * v j * v l)
        (∑ j, ∑ l, ((b i j l * (0 : Fin n → ℝ) j) • ContinuousLinearMap.proj l +
          (0 : Fin n → ℝ) l • (b i j l • ContinuousLinearMap.proj j)) :
          (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) 0 := by
      apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum
      intro j _
      apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum
      intro l _
      exact ((hasFDerivAt_apply j 0).const_mul (b i j l)).mul (hasFDerivAt_apply l 0)
    refine (h1.add h2).congr_fderiv ?_
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun w => ?_)
    simp [A']
  
  have hinj' : Function.Injective (A' : (Fin n → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ)) := by
    intro v w hvw
    have hsub : v - w = 0 := hinj (v - w) (fun i => by
      have h := congrFun hvw i
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, hA'] at h
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, h, sub_self])
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 hsub
  let E0 : (Fin n → ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ) :=
    (LinearEquiv.ofInjectiveEndo _ hinj').toContinuousLinearEquiv
  have hE0 : (E0 : (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ)) = A' := by
    ext1 w; rfl
  have hD' : HasFDerivAt F (E0 : (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ)) 0 := by
    rw [hE0]; exact hD
  
  have hFa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F 0 := hF.contDiffAt
  set e := ContDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph F hFa hD' hn with he
  have heF : (e : (Fin n → ℝ) → (Fin n → ℝ)) = F :=
    ContDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe hFa hD' hn
  have h0s : (0 : Fin n → ℝ) ∈ e.source := ContDiffAt.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source hFa hD' hn
  have h0t : (0 : Fin n → ℝ) ∈ e.target := by
    have h := ContDiffAt.image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target hFa hD' hn
    rw [hF0] at h
    exact h
  have hs0 : e.symm 0 = 0 := by
    have h := e.left_inv h0s
    rw [heF, hF0] at h
    exact h
  
  obtain ⟨Ω, hΩdef⟩ : ∃ Ω : Set (Fin n → ℝ), Ω = fderiv ℝ F ⁻¹'
      range (ContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap :
        ((Fin n → ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ)) → ((Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΩ : IsOpen Ω := by
    rw [hΩdef]; exact ContinuousLinearEquiv.isOpen.preimage (hF.continuous_fderiv hn)
  have h0Ω : (0 : Fin n → ℝ) ∈ Ω := by
    rw [hΩdef]; exact ⟨E0, hD'.fderiv.symm⟩
  
  have hsymm0 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ e.symm 0 := by
    apply e.contDiffAt_symm h0t (f₀' := E0)
    · rw [hs0, heF]; exact hD'
    · rw [hs0, heF]; exact hFa
  have h1le : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
  obtain ⟨K, t, ht, hK⟩ := (hsymm0.of_le h1le).exists_lipschitzOnWith
  have hSo : IsOpen (e.target ∩ e.symm ⁻¹' Ω) := e.isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hΩ
  have hS0 : (0 : Fin n → ℝ) ∈ e.target ∩ e.symm ⁻¹' Ω :=
    ⟨h0t, by simp only [mem_preimage, hs0]; exact h0Ω⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.1 (Filter.inter_mem (hSo.mem_nhds hS0) ht)
  refine ⟨r, K, e.symm, hr, K.coe_nonneg, hs0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨⟨hzt, hzΩ⟩, -⟩ := hball hz
    rw [mem_preimage, hΩdef] at hzΩ
    obtain ⟨E1, hE1⟩ := hzΩ
    apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
    apply e.contDiffAt_symm hzt (f₀' := E1)
    · rw [heF]
      have h : HasFDerivAt F (fderiv ℝ F (e.symm z)) (e.symm z) :=
        (hF.differentiable hn _).hasFDerivAt
      rw [← hE1] at h
      exact h
    · rw [heF]; exact hF.contDiffAt
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨⟨hzt, -⟩, hzt'⟩ := hball hz
    refine ⟨fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h := e.right_inv hzt
      rw [heF] at h
      have h' := congrFun h i
      simpa [hFdef] using h'
    · have h0t' : (0 : Fin n → ℝ) ∈ t := (hball (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)).2
      have h := hK.norm_sub_le hzt' h0t'
      simpa [hs0] using h

informal_problem.statement: ∀ Md : ℝ, 0 < Md → ∃ P0 : ℝ, ∀ Pst : ℝ, P0 ≤ Pst → ∃ l0 : ℝ, 0 < l0 ∧ ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → lam ≤ l0 → ∃ h0 : ℝ, 0 < h0 ∧ ∀ h ρ T1 : ℝ, 0 < h → h ≤ h0 → 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ h / 800 → 4 * Real.log (1 / h) ≤ T1 → ∃ P : RfpPar, P.Md = Md ∧ P.Pst = Pst ∧ P.lam = lam ∧ P.h = h ∧ P.ρ = ρ ∧ P.T1 = T1 ∧ RfpRegime P ∧ RfpClos P

signature.name: rfp_moment_closure
signature.statement: ∀ Md : ℝ, 0 < Md → ∃ P0 : ℝ, ∀ Pst : ℝ, P0 ≤ Pst → ∃ l0 : ℝ, 0 < l0 ∧ ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → lam ≤ l0 → ∃ h0 : ℝ, 0 < h0 ∧ ∀ h ρ T1 : ℝ, 0 < h → h ≤ h0 → 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ h / 800 → 4 * Real.log (1 / h) ≤ T1 → ∃ P : RfpPar, P.Md = Md ∧ P.Pst = Pst ∧ P.lam = lam ∧ P.h = h ∧ P.ρ = ρ ∧ P.T1 = T1 ∧ RfpRegime P ∧ RfpClos P

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Md hMd
  refine ⟨Real.exp (Real.exp Md + 10) + 1, ?_⟩
  intro Pst hPst
  have hE : 0 < Real.exp Md + 13 := by positivity
  refine ⟨min (1 / 1000) (1 / (10 ^ 14 * (Real.exp Md + 13))), lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity), ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam0 hlam1
  have hlamA : lam ≤ 1 / 1000 := le_trans hlam1 (min_le_left _ _)
  have hlamB0 : lam ≤ 1 / (10 ^ 14 * (Real.exp Md + 13)) := le_trans hlam1 (min_le_right _ _)
  have hlamB1 : lam * (10 ^ 14 * (Real.exp Md + 13)) ≤ 1 := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mp hlamB0
  have hlamM : lam * (Real.exp Md + 13) ≤ 1 / 10 ^ 14 := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    calc lam * (Real.exp Md + 13) * 10 ^ 14 = lam * (10 ^ 14 * (Real.exp Md + 13)) := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 := hlamB1
  have hlamS : lam ≤ 1 / 10 ^ 14 := by
    have : lam ≤ lam * (Real.exp Md + 13) := by nlinarith [Real.exp_pos Md]
    linarith
  refine ⟨lam ^ 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro h ρ T1 hh0 hh1 hρ0 hρ1 hT1
  have hreg : ∀ (Lh : ℝ) (A c1 c2 ca : ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ Lh →
      RfpRegime (RfpPar.mk Md Pst lam h ρ T1 Lh A c1 c2 ca) := by
    intro Lh A c1 c2 ca hLh
    unfold RfpRegime
    exact ⟨(hMd : 0 < Md), (by linarith : Real.exp (Real.exp Md + 10) < Pst), (hlam0 : 0 < lam),
      (by linarith : lam ≤ 1 / 100), (hh0 : 0 < h), (hh1 : h ≤ lam ^ 2), (hρ0 : 0 < ρ),
      (hρ1 : ρ ≤ h / 800), (hT1 : 4 * Real.log (1 / h) ≤ T1), (hLh : 0 ≤ Lh)⟩
  
  have hl1 : lam ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hl9 : lam ^ 9 ≤ 1 / 1000 := le_trans (pow_le_of_le_one hlam0.le hl1 (by norm_num)) hlamA
  have hl20pos : 0 ≤ lam ^ 20 := by positivity
  have hl29 : lam ^ 29 ≤ lam ^ 20 / 1000 := by
    calc lam ^ 29 = lam ^ 20 * lam ^ 9 := by ring
      _ ≤ lam ^ 20 * (1 / 1000) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl9 hl20pos
      _ = lam ^ 20 / 1000 := by ring
  have hl20 : lam ^ 20 ≤ 1 / 1000 := le_trans (pow_le_of_le_one hlam0.le hl1 (by norm_num)) hlamA
  have hl29pos : 0 ≤ lam ^ 29 := by positivity
  
  obtain ⟨N5, G, δ, hN5, hGs, hG0, hGd, hδs, hδ0, hδb, hψ0, hI⟩ :=
    rfp_I_reduction (RfpPar.mk Md Pst lam h ρ T1 0 0 0 0 0) (hreg 0 0 0 0 0 le_rfl)
  have hδb' : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ δ η ∧ δ η ≤ lam ^ 29 ∧ |deriv δ η| ≤ lam ^ 29 := hδb
  have hδlt : ∀ η : ℝ, |δ η| < 1 / 40 * (1 / 16) := by
    intro η
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (hδb' η).1]
    have h' : δ η ≤ lam ^ 29 := (hδb' η).2.1
    linarith
  obtain ⟨g, hgs, hg⟩ := smooth_inverse_of_strict_anti G δ (1 / 16) (1 / 8) (1 / 40)
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hGs hG0 hGd hδs hδlt
  have hgb : ∀ η : ℝ, |g η| ≤ 40 * lam ^ 29 ∧ |deriv g η| ≤ 40 * lam ^ 29 := by
    intro η
    obtain ⟨-, hg1, hg2⟩ := hg η
    have hd1 : |δ η| ≤ lam ^ 29 := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (hδb' η).1]; exact (hδb' η).2.1
    have hd2 : |deriv δ η| ≤ lam ^ 29 := (hδb' η).2.2
    constructor
    · calc |g η| ≤ |δ η| / (1 / 40) := hg1
        _ = 40 * |δ η| := by ring
        _ ≤ 40 * lam ^ 29 := by linarith
    · calc |deriv g η| ≤ |deriv δ η| / (1 / 40) := hg2
        _ = 40 * |deriv δ η| := by ring
        _ ≤ 40 * lam ^ 29 := by linarith
  have hg0 : g 0 = 0 := by
    have h1 := (hg 0).2.1
    rw [hδ0, abs_zero, zero_div] at h1
    exact abs_nonpos_iff.mp h1
  have hg16 : ∀ e : ℝ, |g e| ≤ 1 / 16 := fun e => by linarith [(hgb e).1]
  have hgψ : ∀ (P : RfpPar), (∀ y : ℝ, |rfpPsi P y| ≤ 8) → ∀ (η y : ℝ),
      |g η * rfpPsi P y| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    intro P hP η y
    rw [abs_mul]
    calc |g η| * |rfpPsi P y| ≤ (40 * lam ^ 29) * 8 :=
          mul_le_mul (hgb η).1 (hP y) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have hgb' : ∀ η : ℝ, |g η| + |deriv g η| ≤ lam ^ 20 := by
    intro η
    have := hgb η
    linarith
  have hIP1 : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp (rfpY5 Md lam),
          2 * x * rfpF (RfpPar.mk Md Pst lam h ρ T1 0 0 0 0 g) x η) =
        ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp (rfpY5 Md lam),
          2 * x * rfpF (RfpPar.mk Md Pst lam h ρ T1 0 0 0 0 g) x 0 := by
    intro η _ _
    have e := hI g η hg16
    have e2 : N5 * (δ η - 0 - δ η) = 0 := by ring
    rw [(hg η).1, hg0, hG0, e2] at e
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp e
  
  obtain ⟨Lh, hLh, hFeq, hT⟩ := rfp_T_closure (RfpPar.mk Md Pst lam h ρ T1 0 0 0 0 g)
    (hreg 0 0 0 0 g le_rfl) hg0
    (fun η h1 h2 => ⟨fun y => hgψ (RfpPar.mk Md Pst lam h ρ T1 0 0 0 0 0) hψ0 η y, hIP1 η h1 h2⟩)
  have hIP2 : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp (rfpY5 Md lam),
          2 * x * rfpF (RfpPar.mk Md Pst lam h ρ T1 Lh 0 0 0 g) x η) =
        ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp (rfpY5 Md lam),
          2 * x * rfpF (RfpPar.mk Md Pst lam h ρ T1 Lh 0 0 0 g) x 0 := by
    have hcong : ∀ e : ℝ,
        (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp (rfpY5 Md lam),
            2 * x * rfpF (RfpPar.mk Md Pst lam h ρ T1 Lh 0 0 0 g) x e) =
          ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp (rfpY5 Md lam),
            2 * x * rfpF (RfpPar.mk Md Pst lam h ρ T1 0 0 0 0 g) x e := by
      intro e
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x hx
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (Real.exp_pos _).le] at hx
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hx.1 with h0 | hpos
      · subst h0
        simp
      · have hF := hFeq x e hpos hx.2
        show 2 * x * rfpF (RfpPar.mk Md Pst lam h ρ T1 Lh 0 0 0 g) x e =
          2 * x * rfpF (RfpPar.mk Md Pst lam h ρ T1 0 0 0 0 g) x e
        exact congrArg (fun v => 2 * x * v) hF
    intro η h1 h2
    rw [hcong η, hcong 0]
    exact hIP1 η h1 h2
  
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, hψ2, -⟩ :=
    rfp_I_reduction (RfpPar.mk Md Pst lam h ρ T1 Lh 0 0 0 g) (hreg Lh 0 0 0 g hLh)
  obtain ⟨α1, α2, γ1, γ2, hαγ, hMJ⟩ :=
    rfp_MJ_linear (RfpPar.mk Md Pst lam h ρ T1 Lh 0 0 0 g) (hreg Lh 0 0 0 g hLh) hlamA
  have hαγ' : |α1| + |α2| + |γ1| + |γ2| ≤ lam ^ 20 / 16 := hαγ
  
  obtain ⟨hD0, hIp1, hIp2, hB10, hB11, hB20, hB21, hK0, hK1, hW⟩ :=
    rfp_S_masses_pre (RfpPar.mk Md Pst lam h ρ T1 Lh 0 0 0 g) (hreg Lh 0 0 0 g hLh) hlamM
  obtain ⟨hC0, hC1, hΨ⟩ :=
    rfp_S_masses_post (RfpPar.mk Md Pst lam h ρ T1 Lh 0 0 0 g) (hreg Lh 0 0 0 g hLh)
  obtain ⟨hVs, hVb⟩ :=
    rfp_S_V_smooth (RfpPar.mk Md Pst lam h ρ T1 Lh 0 0 0 g) (hreg Lh 0 0 0 g hLh)
  obtain ⟨q2, q1, q0, hq2a, hq2b, hq1s, hq0s, hqb, hqd, hid⟩ :=
    rfp_S_coeffs lam _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ α1 α2 γ1 γ2 _ g hlam0 hlamS hD0 hIp1 hIp2 hB10 hB11 hB20 hB21
      hK0 hK1 hW hC0 hC1 hΨ hαγ' hVs hgs hVb hgb'

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hR hC
  have hR' : RfpRegime P := hR
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl1, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hR
  have sig0 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → sigA y = 0 := fun y hy => by unfold sigA; simp [hy]
  have sig1 : ∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → sigA y = 1 := fun y hy => by
    unfold sigA; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hy]
  have hl2 : P.lam ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 10000 := by nlinarith
  have hh1 : P.h ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hρ1 : P.ρ < 1 := by linarith
  have hlogh : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.h) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hh0]; linarith)
  have hT0 : 0 ≤ P.T1 := by linarith
  have hL : 1 / 2 < Real.log (1 / P.lam) := by
    have h2 : (2:ℝ) ≤ 1 / P.lam := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith
    have := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) h2
    linarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
  have hexpMd : 0 < Real.exp P.Md := Real.exp_pos _
  have hlam13 : 0 < 13 / P.lam := by positivity
  have eY2 : rfpY2 P.Md = Real.exp P.Md + 11 := rfl
  have eY3 : rfpY3 P.Md P.lam = rfpY2 P.Md + 1 + 60 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  have eY4 : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam = rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 13 / P.lam := rfl
  have eY5 : rfpY5 P.Md P.lam = rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  have eYb : rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh = rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 2 + P.T1 + P.Lh + 3 := rfl
  
  have hord : 1 < rfpXg P ∧ rfpXg P < rfpXg2 P ∧ rfpXg2 P < rfpXk P 24 ∧ rfpXk P 24 < rfpXk P 21 ∧
      rfpXk P 21 < rfpXk P 19 ∧ rfpXk P 19 < rfpXk P 16 ∧ rfpXk P 16 < rfpXk P 13 ∧
      rfpXk P 13 < rfpXk P 10 ∧ rfpXk P 10 < rfpXk P 7 ∧ rfpXk P 7 < rfpXk P 4 ∧
      rfpXk P 4 < rfpXv P ∧ rfpXv P < rfpXb P * Real.exp (-3) ∧ 0 < rfpCp P ∧ 0 < rfpCi P := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := Real.add_one_le_exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1)
      unfold rfpXg; rw [eY2] at this ⊢; linarith
    · unfold rfpXg rfpXg2; exact Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (by linarith)
    · unfold rfpXg2 rfpXk; exact Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (by rw [eY3]; linarith)
    · unfold rfpXk; exact Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (by linarith)
    · unfold rfpXk; exact Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (by linarith)
    · unfold rfpXk; exact Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (by linarith)
    · unfold rfpXk; exact Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (by linarith)
    · unfold rfpXk; exact Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (by linarith)
    · unfold rfpXk; exact Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (by linarith)
    · unfold rfpXk; exact Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (by linarith)
    · unfold rfpXk rfpXv; exact Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (by rw [eY4]; linarith)
    · unfold rfpXv rfpXb; rw [← Real.exp_add]
      exact Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (by rw [eYb, eY5]; linarith)
    · unfold rfpCp; exact Real.exp_pos _
    · unfold rfpCi; exact div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (by linarith)
  
  have hpos : ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -2 < η → η < 2 → 0 < rfpF P x η := by
    intro x η hx h1 h2
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, hca, -, -⟩ := hC
    have hb := (hca η h1 h2).2 (Real.log x)
    have hin : 0 < 1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P (Real.log x) := by
      have := neg_abs_le (P.ca η * rfpPsi P (Real.log x)); linarith
    unfold rfpF rfpE
    apply div_pos
    · exact mul_pos (mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) _))
        (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hin)
    · exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by linarith)
  
  have hxv0 : 0 < rfpXv P := Real.exp_pos _
  have hU0 : ∀ x η : ℝ, rfpXv P ≤ x → rfpU P x η = 0 := by
    intro x η hx
    have hxpos : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hxv0 hx
    have hy : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ≤ Real.log x := by
      have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hx
      unfold rfpXv at this
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
    have hy' : Real.exp P.Md + 11 + 1 + 60 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) + 13 / P.lam ≤ Real.log x := by
      rw [eY4, eY3, eY2] at hy; exact hy
    have hK : rfpK P.Md (Real.log x) = 0 := by
      unfold rfpK
      rw [if_neg (by intro h; linarith)]
      have hlog : P.Md ≤ Real.log (Real.log x) := by
        have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos P.Md) (show Real.exp P.Md ≤ Real.log x by linarith)
        rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
      rw [sig1 _ (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hMd]; linarith)]
      ring
    have hRb : rfpRb P (Real.log x) η = 0 := by
      unfold rfpRb rfpR0 rfpBmp
      have hd : 13 / P.lam ≤ Real.log x - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam := by rw [eY4] at hy; linarith
      have hd' := (div_le_iff₀ hl0).1 hd
      have hxi : 13 ≤ P.lam * (Real.log x - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) := by
        linarith [mul_comm P.lam (Real.log x - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)]
      have hY4 : 0 ≤ Real.log x - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam := by linarith
      rw [sig1 (P.lam * (Real.log x - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) - 10) (by linarith),
        sig0 (1 - (Real.log x - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) / (3 / 20)) (by linarith),
        sig0 (1 - (Real.log x - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) / (3 / 20)) (by linarith)]
      ring
    unfold rfpU
    rw [hK, hRb]; ring
  have hxv : ∀ x η : ℝ, rfpXv P ≤ x → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      rfpU P x η = 0 ∧ profRadInt (rfpU P) x η = 0 := by
    intro x η hx h1 h2
    refine ⟨hU0 x η hx, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hmom⟩ := hC
    have hI0 := (hmom η h1 h2).1
    unfold profRadInt
    have hzero : ∫ t in (rfpXv P)..x, rfpU P t η = 0 := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ))]
      · simp
      · intro t ht
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hx] at ht
        exact hU0 t η ht.1
    by_cases hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => rfpU P t η) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (rfpXv P)
    · have hint2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => rfpU P t η) MeasureTheory.volume (rfpXv P) x := by
        have h0 : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => (0:ℝ)) MeasureTheory.volume (rfpXv P) x :=
          intervalIntegrable_const
        refine h0.congr ?_
        intro t ht
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hx] at ht
        exact (hU0 t η ht.1.le).symm
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals hint hint2, hI0, hzero, add_zero]
    · have hnot : ¬ IntervalIntegrable (fun t => rfpU P t η) MeasureTheory.volume 0 x := by
        intro h
        apply hint
        apply h.mono_set
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hxv0.le, Set.uIcc_of_le (le_trans hxv0.le hx)]
        exact Set.Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hx
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_undef hnot
  obtain ⟨hin, hpat⟩ := rfp_inner_patch P hR'
  obtain ⟨htail, hcol⟩ := rfp_tail_collar P hR'
  exact ⟨hord, hin, hpat, hxv, htail, rfp_shape_data P hR', rfp_leadPi_identity P hR' hC, hcol, hpos⟩

      intro p hp
      apply ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      have hpn := hΩ.mem_nhds hp
      have c1 := hFv.continuousAt hpn
      have c2 := hUv.continuousAt hpn
      have c3 := hi1.continuousAt hpn
      have c4 := hdi1.continuousAt hpn
      have c5 := hi2.continuousAt hpn
      have c6 := hdi2.continuousAt hpn
      have c7 := hi3.continuousAt hpn
      have c8 := hdi3.continuousAt hpn
      have c9 := hi4.continuousAt hpn
      have c10 := hdi4.continuousAt hpn
      have c11 := hpv.continuousAt hpn
      have c12 := hdpv.continuousAt hpn
      have c13 := hfx.continuousAt hpn
      have c14 := hux.continuousAt hpn
      have h0 : 0 < p.1 := hp.1
      have h1 := hFv0 p hp
      have h2 := hD p hp
      fun_prop (disch := positivity)
  obtain ⟨A1, A2, A3, A4⟩ := assemble F U (profRadInt U) (profEtaD (profRadInt U))
    (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) (profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)))
    (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)))
    (profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))))
    (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2))
    (profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)))
    (leadPi F) (profEtaD (leadPi F))
    (fun X η => deriv (fun Y => F Y η) X) (fun X η => deriv (fun Y => U Y η) X)
    hFc hUc R1.1 R1.2 R2.1 R2.2 R3.1 R3.2 R4.1 R4.2 T1 T2 (hFx.mono hsub) (hUx.mono hsub)
    (fun p hp => hFpos p.1 p.2 hp.1 (by linarith [hp.2.1]) (by linarith [hp.2.2]))
  refine ⟨A1.congr ?_, A2.congr ?_, A3.congr ?_, A4.congr ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨X, η⟩ ⟨hX, h1, h2⟩
    show shearA F X η = _
    simp only [shearA]
  · rintro ⟨X, η⟩ ⟨hX, h1, h2⟩
    show shearB F U X η = _
    simp only [shearB]
  · rintro ⟨X, η⟩ ⟨hX, h1, h2⟩

    have hX0 : X ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hX
    show psLead2 h F U X η = _
    simp only [psLead2, leadNs, leadW, havg X η hX0, hdavg X η hX0]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h x1 x2 : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (adm : Prop), 0 < x1 → x1 ≤ x2 → ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => F z.1 z.2) (Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1) 1) → ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => shearA F z.1 z.2) (Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1) 1) → ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => shearB F U z.1 z.2) (Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1) 1) → ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => psLead1 h F U z.1 z.2) (Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1) 1) → ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => psLead2 h F U z.1 z.2) (Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1) 1) → (∀ x η : ℝ, x1 ≤ x → x ≤ x2 → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → RfpStrict adm h F U x η) → ∃ μ0 : ℝ, 0 < μ0 ∧ μ0 ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → μ ≤ μ0 → NMargin h μ (Icc x1 x2) F U adm

signature.statement: ∀ (h x1 x2 : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (adm : Prop), 0 < x1 → x1 ≤ x2 → ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => F z.1 z.2) (Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1) 1) → ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => shearA F z.1 z.2) (Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1) 1) → ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => shearB F U z.1 z.2) (Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1) 1) → ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => psLead1 h F U z.1 z.2) (Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1) 1) → ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => psLead2 h F U z.1 z.2) (Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1) 1) → (∀ x η : ℝ, x1 ≤ x → x ≤ x2 → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → RfpStrict adm h F U x η) → ∃ μ0 : ℝ, 0 < μ0 ∧ μ0 ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → μ ≤ μ0 → NMargin h μ (Icc x1 x2) F U adm

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h x1 x2 F U adm hx1 hx12 hFc hAc hBc hP1c hP2c hstr
  have hK : IsCompact (Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  have hne : (Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1).Nonempty :=
    (Set.nonempty_Icc.2 hx12).prod (Set.nonempty_Icc.2 (by norm_num))
  have hS : ∀ z ∈ Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, RfpStrict adm h F U z.1 z.2 :=
    fun z hz => hstr z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2
  have hmin : ∀ g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn g (Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ z ∈ Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, 0 < g z) →
      ∃ m : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ ∀ z ∈ Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, m ≤ g z := by
    intro g hg hpos
    obtain ⟨z0, hz0, hmn⟩ := hK.exists_isMinOn hne hg
    exact ⟨g z0, hpos z0 hz0, fun z hz => isMinOn_iff.1 hmn z hz⟩
  have hAne : ∀ z ∈ Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, shearA F z.1 z.2 ≠ 0 :=
    fun z hz => ne_of_gt (hS z hz).2.1
  have hP1ne : ∀ z ∈ Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, psLead1 h F U z.1 z.2 ≠ 0 :=
    fun z hz => ne_of_gt (hS z hz).2.2.1
  have hq : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => psLead2 h F U z.1 z.2 / psLead1 h F U z.1 z.2)
      (Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := hP2c.div hP1c hP1ne
  have hba : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => shearB F U z.1 z.2 / shearA F z.1 z.2)
      (Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := hBc.div hAc hAne
  have hb2a : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => shearB F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2 / shearA F z.1 z.2)
      (Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := (hBc.pow 2).div hAc hAne
  have hg1 : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => shearA F z.1 z.2 - shearB F U z.1 z.2 *
      (psLead2 h F U z.1 z.2 / psLead1 h F U z.1 z.2)) (Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
    hAc.sub (hBc.mul hq)
  have hg2 : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => 2 - 2 * shearB F U z.1 z.2 *
      (psLead2 h F U z.1 z.2 / psLead1 h F U z.1 z.2) - shearB F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2 / shearA F z.1 z.2
      - (shearA F z.1 z.2 - 2) * (psLead2 h F U z.1 z.2 / psLead1 h F U z.1 z.2) ^ 2)
      (Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
    ((continuousOn_const.sub ((continuousOn_const.mul hBc).mul hq)).sub hb2a).sub
      ((hAc.sub continuousOn_const).mul (hq.pow 2))
  have hg3 : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => shearA F z.1 z.2 *
      (1 + (shearB F U z.1 z.2 / shearA F z.1 z.2) ^ 2) - 2) (Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
    (hAc.mul (continuousOn_const.add (hba.pow 2))).sub continuousOn_const
  obtain ⟨mF, hmF, hmFb⟩ := hmin _ hFc (fun z hz => (hS z hz).1)
  obtain ⟨ma, hma, hmab⟩ := hmin _ hAc (fun z hz => (hS z hz).2.1)
  obtain ⟨mP, hmP, hmPb⟩ := hmin _ hP1c (fun z hz => (hS z hz).2.2.1)
  obtain ⟨m1, hm1, hm1b⟩ := hmin _ hg1 (fun z hz => (hS z hz).2.2.2.1)
  obtain ⟨m2, hm2, hm2b⟩ := hmin _ hg2 (fun z hz => (hS z hz).2.2.2.2.1)
  obtain ⟨m3, hm3, hm3b⟩ : ∃ m3 : ℝ, 0 < m3 ∧ (adm → ∀ z ∈ Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      m3 ≤ shearA F z.1 z.2 * (1 + (shearB F U z.1 z.2 / shearA F z.1 z.2) ^ 2) - 2) := by
    by_cases hadm : adm
    · obtain ⟨m, hm, hmb⟩ := hmin _ hg3 (fun z hz => by
        have := (hS z hz).2.2.2.2.2 hadm
        show 0 < shearA F z.1 z.2 * (1 + (shearB F U z.1 z.2 / shearA F z.1 z.2) ^ 2) - 2
        linarith)
      exact ⟨m, hm, fun _ => hmb⟩
    · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun h' => absurd h' hadm⟩
  obtain ⟨Ca, hCa⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hAc
  obtain ⟨Cb, hCb⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hBc
  obtain ⟨Cp, hCp⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hP2c
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = max 1 (max Ca (max Cb Cp)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hM1 : 1 ≤ M := by rw [hM]; exact le_max_left _ _
  have hM0 : 0 < M := by linarith
  have hMa : Ca ≤ M := by rw [hM]; exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hMb : Cb ≤ M := by
    rw [hM]; exact le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hMp : Cp ≤ M := by
    rw [hM]; exact le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hiM : 0 < 1 / M := by positivity
  have hPM : 0 < mP / M := by positivity
  refine ⟨min 1 (min mF (min ma (min (1 / M) (min mP (min (mP / M) (min m1 (min m2 m3))))))),
    ?_, min_le_left _ _, ?_⟩
  · simp only [lt_min_iff]
    exact ⟨one_pos, hmF, hma, hiM, hmP, hPM, hm1, hm2, hm3⟩
  · intro μ hμ hμle x hx η h1 h2
    simp only [le_min_iff] at hμle
    obtain ⟨-, hμF, hμa, hμM, hμP, hμPM, hμ1, hμ2, hμ3⟩ := hμle
    have hz : ((x, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Icc x1 x2 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hx, h1.le, h2.le⟩
    have hp1 : mP ≤ psLead1 h F U x η := hmPb _ hz
    have hMμ : M ≤ 1 / μ := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hμ]
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hM0] at hμM
      linarith [mul_comm M μ]
    have hMμP : M ≤ psLead1 h F U x η / μ := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hμ]
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hM0] at hμPM
      linarith [mul_comm M μ]
    have ha : ‖shearA F x η‖ ≤ Ca := hCa _ hz
    have hb : ‖shearB F U x η‖ ≤ Cb := hCb _ hz
    have hp : ‖psLead2 h F U x η‖ ≤ Cp := hCp _ hz
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at ha hb hp
    refine ⟨le_trans hμF (hmFb _ hz), le_trans hμa (hmab _ hz), ?_, ?_, le_trans hμP hp1, ?_,
      le_trans hμ1 (hm1b _ hz), le_trans hμ2 (hm2b _ hz),
      fun hadm => le_trans hμ3 (hm3b hadm _ hz)⟩
    · linarith [le_abs_self (shearA F x η)]
    · linarith
    · linarith

by
  obtain ⟨⟨Sm, hSm0, hSm⟩, hKC⟩ := rfp_inner_kC_facts
  have hsig0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → sigA t = 0 := by

  have hsig01 : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA t ∧ sigA t ≤ 1 := by
    intro t; unfold sigA

    · norm_num

  have GM : ∀ a b W : ℝ, 0 < a → ((b = 0 ∧ a ≤ 2) ∨ (a = 2 ∧ b ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 64 ∧ |b * W| ≤ 1 / 4) ∨
      (b = 0 ∧ 2 ≤ a ∧ (a - 2) * W ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 2)) →

    · have e1 : a - b * W = a := by rw [hb]; ring

noncomputable def rinMom (g : ℝ → ℝ) (X : ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, g x

noncomputable def rinQf (h : ℝ) (c k : ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(1 - (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x)) X / X)
  + ((1 - h + (1 / 2 - h) * (2 * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2))) * rinMom (fun x => Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x)) X

         * rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x) * (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x))) X)
    / (X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * c (Real.log X)))

noncomputable def rinNf (h : ℝ) (c k : ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=

subgoal_signatures.name: rfp_lead_explicit
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h X1 : ℝ) (c k : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < X1 → Differentiable ℝ c → Differentiable ℝ k → (∀ y, 0 < c y) → (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ y, y ≤ Real.log X1 → |c y| ≤ M ∧ |k y| ≤ M) → (∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → x < X1 → U x η = η * k (Real.log x) ∧ F x η = c (Real.log x) * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ / Real.sqrt (2 * x)) → ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < X1 → shearA F X η = 1 - 2 * deriv c (Real.log X) / c (Real.log X) ∧ shearB F U X η = 2 * η * deriv k (Real.log X) * (1 + η ^ 2) / c (Real.log X) ∧ leadQs h F U X η = rinQf h c k X η ∧ leadNs h F U X η = η * rinNf h c k X η + 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * leadPi F X η - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (leadPi F) X η

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ Md Pst lam : ℝ, 1 ≤ Md → Real.exp (rfpY2 Md - 1) < Pst → 0 < lam → lam ≤ 1 / 100 → (∀ X, 0 < X → 0 ≤ rinMom (fun x => rfpK Md (Real.log x)) X ∧ rinMom (fun x => rfpK Md (Real.log x)) X ≤ 4 * X ∧ 0 ≤ rinMom (fun x => rfpK Md (Real.log x) ^ 2) X ∧ rinMom (fun x => rfpK Md (Real.log x) ^ 2) X ≤ 16 * X ∧ 0 ≤ rinMom (fun x => rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2) X) ∧ (∀ X, Real.exp 1 ≤ X → X ≤ Real.exp (rfpY2 Md) → rinMom (fun x => rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2) X ≤ (Real.log X + 2) * rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log X) ^ 2 * X / 2 ∧ Pst ^ 2 / X ≤ rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log X) ^ 2) ∧ (∀ X, Real.exp (rfpY2 Md) ≤ X → X ≤ Real.exp (rfpY2 Md + 2) → rinMom (fun x => rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2) X ≤ (rfpY2 Md + 3) * rinC Md Pst lam (rfpY2 Md) ^ 2 * X / 2 ∧ rinC Md Pst lam (rfpY2 Md) * Real.exp (-(51 / 50)) ≤ rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log X) ∧ rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log X) ≤ rinC Md Pst lam (rfpY2 Md)) ∧ 1 ≤ rinC Md Pst lam (rfpY2 Md) ∧ rinC Md Pst lam (rfpY2 Md) ≤ 6 / 5 * Pst

rfp_exterior_strict.definitions:
noncomputable def rfpY6 (P : RfpPar) : ℝ := rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 2 + P.T1

noncomputable def rfpExtS (P : RfpPar) (x η : ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ s in Ioi x, s * rfpF P s η ^ 2

noncomputable def rfpExtQ (P : RfpPar) (x η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -1 + ((1 - P.h) * profRadInt (fun s e => 2 * s * rfpF P s e) x η
      - (1 / 2 - P.h) * η * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun s e => 2 * s * rfpF P s e)) x η) /
    (x * (2 * x * rfpF P x η))

noncomputable def rfpExtN (P : RfpPar) (x η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (4 * P.h * η * rfpExtS P x η - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (rfpExtS P) x η) / x
    + 4 * (1 / 2 + P.h) * η * leadPi (rfpF P) x η - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (leadPi (rfpF P)) x η

  set r := b ^ 2 / a with hrdef
  set r' := b' ^ 2 / a' with hr'def
  have hra : r * a = b ^ 2 := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hane
  have hra' : r' * a' = b' ^ 2 := div_mul_cancel₀ _ ha'ne
  have hbsq : b ^ 2 ≤ K ^ 2 := by
    have h := mul_le_mul hb hb (abs_nonneg b) hK0.le
    have h' := abs_mul_abs_self b
    nlinarith
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := div_nonneg (sq_nonneg b) ha0.le
  have hrK : r ≤ K ^ 3 := by
    have h1 : r * μ ≤ r * a := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha1 hr0
    have h2 : K * (r * μ) ≤ K * K ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hK0.le
    have h3 : K * (r * μ) = r := by linear_combination r * hμK
    nlinarith
  have hbb : |b' + b| ≤ 3 * K := by
    have := abs_add_le b' b
    linarith
  have dr : |r' - r| ≤ 8 * (τ * K ^ 4) := by
    have hid : a' * (r' - r) = (b' + b) * (b' - b) - r * (a' - a) := by
      linear_combination hra' - hra
    have h1 : a' * |r' - r| ≤ 3 * K * τ + K ^ 3 * τ := by
      have h : a' * |r' - r| = |(b' + b) * (b' - b) - r * (a' - a)| := by
        rw [← hid, abs_mul, abs_of_pos ha'0]
      rw [h]
      calc |(b' + b) * (b' - b) - r * (a' - a)| ≤ |(b' + b) * (b' - b)| + |r * (a' - a)| :=
            abs_sub _ _
        _ = |b' + b| * |b' - b| + |r| * |a' - a| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        _ ≤ 3 * K * τ + K ^ 3 * τ := by
            rw [abs_of_nonneg hr0]
            exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul hbb db (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith))
              (mul_le_mul hrK da (abs_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg hK0.le 3))
    have h2 : μ / 2 * |r' - r| ≤ a' * |r' - r| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha' (abs_nonneg _)
    have h3 : K * (μ / 2 * |r' - r|) ≤ K * (3 * K * τ + K ^ 3 * τ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h2.trans h1) hK0.le
    have h4 : K * (μ / 2 * |r' - r|) = 1 / 2 * |r' - r| := by
      linear_combination (1 / 2 * |r' - r|) * hμK
    linarith
  have dquad : |(a' - 2) * q' ^ 2 - (a - 2) * q ^ 2| ≤ 40 * (τ * K ^ 4) := by
    have hid : (a' - 2) * q' ^ 2 - (a - 2) * q ^ 2
        = (a' - a) * q' ^ 2 + (a - 2) * ((q' + q) * (q' - q)) := by ring
    have hq'sq : q' ^ 2 ≤ 4 * K ^ 2 := by
      have h := mul_le_mul hq' hq' (abs_nonneg q') (by linarith)
      have h' := abs_mul_abs_self q'
      nlinarith
    have ha2' : |a - 2| ≤ 3 * K := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hqq : |q' + q| ≤ 3 * K := by
      have := abs_add_le q' q
      linarith
    rw [hid]
    calc |(a' - a) * q' ^ 2 + (a - 2) * ((q' + q) * (q' - q))|
        ≤ |(a' - a) * q' ^ 2| + |(a - 2) * ((q' + q) * (q' - q))| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = |a' - a| * q' ^ 2 + |a - 2| * (|q' + q| * |q' - q|) := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg q')]
      _ ≤ τ * (4 * K ^ 2) + 3 * K * (3 * K * (4 * (τ * K ^ 2))) :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul da hq'sq (sq_nonneg _) hτ0)
            (mul_le_mul ha2' (mul_le_mul hqq dq (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith))
              (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) (by linarith))
      _ ≤ 40 * (τ * K ^ 4) := by linarith
  obtain ⟨bq1, bq2⟩ := abs_le.mp hbq
  obtain ⟨dr1, dr2⟩ := abs_le.mp dr
  obtain ⟨dd1, dd2⟩ := abs_le.mp dquad
  refine ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith
  · linarith
  · intro hadm
    have := hE3 hadm
    linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h X0 : ℝ) (F U G V : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < X0 → (∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → x < X0 → -1 < η → η < 1 → G x η = F x η ∧ V x η = U x η) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => G x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), G x η ^ 2) = ∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), F x η ^ 2) → ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → x < X0 → -1 < η → η < 1 → G x η = F x η ∧ shearA G x η = shearA F x η ∧ shearB G V x η = shearB F U x η ∧ psLead1 h G V x η = psLead1 h F U x η ∧ psLead2 h G V x η = psLead2 h F U x η

signature.name: cone_data_local
signature.statement: ∀ (h X0 : ℝ) (F U G V : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < X0 → (∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → x < X0 → -1 < η → η < 1 → G x η = F x η ∧ V x η = U x η) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => G x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), G x η ^ 2) = ∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), F x η ^ 2) → ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → x < X0 → -1 < η → η < 1 → G x η = F x η ∧ shearA G x η = shearA F x η ∧ shearB G V x η = shearB F U x η ∧ psLead1 h G V x η = psLead1 h F U x η ∧ psLead2 h G V x η = psLead2 h F U x η

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h X0 F U G V hX0 hloc htot x η hx hxX hη1 hη2
  have hO : Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ∈ nhds η := Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2
  
  have hRI : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
      (∀ y e : ℝ, 0 < y → y < X0 → -1 < e → e < 1 → f y e = g y e) →
      profRadInt f x η = profRadInt g x η ∧
        profEtaD (profRadInt f) x η = profEtaD (profRadInt g) x η := by
    intro f g hfg
    have key : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → profRadInt f x e = profRadInt g x e := by
      intro e he1 he2
      unfold profRadInt
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
      refine MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun y hy => ?_)
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hx.le] at hy
      exact hfg y e hy.1 (lt_of_le_of_lt hy.2 hxX) he1 he2
    refine ⟨key η hη1 hη2, ?_⟩
    unfold profEtaD
    exact Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq
      (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hO (fun e he => key e he.1 he.2))
  have hRA : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
      (∀ y e : ℝ, 0 < y → y < X0 → -1 < e → e < 1 → f y e = g y e) →
      profRadAvg f x η = profRadAvg g x η ∧
        profEtaD (profRadAvg f) x η = profEtaD (profRadAvg g) x η := by
    intro f g hfg
    have key : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → profRadAvg f x e = profRadAvg g x e := by
      intro e he1 he2
      unfold profRadAvg
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
      refine MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun s hs => ?_)
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at hs
      have h1 : 0 < s * x := mul_pos hs.1 hx
      have h2 : s * x ≤ x := mul_le_of_le_one_left hx.le hs.2
      exact hfg (s * x) e h1 (lt_of_le_of_lt h2 hxX) he1 he2
    refine ⟨key η hη1 hη2, ?_⟩
    unfold profEtaD
    exact Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq
      (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hO (fun e he => key e he.1 he.2))
  
  have hPkey : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → leadPi G x e = leadPi F x e := by
    intro e he1 he2
    obtain ⟨iF, iG, ht⟩ := htot e he1 he2
    have split : ∀ H : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, IntegrableOn (fun y => H y e ^ 2) (Ioi 0) →
        (∫ y in Ioi (0:ℝ), H y e ^ 2) =
          (∫ y in Ioc (0:ℝ) x, H y e ^ 2) + ∫ y in Ioi x, H y e ^ 2 := by
      intro H hH
      rw [← Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hx.le]
      exact MeasureTheory.setIntegral_union (Set.Ioc_disjoint_Ioi le_rfl) measurableSet_Ioi
        (hH.mono_set Set.Ioc_subset_Ioi_self) (hH.mono_set (Set.Ioi_subset_Ioi hx.le))
    have hc : (∫ y in Ioc (0:ℝ) x, G y e ^ 2) = ∫ y in Ioc (0:ℝ) x, F y e ^ 2 := by
      apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioc
      intro y hy
      simp only
      rw [(hloc y e hy.1 (lt_of_le_of_lt hy.2 hxX) he1 he2).1]
    have s1 := split G iG
    have s2 := split F iF
    unfold leadPi
    linarith
  have hP : leadPi G x η = leadPi F x η := hPkey η hη1 hη2
  have hdP : profEtaD (leadPi G) x η = profEtaD (leadPi F) x η := by
    unfold profEtaD
    exact Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq
      (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hO (fun e he => hPkey e he.1 he.2))
  
  have hN : Set.Ioo 0 X0 ∈ nhds x := Ioo_mem_nhds hx hxX
  have dG : deriv (fun Y => G Y η) x = deriv (fun Y => F Y η) x :=
    Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq
      (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hN (fun y hy => (hloc y η hy.1 hy.2 hη1 hη2).1))
  have dV : deriv (fun Y => V Y η) x = deriv (fun Y => U Y η) x :=
    Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq
      (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hN (fun y hy => (hloc y η hy.1 hy.2 hη1 hη2).2))
  obtain ⟨hG, hV⟩ := hloc x η hx hxX hη1 hη2
  
  obtain ⟨P1a, P1b⟩ := hRI (fun x e => 2 * x * G x e) (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)
    (fun y e h1 h2 h3 h4 => by simp only [(hloc y e h1 h2 h3 h4).1])
  obtain ⟨P2a, P2b⟩ := hRI (fun x e => V x e * (2 * x * G x e)) (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))
    (fun y e h1 h2 h3 h4 => by simp only [(hloc y e h1 h2 h3 h4).1, (hloc y e h1 h2 h3 h4).2])
  obtain ⟨P3a, P3b⟩ := hRI V U (fun y e h1 h2 h3 h4 => (hloc y e h1 h2 h3 h4).2)
  obtain ⟨P3c, P3d⟩ := hRA V U (fun y e h1 h2 h3 h4 => (hloc y e h1 h2 h3 h4).2)
  obtain ⟨P4a, P4b⟩ := hRI (fun x e => V x e ^ 2 - x * G x e ^ 2) (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)
    (fun y e h1 h2 h3 h4 => by simp only [(hloc y e h1 h2 h3 h4).1, (hloc y e h1 h2 h3 h4).2])
  have hW : leadW h V x η = leadW h U x η := by
    unfold leadW
    rw [P3c, P3d]
  
  have hQ : leadQs h G V x η = leadQs h F U x η := by
    unfold leadQs
    rw [hW, P1a, P1b, P2a, P2b, hG]
  have hNs : leadNs h G V x η = leadNs h F U x η := by
    unfold leadNs
    rw [hW, hV, P3a, P3b, P4a, P4b, hP, hdP]
  refine ⟨hG, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold shearA
    rw [dG, hG]
  · unfold shearB
    rw [dV, hG]
  · unfold psLead1
    rw [hQ]
  · unfold psLead2
    rw [hNs, hG]
