signature.statement: AxDatumSmooth → ∀ (h Pst : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ), AxDatum h Pst Pax → ∀ (j0 σ δ ρ : ℝ) (Pc : ℂ → ℂ), 0 < j0 → j0 ≤ 1 / 20 → AxData h j0 σ δ ρ Pc Pax → ∃ Λ0 K1 ρ1 : ℝ, 0 < ρ1 ∧ ρ1 ≤ ρ ∧ 1 ≤ Λ0 ∧ 0 < K1 ∧ ∀ Λ : ℝ, Λ0 ≤ Λ → ∃ (C0 : ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ), ∀ C : ℝ, C0 ≤ C → ∃ Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, AxRaw h j0 σ Pax Λ C K1 ρ1 Kder Fn Un

proof.tactics:
by
  intro _hSm h Pst Pax hD j0 σ δ ρ Pc hj0 hj0' hAD
  have hh0 : 0 < h := hD.1
  have hh1 : h < 1 / 100 := hD.2.1
  have hρ0 : 0 < ρ := hAD.2.2.1
  
  obtain ⟨r, M, χc, ζc, ℓc, zc, Ξ, hCD⟩ := ax_coef_data h j0 σ δ ρ Pc Pax hh0 hh1 hj0 hj0' hAD
  obtain ⟨hr0, hrρ, hr100, hM20, hχd, hζd, hℓd, hzd, -, -, hbd, -⟩ := id hCD
  
  obtain ⟨Λ0, A, hMaj⟩ := ax_rec_majorant h j0 r M χc ζc ℓc zc hh0 hh1 hj0.le hj0' hr0 hr100 hM20
    hχd hζd hℓd hzd
    (fun w hw => ⟨(hbd w hw).1, (hbd w hw).2.1, (hbd w hw).2.2.1, (hbd w hw).2.2.2.1⟩)
  
  obtain ⟨Λ1, hS⟩ := ax_raw_smooth_pos h Pst Pax j0 σ δ ρ Pc r M Λ0 A χc ζc ℓc zc Ξ hD hj0 hj0' hAD hCD hMaj
  obtain ⟨Λ2, hO⟩ := ax_raw_ode h Pst Pax j0 σ δ ρ Pc r M Λ0 A χc ζc ℓc zc Ξ hD hj0 hj0' hAD hCD hMaj
  obtain ⟨Λ3, hH⟩ := ax_raw_holo h Pst Pax j0 σ δ ρ Pc r M Λ0 A χc ζc ℓc zc Ξ hD hj0 hj0' hAD hCD hMaj
  obtain ⟨Λ4, K1, hK1, hCl⟩ :=
    ax_raw_close h Pst Pax j0 σ δ ρ Pc r M Λ0 A χc ζc ℓc zc Ξ hD hj0 hj0' hAD hCD hMaj
  obtain ⟨Λ5, hDv⟩ := ax_raw_derivs h Pst Pax j0 σ δ ρ Pc r M Λ0 A χc ζc ℓc zc Ξ hD hj0 hj0' hAD hCD hMaj
  refine ⟨max (max Λ1 Λ2) (max (max Λ3 Λ4) (max Λ5 1)), K1, r / 8, by linarith, by linarith, ?_, hK1, ?_⟩
  · exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
  intro Λ hΛ
  simp only [max_le_iff] at hΛ
  obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, ⟨h3, h4⟩, h5, -⟩ := hΛ
  obtain ⟨Kder, hKd⟩ := hDv Λ h5
  refine ⟨Real.exp (Λ * M), Kder, fun C hC =>
    ⟨axFnDef h j0 Λ C χc ζc ℓc zc Ξ, axUnDef h j0 Λ C χc ζc ℓc zc Ξ, ?_⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨s1, s2, s3⟩ := hS Λ C h1 hC
  unfold AxRaw
  exact ⟨s1, s2, s3, hO Λ C h2 hC, hH Λ C h3 hC, hCl Λ C h4 hC, hKd C hC⟩

ax_axis_raw.definitions:
def axRect (s : ℝ) : Set ℂ := {w : ℂ | |w.im| < s ∧ -1 - s < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + s}


noncomputable def axRecStep (h j0 Λ : ℝ) (χ ζ ℓ z g : ℂ → ℂ)
    (pv : ℕ → (ℂ → ℂ) × (ℂ → ℂ)) (n : ℕ) : (ℂ → ℂ) × (ℂ → ℂ) :=
  let P : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun i => (pv i).1
  let V : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun i => (pv i).2
  let D : ℂ := 1 / 2 - (h : ℂ)
  let A : ℂ := 1 / 2 + (h : ℂ)
  let L : ℂ := (Λ : ℂ)
  let d : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => 1 - w ^ 2
  let Us : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => 4 * w + (j0 : ℂ)
  let H : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => D * w + d w * Us w
  let Ws : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => 1 - 4 * d w - 2 * D * w * Us w
  let δ0 : ℕ → ℂ := fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else 0
  let Uc : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun i w => δ0 i * Us w + V i w / L
  let Bc : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun i w => -(2 * D * w * V i w + d w * deriv (V i) w) / ((i : ℂ) + 1)
  let Wc : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun i w => δ0 i * Ws w + Bc i w / L
  let Hc : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun i w => δ0 i * H w + d w * V i w / L
  let c : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun m w => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), P i w * P (m - i) w
  let gc : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => if n = 0 then 0 else g w ^ 2 * c (n - 1) w
  let p : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => gc w / (n : ℂ)
  let R1 : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
    ((Wc i w + (h : ℂ) * δ0 i - 2 * (h : ℂ) * w * Uc i w + d w * ζ w * V i w) * P (n - i) w
      + ((n - i : ℕ) : ℂ) * Wc i w * P (n - i) w + Hc i w * deriv (P (n - i)) w)
  let S : ℂ → ℂ := fun w =>
    -(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((n - i : ℕ) : ℂ) * Wc i w * V (n - i) w)
      - A * (1 - 4 * w * Us w) * V n w
      + 2 * A * w / L * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), V i w * V (n - i) w)
      - H w * deriv (V n) w - 4 * d w * V n w
      - d w / L * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), V i w * deriv (V (n - i)) w)
      - d w * deriv p w + 4 * A * w * p w + 2 * w * gc w
  (fun w => (-χ w * P n w + ℓ w * R1 w / L) / (2 * ((n : ℂ) + 1) * ((n : ℂ) + 2)),
   fun w => (-(δ0 n * z w) - ℓ w * S w / L) / (2 * ((n : ℂ) + 1) ^ 2))


noncomputable def axRecList (h j0 Λ : ℝ) (χ ζ ℓ z g : ℂ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℕ → (ℂ → ℂ) × (ℂ → ℂ)
  | 0, _ => ((fun _ => 1), (fun _ => 0))
  | n + 1, k => if k ≤ n then axRecList h j0 Λ χ ζ ℓ z g n k
      else axRecStep h j0 Λ χ ζ ℓ z g (axRecList h j0 Λ χ ζ ℓ z g n) n


noncomputable def axRecPV (h j0 Λ : ℝ) (χ ζ ℓ z g : ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) : (ℂ → ℂ) × (ℂ → ℂ) :=
  axRecList h j0 Λ χ ζ ℓ z g n n


noncomputable def axCut (Y : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.smoothTransition ((46 / 10 - Y) * 10)


noncomputable def axGain (Λ C : ℝ) (Ξ : ℂ → ℂ) (w : ℂ) : ℂ := Complex.exp ((Λ : ℂ) * Ξ w) / (C : ℂ)


noncomputable def axPhi (h j0 Λ C : ℝ) (χ ζ ℓ z Ξ : ℂ → ℂ) (Y : ℝ) (w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' n : ℕ, (axRecPV h j0 Λ χ ζ ℓ z (axGain Λ C Ξ) n).1 w * (Y : ℂ) ^ n


noncomputable def axPsiU (h j0 Λ C : ℝ) (χ ζ ℓ z Ξ : ℂ → ℂ) (Y : ℝ) (w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' n : ℕ, (axRecPV h j0 Λ χ ζ ℓ z (axGain Λ C Ξ) n).2 w * (Y : ℂ) ^ n


noncomputable def axFnDef (h j0 Λ C : ℝ) (χ ζ ℓ z Ξ : ℂ → ℂ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  axCut (Λ * X) * (axGain Λ C Ξ (η : ℂ) * axPhi h j0 Λ C χ ζ ℓ z Ξ (Λ * X) (η : ℂ)).re
    + (1 - axCut (Λ * X))


noncomputable def axUnDef (h j0 Λ C : ℝ) (χ ζ ℓ z Ξ : ℂ → ℂ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  4 * η + j0 + axCut (Λ * X) * (axPsiU h j0 Λ C χ ζ ℓ z Ξ (Λ * X) (η : ℂ)).re / Λ


def AxCoefData (h j0 σ ρ : ℝ) (Pc : ℂ → ℂ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (r M : ℝ) (χc ζc ℓc zc Ξ : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  0 < r ∧ r ≤ ρ / 2 ∧ r ≤ 1 / 100 ∧ 20 ≤ M ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ χc (axRect r) ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ ζc (axRect r) ∧

  let P : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun i => (pv i).1

  let D : ℂ := 1 / 2 - (h : ℂ)

  let Us : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => 4 * w + (j0 : ℂ)
  let H : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => D * w + d w * Us w

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h ε a b X1 : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < ε → a < b → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → a < η → η < b → 0 < F X η) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Pax (Ioo a b) → (∀ η : ℝ, a < η → η < b → 0 < 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < X1 → a < η → η < b → axSq h F U X η * F X η = -2 * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * (X * iteratedDeriv 2 (fun Y => F Y η) X + 2 * deriv (fun Y => F Y η) X) ∧ axSn h Pax F U X η = -2 * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * (X * iteratedDeriv 2 (fun Y => U Y η) X + deriv (fun Y => U Y η) X)) → ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < X1 → a < η → η < b → psLead1 h F U X η = shearA F X η ∧ axPs2 h Pax F U X η = -shearB F U X η ∧ axNs h Pax F U X η = -2 * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * deriv (fun Y => U Y η) X ∧ ((∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ X → 0 < axSq h F U x η) → deriv (fun Y => F Y η) X < 0)

signature.name: ax_ode_identity
signature.statement: ∀ (h ε a b X1 : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < ε → a < b → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → a < η → η < b → 0 < F X η) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Pax (Ioo a b) → (∀ η : ℝ, a < η → η < b → 0 < 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < X1 → a < η → η < b → axSq h F U X η * F X η = -2 * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * (X * iteratedDeriv 2 (fun Y => F Y η) X + 2 * deriv (fun Y => F Y η) X) ∧ axSn h Pax F U X η = -2 * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * (X * iteratedDeriv 2 (fun Y => U Y η) X + deriv (fun Y => U Y η) X)) → ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < X1 → a < η → η < b → psLead1 h F U X η = shearA F X η ∧ axPs2 h Pax F U X η = -shearB F U X η ∧ axNs h Pax F U X η = -2 * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * deriv (fun Y => U Y η) X ∧ ((∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ X → 0 < axSq h F U x η) → deriv (fun Y => F Y η) X < 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h ε a b X1 Pax F U hh0 hh1 hε hab hF hU hFpos hPax hLpos hODE X η hX hXX1 hη1 hη2
  have hΩ : IsOpen (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hε0 : -ε < 0 := by linarith
  
  have etap : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) →
      ∃ gη : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn (↿gη) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) ∧
        ∀ x e : ℝ, -ε < x → a < e → e < b → HasDerivAt (fun e' => g x e') (gη x e) e := by
    intro g hg
    refine ⟨fun x e => fderiv ℝ (↿g) (x, e) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · show ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => fderiv ℝ (↿g) p ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) _
      exact (hg.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ (by norm_num)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
    · intro x e hx he1 he2
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿g) (x, e) :=
        (hg.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds (show ((x, e) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b from
          ⟨hx, he1, he2⟩))).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have hc : HasDerivAt (fun e' : ℝ => ((x, e') : ℝ × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) e :=
        (hasDerivAt_const e x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' e)
      exact hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt e hc
  have hsubI : ∀ Y : ℝ, -ε < Y → uIcc 0 Y ⊆ Ioi (-ε) := by
    intro Y hY x hx
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_min (by linarith) hY) hx.1
  
  have ftc : ∀ k : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn (↿k) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) →
      ∀ Y e : ℝ, -ε < Y → a < e → e < b →
        HasDerivAt (fun Z => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Z, k x e) (k Y e) Y := by
    intro k hk Y e hY he1 he2
    have hcs : ContinuousOn (fun x => k x e) (Ioi (-ε)) :=
      hk.comp (f := fun x : ℝ => ((x, e) : ℝ × ℝ)) (by fun_prop) (fun x hx => ⟨hx, he1, he2⟩)
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right ((hcs.mono (hsubI Y hY)).intervalIntegrable)
      (hcs.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter isOpen_Ioi Y hY) (hcs.continuousAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hY))
  
  have param : ∀ k kη : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn (↿k) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) →
      ContinuousOn (↿kη) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) →
      (∀ x e : ℝ, -ε < x → a < e → e < b → HasDerivAt (fun e' => k x e') (kη x e) e) →
      ∀ Y e : ℝ, -ε < Y → a < e → e < b →
        HasDerivAt (fun e' => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Y, k x e') (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Y, kη x e) e := by
    intro k kη hk hkη hder Y e hY he1 he2
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hr1, hr2⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r ≤ (b - e) / 2 ∧ r ≤ (e - a) / 2 :=
      ⟨min ((b - e) / 2) ((e - a) / 2), lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith),
        min_le_left _ _, min_le_right _ _⟩
    have hball : ∀ e' ∈ Metric.closedBall e r, a < e' ∧ e' < b := by
      intro e' he'
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, Real.dist_eq, abs_le] at he'
      constructor <;> linarith [he'.1, he'.2]
    have hsub := hsubI Y hY
    have hK : IsCompact (uIcc 0 Y ×ˢ Metric.closedBall e r) :=
      isCompact_uIcc.prod (isCompact_closedBall e r)
    have hKΩ : uIcc 0 Y ×ˢ Metric.closedBall e r ⊆ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b :=
      fun p hp => ⟨hsub hp.1, hball p.2 hp.2⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hkη.mono hKΩ)
    have hslice : ∀ m : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn (↿m) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) →
        ∀ e' : ℝ, a < e' → e' < b → ContinuousOn (fun x => m x e') (uIcc 0 Y) :=
      fun m hm e' h1 h2 => hm.comp (f := fun x : ℝ => ((x, e') : ℝ × ℝ)) (by fun_prop)
        (fun x hx => ⟨hsub hx, h1, h2⟩)
    have hmeas : ∀ m : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn (↿m) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) →
        ∀ e' : ℝ, a < e' → e' < b →
          AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => m x e') (volume.restrict (uIoc 0 Y)) :=
      fun m hm e' h1 h2 =>
        ((hslice m hm e' h1 h2).mono uIoc_subset_uIcc).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
    have key := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (μ := volume) (a := 0) (b := Y) (bound := fun _ => C)
      (F := fun (e' : ℝ) (x : ℝ) => k x e') (F' := fun (e' : ℝ) (x : ℝ) => kη x e') (x₀ := e)
      (Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds e hr)
      (Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds e hr)
        (fun e' he' => hmeas k hk e' (hball e' he').1 (hball e' he').2))
      ((hslice k hk e he1 he2).intervalIntegrable)
      (hmeas kη hkη e he1 he2)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht e' he' => hC (t, e') ⟨uIoc_subset_uIcc ht, he'⟩))
      intervalIntegrable_const
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht e' he' =>
        hder t e' (hsub (uIoc_subset_uIcc ht)) (hball e' he').1 (hball e' he').2))
    exact key.2
  
  have pkg : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) → ∀ Z : ℝ, -ε < Z →
      HasDerivAt (fun Y => profRadInt g Y η) (g Z η) Z ∧
      (∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun e => g Z e) v η →
        HasDerivAt (fun Y => profEtaD (profRadInt g) Y η) v Z) ∧
      (∀ Y : ℝ, -ε < Y → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e => profRadInt g Y e) η) := by
    intro g hg Z hZ
    obtain ⟨gη, hgηc, hgd⟩ := etap g hg
    have hgc : ContinuousOn (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) := hg.continuousOn
    refine ⟨ftc g hgc Z η hZ hη1 hη2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro v hv
      have hval : gη Z η = v := (hgd Z η hZ hη1 hη2).unique hv
      have heq : (fun Y => profEtaD (profRadInt g) Y η) =ᶠ[nhds Z]
          (fun Y => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Y, gη x η) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hZ] with Y hY
        exact (param g gη hgc hgηc hgd Y η hY hη1 hη2).deriv
      have h2 := ftc gη hgηc Z η hZ hη1 hη2
      rw [hval] at h2
      exact h2.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
    · intro Y hY
      exact (param g gη hgc hgηc hgd Y η hY hη1 hη2).differentiableAt
  
  have slice : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) → ∀ Z : ℝ, -ε < Z →
      HasDerivAt (fun Y => g Y η) (deriv (fun Y => g Y η) Z) Z ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun e => g Z e) (deriv (fun e => g Z e) η) η ∧
      HasDerivAt (deriv (fun Y => g Y η)) (iteratedDeriv 2 (fun Y => g Y η) Z) Z := by
    intro g hg Z hZ
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿g) (Z, η) :=
      (hg.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds (show ((Z, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b from
        ⟨hZ, hη1, hη2⟩))).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => ((Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) Z :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' Z).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const Z η)
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => ((Z, e) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) η :=
      (hasDerivAt_const η Z).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' η)
    have k1' := hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt Z h1
    have k2' := hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt η h2
    have k1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y => g Y η) Z := k1'.differentiableAt
    have k2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e => g Z e) η := k2'.differentiableAt
    have hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => g Y η) (Ioi (-ε)) :=
      hg.comp (f := fun Y : ℝ => ((Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ)) (contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffOn
        (fun Y hY => ⟨hY, hη1, hη2⟩)
    have hs1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (deriv (fun Y => g Y η)) (Ioi (-ε)) :=
      hs.deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioi (by norm_num)
    have hs2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv (fun Y => g Y η)) Z :=
      (hs1.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hZ)
    have e2 : iteratedDeriv 2 (fun Y => g Y η) = deriv (deriv (fun Y => g Y η)) := by
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one]
    rw [e2]
    exact ⟨k1.hasDerivAt, k2.hasDerivAt, hs2.hasDerivAt⟩
  have hF0 : ∀ Y, 0 < Y → F Y η ≠ 0 := fun Y hY => (hFpos Y η hY.le hη1 hη2).ne'
  have hI : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * p.1 * F p.1 p.2) _
    exact (contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_fst).mul hF
  have hJ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => U p.1 p.2 * (2 * p.1 * F p.1 p.2)) _
    exact hU.mul ((contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_fst).mul hF)
  have hS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => U p.1 p.2 ^ 2 - p.1 * F p.1 p.2 ^ 2) _
    exact (hU.pow 2).sub (contDiffOn_fst.mul (hF.pow 2))
  have hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e => F x e ^ 2)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2 ^ 2) _
    exact hF.pow 2
  have sq : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (f' x : ℝ), HasDerivAt f f' x →
      HasDerivAt (fun y => f y ^ 2) (2 * f x * f') x := by
    intro f f' x hf
    have e1 : (fun y => f y ^ 2) = fun y => f y * f y := funext fun y => pow_two _
    rw [e1]
    exact (hf.mul hf).congr_deriv (by ring)
  have hPaxd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Pax η :=
    (hPax.contDiffAt (Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hPc := (pkg _ hP 0 hε0).2.2
  
  have hW : ∀ Y, 0 < Y → Y * leadW h U Y η =
      Y - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * profRadInt U Y η - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt U) Y η := by
    intro Y hY
    have key : ∀ e, a < e → e < b → Y * profRadAvg U Y e = profRadInt U Y e := by
      intro e _ _
      unfold profRadAvg profRadInt
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right (fun x => U x e) hY.ne', zero_mul, one_mul,
        smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hY.ne', one_mul]
    have hev : (fun e => Y * profRadAvg U Y e) =ᶠ[nhds η] (fun e => profRadInt U Y e) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2] with e he
      exact key e he.1 he.2
    have hd : Y * profEtaD (profRadAvg U) Y η = profEtaD (profRadInt U) Y η := by
      unfold profEtaD
      rw [← hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const_mul_field']
    have hk := key η hη1 hη2
    unfold leadW
    linear_combination (-(2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η)) * hk + (-(1 - η ^ 2)) * hd
  have hPiη : ∀ Y, -ε < Y → profEtaD (axPi Pax F) Y η =
      deriv Pax η + profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => F x e ^ 2)) Y η := by
    intro Y hY
    exact (hPaxd.hasDerivAt.add (hPc Y hY).hasDerivAt).deriv
  have hQrw : ∀ Y, 0 < Y → Y * (2 * Y * F Y η) * leadQs h F U Y η =
      -(2 * Y * F Y η) * (Y * leadW h U Y η) +
      ((1 - h) * profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) Y η
        - (1 / 2 - h) * η * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) Y η
        - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))) Y η
        + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * η * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) Y η) := by
    intro Y hY
    have hY0 := hY.ne'
    have hFY0 := hF0 Y hY
    unfold leadQs
    field_simp
  have hNrw : ∀ Y, 0 < Y → Y * axNs h Pax F U Y η =
      -(Y * leadW h U Y η) * U Y η +
      ((1 / 2 - h) * (profRadInt U Y η - η * profEtaD (profRadInt U) Y η)
        + 4 * h * η * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) Y η
        - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)) Y η)
      + Y * (4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * axPi Pax F Y η - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (axPi Pax F) Y η) := by
    intro Y hY
    have hY0 := hY.ne'
    unfold axNs
    field_simp
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ : ∃ V : ℝ → ℝ, V = fun Y =>
      Y - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * profRadInt U Y η - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt U) Y η :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ΦQ, hΦQ⟩ : ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℝ, Φ = fun Y => -(2 * Y * F Y η) * V Y +
      ((1 - h) * profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) Y η
        - (1 / 2 - h) * η * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) Y η
        - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))) Y η
        + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * η * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) Y η) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ΦN, hΦN⟩ : ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℝ, Φ = fun Y => -(V Y) * U Y η +
      ((1 / 2 - h) * (profRadInt U Y η - η * profEtaD (profRadInt U) Y η)
        + 4 * h * η * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) Y η
        - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)) Y η)
      + Y * (4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * (Pax η + profRadInt (fun x e => F x e ^ 2) Y η)
        - (1 - η ^ 2) * (deriv Pax η + profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => F x e ^ 2)) Y η)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have dPhi : ∀ Z, -ε < Z → ∃ dq dn : ℝ, HasDerivAt ΦQ dq Z ∧ HasDerivAt ΦN dn Z ∧
      (0 < Z → dq = 2 * Z * F Z η * axSq h F U Z η ∧ dn = axSn h Pax F U Z η) := by
    intro Z hZ
    obtain ⟨hFY, hFe, -⟩ := slice F hF Z hZ
    obtain ⟨hUY, hUe, -⟩ := slice U hU Z hZ
    obtain ⟨hUa, hUb, -⟩ := pkg U hU Z hZ
    obtain ⟨hIa, hIb, -⟩ := pkg _ hI Z hZ
    obtain ⟨hJa, hJb, -⟩ := pkg _ hJ Z hZ
    obtain ⟨hSa, hSb, -⟩ := pkg _ hS Z hZ
    obtain ⟨hPa, hPb, -⟩ := pkg _ hP Z hZ
    have hUb' := hUb _ hUe
    have hIb' := hIb _ (hFe.const_mul (2 * Z))
    have hJb' := hJb _ (hUe.mul (hFe.const_mul (2 * Z)))
    have hSb' := hSb _ ((sq _ _ _ hUe).sub ((sq _ _ _ hFe).const_mul Z))
    have hPb' := hPb _ (sq _ _ _ hFe)
    have hVd := ((hasDerivAt_id' Z).sub (hUa.const_mul (2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η))).sub
      (hUb'.const_mul (1 - η ^ 2))
    have hfQ := ((((hasDerivAt_id' Z).const_mul 2).mul hFY).neg.mul hVd).add
      ((((hIa.const_mul (1 - h)).sub (hIb'.const_mul ((1 / 2 - h) * η))).sub
        (hJb'.const_mul (1 - η ^ 2))).add (hJa.const_mul (2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * η)))
    have hfN := (((hVd.neg).mul hUY).add ((((hUa.sub (hUb'.const_mul η)).const_mul (1 / 2 - h)).add
        (hSa.const_mul (4 * h * η))).sub (hSb'.const_mul (1 - η ^ 2)))).add
      ((hasDerivAt_id' Z).mul ((((hasDerivAt_const Z (Pax η)).add hPa).const_mul
        (4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η)).sub (((hasDerivAt_const Z (deriv Pax η)).add hPb').const_mul
          (1 - η ^ 2))))
    refine ⟨_, _, hfQ.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun Y => ?_)),
      hfN.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun Y => ?_)), ?_⟩
    · subst hΦQ hV
      rfl
    · subst hΦN hV
      rfl
    · intro hZ0
      have hWZ := hW Z hZ0
      have hF0Z := hF0 Z hZ0
      have hZ0' := hZ0.ne'
      have hSq : 2 * Z * F Z η * axSq h F U Z η =
          -(2 * Z * leadW h U Z η * (F Z η + Z * deriv (fun Y => F Y η) Z))
            - 2 * Z * F Z η * h * (1 - 2 * η * U Z η)
            - 2 * Z * ((1 / 2 - h) * η + (1 - η ^ 2) * U Z η) * deriv (fun e => F Z e) η := by
        unfold axSq
        field_simp
      constructor
      · rw [hSq]
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.neg_apply]
        linear_combination (2 * F Z η + 2 * Z * deriv (fun Y => F Y η) Z) * hWZ
      · unfold axSn
        rw [show deriv (fun e => axPi Pax F Z e) η =
          deriv Pax η + profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => F x e ^ 2)) Z η from hPiη Z hZ]
        simp only [axPi, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.neg_apply]

      have hf1 : (0 : ℝ) < (n.factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
      have hf2 : (0 : ℝ) < ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
      simp only [hg']
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_of_pos (mul_pos hf1 hf2),
        div_le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hf1 hf2) hf1, Nat.abs_cast]
      have h12 : |(-1 / 2 : ℝ)| = 1 / 2 := by norm_num
      rw [h12]
      calc (n : ℝ) * |-y / 2| ^ (n - 1) * (1 / 2) * (n.factorial : ℝ)
          ≤ ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) * R ^ n * 1 * (n.factorial : ℝ) := by gcongr; norm_num
        _ = R ^ n * ((n.factorial : ℝ) * ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)) := by ring
    have hsu : Summable (fun n : ℕ => R ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) := Real.summable_pow_div_factorial R
    have hmem : z ∈ Set.Ioo (-R) R := ⟨by linarith [neg_abs_le z], by linarith [le_abs_self z]⟩
    have h0mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (-R) R := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hs0 : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (-(0 : ℝ) / 2) ^ n / ((n.factorial : ℝ) * ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))) := by
      apply (hasSum_single 0 _).summable
      intro b hb
      simp [hb]
    have hD := hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected hsu isOpen_Ioo isPreconnected_Ioo hgd hbound h0mem hs0 hmem
    have hsg : Summable (fun n => g' n z) := Summable.of_norm_bounded hsu (fun n => hbound n z hmem)
    have heq : ∑' n, g' n z = -(1 / 2) * ∑' n : ℕ, (-z / 2) ^ n / ((n.factorial : ℝ) * ((n + 2).factorial : ℝ)) := by
      rw [hsg.tsum_eq_zero_add, ← tsum_mul_left]
      have h0 : g' 0 z = 0 := by simp [hg']
      rw [h0, zero_add]
      congr 1
      ext m
      simp only [hg']
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, show m + 1 + 1 = m + 2 by ring, Nat.factorial_succ m]
      have hf1 : (m.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have hf2 : ((m + 2).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      push_cast
      field_simp
    rw [← heq]
    exact hD
  
  have leib : ∀ (k M : ℕ) (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → t ≤ ((M : ℝ) + 1) * ((M : ℝ) + 1 + (k : ℝ)) →
      0 ≤ (-1) ^ M * ((∑' n : ℕ, (-t) ^ n / ((Nat.factorial n : ℝ) * (Nat.factorial (n + k) : ℝ))) -
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M, (-t) ^ n / ((Nat.factorial n : ℝ) * (Nat.factorial (n + k) : ℝ))) := by
    intro k M t ht0 htM
    set a : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => t ^ n / ((Nat.factorial n : ℝ) * (Nat.factorial (n + k) : ℝ)) with ha
    have hterm : ∀ n, (-t) ^ n / ((Nat.factorial n : ℝ) * (Nat.factorial (n + k) : ℝ)) = (-1) ^ n * a n := by
      intro n; simp only [ha]; rw [neg_pow, mul_div_assoc]
    have ha0 : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n := fun n => by simp only [ha]; positivity
    have hsum_a : Summable a := by
      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le ha0 (fun n => ?_) (Real.summable_pow_div_factorial t)
      simp only [ha]
      have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (Nat.factorial (n + k) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
      have h2 : (0:ℝ) < (Nat.factorial n : ℝ) := by positivity
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) h2
      nlinarith
    have hsum : Summable (fun n => (-1:ℝ) ^ n * a n) := by
      refine Summable.of_norm_bounded hsum_a (fun n => ?_)
      rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow, one_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (ha0 n)]
    simp_rw [hterm]
    rw [← hsum.sum_add_tsum_nat_add M, add_sub_cancel_left, ← tsum_mul_left]
    have hsq : ((-1:ℝ) ^ M) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul]; norm_num
    have e : ∀ i, (-1:ℝ) ^ M * ((-1) ^ (i + M) * a (i + M)) = (-1) ^ i * a (i + M) := by
      intro i; rw [pow_add]; linear_combination ((-1:ℝ) ^ i * a (i + M)) * hsq
    simp_rw [e]
    have hrec : ∀ n, a (n + 1) * (((n:ℝ) + 1) * ((n:ℝ) + 1 + k)) = t * a n := by
      intro n
      simp only [ha]
      rw [show n + 1 + k = (n + k) + 1 by ring, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.factorial_succ]
      have h1 : (n.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have h2 : ((n + k).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      push_cast
      field_simp
      ring
    have hanti : Antitone (fun i => a (i + M)) := by
      apply antitone_nat_of_succ_le
      intro i
      have hr := hrec (i + M)
      have hP : (0:ℝ) < (((i + M : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * (((i + M : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 + k) := by positivity
      have hle : t ≤ (((i + M : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * (((i + M : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 + k) := by
        push_cast
        have hi : (0:ℝ) ≤ i := Nat.cast_nonneg i
        have hk : (0:ℝ) ≤ k := Nat.cast_nonneg k
        have hM : (0:ℝ) ≤ M := Nat.cast_nonneg M
        nlinarith
      have h0 := ha0 (i + M)
      show a (i + 1 + M) ≤ a (i + M)
      rw [show i + 1 + M = i + M + 1 by ring]
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      have : a (i + M) * ((((i + M : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * (((i + M : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 + k)) <
          a (i + M + 1) * ((((i + M : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * (((i + M : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 + k)) :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hcon hP
      nlinarith
    have hsumf : Summable (fun i => (-1:ℝ) ^ i * a (i + M)) := by
      refine Summable.of_norm_bounded ((summable_nat_add_iff M).mpr hsum_a) (fun n => ?_)
      rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow, one_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (ha0 _)]
    have := Antitone.alternating_series_le_tendsto hsumf.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat hanti 0
    simpa using this
  
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ,
      A = fun k t => ∑' n : ℕ, (-t) ^ n / ((Nat.factorial n : ℝ) * (Nat.factorial (n + k) : ℝ)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have leib' : ∀ (k M : ℕ) (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → t ≤ ((M : ℝ) + 1) * ((M : ℝ) + 1 + (k : ℝ)) →
      0 ≤ (-1) ^ M * (A k t -
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M, (-t) ^ n / ((Nat.factorial n : ℝ) * (Nat.factorial (n + k) : ℝ))) := by
    intro k M t h0 h1
    rw [hA]
    exact leib k M t h0 h1
  have key : ∀ z : ℝ, axF0 z = A 1 (z / 2) ∧ deriv axF0 z = -(1 / 2) * A 2 (z / 2) := by
    intro z
    constructor
    · unfold axF0
      simp only [hA, neg_div]
    · rw [(hderiv z).deriv]
      simp only [hA, neg_div]
  have s11 : ∀ t : ℝ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range 1, (-t) ^ n / ((Nat.factorial n : ℝ) * (Nat.factorial (n + 1) : ℝ)) = 1 := by
    intro t; norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.factorial]
  have s14 : ∀ t : ℝ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range 4, (-t) ^ n / ((Nat.factorial n : ℝ) * (Nat.factorial (n + 1) : ℝ)) =
      1 - t / 2 + t ^ 2 / 12 - t ^ 3 / 144 := by
    intro t; norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.factorial] <;> ring
  have s15 : ∀ t : ℝ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range 5, (-t) ^ n / ((Nat.factorial n : ℝ) * (Nat.factorial (n + 1) : ℝ)) =
      1 - t / 2 + t ^ 2 / 12 - t ^ 3 / 144 + t ^ 4 / 2880 := by
    intro t; norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.factorial] <;> ring
  have s21 : ∀ t : ℝ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range 1, (-t) ^ n / ((Nat.factorial n : ℝ) * (Nat.factorial (n + 2) : ℝ)) = 1 / 2 := by
    intro t; norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.factorial]
  have s22 : ∀ t : ℝ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range 2, (-t) ^ n / ((Nat.factorial n : ℝ) * (Nat.factorial (n + 2) : ℝ)) =
      1 / 2 - t / 6 := by
    intro t; norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.factorial] <;> ring
  have s24 : ∀ t : ℝ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range 4, (-t) ^ n / ((Nat.factorial n : ℝ) * (Nat.factorial (n + 2) : ℝ)) =
      1 / 2 - t / 6 + t ^ 2 / 48 - t ^ 3 / 720 := by
    intro t; norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.factorial] <;> ring
  have e1 : ((-1 : ℝ)) ^ 1 = -1 := by norm_num
  have e2 : ((-1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 = 1 := by norm_num
  have e4 : ((-1 : ℝ)) ^ 4 = 1 := by norm_num
  have e5 : ((-1 : ℝ)) ^ 5 = -1 := by norm_num
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z hz0 hz1
    obtain ⟨hF, hD⟩ := key z
    rw [hF, hD]
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ z / 2 := by linarith
    have ht1 : z / 2 ≤ 41 / 20 := by linarith
    have h11 := leib' 1 1 (z / 2) ht0 (by norm_num; linarith)
    have h14 := leib' 1 4 (z / 2) ht0 (by norm_num; linarith)
    have h21 := leib' 2 1 (z / 2) ht0 (by norm_num; linarith)
    have h22 := leib' 2 2 (z / 2) ht0 (by norm_num; linarith)
    rw [s11, e1] at h11
    rw [s14, e4] at h14
    rw [s21, e1] at h21
    rw [s22, e2] at h22
    have hs : 0 ≤ 41 / 20 - z / 2 := by linarith
    refine ⟨?_, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hs hs, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hs hs) hs]
  · intro z hz0 hz1
    obtain ⟨hF, hD⟩ := key z
    rw [hF, hD]
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ z / 2 := by linarith
    have ht1 : z / 2 ≤ 2 := by linarith
    have h15 := leib' 1 5 (z / 2) ht0 (by norm_num; linarith)
    have h24 := leib' 2 4 (z / 2) ht0 (by norm_num; linarith)
    rw [s15, e5] at h15
    rw [s24, e4] at h24
    have hlow : 1 / 2 - z / 2 / 6 + (z / 2) ^ 2 / 48 - (z / 2) ^ 3 / 720 ≤ A 2 (z / 2) := by linarith
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlow ht0
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ 2 - z / 2 := by linarith
    have hs1 : 2 - z / 2 ≤ 1 / 50 := by linarith
    have hq2 : (2 - z / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 50) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hs0 hs1 2
    have hq3 : (2 - z / 2) ^ 3 ≤ (1 / 50) ^ 3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hs0 hs1 3
    have hq4 : (2 - z / 2) ^ 4 ≤ (1 / 50) ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hs0 hs1 4
    have hpoly : 1 - z / 2 / 2 + (z / 2) ^ 2 / 12 - (z / 2) ^ 3 / 144 + (z / 2) ^ 4 / 2880
        - z / 2 * (1 / 2 - z / 2 / 6 + (z / 2) ^ 2 / 48 - (z / 2) ^ 3 / 720) ≤ -(9 / 50) := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 - z / 2), hq2, hq3, hq4]
    have hz : z * (-(1 / 2) * A 2 (z / 2)) = -(z / 2 * A 2 (z / 2)) := by ring

    linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h j0 k ε a b X η : ℝ) (U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 ≤ j0 → j0 ≤ 1 / 20 → 0 < ε → a < η → η < b → |η| ≤ 51 / 50 → 0 ≤ X → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → |U x η - (4 * η + j0)| ≤ k ∧ |deriv (fun e => U x e) η - 4| ≤ k) → |leadW h U X η - (1 - 4 * (1 - η ^ 2) - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * (4 * η + j0))| ≤ 3 * k

signature.statement: ∀ (h j0 k ε a b X η : ℝ) (U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 ≤ j0 → j0 ≤ 1 / 20 → 0 < ε → a < η → η < b → |η| ≤ 51 / 50 → 0 ≤ X → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → |U x η - (4 * η + j0)| ≤ k ∧ |deriv (fun e => U x e) η - 4| ≤ k) → |leadW h U X η - (1 - 4 * (1 - η ^ 2) - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * (4 * η + j0))| ≤ 3 * k

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h j0 k ε a b X η U hh0 hh1 hj0 hj1 hε ha hb hη hX hU hB
  have hk : 0 ≤ k := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hB 0 le_rfl hX).1
  have hΩ : IsOpen (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  set G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => fderiv ℝ (↿U) p ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) with hGdef
  have hGc : ContinuousOn G (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) := by
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (↿U)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) :=
      hU.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hGd : ∀ x e : ℝ, ((x, e) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b →
      HasDerivAt (fun e' => U x e') (G (x, e)) e := by
    intro x e hxe
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿U) (x, e) :=
      (hU.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hxe)
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun e' : ℝ => ((x, e') : ℝ × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) e :=
      (hasDerivAt_const e x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id e)
    exact hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt e hc
  have hmem : ∀ s, s ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1 → ∀ e, e ∈ Ioo a b →
      ((s * X, e) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b := by
    intro s hs e he
    exact ⟨show -ε < s * X from lt_of_lt_of_le (neg_lt_zero.mpr hε) (mul_nonneg hs.1 hX), he⟩
  have hsX : ∀ s, s ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1 → 0 ≤ s * X ∧ s * X ≤ X := fun s hs =>
    ⟨mul_nonneg hs.1 hX, mul_le_of_le_one_left hX hs.2⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = min (η - a) (b - η) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hr0 : 0 < r := by
    have : 0 < min (η - a) (b - η) := lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
    rw [hr]; linarith
  have hra : a < η - r := by
    have := min_le_left (η - a) (b - η); rw [hr]; linarith
  have hrb : η + r < b := by
    have := min_le_right (η - a) (b - η); rw [hr]; linarith
  have hKc : IsCompact (Icc 0 X ×ˢ Icc (η - r) (η + r)) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  have hKΩ : Icc 0 X ×ˢ Icc (η - r) (η + r) ⊆ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b := by
    intro p hp
    exact ⟨show -ε < p.1 from lt_of_lt_of_le (neg_lt_zero.mpr hε) hp.1.1,
      ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hra hp.2.1, lt_of_le_of_lt hp.2.2 hrb⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hGc.mono hKΩ)
  have hcurve : ∀ e : ℝ, Continuous (fun s : ℝ => ((s * X, e) : ℝ × ℝ)) := fun e =>
    (continuous_id.mul continuous_const).prodMk continuous_const
  have hFc : ∀ e, e ∈ Ioo a b → ContinuousOn (fun s => U (s * X) e) (Icc 0 1) := by
    intro e he
    exact hU.continuousOn.comp (hcurve e).continuousOn (fun s hs => hmem s hs e he)
  have hF'c : ContinuousOn (fun s => G (s * X, η)) (Icc 0 1) :=
    hGc.comp (hcurve η).continuousOn (fun s hs => hmem s hs η ⟨ha, hb⟩)
  have huIoc : Set.uIoc (0:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Icc (0:ℝ) 1 := by
    rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one]; exact Ioc_subset_Icc_self
  have hball : ∀ e, e ∈ Metric.ball η r → e ∈ Icc (η - r) (η + r) ∧ e ∈ Ioo a b := by
    intro e he
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, abs_lt] at he
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
  have hFint : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => U (s * X) η) volume 0 1 :=
    ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one (hFc η ⟨ha, hb⟩)
  have hleib : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => G (s * X, η)) volume 0 1 ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun e => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, U (s * X) e) (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, G (s * X, η)) η :=
    intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (μ := volume) (a := 0) (b := 1)
      (F := fun e s => U (s * X) e) (F' := fun e s => G (s * X, e)) (x₀ := η)
      (bound := fun _ => M) (Metric.ball_mem_nhds η hr0)
      (Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds ha hb) (fun e he =>
        ((hFc e he).mono huIoc).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc))
      hFint
      ((hF'c.mono huIoc).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s hs e he =>
        hM (s * X, e) ⟨⟨(hsX s (huIoc hs)).1, (hsX s (huIoc hs)).2⟩, (hball e he).1⟩))
      intervalIntegrable_const
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s hs e he =>
        hGd (s * X) e (hmem s (huIoc hs) e (hball e he).2)))
  obtain ⟨hGint, hD⟩ := hleib
  
  have hA : |(∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, U (s * X) η) - (4 * η + j0)| ≤ k := by
    have e1 : (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, U (s * X) η) - (4 * η + j0) =
        ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, (U (s * X) η - (4 * η + j0)) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hFint intervalIntegrable_const]
      simp
    rw [e1]
    have := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := (0:ℝ)) (b := 1) (C := k)
      (f := fun s => U (s * X) η - (4 * η + j0)) (fun s hs => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact (hB _ (hsX s (huIoc hs)).1 (hsX s (huIoc hs)).2).1)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    calc _ ≤ k * |(1:ℝ) - 0| := this
      _ = k := by norm_num
  have hBd : |(∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, G (s * X, η)) - 4| ≤ k := by
    have e1 : (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, G (s * X, η)) - 4 =
        ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, (G (s * X, η) - 4) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hGint intervalIntegrable_const]
      simp
    rw [e1]
    have := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := (0:ℝ)) (b := 1) (C := k)
      (f := fun s => G (s * X, η) - 4) (fun s hs => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        have hs' := huIoc hs
        rw [← (hGd (s * X) η (hmem s hs' η ⟨ha, hb⟩)).deriv]
        exact (hB _ (hsX s hs').1 (hsX s hs').2).2)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    calc _ ≤ k * |(1:ℝ) - 0| := this
      _ = k := by norm_num
  have hlw : leadW h U X η = 1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, U (s * X) η)
      - (1 - η ^ 2) * (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, G (s * X, η)) := by
    unfold leadW profEtaD profRadAvg
    rw [hD.deriv]
  rw [hlw]
  generalize (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, U (s * X) η) = A at hA
  generalize (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, G (s * X, η)) = B at hBd
  have hc1 : |2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η| ≤ 51 / 50 := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * (1 / 2 - h))]
    have := mul_le_mul (show 2 * (1 / 2 - h) ≤ 1 by linarith) hη (abs_nonneg η) zero_le_one
    linarith
  have hc2 : |1 - η ^ 2| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor
    · nlinarith [sq_abs η, abs_nonneg η]
    · nlinarith [sq_nonneg η]
  have eq : 1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * A - (1 - η ^ 2) * B -
      (1 - 4 * (1 - η ^ 2) - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * (4 * η + j0)) =
      -((2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η) * (A - (4 * η + j0)) + (1 - η ^ 2) * (B - 4)) := by ring
  rw [eq, abs_neg]
  have t1 : |(2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η) * (A - (4 * η + j0))| ≤ 51 / 50 * k := by
    rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hc1 hA (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)

  obtain ⟨yb, hyb⟩ : ∃ yb : ℝ, yb = rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh := ⟨_, rfl⟩

  have sig0 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → sigA y = 0 := fun y hy => by unfold sigA; simp [hy]

    unfold sigA; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hy]
  have sigR : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA y ∧ sigA y ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs

    · norm_num

    unfold sigA
    refine Measurable.ite (measurableSet_le measurable_id measurable_const) measurable_const

    fun_prop

    intro a b

      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [(sigR x).1, (sigR x).2])

    unfold rfpSigI

    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (1:ℝ))]
    · simp
    · intro s hs

    unfold rfpSigI

    simpa using this
  have tauR : ∀ a b : ℝ, 1 - P.ρ ≤ tailFac P.ρ a b ∧ tailFac P.ρ a b ≤ 1 := by
    intro a b
    unfold tailFac
    obtain ⟨s0, s1⟩ := sigR ((Real.log (b / a) + 2) / 2)
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  
  obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ : ∃ C0 : ℝ, C0 = Real.log P.Pst - 3 / 5 * (rfpSigI 1 - 1)
      - P.lam * (rfpSigI 1 - rfpY2 P.Md - 1) - (1 - P.lam) * (rfpSigI 1 - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1)

    have a2 : 1 ≤ y - rfpY2 P.Md := by linarith
    have a3 : 1 ≤ y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam := by linarith
    have a4 : 1 ≤ y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1 := by linarith
    have a5 : 1 ≤ (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60 := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
    unfold rfpLam
    rw [← hyb, hI1 y a1, hI1 _ a2, hI1 _ a3, hI1 _ a4, sig1 _ a5, hC0]
    ring

    unfold tailFac
    rw [← Real.exp_sub, Real.log_exp, sig0 ((yb - 3 - yb + 2) / 2) (by linarith)]
    ring

    unfold rfpTh

    intro y hy

    rw [sig0 (1 - (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3) / (3 / 20))
        (by rw [sub_nonpos, le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith),
      sig0 (1 - (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1) / (3 / 20))

    unfold rfpCi
    rw [← hyb, hΛ (yb - 3) le_rfl, hτT, div_self h1ρ.ne', Real.log_one]

    rw [e]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x η hx _ _
    rw [hXb] at hx ⊢

    rw [hE x η hxpos hy, hΛ _ hy, Real.exp_log hxpos, hCi, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hxpos]
    obtain ⟨t0, _⟩ := tauR (Real.exp yb) x
    have hq : 0 < tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp yb) x / (1 - P.ρ) := div_pos (by linarith) h1ρ
    rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hq]
    have e : Real.exp (C0 - (1 / 2 + P.h) * Real.log x) =
        Real.exp C0 * Real.exp (Real.log x * -(1 / 2 + P.h)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    rw [e]
    ring
  · intro x η hx _ _ _
    rw [hXb, ← Real.exp_add] at hx
    have hxpos : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hx
    have hy' : yb - 11 / 4 ≤ Real.log x := by
      have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hx
      rw [Real.log_exp] at this
      linarith
    have hy : yb - 3 ≤ Real.log x := by linarith
    rw [hE x η hxpos hy, hΛ _ hy, Real.exp_log hxpos]
    obtain ⟨t0, t1⟩ := tauR (Real.exp yb) x
    have hq : 0 < tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp yb) x / (1 - P.ρ) := div_pos (by linarith) h1ρ
    rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hq]
    have hM : C0 - (1 / 2 + P.h) * Real.log x ≤ rfpL5 P.Md P.Pst P.lam - 3 / 2 * P.T1 := by
      have e5 : rfpL5 P.Md P.Pst P.lam = Real.log P.Pst + rfpY5 P.Md P.lam / 10
          - 3 / 5 * (rfpSigI 1 + (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1))
          - P.lam * (rfpSigI 1 + (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - rfpY2 P.Md - 1)) - Real.log 2 := by
        unfold rfpL5
        rw [hI1 (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (by linarith),
          hI1 (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - rfpY2 P.Md) (by linarith)]
      rw [e5, hC0]
      have hd : rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 9 / 4 + P.T1 ≤ Real.log x := by linarith
      have hA : 0 ≤ 1 / 2 + P.h := by linarith
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd hA,
        mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (sub_nonneg.2 hhlam) (sub_nonpos.2 hS1)]
    rw [mul_div_assoc']
    refine (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right h1ρ).2 ?_
    refine le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left t1 (Real.exp_pos _).le) ?_
    rw [mul_one]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.2 hM

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hR
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl1, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hR
  have hl2 : P.h ≤ P.lam := by nlinarith
  have hh1 : P.h ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hρ1' : 0 < 1 - P.ρ := by linarith
  have hPst0 : 0 < P.Pst := lt_trans (Real.exp_pos _) hPst
  have hlogh : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.h) := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hh0]; linarith)
  have hT0 : 0 ≤ P.T1 := by linarith
  have hL : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.lam) := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith)
  have hlam13 : 0 < 13 / P.lam := by positivity

  have eY3 : rfpY3 P.Md P.lam = rfpY2 P.Md + 1 + 60 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  have eY4 : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam = rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 13 / P.lam := rfl
  have eY5 : rfpY5 P.Md P.lam = rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  have eYb : rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh = rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 2 + P.T1 + P.Lh + 3 := rfl
  have hY2 : 0 < rfpY2 P.Md := by rw [eY2]; linarith
  have hY4 : 0 < rfpY4 P.Md P.lam := by rw [eY4, eY3]; linarith
  have hY5 : 0 < rfpY5 P.Md P.lam := by rw [eY5]; linarith
  
  have sig0 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → sigA y = 0 := fun y hy => by unfold sigA; simp [hy]
  have sig1 : ∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → sigA y = 1 := fun y hy => by
    unfold sigA; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hy]
  have sigR : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA y ∧ sigA y ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
    · have ha := Real.exp_pos (-1 / y ^ 2)
      have hb := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)
      constructor
      · positivity
      · rw [div_le_one (by linarith)]; linarith
  have hσm : Measurable sigA := by
    unfold sigA
    refine Measurable.ite measurableSet_Iic measurable_const
      (Measurable.ite measurableSet_Ici measurable_const ?_)
    fun_prop
  have hI : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable sigA MeasureTheory.volume a b := by
    intro a b
    refine (intervalIntegrable_const (c := (1:ℝ))).mono_fun' hσm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s => ?_)
    show ‖sigA s‖ ≤ 1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sigR s).1]
    exact (sigR s).2
  
  have hdiff : ∀ a b : ℝ, rfpSigI b - rfpSigI a = ∫ s in a..b, sigA s := by
    intro a b; unfold rfpSigI; exact intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hI 0 b) (hI 0 a)
  have hmono : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → rfpSigI a ≤ rfpSigI b := by
    intro a b hab
    have := intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hab (fun u _ => (sigR u).1)
    linarith [hdiff a b]
  have hlip : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → rfpSigI b - rfpSigI a ≤ b - a := by
    intro a b hab

    simpa using this
  have hS0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → rfpSigI t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpSigI
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ))]
    · simp
    · intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge ht] at hs
      exact sig0 s hs.2
  have hS1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → rfpSigI t - rfpSigI 1 = t - 1 := by
    intro t ht
    rw [hdiff 1 t, intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (1:ℝ))]
    · simp
    · intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le ht] at hs
      exact sig1 s hs.1
  have hSup : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → rfpSigI t ≤ t := by
    intro t ht; have := hlip 0 t ht; rw [hS0 0 le_rfl] at this; linarith
  have hSnn : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpSigI t := by
    intro t

  have hSlow : ∀ t : ℝ, t - 1 ≤ rfpSigI t := by
    intro t
    rcases le_total t 1 with ht | ht
    · linarith [hSnn t]
    · linarith [hS1 t ht, hSnn 1]
  have hSm : Measurable rfpSigI := by
    have : Continuous rfpSigI := by
      unfold rfpSigI; exact intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive hI 0
    exact this.measurable
  have hΛm : Measurable (rfpLam P) := by
    unfold rfpLam tailFac
    fun_prop
  have hτ : ∀ y : ℝ, 1 - P.ρ ≤ tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) ∧
      tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) ≤ 1 := by
    intro y; unfold tailFac
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := sigR ((Real.log (Real.exp y / Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) + 2) / 2)

    constructor <;> nlinarith
  refine ⟨hΛm.exp, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show Measurable (fun y => 1 - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60))

  · intro y
    have hs := sigR ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60)
    refine ⟨(Real.exp_pos _).le, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show 0 ≤ 1 - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60); linarith

    · show 1 - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) = 1
      rw [hσ0]; ring
    · show Real.exp (rfpLam P y) = P.Pst * Real.exp (y / 10)
      have htail : tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) = 1 - P.ρ := by
        unfold tailFac
        rw [← Real.exp_sub, Real.log_exp,
          sig0 ((y - rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh + 2) / 2) (by rw [eYb]; linarith)]
        ring
      have hΛ : rfpLam P y = Real.log P.Pst + y / 10 := by
        unfold rfpLam
        rw [hS0 y hy, hS0 (y - rfpY2 P.Md) (by linarith), hS0 (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (by linarith),
          hS0 (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) (by linarith), hσ0, htail, div_self hρ1'.ne',
          Real.log_one]

  · refine ⟨Real.exp (Real.log P.Pst + 3 / 5 - Real.log (1 - P.ρ)), 1 / 2 - P.lam, by linarith, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    show Real.exp (rfpLam P y) ≤ _
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
    obtain ⟨hτ1, hτ2⟩ := hτ y
    have hτpos : 0 < tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) := by linarith
    have hlogτ : Real.log (tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) /
        (1 - P.ρ)) ≤ -Real.log (1 - P.ρ) := by
      rw [Real.log_div hτpos.ne' hρ1'.ne']
      linarith [Real.log_nonpos hτpos.le hτ2]
    have hu1 := hmono (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (by linarith)
    have hu2 : rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) ≤ y := by
      rcases le_total (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) 0 with h | h
      · rw [hS0 _ h]; exact hy
      · linarith [hSup _ h]
    have p1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu1 (show 0 ≤ 1 - P.h by linarith)
    have p2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu2 (show 0 ≤ P.lam - P.h by linarith)
    have p3 := mul_nonneg hh0.le hy
    have p4 := mul_nonneg hl0.le (hSnn (y - rfpY2 P.Md))
    have p5 := mul_nonneg (sigR ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60)).1
      (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2))

    unfold rfpLam
    linarith

by
  intro P hR hC η h1 h2

  obtain ⟨q, hq_def⟩ : ∃ q : ℝ → ℝ, q = fun y => expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩

    rw [hq_def]

  have qpos_arg : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → 0 < y * |y| := fun y hy => by
    rw [abs_of_pos hy]; exact mul_pos hy hy

    rw [hq_def]

    rw [hq_def]

    rw [hq_def]

    intro y hy

    show expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) = _

  have hDpos : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < q y + q (1 - y) := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : 0 < y
    · exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (qb y hy) (qc _)
    · exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (qc y) (qb _ (by linarith [not_lt.mp hy]))

    funext y
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs with hh1 hh2
    · rw [qa y hh1, zero_div]
    · have hy : 0 < y := not_le.mp hh1

    rw [heq]

  have sig1 : ∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → sigA y = 1 := fun y hy => by

    rw [heq]
