    exact div_nonneg (qc y) (hDpos y).le
  
  have bmpC : Continuous rfpBmp := by
    have e : rfpBmp = fun t => sigA (1 + t / (3 / 20)) * sigA (1 - t / (3 / 20)) := rfl
    rw [e]
    exact (sigC.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.div_const _))).mul
      (sigC.comp (continuous_const.sub (continuous_id.div_const _)))
  have bmp0 : ∀ t : ℝ, 3 / 20 ≤ |t| → rfpBmp t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpBmp
    rcases le_abs'.mp ht with h | h
    · have : t / (3 / 20) ≤ -1 := by rw [div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
      rw [sig0 (1 + t / (3 / 20)) (by linarith), zero_mul]
    · have : 1 ≤ t / (3 / 20) := by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
      rw [sig0 (1 - t / (3 / 20)) (by linarith), mul_zero]
  have bmp1 : rfpBmp 0 = 1 := by
    unfold rfpBmp
    rw [show (1 : ℝ) + 0 / (3 / 20) = 1 by norm_num, show (1 : ℝ) - 0 / (3 / 20) = 1 by norm_num,
      sig1 1 le_rfl]
    norm_num
  have bmpNN : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpBmp t := fun t => by
    unfold rfpBmp; exact mul_nonneg (sigNN _) (sigNN _)
  
  have hl2 : P.lam ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 10000 := by nlinarith
  have hρ1 : P.ρ < 1 := by linarith
  have SigC : Continuous rfpSigI := by
    have e : rfpSigI = fun t => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, sigA s := rfl
    rw [e]
    exact intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive (fun a b => sigC.intervalIntegrable a b) 0
  have tailC : Continuous (fun y => tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh))
      (Real.exp y) / (1 - P.ρ)) := by
    unfold tailFac
    have hlog : Continuous (fun y => Real.log (Real.exp y / Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh))) :=
      (Real.continuous_exp.div_const _).log
        (fun y => (div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (Real.exp_pos _)).ne')
    exact (continuous_const.sub (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub
      (sigC.comp ((hlog.add continuous_const).div_const _))))).div_const _
  have tailNZ : ∀ y : ℝ, tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh))
      (Real.exp y) / (1 - P.ρ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro y
    unfold tailFac
    have key : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → 0 < 1 - P.ρ * (1 - s) := fun s hs => by nlinarith
    exact div_ne_zero (key _ (sigNN _)).ne' (by linarith)
  have lamC : Continuous (rfpLam P) := by
    have e : rfpLam P = fun y => Real.log P.Pst + y / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y
        - P.lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 P.Md)
        - (1 - P.lam) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam)
        + (1 - P.h) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1)
        - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) * Real.log 2
        + Real.log (tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) / (1 - P.ρ)) :=
      rfl
    rw [e]
    refine Continuous.add ?_ (tailC.log tailNZ)
    refine Continuous.sub ?_ ((sigC.comp ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).div_const _)).mul
      continuous_const)
    refine Continuous.add ?_ (continuous_const.mul (SigC.comp
      (((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).sub continuous_const).sub continuous_const)))
    refine Continuous.sub ?_ (continuous_const.mul (SigC.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)))
    refine Continuous.sub ?_ (continuous_const.mul (SigC.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)))
    refine Continuous.sub ?_ (continuous_const.mul SigC)
    exact continuous_const.add (continuous_id.div_const _)
  
  have hL : 20 < 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := by
    have h2' : (2:ℝ) ≤ 1 / P.lam := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith
    have := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) h2'
    linarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
  have e5 : rfpY5 P.Md P.lam = rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  have psiTh : ∀ y : ℝ, rfpPsi P y ≠ 0 → rfpTh P y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hy' : rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 63 / 20 < y := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      apply hy
      have h3 : 3 / 20 ≤ |y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3| := by
        rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith
      have h4 : 3 / 20 ≤ |y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1| := by
        rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith
      unfold rfpPsi
      rw [bmp0 _ h3, bmp0 _ h4]; ring
    have hge : 1 ≤ (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60 := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
    unfold rfpTh
    rw [sig1 _ hge]; ring
  
  have wC : Continuous (fun y => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y)) :=
    Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul lamC)
  have b1C : Continuous (fun y => rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3)) :=
    bmpC.comp ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).add continuous_const)
  have b2C : Continuous (fun y => rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)) :=
    bmpC.comp ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).add continuous_const)
  have b1S : HasCompactSupport (fun y => rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3)) := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro
      (isCompact_Icc (a := rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 63 / 20) (b := rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 57 / 20)) ?_
    intro y hy
    apply bmp0
    rw [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at hy
    rcases hy with hy | hy
    · rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith
    · rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith
  have b2S : HasCompactSupport (fun y => rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)) := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro
      (isCompact_Icc (a := rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 23 / 20) (b := rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 17 / 20)) ?_
    intro y hy
    apply bmp0
    rw [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at hy
    rcases hy with hy | hy
    · rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith
    · rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith
  have g1I : Integrable (fun y => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3)) :=
    (wC.mul b1C).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport b1S.mul_left
  have g2I : Integrable (fun y => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)) :=
    (wC.mul b2C).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport b2S.mul_left
  have Bpos : 0 < ∫ y, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1) := by
    refine Continuous.integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
      (x := rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1) (wC.mul b2C) b2S.mul_left ?_ ?_
    · intro y
      exact mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (bmpNN _)
    · show Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1)) *
        rfpBmp (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1) ≠ 0
      rw [show rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 = 0 by ring, bmp1, mul_one]
      exact (Real.exp_pos _).ne'
  have Heq : (fun y => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y) = fun y =>
      Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3) -
        rfpKa P * (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)) := by
    funext y; unfold rfpPsi; ring
  have HI : Integrable (fun y => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y) := by
    rw [Heq]; exact g1I.sub (g2I.const_mul _)
  have H0 : ∫ y, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y = 0 := by
    rw [Heq, integral_sub g1I (g2I.const_mul _), integral_const_mul]
    unfold rfpKa
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ Bpos.ne', sub_self]
  
  have hf0 : 0 < (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
  have hcaψ : ∀ y, |P.ca η * rfpPsi P y| ≤ 1 / 2 := (hca η (by linarith) (by linarith)).2
  have ptw : ∀ y, Real.exp y * rfpF P (Real.exp y) η ^ 2 =
      (Real.exp (rfpLam P y) ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) +
        P.ca η * (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y)) / 2 := by
    intro y
    have hE : Real.exp y ≠ 0 := (Real.exp_pos y).ne'
    have hsq : Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y) ^ 2 = 1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y := by
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
      have := neg_abs_le (P.ca η * rfpPsi P y)
      linarith [hcaψ y]
    have hrp : ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) = (((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_comm (2:ℝ) (rfpTh P y), Real.rpow_mul hf0.le, Real.rpow_two]
    have hcross : Real.exp (rfpLam P y) ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) * rfpPsi P y =
        Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y := by
      by_cases hψ : rfpPsi P y = 0
      · rw [hψ]; ring
      · rw [psiTh y hψ, mul_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one, sq, ← Real.exp_add, two_mul]
    have hS : Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp y) ^ 2 = 2 * Real.exp y := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
    unfold rfpF rfpE
    rw [Real.log_exp, div_pow, hS, mul_pow, mul_pow, hsq, ← hrp]
    generalize ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) = R at hcross ⊢
    rw [← hcross]
    field_simp
  
  have key : ∫ y, (Real.exp (rfpLam P y) ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) +
        P.ca η * (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y)) / 2 =
      (∫ y, Real.exp (rfpLam P y) ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y)) / 2 := by
    rw [integral_div]
    congr 1
    by_cases hGI : Integrable (fun y => Real.exp (rfpLam P y) ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y))
    · rw [integral_add hGI (HI.const_mul _), integral_const_mul, H0, mul_zero, add_zero]
    · have hnot : ¬ Integrable (fun y => Real.exp (rfpLam P y) ^ 2 *
          ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) + P.ca η * (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y)) := by
        intro hI
        apply hGI
        refine (hI.sub (HI.const_mul (P.ca η))).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
        ring
      rw [integral_undef hGI, integral_undef hnot]
  
  have hcv := integral_comp_exp (fun x => rfpF P x η ^ 2)
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hcv
  unfold leadPi shapeDatum
  rw [← hcv, show (fun x => Real.exp x * rfpF P (Real.exp x) η ^ 2) = fun y =>
      (Real.exp (rfpLam P y) ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) +
        P.ca η * (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y)) / 2 from funext ptw, key]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → RfpClos P → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => rfpE P p.1 p.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ((1 + p.2 ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P p.1) * Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca p.2 * rfpPsi P p.1)) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.2 * rfpK P.Md p.1 + rfpE P p.1 p.2 * rfpRb P p.1 p.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2)

signature.name: rfp_joint_smooth
signature.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → RfpClos P → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => rfpE P p.1 p.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ((1 + p.2 ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P p.1) * Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca p.2 * rfpPsi P p.1)) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.2 * rfpK P.Md p.1 + rfpE P p.1 p.2 * rfpRb P p.1 p.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hReg hClos
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl100, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hReg
  obtain ⟨cAmp, cc1, cc2, cca, -, hca, -, -⟩ := hClos
  
  have hσ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ sigA := by
    obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ,
        F = fun j z => if z ≤ 0 then (0 : ℝ) else (z ^ j)⁻¹ * Real.exp (-1 / z ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hflat : ∀ (j : ℕ) (z : ℝ), 0 < z → z ≤ 1 →
        (z ^ j)⁻¹ * Real.exp (-1 / z ^ 2) ≤ ((j + 1).factorial : ℝ) * z ^ 2 := by
      intro j z hz hz1
      have hx : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / z ^ 2 := by positivity
      have h1 := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp _ hx (j + 1)
      have hA : (0 : ℝ) < ((j + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos _
      have hE : Real.exp (-1 / z ^ 2) = (Real.exp (1 / z ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
        rw [← Real.exp_neg]; ring_nf
      have hEpos := Real.exp_pos (1 / z ^ 2)
      have hzj : z ^ j ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hz.le hz1
      have hzjpos : 0 < z ^ j := pow_pos hz j
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hA] at h1
      have h2 : (1 / z ^ 2) ^ (j + 1) * (z ^ 2) ^ (j + 1) = 1 := by
        rw [← mul_pow]; field_simp; simp
      have h3 : 1 ≤ ((j + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (z ^ 2) ^ (j + 1) * Real.exp (1 / z ^ 2) := by
        calc (1 : ℝ) = (1 / z ^ 2) ^ (j + 1) * (z ^ 2) ^ (j + 1) := h2.symm
          _ ≤ (Real.exp (1 / z ^ 2) * ((j + 1).factorial : ℝ)) * (z ^ 2) ^ (j + 1) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (by positivity)
          _ = _ := by ring
      have h4 : (z ^ 2) ^ (j + 1) ≤ z ^ 2 * z ^ j := by
        calc (z ^ 2) ^ (j + 1) = z ^ 2 * z ^ j * z ^ j := by ring
          _ ≤ z ^ 2 * z ^ j * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hzj (by positivity)
          _ = z ^ 2 * z ^ j := by ring
      have key : 1 ≤ ((j + 1).factorial : ℝ) * z ^ 2 * (z ^ j * Real.exp (1 / z ^ 2)) := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 (le_of_lt (mul_pos hA hEpos))
        nlinarith
      rw [hE, ← mul_inv, ← one_div, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      exact key
    have hFcont0 : ∀ j, ContinuousAt (F j) 0 := by
      intro j
      have h0 : F j 0 = 0 := by simp only [hF]; rw [if_pos le_rfl]
      rw [ContinuousAt, h0]
      apply squeeze_zero_norm' (a := fun z => ((j + 1).factorial : ℝ) * z ^ 2)
      · filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℝ) one_pos] with z hz
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at hz
        simp only [hF]
        split_ifs with h
        · rw [norm_zero]; positivity
        · push_neg at h
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
          exact hflat j z h (by linarith [le_abs_self z])
      · exact (continuous_const.mul (continuous_pow 2)).tendsto' 0 0 (by simp)
    have hpos : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ), 0 < y →
        HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => (z ^ k)⁻¹ * Real.exp (-1 / z ^ 2))
          (-(k : ℝ) * ((y ^ (k + 1))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2)) +
            2 * ((y ^ (k + 3))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2))) y := by
      intro k y hy
      have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := hy.ne'
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => (z ^ k)⁻¹) (-(k : ℝ) * (y ^ (k + 1))⁻¹) y := by
        have := (hasDerivAt_pow k y).inv (pow_ne_zero k hy0)
        convert this using 1
        rcases k with _ | m
        · simp
        · simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
          field_simp
          ring
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => -1 / z ^ 2) (2 / y ^ 3) y := by
        have := (hasDerivAt_const y (-1 : ℝ)).div (hasDerivAt_pow 2 y) (pow_ne_zero 2 hy0)
        convert this using 1
        field_simp
        ring
      have h3 := h1.mul h2.exp
      convert h3 using 1
      field_simp
      ring
    have hFd : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ), HasDerivAt (F k) (-(k : ℝ) * F (k + 1) y + 2 * F (k + 3) y) y := by
      have hneg : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ), y < 0 →
          HasDerivAt (F k) (-(k : ℝ) * F (k + 1) y + 2 * F (k + 3) y) y := by
        intro k y hy
        have hev : F k =ᶠ[nhds y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
          filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hy] with z hz
          simp only [hF]
          rw [if_pos (le_of_lt hz)]
        have hv : -(k : ℝ) * F (k + 1) y + 2 * F (k + 3) y = 0 := by
          simp only [hF]
          rw [if_pos hy.le, if_pos hy.le]
          ring
        rw [hv]
        exact (hasDerivAt_const y (0 : ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
      have hposF : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ), 0 < y →
          HasDerivAt (F k) (-(k : ℝ) * F (k + 1) y + 2 * F (k + 3) y) y := by
        intro k y hy
        have hev : F k =ᶠ[nhds y] fun z => (z ^ k)⁻¹ * Real.exp (-1 / z ^ 2) := by
          filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hy] with z hz
          simp only [hF]
          rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr (show (0 : ℝ) < z from hz))]
        have hv1 : F (k + 1) y = (y ^ (k + 1))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) := by
          simp only [hF]; rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr hy)]
        have hv3 : F (k + 3) y = (y ^ (k + 3))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) := by
          simp only [hF]; rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr hy)]
        rw [hv1, hv3]
        exact (hpos k y hy).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
      intro k y
      rcases lt_trichotomy y 0 with hy | hy | hy
      · exact hneg k y hy
      · subst hy
        have hg : ContinuousAt (fun z => -(k : ℝ) * F (k + 1) z + 2 * F (k + 3) z) 0 :=
          (continuousAt_const.mul (hFcont0 (k + 1))).add (continuousAt_const.mul (hFcont0 (k + 3)))
        exact hasDerivAt_of_hasDerivAt_of_ne (f := F k)
          (g := fun z => -(k : ℝ) * F (k + 1) z + 2 * F (k + 3) z)
          (fun z hz => by
            rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hz with h | h
            · exact hneg k z h
            · exact hposF k z h) (hFcont0 k) hg
      · exact hposF k y hy
    have hFsmooth : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F k) := by
      have hdiff : ∀ k, Differentiable ℝ (F k) := fun k y => (hFd k y).differentiableAt
      have hderiv : ∀ k, deriv (F k) = fun y => -(k : ℝ) * F (k + 1) y + 2 * F (k + 3) y :=
        fun k => funext fun y => (hFd k y).deriv
      have hn : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ n (F k) := by
        intro n
        induction n with
        | zero => intro k; exact contDiff_zero.mpr (hdiff k).continuous
        | succ n ih =>
          intro k
          rw [Nat.cast_succ, contDiff_succ_iff_deriv]
          refine ⟨hdiff k, ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro h; exact absurd h (by simp)
          · rw [hderiv k]
            exact (contDiff_const.mul (ih (k + 1))).add (contDiff_const.mul (ih (k + 3)))
      intro k
      exact contDiff_infty.mpr (fun n => hn n k)
    have hsq : sqFlat = F 0 := by
      funext y; simp only [hF, sqFlat, pow_zero, inv_one, one_mul]
    have hS : ContDiff ℝ ∞ sqFlat := by rw [hsq]; exact hFsmooth 0
    have hsq_nn : ∀ y, 0 ≤ sqFlat y := by intro y; unfold sqFlat; split_ifs <;> positivity
    have hD : ∀ y, 0 < sqFlat y + sqFlat (1 - y) := by
      intro y
      by_cases hy : y ≤ 0
      · have : sqFlat (1 - y) = Real.exp (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2) := by
          unfold sqFlat; rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr (by linarith))]
        linarith [hsq_nn y, Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)]
      · have : sqFlat y = Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) := by
          unfold sqFlat; rw [if_neg hy]
        linarith [hsq_nn (1 - y), Real.exp_pos (-1 / y ^ 2)]
    have hsig : ∀ y, sigA y = sqFlat y / (sqFlat y + sqFlat (1 - y)) := by
      intro y
      unfold sigA sqFlat
      by_cases h0 : y ≤ 0
      · simp only [if_pos h0, zero_div]
      · by_cases h1 : 1 ≤ y
        · have h2 : 1 - y ≤ 0 := by linarith
          simp only [if_neg h0, if_pos h1, if_pos h2, add_zero]
          rw [div_self (Real.exp_pos _).ne']
        · have h2 : ¬ (1 - y ≤ 0) := not_le.mpr (by linarith)
          simp only [if_neg h0, if_neg h1, if_neg h2]
    have hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ => 1 - y) := contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id
    have hS1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => sqFlat (1 - y)) := hS.comp hr
    have hDc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => sqFlat y + sqFlat (1 - y)) := hS.add hS1
    have hD0 : ∀ y, sqFlat y + sqFlat (1 - y) ≠ 0 := fun y => (hD y).ne'
    have hsigeq : sigA = fun y => sqFlat y / (sqFlat y + sqFlat (1 - y)) := funext hsig
    rw [hsigeq]; exact hS.div hDc hD0
  have hσ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ sigA y := by
    intro y; unfold sigA; split_ifs <;> positivity
  
  have hprim : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, g s) := by
    intro g hg
    have hc := hg.continuous
    rw [contDiff_infty_iff_deriv]
    refine ⟨fun b => (hc.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 b).hasDerivAt.differentiableAt, ?_⟩
    have : deriv (fun t => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, g s) = g :=
      funext fun b => (hc.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 b).hasDerivAt.deriv
    rw [this]; exact hg
  have hSI : ContDiff ℝ ∞ rfpSigI := hprim sigA hσ
  have hR0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ rfpR0 := by
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..ξ, sigA (50 * v)) :=
      hprim (fun v => sigA (50 * v)) (by fun_prop)
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : ℝ => 1 - sigA (ξ - 10)) := by fun_prop
    exact h1.mul h2
  have hBmp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ rfpBmp := by
    show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t => sigA (1 + t / (3 / 20)) * sigA (1 - t / (3 / 20)))
    fun_prop
  have hTh : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (rfpTh P) := by
    show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => 1 - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60))
    fun_prop
  have hPsi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (rfpPsi P) := by
    show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3) - rfpKa P * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1))
    fun_prop
  
  have hK : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (rfpK P.Md) := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro y
    by_cases hy : 0 < y
    · have hk : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun t => 4 * (1 - sigA (Real.log t / P.Md))) y :=
        contDiffAt_const.mul (contDiffAt_const.sub
          (hσ.contDiffAt.comp y ((contDiffAt_id.log hy.ne').div_const P.Md)))
      refine hk.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hy] with t ht
      unfold rfpK
      split_ifs with h1
      · have hl : Real.log t / P.Md ≤ 0 :=
          div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (Real.log_nonpos (le_of_lt ht) h1) hMd.le
        have : sigA (Real.log t / P.Md) = 0 := by unfold sigA; rw [if_pos hl]
        rw [this]; ring
      · rfl
    · have hy1 : y < 1 := by linarith [not_lt.mp hy]
      refine (contDiffAt_const (c := (4:ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hy1] with t ht
      unfold rfpK
      rw [if_pos (le_of_lt ht)]
  
  have hlam2 : P.lam ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hρ1 : P.ρ < 1 := by linarith
  have hT : ∀ y, tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) =
      1 - P.ρ * (1 - sigA ((y - rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh + 2) / 2)) := by
    intro y
    unfold tailFac
    rw [← Real.exp_sub, Real.log_exp]
  have hLam : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (rfpLam P) := by
    have hfun : rfpLam P = fun y => (Real.log P.Pst + y / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y
        - P.lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 P.Md)
        - (1 - P.lam) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam)
        + (1 - P.h) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1)
        - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) * Real.log 2)
        + Real.log ((1 - P.ρ * (1 - sigA ((y - rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh + 2) / 2))) / (1 - P.ρ)) := by
      funext y; unfold rfpLam; rw [hT y]
    rw [hfun]
    have hpos : ∀ y, (1 - P.ρ * (1 - sigA ((y - rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh + 2) / 2))) /
        (1 - P.ρ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro y
      have h0 := hσ0 ((y - rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh + 2) / 2)
      apply ne_of_gt
      apply div_pos _ (by linarith)
      nlinarith
    have hrest : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.log P.Pst + y / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y
        - P.lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 P.Md)
        - (1 - P.lam) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam)
        + (1 - P.h) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1)
        - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) * Real.log 2) := by fun_prop
    have hT' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => (1 - P.ρ * (1 - sigA ((y - rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh + 2) / 2))) /
        (1 - P.ρ)) := by fun_prop
    exact hrest.add (hT'.log hpos)
  
  have L : ∀ a : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ a →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => a p.1) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) :=
    fun a ha => (ha.comp contDiff_fst).contDiffOn
  have S : ∀ b : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b (Ioo (-2) 2) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => b p.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) :=
    fun b hb => hb.comp contDiffOn_snd (fun p hp => hp.2)
  have hbase : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (1 + p.2 ^ 2)⁻¹) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) :=
    (ContDiff.inv (by fun_prop : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 1 + p.2 ^ 2))
      (fun p => by positivity)).contDiffOn
  have Fp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ((1 + p.2 ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P p.1))
      (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) :=
    hbase.rpow (L _ hTh) (fun p _ => by positivity)
  have Sq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca p.2 * rfpPsi P p.1))
      (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) := by
    have hrad : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 1 + P.ca p.2 * rfpPsi P p.1)
        (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) := contDiffOn_const.add ((S _ cca).mul (L _ hPsi))
    refine hrad.sqrt (fun p hp => ?_)
    have hb := (hca p.2 hp.2.1 hp.2.2).2 p.1
    rw [abs_le] at hb
    apply ne_of_gt
    linarith [hb.1]
  have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ((1 + p.2 ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P p.1) *
      Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca p.2 * rfpPsi P p.1)) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) := Fp.mul Sq
  have hE : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => rfpE P p.1 p.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) :=
    ((L _ hLam.exp).mul Fp).mul Sq
  have hR0' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam))) := by fun_prop
  have hB1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3)) := by fun_prop
  have hB2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1)) := by fun_prop
  have hRb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => rfpRb P p.1 p.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) :=
    (((S _ cAmp).mul (L _ hR0')).add ((S _ cc1).mul (L _ hB1))).add ((S _ cc2).mul (L _ hB2))
  have hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.2 * rfpK P.Md p.1 + rfpE P p.1 p.2 * rfpRb P p.1 p.2)
      (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) :=
    (contDiffOn_snd.mul (L _ hK)).add (hE.mul hRb)
  exact ⟨hE, hG, hU⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → (1 ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ∧ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ∧ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ≤ rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam → ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y) * Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y) = (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ≤ y → ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y) * Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y) = 1) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, y ≤ 1 → η * rfpK P.Md y + rfpE P y η * rfpRb P y η = 4 * η) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ≤ y → η * rfpK P.Md y + rfpE P y η * rfpRb P y η = 0)

signature.name: rfp_clamp_identities
signature.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → (1 ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ∧ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ∧ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ≤ rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam → ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y) * Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y) = (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ≤ y → ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y) * Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y) = 1) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, y ≤ 1 → η * rfpK P.Md y + rfpE P y η * rfpRb P y η = 4 * η) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ≤ y → η * rfpK P.Md y + rfpE P y η * rfpRb P y η = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hReg
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl100, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hReg
  have hs0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → sigA t = 0 := fun t ht => by
    unfold sigA; rw [if_pos ht]
  have hs1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → sigA t = 1 := fun t ht => by
    unfold sigA; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos ht]
  have hbm : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ -(3 / 20) → rfpBmp t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    have e : t / (3 / 20) = 20 * t / 3 := by ring
    unfold rfpBmp
    rw [hs0 (1 + t / (3 / 20)) (by rw [e]; linarith), zero_mul]
  have hbp : ∀ t : ℝ, 3 / 20 ≤ t → rfpBmp t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    have e : t / (3 / 20) = 20 * t / 3 := by ring
    unfold rfpBmp
    rw [hs0 (1 - t / (3 / 20)) (by rw [e]; linarith), mul_zero]
  have hR0n : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ξ ≤ 0 → rfpR0 ξ = 0 := by
    intro ξ hξ
    unfold rfpR0
    have hI : (∫ v in (0:ℝ)..ξ, sigA (50 * v)) = ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..ξ, (0:ℝ) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro v hv
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge hξ] at hv
      exact hs0 (50 * v) (by linarith [hv.2])
    rw [hI, intervalIntegral.integral_zero, zero_mul]
  have hR0p : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 11 ≤ ξ → rfpR0 ξ = 0 := by
    intro ξ hξ
    unfold rfpR0
    rw [hs1 (ξ - 10) (by linarith), sub_self, mul_zero]
  have hL : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.lam) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith)
  have h13 : 0 < 13 / P.lam := by positivity
  have hh1 : P.h < 1 := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl100 hl0.le]
  have hLh1 : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.h) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hh0]; linarith)
  have hE := Real.exp_pos P.Md
  have hY3 : rfpY3 P.Md P.lam = Real.exp P.Md + 12 + 60 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := by
    unfold rfpY3 rfpY2; ring
  have hY4 : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam = rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 13 / P.lam := rfl
  have hY5 : rfpY5 P.Md P.lam = rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  have hYb : rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh = rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 2 + P.T1 + P.Lh + 3 := rfl
  have hTh1 : ∀ y, y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam → rfpTh P y = 1 := by
    intro y hy
    unfold rfpTh
    rw [hs0 ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60)
      (by rw [div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 60)]; linarith), sub_zero]
  have hTh0 : ∀ y, rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ≤ y → rfpTh P y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    unfold rfpTh
    rw [hs1 ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60)
      (by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 60)]; linarith), sub_self]
  have hPsi : ∀ y, (y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ∨ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ≤ y) → rfpPsi P y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    unfold rfpPsi
    rcases hy with hy | hy
    · rw [hbm (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3) (by linarith),
        hbm (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1) (by linarith), mul_zero, sub_zero]
    · rw [hbp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3) (by linarith),
        hbp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1) (by linarith), mul_zero, sub_zero]
  have hRb : ∀ y η, (y ≤ 1 ∨ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ≤ y) → rfpRb P y η = 0 := by
    intro y η hy
    unfold rfpRb
    rcases hy with hy | hy
    · have hn : P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) ≤ 0 :=
        mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hl0.le (by linarith)
      rw [hR0n _ hn, hbm (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) (by linarith),
        hbm (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) (by linarith)]
      ring
    · have e : P.lam * (13 / P.lam) = 13 := by field_simp
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (show 13 / P.lam ≤ y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam by linarith) hl0.le
      have hn : 11 ≤ P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) := by linarith
      rw [hR0p _ hn, hbp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) (by linarith),
        hbp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) (by linarith)]
      ring
  have hK4 : ∀ y, y ≤ 1 → rfpK P.Md y = 4 := fun y hy => by
    unfold rfpK; rw [if_pos hy]
  have hK0 : ∀ y, rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ≤ y → rfpK P.Md y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hy0 : 0 < y := by linarith
    have hlog : P.Md ≤ Real.log y := by
      rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hy0]; linarith
    unfold rfpK
    rw [if_neg (by linarith), hs1 (Real.log y / P.Md) (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hMd]; linarith),
      sub_self, mul_zero]
  refine ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y η hy
    rw [hTh1 y hy, hPsi y (Or.inl hy), mul_zero, add_zero, Real.sqrt_one, mul_one,
      Real.rpow_one]
  · intro y η hy
    rw [hTh0 y hy, hPsi y (Or.inr hy), mul_zero, add_zero, Real.sqrt_one, mul_one,
      Real.rpow_zero]
  · intro y η hy
    rw [hK4 y hy, hRb y η (Or.inl hy)]
    ring
  · intro y η hy
    rw [hK0 y hy, hRb y η (Or.inr hy)]
    ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → (∀ y : ℝ, rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh ≤ y → rfpLam P y = rfpLam P (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh - 3) + (1 / 2 + P.h) * (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh - 3) - Real.log (1 - P.ρ) - (1 / 2 + P.h) * y) ∧ ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ y : ℝ, rfpLam P y ≤ B + y / 10 - (3 / 5 + P.h) * max y 0

signature.name: rfp_lam_tail_envelope
signature.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → (∀ y : ℝ, rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh ≤ y → rfpLam P y = rfpLam P (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh - 3) + (1 / 2 + P.h) * (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh - 3) - Real.log (1 - P.ρ) - (1 / 2 + P.h) * y) ∧ ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ y : ℝ, rfpLam P y ≤ B + y / 10 - (3 / 5 + P.h) * max y 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hR
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl1, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hR
  
  have hl2 : P.lam ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 10000 := by nlinarith
  have hhlam : P.h ≤ P.lam := by nlinarith
  have hρ1 : P.ρ < 1 := by linarith
  have h1ρ : 0 < 1 - P.ρ := by linarith
  have hlogh : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.h) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hh0]; linarith)
  have hT0 : 0 ≤ P.T1 := by linarith
  have hL : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.lam) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith)
  have hexpMd : 0 < Real.exp P.Md := Real.exp_pos _
  have hlam13 : 0 < 13 / P.lam := by positivity
  have eY2 : rfpY2 P.Md = Real.exp P.Md + 11 := rfl
  have eY3 : rfpY3 P.Md P.lam = rfpY2 P.Md + 1 + 60 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  have eY4 : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam = rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 13 / P.lam := rfl
  have eY5 : rfpY5 P.Md P.lam = rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  obtain ⟨yb, hyb⟩ : ∃ yb : ℝ, yb = rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have eYb : yb = rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 2 + P.T1 + P.Lh + 3 := by rw [hyb]; rfl
  
  have sig0 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → sigA y = 0 := fun y hy => by unfold sigA; simp [hy]
  have sig1 : ∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → sigA y = 1 := fun y hy => by
    unfold sigA; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hy]
  have sigR : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA y ∧ sigA y ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
    · have ha := Real.exp_pos (-1 / y ^ 2)
      have hb := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)
      exact ⟨div_nonneg ha.le (by linarith), (div_le_one (by linarith)).2 (by linarith)⟩
  have sigM : Measurable sigA := by
    unfold sigA
    refine Measurable.ite (measurableSet_le measurable_id measurable_const) measurable_const
      (Measurable.ite (measurableSet_le measurable_const measurable_id) measurable_const ?_)
    fun_prop
  have sigInt : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable sigA MeasureTheory.volume a b := by
    intro a b
    refine (intervalIntegrable_const (c := (1:ℝ))).mono_fun' sigM.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by
      show ‖sigA x‖ ≤ 1
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [(sigR x).1, (sigR x).2])
  
  have hI1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → rfpSigI t = rfpSigI 1 + (t - 1) := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpSigI
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (sigInt 0 1) (sigInt 1 t)]
    congr 1
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (1:ℝ))]
    · simp
    · intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le ht] at hs
      exact sig1 s hs.1
  have hI0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → rfpSigI t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpSigI
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ))]
    · simp
    · intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge ht] at hs
      exact sig0 s hs.2
  have hInn : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpSigI t := by
    intro t
    rcases le_total t 0 with ht | ht
    · rw [hI0 t ht]
    · unfold rfpSigI
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg ht (fun u _ => (sigR u).1)
  have hIle : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → rfpSigI t ≤ t := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpSigI
    have := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on ht (sigInt 0 t)
      (intervalIntegrable_const (c := (1:ℝ))) (fun x _ => (sigR x).2)
    simpa using this
  have hIge : ∀ t : ℝ, t - 1 ≤ rfpSigI t := by
    intro t
    rcases le_total 1 t with ht | ht
    · rw [hI1 t ht]; linarith [hInn 1]
    · linarith [hInn t]
  have tauR : ∀ a b : ℝ, 1 - P.ρ ≤ tailFac P.ρ a b ∧ tailFac P.ρ a b ≤ 1 := by
    intro a b
    unfold tailFac
    obtain ⟨s0, s1⟩ := sigR ((Real.log (b / a) + 2) / 2)
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  
  obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ : ∃ C0 : ℝ, C0 = Real.log P.Pst - 3 / 5 * (rfpSigI 1 - 1)
      - P.lam * (rfpSigI 1 - rfpY2 P.Md - 1) - (1 - P.lam) * (rfpSigI 1 - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1)
      + (1 - P.h) * (rfpSigI 1 - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 2 - P.T1) - Real.log 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΛ : ∀ y : ℝ, yb - 3 ≤ y → rfpLam P y = C0 - (1 / 2 + P.h) * y +
      Real.log (tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp yb) (Real.exp y) / (1 - P.ρ)) := by
    intro y hy
    have a1 : 1 ≤ y := by linarith
    have a2 : 1 ≤ y - rfpY2 P.Md := by linarith
    have a3 : 1 ≤ y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam := by linarith
    have a4 : 1 ≤ y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1 := by linarith
    have a5 : 1 ≤ (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60 := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
    unfold rfpLam
    rw [← hyb, hI1 y a1, hI1 _ a2, hI1 _ a3, hI1 _ a4, sig1 _ a5, hC0]
    ring
  have hτT : tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp yb) (Real.exp (yb - 3)) = 1 - P.ρ := by
    unfold tailFac
    rw [← Real.exp_sub, Real.log_exp, sig0 ((yb - 3 - yb + 2) / 2) (by linarith)]
    ring
  have hτ1 : ∀ y : ℝ, yb ≤ y → tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp yb) (Real.exp y) = 1 := by
    intro y hy
    unfold tailFac
    rw [← Real.exp_sub, Real.log_exp, sig1 ((y - yb + 2) / 2) (by linarith)]
    ring
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro y hy
    rw [← hyb] at hy ⊢
    rw [hΛ y (by linarith), hΛ (yb - 3) le_rfl, hτT, hτ1 y hy, div_self h1ρ.ne',
      Real.log_div one_ne_zero h1ρ.ne', Real.log_one]
    ring
  · 
    obtain ⟨B1, hB1⟩ : ∃ B1 : ℝ, B1 = Real.log P.Pst - Real.log (1 - P.ρ) +
        (3 / 5 + P.h) * (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨B2, hB2⟩ : ∃ B2 : ℝ, B2 = Real.log P.Pst + 3 / 5 + P.lam * (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) +
        (1 - P.lam) * (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1) - (1 - P.h) * (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1) -
        Real.log (1 - P.ρ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨max B1 B2, ?_⟩
    intro y
    have hY1 : 0 < rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1 := by linarith
    have U1 : 0 ≤ sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) * Real.log 2 :=
      mul_nonneg (sigR _).1 (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num))
    have U2 : Real.log (tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) /
        (1 - P.ρ)) ≤ -Real.log (1 - P.ρ) := by
      obtain ⟨t0, t1⟩ := tauR (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y)
      have tp : 0 < tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) := by
        linarith
      rw [Real.log_div tp.ne' h1ρ.ne']
      have := Real.log_le_log tp t1
      rw [Real.log_one] at this
      linarith
    have hB1le := le_max_left B1 B2
    have hB2le := le_max_right B1 B2
    unfold rfpLam
    rcases le_or_gt y (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1) with hy | hy
    · rw [hI0 (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) (by linarith)]
      have m1 : 0 ≤ 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y := mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hInn _)
      have m2 : 0 ≤ P.lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 P.Md) := mul_nonneg hl0.le (hInn _)
      have m3 : 0 ≤ (1 - P.lam) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) :=
        mul_nonneg (by linarith) (hInn _)
      have hmax : max y 0 ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1 := max_le hy hY1.le
      have m4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmax (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 3 / 5 + P.h by linarith)
      linarith
    · rw [max_eq_left (show (0:ℝ) ≤ y by linarith)]
      have m1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hIge y) (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 3 / 5 by norm_num)
      have m2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hIge (y - rfpY2 P.Md)) hl0.le
      have m3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hIge (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam))
        (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - P.lam by linarith)
      have m4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hIle (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) (by linarith))
        (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - P.h by linarith)
      linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a ≤ b → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) → (∀ y η : ℝ, y ≤ a → g (y, η) = g (a, η)) → (∀ y η : ℝ, b ≤ y → g (y, η) = g (b, η)) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y η : ℝ, |η| ≤ 3 / 2 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => g (y, e)) η| ≤ C

signature.name: eventually_const_slice_bound
signature.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a ≤ b → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) → (∀ y η : ℝ, y ≤ a → g (y, η) = g (a, η)) → (∀ y η : ℝ, b ≤ y → g (y, η) = g (b, η)) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y η : ℝ, |η| ≤ 3 / 2 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => g (y, e)) η| ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro g a b hab hg hlo hhi m
  have hU : IsOpen ((univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-2 : ℝ) 2) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hrep : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ D : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ D (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) ∧
      ∀ y η : ℝ, -2 < η → η < 2 → iteratedDeriv k (fun e => g (y, e)) η = D (y, η) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact ⟨g, hg, fun y η _ _ => by simp⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨D, hD, hDr⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨fun z => fderiv ℝ D z ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)), ?_, ?_⟩
      · have h1 := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hD).2
        exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
      · intro y η h1 h2
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        have hev : iteratedDeriv k (fun e => g (y, e)) =ᶠ[nhds η] fun e => D (y, e) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2) (fun e he => hDr y e he.1 he.2)
        rw [hev.deriv_eq]
        have hmem : ((y, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-2 : ℝ) 2 :=
          ⟨mem_univ _, h1, h2⟩
        have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ D (y, η) :=
          (hD.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by simp)
        have hc : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => ((y, e) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) η :=
          (hasDerivAt_const η y).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' η)
        have hcomp := hdiff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt η hc
        exact hcomp.deriv
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hDr⟩ := hrep m
  have hK : IsCompact (Icc a b ×ˢ Icc (-3/2 : ℝ) (3/2)) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  have hsub : Icc a b ×ˢ Icc (-3/2 : ℝ) (3/2) ⊆ (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-2 : ℝ) 2 := by
    intro z hz
    exact ⟨mem_univ _, by linarith [hz.2.1], by linarith [hz.2.2]⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hD.continuousOn.mono hsub)
  refine ⟨C, fun y η hη => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hη1, hη2⟩ := abs_le.1 hη
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ : ∃ y' : ℝ, y' = max a (min y b) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hy'a : a ≤ y' := by rw [hy']; exact le_max_left _ _
  have hy'b : y' ≤ b := by rw [hy']; exact max_le hab (min_le_right _ _)
  have hslice : (fun e => g (y, e)) = fun e => g (y', e) := by
    funext e
    rcases le_or_gt y a with h | h
    · have : y' = a := by rw [hy']; exact max_eq_left (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) h)
      rw [this, hlo y e h]
    · rcases le_or_gt b y with h' | h'
      · have : y' = b := by rw [hy', min_eq_right h', max_eq_right hab]
        rw [this, hhi y e h']
      · have : y' = y := by rw [hy', min_eq_left h'.le, max_eq_right h.le]
        rw [this]
  rw [hslice, hDr y' η (by linarith) (by linarith), ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact hC (y', η) ⟨⟨hy'a, hy'b⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (f u : ℝ → ℝ) (h C ci xv xb : ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 → 0 < xv → 0 < xb → ContinuousOn f (Ioi 0) → ContinuousOn u (Ioi 0) → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → |f x| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧ |u x| ≤ C) → (∀ x : ℝ, xv ≤ x → u x = 0) → (∀ x : ℝ, xb ≤ x → 2 * x * f x = Real.sqrt (2 * x) * ci * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) → IntegrableOn (fun x => u x * (2 * x * f x)) (Ioi 0) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => u x ^ 2 - x * f x ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => 2 * x * f x - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * ci * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) (Ioi 0) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => f x ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable (fun x => u x) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * f x) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => u x * (2 * x * f x)) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => u x ^ 2 - x * f x ^ 2) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => f x ^ 2) volume 0 X

signature.name: slice_integrability
signature.statement: ∀ (f u : ℝ → ℝ) (h C ci xv xb : ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 → 0 < xv → 0 < xb → ContinuousOn f (Ioi 0) → ContinuousOn u (Ioi 0) → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → |f x| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧ |u x| ≤ C) → (∀ x : ℝ, xv ≤ x → u x = 0) → (∀ x : ℝ, xb ≤ x → 2 * x * f x = Real.sqrt (2 * x) * ci * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) → IntegrableOn (fun x => u x * (2 * x * f x)) (Ioi 0) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => u x ^ 2 - x * f x ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => 2 * x * f x - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * ci * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) (Ioi 0) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => f x ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable (fun x => u x) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * f x) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => u x * (2 * x * f x)) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => u x ^ 2 - x * f x ^ 2) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => f x ^ 2) volume 0 X

proof.tactics:
by
  intro f u h C ci xv xb hh0 hh1 hxv hxb hf hu hbd hvan htail
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hbd 1 one_pos).2
  
  have local_tool : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (A B p a : ℝ), ContinuousOn g (Ioi 0) → p < 1 → 0 ≤ a →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ a → |g x| ≤ A + B * x ^ (-p)) → IntegrableOn g (Ioc 0 a) := by
    intro g A B p a hg hp ha hb
    have h2 : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => A + B * x ^ (-p)) (Ioc 0 a) :=
      (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le ha).1
        (intervalIntegrable_const.add
          ((intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_rpow' (by linarith)).const_mul B))
    refine Integrable.mono' h2
      ((hg.mono Ioc_subset_Ioi_self).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioc) ?_
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioc ?_
    intro x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hb x hx.1 hx.2
  
  have tail_tool : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (A q : ℝ), ContinuousOn g (Ioi 0) → 1 < q →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 1 < x → |g x| ≤ A * x ^ (-q)) → IntegrableOn g (Ioi 1) := by
    intro g A q hg hq hb
    have h2 : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => A * x ^ (-q)) (Ioi 1) :=
      (integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) one_pos).const_mul A
    refine Integrable.mono' h2
      ((hg.mono (Ioi_subset_Ioi zero_le_one)).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi) ?_
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi ?_
    intro x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hb x hx
  
  have glue : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → IntegrableOn g (Ioc 0 a) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, a < x → g x = 0) → IntegrableOn g (Ioi 0) := by
    intro g a ha hI hz
    rw [← Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi ha]
    refine hI.union ?_
    exact (integrableOn_zero).congr_fun (fun x hx => (hz x hx).symm) measurableSet_Ioi
  have split : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, IntegrableOn g (Ioc 0 1) → IntegrableOn g (Ioi 1) →
      IntegrableOn g (Ioi 0) := by
    intro g h1 h2
    rw [← Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi zero_le_one]
    exact h1.union h2
  
  have pw : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → |x * f x| ≤ C ∧ |f x| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) ∧
      |f x| ≤ C * x ^ (-(1 + h)) := by
    intro x hx
    have hb := (hbd x hx).1
    have hx1 : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + x := by linarith
    have e1 : (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ≤ 1 :=
      Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have e2 : (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ≤ x ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hx (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have p1 : 0 ≤ x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hx.le _
    have p2 : 0 ≤ (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hx1.le _
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have e3 : x * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) = x ^ (3 / 5 : ℝ) := by
        have : x * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) = x ^ (1 : ℝ) * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_one]
        rw [this, ← Real.rpow_add hx]; norm_num
      have e4 : x ^ (3 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ (1 + x) ^ (3 / 5 : ℝ) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow hx.le (by linarith) (by norm_num)
      have e5 : (1 + x) ^ (3 / 5 : ℝ) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) = (1 + x) ^ (-h) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hx1]; congr 1; ring
      have e6 : (1 + x) ^ (-h) ≤ 1 :=
        Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by linarith) (by linarith)
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hx]
      calc x * |f x| ≤ x * (C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hx.le
        _ = C * ((x * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ))) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h))) := by ring
        _ ≤ C * ((1 + x) ^ (3 / 5 : ℝ) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h))) := by
            rw [e3]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right e4 p2) hC
        _ = C * (1 + x) ^ (-h) := by rw [e5]
        _ ≤ C * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e6 hC
        _ = C := mul_one C
    · calc |f x| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) := hb
        _ ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e1 (mul_nonneg hC p1)
        _ = C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) := mul_one _
    · calc |f x| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) := hb
        _ ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * x ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e2 (mul_nonneg hC p1)
        _ = C * x ^ (-(1 + h)) := by
            rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hx]; congr 2; ring
  have tf : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 < x → |f x| ≤ C ∧ |f x| ≤ C * x ^ (-(1 + h)) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨-, -, b3⟩ := pw x (by linarith)
    have : x ^ (-(1 + h)) ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos hx.le (by linarith)
    exact ⟨le_trans b3 (mul_le_of_le_one_right hC this), b3⟩
  have bf2 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ 1 → |f x ^ 2| ≤ 0 + C ^ 2 * x ^ (-(4 / 5 : ℝ)) := by
    intro x hx _
    obtain ⟨-, b2, -⟩ := pw x hx
    have e : x ^ (-(4 / 5 : ℝ)) = x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hx]; norm_num
    rw [zero_add, abs_pow, e]
    calc |f x| ^ 2 = |f x| * |f x| := sq _
      _ ≤ (C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ))) * (C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ))) :=
          mul_le_mul b2 b2 (abs_nonneg _) (le_trans (abs_nonneg _) b2)
      _ = C ^ 2 * (x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ))) := by ring
  have tf2 : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 < x → |f x ^ 2| ≤ C ^ 2 * x ^ (-(1 + h)) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨t1, t2⟩ := tf x hx
    rw [abs_pow]
    calc |f x| ^ 2 = |f x| * |f x| := sq _
      _ ≤ C * (C * x ^ (-(1 + h))) := mul_le_mul t1 t2 (abs_nonneg _) hC
      _ = C ^ 2 * x ^ (-(1 + h)) := by ring
  have bxf2 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ 1 → |x * f x ^ 2| ≤ 0 + C ^ 2 * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) := by
    intro x hx _
    obtain ⟨b1, b2, -⟩ := pw x hx
    rw [zero_add, show x * f x ^ 2 = (x * f x) * f x by ring, abs_mul]
    calc |x * f x| * |f x| ≤ C * (C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ))) := mul_le_mul b1 b2 (abs_nonneg _) hC
      _ = C ^ 2 * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) := by ring
  have txf2 : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 < x → |x * f x ^ 2| ≤ C ^ 2 * x ^ (-(1 + h)) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨b1, -, -⟩ := pw x (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨-, t2⟩ := tf x hx
    rw [show x * f x ^ 2 = (x * f x) * f x by ring, abs_mul]
    calc |x * f x| * |f x| ≤ C * (C * x ^ (-(1 + h))) := mul_le_mul b1 t2 (abs_nonneg _) hC
      _ = C ^ 2 * x ^ (-(1 + h)) := by ring
  have b2xf : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → |2 * x * f x| ≤ 2 * C := by
    intro x hx
    rw [show 2 * x * f x = 2 * (x * f x) by ring, abs_mul, abs_two]
    linarith [(pw x hx).1]
  have hSid : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
      Real.sqrt (2 * x) * ci * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) = Real.sqrt 2 * ci * x ^ (-h) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) x, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow x]
    have e : x ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ)) * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) = x ^ (-h) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hx]; congr 1; ring
    calc Real.sqrt 2 * x ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ)) * ci * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))
        = Real.sqrt 2 * ci * (x ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ)) * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [e]
  have bT3 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ xb →
      |2 * x * f x - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * ci * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))| ≤
        2 * C + Real.sqrt 2 * |ci| * x ^ (-h) := by
    intro x hx _
    rw [hSid x hx]
    have e : |Real.sqrt 2 * ci * x ^ (-h)| = Real.sqrt 2 * |ci| * x ^ (-h) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg 2),
        abs_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hx.le _)]
    calc _ ≤ |2 * x * f x| + |Real.sqrt 2 * ci * x ^ (-h)| := abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ _ := by rw [e]; linarith [b2xf x hx]
  have bT1 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ xv →
      |u x * (2 * x * f x)| ≤ 2 * C ^ 2 + 0 * x ^ (-(0 : ℝ)) := by
    intro x hx _
    rw [zero_mul, add_zero, abs_mul]
    calc |u x| * |2 * x * f x| ≤ C * (2 * C) :=
          mul_le_mul (hbd x hx).2 (b2xf x hx) (abs_nonneg _) hC
      _ = 2 * C ^ 2 := by ring
  have bu2 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ xv → |u x ^ 2| ≤ C ^ 2 + 0 * x ^ (-(0 : ℝ)) := by
    intro x hx _
    rw [zero_mul, add_zero, abs_pow]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hbd x hx).2 2
  
  have hxf : ContinuousOn (fun x => 2 * x * f x) (Ioi 0) :=
    (continuousOn_const.mul continuousOn_id).mul hf
  have hf2 : ContinuousOn (fun x => f x ^ 2) (Ioi 0) := hf.pow 2
  have hxf2 : ContinuousOn (fun x => x * f x ^ 2) (Ioi 0) := continuousOn_id.mul hf2
  have hu2 : ContinuousOn (fun x => u x ^ 2) (Ioi 0) := hu.pow 2
  have huxf : ContinuousOn (fun x => u x * (2 * x * f x)) (Ioi 0) := hu.mul hxf
  have hS : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * x) * ci * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) (Ioi 0) :=
    ((continuousOn_const.mul continuousOn_id).sqrt.mul continuousOn_const).mul
      (continuousOn_id.rpow_const (fun x hx => Or.inl (Set.mem_Ioi.mp hx).ne'))
  
  have T4 : IntegrableOn (fun x => f x ^ 2) (Ioi 0) :=
    split _ (local_tool _ 0 (C ^ 2) (4 / 5) 1 hf2 (by norm_num) zero_le_one bf2)
      (tail_tool _ (C ^ 2) (1 + h) hf2 (by linarith) tf2)
  have Ixf2 : IntegrableOn (fun x => x * f x ^ 2) (Ioi 0) :=
    split _ (local_tool _ 0 (C ^ 2) (2 / 5) 1 hxf2 (by norm_num) zero_le_one bxf2)
      (tail_tool _ (C ^ 2) (1 + h) hxf2 (by linarith) txf2)
  have T1 : IntegrableOn (fun x => u x * (2 * x * f x)) (Ioi 0) :=
    glue _ xv hxv.le (local_tool _ (2 * C ^ 2) 0 0 xv huxf (by norm_num) hxv.le bT1)
      (fun x hx => by simp only [hvan x hx.le, zero_mul])
  have Iu2 : IntegrableOn (fun x => u x ^ 2) (Ioi 0) :=
    glue _ xv hxv.le (local_tool _ (C ^ 2) 0 0 xv hu2 (by norm_num) hxv.le bu2)
      (fun x hx => by simp [hvan x hx.le])
  have T2 : IntegrableOn (fun x => u x ^ 2 - x * f x ^ 2) (Ioi 0) := Iu2.sub Ixf2
  have T3 : IntegrableOn (fun x => 2 * x * f x - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * ci * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))
      (Ioi 0) :=
    glue _ xb hxb.le (local_tool _ (2 * C) (Real.sqrt 2 * |ci|) h xb (hxf.sub hS) hh1 hxb.le bT3)
      (fun x hx => sub_eq_zero.mpr (htail x hx.le))
  refine ⟨T1, T2, T3, T4, fun X hX => ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · refine (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hX).2 ?_
    refine local_tool _ C 0 0 X hu (by norm_num) hX (fun x hx _ => ?_)
    rw [zero_mul, add_zero]
    exact (hbd x hx).2
  · refine (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hX).2 ?_
    refine local_tool _ (2 * C) 0 0 X hxf (by norm_num) hX (fun x hx _ => ?_)
    rw [zero_mul, add_zero]
    exact b2xf x hx
  · exact (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hX).2 (T1.mono_set Ioc_subset_Ioi_self)
  · exact (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hX).2 (T2.mono_set Ioc_subset_Ioi_self)
  · exact (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hX).2 (T4.mono_set Ioc_subset_Ioi_self)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → ∃ (N5 : ℝ) (G δ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < N5 ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (Ioo (-(1/8)) (1/8)) ∧ G 0 = 0 ∧ (∀ c : ℝ, -(1/16) ≤ c → c ≤ 1/16 → deriv G c ≤ -(1/40)) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ δ ∧ δ 0 = 0 ∧ (∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ δ η ∧ δ η ≤ P.lam ^ 29 ∧ |deriv δ η| ≤ P.lam ^ 29) ∧ (∀ y : ℝ, |rfpPsi P y| ≤ 8) ∧ ∀ (ca : ℝ → ℝ) (η : ℝ), (∀ e : ℝ, |ca e| ≤ 1/16) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam), 2 * x * rfpF { P with ca := ca } x η) - (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam), 2 * x * rfpF { P with ca := ca } x 0) = N5 * (G (ca η) - G (ca 0) - δ η)

signature.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → ∃ (N5 : ℝ) (G δ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < N5 ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (Ioo (-(1/8)) (1/8)) ∧ G 0 = 0 ∧ (∀ c : ℝ, -(1/16) ≤ c → c ≤ 1/16 → deriv G c ≤ -(1/40)) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ δ ∧ δ 0 = 0 ∧ (∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ δ η ∧ δ η ≤ P.lam ^ 29 ∧ |deriv δ η| ≤ P.lam ^ 29) ∧ (∀ y : ℝ, |rfpPsi P y| ≤ 8) ∧ ∀ (ca : ℝ → ℝ) (η : ℝ), (∀ e : ℝ, |ca e| ≤ 1/16) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam), 2 * x * rfpF { P with ca := ca } x η) - (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam), 2 * x * rfpF { P with ca := ca } x 0) = N5 * (G (ca η) - G (ca 0) - δ η)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hP
  have hlam0 : 0 < P.lam := hP.2.2.1
  have hlam1 : P.lam ≤ 1 / 100 := hP.2.2.2.1
  have hσc : Continuous sigA := sigA_contDiff_one.continuous
  obtain ⟨hbc, hb01, hbsupp, hblow⟩ := rfp_bump_facts sigA_contDiff_one
  obtain ⟨hΛc, hΛaff, hΛenv⟩ := rfp_lam_window sigA_contDiff_one P hP
  obtain ⟨-, hψc, hψ8, hψ0, hψtr⟩ := rfp_psi_window P hP hbc hb01 hbsupp hblow hΛaff
  obtain ⟨hA0int, hmass⟩ := rfp_low_mass P hP hΛc hΛenv
  have hθc : Continuous (rfpTh P) := by
    show Continuous (fun y => 1 - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60))
    exact continuous_const.sub (hσc.comp ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).div_const _))
  have hσ01 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ sigA y ∧ sigA y ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
    · have ha := Real.exp_pos (-1 / y ^ 2)
      have hb := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)
      constructor
      · positivity
      · rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]; linarith
  have hθ01 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ rfpTh P y ∧ rfpTh P y ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    have h := hσ01 ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60)
    show 0 ≤ 1 - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) ∧ 1 - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) ≤ 1
    constructor <;> linarith [h.1, h.2]
  have hwin := rfp_I_window_identity P hP hΛc hψc hθc hψ0 hA0int
  have hwc : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y)) := by
    fun_prop
  have hs6 := exp_param_interval_integral (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60)
    (fun y : ℝ => Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y)) (rfpTh P) hwc hθc
  clear hψ0 hA0int hΛenv
  generalize rfpY4 P.Md P.lam = y4 at hwin hmass hs6
  generalize rfpY5 P.Md P.lam = y5 at hwin hmass hΛaff hψtr ⊢
  
  obtain ⟨A0, hA0def⟩ : ∃ A0 : ℝ, A0 = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp y4,
      Real.sqrt (2 * x) * Real.exp (rfpLam P (Real.log x)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨N5, hN5def⟩ : ∃ N5 : ℝ, N5 = Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * y5 + rfpLam P y5) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦdef⟩ : ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℝ, Φ = fun s => ∫ y in y4..y4 + 60,
      Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y) * Real.exp (-(rfpTh P y * s)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Φd, hΦddef⟩ : ∃ Φd : ℝ → ℝ, Φd = fun s => ∫ y in y4..y4 + 60,
      -(rfpTh P y) * (Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y) *
        Real.exp (-(rfpTh P y * s))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : ℝ → ℝ, u = fun s => Real.exp ((1 - P.lam) * s) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ → ℝ,
      v = fun s => rfpBmp (s + 3) - Real.exp (2 + 4 * P.lam) * rfpBmp (s + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨G, hGdef⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ → ℝ,
      G = fun c => ∫ s in (-4:ℝ)..0, u s * (Real.sqrt (1 + c * v s) - 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨δ, hδdef⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ → ℝ, δ = fun η =>
      ((1 - (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) * A0 + (Φ 0 - Φ (Real.log (1 + η ^ 2)))) / N5 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΦ_s : ∀ s, Φ s = ∫ y in y4..y4 + 60,
      Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y) * Real.exp (-(rfpTh P y * s)) :=
    fun s => by rw [hΦdef]
  have hΦd_s : ∀ s, Φd s = ∫ y in y4..y4 + 60,
      -(rfpTh P y) * (Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y) *
        Real.exp (-(rfpTh P y * s))) := fun s => by rw [hΦddef]
  have hu_s : ∀ s, u s = Real.exp ((1 - P.lam) * s) := fun s => by rw [hu]
  have hv_s : ∀ s, v s = rfpBmp (s + 3) - Real.exp (2 + 4 * P.lam) * rfpBmp (s + 1) :=
    fun s => by rw [hv]
  have hG_s : ∀ c, G c = ∫ s in (-4:ℝ)..0, u s * (Real.sqrt (1 + c * v s) - 1) :=
    fun c => by rw [hGdef]
  have hδ_s : ∀ η, δ η = ((1 - (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) * A0 + (Φ 0 - Φ (Real.log (1 + η ^ 2)))) / N5 :=
    fun η => by rw [hδdef]
  have hN5 : 0 < N5 := by rw [hN5def]; positivity
  have hN5ne : N5 ≠ 0 := hN5.ne'
  have hNδ : ∀ η, N5 * δ η = (1 - (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) * A0 + (Φ 0 - Φ (Real.log (1 + η ^ 2))) := by
    intro η; rw [hδ_s]; field_simp
  
  have huc : Continuous u := by rw [hu]; fun_prop
  have hvc : Continuous v := by rw [hv]; fun_prop
  have hvb : ∀ s, |v s| ≤ 8 := fun s => by rw [hv_s, ← hψtr s]; exact hψ8 _
  have hΦs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ := by rw [hΦdef]; exact hs6.1
  have hΦd : ∀ s, HasDerivAt Φ (Φd s) s := by
    intro s; rw [hΦdef, hΦddef]; exact hs6.2 s
  obtain ⟨hGs, hGd⟩ := sqrt_param_interval_integral (-4) 0 8 u v (by norm_num) huc hvc hvb
  
  have hy460 : y4 ≤ y4 + 60 := by linarith
  have hwpos : ∀ y, 0 < Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y) := fun y => by positivity
  have hint : ∀ s : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (fun y => Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y) *
      Real.exp (-(rfpTh P y * s))) volume y4 (y4 + 60) := fun s =>
    Continuous.intervalIntegrable (by fun_prop) _ _
  have hintd : ∀ s : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (fun y => -(rfpTh P y) * (Real.sqrt 2 *
      Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y) * Real.exp (-(rfpTh P y * s)))) volume y4 (y4 + 60) :=
    fun s => Continuous.intervalIntegrable (by fun_prop) _ _
  have hΦ0 : Φ 0 = ∫ y in y4..y4 + 60, Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y) := by
    rw [hΦ_s]; simp only [mul_zero, neg_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
  have hΦnn : ∀ s, 0 ≤ Φ s := fun s => by
    rw [hΦ_s]; exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hy460 (fun y _ => by positivity)
  have hΦle : ∀ s, 0 ≤ s → Φ s ≤ Φ 0 := by
    intro s hs
    rw [hΦ_s s, hΦ_s 0]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hy460 (hint s) (hint 0) (fun y _ => ?_)
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_) (hwpos y).le
    have := mul_nonneg (hθ01 y).1 hs
    linarith
  have hΦd_hi : ∀ s, 0 ≤ s → Φd s ≤ 0 := by
    intro s hs
    rw [hΦd_s]
    have hpt : ∀ y ∈ Icc y4 (y4 + 60), -(rfpTh P y) * (Real.sqrt 2 *
        Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y) * Real.exp (-(rfpTh P y * s))) ≤ 0 := by
      intro y _
      rw [neg_mul]
      exact neg_nonpos.mpr (mul_nonneg (hθ01 y).1 (by positivity))
    have h := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hy460 (hintd s)
      (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _) hpt
    rwa [intervalIntegral.integral_zero] at h
  have hΦd_lo : ∀ s, 0 ≤ s → -(Φ 0) ≤ Φd s := by
    intro s hs
    rw [hΦd_s, hΦ0, ← intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hy460 ?_ (hintd s) (fun y _ => ?_)
    · exact Continuous.intervalIntegrable (by fun_prop) _ _
    · have hθ := hθ01 y
      have hw := hwpos y
      have hep : 0 < Real.exp (-(rfpTh P y * s)) := Real.exp_pos _
      have he : Real.exp (-(rfpTh P y * s)) ≤ 1 :=
        Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith [mul_nonneg hθ.1 hs])
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he hw.le
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hθ.2 (mul_pos hw hep).le
      linarith
  have hA0nn : 0 ≤ A0 := by
    rw [hA0def]
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (fun x _ => by positivity)
  have hmass' : A0 + Φ 0 ≤ P.lam ^ 29 * N5 := by
    rw [hA0def, hΦ0, hN5def]; exact hmass
  
  have hfirst : ∀ η : ℝ, (∫ y in y4..y4 + 60, Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y) *
      ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y)) = Φ (Real.log (1 + η ^ 2)) := by
    intro η
    rw [hΦ_s]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro y _
    beta_reduce
    have hpos : (0:ℝ) < (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hpos, Real.log_inv,
      show -Real.log (1 + η ^ 2) * rfpTh P y = -(rfpTh P y * Real.log (1 + η ^ 2)) by ring]
  have hlast : ∀ c : ℝ, (∫ y in y5 - 4..y5, Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y) *
      Real.sqrt (1 + c * rfpPsi P y)) = N5 * ∫ s in (-4:ℝ)..0, u s * Real.sqrt (1 + c * v s) := by
    intro c
    have e1 : (∫ s in (-4:ℝ)..0, Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * (s + y5) + rfpLam P (s + y5)) *
        Real.sqrt (1 + c * rfpPsi P (s + y5))) = ∫ y in (-4:ℝ) + y5..0 + y5,
        Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y) * Real.sqrt (1 + c * rfpPsi P y) :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right (fun y => Real.sqrt 2 *
        Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y) * Real.sqrt (1 + c * rfpPsi P y)) y5
    rw [show (-4:ℝ) + y5 = y5 - 4 by ring, zero_add] at e1
    rw [← e1, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s hs
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (-4:ℝ) ≤ 0)] at hs
    beta_reduce
    have hΛs := hΛaff (s + y5) (by linarith [hs.1]) (by linarith [hs.2])
    have hexp : Real.exp (3 / 2 * (s + y5) + rfpLam P (s + y5)) =
        Real.exp (3 / 2 * y5 + rfpLam P y5) * Real.exp ((1 - P.lam) * s) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add, hΛs]; congr 1; ring
    have hψs : rfpPsi P (s + y5) = v s := by
      rw [show s + y5 = y5 + s from add_comm _ _, hψtr s, hv_s]
    rw [hexp, hψs, hN5def, hu_s]
    ring
  have hGK : ∀ c : ℝ, G c = (∫ s in (-4:ℝ)..0, u s * Real.sqrt (1 + c * v s)) -
      ∫ s in (-4:ℝ)..0, u s := by
    intro c
    have h1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => u s * Real.sqrt (1 + c * v s)) volume (-4) 0 :=
      Continuous.intervalIntegrable (by fun_prop) _ _
    have h2 : IntervalIntegrable u volume (-4) 0 := huc.intervalIntegrable _ _
    rw [hG_s, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub h1 h2]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s _
    beta_reduce
    ring
  
  have hκ7 : 7 ≤ Real.exp (2 + 4 * P.lam) := by
    have he1' := Real.exp_one_gt_d9
    have he2 : Real.exp 2 = Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
    have : Real.exp 2 ≤ Real.exp (2 + 4 * P.lam) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos 1]
  have hκ8 : Real.exp (2 + 4 * P.lam) ≤ 8 := by
    have he1 := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
    have he2 : Real.exp 2 = Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
    have hsplit : Real.exp (2 + 4 * P.lam) = Real.exp 2 * Real.exp (4 * P.lam) := Real.exp_add _ _
    have hm : Real.exp (4 * P.lam) * Real.exp (-(4 * P.lam)) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
    have hl := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(4 * P.lam))
    have hq : Real.exp (4 * P.lam) * (-(4 * P.lam) + 1) ≤ 1 := by
      have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl (Real.exp_pos (4 * P.lam)).le
      linarith
    have h4 : Real.exp (4 * P.lam) ≤ 25 / 24 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos (4 * P.lam)).le
        (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / 25 - 4 * P.lam)]
    have h2 : Real.exp 2 < 739 / 100 := by rw [he2]; nlinarith [Real.exp_pos 1]
    have h5 := mul_le_mul h2.le h4 (Real.exp_pos _).le (by norm_num)
    rw [hsplit]; linarith
  refine ⟨N5, G, δ, hN5, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hψ8, ?_⟩
  · rw [hGdef]; exact hGs
  · rw [hG_s]; simp
  · intro c h1 h2
    have hd : HasDerivAt G (∫ s in (-4:ℝ)..0, u s * v s / (2 * Real.sqrt (1 + c * v s))) c := by
      rw [hGdef]; exact hGd c (by linarith) (by linarith)
    rw [hd.deriv, hu, hv]
    exact bump_slope_bound rfpBmp P.lam (Real.exp (2 + 4 * P.lam)) c hbc hb01 hbsupp hblow
      hlam0 hlam1 hκ7 hκ8 (abs_le.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩)
  · have hsq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun e : ℝ => 1 + e ^ 2) := by fun_prop
    have hinvc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun e : ℝ => (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) := hsq.inv (fun e => by positivity)
    have hlogc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun e : ℝ => Real.log (1 + e ^ 2)) :=
      hsq.log (fun e => by positivity)
    have hΦJc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun e : ℝ => Φ (Real.log (1 + e ^ 2))) := hΦs.comp hlogc
    rw [hδdef]
    exact (((contDiff_const.sub hinvc).mul contDiff_const).add
      (contDiff_const.sub hΦJc)).div_const N5
  · rw [hδ_s]; simp
  · intro η
    have h1η : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + η ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg η]
    have hJ : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 + η ^ 2) := Real.log_nonneg h1η
    have hf1 : (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ h1η
    have hf0 : 0 < (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
    have hΦJ := hΦle _ hJ
    have hΦJ0 := hΦnn (Real.log (1 + η ^ 2))
    have hfA : 0 ≤ (1 - (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) * A0 := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hf1) hA0nn
    have hfA' : (1 - (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) * A0 ≤ A0 := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hf0.le hA0nn]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hδ_s]; exact div_nonneg (by linarith) hN5.le
    · rw [hδ_s, div_le_iff₀ hN5]; linarith
    · have hq : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => 1 + e ^ 2) (2 * η) η := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_pow 2 η).const_add 1
      have hq0 : (1 + η ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have hinvd := hq.inv hq0
      have hlogd := hq.log hq0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro q2 lam q1 q0 hlam0 hlam1 hq2a hq2b hq1s hq0s hb hd
  have hq2pos : 0 < q2 := by linarith
  
  have scal : ∀ a c : ℝ, |a| ≤ lam → -(27 / 100) ≤ c → c ≤ -(47 / 200) →
      0 < a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c ∧ 2 / 5 ≤ Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c) ∧
      9 / 10 ≤ (Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c) - a) / (2 * q2) ∧
      (Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c) - a) / (2 * q2) ≤ 6 / 5 := by
    intro a c ha hc1 hc2
    obtain ⟨ha1, ha2⟩ := abs_le.mp ha
    have hD : 0 < a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg a, mul_pos hq2pos (show 0 < -c by linarith)]
    have hlow : 9 / 5 * q2 + a ≤ Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c) := by
      have hsq : (9 / 5 * q2 + a) ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hq2pos.le (show 0 ≤ 13 / 50 - q2 by linarith),
          mul_nonneg hq2pos.le (show 0 ≤ 1 / 100 - a by linarith),
          mul_nonneg hq2pos.le (show 0 ≤ -(47 / 200) - c by linarith)]
      calc 9 / 5 * q2 + a = Real.sqrt ((9 / 5 * q2 + a) ^ 2) :=
            (Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)).symm
        _ ≤ Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq
    have hup : Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c) ≤ 12 / 5 * q2 + a := by
      have hsq : a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c ≤ (12 / 5 * q2 + a) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hq2pos.le (show 0 ≤ q2 - 47 / 200 by linarith),
          mul_nonneg hq2pos.le (show 0 ≤ a + 1 / 100 by linarith),
          mul_nonneg hq2pos.le (show 0 ≤ c + 27 / 100 by linarith)]
      calc Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c) ≤ Real.sqrt ((12 / 5 * q2 + a) ^ 2) :=
            Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq
        _ = 12 / 5 * q2 + a := Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)
    refine ⟨hD, by linarith, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]; linarith
    · rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]; linarith
  
  have dscal : ∀ a s d1 d0 : ℝ, 2 / 5 ≤ s → 0 ≤ (s - a) / (2 * q2) →
      (s - a) / (2 * q2) ≤ 6 / 5 → |d1| + |d0| ≤ lam →
      |((2 * a * d1 - 4 * q2 * d0) / (2 * s) - d1) / (2 * q2)| ≤ Real.sqrt lam := by
    intro a s d1 d0 hs hA0 hA1 hdd
    have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith
    have hsne : s ≠ 0 := hs0.ne'
    have hq2ne : q2 ≠ 0 := hq2pos.ne'
    have key : ((2 * a * d1 - 4 * q2 * d0) / (2 * s) - d1) / (2 * q2) * s =
        -(d1 * ((s - a) / (2 * q2)) + d0) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    set X := ((2 * a * d1 - 4 * q2 * d0) / (2 * s) - d1) / (2 * q2) with hX
    set A := (s - a) / (2 * q2) with hA
    have habs : |X| * s = |d1 * A + d0| := by
      rw [← abs_of_pos hs0, ← abs_mul, key, abs_neg]
    have htri : |d1 * A + d0| ≤ |d1| * A + |d0| := by
      have := abs_add_le (d1 * A) d0
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hA0] at this
      exact this
    have h1 : |X| * s ≤ 6 / 5 * lam := by
      rw [habs]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg d1) (sub_nonneg.2 hA1), abs_nonneg d0]
    have h2 : |X| ≤ 3 * lam := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (abs_nonneg X)]
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt lam := Real.sqrt_nonneg lam
    have hr2 : Real.sqrt lam ^ 2 = lam := Real.sq_sqrt hlam0.le
    have hr1 : Real.sqrt lam ≤ 1 / 10 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨fun η => (Real.sqrt (q1 η ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 η) - q1 η) / (2 * q2), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hDs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => q1 η ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 η) (Ioo (-2) 2) :=
      (hq1s.contDiffOn.pow 2).sub (contDiffOn_const.mul hq0s)
    have hDne : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (-2 : ℝ) 2, q1 x ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 x ≠ 0 := fun x hx =>
      (scal _ _ (hb x hx.1 hx.2).1 (hb x hx.1 hx.2).2.1 (hb x hx.1 hx.2).2.2).1.ne'
    exact ((hDs.sqrt hDne).sub hq1s.contDiffOn).div_const _
  · intro η h1 h2
    obtain ⟨hD, -, -, -⟩ := scal _ _ (hb η h1 h2).1 (hb η h1 h2).2.1 (hb η h1 h2).2.2
    have hs2 := Real.sq_sqrt hD.le
    have hq2ne : q2 ≠ 0 := hq2pos.ne'
    have e : q2 * ((Real.sqrt (q1 η ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 η) - q1 η) / (2 * q2)) ^ 2 +
        q1 η * ((Real.sqrt (q1 η ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 η) - q1 η) / (2 * q2)) + q0 η =
        (Real.sqrt (q1 η ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 η) ^ 2 - (q1 η ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 η)) / (4 * q2) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    show q2 * ((Real.sqrt (q1 η ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 η) - q1 η) / (2 * q2)) ^ 2 +
        q1 η * ((Real.sqrt (q1 η ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 η) - q1 η) / (2 * q2)) + q0 η = 0
    rw [e, hs2, sub_self, zero_div]
  · intro η h1 h2
    have hη1 : -2 < η := by linarith
    have hη2 : η < 2 := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hDp, hs, hA1, hA2⟩ :=
      scal _ _ (hb η hη1 hη2).1 (hb η hη1 hη2).2.1 (hb η hη1 hη2).2.2
    refine ⟨hA1, hA2, ?_⟩
    have hmem : Ioo (-2 : ℝ) 2 ∈ nhds η := Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2
    have hd0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ q0 η := (hq0s.contDiffAt hmem).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hd1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ q1 η := hq1s.differentiable (by simp) η
    have hD' : HasDerivAt (fun x => q1 x ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 x)
        (2 * q1 η * deriv q1 η - 4 * q2 * deriv q0 η) η := by
      have := (hd1.hasDerivAt.mul hd1.hasDerivAt).sub (hd0.hasDerivAt.const_mul (4 * q2))
      rw [show (fun x => q1 x ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 x) = fun x => q1 x * q1 x - 4 * q2 * q0 x from
        funext fun x => by ring]
      convert this using 1
      ring
    have hA' : HasDerivAt (fun η => (Real.sqrt (q1 η ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 η) - q1 η) / (2 * q2))
        (((2 * q1 η * deriv q1 η - 4 * q2 * deriv q0 η) /
          (2 * Real.sqrt (q1 η ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 η)) - deriv q1 η) / (2 * q2)) η :=
      ((hD'.sqrt hDp.ne').sub hd1.hasDerivAt).div_const (2 * q2)
    rw [hA'.deriv]
    exact dscal _ _ _ _ hs (by linarith) hA2 (hd η h1 h2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hReg hClos x η hx hη1 hη2
  have hReg' := hReg
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl1, hh0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hReg'
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.lam) := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith)
  have hPst0 : 0 < P.Pst := lt_trans (Real.exp_pos _) hPst
  have hKz : ∀ y : ℝ, Real.exp P.Md ≤ y → rfpK P.Md y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have he1 : 1 < Real.exp P.Md := by rw [← Real.exp_zero]; exact Real.exp_lt_exp.2 hMd
    have hy0 : 0 < y := by linarith
    have hly : P.Md ≤ Real.log y := (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hy0).2 hy
    have hq : 1 ≤ Real.log y / P.Md := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hMd]; linarith
    unfold rfpK sigA
    rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hq]
    ring
  
  have hUz : ∀ s e : ℝ, Real.exp (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam - 1 / 2) < s → rfpU P s e = 0 := by
    intro s e hs
    have hs0 : 0 < s := lt_trans (Real.exp_pos _) hs
    have hy : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam - 1 / 2 < Real.log s := (Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt hs0).2 hs
    have hy4 : Real.exp P.Md + 11 + 1 + 60 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) + 13 / P.lam - 1 / 2 < Real.log s := hy
    have hy3 : rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 13 / P.lam - 1 / 2 < Real.log s := hy
    have h13 : 0 < 13 / P.lam := by positivity
    have hK : rfpK P.Md (Real.log s) = 0 := hKz (Real.log s) (by linarith)
    have hR0 : rfpR0 (P.lam * (Real.log s - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) = 0 := by
      have hξ : 11 ≤ P.lam * (Real.log s - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) := by
        have h1 : 13 / P.lam - 1 / 2 < Real.log s - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam := by linarith
        have h2 : P.lam * (13 / P.lam - 1 / 2) ≤ P.lam * (Real.log s - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1.le hl0.le
        have h3 : P.lam * (13 / P.lam - 1 / 2) = 13 - P.lam / 2 := by
          field_simp
        linarith
      unfold rfpR0
      have hs1 : sigA (P.lam * (Real.log s - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) - 10) = 1 := by
        unfold sigA
        rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos (by linarith)]
      rw [hs1]; ring
    have hBm : ∀ c : ℝ, 1 ≤ c → rfpBmp (Real.log s - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + c) = 0 := by
      intro c hc
      unfold rfpBmp
      have hs2 : sigA (1 - (Real.log s - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + c) / (3 / 20)) = 0 := by
        unfold sigA
        rw [if_pos (by linarith)]
      rw [hs2, mul_zero]
    unfold rfpU rfpRb
    rw [hK, hR0, hBm 3 (by norm_num), hBm 1 (by norm_num)]
    ring
  have hxv0 : 0 < rfpXv P := Real.exp_pos _
  have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hxv0 hx
  have hlt : Real.exp (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam - 1 / 2) < rfpXv P := Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (by linarith)
  have hltx : Real.exp (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam - 1 / 2) < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hlt hx
  have hUv : ∀ s e, rfpXv P < s → rfpU P s e = 0 := fun s e hs => hUz s e (lt_trans hlt hs)
  have hUx : ∀ s e, x < s → rfpU P s e = 0 := fun s e hs => hUz s e (lt_trans hltx hs)
  
  have hderU : deriv (fun Y => rfpU P Y η) x = 0 := by
    have hev : (fun Y => rfpU P Y η) =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hltx] with Y hY
      exact hUz Y η hY
    rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
  have hB : shearB (rfpF P) (rfpU P) x η = 0 := by
    unfold shearB; rw [hderU]; simp
  
  obtain ⟨hFs, hUs, -, hW, hInt⟩ := rfp_profile_regular P hReg hClos
  have hClM := hClos.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  have hM : ∀ e, -1 < e → e < 1 → profRadInt (rfpU P) x e = 0 := by
    intro e he1 he2
    have hz : ∀ s ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) x \ Ioc 0 (rfpXv P), rfpU P s e = 0 := fun s hs =>
      hUv s e (not_le.1 (fun h => hs.2 ⟨hs.1.1, h⟩))
    unfold profRadInt
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hx0.le,
      setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioc (Ioc_subset_Ioc_right hx) hz,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hxv0.le]
    exact (hClM e he1 he2).1
  have hJ : ∀ e, -1 < e → e < 1 →
      profRadInt (fun s e => rfpU P s e * (2 * s * rfpF P s e)) x e = 0 := by
    intro e he1 he2
    have hz : ∀ s ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) \ Ioc 0 x, rfpU P s e * (2 * s * rfpF P s e) = 0 := by
      intro s hs
      rw [hUx s e (not_le.1 (fun h => hs.2 ⟨hs.1, h⟩)), zero_mul]
    unfold profRadInt
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hx0.le,
      ← setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi Ioc_subset_Ioi_self hz]
    exact (hClM e he1 he2).2.1
  have hS : ∀ e, -1 < e → e < 1 →
      profRadInt (fun s e => rfpU P s e ^ 2 - s * rfpF P s e ^ 2) x e = rfpExtS P x e := by

        (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..x, (rfpU P s e ^ 2 - s * rfpF P s e ^ 2)) +
          ∫ s in Ioi x, (rfpU P s e ^ 2 - s * rfpF P s e ^ 2) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hx0.le, ← Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hx0.le]
      exact setIntegral_union (Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same) measurableSet_Ioi
        (hI.mono_set (by rw [← Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hx0.le]; exact subset_union_left))
        (hI.mono_set (by rw [← Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hx0.le]; exact subset_union_right))
    have htail : (∫ s in Ioi x, (rfpU P s e ^ 2 - s * rfpF P s e ^ 2)) = -rfpExtS P x e := by
      unfold rfpExtS
      rw [← integral_neg]
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun s hs => ?_)
      show rfpU P s e ^ 2 - s * rfpF P s e ^ 2 = -(s * rfpF P s e ^ 2)
      rw [hUx s e hs]; ring
    have h0 := (hClM e he1 he2).2.2.1
    unfold profRadInt
    linarith
  have hAvg : ∀ e, profRadAvg (rfpU P) x e = x⁻¹ * profRadInt (rfpU P) x e := by
    intro e
    have h := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right (fun t => rfpU P t e) hx0.ne' (a := 0) (b := 1)
    simp only [zero_mul, one_mul, smul_eq_mul] at h

  have hend : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → φ e = 0) →
      deriv φ η = 0 ∧ (ContinuousAt φ η → φ η = 0) := by

    obtain ⟨L, hLne, hLle, hLev⟩ : ∃ L : Filter ℝ, L.NeBot ∧ L ≤ nhdsWithin η {η}ᶜ ∧

      · refine ⟨nhdsWithin η (Ioi η), inferInstance, nhdsGT_le_nhdsNE η, ?_⟩
        filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (show η < 1 by linarith)] with e he
        exact hφ e (by rw [h]; exact he.1) he.2
      · refine ⟨nhdsWithin η (Iio η), inferInstance, nhdsLT_le_nhdsNE η, ?_⟩
        filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsLT h] with e he
        exact hφ e he.1 (by linarith [he.2])
    have hval : ContinuousAt φ η → φ η = 0 := by
      intro hc
      have t1 : Filter.Tendsto φ L (nhds (φ η)) := hc.tendsto.mono_left (hLle.trans nhdsWithin_le_nhds)
      have t2 : Filter.Tendsto φ L (nhds 0) := tendsto_const_nhds.congr' (hLev.mono fun e he => he.symm)
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique t1 t2
    refine ⟨?_, hval⟩
    by_cases hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ η
    · have h0 := hval hd.continuousAt
      have t1 := (hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope.mp hd.hasDerivAt).mono_left hLle
      have t2 : Filter.Tendsto (slope φ η) L (nhds 0) := by
        refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
        filter_upwards [hLev] with e he
        simp [slope_def_field, he, h0]
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique t1 t2
    · exact deriv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hd
  
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hW 0
  simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero] at hC
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hC 1 0 one_pos (by norm_num)).2
  have hUb : ∀ s e, 0 < s → |e| ≤ 3 / 2 → |rfpU P s e| ≤ C := fun s e hs he => (hC s e hs he).2
  have hFb : ∀ s e, 0 < s → |e| ≤ 3 / 2 → |rfpF P s e| ≤ C * s ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) := by

      Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by linarith) (by linarith)
    calc |rfpF P s e| ≤ C * s ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + s) ^ (-(3 / 5 + P.h)) := (hC s e hs he).1
      _ ≤ C * s ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * 1 :=
