    have h1 : (1 + s) ^ (-(3 / 5 + P.h)) ≤ s ^ (-(3 / 5 + P.h)) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hs (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have h2 : s ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * s ^ (-(3 / 5 + P.h)) = s ^ (-1 - P.h) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hs]; congr 1; ring
    calc |rfpF P s e| ≤ C * s ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + s) ^ (-(3 / 5 + P.h)) := (hC s e hs he).1
      _ ≤ C * s ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * s ^ (-(3 / 5 + P.h)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (mul_nonneg hC0 (Real.rpow_nonneg hs.le _))
      _ = C * s ^ (-1 - P.h) := by rw [mul_assoc, h2]
  have hUc : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => rfpU P p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) := hUs.continuousOn
  have hFc : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => rfpF P p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) := hFs.continuousOn
  have hpt : ∀ (G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => G p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) →
      ∀ s, 0 < s → ContinuousAt (fun e => G s e) η := fun G hG s hs =>
    (hG.continuousAt (prod_mem_nhds (Ioi_mem_nhds hs) (Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith)))).comp
      (f := fun e : ℝ => (s, e)) (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousAt
  have hsl : ∀ (G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => G p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) →
      ∀ e, -2 < e → e < 2 → ContinuousOn (fun s => G s e) (Ioi 0) := fun G hG e h1 h2 =>
    hG.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn (fun s hs => ⟨hs, h1, h2⟩)
  have hcont : ∀ (G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (Bd : ℝ),
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => G p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) →
      (∀ s e : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ x → |e| ≤ 3 / 2 → |G s e| ≤ Bd) →
      ContinuousAt (fun e => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..x, G s e) η := by
    intro G Bd hG hBd
    apply intervalIntegral.continuousAt_of_dominated_interval (bound := fun _ => Bd)
    · filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds (show -2 < η by linarith) (show η < 2 by linarith)] with e he
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hx0.le]
      exact ((hsl G hG e he.1 he.2).mono Ioc_subset_Ioi_self).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioc
    · filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds (show -3 / 2 < η by linarith) (show η < 3 / 2 by linarith)] with e he
      refine ae_of_all _ (fun s hs => ?_)
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hx0.le] at hs
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact hBd s e hs.1 hs.2 (abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith [he.1], by linarith [he.2]⟩)
    · exact intervalIntegrable_const
    · refine ae_of_all _ (fun s hs => ?_)
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hx0.le] at hs
      exact hpt G hG s hs.1
  have hcM : ContinuousAt (fun e => profRadInt (rfpU P) x e) η :=
    hcont (rfpU P) C hUc (fun s e hs _ he => hUb s e hs he)
  have hcJ : ContinuousAt (fun e => profRadInt (fun s e => rfpU P s e * (2 * s * rfpF P s e)) x e) η := by
    refine hcont (fun s e => rfpU P s e * (2 * s * rfpF P s e)) (2 * C ^ 2 * x ^ (3 / 5 : ℝ))
      (hUc.mul ((continuousOn_const.mul continuousOn_fst).mul hFc)) ?_
    intro s e hs hsx he
    have hU := hUb s e hs he
    have hF := hFb s e hs he
    have e35 : s ^ (1:ℝ) * s ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) = s ^ (3 / 5 : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hs]; norm_num
    rw [Real.rpow_one] at e35
    have h3 : s ^ (3 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ x ^ (3 / 5 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow hs.le hsx (by norm_num)
    have h1 : |rfpU P s e * (2 * s * rfpF P s e)| ≤ C * (2 * s * (C * s ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)))) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_two, abs_of_pos hs]
      exact mul_le_mul hU (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hF (by linarith))
        (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (abs_nonneg _)) hC0
    calc |rfpU P s e * (2 * s * rfpF P s e)| ≤ C * (2 * s * (C * s ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)))) := h1
      _ = 2 * C ^ 2 * (s * s ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ))) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 * C ^ 2 * x ^ (3 / 5 : ℝ) := by
          rw [e35]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (by positivity)
  have hcS0 : ContinuousAt
      (fun e => profRadInt (fun s e => rfpU P s e ^ 2 - s * rfpF P s e ^ 2) x e) η := by
    refine hcont (fun s e => rfpU P s e ^ 2 - s * rfpF P s e ^ 2) (C ^ 2 + C ^ 2 * x ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ))
      ((hUc.pow 2).sub (continuousOn_fst.mul (hFc.pow 2))) ?_
    intro s e hs hsx he
    have hU := hUb s e hs he
    have hF := hFb s e hs he
    have hU2 : rfpU P s e ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hU 2
    have hF2 : rfpF P s e ^ 2 ≤ (C * s ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ))) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hF 2
    have e15 : s ^ (1:ℝ) * s ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * s ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) = s ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hs, ← Real.rpow_add hs]; norm_num
    rw [Real.rpow_one] at e15
    have h4 : s * rfpF P s e ^ 2 ≤ s * (C * s ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ))) ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hF2 hs.le
    have h5 : s * (C * s ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ))) ^ 2 = C ^ 2 * s ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := by rw [← e15]; ring
    have h6 : s ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ x ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow hs.le hsx (by norm_num)
    have h7 : C ^ 2 * s ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ C ^ 2 * x ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h6 (sq_nonneg C)
    have h8 : 0 ≤ s * rfpF P s e ^ 2 := mul_nonneg hs.le (sq_nonneg _)
    have h9 : 0 ≤ rfpU P s e ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    have h10 : 0 ≤ C ^ 2 * x ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg C) (Real.rpow_nonneg hx0.le _)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  have hcSt : ContinuousAt (fun e => rfpExtS P x e) η := by
    show ContinuousAt (fun e => ∫ s in Ioi x, s * rfpF P s e ^ 2) η
    apply continuousAt_of_dominated (bound := fun s => C ^ 2 * s ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h))
    · filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds (show -2 < η by linarith) (show η < 2 by linarith)] with e he
      have hc : ContinuousOn (fun s => s * rfpF P s e ^ 2) (Ioi x) :=
        (continuousOn_id.mul ((hsl (rfpF P) hFc e he.1 he.2).pow 2)).mono
          (Ioi_subset_Ioi hx0.le)
      exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi
    · filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds (show -3 / 2 < η by linarith) (show η < 3 / 2 by linarith)] with e he
      refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).2 (ae_of_all _ (fun s hs => ?_))
      have hs0 : 0 < s := lt_trans hx0 hs
      have hF := hFt s e hs0 (abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith [he.1], by linarith [he.2]⟩)
      have hF2 : rfpF P s e ^ 2 ≤ (C * s ^ (-1 - P.h)) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hF 2
      have e1 : s ^ (1:ℝ) * s ^ (-1 - P.h) * s ^ (-1 - P.h) = s ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hs0, ← Real.rpow_add hs0]; congr 1; ring
      rw [Real.rpow_one] at e1
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hs0.le (sq_nonneg _))]
      calc s * rfpF P s e ^ 2 ≤ s * (C * s ^ (-1 - P.h)) ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hF2 hs0.le
        _ = C ^ 2 * s ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h) := by rw [← e1]; ring
    · exact (integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) hx0).const_mul _
    · refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).2 (ae_of_all _ (fun s hs => ?_))
      exact continuousAt_const.mul ((hpt (rfpF P) hFc s (lt_trans hx0 hs)).pow 2)
  
  have hMv : profRadInt (rfpU P) x η = 0 := (hend (fun e => profRadInt (rfpU P) x e) hM).2 hcM
  have hMd : profEtaD (profRadInt (rfpU P)) x η = 0 :=
    (hend (fun e => profRadInt (rfpU P) x e) hM).1
  have hJv : profRadInt (fun s e => rfpU P s e * (2 * s * rfpF P s e)) x η = 0 :=
    (hend (fun e => profRadInt (fun s e => rfpU P s e * (2 * s * rfpF P s e)) x e) hJ).2 hcJ
  have hJd : profEtaD (profRadInt (fun s e => rfpU P s e * (2 * s * rfpF P s e))) x η = 0 :=
    (hend (fun e => profRadInt (fun s e => rfpU P s e * (2 * s * rfpF P s e)) x e) hJ).1
  have hS0v : profRadInt (fun s e => rfpU P s e ^ 2 - s * rfpF P s e ^ 2) x η = rfpExtS P x η := by
    have h := (hend (fun e => profRadInt (fun s e => rfpU P s e ^ 2 - s * rfpF P s e ^ 2) x e
      - rfpExtS P x e) (fun e h1 h2 => by simp only [hS e h1 h2, sub_self])).2 (hcS0.sub hcSt)
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 h
  have hSd : (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun s e => rfpU P s e ^ 2 - s * rfpF P s e ^ 2)) x η =
      (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (rfpExtS P) x η := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hη1 with h1 | h1
    · rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hη2 with h2 | h2
      · congr 1
        unfold profEtaD
        apply Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq
        filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2] with e he
        exact hS e he.1 he.2
      · rw [h2]; ring
    · rw [← h1]; ring
  have hAv : profRadAvg (rfpU P) x η = 0 := by rw [hAvg, hMv, mul_zero]
  have hAd : profEtaD (profRadAvg (rfpU P)) x η = 0 :=
    (hend (fun e => profRadAvg (rfpU P) x e) (fun e h1 h2 => by rw [hAvg, hM e h1 h2, mul_zero])).1
  have hW1 : leadW P.h (rfpU P) x η = 1 := by
    unfold leadW
    rw [hAv, hAd]; ring
  refine ⟨hB, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold leadQs rfpExtQ
    rw [hW1, hJv, hJd]
    ring
  · unfold leadNs rfpExtN
    rw [hW1, hUz x η hltx, hMv, hMd, hSd, hS0v]
    ring

subgoal_signatures.name: rfp_profile_regular
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → RfpClos P → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(rfpF P)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(rfpU P)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) ∧ (∀ x₀ x₁ : ℝ, 0 < x₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, x₀ ≤ x → x ≤ x₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(rfpF P)) (x, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(rfpU P)) (x, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → |η| ≤ 3 / 2 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => rfpF P x e) η| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + P.h)) ∧ |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => rfpU P x e) η| ≤ C) ∧ (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → IntegrableOn (fun x => rfpU P x η * (2 * x * rfpF P x η)) (Ioi 0) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => rfpU P x η ^ 2 - x * rfpF P x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => 2 * x * rfpF P x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * rfpCi P * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + P.h))) (Ioi 0) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => rfpF P x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable (fun x => rfpU P x η) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * rfpF P x η) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => rfpU P x η * (2 * x * rfpF P x η)) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => rfpU P x η ^ 2 - x * rfpF P x η ^ 2) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => rfpF P x η ^ 2) volume 0 X)

by
  refine ⟨1, one_pos, fun Md _ => ⟨0, fun Pst _ => ⟨min (1 / 100) (3 / (8 * max Pst 1)),

  intro P hPMd hPPst hPlam _ hReg hClos x η hx1 hx2 h1 h2

  have eY4 : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam = rfpY2 P.Md + 1 + 60 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) + 13 / P.lam := by

  have hslope := fun v (hv1 : rfpY2 P.Md + 1 ≤ v) (hv2 : v ≤ rfpY6 P) =>

  have hFd : HasDerivAt (fun Y => rfpF P Y η)

  have key : ∀ x s E D : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < s → 0 < E → s ^ 2 = 2 * x →

  have ha : shearA (rfpF P) x η =

  have hDE1 : 2 * deriv (fun v => rfpE P v η) (Real.log x) / rfpE P (Real.log x) η ≤ -(1 + 2 * P.h) := by

  have hsl10 : ∀ v : ℝ, rfpY2 P.Md + 1 ≤ v → v ≤ rfpY6 P →

        Real.sqrt (2 * X) ^ 2 := by

  have hdU : deriv (fun Y => U Y η) X = η * (deriv k (Real.log X) * X⁻¹) := by
    rw [hUe.deriv_eq]; exact hV.deriv
  have hFX := (hform X η hX hXX1).2
  have hUX := (hform X η hX hXX1).1
  have hpart1 : shearA F X η = 1 - 2 * deriv c (Real.log X) / c (Real.log X) := by
    unfold shearA
    rw [hdF, hFX]
    generalize Real.sqrt (2 * X) = s at *
    generalize c (Real.log X) = cy at *
    generalize deriv c (Real.log X) = dc at *
    have hX' : X = s * s / 2 := by linarith
    subst hX'
    have hf : (0:ℝ) < 1 + η ^ 2 := by positivity
    field_simp
    ring
  have hpart2 : shearB F U X η = 2 * η * deriv k (Real.log X) * (1 + η ^ 2) / c (Real.log X) := by
    unfold shearB
    rw [hdU, hFX]
    generalize Real.sqrt (2 * X) = s at *
    generalize c (Real.log X) = cy at *
    generalize deriv k (Real.log X) = dk at *
    have hX' : X = s * s / 2 := by linarith
    subst hX'
    have hf : (0:ℝ) < 1 + η ^ 2 := by positivity
    field_simp
  
  
  
  have hcongr : ∀ (g1 g2 : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ x, 0 < x → x < X1 → x ≤ X → g1 x = g2 x) →
      ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, g1 x = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, g2 x := by
    intro g1 g2 H
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx => ?_)
    rw [uIoc_of_le hX.le] at hx
    exact H x hx.1 (lt_of_le_of_lt hx.2 hXX1) hx.2
  have hsx : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * x) := fun x hx => Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by linarith)
  have hssx : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → Real.sqrt (2 * x) * Real.sqrt (2 * x) = 2 * x :=
    fun x hx => Real.mul_self_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hm1 : ∀ e : ℝ, profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) X e =
      (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * rinMom (fun x => Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x)) X := by
    intro e
    unfold profRadInt rinMom
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    apply hcongr
    intro x hx0 hx1 _
    beta_reduce
    rw [(hform x e hx0 hx1).2, alg1 x _ _ (hsx x hx0) (hssx x hx0)]
    ring
  have hm2 : ∀ e : ℝ, profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) X e =
      e * (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x) * (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x))) X := by
    intro e
    unfold profRadInt rinMom
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    apply hcongr
    intro x hx0 hx1 _
    beta_reduce
    rw [(hform x e hx0 hx1).2, (hform x e hx0 hx1).1, alg1 x _ _ (hsx x hx0) (hssx x hx0)]
    ring
  have hm3 : ∀ e : ℝ, profRadInt U X e = e * rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x)) X := by
    intro e
    unfold profRadInt rinMom
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    apply hcongr
    intro x hx0 hx1 _
    rw [(hform x e hx0 hx1).1]
  have hIk : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => k (Real.log x) ^ 2) volume 0 X := by
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hX.le]
    refine Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded (M := M ^ 2) measure_Ioc_lt_top.ne
      ((hk.continuous.measurable.comp Real.measurable_log).pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioc (fun x hx => ?_)
    have hl : Real.log x ≤ Real.log X1 := Real.log_le_log hx.1 (le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt hx.2 hXX1))
    have h1 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hM _ hl).2 2
    rw [sq_abs] at h1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    exact h1
  have hIc : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => c (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2) volume 0 X := by
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hX.le]
    refine Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded (M := M ^ 2) measure_Ioc_lt_top.ne
      (((hc.continuous.measurable.comp Real.measurable_log).pow_const 2).div_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioc (fun x hx => ?_)
    have hl : Real.log x ≤ Real.log X1 := Real.log_le_log hx.1 (le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt hx.2 hXX1))
    have h1 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hM _ hl).1 2
    rw [sq_abs] at h1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (c (Real.log x))]
  have hm4 : ∀ e : ℝ, profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) X e =
      e ^ 2 * rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x) ^ 2) X
        - ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * rinMom (fun x => c (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2) X := by
    intro e
    unfold profRadInt rinMom
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hIk.const_mul _) (hIc.const_mul _)]
    apply hcongr
    intro x hx0 hx1 _
    beta_reduce
    rw [(hform x e hx0 hx1).2, (hform x e hx0 hx1).1, alg2 x _ _ (hsx x hx0) (hssx x hx0)]
    ring
  have hm5 : ∀ e : ℝ, profRadAvg U X e = e * (rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x)) X / X) := by
    intro e
    unfold profRadAvg rinMom
    have h1 : ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, U (s * X) e = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, e * k (Real.log (s * X)) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s hs => ?_)
      rw [uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at hs
      have hs0 : 0 < s * X := mul_pos hs.1 hX
      have hs1 : s * X ≤ X := mul_le_of_le_one_left hX.le hs.2
      exact (hform (s * X) e hs0 (lt_of_le_of_lt hs1 hXX1)).1
    rw [h1, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right (fun x => k (Real.log x)) hX.ne']
    simp only [zero_mul, one_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  
  
  
  have hq : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => 1 + e ^ 2) (2 * η) η := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_pow 2 η).const_add 1
  have hqpos : (0:ℝ) < 1 + η ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hinv : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) (-(2 * η) / (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2) η :=
    hq.inv hqpos.ne'
  have hd1 : profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) X η =
      -(2 * η) / (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2 * rinMom (fun x => Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x)) X := by
    unfold profEtaD
    rw [show (fun e => profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) X e) = _ from funext hm1]
    exact (hinv.mul_const _).deriv
  have hd2 : profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))) X η =
      (1 * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ + η * (-(2 * η) / (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2)) *
        rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x) * (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x))) X := by
    unfold profEtaD
    rw [show (fun e => profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) X e) = _ from funext hm2]
    exact (((hasDerivAt_id' η).mul hinv).mul_const _).deriv
  have hd3 : profEtaD (profRadInt U) X η = 1 * rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x)) X := by
    unfold profEtaD
    rw [show (fun e => profRadInt U X e) = _ from funext hm3]
    exact ((hasDerivAt_id' η).mul_const _).deriv
  have hd4 : profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)) X η =
      2 * η * rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x) ^ 2) X
        - 2 * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (-(2 * η) / (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2) * rinMom (fun x => c (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2) X := by
    unfold profEtaD
    rw [show (fun e => profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) X e) = _ from funext hm4]
    have hp : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => e ^ 2) (2 * η) η := by simpa using hasDerivAt_pow 2 η
    have hp2 : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2)
        (2 * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (-(2 * η) / (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2)) η := by
      convert hinv.pow 2 using 1 <;> first | rfl | norm_num
    exact ((hp.mul_const _).sub (hp2.mul_const _)).deriv
  have hd5 : profEtaD (profRadAvg U) X η = 1 * (rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x)) X / X) := by
    unfold profEtaD
    rw [show (fun e => profRadAvg U X e) = _ from funext hm5]
    exact ((hasDerivAt_id' η).mul_const _).deriv
  
  
  
  have h2XF : X * (2 * X * F X η) = X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * (c (Real.log X) * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹)) := by
    rw [hFX, alg1 X _ _ hsX hssX]
  refine ⟨hpart1, hpart2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold leadQs leadW rinQf
    rw [h2XF, hm1, hm2, hm5, hd1, hd2, hd5]
    generalize rinMom (fun x => Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x)) X = I0
    generalize rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x) * (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x))) X = J0
    generalize rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x)) X = M0
    generalize Real.sqrt (2 * X) = s at *
    generalize c (Real.log X) = cy at *
    field_simp
    ring
  · unfold leadNs leadW rinNf
    rw [hm3, hm4, hm5, hd3, hd4, hd5, hUX]
    generalize rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x) ^ 2) X = S1
    generalize rinMom (fun x => c (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2) X = S2
    generalize rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x)) X = M0
    generalize leadPi F X η = P0
    generalize profEtaD (leadPi F) X η = P1
    field_simp
    ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → RfpClos P → ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 2) → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |leadPi (rfpF P) x η| ≤ (1 / 2) * ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) ∧ |profEtaD (leadPi (rfpF P)) x η| ≤ 2 * |η| * ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v)

signature.name: rfp_pressure_bound
signature.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → RfpClos P → ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 2) → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |leadPi (rfpF P) x η| ≤ (1 / 2) * ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) ∧ |profEtaD (leadPi (rfpF P)) x η| ≤ 2 * |η| * ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hR hC x η hx hxle h1 h2
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl1, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hR
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, hca, -, -⟩ := hC
  
  obtain ⟨q, hq_def⟩ : ∃ q : ℝ → ℝ, q = fun y => expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hqC : Continuous q := by
    rw [hq_def]
    exact (expNegInvGlue.contDiff (n := 0)).continuous.comp (continuous_id.mul continuous_abs)
  have qpos_arg : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → 0 < y * |y| := fun y hy => by
    rw [abs_of_pos hy]; exact mul_pos hy hy
  have qa : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → q y = 0 := fun y hy => by
    rw [hq_def]
    exact expNegInvGlue.zero_of_nonpos (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hy (abs_nonneg y))
  have qb : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → 0 < q y := fun y hy => by
    rw [hq_def]
    exact expNegInvGlue.pos_of_pos (qpos_arg y hy)
  have qc : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ q y := fun y => by
    rw [hq_def]
    exact expNegInvGlue.nonneg _
  have qd : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → q y = Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hq_def]
    show expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) = _
    rw [expNegInvGlue, if_neg (not_le.mpr (qpos_arg y hy)), abs_of_pos hy]
    congr 1
    rw [neg_div, one_div, sq]
  have hDpos : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < q y + q (1 - y) := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : 0 < y
    · exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (qb y hy) (qc _)
    · exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (qc y) (qb _ (by linarith [not_lt.mp hy]))
  have heq : sigA = fun y => q y / (q y + q (1 - y)) := by
    funext y
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs with hh1 hh2
    · rw [qa y hh1, zero_div]
    · have hy : 0 < y := not_le.mp hh1
      rw [qa (1 - y) (by linarith), add_zero, div_self (qb y hy).ne']
    · have hy : 0 < y := not_le.mp hh1
      rw [qd y hy, qd (1 - y) (by linarith [not_le.mp hh2])]
  have sigC : Continuous sigA := by
    rw [heq]
    exact hqC.div (hqC.add (hqC.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)))
      (fun y => (hDpos y).ne')
  have sig0 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → sigA y = 0 := fun y hy => by unfold sigA; simp [hy]
  have sig1 : ∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → sigA y = 1 := fun y hy => by
    unfold sigA; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hy]
  have sigNN : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA y := fun y => by
    rw [heq]
    show 0 ≤ q y / (q y + q (1 - y))
    exact div_nonneg (qc y) (hDpos y).le
  have sigLe1 : ∀ y : ℝ, sigA y ≤ 1 := fun y => by
    rw [heq]
    show q y / (q y + q (1 - y)) ≤ 1
    rw [div_le_one (hDpos y)]; linarith [qc (1 - y)]
  
  have bmpC : Continuous rfpBmp := by
    have e : rfpBmp = fun t => sigA (1 + t / (3 / 20)) * sigA (1 - t / (3 / 20)) := rfl
    rw [e]
    exact (sigC.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.div_const _))).mul
      (sigC.comp (continuous_const.sub (continuous_id.div_const _)))
  have bmp0 : ∀ t : ℝ, 3 / 20 ≤ |t| → rfpBmp t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpBmp
    rcases le_abs'.mp ht with h | h
    · have : t / (3 / 20) ≤ -1 := by rw [div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
      rw [sig0 (1 + t / (3 / 20)) (by linarith), zero_mul]
    · have : 1 ≤ t / (3 / 20) := by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
      rw [sig0 (1 - t / (3 / 20)) (by linarith), mul_zero]
  have bmp1 : rfpBmp 0 = 1 := by
    unfold rfpBmp
    rw [show (1 : ℝ) + 0 / (3 / 20) = 1 by norm_num, show (1 : ℝ) - 0 / (3 / 20) = 1 by norm_num,
      sig1 1 le_rfl]
    norm_num
  have bmpNN : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpBmp t := fun t => by
    unfold rfpBmp; exact mul_nonneg (sigNN _) (sigNN _)
  
  have hl2 : P.lam ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 10000 := by nlinarith
  have hρ1 : P.ρ < 1 := by linarith
  have SigC : Continuous rfpSigI := by
    have e : rfpSigI = fun t => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, sigA s := rfl
    rw [e]
    exact intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive (fun a b => sigC.intervalIntegrable a b) 0
  have tailC : Continuous (fun y => tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh))
      (Real.exp y) / (1 - P.ρ)) := by
    unfold tailFac
    have hlog : Continuous (fun y => Real.log (Real.exp y / Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh))) :=
      (Real.continuous_exp.div_const _).log
        (fun y => (div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (Real.exp_pos _)).ne')
    exact (continuous_const.sub (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub
      (sigC.comp ((hlog.add continuous_const).div_const _))))).div_const _
  have tailNZ : ∀ y : ℝ, tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh))
      (Real.exp y) / (1 - P.ρ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro y
    unfold tailFac
    have key : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → 0 < 1 - P.ρ * (1 - s) := fun s hs => by nlinarith
    exact div_ne_zero (key _ (sigNN _)).ne' (by linarith)
  have lamC : Continuous (rfpLam P) := by
    have e : rfpLam P = fun y => Real.log P.Pst + y / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y
        - P.lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 P.Md)
        - (1 - P.lam) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam)
        + (1 - P.h) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1)
        - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) * Real.log 2
        + Real.log (tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) / (1 - P.ρ)) :=
      rfl
    rw [e]
    refine Continuous.add ?_ (tailC.log tailNZ)
    refine Continuous.sub ?_ ((sigC.comp ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).div_const _)).mul
      continuous_const)
    refine Continuous.add ?_ (continuous_const.mul (SigC.comp
      (((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).sub continuous_const).sub continuous_const)))
    refine Continuous.sub ?_ (continuous_const.mul (SigC.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)))
    refine Continuous.sub ?_ (continuous_const.mul (SigC.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)))
    refine Continuous.sub ?_ (continuous_const.mul SigC)
    exact continuous_const.add (continuous_id.div_const _)
  have thC : Continuous (rfpTh P) := by
    have e : rfpTh P = fun y => 1 - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) := rfl
    rw [e]
    exact continuous_const.sub (sigC.comp ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).div_const _))
  have th01 : ∀ v : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpTh P v ∧ rfpTh P v ≤ 1 := fun v => by
    unfold rfpTh
    constructor <;> linarith [sigNN ((v - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60), sigLe1 ((v - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60)]
  
  have hL : 20 < 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := by
    have h2' : (2:ℝ) ≤ 1 / P.lam := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith
    have := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) h2'
    linarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
  have e3 : rfpY3 P.Md P.lam = rfpY2 P.Md + 1 + 60 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  have e4 : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam = rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 13 / P.lam := rfl
  have e5 : rfpY5 P.Md P.lam = rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  have h13 : 0 < 13 / P.lam := by positivity
  have hmarg : rfpY2 P.Md + 2 < rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 63 / 20 := by linarith
  have psiSupp : ∀ y : ℝ, rfpPsi P y ≠ 0 → rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 63 / 20 < y := by
    intro y hy
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    apply hy
    have h3 : 3 / 20 ≤ |y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3| := by
      rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith
    have h4 : 3 / 20 ≤ |y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1| := by
      rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith
    unfold rfpPsi
    rw [bmp0 _ h3, bmp0 _ h4]; ring
  have psiTh : ∀ y : ℝ, rfpPsi P y ≠ 0 → rfpTh P y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hy' := psiSupp y hy
    have hge : 1 ≤ (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60 := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
    unfold rfpTh
    rw [sig1 _ hge]; ring
  have psiZero : ∀ v : ℝ, v ≤ rfpY2 P.Md + 2 → rfpPsi P v = 0 := by
    intro v hv
    by_contra hne
    have := psiSupp v hne
    linarith
  
  have wC : Continuous (fun y => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y)) :=
    Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul lamC)
  have b1C : Continuous (fun y => rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3)) :=
    bmpC.comp ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).add continuous_const)
  have b2C : Continuous (fun y => rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)) :=
    bmpC.comp ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).add continuous_const)
  have b1S : HasCompactSupport (fun y => rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3)) := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro
      (isCompact_Icc (a := rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 63 / 20) (b := rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 57 / 20)) ?_
    intro y hy
    apply bmp0
    rw [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at hy
    rcases hy with hy | hy
    · rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith
    · rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith
  have b2S : HasCompactSupport (fun y => rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)) := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro
      (isCompact_Icc (a := rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 23 / 20) (b := rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 17 / 20)) ?_
    intro y hy
    apply bmp0
    rw [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at hy
    rcases hy with hy | hy
    · rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith
    · rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith
  have g1I : Integrable (fun y => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3)) :=
    (wC.mul b1C).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport b1S.mul_left
  have g2I : Integrable (fun y => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)) :=
    (wC.mul b2C).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport b2S.mul_left
  have Bpos : 0 < ∫ y, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1) := by
    refine Continuous.integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
      (x := rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1) (wC.mul b2C) b2S.mul_left ?_ ?_
    · intro y
      exact mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (bmpNN _)
    · show Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1)) *
        rfpBmp (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1) ≠ 0
      rw [show rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 = 0 by ring, bmp1, mul_one]
      exact (Real.exp_pos _).ne'
  have Heq : (fun y => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y) = fun y =>
      Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3) -
        rfpKa P * (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)) := by
    funext y; unfold rfpPsi; ring
  have HI : Integrable (fun y => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y) := by
    rw [Heq]; exact g1I.sub (g2I.const_mul _)
  have H0 : ∫ y, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y = 0 := by
    rw [Heq, integral_sub g1I (g2I.const_mul _), integral_const_mul]
    unfold rfpKa
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ Bpos.ne', sub_self]
  have hHset : ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * rfpPsi P v =
      ∫ v, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * rfpPsi P v := by
    apply setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero
    intro v hv
    have hv' : v ≤ Real.log x := by simpa using hv
    have hyle : Real.log x ≤ rfpY2 P.Md + 2 := (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hx).2 hxle
    rw [psiZero v (by linarith), mul_zero]
  
  have ptw0 : ∀ e : ℝ, -2 < e → e < 2 → ∀ y, Real.exp y * rfpF P (Real.exp y) e ^ 2 =
      (Real.exp (rfpLam P y) ^ 2 * ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) +
        P.ca e * (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y)) / 2 := by
    intro e he1 he2 y
    have hf0 : 0 < (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
    have hcaψ : |P.ca e * rfpPsi P y| ≤ 1 / 2 := (hca e he1 he2).2 y
    have hE : Real.exp y ≠ 0 := (Real.exp_pos y).ne'
    have hsq : Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca e * rfpPsi P y) ^ 2 = 1 + P.ca e * rfpPsi P y := by
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
      have := neg_abs_le (P.ca e * rfpPsi P y)
      linarith
    have hrp : ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) = (((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_comm (2:ℝ) (rfpTh P y), Real.rpow_mul hf0.le, Real.rpow_two]
    have hcross : Real.exp (rfpLam P y) ^ 2 * ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) * rfpPsi P y =
        Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y := by
      by_cases hψ : rfpPsi P y = 0
      · rw [hψ]; ring
      · rw [psiTh y hψ, mul_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one, sq, ← Real.exp_add, two_mul]
    have hS : Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp y) ^ 2 = 2 * Real.exp y := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
    unfold rfpF rfpE
    rw [Real.log_exp, div_pow, hS, mul_pow, mul_pow, hsq, ← hrp]
    generalize ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) = R at hcross ⊢
    rw [← hcross]
    field_simp
  
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, G = fun e v =>
      Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * Real.exp (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨G', hG'⟩ : ∃ G' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, G' = fun e v =>
      Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * (Real.exp (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2)) *
        (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * (2 * e / (1 + e ^ 2)))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hGv : ∀ e v, G e v =
      Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * Real.exp (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2)) :=
    fun e v => by rw [hG]
  have hG'v : ∀ e v, G' e v = Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) *
      (Real.exp (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2)) *
        (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * (2 * e / (1 + e ^ 2)))) := fun e v => by rw [hG']
  have Kle : ∀ e v : ℝ, Real.exp (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2)) ≤ 1 := by
    intro e v
    have hlg := Real.log_nonneg (show (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + e ^ 2 by nlinarith [sq_nonneg e])
    have hneg : -(2 * rfpTh P v) * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2) ≤ 0 := by nlinarith [(th01 v).1]
    calc Real.exp (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2)) ≤ Real.exp 0 := Real.exp_le_exp.2 hneg
      _ = 1 := Real.exp_zero
  have KC : ∀ e : ℝ, Continuous (fun v => Real.exp (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2))) :=
    fun e => Real.continuous_exp.comp ((continuous_const.mul thC).neg.mul continuous_const)
  have GC : ∀ e : ℝ, Continuous (G e) := fun e => by
    rw [hG]; exact wC.mul (KC e)
  have G'C : ∀ e : ℝ, Continuous (G' e) := fun e => by
    rw [hG']; exact wC.mul ((KC e).mul ((continuous_const.mul thC).neg.mul continuous_const))
  have hGn : ∀ e v, ‖G e v‖ ≤ Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) := by
    intro e v
    rw [hGv, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (Real.exp_pos _))]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (Real.exp_pos _).le (Kle e v)
  have hGlow : ∀ e v, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) ≤ Real.exp (2 * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2)) * G e v := by
    intro e v
    rw [hGv, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (Real.exp (2 * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2))), mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
    apply le_mul_of_one_le_right (Real.exp_pos _).le
    apply Real.one_le_exp
    have hlg := Real.log_nonneg (show (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + e ^ 2 by nlinarith [sq_nonneg e])
    nlinarith [(th01 v).2, (th01 v).1]
  have hr1 : ∀ e : ℝ, |2 * e / (1 + e ^ 2)| ≤ 1 := by
    intro e
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 1 + e ^ 2), div_le_one (by positivity),
      abs_mul, abs_two]
    nlinarith [sq_abs e, sq_nonneg (|e| - 1)]
  have hr2 : ∀ e : ℝ, |2 * e / (1 + e ^ 2)| ≤ 2 * |e| := by
    intro e
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 1 + e ^ 2), div_le_iff₀ (by positivity),
      abs_mul, abs_two]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg e) (sq_nonneg e)]
  have hG'b : ∀ e v, ‖G' e v‖ ≤ Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * (2 * |2 * e / (1 + e ^ 2)|) := by
    intro e v
    rw [hG'v, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _),
      abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _),
      abs_of_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * rfpTh P v by linarith [(th01 v).1])]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.exp_pos _).le
    have hK := Kle e v
    have hθ := (th01 v).2
    have hθ0 := (th01 v).1
    have ha := abs_nonneg (2 * e / (1 + e ^ 2))
    have hθa := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hθ ha
    calc Real.exp (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2)) * (2 * rfpTh P v * |2 * e / (1 + e ^ 2)|)
        ≤ 1 * (2 * |2 * e / (1 + e ^ 2)|) :=
          mul_le_mul hK (by linarith) (mul_nonneg (by linarith) ha) zero_le_one
      _ = 2 * |2 * e / (1 + e ^ 2)| := one_mul _
  have hD : ∀ v e : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun e => G e v) (G' e v) e := by
    intro v e
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => 1 + e ^ 2) (2 * e) e := by
      convert (hasDerivAt_pow 2 e).const_add 1 using 1
      norm_num
    have h2 := ((h1.log (by positivity)).const_mul (-(2 * rfpTh P v))).exp.const_mul
      (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v))
    rw [hG, hG']
    exact h2
  
  have keyPi : ∀ e : ℝ, -2 < e → e < 2 →
      leadPi (rfpF P) x e = -(1 / 2) * ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), G e v := by
    intro e he1 he2
    have ptw : ∀ v, Real.exp v * rfpF P (Real.exp v) e ^ 2 =
        (G e v + P.ca e * (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * rfpPsi P v)) / 2 := by
      intro v
      have hR : ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P v) =
          Real.exp (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2)) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by positivity), Real.log_inv]
        congr 1; ring
      have hE2 : Real.exp (rfpLam P v) ^ 2 = Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) := by
        rw [sq, ← Real.exp_add, two_mul]
      rw [ptw0 e he1 he2 v, hGv, hR, hE2]
    have hcv := integral_comp_exp_Ioi (fun x' => rfpF P x' e ^ 2) (Real.log x)
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hcv
    rw [Real.exp_log hx] at hcv
    unfold leadPi
    rw [← hcv, show (fun v => Real.exp v * rfpF P (Real.exp v) e ^ 2) = fun v =>
        (G e v + P.ca e * (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * rfpPsi P v)) / 2 from funext ptw,
      integral_div]
    have HIo : Integrable (fun v => P.ca e * (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * rfpPsi P v))
        (volume.restrict (Ioi (Real.log x))) := Integrable.const_mul HI.integrableOn (P.ca e)
    by_cases hGI : Integrable (G e) (volume.restrict (Ioi (Real.log x)))
    · rw [integral_add hGI HIo, integral_const_mul, hHset, H0]
      ring
    · have hnot : ¬ Integrable (fun v => G e v + P.ca e * (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * rfpPsi P v))
          (volume.restrict (Ioi (Real.log x))) := by
        intro hI
        apply hGI
        refine (hI.sub HIo).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun v => ?_)
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
        ring
      rw [integral_undef hGI, integral_undef hnot]
      ring
  
  have hη2 : -2 < η := by linarith
  have hη2' : η < 2 := by linarith
  by_cases wI : IntegrableOn (fun v => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v)) (Ioi (Real.log x))
  · have GI : ∀ e : ℝ, Integrable (G e) (volume.restrict (Ioi (Real.log x))) := fun e =>
      Integrable.mono' wI (GC e).aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ (fun v => hGn e v))
    have hdΦ := (hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (μ := volume.restrict (Ioi (Real.log x))) (F := G) (F' := G') (x₀ := η)
      (bound := fun v => 2 * Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v)) Filter.univ_mem
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun e => (GC e).aestronglyMeasurable)) (GI η)
      (G'C η).aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ (fun v e _ => (hG'b e v).trans (by
        have := hr1 e
        have := (Real.exp_pos (2 * rfpLam P v)).le
        nlinarith)))
      (Integrable.const_mul wI 2)
      (ae_of_all _ (fun v e _ => hD v e))).2
    constructor
    · have hΦb := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (μ := volume.restrict (Ioi (Real.log x)))
        wI (ae_of_all _ (fun v => hGn η v))
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hΦb
      rw [keyPi η hη2 hη2', abs_mul, show |(-(1 / 2 : ℝ))| = 1 / 2 by norm_num]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hΦb (by norm_num)
    · have hev : (fun e => leadPi (rfpF P) x e) =ᶠ[nhds η]
          (fun e => -(1 / 2) * ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), G e v) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hη2 hη2') (fun e he => keyPi e he.1 he.2)
      have hder : profEtaD (leadPi (rfpF P)) x η =
          -(1 / 2) * ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), G' η v := by
        unfold profEtaD
        rw [hev.deriv_eq]
        exact (hdΦ.const_mul (-(1 / 2))).deriv
      have hb4 : ∀ v, ‖G' η v‖ ≤ 4 * |η| * Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) := by
        intro v
        have h1' := hG'b η v
        have h2' := hr2 η
        have h3' := (Real.exp_pos (2 * rfpLam P v)).le
        have h4' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2' h3'
        nlinarith
      have hΨ := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (μ := volume.restrict (Ioi (Real.log x)))
        (Integrable.const_mul wI (4 * |η|)) (ae_of_all _ hb4)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, integral_const_mul] at hΨ
      rw [hder, abs_mul, show |(-(1 / 2 : ℝ))| = 1 / 2 by norm_num]
      linarith
  · 
    have hGnot : ∀ e : ℝ, ¬ Integrable (G e) (volume.restrict (Ioi (Real.log x))) := by
      intro e hGI
      apply wI
      refine Integrable.mono' (hGI.const_mul (Real.exp (2 * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2))))
        wC.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ (fun v => ?_))
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      exact hGlow e v
    have hz : ∀ e : ℝ, -2 < e → e < 2 → leadPi (rfpF P) x e = 0 := by
      intro e he1 he2
      rw [keyPi e he1 he2, integral_undef (hGnot e), mul_zero]
    rw [integral_undef wI, mul_zero, mul_zero]
    constructor
    · rw [hz η hη2 hη2', abs_zero]
    · have hev : (fun e => leadPi (rfpF P) x e) =ᶠ[nhds η] (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hη2 hη2') (fun e he => hz e he.1 he.2)
      unfold profEtaD
      rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const, abs_zero]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → ∀ y : ℝ, IntegrableOn (fun v => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v)) (Ioi y) ∧ (1 ≤ y → y ≤ rfpY2 P.Md + 2 → ∫ v in Ioi y, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y))

signature.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → ∀ y : ℝ, IntegrableOn (fun v => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v)) (Ioi y) ∧ (1 ≤ y → y ≤ rfpY2 P.Md + 2 → ∫ v in Ioi y, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hR y
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl1, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hR
  
  have hl2 : P.lam ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 10000 := by nlinarith
  have hhlam : P.h ≤ P.lam := by nlinarith
  have hρ1 : P.ρ < 1 := by linarith
  have hρq : P.ρ ≤ 1 / 4 := by linarith
  have h1ρ : 0 < 1 - P.ρ := by linarith
  have hlogh : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.h) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hh0]; linarith)
  have hT0 : 0 ≤ P.T1 := by linarith
  have hL : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.lam) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith)
  have hexpMd : 0 < Real.exp P.Md := Real.exp_pos _
  have hlam13 : 0 < 13 / P.lam := by positivity
  have h13 : 1 ≤ 13 / P.lam := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith
  have eY2 : rfpY2 P.Md = Real.exp P.Md + 11 := rfl
  have eY3 : rfpY3 P.Md P.lam = rfpY2 P.Md + 1 + 60 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  have eY4 : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam = rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 13 / P.lam := rfl
  have eY5 : rfpY5 P.Md P.lam = rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  have eYb : rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh = rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 2 + P.T1 + P.Lh + 3 := rfl
  
  have sig0 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → sigA y = 0 := fun y hy => by unfold sigA; simp [hy]
  have sig1 : ∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → sigA y = 1 := fun y hy => by
    unfold sigA; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hy]
  have sigR : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA y ∧ sigA y ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
    · have ha := Real.exp_pos (-1 / y ^ 2)
      have hb := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)
      exact ⟨div_nonneg ha.le (by linarith), (div_le_one (by linarith)).2 (by linarith)⟩
  have sigM : Measurable sigA := by
    unfold sigA
    refine Measurable.ite (measurableSet_le measurable_id measurable_const) measurable_const
      (Measurable.ite (measurableSet_le measurable_const measurable_id) measurable_const ?_)
    fun_prop
  have sigInt : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable sigA MeasureTheory.volume a b := by
    intro a b
    refine (intervalIntegrable_const (c := (1:ℝ))).mono_fun' sigM.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by
      show ‖sigA x‖ ≤ 1
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [(sigR x).1, (sigR x).2])
  
  have hI1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → rfpSigI t = rfpSigI 1 + (t - 1) := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpSigI
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (sigInt 0 1) (sigInt 1 t)]
    congr 1
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (1:ℝ))]
    · simp
    · intro s hs

  have hI0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → rfpSigI t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpSigI
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ))]
    · simp
    · intro s hs

      exact sig0 s hs.2
  have hD : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → 0 ≤ rfpSigI b - rfpSigI a ∧ rfpSigI b - rfpSigI a ≤ b - a := by
    intro a b hab
    have e : rfpSigI b - rfpSigI a = ∫ s in a..b, sigA s := by
      unfold rfpSigI
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (sigInt 0 b) (sigInt 0 a)
    rw [e]
    refine ⟨intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hab (fun u _ => (sigR u).1), ?_⟩
    have := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hab (sigInt a b)
      (intervalIntegrable_const (c := (1:ℝ))) (fun x _ => (sigR x).2)
    simpa using this
  have tauR : ∀ a b : ℝ, 1 - P.ρ ≤ tailFac P.ρ a b ∧ tailFac P.ρ a b ≤ 1 := by
    intro a b
    unfold tailFac
    obtain ⟨s0, s1⟩ := sigR ((Real.log (b / a) + 2) / 2)
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  
  have hSm : Measurable rfpSigI := (intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive sigInt 0).measurable
  have hT : Measurable (fun v : ℝ =>
      tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp v)) := by
    unfold tailFac
    have hs : Measurable (fun v : ℝ => sigA ((Real.log (Real.exp v /
        Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) + 2) / 2)) :=
      sigM.comp ((((Real.measurable_exp.div_const _).log).add_const _).div_const _)
    exact measurable_const.sub (measurable_const.mul (measurable_const.sub hs))
  have hLm : Measurable (rfpLam P) := by
    unfold rfpLam
    have m1 : Measurable (fun v : ℝ => rfpSigI (v - rfpY2 P.Md)) :=
      hSm.comp (measurable_id.sub_const _)
    have m2 : Measurable (fun v : ℝ => rfpSigI (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam)) :=
      hSm.comp (measurable_id.sub_const _)
    have m3 : Measurable (fun v : ℝ => rfpSigI (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1)) :=
      hSm.comp (((measurable_id.sub_const _).sub_const _).sub_const _)
    have m4 : Measurable (fun v : ℝ => sigA ((v - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60)) :=
      sigM.comp ((measurable_id.sub_const _).div_const _)
    have m5 : Measurable (fun v : ℝ => Real.log (tailFac P.ρ
        (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp v) / (1 - P.ρ))) :=
      (hT.div_const _).log
    exact (((((((measurable_const.add (measurable_id.div_const _)).sub
      (hSm.const_mul _)).sub (m1.const_mul _)).sub (m2.const_mul _)).add
      (m3.const_mul _)).sub (m4.mul_const _)).add m5)
  
  have hint : IntegrableOn (fun v => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v)) (Ioi y) := by
    have hInn : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpSigI t := by
      intro t
      rcases le_total t 0 with ht | ht
      · rw [hI0 t ht]
      · have := (hD 0 t ht).1
        rw [hI0 0 le_rfl] at this
        linarith
    have hIle : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → rfpSigI t ≤ t := by
      intro t ht
      have := (hD 0 t ht).2
      rw [hI0 0 le_rfl] at this
      linarith
    have hIge : ∀ t : ℝ, t - 1 ≤ rfpSigI t := by
      intro t
      rcases le_total 1 t with ht | ht
      · rw [hI1 t ht]; linarith [hInn 1]
      · linarith [hInn t]
    have hEnv : ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ y : ℝ, rfpLam P y ≤ B + y / 10 - (3 / 5 + P.h) * max y 0 := by
      obtain ⟨B1, hB1⟩ : ∃ B1 : ℝ, B1 = Real.log P.Pst - Real.log (1 - P.ρ) +
          (3 / 5 + P.h) * (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨B2, hB2⟩ : ∃ B2 : ℝ, B2 = Real.log P.Pst + 3 / 5 + P.lam * (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) +
          (1 - P.lam) * (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1) - (1 - P.h) * (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1) -
          Real.log (1 - P.ρ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨max B1 B2, ?_⟩
      intro y

        mul_nonneg (sigR _).1 (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num))

    have := hB v
    rcases le_total 0 v with hv | hv

  have hdec : ∀ v : ℝ, y ≤ v →

    have hE : -(P.lam * (rfpSigI (v - rfpY2 P.Md) - rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 P.Md)))
        - (1 - P.lam) * (rfpSigI (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) - rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam))
        + (1 - P.h) * (rfpSigI (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1)
          - rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1)) ≤ 0 := by
      rcases le_or_gt v (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1) with hv | hv
      · 
        rw [hI0 (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) (by linarith),

          have q1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left u1 (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - P.h by linarith)

            (show (0:ℝ) ≤ v - (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1) by linarith)

        ·

          have u1 := (hD (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1)
            (by linarith)).2
          have q1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left u1 (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - P.h by linarith)

    have s4 : rfpSigI v - rfpSigI y = v - y := by

    have sy : sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) = 0 := by

    have sv : 0 ≤ sigA ((v - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) * Real.log 2 :=

    have ty0 : tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) = 1 - P.ρ := by

    have ty : Real.log (tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) /

      rw [ty0, div_self h1ρ.ne', Real.log_one]
    have tv : Real.log (tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp v) /
        (1 - P.ρ)) ≤ -Real.log (1 - P.ρ) := by
      obtain ⟨t0, t1⟩ := tauR (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp v)
      have tp : 0 < tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp v) := by
        linarith
      rw [Real.log_div tp.ne' h1ρ.ne']
      have := Real.log_le_log tp t1
      rw [Real.log_one] at this
      linarith
    unfold rfpLam
    rw [sy, ty]
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y - 2 * Real.log (1 - P.ρ) + y) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hg : IntegrableOn (fun v => K * Real.exp (-v)) (Ioi y) := by

    rw [sO _ hyA, sO _ hyB, sZ _ hyC, sZ _ hyD, hgZ _ hyE]
    ring
  
  have hTh : HasDerivAt (rfpTh P) (-(deriv sigA ((Real.log x - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) * (1 / 60)))
      (Real.log x) := hS6.const_sub 1
  have hf : 0 < (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
  have hsq1 : ∀ s, s < rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 4 → Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P s) = 1 := by
    intro s hs
    have h1 : s - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3 ≤ -(3 / 20) := by linarith
    have h2 : s - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 ≤ -(3 / 20) := by linarith
    unfold rfpPsi
    rw [(hBz _ h1).1, (hBz _ h2).1]
    simp
  have hE3 : HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P s)) 0 (Real.log x) := by
    apply (hasDerivAt_const (Real.log x) (1:ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hyG] with s hs
    exact hsq1 s hs
  have hE : HasDerivAt (fun s => rfpE P s η) ((-(1 / 2) - P.lam) * rfpE P (Real.log x) η)
      (Real.log x) := by
    have h := (hΛ.exp.mul (hTh.const_rpow hf)).mul hE3
    refine h.congr_deriv ?_
    rw [hgZ _ hyE]
    unfold rfpE
    ring
  have hepos : 0 < rfpE P (Real.log x) η := by
    unfold rfpE
    rw [hsq1 _ hyG]
    positivity
  have hFpos : 0 < rfpF P x η := div_pos hepos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity))
  
  have hin1 : HasDerivAt (fun s => P.lam * (s - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) (P.lam * 1) (Real.log x) :=
    ((hasDerivAt_id' _).sub_const _).const_mul _
  have hin2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) 1 (Real.log x) :=
    ((hasDerivAt_id' _).sub_const _).add_const _
  have hin3 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) 1 (Real.log x) :=
    ((hasDerivAt_id' _).sub_const _).add_const _
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = P.Amp η * (R0d (P.lam * (Real.log x - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) * (P.lam * 1))
      + P.c1 η * (Gb (Real.log x - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) * 1)
      + P.c2 η * (Gb (Real.log x - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) * 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hRb : HasDerivAt (fun s => rfpRb P s η) r (Real.log x) := by
    rw [hr]
    exact ((((hR0d _).comp _ hin1).const_mul (P.Amp η)).add
      (((hBd _).comp _ hin2).const_mul (P.c1 η))).add (((hBd _).comp _ hin3).const_mul (P.c2 η))
  
  have hxK : Real.exp (Real.exp P.Md) < x := by
    have h1 : Real.exp (Real.exp P.Md) < rfpXg P := by
      unfold rfpXg; rw [hy2d]; exact Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    linarith
  have hev : (fun X => rfpU P X η) =ᶠ[nhds x]
      (fun X => rfpE P (Real.log X) η * rfpRb P (Real.log X) η) := by
    filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hxK] with X hX
    have hX' : Real.exp (Real.exp P.Md) < X := hX
    have hX0 : 0 < X := lt_trans (Real.exp_pos _) hX'
    have hlX : Real.exp P.Md < Real.log X := (Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt hX0).mpr hX'
    have hMd1 : P.Md + 1 ≤ Real.exp P.Md := Real.add_one_le_exp P.Md
    have hn1 : ¬ (Real.log X ≤ 1) := by intro h; linarith
    have hll : P.Md < Real.log (Real.log X) := (Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt (by linarith)).mpr hlX
    have hσ : sigA (Real.log (Real.log X) / P.Md) = 1 := sO _ (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hMd]; linarith)
    have hK : rfpK P.Md (Real.log X) = 0 := by
      unfold rfpK; rw [if_neg hn1, hσ]; ring
    show η * rfpK P.Md (Real.log X) + rfpE P (Real.log X) η * rfpRb P (Real.log X) η =
      rfpE P (Real.log X) η * rfpRb P (Real.log X) η
    rw [hK]; ring
  
  have hsx : (0:ℝ) < Real.sqrt (2 * x) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  have hss : Real.sqrt (2 * x) ^ 2 = 2 * x := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hlog : HasDerivAt Real.log x⁻¹ x := Real.hasDerivAt_log hx0.ne'
  have hEl : HasDerivAt (fun X => rfpE P (Real.log X) η)
      ((-(1 / 2) - P.lam) * rfpE P (Real.log x) η * x⁻¹) x := hE.comp x hlog
  have hRbl : HasDerivAt (fun X => rfpRb P (Real.log X) η) (r * x⁻¹) x := hRb.comp x hlog
  have hsqd : HasDerivAt (fun X => Real.sqrt (2 * X)) (2 * 1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (2 * x))) x :=
    ((hasDerivAt_id' x).const_mul 2).sqrt (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 2 * x).ne'
  have hF : HasDerivAt (fun X => rfpF P X η)
      (((-(1 / 2) - P.lam) * rfpE P (Real.log x) η * x⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (2 * x) -
        rfpE P (Real.log x) η * (2 * 1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (2 * x)))) / Real.sqrt (2 * x) ^ 2) x :=
    hEl.div hsqd hsx.ne'
  have hU : HasDerivAt (fun X => rfpU P X η)
      ((-(1 / 2) - P.lam) * rfpE P (Real.log x) η * x⁻¹ * rfpRb P (Real.log x) η +
        rfpE P (Real.log x) η * (r * x⁻¹)) x :=
    (hEl.mul hRbl).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  have hA : shearA (rfpF P) x η = 2 + 2 * P.lam := by
    unfold shearA
    rw [hF.deriv, show rfpF P x η = rfpE P (Real.log x) η / Real.sqrt (2 * x) from rfl,
      alg1 x (Real.sqrt (2 * x)) (rfpE P (Real.log x) η) (-(1 / 2) - P.lam) hx0 hsx hss hepos]
    ring
  have hB : shearB (rfpF P) (rfpU P) x η = 2 * ((-(1 / 2) - P.lam) * rfpRb P (Real.log x) η + r) := by
    unfold shearB
    rw [hU.deriv, show rfpF P x η = rfpE P (Real.log x) η / Real.sqrt (2 * x) from rfl]
    exact alg2 x (Real.sqrt (2 * x)) (rfpE P (Real.log x) η) (-(1 / 2) - P.lam)
      (rfpRb P (Real.log x) η) r hx0 hsx hss hepos
  
  have hAb : |P.Amp η| ≤ 6 / 5 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, hA2⟩
  have hl20 : P.lam ^ 20 ≤ P.lam := pow_le_of_le_one hl0.le (by linarith) (by norm_num)
  have hc1' : |P.c1 η| ≤ P.lam := by linarith [abs_nonneg (deriv P.c1 η)]
  have hc2' : |P.c2 η| ≤ P.lam := by linarith [abs_nonneg (deriv P.c2 η)]
  refine ⟨hFpos, hA, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hB, hr]
    have key := alg3 (max C 0) P.lam (P.Amp η) (rfpR0 (P.lam * (Real.log x - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)))
      (R0d (P.lam * (Real.log x - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam))) (P.c1 η) (P.c2 η)
      (rfpBmp (Real.log x - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3)) (rfpBmp (Real.log x - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1))
      (Gb (Real.log x - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3)) (Gb (Real.log x - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1))
      hC0 hl0 hl1 hAb (hR0b _).1 (hR0b _).2 hc1' hc2' (hBb _).1 (hBb _).1 (hBb _).2 (hBb _).2
    convert key using 2
    unfold rfpRb
    ring
  · intro hxk
    have hy3 : Real.log x ≤ rfpY3 P.Md P.lam := by
      have := Real.log_le_log hx0 hxk
      unfold rfpXk at this
      rw [Real.log_exp, sub_zero] at this
      exact this
    have hξ0 : P.lam * (Real.log x - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) ≤ 0 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hl0.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hy3)]
    have h13 : 1300 ≤ 13 / P.lam := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith
    have ht1 : Real.log x - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3 ≤ -(3 / 20) := by linarith
    have ht2 : Real.log x - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1 ≤ -(3 / 20) := by linarith
    rw [hB, hr]
    unfold rfpRb
    rw [(hR0z _ hξ0).1, (hR0z _ hξ0).2, (hBz _ ht1).1, (hBz _ ht1).2, (hBz _ ht2).1,
      (hBz _ ht2).2]
    ring

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨MQ, hMQ, GQ⟩ := rfp_pulse_Q_close
  refine ⟨MQ, hMQ, ?_⟩
  intro Md hMd
  obtain ⟨PQ, GQ⟩ := GQ Md hMd
  refine ⟨PQ, ?_⟩
  intro Pst hPst
  obtain ⟨lQ, hlQ, GQ⟩ := GQ Pst hPst
  refine ⟨min lQ (min (1 / 1000) (Real.exp (-rfpY2 Md) / 20)),
    lt_min hlQ (lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity)), ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam hlaml
  obtain ⟨hQ0, hhQ0, GQ⟩ := GQ lam hlam (le_trans hlaml (min_le_left _ _))
  refine ⟨hQ0, hhQ0, ?_⟩
  intro P hPMd hPPst hPlam hPh hReg hClos
  have Q2 := GQ P hPMd hPPst hPlam hPh hReg hClos
  have hl1 : lam ≤ 1 / 1000 := le_trans hlaml (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
  have hlE : lam ≤ Real.exp (-rfpY2 Md) / 20 :=
    le_trans hlaml (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
  subst hPMd hPPst hPlam
  have hReg' := hReg
  obtain ⟨hMd0, hPst', hl0, hl100, hh0, hhl, -⟩ := hReg'
  have hPst0 : 0 < P.Pst := lt_trans (Real.exp_pos _) hPst'
  intro x η hx1 hx2 he1 he2
  have hη2 : η ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hη0 : 0 ≤ η ^ 2 := sq_nonneg η
  have hl2 : P.lam ^ 2 ≤ P.lam / 1000 := by nlinarith
  have hden : 0 < 1 - P.lam := by linarith
  have hE0 : 0 < Real.exp (-rfpY2 P.Md) := Real.exp_pos _
  have hX0pos : 0 < Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) := Real.exp_pos _
  have hX0x : Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) ≤ x := hx1
  have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hX0pos hX0x
  rcases lt_or_ge x (rfpXk P 0) with hxk | hxk
  · 
    obtain ⟨-, hKC⟩ := rfp_inner_kC_facts
    obtain ⟨hKd, hK04, -, -, hCpos, hCbd⟩ := hKC P.Md P.Pst P.lam hMd0 hPst0
    obtain ⟨Mc, hMc⟩ := hCbd (Real.log (rfpXk P 0))
    have hlead := (rfp_lead_explicit P.h (rfpXk P 0) (rinC P.Md P.Pst P.lam) (rfpK P.Md)

      (fun y => (hCpos y).1)
      ⟨max Mc 4, fun y hy => ⟨le_trans (hMc y hy) (le_max_left _ _), by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (hK04 y).1]; exact le_trans (hK04 y).2 (le_max_right _ _)⟩⟩
      (fun x' η' h0 h1 => rfp_inner_form_ext P hReg x' η' h0 h1.le) x η hx0 hxk).2.2.1
    obtain ⟨hgc, hkc, hG0, hpow, hkz⟩ :=

    have hid := rinQ_power_region P.h η P.lam (Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1)) _
      (rinC P.Md P.Pst P.lam) (rfpK P.Md) hX0pos hG0 (by linarith) hgc hkc hpow hkz x hX0x
    have hhE : P.h ≤ Real.exp (-rfpY2 P.Md) / 1000 := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hA4, hM0, hM1⟩ :=
      rinQ_anchor_X0 P.Md P.Pst P.lam P.h η hMd0 hPst0 hl0 hl100 hh0 hhE he1 he2
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, t = x / Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← ht] at hid
    have ht1 : 1 ≤ t := by rw [ht, le_div_iff₀ hX0pos]; linarith
    have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
    have hxt : x = Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) * t := by
      rw [ht]; field_simp
    have hp1 : 1 ≤ t ^ P.lam := Real.one_le_rpow ht1 hl0.le
    have hpt : t ^ P.lam ≤ t := by
      have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le ht1 (by linarith : P.lam ≤ 1)
      rwa [Real.rpow_one] at this
    have hbern : t ^ P.lam ≤ P.lam * t + (1 - P.lam) := by
      have := Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean2_weighted hl0.le (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - P.lam)
        ht0.le zero_le_one (by ring)
      rw [Real.one_rpow] at this
      linarith
    
    have hEX : Real.exp (-rfpY2 P.Md) * Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) = Real.exp 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    have he2' : 2 ≤ Real.exp 1 := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp 1]
    have hEy : Real.exp (-rfpY2 P.Md) * Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
    have hy2 : 11 ≤ rfpY2 P.Md := by unfold rfpY2; linarith [Real.exp_pos P.Md]
    have hey12 : 12 ≤ Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md) := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (rfpY2 P.Md)]
    have hE10 : Real.exp (-rfpY2 P.Md) ≤ 1 / 10 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hE0.le (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md) - 12)]
    have hX0e : Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) = Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md) * Real.exp 1 :=
      Real.exp_add _ _
    
    have hhη : P.h * η ^ 2 ≤ P.h := by nlinarith
    have hL0 : 0 ≤ 1 - 2 * P.h * η ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hL1 : 1 - 2 * P.h * η ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
    have hm0 : 0 ≤ (1 - 2 * P.h * η ^ 2) * rinMom (fun x => rfpK P.Md (Real.log x))
        (Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1)) / Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) :=
      div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hL0 hM0) hX0pos.le
    have hm1 : (1 - 2 * P.h * η ^ 2) * rinMom (fun x => rfpK P.Md (Real.log x))
        (Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1)) / Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      have hX2 : 2 * Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md) ≤ Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) := by
        rw [hX0e]; nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (rfpY2 P.Md)]
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hX0pos]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul hL1 hM1 hM0 zero_le_one, hX2]
    
    have hQ0 : Real.exp (-rfpY2 P.Md) / 5 + ((1 / 2 - P.h) * (2 * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2)) - P.h) *
        (1 - Real.exp (-rfpY2 P.Md)) ≤
        rinQf P.h (rinC P.Md P.Pst P.lam) (rfpK P.Md) (Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1)) η := by
      rw [← hEX] at hA4
      have hmul : Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) * (Real.exp (-rfpY2 P.Md) / 5 +
          ((1 / 2 - P.h) * (2 * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2)) - P.h) * (1 - Real.exp (-rfpY2 P.Md))) ≤
          Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) *
            rinQf P.h (rinC P.Md P.Pst P.lam) (rfpK P.Md) (Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1)) η := by
        calc _ = Real.exp (-rfpY2 P.Md) * Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) / 5 +
              ((1 - P.h + (1 / 2 - P.h) * (2 * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2))) - 1) *
              (Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) - Real.exp (-rfpY2 P.Md) * Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1)) := by
              ring
          _ ≤ _ := hA4
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hmul hX0pos
    
    have hw0 : 0 ≤ 1 / t := by positivity
    have hwv : 1 / t ≤ t ^ P.lam / t := by gcongr
    have hv1 : t ^ P.lam / t ≤ 1 := by rw [div_le_one ht0]; exact hpt
    have hvw : t ^ P.lam / t - 1 / t ≤ P.lam := by
      rw [← sub_div, div_le_iff₀ ht0]; linarith
    have h5 := rfp_qs_power_ineq P.lam (Real.exp (-rfpY2 P.Md)) P.h (η ^ 2)
      ((1 - 2 * P.h * η ^ 2) * rinMom (fun x => rfpK P.Md (Real.log x))
        (Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1)) / Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1))
      (t ^ P.lam / t) (1 / t)
      (rinQf P.h (rinC P.Md P.Pst P.lam) (rfpK P.Md) (Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1)) η)
      hl0 hlE hE10 hh0.le hhl hη0 hη2 hm0 hm1 hw0 hwv hv1 hvw hQ0
    
    have hQeq : rinQf P.h (rinC P.Md P.Pst P.lam) (rfpK P.Md) x η =
        -1 + (1 - 2 * P.h * η ^ 2) * rinMom (fun x => rfpK P.Md (Real.log x))
          (Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1)) / Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) * (1 / t)
        + t ^ P.lam / t * (rinQf P.h (rinC P.Md P.Pst P.lam) (rfpK P.Md)
          (Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1)) η + 1 - (1 - 2 * P.h * η ^ 2) *
          rinMom (fun x => rfpK P.Md (Real.log x)) (Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1)) /
          Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1))
        + (1 - P.h + (1 / 2 - P.h) * (2 * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2))) * (1 - t ^ P.lam / t) /

      have htne : t ≠ 0 := ht0.ne'
      have hdne : 1 - P.lam ≠ 0 := hden.ne'
      have e1 : rinQf P.h (rinC P.Md P.Pst P.lam) (rfpK P.Md) x η =
          (x * rinQf P.h (rinC P.Md P.Pst P.lam) (rfpK P.Md) x η) / x :=
        eq_div_of_mul_eq hxne (by ring)
      rw [e1, hid, hxt]
      field_simp
      try ring
    
    have hlogt : Real.log t = Real.log x - (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) := by
      rw [ht, Real.log_div hx0.ne' hX0pos.ne', Real.log_exp]
    have hEv : Real.exp (-rfpY2 P.Md) * (t ^ P.lam / t) =
        Real.exp (-(rfpY2 P.Md) - (1 - P.lam) * (Real.log x - rfpY2 P.Md - 1)) := by
      have e1 : t ^ P.lam / t = Real.exp (Real.log t * P.lam) / Real.exp (Real.log t) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos ht0, Real.exp_log ht0]
      rw [e1, ← Real.exp_sub, ← Real.exp_add, hlogt]
      congr 1; ring
    rw [hlead]
    linarith [h5, hQeq, hEv]
  · 
    have hc := Q2 x η hxk hx2 he1 he2
    have hc' := (abs_le.1 hc).1
    have hc3 : 49 / 100 * η ^ 2 ≤ (1 - 2 * P.h) * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2) := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hη0 (by nlinarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 51 / 100 - 2 * P.h - 49 / 100 * η ^ 2)]
    have hc30 : 0 ≤ (1 - 2 * P.h) * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2) := le_trans (by positivity) hc3
    have hQs : P.lam - P.h + (1 - 2 * P.h) * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2) ≤
        (P.lam - P.h + (1 - 2 * P.h) * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2)) / (1 - P.lam) := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hden]
      have : 0 ≤ P.lam - P.h + (1 - 2 * P.h) * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2) := by nlinarith
      nlinarith
    have hLg : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.lam) :=
      Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith)
    have hlogx : rfpY3 P.Md P.lam ≤ Real.log x := by
      have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hxk
      unfold rfpXk at this

  obtain ⟨ht0, ht1⟩ := sB (50 * ξ)
  have hRv : rfpR0 ξ = φ ξ * (1 - sigA (ξ - 10)) := by rw [hR]
  have hT2 : |φ ξ * deriv sigA (ξ - 10)| ≤ 11 * max C 0 := by
    by_cases hz : deriv sigA (ξ - 10) = 0
    · rw [hz, mul_zero, abs_zero]; linarith
    · have h11 : ξ - 10 < 1 := by
        by_contra hc; push_neg at hc; exact hz (hgO _ hc)
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hp0]
      have hle : φ ξ ≤ 11 := hp1.trans (max_le (by linarith) (by norm_num))
      exact mul_le_mul hle (hgB _) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
  have hT1 : 0 ≤ sigA (50 * ξ) * (1 - sigA (ξ - 10)) := mul_nonneg ht0 (by linarith)
  have hT1' : sigA (50 * ξ) * (1 - sigA (ξ - 10)) ≤ 1 :=
    mul_le_one₀ ht1 (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hT2n : 0 ≤ φ ξ * deriv sigA (ξ - 10) := mul_nonneg hp0 (hg0 _)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hRv]; exact mul_nonneg hp0 (by linarith)
  · rw [hRv]
    by_cases h11 : 11 ≤ ξ
    · rw [sO (ξ - 10) (by linarith)]; simp
    · push_neg at h11
      have hle : φ ξ ≤ 11 := hp1.trans (max_le h11.le (by norm_num))
      calc φ ξ * (1 - sigA (ξ - 10)) ≤ φ ξ * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hp0
        _ ≤ 11 := by linarith
  · rw [hRd]; linarith
  · rw [hRd]
    have hab := abs_le.mp hT2
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [hab.1, hab.2]

signature.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → ∀ η : ℝ, (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..rfpXv P, rfpU P x η) = η * (∫ y in Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam), Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y) + (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (P.Amp η * (∫ y in Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam), Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam))) + P.c1 η * (∫ y in Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam), Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3)) + P.c2 η * (∫ y in Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam), Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1)))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hP η
  have hR := hP
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl100, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hR
  have hPst0 : 0 < P.Pst := lt_trans (Real.exp_pos _) hPst
  obtain ⟨_, cG1, -, -, -⟩ := rfp_clamp_identities P hP
  obtain ⟨hcm, -, -, hcneg, C, κ, hκ, hCb⟩ := rfp_shape_data P hP
  
  have hsig : ∀ t, 0 ≤ sigA t ∧ sigA t ≤ 1 := by
    intro t
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · exact ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
    · exact ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
    · have ha := Real.exp_pos (-1 / t ^ 2)
      have hc := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2)
      refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
      linarith
  have hsigm : Measurable sigA := by
    have e : sigA = fun y => if y ≤ 0 then 0 else if 1 ≤ y then 1 else
        Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) / (Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)) := by
      funext y; rfl
    rw [e]
    refine Measurable.ite measurableSet_Iic measurable_const
      (Measurable.ite measurableSet_Ici measurable_const ?_)
    fun_prop
  
  have hb : ∀ t, |rfpBmp t| ≤ 1 := by
    intro t
    unfold rfpBmp
    obtain ⟨a0, a1⟩ := hsig (1 + t / (3 / 20))
    obtain ⟨b0, b1⟩ := hsig (1 - t / (3 / 20))
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg a0 b0)]
    exact mul_le_one₀ a1 b0 b1
  have hbm : Measurable rfpBmp := by
    have e : rfpBmp = fun t => sigA (1 + t / (3 / 20)) * sigA (1 - t / (3 / 20)) := by
      funext t; rfl
    rw [e]
    exact (hsigm.comp (by fun_prop : Measurable fun t : ℝ => 1 + t / (3 / 20))).mul
      (hsigm.comp (by fun_prop : Measurable fun t : ℝ => 1 - t / (3 / 20)))
  
  have hk : ∀ y, |rfpK P.Md y| ≤ 4 := by
    intro y
    unfold rfpK
    split_ifs
    · norm_num
    · obtain ⟨a0, a1⟩ := hsig (Real.log y / P.Md)
      rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hkm : Measurable (rfpK P.Md) := by
    have e : rfpK P.Md = fun y => if y ≤ 1 then 4 else 4 * (1 - sigA (Real.log y / P.Md)) := by
      funext y; rfl
    rw [e]
    exact Measurable.ite measurableSet_Iic measurable_const
      (measurable_const.mul (measurable_const.sub (hsigm.comp (Real.measurable_log.div_const _))))
  
  have hII : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (fun v => sigA (50 * v)) volume a b := by
    intro a b
    have hc : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => (1:ℝ)) volume a b := intervalIntegrable_const
    refine hc.mono_fun' ?_ ?_
    · exact (hsigm.comp (measurable_const.mul measurable_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v => ?_)
      show ‖sigA (50 * v)‖ ≤ 1
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hsig _).1]
      exact (hsig _).2
  have hR0m : Measurable rfpR0 := by
    have e : rfpR0 = fun ξ => (∫ v in (0:ℝ)..ξ, sigA (50 * v)) * (1 - sigA (ξ - 10)) := by
      funext ξ; rfl
    rw [e]
    exact (intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive hII 0).measurable.mul
      (measurable_const.sub (hsigm.comp (measurable_id.sub_const _)))
  have hR0b : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ξ ≤ 13 → |rfpR0 ξ| ≤ 13 := by
    intro ξ hξ
    unfold rfpR0
    obtain ⟨s0, s1⟩ := hsig (ξ - 10)
    have h1 : |1 - sigA (ξ - 10)| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
    rcases le_or_gt ξ 0 with hn | hp
    · have hz : (∫ v in (0:ℝ)..ξ, sigA (50 * v)) = ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..ξ, (0:ℝ) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro v hv
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge hn] at hv
        show sigA (50 * v) = 0
        unfold sigA
        rw [if_pos (by linarith [hv.2])]
      rw [hz, intervalIntegral.integral_zero, zero_mul, abs_zero]
      norm_num
    · have hI := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := 0) (b := ξ) (C := 1)
        (f := fun v => sigA (50 * v)) (fun v _ => by
          show ‖sigA (50 * v)‖ ≤ 1
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hsig _).1]
          exact (hsig _).2)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hI
      have hξ' : |ξ - 0| ≤ 13 := by rw [sub_zero, abs_of_pos hp]; exact hξ
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |∫ v in (0:ℝ)..ξ, sigA (50 * v)| * |1 - sigA (ξ - 10)| ≤ 13 * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul (by linarith) h1 (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        _ = 13 := by norm_num
  
  have hEm : Measurable (fun y => Real.exp (rfpLam P y)) := hcm
  have hE : ∀ y, Real.exp (rfpLam P y) ≤ P.Pst + |C| := by
    intro y
    rcases le_or_gt y 0 with hy | hy
    · have e : Real.exp (rfpLam P y) = P.Pst * Real.exp (y / 10) := (hcneg y hy).2
      rw [e]
      have : Real.exp (y / 10) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by linarith)
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg C]
    · have e : Real.exp (rfpLam P y) ≤ C * Real.exp (-(κ * y)) := hCb y hy.le
      have h1 : Real.exp (-(κ * y)) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by nlinarith)
      have h2 : C * Real.exp (-(κ * y)) ≤ |C| := by
        calc C * Real.exp (-(κ * y)) ≤ |C| * Real.exp (-(κ * y)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) (Real.exp_pos _).le
          _ ≤ |C| * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (abs_nonneg C)
          _ = |C| := mul_one _
      linarith
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ P.Pst + |C| := by linarith [abs_nonneg C]
  have hEm' : Measurable (fun y => Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y)) := by
    have e : (fun y => Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y)) = fun y => Real.exp y * Real.exp (rfpLam P y) := by
      funext y; exact Real.exp_add _ _
    rw [e]
    exact Real.measurable_exp.mul hEm
  have hEP : ∀ y, ‖Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y)‖ ≤ (P.Pst + |C|) * Real.exp y := by
    intro y
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), Real.exp_add, mul_comm (P.Pst + |C|)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hE y) (Real.exp_pos y).le
  
  have hexpI : IntegrableOn Real.exp (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)) := integrableOn_exp_Iic _
  have hIA : IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y) (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)) := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (hexpI.const_mul 4) ((Real.measurable_exp.mul hkm).aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_)
    show ‖Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y‖ ≤ 4 * Real.exp y
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos y), mul_comm 4]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hk y) (Real.exp_pos y).le
  have hIB : ∀ s : ℝ, IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + s))
      (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)) := by
    intro s
    refine Integrable.mono' (hexpI.const_mul (P.Pst + |C|))
      ((hEm'.mul (hbm.comp (by fun_prop : Measurable fun y : ℝ => y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + s))).aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_)
    show ‖Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + s)‖ ≤ (P.Pst + |C|) * Real.exp y
    rw [norm_mul]
    calc ‖Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y)‖ * ‖rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + s)‖
        ≤ ((P.Pst + |C|) * Real.exp y) * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul (hEP y) (by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hb _) (norm_nonneg _)
            (mul_nonneg hM0 (Real.exp_pos y).le)
      _ = (P.Pst + |C|) * Real.exp y := mul_one _
  have hIR : IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)))
      (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)) := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (hexpI.const_mul ((P.Pst + |C|) * 13))
      ((hEm'.mul (hR0m.comp (by fun_prop : Measurable fun y : ℝ => P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)))).aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Iic (fun y hy => ?_)
    show ‖Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam))‖ ≤ (P.Pst + |C|) * 13 * Real.exp y
    have hξ : P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) ≤ 13 := by
      have h4 : y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam ≤ 13 / P.lam := by
        have := mem_Iic.mp hy
        unfold rfpY4 at this
        linarith
      calc P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) ≤ P.lam * (13 / P.lam) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 hl0.le
        _ = 13 := by field_simp
    rw [norm_mul]
    calc ‖Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y)‖ * ‖rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam))‖
        ≤ ((P.Pst + |C|) * Real.exp y) * 13 :=
          mul_le_mul (hEP y) (by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hR0b _ hξ) (norm_nonneg _)
            (mul_nonneg hM0 (Real.exp_pos y).le)
      _ = (P.Pst + |C|) * 13 * Real.exp y := by ring
  
  have hsub : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..rfpXv P, rfpU P x η) =
      ∫ y in Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam), Real.exp y * rfpU P (Real.exp y) η := by
    have h0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ rfpXv P := (Real.exp_pos _).le
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le h0, show rfpXv P = Real.exp (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) from rfl,
      ← Real.image_exp_Iic,
      integral_image_eq_integral_abs_deriv_smul measurableSet_Iic
        (fun x _ => (Real.hasDerivAt_exp x).hasDerivWithinAt) Real.exp_injective.injOn
        (fun x => rfpU P x η)]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Iic (fun y _ => ?_)
    simp only [abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos y), smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hpt : ∀ y ∈ Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam), Real.exp y * rfpU P (Real.exp y) η =
      η * (Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y)
      + ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * P.Amp η) * (Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)))
      + ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * P.c1 η) * (Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3))
      + ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * P.c2 η) * (Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1)) := by
    intro y hy
    have hEy : rfpE P y η = Real.exp (rfpLam P y) * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      rw [← cG1 y η (mem_Iic.mp hy)]
      unfold rfpE
      ring
    have hU : rfpU P (Real.exp y) η = η * rfpK P.Md y + rfpE P y η * rfpRb P y η := by
      unfold rfpU
      rw [Real.log_exp]
    rw [hU, hEy, Real.exp_add]
    unfold rfpRb
    ring
  rw [hsub, setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Iic hpt]
  have iA : Integrable (fun y => η * (Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y)) (volume.restrict (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam))) :=
    hIA.const_mul η
  have iR : Integrable (fun y => ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * P.Amp η) *
      (Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam))))
      (volume.restrict (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam))) := hIR.const_mul _
  have iB1 : Integrable (fun y => ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * P.c1 η) *
      (Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3)))
      (volume.restrict (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam))) := (hIB 3).const_mul _
  have iB2 : Integrable (fun y => ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * P.c2 η) *
      (Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1)))
      (volume.restrict (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam))) := (hIB 1).const_mul _
  have iAR : Integrable (fun y => η * (Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y) + ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * P.Amp η) *
      (Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam))))
      (volume.restrict (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam))) := iA.add iR
  have iARB : Integrable (fun y => η * (Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y) + ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * P.Amp η) *
      (Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam))) +
      ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * P.c1 η) * (Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3)))
      (volume.restrict (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam))) := iAR.add iB1
  rw [integral_add iARB iB2, integral_add iAR iB1, integral_add iA iR, integral_const_mul,
    integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
  ring

subgoal_signatures.name: rfp_clamp_identities
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → (1 ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ∧ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ∧ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ≤ rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam → ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y) * Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y) = (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ≤ y → ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y) * Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y) = 1) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, y ≤ 1 → η * rfpK P.Md y + rfpE P y η * rfpRb P y η = 4 * η) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ≤ y → η * rfpK P.Md y + rfpE P y η * rfpRb P y η = 0)

  have hkm : Measurable (rfpK P.Md) := by
    have e : rfpK P.Md = fun y => if y ≤ 1 then 4 else 4 * (1 - sigA (Real.log y / P.Md)) := by

    rw [e]
    exact Measurable.ite measurableSet_Iic measurable_const

  have hII : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (fun v => sigA (50 * v)) volume a b := by
    intro a b
    have hc : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => (1:ℝ)) volume a b := intervalIntegrable_const
    refine hc.mono_fun' ?_ ?_

  have hR0m : Measurable rfpR0 := by

  have hR0b : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ξ ≤ 13 → |rfpR0 ξ| ≤ 13 := by
    intro ξ hξ

    rcases le_or_gt ξ 0 with hn | hp

  have hEm : Measurable (fun y => Real.exp (rfpLam P y)) := hcm
  have hΛm : Measurable (rfpLam P) := by

      rw [e]

      nlinarith [abs_nonneg C]

      have h1 : Real.exp (-(κ * y)) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by nlinarith)

        calc C * Real.exp (-(κ * y)) ≤ |C| * Real.exp (-(κ * y)) :=

          _ ≤ |C| * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (abs_nonneg C)

      linarith
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ P.Pst + |C| := by linarith [abs_nonneg C]
  
  have hexpI : IntegrableOn Real.exp (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)) := integrableOn_exp_Iic _
  have hgen : ∀ (a m : ℝ → ℝ) (K Mm : ℝ), Measurable a → Measurable m →
      (∀ y, y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam → Real.exp (a y) ≤ K * Real.exp y) →
      (∀ y, y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam → |m y| ≤ Mm) →
      IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (a y) * m y) (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)) := by
    intro a m K Mm ha hm hK hMm
    refine Integrable.mono' (hexpI.const_mul (Real.sqrt 2 * K * Mm))
      ((measurable_const.mul (Real.measurable_exp.comp ha)).mul hm).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Iic (fun y hy => ?_)
    have hy' : y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam := hy
    show ‖Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (a y) * m y‖ ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * K * Mm * Real.exp y

    have h1 := hK y hy'
    have h2 := hMm y hy'
    have hs := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
    have hm0 := abs_nonneg (m y)
    have he := Real.exp_pos (a y)
    calc Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (a y) * |m y| ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * (K * Real.exp y) * Mm :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hs) h2 hm0 (mul_nonneg hs (le_trans he.le h1))
      _ = Real.sqrt 2 * K * Mm * Real.exp y := by ring
  have ha1m : Measurable (fun y => 3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y) :=
    (measurable_const.mul measurable_id).add hΛm
  have ha2m : Measurable (fun y => 3 / 2 * y + 2 * rfpLam P y) :=
    (measurable_const.mul measurable_id).add (measurable_const.mul hΛm)
  have ha1b : ∀ y, y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam →
      Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y) ≤ (Real.exp (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam / 2) * (P.Pst + |C|)) * Real.exp y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [show 3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y = y / 2 + rfpLam P y + y by ring, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul (Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by linarith)) (hE y) (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.exp_pos _).le)

  have ha2b : ∀ y, y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam →

        (Real.exp (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam / 2) * (P.Pst + |C|) * (P.Pst + |C|)) * Real.exp y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [show 3 / 2 * y + 2 * rfpLam P y = y / 2 + rfpLam P y + rfpLam P y + y by ring,

    hgen (fun y => 3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y) (rfpK P.Md) _ 4 ha1m hkm ha1b (fun y _ => hk y)
  have hI1 : IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + 2 * rfpLam P y) *

    refine hgen (fun y => 3 / 2 * y + 2 * rfpLam P y) (fun y => rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)))

      rfpBmp (s + 3) - κ * rfpBmp (s + 1)
    rw [show y5 + s - y5 + 3 = s + 3 by ring, show y5 + s - y5 + 1 = s + 1 by ring]

  have t_numeric : ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → lam ≤ 1 / 100 →

    intro lam h0 h1

    have hL4 : 4 ≤ Real.log (1 / lam) := by

      have he := Real.exp_one_lt_d9

    have hE : Real.exp (-((1 - 30 * lam) * L)) ≤ 5 / 19 := by nlinarith

    have hb : 0 < 1 - lam := by linarith
