    have h2 : (∫ y in a..a + 60, C * Real.exp (β * y)) =
        C / β * (Real.exp (β * (a + 60)) - Real.exp (β * a)) := by
      have hd : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a (a + 60),
          HasDerivAt (fun t => C / β * Real.exp (β * t)) (C * Real.exp (β * x)) x := by
        intro x _

    have hX : 0 < Real.exp y4 := Real.exp_pos _

        simp [Real.zero_rpow hne]

          rw [← Real.log_exp y4]; exact Real.log_le_log hx0 hx.2

          rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2), Real.exp_half, Real.exp_log hx0]

          rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add, mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 2; ring

          rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hx0, mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 2; ring

        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (Real.exp y4) := by
      refine hCi.mono_fun' hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable ?_

  have hL0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.lam) :=

  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = 2 * N5 * Real.exp (-((1 - lam) * y5)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hN5pos : 0 < N5 := by rw [hN5]; positivity

      Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + Λ y) ≤ C * Real.exp ((1 - lam) * y) := by
    intro y hy

            hC, hN5]

  have hβ : 0 < 1 - lam := by linarith
  have hx := t_xpart Λ y4 C lam hΛc hl0 (by linarith) (fun y hy => hdom y (by linarith))

  refine ⟨hx.1, ?_⟩

  have hsplit : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam), 2 * x * rfpF { P with ca := ca } x η) =
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam), 2 * x * rfpF { P with ca := ca } x η) +
      ∫ x in Real.exp (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)..Real.exp (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam),
        2 * x * rfpF { P with ca := ca } x η :=
    (intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals hgint1 hgint2).symm
  have hI1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam), 2 * x * rfpF { P with ca := ca } x η) =
      (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam),
        Real.sqrt (2 * x) * Real.exp (rfpLam P (Real.log x)) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr hlow, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  have hsub : (∫ x in Real.exp (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)..Real.exp (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam),
      2 * x * rfpF { P with ca := ca } x η) = ∫ y in rfpY4 P.Md P.lam..rfpY5 P.Md P.lam, H y := by
    have h := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_deriv' (a := rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)
      (b := rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (f := Real.exp) (f' := Real.exp)
      (g := fun x => 2 * x * rfpF { P with ca := ca } x η)
      (fun x _ => Real.hasDerivAt_exp x) Real.continuous_exp.continuousOn
      (hgc.mono (by rintro _ ⟨y, _, rfl⟩; exact Real.exp_pos y))
    refine h.symm.trans ?_
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun y _ => hpt y)
  rw [hsplit, hI1, hsub]
  have hi : ∀ a b, IntervalIntegrable H volume a b := fun a b => hHc.intervalIntegrable a b
  generalize rfpY4 P.Md P.lam = y4 at hth1 hth0 hord ⊢
  generalize rfpY5 P.Md P.lam = y5 at hord hψ0 ⊢
  have hw1 : (∫ y in y4..y4 + 60, H y) = ∫ y in y4..y4 + 60,
      Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro y hy
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by linarith)] at hy
    show H y = _
    rw [hH_s, hψ0 y (by linarith [hy.2])]
    simp only [mul_zero, add_zero, Real.sqrt_one, mul_one]
  have hw2 : (∫ y in y4 + 60..y5 - 4, H y) = ∫ y in y4 + 60..y5 - 4,
      Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro y hy
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hord] at hy
    show H y = _
    rw [hH_s, hψ0 y (by linarith [hy.2]), hth0 y (by linarith [hy.1])]
    simp only [Real.rpow_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, Real.sqrt_one, mul_one]
  have hw3 : (∫ y in y5 - 4..y5, H y) = ∫ y in y5 - 4..y5,
      Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y) * Real.sqrt (1 + ca η * rfpPsi P y) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro y hy
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by linarith)] at hy
    show H y = _
    rw [hH_s, hth0 y (by linarith [hy.1]), Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hi y4 (y4 + 60)) (hi (y4 + 60) y5),
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hi (y4 + 60) (y5 - 4)) (hi (y5 - 4) y5),
    hw1, hw2, hw3]
  ring

signature.name: exp_param_interval_integral
signature.statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (w θ : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous w → Continuous θ → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in a..b, w y * Real.exp (-(θ y * s))) ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in a..b, w y * Real.exp (-(θ y * s))) (∫ y in a..b, -(θ y) * (w y * Real.exp (-(θ y * s)))) s

proof.tactics:
by
  intro a b w θ hw hθ
  
  have hder : ∀ v : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous v → ∀ s₀ : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in a..b, v y * Real.exp (-(θ y * s)))
        (∫ y in a..b, -(θ y) * (v y * Real.exp (-(θ y * s₀)))) s₀ := by
    intro v hv s₀
    obtain ⟨Cv, hCv⟩ :=
      (isCompact_uIcc (a := a) (b := b)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hv.continuousOn
    obtain ⟨Cθ, hCθ⟩ :=
      (isCompact_uIcc (a := a) (b := b)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hθ.continuousOn
    have hCv0 : 0 ≤ max Cv 0 := le_max_right _ _
    have hCθ0 : 0 ≤ max Cθ 0 := le_max_right _ _
    have hcontF : ∀ x : ℝ, Continuous (fun t => v t * Real.exp (-(θ t * x))) := by
      intro x; fun_prop
    have hcontF' : ∀ x : ℝ, Continuous (fun t => -(θ t) * (v t * Real.exp (-(θ t * x)))) := by
      intro x; fun_prop
    have hbound : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIoc a b, ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball s₀ 1,
        ‖-(θ t) * (v t * Real.exp (-(θ t * x)))‖ ≤
          max Cθ 0 * (max Cv 0 * Real.exp (max Cθ 0 * (|s₀| + 1))) := by
      intro t ht x hx
      have ht' : t ∈ Set.uIcc a b := Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc ht
      have h1 : |v t| ≤ max Cv 0 :=
        le_trans (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hCv t ht') (le_max_left _ _)
      have h2 : |θ t| ≤ max Cθ 0 :=
        le_trans (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hCθ t ht') (le_max_left _ _)
      have hx' : |x| ≤ |s₀| + 1 := by
        have hd : dist x s₀ < 1 := hx
        rw [Real.dist_eq] at hd
        have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub x s₀
        linarith
      have h3 : Real.exp (-(θ t * x)) ≤ Real.exp (max Cθ 0 * (|s₀| + 1)) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        have e1 : -(θ t * x) ≤ |θ t * x| := neg_le_abs _
        rw [abs_mul] at e1
        have e2 : |θ t| * |x| ≤ max Cθ 0 * (|s₀| + 1) :=
          mul_le_mul h2 hx' (abs_nonneg _) hCθ0
        linarith
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_mul, Real.abs_exp]
      exact mul_le_mul h2 (mul_le_mul h1 h3 (Real.exp_pos _).le hCv0) (by positivity) hCθ0
    have hdx : ∀ t x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun x => v t * Real.exp (-(θ t * x)))
        (-(θ t) * (v t * Real.exp (-(θ t * x)))) x := by
      intro t x
      have h : HasDerivAt (fun x => v t * Real.exp (-(θ t * x)))
          (v t * (Real.exp (-(θ t * x)) * -(θ t * 1))) x :=
        (((hasDerivAt_id' x).const_mul (θ t)).neg.exp).const_mul (v t)
      exact h.congr_deriv (by ring)
    have key := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (a := a) (b := b)
      (F := fun x t => v t * Real.exp (-(θ t * x)))
      (F' := fun x t => -(θ t) * (v t * Real.exp (-(θ t * x))))
      (x₀ := s₀)
      (bound := fun _ => max Cθ 0 * (max Cv 0 * Real.exp (max Cθ 0 * (|s₀| + 1))))
      (Metric.ball_mem_nhds s₀ one_pos)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => (hcontF x).aestronglyMeasurable))
      ((hcontF s₀).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      ((hcontF' s₀).aestronglyMeasurable)
      (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun t ht x hx => hbound t ht x hx))
      intervalIntegrable_const
      (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun t _ x _ => hdx t x))
    exact key.2
  
  have hstep : ∀ v : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous v → ∀ s : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in a..b, v y * Real.exp (-(θ y * s)))
        ((fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in a..b, (-(θ y) * v y) * Real.exp (-(θ y * s))) s) s := by
    intro v hv s
    refine (hder v hv s).congr_deriv ?_
    show _ = ∫ y in a..b, (-(θ y) * v y) * Real.exp (-(θ y * s))
    congr 1
    funext y
    ring
  have hnat : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ v : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous v →
      ContDiff ℝ n (fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in a..b, v y * Real.exp (-(θ y * s))) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro v hv
      have hd : Differentiable ℝ (fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in a..b, v y * Real.exp (-(θ y * s))) :=
        fun s => (hstep v hv s).differentiableAt
      rw [Nat.cast_zero]
      exact contDiff_zero.mpr hd.continuous
    | succ n ih =>
      intro v hv
      have hd : Differentiable ℝ (fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in a..b, v y * Real.exp (-(θ y * s))) :=
        fun s => (hstep v hv s).differentiableAt
      have hderiv : deriv (fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in a..b, v y * Real.exp (-(θ y * s))) =
          (fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in a..b, (-(θ y) * v y) * Real.exp (-(θ y * s))) := by
        funext s; exact (hstep v hv s).deriv
      have hT : Continuous (fun y => -(θ y) * v y) := hθ.neg.mul hv
      have hih := ih (fun y => -(θ y) * v y) hT
      rw [show ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) = (n : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 by push_cast; rfl]
      refine contDiff_succ_iff_deriv.mpr ⟨hd, fun h => absurd h (by simp), ?_⟩
      rw [hderiv]
      exact hih
  exact ⟨contDiff_infty.mpr (fun n => hnat n w hw), hder w hw⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (a b M : ℝ) (u v : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < M → Continuous u → Continuous v → (∀ s : ℝ, |v s| ≤ M) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun c : ℝ => ∫ s in a..b, u s * (Real.sqrt (1 + c * v s) - 1)) (Ioo (-(1 / M)) (1 / M)) ∧ ∀ c : ℝ, -(1 / M) < c → c < 1 / M → HasDerivAt (fun c : ℝ => ∫ s in a..b, u s * (Real.sqrt (1 + c * v s) - 1)) (∫ s in a..b, u s * v s / (2 * Real.sqrt (1 + c * v s))) c

signature.name: sqrt_param_interval_integral
signature.statement: ∀ (a b M : ℝ) (u v : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < M → Continuous u → Continuous v → (∀ s : ℝ, |v s| ≤ M) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun c : ℝ => ∫ s in a..b, u s * (Real.sqrt (1 + c * v s) - 1)) (Ioo (-(1 / M)) (1 / M)) ∧ ∀ c : ℝ, -(1 / M) < c → c < 1 / M → HasDerivAt (fun c : ℝ => ∫ s in a..b, u s * (Real.sqrt (1 + c * v s) - 1)) (∫ s in a..b, u s * v s / (2 * Real.sqrt (1 + c * v s))) c

proof.tactics:
by
  intro a b M u v hM hu hv hvM
  
  have hpos : ∀ c : ℝ, -(1 / M) < c → c < 1 / M → ∀ s, 0 < 1 + c * v s := by
    intro c h1 h2 s
    have hc : |c| < 1 / M := abs_lt.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have hcM : |c| * M < 1 := by rwa [lt_div_iff₀ hM] at hc
    have hcv : |c * v s| ≤ |c| * M := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hvM s) (abs_nonneg _)
    have := neg_abs_le (c * v s)
    linarith
  
  have key : ∀ (p : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous w → ∀ c₀ : ℝ, -(1 / M) < c₀ → c₀ < 1 / M →
      HasDerivAt (fun c : ℝ => ∫ s in a..b, w s * (1 + c * v s) ^ p)
        (∫ s in a..b, p * w s * v s * (1 + c₀ * v s) ^ (p - 1)) c₀ := by
    intro p w hw c₀ h1 h2
    have hc : |c₀| < 1 / M := abs_lt.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have hcM : |c₀| * M < 1 := by rwa [lt_div_iff₀ hM] at hc
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, δ = 1 - |c₀| * M := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hδpos : 0 < δ := by linarith
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = δ / (2 * M) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hrpos : 0 < r := by rw [hr]; exact div_pos hδpos (by linarith)
    have hrM : r * M = δ / 2 := by rw [hr]; field_simp
    have hwin : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c₀ r, ∀ t, δ / 2 ≤ 1 + x * v t ∧ 1 + x * v t ≤ 2 := by
      intro x hx t
      have hx' : |x - c₀| < r := by rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] at hx; exact hx
      have hxabs : |x| ≤ |c₀| + r := by
        have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub x c₀
        linarith
      have hxv : |x * v t| ≤ (|c₀| + r) * M := by
        rw [abs_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul hxabs (hvM t) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      have hxv' : |x * v t| ≤ |c₀| * M + r * M := by rw [add_mul] at hxv; exact hxv
      have hab := abs_le.mp hxv'
      constructor <;> linarith [hab.1, hab.2]
    have hK : ∀ y : ℝ, δ / 2 ≤ y → y ≤ 2 → y ^ (p - 1) ≤ (δ / 2) ^ (p - 1) + (2 : ℝ) ^ (p - 1) := by
      intro y hy1 hy2
      have hA : 0 < (δ / 2) ^ (p - 1) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith) _
      have hB : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ (p - 1) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
      rcases le_total 0 (p - 1) with hq | hq
      · have := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by linarith) hy2 hq
        linarith
      · have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by linarith) hy1 hq
        linarith
    have hKpos : 0 ≤ (δ / 2) ^ (p - 1) + (2 : ℝ) ^ (p - 1) :=
      add_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _)
    have hball : Metric.ball c₀ r ∈ nhds c₀ := Metric.ball_mem_nhds c₀ hrpos
    have hmeas : ∀ x : ℝ, Measurable (fun t => w t * (1 + x * v t) ^ p) := fun x =>
      hw.measurable.mul ((measurable_const.add (measurable_const.mul hv.measurable)).pow_const p)
    have hmeas' : Measurable (fun t => p * w t * v t * (1 + c₀ * v t) ^ (p - 1)) :=
      ((measurable_const.mul hw.measurable).mul hv.measurable).mul
        ((measurable_const.add (measurable_const.mul hv.measurable)).pow_const (p - 1))
    have hpos0 : ∀ t, 0 < 1 + c₀ * v t := hpos c₀ h1 h2
    have hcont0 : Continuous (fun t => w t * (1 + c₀ * v t) ^ p) :=
      hw.mul ((continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul hv)).rpow_const
        (fun t => Or.inl (hpos0 t).ne'))
    have hres := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (μ := volume) (a := a) (b := b)
      (F := fun x t => w t * (1 + x * v t) ^ p)
      (F' := fun x t => p * w t * v t * (1 + x * v t) ^ (p - 1))
      (bound := fun t => |p| * M * ((δ / 2) ^ (p - 1) + (2 : ℝ) ^ (p - 1)) * |w t|) hball
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => (hmeas x).aestronglyMeasurable))
      (hcont0.intervalIntegrable a b)
      hmeas'.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t _ x hx => by
        obtain ⟨hy1, hy2⟩ := hwin x hx t
        have hy0 : 0 ≤ (1 + x * v t) ^ (p - 1) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
        have hyK := hK _ hy1 hy2
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hy0]
        have h1 : |p| * |w t| * |v t| ≤ |p| * |w t| * M :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hvM t) (by positivity)
        calc |p| * |w t| * |v t| * (1 + x * v t) ^ (p - 1)
            ≤ |p| * |w t| * M * ((δ / 2) ^ (p - 1) + (2 : ℝ) ^ (p - 1)) :=
              mul_le_mul h1 hyK hy0 (by positivity)
          _ = |p| * M * ((δ / 2) ^ (p - 1) + (2 : ℝ) ^ (p - 1)) * |w t| := by ring))
      ((continuous_const.mul hw.abs).intervalIntegrable a b)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t _ x hx => by
        obtain ⟨hy1, _⟩ := hwin x hx t
        have hp : 0 < 1 + x * v t := by linarith
        have hd : HasDerivAt (fun y => 1 + y * v t) (v t) x := by
          convert ((hasDerivAt_id' x).mul_const (v t)).const_add 1 using 1
          ring
        have := (hd.rpow_const (p := p) (Or.inl hp.ne')).const_mul (w t)
        convert this using 1
        ring))
    exact hres.2
  
  have fam : ∀ (S : Set ℝ) (P : (ℝ → ℝ) → Prop), IsOpen S →
      (∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, P f → ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ, P g ∧ ∀ x ∈ S, HasDerivAt f (g x) x) →
      ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, P f → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f S := by
    intro S P hS hcl
    have hn : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, P f → ContDiffOn ℝ n f S := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        intro f hf
        obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := hcl f hf
        rw [Nat.cast_zero, contDiffOn_zero]
        exact fun x hx => (hg x hx).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      | succ n ih =>
        intro f hf
        obtain ⟨g, hgP, hg⟩ := hcl f hf
        rw [Nat.cast_succ, contDiffOn_succ_iff_deriv_of_isOpen hS]
        refine ⟨fun x hx => (hg x hx).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro h; simp at h
        · exact (ih g hgP).congr (fun x hx => (hg x hx).deriv)
    intro f hf
    exact contDiffOn_infty.mpr (fun n => hn n f hf)
  
  have hfun : (fun c : ℝ => ∫ s in a..b, u s * (Real.sqrt (1 + c * v s) - 1)) =
      fun c : ℝ => (∫ s in a..b, u s * (1 + c * v s) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) - ∫ s in a..b, u s := by
    funext c
    have h1 : Continuous (fun s => u s * (1 + c * v s) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :=
      hu.mul ((continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul hv)).rpow_const
        (fun _ => Or.inr (by norm_num)))
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (h1.intervalIntegrable a b) (hu.intervalIntegrable a b)]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun s _ => ?_)
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    ring
  have hderiv : ∀ c : ℝ, -(1 / M) < c → c < 1 / M →
      HasDerivAt (fun c : ℝ => ∫ s in a..b, u s * (Real.sqrt (1 + c * v s) - 1))
        (∫ s in a..b, u s * v s / (2 * Real.sqrt (1 + c * v s))) c := by
    intro c h1 h2
    rw [hfun]
    have := (key (1 / 2) u hu c h1 h2).sub_const (∫ s in a..b, u s)
    convert this using 1
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun s _ => ?_)
    have hp := hpos c h1 h2 s
    have hsq : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 + c * v s) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hp
    have e : (1 + c * v s) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2 - 1) = (Real.sqrt (1 + c * v s))⁻¹ := by
      rw [show (1 : ℝ) / 2 - 1 = -(1 / 2) by norm_num, Real.rpow_neg hp.le, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    rw [e]
    field_simp
  have hcd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun c : ℝ => ∫ s in a..b, u s * (1 + c * v s) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ))
      (Ioo (-(1 / M)) (1 / M)) := by
    refine fam (Ioo (-(1 / M)) (1 / M))
      (fun g => ∃ (p : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous w ∧
        g = fun c => ∫ s in a..b, w s * (1 + c * v s) ^ p) isOpen_Ioo ?_ _ ⟨1 / 2, u, hu, rfl⟩
    rintro g ⟨p, w, hw, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨_, ⟨p - 1, fun s => p * w s * v s, (continuous_const.mul hw).mul hv, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    exact key p w hw x hx.1 hx.2
  refine ⟨?_, hderiv⟩
  rw [hfun]
  exact hcd.sub contDiffOn_const

by
  intro b lam κ c hbc hb01 hbsupp hblow hlam0 hlam1 hκ7 hκ8 hc
  obtain ⟨hc1, hc2⟩ := abs_le.mp hc
  
  have he14 : Real.exp (-(14 / 5)) ≤ 1 / 12 := by

    have h2 := Real.add_one_le_exp (4 / 5 : ℝ)
    have hsplit : Real.exp (14 / 5) = Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 * Real.exp (4 / 5) := by

        (by positivity)
      linarith
    have hm : Real.exp (-(14 / 5)) * Real.exp (14 / 5) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-(14 / 5))]
  have he43 : 1 / 3 ≤ Real.exp (-(43 / 40)) := by
    have h1 := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
    have h2 := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(3 / 40) : ℝ)
    have hm : Real.exp (3 / 40) * Real.exp (-(3 / 40)) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
    have h3 : Real.exp (3 / 40) ≤ 40 / 37 := by
      nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (3 / 40)]
    have hsplit : Real.exp (43 / 40) = Real.exp 1 * Real.exp (3 / 40) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
    have h4 : Real.exp (43 / 40) ≤ 3 := by
      rw [hsplit]
      have := mul_le_mul h1.le h3 (Real.exp_pos _).le (by norm_num)
      linarith
    have hm2 : Real.exp (-(43 / 40)) * Real.exp (43 / 40) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-(43 / 40)), Real.exp_pos (43 / 40)]
  
  have hpos : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < 1 + c * (b (s + 3) - κ * b (s + 1)) := by
    intro s
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hb01 (s + 3)
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := hb01 (s + 1)
    have hk0 : 0 ≤ κ * b (s + 1) := mul_nonneg (by linarith) h3
    have hk8 : κ * b (s + 1) ≤ 8 := by nlinarith
    rcases le_total 0 (b (s + 3) - κ * b (s + 1)) with hy | hy
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ c + 1 / 16) hy]
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / 16 - c) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ -(b (s + 3) - κ * b (s + 1)))]
  have hD : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < 2 * Real.sqrt (1 + c * (b (s + 3) - κ * b (s + 1))) := by
    intro s
    have := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hpos s)
    linarith
  
  have hA : ∀ s : ℝ, 3 / 20 ≤ |s + 3| →
      Real.exp ((1 - lam) * s) * (b (s + 3) - κ * b (s + 1)) /
        (2 * Real.sqrt (1 + c * (b (s + 3) - κ * b (s + 1)))) ≤ 0 := by
    intro s hs
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (hD s), zero_mul, hbsupp _ hs]
    have h3 := (hb01 (s + 1)).1
    have hk0 : 0 ≤ κ * b (s + 1) := mul_nonneg (by linarith) h3
    have hE := Real.exp_pos ((1 - lam) * s)
    nlinarith
  
  have hB : ∀ s : ℝ, -(63 / 20) ≤ s → s ≤ -(57 / 20) →
      Real.exp ((1 - lam) * s) * (b (s + 3) - κ * b (s + 1)) /
        (2 * Real.sqrt (1 + c * (b (s + 3) - κ * b (s + 1)))) ≤ 8 / 15 * Real.exp (-(14 / 5)) := by
    intro s hs1 hs2
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (hD s)]
    have hb1 : b (s + 1) = 0 := hbsupp _ (by rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith)
    have hy := hpos s
    rw [hb1, mul_zero, sub_zero] at hy ⊢
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hb01 (s + 3)
    have hr0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + c * b (s + 3))
    have hr2 := Real.sq_sqrt hy.le
    have hcy : -(1 / 16) ≤ c * b (s + 3) := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ c + 1 / 16) h1]
    have hr : 15 / 16 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + c * b (s + 3)) := by
      nlinarith
    have hE : Real.exp ((1 - lam) * s) ≤ Real.exp (-(14 / 5)) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      nlinarith
    have hE0 := Real.exp_pos ((1 - lam) * s)
    have hE140 := Real.exp_pos (-(14 / 5))
    have k1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hE0.le
    have k2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr hE140.le
    nlinarith
  
  have hC : ∀ s : ℝ, -(43 / 40) ≤ s → s ≤ -(37 / 40) →
      Real.exp ((1 - lam) * s) * (b (s + 3) - κ * b (s + 1)) /
        (2 * Real.sqrt (1 + c * (b (s + 3) - κ * b (s + 1)))) ≤ -(4 / 5) * Real.exp (-(43 / 40)) := by
    intro s hs1 hs2
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (hD s)]
    have hb3 : b (s + 3) = 0 := hbsupp _ (by rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith)
    have hb1 : 1 / 4 ≤ b (s + 1) := hblow _ (abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
    have hy := hpos s
    rw [hb3] at hy ⊢
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hb01 (s + 1)
    have hz1 : 7 / 4 ≤ κ * b (s + 1) := by nlinarith
    have hz2 : κ * b (s + 1) ≤ 8 := by nlinarith
    have hr0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + c * (0 - κ * b (s + 1)))
    have hr2 := Real.sq_sqrt hy.le
    have hcz : 1 + c * (0 - κ * b (s + 1)) ≤ 1 + κ * b (s + 1) / 16 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ c + 1 / 16) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ κ * b (s + 1))]
    have hr : Real.sqrt (1 + c * (0 - κ * b (s + 1))) ≤ 5 / 8 * (κ * b (s + 1)) := by
      nlinarith
    have hE : Real.exp (-(43 / 40)) ≤ Real.exp ((1 - lam) * s) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      nlinarith
    have hE0 := Real.exp_pos ((1 - lam) * s)
    have hE430 := Real.exp_pos (-(43 / 40))
    have k1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hE (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ κ * b (s + 1))
    have k2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr hE430.le
    nlinarith
  
  have hcont : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp ((1 - lam) * s) * (b (s + 3) - κ * b (s + 1)) /
        (2 * Real.sqrt (1 + c * (b (s + 3) - κ * b (s + 1))))) := by
    apply Continuous.div
    · fun_prop
    · fun_prop
    · intro s; exact (hD s).ne'
  have hint : ∀ a a' : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp ((1 - lam) * s) * (b (s + 3) - κ * b (s + 1)) /
        (2 * Real.sqrt (1 + c * (b (s + 3) - κ * b (s + 1))))) MeasureTheory.volume a a' :=
    fun a a' => hcont.intervalIntegrable a a'
  have piece : ∀ a a' C : ℝ, a ≤ a' → (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc a a', Real.exp ((1 - lam) * s) * (b (s + 3) - κ * b (s + 1)) /
        (2 * Real.sqrt (1 + c * (b (s + 3) - κ * b (s + 1)))) ≤ C) →
      (∫ s in a..a', Real.exp ((1 - lam) * s) * (b (s + 3) - κ * b (s + 1)) /
        (2 * Real.sqrt (1 + c * (b (s + 3) - κ * b (s + 1))))) ≤ (a' - a) * C := by
    intro a a' C hle h
    have := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hle (hint a a') intervalIntegrable_const h
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul] at this
    exact this
  have p1 := piece (-4) (-(63 / 20)) 0 (by norm_num) (fun s hs => hA s (by
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith [hs.2])]; linarith [hs.2]))
  have p2 := piece (-(63 / 20)) (-(57 / 20)) _ (by norm_num) (fun s hs => hB s hs.1 hs.2)
  have p3 := piece (-(57 / 20)) (-(43 / 40)) 0 (by norm_num) (fun s hs => hA s (by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [hs.1])]; linarith [hs.1]))
  have p4 := piece (-(43 / 40)) (-(37 / 40)) _ (by norm_num) (fun s hs => hC s hs.1 hs.2)
  have p5 := piece (-(37 / 40)) 0 0 (by norm_num) (fun s hs => hA s (by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [hs.1])]; linarith [hs.1]))
  have e1 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hint (-4) (-(63 / 20))) (hint (-(63 / 20)) 0)
  have e2 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hint (-(63 / 20)) (-(57 / 20))) (hint (-(57 / 20)) 0)
  have e3 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hint (-(57 / 20)) (-(43 / 40))) (hint (-(43 / 40)) 0)
  have e4 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hint (-(43 / 40)) (-(37 / 40))) (hint (-(37 / 40)) 0)
  rw [← e1, ← e2, ← e3, ← e4]
  nlinarith

informal_problem.statement: (∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → sigA y = 0) ∧ (∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → sigA y = 1) ∧ (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA y ∧ sigA y ≤ 1) ∧ Continuous sigA ∧ Continuous rfpSigI ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → rfpSigI t = 0) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → rfpSigI t = t - 1 + rfpSigI 1) ∧ 0 ≤ rfpSigI 1 ∧ rfpSigI 1 ≤ 1

signature.name: rfp_sig_basics
signature.statement: (∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → sigA y = 0) ∧ (∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → sigA y = 1) ∧ (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA y ∧ sigA y ≤ 1) ∧ Continuous sigA ∧ Continuous rfpSigI ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → rfpSigI t = 0) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → rfpSigI t = t - 1 + rfpSigI 1) ∧ 0 ≤ rfpSigI 1 ∧ rfpSigI 1 ≤ 1

proof.tactics:
by
  have h1 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → sigA y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    unfold sigA
    rw [if_pos hy]
  have h2 : ∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → sigA y = 1 := by
    intro y hy
    unfold sigA
    rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hy]
  have h3 : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA y ∧ sigA y ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
    · have ha := Real.exp_pos (-1 / y ^ 2)
      have hb := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)
      refine ⟨div_nonneg ha.le (by linarith), ?_⟩
      rw [div_le_one (by linarith)]
      linarith
  have hcont : Continuous sigA := by
    set G : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => expNegInvGlue (max y 0 ^ 2) with hG
    have hGc : Continuous G :=
      ((expNegInvGlue.contDiff (n := 0)).continuous).comp ((continuous_id.max continuous_const).pow 2)
    have hG0 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → G y = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      simp only [hG, max_eq_right hy]
      exact expNegInvGlue.zero_of_nonpos (by norm_num)
    have hGp : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → G y = Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) := by
      intro y hy
      simp only [hG, max_eq_left hy.le]
      unfold expNegInvGlue
      rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr (pow_pos hy 2)), neg_div, one_div]
    have hGpos : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → 0 < G y := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hGp y hy]; exact Real.exp_pos _
    have hGnn : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ G y := by
      intro y
      rcases le_or_gt y 0 with hy | hy
      · rw [hG0 y hy]
      · exact (hGpos y hy).le
    have hden : ∀ y : ℝ, G y + G (1 - y) ≠ 0 := by
      intro y
      rcases le_or_gt y 0 with hy | hy
      · have := hGpos (1 - y) (by linarith)
        have := hGnn y
        linarith
      · have := hGpos y hy
        have := hGnn (1 - y)
        linarith
    have heq : sigA = fun y => G y / (G y + G (1 - y)) := by
      funext y
      unfold sigA
      split_ifs with hy0 hy1
      · rw [hG0 y hy0, zero_div]
      · rw [hG0 (1 - y) (by linarith), add_zero, div_self (hGpos y (by linarith)).ne']
      · push_neg at hy0 hy1
        rw [hGp y hy0, hGp (1 - y) (by linarith)]
    rw [heq]
    exact hGc.div (hGc.add (hGc.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))) hden
  have hII : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable sigA MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
    fun a b => hcont.intervalIntegrable a b
  have hS : Continuous rfpSigI := by
    show Continuous (fun t => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, sigA s)
    exact intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive hII 0
  have h6 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → rfpSigI t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    show (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, sigA s) = 0
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ))]
    · simp
    · intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge ht] at hs
      exact h1 s hs.2
  have h7 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → rfpSigI t = t - 1 + rfpSigI 1 := by
    intro t ht
    show (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, sigA s) = t - 1 + ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, sigA s
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hII 0 1) (hII 1 t)]
    have e : (∫ s in (1:ℝ)..t, sigA s) = ∫ s in (1:ℝ)..t, (1:ℝ) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le ht] at hs
      exact h2 s hs.1
    rw [e, intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    ring
  have h8 : 0 ≤ rfpSigI 1 := by
    show 0 ≤ ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, sigA s
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num) (fun u _ => (h3 u).1)
  have h9 : rfpSigI 1 ≤ 1 := by
    show (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, sigA s) ≤ 1
    have := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1) (hII 0 1)
      (intervalIntegrable_const : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1)
      (fun x _ => (h3 x).2)
    simpa using this
  exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, hcont, hS, h6, h7, h8, h9⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → ∀ L : ℝ, 0 ≤ L → (∀ y : ℝ, rfpPsi { P with Lh := L } y = rfpPsi P y) ∧ ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 2 + P.T1 → rfpLam { P with Lh := L } y = rfpLam P y ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, rfpE { P with Lh := L } y η = rfpE P y η

signature.name: rfp_lh_shift_head
signature.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → ∀ L : ℝ, 0 ≤ L → (∀ y : ℝ, rfpPsi { P with Lh := L } y = rfpPsi P y) ∧ ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 2 + P.T1 → rfpLam { P with Lh := L } y = rfpLam P y ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, rfpE { P with Lh := L } y η = rfpE P y η

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hReg L hL
  obtain ⟨_hMd, _hPst, hlam0, hlam1, hh0, hhl, _hρ0, _hρh, hT1, hLhP⟩ := hReg
  have hh1 : P.h ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.h) := Real.log_nonneg (one_le_one_div hh0 hh1)
  have hT0 : 0 ≤ P.T1 := by linarith
  have hsig0 : ∀ z : ℝ, z ≤ 0 → sigA z = 0 := fun z hz => by unfold sigA; rw [if_pos hz]
  have htail : ∀ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M → ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 2 + P.T1 →
      tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 M)) (Real.exp y) = 1 - P.ρ := by
    intro M hM y hy
    unfold tailFac
    rw [← Real.exp_sub, Real.log_exp, hsig0]
    · ring
    · unfold rfpYb; linarith
  have hlam : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 2 + P.T1 →
      rfpLam { P with Lh := L } y = rfpLam P y := by
    intro y hy
    unfold rfpLam
    dsimp only
    rw [htail L hL y hy, htail P.Lh hLhP y hy]
  have hbmp : ∀ y k : ℝ, 1 ≤ k → rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 2 + P.T1 < y →
      rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + k) = 0 := by
    intro y k hk hy
    unfold rfpBmp
    rw [hsig0 (1 - (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + k) / (3 / 20)) ?_, mul_zero]
    have h3 : 3 ≤ y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + k := by linarith
    have e : (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + k) / (3 / 20) = 20 / 3 * (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + k) := by ring
    rw [e]; linarith
  have hint : ∀ k : ℝ, 1 ≤ k →
      (fun y => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam { P with Lh := L } y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + k)) =
        fun y => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + k) := by
    intro k hk
    funext y
    by_cases hy : y ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 2 + P.T1
    · rw [hlam y hy]
    · rw [hbmp y k hk (not_le.mp hy), mul_zero, mul_zero]
  have hKa : rfpKa { P with Lh := L } = rfpKa P := by
    have h3 := hint 3 (by norm_num)
    have h1 := hint 1 le_rfl
    unfold rfpKa
    exact congrArg₂ (· / ·) (congrArg (fun f : ℝ → ℝ => ∫ y, f y) h3)
      (congrArg (fun f : ℝ → ℝ => ∫ y, f y) h1)
  have hpsi : ∀ y : ℝ, rfpPsi { P with Lh := L } y = rfpPsi P y := by
    intro y
    unfold rfpPsi
    rw [hKa]
  refine ⟨hpsi, fun y hy => ⟨hlam y hy, fun η => ?_⟩⟩
  unfold rfpE rfpTh
  dsimp only
  rw [hlam y hy, hpsi y]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ R : RfpPar, RfpRegime R → (∀ x η : ℝ, Real.exp (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1) ≤ x → x ≤ Real.exp (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1 + R.T1) → 2 * x * rfpF R x η = Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1) + rfpLam R (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1)) / x) ∧ rfpCi R * Real.exp ((1 - R.h) * (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 2 + R.T1)) = Real.exp (3 / 2 * (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1) + rfpLam R (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1) + (1 - R.h) * rfpSigI 1) / (1 - R.ρ) ∧ ∀ x η : ℝ, Real.exp (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 2 + R.T1) ≤ x → 2 * x * rfpF R x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * rfpCi R * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + R.h)) = -(Real.sqrt 2 * rfpCi R * R.ρ * x ^ (-R.h) * (1 - sigA ((Real.log (x / rfpXb R) + 2) / 2)))

signature.name: rfp_T_pointwise
signature.statement: ∀ R : RfpPar, RfpRegime R → (∀ x η : ℝ, Real.exp (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1) ≤ x → x ≤ Real.exp (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1 + R.T1) → 2 * x * rfpF R x η = Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 / 2 * (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1) + rfpLam R (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1)) / x) ∧ rfpCi R * Real.exp ((1 - R.h) * (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 2 + R.T1)) = Real.exp (3 / 2 * (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1) + rfpLam R (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1) + (1 - R.h) * rfpSigI 1) / (1 - R.ρ) ∧ ∀ x η : ℝ, Real.exp (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 2 + R.T1) ≤ x → 2 * x * rfpF R x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * rfpCi R * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + R.h)) = -(Real.sqrt 2 * rfpCi R * R.ρ * x ^ (-R.h) * (1 - sigA ((Real.log (x / rfpXb R) + 2) / 2)))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro R hReg
  have hReg' := hReg
  obtain ⟨_hMd, _hPst, hlam0, hlam1, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hReg'
  obtain ⟨⟨hy4, -, -⟩, -, hclamp, -, -⟩ := rfp_clamp_identities R hReg
  obtain ⟨hs0, hs1, hs01, -, -, hSig0, hSig1, -, -⟩ := rfp_sig_basics
  have hh4 : R.h ≤ 1 / 10000 := by nlinarith
  have hρ1 : R.ρ < 1 := by linarith
  have h1ρ : 0 < 1 - R.ρ := by linarith
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / R.h) := Real.log_nonneg (one_le_one_div hh0 (by linarith))
  have hT0 : 0 ≤ R.T1 := by linarith
  have hℓ : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / R.lam) := Real.log_nonneg (one_le_one_div hlam0 (by linarith))
  have h13 : 0 < 13 / R.lam := by positivity
  have hyb : rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh = rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 2 + R.T1 + R.Lh + 3 := rfl
  have hy54 : rfpY5 R.Md R.lam = rfpY4 R.Md R.lam + 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / R.lam) := rfl
  have hy43 : rfpY4 R.Md R.lam = rfpY3 R.Md R.lam + 13 / R.lam := rfl
  have hy32 : rfpY3 R.Md R.lam = rfpY2 R.Md + 1 + 60 * Real.log (1 / R.lam) := rfl
  have hy5a : rfpY4 R.Md R.lam + 60 ≤ rfpY5 R.Md R.lam := by linarith
  have hy5b : 61 ≤ rfpY5 R.Md R.lam := by linarith
  have hy5c : rfpY2 R.Md + 61 ≤ rfpY5 R.Md R.lam := by linarith
  
  have hTF : ∀ y : ℝ, tailFac R.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh)) (Real.exp y) =
      1 - R.ρ * (1 - sigA ((y - rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh + 2) / 2)) := by
    intro y
    unfold tailFac
    rw [← Real.exp_sub, Real.log_exp]
  have hTFpos : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < tailFac R.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh)) (Real.exp y) := by
    intro y
    rw [hTF y]
    have hs := hs01 ((y - rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh + 2) / 2)
    have : R.ρ * (1 - sigA ((y - rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh + 2) / 2)) ≤ R.ρ :=
      mul_le_of_le_one_right hρ0.le (by linarith)
    linarith
  have hLT0 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh - 2 →
      Real.log (tailFac R.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh)) (Real.exp y) / (1 - R.ρ)) = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hTF y, hs0 ((y - rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh + 2) / 2) (by linarith)]
    rw [show (1:ℝ) - R.ρ * (1 - 0) = 1 - R.ρ by ring, div_self h1ρ.ne', Real.log_one]
  
  have hramp : ∀ z : ℝ, rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1 ≤ z → 3 / 2 * z + rfpLam R z =
      3 / 2 * (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1) + rfpLam R (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1)
        + (1 - R.h) * rfpSigI (z - rfpY5 R.Md R.lam - 1 - R.T1)
        + Real.log (tailFac R.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh)) (Real.exp z) / (1 - R.ρ)) := by
    have hAff : ∀ u : ℝ, rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1 ≤ u →
        rfpSigI u = u - 1 + rfpSigI 1 ∧
        rfpSigI (u - rfpY2 R.Md) = u - rfpY2 R.Md - 1 + rfpSigI 1 ∧
        rfpSigI (u - rfpY5 R.Md R.lam) = u - rfpY5 R.Md R.lam - 1 + rfpSigI 1 ∧
        sigA ((u - rfpY4 R.Md R.lam) / 60) = 1 := by
      intro u hu
      exact ⟨hSig1 u (by linarith), hSig1 _ (by linarith), hSig1 _ (by linarith),
        hs1 _ (by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith)⟩
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4⟩ := hAff z hz
    obtain ⟨b1, b2, b3, b4⟩ := hAff (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1) le_rfl
    have b5 : rfpSigI (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1 - rfpY5 R.Md R.lam - 1 - R.T1) = 0 :=
      hSig0 _ (by linarith)
    have b6 := hLT0 (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1) (by linarith [hyb])
    unfold rfpLam
    rw [a1, a2, a3, a4, b1, b2, b3, b4, b5, b6]
    ring
  
  have hsx : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → Real.sqrt (2 * x) = Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (Real.log x / 2) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2), Real.exp_half, Real.exp_log hx]
  have hclampF : ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → rfpY5 R.Md R.lam ≤ Real.log x →
      2 * x * rfpF R x η = Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (Real.log x / 2 + rfpLam R (Real.log x)) := by
    intro x η hx hy
    unfold rfpF rfpE
    rw [mul_assoc (Real.exp (rfpLam R (Real.log x))), hclamp _ η hy, mul_one]
    have hs2 : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * x) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
    calc 2 * x * (Real.exp (rfpLam R (Real.log x)) / Real.sqrt (2 * x))
        = Real.sqrt (2 * x) * Real.sqrt (2 * x) *
            (Real.exp (rfpLam R (Real.log x)) / Real.sqrt (2 * x)) := by
          rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt (by linarith)]
      _ = Real.sqrt (2 * x) * Real.exp (rfpLam R (Real.log x)) := by
          field_simp
      _ = _ := by rw [hsx x hx, Real.exp_add]; ring
  
  obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = rfpLam R (rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh - 3) +
      (1 / 2 + R.h) * (rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh - 3) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hci : rfpCi R = Real.exp A / (1 - R.ρ) := by rw [hAdef]; rfl
  have key : A + (1 - R.h) * (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 2 + R.T1) =
      3 / 2 * (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1) + rfpLam R (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1) + (1 - R.h) * rfpSigI 1 := by
    have hw : rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1 ≤ rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh - 3 := by linarith [hyb]
    have hr := hramp _ hw
    rw [hSig1 (rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh - 3 - rfpY5 R.Md R.lam - 1 - R.T1) (by linarith [hyb]),
      hLT0 (rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh - 3) (by linarith)] at hr
    rw [hAdef]
    linear_combination hr
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro x η hx1 hx2
    have hx : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hx1
    have hy1 : rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1 ≤ Real.log x := (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hx).2 hx1
    have hy2 : Real.log x ≤ rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1 + R.T1 := (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hx).2 hx2
    rw [hclampF x η hx (by linarith)]
    have hr := hramp (Real.log x) hy1
    rw [hSig0 (Real.log x - rfpY5 R.Md R.lam - 1 - R.T1) (by linarith),
      hLT0 (Real.log x) (by linarith [hyb])] at hr
    have he : Real.log x / 2 + rfpLam R (Real.log x) =
        (3 / 2 * (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1) + rfpLam R (rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 1)) - Real.log x := by
      linarith
    rw [he, Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log hx, mul_div_assoc]
  · 
    rw [hci, div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← Real.exp_add, key]
  · 
    intro x η hx1
    have hx : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hx1
    have hy : rfpY5 R.Md R.lam + 2 + R.T1 ≤ Real.log x := (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hx).2 hx1
    have hr := hramp (Real.log x) (by linarith)
    rw [hSig1 (Real.log x - rfpY5 R.Md R.lam - 1 - R.T1) (by linarith)] at hr
    have hexp : Real.log x / 2 + rfpLam R (Real.log x) = A + -(R.h * Real.log x) +
        Real.log (tailFac R.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh)) (Real.exp (Real.log x)) /
          (1 - R.ρ)) := by
      linear_combination hr - key
    have f2 : Real.exp (Real.log x / 2 + rfpLam R (Real.log x)) =
        rfpCi R * Real.exp (-(R.h * Real.log x)) *
          (1 - R.ρ * (1 - sigA ((Real.log x - rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh + 2) / 2))) := by
      rw [hexp, Real.exp_add (A + -(R.h * Real.log x)), Real.exp_add A,
        Real.exp_log (div_pos (hTFpos (Real.log x)) h1ρ), hTF, hci]
      field_simp
    have f3 : Real.sqrt (2 * x) * rfpCi R * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + R.h)) =
        Real.sqrt 2 * rfpCi R * Real.exp (-(R.h * Real.log x)) := by
      rw [hsx x hx, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hx]
      have e : Real.exp (Real.log x / 2) * Real.exp (Real.log x * -(1 / 2 + R.h)) =
          Real.exp (-(R.h * Real.log x)) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
      rw [← e]; ring
    have f4 : x ^ (-R.h) = Real.exp (-(R.h * Real.log x)) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hx]; congr 1; ring
    have f5 : Real.log (x / rfpXb R) = Real.log x - rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh := by
      unfold rfpXb
      rw [Real.log_div hx.ne' (Real.exp_pos _).ne', Real.log_exp]
    rw [hclampF x η hx (by linarith), f2, f3, f4, f5]
    ring

subgoal_signatures.name: rfp_clamp_identities
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → (1 ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ∧ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ∧ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ≤ rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam → ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y) * Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y) = (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ≤ y → ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y) * Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y) = 1) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, y ≤ 1 → η * rfpK P.Md y + rfpE P y η * rfpRb P y η = 4 * η) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ≤ y → η * rfpK P.Md y + rfpE P y η * rfpRb P y η = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: rfp_sig_basics
subgoal_signatures.statement: (∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → sigA y = 0) ∧ (∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → sigA y = 1) ∧ (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA y ∧ sigA y ≤ 1) ∧ Continuous sigA ∧ Continuous rfpSigI ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → rfpSigI t = 0) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → rfpSigI t = t - 1 + rfpSigI 1) ∧ 0 ≤ rfpSigI 1 ∧ rfpSigI 1 ≤ 1

informal_problem.statement: ∀ R : RfpPar, RfpRegime R → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → (∀ y : ℝ, |R.ca η * rfpPsi R y| ≤ 1 / 2) → IntegrableOn (fun x => 2 * x * rfpF R x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * rfpCi R * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + R.h))) (Ioi 0) ∧ ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * rfpF R x η) volume 0 X

signature.name: rfp_T_slice_integrable
signature.statement: ∀ R : RfpPar, RfpRegime R → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → (∀ y : ℝ, |R.ca η * rfpPsi R y| ≤ 1 / 2) → IntegrableOn (fun x => 2 * x * rfpF R x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * rfpCi R * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + R.h))) (Ioi 0) ∧ ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * rfpF R x η) volume 0 X

proof.tactics:
by
  intro R hReg η _h1 _h2 hψ
  have hReg' := hReg
  obtain ⟨_hMd, _hPst, _hlam0, hlam1, hh0, hhl, _hρ0, hρh, _hT1, _hLh⟩ := hReg'
  have hh4 : R.h ≤ 1 / 10000 := by nlinarith
  have hh1 : R.h < 1 := by linarith
  have hρ1 : R.ρ < 1 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨-, -, hs01, hscont, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := rfp_sig_basics
  obtain ⟨hyb1, -, hclamp, -, -⟩ := rfp_clamp_identities R hReg
  obtain ⟨htailL, B, hB⟩ := rfp_lam_tail_envelope R hReg
  have hΛc : Continuous (rfpLam R) := (rfp_lam_window sigA_contDiff_one R hReg).1
  have hb0 : (0:ℝ) < (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
  
  have hEc : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => rfpE R y η) := by
    have hTh : Continuous (rfpTh R) := by
      unfold rfpTh
      exact continuous_const.sub (hscont.comp (by fun_prop))
    have hpow : Continuous (fun y => ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh R y)) :=
      continuous_const.rpow hTh (fun _ => Or.inl hb0.ne')
    have hBmp : Continuous rfpBmp := by
      unfold rfpBmp
      exact (hscont.comp (by fun_prop)).mul (hscont.comp (by fun_prop))
    have hPsi : Continuous (rfpPsi R) := by
      unfold rfpPsi
      exact (hBmp.comp (by fun_prop)).sub (continuous_const.mul (hBmp.comp (by fun_prop)))
    have hsq : Continuous (fun y => Real.sqrt (1 + R.ca η * rfpPsi R y)) :=
      Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul hPsi))
    unfold rfpE
    exact ((Real.continuous_exp.comp hΛc).mul hpow).mul hsq
  have hFc : ContinuousOn (fun x => rfpF R x η) (Ioi 0) := by
    unfold rfpF
    apply ContinuousOn.div
    · exact hEc.comp_continuousOn (Real.continuousOn_log.mono (fun x hx => by
        simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        exact ne_of_gt hx))
    · exact (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).continuousOn
    · intro x hx
      have hx0 : (0:ℝ) < x := hx
      exact Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (by linarith)
  
  have hEb : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpE R y η ∧ rfpE R y η ≤ 5 / 4 * Real.exp (rfpLam R y) := by
    intro y
    have hb1 : (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg η])
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ rfpTh R y := by
      unfold rfpTh; linarith [(hs01 ((y - rfpY4 R.Md R.lam) / 60)).2]
    have hbt0 : 0 ≤ ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh R y) := Real.rpow_nonneg hb0.le _
    have hbt1 : ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh R y) ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one hb0.le hb1 ht0
    have hc := le_abs_self (R.ca η * rfpPsi R y)
    have hcy := hψ y
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + R.ca η * rfpPsi R y) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hs1 : Real.sqrt (1 + R.ca η * rfpPsi R y) ≤ 5 / 4 := by
      calc Real.sqrt (1 + R.ca η * rfpPsi R y) ≤ Real.sqrt ((5 / 4) ^ 2) :=
            Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith)
        _ = 5 / 4 := Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)
    have hE0 : 0 < Real.exp (rfpLam R y) := Real.exp_pos _
    unfold rfpE
    constructor
    · exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hE0.le hbt0) hs0
    · calc Real.exp (rfpLam R y) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh R y) * Real.sqrt (1 + R.ca η * rfpPsi R y)
          ≤ Real.exp (rfpLam R y) * 1 * (5 / 4) :=
            mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbt1 hE0.le) hs1 hs0 (by linarith)
        _ = 5 / 4 * Real.exp (rfpLam R y) := by ring
  
  have hFb : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
      |rfpF R x η| ≤ 3 * Real.exp B * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + R.h)) := by
    intro x hx
    have hxy : Real.exp (Real.log x) = x := Real.exp_log hx
    obtain ⟨hE0, hE1⟩ := hEb (Real.log x)
    have hsq2 : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * x) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
    have hF0 : 0 ≤ rfpF R x η := by unfold rfpF; exact div_nonneg hE0 hsq2.le
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hF0]
    have hsq : Real.exp (Real.log x / 2) ^ 2 = x := by
      rw [sq, ← Real.exp_add, add_halves, hxy]
    have hsx : Real.exp (Real.log x / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * x) := by
      calc Real.exp (Real.log x / 2) = Real.sqrt (Real.exp (Real.log x / 2) ^ 2) :=
            (Real.sqrt_sq (Real.exp_pos _).le).symm
        _ = Real.sqrt x := by rw [hsq]
        _ ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * x) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
    have hBy := hB (Real.log x)
    have ha0 : 0 ≤ 3 / 5 + R.h := by linarith
    have ha1 : 3 / 5 + R.h ≤ 1 := by linarith
    
    have hA : rfpF R x η ≤ 5 / 4 * Real.exp (B - 2 / 5 * Real.log x - (3 / 5 + R.h) * max (Real.log x) 0) := by
      unfold rfpF
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hsq2]
      have e1 : Real.exp (rfpLam R (Real.log x)) ≤
          Real.exp (B - 2 / 5 * Real.log x - (3 / 5 + R.h) * max (Real.log x) 0) * Real.exp (Real.log x / 2) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      have e2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsx
        (Real.exp_pos (B - 2 / 5 * Real.log x - (3 / 5 + R.h) * max (Real.log x) 0)).le
      nlinarith
    have hL1 : Real.log (1 + x) ≤ Real.log 2 + max (Real.log x) 0 := by
      by_cases hx1 : x ≤ 1
      · have := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (show 1 + x ≤ 2 by linarith)
        linarith [le_max_right (Real.log x) 0]
      · have h2x := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (show 1 + x ≤ 2 * x by linarith)
        rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hx.ne'] at h2x
        linarith [le_max_left (Real.log x) 0]
    have hlog2 : 0 ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
    have hK : B - 2 / 5 * Real.log x - (3 / 5 + R.h) * max (Real.log x) 0 - Real.log 2 ≤
        B + Real.log x * (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) + Real.log (1 + x) * (-(3 / 5 + R.h)) := by
      have m1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hL1 ha0
      have m2 : (3 / 5 + R.h) * Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log 2 := by nlinarith
      nlinarith
    have hB2 : Real.exp (B - 2 / 5 * Real.log x - (3 / 5 + R.h) * max (Real.log x) 0) / 2 ≤
        Real.exp B * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + R.h)) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hx, Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 1 + x),
        ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
      have := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hK
      rw [Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)] at this
      exact this
    have hKp := Real.exp_pos (B - 2 / 5 * Real.log x - (3 / 5 + R.h) * max (Real.log x) 0)
    nlinarith
  
  have htail : ∀ x : ℝ, rfpXb R ≤ x →
      2 * x * rfpF R x η = Real.sqrt (2 * x) * rfpCi R * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + R.h)) := by
    intro x hx
    have hxb0 : 0 < rfpXb R := Real.exp_pos _
    have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hxb0 hx
    have hyb : rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh ≤ Real.log x := by
      rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hx0]; exact hx
    have hy5 : rfpY5 R.Md R.lam ≤ Real.log x := le_trans hyb1.2.2 hyb
    have hE : rfpE R (Real.log x) η = Real.exp (rfpLam R (Real.log x)) := by
      unfold rfpE; rw [mul_assoc, hclamp _ η hy5, mul_one]
    have hL := htailL (Real.log x) hyb
    have h1ρ : 0 < 1 - R.ρ := by linarith
    have hciE : rfpCi R = Real.exp (rfpLam R (rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh - 3) +
        (1 / 2 + R.h) * (rfpYb R.Md R.lam R.T1 R.Lh - 3) - Real.log (1 - R.ρ)) := by
      unfold rfpCi; rw [Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log h1ρ]
    have hci : Real.exp (rfpLam R (Real.log x)) = rfpCi R * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + R.h)) := by
      rw [hL, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hx0, hciE, ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1; ring
    have hs0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * x) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
    unfold rfpF
    rw [hE, hci]
    calc 2 * x * (rfpCi R * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + R.h)) / Real.sqrt (2 * x))
        = (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * Real.sqrt (2 * x)) *
            (rfpCi R * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + R.h)) / Real.sqrt (2 * x)) := by
          rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt (by linarith)]
      _ = Real.sqrt (2 * x) * rfpCi R * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + R.h)) := by
          field_simp
  
  have hres := slice_integrability (fun x => rfpF R x η) (fun _ => 0) R.h (3 * Real.exp B)
    (rfpCi R) 1 (rfpXb R) hh0 hh1 one_pos (Real.exp_pos _) hFc continuousOn_const
    (fun x hx => ⟨hFb x hx, by rw [abs_zero]; positivity⟩) (fun _ _ => rfl) htail
  obtain ⟨-, -, hI3, -, hX⟩ := hres
  exact ⟨hI3, fun X hX0 => (hX X hX0).2.1⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: slice_integrability
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (f u : ℝ → ℝ) (h C ci xv xb : ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 → 0 < xv → 0 < xb → ContinuousOn f (Ioi 0) → ContinuousOn u (Ioi 0) → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → |f x| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧ |u x| ≤ C) → (∀ x : ℝ, xv ≤ x → u x = 0) → (∀ x : ℝ, xb ≤ x → 2 * x * f x = Real.sqrt (2 * x) * ci * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) → IntegrableOn (fun x => u x * (2 * x * f x)) (Ioi 0) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => u x ^ 2 - x * f x ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => 2 * x * f x - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * ci * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) (Ioi 0) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => f x ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable (fun x => u x) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * f x) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => u x * (2 * x * f x)) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => u x ^ 2 - x * f x ^ 2) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => f x ^ 2) volume 0 X

      intro a b ha hab
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      apply H2.mono
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hab]
      intro x hx
      exact le_trans ha hx.1
    have hg1 : Real.sqrt (2 * 1) * c (Real.log 1) = P := by
      rw [H1 1 zero_le_one le_rfl, Real.one_rpow, mul_one]
    have hGP : P ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * X) * c (Real.log X) := by
      linarith [H3 1 X one_pos hX1 hXe]
    have hGpos : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * X) * c (Real.log X) := lt_of_lt_of_le hP hGP
    have hsplit := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
      (hint 0 1 le_rfl zero_le_one) (hint 1 X zero_le_one hX1)
    have hmono : (∫ x in (1:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x))
        ≤ ∫ x in (1:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * X) * c (Real.log X) :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hX1 (hint 1 X zero_le_one hX1) intervalIntegrable_const
        (fun x hx => H3 x X (by linarith [hx.1]) hx.2 hXe)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul] at hmono
    have h01 := hI1 1 one_pos le_rfl
    rw [Real.one_rpow] at h01
    unfold rinMom at h01
    have hX3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hXe.trans he3.le) hGpos.le
    have hIX : rinMom (fun x => Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x)) X
        ≤ 7 / 8 * (X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * c (Real.log X))) := by
      unfold rinMom
      rw [← hsplit, h01]
      nlinarith
    have hρ : rinMom (fun x => Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x)) X
        / (X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * c (Real.log X))) ≤ 7 / 8 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hX hGpos)]; exact hIX
    unfold rinQf
    rw [hM X hX hXe, hJ X hX hXe, alg _ _ _ X _ _ hX.ne' hGpos.ne']
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hρ H5.le
    linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h η G Xe X2 : ℝ) (c k : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xe → 0 < G → ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x)) (Set.Ici 0) → ContinuousOn (fun x => k (Real.log x)) (Set.Ici 0) → (∀ x : ℝ, Xe ≤ x → x ≤ X2 → Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x) = G) → (∀ x : ℝ, Xe ≤ x → x ≤ X2 → 0 ≤ k (Real.log x)) → 0 ≤ (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) - ((1 - η ^ 2) * (1 - 2 * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2)) + (1 - 4 * h) * η ^ 2) → ∀ X : ℝ, Xe ≤ X → X ≤ X2 → Xe * rinQf h c k Xe η + ((1 - h + (1 / 2 - h) * (2 * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2))) - 1) * (X - Xe) ≤ X * rinQf h c k X η

signature.statement: ∀ (h η G Xe X2 : ℝ) (c k : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xe → 0 < G → ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x)) (Set.Ici 0) → ContinuousOn (fun x => k (Real.log x)) (Set.Ici 0) → (∀ x : ℝ, Xe ≤ x → x ≤ X2 → Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x) = G) → (∀ x : ℝ, Xe ≤ x → x ≤ X2 → 0 ≤ k (Real.log x)) → 0 ≤ (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) - ((1 - η ^ 2) * (1 - 2 * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2)) + (1 - 4 * h) * η ^ 2) → ∀ X : ℝ, Xe ≤ X → X ≤ X2 → Xe * rinQf h c k Xe η + ((1 - h + (1 / 2 - h) * (2 * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2))) - 1) * (X - Xe) ≤ X * rinQf h c k X η

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h η G Xe X2 c k hXe hG hgc hkc hflat hk0 hLB X h1 h2
  have hX : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hXe h1
  have hXeX2 : Xe ≤ X2 := h1.trans h2
  have hgXe : Real.sqrt (2 * Xe) * c (Real.log Xe) = G := hflat Xe le_rfl hXeX2
  have hgX : Real.sqrt (2 * X) * c (Real.log X) = G := hflat X h1 h2
  have hkgc : ContinuousOn (fun x => k (Real.log x) * (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x)))
      (Set.Ici 0) := hkc.mul hgc
  have hsub1 : Set.Icc 0 Xe ⊆ Set.Ici (0:ℝ) := fun x hx => hx.1
  have hsub2 : Set.Icc Xe X ⊆ Set.Ici (0:ℝ) := fun x hx => le_trans hXe.le hx.1
  have hsplit : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn f (Set.Ici 0) →
      rinMom f X = rinMom f Xe + ∫ x in Xe..X, f x := by
    intro f hf
    unfold rinMom
    exact (intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
      ((hf.mono hsub1).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hXe.le)
      ((hf.mono hsub2).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc h1)).symm
  have hEq : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc Xe X, Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x) = G := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le h1] at hx
    exact hflat x hx.1 (hx.2.trans h2)
  have hI : ∫ x in Xe..X, Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x) = (X - Xe) * G := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => G) hEq, intervalIntegral.integral_const,
      smul_eq_mul]
  have hJ : ∫ x in Xe..X, k (Real.log x) * (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x)) =
      (∫ x in Xe..X, k (Real.log x)) * G := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro x hx
    show k (Real.log x) * (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x)) = k (Real.log x) * G
    rw [hEq x hx]
  have hD : 0 ≤ ∫ x in Xe..X, k (Real.log x) :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg h1 (fun u hu => hk0 u hu.1 (hu.2.trans h2))
  have key : ∀ (L A B M0 I0 J0 D : ℝ), 0 ≤ L - B → 0 ≤ D →
      Xe * (-(1 - L * M0 / Xe) + (A * I0 - B * J0) / (Xe * G)) + (A - 1) * (X - Xe) ≤
        X * (-(1 - L * (M0 + D) / X) + (A * (I0 + (X - Xe) * G) - B * (J0 + D * G)) / (X * G)) := by
    intro L A B M0 I0 J0 D hLB' hD'
    have hXne : X ≠ 0 := hX.ne'
    have hXene : Xe ≠ 0 := hXe.ne'
    have hGne : G ≠ 0 := hG.ne'
    have e1 : Xe * (-(1 - L * M0 / Xe) + (A * I0 - B * J0) / (Xe * G)) =
        -Xe + L * M0 + (A * I0 - B * J0) / G := by
      field_simp
      ring
    have e2 : X * (-(1 - L * (M0 + D) / X) + (A * (I0 + (X - Xe) * G) - B * (J0 + D * G)) / (X * G)) =
        -X + L * (M0 + D) + (A * I0 - B * J0) / G + A * (X - Xe) - B * D := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [e1, e2]
    have e3 : (-X + L * (M0 + D) + (A * I0 - B * J0) / G + A * (X - Xe) - B * D) -
        (-Xe + L * M0 + (A * I0 - B * J0) / G + (A - 1) * (X - Xe)) = (L - B) * D := by ring
    have hp : 0 ≤ (L - B) * D := mul_nonneg hLB' hD'
    linarith
  unfold rinQf
  rw [hsplit _ hkc, hsplit _ hgc, hsplit _ hkgc, hI, hJ, hgXe, hgX]
  exact key _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hLB hD

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h η X0 : ℝ) (c k : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < X0 → ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x)) (Set.Ici 0) → ContinuousOn (fun x => k (Real.log x)) (Set.Ici 0) → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x)) → (∀ x X : ℝ, X0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → Real.sqrt (2 * X) * c (Real.log X) ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x)) → (∀ x : ℝ, X0 ≤ x → k (Real.log x) = 0) → 0 ≤ 1 - h + (1 / 2 - h) * (2 * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2)) → 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x)) X0 → rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x)) X0 ≤ X0 → 0 ≤ rinQf h c k X0 η → ∀ X : ℝ, X0 ≤ X → X0 * rinQf h c k X0 η + ((1 - h + (1 / 2 - h) * (2 * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2))) - 1) * (X - X0) ≤ X * rinQf h c k X η

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h η X0 c k hX0 hgc hkc hpos hmono hk0 hA hL hM0 hM1 hQ0 X h1
  have hX : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hX0 h1
  have g0pos : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * X0) * c (Real.log X0) := hpos X0 hX0
  have gXpos : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * X) * c (Real.log X) := hpos X hX
  have gle : Real.sqrt (2 * X) * c (Real.log X) ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * X0) * c (Real.log X0) :=
    hmono X0 X le_rfl h1
  have hkgc : ContinuousOn (fun x => k (Real.log x) * (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x)))
      (Set.Ici 0) := hkc.mul hgc
  have hsub1 : Set.Icc 0 X0 ⊆ Set.Ici (0:ℝ) := fun x hx => hx.1
  have hsub2 : Set.Icc X0 X ⊆ Set.Ici (0:ℝ) := fun x hx => le_trans hX0.le hx.1
  have hsplit : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn f (Set.Ici 0) →
      rinMom f X = rinMom f X0 + ∫ x in X0..X, f x := by
    intro f hf
    unfold rinMom
    exact (intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
      ((hf.mono hsub1).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hX0.le)
      ((hf.mono hsub2).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc h1)).symm
  have hK : ∫ x in X0..X, k (Real.log x) = 0 := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ)), intervalIntegral.integral_zero]
    intro x hx
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le h1] at hx
    exact hk0 x hx.1
  have hJ : ∫ x in X0..X, k (Real.log x) * (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x)) = 0 := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ)), intervalIntegral.integral_zero]
    intro x hx
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le h1] at hx
    show k (Real.log x) * (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x)) = 0
    rw [hk0 x hx.1, zero_mul]
  have hP : (X - X0) * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * c (Real.log X)) ≤
      ∫ x in X0..X, Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x) := by
    have hm := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) h1
      (intervalIntegrable_const (c := Real.sqrt (2 * X) * c (Real.log X)))
      ((hgc.mono hsub2).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) h1)
      (fun u hu => hmono u X hu.1 hu.2)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul] at hm
    exact hm
  have key : ∀ (L A B M0 I0 J0 P g0 gX : ℝ), 0 < g0 → 0 < gX → gX ≤ g0 → 0 ≤ A → L ≤ 1 →
      0 ≤ M0 → M0 ≤ X0 → (X - X0) * gX ≤ P →
      0 ≤ -(1 - L * M0 / X0) + (A * I0 - B * J0) / (X0 * g0) →
      X0 * (-(1 - L * M0 / X0) + (A * I0 - B * J0) / (X0 * g0)) + (A - 1) * (X - X0) ≤
        X * (-(1 - L * (M0 + 0) / X) + (A * (I0 + P) - B * (J0 + 0)) / (X * gX)) := by
    intro L A B M0 I0 J0 P g0 gX hg0 hgX hgle hA' hL' hM0' hM1' hP' hQ'
    have hXne : X ≠ 0 := hX.ne'
    have hX0ne : X0 ≠ 0 := hX0.ne'
    have hg0ne : g0 ≠ 0 := hg0.ne'
    have hgXne : gX ≠ 0 := hgX.ne'
    have e1 : X0 * (-(1 - L * M0 / X0) + (A * I0 - B * J0) / (X0 * g0)) =
        -X0 + L * M0 + (A * I0 - B * J0) / g0 := by
      field_simp
      ring
    have e2 : X * (-(1 - L * (M0 + 0) / X) + (A * (I0 + P) - B * (J0 + 0)) / (X * gX)) =
        -X + L * M0 + (A * I0 - B * J0) / gX + A * (P / gX) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    have hc : 0 ≤ -X0 + L * M0 + (A * I0 - B * J0) / g0 := by
      rw [← e1]; exact mul_nonneg hX0.le hQ'
    have hd : L * M0 ≤ M0 := mul_le_of_le_one_left hM0' hL'
    have hRg : 0 ≤ (A * I0 - B * J0) / g0 := by linarith
    have hR : 0 ≤ A * I0 - B * J0 := by
      have := mul_nonneg hRg hg0.le
      rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hg0ne] at this
    have hf : (A * I0 - B * J0) / g0 ≤ (A * I0 - B * J0) / gX :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hR hgX hgle
    have hg : X - X0 ≤ P / gX := (le_div_iff₀ hgX).2 hP'
    have hg' : A * (X - X0) ≤ A * (P / gX) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg hA'
    rw [e1, e2]
    linarith
  unfold rinQf at hQ0 ⊢
  rw [hsplit _ hkc, hsplit _ hgc, hsplit _ hkgc, hK, hJ]
  exact key _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ g0pos gXpos gle hA hL hM0 hM1 hP hQ0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Md Pst lam hMd hPst hlam
  
  have hσC : ContDiff ℝ 1 sigA := by
    have hm : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun w : ℝ => w * |w|) (2 * |y|) y := by
      intro y
      rcases lt_trichotomy y 0 with hy | hy | hy
      · have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℝ => -(w ^ 2)) (2 * |y|) y := by
          have := (hasDerivAt_pow 2 y).neg
          convert this using 1
          rw [abs_of_neg hy]; push_cast; ring
        refine h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
        filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hy] with w hw
        rw [abs_of_neg hw]; ring
      · subst hy
        rw [hasDerivAt_iff_isLittleO, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
        intro c hc
        filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0:ℝ) hc] with w hw
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at hw
        simp only [abs_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero, smul_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_abs]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hw.le (abs_nonneg w)
      · have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℝ => w ^ 2) (2 * |y|) y := by
          convert hasDerivAt_pow 2 y using 1
          rw [abs_of_pos hy]; push_cast; ring
        refine h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hy] with w hw
        rw [abs_of_pos hw]; ring
    have hmC : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun w : ℝ => w * |w|) := by
      rw [contDiff_one_iff_deriv]
      refine ⟨fun y => (hm y).differentiableAt, ?_⟩
      have hd : deriv (fun w : ℝ => w * |w|) = fun y => 2 * |y| := funext fun y => (hm y).deriv
      rw [hd]
      exact continuous_const.mul continuous_abs
    obtain ⟨q, hq_def⟩ : ∃ q : ℝ → ℝ, q = fun y => expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hqC : ContDiff ℝ 1 q := by
      rw [hq_def]
      exact expNegInvGlue.contDiff.comp hmC
    have hq1C : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun y => q (1 - y)) := hqC.comp (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id)
    have hDC : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun y => q y + q (1 - y)) := hqC.add hq1C
    have qpos_arg : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → 0 < y * |y| := fun y hy => by
      rw [abs_of_pos hy]; exact mul_pos hy hy
    have qa : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → q y = 0 := fun y hy => by
      rw [hq_def]
      exact expNegInvGlue.zero_of_nonpos (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hy (abs_nonneg y))
    have qb : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → 0 < q y := fun y hy => by
      rw [hq_def]
      exact expNegInvGlue.pos_of_pos (qpos_arg y hy)
    have qc : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ q y := fun y => by
      rw [hq_def]
      exact expNegInvGlue.nonneg _
    have qd : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → q y = Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hq_def]
      show expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) = _
      rw [expNegInvGlue, if_neg (not_le.mpr (qpos_arg y hy)), abs_of_pos hy]
      congr 1
      rw [neg_div, one_div, sq]
    have hDpos : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < q y + q (1 - y) := by
      intro y
      by_cases hy : 0 < y
      · exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (qb y hy) (qc _)
      · exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (qc y) (qb _ (by linarith [not_lt.mp hy]))
    have heq : sigA = fun y => q y / (q y + q (1 - y)) := by
      funext y
      unfold sigA
      split_ifs with h1 h2
      · rw [qa y h1, zero_div]
      · have hy : 0 < y := not_le.mp h1
        rw [qa (1 - y) (by linarith), add_zero, div_self (qb y hy).ne']
      · have hy : 0 < y := not_le.mp h1
        rw [qd y hy, qd (1 - y) (by linarith [not_le.mp h2])]
    rw [heq]
    exact hqC.div hDC (fun y => (hDpos y).ne')
  have hσc : Continuous sigA := hσC.continuous
  have hSI : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt rfpSigI (sigA t) t := fun t =>
    (hσc.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 t).hasDerivAt
  have hEd : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y => y / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y - lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 Md))
      (1 / 10 - 3 / 5 * sigA y - lam * sigA (y - rfpY2 Md)) y := by
    intro y
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y / 10) (1 / 10) y := (hasDerivAt_id y).div_const 10
    have h2 := (hSI y).const_mul (3 / 5 : ℝ)
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun y => rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 Md)) (sigA (y - rfpY2 Md)) y := by
      have h := (hSI (y - rfpY2 Md)).comp y ((hasDerivAt_id y).sub_const (rfpY2 Md))
      rw [mul_one] at h
      exact h
    have h4 := h3.const_mul lam
    exact (h1.sub h2).sub h4
  have hC : ∀ y, 0 < rinC Md Pst lam y ∧ HasDerivAt (rinC Md Pst lam)
      ((1 / 10 - 3 / 5 * sigA y - lam * sigA (y - rfpY2 Md)) * rinC Md Pst lam y) y := by
    intro y
    refine ⟨by unfold rinC; exact mul_pos hPst (Real.exp_pos _), ?_⟩
    have h := ((hEd y).exp).const_mul Pst
    have e2 : Pst * (Real.exp (y / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y - lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 Md)) *
        (1 / 10 - 3 / 5 * sigA y - lam * sigA (y - rfpY2 Md))) =
        (1 / 10 - 3 / 5 * sigA y - lam * sigA (y - rfpY2 Md)) * rinC Md Pst lam y := by
      unfold rinC; ring
    exact h.congr_deriv e2
  have hsig0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → sigA t = 0 := by
    intro t ht; unfold sigA; rw [if_pos ht]
  have hsig1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → sigA t = 1 := by
    intro t ht; unfold sigA; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos ht]
  have hsig01 : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA t ∧ sigA t ≤ 1 := by
    intro t; unfold sigA
    split_ifs
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
    · constructor
      · positivity
      · rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
        linarith [Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2)]
  have hy2 : 11 ≤ rfpY2 Md := by unfold rfpY2; linarith [Real.exp_pos Md]
  
  have hΦpos : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < Real.exp (y / 2) * rinC Md Pst lam y :=
    fun y => mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (hC y).1
  have hΦd : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y => Real.exp (y / 2) * rinC Md Pst lam y)
      ((3 / 5 * (1 - sigA y) - lam * sigA (y - rfpY2 Md)) *
        (Real.exp (y / 2) * rinC Md Pst lam y)) y := by
    intro y
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (y / 2)) (Real.exp (y / 2) * (1 / 2)) y :=
      ((hasDerivAt_id y).div_const 2).exp
    have h2 := h1.mul (hC y).2
    convert h2 using 1
    ring
  have hΦc : Continuous (fun y => Real.exp (y / 2) * rinC Md Pst lam y) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun y => (hΦd y).continuousAt
  have hmono : MonotoneOn (fun y => Real.exp (y / 2) * rinC Md Pst lam y) (Set.Iic (rfpY2 Md)) := by
    apply monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Iic _) hΦc.continuousOn
    · intro y _; exact (hΦd y).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    · intro y hy
      rw [interior_Iic] at hy
      have hy' : y < rfpY2 Md := hy
      rw [(hΦd y).deriv, hsig0 (y - rfpY2 Md) (by linarith)]
      have h1 := hsig01 y
      have h2 := hΦpos y
      have h3 : 0 ≤ 3 / 5 * (1 - sigA y) := by linarith
      have h4 := mul_nonneg h3 h2.le
      linarith
  have hanti : AntitoneOn (fun y => Real.exp (y / 2) * rinC Md Pst lam y) (Set.Ici 1) := by
    apply antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos (convex_Ici _) hΦc.continuousOn
    · intro y _; exact (hΦd y).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    · intro y hy
      rw [interior_Ici] at hy
      have hy' : 1 < y := hy
      rw [(hΦd y).deriv, hsig1 y hy'.le]
      have h1 := hsig01 (y - rfpY2 Md)
      have h2 := hΦpos y
      have h4 := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hlam h1.1) h2.le
      have e : (3 / 5 * (1 - 1) - lam * sigA (y - rfpY2 Md)) *
          (Real.exp (y / 2) * rinC Md Pst lam y) =
          -(lam * sigA (y - rfpY2 Md) * (Real.exp (y / 2) * rinC Md Pst lam y)) := by ring
      rw [e]
      linarith
  have hE : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → Real.sqrt (2 * x) * rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x) =
      Real.sqrt 2 * (Real.exp (Real.log x / 2) * rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x)) := by
    intro x hx
    have hs : Real.sqrt x = Real.exp (Real.log x / 2) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hx]; congr 1; ring
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2) x, hs]
    ring
  have hSig0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → rfpSigI t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpSigI
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ)) ?_]
    · simp
    · intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge ht] at hs
      exact hsig0 s hs.2
  have P1 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 1 → Real.sqrt (2 * x) * rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x) =
      Real.sqrt 2 * Pst * x ^ (3 / 5 : ℝ) := by
    intro x hx0 hx1
    rcases hx0.lt_or_eq with hx | hx
    · rw [hE x hx]
      have hl : Real.log x ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos hx0 hx1
      unfold rinC
      rw [hSig0 _ hl, hSig0 _ (by linarith), Real.rpow_def_of_pos hx]
      rw [show Real.sqrt 2 * (Real.exp (Real.log x / 2) *
          (Pst * Real.exp (Real.log x / 10 - 3 / 5 * 0 - lam * 0))) =
          Real.sqrt 2 * Pst * (Real.exp (Real.log x / 2) *
            Real.exp (Real.log x / 10 - 3 / 5 * 0 - lam * 0)) by ring, ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 2; ring
    · subst hx
      rw [mul_zero, Real.sqrt_zero, zero_mul, Real.zero_rpow (by norm_num), mul_zero]
  have hCc : Continuous (rinC Md Pst lam) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun y => (hC y).2.continuousAt
  have P2 : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (2 * x) * rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x)) (Set.Ici 0) := by
    rw [← Set.Icc_union_Ici_eq_Ici zero_le_one]
    apply ContinuousOn.union_of_isClosed _ _ isClosed_Icc isClosed_Ici
    · have hcf : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Real.sqrt 2 * Pst * x ^ (3 / 5 : ℝ)) :=
        continuous_const.mul (Real.continuous_rpow_const (by norm_num))
      refine hcf.continuousOn.congr ?_
      intro x hx; exact P1 x hx.1 hx.2
    · apply ContinuousOn.mul
      · exact (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).continuousOn
      · exact hCc.comp_continuousOn (Real.continuousOn_log.mono
          (fun x hx => (lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (show (1:ℝ) ≤ x from hx)).ne'))
  refine ⟨P1, P2, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    rw [hE x hx]
    exact mul_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.2 two_pos) (hΦpos _)
  · intro x X hx hxX hXe
    have hX : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hx hxX
    rw [hE x hx, hE X hX]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.sqrt_nonneg 2)
    have hlX : Real.log X ≤ rfpY2 Md := (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hX).2 hXe
    have hlxX : Real.log x ≤ Real.log X := Real.log_le_log hx hxX
    exact hmono (show Real.log x ∈ Set.Iic (rfpY2 Md) from le_trans hlxX hlX)
      (show Real.log X ∈ Set.Iic (rfpY2 Md) from hlX) hlxX
  · intro x h1 h2
    have hx : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) h1
    have hl1 : 1 ≤ Real.log x := (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hx).2 h1
    have hl2 : Real.log x ≤ rfpY2 Md := (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hx).2 h2
    rw [hE x hx, hE _ (Real.exp_pos 1), Real.log_exp]
    congr 1
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact hanti (Set.mem_Ici.2 (le_refl (1:ℝ)))
        (show Real.log x ∈ Set.Ici 1 from hl1) hl1
    · exact hmono (Set.mem_Iic.2 (by linarith))
        (show Real.log x ∈ Set.Iic (rfpY2 Md) from hl2) hl1
  · intro x X h1 hxX
    have hx : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) h1
    have hX : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hx hxX
    have hl1 : 1 ≤ Real.log x := (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hx).2 h1
    have hlxX : Real.log x ≤ Real.log X := Real.log_le_log hx hxX
    rw [hE x hx, hE X hX]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.sqrt_nonneg 2)
    exact hanti (show Real.log x ∈ Set.Ici 1 from hl1)
      (show Real.log X ∈ Set.Ici 1 from le_trans hl1 hlxX) hlxX

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Md hMd
  
  have hφpos : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) = Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [abs_of_pos hy, expNegInvGlue, if_neg (not_le.2 (mul_pos hy hy))]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hφz : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    apply expNegInvGlue.zero_of_nonpos
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (neg_nonneg.2 hy) (abs_nonneg y)]
  have hφnn : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) := fun y => expNegInvGlue.nonneg _
  have hden : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) + expNegInvGlue ((1 - y) * |1 - y|) := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ≤ 0
    · have h1 : 0 < 1 - y := by linarith
      have := hφpos (1 - y) h1
      have hp : 0 < expNegInvGlue ((1 - y) * |1 - y|) := by rw [this]; exact Real.exp_pos _
      linarith [hφnn y]
    · have h1 : 0 < y := lt_of_not_ge hy
      have hp : 0 < expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) := by rw [hφpos y h1]; exact Real.exp_pos _
      linarith [hφnn (1 - y)]
  have hsig_eq : ∀ y : ℝ, sigA y = expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) /
      (expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) + expNegInvGlue ((1 - y) * |1 - y|)) := by
    intro y
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · rw [hφz y h1]; simp
    · have h0 : expNegInvGlue ((1 - y) * |1 - y|) = 0 := hφz (1 - y) (by linarith)
      have hp : 0 < expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) := by
        rw [hφpos y (lt_of_not_ge h1)]; exact Real.exp_pos _
      rw [h0, add_zero, div_self hp.ne']
    · rw [hφpos y (lt_of_not_ge h1), hφpos (1 - y) (by linarith [lt_of_not_ge h2])]
  have hφc : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => expNegInvGlue (y * |y|)) :=
    (expNegInvGlue.contDiff (n := 0)).continuous.comp (continuous_id.mul continuous_abs)
  have hφc' : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => expNegInvGlue ((1 - y) * |1 - y|)) :=
    hφc.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)
  have hsigc : Continuous sigA := by
    have : sigA = fun y => expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) /
        (expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) + expNegInvGlue ((1 - y) * |1 - y|)) := funext hsig_eq
    rw [this]
    exact hφc.div (hφc.add hφc') (fun y => (hden y).ne')
  have hsig01 : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA y ∧ sigA y ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    rw [hsig_eq y]
    exact ⟨div_nonneg (hφnn y) (hden y).le,
      (div_le_one (hden y)).2 (le_add_of_nonneg_right (hφnn (1 - y)))⟩
  have hsig0 : sigA 0 = 0 := by unfold sigA; simp
  
  have hK_eq : ∀ y : ℝ, rfpK Md y = 4 * (1 - sigA (Real.log (max y 1) / Md)) := by
    intro y
    unfold rfpK
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [max_eq_right h, Real.log_one, zero_div, hsig0]; ring
    · rw [max_eq_left (le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge h))]
  have h04 : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpK Md y ∧ rfpK Md y ≤ 4 := by
    intro y
    rw [hK_eq y]
    have := hsig01 (Real.log (max y 1) / Md)
    constructor <;> linarith [this.1, this.2]
  have h4 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 1 → rfpK Md y = 4 := by
    intro y hy
    unfold rfpK
    rw [if_pos hy]
  have h0 : ∀ y : ℝ, Real.exp Md ≤ y → rfpK Md y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have he := Real.add_one_le_exp Md
    have hy1 : 1 < y := by linarith
    have hl : Md ≤ Real.log y := (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le (by linarith)).2 hy
    have hq : 1 ≤ Real.log y / Md := (le_div_iff₀ hMd).2 (by linarith)
    have hs : sigA (Real.log y / Md) = 1 := by
      unfold sigA
      rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hq]
    unfold rfpK
    rw [if_neg (by linarith), hs]
    ring
  have hcont : Continuous (rfpK Md) := by
    have : rfpK Md = fun y => 4 * (1 - sigA (Real.log (max y 1) / Md)) := funext hK_eq
    rw [this]
    have hlog : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => Real.log (max y 1) / Md) :=
      (Continuous.log (continuous_id.max continuous_const)
        (fun y => ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (le_max_right y 1)))).div_const Md
    have hs : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => sigA (Real.log (max y 1) / Md)) := hsigc.comp hlog
    exact continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub hs)
  have K2 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ Real.exp 1 → rfpK Md (Real.log x) = 4 := by
    intro x hx0 hxe
    have hl : Real.log x ≤ 1 := by
      rcases hx0.lt_or_eq with hx | hx
      · exact (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hx).2 hxe
      · rw [← hx, Real.log_zero]; norm_num
    exact h4 _ hl
  have K4 : ∀ x : ℝ, Real.exp (Real.exp Md) ≤ x → rfpK Md (Real.log x) = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hx
    exact h0 _ ((Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hx0).2 hx)
  have hkc : Continuous (fun x => rfpK Md (Real.log x)) := by
    refine continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 (fun x => ?_)
    by_cases hx : x = 0
    · subst hx
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.continuousAt (y := (4 : ℝ))
      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (-1:ℝ) < 0)
        (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1)) ?_
      intro z hz
      have habs : |z| < 1 := abs_lt.2 ⟨hz.1, hz.2⟩
      have hle : Real.log |z| ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos (abs_nonneg z) habs.le
      rw [Real.log_abs] at hle
      exact h4 _ (by linarith)
    · exact (hcont.continuousAt.comp (Real.continuousAt_log hx) :)
  have hxK0 : 0 ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp Md) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hxKX2 : Real.exp (Real.exp Md) ≤ Real.exp (rfpY2 Md) := by
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
    unfold rfpY2; linarith
  have hI1 := hkc.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) 0 (Real.exp (Real.exp Md))
  have hI2 := hkc.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (Real.exp (Real.exp Md)) (Real.exp (rfpY2 Md))
  have hsplit := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals hI1 hI2
  have htail : ∫ x in (Real.exp (Real.exp Md))..(Real.exp (rfpY2 Md)), rfpK Md (Real.log x) = 0 := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ)) ?_]
    · simp
    · intro u hu
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hxKX2] at hu
      exact K4 u hu.1
  have hlo : 0 ≤ ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..(Real.exp (Real.exp Md)), rfpK Md (Real.log x) :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hxK0 (fun u _ => (h04 _).1)
  have hhi : ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..(Real.exp (Real.exp Md)), rfpK Md (Real.log x) ≤
      ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..(Real.exp (Real.exp Md)), (4:ℝ) :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hxK0 hI1 intervalIntegrable_const (fun u _ => (h04 _).2)
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, sub_zero] at hhi
  have hX2 : Real.exp (rfpY2 Md) = Real.exp (Real.exp Md) * Real.exp 11 := by
    unfold rfpY2; rw [Real.exp_add]
  have h11 : (11:ℝ) + 1 ≤ Real.exp 11 := Real.add_one_le_exp 11
  have hfin : Real.exp (Real.exp Md) * 4 ≤ Real.exp (rfpY2 Md) := by
    rw [hX2]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hxK0
  have hmom : rinMom (fun x => rfpK Md (Real.log x)) (Real.exp (rfpY2 Md)) =
      ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..(Real.exp (Real.exp Md)), rfpK Md (Real.log x) := by
    unfold rinMom; rw [← hsplit, htail, add_zero]
  refine ⟨hkc.continuousOn, K2, fun x => h04 _, K4, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hmom]; exact hlo
  · rw [hmom]; linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨B0, hB0, HR⟩ := rfp_r0_bounds
  obtain ⟨-, HK⟩ := rfp_inner_kC_facts
  refine ⟨1, one_pos, ?_⟩

  intro Pst hPst
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℝ, E = Real.exp (rfpY2 Md / 2 + 7 / 10) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨P1, hP1⟩ : ∃ P1 : ℝ, P1 = Pst * Real.exp (1 / 10) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Θ, hΘ⟩ : ∃ Θ : ℝ, Θ = 4 + 4 * E + 11 * P1 * E + 34 * P1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hE0 : 0 < E := by rw [hE]; exact Real.exp_pos _
  have hP10 : 0 < P1 := by rw [hP1]; exact mul_pos (by linarith) (Real.exp_pos _)
  have hΘ0 : 0 < Θ := by rw [hΘ]; positivity
  refine ⟨min (1 / 100) (1 / (40 * Θ)), lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity), ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam hlaml
  refine ⟨1, one_pos, ?_⟩
  intro P hPMd hPPst hPlam _ hReg hClos
  subst hPMd hPPst hPlam
  intro x η hx1 hx2 he1 he2
  have hReg' := hReg
  obtain ⟨hMd0, -, hl0, hl100, hh0, hhl, -⟩ := hReg'
  have hPst0 : 0 < P.Pst := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hCcont, hCpos, hCle, hCaff, hCE⟩ := pqc_rinC_facts P.Md P.Pst P.lam hPst0 hl0.le hl100
  obtain ⟨hR0c, hBc, hBb, -, hrep⟩ := pqc_rfp_rep P hReg
  obtain ⟨hKd, hKb, -, hK0, -, -⟩ := HK P.Md P.Pst P.lam hMd0 hPst0
  obtain ⟨hAc, hc1c, hc2c, -, hAmp, -⟩ := hClos
  obtain ⟨hA1, hA2, hAd, hc1b, hc2b⟩ := hAmp η he1 he2
  have hl1 : P.lam ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hh100 : P.h ≤ 1 / 100 := by nlinarith
  
  have hxk0 : 0 < rfpXk P 0 := by unfold rfpXk; exact Real.exp_pos _
  have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hxk0 hx1
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.lam) := by
    rw [one_div, Real.log_inv]; linarith [Real.log_nonpos hl0.le hl1]
  obtain ⟨x0, hx0d⟩ : ∃ x0 : ℝ, x0 = Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hx00 : 0 < x0 := by rw [hx0d]; exact Real.exp_pos _
  have hxk : rfpXk P 0 = Real.exp (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) := by unfold rfpXk; rw [sub_zero]
  have hx0x : x0 ≤ x := by
    refine le_trans ?_ hx1
    rw [hxk, hx0d]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    unfold rfpY3
    linarith
  
  have hlogm := Real.measurable_log

noncomputable def pulseNForm (h η A A' a1 a1' a2 a2' p0 p1 p2 x e1 M0 M1 M2 KB K2 S0 S1 S2 S00 Pi Pi' : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let f := (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹
  let fp := -(2 * η) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2
  let G := A * M0 + a1 * M1 + a2 * M2
  let G' := A' * M0 + a1' * M1 + a2' * M2
  let H := A ^ 2 * S0 + a1 ^ 2 * S1 + a2 ^ 2 * S2 - S00 / 2
  let H' := 2 * A * A' * S0 + 2 * a1 * a1' * S1 + 2 * a2 * a2' * S2
  let MM := η * KB + f * G
  let MMp := KB + fp * G + f * G'
  let SS := η ^ 2 * K2 + f ^ 2 * H
  let SSp := 2 * η * K2 + 2 * f * fp * H + f ^ 2 * H'
  let Rb := A * p0 + a1 * p1 + a2 * p2
  (-(1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * (MM / x) - (1 - η ^ 2) * (MMp / x)) * (e1 * f * Rb)
    + ((1 / 2 - h) * (MM - η * MMp) + 4 * h * η * SS - (1 - η ^ 2) * SSp) / x
    + 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * Pi - (1 - η ^ 2) * Pi') / (e1 * f)

  have hG4n : 0 ≤ G4 := by
