    linarith
  have hmRb : |mR| ≤ K * lam ^ 2 + 25 / 6 * B * lam := by

    rw [e]
    have h1 : |lam * Rd / (1 / 2 - lam) ^ 2| ≤ 25 / 6 * B * lam := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hl0, abs_of_pos (pow_pos hβ0 2),
        div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos hβ0 2)]
      have k1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hβ2
          (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 25 / 6) hB) hl0.le)
      have k2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hRd hl0.le
      linarith
    calc |eμ - lam * Rd / (1 / 2 - lam) ^ 2| ≤ |eμ| + |lam * Rd / (1 / 2 - lam) ^ 2| :=
          abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ K * lam ^ 2 + 25 / 6 * B * lam := by linarith
  have hE4 : |E4| ≤ K * lam + 3 * B * lam := by
    rw [hE4d, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hG4n]

    calc G4 * |η * A'| * |mR| ≤ 5 / 7 * (K * lam ^ 2 + 25 / 6 * B * lam) :=
          mul_le_mul h1 hmRb (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ K * lam + 3 * B * lam := by
          linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlsq hK, mul_nonneg hB hl0.le, mul_nonneg hK hl0.le]
  have hΔb : |E1 + E2 + E3 - E4| ≤ (27 + 17 * B + 2 * K) * lam := by
    have k1 := abs_sub (E1 + E2 + E3) E4
    have k2 := abs_add_three E1 E2 E3
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ1, hθ2⟩ := L_theta κ sg (4 * s) R hsg0 (by linarith) hR0 hκ2
  
  have hg0 : 0 ≤ g := by rw [hg]; exact div_nonneg hl0.le hlc.le
  have hg1 : g ≤ 1 := by rw [hg, div_le_one hlc]; linarith
  have hMl1 : (27 + 17 * B + 2 * K) * lam ≤ 1 := by

  have hW : |Ns / Qs| ≤ 34 + 3 * B := by

      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg gA0]
      exact mul_le_mul (by linarith) hRd (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)

  have hpert : |N / Q - Ns / Qs| ≤ (70 + 6 * B) * lam := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlsq (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * (1 + (34 + 3 * B)))

  refine ⟨θ, hθ1, ?_⟩
  have hsplit : N / Q - (2 * A * R - 2 * g * A * Rd + θ * sg * R) =

proof.tactics:
by

      |profEtaD (leadPi (rfpF P)) x η| ≤ 2 * |η| * ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) := by

    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, hca, -, -⟩ := hC
    
    obtain ⟨q, hq_def⟩ : ∃ q : ℝ → ℝ, q = fun y => expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hqC : Continuous q := by
      rw [hq_def]
      exact (expNegInvGlue.contDiff (n := 0)).continuous.comp (continuous_id.mul continuous_abs)
    have qpos_arg : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → 0 < y * |y| := fun y hy => by
      rw [abs_of_pos hy]; exact mul_pos hy hy
    have qa : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → q y = 0 := fun y hy => by
      rw [hq_def]

    have qb : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → 0 < q y := fun y hy => by

    have qd : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → q y = Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) := by

    have hDpos : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < q y + q (1 - y) := by

      · exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (qc y) (qb _ (by linarith [not_lt.mp hy]))
    have heq : sigA = fun y => q y / (q y + q (1 - y)) := by

      · rw [qa y hh1, zero_div]
      · have hy : 0 < y := not_le.mp hh1

    have sigC : Continuous sigA := by

      · have : t / (3 / 20) ≤ -1 := by rw [div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
        rw [sig0 (1 + t / (3 / 20)) (by linarith), zero_mul]
      · have : 1 ≤ t / (3 / 20) := by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith

    have bmpNN : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpBmp t := fun t => by

    have hl2 : P.lam ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 10000 := by nlinarith

    have tailC : Continuous (fun y => tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh))

    have lamC : Continuous (rfpLam P) := by
      have e : rfpLam P = fun y => Real.log P.Pst + y / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y

          - (1 - P.lam) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam)

        rfl
      rw [e]
      refine Continuous.add ?_ (tailC.log tailNZ)
      refine Continuous.sub ?_ ((sigC.comp ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).div_const _)).mul
        continuous_const)
      refine Continuous.add ?_ (continuous_const.mul (SigC.comp
        (((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).sub continuous_const).sub continuous_const)))
      refine Continuous.sub ?_ (continuous_const.mul (SigC.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)))
      refine Continuous.sub ?_ (continuous_const.mul (SigC.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)))
      refine Continuous.sub ?_ (continuous_const.mul SigC)
      exact continuous_const.add (continuous_id.div_const _)
    have thC : Continuous (rfpTh P) := by
      have e : rfpTh P = fun y => 1 - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) := rfl
      rw [e]
      exact continuous_const.sub (sigC.comp ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).div_const _))
    have th01 : ∀ v : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpTh P v ∧ rfpTh P v ≤ 1 := fun v => by
      unfold rfpTh
      constructor <;> linarith [sigNN ((v - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60), sigLe1 ((v - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60)]
    
    have hL : 20 < 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := by
      have h2' : (2:ℝ) ≤ 1 / P.lam := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith
      have := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) h2'
      linarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
    have e3 : rfpY3 P.Md P.lam = rfpY2 P.Md + 1 + 60 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
    have e4 : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam = rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 13 / P.lam := rfl
    have e5 : rfpY5 P.Md P.lam = rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
    have h13 : 0 < 13 / P.lam := by positivity
    have psiSupp : ∀ y : ℝ, rfpPsi P y ≠ 0 → rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 63 / 20 < y := by

      · intro y

    have Heq : (fun y => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y) = fun y =>

    have HI : Integrable (fun y => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y) := by
      rw [Heq]; exact g1I.sub (g2I.const_mul _)

    have hHset : ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * rfpPsi P v =

      intro e he1 he2 y

      have hcaψ : |P.ca e * rfpPsi P y| ≤ 1 / 2 := (hca e he1 he2).2 y

      have hsq : Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca e * rfpPsi P y) ^ 2 = 1 + P.ca e * rfpPsi P y := by

        linarith
      have hrp : ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) = (((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y)) ^ 2 := by
        rw [mul_comm (2:ℝ) (rfpTh P y), Real.rpow_mul hf0.le, Real.rpow_two]
      have hcross : Real.exp (rfpLam P y) ^ 2 * ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) * rfpPsi P y =

        · rw [psiTh y hψ, mul_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one, sq, ← Real.exp_add, two_mul]
      have hS : Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp y) ^ 2 = 2 * Real.exp y := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)

    obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, G = fun e v =>

      have hc1 : rfpY2 P.Md + 62 ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1 := by linarith
      have hE : -(P.lam * (rfpSigI (v - rfpY2 P.Md) - rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 P.Md)))
          - (1 - P.lam) * (rfpSigI (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) - rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam))
          + (1 - P.h) * (rfpSigI (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1)
            - rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1)) ≤ 0 := by
        rcases le_or_gt v (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1) with hv | hv
        · 
          rw [hI0 (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) (by linarith),
            hI0 (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) (by linarith)]
          have d2 := (hD (y - rfpY2 P.Md) (v - rfpY2 P.Md) (by linarith)).1
          have d5 := (hD (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (by linarith)).1
          have q2 := mul_nonneg hl0.le d2
          have q5 := mul_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - P.lam by linarith) d5
          linarith
        · rcases le_or_gt y (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1) with hy | hy
          · 
            rw [hI0 (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) (by linarith),
              hI1 (v - rfpY2 P.Md) (by linarith), hI1 (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (by linarith)]
            have u1 := (hD 0 (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) (by linarith)).2
            rw [hI0 0 le_rfl] at u1
            have u2 := (hD (y - rfpY2 P.Md) (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1 - rfpY2 P.Md)
              (by linarith)).1
            rw [hI1 (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1 - rfpY2 P.Md) (by linarith)] at u2
            have u5 := (hD (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1 - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam)
              (by linarith)).1
            rw [hI1 (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1 - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (by linarith)] at u5
            have q2 := mul_nonneg hl0.le u2
            have q5 := mul_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - P.lam by linarith) u5
            have q1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left u1 (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - P.h by linarith)
            have q0 := mul_nonneg hh0.le
              (show (0:ℝ) ≤ v - (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1) by linarith)
            linarith
          · 
            exfalso
            linarith
      have s4 : rfpSigI v - rfpSigI y = v - y := by
        rw [hI1 v (by linarith), hI1 y hy1]; ring
      have sy : sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) = 0 := by
        apply sig0
        apply div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg _ (by norm_num)
        linarith
      have sv : 0 ≤ sigA ((v - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) * Real.log 2 :=
        mul_nonneg (sigR _).1 (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num))
      have ty0 : tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) = 1 - P.ρ := by
        unfold tailFac
        rw [← Real.exp_sub, Real.log_exp,
          sig0 ((y - rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh + 2) / 2) (by linarith)]
        ring
      have ty : Real.log (tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) /
          (1 - P.ρ)) = 0 := by
        rw [ty0, div_self h1ρ.ne', Real.log_one]
      have tv : Real.log (tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp v) /
          (1 - P.ρ)) ≤ -Real.log (1 - P.ρ) := by
        obtain ⟨t0, t1⟩ := tauR (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp v)
        have tp : 0 < tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp v) := by
          linarith
        rw [Real.log_div tp.ne' h1ρ.ne']
        have := Real.log_le_log tp t1
        rw [Real.log_one] at this
        linarith
      unfold rfpLam
      rw [sy, ty]
      linarith
    
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y - 2 * Real.log (1 - P.ρ) + y) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hg : IntegrableOn (fun v => K * Real.exp (-v)) (Ioi y) := by
      have := (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi y (zero_lt_one' ℝ)).const_mul K
      simp only [neg_mul, one_mul] at this
      exact this
    have hle : ∫ v in Ioi y, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) ≤ ∫ v in Ioi y, K * Real.exp (-v) := by
      refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on hint hg measurableSet_Ioi (fun v hv => ?_)
      rw [hK, ← Real.exp_add]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
      have := hdec v (le_of_lt hv)
      linarith
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, integral_exp_neg_Ioi] at hle
    have hKe : K * Real.exp (-y) = Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * ((1 - P.ρ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      rw [hK, ← Real.exp_add]
      have e1 : 2 * rfpLam P y - 2 * Real.log (1 - P.ρ) + y + -y =
          2 * rfpLam P y + -(Real.log (1 - P.ρ) + Real.log (1 - P.ρ)) := by ring
      rw [e1, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log h1ρ]
      ring
    have hinv : ((1 - P.ρ) ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 2 := by
      rw [inv_le_comm₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
      have h34 : (3:ℝ) / 4 ≤ 1 - P.ρ := by linarith
      have := mul_le_mul h34 h34 (by norm_num) h1ρ.le
      rw [sq]
      linarith
    have hpos := Real.exp_pos (2 * rfpLam P y)
    calc ∫ v in Ioi y, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) ≤ K * Real.exp (-y) := hle
      _ = Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * ((1 - P.ρ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := hKe
      _ ≤ Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinv hpos.le
      _ = 2 * Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) := by ring
  
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := hPB
  have hT := hMass (Real.log x) hY1 hY4
  have hT0 : 0 ≤ ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) :=
    MeasureTheory.setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Ioi (fun v _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le)
  have habs : |η| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right habs hT0
  constructor
  · linarith
  · have e : 2 * |η| * ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) =
        2 * (|η| * ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v)) := by ring
    linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hP x hx1 hx2
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl1, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hP
  
  have s0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → sigA t = 0 := fun t ht => by unfold sigA; rw [if_pos ht]
  have s1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → sigA t = 1 := fun t ht => by
    unfold sigA; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos ht]
  have sb : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA t ∧ sigA t ≤ 1 := by
    intro t
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
    · have ha := Real.exp_pos (-1 / t ^ 2)
      have hc := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2)
      constructor
      · positivity
      · rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]; linarith
  have smeas : Measurable sigA := by
    change Measurable (fun y : ℝ => if y ≤ 0 then (0:ℝ) else if 1 ≤ y then 1 else
      Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) / (Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)))
    refine Measurable.ite measurableSet_Iic measurable_const
      (Measurable.ite measurableSet_Ici measurable_const ?_)
    fun_prop
  have sII : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable sigA volume a b := by
    intro a b
    refine IntervalIntegrable.mono_fun' (g := fun _ => (1:ℝ)) intervalIntegrable_const
      smeas.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ (fun x => ?_))
    show ‖sigA x‖ ≤ 1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sb x).1]; exact (sb x).2
  
  have Sig0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → rfpSigI t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpSigI
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ)) ?_]
    · simp
    · intro x hx

  have Sig1 : ∀ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a → 1 ≤ b → rfpSigI b - rfpSigI a = b - a := by
    intro a b ha hb

    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (1:ℝ)) ?_]
    · simp
    · intro x hx

      · rw [Set.uIcc_of_le h] at hx; linarith [hx.1]
      · rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge h] at hx; linarith [hx.1]
  have SigNN : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpSigI t := by
    intro t

    · rw [Sig0 t h]
    · unfold rfpSigI
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg h (fun u _ => (sb u).1)
  have hSc : Continuous rfpSigI := intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive sII 0
  
  have hL : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.lam) := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith)

  have e5 : rfpY5 P.Md P.lam = rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  have eb : rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh = rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 2 + P.T1 + P.Lh + 3 := rfl
  have hLam : ∀ z : ℝ, z ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam →
      rfpLam P z = Real.log P.Pst + z / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI z - P.lam * rfpSigI (z - rfpY2 P.Md) := by

    have t2 : rfpSigI (z - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) = 0 := Sig0 _ (by rw [e5]; linarith)
    have t3 : sigA ((z - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) = 0 :=

    have t4 : tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp z) = 1 - P.ρ := by

      rw [t4, div_self (by linarith), Real.log_one]

    ring
  
  have hxk0 : 0 < rfpXk P 0 := by unfold rfpXk; exact Real.exp_pos _
  have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hxk0 hx1
  obtain ⟨Y, hYdef⟩ : ∃ Y : ℝ, Real.log x = Y := ⟨_, rfl⟩

  have hY3 : rfpY3 P.Md P.lam ≤ Y := by
    have h1 := Real.log_le_log hxk0 hx1

    rw [sub_zero, Real.log_exp, hYdef] at h1
    exact h1
  have hY4 : Y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam := by
    have h1 := Real.log_le_log hx0 hx2
    unfold rfpXv at h1
    rw [Real.log_exp, hYdef] at h1
    exact h1
  have hexpY : Real.exp (Y + rfpLam P Y) = x * Real.exp (rfpLam P Y) := by
    rw [Real.exp_add, ← hYdef, Real.exp_log hx0]
  have h13 : 1300 ≤ 13 / P.lam := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith
  have hy3lo : rfpY2 P.Md + 1 ≤ rfpY3 P.Md P.lam := by rw [e3]; linarith
  have K : ∀ y : ℝ, rfpY3 P.Md P.lam ≤ y → y ≤ Y →
      y + rfpLam P y = (Y + rfpLam P Y) - (1 / 2 - P.lam) * (Y - y) := by
    intro y hy1 hy2

  have I0 : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ξ ≤ 0 → (∫ v in (0:ℝ)..ξ, sigA (50 * v)) = 0 := by

  have R0z : ∀ ξ, ξ ≤ 0 → rfpR0 ξ = 0 := by
    intro ξ h; unfold rfpR0; rw [I0 ξ h, zero_mul]
  have I1 : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 ≤ ξ → 0 ≤ (∫ v in (0:ℝ)..ξ, sigA (50 * v)) ∧

  have R0nn : ∀ ξ, 0 ≤ rfpR0 ξ := by

    · rcases le_total ξ 0 with h | h
      · rw [I0 ξ h]

    · linarith [(sb (ξ - 10)).2]
  have R0z' : ∀ ξ, 11 ≤ ξ → rfpR0 ξ = 0 := by

  have R0le : ∀ ξ, rfpR0 ξ ≤ 11 := by
    intro ξ

    · rw [R0z ξ h]; norm_num
    rcases le_total 11 ξ with h' | h'
    · rw [R0z' ξ h']; norm_num
    unfold rfpR0
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := I1 ξ h

    calc (∫ v in (0:ℝ)..ξ, sigA (50 * v)) * (1 - sigA (ξ - 10))
        ≤ (∫ v in (0:ℝ)..ξ, sigA (50 * v)) * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) a
      _ ≤ 11 := by linarith
  have HR : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpR0 ξ ∧ rfpR0 ξ ≤ 11 := fun ξ => ⟨R0nn ξ, R0le ξ⟩
  have hbmp : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpBmp t ∧ rfpBmp t ≤ 1 := by
    intro t
    unfold rfpBmp
    obtain ⟨a0, a1⟩ := sb (1 + t / (3 / 20))
    obtain ⟨b0, b1⟩ := sb (1 - t / (3 / 20))
    exact ⟨mul_nonneg a0 b0, by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 a1) b0]⟩
  have B1 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ -(3 / 20) → rfpBmp t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpBmp
    rw [s0 (1 + t / (3 / 20)) (by rw [show t / (3 / 20) = 20 / 3 * t by ring]; linarith), zero_mul]
  have B2 : ∀ t : ℝ, 3 / 20 ≤ t → rfpBmp t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpBmp
    rw [s0 (1 - t / (3 / 20)) (by rw [show t / (3 / 20) = 20 / 3 * t by ring]; linarith), mul_zero]
  
  have WC : ∀ (φ r : ℝ → ℝ) (y0 Y β : ℝ), y0 ≤ Y →
      (∀ y : ℝ, y0 ≤ y → y ≤ Y → φ y = φ Y - β * (Y - y)) → (∀ u : ℝ, u ≤ 0 → r u = 0) →
      (∫ y in Iic Y, Real.exp (φ y) * r (y - y0)) =
        Real.exp (φ Y) * (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..(Y - y0), Real.exp (-(β * ((Y - y0) - s))) * r s) := by
    intro φ r y0 Y β hY hφ hr
    set g : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => Real.exp (-(β * ((Y - y0) - s))) * r s with hg
    rw [setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero (s := Icc y0 Y) measurableSet_Iic
      (fun y hy => mem_Iic.2 hy.2) ?_]
    · rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hY]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun y => Real.exp (φ Y) * g (y - y0)) ?_]
      · rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_right g y0, sub_self]
      · intro y hy
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hY] at hy
        show Real.exp (φ y) * r (y - y0) =
          Real.exp (φ Y) * (Real.exp (-(β * ((Y - y0) - (y - y0)))) * r (y - y0))
        rw [hφ y hy.1 hy.2, ← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
        congr 2; ring
    · intro y hy
      obtain ⟨hy1, hy2⟩ := hy
      have hlt : y < y0 := by
        by_contra hc; push_neg at hc; exact hy2 ⟨hc, hy1⟩
      rw [hr _ (by linarith), mul_zero]
  
  have WCB : ∀ (r : ℝ → ℝ) (β t C : ℝ), 0 < β → 0 ≤ t → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ r s ∧ r s ≤ C) →
      0 ≤ (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, Real.exp (-(β * (t - s))) * r s) ∧
        (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, Real.exp (-(β * (t - s))) * r s) ≤ C / β := by
    intro r β t C hβ ht hr
    have hβ0 : β ≠ 0 := hβ.ne'
    have hC : 0 ≤ C := le_trans (hr 0).1 (hr 0).2
    constructor
    · exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg ht (fun u _ => mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (hr u).1)
    · have h1 : ‖∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, Real.exp (-(β * (t - s))) * r s‖ ≤
          ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, C * Real.exp (-(β * (t - s))) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le ht
        · refine ae_of_all _ (fun s _ => ?_)
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (hr s).1), mul_comm]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hr s).2 (Real.exp_pos _).le
        · exact (by fun_prop : Continuous fun s : ℝ => C * Real.exp (-(β * (t - s)))).intervalIntegrable _ _
      have h2 : (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, C * Real.exp (-(β * (t - s)))) =
          C / β - C * Real.exp (-(β * t)) / β := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (f := fun s => C * Real.exp (-(β * (t - s))) / β)]
        · simp only [sub_self, mul_zero, neg_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one, sub_zero]
        · intro s _
          have := ((((hasDerivAt_id' s).const_sub t).const_mul β).neg.exp.const_mul C).div_const β
          convert this using 1
          simp only [Pi.neg_apply]
          field_simp
        · exact (by fun_prop : Continuous fun s : ℝ => C * Real.exp (-(β * (t - s)))).intervalIntegrable _ _
      have h3 : 0 ≤ C * Real.exp (-(β * t)) / β := by positivity
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
      linarith [le_abs_self (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, Real.exp (-(β * (t - s))) * r s)]
  
  have WW : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a w Y Z : ℝ), 0 ≤ w → 0 ≤ Z → (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ f y) →
      (∀ y : ℝ, y < a → f y = 0) → (∀ y : ℝ, a + w < y → f y = 0) →
      (∀ y : ℝ, a ≤ y → y ≤ a + w → y ≤ Y → f y ≤ Z) →
      0 ≤ (∫ y in Iic Y, f y) ∧ (∫ y in Iic Y, f y) ≤ w * Z := by
    intro f a w Y Z hw hZ hf0 hfa hfb hfZ
    refine ⟨setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Iic (fun y _ => hf0 y), ?_⟩
    rw [setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero (s := Iic Y ∩ Icc a (a + w))
      measurableSet_Iic inter_subset_left ?_]
    · have hm : (∫ y in Iic Y ∩ Icc a (a + w), f y) ≤ ∫ y in Iic Y ∩ Icc a (a + w), Z := by
        apply integral_mono_of_nonneg (ae_of_all _ (fun y => hf0 y))
        · exact (continuous_const.integrableOn_Icc).mono_set inter_subset_right
        · rw [Filter.EventuallyLE, ae_restrict_iff' (measurableSet_Iic.inter measurableSet_Icc)]
          exact ae_of_all _ (fun y hy => hfZ y hy.2.1 hy.2.2 hy.1)
      rw [setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul] at hm
      have hv : volume.real (Iic Y ∩ Icc a (a + w)) ≤ w := by
        have := measureReal_mono (μ := volume)
          (inter_subset_right : Iic Y ∩ Icc a (a + w) ⊆ Icc a (a + w)) measure_Icc_lt_top.ne
        rw [Real.volume_real_Icc_of_le (by linarith)] at this
        linarith
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hv hZ
      linarith
    · intro y hy
      obtain ⟨hy1, hy2⟩ := hy
      have hn : ¬ (a ≤ y ∧ y ≤ a + w) := fun h => hy2 ⟨hy1, h⟩
      rcases not_and_or.1 hn with h | h
      · exact hfa y (not_le.1 h)
      · exact hfb y (not_le.1 h)
  
  have WG : ∀ (g p : ℝ → ℝ) (Y C : ℝ), IntegrableOn g (Iic Y) → (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ g y) →
      (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ p y ∧ p y ≤ C) →
      0 ≤ (∫ y in Iic Y, g y) ∧ 0 ≤ (∫ y in Iic Y, g y * p y) ∧
        (∫ y in Iic Y, g y * p y) ≤ C * (∫ y in Iic Y, g y) := by
    intro g p Y C hg hg0 hp
    refine ⟨setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Iic (fun y _ => hg0 y),
      setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Iic (fun y _ => mul_nonneg (hg0 y) (hp y).1), ?_⟩
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_mono_of_nonneg (ae_of_all _ (fun y => mul_nonneg (hg0 y) (hp y).1)) (hg.const_mul C)
    refine ae_of_all _ (fun y => ?_)
    show g y * p y ≤ C * g y
    rw [mul_comm C]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hp y).2 (hg0 y)
  
  have hβ : 0 < 1 / 2 - P.lam := by linarith
  have hZ : 0 ≤ x * Real.exp (rfpLam P Y) := by positivity
  have c1 := WC (fun y => y + rfpLam P y) (fun u => rfpR0 (P.lam * u)) (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) Y
    (1 / 2 - P.lam) hY3 (fun y h1 h2 => K y h1 h2)
    (fun u hu => R0z _ (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hl0.le hu))
  beta_reduce at c1
  rw [hexpY] at c1
  have c2 := WCB (fun s => rfpR0 (P.lam * s)) (1 / 2 - P.lam) (Y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) 11 hβ
    (by linarith) (fun s => HR _)
  beta_reduce at c2
  have h23 : 11 / (1 / 2 - P.lam) ≤ 23 := by rw [div_le_iff₀ hβ]; linarith
  have hwin : ∀ (c : ℝ), 3 / 20 ≤ c → c ≤ 4 → ∀ y : ℝ, rfpY4 P.Md P.lam - c - 3 / 20 ≤ y → y ≤ Y →
      Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + c) ≤ x * Real.exp (rfpLam P Y) := by
    intro c hc1 hc2 y hy1 hy2
    have hy3 : rfpY3 P.Md P.lam ≤ y := by rw [e4] at hy1; linarith
    have hm : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 - P.lam) * (Y - y) := mul_nonneg hβ.le (by linarith)
    calc Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + c)
        ≤ Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbmp _).2 (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) := mul_one _
      _ ≤ Real.exp (Y + rfpLam P Y) := Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by rw [K y hy3 hy2]; linarith)
      _ = x * Real.exp (rfpLam P Y) := hexpY
  have c4 := WW (fun y => Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3))
    (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam - 63 / 20) (3 / 10) Y (x * Real.exp (rfpLam P Y)) (by norm_num) hZ
    (fun y => mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (hbmp _).1)
    (fun y hy => by show _ * _ = _; rw [B1 _ (by linarith), mul_zero])
    (fun y hy => by show _ * _ = _; rw [B2 _ (by linarith), mul_zero])
    (fun y h1 _ h3 => hwin 3 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) y (by linarith) h3)
  beta_reduce at c4
  have c5 := WW (fun y => Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1))
    (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam - 23 / 20) (3 / 10) Y (x * Real.exp (rfpLam P Y)) (by norm_num) hZ
    (fun y => mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (hbmp _).1)
    (fun y hy => by show _ * _ = _; rw [B1 _ (by linarith), mul_zero])
    (fun y hy => by show _ * _ = _; rw [B2 _ (by linarith), mul_zero])
    (fun y h1 _ h3 => hwin 1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) y (by linarith) h3)
  beta_reduce at c5
  
  have hg2c : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (y + 2 * (Real.log P.Pst + y / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y -
      P.lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 P.Md)))) := by
    fun_prop
  have hg2int : IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (y + 2 * (Real.log P.Pst + y / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y -
      P.lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 P.Md)))) (Iic Y) := by
    refine Integrable.mono' ((integrableOn_exp_mul_Iic (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 6 / 5) Y).const_mul
      (Real.exp (2 * Real.log P.Pst))) hg2c.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine ae_of_all _ (fun y => ?_)
    show ‖Real.exp (y + 2 * (Real.log P.Pst + y / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y -
      P.lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 P.Md)))‖ ≤ Real.exp (2 * Real.log P.Pst) * Real.exp (6 / 5 * y)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), ← Real.exp_add]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
    linarith [SigNN y, mul_nonneg hl0.le (SigNN (y - rfpY2 P.Md))]
  have hgint : IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)) (Iic Y) := by
    refine hg2int.congr_fun (fun y hy => ?_) measurableSet_Iic
    show Real.exp (y + 2 * (Real.log P.Pst + y / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y -
      P.lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 P.Md))) = Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)
    rw [hLam y (le_trans hy hY4)]
  have w1 := WG (fun y => Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y))
    (fun y => rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) ^ 2) Y 121 hgint
    (fun y => (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    (fun y => ⟨sq_nonneg _, by
      have a := (HR (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam))).1
      have b := (HR (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam))).2
      show rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) ^ 2 ≤ 121
      nlinarith⟩)
  beta_reduce at w1
  have w2 := WG (fun y => Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y))
    (fun y => rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) ^ 2) Y 1 hgint
    (fun y => (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    (fun y => ⟨sq_nonneg _, by
      have a := (hbmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3)).1
      have b := (hbmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3)).2
      show rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) ^ 2 ≤ 1
      nlinarith⟩)
  beta_reduce at w2
  have w3 := WG (fun y => Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y))
    (fun y => rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) ^ 2) Y 1 hgint
    (fun y => (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    (fun y => ⟨sq_nonneg _, by
      have a := (hbmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1)).1
      have b := (hbmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1)).2
      show rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 1
      nlinarith⟩)
  beta_reduce at w3
  simp only [one_mul] at w2 w3
  exact ⟨c1, c2.1, le_trans c2.2 h23, c4.1, by linarith [c4.2], c5.1, by linarith [c5.2],
    w1.1, w1.2.1, w1.2.2, w2.2.1, w2.2.2, w3.2.1, w3.2.2⟩

informal_problem.statement: rfpPref (fun P => ∀ x : ℝ, rfpXk P 0 ≤ x → x ≤ rfpXv P → 0 ≤ (∫ y in Iic (Real.log x), Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y) ∧ (∫ y in Iic (Real.log x), Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y) ≤ P.lam ^ 50 * x ∧ 0 ≤ (∫ y in Iic (Real.log x), Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y ^ 2) ∧ (∫ y in Iic (Real.log x), Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y ^ 2) ≤ P.lam ^ 20 * (x * Real.exp (rfpLam P (Real.log x))) ∧ (∫ y in Iic (Real.log x), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)) ≤ P.lam ^ 10 * (x * Real.exp (rfpLam P (Real.log x))) ∧ Real.exp (rfpLam P (Real.log x)) ≤ P.lam ^ 20)

signature.statement: rfpPref (fun P => ∀ x : ℝ, rfpXk P 0 ≤ x → x ≤ rfpXv P → 0 ≤ (∫ y in Iic (Real.log x), Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y) ∧ (∫ y in Iic (Real.log x), Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y) ≤ P.lam ^ 50 * x ∧ 0 ≤ (∫ y in Iic (Real.log x), Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y ^ 2) ∧ (∫ y in Iic (Real.log x), Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y ^ 2) ≤ P.lam ^ 20 * (x * Real.exp (rfpLam P (Real.log x))) ∧ (∫ y in Iic (Real.log x), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)) ≤ P.lam ^ 10 * (x * Real.exp (rfpLam P (Real.log x))) ∧ Real.exp (rfpLam P (Real.log x)) ≤ P.lam ^ 20)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hsig0 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → sigA y = 0 := fun y hy => by unfold sigA; rw [if_pos hy]
  have hsig1 : ∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → sigA y = 1 := fun y hy => by
    unfold sigA; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hy]
  have hsigb : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA y ∧ sigA y ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · exact ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
    · exact ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
    · have ha := Real.exp_pos (-1 / y ^ 2)
      have hb := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)
      constructor
      · positivity
      · rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
        linarith
  have hm : Measurable sigA := by
    unfold sigA
    refine Measurable.ite measurableSet_Iic measurable_const
      (Measurable.ite measurableSet_Ici measurable_const ?_)
    fun_prop
  have hsigII : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable sigA volume a b := by
    intro a b
    refine (intervalIntegrable_const (c := (1:ℝ))).mono_fun hm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s => ?_)
    show ‖sigA s‖ ≤ |(1:ℝ)|
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hsigb s).1, abs_one]
    exact (hsigb s).2
  
  have hI0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → rfpSigI t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpSigI
    have e : Set.EqOn sigA (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) (Set.uIcc 0 t) := by
      intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge ht] at hs
      exact hsig0 s hs.2
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr e]
    simp
  have hInn : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpSigI t := by
    intro t
    rcases le_total t 0 with ht | ht
    · rw [hI0 t ht]
    · unfold rfpSigI
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg ht (fun u _ => (hsigb u).1)
  have hIle : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → rfpSigI t ≤ t := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpSigI
    have := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (g := fun _ => (1:ℝ)) ht (hsigII 0 t)
      intervalIntegrable_const (fun u _ => (hsigb u).2)
    simpa using this
  have hIge : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → t - 1 ≤ rfpSigI t := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpSigI
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hsigII 0 1) (hsigII 1 t)]
    have h1 : (∫ s in (1:ℝ)..t, sigA s) = t - 1 := by
      have e : Set.EqOn sigA (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) (Set.uIcc 1 t) := by
        intro s hs
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le ht] at hs
        exact hsig1 s hs.1
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr e]
      simp
    have h2 : 0 ≤ ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, sigA s :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg zero_le_one (fun u _ => (hsigb u).1)
    linarith
  
  have hK : ∀ Md y : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpK Md y ∧ rfpK Md y ≤ 4 := by
    intro Md y
    unfold rfpK
    split_ifs
    · norm_num
    · have := hsigb (Real.log y / Md)
      constructor <;> linarith
  have hKz : ∀ Md y : ℝ, 0 < Md → Real.exp Md ≤ y → rfpK Md y = 0 := by
    intro Md y hMd hy
    have hy1 : 1 < y := lt_of_lt_of_le (by have := Real.add_one_le_exp Md; linarith) hy
    unfold rfpK
    rw [if_neg (not_le.2 hy1)]
    have : Md ≤ Real.log y := by
      rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le (by linarith)]; exact hy
    rw [hsig1 _ ((one_le_div hMd).2 this)]
    ring
  
  have hsupp : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (C E Y : ℝ), E ≤ Y → (∀ y, 0 ≤ f y ∧ f y ≤ C * Real.exp y) →
      (∀ y, E < y → f y = 0) → (∫ y in Iic Y, f y) ≤ C * Real.exp E := by
    intro f C E Y hEY hf hz
    rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Iic
      (Set.Iic_subset_Iic.2 hEY) (fun y hy => hz y (by
        have h2 := hy.2
        simp only [Set.mem_Iic, not_le] at h2
        exact h2))]
    rw [← integral_exp_Iic E, ← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
    refine MeasureTheory.integral_mono_of_nonneg ?_ ((integrableOn_exp_Iic E).const_mul C) ?_
    · filter_upwards with y
      exact (hf y).1
    · filter_upwards with y
      exact (hf y).2
  have hS00 : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (A Y : ℝ), (∀ y, y ≤ Y → y + 2 * g y ≤ A + 1 / 4 * y) →
      (∫ y in Iic Y, Real.exp (y + 2 * g y)) ≤ 4 * Real.exp (A + Y / 4) := by
    intro g A Y hg
    have hint : (∫ y in Iic Y, Real.exp A * Real.exp (1 / 4 * y)) = 4 * Real.exp (A + Y / 4) := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, integral_exp_mul_Iic (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1 / 4),
        Real.exp_add]
      have e : (1:ℝ) / 4 * Y = Y / 4 := by ring
      rw [e]
      ring
    rw [← hint]
    refine MeasureTheory.integral_mono_of_nonneg ?_
      ((integrableOn_exp_mul_Iic (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1 / 4) Y).const_mul _) ?_
    · filter_upwards with y
      exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
    · filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Iic] with y hy
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.2 (hg y hy)
  
  have hlamf : ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam →
      rfpLam P y = Real.log P.Pst + y / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y - P.lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 P.Md) := by
    intro P hR y hy
    obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl1, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hR
    have hL : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.lam) :=
      Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith)
    have hhle : P.h ≤ 1 / 10000 := by nlinarith
    have hT : 0 ≤ P.T1 := by
      have := Real.log_nonneg (show (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 / P.h by rw [le_div_iff₀ hh0]; linarith)
      linarith
    have hρ1 : P.ρ < 1 := by linarith
    have h5 : rfpY5 P.Md P.lam = rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
    have hb : rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh = rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 2 + P.T1 + P.Lh + 3 := rfl
    have e1 : rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) = 0 := hI0 _ (by linarith)
    have e2 : rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) = 0 := hI0 _ (by linarith)
    have e3 : sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) = 0 := hsig0 _ (by linarith)
    have e4 : tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) = 1 - P.ρ := by
      unfold tailFac
      rw [← Real.exp_sub, Real.log_exp, hsig0 _ (by linarith)]
      ring
    unfold rfpLam
    rw [e1, e2, e3, e4, div_self (by linarith : (1:ℝ) - P.ρ ≠ 0), Real.log_one]
    ring
  
  refine ⟨1, one_pos, ?_⟩
  intro Md hMd
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  intro Pst hPst
  refine ⟨Real.exp (-(20 + |Real.log Pst|)), Real.exp_pos _, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam hlaml
  refine ⟨1, one_pos, ?_⟩
  intro P hPMd hPPst hPlam _ hReg _
  intro x hx1 hx2
  have hlf := hlamf P hReg
  obtain ⟨hMd0, hPst0, hl0, hl1, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hReg
  subst hPMd hPPst hPlam
  obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = Real.log (1 / P.lam) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hLe : P.lam = Real.exp (-L) := by
    rw [hLdef, one_div, Real.log_inv, neg_neg, Real.exp_log hl0]
  have hLneg : L = -Real.log P.lam := by rw [hLdef, one_div, Real.log_inv]
  have hLge : 20 + |Real.log P.Pst| ≤ L := by
    have := Real.log_le_log hl0 hlaml
    rw [Real.log_exp] at this
    linarith
  have habs := le_abs_self (Real.log P.Pst)
  have habs0 := abs_nonneg (Real.log P.Pst)
  have hPpos : 0 < P.Pst := lt_trans (Real.exp_pos _) hPst0
  have hlE : Real.exp P.Md + 10 < Real.log P.Pst := (Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt hPpos).2 hPst0
  have hE0 : 0 < Real.exp P.Md := Real.exp_pos _
  have hp : ∀ n : ℕ, P.lam ^ n = Real.exp (-((n:ℝ) * L)) := by
    intro n
    rw [hLe, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hp50 : P.lam ^ 50 = Real.exp (-(50 * L)) := by rw [hp 50]; norm_num
  have hp20 : P.lam ^ 20 = Real.exp (-(20 * L)) := by rw [hp 20]; norm_num
  have hp10 : P.lam ^ 10 = Real.exp (-(10 * L)) := by rw [hp 10]; norm_num
  have he2 : (4:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 2 := by
    have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (1:ℝ)
    have : Real.exp 2 = Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
    nlinarith
  have he4 : (16:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 4 := by
    have : Real.exp 4 = Real.exp 2 * Real.exp 2 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
    nlinarith
  
  have hxk0 : 0 < rfpXk P 0 := Real.exp_pos _
  have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hxk0 hx1
  have hY3 : rfpY3 P.Md P.lam ≤ Real.log x := by
    have := Real.log_le_log hxk0 hx1
    unfold rfpXk at this
    rwa [sub_zero, Real.log_exp] at this
  have hY4 : Real.log x ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam := by
    have := Real.log_le_log hx0 hx2
    unfold rfpXv at this
    rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
  have hy3 : rfpY3 P.Md P.lam = Real.exp P.Md + 12 + 60 * L := by
    rw [hLdef]; unfold rfpY3 rfpY2; ring
  have hy2 : rfpY2 P.Md = Real.exp P.Md + 11 := rfl
  obtain ⟨Y, hY⟩ : ∃ Y : ℝ, Real.log x = Y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hxY : x = Real.exp Y := by rw [← hY, Real.exp_log hx0]
  rw [hY] at hY3 hY4
  rw [hY, hxY]
  have hYlo : Real.exp P.Md + 12 + 60 * L ≤ Y := by linarith
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := by linarith
  have hY0 : 0 ≤ Y := by linarith
  
  have hwf := hlf Y hY4
  have hS1 := hIge Y (by linarith)
  have hS2 := hIle (Y - rfpY2 P.Md) (by linarith)
  have hS3 := hInn (Y - rfpY2 P.Md)
  have hlS : P.lam * rfpSigI (Y - rfpY2 P.Md) ≤ P.lam * Y :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hl0.le
  have hlS0 : 0 ≤ P.lam * rfpSigI (Y - rfpY2 P.Md) := mul_nonneg hl0.le hS3
  have hSY := hIle Y hY0
  have hlY : P.lam * Y ≤ 1 / 100 * Y := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hl1 hY0
  have hwlo : Real.log P.Pst - Y / 2 - P.lam * Y ≤ rfpLam P Y := by rw [hwf]; linarith
  have hwhi : rfpLam P Y ≤ Real.log P.Pst + 3 / 5 - Y / 2 := by rw [hwf]; linarith
  
  have henv : ∀ y, y ≤ Y → y + 2 * rfpLam P y ≤ (2 * Real.log P.Pst + 6 / 5) + 1 / 4 * y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hlf y (le_trans hy hY4)]
    have h1 := mul_nonneg hl0.le (hInn (y - rfpY2 P.Md))
    rcases le_total y 1 with hy1 | hy1
    · have := hInn y
      linarith
    · have := hIge y hy1
      linarith
  have hEY : Real.exp P.Md ≤ Y := by linarith
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact MeasureTheory.setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Iic
      (fun y _ => mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos y).le (hK P.Md y).1)
  · calc (∫ y in Iic Y, Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y) ≤ 4 * Real.exp (Real.exp P.Md) :=
          hsupp (fun y => Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y) 4 (Real.exp P.Md) Y hEY
            (fun y => by
              have hk := hK P.Md y
              have he := Real.exp_pos y
              constructor
              · exact mul_nonneg he.le hk.1
              · nlinarith)
            (fun y hy => by
              show Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y = 0
              rw [hKz P.Md y hMd0 hy.le, mul_zero])
      _ ≤ Real.exp 2 * Real.exp (Real.exp P.Md) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he2 (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = Real.exp (2 + Real.exp P.Md) := (Real.exp_add _ _).symm
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-(50 * L) + Y) := Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by linarith)
      _ = P.lam ^ 50 * Real.exp Y := by rw [Real.exp_add, hp50]
  · exact MeasureTheory.setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Iic
      (fun y _ => mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos y).le (sq_nonneg _))
  · calc (∫ y in Iic Y, Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y ^ 2) ≤ 16 * Real.exp (Real.exp P.Md) :=
          hsupp (fun y => Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y ^ 2) 16 (Real.exp P.Md) Y hEY
            (fun y => by
              have hk := hK P.Md y
              have he := Real.exp_pos y
              have hk2 : rfpK P.Md y ^ 2 ≤ 16 := by nlinarith
              constructor
              · exact mul_nonneg he.le (sq_nonneg _)
              · nlinarith)
            (fun y hy => by
              show Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y ^ 2 = 0
              rw [hKz P.Md y hMd0 hy.le]
              ring)
      _ ≤ Real.exp 4 * Real.exp (Real.exp P.Md) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he4 (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = Real.exp (4 + Real.exp P.Md) := (Real.exp_add _ _).symm
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-(20 * L) + (Y + rfpLam P Y)) := Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by linarith)
      _ = P.lam ^ 20 * (Real.exp Y * Real.exp (rfpLam P Y)) := by
          rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add, hp20]
  · calc (∫ y in Iic Y, Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y))
          ≤ 4 * Real.exp ((2 * Real.log P.Pst + 6 / 5) + Y / 4) :=
          hS00 (rfpLam P) (2 * Real.log P.Pst + 6 / 5) Y henv
      _ ≤ Real.exp 2 * Real.exp ((2 * Real.log P.Pst + 6 / 5) + Y / 4) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he2 (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = Real.exp (2 + ((2 * Real.log P.Pst + 6 / 5) + Y / 4)) := (Real.exp_add _ _).symm
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-(10 * L) + (Y + rfpLam P Y)) := Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by linarith)
      _ = P.lam ^ 10 * (Real.exp Y * Real.exp (rfpLam P Y)) := by
          rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add, hp10]
  · rw [hp20]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by linarith)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hP hC x η hx1 hx2 he1 he2
  have hR := hP
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl100, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hR
  have hPst0 : 0 < P.Pst := lt_trans (Real.exp_pos _) hPst
  obtain ⟨_, cG1, -, -, -⟩ := rfp_clamp_identities P hP
  obtain ⟨hcm, -, -, hcneg, C, κ, hκ, hCb⟩ := rfp_shape_data P hP
  obtain ⟨hAs, hc1s, hc2s, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hC
  
  obtain ⟨KB, hKB⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = ∫ y in Iic (Real.log x), Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨K2, hK2⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = ∫ y in Iic (Real.log x), Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨M0, hM0⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = ∫ y in Iic (Real.log x),
      Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨M1, hM1⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = ∫ y in Iic (Real.log x),
      Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨M2, hM2⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = ∫ y in Iic (Real.log x),
      Real.exp (y + rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨S0, hS0⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = ∫ y in Iic (Real.log x),
      Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨S1, hS1⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = ∫ y in Iic (Real.log x),
      Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨S2, hS2⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = ∫ y in Iic (Real.log x),
      Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨S00, hS00⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = ∫ y in Iic (Real.log x), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hxk0 : 0 < rfpXk P 0 := Real.exp_pos _
  have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hxk0 hx1
  have hY3 : rfpY3 P.Md P.lam ≤ Real.log x := by
    have := Real.log_le_log hxk0 hx1
    unfold rfpXk at this
    rw [Real.log_exp, sub_zero] at this
    exact this
  have hY4 : Real.log x ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam := by
    have := Real.log_le_log hx0 hx2
    unfold rfpXv at this
    rw [Real.log_exp] at this
    exact this
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.lam) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith)
  have hy3 : Real.exp P.Md + 12 ≤ rfpY3 P.Md P.lam := by
    unfold rfpY3 rfpY2; linarith
  have h13 : 1300 ≤ 13 / P.lam := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith
  have hy4 : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam = rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 13 / P.lam := rfl
  have hlam13 : P.lam * (13 / P.lam) = 13 := mul_div_cancel₀ _ hl0.ne'
  
  have hsig : ∀ t, 0 ≤ sigA t ∧ sigA t ≤ 1 := by
    intro t
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · exact ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
    · exact ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
    · have ha := Real.exp_pos (-1 / t ^ 2)
      have hc := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2)
      refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
      linarith
  have hsig0 : ∀ t, t ≤ 0 → sigA t = 0 := fun t ht => by unfold sigA; rw [if_pos ht]
  have hsig1 : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → sigA t = 1 := fun t ht => by
    unfold sigA; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos ht]
  have hsigm : Measurable sigA := by
    have e : sigA = fun y => if y ≤ 0 then 0 else if 1 ≤ y then 1 else
        Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) / (Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)) := by
      funext y; rfl
    rw [e]
    refine Measurable.ite measurableSet_Iic measurable_const
      (Measurable.ite measurableSet_Ici measurable_const ?_)
    fun_prop
  
  have hR0neg : ∀ ξ, ξ ≤ 0 → rfpR0 ξ = 0 := by
    intro ξ hn
    unfold rfpR0
    have hz : (∫ v in (0:ℝ)..ξ, sigA (50 * v)) = ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..ξ, (0:ℝ) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro v hv
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge hn] at hv
      exact hsig0 _ (by linarith [hv.2])
    rw [hz, intervalIntegral.integral_zero, zero_mul]
  have hR0big : ∀ ξ, 11 ≤ ξ → rfpR0 ξ = 0 := by
    intro ξ h
    unfold rfpR0
    rw [hsig1 _ (by linarith)]
    ring
  have hbmp0 : ∀ t, (t ≤ -(3 / 20) ∨ 3 / 20 ≤ t) → rfpBmp t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpBmp
    rcases ht with ht | ht
    · have h' : t / (3 / 20) ≤ -1 := by rw [div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
      rw [hsig0 (1 + t / (3 / 20)) (by linarith), zero_mul]
    · have h' : 1 ≤ t / (3 / 20) := by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
      rw [hsig0 (1 - t / (3 / 20)) (by linarith), mul_zero]
  have hK0 : ∀ y, Real.exp P.Md ≤ y → rfpK P.Md y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hE1 : P.Md + 1 ≤ Real.exp P.Md := Real.add_one_le_exp P.Md
    have h1 : 1 < y := by linarith
    unfold rfpK
    rw [if_neg (by linarith)]
    have h2 : 1 ≤ Real.log y / P.Md := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hMd, one_mul]
      have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hy
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
    rw [hsig1 _ h2]
    ring
  
  have hKφ : ∀ y, rfpK P.Md y * rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) = 0 ∧
      rfpK P.Md y * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) = 0 ∧
      rfpK P.Md y * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) = 0 := by
    intro y
    rcases le_or_gt (Real.exp P.Md) y with hy | hy
    · rw [hK0 y hy]; simp
    · have hyl : y < rfpY3 P.Md P.lam := by linarith
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hR0neg _ (by nlinarith)]; ring
      · rw [hbmp0 _ (Or.inl (by rw [hy4]; linarith))]; ring
      · rw [hbmp0 _ (Or.inl (by rw [hy4]; linarith))]; ring
  have hshift : ∀ y, P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) = P.lam * (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) + 13 := by
    intro y
    rw [hy4]
    linear_combination hlam13
  have hφ01 : ∀ y, rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) = 0 := by
    intro y
    rcases le_or_gt (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) (-(3 / 20)) with h | h
    · rw [hbmp0 _ (Or.inl h)]; ring
    · have h11 : 11 ≤ P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) := by
        rw [hshift y]
        nlinarith
      rw [hR0big _ h11]; ring
  have hφ02 : ∀ y, rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) = 0 := by
    intro y
    rcases le_or_gt (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) (-(3 / 20)) with h | h
    · rw [hbmp0 _ (Or.inl h)]; ring
    · have h11 : 11 ≤ P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) := by
        rw [hshift y]
        nlinarith
      rw [hR0big _ h11]; ring
  have hφ12 : ∀ y, rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) = 0 := by
    intro y
    rcases le_or_gt (3 / 20) (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) with h | h
    · rw [hbmp0 _ (Or.inr h)]; ring
    · rw [hbmp0 (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) (Or.inl (by linarith))]; ring
  
  have hb : ∀ t, |rfpBmp t| ≤ 1 := by

      have := mul_le_mul (ha2a.trans hL1) (ha2a.trans hL1) (abs_nonneg a2) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / 100)
      linarith
    have u1 : A ^ 2 * S0 ≤ 36 / 25 * (121 * S00) := mul_le_mul hA2' hS01 hS00 (by norm_num)
    have u2 : a1 ^ 2 * S1 ≤ 1 / 10000 * S00 := mul_le_mul hsa1 hS11 hS10 (by norm_num)

    have v2 : 0 ≤ a1 ^ 2 * S1 := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hS10
    have v3 : 0 ≤ a2 ^ 2 * S2 := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hS20
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hH' : |2 * A * A' * S0 + 2 * a1 * a1' * S1 + 2 * a2 * a2' * S2| ≤ 30 * S00 := by
    have hS0a : |S0| ≤ 121 * S00 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hS00]; exact hS01
    have hS1a : |S1| ≤ S00 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hS10]; exact hS11
    have hS2a : |S2| ≤ S00 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hS20]; exact hS21
    have c0 : |2 * A| ≤ 2 * (6 / 5) := pb _ _ _ _ habs2 hAa
    have c1 : |2 * a1| ≤ 2 * lam ^ 20 := pb _ _ _ _ habs2 ha1a
    have c2 : |2 * a2| ≤ 2 * lam ^ 20 := pb _ _ _ _ habs2 ha2a
    have d0 := pb _ _ _ _ (pb _ _ _ _ c0 hA'a) hS0a
    have d1 := pb _ _ _ _ (pb _ _ _ _ c1 ha1'a) hS1a
    have d2 := pb _ _ _ _ (pb _ _ _ _ c2 ha2'a) hS2a
    have hLL : 2 * lam ^ 20 * lam ^ 20 ≤ 2 / 10000 := by
      have := mul_le_mul hL1 hL1 hL0 (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / 100)
      linarith
    have e1' : 2 * lam ^ 20 * lam ^ 20 * S00 ≤ 2 / 10000 * S00 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hLL hS000
    have := abs_add_three (2 * A * A' * S0) (2 * a1 * a1' * S1) (2 * a2 * a2' * S2)
    linarith
  
  have s6 : ∀ H H' : ℝ, |H| ≤ 175 * S00 → |H'| ≤ 30 * S00 → |(4 * h * η * (η ^ 2 * K2 + ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * H) - (1 - η ^ 2) * (2 * η * K2 + 2 * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (-(2 * η) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) * H + ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * H')) * (1 + η ^ 2) / (x * e1)| ≤ 1500 * lam ^ 10 := by
    intro H H' hHa hH'a

      rw [abs_of_nonneg hK20]
      exact hK21.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2010 hZ.le)
    have hHY : |H| ≤ 175 * (lam ^ 10 * (x * e1)) := by linarith
    have hH'Y : |H'| ≤ 30 * (lam ^ 10 * (x * e1)) := by linarith
    have w1 := pb _ _ _ _ hη2a hK
    have w2 := pb _ _ _ _ hI2a hHY
    have hSS : |η ^ 2 * K2 + ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * H| ≤ 176 * (lam ^ 10 * (x * e1)) := by
      have := abs_add_le (η ^ 2 * K2) (((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * H)

    have c4h : |4 * h| ≤ 4 / 10000 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]; linarith
    have b1 := pb _ _ _ _ (pb _ _ _ _ c4h hηa) hSS
    have b2 := pb _ _ _ _ c2η hK
    have c2I : |2 * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹| ≤ 2 * 1 := pb _ _ _ _ habs2 hIa

      have := abs_add_three (2 * η * K2) (2 * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (-(2 * η) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) * H) (((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * H')

      have := abs_sub (4 * h * η * (η ^ 2 * K2 + ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * H)) ((1 - η ^ 2) * (2 * η * K2 + 2 * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (-(2 * η) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) * H + ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * H'))
      linarith

  have k4 : |(4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * Pi - (1 - η ^ 2) * Pi') * (1 + η ^ 2) / e1| ≤ 13 * lam ^ 20 := by

    have : e1 ^ 2 ≤ lam ^ 20 * e1 := by rw [sq]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hel he.le

informal_problem.statement: Differentiable ℝ sigA ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ deriv sigA t ∧ deriv sigA t ≤ 200) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, (t ≤ 0 ∨ 1 ≤ t) → deriv sigA t = 0)

signature.name: sigA_deriv_facts
signature.statement: Differentiable ℝ sigA ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ deriv sigA t ∧ deriv sigA t ≤ 200) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, (t ≤ 0 ∨ 1 ≤ t) → deriv sigA t = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hC : ContDiff ℝ 1 sigA := by
    have hm : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun w : ℝ => w * |w|) (2 * |y|) y := by
      intro y
      rcases lt_trichotomy y 0 with hy | hy | hy
      · have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℝ => -(w ^ 2)) (2 * |y|) y := by
          have := (hasDerivAt_pow 2 y).neg
          convert this using 1
          rw [abs_of_neg hy]; push_cast; ring
        refine h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
        filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hy] with w hw
        rw [abs_of_neg hw]; ring
      · subst hy
        rw [hasDerivAt_iff_isLittleO, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
        intro c hc
        filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0:ℝ) hc] with w hw
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at hw
        simp only [abs_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero, smul_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_abs]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hw.le (abs_nonneg w)
      · have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℝ => w ^ 2) (2 * |y|) y := by
          convert hasDerivAt_pow 2 y using 1
          rw [abs_of_pos hy]; push_cast; ring
        refine h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hy] with w hw
        rw [abs_of_pos hw]; ring
    have hmC : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun w : ℝ => w * |w|) := by
      rw [contDiff_one_iff_deriv]
      refine ⟨fun y => (hm y).differentiableAt, ?_⟩
      have hd : deriv (fun w : ℝ => w * |w|) = fun y => 2 * |y| := funext fun y => (hm y).deriv
      rw [hd]
      exact continuous_const.mul continuous_abs
    obtain ⟨q, hq_def⟩ : ∃ q : ℝ → ℝ, q = fun y => expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hqC : ContDiff ℝ 1 q := by
      rw [hq_def]
      exact expNegInvGlue.contDiff.comp hmC
    have hq1C : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun y => q (1 - y)) := hqC.comp (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id)
    have hDC : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun y => q y + q (1 - y)) := hqC.add hq1C
    have qpos_arg : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → 0 < y * |y| := fun y hy => by
      rw [abs_of_pos hy]; exact mul_pos hy hy
    have qa : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → q y = 0 := fun y hy => by
      rw [hq_def]
      exact expNegInvGlue.zero_of_nonpos (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hy (abs_nonneg y))
    have qb : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → 0 < q y := fun y hy => by
      rw [hq_def]
      exact expNegInvGlue.pos_of_pos (qpos_arg y hy)
    have qc : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ q y := fun y => by
      rw [hq_def]
      exact expNegInvGlue.nonneg _
    have qd : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → q y = Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hq_def]
      show expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) = _
      rw [expNegInvGlue, if_neg (not_le.mpr (qpos_arg y hy)), abs_of_pos hy]
      congr 1
      rw [neg_div, one_div, sq]
    have hDpos : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < q y + q (1 - y) := by
      intro y
      by_cases hy : 0 < y
      · exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (qb y hy) (qc _)
      · exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (qc y) (qb _ (by linarith [not_lt.mp hy]))
    have heq : sigA = fun y => q y / (q y + q (1 - y)) := by
      funext y
      unfold sigA
      split_ifs with h1 h2
      · rw [qa y h1, zero_div]
      · have hy : 0 < y := not_le.mp h1
        rw [qa (1 - y) (by linarith), add_zero, div_self (qb y hy).ne']
      · have hy : 0 < y := not_le.mp h1
        rw [qd y hy, qd (1 - y) (by linarith [not_le.mp h2])]
    rw [heq]
    exact hqC.div hDC (fun y => (hDpos y).ne')
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ sigA := hC.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hcont : Continuous (deriv sigA) := hC.continuous_deriv le_rfl
  
  have hneg : ∀ t : ℝ, t < 0 → deriv sigA t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    have hev : sigA =ᶠ[nhds t] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds ht] with y hy
      have hy' : y < 0 := hy
      unfold sigA
      rw [if_pos hy'.le]
    rw [hev.deriv_eq]
    simp
  have hbig : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 < t → deriv sigA t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    have hev : sigA =ᶠ[nhds t] fun _ => (1:ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds ht] with y hy
      have hy' : (1:ℝ) < y := hy
      unfold sigA
      rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hy'.le]
    rw [hev.deriv_eq]
    simp
  
  have hZ : IsClosed {y : ℝ | deriv sigA y = 0} := isClosed_eq hcont continuous_const
  have hle0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → deriv sigA t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    have hsub : Set.Iio (0:ℝ) ⊆ {y : ℝ | deriv sigA y = 0} := fun y hy => hneg y hy
    have h2 := hZ.closure_subset_iff.mpr hsub
    rw [closure_Iio] at h2
    exact h2 (Set.mem_Iic.mpr ht)
  have hge1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → deriv sigA t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    have hsub : Set.Ioi (1:ℝ) ⊆ {y : ℝ | deriv sigA y = 0} := fun y hy => hbig y hy
    have h2 := hZ.closure_subset_iff.mpr hsub
    rw [closure_Ioi] at h2
    exact h2 (Set.mem_Ici.mpr ht)
  
  have hmid : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < 1 → HasDerivAt sigA
      (Real.exp (-1 / t ^ 2) * Real.exp (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2) * (2 / t ^ 3 + 2 / (1 - t) ^ 3) /
        (Real.exp (-1 / t ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2)) ^ 2) t := by
    intro t ht0 ht1
    have hs0 : (1 - t) ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have ht0' : t ≠ 0 := ht0.ne'
    have hp : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => -1 / y ^ 2) (2 / t ^ 3) t := by
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) (2 * t) t := by
        simpa using hasDerivAt_pow 2 t
      have := (hasDerivAt_const t (-1:ℝ)).div h1 (pow_ne_zero 2 ht0')
      convert this using 1
      field_simp
      ring
    have hq : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => -1 / (1 - y) ^ 2) (-(2 / (1 - t) ^ 3)) t := by
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (1 - y) ^ 2) (-(2 * (1 - t))) t := by
        have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => 1 - y) (-1) t := by
          simpa using (hasDerivAt_id t).const_sub (1:ℝ)
        have := h0.pow 2
        convert this using 1
        simp
      have := (hasDerivAt_const t (-1:ℝ)).div h1 (pow_ne_zero 2 hs0)
      convert this using 1
      field_simp
      ring
    have ha := hp.exp
    have hb := hq.exp
    have hS : Real.exp (-1 / t ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hg := ha.div (ha.add hb) hS
    have hev : sigA =ᶠ[nhds t] fun y => Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) /
        (Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)) := by
      filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds (show t ∈ Set.Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 from ⟨ht0, ht1⟩)] with y hy
      unfold sigA
      rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr hy.1), if_neg (not_le.mpr hy.2)]
    refine (hg.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    congr 1
    ring
  
  have key : ∀ u v : ℝ, 0 < u → u ≤ 1 / 2 → 1 / 2 ≤ v →
      Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) * Real.exp (-1 / v ^ 2) * (2 / u ^ 3 + 2 / v ^ 3) ≤
        166 * (Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / v ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
    intro u v hu hu2 hv
    have hv0 : 0 < v := by linarith
    have hA0 : 0 < Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) := Real.exp_pos _
    have hB0 : 0 < Real.exp (-1 / v ^ 2) := Real.exp_pos _
    
    have hAx : Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) * (1 / u ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ 2 := by
      have hx0 : 0 ≤ 1 / u ^ 2 := by positivity
      have h3 := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (1 / u ^ 2) hx0 2
      have hf : ((Nat.factorial 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2 := by norm_num [Nat.factorial]
      rw [hf] at h3
      have hprod : Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) * Real.exp (1 / u ^ 2) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        rw [show -1 / u ^ 2 + 1 / u ^ 2 = 0 by ring, Real.exp_zero]
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hA0.le
      nlinarith
    have hX : Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) * (2 / u ^ 3) ≤ 2 := by
      have e : Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) * (2 / u ^ 3) =
          Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) * (1 / u ^ 2) ^ 2 * (2 * u) := by
        have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := hu.ne'
        field_simp
      rw [e]
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAx (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * u)
      nlinarith
    have hY : 2 / v ^ 3 ≤ 16 := by
      have hv3 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ v ^ 3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) hv 3
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith
    have hB : 1 ≤ 81 * Real.exp (-1 / v ^ 2) := by
      have hiv : 1 / v ^ 2 ≤ 4 := by
        have hv2 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ v ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) hv 2
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        nlinarith
      have hle : Real.exp (-4) ≤ Real.exp (-1 / v ^ 2) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        rw [neg_div]
        linarith
      have he1 := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
      have he0 := Real.exp_pos 1
      have he4 : Real.exp 4 = Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
        norm_num
      have h81 : Real.exp 4 < 81 := by
        rw [he4]
        have h3 : Real.exp 1 < 3 := by linarith
        have h1 : Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 < 9 := by nlinarith
        nlinarith
      have hprod : Real.exp (-4) * Real.exp 4 = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
      have := Real.exp_pos (-4)
      nlinarith
    set A := Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) with hAdef
    set B := Real.exp (-1 / v ^ 2) with hBdef
    have e : A * B * (2 / u ^ 3 + 2 / v ^ 3) = (A * (2 / u ^ 3)) * B + A * B * (2 / v ^ 3) := by
      ring
    rw [e]
    have i1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hX hB0.le
    have i2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hY (mul_pos hA0 hB0).le
    have i3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * B)
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (A - B), mul_pos hA0 hB0]
  have hbound : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < 1 →
      0 ≤ Real.exp (-1 / t ^ 2) * Real.exp (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2) * (2 / t ^ 3 + 2 / (1 - t) ^ 3) /
        (Real.exp (-1 / t ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2)) ^ 2 ∧
      Real.exp (-1 / t ^ 2) * Real.exp (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2) * (2 / t ^ 3 + 2 / (1 - t) ^ 3) /
        (Real.exp (-1 / t ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2)) ^ 2 ≤ 200 := by
    intro t ht0 ht1
    have hs : 0 < 1 - t := by linarith
    have hA0 : 0 < Real.exp (-1 / t ^ 2) := Real.exp_pos _
    have hB0 : 0 < Real.exp (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2) := Real.exp_pos _
    have hS2 : 0 < (Real.exp (-1 / t ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hN : Real.exp (-1 / t ^ 2) * Real.exp (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2) * (2 / t ^ 3 + 2 / (1 - t) ^ 3) ≤
        166 * (Real.exp (-1 / t ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
      by_cases hc : t ≤ 1 / 2
      · exact key t (1 - t) ht0 hc (by linarith)
      · have h := key (1 - t) t hs (by linarith) (by linarith)
        have e1 : Real.exp (-1 / t ^ 2) * Real.exp (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2) * (2 / t ^ 3 + 2 / (1 - t) ^ 3) =
            Real.exp (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2) * Real.exp (-1 / t ^ 2) * (2 / (1 - t) ^ 3 + 2 / t ^ 3) := by
          ring
        have e2 : (Real.exp (-1 / t ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2)) ^ 2 =
            (Real.exp (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / t ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
          ring
        rw [e1, e2]
        exact h
    have hpos : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-1 / t ^ 2) * Real.exp (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2) * (2 / t ^ 3 + 2 / (1 - t) ^ 3) := by
      have : 0 ≤ 2 / (1 - t) ^ 3 := by positivity
      have : 0 ≤ 2 / t ^ 3 := by positivity
      positivity
    refine ⟨div_nonneg hpos hS2.le, ?_⟩
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hS2]
    linarith
  
  refine ⟨hdiff, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t
    by_cases h0 : t ≤ 0
    · rw [hle0 t h0]; norm_num
    by_cases h1 : 1 ≤ t
    · rw [hge1 t h1]; norm_num
    have ht0 : 0 < t := not_le.mp h0
    have ht1 : t < 1 := not_le.mp h1
    rw [(hmid t ht0 ht1).deriv]
    exact hbound t ht0 ht1
  · intro t ht
    rcases ht with h | h

subgoal_signatures.name: rfp_sig_basics
subgoal_signatures.statement: (∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → sigA y = 0) ∧ (∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → sigA y = 1) ∧ (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA y ∧ sigA y ≤ 1) ∧ Continuous sigA ∧ Continuous rfpSigI ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → rfpSigI t = 0) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → rfpSigI t = t - 1 + rfpSigI 1) ∧ 0 ≤ rfpSigI 1 ∧ rfpSigI 1 ≤ 1

subgoal_signatures.statement: ContDiff ℝ 1 sigA

subgoal_signatures.statement: ContDiff ℝ 1 sigA → ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → Continuous (rfpLam P) ∧ (∀ y : ℝ, rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 4 ≤ y → y ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam → rfpLam P y = rfpLam P (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) + (1 / 2 + P.lam) * (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - y)) ∧ ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam → 3 / 2 * y + rfpLam P y ≤ 3 / 2 * rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + rfpLam P (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) + Real.log 2 - (1 - P.lam) * (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - y)

subgoal_signatures.name: rfp_psi_window
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → Continuous rfpBmp → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpBmp t ∧ rfpBmp t ≤ 1) → (∀ t : ℝ, 3 / 20 ≤ |t| → rfpBmp t = 0) → (∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 3 / 40 → 1 / 4 ≤ rfpBmp t) → (∀ y : ℝ, rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 4 ≤ y → y ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam → rfpLam P y = rfpLam P (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) + (1 / 2 + P.lam) * (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - y)) → rfpKa P = Real.exp (2 + 4 * P.lam) ∧ Continuous (rfpPsi P) ∧ (∀ y : ℝ, |rfpPsi P y| ≤ 8) ∧ (∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 4 → rfpPsi P y = 0) ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, rfpPsi P (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + s) = rfpBmp (s + 3) - Real.exp (2 + 4 * P.lam) * rfpBmp (s + 1)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → RfpClos P → ∀ v η : ℝ, -2 < η → η < 2 → 0 < rfpE P v η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun e => rfpE P v e) (rfpE P v η * (-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)) + deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v)))) η ∧ |rfpE P v η * (-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)) + deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v)))| ≤ 2 * rfpE P v η ∧ (-1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → η * (rfpE P v η * (-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)) + deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v)))) ≤ 8 * P.lam ^ 20 * rfpE P v η) ∧ (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ≤ v → deriv (fun e => rfpE P v e) η = 0)

signature.name: rfp_E_eta
signature.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → RfpClos P → ∀ v η : ℝ, -2 < η → η < 2 → 0 < rfpE P v η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun e => rfpE P v e) (rfpE P v η * (-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)) + deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v)))) η ∧ |rfpE P v η * (-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)) + deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v)))| ≤ 2 * rfpE P v η ∧ (-1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → η * (rfpE P v η * (-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)) + deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v)))) ≤ 8 * P.lam ^ 20 * rfpE P v η) ∧ (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ≤ v → deriv (fun e => rfpE P v e) η = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hReg hClos v η h2a h2b
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, hψ8, -⟩ := rfp_I_reduction P hReg
  have hReg' := hReg
  obtain ⟨-, -, hl0, hl1, -⟩ := hReg'
  have hClos' := hClos
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hcas, -, hcl, -, -⟩ := hClos'
  have hsig : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA t ∧ sigA t ≤ 1 := by
    intro t
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs
    · exact ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
    · exact ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
    · have ha := Real.exp_pos (-1 / t ^ 2)
      have hb := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2)
      refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
      linarith
  have hθ0 : 0 ≤ rfpTh P v := by
    unfold rfpTh; linarith [(hsig ((v - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60)).2]
  have hθ1 : rfpTh P v ≤ 1 := by
    unfold rfpTh; linarith [(hsig ((v - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60)).1]
  obtain ⟨hcd, hcy⟩ := hcl η h2a h2b
  have hψ := hψ8 v
  have hcψ := hcy v
  have hg : 1 / 2 ≤ 1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v := by
    have := (abs_le.1 hcψ).1; linarith
  have hgpos : 0 < 1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v := by linarith
  have hc'b : |deriv P.ca η| ≤ P.lam ^ 20 := by
    have := abs_nonneg (P.ca η); linarith
  have hl20 : P.lam ^ 20 ≤ 1 / 100 := by
    have : P.lam ^ 20 ≤ P.lam := pow_le_of_le_one hl0.le (by linarith) (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hq : 0 < 1 + η ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hb : 0 < (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ := inv_pos.2 hq
  have hbθ : 0 < ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P v) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hb _
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hgpos
  have hEdef : ∀ e, rfpE P v e = Real.exp (rfpLam P v) * ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P v) *
      Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca e * rfpPsi P v) := fun e => rfl
  have hE : 0 < rfpE P v η := by
    rw [hEdef]; exact mul_pos (mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) hbθ) hs
  
  have hcaD : HasDerivAt P.ca (deriv P.ca η) η := by
    have : DifferentiableAt ℝ P.ca η :=
      (hcas.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds ⟨h2a, h2b⟩)
    exact this.hasDerivAt
  have hgD : HasDerivAt (fun e => 1 + P.ca e * rfpPsi P v) (deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v) η :=
    (hcaD.mul_const (rfpPsi P v)).const_add 1
  have hsD := hgD.sqrt hgpos.ne'
  have hqD : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => 1 + e ^ 2) (2 * η) η := by
    have := (hasDerivAt_pow 2 η).const_add 1
    simpa using this
  have hbD := hqD.inv hq.ne'
  have hrD := hbD.rpow_const (p := rfpTh P v) (Or.inl hb.ne')
  have hPD := (hrD.const_mul (Real.exp (rfpLam P v))).mul hsD
  have hDer : HasDerivAt (fun e => rfpE P v e) (rfpE P v η * (-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)) + deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v)))) η := by
    show HasDerivAt (fun e => Real.exp (rfpLam P v) * ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P v) *
      Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca e * rfpPsi P v)) _ η
    convert hPD using 1
    simp only [Pi.inv_apply]
    rw [hEdef η, Real.rpow_sub_one hb.ne']
    have hss := Real.mul_self_sqrt hgpos.le
    generalize Real.exp (rfpLam P v) = A
    generalize ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P v) = R
    generalize Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v) = s at hss hs ⊢
    rw [← hss]
    field_simp
  
  have ht : |2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_le]; constructor
    · rw [le_div_iff₀ hq]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (η + 1)]
    · rw [div_le_iff₀ hq]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (η - 1)]
  have hX : |deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v))| ≤ 8 * P.lam ^ 20 := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v)),
      div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
    have h1 : |deriv P.ca η| * |rfpPsi P v| ≤ P.lam ^ 20 * 8 :=
      mul_le_mul hc'b hψ (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    have h2 : 8 * P.lam ^ 20 * 1 ≤ 8 * P.lam ^ 20 * (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by positivity)
    linarith
  have hθt : |-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2))| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hθ0]
    calc rfpTh P v * |2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)| ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul hθ1 ht (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      _ = 1 := by norm_num
  have hBb : |-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)) + deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v))| ≤ 2 := by
    have := abs_add_le (-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2))) (deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v)))
    linarith
  refine ⟨hE, hDer, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hE]
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBb hE.le
    linarith
  · intro hη1 hη2
    have hηt : 0 ≤ η * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)) := by
      have e : η * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)) = 2 * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2) := by ring
      rw [e]; positivity
    have hηX : η * (deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v))) ≤ 8 * P.lam ^ 20 := by
      have h1 : |η| ≤ 1 := abs_le.2 ⟨hη1, hη2⟩
      calc η * (deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v)))
          ≤ |η * (deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v)))| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |η| * |deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v))| := abs_mul _ _
        _ ≤ 1 * (8 * P.lam ^ 20) := mul_le_mul h1 hX (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = 8 * P.lam ^ 20 := one_mul _
    have hηB : η * (-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)) + deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v))) ≤ 8 * P.lam ^ 20 := by
      have e : η * (-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)) + deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v))) =
          -(rfpTh P v * (η * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)))) + η * (deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v))) := by ring
      rw [e]
      have := mul_nonneg hθ0 hηt
      linarith
    calc η * (rfpE P v η * (-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)) + deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v))))
        = rfpE P v η * (η * (-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)) + deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v)))) := by ring
      _ ≤ rfpE P v η * (8 * P.lam ^ 20) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hηB hE.le
      _ = 8 * P.lam ^ 20 * rfpE P v η := by ring
  · intro hv
    have hs0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → sigA t = 0 := fun t ht => by unfold sigA; rw [if_pos ht]
    have hs1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → sigA t = 1 := fun t ht => by
      unfold sigA; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos ht]
    have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.lam) :=
      Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith)
    have hY5 : rfpY5 P.Md P.lam = rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
    have hθz : rfpTh P v = 0 := by
      unfold rfpTh
      rw [hs1 _ (by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith)]
      ring
    have hz1 : sigA (1 - (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3) / (3 / 20)) = 0 := by
      apply hs0
      have : (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3) / (3 / 20) = 20 / 3 * (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3) := by ring
      rw [this]; linarith
    have hz2 : sigA (1 - (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1) / (3 / 20)) = 0 := by
      apply hs0
      have : (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1) / (3 / 20) = 20 / 3 * (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1) := by ring
      rw [this]; linarith
    have hψz : rfpPsi P v = 0 := by
      simp only [rfpPsi, rfpBmp, hz1, hz2, mul_zero, sub_zero]
    have hconst : (fun e => rfpE P v e) = fun _ => Real.exp (rfpLam P v) := by
      funext e
      rw [hEdef e, hθz, hψz, Real.rpow_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, Real.sqrt_one, mul_one, mul_one]
    rw [hconst, deriv_const]

subgoal_signatures.name: rfp_I_reduction
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → ∃ (N5 : ℝ) (G δ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < N5 ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (Ioo (-(1/8)) (1/8)) ∧ G 0 = 0 ∧ (∀ c : ℝ, -(1/16) ≤ c → c ≤ 1/16 → deriv G c ≤ -(1/40)) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ δ ∧ δ 0 = 0 ∧ (∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ δ η ∧ δ η ≤ P.lam ^ 29 ∧ |deriv δ η| ≤ P.lam ^ 29) ∧ (∀ y : ℝ, |rfpPsi P y| ≤ 8) ∧ ∀ (ca : ℝ → ℝ) (η : ℝ), (∀ e : ℝ, |ca e| ≤ 1/16) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam), 2 * x * rfpF { P with ca := ca } x η) - (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam), 2 * x * rfpF { P with ca := ca } x 0) = N5 * (G (ca η) - G (ca 0) - δ η)

signature.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → RfpClos P → ∀ x η : ℝ, rfpXv P ≤ x → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → (1 - P.h - 4 * P.lam ^ 20) * (∫ v in (rfpY2 P.Md + 1)..(Real.log x), Real.exp (3 / 2 * v) * rfpE P v η) ≤ (rfpExtQ P x η + 1) * (Real.exp (3 / 2 * Real.log x) * rfpE P (Real.log x) η)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hReg hClos x η hx1 h1 h2
  have hReg' := hReg
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst0, hl0, hl1, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hReg'
  have hClos' := hClos
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, hca, -, -⟩ := hClos'
  have hxv0 : 0 < rfpXv P := by unfold rfpXv; exact Real.exp_pos _
  have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hxv0 hx1
  have h2a : (-2 : ℝ) < η := by linarith
  have h2b : η < 2 := by linarith
  
  have key1 : ∀ s D : ℝ, 0 < s → 2 * s * (D / Real.sqrt (2 * s)) = Real.sqrt (2 * s) * D := by
    intro s D hs
    have hr : Real.sqrt (2 * s) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by linarith)).ne'
    have hrr : Real.sqrt (2 * s) * Real.sqrt (2 * s) = 2 * s := Real.mul_self_sqrt (by linarith)
    have hi : Real.sqrt (2 * s) * (Real.sqrt (2 * s))⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hr
    linear_combination (-(D * (Real.sqrt (2 * s))⁻¹)) * hrr + (Real.sqrt (2 * s) * D) * hi
  have key2 : ∀ A s2 E : ℝ, A ≠ 0 → s2 ≠ 0 → s2 * s2 = 2 →
      2 * (A * A) * (E / (s2 * A)) * (A * A) = s2 * (A * A * A * E) := by
    intro A s2 E hA hs h
    have hi : (s2 * A) * (s2 * A)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero hs hA)
    linear_combination (-(A ^ 4 * E * (s2 * A)⁻¹)) * h + (s2 * A ^ 3 * E) * hi
  have hgform : ∀ s e : ℝ, 0 < s → 2 * s * rfpF P s e = Real.sqrt (2 * s) * rfpE P (Real.log s) e :=
    fun s e hs => key1 s _ hs
  have hEpos : ∀ v e : ℝ, -2 < e → e < 2 → 0 < rfpE P v e :=
    fun v e ha hb => (rfp_E_eta P hReg hClos v e ha hb).1
  have hEc : ∀ e : ℝ, -2 < e → e < 2 → Continuous (fun v => rfpE P v e) := fun e ha hb =>
    (rfp_joint_smooth P hReg hClos).1.continuousOn.comp_continuous
      (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const) (fun v => ⟨mem_univ _, ha, hb⟩)
  have hlogc : ContinuousOn Real.log (Ioi 0) :=
    Real.continuousOn_log.mono (fun s hs => by
      simp only [mem_compl_iff, mem_singleton_iff]; exact (mem_Ioi.1 hs).ne')
  have hsqc : ContinuousOn (fun s : ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * s)) (Ioi 0) :=
    (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).continuousOn
  have hsqne : ∀ s ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.sqrt (2 * s) ≠ 0 := fun s hs =>
    (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by have := mem_Ioi.1 hs; linarith)).ne'
  have hgc : ∀ e : ℝ, -2 < e → e < 2 → ContinuousOn (fun s => 2 * s * rfpF P s e) (Ioi 0) := by
    intro e ha hb
    unfold rfpF
    exact (continuousOn_const.mul continuousOn_id).mul
      (((hEc e ha hb).comp_continuousOn hlogc).div hsqc hsqne)
  
  obtain ⟨⟨-, -, -⟩, hcl2, -, -, -⟩ := rfp_clamp_identities P hReg
  have hy4 : Real.log (rfpXv P) = rfpY4 P.Md P.lam := by unfold rfpXv; exact Real.log_exp _
  have hfact : ∀ s e : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ rfpXv P →
      2 * s * rfpF P s e = (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * (2 * s * rfpF P s 0) := by
    intro s e hs0 hsx
    rcases hs0.eq_or_lt with hs | hs
    · subst hs; simp
    · have hy : Real.log s ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam := by
        have := Real.log_le_log hs hsx
        rwa [hy4] at this
      unfold rfpF rfpE
      rw [mul_assoc (Real.exp (rfpLam P (Real.log s))) _
          (Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca e * rfpPsi P (Real.log s))), hcl2 _ e hy,
        mul_assoc (Real.exp (rfpLam P (Real.log s))) _
          (Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca 0 * rfpPsi P (Real.log s))), hcl2 _ 0 hy]
      ring
  
  have hint0 : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => 2 * s * rfpF P s 0) volume 0 (rfpXv P) :=
    (((rfp_profile_regular P hReg hClos).2.2.2.2 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).2.2.2.2
      (rfpXv P) hxv0.le).2.1
  have hinte : ∀ e : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (fun s => 2 * s * rfpF P s e) volume 0 (rfpXv P) := by
    intro e
    refine (hint0.const_mul ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹)).congr ?_
    intro s hs
    rw [uIoc_of_le hxv0.le] at hs
    exact (hfact s e hs.1.le hs.2).symm
  have hintab : ∀ e a b : ℝ, -2 < e → e < 2 → 0 < a → a ≤ b →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun s => 2 * s * rfpF P s e) volume a b := by
    intro e a b ha hb ha0 hab
    refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable ((hgc e ha hb).mono ?_)
    intro s hs
    rw [uIcc_of_le hab] at hs
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le ha0 hs.1
  obtain ⟨C0, hC0def⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..rfpXv P, 2 * s * rfpF P s 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsplit : ∀ e : ℝ, -2 < e → e < 2 →
      (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..x, 2 * s * rfpF P s e) =
        (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * C0 + ∫ s in (rfpXv P)..x, 2 * s * rfpF P s e := by
    intro e ha hb
    rw [hC0def, ← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hinte e)
      (hintab e _ _ ha hb hxv0 hx1), ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s hs
    rw [uIcc_of_le hxv0.le] at hs
    exact hfact s e hs.1 hs.2
  
  obtain ⟨Dx, hDx⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, f = fun v e => rfpE P v e * (-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * e / (1 + e ^ 2)) +
      deriv P.ca e * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca e * rfpPsi P v))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hDxf : ∀ v e : ℝ, -2 < e → e < 2 → HasDerivAt (fun e => rfpE P v e) (Dx v e) e ∧
      |Dx v e| ≤ 2 * rfpE P v e ∧
      (-1 ≤ e → e ≤ 1 → e * Dx v e ≤ 8 * P.lam ^ 20 * rfpE P v e) := by
    intro v e ha hb
    obtain ⟨-, d2, d3, d4, -⟩ := rfp_E_eta P hReg hClos v e ha hb
    subst hDx
    exact ⟨d2, d3, d4⟩
  have hsig : Continuous sigA := sigA_deriv_facts.1.continuous
  have hbmp : Continuous rfpBmp := by
    show Continuous (fun t => sigA (1 + t / (3 / 20)) * sigA (1 - t / (3 / 20)))
    exact (hsig.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.div_const _))).mul
      (hsig.comp (continuous_const.sub (continuous_id.div_const _)))
  have hTh : Continuous (fun v => rfpTh P v) := by
    show Continuous (fun v => 1 - sigA ((v - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60))
    exact continuous_const.sub (hsig.comp ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).div_const _))
  have hPsi : Continuous (fun v => rfpPsi P v) := by

subgoal_signatures.name: rfp_E_eta
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → RfpClos P → ∀ v η : ℝ, -2 < η → η < 2 → 0 < rfpE P v η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun e => rfpE P v e) (rfpE P v η * (-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)) + deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v)))) η ∧ |rfpE P v η * (-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)) + deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v)))| ≤ 2 * rfpE P v η ∧ (-1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → η * (rfpE P v η * (-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)) + deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v)))) ≤ 8 * P.lam ^ 20 * rfpE P v η) ∧ (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ≤ v → deriv (fun e => rfpE P v e) η = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: rfp_clamp_identities
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → (1 ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ∧ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ∧ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ≤ rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam → ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y) * Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y) = (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ≤ y → ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y) * Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y) = 1) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, y ≤ 1 → η * rfpK P.Md y + rfpE P y η * rfpRb P y η = 4 * η) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ≤ y → η * rfpK P.Md y + rfpE P y η * rfpRb P y η = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: rfp_joint_smooth

subgoal_signatures.name: rfp_profile_regular
