subgoal_signatures.name: rfp_E_eta
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → RfpClos P → ∀ v η : ℝ, -2 < η → η < 2 → 0 < rfpE P v η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun e => rfpE P v e) (rfpE P v η * (-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)) + deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v)))) η ∧ |rfpE P v η * (-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)) + deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v)))| ≤ 2 * rfpE P v η ∧ (-1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → η * (rfpE P v η * (-(rfpTh P v) * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)) + deriv P.ca η * rfpPsi P v / (2 * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P v)))) ≤ 8 * P.lam ^ 20 * rfpE P v η) ∧ (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ≤ v → deriv (fun e => rfpE P v e) η = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: rfp_clamp_identities
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → (1 ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ∧ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ∧ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ≤ rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam → ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y) * Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y) = (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ≤ y → ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y) * Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y) = 1) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, y ≤ 1 → η * rfpK P.Md y + rfpE P y η * rfpRb P y η = 4 * η) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ≤ y → η * rfpK P.Md y + rfpE P y η * rfpRb P y η = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: rfp_joint_smooth
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → RfpClos P → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => rfpE P p.1 p.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ((1 + p.2 ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P p.1) * Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca p.2 * rfpPsi P p.1)) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.2 * rfpK P.Md p.1 + rfpE P p.1 p.2 * rfpRb P p.1 p.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: sigA_deriv_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement: Differentiable ℝ sigA ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ deriv sigA t ∧ deriv sigA t ≤ 200) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, (t ≤ 0 ∨ 1 ≤ t) → deriv sigA t = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: rfp_lam_tail_envelope
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → (∀ y : ℝ, rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh ≤ y → rfpLam P y = rfpLam P (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh - 3) + (1 / 2 + P.h) * (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh - 3) - Real.log (1 - P.ρ) - (1 / 2 + P.h) * y) ∧ ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ y : ℝ, rfpLam P y ≤ B + y / 10 - (3 / 5 + P.h) * max y 0

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (E : ℝ → ℝ) (lam h y y5 z y6 : ℝ), 0 < lam → lam ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < h → h ≤ lam ^ 2 → y5 ≤ z → z + 1 = y6 → y ≤ y6 → Continuous E → (∀ v : ℝ, 0 < E v) → (∀ v : ℝ, y ≤ v → v ≤ y6 → DifferentiableAt ℝ E v ∧ deriv E v ≤ -(1 / 2 + h) * E v ∧ (v ≤ z → deriv E v ≤ -(1 / 2 + lam / 2) * E v)) → (∀ v : ℝ, y6 ≤ v → E v ≤ 2 * E y6 * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + h) * (v - y6))) → (∫ v in Ioi y, Real.exp (v - y) * E v ^ 2) ≤ (1 / lam + 1 + 2 / h) * E y ^ 2 ∧ (∫ v in Ioc y y5, Real.exp (v - y) * E v ^ 2) ≤ E y ^ 2 / lam ∧ (∫ v in Ioi y, E v ^ 2) ≤ 5 * E y ^ 2

signature.name: extA_integral_bounds
signature.statement: ∀ (E : ℝ → ℝ) (lam h y y5 z y6 : ℝ), 0 < lam → lam ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < h → h ≤ lam ^ 2 → y5 ≤ z → z + 1 = y6 → y ≤ y6 → Continuous E → (∀ v : ℝ, 0 < E v) → (∀ v : ℝ, y ≤ v → v ≤ y6 → DifferentiableAt ℝ E v ∧ deriv E v ≤ -(1 / 2 + h) * E v ∧ (v ≤ z → deriv E v ≤ -(1 / 2 + lam / 2) * E v)) → (∀ v : ℝ, y6 ≤ v → E v ≤ 2 * E y6 * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + h) * (v - y6))) → (∫ v in Ioi y, Real.exp (v - y) * E v ^ 2) ≤ (1 / lam + 1 + 2 / h) * E y ^ 2 ∧ (∫ v in Ioc y y5, Real.exp (v - y) * E v ^ 2) ≤ E y ^ 2 / lam ∧ (∫ v in Ioi y, E v ^ 2) ≤ 5 * E y ^ 2

      apply Continuous.continuousOn

    have hanti : AntitoneOn (fun t => E t * Real.exp (a * (t - y))) (Set.Icc y b) := by
      apply antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos (convex_Icc y b) hcont
      · intro t ht
        rw [interior_Icc] at ht
        exact (hgd t (hd t ht.1.le ht.2.le).1).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      · intro t ht
        rw [interior_Icc] at ht
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hd t ht.1.le ht.2.le
        rw [(hgd t h1).deriv]
        have he := Real.exp_pos (a * (t - y))
        nlinarith
    have hm := hanti ⟨le_rfl, hyv.trans hvb⟩ ⟨hyv, hvb⟩ hyv
    simp only [sub_self, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one] at hm
    have hprod : Real.exp (a * (v - y)) * Real.exp (-a * (v - y)) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_zero]; congr 1; ring
    have hpos := Real.exp_pos (-a * (v - y))
    calc E v = E v * Real.exp (a * (v - y)) * Real.exp (-a * (v - y)) := by
          rw [mul_assoc, hprod, mul_one]
      _ ≤ E y * Real.exp (-a * (v - y)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm hpos.le
  
  have expI : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun v => Real.exp (-c * (v - y))) (Set.Ioi y) ∧
      (∫ v in Set.Ioi y, Real.exp (-c * (v - y))) = 1 / c := by
    intro c hc
    have hfun : (fun v => Real.exp (-c * (v - y))) = fun v => Real.exp (c * y) * Real.exp (-c * v) := by
      funext v; rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    rw [hfun]
    refine ⟨MeasureTheory.Integrable.const_mul (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi y hc) _, ?_⟩
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, integral_exp_mul_Ioi (by linarith : -c < 0) y]
    have e1 : Real.exp (c * y) * Real.exp (-c * y) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_zero]; congr 1; ring
    rw [neg_div_neg_eq, ← mul_div_assoc, e1]
  
  have major : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (s : Set ℝ) (c M : ℝ), 0 < c → 0 ≤ M → MeasurableSet s → s ⊆ Set.Ioi y →
      (∀ v ∈ s, 0 ≤ f v ∧ f v ≤ M * Real.exp (-c * (v - y))) → (∫ v in s, f v) ≤ M / c := by
    intro f s c M hc hM hs hsub hf
    obtain ⟨hint, hval⟩ := expI c hc
    have hgint : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun v => M * Real.exp (-c * (v - y))) (Set.Ioi y) :=
      MeasureTheory.Integrable.const_mul hint M
    have h1 : (∫ v in s, f v) ≤ ∫ v in s, M * Real.exp (-c * (v - y)) := by
      apply MeasureTheory.integral_mono_of_nonneg
      · exact MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hs (fun v hv => (hf v hv).1)
      · exact hgint.mono_set hsub
      · exact MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hs (fun v hv => (hf v hv).2)
    have h2 : (∫ v in s, M * Real.exp (-c * (v - y))) ≤
        ∫ v in Set.Ioi y, M * Real.exp (-c * (v - y)) := by
      apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_set hgint
      · exact MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi
          (fun v _ => mul_nonneg hM (Real.exp_pos _).le)
      · exact HasSubset.Subset.eventuallyLE hsub
    have h3 : (∫ v in Set.Ioi y, M * Real.exp (-c * (v - y))) = M / c := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, hval]; ring
    linarith
  
  have hKpos : 0 < E y := hEpos y
  have env : ∀ v, y ≤ v → E v ^ 2 ≤ 4 * E y ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(1 + 2 * h) * (v - y)) := by
    intro v hv
    have hg0 := gron (1 / 2 + h) y6 (fun t h1 h2 => ⟨(hslope t h1 h2).1, (hslope t h1 h2).2.1⟩)
    have hbound : E v ≤ 2 * E y * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + h) * (v - y)) := by
      rcases le_total v y6 with hv6 | hv6
      · have h1 := hg0 v hv hv6
        have hp : 0 < E y * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + h) * (v - y)) := mul_pos hKpos (Real.exp_pos _)
        linarith
      · have h1 := htail v hv6
        have h2 := hg0 y6 hyy6 le_rfl
        have hp := Real.exp_pos (-(1 / 2 + h) * (v - y6))
        calc E v ≤ 2 * E y6 * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + h) * (v - y6)) := h1
          _ ≤ 2 * (E y * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + h) * (y6 - y))) * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + h) * (v - y6)) := by
            gcongr
          _ = 2 * E y * (Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + h) * (y6 - y)) * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + h) * (v - y6))) := by
            ring
          _ = 2 * E y * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + h) * (v - y)) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 2; ring
    have hEv := hEpos v
    have hsq : Real.exp (-(1 + 2 * h) * (v - y)) =
        Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + h) * (v - y)) * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + h) * (v - y)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    calc E v ^ 2 ≤ (2 * E y * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + h) * (v - y))) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ hEv.le hbound 2
      _ = 4 * E y ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(1 + 2 * h) * (v - y)) := by rw [hsq]; ring
  
  have B3 : (∫ v in Ioi y, E v ^ 2) ≤ 5 * E y ^ 2 := by
    have hI := major (fun v => E v ^ 2) (Set.Ioi y) (1 + 2 * h) (4 * E y ^ 2) (by linarith)
      (by positivity) measurableSet_Ioi subset_rfl (fun v hv => ⟨sq_nonneg _, env v (le_of_lt hv)⟩)
    have h4 : 4 * E y ^ 2 / (1 + 2 * h) ≤ 4 * E y ^ 2 := div_le_self (by positivity) (by linarith)
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (E y)]
  
  have B1 : (∫ v in Ioi y, Real.exp (v - y) * E v ^ 2) ≤ (1 / lam + 1 + 2 / h) * E y ^ 2 := by
    have hI := major (fun v => Real.exp (v - y) * E v ^ 2) (Set.Ioi y) (2 * h) (4 * E y ^ 2)
      (by linarith) (by positivity) measurableSet_Ioi subset_rfl (fun v hv => by
        refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
        have h1 := env v (le_of_lt hv)
        calc Real.exp (v - y) * E v ^ 2
            ≤ Real.exp (v - y) * (4 * E y ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(1 + 2 * h) * (v - y))) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (Real.exp_pos _).le
          _ = 4 * E y ^ 2 * (Real.exp (v - y) * Real.exp (-(1 + 2 * h) * (v - y))) := by ring
          _ = 4 * E y ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(2 * h) * (v - y)) := by
              rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 2; ring)
    have e : 4 * E y ^ 2 / (2 * h) = 2 / h * E y ^ 2 := by field_simp; ring
    have hl : 0 < 1 / lam := by positivity
    have h5 : 2 / h * E y ^ 2 ≤ (1 / lam + 1 + 2 / h) * E y ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _)
    linarith
  
  have B2 : (∫ v in Ioc y y5, Real.exp (v - y) * E v ^ 2) ≤ E y ^ 2 / lam := by
    have hg1 := gron (1 / 2 + lam / 2) z (fun t h1 h2 =>
      ⟨(hslope t h1 (by linarith)).1, (hslope t h1 (by linarith)).2.2 h2⟩)
    exact major (fun v => Real.exp (v - y) * E v ^ 2) (Set.Ioc y y5) lam (E y ^ 2) hlam
      (sq_nonneg _) measurableSet_Ioc Set.Ioc_subset_Ioi_self (fun v hv => by
        refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
        have h1 := hg1 v hv.1.le (hv.2.trans hy5z)
        have h2 : E v ^ 2 ≤ (E y * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + lam / 2) * (v - y))) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (hEpos v).le h1 2
        calc Real.exp (v - y) * E v ^ 2
            ≤ Real.exp (v - y) * (E y * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + lam / 2) * (v - y))) ^ 2 :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (Real.exp_pos _).le
          _ = E y ^ 2 * (Real.exp (v - y) * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + lam / 2) * (v - y)) *
                Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + lam / 2) * (v - y))) := by ring
          _ = E y ^ 2 * Real.exp (-lam * (v - y)) := by
              rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 2; ring)
  exact ⟨B1, B2, B3⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → ∀ v : ℝ, rfpY6 P ≤ v → rfpLam P v ≤ rfpLam P (rfpY6 P) + Real.log 2 - (1 / 2 + P.h) * (v - rfpY6 P)

signature.name: rfp_extA_tail_env
signature.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → ∀ v : ℝ, rfpY6 P ≤ v → rfpLam P v ≤ rfpLam P (rfpY6 P) + Real.log 2 - (1 / 2 + P.h) * (v - rfpY6 P)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hReg v hv
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl1, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hReg
  
  have hsig0 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → sigA y = 0 := fun y hy => by
    unfold sigA; rw [if_pos hy]
  have hsig1 : ∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → sigA y = 1 := fun y hy => by
    unfold sigA; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hy]
  have hsigb : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA y ∧ sigA y ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
    · have ha := Real.exp_pos (-1 / y ^ 2)
      have hb := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)
      constructor
      · positivity
      · rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]; linarith
  have hmeas : Measurable sigA := by
    unfold sigA
    refine Measurable.ite (measurableSet_le measurable_id measurable_const) measurable_const
      (Measurable.ite (measurableSet_le measurable_const measurable_id) measurable_const ?_)
    fun_prop
  have hII : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable sigA MeasureTheory.volume a b := by
    intro a b
    refine (intervalIntegrable_const (c := (1:ℝ))).mono_fun hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_)
    obtain ⟨s0, s1⟩ := hsigb y
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_one]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg s0]; exact s1
  have hSigI : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → rfpSigI t = t - 1 + rfpSigI 1 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpSigI
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hII 0 1) (hII 1 t)]
    have hc : ∫ s in (1:ℝ)..t, sigA s = ∫ s in (1:ℝ)..t, (1:ℝ) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le ht] at hs
      exact hsig1 s hs.1
    rw [hc, intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    ring
  
  have hh1 : P.h ≤ 1 / 10000 := by nlinarith
  have hlogh : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.h) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hh0]; linarith)
  have hT0 : 0 ≤ P.T1 := by linarith
  have hlogl : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.lam) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith)
  have h13 : 0 < 13 / P.lam := by positivity
  have hem := Real.exp_pos P.Md
  have hρ2 : P.ρ ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have hρ1 : 0 < 1 - P.ρ := by linarith
  have e2 : rfpY2 P.Md = Real.exp P.Md + 11 := rfl
  have e4 : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam = Real.exp P.Md + 11 + 1 + 60 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) + 13 / P.lam := by
    unfold rfpY4 rfpY3 rfpY2; ring
  have e5 : rfpY5 P.Md P.lam = Real.exp P.Md + 11 + 1 + 60 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) + 13 / P.lam
      + 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := by
    unfold rfpY5 rfpY4 rfpY3 rfpY2; ring
  have e6 : rfpY6 P = rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 2 + P.T1 := rfl
  have eYb : rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh = rfpY6 P + 3 + P.Lh := by
    unfold rfpYb rfpY6; ring
  
  have key : ∀ w, rfpY6 P ≤ w → rfpLam P w = Real.log P.Pst + w / 10 - 3 / 5 * (w - 1 + rfpSigI 1)
      - P.lam * (w - rfpY2 P.Md - 1 + rfpSigI 1)
      - (1 - P.lam) * (w - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 + rfpSigI 1)
      + (1 - P.h) * (w - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1 - 1 + rfpSigI 1) - Real.log 2
      + Real.log (tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp w) / (1 - P.ρ)) := by
    intro w hw
    have hA : 1 ≤ (w - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60 := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
    unfold rfpLam
    rw [hSigI w (by linarith), hSigI (w - rfpY2 P.Md) (by linarith),
      hSigI (w - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (by linarith),
      hSigI (w - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) (by linarith), hsig1 _ hA]
    ring
  have hlogq : ∀ w, Real.log (Real.exp w / Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) =
      w - rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh := by
    intro w; rw [← Real.exp_sub, Real.log_exp]
  have hL6 : Real.log (tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp (rfpY6 P))
      / (1 - P.ρ)) = 0 := by
    unfold tailFac
    rw [hlogq, hsig0 _ (by rw [eYb]; linarith)]
    rw [show 1 - P.ρ * (1 - 0) = 1 - P.ρ by ring, div_self hρ1.ne', Real.log_one]
  have hLv : Real.log (tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp v)
      / (1 - P.ρ)) ≤ Real.log 2 := by
    unfold tailFac
    rw [hlogq]
    obtain ⟨s0, s1⟩ := hsigb ((v - rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh + 2) / 2)
    generalize sigA ((v - rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh + 2) / 2) = s at s0 s1 ⊢
    have hq1 : 1 ≤ (1 - P.ρ * (1 - s)) / (1 - P.ρ) := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hρ1]; nlinarith
    have hq2 : (1 - P.ρ * (1 - s)) / (1 - P.ρ) ≤ 2 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hρ1]; nlinarith
    exact Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hq2
  rw [key v hv, key (rfpY6 P) le_rfl]
  have hdiff : (Real.log P.Pst + v / 10 - 3 / 5 * (v - 1 + rfpSigI 1)
      - P.lam * (v - rfpY2 P.Md - 1 + rfpSigI 1)
      - (1 - P.lam) * (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 + rfpSigI 1)
      + (1 - P.h) * (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1 - 1 + rfpSigI 1) - Real.log 2)
      - (Real.log P.Pst + rfpY6 P / 10 - 3 / 5 * (rfpY6 P - 1 + rfpSigI 1)
      - P.lam * (rfpY6 P - rfpY2 P.Md - 1 + rfpSigI 1)
      - (1 - P.lam) * (rfpY6 P - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 + rfpSigI 1)
      + (1 - P.h) * (rfpY6 P - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1 - 1 + rfpSigI 1) - Real.log 2)
      = -(1 / 2 + P.h) * (v - rfpY6 P) := by ring
  linarith

signature.name: rfp_extA_E4
signature.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → ∀ η : ℝ, rfpE P (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) η ≤ P.Pst * Real.exp (-(13 / 2) / P.lam)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hReg η
  have hsa0 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → sigA y = 0 := fun y hy => by unfold sigA; rw [if_pos hy]
  have hsa1 : ∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → sigA y = 1 := fun y hy => by
    unfold sigA; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hy]
  have hsann : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA y := fun y => by unfold sigA; split_ifs <;> positivity
  have hsle : ∀ y : ℝ, sigA y ≤ 1 := fun y => by
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
    · rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
      linarith [Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)]
  have hmeas : Measurable sigA := by
    unfold sigA
    refine Measurable.ite measurableSet_Iic measurable_const
      (Measurable.ite measurableSet_Ici measurable_const ?_)
    fun_prop
  have hII : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable sigA MeasureTheory.volume a b := by
    intro a b
    have hc : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => (1:ℝ)) MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
      intervalIntegrable_const
    refine hc.mono_fun hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    show ‖sigA x‖ ≤ |(1:ℝ)|
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hsann x), abs_one]
    exact hsle x
  have hSI0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → rfpSigI t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpSigI
    have hEq : Set.EqOn sigA (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) (Set.uIcc 0 t) := by
      intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge ht] at hs
      exact hsa0 s hs.2
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr hEq]
    simp
  have hSI1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → t - 1 ≤ rfpSigI t := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpSigI
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (b := 1) (hII 0 1) (hII 1 t)]
    have hEq : Set.EqOn sigA (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) (Set.uIcc 1 t) := by
      intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le ht] at hs
      exact hsa1 s hs.1
    have h1 : ∫ s in (1:ℝ)..t, sigA s = t - 1 := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr hEq]
      simp
    have h0 : 0 ≤ ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, sigA s :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num) (fun s _ => hsann s)
    linarith
  have hBmp0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ -1 → rfpBmp t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpBmp
    rw [hsa0 (1 + t / (3 / 20)) (by rw [show t / (3 / 20 : ℝ) = 20 / 3 * t by ring]; linarith),
      zero_mul]
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl1, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hReg
  have hPpos : 0 < P.Pst := lt_trans (Real.exp_pos _) hPst
  
  have hL : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.lam) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith)
  have hh1 : P.h ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hLh' : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.h) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hh0]; linarith)
  have hT0 : 0 ≤ P.T1 := by linarith
  have h13 : 0 < 13 / P.lam := div_pos (by norm_num) hl0
  have hρ1 : P.ρ < 1 := by linarith
  have eY4 : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam = Real.exp P.Md + 12 + 60 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) + 13 / P.lam := by
    unfold rfpY4 rfpY3 rfpY2; ring
  have e42 : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam - rfpY2 P.Md = 1 + 60 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) + 13 / P.lam := by
    unfold rfpY4 rfpY3; ring
  have e45 : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam = -(60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam)) := by
    unfold rfpY5; ring
  have e4b : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam - rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh =
      -(65 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) + P.T1 + P.Lh) := by
    unfold rfpYb rfpY5; ring
  have hY1 : 1 ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam := by rw [eY4]; linarith [Real.exp_pos P.Md]
  
  have hTh : rfpTh P (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) = 1 := by
    unfold rfpTh; rw [sub_self, zero_div, hsa0 0 le_rfl, sub_zero]
  have hPsi : rfpPsi P (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) = 0 := by
    unfold rfpPsi
    rw [hBmp0 (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3) (by linarith),
      hBmp0 (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1) (by linarith), mul_zero, sub_zero]
  have hE1 : rfpE P (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) η ≤ Real.exp (rfpLam P (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)) := by
    unfold rfpE
    rw [hTh, hPsi, mul_zero, add_zero, Real.sqrt_one, mul_one, Real.rpow_one]
    have h1 : (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg η])
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (Real.exp_pos _).le h1
  
  have T1' := hSI1 (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) hY1
  have T2' := hSI1 (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam - rfpY2 P.Md) (by rw [e42]; linarith)
  have T3' : rfpSigI (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) = 0 := hSI0 _ (by rw [e45]; linarith)
  have T4' : rfpSigI (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) = 0 :=
    hSI0 _ (by rw [e45]; linarith)
  have T5' : sigA ((rfpY4 P.Md P.lam - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) = 0 := hsa0 _ (by simp)

    _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log P.Pst + (-(13 / 2) / P.lam)) := Real.exp_le_exp.2 hL2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro E lam a y5 z y6 y hl0 hl1 hay5 hy5z hzy6 hay hyy6 hEc hEpos hslope
  
  have anti : ∀ k p q : ℝ, (∀ v : ℝ, p ≤ v → v ≤ q → DifferentiableAt ℝ E v ∧ deriv E v ≤ -k * E v) →
      ∀ v w : ℝ, p ≤ v → v ≤ w → w ≤ q → Real.exp (k * w) * E w ≤ Real.exp (k * v) * E v := by
    intro k p q hd v w hpv hvw hwq
    have hder : ∀ t, p ≤ t → t ≤ q → HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.exp (k * s) * E s)
        (Real.exp (k * t) * (k * 1) * E t + Real.exp (k * t) * deriv E t) t := by
      intro t h1 h2
      exact (((hasDerivAt_id' t).const_mul k).exp).mul ((hd t h1 h2).1.hasDerivAt)
    have hanti : AntitoneOn (fun s => Real.exp (k * s) * E s) (Set.Icc p q) := by
      apply antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos (convex_Icc p q)
      · intro t ht
        exact (hder t ht.1 ht.2).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      · intro t ht
        rw [interior_Icc] at ht
        exact (hder t ht.1.le ht.2.le).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      · intro t ht
        rw [interior_Icc] at ht
        rw [(hder t ht.1.le ht.2.le).deriv]
        have h := (hd t ht.1.le ht.2.le).2
        have he := Real.exp_pos (k * t)
        nlinarith
    exact hanti ⟨hpv, hvw.trans hwq⟩ ⟨hpv.trans hvw, hwq⟩ hvw

  have hΦc : Continuous (fun v => Real.exp (3 / 2 * v) * E v) :=
    (Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).mul hEc
  have hii : ∀ c d : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (fun v => Real.exp (3 / 2 * v) * E v)
      MeasureTheory.volume c d := fun c d => hΦc.intervalIntegrable c d
  have hl13 : 0 < 13 / lam := by positivity
  rcases le_or_gt y z with hyz | hzy
  · 
    have hμ0 : 0 < 1 - lam / 2 := by linarith
    have hμne : (1 - lam / 2) ≠ 0 := hμ0.ne'
    have hay' : a ≤ y := by linarith
    have hpt : ∀ v, a ≤ v → v ≤ y → Real.exp ((1 - lam / 2) * (v - y)) * (Real.exp (3 / 2 * y) * E y)
        ≤ Real.exp (3 / 2 * v) * E v := by
      intro v hv1 hv2
      have h := anti (1 / 2 + lam / 2) a y (fun w hw1 hw2 =>
        ⟨(hslope w hw1 (hw2.trans hyy6)).1, (hslope w hw1 (hw2.trans hyy6)).2.2.1 (hw2.trans hyz)⟩)
        v y hv1 hv2 le_rfl
      have e1 : Real.exp ((1 - lam / 2) * (v - y)) * (Real.exp (3 / 2 * y) * E y) =
          Real.exp (3 / 2 * v - (1 / 2 + lam / 2) * v) * (Real.exp ((1 / 2 + lam / 2) * y) * E y) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add,
          show (1 - lam / 2) * (v - y) + 3 / 2 * y =
            3 / 2 * v - (1 / 2 + lam / 2) * v + (1 / 2 + lam / 2) * y by ring]
      have e2 : Real.exp (3 / 2 * v) * E v =
          Real.exp (3 / 2 * v - (1 / 2 + lam / 2) * v) * (Real.exp ((1 / 2 + lam / 2) * v) * E v) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add,
          show 3 / 2 * v - (1 / 2 + lam / 2) * v + (1 / 2 + lam / 2) * v = 3 / 2 * v by ring]
      rw [e1, e2]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (Real.exp_pos _).le
    have hint : (∫ v in a..y, Real.exp ((1 - lam / 2) * (v - y)) * (Real.exp (3 / 2 * y) * E y)) =
        (Real.exp (3 / 2 * y) * E y) * ((1 - Real.exp ((1 - lam / 2) * (a - y))) / (1 - lam / 2)) := by
      have hF : ∀ v ∈ Set.uIcc a y, HasDerivAt
          (fun v => Real.exp ((1 - lam / 2) * (v - y)) / (1 - lam / 2) * (Real.exp (3 / 2 * y) * E y))
          (Real.exp ((1 - lam / 2) * (v - y)) * (Real.exp (3 / 2 * y) * E y)) v := by
        intro v _
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun v => (1 - lam / 2) * (v - y)) ((1 - lam / 2) * 1) v :=
          ((hasDerivAt_id' v).sub_const y).const_mul _
        have h2 := (h1.exp.div_const (1 - lam / 2)).mul_const (Real.exp (3 / 2 * y) * E y)
        convert h2 using 1
        rw [mul_one, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hμne]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hF
        ((Continuous.intervalIntegrable (by fun_prop) _ _))]
      simp only [sub_self, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero]
      field_simp
    have htail : Real.exp ((1 - lam / 2) * (a - y)) ≤ lam / 12 := by
      have hya : 13 / lam ≤ y - a := by linarith
      have hlt : lam * (1 / lam) = 1 := by field_simp
      have ht : 100 ≤ 1 / lam := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith
      have e13 : 13 / lam = 13 * (1 / lam) := by ring
      have hprod : (1 - lam / 2) * (13 * (1 / lam)) ≤ (1 - lam / 2) * (y - a) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hμ0.le
      have h12 : (1 - lam / 2) * (a - y) ≤ -(12 * (1 / lam)) := by nlinarith
      have hX : Real.exp (-(12 * (1 / lam))) * (12 * (1 / lam) + 1) ≤ 1 := by
        have h := Real.add_one_le_exp (12 * (1 / lam))
        have hm : Real.exp (-(12 * (1 / lam))) * Real.exp (12 * (1 / lam)) = 1 := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
        have hp := Real.exp_pos (-(12 * (1 / lam)))
        nlinarith
      have hXl := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hX hl0.le
      have hXe : Real.exp (-(12 * (1 / lam))) * (lam * (1 / lam)) = Real.exp (-(12 * (1 / lam))) := by
        rw [hlt, mul_one]
      have hp := Real.exp_pos (-(12 * (1 / lam)))
      have hmono : Real.exp ((1 - lam / 2) * (a - y)) ≤ Real.exp (-(12 * (1 / lam))) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.2 h12
      nlinarith
    have hfac : 1 + lam / 4 ≤ (1 - Real.exp ((1 - lam / 2) * (a - y))) / (1 - lam / 2) := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hμ0]; nlinarith
    have hmono := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hay'
      (Continuous.intervalIntegrable (by fun_prop) a y) (hii a y)
      (fun v hv => hpt v hv.1 hv.2)
    calc (1 + lam / 4) * (Real.exp (3 / 2 * y) * E y)
        ≤ (Real.exp (3 / 2 * y) * E y) * ((1 - Real.exp ((1 - lam / 2) * (a - y))) / (1 - lam / 2)) := by
          rw [mul_comm]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfac (hΦpos y).le
      _ = ∫ v in a..y, Real.exp ((1 - lam / 2) * (v - y)) * (Real.exp (3 / 2 * y) * E y) := hint.symm
      _ ≤ ∫ v in a..y, Real.exp (3 / 2 * v) * E v := hmono
  · 
    have hwin : ∀ v, y5 + 1 ≤ v → v ≤ z →
        Real.exp (3 / 2 * z) * E z ≤ Real.exp (3 / 2 * v) * E v := by
      intro v hv1 hv2
      exact anti (3 / 2) (y5 + 1) z (fun w hw1 hw2 =>
        ⟨(hslope w (by linarith) (by linarith)).1,
          (hslope w (by linarith) (by linarith)).2.2.2 hw1 hw2⟩) v z hv1 hv2 le_rfl
    have hgrow : Real.exp (1 / 2 * y) * E y ≤ Real.exp (1 / 2 * z) * E z :=
      anti (1 / 2) z y (fun w hw1 hw2 =>
        ⟨(hslope w (by linarith) (by linarith)).1,
          (hslope w (by linarith) (by linarith)).2.1⟩) z y le_rfl hzy.le le_rfl
    have hexp1 : Real.exp (y - z) ≤ 3 := by
      have h1 : Real.exp 1 < 3 := lt_trans Real.exp_one_lt_d9 (by norm_num)
      have h2 : Real.exp (y - z) ≤ Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by linarith)
      linarith
    have hΦy : Real.exp (3 / 2 * y) * E y ≤ 3 * (Real.exp (3 / 2 * z) * E z) := by
      have e1 : Real.exp (3 / 2 * y) * E y = Real.exp y * (Real.exp (1 / 2 * y) * E y) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add, show y + 1 / 2 * y = 3 / 2 * y by ring]
      have e2 : Real.exp y * (Real.exp (1 / 2 * z) * E z) =
          Real.exp (y - z) * (Real.exp (3 / 2 * z) * E z) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add,
          show y + 1 / 2 * z = y - z + 3 / 2 * z by ring]
      calc Real.exp (3 / 2 * y) * E y = Real.exp y * (Real.exp (1 / 2 * y) * E y) := e1
        _ ≤ Real.exp y * (Real.exp (1 / 2 * z) * E z) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgrow (Real.exp_pos _).le
        _ = Real.exp (y - z) * (Real.exp (3 / 2 * z) * E z) := e2
        _ ≤ 3 * (Real.exp (3 / 2 * z) * E z) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hexp1 (hΦpos z).le
    have hsplit : (∫ v in a..y, Real.exp (3 / 2 * v) * E v) =
        (∫ v in a..(y5 + 1), Real.exp (3 / 2 * v) * E v) +
        (∫ v in (y5 + 1)..z, Real.exp (3 / 2 * v) * E v) +
        ∫ v in z..y, Real.exp (3 / 2 * v) * E v := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hii _ _) (hii _ _),
        intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hii _ _) (hii _ _)]
    have h1 : 0 ≤ ∫ v in a..(y5 + 1), Real.exp (3 / 2 * v) * E v :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hay5 (fun v _ => (hΦpos v).le)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hP η
  have hR := hP
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl100, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hR
  have hPst0 : 0 < P.Pst := lt_trans (Real.exp_pos _) hPst

  obtain ⟨hcm, -, -, hcneg, C, κ, hκ, hCb⟩ := rfp_shape_data P hP
  
  have hsig : ∀ t, 0 ≤ sigA t ∧ sigA t ≤ 1 := by
    intro t
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · exact ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
    · exact ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
    · have ha := Real.exp_pos (-1 / t ^ 2)
      have hc := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2)
      refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
      linarith
  have hs0 : ∀ t, t ≤ 0 → sigA t = 0 := by
    intro t ht; unfold sigA; rw [if_pos ht]
  have hs1 : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → sigA t = 1 := by
    intro t ht; unfold sigA; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos ht]
  have hsigm : Measurable sigA := by
    have e : sigA = fun y => if y ≤ 0 then 0 else if 1 ≤ y then 1 else
        Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) / (Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)) := by
      funext y; rfl
    rw [e]
    refine Measurable.ite measurableSet_Iic measurable_const
      (Measurable.ite measurableSet_Ici measurable_const ?_)
    fun_prop
  
  have hb : ∀ t, |rfpBmp t| ≤ 1 := by
    intro t

    obtain ⟨a0, a1⟩ := hsig (1 + t / (3 / 20))
    obtain ⟨b0, b1⟩ := hsig (1 - t / (3 / 20))

    have e : rfpBmp = fun t => sigA (1 + t / (3 / 20)) * sigA (1 - t / (3 / 20)) := by

    intro t ht

    · obtain ⟨a0, a1⟩ := hsig (Real.log y / P.Md)

    ring
  
  have hII : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (fun v => sigA (50 * v)) volume a b := by

    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v => ?_)

  have hR0m : Measurable rfpR0 := by
    have e : rfpR0 = fun ξ => (∫ v in (0:ℝ)..ξ, sigA (50 * v)) * (1 - sigA (ξ - 10)) := by

  have hRa : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ξ ≤ 0 → rfpR0 ξ = 0 := by
    intro ξ hn
    unfold rfpR0
    have hz : (∫ v in (0:ℝ)..ξ, sigA (50 * v)) = ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..ξ, (0:ℝ) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro v hv

    rw [hz, intervalIntegral.integral_zero, zero_mul]
  have hRb : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 11 ≤ ξ → rfpR0 ξ = 0 := by
    intro ξ hξ
    unfold rfpR0
    rw [hs1 _ (by linarith)]
    ring
  have hR0b : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ξ ≤ 13 → |rfpR0 ξ| ≤ 13 := by
    intro ξ hξ

    · unfold rfpR0
      obtain ⟨s0, s1⟩ := hsig (ξ - 10)
      have h1 : |1 - sigA (ξ - 10)| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
      have hI := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := 0) (b := ξ) (C := 1)
        (f := fun v => sigA (50 * v)) (fun v _ => by
          show ‖sigA (50 * v)‖ ≤ 1
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hsig _).1]
          exact (hsig _).2)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hI
      have hξ' : |ξ - 0| ≤ 13 := by rw [sub_zero, abs_of_pos hp]; exact hξ
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |∫ v in (0:ℝ)..ξ, sigA (50 * v)| * |1 - sigA (ξ - 10)| ≤ 13 * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul (by linarith) h1 (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        _ = 13 := by norm_num
  
  have hL : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.lam) := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith)
  have hy3 : Real.exp P.Md + 12 ≤ rfpY3 P.Md P.lam := by unfold rfpY3 rfpY2; linarith
  have h13 : 0 < 13 / P.lam := by positivity
  have hy4 : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam = rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 13 / P.lam := rfl
  have hξ11 : ∀ y, rfpY4 P.Md P.lam - 63 / 20 ≤ y → 11 ≤ P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : 13 / P.lam - 63 / 20 ≤ y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam := by rw [hy4] at hy; linarith
    have h2 : P.lam * (13 / P.lam) = 13 := by field_simp
    have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hl0.le
    have h4 : P.lam * (13 / P.lam - 63 / 20) = P.lam * (13 / P.lam) - 63 / 20 * P.lam := by ring
    linarith
  
  have hsupp : ∀ y : ℝ, rfpK P.Md y * rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) = 0 ∧
      rfpK P.Md y * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) = 0 ∧
      rfpK P.Md y * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) = 0 ∧
      rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) = 0 ∧
      rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) = 0 ∧
      rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) = 0 := by
    intro y
    rcases lt_or_ge y (Real.exp P.Md) with hy | hy
    · have hr : rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) = 0 :=
        hRa _ (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hl0.le (by linarith))
      have hb1 : rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) = 0 := hBn _ (by rw [hy4]; linarith)
      have hb2 : rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) = 0 := hBn _ (by rw [hy4]; linarith)
      rw [hr, hb1, hb2]
      simp
    · rw [hK0 y hy]
      rcases le_or_gt (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) (-(3 / 20)) with hb' | hb'
      · rw [hBn _ hb']
        rcases le_or_gt (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) (-(3 / 20)) with hc | hc
        · rw [hBn _ hc]
          simp
        · rw [hRb _ (hξ11 y (by linarith))]
          simp
      · rw [hRb _ (hξ11 y (by linarith)), hBp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) (by linarith)]
        simp
  
  have hEm : Measurable (fun y => Real.exp (rfpLam P y)) := hcm
  have hΛm : Measurable (rfpLam P) := by
    have e : rfpLam P = fun y => Real.log (Real.exp (rfpLam P y)) :=
      funext (fun y => (Real.log_exp _).symm)
    rw [e]
    exact Real.measurable_log.comp hEm
  have hE : ∀ y, Real.exp (rfpLam P y) ≤ P.Pst + |C| := by
    intro y
    rcases le_or_gt y 0 with hy | hy
    · have e : Real.exp (rfpLam P y) = P.Pst * Real.exp (y / 10) := (hcneg y hy).2
      rw [e]
      have : Real.exp (y / 10) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by linarith)
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg C]
    · have e : Real.exp (rfpLam P y) ≤ C * Real.exp (-(κ * y)) := hCb y hy.le
      have h1 : Real.exp (-(κ * y)) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by nlinarith)
      have h2 : C * Real.exp (-(κ * y)) ≤ |C| := by
        calc C * Real.exp (-(κ * y)) ≤ |C| * Real.exp (-(κ * y)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) (Real.exp_pos _).le
          _ ≤ |C| * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (abs_nonneg C)
          _ = |C| := mul_one _
      linarith
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ P.Pst + |C| := by linarith [abs_nonneg C]
  
  have hexpI : IntegrableOn Real.exp (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)) := integrableOn_exp_Iic _
  have hgen : ∀ (a m : ℝ → ℝ) (K Mm : ℝ), Measurable a → Measurable m →
      (∀ y, y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam → Real.exp (a y) ≤ K * Real.exp y) →
      (∀ y, y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam → |m y| ≤ Mm) →
      IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp (a y) * m y ^ 2) (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)) := by
    intro a m K Mm ha hm hK hMm
    refine Integrable.mono' (hexpI.const_mul (K * Mm ^ 2))
      ((Real.measurable_exp.comp ha).mul (hm.pow_const 2)).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Iic (fun y hy => ?_)
    have hy' : y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam := hy
    show ‖Real.exp (a y) * m y ^ 2‖ ≤ K * Mm ^ 2 * Real.exp y
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), abs_pow]
    have h1 := hK y hy'
    have h2 := hMm y hy'
    have hm0 := abs_nonneg (m y)
    have he := Real.exp_pos (a y)
    have h3 : |m y| ^ 2 ≤ Mm ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    calc Real.exp (a y) * |m y| ^ 2 ≤ (K * Real.exp y) * Mm ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul h1 h3 (by positivity) (le_trans he.le h1)
      _ = K * Mm ^ 2 * Real.exp y := by ring
  have ha2m : Measurable (fun y => y + 2 * rfpLam P y) :=
    measurable_id.add (measurable_const.mul hΛm)
  have ha2b : ∀ y, y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam →
      Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) ≤ ((P.Pst + |C|) * (P.Pst + |C|)) * Real.exp y := by
    intro y _
    rw [show y + 2 * rfpLam P y = rfpLam P y + rfpLam P y + y by ring, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul (hE y) (hE y) (Real.exp_pos _).le hM0)
      (Real.exp_pos y).le
  have hI0 : IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y ^ 2) (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)) :=
    hgen (fun y => y) (rfpK P.Md) 1 4 measurable_id hkm (fun y _ => by simp) (fun y _ => hk y)
  have hI1 : IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) *
      rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) ^ 2) (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)) := by
    refine hgen (fun y => y + 2 * rfpLam P y) (fun y => rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)))
      _ 13 ha2m (hR0m.comp (by fun_prop : Measurable fun y : ℝ => P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)))
      ha2b ?_
    intro y hy
    apply hR0b
    have h4 : y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam ≤ 13 / P.lam := by
      rw [hy4] at hy
      linarith
    calc P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) ≤ P.lam * (13 / P.lam) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 hl0.le
      _ = 13 := by field_simp
  have hIB : ∀ s : ℝ, IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) *
      rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + s) ^ 2) (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)) := by
    intro s
    exact hgen (fun y => y + 2 * rfpLam P y) (fun y => rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + s))
      _ 1 ha2m (hbm.comp (by fun_prop : Measurable fun y : ℝ => y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + s))
      ha2b (fun y _ => hb _)
  
  have hvan : ∀ y ∈ Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam), Real.exp y * rfpU P (Real.exp y) η ^ 2 = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hU : rfpU P (Real.exp y) η = 0 := by
      unfold rfpU
      rw [Real.log_exp]
      exact cG5 y η (le_of_lt hy)
    rw [hU]
    ring
  
  have hpt : ∀ y ∈ Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam), Real.exp y * rfpU P (Real.exp y) η ^ 2 =
      η ^ 2 * (Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y ^ 2)
      + (((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * P.Amp η ^ 2) * (Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) *
          rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) ^ 2)
      + (((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * P.c1 η ^ 2) * (Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) *
          rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) ^ 2)
      + (((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * P.c2 η ^ 2) * (Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) *
          rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) ^ 2) := by
    intro y hy
    have hEy : rfpE P y η = Real.exp (rfpLam P y) * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      rw [← cG1 y η (mem_Iic.mp hy)]
      unfold rfpE
      ring
    have hU : rfpU P (Real.exp y) η = η * rfpK P.Md y + rfpE P y η * rfpRb P y η := by
      unfold rfpU
      rw [Real.log_exp]
    obtain ⟨p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6⟩ := hsupp y
    rw [hU, hEy, show y + 2 * rfpLam P y = y + rfpLam P y + rfpLam P y by ring,
      Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add]
    unfold rfpRb
    linear_combination
      (2 * η * Real.exp y * Real.exp (rfpLam P y) * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * P.Amp η) * p1
      + (2 * η * Real.exp y * Real.exp (rfpLam P y) * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * P.c1 η) * p2
      + (2 * η * Real.exp y * Real.exp (rfpLam P y) * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * P.c2 η) * p3
      + (2 * Real.exp y * Real.exp (rfpLam P y) ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * P.Amp η * P.c1 η) * p4
      + (2 * Real.exp y * Real.exp (rfpLam P y) ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * P.Amp η * P.c2 η) * p5
      + (2 * Real.exp y * Real.exp (rfpLam P y) ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * P.c1 η * P.c2 η) * p6
  
  have iA : Integrable (fun y => η ^ 2 * (Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y ^ 2))
      (volume.restrict (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam))) := hI0.const_mul _
  have iR : Integrable (fun y => (((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * P.Amp η ^ 2) * (Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) *
          rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) ^ 2))
      (volume.restrict (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam))) := hI1.const_mul _
  have iB1 : Integrable (fun y => (((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * P.c1 η ^ 2) * (Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) *
          rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) ^ 2))
      (volume.restrict (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam))) := (hIB 3).const_mul _
  have iB2 : Integrable (fun y => (((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * P.c2 η ^ 2) * (Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) *
          rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) ^ 2))
      (volume.restrict (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam))) := (hIB 1).const_mul _
  have iAR : Integrable (fun y => η ^ 2 * (Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y ^ 2)
      + (((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * P.Amp η ^ 2) * (Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) *
          rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) ^ 2))
      (volume.restrict (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam))) := iA.add iR
  have iARB : Integrable (fun y => η ^ 2 * (Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y ^ 2)
      + (((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * P.Amp η ^ 2) * (Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) *
          rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) ^ 2)
      + (((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * P.c1 η ^ 2) * (Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) *
          rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) ^ 2))
      (volume.restrict (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam))) := iAR.add iB1
  have iAll : Integrable (fun y => η ^ 2 * (Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y ^ 2)
      + (((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * P.Amp η ^ 2) * (Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) *
          rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) ^ 2)
      + (((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * P.c1 η ^ 2) * (Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) *
          rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3) ^ 2)
      + (((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * P.c2 η ^ 2) * (Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) *
          rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1) ^ 2))
      (volume.restrict (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam))) := iARB.add iB2
  
  have hφIic : IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp y * rfpU P (Real.exp y) η ^ 2)
      (Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)) :=
    IntegrableOn.congr_fun iAll (fun y hy => (hpt y hy).symm) measurableSet_Iic
  have hφIoi : IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp y * rfpU P (Real.exp y) η ^ 2)
      (Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)) :=
    (integrableOn_zero : IntegrableOn (fun _ : ℝ => (0:ℝ)) (Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam))).congr_fun
      (fun y hy => (hvan y hy).symm) measurableSet_Ioi
  have hφ : Integrable (fun y => Real.exp y * rfpU P (Real.exp y) η ^ 2) := by
    have h := hφIic.union hφIoi
    rwa [Set.Iic_union_Ioi, integrableOn_univ] at h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have key := integrableOn_image_iff_integrableOn_abs_deriv_smul MeasurableSet.univ
      (fun x _ => (Real.hasDerivAt_exp x).hasDerivWithinAt) Real.exp_injective.injOn
      (fun x => rfpU P x η ^ 2)
    rw [Set.image_univ, Real.range_exp, integrableOn_univ] at key
    rw [key]
    refine hφ.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_))
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos y)]
  · have hsub : (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), rfpU P x η ^ 2) =
        ∫ y in Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam), Real.exp y * rfpU P (Real.exp y) η ^ 2 := by
      have hce := integral_comp_exp (fun x => rfpU P x η ^ 2)
      simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hce
      rw [← hce]
      symm
      apply setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero
      intro y hy
      rw [mem_Iic, not_le] at hy
      exact hvan y hy
    rw [hsub, setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Iic hpt, integral_add iARB iB2,
      integral_add iAR iB1, integral_add iA iR, integral_const_mul,
      integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
    ring

subgoal_signatures.name: rfp_clamp_identities
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → (1 ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ∧ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ∧ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ≤ rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam → ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y) * Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y) = (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, rfpY5 P.Md P.lam ≤ y → ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y) * Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y) = 1) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, y ≤ 1 → η * rfpK P.Md y + rfpE P y η * rfpRb P y η = 4 * η) ∧ (∀ y η : ℝ, rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ≤ y → η * rfpK P.Md y + rfpE P y η * rfpRb P y η = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: rfp_shape_data
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → ShapeData P.Pst (fun y => Real.exp (rfpLam P y)) (rfpTh P)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → ∀ η : ℝ, (∀ y : ℝ, |P.ca η * rfpPsi P y| ≤ 1 / 2) → IntegrableOn (fun x => x * rfpF P x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), x * rfpF P x η ^ 2) = 1 / 2 * (((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * (∫ y in Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)) + (∫ y in (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)..(rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y)) + (∫ y in Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)) + P.ca η * (∫ y in Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y))

signature.name: rfp_S_F2_rep
signature.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → ∀ η : ℝ, (∀ y : ℝ, |P.ca η * rfpPsi P y| ≤ 1 / 2) → IntegrableOn (fun x => x * rfpF P x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), x * rfpF P x η ^ 2) = 1 / 2 * (((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * (∫ y in Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)) + (∫ y in (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)..(rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y)) + (∫ y in Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)) + P.ca η * (∫ y in Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hP η hψ
  have hR := hP
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl100, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hR
  obtain ⟨hcm, hϑm, hcb, -, -⟩ := rfp_shape_data P hP
  obtain ⟨-, B, hB⟩ := rfp_lam_tail_envelope P hP
  
  have hsig : ∀ t, 0 ≤ sigA t ∧ sigA t ≤ 1 := by
    intro t
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · exact ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
    · exact ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
    · have ha := Real.exp_pos (-1 / t ^ 2)
      have hc := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2)
      refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
      linarith
  have hsig0 : ∀ t, t ≤ 0 → sigA t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold sigA
    rw [if_pos ht]
  have hsig1 : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → sigA t = 1 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold sigA
    rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos ht]
  have hsigm : Measurable sigA := by
    have e : sigA = fun y => if y ≤ 0 then 0 else if 1 ≤ y then 1 else
        Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) / (Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)) := by
      funext y; rfl
    rw [e]
    refine Measurable.ite measurableSet_Iic measurable_const
      (Measurable.ite measurableSet_Ici measurable_const ?_)
    fun_prop
  
  have hb : ∀ t, |rfpBmp t| ≤ 1 := by
    intro t
    unfold rfpBmp
    obtain ⟨a0, a1⟩ := hsig (1 + t / (3 / 20))
    obtain ⟨b0, b1⟩ := hsig (1 - t / (3 / 20))
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg a0 b0)]
    exact mul_le_one₀ a1 b0 b1
  have hbm : Measurable rfpBmp := by
    have e : rfpBmp = fun t => sigA (1 + t / (3 / 20)) * sigA (1 - t / (3 / 20)) := by
      funext t; rfl
    rw [e]
    exact (hsigm.comp (by fun_prop : Measurable fun t : ℝ => 1 + t / (3 / 20))).mul
      (hsigm.comp (by fun_prop : Measurable fun t : ℝ => 1 - t / (3 / 20)))
  have hb0 : ∀ t, t ≤ -(3 / 20) → rfpBmp t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpBmp
    rw [hsig0 (1 + t / (3 / 20)) (by linarith), zero_mul]
  
  have hL : 99 / 100 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.lam) := by
    have h := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (x := 1 / P.lam) (by positivity)
    have h1 : (1 / P.lam)⁻¹ = P.lam := by rw [one_div, inv_inv]
    rw [h1] at h
    linarith
  have hY5 : rfpY5 P.Md P.lam = rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  have hψ0 : ∀ y, y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 → rfpPsi P y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    unfold rfpPsi
    rw [hb0 _ (by rw [hY5]; linarith), hb0 _ (by rw [hY5]; linarith)]
    ring
  have hϑ1 : ∀ y, y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam → rfpTh P y = 1 := by
    intro y hy
    unfold rfpTh
    rw [hsig0 _ (by linarith)]
    ring
  have hϑ0 : ∀ y, rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 ≤ y → rfpTh P y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    unfold rfpTh
    rw [hsig1 _ (by linarith)]
    ring
  have hϑ01 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ rfpTh P y := fun y => (hcb y).2.1
  have hψm : Measurable (rfpPsi P) := by
    have e : rfpPsi P = fun y => rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3) -
        rfpKa P * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1) := by
      funext y; rfl
    rw [e]
    exact (hbm.comp (by fun_prop : Measurable fun y : ℝ => y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3)).sub
      (measurable_const.mul (hbm.comp (by fun_prop : Measurable fun y : ℝ => y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)))
  have hψb : ∀ y, |rfpPsi P y| ≤ 1 + |rfpKa P| := by
    intro y
    unfold rfpPsi
    have h1 := hb (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3)
    have h2 := hb (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)
    have h3 : |rfpKa P * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)| ≤ |rfpKa P| := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |rfpKa P| * |rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)| ≤ |rfpKa P| * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = |rfpKa P| := mul_one _
    have h4 := abs_sub_le (rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3)) 0
      (rfpKa P * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1))
    rw [sub_zero, zero_sub, abs_neg] at h4
    linarith
  
  have hΛm : Measurable (rfpLam P) := by
    have e : rfpLam P = fun y => Real.log (Real.exp (rfpLam P y)) :=
      funext (fun y => (Real.log_exp _).symm)
    rw [e]
    exact Real.measurable_log.comp hcm
  have hAm : Measurable (fun y => Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)) :=
    Real.measurable_exp.comp (measurable_id.add (measurable_const.mul hΛm))
  have hEI : Integrable (fun y => Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)) := by
    have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)) (Iic 0) := by
      refine Integrable.mono' ((integrableOn_exp_Iic 0).const_mul (Real.exp (2 * B)))
        hAm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Iic (fun y hy => ?_)
      have hy' : y ≤ 0 := hy
      show ‖Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)‖ ≤ Real.exp (2 * B) * Real.exp y
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), ← Real.exp_add]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
      have := hB y
      rw [max_eq_right hy'] at this
      linarith
    have h2 : IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)) (Ioi 0) := by
      refine Integrable.mono' ((exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 (b := 2 * P.h) (by positivity)).const_mul
        (Real.exp (2 * B))) hAm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi (fun y hy => ?_)
      have hy' : 0 < y := hy
      show ‖Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)‖ ≤ Real.exp (2 * B) * Real.exp (-(2 * P.h) * y)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), ← Real.exp_add]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
      have := hB y
      rw [max_eq_left hy'.le] at this
      linarith
    have h3 := h1.union h2
    rw [Iic_union_Ioi] at h3
    exact integrableOn_univ.1 h3
  
  have hf0 : 0 < (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
  have hf1 : (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg η])
  obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ : ∃ H : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ y, H y = 1 / 2 * (Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) *
      ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y)) := ⟨_, fun y => rfl⟩
  have hpt : ∀ y, Real.exp y * (Real.exp y * rfpF P (Real.exp y) η ^ 2) = H y := by
    intro y
    have hs : 0 ≤ 1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y := by
      have := (abs_le.1 (hψ y)).1
      linarith
    have hu := Real.exp_pos y
    have hr : (((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y)) ^ 2 = ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hf0.le]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hH y]
    unfold rfpF rfpE
    rw [Real.log_exp, div_pow, mul_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hs,
      Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.exp y), hr,
      show y + 2 * rfpLam P y = y + rfpLam P y + rfpLam P y by ring, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add]
    field_simp
  have hHm : Measurable H := by
    have e : H = fun y => 1 / 2 * (Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) *
        ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) * (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y)) := funext hH
    rw [e]
    exact measurable_const.mul ((hAm.mul (measurable_const.pow (measurable_const.mul hϑm))).mul
      (measurable_const.add (measurable_const.mul hψm)))
  have hHb : ∀ y, ‖H y‖ ≤ 3 / 4 * Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) := by
    intro y
    rw [hH y]
    have hs := abs_le.1 (hψ y)
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ 1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y := by linarith [hs.1]
    have hs1 : 1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y ≤ 3 / 2 := by linarith [hs.2]
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) := Real.rpow_nonneg hf0.le _
    have hr1 : ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) ≤ 1 :=
      Real.rpow_le_one hf0.le hf1 (by linarith [hϑ01 y])
    have he := Real.exp_pos (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)
    have hEr : 0 ≤ Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) :=
      mul_nonneg he.le hr0
    have hEr1 : Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) ≤
        Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) := by
      calc _ ≤ Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr1 he.le
        _ = _ := mul_one _
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (mul_nonneg hEr hs0))]
    have := mul_le_mul hEr1 hs1 hs0 he.le
    linarith
  have hHI : Integrable H :=
    Integrable.mono' (hEI.const_mul (3 / 4)) hHm.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ hHb)
  
  have hInt : IntegrableOn (fun x => x * rfpF P x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) := by
    have key := integrableOn_image_iff_integrableOn_abs_deriv_smul (s := univ) (f := Real.exp)
      (f' := Real.exp) MeasurableSet.univ (fun y _ => (Real.hasDerivAt_exp y).hasDerivWithinAt)
      Real.exp_injective.injOn (fun x => x * rfpF P x η ^ 2)
    have h := key.2 ((integrableOn_univ.2 hHI).congr_fun (fun y _ => by
      show H y = |Real.exp y| • (Real.exp y * rfpF P (Real.exp y) η ^ 2)
      rw [abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos y), smul_eq_mul, hpt y]) MeasurableSet.univ)
    rwa [image_univ, Real.range_exp] at h
  refine ⟨hInt, ?_⟩
  
  have hval : (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), x * rfpF P x η ^ 2) = ∫ y, H y := by
    have hce := integral_comp_exp (fun x => x * rfpF P x η ^ 2)
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hce
    rw [← hce]
    congr 1
    funext y
    exact hpt y
  have hA : ∀ s : Set ℝ, IntegrableOn H s := fun s => hHI.integrableOn
  rw [hval, ← intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_add_Ioi (b := rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) (hA _) (hA _),
    ← Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi (show rfpY4 P.Md P.lam ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 by linarith),
    setIntegral_union (Set.Ioc_disjoint_Ioi le_rfl) measurableSet_Ioi (hA _) (hA _)]
  
  have e1 : (∫ y in Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam), H y) =
      1 / 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * ∫ y in Iic (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) := by
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Iic (fun y hy => ?_)
    have hy' : y ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam := hy
    rw [hH y, hϑ1 y hy', hψ0 y (by linarith)]
    simp only [mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, Real.rpow_two]
    ring
  have e2 : (∫ y in Ioc (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60), H y) =
      1 / 2 * ∫ y in (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)..(rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60),
        Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by linarith), ← integral_const_mul]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioc (fun y hy => ?_)
    rw [hH y, hψ0 y hy.2, mul_zero, add_zero, mul_one]
  have iE : IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)) (Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60)) :=
    hEI.integrableOn
  have iEψ : IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y)
      (Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60)) := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (iE.const_mul (1 + |rfpKa P|)) (hAm.mul hψm).aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ (fun y => ?_))
    show ‖Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y‖ ≤ (1 + |rfpKa P|) * Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), mul_comm]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hψb y) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have e3 : (∫ y in Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60), H y) =
      1 / 2 * (∫ y in Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)) +
      1 / 2 * P.ca η * (∫ y in Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y) := by
    have i1 : Integrable (fun y => 1 / 2 * Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y))
        (volume.restrict (Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60))) := iE.const_mul _
    have i2 : Integrable (fun y => 1 / 2 * P.ca η * (Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y))
        (volume.restrict (Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60))) := iEψ.const_mul _
    rw [← integral_const_mul, ← integral_const_mul, ← integral_add i1 i2]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun y hy => ?_)
    have hy' : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 < y := hy
    rw [hH y, hϑ0 y hy'.le, mul_zero, Real.rpow_zero]
    ring
  rw [e1, e2, e3]
  ring

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hP hlM
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl1, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hP
  
  have s0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → sigA t = 0 := fun t ht => by unfold sigA; rw [if_pos ht]
  have s1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → sigA t = 1 := fun t ht => by
    unfold sigA; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos ht]
  have sb : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA t ∧ sigA t ≤ 1 := by
    intro t
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
    · have ha := Real.exp_pos (-1 / t ^ 2)
      have hc := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2)
      constructor
      · positivity
      · rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]; linarith
  have smeas : Measurable sigA := by
    change Measurable (fun y : ℝ => if y ≤ 0 then (0:ℝ) else if 1 ≤ y then 1 else
      Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) / (Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)))
    refine Measurable.ite measurableSet_Iic measurable_const
      (Measurable.ite measurableSet_Ici measurable_const ?_)
    fun_prop
  have sII : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable sigA volume a b := by
    intro a b
    refine IntervalIntegrable.mono_fun' (g := fun _ => (1:ℝ)) intervalIntegrable_const
      smeas.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ (fun x => ?_))
    show ‖sigA x‖ ≤ 1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sb x).1]; exact (sb x).2
  
  have Sig0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → rfpSigI t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpSigI
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ)) ?_]
    · simp
    · intro x hx
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge ht] at hx
      exact s0 x hx.2
  have Sig1 : ∀ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a → 1 ≤ b → rfpSigI b - rfpSigI a = b - a := by
    intro a b ha hb
    unfold rfpSigI
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (sII 0 b) (sII 0 a)]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (1:ℝ)) ?_]
    · simp
    · intro x hx
      apply s1
      rcases le_total a b with h | h
      · rw [Set.uIcc_of_le h] at hx; linarith [hx.1]
      · rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge h] at hx; linarith [hx.1]
  have SigNN : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpSigI t := by
    intro t
    rcases le_total t 0 with h | h
    · rw [Sig0 t h]
    · unfold rfpSigI; exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg h (fun x _ => (sb x).1)
  have Sig1le : rfpSigI 1 ≤ 1 := by
    have := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := 0) (b := 1) (C := 1) (f := sigA)
      (fun v _ => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sb _).1]; exact (sb _).2)
    unfold rfpSigI
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sub_zero, abs_one, one_mul] at this
    exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) this
  have SigC : Continuous rfpSigI := intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive sII 0
  
  have hL : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.lam) := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith)
  have hh1 : P.h ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hlogh : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.h) := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hh0]; linarith)
  have hρ1 : P.ρ < 1 := by linarith
  have hy2pos : 0 < rfpY2 P.Md := by unfold rfpY2; positivity
  have e2 : rfpY2 P.Md = Real.exp P.Md + 11 := rfl
  have e3 : rfpY3 P.Md P.lam = rfpY2 P.Md + 1 + 60 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  have e4 : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam = rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 13 / P.lam := rfl
  have e5 : rfpY5 P.Md P.lam = rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  have eb : rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh = rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 2 + P.T1 + P.Lh + 3 := rfl
  have hLam : ∀ z : ℝ, z ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam →
      rfpLam P z = Real.log P.Pst + z / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI z - P.lam * rfpSigI (z - rfpY2 P.Md) := by
    intro z hz2
    have t1 : rfpSigI (z - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) = 0 := Sig0 _ (by rw [e5]; linarith)
    have t2 : rfpSigI (z - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) = 0 := Sig0 _ (by rw [e5]; linarith)
    have t3 : sigA ((z - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) = 0 :=
      s0 _ (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) (by norm_num))
    have hs : sigA ((Real.log (Real.exp z / Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) + 2) / 2) = 0 := by
      apply s0
      rw [← Real.exp_sub, Real.log_exp, eb, e5]
      linarith
    have t4 : tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp z) = 1 - P.ρ := by
      unfold tailFac; rw [hs]; ring
    have t5 : Real.log (tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp z) / (1 - P.ρ)) = 0 := by
      rw [t4, div_self (by linarith), Real.log_one]

            have : 0 ≤ P.lam * (y - Y3) := mul_nonneg hl0.le (by linarith)
            linarith
          have hb := Bb (y - Y4 + s)
          have hb2 : rfpBmp (y - Y4 + s) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hb.1 hb.2
          have he : Real.exp (w y) ≤ D := Real.exp_le_exp.2 hwy
          calc Real.exp (w y) * rfpBmp (y - Y4 + s) ^ 2 ≤ D * 1 := mul_le_mul he hb2 (sq_nonneg _) hD0.le
            _ = D := mul_one D
      have hc : (∫ y in Icc (Y4 - s - 3 / 20) (Y4 - s + 3 / 20), D) =
          (Y4 - s + 3 / 20 - (Y4 - s - 3 / 20)) * D := by
        rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hlohi]; simp
      rw [hc] at hm
      linarith
    · intro y hy; exact mem_Iic.2 (by linarith [hy.2])
    · intro y hy
      obtain ⟨-, hy2⟩ := hy
      simp only [mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le] at hy2
      rcases hy2 with h | h
      · rw [B1 _ (by linarith)]; ring
      · rw [B2 _ (by linarith)]; ring
  
  have hK : (∫ y in Iic Y4, Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y ^ 2) ≤ 16 * Real.exp (Real.exp P.Md) := by
    rw [setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero (s := Iic (Real.exp P.Md)) measurableSet_Iic ?_ ?_]
    · rw [← integral_exp_Iic (Real.exp P.Md), ← integral_const_mul]
      apply integral_mono_of_nonneg
      · exact ae_of_all _ (fun y => (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y ^ 2))
      · exact Integrable.const_mul (integrableOn_exp_Iic _) 16
      · refine ae_of_all _ (fun y => ?_)
        show Real.exp y * rfpK P.Md y ^ 2 ≤ 16 * Real.exp y
        have hk := Kb y
        have hk2 : rfpK P.Md y ^ 2 ≤ 16 := by nlinarith
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk2 (Real.exp_pos y).le
        linarith
    · intro y hy; exact mem_Iic.2 (le_trans (mem_Iic.1 hy) hEY4)
    · intro y hy
      obtain ⟨-, hy2⟩ := hy
      simp only [mem_Iic, not_le] at hy2
      rw [Kz y hy2.le]; ring
  
  have hdom : ∀ y, Real.exp (w y) ≤ Real.exp (2 * Real.log P.Pst + 6 / 5) * Real.exp y := by
    intro y; rw [← Real.exp_add]; apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
    rcases le_total y 0 with h | h
    · linarith [E0 y h]
    · linarith [E1 y h]
  have hint : ∀ a, IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp (w y)) (Iic a) := by
    intro a
    refine Integrable.mono' (Integrable.const_mul (integrableOn_exp_Iic a) (Real.exp (2 * Real.log P.Pst + 6 / 5)))
      (Real.continuous_exp.comp hwc).aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ (fun y => ?_))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]; exact hdom y
  have hsplit := intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_sub_Iic (hint Y3) (hint Y4)
  have hJ : (∫ y in Y3..Y4, Real.exp (w y)) = (D - D * Real.exp (-26)) / (2 * P.lam) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun y => Real.exp (w Y3 - 2 * P.lam * (y - Y3))) ?_]
    · rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
        (f := fun y => -Real.exp (w Y3 - 2 * P.lam * (y - Y3)) / (2 * P.lam)) ?_ ?_]
      · have h26 : w Y3 - 2 * P.lam * (Y4 - Y3) = w Y3 + -26 := by linear_combination (-2) * hY43
        rw [h26, sub_self, mul_zero, sub_zero, Real.exp_add, ← hDd]
        ring
      · intro x _
        have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun y => w Y3 - 2 * P.lam * (y - Y3)) (-(2 * P.lam)) x :=

        exact ((h0.exp.neg).div_const (2 * P.lam)).congr_deriv (by field_simp)
      · exact (by fun_prop : Continuous fun y => Real.exp (w Y3 - 2 * P.lam * (y - Y3))).intervalIntegrable _ _
    · intro y hy
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hY34le] at hy
      show Real.exp (w y) = Real.exp (w Y3 - 2 * P.lam * (y - Y3))
      rw [E2 y hy.1]
  have hI3 : (∫ y in Iic Y3, Real.exp (w y)) ≤ Real.exp (2 * Real.log P.Pst) * (1 + 8 * Y3) := by
    have hs2 := intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_sub_Iic (hint 0) (hint Y3)
    have hA : (∫ y in Iic (0:ℝ), Real.exp (w y)) ≤ Real.exp (2 * Real.log P.Pst) := by
      calc (∫ y in Iic (0:ℝ), Real.exp (w y))
          ≤ ∫ y in Iic (0:ℝ), Real.exp (2 * Real.log P.Pst) * Real.exp y := by
            apply integral_mono_of_nonneg
            · exact ae_of_all _ (fun y => (Real.exp_pos (w y)).le)
            · exact Integrable.const_mul (integrableOn_exp_Iic 0) _
            · rw [Filter.EventuallyLE, ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Iic]
              refine ae_of_all _ (fun y hy => ?_)
              show Real.exp (w y) ≤ Real.exp (2 * Real.log P.Pst) * Real.exp y
              rw [← Real.exp_add]; exact Real.exp_le_exp.2 (E0 y hy)
        _ = Real.exp (2 * Real.log P.Pst) := by
            rw [integral_const_mul, integral_exp_Iic, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
    have hB : (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..Y3, Real.exp (w y)) ≤
        Y3 * (Real.exp (2 * Real.log P.Pst) * Real.exp (6 / 5)) := by
      calc (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..Y3, Real.exp (w y))
          ≤ ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..Y3, Real.exp (2 * Real.log P.Pst) * Real.exp (6 / 5) := by
            apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hY3pos.le ((Real.continuous_exp.comp hwc).intervalIntegrable _ _)
              intervalIntegrable_const
            intro y hy
            rw [← Real.exp_add]; exact Real.exp_le_exp.2 (E1 y hy.1)
        _ = Y3 * (Real.exp (2 * Real.log P.Pst) * Real.exp (6 / 5)) := by
            rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, sub_zero]
    have hE2nn := (Real.exp_pos (2 * Real.log P.Pst)).le
    have h8 : Y3 * (Real.exp (2 * Real.log P.Pst) * Real.exp (6 / 5)) ≤
        Y3 * (Real.exp (2 * Real.log P.Pst) * 8) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he65 hE2nn) hY3pos.le
    linarith
  have I3nn : 0 ≤ ∫ y in Iic Y3, Real.exp (w y) :=
    setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Iic (fun y _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le)
  
  have hDeq : Real.exp (Y3 + 2 * rfpLam P Y3) = D := by rw [hW Y3 hY34le]
  have cong : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, (∫ y in Iic Y4, Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * g y) =
      ∫ y in Iic Y4, Real.exp (w y) * g y :=
    fun g => setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Iic (fun y hy => by simp only [hW y hy])
  have cong0 : (∫ y in Iic Y4, Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)) = ∫ y in Iic Y4, Real.exp (w y) :=
    setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Iic (fun y hy => by simp only [hW y hy])
  have IpEq := cong (fun y => rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - Y3)) ^ 2)
  have B3Eq := cong (fun y => rfpBmp (y - Y4 + 3) ^ 2)
  have B1Eq := cong (fun y => rfpBmp (y - Y4 + 1) ^ 2)
  beta_reduce at IpEq B3Eq B1Eq
  rw [hDeq, IpEq, B3Eq, B1Eq, cong0]
  have Kpos : 0 < Real.exp (Real.exp P.Md) := Real.exp_pos _
  refine ⟨hD0, ?_, ?_, setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Iic (fun y _ => by positivity),
    WB 3 (by norm_num) le_rfl, setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Iic (fun y _ => by positivity),
    WB 1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num), setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Iic (fun y _ => by positivity),
    ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hIpw]
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left Klo hD0.le
    linarith
  · rw [hIpw]
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left Kup hD0.le
    linarith
  · have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he19 Kpos.le
    linarith
  · have hW4 : (∫ y in Iic Y4, Real.exp (w y)) =
        (∫ y in Iic Y3, Real.exp (w y)) + (D - D * Real.exp (-26)) / (2 * P.lam) := by

    have h2J : 2 * P.lam * ((D - D * Real.exp (-26)) / (2 * P.lam)) = D - D * Real.exp (-26) := by

    rw [hW4, mul_add, h2J]

    have f4 : D * (P.lam * Y3) ≤ D * (13 / 10 ^ 6) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlY3 hD0.le
    have f5 : D * P.lam ≤ D * (1 / 10 ^ 14) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hls hD0.le
    have f6 : D * Real.exp (-26) ≤ D * (1 / 1000) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm26 hD0.le
    have f7 : 0 ≤ D * Real.exp (-26) := mul_nonneg hD0.le hm26nn
    have f8 : 0 ≤ 2 * P.lam * (∫ y in Iic Y3, Real.exp (w y)) := mul_nonneg (by positivity) I3nn
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> nlinarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → 0 ≤ (∫ y in Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)) ∧ (∫ y in Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)) ≤ Real.exp (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 2 * rfpLam P (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) * Real.exp (-26) * (1 + 8 * Real.log (1 / P.lam)) ∧ |∫ y in Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y| ≤ 8 * Real.exp (-26) * Real.exp (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 2 * rfpLam P (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hP
  have hP' := hP
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl1, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hP
  
  have s0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → sigA t = 0 := fun t ht => by unfold sigA; rw [if_pos ht]
  have s1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → sigA t = 1 := fun t ht => by
    unfold sigA; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos ht]
  have sb : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA t ∧ sigA t ≤ 1 := by
    intro t
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
    · have ha := Real.exp_pos (-1 / t ^ 2)
      have hc := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - t) ^ 2)
      constructor
      · positivity
      · rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]; linarith
  have scont : Continuous sigA := by
    set G : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => expNegInvGlue (max y 0 ^ 2) with hG
    have hGc : Continuous G :=
      ((expNegInvGlue.contDiff (n := 0)).continuous).comp ((continuous_id.max continuous_const).pow 2)
    have hG0 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → G y = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      simp only [hG, max_eq_right hy]
      exact expNegInvGlue.zero_of_nonpos (by norm_num)
    have hGp : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → G y = Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) := by
      intro y hy
      simp only [hG, max_eq_left hy.le]
      unfold expNegInvGlue
      rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr (pow_pos hy 2)), neg_div, one_div]
    have hGpos : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → 0 < G y := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hGp y hy]; exact Real.exp_pos _
    have hGnn : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ G y := by
      intro y
      rcases le_or_gt y 0 with hy | hy
      · rw [hG0 y hy]
      · exact (hGpos y hy).le
    have hden : ∀ y : ℝ, G y + G (1 - y) ≠ 0 := by
      intro y
      rcases le_or_gt y 0 with hy | hy
      · have := hGpos (1 - y) (by linarith)
        have := hGnn y
        linarith
      · have := hGpos y hy
        have := hGnn (1 - y)
        linarith
    have heq : sigA = fun y => G y / (G y + G (1 - y)) := by
      funext y
      unfold sigA
      split_ifs with hy0 hy1
      · rw [hG0 y hy0, zero_div]
      · rw [hG0 (1 - y) (by linarith), add_zero, div_self (hGpos y (by linarith)).ne']
      · push_neg at hy0 hy1
        rw [hGp y hy0, hGp (1 - y) (by linarith)]
    rw [heq]
    exact hGc.div (hGc.add (hGc.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))) hden
  have sII : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable sigA MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
    fun a b => scont.intervalIntegrable a b
  have Scont : Continuous rfpSigI :=
    intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) sII 0
  have Sig0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → rfpSigI t = 0 := by
    intro t ht

    · simp
    · intro x hx
