      exact s0 x hx.2
  have Sig1 : ∀ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a → 1 ≤ b → rfpSigI b - rfpSigI a = b - a := by
    intro a b ha hb
    unfold rfpSigI
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (sII 0 b) (sII 0 a)]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (1:ℝ)) ?_]
    · simp
    · intro x hx
      apply s1
      rcases le_total a b with h | h
      · rw [Set.uIcc_of_le h] at hx; linarith [hx.1]
      · rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge h] at hx; linarith [hx.1]
  have SigNN : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → 0 ≤ rfpSigI s ∧ rfpSigI s ≤ s := by
    intro s hs
    unfold rfpSigI
    constructor
    · exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hs (fun x _ => (sb x).1)
    · have := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hs (sII 0 s)
        (intervalIntegrable_const (c := (1:ℝ))) (fun x _ => (sb x).2)
      simpa using this
  have SigLo : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t - 1 ≤ rfpSigI t := by
    intro t ht
    rcases le_total t 1 with h | h
    · linarith [(SigNN t ht).1]
    · have := Sig1 1 t le_rfl h
      linarith [(SigNN 1 zero_le_one).1]
  
  have hL : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.lam) := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith)
  have hh1 : P.h ≤ 1 / 100 := by nlinarith
  have hhlam : P.h ≤ P.lam := by nlinarith
  have hlogh : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.h) := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hh0]; linarith)
  have hlh : Real.log (1 / P.h) = -Real.log P.h := by rw [one_div, Real.log_inv]
  have hT1pos : 0 ≤ P.T1 := by linarith
  have hρ1 : P.ρ ≤ 1 / 80000 := by linarith
  have hlog2 : (0.6931471803 : ℝ) < Real.log 2 := Real.log_two_gt_d9
  have hρlog : 4 * P.ρ ≤ Real.log 2 := by linarith
  have he1 : Real.exp 1 < 3 := lt_trans Real.exp_one_lt_d9 (by norm_num)
  have he1p := Real.exp_pos 1
  have he2 : Real.exp 2 < 9 := by
    have : Real.exp 2 = Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
    rw [this]; nlinarith
  have hL3 : 3 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.lam) := by
    rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le (by positivity)]
    have h100 : 100 ≤ 1 / P.lam := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith
    have e3 : Real.exp 3 = Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
    have hx2 : Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 < 9 := by nlinarith
    have : Real.exp 3 < 27 := by rw [e3]; nlinarith
    linarith
  have hy2pos : 0 < rfpY2 P.Md := by unfold rfpY2; positivity
  have e3 : rfpY3 P.Md P.lam = rfpY2 P.Md + 1 + 60 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  have e4 : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam = rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 13 / P.lam := rfl
  have e5 : rfpY5 P.Md P.lam = rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  have eb : rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh = rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 2 + P.T1 + P.Lh + 3 := rfl
  have h13 : 0 < 13 / P.lam := div_pos (by norm_num) hl0
  have h13' : P.lam * (13 / P.lam) = 13 := by field_simp
  have hy3lo : rfpY2 P.Md + 1 ≤ rfpY3 P.Md P.lam := by rw [e3]; linarith
  have hy34 : rfpY3 P.Md P.lam ≤ rfpY4 P.Md P.lam := by rw [e4]; linarith
  have hy45 : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam := by rw [e5]; linarith
  have hy45' : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 4 := by rw [e5]; linarith
  have hy35 : rfpY3 P.Md P.lam ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam := by linarith
  have hk4 : 13 ≤ P.lam * (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) := by
    rw [show rfpY4 P.Md P.lam - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam = 13 / P.lam by rw [e4]; ring, h13']
  have hk5 : 13 ≤ P.lam * (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) := by
    rw [show rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam = 13 / P.lam + (60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam)) by
      rw [e5, e4]; ring, mul_add, h13']
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hl0.le (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam))]
  
  have hQf : ∀ y : ℝ, tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) =
      1 - P.ρ * (1 - sigA ((y - rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh + 2) / 2)) := by
    intro y; unfold tailFac; rw [← Real.exp_sub, Real.log_exp]
  have hQpos : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < (1 - P.ρ * (1 - sigA ((y - rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh + 2) / 2))) / (1 - P.ρ) := by
    intro y
    have := sb ((y - rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh + 2) / 2)
    apply div_pos _ (by linarith)
    nlinarith
  have hlogQ : ∀ y : ℝ, Real.log (tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) / (1 - P.ρ)) ≤ 2 * P.ρ := by
    intro y
    rw [hQf]
    have hs := sb ((y - rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh + 2) / 2)
    refine le_trans (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (hQpos y)) ?_
    rw [div_sub_one (by linarith), div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hρ0.le (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - 2 * P.ρ)]
  have hlogQ0 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam →
      Real.log (tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) / (1 - P.ρ)) = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hQf, s0 _ (by rw [eb]; linarith)]
    rw [show 1 - P.ρ * (1 - 0) = 1 - P.ρ by ring, div_self (by linarith), Real.log_one]
  
  have hΛc : Continuous (rfpLam P) := by
    have e : rfpLam P = fun y => Real.log P.Pst + y / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y - P.lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 P.Md)
        - (1 - P.lam) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam)
        + (1 - P.h) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1)
        - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) * Real.log 2
        + Real.log ((1 - P.ρ * (1 - sigA ((y - rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh + 2) / 2))) / (1 - P.ρ)) := by
      funext y; rw [rfpLam, hQf y]
    rw [e]
    refine Continuous.add ?_ (Continuous.log ?_ (fun y => (hQpos y).ne'))
    · fun_prop
    · fun_prop
  
  have hId : ∀ y, rfpY3 P.Md P.lam ≤ y → rfpLam P y = rfpLam P (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)
      - (1 / 2 + P.lam) * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)
      - (1 - P.lam) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) + (1 - P.h) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1)
      - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) * Real.log 2
      + Real.log (tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) / (1 - P.ρ)) := by
    intro y hy
    have z1 : rfpSigI (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) = 0 := Sig0 _ (by linarith)
    have z2 : rfpSigI (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) = 0 := Sig0 _ (by linarith)
    have z3 : sigA ((rfpY3 P.Md P.lam - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) = 0 :=
      s0 _ (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) (by norm_num))
    have z4 := hlogQ0 (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) hy35
    have a1 := Sig1 (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) y (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have a2 := Sig1 (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam - rfpY2 P.Md) (y - rfpY2 P.Md) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    unfold rfpLam
    rw [z1, z2, z3, z4]
    linear_combination (-(3 / 5 : ℝ)) * a1 - P.lam * a2
  
  obtain ⟨E0, hE0⟩ : ∃ E0 : ℝ, E0 = rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 2 * rfpLam P (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) - 26 - Real.log 2 :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hEp : 0 < Real.exp E0 := Real.exp_pos _
  have hDE : Real.exp (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 2 * rfpLam P (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) * Real.exp (-26) =
      2 * Real.exp E0 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add, show rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 2 * rfpLam P (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) + -26 = E0 + Real.log 2 by
      rw [hE0]; ring, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num)]
    ring
  
  have hwin : ∀ y, rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 ≤ y → y ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam →
      Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) ≤ Real.exp E0 / 2 := by
    intro y hy1 hy2
    have hL' := hId y (by linarith)
    rw [Sig0 (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (by linarith), Sig0 (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) (by linarith),
      s1 ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) (by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith),
      hlogQ0 y hy2] at hL'
    rw [show Real.exp E0 / 2 = Real.exp (E0 - Real.log 2) by rw [Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log (by norm_num)]]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    rw [hL', hE0]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hl0.le (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)]
  
  have htail : ∀ y, rfpY5 P.Md P.lam < y →
      Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) ≤
        Real.exp E0 * Real.exp (2 + 2 * rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) * Real.exp ((-2) * y) +
        Real.exp E0 * Real.exp (4 * Real.log P.h + 2 * P.h * rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) * Real.exp ((-(2 * P.h)) * y) := by
    intro y hy
    have hL' := hId y (by linarith)
    rw [s1 ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) (by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith)] at hL'
    have hq := hlogQ y
    have hS := SigLo (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (by linarith)
    have hSn := SigNN (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (by linarith)
    have hlt := mul_nonneg hl0.le (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam)
    have hb1 := mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - P.lam)
      (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) - (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1))
    have hp1 : 0 ≤ Real.exp E0 * Real.exp (2 + 2 * rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) * Real.exp ((-2) * y) := by positivity
    have hp2 : 0 ≤ Real.exp E0 * Real.exp (4 * Real.log P.h + 2 * P.h * rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) *
        Real.exp ((-(2 * P.h)) * y) := by positivity
    rcases le_total (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) 0 with hc | hc
    · rw [Sig0 _ hc] at hL'
      have : Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) ≤
          Real.exp E0 * Real.exp (2 + 2 * rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) * Real.exp ((-2) * y) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        rw [hL', hE0]
        nlinarith
      linarith
    · have hSn2 := SigNN _ hc
      have hb2 := mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - P.h)
        (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) - rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1))
      have hb3 := mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - 2 * P.h) hT1pos
      have : Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) ≤
          Real.exp E0 * Real.exp (4 * Real.log P.h + 2 * P.h * rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) *
            Real.exp ((-(2 * P.h)) * y) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        rw [hL', hE0]
        rw [hlh] at hT1
        nlinarith
      linarith
  
  have hfc : Continuous (fun y => Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)) := by fun_prop
  have hI1 : IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp E0 * Real.exp (2 + 2 * rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) * Real.exp ((-2) * y))
      (Ioi (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam)) := (integrableOn_exp_mul_Ioi (by norm_num) _).const_mul _
  have hI2 : IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp E0 * Real.exp (4 * Real.log P.h + 2 * P.h * rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) *
      Real.exp ((-(2 * P.h)) * y)) (Ioi (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam)) :=
    (integrableOn_exp_mul_Ioi (by linarith) _).const_mul _
  have hfI2 : IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)) (Ioi (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam)) :=
    Integrable.mono' (hI1.add hI2) hfc.aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi (fun y hy => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]; exact htail y hy))
  have hfI1 : IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y))
      (Ioc (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60) (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam)) := hfc.integrableOn_Ioc
  have hP1 : ∫ y in Ioc (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60) (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) ≤
      (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60)) * (Real.exp E0 / 2) := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hy45]
    calc ∫ y in (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60)..(rfpY5 P.Md P.lam), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)
        ≤ ∫ y in (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60)..(rfpY5 P.Md P.lam), Real.exp E0 / 2 :=
          intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hy45 (hfc.intervalIntegrable _ _) intervalIntegrable_const
            (fun y hy => hwin y hy.1 hy.2)
      _ = _ := by rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
  have hX1 : Real.exp (2 + 2 * rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) * Real.exp ((-2) * rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) = Real.exp 2 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
  have hX2 : Real.exp (4 * Real.log P.h + 2 * P.h * rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) *
      Real.exp ((-(2 * P.h)) * rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) = P.h ^ 4 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add, show 4 * Real.log P.h + 2 * P.h * rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + (-(2 * P.h)) * rfpY5 P.Md P.lam =
      Real.log (P.h ^ 4) by rw [Real.log_pow]; push_cast; ring, Real.exp_log (by positivity)]
  have hP2 : ∫ y in Ioi (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) ≤
      Real.exp E0 * Real.exp 2 / 2 + Real.exp E0 * (P.h ^ 4 / (2 * P.h)) := by
    calc ∫ y in Ioi (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)
        ≤ ∫ y in Ioi (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam), (Real.exp E0 * Real.exp (2 + 2 * rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) * Real.exp ((-2) * y) +
          Real.exp E0 * Real.exp (4 * Real.log P.h + 2 * P.h * rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) *
            Real.exp ((-(2 * P.h)) * y)) :=
          setIntegral_mono_on hfI2 (hI1.add hI2) measurableSet_Ioi (fun y hy => htail y hy)
      _ = Real.exp E0 * Real.exp 2 / 2 + Real.exp E0 * (P.h ^ 4 / (2 * P.h)) := by
          rw [integral_add hI1 hI2, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul,
            integral_exp_mul_Ioi (by norm_num), integral_exp_mul_Ioi (by linarith),
            neg_div_neg_eq, neg_div_neg_eq, ← hX1, ← hX2]
          ring
  have hC1eq : ∫ y in Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) =
      (∫ y in Ioc (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60) (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y)) +
      ∫ y in Ioi (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) := by
    rw [← Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hy45, setIntegral_union Set.Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same measurableSet_Ioi hfI1 hfI2]
  have hu : P.h ^ 4 / (2 * P.h) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    have := pow_le_of_le_one hh0.le (by linarith : P.h ≤ 1) (by norm_num : (4:ℕ) ≠ 0)
    linarith
  have hlen : rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60) = 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := by rw [e5]; ring
  
  have hbA : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ -(3 / 20) → rfpBmp t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpBmp
    rw [s0 (1 + t / (3 / 20)) (by
      have : t / (3 / 20) ≤ -1 := by rw [div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
      linarith), zero_mul]
  have hbB : ∀ t : ℝ, 3 / 20 ≤ t → rfpBmp t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpBmp
    rw [s0 (1 - t / (3 / 20)) (by
      have : 1 ≤ t / (3 / 20) := by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
      linarith), mul_zero]
  have hbnz : ∀ t, rfpBmp t ≠ 0 → -(3 / 20) < t ∧ t < 3 / 20 := by
    intro t ht
    constructor
    · by_contra hc; push_neg at hc; exact ht (hbA t hc)
    · by_contra hc; push_neg at hc; exact ht (hbB t hc)
  have hb01 : ∀ t, 0 ≤ rfpBmp t ∧ rfpBmp t ≤ 1 := by
    intro t
    unfold rfpBmp
    have h1 := sb (1 + t / (3 / 20))
    have h2 := sb (1 - t / (3 / 20))
    exact ⟨mul_nonneg h1.1 h2.1, (mul_le_mul h1.2 h2.2 h2.1 zero_le_one).trans (by norm_num)⟩
  have hΛw : ∀ y, rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 ≤ y → y ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam →
      rfpLam P y = rfpLam P (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) - (1 / 2 + P.lam) * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) - Real.log 2 := by
    intro y hy1 hy2
    have hL' := hId y (by linarith)
    rw [Sig0 (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (by linarith), Sig0 (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) (by linarith),
      s1 ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) (by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith),
      hlogQ0 y hy2] at hL'
    rw [hL']; ring
  have hshift : ∀ z, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P (z - 2)) * rfpBmp (z - 2 - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3) =
      Real.exp (2 + 4 * P.lam) * (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P z) * rfpBmp (z - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)) := by
    intro z
    have e : z - 2 - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3 = z - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 := by ring
    rw [e]
    by_cases hb : rfpBmp (z - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1) = 0
    · rw [hb]; ring
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hbnz _ hb
      rw [hΛw (z - 2) (by linarith) (by linarith), hΛw z (by linarith) (by linarith), ← mul_assoc,
        ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      congr 1
      ring
  have hKa : 0 ≤ rfpKa P ∧ rfpKa P ≤ 8 := by
    have hN : (∫ y, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3)) =
        Real.exp (2 + 4 * P.lam) * ∫ y, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1) := by
      calc (∫ y, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3))
          = ∫ z, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P (z - 2)) * rfpBmp (z - 2 - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3) :=
            (integral_sub_right_eq_self
              (fun y => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3)) 2).symm
        _ = ∫ z, Real.exp (2 + 4 * P.lam) *
              (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P z) * rfpBmp (z - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)) := by
            congr 1; funext z; exact hshift z
        _ = _ := integral_const_mul _ _
    have hc : Real.exp (2 + 4 * P.lam) ≤ 8 := by
      rw [show (8:ℝ) = Real.exp (Real.log 8) from (Real.exp_log (by norm_num)).symm]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      rw [show (8:ℝ) = 2 ^ 3 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]
      push_cast
      linarith
    unfold rfpKa
    rw [hN]
    rcases eq_or_ne (∫ y, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)) 0 with h0 | h0
    · rw [h0, div_zero]; norm_num
    · rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ h0]; exact ⟨(Real.exp_pos _).le, hc⟩
  have hψ8 : ∀ y, |rfpPsi P y| ≤ 8 := by
    intro y
    unfold rfpPsi
    obtain ⟨a0, a1⟩ := hb01 (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3)
    obtain ⟨c0, c1⟩ := hb01 (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)
    have m1 := mul_le_mul hKa.2 c1 c0 (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 8)
    have m2 := mul_nonneg hKa.1 c0
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  have hψ0 : ∀ y, (y ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 4 ∨ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam < y) → rfpPsi P y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    unfold rfpPsi
    rcases hy with hy | hy
    · rw [hbA _ (by linarith), hbA _ (by linarith)]; ring
    · rw [hbB _ (by linarith), hbB _ (by linarith)]; ring
  have hsub : Ioc (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 4) (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) ⊆ Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60) := by
    intro y hy
    simp only [mem_Ioc, mem_Ioi] at hy ⊢
    linarith [hy.1]
  have hred : ∫ y in Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y =
      ∫ y in Ioc (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 4) (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y := by
    apply setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi hsub
    intro y hy
    have hy2 := hy.2
    simp only [mem_Ioc, not_and_or, not_lt, not_le] at hy2
    have : y ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 4 ∨ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam < y := hy2
    rw [hψ0 y this, mul_zero]
  have hΨ : |∫ y in Ioi (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y| ≤
      16 * Real.exp E0 := by
    rw [hred, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by linarith)]
    have hb := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      (a := rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 4) (b := rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (C := Real.exp E0 / 2 * 8)
      (f := fun y => Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y) (by
        intro y hy
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le (by linarith)] at hy
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
        exact mul_le_mul (hwin y (by linarith [hy.1]) hy.2) (hψ8 y) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity))
    rw [show |rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 4)| = 4 by
      rw [show rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 4) = 4 by ring]; norm_num, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hb
    linarith
  refine ⟨setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Ioi (fun y _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hC1eq, hDE]
    rw [hlen] at hP1
    have key : Real.exp E0 * (Real.exp 2 / 2 + P.h ^ 4 / (2 * P.h)) ≤
        Real.exp E0 * (2 + Real.log (1 / P.lam)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hEp.le
    nlinarith
  · rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm (Real.exp (-26)), hDE]
    linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : ℝ => ∫ y in (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)..(rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y)) ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ (∫ y in (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)..(rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y)) ∧ (∫ y in (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)..(rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y)) ≤ 60 * Real.exp (-26) * Real.exp (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 2 * rfpLam P (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) ∧ |deriv (fun e : ℝ => ∫ y in (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)..(rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60), Real.exp (y + 2 * rfpLam P y) * ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y)) η| ≤ 120 * Real.exp (-26) * Real.exp (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 2 * rfpLam P (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hP
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl1, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hP
  
  have hEP : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (w θ : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous w → Continuous θ →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in a..b, w y * Real.exp (-(θ y * s))) ∧
      ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in a..b, w y * Real.exp (-(θ y * s)))
        (∫ y in a..b, -(θ y) * (w y * Real.exp (-(θ y * s)))) s := by
    intro a b w θ hw hθ
    have hder : ∀ v : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous v → ∀ s₀ : ℝ,
        HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in a..b, v y * Real.exp (-(θ y * s)))
          (∫ y in a..b, -(θ y) * (v y * Real.exp (-(θ y * s₀)))) s₀ := by
      intro v hv s₀
      obtain ⟨Cv, hCv⟩ :=
        (isCompact_uIcc (a := a) (b := b)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hv.continuousOn
      obtain ⟨Cθ, hCθ⟩ :=
        (isCompact_uIcc (a := a) (b := b)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hθ.continuousOn
      have hCv0 : 0 ≤ max Cv 0 := le_max_right _ _
      have hCθ0 : 0 ≤ max Cθ 0 := le_max_right _ _
      have hcontF : ∀ x : ℝ, Continuous (fun t => v t * Real.exp (-(θ t * x))) := by
        intro x; fun_prop

    have h26 : Real.exp 26 = Real.exp 2 ^ 13 := by rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; norm_num

      rw [h26]; linarith [show (3:ℝ) ^ 13 = 1594323 by norm_num]

  set L := Real.log (1 / lam) with hLdef
  have hL : lam * L ≤ 2 * s := by

      rw [hLdef, one_div, one_div, Real.log_inv, Real.log_inv, hs, Real.log_sqrt hlam.le]; ring

  have hp20 : lam ^ 20 ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hlam.le hl1
  have ha1 : |α1| ≤ 1 / 16 := by linarith [abs_nonneg α2, abs_nonneg γ1, abs_nonneg γ2]
  have ha2 : |α2| ≤ 1 / 16 := by linarith [abs_nonneg α1, abs_nonneg γ1, abs_nonneg γ2]
  have hc1 : |γ1| ≤ 1 / 16 := by linarith [abs_nonneg α1, abs_nonneg α2, abs_nonneg γ2]
  have hc2 : |γ2| ≤ 1 / 16 := by linarith [abs_nonneg α1, abs_nonneg α2, abs_nonneg γ1]
  have hsq : ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ≤ 1 / 16 → x ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 256 := fun x hx => by
    have := hmul x x (1/16) (1/16) hx hx

  have hA1 : 0 ≤ α1 ^ 2 * B1 ∧ α1 ^ 2 * B1 ≤ D / 256 :=
    ⟨by positivity, by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hsq α1 ha1) hB10]⟩
  have hA2 : 0 ≤ α2 ^ 2 * B2 ∧ α2 ^ 2 * B2 ≤ D / 256 :=
    ⟨by positivity, by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hsq α2 ha2) hB20]⟩
  have hG1 : 0 ≤ γ1 ^ 2 * B1 ∧ γ1 ^ 2 * B1 ≤ D / 256 :=
    ⟨by positivity, by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hsq γ1 hc1) hB10]⟩
  have hG2 : 0 ≤ γ2 ^ 2 * B2 ∧ γ2 ^ 2 * B2 ≤ D / 256 :=
    ⟨by positivity, by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hsq γ2 hc2) hB20]⟩
  have hX1 : |α1 * γ1 * B1| ≤ 1 / 16 * (1 / 16) * D := by
    refine hmul _ _ _ _ (hmul _ _ _ _ ha1 hc1) ?_
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hB10]; exact hB11
  have hX2 : |α2 * γ2 * B2| ≤ 1 / 16 * (1 / 16) * D := by
    refine hmul _ _ _ _ (hmul _ _ _ _ ha2 hc2) ?_
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hB20]; exact hB21
  
  obtain ⟨q2, hq2⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = lam * (Ip + α1 ^ 2 * B1 + α2 ^ 2 * B2) / D := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = 2 * lam * (α1 * γ1 * B1 + α2 * γ2 * B2) / D := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = lam * (K0 + γ1 ^ 2 * B1 + γ2 ^ 2 * B2) / D := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = lam * W4 / (2 * D) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ, f = fun e => lam * (V e + C1 + g e * Ψ) / D := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ, f = fun e => lam * (deriv V e + deriv g e * Ψ) / D := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hq2a : 47 / 200 ≤ q2 := by
    rw [hq2, le_div_iff₀ hD]; nlinarith [hA1.1, hA2.1]
  have hq2b : q2 ≤ 13 / 50 := by
    rw [hq2, div_le_iff₀ hD]
    nlinarith [mul_le_of_le_one_left hA1.1 hl1, mul_le_of_le_one_left hA2.1 hl1]
  have hκb : |κ| ≤ lam / 64 := by
    rw [hκ, abs_div, abs_of_pos hD, div_le_iff₀ hD, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 2 * lam)]

  have hPb : ∀ e, |P e| ≤ s / 1000 := by
    intro e
    obtain ⟨hV0, hV1, -⟩ := hVb e

      constructor <;> nlinarith

    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hst hlam.le

        Real.exp (-26) * D * (69 * lam + 8 * (lam * L)) := by ring
    have h3 : 69 * lam + 8 * (lam * L) ≤ 85 * s := by linarith
    have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (by positivity : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-26) * D)
    have h5 : Real.exp (-26) * D * (85 * s) ≤ 1 / 10 ^ 6 * D * (85 * s) := by
      gcongr
    nlinarith
  have hQb : ∀ e, |Q e| ≤ s / 1000 := by
    intro e
    obtain ⟨-, -, hV2⟩ := hVb e
    have hg2 : |deriv g e| ≤ 1 := by linarith [hgb e, abs_nonneg (g e)]
    have hgΨ : |deriv g e * Ψ| ≤ 1 * (8 * Real.exp (-26) * D) := hmul _ _ _ _ hg2 hΨ
    have hst : |deriv V e + deriv g e * Ψ| ≤ 128 * Real.exp (-26) * D := by
      have := abs_add_le (deriv V e) (deriv g e * Ψ)
      linarith
    rw [hQ]
    show |lam * (deriv V e + deriv g e * Ψ) / D| ≤ s / 1000
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hD, div_le_iff₀ hD, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hlam]
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hst hlam.le
    have h4 : lam * (128 * Real.exp (-26) * D) ≤ s * (128 * (1 / 10 ^ 6) * D) := by
      gcongr
    nlinarith
  
  have hVd : Differentiable ℝ V := hVs.differentiable (by simp)
  have hgd : Differentiable ℝ g := hgs.differentiable (by simp)
  have hPs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P := by
    rw [hP]
    exact ((contDiff_const.mul ((hVs.add contDiff_const).add (hgs.mul contDiff_const))).div_const D)
  have hPd : ∀ e, HasDerivAt P (Q e) e := by
    intro e
    rw [hP, hQ]
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun e => V e + C1 + g e * Ψ) (deriv V e + deriv g e * Ψ) e :=

    exact (h1.const_mul lam).div_const D
  have hu : ∀ e : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => 1 + e ^ 2) (2 * e) e := by
    intro e
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_pow 2 e).const_add 1
  have hq1d : ∀ η : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => κ * e * (1 + e ^ 2)) (κ * (1 + 3 * η ^ 2)) η := by
    intro η

    all_goals (try funext e)
    all_goals (try simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Pi.pow_apply, id_eq, id])
    all_goals (try push_cast)
    all_goals ring
  have hq0d : ∀ η : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => m * e ^ 2 * (1 + e ^ 2) ^ 2 - c - (1 + e ^ 2) ^ 2 / 2 * P e)

    intro η
    have Ha := (((hasDerivAt_pow 2 η).const_mul m).mul ((hu η).pow 2)).sub_const c
    have Hb := (((hu η).pow 2).div_const 2).mul (hPd η)
    convert Ha.sub Hb using 1
    all_goals (try funext e)
    all_goals (try simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Pi.pow_apply, id_eq, id])
    all_goals (try push_cast)
    all_goals ring
  refine ⟨q2, fun e => κ * e * (1 + e ^ 2),
    fun e => m * e ^ 2 * (1 + e ^ 2) ^ 2 - c - (1 + e ^ 2) ^ 2 / 2 * P e, hq2a, hq2b, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · fun_prop
  · apply ContDiff.contDiffOn
    exact ((contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_id.pow 2)).mul ((contDiff_const.add (contDiff_id.pow 2)).pow 2)
      |>.sub contDiff_const).sub ((((contDiff_const.add (contDiff_id.pow 2)).pow 2).div_const 2).mul hPs)
  · intro η h1 h2
    have hηa : |η| ≤ 2 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hη2 : η ^ 2 ≤ 4 := by nlinarith
    have hu5 : |1 + η ^ 2| ≤ 5 := by rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity)]; linarith
    have hu25 : (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ 25 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg η]
    have hcab := abs_le.mp hcb
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have := hmul _ _ _ _ (hmul _ _ _ _ hκb hηa) hu5

      linarith
    · have t1 : m * η ^ 2 ≤ lam / 100 * 4 := mul_le_mul hm1 hη2 (sq_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      have t2 : m * η ^ 2 * (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ lam / 100 * 4 * 25 :=
        mul_le_mul t1 hu25 (by positivity) (by positivity)
      have t3 : 0 ≤ m * η ^ 2 * (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2 := by positivity
      have hw : |(1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2 / 2| ≤ 25 / 2 := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]; linarith
      have t4 := abs_le.mp (hmul _ _ _ _ hw (hPb η))
      show -(27 / 100) ≤ m * η ^ 2 * (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2 - c - (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2 / 2 * P η ∧
        m * η ^ 2 * (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2 - c - (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2 / 2 * P η ≤ -(47 / 200)
      constructor <;> nlinarith
  · intro η h1 h2
    rw [(hq1d η).deriv, (hq0d η).deriv]
    have hηa : |η| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have hη2 : η ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
    have hu2 : |1 + η ^ 2| ≤ 2 := by rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity)]; linarith
    have hw : |η * (1 + η ^ 2)| ≤ 1 * 2 := hmul _ _ _ _ hηa hu2
    have hv : |1 + 3 * η ^ 2| ≤ 4 := by rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity)]; linarith
    have hu4 : |(1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2 / 2| ≤ 2 := by

    have hmabs : |m| ≤ lam / 100 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hm0]; exact hm1
    have T0 : |κ * (1 + 3 * η ^ 2)| ≤ lam / 64 * 4 := hmul _ _ _ _ hκb hv
    have h2w : |2 * (η * (1 + η ^ 2))| ≤ 2 * (1 * 2) := by
      have := hmul 2 _ 2 _ (by norm_num) hw; exact this
    have T1 : |m * (2 * (η * (1 + η ^ 2)) * (1 + 3 * η ^ 2))| ≤ lam / 100 * (2 * (1 * 2) * 4) :=

    have T2 : |2 * (η * (1 + η ^ 2)) * P η| ≤ 2 * (1 * 2) * (s / 1000) := hmul _ _ _ _ h2w (hPb η)
    have T3 : |(1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2 / 2 * Q η| ≤ 2 * (s / 1000) := hmul _ _ _ _ hu4 (hQb η)
    have S1 := abs_sub (m * (2 * (η * (1 + η ^ 2)) * (1 + 3 * η ^ 2)))
      (2 * (η * (1 + η ^ 2)) * P η + (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2 / 2 * Q η)
    have S2 := abs_add_le (2 * (η * (1 + η ^ 2)) * P η) ((1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2 / 2 * Q η)
    linarith
  · intro A η
    have hu0 : (1 + η ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    show D * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 / lam * (q2 * A ^ 2 + κ * η * (1 + η ^ 2) * A +

    rw [hq2, hκ, hm, hc, hP]

    ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (q2 lam : ℝ) (q1 q0 : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < lam → lam ≤ 1 / 100 → 47 / 200 ≤ q2 → q2 ≤ 13 / 50 → ContDiff ℝ ∞ q1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q0 (Ioo (-2) 2) → (∀ η : ℝ, -2 < η → η < 2 → |q1 η| ≤ lam ∧ -(27 / 100) ≤ q0 η ∧ q0 η ≤ -(47 / 200)) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |deriv q1 η| + |deriv q0 η| ≤ Real.sqrt lam / 3) → ∃ Amp : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Amp (Ioo (-2) 2) ∧ (∀ η : ℝ, -2 < η → η < 2 → q2 * Amp η ^ 2 + q1 η * Amp η + q0 η = 0) ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → 9 / 10 ≤ Amp η ∧ Amp η ≤ 6 / 5 ∧ |deriv Amp η| ≤ Real.sqrt lam

signature.statement: ∀ (q2 lam : ℝ) (q1 q0 : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < lam → lam ≤ 1 / 100 → 47 / 200 ≤ q2 → q2 ≤ 13 / 50 → ContDiff ℝ ∞ q1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q0 (Ioo (-2) 2) → (∀ η : ℝ, -2 < η → η < 2 → |q1 η| ≤ lam ∧ -(27 / 100) ≤ q0 η ∧ q0 η ≤ -(47 / 200)) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |deriv q1 η| + |deriv q0 η| ≤ Real.sqrt lam / 3) → ∃ Amp : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Amp (Ioo (-2) 2) ∧ (∀ η : ℝ, -2 < η → η < 2 → q2 * Amp η ^ 2 + q1 η * Amp η + q0 η = 0) ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → 9 / 10 ≤ Amp η ∧ Amp η ≤ 6 / 5 ∧ |deriv Amp η| ≤ Real.sqrt lam

proof.tactics:
by
  intro q2 lam q1 q0 hlam0 hlam1 hq2a hq2b hq1s hq0s hb hd
  have hq2pos : 0 < q2 := by linarith
  
  have scal : ∀ a c : ℝ, |a| ≤ lam → -(27 / 100) ≤ c → c ≤ -(47 / 200) →
      0 < a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c ∧ 2 / 5 ≤ Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c) ∧
      9 / 10 ≤ (Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c) - a) / (2 * q2) ∧
      (Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c) - a) / (2 * q2) ≤ 6 / 5 := by
    intro a c ha hc1 hc2
    obtain ⟨ha1, ha2⟩ := abs_le.mp ha
    have hD : 0 < a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg a, mul_pos hq2pos (show 0 < -c by linarith)]
    have hlow : 9 / 5 * q2 + a ≤ Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c) := by
      have hsq : (9 / 5 * q2 + a) ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hq2pos.le (show 0 ≤ 13 / 50 - q2 by linarith),
          mul_nonneg hq2pos.le (show 0 ≤ 1 / 100 - a by linarith),
          mul_nonneg hq2pos.le (show 0 ≤ -(47 / 200) - c by linarith)]
      calc 9 / 5 * q2 + a = Real.sqrt ((9 / 5 * q2 + a) ^ 2) :=
            (Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)).symm
        _ ≤ Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq
    have hup : Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c) ≤ 12 / 5 * q2 + a := by
      have hsq : a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c ≤ (12 / 5 * q2 + a) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hq2pos.le (show 0 ≤ q2 - 47 / 200 by linarith),
          mul_nonneg hq2pos.le (show 0 ≤ a + 1 / 100 by linarith),
          mul_nonneg hq2pos.le (show 0 ≤ c + 27 / 100 by linarith)]
      calc Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * c) ≤ Real.sqrt ((12 / 5 * q2 + a) ^ 2) :=
            Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq
        _ = 12 / 5 * q2 + a := Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)
    refine ⟨hD, by linarith, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]; linarith
    · rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]; linarith
  
  have dscal : ∀ a s d1 d0 : ℝ, 2 / 5 ≤ s → 0 ≤ (s - a) / (2 * q2) →
      (s - a) / (2 * q2) ≤ 6 / 5 → |d1| + |d0| ≤ Real.sqrt lam / 3 →
      |((2 * a * d1 - 4 * q2 * d0) / (2 * s) - d1) / (2 * q2)| ≤ Real.sqrt lam := by
    intro a s d1 d0 hs hA0 hA1 hdd
    have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith
    have hsne : s ≠ 0 := hs0.ne'
    have hq2ne : q2 ≠ 0 := hq2pos.ne'
    have key : ((2 * a * d1 - 4 * q2 * d0) / (2 * s) - d1) / (2 * q2) * s =
        -(d1 * ((s - a) / (2 * q2)) + d0) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    set X := ((2 * a * d1 - 4 * q2 * d0) / (2 * s) - d1) / (2 * q2) with hX
    set A := (s - a) / (2 * q2) with hA
    have habs : |X| * s = |d1 * A + d0| := by
      rw [← abs_of_pos hs0, ← abs_mul, key, abs_neg]
    have htri : |d1 * A + d0| ≤ |d1| * A + |d0| := by
      have := abs_add_le (d1 * A) d0
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hA0] at this
      exact this
    have h1 : |X| * s ≤ 2 / 5 * Real.sqrt lam := by
      rw [habs]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg d1) (sub_nonneg.2 hA1), abs_nonneg d0]
    have h2 : |X| * (2 / 5) ≤ |X| * s := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (abs_nonneg X)
    linarith
  refine ⟨fun η => (Real.sqrt (q1 η ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 η) - q1 η) / (2 * q2), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hDs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => q1 η ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 η) (Ioo (-2) 2) :=
      (hq1s.contDiffOn.pow 2).sub (contDiffOn_const.mul hq0s)
    have hDne : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (-2 : ℝ) 2, q1 x ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 x ≠ 0 := fun x hx =>
      (scal _ _ (hb x hx.1 hx.2).1 (hb x hx.1 hx.2).2.1 (hb x hx.1 hx.2).2.2).1.ne'
    exact ((hDs.sqrt hDne).sub hq1s.contDiffOn).div_const _
  · intro η h1 h2
    obtain ⟨hD, -, -, -⟩ := scal _ _ (hb η h1 h2).1 (hb η h1 h2).2.1 (hb η h1 h2).2.2
    have hs2 := Real.sq_sqrt hD.le
    have hq2ne : q2 ≠ 0 := hq2pos.ne'
    have e : q2 * ((Real.sqrt (q1 η ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 η) - q1 η) / (2 * q2)) ^ 2 +
        q1 η * ((Real.sqrt (q1 η ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 η) - q1 η) / (2 * q2)) + q0 η =
        (Real.sqrt (q1 η ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 η) ^ 2 - (q1 η ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 η)) / (4 * q2) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    show q2 * ((Real.sqrt (q1 η ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 η) - q1 η) / (2 * q2)) ^ 2 +
        q1 η * ((Real.sqrt (q1 η ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 η) - q1 η) / (2 * q2)) + q0 η = 0
    rw [e, hs2, sub_self, zero_div]
  · intro η h1 h2
    have hη1 : -2 < η := by linarith
    have hη2 : η < 2 := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hDp, hs, hA1, hA2⟩ :=
      scal _ _ (hb η hη1 hη2).1 (hb η hη1 hη2).2.1 (hb η hη1 hη2).2.2
    refine ⟨hA1, hA2, ?_⟩
    have hmem : Ioo (-2 : ℝ) 2 ∈ nhds η := Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2
    have hd0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ q0 η := (hq0s.contDiffAt hmem).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hd1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ q1 η := hq1s.differentiable (by simp) η
    have hD' : HasDerivAt (fun x => q1 x ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 x)
        (2 * q1 η * deriv q1 η - 4 * q2 * deriv q0 η) η := by
      have := (hd1.hasDerivAt.mul hd1.hasDerivAt).sub (hd0.hasDerivAt.const_mul (4 * q2))
      rw [show (fun x => q1 x ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 x) = fun x => q1 x * q1 x - 4 * q2 * q0 x from
        funext fun x => by ring]
      convert this using 1
      ring
    have hA' : HasDerivAt (fun η => (Real.sqrt (q1 η ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 η) - q1 η) / (2 * q2))
        (((2 * q1 η * deriv q1 η - 4 * q2 * deriv q0 η) /
          (2 * Real.sqrt (q1 η ^ 2 - 4 * q2 * q0 η)) - deriv q1 η) / (2 * q2)) η :=

subgoal_signatures.name: rfp_inner_Q_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ Md Pst lam h : ℝ, 0 < Md → 0 < Pst → 0 < lam → lam ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < h → h ≤ Real.exp (-rfpY2 Md) / 1000 → ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → (X ≤ 1 → 1 ≤ rinQf h (rinC Md Pst lam) (rfpK Md) X η) ∧ (1 ≤ X → X ≤ Real.exp 1 → 1 / 5 ≤ rinQf h (rinC Md Pst lam) (rfpK Md) X η) ∧ (Real.exp 1 ≤ X → X ≤ Real.exp (rfpY2 Md) → (Real.exp 1 / X + η ^ 2) / 20 ≤ rinQf h (rinC Md Pst lam) (rfpK Md) X η) ∧ (Real.exp (rfpY2 Md) ≤ X → X ≤ Real.exp (rfpY2 Md + 2) → Real.exp (-rfpY2 Md) / 250 ≤ rinQf h (rinC Md Pst lam) (rfpK Md) X η)

subgoal_signatures.name: rin_g_profile
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ Md Pst lam : ℝ, 0 < Md → 0 < Pst → 0 ≤ lam → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 1 → Real.sqrt (2 * x) * rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x) = Real.sqrt 2 * Pst * x ^ (3 / 5 : ℝ)) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (2 * x) * rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x)) (Set.Ici 0) ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * x) * rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x)) ∧ (∀ x X : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ X → X ≤ Real.exp (rfpY2 Md) → Real.sqrt (2 * x) * rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x) ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * X) * rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log X)) ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, Real.exp 1 ≤ x → x ≤ Real.exp (rfpY2 Md) → Real.sqrt (2 * x) * rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x) = Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp 1) * rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log (Real.exp 1))) ∧ (∀ x X : ℝ, Real.exp 1 ≤ x → x ≤ X → Real.sqrt (2 * X) * rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log X) ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * x) * rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x))

subgoal_signatures.name: rin_k_profile
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ Md : ℝ, 0 < Md → ContinuousOn (fun x => rfpK Md (Real.log x)) (Set.Ici 0) ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ Real.exp 1 → rfpK Md (Real.log x) = 4) ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpK Md (Real.log x) ∧ rfpK Md (Real.log x) ≤ 4) ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, Real.exp (Real.exp Md) ≤ x → rfpK Md (Real.log x) = 0) ∧ 0 ≤ rinMom (fun x => rfpK Md (Real.log x)) (Real.exp (rfpY2 Md)) ∧ rinMom (fun x => rfpK Md (Real.log x)) (Real.exp (rfpY2 Md)) ≤ Real.exp (rfpY2 Md)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h X η gX Ik IG IJk M0 M1 M2 J0 J1 J2 a da b1 db1 b2 db2 : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < X → 0 < gX → profRadAvg U X η = X⁻¹ * (η * Ik + (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (a * M0 + b1 * M1 + b2 * M2)) → profEtaD (profRadAvg U) X η = X⁻¹ * (Ik + -(2 * η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) * (a * M0 + b1 * M1 + b2 * M2) + (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (da * M0 + db1 * M1 + db2 * M2)) → profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) X η = (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * IG → profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) X η = -(2 * η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) * IG → profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) X η = η * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * IJk + ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * (a * J0 + b1 * J1 + b2 * J2) → profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))) X η = ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ - 2 * η ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) * IJk + -(4 * η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 3) * (a * J0 + b1 * J1 + b2 * J2) + ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * (da * J0 + db1 * J1 + db2 * J2) → 2 * X * F X η = (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * gX) → leadQs h F U X η = -1 + (1 - h + (1 - 2 * h) * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2)) * (IG / (X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * gX))) + (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * (Ik / X) - ((1 - η ^ 2) ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2) + (1 - 4 * h) * η ^ 2) * (IJk / (X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * gX))) + 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (a * (M0 / X) + b1 * (M1 / X) + b2 * (M2 / X)) + (1 - η ^ 2) * (-(2 * η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) * (a * (M0 / X) + b1 * (M1 / X) + b2 * (M2 / X)) + (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (da * (M0 / X) + db1 * (M1 / X) + db2 * (M2 / X))) - (1 - η ^ 2) * (-(4 * η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) * (a * (J0 / (X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * gX))) + b1 * (J1 / (X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * gX))) + b2 * (J2 / (X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * gX)))) + (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (da * (J0 / (X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * gX))) + db1 * (J1 / (X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * gX))) + db2 * (J2 / (X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * gX))))) + (4 * h - 1) * η * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (a * (J0 / (X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * gX))) + b1 * (J1 / (X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * gX))) + b2 * (J2 / (X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * gX))))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h X η gX Ik IG IJk M0 M1 M2 J0 J1 J2 a da b1 db1 b2 db2 F U hX hg H1 H2 H3 H4 H5 H6 H7
  unfold leadQs leadW
  rw [H2, H1, H4, H3, H6, H5, H7]
  have hX0 : X ≠ 0 := hX.ne'
  have hg0 : gX ≠ 0 := hg.ne'
  have hS0 : Real.sqrt (2 * X) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)).ne'

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (X η B : ℝ) (κ g φ0 φ1 φ2 A c1 c2 : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < X → Measurable κ → Measurable g → Measurable φ0 → Measurable φ1 → Measurable φ2 → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ X → |κ s| ≤ B ∧ |g s| ≤ B ∧ |φ0 s| ≤ B ∧ |φ1 s| ≤ B ∧ |φ2 s| ≤ B) → DifferentiableAt ℝ A η → DifferentiableAt ℝ c1 η → DifferentiableAt ℝ c2 η → (∀ s e : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ X → U s e = e * κ s + (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * g s * (A e * φ0 s + c1 e * φ1 s + c2 e * φ2 s) ∧ 2 * s * F s e = (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s)) → ∃ Ik IG IJk M0 M1 M2 J0 J1 J2 : ℝ, Ik = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, κ s) ∧ IG = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s) ∧ IJk = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s * κ s) ∧ M0 = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, g s * φ0 s) ∧ M1 = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, g s * φ1 s) ∧ M2 = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, g s * φ2 s) ∧ J0 = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s ^ 2 * φ0 s) ∧ J1 = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s ^ 2 * φ1 s) ∧ J2 = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s ^ 2 * φ2 s) ∧ profRadAvg U X η = X⁻¹ * (η * Ik + (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (A η * M0 + c1 η * M1 + c2 η * M2)) ∧ profEtaD (profRadAvg U) X η = X⁻¹ * (Ik + -(2 * η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) * (A η * M0 + c1 η * M1 + c2 η * M2) + (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (deriv A η * M0 + deriv c1 η * M1 + deriv c2 η * M2)) ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) X η = (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * IG ∧ profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) X η = -(2 * η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) * IG ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) X η = η * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * IJk + ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * (A η * J0 + c1 η * J1 + c2 η * J2) ∧ profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))) X η = ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ - 2 * η ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) * IJk + -(4 * η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 3) * (A η * J0 + c1 η * J1 + c2 η * J2) + ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * (deriv A η * J0 + deriv c1 η * J1 + deriv c2 η * J2) ∧ 2 * X * F X η = (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * g X)

signature.name: pqc_moment_values
signature.statement: ∀ (X η B : ℝ) (κ g φ0 φ1 φ2 A c1 c2 : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < X → Measurable κ → Measurable g → Measurable φ0 → Measurable φ1 → Measurable φ2 → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ X → |κ s| ≤ B ∧ |g s| ≤ B ∧ |φ0 s| ≤ B ∧ |φ1 s| ≤ B ∧ |φ2 s| ≤ B) → DifferentiableAt ℝ A η → DifferentiableAt ℝ c1 η → DifferentiableAt ℝ c2 η → (∀ s e : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ X → U s e = e * κ s + (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * g s * (A e * φ0 s + c1 e * φ1 s + c2 e * φ2 s) ∧ 2 * s * F s e = (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s)) → ∃ Ik IG IJk M0 M1 M2 J0 J1 J2 : ℝ, Ik = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, κ s) ∧ IG = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s) ∧ IJk = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s * κ s) ∧ M0 = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, g s * φ0 s) ∧ M1 = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, g s * φ1 s) ∧ M2 = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, g s * φ2 s) ∧ J0 = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s ^ 2 * φ0 s) ∧ J1 = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s ^ 2 * φ1 s) ∧ J2 = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s ^ 2 * φ2 s) ∧ profRadAvg U X η = X⁻¹ * (η * Ik + (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (A η * M0 + c1 η * M1 + c2 η * M2)) ∧ profEtaD (profRadAvg U) X η = X⁻¹ * (Ik + -(2 * η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) * (A η * M0 + c1 η * M1 + c2 η * M2) + (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (deriv A η * M0 + deriv c1 η * M1 + deriv c2 η * M2)) ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) X η = (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * IG ∧ profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) X η = -(2 * η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) * IG ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) X η = η * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * IJk + ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * (A η * J0 + c1 η * J1 + c2 η * J2) ∧ profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))) X η = ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ - 2 * η ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) * IJk + -(4 * η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 3) * (A η * J0 + c1 η * J1 + c2 η * J2) + ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * (deriv A η * J0 + deriv c1 η * J1 + deriv c2 η * J2) ∧ 2 * X * F X η = (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * g X)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro X η B κ g φ0 φ1 φ2 A c1 c2 F U hX hκ hg hφ0 hφ1 hφ2 hb hA hc1 hc2 hrep
  
  have hII : ∀ (h : ℝ → ℝ) (M : ℝ), Measurable h → (∀ s, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ X → |h s| ≤ M) →
      IntervalIntegrable h volume 0 X := by
    intro h M hm hbd
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hX.le]
    refine Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded (M := M) measure_Ioc_lt_top.ne hm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioc ?_
    intro s hs
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hbd s hs.1.le hs.2
  have hsq_m : Measurable (fun s : ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * s)) := (measurable_const.mul measurable_id).sqrt
  have hsq_b : ∀ s, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ X → |Real.sqrt (2 * s)| ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * X) := by
    intro s _ hs
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hmulb : ∀ a b Ma Mb : ℝ, |a| ≤ Ma → |b| ≤ Mb → |a * b| ≤ Ma * Mb := by
    intro a b Ma Mb ha hb'
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul ha hb' (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans ha)
  have iκ : IntervalIntegrable κ volume 0 X := hII κ B hκ (fun s h0 h1 => (hb s h0 h1).1)
  have igφ : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, Measurable φ → (∀ s, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ X → |φ s| ≤ B) →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun s => g s * φ s) volume 0 X :=
    fun φ hφ hφb => hII _ (B * B) (hg.mul hφ)
      (fun s h0 h1 => hmulb _ _ _ _ (hb s h0 h1).2.1 (hφb s h0 h1))
  have iJ : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, Measurable φ → (∀ s, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ X → |φ s| ≤ B) →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun s => Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s ^ 2 * φ s) volume 0 X :=
    fun φ hφ hφb => hII _ (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * B ^ 2 * B) ((hsq_m.mul (hg.pow_const 2)).mul hφ)
      (fun s h0 h1 => hmulb _ _ _ _ (hmulb _ _ _ _ (hsq_b s h0 h1)
        (by rw [abs_pow]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hb s h0 h1).2.1 2)) (hφb s h0 h1))
  have iGk : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s * κ s) volume 0 X :=
    hII _ (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * B * B) ((hsq_m.mul hg).mul hκ)
      (fun s h0 h1 => hmulb _ _ _ _ (hmulb _ _ _ _ (hsq_b s h0 h1) (hb s h0 h1).2.1) (hb s h0 h1).1)
  have i0 := igφ φ0 hφ0 (fun s h0 h1 => (hb s h0 h1).2.2.1)
  have i1 := igφ φ1 hφ1 (fun s h0 h1 => (hb s h0 h1).2.2.2.1)
  have i2 := igφ φ2 hφ2 (fun s h0 h1 => (hb s h0 h1).2.2.2.2)
  have j0 := iJ φ0 hφ0 (fun s h0 h1 => (hb s h0 h1).2.2.1)
  have j1 := iJ φ1 hφ1 (fun s h0 h1 => (hb s h0 h1).2.2.2.1)
  have j2 := iJ φ2 hφ2 (fun s h0 h1 => (hb s h0 h1).2.2.2.2)
  
  have lin4 : ∀ (f1 f2 f3 f4 : ℝ → ℝ) (a1 a2 a3 a4 : ℝ), IntervalIntegrable f1 volume 0 X →
      IntervalIntegrable f2 volume 0 X → IntervalIntegrable f3 volume 0 X →
      IntervalIntegrable f4 volume 0 X →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, (a1 * f1 x + a2 * f2 x + a3 * f3 x + a4 * f4 x)) =
        a1 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, f1 x) + a2 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, f2 x) +
          a3 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, f3 x) + a4 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, f4 x) := by
    intro f1 f2 f3 f4 a1 a2 a3 a4 h1 h2 h3 h4
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (((h1.const_mul a1).add (h2.const_mul a2)).add (h3.const_mul a3))
        (h4.const_mul a4),
      intervalIntegral.integral_add ((h1.const_mul a1).add (h2.const_mul a2)) (h3.const_mul a3),
      intervalIntegral.integral_add (h1.const_mul a1) (h2.const_mul a2),
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  obtain ⟨Ik, hIk⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, κ s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨IG, hIG⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨IJk, hIJk⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s * κ s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨M0, hM0⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, g s * φ0 s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨M1, hM1⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, g s * φ1 s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨M2, hM2⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, g s * φ2 s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨J0, hJ0⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s ^ 2 * φ0 s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨J1, hJ1⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s ^ 2 * φ1 s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨J2, hJ2⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s ^ 2 * φ2 s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have S1 : ∀ t : ℝ, profRadAvg U X t =
      X⁻¹ * (t * Ik + (1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹ * (A t * M0 + c1 t * M1 + c2 t * M2)) := by
    intro t
    unfold profRadAvg
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right (fun x => U x t) hX.ne']
    simp only [zero_mul, one_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hc : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, U x t) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, (t * κ x + ((1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹ * A t) * (g x * φ0 x)
        + ((1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹ * c1 t) * (g x * φ1 x) + ((1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹ * c2 t) * (g x * φ2 x)) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x hx
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hX.le] at hx
      dsimp only
      rw [(hrep x t hx.1 hx.2).1]
      ring
    rw [hc, lin4 κ (fun x => g x * φ0 x) (fun x => g x * φ1 x) (fun x => g x * φ2 x) _ _ _ _ iκ i0 i1 i2,
      hIk, hM0, hM1, hM2]
    ring
  have S2 : ∀ t : ℝ, profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) X t = (1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹ * IG := by
    intro t
    simp only [profRadInt]
    have hc : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, 2 * x * F x t) =
        ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, (1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * g x) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x hx
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hX.le] at hx
      dsimp only
      rw [(hrep x t hx.1 hx.2).2]
    rw [hc, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hIG]
  have S3 : ∀ t : ℝ, profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) X t =
      t * (1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹ * IJk + ((1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * (A t * J0 + c1 t * J1 + c2 t * J2) := by
    intro t
    simp only [profRadInt]
    have hc : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, U x t * (2 * x * F x t)) =
        ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, ((t * (1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹) * (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * g x * κ x)
          + (((1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * A t) * (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * g x ^ 2 * φ0 x)
          + (((1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * c1 t) * (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * g x ^ 2 * φ1 x)
          + (((1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * c2 t) * (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * g x ^ 2 * φ2 x)) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x hx
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hX.le] at hx
      dsimp only
      rw [(hrep x t hx.1 hx.2).1, (hrep x t hx.1 hx.2).2]
      ring
    rw [hc, lin4 (fun x => Real.sqrt (2 * x) * g x * κ x) (fun x => Real.sqrt (2 * x) * g x ^ 2 * φ0 x)
      (fun x => Real.sqrt (2 * x) * g x ^ 2 * φ1 x) (fun x => Real.sqrt (2 * x) * g x ^ 2 * φ2 x)
      _ _ _ _ iGk j0 j1 j2, hIJk, hJ0, hJ1, hJ2]
    ring
  
  have hq : (1 + η ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hf : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) (-(2 * η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2)) η := by
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => 1 + e ^ 2) (2 * η) η := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_pow 2 η).const_add 1
    convert h1.fun_inv hq using 1
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
    ring
  have hSM : HasDerivAt (fun e => A e * M0 + c1 e * M1 + c2 e * M2)
      (deriv A η * M0 + deriv c1 η * M1 + deriv c2 η * M2) η :=
    ((hA.hasDerivAt.mul_const M0).add (hc1.hasDerivAt.mul_const M1)).add (hc2.hasDerivAt.mul_const M2)
  have hSJ : HasDerivAt (fun e => A e * J0 + c1 e * J1 + c2 e * J2)
      (deriv A η * J0 + deriv c1 η * J1 + deriv c2 η * J2) η :=
    ((hA.hasDerivAt.mul_const J0).add (hc1.hasDerivAt.mul_const J1)).add (hc2.hasDerivAt.mul_const J2)
  have D1 : HasDerivAt (fun e => X⁻¹ * (e * Ik + (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * (A e * M0 + c1 e * M1 + c2 e * M2)))
      (X⁻¹ * (1 * Ik + (-(2 * η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) * (A η * M0 + c1 η * M1 + c2 η * M2)
        + (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (deriv A η * M0 + deriv c1 η * M1 + deriv c2 η * M2)))) η :=
    (((hasDerivAt_id' η).mul_const Ik).add (hf.mul hSM)).const_mul X⁻¹
  have D2 : HasDerivAt (fun e => (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * IG) (-(2 * η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) * IG) η :=
    hf.mul_const IG
  have D3 : HasDerivAt (fun e => e * (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * IJk
        + (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * (A e * J0 + c1 e * J1 + c2 e * J2))
      ((1 * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ + η * (-(2 * η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2))) * IJk
        + ((-(2 * η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹
          + (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (-(2 * η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2))) * (A η * J0 + c1 η * J1 + c2 η * J2)
          + (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (deriv A η * J0 + deriv c1 η * J1 + deriv c2 η * J2))) η :=
    (((hasDerivAt_id' η).mul hf).mul_const IJk).add ((hf.mul hf).mul hSJ)
  refine ⟨Ik, IG, IJk, M0, M1, M2, J0, J1, J2, hIk, hIG, hIJk, hM0, hM1, hM2, hJ0, hJ1, hJ2,
    S1 η, ?_, S2 η, ?_, S3 η, ?_, (hrep X η hX.le le_rfl).2⟩
  · have hfun : profRadAvg U X = fun e =>
        X⁻¹ * (e * Ik + (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * (A e * M0 + c1 e * M1 + c2 e * M2)) := funext S1
    unfold profEtaD
    rw [hfun, D1.deriv]
    ring
  · have hfun : profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) X = fun e => (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * IG := funext S2
    unfold profEtaD
    rw [hfun, D2.deriv]
  · have hfun : profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) X = fun e =>
        e * (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * IJk
          + (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * (A e * J0 + c1 e * J1 + c2 e * J2) := by
      funext e
      rw [S3 e]
      ring
    unfold profEtaD
    rw [hfun, D3.deriv]
    ring

by
  intro lam h η A dA a1 da1 a2 da2 r k jk m0 m1 m2 j0 j1 j2 δ hl0 hl1 hh0 hh1 he0 he1 hA hdA
    ha1 hda1 ha2 hda2 hδ hr hk hjk hm0 hm1 hm2 hj0 hj1 hj2
  have hlne : (1 - lam) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    linarith
  have hpos : (0:ℝ) < 1 + η ^ 2 := by positivity
  have he2 : η ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have he2' : 0 ≤ η ^ 2 := sq_nonneg η
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ (1 - 2 * h) * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2) :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) he2') hpos.le
  have hq1 : (1 - 2 * h) * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2) ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hpos).mpr (by nlinarith)
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ (1 - η ^ 2) ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2) := by positivity
  have hp1 : (1 - η ^ 2) ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2) ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hpos).mpr (by nlinarith)
  have hw0 : 0 < (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hpos
  have hw1 : (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (by linarith)
  have key : ∀ Q : ℝ, -1 + (1 - h + Q) * r - (lam - h + Q) / (1 - lam)
      = (1 - h + Q) * (r - 1 / (1 - lam)) := by
    intro Q
    field_simp
    ring
  have hE := key ((1 - 2 * h) * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2))
  have mul3 : ∀ x y a b : ℝ, |x| ≤ a → |y| ≤ b → 0 ≤ a → |x * y| ≤ a * b :=
    fun x y a b hx hy ha => by
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul hx hy (abs_nonneg _) ha
  have hη : |η| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨he0, he1⟩
  have hw : |(1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, hw1⟩
  have hw2 : |((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩
  have h1e : |1 - η ^ 2| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hc1 : |1 - h + (1 - 2 * h) * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2)| ≤ 2 :=
    abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hc2 : |1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩
  have hc3 : |(1 - η ^ 2) ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2) + (1 - 4 * h) * η ^ 2| ≤ 2 :=
    abs_le.mpr ⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩
  have hc4 : |2 * (1 / 2 - h)| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hc7 : |4 * h - 1| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hηw : |η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2| ≤ 1 * 1 := mul3 _ _ _ _ hη hw2 (by norm_num)
  have hηw' := abs_le.mp hηw
  have hc5 : |-(2 * η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2)| ≤ 2 := by
    rw [abs_neg, mul_assoc, abs_mul]
    have : |(2:ℝ)| = 2 := by norm_num
    rw [this]
    linarith [abs_nonneg (η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2)]
  have hc6 : |-(4 * η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2)| ≤ 4 := by
    rw [abs_neg, mul_assoc, abs_mul]
    have : |(4:ℝ)| = 4 := by norm_num
    rw [this]
    linarith [abs_nonneg (η * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2)]
  have hSm : |A * m0 + a1 * m1 + a2 * m2| ≤ 6 / 5 * δ + 1 * δ + 1 * δ :=
    (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add ((abs_add_le _ _).trans
      (add_le_add (mul3 _ _ _ _ hA hm0 (by norm_num)) (mul3 _ _ _ _ ha1 hm1 (by norm_num))))
      (mul3 _ _ _ _ ha2 hm2 (by norm_num)))
  have hSmp : |dA * m0 + da1 * m1 + da2 * m2| ≤ 1 * δ + 1 * δ + 1 * δ :=
    (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add ((abs_add_le _ _).trans
      (add_le_add (mul3 _ _ _ _ hdA hm0 (by norm_num)) (mul3 _ _ _ _ hda1 hm1 (by norm_num))))
      (mul3 _ _ _ _ hda2 hm2 (by norm_num)))
  have hSj : |A * j0 + a1 * j1 + a2 * j2| ≤ 6 / 5 * δ + 1 * δ + 1 * δ :=
    (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add ((abs_add_le _ _).trans
      (add_le_add (mul3 _ _ _ _ hA hj0 (by norm_num)) (mul3 _ _ _ _ ha1 hj1 (by norm_num))))
      (mul3 _ _ _ _ ha2 hj2 (by norm_num)))
  have hSjp : |dA * j0 + da1 * j1 + da2 * j2| ≤ 1 * δ + 1 * δ + 1 * δ :=
    (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add ((abs_add_le _ _).trans
      (add_le_add (mul3 _ _ _ _ hdA hj0 (by norm_num)) (mul3 _ _ _ _ hda1 hj1 (by norm_num))))
      (mul3 _ _ _ _ hda2 hj2 (by norm_num)))
  have T1 := abs_le.mp (mul3 _ _ _ _ hc1 hr (by norm_num))
  have T2 := abs_le.mp (mul3 _ _ _ _ hc2 hk (by norm_num))
  have T3 := abs_le.mp (mul3 _ _ _ _ hc3 hjk (by norm_num))
  have T4 := abs_le.mp (mul3 _ _ _ _ (mul3 _ _ _ _ (mul3 _ _ _ _ hc4 hη (by norm_num)) hw
    (by norm_num)) hSm (by norm_num))
  have T5 := abs_le.mp (mul3 _ _ _ _ h1e ((abs_add_le _ _).trans
    (add_le_add (mul3 _ _ _ _ hc5 hSm (by norm_num)) (mul3 _ _ _ _ hw hSmp (by norm_num))))
    (by norm_num))
  have T6 := abs_le.mp (mul3 _ _ _ _ h1e ((abs_add_le _ _).trans
    (add_le_add (mul3 _ _ _ _ hc6 hSj (by norm_num)) (mul3 _ _ _ _ hw hSjp (by norm_num))))
    (by norm_num))
  have T7 := abs_le.mp (mul3 _ _ _ _ (mul3 _ _ _ _ (mul3 _ _ _ _ hc7 hη (by norm_num)) hw
    (by norm_num)) hSj (by norm_num))
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [T1.1, T2.2, T3.2, T4.1, T5.1, T6.2, T7.1]
  · linarith [T1.2, T2.1, T3.1, T4.2, T5.2, T6.1, T7.2]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (lam x0 X Cs P1 : ℝ) (g κ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < lam → lam ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < x0 → x0 ≤ X → 0 < Cs → Measurable g → Measurable κ → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ X → 0 ≤ g s ∧ g s ≤ P1) → (∀ s : ℝ, x0 ≤ s → s ≤ X → g s = Cs * s ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam))) → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ X → 0 ≤ κ s ∧ κ s ≤ 4) → (∀ s : ℝ, x0 ≤ s → s ≤ X → κ s = 0) → |(∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s) / (X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * g X)) - 1 / (1 - lam)| ≤ (2 + (P1 * x0 ^ (1 / 2 + lam) / Cs)) * Real.sqrt (x0 / X) ∧ |(∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, κ s) / X| ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt (x0 / X) ∧ |(∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s * κ s) / (X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * g X))| ≤ 4 * (P1 * x0 ^ (1 / 2 + lam) / Cs) * Real.sqrt (x0 / X)

signature.name: pqc_scalar_base
signature.statement: ∀ (lam x0 X Cs P1 : ℝ) (g κ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < lam → lam ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < x0 → x0 ≤ X → 0 < Cs → Measurable g → Measurable κ → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ X → 0 ≤ g s ∧ g s ≤ P1) → (∀ s : ℝ, x0 ≤ s → s ≤ X → g s = Cs * s ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam))) → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ X → 0 ≤ κ s ∧ κ s ≤ 4) → (∀ s : ℝ, x0 ≤ s → s ≤ X → κ s = 0) → |(∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s) / (X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * g X)) - 1 / (1 - lam)| ≤ (2 + (P1 * x0 ^ (1 / 2 + lam) / Cs)) * Real.sqrt (x0 / X) ∧ |(∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, κ s) / X| ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt (x0 / X) ∧ |(∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s * κ s) / (X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * g X))| ≤ 4 * (P1 * x0 ^ (1 / 2 + lam) / Cs) * Real.sqrt (x0 / X)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro lam x0 X Cs P1 g κ hl0 hl1 hx0 hx0X hCs hgm hκm hg hpow hk hk0
  have hX : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hx0 hx0X
  have hP1 : 0 ≤ P1 := le_trans (hg 0 le_rfl hX.le).1 (hg 0 le_rfl hX.le).2
  
  have split : ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (B M : ℝ), Measurable φ → (∀ s, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ X → |φ s| ≤ B) →
      (∀ s, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ x0 → |φ s| ≤ M) →
      (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, φ s) = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..x0, φ s) + (∫ s in x0..X, φ s) ∧
      |∫ s in (0:ℝ)..x0, φ s| ≤ M * x0 := by
    intro φ B M hφ hB hM
    have hint : IntervalIntegrable φ volume 0 X := by
      rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hX.le]
      refine Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded (M := B) ?_ hφ.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      · rw [Real.volume_Ioc]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
      · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioc ?_
        intro s hs
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hB s hs.1.le hs.2
    have h1 : IntervalIntegrable φ volume 0 x0 := hint.mono_set (by
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hx0.le, Set.uIcc_of_le hX.le]; exact Set.Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hx0X)
    have h2 : IntervalIntegrable φ volume x0 X := hint.mono_set (by
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hx0X, Set.uIcc_of_le hX.le]; exact Set.Icc_subset_Icc hx0.le le_rfl)
    refine ⟨(intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals h1 h2).symm, ?_⟩
    have hh := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := 0) (b := x0) (C := M)
      (f := φ) (fun s hs => by
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hx0.le] at hs
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hM s hs.1.le hs.2)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hx0] at hh
    exact hh
  
  have tail1 : (∫ s in x0..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s)
      = Real.sqrt 2 * Cs * ((X ^ (1 - lam) - x0 ^ (1 - lam)) / (1 - lam)) := by
    have hcongr : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc x0 X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s = Real.sqrt 2 * Cs * s ^ (-lam) := by
      intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hx0X] at hs
      have hs0 : 0 < s := lt_of_lt_of_le hx0 hs.1
      rw [hpow s hs.1 hs.2, Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2), Real.sqrt_eq_rpow s]
      have e : s ^ (1 / (2:ℝ)) * s ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam)) = s ^ (-lam) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hs0]; congr 1; ring
      rw [← e]; ring
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr hcongr, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      integral_rpow (Or.inl (by linarith))]
    rw [show -lam + 1 = 1 - lam by ring]
  have tail2 : (∫ s in x0..X, κ s) = 0 := by
    have hcongr : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc x0 X, κ s = (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) s := by
      intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hx0X] at hs
      exact hk0 s hs.1 hs.2
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr hcongr]
    simp
  have tail3 : (∫ s in x0..X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s * κ s) = 0 := by
    have hcongr : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc x0 X, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s * κ s = (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) s := by
      intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hx0X] at hs
      simp [hk0 s hs.1 hs.2]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr hcongr]
    simp
  
  have hgX : g X = Cs * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam)) := hpow X hx0X le_rfl
  have hD : X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * g X) = Real.sqrt 2 * Cs * X ^ (1 - lam) := by
    rw [hgX, Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2), Real.sqrt_eq_rpow X]
    have h3 : X ^ (1:ℝ) * (X ^ (1 / (2:ℝ)) * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam))) = X ^ (1 - lam) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hX, ← Real.rpow_add hX]; congr 1; ring
    rw [Real.rpow_one] at h3
    rw [← h3]; ring
  
  have hl' : 0 < 1 - lam := by linarith
  have hEpos : 0 < X ^ (1 - lam) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hX _
  have hDpos : 0 < Real.sqrt 2 * Cs * X ^ (1 - lam) := by positivity
  have hapos : 0 ≤ x0 ^ (1 / 2 + lam) := Real.rpow_nonneg hx0.le _
  have hεnn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (x0 / X)
  have ht0 : 0 < x0 / X := div_pos hx0 hX
  have ht1 : x0 / X ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hX).2 hx0X
  have hb : x0 ^ (1 / 2 - lam) ≤ X ^ (1 / 2 - lam) := Real.rpow_le_rpow hx0.le hx0X (by linarith)
  have hab : x0 ^ (1 / 2 + lam) * x0 ^ (1 / 2 - lam) = x0 := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hx0, show (1 / 2 + lam) + (1 / 2 - lam) = (1:ℝ) by ring, Real.rpow_one]
  have hcX : X ^ (1 / 2 - lam) * Real.sqrt X = X ^ (1 - lam) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_add hX]; congr 1; ring
  have hε : Real.sqrt (x0 / X) * Real.sqrt X = Real.sqrt x0 := by
    rw [← Real.sqrt_mul (div_nonneg hx0.le hX.le)]; congr 1; field_simp
  have hhead : Real.sqrt (2 * x0) * x0
      ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * (x0 ^ (1 / 2 + lam) * Real.sqrt (x0 / X)) * X ^ (1 - lam) := by
    rw [← hcX, Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2)]
    calc Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt x0 * x0
        = Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt x0 * x0 ^ (1 / 2 + lam) * x0 ^ (1 / 2 - lam) := by
          rw [mul_assoc (Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt x0), hab]
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt x0 * x0 ^ (1 / 2 + lam) * X ^ (1 / 2 - lam) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (by positivity)
      _ = Real.sqrt 2 * (x0 ^ (1 / 2 + lam) * (Real.sqrt (x0 / X) * Real.sqrt X))
            * X ^ (1 / 2 - lam) := by rw [hε]; ring
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hdef : x0 ^ (1 - lam) / ((1 - lam) * X ^ (1 - lam)) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (x0 / X) := by
    have h1 : x0 ^ (1 - lam) / X ^ (1 - lam) ≤ Real.sqrt (x0 / X) := by
      rw [← Real.div_rpow hx0.le hX.le, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge ht0 ht1 (by linarith)
    rw [mul_comm, ← div_div, div_le_iff₀ hl']
    nlinarith
  have htle : x0 / X ≤ Real.sqrt (x0 / X) := by
    have h1 := Real.sq_sqrt ht0.le
    have h2 : Real.sqrt (x0 / X) ≤ 1 := Real.sqrt_le_one.mpr ht1
    nlinarith
  have hK : P1 * x0 ^ (1 / 2 + lam) / Cs * Real.sqrt (x0 / X) * (Real.sqrt 2 * Cs * X ^ (1 - lam))
      = P1 * (Real.sqrt 2 * (x0 ^ (1 / 2 + lam) * Real.sqrt (x0 / X)) * X ^ (1 - lam)) := by
    field_simp
  
  have hφ1m : Measurable (fun s => Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s) := Measurable.mul (by fun_prop) hgm
  have hφ3m : Measurable (fun s => Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s * κ s) := hφ1m.mul hκm
  have b1 : ∀ Y, Y ≤ X → ∀ s, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ Y → |Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s| ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * Y) * P1 := by
    intro Y hY s hs0 hsY
    have hgs := hg s hs0 (le_trans hsY hY)
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hgs.1)]
    exact mul_le_mul (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)) hgs.2 hgs.1 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have b2 : ∀ s, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ X → |κ s| ≤ 4 := by
    intro s hs0 hsX
    have := hk s hs0 hsX
    rw [abs_of_nonneg this.1]; exact this.2
  have b3 : ∀ Y, Y ≤ X → ∀ s, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ Y →
      |Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s * κ s| ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * Y) * P1 * 4 := by
    intro Y hY s hs0 hsY
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (b1 Y hY s hs0 hsY) (b2 s hs0 (le_trans hsY hY)) (abs_nonneg _)
      (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hP1)
  obtain ⟨S1, H1⟩ := split (fun s => Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s) _ _ hφ1m (b1 X le_rfl) (b1 x0 hx0X)
  obtain ⟨S2, H2⟩ := split κ _ _ hκm b2 (fun s h0 h1 => b2 s h0 (le_trans h1 hx0X))
  obtain ⟨S3, H3⟩ := split (fun s => Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s * κ s) _ _ hφ3m (b3 X le_rfl)
    (b3 x0 hx0X)
  rw [hD]
  have hhP := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhead hP1
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [S1, tail1]
    set H := ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..x0, Real.sqrt (2 * s) * g s with hHdef
    have alg : (H + Real.sqrt 2 * Cs * ((X ^ (1 - lam) - x0 ^ (1 - lam)) / (1 - lam)))
          / (Real.sqrt 2 * Cs * X ^ (1 - lam)) - 1 / (1 - lam)
        = H / (Real.sqrt 2 * Cs * X ^ (1 - lam)) - x0 ^ (1 - lam) / ((1 - lam) * X ^ (1 - lam)) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [alg]
    have hq : |H / (Real.sqrt 2 * Cs * X ^ (1 - lam))|
        ≤ P1 * x0 ^ (1 / 2 + lam) / Cs * Real.sqrt (x0 / X) := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hDpos, div_le_iff₀ hDpos, hK]
      calc |H| ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * x0) * P1 * x0 := H1
        _ = P1 * (Real.sqrt (2 * x0) * x0) := by ring
        _ ≤ _ := hhP
    have hdn : 0 ≤ x0 ^ (1 - lam) / ((1 - lam) * X ^ (1 - lam)) := by positivity
    calc _ ≤ |H / (Real.sqrt 2 * Cs * X ^ (1 - lam))|
          + |x0 ^ (1 - lam) / ((1 - lam) * X ^ (1 - lam))| := abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ _ := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hdn]; nlinarith
  · rw [S2, tail2, add_zero, abs_div, abs_of_pos hX, div_le_iff₀ hX]

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Md Pst lam hPst hlam0 hlam1
  have hbasics : (∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → sigA y = 0) ∧ (∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → sigA y = 1) ∧ (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA y ∧ sigA y ≤ 1) ∧ Continuous sigA ∧ Continuous rfpSigI ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → rfpSigI t = 0) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → rfpSigI t = t - 1 + rfpSigI 1) ∧ 0 ≤ rfpSigI 1 ∧ rfpSigI 1 ≤ 1 := by
    have h1 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → sigA y = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      unfold sigA
      rw [if_pos hy]
    have h2 : ∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → sigA y = 1 := by
      intro y hy
      unfold sigA
      rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hy]
    have h3 : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA y ∧ sigA y ≤ 1 := by
      intro y
      unfold sigA
      split_ifs
      · norm_num
      · norm_num
      · have ha := Real.exp_pos (-1 / y ^ 2)
        have hb := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)
        refine ⟨div_nonneg ha.le (by linarith), ?_⟩
        rw [div_le_one (by linarith)]
        linarith

      set G : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => expNegInvGlue (max y 0 ^ 2) with hG

        ((expNegInvGlue.contDiff (n := 0)).continuous).comp ((continuous_id.max continuous_const).pow 2)

        intro y hy

        exact expNegInvGlue.zero_of_nonpos (by norm_num)
      have hGp : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → G y = Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) := by
        intro y hy
        simp only [hG, max_eq_left hy.le]
        unfold expNegInvGlue
        rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr (pow_pos hy 2)), neg_div, one_div]

        intro y hy

        · exact (hGpos y hy).le

        intro y

          have := hGnn y
          linarith
        · have := hGpos y hy
          have := hGnn (1 - y)
          linarith

        funext y
        unfold sigA
        split_ifs with hy0 hy1
        · rw [hG0 y hy0, zero_div]
        · rw [hG0 (1 - y) (by linarith), add_zero, div_self (hGpos y (by linarith)).ne']

    have hII : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable sigA MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
      fun a b => hcont.intervalIntegrable a b

      show Continuous (fun t => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, sigA s)
      exact intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive hII 0
    have h6 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → rfpSigI t = 0 := by
      intro t ht

      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ))]
      · simp
      · intro s hs
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge ht] at hs
        exact h1 s hs.2
    have h7 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → rfpSigI t = t - 1 + rfpSigI 1 := by
      intro t ht
      show (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, sigA s) = t - 1 + ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, sigA s
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hII 0 1) (hII 1 t)]
      have e : (∫ s in (1:ℝ)..t, sigA s) = ∫ s in (1:ℝ)..t, (1:ℝ) := by

      ring

      show 0 ≤ ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, sigA s

      intro y hy

signature.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → RfpClos P → ∀ x : ℝ, rfpXv P ≤ x → ContinuousOn (fun e => profRadInt (fun s e => 2 * s * rfpF P s e) x e) (Icc (-1) 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hReg hClos x hx
  have hxv0 : 0 < rfpXv P := by unfold rfpXv; exact Real.exp_pos _
  have hstar : ∀ s e : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ rfpXv P →
      2 * s * rfpF P s e = (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * (2 * s * rfpF P s 0) := by
    intro s e hs0 hs1
    rw [((pqc_rfp_rep P hReg).2.2.2.2 s e hs0 hs1).2,
      ((pqc_rfp_rep P hReg).2.2.2.2 s 0 hs0 hs1).2]
    simp
  have hFc : ContinuousOn (↿(rfpF P)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) :=
    (rfp_profile_regular P hReg hClos).1.continuousOn
  have hI0 : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => 2 * s * rfpF P s 0) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (rfpXv P) :=
    (((rfp_profile_regular P hReg hClos).2.2.2.2 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).2.2.2.2
      (rfpXv P) hxv0.le).2.1
  let c : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => max (rfpXv P) (min x s)
  let k : ℝ → ℝ := fun e => max (-1) (min 1 e)
  have hc : Continuous c := continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min continuous_id)
  have hk : Continuous k := continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min continuous_id)
  let g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun e s => 2 * c s * rfpF P (c s) (k e)
  have hg : Continuous (Function.uncurry g) := by
    have hmap : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (c p.2, k p.1)) :=
      (hc.comp continuous_snd).prodMk (hk.comp continuous_fst)
    have hmem : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, (c p.2, k p.1) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-2:ℝ) 2 := by
      intro p
      refine ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hxv0 (le_max_left _ _), ?_, ?_⟩
      · have : (-1:ℝ) ≤ k p.1 := le_max_left _ _
        linarith
      · have : k p.1 ≤ 1 := max_le (by norm_num) (min_le_left _ _)
        linarith
    have h1 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (↿(rfpF P)) (c p.2, k p.1)) :=
      hFc.comp_continuous hmap hmem
    have h2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * c p.2 * (↿(rfpF P)) (c p.2, k p.1)) :=
      (continuous_const.mul (hc.comp continuous_snd)).mul h1
    exact h2
  have hG : Continuous (fun e => ∫ s in (rfpXv P)..x, g e s) :=
    intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' hg _ _
  have hH : Continuous (fun e : ℝ => (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..(rfpXv P), 2 * s * rfpF P s 0)

    intro s hs

  congr 1
