proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hReg x η hx1 hx2 h1 h2
  have hReg' := hReg
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl1, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hReg'
  have hxb : 0 < rfpXb P := Real.exp_pos _
  have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hx1
  have hlam2 : P.lam ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 10000 := by nlinarith
  have hρ1 : P.ρ ≤ 1 / 100 := by linarith
  
  have hsig : ∀ y, 0 ≤ sigA y ∧ sigA y ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
    · have ha := Real.exp_pos (-1 / y ^ 2)
      have hb := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)
      constructor
      · positivity
      · rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
        linarith
  have hsigM : Measurable sigA := by
    have e : sigA = fun y => if y ≤ 0 then 0 else if 1 ≤ y then 1 else
        Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) / (Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) + Real.exp (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)) := by
      funext y; rfl
    rw [e]
    refine Measurable.ite measurableSet_Iic measurable_const
      (Measurable.ite measurableSet_Ici measurable_const ?_)
    fun_prop
  have htF : ∀ s, 1 - P.ρ ≤ tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ∧ tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ≤ 1 := by
    intro s
    unfold tailFac
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := hsig ((Real.log (s / rfpXb P) + 2) / 2)
    constructor
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg hρ0.le a]
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg hρ0.le (sub_nonneg.2 b)]
  
  have hlaw : ∀ s e : ℝ, Real.exp (rfpY6 P) ≤ s →
      s * rfpF P s e ^ 2 = rfpCi P ^ 2 / 2 * (tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ^ 2 * s ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h)) ∧
      rfpF P s e ^ 2 = rfpCi P ^ 2 / 2 * (tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ^ 2 * s ^ (-2 - 2 * P.h)) ∧
      rfpE P (Real.log s) e ^ 2 = rfpCi P ^ 2 * (tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ^ 2 * s ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h)) := by
    intro s e hs
    have hs0 : 0 < s := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hs
    have hcl := (rfp_T_pointwise P hReg).2.2 s e hs
    have hsq : Real.sqrt (2 * s) * s ^ (-(1 / 2 + P.h)) = Real.sqrt 2 * s ^ (-P.h) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2), Real.sqrt_eq_rpow s, mul_assoc,
        ← Real.rpow_add hs0, show (1:ℝ) / 2 + -(1 / 2 + P.h) = -P.h by ring]
    have hG : 2 * s * rfpF P s e = Real.sqrt 2 * rfpCi P * s ^ (-P.h) * tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s := by
      unfold tailFac
      have h3 : Real.sqrt (2 * s) * rfpCi P * s ^ (-(1 / 2 + P.h)) =
          Real.sqrt 2 * rfpCi P * s ^ (-P.h) := by
        calc Real.sqrt (2 * s) * rfpCi P * s ^ (-(1 / 2 + P.h))
            = rfpCi P * (Real.sqrt (2 * s) * s ^ (-(1 / 2 + P.h))) := by ring
          _ = Real.sqrt 2 * rfpCi P * s ^ (-P.h) := by rw [hsq]; ring
      linear_combination hcl + h3
    have hpow : s ^ (-P.h) * s ^ (-P.h) = s ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h) * s := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hs0, ← Real.rpow_add_one hs0.ne']
      congr 1; ring
    have hpow2 : s ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h) = s ^ (-2 - 2 * P.h) * s := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add_one hs0.ne']
      congr 1; ring
    have h2 : Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
    have hsq4 : (2 * s * rfpF P s e) ^ 2 =
        2 * rfpCi P ^ 2 * tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ^ 2 * (s ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h) * s) := by
      rw [hG]
      linear_combination (rfpCi P ^ 2 * (s ^ (-P.h)) ^ 2 * tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ^ 2) * h2 +
        (2 * rfpCi P ^ 2 * tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ^ 2) * hpow
    have hA : s * rfpF P s e ^ 2 =
        rfpCi P ^ 2 / 2 * (tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ^ 2 * s ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h)) := by
      have h4s : (4 * s) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      apply mul_right_cancel₀ h4s
      linear_combination hsq4
    have hB : rfpF P s e ^ 2 =
        rfpCi P ^ 2 / 2 * (tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ^ 2 * s ^ (-2 - 2 * P.h)) := by
      apply mul_right_cancel₀ hs0.ne'
      linear_combination hA + (rfpCi P ^ 2 / 2 * tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ^ 2) * hpow2
    have hne : Real.sqrt (2 * s) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)).ne'
    have hE1 : rfpE P (Real.log s) e = rfpF P s e * Real.sqrt (2 * s) := by
      unfold rfpF
      exact (div_mul_cancel₀ _ hne).symm
    have hsq2s : Real.sqrt (2 * s) ^ 2 = 2 * s := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
    refine ⟨hA, hB, ?_⟩
    rw [hE1]
    linear_combination (rfpF P s e ^ 2) * hsq2s + 2 * hA
  
  obtain ⟨J1, hJ1⟩ : ∃ J : ℝ,
      J = ∫ s in Ioi x, tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ^ 2 * s ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨J2, hJ2⟩ : ∃ J : ℝ,
      J = ∫ s in Ioi x, tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ^ 2 * s ^ (-2 - 2 * P.h) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hS : ∀ e, rfpExtS P x e = rfpCi P ^ 2 / 2 * J1 := by
    intro e
    rw [hJ1, rfpExtS, ← integral_const_mul]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun s hs => ?_)
    exact (hlaw s e (le_trans hx1 (le_of_lt hs))).1
  have hPi : ∀ e, leadPi (rfpF P) x e = -(rfpCi P ^ 2 / 2 * J2) := by
    intro e
    rw [hJ2, leadPi, ← integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun s hs => ?_)
    exact (hlaw s e (le_trans hx1 (le_of_lt hs))).2.1
  have hD1 : profEtaD (rfpExtS P) x η = 0 := by
    simp only [profEtaD, hS, deriv_const]
  have hD2 : profEtaD (leadPi (rfpF P)) x η = 0 := by
    simp only [profEtaD, hPi, deriv_const]
  have hN : rfpExtN P x η = 2 * η * rfpCi P ^ 2 * (P.h / x * J1 - (1 / 2 + P.h) * J2) := by
    unfold rfpExtN
    rw [hD1, hD2, hS η, hPi η]
    ring
  
  have ha1 : (-1 - 2 * P.h) < -1 := by linarith
  have ha2 : (-2 - 2 * P.h) < -1 := by linarith
  have hI1 : P.h / x * (∫ s in Ioi x, s ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h)) = x ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h) / 2 := by
    rw [integral_Ioi_rpow_of_lt ha1 hx0, Real.rpow_add_one hx0.ne',
      show (-1 - 2 * P.h + 1) = -(2 * P.h) by ring]
    have hhne : P.h ≠ 0 := hh0.ne'
    have hxne : x ≠ 0 := hx0.ne'
    field_simp
  have hI2 : (1 / 2 + P.h) * (∫ s in Ioi x, s ^ (-2 - 2 * P.h)) = x ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h) / 2 := by
    rw [integral_Ioi_rpow_of_lt ha2 hx0, show (-2 - 2 * P.h + 1) = (-1 - 2 * P.h) by ring]
    have hne : (-1 - 2 * P.h) ≠ 0 := (by linarith : -1 - 2 * P.h < 0).ne
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hτM : Measurable (fun s => tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ^ 2) := by
    unfold tailFac; fun_prop
  have hτ1 : ∀ s, tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    intro s
    obtain ⟨t1, t2⟩ := htF s
    nlinarith
  have hτ0 : ∀ s, (1 - P.ρ) ^ 2 ≤ tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ^ 2 := by
    intro s
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) (htF s).1 2
  have hint : ∀ a : ℝ, a < -1 →
      IntegrableOn (fun s => tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ^ 2 * s ^ a) (Ioi x) := by
    intro a ha
    refine Integrable.mono' (integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt ha hx0) ?_ ?_
    · exact (hτM.mul (by fun_prop)).aestronglyMeasurable
    · rw [ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi]
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s hs => ?_)
      have hs0 : 0 < s := lt_trans hx0 hs
      have hp := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hs0 a
      have hq : 0 ≤ tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hq hp.le)]
      calc tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ^ 2 * s ^ a ≤ 1 * s ^ a :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hτ1 s) hp.le
        _ = s ^ a := one_mul _
  have hsand : ∀ a : ℝ, a < -1 →
      (1 - P.ρ) ^ 2 * (∫ s in Ioi x, s ^ a) ≤
        (∫ s in Ioi x, tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ^ 2 * s ^ a) ∧
      (∫ s in Ioi x, tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ^ 2 * s ^ a) ≤ ∫ s in Ioi x, s ^ a := by
    intro a ha
    have hg := integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt ha hx0
    constructor
    · rw [← integral_const_mul]
      refine setIntegral_mono_on (Integrable.const_mul hg _) (hint a ha) measurableSet_Ioi ?_
      intro s hs
      have hs0 : 0 < s := lt_trans hx0 hs
      have hp := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hs0 a
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hτ0 s) hp.le
    · refine setIntegral_mono_on (hint a ha) hg measurableSet_Ioi ?_
      intro s hs
      have hs0 : 0 < s := lt_trans hx0 hs
      have hp := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hs0 a
      calc tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) s ^ 2 * s ^ a ≤ 1 * s ^ a :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hτ1 s) hp.le
        _ = s ^ a := one_mul _
  have hX : 0 < x ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hx0 _
  obtain ⟨s1, s2⟩ := hsand _ ha1
  obtain ⟨r1, r2⟩ := hsand _ ha2
  rw [← hJ1] at s1 s2
  rw [← hJ2] at r1 r2
  have hhx : 0 ≤ P.h / x := by positivity
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ 1 / 2 + P.h := by linarith
  have u1 : (1 - P.ρ) ^ 2 * (x ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h) / 2) ≤ P.h / x * J1 := by
    rw [← hI1]
    calc (1 - P.ρ) ^ 2 * (P.h / x * ∫ s in Ioi x, s ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h))
        = P.h / x * ((1 - P.ρ) ^ 2 * ∫ s in Ioi x, s ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h)) := by ring
      _ ≤ P.h / x * J1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left s1 hhx
  have u2 : P.h / x * J1 ≤ x ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h) / 2 := by
    rw [← hI1]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left s2 hhx
  have v1 : (1 - P.ρ) ^ 2 * (x ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h) / 2) ≤ (1 / 2 + P.h) * J2 := by
    rw [← hI2]
    calc (1 - P.ρ) ^ 2 * ((1 / 2 + P.h) * ∫ s in Ioi x, s ^ (-2 - 2 * P.h))
        = (1 / 2 + P.h) * ((1 - P.ρ) ^ 2 * ∫ s in Ioi x, s ^ (-2 - 2 * P.h)) := by ring
      _ ≤ (1 / 2 + P.h) * J2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left r1 hA0
  have v2 : (1 / 2 + P.h) * J2 ≤ x ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h) / 2 := by
    rw [← hI2]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left r2 hA0
  have hD : |P.h / x * J1 - (1 / 2 + P.h) * J2| ≤ P.ρ * x ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h) := by
    have hq := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg P.ρ) hX.le
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  
  have htFx : tailFac P.ρ (rfpXb P) x = 1 - P.ρ := by
    have hq : x / rfpXb P ≤ Real.exp (-2) := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hxb]; linarith
    have hl : Real.log (x / rfpXb P) ≤ -2 := by
      have := Real.log_le_log (div_pos hx0 hxb) hq
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
    have hs : sigA ((Real.log (x / rfpXb P) + 2) / 2) = 0 := by
      unfold sigA
      rw [if_pos (by linarith)]
    unfold tailFac
    rw [hs]; ring
  have hE2 := (hlaw x η hx1).2.2
  rw [hN, hE2, htFx, abs_mul]
  have hη : |η| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩
  have hc2 : 0 ≤ rfpCi P ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  have hcoef : |2 * η * rfpCi P ^ 2| ≤ 2 * rfpCi P ^ 2 := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc2, abs_two]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hη hc2]
  have hk : 2 ≤ 3 * (1 - P.ρ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hm : 0 ≤ P.ρ * rfpCi P ^ 2 * x ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h) := by positivity
  calc |2 * η * rfpCi P ^ 2| * |P.h / x * J1 - (1 / 2 + P.h) * J2|
      ≤ (2 * rfpCi P ^ 2) * (P.ρ * x ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h)) :=
        mul_le_mul hcoef hD (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    _ ≤ 3 * P.ρ * (rfpCi P ^ 2 * ((1 - P.ρ) ^ 2 * x ^ (-1 - 2 * P.h))) := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk hm]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h X : ℝ) (c k : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < X → Differentiable ℝ c → Differentiable ℝ k → (∀ y, 0 < c y) → (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ y, y ≤ Real.log (X + 1) → |c y| ≤ M ∧ |k y| ≤ M) → (∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ X → U x η = η * k (Real.log x) ∧ F x η = c (Real.log x) * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ / Real.sqrt (2 * x)) → ∀ η : ℝ, leadNs h F U X η = η * rinNf h c k X η + 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * leadPi F X η - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (leadPi F) X η

signature.name: rfp_lead_explicit_closed
signature.statement: ∀ (h X : ℝ) (c k : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < X → Differentiable ℝ c → Differentiable ℝ k → (∀ y, 0 < c y) → (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ y, y ≤ Real.log (X + 1) → |c y| ≤ M ∧ |k y| ≤ M) → (∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ X → U x η = η * k (Real.log x) ∧ F x η = c (Real.log x) * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ / Real.sqrt (2 * x)) → ∀ η : ℝ, leadNs h F U X η = η * rinNf h c k X η + 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * leadPi F X η - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (leadPi F) X η

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h X c k F U hX hc hk hpos hbd hform η
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hbd
  have alg2 : ∀ x s A : ℝ, 0 < s → s * s = 2 * x → x * (A / s) ^ 2 = A ^ 2 / 2 := by
    intro x s A hs hss
    have hx : x = s * s / 2 := by linarith
    rw [hx]
    field_simp
  have hcongr : ∀ g1 g2 : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x, 0 < x → x ≤ X → g1 x = g2 x) →
      ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, g1 x = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, g2 x := by
    intro g1 g2 hg
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx => ?_)
    rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hX.le] at hx
    exact hg x hx.1 hx.2
  have hsx : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * x) := fun x hx => Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by linarith)
  have hssx : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → Real.sqrt (2 * x) * Real.sqrt (2 * x) = 2 * x :=
    fun x hx => Real.mul_self_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hlogle : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ X → Real.log x ≤ Real.log (X + 1) :=
    fun x hx hxX => Real.log_le_log hx (by linarith)
  have hm3 : ∀ e : ℝ, profRadInt U X e = e * rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x)) X := by
    intro e
    unfold profRadInt rinMom
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    apply hcongr
    intro x hx0 hx1
    rw [(hform x e hx0 hx1).1]
  have hIk : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => k (Real.log x) ^ 2) volume 0 X := by
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hX.le]
    refine Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded (M := M ^ 2) measure_Ioc_lt_top.ne
      ((hk.continuous.measurable.comp Real.measurable_log).pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioc (fun x hx => ?_)
    have h1 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hM _ (hlogle x hx.1 hx.2)).2 2
    rw [sq_abs] at h1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    exact h1
  have hIc : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => c (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2) volume 0 X := by
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hX.le]
    refine Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded (M := M ^ 2) measure_Ioc_lt_top.ne
      (((hc.continuous.measurable.comp Real.measurable_log).pow_const 2).div_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioc (fun x hx => ?_)
    have h1 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hM _ (hlogle x hx.1 hx.2)).1 2
    rw [sq_abs] at h1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (c (Real.log x))]
  have hm4 : ∀ e : ℝ, profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) X e =
      e ^ 2 * rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x) ^ 2) X
        - ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * rinMom (fun x => c (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2) X := by
    intro e
    unfold profRadInt rinMom
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hIk.const_mul _) (hIc.const_mul _)]
    apply hcongr
    intro x hx0 hx1
    beta_reduce
    rw [(hform x e hx0 hx1).2, (hform x e hx0 hx1).1, alg2 x _ _ (hsx x hx0) (hssx x hx0)]
    ring
  have hm5 : ∀ e : ℝ, profRadAvg U X e = e * (rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x)) X / X) := by
    intro e
    unfold profRadAvg rinMom
    have h1 : ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, U (s * X) e = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, e * k (Real.log (s * X)) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s hs => ?_)
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at hs
      exact (hform (s * X) e (mul_pos hs.1 hX) (mul_le_of_le_one_left hX.le hs.2)).1
    rw [h1, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right (fun x => k (Real.log x)) hX.ne']
    simp only [zero_mul, one_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  have hq : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => 1 + e ^ 2) (2 * η) η := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_pow 2 η).const_add 1
  have hqpos : (0:ℝ) < 1 + η ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hinv : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) (-(2 * η) / (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2) η :=
    hq.inv hqpos.ne'
  have hd3 : profEtaD (profRadInt U) X η = 1 * rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x)) X := by
    unfold profEtaD
    rw [show (fun e => profRadInt U X e) = _ from funext hm3]
    exact ((hasDerivAt_id' η).mul_const _).deriv
  have hd4 : profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)) X η =
      2 * η * rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x) ^ 2) X
        - 2 * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (-(2 * η) / (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2) * rinMom (fun x => c (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2) X := by
    unfold profEtaD
    rw [show (fun e => profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) X e) = _ from funext hm4]
    have hp : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => e ^ 2) (2 * η) η := by simpa using hasDerivAt_pow 2 η
    have hp2 : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2)
        (2 * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (-(2 * η) / (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2)) η := by
      convert hinv.pow 2 using 1 <;> first | rfl | norm_num
    exact ((hp.mul_const _).sub (hp2.mul_const _)).deriv
  have hd5 : profEtaD (profRadAvg U) X η = 1 * (rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x)) X / X) := by
    unfold profEtaD
    rw [show (fun e => profRadAvg U X e) = _ from funext hm5]
    exact ((hasDerivAt_id' η).mul_const _).deriv
  have hUX := (hform X η hX le_rfl).1
  unfold leadNs leadW rinNf
  rw [hm3, hm4, hm5, hd3, hd4, hd5, hUX]
  generalize rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x) ^ 2) X = S1
  generalize rinMom (fun x => c (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2) X = S2
  generalize rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x)) X = M0
  generalize leadPi F X η = P0
  generalize profEtaD (leadPi F) X η = P1
  field_simp
  ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ Md Pst lam : ℝ, 0 < Md → Real.exp (Real.exp Md + 10) < Pst → 0 ≤ lam → ∀ X : ℝ, Real.exp (rfpY2 Md + 1) ≤ X → rfpK Md (Real.log X) = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ rinMom (fun x => rfpK Md (Real.log x) ^ 2) X ∧ rinMom (fun x => rfpK Md (Real.log x) ^ 2) X ≤ 16 * Pst ^ 2 ∧ 0 ≤ rinMom (fun x => rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2) X ∧ rinMom (fun x => rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2) X ≤ 8 * Pst ^ 2 * (1 + Real.log X)

signature.name: rfp_inter_moments
signature.statement: ∀ Md Pst lam : ℝ, 0 < Md → Real.exp (Real.exp Md + 10) < Pst → 0 ≤ lam → ∀ X : ℝ, Real.exp (rfpY2 Md + 1) ≤ X → rfpK Md (Real.log X) = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ rinMom (fun x => rfpK Md (Real.log x) ^ 2) X ∧ rinMom (fun x => rfpK Md (Real.log x) ^ 2) X ≤ 16 * Pst ^ 2 ∧ 0 ≤ rinMom (fun x => rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2) X ∧ rinMom (fun x => rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2) X ≤ 8 * Pst ^ 2 * (1 + Real.log X)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Md Pst lam hMd hPst hlam X hX
  have hPst0 : 0 < Pst := lt_trans (Real.exp_pos _) hPst
  have hPst1 : 1 ≤ Pst := le_trans (Real.one_le_exp (by linarith [Real.exp_pos Md])) hPst.le
  have hPstsq : Pst ≤ Pst ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hy2 : rfpY2 Md = Real.exp Md + 11 := by unfold rfpY2; ring
  have hX0 : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hX
  have hlogX : rfpY2 Md + 1 ≤ Real.log X := (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hX0).2 hX
  have hlogX' : Real.exp Md ≤ Real.log X := by rw [hy2] at hlogX; linarith
  have hlog0 : 0 ≤ Real.log X := le_trans (Real.exp_pos Md).le hlogX'
  have hX1 : 1 ≤ X :=
    le_trans (Real.one_le_exp (by rw [hy2]; linarith [Real.exp_pos Md])) hX
  
  have hsig : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA y ∧ sigA y ≤ 1 := by
    intro y; unfold sigA
    split_ifs
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
    · constructor
      · positivity
      · rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
        linarith [Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)]
  have hsigm : Measurable sigA := by
    unfold sigA
    refine Measurable.ite (measurableSet_Iic : MeasurableSet (Iic (0:ℝ))) measurable_const
      (Measurable.ite (measurableSet_Ici : MeasurableSet (Ici (1:ℝ))) measurable_const ?_)
    fun_prop
  have hsigi : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable sigA MeasureTheory.volume a b := by
    intro a b
    refine (intervalIntegrable_const (c := (1:ℝ))).mono_fun hsigm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_)
    show ‖sigA y‖ ≤ ‖(1:ℝ)‖
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hsig y).1, abs_one]
    exact (hsig y).2
  have hS0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → rfpSigI t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpSigI
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ)) ?_]
    · simp
    · intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge ht] at hs
      show sigA s = 0
      unfold sigA; rw [if_pos hs.2]
  have hSpos : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ rfpSigI t ∧ rfpSigI t ≤ t := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpSigI
    constructor
    · exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg ht (fun u _ => (hsig u).1)
    · have h1 : ‖∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, sigA s‖ ≤ 1 * |t - 0| :=
        intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (fun x _ => by
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hsig x).1]; exact (hsig x).2)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg ht, one_mul] at h1
      exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) h1
  have hSlin : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → rfpSigI t = rfpSigI 1 + (t - 1) := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpSigI
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hsigi 0 1) (hsigi 1 t)]
    congr 1
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (1:ℝ)) ?_]
    · simp
    · intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le ht] at hs
      show sigA s = 1
      unfold sigA; rw [if_neg (by linarith [hs.1]), if_pos hs.1]
  have hSsub : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ y → y ≤ 1 → rfpSigI 1 - rfpSigI y ≤ 1 - y := by
    intro y hy0 hy1
    unfold rfpSigI
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hsigi 0 1) (hsigi 0 y)]
    have h1 : ‖∫ s in y..1, sigA s‖ ≤ 1 * |1 - y| :=
      intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (fun x _ => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hsig x).1]; exact (hsig x).2)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - y), one_mul] at h1
    exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) h1
  have hSnn : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpSigI t := by
    intro t
    rcases le_total t 0 with h | h
    · rw [hS0 t h]
    · exact (hSpos t h).1
  have hS1 := hSpos 1 zero_le_one
  have hSc : Continuous rfpSigI :=
    show Continuous (fun t => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, sigA s) from
      intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive hsigi 0
  
  have hk04 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ rfpK Md y ∧ rfpK Md y ≤ 4 := by
    intro y; unfold rfpK
    split_ifs
    · norm_num
    · have := hsig (Real.log y / Md); constructor <;> linarith
  have hkzero : ∀ y, Real.exp Md ≤ y → rfpK Md y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hy1 : 1 < y := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.one_lt_exp_iff.2 hMd) hy
    have hy0 : 0 < y := by linarith
    have hly : Md ≤ Real.log y := (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hy0).2 hy
    have hq : 1 ≤ Real.log y / Md := (one_le_div hMd).2 hly
    unfold rfpK
    rw [if_neg (by linarith)]
    unfold sigA
    rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hq]
    ring
  have hkmeas : Measurable (rfpK Md) := by
    unfold rfpK
    refine Measurable.ite (measurableSet_Iic : MeasurableSet (Iic (1:ℝ))) measurable_const ?_
    exact measurable_const.mul (measurable_const.sub (hsigm.comp (Real.measurable_log.div_const Md)))
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = Pst ^ 2 * Real.exp (6 / 5 * (1 - rfpSigI 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCpos : ∀ y, 0 < rinC Md Pst lam y := by
    intro y; unfold rinC; exact mul_pos hPst0 (Real.exp_pos _)
  have hCid : ∀ y, rinC Md Pst lam y ^ 2 * Real.exp y =
      Pst ^ 2 * Real.exp (6 / 5 * (y - rfpSigI y) - 2 * lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 Md)) := by
    intro y
    have e1 : Real.exp (y / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y - lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 Md)) ^ 2 * Real.exp y =
        Real.exp (6 / 5 * (y - rfpSigI y) - 2 * lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 Md)) := by
      rw [sq, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    unfold rinC
    rw [mul_pow, mul_assoc, e1]
  have hg : ∀ y, y - rfpSigI y ≤ 1 - rfpSigI 1 := by
    intro y
    rcases le_total y 0 with h | h
    · rw [hS0 y h]; linarith
    · rcases le_total y 1 with h' | h'
      · linarith [hSsub y h h']
      · rw [hSlin y h']; linarith
  have hCK1 : ∀ y, rinC Md Pst lam y ^ 2 * Real.exp y ≤ K := by
    intro y; rw [hCid, hK]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (sq_nonneg Pst)
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
    nlinarith [hg y, mul_nonneg hlam (hSnn (y - rfpY2 Md))]
  have hCneg : ∀ y, y ≤ 0 → rinC Md Pst lam y ^ 2 ≤ Pst ^ 2 := by
    intro y hy
    have hE : Real.exp (y / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y - lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 Md)) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff, hS0 y hy]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hlam (hSnn (y - rfpY2 Md))]
    have hC1 : rinC Md Pst lam y ≤ Pst := by
      unfold rinC; exact mul_le_of_le_one_right hPst0.le hE
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (hCpos y).le hC1 2
  have hPK : Pst ^ 2 ≤ K := by
    rw [hK]
    exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (sq_nonneg _) (Real.one_le_exp (by linarith [hS1.2]))
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := le_trans (sq_nonneg _) hPK
  have hCK : ∀ y, rinC Md Pst lam y ^ 2 ≤ K := by
    intro y
    rcases le_total y 0 with h | h
    · exact le_trans (hCneg y h) hPK
    · exact le_trans (le_mul_of_one_le_right (sq_nonneg _) (Real.one_le_exp h)) (hCK1 y)
  have hK16 : K ≤ 16 * Pst ^ 2 := by
    rw [hK]
    have he : Real.exp (6 / 5 * (1 - rfpSigI 1)) ≤ 16 := by
      have h1 : Real.exp (6 / 5 * (1 - rfpSigI 1)) ≤ Real.exp 2 :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by linarith [hS1.1])
      have h2 : Real.exp 2 = Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
      have h3 := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
      have h4 := Real.exp_pos 1
      nlinarith
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg Pst]
  
  have hCc : Continuous (rinC Md Pst lam) :=
    show Continuous (fun y => Pst * Real.exp (y / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y - lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 Md))) from
      continuous_const.mul (Real.continuous_exp.comp (((continuous_id.div_const 10).sub
        (continuous_const.mul hSc)).sub (continuous_const.mul (hSc.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)))))
  have hgm : Measurable (fun x => rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2) :=
    ((hCc.measurable.comp Real.measurable_log).pow_const 2).div_const 2
  have hint : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (fun x => rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2)
      MeasureTheory.volume a b := by
    intro a b
    refine (intervalIntegrable_const (c := K / 2)).mono_fun hgm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_)
    show ‖rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2‖ ≤ ‖K / 2‖
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity), abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
    linarith [hCK (Real.log x)]
  have hstar : rinMom (fun x => rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2) X ≤
      Pst ^ 2 / 2 + K / 2 * Real.log X := by
    unfold rinMom
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hint 0 1) (hint 1 X)]
    have h1 : ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2 ≤ ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, Pst ^ 2 / 2 := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on zero_le_one (hint 0 1) intervalIntegrable_const
      intro x hx
      have := hCneg (Real.log x) (Real.log_nonpos hx.1 hx.2)
      linarith
    have h2 : ∫ x in (1:ℝ)..X, rinC Md Pst lam (Real.log x) ^ 2 / 2 ≤ ∫ x in (1:ℝ)..X, K / 2 * x⁻¹ := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hX1 (hint 1 X)
      · apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
        apply ContinuousOn.mul continuousOn_const
        refine continuousOn_inv₀.mono (fun x hx => ?_)
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hX1] at hx
        simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        linarith [hx.1]
      · intro x hx
        have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith [hx.1]
        have := hCK1 (Real.log x)
        rw [Real.exp_log hx0] at this
        rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ hx0]
        linarith
    have e1 : ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, Pst ^ 2 / 2 = Pst ^ 2 / 2 := by simp
    have e2 : ∫ x in (1:ℝ)..X, K / 2 * x⁻¹ = K / 2 * Real.log X := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_inv_of_pos one_pos (by linarith), div_one]
    linarith
  
  have hkm : Measurable (fun x => rfpK Md (Real.log x) ^ 2) :=
    (hkmeas.comp Real.measurable_log).pow_const 2
  have hkb : ∀ x, ‖rfpK Md (Real.log x) ^ 2‖ ≤ 16 := by
    intro x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    nlinarith [hk04 (Real.log x)]
  have hkint : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (fun x => rfpK Md (Real.log x) ^ 2)
      MeasureTheory.volume a b := by
    intro a b
    refine (intervalIntegrable_const (c := (16:ℝ))).mono_fun hkm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_)
    show ‖rfpK Md (Real.log x) ^ 2‖ ≤ ‖(16:ℝ)‖
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 16)]
    exact hkb x
  obtain ⟨X0, hX0def⟩ : ∃ X0 : ℝ, X0 = Real.exp (Real.exp Md) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hX00 : 0 < X0 := by rw [hX0def]; exact Real.exp_pos _
  have hX0X : X0 ≤ X := by
    refine le_trans ?_ hX
    rw [hX0def]; apply Real.exp_le_exp.2; rw [hy2]; linarith
  have hX0P : X0 ≤ Pst := by
    rw [hX0def]
    exact le_trans (Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by linarith)) hPst.le
  have hMk : rinMom (fun x => rfpK Md (Real.log x) ^ 2) X ≤ 16 * Pst ^ 2 := by
    unfold rinMom
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hkint 0 X0) (hkint X0 X)]
    have htail : ∫ x in X0..X, rfpK Md (Real.log x) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ)) ?_]
      · simp
      · intro x hx
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hX0X] at hx
        have hxpos : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hX00 hx.1
        have hlx : Real.exp Md ≤ Real.log x := by
          rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hxpos, ← hX0def]; exact hx.1
        show rfpK Md (Real.log x) ^ 2 = 0
        rw [hkzero (Real.log x) hlx]; norm_num
    have hhead : ‖∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X0, rfpK Md (Real.log x) ^ 2‖ ≤ 16 * |X0 - 0| :=
      intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (fun x _ => hkb x)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hX00] at hhead
    rw [htail, add_zero]
    have := le_abs_self (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X0, rfpK Md (Real.log x) ^ 2)
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨hkzero (Real.log X) hlogX', ?_, hMk, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold rinMom; exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hX0.le (fun u _ => sq_nonneg _)
  · unfold rinMom; exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hX0.le (fun u _ => by positivity)
  · have h1 : K / 2 * Real.log X ≤ 8 * Pst ^ 2 * Real.log X :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hlog0
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg Pst]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → RfpClos P → ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ rfpXk P 0 → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |leadPi (rfpF P) x η| ≤ (1 / 2) * ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) ∧ |profEtaD (leadPi (rfpF P)) x η| ≤ 2 * |η| * ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v)

signature.name: rfp_inter_pressure
signature.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → RfpClos P → ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ rfpXk P 0 → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |leadPi (rfpF P) x η| ≤ (1 / 2) * ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) ∧ |profEtaD (leadPi (rfpF P)) x η| ≤ 2 * |η| * ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hR hC x η hx hxle h1 h2
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl1, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hR
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, hca, -, -⟩ := hC
  
  obtain ⟨q, hq_def⟩ : ∃ q : ℝ → ℝ, q = fun y => expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hqC : Continuous q := by
    rw [hq_def]
    exact (expNegInvGlue.contDiff (n := 0)).continuous.comp (continuous_id.mul continuous_abs)
  have qpos_arg : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → 0 < y * |y| := fun y hy => by
    rw [abs_of_pos hy]; exact mul_pos hy hy
  have qa : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → q y = 0 := fun y hy => by
    rw [hq_def]
    exact expNegInvGlue.zero_of_nonpos (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hy (abs_nonneg y))
  have qb : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → 0 < q y := fun y hy => by
    rw [hq_def]
    exact expNegInvGlue.pos_of_pos (qpos_arg y hy)
  have qc : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ q y := fun y => by
    rw [hq_def]
    exact expNegInvGlue.nonneg _
  have qd : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → q y = Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hq_def]
    show expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) = _
    rw [expNegInvGlue, if_neg (not_le.mpr (qpos_arg y hy)), abs_of_pos hy]
    congr 1
    rw [neg_div, one_div, sq]
  have hDpos : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < q y + q (1 - y) := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : 0 < y
    · exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (qb y hy) (qc _)
    · exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (qc y) (qb _ (by linarith [not_lt.mp hy]))
  have heq : sigA = fun y => q y / (q y + q (1 - y)) := by
    funext y
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs with hh1 hh2
    · rw [qa y hh1, zero_div]
    · have hy : 0 < y := not_le.mp hh1
      rw [qa (1 - y) (by linarith), add_zero, div_self (qb y hy).ne']
    · have hy : 0 < y := not_le.mp hh1
      rw [qd y hy, qd (1 - y) (by linarith [not_le.mp hh2])]
  have sigC : Continuous sigA := by
    rw [heq]
    exact hqC.div (hqC.add (hqC.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)))
      (fun y => (hDpos y).ne')
  have sig0 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → sigA y = 0 := fun y hy => by unfold sigA; simp [hy]
  have sig1 : ∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → sigA y = 1 := fun y hy => by
    unfold sigA; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hy]
  have sigNN : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA y := fun y => by
    rw [heq]
    show 0 ≤ q y / (q y + q (1 - y))
    exact div_nonneg (qc y) (hDpos y).le
  have sigLe1 : ∀ y : ℝ, sigA y ≤ 1 := fun y => by
    rw [heq]
    show q y / (q y + q (1 - y)) ≤ 1
    rw [div_le_one (hDpos y)]; linarith [qc (1 - y)]
  
  have bmpC : Continuous rfpBmp := by
    have e : rfpBmp = fun t => sigA (1 + t / (3 / 20)) * sigA (1 - t / (3 / 20)) := rfl
    rw [e]
    exact (sigC.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.div_const _))).mul
      (sigC.comp (continuous_const.sub (continuous_id.div_const _)))
  have bmp0 : ∀ t : ℝ, 3 / 20 ≤ |t| → rfpBmp t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpBmp
    rcases le_abs'.mp ht with h | h
    · have : t / (3 / 20) ≤ -1 := by rw [div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
      rw [sig0 (1 + t / (3 / 20)) (by linarith), zero_mul]
    · have : 1 ≤ t / (3 / 20) := by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
      rw [sig0 (1 - t / (3 / 20)) (by linarith), mul_zero]
  have bmp1 : rfpBmp 0 = 1 := by
    unfold rfpBmp
    rw [show (1 : ℝ) + 0 / (3 / 20) = 1 by norm_num, show (1 : ℝ) - 0 / (3 / 20) = 1 by norm_num,
      sig1 1 le_rfl]
    norm_num
  have bmpNN : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpBmp t := fun t => by
    unfold rfpBmp; exact mul_nonneg (sigNN _) (sigNN _)
  
  have hl2 : P.lam ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 10000 := by nlinarith
  have hρ1 : P.ρ < 1 := by linarith
  have SigC : Continuous rfpSigI := by
    have e : rfpSigI = fun t => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, sigA s := rfl
    rw [e]
    exact intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive (fun a b => sigC.intervalIntegrable a b) 0
  have tailC : Continuous (fun y => tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh))
      (Real.exp y) / (1 - P.ρ)) := by
    unfold tailFac
    have hlog : Continuous (fun y => Real.log (Real.exp y / Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh))) :=
      (Real.continuous_exp.div_const _).log
        (fun y => (div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (Real.exp_pos _)).ne')
    exact (continuous_const.sub (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub
      (sigC.comp ((hlog.add continuous_const).div_const _))))).div_const _
  have tailNZ : ∀ y : ℝ, tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh))
      (Real.exp y) / (1 - P.ρ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro y
    unfold tailFac
    have key : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → 0 < 1 - P.ρ * (1 - s) := fun s hs => by nlinarith
    exact div_ne_zero (key _ (sigNN _)).ne' (by linarith)
  have lamC : Continuous (rfpLam P) := by
    have e : rfpLam P = fun y => Real.log P.Pst + y / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y
        - P.lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 P.Md)
        - (1 - P.lam) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam)
        + (1 - P.h) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1)
        - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) * Real.log 2
        + Real.log (tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) / (1 - P.ρ)) :=
      rfl
    rw [e]
    refine Continuous.add ?_ (tailC.log tailNZ)
    refine Continuous.sub ?_ ((sigC.comp ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).div_const _)).mul
      continuous_const)
    refine Continuous.add ?_ (continuous_const.mul (SigC.comp
      (((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).sub continuous_const).sub continuous_const)))
    refine Continuous.sub ?_ (continuous_const.mul (SigC.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)))
    refine Continuous.sub ?_ (continuous_const.mul (SigC.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)))
    refine Continuous.sub ?_ (continuous_const.mul SigC)
    exact continuous_const.add (continuous_id.div_const _)
  have thC : Continuous (rfpTh P) := by
    have e : rfpTh P = fun y => 1 - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) := rfl
    rw [e]
    exact continuous_const.sub (sigC.comp ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).div_const _))
  have th01 : ∀ v : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpTh P v ∧ rfpTh P v ≤ 1 := fun v => by
    unfold rfpTh
    constructor <;> linarith [sigNN ((v - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60), sigLe1 ((v - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60)]
  
  have hL : 20 < 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := by
    have h2' : (2:ℝ) ≤ 1 / P.lam := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith
    have := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) h2'
    linarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
  have e4 : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam = rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 13 / P.lam := rfl
  have e5 : rfpY5 P.Md P.lam = rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  have h13 : 0 < 13 / P.lam := by positivity
  have hmarg : rfpY3 P.Md P.lam < rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 63 / 20 := by linarith
  have psiSupp : ∀ y : ℝ, rfpPsi P y ≠ 0 → rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 63 / 20 < y := by
    intro y hy
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    apply hy
    have h3 : 3 / 20 ≤ |y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3| := by
      rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith
    have h4 : 3 / 20 ≤ |y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1| := by
      rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith
    unfold rfpPsi
    rw [bmp0 _ h3, bmp0 _ h4]; ring
  have psiTh : ∀ y : ℝ, rfpPsi P y ≠ 0 → rfpTh P y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hy' := psiSupp y hy
    have hge : 1 ≤ (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60 := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
    unfold rfpTh
    rw [sig1 _ hge]; ring
  have psiZero : ∀ v : ℝ, v ≤ rfpY3 P.Md P.lam → rfpPsi P v = 0 := by
    intro v hv
    by_contra hne
    have := psiSupp v hne
    linarith
  
  have wC : Continuous (fun y => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y)) :=
    Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul lamC)
  have b1C : Continuous (fun y => rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3)) :=
    bmpC.comp ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).add continuous_const)
  have b2C : Continuous (fun y => rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)) :=
    bmpC.comp ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).add continuous_const)
  have b1S : HasCompactSupport (fun y => rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3)) := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro
      (isCompact_Icc (a := rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 63 / 20) (b := rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 57 / 20)) ?_
    intro y hy
    apply bmp0
    rw [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at hy
    rcases hy with hy | hy
    · rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith
    · rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith
  have b2S : HasCompactSupport (fun y => rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)) := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro
      (isCompact_Icc (a := rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 23 / 20) (b := rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 17 / 20)) ?_
    intro y hy
    apply bmp0
    rw [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at hy
    rcases hy with hy | hy
    · rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith
    · rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith
  have g1I : Integrable (fun y => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3)) :=
    (wC.mul b1C).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport b1S.mul_left
  have g2I : Integrable (fun y => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)) :=
    (wC.mul b2C).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport b2S.mul_left
  have Bpos : 0 < ∫ y, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1) := by
    refine Continuous.integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
      (x := rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1) (wC.mul b2C) b2S.mul_left ?_ ?_
    · intro y
      exact mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (bmpNN _)
    · show Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1)) *
        rfpBmp (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1) ≠ 0
      rw [show rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 = 0 by ring, bmp1, mul_one]
      exact (Real.exp_pos _).ne'
  have Heq : (fun y => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y) = fun y =>
      Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3) -
        rfpKa P * (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)) := by
    funext y; unfold rfpPsi; ring
  have HI : Integrable (fun y => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y) := by
    rw [Heq]; exact g1I.sub (g2I.const_mul _)
  have H0 : ∫ y, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y = 0 := by
    rw [Heq, integral_sub g1I (g2I.const_mul _), integral_const_mul]
    unfold rfpKa
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ Bpos.ne', sub_self]
  have hHset : ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * rfpPsi P v =
      ∫ v, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * rfpPsi P v := by
    apply setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero
    intro v hv
    have hv' : v ≤ Real.log x := by simpa using hv
    have hyle : Real.log x ≤ rfpY3 P.Md P.lam := by
      have hx' : x ≤ Real.exp (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam) := by
        have h := hxle
        unfold rfpXk at h
        rwa [sub_zero] at h
      exact (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hx).2 hx'
    rw [psiZero v (by linarith), mul_zero]
  
  have ptw0 : ∀ e : ℝ, -2 < e → e < 2 → ∀ y, Real.exp y * rfpF P (Real.exp y) e ^ 2 =
      (Real.exp (rfpLam P y) ^ 2 * ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) +
        P.ca e * (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y)) / 2 := by
    intro e he1 he2 y
    have hf0 : 0 < (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
    have hcaψ : |P.ca e * rfpPsi P y| ≤ 1 / 2 := (hca e he1 he2).2 y
    have hE : Real.exp y ≠ 0 := (Real.exp_pos y).ne'
    have hsq : Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca e * rfpPsi P y) ^ 2 = 1 + P.ca e * rfpPsi P y := by
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
      have := neg_abs_le (P.ca e * rfpPsi P y)
      linarith
    have hrp : ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) = (((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_comm (2:ℝ) (rfpTh P y), Real.rpow_mul hf0.le, Real.rpow_two]
    have hcross : Real.exp (rfpLam P y) ^ 2 * ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) * rfpPsi P y =
        Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpPsi P y := by
      by_cases hψ : rfpPsi P y = 0
      · rw [hψ]; ring
      · rw [psiTh y hψ, mul_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one, sq, ← Real.exp_add, two_mul]
    have hS : Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp y) ^ 2 = 2 * Real.exp y := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
    unfold rfpF rfpE
    rw [Real.log_exp, div_pow, hS, mul_pow, mul_pow, hsq, ← hrp]
    generalize ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P y) = R at hcross ⊢
    rw [← hcross]
    field_simp
  
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, G = fun e v =>
      Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * Real.exp (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨G', hG'⟩ : ∃ G' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, G' = fun e v =>
      Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * (Real.exp (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2)) *
        (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * (2 * e / (1 + e ^ 2)))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hGv : ∀ e v, G e v =
      Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * Real.exp (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2)) :=
    fun e v => by rw [hG]
  have hG'v : ∀ e v, G' e v = Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) *
      (Real.exp (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2)) *
        (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * (2 * e / (1 + e ^ 2)))) := fun e v => by rw [hG']
  have Kle : ∀ e v : ℝ, Real.exp (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2)) ≤ 1 := by
    intro e v
    have hlg := Real.log_nonneg (show (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + e ^ 2 by nlinarith [sq_nonneg e])
    have hneg : -(2 * rfpTh P v) * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2) ≤ 0 := by nlinarith [(th01 v).1]
    calc Real.exp (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2)) ≤ Real.exp 0 := Real.exp_le_exp.2 hneg
      _ = 1 := Real.exp_zero
  have KC : ∀ e : ℝ, Continuous (fun v => Real.exp (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2))) :=
    fun e => Real.continuous_exp.comp ((continuous_const.mul thC).neg.mul continuous_const)
  have GC : ∀ e : ℝ, Continuous (G e) := fun e => by
    rw [hG]; exact wC.mul (KC e)
  have G'C : ∀ e : ℝ, Continuous (G' e) := fun e => by
    rw [hG']; exact wC.mul ((KC e).mul ((continuous_const.mul thC).neg.mul continuous_const))
  have hGn : ∀ e v, ‖G e v‖ ≤ Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) := by
    intro e v
    rw [hGv, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (Real.exp_pos _))]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (Real.exp_pos _).le (Kle e v)
  have hGlow : ∀ e v, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) ≤ Real.exp (2 * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2)) * G e v := by
    intro e v
    rw [hGv, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (Real.exp (2 * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2))), mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
    apply le_mul_of_one_le_right (Real.exp_pos _).le
    apply Real.one_le_exp
    have hlg := Real.log_nonneg (show (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + e ^ 2 by nlinarith [sq_nonneg e])
    nlinarith [(th01 v).2, (th01 v).1]
  have hr1 : ∀ e : ℝ, |2 * e / (1 + e ^ 2)| ≤ 1 := by
    intro e
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 1 + e ^ 2), div_le_one (by positivity),
      abs_mul, abs_two]
    nlinarith [sq_abs e, sq_nonneg (|e| - 1)]
  have hr2 : ∀ e : ℝ, |2 * e / (1 + e ^ 2)| ≤ 2 * |e| := by
    intro e
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 1 + e ^ 2), div_le_iff₀ (by positivity),
      abs_mul, abs_two]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg e) (sq_nonneg e)]
  have hG'b : ∀ e v, ‖G' e v‖ ≤ Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * (2 * |2 * e / (1 + e ^ 2)|) := by
    intro e v
    rw [hG'v, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _),
      abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _),
      abs_of_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * rfpTh P v by linarith [(th01 v).1])]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.exp_pos _).le
    have hK := Kle e v
    have hθ := (th01 v).2
    have hθ0 := (th01 v).1
    have ha := abs_nonneg (2 * e / (1 + e ^ 2))
    have hθa := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hθ ha
    calc Real.exp (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2)) * (2 * rfpTh P v * |2 * e / (1 + e ^ 2)|)
        ≤ 1 * (2 * |2 * e / (1 + e ^ 2)|) :=
          mul_le_mul hK (by linarith) (mul_nonneg (by linarith) ha) zero_le_one
      _ = 2 * |2 * e / (1 + e ^ 2)| := one_mul _
  have hD : ∀ v e : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun e => G e v) (G' e v) e := by
    intro v e
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => 1 + e ^ 2) (2 * e) e := by
      convert (hasDerivAt_pow 2 e).const_add 1 using 1
      norm_num
    have h2 := ((h1.log (by positivity)).const_mul (-(2 * rfpTh P v))).exp.const_mul
      (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v))
    rw [hG, hG']
    exact h2
  
  have keyPi : ∀ e : ℝ, -2 < e → e < 2 →
      leadPi (rfpF P) x e = -(1 / 2) * ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), G e v := by
    intro e he1 he2
    have ptw : ∀ v, Real.exp v * rfpF P (Real.exp v) e ^ 2 =
        (G e v + P.ca e * (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * rfpPsi P v)) / 2 := by
      intro v
      have hR : ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (2 * rfpTh P v) =
          Real.exp (-(2 * rfpTh P v) * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2)) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by positivity), Real.log_inv]
        congr 1; ring
      have hE2 : Real.exp (rfpLam P v) ^ 2 = Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) := by
        rw [sq, ← Real.exp_add, two_mul]
      rw [ptw0 e he1 he2 v, hGv, hR, hE2]
    have hcv := integral_comp_exp_Ioi (fun x' => rfpF P x' e ^ 2) (Real.log x)
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hcv
    rw [Real.exp_log hx] at hcv
    unfold leadPi
    rw [← hcv, show (fun v => Real.exp v * rfpF P (Real.exp v) e ^ 2) = fun v =>
        (G e v + P.ca e * (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * rfpPsi P v)) / 2 from funext ptw,
      integral_div]
    have HIo : Integrable (fun v => P.ca e * (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * rfpPsi P v))
        (volume.restrict (Ioi (Real.log x))) := Integrable.const_mul HI.integrableOn (P.ca e)
    by_cases hGI : Integrable (G e) (volume.restrict (Ioi (Real.log x)))
    · rw [integral_add hGI HIo, integral_const_mul, hHset, H0]
      ring
    · have hnot : ¬ Integrable (fun v => G e v + P.ca e * (Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) * rfpPsi P v))
          (volume.restrict (Ioi (Real.log x))) := by
        intro hI
        apply hGI
        refine (hI.sub HIo).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun v => ?_)
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
        ring
      rw [integral_undef hGI, integral_undef hnot]
      ring
  
  have hη2 : -2 < η := by linarith
  have hη2' : η < 2 := by linarith
  by_cases wI : IntegrableOn (fun v => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v)) (Ioi (Real.log x))
  · have GI : ∀ e : ℝ, Integrable (G e) (volume.restrict (Ioi (Real.log x))) := fun e =>
      Integrable.mono' wI (GC e).aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ (fun v => hGn e v))
    have hdΦ := (hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (μ := volume.restrict (Ioi (Real.log x))) (F := G) (F' := G') (x₀ := η)
      (bound := fun v => 2 * Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v)) Filter.univ_mem
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun e => (GC e).aestronglyMeasurable)) (GI η)
      (G'C η).aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ (fun v e _ => (hG'b e v).trans (by
        have := hr1 e
        have := (Real.exp_pos (2 * rfpLam P v)).le
        nlinarith)))
      (Integrable.const_mul wI 2)
      (ae_of_all _ (fun v e _ => hD v e))).2
    constructor
    · have hΦb := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (μ := volume.restrict (Ioi (Real.log x)))
        wI (ae_of_all _ (fun v => hGn η v))
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hΦb
      rw [keyPi η hη2 hη2', abs_mul, show |(-(1 / 2 : ℝ))| = 1 / 2 by norm_num]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hΦb (by norm_num)
    · have hev : (fun e => leadPi (rfpF P) x e) =ᶠ[nhds η]
          (fun e => -(1 / 2) * ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), G e v) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hη2 hη2') (fun e he => keyPi e he.1 he.2)
      have hder : profEtaD (leadPi (rfpF P)) x η =
          -(1 / 2) * ∫ v in Ioi (Real.log x), G' η v := by
        unfold profEtaD
        rw [hev.deriv_eq]
        exact (hdΦ.const_mul (-(1 / 2))).deriv
      have hb4 : ∀ v, ‖G' η v‖ ≤ 4 * |η| * Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) := by
        intro v
        have h1' := hG'b η v
        have h2' := hr2 η
        have h3' := (Real.exp_pos (2 * rfpLam P v)).le
        have h4' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2' h3'
        nlinarith
      have hΨ := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (μ := volume.restrict (Ioi (Real.log x)))
        (Integrable.const_mul wI (4 * |η|)) (ae_of_all _ hb4)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, integral_const_mul] at hΨ
      rw [hder, abs_mul, show |(-(1 / 2 : ℝ))| = 1 / 2 by norm_num]
      linarith
  · 
    have hGnot : ∀ e : ℝ, ¬ Integrable (G e) (volume.restrict (Ioi (Real.log x))) := by
      intro e hGI
      apply wI
      refine Integrable.mono' (hGI.const_mul (Real.exp (2 * Real.log (1 + e ^ 2))))
        wC.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ (fun v => ?_))
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      exact hGlow e v
    have hz : ∀ e : ℝ, -2 < e → e < 2 → leadPi (rfpF P) x e = 0 := by
      intro e he1 he2
      rw [keyPi e he1 he2, integral_undef (hGnot e), mul_zero]
    rw [integral_undef wI, mul_zero, mul_zero]
    constructor
    · rw [hz η hη2 hη2', abs_zero]
    · have hev : (fun e => leadPi (rfpF P) x e) =ᶠ[nhds η] (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hη2 hη2') (fun e he => hz e he.1 he.2)
      unfold profEtaD
      rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const, abs_zero]

signature.name: rfp_inter_mass
signature.statement: ∀ P : RfpPar, RfpRegime P → ∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → y ≤ rfpY3 P.Md P.lam → ∫ v in Ioi y, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P hR y hy1 hy3
  obtain ⟨hMd, hPst, hl0, hl1, hh0, hhl, hρ0, hρh, hT1, hLh⟩ := hR
  
  have hl2 : P.lam ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 10000 := by nlinarith
  have hhlam : P.h ≤ P.lam := by nlinarith
  have hρ1 : P.ρ < 1 := by linarith
  have hρq : P.ρ ≤ 1 / 4 := by linarith
  have h1ρ : 0 < 1 - P.ρ := by linarith
  have hlogh : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.h) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hh0]; linarith)
  have hT0 : 0 ≤ P.T1 := by linarith
  have hL : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / P.lam) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith)
  have hexpMd : 0 < Real.exp P.Md := Real.exp_pos _
  have hlam13 : 0 < 13 / P.lam := by positivity
  have h13 : 1 ≤ 13 / P.lam := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hl0]; linarith
  have eY2 : rfpY2 P.Md = Real.exp P.Md + 11 := rfl
  have eY3 : rfpY3 P.Md P.lam = rfpY2 P.Md + 1 + 60 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  have eY4 : rfpY4 P.Md P.lam = rfpY3 P.Md P.lam + 13 / P.lam := rfl
  have eY5 : rfpY5 P.Md P.lam = rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / P.lam) := rfl
  have eYb : rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh = rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 2 + P.T1 + P.Lh + 3 := rfl
  
  have sig0 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → sigA y = 0 := fun y hy => by unfold sigA; simp [hy]
  have sig1 : ∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → sigA y = 1 := fun y hy => by
    unfold sigA; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hy]
  have sigR : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA y ∧ sigA y ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
    · have ha := Real.exp_pos (-1 / y ^ 2)
      have hb := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2)
      exact ⟨div_nonneg ha.le (by linarith), (div_le_one (by linarith)).2 (by linarith)⟩
  have sigM : Measurable sigA := by
    unfold sigA
    refine Measurable.ite (measurableSet_le measurable_id measurable_const) measurable_const
      (Measurable.ite (measurableSet_le measurable_const measurable_id) measurable_const ?_)
    fun_prop
  have sigInt : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable sigA MeasureTheory.volume a b := by
    intro a b
    refine (intervalIntegrable_const (c := (1:ℝ))).mono_fun' sigM.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by
      show ‖sigA x‖ ≤ 1
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [(sigR x).1, (sigR x).2])
  
  have hI1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → rfpSigI t = rfpSigI 1 + (t - 1) := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpSigI
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (sigInt 0 1) (sigInt 1 t)]
    congr 1
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (1:ℝ))]
    · simp
    · intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le ht] at hs
      exact sig1 s hs.1
  have hI0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → rfpSigI t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold rfpSigI
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ))]
    · simp
    · intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge ht] at hs
      exact sig0 s hs.2
  have hD : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → 0 ≤ rfpSigI b - rfpSigI a ∧ rfpSigI b - rfpSigI a ≤ b - a := by
    intro a b hab
    have e : rfpSigI b - rfpSigI a = ∫ s in a..b, sigA s := by
      unfold rfpSigI
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (sigInt 0 b) (sigInt 0 a)
    rw [e]
    refine ⟨intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hab (fun u _ => (sigR u).1), ?_⟩
    have := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hab (sigInt a b)
      (intervalIntegrable_const (c := (1:ℝ))) (fun x _ => (sigR x).2)
    simpa using this
  have tauR : ∀ a b : ℝ, 1 - P.ρ ≤ tailFac P.ρ a b ∧ tailFac P.ρ a b ≤ 1 := by
    intro a b
    unfold tailFac
    obtain ⟨s0, s1⟩ := sigR ((Real.log (b / a) + 2) / 2)
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  
  have hSm : Measurable rfpSigI := (intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive sigInt 0).measurable
  have hT : Measurable (fun v : ℝ =>
      tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp v)) := by
    unfold tailFac
    have hs : Measurable (fun v : ℝ => sigA ((Real.log (Real.exp v /
        Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) + 2) / 2)) :=
      sigM.comp ((((Real.measurable_exp.div_const _).log).add_const _).div_const _)
    exact measurable_const.sub (measurable_const.mul (measurable_const.sub hs))
  have hLm : Measurable (rfpLam P) := by
    unfold rfpLam
    have m1 : Measurable (fun v : ℝ => rfpSigI (v - rfpY2 P.Md)) :=
      hSm.comp (measurable_id.sub_const _)
    have m2 : Measurable (fun v : ℝ => rfpSigI (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam)) :=
      hSm.comp (measurable_id.sub_const _)
    have m3 : Measurable (fun v : ℝ => rfpSigI (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1)) :=
      hSm.comp (((measurable_id.sub_const _).sub_const _).sub_const _)
    have m4 : Measurable (fun v : ℝ => sigA ((v - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60)) :=
      sigM.comp ((measurable_id.sub_const _).div_const _)
    have m5 : Measurable (fun v : ℝ => Real.log (tailFac P.ρ
        (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp v) / (1 - P.ρ))) :=
      (hT.div_const _).log
    exact (((((((measurable_const.add (measurable_id.div_const _)).sub
      (hSm.const_mul _)).sub (m1.const_mul _)).sub (m2.const_mul _)).add
      (m3.const_mul _)).sub (m4.mul_const _)).add m5)
  
  have hint : IntegrableOn (fun v => Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v)) (Ioi y) := by
    have hInn : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ rfpSigI t := by
      intro t
      rcases le_total t 0 with ht | ht
      · rw [hI0 t ht]
      · have := (hD 0 t ht).1
        rw [hI0 0 le_rfl] at this
        linarith
    have hIle : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → rfpSigI t ≤ t := by
      intro t ht
      have := (hD 0 t ht).2
      rw [hI0 0 le_rfl] at this
      linarith
    have hIge : ∀ t : ℝ, t - 1 ≤ rfpSigI t := by
      intro t
      rcases le_total 1 t with ht | ht
      · rw [hI1 t ht]; linarith [hInn 1]
      · linarith [hInn t]
    have hEnv : ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ y : ℝ, rfpLam P y ≤ B + y / 10 - (3 / 5 + P.h) * max y 0 := by
      obtain ⟨B1, hB1⟩ : ∃ B1 : ℝ, B1 = Real.log P.Pst - Real.log (1 - P.ρ) +
          (3 / 5 + P.h) * (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨B2, hB2⟩ : ∃ B2 : ℝ, B2 = Real.log P.Pst + 3 / 5 + P.lam * (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) +
          (1 - P.lam) * (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1) - (1 - P.h) * (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1) -
          Real.log (1 - P.ρ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨max B1 B2, ?_⟩
      intro y
      have hY1 : 0 < rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1 := by linarith
      have U1 : 0 ≤ sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) * Real.log 2 :=
        mul_nonneg (sigR _).1 (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num))
      have U2 : Real.log (tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) /
          (1 - P.ρ)) ≤ -Real.log (1 - P.ρ) := by
        obtain ⟨t0, t1⟩ := tauR (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y)
        have tp : 0 < tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) := by
          linarith
        rw [Real.log_div tp.ne' h1ρ.ne']
        have := Real.log_le_log tp t1
        rw [Real.log_one] at this
        linarith
      have hB1le := le_max_left B1 B2
      have hB2le := le_max_right B1 B2
      unfold rfpLam
      rcases le_or_gt y (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1) with hy | hy
      · rw [hI0 (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) (by linarith)]
        have m1 : 0 ≤ 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y := mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hInn _)
        have m2 : 0 ≤ P.lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 P.Md) := mul_nonneg hl0.le (hInn _)
        have m3 : 0 ≤ (1 - P.lam) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) :=
          mul_nonneg (by linarith) (hInn _)
        have hmax : max y 0 ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1 := max_le hy hY1.le
        have m4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmax (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 3 / 5 + P.h by linarith)
        linarith
      · rw [max_eq_left (show (0:ℝ) ≤ y by linarith)]
        have m1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hIge y) (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 3 / 5 by norm_num)
        have m2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hIge (y - rfpY2 P.Md)) hl0.le
        have m3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hIge (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam))
          (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - P.lam by linarith)
        have m4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hIle (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) (by linarith))
          (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - P.h by linarith)
        linarith
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hEnv
    have hdom : IntegrableOn (fun v => Real.exp (2 * B) * Real.exp (-(1 / 5) * v)) (Ioi y) :=
      (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi y (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1 / 5)).const_mul _
    refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.mono' hdom ((hLm.const_mul 2).exp.aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v => ?_)
    show ‖Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P v)‖ ≤ Real.exp (2 * B) * Real.exp (-(1 / 5) * v)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), ← Real.exp_add]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
    have := hB v
    rcases le_total 0 v with hv | hv
    · rw [max_eq_left hv] at this
      have := mul_nonneg hh0.le hv
      linarith
    · rw [max_eq_right hv] at this
      linarith
  
  have hdec : ∀ v : ℝ, y ≤ v →
      rfpLam P v ≤ rfpLam P y - (v - y) / 2 - Real.log (1 - P.ρ) := by
    intro v hyv
    have hc1 : rfpY2 P.Md + 62 ≤ rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1 := by linarith
    have hE : -(P.lam * (rfpSigI (v - rfpY2 P.Md) - rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 P.Md)))
        - (1 - P.lam) * (rfpSigI (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) - rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam))
        + (1 - P.h) * (rfpSigI (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1)
          - rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1)) ≤ 0 := by
      rcases le_or_gt v (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1) with hv | hv
      · 
        rw [hI0 (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) (by linarith),
          hI0 (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) (by linarith)]
        have d2 := (hD (y - rfpY2 P.Md) (v - rfpY2 P.Md) (by linarith)).1
        have d5 := (hD (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (by linarith)).1
        have q2 := mul_nonneg hl0.le d2
        have q5 := mul_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - P.lam by linarith) d5
        linarith
      · rcases le_or_gt y (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1) with hy | hy
        · 
          rw [hI0 (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) (by linarith),
            hI1 (v - rfpY2 P.Md) (by linarith), hI1 (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (by linarith)]
          have u1 := (hD 0 (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) (by linarith)).2
          rw [hI0 0 le_rfl] at u1
          have u2 := (hD (y - rfpY2 P.Md) (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1 - rfpY2 P.Md)
            (by linarith)).1
          rw [hI1 (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1 - rfpY2 P.Md) (by linarith)] at u2
          have u5 := (hD (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1 - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam)
            (by linarith)).1
          rw [hI1 (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1 - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (by linarith)] at u5
          have q2 := mul_nonneg hl0.le u2
          have q5 := mul_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - P.lam by linarith) u5
          have q1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left u1 (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - P.h by linarith)
          have q0 := mul_nonneg hh0.le
            (show (0:ℝ) ≤ v - (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1 + P.T1) by linarith)
          linarith
        · 
          rw [hI1 (v - rfpY2 P.Md) (by linarith), hI1 (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (by linarith),
            hI1 (y - rfpY2 P.Md) (by linarith), hI1 (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam) (by linarith)]
          have u1 := (hD (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1) (v - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1)
            (by linarith)).2
          have q1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left u1 (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - P.h by linarith)
          have q0 := mul_nonneg hh0.le (show (0:ℝ) ≤ v - y by linarith)
          linarith
    have s4 : rfpSigI v - rfpSigI y = v - y := by
      rw [hI1 v (by linarith), hI1 y hy1]; ring
    have sy : sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) = 0 := by
      apply sig0
      apply div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg _ (by norm_num)
      linarith
    have sv : 0 ≤ sigA ((v - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) * Real.log 2 :=
      mul_nonneg (sigR _).1 (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num))
    have ty0 : tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) = 1 - P.ρ := by

    rw [hexp] at this

  have hmI : ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h = Real.Gamma (1 + h) := by
    have := Real.Gamma_eq_integral h1h
    rw [hexp] at this
    exact this.symm
  have hpt : ∀ v : ℝ, 0 < v → 0 < Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h) ∧
      Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h) ≤ Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h := by
    intro v hv
    have hZv : 0 ≤ Z * v := mul_nonneg hZ hv.le
    have hw : 0 < Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h := mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hv _)
    have hP : 0 < (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith) _
    have hP1 : (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h) ≤ 1 :=
      Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by linarith) (by linarith)
    exact ⟨mul_pos hw hP, mul_le_of_le_one_right hw.le hP1⟩
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h)) := by
    fun_prop
  have hInt : IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h)) (Ioi 0) := by
    refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.mono' hm hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine (ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi).mono (fun v hv => ?_)
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := hpt v hv
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos a]
    exact b
  have hup : ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h) ≤ Real.Gamma (1 + h) := by
    rw [← hmI]
    exact MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on hInt hm measurableSet_Ioi (fun v hv => (hpt v hv).2)
  have hpos : 0 < ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h) := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae
      ((ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi).mono (fun v hv => (hpt v hv).1.le)) hInt]
    have hsub : Ioi (0:ℝ) ⊆ Function.support
        (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h)) ∩ Ioi 0 :=
      fun v hv => ⟨Function.mem_support.mpr (hpt v hv).1.ne', hv⟩
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ (MeasureTheory.measure_mono hsub)
    simp [Real.volume_Ioi]
  unfold heatProfile
  refine ⟨mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hΓ) hpos, ?_⟩
  rw [inv_mul_le_iff₀ hΓ, mul_one]
  exact hup

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (H : ℝ → ℝ) (L a b : ℝ), 0 < a → a < b → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H (Ioi 0) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv k H Z| ≤ C) → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |H Z - 1| ≤ L * Z) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ e x η : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ 1 → a ≤ x → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun η' => Real.smoothTransition ((x - a) / (b - a)) * (H (2 * (1 - η' ^ 2) * e / x) - 1)) η| ≤ C * e / x
