proof.tactics:
by
  intro H L a b ha hab hHs hHb hL m
  choose Cf hCf using hHb
  
  have interp : ∀ (n : ℕ) (B t : ℝ), 1 ≤ n → 1 ≤ B → 0 ≤ t → t ≤ B →
      ∃ D : ℝ, (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → t ≤ D ^ i) ∧ D ^ n = B ^ (n - 1) * t := by
    intro n B t hn hB ht htB
    have hB0 : 0 < B := by linarith
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s = t / B := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := by rw [hs]; exact div_nonneg ht hB0.le
    have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := by rw [hs]; exact (div_le_one hB0).2 htB
    have hts : t = B * s := by rw [hs]; field_simp
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = s ^ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := by rw [hr]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg hs0 _
    have hr1 : r ≤ 1 := by rw [hr]; exact Real.rpow_le_one hs0 hs1 (by positivity)
    have hrn : r ^ n = s := by rw [hr]; exact Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow hs0 (by omega)
    refine ⟨B * r, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i hi hin
      rw [mul_pow, hts, ← hrn]
      have h1 : B ≤ B ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hB (by omega)
      have h2 : r ^ n ≤ r ^ i := pow_le_pow_of_le_one hr0 hr1 hin
      exact mul_le_mul h1 h2 (pow_nonneg hr0 _) (by positivity)
    · rw [mul_pow, hrn, hts]
      obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_succ]
      ring
  
  have quad : ∀ (c y : ℝ) (i : ℕ), 1 ≤ i → -1 ≤ y → y ≤ 1 →
      |iteratedDeriv i (fun y' : ℝ => c * (1 - y' ^ 2)) y| ≤ 2 * |c| := by
    intro c y i hi hy1 hy2
    have hd1 : deriv (fun y' : ℝ => c * (1 - y' ^ 2)) = fun y' => -(2 * c * y') := by
      funext y'
      exact (((hasDerivAt_pow 2 y').const_sub 1).const_mul c).deriv.trans (by norm_num <;> ring)
    have hd2 : deriv (fun y' : ℝ => -(2 * c * y')) = fun _ => -(2 * c) := by
      funext y'
      exact ((hasDerivAt_id' y').const_mul (2 * c)).neg.deriv.trans (by ring)
    have hd3 : deriv (fun _ : ℝ => -(2 * c)) = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      funext y'
      exact deriv_const _ _
    match i, hi with
    | 1, _ =>
      rw [iteratedDeriv_one, hd1]
      rw [abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_two]
      have : |y| ≤ 1 := abs_le.2 ⟨hy1, hy2⟩
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg c, abs_nonneg y]
    | 2, _ =>
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', iteratedDeriv_one, hd1, hd2]
      simp [abs_mul]
    | k + 3, _ =>
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', iteratedDeriv_succ', iteratedDeriv_succ', hd1, hd2, hd3,
        iteratedDeriv_const]
      split_ifs <;> simp
  
  have comp : ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (M D : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ →
      (∀ y : ℝ, -1 < y → y < 1 → 0 < ψ y) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv i H Z| ≤ M) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → ∀ y : ℝ, -1 < y → y < 1 → |iteratedDeriv i ψ y| ≤ D ^ i) →
      ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
        |iteratedDeriv n (fun y => H (ψ y)) η| ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) * M * D ^ n := by
    intro ψ n M D hψ hpos hHb' hψb η h1 h2
    have hη : η ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have hz : ψ η ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ) := hpos η h1 h2
    have hA : ∀ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i H (Ioi 0) (ψ η)‖ ≤ M := by
      intro i hi
      rw [norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_norm_iteratedDerivWithin,
        iteratedDerivWithin_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioi hz, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact hHb' i hi _ hz
    have hBd : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n →
        ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ψ (Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) η‖ ≤ D ^ i := by
      intro i hi hin
      rw [norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_norm_iteratedDerivWithin,
        iteratedDerivWithin_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioo hη, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact hψb i hi hin η h1 h2
    have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hHs hψ.contDiffOn
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top) isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn isOpen_Ioo.uniqueDiffOn
      (fun y hy => hpos y hy.1 hy.2) hη hA hBd
    rw [norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_norm_iteratedDerivWithin,
      iteratedDerivWithin_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioo hη, Real.norm_eq_abs] at key
    exact key
  
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Cf i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by rw [hM]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨B, hBdef⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = max 1 (4 / a) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hB1 : 1 ≤ B := by rw [hBdef]; exact le_max_left _ _
  have hB4 : 4 / a ≤ B := by rw [hBdef]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hB0 : 0 < B := by linarith
  have hrest : 0 ≤ 4 * (m.factorial : ℝ) * M * B ^ (m - 1) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hM0) (pow_nonneg hB0.le _)
  refine ⟨2 * |L| + 4 * (m.factorial : ℝ) * M * B ^ (m - 1), ?_⟩
  intro e x η he he1 hax h1 h2
  have hx : 0 < x := by linarith
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = 2 * e / x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc0 : 0 < c := by rw [hc]; positivity
  have hc2 : c ≤ 2 / a := by
    rw [hc, div_le_div_iff₀ hx ha]
    nlinarith
  have hex : 0 ≤ e / x := by positivity
  have hsplit : ∀ u v : ℝ, (u + v) * e / x = u * (e / x) + v * (e / x) := fun u v => by ring
  have hrw : ∀ η' : ℝ, 2 * (1 - η' ^ 2) * e / x = c * (1 - η' ^ 2) := by
    intro η'; rw [hc]; ring
  simp only [hrw]
  rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field, abs_mul,
    abs_of_nonneg (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg ((x - a) / (b - a)))]
  refine le_trans (mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _)
    (Real.smoothTransition.le_one ((x - a) / (b - a)))) ?_
  cases m with
  | zero =>
    rw [iteratedDeriv_zero]
    have hη2 : 0 < 1 - η ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hZ : 0 < c * (1 - η ^ 2) := mul_pos hc0 hη2
    have hZc : c * (1 - η ^ 2) ≤ c := by nlinarith
    have h1' := hL _ hZ
    have h2' : L * (c * (1 - η ^ 2)) ≤ |L| * c :=
      calc L * (c * (1 - η ^ 2)) ≤ |L| * (c * (1 - η ^ 2)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self L) hZ.le
        _ ≤ |L| * c := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hZc (abs_nonneg L)
    have h3' : |L| * c = 2 * |L| * (e / x) := by rw [hc]; ring
    have h4 := mul_nonneg hrest hex
    rw [hsplit]
    linarith
  | succ k =>
    have hd : deriv (fun η' => H (c * (1 - η' ^ 2)) - 1) = deriv (fun η' => H (c * (1 - η' ^ 2))) :=
      funext fun y => deriv_sub_const 1
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hd, ← iteratedDeriv_succ']
    have h2c : 2 * c ≤ B := by
      have : 4 / a = 2 * (2 / a) := by ring
      linarith
    obtain ⟨D, hD1, hD2⟩ := interp (k + 1) B (2 * c) (by omega) hB1 (by linarith) h2c
    have hMb : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k + 1 → ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv i H Z| ≤ M := by
      intro i hi Z hZ
      calc |iteratedDeriv i H Z| ≤ Cf i := hCf i Z hZ
        _ ≤ |Cf i| := le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ M := by
          rw [hM]
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cf j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
            (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
    have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ => c * (1 - y ^ 2)) :=
      contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_id.pow 2))
    have hpos : ∀ y : ℝ, -1 < y → y < 1 → 0 < c * (1 - y ^ 2) :=
      fun y g1 g2 => mul_pos hc0 (by nlinarith)
    have hψb : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k + 1 → ∀ y : ℝ, -1 < y → y < 1 →
        |iteratedDeriv i (fun y : ℝ => c * (1 - y ^ 2)) y| ≤ D ^ i := by
      intro i hi hin y g1 g2
      calc _ ≤ 2 * |c| := quad c y i hi g1.le g2.le
        _ = 2 * c := by rw [abs_of_pos hc0]
        _ ≤ D ^ i := hD1 i hi hin
    have hfin := comp _ (k + 1) M D hψ hpos hMb hψb η h1 h2
    rw [hD2] at hfin
    have h5 := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg L) hex
    have h6 : ((k + 1).factorial : ℝ) * M * (B ^ (k + 1 - 1) * (2 * c)) =
        4 * ((k + 1).factorial : ℝ) * M * B ^ (k + 1 - 1) * (e / x) := by
      rw [hc]; ring
    rw [hsplit]
    linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (H : ℝ → ℝ) (L a b : ℝ), 0 < a → a < b → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H (Ioi 0) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv k H Z| ≤ C) → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |H Z - 1| ≤ L * Z) → (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Real.smoothTransition ((z.1 - a) / (b - a)) * (H (2 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2) * e / z.1) - 1)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ e x η : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ 1 → 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Real.smoothTransition ((z.1 - a) / (b - a)) * (H (2 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2) * e / z.1) - 1)) (x, η)‖ ≤ C * e

signature.name: heat_edit_joint
signature.statement: ∀ (H : ℝ → ℝ) (L a b : ℝ), 0 < a → a < b → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H (Ioi 0) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv k H Z| ≤ C) → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |H Z - 1| ≤ L * Z) → (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Real.smoothTransition ((z.1 - a) / (b - a)) * (H (2 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2) * e / z.1) - 1)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ e x η : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ 1 → 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Real.smoothTransition ((z.1 - a) / (b - a)) * (H (2 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2) * e / z.1) - 1)) (x, η)‖ ≤ C * e

proof.tactics:
by
  intro H L a b ha hab hH hHb hnear
  have hle : ∀ j : ℕ, (j : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := fun j => by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hba : 0 < b - a := sub_pos.2 hab
  
  have hg1s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition ((y - a) / (b - a))) :=
    (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := ⊤)).comp ((contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).div_const _)
  have hg1b : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ y : ℝ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun y : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition ((y - a) / (b - a))) y‖ ≤ C := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := a) (b := b)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      ((hg1s.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (hle j)).continuousOn)
    refine ⟨max C0 1, le_trans zero_le_one (le_max_right _ _), fun y => ?_⟩
    rcases lt_or_ge y a with hy | hy
    · have hev : (fun y : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition ((y - a) / (b - a))) =ᶠ[nhds y]
          fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hy] with w hw
        have hw' : w < a := hw
        exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
          (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) hba.le)
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
      exact le_trans zero_le_one (le_max_right _ _)
    rcases le_or_gt y b with hy2 | hy2
    · exact (hC0 y ⟨hy, hy2⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · have hev : (fun y : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition ((y - a) / (b - a))) =ᶠ[nhds y]
          fun _ => (1:ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hy2] with w hw
        have hw' : b < w := hw
        exact Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hba]; linarith)
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds]
      rcases j with _ | j
      · simp only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, norm_one]
        exact le_max_right _ _
      · rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_const]
        simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
        exact le_trans zero_le_one (le_max_right _ _)
  
  have hcutcd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Real.smoothTransition ((z.1 - a) / (b - a))) :=
    hg1s.comp contDiff_fst
  have hcutb : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Real.smoothTransition ((z.1 - a) / (b - a))) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := hg1b j
    refine ⟨C, hC0, fun z => ?_⟩
    have e1 : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Real.smoothTransition ((z.1 - a) / (b - a))) =
        (fun y : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition ((y - a) / (b - a))) ∘
          ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) := rfl
    rw [e1, ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right _ hg1s z (hle j)]
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
    have hp : ∏ _i : Fin j, ‖ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_fst_le ℝ ℝ ℝ)
    calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun y : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition ((y - a) / (b - a)))
            ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) z)‖ * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ C := by rw [mul_one]; exact hC _
  
  have hpA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : ℝ => 2 * (1 - η ^ 2)) :=
    contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_id.pow 2))
  have hAcd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2)) :=
    contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_snd.pow 2))
  have hAb : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ, -1 ≤ z.2 → z.2 ≤ 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2)) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := (-1:ℝ)) (b := 1)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      ((hpA.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (hle j)).continuousOn)
    refine ⟨max C0 0, le_max_right _ _, fun z h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    have e1 : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2)) =
        (fun η : ℝ => 2 * (1 - η ^ 2)) ∘ ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) := rfl
    rw [e1, ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right _ hpA z (hle j)]
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
    have hp : ∏ _i : Fin j, ‖ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_snd_le ℝ ℝ ℝ)
    calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η : ℝ => 2 * (1 - η ^ 2))
            ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) z)‖ * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ max C0 0 := by
          rw [mul_one]; exact (hC0 _ ⟨h1, h2⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  choose PA hPA0 hPA using hAb
  
  have hBb : ∀ i : ℕ, ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ, a ≤ z.1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (z.1)⁻¹) z‖ ≤ (i.factorial : ℝ) / a ^ (i + 1) := by
    intro i z hz
    have hz0 : 0 < z.1 := lt_of_lt_of_le ha hz
    have hs1 : IsOpen (Ioi (a / 2)) := isOpen_Ioi
    have hpre : IsOpen ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) ⁻¹' (Ioi (a / 2))) :=
      hs1.preimage (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).continuous
    have hzs : (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) z ∈ Ioi (a / 2) := by
      show a / 2 < z.1; linarith
    have hinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Inv.inv : ℝ → ℝ) (Ioi (a / 2)) :=
      (contDiffOn_inv ℝ).mono (fun y hy => by
        simp only [mem_compl_iff, mem_singleton_iff]
        exact (lt_trans (half_pos ha) hy).ne')
    have key := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) hinv hs1.uniqueDiffOn hpre.uniqueDiffOn hzs (hle i)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hpre hzs, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hs1 hzs] at key
    rw [show (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (z.1)⁻¹) =
      (Inv.inv : ℝ → ℝ) ∘ ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) from rfl, key]
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
    have hp : ∏ _i : Fin i, ‖ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_fst_le ℝ ℝ ℝ)
    have hx : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (Inv.inv : ℝ → ℝ) z.1‖ =
        (i.factorial : ℝ) * (z.1 ^ (i + 1))⁻¹ := by
      have h' : (-1 - (i : ℤ)) = -((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate, iter_deriv_inv, h',
        zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow, one_mul, norm_inv, norm_pow,
        Real.norm_of_nonneg hz0.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
    have hx2 : (z.1 ^ (i + 1))⁻¹ ≤ (a ^ (i + 1))⁻¹ :=
      inv_anti₀ (pow_pos ha _) (pow_le_pow_left₀ ha.le hz _)
    calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (Inv.inv : ℝ → ℝ) ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) z)‖ * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = (i.factorial : ℝ) * (z.1 ^ (i + 1))⁻¹ := by rw [mul_one]; exact hx
      _ ≤ (i.factorial : ℝ) * (a ^ (i + 1))⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx2 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      _ = (i.factorial : ℝ) / a ^ (i + 1) := (div_eq_mul_inv _ _).symm
  
  have hs : IsOpen (Ioi (a / 2) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hAs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2)) (Ioi (a / 2) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
    hAcd.contDiffOn
  have hBs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (z.1)⁻¹) (Ioi (a / 2) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
    contDiffOn_fst.inv (fun z hz => (lt_trans (half_pos ha) hz.1).ne')
  obtain ⟨Y, hYdef⟩ : ∃ Y : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, Y = fun z => 2 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2) * (z.1)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hYcd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Y (Ioi (a / 2) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    rw [hYdef]; exact hAs.mul hBs
  obtain ⟨K, hKdef⟩ : ∃ K : ℕ → ℝ, K = fun i => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1),
      (i.choose j : ℝ) * PA j * ((i - j).factorial / a ^ (i - j + 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hK0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ K i := by
    intro i
    simp only [hKdef]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hPA0 j))
      (div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (pow_pos ha _).le))
  have hYb : ∀ i : ℕ, ∀ x η : ℝ, a ≤ x → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i Y (x, η)‖ ≤ K i := by
    intro i x η hx h1 h2
    have hzs : (x, η) ∈ Ioi (a / 2) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨show a / 2 < x by linarith, h1, h2⟩
    rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hs hzs, hYdef]
    refine (norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le (f := fun z : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2))
      (g := fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (z.1)⁻¹) hAs hBs hs.uniqueDiffOn hzs (hle i)).trans ?_
    simp only [hKdef]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j _
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hs hzs, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (i - j) hs hzs]
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hPA j (x, η) h1.le h2.le) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
      (hBb (i - j) (x, η) hx) (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hPA0 j))
  
  choose CHi hCHi using hHb
  have hGb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ e x η : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ 1 → a ≤ x → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => H (2 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2) * e / z.1) - 1) (x, η)‖
        ≤ C * e := by
    intro k
    rcases k with _ | k
    · refine ⟨2 * |L| / a, div_nonneg (by positivity) ha.le, fun e x η he he1 hx h1 h2 => ?_⟩
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le ha hx
      have hη : 0 < 1 - η ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have hZ0 : 0 < 2 * (1 - η ^ 2) * e / x := div_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos two_pos hη) he) hx0
      have hZ : 2 * (1 - η ^ 2) * e / x ≤ 2 * e / a := by
        rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hx0 ha]
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg η) he.le) ha.le,
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx he.le]
      calc |H (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) * e / x) - 1| ≤ L * (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) * e / x) := hnear _ hZ0
        _ ≤ |L| * (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) * e / x) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self L) hZ0.le
        _ ≤ |L| * (2 * e / a) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hZ (abs_nonneg L)
        _ = 2 * |L| / a * e := by field_simp
    · obtain ⟨CH, hCHdef⟩ : ∃ CH : ℝ, CH = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), |CHi i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨KK, hKKdef⟩ : ∃ KK : ℝ, KK = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), K i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hCH0 : 0 ≤ CH := by rw [hCHdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
      have hKs : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), K i := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hK0 i)
      have hKK1 : 1 ≤ KK := by rw [hKKdef]; linarith
      refine ⟨((k + 1).factorial : ℝ) * CH * KK ^ (k + 1),
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hCH0) (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _),
        fun e x η he he1 hx h1 h2 => ?_⟩
      have hfun : iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1)
          (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => H (2 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2) * e / z.1) - 1) =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) (H ∘ (e • Y)) := by
        have h2' : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => H (2 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2) * e / z.1)) = H ∘ (e • Y) := by
          funext z
          simp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hYdef]
          congr 1
          ring
        rw [← h2']
        funext z
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_right, iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_right]
        simp only [fderiv_sub_const]
      have hzs : (x, η) ∈ Ioi (a / 2) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨show a / 2 < x by linarith, h1, h2⟩
      rw [hfun, ← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (k + 1) hs hzs]
      have hYs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (e • Y) (Ioi (a / 2) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := hYcd.const_smul e
      have hmaps : MapsTo (e • Y) (Ioi (a / 2) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Ioi 0) := by
        intro z hz
        have hz1 : 0 < z.1 := lt_trans (half_pos ha) hz.1
        have hz2 : -1 < z.2 := hz.2.1
        have hz3 : z.2 < 1 := hz.2.2
        show 0 < (e • Y) z
        rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hYdef]
        exact mul_pos he (mul_pos (mul_pos two_pos (by nlinarith)) (inv_pos.2 hz1))
      have hD0 : 0 ≤ e ^ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ := Real.rpow_nonneg he.le _
      have hout : ∀ i ≤ k + 1,
          ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i H (Ioi 0) ((e • Y) (x, η))‖ ≤ CH := by
        intro i hi
        have hy : (e • Y) (x, η) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) := hmaps hzs
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i isOpen_Ioi hy,
          norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs, hCHdef]
        exact ((hCHi i _ hy).trans (le_abs_self _)).trans
          (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |CHi j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg (CHi j))
            (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega)))
      have hin : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k + 1 →
          ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (e • Y) (Ioi (a / 2) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (x, η)‖ ≤
            (e ^ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * KK) ^ i := by
        intro i hi1 hi2
        have hcw : ContDiffWithinAt ℝ i Y (Ioi (a / 2) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (x, η) :=
          (hYcd.of_le (hle i)).contDiffWithinAt hzs
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_const_smul_apply hcw hs.uniqueDiffOn hzs, norm_smul,
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hs hzs, Real.norm_of_nonneg he.le]
        have hYi : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i Y (x, η)‖ ≤ KK := by
          refine (hYb i x η hx h1 h2).trans ?_
          have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := K) (fun j _ => hK0 j)
            (Finset.mem_range.2 (show i < k + 2 by omega))
          rw [hKKdef]; linarith
        have hpow : (e ^ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ i = e ^ (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * i) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_mul he.le, Real.rpow_natCast]
        have hei : e ≤ (e ^ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ i := by
          rw [hpow]
          calc e = e ^ (1:ℝ) := (Real.rpow_one e).symm
            _ ≤ _ := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge he he1 (by
                rw [inv_mul_le_iff₀ (by positivity), mul_one]; exact_mod_cast hi2)
        have hKi : KK ≤ KK ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hKK1 (by omega)
        rw [mul_pow]
        exact mul_le_mul hei (hYi.trans hKi) (norm_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg hD0 _)
      refine (norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hH hYs (hle (k + 1)) isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn
        hs.uniqueDiffOn hmaps hzs hout hin).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      rw [mul_pow, Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow he.le (by omega)]
      ring
  
  have hGcd : ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => H (2 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2) * e / z.1) - 1) (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    intro e he
    have hZ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2) * e / z.1)
        (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
      ((hAcd.mul contDiff_const).contDiffOn).div contDiffOn_fst
        (fun z hz => (show (0:ℝ) < z.1 from hz.1).ne')
    have hmaps : MapsTo (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2) * e / z.1)
        (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Ioi 0) := by
      intro z hz
      have h1 : (0:ℝ) < z.1 := hz.1
      have h2 : -1 < z.2 := hz.2.1
      have h3 : z.2 < 1 := hz.2.2
      show 0 < 2 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2) * e / z.1
      exact div_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos two_pos (by nlinarith)) he) h1
    exact (hH.comp hZ hmaps).sub contDiffOn_const
  refine ⟨fun e he => hcutcd.contDiffOn.mul (hGcd e he), fun m => ?_⟩
  choose Sc hSc0 hSc using hcutb
  choose Gc hGc0 hGc using hGb
  refine ⟨∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose j : ℝ) * Sc j * Gc (m - j),
    fun e x η he he1 hx h1 h2 => ?_⟩
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose j : ℝ) * Sc j * Gc (m - j) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hSc0 j)) (hGc0 _))
  rcases lt_or_ge x a with hxa | hxa
  · have hev : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Real.smoothTransition ((z.1 - a) / (b - a)) *
        (H (2 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2) * e / z.1) - 1)) =ᶠ[nhds (x, η)] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt continuous_fst continuous_const).mem_nhds
        (show (x, η) ∈ {z : ℝ × ℝ | z.1 < a} from hxa)] with z hz
      have hz' : z.1 < a := hz
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
        (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) hba.le), zero_mul]
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg hC0 he.le
  · have hmem : (x, η) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
      ⟨show (0:ℝ) < x from lt_of_lt_of_le ha hxa, h1, h2⟩
    have hΩ : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
    rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hΩ hmem]
    refine (norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hcutcd.contDiffOn (hGcd e he) hΩ.uniqueDiffOn hmem
      (hle m)).trans ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j _
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hΩ hmem, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (m - j) hΩ hmem]
    have hG := hGc (m - j) e x η he he1 hxa h1 h2
    calc (m.choose j : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j
            (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Real.smoothTransition ((z.1 - a) / (b - a))) (x, η)‖ *
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m - j)
            (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => H (2 * (1 - z.2 ^ 2) * e / z.1) - 1) (x, η)‖
        ≤ (m.choose j : ℝ) * Sc j * (Gc (m - j) * e) :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hSc j _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) hG (norm_nonneg _)
            (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hSc0 j))
      _ = (m.choose j : ℝ) * Sc j * Gc (m - j) * e := by ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h ci ρ xb a : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (q : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → 0 < ci → 0 < ρ → ρ < 1 → 0 < a → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ x η : ℝ, a ≤ x → -1 < η → η < 1 → Real.sqrt (2 * x) * F x η = ci * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * tailFac ρ xb x) → (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(q e)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ e x η : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ 1 → a ≤ x → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun η' => q e x η') η| ≤ C * e / x) → ∃ M : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ 1 → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → IntegrableOn (fun x => 2 * x * F x η * q e x η) (Ioi a) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => x * F x η ^ 2 * (2 * q e x η + q e x η ^ 2)) (Ioi a) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2 * (2 * q e x η + q e x η ^ 2)) (Ioi a)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ∫ x in Ioi a, 2 * x * F x η * q e x η) (Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ∫ x in Ioi a, x * F x η ^ 2 * (2 * q e x η + q e x η ^ 2)) (Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ∫ x in Ioi a, F x η ^ 2 * (2 * q e x η + q e x η ^ 2)) (Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (η : ℝ), -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun η' => ∫ x in Ioi a, 2 * x * F x η' * q e x η') η| ≤ M m * e ∧ |iteratedDeriv m (fun η' => ∫ x in Ioi a, x * F x η' ^ 2 * (2 * q e x η' + q e x η' ^ 2)) η| ≤ M m * e ∧ |iteratedDeriv m (fun η' => ∫ x in Ioi a, F x η' ^ 2 * (2 * q e x η' + q e x η' ^ 2)) η| ≤ M m * e

signature.name: tail_defect_family
signature.statement: ∀ (h ci ρ xb a : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (q : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → 0 < ci → 0 < ρ → ρ < 1 → 0 < a → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ x η : ℝ, a ≤ x → -1 < η → η < 1 → Real.sqrt (2 * x) * F x η = ci * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * tailFac ρ xb x) → (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(q e)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ e x η : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ 1 → a ≤ x → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun η' => q e x η') η| ≤ C * e / x) → ∃ M : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ 1 → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → IntegrableOn (fun x => 2 * x * F x η * q e x η) (Ioi a) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => x * F x η ^ 2 * (2 * q e x η + q e x η ^ 2)) (Ioi a) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2 * (2 * q e x η + q e x η ^ 2)) (Ioi a)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ∫ x in Ioi a, 2 * x * F x η * q e x η) (Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ∫ x in Ioi a, x * F x η ^ 2 * (2 * q e x η + q e x η ^ 2)) (Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ∫ x in Ioi a, F x η ^ 2 * (2 * q e x η + q e x η ^ 2)) (Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (η : ℝ), -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun η' => ∫ x in Ioi a, 2 * x * F x η' * q e x η') η| ≤ M m * e ∧ |iteratedDeriv m (fun η' => ∫ x in Ioi a, x * F x η' ^ 2 * (2 * q e x η' + q e x η' ^ 2)) η| ≤ M m * e ∧ |iteratedDeriv m (fun η' => ∫ x in Ioi a, F x η' ^ 2 * (2 * q e x η' + q e x η' ^ 2)) η| ≤ M m * e

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h ci ρ xb a F q hh hci hρ0 hρ1 ha hFs htail hqs hqη
  have hΩ : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  
  have sliceA : ∀ (m : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ∃ G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
        ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → iteratedDeriv m (fun e => g x e) η = G x η := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro g hg
      exact ⟨g, hg, fun x η _ _ _ => by simp⟩
    | succ m ih =>
      intro g hg
      set Dg : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun x t => fderiv ℝ (↿g) (x, t) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) with hDg
      have hDs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Dg) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
        have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿g)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
          hg.fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ (by simp)
        have h2 := h1.clm_apply (contDiffOn_const (c := ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))))
        exact h2
      have hderiv : ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < t → t < 1 →
          HasDerivAt (fun s => g x s) (Dg x t) t := by
        intro x t hx h1 h2
        have hmem : ((x, t) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨hx, h1, h2⟩
        have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿g) (x, t) :=
          ((hg.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by simp))
        have hc : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (x, s)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) t :=
          (hasDerivAt_const t x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id t)
        exact hdiff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hc
      obtain ⟨G, hGs, hG⟩ := ih Dg hDs

    have hx0 : 0 < x := ha.trans_le hx
    have hev : (fun η' => F x η' ^ 2 * (2 * q e x η' + q e x η' ^ 2)) =ᶠ[nhds η]
        (fun η' => (F x 0 ^ 2) * (2 * q e x η' + q e x η' ^ 2)) := by
      filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds (show η ∈ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 from ⟨h1, h2⟩)] with t ht
      rw [hFc x t hx ht.1 ht.2]
    rw [hev.iteratedDeriv_eq, iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field, abs_mul,
      abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    have k := hQ m x η hx h1 h2
    have hF := hF2 x hx
    have hP0 : 0 < x ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hx0 _
    have hP3 : x ^ (-(3 + 2 * h)) = x ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * x⁻¹ := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_neg_one, ← Real.rpow_add hx0]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [hP3]
    calc F x 0 ^ 2 * |iteratedDeriv m (fun η' => 2 * q e x η' + q e x η' ^ 2) η|
        ≤ (ci ^ 2 * x ^ (-(2 + 2 * h))) * (B m * (e / x)) := by
          apply mul_le_mul hF k (abs_nonneg _)
          exact mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hP0.le
      _ = _ := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; ring
  
  have hqe := hqs e he he1
  have hg1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x η : ℝ => 2 * x * F x η * q e x η)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    have : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * z.1 * F z.1 z.2 * q e z.1 z.2)
        (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
      (((contDiffOn_const (c := (2:ℝ))).mul contDiffOn_fst).mul hFs).mul hqe
    exact this
  have hg2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x η : ℝ => (x * F x η ^ 2 * (2 * q e x η + q e x η ^ 2) : ℝ)))
      (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    have : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.1 * F z.1 z.2 ^ 2 * (2 * q e z.1 z.2 + q e z.1 z.2 ^ 2))
        (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
      (contDiffOn_fst.mul (hFs.pow 2)).mul
        (((contDiffOn_const (c := (2:ℝ))).mul hqe).add (hqe.pow 2))
    exact this
  have hg3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x η : ℝ => (F x η ^ 2 * (2 * q e x η + q e x η ^ 2) : ℝ)))
      (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    have : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => F z.1 z.2 ^ 2 * (2 * q e z.1 z.2 + q e z.1 z.2 ^ 2))
        (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
      (hFs.pow 2).mul (((contDiffOn_const (c := (2:ℝ))).mul hqe).add (hqe.pow 2))
    exact this
  
  obtain ⟨i1, s1, d1⟩ := cruxB (fun x η : ℝ => 2 * x * F x η * q e x η) (1 + h)
    (fun m => 2 * ci * |C m| * e) (by linarith) hg1 hb1
  obtain ⟨i2, s2, d2⟩ := cruxB (fun x η : ℝ => x * F x η ^ 2 * (2 * q e x η + q e x η ^ 2))
    (2 + 2 * h) (fun m => ci ^ 2 * B m * e) (by linarith) hg2 hb2
  obtain ⟨i3, s3, d3⟩ := cruxB (fun x η : ℝ => F x η ^ 2 * (2 * q e x η + q e x η ^ 2))
    (3 + 2 * h) (fun m => ci ^ 2 * B m * e) (by linarith) hg3 hb3
  refine ⟨fun η h1 h2 => ⟨i1 η h1 h2, i2 η h1 h2, i3 η h1 h2⟩, s1, s2, s3,
    fun m η h1 h2 => ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · have hr := d1 m η h1 h2
    have hX : 0 ≤ ci ^ 2 * B m * e * c2 + ci ^ 2 * B m * e * c3 :=
      add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (hB0 m)) he.le) hc20)
        (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (hB0 m)) he.le) hc30)
    have hE : M m * e = 2 * ci * |C m| * e * c1 +
        (ci ^ 2 * B m * e * c2 + ci ^ 2 * B m * e * c3) := by rw [hM]; ring
    calc _ ≤ 2 * ci * |C m| * e * c1 := by rw [hc1]; exact hr
      _ ≤ M m * e := by rw [hE]; linarith
  · have hr := d2 m η h1 h2
    have hX : 0 ≤ 2 * ci * |C m| * e * c1 + ci ^ 2 * B m * e * c3 :=
      add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) he.le) hc10)
        (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (hB0 m)) he.le) hc30)
    have hE : M m * e = ci ^ 2 * B m * e * c2 +
        (2 * ci * |C m| * e * c1 + ci ^ 2 * B m * e * c3) := by rw [hM]; ring
    calc _ ≤ ci ^ 2 * B m * e * c2 := by rw [hc2]; exact hr
      _ ≤ M m * e := by rw [hE]; linarith
  · have hr := d3 m η h1 h2
    have hX : 0 ≤ 2 * ci * |C m| * e * c1 + ci ^ 2 * B m * e * c2 :=
      add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) he.le) hc10)
        (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (hB0 m)) he.le) hc20)
    have hE : M m * e = ci ^ 2 * B m * e * c3 +
        (2 * ci * |C m| * e * c1 + ci ^ 2 * B m * e * c2) := by rw [hM]; ring
    calc _ ≤ ci ^ 2 * B m * e * c3 := by rw [hc3]; exact hr
      _ ≤ M m * e := by rw [hE]; linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (δ C : ℝ) (Φ : (Fin 5 → ℝ) → ℝ → (Fin 5 → ℝ)) (d : ℝ → ℝ → (Fin 5 → ℝ)) (M : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < δ → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : (Fin 5 → ℝ) × ℝ => Φ p.1 p.2) (Metric.ball (0 : Fin 5 → ℝ) δ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) → (∀ η : ℝ, Φ 0 η = 0) → (∀ (d' : Fin 5 → ℝ) (η : ℝ), ‖d'‖ < δ → -2 < η → η < 2 → ‖Φ d' η‖ ≤ C * ‖d'‖) → (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ 1 → ∀ i : Fin 5, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => d e η i) (Ioo (-1) 1)) → (∀ (m : ℕ) (e η : ℝ) (i : Fin 5), 0 < e → e ≤ 1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun η' => d e η' i) η| ≤ M m * e) → ∃ e2 K : ℝ, 0 < e2 ∧ e2 ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ K ∧ (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ e2 → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖d e η‖ < δ / 2) ∧ (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ e2 → ∀ i : Fin 5, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => Φ (d e η) η i) (Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ (∀ (e η : ℝ) (i : Fin 5), 0 < e → e ≤ e2 → -1 < η → η < 1 → |Φ (d e η) η i| ≤ K * e ∧ |deriv (fun η' => Φ (d e η') η' i) η| ≤ K * e) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ Cm : ℝ, ∀ (e η : ℝ) (i : Fin 5), 0 < e → e ≤ e2 → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun η' => Φ (d e η') η' i) η| ≤ Cm)
