signature.statement: ∀ (δ C : ℝ) (Φ : (Fin 5 → ℝ) → ℝ → (Fin 5 → ℝ)) (d : ℝ → ℝ → (Fin 5 → ℝ)) (M : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < δ → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : (Fin 5 → ℝ) × ℝ => Φ p.1 p.2) (Metric.ball (0 : Fin 5 → ℝ) δ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) → (∀ η : ℝ, Φ 0 η = 0) → (∀ (d' : Fin 5 → ℝ) (η : ℝ), ‖d'‖ < δ → -2 < η → η < 2 → ‖Φ d' η‖ ≤ C * ‖d'‖) → (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ 1 → ∀ i : Fin 5, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => d e η i) (Ioo (-1) 1)) → (∀ (m : ℕ) (e η : ℝ) (i : Fin 5), 0 < e → e ≤ 1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun η' => d e η' i) η| ≤ M m * e) → ∃ e2 K : ℝ, 0 < e2 ∧ e2 ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ K ∧ (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ e2 → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖d e η‖ < δ / 2) ∧ (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ e2 → ∀ i : Fin 5, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => Φ (d e η) η i) (Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ (∀ (e η : ℝ) (i : Fin 5), 0 < e → e ≤ e2 → -1 < η → η < 1 → |Φ (d e η) η i| ≤ K * e ∧ |deriv (fun η' => Φ (d e η') η' i) η| ≤ K * e) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ Cm : ℝ, ∀ (e η : ℝ) (i : Fin 5), 0 < e → e ≤ e2 → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun η' => Φ (d e η') η' i) η| ≤ Cm)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro δ C Φ d M hδ hΦs hΦ0 hΦL hds hdb
  
  have s1 : ∀ (f : ℝ → (Fin 5 → ℝ)) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (j : Fin 5), ContDiffAt ℝ n f x →
      iteratedDeriv n (fun y => f y j) x = iteratedDeriv n f x j := by
    intro f n x j hf
    have h := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (Fin 5 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).iteratedFDeriv_comp_left hf
      (i := n) le_rfl
    rw [iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv]
    have e : (fun y => f y j) = (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (Fin 5 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ f := rfl
    rw [e, h]
    simp
  
  set Φt : (Fin 5 → ℝ) × ℝ → (Fin 5 → ℝ) := fun p => Φ p.1 p.2 with hΦt
  set U := Metric.ball (0 : Fin 5 → ℝ) δ ×ˢ Ioo (-2:ℝ) 2 with hU
  set S := Metric.closedBall (0 : Fin 5 → ℝ) (δ/2) ×ˢ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1 with hS
  have hUo : IsOpen U := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hUu : UniqueDiffOn ℝ U := hUo.uniqueDiffOn
  have hSc : IsCompact S := (isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod isCompact_Icc
  have hScv : Convex ℝ S := (convex_closedBall _ _).prod (convex_Icc _ _)
  have hSU : S ⊆ U := by
    rintro ⟨x, t⟩ ⟨hx, ht⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hx; rw [Metric.mem_ball]; linarith
    · exact ⟨by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩
  
  have s3 : ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ (g : ℝ → (Fin 5 → ℝ)) (η : ℝ), -1 < η → η < 1 →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ g η → ‖g η‖ ≤ δ / 2 →
      ‖deriv (fun η' => Φ (g η') η') η‖ ≤ B * (‖deriv g η‖ + ‖g η‖) := by
    have hL : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => fderiv ℝ Φt y) U := hΦs.fderiv_of_isOpen hUo (by simp)
    have hdiffΦ : ∀ x ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ Φt x := fun x hx =>
      ((hΦs.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp))
    have hdiffL : ∀ x ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φt) x := fun x hx =>
      (hL.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
    have hLc : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ Φt) S := (hL.continuousOn).mono hSU
    have hLLc : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φt)) S :=
      (hL.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hUo le_rfl).mono hSU
    obtain ⟨B1, hB1⟩ := hSc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hLc
    obtain ⟨B2, hB2⟩ := IsCompact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (E := (Fin 5 → ℝ) × ℝ →L[ℝ] (Fin 5 → ℝ) × ℝ →L[ℝ] Fin 5 → ℝ) hSc hLLc
    refine ⟨max (max B1 B2) 0, le_max_right _ _, ?_⟩
    intro g η h1 h2 hg hgn
    set p : (Fin 5 → ℝ) × ℝ := (g η, η) with hp
    set p0 : (Fin 5 → ℝ) × ℝ := (0, η) with hp0
    have hpS : p ∈ S := ⟨by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]; exact hgn, h1.le, h2.le⟩
    have hp0S : p0 ∈ S := ⟨by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_self]; positivity, h1.le, h2.le⟩
    have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun t => (g t, t)) (deriv g η, (1:ℝ)) η :=
      hg.hasDerivAt.prodMk (hasDerivAt_id η)
    have hcomp : HasDerivAt (fun t => Φ (g t) t) (fderiv ℝ Φt p (deriv g η, 1)) η :=
      HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (f := fun t => (g t, t)) (l := Φt) η
        (hdiffΦ p (hSU hpS)).hasFDerivAt hγ
    have hγ0 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ((0 : Fin 5 → ℝ), t)) ((0 : Fin 5 → ℝ), (1:ℝ)) η :=
      (hasDerivAt_const η (0 : Fin 5 → ℝ)).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id η)
    have hcomp0 : HasDerivAt (fun t => Φ 0 t) (fderiv ℝ Φt p0 (0, 1)) η :=
      HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (f := fun t : ℝ => ((0 : Fin 5 → ℝ), t)) (l := Φt) η
        (hdiffΦ p0 (hSU hp0S)).hasFDerivAt hγ0
    have hvan : fderiv ℝ Φt p0 (0, 1) = 0 := by
      have : HasDerivAt (fun t => Φ 0 t) 0 η := by
        simp only [hΦ0]; exact hasDerivAt_const η 0
      exact hcomp0.unique this
    rw [hcomp.deriv]
    have hv : ((deriv g η, (1:ℝ)) : (Fin 5 → ℝ) × ℝ) = (deriv g η, 0) + (0, 1) := by simp
    have hsplit : fderiv ℝ Φt p (deriv g η, 1)
        = fderiv ℝ Φt p (deriv g η, 0) + (fderiv ℝ Φt p - fderiv ℝ Φt p0) (0, 1) := by
      rw [hv, map_add, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, hvan, sub_zero]
    have hmv : ‖fderiv ℝ Φt p - fderiv ℝ Φt p0‖ ≤ B2 * ‖p - p0‖ :=
      hScv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le (fun x hx => hdiffL x (hSU hx))
        (fun x hx => hB2 x hx) hp0S hpS
    have hpp0 : ‖p - p0‖ = ‖g η‖ := by simp [hp, hp0, Prod.norm_def]
    have h01 : ‖((0 : Fin 5 → ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖ = 1 := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
    have hd0 : ‖((deriv g η), (0:ℝ))‖ = ‖deriv g η‖ := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
    have e1 : ‖fderiv ℝ Φt p (deriv g η, 0)‖ ≤ B1 * ‖deriv g η‖ := by
      calc _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ Φt p‖ * ‖((deriv g η), (0:ℝ))‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
        _ ≤ B1 * ‖deriv g η‖ := by
          rw [hd0]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hB1 p hpS) (norm_nonneg _)
    have e2 : ‖(fderiv ℝ Φt p - fderiv ℝ Φt p0) (0, 1)‖ ≤ B2 * ‖g η‖ := by
      calc _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ Φt p - fderiv ℝ Φt p0‖ * ‖((0 : Fin 5 → ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖ :=
            ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
        _ ≤ B2 * ‖g η‖ := by rw [h01, mul_one, ← hpp0]; exact hmv
    rw [hsplit]
    have hB1' := le_max_left B1 B2
    have hB2' := le_max_right B1 B2
    have hBm := le_max_left (max B1 B2) 0
    calc _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ Φt p (deriv g η, 0)‖ + ‖(fderiv ℝ Φt p - fderiv ℝ Φt p0) (0, 1)‖ :=
          norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ B1 * ‖deriv g η‖ + B2 * ‖g η‖ := add_le_add e1 e2
      _ ≤ _ := by
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (deriv g η), norm_nonneg (g η)]
  
  have s4 : ∀ (m : ℕ) (A : ℝ), 1 ≤ A → ∃ Cm : ℝ, ∀ g : ℝ → (Fin 5 → ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Ioo (-1) 1) →
      (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖g η‖ ≤ δ / 2) →
      (∀ (i : ℕ) (η : ℝ), 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedDeriv i g η‖ ≤ A) →
      ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedDeriv m (fun η' => Φ (g η') η') η‖ ≤ Cm := by
    intro m A hA
    have hbd : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i Φt U x‖ ≤ C := fun i =>
      hSc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        ((hΦs.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hUu).mono hSU)
    choose Cf hCf using hbd
    set Cg := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m+1), |Cf i| with hCg
    refine ⟨m.factorial * Cg * A ^ m, ?_⟩
    intro g hg hgn hgd η h1 h2
    set s := Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 with hs_def
    have hs : IsOpen s := isOpen_Ioo
    have hηs : η ∈ s := ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have hγ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun t => (g t, t)) s := hg.prodMk contDiffOn_id
    have hmaps : MapsTo (fun t => (g t, t)) s U := fun t ht =>
      ⟨by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]; linarith [hgn t ht.1 ht.2],
        by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩
    have hγS : (g η, η) ∈ S :=
      ⟨by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]; exact hgn η h1 h2, h1.le, h2.le⟩
    have hC : ∀ i, i ≤ m → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i Φt U (g η, η)‖ ≤ Cg := fun i hi =>
      (hCf i _ hγS).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans
        (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => abs_nonneg (Cf j)) (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))))
    have hD : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m →
        ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun t => (g t, t)) s η‖ ≤ A ^ i := by
      intro i hi1 him
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_prodMk (g := fun t : ℝ => t) (hg.contDiffWithinAt hηs)
        contDiffWithinAt_id hs.uniqueDiffOn hηs (by exact_mod_cast le_top)]
      rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_prod]
      refine max_le ?_ ?_
      · rw [norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_norm_iteratedDerivWithin,
          iteratedDerivWithin_of_isOpen hs hηs]
        exact (hgd i η hi1 him h1 h2).trans (le_self_pow₀ hA (by omega))
      · rw [norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_norm_iteratedDerivWithin,
          iteratedDerivWithin_of_isOpen hs hηs, iteratedDeriv_fun_id]
        have hA0 : (1:ℝ) ≤ A ^ i := one_le_pow₀ hA
        split_ifs with h0 h1'
        · omega
        · simpa using hA0
        · simp only [norm_zero]; linarith
    have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hΦs hγ (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hUu
      hs.uniqueDiffOn hmaps hηs hC hD
    rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, ← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hs hηs]
    exact key
  
  set e2 := min 1 (δ / (4 * (|M 0| + 1))) with he2
  have he2pos : 0 < e2 := lt_min one_pos (div_pos hδ (by positivity))
  have he2le : e2 ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
  have hdnorm : ∀ e, 0 < e → e ≤ 1 → ∀ η, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖d e η‖ ≤ |M 0| * e := by
    intro e he he1 η h1 h2
    refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)).2 (fun i => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have := hdb 0 e η i he he1 h1 h2
    simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero] at this
    exact this.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) he.le)
  have hsmall : ∀ e, 0 < e → e ≤ e2 → |M 0| * e ≤ δ / 4 := by
    intro e he hee
    have h3 : e ≤ δ / (4 * (|M 0| + 1)) := hee.trans (min_le_right _ _)
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at h3
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (M 0)]
  have hda : ∀ e, 0 < e → e ≤ e2 → ∀ η, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖d e η‖ ≤ δ / 4 :=
    fun e he hee η h1 h2 => (hdnorm e he (hee.trans he2le) η h1 h2).trans (hsmall e he hee)
  
  have hdsm : ∀ e, 0 < e → e ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (d e) (Ioo (-1) 1) := fun e he he1 =>
    contDiffOn_pi.2 (hds e he he1)
  have hcsm : ∀ e, 0 < e → e ≤ e2 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => Φ (d e η) η) (Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    intro e he hee
    have hγ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun t => (d e t, t)) (Ioo (-1) 1) :=
      (hdsm e he (hee.trans he2le)).prodMk contDiffOn_id
    have hmaps : MapsTo (fun t => (d e t, t)) (Ioo (-1) 1) U := fun t ht =>
      ⟨by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]; linarith [hda e he hee t ht.1 ht.2],
        by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩
    exact hΦs.comp hγ hmaps
  have hdAt : ∀ e, 0 < e → e ≤ 1 → ∀ η, -1 < η → η < 1 → ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffAt ℝ n (d e) η :=
    fun e he he1 η h1 h2 n =>
      ((hdsm e he he1).contDiffAt (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds ⟨h1, h2⟩)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hcAt : ∀ e, 0 < e → e ≤ e2 → ∀ η, -1 < η → η < 1 → ∀ n : ℕ,
      ContDiffAt ℝ n (fun η => Φ (d e η) η) η :=
    fun e he hee η h1 h2 n =>
      ((hcsm e he hee).contDiffAt (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds ⟨h1, h2⟩)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  obtain ⟨B, hB0, hB⟩ := s3
  refine ⟨e2, max (|C| * |M 0|) (B * (|M 1| + |M 0|)), he2pos, he2le,
    le_trans (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) (le_max_left _ _), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro e he hee η h1 h2
    have := hda e he hee η h1 h2
    linarith
  · intro e he hee i
    exact contDiffOn_pi.1 (hcsm e he hee) i
  · intro e η i he hee h1 h2
    have he1 : e ≤ 1 := hee.trans he2le
    have hdn := hdnorm e he he1 η h1 h2
    constructor
    · have hlt : ‖d e η‖ < δ := by linarith [hda e he hee η h1 h2]
      have hv := hΦL (d e η) η hlt (by linarith) (by linarith)
      calc |Φ (d e η) η i| = ‖Φ (d e η) η i‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
        _ ≤ ‖Φ (d e η) η‖ := norm_le_pi_norm _ i
        _ ≤ C * ‖d e η‖ := hv
        _ ≤ |C| * ‖d e η‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (norm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ |C| * (|M 0| * e) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdn (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = (|C| * |M 0|) * e := by ring
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) he.le
    · have hderiv : ‖deriv (d e) η‖ ≤ |M 1| * e := by
        refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)).2 (fun j => ?_)
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        have h := s1 (d e) 1 η j (hdAt e he he1 η h1 h2 1)
        rw [iteratedDeriv_one, iteratedDeriv_one] at h
        rw [← h]
        have := hdb 1 e η j he he1 h1 h2
        rw [iteratedDeriv_one] at this
        exact this.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) he.le)
      have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (d e) η :=
        (hdAt e he he1 η h1 h2 1).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
      have hb := hB (d e) η h1 h2 hdiff (by linarith [hda e he hee η h1 h2])
      have h := s1 (fun η => Φ (d e η) η) 1 η i (hcAt e he hee η h1 h2 1)
      rw [iteratedDeriv_one, iteratedDeriv_one] at h
      rw [h]
      calc |deriv (fun η => Φ (d e η) η) η i| = ‖deriv (fun η => Φ (d e η) η) η i‖ :=
            (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
        _ ≤ ‖deriv (fun η => Φ (d e η) η) η‖ := norm_le_pi_norm _ i
        _ ≤ B * (‖deriv (d e) η‖ + ‖d e η‖) := hb
        _ ≤ B * (|M 1| * e + |M 0| * e) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add hderiv hdn) hB0
        _ = (B * (|M 1| + |M 0|)) * e := by ring
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) he.le
  · intro m
    set A := 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m+1), |M i| with hA
    have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m+1), |M i| :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg (M i))
    have hA1 : 1 ≤ A := by linarith
    obtain ⟨Cm, hCm⟩ := s4 m A hA1
    refine ⟨Cm, ?_⟩
    intro e η i he hee h1 h2
    have he1 : e ≤ 1 := hee.trans he2le
    have hit : ∀ (k : ℕ) (η : ℝ), 1 ≤ k → k ≤ m → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedDeriv k (d e) η‖ ≤ A := by
      intro k η' hk1 hkm g1 g2
      refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by linarith)).2 (fun j => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← s1 (d e) k η' j (hdAt e he he1 η' g1 g2 k)]
      have hle : |M k| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m+1), |M i| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => abs_nonneg (M j)) (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
      calc _ ≤ M k * e := hdb k e η' j he he1 g1 g2
        _ ≤ |M k| * e := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) he.le
        _ ≤ |M k| * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he1 (abs_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ A := by linarith
    have hc := hCm (d e) (hdsm e he he1)
      (fun η' g1 g2 => by linarith [hda e he hee η' g1 g2]) hit η h1 h2
    rw [s1 (fun η => Φ (d e η) η) m η i (hcAt e he hee η h1 h2 m)]
    calc _ = ‖iteratedDeriv m (fun η => Φ (d e η) η) η i‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
      _ ≤ ‖iteratedDeriv m (fun η => Φ (d e η) η) η‖ := norm_le_pi_norm _ i
      _ ≤ Cm := hc

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h k1 k2 : ℝ) (F U q : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (φ ψ : Fin 5 → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → 0 < k1 → k1 < k2 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿q) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ x₀ x₁ : ℝ, 0 < x₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, x₀ ≤ x → x ≤ x₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (x, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (x, η)‖ ≤ C) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => F x e) η| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧ |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => U x e) η| ≤ C) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿q) (x, η)‖ ≤ C) → (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (φ i)) → (∀ i x, (x ≤ k1 ∨ k2 ≤ x) → φ i x = 0) → (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ψ i) (Ioo (-1) 1)) → (∀ i : Fin 5, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (ψ i) η| ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => F z.1 z.2 * (1 + q z.1 z.2) + (ψ 2 z.2 * φ 2 z.1 + ψ 3 z.2 * φ 3 z.1 + ψ 4 z.2 * φ 4 z.1)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => U z.1 z.2 + (ψ 0 z.2 * φ 0 z.1 + ψ 1 z.2 * φ 1 z.1)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ x₀ x₁ : ℝ, 0 < x₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, x₀ ≤ x → x ≤ x₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => F z.1 z.2 * (1 + q z.1 z.2) + (ψ 2 z.2 * φ 2 z.1 + ψ 3 z.2 * φ 3 z.1 + ψ 4 z.2 * φ 4 z.1)) (x, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => U z.1 z.2 + (ψ 0 z.2 * φ 0 z.1 + ψ 1 z.2 * φ 1 z.1)) (x, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => F x e * (1 + q x e) + (ψ 2 e * φ 2 x + ψ 3 e * φ 3 x + ψ 4 e * φ 4 x)) η| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧ |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => U x e + (ψ 0 e * φ 0 x + ψ 1 e * φ 1 x)) η| ≤ C)

signature.name: edit_regularity
signature.statement: ∀ (h k1 k2 : ℝ) (F U q : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (φ ψ : Fin 5 → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → 0 < k1 → k1 < k2 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿q) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ x₀ x₁ : ℝ, 0 < x₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, x₀ ≤ x → x ≤ x₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (x, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (x, η)‖ ≤ C) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => F x e) η| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧ |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => U x e) η| ≤ C) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿q) (x, η)‖ ≤ C) → (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (φ i)) → (∀ i x, (x ≤ k1 ∨ k2 ≤ x) → φ i x = 0) → (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ψ i) (Ioo (-1) 1)) → (∀ i : Fin 5, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (ψ i) η| ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => F z.1 z.2 * (1 + q z.1 z.2) + (ψ 2 z.2 * φ 2 z.1 + ψ 3 z.2 * φ 3 z.1 + ψ 4 z.2 * φ 4 z.1)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => U z.1 z.2 + (ψ 0 z.2 * φ 0 z.1 + ψ 1 z.2 * φ 1 z.1)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ x₀ x₁ : ℝ, 0 < x₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, x₀ ≤ x → x ≤ x₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => F z.1 z.2 * (1 + q z.1 z.2) + (ψ 2 z.2 * φ 2 z.1 + ψ 3 z.2 * φ 3 z.1 + ψ 4 z.2 * φ 4 z.1)) (x, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => U z.1 z.2 + (ψ 0 z.2 * φ 0 z.1 + ψ 1 z.2 * φ 1 z.1)) (x, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => F x e * (1 + q x e) + (ψ 2 e * φ 2 x + ψ 3 e * φ 3 x + ψ 4 e * φ 4 x)) η| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧ |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => U x e + (ψ 0 e * φ 0 x + ψ 1 e * φ 1 x)) η| ≤ C)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h k1 k2 F U q φ ψ hh hk1 hk12 hFs hUs hqs hFbd hwt hq hφs hφ0 hψs hψb
  have hΩ : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hle : ∀ n : ℕ, ((n : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞) := fun n => by exact_mod_cast le_top
  
  have hslice : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ∀ (m : ℕ) (x η : ℝ),
      0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => f x e) η| ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) (x, η)‖ := by
    intro f hf m x η hx h1 h2
    have hs'o : IsOpen ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (x, (0:ℝ)) + p) ⁻¹' (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) :=
      hΩ.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hgs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (↿f) ((x, (0:ℝ)) + p))
        ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (x, (0:ℝ)) + p) ⁻¹' (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) :=
      hf.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn (fun p hp => hp)
    have hLo : IsOpen ((ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ ℝ) ⁻¹'
        ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (x, (0:ℝ)) + p) ⁻¹' (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1))) :=
      hs'o.preimage (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ ℝ).continuous
    have hpt : (x, (0:ℝ)) + (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ ℝ) η = (x, η) := by simp
    have hη : η ∈ (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ ℝ) ⁻¹'
        ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (x, (0:ℝ)) + p) ⁻¹' (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) := by
      show (x, (0:ℝ)) + (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ ℝ) η ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1
      rw [hpt]; exact ⟨hx, h1, h2⟩
    have hη2 : (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ ℝ) η ∈
        ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (x, (0:ℝ)) + p) ⁻¹' (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) := hη
    have hcomp := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ ℝ)
      hgs hs'o.uniqueDiffOn hLo.uniqueDiffOn hη (hle m)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hLo hη, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hs'o hη2] at hcomp
    have hfun : ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (↿f) ((x, (0:ℝ)) + p)) ∘ (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ ℝ)) =
        fun e => f x e := by
      funext e
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.inr_apply, Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero, zero_add]
      rfl
    rw [hfun] at hcomp
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs, ← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, hcomp,
      iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left, hpt]
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
    calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) (x, η)‖ * 1 := by
          gcongr
          rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
          exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_inr_le_one ℝ ℝ ℝ)
      _ = _ := mul_one _
  
  have hcoord2 : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (s : Set ℝ), IsOpen s → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g s → ∀ (m : ℕ) (x η : ℝ),
      η ∈ s → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => g z.2) (x, η)‖ ≤ |iteratedDeriv m g η| := by
    intro g s hs hg m x η hη
    have hLo : IsOpen ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) ⁻¹' s) :=
      hs.preimage (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).continuous
    have hmem : (x, η) ∈ (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) ⁻¹' s := hη
    have hmem2 : (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) (x, η) ∈ s := hη
    have hcomp := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)
      hg hs.uniqueDiffOn hLo.uniqueDiffOn hmem (hle m)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hLo hmem, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hs hmem2] at hcomp
    have e : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => g z.2) = g ∘ (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) := rfl
    have e2 : (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) (x, η) = η := rfl
    rw [e, hcomp, e2, ← Real.norm_eq_abs, ← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
    calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g η‖ * 1 := by
          gcongr
          rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
          exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_snd_le ℝ ℝ ℝ)
      _ = _ := mul_one _
  have hcoord1 : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → ∀ (m : ℕ) (x η : ℝ),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => g z.1) (x, η)‖ ≤ |iteratedDeriv m g x| := by
    intro g hg m x η
    have hcomp := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ)
      (x := (x, η)) hg.contDiffOn uniqueDiffOn_univ (by simp [uniqueDiffOn_univ]) (mem_univ _) (hle m)
    have hpre : (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) ⁻¹' (univ : Set ℝ) = univ := rfl
    rw [hpre, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ] at hcomp
    have e : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => g z.1) = g ∘ (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) := rfl
    have e2 : (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) (x, η) = x := rfl
    rw [e, hcomp, e2, ← Real.norm_eq_abs, ← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
    calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g x‖ * 1 := by
          gcongr
          rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
          exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_fst_le ℝ ℝ ℝ)
      _ = _ := mul_one _
  
  have hψc : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => ψ i z.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
    fun i => (hψs i).comp contDiff_snd.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz.2)
  have hφc : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => φ i z.1) := fun i => (hφs i).comp contDiff_fst
  have hbc : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => ψ i z.2 * φ i z.1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
    fun i => (hψc i).mul (hφc i).contDiffOn
  have h1q : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => 1 + q z.1 z.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
    contDiffOn_const.add hqs
  have hP0c : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => F z.1 z.2 * (1 + q z.1 z.2)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
    hFs.mul h1q
  have hT1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => F z.1 z.2 * (1 + q z.1 z.2) + (ψ 2 z.2 * φ 2 z.1 + ψ 3 z.2 * φ 3 z.1 + ψ 4 z.2 * φ 4 z.1)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
    hP0c.add (((hbc 2).add (hbc 3)).add (hbc 4))
  have hT2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => U z.1 z.2 + (ψ 0 z.2 * φ 0 z.1 + ψ 1 z.2 * φ 1 z.1)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
    hUs.add ((hbc 0).add (hbc 1))
  
  have haddB : ∀ (S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), S ⊆ Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 → ∀ a b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k a z‖ ≤ C) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k b z‖ ≤ C) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => a z + b z) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro S hS a b ha hb hA hB k
    obtain ⟨Ca, hCa⟩ := hA k
    obtain ⟨Cb, hCb⟩ := hB k
    refine ⟨Ca + Cb, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hzΩ := hS hz
    have e : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => a z + b z) z = iteratedFDeriv ℝ k a z + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k b z :=
      iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((ha.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hzΩ)).of_le (hle k))
        ((hb.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hzΩ)).of_le (hle k))
    rw [e]
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hCa z hz) (hCb z hz))
  have hmulB : ∀ (S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), S ⊆ Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 → ∀ a b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k a z‖ ≤ C) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k b z‖ ≤ C) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => a z * b z) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro S hS a b ha hb hA hB k
    choose Ca hCa using hA
    choose Cb hCb using hB
    refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * Ca i * Cb (k - i), fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hzΩ := hS hz
    have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le ha hb hΩ.uniqueDiffOn hzΩ (hle k)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => a y * b y) k hΩ hzΩ] at key
    refine key.trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := a) i hΩ hzΩ,
      iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := b) (k - i) hΩ hzΩ]
    have h1 := hCa i z hz
    have h2 := hCb (k - i) z hz
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 h0) h2 (norm_nonneg _)
      (mul_nonneg h0 ((norm_nonneg _).trans h1))
  have hconst : ∀ (S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (c : ℝ), ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => c) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro S c k
    refine ⟨|c|, fun z _ => ?_⟩
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk | hk
    · subst hk
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne hk.ne' c]
      simp
  
  have hT3 : ∀ x₀ x₁ : ℝ, 0 < x₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, x₀ ≤ x → x ≤ x₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => F z.1 z.2 * (1 + q z.1 z.2) + (ψ 2 z.2 * φ 2 z.1 + ψ 3 z.2 * φ 3 z.1 + ψ 4 z.2 * φ 4 z.1)) (x, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => U z.1 z.2 + (ψ 0 z.2 * φ 0 z.1 + ψ 1 z.2 * φ 1 z.1)) (x, η)‖ ≤ C := by
    intro x₀ x₁ hx₀ m
    have hS : Icc x₀ x₁ ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 :=
      fun z hz => ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hx₀ hz.1.1, hz.2⟩
    have BF : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc x₀ x₁ ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿F) z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hFbd x₀ x₁ hx₀ k
      exact ⟨C, fun z hz => (hC z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2).1⟩
    have BU : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc x₀ x₁ ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿U) z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hFbd x₀ x₁ hx₀ k
      exact ⟨C, fun z hz => (hC z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2).2⟩
    have Bq : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc x₀ x₁ ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿q) z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hq k
      exact ⟨C, fun z hz => hC z.1 z.2 (lt_of_lt_of_le hx₀ hz.1.1) hz.2.1 hz.2.2⟩
    have Bψ : ∀ (i : Fin 5) (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc x₀ x₁ ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => ψ i z.2) z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro i k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hψb i k
      exact ⟨C, fun z hz => (hcoord2 (ψ i) (Ioo (-1) 1) isOpen_Ioo (hψs i) k z.1 z.2 hz.2).trans
        (hC z.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2)⟩
    have Bφ : ∀ (i : Fin 5) (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc x₀ x₁ ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => φ i z.1) z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro i k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := x₀) (b := x₁)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        ((continuous_iteratedDeriv k (hφs i) (hle k)).continuousOn)
      refine ⟨C, fun z hz => (hcoord1 (φ i) (hφs i) k z.1 z.2).trans ?_⟩
      rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact hC z.1 hz.1
    have B1 := haddB _ hS (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (↿q) contDiffOn_const hqs (hconst _ 1) Bq
    have BP0 := hmulB _ hS (↿F) (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => 1 + q z.1 z.2) hFs h1q BF B1
    have BB : ∀ i : Fin 5, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc x₀ x₁ ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => ψ i z.2 * φ i z.1) z‖ ≤ C :=
      fun i => hmulB _ hS _ _ (hψc i) (hφc i).contDiffOn (Bψ i) (Bφ i)
    have B23 := haddB _ hS _ _ (hbc 2) (hbc 3) (BB 2) (BB 3)
    have B234 := haddB _ hS _ _ ((hbc 2).add (hbc 3)) (hbc 4) B23 (BB 4)
    have BG := haddB _ hS _ _ hP0c (((hbc 2).add (hbc 3)).add (hbc 4)) BP0 B234
    have B01 := haddB _ hS _ _ (hbc 0) (hbc 1) (BB 0) (BB 1)
    have BV := haddB _ hS _ _ hUs ((hbc 0).add (hbc 1)) BU B01
    obtain ⟨CG, hCG⟩ := BG m
    obtain ⟨CV, hCV⟩ := BV m
    refine ⟨max CG CV, fun x η hx0 hx1 h1 h2 => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · exact (hCG (x, η) ⟨⟨hx0, hx1⟩, h1, h2⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · exact (hCV (x, η) ⟨⟨hx0, hx1⟩, h1, h2⟩).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  
  have hT4 : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => F x e * (1 + q x e) + (ψ 2 e * φ 2 x + ψ 3 e * φ 3 x + ψ 4 e * φ 4 x)) η| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧ |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => U x e + (ψ 0 e * φ 0 x + ψ 1 e * φ 1 x)) η| ≤ C := by
    choose CF hCF using hwt
    choose Cq hCq using hq
    choose Cψ hCψ using hψb
    have hP : ∀ i : Fin 5, ∃ P : ℝ, 0 ≤ P ∧ ∀ x, |φ i x| ≤ P := by
      intro i
      obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := k1) (b := k2)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        (hφs i).continuous.continuousOn
      have hP0 : 0 ≤ P := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hP k1 ⟨le_rfl, hk12.le⟩)
      refine ⟨P, hP0, fun x => ?_⟩
      by_cases hx : x ≤ k1 ∨ k2 ≤ x
      · rw [hφ0 i x hx, abs_zero]; exact hP0
      · push_neg at hx
        rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hP x ⟨hx.1.le, hx.2.le⟩
    choose P hP0 hPb using hP
    have hCψ0 : ∀ i m, 0 ≤ Cψ i m := fun i m =>
      (abs_nonneg _).trans (hCψ i m 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
    have hwpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) := fun x hx =>
      mul_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hx _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith) _)
    have hk2 : 0 < k2 := hk1.trans hk12
    obtain ⟨W2, hW2⟩ : ∃ W2 : ℝ, W2 = k2 ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + k2) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hW2pos : 0 < W2 := hW2 ▸ hwpos k2 hk2
    have hwanti : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ k2 → W2 ≤ x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) := by
      intro x hx hxk
      rw [hW2]
      exact mul_le_mul (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hx hxk (by norm_num))
        (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith))
        (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith) _).le (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hx _).le
    have hbump : ∀ (i : Fin 5) (m : ℕ) (x η : ℝ), -1 < η → η < 1 →
        |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => ψ i e * φ i x) η| ≤ P i * Cψ i m := by
      intro i m x η h1 h2
      have e : (fun e => ψ i e * φ i x) = fun e => φ i x * ψ i e := by funext e; ring
      rw [e, iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (hPb i x) (hCψ i m η h1 h2) (abs_nonneg _) (hP0 i)
    have hbumpw : ∀ (i : Fin 5) (m : ℕ) (x η : ℝ), 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => ψ i e * φ i x) η| ≤
          (P i * Cψ i m / W2) * (x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h))) := by
      intro i m x η hx h1 h2
      have hc0 : 0 ≤ P i * Cψ i m / W2 := div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hP0 i) (hCψ0 i m)) hW2pos.le
      by_cases hxo : x ≤ k1 ∨ k2 ≤ x
      · have e : (fun e => ψ i e * φ i x) = fun e => (0 : ℝ) * ψ i e := by
          funext e; rw [hφ0 i x hxo]; ring
        rw [e, iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field, zero_mul, abs_zero]
        exact mul_nonneg hc0 (hwpos x hx).le
      · push_neg at hxo
        refine (hbump i m x η h1 h2).trans ?_
        rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hW2pos]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hwanti x hx hxo.2.le) (mul_nonneg (hP0 i) (hCψ0 i m))
    intro m
    refine ⟨max ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose j : ℝ) * |CF j| * (1 + |Cq (m - j)|)) +
      (P 2 * Cψ 2 m / W2 + P 3 * Cψ 3 m / W2 + P 4 * Cψ 4 m / W2))
      (|CF m| + (P 0 * Cψ 0 m + P 1 * Cψ 1 m)), ?_⟩
    intro x η hx h1 h2
    have hbw2 := hbumpw 2 m x η hx h1 h2
    have hbw3 := hbumpw 3 m x η hx h1 h2
    have hbw4 := hbumpw 4 m x η hx h1 h2
    obtain ⟨wx, hwx⟩ : ∃ wx : ℝ, wx = x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hwx] at hbw2 hbw3 hbw4
    have hwx0 : 0 < wx := hwx ▸ hwpos x hx
    have hmem : ((x, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hx, h1, h2⟩
    have hsl : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun e => f x e) η :=
      fun f hf => (hf.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hmem)).comp η (contDiffAt_const.prodMk contDiffAt_id)
    have hψat : ∀ i, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (ψ i) η :=
      fun i => (hψs i).contDiffAt (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds ⟨h1, h2⟩)
    have hbat : ∀ i, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun e => ψ i e * φ i x) η := fun i => (hψat i).mul contDiffAt_const
    have hFj : ∀ j, |iteratedDeriv j (fun e => F x e) η| ≤ |CF j| * wx := by
      intro j
      have := (hCF j x η hx h1 h2).1
      rw [mul_assoc, ← hwx] at this
      exact this.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hwx0.le)
    have hqk : ∀ k, |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => 1 + q x e) η| ≤ 1 + |Cq k| := by
      intro k
      have hb := (hslice q hqs k x η hx h1 h2).trans ((hCq k x η hx h1 h2).trans (le_abs_self _))
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk | hk
      · subst hk
        simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero] at hb ⊢
        have := abs_add_le (1 : ℝ) (q x η)
        rw [abs_one] at this
        linarith
      · rw [iteratedDeriv_const_add (f := fun e => q x e) hk (1 : ℝ)]
        linarith
    have hqat : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun e => 1 + q x e) η := contDiffAt_const.add (hsl q hqs)
    have hL : |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => F x e * (1 + q x e)) η| ≤
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose j : ℝ) * |CF j| * (1 + |Cq (m - j)|)) * wx := by
      have e : (fun e => F x e * (1 + q x e)) = (fun e => F x e) * (fun e => 1 + q x e) := rfl
      rw [e, iteratedDeriv_mul ((hsl F hFs).of_le (hle m)) (hqat.of_le (hle m)), Finset.sum_mul]
      refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_)
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, Nat.abs_cast]
      have a1 := hFj j
      have a2 := hqk (m - j)
      have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (m.choose j : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      calc (m.choose j : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv j (fun e => F x e) η| *
            |iteratedDeriv (m - j) (fun e => 1 + q x e) η|
          ≤ (m.choose j : ℝ) * (|CF j| * wx) * (1 + |Cq (m - j)|) :=
            mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a1 h0) a2 (abs_nonneg _)
              (mul_nonneg h0 (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hwx0.le))
        _ = (m.choose j : ℝ) * |CF j| * (1 + |Cq (m - j)|) * wx := by ring
    constructor
    · have hA : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun e => F x e * (1 + q x e)) η := (hsl F hFs).mul hqat
      rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_add (hA.of_le (hle m)) ((((hbat 2).add (hbat 3)).add (hbat 4)).of_le (hle m)),
        iteratedDeriv_fun_add (((hbat 2).add (hbat 3)).of_le (hle m)) ((hbat 4).of_le (hle m)),
        iteratedDeriv_fun_add ((hbat 2).of_le (hle m)) ((hbat 3).of_le (hle m))]
      rw [mul_assoc, ← hwx]
      have a1 := abs_add_le (iteratedDeriv m (fun e => F x e * (1 + q x e)) η)
        (iteratedDeriv m (fun e => ψ 2 e * φ 2 x) η + iteratedDeriv m (fun e => ψ 3 e * φ 3 x) η +
          iteratedDeriv m (fun e => ψ 4 e * φ 4 x) η)
      have a2 := abs_add_le (iteratedDeriv m (fun e => ψ 2 e * φ 2 x) η + iteratedDeriv m (fun e => ψ 3 e * φ 3 x) η)
          (iteratedDeriv m (fun e => ψ 4 e * φ 4 x) η)
      have a3 := abs_add_le (iteratedDeriv m (fun e => ψ 2 e * φ 2 x) η) (iteratedDeriv m (fun e => ψ 3 e * φ 3 x) η)
      have hmax := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose j : ℝ) * |CF j| * (1 + |Cq (m - j)|)) +
        (P 2 * Cψ 2 m / W2 + P 3 * Cψ 3 m / W2 + P 4 * Cψ 4 m / W2))
        (|CF m| + (P 0 * Cψ 0 m + P 1 * Cψ 1 m))) hwx0.le
      have hring : ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose j : ℝ) * |CF j| * (1 + |Cq (m - j)|)) +
          (P 2 * Cψ 2 m / W2 + P 3 * Cψ 3 m / W2 + P 4 * Cψ 4 m / W2)) * wx =
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose j : ℝ) * |CF j| * (1 + |Cq (m - j)|)) * wx +
          (P 2 * Cψ 2 m / W2 * wx + P 3 * Cψ 3 m / W2 * wx + P 4 * Cψ 4 m / W2 * wx) := by ring
      linarith
    · have hA : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun e => U x e) η := hsl U hUs
      rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_add (hA.of_le (hle m)) (((hbat 0).add (hbat 1)).of_le (hle m)),
        iteratedDeriv_fun_add ((hbat 0).of_le (hle m)) ((hbat 1).of_le (hle m))]
      have hU := (hCF m x η hx h1 h2).2
      have t0 := hbump 0 m x η h1 h2
      have t1 := hbump 1 m x η h1 h2
      have a1 := abs_add_le (iteratedDeriv m (fun e => U x e) η)
        (iteratedDeriv m (fun e => ψ 0 e * φ 0 x) η + iteratedDeriv m (fun e => ψ 1 e * φ 1 x) η)
      have a2 := abs_add_le (iteratedDeriv m (fun e => ψ 0 e * φ 0 x) η) (iteratedDeriv m (fun e => ψ 1 e * φ 1 x) η)
      have a3 := le_abs_self (CF m)
      have a4 := le_max_right ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose j : ℝ) * |CF j| * (1 + |Cq (m - j)|)) +
        (P 2 * Cψ 2 m / W2 + P 3 * Cψ 3 m / W2 + P 4 * Cψ 4 m / W2))
        (|CF m| + (P 0 * Cψ 0 m + P 1 * Cψ 1 m))
      linarith
  exact ⟨hT1, hT2, hT3, hT4⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h k1 k2 x1 x2 E A : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (q : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (φ : Fin 5 → ℝ → ℝ) (ψ : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → 0 < k1 → k1 < k2 → 0 < x1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ E → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(q e)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) → (∀ x₀ x₁ : ℝ, 0 < x₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, x₀ ≤ x → x ≤ x₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (x, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (x, η)‖ ≤ C) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => F x e) η| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧ |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => U x e) η| ≤ C) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ e x η : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ E → 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(q e)) (x, η)‖ ≤ C * e) → (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (φ i)) → (∀ i x, (x ≤ k1 ∨ k2 ≤ x) → φ i x = 0) → (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ E → ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ψ e i) (Ioo (-1) 1)) → (∀ (e η : ℝ) (i : Fin 5), 0 < e → e ≤ E → -1 < η → η < 1 → |ψ e i η| ≤ A * e ∧ |deriv (ψ e i) η| ≤ A * e) → ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ E → (∀ x η : ℝ, x1 ≤ x → x ≤ x2 → -1 < η → η < 1 → |(F x η * (1 + q e x η) + (ψ e 2 η * φ 2 x + ψ e 3 η * φ 3 x + ψ e 4 η * φ 4 x)) - F x η| ≤ e * K ∧ |deriv (fun Y => F Y η) x| ≤ K ∧ |deriv (fun Y => U Y η) x| ≤ K ∧ |deriv (fun Y => (F Y η * (1 + q e Y η) + (ψ e 2 η * φ 2 Y + ψ e 3 η * φ 3 Y + ψ e 4 η * φ 4 Y)) - F Y η) x| ≤ e * K ∧ |deriv (fun Y => (U Y η + (ψ e 0 η * φ 0 Y + ψ e 1 η * φ 1 Y)) - U Y η) x| ≤ e * K) ∧ (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ 1 → ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv j (fun e' => F x e') η| ≤ K * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧ |iteratedDeriv j (fun e' => U x e') η| ≤ K ∧ |iteratedDeriv j (fun e' => (F x e' * (1 + q e x e') + (ψ e 2 e' * φ 2 x + ψ e 3 e' * φ 3 x + ψ e 4 e' * φ 4 x)) - F x e') η| ≤ e * K * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧ |iteratedDeriv j (fun e' => (U x e' + (ψ e 0 e' * φ 0 x + ψ e 1 e' * φ 1 x)) - U x e') η| ≤ e * K)

signature.name: edit_closeness
signature.statement: ∀ (h k1 k2 x1 x2 E A : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (q : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (φ : Fin 5 → ℝ → ℝ) (ψ : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → 0 < k1 → k1 < k2 → 0 < x1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ E → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(q e)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) → (∀ x₀ x₁ : ℝ, 0 < x₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, x₀ ≤ x → x ≤ x₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (x, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (x, η)‖ ≤ C) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => F x e) η| ≤ C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧ |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => U x e) η| ≤ C) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ e x η : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ E → 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(q e)) (x, η)‖ ≤ C * e) → (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (φ i)) → (∀ i x, (x ≤ k1 ∨ k2 ≤ x) → φ i x = 0) → (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ E → ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ψ e i) (Ioo (-1) 1)) → (∀ (e η : ℝ) (i : Fin 5), 0 < e → e ≤ E → -1 < η → η < 1 → |ψ e i η| ≤ A * e ∧ |deriv (ψ e i) η| ≤ A * e) → ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → e ≤ E → (∀ x η : ℝ, x1 ≤ x → x ≤ x2 → -1 < η → η < 1 → |(F x η * (1 + q e x η) + (ψ e 2 η * φ 2 x + ψ e 3 η * φ 3 x + ψ e 4 η * φ 4 x)) - F x η| ≤ e * K ∧ |deriv (fun Y => F Y η) x| ≤ K ∧ |deriv (fun Y => U Y η) x| ≤ K ∧ |deriv (fun Y => (F Y η * (1 + q e Y η) + (ψ e 2 η * φ 2 Y + ψ e 3 η * φ 3 Y + ψ e 4 η * φ 4 Y)) - F Y η) x| ≤ e * K ∧ |deriv (fun Y => (U Y η + (ψ e 0 η * φ 0 Y + ψ e 1 η * φ 1 Y)) - U Y η) x| ≤ e * K) ∧ (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ 1 → ∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv j (fun e' => F x e') η| ≤ K * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧ |iteratedDeriv j (fun e' => U x e') η| ≤ K ∧ |iteratedDeriv j (fun e' => (F x e' * (1 + q e x e') + (ψ e 2 e' * φ 2 x + ψ e 3 e' * φ 3 x + ψ e 4 e' * φ 4 x)) - F x e') η| ≤ e * K * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ∧ |iteratedDeriv j (fun e' => (U x e' + (ψ e 0 e' * φ 0 x + ψ e 1 e' * φ 1 x)) - U x e') η| ≤ e * K)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h k1 k2 x1 x2 E A F U q φ ψ hh hk1 hk12 hx1 hFs hUs hqs hFbd hwt hq hφs hφ0 hψs hψb
  have hinf : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  
  have slice : ∀ (G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (x η : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → 0 < x →
      -1 < η → η < 1 →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y => G Y η) x ∧
      |deriv (fun Y => G Y η) x| ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (↿G) (x, η)‖ ∧
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e => G x e) η ∧
      |deriv (fun e => G x e) η| ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (↿G) (x, η)‖ := by
    intro G x η hG hx h1 h2
    have hmem : (x, η) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨hx, h1, h2⟩
    have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿G) (x, η) :=
      (hG.contDiffAt ((isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo).mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt hinf
    have hL := hdiff.hasFDerivAt
    have hγ1 : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, η)) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) x :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const x η)
    have hγ2 : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => (x, e)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) η :=
      (hasDerivAt_const η x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' η)
    have hc1' : HasDerivAt ((↿G) ∘ fun Y : ℝ => (Y, η)) (fderiv ℝ (↿G) (x, η) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) x :=
      hL.comp_hasDerivAt x hγ1
    have hc2' : HasDerivAt ((↿G) ∘ fun e : ℝ => (x, e)) (fderiv ℝ (↿G) (x, η) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) η :=
      hL.comp_hasDerivAt η hγ2
    have hc1 : HasDerivAt (fun Y => G Y η) (fderiv ℝ (↿G) (x, η) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) x := hc1'
    have hc2 : HasDerivAt (fun e => G x e) (fderiv ℝ (↿G) (x, η) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) η := hc2'
    have hn : ‖fderiv ℝ (↿G) (x, η)‖ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (↿G) (x, η)‖ :=
      (norm_iteratedFDeriv_one _).symm
    refine ⟨hc1.differentiableAt, ?_, hc2.differentiableAt, ?_⟩
    · rw [hc1.deriv, ← Real.norm_eq_abs, ← hn]
      calc ‖fderiv ℝ (↿G) (x, η) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))‖
          ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (↿G) (x, η)‖ * ‖((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
        _ = ‖fderiv ℝ (↿G) (x, η)‖ := by simp
    · rw [hc2.deriv, ← Real.norm_eq_abs, ← hn]
      calc ‖fderiv ℝ (↿G) (x, η) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖
          ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (↿G) (x, η)‖ * ‖((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
        _ = ‖fderiv ℝ (↿G) (x, η)‖ := by simp
  
  have hφd : ∀ i x, DifferentiableAt ℝ (φ i) x := fun i x => ((hφs i).differentiable hinf) x
  have hbump : ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ (i : Fin 5) (x : ℝ), |φ i x| ≤ M ∧ |deriv (φ i) x| ≤ M ∧
      (0 < x → |φ i x| ≤ M * (x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)))) := by
    have hb0 : ∀ i, ∃ B, ∀ x ∈ Icc k1 k2, ‖φ i x‖ ≤ B := fun i =>
      isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hφs i).continuous.continuousOn
    have hb1 : ∀ i, ∃ B, ∀ x ∈ Icc k1 k2, ‖deriv (φ i) x‖ ≤ B := fun i =>
      isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        ((hφs i).continuous_deriv (by simp)).continuousOn
    choose B0 hB0 using hb0
    choose B1 hB1 using hb1
    obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, S = ∑ i, (|B0 i| + |B1 i|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hSi : ∀ i, |B0 i| + |B1 i| ≤ S := fun i => by
      rw [hS]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |B0 i| + |B1 i|)
        (fun j _ => by positivity) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have hS0 : 0 ≤ S := le_trans (by positivity) (hSi 0)
    have hglob : ∀ i x, |φ i x| ≤ S ∧ |deriv (φ i) x| ≤ S := by
      intro i x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Icc k1 k2
      · have a := hB0 i x hx
        have b := hB1 i x hx
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at a b
        have := hSi i
        constructor
        · linarith [le_abs_self (B0 i), abs_nonneg (B1 i)]
        · linarith [le_abs_self (B1 i), abs_nonneg (B0 i)]
      · have hx' : x < k1 ∨ k2 < x := by
          simp only [mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le] at hx; exact hx
        have hev : φ i =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
          rcases hx' with hx' | hx'
          · filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hx'] with y hy
            exact hφ0 i y (Or.inl (le_of_lt hy))
          · filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hx'] with y hy
            exact hφ0 i y (Or.inr (le_of_lt hy))
        rw [hev.eq_of_nhds, hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
        simp [hS0]
    have hk2 : 0 < k2 := by linarith
    obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ, W = k2 ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + k2) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hW0 : 0 < W := by
      rw [hW]
      exact mul_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hk2 _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith) _)
    have hSW : 0 ≤ S / W := div_nonneg hS0 hW0.le
    refine ⟨S + S / W, by positivity, fun i x => ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · linarith [(hglob i x).1]
    · linarith [(hglob i x).2]
    · intro hx
      have hw0 : 0 ≤ x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) :=
        mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hx.le _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
      by_cases hxk : x ≤ k2
      · have hWle : W ≤ x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) := by
          rw [hW]
          exact mul_le_mul (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hx hxk (by norm_num))
            (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith))
            (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hx.le _)
        have h1 : S ≤ S / W * (x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h))) := by
          calc S = S / W * W := by field_simp
            _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hWle hSW
        calc |φ i x| ≤ S := (hglob i x).1
          _ ≤ S / W * (x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h))) := h1
          _ ≤ (S + S / W) * (x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h))) := by
            rw [add_mul]; linarith [mul_nonneg hS0 hw0]
      · rw [hφ0 i x (Or.inr (le_of_lt (not_le.mp hxk))), abs_zero]
        exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) hw0
  
  obtain ⟨M, hM0, hM⟩ := hbump
  obtain ⟨CF0, hCF0⟩ := hFbd x1 x2 hx1 0
  obtain ⟨CF1, hCF1⟩ := hFbd x1 x2 hx1 1
  obtain ⟨Cw0, hCw0⟩ := hwt 0
  obtain ⟨Cw1, hCw1⟩ := hwt 1
  obtain ⟨Cq0, hCq0⟩ := hq 0
  obtain ⟨Cq1, hCq1⟩ := hq 1
  obtain ⟨D0, hD0⟩ : ∃ D, D = |CF0| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨D1, hD1⟩ : ∃ D, D = |CF1| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Cw, hCw⟩ : ∃ D, D = |Cw0| + |Cw1| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Q0, hQ0⟩ : ∃ D, D = |Cq0| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Q1, hQ1⟩ : ∃ D, D = |Cq1| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨A', hA'⟩ : ∃ D, D = |A| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD00 : 0 ≤ D0 := by rw [hD0]; exact abs_nonneg _
  have hD10 : 0 ≤ D1 := by rw [hD1]; exact abs_nonneg _
  have hCw00 : 0 ≤ Cw := by rw [hCw]; positivity
  have hQ00 : 0 ≤ Q0 := by rw [hQ0]; exact abs_nonneg _
  have hQ10 : 0 ≤ Q1 := by rw [hQ1]; exact abs_nonneg _
  have hA'0 : 0 ≤ A' := by rw [hA']; exact abs_nonneg _
  have hCF0D : CF0 ≤ D0 := by rw [hD0]; exact le_abs_self _
  have hCF1D : CF1 ≤ D1 := by rw [hD1]; exact le_abs_self _
  have hCw0C : Cw0 ≤ Cw := by rw [hCw]; linarith [le_abs_self Cw0, abs_nonneg Cw1]
  have hCw1C : Cw1 ≤ Cw := by rw [hCw]; linarith [le_abs_self Cw1, abs_nonneg Cw0]
  have hCq0Q : Cq0 ≤ Q0 := by rw [hQ0]; exact le_abs_self _
  have hCq1Q : Cq1 ≤ Q1 := by rw [hQ1]; exact le_abs_self _
  have hAA : A ≤ A' := by rw [hA']; exact le_abs_self _
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = D1 + Cw + 2 * (D0 + D1 + Cw) * (Q0 + Q1) + 3 * A' * M := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have p1 := mul_nonneg hD00 hQ00
  have p2 := mul_nonneg hD00 hQ10
  have p3 := mul_nonneg hD10 hQ00
  have p4 := mul_nonneg hD10 hQ10
  have p5 := mul_nonneg hCw00 hQ00
  have p6 := mul_nonneg hCw00 hQ10
  have p7 := mul_nonneg hA'0 hM0
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := by rw [hK]; nlinarith
  have kA1 : D0 * Q0 + 3 * A' * M ≤ K := by rw [hK]; nlinarith
  have kA4 : D1 * Q0 + D0 * Q1 + 3 * A' * M ≤ K := by rw [hK]; nlinarith
  have kA5 : 2 * A' * M ≤ K := by rw [hK]; nlinarith
  have kD1 : D1 ≤ K := by rw [hK]; nlinarith
  have kCw : Cw ≤ K := by rw [hK]; nlinarith
  have kB0 : Cw * Q0 + 3 * A' * M ≤ K := by rw [hK]; nlinarith
  have kB1 : Cw * Q0 + Cw * Q1 + 3 * A' * M ≤ K := by rw [hK]; nlinarith
  
  have pb : ∀ u v P V : ℝ, |u| ≤ P → |v| ≤ V → |u * v| ≤ P * V := fun u v P V hu hv => by
    rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hu hv (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans hu)
  have tri4 : ∀ a b c d : ℝ, |a + (b + c + d)| ≤ |a| + |b| + |c| + |d| := fun a b c d => by
    have := abs_add_le a (b + c + d); have := abs_add_three b c d; linarith
  have tri5 : ∀ a b c d f : ℝ, |a + b + (c + d + f)| ≤ |a| + |b| + |c| + |d| + |f| :=
    fun a b c d f => by
      have := abs_add_le (a + b) (c + d + f); have := abs_add_le a b
      have := abs_add_three c d f; linarith
  refine ⟨K, hK0, fun e he heE => ⟨fun x η hx1' hx2' h1 h2 => ?_, fun j hj x η hx h1 h2 => ?_⟩⟩
  · 
    have hx : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hx1 hx1'
    obtain ⟨sF1, sF2, -, -⟩ := slice F x η hFs hx h1 h2
    obtain ⟨-, sU2, -, -⟩ := slice U x η hUs hx h1 h2
    obtain ⟨sq1, sq2, -, -⟩ := slice (q e) x η (hqs e he heE) hx h1 h2
    have hF0 : |F x η| ≤ D0 := by
      have := (hCF0 x η hx1' hx2' h1 h2).1
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      exact this.trans hCF0D
    have hFd : |deriv (fun Y => F Y η) x| ≤ D1 :=
      sF2.trans ((hCF1 x η hx1' hx2' h1 h2).1.trans hCF1D)
    have hUd : |deriv (fun Y => U Y η) x| ≤ D1 :=
      sU2.trans ((hCF1 x η hx1' hx2' h1 h2).2.trans hCF1D)
    have hq0 : |q e x η| ≤ Q0 * e := by
      have := hCq0 e x η he heE hx h1 h2
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      exact this.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCq0Q he.le)
    have hqd : |deriv (fun Y => q e Y η) x| ≤ Q1 * e :=
      sq2.trans ((hCq1 e x η he heE hx h1 h2).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCq1Q he.le))
    have hψ : ∀ i, |ψ e i η| ≤ A' * e := fun i =>
      (hψb e η i he heE h1 h2).1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAA he.le)
    refine ⟨?_, hFd.trans kD1, hUd.trans kD1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc |(F x η * (1 + q e x η) + (ψ e 2 η * φ 2 x + ψ e 3 η * φ 3 x + ψ e 4 η * φ 4 x)) - F x η|
          = |F x η * q e x η + (ψ e 2 η * φ 2 x + ψ e 3 η * φ 3 x + ψ e 4 η * φ 4 x)| := by
            congr 1; ring
        _ ≤ |F x η * q e x η| + |ψ e 2 η * φ 2 x| + |ψ e 3 η * φ 3 x| + |ψ e 4 η * φ 4 x| :=
            tri4 _ _ _ _
        _ ≤ D0 * (Q0 * e) + A' * e * M + A' * e * M + A' * e * M :=
            add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add (pb _ _ _ _ hF0 hq0)
              (pb _ _ _ _ (hψ 2) (hM 2 x).1)) (pb _ _ _ _ (hψ 3) (hM 3 x).1))
              (pb _ _ _ _ (hψ 4) (hM 4 x).1)
        _ = e * (D0 * Q0 + 3 * A' * M) := by ring
        _ ≤ e * K := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left kA1 he.le
    · have hfun : (fun Y => (F Y η * (1 + q e Y η) + (ψ e 2 η * φ 2 Y + ψ e 3 η * φ 3 Y + ψ e 4 η * φ 4 Y)) - F Y η)
          = fun Y => F Y η * q e Y η + (ψ e 2 η * φ 2 Y + ψ e 3 η * φ 3 Y + ψ e 4 η * φ 4 Y) := by
        funext Y; ring
      have hd : HasDerivAt (fun Y => F Y η * q e Y η + (ψ e 2 η * φ 2 Y + ψ e 3 η * φ 3 Y + ψ e 4 η * φ 4 Y))
          (deriv (fun Y => F Y η) x * q e x η + F x η * deriv (fun Y => q e Y η) x +
            (ψ e 2 η * deriv (φ 2) x + ψ e 3 η * deriv (φ 3) x + ψ e 4 η * deriv (φ 4) x)) x :=
        (sF1.hasDerivAt.mul sq1.hasDerivAt).add
          ((((hφd 2 x).hasDerivAt.const_mul (ψ e 2 η)).add
            ((hφd 3 x).hasDerivAt.const_mul (ψ e 3 η))).add
            ((hφd 4 x).hasDerivAt.const_mul (ψ e 4 η)))
      rw [hfun, hd.deriv]
      calc _ ≤ |deriv (fun Y => F Y η) x * q e x η| + |F x η * deriv (fun Y => q e Y η) x| +
            |ψ e 2 η * deriv (φ 2) x| + |ψ e 3 η * deriv (φ 3) x| + |ψ e 4 η * deriv (φ 4) x| :=
            tri5 _ _ _ _ _
        _ ≤ D1 * (Q0 * e) + D0 * (Q1 * e) + A' * e * M + A' * e * M + A' * e * M :=
            add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add (pb _ _ _ _ hFd hq0)
              (pb _ _ _ _ hF0 hqd)) (pb _ _ _ _ (hψ 2) (hM 2 x).2.1))
              (pb _ _ _ _ (hψ 3) (hM 3 x).2.1)) (pb _ _ _ _ (hψ 4) (hM 4 x).2.1)
        _ = e * (D1 * Q0 + D0 * Q1 + 3 * A' * M) := by ring
        _ ≤ e * K := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left kA4 he.le
    · have hfun : (fun Y => (U Y η + (ψ e 0 η * φ 0 Y + ψ e 1 η * φ 1 Y)) - U Y η)
          = fun Y => ψ e 0 η * φ 0 Y + ψ e 1 η * φ 1 Y := by
        funext Y; ring
      have hd : HasDerivAt (fun Y => ψ e 0 η * φ 0 Y + ψ e 1 η * φ 1 Y)
          (ψ e 0 η * deriv (φ 0) x + ψ e 1 η * deriv (φ 1) x) x :=
        ((hφd 0 x).hasDerivAt.const_mul (ψ e 0 η)).add ((hφd 1 x).hasDerivAt.const_mul (ψ e 1 η))
      rw [hfun, hd.deriv]
      calc _ ≤ |ψ e 0 η * deriv (φ 0) x| + |ψ e 1 η * deriv (φ 1) x| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ A' * e * M + A' * e * M :=
            add_le_add (pb _ _ _ _ (hψ 0) (hM 0 x).2.1) (pb _ _ _ _ (hψ 1) (hM 1 x).2.1)
        _ = e * (2 * A' * M) := by ring
        _ ≤ e * K := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left kA5 he.le
  · 
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : ℝ, w = x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hw0 : 0 ≤ w := by
      rw [hw]; exact mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hx.le _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
    have hwr : ∀ C : ℝ, C * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) = C * w := fun C => by
      rw [hw]; ring
    obtain ⟨-, -, sF3, -⟩ := slice F x η hFs hx h1 h2
    obtain ⟨-, -, sq3, sq4⟩ := slice (q e) x η (hqs e he heE) hx h1 h2
    have hF0 : |F x η| ≤ Cw * w := by
      have := (hCw0 x η hx h1 h2).1
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, hwr] at this
      exact this.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCw0C hw0)
    have hFd : |deriv (fun e' => F x e') η| ≤ Cw * w := by
      have := (hCw1 x η hx h1 h2).1
      rw [iteratedDeriv_one, hwr] at this
      exact this.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCw1C hw0)
    have hq0 : |q e x η| ≤ Q0 * e := by
      have := hCq0 e x η he heE hx h1 h2
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      exact this.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCq0Q he.le)
    have hqd : |deriv (fun e' => q e x e') η| ≤ Q1 * e :=
      sq4.trans ((hCq1 e x η he heE hx h1 h2).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCq1Q he.le))
    have hψ : ∀ i, |ψ e i η| ≤ A' * e := fun i =>
      (hψb e η i he heE h1 h2).1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAA he.le)
    have hψ' : ∀ i, |deriv (ψ e i) η| ≤ A' * e := fun i =>
      (hψb e η i he heE h1 h2).2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAA he.le)
    have hψd : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (ψ e i) η := fun i =>
      ((hψs e he heE i).contDiffAt (Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2)).differentiableAt hinf
    have hφw : ∀ i, |φ i x| ≤ M * w := fun i => by rw [hw]; exact (hM i x).2.2 hx
    rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.mp hj with rfl | rfl
    · refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hwr]
        have := (hCw0 x η hx h1 h2).1
        rw [hwr] at this
        exact this.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hCw0C.trans kCw) hw0)
      · exact (hCw0 x η hx h1 h2).2.trans (hCw0C.trans kCw)
      · rw [iteratedDeriv_zero]
        calc |(F x η * (1 + q e x η) + (ψ e 2 η * φ 2 x + ψ e 3 η * φ 3 x + ψ e 4 η * φ 4 x)) - F x η|
            = |F x η * q e x η + (ψ e 2 η * φ 2 x + ψ e 3 η * φ 3 x + ψ e 4 η * φ 4 x)| := by
              congr 1; ring
          _ ≤ |F x η * q e x η| + |ψ e 2 η * φ 2 x| + |ψ e 3 η * φ 3 x| + |ψ e 4 η * φ 4 x| :=
              tri4 _ _ _ _
          _ ≤ Cw * w * (Q0 * e) + A' * e * (M * w) + A' * e * (M * w) + A' * e * (M * w) :=
              add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add (pb _ _ _ _ hF0 hq0)
                (pb _ _ _ _ (hψ 2) (hφw 2))) (pb _ _ _ _ (hψ 3) (hφw 3)))
                (pb _ _ _ _ (hψ 4) (hφw 4))
          _ = e * (Cw * Q0 + 3 * A' * M) * w := by ring
          _ ≤ e * K * w :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left kB0 he.le) hw0
          _ = e * K * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) := by rw [hw]; ring
      · rw [iteratedDeriv_zero]
        calc |(U x η + (ψ e 0 η * φ 0 x + ψ e 1 η * φ 1 x)) - U x η|
            = |ψ e 0 η * φ 0 x + ψ e 1 η * φ 1 x| := by congr 1; ring
          _ ≤ |ψ e 0 η * φ 0 x| + |ψ e 1 η * φ 1 x| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ A' * e * M + A' * e * M :=
              add_le_add (pb _ _ _ _ (hψ 0) (hM 0 x).1) (pb _ _ _ _ (hψ 1) (hM 1 x).1)
          _ = e * (2 * A' * M) := by ring
          _ ≤ e * K := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left kA5 he.le
    · refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hwr]
        have := (hCw1 x η hx h1 h2).1
        rw [hwr] at this
        exact this.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hCw1C.trans kCw) hw0)
      · exact (hCw1 x η hx h1 h2).2.trans (hCw1C.trans kCw)
      · have hfun : (fun e' => (F x e' * (1 + q e x e') + (ψ e 2 e' * φ 2 x + ψ e 3 e' * φ 3 x + ψ e 4 e' * φ 4 x)) - F x e')
            = fun e' => F x e' * q e x e' + (ψ e 2 e' * φ 2 x + ψ e 3 e' * φ 3 x + ψ e 4 e' * φ 4 x) := by
          funext e'; ring
        have hd : HasDerivAt (fun e' => F x e' * q e x e' + (ψ e 2 e' * φ 2 x + ψ e 3 e' * φ 3 x + ψ e 4 e' * φ 4 x))
            (deriv (fun e' => F x e') η * q e x η + F x η * deriv (fun e' => q e x e') η +
              (deriv (ψ e 2) η * φ 2 x + deriv (ψ e 3) η * φ 3 x + deriv (ψ e 4) η * φ 4 x)) η :=
          (sF3.hasDerivAt.mul sq3.hasDerivAt).add
            ((((hψd 2).hasDerivAt.mul_const (φ 2 x)).add
              ((hψd 3).hasDerivAt.mul_const (φ 3 x))).add
              ((hψd 4).hasDerivAt.mul_const (φ 4 x)))
        rw [iteratedDeriv_one, hfun, hd.deriv]
        calc _ ≤ |deriv (fun e' => F x e') η * q e x η| + |F x η * deriv (fun e' => q e x e') η| +
              |deriv (ψ e 2) η * φ 2 x| + |deriv (ψ e 3) η * φ 3 x| + |deriv (ψ e 4) η * φ 4 x| :=
              tri5 _ _ _ _ _
          _ ≤ Cw * w * (Q0 * e) + Cw * w * (Q1 * e) + A' * e * (M * w) + A' * e * (M * w) +
                A' * e * (M * w) :=
              add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add (pb _ _ _ _ hFd hq0)
                (pb _ _ _ _ hF0 hqd)) (pb _ _ _ _ (hψ' 2) (hφw 2)))
                (pb _ _ _ _ (hψ' 3) (hφw 3))) (pb _ _ _ _ (hψ' 4) (hφw 4))
          _ = e * (Cw * Q0 + Cw * Q1 + 3 * A' * M) * w := by ring
          _ ≤ e * K * w :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left kB1 he.le) hw0
          _ = e * K * x ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * (1 + x) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) := by rw [hw]; ring
      · have hfun : (fun e' => (U x e' + (ψ e 0 e' * φ 0 x + ψ e 1 e' * φ 1 x)) - U x e')
            = fun e' => ψ e 0 e' * φ 0 x + ψ e 1 e' * φ 1 x := by
          funext e'; ring
        have hd : HasDerivAt (fun e' => ψ e 0 e' * φ 0 x + ψ e 1 e' * φ 1 x)
            (deriv (ψ e 0) η * φ 0 x + deriv (ψ e 1) η * φ 1 x) η :=
          ((hψd 0).hasDerivAt.mul_const (φ 0 x)).add ((hψd 1).hasDerivAt.mul_const (φ 1 x))
        rw [iteratedDeriv_one, hfun, hd.deriv]
        calc _ ≤ |deriv (ψ e 0) η * φ 0 x| + |deriv (ψ e 1) η * φ 1 x| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ A' * e * M + A' * e * M :=
              add_le_add (pb _ _ _ _ (hψ' 0) (hM 0 x).1) (pb _ _ _ _ (hψ' 1) (hM 1 x).1)
          _ = e * (2 * A' * M) := by ring
          _ ≤ e * K := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left kA5 he.le

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h ci k1 k2 a : ℝ) (F U G V q : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < k1 → k1 < k2 → k2 < a → MomTot h ci F U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿V) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ k1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → G x η = F x η ∧ V x η = U x η) → (∀ x η : ℝ, k2 ≤ x → x < a → -1 < η → η < 1 → G x η = F x η ∧ V x η = U x η) → (∀ x η : ℝ, a ≤ x → -1 < η → η < 1 → G x η = F x η * (1 + q x η) ∧ V x η = 0 ∧ U x η = 0) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → IntegrableOn (fun x => 2 * x * F x η * q x η) (Ioi a) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => x * F x η ^ 2 * (2 * q x η + q x η ^ 2)) (Ioi a) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2 * (2 * q x η + q x η ^ 2)) (Ioi a)) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → (∫ x in k1..k2, (V x η * (2 * x * G x η) - U x η * (2 * x * F x η))) = 0 ∧ (∫ x in k1..k2, ((V x η ^ 2 - x * G x η ^ 2) - (U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2))) - (∫ x in Ioi a, x * F x η ^ 2 * (2 * q x η + q x η ^ 2)) = 0 ∧ (∫ x in k1..k2, 2 * x * (G x η - F x η)) + (∫ x in Ioi a, 2 * x * F x η * q x η) = 0 ∧ (∫ x in k1..k2, (G x η ^ 2 - F x η ^ 2)) + (∫ x in Ioi a, F x η ^ 2 * (2 * q x η + q x η ^ 2)) = 0 ∧ (∫ x in k1..k2, (V x η - U x η)) = 0) → MomTot h ci G V ∧ (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → leadPi G 0 η = leadPi F 0 η) ∧ ∀ x η : ℝ, k2 ≤ x → -1 < η → η < 1 → profRadInt V x η = profRadInt U x η

signature.name: edit_moment_totals
signature.statement: ∀ (h ci k1 k2 a : ℝ) (F U G V q : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < k1 → k1 < k2 → k2 < a → MomTot h ci F U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿V) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ x η : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ k1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → G x η = F x η ∧ V x η = U x η) → (∀ x η : ℝ, k2 ≤ x → x < a → -1 < η → η < 1 → G x η = F x η ∧ V x η = U x η) → (∀ x η : ℝ, a ≤ x → -1 < η → η < 1 → G x η = F x η * (1 + q x η) ∧ V x η = 0 ∧ U x η = 0) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → IntegrableOn (fun x => 2 * x * F x η * q x η) (Ioi a) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => x * F x η ^ 2 * (2 * q x η + q x η ^ 2)) (Ioi a) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2 * (2 * q x η + q x η ^ 2)) (Ioi a)) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → (∫ x in k1..k2, (V x η * (2 * x * G x η) - U x η * (2 * x * F x η))) = 0 ∧ (∫ x in k1..k2, ((V x η ^ 2 - x * G x η ^ 2) - (U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2))) - (∫ x in Ioi a, x * F x η ^ 2 * (2 * q x η + q x η ^ 2)) = 0 ∧ (∫ x in k1..k2, 2 * x * (G x η - F x η)) + (∫ x in Ioi a, 2 * x * F x η * q x η) = 0 ∧ (∫ x in k1..k2, (G x η ^ 2 - F x η ^ 2)) + (∫ x in Ioi a, F x η ^ 2 * (2 * q x η + q x η ^ 2)) = 0 ∧ (∫ x in k1..k2, (V x η - U x η)) = 0) → MomTot h ci G V ∧ (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → leadPi G 0 η = leadPi F 0 η) ∧ ∀ x η : ℝ, k2 ≤ x → -1 < η → η < 1 → profRadInt V x η = profRadInt U x η

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h ci k1 k2 a F U G V q hk1 hk12 hk2a hMT hF hU hG hV hL1 hL2 hT hInt hI
  
  have s1 : ∀ (f g m τ : ℝ → ℝ), IntegrableOn f (Ioi 0) → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ k1 → g x = f x) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, k1 ≤ x → x ≤ k2 → g x - f x = m x) → ContinuousOn m (Icc k1 k2) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, k2 ≤ x → x < a → g x = f x) → (∀ x : ℝ, a ≤ x → g x - f x = τ x) →
      IntegrableOn τ (Ioi a) → IntegrableOn g (Ioi 0) ∧
        (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), g x) = (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), f x) + (∫ x in k1..k2, m x) + ∫ x in Ioi a, τ x := by
    intro f g m τ hf h1 h2 hm h3 h4 hτ
    set δ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => g x - f x with hδ
    have hA : IntegrableOn δ (Ioc 0 k1) := by
      refine (integrableOn_zero).congr_fun (fun x hx => ?_) measurableSet_Ioc
      show (0:ℝ) = g x - f x
      rw [h1 x hx.1 hx.2, sub_self]
    have hB : IntegrableOn δ (Ioc k1 k2) :=
      ((hm.integrableOn_Icc).mono_set Ioc_subset_Icc_self).congr_fun
        (fun x hx => (h2 x hx.1.le hx.2).symm) measurableSet_Ioc
    have hC : IntegrableOn δ (Ioo k2 a) := by
      refine (integrableOn_zero).congr_fun (fun x hx => ?_) measurableSet_Ioo
      show (0:ℝ) = g x - f x
      rw [h3 x hx.1.le hx.2, sub_self]
    have hD : IntegrableOn δ (Ici a) :=
      ((integrableOn_Ici_iff_integrableOn_Ioi).mpr hτ).congr_fun (fun x hx => (h4 x hx).symm)
        measurableSet_Ici
    have hdisj : Disjoint (Ioo k2 a) (Ici a) :=
      Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun x hx hx' => absurd hx.2 (not_lt.mpr hx')
    have hδk2 : IntegrableOn δ (Ioi k2) := by
      rw [← Ioo_union_Ici_eq_Ioi hk2a]; exact hC.union hD
    have hδk1 : IntegrableOn δ (Ioi k1) := by
      rw [← Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hk12.le]; exact hB.union hδk2
    have hδint : IntegrableOn δ (Ioi 0) := by
      rw [← Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hk1.le]; exact hA.union hδk1
    have q1 : (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), δ x) = (∫ x in Ioc 0 k1, δ x) + ∫ x in Ioi k1, δ x := by
      rw [← setIntegral_union (Ioc_disjoint_Ioi le_rfl) measurableSet_Ioi hA hδk1,
        Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hk1.le]
    have q2 : (∫ x in Ioi k1, δ x) = (∫ x in Ioc k1 k2, δ x) + ∫ x in Ioi k2, δ x := by
      rw [← setIntegral_union (Ioc_disjoint_Ioi le_rfl) measurableSet_Ioi hB hδk2,
        Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hk12.le]
    have q3 : (∫ x in Ioi k2, δ x) = (∫ x in Ioo k2 a, δ x) + ∫ x in Ici a, δ x := by
      rw [← setIntegral_union hdisj measurableSet_Ici hC hD, Ioo_union_Ici_eq_Ioi hk2a]
    have q4 : (∫ x in Ioc 0 k1, δ x) = 0 :=
      setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero (fun x hx => by
        show g x - f x = 0
        rw [h1 x hx.1 hx.2, sub_self])
    have q6 : (∫ x in Ioo k2 a, δ x) = 0 :=
      setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero (fun x hx => by
        show g x - f x = 0
        rw [h3 x hx.1.le hx.2, sub_self])
    have q5 : (∫ x in Ioc k1 k2, δ x) = ∫ x in k1..k2, m x := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hk12.le]
      exact setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioc (fun x hx => h2 x hx.1.le hx.2)
    have q7 : (∫ x in Ici a, δ x) = ∫ x in Ioi a, τ x := by
      rw [integral_Ici_eq_integral_Ioi]
      exact setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun x hx => h4 x (le_of_lt hx))
    have hgeq : (fun x => g x) = fun x => f x + δ x := by
      funext x; simp only [hδ]; ring
    have hg : IntegrableOn g (Ioi 0) := by
      have := hf.add hδint
      rw [show g = fun x => f x + δ x from hgeq]
      exact this
    refine ⟨hg, ?_⟩
    rw [show (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), g x) = ∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (f x + δ x) by rw [hgeq],
      integral_add hf hδint, q1, q2, q3, q4, q5, q6, q7]
    ring
  
  have s2 : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable f volume 0 X) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ k1 → g x = f x) → ContinuousOn g (Ioi 0) →
      ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 X := by
    intro f g hf h1 hg X hX
    have base : ∀ Y, 0 ≤ Y → Y ≤ k1 → IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 Y := by
      intro Y hY hYk
      refine (hf Y hY).congr ?_
      rw [uIoc_of_le hY]
      intro x hx
      exact (h1 x hx.1 (hx.2.trans hYk)).symm
    by_cases hXk : X ≤ k1
    · exact base X hX hXk
    · have hXk' : k1 < X := lt_of_not_ge hXk
      refine (base k1 hk1.le le_rfl).trans ?_
      refine (hg.mono ?_).intervalIntegrable
      rw [uIcc_of_le hXk'.le]
      intro x hx
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hk1 hx.1
  
  have s3 : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable f volume 0 X) →
      (∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 X) → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ k1 → g x = f x) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, k2 ≤ x → g x = f x) → (∫ x in k1..k2, (g x - f x)) = 0 →
      ∀ X : ℝ, k2 ≤ X → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, g x) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, f x := by
    intro f g hf hg h1 h2 hI0 X hX
    have hX0 : 0 ≤ X := by linarith
    have sub : ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ), IntervalIntegrable φ volume 0 X → ∀ c d : ℝ, 0 ≤ c → c ≤ d → d ≤ X →
        IntervalIntegrable φ volume c d := by
      intro φ hφ c d hc hcd hd
      refine hφ.mono_set ?_
      rw [uIcc_of_le hcd, uIcc_of_le hX0]
      exact Icc_subset_Icc hc hd
    have split : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, IntervalIntegrable φ volume 0 X →
        (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, φ x) = (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..k1, φ x) + (∫ x in k1..k2, φ x) + ∫ x in k2..X, φ x := by
      intro φ hφ
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (sub φ hφ 0 k1 le_rfl hk1.le (by linarith))
          (sub φ hφ k1 k2 hk1.le hk12.le hX),
        intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (sub φ hφ 0 k2 le_rfl (by linarith) hX)
          (sub φ hφ k2 X (by linarith) hX le_rfl)]
    have e1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..k1, g x) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..k1, f x := by
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x hx => ?_)
      rw [uIoc_of_le hk1.le] at hx
      exact h1 x hx.1 hx.2
    have e3 : (∫ x in k2..X, g x) = ∫ x in k2..X, f x := by
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x hx => ?_)
      rw [uIcc_of_le hX] at hx
      exact h2 x hx.1
    have e2 : (∫ x in k1..k2, g x) = ∫ x in k1..k2, f x := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (sub g (hg X hX0) k1 k2 hk1.le hk12.le hX)
        (sub f (hf X hX0) k1 k2 hk1.le hk12.le hX)] at hI0
      linarith

by
  intro h y hh hy

  have h1y : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + y := by linarith
  have hyle : y ≤ 1 + y := by linarith
  have ha : 0 < y ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hy _
  have hb : 0 < (1 + y) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hy1 _
  have hc : 0 < (1 + y) ^ (-(3 / 5 : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hy1 _
  have hb1 : (1 + y) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ≤ 1 :=
    Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos h1y (by linarith)
  have hbc : (1 + y) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ≤ (1 + y) ^ (-(3 / 5 : ℝ)) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h1y (by linarith)
  have hcy : (1 + y) ^ (-(3 / 5 : ℝ)) ≤ y ^ (-(3 / 5 : ℝ)) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hy hyle (by norm_num)
  have hby : (1 + y) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) ≤ y ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hy hyle (by linarith)
  have e1 : y ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * y ^ (-(3 / 5 : ℝ)) = y⁻¹ := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hy, show (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) + -(3 / 5) = -1 by norm_num, Real.rpow_neg_one]
  have e2 : y ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * y ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) = y ^ (-(1 + h)) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hy]; congr 1; ring
  have e3 : y ^ (-(1 + h)) * y ^ (-(1 + h)) = y ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hy]; congr 1; ring
  have e4 : y ^ (1 : ℝ) * (y ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) * y ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ))) = y ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := by

    rw [← Real.rpow_add hy1, ← Real.rpow_add hy1]; congr 1; norm_num
  have hm : y ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ (1 + y) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow hy.le hyle (by norm_num)
  have hinv : (1 + y) ^ (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos h1y (by norm_num)
  set a := y ^ (-(2 / 5 : ℝ)) with ha_def
  set b := (1 + y) ^ (-(3 / 5 + h)) with hb_def
  set c := (1 + y) ^ (-(3 / 5 : ℝ)) with hc_def
  have hw : 0 < a * b := mul_pos ha hb
  refine ⟨hw, mul_le_of_le_one_right ha.le hb1, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (g1 g2 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X A ε : ℝ), 0 < X → 0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ y e : ℝ, 0 < y → y ≤ X → -1 < e → e < 1 → |g1 y e| ≤ A ∧ |deriv (fun e' => g1 y e') e| ≤ A ∧ |g2 y e - g1 y e| ≤ ε * A ∧ |deriv (fun e' => g2 y e' - g1 y e') e| ≤ ε * A) → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |profRadInt g1 X η| ≤ A * X ∧ |profEtaD (profRadInt g1) X η| ≤ A * X ∧ |profRadInt g2 X η - profRadInt g1 X η| ≤ ε * (A * X) ∧ |profEtaD (profRadInt g2) X η - profEtaD (profRadInt g1) X η| ≤ ε * (A * X)

    constructor
    · rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [b1.1, b1.2, b3.1, b3.2]
    · rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [b2.1, b2.2, b4.1, b4.2]
  obtain ⟨I1, J1, E1⟩ := leib g1 A dd1 c1 hB1
  obtain ⟨I2, J2, E2⟩ := leib g2 (A + ε * A) dd2 c2 hB2
  have hXabs : |X - 0| = X := by rw [sub_zero, abs_of_pos hX]
  have key : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ t, 0 < t → t ≤ X → |f t| ≤ C) →
      |∫ y in (0:ℝ)..X, f y| ≤ C * X := by
    intro f C hf
    have := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := 0) (b := X) (f := f) (C := C)
      (fun t ht => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hf t (hmem t ht).1 (hmem t ht).2)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hXabs] at this
    exact this
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show |∫ y in (0:ℝ)..X, g1 y η| ≤ A * X
    exact key (fun y => g1 y η) A (fun t h1 h2 => (hb t η h1 h2 hη1 hη2).1)
  · rw [E1]
    exact key (fun y => deriv (fun e' => g1 y e') η) A
      (fun t h1 h2 => (hb t η h1 h2 hη1 hη2).2.1)
  · have e : profRadInt g2 X η - profRadInt g1 X η = ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..X, (g2 y η - g1 y η) :=
      (intervalIntegral.integral_sub I2 I1).symm
    rw [e, ← mul_assoc]
    exact key (fun y => g2 y η - g1 y η) (ε * A)
      (fun t h1 h2 => (hb t η h1 h2 hη1 hη2).2.2.1)
  · rw [E2, E1, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub J2 J1, ← mul_assoc]
    exact key (fun y => deriv (fun e' => g2 y e') η - deriv (fun e' => g1 y e') η) (ε * A)
      (fun t h1 h2 => by
        show |deriv (fun e' => g2 t e') η - deriv (fun e' => g1 t e') η| ≤ ε * A
        rw [← hsubd t η h1 hη1 hη2]
        exact (hb t η h1 h2 hη1 hη2).2.2.2)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (g1 g2 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X A ε p : ℝ), 0 < X → 1 < p → 0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ y e : ℝ, X < y → -1 < e → e < 1 → |g1 y e| ≤ A * y ^ (-p) ∧ |deriv (fun e' => g1 y e') e| ≤ A * y ^ (-p) ∧ |g2 y e - g1 y e| ≤ ε * (A * y ^ (-p)) ∧ |deriv (fun e' => g2 y e' - g1 y e') e| ≤ ε * (A * y ^ (-p))) → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |∫ y in Ioi X, g1 y η| ≤ A * X ^ (1 - p) / (p - 1) ∧ |deriv (fun e => ∫ y in Ioi X, g1 y e) η| ≤ A * X ^ (1 - p) / (p - 1) ∧ |(∫ y in Ioi X, g2 y η) - ∫ y in Ioi X, g1 y η| ≤ ε * (A * X ^ (1 - p) / (p - 1)) ∧ |deriv (fun e => ∫ y in Ioi X, g2 y e) η - deriv (fun e => ∫ y in Ioi X, g1 y e) η| ≤ ε * (A * X ^ (1 - p) / (p - 1))
