signature.statement: ∀ (g1 g2 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X A ε p : ℝ), 0 < X → 1 < p → 0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ y e : ℝ, X < y → -1 < e → e < 1 → |g1 y e| ≤ A * y ^ (-p) ∧ |deriv (fun e' => g1 y e') e| ≤ A * y ^ (-p) ∧ |g2 y e - g1 y e| ≤ ε * (A * y ^ (-p)) ∧ |deriv (fun e' => g2 y e' - g1 y e') e| ≤ ε * (A * y ^ (-p))) → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |∫ y in Ioi X, g1 y η| ≤ A * X ^ (1 - p) / (p - 1) ∧ |deriv (fun e => ∫ y in Ioi X, g1 y e) η| ≤ A * X ^ (1 - p) / (p - 1) ∧ |(∫ y in Ioi X, g2 y η) - ∫ y in Ioi X, g1 y η| ≤ ε * (A * X ^ (1 - p) / (p - 1)) ∧ |deriv (fun e => ∫ y in Ioi X, g2 y e) η - deriv (fun e => ∫ y in Ioi X, g1 y e) η| ≤ ε * (A * X ^ (1 - p) / (p - 1))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro g1 g2 X A ε p hX hp hA hε hg1 hg2 hb η hη1 hη2
  have hΩ : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  
  have slice : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      (∀ y e : ℝ, 0 < y → -1 < e → e < 1 →
        HasDerivAt (fun e' => g y e') (fderiv ℝ (↿g) (y, e) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) e) ∧
      (∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → ContinuousOn (fun y => g y e) (Ioi 0) ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun y => deriv (fun e' => g y e') e) (Ioi 0)) := by
    intro g hg
    have hD : ∀ y e : ℝ, 0 < y → -1 < e → e < 1 →
        HasDerivAt (fun e' => g y e') (fderiv ℝ (↿g) (y, e) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) e := by
      intro y e hy he1 he2
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (↿g) (y, e) :=
        hg.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds (show (y, e) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 from ⟨hy, he1, he2⟩))
      have hFD : HasFDerivAt (↿g) (fderiv ℝ (↿g) (y, e)) (y, e) :=
        (h1.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
      have hp : HasDerivAt (fun e' : ℝ => ((y, e') : ℝ × ℝ)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) e :=
        (hasDerivAt_const e y).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id e)
      exact hFD.comp_hasDerivAt e hp
    refine ⟨hD, fun e he1 he2 => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · exact hg.continuousOn.comp
        (Continuous.continuousOn (by fun_prop : Continuous fun y : ℝ => ((y, e) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        (fun y hy => ⟨hy, he1, he2⟩)
    · have hfd : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (↿g)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
        hg.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ (by simp)
      have hc : ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ => fderiv ℝ (↿g) (y, e)) (Ioi 0) :=
        hfd.comp (Continuous.continuousOn (by fun_prop : Continuous fun y : ℝ => ((y, e) : ℝ × ℝ)))
          (fun y hy => ⟨hy, he1, he2⟩)
      have hc2 : ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ => fderiv ℝ (↿g) (y, e) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) (Ioi 0) :=
        hc.clm_apply continuousOn_const
      exact hc2.congr (fun y hy => (hD y e hy he1 he2).deriv)
  have hXsub : Ioi X ⊆ Ioi (0:ℝ) := Ioi_subset_Ioi hX.le
  have hp' : -p < -1 := by linarith
  have hI : IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (-p)) (Ioi X) := integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt hp' hX
  have hclosed : ∫ y in Ioi X, y ^ (-p) = X ^ (1 - p) / (p - 1) := by
    rw [integral_Ioi_rpow_of_lt hp' hX]
    have e1 : -p + 1 = 1 - p := by ring
    have hne1 : -p + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have hne2 : p - 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
    rw [div_eq_div_iff hne1 hne2, e1]
    ring
  have key : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ y, X < y → |f y| ≤ C * y ^ (-p)) →
      |∫ y in Ioi X, f y| ≤ C * (X ^ (1 - p) / (p - 1)) := by
    intro f C hf
    have h1 := MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (hI.const_mul C)
      (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi (fun y hy => by
        show ‖f y‖ ≤ C * y ^ (-p)
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hf y hy))
    rw [integral_const_mul, hclosed, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact h1
  
  have leib : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ B : ℝ,
      (∀ y e : ℝ, 0 < y → -1 < e → e < 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e' => g y e') e) →
      (∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → ContinuousOn (fun y => g y e) (Ioi 0) ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun y => deriv (fun e' => g y e') e) (Ioi 0)) →
      (∀ y e : ℝ, X < y → -1 < e → e < 1 →
        |g y e| ≤ B * y ^ (-p) ∧ |deriv (fun e' => g y e') e| ≤ B * y ^ (-p)) →
      Integrable (fun y => g y η) (volume.restrict (Ioi X)) ∧
      Integrable (fun y => deriv (fun e' => g y e') η) (volume.restrict (Ioi X)) ∧
      deriv (fun e => ∫ y in Ioi X, g y e) η = ∫ y in Ioi X, deriv (fun e' => g y e') η := by
    intro g B hd hc hB
    have hmeas : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 →
        AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y => g y e) (volume.restrict (Ioi X)) :=
      fun e he1 he2 => ((hc e he1 he2).1.mono hXsub).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi
    have hmeas' : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y => deriv (fun e' => g y e') η)
        (volume.restrict (Ioi X)) :=
      ((hc η hη1 hη2).2.mono hXsub).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi
    have hint : Integrable (fun y => g y η) (volume.restrict (Ioi X)) := by
      refine Integrable.mono' (hI.const_mul B) (hmeas η hη1 hη2) ?_
      refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi (fun y hy => ?_)
      show ‖g y η‖ ≤ B * y ^ (-p)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact (hB y η hy hη1 hη2).1
    obtain ⟨hJ, hH⟩ := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (μ := volume.restrict (Ioi X))
      (F := fun e y => g y e) (F' := fun e y => deriv (fun e' => g y e') e) (x₀ := η)
      (bound := fun y => B * y ^ (-p)) (s := Ioo (-1) 1)
      (Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2)
      (Filter.mem_of_superset (Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2) (fun e he => hmeas e he.1 he.2))
      hint hmeas'
      (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi (fun y hy x hx => by
        show ‖deriv (fun e' => g y e') x‖ ≤ B * y ^ (-p)
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact (hB y x hy hx.1 hx.2).2))
      (hI.const_mul B)
      (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi
        (fun y hy x hx => (hd y x (lt_trans hX hy) hx.1 hx.2).hasDerivAt))
    exact ⟨hint, hJ, hH.deriv⟩
  obtain ⟨d1, c1⟩ := slice g1 hg1
  obtain ⟨d2, c2⟩ := slice g2 hg2
  have dd1 : ∀ y e : ℝ, 0 < y → -1 < e → e < 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e' => g1 y e') e :=
    fun y e hy he1 he2 => (d1 y e hy he1 he2).differentiableAt
  have dd2 : ∀ y e : ℝ, 0 < y → -1 < e → e < 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e' => g2 y e') e :=
    fun y e hy he1 he2 => (d2 y e hy he1 he2).differentiableAt
  have hsubd : ∀ y e : ℝ, 0 < y → -1 < e → e < 1 →
      deriv (fun e' => g2 y e' - g1 y e') e =
        deriv (fun e' => g2 y e') e - deriv (fun e' => g1 y e') e :=
    fun y e hy he1 he2 => deriv_fun_sub (dd2 y e hy he1 he2) (dd1 y e hy he1 he2)
  have hB1 : ∀ y e : ℝ, X < y → -1 < e → e < 1 →
      |g1 y e| ≤ A * y ^ (-p) ∧ |deriv (fun e' => g1 y e') e| ≤ A * y ^ (-p) :=
    fun y e hy he1 he2 => ⟨(hb y e hy he1 he2).1, (hb y e hy he1 he2).2.1⟩
  have hB2 : ∀ y e : ℝ, X < y → -1 < e → e < 1 →
      |g2 y e| ≤ (A + ε * A) * y ^ (-p) ∧
        |deriv (fun e' => g2 y e') e| ≤ (A + ε * A) * y ^ (-p) := by
    intro y e hy he1 he2
    obtain ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4⟩ := hb y e hy he1 he2
    rw [hsubd y e (lt_trans hX hy) he1 he2] at a4
    have hw : (A + ε * A) * y ^ (-p) = A * y ^ (-p) + ε * (A * y ^ (-p)) := by ring
    rw [hw]
    have b1 := abs_le.mp a1
    have b2 := abs_le.mp a2
    have b3 := abs_le.mp a3
    have b4 := abs_le.mp a4
    constructor
    · rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [b1.1, b1.2, b3.1, b3.2]
    · rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [b2.1, b2.2, b4.1, b4.2]
  obtain ⟨I1, J1, E1⟩ := leib g1 A dd1 c1 hB1
  obtain ⟨I2, J2, E2⟩ := leib g2 (A + ε * A) dd2 c2 hB2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [mul_div_assoc]
    exact key (fun y => g1 y η) A (fun y hy => (hb y η hy hη1 hη2).1)
  · rw [E1, mul_div_assoc]
    exact key (fun y => deriv (fun e' => g1 y e') η) A (fun y hy => (hb y η hy hη1 hη2).2.1)
  · have e : (∫ y in Ioi X, g2 y η) - ∫ y in Ioi X, g1 y η = ∫ y in Ioi X, (g2 y η - g1 y η) :=
      (integral_sub I2 I1).symm
    rw [e, mul_div_assoc, ← mul_assoc]
    exact key (fun y => g2 y η - g1 y η) (ε * A)
      (fun y hy => by rw [mul_assoc]; exact (hb y η hy hη1 hη2).2.2.1)
  · rw [E2, E1, ← integral_sub J2 J1, mul_div_assoc, ← mul_assoc]
    exact key (fun y => deriv (fun e' => g2 y e') η - deriv (fun e' => g1 y e') η) (ε * A)
      (fun y hy => by
        show |deriv (fun e' => g2 y e') η - deriv (fun e' => g1 y e') η| ≤ ε * A * y ^ (-p)
        rw [← hsubd y η (lt_trans hX hy) hη1 hη2, mul_assoc]
        exact (hb y η hy hη1 hη2).2.2.2)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (f u g v : ℝ → ℝ) (y e K ε w : ℝ), 0 < y → 0 ≤ ε → ε ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ w → y * w ≤ 1 → y * w ^ 2 ≤ 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ f e → DifferentiableAt ℝ u e → DifferentiableAt ℝ g e → DifferentiableAt ℝ v e → |f e| ≤ K * w → |deriv f e| ≤ K * w → |u e| ≤ K → |deriv u e| ≤ K → |g e - f e| ≤ ε * (K * w) → |deriv (fun t => g t - f t) e| ≤ ε * (K * w) → |v e - u e| ≤ ε * K → |deriv (fun t => v t - u t) e| ≤ ε * K → (|u e| ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 ∧ |deriv u e| ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 ∧ |v e - u e| ≤ ε * (16 * (K + 1) ^ 2) ∧ |deriv (fun t => v t - u t) e| ≤ ε * (16 * (K + 1) ^ 2)) ∧ (|2 * y * f e| ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 ∧ |deriv (fun t => 2 * y * f t) e| ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 ∧ |2 * y * g e - 2 * y * f e| ≤ ε * (16 * (K + 1) ^ 2) ∧ |deriv (fun t => 2 * y * g t - 2 * y * f t) e| ≤ ε * (16 * (K + 1) ^ 2)) ∧ (|u e * (2 * y * f e)| ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 ∧ |deriv (fun t => u t * (2 * y * f t)) e| ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 ∧ |v e * (2 * y * g e) - u e * (2 * y * f e)| ≤ ε * (16 * (K + 1) ^ 2) ∧ |deriv (fun t => v t * (2 * y * g t) - u t * (2 * y * f t)) e| ≤ ε * (16 * (K + 1) ^ 2)) ∧ (|u e ^ 2 - y * f e ^ 2| ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 ∧ |deriv (fun t => u t ^ 2 - y * f t ^ 2) e| ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 ∧ |(v e ^ 2 - y * g e ^ 2) - (u e ^ 2 - y * f e ^ 2)| ≤ ε * (16 * (K + 1) ^ 2) ∧ |deriv (fun t => (v t ^ 2 - y * g t ^ 2) - (u t ^ 2 - y * f t ^ 2)) e| ≤ ε * (16 * (K + 1) ^ 2)) ∧ (|f e ^ 2| ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 * w ^ 2 ∧ |deriv (fun t => f t ^ 2) e| ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 * w ^ 2 ∧ |g e ^ 2 - f e ^ 2| ≤ ε * (16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 * w ^ 2) ∧ |deriv (fun t => g t ^ 2 - f t ^ 2) e| ≤ ε * (16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 * w ^ 2))

signature.statement: ∀ (f u g v : ℝ → ℝ) (y e K ε w : ℝ), 0 < y → 0 ≤ ε → ε ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ w → y * w ≤ 1 → y * w ^ 2 ≤ 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ f e → DifferentiableAt ℝ u e → DifferentiableAt ℝ g e → DifferentiableAt ℝ v e → |f e| ≤ K * w → |deriv f e| ≤ K * w → |u e| ≤ K → |deriv u e| ≤ K → |g e - f e| ≤ ε * (K * w) → |deriv (fun t => g t - f t) e| ≤ ε * (K * w) → |v e - u e| ≤ ε * K → |deriv (fun t => v t - u t) e| ≤ ε * K → (|u e| ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 ∧ |deriv u e| ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 ∧ |v e - u e| ≤ ε * (16 * (K + 1) ^ 2) ∧ |deriv (fun t => v t - u t) e| ≤ ε * (16 * (K + 1) ^ 2)) ∧ (|2 * y * f e| ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 ∧ |deriv (fun t => 2 * y * f t) e| ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 ∧ |2 * y * g e - 2 * y * f e| ≤ ε * (16 * (K + 1) ^ 2) ∧ |deriv (fun t => 2 * y * g t - 2 * y * f t) e| ≤ ε * (16 * (K + 1) ^ 2)) ∧ (|u e * (2 * y * f e)| ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 ∧ |deriv (fun t => u t * (2 * y * f t)) e| ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 ∧ |v e * (2 * y * g e) - u e * (2 * y * f e)| ≤ ε * (16 * (K + 1) ^ 2) ∧ |deriv (fun t => v t * (2 * y * g t) - u t * (2 * y * f t)) e| ≤ ε * (16 * (K + 1) ^ 2)) ∧ (|u e ^ 2 - y * f e ^ 2| ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 ∧ |deriv (fun t => u t ^ 2 - y * f t ^ 2) e| ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 ∧ |(v e ^ 2 - y * g e ^ 2) - (u e ^ 2 - y * f e ^ 2)| ≤ ε * (16 * (K + 1) ^ 2) ∧ |deriv (fun t => (v t ^ 2 - y * g t ^ 2) - (u t ^ 2 - y * f t ^ 2)) e| ≤ ε * (16 * (K + 1) ^ 2)) ∧ (|f e ^ 2| ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 * w ^ 2 ∧ |deriv (fun t => f t ^ 2) e| ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 * w ^ 2 ∧ |g e ^ 2 - f e ^ 2| ≤ ε * (16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 * w ^ 2) ∧ |deriv (fun t => g t ^ 2 - f t ^ 2) e| ≤ ε * (16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 * w ^ 2))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro f u g v y e K ε w hy hε0 hε1 hw hyw hyw2 hfd hud hgd hvd hf hf' hu hu' hgf hgf' hvu hvu'
  
  have Hf := hfd.hasDerivAt
  have Hu := hud.hasDerivAt
  have Hg := hgd.hasDerivAt
  have Hv := hvd.hasDerivAt
  have sqd : ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ), HasDerivAt φ (deriv φ e) e →
      HasDerivAt (fun t => φ t ^ 2) (2 * φ e * deriv φ e) e := by
    intro φ hφ
    convert hφ.pow 2 using 1
    norm_num
  have Pf := sqd f Hf
  have Pu := sqd u Hu
  have Pg := sqd g Hg
  have Pv := sqd v Hv
  have d1 : deriv (fun t => g t - f t) e = deriv g e - deriv f e := (Hg.sub Hf).deriv
  have d2 : deriv (fun t => v t - u t) e = deriv v e - deriv u e := (Hv.sub Hu).deriv
  have d3 : deriv (fun t => 2 * y * f t) e = 2 * y * deriv f e := (Hf.const_mul (2 * y)).deriv
  have d4 : deriv (fun t => 2 * y * g t - 2 * y * f t) e = 2 * y * deriv g e - 2 * y * deriv f e :=
    ((Hg.const_mul (2 * y)).sub (Hf.const_mul (2 * y))).deriv
  have d5 : deriv (fun t => u t * (2 * y * f t)) e
      = deriv u e * (2 * y * f e) + u e * (2 * y * deriv f e) :=
    (Hu.mul (Hf.const_mul (2 * y))).deriv
  have d6 : deriv (fun t => v t * (2 * y * g t) - u t * (2 * y * f t)) e
      = (deriv v e * (2 * y * g e) + v e * (2 * y * deriv g e))
        - (deriv u e * (2 * y * f e) + u e * (2 * y * deriv f e)) :=
    ((Hv.mul (Hg.const_mul (2 * y))).sub (Hu.mul (Hf.const_mul (2 * y)))).deriv
  have d7 : deriv (fun t => u t ^ 2 - y * f t ^ 2) e
      = 2 * u e * deriv u e - y * (2 * f e * deriv f e) :=
    (Pu.sub (Pf.const_mul y)).deriv
  have d8 : deriv (fun t => (v t ^ 2 - y * g t ^ 2) - (u t ^ 2 - y * f t ^ 2)) e
      = (2 * v e * deriv v e - y * (2 * g e * deriv g e))
        - (2 * u e * deriv u e - y * (2 * f e * deriv f e)) :=
    ((Pv.sub (Pg.const_mul y)).sub (Pu.sub (Pf.const_mul y))).deriv
  have d9 : deriv (fun t => f t ^ 2) e = 2 * f e * deriv f e := Pf.deriv
  have d10 : deriv (fun t => g t ^ 2 - f t ^ 2) e = 2 * g e * deriv g e - 2 * f e * deriv f e :=
    (Pg.sub Pf).deriv
  
  have jet : ∀ (a a' b b' c c' d d' α β : ℝ), 0 ≤ α → 0 ≤ β → |a| ≤ α → |a'| ≤ α →
      |b| ≤ β → |b'| ≤ β → |c - a| ≤ ε * α → |c' - a'| ≤ ε * α → |d - b| ≤ ε * β →
      |d' - b'| ≤ ε * β →
      |a * b| ≤ α * β ∧ |a' * b + a * b'| ≤ 2 * (α * β) ∧ |c * d - a * b| ≤ 3 * ε * (α * β) ∧
      |(c' * d + c * d') - (a' * b + a * b')| ≤ 6 * ε * (α * β) := by
    intro a a' b b' c c' d d' α β hα hβ ha ha' hb hb' hca hca' hdb hdb'
    have hεβ : ε * β ≤ β := mul_le_of_le_one_left hβ hε1
    have hεα0 : 0 ≤ ε * α := mul_nonneg hε0 hα
    have hd : |d| ≤ 2 * β := by
      have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub d b
      linarith
    have hd' : |d'| ≤ 2 * β := by
      have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub d' b'
      linarith
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul ha hb (abs_nonneg _) hα
    · calc |a' * b + a * b'| ≤ |a' * b| + |a * b'| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |a'| * |b| + |a| * |b'| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        _ ≤ α * β + α * β := add_le_add (mul_le_mul ha' hb (abs_nonneg _) hα)
            (mul_le_mul ha hb' (abs_nonneg _) hα)
        _ = 2 * (α * β) := by ring
    · have e1 : c * d - a * b = (c - a) * d + a * (d - b) := by ring
      rw [e1]
      calc |(c - a) * d + a * (d - b)| ≤ |(c - a) * d| + |a * (d - b)| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |c - a| * |d| + |a| * |d - b| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        _ ≤ (ε * α) * (2 * β) + α * (ε * β) :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul hca hd (abs_nonneg _) hεα0) (mul_le_mul ha hdb (abs_nonneg _) hα)
        _ = 3 * ε * (α * β) := by ring
    · have e1 : (c' * d + c * d') - (a' * b + a * b')
          = ((c' - a') * d + a' * (d - b)) + ((c - a) * d' + a * (d' - b')) := by ring
      rw [e1]
      calc |((c' - a') * d + a' * (d - b)) + ((c - a) * d' + a * (d' - b'))|
          ≤ |(c' - a') * d + a' * (d - b)| + |(c - a) * d' + a * (d' - b')| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ (|(c' - a') * d| + |a' * (d - b)|) + (|(c - a) * d'| + |a * (d' - b')|) :=
            add_le_add (abs_add_le _ _) (abs_add_le _ _)
        _ = (|c' - a'| * |d| + |a'| * |d - b|) + (|c - a| * |d'| + |a| * |d' - b'|) := by
            simp only [abs_mul]
        _ ≤ ((ε * α) * (2 * β) + α * (ε * β)) + ((ε * α) * (2 * β) + α * (ε * β)) :=
            add_le_add
              (add_le_add (mul_le_mul hca' hd (abs_nonneg _) hεα0)
                (mul_le_mul ha' hdb (abs_nonneg _) hα))
              (add_le_add (mul_le_mul hca hd' (abs_nonneg _) hεα0)
                (mul_le_mul ha hdb' (abs_nonneg _) hα))
        _ = 6 * ε * (α * β) := by ring
  have absEq : ∀ x z B : ℝ, x = z → |x| ≤ B → |z| ≤ B := fun x z B h hb => h ▸ hb
  
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hu
  have hKK : 0 ≤ K * K := mul_nonneg hK hK
  have hKw : 0 ≤ K * w := mul_nonneg hK hw
  have hcd : |deriv g e - deriv f e| ≤ ε * (K * w) := by rw [← d1]; exact hgf'
  have hvd : |deriv v e - deriv u e| ≤ ε * K := by rw [← d2]; exact hvu'
  have hyKw : y * (K * w) ≤ K := by
    calc y * (K * w) = K * (y * w) := by ring
      _ ≤ K * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyw hK
      _ = K := mul_one K
  have hyKw2 : y * (K * w * (K * w)) ≤ K * K := by
    calc y * (K * w * (K * w)) = (K * K) * (y * w ^ 2) := by ring
      _ ≤ (K * K) * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyw2 hKK
      _ = K * K := mul_one _
  have hAe : 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 = 16 * (K * K) + 32 * K + 16 := by ring
  have hA1 : K ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 := by rw [hAe]; linarith
  have hA2 : 2 * K ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 := by rw [hAe]; linarith
  have hA12 : 12 * (K * K) ≤ 16 * (K + 1) ^ 2 := by rw [hAe]; linarith
  have hεA1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA1 hε0
  have hεA2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA2 hε0
  have hεA12 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA12 hε0
  have hεKK : 0 ≤ ε * (K * K) := mul_nonneg hε0 hKK
  have hw2 : 0 ≤ w ^ 2 := sq_nonneg w
  have hAw := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hA12 hw2
  have hεAw := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAw hε0
  have hKKw : 0 ≤ K * K * w ^ 2 := mul_nonneg hKK hw2
  have hεKKw : 0 ≤ ε * (K * K * w ^ 2) := mul_nonneg hε0 hKKw
  have hεyKw := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyKw hε0
  have hεyKw2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyKw2 hε0
  
  have h2y : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * y := by linarith
  have sc : ∀ x B : ℝ, |x| ≤ B → |2 * y * x| ≤ 2 * (y * B) := by
    intro x B hx
    calc |2 * y * x| = 2 * y * |x| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos h2y]
      _ ≤ 2 * y * B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx h2y.le
      _ = 2 * (y * B) := by ring
  have b1 : |2 * y * f e| ≤ 2 * K := by have := sc _ _ hf; linarith
  have b2 : |2 * y * deriv f e| ≤ 2 * K := by have := sc _ _ hf'; linarith
  have b3 : |2 * y * g e - 2 * y * f e| ≤ ε * (2 * K) := by
    have := sc _ _ hgf
    have e1 : 2 * y * g e - 2 * y * f e = 2 * y * (g e - f e) := by ring
    rw [e1]
    have e2 : y * (ε * (K * w)) = ε * (y * (K * w)) := by ring
    rw [e2] at this
    linarith
  have b4 : |2 * y * deriv g e - 2 * y * deriv f e| ≤ ε * (2 * K) := by
    have := sc _ _ hcd
    have e1 : 2 * y * deriv g e - 2 * y * deriv f e = 2 * y * (deriv g e - deriv f e) := by ring
    rw [e1]
    have e2 : y * (ε * (K * w)) = ε * (y * (K * w)) := by ring
    rw [e2] at this
    linarith
  
  have yb : ∀ p q B C : ℝ, |p| ≤ B → |q| ≤ C → |p - y * q| ≤ B + y * C := by
    intro p q B C hp hq
    rw [abs_le] at hp hq ⊢
    have i1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq.1 hy.le
    have i2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq.2 hy.le
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  obtain ⟨J1, J2, J3, J4⟩ := jet (u e) (deriv u e) (2 * y * f e) (2 * y * deriv f e) (v e) (deriv v e)
    (2 * y * g e) (2 * y * deriv g e) K (2 * K) hK (by linarith) hu hu' b1 b2 hvu hvd b3 b4
  obtain ⟨F1, F2, F3, F4⟩ := jet (f e) (deriv f e) (f e) (deriv f e) (g e) (deriv g e) (g e)
    (deriv g e) (K * w) (K * w) hKw hKw hf hf' hf hf' hgf hcd hgf hcd
  obtain ⟨U1, U2, U3, U4⟩ := jet (u e) (deriv u e) (u e) (deriv u e) (v e) (deriv v e) (v e)
    (deriv v e) K K hK hK hu hu' hu hu' hvu hvd hvu hvd
  have F1' : |f e ^ 2| ≤ K * w * (K * w) := absEq _ _ _ (by ring) F1
  have F2' : |2 * f e * deriv f e| ≤ 2 * (K * w * (K * w)) := absEq _ _ _ (by ring) F2
  have F3' : |g e ^ 2 - f e ^ 2| ≤ 3 * ε * (K * w * (K * w)) := absEq _ _ _ (by ring) F3
  have F4' : |2 * g e * deriv g e - 2 * f e * deriv f e| ≤ 6 * ε * (K * w * (K * w)) :=
    absEq _ _ _ (by ring) F4
  have U1' : |u e ^ 2| ≤ K * K := absEq _ _ _ (by ring) U1
  have U2' : |2 * u e * deriv u e| ≤ 2 * (K * K) := absEq _ _ _ (by ring) U2
  have U3' : |v e ^ 2 - u e ^ 2| ≤ 3 * ε * (K * K) := absEq _ _ _ (by ring) U3
  have U4' : |2 * v e * deriv v e - 2 * u e * deriv u e| ≤ 6 * ε * (K * K) :=
    absEq _ _ _ (by ring) U4
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  
  · linarith
  · linarith
  · linarith
  · linarith
  
  · linarith
  · rw [d3]; linarith
  · linarith
  · rw [d4]; linarith
  
  · linarith
  · rw [d5]; linarith
  · linarith
  · rw [d6]; linarith
  
  · have := yb _ _ _ _ U1' F1'
    linarith
  · rw [d7]
    have := yb _ _ _ _ U2' F2'
    linarith
  · have := yb _ _ _ _ U3' F3'
    have e1 : (v e ^ 2 - y * g e ^ 2) - (u e ^ 2 - y * f e ^ 2)
        = (v e ^ 2 - u e ^ 2) - y * (g e ^ 2 - f e ^ 2) := by ring
    rw [e1]
    linarith
  · rw [d8]
    have := yb _ _ _ _ U4' F4'
    have e1 : (2 * v e * deriv v e - y * (2 * g e * deriv g e))
        - (2 * u e * deriv u e - y * (2 * f e * deriv f e))
        = (2 * v e * deriv v e - 2 * u e * deriv u e)
          - y * (2 * g e * deriv g e - 2 * f e * deriv f e) := by ring
    rw [e1]
    linarith
  
  · linarith
  · rw [d9]; linarith
  · linarith
  · rw [d10]; linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (c Q x1 x2 : ℝ), 0 < c → 0 < x1 → x1 ≤ x2 → ∃ L : ℝ, ∀ (X δ f fx ux f' fx' ux' : ℝ), x1 ≤ X → X ≤ x2 → 0 ≤ δ → c ≤ f → c ≤ f' → |fx| ≤ Q → |ux| ≤ Q → |f' - f| ≤ δ → |fx' - fx| ≤ δ → |ux' - ux| ≤ δ → |-2 * X * fx' / f' - -2 * X * fx / f| ≤ L * δ ∧ |Real.sqrt (2 * X) * ux' / f' - Real.sqrt (2 * X) * ux / f| ≤ L * δ

signature.name: cone_alg_shear
signature.statement: ∀ (c Q x1 x2 : ℝ), 0 < c → 0 < x1 → x1 ≤ x2 → ∃ L : ℝ, ∀ (X δ f fx ux f' fx' ux' : ℝ), x1 ≤ X → X ≤ x2 → 0 ≤ δ → c ≤ f → c ≤ f' → |fx| ≤ Q → |ux| ≤ Q → |f' - f| ≤ δ → |fx' - fx| ≤ δ → |ux' - ux| ≤ δ → |-2 * X * fx' / f' - -2 * X * fx / f| ≤ L * δ ∧ |Real.sqrt (2 * X) * ux' / f' - Real.sqrt (2 * X) * ux / f| ≤ L * δ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro c Q x1 x2 hc hx1 hx12
  refine ⟨(2 * x2 + Real.sqrt (2 * x2)) * (1 / c + Q / c ^ 2), ?_⟩
  intro X δ f fx ux f' fx' ux' hX1 hX2 hδ hcf hcf' hfx hux hff hfxx huxx
  have hQ : 0 ≤ Q := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hfx
  have hfpos : 0 < f := lt_of_lt_of_le hc hcf
  have hf'pos : 0 < f' := lt_of_lt_of_le hc hcf'
  have hc2 : c ^ 2 ≤ f * f' := by
    rw [sq]; exact mul_le_mul hcf hcf' hc.le hfpos.le
  have hX : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hx1 hX1
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ 1 / c + Q / c ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hMδ : 0 ≤ (1 / c + Q / c ^ 2) * δ := mul_nonneg hM0 hδ
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * x2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hsX : Real.sqrt (2 * X) ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * x2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
  have key : ∀ p p' : ℝ, |p| ≤ Q → |p' - p| ≤ δ →
      |p' / f' - p / f| ≤ (1 / c + Q / c ^ 2) * δ := by
    intro p p' hp hpp
    have hid : p' / f' - p / f = (p' - p) / f' + p * (f - f') / (f * f') := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hid]
    have h1 : |(p' - p) / f'| ≤ δ / c := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hf'pos]
      calc |p' - p| / f' ≤ δ / f' := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hpp hf'pos.le
        _ ≤ δ / c := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hδ hc hcf'
    have h2 : |p * (f - f') / (f * f')| ≤ Q * δ / c ^ 2 := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (mul_pos hfpos hf'pos), abs_sub_comm f f']
      calc |p| * |f' - f| / (f * f') ≤ Q * δ / (f * f') :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul hp hff (abs_nonneg _) hQ)
              (mul_pos hfpos hf'pos).le
        _ ≤ Q * δ / c ^ 2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg hQ hδ) (by positivity) hc2
    calc |(p' - p) / f' + p * (f - f') / (f * f')|
        ≤ |(p' - p) / f'| + |p * (f - f') / (f * f')| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ δ / c + Q * δ / c ^ 2 := add_le_add h1 h2
      _ = (1 / c + Q / c ^ 2) * δ := by ring
  have hsplit : (2 * x2 + Real.sqrt (2 * x2)) * (1 / c + Q / c ^ 2) * δ =
      2 * x2 * ((1 / c + Q / c ^ 2) * δ) + Real.sqrt (2 * x2) * ((1 / c + Q / c ^ 2) * δ) := by
    ring
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have e : -2 * X * fx' / f' - -2 * X * fx / f = (-2 * X) * (fx' / f' - fx / f) := by ring
    rw [e, abs_mul, abs_of_neg (by linarith : -2 * X < 0)]
    have k := key fx fx' hfx hfxx
    have hA : -(-2 * X) * |fx' / f' - fx / f| ≤ 2 * x2 * ((1 / c + Q / c ^ 2) * δ) :=
      mul_le_mul (by linarith) k (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    have hB : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * x2) * ((1 / c + Q / c ^ 2) * δ) := mul_nonneg hs0 hMδ
    rw [hsplit]
    linarith
  · have e : Real.sqrt (2 * X) * ux' / f' - Real.sqrt (2 * X) * ux / f =
        Real.sqrt (2 * X) * (ux' / f' - ux / f) := by ring
    rw [e, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    have k := key ux ux' hux huxx
    have hA : Real.sqrt (2 * X) * |ux' / f' - ux / f| ≤
        Real.sqrt (2 * x2) * ((1 / c + Q / c ^ 2) * δ) :=
      mul_le_mul hsX k (abs_nonneg _) hs0
    have hB : 0 ≤ 2 * x2 * ((1 / c + Q / c ^ 2) * δ) :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) hMδ
    rw [hsplit]
    linarith

by
  intro h c Q x1 x2 hh0 hh1 hc hx1 hx12
  obtain ⟨m1, hm1⟩ : ∃ m : ℝ, m = 2 * x1 ^ 2 * c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hm1pos : 0 < m1 := by rw [hm1]; positivity
  refine ⟨2 * x2 * (2 + 4 / m1 + 8 * Q * x2 ^ 2 / m1 ^ 2), ?_⟩
  intro X η δ f a b i1 j1 i2 j2 f' a' b' i1' j1' i2' j2' hX1 hX2 he1 he2 hδ hf hf' hi1 hj1 hi2 hj2
    df da db di1 dj1 di2 dj2
  have hQ : 0 ≤ Q := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hi1
  have hX : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hx1 hX1
  have hx2 : 0 < x2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hX hX2
  have hp1 : 0 < 1 + η := by linarith
  have hp2 : 0 < 1 - η := by linarith
  have hη2 : η ^ 2 < 1 := by linarith [mul_pos hp1 hp2]
  have hD : 1 / 2 ≤ 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 := by
    linarith [mul_nonneg hh0.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hη2.le)]
  have hDpos : 0 < 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 := by linarith
  
  have kb : ∀ k y B : ℝ, |k| ≤ 1 → |y| ≤ B → |k * y| ≤ B := by
    intro k y B hk hy
    rw [abs_mul]
    calc |k| * |y| ≤ 1 * B := mul_le_mul hk hy (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      _ = B := one_mul B
  have q1 : 0 < 1 - 2 * h := by linarith
  have q2 : 0 < 1 - 4 * h := by linarith
  have r1 := mul_pos q1 hp1
  have r2 := mul_pos q1 hp2
  have r3 := mul_pos q2 hp1
  have r4 := mul_pos q2 hp2
  have c1 : |2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have c2 : |1 - η ^ 2| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [sq_nonneg η]
  have c3 : |-(1 - η ^ 2)| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_neg]; exact c2
  have c4 : |1 - h| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have c5 : |-((1 / 2 - h) * η)| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have c6 : |2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * η| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  
  set D := 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 with hDdef
  set W := 1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * a - (1 - η ^ 2) * b with hWdef
  set W' := 1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * a' - (1 - η ^ 2) * b' with hW'def
  set N := (1 - h) * i1 - (1 / 2 - h) * η * j1 - (1 - η ^ 2) * j2 + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * η * i2
    with hNdef
  set N' := (1 - h) * i1' - (1 / 2 - h) * η * j1' - (1 - η ^ 2) * j2' + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * η * i2'
    with hN'def
  set E := X * (2 * X * f) with hEdef
  set E' := X * (2 * X * f') with hE'def
  
  have hWd : |W' - W| ≤ 2 * δ := by
    have e : W' - W = -(2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * (a' - a)) + (-(1 - η ^ 2)) * (b' - b) := by
      rw [hWdef, hW'def]; ring
    have t1 := abs_le.mp (kb _ _ _ c1 da)
    have t2 := abs_le.mp (kb _ _ _ c3 db)
    rw [e, abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [t1.1, t1.2, t2.1, t2.2]
  
  have hNb : |N| ≤ 4 * Q := by
    have e : N = (1 - h) * i1 + (-((1 / 2 - h) * η)) * j1 + (-(1 - η ^ 2)) * j2
        + (2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * η) * i2 := by rw [hNdef]; ring
    have t1 := abs_le.mp (kb _ _ _ c4 hi1)
    have t2 := abs_le.mp (kb _ _ _ c5 hj1)
    have t3 := abs_le.mp (kb _ _ _ c3 hj2)
    have t4 := abs_le.mp (kb _ _ _ c6 hi2)
    rw [e, abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [t1.1, t1.2, t2.1, t2.2, t3.1, t3.2, t4.1, t4.2]
  have hNd : |N' - N| ≤ 4 * δ := by
    have e : N' - N = (1 - h) * (i1' - i1) + (-((1 / 2 - h) * η)) * (j1' - j1)
        + (-(1 - η ^ 2)) * (j2' - j2) + (2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * η) * (i2' - i2) := by
      rw [hNdef, hN'def]; ring
    have t1 := abs_le.mp (kb _ _ _ c4 di1)
    have t2 := abs_le.mp (kb _ _ _ c5 dj1)
    have t3 := abs_le.mp (kb _ _ _ c3 dj2)
    have t4 := abs_le.mp (kb _ _ _ c6 di2)
    rw [e, abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [t1.1, t1.2, t2.1, t2.2, t3.1, t3.2, t4.1, t4.2]
  
  have hx1X : x1 ^ 2 ≤ X ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hx1.le hX1 2
  have hXx2 : X ^ 2 ≤ x2 ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hX.le hX2 2
  have hEm : m1 ≤ E := by
    have := mul_le_mul hx1X hf hc.le (sq_nonneg X)
    have e1 : E = 2 * (X ^ 2 * f) := by rw [hEdef]; ring
    rw [hm1, e1]; linarith
  have hE'm : m1 ≤ E' := by
    have := mul_le_mul hx1X hf' hc.le (sq_nonneg X)
    have e1 : E' = 2 * (X ^ 2 * f') := by rw [hE'def]; ring
    rw [hm1, e1]; linarith
  have hEpos : 0 < E := lt_of_lt_of_le hm1pos hEm
  have hE'pos : 0 < E' := lt_of_lt_of_le hm1pos hE'm
  have hEd : |E - E'| ≤ 2 * x2 ^ 2 * δ := by
    have e : E - E' = (2 * X ^ 2) * (f - f') := by rw [hEdef, hE'def]; ring
    rw [e, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 2 * X ^ 2), abs_sub_comm]
    have : 2 * X ^ 2 ≤ 2 * x2 ^ 2 := by linarith
    exact mul_le_mul this df (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
  
  have hq : N' / E' - N / E = (N' - N) / E' + N * (E - E') / (E * E') := by
    field_simp; ring
  have b1 : |(N' - N) / E'| ≤ 4 * δ / m1 := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hE'pos]
    exact div_le_div₀ (by linarith) hNd hm1pos hE'm
  have b2 : |N * (E - E') / (E * E')| ≤ 4 * Q * (2 * x2 ^ 2 * δ) / m1 ^ 2 := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (mul_pos hEpos hE'pos), show m1 ^ 2 = m1 * m1 from sq m1]

  intro X η δ f u a b i3 j3 i4 j4 p q f' u' a' b' i3' j3' i4' j4' p' q' hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2 hδ0 hδQ

      have him : ((t : ℂ) * x).im = t * x.im := by simp
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [him, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ht0]
        have := abs_nonneg x.im
        nlinarith
      · rw [hre]
        rcases le_total 0 x.re with h | h
        · have := mul_nonneg ht0 h; linarith
        · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1) (neg_nonneg.mpr h)]
      · rw [hre]
        rcases le_total 0 x.re with h | h
        · nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht1 h]
        · nlinarith [mul_nonneg ht0 (neg_nonneg.mpr h)]
    have hball : ∀ w ∈ axRect s, ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball w (s / 2), x ∈ axRect (3 * s / 2) := by
      intro w hw x hx
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hx
      have h1 := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (x - w)
      have h2 := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (x - w)
      rw [Complex.sub_re] at h1
      rw [Complex.sub_im] at h2
      obtain ⟨a1, a2, a3⟩ := hw
      have a1' := abs_lt.mp a1
      have b1 := abs_le.mp h1
      have b2 := abs_le.mp h2
      exact ⟨abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [b2.1], by linarith [b2.2]⟩, by linarith [b1.1],
        by linarith [b1.2]⟩
    have hself : ∀ w ∈ axRect s, w ∈ axRect (3 * s / 2) := fun w hw =>
      hball w hw w (Metric.mem_ball_self (by linarith))
    have hnorm : ∀ x ∈ axRect (3 * s / 2), ‖x‖ ≤ 2 := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hx
      have := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im x
      have : |x.re| < 1 + 3 * s / 2 := abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      linarith
    have hcont : ∀ x ∈ axRect (3 * s / 2),
        ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => ζ ((t : ℂ) * x)) (Icc 0 1) ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => deriv ζ ((t : ℂ) * x)) (Icc 0 1) := by
      intro x hx
      have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) * x) := by fun_prop
      have hm : MapsTo (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) * x) (Icc 0 1) (axRect (2 * s)) :=
        fun t ht => hsub (hstar x hx t ht)
      exact ⟨hζc.comp hc.continuousOn hm, hζ'c.comp hc.continuousOn hm⟩
    have huIoc : ∀ t ∈ uIoc (0:ℝ) 1, t ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1 := by
      intro t ht
      rw [uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
      exact Ioc_subset_Icc_self ht
    have huIcc : uIcc (0:ℝ) 1 = Icc 0 1 := uIcc_of_le zero_le_one
    have hpt : ∀ x ∈ axRect (3 * s / 2), ∀ t ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt (fun v : ℂ => v * ζ ((t : ℂ) * v))
          (ζ ((t : ℂ) * x) + x * (deriv ζ ((t : ℂ) * x) * (t : ℂ))) x := by
      intro x hx t ht
      have hz := hdiff _ (hstar x hx t ht)
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℂ => (t : ℂ) * v) (t : ℂ) x := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul (t : ℂ)
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℂ => ζ ((t : ℂ) * v)) (deriv ζ ((t : ℂ) * x) * (t : ℂ)) x :=
        hz.comp x h1
      have h3 := (hasDerivAt_id' x).mul h2
      convert h3 using 1
      ring
    have hF'b : ∀ x ∈ axRect (3 * s / 2), ∀ t ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
        ‖ζ ((t : ℂ) * x) + x * (deriv ζ ((t : ℂ) * x) * (t : ℂ))‖ ≤ 3 * B₀ := by
      intro x hx t ht
      have hu := hstar x hx t ht
      obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := hB _ hu
      have hx2 := hnorm x hx
      have ht' : ‖(t : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht.1]; exact ht.2
      have hB0 : 0 ≤ B₀ := (norm_nonneg _).trans b1
      calc ‖ζ ((t : ℂ) * x) + x * (deriv ζ ((t : ℂ) * x) * (t : ℂ))‖
          ≤ ‖ζ ((t : ℂ) * x)‖ + ‖x‖ * (‖deriv ζ ((t : ℂ) * x)‖ * ‖(t : ℂ)‖) := by
            refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
            rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
        _ ≤ B₀ + 2 * (B₀ * 1) := by gcongr
        _ = 3 * B₀ := by ring
    refine ⟨fun w hw => ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hw' := hself w hw
      have hballmem : Metric.ball w (s / 2) ∈ nhds w := Metric.ball_mem_nhds w (by linarith)
      have hF'int : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun t : ℝ => ζ ((t : ℂ) * w) + w * (deriv ζ ((t : ℂ) * w) * (t : ℂ))) volume 0 1 := by
        apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
        rw [huIcc]
        exact (hcont w hw').1.add (continuousOn_const.mul
          ((hcont w hw').2.mul Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn))
      obtain ⟨-, hD⟩ := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
        (μ := volume) (a := 0) (b := 1) (bound := fun _ => 3 * B₀)
        (F := fun v t => v * ζ ((t : ℂ) * v))
        (F' := fun v t => ζ ((t : ℂ) * v) + v * (deriv ζ ((t : ℂ) * v) * (t : ℂ)))
        hballmem
        (Filter.eventually_of_mem hballmem (fun x hx =>
          ((continuousOn_const.mul (hcont x (hball w hw x hx)).1).mono
            (fun t ht => huIoc t ht)).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc))
        (by
          apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
          rw [huIcc]
          exact continuousOn_const.mul (hcont w hw').1)
        ((((hcont w hw').1.add (continuousOn_const.mul
          ((hcont w hw').2.mul Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn))).mono
            (fun t ht => huIoc t ht)).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc)
        (ae_of_all _ (fun t ht x hx => hF'b x (hball w hw x hx) t (huIoc t ht)))
        intervalIntegrable_const
        (ae_of_all _ (fun t ht x hx => hpt x (hball w hw x hx) t (huIoc t ht)))
      have hFTC : (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, (ζ ((t : ℂ) * w) + w * (deriv ζ ((t : ℂ) * w) * (t : ℂ))))
          = ζ w := by
        have := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
          (f := fun y : ℝ => (y : ℂ) * ζ ((y : ℂ) * w)) (a := 0) (b := 1) (fun t ht => by
            rw [huIcc] at ht
            have hz := hdiff _ (hstar w hw' t ht)
            have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℂ => y * w) w (t : ℂ) := by
              simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (t : ℂ)).mul_const w
            have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℂ => ζ (y * w)) (deriv ζ ((t : ℂ) * w) * w) (t : ℂ) :=
              hz.comp (t : ℂ) h1
            have h3 := ((hasDerivAt_id' (t : ℂ)).mul h2).comp_ofReal
            convert h3 using 1
            ring) hF'int
        rw [this]
        simp
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [← hFTC]; exact hD
      · have := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := 0) (b := 1) (C := 2 * B₀)
          (f := fun t : ℝ => w * ζ ((t : ℂ) * w)) (fun t ht => by
            rw [norm_mul]
            exact mul_le_mul (hnorm w hw') (hB _ (hstar w hw' t (huIoc t ht))).1 (norm_nonneg _)
              (by norm_num))
        simpa using this
    · intro hre x
      have hfun : (fun t : ℝ => (x : ℂ) * ζ ((t : ℂ) * (x : ℂ))) =
          fun t : ℝ => (((x * (ζ ((t * x : ℝ) : ℂ)).re) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        funext t
        have e1 : (t : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) = ((t * x : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
        obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y : ℝ, y = t * x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
        rw [e1, ← hy]
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hre y]
      rw [hfun, intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal, Complex.ofReal_im]
  
  intro h j0 σ δ ρ Pc Pax hh0 hh1 hj0 hj0' hAD
  obtain ⟨hσ, hδ, hρ, hρ50, hPcd, hPcR, hden, -, -⟩ := hAD
  have hPcd' : DifferentiableOn ℂ Pc (axRect (2 * ρ)) := hPcd
  have hne : ∀ w ∈ axRect ρ,
      ((1 / 2 - (h : ℂ)) * w + (1 - w ^ 2) * (4 * w + (j0 : ℂ))) ^ 2 + ((σ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 ≠ 0 ∧
      1 - 2 * (h : ℂ) * w ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hw
    exact hden w h1.le h2.le h3.le
  obtain ⟨χc, hχc⟩ : ∃ f : ℂ → ℂ, f = fun w =>
      ((1 / 2 - (h : ℂ)) * w + (1 - w ^ 2) * (4 * w + (j0 : ℂ))) ^ 2 /
        (((1 / 2 - (h : ℂ)) * w + (1 - w ^ 2) * (4 * w + (j0 : ℂ))) ^ 2 + ((σ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ζc, hζc⟩ : ∃ f : ℂ → ℂ, f = fun w =>
      -(1 - 2 * (h : ℂ) * w ^ 2) * ((1 / 2 - (h : ℂ)) * w + (1 - w ^ 2) * (4 * w + (j0 : ℂ))) /
        (((1 / 2 - (h : ℂ)) * w + (1 - w ^ 2) * (4 * w + (j0 : ℂ))) ^ 2 + ((σ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ℓc, hℓc⟩ : ∃ f : ℂ → ℂ, f = fun w => (1 - 2 * (h : ℂ) * w ^ 2)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨zc, hzc⟩ : ∃ f : ℂ → ℂ, f = fun w =>
      (-(1 / 2 + (h : ℂ)) * (1 - 2 * w * (4 * w + (j0 : ℂ))) * (4 * w + (j0 : ℂ))
        - 4 * ((1 / 2 - (h : ℂ)) * w + (1 - w ^ 2) * (4 * w + (j0 : ℂ)))
        - (1 - w ^ 2) * deriv Pc w + 4 * (1 / 2 + (h : ℂ)) * w * Pc w) / (1 - 2 * (h : ℂ) * w ^ 2) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Ξ, hΞdef⟩ : ∃ f : ℂ → ℂ, f = fun v => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, v * ζc ((t : ℂ) * v) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hχd : DifferentiableOn ℂ χc (axRect ρ) := by
    rw [hχc]
    exact DifferentiableOn.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (fun w hw => (hne w hw).1)
  have hζd : DifferentiableOn ℂ ζc (axRect ρ) := by
    rw [hζc]
    exact DifferentiableOn.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (fun w hw => (hne w hw).1)
  have hℓd : DifferentiableOn ℂ ℓc (axRect ρ) := by
    rw [hℓc]
    exact DifferentiableOn.inv (by fun_prop) (fun w hw => (hne w hw).2)
  have hPd : DifferentiableOn ℂ Pc (axRect ρ) := hPcd'.mono (hmono _ _ (by linarith))
  have hdPd : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv Pc) (axRect ρ) :=
    ((hPcd'.analyticOnNhd (hOpen _)).deriv.differentiableOn).mono (hmono _ _ (by linarith))
  have hzd : DifferentiableOn ℂ zc (axRect ρ) := by
    rw [hzc]
    refine DifferentiableOn.div ?_ (by fun_prop) (fun w hw => (hne w hw).2)
    refine DifferentiableOn.add (DifferentiableOn.sub (by fun_prop) ?_) ?_
    · exact DifferentiableOn.mul (by fun_prop) hdPd
    · exact DifferentiableOn.mul (by fun_prop) hPd
  
  obtain ⟨Bχ, -, hBχ⟩ := s1 (3 * ρ / 4) ρ χc (by linarith) hχd
  obtain ⟨Bζ, -, hBζ⟩ := s1 (3 * ρ / 4) ρ ζc (by linarith) hζd
  obtain ⟨Bℓ, -, hBℓ⟩ := s1 (3 * ρ / 4) ρ ℓc (by linarith) hℓd
  obtain ⟨Bz, -, hBz⟩ := s1 (3 * ρ / 4) ρ zc (by linarith) hzd
  obtain ⟨BP, -, hBP⟩ := s1 (3 * ρ / 4) (2 * ρ) Pc (by linarith) hPcd'
  obtain ⟨hΞ, hΞreal⟩ := s3 (ρ / 2) Bζ ζc (by linarith) (by linarith)
    (by rw [show 2 * (ρ / 2) = ρ by ring]; exact hζd)
    (fun u hu => by
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hu
      exact hBζ u (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith))
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = max (max (max 20 Bχ) (max Bζ Bℓ)) (max (max Bz (2 * Bζ)) BP) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hM20 : 20 ≤ M := by rw [hM]; simp
  have hMχ : Bχ ≤ M := by rw [hM]; simp
  have hMζ : Bζ ≤ M := by rw [hM]; simp
  have hMℓ : Bℓ ≤ M := by rw [hM]; simp
  have hMz : Bz ≤ M := by rw [hM]; simp
  have hMΞ : 2 * Bζ ≤ M := by rw [hM]; simp
  have hMP : BP ≤ M := by rw [hM]; simp
  
  have hχR : ∀ η : ℝ, χc (η : ℂ) = ((axChi h j0 σ η : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro η
    simp only [hχc, axChi, axHs]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hζR : ∀ η : ℝ, ζc (η : ℂ) = ((axZeta h j0 σ η : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro η
    simp only [hζc, axZeta, axHs]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hsubr : axRect (ρ / 2) ⊆ axRect ρ := hmono _ _ (by linarith)
  refine ⟨ρ / 2, M, χc, ζc, ℓc, zc, Ξ, ?_⟩
  unfold AxCoefData
  refine ⟨by linarith, le_refl _, by linarith, hM20, hχd.mono hsubr, hζd.mono hsubr,
    hℓd.mono hsubr, hzd.mono hsubr, ?_, hPcd'.mono (hmono _ _ (by linarith)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro w hw
    have hd : HasDerivAt Ξ (ζc w) w := by rw [hΞdef]; exact (hΞ w hw).1
    exact hd.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  · intro w hw
    have hw2 := hw
    obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := hw2
    have d1 : |w.im| ≤ 3 * ρ / 4 := by linarith
    have d2 : -1 - 3 * ρ / 4 ≤ w.re := by linarith
    have d3 : w.re ≤ 1 + 3 * ρ / 4 := by linarith
    refine ⟨(hBχ w d1 d2 d3).1.trans hMχ, (hBζ w d1 d2 d3).1.trans hMζ,
      (hBℓ w d1 d2 d3).1.trans hMℓ, (hBz w d1 d2 d3).1.trans hMz, ?_,
      (hBP w d1 d2 d3).1.trans hMP, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hΞdef]; exact (hΞ w hw).2.trans hMΞ
    · rw [hΞdef]; exact (hΞ w hw).1
    · simp only [hℓc]
      exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (hne w (hsubr hw)).2
  · intro η hη1 hη2
    have hPη : Pc (η : ℂ) = ((Pax η : ℝ) : ℂ) := hPcR η (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hmem2 : (η : ℂ) ∈ axRect (2 * ρ) :=
      ⟨by rw [Complex.ofReal_im, abs_zero]; linarith, by rw [Complex.ofReal_re]; linarith,
        by rw [Complex.ofReal_re]; linarith⟩
    have hmem1 : (η : ℂ) ∈ axRect ρ :=
      ⟨by rw [Complex.ofReal_im, abs_zero]; linarith, by rw [Complex.ofReal_re]; linarith,
        by rw [Complex.ofReal_re]; linarith⟩
    have hdPη : deriv Pc (η : ℂ) = ((deriv Pax η : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
      s2 Pc Pax (-1 - 2 * ρ) (1 + 2 * ρ) η (by linarith) (by linarith)
        (hPcd'.differentiableAt ((hOpen _).mem_nhds hmem2)) (fun x h1 h2 => hPcR x h1 h2)
    refine ⟨hχR η, hζR η, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [hzc, hPη, hdPη, axZs, axHs]
      push_cast
      ring
    · rw [hΞdef]
      exact hΞreal (fun x => by rw [hζR x, Complex.ofReal_im]) η
    · simp only [hℓc]
      have e : (1 - 2 * (h : ℂ) * (η : ℂ) ^ 2) = ((1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [e, ← Complex.ofReal_inv, Complex.ofReal_im]
    · have hdχ := s2 χc (fun e => axChi h j0 σ e) (η - 1) (η + 1) η (by linarith) (by linarith)
        (hχd.differentiableAt ((hOpen _).mem_nhds hmem1)) (fun x _ _ => hχR x)
      have hb := (hBχ (η : ℂ) (by rw [Complex.ofReal_im, abs_zero]; linarith)
        (by rw [Complex.ofReal_re]; linarith) (by rw [Complex.ofReal_re]; linarith)).2
      rw [hdχ, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hb
      exact hb.trans hMχ

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h j0 r M : ℝ) (χ ζ ℓ z : ℂ → ℂ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 ≤ j0 → j0 ≤ 1 / 20 → 0 < r → r ≤ 1 / 100 → 20 ≤ M → DifferentiableOn ℂ χ (axRect r) → DifferentiableOn ℂ ζ (axRect r) → DifferentiableOn ℂ ℓ (axRect r) → DifferentiableOn ℂ z (axRect r) → (∀ w ∈ axRect r, ‖χ w‖ ≤ M ∧ ‖ζ w‖ ≤ M ∧ ‖ℓ w‖ ≤ M ∧ ‖z w‖ ≤ M) → ∃ Λ0 A : ℝ, AxMajor h j0 r Λ0 A χ ζ ℓ z

signature.name: ax_rec_majorant
signature.statement: ∀ (h j0 r M : ℝ) (χ ζ ℓ z : ℂ → ℂ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 ≤ j0 → j0 ≤ 1 / 20 → 0 < r → r ≤ 1 / 100 → 20 ≤ M → DifferentiableOn ℂ χ (axRect r) → DifferentiableOn ℂ ζ (axRect r) → DifferentiableOn ℂ ℓ (axRect r) → DifferentiableOn ℂ z (axRect r) → (∀ w ∈ axRect r, ‖χ w‖ ≤ M ∧ ‖ζ w‖ ≤ M ∧ ‖ℓ w‖ ≤ M ∧ ‖z w‖ ≤ M) → ∃ Λ0 A : ℝ, AxMajor h j0 r Λ0 A χ ζ ℓ z

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h j0 r M χ ζ ℓ z hh0 hh1 hj0 hj0' hr0 hr1 hM hχd hζd hℓd hzd hbd
  
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℝ, E = 2 * Real.exp (10 * M / r) + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨E', hE'⟩ : ∃ E' : ℝ, E' = 40 * M / r := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ, G = M * (7 * E + 12 * M * E * E') := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨G', hG'⟩ : ∃ G' : ℝ, G' = M * (8 * E' + 60 * E' ^ 2 + 40 * E ^ 2 / (r / 20)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = 2 * (10 * M / r) * G * Real.exp (40 * M / r) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ, b = 40 * M * G' / r := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = max (max E E') (max a b) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by linarith
  have hEpos : 0 < E := by rw [hE]; positivity
  have hE'1 : 1 ≤ E' := by rw [hE', le_div_iff₀ hr0]; linarith
  have hE'0 : 0 ≤ E' := by linarith
  have hG0 : 0 ≤ G := by
    rw [hG]
    exact mul_nonneg hM0 (add_nonneg (by linarith)
      (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hM0) hEpos.le) hE'0))
  have hG'0 : 0 ≤ G' := by
    rw [hG']
    exact mul_nonneg hM0 (add_nonneg (add_nonneg (by linarith) (by positivity))
      (div_nonneg (by positivity) (by linarith)))
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by
    rw [ha]
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (div_nonneg (by linarith) hr0.le)) hG0)
      (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ b := by
    rw [hb]
    exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hG'0) hr0.le
  have hEA : E ≤ A := by rw [hA]; exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hE'A : E' ≤ A := by rw [hA]; exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have haA : a ≤ A := by rw [hA]; exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hbA : b ≤ A := by rw [hA]; exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := le_trans hEpos.le hEA
  clear hA
  refine ⟨max 1 (max a b), A, le_max_left _ _, lt_of_lt_of_le hEpos hEA, ?_⟩
  intro Λ hΛ g hgd hgb
  have hΛ1 : 1 ≤ Λ := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hΛ
  have hΛ0 : 0 < Λ := by linarith
  have haΛ : a ≤ Λ := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hΛ

ax_raw_ode.definitions:
noncomputable def axSer (c : ℕ → ℂ) (y : ℂ) : ℂ := ∑' n : ℕ, c n * y ^ n

noncomputable def axPn (h j0 Λ C : ℝ) (χ ζ ℓ z Ξ : ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) : ℂ → ℂ :=
  (axRecPV h j0 Λ χ ζ ℓ z (axGain Λ C Ξ) n).1

noncomputable def axVn (h j0 Λ C : ℝ) (χ ζ ℓ z Ξ : ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) : ℂ → ℂ :=
  (axRecPV h j0 Λ χ ζ ℓ z (axGain Λ C Ξ) n).2

noncomputable def axQn (h j0 Λ C : ℝ) (χ ζ ℓ z Ξ : ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) (w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (if n = 0 then 0 else axGain Λ C Ξ w ^ 2 *
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - 1 + 1), axPn h j0 Λ C χ ζ ℓ z Ξ i w * axPn h j0 Λ C χ ζ ℓ z Ξ (n - 1 - i) w) /
    (n : ℂ)

signature.name: ax_raw_close
signature.statement:
∀ (h Pst : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (j0 σ δ ρ : ℝ) (Pc : ℂ → ℂ) (r M Λ0 A : ℝ) (χc ζc ℓc zc Ξ : ℂ → ℂ), AxDatum h Pst Pax → 0 < j0 → j0 ≤ 1 / 20 → AxData h j0 σ δ ρ Pc Pax → AxCoefData h j0 σ ρ Pc Pax r M χc ζc ℓc zc Ξ → AxMajor h j0 r Λ0 A χc ζc ℓc zc → ∃ Λ1 K1 : ℝ, 0 < K1 ∧ ∀ Λ C : ℝ, Λ1 ≤ Λ → Real.exp (Λ * M) ≤ C →
    let Fn := axFnDef h j0 Λ C χc ζc ℓc zc Ξ
    let Un := axUnDef h j0 Λ C χc ζc ℓc zc Ξ
    ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) → -1 - r / 8 < η → η < 1 + r / 8 →
      |X * deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) X / Fn X η -
          Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η * deriv axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η) / axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η)| ≤ K1 / Λ ∧
      |deriv (fun e => Fn X e) η / Fn X η - Λ * axZeta h j0 σ η -
          Λ * X * deriv (fun e => axChi h j0 σ e) η * deriv axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η) /
            axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η)| ≤ K1 / Λ ∧
      |Un X η - (4 * η + j0)| ≤ K1 / Λ ∧ |deriv (fun e => Un X e) η - 4| ≤ K1 / Λ ∧
      |deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) X + axZs h j0 Pax η / (2 * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2))| ≤ K1 / Λ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Pst Pax j0 σ δ ρ Pc r M Λ0 A χc ζc ℓc zc Ξ hD hj0 hj0' hAD hCD hMaj
  obtain ⟨hr0, -, hr100, hM20, hχd, hζd, hℓd, hzd, hΞd, -, hpt, hreal⟩ := hCD
  obtain ⟨hΛ0, hA0, hMain⟩ := hMaj
  have hσ : 0 < σ := hAD.1
  refine ⟨max Λ0 (40 * A), A * (60 + 40 / r + 40 * M),
    mul_pos hA0 (by have h1 : 0 < 40 / r := div_pos (by norm_num) hr0; linarith), ?_⟩
  intro Λ C hΛ hC Fn Un X η hX0 hX1 hη1 hη2
  have hΛ0' : Λ0 ≤ Λ := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hΛ
  have hΛA : 40 * A ≤ Λ := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hΛ
  have hΛ1 : 1 ≤ Λ := le_trans hΛ0 hΛ0'
  have hΛpos : 0 < Λ := by linarith
  have ha0 : 0 < A / Λ := div_pos hA0 hΛpos
  have haA : A / Λ ≤ A := div_le_self hA0.le hΛ1
  have ha40 : 40 * (A / Λ) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [mul_div_assoc', div_le_one hΛpos]; exact hΛA
  have har : 0 ≤ A / Λ / r := div_nonneg ha0.le hr0.le
  have haM : 0 ≤ M * (A / Λ) := mul_nonneg (by linarith) ha0.le
  have hK1eq : A * (60 + 40 / r + 40 * M) / Λ =
      60 * (A / Λ) + 40 * (A / Λ / r) + 40 * M * (A / Λ) := by ring
  rw [hK1eq]
  
  obtain ⟨hgd, hgb, hgreal⟩ := ax_gain_props Λ C M r Ξ ζc hΛpos.le hC
    (fun w hw => ⟨(hpt w hw).2.2.2.2.1, (hpt w hw).2.2.2.2.2.2.1⟩)
  have hMn := hMain Λ hΛ0' (axGain Λ C Ξ) hgd (fun w hw => (hgb w hw).1)
  obtain ⟨P, hPdef⟩ : ∃ P : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ, ∀ n, P n = (axRecPV h j0 Λ χc ζc ℓc zc (axGain Λ C Ξ) n).1 :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨V, hVdef⟩ : ∃ V : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ, ∀ n, V n = (axRecPV h j0 Λ χc ζc ℓc zc (axGain Λ C Ξ) n).2 :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Ec, hEc⟩ : ∃ Ec : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ, ∀ n w,
      Ec n w = (-χc w / 2) ^ n / ((n.factorial : ℂ) * ((n + 1).factorial : ℂ)) := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hPd : ∀ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (P n) (axRect r) := fun n => by rw [hPdef]; exact (hMn n).1
  have hVd : ∀ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (V n) (axRect r) := fun n => by rw [hVdef]; exact (hMn n).2.1
  have hBd : ∀ n, ∀ w ∈ axRect (r / 2), ‖P n w‖ ≤ A * (1 / 10) ^ n ∧ ‖V n w‖ ≤ A * (1 / 10) ^ n ∧
      ‖P n w - Ec n w‖ ≤ A / Λ * (1 / 10) ^ n ∧
      ‖V n w - (if n = 1 then -zc w / 2 else 0)‖ ≤ A / Λ * (1 / 10) ^ n := by
    intro n w hw; rw [hPdef, hVdef, hEc]; exact (hMn n).2.2.1 w hw
  have hrealc : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 - r < e → e < 1 + r → (χc (e:ℂ)).im = 0 ∧ (ζc (e:ℂ)).im = 0 ∧
      (ℓc (e:ℂ)).im = 0 ∧ (zc (e:ℂ)).im = 0 ∧ (axGain Λ C Ξ (e:ℂ)).im = 0 := by
    intro e h1 h2
    obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, -⟩ := hreal e h1 h2
    refine ⟨by rw [c1]; exact Complex.ofReal_im _, by rw [c2]; exact Complex.ofReal_im _, c5,
      by rw [c3]; exact Complex.ofReal_im _, ?_⟩
    rw [(hgreal e c4).1]; exact Complex.ofReal_im _
  have hPV : ∀ n, ∀ e : ℝ, -1 - r < e → e < 1 + r → (P n (e:ℂ)).im = 0 ∧ (V n (e:ℂ)).im = 0 := by
    intro n; rw [hPdef, hVdef]; exact (hMn n).2.2.2 hrealc
  
  have hrect : ∀ s : ℝ, IsOpen (axRect s) := by
    intro s
    show IsOpen {w : ℂ | |w.im| < s ∧ -1 - s < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + s}
    refine (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const).inter ?_
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
      (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const)
  have hηr1 : -1 - r < η := by linarith
  have hηr2 : η < 1 + r := by linarith
  have hηR : (η : ℂ) ∈ axRect (r / 2) := by
    show |(η:ℂ).im| < r / 2 ∧ -1 - r / 2 < (η:ℂ).re ∧ (η:ℂ).re < 1 + r / 2
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.ofReal_re, abs_zero]
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hηRr : (η : ℂ) ∈ axRect r := by
    show |(η:ℂ).im| < r ∧ -1 - r < (η:ℂ).re ∧ (η:ℂ).re < 1 + r
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.ofReal_re, abs_zero]
    exact ⟨hr0, hηr1, hηr2⟩
  
  have hχ0 : 0 ≤ axChi h j0 σ η := by unfold axChi; positivity
  have hχ1 : axChi h j0 σ η ≤ 1 := by
    unfold axChi
    rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg σ]
  rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 10 * Λ)] at hX1
  have hY0 : 0 ≤ Λ * X := mul_nonneg hΛpos.le hX0
  have hY1 : Λ * X ≤ 41 / 10 := by linarith
  have hYabs : |Λ * X| < 5 := abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hz0 : 0 ≤ Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η := mul_nonneg hY0 hχ0
  have hz1 : Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η ≤ 41 / 10 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hχ1 hY0; linarith
  have hXlt : X < 9 / (2 * Λ) := by rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * Λ)]; linarith
  have hnhds : Set.Iio (9 / (2 * Λ)) ∈ nhds X := Iio_mem_nhds hXlt
  have hΛX' : ∀ X' ∈ Set.Iio (9 / (2 * Λ)), Λ * X' ≤ 9 / 2 := by
    intro X' hX'
    have := (lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * Λ)).mp hX'
    linarith
  
  have hcut : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 9 / 2 → axCut y = 1 := by
    intro y hy; unfold axCut; exact Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith)
  have hPhi : ∀ (y : ℝ) (w : ℂ), axPhi h j0 Λ C χc ζc ℓc zc Ξ y w = ∑' n, P n w * (y : ℂ) ^ n := by
    intro y w; unfold axPhi; simp only [hPdef]
  have hPsi : ∀ (y : ℝ) (w : ℂ), axPsiU h j0 Λ C χc ζc ℓc zc Ξ y w = ∑' n, V n w * (y : ℂ) ^ n := by
    intro y w; unfold axPsiU; simp only [hVdef]
  have hFn : ∀ X' : ℝ, Λ * X' ≤ 9 / 2 → ∀ e : ℝ,
      Fn X' e = (axGain Λ C Ξ (e:ℂ) * ∑' n, P n (e:ℂ) * ((Λ * X' : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ n).re := by
    intro X' hX' e
    show axCut (Λ * X') * _ + (1 - axCut (Λ * X')) = _
    rw [hcut _ hX', hPhi]; ring
  have hUn : ∀ X' : ℝ, Λ * X' ≤ 9 / 2 → ∀ e : ℝ,
      Un X' e = 4 * e + j0 + (∑' n, V n (e:ℂ) * ((Λ * X' : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ n).re / Λ := by
    intro X' hX' e
    show 4 * e + j0 + axCut (Λ * X') * _ / Λ = _
    rw [hcut _ hX', hPsi, one_mul]
  
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ n, p n = (P n (η:ℂ)).re := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ n, v n = (V n (η:ℂ)).re := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ec, hec⟩ : ∃ ec : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ n, ec n =
      (-axChi h j0 σ η / 2) ^ n / ((n.factorial : ℝ) * ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ζ0, hζ0⟩ : ∃ ζ0 : ℝ, ζ0 = axZs h j0 Pax η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ι, hι⟩ : ∃ ι : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ n, ι n = if n = 1 then -ζ0 / 2 else 0 := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hχη, hζη, hzη, hΞη, -, hdχM⟩ := hreal η hηr1 hηr2
  have hPη : ∀ n, P n (η:ℂ) = (p n : ℂ) := by
    intro n; apply Complex.ext
    · simp [hp]
    · simp [(hPV n η hηr1 hηr2).1]
  have hVη : ∀ n, V n (η:ℂ) = (v n : ℂ) := by
    intro n; apply Complex.ext
    · simp [hv]
    · simp [(hPV n η hηr1 hηr2).2]
  have hEcη : ∀ n, Ec n (η:ℂ) = (ec n : ℂ) := by
    intro n; simp [hEc, hec, hχη]
  have hzcη : zc (η:ℂ) = (ζ0 : ℂ) := by rw [hzη, hζ0]
  have hbP := fun n => hBd n (η:ℂ) hηR
  have hpb : ∀ n, |p n| ≤ A * (1 / 10) ^ n := fun n => by
    rw [hp]; exact le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _) (hbP n).1
  have hvb : ∀ n, |v n| ≤ A * (1 / 10) ^ n := fun n => by
    rw [hv]; exact le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _) (hbP n).2.1
  have hdb : ∀ n, |p n - ec n| ≤ A / Λ * (1 / 10) ^ n := fun n => by
    have h1 := (hbP n).2.2.1
    rw [hPη, hEcη, ← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact h1
  have hecb : ∀ n, |ec n| ≤ 2 * A * (1 / 10) ^ n := fun n => by
    have h1 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (ec n) (p n)
    have h2 := abs_sub_comm (ec n) (p n)
    have h3 : A / Λ * (1 / 10 : ℝ) ^ n ≤ A * (1 / 10) ^ n :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right haA (by positivity)
    linarith [hpb n, hdb n]
  have hβb : ∀ n, |v n - ι n| ≤ A / Λ * (1 / 10) ^ n := fun n => by
    have h1 := (hbP n).2.2.2
    have h2 : (if n = 1 then -zc (η:ℂ) / 2 else 0) = ((ι n : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [hι, hzcη]; split_ifs <;> push_cast <;> rfl
    rw [hVη, h2, ← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact h1
  
  have hfacN : ∀ n : ℕ, 5 ^ n ≤ 3 * (n.factorial * (n + 1).factorial) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => norm_num [Nat.factorial]
    | succ k ih =>
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk | hk
      · subst hk; norm_num [Nat.factorial]
      · have e : (k + 1).factorial * (k + 1 + 1).factorial =
            (k + 1) * (k + 2) * (k.factorial * (k + 1).factorial) := by
          simp only [Nat.factorial_succ]; ring
        rw [e, pow_succ]
        have h6 : 6 ≤ (k + 1) * (k + 2) := by nlinarith
        have h7 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (k.factorial * (k + 1).factorial) h6
        nlinarith
  obtain ⟨b0, hb0⟩ : ∃ b0 : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ n, b0 n =
      (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n / ((n.factorial : ℝ) * ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hb0b : ∀ n, |b0 n| ≤ 3 * (1 / 10) ^ n := by
    intro n
    have hQ : (0:ℝ) < (n.factorial : ℝ) * ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hN : (5:ℝ) ^ n ≤ 3 * ((n.factorial : ℝ) * ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)) := by
      exact_mod_cast hfacN n
    rw [hb0, abs_div, abs_pow, abs_of_pos hQ, div_le_iff₀ hQ]
    have e1 : |(-1 / 2 : ℝ)| ^ n = 5 ^ n * (1 / 10) ^ n := by
      rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
    rw [e1]
    have : (0:ℝ) ≤ (1 / 10) ^ n := by positivity
    nlinarith
  have hF0eq : axF0 = fun z => ∑' n, b0 n * z ^ n := by
    funext z; unfold axF0; congr 1; funext n; rw [hb0]
    rw [show -z / 2 = (-1 / 2) * z by ring, mul_pow]; ring
  obtain ⟨-, -, hF0has, -, -⟩ := ax_real_series 3 b0 hb0b (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η)
    (abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
  have hF0diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η) := by
    rw [hF0eq]; exact hF0has.differentiableAt
  obtain ⟨hF0lo, hF0hi, hf0lo, hf0hi⟩ := ax_f0_bounds.1 _ hz0 hz1
  
  obtain ⟨hsP, hsP', hPhas, hPbd, hP'bd⟩ := ax_real_series A p hpb (Λ * X) hYabs
  obtain ⟨hsE, hsE', hEhas, -, -⟩ := ax_real_series (2 * A) ec hecb (Λ * X) hYabs
  obtain ⟨hsD, hsD', -, hDbd, hD'bd⟩ := ax_real_series (A / Λ) (fun n => p n - ec n) hdb (Λ * X) hYabs
  obtain ⟨hsV, hsV', hVhas, hVbd, -⟩ := ax_real_series A v hvb (Λ * X) hYabs
  obtain ⟨-, hsB', -, -, hB'bd⟩ := ax_real_series (A / Λ) (fun n => v n - ι n) hβb (Λ * X) hYabs
  beta_reduce at hsD hsD' hDbd hD'bd hsB' hB'bd
  have hSe : (fun y : ℝ => ∑' n, ec n * y ^ n) = fun y => axF0 (y * axChi h j0 σ η) := by
    funext y; unfold axF0; congr 1; funext n; rw [hec]
    rw [show -(y * axChi h j0 σ η) / 2 = (-axChi h j0 σ η / 2) * y by ring, mul_pow]; ring
  have hchain : HasDerivAt (fun y => axF0 (y * axChi h j0 σ η))
      (deriv axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η) * axChi h j0 σ η) (Λ * X) := by
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y * axChi h j0 σ η) (axChi h j0 σ η) (Λ * X) := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (Λ * X)).mul_const (axChi h j0 σ η)
    exact hF0diff.hasDerivAt.comp (Λ * X) h1
  rw [hSe] at hEhas
  have hSe' : ∑' n : ℕ, (n:ℝ) * ec n * (Λ * X) ^ (n - 1) =
      deriv axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η) * axChi h j0 σ η := hEhas.unique hchain
  have hSeY : ∑' n, ec n * (Λ * X) ^ n = axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η) := congrFun hSe (Λ * X)
  have hdiff0 : ∑' n, p n * (Λ * X) ^ n - axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η) =
      ∑' n, (p n - ec n) * (Λ * X) ^ n := by
    rw [← hSeY, ← hsP.tsum_sub hsE]; congr 1; funext n; ring
  have hdiff1 : ∑' n : ℕ, (n:ℝ) * p n * (Λ * X) ^ (n - 1) -
      deriv axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η) * axChi h j0 σ η =
      ∑' n : ℕ, (n:ℝ) * (p n - ec n) * (Λ * X) ^ (n - 1) := by
    rw [← hSe', ← hsP'.tsum_sub hsE']; congr 1; funext n; ring
  have hab : |∑' n, p n * (Λ * X) ^ n - axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η)| ≤ 1 / 20 := by
    rw [hdiff0]; linarith
  have hab2 : |∑' n, p n * (Λ * X) ^ n - axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η)| ≤ 2 * (A / Λ) := by
    rw [hdiff0]; exact hDbd
  have hSpos : 0 < ∑' n, p n * (Λ * X) ^ n := by
    have := (abs_le.mp hab).1; linarith
  have hF0pos : 0 < axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η) := by linarith
  
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ : ∃ γ : ℝ, γ = Real.exp (Λ * (Ξ (η:ℂ)).re) / C := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hgη, hγpos⟩ := hgreal η hΞη
  rw [← hγ] at hgη hγpos
  have hΨ : ∀ y : ℝ, ∑' n, P n (η:ℂ) * (y : ℂ) ^ n = ((∑' n, p n * y ^ n : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro y; rw [Complex.ofReal_tsum]; congr 1; funext n; simp [hPη]
  have hΨv : ∀ y : ℝ, ∑' n, V n (η:ℂ) * (y : ℂ) ^ n = ((∑' n, v n * y ^ n : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro y; rw [Complex.ofReal_tsum]; congr 1; funext n; simp [hVη]
  have hFnη : ∀ X' : ℝ, Λ * X' ≤ 9 / 2 → Fn X' η = γ * ∑' n, p n * (Λ * X') ^ n := by
    intro X' hX'
    rw [hFn X' hX' η, hgη, hΨ, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_re]
  have hUnη : ∀ X' : ℝ, Λ * X' ≤ 9 / 2 → Un X' η = 4 * η + j0 + (∑' n, v n * (Λ * X') ^ n) / Λ := by
    intro X' hX'
    rw [hUn X' hX' η, hΨv, Complex.ofReal_re]
  have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Λ * x) Λ X := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id X).const_mul Λ
  have hFX : Fn X η = γ * ∑' n, p n * (Λ * X) ^ n := hFnη X (by linarith)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have hFder : HasDerivAt (fun X' => Fn X' η)
        (γ * ((∑' n : ℕ, (n:ℝ) * p n * (Λ * X) ^ (n - 1)) * Λ)) X := by
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun X' => γ * ∑' n, p n * (Λ * X') ^ n)
          (γ * ((∑' n : ℕ, (n:ℝ) * p n * (Λ * X) ^ (n - 1)) * Λ)) X :=
        (hPhas.comp X hlin).const_mul γ
      exact h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hnhds (fun X' hX' => hFnη X' (hΛX' X' hX')))
    have hT1eq : X * deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) X / Fn X η -
        Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η * deriv axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η) / axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η)
        = (Λ * X) * ((∑' n : ℕ, (n:ℝ) * p n * (Λ * X) ^ (n - 1)) / (∑' n, p n * (Λ * X) ^ n) -
          (deriv axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η) * axChi h j0 σ η) / axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η)) := by
      rw [hFder.deriv, hFX]
      field_simp [hγpos.ne', hSpos.ne', hF0pos.ne']
    have hp0T1 : |deriv axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η) * axChi h j0 σ η| ≤ 1 / 4 := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hχ0]
      have h1 : |deriv axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η)| ≤ 1 / 4 := abs_le.mpr ⟨hf0lo, by linarith⟩
      have h2 := mul_le_mul h1 hχ1 hχ0 (by norm_num)
      linarith
    have hs3a := ax_ratio_perturb _ _ (∑' n : ℕ, (n:ℝ) * p n * (Λ * X) ^ (n - 1))
      (deriv axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η) * axChi h j0 σ η) hF0lo hab
    have hpp0 : |∑' n : ℕ, (n:ℝ) * p n * (Λ * X) ^ (n - 1) -
        deriv axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η) * axChi h j0 σ η| ≤ A / Λ := by

noncomputable def axGlueFe (Pst C T : ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ → ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (Real.exp (axLam T ℓ X η) * (X / 110) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) / C +
      (c η 2 * γ 0 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) + c η 3 * γ 1 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) +
        c η 4 * γ 2 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)))) / Real.sqrt (2 * X)

noncomputable def axGlueUe (Pst C : ℝ) (G : ℝ → ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  G η + Real.smoothTransition (Real.log (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) + 8) * (4 * η - G η) +
      (c η 0 * β 0 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) + c η 1 * β 1 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)))

      (fun X => (4 * η) ^ 2 - X * refFin Pst (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) X η ^ 2)
      (fun x => ((4 * η + (c η 0 * β 0 x + c η 1 * β 1 x)) ^ 2 - (Pst * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) + (c η 2 * γ 0 x + c η 3 * γ 1 x + c η 4 * γ 2 x)) ^ 2 / 2) - ((4 * η) ^ 2 - (Pst * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 2))
      (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) _ hXRpos
      ((by fun_prop : ContinuousOn (fun X => axUm Pst C G U β c X η ^ 2 - X * axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c X η ^ 2) _).intervalIntegrable) r3
      (fun X _ hX => by simp only [(low X hX).1, (low X hX).2]) (fun x hx1 _ => ?_) h3 ?_
    · obtain ⟨t1, t2, t3⟩ := tail x hx1
      simp only [t1, t2, t3]
      exact (alg _ x _ _ (c η 0 * β 0 x + c η 1 * β 1 x) hXRpos (he6 x hx1)).2.2.1
    · show _ * (-(_ - _) / _) = _
      rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hXRpos.ne']; rfl
  · 
    refine split (fun X => axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c X η ^ 2)
      (fun X => axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0) X η ^ 2)
      (fun X => refFin Pst (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) X η ^ 2)
      (fun x => ((Pst * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) + (c η 2 * γ 0 x + c η 3 * γ 1 x + c η 4 * γ 2 x)) ^ 2 - (Pst * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)) ^ 2) / (2 * x))
      (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) 1 _ hXRpos
      ((by fun_prop : ContinuousOn (fun X => axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c X η ^ 2) _).intervalIntegrable) r4
      (fun X _ hX => by simp only [(low X hX).1]) (fun x hx1 _ => ?_) h4 ?_
    · obtain ⟨-, t2, t3⟩ := tail x hx1
      simp only [t2, t3]
      exact (alg _ x _ _ (c η 0 * β 0 x + c η 1 * β 1 x) hXRpos (he6 x hx1)).2.2.2
    · show 1 * _ = _
      rw [one_mul]; rfl

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h Pst : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ), AxDatum h Pst Pax → ∃ K1 : ℝ, 0 < K1 ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 / 100 → ∀ Bd T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∃ C0 : ℝ, ∀ C : ℝ, C0 ≤ C → ∀ (Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ : ℝ) (ℓ G : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ), AxInner h Pax ε Bd C Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ ℓ G F U → AxReg (axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0)) (axUm Pst C G U β (fun _ => 0)) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖axDisc Pst (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) (axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0)) (axUm Pst C G U β (fun _ => 0)) η‖ ≤ K1 * ε ∧ ‖deriv (axDisc Pst (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) (axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0)) (axUm Pst C G U β (fun _ => 0))) η‖ ≤ K1 * ε) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (axDisc Pst (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) (axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0)) (axUm Pst C G U β (fun _ => 0))) (Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedDeriv m (axDisc Pst (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) (axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0)) (axUm Pst C G U β (fun _ => 0))) η‖ ≤ K

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Pst Pax hD
  have hPst : 0 < Pst := hD.2.2.1
  have hP11 : 11 < Pst := by
    have := Real.add_one_le_exp 10
    linarith [hD.2.2.2.1]
  refine ⟨2 + Pst, by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro ε hε hε1 Bd T hT
  obtain ⟨Xs, hXsd⟩ : ∃ Xs : ℝ, Xs = 110 * Real.exp (1 + T) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨B1, hB1d⟩ : ∃ B1 : ℝ, B1 = (|Bd| + 1) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hXs1 : 1 ≤ Xs := by
    rw [hXsd]
    have := Real.add_one_le_exp (1 + T)
    linarith
  have hXs0 : 0 < Xs := by linarith
  have hB1 : 0 ≤ B1 := by rw [hB1d]; positivity
  obtain ⟨Q, hQd⟩ : ∃ Q : ℝ,
      Q = 40 * Xs ^ 2 * (B1 + B1 ^ 2) + 8 * Pst * Xs ^ 2 + 4 * Pst ^ 2 * Xs ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨t, htd⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, t = ε / (5 * Pst ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ht : 0 < t := by rw [htd]; positivity
  have ht5 : 5 * Pst ^ 2 * t = ε := by rw [htd]; field_simp
  refine ⟨max (max 1 (Real.exp (7 + T))) (max (Q / ε) (Xs / t ^ 5)), ?_⟩
  intro C hC Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ ℓ G F U β γ hIn hReg
  have hC1 : 1 ≤ C := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hC
  have hCe : Real.exp (7 + T) ≤ C := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hC
  have hCQ : Q / ε ≤ C := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hC
  have hCX : Xs / t ^ 5 ≤ C := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hC
  have hCpos : 0 < C := by linarith
  have hQC : Q ≤ C * ε := (div_le_iff₀ hε).mp hCQ
  have hXsC : Xs ≤ C * t ^ 5 := (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mp hCX
  have hCP1 : 1 ≤ C * Pst := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hC1 (by linarith)
  have hCP : C ≤ C * Pst := le_mul_of_one_le_right hCpos.le (by linarith)
  have hpow : C * Pst ≤ (C * Pst) ^ 10 := le_self_pow₀ hCP1 (by norm_num)
  have hXRC : C ≤ 110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10 := by linarith
  have hXR1 : 1 ≤ 110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10 := by linarith
  have hX1 : Xs ≤ 110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10 * Real.exp (-6) := by
    rw [hXsd]
    have e : Real.exp (1 + T) = Real.exp (7 + T) * Real.exp (-6) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
    rw [e]
    have h7 : Real.exp (7 + T) ≤ (C * Pst) ^ 10 := by linarith
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h7 (Real.exp_pos (-6)).le
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨hUf, hFf, hFref⟩ := ax_disc_profile_facts h Pst Pax ε Bd C T Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ ℓ G F U β γ
    hPst hT hIn
  rw [← hXsd, ← hB1d] at hFf
  rw [← hXsd] at hFref
  obtain ⟨ε', hε', hFs, hUs, -, hbd⟩ := hReg
  generalize hF0 : axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0) = F0 at hFf hFref hFs hbd ⊢
  generalize hU0 : axUm Pst C G U β (fun _ => 0) = U0 at hUf hUs hbd ⊢
  generalize hXRg : 110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10 = XR at hFref hXRC hXR1 hX1 ⊢
  have hXRpos : 0 < XR := by linarith
  
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ B1 / C := by positivity
  obtain ⟨jI, jJ, jS, jC⟩ := ax_disc_inner_pieces ε ε' Xs (B1 / C) F0 U0 hε.le hε1 hε' hXs1 hM0 hFs hUs
    (fun m => hbd Xs m)
    (fun X η h0 h1 h2 h3 => ⟨(hUf X η h0 h2 h3).1, (hUf X η h0 h2 h3).2,
      (hFf X η h0 h1 h2 h3).1, (hFf X η h0 h1 h2 h3).2⟩)
  obtain ⟨jM, jU, jR⟩ := ax_disc_outer_pieces ε ε' Pst XR Xs (XR * Real.exp (-6)) U0 hε.le hε1 hε'
    hPst hXRpos hXs0 hX1 hUs
    (fun m => (hbd (XR * Real.exp (-6)) m).imp (fun K hK X η a b c d => (hK X η a b c d).2))
    (fun X η a _ c d => hUf X η a c d)
  obtain ⟨jf, jf2, jef⟩ := ax_eta_weight_jets
  
  have hwk : ∀ (B B' : ℝ) (r : ℝ → ℝ), EtaJet B r → B ≤ B' → EtaJet B' r := by
    intro B B' r hr hB
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hr
    exact ⟨h1, h2, fun η a b => ⟨(h3 η a b).1.trans hB, (h3 η a b).2.trans hB⟩⟩
  have habs : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → |-1 / x| = 1 / x := by
    intro x hx; rw [abs_div, abs_neg, abs_one, abs_of_pos hx]
  have he1 : 2 ≤ Real.exp 1 := by have := Real.add_one_le_exp 1; linarith
  have he6 : 64 ≤ Real.exp 6 := by
    have e : Real.exp 6 = Real.exp 1 ^ 6 := by rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; norm_num
    rw [e]
    have := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2) he1 6
    linarith
  have hq0 : 0 < Real.exp (-6) := Real.exp_pos _
  have hq : Real.exp (-6) ≤ 1 / 64 := by
    rw [Real.exp_neg, ← one_div]
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) he6
  have hP2 : 0 ≤ 8 * Pst * Xs ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hP3 : 0 ≤ 4 * Pst ^ 2 * Xs ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hP1 : 0 ≤ 40 * Xs ^ 2 * (B1 + B1 ^ 2) := by positivity
  
  have hW : 20 * Xs ^ 2 * (B1 / C + (B1 / C) ^ 2) ≤ ε / 2 := by
    have e1 : (B1 / C) ^ 2 ≤ B1 ^ 2 / C := by
      rw [div_pow]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) hCpos (le_self_pow₀ hC1 (by norm_num))
    have e2 : B1 / C + (B1 / C) ^ 2 ≤ (B1 + B1 ^ 2) / C := by rw [add_div]; linarith
    have h1 : 20 * Xs ^ 2 * (B1 / C + (B1 / C) ^ 2) ≤ 20 * Xs ^ 2 * ((B1 + B1 ^ 2) / C) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e2 (by positivity)
    have h2 : 20 * Xs ^ 2 * ((B1 + B1 ^ 2) / C) ≤ ε / 2 := by
      rw [mul_div_assoc', div_le_iff₀ hCpos]
      have : 20 * Xs ^ 2 * (B1 + B1 ^ 2) ≤ Q / 2 := by rw [hQd]; linarith
      have hεC : ε / 2 * C = C * ε / 2 := by ring
      rw [hεC]; linarith
    linarith
  have hW0 : 0 ≤ 20 * Xs ^ 2 * (B1 / C + (B1 / C) ^ 2) := by positivity
  
  have hsq1 : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt XR := by
    have := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hXR1
    rwa [Real.sqrt_one] at this
  have hA : XR ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) = XR * Real.sqrt XR := by
    rw [show (3 / 2 : ℝ) = 1 + 1 / 2 by norm_num, Real.rpow_add hXRpos, Real.rpow_one,
      Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  have hAX : XR ≤ XR ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by rw [hA]; exact le_mul_of_one_le_right hXRpos.le hsq1
  have hApos : 0 < XR ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hCA : C ≤ XR ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by linarith
  
  have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 ≤ 8 / 5 := by
    rw [show (8 / 5 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt ((8 / 5) ^ 2) by rw [Real.sqrt_sq]; norm_num]
    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hs20 := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ XR ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hXRpos.le _
  have ha1 : XR ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos hXR1 (by norm_num)
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ Xs ^ (8 / 5 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hXs0.le _
  have hb1 : Xs ^ (8 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ Xs ^ 2 := by
    have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hXs1 (show (8 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
    rwa [Real.rpow_two] at this
  have hab : XR ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (8 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ Xs ^ 2 :=
    (mul_le_of_le_one_left hb0 ha1).trans hb1
  have hab0 : 0 ≤ XR ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (8 / 5 : ℝ) := mul_nonneg ha0 hb0
  have hκIe : 5 / 8 * Real.sqrt 2 * Pst * XR ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (8 / 5 : ℝ) =
      (5 / 8 * Real.sqrt 2) * (Pst * (XR ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (8 / 5 : ℝ))) := by ring
  have hκI0 : 0 ≤ 5 / 8 * Real.sqrt 2 * Pst * XR ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (8 / 5 : ℝ) := by
    rw [hκIe]; positivity
  have hκI : 5 / 8 * Real.sqrt 2 * Pst * XR ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (8 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ Pst * Xs ^ 2 := by
    rw [hκIe]
    have h1 : Pst * (XR ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (8 / 5 : ℝ)) ≤ Pst * Xs ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hab hPst.le
    have h2 : 0 ≤ Pst * (XR ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (8 / 5 : ℝ)) := mul_nonneg hPst.le hab0
    have h3 : 5 / 8 * Real.sqrt 2 ≤ 1 := by linarith
    exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left h2 h3).trans h1
  
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ XR ^ (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hXRpos.le _
  have hc1 : XR ^ (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos hXR1 (by norm_num)
  have hd0 : 0 ≤ Xs ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hXs0.le _
  have hd1 : Xs ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ Xs ^ 2 := by
    have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hXs1 (show (6 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
    rwa [Real.rpow_two] at this
  have hcd : XR ^ (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ Xs ^ 2 :=
    (mul_le_of_le_one_left hd0 hc1).trans hd1
  have hcd0 : 0 ≤ XR ^ (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) := mul_nonneg hc0 hd0
  have hκSe : 5 / 12 * Pst ^ 2 * XR ^ (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) =
      5 / 12 * (Pst ^ 2 * (XR ^ (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ))) := by ring
  have hκS0 : 0 ≤ 5 / 12 * Pst ^ 2 * XR ^ (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) := by
    rw [hκSe]; positivity
  have hκS : 5 / 12 * Pst ^ 2 * XR ^ (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ Pst ^ 2 * Xs ^ 2 := by
    rw [hκSe]
    have h1 : Pst ^ 2 * (XR ^ (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ)) ≤ Pst ^ 2 * Xs ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcd (sq_nonneg Pst)
    have h2 : 0 ≤ Pst ^ 2 * (XR ^ (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ)) := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg Pst) hcd0
    linarith
  
  have hXsXR : Xs / XR ≤ t ^ 5 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hXRpos]
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hXRC (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ t ^ 5)
    have e : C * t ^ 5 = t ^ 5 * C := by ring
    linarith
  have hroot : (t ^ 5) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) = t := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul ht.le]; norm_num
  have hκC1 : (Xs / XR) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ t := by
    have := Real.rpow_le_rpow (div_nonneg hXs0.le hXRpos.le) hXsXR (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / 5)
    rwa [hroot] at this
  have hκC0 : 0 ≤ (Xs / XR) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg (div_nonneg hXs0.le hXRpos.le) _
  have hκC : 2 * (5 / 2 * Pst ^ 2 * (Xs / XR) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ)) ≤ ε := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hκC1 (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 5 * Pst ^ 2)
    have e : 2 * (5 / 2 * Pst ^ 2 * (Xs / XR) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ)) = 5 * Pst ^ 2 * (Xs / XR) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := by
      ring
    linarith
  
  have hBR : 2 * ε * Pst * (XR * Real.exp (-6)) * Real.sqrt (2 * (XR * Real.exp (-6))) *
      (XR * Real.exp (-6) / XR) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) ≤ ε * Pst / 2 * XR ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    have e1 : XR * Real.exp (-6) / XR = Real.exp (-6) := by field_simp
    rw [e1, hA]
    have r0 : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-6) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
    have r1 : Real.exp (-6) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one hq0.le (by linarith) (by norm_num)
    have hx6 : 2 * (XR * Real.exp (-6)) ≤ XR := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq hXRpos.le
      linarith
    have s1 : Real.sqrt (2 * (XR * Real.exp (-6))) ≤ Real.sqrt XR := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hx6
    have s0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * (XR * Real.exp (-6))) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have k0 : 0 ≤ 2 * ε * Pst * (XR * Real.exp (-6)) := by positivity
    have m1 : Real.sqrt (2 * (XR * Real.exp (-6))) * Real.exp (-6) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt XR :=
      (mul_le_of_le_one_right s0 r1).trans s1
    have step1 : 2 * ε * Pst * (XR * Real.exp (-6)) * Real.sqrt (2 * (XR * Real.exp (-6))) *
        Real.exp (-6) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ε * Pst * (XR * Real.exp (-6)) * Real.sqrt XR := by
      rw [mul_assoc (2 * ε * Pst * (XR * Real.exp (-6)))]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left m1 k0
    have k1 : 0 ≤ ε * Pst * XR * Real.sqrt XR := by positivity
    have m2 : (ε * Pst * XR * Real.sqrt XR) * Real.exp (-6) ≤ (ε * Pst * XR * Real.sqrt XR) * (1 / 64) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq k1
    have step2 : 2 * ε * Pst * (XR * Real.exp (-6)) * Real.sqrt XR ≤ ε * Pst / 2 * (XR * Real.sqrt XR) := by
      have e2 : 2 * ε * Pst * (XR * Real.exp (-6)) * Real.sqrt XR =
          2 * ((ε * Pst * XR * Real.sqrt XR) * Real.exp (-6)) := by ring
      have e3 : ε * Pst / 2 * (XR * Real.sqrt XR) = (ε * Pst * XR * Real.sqrt XR) / 2 := by ring
      rw [e2, e3]
      linarith
    linarith
  
  have j0 := eta_lincomb_jets (-1 / XR) 0 0 _ _ _ _ _ _ jM jM jM
  have j1 := eta_lincomb_jets (-1 / XR ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ))
    (5 / 8 * Real.sqrt 2 * Pst * XR ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (8 / 5 : ℝ) / XR ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) 0
    _ _ _ _ _ _ jI jf jf
  have j2 := eta_lincomb_jets (-1 / XR ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) (-1 / XR ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ))
    (4 * (5 / 8 * Real.sqrt 2 * Pst * XR ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (8 / 5 : ℝ)) / XR ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ))
    _ _ _ _ _ _ jJ jR jef
  have j3 := eta_lincomb_jets (-1 / XR) (1 / XR)
    (-(5 / 12 * Pst ^ 2 * XR ^ (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ)) / XR) _ _ _ _ _ _ jU jS jf2
  have j4 := eta_lincomb_jets (-1) (5 / 2 * Pst ^ 2 * (Xs / XR) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ)) 0 _ _ _ _ _ _ jC jf2 jf2
  have hK : 0 ≤ (2 + Pst) * ε := by positivity
  have hPε : 0 ≤ Pst * ε := by positivity
