    have hCle : ∀ i ≤ m, |Cf i| ≤ C := fun i hi =>
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cf i|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
    have hKle : ∀ i ≤ m, |Kf i| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Kf i| := fun i hi =>
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Kf i|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
    have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Kf i| :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by rw [hDdef]; linarith
    refine ⟨(m.factorial : ℝ) * C * D ^ m, fun η h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    have hη : η ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hΨ hγs (n := m) (by simp) hWo.uniqueDiffOn hO
      hmaps hη (C := C) (D := D)
      (fun i hi => (hCf i _ (hγK η h1 h2)).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans (hCle i hi)))
      (by
        intro i hi1 hi2
        have e := iteratedFDerivWithin_prodMk (f := d) (g := fun x : ℝ => x) (hd η hη)
          contDiffWithinAt_id hO hη (i := i) (by simp)
        rw [e, ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_prod,
          norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_norm_iteratedDerivWithin,
          norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_norm_iteratedDerivWithin]
        have e1 : iteratedDerivWithin i d (Ioo (-1) 1) η = iteratedDeriv i d η :=
          iteratedDerivWithin_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioo hη
        have e2 : iteratedDerivWithin i (fun x : ℝ => x) (Ioo (-1) 1) η =
            if i = 0 then η else if i = 1 then 1 else 0 :=
          iteratedDerivWithin_id hη hO
        rw [e1, e2]
        have hDi : D ≤ D ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
        refine max_le ?_ ?_
        · have := hKf i η h1 h2
          have := hKle i hi2
          have := le_abs_self (Kf i)
          rw [hDdef] at hDi ⊢
          linarith
        · rw [if_neg (by omega)]
          split_ifs
          · rw [norm_one]; linarith
          · rw [norm_zero]; linarith)
    rw [← iteratedDerivWithin_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioo hη,
      ← norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_norm_iteratedDerivWithin (𝕜 := ℝ)]
    exact key
  · intro η h1 h2
    have hA := (hdb η h1 h2).1
    have hB := (hdb η h1 h2).2
    have hv := hKconv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le (fun p hp => hdiffW p (hKW hp)) hM1
      (h0K η h1 h2) (hγK η h1 h2)
    have hΨ0 : Ψ ((0 : Fin 5 → ℝ), η) = 0 := hΦ0 η
    rw [hΨ0, sub_zero, hnorm] at hv
    have hgv := hKconv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le (fun p hp => hgdiff p (hKW hp)) hM2
      (h0K η h1 h2) (hγK η h1 h2)
    rw [hg0 η (by linarith) (by linarith), sub_zero, hnorm] at hgv
    have hdη : DifferentiableAt ℝ d η :=
      (hd.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds ⟨h1, h2⟩)
    have hγ' : HasDerivAt (fun e => (d e, e)) (deriv d η, (1 : ℝ)) η :=
      hdη.hasDerivAt.prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' η)
    have hc' := HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (f := fun e => (d e, e)) (l := Ψ) η
      (hdiffW _ (hKW (hγK η h1 h2))).hasFDerivAt hγ'
    have hderiv : deriv (fun e => Φ (d e) e) η = fderiv ℝ Ψ (d η, η) (deriv d η, (1 : ℝ)) :=
      hc'.deriv
    have hsplit : ((deriv d η, (1 : ℝ)) : (Fin 5 → ℝ) × ℝ) =
        (deriv d η, (0 : ℝ)) + ((0 : Fin 5 → ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) := by
      simp
    have hL : ‖fderiv ℝ Ψ (d η, η) (deriv d η, (0 : ℝ))‖ ≤ M1 * ‖deriv d η‖ := by
      refine ((fderiv ℝ Ψ (d η, η)).le_opNorm _).trans ?_
      rw [Prod.norm_mk, norm_zero, max_eq_left (norm_nonneg _)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hM1 _ (hγK η h1 h2)) (norm_nonneg _)
    have hgeq : fderiv ℝ Ψ (d η, η) ((0 : Fin 5 → ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) = g (d η, η) := rfl
    have hc2 : ‖deriv (fun e => Φ (d e) e) η‖ ≤ M1 * ‖deriv d η‖ + M2 * ‖d η‖ := by
      rw [hderiv, hsplit, map_add, hgeq]
      exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add hL hgv)
    have a1 : M1 * ‖d η‖ ≤ max M1 0 * θ0 :=
      mul_le_mul (le_max_left _ _) hA (norm_nonneg _) (le_max_right _ _)
    have a2 : M1 * ‖deriv d η‖ ≤ max M1 0 * θ0 :=
      mul_le_mul (le_max_left _ _) hB (norm_nonneg _) (le_max_right _ _)
    have a3 : M2 * ‖d η‖ ≤ max M2 0 * θ0 :=
      mul_le_mul (le_max_left _ _) hA (norm_nonneg _) (le_max_right _ _)
    have b1 : 0 ≤ max M1 0 * θ0 := mul_nonneg (le_max_right _ _) hθ0
    have b2 : 0 ≤ max M2 0 * θ0 := mul_nonneg (le_max_right _ _) hθ0
    have e : (max M1 0 + max M2 0 + 1) * θ0 = max M1 0 * θ0 + max M2 0 * θ0 + θ0 := by ring
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show ‖Ψ (d η, η)‖ ≤ _
      rw [e]; linarith
    · rw [e]; linarith

informal_problem.statement: AxStressLocal → ∀ (h Pst : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (ε Bd C T θ Kb Ks MP s1 s2 : ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ) (Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ : ℝ) (ℓ G : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), AxGlue h Pst Pax ε Bd C T θ Kb Ks MP s1 s2 β γ c Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ ℓ G F U → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ Xa → -1 < η → η < 1 → leadStressTh h (axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c) (axUm Pst C G U β c) X η = 0 ∧ axTz h Pax (axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c) (axUm Pst C G U β c) X η = 0) ∧ AxAdm h Pax (fun X => Real.exp (-(aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2))) (fun X => min 1 (Real.log (X / Xa))) (Ioc Xa Xa2) (axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c) (axUm Pst C G U β c) ∧ ∃ μ0 : ℝ, 0 < μ0 ∧ AxCone h μ0 Pax (Icc Xa1 110) (axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c) (axUm Pst C G U β c) ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → 2 + μ0 ≤ psLead1 h (axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c) (axUm Pst C G U β c) 110 η

signature.statement: AxStressLocal → ∀ (h Pst : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (ε Bd C T θ Kb Ks MP s1 s2 : ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ) (Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ : ℝ) (ℓ G : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), AxGlue h Pst Pax ε Bd C T θ Kb Ks MP s1 s2 β γ c Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ ℓ G F U → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ Xa → -1 < η → η < 1 → leadStressTh h (axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c) (axUm Pst C G U β c) X η = 0 ∧ axTz h Pax (axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c) (axUm Pst C G U β c) X η = 0) ∧ AxAdm h Pax (fun X => Real.exp (-(aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2))) (fun X => min 1 (Real.log (X / Xa))) (Ioc Xa Xa2) (axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c) (axUm Pst C G U β c) ∧ ∃ μ0 : ℝ, 0 < μ0 ∧ AxCone h μ0 Pax (Icc Xa1 110) (axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c) (axUm Pst C G U β c) ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → 2 + μ0 ≤ psLead1 h (axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c) (axUm Pst C G U β c) 110 η

proof.tactics:
by
  intro hLoc h Pst Pax ε Bd C T θ Kb Ks MP s1 s2 β γ c Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ ℓ G F U hG
  obtain ⟨hD, hIn, -, -, hBump, -, -, -, -, -, -, hKs, hT, -, -, hXR9, -⟩ := hG
  obtain ⟨⟨hXa, hXan, hXa1, hXa2, hXτ, hτ, -, hC1⟩, -, -, hExp, -, -, -, -,
    ⟨hz, hadm, μ, hμ, hcone⟩⟩ := hIn
  obtain ⟨hs1, -, -, -, -, hβz, hγz⟩ := hBump
  have hPst : 0 < Pst := hD.2.2.1
  have hCpos : 0 < C := by linarith
  have hXR : 0 < 110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10 := by positivity
  have hKs0 : 0 ≤ Ks := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hKs 0)
  have hT1 : 1 ≤ T := by
    have : 0 ≤ 40 * Ks * (|Bd| + 1) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hTpos : 0 < T := by linarith
  obtain ⟨X1, hX1⟩ : ∃ X1 : ℝ, X1 = 110 * Real.exp 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have he1 : (1:ℝ) < Real.exp 1 := by
    have := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (show (0:ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)
    rwa [Real.exp_zero] at this
  have heτ : Real.exp (-τ) < 1 := by
    have := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (show -τ < 0 by linarith)
    rwa [Real.exp_zero] at this
  have h110 : (110:ℝ) < X1 := by rw [hX1]; linarith
  have hτ110 : 110 * Real.exp (-τ) < 110 := by linarith
  have hXa2X1 : Xa2 < X1 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨Fi, hFi⟩ : ∃ f, f = axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Ui, hUi⟩ : ∃ f, f = axUm Pst C G U β c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hFi, ← hUi]
  
  have hagr : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → Fi X η = F X η ∧ Ui X η = U X η := by
    intro X η hX0 hXX1 hη1 hη2
    rw [hFi, hUi]
    by_cases hX : X ≤ 110
    · simp [axFm, axUm, hX]
    · have hX' : 110 < X := not_le.mp hX
      have hXR' : X < 110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10 * Real.exp (-9) := by
        have h1 : Real.exp 1 ≤ Real.exp (1 + T) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
        have h2 : X1 ≤ 110 * Real.exp (1 + T) := by rw [hX1]; linarith
        linarith
      have hxpos : 0 < X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) := div_pos hX0 hXR
      have hx9 : X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) < Real.exp (-9) := by
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ hXR]; linarith
      have hxs1 : X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) ≤ s1 := by
        have : Real.exp (-9) < Real.exp (-6) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by norm_num)
        linarith
      have hlogx : Real.log (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) + 8 ≤ 0 := by
        have : Real.log (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) < -9 := (Real.log_lt_iff_lt_exp hxpos).mpr hx9
        linarith
      have hσ1 : Real.smoothTransition (Real.log (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) + 8) = 0 :=
        Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos hlogx
      have hX110 : X / 110 < Real.exp 1 := by
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 110)]
        rw [hX1] at hXX1
        linarith
      have hlog110 : Real.log (X / 110) < 1 :=
        (Real.log_lt_iff_lt_exp (by positivity)).mpr hX110
      have hσ2 : Real.smoothTransition ((Real.log (X / 110) - 1) / T) = 0 :=
        Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
          (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) hTpos.le)
      have hlam : axLam T ℓ X η = ℓ η := by
        simp only [axLam, hσ2]; ring
      obtain ⟨hU, hF⟩ := hExp X η (by linarith) hη1 hη2
      have hb0 : β 0 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) = 0 := hβz 0 _ (Or.inl hxs1)
      have hb1 : β 1 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) = 0 := hβz 1 _ (Or.inl hxs1)
      have hg0 : γ 0 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) = 0 := hγz 0 _ (Or.inl hxs1)
      have hg1 : γ 1 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) = 0 := hγz 1 _ (Or.inl hxs1)
      have hg2 : γ 2 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) = 0 := hγz 2 _ (Or.inl hxs1)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [axFm, hX, if_false]
        rw [hlam, hg0, hg1, hg2, hF]
        simp only [mul_zero, add_zero]
        rw [div_div]
      · simp only [axUm, hX, if_false]
        rw [hσ1, hb0, hb1, hU]
        ring
  
  have hval : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      Fi X η = F X η ∧ shearA Fi X η = shearA F X η ∧ shearB Fi Ui X η = shearB F U X η ∧
      psLead1 h Fi Ui X η = psLead1 h F U X η ∧ axPs2 h Pax Fi Ui X η = axPs2 h Pax F U X η ∧
      leadStressTh h Fi Ui X η = leadStressTh h F U X η ∧
      axTz h Pax Fi Ui X η = axTz h Pax F U X η := by
    intro X η hX0 hXX1 hη1 hη2
    obtain ⟨hq, hn, ha, hb⟩ := hLoc.1 h X1 Pax F U Fi Ui hagr X η hX0 hXX1 hη1 hη2
    have hf := (hagr X η hX0 hXX1 hη1 hη2).1
    have hp2 : axPs2 h Pax Fi Ui X η = axPs2 h Pax F U X η := by
      simp only [axPs2, hn, hf]
    refine ⟨hf, ha, hb, ?_, hp2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [psLead1, hq]
    · simp only [leadStressTh, hf, hq, ha]
    · simp only [axTz, hf, hp2, hb]
  
  have hN : IsOpen (Ioo 0 X1 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have key : ∀ z ∈ Ioo 0 X1 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
      leadStressTh h Fi Ui z.1 z.2 = leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 ∧
      axTz h Pax Fi Ui z.1 z.2 = axTz h Pax F U z.1 z.2 := by
    rintro ⟨a, b⟩ ⟨⟨ha0, ha1⟩, ⟨hb1, hb2⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, e1, e2⟩ := hval a b ha0 ha1 hb1 hb2
    exact ⟨e1, e2⟩
  have hev : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → ∀ m : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTh h Fi Ui)) (X, η) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(leadStressTh h F U)) (X, η) ∧
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(axTz h Pax Fi Ui)) (X, η) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(axTz h Pax F U)) (X, η) ∧
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTh h Fi Ui z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h Fi Ui z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + axTz h Pax Fi Ui z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) (X, η) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + axTz h Pax F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) (X, η) ∧
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => axTz h Pax Fi Ui z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h Fi Ui z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + axTz h Pax Fi Ui z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) (X, η) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => axTz h Pax F U z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + axTz h Pax F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) (X, η) := by
    intro X η hX0 hXX1 hη1 hη2 m
    have hmem : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioo 0 X1 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨⟨hX0, hXX1⟩, ⟨hη1, hη2⟩⟩
    have hnh := hN.mem_nhds hmem
    have E1 : (↿(leadStressTh h Fi Ui)) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)] ↿(leadStressTh h F U) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hnh (fun z hz => (key z hz).1)
    have E2 : (↿(axTz h Pax Fi Ui)) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)] ↿(axTz h Pax F U) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hnh (fun z hz => (key z hz).2)
    have E3 : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTh h Fi Ui z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h Fi Ui z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + axTz h Pax Fi Ui z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)]
        (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + axTz h Pax F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hnh (fun z hz => by simp only [(key z hz).1, (key z hz).2])
    have E4 : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => axTz h Pax Fi Ui z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h Fi Ui z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + axTz h Pax Fi Ui z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)]
        (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => axTz h Pax F U z.1 z.2 /
          Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2 + axTz h Pax F U z.1 z.2 ^ 2)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hnh (fun z hz => by simp only [(key z hz).1, (key z hz).2])
    exact ⟨(E1.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, (E2.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds,
      (E3.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, (E4.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds⟩
  
  have hAdm : AxAdm h Pax (fun X => Real.exp (-(aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2)))
      (fun X => min 1 (Real.log (X / Xa))) (Ioc Xa Xa2) Fi Ui := by
    obtain ⟨⟨c₀, hc₀, H1⟩, H2, ⟨κ, hκ0, hκ2, H3⟩⟩ := hadm
    refine ⟨⟨c₀, hc₀, ?_⟩, ?_, ⟨κ, hκ0, hκ2, ?_⟩⟩
    · intro X hX η hη1 hη2
      obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, e1, e2⟩ :=
        hval X η (by linarith [hX.1]) (by linarith [hX.2]) hη1 hη2
      rw [e1, e2]
      exact H1 X hX η hη1 hη2
    · intro m
      obtain ⟨C', N', H⟩ := H2 m
      refine ⟨C', N', fun X hX η hη1 hη2 => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨e1, e2, e3, e4⟩ := hev X η (by linarith [hX.1]) (by linarith [hX.2]) hη1 hη2 m
      rw [e1, e2, e3, e4]
      exact H X hX η hη1 hη2
    · intro X hX η hη1 hη2
      obtain ⟨f, a, b, -, -, e1, e2⟩ :=
        hval X η (by linarith [hX.1]) (by linarith [hX.2]) hη1 hη2
      rw [f, a, b, e1, e2]
      exact H3 X hX η hη1 hη2
  refine ⟨?_, hAdm, μ, hμ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro X η hX0 hXa' hη1 hη2
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, e1, e2⟩ := hval X η hX0 (by linarith) hη1 hη2
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact hz X η hX0 hXa' hη1 hη2
  · intro X hX η hη1 hη2
    obtain ⟨f, a, b, p1, p2, -, -⟩ :=
      hval X η (by linarith [hX.1]) (by linarith [hX.2]) hη1 hη2
    rw [f, a, b, p1, p2]
    exact hcone X hX η hη1 hη2
  · intro η hη1 hη2
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, p1, -, -, -⟩ := hval 110 η (by norm_num) h110 hη1 hη2
    rw [p1]
    have hsh : shearB F U 110 η = 0 := by
      have hevU : (fun Y => U Y η) =ᶠ[nhds (110:ℝ)] (fun _ => G η) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hτ110)
          (fun Y hY => (hExp Y η (le_of_lt hY) hη1 hη2).1)
      simp only [shearB, hevU.deriv_eq, deriv_const, mul_zero, zero_div]
    have hc3 := (hcone 110 ⟨by linarith, le_rfl⟩ η hη1 hη2).2.2.1
    rw [hsh, zero_div, zero_mul, sub_zero] at hc3
    linarith

      have e : a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) = a + b ^ 2 / a := by
        field_simp <;> ring
      rw [e]
      have hb2 : b ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 100 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]; have := abs_nonneg b; nlinarith
      have : b ^ 2 / a ≤ 1 / 60 := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ ha]; linarith
      linarith
    linarith
  
  have barrier : ∀ (p S l : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → c ≤ 3 →
      (∀ X : ℝ, 110 ≤ X → X ≤ X5 → HasDerivAt p (S X - l X * p X / X) X) →
      (∀ X : ℝ, 110 ≤ X → X ≤ X5 → 1 / 2 ≤ S X ∧ l X ≤ 7 / 10) → c ≤ p 110 →
      ∀ X : ℝ, 110 ≤ X → X ≤ X5 → c + (X - 110) / 4 ≤ p X := by
    intro p S l c hc0 hc3 hp hSl hc X hX1 hX2
    have hfd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun Y => c + (Y - 110) / 4) (1 / 4) x := by
      intro x
      exact (((hasDerivAt_id' x).sub_const 110).div_const 4).const_add c
    refine image_le_of_deriv_right_lt_deriv_boundary' (f := fun Y => c + (Y - 110) / 4)
      (f' := fun _ => 1 / 4) (B := p) (B' := fun Y => S Y - l Y * p Y / Y) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      ⟨hX1, hX2⟩
    · exact (continuous_const.add ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).div_const 4)).continuousOn
    · intro x _; exact (hfd x).hasDerivWithinAt
    · show c + ((110:ℝ) - 110) / 4 ≤ p 110
      linarith
    · intro x hx; exact (hp x hx.1 hx.2).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · intro x hx; exact (hp x hx.1 hx.2.le).hasDerivWithinAt
    · intro x hx heq
      have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith [hx.1]
      have hpx : p x = c + (x - 110) / 4 := heq.symm
      obtain ⟨hS, hl⟩ := hSl x hx.1 hx.2.le
      have hpn : 0 ≤ p x := by rw [hpx]; linarith [hx.1]
      have h1 : l x * p x ≤ 7 / 10 * p x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hl hpn
      have h2 : l x * p x / x < 1 / 4 := by
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ hx0]; linarith [hx.1]
      show 1 / 4 < S x - l x * p x / x
      linarith
  
  have pderiv : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * leadQs h Fi Ui Y η)
        (axSq h Fi Ui X η - (1 + X * deriv (fun Y => Fi Y η) X / Fi X η) *
          (X * leadQs h Fi Ui X η) / X) X := by
    intro X η hX h1 h2
    have hZ := (hSrc h ε' Pax Fi Ui hh0 (by linarith) hε' hFs hUs hFp hPO X η hX h1 h2).1
    have hW : (X, η) ∈ Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨show -ε' < X by linarith, h1, h2⟩
    have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y => Fi Y η) X := by
      have hca : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (↿Fi) (X, η) :=
        hFs.contDiffAt ((isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo).mem_nhds hW)
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿Fi) (X, η) := hca.differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hpair : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y : ℝ => ((Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ)) X :=
        DifferentiableAt.prodMk differentiableAt_id (differentiableAt_const η)
      exact hd.comp X hpair
    have hF := hFd.hasDerivAt
    have hFX : 0 < Fi X η := hFp X η hX.le h1 h2
    have hX0 : X ≠ 0 := hX.ne'
    have hF0 : Fi X η ≠ 0 := hFX.ne'
    have hD : HasDerivAt (fun Y => 2 * Y * Fi Y η)
        (2 * Fi X η + 2 * X * deriv (fun Y => Fi Y η) X) X := by
      have := ((hasDerivAt_id' X).const_mul 2).mul hF
      convert this using 1; ring
    have hD0 : 2 * X * Fi X η ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hQ := hZ.div hD hD0
    have hev : (fun Y => Y * leadQs h Fi Ui Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X]
        (fun Y => Y * (2 * Y * Fi Y η) * leadQs h Fi Ui Y η / (2 * Y * Fi Y η)) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hX] with Y hY
      have hY0 : (0:ℝ) < Y := hY
      have hFY : 0 < Fi Y η := hFp Y η hY0.le h1 h2
      have hDY : 2 * Y * Fi Y η ≠ 0 := by positivity
      rw [mul_right_comm Y (2 * Y * Fi Y η), mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hDY]
    refine (hQ.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).congr_deriv ?_
    field_simp
  
  obtain ⟨μ, hμd⟩ : ∃ μ : ℝ, μ = min μ0 (min mF (1 / 2)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨μ1, hμ1d⟩ : ∃ μ1 : ℝ, μ1 = min μ0 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hμ : 0 < μ := by rw [hμd]; exact lt_min hμ0 (lt_min hmF (by norm_num))
  have hμa : μ ≤ μ0 := by rw [hμd]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hμb : μ ≤ mF := by rw [hμd]; exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hμc : μ ≤ 1 / 2 := by rw [hμd]; exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hμμ1 : μ ≤ μ1 := by rw [hμ1d]; exact le_min hμa (by linarith)
  have hμ10 : μ1 ≤ μ0 := by rw [hμ1d]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hμ11 : μ1 ≤ 1 := by rw [hμ1d]; exact min_le_right _ _
  refine ⟨μ, hμ, ?_⟩
  unfold AxCone
  intro X hX η h1 h2
  have hη2 : η ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
  have hη0 : 0 ≤ η ^ 2 := sq_nonneg η
  obtain ⟨L, hLd⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hL0 : 0 < L := by rw [hLd]; nlinarith
  have hL1 : L ≤ 1 := by rw [hLd]; nlinarith
  have hc110 : L * (2 + μ1) ≤ 110 * leadQs h Fi Ui 110 η := by
    have hps1 := hps η h1 h2
    unfold psLead1 at hps1
    rw [← hLd, le_div_iff₀ hL0] at hps1
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hμ10 hL0.le]
  have hp := barrier (fun Y => Y * leadQs h Fi Ui Y η) (fun Y => axSq h Fi Ui Y η)
    (fun Y => 1 + Y * deriv (fun Z => Fi Z η) Y / Fi Y η) (L * (2 + μ1))
    (mul_nonneg hL0.le (by linarith))
    (by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show 2 + μ1 ≤ 3 by linarith) hL0.le])
    (fun Y hY1 _ => pderiv Y η (by linarith) h1 h2)
    (fun Y hY1 hY2 => ⟨(hblk Y η hY1 hY2 h1 h2).2.2.2.1, (hblk Y η hY1 hY2 h1 h2).2.2.1⟩)
    hc110 X hX.1 hX.2
  have hP : 2 + μ1 + (X - 110) / 4 ≤ psLead1 h Fi Ui X η := by
    unfold psLead1
    rw [← hLd, le_div_iff₀ hL0]
    have hX110 : 0 ≤ X - 110 := by linarith [hX.1]
    have : (2 + μ1 + (X - 110) / 4) * L ≤ L * (2 + μ1) + (X - 110) / 4 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hX110 (sub_nonneg.mpr hL1)]
    exact this.trans hp
  obtain ⟨hF1, hl1, hl2, -, hb1, hb2⟩ := hblk X η hX.1 hX.2 h1 h2
  have hsA : shearA Fi X η = 2 - 2 * (1 + X * deriv (fun Y => Fi Y η) X / Fi X η) := by
    unfold shearA; ring
  have hsA1 : 3 / 5 ≤ shearA Fi X η := by rw [hsA]; linarith
  have hsA2 : shearA Fi X η ≤ 9 / 10 := by rw [hsA]; linarith
  exact arith μ μ1 mF X (Fi X η) (shearA Fi X η) (shearB Fi Ui X η) (psLead1 h Fi Ui X η)
    (axPs2 h Pax Fi Ui X η)
    (axPs2 h Pax Fi Ui X η + shearB Fi Ui X η / shearA Fi X η * psLead1 h Fi Ui X η)
    hμ hμμ1 hμb hμc hX.1 hP hF1 hsA1 hsA2 hb1 hb2

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (s B : ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ), 0 < s → 0 ≤ B → (∀ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (c n) (axRect s)) → (∀ n, ∀ w ∈ axRect s, ‖c n w‖ ≤ B * (1 / 10) ^ n) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∑' n : ℕ, c n (p.2 : ℂ) * (p.1 : ℂ) ^ n) (Ioo (-5) 5 ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - s / 2) (1 + s / 2))

signature.name: ax_series_contDiff
signature.statement: ∀ (s B : ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ), 0 < s → 0 ≤ B → (∀ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (c n) (axRect s)) → (∀ n, ∀ w ∈ axRect s, ‖c n w‖ ≤ B * (1 / 10) ^ n) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∑' n : ℕ, c n (p.2 : ℂ) * (p.1 : ℂ) ^ n) (Ioo (-5) 5 ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - s / 2) (1 + s / 2))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hopen : ∀ s : ℝ, IsOpen (axRect s) := by
    intro s
    exact (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
        (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const))
  
  have hcauchy : ∀ (s t K : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ), t < s → DifferentiableOn ℂ f (axRect s) →
      (∀ w ∈ axRect s, ‖f w‖ ≤ K) → ∀ w ∈ axRect t, ‖deriv f w‖ ≤ 2 * K / (s - t) := by
    intro s t K f hts hf hK w hw
    have hR : 0 < (s - t) / 2 := by linarith
    have hball : Metric.closedBall w ((s - t) / 2) ⊆ axRect s := by
      intro z hz
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hz
      have h1 := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (z - w)
      have h2 := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (z - w)
      rw [Complex.sub_im] at h1
      rw [Complex.sub_re] at h2
      simp only [axRect, mem_setOf_eq] at hw ⊢
      obtain ⟨hw1, hw2, hw3⟩ := hw
      have a1 := abs_le.mp (le_trans h1 hz)
      have a2 := abs_le.mp (le_trans h2 hz)
      have a3 := abs_lt.mp hw1
      refine ⟨abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hd : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball w ((s - t) / 2)) := by
      apply DifferentiableOn.diffContOnCl
      rw [closure_ball w hR.ne']
      exact hf.mono hball
    have hC := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hR hd
      (fun z hz => hK z (hball (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz)))
    calc ‖deriv f w‖ ≤ K / ((s - t) / 2) := hC
      _ = 2 * K / (s - t) := by rw [div_div_eq_mul_div, mul_comm]
  
  have hsumm : ∀ k : ℕ, Summable (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) := by
    intro k
    have h1 := summable_pow_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one (R := ℝ) k (r := (1 / 2 : ℝ))
      (by norm_num)
    have h2 := (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr h1
    refine (h2.mul_left 2).congr (fun n => ?_)
    push_cast
    ring
  
  have hfd : ∀ (s B D : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ), 0 < s → 0 ≤ B → 0 ≤ D →
      (∀ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (c n) (axRect s)) →
      (∀ n, ∀ w ∈ axRect s, ‖c n w‖ ≤ B * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * (1 / 10) ^ n) →
      (∀ n, ∀ w ∈ axRect s, ‖deriv (c n) w‖ ≤ D * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * (1 / 10) ^ n) →
      ∀ p ∈ Ioo (-5 : ℝ) 5 ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - s) (1 + s),
      HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∑' n : ℕ, c n (q.2 : ℂ) * (q.1 : ℂ) ^ n)
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).smulRight
            (∑' n : ℕ, ((n : ℂ) + 1) * c (n + 1) (p.2 : ℂ) * (p.1 : ℂ) ^ n) +
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).smulRight
            (∑' n : ℕ, deriv (c n) (p.2 : ℂ) * (p.1 : ℂ) ^ n)) p := by
    intro s B D k c hs hB hD hdiff hbd hdbd p hp
    have hUo : IsOpen (Ioo (-5 : ℝ) 5 ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - s) (1 + s)) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hUc : IsPreconnected (Ioo (-5 : ℝ) 5 ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - s) (1 + s)) :=
      ((convex_Ioo _ _).prod (convex_Ioo _ _)).isPreconnected
    have hmem : ∀ q ∈ Ioo (-5 : ℝ) 5 ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - s) (1 + s),
        ((q.2 : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ axRect s ∧ |q.1| < 5 := by
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩ := hq
      refine ⟨?_, abs_lt.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩⟩
      show |((q.2 : ℝ) : ℂ).im| < s ∧ -1 - s < ((q.2 : ℝ) : ℂ).re ∧ ((q.2 : ℝ) : ℂ).re < 1 + s
      rw [Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.ofReal_re, abs_zero]
      exact ⟨hs, h3, h4⟩
    
    have hgen : ∀ (E x y : ℝ) (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ E → 0 ≤ x →
        x ≤ E * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * (1 / 10) ^ n → 0 ≤ y → y ≤ 5 →
        x * y ^ n ≤ E * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (k + 1) * (1 / 2) ^ n := by
      intro E x y n hE hx0 hx hy0 hy5
      have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := n.cast_nonneg
      have h1 : x * y ^ n ≤ E * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * (1 / 10) ^ n * 5 ^ n :=
        mul_le_mul hx (pow_le_pow_left₀ hy0 hy5 n) (pow_nonneg hy0 n) (by positivity)
      have h2 : E * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * (1 / 10) ^ n * 5 ^ n =
          E * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * (1 / 2) ^ n := by
        rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_pow]; norm_num
      have h3 : ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (k + 1) :=
        pow_le_pow_right₀ (by linarith) (Nat.le_succ k)
      calc x * y ^ n ≤ _ := h1
        _ = _ := h2
        _ ≤ E * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (k + 1) * (1 / 2) ^ n := by gcongr
    have hgen2 : ∀ (E x y : ℝ) (m : ℕ), 0 ≤ E → 0 ≤ x →
        x ≤ E * (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * (1 / 10) ^ (m + 1) → 0 ≤ y → y ≤ 5 →
        ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * x * y ^ m ≤ E * (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) ^ (k + 1) * (1 / 2) ^ (m + 1) := by
      intro E x y m hE hx0 hx hy0 hy5
      push_cast at hx ⊢
      have hm : (0 : ℝ) ≤ m := m.cast_nonneg
      have hy : y ^ m ≤ 5 ^ m := pow_le_pow_left₀ hy0 hy5 m
      have e : (1 / 10 : ℝ) ^ m * 5 ^ m = (1 / 2) ^ m := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
      have hQ : 0 ≤ E * ((m : ℝ) + 1 + 1) ^ k * (1 / 2) ^ m := by positivity
      calc ((m : ℝ) + 1) * x * y ^ m
          ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (E * ((m : ℝ) + 1 + 1) ^ k * (1 / 10) ^ (m + 1)) * 5 ^ m := by
            gcongr
        _ = E * ((m : ℝ) + 1 + 1) ^ k * ((m : ℝ) + 1) * ((1 / 10) ^ m * 5 ^ m) / 10 := by ring
        _ = E * ((m : ℝ) + 1 + 1) ^ k * (1 / 2) ^ m * ((m : ℝ) + 1) / 10 := by rw [e]; ring
        _ ≤ E * ((m : ℝ) + 1 + 1) ^ k * (1 / 2) ^ m * (((m : ℝ) + 2) / 2) := by
            nlinarith [mul_nonneg hQ hm]
        _ = E * ((m : ℝ) + 1 + 1) ^ (k + 1) * (1 / 2) ^ (m + 1) := by ring
    
    let a : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun n q => (n : ℂ) * c n (q.2 : ℂ) * (q.1 : ℂ) ^ (n - 1)
    let b : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun n q => deriv (c n) (q.2 : ℂ) * (q.1 : ℂ) ^ n
    let L1 := ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) ℂ (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ)
    let L2 := ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) ℂ (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)
    let f' : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ → (ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ) := fun n q =>
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).smulRight (a n q) +
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).smulRight (b n q)
    have hterm : ∀ n, ∀ q ∈ Ioo (-5 : ℝ) 5 ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - s) (1 + s),
        HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => c n (q.2 : ℂ) * (q.1 : ℂ) ^ n) (f' n q) q := by
      intro n q hq
      have hcn : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => c n (y : ℂ)) (deriv (c n) (q.2 : ℂ)) q.2 :=
        (((hdiff n).differentiableAt ((hopen s).mem_nhds (hmem q hq).1)).hasDerivAt).comp_ofReal
      have hpw : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (y : ℂ) ^ n) ((n : ℂ) * ((q.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ (n - 1)) q.1 :=
        (hasDerivAt_pow n ((q.1 : ℝ) : ℂ)).comp_ofReal
      have h1 := hcn.hasFDerivAt.comp q hasFDerivAt_snd
      have h2 := hpw.hasFDerivAt.comp q hasFDerivAt_fst
      have h3 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => c n (q.2 : ℂ) * (q.1 : ℂ) ^ n) _ q := h1.mul h2
      refine h3.congr_fderiv ?_
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun v => ?_)
      simp only [f', a, b, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', Function.comp_apply,
        smul_eq_mul, Complex.real_smul]
      ring
    have hab : ∀ n, ∀ q ∈ Ioo (-5 : ℝ) 5 ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - s) (1 + s),
        ‖a n q‖ ≤ B * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (k + 1) * (1 / 2) ^ n ∧
        ‖b n q‖ ≤ D * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (k + 1) * (1 / 2) ^ n := by
      intro n q hq
      obtain ⟨hq1, hq2⟩ := hmem q hq
      have hy0 : 0 ≤ ‖((q.1 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have hy5 : ‖((q.1 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤ 5 := by
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hq2.le
      constructor
      · cases n with
        | zero =>
          simp only [a, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, norm_zero]
          positivity
        | succ m =>
          show ‖((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * c (m + 1) (q.2 : ℂ) * ((q.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ (m + 1 - 1)‖ ≤ _
          rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_natCast]
          exact hgen2 B _ _ m hB (norm_nonneg _) (hbd (m + 1) _ hq1) hy0 hy5
      · show ‖deriv (c n) (q.2 : ℂ) * ((q.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ n‖ ≤ _
        rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
        exact hgen D _ _ n hD (norm_nonneg _) (hdbd n _ hq1) hy0 hy5
    have hfb : ∀ n, ∀ q ∈ Ioo (-5 : ℝ) 5 ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - s) (1 + s),
        ‖f' n q‖ ≤ (B + D) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (k + 1) * (1 / 2) ^ n := by
      intro n q hq
      obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := hab n q hq
      calc ‖f' n q‖ ≤ ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).smulRight (a n q)‖ +
            ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).smulRight (b n q)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = ‖a n q‖ + ‖b n q‖ := by
          rw [ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply,
            ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.norm_fst,
            ContinuousLinearMap.norm_snd, one_mul, one_mul]
        _ ≤ (B + D) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (k + 1) * (1 / 2) ^ n := by linarith
    have hmaj : ∀ E : ℝ, Summable (fun n : ℕ => E * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (k + 1) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) :=
      fun E => ((hsumm (k + 1)).mul_left E).congr (fun n => (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm)
    have hsp : Summable (fun n : ℕ => c n (p.2 : ℂ) * (p.1 : ℂ) ^ n) := by
      refine Summable.of_norm_bounded (hmaj B) (fun n => ?_)
      obtain ⟨hq1, hq2⟩ := hmem p hp
      rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
      refine hgen B _ _ n hB (norm_nonneg _) (hbd n _ hq1) (norm_nonneg _) ?_
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hq2.le
    have hmain := hasFDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected
      (f := fun n q => c n (q.2 : ℂ) * (q.1 : ℂ) ^ n) (f' := f') (hmaj (B + D)) hUo hUc hterm hfb hp
      hsp hp
    refine hmain.congr_fderiv ?_
    have hsa : Summable (fun n => a n p) :=

    ⟨by rw [em1, e4]; linarith, by rw [e4, e5]; linarith⟩
  have hφda : HasDerivAt (fun Y => Fn Y η) (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) (4 / Λ)) (4 / Λ) :=

def AxHJetK (Xan ρ : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (Φ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (C : ℝ),
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Φ p.1 p.2) (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ axRect ρ) ∧
    ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xan →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Φ X) (axRect ρ) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ axRect ρ, ‖Φ X w‖ ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → Φ X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => φ Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ))

def AxHJet (Xan ρ : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => φ Y η) (Ioo (-ε) (Xan + ε))) ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, AxHJetK Xan ρ φ k

proof.tactics:
by
  intro hSm h Pst Pax hD j0 σ δ ρ Pc hj0 hj0' hAD Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 om Kder M Fn Un hΛ hK hρ1 ht1 ht1'
    hκ0 hκ0' hom hom' hA hR
  
  
  
  have halg : ∀ (Cc f a sb e Fv d1 d2 : ℝ), 1 ≤ Cc → 1 / Cc ≤ f → f ≤ Cc → 1 / Cc ≤ a → a ≤ Cc →
      |sb| ≤ Cc → 21 / 10 < a + sb ^ 2 / a → 0 ≤ e → e ≤ 1 / (2000 * Cc ^ 10) →
      |Fv - f| ≤ 1 / (2000 * Cc ^ 10) → |d1| ≤ 1 / (2000 * Cc ^ 10) → |d2| ≤ 1 / (2000 * Cc ^ 10) →
      0 < 1 / (20 * Cc ^ 3) ∧ 1 / (20 * Cc ^ 3) ≤ 1 ∧ 1 / (20 * Cc ^ 3) ≤ Fv ∧
      1 / (20 * Cc ^ 3) ≤ (1 - e) * a ∧
      2 + 1 / (20 * Cc ^ 3) ≤ (1 - e) * a * (1 + ((1 - e) * sb * f / Fv / ((1 - e) * a)) ^ 2) ∧
      (1 - e) * a * (1 + ((1 - e) * sb * f / Fv / ((1 - e) * a)) ^ 2) ≤ 1 / (1 / (20 * Cc ^ 3)) ∧
      |(1 - e) * sb * f / Fv / ((1 - e) * a)| ≤ 1 / (1 / (20 * Cc ^ 3)) ∧
      1 / (20 * Cc ^ 3) ≤ Fv * (a + d1) - (1 - e) * sb * f / Fv / ((1 - e) * a) * (d2 - f * sb) ∧
      |d2 - f * sb + (1 - e) * sb * f / Fv / ((1 - e) * a) * (Fv * (a + d1))| ≤ (1 / (20 * Cc ^ 3)) ^ 2 ∧
      Real.sqrt ((Fv * (a + d1)) ^ 2 + (d2 - f * sb) ^ 2) ≤ 1 / (1 / (20 * Cc ^ 3)) := by
    intro Cc f a sb e Fv d1 d2 hC hf1 hf2 ha1 ha2 hsb hv he0 he1 hFv hd1 hd2
    have hC0 : 0 < Cc := by linarith
    rw [one_div_one_div]
    obtain ⟨dl, hdl⟩ : ∃ dl : ℝ, dl = 1 / (2000 * Cc ^ 10) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hdl] at he1 hFv hd1 hd2
    obtain ⟨c, hcdef⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = 1 / (20 * Cc ^ 3) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hcdef]
    have hdl0 : 0 < dl := by rw [hdl]; positivity
    have hdl10 : dl * Cc ^ 10 = 1 / 2000 := by rw [hdl]; field_simp
    have hpow : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 10 → dl * Cc ^ k ≤ 1 / 2000 := by
      intro k hk
      have h1 : Cc ^ k ≤ Cc ^ 10 := pow_le_pow_right₀ hC hk
      have h2 : dl * Cc ^ k ≤ dl * Cc ^ 10 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hdl0.le
      linarith only [h2, hdl10]
    have hk0 := hpow 0 (by norm_num)
    have hk1 := hpow 1 (by norm_num)
    have hk2 := hpow 2 (by norm_num)
    have hk3 := hpow 3 (by norm_num)
    have hk4 := hpow 4 (by norm_num)
    have hk6 := hpow 6 (by norm_num)
    have hk9 := hpow 9 (by norm_num)
    rw [pow_zero, mul_one] at hk0
    rw [pow_one] at hk1
    have hc : c * (20 * Cc ^ 3) = 1 := by rw [hcdef]; field_simp
    have hc0 : 0 < c := by rw [hcdef]; positivity
    have hC2 : 1 ≤ Cc ^ 2 := one_le_pow₀ hC
    have hC23 : Cc ^ 2 ≤ Cc ^ 3 := pow_le_pow_right₀ hC (by norm_num)
    have hC13 : Cc ≤ Cc ^ 3 := by
      have := pow_le_pow_right₀ hC (show 1 ≤ 3 by norm_num); rwa [pow_one] at this
    have hC3' : 1 ≤ Cc ^ 3 := by linarith only [hC2, hC23]
    have hc20 : c ≤ 1 / 20 := by
      have h1 : c * 20 ≤ c * (20 * Cc ^ 3) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith only [hC3']) hc0.le
      linarith only [h1, hc]
    have hcC : c * Cc ≤ 1 / 20 := by
      have h1 : c * (20 * Cc) ≤ c * (20 * Cc ^ 3) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith only [hC13]) hc0.le
      linarith only [h1, hc]
    have hCa : 1 ≤ a * Cc := (div_le_iff₀ hC0).mp ha1
    have hCf : 1 ≤ f * Cc := (div_le_iff₀ hC0).mp hf1
    have ha0 : 0 < a := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) ha1
    have hf0 : 0 < f := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hf1
    obtain ⟨hFvl, hFvu⟩ := abs_le.mp hFv
    have hFvC : 1 ≤ 2 * Cc * Fv := by
      have h1 : Cc * (f - dl) ≤ Cc * Fv :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith only [hFvl]) hC0.le
      linarith only [h1, hCf, hk1]
    have hFv0 : 0 < Fv := by
      have h1 : (2 * Cc) * 0 < (2 * Cc) * Fv := by rw [mul_zero]; linarith only [hFvC]
      exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left h1 (by linarith only [hC0])
    have hFv2 : Fv ≤ 2 * Cc := by linarith only [hFvu, hf2, hk0, hC]
    have he2 : e ≤ 1 / 2000 := by linarith only [he1, hk0]
    have h1e : 0 < 1 - e := by linarith only [he2]
    have hr : (1 - e) * sb * f / Fv / ((1 - e) * a) = sb * (f / Fv) * (1 / a) := by
      field_simp
    rw [hr]
    obtain ⟨ρ', hρdef⟩ : ∃ ρ' : ℝ, ρ' = f / Fv := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨ia, hiadef⟩ : ∃ ia : ℝ, ia = 1 / a := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hρdef, ← hiadef]
    have hia0 : 0 < ia := by rw [hiadef]; positivity
    have hiaC : ia ≤ Cc := by rw [hiadef, div_le_iff₀ ha0]; linarith only [hCa]
    have haia : a * ia = 1 := by rw [hiadef]; field_simp
    have hρFv : ρ' * Fv = f := by rw [hρdef]; field_simp
    have hρ1 : |ρ' - 1| ≤ 2 * Cc * dl := by
      rw [show ρ' - 1 = (f - Fv) / Fv by rw [hρdef]; field_simp, abs_div, abs_of_pos hFv0,
        div_le_iff₀ hFv0]
      have h1 := abs_sub_comm f Fv
      have h2 : dl * 1 ≤ dl * (2 * Cc * Fv) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hFvC hdl0.le
      linarith only [h1, h2, hFv]
    obtain ⟨hρl, hρu⟩ := abs_le.mp hρ1
    have hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ' := by linarith only [hρl, hk1]
    have hρ2 : ρ' ≤ 2 := by linarith only [hρu, hk1]
    have hsb2 : sb ^ 2 ≤ Cc ^ 2 := by
      have h1 := sq_abs sb
      have h3 : |sb| ^ 2 ≤ Cc ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg sb) hsb 2
      linarith only [h1, h3]
    obtain ⟨w, hwdef⟩ : ∃ w : ℝ, w = sb ^ 2 * ia := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hw0 : 0 ≤ w := by rw [hwdef]; exact mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hia0.le
    have hwC : w ≤ Cc ^ 3 := by
      have h1 : sb ^ 2 * ia ≤ Cc ^ 2 * Cc := mul_le_mul hsb2 hiaC hia0.le (sq_nonneg _)
      have h2 : Cc ^ 2 * Cc = Cc ^ 3 := by ring
      rw [hwdef]; linarith only [h1, h2]
    have hvw : 21 / 10 < a + w := by
      rw [hwdef, hiadef, mul_one_div]; exact hv
    have hr_abs : |sb * ρ' * ia| ≤ 2 * Cc ^ 2 := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hρ0, abs_of_pos hia0]
      have h1 : |sb| * ρ' * ia ≤ Cc * 2 * Cc :=
        mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hsb hρ2 hρ0 hC0.le) hiaC hia0.le (by linarith only [hC0])
      have h2 : Cc * 2 * Cc = 2 * Cc ^ 2 := by ring
      linarith only [h1, h2]
    have hv_eq : (1 - e) * a * (1 + (sb * ρ' * ia) ^ 2) = (1 - e) * (a + w * ρ' ^ 2) := by
      rw [hwdef]
      linear_combination (1 - e) * sb ^ 2 * ρ' ^ 2 * ia * haia
    have hρsq : 1 - 4 * Cc * dl ≤ ρ' ^ 2 := by
      have hq0 : 0 ≤ 1 - 2 * Cc * dl := by linarith only [hk1]
      have h1 : (1 - 2 * Cc * dl) ^ 2 ≤ ρ' ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hq0 (by linarith only [hρl]) 2
      nlinarith only [h1, sq_nonneg (Cc * dl)]
    have hρ4 : ρ' ^ 2 ≤ 4 := by
      have h1 : ρ' ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hρ0 hρ2 2
      linarith only [h1]
    have hupp : a + w * ρ' ^ 2 ≤ 5 * Cc ^ 3 := by
      have h1 : w * ρ' ^ 2 ≤ Cc ^ 3 * 4 :=
        mul_le_mul hwC hρ4 (sq_nonneg ρ') (by linarith only [hC3'])
      linarith only [h1, ha2, hC13]
    have hlow : a + w - 4 * Cc ^ 4 * dl ≤ a + w * ρ' ^ 2 := by
      have h1 : w * (1 - 4 * Cc * dl) ≤ w * ρ' ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hρsq hw0
      have h2 : w * (Cc * dl) ≤ Cc ^ 3 * (Cc * dl) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hwC (mul_nonneg hC0.le hdl0.le)
      have h3 : Cc ^ 3 * (Cc * dl) = Cc ^ 4 * dl := by ring
      linarith only [h1, h2, h3]
    have hpos_v : 0 ≤ a + w * ρ' ^ 2 := by
      have := mul_nonneg hw0 (sq_nonneg ρ'); linarith only [this, ha0]
    refine ⟨hc0, by linarith only [hc20], ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : c * 1 ≤ c * (2 * Cc * Fv) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hFvC hc0.le
      have h2 : c * Cc * Fv ≤ 1 / 20 * Fv := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcC hFv0.le
      linarith only [h1, h2, hFv0]
    · have h1 : c * 1 ≤ c * (a * Cc) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hCa hc0.le
      have h2 : c * Cc * a ≤ 1 / 20 * a := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcC ha0.le
      have h3 : e * a ≤ 1 / 2000 * a := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he2 ha0.le
      linarith only [h1, h2, h3, ha0]
    · rw [hv_eq]
      have h1 : e * (a + w * ρ' ^ 2) ≤ dl * (5 * Cc ^ 3) := mul_le_mul he1 hupp hpos_v hdl0.le
      have h4 : dl * Cc ^ 4 ≤ 1 / 2000 := hk4
      linarith only [h1, hlow, hvw, hk3, h4, hc20]
    · rw [hv_eq]
      have h1 := mul_nonneg he0 hpos_v
      linarith only [h1, hupp, hC3']
    · linarith only [hr_abs, hC23, hC3']
    · have hid : Fv * (a + d1) - sb * ρ' * ia * (d2 - f * sb) =
          Fv * a + Fv * d1 - sb * ρ' * ia * d2 + w * f * ρ' := by rw [hwdef]; ring
      rw [hid]
      have p1 : f * a - dl * Cc ≤ Fv * a := by
        have h1 := mul_nonneg (by linarith only [hFvl] : 0 ≤ Fv - f + dl) ha0.le
        have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha2 hdl0.le
        linarith only [h1, h2]
      have p2 : -(2 * Cc * dl) ≤ Fv * d1 := by
        have h1 : |Fv * d1| ≤ 2 * Cc * dl := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hFv0]
          exact mul_le_mul hFv2 hd1 (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith only [hC0])
        linarith only [h1, neg_abs_le (Fv * d1)]
      have p3 : sb * ρ' * ia * d2 ≤ 2 * Cc ^ 2 * dl := by
        have h1 : |sb * ρ' * ia * d2| ≤ 2 * Cc ^ 2 * dl := by
          rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hr_abs hd2 (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith only [hC2])
        linarith only [h1, le_abs_self (sb * ρ' * ia * d2)]
      have hwf0 : 0 ≤ w * f := mul_nonneg hw0 hf0.le
      have hwf : w * f ≤ Cc ^ 3 * Cc := mul_le_mul hwC hf2 hf0.le (by linarith only [hC3'])
      have p4 : w * f - 2 * (Cc ^ 5 * dl) ≤ w * f * ρ' := by
        have h1 : w * f * (1 - 2 * Cc * dl) ≤ w * f * ρ' :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith only [hρl]) hwf0
        have h2 : w * f * (Cc * dl) ≤ Cc ^ 3 * Cc * (Cc * dl) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hwf (mul_nonneg hC0.le hdl0.le)
        have h3 : Cc ^ 3 * Cc * (Cc * dl) = Cc ^ 5 * dl := by ring
        linarith only [h1, h2, h3]
      have hfv : f * (21 / 10) ≤ f * (a + w) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hvw.le hf0.le
      have hS : f * (21 / 10) - dl * (3 * Cc + 2 * Cc ^ 2 + 2 * Cc ^ 5) ≤
          Fv * a + Fv * d1 - sb * ρ' * ia * d2 + w * f * ρ' := by
        linarith only [p1, p2, p3, p4, hfv]
      have hCS := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS hC0.le
      have hk2' : dl * Cc ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 2000 := hk2
      have hk3' : dl * Cc ^ 3 ≤ 1 / 2000 := hk3
      have hk6' : dl * Cc ^ 6 ≤ 1 / 2000 := hk6
      have hexp : Cc * (f * (21 / 10) - dl * (3 * Cc + 2 * Cc ^ 2 + 2 * Cc ^ 5)) =
          21 / 10 * (f * Cc) - (3 * (dl * Cc ^ 2) + 2 * (dl * Cc ^ 3) + 2 * (dl * Cc ^ 6)) := by
        ring
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      have h5 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hcon hC0
      linarith only [h5, hCS, hexp, hCf, hk2', hk3', hk6', hcC]
    · have hid : d2 - f * sb + sb * ρ' * ia * (Fv * (a + d1)) = d2 + sb * f * d1 * ia := by
        linear_combination (sb * ia * (a + d1)) * hρFv + (sb * f) * haia
      rw [hid]
      have hb : |d2 + sb * f * d1 * ia| ≤ dl + Cc * Cc * dl * Cc := by
        calc |d2 + sb * f * d1 * ia| ≤ |d2| + |sb * f * d1 * ia| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = |d2| + |sb| * f * |d1| * ia := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hf0, abs_of_pos hia0]
          _ ≤ dl + Cc * Cc * dl * Cc := by
              have h1 : |sb| * f ≤ Cc * Cc := mul_le_mul hsb hf2 hf0.le hC0.le
              have h2 : |sb| * f * |d1| ≤ Cc * Cc * dl :=
                mul_le_mul h1 hd1 (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hC0.le hC0.le)
              have h3 : |sb| * f * |d1| * ia ≤ Cc * Cc * dl * Cc :=
                mul_le_mul h2 hiaC hia0.le (by positivity)
              linarith only [h3, hd2]
      have hc2 : c ^ 2 * (400 * Cc ^ 6) = 1 := by
        have : c ^ 2 * (400 * Cc ^ 6) = (c * (20 * Cc ^ 3)) ^ 2 := by ring
        rw [this, hc]; norm_num
      have hB : dl + Cc * Cc * dl * Cc ≤ c ^ 2 := by
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hcon (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 400 * Cc ^ 6)
        have hexp : (dl + Cc * Cc * dl * Cc) * (400 * Cc ^ 6) =
            400 * (dl * Cc ^ 6) + 400 * (dl * Cc ^ 9) := by ring
        have hk6' : dl * Cc ^ 6 ≤ 1 / 2000 := hk6
        have hk9' : dl * Cc ^ 9 ≤ 1 / 2000 := hk9
        linarith only [h1, hexp, hc2, hk6', hk9']
      linarith only [hb, hB]
    · have hBt : |Fv * (a + d1)| ≤ 4 * Cc ^ 2 := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hFv0]
        have h1 : |a + d1| ≤ 2 * Cc := by
          have := abs_add_le a d1
          rw [abs_of_pos ha0] at this
          linarith only [this, ha2, hd1, hk0, hC]
        have h2 : Fv * |a + d1| ≤ 2 * Cc * (2 * Cc) :=
          mul_le_mul hFv2 h1 (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith only [hC0])
        have h3 : 2 * Cc * (2 * Cc) = 4 * Cc ^ 2 := by ring
        linarith only [h2, h3]
      have hBz : |d2 - f * sb| ≤ 2 * Cc ^ 2 := by
        have h1 := abs_sub d2 (f * sb)
        have h2 : |f * sb| ≤ Cc * Cc := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hf0]; exact mul_le_mul hf2 hsb (abs_nonneg _) hC0.le
        have h3 : Cc * Cc = Cc ^ 2 := by ring
        linarith only [h1, h2, h3, hd2, hk0, hC2]
      have hsum : (Fv * (a + d1)) ^ 2 + (d2 - f * sb) ^ 2 ≤
          (|Fv * (a + d1)| + |d2 - f * sb|) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith only [mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg (Fv * (a + d1))) (abs_nonneg (d2 - f * sb)),
          sq_abs (Fv * (a + d1)), sq_abs (d2 - f * sb)]
      calc Real.sqrt ((Fv * (a + d1)) ^ 2 + (d2 - f * sb) ^ 2)
          ≤ Real.sqrt ((|Fv * (a + d1)| + |d2 - f * sb|) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsum
        _ = |Fv * (a + d1)| + |d2 - f * sb| :=
            Real.sqrt_sq (add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _))
        _ ≤ 20 * Cc ^ 3 := by linarith only [hBt, hBz, hC23, hC3']
  
  
  
  have hsig : ∀ u dl : ℝ, 0 < u → u < 1 / 2 → dl ≤ 1 → u ≤ dl / 8 → 0 ≤ sigA u ∧ sigA u ≤ dl := by
    intro u dl hu0 hu1 hdl1 hu
    have hdl0 : 0 < dl := by linarith
    have hn1 : ¬ u ≤ 0 := by linarith
    have hn2 : ¬ 1 ≤ u := by linarith
    unfold sigA
    rw [if_neg hn1, if_neg hn2]
    set A := Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) with hA
    set B := Real.exp (-1 / (1 - u) ^ 2) with hB
    have hA0 : 0 < A := Real.exp_pos _
    have hB0 : 0 < B := Real.exp_pos _
    refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
    have h1 : A / (A + B) ≤ A / B := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hA0.le hB0 (by linarith)
    have hB4 : Real.exp (-4) ≤ B := by
      rw [hB]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      rw [neg_div, neg_le_neg_iff, div_le_iff₀ (by nlinarith)]
      nlinarith
    have hE4 : Real.exp 4 * Real.exp (-4) = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
    have hAu : A ≤ u ^ 2 := by
      have hs : (1 / u ^ 2) * u ^ 2 = 1 := by field_simp
      have hE := Real.add_one_le_exp (1 / u ^ 2)
      have hAE : A * Real.exp (1 / u ^ 2) = 1 := by
        rw [hA, ← Real.exp_add]
        have : -1 / u ^ 2 + 1 / u ^ 2 = 0 := by ring
        rw [this, Real.exp_zero]
      have hs0 : 0 ≤ 1 / u ^ 2 := by positivity
      calc A = A * ((1 / u ^ 2) * u ^ 2) := by rw [hs, mul_one]
        _ = (A * (1 / u ^ 2)) * u ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ (A * Real.exp (1 / u ^ 2)) * u ^ 2 := by
            gcongr
            linarith

by
  intro c U B Λ hU hΛ hc hcb k
  have hsum0 : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ k * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) :=
    summable_pow_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one k (by norm_num)

    hsum0.mul_left |B|

by
  intro a B Λ p0 hΛ ha

        _ = B ^ 2 * (1 / 10) ^ m := by rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hkm]

        ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |a k * a (m - k)| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), B ^ 2 * (1 / 10) ^ m := Finset.sum_le_sum hterm

      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), a i * a (m + 1 - 1 - i)) / (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Λ)) =
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), a k * a (m - k)) / (((m : ℝ) + 1) * Λ) := by
    intro m

    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    push_cast
    rfl

  · 
    intro n
    rcases n with _ | m

      linarith [abs_nonneg p0]
    · rw [hP m]
      have hpos : 0 < ((m : ℝ) + 1) * Λ := by positivity

            (10 * B ^ 2 / Λ) * (1 / 10) ^ (m + 1) * (((m : ℝ) + 1) * Λ) := by ring

      linarith [hconv m]

    intro Y hY

      ⟨_, rfl⟩

      intro x hx

        · rw [abs_of_nonpos h2, abs_of_nonpos (h1.trans h2)]; linarith

      calc Λ * |x| ≤ Λ * |Y| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxY hΛ.le

      have hfs : Summable (fun n => ‖f n‖) :=
        Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => norm_nonneg _) hfb
          ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).mul_left B)

    have hint : HasSum (fun m : ℕ => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Y, c m * (Λ * x) ^ m)

        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx => hcauchy _ (hx5 x (Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hx))))
    have hterm : ∀ m : ℕ, ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Y, c m * (Λ * x) ^ m =

        funext x; rw [mul_pow]; ring
      rw [e, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_pow, zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero m),
        sub_zero]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hS2 : HasSum (fun m : ℕ => (if m + 1 = 0 then p0 else
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), a i * a (m + 1 - 1 - i)) / (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Λ)) *
          (Λ * Y) ^ (m + 1)) (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Y, (∑' n : ℕ, a n * (Λ * x) ^ n) ^ 2) := by
      have hfe : (fun m : ℕ => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Y, c m * (Λ * x) ^ m) =
          (fun m : ℕ => (if m + 1 = 0 then p0 else
            (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), a i * a (m + 1 - 1 - i)) / (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Λ)) *

      rw [show (-1 - (i:ℤ)) = -((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast,
        inv_pow]
    rw [e, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow, one_mul,
      Real.norm_natCast, norm_pow, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hy0.le)]
    have h1 : (f x)⁻¹ ≤ 1 + 1 / c := by
      have := inv_anti₀ hc hcf
      rw [one_div]
      have : 0 ≤ (1:ℝ) := zero_le_one
      linarith
    have h2 : (f x)⁻¹ ^ (i + 1) ≤ (1 + 1 / c) ^ (m + 1) :=
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ (inv_nonneg.2 hy0.le) h1 _).trans (pow_le_pow_right₀ hK1 (by omega))
    have h3 : (i.factorial : ℝ) ≤ m.factorial := Nat.cast_le.2 (Nat.factorial_le hi)
    exact mul_le_mul h3 h2 (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hfD : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i f (U ∩ f ⁻¹' ({0}ᶜ : Set ℝ)) x‖ ≤
      (1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Mb j|) ^ i := by
    intro i hi1 hi
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hSo hxS]
    have a1 := hMb i hi
    have a2 : |Mb i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Mb j| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Mb j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
    have a3 : (1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Mb j|) ≤
        (1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Mb j|) ^ i := by
      calc (1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Mb j|)
          = (1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Mb j|) ^ 1 := (pow_one _).symm
        _ ≤ _ := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by linarith) hi1
    linarith [le_abs_self (Mb i)]
  have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le (contDiffOn_inv ℝ) (hf.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
    (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hT.uniqueDiffOn hSo.uniqueDiffOn (fun q hq => hq.2) hxS hgC hfD
  rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hSo hxS] at key
  exact key

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (s Λ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < Λ → ∃ K : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ m, 0 ≤ K m) ∧ ∀ (B : ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ), 0 ≤ B → (∀ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (c n) (axRect s)) → (∀ n, ∀ w ∈ axRect s, ‖c n w‖ ≤ B * (1 / 10) ^ n) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (∑' n : ℕ, c n (z.2 : ℂ) * ((Λ * z.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ n).re) ({X : ℝ | |Λ * X| < 5} ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - s / 2) (1 + s / 2)) ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (z : ℝ × ℝ), z ∈ {X : ℝ | |Λ * X| < 5} ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - s / 2) (1 + s / 2) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (∑' n : ℕ, c n (z.2 : ℂ) * ((Λ * z.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ n).re) z‖ ≤ K m * B

signature.statement: ∀ (s Λ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < Λ → ∃ K : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ m, 0 ≤ K m) ∧ ∀ (B : ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ), 0 ≤ B → (∀ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (c n) (axRect s)) → (∀ n, ∀ w ∈ axRect s, ‖c n w‖ ≤ B * (1 / 10) ^ n) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (∑' n : ℕ, c n (z.2 : ℂ) * ((Λ * z.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ n).re) ({X : ℝ | |Λ * X| < 5} ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - s / 2) (1 + s / 2)) ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (z : ℝ × ℝ), z ∈ {X : ℝ | |Λ * X| < 5} ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - s / 2) (1 + s / 2) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (∑' n : ℕ, c n (z.2 : ℂ) * ((Λ * z.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ n).re) z‖ ≤ K m * B

proof.tactics:
by
  have hle : ∀ i : ℕ, ((i : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := fun i => by exact_mod_cast le_top
  
  have t_s4 : ∀ (G F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (H L : ℕ → ℝ) (R θ : ℝ), 0 ≤ R → 0 ≤ θ → R * θ < 1 →
      (∀ k, 0 ≤ H k) → (∀ k, 0 ≤ L k) → (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (G n)) → (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F n)) →
      (∀ (n k : ℕ) (X : ℝ), |iteratedDeriv k (G n) X| ≤ H k * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * R ^ n) →
      (∀ (n k : ℕ) (η : ℝ), |iteratedDeriv k (F n) η| ≤ L k * θ ^ n) →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => ∑' n : ℕ, G n z.1 * F n z.2) ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (z : ℝ × ℝ),
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => ∑' n : ℕ, G n z.1 * F n z.2) z‖ ≤
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) * H i * L (m - i)) *
            ∑' n : ℕ, ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ m * (R * θ) ^ n := by
    intro G F H L R θ hR hθ hRθ hH hL hG hF hGb hFb
    have hq0 : 0 ≤ R * θ := mul_nonneg hR hθ
    have hT : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => G n z.1 * F n z.2) := fun n =>
      ((hG n).comp contDiff_fst).mul ((hF n).comp contDiff_snd)
    have hGp : ∀ n i (z : ℝ × ℝ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => G n z.1) z‖ ≤
        H i * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ i * R ^ n := by
      intro n i z
      have e : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => G n z.1) = G n ∘ ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) := rfl
      rw [e, ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right _ (hG n) z (hle i)]
      refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
      have hp : ∏ _j : Fin i, ‖ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
        exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_fst_le _ _ _)
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (G n) ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) z)‖ *
            ∏ _j : Fin i, ‖ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ‖
          ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (G n) ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) z)‖ * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = |iteratedDeriv i (G n) z.1| := by
            rw [mul_one, norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs]; rfl
        _ ≤ _ := hGb n i z.1
    have hFp : ∀ n i (z : ℝ × ℝ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => F n z.2) z‖ ≤ L i * θ ^ n := by
      intro n i z
      have e : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => F n z.2) = F n ∘ ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) := rfl
      rw [e, ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right _ (hF n) z (hle i)]
      refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
      have hp : ∏ _j : Fin i, ‖ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
        exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_snd_le _ _ _)
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (F n) ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) z)‖ *
            ∏ _j : Fin i, ‖ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ‖
          ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (F n) ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) z)‖ * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = |iteratedDeriv i (F n) z.2| := by
            rw [mul_one, norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs]; rfl
        _ ≤ _ := hFb n i z.2
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℕ → ℝ,
        A = fun k => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * H i * L (k - i) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hTb : ∀ (k n : ℕ) (z : ℝ × ℝ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => G n z.1 * F n z.2) z‖ ≤
        A k * (((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * (R * θ) ^ n) := by
      intro k n z
      refine le_trans (norm_iteratedFDeriv_mul_le ((hG n).comp contDiff_fst) ((hF n).comp contDiff_snd) z
        (hle k)) ?_
      rw [hA, Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => ?_)
      have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
      have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := by have := n.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ); linarith
      have h1 : ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ i ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ hn1 hik
      have hg := hGp n i z
      have hf := hFp n (k - i) z
      have hc : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      calc (k.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => G n z.1) z‖ *
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => F n z.2) z‖
          ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * (H i * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ i * R ^ n) * (L (k - i) * θ ^ n) :=
            mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg hc) hf (norm_nonneg _)
              (mul_nonneg hc (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hH i) (by positivity)) (pow_nonneg hR n)))
        _ ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * (H i * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * R ^ n) * (L (k - i) * θ ^ n) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (mul_nonneg (hL _) (pow_nonneg hθ n))
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hc
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (pow_nonneg hR n)
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (hH i)
        _ = (k.choose i : ℝ) * H i * L (k - i) * (((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * (R * θ) ^ n) := by
            rw [mul_pow]; ring
    have hsum : ∀ k : ℕ, Summable (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * (R * θ) ^ n) := by
      intro k
      have hq1 : ‖R * θ‖ < 1 := by rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hq0]; exact hRθ
      have s1 := summable_pow_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one k hq1
      have s2 := summable_geometric_of_lt_one hq0 hRθ
      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => by positivity) (fun n => ?_) ((s1.add s2).mul_left (2 ^ k))
      have key : ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k ≤ 2 ^ k * ((n : ℝ) ^ k + 1) := by
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with hn | hn
        · subst hn
          rw [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, one_pow]
          have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (0 : ℝ) ^ k := pow_nonneg le_rfl k
          have h2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ k := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
          nlinarith
        · have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
          calc ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k ≤ (2 * (n : ℝ)) ^ k := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by linarith) k
            _ = 2 ^ k * (n : ℝ) ^ k := mul_pow _ _ _
            _ ≤ 2 ^ k * ((n : ℝ) ^ k + 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by positivity)
      show ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * (R * θ) ^ n ≤ 2 ^ k * ((n : ℝ) ^ k * (R * θ) ^ n + (R * θ) ^ n)
      calc ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * (R * θ) ^ n ≤ 2 ^ k * ((n : ℝ) ^ k + 1) * (R * θ) ^ n :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right key (pow_nonneg hq0 n)
        _ = 2 ^ k * ((n : ℝ) ^ k * (R * θ) ^ n + (R * θ) ^ n) := by ring
    have hS : ∀ k : ℕ, ((k : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤ →
        Summable (fun n : ℕ => A k * (((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * (R * θ) ^ n)) :=
      fun k _ => (hsum k).mul_left (A k)
    have hB : ∀ (k n : ℕ) (z : ℝ × ℝ), ((k : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤ →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => G n z.1 * F n z.2) z‖ ≤
          A k * (((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * (R * θ) ^ n) := fun k n z _ => hTb k n z
    refine ⟨contDiff_tsum (N := ⊤) hT hS hB, fun m z => ?_⟩
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_tsum_apply (N := ⊤) hT hS hB le_top z]
    have hnorm : Summable (fun n => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => G n z.1 * F n z.2) z‖) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => norm_nonneg _) (fun n => hTb m n z) ((hsum m).mul_left (A m))
    refine le_trans (norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm) ?_
    refine le_trans (Summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun n => hTb m n z) hnorm ((hsum m).mul_left (A m))) ?_
    rw [tsum_mul_left, hA]
  
  have t_s1 : ∀ (s B : ℝ) (c : ℂ → ℂ), 0 < s → DifferentiableOn ℂ c (axRect s) →
      (∀ w ∈ axRect s, ‖c w‖ ≤ B) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun t : ℝ => (c (t : ℂ)).re) (Ioo (-1 - 3 * s / 4) (1 + 3 * s / 4)) ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ η ∈ Ioo (-1 - 3 * s / 4) (1 + 3 * s / 4),
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun t : ℝ => (c (t : ℂ)).re) η| ≤ B * (k.factorial : ℝ) * (8 / s) ^ k := by
    intro s B c hs hc hB
    have hO : IsOpen (axRect s) :=
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const).inter
        ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
          (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const))
    have hmap : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-1 - 3 * s / 4) (1 + 3 * s / 4), (t : ℂ) ∈ axRect s := by
      intro t ht
      show |(t : ℂ).im| < s ∧ -1 - s < (t : ℂ).re ∧ (t : ℂ).re < 1 + s
      rw [Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.ofReal_re, abs_zero]
      exact ⟨hs, by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩
    have hdk : ∀ k : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iteratedDeriv k c) (axRect s) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => rw [iteratedDeriv_zero]; exact hc
      | succ k ih => rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]; exact ih.deriv hO
    have hid : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-1 - 3 * s / 4) (1 + 3 * s / 4),
        iteratedDeriv k (fun t : ℝ => (c (t : ℂ)).re) t = (iteratedDeriv k c (t : ℂ)).re := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => intro t _; rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, iteratedDeriv_zero]
      | succ k ih =>
        intro t ht
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        have hev : iteratedDeriv k (fun t : ℝ => (c (t : ℂ)).re) =ᶠ[nhds t]
            fun t' : ℝ => (iteratedDeriv k c (t' : ℂ)).re :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds ht) ih
        rw [hev.deriv_eq]
        have hd : HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv k c) (deriv (iteratedDeriv k c) (t : ℂ)) (t : ℂ) :=
          ((hdk k).differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds (hmap t ht))).hasDerivAt
        rw [hd.real_of_complex.deriv, iteratedDeriv_succ]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have hC : ContDiffOn ℂ ∞ c (axRect s) := hc.contDiffOn hO
      have hR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c (axRect s) := hC.restrict_scalars ℝ
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : ℝ => c (Complex.ofRealCLM η))
          (Ioo (-1 - 3 * s / 4) (1 + 3 * s / 4)) :=
        hR.comp Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun η hη => by
          rw [Complex.ofRealCLM_apply]; exact hmap η hη)
      have h2 := Complex.reCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h1
      refine h2.congr (fun η _ => ?_)
      simp
    · intro k η hη
      rw [hid k η hη]
      have hR8 : 0 < s / 8 := by positivity
      have hball : Metric.closedBall (η : ℂ) (s / 8) ⊆ axRect s := by
        intro w hw
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hw
        have h1 := abs_le.mp ((Complex.abs_re_le_norm (w - η)).trans hw)
        have h2 := abs_le.mp ((Complex.abs_im_le_norm (w - η)).trans hw)
        simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, sub_zero] at h1 h2
        obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := hη
        show |w.im| < s ∧ -1 - s < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + s
        refine ⟨?_, by linarith [h1.1], by linarith [h1.2]⟩
        rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith [h2.1, h2.2]
      have hdc : DiffContOnCl ℂ c (Metric.ball (η : ℂ) (s / 8)) :=
        (hc.mono (by rw [closure_ball _ hR8.ne']; exact hball)).diffContOnCl
      have hsph : ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere (η : ℂ) (s / 8), ‖c z‖ ≤ B :=
        fun z hz => hB z (hball (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz))
      have hC := Complex.norm_iteratedDeriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le k hR8 hdc hsph
      calc |(iteratedDeriv k c (η : ℂ)).re| ≤ ‖iteratedDeriv k c (η : ℂ)‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
        _ ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) * B / (s / 8) ^ k := hC
        _ = B * (k.factorial : ℝ) * (8 / s) ^ k := by
            rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← inv_pow, inv_div]; ring
  
  have t_bump : ∀ (β : ℝ → ℝ) (p q : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ β → (∀ x, x ∉ Icc p q → β x = 0) →
      ∃ C : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 ≤ C j) ∧ ∀ j x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j β x‖ ≤ C j := by
    intro β p q hβ hz
    have hcs : HasCompactSupport β := HasCompactSupport.intro isCompact_Icc hz
    have : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j β x‖ ≤ C := by
      intro j
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (hβ.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (hle j)).bounded_above_of_compact_support
        (hcs.iteratedFDeriv j)
      exact ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, fun x => (hC x).trans (le_max_left _ _)⟩
    choose C hC0 hC using this
    exact ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩
  
  have t_s2 : ∀ (a b ρ0 D : ℝ), 0 < ρ0 → 0 ≤ D → ∃ L : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 ≤ L k) ∧
      ∀ (B : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ B → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (Ioo (a - ρ0) (b + ρ0)) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ η ∈ Ioo (a - ρ0) (b + ρ0), |iteratedDeriv k f η| ≤ B * (k.factorial : ℝ) * D ^ k) →
      ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F ∧ (∀ η ∈ Ioo a b, F η = f η) ∧
        ∀ (k : ℕ) (η : ℝ), |iteratedDeriv k F η| ≤ L k * B := by
    intro a b ρ0 D hρ hD
    obtain ⟨ε, hε⟩ : ∃ ε : ℝ, ε = ρ0 / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hε0 : 0 < ε := by rw [hε]; linarith
    have hερ : ε < ρ0 := by rw [hε]; linarith
    obtain ⟨β, hβdef⟩ : ∃ β : ℝ → ℝ, β = fun η => Real.smoothTransition ((η - (a - ε)) / ε) *
        Real.smoothTransition (((b + ε) - η) / ε) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hβs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ β := by
      rw [hβdef]
      exact (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp ((contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).div_const _)).mul
        (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp ((contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id).div_const _))
    have hβ1 : ∀ η ∈ Ioo a b, β η = 1 := by
      intro η hη
      rw [hβdef]
      show Real.smoothTransition ((η - (a - ε)) / ε) * Real.smoothTransition (((b + ε) - η) / ε) = 1
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le ((one_le_div hε0).mpr (by linarith [hη.1])),
        Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le ((one_le_div hε0).mpr (by linarith [hη.2])), one_mul]
    have hβ0 : ∀ η, η ∉ Icc (a - ε) (b + ε) → β η = 0 := by
      intro η hη
      rw [hβdef]
      show Real.smoothTransition ((η - (a - ε)) / ε) * Real.smoothTransition (((b + ε) - η) / ε) = 0
      rw [mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at hη
      rcases hη with h | h
      · rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) hε0.le),
          zero_mul]
      · have h0 : Real.smoothTransition (((b + ε) - η) / ε) = 0 :=
          Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) hε0.le)

    obtain ⟨Cβ, hCβ0, hCβ⟩ := t_bump β (a - ε) (b + ε) hβs hβ0
    refine ⟨fun k => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
        (k.choose j : ℝ) * Cβ j * (((k - j).factorial : ℝ) * D ^ (k - j)),
      fun k => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => by have := hCβ0 j; positivity), ?_⟩
    intro B f hB hf hfb
    have hzero : ∀ η, η ∉ Ioo (a - ρ0) (b + ρ0) →
        (fun x => β x * f x) =ᶠ[nhds η] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      intro η hη
      have hηc : η ∈ (Icc (a - ε) (b + ε))ᶜ := by
        intro h
        apply hη
        exact ⟨by linarith [h.1], by linarith [h.2]⟩
      exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (isClosed_Icc.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hηc)
        (fun x hx => by simp only [hβ0 x hx, zero_mul])
    refine ⟨fun x => β x * f x, ?_, fun η hη => by simp only [hβ1 η hη, one_mul], ?_⟩
    · rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro η
      by_cases h : η ∈ Ioo (a - ρ0) (b + ρ0)
      · exact (hβs.contDiffOn.mul hf).contDiffAt (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds h)

      by_cases h : η ∈ Ioo (a - ρ0) (b + ρ0)
      · rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k isOpen_Ioo h]
        refine le_trans (norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hβs.contDiffOn hf isOpen_Ioo.uniqueDiffOn h

        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ?_)
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j isOpen_Ioo h,
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (k - j) isOpen_Ioo h,
          norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv (n := k - j), Real.norm_eq_abs]
        have h1 := hCβ j η

        calc (k.choose j : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j β η‖ * |iteratedDeriv (k - j) f η|
            ≤ (k.choose j : ℝ) * Cβ j * (B * ((k - j).factorial : ℝ) * D ^ (k - j)) :=

                (mul_nonneg hc (hCβ0 j))

      · rw [((hzero η h).iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
        simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]

  have t_s3 : ∀ Λ : ℝ, 0 < Λ → ∃ (H : ℕ → ℝ) (G : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k, 0 ≤ H k) ∧
      (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (G n)) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (X : ℝ), |Λ * X| ≤ 5 → G n X = (Λ * X) ^ n) ∧
      ∀ (n k : ℕ) (X : ℝ), |iteratedDeriv k (G n) X| ≤ H k * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * 6 ^ n := by
    intro Λ hΛ
    obtain ⟨γ, hγdef⟩ : ∃ γ : ℝ → ℝ,
        γ = fun Y => Real.smoothTransition (6 - Y) * Real.smoothTransition (6 + Y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hγs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ γ := by
      rw [hγdef]
      exact (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id)).mul
        (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id))
    have hγ1 : ∀ Y, |Y| ≤ 5 → γ Y = 1 := by
      intro Y hY
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_le.mp hY
      rw [hγdef]
      show Real.smoothTransition (6 - Y) * Real.smoothTransition (6 + Y) = 1
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith),
        Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith), one_mul]
    have hγ0 : ∀ Y, Y ∉ Icc (-6 : ℝ) 6 → γ Y = 0 := by
      intro Y hY
      rw [mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at hY

      show Real.smoothTransition (6 - Y) * Real.smoothTransition (6 + Y) = 0
      rcases hY with h | h
      · have h0 : Real.smoothTransition (6 + Y) = 0 := Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
        rw [h0, mul_zero]
      · have h0 : Real.smoothTransition (6 - Y) = 0 := Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
        rw [h0, zero_mul]
    obtain ⟨Γ, hΓ0, hΓ⟩ := t_bump γ (-6) 6 hγs hγ0
    have hpow : ∀ (n i : ℕ) (Y : ℝ), |Y| ≤ 6 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun Y : ℝ => Y ^ n) Y‖ ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ i * 6 ^ n := by
      intro n i Y hY
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate, iter_deriv_pow,
        Real.norm_eq_abs]
      by_cases hin : n < i
      · rw [Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_range.mpr hin) (sub_self _), zero_mul, abs_zero]
        positivity
      · push Not at hin
        rw [abs_mul, Finset.abs_prod, abs_pow]
        have hp : ∏ l ∈ Finset.range i, |(n : ℝ) - (l : ℝ)| ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ i := by
          rw [← Finset.card_range i, ← Finset.prod_const]
          rw [Finset.card_range]
          refine Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) (fun l hl => ?_)
          have hl' : l < i := Finset.mem_range.mp hl
          have hln : (l : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hl' hin))
          have hl0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ l := Nat.cast_nonneg _
          rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
        have hy : |Y| ^ (n - i) ≤ (6 : ℝ) ^ n :=
          (pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg Y) hY _).trans (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (Nat.sub_le n i))
        exact mul_le_mul hp hy (by positivity) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : ℕ → ℝ, S = fun k => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose j : ℝ) * Γ j :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hS0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ S k := fun k => by
      rw [hS]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hΓ0 j))
    have hhs : ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun Y : ℝ => γ Y * Y ^ n) := fun n => hγs.mul (contDiff_id.pow n)
    have hhb : ∀ (n k : ℕ) (Y : ℝ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun Y : ℝ => γ Y * Y ^ n) Y‖ ≤
        S k * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * 6 ^ n := by
      intro n k Y
      by_cases hY : |Y| ≤ 6
      · refine le_trans (norm_iteratedFDeriv_mul_le hγs (contDiff_id.pow n) Y (hle k)) ?_
        rw [hS]
        simp only
        rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j hj => ?_)
        have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := by have := n.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ); linarith
        have h2 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - j) (fun Y : ℝ => Y ^ n) Y‖ ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * 6 ^ n :=
          (hpow n (k - j) Y hY).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (pow_le_pow_right₀ hn1 (Nat.sub_le k j)) (by positivity))
        have hc : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k.choose j : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
        calc (k.choose j : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j γ Y‖ *
              ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - j) (fun Y : ℝ => Y ^ n) Y‖
            ≤ (k.choose j : ℝ) * Γ j * (((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * 6 ^ n) :=
              mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hΓ j Y) hc) h2 (norm_nonneg _)
                (mul_nonneg hc (hΓ0 j))
          _ = (k.choose j : ℝ) * Γ j * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * 6 ^ n := by ring
      · push Not at hY
        have hopen : IsOpen {Y' : ℝ | 6 < |Y'|} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_abs
        have hev : (fun Y : ℝ => γ Y * Y ^ n) =ᶠ[nhds Y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
          refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hopen.mem_nhds hY) (fun Y' hY' => ?_)
          have : Y' ∉ Icc (-6 : ℝ) 6 := by
            intro h
            have : |Y'| ≤ 6 := abs_le.mpr ⟨h.1, h.2⟩
            exact absurd hY' (not_lt.mpr this)

        rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
        simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
        exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hS0 k) (by positivity)) (by positivity)
    refine ⟨fun k => Λ ^ k * S k, fun n X => γ (Λ * X) * (Λ * X) ^ n,
      fun k => mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hΛ.le k) (hS0 k), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro n
      exact (hhs n).comp (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id)
    · intro n X hX
      show γ (Λ * X) * (Λ * X) ^ n = (Λ * X) ^ n
      rw [hγ1 _ hX, one_mul]
    · intro n k X

      beta_reduce at e
      rw [e, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_of_pos hΛ, ← Real.norm_eq_abs (iteratedDeriv _ _ _),
        ← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
      calc Λ ^ k * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun Y : ℝ => γ Y * Y ^ n) (Λ * X)‖
          ≤ Λ ^ k * (S k * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * 6 ^ n) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hhb n k (Λ * X)) (pow_nonneg hΛ.le k)
        _ = Λ ^ k * S k * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * 6 ^ n := by ring
  
  intro s Λ hs hΛ
  obtain ⟨L, hL0, hL⟩ := t_s2 (-1 - s / 2) (1 + s / 2) (s / 4) (8 / s) (by positivity) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨H, G, hH0, hGs, hGeq, hGb⟩ := t_s3 Λ hΛ
  refine ⟨fun m => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) * H i * L (m - i)) *
      ∑' n : ℕ, ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ m * (6 * (1 / 10)) ^ n,
    fun m => mul_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hH0 i))
      (hL0 _)) (tsum_nonneg fun n => by positivity), ?_⟩
  intro B c hB hcd hcb
  have hI : Ioo (-1 - s / 2 - s / 4) (1 + s / 2 + s / 4) = Ioo (-1 - 3 * s / 4) (1 + 3 * s / 4) := by
    congr 1 <;> ring
  have hF : ∀ n, ∃ Fn : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ Fn ∧
      (∀ η ∈ Ioo (-1 - s / 2) (1 + s / 2), Fn η = (c n (η : ℂ)).re) ∧
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (η : ℝ), |iteratedDeriv k Fn η| ≤ L k * (B * (1 / 10) ^ n) := by
    intro n
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := t_s1 s (B * (1 / 10) ^ n) (c n) hs (hcd n) (hcb n)
    exact hL (B * (1 / 10) ^ n) (fun t => (c n (t : ℂ)).re) (by positivity) (by rw [hI]; exact h1)
      (by rw [hI]; exact h2)
  choose F hFs hFeq hFb using hF
  obtain ⟨hT, hTb⟩ := t_s4 G F H (fun k => L k * B) 6 (1 / 10) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    hH0 (fun k => mul_nonneg (hL0 k) hB) hGs hFs hGb
    (fun n k η => le_of_le_of_eq (hFb n k η) (by ring))
  have hO : IsOpen ({X : ℝ | |Λ * X| < 5} ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - s / 2) (1 + s / 2)) :=
    (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const).prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hid : ∀ z ∈ {X : ℝ | |Λ * X| < 5} ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - s / 2) (1 + s / 2),
      (∑' n : ℕ, c n (z.2 : ℂ) * ((Λ * z.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ n).re = ∑' n : ℕ, G n z.1 * F n z.2 := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨hz1, hz2⟩ := hz
    have hz1' : |Λ * z.1| < 5 := hz1
    have hw : (z.2 : ℂ) ∈ axRect s := by
      show |(z.2 : ℂ).im| < s ∧ -1 - s < (z.2 : ℂ).re ∧ (z.2 : ℂ).re < 1 + s
      rw [Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.ofReal_re, abs_zero]
      exact ⟨hs, by linarith [hz2.1], by linarith [hz2.2]⟩
    have hsum : Summable (fun n : ℕ => c n (z.2 : ℂ) * ((Λ * z.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ n) := by
      refine Summable.of_norm_bounded
        ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (by norm_num)).mul_left B)
        (fun n => ?_)
      calc ‖c n (z.2 : ℂ) * ((Λ * z.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ n‖ = ‖c n (z.2 : ℂ)‖ * |Λ * z.1| ^ n := by
            rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        _ ≤ (B * (1 / 10) ^ n) * 5 ^ n :=
            mul_le_mul (hcb n _ hw) (pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hz1'.le n) (by positivity)
              (by positivity)
        _ = B * (1 / 2) ^ n := by rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_pow]; norm_num
    rw [← Complex.reCLM_apply, Complex.reCLM.map_tsum hsum]
    refine tsum_congr (fun n => ?_)
    rw [Complex.reCLM_apply, ← Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.re_mul_ofReal, hGeq n z.1 hz1'.le,
      hFeq n z.2 hz2, mul_comm]
  refine ⟨hT.contDiffOn.congr (fun z hz => hid z hz), fun m z hz => ?_⟩
  have hev : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (∑' n : ℕ, c n (z.2 : ℂ) * ((Λ * z.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ n).re) =ᶠ[nhds z]
      (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => ∑' n : ℕ, G n z.1 * F n z.2) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hz) hid
  rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
  refine (hTb m z).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  beta_reduce
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h j0 σ ρ Pc Pax r M Λ0 A χc ζc ℓc zc Ξ hσ hCD hMaj Λ C hΛΛ0 hΛA hC X η hX0 hX1 hη1 hη2
  obtain ⟨hr0, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, hΞd, -, hbd, hreal⟩ := hCD
  obtain ⟨hΛ0, hA0, hmaj⟩ := hMaj
  have hΛpos : 0 < Λ := by linarith
  have hCpos : 0 < C := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hC
  
  have hS5 : ∀ (Y c ε : ℝ) (p : ℕ → ℂ), 0 ≤ Y → Y ≤ 41 / 10 → 0 ≤ ε →
      (∀ n : ℕ, ‖p n - (-(c : ℂ) / 2) ^ n / ((n.factorial : ℂ) * ((n + 1).factorial : ℂ))‖ ≤
        ε * (1 / 10) ^ n) →
      axF0 (Y * c) - 2 * ε ≤ (∑' n : ℕ, p n * (Y : ℂ) ^ n).re := by
    intro Y c ε p hY0 hY1 hε0 hb
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : ℕ → ℂ,
        e = fun n => (-(c : ℂ) / 2) ^ n / ((n.factorial : ℂ) * ((n + 1).factorial : ℂ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hb' : ∀ n, ‖p n - e n‖ ≤ ε * (1 / 10) ^ n := fun n => by rw [he]; exact hb n
    have hxs : Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
        (-(Y * c) / 2) ^ n / ((n.factorial : ℝ) * ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))) := by
      refine Summable.of_norm_bounded (Real.summable_pow_div_factorial (|Y * c| / 2)) (fun n => ?_)
      have hf1 : (0 : ℝ) < n.factorial := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.factorial_pos n)
      have hf2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n + 1).factorial := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_pow, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hf1,
        abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < (n + 1).factorial), neg_div, abs_neg, abs_div, abs_two]
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) hf1
      nlinarith
    have hterm : ∀ n : ℕ, e n * (Y : ℂ) ^ n =
        (((-(Y * c) / 2) ^ n / ((n.factorial : ℝ) * ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      intro n
      rw [he, show -(Y * c) / 2 = Y * (-c / 2) by ring, mul_pow]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hes : Summable (fun n : ℕ => e n * (Y : ℂ) ^ n) :=
      (Complex.summable_ofReal.mpr hxs).congr (fun n => (hterm n).symm)
    have hesum : ∑' n : ℕ, e n * (Y : ℂ) ^ n = ((axF0 (Y * c) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [tsum_congr hterm, ← Complex.ofReal_tsum]
      rfl
    have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 41 / 100 := by norm_num
    have hq1 : (41 / 100 : ℝ) < 1 := by norm_num
    have hdb : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖p n * (Y : ℂ) ^ n - e n * (Y : ℂ) ^ n‖ ≤ ε * (41 / 100) ^ n := by
      intro n
      rw [← sub_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hY0]
      calc ‖p n - e n‖ * Y ^ n ≤ ε * (1 / 10) ^ n * Y ^ n :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hb' n) (pow_nonneg hY0 n)
        _ = ε * (1 / 10 * Y) ^ n := by rw [mul_pow, mul_assoc]
        _ ≤ ε * (41 / 100) ^ n :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by linarith) n) hε0
    have hds : Summable (fun n : ℕ => p n * (Y : ℂ) ^ n - e n * (Y : ℂ) ^ n) :=
      Summable.of_norm_bounded ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one hq0 hq1).mul_left ε) hdb
    have hdn := tsum_of_norm_bounded ((hasSum_geometric_of_lt_one hq0 hq1).mul_left ε) hdb
    have hsplit : ∑' n : ℕ, p n * (Y : ℂ) ^ n =
        ∑' n : ℕ, e n * (Y : ℂ) ^ n + ∑' n : ℕ, (p n * (Y : ℂ) ^ n - e n * (Y : ℂ) ^ n) := by
      rw [← hes.tsum_add hds]
      exact tsum_congr (fun n => by ring)
    rw [hsplit, hesum, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re]
    have hre := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (∑' n : ℕ, (p n * (Y : ℂ) ^ n - e n * (Y : ℂ) ^ n))
    have hab := neg_abs_le (∑' n : ℕ, (p n * (Y : ℂ) ^ n - e n * (Y : ℂ) ^ n)).re
    have h5 : ε * (1 - 41 / 100 : ℝ)⁻¹ = ε * (100 / 59) := by norm_num
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ, g = axGain Λ C Ξ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hgd : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (axRect r) := by
    rw [hg]
    exact ((hΞd.const_mul (Λ : ℂ)).cexp).div_const (C : ℂ)
  have hgb : ∀ w ∈ axRect r, ‖g w‖ ≤ 1 := by

  have hηr1 : -1 - r < η := by linarith

  obtain ⟨hχ, -, -, hΞr, -, -⟩ := hreal η hηr1 hηr2
  have hηrect : (η : ℂ) ∈ axRect (r / 2) := by

    rw [Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.ofReal_re, abs_zero]

  have hηrect' : (η : ℂ) ∈ axRect r := by
    show |(η : ℂ).im| < r ∧ -1 - r < (η : ℂ).re ∧ (η : ℂ).re < 1 + r
    rw [Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.ofReal_re, abs_zero]
    exact ⟨hr0, hηr1, hηr2⟩
  
  have hgη : g (η : ℂ) = ((Real.exp (Λ * (Ξ (η : ℂ)).re) / C : ℝ) : ℂ) := by

(h j0 Λ X : ℝ) (w χ ζ ℓ : ℂ) (a a' b b' : ℕ → ℂ) (B : ℝ)

    (hrec : ∀ n : ℕ,
      let D : ℂ := 1 / 2 - (h : ℂ)

    let D : ℂ := 1 / 2 - (h : ℂ)

    let ube := axSer (fun n => b' n / ((n : ℂ) + 1)) y
    let W := 1 - 2 * D * w * (Us + ub / (Λ : ℂ)) - d * (4 + ube / (Λ : ℂ))
    let U := Us + u / (Λ : ℂ)
    (-W * (Φ + (Λ : ℂ) * (X : ℂ) * Φ1) - (h : ℂ) * (1 - 2 * w * U) * Φ
        - (D * w + d * U) * ((Λ : ℂ) * ζ * Φ + Φe) =
      -2 * (1 - 2 * (h : ℂ) * w ^ 2) * (Λ : ℂ) * ((Λ : ℂ) * (X : ℂ) * Φ2 + 2 * Φ1))
