proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xan ρ φ ψ _ hφ hψ
  unfold AxHJet AxHJetK at *
  obtain ⟨hs1, hj1⟩ := hφ
  obtain ⟨hs2, hj2⟩ := hψ
  choose Φ C1 hc1 hX1 using hj1
  choose Ψ C2 hc2 hX2 using hj2
  refine ⟨fun η h1 h2 => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨e1, he1, s1⟩ := hs1 η h1 h2
    obtain ⟨e2, he2, s2⟩ := hs2 η h1 h2
    refine ⟨min e1 e2, lt_min he1 he2, ?_⟩
    exact (s1.mono (fun x hx => ⟨by linarith [hx.1, min_le_left e1 e2],
        by linarith [hx.2, min_le_left e1 e2]⟩)).mul
      (s2.mono (fun x hx => ⟨by linarith [hx.1, min_le_right e1 e2],
        by linarith [hx.2, min_le_right e1 e2]⟩))
  · refine ⟨fun X w => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
        ((k.choose i : ℕ) : ℂ) * Φ i X w * Ψ (k - i) X w,
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |C1 i| * |C2 (k - i)|, ?_,
      fun X hXa hXb => ⟨?_, fun w hw => ?_, fun η h1 h2 => ?_⟩⟩
    · apply continuousOn_finset_sum
      intro i _
      exact (continuousOn_const.mul (hc1 i)).mul (hc2 (k - i))
    · apply DifferentiableOn.fun_sum
      intro i _
      exact ((differentiableOn_const _).mul (hX1 i X hXa hXb).1).mul (hX2 (k - i) X hXa hXb).1
    · refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_))
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast]
      have b1 : ‖Φ i X w‖ ≤ |C1 i| := ((hX1 i X hXa hXb).2.1 w hw).trans (le_abs_self _)
      have b2 : ‖Ψ (k - i) X w‖ ≤ |C2 (k - i)| :=
        ((hX2 (k - i) X hXa hXb).2.1 w hw).trans (le_abs_self _)
      have c0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b1 c0) b2 (norm_nonneg _)
        (mul_nonneg c0 (abs_nonneg _))
    · obtain ⟨e1, he1, s1⟩ := hs1 η h1 h2
      obtain ⟨e2, he2, s2⟩ := hs2 η h1 h2
      have ca : ContDiffAt ℝ k (fun Y => φ Y η) X :=
        contDiffAt_infty.mp (s1.contDiffAt (Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith))) k
      have cb : ContDiffAt ℝ k (fun Y => ψ Y η) X :=
        contDiffAt_infty.mp (s2.contDiffAt (Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith))) k
      show ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ((k.choose i : ℕ) : ℂ) * Φ i X (η : ℂ) * Ψ (k - i) X (η : ℂ)
        = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => φ Y η * ψ Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ)
      rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_mul ca cb]
      push_cast
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [(hX1 i X hXa hXb).2.2 η h1 h2, (hX2 (k - i) X hXa hXb).2.2 η h1 h2]

signature.name: axhjet_exp
signature.statement: ∀ (Xan ρ : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ Xan → AxHJet Xan ρ φ → AxHJet Xan ρ (fun X η => Real.exp (φ X η))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xan ρ φ _ hφ
  unfold AxHJet at hφ ⊢
  obtain ⟨hs, hj⟩ := hφ
  unfold AxHJetK at hj
  choose Φ C hc hX using hj
  
  have key : ∀ (X η : ℝ), 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xan → -1 < η → η < 1 → ∀ n : ℕ,
      iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (fun Y => Real.exp (φ Y η)) X =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv (i + 1) (fun Y => φ Y η) X *
          iteratedDeriv (n - i) (fun Y => Real.exp (φ Y η)) X := by
    intro X η hXa hXb h1 h2 n
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, s⟩ := hs η h1 h2
    have hI : Ioo (-ε) (Xan + ε) ∈ nhds X := Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (deriv (fun Y => φ Y η)) (Ioo (-ε) (Xan + ε)) :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioo).mp s).2
    have hd : deriv (fun Y => Real.exp (φ Y η)) =ᶠ[nhds X]
        fun Y => deriv (fun Y => φ Y η) Y * Real.exp (φ Y η) := by
      filter_upwards [hI] with Y hY
      have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y => φ Y η) Y :=
        (s.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hY)
      exact (hdiff.hasDerivAt.exp).deriv.trans (mul_comm _ _)
    have e1 : ContDiffAt ℝ n (deriv (fun Y => φ Y η)) X :=
      contDiffAt_infty.mp (hb.contDiffAt hI) n
    have e2 : ContDiffAt ℝ n (fun Y => Real.exp (φ Y η)) X :=
      contDiffAt_infty.mp (s.exp.contDiffAt hI) n
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ' (n := n), hd.iteratedDeriv_eq n, iteratedDeriv_fun_mul e1 e2]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ' (n := i)]
  refine ⟨fun η h1 h2 => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨ε, hε, s⟩ := hs η h1 h2
    exact ⟨ε, hε, s.exp⟩
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ k IH =>
    rcases k with _ | n
    · unfold AxHJetK
      refine ⟨fun X w => Complex.exp (Φ 0 X w), Real.exp (C 0), (hc 0).cexp,
        fun X hXa hXb => ⟨(hX 0 X hXa hXb).1.cexp, fun w hw => ?_, fun η h1 h2 => ?_⟩⟩
      · exact (Complex.norm_exp_le_exp_norm _).trans
          (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ((hX 0 X hXa hXb).2.1 w hw))
      · show Complex.exp (Φ 0 X η) = ((iteratedDeriv 0 (fun Y => Real.exp (φ Y η)) X : ℝ) : ℂ)
        rw [(hX 0 X hXa hXb).2.2 η h1 h2, iteratedDeriv_zero, iteratedDeriv_zero,
          Complex.ofReal_exp]
    · have IH' : ∀ m : ℕ, m < n + 1 → AxHJetK Xan ρ (fun X η => Real.exp (φ X η)) m := IH
      unfold AxHJetK at IH'
      choose E B hEc hEX using IH'
      have hm : ∀ i : ℕ, n - i < n + 1 := fun i => Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.sub_le n i)
      unfold AxHJetK
      refine ⟨fun X w => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          ((n.choose i : ℕ) : ℂ) * Φ (i + 1) X w * E (n - i) (hm i) X w,
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * |C (i + 1)| * |B (n - i) (hm i)|, ?_,
        fun X hXa hXb => ⟨?_, fun w hw => ?_, fun η h1 h2 => ?_⟩⟩
      · show ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          ((n.choose i : ℕ) : ℂ) * Φ (i + 1) p.1 p.2 * E (n - i) (hm i) p.1 p.2) _
        refine continuousOn_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => ?_)
        exact (continuousOn_const.mul (hc (i + 1))).mul (hEc (n - i) (hm i))
      · show DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          ((n.choose i : ℕ) : ℂ) * Φ (i + 1) X w * E (n - i) (hm i) X w) _
        refine DifferentiableOn.fun_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
        exact ((differentiableOn_const _).mul (hX (i + 1) X hXa hXb).1).mul
          (hEX (n - i) (hm i) X hXa hXb).1
      · show ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          ((n.choose i : ℕ) : ℂ) * Φ (i + 1) X w * E (n - i) (hm i) X w‖ ≤ _
        refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_))
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast]
        have a1 := ((hX (i + 1) X hXa hXb).2.1 w hw).trans (le_abs_self _)
        have a2 := ((hEX (n - i) (hm i) X hXa hXb).2.1 w hw).trans (le_abs_self _)
        exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) a2 (norm_nonneg _)
          (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _))
      · show (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          ((n.choose i : ℕ) : ℂ) * Φ (i + 1) X η * E (n - i) (hm i) X η) = _
        rw [key X η hXa hXb h1 h2 n]
        push_cast
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        rw [(hX (i + 1) X hXa hXb).2.2 η h1 h2, (hEX (n - i) (hm i) X hXa hXb).2.2 η h1 h2]

signature.name: axhjet_inv
signature.statement: ∀ (Xan ρ m : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (Φ0 : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ), 0 ≤ Xan → 0 < m → AxHJet Xan ρ φ → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ Y : ℝ, -ε < Y → Y < Xan + ε → φ Y η ≠ 0) → ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Φ0 p.1 p.2) (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ axRect ρ) → (∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xan → DifferentiableOn ℂ (Φ0 X) (axRect ρ) ∧ ∀ w ∈ axRect ρ, m ≤ ‖Φ0 X w‖) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xan → -1 < η → η < 1 → Φ0 X (η : ℂ) = ((φ X η : ℝ) : ℂ)) → AxHJet Xan ρ (fun X η => (φ X η)⁻¹)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xan ρ m φ Φ0 _ hm hφ hnz hΦ0c hΦ0 hΦ0r
  unfold AxHJet at hφ ⊢
  obtain ⟨hs, hj⟩ := hφ
  unfold AxHJetK at hj
  choose Φ C hc hX using hj
  
  have hloc : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ∃ e : ℝ, 0 < e ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => φ Y η) (Ioo (-e) (Xan + e)) ∧
      ∀ Y ∈ Ioo (-e) (Xan + e), φ Y η ≠ 0 := by
    intro η h1 h2
    obtain ⟨e1, he1, s1⟩ := hs η h1 h2
    obtain ⟨e2, he2, n2⟩ := hnz η h1 h2
    refine ⟨min e1 e2, lt_min he1 he2, s1.mono (fun x hx => ⟨by linarith [hx.1, min_le_left e1 e2],
      by linarith [hx.2, min_le_left e1 e2]⟩), fun Y hY => n2 Y
      (by linarith [hY.1, min_le_right e1 e2]) (by linarith [hY.2, min_le_right e1 e2])⟩
  
  have hrec : ∀ (η X : ℝ) (n : ℕ), -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xan →
      iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (fun Y => (φ Y η)⁻¹) X =
        -(φ X η)⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℝ) *
          iteratedDeriv (i + 1) (fun Y => φ Y η) X * iteratedDeriv (n - i) (fun Y => (φ Y η)⁻¹) X := by
    intro η X n h1 h2 hX0 hX1
    obtain ⟨e, he, sU, nU⟩ := hloc η h1 h2
    have hXU : Ioo (-e) (Xan + e) ∈ nhds X := Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have sg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => (φ Y η)⁻¹) (Ioo (-e) (Xan + e)) := sU.inv nU
    have cf : ContDiffAt ℝ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) (fun Y => φ Y η) X :=
      contDiffAt_infty.mp (sU.contDiffAt hXU) (n + 1)
    have cg : ContDiffAt ℝ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) (fun Y => (φ Y η)⁻¹) X :=
      contDiffAt_infty.mp (sg.contDiffAt hXU) (n + 1)
    have hev : (fun Y => φ Y η * (φ Y η)⁻¹) =ᶠ[nhds X] (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hXU (fun Y hY => mul_inv_cancel₀ (nU Y hY))
    have h0 : iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (fun Y => φ Y η * (φ Y η)⁻¹) X = 0 := by
      rw [hev.iteratedDeriv_eq, iteratedDeriv_const]; simp
    rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_mul cf cg, Finset.sum_range_succ'] at h0
    simp only [Nat.choose_zero_right, iteratedDeriv_zero, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, Nat.sub_zero,
      Nat.add_sub_add_right] at h0
    have hne : φ X η ≠ 0 := nU X ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have key : φ X η * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (fun Y => (φ Y η)⁻¹) X =
        -∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℝ) *
          iteratedDeriv (i + 1) (fun Y => φ Y η) X * iteratedDeriv (n - i) (fun Y => (φ Y η)⁻¹) X := by
      linarith
    calc iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (fun Y => (φ Y η)⁻¹) X
        = (φ X η)⁻¹ * (φ X η * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (fun Y => (φ Y η)⁻¹) X) := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne, one_mul]
      _ = _ := by rw [key]; ring
  refine ⟨fun η h1 h2 => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨e, he, sU, nU⟩ := hloc η h1 h2
    exact ⟨e, he, sU.inv nU⟩
  · induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ k ih =>
    rcases k with _ | n
    · unfold AxHJetK
      have hnz0 : ∀ X, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xan → ∀ w ∈ axRect ρ, Φ0 X w ≠ 0 := fun X a b w hw =>
        norm_pos_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hm ((hΦ0 X a b).2 w hw))
      refine ⟨fun X w => (Φ0 X w)⁻¹, m⁻¹, ?_, fun X a b => ⟨?_, fun w hw => ?_, fun η h1 h2 => ?_⟩⟩
      · exact hΦ0c.inv₀ (fun p hp => hnz0 p.1 hp.1.1 hp.1.2 p.2 hp.2)
      · exact (hΦ0 X a b).1.inv (fun w hw => hnz0 X a b w hw)
      · show ‖(Φ0 X w)⁻¹‖ ≤ m⁻¹
        rw [norm_inv]; exact inv_anti₀ hm ((hΦ0 X a b).2 w hw)
      · show (Φ0 X (η : ℂ))⁻¹ = ((iteratedDeriv 0 (fun Y => (φ Y η)⁻¹) X : ℝ) : ℂ)
        rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, hΦ0r X η a b h1 h2, Complex.ofReal_inv]
    · have ih' : ∀ j : ℕ, AxHJetK Xan ρ (fun X η => (φ X η)⁻¹) (min j n) :=
        fun j => ih _ (by omega)
      unfold AxHJetK at ih' ⊢
      choose W B hWc hWX using ih'
      have hmin : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), min (n - i) n = n - i := fun i _ => by omega
      refine ⟨fun X w => -(W 0 X w) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) * Φ (i + 1) X w * W (n - i) X w,
        |B 0| * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * |C (i + 1)| * |B (n - i)|,
        ?_, fun X a b => ⟨?_, fun w hw => ?_, fun η h1 h2 => ?_⟩⟩
      · apply ContinuousOn.mul (hWc 0).neg
        apply continuousOn_finset_sum
        intro i _
        exact (continuousOn_const.mul (hc (i + 1))).mul (hWc (n - i))
      · apply DifferentiableOn.mul (hWX 0 X a b).1.neg
        apply DifferentiableOn.fun_sum
        intro i _
        exact ((differentiableOn_const _).mul (hX (i + 1) X a b).1).mul (hWX (n - i) X a b).1
      · show ‖-(W 0 X w) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) * Φ (i + 1) X w * W (n - i) X w‖ ≤ _
        rw [norm_mul, norm_neg]
        have b0 : ‖W 0 X w‖ ≤ |B 0| := ((hWX 0 X a b).2.1 w hw).trans (le_abs_self _)
        have bs : ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            (((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) * Φ (i + 1) X w * W (n - i) X w‖ ≤
            ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * |C (i + 1)| * |B (n - i)| := by
          refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_))
          rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast]
          have b1 : ‖Φ (i + 1) X w‖ ≤ |C (i + 1)| :=
            ((hX (i + 1) X a b).2.1 w hw).trans (le_abs_self _)
          have b2 : ‖W (n - i) X w‖ ≤ |B (n - i)| :=
            ((hWX (n - i) X a b).2.1 w hw).trans (le_abs_self _)
          have c0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b1 c0) b2 (norm_nonneg _)
            (mul_nonneg c0 (abs_nonneg _))
        exact mul_le_mul b0 bs (norm_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)
      · have hW0 : W 0 X (η : ℂ) = (((φ X η)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          have := (hWX 0 X a b).2.2 η h1 h2
          rw [show min 0 n = 0 from Nat.zero_min n, iteratedDeriv_zero] at this
          exact this
        have e1 : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            (((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) * Φ (i + 1) X (η : ℂ) * W (n - i) X (η : ℂ) =
            ((((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv (i + 1) (fun Y => φ Y η) X *
              iteratedDeriv (n - i) (fun Y => (φ Y η)⁻¹) X : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          intro i hi
          have hw := (hWX (n - i) X a b).2.2 η h1 h2
          rw [hmin i hi] at hw
          rw [(hX (i + 1) X a b).2.2 η h1 h2, hw]
          push_cast
          ring
        show -(W 0 X (η : ℂ)) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            (((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) * Φ (i + 1) X (η : ℂ) * W (n - i) X (η : ℂ) =
            ((iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (fun Y => (φ Y η)⁻¹) X : ℝ) : ℂ)
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl e1, hW0, hrec η X n h1 h2 a b]
        push_cast
        ring

signature.name: axhjet_integral
signature.statement: ∀ (Xan ρ : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ Xan → 0 < ρ → AxHJet Xan ρ φ → AxHJet Xan ρ (fun X η => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, φ s η)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xan ρ φ hXan _hρ hφ
  have hSo : IsOpen (axRect ρ) := by
    unfold axRect
    exact (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
        (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const))
  
  have hprim : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a c : ℝ), a < 0 → 0 < c → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (Ioo a c) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..Y, f s) (Ioo a c) ∧
      ∀ Y ∈ Ioo a c, deriv (fun Y => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..Y, f s) Y = f Y := by
    intro f a c ha hc hf
    have hcont : ContinuousOn f (Ioo a c) := hf.continuousOn
    have h0 : (0:ℝ) ∈ Ioo a c := ⟨ha, hc⟩
    have hD : ∀ Y ∈ Ioo a c, HasDerivAt (fun Y => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..Y, f s) (f Y) Y := by
      intro Y hY
      have hsub : uIcc 0 Y ⊆ Ioo a c := Set.OrdConnected.uIcc_subset ordConnected_Ioo h0 hY
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right ((hcont.mono hsub).intervalIntegrable)
        (ContinuousOn.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter isOpen_Ioo hcont Y hY)
        (hcont.continuousAt (Ioo_mem_nhds hY.1 hY.2))
    have hE : ∀ Y ∈ Ioo a c, deriv (fun Y => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..Y, f s) Y = f Y :=
      fun Y hY => (hD Y hY).deriv
    exact ⟨(contDiffOn_infty_iff_deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioo).mpr
      ⟨fun Y hY => (hD Y hY).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt, hf.congr hE⟩, hE⟩
  unfold AxHJet AxHJetK at *
  obtain ⟨hs, hj⟩ := hφ
  refine ⟨fun η h1 h2 => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨ε, hε, hsm⟩ := hs η h1 h2
    exact ⟨ε, hε, (hprim (fun Y => φ Y η) (-ε) (Xan + ε) (by linarith) (by linarith) hsm).1⟩
  cases k with
  | succ k =>
    obtain ⟨Φ, C, hc, hX⟩ := hj k
    refine ⟨Φ, C, hc, fun X hXa hXb => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨d, b, r⟩ := hX X hXa hXb
    refine ⟨d, b, fun η h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hsm⟩ := hs η h1 h2
    have hder := (hprim (fun Y => φ Y η) (-ε) (Xan + ε) (by linarith) (by linarith) hsm).2
    have hev : deriv (fun Y => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..Y, φ s η) =ᶠ[nhds X] (fun Y => φ Y η) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
        (Ioo_mem_nhds (show -ε < X by linarith) (show X < Xan + ε by linarith)) hder
    rw [r η h1 h2]
    show ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => φ Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ((iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun Y => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..Y, φ s η) X : ℝ) : ℂ)
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hev.iteratedDeriv_eq k]
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨Φ, C, hc, hX⟩ := hj 0
    have hsl : ∀ w ∈ axRect ρ, ContinuousOn (fun s => Φ s w) (Icc 0 Xan) := fun w hw =>
      hc.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn (fun s hs => ⟨hs, hw⟩)
    
    obtain ⟨cl, hcl⟩ : ∃ cl : ℝ → ℝ, cl = fun s => max 0 (min Xan s) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hclc : Continuous cl := by
      rw [hcl]; exact continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min continuous_id)
    have hclm : ∀ s, cl s ∈ Icc 0 Xan := fun s => by
      rw [hcl]; exact ⟨le_max_left _ _, max_le hXan (min_le_left _ _)⟩
    have hcle : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 Xan, cl s = s := fun s hs => by
      rw [hcl]; simp only [min_eq_right hs.2, max_eq_right hs.1]
    have hfc : Continuous (Function.uncurry
        (fun (p : ℝ × axRect ρ) (t : ℝ) => Φ (cl t) (p.2 : ℂ))) :=
      hc.comp_continuous ((hclc.comp continuous_snd).prodMk
        (continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_fst)))
        (fun z => ⟨hclm z.2, z.1.2.2⟩)
    have hH := intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous
      (μ := volume) (a₀ := 0) hfc continuous_fst
    have hΓc : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..p.1, Φ s p.2)
        (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ axRect ρ) := by
      rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
      refine (hH.comp (continuous_subtype_val.fst.prodMk
        ((continuous_subtype_val.snd).subtype_mk
          (fun q : (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ axRect ρ : Set (ℝ × ℂ)) => q.2.2)))).congr (fun q => ?_)
      show (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..(q : ℝ × ℂ).1, Φ (cl t) (q : ℝ × ℂ).2) =
        ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..(q : ℝ × ℂ).1, Φ s (q : ℝ × ℂ).2
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro t ht
      rw [uIcc_of_le q.2.1.1] at ht
      simp only
      rw [hcle t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans q.2.1.2⟩]
    
    have hΓd : ∀ X, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xan →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Φ s w) (axRect ρ) := by
      intro X hX0 hX1 w0 hw0
      apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      obtain ⟨R, hR, hRS⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hSo w0 hw0
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = R / 3 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hr0 : 0 < r := by rw [hr]; positivity
      have hsubI : uIoc 0 X ⊆ Icc 0 Xan := by
        rw [uIoc_of_le hX0]; exact fun t ht => ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2.trans hX1⟩
      have hsubC : uIcc 0 X ⊆ Icc 0 Xan := by
        rw [uIcc_of_le hX0]; exact Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hX1
      have hball : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball w0 r, Metric.closedBall x r ⊆ axRect ρ := by
        intro x hx z hz
        apply hRS
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hx ⊢
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hz
        calc dist z w0 ≤ dist z x + dist x w0 := dist_triangle _ _ _
          _ < R := by linarith
      have hballS : Metric.ball w0 r ⊆ axRect ρ := fun x hx =>
        hball x hx (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr0.le)
      have hcauchy : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 Xan, ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball w0 r, ‖deriv (Φ t) x‖ ≤ C / r := by
        intro t ht x hx
        apply Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr0
        · apply DifferentiableOn.diffContOnCl
          rw [closure_ball x hr0.ne']
          exact (hX t ht.1 ht.2).1.mono (hball x hx)
        · intro z hz
          exact (hX t ht.1 ht.2).2.1 z (hball x hx (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz))
      have hmeasF : ∀ x ∈ axRect ρ,
          AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => Φ t x) (volume.restrict (uIoc 0 X)) :=
        fun x hx => ((hsl x hx).mono hsubI).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
      have hmeasF' : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => deriv (Φ t) w0)
          (volume.restrict (uIoc 0 X)) := by
        obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ : ∃ h : ℕ → ℂ, h = fun n : ℕ => ((r / ((n : ℝ) + 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
        have hpos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < r / ((n : ℝ) + 2) := fun n => by positivity
        have hhn : ∀ n : ℕ, w0 + h n ∈ axRect ρ := by
          intro n
          apply hballS
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, hh]
          simp only [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          rw [abs_of_pos (hpos n)]
          exact div_lt_self hr0 (by have := Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n; linarith)
        have hreal : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => r / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
          Filter.Tendsto.div_atTop tendsto_const_nhds
            (Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right _ 2 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
        have hh0 : Filter.Tendsto h Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
          have := (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp hreal
          rw [Complex.ofReal_zero] at this
          rw [hh]; exact this
        have hhT : Filter.Tendsto h Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) :=
          tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hh0, Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => by
            rw [hh]
            exact mem_compl_singleton_iff.mpr (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hpos n).ne'))⟩
        apply aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae Filter.atTop
          (f := fun n t => (h n)⁻¹ • (Φ t (w0 + h n) - Φ t w0))
        · intro n
          exact (((hmeasF _ (hhn n)).sub (hmeasF _ hw0)).const_smul (h n)⁻¹ : _)
        · apply ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_uIoc
          intro t ht
          have hdt : HasDerivAt (Φ t) (deriv (Φ t) w0) w0 :=
            ((hX t (hsubI ht).1 (hsubI ht).2).1.differentiableAt (hSo.mem_nhds hw0)).hasDerivAt
          exact hdt.tendsto_slope_zero.comp hhT
      have key := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (𝕜 := ℂ)
        (μ := volume) (a := 0) (b := X) (bound := fun _ => C / r) (F := fun x t => Φ t x)
        (F' := fun x t => deriv (Φ t) x) (x₀ := w0) (s := Metric.ball w0 r)
        (Metric.ball_mem_nhds w0 hr0)
        (Filter.eventually_of_mem (hSo.mem_nhds hw0) hmeasF)
        (((hsl w0 hw0).mono hsubC).intervalIntegrable)
        hmeasF'
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht x hx => hcauchy t (hsubI ht) x hx))
        intervalIntegrable_const
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht x hx =>
          ((hX t (hsubI ht).1 (hsubI ht).2).1.differentiableAt
            (hSo.mem_nhds (hballS hx))).hasDerivAt))
      exact key.2.differentiableAt
    refine ⟨fun X w => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Φ s w, |C| * Xan, hΓc,
      fun X hXa hXb => ⟨hΓd X hXa hXb, fun w hw => ?_, fun η h1 h2 => ?_⟩⟩
    · have hsubI : uIoc 0 X ⊆ Icc 0 Xan := by
        rw [uIoc_of_le hXa]; exact fun t ht => ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2.trans hXb⟩
      have hb := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := 0) (b := X) (C := |C|)
        (f := fun s => Φ s w)
        (fun s hs => ((hX s (hsubI hs).1 (hsubI hs).2).2.1 w hw).trans (le_abs_self C))
      rw [sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hXa] at hb
      exact hb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hXb (abs_nonneg C))
    · show ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, Φ s (η : ℂ) =
        ((iteratedDeriv 0 (fun Y => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..Y, φ s η) X : ℝ) : ℂ)
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, ← intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s hs
      rw [uIcc_of_le hXa] at hs
      have := (hX s hs.1 (hs.2.trans hXb)).2.2 η h1 h2
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero] at this
      exact this

signature.name: sigA_flat_deriv
signature.statement: ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ sigA (Ioo 0 1) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → u < 1 → 0 < sigA u) ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ G : ℝ, ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → u ≤ 1 / 2 → |iteratedDeriv n sigA u| ≤ G * Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) * (u ^ (3 * n))⁻¹

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hG0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun u : ℝ => (expNegInvGlue (u ^ 2) + expNegInvGlue ((1 - u) ^ 2))⁻¹) := by
    apply ContDiff.inv
    · exact (expNegInvGlue.contDiff.comp (contDiff_id.pow 2)).add
        (expNegInvGlue.contDiff.comp ((contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id).pow 2))
    · intro u
      have n1 := expNegInvGlue.nonneg (u ^ 2)
      have n2 := expNegInvGlue.nonneg ((1 - u) ^ 2)
      apply ne_of_gt
      by_cases hu : u = 0
      · have : 0 < expNegInvGlue ((1 - u) ^ 2) :=
          expNegInvGlue.pos_of_pos (by rw [hu]; norm_num)
        linarith
      · have : 0 < expNegInvGlue (u ^ 2) :=
          expNegInvGlue.pos_of_pos (lt_of_le_of_ne (sq_nonneg u) (Ne.symm (pow_ne_zero 2 hu)))
        linarith
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ,
      g = fun u : ℝ => (expNegInvGlue (u ^ 2) + expNegInvGlue ((1 - u) ^ 2))⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g := by rw [hg]; exact hG0
  have hfac : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → u < 1 → sigA =ᶠ[nhds u]
      (fun w => (fun w : ℝ => Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) * (w ^ 0)⁻¹) w * g w) := by
    intro u hu hu1
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hu hu1) (fun w hw => ?_)
    have hw0 : ¬ w ≤ 0 := not_le.mpr hw.1
    have hw1 : ¬ 1 ≤ w := not_le.mpr hw.2
    have e1 : expNegInvGlue (w ^ 2) = Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) := by
      rw [expNegInvGlue, if_neg (not_le.mpr (pow_pos hw.1 2)), neg_div, one_div]
    have e2 : expNegInvGlue ((1 - w) ^ 2) = Real.exp (-1 / (1 - w) ^ 2) := by
      rw [expNegInvGlue, if_neg (not_le.mpr (pow_pos (sub_pos.mpr hw.2) 2)), neg_div, one_div]
    rw [hg]
    show sigA w = Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) * (w ^ 0)⁻¹ *
      (expNegInvGlue (w ^ 2) + expNegInvGlue ((1 - w) ^ 2))⁻¹
    rw [e1, e2]
    unfold sigA
    rw [if_neg hw0, if_neg hw1, pow_zero, inv_one, mul_one, div_eq_mul_inv]
  
  have hsm : ∀ (k : ℕ) (w : ℝ), w ≠ 0 →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ => Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) * (w ^ k)⁻¹) w := by
    intro k w hw
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ => -1 / w ^ 2) w :=
      contDiffAt_const.div (contDiffAt_id.pow 2) (pow_ne_zero 2 hw)
    exact h1.exp.mul ((contDiffAt_id.pow k).inv (pow_ne_zero k hw))
  
  have hder : ∀ (k : ℕ) (w : ℝ), 0 < w →
      HasDerivAt (fun w : ℝ => Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) * (w ^ k)⁻¹)
        (2 * (Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) * (w ^ (k + 3))⁻¹) -
          (k : ℝ) * (Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) * (w ^ (k + 1))⁻¹)) w := by
    intro k w hw
    have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := hw.ne'
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℝ => -1 / w ^ 2) (2 / w ^ 3) w := by
      have := ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 w).inv (pow_ne_zero 2 hw0)).neg
      convert this using 1
      · funext x
        simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
      · field_simp
        ring
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℝ => (w ^ k)⁻¹) (-(k : ℝ) * (w ^ (k + 1))⁻¹) w := by
      have := (hasDerivAt_pow k w).inv (pow_ne_zero k hw0)
      convert this using 1
      rcases k with _ | m
      · simp
      · simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
        push_cast
        field_simp
        ring
    convert h1.exp.mul h2 using 1
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hfam : ∀ j k : ℕ, ∃ A : ℝ, ∀ v : ℝ, 0 < v → v ≤ 1 →
      |iteratedDeriv j (fun w : ℝ => Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) * (w ^ k)⁻¹) v| ≤
        A * Real.exp (-1 / v ^ 2) * (v ^ (k + 3 * j))⁻¹ := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro k
      refine ⟨1, fun v hv _ => ?_⟩
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, abs_of_pos (mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (inv_pos.mpr (pow_pos hv k)))]
      simp
    | succ j ih =>
      intro k
      obtain ⟨A1, hA1⟩ := ih (k + 3)
      obtain ⟨A2, hA2⟩ := ih (k + 1)
      refine ⟨2 * |A1| + k * |A2|, fun v hv hv1 => ?_⟩
      have hev : deriv (fun w : ℝ => Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) * (w ^ k)⁻¹) =ᶠ[nhds v]
          (fun w => 2 * (Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) * (w ^ (k + 3))⁻¹) -
            (k : ℝ) * (Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) * (w ^ (k + 1))⁻¹)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hv) (fun w hw => (hder k w hw).deriv)
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hev.iteratedDeriv_eq]
      have hc1 : ContDiffAt ℝ j
          (fun w : ℝ => 2 * (Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) * (w ^ (k + 3))⁻¹)) v :=
        contDiffAt_const.mul ((hsm (k + 3) v hv.ne').of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      have hc2 : ContDiffAt ℝ j
          (fun w : ℝ => (k : ℝ) * (Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) * (w ^ (k + 1))⁻¹)) v :=
        contDiffAt_const.mul ((hsm (k + 1) v hv.ne').of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      have hsub := iteratedDeriv_fun_sub hc1 hc2
      rw [hsub, iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field, iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field]
      have b1 := hA1 v hv hv1
      have b2 := hA2 v hv hv1
      have e1 : k + 3 + 3 * j = k + 3 * (j + 1) := by ring
      rw [e1] at b1
      have hE : 0 < Real.exp (-1 / v ^ 2) := Real.exp_pos _
      have hI : 0 ≤ (v ^ (k + 3 * (j + 1)))⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr (pow_nonneg hv.le _)
      have hI2 : 0 ≤ (v ^ (k + 1 + 3 * j))⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr (pow_nonneg hv.le _)
      have hmono : (v ^ (k + 1 + 3 * j))⁻¹ ≤ (v ^ (k + 3 * (j + 1)))⁻¹ :=
        inv_anti₀ (pow_pos hv _) (pow_le_pow_of_le_one hv.le hv1 (by omega))
      have b1' := b1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self A1) hE.le) hI)
      have b2' := b2.trans (mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self A2) hE.le)
        hmono hI2 (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hE.le))
      generalize iteratedDeriv j (fun w => Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) * (w ^ (k + 3))⁻¹) v = a at b1' ⊢
      generalize iteratedDeriv j (fun w => Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) * (w ^ (k + 1))⁻¹) v = b at b2' ⊢
      have hk : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k := Nat.cast_nonneg k
      have t1 : |2 * a - (k : ℝ) * b| ≤ 2 * |a| + (k : ℝ) * |b| := by
        have := abs_sub (2 * a) ((k : ℝ) * b)
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (two_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2), abs_of_nonneg hk] at this
        exact this
      have t2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b2' hk
      nlinarith
  have hsig : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ sigA (Ioo 0 1) := by
    intro u hu
    exact (((hsm 0 u hu.1.ne').mul hG.contDiffAt).congr_of_eventuallyEq
      (hfac u hu.1 hu.2)).contDiffWithinAt
  refine ⟨hsig, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u hu0 hu1
    unfold sigA
    rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr hu0), if_neg (not_le.mpr hu1)]
    exact div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (add_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (Real.exp_pos _))
  · intro n
    choose A hA using fun j => hfam j 0
    have hM : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2), ‖iteratedDeriv k g u‖ ≤ M :=
      fun k => isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        ((hG.continuous_iteratedDeriv k (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).continuousOn)
    choose M hM using hM
    refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * (|A i| * |M (n - i)|),
      fun u hu hu2 => ?_⟩
    have hu1 : u < 1 := by linarith
    rw [(hfac u hu hu1).iteratedDeriv_eq, iteratedDeriv_fun_mul
      ((hsm 0 u hu.ne').of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      (hG.contDiffAt.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
    have hE : 0 < Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) := Real.exp_pos _
    have hX : 0 ≤ (u ^ (3 * n))⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr (pow_nonneg hu.le _)
    refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i hi
    have hin : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
    have b1 := hA i u hu (by linarith)
    rw [zero_add] at b1
    have hmono : (u ^ (3 * i))⁻¹ ≤ (u ^ (3 * n))⁻¹ :=
      inv_anti₀ (pow_pos hu _) (pow_le_pow_of_le_one hu.le (by linarith) (by omega))
    have b1' : |iteratedDeriv i (fun w : ℝ => Real.exp (-1 / w ^ 2) * (w ^ 0)⁻¹) u| ≤
        |A i| * (Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) * (u ^ (3 * n))⁻¹) := by
      refine b1.trans ?_
      rw [mul_assoc]
      exact mul_le_mul (le_abs_self _) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono hE.le)
        (mul_nonneg hE.le (inv_nonneg.mpr (pow_nonneg hu.le _))) (abs_nonneg _)
    have b2 : |iteratedDeriv (n - i) g u| ≤ |M (n - i)| := by
      have := hM (n - i) u ⟨hu.le, hu2⟩
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      exact this.trans (le_abs_self _)
    have hc : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, Nat.abs_cast]
    have key := mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b1' hc) b2 (abs_nonneg _)
      (mul_nonneg hc (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hE.le hX)))
    calc _ ≤ _ := key
      _ = _ := by ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (X0 t1 c : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < X0 → 0 < t1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Ioo 0 1) → (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ G : ℝ, ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → u ≤ 1 / 2 → |iteratedDeriv n g u| ≤ G * Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) * (u ^ (3 * n))⁻¹) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => c * g (Real.log (Y / X0) / t1)) (Ioo X0 (X0 * Real.exp t1)) ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ X : ℝ, X0 < X → X ≤ X0 * Real.exp (t1 / 2) → |iteratedDeriv n (fun Y => c * g (Real.log (Y / X0) / t1)) X| ≤ K * Real.exp (-(t1 ^ 2 / Real.log (X / X0) ^ 2)) * (Real.log (X / X0) ^ (3 * n))⁻¹

signature.name: flat_log_chain
signature.statement: ∀ (X0 t1 c : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < X0 → 0 < t1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Ioo 0 1) → (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ G : ℝ, ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → u ≤ 1 / 2 → |iteratedDeriv n g u| ≤ G * Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) * (u ^ (3 * n))⁻¹) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => c * g (Real.log (Y / X0) / t1)) (Ioo X0 (X0 * Real.exp t1)) ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ X : ℝ, X0 < X → X ≤ X0 * Real.exp (t1 / 2) → |iteratedDeriv n (fun Y => c * g (Real.log (Y / X0) / t1)) X| ≤ K * Real.exp (-(t1 ^ 2 / Real.log (X / X0) ^ 2)) * (Real.log (X / X0) ^ (3 * n))⁻¹

proof.tactics:
by
  intro X0 t1 c g hX0 ht1 hg hG
  
  have hlog : ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → ∀ j : ℕ,
      iteratedDeriv (j + 1) (fun Y => Real.log (Y / X0) / t1) X =
        (-1) ^ j * (j.factorial : ℝ) * (X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹ / t1 := by
    intro X hX j
    have hd : ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → deriv (fun Y => Real.log (Y / X0) / t1) Y = t1⁻¹ * Y⁻¹ := by
      intro Y hY
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y / X0) (1 / X0) Y := (hasDerivAt_id Y).div_const X0
      have h2 := (h1.log (div_pos hY hX0).ne').div_const t1
      rw [h2.deriv]
      field_simp
    have hev : deriv (fun Y => Real.log (Y / X0) / t1) =ᶠ[nhds X] fun Y => t1⁻¹ * Y⁻¹ :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds hX) (fun Y hY => hd Y hY)
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hev.iteratedDeriv_eq, iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field,
      iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate]
    have hinv : deriv^[j] (fun Y : ℝ => Y⁻¹) X =
        (-1) ^ j * (j.factorial : ℝ) * X ^ (-1 - (j : ℤ)) := iter_deriv_inv j X
    rw [hinv]
    have hz : X ^ (-1 - (j : ℤ)) = (X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹ := by
      rw [show (-1 - (j : ℤ)) = -((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
    rw [hz]
    ring
  
  have hcomp : ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ) (s t : Set ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x C D : ℝ), IsOpen s → IsOpen t →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g t → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u s → MapsTo u s t → x ∈ s →
      (∀ i, i ≤ n → |iteratedDeriv i g (u x)| ≤ C) →
      (∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → |iteratedDeriv i u x| ≤ D ^ i) →
      |iteratedDeriv n (fun y => g (u y)) x| ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) * C * D ^ n := by
    intro u s t n x C D hs ht hg' hu hst hx hC hD
    have key : ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (z : ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsOpen S → z ∈ S →
        ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k φ S z‖ = |iteratedDeriv k φ z| := by
      intro φ S z k hS hz
      rw [norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_norm_iteratedDerivWithin,
        iteratedDerivWithin_of_isOpen hS hz, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have h := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hg' hu (by exact_mod_cast le_top) ht.uniqueDiffOn
      hs.uniqueDiffOn hst hx (C := C) (D := D) (n := n)
      (fun i hi => by rw [key g t (u x) i ht (hst hx)]; exact hC i hi)
      (fun i hi1 hi2 => by rw [key u s x i hs hx]; exact hD i hi1 hi2)
    rw [key (g ∘ u) s x n hs hx] at h
    exact h
  
  have hmaps : MapsTo (fun Y => Real.log (Y / X0) / t1) (Ioo X0 (X0 * Real.exp t1))
      (Ioo 0 1) := by
    intro Y hY
    have h1 : 1 < Y / X0 := (one_lt_div hX0).mpr hY.1
    have h2 : Y / X0 < Real.exp t1 := by
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hX0, mul_comm]; exact hY.2
    have h3 : Real.log (Y / X0) < t1 := (Real.log_lt_iff_lt_exp (by linarith)).mpr h2
    exact ⟨div_pos (Real.log_pos h1) ht1, (div_lt_one ht1).mpr h3⟩
  
  have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => Real.log (Y / X0) / t1) (Ioo X0 (X0 * Real.exp t1)) := by
    have h0 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y : ℝ => Y / X0) (Ioo X0 (X0 * Real.exp t1)) :=
      contDiffOn_id.div_const X0
    exact (h0.log (fun Y hY => div_ne_zero (by linarith [hY.1]) hX0.ne')).div_const t1
  have hgu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => g (Real.log (Y / X0) / t1)) (Ioo X0 (X0 * Real.exp t1)) :=
    hg.comp hu hmaps
  refine ⟨contDiffOn_const.mul hgu, ?_⟩
  
  intro n
  choose G hG' using hG
  obtain ⟨Gs, hGsdef⟩ : ∃ Gs : ℝ, Gs = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |G i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = (n.factorial : ℝ) * (1 + 1 / t1) * (1 + 1 / X0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hGs0 : 0 ≤ Gs := by
    rw [hGsdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
  refine ⟨|c| * n.factorial * Gs * D ^ n * t1 ^ (3 * n), ?_⟩
  intro X hX1 hX2
  have hXpos : 0 < X := by linarith
  have hXs : X ∈ Ioo X0 (X0 * Real.exp t1) :=
    ⟨hX1, lt_of_le_of_lt hX2
      (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by linarith)) hX0)⟩
  set y := Real.log (X / X0) with hy
  have hy0 : 0 < y := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr hX1)
  have hy1 : y ≤ t1 / 2 := by
    rw [hy, Real.log_le_iff_le_exp (div_pos hXpos hX0), div_le_iff₀ hX0, mul_comm]
    exact hX2
  have hu0 : 0 < y / t1 := div_pos hy0 ht1
  have hu0h : y / t1 ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ ht1]; linarith
  have hu01 : y / t1 ≤ 1 := by linarith
  
  have hCb : ∀ i, i ≤ n → |iteratedDeriv i g (y / t1)| ≤
      Gs * Real.exp (-1 / (y / t1) ^ 2) * ((y / t1) ^ (3 * n))⁻¹ := by
    intro i hi
    have e1 := hG' i (y / t1) hu0 hu0h
    have hE := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (y / t1) ^ 2)
    have e2 : ((y / t1) ^ (3 * i))⁻¹ ≤ ((y / t1) ^ (3 * n))⁻¹ :=
      inv_anti₀ (pow_pos hu0 _) (pow_le_pow_of_le_one hu0.le hu01 (by omega))
    have e3 : G i ≤ Gs := by
      refine (le_abs_self _).trans ?_
      rw [hGsdef]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |G i|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
    calc |iteratedDeriv i g (y / t1)| ≤ G i * Real.exp (-1 / (y / t1) ^ 2) *
          ((y / t1) ^ (3 * i))⁻¹ := e1
      _ ≤ Gs * Real.exp (-1 / (y / t1) ^ 2) * ((y / t1) ^ (3 * n))⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right e3 hE.le) e2
            (inv_nonneg.mpr (pow_nonneg hu0.le _)) (mul_nonneg hGs0 hE.le)
  
  have hDb : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n →
      |iteratedDeriv i (fun Y => Real.log (Y / X0) / t1) X| ≤ D ^ i := by
    intro i hi1 hi2
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, i = j + 1 := ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [hlog X hXpos j]
    simp only [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, one_mul, Nat.abs_cast,
      abs_inv, abs_of_pos hXpos, abs_of_pos ht1]
    rw [hDdef, mul_pow, mul_pow]
    have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)
    have a1 : (j.factorial : ℝ) ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) :=
      (Nat.cast_le.mpr (Nat.factorial_le (by omega))).trans (le_self_pow₀ hn1 (by omega))
    have hX0i : 0 < 1 / X0 := one_div_pos.mpr hX0
    have ht1i : 0 < 1 / t1 := one_div_pos.mpr ht1
    have a2 : (X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹ ≤ (1 + 1 / X0) ^ (j + 1) := by
      calc (X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹ ≤ (X0 ^ (j + 1))⁻¹ :=
            inv_anti₀ (pow_pos hX0 _) (pow_le_pow_left₀ hX0.le hX1.le _)
        _ = (1 / X0) ^ (j + 1) := by rw [one_div, inv_pow]
        _ ≤ (1 + 1 / X0) ^ (j + 1) := pow_le_pow_left₀ hX0i.le (by linarith) _
    have a3 : 1 / t1 ≤ (1 + 1 / t1) ^ (j + 1) :=
      (by linarith : 1 / t1 ≤ 1 + 1 / t1).trans (le_self_pow₀ (by linarith) (by omega))
    rw [div_eq_mul_one_div]
    calc (j.factorial : ℝ) * (X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹ * (1 / t1)
        ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) * (1 + 1 / X0) ^ (j + 1) * (1 + 1 / t1) ^ (j + 1) :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul a1 a2 (by positivity) (by positivity)) a3 (by positivity)
            (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by ring
  
  have hmain : |iteratedDeriv n (fun Y => g (Real.log (Y / X0) / t1)) X| ≤
      (n.factorial : ℝ) * (Gs * Real.exp (-1 / (y / t1) ^ 2) * ((y / t1) ^ (3 * n))⁻¹) * D ^ n :=
    hcomp (fun Y => Real.log (Y / X0) / t1) _ _ n X _ D isOpen_Ioo isOpen_Ioo hg hu hmaps hXs
      hCb hDb
  have hw : Real.exp (-1 / (y / t1) ^ 2) = Real.exp (-(t1 ^ 2 / y ^ 2)) := by
    rw [div_pow, div_div_eq_mul_div (-1 : ℝ), neg_one_mul, neg_div]
  have hp : ((y / t1) ^ (3 * n))⁻¹ = t1 ^ (3 * n) * (y ^ (3 * n))⁻¹ := by
    rw [div_pow, inv_div, div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field, abs_mul]
  calc |c| * |iteratedDeriv n (fun Y => g (Real.log (Y / X0) / t1)) X|
      ≤ |c| * ((n.factorial : ℝ) * (Gs * Real.exp (-1 / (y / t1) ^ 2) *
          ((y / t1) ^ (3 * n))⁻¹) * D ^ n) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmain (abs_nonneg c)
    _ = _ := by rw [hw, hp]; ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (e : ℝ → ℝ) (B : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ e (Ioo a b) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ B (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ Cm : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m B p‖ ≤ Cm) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ p ∈ Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => e z.1 * B z) p‖ ≤ C * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |iteratedDeriv i e p.1|

signature.name: flat_scalar_mul_bound
signature.statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (e : ℝ → ℝ) (B : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ e (Ioo a b) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ B (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ Cm : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m B p‖ ≤ Cm) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ p ∈ Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => e z.1 * B z) p‖ ≤ C * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |iteratedDeriv i e p.1|

proof.tactics:
by
  intro a b e B He HB Hbd m
  have hSo : IsOpen (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hSu : UniqueDiffOn ℝ (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := hSo.uniqueDiffOn
  have hUo : IsOpen (Ioo a b) := isOpen_Ioo
  have hle : ∀ k : ℕ, (k : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := fun k => by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hE : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => e z.1) (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
    He.comp contDiffOn_fst (fun z hz => hz.1)
  have s3 : ∀ (i : ℕ) (p : ℝ × ℝ), p.1 ∈ Ioo a b →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => e z.1) p‖ ≤ |iteratedDeriv i e p.1| := by
    intro i p hp
    set g : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ with hg
    have hWo : IsOpen (g ⁻¹' Ioo a b) := hUo.preimage g.continuous
    have hpW : p ∈ g ⁻¹' Ioo a b := hp
    have h1 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right g He hUo.uniqueDiffOn
      hWo.uniqueDiffOn hpW (hle i)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hWo hpW, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hUo hpW] at h1
    have h2 : (e ∘ g) = fun z : ℝ × ℝ => e z.1 := rfl
    rw [h2] at h1
    rw [h1]
    calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i e (g p)‖ * ∏ _ : Fin i, ‖g‖ :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i e (g p)‖ * 1 := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (norm_nonneg _)
          rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
          exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_fst_le ℝ ℝ ℝ)
      _ = |iteratedDeriv i e p.1| := by
          rw [mul_one, norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          rfl
  choose Cb hCb using Hbd
  set Dm : ℝ := ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Cb j| with hDm
  have hDm0 : 0 ≤ Dm := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hBb : ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ p ∈ Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j B p‖ ≤ Dm := by
    intro j hj p hp
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j B p‖ ≤ Cb j := hCb j p hp
      _ ≤ |Cb j| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ Dm := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cb j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj))
  clear_value Dm
  refine ⟨2 ^ m * Dm, mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (by norm_num) _) hDm0, ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  have hL := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le (f := fun z : ℝ × ℝ => e z.1) (g := B) hE HB hSu hp
    (n := m) (hle m)
  rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hSo hp] at hL
  calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => e z.1 * B z) p‖
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) *
          ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => e z.1) (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) p‖ *
          ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ (m - i) B (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) p‖ := hL
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), 2 ^ m * Dm * |iteratedDeriv i e p.1| := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hSo hp, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (m - i) hSo hp]
        have hc : (m.choose i : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ m := by exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_le_two_pow m i
        have h3 := s3 i p hp.1
        have h4 := hBb (m - i) (Nat.sub_le m i) p hp
        calc (m.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => e z.1) p‖ *
              ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m - i) B p‖
            ≤ 2 ^ m * |iteratedDeriv i e p.1| * Dm :=
              mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hc h3 (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)) h4 (norm_nonneg _)
                (by positivity)
          _ = 2 ^ m * Dm * |iteratedDeriv i e p.1| := by ring
    _ = 2 ^ m * Dm * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |iteratedDeriv i e p.1| := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (a b c : ℝ) (Bθ Bz : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), 0 < c → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Bθ (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Bz (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ Cm : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Bθ p‖ ≤ Cm ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Bz p‖ ≤ Cm) → (∀ p ∈ Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, c ≤ Real.sqrt (Bθ p ^ 2 + Bz p ^ 2)) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Bθ z / Real.sqrt (Bθ z ^ 2 + Bz z ^ 2)) p‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Bz z / Real.sqrt (Bθ z ^ 2 + Bz z ^ 2)) p‖ ≤ C

signature.name: unit_direction_bound
signature.statement: ∀ (a b c : ℝ) (Bθ Bz : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), 0 < c → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Bθ (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Bz (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ Cm : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Bθ p‖ ≤ Cm ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Bz p‖ ≤ Cm) → (∀ p ∈ Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, c ≤ Real.sqrt (Bθ p ^ 2 + Bz p ^ 2)) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Bθ z / Real.sqrt (Bθ z ^ 2 + Bz z ^ 2)) p‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Bz z / Real.sqrt (Bθ z ^ 2 + Bz z ^ 2)) p‖ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro a b c Bθ Bz hc hBθ hBz hBd hlow m
  have hDo : IsOpen (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hqc : Continuous (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2) := by fun_prop
  have hTo : IsOpen {w : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2} := isOpen_lt continuous_const hqc
  have hq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2) :=
    (contDiff_fst.pow 2).add (contDiff_snd.pow 2)
  have hsq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2))
      {w : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2} :=
    hq.contDiffOn.sqrt (fun w hw => ne_of_gt hw)
  have hsq0 : ∀ w ∈ {w : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2}, Real.sqrt (w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2) ≠ 0 :=
    fun w hw => (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hw).ne'
  have hg1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => w.1 / Real.sqrt (w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2))
      {w : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2} :=
    contDiff_fst.contDiffOn.div hsq hsq0
  have hg2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => w.2 / Real.sqrt (w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2))
      {w : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2} :=
    contDiff_snd.contDiffOn.div hsq hsq0
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hBd 0
  have hKc : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ × ℝ) R ∩
      {w : ℝ × ℝ | c ≤ Real.sqrt (w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2)}) :=
    (isCompact_closedBall 0 R).inter_right
      (isClosed_le continuous_const (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp hqc))
  have hKT : Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ × ℝ) R ∩ {w : ℝ × ℝ | c ≤ Real.sqrt (w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2)} ⊆
      {w : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2} :=
    fun w hw => Real.sqrt_pos.1 (lt_of_lt_of_le hc hw.2)
  have hbd : ∀ (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g {w : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2} →
      ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ G : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ × ℝ) R ∩
        {w : ℝ × ℝ | c ≤ Real.sqrt (w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2)},
        ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ n g {w : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2} w‖ ≤ G := by
    intro g hg n
    have hcont := hg.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (m := n) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      hTo.uniqueDiffOn
    exact hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hcont.mono hKT)
  choose G1 hG1 using hbd _ hg1
  choose G2 hG2 using hbd _ hg2
  choose Cb hCb using hBd
  have hΦs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (Bθ z, Bz z)) (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
    hBθ.prodMk hBz
  have hΦK : ∀ p ∈ Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, (Bθ p, Bz p) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ × ℝ) R ∩
      {w : ℝ × ℝ | c ≤ Real.sqrt (w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2)} := by
    intro p hp
    refine ⟨?_, hlow p hp⟩
    rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
    have h1 := (hR p hp).1
    have h2 := (hR p hp).2
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] at h1 h2
    exact norm_prod_le_iff.2 ⟨h1, h2⟩
  obtain ⟨Cg, hCg⟩ : ∃ Cg : ℝ, Cg = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (|G1 i| + |G2 i|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Dd, hDd⟩ : ∃ Dd : ℝ, Dd = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Cb i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hDd1 : 1 ≤ Dd := by
    rw [hDd]
    linarith [Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1)) => abs_nonneg (Cb i))]
  have hDi : ∀ p ∈ Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m →
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (Bθ z, Bz z)) (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) p‖
        ≤ Dd ^ i := by
    intro p hp i hi1 him
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_prodMk (hBθ.contDiffWithinAt hp) (hBz.contDiffWithinAt hp)
      hDo.uniqueDiffOn hp (by exact_mod_cast le_top), ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_prod,
      iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hDo hp, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hDo hp]
    have hs : |Cb i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Cb j| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cb j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
    have hle : Cb i ≤ Dd := by rw [hDd]; linarith [le_abs_self (Cb i)]
    have hpow : Dd ≤ Dd ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hDd1 (by omega)
    exact max_le (by linarith [(hCb i p hp).1]) (by linarith [(hCb i p hp).2])
  have key : ∀ g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g {w : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2} →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ × ℝ) R ∩
        {w : ℝ × ℝ | c ≤ Real.sqrt (w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2)},
        ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i g {w : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2} w‖ ≤ Cg) →
      ∀ p ∈ Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (g ∘ fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (Bθ z, Bz z)) p‖ ≤
          (m.factorial : ℝ) * Cg * Dd ^ m := by
    intro g hg hgb p hp
    rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hDo hp]
    exact norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hg hΦs (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hTo.uniqueDiffOn
      hDo.uniqueDiffOn (fun z hz => hKT (hΦK z hz)) hp (fun i hi => hgb i hi _ (hΦK p hp))
      (hDi p hp)
  have hsum : ∀ i ≤ m, |G1 i| + |G2 i| ≤ Cg := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hCg]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |G1 j| + |G2 j|)
      (fun j _ => add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
  refine ⟨(m.factorial : ℝ) * Cg * Dd ^ m, fun p hp => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · refine key _ hg1 (fun i hi w hw => ?_) p hp
    have := hG1 i w hw
    linarith [le_abs_self (G1 i), abs_nonneg (G2 i), hsum i hi]
  · refine key _ hg2 (fun i hi w hw => ?_) p hp
    have := hG2 i w hw
    linarith [le_abs_self (G2 i), abs_nonneg (G1 i), hsum i hi]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h j0 Λ r : ℝ) (χ ζ ℓ z g : ℂ → ℂ) (pv : ℕ → (ℂ → ℂ) × (ℂ → ℂ)) (n : ℕ), 0 < r → DifferentiableOn ℂ χ (axRect r) → DifferentiableOn ℂ ζ (axRect r) → DifferentiableOn ℂ ℓ (axRect r) → DifferentiableOn ℂ z (axRect r) → DifferentiableOn ℂ g (axRect r) → (∀ m ≤ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (pv m).1 (axRect r) ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (pv m).2 (axRect r)) → DifferentiableOn ℂ (axRecStep h j0 Λ χ ζ ℓ z g pv n).1 (axRect r) ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (axRecStep h j0 Λ χ ζ ℓ z g pv n).2 (axRect r)

signature.name: ax_step_holo
signature.statement: ∀ (h j0 Λ r : ℝ) (χ ζ ℓ z g : ℂ → ℂ) (pv : ℕ → (ℂ → ℂ) × (ℂ → ℂ)) (n : ℕ), 0 < r → DifferentiableOn ℂ χ (axRect r) → DifferentiableOn ℂ ζ (axRect r) → DifferentiableOn ℂ ℓ (axRect r) → DifferentiableOn ℂ z (axRect r) → DifferentiableOn ℂ g (axRect r) → (∀ m ≤ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (pv m).1 (axRect r) ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (pv m).2 (axRect r)) → DifferentiableOn ℂ (axRecStep h j0 Λ χ ζ ℓ z g pv n).1 (axRect r) ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (axRecStep h j0 Λ χ ζ ℓ z g pv n).2 (axRect r)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h j0 Λ r χ ζ ℓ z g pv n _hr hχ hζ hℓ hz hg hpv
  have hΩ : IsOpen (axRect r) :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
        (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const))
  have hP : ∀ m ≤ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (pv m).1 (axRect r) := fun m hm => (hpv m hm).1
  have hV : ∀ m ≤ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (pv m).2 (axRect r) := fun m hm => (hpv m hm).2
  have hdP : ∀ m ≤ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (pv m).1) (axRect r) :=
    fun m hm => (hP m hm).deriv hΩ
  have hdV : ∀ m ≤ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (pv m).2) (axRect r) :=
    fun m hm => (hV m hm).deriv hΩ
  have hgc : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => if n = 0 then (0 : ℂ) else g w ^ 2 *
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - 1 + 1), (pv i).1 w * (pv (n - 1 - i)).1 w) (axRect r) := by
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · simp only [hn, if_true]
      exact differentiableOn_const _
    · simp only [hn, if_false]
      apply (hg.pow 2).mul
      apply DifferentiableOn.fun_sum
      intro i hi
      have hi' := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
      exact (hP i (by omega)).mul (hP _ (by omega))
  have hp := hgc.div_const (n : ℂ)
  have hdp := hp.deriv hΩ
  have hsum : ∀ F : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ, (∀ i ≤ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F i) (axRect r)) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), F i w) (axRect r) := by
    intro F hF
    apply DifferentiableOn.fun_sum
    intro i hi
    exact hF i (by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hi; omega)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [axRecStep]
    apply DifferentiableOn.div_const
    refine ((hχ.neg).mul (hP n le_rfl)).add (DifferentiableOn.div_const (hℓ.mul ?_) _)
    apply hsum
    intro i hi
    have h1 := hP (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i)
    have h2 := hV i hi
    have h3 := hdP (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i)
    have h4 := hdV i hi
    fun_prop
  · simp only [axRecStep]
    apply DifferentiableOn.div_const
    have hS1 := hsum (fun i w => ((n - i : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((if i = 0 then 1 else 0) * (1 - 4 * (1 - w ^ 2) - 2 * (1 / 2 - (h : ℂ)) * w * (4 * w + (j0 : ℂ))) + -(2 * (1 / 2 - (h : ℂ)) * w * (pv i).2 w + (1 - w ^ 2) * deriv (pv i).2 w) / ((i : ℂ) + 1) / (Λ : ℂ)) * (pv (n - i)).2 w) (by
      intro i hi
      have h1 := hV (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i)
      have h2 := hV i hi
      have h4 := hdV i hi
      fun_prop)
    have hS2 := hsum (fun i w => (pv i).2 w * (pv (n - i)).2 w) (by
      intro i hi
      have h1 := hV (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i)
      have h2 := hV i hi
      fun_prop)
    have hS3 := hsum (fun i w => (pv i).2 w * deriv (pv (n - i)).2 w) (by
      intro i hi
      have h1 := hdV (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i)
      have h2 := hV i hi
      fun_prop)
    have h5 := hV n le_rfl
    have h6 := hdV n le_rfl
    fun_prop

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h j0 Λ r : ℝ) (χ ζ ℓ z g : ℂ → ℂ) (pv : ℕ → (ℂ → ℂ) × (ℂ → ℂ)) (n : ℕ), 0 < r → DifferentiableOn ℂ g (axRect r) → (∀ m ≤ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (pv m).1 (axRect r) ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (pv m).2 (axRect r)) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 - r < η → η < 1 + r → (χ (η : ℂ)).im = 0 ∧ (ζ (η : ℂ)).im = 0 ∧ (ℓ (η : ℂ)).im = 0 ∧ (z (η : ℂ)).im = 0 ∧ (g (η : ℂ)).im = 0) → (∀ m ≤ n, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 - r < η → η < 1 + r → ((pv m).1 (η : ℂ)).im = 0 ∧ ((pv m).2 (η : ℂ)).im = 0) → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 - r < η → η < 1 + r → ((axRecStep h j0 Λ χ ζ ℓ z g pv n).1 (η : ℂ)).im = 0 ∧ ((axRecStep h j0 Λ χ ζ ℓ z g pv n).2 (η : ℂ)).im = 0

signature.name: ax_step_real
signature.statement: ∀ (h j0 Λ r : ℝ) (χ ζ ℓ z g : ℂ → ℂ) (pv : ℕ → (ℂ → ℂ) × (ℂ → ℂ)) (n : ℕ), 0 < r → DifferentiableOn ℂ g (axRect r) → (∀ m ≤ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (pv m).1 (axRect r) ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (pv m).2 (axRect r)) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 - r < η → η < 1 + r → (χ (η : ℂ)).im = 0 ∧ (ζ (η : ℂ)).im = 0 ∧ (ℓ (η : ℂ)).im = 0 ∧ (z (η : ℂ)).im = 0 ∧ (g (η : ℂ)).im = 0) → (∀ m ≤ n, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 - r < η → η < 1 + r → ((pv m).1 (η : ℂ)).im = 0 ∧ ((pv m).2 (η : ℂ)).im = 0) → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 - r < η → η < 1 + r → ((axRecStep h j0 Λ χ ζ ℓ z g pv n).1 (η : ℂ)).im = 0 ∧ ((axRecStep h j0 Λ χ ζ ℓ z g pv n).2 (η : ℂ)).im = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h j0 Λ r χ ζ ℓ z g pv n hr hg hpv hreal hpvreal
  have hopen : IsOpen (axRect r) := by
    unfold axRect
    exact (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
        (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const))
  have hmem : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 - r < η → η < 1 + r → (η : ℂ) ∈ axRect r := by
    intro η h1 h2
    show |(η : ℂ).im| < r ∧ -1 - r < (η : ℂ).re ∧ (η : ℂ).re < 1 + r
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.ofReal_re, abs_zero]
    exact ⟨hr, h1, h2⟩
  
  have dreal : ∀ f : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ f (axRect r) →
      (∀ η : ℝ, -1 - r < η → η < 1 + r → (f (η : ℂ)).im = 0) →
      ∀ η : ℝ, -1 - r < η → η < 1 + r → (deriv f (η : ℂ)).im = 0 := by
    intro f hf hfr η h1 h2
    have hd : HasDerivAt f (deriv f η) η :=
      ((hf _ (hmem η h1 h2)).differentiableAt (hopen.mem_nhds (hmem η h1 h2))).hasDerivAt
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => f y) (deriv f η) η := hd.comp_ofReal
    have h4 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (f y).im) (deriv f η).im η := by
      have := Complex.imCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt η h3
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using this
    have h5 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (f y).im) 0 η := by
      apply (hasDerivAt_const η (0:ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2] with y hy
      exact hfr y hy.1 hy.2
    exact h4.unique h5
  have hc : ∀ x : ℂ, x.im = 0 → (starRingEnd ℂ) x = x := fun x hx => Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mpr hx
  
  have hpdiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w : ℂ => (if n = 0 then 0 else g w ^ 2 *
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - 1 + 1), (pv i).1 w * (pv (n - 1 - i)).1 w) / (n : ℂ)) (axRect r) := by
    by_cases hn : n = 0

  have hpreal : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 - r < η → η < 1 + r → ((if n = 0 then 0 else g (η : ℂ) ^ 2 *

  have nagumo : ∀ (ρ c : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (f : ℂ → ℂ), 0 < ρ → 0 ≤ c → DifferentiableOn ℂ f (axRect ρ) →
      (∀ σ u, 0 ≤ σ → σ < ρ → u ∈ axRect σ → ‖f u‖ ≤ c * ((ρ - σ)⁻¹) ^ k) →
      ∀ σ u, 0 ≤ σ → σ < ρ → u ∈ axRect σ →
        ‖deriv f u‖ ≤ 3 * ((k : ℝ) + 2) * c * ((ρ - σ)⁻¹) ^ (k + 1) := by
    intro ρ c k f hρ hc hf hb σ u hσ0 hσρ hu
    have hk1 : (0:ℝ) < (k:ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    have hk2 : (0:ℝ) < (k:ℝ) + 2 := by positivity

    have hsub : axRect (σ + δ) ⊆ axRect ρ := by
      intro ξ hξ
      obtain ⟨a1, a2, a3⟩ := hξ

    have hdc : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball u δ) := hf.diffContOnCl_ball (hball.trans hsub)
    have e0 : ρ - (σ + δ) = (ρ - σ) * (((k:ℝ) + 1) / ((k:ℝ) + 2)) := by
      rw [hδ]; field_simp; ring
    have hratio : ((ρ - (σ + δ))⁻¹) ^ k ≤ 3 * ((ρ - σ)⁻¹) ^ k := by
      rw [e0, mul_inv, inv_div, mul_pow, mul_comm (3:ℝ)]

      have h1 : ((k:ℝ) + 2) / ((k:ℝ) + 1) ≤ Real.exp (1 / ((k:ℝ) + 1)) := by
        rw [e2]; exact Real.add_one_le_exp _
      have h3 : (k:ℝ) * (1 / ((k:ℝ) + 1)) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [mul_one_div, div_le_one hk1]; linarith
      calc (((k:ℝ) + 2) / ((k:ℝ) + 1)) ^ k ≤ (Real.exp (1 / ((k:ℝ) + 1))) ^ k :=
            pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h1 k
        _ = Real.exp ((k:ℝ) * (1 / ((k:ℝ) + 1))) := (Real.exp_nat_mul _ k).symm
        _ ≤ Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h3
        _ ≤ 3 := by have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9; linarith
    have hsph : ∀ ξ ∈ Metric.sphere u δ, ‖f ξ‖ ≤ 3 * c * ((ρ - σ)⁻¹) ^ k := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hξ' : ξ ∈ axRect (σ + δ) := hball (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hξ)
      have := hb (σ + δ) ξ (by linarith) (by linarith) hξ'
      calc ‖f ξ‖ ≤ c * ((ρ - (σ + δ))⁻¹) ^ k := this
        _ ≤ c * (3 * ((ρ - σ)⁻¹) ^ k) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hratio hc
        _ = 3 * c * ((ρ - σ)⁻¹) ^ k := by ring

    calc ‖deriv f u‖ ≤ 3 * c * ((ρ - σ)⁻¹) ^ k / δ := hcd
      _ = 3 * ((k : ℝ) + 2) * c * ((ρ - σ)⁻¹) ^ (k + 1) := by
        rw [hδ, pow_succ]; field_simp
  
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by linarith

  have hwr : w ∈ axRect r := by

  have term0 : ∀ (e : ℝ) (a0 Ws H P P' : ℂ), 0 ≤ e → ‖a0‖ ≤ M → ‖Ws‖ ≤ M → ‖H‖ ≤ M →

    intro v e i j a b d ζ0 V V' P P' hv he ha hb hd hζ0 hV hV' hP hP'

      intro x; rw [norm_div, hΛn]; exact div_le_self (norm_nonneg _) hΛ
    have hi0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ i := Nat.cast_nonneg i

    have hXL := (divL (-(a * V + d * V') / ((i : ℂ) + 1))).trans hX
    have hbV : ‖b * (V / (Λ:ℂ))‖ ≤ M * A := mb hb ((divL V).trans hV2)
    have hdζV : ‖d * ζ0 * V‖ ≤ M * M * A := mb (mb hd hζ0) hV2

        (d * ζ0 * V)

    have t1 := mb hQ hPB

    have t2 := mb (mb hjn hXL) hPB
    have hdVL : ‖d * V / (Λ:ℂ)‖ ≤ M * (v * t ^ i) := (divL _).trans (mb hd hV)
    have t3 := mb hdVL hP'
    have key3 : M * (v * t ^ i) * (3 * ((j:ℝ) + 2) * e * t ^ (j + 1)) =

        · obtain ⟨hV, hz⟩ := hv1 rfl
          have h2 : ‖(2 : ℂ)‖ = 2 := by norm_num
          rw [hV, norm_div, norm_neg, h2]
          calc ‖zw‖ / 2 ≤ M / 2 * t := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg zw]
            _ = _ := by push_cast; field_simp; ring
      · calc ‖Vm‖ ≤ _ := hv2 hm
          _ = (40 * M * G' / r / Λ) * ((r / 20) ^ m / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * t ^ m) := by ring
          _ ≤ (40 * M / r) * ((r / 20) ^ m / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * t ^ m) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hbΛ.trans hE') hW
          _ = _ := by ring
  
  have hBnd : ∀ n : ℕ, (∀ m ≤ n, ∀ s w, 0 ≤ s → s < r → w ∈ axRect s →
      ‖P m w - (-χ w / 2) ^ m / ((m.factorial : ℂ) * ((m + 1).factorial : ℂ))‖ ≤
        2 * (10 * M / r) * G / Λ * μ m * (r / 20) ^ m / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * ((r - s)⁻¹) ^ m ∧
      (2 ≤ m → ‖V m w‖ ≤ 40 * M * G' / r / Λ * (r / 20) ^ m / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * ((r - s)⁻¹) ^ m)) →
      ∀ m ≤ n, ∀ s w, 0 ≤ s → s < r → w ∈ axRect s →
        ‖P m w‖ ≤ (2 * Real.exp (10 * M / r) + 1) * (r / 20) ^ m / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * ((r - s)⁻¹) ^ m ∧
        ‖V m w‖ ≤ (40 * M / r) * (r / 20) ^ m / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * ((r - s)⁻¹) ^ m := by
    intro n hC m hm s w hs0 hsr hw
    obtain ⟨hq, hv⟩ := hC m hm s w hs0 hsr hw
    have hF := hF2 s hsr w hw
    obtain ⟨a1, a2, -⟩ := hA m ((r - s)⁻¹) (P m w) (V m w) _ (z w) (hF1 s hs0 hsr)
      (hebd (χ w) m hF.1) (fun h => by subst h; exact hV0 w)
      (fun h => by subst h; exact ⟨hV1 w, hF.2⟩) hq hv
    exact ⟨a1, a2⟩
  
  have hC : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ m ≤ n, ∀ s w, 0 ≤ s → s < r → w ∈ axRect s →
      ‖P m w - (-χ w / 2) ^ m / ((m.factorial : ℂ) * ((m + 1).factorial : ℂ))‖ ≤
        2 * (10 * M / r) * G / Λ * μ m * (r / 20) ^ m / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * ((r - s)⁻¹) ^ m ∧
      (2 ≤ m → ‖V m w‖ ≤ 40 * M * G' / r / Λ * (r / 20) ^ m / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * ((r - s)⁻¹) ^ m) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro m hm s w hs0 hsr hw
      obtain rfl : m = 0 := by omega
      refine ⟨?_, fun h => absurd h (by norm_num)⟩
      have e0 : P 0 w - (-χ w / 2) ^ 0 / (((0 : ℕ).factorial : ℂ) * (((0 : ℕ) + 1).factorial : ℂ)) = 0 := by
        rw [hP0 w]; simp
      rw [e0, norm_zero, hμ0]
      simp only [pow_zero, mul_one]
      positivity
    | succ n ih =>
      intro m hm s w hs0 hsr hw
      rcases Nat.of_le_succ hm with h | h
      · exact ih m h s w hs0 hsr hw
      · subst h
        have hB := hBnd n ih
        have hF := hF2 s hsr w hw
        have ht1 := hF1 s hs0 hsr
        obtain ⟨hqn, -⟩ := ih n le_rfl s w hs0 hsr hw
        have hcast : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = (n : ℝ) + 2 := by push_cast; ring
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hμs n, hcast]
          have hXb := hX n hB s w hs0 hsr hw
          have hcn : ‖(2 * ((n : ℂ) + 1) * ((n : ℂ) + 2))‖ = 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 2) := by
            have e : (2 * ((n : ℂ) + 1) * ((n : ℂ) + 2)) =
                ((2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
            rw [e, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
          have hid : 2 * ((n : ℂ) + 1) * ((n : ℂ) + 2) * (P (n + 1) w - (-χ w / 2) ^ (n + 1) /
              (((n + 1).factorial : ℂ) * ((n + 1 + 1).factorial : ℂ))) =
              (2 * ((n : ℂ) + 1) * ((n : ℂ) + 2) * P (n + 1) w + χ w * P n w) -
                χ w * (P n w - (-χ w / 2) ^ n / ((n.factorial : ℂ) * ((n + 1).factorial : ℂ))) := by
            linear_combination (-1 : ℂ) * herec (χ w) n
          have h1 : 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 2) * ‖P (n + 1) w - (-χ w / 2) ^ (n + 1) /
              (((n + 1).factorial : ℂ) * ((n + 1 + 1).factorial : ℂ))‖ ≤
              ‖2 * ((n : ℂ) + 1) * ((n : ℂ) + 2) * P (n + 1) w + χ w * P n w‖ +
                ‖χ w * (P n w - (-χ w / 2) ^ n / ((n.factorial : ℂ) * ((n + 1).factorial : ℂ)))‖ := by
            rw [← hcn, ← norm_mul, hid]
            exact norm_sub_le _ _
          have hD : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 2) := by positivity
          have h2 : ‖P (n + 1) w - (-χ w / 2) ^ (n + 1) /
              (((n + 1).factorial : ℂ) * ((n + 1 + 1).factorial : ℂ))‖ ≤
              (‖2 * ((n : ℂ) + 1) * ((n : ℂ) + 2) * P (n + 1) w + χ w * P n w‖ +
                ‖χ w * (P n w - (-χ w / 2) ^ n / ((n.factorial : ℂ) * ((n + 1).factorial : ℂ)))‖) /
                (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 2)) := by
            rw [le_div_iff₀ hD, mul_comm]; exact h1
          refine h2.trans (hgen (10 * M / r) (r / 20) ((r - s)⁻¹) (μ n) _ _ n hx0 hκ0 ht1 (hμb n).1 ?_ ?_)
          · refine hXb.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
            linear_combination (G / Λ * (r / 20) ^ n / ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((r - s)⁻¹) ^ (n + 1)) * hMx
          · rw [norm_mul]
            calc ‖χ w‖ * ‖P n w - (-χ w / 2) ^ n / ((n.factorial : ℂ) * ((n + 1).factorial : ℂ))‖
                ≤ M * (2 * (10 * M / r) * G / Λ * μ n * (r / 20) ^ n / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 *
                    ((r - s)⁻¹) ^ n) := mul_le_mul hF.1 hqn (norm_nonneg _) hM
              _ = _ := by
                linear_combination (2 * (10 * M / r) * G / Λ * μ n * (r / 20) ^ n / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 *
                    ((r - s)⁻¹) ^ n) * hMx
        · intro h2n
          have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by omega
          have hYb := hY n hn1 hB s w hs0 hsr hw
          have hnorm : ‖2 * ((n : ℂ) + 1) ^ 2 * V (n + 1) w‖ = 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * ‖V (n + 1) w‖ := by
            have e : (2 * ((n : ℂ) + 1) ^ 2) = ((2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
            rw [norm_mul, e, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
          rw [hnorm] at hYb
          rw [hcast]
          exact hVstep _ _ n (by linarith) hYb
  intro n s w hs0 hsr hw
  obtain ⟨hq, hv⟩ := hC n n le_rfl s w hs0 hsr hw
  have hF := hF2 s hsr w hw
  obtain ⟨a1, a2, a3⟩ := hA n ((r - s)⁻¹) (P n w) (V n w) _ (z w) (hF1 s hs0 hsr)
    (hebd (χ w) n hF.1) (fun h => by subst h; exact hV0 w)
    (fun h => by subst h; exact ⟨hV1 w, hF.2⟩) hq hv
  exact ⟨a1, a2, a3, hv⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 om : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < ρ1 → 0 < t1 → t1 ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < om → AxAxisOut h j0 σ δ Pax Λ C K ρ1 Kder Fn Un → ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un X η = axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn X η ∧ axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un X η = axFfModelU Λ t1 κ0 Un X η

signature.name: ax_ff_model_eq
signature.statement: ∀ (h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 om : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < ρ1 → 0 < t1 → t1 ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < om → AxAxisOut h j0 σ δ Pax Λ C K ρ1 Kder Fn Un → ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un X η = axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn X η ∧ axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un X η = axFfModelU Λ t1 κ0 Un X η

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 om Pax Kder Fn Un hΛ hρ1 ht1 ht1' hom hA X η _hX hX2 hη1 hη2
  have hΛ0 : 0 < Λ := by linarith
  have hc : 0 < 4 / Λ := div_pos (by norm_num) hΛ0
  have s3 : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → (∀ s, s ≤ c → g s = 0) → ∀ Y : ℝ,
      (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..Y, g s) = ∫ s in c..Y, g s := by
    intro g c hc0 hg Y
    by_cases hY : Y ≤ c
    · have e1 : (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..Y, g s) = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..Y, (0:ℝ) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro s hs
        rcases Set.mem_uIcc.mp hs with ⟨_, h2⟩ | ⟨_, h2⟩
        · exact hg s (by linarith)
        · exact hg s (by linarith)
      have e2 : (∫ s in c..Y, g s) = ∫ s in c..Y, (0:ℝ) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro s hs
        rcases Set.mem_uIcc.mp hs with ⟨_, h2⟩ | ⟨_, h2⟩
        · exact hg s (by linarith)
        · exact hg s (by linarith)
      rw [e1, e2, intervalIntegral.integral_zero, intervalIntegral.integral_zero]
    · push_neg at hY
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by linarith), intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hY.le]
      refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioc
        (Set.Ioc_subset_Ioc_left hc0.le) ?_
      intro x hx
      apply hg
      by_contra hxc
      push_neg at hxc
      exact hx.2 ⟨hxc, hx.1.2⟩
  have hzero : ∀ s, s ≤ 4 / Λ → axEa Λ t1 κ0 s = 0 := by
    intro s hs
    unfold axEa
    rw [if_pos hs]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ax_collar_rep_F h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 om Pax Kder Fn Un hΛ hρ1 ht1 ht1' hom hA X η hX2 hη1 hη2]
    unfold axFfModelF
    rw [s3 (fun s => axEa Λ t1 κ0 s * (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) s * (Fn s η)⁻¹)) (4 / Λ) hc
      (fun s hs => by simp only [hzero s hs, zero_mul]) X, neg_one_mul]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
  · rw [ax_collar_rep_U h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 om Pax Kder Fn Un hΛ hρ1 ht1 ht1' hom hA X η hX2 hη1 hη2]
    unfold axFfModelU
    rw [s3 (fun s => axEa Λ t1 κ0 s * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) s) (4 / Λ) hc
      (fun s hs => by simp only [hzero s hs, zero_mul]) X]
    ring

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 om : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < ρ1 → 0 < t1 → t1 ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < om → AxAxisOut h j0 σ δ Pax Λ C K ρ1 Kder Fn Un → ∀ X η : ℝ, X < 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un X η = Fn X η * Real.exp (-1 * ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, axEa Λ t1 κ0 s * (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) s * (Fn s η)⁻¹))

subgoal_signatures.name: ax_collar_rep_U
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 om : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < ρ1 → 0 < t1 → t1 ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < om → AxAxisOut h j0 σ δ Pax Λ C K ρ1 Kder Fn Un → ∀ X η : ℝ, X < 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un X η = Un X η + -1 * ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, axEa Λ t1 κ0 s * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) s

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < ρ1 → 0 < t1 → t1 ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < κ0 → κ0 < 1 / 2 → AxAxisOut h j0 σ δ Pax Λ C K ρ1 Kder Fn Un → ∀ X η : ℝ, 4 / Λ < X → X < 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → HasDerivAt (fun Y => axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn Y η) ((1 - axEa Λ t1 κ0 X) * deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) X * axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn X η / Fn X η) X ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => axFfModelU Λ t1 κ0 Un Y η) ((1 - axEa Λ t1 κ0 X) * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) X) X

signature.name: ax_ff_model_deriv
signature.statement: ∀ (h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < ρ1 → 0 < t1 → t1 ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < κ0 → κ0 < 1 / 2 → AxAxisOut h j0 σ δ Pax Λ C K ρ1 Kder Fn Un → ∀ X η : ℝ, 4 / Λ < X → X < 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → HasDerivAt (fun Y => axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn Y η) ((1 - axEa Λ t1 κ0 X) * deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) X * axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn X η / Fn X η) X ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => axFfModelU Λ t1 κ0 Un Y η) ((1 - axEa Λ t1 κ0 X) * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) X) X

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 Pax Kder Fn Un hΛ hρ1 ht1 ht1' hκ0 hκ0' hA X η hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2
  obtain ⟨hFs, hUs, hpos, -⟩ := hA
  have hΛ0 : 0 < Λ := by linarith
  have hc : 0 < 4 / Λ := div_pos (by norm_num) hΛ0
  have hXpos : 0 < X := lt_trans hc hX1
  
  have he1 : Real.exp t1 < 41 / 40 := by
    have h1 : Real.exp t1 ≤ Real.exp (1 / 100) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ht1'
    have h2 : Real.exp (1 / 100) < 1 / (1 - 1 / 100) :=
      Real.exp_bound_div_one_sub_of_interval' (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have h3 : (1 : ℝ) / (1 - 1 / 100) < 41 / 40 := by norm_num
    linarith
  have hXV : X < 41 / (10 * Λ) := by
    have h1 : 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 < 4 / Λ * (41 / 40) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left he1 hc
    have h2 : 4 / Λ * (41 / 40) = 41 / (10 * Λ) := by field_simp; ring
    linarith
  have hVO : 41 / (10 * Λ) < 5 / Λ := by
    rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hΛ0]; nlinarith
  have hO0 : -1 / Λ < 0 := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by norm_num) hΛ0
  have hVsub : Ioo 0 (41 / (10 * Λ)) ⊆ Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) :=
    fun s hs => ⟨lt_trans hO0 hs.1, lt_trans hs.2 hVO⟩
  have hηS : η ∈ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hmaps : MapsTo (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, η)) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ))
      (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) := fun Y hY => ⟨hY, hηS⟩
  
  have hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => Fn Y η) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ)) :=
    hFs.comp ((contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffOn) hmaps
  have hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => Un Y η) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ)) :=
    hUs.comp ((contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffOn) hmaps
  have hOo : IsOpen (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ)) := isOpen_Ioo
  have hVo : IsOpen (Ioo 0 (41 / (10 * Λ))) := isOpen_Ioo
  have hXVm : X ∈ Ioo 0 (41 / (10 * Λ)) := ⟨hXpos, hXV⟩
  have hXO : X ∈ Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) := hVsub hXVm
  have hdφ : ContinuousOn (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η)) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ)) :=
    hφ.continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen hOo (by simp)
  have hdψ : ContinuousOn (deriv (fun Y => Un Y η)) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ)) :=
    hψ.continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen hOo (by simp)
  have hφX : HasDerivAt (fun Y => Fn Y η) (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) X) X :=
    ((hφ.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hOo.mem_nhds hXO)).hasDerivAt
  have hψX : HasDerivAt (fun Y => Un Y η) (deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) X) X :=
    ((hψ.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hOo.mem_nhds hXO)).hasDerivAt
  
  have hFpos : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 (41 / (10 * Λ)), 0 < Fn s η :=
    fun s hs => hpos s η hs.1.le hs.2.le hηS.1 hηS.2
  
  have hsig : Continuous sigA := by
    have he_cont : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => expNegInvGlue (y * |y|)) :=
      (expNegInvGlue.contDiff (n := 0)).continuous.comp (continuous_id.mul continuous_abs)
    have he0 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      apply expNegInvGlue.zero_of_nonpos
      rw [abs_of_nonpos hy]
      nlinarith
    have hepos : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) = Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2) := by
      intro y hy
      rw [abs_of_pos hy]
      unfold expNegInvGlue
      rw [if_neg (by nlinarith)]
      congr 1
      rw [neg_div, one_div, sq]
    have hnn : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) := fun y => expNegInvGlue.nonneg _
    have hden : ∀ y : ℝ, expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) + expNegInvGlue ((1 - y) * |1 - y|) ≠ 0 := by
      intro y
      apply ne_of_gt
      rcases lt_or_ge 0 y with hy | hy
      · rw [hepos y hy]
        linarith [Real.exp_pos (-1 / y ^ 2), hnn (1 - y)]
      · rw [hepos (1 - y) (by linarith)]
        linarith [Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - y) ^ 2), hnn y]
    have hfun : sigA = fun y => expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) /
        (expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) + expNegInvGlue ((1 - y) * |1 - y|)) := by
      funext y
      unfold sigA
      split_ifs with h1 h2
      · rw [he0 y h1, zero_div]
      · rw [he0 (1 - y) (by linarith), add_zero]
        have hne : expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) ≠ 0 := by
          rw [hepos y (by linarith)]; exact (Real.exp_pos _).ne'
        exact (div_self hne).symm
      · push_neg at h1 h2
        rw [hepos y h1, hepos (1 - y) (by linarith)]
    have h1m : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => expNegInvGlue ((1 - y) * |1 - y|)) :=
      he_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)
    rw [hfun]
    exact he_cont.div (he_cont.add h1m) hden
  have hEa : ContinuousOn (fun s => axEa Λ t1 κ0 s) (Ioi 0) := by
    have hlog : ContinuousOn (fun s => Real.log (s * Λ / 4)) (Ioi 0) :=
      ContinuousOn.log (by fun_prop) (fun s hs => (div_pos (mul_pos hs hΛ0) (by norm_num)).ne')
    have he1c : ContinuousOn (fun s => (1 - κ0) * sigA (Real.log (s * Λ / 4) / t1)) (Ioi 0) :=
      continuousOn_const.mul (hsig.comp_continuousOn (hlog.div_const t1))
    refine he1c.congr ?_
    intro s hs
    have hs0 : (0 : ℝ) < s := hs
    show axEa Λ t1 κ0 s = (1 - κ0) * sigA (Real.log (s * Λ / 4) / t1)
    unfold axEa axLogY
    split_ifs with hsl
    · have hle : s * Λ / 4 ≤ 1 := by
        rw [div_le_one (by norm_num)]
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hΛ0] at hsl
        linarith
      have hlg : Real.log (s * Λ / 4) ≤ 0 :=
        Real.log_nonpos (div_pos (mul_pos hs0 hΛ0) (by norm_num)).le hle
      have hneg : Real.log (s * Λ / 4) / t1 ≤ 0 := div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hlg ht1.le
      have hs0' : sigA (Real.log (s * Λ / 4) / t1) = 0 := by
        unfold sigA; rw [if_pos hneg]
      rw [hs0', mul_zero]
    · rfl
  
  have hEaV : ContinuousOn (fun s => axEa Λ t1 κ0 s) (Ioo 0 (41 / (10 * Λ))) :=
    hEa.mono (fun s hs => hs.1)
  have hg : ContinuousOn (fun s => axEa Λ t1 κ0 s * (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) s / Fn s η))
      (Ioo 0 (41 / (10 * Λ))) :=
    hEaV.mul ((hdφ.mono hVsub).div (hφ.continuousOn.mono hVsub) (fun s hs => (hFpos s hs).ne'))
  have hk : ContinuousOn (fun s => axEa Λ t1 κ0 s * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) s)
      (Ioo 0 (41 / (10 * Λ))) :=
    hEaV.mul (hdψ.mono hVsub)
  have hIcc : Icc (4 / Λ) X ⊆ Ioo 0 (41 / (10 * Λ)) :=
    fun s hs => ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hc hs.1, lt_of_le_of_lt hs.2 hXV⟩
  
  have hI : HasDerivAt
      (fun u => ∫ s in (4 / Λ)..u, axEa Λ t1 κ0 s * (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) s / Fn s η))
      (axEa Λ t1 κ0 X * (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) X / Fn X η)) X :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right ((hg.mono hIcc).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hX1.le)
      (hg.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter hVo X hXVm) (hg.continuousAt (hVo.mem_nhds hXVm))
  have hJ : HasDerivAt
      (fun u => ∫ s in (4 / Λ)..u, axEa Λ t1 κ0 s * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) s)
      (axEa Λ t1 κ0 X * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) X) X :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right ((hk.mono hIcc).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hX1.le)
      (hk.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter hVo X hXVm) (hk.continuousAt (hVo.mem_nhds hXVm))
  have hF0 : Fn X η ≠ 0 := (hFpos X hXVm).ne'
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have hprod := hφX.mul (hI.neg.exp)
    simp only [Pi.neg_apply] at hprod
    unfold axFfModelF
    convert hprod using 1
    field_simp
    ring
  · 
    unfold axFfModelU
    convert hψX.sub hJ using 1
    ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h Pst j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), AxDatumSmooth → AxDatum h Pst Pax → 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < ρ1 → 0 < t1 → t1 ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < κ0 → κ0 < 1 / 2 → AxAxisOut h j0 σ δ Pax Λ C K ρ1 Kder Fn Un → ∃ (Bθ Bz : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (Cd : ℝ), osbGood (Ioo (4 / Λ) (4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 / 2)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Ioo (4 / Λ) (4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 / 2)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) Bθ ∧ osbGood (Ioo (4 / Λ) (4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 / 2)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Ioo (4 / Λ) (4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 / 2)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) Bz ∧ ∀ X η : ℝ, 4 / Λ < X → X < 4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 / 2) → -1 < η → η < 1 → leadStressTh h (axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn) (axFfModelU Λ t1 κ0 Un) X η = axEa Λ t1 κ0 X * Bθ (X, η) ∧ axTz h Pax (axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn) (axFfModelU Λ t1 κ0 Un) X η = axEa Λ t1 κ0 X * Bz (X, η) ∧ |axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn X η - Fn X η| ≤ Cd * axLogY Λ X ∧ |Bθ (X, η) - axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn X η * shearA Fn X η| ≤ Cd * axLogY Λ X ∧ |Bz (X, η) + Fn X η * shearB Fn Un X η| ≤ Cd * axLogY Λ X
