proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Pst j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 Pax Kder Fn Un hSm hD hΛ hρ1 ht1 ht1' hκ0 hκ0' hA
  have hh0 : 0 < h := hD.1
  have hh1 : h < 1 / 100 := hD.2.1
  have hΛ0 : 0 < Λ := by linarith
  have hX0 : 0 < 4 / Λ := div_pos (by norm_num) hΛ0
  have hE : Real.exp (t1 / 2) < 41 / 40 := by
    have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(t1 / 2))
    have h2 : Real.exp (t1 / 2) * Real.exp (-(t1 / 2)) = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
    have hp := Real.exp_pos (t1 / 2)
    have h3 : Real.exp (t1 / 2) * (-(t1 / 2) + 1) ≤ Real.exp (t1 / 2) * Real.exp (-(t1 / 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hp.le
    nlinarith
  have hX41 : 4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 / 2) < 41 / (10 * Λ) := by
    calc 4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 / 2) < 4 / Λ * (41 / 40) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hE hX0
      _ = 41 / (10 * Λ) := by
        rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_eq_div_iff (by positivity) (by positivity)]; ring
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : Set (ℝ × ℝ), W = Ioo (4 / Λ) (4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 / 2)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hW]
  have hWo : IsOpen W := by rw [hW]; exact isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hWb : Bornology.IsBounded W := by
    rw [hW]; exact (Metric.isBounded_Ioo _ _).prod (Metric.isBounded_Ioo _ _)
  have hN0o : IsOpen (Ioo (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hN0b : Bornology.IsBounded (Ioo (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
    (Metric.isBounded_Ioo _ _).prod (Metric.isBounded_Ioo _ _)
  have Wmem : ∀ p ∈ W, 4 / Λ < p.1 ∧ p.1 < 4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 / 2) ∧ -1 < p.2 ∧ p.2 < 1 := by
    intro p hp; rw [hW] at hp; exact ⟨hp.1.1, hp.1.2, hp.2.1, hp.2.2⟩
  have memW : ∀ X η : ℝ, 4 / Λ < X → X < 4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 / 2) → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      (X, η) ∈ W := by
    intro X η a b c d; rw [hW]; exact ⟨⟨a, b⟩, ⟨c, d⟩⟩
  have hWN : W ⊆ Ioo (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ := Wmem p hp
    have h34 : 3 / Λ < 4 / Λ := div_lt_div_of_pos_right (by norm_num) hΛ0
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ⟨c, d⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨hmul, hadd, hsub, hinv, hcomp, hcst, -, -⟩ := ax_osb_algebra W hWo hWb
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hresN⟩ := ax_osb_algebra _ hN0o hN0b
  have resW : ∀ f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, osbGood (Ioo (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1)
      (Ioo (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) f → osbGood W W f :=
    fun f hf => hresN W f hWo hWN hf
  have toW : ∀ f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, osbGood (Ioo (4 / Λ) (4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 / 2)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1)
      (Ioo (4 / Λ) (4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 / 2)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) f → osbGood W W f := by
    intro f hf; rw [hW]; exact hf
  obtain ⟨hFnN, hFiN, hdFN, hUnN, hdUN, heN, -, -, hmom⟩ :=
    ax_ff_box_reg h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 Pax Kder Fn Un hΛ hρ1 ht1 ht1' hκ0 hκ0' hA
  have gF := resW _ hFnN
  have gFi := resW _ hFiN
  have gdF := resW _ hdFN
  have gU := resW _ hUnN
  have gdU := resW _ hdUN
  have ge := resW _ heN
  have gI0 := toW _ (hmom Un (Or.inl rfl)).1
  have gdI0 := toW _ (hmom Un (Or.inl rfl)).2.1
  have gI1 := toW _ (hmom (fun x e => 2 * x * Fn x e) (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))).1
  have gdI1 := toW _ (hmom (fun x e => 2 * x * Fn x e) (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))).2.1
  have gI2 := toW _ (hmom (fun x e => Un x e * (2 * x * Fn x e)) (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)))).1
  have gdI2 :=
    toW _ (hmom (fun x e => Un x e * (2 * x * Fn x e)) (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)))).2.1
  have gxi : osbGood W W (fun p => p.1⁻¹) :=
    hinv (fun p => p.1) (4 / Λ) (hcst _ (by fun_prop)) hX0 (fun p hp => by
      obtain ⟨a, -, -, -⟩ := Wmem p hp
      show 4 / Λ ≤ |p.1|
      rw [abs_of_pos (show 0 < p.1 by linarith)]; exact a.le)
  have gLi : osbGood W W (fun p => (1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
    hinv (fun p => 1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2) (1 / 2) (hcst _ (by fun_prop)) (by norm_num) (fun p hp => by
      obtain ⟨-, -, c, d⟩ := Wmem p hp
      have h1 : p.2 ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
      have h2 : 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2 ≤ 2 * h := by nlinarith
      show 1 / 2 ≤ |1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2|
      rw [abs_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2 by linarith)]; linarith)
  
  have hy : ∀ p ∈ W, 0 < axLogY Λ p.1 := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨a, -, -, -⟩ := Wmem p hp
    unfold axLogY
    apply Real.log_pos
    have h2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right a hΛ0
    have h3 : 4 / Λ * Λ = 4 := by field_simp
    linarith
  have bnd : ∀ g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, osbGood W W g → ∃ M, ∀ p ∈ W, |g p| ≤ M := by
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hg.2 0
    exact ⟨M, fun p hp => by
      have h1 := hM p hp
      rwa [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1⟩
  have oyM : ∀ g f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, osbGood W W g → axFfOyGood W Λ f →
      axFfOyGood W Λ (fun p => g p * f p) := by
    intro g f hg hf
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := bnd g hg
    obtain ⟨Cf, hCf⟩ := hf.2
    refine ⟨hmul g f hg hf.1, M * Cf, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    have h1 := hM p hp
    have h2 := hCf p hp
    show |g p * f p| ≤ M * Cf * axLogY Λ p.1
    rw [abs_mul]
    calc |g p| * |f p| ≤ M * (Cf * axLogY Λ p.1) :=
          mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans h1)
      _ = M * Cf * axLogY Λ p.1 := by ring
  have oyA : ∀ f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, axFfOyGood W Λ f → axFfOyGood W Λ g →
      axFfOyGood W Λ (fun p => f p + g p) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    obtain ⟨C1, h1⟩ := hf.2
    obtain ⟨C2, h2⟩ := hg.2
    refine ⟨hadd f g hf.1 hg.1, C1 + C2, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    show |f p + g p| ≤ (C1 + C2) * axLogY Λ p.1
    have k1 := abs_add_le (f p) (g p)
    have k2 := h1 p hp
    have k3 := h2 p hp
    linarith
  have oyS : ∀ f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, axFfOyGood W Λ f → axFfOyGood W Λ g →
      axFfOyGood W Λ (fun p => f p - g p) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    obtain ⟨C1, h1⟩ := hf.2
    obtain ⟨C2, h2⟩ := hg.2
    refine ⟨hsub f g hf.1 hg.1, C1 + C2, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    show |f p - g p| ≤ (C1 + C2) * axLogY Λ p.1
    have k1 := abs_sub (f p) (g p)
    have k2 := h1 p hp
    have k3 := h2 p hp
    linarith
  have oyC : ∀ c f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ c → axFfOyGood W Λ f →
      axFfOyGood W Λ (fun p => c p * f p) := fun c f hc hf => oyM c f (hcst c hc) hf
  
  obtain ⟨R1, R2, R3, D0, D1, D2, D3, D4, dD0, dD1, dD2, dD3, dD4, Cr, hgood, hrep⟩ :=
    ax_ff_flat_reps h Pst j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 Pax Kder Fn Un hSm hD hΛ hρ1 ht1 ht1' hκ0 hκ0' hA
  have mkO : ∀ f, f ∈ ({R1, R2, R3, D0, D1, D2, D3, D4, dD0, dD1, dD2, dD3, dD4} :
      Set (ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)) → axFfOyGood W Λ f := by
    intro f hf
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hgood f hf
    refine ⟨toW f h1, Cr, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ := Wmem p hp
    exact h2 p.1 p.2 a b c d
  have oR1 := mkO R1 (by simp)
  have oR2 := mkO R2 (by simp)
  have oR3 := mkO R3 (by simp)
  have oD0 := mkO D0 (by simp)
  have oD1 := mkO D1 (by simp)
  have oD2 := mkO D2 (by simp)
  have oD3 := mkO D3 (by simp)
  have oD4 := mkO D4 (by simp)
  have odD0 := mkO dD0 (by simp)
  have odD1 := mkO dD1 (by simp)
  have odD2 := mkO dD2 (by simp)
  have odD3 := mkO dD3 (by simp)
  have odD4 := mkO dD4 (by simp)
  
  obtain ⟨W1, hW1⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, f = fun p =>
      p.1⁻¹ * (2 * (1 / 2 - h) * p.2 * D0 p + (1 - p.2 ^ 2) * dD0 p) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have oW1 : axFfOyGood W Λ W1 := by
    rw [hW1]
    exact oyM _ _ gxi (oyA _ _ (oyC (fun p => 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * p.2) _ (by fun_prop) oD0)
      (oyC (fun p => 1 - p.2 ^ 2) _ (by fun_prop) odD0))
  obtain ⟨dM, hdM⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, f = fun p => (1 - h) * D1 p - (1 / 2 - h) * p.2 * dD1 p -
      (1 - p.2 ^ 2) * dD2 p + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * p.2 * D2 p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have odM : axFfOyGood W Λ dM := by
    rw [hdM]
    exact oyA _ _ (oyS _ _ (oyS _ _ (oyC (fun _ => 1 - h) _ (by fun_prop) oD1)
      (oyC (fun p => (1 / 2 - h) * p.2) _ (by fun_prop) odD1))
      (oyC (fun p => 1 - p.2 ^ 2) _ (by fun_prop) odD2))
      (oyC (fun p => 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * p.2) _ (by fun_prop) oD2)
  obtain ⟨Mn, hMn⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, f = fun p =>
      (1 - h) * profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * Fn x e) p.1 p.2
      - (1 / 2 - h) * p.2 * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * Fn x e)) p.1 p.2
      - (1 - p.2 ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => Un x e * (2 * x * Fn x e))) p.1 p.2
      + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * p.2 * profRadInt (fun x e => Un x e * (2 * x * Fn x e)) p.1 p.2 :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have gMn : osbGood W W Mn := by
    rw [hMn]
    exact hadd _ _ (hsub _ _ (hsub _ _ (hmul _ _ (hcst (fun _ => 1 - h) (by fun_prop)) gI1)
      (hmul _ _ (hcst (fun p => (1 / 2 - h) * p.2) (by fun_prop)) gdI1))
      (hmul _ _ (hcst (fun p => 1 - p.2 ^ 2) (by fun_prop)) gdI2))
      (hmul _ _ (hcst (fun p => 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * p.2) (by fun_prop)) gI2)
  have g1eR2 : osbGood W W (fun p => 1 + axEa Λ t1 κ0 p.1 * R2 p) :=
    hadd _ _ (hcst (fun _ => 1) contDiff_const) (hmul _ _ ge oR2.1)
  have g1eR1 : osbGood W W (fun p => 1 + axEa Λ t1 κ0 p.1 * R1 p) :=
    hadd _ _ (hcst (fun _ => 1) contDiff_const) (hmul _ _ ge oR1.1)
  have gK : osbGood W W (fun p => p.1⁻¹ * p.1⁻¹ * (Fn p.1 p.2)⁻¹ * (1 / 2)) :=
    hmul _ _ (hmul _ _ (hmul _ _ gxi gxi) gFi) (hcst (fun _ => 1 / 2) contDiff_const)
  obtain ⟨Q1, hQ1⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, f = fun p => W1 p + p.1⁻¹ * p.1⁻¹ * (Fn p.1 p.2)⁻¹ * (1 / 2) *
      ((1 + axEa Λ t1 κ0 p.1 * R2 p) * dM p + Mn p * R2 p) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have oQ1 : axFfOyGood W Λ Q1 := by
    rw [hQ1]
    exact oyA _ _ oW1 (oyM _ _ gK (oyA _ _ (oyM _ _ g1eR2 odM) (oyM _ _ gMn oR2)))
  have gFm : osbGood W W (fun p => Fn p.1 p.2 * (1 + axEa Λ t1 κ0 p.1 * R1 p)) :=
    hmul _ _ gF g1eR1
  obtain ⟨Eθ, hEθ⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, f = fun p => Fn p.1 p.2 * (1 + axEa Λ t1 κ0 p.1 * R1 p) *
      p.1 * (1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2)⁻¹ * Q1 p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have oEθ : axFfOyGood W Λ Eθ := by
    rw [hEθ]
    exact oyM _ _ (hmul _ _ (hmul _ _ gFm (hcst (fun p => p.1) (by fun_prop))) gLi) oQ1
  have gshA : osbGood W W (fun p => -2 * p.1 * deriv (fun Y => Fn Y p.2) p.1 * (Fn p.1 p.2)⁻¹) :=
    hmul _ _ (hmul _ _ (hcst (fun p => -2 * p.1) (by fun_prop)) gdF) gFi
  obtain ⟨Bθ, hBθ⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, f = fun p => Fn p.1 p.2 * (1 + axEa Λ t1 κ0 p.1 * R1 p) *
      (-2 * p.1 * deriv (fun Y => Fn Y p.2) p.1 * (Fn p.1 p.2)⁻¹) + Eθ p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have gBθ : osbGood W W Bθ := by rw [hBθ]; exact hadd _ _ (hmul _ _ gFm gshA) oEθ.1
  obtain ⟨lW, hlW⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, f = fun p => 1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * p.2 *
      (p.1⁻¹ * profRadInt Un p.1 p.2) - (1 - p.2 ^ 2) * (p.1⁻¹ * profEtaD (profRadInt Un) p.1 p.2) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have glW : osbGood W W lW := by
    rw [hlW]
    exact hsub _ _ (hsub _ _ (hcst (fun _ => 1) contDiff_const)
      (hmul _ _ (hcst (fun p => 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * p.2) (by fun_prop)) (hmul _ _ gxi gI0)))
      (hmul _ _ (hcst (fun p => 1 - p.2 ^ 2) (by fun_prop)) (hmul _ _ gxi gdI0))
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, f = fun p => (1 / 2 - h) * (D0 p - p.2 * dD0 p) +
      4 * h * p.2 * D3 p - (1 - p.2 ^ 2) * dD3 p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have oT : axFfOyGood W Λ T := by
    rw [hT]
    exact oyS _ _ (oyA _ _ (oyC (fun _ => 1 / 2 - h) _ (by fun_prop)

    have hXO : (X, η0) ∈ O := ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith [hX.2]⟩, hη0a, hη0b⟩
    have hP : 0 < psLead1 h Fn Un X η0 := (hA6 X η0 hXpos hX41 hη0a hη0b).2.2.2.2.2.2.2
    have hL : 1 - 2 * h * η0 ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; unfold psLead1 at hP; rw [h0, div_zero] at hP; exact lt_irrefl _ hP
    have hFX : Fn X η0 ≠ 0 := (hA3 X η0 hXpos.le hX41 hη0a hη0b).ne'
    have hcF : ContinuousAt (fun e => Fn X e) η0 :=
      (hFc.continuousAt (hO.mem_nhds hXO)).comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousAt
    have hX5 : X < 5 / Λ := by linarith [hX.2]
    have hg2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e => 2 * x * Fn x e)) O := by
      show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * p.1 * Fn p.1 p.2) O
      exact (contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_fst).mul hA1
    have hg3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e => Un x e * (2 * x * Fn x e))) O := by
      show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Un p.1 p.2 * (2 * p.1 * Fn p.1 p.2)) O
      exact hA2.mul hg2
    obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := hs2 Un hA2 X η0 hXpos.le hX5 hη0a hη0b
    obtain ⟨c3, c4⟩ := hs2 _ hg2 X η0 hXpos.le hX5 hη0a hη0b
    obtain ⟨c5, c6⟩ := hs2 _ hg3 X η0 hXpos.le hX5 hη0a hη0b
    have hPc : ContinuousAt (fun e => psLead1 h Fn Un X e) η0 :=
      hs3 X η0 hXpos hFX hL hcF c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6
    have hSc : ContinuousWithinAt (fun e => shearA Fn X e) (Icc (-1) 1) η0 :=
      (hShAc.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn
        (fun e he => ⟨hX, he⟩)) η0 hη0I
    have hcl : η0 ∈ closure (Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
      rw [closure_Ioo (by norm_num)]; exact hη0I
    haveI := mem_closure_iff_nhdsWithin_neBot.mp hcl
    have t1' : Filter.Tendsto (fun e => shearA Fn X e) (nhdsWithin η0 (Ioo (-1) 1))
        (nhds (shearA Fn X η0)) := (hSc.mono Ioo_subset_Icc_self).tendsto
    have t2' : Filter.Tendsto (fun e => shearA Fn X e) (nhdsWithin η0 (Ioo (-1) 1))
        (nhds (psLead1 h Fn Un X η0)) := by
      refine (hPc.continuousWithinAt.tendsto).congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with e he
      exact ((hnat X e hXpos hX41 he.1 he.2).1).symm
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique t1' t2'
  have hShApos : ∀ z ∈ Kb, 0 < shearA Fn z.1 z.2 := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨hz1, hz2, hz3, hz4⟩ := hKfacts z hz
    obtain ⟨hzx, hze1, hze2⟩ := hz
    have hP : 0 < psLead1 h Fn Un z.1 z.2 := (hA6 z.1 z.2 hz1 hz2 hz3 hz4).2.2.2.2.2.2.2
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hze1 with hl | hl
    · rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hze2 with hu | hu
      · rw [(hnat z.1 z.2 hz1 hz2 hl hu).1]; exact hP
      · rw [hBd z.1 z.2 hzx (Or.inl hu)]; exact hP
    · rw [hBd z.1 z.2 hzx (Or.inr hl.symm)]; exact hP
  
  have hFcK : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Fn z.1 z.2) Kb := hFc.mono hKO
  obtain ⟨zF, hzF, hminF⟩ := hKc.exists_isMinOn hKne hFcK
  obtain ⟨zA, hzA, hminA⟩ := hKc.exists_isMinOn hKne hShAc
  obtain ⟨MF, hMF⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hFcK
  obtain ⟨MA, hMA⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hShAc
  obtain ⟨MB, hMB⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hShBc
  have hmF : 0 < Fn zF.1 zF.2 := hFposK zF hzF
  have hmA : 0 < shearA Fn zA.1 zA.2 := hShApos zA hzA
  obtain ⟨Cc, hCc⟩ : ∃ Cc : ℝ, Cc = max (max 1 MF)
      (max (max (1 / Fn zF.1 zF.2) MA) (max (1 / shearA Fn zA.1 zA.2) MB)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hC1 : 1 ≤ Cc := by rw [hCc]; exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hCMF : MF ≤ Cc := by rw [hCc]; exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hCmF : 1 / Fn zF.1 zF.2 ≤ Cc := by
    rw [hCc]; exact le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hCMA : MA ≤ Cc := by
    rw [hCc]; exact le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hCmA : 1 / shearA Fn zA.1 zA.2 ≤ Cc := by
    rw [hCc]; exact le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hCMB : MB ≤ Cc := by
    rw [hCc]; exact le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hCc0 : 0 < Cc := by linarith
  have h1mF : 1 / Cc ≤ Fn zF.1 zF.2 := (one_div_le hCc0 hmF).mpr hCmF
  have h1mA : 1 / Cc ≤ shearA Fn zA.1 zA.2 := (one_div_le hCc0 hmA).mpr hCmA
  refine ⟨Cc, hC1, fun X η hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2 => ?_⟩
  have hz : (X, η) ∈ Kb := ⟨⟨hX1, hX2⟩, hη1.le, hη2.le⟩
  have hXpos : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hX0 hX1
  have hX41 : X ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) := by linarith
  have hFmin : Fn zF.1 zF.2 ≤ Fn X η := isMinOn_iff.mp hminF (X, η) hz
  have hAmin : shearA Fn zA.1 zA.2 ≤ shearA Fn X η := isMinOn_iff.mp hminA (X, η) hz
  have hFn : ‖Fn X η‖ ≤ MF := hMF (X, η) hz
  have hAn : ‖shearA Fn X η‖ ≤ MA := hMA (X, η) hz
  have hBn : ‖shearB Fn Un X η‖ ≤ MB := hMB (X, η) hz
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hFn hAn hBn
  
  obtain ⟨hIA, hIB⟩ := hnat X η hXpos hX41 hη1 hη2
  have hRF : ∀ x e : ℝ, 0 < x → x < 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 → -1 < e → e < 1 →
      axRefF Λ t1 Fn x e = Fn x e ∧ axRefU Λ t1 Un x e = Un x e := by
    intro x e hx1 hx2 _ _
    have hlog : axLogY Λ x ≤ t1 := by
      unfold axLogY
      rw [Real.log_le_iff_le_exp (div_pos (mul_pos hx1 hΛ0) (by norm_num))]
      have h3 : x * Λ < 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 * Λ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hx2 hΛ0
      have e2 : 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 * Λ = 4 * Real.exp t1 := by field_simp
      linarith
    unfold axRefF axRefU
    rw [if_pos (Or.inr hlog), if_pos (Or.inr hlog)]
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  have hXX1 : X < 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hX2 hXmX1
  have hloc := ax_stress_local.1 h (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) Pax Fn Un (axRefF Λ t1 Fn)
    (axRefU Λ t1 Un) hRF X η hXpos hXX1 hη1 hη2
  have hP1 : psLead1 h (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) X η = psLead1 h Fn Un X η := by
    unfold psLead1; rw [hloc.1]
  have hP2 : axPs2 h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) X η = axPs2 h Pax Fn Un X η := by
    unfold axPs2; rw [hloc.2.1, (hRF X η hXpos hXX1 hη1 hη2).1]
  have hX110 : X ≤ 110 := by linarith
  have hgap := (hR4 X η hX1 hX110 hη1.le hη2.le).2.2.2.1
  rw [hP1, hP2, ← hIA, hIB, neg_sq] at hgap
  refine ⟨le_trans h1mF hFmin, le_trans (le_trans (le_abs_self _) hFn) hCMF,
    le_trans h1mA hAmin, le_trans (le_trans (le_abs_self _) hAn) hCMA, le_trans hBn hCMB,
    by linarith⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (Λ t1 ρ1 : ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < t1 → t1 ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < ρ1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Fn) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Un) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → 0 < Fn X η) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axRefF Λ t1 Fn)) (Ioi (-1 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axRefU Λ t1 Un)) (Ioi (-1 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → 0 < axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, X < 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 → axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η = Fn X η ∧ axRefU Λ t1 Un X η = Un X η) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 4 / Λ * Real.exp (2 * t1) ≤ X → axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η = axRefF Λ t1 Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp (2 * t1)) η ∧ axRefU Λ t1 Un X η = axRefU Λ t1 Un (4 / Λ * Real.exp (2 * t1)) η) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → X * deriv (fun Y => axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η) X = (1 - sigA ((axLogY Λ X - t1) / t1)) * (X * deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) X / Fn X η) * axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η ∧ X * deriv (fun Y => axRefU Λ t1 Un Y η) X = (1 - sigA ((axLogY Λ X - t1) / t1)) * (X * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) X)) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 4 / Λ * Real.exp (2 * t1) ≤ X → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → deriv (fun Y => axRefU Λ t1 Un Y η) X = 0)

signature.statement: ∀ (Λ t1 ρ1 : ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < t1 → t1 ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < ρ1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Fn) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Un) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → 0 < Fn X η) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axRefF Λ t1 Fn)) (Ioi (-1 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axRefU Λ t1 Un)) (Ioi (-1 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → 0 < axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, X < 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 → axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η = Fn X η ∧ axRefU Λ t1 Un X η = Un X η) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 4 / Λ * Real.exp (2 * t1) ≤ X → axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η = axRefF Λ t1 Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp (2 * t1)) η ∧ axRefU Λ t1 Un X η = axRefU Λ t1 Un (4 / Λ * Real.exp (2 * t1)) η) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → X * deriv (fun Y => axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η) X = (1 - sigA ((axLogY Λ X - t1) / t1)) * (X * deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) X / Fn X η) * axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η ∧ X * deriv (fun Y => axRefU Λ t1 Un Y η) X = (1 - sigA ((axLogY Λ X - t1) / t1)) * (X * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) X)) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 4 / Λ * Real.exp (2 * t1) ≤ X → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → deriv (fun Y => axRefU Λ t1 Un Y η) X = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Λ t1 ρ1 Fn Un hΛ ht1 ht1s hρ1 hFs hUs hFpos
  
  have hΛpos : 0 < Λ := by linarith
  have hΛne : Λ ≠ 0 := hΛpos.ne'
  have h4pos : 0 < 4 / Λ := by positivity
  have hneg : -1 / Λ < 0 := by
    have : 0 < 1 / Λ := by positivity
    have e : -1 / Λ = -(1 / Λ) := by ring
    linarith
  have hexp1 : 1 < Real.exp t1 := by
    have := Real.add_one_lt_exp ht1.ne'; linarith
  have hexp12 : Real.exp t1 < Real.exp (2 * t1) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have hexp2 : Real.exp (2 * t1) < 41 / 40 := by
    have h := Real.abs_exp_sub_one_sub_id_le (x := 2 * t1)
      (by rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * t1)]; linarith)
    have h2 := le_abs_self (Real.exp (2 * t1) - 1 - 2 * t1)
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht1s ht1.le]
  have h41 : 41 / (10 * Λ) = 4 / Λ * (41 / 40) := by
    first | (field_simp; ring) | field_simp
  have h5 : 41 / (10 * Λ) < 5 / Λ := by
    rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hΛpos]; linarith
  have hX1pos : 0 < 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 := by positivity
  have hX1X2 : 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 < 4 / Λ * Real.exp (2 * t1) :=
    mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hexp12 h4pos
  have hX2lt : 4 / Λ * Real.exp (2 * t1) < 41 / (10 * Λ) := by
    rw [h41]; exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hexp2 h4pos
  have hX1lt : 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 < 41 / (10 * Λ) := by linarith
  
  have hexpY : ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → 4 / Λ * Real.exp (axLogY Λ X) = X := by
    intro X hX
    have hp : 0 < X * Λ / 4 := by have := mul_pos hX hΛpos; linarith
    unfold axLogY
    rw [Real.exp_log hp]
    first | (field_simp; ring) | field_simp
  have hlogexp : ∀ c : ℝ, axLogY Λ (4 / Λ * Real.exp c) = c := by
    intro c
    unfold axLogY
    have : 4 / Λ * Real.exp c * Λ / 4 = Real.exp c := by
      first | (field_simp; ring) | field_simp
    rw [this, Real.log_exp]
  have hlogle : ∀ X c : ℝ, 0 < X → (axLogY Λ X ≤ c ↔ X ≤ 4 / Λ * Real.exp c) := by
    intro X c hX
    constructor
    · intro h
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h) h4pos.le
      rwa [hexpY X hX] at this
    · intro h
      rw [← Real.exp_le_exp]
      have h' : 4 / Λ * Real.exp (axLogY Λ X) ≤ 4 / Λ * Real.exp c := by rw [hexpY X hX]; exact h
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h' h4pos
  have hlogge : ∀ X c : ℝ, 0 < X → (c ≤ axLogY Λ X ↔ 4 / Λ * Real.exp c ≤ X) := by
    intro X c hX
    constructor
    · intro h
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h) h4pos.le
      rwa [hexpY X hX] at this
    · intro h
      rw [← Real.exp_le_exp]
      have h' : 4 / Λ * Real.exp c ≤ 4 / Λ * Real.exp (axLogY Λ X) := by rw [hexpY X hX]; exact h
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h' h4pos
  
  have hsig0 : ∀ z : ℝ, z ≤ 0 → sigA z = 0 := by
    intro z hz; rw [sigA, if_pos hz]
  have hsig1 : ∀ z : ℝ, 1 ≤ z → sigA z = 1 := by
    intro z hz; rw [sigA, if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hz]
  have hsigA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ sigA := sigA_collar_facts.1
  
  obtain ⟨gF, hgF⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ y η, g y η = (1 - sigA ((y - t1) / t1)) * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) *
      (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) / Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) η) :=
    ⟨fun y η => (1 - sigA ((y - t1) / t1)) * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) *
      (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) / Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) η), fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨gU, hgU⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ y η, g y η = (1 - sigA ((y - t1) / t1)) * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) *
      deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) :=
    ⟨fun y η => (1 - sigA ((y - t1) / t1)) * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) *
      deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y), fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hFdef : ∀ X η, axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η = if X ≤ 0 ∨ axLogY Λ X ≤ t1 then Fn X η else
      Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) η * Real.exp (∫ y in t1..axLogY Λ X, gF y η) := by
    intro X η; simp only [axRefF, hgF]
  have hUdef : ∀ X η, axRefU Λ t1 Un X η = if X ≤ 0 ∨ axLogY Λ X ≤ t1 then Un X η else
      Un (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) η + ∫ y in t1..axLogY Λ X, gU y η := by
    intro X η; simp only [axRefU, hgU]
  
  have hΩo : IsOpen (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have slice : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => deriv (fun Y => f Y p.2) p.1)
        (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) ∧
      ∀ X η : ℝ, (X, η) ∈ Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) →
        HasDerivAt (fun Y => f Y η) (deriv (fun Y => f Y η) X) X := by
    intro f hf
    have hcomp : ∀ X η : ℝ, (X, η) ∈ Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) →
        HasDerivAt (fun Y => f Y η) (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) X := by
      intro X η hp
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿f) (X, η) :=
        (hf.contDiffAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hp)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have hl : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, η)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) X :=
        (hasDerivAt_id' X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X η)
      exact hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt X hl
    refine ⟨?_, fun X η hp => (hcomp X η hp).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt⟩
    have h1 := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hΩo).mp hf).2
    refine (h1.clm_apply (contDiffOn_const (c := ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))))).congr ?_
    intro p hp
    exact (hcomp p.1 p.2 hp).deriv
  obtain ⟨hDFs, hDF⟩ := slice Fn hFs
  obtain ⟨hDUs, hDU⟩ := slice Un hUs
  
  have hcut : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 1 - sigA ((p.1 - t1) / t1)) :=
    contDiff_const.sub (hsigA.comp ((contDiff_fst.sub contDiff_const).div_const t1))
  have hZs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 4 / Λ * Real.exp p.1) :=
    contDiff_const.mul (Real.contDiff_exp.comp contDiff_fst)
  have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (4 / Λ * Real.exp p.1, p.2)) := hZs.prodMk contDiff_snd
  have hmapΩ : ∀ y η : ℝ, Real.exp y < 41 / 40 → η ∈ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) →
      (4 / Λ * Real.exp y, η) ∈ Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) := by
    intro y η hy hη
    have h1 : 4 / Λ * Real.exp y < 41 / (10 * Λ) := by
      rw [h41]; exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy h4pos
    have h2 : 0 < 4 / Λ * Real.exp y := by positivity
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, hη⟩
  have hposZ : ∀ y η : ℝ, Real.exp y < 41 / 40 → η ∈ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) →
      0 < Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) η := by
    intro y η hy hη
    have h1 : 4 / Λ * Real.exp y < 41 / (10 * Λ) := by

    have hIF' : HasDerivAt (fun Y => ∫ y in t1..axLogY Λ Y, gF y η) (gF (axLogY Λ X) η * (1 / X)) X :=
      (hgFc.integral_hasStrictDerivAt t1 (axLogY Λ X)).hasDerivAt.comp X hlogd
    have hIU' : HasDerivAt (fun Y => ∫ y in t1..axLogY Λ Y, gU y η) (gU (axLogY Λ X) η * (1 / X)) X :=
      (hgUc.integral_hasStrictDerivAt t1 (axLogY Λ X)).hasDerivAt.comp X hlogd
    have hevF : (fun Y => axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X]
        (fun Y => Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) η * Real.exp (∫ y in t1..axLogY Λ Y, gF y η)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hX) (fun Y hY => (eqG Y η hY hη).1)
    have hevU : (fun Y => axRefU Λ t1 Un Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X]
        (fun Y => Un (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) η + ∫ y in t1..axLogY Λ Y, gU y η) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hX) (fun Y hY => (eqG Y η hY hη).2)
    have hdF : deriv (fun Y => axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η) X = Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) η *
        (Real.exp (∫ y in t1..axLogY Λ X, gF y η) * (gF (axLogY Λ X) η * (1 / X))) :=
      ((hIF'.exp.const_mul (Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) η)).congr_of_eventuallyEq hevF).deriv
    have hdU : deriv (fun Y => axRefU Λ t1 Un Y η) X = gU (axLogY Λ X) η * (1 / X) :=
      ((hIU'.const_add (Un (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) η)).congr_of_eventuallyEq hevU).deriv
    have hgX : gF (axLogY Λ X) η = (1 - sigA ((axLogY Λ X - t1) / t1)) * X *
        (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) X / Fn X η) := by
      rw [hgF, hexpY X hX]
    have hgXU : gU (axLogY Λ X) η = (1 - sigA ((axLogY Λ X - t1) / t1)) * X *
        deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) X := by
      rw [hgU, hexpY X hX]
    have hXi : X * (1 / X) = 1 := mul_one_div_cancel hX.ne'
    rw [hdF, hdU, (eqG X η hX hη).1, hgX, hgXU]
    constructor
    · linear_combination (Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) η * Real.exp (∫ y in t1..axLogY Λ X, gF y η) *
        (1 - sigA ((axLogY Λ X - t1) / t1)) * X * (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) X / Fn X η)) * hXi
    · linear_combination ((1 - sigA ((axLogY Λ X - t1) / t1)) * X * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) X) * hXi
  
  have hC7 : ∀ X η : ℝ, 4 / Λ * Real.exp (2 * t1) ≤ X → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 →
      deriv (fun Y => axRefU Λ t1 Un Y η) X = 0 := by
    intro X η hX h1 h2
    have hXpos : 0 < X := by linarith
    have hL : 2 * t1 ≤ axLogY Λ X := (hlogge X (2 * t1) hXpos).mpr hX
    have h := (hC6 X η hXpos h1 h2).2
    rw [hsig1 _ (by rw [le_div_iff₀ ht1]; linarith), sub_self, zero_mul] at h
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left hXpos.ne'
  exact ⟨hC1, hC2, hC3, hC4, hC5, hC6, hC7⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: profRadAvg_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profRadAvg g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(profRadAvg g)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → X * profRadAvg g X η = profRadInt g X η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * profRadAvg g Y η) (g X η) X)

subgoal_signatures.name: sigA_collar_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement: ContDiff ℝ ∞ sigA ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ collarG ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ collarGam ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → 1 - sigA (1 - u) = Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) * collarG u) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → HasDerivAt sigA (Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) / u ^ 3 * collarGam u) (1 - u)) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → 0 ≤ collarGam u) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → u ≤ 1 / 2 → Real.exp (-4) / 2 ≤ collarGam u)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h Pst : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ), AxDatum h Pst Pax → ∀ (j0 σ δ ρ : ℝ) (Pc : ℂ → ℂ), 0 < j0 → j0 ≤ 1 / 20 → AxData h j0 σ δ ρ Pc Pax → ∀ (Λ C K ρ1 : ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < K → 0 < ρ1 → 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < C → AxAxisOut h j0 σ δ Pax Λ C K ρ1 Kder Fn Un → ∃ ts : ℝ, 0 < ts ∧ ts ≤ 1 / 100 ∧ ∀ t1 : ℝ, 0 < t1 → t1 ≤ ts → ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 110 → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |axRefU Λ t1 Un X η - (4 * η + j0)| ≤ 2 * K / Λ ∧ |deriv (fun e => axRefU Λ t1 Un X e) η - 4| ≤ 2 * K / Λ ∧ 1 ≤ Kder 0 * (C * axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η) ∧ C * axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η ≤ Kder 0 ∧ (0 < X → deriv (fun Y => axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η) X ≤ 0 ∧ |X * deriv (fun Y => axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η) X / axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η| ≤ K * (axChi h j0 σ η + 1 / Λ) ∧ |axHs h j0 η * (deriv (fun e => axRefF Λ t1 Fn X e) η / axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η - Λ * axZeta h j0 σ η)| ≤ 2 * K * (axChi h j0 σ η + 1 / Λ) ∧ |deriv (fun e => axRefF Λ t1 Fn X e) η / axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η - Λ * axZeta h j0 σ η| ≤ 2 * K)

signature.statement: ∀ (h Pst : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ), AxDatum h Pst Pax → ∀ (j0 σ δ ρ : ℝ) (Pc : ℂ → ℂ), 0 < j0 → j0 ≤ 1 / 20 → AxData h j0 σ δ ρ Pc Pax → ∀ (Λ C K ρ1 : ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < K → 0 < ρ1 → 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < C → AxAxisOut h j0 σ δ Pax Λ C K ρ1 Kder Fn Un → ∃ ts : ℝ, 0 < ts ∧ ts ≤ 1 / 100 ∧ ∀ t1 : ℝ, 0 < t1 → t1 ≤ ts → ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 110 → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |axRefU Λ t1 Un X η - (4 * η + j0)| ≤ 2 * K / Λ ∧ |deriv (fun e => axRefU Λ t1 Un X e) η - 4| ≤ 2 * K / Λ ∧ 1 ≤ Kder 0 * (C * axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η) ∧ C * axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η ≤ Kder 0 ∧ (0 < X → deriv (fun Y => axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η) X ≤ 0 ∧ |X * deriv (fun Y => axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η) X / axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η| ≤ K * (axChi h j0 σ η + 1 / Λ) ∧ |axHs h j0 η * (deriv (fun e => axRefF Λ t1 Fn X e) η / axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η - Λ * axZeta h j0 σ η)| ≤ 2 * K * (axChi h j0 σ η + 1 / Λ) ∧ |deriv (fun e => axRefF Λ t1 Fn X e) η / axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η - Λ * axZeta h j0 σ η| ≤ 2 * K)

by
  intro h Pst Pax hD j0 σ δ ρ Pc hj0 hj0' hAD Λ C K ρ1 Kder Fn Un hK hρ1 hΛ hC hAx
  have hh0 : 0 < h := hD.1
  have hh1 : h < 1 / 100 := hD.2.1
  have hσ : 0 < σ := hAD.1
  obtain ⟨hA1, hA2, hA3, -, -, hA6, -, hA8⟩ := id hAx
  have hΛpos : 0 < Λ := by linarith
  have h4pos : 0 < 4 / Λ := div_pos (by norm_num) hΛpos
  have h1L : -1 / Λ < 0 := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by norm_num) hΛpos
  have hKB := ax_kder_slice_bounds Λ C ρ1 Kder Fn Un hΛ hC hρ1 hA1 hA2 hA3 hA8
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = |Kder 2| * |Kder 0| + |Kder 1| ^ 2 * |Kder 0| ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by rw [hB]; positivity
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ Q : ℝ, Q = 1 + |Kder 1| + |Kder 2| + B := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hQ0 : 0 < Q := by
    rw [hQ]; have := abs_nonneg (Kder 1); have := abs_nonneg (Kder 2); linarith
  refine ⟨min (1 / 200) (K / (80 * Q)), lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos hK (mul_pos (by norm_num) hQ0)),
    le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (by norm_num), ?_⟩
  intro t1 ht1 ht1s X η hX0 _hX110 hη1 hη2
  have ht1a : t1 ≤ 1 / 200 := le_trans ht1s (min_le_left _ _)
  have ht1b : t1 ≤ K / (80 * Q) := le_trans ht1s (min_le_right _ _)
  have hQt : 80 * Q * t1 ≤ K := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num) hQ0)] at ht1b; linarith
  have eQ : 80 * Q * t1 = 80 * t1 + 80 * (|Kder 1| * t1) + 80 * (|Kder 2| * t1) + 80 * (B * t1) := by
    rw [hQ]; ring
  have p1 : 0 ≤ |Kder 1| * t1 := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) ht1.le
  have p2 : 0 ≤ |Kder 2| * t1 := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) ht1.le
  have p3 : 0 ≤ B * t1 := mul_nonneg hB0 ht1.le
  have hE1 : 16 * (|Kder 1| * t1) ≤ K := by linarith
  have hE2 : 16 * (|Kder 2| * t1) ≤ K := by linarith
  have hE3 : 80 * (B * t1) ≤ K := by linarith
  
  have hexp1 : 1 < Real.exp t1 := by have := Real.add_one_lt_exp ht1.ne'; linarith
  have hexp12 : Real.exp t1 ≤ Real.exp (2 * t1) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have hexp2 : Real.exp (2 * t1) - 1 ≤ 4 * t1 := by
    have h' := Real.abs_exp_sub_one_le (x := 2 * t1)
      (by rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * t1)]; linarith)
    rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * t1)] at h'
    linarith [le_abs_self (Real.exp (2 * t1) - 1)]
  obtain ⟨X1, hX1⟩ : ∃ X1 : ℝ, X1 = 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨X2, hX2⟩ : ∃ X2 : ℝ, X2 = 4 / Λ * Real.exp (2 * t1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hX0X1 : 4 / Λ ≤ X1 := by rw [hX1]; exact le_mul_of_one_le_right h4pos.le hexp1.le
  have hX1pos : 0 < X1 := by linarith
  have hX12 : X1 ≤ X2 := by rw [hX1, hX2]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp12 h4pos.le
  have hX2le : X2 ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) := by
    have e1 : Real.exp (2 * t1) ≤ 41 / 40 := by linarith
    have e2 : 41 / (10 * Λ) = 4 / Λ * (41 / 40) := by field_simp; ring
    rw [hX2, e2]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e1 h4pos.le
  have h41 : 41 / (10 * Λ) < 5 / Λ := by
    rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hΛpos]; linarith
  have hX21 : X2 - X1 ≤ 16 * t1 / Λ := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp2 h4pos.le
    have e1 : 4 / Λ * (Real.exp (2 * t1) - 1) = X2 - 4 / Λ := by rw [hX2]; ring
    have e2 : 4 / Λ * (4 * t1) = 16 * t1 / Λ := by ring
    linarith
  
  have hlogX1 : axLogY Λ X1 = t1 := by
    unfold axLogY
    have : X1 * Λ / 4 = Real.exp t1 := by rw [hX1]; field_simp
    rw [this, Real.log_exp]
  have hlogX2 : axLogY Λ X2 = 2 * t1 := by
    unfold axLogY
    have : X2 * Λ / 4 = Real.exp (2 * t1) := by rw [hX2]; field_simp
    rw [this, Real.log_exp]
  have hlogmono : ∀ Y Z : ℝ, 0 < Y → Y ≤ Z → axLogY Λ Y ≤ axLogY Λ Z := by
    intro Y Z hY hYZ
    unfold axLogY
    apply Real.log_le_log (div_pos (mul_pos hY hΛpos) (by norm_num))
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hYZ hΛpos.le
    linarith
  have hEq : ∀ Y e : ℝ, Y ≤ X1 → axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y e = Fn Y e ∧ axRefU Λ t1 Un Y e = Un Y e := by
    intro Y e hY
    have hc : Y ≤ 0 ∨ axLogY Λ Y ≤ t1 := by
      rcases le_or_gt Y 0 with h0 | h0
      · exact Or.inl h0
      · exact Or.inr ((hlogmono Y X1 h0 hY).trans hlogX1.le)
    exact ⟨by unfold axRefF; rw [if_pos hc], by unfold axRefU; rw [if_pos hc]⟩
  
  have hsig : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ sigA u ∧ sigA u ≤ 1 := by
    intro u
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
    · have ha := Real.exp_pos (-1 / u ^ 2)
      have hb := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - u) ^ 2)
      exact ⟨div_nonneg ha.le (by linarith), (div_le_one (by linarith)).mpr (by linarith)⟩
  have hs01 : ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 ≤ 1 - sigA ((axLogY Λ Y - t1) / t1) ∧
      1 - sigA ((axLogY Λ Y - t1) / t1) ≤ 1 := by
    intro Y; have := hsig ((axLogY Λ Y - t1) / t1); constructor <;> linarith [this.1, this.2]
  have hsabs : ∀ Y : ℝ, |1 - sigA ((axLogY Λ Y - t1) / t1)| ≤ 1 := by
    intro Y; rw [abs_of_nonneg (hs01 Y).1]; exact (hs01 Y).2
  have hs0 : ∀ Y : ℝ, X2 ≤ Y → 1 - sigA ((axLogY Λ Y - t1) / t1) = 0 := by
    intro Y hY
    have hl : 2 * t1 ≤ axLogY Λ Y := hlogX2.symm.le.trans (hlogmono X2 Y (by linarith) hY)
    have hu : 1 ≤ (axLogY Λ Y - t1) / t1 := by rw [le_div_iff₀ ht1]; linarith
    have hn : ¬ ((axLogY Λ Y - t1) / t1 ≤ 0) := by linarith
    unfold sigA
    simp only [if_neg hn, if_pos hu, sub_self]
  
  obtain ⟨R1, R2, R3, -, R5, R6, -⟩ :=
    ax_ref_regular Λ t1 ρ1 Fn Un hΛ ht1 (by linarith) hρ1 hA1 hA2 hA3
  have hR5 : ∀ Y e : ℝ, X2 ≤ Y → axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y e = axRefF Λ t1 Fn X2 e ∧

    rw [hX2]; exact R5
  have hcl : ∀ Y e : ℝ, axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y e = axRefF Λ t1 Fn (min Y X2) e ∧
      axRefU Λ t1 Un Y e = axRefU Λ t1 Un (min Y X2) e := by
    intro Y e
    rcases le_total Y X2 with hY | hY
    · rw [min_eq_left hY]; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · rw [min_eq_right hY]; exact hR5 Y e hY
  have hO : IsOpen (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hOR : IsOpen (Ioi (-1 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hS : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hSsub : Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) ⊆ Ioi (-1 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) :=
    prod_mono (Ioi_subset_Ioi h1L.le) subset_rfl
  have memO : ∀ Y e : ℝ, 0 ≤ Y → Y ≤ X2 → -1 - ρ1 < e → e < 1 + ρ1 →
      (Y, e) ∈ Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) :=
    fun Y e h1 h2 h3 h4 => Set.mk_mem_prod ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩ ⟨h3, h4⟩
  have memOR : ∀ Y e : ℝ, 0 ≤ Y → -1 - ρ1 < e → e < 1 + ρ1 →
      (Y, e) ∈ Ioi (-1 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) :=
    fun Y e h1 h3 h4 => Set.mk_mem_prod (show -1 / Λ < Y by linarith) ⟨h3, h4⟩
  have hs1 : -1 - ρ1 < η := by linarith
  have hs2 : η < 1 + ρ1 := by linarith
  have hchi : 0 ≤ axChi h j0 σ η := by
    unfold axChi; exact div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by positivity)
  have hKL : 0 ≤ K / Λ := div_nonneg hK.le hΛpos.le
  have hk0 : 0 ≤ K * (axChi h j0 σ η + 1 / Λ) :=
    mul_nonneg hK.le (add_nonneg hchi (one_div_pos.mpr hΛpos).le)
  
  obtain ⟨hMon1, hMon2⟩ := ref_profile_monotone (fun Y => axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η) (fun Y => Fn Y η)
    (fun Y => 1 - sigA ((axLogY Λ Y - t1) / t1)) X1 X2 (K * (axChi h j0 σ η + 1 / Λ))
    hX1pos hX12 hk0
    (fun Y hY => (slice_deriv_facts (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) _ Y η hOR R1
      (memOR Y η hY.le hs1 hs2)).1.differentiableAt)
    (fun Y hY hYb => (slice_deriv_facts Fn _ Y η hO hA1 (memO Y η hY.le hYb hs1 hs2)).1.differentiableAt)
    (fun Y hY => R3 Y η hY.le hs1 hs2)
    (fun Y hY hYb => hA3 Y η hY.le (by linarith) hs1 hs2)
    hs01 hs0
    (fun Y hY => (R6 Y η hY hs1 hs2).1)
    (fun Y hY hYb => ax_axis_dX_nonpos h j0 σ δ Pax Λ C K ρ1 Kder Fn Un hΛ hρ1 hAx Y η hY
      (by linarith) hη1 hη2)
    (fun Y hY hYb => (hA6 Y η hY (by linarith) hs1 hs2).2.1)
    (hEq X1 η le_rfl).1
  have hF0 : 1 ≤ Kder 0 * (C * axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η) ∧ C * axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η ≤ Kder 0 := by
    rcases le_total X X1 with hXX | hXX
    · rw [(hEq X η hXX).1]
      have := hKB X η hX0 (by linarith) hs1 hs2
      exact ⟨this.1, this.2.1⟩
    · have hm1 : X1 ≤ min X X2 := le_min hXX hX12
      have hm2 : min X X2 ≤ X2 := min_le_right _ _
      obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := hMon2 X hXX
      have hk1 := hKB (min X X2) η (by linarith) (by linarith) hs1 hs2
      have hk2 := hKB X1 η hX1pos.le (by linarith) hs1 hs2
      have hFm : 0 < Fn (min X X2) η := hA3 _ η (by linarith) (by linarith) hs1 hs2
      have hK0 : 0 ≤ Kder 0 := le_trans (mul_pos hC hFm).le hk1.2.1
      constructor
      · calc (1:ℝ) ≤ Kder 0 * (C * Fn (min X X2) η) := hk1.1

      · calc C * axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η ≤ C * Fn X1 η := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb2 hC.le
          _ ≤ Kder 0 := hk2.2.1
  
  have hlim0 : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), ContinuousAt g 0 → (∀ Y, 0 < Y → Y < X1 → |g Y| ≤ c) →
      |g 0| ≤ c :=
    fun g c hg hb => le_of_tendsto (hg.abs.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds)
      (Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hX1pos) (fun Y hY => hb Y hY.1 hY.2))
  have hU0s : ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 ≤ Y → Y ≤ X1 → |Un Y η - (4 * η + j0)| ≤ K / Λ := by
    intro Y hY0 hY1
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hY0 with hY | hY

        ((slice_deriv_facts Un _ 0 η hO hA2 (memO 0 η le_rfl (by linarith) hs1 hs2)).1.continuousAt.sub

        (fun Y hy1 hy2 => (hA6 Y η hy1 (by linarith) hs1 hs2).2.2.2.2.1)
    · exact (hA6 Y η hY (by linarith) hs1 hs2).2.2.2.2.1
  have hU1s : ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 ≤ Y → Y ≤ X1 → |deriv (fun e => Un Y e) η - 4| ≤ K / Λ := by
    intro Y hY0 hY1
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hY0 with hY | hY
    · subst hY
      exact hlim0 (fun Y => deriv (fun e => Un Y e) η - 4) (K / Λ)
        ((slice_deriv_facts Un _ 0 η hO hA2 (memO 0 η le_rfl (by linarith) hs1 hs2)).2.2.2.2.2.sub
          continuousAt_const)
        (fun Y hy1 hy2 => (hA6 Y η hy1 (by linarith) hs1 hs2).2.2.2.2.2.1)
    · exact (hA6 Y η hY (by linarith) hs1 hs2).2.2.2.2.2.1
  
  have hU0 : |axRefU Λ t1 Un X η - (4 * η + j0)| ≤ 2 * K / Λ := by

  have hpdE : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profEtaD g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨hd, hG'⟩ := (contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hSo).1 hg
    refine (hG'.clm_apply (contDiffOn_const (c := ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))))).congr ?_
    intro p hp
    have hhas : HasFDerivAt (↿g) (fderiv ℝ (↿g) p) (p.1, p.2) :=
      ((hd p hp).differentiableAt (hSo.mem_nhds hp)).hasFDerivAt
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => (p.1, e)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) p.2 :=
      (hasDerivAt_const p.2 p.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' p.2)
    exact (hhas.comp_hasDerivAt p.2 hc).deriv
  
  have hrad : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profRadInt g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨hA, -, hId⟩ := profRadAvg_props g ε hε hg
    refine (contDiffOn_fst.mul hA).congr ?_
    intro p hp
    exact ((hId p.1 p.2 hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2).1).symm
  have g2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e : ℝ => 2 * x * F x e)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * p.1 * F p.1 p.2) _
    exact (contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_fst).mul hF
  have g3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e : ℝ => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)))
      (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => U p.1 p.2 * (2 * p.1 * F p.1 p.2)) _
    exact hU.mul ((contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_fst).mul hF)
  have a := (profRadAvg_props U ε hε hU).1
  have a' := hpdE _ a
  have I := hrad _ g2
  have I' := hpdE _ I
  have J := hrad _ g3
  have J' := hpdE _ J
  
  obtain ⟨Gf, hGfdef⟩ : ∃ Gf : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, Gf = fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      -(1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * p.2 * profRadAvg U p.1 p.2
        - (1 - p.2 ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadAvg U) p.1 p.2) * (p.1 * (2 * p.1 * F p.1 p.2)) +
      ((1 - h) * profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) p.1 p.2
        - (1 / 2 - h) * p.2 * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) p.1 p.2
        - (1 - p.2 ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))) p.1 p.2
        + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * p.2 * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) p.1 p.2) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Gf (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    have hW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * p.2 * profRadAvg U p.1 p.2
        - (1 - p.2 ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadAvg U) p.1 p.2) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
      (contDiffOn_const.sub ((contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_snd).mul a)).sub
        ((contDiffOn_const.sub (contDiffOn_snd.pow 2)).mul a')
    have hN : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        (1 - h) * profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) p.1 p.2
        - (1 / 2 - h) * p.2 * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) p.1 p.2
        - (1 - p.2 ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))) p.1 p.2
        + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * p.2 * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) p.1 p.2)
        (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
      (((contDiffOn_const.mul I).sub ((contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_snd).mul I')).sub
        ((contDiffOn_const.sub (contDiffOn_snd.pow 2)).mul J')).add
        ((contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_snd).mul J)
    have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 * (2 * p.1 * F p.1 p.2))
        (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
      contDiffOn_fst.mul ((contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_fst).mul hF)
    rw [hGfdef]
    exact (hW.neg.mul hD).add hN
  have hmaps : ∀ Y ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) X, (Y, η) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := fun Y hY =>
    ⟨show -ε < Y by linarith [hY.1], hη1, hη2⟩
  have hGc : ContinuousOn (fun Y : ℝ => Gf (Y, η)) (Icc 0 X) :=
    hG.continuousOn.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn hmaps
  
  have key : ∀ (d W N : ℝ), d ≠ 0 → d * (-W + N / d) = -W * d + N := by
    intro d W N hd
    have e : d * (N / d) = N := by field_simp
    rw [mul_add, e]
    ring
  have hEq : ∀ Y ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) X, Y * (2 * Y * F Y η) * leadQs h F U Y η = Gf (Y, η) := by
    intro Y hY
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hY.1 with h0 | hpos
    · subst h0
      simp [hGfdef, profRadInt, profEtaD]
    · have hd : Y * (2 * Y * F Y η) ≠ 0 := by
        have := hFpos Y η hY.1 hη1 hη2
        positivity
      unfold leadQs
      rw [key _ _ _ hd]
      simp only [hGfdef, leadW]
  
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ : ∃ ψ : ℝ → ℝ,
      ψ = fun Y => Y * (2 * Y * F Y η) * leadQs h F U Y η - s0 * F X η * Y ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hψc : ContinuousOn ψ (Icc 0 X) := by
    rw [hψ]
    refine ContinuousOn.congr (f := fun Y => Gf (Y, η) - s0 * F X η * Y ^ 2) ?_ ?_
    · exact hGc.sub (by fun_prop)
    · intro Y hY
      simp only [hEq Y hY]
  have hderiv : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → HasDerivAt ψ
      (2 * x * F x η * axSq h F U x η - s0 * F X η * (2 * x)) x := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := (ax_source_identity h ε Pax F U hh0 hh1 hε hF hU hFpos hPax x η hx hη1 hη2).1
    have h2 := (hasDerivAt_pow 2 x).const_mul (s0 * F X η)
    rw [hψ]
    convert h1.sub h2 using 1
    norm_num
  
  have hFsc : ContinuousOn (fun Y => F Y η) (Icc 0 X) :=
    hF.continuousOn.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn hmaps
  have hFdiff : ∀ x : ℝ, -ε < x → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y => F Y η) x := by
    intro x hx
    have hmem : (x, η) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨hx, hη1, hη2⟩
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿F) (x, η) :=
      (hF.contDiffAt (hSo.mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    exact hd.comp x ((hasDerivAt_id' x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const x η)).differentiableAt
  have hanti : AntitoneOn (fun Y => F Y η) (Icc 0 X) := by
    apply antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos (convex_Icc 0 X) hFsc
    · rw [interior_Icc]
      intro x hx
      exact (hFdiff x (by linarith [hx.1])).differentiableWithinAt
    · rw [interior_Icc]
      intro x hx
      exact hdF x hx.1 hx.2.le
  have hmono : MonotoneOn ψ (Icc 0 X) := by
    apply monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Icc 0 X) hψc
    · rw [interior_Icc]
      intro x hx
      exact (hderiv x hx.1).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    · rw [interior_Icc]
      intro x hx
      rw [(hderiv x hx.1).deriv]
      have hFx := hFpos x η hx.1.le hη1 hη2
      have hq := hSq x hx.1 hx.2.le
      have hFX : F X η ≤ F x η := hanti ⟨hx.1.le, hx.2.le⟩ ⟨hX.le, le_rfl⟩ hx.2.le
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hx.1.le hFx.le) (sub_nonneg.2 hq),
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hx.1.le hs0) (sub_nonneg.2 hFX)]
  have h0X := hmono ⟨le_rfl, hX.le⟩ ⟨hX.le, le_rfl⟩ hX.le
  rw [hψ] at h0X
  simp only at h0X
  have hz : (0:ℝ) * (2 * 0 * F 0 η) * leadQs h F U 0 η - s0 * F X η * 0 ^ 2 = 0 := by ring
  have hFXp := hFpos X η hX.le hη1 hη2
  have hdpos : 0 < X * (2 * X * F X η) := by positivity
  have hQ2 : s0 / 2 ≤ leadQs h F U X η := by
    refine le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ hdpos
    nlinarith
  have hsq : η ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
  have hL : 0 < 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 := by nlinarith [mul_pos hh0 (sub_pos.2 hsq)]
  have hL1 : 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg two_pos.le hh0.le) (sq_nonneg η)]
  unfold psLead1
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hL]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQ2 hX.le, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hs0 hX.le) (sub_nonneg.2 hL1)]

subgoal_signatures.name: profRadAvg_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profRadAvg g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(profRadAvg g)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → X * profRadAvg g X η = profRadInt g X η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * profRadAvg g Y η) (g X η) X)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h ε Λ σ j0 : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (η : ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 < ε → 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < σ → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Pax (Ioo (-1) 1) → -1 < η → η < 1 → 99 * σ ^ 2 < axHs h j0 η ^ 2 → (∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ 4 / Λ → leadStressTh h F U X η = 0) → (∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ 110 → deriv (fun Y => F Y η) X ≤ 0 ∧ 0 < psLead1 h F U X η ∧ 95 / 100 * Λ * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * axChi h j0 σ η ≤ axSq h F U X η) → ∀ X : ℝ, 4 / Λ ≤ X → X ≤ 110 → 12 / 5 ≤ psLead1 h F U X η

by
  intro h ε Λ σ j0 Pax F U η hh0 hh1 hε hΛ hσ hF hU hFpos hPax hη1 hη2 hHs hStr hMain X hX0 hX1
  
  have s3 : ∀ (Ψ d : ℝ → ℝ) (c X0 X1 : ℝ), 0 < X0 → X0 ≤ X1 → 0 ≤ c → 376 / 100 ≤ c * X0 →
      ContinuousOn Ψ (Icc 0 X0) → Ψ 0 = 0 →
      (∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → Y ≤ X1 → HasDerivAt Ψ (d Y) Y) →
      (∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → Y ≤ X1 → c * Y ≤ d Y) →
      (∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → Y < X0 → c * Y + Ψ Y ^ 2 / (2 * Y ^ 2) ≤ d Y) →
      ∀ X : ℝ, X0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → 12 / 5 * X ≤ Ψ X := by
    intro Ψ d c X0 X1 hX0 hX01 hc hk hΨc hΨ0 hΨd hd1 hd2 X hX hX'
    have hq2 : ∀ Y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun Y => c * Y ^ 2 / 2) (c * Y) Y := by
      intro Y
      have := ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 Y).const_mul c).div_const 2
      convert this using 1
      push_cast
      ring
    have hq3 : ∀ Y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun Y => c ^ 2 * Y ^ 3 / 24) (c ^ 2 * Y ^ 2 / 8) Y := by
      intro Y
      have := ((hasDerivAt_pow 3 Y).const_mul (c ^ 2)).div_const 24

    have st1 : ∀ Y ∈ Icc 0 X0, c * Y ^ 2 / 2 ≤ Ψ Y := by
      have hmono : MonotoneOn (fun Y => Ψ Y - c * Y ^ 2 / 2) (Icc 0 X0) := by

        · exact hΨc.sub (by fun_prop)

        · intro Y hY
          rw [interior_Icc] at hY
          have := hd1 Y hY.1 (by linarith [hY.2])
          show 0 ≤ d Y - c * Y
          linarith
      intro Y hY
      have h' : Ψ 0 - c * 0 ^ 2 / 2 ≤ Ψ Y - c * Y ^ 2 / 2 :=
        hmono ⟨le_refl 0, hX0.le⟩ hY hY.1
      have e : c * (0:ℝ) ^ 2 / 2 = 0 := by ring

      linarith
    
    have st2 : c * X0 ^ 2 / 2 + c ^ 2 * X0 ^ 3 / 24 ≤ Ψ X0 := by
      have hmono : MonotoneOn (fun Y => Ψ Y - c * Y ^ 2 / 2 - c ^ 2 * Y ^ 3 / 24) (Icc 0 X0) := by
        apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc 0 X0)
          (f' := fun Y => d Y - c * Y - c ^ 2 * Y ^ 2 / 8)
        · exact (hΨc.sub (by fun_prop)).sub (by fun_prop)
        · intro Y hY
          rw [interior_Icc] at hY
          have h1 := hΨd Y hY.1 (by linarith [hY.2])
          exact ((h1.sub (hq2 Y)).sub (hq3 Y)).hasDerivWithinAt
        · intro Y hY
          rw [interior_Icc] at hY
          have hY0 := hY.1
          have hR := hd2 Y hY.1 hY.2
          have hs1 := st1 Y ⟨hY.1.le, hY.2.le⟩
          have hq : c ^ 2 * Y ^ 2 / 8 ≤ Ψ Y ^ 2 / (2 * Y ^ 2) := by
            rw [le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos two_pos (pow_pos hY0 2))]
            have h0 : 0 ≤ c * Y ^ 2 / 2 := div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc (sq_nonneg Y)) (by norm_num)
            have := mul_le_mul hs1 hs1 h0 (le_trans h0 hs1)
            nlinarith
          show 0 ≤ d Y - c * Y - c ^ 2 * Y ^ 2 / 8
          linarith
      have h' : Ψ 0 - c * 0 ^ 2 / 2 - c ^ 2 * 0 ^ 3 / 24 ≤
          Ψ X0 - c * X0 ^ 2 / 2 - c ^ 2 * X0 ^ 3 / 24 :=
        hmono ⟨le_refl 0, hX0.le⟩ ⟨hX0.le, le_refl X0⟩ hX0.le
      have e : c * (0:ℝ) ^ 2 / 2 = 0 := by ring
      have e' : c ^ 2 * (0:ℝ) ^ 3 / 24 = 0 := by ring

      linarith
    have hkk : 12 / 5 ≤ (c * X0) / 2 + (c * X0) ^ 2 / 24 := by nlinarith [hk]
    have st2' : 12 / 5 * X0 ≤ Ψ X0 := by

      have e : X0 * ((c * X0) / 2 + (c * X0) ^ 2 / 24) = c * X0 ^ 2 / 2 + c ^ 2 * X0 ^ 3 / 24 := by
        ring
      linarith
    
    have hmono3 : MonotoneOn (fun Y => Ψ Y - c * Y ^ 2 / 2) (Icc X0 X) := by
      apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc X0 X) (f' := fun Y => d Y - c * Y)
      · apply continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt
        intro Y hY
        have := (hΨd Y (by linarith [hY.1]) (by linarith [hY.2])).continuousAt
        exact this.sub (by fun_prop)
      · intro Y hY
        rw [interior_Icc] at hY
        have h1 := hΨd Y (by linarith [hY.1]) (by linarith [hY.2])
        exact (h1.sub (hq2 Y)).hasDerivWithinAt
      · intro Y hY
        rw [interior_Icc] at hY
        have := hd1 Y (by linarith [hY.1]) (by linarith [hY.2])
        show 0 ≤ d Y - c * Y
        linarith
    have h3 : Ψ X0 - c * X0 ^ 2 / 2 ≤ Ψ X - c * X ^ 2 / 2 :=
      hmono3 ⟨le_refl _, hX⟩ ⟨hX, le_refl _⟩ hX
    have p1 : 0 ≤ c * (X - X0) ^ 2 := mul_nonneg hc (sq_nonneg _)
    have p2 : 0 ≤ (c * X0 - 376 / 100) * (X - X0) :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
    nlinarith
  
  have hΛpos : 0 < Λ := by linarith
  have hX0pos : 0 < 4 / Λ := div_pos (by norm_num) hΛpos
  have hX0le : 4 / Λ ≤ 110 := by
    have := div_le_self (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 4) hΛ
    linarith
  have hη2' : η ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith

  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = 95 / 100 * Λ * axChi h j0 σ η := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by

    rw [hc]
    have e : 95 / 100 * Λ * axChi h j0 σ η * (4 / Λ) = 19 / 5 * axChi h j0 σ η := by
      field_simp

    linarith
  
  have hO : IsOpen (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hfd : ∀ Y : ℝ, -ε < Y → HasDerivAt (fun Y => F Y η) (deriv (fun Y => F Y η) Y) Y := by
    intro Y hY

  have hfs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => F Y η) (Ioi (-ε)) :=
    hF.comp (contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffOn (fun Y hY => ⟨hY, hη1, hη2⟩)
  have hfc : ContinuousOn (deriv (fun Y => F Y η)) (Ioi (-ε)) :=
    hfs.continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioi (by simp)
  
  have hpS : ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → Y ≤ 4 / Λ →
      psLead1 h F U Y η = -2 * Y * deriv (fun Y => F Y η) Y / F Y η := by
    intro Y hY hY'
    have h0 := hStr Y hY hY'
    unfold leadStressTh at h0
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h0 with h1 | h1
    · exact absurd h1 (hFpos Y η hY.le hη1 hη2).ne'
    · unfold shearA at h1
      unfold psLead1
      linarith
  
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun Y => Y * psLead1 h F U Y η) (Icc 0 (4 / Λ)) := by
    have hsub : Icc 0 (4 / Λ) ⊆ Ioi (-ε) := fun Y hY => by
      simp only [mem_Ioi]; linarith [hY.1]
    have hg : ContinuousOn (fun Y => Y * (-2 * Y * deriv (fun Y => F Y η) Y / F Y η))
        (Icc 0 (4 / Λ)) := by

    · exact absurd h2 hf.ne'
    · unfold psLead1; linarith
  have hNn : X * axNs h Pax Fn Un X η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) =
      -(shearB Fn Un X η * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Fn X η)) := by
    have h1 := hst.2
    unfold axTz at h1
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h1 with h2 | h2
    · exact absurd h2 hf.ne'
    · have h3 : axPs2 h Pax Fn Un X η = -shearB Fn Un X η := by linarith
      unfold axPs2 at h3
      have hS : Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Fn X η ≠ 0 :=
        (mul_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)) hf).ne'
      calc X * axNs h Pax Fn Un X η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)
          = X * axNs h Pax Fn Un X η / ((1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Fn X η)) *
              (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Fn X η) := by
            rw [← div_div, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hS]
        _ = _ := by rw [h3]; ring
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hPax⟩ := hSm h Pst Pax hD
  have hPax' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Pax (Set.Ioo (-1) 1) :=
    hPax.mono (Set.Ioo_subset_Ioo (by linarith) (by linarith))
  have hneg : -1 / Λ < 0 := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by norm_num) hΛ0
  have hsubR : Set.Ioi (-(1 / Λ)) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 ⊆
      Set.Ioi (-1 / Λ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) := by
    apply Set.prod_mono
    · intro x hx
      simp only [Set.mem_Ioi] at hx ⊢
      rw [neg_div]; exact hx
    · exact Set.Ioo_subset_Ioo (by linarith) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨hT1, hT2⟩ := ax_stress_smooth h (1 / Λ) Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) hh0
    (by linarith) (by positivity) (hR.1.mono hsubR) (hR.2.1.mono hsubR)
    (fun x e hx h1 h2 => hR.2.2.1 x e hx (by linarith) (by linarith)) hPax'
  have hmapsR : Set.MapsTo (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, η)) (Set.Ioi (-1 / Λ))
      (Set.Ioi (-1 / Λ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) :=
    fun Y hY => ⟨hY, show -1 - ρ1 < η by linarith, show η < 1 + ρ1 by linarith⟩
  have hmaps0 : Set.MapsTo (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, η)) (Set.Ioi 0) (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1) :=
    fun Y hY => ⟨hY, hη1, hη2⟩
  have hpair : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, η)) := contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const
  have hfr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η) (Set.Ioi (-1 / Λ)) :=
    hR.1.comp hpair.contDiffOn hmapsR
  have hur : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => axRefU Λ t1 Un Y η) (Set.Ioi (-1 / Λ)) :=
    hR.2.1.comp hpair.contDiffOn hmapsR
  have hsub0 : Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ⊆ Set.Ioi (-1 / Λ) :=
    fun Y hY => Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (lt_trans hneg (Set.mem_Ioi.mp hY))
  have hfrc : ContinuousOn (fun Y => axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η) (Set.Ioi 0) := hfr.continuousOn.mono hsub0
  have hfr'c : ContinuousOn (deriv (fun Y => axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η)) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    (hfr.continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioi (by norm_num)).mono hsub0
  have hur'c : ContinuousOn (deriv (fun Y => axRefU Λ t1 Un Y η)) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    (hur.continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioi (by norm_num)).mono hsub0
  have hT1c : ContinuousOn (fun Y => leadStressTh h (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) Y η)
      (Set.Ioi 0) := (hT1.comp hpair.contDiffOn hmaps0).continuousOn
  have hT2c : ContinuousOn (fun Y => axTz h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) Y η)
      (Set.Ioi 0) := (hT2.comp hpair.contDiffOn hmaps0).continuousOn
  have hfrne : ∀ Y ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η ≠ 0 := fun Y hY =>
    (hR.2.2.1 Y η (Set.mem_Ioi.mp hY).le (by linarith) (by linarith)).ne'
  have hpc : ContinuousOn (fun Y => psLead1 h (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) Y η)
      (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    have hc : ContinuousOn (fun Y => leadStressTh h (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) Y η /
        axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η + -2 * Y * deriv (fun Y => axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η) Y / axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η)
        (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      (hT1c.div hfrc hfrne).add
        (((continuousOn_const.mul continuous_id.continuousOn).mul hfr'c).div hfrc hfrne)
    refine hc.congr ?_
    intro Y hY
    have hne := hfrne Y hY
    show psLead1 h (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) Y η =
      leadStressTh h (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) Y η / axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η +
        -2 * Y * deriv (fun Y => axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η) Y / axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η
    rw [leadStressTh, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hne]
    unfold psLead1 shearA
    ring
  have hsqrtc : Continuous (fun Y : ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * Y)) :=
    Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)
  have hqc : ContinuousOn
      (fun Y => Y * axNs h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) Y η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2))
      (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    have hc : ContinuousOn (fun Y => (axTz h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) Y η /
        axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η - Real.sqrt (2 * Y) * deriv (fun Y => axRefU Λ t1 Un Y η) Y /
        axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Y) * axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η)) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      ((hT2c.div hfrc hfrne).sub ((hsqrtc.continuousOn.mul hur'c).div hfrc hfrne)).mul
        (hsqrtc.continuousOn.mul hfrc)
    refine hc.congr ?_
    intro Y hY
    have hne := hfrne Y hY
    have hS : Real.sqrt (2 * Y) * axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith [Set.mem_Ioi.mp hY])).ne' hne
    show Y * axNs h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) Y η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) =
      (axTz h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) Y η / axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η -
        Real.sqrt (2 * Y) * deriv (fun Y => axRefU Λ t1 Un Y η) Y / axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η) *
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Y) * axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η)
    rw [axTz, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hne]
    unfold axPs2 shearB
    rw [add_sub_cancel_right, ← div_div, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hS]
  have hsigc : Continuous sigA := sigA_collar_facts.1.continuous
  have hxc : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => 4 / Λ * Real.exp y) := continuous_const.mul Real.continuous_exp
  have hxpos : ∀ y : ℝ, 4 / Λ * Real.exp y ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) :=
    fun y => Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by positivity)
  have hpx : Continuous
      (fun y => psLead1 h (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) η) :=
    hpc.comp_continuous hxc hxpos
  have hqx : Continuous (fun y => 4 / Λ * Real.exp y *
      axNs h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)) :=
    hqc.comp_continuous hxc hxpos
  have hθc : Continuous (fun y => axTheta Λ om y) := by unfold axTheta; fun_prop
  have hβc : Continuous (fun y => axBeta Λ om y) := by unfold axBeta; fun_prop
  have hκc : Continuous (fun y => axKap κ0 t1 y) := by unfold axKap; fun_prop
  have hgc : Continuous (fun y => axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η) := by
    show Continuous (fun y => (1 - axTheta Λ om y) * axKap κ0 t1 y *
      psLead1 h (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) η + axTheta Λ om y * (4 / 5))
    exact (((continuous_const.sub hθc).mul hκc).mul hpx).add (hθc.mul continuous_const)
  have hkc : Continuous (fun y => axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η) := by
    have he : (fun y => axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η) = fun y =>
        -(axBeta Λ om y * axKap κ0 t1 y * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y *
          axNs h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) η /
            (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2))) / 2 := by
      funext y
      unfold axSlopeU
      ring
    rw [he]
    exact (((hβc.mul hκc).mul hqx).neg).div_const 2
  
  have hI : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun u => ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..u, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η)
      (axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un u η) u :=
    fun u => (hgc.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 u).hasDerivAt
  have hJ : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun u => ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..u, axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η)
      (axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un u η) u :=
    fun u => (hkc.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 u).hasDerivAt
  have hl : HasDerivAt (fun Y => axLogY Λ Y) (1 / X) X := by
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => Y * Λ / 4) (1 * Λ / 4) X :=
      ((hasDerivAt_id' X).mul_const Λ).div_const 4
    have h2 := h1.log (ne_of_gt hXΛ)
    unfold axLogY
    convert h2 using 1
    field_simp
  have hFn0 : 0 < Fn (4 / Λ) η := hA.2.2.1 (4 / Λ) η hX0.le h4le (by linarith) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E, E = Real.exp (-(1 / 2) *
      ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ X, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hEpos : 0 < E := by rw [hE]; exact Real.exp_pos _
  have hFval : axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un X η = Fn (4 / Λ) η * E := by
    rw [axProfF, if_neg (not_le.mpr hX1), hE]
  have hGd := ((((hI (axLogY Λ X)).comp X hl).const_mul (-(1 / 2))).exp).const_mul (Fn (4 / Λ) η)
  have hHd := ((hJ (axLogY Λ X)).comp X hl).const_add (Un (4 / Λ) η)
  have hFd : HasDerivAt (fun Y => axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un Y η)
      (Fn (4 / Λ) η * (E * (-(1 / 2) * (axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un (axLogY Λ X) η * (1 / X))))) X := by
    rw [hE]
    refine hGd.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hX1) ?_
    intro Y hY
    show axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un Y η = Fn (4 / Λ) η * Real.exp (-(1 / 2) *
      ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ Y, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η)
    rw [axProfF, if_neg (not_le.mpr (Set.mem_Ioi.mp hY))]
  have hUd : HasDerivAt (fun Y => axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un Y η)
      (axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un (axLogY Λ X) η * (1 / X)) X := by
    refine hHd.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hX1) ?_
    intro Y hY
    show axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un Y η = Un (4 / Λ) η +
      ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ Y, axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η
    rw [axProfU, if_neg (not_le.mpr (Set.mem_Ioi.mp hY))]
  
  have hgy : axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un (axLogY Λ X) η = (1 - axEa Λ t1 κ0 X) * shearA Fn X η := by
    rw [axShearA, hpos, hθ, hκ, hP1, hP1n]; ring
  have hky : axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un (axLogY Λ X) η =
      -((1 - axEa Λ t1 κ0 X) * -(shearB Fn Un X η * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Fn X η))) / 2 := by
    rw [axSlopeU, hpos, hβ, hκ, ← hNn, ← hNs]
    ring
  have hderF := hFd.deriv
  have hderU := hUd.deriv
  have hXinv : X * (1 / X) = 1 := mul_one_div_cancel hXne
  refine ⟨by rw [hFval]; exact mul_pos hFn0 hEpos, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hsA : shearA (axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un) X η = axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un (axLogY Λ X) η := by
      show -2 * X * deriv (fun Y => axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un Y η) X /
        axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un X η = _
      rw [hderF, hFval, div_eq_iff (mul_ne_zero hFn0.ne' hEpos.ne')]
      calc -2 * X * (Fn (4 / Λ) η * (E * (-(1 / 2) *
            (axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un (axLogY Λ X) η * (1 / X)))))
          = axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un (axLogY Λ X) η * (Fn (4 / Λ) η * E) * (X * (1 / X)) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hXinv, mul_one]
    rw [hsA, hgy]
  · show Real.sqrt (2 * X) * deriv (fun Y => axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un Y η) X /
        axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un X η =
      (1 - axEa Λ t1 κ0 X) * shearB Fn Un X η * Fn X η / axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un X η
    rw [hderU, hky]
    congr 1
    have hsq : Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Real.sqrt (2 * X) = 2 * X := Real.mul_self_sqrt (by linarith)
    calc Real.sqrt (2 * X) * (-((1 - axEa Λ t1 κ0 X) *
          -(shearB Fn Un X η * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Fn X η))) / 2 * (1 / X))
        = (1 - axEa Λ t1 κ0 X) * shearB Fn Un X η * Fn X η *
            (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Real.sqrt (2 * X)) * (1 / X) / 2 := by ring
      _ = (1 - axEa Λ t1 κ0 X) * shearB Fn Un X η * Fn X η * (X * (1 / X)) := by rw [hsq]; ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hXinv, mul_one]

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Pst Pax _hD j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 ts Kder M Fn Un hΛ hρ1 hts hts' hA hR
  obtain ⟨hA1, hA2, hA3, hA4, -, hA6, -, -⟩ := hA
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hR4, -, -⟩ := hR
  have hΛ0 : 0 < Λ := by linarith

  have hexp1 : 1 ≤ Real.exp ts := Real.one_le_exp hts.le
  have hexp2 : Real.exp ts < 41 / 40 := by
    have h1 := Real.abs_exp_sub_one_sub_id_le (x := ts)
      (by rw [abs_of_pos hts]; linarith)

    rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith) hΛ0]; linarith
  have h41_110 : 41 / (10 * Λ) ≤ 110 := by

  set Xm := 4 / Λ * Real.exp ts with hXm_def
  set O : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) with hO_def
  have hO : IsOpen O := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  set Kb : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Icc (4 / Λ) Xm ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 with hK_def
  have hKO : Kb ⊆ O := by
    intro z hz

  have hKne : Kb.Nonempty := ⟨(4 / Λ, 0), ⟨le_rfl, hX0m⟩, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
  have hKfacts : ∀ z ∈ Kb, 0 < z.1 ∧ z.1 ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) ∧ -1 - ρ1 < z.2 ∧ z.2 < 1 + ρ1 := by
    intro z hz

  have hs1 : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) O →

      (((hf.differentiableOn (by simp)) z hz).differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds hz)).hasFDerivAt
    constructor
    · have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, z.2)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) z.1 :=

  have hs2 : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) O → ∀ X e0 : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X < 5 / Λ →

    intro g hg X e0 hX0' hX5 he0a he0b
