      have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le ha hx.1
      have hm : fr a / fn a ≤ fr x / fn x := hmonoR ⟨le_rfl, hab⟩ hx hx.1
      rw [E, div_self hfa.ne', le_div_iff₀ (Pfn x hx0 hx.2)] at hm
      linarith
    rcases le_total X b with hXb | hXb
    · rw [min_eq_left hXb]
      exact lowerIcc X ⟨hX, hXb⟩
    · rw [min_eq_right hXb]
      exact le_trans (lowerIcc b ⟨hab, le_rfl⟩) (hmonob (Set.mem_Ici.mpr le_rfl) hXb hXb)
  · rw [← E]
    exact hanti (Set.mem_Ici.mpr le_rfl) hX hX

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (s : ℝ → ℝ) (a b η L : ℝ), IsOpen S → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) S → a ≤ b → (∀ Y : ℝ, a ≤ Y → Y ≤ b → (Y, η) ∈ S) → (∀ Y e : ℝ, a ≤ Y → Y ≤ b → (Y, e) ∈ S → deriv (fun X => f X e) Y = s Y * g Y e) → (∀ Y : ℝ, a ≤ Y → Y ≤ b → |s Y| ≤ 1) → (∀ Y : ℝ, a ≤ Y → Y ≤ b → |deriv (fun e => g Y e) η| ≤ L) → ∀ X : ℝ, a ≤ X → X ≤ b → |deriv (fun e => f X e) η - deriv (fun e => f a e) η| ≤ L * (X - a)

signature.name: eta_deriv_transfer
signature.statement: ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (s : ℝ → ℝ) (a b η L : ℝ), IsOpen S → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) S → a ≤ b → (∀ Y : ℝ, a ≤ Y → Y ≤ b → (Y, η) ∈ S) → (∀ Y e : ℝ, a ≤ Y → Y ≤ b → (Y, e) ∈ S → deriv (fun X => f X e) Y = s Y * g Y e) → (∀ Y : ℝ, a ≤ Y → Y ≤ b → |s Y| ≤ 1) → (∀ Y : ℝ, a ≤ Y → Y ≤ b → |deriv (fun e => g Y e) η| ≤ L) → ∀ X : ℝ, a ≤ X → X ≤ b → |deriv (fun e => f X e) η - deriv (fun e => f a e) η| ≤ L * (X - a)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro f g S s a b η L hS hf hab hmem hd hs hg X haX hXb
  have hmix : ∀ x y : ℝ, (x, y) ∈ S →
      HasDerivAt (fun X => deriv (fun e => f X e) y)
        (deriv (fun e => deriv (fun X => f X e) x) y) x := by
    intro x y hxy
    have hCD : ∀ q ∈ S, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (↿f) q := fun q hq => hf.contDiffAt (hS.mem_nhds hq)
    have hpe : ∀ X e : ℝ, (X, e) ∈ S →
        deriv (fun e' => f X e') e = fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, e) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) := by
      intro X e hq
      have hD : HasFDerivAt (↿f) (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, e)) (X, e) :=
        ((hCD _ hq).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
      have hc : HasDerivAt (fun e' : ℝ => ((X, e') : ℝ × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) e :=
        (hasDerivAt_const e X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id e)
      exact (hD.comp_hasDerivAt e hc).deriv
    have hpX : ∀ X e : ℝ, (X, e) ∈ S →
        deriv (fun X' => f X' e) X = fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, e) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) := by
      intro X e hq
      have hD : HasFDerivAt (↿f) (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, e)) (X, e) :=
        ((hCD _ hq).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
      have hc : HasDerivAt (fun X' : ℝ => ((X', e) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) X :=
        (hasDerivAt_id X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X e)
      exact (hD.comp_hasDerivAt X hc).deriv
    have hN1 : {X' : ℝ | (X', y) ∈ S} ∈ nhds x :=
      (hS.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mem_nhds hxy
    have hN2 : {e : ℝ | (x, e) ∈ S} ∈ nhds y :=
      (hS.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mem_nhds hxy
    have hE1 : (fun X' => deriv (fun e => f X' e) y) =ᶠ[nhds x]
        (fun X' => fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X', y) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hN1 (fun X' hX' => hpe X' y hX')
    have hE2 : (fun e => deriv (fun X => f X e) x) =ᶠ[nhds y]
        (fun e => fderiv ℝ (↿f) (x, e) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hN2 (fun e he => hpX x e he)
    have hG : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (x, y) :=
      (hCD _ hxy).fderiv_right (by norm_num)
    have hGD : HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (x, y)) (x, y) :=
      (hG.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun X' => fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X', y) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)))
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (x, y) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) x := by
      have hc : HasDerivAt (fun X' : ℝ => ((X', y) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) x :=
        (hasDerivAt_id x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const x y)
      have hGc : HasDerivAt (fun X' : ℝ => fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X', y))
          (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (x, y) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) x :=
        hGD.comp_hasDerivAt x hc
      have hA : HasFDerivAt (fun T : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ => T ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)))
          (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)))
          (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (x, y)) :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))).hasFDerivAt
      exact hA.comp_hasDerivAt x hGc
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun e => fderiv ℝ (↿f) (x, e) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)))
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (x, y) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) y := by
      have hc : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => ((x, e) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) y :=
        (hasDerivAt_const y x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id y)
      have hGc : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => fderiv ℝ (↿f) (x, e))
          (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (x, y) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) y :=
        hGD.comp_hasDerivAt y hc
      have hA : HasFDerivAt (fun T : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ => T ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)))
          (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)))
          (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (x, y)) :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))).hasFDerivAt
      exact hA.comp_hasDerivAt y hGc
    have hsym : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ (↿f) (x, y) :=
      (hCD _ hxy).isSymmSndFDerivAt (by rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]; norm_num)
    have hval : deriv (fun e => deriv (fun X => f X e) x) y =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (x, y) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) := by
      rw [hE2.deriv_eq, h2.deriv, hsym.eq]
    rw [hval]
    exact h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq hE1
  have hderiv : ∀ Y ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivWithinAt (fun Y => deriv (fun e => f Y e) η)
      (deriv (fun e => deriv (fun X => f X e) Y) η) (Set.Icc a b) Y :=
    fun Y hY => (hmix Y η (hmem Y hY.1 hY.2)).hasDerivWithinAt
  have hbound : ∀ Y ∈ Set.Ico a b, ‖deriv (fun e => deriv (fun X => f X e) Y) η‖ ≤ L := by
    intro Y hY
    have hY1 := hY.1
    have hY2 := hY.2.le
    have hN : {e : ℝ | (Y, e) ∈ S} ∈ nhds η :=
      (hS.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mem_nhds (hmem Y hY1 hY2)
    have hE : (fun e => deriv (fun X => f X e) Y) =ᶠ[nhds η] (fun e => s Y * g Y e) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hN (fun e he => hd Y e hY1 hY2 he)
    rw [hE.deriv_eq, deriv_const_mul_field, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    calc |s Y| * |deriv (fun e => g Y e) η| ≤ 1 * L :=
          mul_le_mul (hs Y hY1 hY2) (hg Y hY1 hY2) (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      _ = L := one_mul L
  have hfin := norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le_segment' hderiv hbound X ⟨haX, hXb⟩
  rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hfin

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (Λ C ρ1 : ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < C → 0 < ρ1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Fn) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Un) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → 0 < Fn X η) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => C * Fn z.1 z.2) (X, η)‖ ≤ Kder m ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (C * Fn z.1 z.2)⁻¹) (X, η)‖ ≤ Kder m ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Un) (X, η)‖ ≤ Kder m) → ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → 1 ≤ Kder 0 * (C * Fn X η) ∧ C * Fn X η ≤ Kder 0 ∧ |deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) X| ≤ Kder 1 ∧ |deriv (fun e => deriv (fun Y => Un Y e) X) η| ≤ Kder 2 ∧ |deriv (fun e => deriv (fun Y => Fn Y e) X / Fn X e) η| ≤ Kder 2 * Kder 0 + Kder 1 ^ 2 * Kder 0 ^ 2

signature.name: ax_kder_slice_bounds
signature.statement: ∀ (Λ C ρ1 : ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < C → 0 < ρ1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Fn) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Un) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → 0 < Fn X η) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => C * Fn z.1 z.2) (X, η)‖ ≤ Kder m ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (C * Fn z.1 z.2)⁻¹) (X, η)‖ ≤ Kder m ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Un) (X, η)‖ ≤ Kder m) → ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → 1 ≤ Kder 0 * (C * Fn X η) ∧ C * Fn X η ≤ Kder 0 ∧ |deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) X| ≤ Kder 1 ∧ |deriv (fun e => deriv (fun Y => Un Y e) X) η| ≤ Kder 2 ∧ |deriv (fun e => deriv (fun Y => Fn Y e) X / Fn X e) η| ≤ Kder 2 * Kder 0 + Kder 1 ^ 2 * Kder 0 ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Λ C ρ1 Kder Fn Un hΛ hC hρ1 hFs hUs hpos hB X η hX0 hX1 hη1 hη2
  obtain ⟨S, hSdef⟩ : ∃ S : Set (ℝ × ℝ), S = Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hSdef] at hFs hUs
  have hSo : IsOpen S := by rw [hSdef]; exact isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hΛpos : 0 < Λ := by linarith
  have hmem : (X, η) ∈ S := by
    rw [hSdef]
    refine Set.mk_mem_prod ⟨?_, ?_⟩ ⟨hη1, hη2⟩
    · have : -1 / Λ < 0 := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by norm_num) hΛpos
      linarith
    · have h41 : 41 / (10 * Λ) < 5 / Λ := by
        rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hΛpos]; nlinarith
      linarith
  
  have mixed : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) S → ∃ d : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun e => deriv (fun Y => f Y e) X) d η ∧
        |d| ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (↿f) (X, η)‖ := by
    intro f hf
    have hslice : ∀ e, (X, e) ∈ S →
        deriv (fun Y => f Y e) X = fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, e) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) := by
      intro e he
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿f) (X, e) :=
        (hf.contDiffAt (hSo.mem_nhds he)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, e)) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) X :=
        (hasDerivAt_id X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X e)
      exact (hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt X h1).deriv
    have hT : {e : ℝ | (X, e) ∈ S} ∈ nhds η :=
      (hSo.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mem_nhds hmem
    have hev : (fun e => deriv (fun Y => f Y e) X) =ᶠ[nhds η]
        (fun e => fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, e) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hT (fun e he => hslice e he)
    have hca : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (↿f) (X, η) := hf.contDiffAt (hSo.mem_nhds hmem)
    have hfd : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (X, η) :=
      hca.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
    have hD : HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (X, η)) (X, η) :=
      (hfd.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => (X, e)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) η :=
      (hasDerivAt_const η X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id η)
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun e => fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, e))
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (X, η) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) η := hD.comp_hasDerivAt η h2
    have h4 := h3.clm_apply (hasDerivAt_const η ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))
    simp only [map_zero, add_zero] at h4
    refine ⟨_, h4.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev, ?_⟩
    have hn01 : ‖((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖ = 1 := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
    have hn10 : ‖((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))‖ = 1 := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
    have hle := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm₂ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (X, η))
      ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))
    rw [hn01, hn10, mul_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hle
    have hnn : ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (X, η)‖ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (↿f) (X, η)‖ := by
      rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_one, norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
    rw [← hnn]
    exact hle
  
  have first : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) S →
      HasDerivAt (fun e => f X e) (deriv (fun e => f X e) η) η ∧
      |deriv (fun Y => f Y η) X| ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (↿f) (X, η)‖ ∧
      |deriv (fun e => f X e) η| ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (↿f) (X, η)‖ := by
    intro f hf
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿f) (X, η) :=
      (hf.contDiffAt (hSo.mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, η)) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) X :=
      (hasDerivAt_id X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X η)
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => (X, e)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) η :=
      (hasDerivAt_const η X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id η)
    have hX : HasDerivAt (fun Y => f Y η) (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) X := by
      have := hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt X h1
      exact this
    have hE : HasDerivAt (fun e => f X e) (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) η := by
      have := hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt η h2
      exact this
    have hn01 : ‖((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖ = 1 := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
    have hn10 : ‖((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))‖ = 1 := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
    have b1 := (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η)).le_opNorm ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))
    have b2 := (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η)).le_opNorm ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))
    rw [hn10, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at b1
    rw [hn01, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at b2
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_one, hX.deriv, hE.deriv]
    exact ⟨hE, b1, b2⟩
  
  obtain ⟨hG0, hI0, -⟩ := hB 0 X η hX0 hX1 hη1 hη2
  obtain ⟨hG1, -, hU1⟩ := hB 1 X η hX0 hX1 hη1 hη2
  obtain ⟨hG2, -, hU2⟩ := hB 2 X η hX0 hX1 hη1 hη2
  simp only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hG0 hI0
  have hFp : 0 < Fn X η := hpos X η hX0 hX1 hη1 hη2
  have hb0 : 0 < C * Fn X η := mul_pos hC hFp
  have hinvK : (C * Fn X η)⁻¹ ≤ Kder 0 := le_trans (le_abs_self _) hI0
  have hP1 : 1 ≤ Kder 0 * (C * Fn X η) := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hinvK hb0.le
    rwa [inv_mul_cancel₀ hb0.ne'] at this
  have hP2 : C * Fn X η ≤ Kder 0 := le_trans (le_abs_self _) hG0
  
  have hP3 : |deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) X| ≤ Kder 1 :=
    le_trans (first Un hUs).2.1 hU1
  have hP4 : |deriv (fun e => deriv (fun Y => Un Y e) X) η| ≤ Kder 2 := by
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hdb⟩ := mixed Un hUs
    rw [hd.deriv]
    exact le_trans hdb hU2
  
  refine ⟨hP1, hP2, hP3, hP4, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨G, hGdef⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, G = fun Y e => C * Fn Y e := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hGs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) S := by
    rw [hGdef]; exact contDiffOn_const.mul hFs
  have hGu : (↿G) = fun z : ℝ × ℝ => C * Fn z.1 z.2 := by rw [hGdef]; rfl
  have hrat : (fun e => deriv (fun Y => Fn Y e) X / Fn X e) =
      (fun e => deriv (fun Y => G Y e) X / G X e) := by
    funext e
    rw [hGdef]
    simp only
    rw [deriv_const_mul_field, mul_div_mul_left _ _ hC.ne']
  obtain ⟨a', ha', ha'b⟩ := mixed G hGs
  have sdf := first G hGs
  have hGX : G X η = C * Fn X η := by rw [hGdef]
  have hq0 := ha'.div sdf.1 (by rw [hGX]; exact hb0.ne')
  have hq : HasDerivAt (fun e => deriv (fun Y => G Y e) X / G X e) _ η := hq0
  rw [hrat, hq.deriv, hGX]
  have hK2 : |a'| ≤ Kder 2 := le_trans ha'b (by rw [hGu]; exact hG2)
  have hKa : |deriv (fun Y => G Y η) X| ≤ Kder 1 :=
    le_trans sdf.2.1 (by rw [hGu]; exact hG1)
  have hKb : |deriv (fun e => G X e) η| ≤ Kder 1 :=
    le_trans sdf.2.2 (by rw [hGu]; exact hG1)
  
  set a := deriv (fun Y => G Y η) X
  set b' := deriv (fun e => G X e) η
  set b := C * Fn X η
  set u := b⁻¹ with hu
  have hu0 : 0 < u := inv_pos.mpr hb0
  have hid : (a' * b - a * b') / b ^ 2 = a' * u - a * b' * u ^ 2 := by
    rw [hu]; field_simp
  rw [hid]
  have hK1n : 0 ≤ Kder 1 := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hKa
  have hK2n : 0 ≤ Kder 2 := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hK2
  have t1 : |a' * u| ≤ Kder 2 * Kder 0 := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hu0]
    exact mul_le_mul hK2 hinvK hu0.le hK2n
  have t2 : |a * b' * u ^ 2| ≤ Kder 1 ^ 2 * Kder 0 ^ 2 := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (pow_pos hu0 2)]
    have hab : |a| * |b'| ≤ Kder 1 ^ 2 := by
      rw [sq]; exact mul_le_mul hKa hKb (abs_nonneg _) hK1n
    have hu2 : u ^ 2 ≤ Kder 0 ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hu0.le hinvK 2
    exact mul_le_mul hab hu2 (pow_pos hu0 2).le (sq_nonneg _)
  calc |a' * u - a * b' * u ^ 2| ≤ |a' * u| + |a * b' * u ^ 2| := abs_sub _ _
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add t1 t2

signature.statement: ∀ W : Set (ℝ × ℝ), IsOpen W → Bornology.IsBounded W → (∀ f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, osbGood W W f → osbGood W W g → osbGood W W (fun p => f p * g p)) ∧ (∀ f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, osbGood W W f → osbGood W W g → osbGood W W (fun p => f p + g p)) ∧ (∀ f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, osbGood W W f → osbGood W W g → osbGood W W (fun p => f p - g p)) ∧ (∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), osbGood W W f → 0 < c → (∀ p ∈ W, c ≤ |f p|) → osbGood W W (fun p => (f p)⁻¹)) ∧ (∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), osbGood W W f → ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → osbGood W W (fun p => φ (f p))) ∧ (∀ φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → osbGood W W φ) ∧ (∀ f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, osbGood W W f → osbGood W W (fun p => fderiv ℝ f p (0, 1)) ∧ osbGood W W (fun p => fderiv ℝ f p (1, 0))) ∧ (∀ (V : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen V → V ⊆ W → osbGood W W f → osbGood V V f)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro W hWo hWb
  have hWu : UniqueDiffOn ℝ W := hWo.uniqueDiffOn
  have hW : ∀ (F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ × ℝ), x ∈ W →
      iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ n F W x = iteratedFDeriv ℝ n F x :=
    fun F n x hx => iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hWo hx
  have hN : ∀ n : ℕ, ((n : ℕ∞ω)) ≤ ∞ := fun n => by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hAt : ∀ (F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ × ℝ), x ∈ W → ContDiffAt ℝ n F x :=
    fun F hF n x hx => (hF.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hx)).of_le (hN n)
  
  have hmul : ∀ f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, osbGood W W f → osbGood W W g →
      osbGood W W (fun p => f p * g p) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.mul hg.1, fun n => ?_⟩
    choose A hA using hf.2
    choose B hB using hg.2
    refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * A i * B (n - i), fun p hp => ?_⟩
    rw [← hW _ n p hp]
    refine (norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hf.1 hg.1 hWu hp (hN n)).trans ?_
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    rw [hW _ i p hp, hW _ (n - i) p hp]
    have h1 := hA i p hp
    have h2 := hB (n - i) p hp
    have h0 : 0 ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f p‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have h0' : 0 ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) g p‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ n.choose i := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hc) h2 h0' (mul_nonneg hc (h0.trans h1))
  
  have hadd : ∀ f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, osbGood W W f → osbGood W W g →
      osbGood W W (fun p => f p + g p) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.add hg.1, fun n => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨Cf, hCf⟩ := hf.2 n
    obtain ⟨Cg, hCg⟩ := hg.2 n
    refine ⟨Cf + Cg, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    have e : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun p => f p + g p) p =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f p + iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g p :=
      iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (hAt f hf.1 n p hp) (hAt g hg.1 n p hp)
    rw [e]
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hCf p hp) (hCg p hp))
  
  have hsub : ∀ f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, osbGood W W f → osbGood W W g →
      osbGood W W (fun p => f p - g p) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.sub hg.1, fun n => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨Cf, hCf⟩ := hf.2 n
    obtain ⟨Cg, hCg⟩ := hg.2 n
    refine ⟨Cf + Cg, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    have e : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun p => f p - g p) p =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f p - iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g p :=
      iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply (hAt f hf.1 n p hp) (hAt g hg.1 n p hp)
    rw [e]
    exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hCf p hp) (hCg p hp))
  
  have hinv : ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), osbGood W W f → 0 < c →
      (∀ p ∈ W, c ≤ |f p|) → osbGood W W (fun p => (f p)⁻¹) := by
    intro f c hf hc hlow
    have hne : ∀ p ∈ W, f p ≠ 0 := fun p hp => abs_pos.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hc (hlow p hp))
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => (f p)⁻¹) W := hf.1.inv hne
    refine ⟨hsm, fun n => ?_⟩
    choose A hA using hf.2
    have hgs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Inv.inv : ℝ → ℝ) ({0}ᶜ) := contDiffOn_inv ℝ
    have hgd : ∀ (i : ℕ) (y : ℝ),
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (Inv.inv : ℝ → ℝ) y‖ = (i.factorial : ℝ) * (|y| ^ (i + 1))⁻¹ := by
      intro i y
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate, iter_deriv_inv]
      rw [show (-1 - (i:ℤ)) = -((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow, one_mul, norm_inv, norm_pow,
        Real.norm_natCast, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    refine ⟨(n.factorial : ℝ) * ((n.factorial : ℝ) * (c⁻¹ + 1) ^ (n + 1)) *
      (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |A i|) ^ n, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    have hD1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |A i| :=
      le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _))
    have hC : ∀ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (Inv.inv : ℝ → ℝ) ({0}ᶜ) (f p)‖ ≤
        (n.factorial : ℝ) * (c⁻¹ + 1) ^ (n + 1) := by
      intro i hi
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i isOpen_compl_singleton
        (show f p ∈ ({0}ᶜ : Set ℝ) from hne p hp), hgd i (f p)]
      have hfi : (i.factorial : ℝ) ≤ n.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le hi
      have hci : 0 ≤ c⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.2 hc.le
      have hy : (|f p| ^ (i + 1))⁻¹ ≤ (c⁻¹ + 1) ^ (n + 1) := by
        have h1 : (|f p| ^ (i + 1))⁻¹ ≤ (c ^ (i + 1))⁻¹ :=
          inv_anti₀ (pow_pos hc _) (pow_le_pow_left₀ hc.le (hlow p hp) _)
        have h2 : (c ^ (i + 1))⁻¹ = (c⁻¹) ^ (i + 1) := (inv_pow c (i + 1)).symm
        have h3 : (c⁻¹) ^ (i + 1) ≤ (c⁻¹ + 1) ^ (i + 1) :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ hci (by linarith) _
        have h4 : (c⁻¹ + 1) ^ (i + 1) ≤ (c⁻¹ + 1) ^ (n + 1) :=
          pow_le_pow_right₀ (by linarith) (by omega)
        linarith
      exact mul_le_mul hfi hy (inv_nonneg.2 (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    have hD : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n →
        ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i f W p‖ ≤ (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |A i|) ^ i := by
      intro i hi1 hin
      rw [hW f i p hp]
      have h1 := hA i p hp
      have h2 : |A i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |A j| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |A j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
      have h3 : (1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |A j|) ≤
          (1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |A j|) ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
      linarith [le_abs_self (A i)]
    have hmaps : MapsTo f W ({0}ᶜ : Set ℝ) := fun p hp => hne p hp
    have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hgs hf.1 (hN n)
      isOpen_compl_singleton.uniqueDiffOn hWu hmaps hp hC hD
    rw [← hW _ n p hp]
    exact key
  
  have hcomp : ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), osbGood W W f → ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ →
      osbGood W W (fun p => φ (f p)) := by
    intro f φ hf hφ
    refine ⟨hφ.comp_contDiffOn hf.1, fun n => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hf.2 0
    have hfM : ∀ p ∈ W, f p ∈ Icc (-M) M := by
      intro p hp
      have h1 := hM p hp
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
      exact abs_le.mp h1
    have hBex : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ Icc (-M) M, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i φ y‖ ≤ B :=
      fun i => isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        (hφ.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (hN i)).continuousOn
    choose B hB using hBex
    choose A hA using hf.2
    refine ⟨(n.factorial : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |B i|) *
      (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |A i|) ^ n, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    have hD1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |A i| :=
      le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _))
    have hC : ∀ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i φ univ (f p)‖ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |B i| := by
      intro i hi
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_univ]
      have h1 := hB i (f p) (hfM p hp)
      have h2 : |B i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |B j| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |B j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
      linarith [le_abs_self (B i)]
    have hD : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n →
        ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i f W p‖ ≤ (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |A i|) ^ i := by
      intro i hi1 hin
      rw [hW f i p hp]
      have h1 := hA i p hp
      have h2 : |A i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |A j| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |A j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
      have h3 : (1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |A j|) ≤
          (1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |A j|) ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
      linarith [le_abs_self (A i)]
    have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hφ.contDiffOn hf.1 (hN n)
      uniqueDiffOn_univ hWu (mapsTo_univ _ _) hp hC hD
    rw [← hW _ n p hp]
    exact key
  
  have hglob : ∀ φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → osbGood W W φ := by
    intro φ hφ
    refine ⟨hφ.contDiffOn, fun m => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hWb.isCompact_closure.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hφ.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (hN m)).continuousOn
    exact ⟨C, fun p hp => hC p (subset_closure hp)⟩
  
  have hpart : ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (v : ℝ × ℝ), osbGood W W f →
      osbGood W W (fun p => fderiv ℝ f p v) := by
    intro f v hf
    have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) W := hf.1.fderiv_of_isOpen hWo (le_of_eq rfl)
    have hfun : (fun p => fderiv ℝ f p v) =
        ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v : (ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ fderiv ℝ f := rfl
    refine ⟨?_, fun n => ?_⟩
    · rw [hfun]
      exact (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v : (ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hfd
    · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hf.2 (n + 1)
      refine ⟨‖(ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v : (ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ * C, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      rw [hfun]
      have hAtz : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) z := hfd.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hz)
      refine ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v : (ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left
        hAtz (hN n)).trans ?_
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC z hz) (norm_nonneg _)
  
  have hres : ∀ (V : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen V → V ⊆ W → osbGood W W f →
      osbGood V V f := fun V f _ hVW hf =>
    ⟨hf.1.mono hVW, fun m => (hf.2 m).imp (fun C hC z hz => hC z (hVW hz))⟩
  exact ⟨hmul, hadd, hsub, hinv, hcomp, hglob, fun f hf => ⟨hpart f (0, 1) hf, hpart f (1, 0) hf⟩,
    hres⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 Pax Kder Fn Un hΛ hρ1 ht1 ht1' hκ0 hκ0' hA
  have hΛ0 : 0 < Λ := by linarith
  
  have s1 : ∀ (O Kc W S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen O → IsCompact Kc → Kc ⊆ O →
      W ⊆ O → S ⊆ Kc → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O → osbGood W S f := by

subgoal_signatures.statement: ContDiff ℝ ∞ sigA ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ collarG ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ collarGam ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → 1 - sigA (1 - u) = Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) * collarG u) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → HasDerivAt sigA (Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) / u ^ 3 * collarGam u) (1 - u)) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → 0 ≤ collarGam u) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → u ≤ 1 / 2 → Real.exp (-4) / 2 ≤ collarGam u)

by
  intro h Pst j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 Pax Kder Fn Un hSm hD hΛ hρ1 ht1 ht1' hκ0 hκ0' hA
  have hΛ0 : 0 < Λ := by linarith
  have hX0 : 0 < 4 / Λ := div_pos (by norm_num) hΛ0
  have hE : Real.exp (t1 / 2) < 41 / 40 := by
    have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(t1 / 2))
    have h2 : Real.exp (t1 / 2) * Real.exp (-(t1 / 2)) = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
    have hp := Real.exp_pos (t1 / 2)
    have h3 : Real.exp (t1 / 2) * (-(t1 / 2) + 1) ≤ Real.exp (t1 / 2) * Real.exp (-(t1 / 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hp.le
    nlinarith
  have hX41 : 4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 / 2) < 41 / (10 * Λ) := by
    calc 4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 / 2) < 4 / Λ * (41 / 40) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hE hX0
      _ = 41 / (10 * Λ) := by
        rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_eq_div_iff (by positivity) (by positivity)]; ring
  have h415 : 41 / (10 * Λ) < 5 / Λ := by
    rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hΛ0]; nlinarith
  have hm1 : -1 / Λ < 0 := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by norm_num) hΛ0
  have hexpos : 0 < 4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 / 2) := by positivity
  
  obtain ⟨hmul, hadd, hsub, hinv, hcomp, hcst, -, -⟩ :=

    ax_ff_box_reg h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 Pax Kder Fn Un hΛ hρ1 ht1 ht1' hκ0 hκ0' hA
  have gaF : osbGood (Ioo (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1)

  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hPs⟩ := hSm h Pst Pax hD
  have hPd : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ Pax η := by

  have hcF : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →

    intro η h1 h2
    refine hA.1.continuousOn.comp
      (Continuous.prodMk continuous_id (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ => η)).continuousOn ?_
    intro x hx
    show (x, η) ∈ Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)

    intro η h1 h2
    refine hA.2.1.continuousOn.comp
      (Continuous.prodMk continuous_id (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ => η)).continuousOn ?_
    intro x hx
    show (x, η) ∈ Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)
    exact Set.mk_mem_prod ⟨by linarith [hx.1], by linarith [hx.2]⟩ ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hc1 : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ContinuousOn (fun x => 2 * x * Fn x η) (Icc 0 (4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 / 2))) :=

  have hc2 : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →

  obtain ⟨β1, β2, β3, β5, β6, gβ1, gβ2, gβ3, gβ5, gβ6, hftc⟩ :=

    hΛ ht1 ht1' hκ0 hκ0' ge gm1 gz gz gdU gdU gdU hcU (fun x η hx _ _ => hexU x η hx)

    hΛ ht1 ht1' hκ0 hκ0' ge gF2 gz gz gβ3 gdU gdU hc4

h) * η * D0 + (1 - η ^ 2) * dD0) / X * U X η - e * ((2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * D0 + (1 - η ^ 2) * dD0) / X) * R3 + ((1 / 2 - h) * (D0 - η * dD0) + 4 * h * η * D3 - (1 - η ^ 2) * dD3) / X + 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * D4 - (1 - η ^ 2) * dD4) / ((1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (2 * X)) - F X η * shearB F U X η)

signature.name: ax_ff_stress_alg
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (F U F' U' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η e R1 R2 R3 D0 D1 D2 D3 D4 dD0 dD1 dD2 dD3 dD4 : ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η → 0 < F' X η → F' X η = F X η * (1 + e * R1) → (F' X η)⁻¹ = (F X η)⁻¹ * (1 + e * R2) → U' X η = U X η - e * R3 → profRadInt U' X η = profRadInt U X η + e * D0 → profEtaD (profRadInt U') X η = profEtaD (profRadInt U) X η + e * dD0 → profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F' x e) X η = profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) X η + e * D1 → profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F' x e)) X η = profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) X η + e * dD1 → profRadInt (fun x e => U' x e * (2 * x * F' x e)) X η = profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) X η + e * D2 → profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U' x e * (2 * x * F' x e))) X η = profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))) X η + e * dD2 → profRadInt (fun x e => U' x e ^ 2 - x * F' x e ^ 2) X η = profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) X η + e * D3 → profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U' x e ^ 2 - x * F' x e ^ 2)) X η = profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)) X η + e * dD3 → axPi Pax F' X η = axPi Pax F X η + e * D4 → profEtaD (axPi Pax F') X η = profEtaD (axPi Pax F) X η + e * dD4 → shearA F' X η = (1 - e) * shearA F X η → shearB F' U' X η = (1 - e) * shearB F U X η * F X η / F' X η → leadStressTh h F U X η = 0 → axTz h Pax F U X η = 0 → leadStressTh h F' U' X η = e * (F' X η * (shearA F X η + X * ((2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * D0 + (1 - η ^ 2) * dD0) / X + (((1 - h) * D1 - (1 / 2 - h) * η * dD1 - (1 - η ^ 2) * dD2 + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * η * D2) * (1 + e * R2) + ((1 - h) * profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) X η - (1 / 2 - h) * η * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e)) X η - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))) X η + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * η * profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) X η) * R2) / (2 * X ^ 2 * F X η)) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2))) ∧ axTz h Pax F' U' X η = e * (X * (leadW h U X η * R3 + (2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * D0 + (1 - η ^ 2) * dD0) / X * U X η - e * ((2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * D0 + (1 - η ^ 2) * dD0) / X) * R3 + ((1 / 2 - h) * (D0 - η * dD0) + 4 * h * η * D3 - (1 - η ^ 2) * dD3) / X + 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * D4 - (1 - η ^ 2) * dD4) / ((1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (2 * X)) - F X η * shearB F U X η)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Pax F U F' U' X η e R1 R2 R3 D0 D1 D2 D3 D4 dD0 dD1 dD2 dD3 dD4 hh0 hh1 hX hη1 hη2
    hF hF' _hR1 hR2 hU3 hD0 hdD0 hD1 hdD1 hD2 hdD2 hD3 hdD3 hD4 hdD4 hshA hshB hz1 hz2
  have hXne : X ≠ 0 := hX.ne'
  have hFne : F X η ≠ 0 := hF.ne'
  have hF'ne : F' X η ≠ 0 := hF'.ne'
  have hη2' : η ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
  have hhη : h * η ^ 2 ≤ h := by nlinarith
  have hL : 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    have : 0 < 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 := by linarith
    exact this.ne'
  have hs : Real.sqrt (2 * X) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)).ne'
  have hlead : ∀ V : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, leadW h V X η = 1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η *
      (X⁻¹ * profRadInt V X η) - (1 - η ^ 2) * (X⁻¹ * profEtaD (profRadInt V) X η) := by
    intro V
    have havg : ∀ e : ℝ, profRadAvg V X e = X⁻¹ * profRadInt V X e := by
      intro e
      unfold profRadAvg profRadInt
      have := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right (fun x => V x e) hXne (a := 0) (b := 1)
      simp only [zero_mul, one_mul, smul_eq_mul] at this
      exact this
    have hfun : (fun e => profRadAvg V X e) = fun e => X⁻¹ * profRadInt V X e := funext havg
    have hd : profEtaD (profRadAvg V) X η = X⁻¹ * profEtaD (profRadInt V) X η := by
      unfold profEtaD
      rw [hfun]
      exact congrFun (deriv_const_mul_field' (v := fun e => profRadInt V X e) X⁻¹) η
    unfold leadW
    rw [havg η, hd]
  have hW' : leadW h U' X η = leadW h U X η -
      e * ((2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * D0 + (1 - η ^ 2) * dD0) / X) := by
    rw [hlead U', hlead U, hD0, hdD0]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hA : shearA F X η = X * leadQs h F U X η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) := by
    unfold leadStressTh at hz1
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hz1 with h0 | h0
    · exact absurd h0 hFne
    · linarith
  have hB : shearB F U X η = -axPs2 h Pax F U X η := by
    unfold axTz at hz2
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hz2 with h0 | h0
    · exact absurd h0 hFne
    · linarith
  have hc : 1 + e * R2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hc0
    rw [hc0, mul_zero] at hR2
    exact inv_ne_zero hF'ne hR2
  have hF'eq : F' X η = F X η / (1 + e * R2) := by
    rw [← inv_inv (F' X η), hR2, mul_inv, inv_inv, div_eq_mul_inv]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold leadStressTh
    rw [hshA, hA]
    unfold leadQs
    rw [hW', hdD1, hdD2, hD1, hD2, hF'eq]
    field_simp
    ring
  · unfold axTz
    rw [hshB, hB]
    unfold axPs2 axNs
    rw [hW', hdD0, hdD3, hdD4, hD0, hD3, hD4, hU3, hF'eq]
    field_simp
    ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h j0 σ δ : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Λ K ρ1 : ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < ρ1 → 1 ≤ Λ → ∃ M : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ (C : ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ C → AxAxisOut h j0 σ δ Pax Λ C K ρ1 Kder Fn Un → ∀ t1 : ℝ, 0 < t1 → t1 ≤ 1 / 100 → (∀ (k : ℕ) (X η : ℝ), 0 ≤ X → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => C * axRefF Λ t1 Fn X e) η| ≤ M k ∧ |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => axRefU Λ t1 Un X e) η| ≤ M k ∧ (0 < X → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => (C * axRefF Λ t1 Fn X e)⁻¹) η| ≤ M k)) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |X * deriv (fun Y => axRefU Λ t1 Un Y η) X| ≤ M 0)

signature.name: ax_ref_slice_jets
signature.statement: ∀ (h j0 σ δ : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Λ K ρ1 : ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < ρ1 → 1 ≤ Λ → ∃ M : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ (C : ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ C → AxAxisOut h j0 σ δ Pax Λ C K ρ1 Kder Fn Un → ∀ t1 : ℝ, 0 < t1 → t1 ≤ 1 / 100 → (∀ (k : ℕ) (X η : ℝ), 0 ≤ X → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => C * axRefF Λ t1 Fn X e) η| ≤ M k ∧ |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => axRefU Λ t1 Un X e) η| ≤ M k ∧ (0 < X → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => (C * axRefF Λ t1 Fn X e)⁻¹) η| ≤ M k)) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |X * deriv (fun Y => axRefU Λ t1 Un Y η) X| ≤ M 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h j0 σ δ Pax Λ K ρ1 Kder hρ1 hΛ
  
  obtain ⟨Bψ, hBψ⟩ : ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ, B = fun k => 41 / 10 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
      (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Kder (i + 1)| * |Kder (k - i)| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨MF, hMF⟩ : ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ, B = fun k => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) *
      (fun i => |Kder i|) i * ((k - i).factorial * Real.exp (1 / 100 * Bψ 0) *
        (1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k - i + 1), 1 / 100 * Bψ j) ^ (k - i)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨MU, hMU⟩ : ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ, B = fun k => |Kder k| + 1 / 100 * (41 / 10 * |Kder (k + 1)|) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hM1 : ∀ k, |Kder k| ≤ |Kder k| + |MF k| + |MU k| + 41 / 10 * |Kder 1| := fun k => by
    linarith [abs_nonneg (MF k), abs_nonneg (MU k), abs_nonneg (Kder 1)]
  have hMF' : ∀ k, MF k ≤ |Kder k| + |MF k| + |MU k| + 41 / 10 * |Kder 1| := fun k => by
    linarith [le_abs_self (MF k), abs_nonneg (Kder k), abs_nonneg (MU k), abs_nonneg (Kder 1)]
  have hMU' : ∀ k, MU k ≤ |Kder k| + |MF k| + |MU k| + 41 / 10 * |Kder 1| := fun k => by
    linarith [le_abs_self (MU k), abs_nonneg (Kder k), abs_nonneg (MF k), abs_nonneg (Kder 1)]
  have hM4 : 41 / 10 * |Kder 1| ≤ |Kder 0| + |MF 0| + |MU 0| + 41 / 10 * |Kder 1| := by
    linarith [abs_nonneg (Kder 0), abs_nonneg (MF 0), abs_nonneg (MU 0)]
  refine ⟨fun k => |Kder k| + |MF k| + |MU k| + 41 / 10 * |Kder 1|, ?_⟩
  beta_reduce
  intro C Fn Un hC hAx t1 ht1 ht1'
  obtain ⟨hFn, hUn, hFpos, -, -, -, -, hK8⟩ := hAx
  have hCpos : 0 < C := by linarith
  have hΛpos : 0 < Λ := by linarith
  have hΛne : Λ ≠ 0 := hΛpos.ne'
  have h4pos : 0 < 4 / Λ := by positivity
  
  have hexp2 : Real.exp (2 * t1) < 41 / 40 := by
    have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(2 * t1))
    have h2 : Real.exp (2 * t1) * Real.exp (-(2 * t1)) = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
    have h3 := Real.exp_pos (2 * t1)
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 h3.le, mul_nonneg h3.le (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1')]
  have hlog : 2 * t1 < Real.log (41 / 40) := (Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt (by norm_num)).mpr hexp2
  have hX1pos : 0 < 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 := by positivity
  have hX12 : 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 ≤ 4 / Λ * Real.exp (2 * t1) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)) h4pos.le
  have hX2lt : 4 / Λ * Real.exp (2 * t1) < 41 / (10 * Λ) := by
    have e : 41 / (10 * Λ) = 4 / Λ * (41 / 40) := by field_simp; ring
    rw [e]; exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hexp2 h4pos
  have h41 : 41 / (10 * Λ) ≤ 41 / 10 := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]; nlinarith
  have hX1lt : 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 < 41 / (10 * Λ) := lt_of_le_of_lt hX12 hX2lt
  have hsig : ∀ z, 0 ≤ sigA z ∧ sigA z ≤ 1 := by
    intro z
    unfold sigA
    split_ifs
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
    · have hp := Real.exp_pos (-1 / z ^ 2)
      have hq := Real.exp_pos (-1 / (1 - z) ^ 2)
      constructor
      · positivity
      · rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]; linarith
  have hsig' : ∀ z, |1 - sigA z| ≤ 1 := fun z => by
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := hsig z
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hR4, hR5, hR6, hR7⟩ := ax_ref_regular Λ t1 ρ1 Fn Un hΛ ht1 ht1' hρ1 hFn hUn hFpos
  have KS := ax_kder_slice_bounds Λ C ρ1 Kder Fn Un hΛ hCpos hρ1 hFn hUn hFpos hK8
  have SJ := ax_axis_slice_jets Λ C ρ1 Kder Fn Un hΛ hCpos hρ1 hFn hUn hFpos hK8
  have IJ := ax_ref_integrand_jets Λ t1 ρ1 C Kder Fn Un hΛ ht1 ht1' hρ1 hCpos hFn hUn hFpos hK8
  obtain ⟨hψs0, hφs0, hRep⟩ := ax_ref_rep Λ t1 ρ1 C Fn Un hΛ ht1 ht1' hρ1 hCpos hFn hUn hFpos
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ : ∃ ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ψ = fun y e => (1 - sigA ((y - t1) / t1)) *
      (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) * (deriv (fun Y => C * Fn Y e) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) *
        (C * Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) e)⁻¹) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ : ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, φ = fun y e => (1 - sigA ((y - t1) / t1)) *
      (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) * deriv (fun Y => Un Y e) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hψs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿ψ) (Ioo 0 (Real.log (41 / 40)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) := by
    rw [hψ]; exact hψs0
  have hφs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿φ) (Ioo 0 (Real.log (41 / 40)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) := by
    rw [hφ]; exact hφs0
  have hRepF : ∀ X e : ℝ, 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 ≤ X → X ≤ 4 / Λ * Real.exp (2 * t1) →
      C * axRefF Λ t1 Fn X e =
        C * Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) e * Real.exp (∫ y in t1..axLogY Λ X, ψ y e) := by
    intro X e h1 h2; rw [hψ]; exact (hRep X e h1 h2).1
  have hRepU : ∀ X e : ℝ, 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 ≤ X → X ≤ 4 / Λ * Real.exp (2 * t1) →
      axRefU Λ t1 Un X e = Un (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) e + ∫ y in t1..axLogY Λ X, φ y e := by
    intro X e h1 h2; rw [hφ]; exact (hRep X e h1 h2).2
  have hIJψ : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y η : ℝ), 0 < y → y ≤ 2 * t1 → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 →
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ψ y e) η| ≤ Bψ k := by
    intro k y η h1 h2 h3 h4
    rw [hψ, hBψ]; exact (IJ k y η h1 h2 h3 h4).1
  have hIJφ : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y η : ℝ), 0 < y → y ≤ 2 * t1 → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 →
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => φ y e) η| ≤ 41 / 10 * |Kder (k + 1)| := by
    intro k y η h1 h2 h3 h4
    rw [hφ]; exact (IJ k y η h1 h2 h3 h4).2
  obtain ⟨hf1s, hu1s, -, -, hinv1s, hjet1⟩ := SJ (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) hX1pos.le hX1lt.le
  
  have hB : ∀ (k : ℕ) (X η : ℝ), 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 ≤ X → X ≤ 4 / Λ * Real.exp (2 * t1) →
      -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 →
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => C * axRefF Λ t1 Fn X e) η| ≤ MF k ∧
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => axRefU Λ t1 Un X e) η| ≤ MU k ∧
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => (C * axRefF Λ t1 Fn X e)⁻¹) η| ≤ MF k := by
    intro k X η hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2
    have hXpos : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hX1pos hX1
    have hm1 : t1 ≤ axLogY Λ X := by
      unfold axLogY
      rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le (by positivity)]
      calc Real.exp t1 = 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 * Λ / 4 := by field_simp
        _ ≤ X * Λ / 4 := by gcongr
    have hm2 : axLogY Λ X ≤ 2 * t1 := by
      unfold axLogY
      rw [Real.log_le_iff_le_exp (by positivity)]
      calc X * Λ / 4 ≤ 4 / Λ * Real.exp (2 * t1) * Λ / 4 := by gcongr
        _ = Real.exp (2 * t1) := by field_simp
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      have e1 : (fun e => C * axRefF Λ t1 Fn X e) = fun e =>
          C * Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) e * Real.exp (∫ y in t1..axLogY Λ X, ψ y e) := by
        funext e; exact hRepF X e hX1 hX2
      have i1 := exp_integral_product_jets (fun e => C * Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) e) ψ 0 t1
        (axLogY Λ X) (Real.log (41 / 40)) (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) (1 / 100) (fun i => |Kder i|) Bψ
        ht1 hm1 (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) hf1s hψs η hη1 hη2
        (fun i => le_trans (hjet1 i η hη1 hη2).1 (le_abs_self _))
        (fun i y hy1 hy2 => hIJψ i y η (by linarith) (by linarith) hη1 hη2) k
      rw [e1, hMF]; exact i1
    · 
      have e2 : (fun e => axRefU Λ t1 Un X e) =
          (fun e => Un (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) e) + (fun e => ∫ y in t1..axLogY Λ X, φ y e) := by
        funext e; exact hRepU X e hX1 hX2
      obtain ⟨hJs, hJb⟩ := param_int_eta_jet φ 0 t1 (axLogY Λ X) (Real.log (41 / 40)) (-1 - ρ1)
        (1 + ρ1) ht1 hm1 (by linarith) (by linarith) hφs
      have hJk := hJb k η (41 / 10 * |Kder (k + 1)|) hη1 hη2
        (fun y hy1 hy2 => hIJφ k y η (by linarith) (by linarith) hη1 hη2)
      have hnhd : Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) ∈ nhds η := Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2
      have hcd1 : ContDiffAt ℝ k (fun e => Un (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) e) η :=
        (hu1s.contDiffAt hnhd).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have hcd2 : ContDiffAt ℝ k (fun e => ∫ y in t1..axLogY Λ X, φ y e) η :=
        (hJs.contDiffAt hnhd).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      rw [e2, iteratedDeriv_add hcd1 hcd2]
      have hU1 := le_trans (hjet1 k η hη1 hη2).2.1 (le_abs_self (Kder k))
      have hlen : (axLogY Λ X - t1) * (41 / 10 * |Kder (k + 1)|) ≤
          1 / 100 * (41 / 10 * |Kder (k + 1)|) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (by positivity)
      have htri := abs_add_le (iteratedDeriv k (fun e => Un (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) e) η)
        (iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in t1..axLogY Λ X, φ y e) η)
      rw [hMU]
      show _ ≤ |Kder k| + 1 / 100 * (41 / 10 * |Kder (k + 1)|)
      linarith
    · 
      have e3 : (fun e => (C * axRefF Λ t1 Fn X e)⁻¹) = fun e =>
          (C * Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) e)⁻¹ *
            Real.exp (∫ y in t1..axLogY Λ X, (fun y e => -ψ y e) y e) := by
        funext e
        show (C * axRefF Λ t1 Fn X e)⁻¹ = (C * Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) e)⁻¹ *
            Real.exp (∫ y in t1..axLogY Λ X, -ψ y e)
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_neg, Real.exp_neg, ← mul_inv, hRepF X e hX1 hX2]
      have hψn : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun y e => -ψ y e))
          (Ioo 0 (Real.log (41 / 40)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) := hψs.neg
      have hbn : ∀ (i : ℕ) (y : ℝ), t1 ≤ y → y ≤ axLogY Λ X →
          |iteratedDeriv i (fun e => (fun y e => -ψ y e) y e) η| ≤ Bψ i := by
        intro i y hy1 hy2
        have h' : iteratedDeriv i (fun e => (fun y e => -ψ y e) y e) η =

    have hfe : (fun e => F x e ^ 2) = fun e => (C⁻¹) ^ 2 * ((C * F x e) * (C * F x e)) := by
      funext e
      rw [show (C⁻¹) ^ 2 * ((C * F x e) * (C * F x e)) = (C⁻¹ * C) ^ 2 * F x e ^ 2 by ring,
        inv_mul_cancel₀ hCne, one_pow, one_mul]
    rw [hfe, iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field, abs_mul]
    have hc : |(C⁻¹) ^ 2| ≤ 1 := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hCpos.le) 2)]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (inv_nonneg.2 hCpos.le) (inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hC)
    have hb : |iteratedDeriv j (fun e => (C * F x e) * (C * F x e)) e'| ≤ L m m j :=
      le_trans (leib (fun e => C * F x e) (fun e => C * F x e) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) e' j
        hSo he' hGs hGs)
        (summono j _ _ m m (fun i => (hJ' i x e' hx0 hx1 he1 he2).1)
          (fun i => (hJ' i x e' hx0 hx1 he1 he2).1))
    calc _ ≤ 1 * L m m j := mul_le_mul hc hb (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      _ = L m m j := one_mul _
  have hg2 : ∀ (j : ℕ) (x e' : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 110 → -1 ≤ e' → e' ≤ 1 →
      |iteratedDeriv j (fun e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) e'| ≤ 111 * L m m j := by
    intro j x e' hx0 hx1 he1 he2
    have he' : e' ∈ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hUs := hUsl x hx0
    have hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => U x e * U x e) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := hUs.mul hUs
    have hB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => x * F x e ^ 2) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) :=
      contDiffOn_const.mul ((hFsl x hx0).pow 2)
    have hfe : (fun e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) = fun e => U x e * U x e - x * F x e ^ 2 := by
      funext e; ring
    rw [hfe, iteratedDeriv_fun_sub (cdaG _ _ e' hSo he' hA j) (cdaG _ _ e' hSo he' hB j)]
    have b1 : |iteratedDeriv j (fun e => U x e * U x e) e'| ≤ L m m j :=
      le_trans (leib (fun e => U x e) (fun e => U x e) _ e' j hSo he' hUs hUs)
        (summono j _ _ m m (fun i => (hJ' i x e' hx0 hx1 he1 he2).2)
          (fun i => (hJ' i x e' hx0 hx1 he1 he2).2))
    have b2 : |iteratedDeriv j (fun e => x * F x e ^ 2) e'| ≤ 110 * L m m j := by
      rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hx0]
      exact mul_le_mul hx1 (hFsq j x e' hx0 hx1 he1 he2) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
    have t := abs_sub (iteratedDeriv j (fun e => U x e * U x e) e')
      (iteratedDeriv j (fun e => x * F x e ^ 2) e')
    linarith
  
  have rad : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (B : ℕ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) →
      (∀ (j : ℕ) (x e' : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → -1 ≤ e' → e' ≤ 1 →
        |iteratedDeriv j (fun e => g x e) e'| ≤ B j) → (∀ j, 0 ≤ B j) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => profRadInt g X e) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) ∧
        ∀ j : ℕ, |iteratedDeriv j (fun e => profRadInt g X e) η| ≤ 110 * B j := by
    intro g B hg hgb hB0
    obtain ⟨hs1, hb1⟩ := param_int_eta_jet g (-ε) 0 X (X + 1) (-1 - r) (1 + r) (by linarith)
      hX.le (by linarith) (by linarith) (hg.mono (prod_mono Ioo_subset_Ioi_self subset_rfl))
    refine ⟨hs1, fun j => ?_⟩
    have H := hb1 j η (B j) (by linarith) (by linarith) (fun y hy0 hy1 => hgb j y η hy0 hy1 h1 h2)
    have H2 : (X - 0) * B j ≤ 110 * B j := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (hB0 j)
    exact le_trans H H2
  
  have cda : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ s → ∀ j : ℕ, ContDiffAt ℝ (j : ℕ) φ η :=
    fun φ hφ j => cdaG φ s η hso hηs hφ j
  have addB : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g s → ∀ j : ℕ,
      |iteratedDeriv j (fun e => f e + g e) η| ≤ |iteratedDeriv j f η| + |iteratedDeriv j g η| := by
    intro f g hf hg j
    rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_add (cda f hf j) (cda g hg j)]
    exact abs_add_le _ _
  have subB : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g s → ∀ j : ℕ,
      |iteratedDeriv j (fun e => f e - g e) η| ≤ |iteratedDeriv j f η| + |iteratedDeriv j g η| := by
    intro f g hf hg j
    rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_sub (cda f hf j) (cda g hg j)]
    exact abs_sub _ _
  have cB : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (A : ℕ → ℝ) (K : ℝ), |c| ≤ K → 0 ≤ K →
      (∀ i, |iteratedDeriv i f η| ≤ A i) → ∀ j : ℕ,
      |iteratedDeriv j (fun e => c * f e) η| ≤ K * A j := by
    intro c f A K hc hK hA j
    rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul hc (hA j) (abs_nonneg _) hK
  have mulB : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (A B : ℕ → ℝ) (K : ℝ), |c| ≤ K → 0 ≤ K →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g s →
      (∀ i, |iteratedDeriv i f η| ≤ A i) → (∀ i, |iteratedDeriv i g η| ≤ B i) → ∀ j : ℕ,
      |iteratedDeriv j (fun e => c * (f e * g e)) η| ≤ K * L A B j := by
    intro c f g A B K hc hK hf hg hA hB j
    rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul hc (le_trans (leib f g s η j hso hηs hf hg) (summono j _ _ A B hA hB))
      (abs_nonneg _) hK
  
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ → ℝ, W = fun e => leadW h U X e := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : ℝ → ℝ, u = fun e => U X e := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨J1, hJ1⟩ : ∃ J1 : ℝ → ℝ, J1 = fun e => profRadInt U X e := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨J2, hJ2⟩ : ∃ J2 : ℝ → ℝ, J2 = fun e => profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) X e :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ → ℝ, P = fun e => axPi Pax F X e := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  obtain ⟨hWs0, hWb0⟩ := lw ε r X U m hε hr hX hU
    (fun j x e' h0 hx he1 he2 => (hJ' j x e' h0 (by linarith) he1 he2).2)
  have hWs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ W s := by rw [hW]; exact hWs0.mono hsS
  have hWb : ∀ i, |iteratedDeriv i W η| ≤ BW i := fun i => by
    rw [hW, hBW]; exact hWb0 i η h1 h2
  
  have hus : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u s := by rw [hu]; exact (hUsl X hX.le).mono hsS
  have hub : ∀ i, |iteratedDeriv i u η| ≤ m i := fun i => by
    rw [hu]; exact (hJ' i X η hX.le hX110 h1 h2).2
  
  obtain ⟨hJ1S0, hJ1b0⟩ := rad U m hU
    (fun j x e' h0 hx he1 he2 => (hJ' j x e' h0 (by linarith) he1 he2).2) mnn
  have hJ1S : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ J1 (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := by rw [hJ1]; exact hJ1S0
  have hJ1s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ J1 s := hJ1S.mono hsS
  have hJ1ds : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (deriv J1) s :=
    (((contDiffOn_infty_iff_deriv_of_isOpen hSo).mp hJ1S).2).mono hsS
  have hJ1b : ∀ i, |iteratedDeriv i J1 η| ≤ B1 i := fun i => by
    rw [hJ1, hB1]; exact hJ1b0 i
  have hJ1db : ∀ i, |iteratedDeriv i (deriv J1) η| ≤ B1s i := fun i => by
    rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ', hB1s]; exact hJ1b (i + 1)
  
  have hg2s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2))
      (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) :=
    ((hU.pow 2).sub (contDiffOn_fst.mul (hF.pow 2))).congr (fun p _ => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hJ2S0, hJ2b0⟩ := rad (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) (fun j => 111 * L m m j) hg2s
    (fun j x e' h0 hx he1 he2 => hg2 j x e' h0 (by linarith) he1 he2)
    (fun j => mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Lmm_nn j))
  have hJ2S : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ J2 (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := by rw [hJ2]; exact hJ2S0
  have hJ2s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ J2 s := hJ2S.mono hsS
  have hJ2ds : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (deriv J2) s :=
    (((contDiffOn_infty_iff_deriv_of_isOpen hSo).mp hJ2S).2).mono hsS
  have hJ2b : ∀ i, |iteratedDeriv i J2 η| ≤ B2 i := fun i => by
    rw [hJ2, hB2]; exact hJ2b0 i
  have hJ2db : ∀ i, |iteratedDeriv i (deriv J2) η| ≤ B2s i := fun i => by
    rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ', hB2s]; exact hJ2b (i + 1)
  
  have hFs2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e => F x e ^ 2)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) :=
    (hF.pow 2).congr (fun p _ => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hQS, hQb⟩ := rad (fun x e => F x e ^ 2) (L m m) hFs2
    (fun j x e' h0 hx he1 he2 => hFsq j x e' h0 (by linarith) he1 he2) Lmm_nn
  have hPeq : P = fun e => Pax e + profRadInt (fun x e => F x e ^ 2) X e := by
    subst hP; rfl
  have hPs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P s := by
    rw [hPeq]; exact (hPax.mono hsP).add (hQS.mono hsS)
  have hPds : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (deriv P) s :=
    ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_deriv_of_isOpen hso).mp hPs).2
  have hPb : ∀ i, |iteratedDeriv i P η| ≤ BP i := fun i => by
    rw [hPeq, hBP]
    exact le_trans (addB Pax (fun e => profRadInt (fun x e => F x e ^ 2) X e) (hPax.mono hsP)
      (hQS.mono hsS) i) (add_le_add (hBPax i η h1 h2) (hQb i))
  have hPdb : ∀ i, |iteratedDeriv i (deriv P) η| ≤ BPs i := fun i => by
    rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ', hBPs]; exact hPb (i + 1)
  
  have hids : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e : ℝ => e) s := contDiffOn_id
  have hidb : ∀ i, |iteratedDeriv i (fun e : ℝ => e) η| ≤ I1 i := fun i => by
    rw [hI1]; exact hid i η h1 h2
  have hq2s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e : ℝ => 1 - e ^ 2) s := contDiffOn_const.sub (contDiffOn_id.pow 2)
  have hq2b : ∀ i, |iteratedDeriv i (fun e : ℝ => 1 - e ^ 2) η| ≤ I2 i := fun i => by
    rw [hI2]; exact hp i η h1 h2
  
  obtain ⟨T1, hT1⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ → ℝ, T = fun e => (-X) * (W e * u e) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨T2, hT2⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ → ℝ, T = fun e => (1 / 2 - h) * J1 e := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨T3, hT3⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ → ℝ, T = fun e => (1 / 2 - h) * (e * deriv J1 e) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨T4, hT4⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ → ℝ, T = fun e => 4 * h * (e * J2 e) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨T5, hT5⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ → ℝ, T = fun e => 1 * ((1 - e ^ 2) * deriv J2 e) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨T6, hT6⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ → ℝ, T = fun e => 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * X * (e * P e) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨T7, hT7⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ → ℝ, T = fun e => X * ((1 - e ^ 2) * deriv P e) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : ℝ → ℝ, N = fun e => T1 e + T2 e - T3 e + T4 e - T5 e + T6 e - T7 e :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hT1s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ T1 s := by rw [hT1]; exact contDiffOn_const.mul (hWs.mul hus)
  have hT2s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ T2 s := by rw [hT2]; exact contDiffOn_const.mul hJ1s
  have hT3s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ T3 s := by rw [hT3]; exact contDiffOn_const.mul (hids.mul hJ1ds)
  have hT4s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ T4 s := by rw [hT4]; exact contDiffOn_const.mul (hids.mul hJ2s)
  have hT5s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ T5 s := by rw [hT5]; exact contDiffOn_const.mul (hq2s.mul hJ2ds)
  have hT6s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ T6 s := by rw [hT6]; exact contDiffOn_const.mul (hids.mul hPs)
  have hT7s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ T7 s := by rw [hT7]; exact contDiffOn_const.mul (hq2s.mul hPds)
  have hNs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ N s := by
    rw [hN]; exact (((((hT1s.add hT2s).sub hT3s).add hT4s).sub hT5s).add hT6s).sub hT7s
  have hca : |1 / 2 - h| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hc4 : |4 * h| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hc1 : |(1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by norm_num
  have hcX : |-X| ≤ 110 := by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hX]; exact hX110
  have hcX' : |X| ≤ 110 := by rw [abs_of_pos hX]; exact hX110
  have hc6 : |4 * (1 / 2 + h) * X| ≤ 330 := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hX.le)]
    have := mul_le_mul (show 4 * (1 / 2 + h) ≤ 3 by linarith) hX110 hX.le (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hNb : ∀ j, |iteratedDeriv j N η| ≤ BN j := by
    intro j
    have t1 : |iteratedDeriv j T1 η| ≤ 110 * L BW m j := by
      rw [hT1]; exact mulB (-X) W u BW m 110 hcX (by norm_num) hWs hus hWb hub j
    have t2 : |iteratedDeriv j T2 η| ≤ 1 * B1 j := by
      rw [hT2]; exact cB (1 / 2 - h) J1 B1 1 hca (by norm_num) hJ1b j
    have t3 : |iteratedDeriv j T3 η| ≤ 1 * L I1 B1s j := by
      rw [hT3]; exact mulB (1 / 2 - h) (fun e => e) (deriv J1) I1 B1s 1 hca (by norm_num)
        hids hJ1ds hidb hJ1db j
    have t4 : |iteratedDeriv j T4 η| ≤ 1 * L I1 B2 j := by
      rw [hT4]; exact mulB (4 * h) (fun e => e) J2 I1 B2 1 hc4 (by norm_num) hids hJ2s hidb hJ2b j
    have t5 : |iteratedDeriv j T5 η| ≤ 1 * L I2 B2s j := by
      rw [hT5]; exact mulB 1 (fun e => 1 - e ^ 2) (deriv J2) I2 B2s 1 hc1 (by norm_num)
        hq2s hJ2ds hq2b hJ2db j
    have t6 : |iteratedDeriv j T6 η| ≤ 330 * L I1 BP j := by
      rw [hT6]; exact mulB (4 * (1 / 2 + h) * X) (fun e => e) P I1 BP 330 hc6 (by norm_num)
        hids hPs hidb hPb j
    have t7 : |iteratedDeriv j T7 η| ≤ 110 * L I2 BPs j := by
      rw [hT7]; exact mulB X (fun e => 1 - e ^ 2) (deriv P) I2 BPs 110 hcX' (by norm_num)
        hq2s hPds hq2b hPdb j
    have b1 := addB T1 T2 hT1s hT2s j
    have b2 := subB (fun e => T1 e + T2 e) T3 (hT1s.add hT2s) hT3s j
    have b3 := addB (fun e => T1 e + T2 e - T3 e) T4 ((hT1s.add hT2s).sub hT3s) hT4s j
    have b4 := subB (fun e => T1 e + T2 e - T3 e + T4 e) T5
      (((hT1s.add hT2s).sub hT3s).add hT4s) hT5s j
    have b5 := addB (fun e => T1 e + T2 e - T3 e + T4 e - T5 e) T6
      ((((hT1s.add hT2s).sub hT3s).add hT4s).sub hT5s) hT6s j
    have b6 := subB (fun e => T1 e + T2 e - T3 e + T4 e - T5 e + T6 e) T7
      (((((hT1s.add hT2s).sub hT3s).add hT4s).sub hT5s).add hT6s) hT7s j
    rw [hN]
    simp only [hBN]
    linarith
  
  have alg : ∀ (w u0 j1 dj1 j2 dj2 p dp e : ℝ),
      X * (-w * u0 + ((1 / 2 - h) * (j1 - e * dj1) + 4 * h * e * j2 - (1 - e ^ 2) * dj2) / X +
          4 * (1 / 2 + h) * e * p - (1 - e ^ 2) * dp) =
        (-X) * (w * u0) + (1 / 2 - h) * j1 - (1 / 2 - h) * (e * dj1) + 4 * h * (e * j2) -
          1 * ((1 - e ^ 2) * dj2) + 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * X * (e * p) - X * ((1 - e ^ 2) * dp) := by
    intro w u0 j1 dj1 j2 dj2 p dp e
    have hXX : X * X⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hXne
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    linear_combination ((1 / 2 - h) * (j1 - e * dj1) + 4 * h * e * j2 - (1 - e ^ 2) * dj2) * hXX
  have key : ∀ e, X * axNs h Pax F U X e = N e := by
    intro e
    rw [hN]
    simp only [hT1, hT2, hT3, hT4, hT5, hT6, hT7, hW, hu, hJ1, hJ2, hP]
    simp only [axNs, profEtaD]
    exact alg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  have hfun : (fun e => X * axNs h Pax F U X e / (1 - 2 * h * e ^ 2)) = fun e => q e * N e := by
    funext e
    simp only [hqdef]
    rw [key e, div_eq_inv_mul]
  have hqs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q s := hq.mono hs2
  have hqb : ∀ i, |iteratedDeriv i q η| ≤ Bq i := fun i => hBq i η h1 h2
  rw [hfun]
  exact le_trans (leib q N s η k hso hηs hqs hNs) (summono k _ _ Bq BN hqb hNb)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h j0 rP Kd1 : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (MF : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 < j0 → j0 ≤ 1 / 20 → 0 < rP → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Pax (Ioo (-1 - rP) (1 + rP)) → ∃ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ (C ε r : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ C → 0 < ε → 0 < r → r ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (X η : ℝ), 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 110 → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => C * F X e) η| ≤ MF k ∧ |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => U X e) η| ≤ MF k) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ 110 → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |X * deriv (fun Y => U Y η) X| ≤ Kd1) → ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ 110 → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |axPi Pax F X η - Pax η| ≤ A / C ^ 2 ∧ |deriv (fun e => axPi Pax F X e) η - deriv Pax η| ≤ A / C ^ 2 ∧ |2 * η * X * F X η ^ 2| ≤ A / C ^ 2 ∧ |axSn h Pax F U X η| ≤ A ∧ |axZs h j0 Pax η| ≤ A

signature.statement: ∀ (h j0 rP Kd1 : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (MF : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 < j0 → j0 ≤ 1 / 20 → 0 < rP → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Pax (Ioo (-1 - rP) (1 + rP)) → ∃ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ (C ε r : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ C → 0 < ε → 0 < r → r ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (X η : ℝ), 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 110 → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => C * F X e) η| ≤ MF k ∧ |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => U X e) η| ≤ MF k) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ 110 → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |X * deriv (fun Y => U Y η) X| ≤ Kd1) → ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ 110 → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |axPi Pax F X η - Pax η| ≤ A / C ^ 2 ∧ |deriv (fun e => axPi Pax F X e) η - deriv Pax η| ≤ A / C ^ 2 ∧ |2 * η * X * F X η ^ 2| ≤ A / C ^ 2 ∧ |axSn h Pax F U X η| ≤ A ∧ |axZs h j0 Pax η| ≤ A

proof.tactics:

subgoal_signatures.name: ax_chi_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h j0 σ η : ℝ, 0 < σ → 0 ≤ axChi h j0 σ η ∧ axChi h j0 σ η ≤ 1 ∧ axHs h j0 η * axZeta h j0 σ η = -(1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * axChi h j0 σ η ∧ |axHs h j0 η| / (axHs h j0 η ^ 2 + σ ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (axChi h j0 σ η) / σ ∧ |deriv (fun e => axChi h j0 σ e) η| ≤ |1 / 2 - h + 4 * (1 - η ^ 2) - 2 * η * (4 * η + j0)| / σ ∧ |axHs h j0 η * deriv (fun e => axChi h j0 σ e) η| ≤ 2 * |1 / 2 - h + 4 * (1 - η ^ 2) - 2 * η * (4 * η + j0)| * axChi h j0 σ η ∧ (0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 ≤ j0 → j0 ≤ 1 / 20 → |η| ≤ 51 / 50 → |1 / 2 - h + 4 * (1 - η ^ 2) - 2 * η * (4 * η + j0)| ≤ 9 ∧ |axHs h j0 η| ≤ 5)

noncomputable def afcRF (h Λ t1 κ0 om : ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X e : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..min (axLogY Λ X) t1, (axKap κ0 t1 y - 1) * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) *
      (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y e) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) / Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) e))

      (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y e) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) / Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) e))
