  have IB : ∀ f fr f' fr' u ur u' ur' x : ℝ, |x| ≤ 110 →
      |f - fr| ≤ M * d → |f' - fr'| ≤ M * d → |u - ur| ≤ M * d → |u' - ur'| ≤ M * d →
      |fr| ≤ M → |fr'| ≤ M → |ur| ≤ M → |ur'| ≤ M → |f| ≤ M → |f'| ≤ M → |u| ≤ M → |u'| ≤ M →
      (|2 * x * f - 2 * x * fr| ≤ N * d ∧ |2 * x * f' - 2 * x * fr'| ≤ N * d ∧
        |2 * x * fr| ≤ N ∧ |2 * x * fr'| ≤ N) ∧
      (|u * (2 * x * f) - ur * (2 * x * fr)| ≤ N * d ∧
        |(u' * (2 * x * f) + u * (2 * x * f')) - (ur' * (2 * x * fr) + ur * (2 * x * fr'))| ≤ N * d ∧
        |ur * (2 * x * fr)| ≤ N ∧ |ur' * (2 * x * fr) + ur * (2 * x * fr')| ≤ N) ∧
      (|(u ^ 2 - x * f ^ 2) - (ur ^ 2 - x * fr ^ 2)| ≤ N * d ∧
        |(2 * u * u' - x * (2 * f * f')) - (2 * ur * ur' - x * (2 * fr * fr'))| ≤ N * d ∧
        |ur ^ 2 - x * fr ^ 2| ≤ N ∧ |2 * ur * ur' - x * (2 * fr * fr')| ≤ N) ∧
      (|f ^ 2 - fr ^ 2| ≤ N * d ∧ |2 * f * f' - 2 * fr * fr'| ≤ N * d ∧
        |fr ^ 2| ≤ N ∧ |2 * fr * fr'| ≤ N) ∧
      (|u - ur| ≤ N * d ∧ |u' - ur'| ≤ N * d ∧ |ur| ≤ N ∧ |ur'| ≤ N) := by
    intro f fr f' fr' u ur u' ur' x hx df df' du du' bfr bfr' bur bur' bf bf' bu bu'
    have hx2 : |2 * x| ≤ 220 := by
      have := mb _ _ _ _ h2c hx; linarith
    have e1 := mb _ _ _ _ hx2 df
    have e2 := mb _ _ _ _ hx2 df'
    have r1 := mb _ _ _ _ hx2 bfr
    have r2 := mb _ _ _ _ hx2 bfr'
    have v1 := mb _ _ _ _ hx2 bf
    have v2 := mb _ _ _ _ hx2 bf'
    rw [show 2 * x * (f - fr) = 2 * x * f - 2 * x * fr by ring] at e1
    rw [show 2 * x * (f' - fr') = 2 * x * f' - 2 * x * fr' by ring] at e2
    have p1 := pd u (2 * x * f) ur (2 * x * fr) _ _ _ _ du e1 v1 bur
    have p2 := pd u' (2 * x * f) ur' (2 * x * fr) _ _ _ _ du' e1 v1 bur'
    have p3 := pd u (2 * x * f') ur (2 * x * fr') _ _ _ _ du e2 v2 bur
    have q1 := mb _ _ _ _ bur r1
    have q2 := mb _ _ _ _ bur' r1
    have q3 := mb _ _ _ _ bur r2
    have s1 := pd u u ur ur _ _ _ _ du du bu bur
    have s2 := pd f f fr fr _ _ _ _ df df bf bfr
    have s3 := pd u u' ur ur' _ _ _ _ du du' bu' bur
    have s4 := pd f f' fr fr' _ _ _ _ df df' bf' bfr
    have t1 := mb _ _ _ _ bur bur
    have t2 := mb _ _ _ _ bfr bfr
    have t3 := mb _ _ _ _ bur bur'
    have t4 := mb _ _ _ _ bfr bfr'
    have xs2 := mb _ _ _ _ hx s2
    have xs4 := mb _ _ _ _ hx s4
    have xt2 := mb _ _ _ _ hx t2
    have xt4 := mb _ _ _ _ hx t4
    have w1 := mb _ _ _ _ h2c s3
    have w2 := mb _ _ _ _ h2c xs4
    have w3 := mb _ _ _ _ h2c t3
    have w4 := mb _ _ _ _ h2c xt4
    have w5 := mb _ _ _ _ h2c s4
    have w6 := mb _ _ _ _ h2c t4
    have hMd2 := hM2d
    refine ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩, ⟨by linarith, ?_, by linarith, ?_⟩,
      ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
    · have key : |(u' * (2 * x * f) - ur' * (2 * x * fr)) + (u * (2 * x * f') - ur * (2 * x * fr'))|
          ≤ N * d := (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith)
      convert key using 2; ring
    · exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith)
    · have key : |(u * u - ur * ur) - x * (f * f - fr * fr)| ≤ N * d := (a2 _ _).trans (by linarith)
      convert key using 2; ring
    · have key : |2 * (u * u' - ur * ur') - 2 * (x * (f * f' - fr * fr'))| ≤ N * d :=
        (a2 _ _).trans (by linarith)
      convert key using 2; ring
    · have key : |ur * ur - x * (fr * fr)| ≤ N := (a2 _ _).trans (by linarith)
      convert key using 2; ring
    · have key : |2 * (ur * ur') - 2 * (x * (fr * fr'))| ≤ N := (a2 _ _).trans (by linarith)
      convert key using 2; ring
    · have key : |f * f - fr * fr| ≤ N * d := by linarith
      convert key using 2; ring
    · have key : |2 * (f * f' - fr * fr')| ≤ N * d := by linarith
      convert key using 2; ring
    · have key : |fr * fr| ≤ N := by linarith
      convert key using 2; ring
    · have key : |2 * (fr * fr')| ≤ N := by linarith
      convert key using 2; ring
  
  have hxa : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → |x| ≤ 110 := by
    intro x h0 h1; rw [abs_of_nonneg h0]; linarith
  obtain ⟨-, -, m1d, m1'd, m1r, m1'r⟩ := cmp (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) (fun x e => 2 * x * Fr x e)
    (N * d) (N * d) N N (sm1 F hF) (sm1 Fr hFr) (by
      intro x h0 h1
      obtain ⟨p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8, p9, p10, p11, p12, -⟩ := PW x h0 h1
      have hI := IB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ x (hxa x h0 h1) p1 p2 p3 p4 p5 p6 p7 p8 p9 p10 p11 p12
      rw [(did F U hF hU x h0).1, (did Fr Ur hFr hUr x h0).1]
      exact hI.1)
  obtain ⟨-, -, m2d, m2'd, m2r, m2'r⟩ := cmp (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e))
    (fun x e => Ur x e * (2 * x * Fr x e))
    (N * d) (N * d) N N (sm2 F U hF hU) (sm2 Fr Ur hFr hUr) (by
      intro x h0 h1
      obtain ⟨p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8, p9, p10, p11, p12, -⟩ := PW x h0 h1
      have hI := IB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ x (hxa x h0 h1) p1 p2 p3 p4 p5 p6 p7 p8 p9 p10 p11 p12
      rw [(did F U hF hU x h0).2.1, (did Fr Ur hFr hUr x h0).2.1]
      exact hI.2.1)
  obtain ⟨-, -, m3d, m3'd, m3r, m3'r⟩ := cmp (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)
    (fun x e => Ur x e ^ 2 - x * Fr x e ^ 2)
    (N * d) (N * d) N N (sm4 F U hF hU) (sm4 Fr Ur hFr hUr) (by
      intro x h0 h1
      obtain ⟨p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8, p9, p10, p11, p12, -⟩ := PW x h0 h1
      have hI := IB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ x (hxa x h0 h1) p1 p2 p3 p4 p5 p6 p7 p8 p9 p10 p11 p12
      rw [(did F U hF hU x h0).2.2.1, (did Fr Ur hFr hUr x h0).2.2.1]
      exact hI.2.2.1)
  obtain ⟨D4, D4r, m4d, m4'd, m4r, m4'r⟩ := cmp (fun x e => F x e ^ 2) (fun x e => Fr x e ^ 2)
    (N * d) (N * d) N N (sm5 F hF) (sm5 Fr hFr) (by
      intro x h0 h1
      obtain ⟨p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8, p9, p10, p11, p12, -⟩ := PW x h0 h1
      have hI := IB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ x (hxa x h0 h1) p1 p2 p3 p4 p5 p6 p7 p8 p9 p10 p11 p12
      rw [(did F U hF hU x h0).2.2.2, (did Fr Ur hFr hUr x h0).2.2.2]
      exact hI.2.2.2.1)
  obtain ⟨-, -, mUd, mU'd, mUr, mU'r⟩ := cmp U Ur (N * d) (N * d) N N hU hUr (by
      intro x h0 h1
      obtain ⟨p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8, p9, p10, p11, p12, -⟩ := PW x h0 h1
      have hI := IB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ x (hxa x h0 h1) p1 p2 p3 p4 p5 p6 p7 p8 p9 p10 p11 p12
      exact hI.2.2.2.2)
  
  have hXne : X ≠ 0 := hX0.ne'
  have alg1 : ∀ W Wr n nr Fx Fxr : ℝ, Fx ≠ 0 → Fxr ≠ 0 →
      X * (-W + n / (X * (2 * X * Fx))) - X * (-Wr + nr / (X * (2 * X * Fxr))) =
        -(X * (W - Wr)) + (n - nr) / (2 * X * Fx) + nr * (Fxr - Fx) / (2 * X * Fx * Fxr) := by
    intro W Wr n nr Fx Fxr h1 h2
    field_simp
    ring
  have numb : ∀ a b c e ar br cr er : ℝ, |a - ar| ≤ X * (N * d) → |b - br| ≤ X * (N * d) →
      |c - cr| ≤ X * (N * d) → |e - er| ≤ X * (N * d) → |ar| ≤ X * N → |br| ≤ X * N →
      |cr| ≤ X * N → |er| ≤ X * N →
      |((1 - h) * a - (1 / 2 - h) * η * b - (1 - η ^ 2) * c + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * η * e) -
        ((1 - h) * ar - (1 / 2 - h) * η * br - (1 - η ^ 2) * cr + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * η * er)|
        ≤ 4 * (X * (N * d)) ∧
      |(1 - h) * ar - (1 / 2 - h) * η * br - (1 - η ^ 2) * cr + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * η * er|
        ≤ 4 * (X * N) := by
    intro a b c e ar br cr er ha hb hc he hra hrb hrc hre
    constructor
    · have key : |(1 - h) * (a - ar) - ((1 / 2 - h) * η) * (b - br) - (1 - η ^ 2) * (c - cr) +
          (2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * η) * (e - er)| ≤ 4 * (X * (N * d)) := by
        refine (a4 _ _ _ _).trans ?_
        have := cb _ _ _ c1 ha
        have := cb _ _ _ c2 hb
        have := cb _ _ _ c3 hc
        have := cb _ _ _ c4 he
        linarith
      convert key using 2; ring
    · refine (a4 _ _ _ _).trans ?_
      have := cb _ _ _ c1 hra
      have := cb _ _ _ c2 hrb
      have := cb _ _ _ c3 hrc
      have := cb _ _ _ c4 hre
      linarith
  have FXp : 0 < F X η := hFpos X η hX0' he1 he2
  obtain ⟨FXd, -, UXd, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, UXb, -, FXl⟩ := PW X hX0' le_rfl
  have FrXl : fl ≤ Fr X η := (H X η hX0' le_rfl he1 he2).1
  have FrXp : 0 < Fr X η := by linarith
  have hQ : |X * leadQs h F U X η - X * leadQs h Fr Ur X η| ≤ (220 + k1 + k2) * d := by
    unfold leadQs
    rw [alg1 _ _ _ _ _ _ FXp.ne' FrXp.ne']
    obtain ⟨nd, nrb⟩ := numb _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ m1d m1'd m2'd m2d m1r m1'r m2'r m2r
    have hd1' : X * fl ≤ 2 * X * F X η := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show fl ≤ 2 * F X η by linarith) hX0'
      linarith
    have hd2' : X * fl * fl ≤ 2 * X * F X η * Fr X η :=
      mul_le_mul hd1' FrXl hfl.le (by nlinarith)
    have FdX' : |Fr X η - F X η| ≤ M * d := by rw [abs_sub_comm]; exact FXd
    have t1 := qb _ _ _ (X * fl) (mul_pos hX0 hfl) hd1' nd
    have t2 := qb _ _ _ (X * fl * fl) (mul_pos (mul_pos hX0 hfl) hfl) hd2' (mb _ _ _ _ nrb FdX')
    have e1 : 4 * (X * (N * d)) / (X * fl) = k1 * d := by
      rw [hk1, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_eq_div_iff (mul_pos hX0 hfl).ne' hfl.ne']; ring
    have e2 : 4 * (X * N) * (M * d) / (X * fl * fl) = k2 * d := by
      rw [hk2, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_eq_div_iff (mul_pos (mul_pos hX0 hfl) hfl).ne'
        (mul_pos hfl hfl).ne']; ring
    rw [e1] at t1
    rw [e2] at t2
    have t0 := mb _ _ _ _ hXa hW
    have hXd : X * d ≤ 110 * d := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hX1 hd0
    refine (a3n _ _ _).trans ?_
    linarith
  
  have alg2 : ∀ W Wr u ur S Sr P Pr Q Qr : ℝ,
      X * (-W * u + S / X + 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * P - (1 - η ^ 2) * Q) -
        X * (-Wr * ur + Sr / X + 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * Pr - (1 - η ^ 2) * Qr) =
      -(X * (W * u - Wr * ur)) + (S - Sr) + X * (4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * (P - Pr)) -
        X * ((1 - η ^ 2) * (Q - Qr)) := by
    intro W Wr u ur S Sr P Pr Q Qr
    field_simp
    ring
  have Sb : ∀ I Ir I' Ir' J Jr J' Jr' : ℝ, |I - Ir| ≤ X * (N * d) → |I' - Ir'| ≤ X * (N * d) →
      |J - Jr| ≤ X * (N * d) → |J' - Jr'| ≤ X * (N * d) →
      |((1 / 2 - h) * (I - η * I') + 4 * h * η * J - (1 - η ^ 2) * J') -
        ((1 / 2 - h) * (Ir - η * Ir') + 4 * h * η * Jr - (1 - η ^ 2) * Jr')| ≤ 4 * (X * (N * d)) := by
    intro I Ir I' Ir' J Jr J' Jr' h1 h2 h3 h4
    have key : |(1 / 2 - h) * (I - Ir) - ((1 / 2 - h) * η) * (I' - Ir') + (4 * h * η) * (J - Jr) -
        (1 - η ^ 2) * (J' - Jr')| ≤ 4 * (X * (N * d)) := by
      refine (a4' _ _ _ _).trans ?_
      have := cb _ _ _ c0 h1
      have := cb _ _ _ c2 h2
      have := cb _ _ _ c5 h3
      have := cb _ _ _ c3 h4
      linarith
    convert key using 2; ring
  have hPd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Pax η :=
    (hPax.contDiffAt (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds ⟨he1, he2⟩)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hQF : profEtaD (axPi Pax F) X η = deriv Pax η + profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => F x e ^ 2)) X η := by
    unfold profEtaD axPi
    exact (hPd.hasDerivAt.add D4.hasDerivAt).deriv
  have hQFr : profEtaD (axPi Pax Fr) X η =
      deriv Pax η + profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => Fr x e ^ 2)) X η := by
    unfold profEtaD axPi
    exact (hPd.hasDerivAt.add D4r.hasDerivAt).deriv
  have m4d' : |axPi Pax F X η - axPi Pax Fr X η| ≤ X * (N * d) := by
    have e : axPi Pax F X η - axPi Pax Fr X η =
        profRadInt (fun x e => F x e ^ 2) X η - profRadInt (fun x e => Fr x e ^ 2) X η := by
      unfold axPi; ring
    rw [e]; exact m4d
  have m4'd' : |profEtaD (axPi Pax F) X η - profEtaD (axPi Pax Fr) X η| ≤ X * (N * d) := by
    rw [hQF, hQFr]
    have e : deriv Pax η + profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => F x e ^ 2)) X η -
        (deriv Pax η + profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => Fr x e ^ 2)) X η) =
        profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => F x e ^ 2)) X η -
          profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x e => Fr x e ^ 2)) X η := by ring
    rw [e]; exact m4'd
  have hK : |X * axNs h Pax F U X η - X * axNs h Pax Fr Ur X η| ≤
      (550 * M ^ 2 + 440 * N + 48400 * N) * d := by
    unfold axNs
    rw [alg2]
    have T1 := mb _ _ _ _ hXa (pd _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hW UXd UXb hWr)
    have T2 := Sb _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ mUd mU'd m3d m3'd
    have T3 := mb _ _ _ _ hXa (mb _ _ _ _ c6 m4d')
    have T4 := mb _ _ _ _ hXa (cb _ _ _ c3 m4'd')
    have hGMd : Gb * (M * d) ≤ M * (M * d) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hGM hMd0
    refine (a4n _ _ _ _).trans ?_
    linarith
  constructor
  · unfold psLead1
    rw [← sub_div]
    refine (qb _ _ _ (1 / 2) (by norm_num) hL0 hQ).trans ?_
    have e : (220 + k1 + k2) * d / (1 / 2) = B1 * d := by rw [hB1]; ring
    rw [e]
    linarith [mul_nonneg hB20 hd0]
  · rw [← sub_div]
    refine (qb _ _ _ (1 / 2) (by norm_num) hL0 hK).trans ?_
    have e : (550 * M ^ 2 + 440 * N + 48400 * N) * d / (1 / 2) = B2 * d := by rw [hB2]; ring
    rw [e]
    linarith [mul_nonneg hB10 hd0]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (ε Bd C Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ : ℝ) (ℓ G : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), AxInner h Pax ε Bd C Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ ℓ G F U → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m ℓ η| ≤ K ∧ |iteratedDeriv m G η| ≤ K

signature.name: ax_inner_eta_bounds
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (ε Bd C Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ : ℝ) (ℓ G : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), AxInner h Pax ε Bd C Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ ℓ G F U → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m ℓ η| ≤ K ∧ |iteratedDeriv m G η| ≤ K

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Pax ε Bd C Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ ℓ G F U hIn m
  obtain ⟨⟨_hXa, _, _, _, _hXa2, hτ, _haa, hC1⟩, ⟨ε', hε', hFs, hUs, _hFpos, hFUbd⟩, _hA3, hExp,
    _hℓs, _hGs, hBd, _hUb, _hrest⟩ := hIn
  
  have hcomp : ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (g : E → ℝ) (f : ℝ → E)
      (t : Set E), IsOpen t → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g t → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (Ioo (-1) 1) →
      MapsTo f (Ioo (-1) 1) t →
      (∀ i : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g (f x)‖ ≤ B) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ ≤ B) →
      ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, |iteratedDeriv n (g ∘ f) x| ≤ K := by
    intro E _ _ g f t ht hg hf hmaps hgB hfB n
    choose Cg hCg using hgB
    choose Cf hCf using hfB
    refine ⟨(n.factorial : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |Cg i|) *
      (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |Cf i|) ^ n, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have hgb : ∀ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i g t (f x)‖ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |Cg i| := by
      intro i hi
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i ht (hmaps hx)]
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g (f x)‖ ≤ Cg i := hCg i x hx
        _ ≤ |Cg i| := le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ _ := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cg i|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
            (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
    have hfb : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i f (Ioo (-1) 1) x‖ ≤
        (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |Cf i|) ^ i := by
      intro i hi1 hi
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i isOpen_Ioo hx]
      have hS : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |Cf i| :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ ≤ Cf i := hCf i x hx
        _ ≤ |Cf i| := le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |Cf i| :=
            Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cf i|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
              (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
        _ ≤ 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |Cf i| := by linarith
        _ ≤ _ := le_self_pow₀ (by linarith) (by omega)
    have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hg hf (by exact_mod_cast le_top) ht.uniqueDiffOn
      isOpen_Ioo.uniqueDiffOn hmaps hx hgb hfb
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n isOpen_Ioo hx, norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv,
      Real.norm_eq_abs] at key
    exact key
  
  set ι : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ := fun e => ((110 : ℝ), e) with hι
  have hιs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ι := contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id
  have hιB : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i ι x‖ ≤ B := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      ((hιs.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (m := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).continuousOn
        (s := Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    exact ⟨B, fun x hx => hB x (Ioo_subset_Icc_self hx)⟩
  have hιm : MapsTo ι (Ioo (-1) 1) (Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    intro e he
    exact ⟨show -ε' < (110 : ℝ) by linarith, he⟩
  have hΩ : IsOpen (Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hFUB : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (↿F) (ι x)‖ ≤ B ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (↿U) (ι x)‖ ≤ B := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hFUbd 110 i
    exact ⟨B, fun x hx => hB 110 x (by norm_num) le_rfl hx.1 hx.2⟩
  have h110 : 110 * Real.exp (-τ) ≤ 110 := by
    have : Real.exp (-τ) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨KG, hKG⟩ := hcomp (↿U) ι _ hΩ hUs hιs.contDiffOn hιm
    (fun i => (hFUB i).imp (fun B hB x hx => (hB x hx).2)) hιB m
  
  have hφs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((↿F) ∘ ι) (Ioo (-1) 1) := hFs.comp hιs.contDiffOn hιm
  have hφB : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i ((↿F) ∘ ι) x‖ ≤ B := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hcomp (↿F) ι _ hΩ hFs hιs.contDiffOn hιm
      (fun i => (hFUB i).imp (fun B hB x hx => (hB x hx).1)) hιB i
    refine ⟨B, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hB x hx
  set κ : ℝ := C * Real.sqrt (2 * 110) with hκd
  have hκ : 0 < κ := mul_pos (by linarith) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num))
  have hφeq : ∀ e ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ((↿F) ∘ ι) e = Real.exp (ℓ e) / κ := by
    intro e he
    show F 110 e = Real.exp (ℓ e) / κ
    rw [(hExp 110 e h110 he.1 he.2).2, div_self (by norm_num : (110 : ℝ) ≠ 0), Real.one_rpow,
      mul_one]
  set L : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => Real.log (κ * y) with hLd
  have hLs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (Ioi 0) :=
    (contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_id).log (fun y hy => (mul_pos hκ hy).ne')
  have hLB : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i L (((↿F) ∘ ι) x)‖ ≤ B := by
    intro i
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i L) (Ioi 0) :=
      (hLs.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (m := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
        isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn).congr
        (fun y hy => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i isOpen_Ioi hy).symm)
    have hsub : Icc (Real.exp (-Bd) / κ) (Real.exp Bd / κ) ⊆ Ioi 0 :=
      fun y hy => lt_of_lt_of_le (div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) hκ) hy.1
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hcont.mono hsub)
    refine ⟨B, fun x hx => hB _ ?_⟩
    rw [hφeq x hx]
    obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := abs_le.mp (hBd x hx.1 hx.2).1
    constructor
    · gcongr
    · gcongr
  have hφm : MapsTo ((↿F) ∘ ι) (Ioo (-1) 1) (Ioi 0) := by
    intro x hx
    show 0 < ((↿F) ∘ ι) x
    rw [hφeq x hx]
    exact div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) hκ
  obtain ⟨Kℓ, hKℓ⟩ := hcomp L ((↿F) ∘ ι) _ isOpen_Ioi hLs hφs hφm hLB hφB m
  refine ⟨max Kℓ KG, fun η h1 h2 => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · have hev : ℓ =ᶠ[nhds η] (L ∘ ((↿F) ∘ ι)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2) (fun e he => by
        show ℓ e = Real.log (κ * ((↿F) ∘ ι) e)
        rw [hφeq e he, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hκ.ne', Real.log_exp])
    rw [hev.iteratedDeriv_eq m]
    exact (hKℓ η ⟨h1, h2⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  · have hev : G =ᶠ[nhds η] ((↿U) ∘ ι) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2) (fun e he => by
        show G e = U 110 e
        exact (hExp 110 e h110 he.1 he.2).1.symm)
    rw [hev.iteratedDeriv_eq m]
    exact (hKG η ⟨h1, h2⟩).trans (le_max_right _ _)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (Pst C T : ℝ) (ℓ G : ℝ → ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ), 0 < Pst → 0 < C → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ℓ (Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c (Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (β i)) → (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (γ j)) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m ℓ η| ≤ K ∧ |iteratedDeriv m G η| ≤ K ∧ ‖iteratedDeriv m c η‖ ≤ K) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axGlueFe Pst C T ℓ γ c)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axGlueUe Pst C G β c)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < a → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, a ≤ X → X ≤ b → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(axGlueFe Pst C T ℓ γ c)) (X, η)‖ ≤ K ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(axGlueUe Pst C G β c)) (X, η)‖ ≤ K

signature.name: ax_glue_explicit_regular
signature.statement: ∀ (Pst C T : ℝ) (ℓ G : ℝ → ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ), 0 < Pst → 0 < C → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ℓ (Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c (Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (β i)) → (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (γ j)) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m ℓ η| ≤ K ∧ |iteratedDeriv m G η| ≤ K ∧ ‖iteratedDeriv m c η‖ ≤ K) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axGlueFe Pst C T ℓ γ c)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axGlueUe Pst C G β c)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < a → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, a ≤ X → X ≤ b → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(axGlueFe Pst C T ℓ γ c)) (X, η)‖ ≤ K ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(axGlueUe Pst C G β c)) (X, η)‖ ≤ K

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Pst C T ℓ G β γ c hPst hC hℓ hG hc hβ hγ hb
  have hk : ∀ k : ℕ, (k : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := fun k => by exact_mod_cast le_top
  
  have Tcpt : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (φ : ℝ × ℝ → V)
      (W S K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen W → IsCompact K → S ⊆ K → K ⊆ W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ W →
      ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k φ z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro V _ _ φ W S K hW hK hSK hKW hφ k
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k φ W) W :=
      hφ.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (hk k) hW.uniqueDiffOn
    have h2 : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k φ) W :=
      h1.congr (fun z hz => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hW hz).symm)
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (h2.mono hKW)
    exact ⟨C, fun z hz => hC z (hSK hz)⟩
  
  have Tadd : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (Ω S : Set (ℝ × ℝ))
      (f g : ℝ × ℝ → V), IsOpen Ω → S ⊆ Ω → axgeGood Ω S f → axgeGood Ω S g →
      axgeGood Ω S (fun z => f z + g z) := by
    intro V _ _ Ω S f g hΩ hS hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.add hg.1, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨Cf, hCf⟩ := hf.2 k
    obtain ⟨Cg, hCg⟩ := hg.2 k
    refine ⟨Cf + Cg, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hzn := hΩ.mem_nhds (hS hz)
    have e := iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((hf.1.contDiffAt hzn).of_le (hk k))
      ((hg.1.contDiffAt hzn).of_le (hk k))
    have e' : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => f z + g z) z =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g z := e
    rw [e']
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hCf z hz) (hCg z hz))
  
  have Tbil : ∀ {E F H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F]
      [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] H)
      (Ω S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (f : ℝ × ℝ → E) (g : ℝ × ℝ → F), IsOpen Ω → S ⊆ Ω →
      axgeGood Ω S f → axgeGood Ω S g → axgeGood Ω S (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) := by
    intro E F H _ _ _ _ _ _ B Ω S f g hΩ hS hf hg
    refine ⟨(B.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hf.1).clm_apply hg.1, fun k => ?_⟩
    choose Cf hCf using hf.2
    choose Cg hCg using hg.2
    refine ⟨‖B‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cf i| * |Cg (k - i)|,
      fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hz' := hS hz
    have hb := B.norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_le_of_bilinear hf.1 hg.1 hΩ.uniqueDiffOn hz' (hk k)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hΩ hz'] at hb
    refine hb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_) (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg B))
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩ hz', iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (k - i) hΩ hz']
    have h1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f z‖ ≤ |Cf i| := (hCf i z hz).trans (le_abs_self _)
    have h2 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) g z‖ ≤ |Cg (k - i)| :=
      (hCg (k - i) z hz).trans (le_abs_self _)
    have h0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 h0) h2 (norm_nonneg _)
      (mul_nonneg h0 (abs_nonneg _))
  
  have Tcomp : ∀ {E F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F]
      [NormedSpace ℝ F] (Ω S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (Tt : Set E) (g : E → F) (f : ℝ × ℝ → E),
      IsOpen Ω → S ⊆ Ω → IsOpen Tt → MapsTo f Ω Tt → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g Tt → axgeGood Ω S f →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (f z)‖ ≤ C) →
      axgeGood Ω S (fun z => g (f z)) := by
    intro E F _ _ _ _ Ω S Tt g f hΩ hS hT hmap hg hf hgb
    refine ⟨hg.comp hf.1 hmap, fun k => ?_⟩
    choose Cf hCf using hf.2
    choose Cg hCg using hgb
    refine ⟨(k.factorial : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cg i|) *
      (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cf i|) ^ k, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hz' := hS hz
    have hD1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cf i| :=
      le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have hgC : ∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i g Tt (f z)‖ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cg i| := by
      intro i hi
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hT (hmap hz')]
      refine (hCg i z hz).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans ?_)
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cg i|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
    have hfD : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i f Ω z‖ ≤
        (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cf i|) ^ i := by
      intro i hi1 hik
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩ hz']
      refine (hCf i z hz).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans ?_)
      refine le_trans ?_ (le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega))
      have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cf i|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (show i < k + 1 by omega))
      linarith
    have hb := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hg hf.1 (hk k) hT.uniqueDiffOn hΩ.uniqueDiffOn
      hmap hz' hgC hfD
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hΩ hz'] at hb
    exact hb
  
  have Texp : ∀ (Ω S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen Ω → S ⊆ Ω → axgeGood Ω S A →
      axgeGood Ω S (fun z => Real.exp (A z)) := by
    intro Ω S A hΩ hS hA
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hA.2 0
    refine Tcomp Ω S univ Real.exp A hΩ hS isOpen_univ (fun _ _ => mem_univ _)
      Real.contDiff_exp.contDiffOn hA (fun k => ⟨Real.exp M, fun z hz => ?_⟩)
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate, Real.iter_deriv_exp,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.abs_exp]
    have := hM z hz
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ((le_abs_self _).trans this)
  
  have Tlift : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (h : ℝ → V) (a b : ℝ),
      0 < a → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h (Ioo (-1) 1) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedDeriv k h η‖ ≤ K) →
      axgeGood (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => h z.2) := by
    intro V _ _ h a b ha hh hhb
    have hΩ : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hS : Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 :=
      fun z hz => ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le ha hz.1.1, hz.2⟩
    have hsnd : axgeGood (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)
        (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.2) :=
      ⟨contDiff_snd.contDiffOn, Tcpt _ univ _ (Icc a b ×ˢ Icc (-1) 1) isOpen_univ
        (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc) (prod_mono subset_rfl Ioo_subset_Icc_self)
        (subset_univ _) contDiff_snd.contDiffOn⟩
    refine Tcomp _ (Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Ioo (-1) 1) h (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.2) hΩ hS
      isOpen_Ioo (fun z hz => hz.2) hh hsnd (fun k => ?_)
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hhb k
    exact ⟨K, fun z hz => by
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]; exact hK z.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2⟩
  
  have TX : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (φ : ℝ × ℝ → V) (a b : ℝ),
      0 < a → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ univ) →
      axgeGood (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) φ := by
    intro V _ _ φ a b ha hφ
    refine ⟨hφ.mono (prod_mono subset_rfl (subset_univ _)), Tcpt φ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ univ) _
      (Icc a b ×ˢ Icc (-1) 1) (isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_univ) (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)
      (prod_mono subset_rfl Ioo_subset_Icc_self) ?_ hφ⟩
    intro z hz
    exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le ha hz.1.1, mem_univ _⟩
  have hcongr : ∀ (Ω S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), f = g → axgeGood Ω S g →
      axgeGood Ω S f := fun Ω S f g h hg => by rw [h]; exact hg
  
  obtain ⟨XR, hXRdef⟩ : ∃ XR : ℝ, XR = 110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hXR : 0 < XR := by rw [hXRdef]; exact mul_pos (by norm_num) (pow_pos (mul_pos hC hPst) 10)
  have hσ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Real.smoothTransition := Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := ⊤)
  have hfst : ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.1) z :=
    fun z => contDiff_fst.contDiffAt
  have hq1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => 1 + z.2 ^ 2) := contDiff_const.add (contDiff_snd.pow 2)
  have hq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (1 + z.2 ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
    hq1.inv (fun z => by positivity)
  have hlogq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Real.log ((1 + z.2 ^ 2)⁻¹)) :=
    hq.log (fun z => by positivity)
  have hsinv : ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ, 0 < z.1 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (Real.sqrt (2 * z.1))⁻¹) z :=
    fun z hz => (((contDiffAt_const (c := (2:ℝ))).mul (hfst z)).sqrt (mul_pos two_pos hz).ne').inv
      (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (mul_pos two_pos hz)).ne'
  have hL1 : ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ, 0 < z.1 →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (Real.log (z.1 / 110) - 1) / T) z :=
    fun z hz => ((((hfst z).div_const 110).log (div_pos hz (by norm_num)).ne').sub
      (contDiffAt_const (c := (1:ℝ)))).div_const T
  have hL2 : ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ, 0 < z.1 →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Real.log (z.1 / XR) + 8) z :=
    fun z hz => (((hfst z).div_const XR).log (div_pos hz hXR).ne').add
      (contDiffAt_const (c := (8:ℝ)))
  have main : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < a →
      axgeGood (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (↿(axGlueFe Pst C T ℓ γ c)) ∧
      axgeGood (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (↿(axGlueUe Pst C G β c)) := by
    intro a b ha
    have hΩ : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hS : Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 :=
      fun z hz => ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le ha hz.1.1, hz.2⟩
    have hWsm : ∀ φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, (∀ z : ℝ × ℝ, 0 < z.1 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ φ z) →
        axgeGood (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) φ :=
      fun φ h => TX φ a b ha (fun z hz => (h z hz.1).contDiffWithinAt)
    
    have gQ1 := hWsm (fun z => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((Real.log (z.1 / 110) - 1) / T))
      (fun z hz => (contDiffAt_const (c := (1:ℝ))).sub (hσ.contDiffAt.comp z (hL1 z hz)))
    have gR1 := hWsm (fun z => Real.smoothTransition ((Real.log (z.1 / 110) - 1) / T) *
        Real.log ((1 + z.2 ^ 2)⁻¹))
      (fun z hz => (hσ.contDiffAt.comp z (hL1 z hz)).mul hlogq.contDiffAt)
    have gP := hWsm (fun z => (z.1 / 110) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) * C⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (2 * z.1))⁻¹)
      (fun z hz => ((((hfst z).div_const 110).rpow_const_of_ne (div_pos hz (by norm_num)).ne').mul
        (contDiffAt_const (c := C⁻¹))).mul (hsinv z hz))
    have gΓ : ∀ j : Fin 3, axgeGood (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)
        (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => γ j (z.1 / XR) * (Real.sqrt (2 * z.1))⁻¹) := fun j =>
      hWsm _ (fun z hz => ((hγ j).contDiffAt.comp z ((hfst z).div_const XR)).mul (hsinv z hz))
    have gQ2 := hWsm (fun z => 1 - Real.smoothTransition (Real.log (z.1 / XR) + 8))
      (fun z hz => (contDiffAt_const (c := (1:ℝ))).sub (hσ.contDiffAt.comp z (hL2 z hz)))
    have gR2 := hWsm (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (Real.log (z.1 / XR) + 8) * (4 * z.2))
      (fun z hz => (hσ.contDiffAt.comp z (hL2 z hz)).mul
        ((contDiffAt_const (c := (4:ℝ))).mul contDiff_snd.contDiffAt))
    have gB : ∀ i : Fin 2, axgeGood (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)
        (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => β i (z.1 / XR)) := fun i =>
      hWsm _ (fun z hz => (hβ i).contDiffAt.comp z ((hfst z).div_const XR))
    have gL := Tlift ℓ a b ha hℓ (fun k => (hb k).imp fun K hK η h1 h2 => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact (hK η h1 h2).1)
    have gG := Tlift G a b ha hG (fun k => (hb k).imp fun K hK η h1 h2 => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact (hK η h1 h2).2.1)
    have gc := Tlift c a b ha hc (fun k => (hb k).imp fun K hK η h1 h2 => (hK η h1 h2).2.2)
    
    have gA := Tadd _ _ _ _ hΩ hS (Tbil (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) _ _ _ _ hΩ hS gQ1 gL) gR1
    have gE := Texp _ _ _ hΩ hS gA
    have gt1 := Tbil (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) _ _ _ _ hΩ hS gE gP
    have ge : ∀ (k : Fin 5) (j : Fin 3), axgeGood (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)
        (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 5 => ℝ) k)) (c z.2)
          (γ j (z.1 / XR) * (Real.sqrt (2 * z.1))⁻¹)) := fun k j =>
      Tbil _ _ _ _ _ hΩ hS gc (gΓ j)
    have gu : ∀ (k : Fin 5) (i : Fin 2), axgeGood (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)
        (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 5 => ℝ) k)) (c z.2)
          (β i (z.1 / XR))) := fun k i =>
      Tbil _ _ _ _ _ hΩ hS gc (gB i)
    have gFe := Tadd _ _ _ _ hΩ hS gt1
      (Tadd _ _ _ _ hΩ hS (Tadd _ _ _ _ hΩ hS (ge 2 0) (ge 3 1)) (ge 4 2))
    have gUe := Tadd _ _ _ _ hΩ hS
      (Tadd _ _ _ _ hΩ hS (Tbil (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) _ _ _ _ hΩ hS gQ2 gG) gR2)
      (Tadd _ _ _ _ hΩ hS (gu 0 0) (gu 1 1))
    refine ⟨hcongr _ _ _ _ ?_ gFe, hcongr _ _ _ _ ?_ gUe⟩
    · funext z
      obtain ⟨X, η⟩ := z
      show axGlueFe Pst C T ℓ γ c X η = _
      simp only [axGlueFe, axLam, ← hXRdef, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply',
        ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply]
      ring
    · funext z
      obtain ⟨X, η⟩ := z
      show axGlueUe Pst C G β c X η = _
      simp only [axGlueUe, ← hXRdef, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply',
        ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply]
      ring
  obtain ⟨h1F, h1U⟩ := main 1 1 one_pos
  refine ⟨h1F.1, h1U.1, fun a b ha m => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hF, hU⟩ := main a b ha
  obtain ⟨CF, hCF⟩ := hF.2 m
  obtain ⟨CU, hCU⟩ := hU.2 m
  refine ⟨max CF CU, fun X η h1 h2 h3 h4 => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · exact (hCF (X, η) ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  · exact (hCU (X, η) ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩).trans (le_max_right _ _)

ax_glue_explicit_regular.definitions:
abbrev axgeGood {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (Ω S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (f : ℝ × ℝ → V) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z‖ ≤ C

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h ε r X : ℝ) (U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (B : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 < ε → 0 < r → 0 < X → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (x η : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => U x e) η| ≤ B k) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => leadW h U X e) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (η : ℝ), -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => leadW h U X e) η| ≤ 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * (B (k - i) + 2 * B (k - i + 1))

signature.name: leadW_jet
signature.statement: ∀ (h ε r X : ℝ) (U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (B : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 < ε → 0 < r → 0 < X → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (x η : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => U x e) η| ≤ B k) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => leadW h U X e) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (η : ℝ), -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => leadW h U X e) η| ≤ 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * (B (k - i) + 2 * B (k - i + 1))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h ε r X U B hh0 hh1 hε hr hX hU hB
  
  have leib : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (s : Set ℝ) (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsOpen s → x ∈ s →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g s →
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => f e * g e) x| ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv i f x| * |iteratedDeriv (k - i) g x| := by
    intro f g s x k hs hx hf hg
    have H := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hf hg hs.uniqueDiffOn hx (n := k)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hw : ∀ (j : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), iteratedDerivWithin j φ s x = iteratedDeriv j φ x :=
      fun j φ => iteratedDerivWithin_of_isOpen hs hx
    simp only [norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_norm_iteratedDerivWithin, Real.norm_eq_abs, hw] at H
    exact H
  have hSo : IsOpen (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := isOpen_Ioo
  
  have hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun s e : ℝ => U (s * X) e))
      (Ioo (-ε / X) 2 ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := by
    have hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1 * X, p.2)) :=
      (contDiff_fst.mul contDiff_const).prodMk contDiff_snd
    have hmaps : MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1 * X, p.2))
        (Ioo (-ε / X) 2 ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := by
      intro p hp
      simp only [mem_prod, mem_Ioo, mem_Ioi] at hp ⊢
      refine ⟨?_, hp.2⟩
      have h1 : -ε / X < p.1 := hp.1.1
      rwa [div_lt_iff₀ hX] at h1
    exact hU.comp hφ.contDiffOn hmaps
  have hlt : -ε / X < 0 := by
    have := div_pos hε hX
    rw [neg_div]; linarith
  have param_int_eta_jet : ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a' a b b' c d : ℝ), a' < a → a ≤ b → b < b' → c < d → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿ψ) (Ioo a' b' ×ˢ Ioo c d) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) (Ioo c d) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (η B : ℝ), c < η → η < d → (∀ y : ℝ, a ≤ y → y ≤ b → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ψ y e) η| ≤ B) → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) η| ≤ (b - a) * B := by
    intro ψ a' a b b' c d ha hab hb hcd hψ
    set W : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Ioo a' b' ×ˢ Ioo c d with hW
    have hWo : IsOpen W := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hIoc : Set.uIoc a b = Ioc a b := Set.uIoc_of_le hab
    have leib : ∀ (φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (η : ℝ), c < η → η < d →
        ContinuousOn (↿φ) W → ContinuousOn (↿φ') W →
        (∀ y e : ℝ, a' < y → y < b' → c < e → e < d →
          HasDerivAt (fun e' => φ y e') (φ' y e) e) →
        HasDerivAt (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, φ y e) (∫ y in a..b, φ' y η) η := by
      intro φ φ' η hη1 hη2 hφ hφ' hder
      set r := min (η - c) (d - η) / 2 with hr
      have hr0 : 0 < r := by
        have : 0 < min (η - c) (d - η) := lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
        linarith
      have hr1 : r ≤ (η - c) / 2 := by
        have := min_le_left (η - c) (d - η); linarith
      have hr2 : r ≤ (d - η) / 2 := by
        have := min_le_right (η - c) (d - η); linarith
      have hKW : Icc a b ×ˢ Icc (η - r) (η + r) ⊆ W := by
        rintro ⟨t, x⟩ ⟨⟨ht1, ht2⟩, hx1, hx2⟩
        exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩
      obtain ⟨Bd, hBd⟩ :=
        (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hφ'.mono hKW)
      have slice : ∀ (χ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn (↿χ) W → ∀ x, c < x → x < d →
          ContinuousOn (fun t => χ t x) (Icc a b) := by
        intro χ hχ x hx1 hx2
        have : ContinuousOn (↿χ ∘ fun t : ℝ => (t, x)) (Icc a b) :=
          hχ.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
            (fun t ht => ⟨⟨by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩, hx1, hx2⟩)
        exact this
      have hmeas : ∀ (χ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn (↿χ) W → ∀ x, c < x → x < d →
          AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => χ t x) (volume.restrict (Set.uIoc a b)) := by
        intro χ hχ x hx1 hx2
        rw [hIoc]
        exact ((slice χ hχ x hx1 hx2).mono Ioc_subset_Icc_self).aestronglyMeasurable
          measurableSet_Ioc
      have key := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
        (μ := volume) (F := fun x t => φ t x) (F' := fun x t => φ' t x) (x₀ := η)
        (bound := fun _ => Bd) (a := a) (b := b) (s := Ioo (η - r) (η + r))
        (Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith))
        (Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2) (fun x hx => hmeas φ hφ x hx.1 hx.2))
        ((slice φ hφ η hη1 hη2).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab)
        (hmeas φ' hφ' η hη1 hη2)
        (ae_of_all _ (fun t ht x hx => by
          rw [hIoc] at ht
          exact hBd (t, x) ⟨⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩, hx.1.le, hx.2.le⟩))
        intervalIntegrable_const
        (ae_of_all _ (fun t ht x hx => by
          rw [hIoc] at ht
          exact hder t x (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.2]) (by linarith [hx.1])
            (by linarith [hx.2])))
      exact key.2
    set Ψ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun k y e => iteratedDeriv k (fun e' => ψ y e') e with hΨ
    have chain : ∀ (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (y e : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W → (y, e) ∈ W →
        HasDerivAt (fun e' => g (y, e')) (fderiv ℝ g (y, e) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) e := by
      intro g y e hg hye
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (y, e) :=
        (hg.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hye)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hp : HasDerivAt (fun e' : ℝ => (y, e')) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) e :=
        (hasDerivAt_const e y).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' e)
      exact hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt e hp
    have s1 : ∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(Ψ k)) W := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        have : ↿(Ψ 0) = ↿ψ := by
          funext p
          simp [hΨ]
        rw [this]; exact hψ
      | succ k ih =>
        have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿(Ψ k))) W :=
          ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hWo).1 ih).2
        have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => fderiv ℝ (↿(Ψ k)) p ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) W :=
          hf.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
        refine hG.congr ?_
        rintro ⟨y, e⟩ hye
        have h1 := chain (↿(Ψ k)) y e ih hye
        show iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun e' => ψ y e') e = _
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        exact h1.deriv
    have s2 : ∀ k y e, a' < y → y < b' → c < e → e < d →
        HasDerivAt (fun e' => Ψ k y e') (Ψ (k + 1) y e) e := by
      intro k y e h1 h2 h3 h4
      have h5 := chain (↿(Ψ k)) y e (s1 k) ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩
      have heq : Ψ (k + 1) y e = fderiv ℝ (↿(Ψ k)) (y, e) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) := by
        show iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun e' => ψ y e') e = _
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        exact h5.deriv
      rw [heq]
      exact h5
    have hC : ∀ k η, c < η → η < d →
        iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) η = ∫ y in a..b, Ψ k y η := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro η _ _
        simp [hΨ]
      | succ k ih =>
        intro η h1 h2
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        have hev : iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) =ᶠ[nhds η]
            fun e => ∫ y in a..b, Ψ k y e :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2) (fun e he => ih e he.1 he.2)
        rw [hev.deriv_eq]
        exact (leib (Ψ k) (Ψ (k + 1)) η h1 h2 (s1 k).continuousOn (s1 (k + 1)).continuousOn
          (s2 k)).deriv
    have hsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) (Ioo c d) := by
      apply contDiffOn_of_differentiableOn_deriv
      intro m _
      have hd : DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, Ψ m y e) (Ioo c d) := fun e he =>
        (leib (Ψ m) (Ψ (m + 1)) e he.1 he.2 (s1 m).continuousOn (s1 (m + 1)).continuousOn
          (s2 m)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      refine hd.congr ?_
      intro e he
      rw [iteratedDerivWithin_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioo he, hC m e he.1 he.2]
    refine ⟨hsmooth, fun k η B h1 h2 hB => ?_⟩
    rw [hC k η h1 h2]
    have hI := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := a) (b := b) (C := B)
      (f := fun y => Ψ k y η) (fun y hy => by
        rw [hIoc] at hy
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hB y hy.1.le hy.2)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hab)] at hI
    linarith
  obtain ⟨hAs, hAb⟩ := param_int_eta_jet (fun s e : ℝ => U (s * X) e) (-ε / X) 0 1 2
    (-1 - r) (1 + r) hlt zero_le_one one_lt_two (by linarith) hψ
  have hAs' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => profRadAvg U X e) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := hAs
  have hAb' : ∀ (j : ℕ) (η : ℝ), -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 →
      |iteratedDeriv j (fun e => profRadAvg U X e) η| ≤ B j := by
    intro j η h1 h2
    have H := hAb j η (B j) (by linarith) (by linarith)
      (fun y hy0 hy1 => hB j (y * X) η (mul_nonneg hy0 hX.le) (mul_le_of_le_one_left hX.le hy1) h1 h2)
    have e : (1:ℝ) - 0 = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [e, one_mul] at H
    exact H
  have hB0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ B j := fun j =>
    le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hB j 0 0 le_rfl hX.le (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
  have hA's : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (deriv (fun e => profRadAvg U X e)) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) :=
    ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_deriv_of_isOpen hSo).mp hAs').2
  have hA'b : ∀ (j : ℕ) (η : ℝ), -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 →
      |iteratedDeriv j (deriv (fun e => profRadAvg U X e)) η| ≤ B (j + 1) := by
    intro j η h1 h2
    rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
    exact hAb' (j + 1) η h1 h2
  
  have hid : ∀ (i : ℕ) (η : ℝ), -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |iteratedDeriv i (fun e : ℝ => e) η| ≤ 1 := by
    intro i η h1 h2
    have e : iteratedDeriv i (fun e : ℝ => e) η = if i = 0 then η else if i = 1 then 1 else 0 :=
      iteratedDeriv_id
    rw [e]
    split_ifs
    · exact abs_le.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · simp
    · simp
  have hD1 : deriv (fun e : ℝ => 1 - e ^ 2) = fun e => -(2 * e) := by
    funext e
    have := ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 e).const_sub 1).deriv
    exact this.trans (by norm_num)
  have hD2 : deriv (fun e : ℝ => -(2 * e)) = fun _ => -2 := by
    funext e
    have := (((hasDerivAt_id' e).const_mul (2:ℝ)).neg).deriv
    exact this.trans (by norm_num)
  have hD3 : deriv (fun _ : ℝ => (-2:ℝ)) = fun _ => 0 := by
    funext e
    exact deriv_const e (-2)
  have hp : ∀ (i : ℕ) (η : ℝ), -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 →
      |iteratedDeriv i (fun e : ℝ => 1 - e ^ 2) η| ≤ 2 := by
    intro i η h1 h2
    match i with
    | 0 =>
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, abs_le]
      constructor <;> nlinarith
    | 1 =>
      rw [iteratedDeriv_one, hD1, abs_le]
      constructor <;> linarith
    | 2 =>
      rw [show (2:ℕ) = 1 + 1 from rfl, iteratedDeriv_succ', iteratedDeriv_one, hD1, hD2]
      norm_num
    | m + 3 =>
      rw [show m + 3 = m + 1 + 1 + 1 from rfl, iteratedDeriv_succ', iteratedDeriv_succ',
        iteratedDeriv_succ', hD1, hD2, hD3]
      simp
  
  have hW : (fun e => leadW h U X e) = fun e =>
      (1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * (e * profRadAvg U X e)) -
        (1 - e ^ 2) * deriv (fun e' => profRadAvg U X e') e := by
    funext e
    simp only [leadW, profEtaD]
    ring
  have hPs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => e * profRadAvg U X e) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) :=
    contDiffOn_id.mul hAs'
  have hcPs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * (e * profRadAvg U X e))
      (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := contDiffOn_const.mul hPs
  have hLs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => 1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * (e * profRadAvg U X e))
      (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := contDiffOn_const.sub hcPs
  have hqs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e : ℝ => 1 - e ^ 2) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) :=
    contDiffOn_const.sub (contDiffOn_id.pow 2)
  have hQs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => (1 - e ^ 2) * deriv (fun e' => profRadAvg U X e') e)
      (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := hqs.mul hA's
  have hWs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => leadW h U X e) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := by
    rw [hW]; exact hLs.sub hQs
  refine ⟨hWs, ?_⟩
  intro k η h1 h2
  have hη : η ∈ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hn : Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r) ∈ nhds η := hSo.mem_nhds hη
  have cda : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) → ContDiffAt ℝ (k : ℕ) φ η :=
    fun φ hφ => (hφ.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hconst : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun _ : ℝ => (1:ℝ)) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := contDiffOn_const
  rw [hW, iteratedDeriv_fun_sub (cda _ hLs) (cda _ hQs)]
  have hLk : iteratedDeriv k (fun e => 1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * (e * profRadAvg U X e)) η =
      (if k = 0 then (1:ℝ) else 0) -
        2 * (1 / 2 - h) * iteratedDeriv k (fun e => e * profRadAvg U X e) η := by
    rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_sub (cda _ hconst) (cda _ hcPs), iteratedDeriv_const,
      iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field]
  rw [hLk]
  have hc : |2 * (1 / 2 - h)| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hite : |(if k = 0 then (1:ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 := by split_ifs <;> simp
  have hP : |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => e * profRadAvg U X e) η| ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * B (k - i) := by
    refine le_trans (leib (fun e => e) (fun e => profRadAvg U X e) _ η k hSo hη contDiffOn_id hAs') ?_
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    have hi := hid i η h1 h2
    have hA := hAb' (k - i) η h1 h2
    have hc0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ k.choose i := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    calc (k.choose i : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv i (fun e => e) η| *
          |iteratedDeriv (k - i) (fun e => profRadAvg U X e) η|
        ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * 1 * B (k - i) :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi hc0) hA (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = (k.choose i : ℝ) * B (k - i) := by ring
  have hQ : |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => (1 - e ^ 2) * deriv (fun e' => profRadAvg U X e') e) η| ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * 2 * B (k - i + 1) := by
    refine le_trans (leib (fun e : ℝ => 1 - e ^ 2) (deriv (fun e' => profRadAvg U X e')) _ η k
      hSo hη hqs hA's) ?_
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    have hi := hp i η h1 h2
    have hA := hA'b (k - i) η h1 h2
    have hc0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ k.choose i := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi hc0) hA (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
  have hS1 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * B (k - i) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hB0 _))
  have hcP : |2 * (1 / 2 - h) * iteratedDeriv k (fun e => e * profRadAvg U X e) η| ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * B (k - i) := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    calc _ ≤ 1 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * B (k - i) :=
          mul_le_mul hc hP (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      _ = _ := one_mul _
  have hsum : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * (B (k - i) + 2 * B (k - i + 1)) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * B (k - i) +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * 2 * B (k - i + 1) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  rw [hsum]
  have t1 := abs_sub ((if k = 0 then (1:ℝ) else 0) -
      2 * (1 / 2 - h) * iteratedDeriv k (fun e => e * profRadAvg U X e) η)
    (iteratedDeriv k (fun e => (1 - e ^ 2) * deriv (fun e' => profRadAvg U X e') e) η)
  have t2 := abs_sub (if k = 0 then (1:ℝ) else 0)
    (2 * (1 / 2 - h) * iteratedDeriv k (fun e => e * profRadAvg U X e) η)
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (MF : ℕ → ℝ), ∃ BN : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ (ε r X : ℝ) (G U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ε → 0 < r → 0 < X → X ≤ 110 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (x η : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => G x e) η| ≤ MF k ∧ |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => U x e) η| ≤ MF k) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => (1 - h) * profRadInt (fun x y => 2 * x * G x y) X e - (1 / 2 - h) * e * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x y => 2 * x * G x y)) X e - (1 - e ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x y => U x y * (2 * x * G x y))) X e + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * e * profRadInt (fun x y => U x y * (2 * x * G x y)) X e) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (η : ℝ), -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => (1 - h) * profRadInt (fun x y => 2 * x * G x y) X e - (1 / 2 - h) * e * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x y => 2 * x * G x y)) X e - (1 - e ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x y => U x y * (2 * x * G x y))) X e + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * e * profRadInt (fun x y => U x y * (2 * x * G x y)) X e) η| ≤ BN k

signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (MF : ℕ → ℝ), ∃ BN : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ (ε r X : ℝ) (G U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ε → 0 < r → 0 < X → X ≤ 110 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (x η : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => G x e) η| ≤ MF k ∧ |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => U x e) η| ≤ MF k) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => (1 - h) * profRadInt (fun x y => 2 * x * G x y) X e - (1 / 2 - h) * e * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x y => 2 * x * G x y)) X e - (1 - e ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x y => U x y * (2 * x * G x y))) X e + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * e * profRadInt (fun x y => U x y * (2 * x * G x y)) X e) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (η : ℝ), -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => (1 - h) * profRadInt (fun x y => 2 * x * G x y) X e - (1 / 2 - h) * e * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x y => 2 * x * G x y)) X e - (1 - e ^ 2) * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun x y => U x y * (2 * x * G x y))) X e + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * e * profRadInt (fun x y => U x y * (2 * x * G x y)) X e) η| ≤ BN k

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h MF
  obtain ⟨m2, hm2⟩ : ∃ m2 : ℕ → ℝ, m2 = fun j =>
      ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose l : ℝ) * MF l * (220 * MF (j - l)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨A1, hA1⟩ : ∃ A1 : ℕ → ℝ, A1 = fun j => 110 * (220 * MF j) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨A2, hA2⟩ : ∃ A2 : ℕ → ℝ, A2 = fun j => 110 * m2 j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨fun k => |1 - h| * A1 k +
    |1 / 2 - h| * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * 1 * A1 (k - i + 1) +
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * 2 * A2 (k - i + 1) +
    |2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h))| * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * 1 * A2 (k - i), ?_⟩
  intro ε r X G U hε hr hX hX110 hG hU hJ
  
  have leib : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (s : Set ℝ) (x : ℝ) (A B : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsOpen s → x ∈ s →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g s → (∀ i, |iteratedDeriv i f x| ≤ A i) →
      (∀ i, |iteratedDeriv i g x| ≤ B i) →
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => f e * g e) x| ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * A i * B (k - i) := by
    intro f g s x A B k hs hx hf hg hA hB
    have H := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hf hg hs.uniqueDiffOn hx (n := k)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hw : ∀ (j : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), iteratedDerivWithin j φ s x = iteratedDeriv j φ x :=
      fun j φ => iteratedDerivWithin_of_isOpen hs hx
    simp only [norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_norm_iteratedDerivWithin, Real.norm_eq_abs, hw] at H
    refine le_trans H (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
    have hA0 : 0 ≤ A i := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hA i)
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hA i) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) (hB (k - i))
      (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hA0)
  have hSo : IsOpen (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := isOpen_Ioo
  have hMF0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ MF j := fun j =>
    le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hJ j 0 0 le_rfl hX.le (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).1
  have hm20 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ m2 j := fun j => by
    rw [hm2]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun l _ => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hMF0 l))
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hMF0 _)))
  
  have slice : ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) →
      ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => F x e) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) :=
    fun F hF x hx => hF.comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id).contDiffOn
      (fun e he => Set.mk_mem_prod (show x ∈ Ioi (-ε) by simp only [mem_Ioi]; linarith) he)
  
  have hg1s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x y => 2 * x * G x y)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * p.1) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) :=
      contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_fst
    exact h1.mul hG
  have hg2s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x y => U x y * (2 * x * G x y)))
      (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * p.1) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) :=
      contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_fst
    exact hU.mul (h1.mul hG)
  
  have hb1 : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x η : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 →
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => 2 * x * G x e) η| ≤ 220 * MF k := by
    intro k x η h0 hx h1 h2
    rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * x)]
    exact mul_le_mul (by linarith) (hJ k x η h0 hx h1 h2).1 (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
  have hb2 : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x η : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 →
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => U x e * (2 * x * G x e)) η| ≤ m2 k := by
    intro k x η h0 hx h1 h2
    rw [hm2]
    exact leib (fun e => U x e) (fun e => 2 * x * G x e) _ η MF (fun i => 220 * MF i) k hSo
      ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩ (slice U hU x h0) (contDiffOn_const.mul (slice G hG x h0))
      (fun i => (hJ i x η h0 hx h1 h2).2) (fun i => hb1 i x η h0 hx h1 h2)
  
  have param_int_eta_jet : ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a' a b b' c d : ℝ), a' < a → a ≤ b → b < b' → c < d → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿ψ) (Ioo a' b' ×ˢ Ioo c d) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) (Ioo c d) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (η B : ℝ), c < η → η < d → (∀ y : ℝ, a ≤ y → y ≤ b → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ψ y e) η| ≤ B) → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) η| ≤ (b - a) * B := by
    intro ψ a' a b b' c d ha hab hb hcd hψ
    set W : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Ioo a' b' ×ˢ Ioo c d with hW
    have hWo : IsOpen W := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hIoc : Set.uIoc a b = Ioc a b := Set.uIoc_of_le hab
    have leib : ∀ (φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (η : ℝ), c < η → η < d →
        ContinuousOn (↿φ) W → ContinuousOn (↿φ') W →
        (∀ y e : ℝ, a' < y → y < b' → c < e → e < d →
          HasDerivAt (fun e' => φ y e') (φ' y e) e) →
        HasDerivAt (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, φ y e) (∫ y in a..b, φ' y η) η := by
      intro φ φ' η hη1 hη2 hφ hφ' hder
      set r := min (η - c) (d - η) / 2 with hr
      have hr0 : 0 < r := by
        have : 0 < min (η - c) (d - η) := lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
        linarith
      have hr1 : r ≤ (η - c) / 2 := by
        have := min_le_left (η - c) (d - η); linarith
      have hr2 : r ≤ (d - η) / 2 := by
        have := min_le_right (η - c) (d - η); linarith
      have hKW : Icc a b ×ˢ Icc (η - r) (η + r) ⊆ W := by
        rintro ⟨t, x⟩ ⟨⟨ht1, ht2⟩, hx1, hx2⟩
        exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩
      obtain ⟨Bd, hBd⟩ :=
        (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hφ'.mono hKW)
      have slice : ∀ (χ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn (↿χ) W → ∀ x, c < x → x < d →
          ContinuousOn (fun t => χ t x) (Icc a b) := by
        intro χ hχ x hx1 hx2
        have : ContinuousOn (↿χ ∘ fun t : ℝ => (t, x)) (Icc a b) :=
          hχ.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
            (fun t ht => ⟨⟨by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩, hx1, hx2⟩)
        exact this
      have hmeas : ∀ (χ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn (↿χ) W → ∀ x, c < x → x < d →
          AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => χ t x) (volume.restrict (Set.uIoc a b)) := by
        intro χ hχ x hx1 hx2
        rw [hIoc]
        exact ((slice χ hχ x hx1 hx2).mono Ioc_subset_Icc_self).aestronglyMeasurable
          measurableSet_Ioc
      have key := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
        (μ := volume) (F := fun x t => φ t x) (F' := fun x t => φ' t x) (x₀ := η)
        (bound := fun _ => Bd) (a := a) (b := b) (s := Ioo (η - r) (η + r))
        (Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith))
        (Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2) (fun x hx => hmeas φ hφ x hx.1 hx.2))
        ((slice φ hφ η hη1 hη2).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab)
        (hmeas φ' hφ' η hη1 hη2)
        (ae_of_all _ (fun t ht x hx => by
          rw [hIoc] at ht
          exact hBd (t, x) ⟨⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩, hx.1.le, hx.2.le⟩))
        intervalIntegrable_const
        (ae_of_all _ (fun t ht x hx => by
          rw [hIoc] at ht
          exact hder t x (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.2]) (by linarith [hx.1])
            (by linarith [hx.2])))
      exact key.2
    set Ψ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun k y e => iteratedDeriv k (fun e' => ψ y e') e with hΨ
    have chain : ∀ (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (y e : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W → (y, e) ∈ W →
        HasDerivAt (fun e' => g (y, e')) (fderiv ℝ g (y, e) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) e := by
      intro g y e hg hye
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (y, e) :=
        (hg.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hye)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hp : HasDerivAt (fun e' : ℝ => (y, e')) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) e :=
        (hasDerivAt_const e y).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' e)
      exact hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt e hp
    have s1 : ∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(Ψ k)) W := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        have : ↿(Ψ 0) = ↿ψ := by
          funext p
          simp [hΨ]
        rw [this]; exact hψ
      | succ k ih =>
        have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿(Ψ k))) W :=
          ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hWo).1 ih).2
        have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => fderiv ℝ (↿(Ψ k)) p ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) W :=
          hf.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
        refine hG.congr ?_
        rintro ⟨y, e⟩ hye
        have h1 := chain (↿(Ψ k)) y e ih hye
        show iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun e' => ψ y e') e = _
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        exact h1.deriv
    have s2 : ∀ k y e, a' < y → y < b' → c < e → e < d →
        HasDerivAt (fun e' => Ψ k y e') (Ψ (k + 1) y e) e := by
      intro k y e h1 h2 h3 h4
      have h5 := chain (↿(Ψ k)) y e (s1 k) ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩
      have heq : Ψ (k + 1) y e = fderiv ℝ (↿(Ψ k)) (y, e) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) := by
        show iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun e' => ψ y e') e = _
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        exact h5.deriv
      rw [heq]
      exact h5
    have hC : ∀ k η, c < η → η < d →
        iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) η = ∫ y in a..b, Ψ k y η := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro η _ _
        simp [hΨ]
      | succ k ih =>
        intro η h1 h2
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        have hev : iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) =ᶠ[nhds η]
            fun e => ∫ y in a..b, Ψ k y e :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2) (fun e he => ih e he.1 he.2)
        rw [hev.deriv_eq]
        exact (leib (Ψ k) (Ψ (k + 1)) η h1 h2 (s1 k).continuousOn (s1 (k + 1)).continuousOn
          (s2 k)).deriv
    have hsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) (Ioo c d) := by
      apply contDiffOn_of_differentiableOn_deriv
      intro m _
      have hd : DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, Ψ m y e) (Ioo c d) := fun e he =>
        (leib (Ψ m) (Ψ (m + 1)) e he.1 he.2 (s1 m).continuousOn (s1 (m + 1)).continuousOn
          (s2 m)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      refine hd.congr ?_
      intro e he
      rw [iteratedDerivWithin_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioo he, hC m e he.1 he.2]
    refine ⟨hsmooth, fun k η B h1 h2 hB => ?_⟩
    rw [hC k η h1 h2]
    have hI := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := a) (b := b) (C := B)
      (f := fun y => Ψ k y η) (fun y hy => by
        rw [hIoc] at hy
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hB y hy.1.le hy.2)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hab)] at hI
    linarith
  
  have rad : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (B : ℕ → ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) → (∀ j, 0 ≤ B j) →
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (x η : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 →
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => g x e) η| ≤ B k) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => profRadInt g X e) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) ∧
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (η : ℝ), -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 →
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => profRadInt g X e) η| ≤ 110 * B k := by
    intro g B hg hB0 hB
    obtain ⟨hs, hb⟩ := param_int_eta_jet g (-ε) 0 X (X + 1) (-1 - r) (1 + r) (by linarith) hX.le
      (by linarith) (by linarith) (hg.mono (prod_mono Ioo_subset_Ioi_self subset_rfl))
    refine ⟨hs, fun k η h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    have H := hb k η (B k) (by linarith) (by linarith) (fun y hy0 hy1 => hB k y η hy0 hy1 h1 h2)
    rw [sub_zero] at H
    exact le_trans H (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hX110 (hB0 k))
  obtain ⟨hI1s, hI1b⟩ := rad (fun x y => 2 * x * G x y) (fun k => 220 * MF k) hg1s
    (fun j => by linarith [hMF0 j]) hb1
  obtain ⟨hI2s, hI2b⟩ := rad (fun x y => U x y * (2 * x * G x y)) m2 hg2s hm20 hb2
  
  have hid : ∀ (i : ℕ) (η : ℝ), -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |iteratedDeriv i (fun e : ℝ => e) η| ≤ 1 := by
    intro i η h1 h2
    have e : iteratedDeriv i (fun e : ℝ => e) η = if i = 0 then η else if i = 1 then 1 else 0 :=
      iteratedDeriv_id
    rw [e]
    split_ifs
    · exact abs_le.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · simp
    · simp
  have hD1 : deriv (fun e : ℝ => 1 - e ^ 2) = fun e => -(2 * e) := by
    funext e
    have := ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 e).const_sub 1).deriv
    exact this.trans (by norm_num)
  have hD2 : deriv (fun e : ℝ => -(2 * e)) = fun _ => -2 := by
    funext e
    have := (((hasDerivAt_id' e).const_mul (2:ℝ)).neg).deriv
    exact this.trans (by norm_num)
  have hD3 : deriv (fun _ : ℝ => (-2:ℝ)) = fun _ => 0 := by
    funext e
    exact deriv_const e (-2)
  have hpj : ∀ (i : ℕ) (η : ℝ), -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 →
      |iteratedDeriv i (fun e : ℝ => 1 - e ^ 2) η| ≤ 2 := by
    intro i η h1 h2
    match i with
    | 0 =>
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, abs_le]
      constructor <;> nlinarith
    | 1 =>
      rw [iteratedDeriv_one, hD1, abs_le]
      constructor <;> linarith
    | 2 =>
      rw [show (2:ℕ) = 1 + 1 from rfl, iteratedDeriv_succ', iteratedDeriv_one, hD1, hD2]
      norm_num
    | m + 3 =>
      rw [show m + 3 = m + 1 + 1 + 1 from rfl, iteratedDeriv_succ', iteratedDeriv_succ',
        iteratedDeriv_succ', hD1, hD2, hD3]
      simp
  
  have combine : ∀ (I1 I2 : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ I1 (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ I2 (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) →
      (∀ (j : ℕ) (η : ℝ), -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |iteratedDeriv j I1 η| ≤ A1 j) →
      (∀ (j : ℕ) (η : ℝ), -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → |iteratedDeriv j I2 η| ≤ A2 j) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => (1 - h) * I1 e - (1 / 2 - h) * e * deriv I1 e -
        (1 - e ^ 2) * deriv I2 e + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * e * I2 e) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) ∧
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (η : ℝ), -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 →
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => (1 - h) * I1 e - (1 / 2 - h) * e * deriv I1 e -
          (1 - e ^ 2) * deriv I2 e + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * e * I2 e) η| ≤
        |1 - h| * A1 k +
        |1 / 2 - h| * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * 1 * A1 (k - i + 1) +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * 2 * A2 (k - i + 1) +
        |2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h))| * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * 1 * A2 (k - i) := by
    intro I1 I2 hI1 hI2 hb1' hb2'
    have hD1' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (deriv I1) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_deriv_of_isOpen hSo).mp hI1).2
    have hD2' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (deriv I2) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_deriv_of_isOpen hSo).mp hI2).2
    have hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e : ℝ => 1 - e ^ 2) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) :=
      contDiffOn_const.sub (contDiffOn_id.pow 2)
    have hT1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => (1 - h) * I1 e) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) :=
      contDiffOn_const.mul hI1
    have hQ1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => e * deriv I1 e) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) :=
      contDiffOn_id.mul hD1'
    have hT2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => (1 / 2 - h) * (e * deriv I1 e)) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) :=
      contDiffOn_const.mul hQ1
    have hT3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => (1 - e ^ 2) * deriv I2 e) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) :=
      hp.mul hD2'
    have hQ4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => e * I2 e) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) :=
      contDiffOn_id.mul hI2
    have hT4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * (e * I2 e))
        (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := contDiffOn_const.mul hQ4
    have hNF : (fun e => (1 - h) * I1 e - (1 / 2 - h) * e * deriv I1 e -
        (1 - e ^ 2) * deriv I2 e + 2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * e * I2 e) =
        fun e => ((1 - h) * I1 e - (1 / 2 - h) * (e * deriv I1 e) - (1 - e ^ 2) * deriv I2 e) +
          2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * (e * I2 e) := by
      funext e; ring
    rw [hNF]
    have hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => (1 - h) * I1 e - (1 / 2 - h) * (e * deriv I1 e))
        (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := hT1.sub hT2
    have hB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => (1 - h) * I1 e - (1 / 2 - h) * (e * deriv I1 e) -
        (1 - e ^ 2) * deriv I2 e) (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := hA.sub hT3
    refine ⟨hB.add hT4, fun k η h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    have hη : η ∈ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have cda : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) →
        ContDiffAt ℝ (k : ℕ) φ η :=
      fun φ hφ => (hφ.contDiffAt (hSo.mem_nhds hη)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_add (cda _ hB) (cda _ hT4), iteratedDeriv_fun_sub (cda _ hA) (cda _ hT3),
      iteratedDeriv_fun_sub (cda _ hT1) (cda _ hT2)]
    rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field (1 - h), iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field (1 / 2 - h),
      iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field (2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)))]
    have e1 : |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => e * deriv I1 e) η| ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * 1 * A1 (k - i + 1) :=
      leib (fun e => e) (deriv I1) _ η (fun _ => 1) (fun j => A1 (j + 1)) k hSo hη contDiffOn_id
        hD1' (fun i => hid i η h1 h2)
        (fun j => by rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']; exact hb1' (j + 1) η h1 h2)
    have e3 : |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => (1 - e ^ 2) * deriv I2 e) η| ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * 2 * A2 (k - i + 1) :=
      leib (fun e => 1 - e ^ 2) (deriv I2) _ η (fun _ => 2) (fun j => A2 (j + 1)) k hSo hη hp
        hD2' (fun i => hpj i η h1 h2)
        (fun j => by rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']; exact hb2' (j + 1) η h1 h2)
    have e4 : |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => e * I2 e) η| ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * 1 * A2 (k - i) :=
      leib (fun e => e) I2 _ η (fun _ => 1) A2 k hSo hη contDiffOn_id hI2
        (fun i => hid i η h1 h2) (fun j => hb2' j η h1 h2)
    have k1 : |(1 - h) * iteratedDeriv k I1 η| ≤ |1 - h| * A1 k := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb1' k η h1 h2) (abs_nonneg _)
    have k2 : |(1 / 2 - h) * iteratedDeriv k (fun e => e * deriv I1 e) η| ≤
        |1 / 2 - h| * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * 1 * A1 (k - i + 1) := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e1 (abs_nonneg _)
    have k4 : |2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * iteratedDeriv k (fun e => e * I2 e) η| ≤
        |2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h))| * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * 1 * A2 (k - i) := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e4 (abs_nonneg _)
    have tri : ∀ a b c d : ℝ, |a - b - c + d| ≤ |a| + |b| + |c| + |d| := fun a b c d => by
      have := abs_add_le (a - b - c) d
      have := abs_sub (a - b) c
      have := abs_sub a b
      linarith
    have := tri ((1 - h) * iteratedDeriv k I1 η)
      ((1 / 2 - h) * iteratedDeriv k (fun e => e * deriv I1 e) η)
      (iteratedDeriv k (fun e => (1 - e ^ 2) * deriv I2 e) η)
      (2 * (h - (1 / 2 - h)) * iteratedDeriv k (fun e => e * I2 e) η)
    linarith
  obtain ⟨hNs, hNb⟩ := combine (fun e => profRadInt (fun x y => 2 * x * G x y) X e)
    (fun e => profRadInt (fun x y => U x y * (2 * x * G x y)) X e) hI1s hI2s
    (fun j η h1 h2 => by rw [hA1]; exact hI1b j η h1 h2)
    (fun j η h1 h2 => by rw [hA2]; exact hI2b j η h1 h2)
  exact ⟨hNs, fun k η h1 h2 => hNb k η h1 h2⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a' a b b' c d : ℝ), a' < a → a ≤ b → b < b' → c < d → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿ψ) (Ioo a' b' ×ˢ Ioo c d) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) (Ioo c d) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (η B : ℝ), c < η → η < d → (∀ y : ℝ, a ≤ y → y ≤ b → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ψ y e) η| ≤ B) → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) η| ≤ (b - a) * B

signature.statement: ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a' a b b' c d : ℝ), a' < a → a ≤ b → b < b' → c < d → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿ψ) (Ioo a' b' ×ˢ Ioo c d) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) (Ioo c d) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (η B : ℝ), c < η → η < d → (∀ y : ℝ, a ≤ y → y ≤ b → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ψ y e) η| ≤ B) → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) η| ≤ (b - a) * B

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ψ a' a b b' c d ha hab hb hcd hψ
  set W : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Ioo a' b' ×ˢ Ioo c d with hW
  have hWo : IsOpen W := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hIoc : Set.uIoc a b = Ioc a b := Set.uIoc_of_le hab
  
  have leib : ∀ (φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (η : ℝ), c < η → η < d →
      ContinuousOn (↿φ) W → ContinuousOn (↿φ') W →
      (∀ y e : ℝ, a' < y → y < b' → c < e → e < d →
        HasDerivAt (fun e' => φ y e') (φ' y e) e) →
      HasDerivAt (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, φ y e) (∫ y in a..b, φ' y η) η := by
    intro φ φ' η hη1 hη2 hφ hφ' hder
    set r := min (η - c) (d - η) / 2 with hr
    have hr0 : 0 < r := by
      have : 0 < min (η - c) (d - η) := lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
      linarith
    have hr1 : r ≤ (η - c) / 2 := by
      have := min_le_left (η - c) (d - η); linarith
    have hr2 : r ≤ (d - η) / 2 := by
      have := min_le_right (η - c) (d - η); linarith
    have hKW : Icc a b ×ˢ Icc (η - r) (η + r) ⊆ W := by
      rintro ⟨t, x⟩ ⟨⟨ht1, ht2⟩, hx1, hx2⟩
      exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    obtain ⟨Bd, hBd⟩ :=
      (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hφ'.mono hKW)
    have slice : ∀ (χ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn (↿χ) W → ∀ x, c < x → x < d →
        ContinuousOn (fun t => χ t x) (Icc a b) := by
      intro χ hχ x hx1 hx2
      have : ContinuousOn (↿χ ∘ fun t : ℝ => (t, x)) (Icc a b) :=
        hχ.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
          (fun t ht => ⟨⟨by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩, hx1, hx2⟩)
      exact this
    have hmeas : ∀ (χ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn (↿χ) W → ∀ x, c < x → x < d →
        AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => χ t x) (volume.restrict (Set.uIoc a b)) := by
      intro χ hχ x hx1 hx2
      rw [hIoc]
      exact ((slice χ hχ x hx1 hx2).mono Ioc_subset_Icc_self).aestronglyMeasurable
        measurableSet_Ioc
    have key := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (μ := volume) (F := fun x t => φ t x) (F' := fun x t => φ' t x) (x₀ := η)
      (bound := fun _ => Bd) (a := a) (b := b) (s := Ioo (η - r) (η + r))
      (Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith))
      (Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2) (fun x hx => hmeas φ hφ x hx.1 hx.2))
      ((slice φ hφ η hη1 hη2).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab)
      (hmeas φ' hφ' η hη1 hη2)
      (ae_of_all _ (fun t ht x hx => by
        rw [hIoc] at ht
        exact hBd (t, x) ⟨⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩, hx.1.le, hx.2.le⟩))
      intervalIntegrable_const
      (ae_of_all _ (fun t ht x hx => by
        rw [hIoc] at ht
        exact hder t x (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.2]) (by linarith [hx.1])
          (by linarith [hx.2])))
    exact key.2
  
  set Ψ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun k y e => iteratedDeriv k (fun e' => ψ y e') e with hΨ
  have chain : ∀ (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (y e : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W → (y, e) ∈ W →
      HasDerivAt (fun e' => g (y, e')) (fderiv ℝ g (y, e) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) e := by
    intro g y e hg hye
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (y, e) :=
      (hg.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hye)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hp : HasDerivAt (fun e' : ℝ => (y, e')) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) e :=
      (hasDerivAt_const e y).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' e)
    exact hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt e hp
  have s1 : ∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(Ψ k)) W := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      have : ↿(Ψ 0) = ↿ψ := by
        funext p
        simp [hΨ]
      rw [this]; exact hψ
    | succ k ih =>
      have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿(Ψ k))) W :=
        ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hWo).1 ih).2
      have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => fderiv ℝ (↿(Ψ k)) p ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) W :=
        hf.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
      refine hG.congr ?_
      rintro ⟨y, e⟩ hye
      have h1 := chain (↿(Ψ k)) y e ih hye
      show iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun e' => ψ y e') e = _
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
      exact h1.deriv
  have s2 : ∀ k y e, a' < y → y < b' → c < e → e < d →
      HasDerivAt (fun e' => Ψ k y e') (Ψ (k + 1) y e) e := by
    intro k y e h1 h2 h3 h4
    have h5 := chain (↿(Ψ k)) y e (s1 k) ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩
    have heq : Ψ (k + 1) y e = fderiv ℝ (↿(Ψ k)) (y, e) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) := by
      show iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun e' => ψ y e') e = _
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
      exact h5.deriv
    rw [heq]
    exact h5
  
  have hC : ∀ k η, c < η → η < d →
      iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) η = ∫ y in a..b, Ψ k y η := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro η _ _
      simp [hΨ]
    | succ k ih =>
      intro η h1 h2
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
      have hev : iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) =ᶠ[nhds η]
          fun e => ∫ y in a..b, Ψ k y e :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2) (fun e he => ih e he.1 he.2)
      rw [hev.deriv_eq]
      exact (leib (Ψ k) (Ψ (k + 1)) η h1 h2 (s1 k).continuousOn (s1 (k + 1)).continuousOn
        (s2 k)).deriv
  have hsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) (Ioo c d) := by
    apply contDiffOn_of_differentiableOn_deriv
    intro m _
    have hd : DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, Ψ m y e) (Ioo c d) := fun e he =>
      (leib (Ψ m) (Ψ (m + 1)) e he.1 he.2 (s1 m).continuousOn (s1 (m + 1)).continuousOn
        (s2 m)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    refine hd.congr ?_
    intro e he
    rw [iteratedDerivWithin_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioo he, hC m e he.1 he.2]
  refine ⟨hsmooth, fun k η B h1 h2 hB => ?_⟩
  rw [hC k η h1 h2]
  have hI := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := a) (b := b) (C := B)
    (f := fun y => Ψ k y η) (fun y hy => by
      rw [hIoc] at hy
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact hB y hy.1.le hy.2)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hab)] at hI
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (Λ t1 ρ1 C : ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < t1 → t1 ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < ρ1 → 0 < C → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Fn) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Un) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → 0 < Fn X η) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun y e : ℝ => (1 - sigA ((y - t1) / t1)) * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) * (deriv (fun Y => C * Fn Y e) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) * (C * Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) e)⁻¹))) (Ioo 0 (Real.log (41 / 40)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun y e : ℝ => (1 - sigA ((y - t1) / t1)) * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) * deriv (fun Y => Un Y e) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y))) (Ioo 0 (Real.log (41 / 40)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) ∧ ∀ X e : ℝ, 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 ≤ X → X ≤ 4 / Λ * Real.exp (2 * t1) → C * axRefF Λ t1 Fn X e = C * Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) e * Real.exp (∫ y in t1..axLogY Λ X, (1 - sigA ((y - t1) / t1)) * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) * (deriv (fun Y => C * Fn Y e) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) * (C * Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) e)⁻¹)) ∧ axRefU Λ t1 Un X e = Un (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) e + ∫ y in t1..axLogY Λ X, (1 - sigA ((y - t1) / t1)) * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) * deriv (fun Y => Un Y e) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y)
