by
  intro Λ t1 ρ1 C Fn Un hΛ ht1 ht1s hρ1 hC hFs hUs hFpos
  have hΛpos : 0 < Λ := by linarith
  have hΛne : Λ ≠ 0 := hΛpos.ne'
  have h4pos : 0 < 4 / Λ := by positivity
  have hneg : -1 / Λ < 0 := by
    have : 0 < 1 / Λ := by positivity
    have e : -1 / Λ = -(1 / Λ) := by ring
    linarith
  have h41 : 41 / (10 * Λ) = 4 / Λ * (41 / 40) := by
    first | (field_simp; ring) | field_simp
  have h5 : 41 / (10 * Λ) < 5 / Λ := by
    rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hΛpos]; linarith
  have hexpY : ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → 4 / Λ * Real.exp (axLogY Λ X) = X := by
    intro X hX
    have hp : 0 < X * Λ / 4 := by have := mul_pos hX hΛpos; linarith
    unfold axLogY
    rw [Real.exp_log hp]
    first | (field_simp; ring) | field_simp
  have hsigA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ sigA := sigA_collar_facts.1
  have hΩo : IsOpen (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have slice : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => deriv (fun Y => f Y p.2) p.1)
        (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) := by
    intro f hf
    have hcomp : ∀ X η : ℝ, (X, η) ∈ Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) →
        HasDerivAt (fun Y => f Y η) (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) X := by
      intro X η hp
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿f) (X, η) :=
        (hf.contDiffAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hp)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have hl : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, η)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) X :=
        (hasDerivAt_id' X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X η)
      exact hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt X hl
    have h1 := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hΩo).mp hf).2
    refine (h1.clm_apply (contDiffOn_const (c := ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))))).congr ?_
    intro p hp
    exact (hcomp p.1 p.2 hp).deriv
  have hCFs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun X e : ℝ => C * Fn X e))
      (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) :=
    (contDiffOn_const.mul hFs).congr (fun p _ => rfl)
  have hDFs := slice _ hCFs
  have hDUs := slice Un hUs
  have hcut : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 1 - sigA ((p.1 - t1) / t1)) :=
    contDiff_const.sub (hsigA.comp ((contDiff_fst.sub contDiff_const).div_const t1))
  have hZs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 4 / Λ * Real.exp p.1) :=
    contDiff_const.mul (Real.contDiff_exp.comp contDiff_fst)
  have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (4 / Λ * Real.exp p.1, p.2)) := hZs.prodMk contDiff_snd
  have hW0 : ∀ q ∈ Ioo 0 (Real.log (41 / 40)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1),
      0 < 4 / Λ * Real.exp q.1 ∧ 4 / Λ * Real.exp q.1 < 41 / (10 * Λ) := by
    intro q hq
    have hy : Real.exp q.1 < 41 / 40 :=
      (Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 41 / 40)).mp hq.1.2
    refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
    rw [h41]; exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy h4pos
  have hmaps : MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (4 / Λ * Real.exp p.1, p.2))
      (Ioo 0 (Real.log (41 / 40)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1))
      (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hW0 q hq
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, hq.2⟩
  have hne : ∀ q ∈ Ioo 0 (Real.log (41 / 40)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1),
      C * Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp q.1) q.2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hW0 q hq
    exact (mul_pos hC (hFpos _ _ h1.le h2.le hq.2.1 hq.2.2)).ne'
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hA := hDFs.comp hψ.contDiffOn hmaps
    have hB := hCFs.comp hψ.contDiffOn hmaps
    have hC' := (hcut.contDiffOn.mul hZs.contDiffOn).mul (hA.mul (hB.inv hne))
    refine hC'.congr ?_
    intro q _
    rfl
  · have hA := hDUs.comp hψ.contDiffOn hmaps
    have hC' := (hcut.contDiffOn.mul hZs.contDiffOn).mul hA
    refine hC'.congr ?_
    intro q _
    rfl
  · intro X e hX1 _
    have hX1pos : 0 < 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 := by positivity
    have hXpos : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hX1pos hX1
    have hle : t1 ≤ axLogY Λ X := by
      rw [← Real.exp_le_exp]
      have h' : 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 ≤ 4 / Λ * Real.exp (axLogY Λ X) := by
        rw [hexpY X hXpos]; exact hX1
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h' h4pos
    have hint : ∀ y : ℝ, (1 - sigA ((y - t1) / t1)) * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) *
        (deriv (fun Y => C * Fn Y e) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) * (C * Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) e)⁻¹) =
        (1 - sigA ((y - t1) / t1)) * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) *
        (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y e) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) / Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) e) := by
      intro y
      have key : ∀ d f : ℝ, C * d * (C * f)⁻¹ = d / f := by
        intro d f
        rw [mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_mul_mul_comm, mul_inv_cancel₀ hC.ne', one_mul]
      rw [deriv_const_mul_field, key]
    simp only [hint]
    by_cases hc : axLogY Λ X ≤ t1
    · have heq : axLogY Λ X = t1 := le_antisymm hc hle
      have hXe : X = 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 := by rw [← heq, hexpY X hXpos]
      unfold axRefF axRefU
      rw [if_pos (Or.inr hc), if_pos (Or.inr hc), heq, intervalIntegral.integral_same,
        intervalIntegral.integral_same, Real.exp_zero, mul_one, add_zero]
      rw [← hXe]
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · have hc' : ¬ (X ≤ 0 ∨ axLogY Λ X ≤ t1) := not_or.mpr ⟨not_le.mpr hXpos, hc⟩
      unfold axRefF axRefU
      rw [if_neg hc', if_neg hc']
      exact ⟨by ring, rfl⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: sigA_collar_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement: ContDiff ℝ ∞ sigA ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ collarG ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ collarGam ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → 1 - sigA (1 - u) = Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) * collarG u) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → HasDerivAt sigA (Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) / u ^ 3 * collarGam u) (1 - u)) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → 0 ≤ collarGam u) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → u ≤ 1 / 2 → Real.exp (-4) / 2 ≤ collarGam u)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (Λ C ρ1 : ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < C → 0 < ρ1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Fn) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Un) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → 0 < Fn X η) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => C * Fn z.1 z.2) (X, η)‖ ≤ Kder m ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (C * Fn z.1 z.2)⁻¹) (X, η)‖ ≤ Kder m ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Un) (X, η)‖ ≤ Kder m) → ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => C * Fn x e) (Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => Un x e) (Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => deriv (fun Y => C * Fn Y e) x) (Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => deriv (fun Y => Un Y e) x) (Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) ∧ (0 < x → x < 41 / (10 * Λ) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => (C * Fn x e)⁻¹) (Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1))) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (η : ℝ), -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => C * Fn x e) η| ≤ Kder k ∧ |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => Un x e) η| ≤ Kder k ∧ |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => deriv (fun Y => C * Fn Y e) x) η| ≤ Kder (k + 1) ∧ |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => deriv (fun Y => Un Y e) x) η| ≤ Kder (k + 1) ∧ (0 < x → x < 41 / (10 * Λ) → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => (C * Fn x e)⁻¹) η| ≤ Kder k)

signature.name: ax_axis_slice_jets
signature.statement: ∀ (Λ C ρ1 : ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < C → 0 < ρ1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Fn) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Un) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → 0 < Fn X η) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => C * Fn z.1 z.2) (X, η)‖ ≤ Kder m ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (C * Fn z.1 z.2)⁻¹) (X, η)‖ ≤ Kder m ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Un) (X, η)‖ ≤ Kder m) → ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => C * Fn x e) (Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => Un x e) (Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => deriv (fun Y => C * Fn Y e) x) (Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => deriv (fun Y => Un Y e) x) (Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) ∧ (0 < x → x < 41 / (10 * Λ) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => (C * Fn x e)⁻¹) (Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1))) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (η : ℝ), -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => C * Fn x e) η| ≤ Kder k ∧ |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => Un x e) η| ≤ Kder k ∧ |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => deriv (fun Y => C * Fn Y e) x) η| ≤ Kder (k + 1) ∧ |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => deriv (fun Y => Un Y e) x) η| ≤ Kder (k + 1) ∧ (0 < x → x < 41 / (10 * Λ) → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => (C * Fn x e)⁻¹) η| ≤ Kder k)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have L1 : ∀ (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (U : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (x : ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => g (x, e)) {e | (x, e) ∈ U} ∧
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (e : ℝ), (x, e) ∈ U →
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => g (x, e)) e| ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (x, e)‖ := by
    intro g U x hU hg
    have hT : IsOpen {e : ℝ | (x, e) ∈ U} := hU.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
    have hι : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun e : ℝ => (x, e)) := contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id
    refine ⟨hg.comp hι.contDiffOn (fun e he => he), ?_⟩
    have hP : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ e : ℝ, (x, e) ∈ U →
        iteratedDeriv k (fun e => g (x, e)) e =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (x, e) (fun _ => ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => intro e he; simp
      | succ k ih =>
        intro e he
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        have hev : iteratedDeriv k (fun e => g (x, e)) =ᶠ[nhds e]
            fun e' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (x, e') (fun _ => ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hT.mem_nhds he) (fun e' he' => ih e' he')
        rw [hev.deriv_eq]
        have hcd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g (x, e) := hg.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds he)
        have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g) (x, e) :=
          hcd.iteratedFDeriv_right (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
        have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g) (x, e) :=
          h1.differentiableAt (by norm_num)
        have hιd : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => (x, e)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) e :=
          (hasDerivAt_const e x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id e)
        have h2 := hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt e hιd
        have h3 := (ContinuousMultilinearMap.apply ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ
          (fun _ => ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)))).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt e h2
        have h4 : HasDerivAt (fun e' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (x, e') (fun _ => ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))))
            (fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g) (x, e) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) (fun _ => ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)))) e :=
          h3
        rw [h4.deriv, iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left]
        rfl
    intro k e he
    rw [hP k e he, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _).trans ?_
    have hv : ‖((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖ = 1 := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
    simp [hv]
  
  have L2 : ∀ (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (U : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ g z ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) U ∧
      (∀ x e : ℝ, (x, e) ∈ U → deriv (fun Y => g (Y, e)) x = fderiv ℝ g (x, e) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) ∧
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : ℝ × ℝ), z ∈ U →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => fderiv ℝ g z ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) z‖ ≤
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) g z‖ := by
    intro g U hU hg
    have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ g) U := hg.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    refine ⟨hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x e he
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (x, e) :=
        (hg.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds he)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, e)) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) x :=
        (hasDerivAt_id x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const x e)
      exact (hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt x h1).deriv
    · intro k z hz
      have hfun : (fun z => fderiv ℝ g z ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) =
          (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) : ((ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ fderiv ℝ g := by
        funext z; rfl
      have hA : ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) : ((ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
        refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun f => ?_)
        have hw : ‖((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))‖ = 1 := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
        have := f.le_opNorm ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))
        rw [hw, mul_one] at this
        show ‖f ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))‖ ≤ 1 * ‖f‖
        linarith
      rw [hfun, ← norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
      refine (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left _
        (hD.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).trans ?_
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hA
  intro Λ C ρ1 Kder Fn Un hΛ hC hρ1 hFn hUn hpos hK x hx0 hx1
  have hΛpos : 0 < Λ := by linarith
  have hSo : IsOpen (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have h41 : 41 / (10 * Λ) < 5 / Λ := by
    rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hΛpos]; nlinarith
  have hneg : -1 / Λ < 0 := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by norm_num) hΛpos
  have hxS : x ∈ Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hIS : ∀ e ∈ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1),
      (x, e) ∈ Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) :=
    fun e he => Set.mk_mem_prod hxS he
  have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => C * Fn z.1 z.2)
      (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) :=
    contDiffOn_const.mul hFn
  have hU'o : IsOpen (Ioo 0 (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hU'S : Ioo 0 (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) ⊆
      Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) :=
    fun z hz => ⟨⟨by linarith [hz.1.1], by linarith [hz.1.2]⟩, hz.2⟩
  have hGi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (C * Fn z.1 z.2)⁻¹)
      (Ioo 0 (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) :=
    (hG.mono hU'S).inv
      (fun z hz => (mul_pos hC (hpos z.1 z.2 hz.1.1.le hz.1.2.le hz.2.1 hz.2.2)).ne')
  have hXd : ∀ g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) g (x, η)‖ ≤ Kder (k + 1)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => deriv (fun Y => g (Y, e)) x) (Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) ∧
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (η : ℝ), -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 →
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => deriv (fun Y => g (Y, e)) x) η| ≤ Kder (k + 1) := by
    intro g hg hb
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := L2 g _ hSo hg
    obtain ⟨s1, s2⟩ := L1 _ _ x hSo h1
    refine ⟨(s1.mono (fun e he => hIS e he)).congr (fun e he => h2 x e (hIS e he)), ?_⟩
    intro k η hη1 hη2
    have hev : (fun e => deriv (fun Y => g (Y, e)) x) =ᶠ[nhds η]
        (fun e => fderiv ℝ g (x, e) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2) (fun e he => h2 x e (hIS e he))
    rw [hev.iteratedDeriv_eq]
    exact ((s2 k η (hIS η ⟨hη1, hη2⟩)).trans (h3 k _ (hIS η ⟨hη1, hη2⟩))).trans (hb k η hη1 hη2)
  obtain ⟨sG, bG⟩ := L1 _ _ x hSo hG
  obtain ⟨sU, bU⟩ := L1 _ _ x hSo hUn
  obtain ⟨dG, dbG⟩ := hXd _ hG (fun k η h1 h2 => (hK (k + 1) x η hx0 hx1 h1 h2).1)
  obtain ⟨dU, dbU⟩ := hXd _ hUn (fun k η h1 h2 => (hK (k + 1) x η hx0 hx1 h1 h2).2.2)
  refine ⟨sG.mono (fun e he => hIS e he), sU.mono (fun e he => hIS e he), dG, dU, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hx0' hx1'
    exact (L1 _ _ x hU'o hGi).1.mono (fun e he => ⟨⟨hx0', hx1'⟩, he⟩)
  · intro k η hη1 hη2
    have hm := hIS η ⟨hη1, hη2⟩
    obtain ⟨k1, k2, k3⟩ := hK k x η hx0 hx1 hη1 hη2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro f ψ a' a b b' c d L Bf Bψ ha'a hab hbb' hL hcd hf hψ η hc hd hBf hBψ k
  have hη : η ∈ Ioo c d := ⟨hc, hd⟩
  have conv : ∀ (j : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ),
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j φ (Ioo c d) η‖ = |iteratedDeriv j φ η| := by
    intro j φ
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j isOpen_Ioo hη, norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv,
      Real.norm_eq_abs]
  
  have expLemma : ∀ (G : ℝ → ℝ) (A D : ℝ) (m : ℕ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (Ioo c d) → G η ≤ A →
      (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m → |iteratedDeriv i G η| ≤ D ^ i) →
      |iteratedDeriv m (fun e => Real.exp (G e)) η| ≤ (m.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp A * D ^ m := by
    intro G A D m hG hA hD

      (t := univ) (s := Ioo c d) (x := η) (C := Real.exp A) (D := D)
      Real.contDiff_exp.contDiffOn hG (by exact_mod_cast le_top) uniqueDiffOn_univ
      (uniqueDiffOn_Ioo c d) (mapsTo_univ G _) hη ?_ ?_
    · rw [conv] at key
      exact key

      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_univ, norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv,

    · intro i h1 h2

  have param_int_eta_jet : ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a' a b b' c d : ℝ), a' < a → a ≤ b → b < b' → c < d →

      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) (Ioo c d) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (η B : ℝ), c < η → η < d →

    set W : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Ioo a' b' ×ˢ Ioo c d with hW
    have hWo : IsOpen W := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hIoc : Set.uIoc a b = Ioc a b := Set.uIoc_of_le hab

        have := min_le_left (η - c) (d - η); linarith
      have hr2 : r ≤ (d - η) / 2 := by
        have := min_le_right (η - c) (d - η); linarith
      have hKW : Icc a b ×ˢ Icc (η - r) (η + r) ⊆ W := by
        rintro ⟨t, x⟩ ⟨⟨ht1, ht2⟩, hx1, hx2⟩
        exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩
      obtain ⟨Bd, hBd⟩ :=
        (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hφ'.mono hKW)

        intro χ hχ x hx1 hx2
        have : ContinuousOn (↿χ ∘ fun t : ℝ => (t, x)) (Icc a b) :=
          hχ.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
            (fun t ht => ⟨⟨by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩, hx1, hx2⟩)
        exact this
      have hmeas : ∀ (χ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn (↿χ) W → ∀ x, c < x → x < d →
          AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => χ t x) (volume.restrict (Set.uIoc a b)) := by
        intro χ hχ x hx1 hx2
        rw [hIoc]
        exact ((slice χ hχ x hx1 hx2).mono Ioc_subset_Icc_self).aestronglyMeasurable
          measurableSet_Ioc
      have key := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
        (μ := volume) (F := fun x t => φ t x) (F' := fun x t => φ' t x) (x₀ := η)
        (bound := fun _ => Bd) (a := a) (b := b) (s := Ioo (η - r) (η + r))
        (Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith))
        (Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2) (fun x hx => hmeas φ hφ x hx.1 hx.2))
        ((slice φ hφ η hη1 hη2).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab)
        (hmeas φ' hφ' η hη1 hη2)
        (ae_of_all _ (fun t ht x hx => by
          rw [hIoc] at ht
          exact hBd (t, x) ⟨⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩, hx.1.le, hx.2.le⟩))
        intervalIntegrable_const
        (ae_of_all _ (fun t ht x hx => by
          rw [hIoc] at ht
          exact hder t x (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.2]) (by linarith [hx.1])

      exact key.2

      intro g y e hg hye

      intro k

          simp [hΨ]

        have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => fderiv ℝ (↿(Ψ k)) p ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) W :=

        have h1 := chain (↿(Ψ k)) y e ih hye
        show iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun e' => ψ y e') e = _

        exact h1.deriv
    have s2 : ∀ k y e, a' < y → y < b' → c < e → e < d →
        HasDerivAt (fun e' => Ψ k y e') (Ψ (k + 1) y e) e := by
      intro k y e h1 h2 h3 h4
      have h5 := chain (↿(Ψ k)) y e (s1 k) ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩

        show iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun e' => ψ y e') e = _

        exact h5.deriv
      rw [heq]
      exact h5
    have hC : ∀ k η, c < η → η < d →
        iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) η = ∫ y in a..b, Ψ k y η := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro η _ _
        simp [hΨ]
      | succ k ih =>
        intro η h1 h2
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        have hev : iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) =ᶠ[nhds η]

        rw [hev.deriv_eq]
        exact (leib (Ψ k) (Ψ (k + 1)) η h1 h2 (s1 k).continuousOn (s1 (k + 1)).continuousOn
          (s2 k)).deriv
    have hsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) (Ioo c d) := by
      apply contDiffOn_of_differentiableOn_deriv
      intro m _
      have hd : DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, Ψ m y e) (Ioo c d) := fun e he =>
        (leib (Ψ m) (Ψ (m + 1)) e he.1 he.2 (s1 m).continuousOn (s1 (m + 1)).continuousOn
          (s2 m)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      refine hd.congr ?_
      intro e he
      rw [iteratedDerivWithin_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioo he, hC m e he.1 he.2]
    refine ⟨hsmooth, fun k η B h1 h2 hB => ?_⟩

    have hI := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := a) (b := b) (C := B)

  have hBψ0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ Bψ j := fun j => le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hBψ j a le_rfl hab)

      _ ≤ (1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), L * Bψ j) ^ i := le_self_pow₀ h1D (by omega)
  have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => Real.exp (∫ y in a..b, ψ y e)) (Ioo c d) :=

    (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hBf0 i))

          have := hC0 (s, z.2) ⟨hs', hz.2⟩
          rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] at this
          exact this.trans (le_abs_self _)
        calc ‖∫ s in x0..z.1, c (s, z.2)‖ ≤ |C0| * |z.1 - x0| :=
              intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hb
          _ ≤ |C0| * (hi - lo) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (abs_nonneg _)
            rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [hz.1.1, hz.1.2]
    | succ n ih =>
      intro c hc
      obtain ⟨ih1, Cp, hCp⟩ := ih (fun p => fderiv ℝ c p (0, 1)) (hpart c hc)
      obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hc.2 1
      obtain ⟨Cn, hCn⟩ := hc.2 n
      have hD := pd lo hi x0 hax hxb c hc.1 C1 hC1
      let A : ℝ →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).smulRight (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)
      let B : ℝ →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).smulRight (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ)
      let Pc' := fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in x0..q.1, fderiv ℝ c (s, q.2) (0, 1)
      have hcn : ContDiffOn ℝ n c (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := contDiffOn_infty.mp hc.1 n
      have hA : ContDiffOn ℝ n (⇑A ∘ Pc') (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
        A.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn ih1
      have hB : ContDiffOn ℝ n (⇑B ∘ c) (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
        B.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hcn
      have hR : ∀ p ∈ Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
          fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in x0..q.1, c (s, q.2)) p = ((⇑A ∘ Pc') + (⇑B ∘ c)) p := by
        intro p hp
        rw [(hD p hp).fderiv]

      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [show ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) = (n : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 by push_cast; rfl]
        rw [contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hUo]
        exact ⟨fun p hp => (hD p hp).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt,
          fun h => absurd h (by simp), (hA.add hB).congr hR⟩
      · refine ⟨‖A‖ * Cp + ‖B‖ * Cn, fun z hz => ?_⟩
        rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
        have hev : fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in x0..q.1, c (s, q.2)) =ᶠ[nhds z]
            ((⇑A ∘ Pc') + (⇑B ∘ c)) := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hz) hR
        rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ n).eq_of_nhds]
        have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ n Pc' z := ih1.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hz)
        have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ n c z := hcn.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hz)
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (A.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp z h1)
          (B.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp z h2)]
        calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (⇑A ∘ Pc') z‖ + ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (⇑B ∘ c) z‖ :=

                (B.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left h2 le_rfl)
          _ ≤ ‖A‖ * Cp + ‖B‖ * Cn :=
              add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hCp z hz) (norm_nonneg A))
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hCn z hz) (norm_nonneg B))
  
  have hΛ0 : (0:ℝ) < Λ := by linarith
  have h34 : 3 / Λ < 4 / Λ := div_lt_div_of_pos_right (by norm_num) hΛ0
  have h4m : 4 / Λ < 41 / (10 * Λ) := by
    rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ hΛ0 (by positivity)]; nlinarith
  have hUo : IsOpen (Ioo (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hUb : Bornology.IsBounded (Ioo (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
    (Metric.isBounded_Ioo _ _).prod (Metric.isBounded_Ioo _ _)
  obtain ⟨hmul, hadd, hsub, -, hcomp, hcst, hpart, -⟩ := ax_osb_algebra _ hUo hUb
  have hPP := pp (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) (4 / Λ) h34 h4m (fun f hf => (hpart f hf).1)

  have gcB := hmul _ _ ge gb

      osbGood (Ioo (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Ioo (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) c →
      osbGood (Ioo (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Ioo (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)
        (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in (4 / Λ)..q.1, c (s, q.2)) := by
    intro c hc
    unfold osbGood
    exact ⟨contDiffOn_infty.mpr (fun n => (hPP n c hc).1), fun m => (hPP m c hc).2⟩
  have hdP : ∀ c : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
      osbGood (Ioo (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Ioo (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) c →
      ∀ x η : ℝ, 3 / Λ < x → x < 41 / (10 * Λ) → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      HasDerivAt (fun Y => ∫ s in (4 / Λ)..Y, c (s, η)) (c (x, η)) x := by
    intro c hc x η h1 h2 h3 h4
    obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hc.2 1
    have hF := pd (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) (4 / Λ) h34 h4m c hc.1 C1 hC1 (x, η) ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, ⟨h3, h4⟩⟩
    have hl : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, η)) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) x :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const x η)
    refine (hF.comp_hasDerivAt x hl).congr_deriv ?_
    simp
  obtain ⟨EE, hEE⟩ : ∃ EE : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
      EE = fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in (4 / Λ)..q.1, axEa Λ t1 κ0 s * a (s, q.2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨JJ, hJJ⟩ : ∃ JJ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
      JJ = fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in (4 / Λ)..q.1, axEa Λ t1 κ0 s * b (s, q.2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have gEE : osbGood (Ioo (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)
      (Ioo (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) EE := by
    rw [hEE]; exact hosbP _ gcA
  have gJJ : osbGood (Ioo (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)
      (Ioo (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) JJ := by
    rw [hJJ]; exact hosbP _ gcB
  have gm := hcomp EE (fun x => -(Real.exp (-x))) gEE (by fun_prop)
  have gp := hcomp EE (fun x => Real.exp x) gEE (by fun_prop)
  have g3 := hcomp EE (fun x => -2 * Real.exp (-x) ^ 2) gEE (by fun_prop)
  have g4 := hcomp EE (fun x => Real.exp (-x)) gEE (by fun_prop)
  have g2 := hcst (fun _ => (2:ℝ)) contDiff_const

  have gβ3 := hmul _ _ ga g3

    fun p => b p * Real.exp (-(EE p)) - JJ p * a p * Real.exp (-(EE p)),

  have hmem : ∀ x ∈ uIcc (4 / Λ) X, 3 / Λ < x ∧ x < 41 / (10 * Λ) := by

      osbGood (Ioo (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Ioo (3 / Λ) (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) f →

    exact hf.1.continuousOn.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn

    fun x hx => hdP _ gcA x η (hmem x hx).1 (hmem x hx).2 h3 h4

signature.statement: ∀ (h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 om r : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < t1 → 0 < om → 0 < r → r ≤ ρ1 → AxAxisOut h j0 σ δ Pax Λ C K ρ1 Kder Fn Un → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un)) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un)) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) → ∃ ε' : ℝ, 0 < ε' ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un)) (Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un)) (Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un X η) ∧ (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C' : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C' ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C')

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have pd : ∀ (lo hi α β x0 : ℝ), lo < x0 → x0 < hi → ∀ (c : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo α β) → ∀ (C1 : ℝ),
      (∀ z ∈ Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo α β, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 c z‖ ≤ C1) →
      ∀ p ∈ Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo α β, HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in x0..q.1, c (s, q.2))
        ((∫ s in x0..p.1, fderiv ℝ c (s, p.2) (0, 1)) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ
          + c p • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) p := by
    intro lo hi α β x0 hax hxb c hc C1 hC1
    have hUo : IsOpen (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo α β) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hcc : ContinuousOn c (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo α β) := hc.continuousOn
    have hsl : ∀ e ∈ Ioo α β, ContinuousOn (fun s => c (s, e)) (Ioo lo hi) := by
      intro e he
      exact hcc.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn (fun s hs => ⟨hs, he⟩)
    have hsub : ∀ x ∈ Ioo lo hi, ∀ y ∈ Ioo lo hi, uIcc x y ⊆ Ioo lo hi :=
      fun x hx y hy => ordConnected_Ioo.uIcc_subset hx hy
    have hii : ∀ e ∈ Ioo α β, ∀ x ∈ Ioo lo hi, ∀ y ∈ Ioo lo hi,
        IntervalIntegrable (fun s => c (s, e)) MeasureTheory.volume x y :=
      fun e he x hx y hy => ((hsl e he).mono (hsub x hx y hy)).intervalIntegrable
    have hx0 : x0 ∈ Ioo lo hi := ⟨hax, hxb⟩
    rintro ⟨X, e0⟩ ⟨hX, he0⟩
    have hfd : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ c) (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo α β) :=
      hc.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hUo (by simp)
    have hdiff : ∀ z ∈ Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo α β, HasFDerivAt c (fderiv ℝ c z) z := fun z hz =>
      (((hc.differentiableOn (by simp)) z hz).differentiableAt (hUo.mem_nhds hz)).hasFDerivAt
    have hn01 : ‖((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖ = 1 := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
    have hG : HasDerivAt (fun e => ∫ s in x0..X, c (s, e))
        (∫ s in x0..X, fderiv ℝ c (s, e0) (0, 1)) e0 := by
      have hUI : uIoc x0 X ⊆ Ioo lo hi := uIoc_subset_uIcc.trans (hsub x0 hx0 X hX)
      have := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
        (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
        (a := x0) (b := X) (F := fun e s => c (s, e)) (F' := fun e s => fderiv ℝ c (s, e) (0, 1))
        (x₀ := e0) (bound := fun _ => C1) (s := Ioo α β) (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds he0) ?_
        (hii e0 he0 x0 hx0 X hX) ?_ ?_ intervalIntegrable_const ?_
      · exact this.2
      · filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds he0] with e he
        exact ((hsl e he).mono hUI).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
      · have hco : ContinuousOn (fun s => fderiv ℝ c (s, e0) (0, 1)) (Ioo lo hi) :=
          (hfd.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
            (fun s hs => ⟨hs, he0⟩)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
        exact (hco.mono hUI).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht e he => ?_)
        have hz : (t, e) ∈ Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo α β := ⟨hUI ht, he⟩
        calc ‖fderiv ℝ c (t, e) (0, 1)‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ c (t, e)‖ * ‖((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖ :=
              ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
          _ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 c (t, e)‖ := by rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_one, hn01, mul_one]
          _ ≤ C1 := hC1 _ hz
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht e he => ?_)
        have hz : (t, e) ∈ Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo α β := ⟨hUI ht, he⟩
        exact (hdiff _ hz).comp_hasDerivAt e ((hasDerivAt_const e t).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' e))
    have hH : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in X..q.1, c (s, q.2))
        (c (X, e0) • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) (X, e0) := by
      rw [hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
      intro ε hε
      have hcont : ContinuousAt c (X, e0) := hcc.continuousAt (hUo.mem_nhds ⟨hX, he0⟩)
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδc⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hcont ε hε
      obtain ⟨δ', hδ', hδU⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hUo (X, e0) ⟨hX, he0⟩
      filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℝ × ℝ) (lt_min hδ hδ')] with h hh
      have hh' : ‖h‖ < min δ δ' := by simpa using hh
      have hpt : ∀ s ∈ uIcc X (X + h.1), (s, e0 + h.2) ∈ Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo α β ∧
          ‖c (s, e0 + h.2) - c (X, e0)‖ ≤ ε := by
        intro s hs
        have h1 : |s - X| ≤ |h.1| := by
          have := abs_sub_left_of_mem_uIcc hs
          simpa using this
        have h1' : |h.1| ≤ ‖h‖ := by
          have := norm_fst_le h
          rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
        have h2' : |h.2| ≤ ‖h‖ := by
          have := norm_snd_le h
          rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
        have hd : dist (s, e0 + h.2) (X, e0) < min δ δ' := by
          rw [Prod.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
          rw [show e0 + h.2 - e0 = h.2 by ring]
          exact max_lt (by linarith) (by linarith)
        refine ⟨hδU (Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le hd (min_le_right _ _))), ?_⟩
        have := hδc (lt_of_lt_of_le hd (min_le_left _ _))
        rw [dist_eq_norm] at this
        exact this.le
      have hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => c (s, e0 + h.2)) MeasureTheory.volume X (X + h.1) :=
        (hcc.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
          (fun s hs => (hpt s hs).1)).intervalIntegrable
      simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, intervalIntegral.integral_same, sub_zero,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', smul_eq_mul]
      have hconst : c (X, e0) * h.1 = ∫ s in X..X + h.1, c (X, e0) := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]; ring
      rw [hconst, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub hint intervalIntegrable_const]
      calc ‖∫ s in X..X + h.1, (c (s, e0 + h.2) - c (X, e0))‖ ≤ ε * |X + h.1 - X| :=
            intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
              (fun s hs => (hpt s (uIoc_subset_uIcc hs)).2)
        _ ≤ ε * ‖h‖ := by
            rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
            have := norm_fst_le h
            rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this hε.le
    have hEq : (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in x0..q.1, c (s, q.2)) =ᶠ[nhds (X, e0)]
        fun q => ((fun e => ∫ s in x0..X, c (s, e)) ∘ Prod.snd) q + ∫ s in X..q.1, c (s, q.2) := by
      filter_upwards [hUo.mem_nhds ⟨hX, he0⟩] with q hq
      exact (intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hii q.2 hq.2 x0 hx0 X hX)
        (hii q.2 hq.2 X hX q.1 hq.1)).symm
    have hsnd : HasFDerivAt (Prod.snd : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) (X, e0) :=
      hasFDerivAt_snd
    have hGs := HasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt (X, e0) hG hsnd
    exact (hGs.add hH).congr_of_eventuallyEq hEq
  
  have hpart : ∀ (W : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen W → ∀ f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, osbGood W W f →
      osbGood W W (fun p => fderiv ℝ f p (0, 1)) := by
    intro W hUo f hf
    unfold osbGood at hf ⊢
    let L : (ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))
    have heq : (fun p => fderiv ℝ f p (0, 1)) = ⇑L ∘ fderiv ℝ f := by funext p; rfl
    refine ⟨?_, fun m => ?_⟩
    · rw [heq]
      exact L.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (hf.1.fderiv_of_isOpen hUo (by simp))
    · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hf.2 (m + 1)
      refine ⟨‖L‖ * C, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      rw [heq]
      have hfa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f z := hf.1.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hz)
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ m (fderiv ℝ f) z := hfa.fderiv_right (by simp)
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (⇑L ∘ fderiv ℝ f) z‖
          ≤ ‖L‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fderiv ℝ f) z‖ := L.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left h1 le_rfl
        _ = ‖L‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f z‖ := by rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
        _ ≤ ‖L‖ * C := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC z hz) (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg L)
  
  have pp : ∀ (lo hi α β x0 : ℝ), lo < x0 → x0 < hi →
      ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ c : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, osbGood (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo α β) (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo α β) c →
        ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in x0..q.1, c (s, q.2)) (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo α β) := by
    intro lo hi α β x0 hax hxb n
    have hUo : IsOpen (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo α β) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro c hc
      obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hc.2 1
      have hD := pd lo hi α β x0 hax hxb c hc.1 C1 hC1
      rw [Nat.cast_zero, contDiffOn_zero]
      exact fun z hz => (hD z hz).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    | succ n ih =>
      intro c hc
      have ih1 := ih (fun p => fderiv ℝ c p (0, 1)) (hpart _ hUo c hc)
      obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hc.2 1
      have hD := pd lo hi α β x0 hax hxb c hc.1 C1 hC1
      let A : ℝ →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).smulRight (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)
      let B : ℝ →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).smulRight (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ)
      let Pc' := fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in x0..q.1, fderiv ℝ c (s, q.2) (0, 1)
      have hcn : ContDiffOn ℝ n c (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo α β) := contDiffOn_infty.mp hc.1 n
      have hA : ContDiffOn ℝ n (⇑A ∘ Pc') (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo α β) :=
        A.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn ih1
      have hB : ContDiffOn ℝ n (⇑B ∘ c) (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo α β) :=
        B.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hcn
      have hR : ∀ p ∈ Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo α β,
          fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in x0..q.1, c (s, q.2)) p = ((⇑A ∘ Pc') + (⇑B ∘ c)) p := by
        intro p hp
        rw [(hD p hp).fderiv]
        simp [A, B, Pc']
      rw [show ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) = (n : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 by push_cast; rfl]
      rw [contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hUo]
      exact ⟨fun p hp => (hD p hp).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt,
        fun h => absurd h (by simp), (hA.add hB).congr hR⟩
  
  have cb : ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (V K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (m : ℕ), IsOpen V → IsCompact K → K ⊆ V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V → ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f p‖ ≤ B := by
    intro f V K m hV hK hKV hf
    have h1 := hf.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (m := m) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      hV.uniqueDiffOn
    have h2 : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f) V :=
      h1.congr (fun p hp => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hV hp).symm)
    exact hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (h2.mono hKV)
  intro h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 om r Pax Kder Fn Un hΛ1 ht1 hom hr hrρ hA hSA hSU
  have hΛ : 0 < Λ := by linarith
  have hρ1 : 0 < ρ1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hr hrρ
  have hX0 : 0 < 4 / Λ := by positivity
  have he1 : Real.exp (-1) < Real.exp (-1 / 2) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by norm_num)
  have he2 : Real.exp (-1 / 2) < 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_zero]; exact Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by norm_num)
  have hpos1 : 0 < 4 / Λ * Real.exp (-1) := by positivity
  have hlow : 4 / Λ * Real.exp (-1) < 4 / Λ * Real.exp (-1 / 2) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left he1 hX0
  have ha0 : 4 / Λ * Real.exp (-1 / 2) < 4 / Λ := mul_lt_of_lt_one_right hX0 he2
  have h45 : 4 / Λ < 5 / Λ := div_lt_div_of_pos_right (by norm_num) hΛ
  have hm1 : -1 / Λ < 0 := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by norm_num) hΛ
  have hX0le : 4 / Λ ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hΛ (by positivity)]; nlinarith
  have hε : -1 / Λ < -(1 / (2 * Λ)) := by
    have e : -1 / Λ = -(1 / Λ) := neg_div _ _
    have : 1 / (2 * Λ) < 1 / Λ := by
      rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hΛ]; linarith
    linarith
  
  have chart : ∀ g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) → ∀ T, 4 / Λ < T →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ z.1, g (y, z.2))
        (Ioo (4 / Λ * Real.exp (-1)) T ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r / 2) (1 + r / 2)) := by
    intro g hg T hT
    have hT4 : 1 < T * Λ / 4 := by
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; have := (div_lt_iff₀ hΛ).mp hT; linarith
    have hhi : 0 < Real.log (T * Λ / 4) + 1 := by linarith [Real.log_pos hT4]
    have hgo : osbGood (Ioo (-2) (Real.log (T * Λ / 4) + 1) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r / 2) (1 + r / 2))
        (Ioo (-2) (Real.log (T * Λ / 4) + 1) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r / 2) (1 + r / 2)) g := by
      refine ⟨hg.mono (prod_mono (subset_univ _) (Ioo_subset_Ioo (by linarith) (by linarith))),
        fun m => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := cb g (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r))
        (Icc (-2) (Real.log (T * Λ / 4) + 1) ×ˢ Icc (-1 - r / 2) (1 + r / 2)) m
        (isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioo) (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)
        (prod_mono (subset_univ _) (Icc_subset_Ioo (by linarith) (by linarith))) hg
      exact ⟨B, fun z hz => hB z (prod_mono Ioo_subset_Icc_self Ioo_subset_Icc_self hz)⟩
    have hP := contDiffOn_infty.mpr
      (fun n => pp (-2) (Real.log (T * Λ / 4) + 1) (-1 - r / 2) (1 + r / 2) 0 (by norm_num) hhi n g hgo)
    have hpz : ∀ z ∈ Ioo (4 / Λ * Real.exp (-1)) T ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r / 2) (1 + r / 2),
        Real.exp (-1) < z.1 * Λ / 4 := by
      intro z hz
      calc Real.exp (-1) = 4 / Λ * Real.exp (-1) * Λ / 4 := by field_simp
        _ < z.1 * Λ / 4 := by gcongr; exact hz.1.1
    have hμ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (Real.log (z.1 * Λ / 4), z.2))
        (Ioo (4 / Λ * Real.exp (-1)) T ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r / 2) (1 + r / 2)) :=
      (((contDiffOn_fst.mul contDiffOn_const).div_const 4).log
        (fun z hz => (lt_trans (Real.exp_pos _) (hpz z hz)).ne')).prodMk contDiffOn_snd
    have hmaps : MapsTo (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (Real.log (z.1 * Λ / 4), z.2))
        (Ioo (4 / Λ * Real.exp (-1)) T ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r / 2) (1 + r / 2))
        (Ioo (-2) (Real.log (T * Λ / 4) + 1) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r / 2) (1 + r / 2)) := by
      intro z hz
      have hp := hpz z hz
      have hzp : 0 < z.1 * Λ / 4 := lt_trans (Real.exp_pos _) hp
      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, hz.2⟩
      · rw [Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt hzp]
        exact lt_trans (Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by norm_num)) hp
      · have : Real.log (z.1 * Λ / 4) < Real.log (T * Λ / 4) :=
          Real.log_lt_log hzp (by have := hz.1.2; gcongr)
        linarith
    exact (hP.comp hμ hmaps).congr (fun z _ => rfl)
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ : ∃ Φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, Φ = fun z => Fn (4 / Λ) z.2 *
      Real.exp (-(1 / 2) * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ z.1, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y z.2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩ : ∃ Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, Ψ = fun z => Un (4 / Λ) z.2 +
      ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ z.1, axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y z.2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmemG : ∀ z ∈ (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r / 2) (1 + r / 2),
      ((fun z : ℝ × ℝ => ((4 / Λ : ℝ), z.2)) z) ∈ Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) :=
    fun z hz => ⟨⟨by linarith, h45⟩, ⟨by linarith [hz.2.1], by linarith [hz.2.2]⟩⟩
  have hGF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Fn (4 / Λ) z.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r / 2) (1 + r / 2)) :=

        exact ((hG2 (z.1 + 1) (by linarith)).mono (inter_subset_right.trans (hsub2 _))).congr
          (fun q hq => hE2 q hq.2.1.1 hq.2.2.1 hq.2.2.2)
    · intro X₁ m
      obtain ⟨B1, hB1⟩ := cb G1 _ (Icc 0 (4 / Λ * Real.exp (-1 / 2)) ×ˢ Icc (-1) 1) m
        (isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo) (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)
        (prod_mono (Icc_subset_Ioo hm1 (by linarith)) (Icc_subset_Ioo (by linarith) (by linarith))) hG1
      obtain ⟨B2, hB2⟩ := cb G2 _ (Icc (4 / Λ * Real.exp (-1 / 2)) (max X₁ (4 / Λ)) ×ˢ Icc (-1) 1) m
        (isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo) (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)
        (prod_mono (Icc_subset_Ioo hlow (by linarith [le_max_left X₁ (4 / Λ)]))
          (Icc_subset_Ioo (by linarith) (by linarith)))
        (hG2 (max X₁ (4 / Λ) + 1) (by linarith [le_max_right X₁ (4 / Λ)]))
      refine ⟨max B1 B2, fun X η hX hXX h1 h2 => ?_⟩
      by_cases hc : X ≤ 4 / Λ * Real.exp (-1 / 2)
      · rw [((hev1 (X, η) ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, h1, h2⟩).iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
        exact (hB1 _ ⟨⟨hX, hc⟩, h1.le, h2.le⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _)
      · push_neg at hc
        rw [((hev2 (max X₁ (4 / Λ) + 1) (X, η)
          ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith [le_max_left X₁ (4 / Λ)]⟩, h1, h2⟩).iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
        exact (hB2 _ ⟨⟨hc.le, le_trans hXX (le_max_left _ _)⟩, h1.le, h2.le⟩).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  obtain ⟨sF, bF⟩ := glueS (↿(axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un)) (↿Fn) Φ hA.1 hΦs
    (fun p hp => by
      show axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un p.1 p.2 = Fn p.1 p.2
      exact if_pos hp)
    (fun p h0 h1 h2 => (hEF p h0 h1 h2).1)
  obtain ⟨sU, bU⟩ := glueS (↿(axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un)) (↿Un) Ψ hA.2.1 hΨs
    (fun p hp => by
      show axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un p.1 p.2 = Un p.1 p.2
      exact if_pos hp)
    (fun p h0 h1 h2 => (hEF p h0 h1 h2).2)
  refine ⟨1 / (2 * Λ), by positivity, sF, sU, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro X η hX h1 h2
    by_cases hc : X ≤ 4 / Λ
    · have e1 : axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un X η = Fn X η := if_pos hc
      rw [e1]
      exact hA.2.2.1 X η hX (hc.trans hX0le) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    · have e1 : axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un X η = Fn (4 / Λ) η *
          Real.exp (-(1 / 2) * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ X, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η) := if_neg hc
      rw [e1]
      exact mul_pos (hA.2.2.1 _ η hX0.le hX0le (by linarith) (by linarith)) (Real.exp_pos _)
  · intro X₁ m
    obtain ⟨BF, hBF⟩ := bF X₁ m
    obtain ⟨BU, hBU⟩ := bU X₁ m
    exact ⟨max BF BU, fun X η a b c d =>
      ⟨(hBF X η a b c d).trans (le_max_left _ _), (hBU X η a b c d).trans (le_max_right _ _)⟩⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h Λ C t1 κ0 om : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → 1 ≤ C → 0 < om → om ≤ 1 / 25 → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < Fn (4 / Λ) η) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → Continuous (fun y => axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η) ∧ Continuous (fun y => axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η)) → ∀ X η : ℝ, 110 * Real.exp (-(1 / 20)) ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un X η = axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un 110 η ∧ axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un X η = Real.exp (Real.log (C * Real.sqrt 220 * axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un 110 η)) * (X / 110) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) / (C * Real.sqrt (2 * X))

signature.name: ax_prof_tail
signature.statement: ∀ (h Λ C t1 κ0 om : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → 1 ≤ C → 0 < om → om ≤ 1 / 25 → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < Fn (4 / Λ) η) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → Continuous (fun y => axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η) ∧ Continuous (fun y => axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η)) → ∀ X η : ℝ, 110 * Real.exp (-(1 / 20)) ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un X η = axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un 110 η ∧ axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un X η = Real.exp (Real.log (C * Real.sqrt 220 * axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un 110 η)) * (X / 110) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) / (C * Real.sqrt (2 * X))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Λ C t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un hΛ hC hom hom' hFn0 hcont X η hX hη1 hη2
  have hΛpos : 0 < Λ := by linarith
  have hC0 : 0 < C := by linarith
  
  have hsig : ∀ z : ℝ, 1 ≤ z → sigA z = 1 := by
    intro z hz
    unfold sigA
    rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr (by linarith)), if_pos hz]
  have hcut : ∀ y : ℝ, Real.log (25 * Λ) + om ≤ y →
      axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η = 4 / 5 ∧ axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hw : 0 < om / 2 := by linarith
    have h1 : axTheta Λ om y = 1 := by
      unfold axTheta
      apply hsig
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hw]
      linarith
    have h2 : axBeta Λ om y = 0 := by
      unfold axBeta
      have : sigA ((y - Real.log (25 * Λ)) / (om / 2)) = 1 := by
        apply hsig
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hw]
        linarith
      rw [this]
      ring
    constructor
    · unfold axShearA
      rw [h1]
      ring
    · unfold axSlopeU
      rw [h2]
      simp
  
  have he : (19 / 20 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (-(1 / 20)) := by
    have := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(1 / 20 : ℝ))
    linarith
  have he1 : Real.exp (-(1 / 20 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by norm_num)
  have hmargin : ∀ Z : ℝ, 110 * Real.exp (-(1 / 20)) ≤ Z → 1 / 25 ≤ Real.log (Z / 100) := by
    intro Z hZ
    have hep : 0 < Real.exp (-(1 / 20 : ℝ)) := Real.exp_pos _
    have h1 : (11 / 10) * Real.exp (-(1 / 20 : ℝ)) ≤ Z / 100 := by linarith
    have h2 := Real.log_le_log (mul_pos (by norm_num) hep) h1
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hep.ne', Real.log_exp] at h2
    have h3 := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 11 / 10)
    have h4 : (1:ℝ) - (11 / 10)⁻¹ = 1 / 11 := by norm_num
    linarith
  
  have hX0 : 4 / Λ ≤ 4 := div_le_self (by norm_num) hΛ
  have hXpos : 0 < X := by linarith
  have hXn : ¬ X ≤ 4 / Λ := by
    intro h'
    linarith
  have h110n : ¬ (110:ℝ) ≤ 4 / Λ := by
    intro h'
    linarith
  
  have h25 : (25 * Λ) ≠ 0 := (mul_pos (by norm_num) hΛpos).ne'
  have hlogY : ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → axLogY Λ Z = Real.log (25 * Λ) + Real.log (Z / 100) := by
    intro Z hZ
    unfold axLogY
    rw [← Real.log_mul h25 (div_pos hZ (by norm_num)).ne']
    congr 1
    ring
  have hsX : Real.log (25 * Λ) + om ≤ axLogY Λ X := by
    rw [hlogY X hXpos]
    linarith [hmargin X hX]
  have hs110 : Real.log (25 * Λ) + om ≤ axLogY Λ 110 := by
    rw [hlogY 110 (by norm_num)]
    linarith [hmargin 110 (by linarith)]
  have hdiff : axLogY Λ X = axLogY Λ 110 + Real.log (X / 110) := by
    unfold axLogY
    rw [← Real.log_mul (div_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) hΛpos) (by norm_num)).ne'
      (div_pos hXpos (by norm_num)).ne']
    congr 1
    ring
  
  have hsplit : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), Continuous f →
      (∀ y : ℝ, Real.log (25 * Λ) + om ≤ y → f y = c) →
      ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ X, f y =
        (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ 110, f y) + Real.log (X / 110) * c := by
    intro f c hf hfc
    have htail : ∫ y in (axLogY Λ 110)..axLogY Λ X, f y = Real.log (X / 110) * c := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => c), intervalIntegral.integral_const,
        smul_eq_mul, hdiff]
      · ring
      · intro y hy
        rw [Set.mem_uIcc] at hy
        show f y = c
        apply hfc
        rcases hy with hy | hy <;> linarith
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hf.intervalIntegrable 0 (axLogY Λ 110))
      (hf.intervalIntegrable (axLogY Λ 110) (axLogY Λ X)), htail]
  
  have hA : (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ X, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η) =
      (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ 110, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η) + Real.log (X / 110) * (4 / 5) :=
    hsplit (fun y => axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η) (4 / 5) (hcont η hη1 hη2).1
      (fun y hy => (hcut y hy).1)
  have hB : (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ X, axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η) =
      (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ 110, axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η) + Real.log (X / 110) * 0 :=
    hsplit (fun y => axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η) 0 (hcont η hη1 hη2).2
      (fun y hy => (hcut y hy).2)
  rw [mul_zero, add_zero] at hB
  have hU110 : axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un 110 η =
      Un (4 / Λ) η + ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ 110, axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η := by
    unfold axProfU
    rw [if_neg h110n]
  have hUX : axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un X η =
      Un (4 / Λ) η + ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ X, axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η := by
    unfold axProfU
    rw [if_neg hXn]
  have hF110 : axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un 110 η =
      Fn (4 / Λ) η * Real.exp (-(1 / 2) * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ 110, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η) := by
    unfold axProfF
    rw [if_neg h110n]
  have hFX : axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un X η =
      Fn (4 / Λ) η * Real.exp (-(1 / 2) * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ X, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η) := by
    unfold axProfF
    rw [if_neg hXn]
  refine ⟨by rw [hUX, hU110, hB], ?_⟩
  
  have hcpos : 0 < axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un 110 η := by
    rw [hF110]
    exact mul_pos (hFn0 η hη1 hη2) (Real.exp_pos _)
  have key : ∀ a b : ℝ, Fn (4 / Λ) η * Real.exp (-(1 / 2) * (a + b * (4 / 5))) =
      Fn (4 / Λ) η * Real.exp (-(1 / 2) * a) * Real.exp (-(2 / 5) * b) := by
    intro a b
    rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 2
    ring
  have hFX' : axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un X η =
      axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un 110 η * Real.exp (-(2 / 5) * Real.log (X / 110)) := by
    rw [hFX, hA, hF110]
    exact key _ _
  
  have ht : 0 < X / 110 := div_pos hXpos (by norm_num)
  have hs220 : 0 < Real.sqrt 220 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)
  rw [hFX', Real.exp_log (mul_pos (mul_pos hC0 hs220) hcpos), Real.rpow_def_of_pos ht]
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (2 * X) = Real.sqrt 220 * Real.exp (Real.log (X / 110) * (1 / 2)) := by
    rw [show 2 * X = 220 * (X / 110) by ring, Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num),
      Real.sqrt_eq_rpow (X / 110), Real.rpow_def_of_pos ht]
  rw [hsq, eq_div_iff (mul_pos hC0 (mul_pos hs220 (Real.exp_pos _))).ne']
  have hexp : Real.exp (Real.log (X / 110) * (1 / 10)) =
      Real.exp (-(2 / 5) * Real.log (X / 110)) * Real.exp (Real.log (X / 110) * (1 / 2)) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hexp]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h Λ t1 κ0 om r ρ1 : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < t1 → 0 < om → 0 < r → r ≤ ρ1 → r ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Pax (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axRefF Λ t1 Fn)) (Ioi (-1 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axRefU Λ t1 Un)) (Ioi (-1 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → 0 < axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un)) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un)) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r))

signature.name: ax_integrands_smooth
signature.statement: ∀ (h Λ t1 κ0 om r ρ1 : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < t1 → 0 < om → 0 < r → r ≤ ρ1 → r ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Pax (Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axRefF Λ t1 Fn)) (Ioi (-1 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axRefU Λ t1 Un)) (Ioi (-1 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → 0 < axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un)) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un)) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Λ t1 κ0 om r ρ1 Pax Fn Un hh0 hh1 hΛ ht1 hom hr hrρ hr1 hPax hF hU hFpos
  have hw : (0:ℝ) < 1 + r := by linarith
  
  have hstrip : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), 0 < c →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-c) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profRadAvg g)) (Ioi (-c) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profRadInt g)) (Ioi (-c) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := by
    intro g c hc hg
    have hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1, (1 + r) * p.2)) :=
      contDiff_fst.prodMk (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_snd)
    have hgt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x ξ : ℝ => g x ((1 + r) * ξ))) (Ioi (-c) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
      refine (hg.comp hχ.contDiffOn ?_).congr (fun p _ => rfl)
      intro p hp
      have h1 : -1 < p.2 := hp.2.1
      have h2 : p.2 < 1 := hp.2.2
      refine ⟨hp.1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show -1 - r < (1 + r) * p.2
        nlinarith [mul_pos hw (show (0:ℝ) < p.2 + 1 by linarith)]
      · show (1 + r) * p.2 < 1 + r
        nlinarith [mul_pos hw (show (0:ℝ) < 1 - p.2 by linarith)]
    obtain ⟨hA, -, hId⟩ := profRadAvg_props _ c hc hgt
    have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1, p.2 / (1 + r))) :=
      contDiff_fst.prodMk (contDiff_snd.div_const _)
    have hψm : MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1, p.2 / (1 + r)))
        (Ioi (-c) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) (Ioi (-c) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
      intro p hp
      have h1 : -1 - r < p.2 := hp.2.1
      have h2 : p.2 < 1 + r := hp.2.2
      refine ⟨hp.1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show -1 < p.2 / (1 + r)
        rw [lt_div_iff₀ hw]; linarith
      · show p.2 / (1 + r) < 1
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ hw]; linarith
    have heq : ∀ η : ℝ, (1 + r) * (η / (1 + r)) = η := fun η => by field_simp
    have hAvg : ∀ X η : ℝ,
        profRadAvg (fun x ξ : ℝ => g x ((1 + r) * ξ)) X (η / (1 + r)) = profRadAvg g X η := by
      intro X η
      simp only [profRadAvg, heq η]
    have hInt : ∀ X η : ℝ,
        profRadInt (fun x ξ : ℝ => g x ((1 + r) * ξ)) X (η / (1 + r)) = profRadInt g X η := by
      intro X η
      simp only [profRadInt, heq η]
    have hAv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profRadAvg g)) (Ioi (-c) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := by
      refine (hA.comp hψ.contDiffOn hψm).congr ?_
      intro p _
      exact (hAvg p.1 p.2).symm
    refine ⟨hAv, ?_⟩
    refine (contDiffOn_fst.mul hAv).congr ?_
    intro p hp
    have hm := hψm hp
    have h1 := (hId p.1 (p.2 / (1 + r)) hp.1 hm.2.1 hm.2.2).1
    show profRadInt g p.1 p.2 = p.1 * profRadAvg g p.1 p.2
    rw [← hInt, ← hAvg]
    exact h1.symm
  
  have hpd : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (W : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) W →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profEtaD g)) W := by
    intro g W hW hg
    obtain ⟨hd, hG'⟩ := (contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hW).1 hg
    refine (hG'.clm_apply (contDiffOn_const (c := ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))))).congr ?_
    intro p hp
    have hhas : HasFDerivAt (↿g) (fderiv ℝ (↿g) p) (p.1, p.2) :=
      ((hd p hp).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hp)).hasFDerivAt
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => (p.1, e)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) p.2 :=
      (hasDerivAt_const p.2 p.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' p.2)
    exact (hhas.comp_hasDerivAt p.2 hc).deriv
  
  have key : ∀ (ε : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ε →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) →
      (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 - r < η → η < 1 + r → 0 < F X η) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(psLead1 h F U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axNs h Pax F U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) := by
    intro ε F U hε hF hU hFpos
    set Ω : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r) with hΩdef
    have hΩo : IsOpen Ω := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hsub : Ω ⊆ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r) := fun p hp =>
      ⟨show -ε < p.1 from lt_trans (neg_lt_zero.mpr hε) hp.1, hp.2⟩
    have hrad : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r)) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profRadInt g)) Ω :=
      fun g hg => ((hstrip g ε hε hg).2).mono hsub
    have hFp : ∀ p ∈ Ω, 0 < F p.1 p.2 := fun p hp => hFpos _ _ hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2
    have hLp : ∀ p ∈ Ω, 0 < 1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2 := by
      intro p hp
      have h1 : -1 - r < p.2 := hp.2.1
      have h2 : p.2 < 1 + r := hp.2.2
      have hsq : p.2 ^ 2 < 4 := by

subgoal_signatures.name: profRadAvg_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profRadAvg g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(profRadAvg g)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → X * profRadAvg g X η = profRadInt g X η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * profRadAvg g Y η) (g X η) X)

subgoal_signatures.name: sigA_collar_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement: ContDiff ℝ ∞ sigA ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ collarG ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ collarGam ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → 1 - sigA (1 - u) = Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) * collarG u) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → HasDerivAt sigA (Real.exp (-1 / u ^ 2) / u ^ 3 * collarGam u) (1 - u)) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → 0 ≤ collarGam u) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → u ≤ 1 / 2 → Real.exp (-4) / 2 ≤ collarGam u)

signature.statement: ∀ (h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Λ → 0 < C → 0 < ρ1 → AxAxisOut h j0 σ δ Pax Λ C K ρ1 Kder Fn Un → ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 4 / Λ → -1 < η → η < 1 → |Un X η - (4 * η + j0)| ≤ K / Λ ∧ |deriv (fun e => Un X e) η - 4| ≤ K / Λ ∧ 0 < C * Fn X η ∧ C * Fn X η ≤ Kder 0 ∧ (C * Fn X η)⁻¹ ≤ Kder 0 ∧ |C * deriv (fun e => Fn X e) η| ≤ Kder 1

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 Pax Kder Fn Un hΛ hC hρ1 hA X η hX0 hXX0 h1 h2
  have h41 : 4 / Λ ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hΛ (by positivity)]; nlinarith
  have hη1 : -1 - ρ1 < η := by linarith
  have hη2 : η < 1 + ρ1 := by linarith
  have hDo : IsOpen (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hneg : -1 / Λ < 0 := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by norm_num) hΛ
  have h45 : 4 / Λ < 5 / Λ := div_lt_div_of_pos_right (by norm_num) hΛ
  have hmem : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 4 / Λ →
      (x, η) ∈ Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) :=
    fun x hx1 hx2 => Set.mk_mem_prod ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩ ⟨hη1, hη2⟩
  have hslice : ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ f (x, η) →
      HasDerivAt (fun e => f (x, e)) (fderiv ℝ f (x, η) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) η := by
    intro f x hf
    have hι : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => (x, e)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) η :=
      (hasDerivAt_const η x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id η)
    exact hf.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt η hι
  have hUd : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 4 / Λ → DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿Un) (x, η) := fun x hx1 hx2 =>
    (hA.2.1.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds (hmem x hx1 hx2))).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => C * Fn z.1 z.2) (X, η) :=
    (differentiableAt_const C).mul
      ((hA.1.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds (hmem X hX0 hXX0))).differentiableAt (by simp))
  have hUid : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 4 / Λ →
      deriv (fun e => Un x e) η = fderiv ℝ (↿Un) (x, η) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) :=
    fun x hx1 hx2 => (hslice (↿Un) x (hUd x hx1 hx2)).deriv
  have hA6 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ 4 / Λ →
      |Un x η - (4 * η + j0)| ≤ K / Λ ∧ |deriv (fun e => Un x e) η - 4| ≤ K / Λ := by
    intro x hx1 hx2
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, a5, a6, -, -⟩ := hA.2.2.2.2.2.1 x η hx1 (hx2.trans h41) hη1 hη2
    exact ⟨a5, a6⟩
  have hA8 := hA.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  have hclose : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousAt φ 0 →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ 4 / Λ → φ x ≤ K / Λ) → φ 0 ≤ K / Λ := by
    intro φ hφ hb
    have h4 : (0:ℝ) < 4 / Λ := by positivity
    apply le_of_tendsto (x := nhdsWithin (0:ℝ) (Ioi 0)) (hφ.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds)
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT h4] with x hx
    exact hb x hx.1 hx.2.le
  have hcomp : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => (x, η)) 0 :=
    (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousAt
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases hX0.lt_or_eq with hX | hX
    · exact (hA6 X hX hXX0).1
    · subst hX
      apply hclose (fun x => |Un x η - (4 * η + j0)|) _ (fun x hx1 hx2 => (hA6 x hx1 hx2).1)
      have hc : ContinuousAt (↿Un) ((0:ℝ), η) := (hUd 0 le_rfl hXX0).continuousAt
      have : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => Un x η) 0 :=
        ContinuousAt.comp (g := ↿Un) (f := fun x : ℝ => (x, η)) hc hcomp
      exact (this.sub continuousAt_const).abs
  · rcases hX0.lt_or_eq with hX | hX
    · exact (hA6 X hX hXX0).2
    · subst hX
      rw [hUid 0 le_rfl hXX0]
      apply hclose (fun x => |fderiv ℝ (↿Un) (x, η) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) - 4|)
      · have hfc : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (↿Un)) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) :=
          hA.2.1.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hDo (by simp)
        have h3 : ContinuousAt (fderiv ℝ (↿Un)) ((0:ℝ), η) :=
          hfc.continuousAt (hDo.mem_nhds (hmem 0 le_rfl hXX0))
        have h4 : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => fderiv ℝ (↿Un) (x, η)) 0 :=
          ContinuousAt.comp (g := fderiv ℝ (↿Un)) (f := fun x : ℝ => (x, η)) h3 hcomp
        exact ((h4.clm_apply continuousAt_const).sub continuousAt_const).abs
      · intro x hx1 hx2
        show |fderiv ℝ (↿Un) (x, η) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) - 4| ≤ K / Λ
        rw [← hUid x hx1.le hx2]
        exact (hA6 x hx1 hx2).2
  · exact mul_pos hC (hA.2.2.1 X η hX0 (hXX0.trans h41) hη1 hη2)
  · have := (hA8 0 X η hX0 (hXX0.trans h41) hη1 hη2).1
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans this
  · have := (hA8 0 X η hX0 (hXX0.trans h41) hη1 hη2).2.1
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans this
  · have hb := (hA8 1 X η hX0 (hXX0.trans h41) hη1 hη2).1
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_one] at hb
    have hd : deriv (fun e => C * Fn X e) η =
        fderiv ℝ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => C * Fn z.1 z.2) (X, η) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) :=
      (hslice (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => C * Fn z.1 z.2) X hFd).deriv
    have he : deriv (fun e => C * Fn X e) η = C * deriv (fun e => Fn X e) η := by
      rw [deriv_const_mul_field']
    rw [← he, hd]
    have hn : ‖((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖ = 1 := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
    calc |fderiv ℝ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => C * Fn z.1 z.2) (X, η) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))|
        = ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => C * Fn z.1 z.2) (X, η) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖ :=
          (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
      _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => C * Fn z.1 z.2) (X, η)‖ * ‖((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ = ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => C * Fn z.1 z.2) (X, η)‖ := by rw [hn, mul_one]
      _ ≤ Kder 1 := hb

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 om Pax Kder Fn Un hΛ hρ1 ht1 ht1' hom hA X η _hXnn hX hη1 hη2
  
  have repF : axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un X η = Fn X η * Real.exp (-1 * ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X,
      axEa Λ t1 κ0 s * (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) s * (Fn s η)⁻¹)) := by
    obtain ⟨hFs, _hUs, hFpos, hSt, -, -, -, -⟩ := hA
    have hΛ0 : 0 < Λ := by linarith
    have hX0 : 0 < 4 / Λ := div_pos (by norm_num) hΛ0
    have hEa0 : ∀ x, x ≤ 4 / Λ → axEa Λ t1 κ0 x = 0 := fun x hx => by
      unfold axEa; rw [if_pos hx]
    by_cases hXa : X ≤ 4 / Λ
    · have hI : (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..X, axEa Λ t1 κ0 s * (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) s * (Fn s η)⁻¹)) = 0 := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ)) ?_, intervalIntegral.integral_zero]
        intro s hs
        have hs' : s ≤ 4 / Λ := by
          rcases Set.mem_uIcc.mp hs with h1 | h1
          · linarith [h1.2]
          · linarith [h1.2]

      unfold axProfF

      have hiΛ : 0 < 1 / Λ := by positivity

      have hηρ : η ∈ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

        linarith
      have ht1log : t1 < Real.log (41 / 40) := (Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt (by norm_num)).mpr hexp
      have hX41 : X ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) := by

        have h2 : 4 / Λ * (41 / 40) = 41 / (10 * Λ) := by field_simp; ring
        linarith
      have hXΛ1 : 1 < X * Λ / 4 := by
        have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hXa hΛ0
        have e : 4 / Λ * Λ = 4 := by field_simp
        linarith
      have hXΛ2 : X * Λ / 4 ≤ Real.exp t1 := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hX hΛ0.le
        have e : 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 * Λ = 4 * Real.exp t1 := by field_simp
        linarith
      have hL0 : 0 < axLogY Λ X := by unfold axLogY; exact Real.log_pos hXΛ1
      have hLt : axLogY Λ X ≤ t1 := by
        unfold axLogY; exact (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp (by linarith)).mpr hXΛ2
      have haL : 4 / Λ * Real.exp (axLogY Λ X) = X := by
        unfold axLogY; rw [Real.exp_log (by linarith)]; field_simp
      have hsubJ : Icc 0 X ⊆ Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) := by
        intro x hx
        refine ⟨by rw [em1]; linarith [hx.1], ?_⟩
        rw [e5]; rw [e41] at hX41; linarith [hx.2]
      have hφs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => Fn Y η) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ)) :=

      have hφd : ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 X, HasDerivAt (fun Y => Fn Y η) (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) x) x :=
        fun x hx => ((hφs.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
          (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds (hsubJ hx))).hasDerivAt
      have hDc : ContinuousOn (deriv fun Y => Fn Y η) (Icc 0 X) :=
        (hφs.continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioo (by simp)).mono hsubJ
      have hφc : ContinuousOn (fun Y => Fn Y η) (Icc 0 X) := hφs.continuousOn.mono hsubJ
      have hφpos : ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 X, 0 < Fn x η := fun x hx =>
        hFpos x η hx.1 (le_trans hx.2 hX41) (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have hsigc : Continuous sigA := by
        have hE : Continuous expNegInvGlue := (expNegInvGlue.contDiff (n := 0)).continuous
        have ha : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => expNegInvGlue (y * |y|)) :=

          hE.comp ((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).mul (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).abs)
        have hpos : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) + expNegInvGlue ((1 - y) * |1 - y|) := by
          intro y
          rcases lt_or_ge 0 y with hy | hy
          · have := expNegInvGlue.pos_of_pos (mul_pos hy (abs_pos.mpr hy.ne'))
            linarith [expNegInvGlue.nonneg ((1 - y) * |1 - y|)]
          · have h1 : 0 < 1 - y := by linarith
            have := expNegInvGlue.pos_of_pos (mul_pos h1 (abs_pos.mpr h1.ne'))

        have heq : sigA = fun y => expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) /
            (expNegInvGlue (y * |y|) + expNegInvGlue ((1 - y) * |1 - y|)) := by

          split_ifs with h0 h1
          · rw [expNegInvGlue.zero_of_nonpos (by nlinarith [abs_nonneg y]), zero_div]

              (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) (abs_nonneg _)), add_zero,
              div_self (expNegInvGlue.pos_of_pos (mul_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < y)

        · have hxp : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hX0 hx

      have hsig0 : ∀ y, y ≤ 0 → sigA y = 0 := by
