          have hs0 : sigA (Real.log (y * Λ / 4) / t1) = 0 :=
            hsig0 _ (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hl ht1.le)
          rw [hs0, mul_zero]
        · rfl
    have hkapE : ∀ y, 0 ≤ y → axKap κ0 t1 y = 1 - axEa Λ t1 κ0 (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) := by
      intro y hy
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hy with h0 | h0
      · rw [← h0, Real.exp_zero, mul_one, hEa0 _ le_rfl]
        unfold axKap; rw [zero_div, hsig0 0 le_rfl]; ring
      · have hgt : 4 / Λ < 4 / Λ * Real.exp y := lt_mul_of_one_lt_right hX0 (by
          have := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr h0; rwa [Real.exp_zero] at this)
        unfold axEa; rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr hgt)]
        have hlog : axLogY Λ (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) = y := by
          unfold axLogY
          have : 4 / Λ * Real.exp y * Λ / 4 = Real.exp y := by field_simp
          rw [this, Real.log_exp]
        rw [hlog]; unfold axKap; ring
    obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = axLogY Λ X := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hLdef]
    have hXΛ : 1 < X * Λ / 4 := by
      have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hXa hΛ0
      rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hΛ0.ne'] at this; linarith
    have hXΛ' : X * Λ / 4 ≤ Real.exp t1 := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hX hΛ0.le
      have e : 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 * Λ = 4 * Real.exp t1 := by field_simp
      linarith
    have hL0 : 0 < L := by rw [hLdef]; exact Real.log_pos hXΛ
    have hLt : L ≤ t1 := by
      have := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hXΛ'
      rw [Real.log_exp] at this
      rw [hLdef]; exact this
    have hLX : 4 / Λ * Real.exp L = X := by
      rw [hLdef]; unfold axLogY; rw [Real.exp_log (by linarith)]; field_simp
    have hψs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => Un Y η) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ)) :=
      hUs.comp (contDiffOn_id.prodMk contDiffOn_const) (fun _ hY => Set.mk_mem_prod hY hηρ)
    have hψd : ContinuousOn (deriv fun Y => Un Y η) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ)) :=
      hψs.continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioo (by simp)
    have hψh : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ),
        HasDerivAt (fun Y => Un Y η) (deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) x) x :=
      fun x hx => ((hψs.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hx)).hasDerivAt
    have hXJ : X < 5 / Λ := by
      have h1 : 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 < 4 / Λ * (41 / 40) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hexp hX0
      have h2 : 4 / Λ * (41 / 40) = 41 / 10 * (1 / Λ) := by ring
      rw [e5]; linarith
    have hIccJ : Icc 0 X ⊆ Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) := by
      intro x hx
      exact ⟨by rw [em1]; linarith [hx.1], by linarith [hx.2]⟩
    have hdc : ContinuousOn (deriv fun Y => Un Y η) (Icc 0 X) := hψd.mono hIccJ
    have hgc : ContinuousOn (fun x => (1 - axEa Λ t1 κ0 x) * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) x) (Icc 0 X) :=
      (continuous_const.sub hEc).continuousOn.mul hdc
    have hedc : ContinuousOn (fun x => axEa Λ t1 κ0 x * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) x) (Icc 0 X) :=
      hEc.continuousOn.mul hdc
    have hsub : Icc (4 / Λ) X ⊆ Icc 0 X := Icc_subset_Icc_left hX0.le
    have hsub0 : Icc 0 (4 / Λ) ⊆ Icc 0 X := Icc_subset_Icc_right hXa.le
    have hu1 : Set.uIcc (4 / Λ) X = Icc (4 / Λ) X := Set.uIcc_of_le hXa.le
    have hu0 : Set.uIcc 0 (4 / Λ) = Icc 0 (4 / Λ) := Set.uIcc_of_le hX0.le
    have hdi : IntervalIntegrable (deriv fun Y => Un Y η) MeasureTheory.volume (4 / Λ) X := by
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable; rw [hu1]; exact hdc.mono hsub
    have hedi : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => axEa Λ t1 κ0 x * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) x)
        MeasureTheory.volume (4 / Λ) X := by
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable; rw [hu1]; exact hedc.mono hsub
    have hedi0 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => axEa Λ t1 κ0 x * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) x)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (4 / Λ) := by
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable; rw [hu0]; exact hedc.mono hsub0
    have hint : (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..L, axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η) =
        ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..L, ((fun x => (1 - axEa Λ t1 κ0 x) * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) x) ∘
          (fun y => 4 / Λ * Real.exp y)) y * (fun y => 4 / Λ * Real.exp y) y := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro y hy
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hL0.le] at hy
      simp only [Function.comp]
      rw [hwin y (by linarith [hy.2]) (by linarith [hy.2]), hkapE y hy.1]
      ring
    have himg : (fun y => 4 / Λ * Real.exp y) '' Set.uIcc 0 L ⊆ Icc 0 X := by
      rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hL0.le] at hy
      show 0 ≤ 4 / Λ * Real.exp y ∧ 4 / Λ * Real.exp y ≤ X
      refine ⟨(mul_pos hX0 (Real.exp_pos y)).le, ?_⟩
      rw [← hLX]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hy.2) hX0.le
    have hcov := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_deriv' (a := 0) (b := L)
      (f := fun y => 4 / Λ * Real.exp y) (f' := fun y => 4 / Λ * Real.exp y)
      (g := fun x => (1 - axEa Λ t1 κ0 x) * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) x)
      (fun x _ => (Real.hasDerivAt_exp x).const_mul (4 / Λ))
      (continuous_const.mul Real.continuous_exp).continuousOn (hgc.mono himg)
    have hmain : (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..L, axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η) =
        ∫ x in (4 / Λ)..X, (1 - axEa Λ t1 κ0 x) * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) x := by
      rw [hint, hcov]
      simp only [Real.exp_zero, mul_one, hLX]
    have hsplit : (∫ x in (4 / Λ)..X, (1 - axEa Λ t1 κ0 x) * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) x) =
        (∫ x in (4 / Λ)..X, deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) x) -
          ∫ x in (4 / Λ)..X, axEa Λ t1 κ0 x * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) x := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub hdi hedi]
      congr 1; funext x; ring
    have hftc : (∫ x in (4 / Λ)..X, deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) x) = Un X η - Un (4 / Λ) η :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
        (fun x hx => by rw [hu1] at hx; exact hψh x (hIccJ (hsub hx))) hdi
    have hext : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, axEa Λ t1 κ0 x * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) x) =
        ∫ x in (4 / Λ)..X, axEa Λ t1 κ0 x * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) x := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals hedi0 hedi]
      have heq : Set.EqOn (fun x => axEa Λ t1 κ0 x * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) x) (fun _ => (0:ℝ))
          (Set.uIcc 0 (4 / Λ)) := by
        intro x hx
        rw [hu0] at hx
        simp only [hEa0 x hx.2, zero_mul]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr heq]
      simp
    rw [hmain, hsplit, hftc, hext]
    ring
  
  have hΛ0 : 0 < Λ := by linarith
  have hc : 0 < 4 / Λ := div_pos (by norm_num) hΛ0
  have s3 : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → (∀ s, s ≤ c → g s = 0) → ∀ Y : ℝ,
      (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..Y, g s) = ∫ s in c..Y, g s := by
    intro g c hc0 hg Y
    by_cases hY : Y ≤ c
    · have e1 : (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..Y, g s) = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..Y, (0:ℝ) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro s hs
        rcases Set.mem_uIcc.mp hs with ⟨_, h2⟩ | ⟨_, h2⟩
        · exact hg s (by linarith)
        · exact hg s (by linarith)
      have e2 : (∫ s in c..Y, g s) = ∫ s in c..Y, (0:ℝ) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro s hs
        rcases Set.mem_uIcc.mp hs with ⟨_, h2⟩ | ⟨_, h2⟩
        · exact hg s (by linarith)
        · exact hg s (by linarith)
      rw [e1, e2, intervalIntegral.integral_zero, intervalIntegral.integral_zero]
    · push_neg at hY
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by linarith), intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hY.le]
      refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioc
        (Set.Ioc_subset_Ioc_left hc0.le) ?_
      intro x hx
      apply hg
      by_contra hxc
      push_neg at hxc
      exact hx.2 ⟨hxc, hx.1.2⟩
  have hzero : ∀ s, s ≤ 4 / Λ → axEa Λ t1 κ0 s = 0 := by
    intro s hs
    unfold axEa
    rw [if_pos hs]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [repF]
    unfold axFfModelF
    rw [s3 (fun s => axEa Λ t1 κ0 s * (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) s * (Fn s η)⁻¹)) (4 / Λ) hc
      (fun s hs => by simp only [hzero s hs, zero_mul]) X, neg_one_mul]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
  · rw [repU]
    unfold axFfModelU
    rw [s3 (fun s => axEa Λ t1 κ0 s * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) s) (4 / Λ) hc
      (fun s hs => by simp only [hzero s hs, zero_mul]) X]
    ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (F U G V : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ), 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → (∀ x e : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → -1 < e → e < 1 → G x e = F x e ∧ V x e = U x e) → G X η = F X η ∧ psLead1 h G V X η = psLead1 h F U X η ∧ axPs2 h Pax G V X η = axPs2 h Pax F U X η

signature.name: ps_local_congr
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (F U G V : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ), 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → (∀ x e : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → -1 < e → e < 1 → G x e = F x e ∧ V x e = U x e) → G X η = F X η ∧ psLead1 h G V X η = psLead1 h F U X η ∧ axPs2 h Pax G V X η = axPs2 h Pax F U X η

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Pax F U G V X η hX hη1 hη2 hag
  
  have hI : ∀ (g g' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ x e : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → -1 < e → e < 1 → g' x e = g x e) →
      ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → profRadInt g' X e = profRadInt g X e := by
    intro g g' hg e he1 he2
    unfold profRadInt
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro x hx
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hX] at hx
    exact hg x e hx.1 hx.2 he1 he2
  
  have hAv : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → profRadAvg V X e = profRadAvg U X e := by
    intro e he1 he2
    unfold profRadAvg
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s hs
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at hs
    exact (hag (s * X) e (mul_nonneg hs.1 hX) (mul_le_of_le_one_left hX hs.2) he1 he2).2
  
  have hD : ∀ (φ ψ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → φ e = ψ e) → deriv φ η = deriv ψ η := by
    intro φ ψ hφ
    apply Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq
    exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2) (fun e he => hφ e he.1 he.2)
  have hED : ∀ (g g' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → g' X e = g X e) →
      profEtaD g' X η = profEtaD g X η := by
    intro g g' hg
    unfold profEtaD
    exact hD _ _ hg
  
  have h1 : ∀ x e : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → -1 < e → e < 1 →
      (fun x e => 2 * x * G x e) x e = (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) x e := by
    intro x e a b c d
    simp only [(hag x e a b c d).1]
  have h2 : ∀ x e : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → -1 < e → e < 1 →
      (fun x e => V x e * (2 * x * G x e)) x e = (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) x e := by
    intro x e a b c d
    simp only [(hag x e a b c d).1, (hag x e a b c d).2]
  have h3 : ∀ x e : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → -1 < e → e < 1 → V x e = U x e :=
    fun x e a b c d => (hag x e a b c d).2
  have h4 : ∀ x e : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → -1 < e → e < 1 →
      (fun x e => V x e ^ 2 - x * G x e ^ 2) x e = (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) x e := by
    intro x e a b c d
    simp only [(hag x e a b c d).1, (hag x e a b c d).2]
  have h5 : ∀ x e : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → -1 < e → e < 1 →
      (fun x e => G x e ^ 2) x e = (fun x e => F x e ^ 2) x e := by
    intro x e a b c d
    simp only [(hag x e a b c d).1]
  have e1 := hI _ _ h1 η hη1 hη2
  have e2 := hI _ _ h2 η hη1 hη2
  have e3 := hI _ _ h3 η hη1 hη2
  have e4 := hI _ _ h4 η hη1 hη2
  have d1 := hED _ _ (hI _ _ h1)
  have d2 := hED _ _ (hI _ _ h2)
  have d3 := hED _ _ (hI _ _ h3)
  have d4 := hED _ _ (hI _ _ h4)
  have hW : leadW h V X η = leadW h U X η := by
    unfold leadW
    rw [hAv η hη1 hη2, hED _ _ hAv]
  have hPi : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → axPi Pax G X e = axPi Pax F X e := by
    intro e he1 he2
    unfold axPi
    rw [hI _ _ h5 e he1 he2]
  have dPi := hED _ _ hPi
  
  have hFX : G X η = F X η := (hag X η hX le_rfl hη1 hη2).1
  have hUX : V X η = U X η := (hag X η hX le_rfl hη1 hη2).2
  refine ⟨hFX, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    unfold psLead1 leadQs
    rw [hW, e1, d1, d2, e2, hFX]
  · 
    unfold axPs2 axNs
    rw [hW, e3, d3, e4, d4, hPi η hη1 hη2, dPi, hUX, hFX]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < ρ1 → AxAxisOut h j0 σ δ Pax Λ C K ρ1 Kder Fn Un → ∃ c Bn Km : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 0 ≤ Bn ∧ 0 ≤ Km ∧ ∀ t1 κ0 X : ℝ, 0 < t1 → t1 ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < κ0 → κ0 < 1 / 2 → 4 / Λ < X → X ≤ 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 → (∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → ContinuousOn (fun x => Fn x e) (Icc 0 X) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => deriv (fun e' => Fn x e') e) (Icc 0 X) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => Un x e) (Icc 0 X) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => deriv (fun e' => Un x e') e) (Icc 0 X) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn x e) (Icc 0 X) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => deriv (fun e' => axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn x e') e) (Icc 0 X) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => axFfModelU Λ t1 κ0 Un x e) (Icc 0 X) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => deriv (fun e' => axFfModelU Λ t1 κ0 Un x e') e) (Icc 0 X)) ∧ (∀ x e : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → -1 < e → e < 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e' => Fn x e') e ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e' => Un x e') e ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e' => axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn x e') e ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e' => axFfModelU Λ t1 κ0 Un x e') e ∧ c ≤ Fn x e ∧ c ≤ axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn x e ∧ |Fn x e| ≤ Bn ∧ |deriv (fun e' => Fn x e') e| ≤ Bn ∧ |Un x e| ≤ Bn ∧ |deriv (fun e' => Un x e') e| ≤ Bn ∧ |axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn x e - Fn x e| ≤ Km * (axEa Λ t1 κ0 X * (X - 4 / Λ)) ∧ |deriv (fun e' => axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn x e') e - deriv (fun e' => Fn x e') e| ≤ Km * (axEa Λ t1 κ0 X * (X - 4 / Λ)) ∧ |axFfModelU Λ t1 κ0 Un x e - Un x e| ≤ Km * (axEa Λ t1 κ0 X * (X - 4 / Λ)) ∧ |deriv (fun e' => axFfModelU Λ t1 κ0 Un x e') e - deriv (fun e' => Un x e') e| ≤ Km * (axEa Λ t1 κ0 X * (X - 4 / Λ)))

signature.name: ax_model_pointwise
signature.statement: ∀ (h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < ρ1 → AxAxisOut h j0 σ δ Pax Λ C K ρ1 Kder Fn Un → ∃ c Bn Km : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 0 ≤ Bn ∧ 0 ≤ Km ∧ ∀ t1 κ0 X : ℝ, 0 < t1 → t1 ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < κ0 → κ0 < 1 / 2 → 4 / Λ < X → X ≤ 4 / Λ * Real.exp t1 → (∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → ContinuousOn (fun x => Fn x e) (Icc 0 X) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => deriv (fun e' => Fn x e') e) (Icc 0 X) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => Un x e) (Icc 0 X) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => deriv (fun e' => Un x e') e) (Icc 0 X) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn x e) (Icc 0 X) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => deriv (fun e' => axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn x e') e) (Icc 0 X) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => axFfModelU Λ t1 κ0 Un x e) (Icc 0 X) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => deriv (fun e' => axFfModelU Λ t1 κ0 Un x e') e) (Icc 0 X)) ∧ (∀ x e : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → -1 < e → e < 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e' => Fn x e') e ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e' => Un x e') e ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e' => axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn x e') e ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e' => axFfModelU Λ t1 κ0 Un x e') e ∧ c ≤ Fn x e ∧ c ≤ axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn x e ∧ |Fn x e| ≤ Bn ∧ |deriv (fun e' => Fn x e') e| ≤ Bn ∧ |Un x e| ≤ Bn ∧ |deriv (fun e' => Un x e') e| ≤ Bn ∧ |axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn x e - Fn x e| ≤ Km * (axEa Λ t1 κ0 X * (X - 4 / Λ)) ∧ |deriv (fun e' => axFfModelF Λ t1 κ0 Fn x e') e - deriv (fun e' => Fn x e') e| ≤ Km * (axEa Λ t1 κ0 X * (X - 4 / Λ)) ∧ |axFfModelU Λ t1 κ0 Un x e - Un x e| ≤ Km * (axEa Λ t1 κ0 X * (X - 4 / Λ)) ∧ |deriv (fun e' => axFfModelU Λ t1 κ0 Un x e') e - deriv (fun e' => Un x e') e| ≤ Km * (axEa Λ t1 κ0 X * (X - 4 / Λ)))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h j0 σ δ Λ C K ρ1 Pax Kder Fn Un hΛ hρ1 hA
  have hF := hA.1
  have hU := hA.2.1
  have hpos := hA.2.2.1
  
  have s1 : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (a b c d : ℝ), IsOpen S → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) S → Icc a b ×ˢ Icc c d ⊆ S → ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ (∀ x e : ℝ, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → c ≤ e → e ≤ d → |f x e| ≤ B ∧ |deriv (fun Y => f Y e) x| ≤ B ∧ |deriv (fun e' => f x e') e| ≤ B ∧ |deriv (fun e' => deriv (fun Y => f Y e') x) e| ≤ B ∧ HasDerivAt (fun e' => f x e') (deriv (fun e' => f x e') e) e ∧ HasDerivAt (fun e' => deriv (fun Y => f Y e') x) (deriv (fun e' => deriv (fun Y => f Y e') x) e) e) ∧ (∀ e : ℝ, c ≤ e → e ≤ d → ContinuousOn (fun Y => f Y e) (Icc a b) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun Y => deriv (fun Y' => f Y' e) Y) (Icc a b) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun Y => deriv (fun e' => f Y e') e) (Icc a b) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun Y => deriv (fun e' => deriv (fun Y' => f Y' e') Y) e) (Icc a b)) := by
    intro f S a b c d hS hF hK
    set F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := ↿f with hFdef
    have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fderiv ℝ F) S := hF.fderiv_of_isOpen hS (by norm_num)
    set g1 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => fderiv ℝ F p ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) with hg1def
    set g2 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => fderiv ℝ F p ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) with hg2def
    have hg1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 g1 S := hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const

    (fun y e hy0 hyX he1 he2 => by

    (G X η) (V X η) (profRadAvg V X η) (profEtaD (profRadAvg V) X η)
    (profRadInt V X η) (profEtaD (profRadInt V) X η)
    (profRadInt (fun y e => V y e ^ 2 - y * G y e ^ 2) X η)
    (profEtaD (profRadInt (fun y e => V y e ^ 2 - y * G y e ^ 2)) X η)
    (axPi Pax G X η) (profEtaD (axPi Pax G) X η)

by

    calc 4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 / 2) < 4 / Λ * (41 / 40) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hE hX0

    intro x hx

        · exact ⟨⟨by linarith [h.1], by linarith [h.2]⟩, he1, he2⟩
      have hcurve : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => (s, e)) := continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const
      have hfd' : ContinuousOn (fun p => fderiv ℝ f p (0, 1)) (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
        (hf.1.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hΩo (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
      exact ⟨hf.1.continuousOn.comp hcurve.continuousOn hmaps,
        hfd'.comp hcurve.continuousOn hmaps⟩
    · intro s e hs1 hs2 he1 he2
      have hmem : (s, e) ∈ Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨⟨hs1, hs2⟩, he1, he2⟩
      have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (s, e) :=
        (hf.1.contDiffAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hc : HasDerivAt (fun e' : ℝ => (s, e')) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) e :=
        (hasDerivAt_const e s).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' e)
      exact hfd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt e hc
  
  have dom : ∀ (x e0 M : ℝ) (G G' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), -1 < e0 → e0 < 1 →
      (∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → ContinuousOn (G e) (Set.uIcc x0 x)) →
      ContinuousOn (G' e0) (Set.uIcc x0 x) →
      (∀ e s : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → s ∈ Set.uIcc x0 x →
        HasDerivAt (fun e' => G e' s) (G' e s) e ∧ |G' e s| ≤ M) →
      HasDerivAt (fun e => ∫ s in x0..x, G e s) (∫ s in x0..x, G' e0 s) e0 := by
    intro x e0 M G G' h1 h2 hcont hcont' h
    have := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (a := x0) (b := x) (F := G) (F' := G') (x₀ := e0)
      (bound := fun _ => M) (Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2)
      (Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2) (fun e he =>
        ((hcont e he.1 he.2).mono Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc))
      ((hcont e0 h1 h2).intervalIntegrable)
      ((hcont'.mono Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc)
      (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun t ht e he => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact (h e t he.1 he.2 (Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc ht)).2))
      intervalIntegrable_const
      (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun t ht e he => (h e t he.1 he.2 (Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc ht)).1))
    exact this.2
  
  have prim : ∀ (M : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn g (Set.uIcc x0 X) →
      (∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc x0 X, |g s| ≤ M) →
      ContinuousOn (fun x => ∫ s in x0..x, g s) (Set.uIcc x0 X) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc x0 X, |∫ s in x0..x, g s| ≤ M * |X - x0| := by
    intro M g hg hb
    refine ⟨intervalIntegral.continuousOn_primitive_interval hg.integrableOn_uIcc,
      fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have hsub : Set.uIcc x0 x ⊆ Set.uIcc x0 X := Set.uIcc_subset_uIcc Set.left_mem_uIcc hx
    have hM : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hb x0 Set.left_mem_uIcc)
    have h1 := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := x0) (b := x) (C := M)
      (f := g) (fun t ht => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hb t (hsub (Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc ht)))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Set.abs_sub_left_of_mem_uIcc hx) hM)
  
  have hI : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc x0 X, a < s ∧ s < b := by
    intro s hs
    rcases Set.mem_uIcc.mp hs with h | h
    · exact ⟨by linarith [h.1], by linarith [h.2]⟩
    · exact ⟨by linarith [h.1], by linarith [h.2]⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨Mψ, hMψ0, hMψ⟩, sψ, -⟩ := slice _ gψ
  obtain ⟨⟨Mc, hMc0, hMc⟩, sc, dc⟩ := slice _ gc
  obtain ⟨⟨Mβ, hMβ0, hMβ⟩, sβ, dβ⟩ := slice _ gβ
  have hψc : ContinuousOn ψ (Set.uIcc x0 X) := (sψ 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).1
  have hψb : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc x0 X, |ψ s| ≤ Mψ := fun s hs =>
    (hMψ (s, 0) ⟨hI s hs, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩).1
  have mem : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc x0 X, ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 →
      (s, e) ∈ Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
    fun s hs e h1 h2 => ⟨hI s hs, h1, h2⟩
  have gcont : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 →
      ContinuousOn (fun s => ψ s * β (s, e)) (Set.uIcc x0 X) :=
    fun e h1 h2 => hψc.mul (sβ e h1 h2).1
  have g'cont : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 →
      ContinuousOn (fun s => ψ s * fderiv ℝ β (s, e) (0, 1)) (Set.uIcc x0 X) :=
    fun e h1 h2 => hψc.mul (sβ e h1 h2).2
  have gb : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc x0 X, |ψ s * β (s, e)| ≤ Mψ * Mβ := by
    intro e h1 h2 s hs
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (hψb s hs) (hMβ _ (mem s hs e h1 h2)).1 (abs_nonneg _) hMψ0
  have g'b : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc x0 X,
      |ψ s * fderiv ℝ β (s, e) (0, 1)| ≤ Mψ * Mβ := by
    intro e h1 h2 s hs
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (hψb s hs) (hMβ _ (mem s hs e h1 h2)).2 (abs_nonneg _) hMψ0
  have Φfacts : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 →
      ContinuousOn (fun x => ∫ s in x0..x, ψ s * β (s, e)) (Set.uIcc x0 X) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc x0 X, |∫ s in x0..x, ψ s * β (s, e)| ≤ Mψ * Mβ * |X - x0|) :=
    fun e h1 h2 => prim _ _ (gcont e h1 h2) (gb e h1 h2)
  have Φηfacts : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 →
      ContinuousOn (fun x => ∫ s in x0..x, ψ s * fderiv ℝ β (s, e) (0, 1)) (Set.uIcc x0 X) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc x0 X,
        |∫ s in x0..x, ψ s * fderiv ℝ β (s, e) (0, 1)| ≤ Mψ * Mβ * |X - x0|) :=
    fun e h1 h2 => prim _ _ (g'cont e h1 h2) (g'b e h1 h2)
  have hinner : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc x0 X, ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 →
      HasDerivAt (fun e' => ∫ s in x0..x, ψ s * β (s, e'))
        (∫ s in x0..x, ψ s * fderiv ℝ β (s, e) (0, 1)) e := by
    intro x hx e h1 h2
    have hsub : Set.uIcc x0 x ⊆ Set.uIcc x0 X := Set.uIcc_subset_uIcc Set.left_mem_uIcc hx
    exact dom x e (Mψ * Mβ) (fun e' s => ψ s * β (s, e'))
      (fun e' s => ψ s * fderiv ℝ β (s, e') (0, 1)) h1 h2
      (fun e' h1' h2' => (gcont e' h1' h2').mono hsub) ((g'cont e h1 h2).mono hsub)
      (fun e' s h1' h2' hs =>
        ⟨(dβ s e' (hI s (hsub hs)).1 (hI s (hsub hs)).2 h1' h2').const_mul (ψ s),
          g'b e' h1' h2' s (hsub hs)⟩)
  have hout := dom X η (Mc * (Mψ * Mβ * |X - x0|) + Mc * (Mψ * Mβ * |X - x0|))
    (fun e x => c (x, e) * ∫ s in x0..x, ψ s * β (s, e))
    (fun e x => fderiv ℝ c (x, e) (0, 1) * (∫ s in x0..x, ψ s * β (s, e)) +
       c (x, e) * ∫ s in x0..x, ψ s * fderiv ℝ β (s, e) (0, 1)) hη1 hη2
    (fun e h1 h2 => (sc e h1 h2).1.mul (Φfacts e h1 h2).1)
    (((sc η hη1 hη2).2.mul (Φfacts η hη1 hη2).1).add
      ((sc η hη1 hη2).1.mul (Φηfacts η hη1 hη2).1))
    (fun e x h1 h2 hx => ⟨(dc x e (hI x hx).1 (hI x hx).2 h1 h2).mul (hinner x hx e h1 h2), by
      have hp := hMc _ (mem x hx e h1 h2)
      have hΦ := (Φfacts e h1 h2).2 x hx
      have hΦη := (Φηfacts e h1 h2).2 x hx
      show |fderiv ℝ c (x, e) (0, 1) * (∫ s in x0..x, ψ s * β (s, e)) +
        c (x, e) * ∫ s in x0..x, ψ s * fderiv ℝ β (s, e) (0, 1)| ≤ _
      refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul hp.2 hΦ (abs_nonneg _) hMc0)
        (mul_le_mul hp.1 hΦη (abs_nonneg _) hMc0)⟩)
  have hsplit := intervalIntegral.integral_add (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (a := x0) (b := X)
    ((sc η hη1 hη2).2.mul (Φfacts η hη1 hη2).1).intervalIntegrable
    ((sc η hη1 hη2).1.mul (Φηfacts η hη1 hη2).1).intervalIntegrable
  exact hout.congr_deriv hsplit

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (a b x0 : ℝ) (c : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), a < x0 → x0 < b → osbGood (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) c → osbGood (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in x0..p.1, c (s, p.2)) ∧ ∀ X η : ℝ, a < X → X < b → -1 < η → η < 1 → HasDerivAt (fun Y => ∫ s in x0..Y, c (s, η)) (c (X, η)) X ∧ HasDerivAt (fun e => ∫ s in x0..X, c (s, e)) (∫ s in x0..X, deriv (fun e => c (s, e)) η) η

signature.name: ax_param_prim
signature.statement: ∀ (a b x0 : ℝ) (c : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), a < x0 → x0 < b → osbGood (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) c → osbGood (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in x0..p.1, c (s, p.2)) ∧ ∀ X η : ℝ, a < X → X < b → -1 < η → η < 1 → HasDerivAt (fun Y => ∫ s in x0..Y, c (s, η)) (c (X, η)) X ∧ HasDerivAt (fun e => ∫ s in x0..X, c (s, e)) (∫ s in x0..X, deriv (fun e => c (s, e)) η) η

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have pd : ∀ (lo hi x0 : ℝ), lo < x0 → x0 < hi → ∀ (c : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ∀ (C1 : ℝ),
      (∀ z ∈ Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 c z‖ ≤ C1) →
      ∀ p ∈ Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in x0..q.1, c (s, q.2))
        ((∫ s in x0..p.1, fderiv ℝ c (s, p.2) (0, 1)) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ
          + c p • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) p := by
    intro lo hi x0 hax hxb c hc C1 hC1
    have hUo : IsOpen (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hcc : ContinuousOn c (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := hc.continuousOn
    have hsl : ∀ e ∈ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, ContinuousOn (fun s => c (s, e)) (Ioo lo hi) := by
      intro e he
      exact hcc.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn (fun s hs => ⟨hs, he⟩)
    have hsub : ∀ x ∈ Ioo lo hi, ∀ y ∈ Ioo lo hi, uIcc x y ⊆ Ioo lo hi :=
      fun x hx y hy => ordConnected_Ioo.uIcc_subset hx hy
    have hii : ∀ e ∈ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ Ioo lo hi, ∀ y ∈ Ioo lo hi,
        IntervalIntegrable (fun s => c (s, e)) volume x y :=
      fun e he x hx y hy => ((hsl e he).mono (hsub x hx y hy)).intervalIntegrable
    have hx0 : x0 ∈ Ioo lo hi := ⟨hax, hxb⟩
    rintro ⟨X, e0⟩ ⟨hX, he0⟩
    have hfd : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ c) (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
      hc.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hUo (by simp)
    have hdiff : ∀ z ∈ Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, HasFDerivAt c (fderiv ℝ c z) z := fun z hz =>
      (((hc.differentiableOn (by simp)) z hz).differentiableAt (hUo.mem_nhds hz)).hasFDerivAt
    have hn01 : ‖((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖ = 1 := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
    have hG : HasDerivAt (fun e => ∫ s in x0..X, c (s, e))
        (∫ s in x0..X, fderiv ℝ c (s, e0) (0, 1)) e0 := by
      have hUI : uIoc x0 X ⊆ Ioo lo hi := uIoc_subset_uIcc.trans (hsub x0 hx0 X hX)
      have := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (μ := volume)
        (a := x0) (b := X) (F := fun e s => c (s, e)) (F' := fun e s => fderiv ℝ c (s, e) (0, 1))
        (x₀ := e0) (bound := fun _ => C1) (s := Ioo (-1) 1) (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds he0) ?_
        (hii e0 he0 x0 hx0 X hX) ?_ ?_ intervalIntegrable_const ?_
      · exact this.2
      · filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds he0] with e he
        exact ((hsl e he).mono hUI).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
      · have hco : ContinuousOn (fun s => fderiv ℝ c (s, e0) (0, 1)) (Ioo lo hi) :=
          (hfd.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
            (fun s hs => ⟨hs, he0⟩)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
        exact (hco.mono hUI).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht e he => ?_)
        have hz : (t, e) ∈ Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨hUI ht, he⟩
        calc ‖fderiv ℝ c (t, e) (0, 1)‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ c (t, e)‖ * ‖((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖ :=
              ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
          _ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 c (t, e)‖ := by rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_one, hn01, mul_one]
          _ ≤ C1 := hC1 _ hz
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht e he => ?_)
        have hz : (t, e) ∈ Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨hUI ht, he⟩
        exact (hdiff _ hz).comp_hasDerivAt e ((hasDerivAt_const e t).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' e))
    have hH : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in X..q.1, c (s, q.2))
        (c (X, e0) • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) (X, e0) := by
      rw [hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
      intro ε hε
      have hcont : ContinuousAt c (X, e0) := hcc.continuousAt (hUo.mem_nhds ⟨hX, he0⟩)
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδc⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hcont ε hε
      obtain ⟨δ', hδ', hδU⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hUo (X, e0) ⟨hX, he0⟩
      filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℝ × ℝ) (lt_min hδ hδ')] with h hh
      have hh' : ‖h‖ < min δ δ' := by simpa using hh
      have hpt : ∀ s ∈ uIcc X (X + h.1), (s, e0 + h.2) ∈ Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ∧
          ‖c (s, e0 + h.2) - c (X, e0)‖ ≤ ε := by
        intro s hs
        have h1 : |s - X| ≤ |h.1| := by
          have := abs_sub_left_of_mem_uIcc hs
          simpa using this
        have h1' : |h.1| ≤ ‖h‖ := by
          have := norm_fst_le h
          rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
        have h2' : |h.2| ≤ ‖h‖ := by
          have := norm_snd_le h
          rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
        have hd : dist (s, e0 + h.2) (X, e0) < min δ δ' := by
          rw [Prod.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
          rw [show e0 + h.2 - e0 = h.2 by ring]
          exact max_lt (by linarith) (by linarith)
        refine ⟨hδU (Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le hd (min_le_right _ _))), ?_⟩
        have := hδc (lt_of_lt_of_le hd (min_le_left _ _))
        rw [dist_eq_norm] at this
        exact this.le
      have hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => c (s, e0 + h.2)) volume X (X + h.1) :=
        (hcc.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
          (fun s hs => (hpt s hs).1)).intervalIntegrable
      simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, intervalIntegral.integral_same, sub_zero,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', smul_eq_mul]
      have hconst : c (X, e0) * h.1 = ∫ s in X..X + h.1, c (X, e0) := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]; ring
      rw [hconst, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub hint intervalIntegrable_const]
      calc ‖∫ s in X..X + h.1, (c (s, e0 + h.2) - c (X, e0))‖ ≤ ε * |X + h.1 - X| :=
            intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
              (fun s hs => (hpt s (uIoc_subset_uIcc hs)).2)
        _ ≤ ε * ‖h‖ := by
            rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
            have := norm_fst_le h
            rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this hε.le
    have hEq : (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in x0..q.1, c (s, q.2)) =ᶠ[nhds (X, e0)]
        fun q => ((fun e => ∫ s in x0..X, c (s, e)) ∘ Prod.snd) q + ∫ s in X..q.1, c (s, q.2) := by
      filter_upwards [hUo.mem_nhds ⟨hX, he0⟩] with q hq
      exact (intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hii q.2 hq.2 x0 hx0 X hX)
        (hii q.2 hq.2 X hX q.1 hq.1)).symm
    have hsnd : HasFDerivAt (Prod.snd : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) (X, e0) :=
      hasFDerivAt_snd
    have hGs := HasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt (X, e0) hG hsnd
    exact (hGs.add hH).congr_of_eventuallyEq hEq
  
  have pp : ∀ (lo hi x0 : ℝ), lo < x0 → x0 < hi →
      (∀ f, osbGood (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) f →
        osbGood (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)
          (fun p => fderiv ℝ f p (0, 1))) →
      ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ c : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, osbGood (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) c →
        ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in x0..q.1, c (s, q.2)) (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) ∧
        ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in x0..q.1, c (s, q.2)) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro lo hi x0 hax hxb hpart n
    have hUo : IsOpen (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro c hc
      obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hc.2 1
      obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := hc.2 0
      have hD := pd lo hi x0 hax hxb c hc.1 C1 hC1
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Nat.cast_zero, contDiffOn_zero]
        exact fun z hz => (hD z hz).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      · refine ⟨|C0| * (hi - lo), fun z hz => ?_⟩
        rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]
        have hb : ∀ s ∈ uIoc x0 z.1, ‖c (s, z.2)‖ ≤ |C0| := fun s hs => by
          have hs' : s ∈ Ioo lo hi :=
            (uIoc_subset_uIcc.trans (ordConnected_Ioo.uIcc_subset ⟨hax, hxb⟩ hz.1)) hs
          have := hC0 (s, z.2) ⟨hs', hz.2⟩
          rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] at this
          exact this.trans (le_abs_self _)
        calc ‖∫ s in x0..z.1, c (s, z.2)‖ ≤ |C0| * |z.1 - x0| :=
              intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hb
          _ ≤ |C0| * (hi - lo) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (abs_nonneg _)
            rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [hz.1.1, hz.1.2]
    | succ n ih =>
      intro c hc
      obtain ⟨ih1, Cp, hCp⟩ := ih (fun p => fderiv ℝ c p (0, 1)) (hpart c hc)
      obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hc.2 1
      obtain ⟨Cn, hCn⟩ := hc.2 n
      have hD := pd lo hi x0 hax hxb c hc.1 C1 hC1
      let A : ℝ →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).smulRight (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)
      let B : ℝ →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).smulRight (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ)
      let Pc' := fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in x0..q.1, fderiv ℝ c (s, q.2) (0, 1)
      have hcn : ContDiffOn ℝ n c (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := contDiffOn_infty.mp hc.1 n
      have hA : ContDiffOn ℝ n (⇑A ∘ Pc') (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
        A.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn ih1
      have hB : ContDiffOn ℝ n (⇑B ∘ c) (Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
        B.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hcn
      have hR : ∀ p ∈ Ioo lo hi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
          fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in x0..q.1, c (s, q.2)) p = ((⇑A ∘ Pc') + (⇑B ∘ c)) p := by
        intro p hp
        rw [(hD p hp).fderiv]
        simp [A, B, Pc']
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [show ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) = (n : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 by push_cast; rfl]
        rw [contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hUo]
        exact ⟨fun p hp => (hD p hp).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt,
          fun h => absurd h (by simp), (hA.add hB).congr hR⟩
      · refine ⟨‖A‖ * Cp + ‖B‖ * Cn, fun z hz => ?_⟩
        rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
        have hev : fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in x0..q.1, c (s, q.2)) =ᶠ[nhds z]
            ((⇑A ∘ Pc') + (⇑B ∘ c)) := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hz) hR
        rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ n).eq_of_nhds]
        have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ n Pc' z := ih1.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hz)
        have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ n c z := hcn.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hz)
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (A.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp z h1)
          (B.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp z h2)]
        calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (⇑A ∘ Pc') z‖ + ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (⇑B ∘ c) z‖ :=
              norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ ‖A‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n Pc' z‖ + ‖B‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n c z‖ :=
              add_le_add (A.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left h1 le_rfl)
                (B.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left h2 le_rfl)
          _ ≤ ‖A‖ * Cp + ‖B‖ * Cn :=
              add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hCp z hz) (norm_nonneg A))
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hCn z hz) (norm_nonneg B))
  intro a b x0 c hax hxb hc
  have hUo : IsOpen (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hUb : Bornology.IsBounded (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
    (Metric.isBounded_Ioo _ _).prod (Metric.isBounded_Ioo _ _)
  have hpart : ∀ f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, osbGood (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) f →
      osbGood (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (fun p => fderiv ℝ f p (0, 1)) := by
    intro f hf
    unfold osbGood at hf ⊢
    let L : (ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))
    have heq : (fun p => fderiv ℝ f p (0, 1)) = ⇑L ∘ fderiv ℝ f := by funext p; rfl
    refine ⟨?_, fun m => ?_⟩
    · rw [heq]
      exact L.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (hf.1.fderiv_of_isOpen hUo (by simp))
    · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hf.2 (m + 1)
      refine ⟨‖L‖ * C, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      rw [heq]
      have hfa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f z := hf.1.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hz)
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ m (fderiv ℝ f) z := hfa.fderiv_right (by simp)
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (⇑L ∘ fderiv ℝ f) z‖
          ≤ ‖L‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fderiv ℝ f) z‖ := L.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left h1 le_rfl
        _ = ‖L‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f z‖ := by rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
        _ ≤ ‖L‖ * C := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC z hz) (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg L)
  have hPP := pp a b x0 hax hxb hpart
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold osbGood
    exact ⟨contDiffOn_infty.mpr (fun n => (hPP n c hc).1), fun m => (hPP m c hc).2⟩
  · intro X η h1 h2 h3 h4
    obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hc.2 1
    have hF := pd a b x0 hax hxb c hc.1 C1 hC1 (X, η) ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, ⟨h3, h4⟩⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have hl : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, η)) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) X :=
        (hasDerivAt_id' X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X η)
      refine (hF.comp_hasDerivAt X hl).congr_deriv ?_
      simp
    · have hl' : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => (X, e)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) η :=
        (hasDerivAt_const η X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' η)
      have hI : (∫ s in x0..X, fderiv ℝ c (s, η) (0, 1)) =
          ∫ s in x0..X, deriv (fun e => c (s, e)) η := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro s hs
        have hsI : s ∈ Ioo a b := ordConnected_Ioo.uIcc_subset ⟨hax, hxb⟩ ⟨h1, h2⟩ hs
        have hz : (s, η) ∈ Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨hsI, h3, h4⟩
        have hdc : HasFDerivAt c (fderiv ℝ c (s, η)) (s, η) :=
          (((hc.1.differentiableOn (by simp)) _ hz).differentiableAt (hUo.mem_nhds hz)).hasFDerivAt
        have hs' : HasDerivAt (fun e => c (s, e)) (fderiv ℝ c (s, η) (0, 1)) η :=
          hdc.comp_hasDerivAt η ((hasDerivAt_const η s).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' η))
        exact hs'.deriv.symm
      rw [← hI]
      refine (hF.comp_hasDerivAt η hl').congr_deriv ?_
      simp

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (a c a' c' : ℝ) (U V : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), a' < a → c < c' → IsOpen U → Bornology.IsBounded U → IsOpen V → U ⊆ Ioo a c ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) → (∀ z ∈ U, (g z.1, z.2) ∈ V) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Ioo a' c') → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ V, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F z‖ ≤ C) → osbGood U U (fun z => F (g z.1, z.2))

signature.name: osb_chart_comp
signature.statement: ∀ (a c a' c' : ℝ) (U V : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), a' < a → c < c' → IsOpen U → Bornology.IsBounded U → IsOpen V → U ⊆ Ioo a c ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) → (∀ z ∈ U, (g z.1, z.2) ∈ V) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Ioo a' c') → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ V, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F z‖ ≤ C) → osbGood U U (fun z => F (g z.1, z.2))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro a c a' c' U V g F ha hc hU hUb hV hsub hmaps hg hF hFb
  have hO : IsOpen (Ioo a' c' ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ
  have hΘ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (g z.1, z.2)) (Ioo a' c' ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) :=
    (hg.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz.1)).prodMk contDiff_snd.contDiffOn
  have hUO : U ⊆ Ioo a' c' ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) := by
    intro z hz
    have h := (hsub hz).1
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith [h.1], by linarith [h.2]⟩, mem_univ _⟩
  have hle : ∀ i : ℕ, ((i : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := fun i => by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hK : IsCompact (closure U) := hUb.isCompact_closure
  have hKO : closure U ⊆ Ioo a' c' ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) := by
    have h1 : closure U ⊆ Icc a c ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) :=
      closure_minimal (hsub.trans (prod_mono Ioo_subset_Icc_self subset_rfl))
        (isClosed_Icc.prod isClosed_univ)
    intro z hz
    have h := (h1 hz).1
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith [h.1], by linarith [h.2]⟩, mem_univ _⟩
  have hBd : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ U,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (g z.1, z.2)) z‖ ≤ B := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      ((hΘ.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (hle i) hO.uniqueDiffOn).mono hKO)
    refine ⟨B, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO (hUO hz)]
    exact hB z (subset_closure hz)
  choose Bf hBf using hBd
  choose Cf hCf using hFb
  have hmaps' : MapsTo (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (g z.1, z.2)) U V := fun z hz => hmaps z hz
  refine ⟨hF.comp (hΘ.mono hUO) hmaps', ?_⟩
  intro m
  refine ⟨(m.factorial : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Cf i|) *
    (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Bf i|) ^ m, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  have hD1 : 1 ≤ 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Bf i| := by
    have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1)) => abs_nonneg (Bf i))
    linarith
  have hFz : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i F V ((fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (g z.1, z.2)) z)‖ ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Cf i| := by
    intro i hi
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hV (hmaps z hz)]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F (g z.1, z.2)‖ ≤ Cf i := hCf i _ (hmaps z hz)
      _ ≤ |Cf i| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cf i|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg (Cf j))
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  have hΘz : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m →
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (g z.1, z.2)) U z‖ ≤
        (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Bf i|) ^ i := by
    intro i hi1 him
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hU hz]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (g z.1, z.2)) z‖ ≤ Bf i := hBf i z hz
      _ ≤ |Bf i| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Bf j| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Bf i|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg (Bf j))
            (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
      _ ≤ 1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Bf j| := by linarith
      _ ≤ _ := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
  have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hF (hΘ.mono hUO) (hle m) hV.uniqueDiffOn
    hU.uniqueDiffOn hmaps' hz hFz hΘz
  rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hU hz] at key
  exact key

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (Λ t1 κ0 X : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Λ → 0 < t1 → 4 / Λ < X → (∫ s in (4 / Λ)..X, axEa Λ t1 κ0 s * f s) = (1 - κ0) * (t1 / 2) * Real.exp (-1 / (axLogY Λ X / t1) ^ 2) * ∫ τ in Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-τ) * ((axLogY Λ X / t1 / Real.sqrt (1 + (axLogY Λ X / t1) ^ 2 * τ)) ^ 3 * collarG (axLogY Λ X / t1 / Real.sqrt (1 + (axLogY Λ X / t1) ^ 2 * τ)) * (4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 * (axLogY Λ X / t1 / Real.sqrt (1 + (axLogY Λ X / t1) ^ 2 * τ)))) * f (4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 * (axLogY Λ X / t1 / Real.sqrt (1 + (axLogY Λ X / t1) ^ 2 * τ)))))

signature.name: flat_div_subst
signature.statement: ∀ (Λ t1 κ0 X : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Λ → 0 < t1 → 4 / Λ < X → (∫ s in (4 / Λ)..X, axEa Λ t1 κ0 s * f s) = (1 - κ0) * (t1 / 2) * Real.exp (-1 / (axLogY Λ X / t1) ^ 2) * ∫ τ in Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-τ) * ((axLogY Λ X / t1 / Real.sqrt (1 + (axLogY Λ X / t1) ^ 2 * τ)) ^ 3 * collarG (axLogY Λ X / t1 / Real.sqrt (1 + (axLogY Λ X / t1) ^ 2 * τ)) * (4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 * (axLogY Λ X / t1 / Real.sqrt (1 + (axLogY Λ X / t1) ^ 2 * τ)))) * f (4 / Λ * Real.exp (t1 * (axLogY Λ X / t1 / Real.sqrt (1 + (axLogY Λ X / t1) ^ 2 * τ)))))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Λ t1 κ0 X f hΛ ht1 hX
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : ℝ, w = axLogY Λ X / t1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hw]
  set X0 : ℝ := 4 / Λ with hX0def
  have hX0 : 0 < X0 := div_pos (by norm_num) hΛ
  have hXpos : 0 < X := lt_trans hX0 hX
  have hXL : 1 < X * Λ / 4 := by
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 4)]
    have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hX hΛ
    have h4 : 4 / Λ * Λ = 4 := by field_simp
    rw [hX0def] at h1
    linarith
  have hlogpos : 0 < axLogY Λ X := by unfold axLogY; exact Real.log_pos hXL
  have hw0 : 0 < w := by rw [hw]; exact div_pos hlogpos ht1
  have hwne : w ≠ 0 := hw0.ne'
  have ht1ne : t1 ≠ 0 := ht1.ne'
  have hXe : X0 * Real.exp (t1 * w) = X := by
    have e : t1 * w = axLogY Λ X := by rw [hw]; field_simp
    rw [e]
    unfold axLogY
    rw [Real.exp_log (by linarith), hX0def]
    field_simp
  have hS : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → 1 < Real.sqrt (1 + w ^ 2 * τ) ∧
      Real.sqrt (1 + w ^ 2 * τ) ^ 2 = 1 + w ^ 2 * τ := by
    intro τ hτ
    have h1 : 0 < w ^ 2 * τ := by positivity
    refine ⟨?_, Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)⟩
    calc (1:ℝ) = Real.sqrt 1 := Real.sqrt_one.symm
      _ < Real.sqrt (1 + w ^ 2 * τ) := Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ : ∃ χ : ℝ → ℝ, χ = fun τ => X0 * Real.exp (t1 * (w / Real.sqrt (1 + w ^ 2 * τ))) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have himg : χ '' Ioi 0 = Ioo X0 X := by
    ext s
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨τ, hτ, rfl⟩
      have hτ' : (0:ℝ) < τ := hτ
      obtain ⟨hS1, -⟩ := hS τ hτ'
      have hV0 : 0 < w / Real.sqrt (1 + w ^ 2 * τ) := div_pos hw0 (by linarith)
      have hVw : w / Real.sqrt (1 + w ^ 2 * τ) < w := div_lt_self hw0 hS1
      rw [hχ]
      constructor
      · show X0 < X0 * Real.exp (t1 * (w / Real.sqrt (1 + w ^ 2 * τ)))
        have : 1 < Real.exp (t1 * (w / Real.sqrt (1 + w ^ 2 * τ))) := by
          have h := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (mul_pos ht1 hV0); rwa [Real.exp_zero] at h
        nlinarith
      · show X0 * Real.exp (t1 * (w / Real.sqrt (1 + w ^ 2 * τ))) < X
        rw [← hXe]
        apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left _ hX0
        exact Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hVw ht1)
    · rintro ⟨hs1, hs2⟩
      have hspos : 0 < s := lt_trans hX0 hs1
      have hsX0 : 1 < s / X0 := by rw [lt_div_iff₀ hX0]; linarith
      obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩ : ∃ ℓ : ℝ, ℓ = Real.log (s / X0) / t1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hℓ0 : 0 < ℓ := by rw [hℓ]; exact div_pos (Real.log_pos hsX0) ht1
      have hℓne : ℓ ≠ 0 := hℓ0.ne'
      have htℓ : t1 * ℓ = Real.log (s / X0) := by rw [hℓ]; field_simp
      have hℓw : ℓ < w := by
        have h1 : Real.log (s / X0) < t1 * w := by
          rw [Real.log_lt_iff_lt_exp (by positivity), div_lt_iff₀ hX0]
          calc s < X := hs2
            _ = Real.exp (t1 * w) * X0 := by rw [← hXe]; ring
        rw [← htℓ] at h1
        exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left h1 ht1.le
      refine ⟨1 / ℓ ^ 2 - 1 / w ^ 2, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show 0 < 1 / ℓ ^ 2 - 1 / w ^ 2
        have : 1 / w ^ 2 < 1 / ℓ ^ 2 :=
          one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt (by positivity) (pow_lt_pow_left₀ hℓw hℓ0.le (by norm_num))
        linarith
      · rw [hχ]
        show X0 * Real.exp (t1 * (w / Real.sqrt (1 + w ^ 2 * (1 / ℓ ^ 2 - 1 / w ^ 2)))) = s
        have e1 : 1 + w ^ 2 * (1 / ℓ ^ 2 - 1 / w ^ 2) = (w / ℓ) ^ 2 := by field_simp; ring
        rw [e1, Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]
        have e2 : w / (w / ℓ) = ℓ := by field_simp
        rw [e2, htℓ, Real.exp_log (by positivity)]
        field_simp
  have hinj : InjOn χ (Ioi 0) := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    have ha' : (0:ℝ) < a := ha
    have hb' : (0:ℝ) < b := hb
    obtain ⟨hSa, hSa2⟩ := hS a ha'
    obtain ⟨hSb, hSb2⟩ := hS b hb'
    rw [hχ] at hab
    have h1 := mul_left_cancel₀ hX0.ne' hab
    have h2 := Real.exp_injective h1
    have h3 := mul_left_cancel₀ ht1ne h2
    rw [div_eq_div_iff (by linarith) (by linarith)] at h3
    have h4 := mul_left_cancel₀ hwne h3
    have h5 : 1 + w ^ 2 * a = 1 + w ^ 2 * b := by rw [← hSa2, ← hSb2, h4]
    have h6 : w ^ 2 * a = w ^ 2 * b := by linarith
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_pos hw0 2).ne' h6
  have hd : ∀ τ ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ), HasDerivWithinAt χ
      (-(χ τ * t1 * (w / Real.sqrt (1 + w ^ 2 * τ)) ^ 3 / 2)) (Ioi 0) τ := by
    intro τ hτ
    have hτ' : (0:ℝ) < τ := hτ
    obtain ⟨hS1, hS2⟩ := hS τ hτ'
    have hSpos : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 + w ^ 2 * τ) := by linarith
    have hk : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => 1 + w ^ 2 * x) (w ^ 2) τ := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id τ).const_mul (w ^ 2)).const_add 1
    have hsq : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.sqrt (1 + w ^ 2 * x))
        (w ^ 2 / (2 * Real.sqrt (1 + w ^ 2 * τ))) τ :=
      hk.sqrt (show (1:ℝ) + w ^ 2 * τ ≠ 0 by positivity)
    have hV := (hasDerivAt_const τ w).fun_div hsq hSpos.ne'
    have hE := ((hV.const_mul t1).exp).const_mul X0
    rw [hχ]
    apply HasDerivAt.hasDerivWithinAt
    convert hE using 1
    beta_reduce
    field_simp
    ring
  have hInt : (∫ s in X0..X, axEa Λ t1 κ0 s * f s) = ∫ s in χ '' Ioi 0, axEa Λ t1 κ0 s * f s := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hX.le, MeasureTheory.integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo, himg]
  rw [hInt, MeasureTheory.integral_image_eq_integral_abs_deriv_smul
    (f' := fun τ => -(χ τ * t1 * (w / Real.sqrt (1 + w ^ 2 * τ)) ^ 3 / 2)) measurableSet_Ioi hd hinj,
    ← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
  apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
  intro τ hτ
  beta_reduce
  have hτ' : (0:ℝ) < τ := hτ
  obtain ⟨hS1, hS2⟩ := hS τ hτ'

      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G0) (Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) (Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X η : ℝ, X ≤ 4 / Λ → G X η = G0 X η) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) (Ioi (-1 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    intro G G0 hG0 hG hEq
    apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    intro z hz
    have hz' := hz
    simp only [mem_prod, mem_Ioi, mem_Ioo] at hz'
    by_cases hz1 : z.1 < 4 / Λ
    · refine ⟨Ioo (-1 / Λ) (4 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1, isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [mem_prod, mem_Ioo]
        exact ⟨⟨hz'.1, hz1⟩, hz'.2⟩
      · refine (hG0.mono ?_).congr ?_
        · intro w hw
          simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_prod, mem_Ioi, mem_Ioo] at hw ⊢
          exact ⟨⟨hw.2.1.1, by linarith [hw.2.1.2]⟩, by linarith [hw.2.2.1], by linarith [hw.2.2.2]⟩
        · intro w hw
          simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_prod, mem_Ioi, mem_Ioo] at hw
          exact hEq w.1 w.2 hw.2.1.2.le
    · push_neg at hz1
      refine ⟨Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1, isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo, ?_, hG.mono inter_subset_right⟩
      simp only [mem_prod, mem_Ioi, mem_Ioo]
      exact ⟨by linarith, hz'.2⟩
  have c1 := hglue (axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un) Fn hA.1 hFsm
    (fun X η hX => by unfold axProfF; exact if_pos hX)
  have c2 := hglue (axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un) Un hA.2.1 hUsm
    (fun X η hX => by unfold axProfU; exact if_pos hX)
  
  have hpd : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen S → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) S →

    intro f S hS hf

      (hasDerivAt_id z.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const z.1 z.2)
    have hc := HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (l := ↿f) (f := fun Y : ℝ => (Y, z.2)) z.1

  have hS1 : IsOpen (Ioi (-1 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo

  have hdU := hpd _ _ hS1 hUrS
  have hVS : (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) ⊆ Ioi (-1 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) := by
    intro w hw
    simp only [mem_prod, mem_Ioi, mem_Ioo] at hw ⊢
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hFne : ∀ z ∈ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1), (↿(axRefF Λ t1 Fn)) z ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz

  have hFrV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axRefF Λ t1 Fn)) (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := hFrS.mono hVS
  have eΛ : -(1 / Λ) = -1 / Λ := by ring
  have hFrS' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axRefF Λ t1 Fn)) (Ioi (-(1 / Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    rw [eΛ]; exact hFrS.mono (prod_mono subset_rfl (Ioo_subset_Ioo (by linarith) (by linarith)))
  have hUrS' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axRefU Λ t1 Un)) (Ioi (-(1 / Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    rw [eΛ]; exact hUrS.mono (prod_mono subset_rfl (Ioo_subset_Ioo (by linarith) (by linarith)))
  have hFrP' : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η :=
    fun X η hX h1 h2 => hFrP X η hX (by linarith) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨hT1, hT2⟩ := ax_stress_smooth h (1 / Λ) Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) hh0
    (by linarith) (one_div_pos.mpr hΛ0) hFrS' hUrS' hFrP' hPaxO
  have idP : ∀ X η : ℝ, axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η ≠ 0 →
      psLead1 h (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) X η =
        leadStressTh h (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) X η / axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η +
        (-2 * X * deriv (fun Y => axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η) X) / axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η := by
    intro X η hF
    simp only [leadStressTh, shearA, psLead1]
    generalize X * leadQs h (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) X η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) = A
    generalize deriv (fun Y => axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y η) X = d
    generalize axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η = Fv at hF ⊢
    field_simp
    try ring
  have idN : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η ≠ 0 →
      X * axNs h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) X η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) =
        Real.sqrt (2 * X) * axTz h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) X η -
          2 * X * deriv (fun Y => axRefU Λ t1 Un Y η) X := by
    intro X η hX he1 he2 hF
    have hq : η ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith

    have hL : 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      have : 0 < 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 := by linarith
      exact this.ne'
    have hs : Real.sqrt (2 * X) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)).ne'
    have hss : Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Real.sqrt (2 * X) = 2 * X := Real.mul_self_sqrt (by linarith)
    simp only [axTz, axPs2, shearB]
    generalize axNs h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) X η = N
    generalize deriv (fun Y => axRefU Λ t1 Un Y η) X = d
    generalize axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η = Fv at hF ⊢
    generalize 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 = L at hL ⊢
    generalize Real.sqrt (2 * X) = s at hs hss ⊢
    rw [← hss]
    field_simp
    try ring
  have h2x : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * z.1) (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
    contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_fst
  have hm2x : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => -2 * z.1) (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
    contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_fst
  have c4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(psLead1 h (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un)))
      (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    have hA1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ =>
        leadStressTh h (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) z.1 z.2 / axRefF Λ t1 Fn z.1 z.2)
        (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := hT1.div hFrV hFne
    have hA2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ =>
        (-2 * z.1 * deriv (fun Y => axRefF Λ t1 Fn Y z.2) z.1) / axRefF Λ t1 Fn z.1 z.2)
        (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := (hm2x.mul (hdF.mono hVS)).div hFrV hFne
    refine (hA1.add hA2).congr ?_
    intro z hz
    exact idP z.1 z.2 (hFne z hz)
  have c5 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ =>
      z.1 * axNs h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) z.1 z.2 / (1 - 2 * h * z.2 ^ 2))
      (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    have hsq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * z.1)) (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
      h2x.sqrt (fun z hz => by
        simp only [mem_prod, mem_Ioi, mem_Ioo] at hz
        exact (by linarith [hz.1] : (0:ℝ) < 2 * z.1).ne')
    have hB1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ =>
        Real.sqrt (2 * z.1) * axTz h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) z.1 z.2)
        (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := hsq.mul hT2
    have hB2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ =>
        2 * z.1 * deriv (fun Y => axRefU Λ t1 Un Y z.2) z.1)
        (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := h2x.mul (hdU.mono hVS)
    refine (hB1.sub hB2).congr ?_
    intro z hz
    have hz' := hz
    simp only [mem_prod, mem_Ioi, mem_Ioo] at hz'
    exact idN z.1 z.2 hz'.1 hz'.2.1 hz'.2.2 (hFne z hz)
  
  have c6 : ∀ X η : ℝ, 4 / Λ < X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      HasDerivAt (fun Y => axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un Y η)
        (-(1 / 2) * axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un (axLogY Λ X) η * axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un X η / X) X ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun Y => axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un Y η)
        (axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un (axLogY Λ X) η / X) X := by
    intro X η hX he1 he2
    obtain ⟨hcA, hcB⟩ := hCont η he1 he2
    have hX0 : 0 < X := lt_trans h4pos hX
    have hXne : X ≠ 0 := hX0.ne'
    have hℓ : HasDerivAt (fun Y => axLogY Λ Y) (1 / X) X := by
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => Y * Λ / 4) (1 * Λ / 4) X :=
        ((hasDerivAt_id X).mul_const Λ).div_const 4
      have h2 := h1.log (div_pos (mul_pos hX0 hΛ0) (by norm_num)).ne'
      unfold axLogY
      convert h2 using 1
      field_simp
    have hΦ : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun v => ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..v, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η)
        (axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un u η) u := fun u =>
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hcA.intervalIntegrable 0 u)
        (hcA.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter _ _) hcA.continuousAt
    have hΨ : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun v => ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..v, axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η)
        (axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un u η) u := fun u =>
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hcB.intervalIntegrable 0 u)
        (hcB.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter _ _) hcB.continuousAt
    have hcF := (hΦ (axLogY Λ X)).comp X hℓ
    have hG := ((hcF.const_mul (-(1 / 2))).exp).const_mul (Fn (4 / Λ) η)
    have hevF : (fun Y => axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X]
        (fun Y => Fn (4 / Λ) η * Real.exp (-(1 / 2) *
          ((fun v => ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..v, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η) ∘
            (fun Y => axLogY Λ Y)) Y)) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hX] with Y hY
      unfold axProfF
      rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr hY)]
      rfl
    have hFX : axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un X η = Fn (4 / Λ) η *
        Real.exp (-(1 / 2) * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ X, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η) := by
      unfold axProfF
      rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr hX)]
    have hcU := (hΨ (axLogY Λ X)).comp X hℓ
    have hH := hcU.const_add (Un (4 / Λ) η)
    have hevU : (fun Y => axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X]
        (fun Y => Un (4 / Λ) η +
          ((fun v => ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..v, axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η) ∘
            (fun Y => axLogY Λ Y)) Y) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hX] with Y hY
      unfold axProfU
      rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr hY)]
      rfl
    refine ⟨(hG.congr_of_eventuallyEq hevF).congr_deriv ?_,
      (hH.congr_of_eventuallyEq hevU).congr_deriv ?_⟩
    · rw [hFX]
      try simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      ring
    · try simp only [Function.comp_apply]

  have c7 := (ax_ref_regular Λ t1 ρ1 Fn Un hΛ ht1 ht1' hρ1 hA.1 hA.2.1 hA.2.2.1).2.2.2.2.1
  
  have c8 : ∀ X η : ℝ, 100 * Real.exp om ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un X η = axProfU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un (100 * Real.exp om) η ∧
      axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un X η = axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un (100 * Real.exp om) η *
        Real.exp (-(2 / 5) * Real.log (X / (100 * Real.exp om))) := by
    intro X η hX he1 he2
    obtain ⟨hcA, hcB⟩ := hCont η he1 he2
    obtain ⟨XI, hXI⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = 100 * Real.exp om := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hXI] at hX ⊢

      have := Real.one_le_exp hom.le

    have h4 : 4 / Λ ≤ 4 := div_le_self (by norm_num) hΛ

    have hyI : axLogY Λ XI = Real.log (25 * Λ) + om := by
      unfold axLogY

        Real.log_mul (mul_pos (by norm_num) hΛ0).ne' (Real.exp_pos om).ne', Real.log_exp]

      unfold axLogY

        (div_pos (mul_pos hXI0 hΛ0) (by norm_num)).ne']
      congr 1
      field_simp
    have hyle : axLogY Λ XI ≤ axLogY Λ X := by
      unfold axLogY
      exact Real.log_le_log (div_pos (mul_pos hXI0 hΛ0) (by norm_num))
        (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hX hΛ0.le) (by norm_num))
    have hsig1 : ∀ u : ℝ, 1 ≤ u → sigA u = 1 := by
      intro u hu
      unfold sigA
      rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr (by linarith)), if_pos hu]
    have hA45 : ∀ y, axLogY Λ XI ≤ y → axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η = 4 / 5 := by
      intro y hy
      have hθ : axTheta Λ om y = 1 := by
        unfold axTheta
        apply hsig1
        rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]
        linarith
      unfold axShearA
      rw [hθ]
      ring
    have hB0 : ∀ y, axLogY Λ XI ≤ y → axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have hβ : axBeta Λ om y = 0 := by
        unfold axBeta
        rw [hsig1 _ (by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]; linarith)]
        ring
      unfold axSlopeU
      rw [hβ]

    have hsplitA : ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ X, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η =

          (axLogY Λ X - axLogY Λ XI) * (4 / 5) := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hcA.intervalIntegrable 0 (axLogY Λ XI))
        (hcA.intervalIntegrable (axLogY Λ XI) (axLogY Λ X))]
      congr 1
      have hEq : EqOn (fun y => axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η) (fun _ => (4 / 5 : ℝ))
          (uIcc (axLogY Λ XI) (axLogY Λ X)) := by
        intro y hy
        rw [uIcc_of_le hyle] at hy
        exact hA45 y hy.1
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr hEq, intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
    have hsplitB : ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ X, axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η =
        ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ XI, axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hcB.intervalIntegrable 0 (axLogY Λ XI))
        (hcB.intervalIntegrable (axLogY Λ XI) (axLogY Λ X))]
      have hEq : EqOn (fun y => axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))
          (uIcc (axLogY Λ XI) (axLogY Λ X)) := by
        intro y hy
        rw [uIcc_of_le hyle] at hy
        exact hB0 y hy.1
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr hEq, intervalIntegral.integral_zero, add_zero]
    constructor
    · unfold axProfU
      rw [if_neg hXb, if_neg hXIb, hsplitB]
    · unfold axProfF
      rw [if_neg hXb, if_neg hXIb, hsplitA, ← hyX]
      have e : -(1 / 2) * ((∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ XI, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η) +
          (axLogY Λ X - axLogY Λ XI) * (4 / 5)) =
          -(1 / 2) * (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ XI, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η) +
            (-(2 / 5) * (axLogY Λ X - axLogY Λ XI)) := by ring
      rw [e, Real.exp_add]
      ring
  exact ⟨c1, c2, hFpos, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: ax_integrands_smooth

        have hf : HasDerivAt (fun Y => Un Y e) (deriv (fun Y => Un Y e) (4 / Λ * Real.exp z))

            (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds (hV hzI))).hasDerivAt
        have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun z => Un (4 / Λ * Real.exp z) e)
            (deriv (fun Y => Un Y e) (4 / Λ * Real.exp z) * (4 / Λ * Real.exp z)) z := by

      have key := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hder ((hcDU.mono hsub).intervalIntegrable)

      linarith
  
  have hsplit : ∀ (y a : ℝ) (A D k s : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < y → Continuous A → ContinuousOn D (Icc 0 (2 * t1)) →
      Continuous k → Continuous s → (∀ z : ℝ, 2 * t1 ≤ z → s z = 1) →
      (∀ z : ℝ, 0 ≤ z → z ≤ t1 → a * A z = k z * D z) →
      (y ≤ t1 → a * (∫ z in (0:ℝ)..y, A z) - (∫ z in (0:ℝ)..y, D z) =
        (∫ z in (0:ℝ)..min y t1, (k z - 1) * D z) + a * (∫ z in t1..max y t1, A z) -
          (∫ z in t1..min (max y t1) (2 * t1), (1 - s z) * D z)) ∧
      (t1 < y → a * (∫ z in (0:ℝ)..y, A z) - ((∫ z in (0:ℝ)..t1, D z) + ∫ z in t1..y, (1 - s z) * D z) =
        (∫ z in (0:ℝ)..min y t1, (k z - 1) * D z) + a * (∫ z in t1..max y t1, A z) -
          (∫ z in t1..min (max y t1) (2 * t1), (1 - s z) * D z)) := by
    intro y a A D k s hy hAc hDc hkc hsc hs1 hak
    have hP : ∀ m : ℝ, 0 ≤ m → m ≤ t1 →
        a * (∫ z in (0:ℝ)..m, A z) - (∫ z in (0:ℝ)..m, D z) = ∫ z in (0:ℝ)..m, (k z - 1) * D z := by
      intro m hm0 hm1
      have hDm : ContinuousOn D (Icc 0 m) := hDc.mono (Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl (by linarith))
      have i1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun z => k z * D z) MeasureTheory.volume 0 m :=
        (hkc.continuousOn.mul hDm).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hm0
      have i2 : IntervalIntegrable D MeasureTheory.volume 0 m := hDm.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hm0
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      have h1 : (∫ z in (0:ℝ)..m, a * A z) = ∫ z in (0:ℝ)..m, k z * D z := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro z hz

      rw [h1, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub i1 i2]

      ring
    constructor
    · intro hyt
      rw [min_eq_left hyt, max_eq_right hyt, min_eq_left (by linarith : t1 ≤ 2 * t1),
        intervalIntegral.integral_same, intervalIntegral.integral_same, hP y hy.le hyt]
      ring
    · intro hyt
      rw [min_eq_right hyt.le, max_eq_left hyt.le]
      have hsA : (∫ z in (0:ℝ)..t1, A z) + (∫ z in t1..y, A z) = ∫ z in (0:ℝ)..y, A z :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hAc.intervalIntegrable _ _)
          (hAc.intervalIntegrable _ _)
      have htail : (∫ z in t1..min y (2 * t1), (1 - s z) * D z) = ∫ z in t1..y, (1 - s z) * D z := by
        by_cases hy2 : y ≤ 2 * t1
        · rw [min_eq_left hy2]
        · push_neg at hy2
          rw [min_eq_right hy2.le]
          have hzero : ∀ z ∈ uIcc (2 * t1) y, (1 - s z) * D z = 0 := by
            intro z hz
            rw [uIcc_of_le hy2.le] at hz
            rw [hs1 z hz.1]
            ring
          have i1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun z => (1 - s z) * D z) MeasureTheory.volume t1 (2 * t1) :=
            (((continuous_const.sub hsc).continuousOn).mul
              (hDc.mono (Icc_subset_Icc ht1.le le_rfl))).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by linarith)
          have i2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun z => (1 - s z) * D z) MeasureTheory.volume (2 * t1) y :=
            ((continuousOn_const (c := (0:ℝ))).congr (fun z hz => hzero z hz)).intervalIntegrable
          have h0 : (∫ z in (2 * t1)..y, (1 - s z) * D z) = 0 := by
            rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ)) (fun z hz => hzero z hz)]
            simp

  have hsigc : Continuous sigA := sigA_collar_facts.1.continuous

    hIS.2.continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)

  have cF2 : ∀ a b : ℝ, (∫ z in a..b, (1 - sigA ((z - t1) / t1)) * (4 / Λ * Real.exp z *
      (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y e) (4 / Λ * Real.exp z) / Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp z) e))) =

  have cU1 : ∀ a b : ℝ, (∫ z in a..b, (axKap κ0 t1 z - 1) * (4 / Λ * Real.exp z *

  have cU2 : ∀ a b : ℝ, (∫ z in a..b, (1 - sigA ((z - t1) / t1)) * (4 / Λ * Real.exp z *

        deriv (fun Y => Un Y e) (4 / Λ * Real.exp z) :=
    fun a b => intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun z _ => by ring)
  have hF4 : 0 < Fn (4 / Λ) e := by
    have := hFpos 0 ⟨le_rfl, by linarith⟩
    rwa [Real.exp_zero, mul_one] at this
  have hF1p : 0 < Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp t1) e := hFpos t1 ⟨ht1.le, by linarith⟩
  have hPF : axProfF h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un X e = Fn (4 / Λ) e *
      Real.exp (-(1 / 2) * ∫ z in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ X, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un z e) := by

    rw [hPF, Real.log_mul hF4.ne' (Real.exp_pos _).ne', Real.log_exp]

  · by_cases hyt : axLogY Λ X ≤ t1

subgoal_signatures.name: sigA_collar_facts

    ((hC η he1 he2).2.comp (continuous_id.mul continuous_const).continuousOn
      hmaps).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one
  have hP : |(∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, U (s * X) η) - ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Ur (s * X) η| ≤ D := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub hIU hIR]
    have := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := 0) (b := 1) (C := D)
      (f := fun s => U (s * X) η - Ur (s * X) η) (fun s hs => by
        rw [hIoc] at hs
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hD3 (s * X) (hsX s hs).1.le (hsX s hs).2)
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
  have hQ : |(∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, deriv (fun e' => U (s * X) e') η) -
      ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, deriv (fun e' => Ur (s * X) e') η| ≤ D := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub hJU hJR]
    have := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := 0) (b := 1) (C := D)
      (f := fun s => deriv (fun e' => U (s * X) e') η - deriv (fun e' => Ur (s * X) e') η)
      (fun s hs => by
        rw [hIoc] at hs
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hD4 (s * X) (hsX s hs).1 (hsX s hs).2)
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
  have hWU : leadW h U X η = 1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, U (s * X) η) -
      (1 - η ^ 2) * (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, deriv (fun e' => U (s * X) e') η) := by
    unfold leadW profEtaD profRadAvg
    rw [hAU.deriv]
  have hWR : leadW h Ur X η = 1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Ur (s * X) η) -
      (1 - η ^ 2) * (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, deriv (fun e' => Ur (s * X) e') η) := by
    unfold leadW profEtaD profRadAvg
    rw [hAR.deriv]
  have fin : ∀ a b c d : ℝ, |a - b| ≤ D → |c - d| ≤ D →
      |1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * a - (1 - η ^ 2) * c -
        (1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * b - (1 - η ^ 2) * d)| ≤ 2 * D := by
    intro a b c d hab hcd
    have e : 1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * a - (1 - η ^ 2) * c -
        (1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * b - (1 - η ^ 2) * d) =
        -(2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η) * (a - b) + -((1 - η ^ 2) * (c - d)) := by ring
    rw [e]
    have hα : |-(2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η)| ≤ 1 := by
      rw [abs_neg, abs_le]
      constructor
      · nlinarith [mul_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 1 - η) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 1 - 2 * h),
          mul_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 1 + η) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 1 - 2 * h)]
      · nlinarith [mul_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 1 - η) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 1 - 2 * h),
          mul_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 1 + η) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 1 - 2 * h)]
    have hβ0 : 0 ≤ 1 - η ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hβ1 : 1 - η ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
    calc _ ≤ |-(2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η) * (a - b)| + |-((1 - η ^ 2) * (c - d))| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = |-(2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η)| * |a - b| + (1 - η ^ 2) * |c - d| := by
          rw [abs_neg ((1 - η ^ 2) * (c - d)), abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hβ0]
      _ ≤ 1 * D + 1 * D := add_le_add (mul_le_mul hα hab (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one)
          (mul_le_mul hβ1 hcd (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one)
      _ = 2 * D := by ring
  rw [hWU, hWR]
  exact fin _ _ _ _ hP hQ

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h j0 σ δ : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Λ C K ρ1 : ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < ρ1 → AxAxisOut h j0 σ δ Pax Λ C K ρ1 Kder Fn Un → ∃ B1 : ℝ, 0 ≤ B1 ∧ ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (a b η : ℝ), Continuous w → (∀ y : ℝ, |w y| ≤ 1) → 0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → b ≤ 1 / 50 → -1 < η → η < 1 → ∃ dF dU : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, w y * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) * (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y e) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) / Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) e)) dF η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, w y * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) * deriv (fun Y => Un Y e) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y)) dU η ∧ |dF| ≤ B1 * (b - a) ∧ |dU| ≤ B1 * (b - a) ∧ |∫ y in a..b, w y * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) * (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) / Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) η)| ≤ B1 * (b - a) ∧ |∫ y in a..b, w y * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) * deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y)| ≤ B1 * (b - a)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h j0 σ δ Pax Λ C K ρ1 Kder Fn Un hΛ hρ1 hA
  obtain ⟨hFs, hUs, hFpos, -⟩ := hA
  have hΛ0 : 0 < Λ := by linarith
  
  have hexp : Real.exp (1 / 50) ≤ 50 / 49 := by
    have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(1 / 50))
    have h2 : Real.exp (1 / 50) * Real.exp (-(1 / 50)) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
    have h3 := Real.exp_pos (1 / 50)
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨Kb, hKb⟩ : ∃ Kb : Set (ℝ × ℝ), Kb = Icc 0 (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hKc : IsCompact Kb := by rw [hKb]; exact isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  have hmem : ∀ t x : ℝ, t ≤ 1 / 50 → -1 ≤ x → x ≤ 1 → ((4 / Λ * Real.exp t, x) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Kb := by
    intro t x ht hx1 hx2
    rw [hKb]
    refine ⟨⟨by positivity, ?_⟩, hx1, hx2⟩
    have he : Real.exp t ≤ 50 / 49 := le_trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ht) hexp
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_div_iff₀ hΛ0 (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he hΛ0.le]
  
  have key : ∀ (Φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (W : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ W → Kb ⊆ W →
      ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (a b η : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), Continuous w → (∀ y : ℝ, |w y| ≤ 1) →
        a ≤ b → b ≤ 1 / 50 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        (∀ t e : ℝ, a ≤ t → t ≤ b → -1 < e → e < 1 → g t e = w t * Φ (4 / Λ * Real.exp t, e)) →
        ∃ d : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, g y e) d η ∧ |d| ≤ B * (b - a) ∧
          |∫ y in a..b, g y η| ≤ B * (b - a) := by
    intro Φ W hW hΦ hKW
    have hΦc : ContinuousOn Φ W := hΦ.continuousOn
    have hΦ' : ContinuousOn (fun z => fderiv ℝ Φ z ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) W :=
      (hΦ.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW le_rfl).clm_apply continuousOn_const
    obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hΦc.mono hKW)
    obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hΦ'.mono hKW)
    refine ⟨max (max C0 C1) 0, le_max_right _ _, ?_⟩
    intro w a b η g hw hw1 hab hb he1 he2 hg
    have hB0 : C0 ≤ max (max C0 C1) 0 := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
    have hB1 : C1 ≤ max (max C0 C1) 0 := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
    have hcurve : ∀ x : ℝ, Continuous (fun t : ℝ => ((4 / Λ * Real.exp t, x) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
      intro x; fun_prop
    have hcont : ∀ x : ℝ, -1 ≤ x → x ≤ 1 →
        ContinuousOn (fun t => w t * Φ (4 / Λ * Real.exp t, x)) (Icc a b) := by
      intro x h1 h2
      refine hw.continuousOn.mul ?_
      exact hΦc.comp (hcurve x).continuousOn
        (fun t ht => hKW (hmem t x (le_trans ht.2 hb) h1 h2))
    have hcont' : ∀ x : ℝ, -1 ≤ x → x ≤ 1 →
        ContinuousOn (fun t => w t * fderiv ℝ Φ (4 / Λ * Real.exp t, x) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) (Icc a b) := by
      intro x h1 h2
      refine hw.continuousOn.mul ?_
      exact hΦ'.comp (hcurve x).continuousOn
        (fun t ht => hKW (hmem t x (le_trans ht.2 hb) h1 h2))
    have hderiv : ∀ t x : ℝ, t ≤ b → -1 < x → x < 1 →
        HasDerivAt (fun x => w t * Φ (4 / Λ * Real.exp t, x))
          (w t * fderiv ℝ Φ (4 / Λ * Real.exp t, x) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) x := by
      intro t x ht h1 h2
      have hz : ((4 / Λ * Real.exp t, x) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ W := hKW (hmem t x (le_trans ht hb) h1.le h2.le)
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ (4 / Λ * Real.exp t, x) :=
        (hΦ.differentiableOn one_ne_zero _ hz).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hz)
      have hc : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => ((4 / Λ * Real.exp t, x') : ℝ × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) x :=
        (hasDerivAt_const x _).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id x)
      exact (hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt x hc).const_mul (w t)
    have hsub : uIoc a b ⊆ Icc a b := by rw [uIoc_of_le hab]; exact Ioc_subset_Icc_self
    have hbd : ∀ t ∈ uIoc a b, ∀ x ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖w t * fderiv ℝ Φ (4 / Λ * Real.exp t, x) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))‖ ≤ max (max C0 C1) 0 := by
      intro t ht x hx
      have ht' := hsub ht
      have h3 := hC1 _ (hmem t x (le_trans ht'.2 hb) hx.1.le hx.2.le)
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have h4 := hw1 t
      have h5 : 0 ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ Φ (4 / Λ * Real.exp t, x) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))‖ := norm_nonneg _
      nlinarith
    obtain ⟨-, hD⟩ := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (μ := volume) (bound := fun _ => max (max C0 C1) 0)
      (F := fun x t => w t * Φ (4 / Λ * Real.exp t, x))
      (F' := fun x t => w t * fderiv ℝ Φ (4 / Λ * Real.exp t, x) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)))
      (x₀ := η) (s := Ioo (-1) 1) (Ioo_mem_nhds he1 he2)
      (Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds he1 he2) (fun x hx =>
        ((hcont x hx.1.le hx.2.le).mono hsub).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc))
      ((hcont η he1.le he2.le).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab)
      (((hcont' η he1.le he2.le).mono hsub).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht x hx => hbd t ht x hx))
      intervalIntegrable_const
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht x hx => hderiv t x (hsub ht).2 hx.1 hx.2))
    have hgeq : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 →
        (∫ y in a..b, g y e) = ∫ y in a..b, w y * Φ (4 / Λ * Real.exp y, e) := by
      intro e h1 h2
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun t ht => ?_)
      rw [uIcc_of_le hab] at ht
      exact hg t e ht.1 ht.2 h1 h2
    refine ⟨_, hD.congr_of_eventuallyEq
      (Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds he1 he2) (fun e he => hgeq e he.1 he.2)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (fun t ht => hbd t ht η ⟨he1, he2⟩)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hab)] at this
      exact this
    · rw [hgeq η he1 he2]
      have := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
        (C := max (max C0 C1) 0) (f := fun y => w y * Φ (4 / Λ * Real.exp y, η)) (a := a) (b := b)
        (fun t ht => by
          have ht' := hsub ht
          have h3 := hC0 _ (hmem t η (le_trans ht'.2 hb) he1.le he2.le)
          show ‖w t * Φ (4 / Λ * Real.exp t, η)‖ ≤ _
          rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          have h4 := hw1 t
          have h5 : 0 ≤ ‖Φ (4 / Λ * Real.exp t, η)‖ := norm_nonneg _
          nlinarith)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hab)] at this
      exact this
  
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : Set (ℝ × ℝ), D = Ioo (-1 / Λ) (5 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hDo : IsOpen D := by rw [hDdef]; exact isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  rw [← hDdef] at hFs hUs
  have hKbD : Kb ⊆ D := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hKb] at hz
    rw [hDdef]
    have h1 : -1 / Λ < 0 := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by norm_num) hΛ0
    have h2 : 41 / (10 * Λ) < 5 / Λ := by
      rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hΛ0]; nlinarith
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith [hz.1.1], by linarith [hz.1.2]⟩, by linarith [hz.2.1], by linarith [hz.2.2]⟩
  have hpart : ∀ G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) D → ∀ Y e : ℝ, ((Y, e) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ D →
      deriv (fun Y' => G Y' e) Y = fderiv ℝ (↿G) (Y, e) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) := by
    intro G hG Y e hz
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿G) (Y, e) :=
      (hG.differentiableOn (by simp) _ hz).differentiableAt (hDo.mem_nhds hz)
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun Y' : ℝ => ((Y', e) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) Y :=
      (hasDerivAt_id Y).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const Y e)
    exact (hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt Y hc).deriv
  have hDG : ∀ G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) D →
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿G) z ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) D := by
    intro G hG
    exact (hG.fderiv_of_isOpen hDo (by norm_num)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  obtain ⟨W1, hW1⟩ : ∃ W1 : Set (ℝ × ℝ), W1 = D ∩ (↿Fn) ⁻¹' ({0}ᶜ : Set ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hW1o : IsOpen W1 := by
    rw [hW1]; exact hFs.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hDo isOpen_compl_singleton
  have hKbW1 : Kb ⊆ W1 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hW1]
    refine ⟨hKbD hz, ?_⟩
    have hz' := hz
    rw [hKb] at hz'
    show (↿Fn) z ∈ ({0}ᶜ : Set ℝ)
    rw [mem_compl_singleton_iff]
    exact (hFpos z.1 z.2 hz'.1.1 hz'.1.2 (by linarith [hz'.2.1]) (by linarith [hz'.2.2])).ne'
  obtain ⟨Φ1, hΦ1⟩ : ∃ Φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
      Φ = fun z => z.1 * (fderiv ℝ (↿Fn) z ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) / Fn z.1 z.2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΦ1s : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ1 W1 := by
    have hFn1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Fn z.1 z.2) W1 :=
      (hFs.of_le (by norm_num)).mono (by rw [hW1]; exact inter_subset_left)
    have hd1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿Fn) z ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) W1 :=
      (hDG Fn hFs).mono (by rw [hW1]; exact inter_subset_left)
    have hne : ∀ z ∈ W1, Fn z.1 z.2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro z hz
      rw [hW1] at hz
      exact hz.2
    rw [hΦ1]
    exact contDiffOn_fst.mul (hd1.div hFn1 hne)
  
  obtain ⟨Φ2, hΦ2⟩ : ∃ Φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
      Φ = fun z => z.1 * fderiv ℝ (↿Un) z ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΦ2s : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ2 D := by
    rw [hΦ2]
    exact contDiffOn_fst.mul (hDG Un hUs)
  obtain ⟨BF, hBF0, hF⟩ := key Φ1 W1 hW1o hΦ1s hKbW1
  obtain ⟨BU, hBU0, hU⟩ := key Φ2 D hDo hΦ2s hKbD
  refine ⟨max BF BU, le_trans hBF0 (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro w a b η hw hw1 ha hab hb he1 he2
  have hmemD : ∀ t e : ℝ, t ≤ b → -1 < e → e < 1 → ((4 / Λ * Real.exp t, e) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ D :=
    fun t e ht h1 h2 => hKbD (hmem t e (ht.trans hb) h1.le h2.le)
  obtain ⟨dF, hdF, hdFb, hvF⟩ := hF w a b η
    (fun y e => w y * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) *
      (deriv (fun Y => Fn Y e) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) / Fn (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) e))
    hw hw1 hab hb he1 he2 (fun t e _ ht2 h1 h2 => by
      rw [hΦ1]
      dsimp only
      rw [hpart Fn hFs _ _ (hmemD t e ht2 h1 h2)]
      ring)
  obtain ⟨dU, hdU, hdUb, hvU⟩ := hU w a b η
    (fun y e => w y * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) * deriv (fun Y => Un Y e) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y))
    hw hw1 hab hb he1 he2 (fun t e _ ht2 h1 h2 => by
      rw [hΦ2]
      dsimp only
      rw [hpart Un hUs _ _ (hmemD t e ht2 h1 h2)]
      ring)
  have hba : 0 ≤ b - a := sub_nonneg.mpr hab
  have hmF : BF * (b - a) ≤ max BF BU * (b - a) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hba
  have hmU : BU * (b - a) ≤ max BF BU * (b - a) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) hba
  exact ⟨dF, dU, hdF, hdU, hdFb.trans hmF, hdUb.trans hmU, hvF.trans hmF, hvU.trans hmU⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h j0 σ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 om : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (M : ℕ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 1 ≤ Λ → 0 < ρ1 → 0 < t1 → t1 ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < κ0 → κ0 < 1 / 2 → 0 < om → om ≤ 1 / 25 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Pax (Ioo (-1) 1) → AxRefPI h j0 σ Pax Λ C K ρ1 M (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) → ∀ X η : ℝ, 4 / Λ < X → X ≤ 110 → -1 < η → η < 1 → ∃ dA dS : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun e => ∫ y in t1..max (axLogY Λ X) t1, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y e) dA η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun e => ∫ y in t1..max (axLogY Λ X) t1, axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y e) dS η ∧ |dA| ≤ κ0 * max (M 1) 0 * Real.log (28 * Λ) ∧ |dS| ≤ κ0 * max (M 1) 0 * Real.log (28 * Λ) / 2 ∧ |∫ y in t1..max (axLogY Λ X) t1, axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η| ≤ κ0 * max (M 0) 0 * Real.log (28 * Λ) / 2 ∧ (X ≤ 100 * Real.exp om → |∫ y in t1..max (axLogY Λ X) t1, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η| ≤ κ0 * max (M 0) 0 * Real.log (28 * Λ) + 2 * om / 5)
