proof.tactics:
by
  intro h j0 σ Λ C K ρ1 t1 κ0 om Pax M Fn Un hh0 hh1 hΛ hρ1 ht1 ht1c hκ0 hκ0' hom hom' hPax hR
    X η hX hX110 he1 he2
  have hΛ0 : 0 < Λ := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hFrS, hUrS, hFrP, -, -, hMom⟩ := hR
  obtain ⟨sig0, sig1, sigB, -, -⟩ := rfp_sig_basics
  have sigS : ContDiff ℝ ∞ sigA := sigA_collar_facts.1
  have hM00 : 0 ≤ max (M 0) 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hM10 : 0 ≤ max (M 1) 0 := le_max_right _ _
  
  have hXΛ : 4 < X * Λ := (div_lt_iff₀ hΛ0).mp hX
  have hyX : 0 < axLogY Λ X := by
    unfold axLogY; apply Real.log_pos; linarith
  have hexpX : Real.exp (axLogY Λ X) = X * Λ / 4 := by
    unfold axLogY; exact Real.exp_log (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨Mx, hMx⟩ : ∃ Mx : ℝ, Mx = max (axLogY Λ X) t1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hMx]
  have ht1Mx : t1 ≤ Mx := by rw [hMx]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hLb : 0 < Real.log (28 * Λ) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hyXLb : axLogY Λ X ≤ Real.log (28 * Λ) := by
    unfold axLogY
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hX110 hΛ0.le
    exact Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hlen : Mx - t1 ≤ Real.log (28 * Λ) := by
    rw [hMx]
    rcases le_total (axLogY Λ X) t1 with hc | hc
    · rw [max_eq_right hc]; linarith
    · rw [max_eq_left hc]; linarith
  have h4pos : 0 < 4 / Λ := div_pos (by norm_num) hΛ0
  have hrange : ∀ y, y ≤ Mx → 4 / Λ * Real.exp y ≤ 110 := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hMx] at hy
    rcases le_max_iff.mp hy with hy | hy
    · have h1 := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hy
      rw [hexpX] at h1
      calc 4 / Λ * Real.exp y ≤ 4 / Λ * (X * Λ / 4) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 h4pos.le
        _ = X := by field_simp
        _ ≤ 110 := hX110
    · have e1 : Real.exp y ≤ Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      have e2 := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
      have e3 : 4 / Λ ≤ 4 := div_le_self (by norm_num) hΛ
      have e4 : 0 < Real.exp y := Real.exp_pos _
      nlinarith
  
  have hpt : ∀ y e : ℝ, t1 ≤ y → y ≤ Mx → -1 < e → e < 1 →
      |deriv (fun e' => axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y e') e| ≤ κ0 * max (M 1) 0 ∧
      |deriv (fun e' => axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y e') e| ≤ κ0 * max (M 1) 0 / 2 ∧
      |axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y e| ≤ κ0 * max (M 0) 0 / 2 ∧
      |axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y e| ≤ κ0 * max (M 0) 0 + 4 / 5 ∧
      (y ≤ Real.log (25 * Λ) + om / 2 → |axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y e| ≤ κ0 * max (M 0) 0) := by
    intro y e hy1 hy2 he1' he2'
    have hkap : axKap κ0 t1 y = κ0 := by
      unfold axKap
      rw [sig1 _ ((le_div_iff₀ ht1).mpr (by linarith))]
      ring
    have θb : 0 ≤ axTheta Λ om y ∧ axTheta Λ om y ≤ 1 := by unfold axTheta; exact sigB _
    have βb : 0 ≤ axBeta Λ om y ∧ axBeta Λ om y ≤ 1 := by
      unfold axBeta
      obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := sigB ((y - Real.log (25 * Λ)) / (om / 2))
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hx1 : 4 / Λ ≤ 4 / Λ * Real.exp y :=
      le_mul_of_one_le_right h4pos.le (Real.one_le_exp (by linarith))
    have hx2 := hrange y hy2
    have m0 := hMom 0 (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) e hx1 hx2 he1'.le he2'.le
    have m1 := hMom 1 (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) e hx1 hx2 he1'.le he2'.le
    simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero, iteratedDeriv_one] at m0 m1
    have hP0 : |psLead1 h (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) e| ≤ max (M 0) 0 :=
      le_trans m0.2.2.1 (le_max_left _ _)
    have hP1 : |deriv (fun e' => psLead1 h (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) e') e| ≤
        max (M 1) 0 := le_trans m1.2.2.1 (le_max_left _ _)
    have hN0 : |4 / Λ * Real.exp y * axNs h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) e /
        (1 - 2 * h * e ^ 2)| ≤ max (M 0) 0 := le_trans m0.2.2.2.1 (le_max_left _ _)
    have hN1 : |deriv (fun e' => 4 / Λ * Real.exp y *
        axNs h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) e' / (1 - 2 * h * e' ^ 2)) e| ≤
        max (M 1) 0 := le_trans m1.2.2.2.1 (le_max_left _ _)
    have hsh : (fun e' => axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y e') = fun e' =>
        ((1 - axTheta Λ om y) * κ0) * psLead1 h (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) e' +
          axTheta Λ om y * (4 / 5) := by
      funext e'; unfold axShearA; rw [hkap]
    have hsl : (fun e' => axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y e') = fun e' =>
        (-(axBeta Λ om y * κ0) / 2) * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y *
          axNs h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) e' / (1 - 2 * h * e' ^ 2)) := by
      funext e'; unfold axSlopeU; rw [hkap]; ring
    have hc1 : 0 ≤ (1 - axTheta Λ om y) * κ0 := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hκ0.le
    have hc1' : (1 - axTheta Λ om y) * κ0 ≤ κ0 := by nlinarith
    have hc2 : |-(axBeta Λ om y * κ0) / 2| ≤ κ0 / 2 := by
      rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> nlinarith
    have hval : axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y e =
        ((1 - axTheta Λ om y) * κ0) * psLead1 h (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) e +
          axTheta Λ om y * (4 / 5) := congrFun hsh e
    have hPv : |((1 - axTheta Λ om y) * κ0) *
        psLead1 h (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) e| ≤ κ0 * max (M 0) 0 := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc1]
      exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP0 hc1) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc1' hM00)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hsh, deriv_add_const, deriv_const_mul_field, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc1]
      exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP1 hc1) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc1' hM10)
    · rw [hsl, deriv_const_mul_field, abs_mul]
      have := mul_le_mul hc2 hN1 (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
      linarith
    · rw [show axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y e = (-(axBeta Λ om y * κ0) / 2) * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y *
          axNs h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) e / (1 - 2 * h * e ^ 2)) from
          congrFun hsl e, abs_mul]
      have := mul_le_mul hc2 hN0 (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
      linarith
    · rw [hval]
      have h3 : |axTheta Λ om y * (4 / 5)| ≤ 4 / 5 := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg θb.1 (by norm_num))]; linarith
      exact le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) (add_le_add hPv h3)
    · intro hyb
      have hθ0 : axTheta Λ om y = 0 := by
        unfold axTheta; apply sig0
        apply div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg <;> linarith
      rw [hval, hθ0]
      rw [hθ0] at hPv
      simpa using hPv
  
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = min ρ1 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hr0 : 0 < r := by rw [hr]; exact lt_min hρ1 one_pos
  have hrρ : r ≤ ρ1 := by rw [hr]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hr1 : r ≤ 1 := by rw [hr]; exact min_le_right _ _
  obtain ⟨hSA, -⟩ := ax_integrands_smooth h Λ t1 κ0 om r ρ1 (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) Fn Un hh0 hh1 hΛ ht1 hom
    hr0 hrρ hr1 contDiffOn_const hFrS hUrS hFrP
  have hSA' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un)) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
    hSA.mono (prod_mono subset_rfl (Ioo_subset_Ioo (by linarith) (by linarith)))
  have hcA : Continuous (fun y => axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η) := by
    have hmap : ∀ y : ℝ, (y, η) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - r) (1 + r) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := by
      intro y
      simp only [mem_prod, mem_univ, mem_Ioo, true_and]
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    exact hSA.continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const) hmap
  
  have hpd : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen S → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) S →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => deriv (fun Y => f Y z.2) z.1) S := by
    intro f S hS hf
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => fderiv ℝ (↿f) z ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) S :=
      (hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hS (by simp)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    refine h1.congr ?_
    intro z hz
    have hdz : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿f) z :=
      (hf.contDiffAt (hS.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hp : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, z.2)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) z.1 :=
      (hasDerivAt_id z.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const z.1 z.2)
    have hc := HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (l := ↿f) (f := fun Y : ℝ => (Y, z.2)) z.1
      hdz.hasFDerivAt hp
    exact hc.deriv
  have hS1 : IsOpen (Ioi (-1 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hdU := hpd _ _ hS1 hUrS
  have hVS : (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) ⊆ Ioi (-1 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1) := by
    intro w hw
    have hm1 : -1 / Λ < 0 := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by norm_num) hΛ0
    simp only [mem_prod, mem_Ioi, mem_Ioo] at hw ⊢
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hFne : ∀ z ∈ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1), (↿(axRefF Λ t1 Fn)) z ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [mem_prod, mem_Ioi, mem_Ioo] at hz
    exact (hFrP z.1 z.2 hz.1.le (by linarith) (by linarith)).ne'
  have eΛ : -(1 / Λ) = -1 / Λ := by ring
  have hFrS' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axRefF Λ t1 Fn)) (Ioi (-(1 / Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    rw [eΛ]; exact hFrS.mono (prod_mono subset_rfl (Ioo_subset_Ioo (by linarith) (by linarith)))
  have hUrS' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axRefU Λ t1 Un)) (Ioi (-(1 / Λ)) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    rw [eΛ]; exact hUrS.mono (prod_mono subset_rfl (Ioo_subset_Ioo (by linarith) (by linarith)))
  have hFrP' : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η :=
    fun X η hX h1 h2 => hFrP X η hX (by linarith) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨-, hT2⟩ := ax_stress_smooth h (1 / Λ) Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) hh0
    (by linarith) (one_div_pos.mpr hΛ0) hFrS' hUrS' hFrP' hPax
  have idN : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η ≠ 0 →
      X * axNs h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) X η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) =
        Real.sqrt (2 * X) * axTz h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) X η -
          2 * X * deriv (fun Y => axRefU Λ t1 Un Y η) X := by
    intro X η hX he1 he2 hF
    have hq : η ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
    have hhq : h * η ^ 2 ≤ h := mul_le_of_le_one_right hh0.le hq.le
    have hL : 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      have : 0 < 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 := by linarith
      exact this.ne'
    have hs : Real.sqrt (2 * X) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)).ne'
    have hss : Real.sqrt (2 * X) * Real.sqrt (2 * X) = 2 * X := Real.mul_self_sqrt (by linarith)
    simp only [axTz, axPs2, shearB]
    generalize axNs h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) X η = N
    generalize deriv (fun Y => axRefU Λ t1 Un Y η) X = d
    generalize axRefF Λ t1 Fn X η = Fv at hF ⊢
    generalize 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 = L at hL ⊢
    generalize Real.sqrt (2 * X) = s at hs hss ⊢
    rw [← hss]
    field_simp
    try ring
  have h2x : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * z.1) (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
    contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_fst
  have c5 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ =>
      z.1 * axNs h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) z.1 z.2 / (1 - 2 * h * z.2 ^ 2))
      (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    have hsq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * z.1)) (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
      h2x.sqrt (fun z hz => by
        simp only [mem_prod, mem_Ioi, mem_Ioo] at hz
        exact (by linarith [hz.1] : (0:ℝ) < 2 * z.1).ne')
    have hB1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ =>
        Real.sqrt (2 * z.1) * axTz h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) z.1 z.2)
        (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := hsq.mul hT2
    have hB2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ =>
        2 * z.1 * deriv (fun Y => axRefU Λ t1 Un Y z.2) z.1)
        (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := h2x.mul (hdU.mono hVS)
    refine (hB1.sub hB2).congr ?_
    intro z hz
    have hz' := hz
    simp only [mem_prod, mem_Ioi, mem_Ioo] at hz'
    exact idN z.1 z.2 hz'.1 hz'.2.1 hz'.2.2 (hFne z hz)
  have hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => ((4 / Λ * Real.exp z.1, z.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
    (contDiff_const.mul (Real.contDiff_exp.comp contDiff_fst)).prodMk contDiff_snd
  have hmaps : MapsTo (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => ((4 / Λ * Real.exp z.1, z.2) : ℝ × ℝ))
      (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [mem_prod, mem_univ, mem_Ioo, true_and, mem_Ioi] at hz ⊢
    exact ⟨mul_pos h4pos (Real.exp_pos _), hz⟩
  have hNφ := c5.comp hφ.contDiffOn hmaps
  have hcut : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => -(axBeta Λ om z.1 * axKap κ0 t1 z.1) / 2) := by
    unfold axBeta axKap
    have a1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => sigA ((z.1 - Real.log (25 * Λ)) / (om / 2))) :=
      sigS.comp ((contDiff_fst.sub contDiff_const).div_const _)
    have a2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => sigA (z.1 / t1)) := sigS.comp (contDiff_fst.div_const _)
    exact (((contDiff_const.sub a1).mul (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_const.mul a2))).neg).div_const _
  have hSU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un)) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    refine (hcut.contDiffOn.mul hNφ).congr ?_
    intro z _
    show axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un z.1 z.2 = _
    unfold axSlopeU
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    ring
  
  have hbox : ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿ψ) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿ψ) (Ioo (t1 - 1) (Mx + 1) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
    fun ψ hψ => hψ.mono (prod_mono (subset_univ _) subset_rfl)
  obtain ⟨hIA, hIAb⟩ := param_int_eta_jet (axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un) (t1 - 1) t1 Mx (Mx + 1) (-1) 1
    (by linarith) ht1Mx (by linarith) (by norm_num) (hbox _ hSA')
  obtain ⟨hIS, hISb⟩ := param_int_eta_jet (axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un) (t1 - 1) t1 Mx (Mx + 1) (-1) 1
    (by linarith) ht1Mx (by linarith) (by norm_num) (hbox _ hSU)
  have hdA : HasDerivAt (fun e => ∫ y in t1..Mx, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y e)
      (deriv (fun e => ∫ y in t1..Mx, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y e) η) η :=
    ((hIA.contDiffAt (Ioo_mem_nhds he1 he2)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasDerivAt
  have hdS : HasDerivAt (fun e => ∫ y in t1..Mx, axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y e)
      (deriv (fun e => ∫ y in t1..Mx, axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y e) η) η :=
    ((hIS.contDiffAt (Ioo_mem_nhds he1 he2)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasDerivAt
  have hdAb := hIAb 1 η (κ0 * max (M 1) 0) he1 he2 (fun y hy1 hy2 => by
    rw [iteratedDeriv_one]; exact (hpt y η hy1 hy2 he1 he2).1)
  have hdSb := hISb 1 η (κ0 * max (M 1) 0 / 2) he1 he2 (fun y hy1 hy2 => by
    rw [iteratedDeriv_one]; exact (hpt y η hy1 hy2 he1 he2).2.1)
  rw [iteratedDeriv_one] at hdAb hdSb
  have hK1 : 0 ≤ κ0 * max (M 1) 0 := mul_nonneg hκ0.le hM10
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ κ0 * max (M 0) 0 := mul_nonneg hκ0.le hM00
  refine ⟨_, _, hdA, hdS, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlen hK1
    linarith
  · have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlen hK1
    linarith
  · 
    have hv := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      (f := fun y => axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η) (C := κ0 * max (M 0) 0 / 2)
      (a := t1) (b := Mx) (fun y hy => by
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le ht1Mx] at hy
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact (hpt y η hy.1.le hy.2 he1 he2).2.2.1)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ Mx - t1)] at hv
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlen hK0
    linarith
  · 
    intro hXI
    have hG4 : axLogY Λ X ≤ Real.log (25 * Λ) + om := by
      have h1 : X * Λ / 4 ≤ 25 * Λ * Real.exp om := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hXI hΛ0.le
        linarith
      have h2 := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) h1
      rw [Real.log_mul (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 25 * Λ).ne' (Real.exp_pos om).ne', Real.log_exp] at h2
      unfold axLogY; exact h2
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = max t1 (min Mx (Real.log (25 * Λ) + om / 2)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hc1 : t1 ≤ c := by rw [hc]; exact le_max_left _ _
    have hc2 : c ≤ Mx := by rw [hc]; exact max_le ht1Mx (min_le_left _ _)
    have hMc : Mx - c ≤ om / 2 := by
      have hcm : min Mx (Real.log (25 * Λ) + om / 2) ≤ c := by rw [hc]; exact le_max_right _ _
      rcases min_choice Mx (Real.log (25 * Λ) + om / 2) with hm | hm
      · rw [hm] at hcm; linarith
      · rw [hm] at hcm
        rcases le_total (axLogY Λ X) t1 with h1 | h1
        · have : Mx = t1 := by rw [hMx]; exact max_eq_right h1
          linarith
        · have : Mx = axLogY Λ X := by rw [hMx]; exact max_eq_left h1
          linarith
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hcA.intervalIntegrable t1 c)
      (hcA.intervalIntegrable c Mx)]
    have b1 := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      (f := fun y => axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η) (C := κ0 * max (M 0) 0)
      (a := t1) (b := c) (fun y hy => by
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hc1] at hy
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        have hy2 := hy.2
        rw [hc, le_max_iff] at hy2
        rcases hy2 with hy2 | hy2
        · exact absurd hy.1 (not_lt.mpr hy2)
        · exact (hpt y η hy.1.le (le_trans hy2 (min_le_left _ _)) he1 he2).2.2.2.2
            (le_trans hy2 (min_le_right _ _)))
    have b2 := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      (f := fun y => axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η) (C := κ0 * max (M 0) 0 + 4 / 5)
      (a := c) (b := Mx) (fun y hy => by
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hc2] at hy
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact (hpt y η (by linarith [hy.1]) hy.2 he1 he2).2.2.2.1)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ c - t1)] at b1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ Mx - c)] at b2
    have hsum := abs_add_le (∫ y in t1..c, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η)
      (∫ y in c..Mx, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η)
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlen hK0
    nlinarith

subgoal_signatures.name: param_int_eta_jet
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a' a b b' c d : ℝ), a' < a → a ≤ b → b < b' → c < d → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿ψ) (Ioo a' b' ×ˢ Ioo c d) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) (Ioo c d) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (η B : ℝ), c < η → η < d → (∀ y : ℝ, a ≤ y → y ≤ b → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ψ y e) η| ≤ B) → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) η| ≤ (b - a) * B

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h Pst : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (ε Bd C T Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ : ℝ) (ℓ G : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Pst → 0 < T → AxInner h Pax ε Bd C Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ ℓ G F U → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → |axUm Pst C G U β (fun _ => 0) X η - 4 * η| ≤ ε ∧ |deriv (fun e => axUm Pst C G U β (fun _ => 0) X e) η - 4| ≤ ε) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 110 * Real.exp (1 + T) → -1 < η → η < 1 → |axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0) X η| ≤ (|Bd| + 1) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) / C ∧ |deriv (fun e => axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0) X e) η| ≤ (|Bd| + 1) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) / C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 110 * Real.exp (1 + T) ≤ X → axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0) X η = refFin Pst (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) X η)

signature.name: ax_disc_profile_facts
signature.statement: ∀ (h Pst : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (ε Bd C T Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ : ℝ) (ℓ G : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Pst → 0 < T → AxInner h Pax ε Bd C Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ ℓ G F U → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → |axUm Pst C G U β (fun _ => 0) X η - 4 * η| ≤ ε ∧ |deriv (fun e => axUm Pst C G U β (fun _ => 0) X e) η - 4| ≤ ε) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 110 * Real.exp (1 + T) → -1 < η → η < 1 → |axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0) X η| ≤ (|Bd| + 1) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) / C ∧ |deriv (fun e => axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0) X e) η| ≤ (|Bd| + 1) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) / C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 110 * Real.exp (1 + T) ≤ X → axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0) X η = refFin Pst (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) X η)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Pst Pax ε Bd C T Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ ℓ G F U β γ hPst hT hIn
  unfold AxInner at hIn
  obtain ⟨⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hC1⟩, ⟨ε', -, -, -, hFpos, -⟩, -, -, hℓs, hGs, hη, hin, -⟩ := hIn
  have hCpos : 0 < C := by linarith
  
  have hA : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      |axUm Pst C G U β (fun _ => 0) X η - 4 * η| ≤ ε ∧
      |deriv (fun e => axUm Pst C G U β (fun _ => 0) X e) η - 4| ≤ ε := by
    intro X η hX0 h1 h2
    by_cases hX : X ≤ 110
    · have hfun : (fun e => axUm Pst C G U β (fun _ => 0) X e) = fun e => U X e := by
        funext e; simp only [axUm, if_pos hX]
      have hv : axUm Pst C G U β (fun _ => 0) X η = U X η := by simp only [axUm, if_pos hX]
      have := hin X η hX0 hX h1 h2
      rw [hfun, hv]
      exact ⟨this.1, this.2.1⟩
    · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, s = Real.smoothTransition (Real.log (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) + 8) :=
        ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := hs ▸ Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _
      have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := hs ▸ Real.smoothTransition.le_one _
      have key : ∀ a : ℝ, |(1 - s) * a| ≤ |a| := fun a => by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - s)]
        have := abs_nonneg a
        nlinarith
      have hfun : (fun e => axUm Pst C G U β (fun _ => 0) X e) =
          fun e => G e + s * (4 * e - G e) := by
        funext e
        simp only [axUm, if_neg hX, ← hs, Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul, add_zero]
      have hv : axUm Pst C G U β (fun _ => 0) X η = G η + s * (4 * η - G η) := by
        simp only [axUm, if_neg hX, ← hs, Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul, add_zero]
      have hGd : DifferentiableAt ℝ G η :=
        (hGs.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2)
      have hd : HasDerivAt (fun e => G e + s * (4 * e - G e))
          (deriv G η + s * (4 * 1 - deriv G η)) η :=
        hGd.hasDerivAt.add ((((hasDerivAt_id' η).const_mul 4).sub hGd.hasDerivAt).const_mul s)
      rw [hfun, hv, hd.deriv]
      constructor
      · rw [show G η + s * (4 * η - G η) - 4 * η = (1 - s) * (G η - 4 * η) by ring]
        exact (key _).trans (hη η h1 h2).2.2.1
      · rw [show deriv G η + s * (4 * 1 - deriv G η) - 4 = (1 - s) * (deriv G η - 4) by ring]
        exact (key _).trans (hη η h1 h2).2.2.2.1
  
  have hC : ∀ X η : ℝ, 110 * Real.exp (1 + T) ≤ X →
      axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0) X η = refFin Pst (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) X η := by
    intro X η hX
    have he1 : 2 + T ≤ Real.exp (1 + T) := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1 + T)]
    have hX110 : ¬ X ≤ 110 := by intro h'; nlinarith
    have hXpos : 0 < X := by nlinarith
    have hdiv : Real.exp (1 + T) ≤ X / 110 := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
    have hlog : 1 + T ≤ Real.log (X / 110) := by
      have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hdiv
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
    have harg : 1 ≤ (Real.log (X / 110) - 1) / T := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hT]; linarith
    have hσ := Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le harg
    have hf : 0 < (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
    have hp : 0 < C * Pst := by positivity
    have hrp : (X / 110) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) =
        (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) * (C * Pst) := by
      have e : X / 110 = X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) * (C * Pst) ^ 10 := by
        field_simp
      rw [e, Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      congr 1
      rw [show (1 / 10 : ℝ) = ((10 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ by norm_num]
      exact Real.pow_rpow_inv_natCast hp.le (by norm_num)
    simp only [axFm, if_neg hX110, axLam, hσ, Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul, add_zero, sub_self,
      one_mul, zero_add, Real.exp_log hf, refFin]
    rw [hrp]
    congr 1
    rw [div_eq_iff hCpos.ne']
    ring
  
  have hB : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 110 * Real.exp (1 + T) → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      |axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0) X η| ≤ (|Bd| + 1) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) / C ∧
      |deriv (fun e => axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0) X e) η| ≤
        (|Bd| + 1) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) / C := by
    intro X η hX0 hXs h1 h2
    have hE1 : 1 ≤ Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) := Real.one_le_exp (by positivity)
    have hBd : |Bd| ≤ (|Bd| + 1) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg Bd]
    by_cases hX : X ≤ 110
    · have hfun : (fun e => axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0) X e) = fun e => F X e := by
        funext e; simp only [axFm, if_pos hX]
      have hv : axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0) X η = F X η := by simp only [axFm, if_pos hX]
      obtain ⟨-, -, hCF, hCdF⟩ := hin X η hX0 hX h1 h2
      have hFp := hFpos X η hX0 h1 h2
      rw [hfun, hv]
      constructor
      · rw [abs_of_pos hFp, le_div_iff₀ hCpos]
        have := mul_comm (F X η) C
        linarith [le_abs_self Bd]
      · rw [le_div_iff₀ hCpos]
        have e : |deriv (fun e => F X e) η| * C = |C * deriv (fun e => F X e) η| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hCpos]; ring
        rw [e]
        linarith [le_abs_self Bd]
    · have hX' : 110 < X := not_le.mp hX
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, s = Real.smoothTransition ((Real.log (X / 110) - 1) / T) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := hs ▸ Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _
      have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := hs ▸ Real.smoothTransition.le_one _
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, a = (X / 110) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r, r = Real.sqrt (2 * X) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hfun : (fun e => axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0) X e) =
          fun e => Real.exp ((1 - s) * ℓ e + s * Real.log ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹)) * a / C / r := by
        funext e
        simp only [axFm, if_neg hX, axLam, ← hs, ← ha, ← hr, Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul, add_zero]
      have hv : axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0) X η =
          Real.exp ((1 - s) * ℓ η + s * Real.log ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹)) * a / C / r := by
        simp only [axFm, if_neg hX, axLam, ← hs, ← ha, ← hr, Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul, add_zero]
      
      have ha0 : 0 < a := by rw [ha]; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) _
      have haX : a ≤ X / 110 := by
        have h110 : 1 ≤ X / 110 := by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
        have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h110 (show (1 / 10 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num)
        rwa [Real.rpow_one, ← ha] at this
      have hXe : X / 110 ≤ Real.exp (1 + T) := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
      have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := by
        have := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (show (1:ℝ) ≤ 2 * X by linarith)
        rwa [Real.sqrt_one, ← hr] at this
      
      obtain ⟨hℓ1, hℓ2, -⟩ := hη η h1 h2
      have hℓd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ℓ η :=
        (hℓs.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2)
      
      have hq1 : 1 ≤ 1 + η ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have hlg0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 + η ^ 2) := Real.log_nonneg hq1
      have hlinv : Real.log ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) = -Real.log (1 + η ^ 2) := Real.log_inv _
      
      have hL0 : (1 - s) * ℓ η + s * Real.log ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ≤ |Bd| + 1 := by
        rw [hlinv]
        have a1 : ℓ η ≤ |Bd| := (le_abs_self _).trans (hℓ1.trans (le_abs_self _))
        have a2 : (1 - s) * ℓ η ≤ (1 - s) * |Bd| :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a1 (by linarith)
        have a3 : 0 ≤ s * Real.log (1 + η ^ 2) := mul_nonneg hs0 hlg0
        have a4 : (1 - s) * |Bd| ≤ |Bd| := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg Bd]
        linarith
      
      have hq : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => 1 + e ^ 2) (2 * η) η := by
        have := ((hasDerivAt_id' η).pow 2).const_add 1
        convert this using 1
        simp
      have h3 := (hℓd.hasDerivAt.const_mul (1 - s)).add
        ((hq.log (by positivity)).neg.const_mul s)
      have hfeq : (fun e => (1 - s) * ℓ e + s * Real.log ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹)) =
          (fun e => (1 - s) * ℓ e + s * -Real.log (1 + e ^ 2)) := by
        funext e; rw [Real.log_inv]
      have hlam : HasDerivAt (fun e => (1 - s) * ℓ e + s * Real.log ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹))
          ((1 - s) * deriv ℓ η + s * -(2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2))) η := by
        rw [hfeq]; exact h3
      have hφ : HasDerivAt
          (fun e => Real.exp ((1 - s) * ℓ e + s * Real.log ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹)) * a / C / r)
          (Real.exp ((1 - s) * ℓ η + s * Real.log ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹)) *
            ((1 - s) * deriv ℓ η + s * -(2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2))) * a / C / r) η :=
        ((hlam.exp.mul_const a).div_const C).div_const r
      
      have hfrac : |2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2)| ≤ 1 := by
        have hpos : 0 < 1 + η ^ 2 := by positivity
        rw [abs_le]
        constructor
        · rw [le_div_iff₀ hpos]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (η + 1)]
        · rw [div_le_iff₀ hpos]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (η - 1)]
      have hL1 : |(1 - s) * deriv ℓ η + s * -(2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2))| ≤ |Bd| + 1 := by
        have b1 : |(1 - s) * deriv ℓ η| ≤ |Bd| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - s)]
          have := hℓ2.trans (le_abs_self Bd)
          nlinarith [abs_nonneg (deriv ℓ η)]
        have b2 : |s * -(2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2))| ≤ 1 := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hs0]
          nlinarith [abs_nonneg (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2))]
        exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith)
      
      obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ : ∃ V, V = Real.exp ((1 - s) * ℓ η + s * Real.log ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹)) * a / C / r :=
        ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hVpos : 0 < V := by
        rw [hV]; have : 0 < r := by linarith
        positivity
      have hEe : Real.exp (|Bd| + 1) * Real.exp (1 + T) = Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
      have hVle : V ≤ Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) / C := by
        rw [hV]
        have m1 : Real.exp ((1 - s) * ℓ η + s * Real.log ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹)) * a ≤
            Real.exp (|Bd| + 1) * Real.exp (1 + T) :=
          mul_le_mul (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hL0) (haX.trans hXe) ha0.le (Real.exp_pos _).le
        rw [hEe] at m1
        have m2 : Real.exp ((1 - s) * ℓ η + s * Real.log ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹)) * a / C ≤
            Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) / C := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right m1 hCpos.le
        have m3 : 0 ≤ Real.exp ((1 - s) * ℓ η + s * Real.log ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹)) * a / C := by
          positivity
        exact (div_le_self m3 hr1).trans m2
      have hEC : 0 ≤ Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) / C := by positivity
      rw [hfun, hφ.deriv, hv, ← hV]
      constructor
      · rw [abs_of_pos hVpos]
        have : Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) / C ≤ (|Bd| + 1) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) / C := by
          rw [mul_div_assoc]
          nlinarith [abs_nonneg Bd]
        linarith
      · have e : Real.exp ((1 - s) * ℓ η + s * Real.log ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹)) *
            ((1 - s) * deriv ℓ η + s * -(2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2))) * a / C / r =
            V * ((1 - s) * deriv ℓ η + s * -(2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2))) := by
          rw [hV]; ring
        rw [e, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hVpos]
        calc V * |(1 - s) * deriv ℓ η + s * -(2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2))|
            ≤ Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) / C * (|Bd| + 1) :=
              mul_le_mul hVle hL1 (abs_nonneg _) hEC
          _ = (|Bd| + 1) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) / C := by ring
  exact ⟨hA, hB, hC⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (Pst XR Xs ε' η : ℝ) (F0 U0 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Pst → 0 < XR → 0 < Xs → Xs ≤ XR * Real.exp (-6) → 0 < ε' → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F0) (Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U0) (Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → -1 < η → η < 1 → (∀ X : ℝ, Xs ≤ X → F0 X η = refFin Pst XR X η) → axDisc Pst XR F0 U0 η 0 = -(∫ x in (0:ℝ)..XR * Real.exp (-6), (U0 x η - 4 * η)) / XR ∧ axDisc Pst XR F0 U0 η 1 = -((∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xs, 2 * x * F0 x η) - 5 / 8 * Real.sqrt 2 * Pst * XR ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (8 / 5 : ℝ) * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) / XR ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) ∧ axDisc Pst XR F0 U0 η 2 = -((∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xs, U0 x η * (2 * x * F0 x η)) + (∫ x in Xs..XR * Real.exp (-6), (U0 x η - 4 * η) * (2 * x * refFin Pst XR x η)) - 4 * (5 / 8 * Real.sqrt 2 * Pst * XR ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (8 / 5 : ℝ)) * (η * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹)) / XR ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) ∧ axDisc Pst XR F0 U0 η 3 = -((∫ x in (0:ℝ)..XR * Real.exp (-6), (U0 x η ^ 2 - 16 * η ^ 2)) - (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xs, x * F0 x η ^ 2) + 5 / 12 * Pst ^ 2 * XR ^ (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) / XR ∧ axDisc Pst XR F0 U0 η 4 = -((∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xs, F0 x η ^ 2) - 5 / 2 * Pst ^ 2 * (Xs / XR) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Pst XR Xs ε' η F0 U0 hPst hXR hXs hXs1 hε' hF0 hU0 hη1 hη2 htail
  simp only [axDisc, profRadInt, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two,
    Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.cons_val_four, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons]
  generalize hX1g : XR * Real.exp (-6) = X1 at hXs1 ⊢
  have hX10 : 0 ≤ X1 := by linarith
  
  have hXRr : ∀ r x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → (x / XR) ^ r = x ^ r * XR ^ (-r) := by
    intro r x hx
    rw [Real.div_rpow hx hXR.le, Real.rpow_neg hXR.le, div_eq_mul_inv]
  have rpow_int : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (c r X : ℝ), -1 < r → 0 ≤ X → (∀ x, 0 ≤ x → g x = c * x ^ r) →
      IntervalIntegrable g MeasureTheory.volume 0 X ∧
        (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, g x) = c * (X ^ (r + 1) / (r + 1)) := by
    intro g c r X hr hX hg
    have hEq : Set.EqOn (fun x => c * x ^ r) g (Set.uIcc 0 X) := by
      intro x hx
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hX] at hx
      exact (hg x hx.1).symm
    refine ⟨((intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_rpow' hr).const_mul c).congr
      (hEq.mono Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc), ?_⟩
    calc (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, g x) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, c * x ^ r :=
          (intervalIntegral.integral_congr hEq).symm
      _ = c * (X ^ (r + 1) / (r + 1)) := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_rpow (Or.inl hr),
          Real.zero_rpow (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < r + 1).ne', sub_zero]
  
  have P1 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → 2 * x * refFin Pst XR x η =
      (Real.sqrt 2 * Pst * XR ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ)) * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) * x ^ (3 / 5 : ℝ) := by
    intro x hx
    rcases hx.eq_or_lt with h0 | hpos
    · subst h0
      rw [Real.zero_rpow (by norm_num)]
      ring
    · unfold refFin
      have hsx : Real.sqrt (2 * x) * Real.sqrt (2 * x) = 2 * x := Real.mul_self_sqrt (by linarith)
      have hs : Real.sqrt (2 * x) = Real.sqrt 2 * x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2), Real.sqrt_eq_rpow x]
      have h35 : x ^ (3 / 5 : ℝ) = x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hpos]; norm_num
      have hsp : Real.sqrt (2 * x) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)).ne'
      rw [hXRr _ x hx, h35]
      calc 2 * x * (Pst * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) * XR ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ))) / Real.sqrt (2 * x))
          = (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * Real.sqrt (2 * x)) *
              (Pst * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) * XR ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ)))) / Real.sqrt (2 * x) := by
            rw [hsx]; ring
        _ = Real.sqrt (2 * x) * (Pst * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) * XR ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ)))) := by
            rw [div_eq_iff hsp]; ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hs]; ring
  have P2 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x * refFin Pst XR x η ^ 2 =
      (Pst ^ 2 * XR ^ (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 / 2) * x ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := by
    intro x hx
    rcases hx.eq_or_lt with h0 | hpos
    · subst h0
      rw [Real.zero_rpow (by norm_num)]
      ring
    · have hA : ((x / XR) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)) ^ 2 = x ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) * XR ^ (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (div_nonneg hx hXR.le), ← hXRr _ x hx]
        norm_num
      have hs2 : Real.sqrt (2 * x) ^ 2 = 2 * x := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
      have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := hpos.ne'
      unfold refFin
      rw [div_pow, mul_pow, hA, hs2]
      field_simp
      try ring
  have P3 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → refFin Pst XR x η ^ 2 =
      (Pst ^ 2 * XR ^ (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 / 2) * x ^ (-(4 / 5) : ℝ) := by
    intro x hx
    rcases hx.eq_or_lt with h0 | hpos
    · subst h0
      rw [Real.zero_rpow (by norm_num)]
      simp [refFin]
    · have hA : ((x / XR) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)) ^ 2 = x ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) * XR ^ (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (div_nonneg hx hXR.le), ← hXRr _ x hx]
        norm_num
      have hs2 : Real.sqrt (2 * x) ^ 2 = 2 * x := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
      have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := hpos.ne'
      have h45 : x ^ (-(4 / 5) : ℝ) = x ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) / x := by
        rw [show (-(4 / 5) : ℝ) = 1 / 5 - 1 by norm_num, Real.rpow_sub hpos, Real.rpow_one]
      unfold refFin
      rw [div_pow, mul_pow, hA, hs2, h45]
      field_simp
      try ring
  have I1 := fun X (hX : 0 ≤ X) => rpow_int (fun x => 2 * x * refFin Pst XR x η)
    (Real.sqrt 2 * Pst * XR ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ)) * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) (3 / 5) X (by norm_num) hX P1
  have I2 := fun X (hX : 0 ≤ X) => rpow_int (fun x => x * refFin Pst XR x η ^ 2)
    (Pst ^ 2 * XR ^ (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 / 2) (1 / 5) X (by norm_num) hX P2
  have I3 := fun X (hX : 0 ≤ X) => rpow_int (fun x => refFin Pst XR x η ^ 2)
    (Pst ^ 2 * XR ^ (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 / 2) (-(4 / 5)) X (by norm_num) hX P3
  have K1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xs, 2 * x * refFin Pst XR x η) =
      5 / 8 * Real.sqrt 2 * Pst * XR ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (8 / 5 : ℝ) * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    rw [(I1 Xs hXs.le).2, show (3 / 5 : ℝ) + 1 = 8 / 5 by norm_num]; ring
  have K2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xs, x * refFin Pst XR x η ^ 2) =
      5 / 12 * Pst ^ 2 * XR ^ (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) * Xs ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
    rw [(I2 Xs hXs.le).2, show (1 / 5 : ℝ) + 1 = 6 / 5 by norm_num]; ring
  have K3 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xs, refFin Pst XR x η ^ 2) =
      5 / 2 * Pst ^ 2 * (Xs / XR) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
    rw [(I3 Xs hXs.le).2, show (-(4 / 5) : ℝ) + 1 = 1 / 5 by norm_num, hXRr _ Xs hXs.le]; ring
  
  have slice : ∀ G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) (Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ContinuousOn (fun x => G x η) (Ici 0) := by
    intro G hG
    refine hG.continuousOn.comp (Continuous.prodMk continuous_id continuous_const).continuousOn ?_
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨show -ε' < x by linarith [Set.mem_Ici.mp hx], hη1, hη2⟩
  have cF := slice F0 hF0
  have cU := slice U0 hU0
  have hXsmem : Xs ∈ Set.uIcc 0 X1 := by rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hX10]; exact ⟨hXs.le, hXs1⟩
  have hS0 : Set.uIcc 0 Xs ⊆ Set.uIcc 0 X1 := Set.uIcc_subset_uIcc Set.left_mem_uIcc hXsmem
  have hT0 : Set.uIcc Xs X1 ⊆ Set.uIcc 0 X1 := Set.uIcc_subset_uIcc hXsmem Set.right_mem_uIcc
  have h01 : Set.uIcc 0 X1 ⊆ Ici 0 := by
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hX10]; exact Set.Icc_subset_Ici_self
  have cUF : ContinuousOn (fun x => U0 x η * (2 * x * F0 x η)) (Ici 0) := by fun_prop
  have iU1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U0 x η) MeasureTheory.volume 0 X1 :=
    (cU.mono h01).intervalIntegrable
  have iF2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * F0 x η) MeasureTheory.volume 0 X1 :=
    ((show ContinuousOn (fun x => 2 * x * F0 x η) (Ici 0) by fun_prop).mono h01).intervalIntegrable
  have iUF : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U0 x η * (2 * x * F0 x η)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 X1 :=
    (cUF.mono h01).intervalIntegrable
  have iU2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U0 x η ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 X1 :=
    ((show ContinuousOn (fun x => U0 x η ^ 2) (Ici 0) by fun_prop).mono h01).intervalIntegrable
  have ixF : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => x * F0 x η ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 X1 :=
    ((show ContinuousOn (fun x => x * F0 x η ^ 2) (Ici 0) by fun_prop).mono h01).intervalIntegrable
  have iFF : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => F0 x η ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 X1 :=
    ((show ContinuousOn (fun x => F0 x η ^ 2) (Ici 0) by fun_prop).mono h01).intervalIntegrable
  have iR1 := (I1 X1 hX10).1
  have iR2 := (I2 X1 hX10).1
  have iR3 := (I3 X1 hX10).1
  
  have tail : ∀ (g1 g2 : ℝ → ℝ), IntervalIntegrable g1 MeasureTheory.volume 0 X1 →
      IntervalIntegrable g2 MeasureTheory.volume 0 X1 → (∀ x, Xs ≤ x → x ≤ X1 → g1 x = g2 x) →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X1, g1 x) - (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X1, g2 x) =
        (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xs, g1 x) - (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xs, g2 x) := by
    intro g1 g2 h1 h2 heq
    have hc : (∫ x in Xs..X1, g1 x) = ∫ x in Xs..X1, g2 x := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x hx
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hXs1] at hx
      exact heq x hx.1 hx.2
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (h1.mono_set hS0) (h1.mono_set hT0),
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (h2.mono_set hS0) (h2.mono_set hT0), hc]
    ring
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub iU1 intervalIntegrable_const]
  · 
    rw [tail (fun x => 2 * x * F0 x η) (fun x => 2 * x * refFin Pst XR x η) iF2 iR1
      (fun x h1 _ => by rw [htail x h1]), K1]
  · 
    have hA : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X1, U0 x η * (2 * x * F0 x η)) =
        (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xs, U0 x η * (2 * x * F0 x η)) +
          ∫ x in Xs..X1, U0 x η * (2 * x * refFin Pst XR x η) := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (iUF.mono_set hS0) (iUF.mono_set hT0)]
      congr 1
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x hx
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hXs1] at hx
      simp only [htail x hx.1]
    have hB : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X1, 4 * η * (2 * x * refFin Pst XR x η)) =
        4 * η * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X1, 2 * x * refFin Pst XR x η :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul _ _
    have hR : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X1, 2 * x * refFin Pst XR x η) =
        (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xs, 2 * x * refFin Pst XR x η) +
          ∫ x in Xs..X1, 2 * x * refFin Pst XR x η :=
      (intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (iR1.mono_set hS0) (iR1.mono_set hT0)).symm
    have iT : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * refFin Pst XR x η) MeasureTheory.volume Xs X1 :=
      iR1.mono_set hT0
    have hC : (∫ x in Xs..X1, (U0 x η - 4 * η) * (2 * x * refFin Pst XR x η)) =
        (∫ x in Xs..X1, U0 x η * (2 * x * refFin Pst XR x η)) -
          4 * η * ∫ x in Xs..X1, 2 * x * refFin Pst XR x η := by
      simp only [sub_mul]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub
        (iT.continuousOn_mul (cU.mono (h01.trans' hT0)) : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun x => U0 x η * (2 * x * refFin Pst XR x η)) MeasureTheory.volume Xs X1)
        (iT.const_mul (4 * η)), intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    rw [hA, hB, hR, hC, K1]
    ring
  · 
    have e1 := intervalIntegral.integral_sub iU2 ixF
    have e2 := intervalIntegral.integral_sub
      (intervalIntegrable_const : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ => (4 * η) ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 X1) iR2
    have e3 := intervalIntegral.integral_sub iU2
      (intervalIntegrable_const : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ => 16 * η ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 X1)
    have e4 : (∫ _ in (0:ℝ)..X1, (4 * η) ^ 2) = ∫ _ in (0:ℝ)..X1, 16 * η ^ 2 := by
      simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    have t := tail (fun x => x * F0 x η ^ 2) (fun x => x * refFin Pst XR x η ^ 2) ixF iR2
      (fun x h1 _ => by rw [htail x h1])
    rw [e1, e2, e3, e4]
    congr 1
    congr 1
    linarith [t, K2]
  · 
    rw [tail (fun x => F0 x η ^ 2) (fun x => refFin Pst XR x η ^ 2) iFF iR3
      (fun x h1 _ => by rw [htail x h1]), K3]

  intro ε ε' Xs M0 F0 U0 hε0 hε1 hε' hXs hM0 hF hU hK hB
  
  have PI : ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a' a b b' c d : ℝ), a' < a → a ≤ b → b < b' → c < d →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿ψ) (Ioo a' b' ×ˢ Ioo c d) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) (Ioo c d) ∧
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (η B : ℝ), c < η → η < d →
        (∀ y : ℝ, a ≤ y → y ≤ b → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ψ y e) η| ≤ B) →
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) η| ≤ (b - a) * B := by
    intro ψ a' a b b' c d ha hab hb hcd hψ
    set W : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Ioo a' b' ×ˢ Ioo c d with hW
    have hWo : IsOpen W := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hIoc : Set.uIoc a b = Ioc a b := Set.uIoc_of_le hab
    have leib : ∀ (φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (η : ℝ), c < η → η < d →
        ContinuousOn (↿φ) W → ContinuousOn (↿φ') W →
        (∀ y e : ℝ, a' < y → y < b' → c < e → e < d →
          HasDerivAt (fun e' => φ y e') (φ' y e) e) →
        HasDerivAt (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, φ y e) (∫ y in a..b, φ' y η) η := by
      intro φ φ' η hη1 hη2 hφ hφ' hder
      set r := min (η - c) (d - η) / 2 with hr
      have hr0 : 0 < r := by
        have : 0 < min (η - c) (d - η) := lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
        linarith
      have hr1 : r ≤ (η - c) / 2 := by
        have := min_le_left (η - c) (d - η); linarith
      have hr2 : r ≤ (d - η) / 2 := by
        have := min_le_right (η - c) (d - η); linarith
      have hKW : Icc a b ×ˢ Icc (η - r) (η + r) ⊆ W := by
        rintro ⟨t, x⟩ ⟨⟨ht1, ht2⟩, hx1, hx2⟩
        exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩
      obtain ⟨Bd, hBd⟩ :=
        (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hφ'.mono hKW)
      have slice : ∀ (χ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn (↿χ) W → ∀ x, c < x → x < d →
          ContinuousOn (fun t => χ t x) (Icc a b) := by
        intro χ hχ x hx1 hx2
        have : ContinuousOn (↿χ ∘ fun t : ℝ => (t, x)) (Icc a b) :=
          hχ.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
            (fun t ht => ⟨⟨by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩, hx1, hx2⟩)
        exact this
      have hmeas : ∀ (χ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn (↿χ) W → ∀ x, c < x → x < d →
          AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => χ t x) (volume.restrict (Set.uIoc a b)) := by
        intro χ hχ x hx1 hx2
        rw [hIoc]
        exact ((slice χ hχ x hx1 hx2).mono Ioc_subset_Icc_self).aestronglyMeasurable
          measurableSet_Ioc
      have key := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
        (μ := volume) (F := fun x t => φ t x) (F' := fun x t => φ' t x) (x₀ := η)
        (bound := fun _ => Bd) (a := a) (b := b) (s := Ioo (η - r) (η + r))
        (Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith))
        (Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2) (fun x hx => hmeas φ hφ x hx.1 hx.2))
        ((slice φ hφ η hη1 hη2).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab)
        (hmeas φ' hφ' η hη1 hη2)
        (ae_of_all _ (fun t ht x hx => by
          rw [hIoc] at ht
          exact hBd (t, x) ⟨⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩, hx.1.le, hx.2.le⟩))
        intervalIntegrable_const
        (ae_of_all _ (fun t ht x hx => by
          rw [hIoc] at ht
          exact hder t x (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.2]) (by linarith [hx.1])
            (by linarith [hx.2])))
      exact key.2
    set Ψ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun k y e => iteratedDeriv k (fun e' => ψ y e') e with hΨ
    have chain : ∀ (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (y e : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W → (y, e) ∈ W →
        HasDerivAt (fun e' => g (y, e')) (fderiv ℝ g (y, e) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) e := by
      intro g y e hg hye
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (y, e) :=
        (hg.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hye)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hp : HasDerivAt (fun e' : ℝ => (y, e')) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) e :=
        (hasDerivAt_const e y).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' e)
      exact hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt e hp
    have s1 : ∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(Ψ k)) W := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        have : ↿(Ψ 0) = ↿ψ := by
          funext p
          simp [hΨ]
        rw [this]; exact hψ
      | succ k ih =>
        have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿(Ψ k))) W :=
          ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hWo).1 ih).2
        have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => fderiv ℝ (↿(Ψ k)) p ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) W :=
          hf.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
        refine hG.congr ?_
        rintro ⟨y, e⟩ hye
        have h1 := chain (↿(Ψ k)) y e ih hye
        show iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun e' => ψ y e') e = _
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        exact h1.deriv
    have s2 : ∀ k y e, a' < y → y < b' → c < e → e < d →
        HasDerivAt (fun e' => Ψ k y e') (Ψ (k + 1) y e) e := by
      intro k y e h1 h2 h3 h4
      have h5 := chain (↿(Ψ k)) y e (s1 k) ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩
      have heq : Ψ (k + 1) y e = fderiv ℝ (↿(Ψ k)) (y, e) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) := by
        show iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun e' => ψ y e') e = _
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        exact h5.deriv
      rw [heq]
      exact h5
    have hC : ∀ k η, c < η → η < d →
        iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) η = ∫ y in a..b, Ψ k y η := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro η _ _
        simp [hΨ]
      | succ k ih =>
        intro η h1 h2
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        have hev : iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) =ᶠ[nhds η]
            fun e => ∫ y in a..b, Ψ k y e :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2) (fun e he => ih e he.1 he.2)
        rw [hev.deriv_eq]
        exact (leib (Ψ k) (Ψ (k + 1)) η h1 h2 (s1 k).continuousOn (s1 (k + 1)).continuousOn
          (s2 k)).deriv
    have hsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) (Ioo c d) := by
      apply contDiffOn_of_differentiableOn_deriv
      intro m _
      have hd : DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, Ψ m y e) (Ioo c d) := fun e he =>
        (leib (Ψ m) (Ψ (m + 1)) e he.1 he.2 (s1 m).continuousOn (s1 (m + 1)).continuousOn
          (s2 m)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      refine hd.congr ?_
      intro e he
      rw [iteratedDerivWithin_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioo he, hC m e he.1 he.2]
    refine ⟨hsmooth, fun k η B h1 h2 hB => ?_⟩
    rw [hC k η h1 h2]
    have hI := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := a) (b := b) (C := B)
      (f := fun y => Ψ k y η) (fun y hy => by
        rw [hIoc] at hy
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hB y hy.1.le hy.2)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hab)] at hI
    linarith
  
  have SL : ∀ (G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (U : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (x η : ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsOpen U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G U → (x, η) ∈ U →
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => G (x, e)) η| ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k G (x, η)‖ := by
    intro G U x η k hUo hG hxU
    have hU' : IsOpen ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ((x, 0) : ℝ × ℝ) + w) ⁻¹' U) :=
      hUo.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => G (((x, 0) : ℝ × ℝ) + w))
        ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ((x, 0) : ℝ × ℝ) + w) ⁻¹' U) :=
      hG.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn (fun w hw => hw)
    have hLη : (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ ℝ) η ∈
        ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ((x, 0) : ℝ × ℝ) + w) ⁻¹' U) := by
      show ((x, 0) : ℝ × ℝ) + ((ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ ℝ) η) ∈ U
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.inr_apply, Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero, zero_add]
      exact hxU
    have hpre : IsOpen ((ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ ℝ) ⁻¹'
        ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ((x, 0) : ℝ × ℝ) + w) ⁻¹' U)) :=
      hU'.preimage (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ ℝ).continuous
    have key := (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ ℝ).iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right hh
      hU'.uniqueDiffOn hpre.uniqueDiffOn hLη (i := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hpre hLη,
      iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hU' hLη] at key
    have hslice : (fun e => G (x, e)) =
        (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => G (((x, 0) : ℝ × ℝ) + w)) ∘ (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ ℝ) := by
      funext e
      rw [Function.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.inr_apply, Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero, zero_add]
    have htr : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => G (((x, 0) : ℝ × ℝ) + w))
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ ℝ) η) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ k G (x, η) := by
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left, ContinuousLinearMap.inr_apply, Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero,
        zero_add]
    rw [hslice, iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv, key,
      ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, htr, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _).trans ?_
    have h1 : ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ ℝ) 1‖ = 1 := by
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.inr_apply, Prod.norm_mk, norm_zero, norm_one]
      exact max_eq_right zero_le_one
    rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => h1), Finset.prod_const_one, mul_one]
  
  have MUL : ∀ (O S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen O → S ⊆ O → ∀ f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g O →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z‖ ≤ C) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g z‖ ≤ C) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => f z * g z) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro O S hOo hSO f g hf hg hbf hbg k
    choose Cf hCf using hbf
    choose Cg hCg using hbg
    refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
        (k.choose i : ℝ) * max (Cf i) 0 * max (Cg (k - i)) 0, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hzO : z ∈ O := hSO hz
    have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hf hg hOo.uniqueDiffOn hzO (n := k)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hOo hzO] at key
    refine key.trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hOo hzO, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (k - i) hOo hzO]
    have h1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f z‖ ≤ max (Cf i) 0 := (hCf i z hz).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have h2 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) g z‖ ≤ max (Cg (k - i)) 0 :=
      (hCg (k - i) z hz).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k.choose i := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 h0) h2 (norm_nonneg _)
      (mul_nonneg h0 (le_max_right _ _))
  have hOo : IsOpen (Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hSO : Icc 0 Xs ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := by
    rintro ⟨x, e⟩ ⟨⟨hx0, _⟩, he⟩
    exact ⟨show -ε' < x by linarith, he⟩
  have MUL' := MUL _ _ hOo hSO
  have hcoord : ∀ c : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ c →
      ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc 0 Xs ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k c z‖ ≤ C := by
    have hKc : IsCompact (Icc (0:ℝ) Xs ×ˢ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    intro c hc k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hc.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (m := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).continuousOn
    exact ⟨C, fun z hz => hC z ⟨hz.1, hz.2.1.le, hz.2.2.le⟩⟩
  have hKF : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc 0 Xs ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿F0) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK k
    exact ⟨C, fun z hz => (hC z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2).1⟩
  have hKU : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc 0 Xs ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿U0) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK k
    exact ⟨C, fun z hz => (hC z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2).2⟩
  
  have c1s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * z.1) := contDiff_const.mul contDiff_fst
  have c2s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.1) := contDiff_fst
  have e1 : (↿(fun x e => 2 * x * F0 x e) : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) = fun z => 2 * z.1 * (↿F0) z := by
    funext z; rfl
  have e2 : (↿(fun x e => U0 x e * (2 * x * F0 x e)) : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) =
      fun z => (↿U0) z * (↿(fun x e => 2 * x * F0 x e)) z := by
    funext z; rfl
  have e4 : (↿(fun x e => F0 x e ^ 2) : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) = fun z => (↿F0) z * (↿F0) z := by
    funext z
    show F0 z.1 z.2 ^ 2 = F0 z.1 z.2 * F0 z.1 z.2
    ring
  have e3 : (↿(fun x e => x * F0 x e ^ 2) : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) =
      fun z => z.1 * (↿(fun x e => F0 x e ^ 2)) z := by
    funext z; rfl
  have r1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e => 2 * x * F0 x e)) (Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    rw [e1]; exact c1s.contDiffOn.mul hF
  have b1 : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc 0 Xs ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(fun x e => 2 * x * F0 x e)) z‖ ≤ C := by
    rw [e1]; exact MUL' (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * z.1) (↿F0) c1s.contDiffOn hF (hcoord _ c1s) hKF
  have r2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e => U0 x e * (2 * x * F0 x e)))
      (Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    rw [e2]; exact hU.mul r1
  have b2 : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc 0 Xs ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(fun x e => U0 x e * (2 * x * F0 x e))) z‖ ≤ C := by
    rw [e2]; exact MUL' (↿U0) (↿(fun x e => 2 * x * F0 x e)) hU r1 hKU b1
  have r4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e => F0 x e ^ 2)) (Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    rw [e4]; exact hF.mul hF
  have b4 : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc 0 Xs ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(fun x e => F0 x e ^ 2)) z‖ ≤ C := by
    rw [e4]; exact MUL' (↿F0) (↿F0) hF hF hKF hKF
  have r3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun x e => x * F0 x e ^ 2)) (Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    rw [e3]; exact c2s.contDiffOn.mul r4
  have b3 : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc 0 Xs ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(fun x e => x * F0 x e ^ 2)) z‖ ≤ C := by
    rw [e3]
    exact MUL' (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.1) (↿(fun x e => F0 x e ^ 2)) c2s.contDiffOn r4
      (hcoord _ c2s) b4
  
  obtain ⟨Bp, hBp⟩ : ∃ Bp : ℝ, Bp = 20 * Xs * (M0 + M0 ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have JET : ∀ ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿ψ) (Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc 0 Xs ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿ψ) z‖ ≤ C) →
      (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xs → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        |ψ X η| ≤ Bp ∧ |deriv (fun e => ψ X e) η| ≤ Bp) →
      EtaJet (20 * Xs ^ 2 * (M0 + M0 ^ 2)) (fun e => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xs, ψ x e) := by
    intro ψ hψ hψb hψp
    have hsub : Ioo (-ε') (Xs + 1) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
      prod_mono (fun x hx => hx.1) subset_rfl
    obtain ⟨hsm, hder⟩ := PI ψ (-ε') 0 Xs (Xs + 1) (-1) 1 (by linarith) (by linarith)
      (by linarith) (by norm_num) (hψ.mono hsub)
    refine ⟨hsm, fun m => ?_, fun η h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hψb m
      refine ⟨(Xs - 0) * C, fun η h1 h2 => hder m η C h1 h2 (fun y hy0 hy1 => ?_)⟩
      have hm : ((y, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
        ⟨show -ε' < y by linarith, h1, h2⟩
      have hm2 : ((y, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 Xs ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨⟨hy0, hy1⟩, h1, h2⟩
      exact (SL (↿ψ) _ y η m hOo hψ hm).trans (hC (y, η) hm2)
    · have e0 := hder 0 η Bp h1 h2 (fun y hy0 hy1 => by
        rw [iteratedDeriv_zero]; exact (hψp y η hy0 hy1 h1 h2).1)
      have e1 := hder 1 η Bp h1 h2 (fun y hy0 hy1 => by
        rw [iteratedDeriv_one]; exact (hψp y η hy0 hy1 h1 h2).2)
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, sub_zero] at e0
      rw [iteratedDeriv_one, sub_zero] at e1
      have hX : Xs * Bp = 20 * Xs ^ 2 * (M0 + M0 ^ 2) := by rw [hBp]; ring
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  
  have hdiff : ∀ (G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) →
      ∀ X η : ℝ, ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
      HasDerivAt (fun e => G (X, e)) (deriv (fun e => G (X, e)) η) η := by
    intro G hG X η hm
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ G (X, η) :=
      (hG.contDiffAt (hOo.mem_nhds hm)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hp : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => (X, e)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) η :=
      (hasDerivAt_const η X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' η)
    exact (hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt η hp).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  have mb : ∀ a b A B : ℝ, |a| ≤ A → |b| ≤ B → |a * b| ≤ A * B := fun a b A B ha hb => by
    rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul ha hb (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans ha)
  have hA : 0 ≤ Xs * M0 := by positivity
  have hQ : 0 ≤ Xs * M0 ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hMQ : M0 ^ 2 ≤ Xs * M0 ^ 2 := le_mul_of_one_le_left (sq_nonneg _) hXs
  have hBpe : Bp = 20 * (Xs * M0) + 20 * (Xs * M0 ^ 2) := by rw [hBp]; ring
  have PW : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xs → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      (|2 * X * F0 X η| ≤ Bp ∧ |deriv (fun e => 2 * X * F0 X e) η| ≤ Bp) ∧
      (|U0 X η * (2 * X * F0 X η)| ≤ Bp ∧ |deriv (fun e => U0 X e * (2 * X * F0 X e)) η| ≤ Bp) ∧
      (|X * F0 X η ^ 2| ≤ Bp ∧ |deriv (fun e => X * F0 X e ^ 2) η| ≤ Bp) ∧
      (|F0 X η ^ 2| ≤ Bp ∧ |deriv (fun e => F0 X e ^ 2) η| ≤ Bp) := by
    intro X η hX0 hX1 h1 h2
    have hm : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨show -ε' < X by linarith, h1, h2⟩
    obtain ⟨hu, hu', hf, hf'⟩ := hB X η hX0 hX1 h1 h2
    have hFd : HasDerivAt (fun e => F0 X e) (deriv (fun e => F0 X e) η) η := hdiff (↿F0) hF X η hm
    have hUd : HasDerivAt (fun e => U0 X e) (deriv (fun e => U0 X e) η) η := hdiff (↿U0) hU X η hm
    set f := F0 X η with hfdef
    set u := U0 X η with hudef
    set f' := deriv (fun e => F0 X e) η with hf'def
    set u' := deriv (fun e => U0 X e) η with hu'def
    have hη : |η| ≤ 1 := abs_le.2 ⟨h1.le, h2.le⟩
    have hu5 : |u| ≤ 5 := by
      have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub u (4 * η)
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 4)] at this
      linarith
    have hu'5 : |u'| ≤ 5 := by
      have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub u' 4
      rw [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 4)] at this
      linarith
    have h2X : |2 * X| ≤ 2 * Xs := by rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]; linarith
    have hXa : |X| ≤ Xs := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hX0]; exact hX1
    have hf2 : |f ^ 2| ≤ M0 ^ 2 := by
      rw [abs_pow]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hf 2
    have hff : |f' * f + f * f'| ≤ M0 * M0 + M0 * M0 :=
      (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (mb _ _ _ _ hf' hf) (mb _ _ _ _ hf hf'))
    have D1 : deriv (fun e => 2 * X * F0 X e) η = 2 * X * f' := (hFd.const_mul (2 * X)).deriv
    have D2 : deriv (fun e => U0 X e * (2 * X * F0 X e)) η =
        u' * (2 * X * f) + u * (2 * X * f') :=
      (hUd.mul (hFd.const_mul (2 * X))).deriv
    have e4' : (fun e => F0 X e ^ 2) = fun e => F0 X e * F0 X e := by funext e; ring
    have e3' : (fun e => X * F0 X e ^ 2) = fun e => X * (F0 X e * F0 X e) := by funext e; ring
    have D4 : deriv (fun e => F0 X e ^ 2) η = f' * f + f * f' := by
      rw [e4']; exact (hFd.mul hFd).deriv
    have D3 : deriv (fun e => X * F0 X e ^ 2) η = X * (f' * f + f * f') := by
      rw [e3']; exact ((hFd.mul hFd).const_mul X).deriv
    have p1 : |2 * X * f| ≤ 2 * Xs * M0 := mb _ _ _ _ h2X hf
    have p1' : |2 * X * f'| ≤ 2 * Xs * M0 := mb _ _ _ _ h2X hf'
    have p2 : |u * (2 * X * f)| ≤ 5 * (2 * Xs * M0) := mb _ _ _ _ hu5 p1
    have p2a : |u' * (2 * X * f)| ≤ 5 * (2 * Xs * M0) := mb _ _ _ _ hu'5 p1
    have p2b : |u * (2 * X * f')| ≤ 5 * (2 * Xs * M0) := mb _ _ _ _ hu5 p1'
    have p3 : |X * f ^ 2| ≤ Xs * M0 ^ 2 := mb _ _ _ _ hXa hf2
    have p3' : |X * (f' * f + f * f')| ≤ Xs * (M0 * M0 + M0 * M0) := mb _ _ _ _ hXa hff
    have q1 : 2 * Xs * M0 = 2 * (Xs * M0) := by ring
    have q2 : 5 * (2 * Xs * M0) = 10 * (Xs * M0) := by ring
    have q3 : Xs * (M0 * M0 + M0 * M0) = 2 * (Xs * M0 ^ 2) := by ring
    have q5 : M0 * M0 + M0 * M0 = 2 * M0 ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [q1] at p1 p1'
    rw [q2] at p2 p2a p2b
    rw [q3] at p3'
    rw [q5] at hff
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [hBpe]; linarith
    · rw [D1, hBpe]; linarith
    · rw [hBpe]; linarith
    · rw [D2, hBpe]
      have := abs_add_le (u' * (2 * X * f)) (u * (2 * X * f'))
      linarith
    · rw [hBpe]; linarith
    · rw [D3, hBpe]; linarith
    · rw [hBpe]; linarith
    · rw [D4, hBpe]; linarith
  exact ⟨JET (fun x e => 2 * x * F0 x e) r1 b1 (fun X η a b c d => (PW X η a b c d).1),
    JET (fun x e => U0 x e * (2 * x * F0 x e)) r2 b2 (fun X η a b c d => (PW X η a b c d).2.1),
    JET (fun x e => x * F0 x e ^ 2) r3 b3 (fun X η a b c d => (PW X η a b c d).2.2.1),
    JET (fun x e => F0 x e ^ 2) r4 b4 (fun X η a b c d => (PW X η a b c d).2.2.2)⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (ε ε' Pst XR Xs X1 : ℝ) (U0 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ ε → ε ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < ε' → 0 < Pst → 0 < XR → 0 < Xs → Xs ≤ X1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U0) (Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U0) (X, η)‖ ≤ K) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → |U0 X η - 4 * η| ≤ ε ∧ |deriv (fun e => U0 X e) η - 4| ≤ ε) → EtaJet (ε * X1) (fun e => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X1, (U0 x e - 4 * e)) ∧ EtaJet (18 * ε * X1) (fun e => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X1, (U0 x e ^ 2 - 16 * e ^ 2)) ∧ EtaJet (2 * ε * Pst * X1 * Real.sqrt (2 * X1) * (X1 / XR) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)) (fun e => ∫ x in Xs..X1, (U0 x e - 4 * e) * (2 * x * refFin Pst XR x e))

signature.name: ax_disc_outer_pieces
signature.statement: ∀ (ε ε' Pst XR Xs X1 : ℝ) (U0 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ ε → ε ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < ε' → 0 < Pst → 0 < XR → 0 < Xs → Xs ≤ X1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U0) (Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U0) (X, η)‖ ≤ K) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → |U0 X η - 4 * η| ≤ ε ∧ |deriv (fun e => U0 X e) η - 4| ≤ ε) → EtaJet (ε * X1) (fun e => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X1, (U0 x e - 4 * e)) ∧ EtaJet (18 * ε * X1) (fun e => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X1, (U0 x e ^ 2 - 16 * e ^ 2)) ∧ EtaJet (2 * ε * Pst * X1 * Real.sqrt (2 * X1) * (X1 / XR) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)) (fun e => ∫ x in Xs..X1, (U0 x e - 4 * e) * (2 * x * refFin Pst XR x e))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ε ε' Pst XR Xs X1 U0 hε0 hε1 hε' hP hXR hXs hX1 hU hjet hpt
  
  have PI : ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a' a b b' c d : ℝ), a' < a → a ≤ b → b < b' → c < d → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿ψ) (Ioo a' b' ×ˢ Ioo c d) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) (Ioo c d) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (η B : ℝ), c < η → η < d → (∀ y : ℝ, a ≤ y → y ≤ b → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ψ y e) η| ≤ B) → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) η| ≤ (b - a) * B := by
    intro ψ a' a b b' c d ha hab hb hcd hψ
    set W : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Ioo a' b' ×ˢ Ioo c d with hW
    have hWo : IsOpen W := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hIoc : Set.uIoc a b = Ioc a b := Set.uIoc_of_le hab
    have leib : ∀ (φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (η : ℝ), c < η → η < d →
        ContinuousOn (↿φ) W → ContinuousOn (↿φ') W →
        (∀ y e : ℝ, a' < y → y < b' → c < e → e < d →
          HasDerivAt (fun e' => φ y e') (φ' y e) e) →
        HasDerivAt (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, φ y e) (∫ y in a..b, φ' y η) η := by
      intro φ φ' η hη1 hη2 hφ hφ' hder
      set r := min (η - c) (d - η) / 2 with hr
      have hr0 : 0 < r := by
        have : 0 < min (η - c) (d - η) := lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
        linarith
      have hr1 : r ≤ (η - c) / 2 := by
        have := min_le_left (η - c) (d - η); linarith
      have hr2 : r ≤ (d - η) / 2 := by
        have := min_le_right (η - c) (d - η); linarith
      have hKW : Icc a b ×ˢ Icc (η - r) (η + r) ⊆ W := by
        rintro ⟨t, x⟩ ⟨⟨ht1, ht2⟩, hx1, hx2⟩
        exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩
      obtain ⟨Bd, hBd⟩ :=
        (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hφ'.mono hKW)
      have slice : ∀ (χ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn (↿χ) W → ∀ x, c < x → x < d →
          ContinuousOn (fun t => χ t x) (Icc a b) := by
        intro χ hχ x hx1 hx2
        have : ContinuousOn (↿χ ∘ fun t : ℝ => (t, x)) (Icc a b) :=
          hχ.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
            (fun t ht => ⟨⟨by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩, hx1, hx2⟩)
        exact this
      have hmeas : ∀ (χ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn (↿χ) W → ∀ x, c < x → x < d →
          AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => χ t x) (volume.restrict (Set.uIoc a b)) := by
        intro χ hχ x hx1 hx2
        rw [hIoc]
        exact ((slice χ hχ x hx1 hx2).mono Ioc_subset_Icc_self).aestronglyMeasurable
          measurableSet_Ioc
      have key := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
        (μ := volume) (F := fun x t => φ t x) (F' := fun x t => φ' t x) (x₀ := η)
        (bound := fun _ => Bd) (a := a) (b := b) (s := Ioo (η - r) (η + r))
        (Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith))
        (Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2) (fun x hx => hmeas φ hφ x hx.1 hx.2))
        ((slice φ hφ η hη1 hη2).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab)
        (hmeas φ' hφ' η hη1 hη2)
        (ae_of_all _ (fun t ht x hx => by
          rw [hIoc] at ht
          exact hBd (t, x) ⟨⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩, hx.1.le, hx.2.le⟩))
        intervalIntegrable_const
        (ae_of_all _ (fun t ht x hx => by
          rw [hIoc] at ht
          exact hder t x (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.2]) (by linarith [hx.1])
            (by linarith [hx.2])))
      exact key.2
    set Ψ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun k y e => iteratedDeriv k (fun e' => ψ y e') e with hΨ
    have chain : ∀ (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (y e : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W → (y, e) ∈ W →
        HasDerivAt (fun e' => g (y, e')) (fderiv ℝ g (y, e) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) e := by
      intro g y e hg hye
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (y, e) :=
        (hg.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hye)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hp : HasDerivAt (fun e' : ℝ => (y, e')) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) e :=
        (hasDerivAt_const e y).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' e)
      exact hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt e hp
    have s1 : ∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(Ψ k)) W := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        have : ↿(Ψ 0) = ↿ψ := by
          funext p
          simp [hΨ]
        rw [this]; exact hψ
      | succ k ih =>
        have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿(Ψ k))) W :=
          ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hWo).1 ih).2
        have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => fderiv ℝ (↿(Ψ k)) p ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) W :=
          hf.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
        refine hG.congr ?_
        rintro ⟨y, e⟩ hye
        have h1 := chain (↿(Ψ k)) y e ih hye
        show iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun e' => ψ y e') e = _
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        exact h1.deriv
    have s2 : ∀ k y e, a' < y → y < b' → c < e → e < d →
        HasDerivAt (fun e' => Ψ k y e') (Ψ (k + 1) y e) e := by
      intro k y e h1 h2 h3 h4
      have h5 := chain (↿(Ψ k)) y e (s1 k) ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩
      have heq : Ψ (k + 1) y e = fderiv ℝ (↿(Ψ k)) (y, e) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) := by
        show iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun e' => ψ y e') e = _
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        exact h5.deriv
      rw [heq]
      exact h5
    have hC : ∀ k η, c < η → η < d →
        iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) η = ∫ y in a..b, Ψ k y η := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro η _ _
        simp [hΨ]
      | succ k ih =>
        intro η h1 h2
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        have hev : iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) =ᶠ[nhds η]
            fun e => ∫ y in a..b, Ψ k y e :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2) (fun e he => ih e he.1 he.2)
        rw [hev.deriv_eq]
        exact (leib (Ψ k) (Ψ (k + 1)) η h1 h2 (s1 k).continuousOn (s1 (k + 1)).continuousOn
          (s2 k)).deriv
    have hsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) (Ioo c d) := by
      apply contDiffOn_of_differentiableOn_deriv
      intro m _
      have hd : DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, Ψ m y e) (Ioo c d) := fun e he =>
        (leib (Ψ m) (Ψ (m + 1)) e he.1 he.2 (s1 m).continuousOn (s1 (m + 1)).continuousOn
          (s2 m)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      refine hd.congr ?_
      intro e he
      rw [iteratedDerivWithin_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioo he, hC m e he.1 he.2]
    refine ⟨hsmooth, fun k η B h1 h2 hB => ?_⟩
    rw [hC k η h1 h2]
    have hI := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := a) (b := b) (C := B)
      (f := fun y => Ψ k y η) (fun y hy => by
        rw [hIoc] at hy
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hB y hy.1.le hy.2)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hab)] at hI
    linarith
  
  have L1 : ∀ (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (U : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (x : ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U →
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (e : ℝ), (x, e) ∈ U →
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => g (x, e)) e| ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (x, e)‖ := by
    intro g U x hU hg
    have hT : IsOpen {e : ℝ | (x, e) ∈ U} := hU.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
    have hP : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ e : ℝ, (x, e) ∈ U →
        iteratedDeriv k (fun e => g (x, e)) e =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (x, e) (fun _ => ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => intro e he; simp
      | succ k ih =>
        intro e he
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        have hev : iteratedDeriv k (fun e => g (x, e)) =ᶠ[nhds e]
            fun e' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (x, e') (fun _ => ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hT.mem_nhds he) (fun e' he' => ih e' he')
        rw [hev.deriv_eq]
        have hcd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g (x, e) := hg.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds he)
        have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g) (x, e) :=
          hcd.iteratedFDeriv_right (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
        have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g) (x, e) :=
          h1.differentiableAt (by norm_num)
        have hιd : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => (x, e)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) e :=
          (hasDerivAt_const e x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id e)
        have h2 := hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt e hιd
        have h3 := (ContinuousMultilinearMap.apply ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ
          (fun _ => ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)))).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt e h2
        have h4 : HasDerivAt (fun e' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (x, e') (fun _ => ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))))
            (fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g) (x, e) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) (fun _ => ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)))) e :=
          h3
        rw [h4.deriv, iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left]
        rfl
    intro k e he
    rw [hP k e he, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _).trans ?_
    have hv : ‖((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖ = 1 := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
    simp [hv]
  
  have CV : ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a' a b b' B : ℝ), a' < a → a ≤ b → b < b' → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿ψ) (Ioo a' b' ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ y η : ℝ, a ≤ y → y ≤ b → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿ψ) (y, η)‖ ≤ K) → (∀ y η : ℝ, a ≤ y → y ≤ b → -1 < η → η < 1 → |ψ y η| ≤ B ∧ |deriv (fun e => ψ y e) η| ≤ B) → EtaJet ((b - a) * B) (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) := by
    intro ψ a' a b b' B ha hab hb hψ hK hB
    have hPI := PI ψ a' a b b' (-1) 1 ha hab hb (by norm_num) hψ
    refine ⟨hPI.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro m
      obtain ⟨K, hK'⟩ := hK m
      refine ⟨(b - a) * K, fun η h1 h2 => hPI.2 m η K h1 h2 (fun y hy1 hy2 => ?_)⟩
      have hmem : (y, η) ∈ Ioo a' b' ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, h1, h2⟩
      exact (L1 (↿ψ) _ y (isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo) hψ m η hmem).trans (hK' y η hy1 hy2 h1 h2)
    · intro η h1 h2
      constructor
      · have := hPI.2 0 η B h1 h2 (fun y hy1 hy2 => by
          rw [iteratedDeriv_zero]; exact (hB y η hy1 hy2 h1 h2).1)
        rw [iteratedDeriv_zero] at this
        exact this
      · have := hPI.2 1 η B h1 h2 (fun y hy1 hy2 => by
          rw [iteratedDeriv_one]; exact (hB y η hy1 hy2 h1 h2).2)
        rw [iteratedDeriv_one] at this
        exact this
  
  have CB : ∀ (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (O K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen O → IsCompact K → K ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g O → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro g O K hO hK hKO hg m
    apply hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    intro z hz
