      fun z hz => ⟨⟨by linarith [hz.1.1], by linarith [hz.1.2]⟩, hz.2⟩
    have hK'sub : Icc Xs X1 ×ˢ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) :=
      fun z hz => ⟨show (0:ℝ) < z.1 by linarith [hz.1.1], mem_univ _⟩
    have jMS : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc Xs X1 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => U0 z.1 z.2 - 4 * z.2) z‖ ≤ C := fun k =>
      (jM k).imp (fun C hC z hz => hC z ⟨⟨by linarith [hz.1.1], hz.1.2⟩, hz.2⟩)
    have jw : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc Xs X1 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * z.1 * refFin Pst XR z.1 z.2) z‖ ≤ C := fun k =>
      (CB _ _ _ (isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_univ) (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc) hK'sub cw k).imp
        (fun C hC z hz => hC z ⟨hz.1, Ioo_subset_Icc_self hz.2⟩)
    have jR : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ Icc Xs X1 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (U0 z.1 z.2 - 4 * z.2) *
          (2 * z.1 * refFin Pst XR z.1 z.2)) z‖ ≤ C :=
      PROD (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => U0 z.1 z.2 - 4 * z.2) (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * z.1 * refFin Pst XR z.1 z.2)
        _ _ hΩ'o hS'Ω' (cM.mono hΩ'1) (cw.mono hΩ'2) jMS jw
    have JR := CV (fun x e => (U0 x e - 4 * e) * (2 * x * refFin Pst XR x e)) (Xs / 2) Xs X1 (X1 + 1)
      (2 * ε * R) (by linarith) hX1 (by linarith) ((cM.mono hΩ'1).mul (cw.mono hΩ'2))
      (fun m => (jR m).imp (fun C hC y η h1 h2 h3 h4 => hC (y, η) ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩))
      (fun y η h1 h2 h3 h4 => ptR y η h1 h2 h3 h4)
    have hbound : (X1 - Xs) * (2 * ε * R) ≤
        2 * ε * Pst * X1 * Real.sqrt (2 * X1) * (X1 / XR) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) := by
      have h1 : (X1 - Xs) * (2 * ε * R) ≤ X1 * (2 * ε * R) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (by positivity)
      have h2 : X1 * (2 * ε * R) = 2 * ε * Pst * X1 * Real.sqrt (2 * X1) * (X1 / XR) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) := by
        rw [hRdef]; ring
      linarith
    exact hwk _ _ _ JR hbound

informal_problem.statement: EtaJet 1 (fun e => (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ∧ EtaJet 2 (fun e => ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) ∧ EtaJet 1 (fun e => e * (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹)

signature.name: ax_eta_weight_jets
signature.statement: EtaJet 1 (fun e => (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ∧ EtaJet 2 (fun e => ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) ∧ EtaJet 1 (fun e => e * (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹)

proof.tactics:
by
  have key : ∀ (B : ℝ) (r r' : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ r → (∀ η, HasDerivAt r (r' η) η) →
      (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |r η| ≤ B ∧ |r' η| ≤ B) → EtaJet B r := by
    intro B r r' hr hd hb
    refine ⟨hr.contDiffOn, fun m => ?_, fun η h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    · have hc : Continuous (iteratedDeriv m r) :=
        hr.continuous_iteratedDeriv m (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ :=
        isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hc.continuousOn (s := Icc (-1:ℝ) 1))
      refine ⟨K, fun η h1 h2 => ?_⟩
      have := hK η ⟨h1.le, h2.le⟩
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    · rw [(hd η).deriv]
      exact hb η h1 h2
  have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun e : ℝ => 1 + e ^ 2) := contDiff_const.add (contDiff_id.pow 2)
  have hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun e : ℝ => (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) := hg.inv (fun e => by positivity)
  have hf2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun e : ℝ => ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) := hf.pow 2
  have hef : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun e : ℝ => e * (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) := contDiff_id.mul hf
  have hD1 : ∀ η : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => 1 + e ^ 2) (2 * η) η := by
    intro η
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_pow 2 η).const_add 1
  have hD2 : ∀ η : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) (-(2 * η) / (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2) η :=
    fun η => (hD1 η).fun_inv (by positivity)
  have hD3 : ∀ η : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => ((1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2)
      (-(4 * η) / (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 3) η := by
    intro η
    have hq : (1 + η ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    refine ((hD2 η).fun_pow 2).congr_deriv ?_
    have hi : (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + η ^ 2) = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hq
    field_simp
    linear_combination (-(4 * η)) * hi
  have hD4 : ∀ η : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => e * (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹)
      ((1 - η ^ 2) / (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2) η := by
    intro η
    have hq : (1 + η ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    refine ((hasDerivAt_id' η).fun_mul (hD2 η)).congr_deriv ?_
    field_simp
    ring
  refine ⟨key 1 _ _ hf hD2 ?_, key 2 _ _ hf2 hD3 ?_, key 1 _ _ hef hD4 ?_⟩
  · intro η h1 h2
    have hq1 : 1 ≤ 1 + η ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg η]
    have hq2 : 0 < (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2 := by positivity
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
      exact inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hq1
    · rw [abs_le]
      constructor
      · rw [le_div_iff₀ hq2]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (η + 1), sq_nonneg η, sq_nonneg (η ^ 2)]
      · rw [div_le_iff₀ hq2]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (η - 1), sq_nonneg η, sq_nonneg (η ^ 2)]
  · intro η h1 h2
    have hq1 : 1 ≤ 1 + η ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg η]
    have hq3 : 0 < (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 3 := by positivity
    have hqq : 1 + η ^ 2 ≤ (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 3 := by
      have : 0 ≤ (1 + η ^ 2) * η ^ 2 * (2 + η ^ 2) := by positivity
      nlinarith
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      have a := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hq1
      have b : 0 ≤ (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
      nlinarith
    · rw [abs_le]
      constructor
      · rw [le_div_iff₀ hq3]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (η + 1)]
      · rw [div_le_iff₀ hq3]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (η - 1)]
  · intro η h1 h2
    have hq1 : 1 ≤ 1 + η ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg η]
    have hq0 : 0 < 1 + η ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hq2 : 0 < (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2 := by positivity
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, abs_le]
      constructor
      · rw [le_div_iff₀ hq0]
        nlinarith
      · rw [div_le_iff₀ hq0]
        nlinarith
    · rw [abs_le]
      constructor
      · rw [le_div_iff₀ hq2]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg η, sq_nonneg (η ^ 2)]
      · rw [div_le_iff₀ hq2]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg η, sq_nonneg (η ^ 2)]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (a b c Bu Bv Bw : ℝ) (u v w : ℝ → ℝ), EtaJet Bu u → EtaJet Bv v → EtaJet Bw w → EtaJet (|a| * Bu + |b| * Bv + |c| * Bw) (fun e => a * u e + b * v e + c * w e)

signature.name: eta_lincomb_jets
signature.statement: ∀ (a b c Bu Bv Bw : ℝ) (u v w : ℝ → ℝ), EtaJet Bu u → EtaJet Bv v → EtaJet Bw w → EtaJet (|a| * Bu + |b| * Bv + |c| * Bw) (fun e => a * u e + b * v e + c * w e)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro a b c Bu Bv Bw u v w hu hv hw
  have hlin : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      iteratedDeriv m (fun e => a * u e + b * v e + c * w e) η =
        a * iteratedDeriv m u η + b * iteratedDeriv m v η + c * iteratedDeriv m w η := by
    intro m η h1 h2
    have hO : Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ∈ nhds η := Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2
    have hu' : ContDiffAt ℝ m u η := (hu.1.contDiffAt hO).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hv' : ContDiffAt ℝ m v η := (hv.1.contDiffAt hO).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hw' : ContDiffAt ℝ m w η := (hw.1.contDiffAt hO).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hau : ContDiffAt ℝ m (fun e => a * u e) η := contDiffAt_const.mul hu'
    have hbv : ContDiffAt ℝ m (fun e => b * v e) η := contDiffAt_const.mul hv'
    have hcw : ContDiffAt ℝ m (fun e => c * w e) η := contDiffAt_const.mul hw'
    have e : (fun e => a * u e + b * v e + c * w e) =
        ((fun e => a * u e) + (fun e => b * v e)) + (fun e => c * w e) := rfl
    have hab : ContDiffAt ℝ m ((fun e => a * u e) + (fun e => b * v e)) η := hau.add hbv
    rw [e, iteratedDeriv_add hab hcw, iteratedDeriv_add hau hbv,
      iteratedDeriv_const_mul a hu', iteratedDeriv_const_mul b hv', iteratedDeriv_const_mul c hw']
  have tri : ∀ (x y z X Y Z : ℝ), |x| ≤ X → |y| ≤ Y → |z| ≤ Z →
      |a * x + b * y + c * z| ≤ |a| * X + |b| * Y + |c| * Z := by
    intro x y z X Y Z hx hy hz
    have h1 := abs_add_le (a * x + b * y) (c * z)
    have h2 := abs_add_le (a * x) (b * y)
    simp only [abs_mul] at h1 h2
    have k1 : |a| * |x| ≤ |a| * X := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx (abs_nonneg a)
    have k2 : |b| * |y| ≤ |b| * Y := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy (abs_nonneg b)
    have k3 : |c| * |z| ≤ |c| * Z := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz (abs_nonneg c)
    linarith
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ((contDiffOn_const.mul hu.1).add (contDiffOn_const.mul hv.1)).add
      (contDiffOn_const.mul hw.1)
  · intro m
    obtain ⟨Ku, hKu⟩ := hu.2.1 m
    obtain ⟨Kv, hKv⟩ := hv.2.1 m
    obtain ⟨Kw, hKw⟩ := hw.2.1 m
    refine ⟨|a| * Ku + |b| * Kv + |c| * Kw, fun η h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    rw [hlin m η h1 h2]
    exact tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (hKu η h1 h2) (hKv η h1 h2) (hKw η h1 h2)
  · intro η h1 h2
    refine ⟨tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (hu.2.2 η h1 h2).1 (hv.2.2 η h1 h2).1 (hw.2.2 η h1 h2).1, ?_⟩
    have hd := hlin 1 η h1 h2
    simp only [iteratedDeriv_one] at hd
    rw [hd]
    exact tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (hu.2.2 η h1 h2).2 (hv.2.2 η h1 h2).2 (hw.2.2 η h1 h2).2

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (M : ℝ) (d : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ) (r0 r1 r2 r3 r4 : ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ M → EtaJet M r0 → EtaJet M r1 → EtaJet M r2 → EtaJet M r3 → EtaJet M r4 → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → d η 0 = r0 η ∧ d η 1 = r1 η ∧ d η 2 = r2 η ∧ d η 3 = r3 η ∧ d η 4 = r4 η) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖d η‖ ≤ M ∧ ‖deriv d η‖ ≤ M) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ d (Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedDeriv m d η‖ ≤ K

signature.name: fin5_vector_jets
signature.statement: ∀ (M : ℝ) (d : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ) (r0 r1 r2 r3 r4 : ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ M → EtaJet M r0 → EtaJet M r1 → EtaJet M r2 → EtaJet M r3 → EtaJet M r4 → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → d η 0 = r0 η ∧ d η 1 = r1 η ∧ d η 2 = r2 η ∧ d η 3 = r3 η ∧ d η 4 = r4 η) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖d η‖ ≤ M ∧ ‖deriv d η‖ ≤ M) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ d (Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedDeriv m d η‖ ≤ K

proof.tactics:
by
  intro M d r0 r1 r2 r3 r4 hM h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 hd
  have hg : ∀ i : Fin 5, ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ, EtaJet M g ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → d η i = g η := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact ⟨r0, h0, fun η a b => (hd η a b).1⟩
    · exact ⟨r1, h1, fun η a b => (hd η a b).2.1⟩
    · exact ⟨r2, h2, fun η a b => (hd η a b).2.2.1⟩
    · exact ⟨r3, h3, fun η a b => (hd η a b).2.2.2.1⟩
    · exact ⟨r4, h4, fun η a b => (hd η a b).2.2.2.2⟩
  choose g hgJ hgd using hg
  have hdsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ d (Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    refine contDiffOn_pi.mpr (fun i => ?_)
    exact (hgJ i).1.congr (fun η hη => hgd i η hη.1 hη.2)
  have hcomp : ∀ (m : ℕ) (η : ℝ) (i : Fin 5), -1 < η → η < 1 →
      iteratedDeriv m d η i = iteratedDeriv m (g i) η := by
    intro m η i a b
    have hda : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ d η := hdsm.contDiffAt (Ioo_mem_nhds a b)
    have hev : (fun e => d e i) =ᶠ[nhds η] g i :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds a b) (fun e he => hgd i e he.1 he.2)
    rw [← hev.iteratedDeriv_eq m]
    have hm : ((m : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
    have key := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 5 => ℝ) i).iteratedFDeriv_comp_left
      hda hm
    rw [iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv]
    have hfun : (fun e => d e i) =
        ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 5 => ℝ) i) ∘ d := rfl
    rw [hfun, key]
    rfl
  refine ⟨fun η a b => ⟨?_, ?_⟩, hdsm, fun m => ?_⟩
  · refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hM).mpr (fun i => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hgd i η a b]
    exact ((hgJ i).2.2 η a b).1
  · refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hM).mpr (fun i => ?_)
    rw [← iteratedDeriv_one, hcomp 1 η i a b, iteratedDeriv_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact ((hgJ i).2.2 η a b).2
  · choose K hK using fun i => (hgJ i).2.1 m
    refine ⟨∑ i, |K i|, fun η a b => ?_⟩
    refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg (K j)))).mpr
      (fun i => ?_)
    rw [hcomp m η i a b, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact (hK i η a b).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans
      (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => abs_nonneg (K j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h cinf Xb ε : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → 0 < Xb → 0 < ε → ProfileReg h cinf Xb ε F U → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |leadPi F 0 η| ≤ M ∧ |deriv (fun e => leadPi F 0 e) η| ≤ M

signature.name: pp_axis_datum_bounds
signature.statement: ∀ (h cinf Xb ε : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → 0 < Xb → 0 < ε → ProfileReg h cinf Xb ε F U → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |leadPi F 0 η| ≤ M ∧ |deriv (fun e => leadPi F 0 e) η| ≤ M

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h cinf Xb ε F U hh hXb hε hPR
  obtain ⟨smF, -, -, bdd, intF, ext⟩ := hPR
  have hΩ : IsOpen (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  
  have hGsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun y e => F y e ^ 2)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := smF.pow 2
  have hGsm0 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun y e => F y e ^ 2)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
    hGsm.mono (prod_mono (Ioi_subset_Ioi (by linarith)) subset_rfl)
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := bdd Xb 0
  obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := bdd Xb 1
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = 2 * (|C0| + |C1|) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by rw [hB]; positivity
  have hhead : ∀ y e : ℝ, 0 < y → y ≤ Xb → -1 < e → e < 1 →
      |F y e ^ 2| ≤ B ∧ |deriv (fun e' => F y e' ^ 2) e| ≤ B := by
    intro y e hy hyX he1 he2
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (↿F) (y, e) :=
      smF.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds ⟨show -ε < y by linarith, he1, he2⟩)
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿F) (y, e) := h1.differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hcv : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (y, t)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) e :=
      (hasDerivAt_const e y).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' e)
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = fderiv ℝ (↿F) (y, e) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hF1 : HasDerivAt (fun t => F y t) L e := by
      rw [hL]; exact hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt e hcv
    have hLb : |L| ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (↿F) (y, e)‖ := by
      rw [hL, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc ‖fderiv ℝ (↿F) (y, e) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖
          ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (↿F) (y, e)‖ * ‖((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
        _ = ‖fderiv ℝ (↿F) (y, e)‖ := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
    have a0 := (hC0 y e hy.le hyX he1 he2).1
    have a1 := (hC1 y e hy.le hyX he1 he2).1
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] at a0
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_one] at a1
    have hF : |F y e| ≤ |C0| := by
      have : ‖F y e‖ ≤ C0 := a0
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      exact this.trans (le_abs_self _)
    have hL' : |L| ≤ |C1| := hLb.trans (a1.trans (le_abs_self _))
    have hsq : HasDerivAt (fun t => F y t ^ 2) (2 * F y e * L) e := by
      have := hF1.fun_pow 2
      convert this using 1
      norm_num
    rw [hsq.deriv]
    have e0 := abs_nonneg (F y e)
    have e1 := abs_nonneg L
    have e2 := abs_nonneg C0
    have e3 := abs_nonneg C1
    constructor
    · rw [abs_pow]
      have : |F y e| ^ 2 ≤ |C0| ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ e0 hF 2
      rw [hB]; nlinarith
    · rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_two]
      have : 2 * |F y e| * |L| ≤ 2 * |C0| * |C1| :=
        mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hF (by norm_num)) hL' e1 (by positivity)
      rw [hB]; nlinarith
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨hHs, hHb, -⟩ := heatProfile_props h hh heatK_deriv_bound (fun Z hZ => heatK_ode h Z hh hZ)
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hHb 0
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hHb 1
  simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero] at ha
  simp only [iteratedDeriv_one] at hb
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := (abs_nonneg _).trans (ha 1 one_pos)
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ b := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hb 1 one_pos)
  obtain ⟨AT, hAT⟩ : ∃ AT : ℝ, AT = cinf ^ 2 / 2 * (a ^ 2 + 2 * a * (b * (4 / Xb))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hAT0 : 0 ≤ AT := by rw [hAT]; positivity
  have htail : ∀ y e : ℝ, Xb < y → -1 < e → e < 1 →
      |F y e ^ 2| ≤ AT * y ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) ∧
        |deriv (fun e' => F y e' ^ 2) e| ≤ AT * y ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) := by
    intro y e hy he1 he2
    have hy0 : 0 < y := hXb.trans hy
    have hs0 : 0 < y ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hy0 _
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = cinf ^ 2 / 2 * y ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by rw [hc]; positivity
    have hr : y ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * y ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) = y ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * y := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hy0, ← Real.rpow_add_one hy0.ne']
      congr 1; ring
    have hsqid : ∀ e' : ℝ, -1 < e' → e' < 1 →
        F y e' ^ 2 = c * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e' ^ 2) / y) ^ 2 := by
      intro e' h1 h2
      have key : (Real.sqrt (2 * y) * F y e') ^ 2 =
          (cinf * y ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e' ^ 2) / y)) ^ 2 := by
        rw [(ext y e' hy.le h1 h2).2]
      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)] at key
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ (show (2 * y) ≠ 0 by positivity)
      rw [key, hc]
      linear_combination cinf ^ 2 * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e' ^ 2) / y) ^ 2 * hr
    have hz : 0 < 2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y := by
      apply div_pos _ hy0
      nlinarith
    have hHv : |heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y)| ≤ a := ha _ hz
    have hHd : |deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y)| ≤ b := hb _ hz
    have hzd : HasDerivAt (fun e' : ℝ => 2 * (1 - e' ^ 2) / y) (2 * -(2 * e) / y) e := by
      have := (((hasDerivAt_pow 2 e).const_sub 1).const_mul 2).div_const y
      convert this using 1
      norm_num
    have hzdb : |2 * -(2 * e) / y| ≤ 4 / Xb := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hy0, abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_mul]
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hy0 hXb]
      have := abs_lt.mpr ⟨he1, he2⟩
      norm_num
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg e, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this.le hXb.le]
    have hHdiff : HasDerivAt (heatProfile h) (deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y))
        (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y) :=
      ((hHs.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hz)).hasDerivAt
    have hcomp := hHdiff.comp e hzd
    have hphi : HasDerivAt (fun e' => c * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e' ^ 2) / y) ^ 2)
        (c * (2 * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y) *
          (deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y) * (2 * -(2 * e) / y)))) e := by
      have h2 := (hcomp.fun_pow 2).const_mul c
      simp only [Function.comp_apply] at h2
      convert h2 using 1
      norm_num
    have hev : (fun e' => F y e' ^ 2) =ᶠ[nhds e]
        (fun e' => c * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e' ^ 2) / y) ^ 2) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds he1 he2) (fun e' he' => hsqid e' he'.1 he'.2)
    constructor
    · rw [hsqid e he1 he2, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc0 (sq_nonneg _))]
      have k : heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y) ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2 := by
        have := mul_le_mul hHv hHv (abs_nonneg _) ha0
        rw [← sq_abs]; nlinarith
      have k2 : 0 ≤ cinf ^ 2 / 2 * y ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * (2 * a * (b * (4 / Xb))) := by positivity
      calc c * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y) ^ 2 ≤ c * a ^ 2 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k hc0
        _ ≤ AT * y ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) := by rw [hc, hAT]; nlinarith
    · rw [hev.deriv_eq, hphi.deriv]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc0, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_two]
      have k1 : |deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y)| * |2 * -(2 * e) / y| ≤
          b * (4 / Xb) := mul_le_mul hHd hzdb (abs_nonneg _) hb0
      have k2 : 2 * |heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y)| *
          (|deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y)| * |2 * -(2 * e) / y|) ≤
          2 * a * (b * (4 / Xb)) :=
        mul_le_mul (by linarith) k1 (by positivity) (by linarith)
      have k3 : 0 ≤ cinf ^ 2 / 2 * y ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * a ^ 2 := by positivity
      calc c * (2 * |heatProfile h (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y)| *
            (|deriv (heatProfile h) (2 * (1 - e ^ 2) / y)| * |2 * -(2 * e) / y|))
          ≤ c * (2 * a * (b * (4 / Xb))) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k2 hc0
        _ ≤ AT * y ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) := by rw [hc, hAT]; nlinarith
  
  
  
  have hcdiff : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e => profRadInt (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) Xb e) η := by
    intro η h1 h2
    obtain ⟨r, hrdef⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = min ((1 - η) / 2) ((η + 1) / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hr : 0 < r := by rw [hrdef]; exact lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hr1 : η + r < 1 := by
      have := min_le_left ((1 - η) / 2) ((η + 1) / 2); rw [← hrdef] at this; linarith
    have hr2 : -1 < η - r := by
      have := min_le_right ((1 - η) / 2) ((η + 1) / 2); rw [← hrdef] at this; linarith
    have hG2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2 ^ 2) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := hGsm
    have hK : IsCompact (Icc 0 Xb ×ˢ Icc (η - r) (η + r)) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    have hKS : Icc 0 Xb ×ˢ Icc (η - r) (η + r) ⊆ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 := by
      rintro ⟨p1, p2⟩ ⟨⟨hp1, -⟩, hp2, hp3⟩
      exact ⟨show -ε < p1 by linarith, show -1 < p2 by linarith, show p2 < 1 by linarith⟩
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2 ^ 2)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
      hG2.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ (by simp)
    obtain ⟨Mb, hMb⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hcont.mono hKS)
    have hcF : ∀ x ∈ Icc (η - r) (η + r), ContinuousOn (fun t => F t x ^ 2) (Icc 0 Xb) := by
      intro x hx
      exact (hG2.continuousOn.mono hKS).comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
        (fun t ht => ⟨ht, hx⟩)
    have hcD : ∀ x ∈ Icc (η - r) (η + r), ContinuousOn
        (fun t => fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2 ^ 2) (t, x) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) (Icc 0 Xb) := by
      intro x hx
      have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun t => fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2 ^ 2) (t, x)) (Icc 0 Xb) :=
        (hcont.mono hKS).comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
          (fun t ht => ⟨ht, hx⟩)
      exact h1.clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have hηK : η ∈ Icc (η - r) (η + r) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hs : Ioo (η - r) (η + r) ∈ nhds η := Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hmeas : ∀ᶠ x in nhds η,
        AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => F t x ^ 2) (volume.restrict (uIoc 0 Xb)) := by
      filter_upwards [hs] with x hx
      rw [uIoc_of_le hXb.le]
      exact ((hcF x ⟨hx.1.le, hx.2.le⟩).mono Ioc_subset_Icc_self).aestronglyMeasurable
        measurableSet_Ioc
    have hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => F t η ^ 2) volume 0 Xb :=
      (hcF η hηK).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hXb.le
    have hmeas' : AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun t => fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2 ^ 2) (t, η) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)))
        (volume.restrict (uIoc 0 Xb)) := by
      rw [uIoc_of_le hXb.le]
      exact ((hcD η hηK).mono Ioc_subset_Icc_self).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioc
    have hbound : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume, t ∈ uIoc 0 Xb → ∀ x ∈ Ioo (η - r) (η + r),
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2 ^ 2) (t, x) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖ ≤ (fun _ => Mb) t := by
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht x hx => ?_)
      rw [uIoc_of_le hXb.le] at ht
      calc ‖fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2 ^ 2) (t, x) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖
          ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2 ^ 2) (t, x)‖ * ‖((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖ :=
            ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
        _ = ‖fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2 ^ 2) (t, x)‖ := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
        _ ≤ Mb := hMb (t, x) ⟨Ioc_subset_Icc_self ht, hx.1.le, hx.2.le⟩
    have hdiff : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume, t ∈ uIoc 0 Xb → ∀ x ∈ Ioo (η - r) (η + r),
        HasDerivAt (fun x => F t x ^ 2)
          (fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2 ^ 2) (t, x) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) x := by
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht x hx => ?_)
      rw [uIoc_of_le hXb.le] at ht
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2 ^ 2) (t, x) :=
        (hG2.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds (show ((t, x) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 from
          ⟨show -ε < t by linarith [ht.1],
          show -1 < x by linarith [hx.1], show x < 1 by linarith [hx.2]⟩))).differentiableAt (by simp)
      exact hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt x ((hasDerivAt_const x t).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' x))
    obtain ⟨-, hder⟩ := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      hs hmeas hint hmeas' hbound intervalIntegrable_const hdiff
    exact hder.differentiableAt
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨MT, hMT⟩ : ∃ MT : ℝ, MT = AT * Xb ^ (1 - (2 + 2 * h)) / (2 + 2 * h - 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hTb := tail_pair_bound (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) Xb AT 0 (2 + 2 * h)
    hXb (by linarith) hAT0 le_rfl hGsm0 hGsm0 (fun y e hy he1 he2 => by
      obtain ⟨k1, k2⟩ := htail y e hy he1 he2
      exact ⟨k1, k2, by simp, by simp⟩)
  have hRb := radint_pair_bound (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) Xb B 0
    hXb hB0 le_rfl hGsm0 hGsm0 (fun y e hy hyX he1 he2 => by
      obtain ⟨k1, k2⟩ := hhead y e hy hyX he1 he2
      exact ⟨k1, k2, by simp, by simp⟩)
  
  
  
  have hsplit : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 →
      leadPi F 0 e = -(∫ y in Ioi Xb, F y e ^ 2) - profRadInt (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) Xb e := by
    intro e he1 he2
    have hcF : ContinuousOn (fun x => F x e) (Ioi (-ε)) :=
      smF.continuousOn.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
        (fun x hx => ⟨hx, he1, he2⟩)
    have hid := jp_leadPi_axis_identity (Xb + 1) ε e F F (by linarith) hε (fun _ _ => rfl) hcF
      (intF e he1 he2) Xb (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hXbdef : leadPi F Xb e = -∫ y in Ioi Xb, F y e ^ 2 := rfl
    linarith
  
  
  
  refine ⟨MT + B * Xb, fun η h1 h2 => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨T1, T2, -, -⟩ := hTb η h1 h2
  obtain ⟨c1, c2, -, -⟩ := hRb η h1 h2
  have T1' : |∫ y in Ioi Xb, F y η ^ 2| ≤ MT := by rw [hMT]; exact T1
  have T2' : |deriv (fun e => ∫ y in Ioi Xb, F y e ^ 2) η| ≤ MT := by rw [hMT]; exact T2
  have c1' : |profRadInt (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) Xb η| ≤ B * Xb := c1
  have c2' : |deriv (fun e => profRadInt (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) Xb e) η| ≤ B * Xb := c2
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ MT + B * Xb := by
    linarith [(abs_nonneg _).trans T1', (abs_nonneg _).trans c1']
  constructor
  · rw [hsplit η h1 h2]
    calc |-(∫ y in Ioi Xb, F y η ^ 2) - profRadInt (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) Xb η|
        ≤ |-(∫ y in Ioi Xb, F y η ^ 2)| + |profRadInt (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) Xb η| := abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ MT + B * Xb := by rw [abs_neg]; linarith
  · by_cases hT : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e => ∫ y in Ioi Xb, F y e ^ 2) η
    · have hev : (fun e => leadPi F 0 e) =ᶠ[nhds η]
          (fun e => -(∫ y in Ioi Xb, F y e ^ 2) - profRadInt (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) Xb e) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2) (fun e he => hsplit e he.1 he.2)
      rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_fun_sub (f := fun e => -(∫ y in Ioi Xb, F y e ^ 2)) hT.neg
        (hcdiff η h1 h2), deriv.fun_neg]
      calc |-deriv (fun e => ∫ y in Ioi Xb, F y e ^ 2) η -
            deriv (fun e => profRadInt (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) Xb e) η|
          ≤ |-deriv (fun e => ∫ y in Ioi Xb, F y e ^ 2) η| +
            |deriv (fun e => profRadInt (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) Xb e) η| := abs_sub _ _
        _ ≤ MT + B * Xb := by rw [abs_neg]; linarith
    · have hP : ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e => leadPi F 0 e) η := by
        intro hP
        apply hT
        have hd2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ
            (fun e => -(leadPi F 0 e + profRadInt (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) Xb e)) η :=
          (hP.add (hcdiff η h1 h2)).neg
        refine hd2.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
        filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2] with e he
        rw [hsplit e he.1 he.2]
        ring
      rw [deriv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hP, abs_zero]
      exact hM0

subgoal_signatures.name: tail_pair_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (g1 g2 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X A ε p : ℝ), 0 < X → 1 < p → 0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ y e : ℝ, X < y → -1 < e → e < 1 → |g1 y e| ≤ A * y ^ (-p) ∧ |deriv (fun e' => g1 y e') e| ≤ A * y ^ (-p) ∧ |g2 y e - g1 y e| ≤ ε * (A * y ^ (-p)) ∧ |deriv (fun e' => g2 y e' - g1 y e') e| ≤ ε * (A * y ^ (-p))) → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |∫ y in Ioi X, g1 y η| ≤ A * X ^ (1 - p) / (p - 1) ∧ |deriv (fun e => ∫ y in Ioi X, g1 y e) η| ≤ A * X ^ (1 - p) / (p - 1) ∧ |(∫ y in Ioi X, g2 y η) - ∫ y in Ioi X, g1 y η| ≤ ε * (A * X ^ (1 - p) / (p - 1)) ∧ |deriv (fun e => ∫ y in Ioi X, g2 y e) η - deriv (fun e => ∫ y in Ioi X, g1 y e) η| ≤ ε * (A * X ^ (1 - p) / (p - 1))

subgoal_signatures.name: radint_pair_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (g1 g2 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X A ε : ℝ), 0 < X → 0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ y e : ℝ, 0 < y → y ≤ X → -1 < e → e < 1 → |g1 y e| ≤ A ∧ |deriv (fun e' => g1 y e') e| ≤ A ∧ |g2 y e - g1 y e| ≤ ε * A ∧ |deriv (fun e' => g2 y e' - g1 y e') e| ≤ ε * A) → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |profRadInt g1 X η| ≤ A * X ∧ |profEtaD (profRadInt g1) X η| ≤ A * X ∧ |profRadInt g2 X η - profRadInt g1 X η| ≤ ε * (A * X) ∧ |profEtaD (profRadInt g2) X η - profEtaD (profRadInt g1) X η| ≤ ε * (A * X)

subgoal_signatures.name: jp_leadPi_axis_identity
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (R ε η : ℝ) (F Fi : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < ε → (∀ X : ℝ, X < R → F X η = Fi X η) → ContinuousOn (fun x => Fi x η) (Ioi (-ε)) → IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) → ∀ Y : ℝ, -ε < Y → Y < R → leadPi F Y η = leadPi F 0 η + profRadInt (fun x e => Fi x e ^ 2) Y η

subgoal_signatures.name: heatK_deriv_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ β Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → 0 < Z → HasDerivAt (fun Y => heatK β Y) (-β * heatK (β + 1) Z) Z ∧ |heatK β Z| ≤ Real.Gamma (β + 1)

subgoal_signatures.name: heatK_ode
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h Z : ℝ, 0 < h → 0 < Z → (h + 1) * Z ^ 2 * heatK (h + 2) Z - (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * heatK (h + 1) Z + (1 + h) * heatK h Z = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: heatProfile_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → (∀ β Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → 0 < Z → HasDerivAt (fun Y => heatK β Y) (-β * heatK (β + 1) Z) Z ∧ |heatK β Z| ≤ Real.Gamma (β + 1)) → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → (h + 1) * Z ^ 2 * heatK (h + 2) Z - (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * heatK (h + 1) Z + (1 + h) * heatK h Z = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → |iteratedDeriv k (heatProfile h) Z| ≤ C) ∧ (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 < Z → Z ^ 2 * deriv (deriv (heatProfile h)) Z + (1 + 2 * (1 + h) * Z) * deriv (heatProfile h) Z + h * (1 + h) * heatProfile h Z = 0)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (F F' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε x M A ε' : ℝ), 0 < ε → 0 < x → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F') (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → IntegrableOn (fun y => F y η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun y => F' y η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ leadPi F' 0 η = leadPi F 0 η ∧ |leadPi F 0 η| ≤ M ∧ |deriv (fun e => leadPi F 0 e) η| ≤ M) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |profRadInt (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) x η| ≤ A ∧ |profEtaD (profRadInt (fun y e => F y e ^ 2)) x η| ≤ A ∧ |profRadInt (fun y e => F' y e ^ 2) x η - profRadInt (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) x η| ≤ ε' ∧ |profEtaD (profRadInt (fun y e => F' y e ^ 2)) x η - profEtaD (profRadInt (fun y e => F y e ^ 2)) x η| ≤ ε') → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |leadPi F x η| ≤ M + A ∧ |profEtaD (leadPi F) x η| ≤ M + A ∧ |leadPi F' x η - leadPi F x η| ≤ ε' ∧ |profEtaD (leadPi F') x η - profEtaD (leadPi F) x η| ≤ ε'

signature.name: pp_leadPi_pair
signature.statement: ∀ (F F' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε x M A ε' : ℝ), 0 < ε → 0 < x → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F') (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → IntegrableOn (fun y => F y η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun y => F' y η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ leadPi F' 0 η = leadPi F 0 η ∧ |leadPi F 0 η| ≤ M ∧ |deriv (fun e => leadPi F 0 e) η| ≤ M) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |profRadInt (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) x η| ≤ A ∧ |profEtaD (profRadInt (fun y e => F y e ^ 2)) x η| ≤ A ∧ |profRadInt (fun y e => F' y e ^ 2) x η - profRadInt (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) x η| ≤ ε' ∧ |profEtaD (profRadInt (fun y e => F' y e ^ 2)) x η - profEtaD (profRadInt (fun y e => F y e ^ 2)) x η| ≤ ε') → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |leadPi F x η| ≤ M + A ∧ |profEtaD (leadPi F) x η| ≤ M + A ∧ |leadPi F' x η - leadPi F x η| ≤ ε' ∧ |profEtaD (leadPi F') x η - profEtaD (leadPi F) x η| ≤ ε'

proof.tactics:
by
  intro F F' ε x M A ε' hε hx smF smF' H1 H2 η hη1 hη2
  have hS : IsOpen (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  
  have hdiff : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e => profRadInt g x e) η := by
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = min ((1 - η) / 2) ((η + 1) / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hr0 : 0 < r := by rw [hr]; exact lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hr1 : r ≤ (1 - η) / 2 := by rw [hr]; exact min_le_left _ _
    have hr2 : r ≤ (η + 1) / 2 := by rw [hr]; exact min_le_right _ _
    have hKsub : Icc 0 x ×ˢ Icc (η - r) (η + r) ⊆ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := by
      rintro ⟨t, e⟩ ⟨⟨ht0, -⟩, he1, he2⟩
      exact ⟨show -ε < t by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hK : IsCompact (Icc 0 x ×ˢ Icc (η - r) (η + r)) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    have hfd : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (↿g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
      hg.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hS (by simp)
    obtain ⟨M0, hM0⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hfd.mono hKsub)
    have hpt : ∀ t e : ℝ, (t, e) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
        HasDerivAt (fun e' => g t e') (fderiv ℝ (↿g) (t, e) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) e := by
      intro t e hte
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (↿g) (t, e) := hg.contDiffAt (hS.mem_nhds hte)
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿g) (t, e) := h1.differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hcv : HasDerivAt (fun e' : ℝ => (t, e')) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) e :=
        (hasDerivAt_const e t).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' e)
      exact hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt e hcv
    have hcont_slice : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 → ContinuousOn (fun t => g t e) (Icc 0 x) := by
      intro e he1 he2
      have : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => (↿g) (t, e)) (Icc 0 x) :=
        hg.continuousOn.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
          (fun t ht => ⟨show -ε < t by linarith [ht.1], he1, he2⟩)
      exact this
    have hcont_d : ContinuousOn (fun t => fderiv ℝ (↿g) (t, η) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) (Icc 0 x) := by
      have : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ (↿g) (t, η)) (Icc 0 x) :=
        hfd.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
          (fun t ht => ⟨show -ε < t by linarith [ht.1], hη1, hη2⟩)
      exact this.clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have huIoc : uIoc 0 x = Ioc 0 x := uIoc_of_le hx.le
    have huIcc : uIcc 0 x = Icc 0 x := uIcc_of_le hx.le
    have hs : Ioo (η - r) (η + r) ∈ nhds η := Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith)
    show DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..x, g t e) η
    refine (intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (μ := volume) (a := 0) (b := x) (x₀ := η) (s := Ioo (η - r) (η + r))
      (F := fun e t => g t e) (F' := fun e t => fderiv ℝ (↿g) (t, e) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)))
      (bound := fun _ => M0) hs ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_).2.differentiableAt
    · filter_upwards [hs] with e he
      rw [huIoc]
      exact ((hcont_slice e (by linarith [he.1]) (by linarith [he.2])).mono
        Ioc_subset_Icc_self).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioc
    · apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      rw [huIcc]
      exact hcont_slice η hη1 hη2
    · rw [huIoc]
      exact (hcont_d.mono Ioc_subset_Icc_self).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioc
    · refine MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun t ht e he => ?_)
      rw [huIoc] at ht
      have hmem : (t, e) ∈ Icc 0 x ×ˢ Icc (η - r) (η + r) :=
        ⟨Ioc_subset_Icc_self ht, he.1.le, he.2.le⟩
      calc ‖fderiv ℝ (↿g) (t, e) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖
          ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (↿g) (t, e)‖ * ‖((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
        _ = ‖fderiv ℝ (↿g) (t, e)‖ := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
        _ ≤ M0 := hM0 _ hmem
    · exact intervalIntegrable_const
    · refine MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun t ht e he => ?_)
      rw [huIoc] at ht
      exact hpt t e ⟨show -ε < t by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [he.1], by linarith [he.2]⟩
  
  have hshift : ∀ G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ e : ℝ, IntegrableOn (fun y => G y e ^ 2) (Ioi 0) →
      leadPi G x e = leadPi G 0 e + profRadInt (fun y e => G y e ^ 2) x e := by
    intro G e hint
    have h2 : IntegrableOn (fun y => G y e ^ 2) (Ioi x) := hint.mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi hx.le)
    have h3 := intervalIntegral.integral_interval_add_Ioi hint h2
    show -(∫ y in Ioi x, G y e ^ 2) = -(∫ y in Ioi 0, G y e ^ 2) + ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..x, G y e ^ 2
    linarith
  have hO : IsOpen (Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioo
  have hηO : η ∈ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨hη1, hη2⟩
  have ev1 : (fun e => leadPi F x e) =ᶠ[nhds η]
      (fun e => leadPi F 0 e + profRadInt (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) x e) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hηO) (fun e he => hshift F e (H1 e he.1 he.2).1)
  have ev2 : (fun e => leadPi F' x e) =ᶠ[nhds η]
      (fun e => leadPi F 0 e + profRadInt (fun y e => F' y e ^ 2) x e) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hηO) (fun e he => by
      rw [hshift F' e (H1 e he.1 he.2).2.1, (H1 e he.1 he.2).2.2.1])
  have sq : ∀ P : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿P) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun (y e : ℝ) => P y e ^ 2)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
    fun P hP => hP.pow 2
  have D1 := hdiff (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) (sq F smF)
  have D2 := hdiff (fun y e => F' y e ^ 2) (sq F' smF')
  obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3, i4, i5⟩ := H1 η hη1 hη2
  obtain ⟨j1, j2, j3, j4⟩ := H2 η hη1 hη2
  unfold profEtaD at j2 j4
  have v1 := hshift F η i1
  have v2 : leadPi F' x η = leadPi F 0 η + profRadInt (fun y e => F' y e ^ 2) x η := by
    rw [hshift F' η i2, i3]
  have hMA : 0 ≤ M + A := by
    linarith [abs_nonneg (leadPi F 0 η), abs_nonneg (profRadInt (fun y e => F y e ^ 2) x η)]
  have hε' : 0 ≤ ε' := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) j3
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [v1]
    exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith)
  · unfold profEtaD
    by_cases hPd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e => leadPi F 0 e) η
    · rw [ev1.deriv_eq, deriv_fun_add hPd D1]
      exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith)
    · have hnd : ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e => leadPi F x e) η := by
        intro hd
        apply hPd
        have h3 := (hd.congr_of_eventuallyEq ev1.symm).sub D1
        convert h3 using 1
        funext e
        simp
      rw [deriv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hnd]
      simpa using hMA
  · rw [v1, v2, add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]
    exact j3
  · unfold profEtaD
    by_cases hPd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e => leadPi F 0 e) η
    · rw [ev2.deriv_eq, ev1.deriv_eq, deriv_fun_add hPd D2, deriv_fun_add hPd D1,
        add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]
      exact j4
    · have hnd1 : ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e => leadPi F x e) η := by
        intro hd
        apply hPd
        have h3 := (hd.congr_of_eventuallyEq ev1.symm).sub D1
        convert h3 using 1
        funext e
        simp
      have hnd2 : ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e => leadPi F' x e) η := by
        intro hd
        apply hPd
        have h3 := (hd.congr_of_eventuallyEq ev2.symm).sub D2
        convert h3 using 1
        funext e
        simp
      rw [deriv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hnd1, deriv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hnd2]
      simpa using hε'

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (S G W S' G' W' : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (O : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen O → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → ∀ p ∈ O, S i p.1 p.2 = S' i p.1 p.2 ∧ G i p.1 p.2 = G' i p.1 p.2 ∧ W i p.1 p.2 = W' i p.1 p.2) → ∀ p ∈ O, bgResTh h S G W n p.1 p.2 = bgResTh h S' G' W' n p.1 p.2 ∧ bgResZ h S G W n p.1 p.2 = bgResZ h S' G' W' n p.1 p.2 ∧ bgResRad h S G W n p.1 p.2 = bgResRad h S' G' W' n p.1 p.2

signature.name: bgRes_local
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (S G W S' G' W' : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (O : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen O → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → ∀ p ∈ O, S i p.1 p.2 = S' i p.1 p.2 ∧ G i p.1 p.2 = G' i p.1 p.2 ∧ W i p.1 p.2 = W' i p.1 p.2) → ∀ p ∈ O, bgResTh h S G W n p.1 p.2 = bgResTh h S' G' W' n p.1 p.2 ∧ bgResZ h S G W n p.1 p.2 = bgResZ h S' G' W' n p.1 p.2 ∧ bgResRad h S G W n p.1 p.2 = bgResRad h S' G' W' n p.1 p.2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h S G W S' G' W' n O hO hEq p0 hp0
  have hX : ∀ f f' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ p ∈ O, f p.1 p.2 = f' p.1 p.2) →
      ∀ p ∈ O, pdX f p.1 p.2 = pdX f' p.1 p.2 := by
    intro f f' hf p hp
    have hs : IsOpen ((fun Y : ℝ => (Y, p.2)) ⁻¹' O) :=
      hO.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
    have hmem : p.1 ∈ (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, p.2)) ⁻¹' O := by
      show (p.1, p.2) ∈ O
      exact hp
    have hev : (fun Y => f Y p.2) =ᶠ[nhds p.1] (fun Y => f' Y p.2) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hs.mem_nhds hmem) (fun Y hY => hf (Y, p.2) hY)
    unfold pdX
    exact hev.deriv_eq
  have hE : ∀ f f' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ p ∈ O, f p.1 p.2 = f' p.1 p.2) →
      ∀ p ∈ O, pdE f p.1 p.2 = pdE f' p.1 p.2 := by
    intro f f' hf p hp
    have hs : IsOpen ((fun e : ℝ => (p.1, e)) ⁻¹' O) :=
      hO.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
    have hmem : p.2 ∈ (fun e : ℝ => (p.1, e)) ⁻¹' O := by
      show (p.1, p.2) ∈ O
      exact hp
    have hev : (fun e => f p.1 e) =ᶠ[nhds p.2] (fun e => f' p.1 e) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hs.mem_nhds hmem) (fun e he => hf (p.1, e) he)
    unfold pdE
    exact hev.deriv_eq
  have hUz : ∀ f f' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ p ∈ O, f p.1 p.2 = f' p.1 p.2) →
      ∀ p ∈ O, bgUz f p.1 p.2 = bgUz f' p.1 p.2 := by
    intro f f' hf p hp
    simp only [bgUz, hf p hp, hX f f' hf p hp]
  have hTop : ∀ (b : ℝ) (f f' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ p ∈ O, f p.1 p.2 = f' p.1 p.2) →
      ∀ p ∈ O, simTop h b f p.1 p.2 = simTop h b f' p.1 p.2 := by
    intro b f f' hf p hp
    simp only [simTop, hf p hp, hX f f' hf p hp, hE f f' hf p hp]
  have hZop : ∀ (b : ℝ) (f f' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ p ∈ O, f p.1 p.2 = f' p.1 p.2) →
      ∀ p ∈ O, simZop h b f p.1 p.2 = simZop h b f' p.1 p.2 := by
    intro b f f' hf p hp
    simp only [simZop, hf p hp, hX f f' hf p hp, hE f f' hf p hp]
  have hVx : ∀ (m : ℕ) (f f' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ p ∈ O, f p.1 p.2 = f' p.1 p.2) →
      ∀ p ∈ O, bgVx h m f p.1 p.2 = bgVx h m f' p.1 p.2 := by
    intro m f f' hf p hp
    simp only [bgVx, hf p hp, hE f f' hf p hp, hUz f f' hf p hp]
  have hS : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → ∀ p ∈ O, S i p.1 p.2 = S' i p.1 p.2 :=
    fun i hi p hp => (hEq i hi p hp).1
  have hG : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → ∀ p ∈ O, G i p.1 p.2 = G' i p.1 p.2 :=
    fun i hi p hp => (hEq i hi p hp).2.1
  have hW : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → ∀ p ∈ O, W i p.1 p.2 = W' i p.1 p.2 :=
    fun i hi p hp => (hEq i hi p hp).2.2
  have hOm : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ n → bgOm h S k p0.1 p0.2 = bgOm h S' k p0.1 p0.2 := by
    intro k hk
    unfold bgOm
    congr 1
    · congr 1
      · congr 1
        · exact hTop _ _ _ (hVx k _ _ (hS k hk)) p0 hp0
        · rw [hX _ _ (hX _ _ (hVx k _ _ (hS k hk))) p0 hp0, hX _ _ (hVx k _ _ (hS k hk)) p0 hp0]
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
        have hi' : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        have h1 := hS i (by omega)
        have h2 := hS (k - i) (by omega)
        rw [hVx i _ _ h1 p0 hp0, hVx (k - i) _ _ h2 p0 hp0, hX _ _ (hVx (k - i) _ _ h2) p0 hp0,
          hUz _ _ h1 p0 hp0, hZop _ _ _ (hVx (k - i) _ _ h2) p0 hp0]
    · split_ifs with hk1
      · exact hZop _ _ _ (hZop _ _ _ (hVx (k - 1) _ _ (hS (k - 1) (by omega)))) p0 hp0
      · rfl
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold bgResTh
    congr 1
    · congr 1
      · congr 1
        · exact hTop _ _ _ (hG n le_rfl) p0 hp0
        · rw [hX _ _ (hX _ _ (hG n le_rfl)) p0 hp0, hX _ _ (hG n le_rfl) p0 hp0]
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
        have hi' : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        have h1 := hS i hi'
        have h2 := hG (n - i) (by omega)
        rw [hVx i _ _ h1 p0 hp0, h2 p0 hp0, hX _ _ h2 p0 hp0,
          hUz _ _ h1 p0 hp0, hZop _ _ _ h2 p0 hp0]
    · split_ifs with hn1
      · exact hZop _ _ _ (hZop _ _ _ (hG (n - 1) (by omega))) p0 hp0
      · rfl
  · unfold bgResZ
    congr 1
    · congr 1
      · congr 1
        · congr 1
          · exact hTop _ _ _ (hUz _ _ (hS n le_rfl)) p0 hp0
          · exact hZop _ _ _ (hW n le_rfl) p0 hp0
        · rw [hX _ _ (hX _ _ (hUz _ _ (hS n le_rfl))) p0 hp0,
            hX _ _ (hUz _ _ (hS n le_rfl)) p0 hp0]
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
        have hi' : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        have h1 := hS i hi'
        have h2 := hUz _ _ (hS (n - i) (by omega))
        rw [hVx i _ _ h1 p0 hp0, hX _ _ h2 p0 hp0,
          hUz _ _ h1 p0 hp0, hZop _ _ _ h2 p0 hp0]
    · split_ifs with hn1
      · exact hZop _ _ _ (hZop _ _ _ (hUz _ _ (hS (n - 1) (by omega)))) p0 hp0
      · rfl
  · unfold bgResRad
    congr 1
    · congr 1
      · exact hX _ _ (hW n le_rfl) p0 hp0
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
        have hi' : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        rw [hG i hi' p0 hp0, hG (n - i) (by omega) p0 hp0]
    · split_ifs with hn1
      · rw [hOm (n - 1) (by omega)]
      · rfl

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab ε Xm Xs Xi : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ), SimScaleProps h → LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → 0 < ε → 0 < Xi → BgAnalytic Xi F → BgAnalytic Xi U → 1 ≤ n → BgLower h ε Xm Xs Xi m1 m2 F U S G W n → ∃ (Si Gi Wi : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Si) (Ico 0 Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Gi) (Ico 0 Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Wi) (Ico 0 Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X1 : ℝ, X1 < Xi → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Si) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Gi) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Wi) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ BgAnalytic Xi Si ∧ BgAnalytic Xi Gi ∧ ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi → -1 < η → η < 1 → bgResRad h (Function.update S n Si) (Function.update G n Gi) (Function.update W n Wi) n X η = 0 ∧ bgResTh h (Function.update S n Si) (Function.update G n Gi) (Function.update W n Wi) n X η = 0 ∧ bgResZ h (Function.update S n Si) (Function.update G n Gi) (Function.update W n Wi) n X η = 0

signature.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab ε Xm Xs Xi : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ), SimScaleProps h → LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → 0 < ε → 0 < Xi → BgAnalytic Xi F → BgAnalytic Xi U → 1 ≤ n → BgLower h ε Xm Xs Xi m1 m2 F U S G W n → ∃ (Si Gi Wi : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Si) (Ico 0 Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Gi) (Ico 0 Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Wi) (Ico 0 Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X1 : ℝ, X1 < Xi → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Si) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Gi) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Wi) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ BgAnalytic Xi Si ∧ BgAnalytic Xi Gi ∧ ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi → -1 < η → η < 1 → bgResRad h (Function.update S n Si) (Function.update G n Gi) (Function.update W n Wi) n X η = 0 ∧ bgResTh h (Function.update S n Si) (Function.update G n Gi) (Function.update W n Wi) n X η = 0 ∧ bgResZ h (Function.update S n Si) (Function.update G n Gi) (Function.update W n Wi) n X η = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab ε Xm Xs Xi F U T0th T0z S G W n hS hLP hε hXi
    hAF hAU hn hL
  have hLP' := hLP
  unfold LeadingProfile at hLP'
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, hh1, -⟩, ⟨hFs, hUs, -, -⟩, -⟩ := hLP'
  have hsub0 : Ioo 0 Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 :=
    prod_mono (fun x hx => hx.1) subset_rfl
  have hHF : BgHolo Xi F := bgHolo_of_analytic Xi F hXi hAF (hFs.mono hsub0)
  have hHU : BgHolo Xi U := bgHolo_of_analytic Xi U hXi hAU (hUs.mono hsub0)
  unfold BgLower at hL
  obtain ⟨⟨hS0, hG0, -⟩, hlow⟩ := hL
  have hsubε : Ioo 0 Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 :=
    prod_mono (fun x hx => by simp only [mem_Ioi]; linarith [hx.1]) subset_rfl
  
  have hHk : ∀ k : ℕ, k < n → BgHolo Xi (S k) ∧ BgHolo Xi (G k) := by
    intro k hk
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk0 | hk0
    · rw [hk0, hS0, hG0]
      exact ⟨bgHolo_profRadAvg Xi U hXi hHU, hHF⟩

def BgHolo (Xi : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (fc : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (ρ C : ℕ → ℝ),
    (∀ k, 0 < ρ k ∧ ρ (k + 1) ≤ ρ k) ∧
    (∀ k, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => fc k p.1 p.2) (Ioo 0 Xi ×ˢ cStrip (ρ k))) ∧
    (∀ k X, 0 < X → X < Xi → DifferentiableOn ℂ (fc k X) (cStrip (ρ k)) ∧
        ∀ w ∈ cStrip (ρ k), ‖fc k X w‖ ≤ C k) ∧
    (∀ k X (w : ℂ), 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip (ρ (k + 1)) →
        HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => fc k Y w) (fc (k + 1) X w) X) ∧
    (∀ (X η : ℝ), 0 < X → X < Xi → -1 < η → η < 1 → fc 0 X (η : ℂ) = ((f X η : ℝ) : ℂ))


noncomputable def bgKer (k : ℝ → ℝ) (r : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  X * ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, k t * r (t * X) η

noncomputable def bgkG (t : ℝ) : ℝ := (1 - t) / 2
noncomputable def bgkGp (t : ℝ) : ℝ := t / 2
noncomputable def bgkU (t : ℝ) : ℝ := -Real.log t / 2
noncomputable def bgkUp (_t : ℝ) : ℝ := 1 / 2
noncomputable def bgkS (t : ℝ) : ℝ := (t - 1 - Real.log t) / 2


noncomputable def bgCoefA (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (G0 S0 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Fin 6 → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := ![
  fun X η => (-(-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) + 2 * (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * η * bgUz S0 X η) /
      (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) + bgVx h 0 S0 X η,
  fun X η => (1 - 2 * η * bgUz S0 X η) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) + bgVx h 0 S0 X η,
  fun X η => ((1 / 2 - h) * η + (1 - η ^ 2) * bgUz S0 X η) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2),
  fun X η => 2 * η * (G0 X η + X * pdX G0 X η) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) + simZop h (-(1 + h)) G0 X η,
  fun X η => -(2 * (1 / 2 - h + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * η * (G0 X η + X * pdX G0 X η)) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2),
  fun X η => -((1 - η ^ 2) * (G0 X η + X * pdX G0 X η)) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)]


noncomputable def bgCoefB (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (S0 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Fin 8 → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := ![
  fun X η => (-(-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) + 2 * (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * η * bgUz S0 X η) /
      (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) + 2 * η * X * pdX (bgUz S0) X η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) +
      simZop h (-(1 / 2 + h)) (bgUz S0) X η,
  fun X η => (1 - 2 * η * bgUz S0 X η) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) + bgVx h 0 S0 X η,
  fun X η => ((1 / 2 - h) * η + (1 - η ^ 2) * bgUz S0 X η) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2),
  fun X η => -(2 * (1 / 2 - h + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * η * (X * pdX (bgUz S0) X η)) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2),
  fun X η => -((1 - η ^ 2) * (X * pdX (bgUz S0) X η)) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2),
  fun _ η => 2 * (-(1 + 2 * h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2),
  fun _ η => (1 - η ^ 2) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2),
  fun _ η => -(2 * η) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)]


noncomputable def bgKTh (h : ℝ) (S G : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ioo 0 n,
      (bgVx h i (S i) X η * (G (n - i) X η + X * pdX (G (n - i)) X η)
        + bgUz (S i) X η * simZop h (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((n - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) (G (n - i)) X η))
    - simZop h (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h))
        (simZop h (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) (G (n - 1))) X η


noncomputable def bgKZ (h : ℝ) (S : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ioo 0 n,
      (X * bgVx h i (S i) X η * pdX (bgUz (S (n - i))) X η
        + bgUz (S i) X η * simZop h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((n - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) (bgUz (S (n - i))) X η))
    - simZop h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h))
        (simZop h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) (bgUz (S (n - 1)))) X η


noncomputable def bgKRad (h : ℝ) (S G : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ioo 0 n, G i X η * G (n - i) X η) - bgOm h S (n - 1) X η / 2

signature.statement: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ), 0 < a → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ico 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X1 : ℝ, X1 < a → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioo (-1) a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X < a → g X η = f X η) ∧ (∀ X1 : ℝ, X1 < a → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro f a ha hf hbd
  obtain ⟨c, hcs, hcid⟩ := seeley_coeffs_exist seeley_lagrange_identity
  obtain ⟨H, hHs, hHvan, hHbd, hHlim⟩ := seeley_cutoff f a ha hf hbd
  obtain ⟨hWs, hWd⟩ := seeley_reflected_series H c (a / 2) (by positivity) hHs hHvan
  have hLN : Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Iio 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 :=
    prod_mono Ioo_subset_Iio_self subset_rfl
  have hlim : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ∀ m : ℕ,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun p => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
        (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∑' k : ℕ, c k * H (-(2:ℝ) ^ k * q.1, q.2)) p)
        (nhdsWithin ((0:ℝ), η) (Ioo (-1) 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1))
        (nhds (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (↿f) (Ico 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ((0:ℝ), η))) := by
    intro η₀ h1 h2 m
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hHbd m
    have h6 := seeley_series_boundary_limit H c m K η₀ _ (hcs m) hK (hHlim η₀ h1 h2 m)
    rw [(seeley_multilinear_reflect c hcs hcid m _).tsum_eq] at h6
    have h6' := h6.congr' (eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall fun p hp => (hWd m p hp).symm)
    exact h6'.mono_left (nhdsWithin_mono _ hLN)
  set g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun X η => if 0 ≤ X then f X η else
      (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∑' k : ℕ, c k * H (-(2:ℝ) ^ k * q.1, q.2)) (X, η) with hg
  have hgs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioo (-1) a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
    contDiffOn_glue_halfstrip a (↿f) _ ha hf (hWs.mono hLN) hlim
  have hge : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → g X η = f X η := fun X η h => by
    simp only [hg, if_pos h]
  refine ⟨g, hgs, fun X η h _ => hge X η h, ?_⟩
  intro X1 hX1 m
  have hX2 : max X1 (a / 2) < a := max_lt hX1 (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbd (max X1 (a / 2)) hX2 m
  have hint : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ max X1 (a / 2) → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C := by
    intro X η h0 hX e1 e2
    have hev : (↿g) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)] (↿f) := by
      filter_upwards [(isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds
        (show ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) from ⟨h0, mem_univ _⟩)] with p hp
      exact hge p.1 p.2 (le_of_lt hp.1)
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
    exact hC X η h0 hX e1 e2
  refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
  intro X η h0 hX e1 e2
  rcases h0.lt_or_eq with h0 | h0
  · exact hint X η h0 (hX.trans (le_max_left _ _)) e1 e2
  · subst h0
    have hT : IsOpen (Ioo (-1 : ℝ) a ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g)) (Ioo (-1) a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
      (hgs.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hT.uniqueDiffOn).congr
        (fun x hx => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hT hx).symm)
    have hca : ContinuousAt (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g)) ((0:ℝ), η) :=
      hcont.continuousAt (hT.mem_nhds ⟨⟨by norm_num, ha⟩, e1, e2⟩)
    have hpath : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => ((t, η) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const
    have hline : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (t, η))
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (nhds (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (0, η))) :=
      ((hca.tendsto.comp (hpath.tendsto 0)).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds)
    refine le_of_tendsto hline.norm ?_
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (show (0:ℝ) < a / 2 by linarith)] with t ht
    exact hint t η ht.1 (ht.2.le.trans (le_max_right _ _)) e1 e2

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (H : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (b : ℝ), 0 < b → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, b ≤ p.1 → H p = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∑' k : ℕ, c k * H (-(2:ℝ) ^ k * p.1, p.2)) (Iio 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (p : ℝ × ℝ), p ∈ Iio (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 → iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∑' k : ℕ, c k * H (-(2:ℝ) ^ k * q.1, q.2)) p = ∑' k : ℕ, c k • (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m H (-(2:ℝ) ^ k * p.1, p.2)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ : Fin m => ContinuousLinearMap.prodMap ((-(2:ℝ) ^ k) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))

signature.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab ε Xm Xs Xi : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (Si Gi Wi : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → 0 < Xm → Xm < Xi → Xi < p1 → Xv < Xs → 1 ≤ n → BgLower h ε Xm Xs Xi m1 m2 F U S G W n → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Si) (Ioo (-1) Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Gi) (Ioo (-1) Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Wi) (Ioo (-1) Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X1 : ℝ, X1 < Xi → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Si) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Gi) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Wi) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → BgAnalytic Xi Si → BgAnalytic Xi Gi → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi → -1 < η → η < 1 → bgResRad h (Function.update S n Si) (Function.update G n Gi) (Function.update W n Wi) n X η = 0 ∧ bgResTh h (Function.update S n Si) (Function.update G n Gi) (Function.update W n Wi) n X η = 0 ∧ bgResZ h (Function.update S n Si) (Function.update G n Gi) (Function.update W n Wi) n X η = 0) → ∃ (Sn Gn Wn : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), BgOrdPre h ε Xm Xs Xi m1 m2 (Function.update S n Sn) (Function.update G n Gn) (Function.update W n Wn) n ∧ BgMom (Function.update S n Sn) (Function.update G n Gn) (Function.update W n Wn) n

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab ε Xm Xs Xi F U T0th T0z S G W n Si Gi Wi
    hLP hε hε1 hF hU hXm0 hXmXi hXip1 hXvXs hn hLow hSi hGi hWi hbd hASi hAGi hres
  have hLP' := hLP
  unfold LeadingProfile at hLP'
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, hh1, hlam, -, hcp, -, -, -, -, hp12, hp2m1, hm12, hm2Xv, -, -⟩,
    -, -, -, ⟨εL, -, -, -, -, hLbd⟩, -, -, hLv, hLp, -, -⟩ := hLP'
  have hLow' := hLow
  unfold BgLower at hLow'
  obtain ⟨⟨hS0, hG0, -⟩, hlow⟩ := hLow'
  have hh2 : h < 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have hn0 : (0:ℕ) ≠ n := by omega
  have hΩo : IsOpen (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  obtain ⟨Xk, hXk⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = (Xm + Xi) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Xt, hXt⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = (Xk + Xi) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨pb, hpb⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = (p1 + p2) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hXmXk : Xm < Xk := by rw [hXk]; linarith
  have hXkXt : Xk < Xt := by rw [hXt, hXk]; linarith
  have hXtXi : Xt < Xi := by rw [hXt, hXk]; linarith
  have hp1pb : p1 < pb := by rw [hpb]; linarith
  have hpbp2 : pb < p2 := by rw [hpb]; linarith
  have hp2Xs : p2 < Xs := by linarith
  have hXs0 : 0 < Xs := by linarith
  
  obtain ⟨hcAM, hcPD, hcC, hcX, hcE, -, hcPhi, hcFrz, hcCg, hcSum⟩ := bg_good_closure ε h hε hh0 hh2
  have gadd : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε g →
      bgCoefGood ε (fun X η => f X η + g X η) := fun f g hf hg => (hcAM f g hf hg).1
  have gmul : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε g →
      bgCoefGood ε (fun X η => f X η * g X η) := fun f g hf hg => (hcAM f g hf hg).2
  have gUz : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (bgUz f) := fun f hf =>
    gadd f (fun X η => X * pdX f X η) hf (gmul (fun X _ => X) (pdX f) hcX (hcPD f hf).1)
  have gprim : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε g → ∀ a : ℝ, 0 ≤ a →
      bgCoefGood ε (fun (_ η : ℝ) => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..a, g x η) := fun g hg a ha =>
    hcFrz (fun X η => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, g x η) a ha (param_primitive_good ε g hε hg)
  
  have hder : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → ∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      HasDerivAt (fun Y => f Y η) (pdX f X η) X := by
    intro f hf X η hX e1 e2
    have hca : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (↿f) (X, η) := hf.1.contDiffAt (hΩo.mem_nhds ⟨hX, e1, e2⟩)
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ((↿f) ∘ (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, η))) X :=
      (hca.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).comp X (differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const η))
    exact hd.hasDerivAt
  have hcon : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ContinuousOn (fun Y => f Y η) (Ioi (-ε)) := fun f hf η e1 e2 Y hY =>
    (hder f hf Y η hY e1 e2).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hII : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn g (Ioi (-ε)) → ∀ a b : ℝ, -ε < a → -ε < b →
      IntervalIntegrable g volume a b := by
    intro g hg a b ha hb
    refine (hg.mono ?_).intervalIntegrable
    intro x hx
    rcases Set.mem_uIcc.mp hx with h1 | h1 <;> simp only [mem_Ioi] <;> linarith [h1.1]
  
  have gF : bgCoefGood ε F :=
    ⟨hF, fun X1 m => (hLbd X1 m).imp fun C hC X η a b c d => (hC X η a b c d).1⟩
  obtain ⟨hpa1, hpa2, hpa3⟩ := profRadAvg_props U ε hε hU
  have gSz : bgCoefGood ε (S 0) := by
    rw [hS0]
    exact ⟨hpa1, fun X1 m => hpa2 X1 m ((hLbd X1 m).imp fun C hC X η a b c d => (hC X η a b c d).2)⟩
  have gGz : bgCoefGood ε (G 0) := by rw [hG0]; exact gF
  have glow : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i < n → bgCoefGood ε (S i) ∧ bgCoefGood ε (G i) := by
    intro i h1 h2
    have hp := (hlow i h1 h2).1
    unfold BgOrdPre at hp
    exact ⟨⟨hp.1.1, fun X1 m => (hp.2.1 m).imp fun C hC X η a _ c d => (hC X η a c d).1⟩,
      ⟨hp.1.2.1, fun X1 m => (hp.2.1 m).imp fun C hC X η a _ c d => (hC X η a c d).2.1⟩⟩
  have gupd : ∀ (T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), bgCoefGood ε (T 0) →
      (∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i < n → bgCoefGood ε (T i)) → bgCoefGood ε f →
      ∀ i, i ≤ n → bgCoefGood ε (Function.update T n f i) := by
    intro T f h0 hm hf i hi
    rcases eq_or_ne i n with rfl | hin
    · rw [Function.update_self]; exact hf
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hin]
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with rfl | hi0
      · exact h0
      · exact hm i hi0 (lt_of_le_of_ne hi hin)
  
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ : ∃ k : ℝ → ℝ, k = fun X => Real.smoothTransition ((Xt - X) / (Xt - Xk)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hκs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ κ := by
    rw [hκ]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp ((contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id).div_const _)
  have hκ1 : ∀ X, X ≤ Xk → κ X = 1 := by
    intro X hX; simp only [hκ]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]; linarith)
  have hκ0 : ∀ X, Xt ≤ X → κ X = 0 := by
    intro X hX; simp only [hκ]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
      (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith))
  have gκf : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioo (-1) Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      (∀ X1 : ℝ, X1 < Xi → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → bgCoefGood ε (fun X η => κ X * f X η) :=
    fun f hf hb => cutoff_mul_good ε Xt Xi κ f hε hε1 hXtXi hκs hκ0 hf hb
  have gκSi := gκf Si hSi
    (fun X1 h1 m => (hbd X1 h1 m).imp fun C hC X η a b c d => (hC X η a b c d).1)
  have gκGi := gκf Gi hGi
    (fun X1 h1 m => (hbd X1 h1 m).imp fun C hC X η a b c d => (hC X η a b c d).2.1)
  have gκWi := gκf Wi hWi
    (fun X1 h1 m => (hbd X1 h1 m).imp fun C hC X η a b c d => (hC X η a b c d).2.2)
  
  obtain ⟨cb, hcbs, hcbz, hcbi⟩ := dual_power_bumps 1 ![-lam] p1 pb (by linarith) hp1pb
    (fun i j _ => Subsingleton.elim i j)
  obtain ⟨eb, hebs, hebz, hebi⟩ := dual_power_bumps 3 ![1, -1 - lam, -lam] pb p2 (by linarith)
    hpbp2 (by intro i j hij; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp at hij ⊢ <;> linarith)
  have hcI : ∫ x in p1..pb, x ^ (-lam) * cb 0 x = 1 := by simpa using hcbi 0 0
  have he00 : ∫ x in pb..p2, x * eb 0 x = 1 := by simpa using hebi 0 0
  have he01 : ∫ x in pb..p2, x * eb 1 x = 0 := by simpa using hebi 0 1
  have he02 : ∫ x in pb..p2, x * eb 2 x = 0 := by simpa using hebi 0 2
  have he10 : ∫ x in pb..p2, x ^ (-1 - lam) * eb 0 x = 0 := by simpa using hebi 1 0
  have he11 : ∫ x in pb..p2, x ^ (-1 - lam) * eb 1 x = 1 := by simpa using hebi 1 1
  have he12 : ∫ x in pb..p2, x ^ (-1 - lam) * eb 2 x = 0 := by simpa using hebi 1 2
  have he20 : ∫ x in pb..p2, x ^ (-lam) * eb 0 x = 0 := by simpa using hebi 2 0
  have he21 : ∫ x in pb..p2, x ^ (-lam) * eb 1 x = 0 := by simpa using hebi 2 1
  have he22 : ∫ x in pb..p2, x ^ (-lam) * eb 2 x = 1 := by simpa using hebi 2 2
  have gcb : bgCoefGood ε (fun X (_ : ℝ) => cb 0 X) := hcPhi _ (hcbs 0)
  have geb : ∀ j, bgCoefGood ε (fun X (_ : ℝ) => eb j X) := fun j => hcPhi _ (hebs j)
  
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ, f = fun η => cpatch * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ / Real.sqrt 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ, f = fun η => Real.sqrt 2 / cpatch * (1 + η * η) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hs2 : (0:ℝ) < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)
  have hφψ : ∀ η, φ η * ψ η = 1 := by
    intro η; simp only [hφ, hψ]
    have h3 : (0:ℝ) < 1 + η ^ 2 := by positivity
    first | (field_simp; ring) | field_simp
  have hPF2 : ∀ X η, p1 ≤ X → X ≤ p2 → -1 < η → η < 1 → F X η = φ η * X ^ (-1 - lam) := by
    intro X η h1 h2 e1 e2
    have hX : 0 < X := by linarith
    have hq := (hLp X η (Or.inl ⟨h1, h2⟩) e1 e2).2
    have hs : Real.sqrt (2 * X) = Real.sqrt 2 * X ^ ((1:ℝ) / 2) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num), Real.sqrt_eq_rpow X]
    have hr : X ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam)) = X ^ ((1:ℝ) / 2) * X ^ (-1 - lam) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hX]; congr 1; ring
    rw [hs, hr] at hq
    have hne : Real.sqrt 2 * X ^ ((1:ℝ) / 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hne
    rw [hq]; simp only [hφ]
    first | (field_simp; ring) | field_simp | ring
  have hPF3 : ∀ X η, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → bgUz (S 0) X η = U X η := by
    intro X η hX e1 e2
    have h1 := (hpa3 X η hX e1 e2).2
    have hd := hder (S 0) gSz X η hX e1 e2
    rw [hS0] at hd
    have h2 := (hasDerivAt_id' X).mul hd
    rw [hS0]; unfold bgUz
    rw [h1.unique h2]; ring
  have hXv0 : 0 < Xv := by linarith
  have hPF4 : ∀ X η, Xv ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → S 0 X η = 0 := by
    intro X η hX e1 e2
    have h1 := (hpa3 X η (by linarith) e1 e2).1
    rw [(hLv X η hX e1 e2).2] at h1
    rw [hS0]
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h1 with h | h
    · linarith
    · exact h
  
  obtain ⟨S0', hS0'⟩ : ∃ T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, T = Function.update S n (fun X η => κ X * Si X η) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨G0', hG0'⟩ : ∃ T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, T = Function.update G n (fun X η => κ X * Gi X η) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨m4z, hm4z⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ, f = fun η => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xs,
      x * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), bgUz (S0' i) x η * G0' (n - i) x η := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ, f = fun η => m4z η * ψ η * (-1 / lam) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Sn, hSn⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, f = fun X η => κ X * Si X η + α η * cb 0 X := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨S', hS'⟩ : ∃ T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, T = Function.update S n Sn := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨src0, hsrc0⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, f = fun X η =>
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), G0' i X η * G0' (n - i) X η - bgOm h S' (n - 1) X η / 2 :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨P0, hP0⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, f = fun X η => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, src0 x η := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨m5z, hm5z⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ, f = fun η => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xs,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), bgUz (S' i) x η * bgUz (S' (n - i)) x η - x * src0 x η) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨β1, hβ1⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ, f = fun η => (-1) * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xs, x * (κ x * Gi x η) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨β2, hβ2⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ,
      f = fun η => (Wi Xm η + P0 Xs η + (-1) * P0 Xm η) * ψ η * (-1 / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨β3, hβ3⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ, f = fun η => m5z η * ψ η * (1 / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Eb, hEb⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
      f = fun X η => β1 η * eb 0 X + β2 η * eb 1 X + β3 η * eb 2 X := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Gn, hGn⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, f = fun X η => κ X * Gi X η + Eb X η := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨G', hG'⟩ : ∃ T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, T = Function.update G n Gn := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨src, hsrc⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, f = fun X η =>
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), G' i X η * G' (n - i) X η - bgOm h S' (n - 1) X η / 2 :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, f = fun X η => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, src x η := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Wn, hWn⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
      f = fun X η => if -1 < η ∧ η < 1 then P X η - P Xs η else 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨W', hW'⟩ : ∃ T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, T = Function.update W n Wn := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hS'n : S' n = Sn := by rw [hS']; exact Function.update_self _ _ _
  have hS'i : ∀ i, i ≠ n → S' i = S i := fun i hi => by rw [hS']; exact Function.update_of_ne hi _ _
  have hG'n : G' n = Gn := by rw [hG']; exact Function.update_self _ _ _
  have hG'i : ∀ i, i ≠ n → G' i = G i := fun i hi => by rw [hG']; exact Function.update_of_ne hi _ _
  have hW'n : W' n = Wn := by rw [hW']; exact Function.update_self _ _ _
  have hS0'n : S0' n = fun X η => κ X * Si X η := by rw [hS0']; exact Function.update_self _ _ _
  have hS0'i : ∀ i, i ≠ n → S0' i = S i := fun i hi => by
    rw [hS0']; exact Function.update_of_ne hi _ _
  have hG0'n : G0' n = fun X η => κ X * Gi X η := by rw [hG0']; exact Function.update_self _ _ _
  have hG0'i : ∀ i, i ≠ n → G0' i = G i := fun i hi => by
    rw [hG0']; exact Function.update_of_ne hi _ _
  
  have gconst : ∀ c : ℝ, bgCoefGood ε (fun (_ _ : ℝ) => c) := hcC
  have gψ : bgCoefGood ε (fun (_ η : ℝ) => ψ η) := by
    rw [hψ]
    exact gmul (fun _ _ => Real.sqrt 2 / cpatch) (fun _ η => 1 + η * η) (hcC _)
      (gadd (fun _ _ => 1) (fun _ η => η * η) (hcC 1) (gmul (fun _ η => η) (fun _ η => η) hcE hcE))
  have gS0' : ∀ i, i ≤ n → bgCoefGood ε (S0' i) := by
    rw [hS0']; exact gupd S _ gSz (fun i a b => (glow i a b).1) gκSi
  have gG0' : ∀ i, i ≤ n → bgCoefGood ε (G0' i) := by
    rw [hG0']; exact gupd G _ gGz (fun i a b => (glow i a b).2) gκGi
  have gI4 : bgCoefGood ε (fun X η =>
      X * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), bgUz (S0' i) X η * G0' (n - i) X η) :=
    gmul (fun X _ => X) _ hcX (hcSum _ (fun i X η => bgUz (S0' i) X η * G0' (n - i) X η)
      (fun i hi => gmul _ _ (gUz _ (gS0' i (by simp at hi; omega))) (gG0' _ (by omega))))
  have gm4z : bgCoefGood ε (fun (_ η : ℝ) => m4z η) := by
    rw [hm4z]; exact gprim _ gI4 Xs hXs0.le
  have gα : bgCoefGood ε (fun (_ η : ℝ) => α η) := by
    rw [hα]
    exact gmul (fun _ η => m4z η * ψ η) (fun _ _ => -1 / lam)
