signature.statement: ∀ (h Pst : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (ε Bd C T θ Kb Ks MP s1 s2 : ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ) (Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ : ℝ) (ℓ G : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), AxGlue h Pst Pax ε Bd C T θ Kb Ks MP s1 s2 β γ c Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ ℓ G F U → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → |axUm Pst C G U β c X η - 4 * η| ≤ ε + 2 * θ * Kb ∧ |deriv (fun e => axUm Pst C G U β c X e) η - 4| ≤ ε + 2 * θ * Kb) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 110 ≤ X → X < 110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10 * Real.exp (-8) → -1 < η → η < 1 → deriv (fun Y => axUm Pst C G U β c Y η) X = 0) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10 * Real.exp (-8) ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → |X * deriv (fun Y => axUm Pst C G U β c Y η) X| ≤ Ks * ε + 2 * θ * Kb)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Pst Pax ε Bd C T θ Kb Ks MP s1 s2 β γ c Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ ℓ G F U hG
  obtain ⟨hD, hIn, hε0, hε1, hBump, hKbβ, hKbγ, hCoef, hθ0, hk, h3θ, hKs, hT, hMP, hE2, hXR, hKc⟩ := hG
  have hPst : 0 < Pst := hD.2.2.1
  obtain ⟨⟨-, -, -, -, -, hτ, -, hC1⟩, -, -, hexpl, -, hGs, hη, hin, -⟩ := hIn
  obtain ⟨hs1, -, -, hβs, -, hβ0, -⟩ := hBump
  obtain ⟨hcs, -, hcb⟩ := hCoef
  have hKb0 : 0 ≤ Kb := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hKbβ 0 0).1
  have hKs0 : 0 ≤ Ks := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hKs 0)
  have hCP : 0 < C * Pst := mul_pos (by linarith) hPst
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, R = 110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hR0 : 0 < R := by rw [hR]; positivity
  have hθK : 0 ≤ θ * Kb := mul_nonneg hθ0 hKb0
  
  have hcomp : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ∀ i : Fin 5,
      HasDerivAt (fun e => c e i) (deriv c η i) η ∧ |c η i| ≤ θ ∧ |deriv c η i| ≤ θ := by
    intro η h1 h2 i
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ c η :=
      (hcs.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2)
    refine ⟨hasDerivAt_pi.mp hd.hasDerivAt i, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := norm_le_pi_norm (c η) i
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      exact this.trans (hcb η h1 h2).1
    · have := norm_le_pi_norm (deriv c η) i
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      exact this.trans (hcb η h1 h2).2
  have hprod : ∀ a b : ℝ, |a| ≤ θ → |b| ≤ Kb → |a * b| ≤ θ * Kb := fun a b ha hb => by
    rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul ha hb (abs_nonneg _) hθ0
  
  have hX8 : 110 < R * Real.exp (-8) := by
    have hT1 : 1 ≤ T := by
      have : 0 ≤ 40 * Ks * (|Bd| + 1) :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hKs0) (by positivity)
      linarith
    have he : 2 + T ≤ Real.exp (1 + T) := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1 + T)]
    have h98 : R * Real.exp (-9) ≤ R * Real.exp (-8) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by norm_num)) hR0.le
    rw [← hR] at hXR
    linarith
  
  have hA : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      |axUm Pst C G U β c X η - 4 * η| ≤ ε + 2 * θ * Kb ∧
      |deriv (fun e => axUm Pst C G U β c X e) η - 4| ≤ ε + 2 * θ * Kb := by
    intro X η hX0 h1 h2
    by_cases hX : X ≤ 110
    · have hfun : (fun e => axUm Pst C G U β c X e) = fun e => U X e := by
        funext e; simp only [axUm, if_pos hX]
      have hv : axUm Pst C G U β c X η = U X η := by simp only [axUm, if_pos hX]
      have := hin X η hX0 hX h1 h2
      rw [hfun, hv]
      constructor <;> linarith [this.1, this.2.1]
    · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, s = Real.smoothTransition (Real.log (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) + 8) :=
        ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨v0, hv0⟩ : ∃ v, v = β 0 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨v1, hv1⟩ : ∃ v, v = β 1 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := by rw [hs]; exact Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _
      have hs1' : s ≤ 1 := by rw [hs]; exact Real.smoothTransition.le_one _
      have hv0b : |v0| ≤ Kb := by rw [hv0]; exact (hKbβ 0 _).1
      have hv1b : |v1| ≤ Kb := by rw [hv1]; exact (hKbβ 1 _).1
      have key : ∀ a : ℝ, |(1 - s) * a| ≤ |a| := fun a => by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - s)]
        have := abs_nonneg a
        nlinarith
      have hfun : (fun e => axUm Pst C G U β c X e) =
          fun e => G e + s * (4 * e - G e) + (c e 0 * v0 + c e 1 * v1) := by
        funext e; simp only [axUm, if_neg hX, ← hs, ← hv0, ← hv1]
      have hv : axUm Pst C G U β c X η = G η + s * (4 * η - G η) + (c η 0 * v0 + c η 1 * v1) := by
        simp only [axUm, if_neg hX, ← hs, ← hv0, ← hv1]
      have hGd : DifferentiableAt ℝ G η :=
        (hGs.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2)
      obtain ⟨hc0d, hc0, hc0'⟩ := hcomp η h1 h2 0
      obtain ⟨hc1d, hc1, hc1'⟩ := hcomp η h1 h2 1
      have hd : HasDerivAt (fun e => G e + s * (4 * e - G e) + (c e 0 * v0 + c e 1 * v1))
          (deriv G η + s * (4 * 1 - deriv G η) + (deriv c η 0 * v0 + deriv c η 1 * v1)) η :=
        (hGd.hasDerivAt.add ((((hasDerivAt_id' η).const_mul 4).sub hGd.hasDerivAt).const_mul s)).add
          ((hc0d.mul_const v0).add (hc1d.mul_const v1))
      rw [hfun, hv, hd.deriv]
      have p0 := hprod _ _ hc0 hv0b
      have p1 := hprod _ _ hc1 hv1b
      have p0' := hprod _ _ hc0' hv0b
      have p1' := hprod _ _ hc1' hv1b
      constructor
      · rw [show G η + s * (4 * η - G η) + (c η 0 * v0 + c η 1 * v1) - 4 * η =
            (1 - s) * (G η - 4 * η) + (c η 0 * v0 + c η 1 * v1) by ring]
        have k1 := (key (G η - 4 * η)).trans (hη η h1 h2).2.2.1
        have t1 := abs_add_le ((1 - s) * (G η - 4 * η)) (c η 0 * v0 + c η 1 * v1)
        have t2 := abs_add_le (c η 0 * v0) (c η 1 * v1)
        linarith
      · rw [show deriv G η + s * (4 * 1 - deriv G η) + (deriv c η 0 * v0 + deriv c η 1 * v1) - 4 =
            (1 - s) * (deriv G η - 4) + (deriv c η 0 * v0 + deriv c η 1 * v1) by ring]
        have k1 := (key (deriv G η - 4)).trans (hη η h1 h2).2.2.2.1
        have t1 := abs_add_le ((1 - s) * (deriv G η - 4)) (deriv c η 0 * v0 + deriv c η 1 * v1)
        have t2 := abs_add_le (deriv c η 0 * v0) (deriv c η 1 * v1)
        linarith
  
  have hB : ∀ X η : ℝ, 110 ≤ X → X < 110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10 * Real.exp (-8) → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      deriv (fun Y => axUm Pst C G U β c Y η) X = 0 := by
    intro X η hX1 hX2 h1 h2
    rw [← hR] at hX2
    have hea : 110 * Real.exp (-τ) < 110 := by
      have : Real.exp (-τ) < 1 := by
        have := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (show -τ < 0 by linarith)
        rwa [Real.exp_zero] at this
      linarith
    have hev : (fun Y => axUm Pst C G U β c Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X] fun _ => G η := by
      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
        (Ioo_mem_nhds (show 110 * Real.exp (-τ) < X by linarith) hX2) ?_
      intro Y hY
      by_cases hY1 : Y ≤ 110
      · simp only [axUm, if_pos hY1]
        exact (hexpl Y η hY.1.le h1 h2).1
      · have hYpos : 0 < Y := by linarith [not_le.mp hY1]
        have hy0 : 0 < Y / R := div_pos hYpos hR0
        have hy8 : Y / R < Real.exp (-8) := by
          rw [div_lt_iff₀ hR0]; linarith [hY.2]
        have hlog : Real.log (Y / R) + 8 ≤ 0 := by
          have := Real.log_lt_log hy0 hy8
          rw [Real.log_exp] at this; linarith
        have hσ := Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos hlog
        have hys : Y / R ≤ s1 := by
          have : Real.exp (-8) < Real.exp (-6) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by norm_num)
          linarith
        have hb0 := hβ0 0 (Y / R) (Or.inl hys)
        have hb1 := hβ0 1 (Y / R) (Or.inl hys)
        rw [hR] at hσ hb0 hb1
        simp only [axUm, if_neg hY1, hσ, hb0, hb1]
        ring
    rw [hev.deriv_eq]
    exact deriv_const _ _
  
  have hC : ∀ X η : ℝ, 110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10 * Real.exp (-8) ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      |X * deriv (fun Y => axUm Pst C G U β c Y η) X| ≤ Ks * ε + 2 * θ * Kb := by
    intro X η hX h1 h2
    rw [← hR] at hX
    have hX110 : 110 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hX8 hX
    have hX0 : 0 < X := by linarith
    have hev : (fun Y => axUm Pst C G U β c Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X] fun Y =>
        G η + Real.smoothTransition (Real.log (Y / R) + 8) * (4 * η - G η) +
          (c η 0 * β 0 (Y / R) + c η 1 * β 1 (Y / R)) := by
      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hX110) ?_
      intro Y hY
      have hY' : ¬ Y ≤ 110 := not_le.mpr hY
      rw [hR]
      simp only [axUm, if_neg hY']
    rw [hev.deriv_eq]
    have hq : HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y / R) (1 / R) X := (hasDerivAt_id' X).div_const R
    have hqX : X / R ≠ 0 := (div_pos hX0 hR0).ne'
    have hL : HasDerivAt (fun Y => Real.log (Y / R) + 8) (1 / R / (X / R)) X :=
      (hq.log hqX).add_const 8
    have hσd : HasDerivAt Real.smoothTransition
        (deriv Real.smoothTransition (Real.log (X / R) + 8)) (Real.log (X / R) + 8) :=
      ((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).differentiable (by simp) _).hasDerivAt
    have hσL := hσd.comp X hL
    have hb : ∀ i : Fin 2, HasDerivAt (fun Y => β i (Y / R))
        (deriv (β i) (X / R) * (1 / R)) X := fun i =>
      (((hβs i).differentiable (by simp) _).hasDerivAt).comp X hq
    have hΦ : HasDerivAt (fun Y => G η + Real.smoothTransition (Real.log (Y / R) + 8) * (4 * η - G η) +
          (c η 0 * β 0 (Y / R) + c η 1 * β 1 (Y / R)))
        (0 + deriv Real.smoothTransition (Real.log (X / R) + 8) * (1 / R / (X / R)) * (4 * η - G η) +
          (c η 0 * (deriv (β 0) (X / R) * (1 / R)) + c η 1 * (deriv (β 1) (X / R) * (1 / R)))) X :=
      ((hasDerivAt_const X (G η)).add (hσL.mul_const (4 * η - G η))).add
        (((hb 0).const_mul (c η 0)).add ((hb 1).const_mul (c η 1)))
    rw [hΦ.deriv]
    have hid : X * (1 / R / (X / R)) = 1 := by field_simp
    have e : X * (0 + deriv Real.smoothTransition (Real.log (X / R) + 8) * (1 / R / (X / R)) *
          (4 * η - G η) +
          (c η 0 * (deriv (β 0) (X / R) * (1 / R)) + c η 1 * (deriv (β 1) (X / R) * (1 / R)))) =
        deriv Real.smoothTransition (Real.log (X / R) + 8) * (4 * η - G η) +
          (c η 0 * (X / R * deriv (β 0) (X / R)) + c η 1 * (X / R * deriv (β 1) (X / R))) := by
      linear_combination (deriv Real.smoothTransition (Real.log (X / R) + 8) * (4 * η - G η)) * hid
    rw [e]
    obtain ⟨-, hc0, -⟩ := hcomp η h1 h2 0
    obtain ⟨-, hc1, -⟩ := hcomp η h1 h2 1
    have hAε : |4 * η - G η| ≤ ε := by rw [abs_sub_comm]; exact (hη η h1 h2).2.2.1
    have m1 : |deriv Real.smoothTransition (Real.log (X / R) + 8) * (4 * η - G η)| ≤ Ks * ε := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul (hKs _) hAε (abs_nonneg _) hKs0
    have p0 := hprod _ _ hc0 (hKbβ 0 (X / R)).2
    have p1 := hprod _ _ hc1 (hKbβ 1 (X / R)).2
    have t1 := abs_add_le (deriv Real.smoothTransition (Real.log (X / R) + 8) * (4 * η - G η))
      (c η 0 * (X / R * deriv (β 0) (X / R)) + c η 1 * (X / R * deriv (β 1) (X / R)))
    have t2 := abs_add_le (c η 0 * (X / R * deriv (β 0) (X / R))) (c η 1 * (X / R * deriv (β 1) (X / R)))
    linarith
  exact ⟨hA, hB, hC⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h Pst : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (ε Bd C T θ Kb Ks MP s1 s2 : ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ) (Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ : ℝ) (ℓ G : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), AxGlue h Pst Pax ε Bd C T θ Kb Ks MP s1 s2 β γ c Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ ℓ G F U → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 110 * Real.exp (1 + T) → -1 < η → η < 1 → |axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c X η| ≤ (|Bd| + 1) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) / C ∧ |deriv (fun e => axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c X e) η| ≤ (|Bd| + 1) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) / C) ∧ 220 * Real.exp (1 + T) * ((|Bd| + 1) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) / C) ^ 2 ≤ 1

signature.name: ax_shear_F_inner
signature.statement: ∀ (h Pst : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (ε Bd C T θ Kb Ks MP s1 s2 : ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ) (Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ : ℝ) (ℓ G : ℝ → ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), AxGlue h Pst Pax ε Bd C T θ Kb Ks MP s1 s2 β γ c Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ ℓ G F U → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 110 * Real.exp (1 + T) → -1 < η → η < 1 → |axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c X η| ≤ (|Bd| + 1) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) / C ∧ |deriv (fun e => axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c X e) η| ≤ (|Bd| + 1) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) / C) ∧ 220 * Real.exp (1 + T) * ((|Bd| + 1) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) / C) ^ 2 ≤ 1

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Pst Pax ε Bd C T θ Kb Ks MP s1 s2 β γ c Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ ℓ G F U hG
  obtain ⟨hD, hIn, hε0, hε1, hBump, hKbβ, hKbγ, hCoef, hθ0, hk, h3θ, hKs, hT, hMP, hE2, hXR, hKc⟩ := hG
  have hPst : 0 < Pst := hD.2.2.1
  have hC1 : 1 ≤ C := hIn.1.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  have hC0 : 0 < C := by linarith
  have hKs0 : 0 ≤ Ks := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hKs 0)
  have hT1 : 1 ≤ T := by
    have : 0 ≤ 40 * Ks * (|Bd| + 1) := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hKs0) (by positivity)
    linarith
  have hT0 : 0 < T := by linarith
  have hXRpos : 0 < 110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨hs1, -, -, -, -, -, hγ0⟩ := hBump
  have hPF := ax_disc_profile_facts h Pst Pax ε Bd C T Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ ℓ G F U β γ hPst hT0 hIn
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro X η hX0 hXs h1 h2
    have hx : X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) ≤ s1 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hXRpos]
      have e96 : Real.exp (-9) < Real.exp (-6) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by norm_num)
      have : Real.exp (-9) * (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) ≤ s1 * (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_of_lt (e96.trans hs1)) hXRpos.le
      nlinarith
    have hγz : ∀ j, γ j (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) = 0 := fun j => hγ0 j _ (Or.inl hx)
    have hfun : (fun e => axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c X e) = (fun e => axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0) X e) := by
      funext e
      unfold axFm
      split_ifs
      · rfl
      · simp only [hγz, mul_zero, add_zero]
    have hval : axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c X η = axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ (fun _ => 0) X η := congrFun hfun η
    rw [hval, hfun]
    exact hPF.2.1 X η hX0 hXs h1 h2
  · have ha : 0 ≤ |Bd| := abs_nonneg Bd
    have hW : 0 < Real.exp (2 * |Bd| + 2 + 2 * T) := Real.exp_pos _
    have hE : 0 < Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) := Real.exp_pos _
    have hE1 : 0 < Real.exp (1 + T) := Real.exp_pos _
    have hQ : 3000 * (|Bd| + 2) * Real.exp (2 * |Bd| + 2 + 2 * T) ≤ C := by
      have h1 : 30 * (|Bd| + 2) * Real.exp (2 * |Bd| + 2 + 2 * T) ≤
          30 * (|Bd| + 2) * Real.exp (2 * |Bd| + 2 + 2 * T) * (1 + 110 * Bd ^ 2) :=
        le_mul_of_one_le_right (by positivity) (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg Bd])
      have h2 : C * ε ≤ C * (1 / 100) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hε1 hC0.le
      linarith
    have hexp : Real.exp (1 + T) * (Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T)) ≤
        Real.exp (2 * |Bd| + 2 + 2 * T) * Real.exp (2 * |Bd| + 2 + 2 * T) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    have hQ2 : (3000 * (|Bd| + 2) * Real.exp (2 * |Bd| + 2 + 2 * T)) ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hQ 2
    have hab : (|Bd| + 1) ^ 2 ≤ (|Bd| + 2) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by linarith) 2
    have key : 220 * (|Bd| + 1) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (1 + T) * (Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T)))
        ≤ C ^ 2 := by
      have s1' : 220 * (|Bd| + 1) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (1 + T) * (Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T)))
          ≤ 220 * (|Bd| + 2) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (2 * |Bd| + 2 + 2 * T) * Real.exp (2 * |Bd| + 2 + 2 * T)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hab (by norm_num)) hexp (by positivity) (by positivity)
      have s2' : 220 * (|Bd| + 2) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (2 * |Bd| + 2 + 2 * T) * Real.exp (2 * |Bd| + 2 + 2 * T))
          ≤ (3000 * (|Bd| + 2) * Real.exp (2 * |Bd| + 2 + 2 * T)) ^ 2 := by
        have : 0 ≤ (|Bd| + 2) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (2 * |Bd| + 2 + 2 * T) * Real.exp (2 * |Bd| + 2 + 2 * T)) := by
          positivity
        nlinarith
      linarith
    have hEq : 220 * Real.exp (1 + T) * ((|Bd| + 1) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) / C) ^ 2 =
        220 * (|Bd| + 1) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (1 + T) * (Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T) * Real.exp (|Bd| + 2 + T))) / C ^ 2 := by
      field_simp
    rw [hEq, div_le_one (by positivity)]
    exact key

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Pst Pax ε Bd C T θ Kb Ks MP s1 s2 β γ c Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 aa τ ℓ G F U hG
  obtain ⟨hD, hIn, hε0, hε1, hBump, hKbβ, hKbγ, hCoef, hθ0, hk, h3θ, hKs, hT, hMP, hE2, hXR, hKc⟩ := hG
  have hPst : 0 < Pst := hD.2.2.1
  have hC1 : 1 ≤ C := hIn.1.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  have hC0 : 0 < C := by linarith
  have hCne : C ≠ 0 := hC0.ne'
  have hPne : Pst ≠ 0 := hPst.ne'
  have hKs0 : 0 ≤ Ks := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hKs 0)
  have hT0 : 0 < T := by
    have : 0 ≤ 40 * Ks * (|Bd| + 1) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hK : 0 < C * Pst := mul_pos hC0 hPst
  have hXR0 : 0 < 110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨hs1, -, -, -, -, -, hγ0⟩ := hBump
  obtain ⟨hcs, -, hcb⟩ := hCoef
  
  have hform : ∀ X e : ℝ, 110 * Real.exp (1 + T) ≤ X →
      axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c X e = (Pst * (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) +
        (c e 2 * γ 0 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) + c e 3 * γ 1 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) +
          c e 4 * γ 2 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)))) / Real.sqrt (2 * X) := by
    intro X e hX
    have he1 : 1 < Real.exp (1 + T) := by have := Real.add_one_le_exp (1 + T); linarith
    have hX110 : ¬ X ≤ 110 := by intro h'; linarith
    unfold axFm
    rw [if_neg hX110]
    have hXe : Real.exp (1 + T) ≤ X / 110 := by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
    have hlog : 1 + T ≤ Real.log (X / 110) := by
      have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hXe
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
    have hσ : Real.smoothTransition ((Real.log (X / 110) - 1) / T) = 1 := by
      apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hT0]; linarith
    have hlam : Real.exp (axLam T ℓ X e) = (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      unfold axLam
      rw [hσ, sub_self, zero_mul, zero_add, one_mul, Real.exp_log (by positivity)]
    have hy0 : 0 ≤ X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) := div_nonneg (by linarith) hXR0.le
    have hsplit : X / 110 = (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) * (C * Pst) ^ (10 : ℕ) := by
      field_simp
    have hroot : ((C * Pst) ^ (10 : ℕ)) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) = C * Pst := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hK.le]; norm_num
    rw [hlam, hsplit, Real.mul_rpow hy0 (by positivity), hroot]
    rw [show (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * ((X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) * (C * Pst)) / C =
        Pst * (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) from by
      rw [div_eq_iff hCne]; ring]
  
  have hbump : ∀ y η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      HasDerivAt (fun e => c e 2 * γ 0 y + c e 3 * γ 1 y + c e 4 * γ 2 y)
        (deriv c η 2 * γ 0 y + deriv c η 3 * γ 1 y + deriv c η 4 * γ 2 y) η ∧
      |c η 2 * γ 0 y + c η 3 * γ 1 y + c η 4 * γ 2 y| ≤ 3 * θ * Kb ∧
      |deriv c η 2 * γ 0 y + deriv c η 3 * γ 1 y + deriv c η 4 * γ 2 y| ≤ 3 * θ * Kb := by
    intro y η h1 h2
    have hd : HasDerivAt c (deriv c η) η :=
      ((hcs.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2)).hasDerivAt
    have hdi := hasDerivAt_pi.mp hd
    obtain ⟨hn, hdn⟩ := hcb η h1 h2
    have hci : ∀ i, |c η i| ≤ θ := fun i => by
      have := norm_le_pi_norm (c η) i
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      linarith
    have hdci : ∀ i, |deriv c η i| ≤ θ := fun i => by
      have := norm_le_pi_norm (deriv c η) i
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      linarith
    have hprod : ∀ a b : ℝ, |a| ≤ θ → |b| ≤ Kb → |a * b| ≤ θ * Kb := fun a b ha hb => by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul ha hb (abs_nonneg _) hθ0
    have hsum : ∀ a1 a2 a3 : ℝ, |a1| ≤ θ * Kb → |a2| ≤ θ * Kb → |a3| ≤ θ * Kb →
        |a1 + a2 + a3| ≤ 3 * θ * Kb := by
      intro a1 a2 a3 b1 b2 b3
      have i1 := abs_add_le (a1 + a2) a3
      have i2 := abs_add_le a1 a2
      linarith
    refine ⟨(((hdi 2).mul_const _).add ((hdi 3).mul_const _)).add ((hdi 4).mul_const _), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hsum _ _ _ (hprod _ _ (hci 2) (hKbγ 0 y).1) (hprod _ _ (hci 3) (hKbγ 1 y).1)
        (hprod _ _ (hci 4) (hKbγ 2 y).1)
    · exact hsum _ _ _ (hprod _ _ (hdci 2) (hKbγ 0 y).1) (hprod _ _ (hdci 3) (hKbγ 1 y).1)
        (hprod _ _ (hdci 4) (hKbγ 2 y).1)
  
  have hq : ∀ y : ℝ, Real.exp (-8) ≤ y → 256 / 625 ≤ y ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : Real.exp (-8) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) ≤ y ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow (Real.exp_pos _).le hy (by norm_num)
    have h2 : Real.exp (-8) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) = Real.exp (-1 / 5) ^ 4 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_mul, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]; norm_num
    have h3 : (4 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (-1 / 5) := by
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp (-1 / 5); linarith
    have h4 : (4 / 5 : ℝ) ^ 4 ≤ Real.exp (-1 / 5) ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) h3 4
    have h5 : (4 / 5 : ℝ) ^ 4 = 256 / 625 := by norm_num
    linarith
  
  have hfd : ∀ η : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹) (-(2 * η) / (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2) η := by
    intro η
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => 1 + e ^ 2) (2 * η) η := by
      have := (hasDerivAt_pow 2 η).const_add 1
      simpa using this
    have := h1.inv (by positivity)
    exact this
  have hfb : ∀ η : ℝ, |-(2 * η) / (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2| ≤ (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    intro η
    have hp : 0 < 1 + η ^ 2 := by positivity
    rw [abs_div, abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_two, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2),
      div_le_iff₀ (by positivity),
      show (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 + η ^ 2 from by
        rw [pow_two (1 + η ^ 2), ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hp.ne', one_mul]]
    nlinarith [sq_abs η, sq_nonneg (|η| - 1)]
  have hfhalf : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → 1 / 2 ≤ (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    intro η h1 h2
    have hp : 0 < 1 + η ^ 2 := by positivity
    rw [← one_div, le_div_iff₀ hp]; nlinarith
  
  have hsmall : ∀ X η : ℝ, 110 * Real.exp (1 + T) ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      |c η 2 * γ 0 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) + c η 3 * γ 1 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) +
          c η 4 * γ 2 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10))| ≤
        Pst * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) / 200 ∧
      |deriv c η 2 * γ 0 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) + deriv c η 3 * γ 1 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) +
          deriv c η 4 * γ 2 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10))| ≤
        Pst * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) / 200 := by
    intro X η hX h1 h2
    have hX0 : 0 < X := by have := Real.exp_pos (1 + T); linarith
    have hq0 : 0 ≤ (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_nonneg (div_nonneg hX0.le hXR0.le) _
    have hf0 : 0 < (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
    have hE0 : 0 ≤ Pst * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hPst.le hf0.le) hq0
    obtain ⟨-, hb1, hb2⟩ := hbump (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) η h1 h2
    by_cases hy : X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) ≤ s1
    · rw [hγ0 0 _ (Or.inl hy), hγ0 1 _ (Or.inl hy), hγ0 2 _ (Or.inl hy)]
      simp only [mul_zero, add_zero, abs_zero]
      constructor <;> linarith
    · push_neg at hy
      have hy8 : Real.exp (-8) ≤ X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) := by
        have : Real.exp (-8) ≤ Real.exp (-6) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by norm_num)
        linarith
      have hq1 := hq _ hy8
      have hfh := hfhalf η h1 h2
      have hfq : (1 / 2) * (256 / 625) ≤ (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul hfh hq1 (by norm_num) hf0.le
      have hE := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfq hPst.le
      constructor <;> nlinarith
  
  have absfact : ∀ (P q S b d f fp : ℝ), 0 < S → 0 ≤ P → 0 ≤ q → 0 ≤ f → |fp| ≤ f →
      |b| ≤ P * f * q / 200 → |d| ≤ P * f * q / 200 →
      |(P * f * q + b) / S| ≤ 201 / 200 * (P * f * q / S) ∧
      |(P * fp * q + d) / S| ≤ 201 / 200 * (P * f * q / S) := by
    intro P q S b d f fp hS hP hq0 hf hfp hb hd
    have hE : 0 ≤ P * f * q := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hP hf) hq0
    constructor
    · rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hS, mul_div_assoc']
      refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hS.le
      have := abs_add_le (P * f * q) b
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hE] at this
      linarith
    · rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hS, mul_div_assoc']
      refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hS.le
      have h1 : |P * fp * q| ≤ P * f * q := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hP, abs_of_nonneg hq0]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfp hP) hq0
      have := abs_add_le (P * fp * q) d
      linarith
  refine ⟨fun X η hX h1 h2 => ?_, fun X η hX h1 h2 => ?_⟩
  · have hX0 : 0 < X := by have := Real.exp_pos (1 + T); linarith
    have hS : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * X) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
    have hq0 : 0 ≤ (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_nonneg (div_nonneg hX0.le hXR0.le) _
    have hf0 : 0 < (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
    obtain ⟨hB, -, -⟩ := hbump (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) η h1 h2
    obtain ⟨hs1', hs2'⟩ := hsmall X η hX h1 h2
    have hfun : (fun e => axFm Pst C T ℓ F γ c X e) = fun e =>
        (Pst * (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) +
          (c e 2 * γ 0 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) + c e 3 * γ 1 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) +
            c e 4 * γ 2 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)))) / Real.sqrt (2 * X) :=
      funext fun e => hform X e hX
    have hder : HasDerivAt (fun e =>
        (Pst * (1 + e ^ 2)⁻¹ * (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) +
          (c e 2 * γ 0 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) + c e 3 * γ 1 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) +
            c e 4 * γ 2 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)))) / Real.sqrt (2 * X))
        ((Pst * (-(2 * η) / (1 + η ^ 2) ^ 2) * (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) +
          (deriv c η 2 * γ 0 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) + deriv c η 3 * γ 1 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) +
            deriv c η 4 * γ 2 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)))) / Real.sqrt (2 * X)) η :=
      ((((hfd η).const_mul Pst).mul_const
        ((X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ))).add hB).div_const (Real.sqrt (2 * X))
    rw [hfun, hder.deriv, hform X η hX]
    unfold refFin
    exact absfact Pst _ _ _ _ _ _ hS hPst.le hq0 hf0.le (hfb η) hs1' hs2'
  · have h98 : 110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10 * Real.exp (-9) ≤ 110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10 * Real.exp (-8) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by norm_num)) hXR0.le
    have hXs : 110 * Real.exp (1 + T) ≤ X := by linarith
    have hX0 : 0 < X := by have := Real.exp_pos (1 + T); linarith
    have hS : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * X) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
    have hf0 : 0 < (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
    rw [hform X η hXs, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hS.ne']
    have hy8 : Real.exp (-8) ≤ X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10) := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hXR0]; linarith
    have hq1 := hq _ hy8
    have hfh := hfhalf η h1 h2
    have hfq : (1 / 2) * (256 / 625) ≤ (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul hfh hq1 (by norm_num) hf0.le
    have hE := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfq hPst.le
    obtain ⟨-, hb1, -⟩ := hbump (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) η h1 h2
    have hn := neg_abs_le (c η 2 * γ 0 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) +
      c η 3 * γ 1 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)) + c η 4 * γ 2 (X / (110 * (C * Pst) ^ 10)))
    nlinarith

proof.tactics:
by
  have ax_leadW_close : ∀ (h j0 k ε a b X η : ℝ) (U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 ≤ j0 → j0 ≤ 1 / 20 → 0 < ε → a < η → η < b → |η| ≤ 51 / 50 → 0 ≤ X → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ X → |U x η - (4 * η + j0)| ≤ k ∧ |deriv (fun e => U x e) η - 4| ≤ k) → |leadW h U X η - (1 - 4 * (1 - η ^ 2) - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * (4 * η + j0))| ≤ 3 * k := by
    intro h j0 k ε a b X η U hh0 hh1 hj0 hj1 hε ha hb hη hX hU hB
    have hk : 0 ≤ k := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hB 0 le_rfl hX).1
    have hΩ : IsOpen (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
    set G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => fderiv ℝ (↿U) p ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) with hGdef
    have hGc : ContinuousOn G (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) := by
      have h1 : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (↿U)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b) :=
        hU.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ (by simp)
      exact h1.clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have hGd : ∀ x e : ℝ, ((x, e) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo a b →
        HasDerivAt (fun e' => U x e') (G (x, e)) e := by
      intro x e hxe
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿U) (x, e) :=
        (hU.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hxe)
      have hc : HasDerivAt (fun e' : ℝ => ((x, e') : ℝ × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) e :=
        (hasDerivAt_const e x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id e)

    have eN : |(1 / 2 - h) * (I0 - η * J0) + 4 * h * η * I1 - (1 - η ^ 2) * J1| ≤
        ((4 + k) + 4 * h * ((4 + k) ^ 2 + A) + (2 * (4 + k) ^ 2 + 2 * A)) * X := by
      have b1 := abs_sub ((1 / 2 - h) * (I0 - η * J0) + 4 * h * η * I1) ((1 - η ^ 2) * J1)
      have b2 := abs_add_le ((1 / 2 - h) * (I0 - η * J0)) (4 * h * η * I1)
      linarith
    have eNX : |((1 / 2 - h) * (I0 - η * J0) + 4 * h * η * I1 - (1 - η ^ 2) * J1) / X| ≤
        (4 + k) + 4 * h * ((4 + k) ^ 2 + A) + (2 * (4 + k) ^ 2 + 2 * A) := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hX, div_le_iff₀ hX]; exact eN
    have e5 : |4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * P| ≤ 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * (MP + B) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 4 * (1 / 2 + h))]
      have : |η| * |P| ≤ 1 * (MP + B) := mul_le_mul hηa hP (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      calc 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * |η| * |P| = 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * (|η| * |P|) := by ring
        _ ≤ 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * (1 * (MP + B)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this (by positivity)
        _ = _ := by ring
    have e6 : |(1 - η ^ 2) * Q| ≤ MP + B := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hd0]
      calc (1 - η ^ 2) * |Q| ≤ 1 * |Q| :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [sq_nonneg η]) (abs_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ _ := by linarith
    have c1 := abs_sub (-W * u + ((1 / 2 - h) * (I0 - η * J0) + 4 * h * η * I1 - (1 - η ^ 2) * J1) / X
        + 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * P) ((1 - η ^ 2) * Q)
    have c2 := abs_add_le (-W * u + ((1 / 2 - h) * (I0 - η * J0) + 4 * h * η * I1 - (1 - η ^ 2) * J1) / X)
        (4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * P)
    have c3 := abs_add_le (-W * u) (((1 / 2 - h) * (I0 - η * J0) + 4 * h * η * I1 - (1 - η ^ 2) * J1) / X)
    have hkk : k * k ≤ k / 50 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk1 hk0 |>.trans_eq (by ring)
    have hkk2 : k * k ≤ 1 / 2500 := by nlinarith
    have hhk : h * k ≤ h / 50 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk1 hh0.le |>.trans_eq (by ring)
    have hhkk : h * (k * k) ≤ h / 2500 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkk2 hh0.le |>.trans_eq (by ring)
    have hhA : h * A ≤ A / 100 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh1.le hA |>.trans_eq (by ring)
    have hhMB : h * (MP + B) ≤ (MP + B) / 100 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh1.le (by linarith) |>.trans_eq (by ring)
    linarith
  exact arith (leadW h U X η) (U X η) (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, U x η)
    (deriv (fun e => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, U x e) η) (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, (U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2))
    (deriv (fun e => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, (U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2)) η)
    (Pax η + ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, F x η ^ 2) (deriv (fun e => Pax e + ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, F x e ^ 2) η)
    hWb huX hI0 hJ0 hI1 hJ1 hPv hPQ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ε' Xs X B0 Pst XR η F hε' hXs hXsX hXXR hη1 hη2 hF hin hB hout
  have hXR : 0 < XR := by linarith
  have hf0 : 0 < (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
  have hf1 : (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg η])
  
  have hsq : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → refFin Pst XR x η ^ 2 =
      Pst ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * (x / XR) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) / (2 * x) := by
    intro x hx
    unfold refFin
    have h1 : Real.sqrt (2 * x) ^ 2 = 2 * x := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
    have h2 : ((x / XR) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)) ^ 2 = (x / XR) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (div_nonneg hx.le hXR.le)]
      norm_num
    rw [div_pow, mul_pow, mul_pow, h1, h2]
  
  have hderiv : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → HasDerivAt
      (fun y => 5 / 2 * Pst ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * (y / XR) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ))
      (refFin Pst XR x η ^ 2) x := by
    intro x hx
    have hu : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y / XR) (1 / XR) x := (hasDerivAt_id' x).div_const XR
    have hp := (hu.rpow_const (p := (1 / 5 : ℝ)) (Or.inl (div_pos hx hXR).ne')).const_mul
      (5 / 2 * Pst ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2)
    convert hp using 1
    have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := hx.ne'
    have hXR0 : XR ≠ 0 := hXR.ne'
    rw [hsq x hx, Real.rpow_sub_one (div_pos hx hXR).ne']
    field_simp
  
  have hint : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < a → a ≤ b →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => refFin Pst XR x η ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume a b := by
    intro a b ha hab
    apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hab]
    unfold refFin
    apply ContinuousOn.pow
    apply ContinuousOn.div
    · exact (continuous_const.mul ((continuous_id.div_const XR).rpow_const
        (fun _ => Or.inr (by norm_num)))).continuousOn
    · exact (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).continuousOn
    · intro x hx
      exact (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith [hx.1])).ne'
  
  have hbound : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < a → a ≤ b → b ≤ XR →
      (∫ x in a..b, refFin Pst XR x η ^ 2) ≤ 5 / 2 * Pst ^ 2 := by
    intro a b ha hab hbXR
    have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
      (fun x hx => hderiv x (by rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hab] at hx; linarith [hx.1])) (hint a b ha hab)
    rw [hFTC]
    beta_reduce
    have h1 : 0 ≤ 5 / 2 * Pst ^ 2 * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * (a / XR) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) :=
      mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Real.rpow_nonneg (div_nonneg ha.le hXR.le) _)
    have hq0 : 0 ≤ (b / XR) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg (div_nonneg (by linarith) hXR.le) _
    have hq1 : (b / XR) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ 1 :=
      Real.rpow_le_one (div_nonneg (by linarith) hXR.le) ((div_le_one hXR).mpr hbXR) (by norm_num)
    have hf2 : ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hf0.le hf1
    have hf20 : 0 ≤ ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    have hfq : ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * (b / XR) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
    have hP : 0 ≤ Pst ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfq hP]
  
  have hsplit : ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (M K : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ Xs → |φ x| ≤ M) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, Xs < x → x ≤ X → |φ x| ≤ K * refFin Pst XR x η ^ 2) →
      |∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, φ x| ≤ M * Xs + K * (5 / 2 * Pst ^ 2) := by
    intro φ M K hK h1 h2
    have hM : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (h1 Xs hXs le_rfl)
    have hR : 0 ≤ M * Xs + K * (5 / 2 * Pst ^ 2) :=
      add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hM hXs.le) (mul_nonneg hK (by positivity))
    by_cases hφ : IntervalIntegrable φ MeasureTheory.volume 0 X
    · have hi1 : IntervalIntegrable φ MeasureTheory.volume 0 Xs := hφ.mono_set (by
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hXs.le, Set.uIcc_of_le (by linarith)]
        exact Set.Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hXsX)
      have hi2 : IntervalIntegrable φ MeasureTheory.volume Xs X := hφ.mono_set (by
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hXsX, Set.uIcc_of_le (by linarith)]
        exact Set.Icc_subset_Icc hXs.le le_rfl)
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals hi1 hi2]
      have e1 : ‖∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xs, φ x‖ ≤ M * |Xs - 0| :=
        intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (fun x hx => by
          rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hXs.le] at hx
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
          exact h1 x hx.1 hx.2)
      have e2 : ‖∫ x in Xs..X, φ x‖ ≤ ∫ x in Xs..X, K * refFin Pst XR x η ^ 2 :=
        intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hXsX
          (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun x hx => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact h2 x hx.1 hx.2))
          ((hint Xs X hXs hXsX).const_mul K)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at e2
      have e3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound Xs X hXs hXsX hXXR) hK
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at e1 e2
      rw [sub_zero, abs_of_pos hXs] at e1
      calc _ ≤ |∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Xs, φ x| + |∫ x in Xs..X, φ x| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ _ := by linarith
    · rw [intervalIntegral.integral_undef hφ, abs_zero]
      exact hR
  
  have hg : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
      deriv (fun e => F x e ^ 2) η = 2 * F x η * deriv (fun e => F x e) η := by
    intro x hx
    have hW : (x, η) ∈ Set.Ioi (-ε') ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
      ⟨show -ε' < x by linarith, hη1, hη2⟩
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿F) (x, η) :=
      (hF.contDiffAt ((isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo).mem_nhds hW)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hd2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e => F x e) η :=
      hd.comp η ((differentiableAt_const x).prodMk differentiableAt_id)
    have := hd2.hasDerivAt.fun_pow 2
    rw [this.deriv]
    norm_num
  
  have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ (201 / 200) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hP : 0 ≤ Pst ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  have i1 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ Xs → |F x η ^ 2| ≤ B0 ^ 2 := by
    intro x hx hxs
    rw [abs_pow]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hin x hx.le hxs).1 2
  have o1 : ∀ x : ℝ, Xs < x → x ≤ X → |F x η ^ 2| ≤ (201 / 200) ^ 2 * refFin Pst XR x η ^ 2 := by
    intro x hx hxX
    have h := (hout x hx.le hxX).1
    calc |F x η ^ 2| = |F x η| ^ 2 := abs_pow _ _
      _ ≤ (201 / 200 * refFin Pst XR x η) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h 2
      _ = _ := by ring
  have i2 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ Xs → |deriv (fun e => F x e ^ 2) η| ≤ 2 * B0 ^ 2 := by
    intro x hx hxs
    rw [hg x hx, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_two]
    obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := hin x hx.le hxs
    have := mul_le_mul a1 a2 (abs_nonneg _) (le_trans (abs_nonneg _) a1)
    nlinarith
  have o2 : ∀ x : ℝ, Xs < x → x ≤ X →
      |deriv (fun e => F x e ^ 2) η| ≤ 2 * (201 / 200) ^ 2 * refFin Pst XR x η ^ 2 := by
    intro x hx hxX
    rw [hg x (by linarith), abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_two]
    obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := hout x hx.le hxX
    have := mul_le_mul a1 a2 (abs_nonneg _) (le_trans (abs_nonneg _) a1)
    nlinarith
  have r1 := hsplit (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (B0 ^ 2) ((201 / 200) ^ 2) hc i1 o1
  have r2 := hsplit (fun x => deriv (fun e => F x e ^ 2) η) (2 * B0 ^ 2) (2 * (201 / 200) ^ 2)
    (by positivity) i2 o2
  constructor
  · nlinarith
  · nlinarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → Xa < Xm → Xm < Xs → Xs < Xb → BgCoeffSeq h Xm Xs m1 m2 F U S G W → ∀ (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → nsResidual 1 (fun y' s' => curl3 (fun w => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgAn h n (S n) w s') y' + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgBn h n (G n) y' s') (fun y' s' => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgPn h n (W n) y' s') x t - stressDivField h (bgTsum h (bgTthSeq h T0th S G W) N) (bgTsum h (bgTzSeq h T0z S G W) N) x t = bgResTail h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) N x t

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs F U T0th T0z S G W hS hL hXam hXms hXsb hB
    N x t ht hr
  
  have hL' := hL
  unfold LeadingProfile at hL'
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, hh1, -, -, -, -, -, hXa, -⟩, -, ⟨hT0s, hT0zs, -⟩, -, ⟨εL, hεL, hFs, hUs, -⟩, -⟩ := hL'
  have hB' := hB
  unfold BgCoeffSeq at hB'
  obtain ⟨⟨hS0, hG0, hW0⟩, ⟨εB, hεB, hBsm⟩, -, -, -, hBrad, hBin, hBint⟩ := hB'
  obtain ⟨εP, hεP, hPs, -⟩ :=
    leadPi_smooth_bounds h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z hL
  obtain ⟨ε8, hε8, hR⟩ :=
    bg_coef_regular h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs F U T0th T0z S G W hS hL hB
  have hV := bg_res_vanish h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs F U T0th T0z S G W
    hS hL hXam hXms hXsb hB
  have hXm0 : 0 < Xm := by linarith
  have hXmb : Xm < Xb := by linarith
  have h9 := fun (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) =>
    stress_prim_props (bgResTh h S G W n) (bgResZ h S G W n) ε8 Xm Xb hε8 hXm0 hXmb (hR n hn).1
      (hR n hn).2.1 (fun m => (hR n hn).2.2.2.2.1 Xb m)
      (fun X η hX0 hXm h1 h2 => hBin n hn X η hX0 hXm h1 h2)
      (fun X η hX h1 h2 => hV n hn X η h1 h2 (Or.inl hX))
      (fun η h1 h2 => hBint n hn η h1 h2)
  
  have hper : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → ∀ n : ℕ,
      (DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y => bgTthSeq h T0th S G W n Y η) X ∧
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y => bgTzSeq h T0z S G W n Y η) X) ∧
      (deriv (fun Y => bgTthSeq h T0th S G W n Y η) X + bgTthSeq h T0th S G W n X η / X =
          -bgResTh h S G W n X η ∧
        Real.sqrt (2 * X) * (deriv (fun Y => bgTzSeq h T0z S G W n Y η) X +
          bgTzSeq h T0z S G W n X η / (2 * X)) = -bgResZ h S G W n X η) := by
    intro X η hX0 hη1 hη2 n
    have hslice : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) →
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y => f Y η) X := by
      intro f hf
      have hca := hf.contDiffAt ((isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo).mem_nhds
        (show (X, η) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 from ⟨hX0, hη1, hη2⟩))
      have hin : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y : ℝ => ((Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ)) X :=
        differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const η)
      have hc := (hca.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).comp X hin
      exact hc
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with hn | hn
    · subst hn
      have e1 : bgTthSeq h T0th S G W 0 = fun X η => if 0 < X then T0th X η else 0 := by
        simp [bgTthSeq]
      have e2 : bgTzSeq h T0z S G W 0 = fun X η => if 0 < X then T0z X η else 0 := by
        simp [bgTzSeq]
      have hev1 : (fun Y => bgTthSeq h T0th S G W 0 Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X] (fun Y => T0th Y η) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hX0] with Y hY
        rw [e1]
        exact if_pos (show (0:ℝ) < Y from hY)
      have hev2 : (fun Y => bgTzSeq h T0z S G W 0 Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X] (fun Y => T0z Y η) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hX0] with Y hY
        rw [e2]
        exact if_pos (show (0:ℝ) < Y from hY)
      have hv1 : bgTthSeq h T0th S G W 0 X η = T0th X η := by
        rw [e1]
        exact if_pos hX0
      have hv2 : bgTzSeq h T0z S G W 0 X η = T0z X η := by
        rw [e2]
        exact if_pos hX0
      refine ⟨⟨(hslice T0th hT0s).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev1,
        (hslice T0z hT0zs).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev2⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hev1.deriv_eq, hv1, bg_lead_th_identity h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab
          F U T0th T0z S G W hL hS0 hG0 X η hX0 hη1 hη2, neg_neg]
      · rw [hev2.deriv_eq, hv2, bg_lead_z_identity h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab
          F U T0th T0z S G W hL hS0 hW0 X η hX0 hη1 hη2, neg_neg]
    · have e1 : bgTthSeq h T0th S G W n = stressPrimTh (bgResTh h S G W n) := by
        simp [bgTthSeq, show n ≠ 0 by omega]
      have e2 : bgTzSeq h T0z S G W n = stressPrimZ (bgResZ h S G W n) := by
        simp [bgTzSeq, show n ≠ 0 by omega]
      obtain ⟨t1, t2, -, t4, -⟩ := h9 n (by omega)
      rw [e1, e2]
      exact ⟨⟨hslice _ t1, hslice _ t2⟩, t4 X η hX0 hη1 hη2⟩

    have hd : deriv (fun Y => bgTsum h (bgTzSeq h T0z S G W) N q Y η) X =

    unfold bgTsum

      bgResRad h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k X η = bgResRad h S G W k X η := by
    intro k hk X η
    exact bgRes_local h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) S G W k univ isOpen_univ

  ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
    ((simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(2 + 2 * h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) *
        bgResRad h S G W k (simX h x t) (simEta h x t)) • radVec x +

        bgResTh h S G W k (simX h x t) (simEta h x t)) • azVec x +
     (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) *
        bgResZ h S G W k (simX h x t) (simEta h x t)) • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h a S G W H0 HZ Hp k hk X η hX h1 h2
  
  have hpdX : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → f Y e = 0) →
      ∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → pdX f Y e = 0 := by
    intro f hf Y e hY he1 he2
    unfold pdX
    have hev : (fun Y' => f Y' e) =ᶠ[nhds Y] fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hY) (fun Y' hY' => hf Y' e hY' he1 he2)
    rw [hev.deriv_eq]
    simp
  have hpdE : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → f Y e = 0) →
      ∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → pdE f Y e = 0 := by
    intro f hf Y e hY he1 he2
    unfold pdE
    have hev : (fun e' => f Y e') =ᶠ[nhds e] fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds he1 he2) (fun e' he' => hf Y e' hY he'.1 he'.2)
    rw [hev.deriv_eq]
    simp
  
  have hTop : ∀ (b : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → f Y e = 0) →

    intro b f hf Y e hY he1 he2
    unfold simTop
    rw [hf Y e hY he1 he2, hpdX f hf Y e hY he1 he2, hpdE f hf Y e hY he1 he2]
    simp
  have hZop : ∀ (b : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → f Y e = 0) →

    intro b f hf Y e hY he1 he2
    unfold simZop
    rw [hf Y e hY he1 he2, hpdX f hf Y e hY he1 he2, hpdE f hf Y e hY he1 he2]
    simp
  have hUz : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → f Y e = 0) →
      ∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → bgUz f Y e = 0 := by
    intro f hf Y e hY he1 he2
    unfold bgUz
    rw [hf Y e hY he1 he2, hpdX f hf Y e hY he1 he2]
    simp
  have hVx : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → f Y e = 0) →
      ∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → bgVx h n f Y e = 0 := by
    intro n f hf Y e hY he1 he2
    unfold bgVx
    rw [hUz f hf Y e hY he1 he2, hf Y e hY he1 he2, hpdE f hf Y e hY he1 he2]
    simp
  
  have hS : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → S j Y e = 0 := by
    intro j
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with rfl | hj
    · exact H0
    · exact fun Y e hY he1 he2 => (Hp j hj Y e hY he1 he2).1
  have hG : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → G j Y e = 0 :=
    fun j hj Y e hY he1 he2 => (Hp j hj Y e hY he1 he2).2.1
  have hW : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → W j Y e = 0 :=
    fun j hj Y e hY he1 he2 => (Hp j hj Y e hY he1 he2).2.2
  have hU : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → bgUz (S j) Y e = 0 :=
    fun j => hUz _ (hS j)
  have hV : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → bgVx h j (S j) Y e = 0 :=
    fun j => hVx _ _ (hS j)
  
  have hOm : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → bgOm h S m Y e = 0 := by
    intro m Y e hY he1 he2
    have u : ∀ i : ℕ, bgUz (S i) Y e = 0 := fun i => hU i Y e hY he1 he2
    have v : ∀ i : ℕ, bgVx h i (S i) Y e = 0 := fun i => hV i Y e hY he1 he2
    unfold bgOm
    rw [hTop _ _ (hV m) Y e hY he1 he2, hpdX _ (hpdX _ (hV m)) Y e hY he1 he2,
      hpdX _ (hV m) Y e hY he1 he2]
    split_ifs
    · rw [hZop _ _ (hZop _ _ (hV (m - 1))) Y e hY he1 he2]
      simp [u, v]
    · simp [u, v]
  have u : ∀ i : ℕ, bgUz (S i) X η = 0 := fun i => hU i X η hX h1 h2
  have v : ∀ i : ℕ, bgVx h i (S i) X η = 0 := fun i => hV i X η hX h1 h2
  
  have hTh : bgResTh h S G W k X η = 0 := by
    have hinner : ∀ Y e : ℝ, a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 →
        simZop h (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) (G (k - 1)) Y e = 0 := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (k - 1) with h0 | hpos
      · intro Y e hY he1 he2
        rw [h0]
        simp only [Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
        exact HZ Y e hY he1 he2
      · exact hZop _ _ (hG (k - 1) hpos)
    unfold bgResTh
    rw [if_pos hk, hTop _ _ (hG k hk) X η hX h1 h2, hpdX _ (hpdX _ (hG k hk)) X η hX h1 h2,
      hpdX _ (hG k hk) X η hX h1 h2, hZop _ _ hinner X η hX h1 h2]
    simp [u, v]
  
  have hZ : bgResZ h S G W k X η = 0 := by
    unfold bgResZ
    rw [if_pos hk, hTop _ _ (hU k) X η hX h1 h2, hZop _ _ (hW k hk) X η hX h1 h2,
      hpdX _ (hpdX _ (hU k)) X η hX h1 h2, hpdX _ (hU k) X η hX h1 h2,
      hZop _ _ (hZop _ _ (hU (k - 1))) X η hX h1 h2]
    simp [u, v]
  
  have hRad : bgResRad h S G W k X η = 0 := by
    unfold bgResRad
    rw [if_pos hk, hOm (k - 1) X η hX h1 h2, hpdX _ (hW k hk) X η hX h1 h2]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero]
    · ring
    · intro i _
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with rfl | hi0
      · rw [Nat.sub_zero, hG k hk X η hX h1 h2, mul_zero]
      · rw [hG i hi0 X η hX h1 h2, zero_mul]
  exact ⟨hRad, hTh, hZ⟩

by
  intro h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z hL Y e hY he1 he2

  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, -, -, hcinf, -, -, -, hXa0, hXap1, hp12, hp2m1, hm12, hm2v, hXvc, hXcb⟩,
    ⟨hFs, -, -, -⟩, -, -, -, -, hL7, -, -, -, -⟩ := hL
  have hXb0 : 0 < Xb := by linarith
  have hFd : ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y' => F Y' 0) Y := by
    intro Y hY
    have hmem : (Y, (0:ℝ)) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨hY, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
    have hopen : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hc := (hFs.contDiffAt (hopen.mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y' : ℝ => (Y', (0:ℝ))) Y :=
      differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const _)
    exact DifferentiableAt.comp (g := ↿F) Y hc h2

    intro Y e hY he1 he2
    have hY0 : 0 < Y := by linarith
    have hL := (hL7 Y e hY.le he1 he2).2
    have hs2 : 0 < Real.sqrt 2 := by positivity
    have hsY : 0 < Real.sqrt Y := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hY0
    have hsq : Real.sqrt (2 * Y) = Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt Y := Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num) Y
    have hpow : Y ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) = Y ^ (-(1 + h)) * Real.sqrt Y := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_add hY0]

      ring
    rw [hsq, hpow] at hL
    have e1 : F Y e = (Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt Y * F Y e) / (Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt Y) := by
      field_simp
    rw [e1, hL]
    field_simp

    rw [hFw]
    have hp : 0 < (2 / w) ^ (1 + h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) _

        cinf / Real.sqrt 2 * Y ^ (-(1 + h)) * (H' * ((0 * Y - 2 * (1 - e ^ 2) * 1) / Y ^ 2)) := by

  field_simp
  ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → BgCoeffSeq h Xm Xs m1 m2 F U S G W → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(S n)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(G n)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(W n)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ∀ N k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgResRad h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgResTh h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgResZ h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ∀ X1 : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgResRad h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgResTh h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgResZ h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C

signature.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → BgCoeffSeq h Xm Xs m1 m2 F U S G W → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(S n)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(G n)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(W n)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ∀ N k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgResRad h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgResTh h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgResZ h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ∀ X1 : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgResRad h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgResTh h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgResZ h (bgTrunc N S) (bgTrunc N G) (bgTrunc N W) k)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs F U T0th T0z S G W hSc hL hB
  obtain ⟨εP, hεP, hPs, hPb⟩ :=
    leadPi_smooth_bounds h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z hL
  unfold LeadingProfile at hL
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, hh1, -⟩, -, -, -, ⟨εL, hεL, hFs, hUs, -, hFU⟩, -⟩ := hL
  unfold BgCoeffSeq at hB
  obtain ⟨⟨hS0, hG0, hW0⟩, ⟨εB, hεB, hBsm⟩, hBbd, -⟩ := hB
  have hh2 : h < 1 / 2 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨ε, hεdef⟩ : ∃ ε : ℝ, ε = min (min εL εB) εP := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hε : 0 < ε := by rw [hεdef]; exact lt_min (lt_min hεL hεB) hεP
  have hεL' : ε ≤ εL := by rw [hεdef]; exact (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hεB' : ε ≤ εB := by rw [hεdef]; exact (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hεP' : ε ≤ εP := by rw [hεdef]; exact min_le_right _ _
  have hΩ : IsOpen (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hle : ∀ m : ℕ, ((m : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := fun m => by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hmem : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
    fun X η h0 h1 h2 => ⟨show -ε < X by linarith, h1, h2⟩
  
  have hcongr : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → (∀ X η, f X η = g X η) → bgCoefGood ε g := by
    intro f g hf hfg
    have : f = g := funext fun X => funext fun η => hfg X η
    subst this
    exact hf
  
  have hadd : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε g →
      bgCoefGood ε (fun X η => f X η + g X η) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.add hg.1, ?_⟩
    intro X1 m
    obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hf.2 X1 m
    obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := hg.2 X1 m
    refine ⟨C1 + C2, fun X η h0 h1 h2 h3 => ?_⟩
    have hz := hΩ.mem_nhds (hmem X η h0 h2 h3)
    have e : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun X η => f X η + g X η)) (X, η) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) (X, η) + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η) :=
      iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((hf.1.contDiffAt hz).of_le (hle m)) ((hg.1.contDiffAt hz).of_le (hle m))
    rw [e]
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hC1 X η h0 h1 h2 h3) (hC2 X η h0 h1 h2 h3))
  have hsub : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε g →
      bgCoefGood ε (fun X η => f X η - g X η) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.sub hg.1, ?_⟩
    intro X1 m
    obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hf.2 X1 m
    obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := hg.2 X1 m
    refine ⟨C1 + C2, fun X η h0 h1 h2 h3 => ?_⟩
    have hz := hΩ.mem_nhds (hmem X η h0 h2 h3)
    have e : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun X η => f X η - g X η)) (X, η) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) (X, η) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η) :=
      iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply ((hf.1.contDiffAt hz).of_le (hle m)) ((hg.1.contDiffAt hz).of_le (hle m))
    rw [e]
    exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hC1 X η h0 h1 h2 h3) (hC2 X η h0 h1 h2 h3))
  
  have hmul : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε g →
      bgCoefGood ε (fun X η => f X η * g X η) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.mul hg.1, ?_⟩
    intro X1 m
    have hS : Icc (0 : ℝ) X1 ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
      fun z hz => hmem z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.2.1 hz.2.2
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) (↿f) (↿g)
      (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) (Icc (0 : ℝ) X1 ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) hΩ hS hf.1 hg.1
      (fun k => (hf.2 X1 k).imp fun C hC z hz => hC z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2)
      (fun k => (hg.2 X1 k).imp fun C hC z hz => hC z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2) m
    have e : (fun z => (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) ((↿f) z) ((↿g) z)) =
        ↿(fun X η => f X η * g X η) := by
      funext z
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply']
      rfl
    refine ⟨C, fun X η h0 h1 h2 h3 => ?_⟩
    rw [← e]
    exact hC (X, η) ⟨⟨h0, h1⟩, h2, h3⟩
  
  have hbasic : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (V : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) V →
      (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ V) → bgCoefGood ε f := by
    intro f V hV hf hsubV
    refine ⟨hf.mono (fun z hz => hsubV z.1 z.2 hz.1 hz.2.1.le hz.2.2.le), ?_⟩
    intro X1 m
    have hK : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) X1 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    have hKV : Icc (0 : ℝ) X1 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ V :=
      fun z hz => hsubV z.1 z.2 (by linarith [hz.1.1]) hz.2.1 hz.2.2
    have hc : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f)) V :=
      (hf.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (hle m) hV.uniqueDiffOn).congr
        (fun z hz => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hV hz).symm)
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hc.mono hKV)
    exact ⟨C, fun X η h0 h1 h2 h3 => hC (X, η) ⟨⟨h0, h1⟩, h2.le, h3.le⟩⟩
  have hconst : ∀ c : ℝ, bgCoefGood ε (fun _ _ => c) := fun c =>
    hbasic (fun _ _ => c) univ isOpen_univ contDiffOn_const (fun _ _ _ _ _ => mem_univ _)
  have hX : bgCoefGood ε (fun X _ => X) :=
    hbasic (fun X _ => X) univ isOpen_univ contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun _ _ _ _ _ => mem_univ _)
  have hη : bgCoefGood ε (fun _ η => η) :=
    hbasic (fun _ η => η) univ isOpen_univ contDiff_snd.contDiffOn (fun _ _ _ _ _ => mem_univ _)
  have hinv : bgCoefGood ε (fun _ η => (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
    refine hbasic _ {w : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < 1 - 2 * h * w.2 ^ 2}
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)) ?_ ?_
    · exact ((contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_snd.pow 2))).contDiffOn).inv
        (fun w hw => ne_of_gt hw)
    · intro X η _ h1 h2
      have hη2 : η ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
      show 0 < 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2
      nlinarith
  
  have hpd : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (v : ℝ × ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), bgCoefGood ε f →
      (∀ X η, ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 → g X η = fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η) v) →
      bgCoefGood ε g := by
    intro f v g hf hgv
    have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hf.1.fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ le_rfl
    have hDg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿f))
        (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hD
    have heq : ∀ z ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1,
        (↿g) z = ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿f)) z := by
      intro z hz
      have := hgv z.1 z.2 hz
      exact this
    refine ⟨hDg.congr heq, ?_⟩
    intro X1 m
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hf.2 X1 (m + 1)
    refine ⟨‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v‖ * C, fun X η h0 h1 h2 h3 => ?_⟩
    have hz := hmem X η h0 h2 h3
    have hev : (↿g) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)] ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿f)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hΩ.mem_nhds hz) heq
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (X, η)‖
        ≤ ‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (X, η)‖ :=
          (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v).norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left
            (hD.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hz)) (hle m)
      _ = ‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) (↿f) (X, η)‖ := by
          rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
      _ ≤ ‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v‖ * C :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC X η h0 h1 h2 h3) (by positivity)
  have hpdX : ∀ f, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (pdX f) := by
    intro f hf
    refine hpd f ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) (pdX f) hf (fun X η hz => ?_)
    have hd : HasFDerivAt (↿f) (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η)) (X, η) :=
      ((hf.1.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => ((Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) X :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X η)
    exact (hd.comp_hasDerivAt X hc).deriv
  have hpdE : ∀ f, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (pdE f) := by
    intro f hf
    refine hpd f ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) (pdE f) hf (fun X η hz => ?_)
    have hd : HasFDerivAt (↿f) (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η)) (X, η) :=
      ((hf.1.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => ((X, e) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) η :=
      (hasDerivAt_const η X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' η)
    exact (hd.comp_hasDerivAt η hc).deriv
  have hsum : ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ i ∈ s, bgCoefGood ε (f i)) →
      bgCoefGood ε (fun X η => ∑ i ∈ s, f i X η) := by
    intro s f
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => intro _; exact hcongr _ _ (hconst 0) (fun X η => by simp)
    | @insert a s ha ih =>
      intro hf
      exact hcongr _ _ (hadd _ _ (hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s))
        (ih fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))) (fun X η => by rw [Finset.sum_insert ha])
  
  have hUz : ∀ f, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (bgUz f) := fun f hf =>
    hcongr _ _ (hadd _ _ hf (hmul _ _ hX (hpdX f hf))) (fun X η => rfl)
  have hVx : ∀ (n : ℕ) f, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (bgVx h n f) := by
    intro n f hf
    have A1 := hmul _ _ (hmul _ _ (hconst 2) hη) (hUz f hf)
    have A2 := hmul _ _ (hmul _ _ (hconst (2 * (1 / 2 - h + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h))) hη) hf
    have A3 := hmul _ _ (hsub _ _ (hconst 1) (hmul _ _ hη hη)) (hpdE f hf)
    refine hcongr _ _ (hmul _ _ (hsub _ _ (hsub _ _ A1 A2) A3) hinv) (fun X η => ?_)
    simp only [bgVx]
    ring
  have hTop : ∀ (b : ℝ) f, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (simTop h b f) := by
    intro b f hf
    have A1 := hmul _ _ (hconst (-b)) hf
    have A2 := hmul _ _ (hmul _ _ (hconst (1 / 2 - h)) hη) (hpdE f hf)
    have A3 := hmul _ _ hX (hpdX f hf)
    refine hcongr _ _ (hmul _ _ (hadd _ _ (hadd _ _ A1 A2) A3) hinv) (fun X η => ?_)
    simp only [simTop]
    ring
  have hZop : ∀ (b : ℝ) f, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (simZop h b f) := by
    intro b f hf
    have A1 := hmul _ _ (hmul _ _ (hconst (2 * b)) hη) hf
    have A2 := hmul _ _ (hsub _ _ (hconst 1) (hmul _ _ hη hη)) (hpdE f hf)
    have A3 := hmul _ _ (hmul _ _ (hmul _ _ (hconst 2) hη) hX) (hpdX f hf)
    refine hcongr _ _ (hmul _ _ (hsub _ _ (hadd _ _ A1 A2) A3) hinv) (fun X η => ?_)
    simp only [simZop]
    ring
  
  have hsubL : Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (-εL) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
    prod_mono (fun x hx => by simp only [mem_Ioi] at hx ⊢; linarith) subset_rfl
  have hsubB : Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (-εB) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
    prod_mono (fun x hx => by simp only [mem_Ioi] at hx ⊢; linarith) subset_rfl
  have hsubP : Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (-εP) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
    prod_mono (fun x hx => by simp only [mem_Ioi] at hx ⊢; linarith) subset_rfl
  have hSg : ∀ n, bgCoefGood ε (S n) := by
    intro n
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · rw [hS0]
      obtain ⟨hsm, hbd, -⟩ := profRadAvg_props U εL hεL hUs
      exact ⟨hsm.mono hsubL, fun X1 m => hbd X1 m
        ((hFU X1 m).imp fun C hC X η a b c d => (hC X η a b c d).2)⟩
    · exact ⟨(hBsm n hn).1.mono hsubB, fun X1 m =>
        (hBbd n hn m).imp fun C hC X η a _ c d => (hC X η a c d).1⟩
  have hGg : ∀ n, bgCoefGood ε (G n) := by
    intro n
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · rw [hG0]
      exact ⟨hFs.mono hsubL, fun X1 m =>
        (hFU X1 m).imp fun C hC X η a b c d => (hC X η a b c d).1⟩
    · exact ⟨(hBsm n hn).2.1.mono hsubB, fun X1 m =>
        (hBbd n hn m).imp fun C hC X η a _ c d => (hC X η a c d).2.1⟩
  have hWg : ∀ n, bgCoefGood ε (W n) := by
    intro n
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · rw [hW0]
      exact ⟨hPs.mono hsubP, hPb⟩
    · exact ⟨(hBsm n hn).2.2.mono hsubB, fun X1 m =>
        (hBbd n hn m).imp fun C hC X η a _ c d => (hC X η a c d).2.2⟩
  
  have htr : ∀ (T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ n, bgCoefGood ε (T n)) →
      ∀ N n, bgCoefGood ε (bgTrunc N T n) := by
    intro T hT N n
    unfold bgTrunc
    split_ifs
    · exact hT n
    · exact hconst 0
  
  have hres : ∀ (S' G' W' : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → (∀ i, bgCoefGood ε (S' i)) →
      (∀ i, bgCoefGood ε (G' i)) → (∀ i, bgCoefGood ε (W' i)) →
      bgCoefGood ε (bgResRad h S' G' W' k) ∧ bgCoefGood ε (bgResTh h S' G' W' k) ∧
        bgCoefGood ε (bgResZ h S' G' W' k) := by
    intro S' G' W' k hk hSg' hGg' hWg'
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have R1 := hpdX _ (hWg' k)
      have R2 := hsum (Finset.range (k + 1)) (fun i X η => G' i X η * G' (k - i) X η)
        (fun i _ => hmul _ _ (hGg' i) (hGg' (k - i)))
      have R3 := hmul _ _ (bgOm_good h ε S' (k - 1) hh0 hh2 hε (fun i _ => hSg' i)) (hconst (1 / 2))
      refine hcongr _ _ (hadd _ _ (hsub _ _ R1 R2) R3) (fun X η => ?_)
      simp only [bgResRad, if_pos hk]
      ring
    · have R1 := hTop (-(1 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) _ (hGg' k)
      have R2 := hmul _ _ (hconst 2) (hadd _ _ (hmul _ _ hX (hpdX _ (hpdX _ (hGg' k))))
        (hmul _ _ (hconst 2) (hpdX _ (hGg' k))))
      have R3 := hsum (Finset.range (k + 1))
        (fun i X η => bgVx h i (S' i) X η * (G' (k - i) X η + X * pdX (G' (k - i)) X η)
            + bgUz (S' i) X η * simZop h (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) (G' (k - i)) X η)
        (fun i _ => hadd _ _ (hmul _ _ (hVx i (S' i) (hSg' i))
            (hadd _ _ (hGg' (k - i)) (hmul _ _ hX (hpdX _ (hGg' (k - i))))))
          (hmul _ _ (hUz _ (hSg' i)) (hZop _ _ (hGg' (k - i)))))
      have R4 := hZop (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h)) _
        (hZop (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) _ (hGg' (k - 1)))
      refine hcongr _ _ (hsub _ _ (hadd _ _ (hsub _ _ R1 R2) R3) R4) (fun X η => ?_)
      simp only [bgResTh, if_pos hk]
    · have Z1 := hTop (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) _ (hUz _ (hSg' k))
      have Z2 := hZop (-(1 + 2 * h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) _ (hWg' k)
      have Z3 := hmul _ _ (hconst 2) (hadd _ _ (hmul _ _ hX (hpdX _ (hpdX _ (hUz _ (hSg' k)))))
        (hpdX _ (hUz _ (hSg' k))))
      have Z4 := hsum (Finset.range (k + 1))
        (fun i X η => X * bgVx h i (S' i) X η * pdX (bgUz (S' (k - i))) X η
            + bgUz (S' i) X η * simZop h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) (bgUz (S' (k - i))) X η)
        (fun i _ => hadd _ _ (hmul _ _ (hmul _ _ hX (hVx i (S' i) (hSg' i)))
            (hpdX _ (hUz _ (hSg' (k - i)))))
          (hmul _ _ (hUz _ (hSg' i)) (hZop _ _ (hUz _ (hSg' (k - i))))))
      have Z5 := hZop (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h)) _
        (hZop (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) _ (hUz _ (hSg' (k - 1))))
      refine hcongr _ _ (hsub _ _ (hadd _ _ (hsub _ _ (hadd _ _ Z1 Z2) Z3) Z4) Z5) (fun X η => ?_)
      simp only [bgResZ, if_pos hk]
  refine ⟨ε, hε, fun n => ⟨(hSg n).1, (hGg n).1, (hWg n).1⟩, ?_⟩
  intro N k hk
  obtain ⟨hR, hT, hZ⟩ := hres _ _ _ k hk (htr S hSg N) (htr G hGg N) (htr W hWg N)
  refine ⟨hR.1, hT.1, hZ.1, ?_⟩
  intro X1 m
  obtain ⟨C1, h1⟩ := hR.2 X1 m
  obtain ⟨C2, h2⟩ := hT.2 X1 m
  obtain ⟨C3, h3⟩ := hZ.2 X1 m
  refine ⟨max C1 (max C2 C3), fun X η a b c d => ⟨(h1 X η a b c d).trans (le_max_left _ _),
    (h2 X η a b c d).trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)),
    (h3 X η a b c d).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _))⟩⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xm Xs F U T0th T0z S G W hS hL hXam hB N x t ht hr
  have hL' := hL
  obtain ⟨⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hXa, -⟩, -, ⟨-, -, hT0van, -⟩, -, ⟨εL, hεL, hFε, hUε, -⟩, -⟩ := hL'
  have hB' := hB
  obtain ⟨⟨hS0, hG0, hW0⟩, ⟨εB, hεB, hBsm⟩, -, -, -, -, hBin, -⟩ := hB'
  
  have hsub : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → Ici (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 :=
    fun ε hε => prod_mono (fun y hy => by simp only [mem_Ici] at hy; simp only [mem_Ioi]; linarith)
      subset_rfl
  have hin : ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(S n)) (Ici 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(G n)) (Ici 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(W n)) (Ici 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    intro n
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst hn
      obtain ⟨εP, hεP, hP, -⟩ :=
        leadPi_smooth_bounds h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z hL
      rw [hS0, hG0, hW0]
      exact ⟨((profRadAvg_props U εL hεL hUε).1).mono (hsub εL hεL), hFε.mono (hsub εL hεL),
        hP.mono (hsub εP hεP)⟩
    · obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := hBsm n (by omega)
      exact ⟨a.mono (hsub εB hεB), b.mono (hsub εB hεB), c.mono (hsub εB hεB)⟩
  
  have hΩo : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
  have hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun (w : ℝ³) (s' : ℝ) => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgAn h n (S n) w s'))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (↿(bgAn h n (S n))) z) _
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun n _ => (bg_field_smooth_div h n (S n) hS (hin n).1).1)
  have hBv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun (y' : ℝ³) (s' : ℝ) => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgBn h n (G n) y' s'))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (↿(bgBn h n (G n))) z) _
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun n _ => (bg_field_smooth_div h n (G n) hS (hin n).2.1).2.1)
  have hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun (y' : ℝ³) (s' : ℝ) => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgPn h n (W n) y' s'))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (↿(bgPn h n (W n))) z) _
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun n _ => (bg_field_smooth_div h n (W n) hS (hin n).2.2).2.2.1)
  have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun (y' : ℝ³) (s' : ℝ) => curl3 (fun w => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      bgAn h n (S n) w s') y' + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgBn h n (G n) y' s'))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
    (curl_field_contDiffOn_bounded _ _ _ _ hΩo subset_rfl hA hBv).1
  have hR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(nsResidual 1 (fun y' s' => curl3 (fun w => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      bgAn h n (S n) w s') y' + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgBn h n (G n) y' s')
      (fun y' s' => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgPn h n (W n) y' s'))) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
    (nsResidual_contDiffOn_eq_jet 1 _ _ _ hΩo hu hp).1
  have hRc := hR.continuousOn.continuousAt (hΩo.mem_nhds (show ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ).2 < 1 from ht))
  
  have hq0 : 0 < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) := (hS.1 (x 2) (1 - t) (by linarith)).1
  have hq : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) (x, t) := by
    have hc : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (x 2, 1 - t) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.continuousAt ((isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds
        ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - t by linarith⟩)
    have hg : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) (x, t) :=
      (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ))).continuousAt
    exact ContinuousAt.comp (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2)
      (f := fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) hc hg
  have hX : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simX h w.1 w.2) (x, t) := by
    show ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2) / (2 * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2))) (x, t)
    refine ContinuousAt.div₀ ?_ (continuousAt_const.mul hq) ?_
    · exact (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2)).continuousAt
    · exact mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hq0.ne'
  have hX0 : simX h x t = 0 := by unfold simX; rw [hr, zero_div]
  have hev : ∀ᶠ w in nhds ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ), simX h w.1 w.2 < Xa :=
    hX.eventually_lt continuousAt_const (show simX h x t < Xa by rw [hX0]; exact hXa)
  
  have hseq : ∀ (n : ℕ) (Y η : ℝ), Y ≤ Xa →
      bgTthSeq h T0th S G W n Y η = 0 ∧ bgTzSeq h T0z S G W n Y η = 0 := by
    intro n Y η hY
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst hn
      simp only [bgTthSeq, bgTzSeq, ↓reduceIte]
      by_cases hY0 : 0 < Y
      · rw [if_pos hY0, if_pos hY0]; exact hT0van Y η hY0 (Or.inl hY)
      · rw [if_neg hY0, if_neg hY0]; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn
      simp only [bgTthSeq, bgTzSeq, hn, ↓reduceIte, stressPrimTh, stressPrimZ]
      by_cases hg : 0 < Y ∧ -1 < η ∧ η < 1
      · rw [if_pos hg, if_pos hg]
        have hint : ∀ u ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) Y, bgResTh h S G W n u η = 0 ∧ bgResZ h S G W n u η = 0 :=
          fun u hu => hBin n hn1 u η hu.1 (by linarith [hu.2]) hg.2.1 hg.2.2
        have e1 : ∫ u in Ioc (0:ℝ) Y, u * bgResTh h S G W n u η = 0 :=
          MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero (fun u hu => by rw [(hint u hu).1, mul_zero])
        have e2 : ∫ u in Ioc (0:ℝ) Y, bgResZ h S G W n u η = 0 :=
          MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero (fun u hu => (hint u hu).2)
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hg.1.le, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hg.1.le, e1, e2]
        simp
      · rw [if_neg hg, if_neg hg]; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  have hTs : ∀ q Y η : ℝ, Y ≤ Xa → bgTsum h (bgTthSeq h T0th S G W) N q Y η = 0 ∧
      bgTsum h (bgTzSeq h T0z S G W) N q Y η = 0 := by
    intro q Y η hY
    unfold bgTsum
    exact ⟨Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun n _ => by rw [(hseq n Y η hY).1, mul_zero]),
      Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun n _ => by rw [(hseq n Y η hY).2, mul_zero])⟩
  
  have hsdf : ∀ (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), simX h y s < Xa →
      stressDivField h (bgTsum h (bgTthSeq h T0th S G W) N) (bgTsum h (bgTzSeq h T0z S G W) N) y s = 0 := by
    intro y s hy
    have key : ∀ (T : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ q Y η, Y ≤ Xa → T q Y η = 0) → ∀ q η,
        deriv (fun Y => T q Y η) (simX h y s) = 0 ∧ T q (simX h y s) η = 0 := by
      intro T hT q η
      refine ⟨?_, hT q _ η hy.le⟩
      have hev0 : (fun Y => T q Y η) =ᶠ[nhds (simX h y s)] fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Iio_mem_nhds hy) (fun Y hY => hT q Y η (le_of_lt hY))
      rw [hev0.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
    obtain ⟨d1, v1⟩ := key (bgTsum h (bgTthSeq h T0th S G W) N) (fun q Y η hY => (hTs q Y η hY).1)
      (simScale h (y 2) (1 - s)) (simEta h y s)
    obtain ⟨d2, v2⟩ := key (bgTsum h (bgTzSeq h T0z S G W) N) (fun q Y η hY => (hTs q Y η hY).2)
      (simScale h (y 2) (1 - s)) (simEta h y s)
    unfold stressDivField
    rw [d1, v1, d2, v2]
    simp
  
  refine hRc.congr ?_
  filter_upwards [hev] with w hw
  rcases w with ⟨y, s⟩
  have e : stressDivField h (bgTsum h (bgTthSeq h T0th S G W) N) (bgTsum h (bgTzSeq h T0z S G W) N) y s = 0 :=
    hsdf y s hw
  show nsResidual 1 (fun y' s' => curl3 (fun w => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgAn h n (S n) w s') y' + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgBn h n (G n) y' s') (fun y' s' => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgPn h n (W n) y' s') y s = nsResidual 1 (fun y' s' => curl3 (fun w => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgAn h n (S n) w s') y' + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgBn h n (G n) y' s') (fun y' s' => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgPn h n (W n) y' s') y s - stressDivField h (bgTsum h (bgTthSeq h T0th S G W) N) (bgTsum h (bgTzSeq h T0z S G W) N) y s
  rw [e, sub_zero]
