informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h l z τ : ℝ), 0 < l → simScale h (l ^ (1 / 2 - h) * z) (l * τ) = l * simScale h z τ

signature.name: simScale_homog
signature.statement: ∀ (h l z τ : ℝ), 0 < l → simScale h (l ^ (1 / 2 - h) * z) (l * τ) = l * simScale h z τ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h l z τ hl
  have hl2 : l ^ (1 - 2 * h) * l ^ (2 * h) = l := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hl, show (1 - 2 * h) + 2 * h = (1 : ℝ) by ring, Real.rpow_one]
  have ha : (l ^ (1 / 2 - h) * z) ^ 2 = l ^ (1 - 2 * h) * z ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, sq (l ^ (1 / 2 - h)), ← Real.rpow_add hl,
      show (1 / 2 - h) + (1 / 2 - h) = 1 - 2 * h by ring]
  have key : ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p → l * p - (l ^ (1 / 2 - h) * z) ^ 2 * (l * p) ^ (2 * h) =
      l * (p - z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h)) := by
    intro p hp
    rw [ha, Real.mul_rpow hl.le hp.le]
    linear_combination (-(z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h))) * hl2
  letI : SMul ℝ (Set ℝ) := Set.smulSet
  have hset : {q : ℝ | 0 < q ∧ l * τ ≤ q - (l ^ (1 / 2 - h) * z) ^ 2 * q ^ (2 * h)} =
      l • {q : ℝ | 0 < q ∧ τ ≤ q - z ^ 2 * q ^ (2 * h)} := by
    ext q
    rw [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem₀ hl.ne', smul_eq_mul, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
      Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    obtain ⟨p, hpdef⟩ : ∃ p : ℝ, p = l⁻¹ * q := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hq : q = l * p := by rw [hpdef]; field_simp
    rw [← hpdef, hq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hq0, hc⟩
      have hp : 0 < p := by nlinarith
      refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
      rw [key _ hp] at hc
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hc hl
    · rintro ⟨hp, hc⟩
      refine ⟨mul_pos hl hp, ?_⟩
      rw [key _ hp]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc hl.le
  unfold simScale
  rw [hset, Real.sInf_smul_of_nonneg hl.le, smul_eq_mul]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h l : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (y y' : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), 0 < l → s < 1 → y' 0 = l ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * y 0 → y' 1 = l ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * y 1 → y' 2 = l ^ (1 / 2 - h) * y 2 → bgAn h n g y' (1 - l * (1 - s)) = l ^ (-h + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) • bgAn h n g y s ∧ bgBn h n g y' (1 - l * (1 - s)) = l ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) • bgBn h n g y s ∧ bgPn h n g y' (1 - l * (1 - s)) = l ^ (-(1 + 2 * h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * bgPn h n g y s

signature.name: bg_field_dilation
signature.statement: ∀ (h l : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (y y' : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), 0 < l → s < 1 → y' 0 = l ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * y 0 → y' 1 = l ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * y 1 → y' 2 = l ^ (1 / 2 - h) * y 2 → bgAn h n g y' (1 - l * (1 - s)) = l ^ (-h + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) • bgAn h n g y s ∧ bgBn h n g y' (1 - l * (1 - s)) = l ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) • bgBn h n g y s ∧ bgPn h n g y' (1 - l * (1 - s)) = l ^ (-(1 + 2 * h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * bgPn h n g y s

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h l n g y y' s hl hs hy0 hy1 hy2
  have hQ0 : 0 ≤ simScale h (y 2) (1 - s) := by
    unfold simScale
    exact Real.sInf_nonneg (fun x hx => hx.1.le)
  have homog : ∀ (h l z τ : ℝ), 0 < l → simScale h (l ^ (1 / 2 - h) * z) (l * τ) = l * simScale h z τ := by
    intro h l z τ hl
    have hl2 : l ^ (1 - 2 * h) * l ^ (2 * h) = l := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hl, show (1 - 2 * h) + 2 * h = (1 : ℝ) by ring, Real.rpow_one]
    have ha : (l ^ (1 / 2 - h) * z) ^ 2 = l ^ (1 - 2 * h) * z ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, sq (l ^ (1 / 2 - h)), ← Real.rpow_add hl,
        show (1 / 2 - h) + (1 / 2 - h) = 1 - 2 * h by ring]
    have key : ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p → l * p - (l ^ (1 / 2 - h) * z) ^ 2 * (l * p) ^ (2 * h) =
        l * (p - z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h)) := by
      intro p hp
      rw [ha, Real.mul_rpow hl.le hp.le]
      linear_combination (-(z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h))) * hl2
    letI : SMul ℝ (Set ℝ) := Set.smulSet
    have hset : {q : ℝ | 0 < q ∧ l * τ ≤ q - (l ^ (1 / 2 - h) * z) ^ 2 * q ^ (2 * h)} =
        l • {q : ℝ | 0 < q ∧ τ ≤ q - z ^ 2 * q ^ (2 * h)} := by
      ext q
      rw [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem₀ hl.ne', smul_eq_mul, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
        Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      obtain ⟨p, hpdef⟩ : ∃ p : ℝ, p = l⁻¹ * q := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hq : q = l * p := by rw [hpdef]; field_simp
      rw [← hpdef, hq]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hq0, hc⟩
        have hp : 0 < p := by nlinarith
        refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
        rw [key _ hp] at hc
        exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hc hl
      · rintro ⟨hp, hc⟩
        refine ⟨mul_pos hl hp, ?_⟩
        rw [key _ hp]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc hl.le
    unfold simScale
    rw [hset, Real.sInf_smul_of_nonneg hl.le, smul_eq_mul]
  have hQ : simScale h (y' 2) (1 - (1 - l * (1 - s))) = l * simScale h (y 2) (1 - s) := by
    rw [hy2, show (1:ℝ) - (1 - l * (1 - s)) = l * (1 - s) by ring]
    exact homog h l (y 2) (1 - s) hl
  have hsq : (l ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ 2 = l := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hl.le]
    norm_num
  have hX : simX h y' (1 - l * (1 - s)) = simX h y s := by
    unfold simX
    rw [hQ, hy0, hy1]
    have e1 : (l ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * y 0) ^ 2 + (l ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * y 1) ^ 2 =
        l * (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) := by
      rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, hsq]; ring
    rw [e1, show 2 * (l * simScale h (y 2) (1 - s)) = l * (2 * simScale h (y 2) (1 - s)) by ring,
      mul_div_mul_left _ _ hl.ne']
  have hE : simEta h y' (1 - l * (1 - s)) = simEta h y s := by
    unfold simEta
    rw [hQ, hy2, Real.mul_rpow hl.le hQ0]
    have hll : l ^ (1 / 2 - h) * l ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hl, add_neg_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
    linear_combination (y 2 * simScale h (y 2) (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) * hll
  have hJ : azVec y' = l ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) • azVec y := by
    unfold azVec
    rw [hy0, hy1, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_neg]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold bgAn
    rw [hQ, hX, hE, hJ, Real.mul_rpow hl.le hQ0, smul_smul, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    have hA : l ^ (-h + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) = l ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * l ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hl]; congr 1; ring
    rw [hA]
    generalize l ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) = A
    generalize l ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) = B
    generalize simScale h (y 2) (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) = C
    ring
  · unfold bgBn
    rw [hQ, hX, hE, hJ, Real.mul_rpow hl.le hQ0, smul_smul, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    have hB : l ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) = l ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * l ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hl]; congr 1; ring
    rw [hB]
    generalize l ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) = A
    generalize l ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) = B
    generalize simScale h (y 2) (1 - s) ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) = C
    ring
  · unfold bgPn
    rw [hQ, hX, hE, Real.mul_rpow hl.le hQ0]
    ring

by
  intro h l hh0 hh1 hl
  have hl0 : 0 ≤ l := by linarith
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = l ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ, b = l ^ (1 / 2 - h) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by rw [ha]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg hl0 _
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ b := by rw [hb]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg hl0 _
  have hal : a ≤ l := by rw [ha]; exact Real.rpow_le_self_of_one_le hl (by norm_num)
  have hbl : b ≤ l := by rw [hb]; exact Real.rpow_le_self_of_one_le hl (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³, D = a • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ³ +
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight
        ((b - a) • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD : ∀ y : ℝ³, D y 0 = a * y 0 ∧ D y 1 = a * y 1 ∧ D y 2 = b * y 2 := by
    intro y
    subst hDdef
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp <;> ring
  have hDn : ∀ y : ℝ³, ‖D y‖ ≤ l * ‖y‖ := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := hD y
    have e1 := EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq (D y)
    have e2 := EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq y
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at e1 e2
    have hsq : ‖D y‖ ^ 2 ≤ (l * ‖y‖) ^ 2 := by
      rw [e1, mul_pow, e2]
      have h0' : (D y).ofLp 0 = a * y.ofLp 0 := h0
      have h1' : (D y).ofLp 1 = a * y.ofLp 1 := h1
      have h2' : (D y).ofLp 2 = b * y.ofLp 2 := h2
      rw [h0', h1', h2']
      have ea : a ^ 2 ≤ l ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ ha0 hal 2
      have eb : b ^ 2 ≤ l ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hb0 hbl 2
      have k0 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ea (sq_nonneg (y.ofLp 0))
      have k1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ea (sq_nonneg (y.ofLp 1))
      have k2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right eb (sq_nonneg (y.ofLp 2))
      nlinarith
    exact (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hl0 (norm_nonneg _))
      two_ne_zero).mp hsq
  refine ⟨(D.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)).prod (l • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ³ ℝ),
    ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hl0 ?_
    rintro ⟨y, s⟩
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd',
      Prod.norm_def]
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hl0]
    apply max_le
    · exact (hDn y).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left _ _) hl0)
    · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right _ _) hl0
  · intro y s
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := hD y
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← ha]; exact h0
    · rw [← ha]; exact h1
    · rw [← hb]; exact h2
    · simp [smul_eq_mul]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ {E V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (F : E → V) (Λ : E →L[ℝ] E) (c : E) (U : Set E) (a b : ℝ) (m : ℕ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → (∀ w ∈ U, Λ w + c ∈ U) → (∀ w ∈ U, F (Λ w + c) = a • F w) → ‖Λ‖ ≤ b → ∀ w ∈ U, |a| * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F w‖ ≤ b ^ m * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F (Λ w + c)‖

signature.name: affine_rescale_deriv_bound
signature.statement: ∀ {E V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (F : E → V) (Λ : E →L[ℝ] E) (c : E) (U : Set E) (a b : ℝ) (m : ℕ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → (∀ w ∈ U, Λ w + c ∈ U) → (∀ w ∈ U, F (Λ w + c) = a • F w) → ‖Λ‖ ≤ b → ∀ w ∈ U, |a| * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F w‖ ≤ b ^ m * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F (Λ w + c)‖

proof.tactics:
by
  intro E V _ _ _ _ F Λ c U a b m hU hF hmaps hid hΛ w hw
  have hm : ((m : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hU₁ : IsOpen ((fun z : E => z + c) ⁻¹' U) :=
    hU.preimage (continuous_id.add continuous_const)
  have hU₂ : IsOpen (Λ ⁻¹' ((fun z : E => z + c) ⁻¹' U)) := hU₁.preimage Λ.continuous
  have hΛw : Λ w ∈ (fun z : E => z + c) ⁻¹' U := hmaps w hw
  have hF₁ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (z + c)) ((fun z : E => z + c) ⁻¹' U) :=
    hF.comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const).contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
  have hchain := Λ.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right hF₁ hU₁.uniqueDiffOn hU₂.uniqueDiffOn hΛw hm
  rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hU₂ (show w ∈ Λ ⁻¹' ((fun z : E => z + c) ⁻¹' U) from hΛw),
    iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hU₁ hΛw, iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right] at hchain
  have hev : ((fun z => F (z + c)) ∘ Λ) =ᶠ[nhds w] (fun z => a • F z) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hw) (fun z hz => hid z hz)
  have hloc := (hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply' ((hF.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hw)).of_le hm)] at hloc
  rw [hloc] at hchain
  have hnorm := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
    (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F (Λ w + c)) (fun _ : Fin m => Λ)
  rw [← hchain, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hnorm
  simp only [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hnorm
  calc |a| * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F w‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F (Λ w + c)‖ * ‖Λ‖ ^ m := hnorm
    _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F (Λ w + c)‖ * b ^ m :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg Λ) hΛ m) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = b ^ m * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F (Λ w + c)‖ := mul_comm _ _

informal_problem.statement: ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : ℝ³ × ℝ → V) (m : ℕ) (P : ℝ → ℝ → Prop) (B R : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} → (∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → P (x 2) t → 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 ≤ R (x 2) t → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (x, t)‖ ≤ B (x 2) t) → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → P (x 2) t → 0 < R (x 2) t → x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 ≤ R (x 2) t → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (x, t)‖ ≤ B (x 2) t

signature.name: axis_extension_bound
signature.statement: ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : ℝ³ × ℝ → V) (m : ℕ) (P : ℝ → ℝ → Prop) (B R : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} → (∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → P (x 2) t → 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 ≤ R (x 2) t → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (x, t)‖ ≤ B (x 2) t) → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → P (x 2) t → 0 < R (x 2) t → x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 ≤ R (x 2) t → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (x, t)‖ ≤ B (x 2) t

proof.tactics:
by
  intro V _ _ f m P B R hf hoff x t ht hP hR hr
  by_cases hpos : 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2
  · exact hoff x t ht hP hpos hr
  have hs : x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hpos) (by positivity)
  have hx0 : x 0 = 0 := by
    have h0 : x 0 ^ 2 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0), sq_nonneg (x 1)]
    exact (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero).mp h0
  have hx1 : x 1 = 0 := by
    have h0 : x 1 ^ 2 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0), sq_nonneg (x 1)]
    exact (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero).mp h0
  set e : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) with he
  have hy0 : ∀ ε : ℝ, (x + ε • e) 0 = ε := by intro ε; simp [he, hx0]
  have hy1 : ∀ ε : ℝ, (x + ε • e) 1 = 0 := by intro ε; simp [he, hx1]
  have hy2 : ∀ ε : ℝ, (x + ε • e) 2 = x 2 := by intro ε; simp [he]
  have hbound : ∀ ε ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) (min 1 (R (x 2) t)),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (x + ε • e, t)‖ ≤ B (x 2) t := by
    rintro ε ⟨hε0, hε1⟩
    have h1 : ε < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hε1 (min_le_left _ _)
    have h2 : ε < R (x 2) t := lt_of_lt_of_le hε1 (min_le_right _ _)
    have hb := hoff (x + ε • e) t ht (by rw [hy2]; exact hP)
      (by rw [hy0, hy1]; nlinarith [mul_pos hε0 hε0])
      (by rw [hy0, hy1, hy2]; nlinarith [mul_pos hε0 hε0])
    rwa [hy2] at hb
  have hU : {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∈ nhds (x, t) :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const).mem_nhds ht
  have hcont : ContinuousAt (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f) (x, t) :=
    (hf.contDiffAt hU).continuousAt_iteratedFDeriv (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hγ : Continuous (fun ε : ℝ => (x + ε • e, t)) := by fun_prop
  have hγ0 : (fun ε : ℝ => (x + ε • e, t)) 0 = (x, t) := by simp
  have hφ : Filter.Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (x + ε • e, t)‖)
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (x, t)‖) := by
    have h1 : ContinuousAt (fun ε : ℝ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (x + ε • e, t)) 0 :=
      ContinuousAt.comp_of_eq hcont hγ.continuousAt hγ0
    have h2 := h1.norm.tendsto
    simp only [zero_smul, add_zero] at h2
    exact h2.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  apply le_of_tendsto hφ
  filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (lt_min one_pos hR)] with ε hε
  exact hbound ε hε

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h Xp : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → (∀ X η : ℝ, Xp ≤ X → g X η = 0) → ∀ (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → Xp < simX h x t → iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgAn h n g)) (x, t) = 0 ∧ iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgBn h n g)) (x, t) = 0 ∧ iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgPn h n g)) (x, t) = 0

signature.name: bg_field_vanish_far
signature.statement: ∀ (h Xp : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → (∀ X η : ℝ, Xp ≤ X → g X η = 0) → ∀ (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → Xp < simX h x t → iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgAn h n g)) (x, t) = 0 ∧ iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgBn h n g)) (x, t) = 0 ∧ iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgPn h n g)) (x, t) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Xp n g hS hh0 hh1 hvan m x t ht hX
  have hQc : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) (x, t) := by
    have hc4 : ContinuousAt (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h p.1 p.2) (x 2, 1 - t) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.continuousAt ((isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds
        ⟨mem_univ _, show (0 : ℝ) < 1 - t by linarith⟩)
    have hφ : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)) :=
      ((EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3)).continuous.comp continuous_fst).prodMk
        (continuous_const.sub continuous_snd)
    exact hc4.comp_of_eq (f := fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)) hφ.continuousAt rfl
  have hN : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2) := by
    have h0 : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.1 0) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3)).continuous.comp continuous_fst
    have h1 : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.1 1) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3)).continuous.comp continuous_fst
    exact (h0.pow 2).add (h1.pow 2)
  have hXc : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simX h w.1 w.2) (x, t) := by
    have hD : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => 2 * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) (x, t) :=
      continuousAt_const.mul hQc
    have hne : 2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≠ 0 := by
      have := (hS.1 (x 2) (1 - t) (by linarith)).1
      positivity
    have := hN.continuousAt.div hD hne
    unfold simX
    exact this
  have hev : ∀ᶠ w in nhds ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ), Xp < simX h w.1 w.2 :=
    continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hXc hX
  have hg : ∀ᶠ w in nhds ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ), g (simX h w.1 w.2) (simEta h w.1 w.2) = 0 :=
    hev.mono fun w hw => hvan _ _ hw.le
  have hA : (↿(bgAn h n g)) =ᶠ[nhds ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ)] fun _ => (0 : ℝ³) :=
    hg.mono fun w hw => by
      show bgAn h n g w.1 w.2 = 0
      unfold bgAn
      rw [hw, mul_zero, zero_smul]
  have hB : (↿(bgBn h n g)) =ᶠ[nhds ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ)] fun _ => (0 : ℝ³) :=
    hg.mono fun w hw => by
      show bgBn h n g w.1 w.2 = 0
      unfold bgBn
      rw [hw, mul_zero, zero_smul]
  have hP : (↿(bgPn h n g)) =ᶠ[nhds ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ)] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
    hg.mono fun w hw => by
      show bgPn h n g w.1 w.2 = 0
      unfold bgPn
      rw [hw, mul_zero]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [(hA.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
    rfl
  · rw [(hB.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
    rfl
  · rw [(hP.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
    rfl

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h M : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < M → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≤ 1 → 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 ≤ M * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgAn h n g)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgBn h n g)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgPn h n g)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K)

signature.name: bg_field_offaxis_wt_bounds
signature.statement: ∀ (h M : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < M → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≤ 1 → 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 ≤ M * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgAn h n g)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgBn h n g)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(bgPn h n g)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h M n g hS h0 hh2 hM hg hgb m
  
  obtain ⟨Ω, hΩ⟩ : ∃ Ω : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ), Ω = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hSd⟩ : ∃ S : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ), S = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1 ∧
      0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ∧
      simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 ∧
      w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ M * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ Q : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ, Q = fun w => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ : ∃ Φ : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ, Φ = fun z => (simX h z.1 z.2, simEta h z.1 z.2) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Jf, hJf⟩ : ∃ Jf : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ³, Jf = fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
      -(z.1 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
        z.1 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => z.1 i) := fun i =>
    ((EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)).contDiff
  have hr2c : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2) :=
    ((hc 0).continuous.pow 2).add ((hc 1).continuous.pow 2)
  have hΩo : IsOpen Ω := by
    rw [hΩ]
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const).inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hr2c)
  have hTo : IsOpen (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hmemS : ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w ∈ S ↔ (w.2 < 1 ∧ 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ∧
      simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 ∧
      w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ M * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) := by
    intro w; rw [hSd]; rfl
  have hmemΩ : ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w ∈ Ω ↔ (w.2 < 1 ∧ 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2) := by
    intro w; rw [hΩ]; rfl
  have hΩsub : Ω ⊆ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := fun w hw => ((hmemΩ w).1 hw).1
  have hSΩ : S ⊆ Ω := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, -⟩ := (hmemS w).1 hw
    exact (hmemΩ w).2 ⟨h1, h2⟩
  have hreg := bg_interior_region_facts h M hS h0 hh2 hM
  have hρ : ∀ w ∈ S, 0 < Q w ∧ Q w ≤ 1 := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨h1, -, h2, -⟩ := (hmemS w).1 hw
    rw [hQ]
    exact ⟨(hreg w h1).1.1, h2⟩
  have hmaps : MapsTo Φ Ω (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨h1, hr⟩ := (hmemΩ w).1 hw
    obtain ⟨⟨hq, -, he1, he2⟩, -⟩ := hreg w h1
    have hX : 0 < simX h w.1 w.2 := by
      unfold simX
      exact div_pos hr (mul_pos two_pos hq)
    rw [hΦ]
    exact ⟨mem_Ioi.mpr hX, he1, he2⟩
  
  have hconv : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : ℝ³ × ℝ → F),
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 →
        w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ M * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w‖ ≤ C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K)) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w‖ ≤ C * Q w ^ (-K) := by
    intro F _ _ f hf k
    obtain ⟨C, K, hCK⟩ := hf k
    refine ⟨C, K, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨h1, -, h2, h3⟩ := (hmemS w).1 hw
    rw [hQ]
    exact hCK w h1 h2 h3
  
  obtain ⟨hΦs, hΦb⟩ := simXEta_wt_bound h M hS h0 hh2 hM
  have hΦs' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ Ω := by rw [hΦ]; exact hΦs.mono hΩsub
  have hΦb' : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Φ w‖ ≤ C * Q w ^ (-K) := by
    rw [hΦ]; exact hconv _ hΦb
  have houter : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿g) (Φ w)‖ ≤ C * Q w ^ (-K) := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hgb k
    refine ⟨C, 0, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    have hT := hmaps (hSΩ hw)
    rw [hΦ] at hT
    obtain ⟨hX0, he1, he2⟩ := hT
    rw [neg_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one, hΦ]
    exact hC _ _ hX0 he1 he2
  obtain ⟨hGs, hGb⟩ := wt_comp_bound (↿g) Φ Q Ω S (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) hΩo hTo hSΩ
    hmaps hρ hg hΦs' houter hΦb'
  
  have hpow : ∀ p : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Q z ^ p) Ω ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => Q z ^ p) w‖ ≤ C * Q w ^ (-K) := by
    intro p
    obtain ⟨hs, hb⟩ := simScale_rpow_wt_bound h p hS h0 hh2
    refine ⟨by rw [hQ]; exact hs.mono hΩsub, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, K, hCK⟩ := hb k
    refine ⟨C, K, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨h1, -, h2, -⟩ := (hmemS w).1 hw
    rw [hQ]
    exact hCK w h1 h2
  
  have hJs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Jf := by
    rw [hJf]
    exact ((hc 1).neg.smul contDiff_const).add ((hc 0).smul contDiff_const)
  have hJb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Jf w‖ ≤ C * Q w ^ (-K) := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := ball_iteratedFDeriv_bound Jf hJs (M + 1) k
    refine ⟨C, 0, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨h1, -, h2, h3⟩ := (hmemS w).1 hw
    obtain ⟨hn, -⟩ := (hreg w h1).2 h2 h3
    rw [neg_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
    exact hC w hn
  
  obtain ⟨hPs, hPb⟩ := wt_bilinear_bound (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ)
    (fun z => Q z ^ (-(1 + 2 * h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h)) (↿g ∘ Φ) Q Ω S hΩo hSΩ hρ
    (hpow _).1 hGs (hpow _).2 hGb
  obtain ⟨hsBs, hsBb⟩ := wt_bilinear_bound (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ)
    (fun z => Q z ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h)) (↿g ∘ Φ) Q Ω S hΩo hSΩ hρ
    (hpow _).1 hGs (hpow _).2 hGb
  obtain ⟨-, hBb⟩ := wt_bilinear_bound (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³)
    _ Jf Q Ω S hΩo hSΩ hρ hsBs hJs.contDiffOn hsBb hJb
  obtain ⟨hsAs, hsAb⟩ := wt_bilinear_bound ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ)
    (fun z => Q z ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h)) (↿g ∘ Φ) Q Ω S hΩo hSΩ hρ
    (hpow _).1 hGs (hpow _).2 hGb
  obtain ⟨-, hAb⟩ := wt_bilinear_bound (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³)
    _ Jf Q Ω S hΩo hSΩ hρ hsAs hJs.contDiffOn hsAb hJb
  
  have eP : (↿(bgPn h n g)) = fun z => ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ
      (Q z ^ (-(1 + 2 * h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h)) ((↿g ∘ Φ) z) := by
    funext z
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply', hQ, hΦ]
    rfl
  have eB : (↿(bgBn h n g)) = fun z => (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ (Q z ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h)) ((↿g ∘ Φ) z)) (Jf z) := by
    funext z
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply', hQ, hΦ, hJf]
    rfl
  have eA : (↿(bgAn h n g)) = fun z => (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³)
      (((1 / 2 : ℝ) • ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) (Q z ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h))
        ((↿g ∘ Φ) z)) (Jf z) := by
    funext z
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply', smul_eq_mul, hQ, hΦ, hJf,
      ← mul_assoc]
    rfl
  
  obtain ⟨CA, KA, hA⟩ := hAb m
  obtain ⟨CB, KB, hB⟩ := hBb m
  obtain ⟨CP, KP, hP⟩ := hPb m
  refine ⟨|CA| + |CB| + |CP|, max (max KA KB) KP, ?_⟩
  intro x t ht hq1 hr0 hr
  have hw : ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ S := (hmemS (x, t)).2 ⟨ht, hr0, hq1, hr⟩
  have hQw : Q (x, t) = simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) := by rw [hQ]
  have hq0 : 0 < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) := by rw [← hQw]; exact (hρ _ hw).1
  have hqK0 : 0 ≤ simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-max (max KA KB) KP) :=
    (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _).le
  have hgen : ∀ Ci Ki : ℝ, Ki ≤ max (max KA KB) KP → |Ci| ≤ |CA| + |CB| + |CP| →
      Ci * Q (x, t) ^ (-Ki) ≤
        (|CA| + |CB| + |CP|) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-max (max KA KB) KP) := by
    intro Ci Ki hKi hCi
    rw [hQw]
    calc Ci * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-Ki)
        ≤ |Ci| * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-Ki) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _).le
      _ ≤ |Ci| * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-max (max KA KB) KP) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1 (by linarith)) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ (|CA| + |CB| + |CP|) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-max (max KA KB) KP) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCi hqK0
  have hKA : KA ≤ max (max KA KB) KP := (le_max_left KA KB).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hKB : KB ≤ max (max KA KB) KP := (le_max_right KA KB).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hKP : KP ≤ max (max KA KB) KP := le_max_right _ _
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [eA]
    exact (hA _ hw).trans (hgen CA KA hKA (by linarith [abs_nonneg CB, abs_nonneg CP]))
  · rw [eB]
    exact (hB _ hw).trans (hgen CB KB hKB (by linarith [abs_nonneg CA, abs_nonneg CP]))
  · rw [eP]
    exact (hP _ hw).trans (hgen CP KP hKP (by linarith [abs_nonneg CA, abs_nonneg CB]))

subgoal_signatures.name: wt_bilinear_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {E F G H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] H) (f : E → F) (g : E → G) (ρ : E → ℝ) (Ω S : Set E), IsOpen Ω → S ⊆ Ω → (∀ w ∈ S, 0 < ρ w ∧ ρ w ≤ 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g Ω → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) Ω ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)

subgoal_signatures.name: wt_comp_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {E F G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (g : F → G) (f : E → F) (ρ : E → ℝ) (Ω S : Set E) (T : Set F), IsOpen Ω → IsOpen T → S ⊆ Ω → MapsTo f Ω T → (∀ w ∈ S, 0 < ρ w ∧ ρ w ≤ 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g T → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (f w)‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (g ∘ f) Ω ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (g ∘ f) w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)

subgoal_signatures.name: ball_iteratedFDeriv_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (p : ℝ³ × ℝ → F), ContDiff ℝ ∞ p → ∀ (B : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, ‖w‖ ≤ B → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k p w‖ ≤ C

subgoal_signatures.name: bg_interior_region_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h M : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < M → ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → (0 < simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ∧ 0 ≤ simX h w.1 w.2 ∧ -1 < simEta h w.1 w.2 ∧ simEta h w.1 w.2 < 1) ∧ (simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 → w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ M * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) → ‖w‖ ≤ M + 1 ∧ simX h w.1 w.2 ≤ M / 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: simScale_rpow_wt_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h p : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ p) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ p) w‖ ≤ C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K)

subgoal_signatures.name: simXEta_wt_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h M : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < M → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (simX h z.1 z.2, simEta h z.1 z.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 → w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ M * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (simX h z.1 z.2, simEta h z.1 z.2)) w‖ ≤ C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K)

informal_problem.statement: RepairProperty → ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xan Xm Xm2 Xp2 Xp r1 r2 : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (FN UN : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), JoinProf h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xan Xm Xm2 Xp2 Xp r1 r2 F U → ModulatedFamily h Xm Xp F U FN UN → ∃ ε κ Xm' s2 : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 < κ ∧ Xm < Xm' ∧ Xm' < Xp ∧ r1 < s2 ∧ s2 < r2 ∧ ProfileReg h cinf Xb ε F U ∧ ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∃ F' U' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ X η : ℝ, (X ≤ Xm' ∨ s2 ≤ X) → F' X η = F X η ∧ U' X η = U X η) ∧ ProfileReg h cinf Xb ε F' U' ∧ (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), F' x η ^ 2) = ∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), F x η ^ 2 ∧ profRadInt U' s2 η = profRadInt U s2 η ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F' x e) s2 η = profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * F x e) s2 η ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => U' x e * (2 * x * F' x e)) s2 η = profRadInt (fun x e => U x e * (2 * x * F x e)) s2 η ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => U' x e ^ 2 - x * F' x e ^ 2) s2 η = profRadInt (fun x e => U x e ^ 2 - x * F x e ^ 2) s2 η ∧ ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U' x η) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * F' x η) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U' x η * (2 * x * F' x η)) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U' x η ^ 2 - x * F' x η ^ 2) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => F' x η ^ 2) volume 0 X) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ r2 → -1 < η → η < 1 → |F' X η - F X η| ≤ τ ∧ |U' X η - U X η| ≤ τ ∧ |deriv (fun e => F' X e) η - deriv (fun e => F X e) η| ≤ τ ∧ |deriv (fun e => U' X e) η - deriv (fun e => U X e) η| ≤ τ) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 → κ ≤ shearA F' X η ∧ shearA F' X η ≤ 1 / κ ∧ |shearB F' U' X η| ≤ 1 / κ ∧ κ ≤ shearA F' X η * (1 + (shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η) ^ 2) - 2 ∧ κ ≤ psLead1 h F U X η - shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η * psLead2 h F U X η - 2 ∧ κ ≤ coneUp (psLead1 h F U X η - shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η * psLead2 h F U X η) (psLead2 h F U X η + shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η * psLead1 h F U X η) - shearA F' X η * (1 + (shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η) ^ 2)) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, Xp ≤ X → X ≤ r2 → -1 < η → η < 1 → |shearA F' X η - shearA F X η| ≤ τ ∧ |shearB F' U' X η - shearB F U X η| ≤ τ)

x * F' x η ^ 2) volume 0 X ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun x => F' x η ^ 2) volume 0 X) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ r2 → -1 < η → η < 1 → |F' X η - F X η| ≤ τ ∧ |U' X η - U X η| ≤ τ ∧ |deriv (fun e => F' X e) η - deriv (fun e => F X e) η| ≤ τ ∧ |deriv (fun e => U' X e) η - deriv (fun e => U X e) η| ≤ τ) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 → κ ≤ shearA F' X η ∧ shearA F' X η ≤ 1 / κ ∧ |shearB F' U' X η| ≤ 1 / κ ∧ κ ≤ shearA F' X η * (1 + (shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η) ^ 2) - 2 ∧ κ ≤ psLead1 h F U X η - shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η * psLead2 h F U X η - 2 ∧ κ ≤ coneUp (psLead1 h F U X η - shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η * psLead2 h F U X η) (psLead2 h F U X η + shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η * psLead1 h F U X η) - shearA F' X η * (1 + (shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η) ^ 2)) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, Xp ≤ X → X ≤ r2 → -1 < η → η < 1 → |shearA F' X η - shearA F X η| ≤ τ ∧ |shearB F' U' X η - shearB F U X η| ≤ τ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro hRep h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xan Xm Xm2 Xp2 Xp r1 r2 F U FN UN hJ hM
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, hh1, hlam, hcinf, hcp, haa, hab, hXa, hXap1, hp12, hp2m1, hm12, hm2Xv, hXvXc, hXcXb,
    hXaXan, hXanXm, hXmXm2, hXm2Xp2, hXp2Xp, hXpr1, hr1r2, hr2p1⟩, hpatch, -, hJadm, -, hJint,
    ⟨hFs, hUs, hFpos, hFbd⟩, ⟨ε, hε, hFsε, hUsε, hF0, hFbdε⟩, -, hheat, -, -, -, -⟩ := hJ
  obtain ⟨Xm', Xp', κ, C, N0, hXm', hXm'p', hXp'p, hκ, hN0, hMN⟩ := hM
  obtain ⟨s1, s2, δ, CΦ, β, γ, Φ, hs1, hs12, hs2, hδ, hβs, hγs, hβ0, hγ0, hΦs, hΦ0, hΦ⟩ :=
    hRep lam cpatch r1 r2 hlam hcp (by linarith) hr1r2
  obtain ⟨-, -, κa, hκa0, -, hκa⟩ := hJadm
  have hXm0 : 0 < Xm := by linarith
  have hXp0 : 0 < Xp := by linarith
  have hSo : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hslc : ∀ (Ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (T : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (η : ℝ), ContinuousOn (↿Ψ) T →
      (∀ x ∈ S, (x, η) ∈ T) → ContinuousOn (fun x => Ψ x η) S := by
    intro Ψ S T η hc hm
    exact hc.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn (fun x hx => hm x hx)
  have hdiv : ∀ a k D : ℝ, 0 < D → a * (k / D) ≤ 1 → a * k ≤ D := by
    intro a k D hD hh
    have h2 : a * (k / D) * D = a * k := by field_simp
    linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh hD.le, h2]
  have s1h : ∀ a b : ℝ, a + b - a = b := fun a b => by ring
  have hPR : ProfileReg h cinf Xb ε F U := by
    refine ⟨hFsε, hUsε, ?_, hFbdε, fun η e1 e2 => (hJint η e1 e2).1,
      fun X η hX e1 e2 => hheat X η hX e1 e2⟩
    intro X η hX e1 e2
    rcases hX.lt_or_eq with hX | hX
    · exact hFpos X η hX e1 e2
    · rw [← hX]; exact hF0 η e1 e2
  have hFpatch : ∀ X η : ℝ, r1 ≤ X → X ≤ r2 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      U X η = 0 ∧ F X η = patchF0 lam cpatch η X := by
    intro X η h1 h2 e1 e2
    obtain ⟨hu, hf⟩ := hpatch X η h1 h2 e1 e2
    have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * X) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by linarith)
    refine ⟨hu, ?_⟩
    unfold patchF0
    rw [eq_div_iff hs.ne']
    linarith [hf]
  
  obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := hFbd Xm Xp hXm0 0
  obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hFbd Xm Xp hXm0 1
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = max (max C0 C1) 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by rw [hB]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hBC0 : C0 ≤ B := by rw [hB]; exact (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hBC1 : C1 ≤ B := by rw [hB]; exact (le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hBpt : ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 → |F X η| ≤ B ∧ |U X η| ≤ B ∧
      |deriv (fun e' => F X e') η| ≤ B ∧ |deriv (fun e' => U X e') η| ≤ B := by
    intro X η h1 h2 e1 e2
    have hmem : (X, η) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨show (0:ℝ) < X by linarith, e1, e2⟩
    obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := hC0 X η h1 h2 e1 e2
    obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := hC1 X η h1 h2 e1 e2
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at a1 a2
    have d1 := (slice_deriv_facts F _ X η hSo hFs hmem).2.2.2.1
    have d2 := (slice_deriv_facts U _ X η hSo hUs hmem).2.2.2.1
    exact ⟨a1.trans hBC0, a2.trans hBC0, d1.trans (c1.trans hBC1), d2.trans (c2.trans hBC1)⟩
  obtain ⟨M0, hM0⟩ : ∃ M0 : ℝ, M0 = (Xp' - Xm') * (8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hM0nn : 0 ≤ M0 := by
    rw [hM0]
    exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (by linarith)) (sq_nonneg _))
  obtain ⟨K2, hK2pos, hK2⟩ := ax_repair_coef δ Φ hδ hΦs hΦ0
  obtain ⟨Γ, hΓ0, hΓ⟩ := rc_bump_regular s1 s2 β γ hβs hγs hβ0 hγ0
  obtain ⟨B1, hB1⟩ := hFbd Xp r2 hXp0 1
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := cone_alg_shear (κa / 2) B1 Xp r2 (by linarith) hXp0 (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ, W = Γ * K2 * M0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hWnn : 0 ≤ W := by rw [hW]; exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hΓ0 hK2pos.le) hM0nn
  have hRF0 : ∀ (c : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ) (X η : ℝ), (X ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ X) →
      rcRF γ c X η = 0 ∧ rcRU β c X η = 0 := by
    intro c X η hX
    simp only [rcRF, rcRU, hγ0 0 X hX, hγ0 1 X hX, hγ0 2 X hX, hβ0 0 X hX, hβ0 1 X hX, mul_zero,
      add_zero, and_self]
  refine ⟨ε, κ, Xm', s2, hε, hκ, hXm', by linarith, by linarith, hs2, hPR, ?_⟩
  intro τ hτ
  
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ, P = 1 + 1 / τ + (M0 * 2) / δ + W / τ + (W * 2) / κa + (W * |L|) / τ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨N1, hN1⟩ := exists_nat_ge ((|C| + 1) * P)
  obtain ⟨N, hNd⟩ : ∃ N : ℕ, N = max N0 N1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hNN0 : N0 ≤ N := by rw [hNd]; exact le_max_left _ _
  have hNpos : (0:ℝ) < N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
  have hNge : (|C| + 1) * P ≤ (N : ℝ) :=
    hN1.trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr (by rw [hNd]; exact le_max_right _ _))
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q : ℝ, q = (|C| + 1) / (N : ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := by rw [hq]; positivity
  have hqP : q * P ≤ 1 := by rw [hq, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_one hNpos]; exact hNge
  have hCNq : C / (N : ℝ) ≤ q := by rw [hq]; gcongr; linarith [le_abs_self C]
  have hexp : q * P = q + q * (1 / τ) + q * ((M0 * 2) / δ) + q * (W / τ) + q * ((W * 2) / κa) +
      q * ((W * |L|) / τ) := by rw [hP]; ring
  have t1 : 0 ≤ q * (1 / τ) := mul_nonneg hq0 (div_nonneg zero_le_one hτ.le)
  have t2 : 0 ≤ q * ((M0 * 2) / δ) := mul_nonneg hq0 (div_nonneg (by linarith) hδ.le)
  have t3 : 0 ≤ q * (W / τ) := mul_nonneg hq0 (div_nonneg hWnn hτ.le)
  have t4 : 0 ≤ q * ((W * 2) / κa) := mul_nonneg hq0 (div_nonneg (by linarith) hκa0.le)
  have t5 : 0 ≤ q * ((W * |L|) / τ) :=
    mul_nonneg hq0 (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hWnn (abs_nonneg L)) hτ.le)
  have hq1 : q ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hqτ : q ≤ τ := by have := hdiv q 1 τ hτ (by linarith); linarith
  have hθ0δ : M0 * q ≤ δ / 2 := by have := hdiv q (M0 * 2) δ hδ (by linarith); linarith
  have hWτ : q * W ≤ τ := hdiv q W τ hτ (by linarith)
  have hWκ : q * W ≤ κa / 2 := by have := hdiv q (W * 2) κa hκa0 (by linarith); linarith
  have hWL : q * (W * |L|) ≤ τ := hdiv q (W * |L|) τ hτ (by linarith)
  have hΓθ : Γ * (K2 * (M0 * q)) = q * W := by rw [hW]; ring
  have hΓθ0 : 0 ≤ Γ * (K2 * (M0 * q)) := by rw [hΓθ]; exact mul_nonneg hq0 hWnn
  have hΓτ : Γ * (K2 * (M0 * q)) ≤ τ := by rw [hΓθ]; exact hWτ
  have hΓκ : Γ * (K2 * (M0 * q)) ≤ κa / 2 := by rw [hΓθ]; exact hWκ
  have hLΓ : L * (Γ * (K2 * (M0 * q))) ≤ τ := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self L) hΓθ0
    have h2 : |L| * (Γ * (K2 * (M0 * q))) = q * (W * |L|) := by rw [hΓθ]; ring
    linarith
  obtain ⟨hagr, hGs, hVs, hGpos, hGbd, hclose⟩ := hMN N hNN0
  have hpw : ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 → |F X η| ≤ B ∧ |U X η| ≤ B ∧
      |deriv (fun e' => F X e') η| ≤ B ∧ |deriv (fun e' => U X e') η| ≤ B ∧
      |FN N X η - F X η| ≤ q ∧ |UN N X η - U X η| ≤ q ∧
      |deriv (fun e' => FN N X e') η - deriv (fun e' => F X e') η| ≤ q ∧
      |deriv (fun e' => UN N X e') η - deriv (fun e' => U X e') η| ≤ q := by
    intro X η h1 h2 e1 e2
    obtain ⟨b1, b2, b3, b4⟩ := hBpt X η h1 h2 e1 e2
    obtain ⟨k1, k2, k3, k4, -⟩ := hclose X η h1 h2 e1 e2
    exact ⟨b1, b2, b3, b4, k1.trans hCNq, k2.trans hCNq, k3.trans hCNq, k4.trans hCNq⟩
  have hjoint : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C' : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C' ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C' ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(FN N)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C' ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(UN N)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C' := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨Ca, hCa⟩ := hFbd Xm Xp hXm0 m
    obtain ⟨Cb, hCb⟩ := hGbd m
    refine ⟨max Ca Cb, fun X η h1 h2 e1 e2 => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := hCa X η h1 h2 e1 e2
    obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := hCb X η h1 h2 e1 e2
    exact ⟨a1.trans (le_max_left _ _), a2.trans (le_max_left _ _), b1.trans (le_max_right _ _),
      b2.trans (le_max_right _ _)⟩
  obtain ⟨hdS, hdK, hdB⟩ := rc_discrepancy_jets Xm Xp Xm' Xp' B q F U (FN N) (UN N) hXm0 hXm' hXm'p'
    hXp'p hB0 hq0 hq1 hFs hUs hGs hVs hjoint hpw
  set d : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ := rcDisc Xm' Xp' F U (FN N) (UN N) with hd
  have hdn : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖d η‖ ≤ M0 * q ∧ ‖deriv d η‖ ≤ M0 * q := by
    intro η e1 e2; rw [hM0]; exact hdB η e1 e2
  have hdδ : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖d η‖ < δ := fun η e1 e2 => by
    linarith [(hdn η e1 e2).1]
  set c : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ := fun η => Φ (d η) η with hc
  have hAx : AxCoef (K2 * (M0 * q)) c :=
    hK2 (M0 * q) d (mul_nonneg hM0nn hq0) hθ0δ hdS hdK hdn
  obtain ⟨hRFs, hRUs, hRbd, hRpt⟩ := hΓ (K2 * (M0 * q)) c hAx
  have hRvan : ∀ X η : ℝ, (X ≤ Xm' ∨ Xb ≤ X) → rcRF γ c X η = 0 ∧ rcRU β c X η = 0 :=
    fun X η hX => hRF0 c X η (hX.imp (fun h' => by linarith) (fun h' => by linarith))
  have hpos : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < FN N X η + rcRF γ c X η := by
    intro X η hX e1 e2
    by_cases hr : r1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ r2
    · obtain ⟨-, hfp⟩ := hFpatch X η hr.1 hr.2 e1 e2
      have hG : FN N X η = F X η := (hagr X η (Or.inr (by linarith [hr.1]))).1
      obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, ilow⟩ := hΦ (d η) η (hdδ η e1 e2) (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have hlow := ilow X hr.1 hr.2
      have hrep : patchF0 lam cpatch η X + rcRF γ c X η = repF lam cpatch γ (Φ (d η) η) η X := by
        simp only [repF, rcRF, hc]; ring
      have hpp : 0 < patchF0 lam cpatch η X := by
        unfold patchF0

repair_construct.definitions:
noncomputable def rcDisc (a b : ℝ) (F U G V : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (η : ℝ) : Fin 5 → ℝ :=
  ![-∫ x in a..b, (V x η - U x η), -∫ x in a..b, 2 * x * (G x η - F x η),
    -∫ x in a..b, (V x η * (2 * x * G x η) - U x η * (2 * x * F x η)),
    -∫ x in a..b, ((V x η ^ 2 - x * G x η ^ 2) - (U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2)),
    -∫ x in a..b, (G x η ^ 2 - F x η ^ 2)]

noncomputable def rcRF (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  c η 2 * γ 0 X + c η 3 * γ 1 X + c η 4 * γ 2 X

noncomputable def rcRU (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  c η 0 * β 0 X + c η 1 * β 1 X

and_nodes.definitions_block:
noncomputable def rcDisc (a b : ℝ) (F U G V : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (η : ℝ) : Fin 5 → ℝ :=
  ![-∫ x in a..b, (V x η - U x η), -∫ x in a..b, 2 * x * (G x η - F x η),
    -∫ x in a..b, (V x η * (2 * x * G x η) - U x η * (2 * x * F x η)),
    -∫ x in a..b, ((V x η ^ 2 - x * G x η ^ 2) - (U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2)),
    -∫ x in a..b, (G x η ^ 2 - F x η ^ 2)]

noncomputable def rcRF (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  c η 2 * γ 0 X + c η 3 * γ 1 X + c η 4 * γ 2 X

noncomputable def rcRU (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  c η 0 * β 0 X + c η 1 * β 1 X

by
  intro hLPR hPP hCG h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xan Xm Xm2 Xp2 Xp r1 r2 ε κ F U hJ hε hPR hκ
  have hJ' := hJ
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, hh1, hlam, hcinf, hcp, haa, hab, hXa, hXap1, hp12, hp2m1, hm12, hm2Xv, hXvXc, hXcXb,
    hXaXan, hXanXm, hXmXm2, hXm2Xp2, hXp2Xp, hXpr1, hr1r2, hr2p1⟩, -⟩ := hJ'
  have hXm0 : 0 < Xm := by linarith
  have hXb0 : 0 < Xb := by linarith
  have hXmr2 : Xm ≤ r2 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨cF, k, A, hcF, hk0, hk1, hA0, hFlow, hQMright, hQMleft⟩ :=
    middle_ref_margins hLPR hCG h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xan Xm Xm2 Xp2 Xp r1 r2 ε κ
      F U hJ hε hPR hκ
  obtain ⟨τ0, hτ0, hstab⟩ := quad_margin_stable k A hk0 hk1 hA0
  obtain ⟨Cps, δ₀, hδ₀, hpert⟩ := hPP h cinf Xb ε Xm r2 cF F U hh0 hh1 hXb0 hε hXm0 hXmr2 hcF hPR hFlow
  have hC1 : 0 < |Cps| + 1 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨τ, hτdef⟩ : ∃ τ : ℝ, τ = min (min (τ0 / (|Cps| + 1)) δ₀) (cF / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hτpos : 0 < τ := by
    rw [hτdef]; exact lt_min (lt_min (div_pos hτ0 hC1) hδ₀) (by linarith)
  have hτ1 : τ ≤ τ0 / (|Cps| + 1) := by
    rw [hτdef]; exact le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hτδ : τ ≤ δ₀ := by
    rw [hτdef]; exact le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hτc : τ ≤ cF / 2 := by
    rw [hτdef]; exact min_le_right _ _
  have hτmul : τ * (|Cps| + 1) ≤ τ0 := (le_div_iff₀ hC1).mp hτ1
  have hCτ : Cps * τ ≤ τ0 := by
    have : Cps * τ ≤ |Cps| * τ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hτpos.le
    nlinarith
  have hττ0 : τ ≤ τ0 := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hτpos.le (abs_nonneg Cps)]
  refine ⟨τ, hτpos, ?_⟩
  intro F' U' hPR' hPi hclose hmarg hshear
  have hF'low : ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ r2 → -1 < η → η < 1 → cF / 2 ≤ F' X η := by
    intro X η h1 h2 e1 e2
    have hc := (hclose X η (by linarith) h2 e1 e2).1
    have hf := hFlow X η h1 h2 e1 e2
    have := (abs_le.mp hc).1
    linarith
  have hps := hpert F' U' τ hPR' hτδ hPi hclose
  have hQM : ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ r2 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      k / 2 ≤ shearA F' X η ∧ shearA F' X η ≤ A + 1 ∧ |shearB F' U' X η| ≤ A + 1 ∧
      |psLead1 h F' U' X η| ≤ A + 1 ∧ |psLead2 h F' U' X η| ≤ A + 1 ∧
      k / 2 ≤ shearA F' X η * (1 + (shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η) ^ 2) - 2 ∧
      k / 2 ≤ psLead1 h F' U' X η - shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η * psLead2 h F' U' X η -
        shearA F' X η * (1 + (shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η) ^ 2) ∧
      (shearA F' X η * (1 + (shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η) ^ 2) - 2) *
          (psLead2 h F' U' X η + shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η * psLead1 h F' U' X η) ^ 2 ≤
        (2 - k / 2) * (psLead1 h F' U' X η - shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η * psLead2 h F' U' X η -
          shearA F' X η * (1 + (shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η) ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
    intro X η h1 h2 e1 e2
    obtain ⟨d1, d2⟩ := hps X η h1 h2 e1 e2
    have d1' : |psLead1 h F' U' X η - psLead1 h F U X η| ≤ τ0 := d1.trans hCτ
    have d2' : |psLead2 h F' U' X η - psLead2 h F U X η| ≤ τ0 := d2.trans hCτ
    rcases le_total X Xp with hX | hX
    · obtain ⟨n1, n2, n3, n4, n5, n6⟩ := hmarg X η h1 hX e1 e2
      obtain ⟨q1, q2, q3, q4, q5, q6, q7, q8⟩ :=
        hQMleft (shearA F' X η) (shearB F' U' X η) X η h1 hX e1 e2 n1 n2 n3 n4 n5 n6
      exact hstab _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ q1 q2 q3 q4 q5 q6 q7 q8 (by simp [hτ0.le]) (by simp [hτ0.le]) d1' d2'
    · obtain ⟨q1, q2, q3, q4, q5, q6, q7, q8⟩ := hQMright X η hX h2 e1 e2
      obtain ⟨s1, s2⟩ := hshear X η hX h2 e1 e2
      exact hstab _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ q1 q2 q3 q4 q5 q6 q7 q8 (s1.trans hττ0) (s2.trans hττ0) d1' d2'
  obtain ⟨κ', c', hκ'0, hκ'2, hc', hcone⟩ :=
    quad_cone_stress (k / 2) (A + 1) (cF / 2) (by positivity) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by positivity)
  have hThE : ∀ X η : ℝ, leadStressTh h F' U' X η = F' X η * (psLead1 h F' U' X η - shearA F' X η) :=

  have hTzE : ∀ X η : ℝ, leadStressTz h F' U' X η = F' X η * (psLead2 h F' U' X η + shearB F' U' X η) :=
    fun _ _ => rfl
  have hpt : ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ r2 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      c' ≤ Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F' U' X η ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F' U' X η ^ 2) ∧
      (κ' ≤ F' X η ∧ κ' ≤ shearA F' X η ∧
        κ' ≤ shearA F' X η * (1 + (shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η) ^ 2) - 2 ∧
        κ' * Real.sqrt (leadStressTh h F' U' X η ^ 2 + leadStressTz h F' U' X η ^ 2) ≤
          leadStressTh h F' U' X η - shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η * leadStressTz h F' U' X η ∧
        (shearA F' X η * (1 + (shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η) ^ 2) - 2) *
            (leadStressTz h F' U' X η + shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η * leadStressTh h F' U' X η) ^ 2 ≤
          (2 - κ') * (leadStressTh h F' U' X η - shearB F' U' X η / shearA F' X η * leadStressTz h F' U' X η) ^ 2) := by
    intro X η h1 h2 e1 e2
    obtain ⟨q1, q2, q3, q4, q5, q6, q7, q8⟩ := hQM X η h1 h2 e1 e2
    rw [hThE, hTzE]
    exact hcone (F' X η) (shearA F' X η) (shearB F' U' X η) (psLead1 h F' U' X η) (psLead2 h F' U' X η)
      (hF'low X η h1 h2 e1 e2) q1 q3 q6 q7 q8
  obtain ⟨W, hW0, hW⟩ := edge_weight_window Xa Xb aa ab Xm r2 hXa (by linarith) hXmr2 (by linarith) haa hab
  obtain ⟨⟨-, -, hTs, hTzs⟩, hLb⟩ := hLPR h cinf Xb ε F' U' hh0 hh1 hXb0 hε hPR'
  have hLb' := hLb Xm r2 (cF / 2) hXm0 (by positivity) hF'low
  have hΩ : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hSΩ : Icc Xm r2 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
    fun z hz => ⟨show 0 < z.1 from lt_of_lt_of_le hXm0 hz.1.1, hz.2⟩
  have hdir := unit_dir_bounds (leadStressTh h F' U') (leadStressTz h F' U') _ _ hΩ hSΩ hTs hTzs c' hc'
    (fun z hz => (hpt z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2).1)
    (fun m => by
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hLb' m
      exact ⟨C, fun z hz => ⟨(hC z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2).2.2.1,
        (hC z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2).2.2.2⟩⟩)
  refine ⟨⟨c', hc', fun X hX η e1 e2 => ?_⟩, fun m => ?_, ⟨κ', hκ'0, hκ'2, fun X hX η e1 e2 => ?_⟩⟩
  · have hw := (hW X hX.1 hX.2).2

    have key : C1 ≤ max (C1 / W) C2 * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X := by

    refine ⟨PR1.mono (prod_mono (Ioi_subset_Ioi (by linarith)) subset_rfl),
