      fun X η hX e1 e2 => PR3 X η hX.le e1 e2, fun X₀ X₁ hX₀ m => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := PR4 X₁ m
    exact ⟨C, fun X η h1 h2 e1 e2 => hC X η (by linarith) h2 e1 e2⟩
  case LP2 =>
    refine ⟨hTh.congr (fun z hz => hp1 z.1 z.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2),
      hTz.congr (fun z hz => hp2 z.1 z.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2), ?_,
      ⟨c₀, hc₀, fun X η h1 h2 e1 e2 => ?_⟩, fun m => ?_, fun m => ?_,
      ⟨κ, hκ0, hκ2, fun X η h1 h2 e1 e2 => ?_⟩⟩
    · intro X η hX hW
      by_cases hη : -1 < η ∧ η < 1
      · rw [hT1', hT2', if_pos hη, if_pos hη]
        obtain ⟨q1, q2⟩ : leadStressTh h F' U' X η = leadStressTh h F U X η ∧
            leadStressTz h F' U' X η = leadStressTz h F U X η := by
          rcases hW with hW | hW
          · exact hst X η hη.1 hη.2 (Or.inl ⟨hX, by linarith⟩)
          · exact hst X η hη.1 hη.2 (Or.inr (by linarith))
        rw [q1, q2]
        exact J2.1 X η hX hW hη.1 hη.2
      · rw [hT1', hT2', if_neg hη, if_neg hη]
        exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · rw [hp1 X η e1 e2, hp2 X η e1 e2]
      exact hlow X ⟨h1, h2⟩ η e1 e2
    · obtain ⟨C, N, hb⟩ := hder m
      refine ⟨C, N, fun X η h1 h2 e1 e2 => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨i1, i2, -, -⟩ := iter m X η e1 e2
      rw [i1, i2]
      exact ⟨(hb X ⟨h1, h2⟩ η e1 e2).1, (hb X ⟨h1, h2⟩ η e1 e2).2.1⟩
    · obtain ⟨C, N, hb⟩ := hder m
      refine ⟨C, fun X η h1 h2 e1 e2 => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨-, -, i3, i4⟩ := iter m X η e1 e2
      rw [i3, i4]
      exact ⟨(hb X ⟨h1, h2⟩ η e1 e2).2.2.1, (hb X ⟨h1, h2⟩ η e1 e2).2.2.2⟩
    · rw [hp1 X η e1 e2, hp2 X η e1 e2]
      exact hcone X ⟨h1, h2⟩ η e1 e2
  case LP3 =>
    exact fun X η _ e1 e2 => ⟨hp1 X η e1 e2, hp2 X η e1 e2⟩
  case LP4 =>
    exact ⟨ε, hε, PR1, PR2, fun η e1 e2 => PR3 0 η le_rfl e1 e2, PR4⟩
  case LP5 =>
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, Fc, Uc, Pc, hk⟩ := J8
    refine ⟨Xan, ρ, hXaXan, by linarith, hρ, Fc, Uc, Pc, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, c1, c2, c3, hX⟩ := hk k
    refine ⟨C, c1, c2, c3, fun X hX0 hXan => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨d1, d2, d3, b, hid⟩ := hX X hX0 hXan
    refine ⟨d1, d2, d3, b, fun η e1 e2 => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3⟩ := hid η e1 e2
    have hXm : X < Xm' := by linarith
    have hnb : Iio Xm' ∈ nhds X := isOpen_Iio.mem_nhds hXm
    have eF : iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => F' Y η) X = iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => F Y η) X :=
      Filter.EventuallyEq.iteratedDeriv_eq k
        (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hnb (fun Y hY => (hag Y η (Or.inl (le_of_lt hY))).1))
    have eU : iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => U' Y η) X = iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => U Y η) X :=
      Filter.EventuallyEq.iteratedDeriv_eq k
        (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hnb (fun Y hY => (hag Y η (Or.inl (le_of_lt hY))).2))
    have eP : iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => leadPi F' Y η) X = iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => leadPi F Y η) X :=
      Filter.EventuallyEq.iteratedDeriv_eq k
        (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hnb (fun Y hY => s2L F F' Xm' η hXm'0
          (fun x hx => (hag x η (Or.inl hx)).1) (J5 η e1 e2).1 (PR5 η e1 e2) (hmom η e1 e2).1 Y hY))
    rw [eF, eU, eP]
    exact ⟨i1, i2, i3⟩
  case LP7 =>
    intro X η hX e1 e2
    have hs2X : s2 ≤ X := by linarith
    have hX0 : 0 ≤ X := by linarith
    obtain ⟨u0, pu0⟩ := J10 X η hX e1 e2
    have hm := hmom η e1 e2
    refine ⟨by rw [(hag X η (Or.inr hs2X)).2]; exact u0, ?_⟩
    rw [s4L U U' s2 X η hs2X (fun x hx => (hag x η (Or.inr hx)).2) ((J5 η e1 e2).2 X hX0).1
      ((J5 η e1 e2).2 s2 hs20.le).1 (hm.2.2.2.2.2 X hX0).1 (hm.2.2.2.2.2 s2 hs20.le).1 hm.2.1]
    exact pu0
  case LP8 =>
    intro X η hX e1 e2
    have hs : s2 ≤ X := by
      rcases hX with ⟨h1, _⟩ | ⟨h1, _⟩ <;> linarith
    rw [(hag X η (Or.inr hs)).1, (hag X η (Or.inr hs)).2]
    exact J11 X η hX e1 e2
  case LP9 =>
    intro η e1 e2
    have hm := hmom η e1 e2
    obtain ⟨z1, z2, z3⟩ := J12 η e1 e2
    have pk' := hm.2.2.2.2.2 s2 hs20.le
    have pk := (J5 η e1 e2).2 s2 hs20.le
    have r3 := hm.2.2.1
    have r4 := hm.2.2.2.1
    have r5 := hm.2.2.2.2.1
    simp only [profRadInt] at r3 r4 r5
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have j1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, (U' x η * (2 * x * F' x η) - U x η * (2 * x * F x η))) = 0 := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub pk'.2.2.1 pk.2.2.1]
        linarith
      exact (s3L (fun x => U x η * (2 * x * F x η)) (fun x => U' x η * (2 * x * F' x η)) s2 hs20
        (fun x hx => by
          have hq := hag x η (Or.inr hx.le)
          simp only [hq.1, hq.2]) (pk'.2.2.1.sub pk.2.2.1) j1).trans z1
    · have j1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, ((U' x η ^ 2 - x * F' x η ^ 2) - (U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2))) = 0 := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub pk'.2.2.2.1 pk.2.2.2.1]
        linarith
      exact (s3L (fun x => U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2) (fun x => U' x η ^ 2 - x * F' x η ^ 2) s2 hs20
        (fun x hx => by
          have hq := hag x η (Or.inr hx.le)
          simp only [hq.1, hq.2]) (pk'.2.2.2.1.sub pk.2.2.2.1) j1).trans z2
    · have e : (fun x : ℝ => (2 * x * F' x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) -
          (2 * x * F x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))) =
          fun x : ℝ => 2 * x * F' x η - 2 * x * F x η := by
        funext x; ring
      have ii : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => (2 * x * F' x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) -
          (2 * x * F x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))) volume 0 s2 := by
        rw [e]; exact pk'.2.1.sub pk.2.1
      have j1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, ((2 * x * F' x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) -
          (2 * x * F x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))))) = 0 := by
        rw [e, intervalIntegral.integral_sub pk'.2.1 pk.2.1]
        linarith
      exact (s3L (fun x => 2 * x * F x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))
        (fun x => 2 * x * F' x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h))) s2 hs20
        (fun x hx => by
          have hq := hag x η (Or.inr hx.le)
          simp only [hq.1]) ii j1).trans z3
  case LP10 =>
    intro m
    obtain ⟨C, N, hC⟩ := J13 m
    refine ⟨C, N, fun X η h1 h2 e1 e2 => ?_⟩
    have hev : (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) * F' w.1 w.2 -
          cinf * w.1 ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - w.2 ^ 2) / w.1))
        =ᶠ[nhds ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ)] (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) * F w.1 w.2 -
          cinf * w.1 ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - w.2 ^ 2) / w.1)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds
          (show ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi s2 ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) from ⟨show s2 < X by linarith, mem_univ _⟩))
        (fun w hw => by simp only [(hag w.1 w.2 (Or.inr (le_of_lt hw.1))).1])
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
    exact hC X η h1 h2 e1 e2

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (V : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (g : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => g z.1 z.2) (V ×ˢ univ) → (∀ p ∈ V, ∀ s : ℝ, g p (s + 1) = g p s) → (∀ p ∈ V, (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, g p s) = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..z.2, g z.1 s) (V ×ˢ univ) ∧ (∀ p ∈ V, ∀ φ : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun ψ => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..ψ, g p s) (g p φ) φ) ∧ ∀ K : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ φ : ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..z.2, g z.1 s) (p, φ)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => g z.1 z.2) (p, φ)‖ ≤ C

signature.name: periodic_primitive_smooth
signature.statement: ∀ (V : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (g : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => g z.1 z.2) (V ×ˢ univ) → (∀ p ∈ V, ∀ s : ℝ, g p (s + 1) = g p s) → (∀ p ∈ V, (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, g p s) = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..z.2, g z.1 s) (V ×ˢ univ) ∧ (∀ p ∈ V, ∀ φ : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun ψ => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..ψ, g p s) (g p φ) φ) ∧ ∀ K : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ φ : ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..z.2, g z.1 s) (p, φ)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => g z.1 z.2) (p, φ)‖ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro V g hV hG hper hmean
  have hO : IsOpen (V ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) := hV.prod isOpen_univ
  have hOO : IsOpen ((V ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) := hO.prod isOpen_univ
  
  have hsm' : ∀ (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (H : ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) × ℝ → F),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H ((V ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => (fderiv ℝ H w).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) ℝ)) ((V ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) := by
    intro F _ _ H hH
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ H) ((V ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) :=
      hH.fderiv_of_isOpen hOO (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_comp contDiffOn_const
  
  have hderiv : ∀ (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
      (H : ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) × ℝ → F),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H ((V ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) →
      ∀ x₀ ∈ V ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ), HasFDerivAt (fun x => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, H (x, t))
        (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, (fderiv ℝ H (x₀, t)).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) ℝ)) x₀ := by
    intro F _ _ _ H hH x₀ hx₀
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hO x₀ hx₀
    have hsub : Metric.closedBall x₀ (ε / 2) ⊆ V ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hε)).trans hball
    have hS : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall x₀ (ε / 2) ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :=
      (isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod isCompact_Icc
    have hH' := hsm' F H hH
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hS.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hH'.continuousOn.mono (fun w hw => ⟨hsub hw.1, mem_univ _⟩))
    have hcont : ∀ x ∈ V ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ), Continuous (fun t : ℝ => H (x, t)) := fun x hx =>
      hH.continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
        (fun t => ⟨hx, mem_univ t⟩)
    have hcont' : ∀ x ∈ V ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ), Continuous (fun t : ℝ => (fderiv ℝ H (x, t)).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) ℝ)) := fun x hx =>
      hH'.continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
        (fun t => ⟨hx, mem_univ t⟩)
    have hdiff : ∀ x ∈ V ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ), ∀ t : ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun y => H (y, t))
        ((fderiv ℝ H (x, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) ℝ)) x := by
      intro x hx t
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ H (x, t) :=
        (hH.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hOO.mem_nhds ⟨hx, mem_univ t⟩)
      exact hd.hasFDerivAt.comp x (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left x t)
    refine intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (μ := volume)
      (E := F) (H := (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) (F := fun x t => H (x, t))
      (F' := fun x t => (fderiv ℝ H (x, t)).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) ℝ))
      (bound := fun _ => C)
      (Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds x₀ (half_pos hε)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ intervalIntegrable_const ?_
    · filter_upwards [hO.mem_nhds hx₀] with x hx
      exact (hcont x hx).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact (hcont x₀ hx₀).intervalIntegrable 0 1
    · exact (hcont' x₀ hx₀).aestronglyMeasurable
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht x hx => hC (x, t) ⟨hx, ?_⟩)
      rw [uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
      exact Ioc_subset_Icc_self ht
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t _ x hx => hdiff x (hsub hx) t)
  
  have hcomp : ∀ (E F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F]
      [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F], CompleteSpace (E →L[ℝ] F) :=
    fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => inferInstance
  have key : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
      (H : ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) × ℝ → F),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H ((V ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun x => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, H (x, t)) (V ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro F _ _ _ H hH
      rw [Nat.cast_zero, contDiffOn_zero]
      exact fun x hx => (hderiv F H hH x hx).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    | succ k ih =>
      intro F _ _ _ H hH
      have e : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) = (k : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 := by push_cast; rfl
      rw [e, contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO]
      refine ⟨fun x hx => (hderiv F H hH x hx).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt,
        fun h => absurd h (by simp), ?_⟩
      haveI : CompleteSpace ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ →L[ℝ] F) := hcomp _ F
      exact (ih ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ →L[ℝ] F) _ (hsm' F H hH)).congr
        (fun x hx => (hderiv F H hH x hx).fderiv)
  
  have hgc : ∀ p ∈ V, Continuous (g p) := fun p hp =>
    hG.continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
      (fun s => ⟨hp, mem_univ s⟩)
  
  have hQper : ∀ p ∈ V, ∀ φ : ℝ, (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..(φ + 1), g p s) = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..φ, g p s := by
    intro p hp φ
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals ((hgc p hp).intervalIntegrable 0 φ)
      ((hgc p hp).intervalIntegrable φ (φ + 1))]
    have h1 : (∫ s in φ..(φ + 1), g p s) = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..(0 + 1), g p s :=
      Function.Periodic.intervalIntegral_add_eq (hper p hp) φ 0
    rw [h1, zero_add, hmean p hp, add_zero]
  
  have hstar : (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..z.2, g z.1 s) =
      fun z => z.2 * ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, g z.1 (z.2 * t) := by
    funext z
    have := intervalIntegral.smul_integral_comp_mul_left (a := 0) (b := 1) (g z.1) z.2
    rw [mul_zero, mul_one, smul_eq_mul] at this
    exact this.symm
  have hHs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) × ℝ => g w.1.1 (w.1.2 * w.2))
      ((V ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) := by
    have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) × ℝ => (w.1.1, w.1.2 * w.2)) := by
      fun_prop
    exact hG.comp hψ.contDiffOn (fun w hw => ⟨hw.1.1, mem_univ _⟩)
  have hI : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, g z.1 (z.2 * t))
      (V ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) :=
    contDiffOn_infty.mpr (fun n => key n ℝ _ hHs)
  have hQs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..z.2, g z.1 s)
      (V ×ˢ univ) := by
    rw [hstar]
    exact contDiff_snd.contDiffOn.mul hI
  
  have hbound : ∀ F : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (V ×ˢ univ) →
      (∀ p ∈ V, ∀ φ : ℝ, F (p, φ + 1) = F (p, φ)) → ∀ K : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), IsCompact K →
      K ⊆ V → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ φ : ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F (p, φ)‖ ≤ C := by
    intro F hF hFp K hK hKV m
    have hc : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F) (V ×ˢ univ) :=
      (hF.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hO.uniqueDiffOn).congr
        (fun w hw => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hO hw).symm)
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (hK.prod (isCompact_Icc (a := (0:ℝ)) (b := 1))).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hc.mono (fun w hw => ⟨hKV hw.1, mem_univ _⟩))
    have htr : ∀ p ∈ V, ∀ φ : ℝ,
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F (p, φ + 1) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F (p, φ) := by
      intro p hp φ
      have e1 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) m
        ((0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), (1:ℝ)) (p, φ)
      have e2 : ((p, φ) : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) + ((0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), (1:ℝ)) = (p, φ + 1) := by
        simp
      rw [e2] at e1
      rw [← e1]
      have hev : (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => F (z + ((0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), (1:ℝ))))
          =ᶠ[nhds (p, φ)] F := by
        filter_upwards [hO.mem_nhds (show ((p, φ) : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) ∈ V ×ˢ univ from
          ⟨hp, mem_univ _⟩)] with z hz
        have hz2 : z + ((0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), (1:ℝ)) = (z.1, z.2 + 1) :=
          Prod.ext (by simp) (by simp)
        rw [hz2, hFp z.1 hz.1 z.2]
      exact (hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds
    refine ⟨C, fun p hp φ => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hφy⟩ := Function.Periodic.exists_mem_Ico₀
      (f := fun φ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F (p, φ)) (c := (1:ℝ))
      (fun φ => htr p (hKV hp) φ) one_pos φ
    have hφy' : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F (p, φ) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F (p, y) := hφy
    rw [hφy']
    exact hC (p, y) ⟨hp, Ico_subset_Icc_self hy⟩
  refine ⟨hQs, fun p hp φ => ((hgc p hp).integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 φ).hasDerivAt, ?_⟩
  intro K hK hKV m
  obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hbound _ hQs (fun p hp φ => hQper p hp φ) K hK hKV m
  obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := hbound _ hG (fun p hp φ => hper p hp φ) K hK hKV m
  exact ⟨max C1 C2, fun p hp φ =>
    ⟨(hC1 p hp φ).trans (le_max_left _ _), (hC2 p hp φ).trans (le_max_right _ _)⟩⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X₁ X₂ c : ℝ), 0 < X₁ → 0 < c → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η) → (∀ X η : ℝ, X₁ ≤ X → X ≤ X₂ → -1 < η → η < 1 → c ≤ F X η) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₁ ≤ X → X ≤ X₂ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(shearA F)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(shearB F U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₁ ≤ X → X ≤ X₂ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(shearA F)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(shearB F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C

signature.name: shear_jet_bounds
signature.statement: ∀ (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X₁ X₂ c : ℝ), 0 < X₁ → 0 < c → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η) → (∀ X η : ℝ, X₁ ≤ X → X ≤ X₂ → -1 < η → η < 1 → c ≤ F X η) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₁ ≤ X → X ≤ X₂ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(shearA F)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(shearB F U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₁ ≤ X → X ≤ X₂ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(shearA F)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(shearB F U)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro F U X₁ X₂ c hX₁ hc hFs hUs hFpos hFc hbd
  set Ω : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 with hΩdef
  set S : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Icc X₁ X₂ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 with hSdef
  have hΩ : IsOpen Ω := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hSΩ : S ⊆ Ω := fun z hz => ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hX₁ hz.1.1, hz.2⟩
  have hU' : UniqueDiffOn ℝ Ω := hΩ.uniqueDiffOn
  have hle : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := fun n => by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hwin : ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (z : ℝ × ℝ), z ∈ Ω →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f z = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ n f Ω z :=
    fun f n z hz => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hΩ hz).symm
  
  have hmul : ∀ f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, axgeGood Ω S f → axgeGood Ω S g →
      axgeGood Ω S (fun z => f z * g z) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.mul hg.1, ?_⟩
    choose Cf hCf using hf.2
    choose Cg hCg using hg.2
    intro n
    refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * Cf i * Cg (n - i), fun z hz => ?_⟩
    rw [hwin _ n z (hSΩ hz)]
    refine (norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hf.1 hg.1 hU' (hSΩ hz) (hle n)).trans ?_
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
    have h1 := hCf i z hz
    have h2 := hCg (n - i) z hz
    rw [hwin f i z (hSΩ hz)] at h1
    rw [hwin g (n - i) z (hSΩ hz)] at h2
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) h2 (norm_nonneg _)
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) ((norm_nonneg _).trans h1))
  
  have hinv : ∀ f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, axgeGood Ω S f → (∀ z ∈ Ω, 0 < f z) → (∀ z ∈ S, c ≤ f z) →
      axgeGood Ω S (fun z => (f z)⁻¹) := by
    intro f hf hpos hcf
    refine ⟨hf.1.inv (fun z hz => (hpos z hz).ne'), ?_⟩
    choose Cf hCf using hf.2
    have hT : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ)) := isOpen_Ioi
    have hinvT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Inv.inv : ℝ → ℝ) (Ioi 0) :=
      (contDiffOn_inv ℝ).mono (fun y (hy : (0:ℝ) < y) => (show y ≠ 0 from hy.ne'))
    have hJ : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ Icc c (max c (Cf 0)),
        ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (Inv.inv : ℝ → ℝ) (Ioi 0) y‖ ≤ B := by
      intro i
      have hcont := hinvT.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (hle i) hT.uniqueDiffOn
      exact isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        (hcont.mono (fun y hy => (show (0:ℝ) < y from lt_of_lt_of_le hc hy.1)))
    choose B hB using hJ
    have hfS : ∀ z ∈ S, f z ∈ Icc c (max c (Cf 0)) := by
      intro z hz
      refine ⟨hcf z hz, le_max_of_le_right ?_⟩
      have := hCf 0 z hz
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans this
    intro n
    refine ⟨(n.factorial : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |B i|) *
      (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |Cf i|) ^ n, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hzΩ := hSΩ hz
    rw [hwin _ n z hzΩ]
    show ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ n ((Inv.inv : ℝ → ℝ) ∘ f) Ω z‖ ≤ _
    refine norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hinvT hf.1 (hle n) hT.uniqueDiffOn hU'
      (fun w hw => hpos w hw) hzΩ ?_ ?_
    · intro i hi
      refine (hB i (f z) (hfS z hz)).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans ?_)
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |B j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
    · intro i hi1 hin
      have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |Cf i| :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
      have hD1 : 1 ≤ 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |Cf i| := by linarith
      have hci := hCf i z hz
      rw [hwin f i z hzΩ] at hci
      refine hci.trans ((le_abs_self _).trans ?_)
      refine le_trans ?_ (le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega))
      have : |Cf i| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |Cf i| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cf j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hin))
      linarith
  
  have hcoef : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Ioi 0) → axgeGood Ω S (fun z => g z.1) := by
    intro g hg
    have hGs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => g z.1) Ω :=
      hg.comp contDiffOn_fst (fun z hz => hz.1)
    refine ⟨hGs, fun n => ?_⟩
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => g z.1)) Ω :=
      (hGs.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (hle n) hU').congr (fun z hz => hwin _ n z hz)
    have hK : IsCompact (Icc X₁ X₂ ×ˢ ({0} : Set ℝ)) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_singleton
    have hKΩ : Icc X₁ X₂ ×ˢ ({0} : Set ℝ) ⊆ Ω := by
      rintro ⟨X, η⟩ ⟨hX, hη⟩
      have hη0 : η = 0 := hη
      subst hη0
      exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hX₁ hX.1, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hcont.mono hKΩ)
    refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨X, η⟩ ⟨hX, -⟩
    have htr := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z : ℝ × ℝ => g z.1) n
      ((0:ℝ), η) (X, (0:ℝ))
    have e1 : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => g (z + ((0:ℝ), η)).1) = fun z => g z.1 := by
      funext z; simp
    have e2 : ((X, (0:ℝ)) + ((0:ℝ), η) : ℝ × ℝ) = (X, η) := by simp
    rw [e1, e2] at htr
    rw [← htr]
    exact hC _ ⟨hX, rfl⟩
  
  have hpart : ∀ G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) Ω →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿G) z‖ ≤ C) →
      (∀ X η : ℝ, (X, η) ∈ Ω →
        deriv (fun Y => G Y η) X = fderiv ℝ (↿G) (X, η) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) ∧
      axgeGood Ω S (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿G) z ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) := by
    intro G hG hGb
    have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿G)) Ω :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ).1 hG).2
    refine ⟨fun X η hz => ?_, hfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const, fun n => ?_⟩
    · have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿G) (X, η) :=
        (hG.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, η)) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) X :=
        (hasDerivAt_id X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X η)
      exact (hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt X hγ).deriv
    · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hGb (n + 1)
      refine ⟨‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))‖ * C, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      have e : (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿G) z ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) =
          (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿G) := by
        funext z; simp
      rw [e]
      refine (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left _
        (hfd.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds (hSΩ hz))) (hle n)).trans ?_
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC z hz) (norm_nonneg _)
  
  have hfin : ∀ H GH : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, axgeGood Ω S GH → (∀ z ∈ Ω, H z = GH z) →
      axgeGood Ω S H := by
    intro H GH hG hEq
    refine ⟨hG.1.congr hEq, fun n => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hG.2 n
    refine ⟨C, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hev : H =ᶠ[nhds z] GH := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hΩ.mem_nhds (hSΩ hz)) hEq
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ n).eq_of_nhds]
    exact hC z hz
  
  have hbdF : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿F) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbd k
    exact ⟨C, fun z hz => (hC z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2).1⟩
  have hbdU : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿U) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbd k
    exact ⟨C, fun z hz => (hC z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2).2⟩
  obtain ⟨hidF, hDF⟩ := hpart F hFs hbdF
  obtain ⟨hidU, hDU⟩ := hpart U hUs hbdU
  have hFg : axgeGood Ω S (↿F) := ⟨hFs, hbdF⟩
  have hiF := hinv (↿F) hFg (fun z hz => hFpos z.1 z.2 hz.1 hz.2.1 hz.2.2)
    (fun z hz => hFc z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2)
  have hlin : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun X : ℝ => -2 * X) (Ioi 0) :=
    (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id).contDiffOn
  have hsq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun X : ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * X)) (Ioi 0) :=
    ContDiffOn.sqrt (f := fun X : ℝ => 2 * X) (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id).contDiffOn
      (fun x hx => by
        have hx' : (0:ℝ) < x := hx
        show 2 * x ≠ 0
        positivity)
  have ha := hcoef _ hlin
  have hr := hcoef _ hsq
  have hGA := hmul _ _ ha (hmul _ _ hDF hiF)
  have hGB := hmul _ _ hr (hmul _ _ hDU hiF)
  have hA := hfin (↿(shearA F)) _ hGA (by
    rintro ⟨X, η⟩ hz
    show shearA F X η = -2 * X * (fderiv ℝ (↿F) (X, η) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) * (F X η)⁻¹)
    unfold shearA
    rw [hidF X η hz]
    ring)
  have hB := hfin (↿(shearB F U)) _ hGB (by
    rintro ⟨X, η⟩ hz
    show shearB F U X η = Real.sqrt (2 * X) * (fderiv ℝ (↿U) (X, η) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) * (F X η)⁻¹)
    unfold shearB
    rw [hidU X η hz]
    ring)
  refine ⟨hA.1, hB.1, fun m => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨C1, h1⟩ := hA.2 m
  obtain ⟨C2, h2⟩ := hB.2 m
  exact ⟨max C1 C2, fun X η a b d e =>
    ⟨(h1 (X, η) ⟨⟨a, b⟩, d, e⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _),
      (h2 (X, η) ⟨⟨a, b⟩, d, e⟩).trans (le_max_right _ _)⟩⟩

by
  intro κL A' P0 hκ hA hP
  have margin : ∀ (R : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (g : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), IsCompact R →
      ContinuousOn g R → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ R, ∀ y ∈ R, dist x y ≤ δ → g x - κL / 2 ≤ g y := by
    intro R g hR hg
    have hu := hR.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hg
    rw [Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff_le] at hu
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := hu (κL / 2) (by linarith)
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun x hx y hy hxy => ?_⟩
    have := h x hx y hy hxy
    rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_le] at this
    linarith [this.2]
  obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), R = Set.Icc (κL / 2) (A' + 1) ×ˢ
      (Set.Icc (-(A' + 1)) (A' + 1) ×ˢ (Set.Icc (-P0) P0 ×ˢ Set.Icc (-P0) P0)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hRc : IsCompact R := by
    rw [hRdef]
    exact isCompact_Icc.prod (isCompact_Icc.prod (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc))
  have hne : ∀ x ∈ R, x.1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hRdef] at hx
    have := hx.1.1
    exact ne_of_gt (by linarith)
  have hq : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => x.2.1 / x.1) R :=
    (continuous_snd.fst.continuousOn).div continuous_fst.continuousOn hne
  have hc : Continuous (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => coneUp z.1 z.2) := by
    unfold coneUp
    fun_prop
  have hg2 : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => x.1 * (1 + (x.2.1 / x.1) ^ 2) - 2) R :=
    (continuous_fst.continuousOn.mul (continuousOn_const.add (hq.pow 2))).sub continuousOn_const
  have hg3 : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => x.2.2.1 - x.2.1 / x.1 * x.2.2.2 - 2) R :=
    ((continuous_snd.snd.fst.continuousOn).sub
      (hq.mul continuous_snd.snd.snd.continuousOn)).sub continuousOn_const
  have hg4 : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => coneUp (x.2.2.1 - x.2.1 / x.1 * x.2.2.2)
      (x.2.2.2 + x.2.1 / x.1 * x.2.2.1) - x.1 * (1 + (x.2.1 / x.1) ^ 2)) R := by
    have hin : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
        ((x.2.2.1 - x.2.1 / x.1 * x.2.2.2), (x.2.2.2 + x.2.1 / x.1 * x.2.2.1))) R :=
      ((continuous_snd.snd.fst.continuousOn).sub (hq.mul continuous_snd.snd.snd.continuousOn)).prodMk
        ((continuous_snd.snd.snd.continuousOn).add (hq.mul continuous_snd.snd.fst.continuousOn))
    exact (hc.comp_continuousOn hin).sub
      (continuous_fst.continuousOn.mul (continuousOn_const.add (hq.pow 2)))
  obtain ⟨δ2, hδ2, h2⟩ := margin R _ hRc hg2
  obtain ⟨δ3, hδ3, h3⟩ := margin R _ hRc hg3
  obtain ⟨δ4, hδ4, h4⟩ := margin R _ hRc hg4
  obtain ⟨τ, hτpos, t1, t2, t3, t4, t5⟩ : ∃ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ ∧ τ ≤ δ2 ∧ τ ≤ δ3 ∧ τ ≤ δ4 ∧
      τ ≤ κL / 2 ∧ τ ≤ 1 :=
    ⟨min (min δ2 (min δ3 δ4)) (min (κL / 2) 1),
      lt_min (lt_min hδ2 (lt_min hδ3 hδ4)) (lt_min (by linarith) one_pos),
      le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _),
      le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)),
      le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)),
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _),
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)⟩
  refine ⟨τ, hτpos, t5, ?_⟩
  intro a b a' b' p1 p2 ha1 ha2 hb hp1 hp2 G2 G3 G4 ha' hb'
  obtain ⟨ha'1, ha'2⟩ := abs_le.mp ha'
  obtain ⟨hb'1, hb'2⟩ := abs_le.mp hb'
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := abs_le.mp hb
  obtain ⟨hp11, hp12⟩ := abs_le.mp hp1
  obtain ⟨hp21, hp22⟩ := abs_le.mp hp2
  have hx : ((a, b, p1, p2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈ R := by
    rw [hRdef]
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ⟨hp11, hp12⟩, ⟨hp21, hp22⟩⟩
  have hy : ((a', b', p1, p2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈ R := by
    rw [hRdef]
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ⟨hp11, hp12⟩, ⟨hp21, hp22⟩⟩
  have hd : dist ((a, b, p1, p2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (a', b', p1, p2) ≤ τ := by
    rw [Prod.dist_eq, Prod.dist_eq, Prod.dist_eq, dist_self, dist_self, Real.dist_eq,
      Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm a, abs_sub_comm b]
    exact max_le ha' (max_le hb' (max_le hτpos.le hτpos.le))
  refine ⟨by linarith, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := h2 _ hx _ hy (hd.trans t1)
    dsimp only at this
    linarith
  · have := h3 _ hx _ hy (hd.trans t2)
    dsimp only at this
    linarith
  · have := h4 _ hx _ hy (hd.trans t3)
    dsimp only at this
    linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (w1 w2 w3 w4 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (Ω S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (V K : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (Q : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen Ω → S ⊆ Ω → IsOpen V → K ⊆ V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿w1) Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿w2) Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿w3) Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿w4) Ω → (∀ z ∈ Ω, (w1 z.1 z.2, w2 z.1 z.2, w3 z.1 z.2, w4 z.1 z.2) ∈ V) → (∀ z ∈ S, (w1 z.1 z.2, w2 z.1 z.2, w3 z.1 z.2, w4 z.1 z.2) ∈ K) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿w1) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿w2) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿w3) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿w4) z‖ ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => Q z.1 z.2) (V ×ˢ univ) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ φ : ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => Q z.1 z.2) (p, φ)‖ ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Q (w1 z.1 z.2.1, w2 z.1 z.2.1, w3 z.1 z.2.1, w4 z.1 z.2.1) z.2.2) {z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | (z.1, z.2.1) ∈ Ω} ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, (z.1, z.2.1) ∈ S → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Q (w1 z.1 z.2.1, w2 z.1 z.2.1, w3 z.1 z.2.1, w4 z.1 z.2.1) z.2.2) z‖ ≤ C

signature.name: phase_compose
signature.statement: ∀ (w1 w2 w3 w4 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (Ω S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (V K : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (Q : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen Ω → S ⊆ Ω → IsOpen V → K ⊆ V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿w1) Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿w2) Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿w3) Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿w4) Ω → (∀ z ∈ Ω, (w1 z.1 z.2, w2 z.1 z.2, w3 z.1 z.2, w4 z.1 z.2) ∈ V) → (∀ z ∈ S, (w1 z.1 z.2, w2 z.1 z.2, w3 z.1 z.2, w4 z.1 z.2) ∈ K) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿w1) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿w2) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿w3) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿w4) z‖ ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => Q z.1 z.2) (V ×ˢ univ) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ φ : ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => Q z.1 z.2) (p, φ)‖ ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Q (w1 z.1 z.2.1, w2 z.1 z.2.1, w3 z.1 z.2.1, w4 z.1 z.2.1) z.2.2) {z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | (z.1, z.2.1) ∈ Ω} ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, (z.1, z.2.1) ∈ S → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Q (w1 z.1 z.2.1, w2 z.1 z.2.1, w3 z.1 z.2.1, w4 z.1 z.2.1) z.2.2) z‖ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro w1 w2 w3 w4 Ω S V K Q hΩ hSΩ hV hKV hw1 hw2 hw3 hw4 hwV hwK hwb hQs hQb
  have hle : ∀ k : ℕ, ((k : WithTop ℕ∞)) ≤ ∞ := fun k => by exact_mod_cast le_top
  obtain ⟨pr, hpr⟩ : ∃ pr : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ, ∀ z, pr z = (z.1, z.2.1) :=
    ⟨(ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).prod
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))), fun z => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ, ∀ z, L z = z.2.2 :=
    ⟨(ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)), fun z => rfl⟩
  have hprn : ‖pr‖ ≤ 1 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound pr zero_le_one (fun z => ?_)
    rw [hpr, one_mul, norm_prod_le_iff]
    exact ⟨norm_fst_le z, (norm_fst_le z.2).trans (norm_snd_le z)⟩
  have hLn : ‖L‖ ≤ 1 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound L zero_le_one (fun z => ?_)
    rw [hL, one_mul]
    exact (norm_snd_le z.2).trans (norm_snd_le z)
  have hΩ'eq : {z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | (z.1, z.2.1) ∈ Ω} = pr ⁻¹' Ω := by
    ext z
    rw [mem_preimage, hpr]
    exact Iff.rfl
  have hO' : IsOpen (pr ⁻¹' Ω) := hΩ.preimage pr.continuous
  have hO : IsOpen {z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | (z.1, z.2.1) ∈ Ω} := by rw [hΩ'eq]; exact hO'
  have hT : IsOpen ((V ×ˢ univ) : Set ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ)) := hV.prod isOpen_univ
  
  have hslice : ∀ (a : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a Ω → ∀ (i : ℕ) (z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ),
      (z.1, z.2.1) ∈ Ω →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => a (z.1, z.2.1)) z‖ ≤
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i a (z.1, z.2.1)‖ := by
    intro a ha i z hz
    have hfun : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => a (z.1, z.2.1)) = a ∘ pr := by
      funext y; simp only [Function.comp_apply, hpr]
    have hz' : pr z ∈ Ω := by rw [hpr]; exact hz
    have hzp : z ∈ pr ⁻¹' Ω := hz'
    rw [hfun, ← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO' hzp,
      ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right pr ha hΩ.uniqueDiffOn hO'.uniqueDiffOn hz'
        (hle i),
      iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩ hz', hpr]
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _)
      (Finset.prod_le_one₀ (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun _ _ => hprn))
  
  have hLd : ∀ (i : ℕ) (z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), 1 ≤ i → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (⇑L) z‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro i z hi
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, i = j + 1 := ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (⇑L) = fun _ => L := by funext y; exact L.fderiv
    rw [hfd]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with hj | hj
    · subst hj; rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]; exact hLn
    · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (by omega : j ≠ 0)]; simp
  
  have hpair : ∀ {F1 F2 : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F1] [NormedSpace ℝ F1] [NormedAddCommGroup F2]
      [NormedSpace ℝ F2] (a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → F1) (b : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → F2) (x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (i : ℕ),
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ a x → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ b x →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y => (a y, b y)) x‖ =
        max ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i a x‖ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i b x‖ := by
    intro F1 F2 _ _ _ _ a b x i ha hb
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_prodMk ha hb (hle i)]
    exact ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_prod _ _
  
  have hpc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => ((z.1, z.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
  have hmp : MapsTo (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => ((z.1, z.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
      {z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | (z.1, z.2.1) ∈ Ω} Ω := fun z hz => hz
  have ha1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => w1 z.1 z.2.1)
      {z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | (z.1, z.2.1) ∈ Ω} := hw1.comp hpc.contDiffOn hmp
  have ha2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => w2 z.1 z.2.1)
      {z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | (z.1, z.2.1) ∈ Ω} := hw2.comp hpc.contDiffOn hmp
  have ha3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => w3 z.1 z.2.1)
      {z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | (z.1, z.2.1) ∈ Ω} := hw3.comp hpc.contDiffOn hmp
  have ha4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => w4 z.1 z.2.1)
      {z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | (z.1, z.2.1) ∈ Ω} := hw4.comp hpc.contDiffOn hmp
  have hLs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => z.2.2) := by fun_prop
  have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
      ((w1 z.1 z.2.1, w2 z.1 z.2.1, w3 z.1 z.2.1, w4 z.1 z.2.1), z.2.2))
      {z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | (z.1, z.2.1) ∈ Ω} :=
    (ha1.prodMk (ha2.prodMk (ha3.prodMk ha4))).prodMk hLs.contDiffOn
  have hfm : MapsTo (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
      ((w1 z.1 z.2.1, w2 z.1 z.2.1, w3 z.1 z.2.1, w4 z.1 z.2.1), z.2.2))
      {z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | (z.1, z.2.1) ∈ Ω} (V ×ˢ univ) :=
    fun z hz => ⟨hwV (z.1, z.2.1) hz, mem_univ _⟩
  have hcomp : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Q (w1 z.1 z.2.1, w2 z.1 z.2.1, w3 z.1 z.2.1, w4 z.1 z.2.1) z.2.2)
      = (fun y : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => Q y.1 y.2) ∘ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
      ((w1 z.1 z.2.1, w2 z.1 z.2.1, w3 z.1 z.2.1, w4 z.1 z.2.1), z.2.2)) := rfl
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hcomp]; exact hQs.comp hf hfm
  · intro m
    choose Cg hCg using hQb
    choose Cw hCw using hwb
    refine ⟨(m.factorial : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Cg i|) *
      (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |max (Cw i) 1|) ^ m, ?_⟩
    intro z hzS
    have hz : z ∈ {z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | (z.1, z.2.1) ∈ Ω} := hSΩ hzS
    have hpz : ((z.1, z.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ω := hSΩ hzS
    have hzn : {z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | (z.1, z.2.1) ∈ Ω} ∈ nhds z := hO.mem_nhds hz
    have hfz := hfm hz
    have hgb : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun y : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => Q y.1 y.2)
        (V ×ˢ univ) ((w1 z.1 z.2.1, w2 z.1 z.2.1, w3 z.1 z.2.1, w4 z.1 z.2.1), z.2.2)‖ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Cg i| := by
      intro i hi
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hT hfz]
      exact (hCg i _ (hwK (z.1, z.2.1) hzS) z.2.2).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans
        (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cg i|) (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))))
    have hfb : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
        ((w1 z.1 z.2.1, w2 z.1 z.2.1, w3 z.1 z.2.1, w4 z.1 z.2.1), z.2.2)) z‖ ≤ max (Cw i) 1 := by
      intro i hi
      have c1 := ha1.contDiffAt hzn
      have c2 := ha2.contDiffAt hzn
      have c3 := ha3.contDiffAt hzn
      have c4 := ha4.contDiffAt hzn
      rw [hpair _ _ z i (c1.prodMk (c2.prodMk (c3.prodMk c4))) hLs.contDiffAt,
        hpair _ _ z i c1 (c2.prodMk (c3.prodMk c4)), hpair _ _ z i c2 (c3.prodMk c4),
        hpair _ _ z i c3 c4]
      obtain ⟨b1, b2, b3, b4⟩ := hCw i (z.1, z.2.1) hzS
      have e1 := (hslice (↿w1) hw1 i z hpz).trans b1
      have e2 := (hslice (↿w2) hw2 i z hpz).trans b2
      have e3 := (hslice (↿w3) hw3 i z hpz).trans b3
      have e4 := (hslice (↿w4) hw4 i z hpz).trans b4
      have eL : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => z.2.2) z‖ ≤ 1 := by
        have : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => z.2.2) = ⇑L := funext fun y => (hL y).symm
        rw [this]; exact hLd i z hi
      exact max_le (max_le (e1.trans (le_max_left _ _)) (max_le (e2.trans (le_max_left _ _))
        (max_le (e3.trans (le_max_left _ _)) (e4.trans (le_max_left _ _)))))
        (eL.trans (le_max_right _ _))
    have hD1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |max (Cw i) 1| := by
      have := Finset.sum_nonneg (s := Finset.range (m + 1)) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg (max (Cw i) 1))
      linarith
    have hfb' : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
        ((w1 z.1 z.2.1, w2 z.1 z.2.1, w3 z.1 z.2.1, w4 z.1 z.2.1), z.2.2))
        {z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | (z.1, z.2.1) ∈ Ω} z‖ ≤
        (1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |max (Cw i) 1|) ^ i := by
      intro i hi1 him
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO hz]
      have hs : |max (Cw i) 1| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |max (Cw i) 1| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |max (Cw i) 1|) (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
      calc _ ≤ max (Cw i) 1 := hfb i hi1
        _ ≤ |max (Cw i) 1| := le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |max (Cw i) 1| := by linarith
        _ ≤ _ := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
    have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hQs hf (hle m) hT.uniqueDiffOn hO.uniqueDiffOn
      hfm hz hgb hfb'
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hO hz] at key
    rw [hcomp]
    exact key

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (Pa Pb : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (Xm Xm2 Xp2 Xp : ℝ), 0 < Xm → Xm < Xm2 → Xm2 < Xp2 → Xp2 < Xp → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Pa z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) (Ioo Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 ×ˢ univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Pb z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) (Ioo Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 ×ˢ univ) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, Xm2 ≤ z.1 → z.1 ≤ Xp2 → -1 < z.2.1 → z.2.1 < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Pa z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Pb z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) z‖ ≤ C) → (∀ X η φ : ℝ, (X ≤ Xm2 ∨ Xp2 ≤ X) → Pa X η φ = 0 ∧ Pb X η φ = 0) → ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → (∀ X η : ℝ, (X ≤ Xm2 ∨ Xp2 ≤ X) → F X η * Real.exp (-Pa X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ))) = F X η ∧ U X η + Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η * Pb X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ)) = U X η) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun X η : ℝ => F X η * Real.exp (-Pa X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ))))) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun X η : ℝ => U X η + Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η * Pb X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ)))) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η * Real.exp (-Pa X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ)))) ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C' : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun X η : ℝ => F X η * Real.exp (-Pa X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ))))) (X, η)‖ ≤ C' ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun X η : ℝ => U X η + Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η * Pb X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ)))) (X, η)‖ ≤ C'

signature.name: modulation_regularity
signature.statement: ∀ (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (Pa Pb : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (Xm Xm2 Xp2 Xp : ℝ), 0 < Xm → Xm < Xm2 → Xm2 < Xp2 → Xp2 < Xp → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Pa z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) (Ioo Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 ×ˢ univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Pb z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) (Ioo Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 ×ˢ univ) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, Xm2 ≤ z.1 → z.1 ≤ Xp2 → -1 < z.2.1 → z.2.1 < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Pa z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Pb z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) z‖ ≤ C) → (∀ X η φ : ℝ, (X ≤ Xm2 ∨ Xp2 ≤ X) → Pa X η φ = 0 ∧ Pb X η φ = 0) → ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → (∀ X η : ℝ, (X ≤ Xm2 ∨ Xp2 ≤ X) → F X η * Real.exp (-Pa X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ))) = F X η ∧ U X η + Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η * Pb X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ)) = U X η) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun X η : ℝ => F X η * Real.exp (-Pa X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ))))) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun X η : ℝ => U X η + Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η * Pb X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ)))) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η * Real.exp (-Pa X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ)))) ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C' : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun X η : ℝ => F X η * Real.exp (-Pa X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ))))) (X, η)‖ ≤ C' ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun X η : ℝ => U X η + Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η * Pb X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ)))) (X, η)‖ ≤ C'

proof.tactics:
by
  intro F U Pa Pb Xm Xm2 Xp2 Xp hXm hXm2 hX2 hXp hF hU hFpos hB hPa hPb hPB hvan N _hN
  
  have hoff : ∀ X η : ℝ, (X ≤ Xm2 ∨ Xp2 ≤ X) →
      F X η * Real.exp (-Pa X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ))) = F X η ∧
      U X η + Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η * Pb X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ)) = U X η := by
    intro X η hc
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hvan X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) hc
    rw [h1, h2]
    simp
  
  have hcpt : ∀ {E G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup G]
      [NormedSpace ℝ G] (f : E → G) (V K : Set E), IsOpen V → IsCompact K → K ⊆ V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro E G _ _ _ _ f V K hV hK hKV hf k
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k f V) V :=
      hf.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hV.uniqueDiffOn
    have h2 : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f) V :=
      h1.congr (fun z hz => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hV hz).symm)
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (h2.mono hKV)
    exact ⟨C, hC⟩
  have hcomp : ∀ {E G H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup G]
      [NormedSpace ℝ G] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] (g : G → H) (f : E → G)
      (V S : Set E) (T : Set G), IsOpen V → IsOpen T → S ⊆ V → MapsTo f V T →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g T → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (f w)‖ ≤ C) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w‖ ≤ C) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (g ∘ f) V ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (g ∘ f) w‖ ≤ C := by
    intro E G H _ _ _ _ _ _ g f V S T hV hT hSV hM hg hf hgb hfb
    have key := wt_comp_bound g f (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) V S T hV hT hSV hM
      (fun _ _ => ⟨one_pos, le_rfl⟩) hg hf
      (fun k => by
        obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hgb k
        exact ⟨C, 0, fun w hw => by simpa using hC w hw⟩)
      (fun k => by
        obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hfb k
        exact ⟨C, 0, fun w hw => by simpa using hC w hw⟩)
    refine ⟨key.1, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, K, hC⟩ := key.2 k
    exact ⟨C, fun w hw => by simpa using hC w hw⟩
  have hmul : ∀ (f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (V S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen V → S ⊆ V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g V →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z‖ ≤ C) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g z‖ ≤ C) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => f z * g z) V ∧
        ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => f z * g z) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro f g V S hV hSV hf hg hfb hgb
    refine ⟨hf.mul hg, ?_⟩
    have := iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) f g V S hV hSV hf hg
      hfb hgb
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply'] using this
  have hadd : ∀ (f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (V S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen V → S ⊆ V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g V →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z‖ ≤ C) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g z‖ ≤ C) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => f z + g z) V ∧
        ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => f z + g z) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro f g V S hV hSV hf hg hfb hgb
    refine ⟨hf.add hg, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C1, h1⟩ := hfb k
    obtain ⟨C2, h2⟩ := hgb k
    refine ⟨C1 + C2, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hz' : V ∈ nhds z := hV.mem_nhds (hSV hz)
    have e : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => f z + g z) z =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g z :=
      iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((hf.contDiffAt hz').of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        ((hg.contDiffAt hz').of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    rw [e]
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (h1 z hz) (h2 z hz))
  
  set Ω : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Ioo Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 with hΩdef
  set S0 : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Icc Xm2 Xp2 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 with hS0def
  set W : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.1 < Xm2} ∪ {w : ℝ × ℝ | Xp2 < w.1} with hWdef
  have hΩo : IsOpen Ω := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hS0Ω : S0 ⊆ Ω := fun z hz =>
    ⟨⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hXm2 hz.1.1, lt_of_le_of_lt hz.1.2 hXp⟩, hz.2⟩
  have hΩs : Ω ⊆ Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 := fun z hz =>
    ⟨show (0:ℝ) < z.1 from lt_trans hXm hz.1.1, hz.2⟩
  have hΩ'o : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_univ
  have hK0c : IsCompact (Icc Xm2 Xp2 ×ˢ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  have hK0Ω' : Icc Xm2 Xp2 ×ˢ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) := fun z hz =>
    ⟨show (0:ℝ) < z.1 from lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_trans hXm hXm2) hz.1.1, mem_univ _⟩
  have hS0K0 : S0 ⊆ Icc Xm2 Xp2 ×ˢ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1 := prod_mono subset_rfl Ioo_subset_Icc_self
  have hΩΩ' : Ω ⊆ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) := fun z hz =>
    ⟨show (0:ℝ) < z.1 from lt_trans hXm hz.1.1, mem_univ _⟩
  have hW : IsOpen W :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_fst continuous_const).union (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst)
  have hWoff : ∀ w ∈ W, (w.1 ≤ Xm2 ∨ Xp2 ≤ w.1) := fun w hw =>
    hw.elim (fun h => Or.inl (le_of_lt h)) (fun h => Or.inr (le_of_lt h))
  
  have hjF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => F w.1 w.2) Ω := hF.mono hΩs
  have hjU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => U w.1 w.2) Ω := hU.mono hΩs
  have hFb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => F w.1 w.2) (X, η)‖ ≤ C := fun k =>
    (hB k).imp (fun C hC X η a b c d => (hC X η a b c d).1)
  have hUb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => U w.1 w.2) (X, η)‖ ≤ C := fun k =>
    (hB k).imp (fun C hC X η a b c d => (hC X η a b c d).2)
  have hjFb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S0, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => F w.1 w.2) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hFb k
    refine ⟨C, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨X, η⟩ := z
    exact hC X η (le_trans hXm2.le hz.1.1) (le_trans hz.1.2 hXp.le) hz.2.1 hz.2.2
  have hjUb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S0, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => U w.1 w.2) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hUb k
    refine ⟨C, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨X, η⟩ := z
    exact hC X η (le_trans hXm2.le hz.1.1) (le_trans hz.1.2 hXp.le) hz.2.1 hz.2.2
  
  have hι : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ((w.1, w.2, (N:ℝ) * Real.log w.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))
      (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) :=
    contDiffOn_fst.prodMk (contDiffOn_snd.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.mul
      (contDiffOn_fst.log (fun w hw => (show (0:ℝ) < w.1 from hw.1).ne'))))
  have hιb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S0,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ((w.1, w.2, (N:ℝ) * Real.log w.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hcpt _ _ _ hΩ'o hK0c hK0Ω' hι k
    exact ⟨C, fun z hz => hC z (hS0K0 hz)⟩
  have hphase : ∀ G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => G z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) (Ioo Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 ×ˢ univ) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, Xm2 ≤ z.1 → z.1 ≤ Xp2 → -1 < z.2.1 → z.2.1 < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => G z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) z‖ ≤ C) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => G w.1 w.2 ((N:ℝ) * Real.log w.1)) Ω ∧
        ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S0,
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => G w.1 w.2 ((N:ℝ) * Real.log w.1)) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro G hG hGb
    exact hcomp (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => G z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2)
      (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ((w.1, w.2, (N:ℝ) * Real.log w.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) Ω S0
      (Ioo Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 ×ˢ univ) hΩo (isOpen_Ioo.prod (isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ)) hS0Ω
      (fun w hw => ⟨hw.1, hw.2, mem_univ _⟩) hG (hι.mono hΩΩ')
      (fun k => by
        obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hGb k
        exact ⟨C, fun w hw => hC _ hw.1.1 hw.1.2 hw.2.1 hw.2.2⟩) hιb
  have hga := hphase Pa hPa (fun k => (hPB k).imp (fun C hC z a b c d => (hC z a b c d).1))
  have hgb := hphase Pb hPb (fun k => (hPB k).imp (fun C hC z a b c d => (hC z a b c d).2))
  
  have houter : ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g Ω →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S0, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g z‖ ≤ C) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ψ ∘ g) Ω ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S0, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ ∘ g) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro ψ g hψ hg hgb'
    obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := hgb' 0
    have hψb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ Icc (-C0) C0, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ y‖ ≤ C :=
      hcpt ψ univ (Icc (-C0) C0) isOpen_univ isCompact_Icc (subset_univ _) hψ.contDiffOn
    exact hcomp ψ g Ω S0 univ hΩo isOpen_univ hS0Ω (mapsTo_univ _ _) hψ.contDiffOn hg
      (fun k => by
        obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hψb k
        refine ⟨C, fun w hw => hC _ ?_⟩
        have := hC0 w hw
        rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
        exact abs_le.mp this) hgb'
  have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-t / (2 * (N:ℝ)))) := by fun_prop
  have hEa := houter (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-t / (2 * (N:ℝ))))
    (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Pa w.1 w.2 ((N:ℝ) * Real.log w.1)) hψ hga.1 hga.2
  
  have hsq' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) / (2 * (N:ℝ)))
      (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) :=
    ((contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_fst).sqrt (fun w hw => by
      have : (0:ℝ) < w.1 := hw.1
      positivity)).div_const _
  have hsqb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S0,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) / (2 * (N:ℝ))) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hcpt _ _ _ hΩ'o hK0c hK0Ω' hsq' k
    exact ⟨C, fun z hz => hC z (hS0K0 hz)⟩
  
  have hFNp := hmul (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => F w.1 w.2)
    ((fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-t / (2 * (N:ℝ)))) ∘ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Pa w.1 w.2 ((N:ℝ) * Real.log w.1)))
    Ω S0 hΩo hS0Ω hjF hEa.1 hjFb hEa.2
  have hT1 := hmul (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) / (2 * (N:ℝ))) (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => F w.1 w.2)
    Ω S0 hΩo hS0Ω (hsq'.mono hΩΩ') hjF hsqb hjFb
  have hTb := hmul (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) / (2 * (N:ℝ)) * F w.1 w.2)
    (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Pb w.1 w.2 ((N:ℝ) * Real.log w.1)) Ω S0 hΩo hS0Ω hT1.1 hgb.1 hT1.2 hgb.2
  have hUNp := hadd (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => U w.1 w.2)
    (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) / (2 * (N:ℝ)) * F w.1 w.2 *
      Pb w.1 w.2 ((N:ℝ) * Real.log w.1)) Ω S0 hΩo hS0Ω hjU hTb.1 hjUb hTb.2
  have hUNeq : (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => U w.1 w.2 + Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) * F w.1 w.2 *
      Pb w.1 w.2 ((N:ℝ) * Real.log w.1) / (2 * (N:ℝ))) =
      (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => U w.1 w.2 + Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) / (2 * (N:ℝ)) * F w.1 w.2 *
      Pb w.1 w.2 ((N:ℝ) * Real.log w.1)) := by
    funext w; ring
  have hUNs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => U w.1 w.2 + Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) * F w.1 w.2 *
      Pb w.1 w.2 ((N:ℝ) * Real.log w.1) / (2 * (N:ℝ))) Ω := by
    rw [hUNeq]; exact hUNp.1
  have hUNb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S0, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k
      (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => U w.1 w.2 + Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) * F w.1 w.2 *
        Pb w.1 w.2 ((N:ℝ) * Real.log w.1) / (2 * (N:ℝ))) z‖ ≤ C := by
    rw [hUNeq]; exact hUNp.2
  have hFNs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => F w.1 w.2 *
      Real.exp (-Pa w.1 w.2 ((N:ℝ) * Real.log w.1) / (2 * (N:ℝ)))) Ω := hFNp.1
  have hFNb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S0, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k
      (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => F w.1 w.2 *
        Real.exp (-Pa w.1 w.2 ((N:ℝ) * Real.log w.1) / (2 * (N:ℝ)))) z‖ ≤ C := hFNp.2
  
  have hglue : ∀ (G G0 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G Ω →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G0 (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ w ∈ W, G w = G0 w) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    intro G G0 hG hG0 heq
    apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    intro x hx
    by_cases hin : Xm < x.1 ∧ x.1 < Xp
    · refine ⟨Ioo Xm Xp ×ˢ univ, isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ, ⟨hin, mem_univ _⟩, hG.mono ?_⟩
      intro z hz
      exact ⟨hz.2.1, hz.1.2⟩
    · refine ⟨W, hW, ?_, (hG0.mono inter_subset_left).congr (fun z hz => heq z hz.2)⟩
      rcases not_and_or.mp hin with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (lt_of_le_of_lt (not_lt.mp h) hXm2)
      · exact Or.inr (lt_of_lt_of_le hXp (not_lt.mp h))
  have hbound : ∀ (G G0 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S0, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k G z‖ ≤ C) →
      (∀ w ∈ W, G w = G0 w) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k G0 (X, η)‖ ≤ C) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k G (X, η)‖ ≤ C := by
    intro G G0 hGb heq hG0b k
    obtain ⟨C1, h1⟩ := hGb k
    obtain ⟨C2, h2⟩ := hG0b k
    refine ⟨max C1 C2, fun X η hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2 => ?_⟩
    by_cases hin : Xm2 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ Xp2
    · exact (h1 (X, η) ⟨hin, hη1, hη2⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · have hmem : (X, η) ∈ W := by
        rcases not_and_or.mp hin with h | h
        · exact Or.inl (not_le.mp h)
        · exact Or.inr (not_le.mp h)
      have hev : G =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)] G0 := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hmem) heq
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
      exact (h2 X η hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hFNoff : ∀ w ∈ W, (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => F w.1 w.2 *
      Real.exp (-Pa w.1 w.2 ((N:ℝ) * Real.log w.1) / (2 * (N:ℝ)))) w = (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => F w.1 w.2) w :=
    fun w hw => (hoff w.1 w.2 (hWoff w hw)).1
  have hUNoff : ∀ w ∈ W, (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => U w.1 w.2 + Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) * F w.1 w.2 *
      Pb w.1 w.2 ((N:ℝ) * Real.log w.1) / (2 * (N:ℝ))) w = (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => U w.1 w.2) w :=
    fun w hw => (hoff w.1 w.2 (hWoff w hw)).2
  refine ⟨hoff, hglue _ _ hFNs hF hFNoff, hglue _ _ hUNs hU hUNoff,
    fun X η hX h1 h2 => mul_pos (hFpos X η hX h1 h2) (Real.exp_pos _), ?_⟩
  intro m
  obtain ⟨C1, h1⟩ := hbound _ _ hFNb hFNoff hFb m
  obtain ⟨C2, h2⟩ := hbound _ _ hUNb hUNoff hUb m
  exact ⟨max C1 C2, fun X η a b c d =>
    ⟨(h1 X η a b c d).trans (le_max_left _ _), (h2 X η a b c d).trans (le_max_right _ _)⟩⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: wt_comp_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {E F G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (g : F → G) (f : E → F) (ρ : E → ℝ) (Ω S : Set E) (T : Set F), IsOpen Ω → IsOpen T → S ⊆ Ω → MapsTo f Ω T → (∀ w ∈ S, 0 < ρ w ∧ ρ w ≤ 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g T → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (f w)‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (g ∘ f) Ω ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (g ∘ f) w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)

subgoal_signatures.name: iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {E F G H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] H) (f : E → F) (g : E → G) (O S : Set E), IsOpen O → S ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g O → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z‖ ≤ C) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g z‖ ≤ C) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) z‖ ≤ C

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (Pa Pb : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (Xm Xm2 Xp2 Xp c : ℝ), 0 < Xm → Xm < Xm2 → Xm2 < Xp2 → Xp2 < Xp → 0 < c → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 → c ≤ F X η) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Pa z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) (Ioo Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 ×ˢ univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Pb z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) (Ioo Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 ×ˢ univ) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, Xm2 ≤ z.1 → z.1 ≤ Xp2 → -1 < z.2.1 → z.2.1 < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Pa z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Pb z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) z‖ ≤ C) → (∀ X η φ : ℝ, (X ≤ Xm2 ∨ Xp2 ≤ X) → Pa X η φ = 0 ∧ Pb X η φ = 0) → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 → |F X η * Real.exp (-Pa X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ))) - F X η| ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ∧ |U X η + Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η * Pb X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ)) - U X η| ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ∧ |deriv (fun e => F X e * Real.exp (-Pa X e ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ)))) η - deriv (fun e => F X e) η| ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ∧ |deriv (fun e => U X e + Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X e * Pb X e ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ))) η - deriv (fun e => U X e) η| ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ∧ |shearA (fun X η : ℝ => F X η * Real.exp (-Pa X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ)))) X η - (shearA F X η + deriv (fun φ => Pa X η φ) ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X))| ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ∧ |shearB (fun X η : ℝ => F X η * Real.exp (-Pa X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ)))) (fun X η : ℝ => U X η + Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η * Pb X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ))) X η - (shearB F U X η + deriv (fun φ => Pb X η φ) ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X))| ≤ C / (N : ℝ)

signature.name: modulation_errors
signature.statement: ∀ (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (Pa Pb : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (Xm Xm2 Xp2 Xp c : ℝ), 0 < Xm → Xm < Xm2 → Xm2 < Xp2 → Xp2 < Xp → 0 < c → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 → c ≤ F X η) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Pa z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) (Ioo Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 ×ˢ univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Pb z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) (Ioo Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 ×ˢ univ) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, Xm2 ≤ z.1 → z.1 ≤ Xp2 → -1 < z.2.1 → z.2.1 < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Pa z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Pb z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) z‖ ≤ C) → (∀ X η φ : ℝ, (X ≤ Xm2 ∨ Xp2 ≤ X) → Pa X η φ = 0 ∧ Pb X η φ = 0) → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 → |F X η * Real.exp (-Pa X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ))) - F X η| ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ∧ |U X η + Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η * Pb X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ)) - U X η| ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ∧ |deriv (fun e => F X e * Real.exp (-Pa X e ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ)))) η - deriv (fun e => F X e) η| ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ∧ |deriv (fun e => U X e + Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X e * Pb X e ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ))) η - deriv (fun e => U X e) η| ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ∧ |shearA (fun X η : ℝ => F X η * Real.exp (-Pa X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ)))) X η - (shearA F X η + deriv (fun φ => Pa X η φ) ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X))| ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ∧ |shearB (fun X η : ℝ => F X η * Real.exp (-Pa X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ)))) (fun X η : ℝ => U X η + Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η * Pb X η ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X) / (2 * (N : ℝ))) X η - (shearB F U X η + deriv (fun φ => Pb X η φ) ((N : ℝ) * Real.log X))| ≤ C / (N : ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro F U Pa Pb Xm Xm2 Xp2 Xp c hXm hXm2 hX2 hXp hc hFs hUs hFc hFUbd hPaS hPbS hPbd hPvan
  
  have t_exp : ∀ (P M n : ℝ), |P| ≤ M → 1 ≤ n → 0 < Real.exp (-P / (2 * n)) ∧
      Real.exp (-P / (2 * n)) ≤ Real.exp (M / 2) ∧ (Real.exp (-P / (2 * n)))⁻¹ ≤ Real.exp (M / 2) ∧
      |Real.exp (-P / (2 * n)) - 1| ≤ Real.exp (M / 2) * M / (2 * n) ∧
      |(Real.exp (-P / (2 * n)))⁻¹ - 1| ≤ Real.exp (M / 2) * M / (2 * n) := by
    intro P M n hP hn
    have hn0 : 0 < n := by linarith
    have hM : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hP
    have hta : |-P / (2 * n)| ≤ M / (2 * n) := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 2 * n)]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hP (by positivity)
    set t := -P / (2 * n) with ht
    have hM2 : M / (2 * n) ≤ M / 2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hM (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    have key : ∀ s : ℝ, |Real.exp s - 1| ≤ |s| * Real.exp |s| := by
      intro s
      rcases le_total 0 s with hs | hs
      · have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (-s)
        have h2 : 1 ≤ Real.exp s := Real.one_le_exp hs
        have h3 : Real.exp (-s) * Real.exp s = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith), abs_of_nonneg hs]
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (Real.exp_pos s).le]
      · have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp s
        have h2 : Real.exp s ≤ 1 := by
          have := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hs
          rwa [Real.exp_zero] at this
        have h4 : 1 ≤ Real.exp (-s) := Real.one_le_exp (by linarith)
        rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith), abs_of_nonpos hs]
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ -s) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (-s) - 1)]
    have hE : Real.exp |t| ≤ Real.exp (M/2) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (hta.trans hM2)
    refine ⟨Real.exp_pos _, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (le_abs_self t)).trans hE
    · rw [← Real.exp_neg]; exact (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_abs t)).trans hE
    · calc |Real.exp t - 1| ≤ |t| * Real.exp |t| := key t
        _ ≤ (M / (2*n)) * Real.exp (M/2) := mul_le_mul hta hE (Real.exp_pos _).le (by positivity)
        _ = _ := by ring
    · rw [← Real.exp_neg]
      calc |Real.exp (-t) - 1| ≤ |-t| * Real.exp |-t| := key (-t)
        _ = |t| * Real.exp |t| := by rw [abs_neg]
        _ ≤ (M / (2*n)) * Real.exp (M/2) := mul_le_mul hta hE (Real.exp_pos _).le (by positivity)
        _ = _ := by ring
  
  have t_val : ∀ (f fe u ue Q a2 b2 E s n B M K sig : ℝ), 1 ≤ n → 0 < E → E ≤ K →
      |E - 1| ≤ K * M / (2 * n) → 0 ≤ s → s ≤ sig → |f| ≤ B → |fe| ≤ B → |Q| ≤ M → |a2| ≤ M →
      |b2| ≤ M → |f * E - f| ≤ (B * M * K + sig * B * M) / n ∧
      |u + s * f * Q / (2 * n) - u| ≤ (B * M * K + sig * B * M) / n ∧
      |fe * E - f * E * a2 / (2 * n) - fe| ≤ (B * M * K + sig * B * M) / n ∧
      |ue + s * (fe * Q + f * b2) / (2 * n) - ue| ≤ (B * M * K + sig * B * M) / n := by
    intro f fe u ue Q a2 b2 E s n B M K sig hn hE hEK hE1 hs hsig hf hfe hQ ha2 hb2
    have hn0 : 0 < n := by linarith
    have hB : 0 ≤ B := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hf
    have hM : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hQ
    have hK : 0 ≤ K := by linarith
    have hsg : 0 ≤ sig := by linarith
    have hd : |(E - 1) * n| ≤ K * M / 2 := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hn0]
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hE1 hn0.le
      rwa [show K * M / (2 * n) * n = K * M / 2 by field_simp] at this
    have hBMK : 0 ≤ B * M * K := by positivity
    have hsBM : 0 ≤ sig * B * M := by positivity
    have fin : ∀ x y : ℝ, x * n = y → |y| ≤ B * M * K + sig * B * M →
        |x| ≤ (B * M * K + sig * B * M) / n := by
      intro x y hxy hy
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hn0]
      have : |x| * n = |y| := by rw [← hxy, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hn0]
      rw [this]; exact hy
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine fin _ (f * ((E - 1) * n)) (by ring) ?_
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |f| * |(E - 1) * n| ≤ B * (K * M / 2) := mul_le_mul hf hd (abs_nonneg _) hB
        _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith
    · refine fin _ (s * f * Q / 2) (by field_simp; ring) ?_
      rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hs, abs_two]
      have h1 : s * |f| ≤ sig * B := mul_le_mul hsig hf (abs_nonneg _) hsg
      have h2 : s * |f| * |Q| ≤ sig * B * M := mul_le_mul h1 hQ (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      nlinarith
    · refine fin _ (fe * ((E - 1) * n) - f * E * a2 / 2) (by field_simp; ring) ?_
      have h1 : |fe * ((E - 1) * n)| ≤ B * (K * M / 2) := by
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hfe hd (abs_nonneg _) hB
      have h2 : |f * E * a2 / 2| ≤ B * K * M / 2 := by
        rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hE, abs_two]
        have h3 : |f| * E ≤ B * K := mul_le_mul hf hEK hE.le hB
        have h4 : |f| * E * |a2| ≤ B * K * M := mul_le_mul h3 ha2 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        linarith
      calc |fe * ((E - 1) * n) - f * E * a2 / 2| ≤ |fe * ((E - 1) * n)| + |f * E * a2 / 2| :=
            abs_sub _ _
        _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith
    · refine fin _ (s * (fe * Q + f * b2) / 2) (by field_simp; ring) ?_
      have h1 : |fe * Q + f * b2| ≤ B * M + B * M := by
        calc |fe * Q + f * b2| ≤ |fe * Q| + |f * b2| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ B * M + B * M := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
            exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul hfe hQ (abs_nonneg _) hB)
              (mul_le_mul hf hb2 (abs_nonneg _) hB)
      rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hs, abs_two]
      have h2 : s * |fe * Q + f * b2| ≤ sig * (B * M + B * M) :=
        mul_le_mul hsig h1 (abs_nonneg _) hsg
      nlinarith
  
  have t_shear : ∀ (X Xp c f fX uX E s n B M K sig a1 a3 b1 b3 Q : ℝ), 0 < X → X ≤ Xp → 0 < c →
      c ≤ f → |fX| ≤ B → |uX| ≤ B → 1 ≤ n → 0 < E → E⁻¹ ≤ K → |E⁻¹ - 1| ≤ K * M / (2 * n) →
      s = Real.sqrt (2 * X) → s ≤ sig → |a1| ≤ M → |a3| ≤ M → |b1| ≤ M → |b3| ≤ M → |Q| ≤ M →
      |-2 * X * (fX * E - f * E * (a1 + n / X * a3) / (2 * n)) / (f * E) - (-2 * X * fX / f + a3)| ≤
        (Xp * M + M * K * (sig * B / c + M) + K * (M + 2 * Xp * B * M / c + 2 * Xp * M)) / n ∧
      |s * (uX + (f * Q / s + s * fX * Q + s * f * (b1 + n / X * b3)) / (2 * n)) / (f * E) -

    have ba3 : |DA ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))| ≤ M :=

    have bb3 : |DB ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))| ≤ M :=
      (hfd3 (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Pb z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) _ _ hv001).trans (hB1.trans hMD1)
    obtain ⟨hE0, hEK, hEiK, hE1, hEi1⟩ := t_exp (Pa X η (n * Real.log X)) M n bP hn
    have hsX : Real.sqrt (2 * X) ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * Xp) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)

    have hle6 : (Xp * M + M * Real.exp (M / 2) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Xp) * B / c + M) +

    have hvan : ∀ Y e φ : ℝ, (Y < Xm2 ∨ Xp2 < Y) → Pa Y e φ = 0 ∧ Pb Y e φ = 0 := by

    · rw [hFN X η hoff, sub_self, abs_zero]; exact hz
    · rw [hUN X η hoff, sub_self, abs_zero]; exact hz
    · rw [e3, sub_self, abs_zero]; exact hz
    · rw [e4, sub_self, abs_zero]; exact hz
    · simp only [shearA]

    · simp only [shearB]

proof.tactics:
by
  intro hLPR hCG h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xan Xm Xm2 Xp2 Xp r1 r2 ε κ F U hJ hε hPR hκ
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, hh1, hlam, hcinf, hcp, haa, hab, hXa, hXap1, hp12, hp2m1, hm12, hm2Xv, hXvXc, hXcXb,
    hXaXan, hXanXm, hXmXm2, hXm2Xp2, hXp2Xp, hXpr1, hr1r2, hr2p1⟩, -, -, hJadm, ⟨μ, hμ, hRC⟩, -⟩ := hJ
  obtain ⟨⟨c₀, hc₀, hlow⟩, -, ⟨κa, hκa0, -, hcone⟩⟩ := hJadm
  have hPR' := hPR
  obtain ⟨hFs, hUs, hFpos, hBd, -⟩ := hPR'
  have hXm0 : 0 < Xm := by linarith
  have hXp0 : 0 < Xp := by linarith
  have hXmXp : Xm ≤ Xp := by linarith
  have hXpr2 : Xp ≤ r2 := by linarith
  have hr20 : 0 < r2 := by linarith
  have hr2Xb : r2 < Xb := by linarith
  have hXb0 : 0 < Xb := by linarith
  have hXaXp : Xa < Xp := by linarith
  
  have adm_to_quad : ∀ κ c1 B f a b q1 q2 : ℝ, 0 < κ → 0 < c1 → 0 < f → f ≤ B → 0 < a →
      c1 ≤ Real.sqrt ((f * (q1 - a)) ^ 2 + (f * (q2 + b)) ^ 2) →
      κ * Real.sqrt ((f * (q1 - a)) ^ 2 + (f * (q2 + b)) ^ 2) ≤ f * (q1 - a) - b / a * (f * (q2 + b)) →
      (a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) - 2) * (f * (q2 + b) + b / a * (f * (q1 - a))) ^ 2 ≤
        (2 - κ) * (f * (q1 - a) - b / a * (f * (q2 + b))) ^ 2 →
      κ * c1 / B ≤ q1 - b / a * q2 - a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) ∧
      (a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) - 2) * (q2 + b / a * q1) ^ 2 ≤
        (2 - κ) * (q1 - b / a * q2 - a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
    intro κ c1 B f a b q1 q2 hκ hc1 hf hfB ha hT hc hq
    have hra : a * (b / a) = b := by field_simp
    have id1 : f * (q1 - a) - b / a * (f * (q2 + b)) = f * (q1 - b / a * q2 - a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2)) := by
      linear_combination (f * (b / a)) * hra
    have id2 : f * (q2 + b) + b / a * (f * (q1 - a)) = f * (q2 + b / a * q1) := by
      linear_combination (-f) * hra
    rw [id1] at hc
    rw [id1, id2] at hq
    have hfD : κ * c1 ≤ f * (q1 - b / a * q2 - a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2)) :=
      le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT hκ.le) hc
    have hD0 : 0 ≤ q1 - b / a * q2 - a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) := by
      by_contra hneg
      push_neg at hneg
      linarith [mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hf hneg, mul_pos hκ hc1]
    have hB : 0 < B := lt_of_lt_of_le hf hfB
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [div_le_iff₀ hB]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfB hD0]
    · have hf2 : 0 < f ^ 2 := by positivity
      have h2 : f ^ 2 * ((a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) - 2) * (q2 + b / a * q1) ^ 2) ≤
          f ^ 2 * ((2 - κ) * (q1 - b / a * q2 - a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2)) ^ 2) := by
        calc f ^ 2 * ((a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) - 2) * (q2 + b / a * q1) ^ 2)
            = (a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) - 2) * (f * (q2 + b / a * q1)) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ ≤ (2 - κ) * (f * (q1 - b / a * q2 - a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2))) ^ 2 := hq
          _ = f ^ 2 * ((2 - κ) * (q1 - b / a * q2 - a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2)) ^ 2) := by ring
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h2 hf2
  have relax_to_quad : ∀ AQ : ℝ, 0 ≤ AQ → ∀ a b q1 q2 : ℝ, κ ≤ a → |b| ≤ 1 / κ → |q1| ≤ AQ → |q2| ≤ AQ →
      κ ≤ a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) - 2 → κ ≤ q1 - b / a * q2 - 2 →
      κ ≤ coneUp (q1 - b / a * q2) (q2 + b / a * q1) - a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) →
      κ ≤ q1 - b / a * q2 - a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) ∧
      (a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) - 2) * (q2 + b / a * q1) ^ 2 ≤
        (2 - min 1 (2 * κ ^ 2 / (AQ + AQ / κ ^ 2 + 1) ^ 2)) * (q1 - b / a * q2 - a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
    intro AQ hAQ a b q1 q2 ha hb hq1 hq2 hv hP hcu
    have ha0 : 0 < a := lt_of_lt_of_le hκ ha
    have hrb : |b / a| ≤ 1 / κ ^ 2 := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos ha0]
      calc |b| / a ≤ (1 / κ) / a := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hb ha0.le
        _ ≤ (1 / κ) / κ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (one_div_pos.mpr hκ).le hκ ha

    have hPle : q1 - b / a * q2 ≤ AQ + AQ / κ ^ 2 := by
      have h1 : q1 ≤ AQ := (le_abs_self q1).trans hq1
      have h2 : -(b / a * q2) ≤ AQ / κ ^ 2 := by
        calc -(b / a * q2) ≤ |b / a * q2| := neg_le_abs _
          _ = |b / a| * |q2| := abs_mul _ _
          _ ≤ (1 / κ ^ 2) * AQ := mul_le_mul hrb hq2 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = AQ / κ ^ 2 := by ring
      linarith
    exact hCG.1 κ (AQ + AQ / κ ^ 2 + 1) (q1 - b / a * q2) (q2 + b / a * q1) (a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2)) hκ
      (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hslice : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      |deriv (fun Y => f Y η) X| ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (↿f) (X, η)‖ := by
    intro f hf X η hX e1 e2
    have hmem : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
      ⟨show -ε < X by linarith, e1, e2⟩
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿f) (X, η) :=
      (hf.contDiffAt ((isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo).mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have hp : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => ((Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) X :=
      (hasDerivAt_id X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X η)
    have hc := hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt X hp
    have heq : deriv (fun Y => f Y η) X = fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) := hc.deriv
    rw [heq, norm_iteratedFDeriv_one]
    calc |fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))|
        = ‖fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
      _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η)‖ * ‖((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ = ‖fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η)‖ := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
  
  obtain ⟨cF, hcFdef⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = min μ κa := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hcF : 0 < cF := by rw [hcFdef]; exact lt_min hμ hκa0
  have hcFμ : cF ≤ μ := by rw [hcFdef]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hcFκ : cF ≤ κa := by rw [hcFdef]; exact min_le_right _ _
  have hFlow : ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ r2 → -1 < η → η < 1 → cF ≤ F X η := by
    intro X η h1 h2 e1 e2
    rcases le_total X Xp with hX | hX
    · exact le_trans hcFμ (hRC X ⟨h1, hX⟩ η e1 e2).1
    · exact le_trans hcFκ (hcone X (Or.inr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩) η e1 e2).1
  
  obtain ⟨-, hLb⟩ := hLPR h cinf Xb ε F U hh0 hh1 hXb0 hε hPR
  obtain ⟨AP, hAP⟩ := hLb Xm r2 cF hXm0 hcF hFlow 0
  have hPs : ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ r2 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      |psLead1 h F U X η| ≤ |AP| ∧ |psLead2 h F U X η| ≤ |AP| := by
    intro X η h1 h2 e1 e2
    obtain ⟨q1, q2, -, -⟩ := hAP X η h1 h2 e1 e2
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at q1 q2
    have q1' : |psLead1 h F U X η| ≤ AP := q1
    have q2' : |psLead2 h F U X η| ≤ AP := q2
    exact ⟨q1'.trans (le_abs_self _), q2'.trans (le_abs_self _)⟩
  
  obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := hBd r2 0
  obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hBd r2 1
  have hB0 : 0 < |C0| + 1 := by positivity

  obtain ⟨r1, r2, r3⟩ := key _ _ _ _ _ _ hG1 hG2 hQ e1 e2 e3
  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩,
    abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, r1, r2, r3⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ Xa Xb aa ab x1 x2 : ℝ, 0 < Xa → Xa < x1 → x1 ≤ x2 → x2 < Xb → 0 < aa → 0 < ab → ∃ W : ℝ, 0 < W ∧ ∀ X : ℝ, x1 ≤ X → X ≤ x2 → W ≤ edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X ∧ edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X ≤ 1

signature.name: edge_weight_window
signature.statement: ∀ Xa Xb aa ab x1 x2 : ℝ, 0 < Xa → Xa < x1 → x1 ≤ x2 → x2 < Xb → 0 < aa → 0 < ab → ∃ W : ℝ, 0 < W ∧ ∀ X : ℝ, x1 ≤ X → X ≤ x2 → W ≤ edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X ∧ edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X ≤ 1

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xa Xb aa ab x1 x2 hXa hx1 hx12 hx2 haa hab
  have hx1p : 0 < x1 := lt_trans hXa hx1
  have hx2p : 0 < x2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hx1p hx12
  have hXbp : 0 < Xb := lt_trans hx2p hx2
  have hL1 : 0 < Real.log (x1 / Xa) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hx1)
  have hL2 : 0 < Real.log (Xb / x2) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hx2p).mpr hx2)
  refine ⟨Real.exp (-(aa / Real.log (x1 / Xa) ^ 2) - ab / Real.log (Xb / x2) ^ 2),
    Real.exp_pos _, ?_⟩
  intro X hX1 hX2
  have hXa' : Xa < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hx1 hX1
  have hXb' : X < Xb := lt_of_le_of_lt hX2 hx2
  have hXp : 0 < X := lt_trans hXa hXa'
  have hEq : edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X =
      Real.exp (-(aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2) - ab / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2) := by
    unfold edgeWeight
    rw [if_pos ⟨hXa', hXb'⟩]
  rw [hEq]
  have hl1 : Real.log (x1 / Xa) ≤ Real.log (X / Xa) :=
    Real.log_le_log (div_pos hx1p hXa) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hX1 hXa.le)
  have hl2 : Real.log (Xb / x2) ≤ Real.log (Xb / X) :=
    Real.log_le_log (div_pos hXbp hx2p) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hXbp.le hXp hX2)
  have hs1 : Real.log (x1 / Xa) ^ 2 ≤ Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ hL1.le hl1 2
  have hs2 : Real.log (Xb / x2) ^ 2 ≤ Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ hL2.le hl2 2
  have hp1 : aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2 ≤ aa / Real.log (x1 / Xa) ^ 2 :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left haa.le (pow_pos hL1 2) hs1
  have hp2 : ab / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2 ≤ ab / Real.log (Xb / x2) ^ 2 :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hab.le (pow_pos hL2 2) hs2
  have hn1 : 0 ≤ aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2 := div_nonneg haa.le (sq_nonneg _)
  have hn2 : 0 ≤ ab / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2 := div_nonneg hab.le (sq_nonneg _)
  constructor
  · exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  · exact Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)

signature.name: seeley_lagrange_identity
signature.statement: ∀ N j : ℕ, j ≤ N → ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (∏ i ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)).erase k, (1 + (2:ℝ) ^ i) / ((2:ℝ) ^ i - (2:ℝ) ^ k)) * (-(2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j = 1

proof.tactics:
by
  intro N j hj
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun k : ℕ => -(2:ℝ) ^ k) ↑(Finset.range (N + 1)) := by
    intro a _ b _ hab
    have h2 : (2:ℝ) ^ a = (2:ℝ) ^ b := by simpa using hab
    exact pow_right_injective₀ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2) (by norm_num : (2:ℝ) ≠ 1) h2
  have hdeg : (Polynomial.X ^ j : Polynomial ℝ).degree < ↑(Finset.range (N + 1)).card := by
    rw [Polynomial.degree_X_pow, Finset.card_range]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj
  have hI := Lagrange.eq_interpolate hinj hdeg
  have hE := congrArg (Polynomial.eval (1:ℝ)) hI
  simp only [Lagrange.interpolate_apply, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, Polynomial.eval_C_mul,
    Lagrange.basis.eq_1, Polynomial.eval_prod, Lagrange.basisDivisor.eq_1, Polynomial.eval_sub,
    Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_X_pow, one_pow] at hE
  refine Eq.trans ?_ hE.symm
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
  rw [mul_comm]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  have e : -(2:ℝ) ^ k - -(2:ℝ) ^ i = (2:ℝ) ^ i - (2:ℝ) ^ k := by ring
  rw [e, div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring
