signature.name: seeley_coeffs_exist
signature.statement: (∀ N j : ℕ, j ≤ N → ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (∏ i ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)).erase k, (1 + (2:ℝ) ^ i) / ((2:ℝ) ^ i - (2:ℝ) ^ k)) * (-(2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j = 1) → ∃ c : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ j : ℕ, Summable (fun k : ℕ => |c k| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j)) ∧ (∀ j : ℕ, ∑' k : ℕ, c k * (-(2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j = 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro hyp
  
  have key : ∀ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a → 2 * a ≤ b → b ≤ 3 * a * b - 4 * a ^ 2 := by
    intro a b ha hb
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hb) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 3 * a - 1),
      mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * a) (sub_nonneg.2 ha)]
  have ineq1 : ∀ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a → 2 * a ≤ b → (1 + a) / (b - a) ≤ 4 * a / b := by
    intro a b ha hb
    have hb0 : 0 < b := by linarith
    have hd : 0 < b - a := by linarith
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hd hb0]
    nlinarith [key a b ha hb]
  have ineq2 : ∀ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a → 2 * a ≤ b → (1 + b) / (b - a) ≤ 1 + 4 * a / b := by
    intro a b ha hb
    have hb0 : 0 < b := by linarith
    have hd : 0 < b - a := by linarith
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hd]
    have e : (1 + 4 * a / b) * (b - a) = (b - a) + 4 * a - 4 * a ^ 2 / b := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [e]
    have h2 : 4 * a ^ 2 / b ≤ 3 * a - 1 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hb0]
      nlinarith [key a b ha hb]
    linarith
  
  have split : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ) (N k : ℕ), k ≤ N → ∏ i ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)).erase k, f i =
      (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, f i) * ∏ i ∈ Finset.Ico (k + 1) (N + 1), f i := by
    intro f N k hk
    have hset : (Finset.range (N + 1)).erase k = Finset.range k ∪ Finset.Ico (k + 1) (N + 1) := by
      ext i
      simp only [Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_Ico]
      omega
    rw [hset, Finset.prod_union]
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro i h1 h2
    simp only [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_Ico] at h1 h2
    omega
  
  have head_fac : ∀ k i : ℕ, i < k →
      |(1 + (2:ℝ) ^ i) / ((2:ℝ) ^ i - (2:ℝ) ^ k)| ≤ 4 * (2:ℝ) ^ i / (2:ℝ) ^ k := by
    intro k i hik
    have ha : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ i := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    have hb : 2 * (2:ℝ) ^ i ≤ 2 ^ k := by
      have : (2:ℝ) ^ (i + 1) ≤ 2 ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hik
      rw [pow_succ] at this
      linarith
    have hden : (2:ℝ) ^ i - 2 ^ k < 0 := by linarith
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 1 + 2 ^ i), abs_of_neg hden, neg_sub]
    exact ineq1 _ _ ha hb
  have tail_fac : ∀ k i : ℕ, k < i →
      1 ≤ (1 + (2:ℝ) ^ i) / ((2:ℝ) ^ i - (2:ℝ) ^ k) ∧
      (1 + (2:ℝ) ^ i) / ((2:ℝ) ^ i - (2:ℝ) ^ k) ≤ 1 + 4 * (2:ℝ) ^ k / (2:ℝ) ^ i := by
    intro k i hki
    have ha : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ k := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    have hb : 2 * (2:ℝ) ^ k ≤ 2 ^ i := by
      have : (2:ℝ) ^ (k + 1) ≤ 2 ^ i := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hki
      rw [pow_succ] at this
      linarith
    have hden : (0:ℝ) < 2 ^ i - 2 ^ k := by linarith
    refine ⟨?_, ineq2 _ _ ha hb⟩
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hden]
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℕ → ℝ, A = fun k =>
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (1 + (2:ℝ) ^ i) / ((2:ℝ) ^ i - (2:ℝ) ^ k) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℕ → ℝ, E = fun k =>
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (4 * (2:ℝ) ^ i / (2:ℝ) ^ k) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hE0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ E k := by
    intro k
    rw [hE]
    exact Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)
  have hAE : ∀ k, |A k| ≤ E k := by
    intro k
    simp only [hA, hE]
    rw [Finset.abs_prod]
    exact Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (fun i hi => head_fac k i (Finset.mem_range.1 hi))
  have hErec : ∀ k, E (k + 1) = 2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k * E k := by
    intro k
    simp only [hE]
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]
    have h1 : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range k, 4 * (2:ℝ) ^ i / 2 ^ (k + 1) = (1 / 2) * (4 * 2 ^ i / 2 ^ k) := by
      intro i _
      rw [pow_succ]
      field_simp
    rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl h1, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_range]
    have h2 : 4 * (2:ℝ) ^ k / 2 ^ (k + 1) = 2 := by
      rw [pow_succ]
      field_simp
      norm_num
    rw [h2]
    ring
  have head_sum : ∀ j : ℕ, Summable (fun k => |A k| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j) := by
    intro j
    have hg : Summable (fun k => E k * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j) := by
      refine summable_of_ratio_norm_eventually_le (r := 1 / 2) (by norm_num) ?_
      filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (j + 2)] with k hk
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hE0 _) (by positivity)),
        Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hE0 _) (by positivity)), hErec]
      have h1 : (2:ℝ) ^ (j + 1) * (1 / 2) ^ k ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        have : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ (1 / 2) ^ (j + 2) :=
          pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hk
        calc (2:ℝ) ^ (j + 1) * (1 / 2) ^ k ≤ 2 ^ (j + 1) * (1 / 2) ^ (j + 2) := by gcongr
          _ = 1 / 2 := by
            rw [pow_succ (1 / 2 : ℝ) (j + 1), ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow]
            norm_num
      have h2 : 0 ≤ E k * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j := mul_nonneg (hE0 _) (by positivity)
      calc 2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k * E k * ((2:ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) ^ j
          = ((2:ℝ) ^ (j + 1) * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (E k * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j) := by
            rw [pow_succ (2:ℝ) k, mul_pow, pow_succ (2:ℝ) j]
            ring
        _ ≤ 1 / 2 * (E k * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 h2
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => by positivity) (fun k => ?_) hg
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hAE k) (by positivity)
  
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ B : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ, B = fun N k =>
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.Ico (k + 1) (N + 1), (1 + (2:ℝ) ^ i) / ((2:ℝ) ^ i - (2:ℝ) ^ k) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hB1 : ∀ N k, 1 ≤ B N k := by
    intro N k
    simp only [hB]
    calc (1:ℝ) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.Ico (k + 1) (N + 1), (1:ℝ) := by simp
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun _ _ => zero_le_one)
          (fun i hi => (tail_fac k i (by rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hi; omega)).1)
  have hBexp : ∀ N k, B N k ≤ Real.exp 4 := by
    intro N k
    simp only [hB]
    calc _ ≤ ∏ i ∈ Finset.Ico (k + 1) (N + 1), Real.exp (4 * (2:ℝ) ^ k / 2 ^ i) :=
          Finset.prod_le_prod₀
            (fun i hi => by
              have := (tail_fac k i (by rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hi; omega)).1
              linarith)
            (fun i hi => (tail_fac k i (by rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hi; omega)).2.trans
              (by
                have := Real.add_one_le_exp (4 * (2:ℝ) ^ k / 2 ^ i)
                linarith))
      _ = Real.exp (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico (k + 1) (N + 1), 4 * (2:ℝ) ^ k / 2 ^ i) := (Real.exp_sum _ _).symm
      _ ≤ Real.exp 4 := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
        rw [Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sum_range]
        have h3 : ∀ l ∈ Finset.range (N + 1 - (k + 1)),
            4 * (2:ℝ) ^ k / 2 ^ (k + 1 + l) = 2 * (1 / 2) ^ l := by
          intro l _
          rw [pow_add, pow_add]
          field_simp
          rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_pow]
          norm_num
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h3, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        linarith [sum_geometric_two_le (N + 1 - (k + 1))]
  have hBmono : ∀ k, Monotone (fun N => B N k) := by
    intro k
    apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
    intro N
    show B N k ≤ B (N + 1) k
    by_cases hkN : k ≤ N
    · have e : B (N + 1) k = B N k * ((1 + (2:ℝ) ^ (N + 1)) / ((2:ℝ) ^ (N + 1) - (2:ℝ) ^ k)) := by
        simp only [hB]
        exact Finset.prod_Ico_succ_top (by omega) _
      rw [e]
      have h1 := hB1 N k
      have h2 := (tail_fac k (N + 1) (by omega)).1
      nlinarith
    · have e : B N k = 1 := by
        simp only [hB]
        rw [Finset.Ico_eq_empty_of_le (by omega), Finset.prod_empty]
      rw [e]
      exact hB1 (N + 1) k
  have hBdd : ∀ k, BddAbove (Set.range (fun N => B N k)) := by
    intro k
    refine ⟨Real.exp 4, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨N, rfl⟩
    exact hBexp N k
  have hlim : ∀ k, Filter.Tendsto (fun N => B N k) Filter.atTop (nhds (⨆ N, B N k)) :=
    fun k => tendsto_atTop_ciSup (hBmono k) (hBdd k)
  have hβ : ∀ k, |⨆ N, B N k| ≤ Real.exp 4 := by
    intro k
    have h1 : 1 ≤ ⨆ N, B N k := (hB1 0 k).trans (le_ciSup (hBdd k) 0)
    have h2 : (⨆ N, B N k) ≤ Real.exp 4 := ciSup_le (fun N => hBexp N k)
    rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
    exact h2
  
  refine ⟨fun k => A k * ⨆ N, B N k, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => by positivity) (fun k => ?_)
      ((head_sum j).mul_left (Real.exp 4))
    show |A k * ⨆ N, B N k| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j ≤ Real.exp 4 * (|A k| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j)
    rw [abs_mul]
    calc |A k| * |⨆ N, B N k| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j ≤ |A k| * Real.exp 4 * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j := by
          gcongr
          exact hβ k
      _ = Real.exp 4 * (|A k| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j) := by ring
  · intro j
    obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ, F = fun N k =>
        if k ≤ N then A k * B N k * (-(2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j else 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hconv : Filter.Tendsto (fun N => ∑' k, F N k) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (∑' k, A k * (⨆ N, B N k) * (-(2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j)) := by
      refine tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence
        (bound := fun k => Real.exp 4 * (|A k| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j)) ((head_sum j).mul_left _) ?_ ?_
      · intro k
        have h : Filter.Tendsto (fun N => A k * B N k * (-(2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (A k * (⨆ N, B N k) * (-(2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j)) :=
          ((hlim k).const_mul (A k)).mul_const _
        refine h.congr' ?_
        filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop k] with N hN
        simp only [hF, if_pos hN]
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun N k => ?_)
        simp only [hF]
        split_ifs with hkN
        · have hBpos : 0 < B N k := by linarith [hB1 N k]
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg,
            abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 2 ^ k), abs_of_pos hBpos]
          calc |A k| * B N k * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j ≤ |A k| * Real.exp 4 * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j := by
                gcongr
                exact hBexp N k
            _ = Real.exp 4 * (|A k| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j) := by ring
        · rw [norm_zero]
          positivity
    have hone : (fun N => ∑' k, F N k) =ᶠ[Filter.atTop] (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) := by
      filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop j] with N hN
      rw [tsum_eq_sum (s := Finset.range (N + 1))]
      · refine (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k hk => ?_)).trans (hyp N j hN)
        have hkN : k ≤ N := by
          simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hk
          omega
        simp only [hF, if_pos hkN, hA, hB]
        rw [split _ N k hkN]
      · intro k hk
        have hkN : ¬ k ≤ N := by
          simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hk
          omega
        simp only [hF, if_neg hkN]
    have hfin := tendsto_nhds_unique hconv (tendsto_const_nhds.congr' hone.symm)
    exact hfin

signature.name: seeley_multilinear_reflect
signature.statement: ∀ (c : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ j : ℕ, Summable (fun k : ℕ => |c k| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j)) → (∀ j : ℕ, ∑' k : ℕ, c k * (-(2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j = 1) → ∀ (m : ℕ) (M : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ), HasSum (fun k : ℕ => c k • M.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ : Fin m => ContinuousLinearMap.prodMap ((-(2:ℝ) ^ k) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))) M

proof.tactics:
by
  intro c hS hI m M
  have hexp : ∀ (t : ℝ) (v : Fin m → ℝ × ℝ),
      M (fun i => ContinuousLinearMap.prodMap (t • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) (v i)) =
      ∑ s : Finset (Fin m), t ^ s.card *
        M (s.piecewise (fun i => ((v i).1, (0:ℝ))) (fun i => ((0:ℝ), (v i).2))) := by
    intro t v
    have ha : (fun i => ContinuousLinearMap.prodMap (t • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) (v i)) =
        (fun i => t • ((v i).1, (0:ℝ))) + (fun i => ((0:ℝ), (v i).2)) := by
      funext i
      ext <;> simp [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
    rw [ha, M.map_add_univ]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun s _ => ?_)
    have hc : s.piecewise (fun i => t • ((v i).1, (0:ℝ))) (fun i => ((0:ℝ), (v i).2)) =
        s.piecewise (fun i => t • (s.piecewise (fun i => ((v i).1, (0:ℝ)))
          (fun i => ((0:ℝ), (v i).2))) i)
          (s.piecewise (fun i => ((v i).1, (0:ℝ))) (fun i => ((0:ℝ), (v i).2))) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : i ∈ s
      · simp [Finset.piecewise_eq_of_mem _ _ _ hi]
      · simp [Finset.piecewise_eq_of_notMem _ _ _ hi]
    rw [hc, M.map_piecewise_smul]
    simp [Finset.prod_const, smul_eq_mul]
  have hnorm : ∀ k : ℕ, ‖ContinuousLinearMap.prodMap ((-(2:ℝ) ^ k) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)‖ ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ k := by
    intro k
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity) (fun q => ?_)
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := q
    have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ k := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap', Prod.map, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, smul_eq_mul, Prod.norm_def, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 2 ^ k)]
    have hμ : 0 ≤ max |a| |b| := le_trans (abs_nonneg a) (le_max_left _ _)
    refine max_le ?_ ?_
    · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left _ _) (by positivity)
    · calc |b| ≤ max |a| |b| := le_max_right _ _
        _ = 1 * max |a| |b| := (one_mul _).symm
        _ ≤ 2 ^ k * max |a| |b| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hμ
  have hbound : ∀ k, ‖c k • M.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ : Fin m =>
      ContinuousLinearMap.prodMap ((-(2:ℝ) ^ k) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖ ≤ ‖M‖ * (|c k| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ m) := by
    intro k
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have h1 := M.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le (fun _ : Fin m =>
      ContinuousLinearMap.prodMap ((-(2:ℝ) ^ k) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))
    rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h1
    have h2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hnorm k) m
    have h3 := h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (norm_nonneg M))
    calc |c k| * _ ≤ |c k| * (‖M‖ * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ m) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖M‖ * (|c k| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ m) := by ring
  have hsum := Summable.of_norm_bounded ((hS m).mul_left ‖M‖) hbound
  have hT := hsum.hasSum
  suffices h : (∑' k, c k • M.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ : Fin m =>
      ContinuousLinearMap.prodMap ((-(2:ℝ) ^ k) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))) = M by
    rw [h] at hT; exact hT
  ext v
  have hev := ContinuousMultilinearMap.hasSum_eval hT v
  have hscal : ∀ j : ℕ, HasSum (fun k => c k * (-(2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j) 1 := by
    intro j
    have hs : Summable (fun k => c k * (-(2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ j) := by
      refine Summable.of_norm_bounded (hS j) (fun k => le_of_eq ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg,
        abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 2 ^ k)]
    have := hs.hasSum
    rwa [hI j] at this
  have hfin : HasSum (fun k => ∑ s : Finset (Fin m), c k * (-(2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ s.card *
      M (s.piecewise (fun i => ((v i).1, (0:ℝ))) (fun i => ((0:ℝ), (v i).2))))
      (∑ s : Finset (Fin m), 1 *
        M (s.piecewise (fun i => ((v i).1, (0:ℝ))) (fun i => ((0:ℝ), (v i).2)))) :=
    hasSum_sum (fun s _ => (hscal s.card).mul_right _)
  have hMv : (∑ s : Finset (Fin m), 1 *
      M (s.piecewise (fun i => ((v i).1, (0:ℝ))) (fun i => ((0:ℝ), (v i).2)))) = M v := by
    have h1 := hexp 1 v
    simp only [one_pow] at h1
    rw [← h1]
    congr 1
    funext i
    ext <;> simp [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
  rw [hMv] at hfin
  have hfin' : HasSum (fun k => (c k • M.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ : Fin m =>
      ContinuousLinearMap.prodMap ((-(2:ℝ) ^ k) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))) v) (M v) := by
    convert hfin using 1
    funext k
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, hexp, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun s _ => by ring)
  exact hev.unique hfin'

by
  intro f a ha hf hbd

    ⟨_, rfl⟩

    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Real.smoothTransition := Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := ⊤)
    rw [hχdef]
    exact h1.comp ((contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id).div_const _)

    intro X hX
    rw [hχdef]
    apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
    rw [le_div_iff₀ ha4]; linarith
  have hχ0 : ∀ X : ℝ, a / 2 ≤ X → χ X = 0 := by
    intro X hX
    rw [hχdef]
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) ha4.le
  obtain ⟨H, hHdef⟩ : ∃ H : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, H = fun q => χ q.1 * f q.1 q.2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hHq : ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ, H q = χ q.1 * f q.1 q.2 := fun q => by rw [hHdef]
  have hO : IsOpen (Ioo 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hfO : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioo 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
    hf.mono (prod_mono Ioo_subset_Ico_self subset_rfl)
  have hχfst : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => χ q.1) := hχ.comp contDiff_fst
  have hHO : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H (Ioo 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    rw [hHdef]
    exact hχfst.contDiffOn.mul hfO
  have hΩ : IsOpen {q : ℝ × ℝ | a / 2 < q.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst
  have hHΩ : ∀ q ∈ {q : ℝ × ℝ | a / 2 < q.1}, H q = 0 := by
    intro q hq
    rw [hHq, hχ0 q.1 (le_of_lt hq), zero_mul]
  have hzero : ∀ (m : ℕ) (p : ℝ × ℝ), a / 2 < p.1 → iteratedFDeriv ℝ m H p = 0 := by
    intro m p hp
    have hev : H =ᶠ[nhds p] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hΩ.mem_nhds hp) hHΩ
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
    rfl
  refine ⟨H, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    intro p hp
    by_cases hpa : p.1 < a
    · exact ⟨_, hO, ⟨⟨hp.1, hpa⟩, hp.2⟩, hHO.mono inter_subset_right⟩
    · refine ⟨_, hΩ, show a / 2 < p.1 by linarith [not_lt.mp hpa], ?_⟩
      exact (contDiffOn_const (c := (0:ℝ))).congr (fun q hq => hHΩ q hq.2)
  · 
    intro p hp
    rw [hHq, hχ0 p.1 hp, zero_mul]
  · 
    intro m
    obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : Set (ℝ × ℝ), S = Ioo 0 (3 * a / 4) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hSO : S ⊆ Ioo 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := by
      rw [hS]; exact prod_mono (Ioo_subset_Ioo_right (by linarith)) subset_rfl
    have hbχ : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => χ q.1) z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro k
      have hc : Continuous (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => χ q.1)) :=
        hχfst.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc :
        IsCompact (Icc (0:ℝ) a ×ˢ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hc.continuousOn
      refine ⟨C, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      rw [hS] at hz
      exact hC z ⟨⟨hz.1.1.le, by linarith [hz.1.2]⟩, hz.2.1.le, hz.2.2.le⟩
    have hbf : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿f) z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbd (3 * a / 4) (by linarith) k
      refine ⟨C, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      rw [hS] at hz
      exact hC z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2.le hz.2.1 hz.2.2
    choose Cχ hCχ using hbχ
    choose Cf hCf using hbf
    have hHeq : H = fun y : ℝ × ℝ => χ y.1 * (↿f) y := by rw [hHdef]; rfl
    have hK₁ : ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m H z‖ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) * Cχ i * Cf (m - i) := by
      intro z hz
      have hzO := hSO hz
      rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hO hzO, hHeq]
      refine (norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hχfst.contDiffOn hfO hO.uniqueDiffOn hzO
        (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).trans ?_
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO hzO, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (m - i) hO hzO]
      have h1 := hCχ i z hz
      have h2 := hCf (m - i) z hz
      exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) h2 (norm_nonneg _)
        (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) ((norm_nonneg _).trans h1))
    refine ⟨max (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) * Cχ i * Cf (m - i)) 0,
      fun p hp => ?_⟩
    by_cases hp3 : p.1 < 3 * a / 4
    · have hpS : p ∈ S := by rw [hS]; exact ⟨⟨hp.1, hp3⟩, hp.2⟩
      exact (hK₁ p hpS).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · rw [hzero m p (by linarith [not_lt.mp hp3]), norm_zero]
      exact le_max_right _ _
  · 
    intro η₀ h1 h2 m
    have hU : UniqueDiffOn ℝ (Ico 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
      (uniqueDiffOn_Ico 0 a).prod (uniqueDiffOn_Ioo (-1) 1)
    have hx₀ : ((0:ℝ), η₀) ∈ Ico 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨⟨le_rfl, ha⟩, h1, h2⟩
    have hcont := (hf.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (m := m)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hU) _ hx₀
    have hW : IsOpen {q : ℝ × ℝ | q.1 < a / 4} := isOpen_lt continuous_fst continuous_const
    have hV : Ioo 0 (a / 4) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ∈
        nhdsWithin ((0:ℝ), η₀) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
      refine Filter.mem_of_superset
        (inter_mem_nhdsWithin _ (hW.mem_nhds (show (0:ℝ) < a / 4 from ha4))) ?_
      rintro q ⟨⟨hq1, hq2⟩, hq3⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hq1, hq3⟩, hq2⟩
    have hVR : Ioo 0 (a / 4) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ico 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
      prod_mono (fun x hx => ⟨hx.1.le, by linarith [hx.2]⟩) subset_rfl
    have hle : nhdsWithin ((0:ℝ), η₀) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ≤
        nhdsWithin ((0:ℝ), η₀) (Ico 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
      (nhdsWithin_le_of_mem hV).trans (nhdsWithin_mono _ hVR)
    refine (hcont.tendsto.mono_left hle).congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [hV] with q hq
    have hqO : q ∈ Ioo 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨⟨hq.1.1, by linarith [hq.1.2]⟩, hq.2⟩
    have hRq : Ico 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ∈ nhds q :=
      Filter.mem_of_superset (hO.mem_nhds hqO) (prod_mono Ioo_subset_Ico_self subset_rfl)
    have hca : ContDiffAt ℝ m (↿f) q := (hf.contDiffAt hRq).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_iteratedFDeriv hU hca (hVR hq)]
    have hev : H =ᶠ[nhds q] (↿f) := by
      filter_upwards [hW.mem_nhds (show q.1 < a / 4 from hq.1.2)] with r hr
      rw [hHq, hχ1 r.1 (le_of_lt hr), one_mul]
      rfl
    exact ((hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds).symm

by

  have hNo : IsOpen (Iio (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Iio.prod isOpen_Ioo

    intro k q

    intro k

    · rintro ⟨h1, h3⟩

    · rintro ⟨h1, h3⟩

      exact hp
    have key := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right
      (ContinuousLinearMap.prodMap ((-(2:ℝ) ^ k) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)) hHs hPo.uniqueDiffOn
      (by rw [hpre k]; exact hNo.uniqueDiffOn) hLp (i := m) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [hpre k] at key
    rw [key, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hPo hLp, hL]
  have htail : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, p.1 < 0 → ∃ K : ℕ,
      (∀ k : ℕ, K ≤ k → ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ, q.1 < p.1 / 2 → H (-(2:ℝ) ^ k * q.1, q.2) = 0) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, K ≤ k → ∀ m : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m H (-(2:ℝ) ^ k * p.1, p.2) = 0) := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := pow_unbounded_of_one_lt (2 * b / (-p.1)) (one_lt_two : (1:ℝ) < 2)
    have hd : 0 < -p.1 := by linarith
    have hK' : b < 2 ^ K * (-p.1) / 2 := by
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hd] at hK
      linarith
    have hpos : (0:ℝ) < 2 ^ K := by positivity
    refine ⟨K, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k hk q hq
      apply hHv
      have hkK : (2:ℝ) ^ K ≤ 2 ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ one_le_two hk
      have hpk : (0:ℝ) < 2 ^ k := by positivity
      show b ≤ -(2:ℝ) ^ k * q.1
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hkK) hd.le, mul_pos hpk (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < p.1 / 2 - q.1)]
    · intro k hk m
      have hkK : (2:ℝ) ^ K ≤ 2 ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ one_le_two hk
      have hr : b < -(2:ℝ) ^ k * p.1 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hkK) hd.le, mul_pos hpos hd]
      have hev : H =ᶠ[nhds ((-(2:ℝ) ^ k * p.1, p.2) : ℝ × ℝ)] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).mem_nhds
          (show ((-(2:ℝ) ^ k * p.1, p.2) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ {r : ℝ × ℝ | b < r.1} from hr)] with r hr'
        exact hHv r (le_of_lt hr')
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
      rfl
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨K, hK1, -⟩ := htail p hp.1
    have hp1 : p.1 < 0 := hp.1
    refine ⟨{q : ℝ × ℝ | q.1 < p.1 / 2}, isOpen_lt continuous_fst continuous_const,
      show p.1 < p.1 / 2 by linarith, ?_⟩
    have hsum : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, c k * H (-(2:ℝ) ^ k * q.1, q.2))
        (Iio (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
      ContDiffOn.sum (fun k _ => hT k)
    refine (hsum.mono inter_subset_left).congr ?_
    intro q hq
    exact tsum_eq_sum (fun k hk => by rw [hK1 k (by simpa using hk) q hq.2, mul_zero])
  · intro m p hp
    obtain ⟨K, hK1, hK2⟩ := htail p hp.1
    have hp1 : p.1 < 0 := hp.1
    have hev : (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∑' k : ℕ, c k * H (-(2:ℝ) ^ k * q.1, q.2)) =ᶠ[nhds p]
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => c k * H (-(2:ℝ) ^ k * q.1, q.2)) := by
      filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt continuous_fst continuous_const).mem_nhds
        (show p ∈ {q : ℝ × ℝ | q.1 < p.1 / 2} from show p.1 < p.1 / 2 by linarith)] with q hq
      rw [Finset.sum_apply]
      exact tsum_eq_sum (fun k hk => by rw [hK1 k (by simpa using hk) q hq, mul_zero])
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_sum_apply
      (fun k _ => ((hT k).contDiffAt (hNo.mem_nhds hp)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
    rw [tsum_eq_sum (s := Finset.range K) (fun k hk => by
      rw [hK2 k (by simpa using hk) m]
      ext v
      simp)]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => hTd k m p hp)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (H : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (K η₀ : ℝ) (J : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ), Summable (fun k : ℕ => |c k| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ m) → (∀ p ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m H p‖ ≤ K) → Filter.Tendsto (fun p => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m H p) (nhdsWithin ((0:ℝ), η₀) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) (nhds J) → Filter.Tendsto (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∑' k : ℕ, c k • (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m H (-(2:ℝ) ^ k * p.1, p.2)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ : Fin m => ContinuousLinearMap.prodMap ((-(2:ℝ) ^ k) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))) (nhdsWithin ((0:ℝ), η₀) (Iio 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) (nhds (∑' k : ℕ, c k • J.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ : Fin m => ContinuousLinearMap.prodMap ((-(2:ℝ) ^ k) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))))

signature.name: seeley_series_boundary_limit
signature.statement: ∀ (H : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (K η₀ : ℝ) (J : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ), Summable (fun k : ℕ => |c k| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ m) → (∀ p ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m H p‖ ≤ K) → Filter.Tendsto (fun p => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m H p) (nhdsWithin ((0:ℝ), η₀) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) (nhds J) → Filter.Tendsto (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∑' k : ℕ, c k • (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m H (-(2:ℝ) ^ k * p.1, p.2)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ : Fin m => ContinuousLinearMap.prodMap ((-(2:ℝ) ^ k) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))) (nhdsWithin ((0:ℝ), η₀) (Iio 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) (nhds (∑' k : ℕ, c k • J.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ : Fin m => ContinuousLinearMap.prodMap ((-(2:ℝ) ^ k) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro H c m K η₀ J hsum hK hJ
  let L : ℕ → (ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ) := fun k =>
    ContinuousLinearMap.prodMap ((-(2:ℝ) ^ k) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)
  have hL : ∀ k (q : ℝ × ℝ), L k q = (-(2:ℝ) ^ k * q.1, q.2) := by
    intro k q
    simp [L, smul_eq_mul, Prod.map]
  have hLnorm : ∀ k, ‖L k‖ ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ k := by
    intro k
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity) (fun q => ?_)
    rw [hL, Prod.norm_def, Prod.norm_def]
    have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ k := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    have hq : 0 ≤ max ‖q.1‖ ‖q.2‖ := le_max_of_le_left (norm_nonneg _)
    apply max_le
    · have e : ‖-(2:ℝ) ^ k * q.1‖ = 2 ^ k * ‖q.1‖ := by
        rw [norm_mul, norm_neg, norm_pow, Real.norm_ofNat]
      rw [e]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left _ _) (by positivity)
    · calc ‖q.2‖ ≤ max ‖q.1‖ ‖q.2‖ := le_max_right _ _
        _ = 1 * max ‖q.1‖ ‖q.2‖ := (one_mul _).symm
        _ ≤ 2 ^ k * max ‖q.1‖ ‖q.2‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hq
  have hmaps : ∀ k, ∀ p ∈ (Iio (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1), L k p ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := by
    intro k p hp
    rw [hL]
    refine ⟨?_, hp.2⟩
    have hp1 : p.1 < 0 := hp.1
    have h2 : (0:ℝ) < 2 ^ k := by positivity
    show 0 < -(2:ℝ) ^ k * p.1
    nlinarith
  have hfix : ∀ k, L k ((0:ℝ), η₀) = ((0:ℝ), η₀) := by
    intro k
    rw [hL]
    simp
  have main : Filter.Tendsto (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∑' k : ℕ,
      c k • (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m H (L k p)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ : Fin m => L k))
      (nhdsWithin ((0:ℝ), η₀) (Iio 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1))
      (nhds (∑' k : ℕ, c k • J.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ : Fin m => L k))) := by
    refine tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence
      (bound := fun k => |c k| * |K| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ m) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact (hsum.mul_right |K|).congr (fun k => by ring)
    · intro k
      have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (L k) (nhdsWithin ((0:ℝ), η₀) (Iio 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1))
          (nhdsWithin ((0:ℝ), η₀) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) := by
        apply tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within
        · have := (L k).continuous.tendsto ((0:ℝ), η₀)
          rw [hfix] at this
          exact this.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
        · exact eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall (hmaps k)
      have h2 := hJ.comp h1
      have h3 := ((ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMapL
        (fun _ : Fin m => L k) : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ →L[ℝ]
          ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ).continuous.tendsto J).comp h2
      exact h3.const_smul (c k)
    · refine eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall (fun p hp k => ?_)
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have hA := hK _ (hmaps k p hp)
      have hB := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m H (L k p)) (fun _ : Fin m => L k)
      have hC : ∏ _i : Fin m, ‖L k‖ ≤ ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ m := by
        rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hLnorm k) m
      have hK' : K ≤ |K| := le_abs_self K
      calc |c k| * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ m H (L k p)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ : Fin m => L k)‖
          ≤ |c k| * (‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m H (L k p)‖ * ∏ _i : Fin m, ‖L k‖) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB (abs_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ |c k| * (|K| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ m) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (abs_nonneg _)
            exact mul_le_mul (hA.trans hK') hC
              (Finset.prod_nonneg fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = |c k| * |K| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ m := by ring
  refine main.congr (fun p => tsum_congr (fun k => ?_))
  rw [hL]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (a : ℝ) (u w : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), 0 < a → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u (Ico 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w (Ioo (-1) 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ∀ m : ℕ, Filter.Tendsto (fun p => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w p) (nhdsWithin ((0:ℝ), η) (Ioo (-1) 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) (nhds (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m u (Ico 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ((0:ℝ), η)))) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => if 0 ≤ p.1 then u p else w p) (Ioo (-1) a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)

signature.name: contDiffOn_glue_halfstrip
signature.statement: ∀ (a : ℝ) (u w : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), 0 < a → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u (Ico 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w (Ioo (-1) 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ∀ m : ℕ, Filter.Tendsto (fun p => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w p) (nhdsWithin ((0:ℝ), η) (Ioo (-1) 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) (nhds (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m u (Ico 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ((0:ℝ), η)))) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => if 0 ≤ p.1 then u p else w p) (Ioo (-1) a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro a u w ha hu hw hlim
  have hRu : UniqueDiffOn ℝ (Ico 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
    (uniqueDiffOn_Ico 0 a).prod isOpen_Ioo.uniqueDiffOn
  have hLo : IsOpen (Ioo (-1:ℝ) 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hTo : IsOpen (Ioo (-1:ℝ) a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hPu := hu.ftaylorSeriesWithin hRu
  have hRn : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (-1:ℝ) a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, 0 < x.1 → Ico 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ∈ nhds x := by
    intro x hx h0
    apply Filter.mem_of_superset
      ((isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo : IsOpen (Ioo 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)).mem_nhds ⟨⟨h0, hx.1.2⟩, hx.2⟩)
    exact prod_mono Ioo_subset_Ico_self subset_rfl
  have hBR : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      Ioc (-1:ℝ) 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ∪ Ico 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ∈ nhds ((0:ℝ), η) := by
    intro η h1 h2
    apply Filter.mem_of_superset (hTo.mem_nhds ⟨⟨by norm_num, ha⟩, h1, h2⟩)
    intro y hy
    rcases le_or_gt 0 y.1 with h | h
    · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨h, hy.1.2⟩, hy.2⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨hy.1.1, h.le⟩, hy.2⟩
  have s4 : ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : ℝ × ℝ), y ∈ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
      HasFDerivAt (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w) ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m+1) w y).curryLeft) y := by
    intro m y hy
    have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ w y := hw.contDiffAt (hLo.mem_nhds hy)
    have hd := hc.differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv (m := m)
      (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.2 (ENat.natCast_lt_top m))
    have := hd.hasFDerivAt
    rw [fderiv_iteratedFDeriv] at this
    exact this
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ × ℝ → FormalMultilinearSeries ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) ℝ,
      P = fun x m => if 0 ≤ x.1 then iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m u (Ico 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) x
        else iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have c1 : ∀ y ∈ Ico 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, ∀ m : ℕ,
      P y m = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m u (Ico 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) y := by
    intro y hy m; rw [hP]; exact if_pos hy.1.1
  have c2 : ∀ y ∈ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, ∀ m : ℕ, P y m = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w y := by
    intro y hy m; rw [hP]; exact if_neg (not_le.2 hy.1.2)
  have c3 : ∀ η : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ,
      P ((0:ℝ), η) m = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m u (Ico 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ((0:ℝ), η) := by
    intro η m; rw [hP]; exact if_pos le_rfl
  have hd : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
      HasFDerivAt (fun x => P x m) ((P y (m+1)).curryLeft) y := by
    intro m y hy
    rw [c2 y hy (m+1)]
    apply (s4 m y hy).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [hLo.mem_nhds hy] with x hx
    exact c2 x hx m
  have he : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ∀ m : ℕ,
      ContinuousWithinAt (fun x => P x m) (Ioo (-1:ℝ) 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) ((0:ℝ), η) := by
    intro η h1 h2 m
    show Filter.Tendsto (fun x => P x m) _ (nhds (P ((0:ℝ), η) m))
    rw [c3 η m]
    exact tendsto_nhdsWithin_congr (fun x hx => (c2 x hx m).symm) (hlim η h1 h2 m)
  have hedge : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      HasFDerivWithinAt (fun x => P x m) ((P ((0:ℝ), η) (m+1)).curryLeft)
        (Ioc (-1:ℝ) 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) ((0:ℝ), η) := by
    intro m η h1 h2
    obtain ⟨lo, hlo⟩ : ∃ lo : ℝ, lo = (η - 1) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨hi, hhi⟩ : ∃ hi : ℝ, hi = (η + 1) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hsL : Ioo (-1/2:ℝ) 0 ×ˢ Ioo lo hi ⊆ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
      prod_mono (Ioo_subset_Ioo_left (by norm_num)) (Ioo_subset_Ioo (by linarith) (by linarith))
    have hcl : closure (Ioo (-1/2:ℝ) 0 ×ˢ Ioo lo hi) = Icc (-1/2:ℝ) 0 ×ˢ Icc lo hi := by
      rw [closure_prod_eq, closure_Ioo (by norm_num), closure_Ioo (ne_of_lt (by linarith))]
    have hclB : closure (Ioo (-1/2:ℝ) 0 ×ˢ Ioo lo hi) ⊆ Ioc (-1:ℝ) 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := by
      rw [hcl]
      rintro y ⟨⟨a1, a2⟩, b1, b2⟩
      exact ⟨⟨by linarith, a2⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun x => P x m) (Ioo (-1/2:ℝ) 0 ×ˢ Ioo lo hi) :=
      fun y hy => (hd m y (hsL hy)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have hcont : ∀ y ∈ closure (Ioo (-1/2:ℝ) 0 ×ˢ Ioo lo hi),
        ContinuousWithinAt (fun x => P x m) (Ioo (-1/2:ℝ) 0 ×ˢ Ioo lo hi) y := by
      intro y hy
      apply ContinuousWithinAt.mono _ hsL
      have hyB := hclB hy
      rcases hyB.1.2.lt_or_eq with h | h
      · exact (hd m y ⟨⟨hyB.1.1, h⟩, hyB.2⟩).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      · have hy' : y = ((0:ℝ), y.2) := Prod.ext h rfl
        rw [hy']
        exact he y.2 hyB.2.1 hyB.2.2 m
    have htend : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun x => P x m) y)
        (nhdsWithin ((0:ℝ), η) (Ioo (-1/2:ℝ) 0 ×ˢ Ioo lo hi))
        (nhds ((P ((0:ℝ), η) (m+1)).curryLeft)) := by
      have h0 := ((continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (m+1) => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ).continuous.tendsto
        _).comp (hlim η h1 h2 (m+1))
      rw [c3 η (m+1)]
      refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_congr ?_ (h0.mono_left (nhdsWithin_mono _ hsL))
      intro y hy
      rw [(hd m y (hsL hy)).fderiv, c2 y (hsL hy) (m+1)]
      rfl
    have key := hasFDerivWithinAt_closure_of_tendsto_fderiv hdiff
      ((convex_Ioo _ _).prod (convex_Ioo _ _)) (isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo) hcont htend
    apply key.mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin
    rw [mem_nhdsWithin]
    refine ⟨Ioo (-1/2:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Ioo lo hi, isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo,
      ⟨⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro y ⟨⟨⟨a1, a2⟩, b1, b2⟩, ⟨d1, d2⟩, e1, e2⟩
    rw [hcl]
    exact ⟨⟨a1.le, d2⟩, b1.le, b2.le⟩
  have hderiv : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ Ioo (-1:ℝ) a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
      HasFDerivAt (fun x => P x m) ((P x (m+1)).curryLeft) x := by
    intro m x hx
    have hRd : ∀ y ∈ Ico 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
        HasFDerivWithinAt (fun x => P x m) ((P y (m+1)).curryLeft) (Ico 0 a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) y := by
      intro y hy
      rw [c1 y hy (m+1)]
      have := hPu.fderivWithin m (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.2 (ENat.natCast_lt_top m)) y hy
      exact this.congr (fun z hz => c1 z hz m) (c1 y hy m)
    rcases lt_trichotomy x.1 0 with h | h | h
    · exact hd m x ⟨⟨hx.1.1, h⟩, hx.2⟩
    · have hx' : x = ((0:ℝ), x.2) := Prod.ext h rfl
      rw [hx']
      have h1 := hRd ((0:ℝ), x.2) ⟨⟨le_rfl, ha⟩, hx.2⟩
      have h2 := hedge m x.2 hx.2.1 hx.2.2
      exact (h2.union h1).hasFDerivAt (hBR x.2 hx.2.1 hx.2.2)
    · exact (hRd x ⟨⟨h.le, hx.1.2⟩, hx.2⟩).hasFDerivAt (hRn x hx h)
  have hF : HasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞)
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => if 0 ≤ p.1 then u p else w p) P (Ioo (-1) a ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x _
      by_cases h : 0 ≤ x.1
      · rw [hP]; simp [h]
      · rw [hP]; simp [h]
    · intro m _ x hx
      exact (hderiv m x hx).hasFDerivWithinAt
    · intro m _ x hx
      exact (hderiv m x hx).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  exact hF.contDiffOn

signature.name: dual_power_bumps
signature.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (s : Fin k → ℝ) (p q : ℝ), 0 < p → p < q → Function.Injective s → ∃ e : Fin k → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (e j)) ∧ (∀ j x, (x ≤ p ∨ q ≤ x) → e j x = 0) ∧ ∀ i j, (∫ x in p..q, x ^ (s i) * e j x) = if i = j then 1 else 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro k s p q hp hpq hs
  
  have hrpow : ∀ (σ c d : ℝ), 0 < c → 0 < d → ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ σ) (uIcc c d) := by
    intro σ c d hc hd
    refine ContinuousOn.rpow_const continuousOn_id (fun x hx => Or.inl ?_)
    rcases Set.mem_uIcc.mp hx with h | h
    · exact (lt_of_lt_of_le hc h.1).ne'
    · exact (lt_of_lt_of_le hd h.1).ne'
  have hposI : ∀ x ∈ uIcc p q, 0 < x := fun x hx => by
    rw [uIcc_of_le hpq.le] at hx; linarith [hx.1]
  
  have step : ∀ (a b l : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), p < a → b < q → ContDiff ℝ ∞ g →
      (∀ x : ℝ, (x < a ∨ b < x) → g x = 0) →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => -(g x + x * deriv g x) - l * g x) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, (x < a ∨ b < x) → -(g x + x * deriv g x) - l * g x = 0) ∧
      ∀ σ : ℝ, (∫ x in p..q, x ^ σ * (-(g x + x * deriv g x) - l * g x)) =
        (σ - l) * ∫ x in p..q, x ^ σ * g x := by
    intro a b l g hpa hbq hg hvan
    have hdg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (deriv g) := (contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.mp hg).2
    have hgd : Differentiable ℝ g := hg.differentiable (by simp)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ((hg.add (contDiff_id.mul hdg)).neg).sub (contDiff_const.mul hg)
    · intro x hx
      have hev : g =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
        rcases hx with hx | hx
        · filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hx] with y hy using hvan y (Or.inl hy)
        · filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hx] with y hy using hvan y (Or.inr hy)
      rw [hev.deriv_eq, hvan x hx]
      simp
    · intro σ
      have hv'c : Continuous (fun x => g x + x * deriv g x) :=
        hg.continuous.add (continuous_id.mul hdg.continuous)
      have hu'c : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => σ * x ^ (σ - 1)) (uIcc p q) :=
        continuousOn_const.mul (hrpow (σ - 1) p q hp (by linarith))
      have hibp := intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul
        (a := p) (b := q) (u := fun x => x ^ σ) (u' := fun x => σ * x ^ (σ - 1))
        (v := fun x => x * g x) (v' := fun x => g x + x * deriv g x)
        (fun x hx => Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl (hposI x hx).ne'))
        (fun x _ => by
          have h := (hasDerivAt_id' x).mul (hgd x).hasDerivAt
          simp only [one_mul] at h
          exact h)
        hu'c.intervalIntegrable (hv'c.intervalIntegrable _ _)
      have hgp : g p = 0 := hvan p (Or.inl hpa)
      have hgq : g q = 0 := hvan q (Or.inr hbq)
      have hcong : (∫ x in p..q, σ * x ^ (σ - 1) * (x * g x)) = σ * ∫ x in p..q, x ^ σ * g x := by
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x hx => ?_)
        have hx0 := hposI x hx
        show σ * x ^ (σ - 1) * (x * g x) = σ * (x ^ σ * g x)
        rw [Real.rpow_sub_one hx0.ne' σ]
        field_simp
      simp only [hgp, hgq, mul_zero, sub_zero, zero_sub] at hibp
      rw [hcong] at hibp
      have hI1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => -(x ^ σ * (g x + x * deriv g x))) volume p q :=
        ((hrpow σ p q hp (by linarith)).mul hv'c.continuousOn).neg.intervalIntegrable
      have hI2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => l * (x ^ σ * g x)) volume p q :=
        (continuousOn_const.mul
          ((hrpow σ p q hp (by linarith)).mul hg.continuous.continuousOn)).intervalIntegrable
      calc (∫ x in p..q, x ^ σ * (-(g x + x * deriv g x) - l * g x))
          = ∫ x in p..q, (-(x ^ σ * (g x + x * deriv g x)) - l * (x ^ σ * g x)) := by
            congr 1; funext x; ring
        _ = -(∫ x in p..q, x ^ σ * (g x + x * deriv g x)) - l * ∫ x in p..q, x ^ σ * g x := by
            rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hI1 hI2,
              intervalIntegral.integral_neg, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
        _ = (σ - l) * ∫ x in p..q, x ^ σ * g x := by
            rw [hibp]; ring
  
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = (2 * p + q) / 3 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ, b = (p + 2 * q) / 3 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hpa : p < a := by rw [ha]; linarith
  have hab : a < b := by rw [ha, hb]; linarith
  have hbq : b < q := by rw [hb]; linarith
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ : ∃ β : ℝ → ℝ, β = fun x => expNegInvGlue (x - a) * expNegInvGlue (b - x) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hβs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ β := by
    rw [hβ]
    exact (expNegInvGlue.contDiff.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)).mul
      (expNegInvGlue.contDiff.comp (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id))
  have hβle : ∀ x : ℝ, (x ≤ a ∨ b ≤ x) → β x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hβ]
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · show expNegInvGlue (x - a) * expNegInvGlue (b - x) = 0
      rw [expNegInvGlue.zero_of_nonpos (x := x - a) (by linarith), zero_mul]
    · show expNegInvGlue (x - a) * expNegInvGlue (b - x) = 0
      rw [expNegInvGlue.zero_of_nonpos (x := b - x) (by linarith), mul_zero]
  have hβv : ∀ x : ℝ, (x < a ∨ b < x) → β x = 0 :=
    fun x hx => hβle x (hx.imp le_of_lt le_of_lt)
  have hβpos : ∀ σ : ℝ, 0 < ∫ x in p..q, x ^ σ * β x := by
    intro σ
    have hfi : ∀ c d : ℝ, 0 < c → 0 < d → IntervalIntegrable (fun x => x ^ σ * β x) volume c d :=
      fun c d hc hd => ((hrpow σ c d hc hd).mul hβs.continuous.continuousOn).intervalIntegrable
    have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith
    have hb0 : 0 < b := by linarith
    have hq0 : 0 < q := by linarith
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hfi p a hp ha0) (hfi a q ha0 hq0),
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hfi a b ha0 hb0) (hfi b q hb0 hq0)]
    have h1 : (∫ x in p..a, x ^ σ * β x) = 0 := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ)) (fun x hx => ?_),
        intervalIntegral.integral_zero]
      rw [uIcc_of_le hpa.le] at hx
      show x ^ σ * β x = 0
      rw [hβle x (Or.inl hx.2), mul_zero]
    have h3 : (∫ x in b..q, x ^ σ * β x) = 0 := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ)) (fun x hx => ?_),
        intervalIntegral.integral_zero]
      rw [uIcc_of_le hbq.le] at hx
      show x ^ σ * β x = 0
      rw [hβle x (Or.inr hx.1), mul_zero]
    have h2 : 0 < ∫ x in a..b, x ^ σ * β x := by
      refine intervalIntegral.intervalIntegral_pos_of_pos_on (hfi a b ha0 hb0) (fun x hx => ?_) hab
      rw [hβ]
      exact mul_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith [hx.1]) σ)
        (mul_pos (expNegInvGlue.pos_of_pos (by linarith [hx.1]))
          (expNegInvGlue.pos_of_pos (by linarith [hx.2])))
    rw [h1, h3]
    linarith
  
  have C : ∀ T : Finset (Fin k), ∃ G : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ G ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, (x < a ∨ b < x) → G x = 0) ∧
      ∀ σ : ℝ, (∫ x in p..q, x ^ σ * G x) = (∏ m ∈ T, (σ - s m)) * ∫ x in p..q, x ^ σ * β x := by
    intro T
    refine Finset.induction_on T ?_ ?_
    · exact ⟨β, hβs, hβv, fun σ => by simp⟩
    · intro m T hm ih
      obtain ⟨G, hGs, hGv, hGi⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := step a b (s m) G hpa hbq hGs hGv
      refine ⟨_, h1, h2, fun σ => ?_⟩
      rw [h3, hGi, Finset.prod_insert hm]
      ring
  
  choose G hGs hGv hGi using fun j : Fin k => C (Finset.univ.erase j)
  refine ⟨fun j x => ((∏ m ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (s j - s m)) *
      ∫ y in p..q, y ^ (s j) * β y)⁻¹ * G j x, fun j => contDiff_const.mul (hGs j), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j x hx
    show _ * G j x = 0
    rw [hGv j x (hx.imp (fun h => by linarith) (fun h => by linarith)), mul_zero]
  · intro i j
    have hmc : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ), x ^ s i * (c * G j x) = c * (x ^ s i * G j x) :=
      fun c x => by ring
    simp only [hmc]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hGi j (s i)]
    split_ifs with hij
    · subst hij
      have hQ : (∏ m ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (s i - s m)) ≠ 0 :=
        Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun m hm =>
          sub_ne_zero.mpr (hs.ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hm).symm))
      have hI := (hβpos (s i)).ne'
      field_simp
    · have hz : (∏ m ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (s i - s m)) = 0 :=
        Finset.prod_eq_zero (i := i) (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hij, Finset.mem_univ _⟩) (sub_self _)
      rw [hz]
      simp

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (ε h : ℝ), 0 < ε → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → (∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε g → bgCoefGood ε (fun (X η : ℝ) => f X η + g X η) ∧ bgCoefGood ε (fun (X η : ℝ) => f X η * g X η)) ∧ (∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (pdX f) ∧ bgCoefGood ε (pdE f)) ∧ (∀ c : ℝ, bgCoefGood ε (fun (_ _ : ℝ) => c)) ∧ bgCoefGood ε (fun (X _ : ℝ) => X) ∧ bgCoefGood ε (fun (_ η : ℝ) => η) ∧ bgCoefGood ε (fun (_ η : ℝ) => (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)⁻¹) ∧ (∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → bgCoefGood ε (fun (X _ : ℝ) => φ X)) ∧ (∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (fun (_ η : ℝ) => f a η)) ∧ (∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → f X η = g X η) → bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε g) ∧ (∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (Fs : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ i ∈ s, bgCoefGood ε (Fs i)) → bgCoefGood ε (fun (X η : ℝ) => ∑ i ∈ s, Fs i X η))

signature.name: bg_good_closure
signature.statement: ∀ (ε h : ℝ), 0 < ε → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → (∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε g → bgCoefGood ε (fun (X η : ℝ) => f X η + g X η) ∧ bgCoefGood ε (fun (X η : ℝ) => f X η * g X η)) ∧ (∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (pdX f) ∧ bgCoefGood ε (pdE f)) ∧ (∀ c : ℝ, bgCoefGood ε (fun (_ _ : ℝ) => c)) ∧ bgCoefGood ε (fun (X _ : ℝ) => X) ∧ bgCoefGood ε (fun (_ η : ℝ) => η) ∧ bgCoefGood ε (fun (_ η : ℝ) => (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)⁻¹) ∧ (∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → bgCoefGood ε (fun (X _ : ℝ) => φ X)) ∧ (∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (fun (_ η : ℝ) => f a η)) ∧ (∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → f X η = g X η) → bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε g) ∧ (∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (Fs : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ i ∈ s, bgCoefGood ε (Fs i)) → bgCoefGood ε (fun (X η : ℝ) => ∑ i ∈ s, Fs i X η))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ε h hε hh0 hh1
  have hΩ : IsOpen (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hle : ∀ m : ℕ, ((m : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := fun m => by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hmem : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
    fun X η h0 h1 h2 => ⟨show -ε < X by linarith, h1, h2⟩
  
  have hcongr : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → (∀ X η, f X η = g X η) → bgCoefGood ε g := by
    intro f g hf hfg
    have : f = g := funext fun X => funext fun η => hfg X η
    subst this
    exact hf
  
  have hcongrΩ : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → f X η = g X η) →
      bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε g := by
    intro f g H hf
    have heq : ∀ z ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, (↿g) z = (↿f) z :=
      fun z hz => (H z.1 z.2 hz.1 hz.2.1 hz.2.2).symm
    refine ⟨hf.1.congr heq, ?_⟩
    intro X1 m
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hf.2 X1 m
    refine ⟨C, fun X η h0 h1 h2 h3 => ?_⟩
    have hev : (↿g) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)] (↿f) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hΩ.mem_nhds (hmem X η h0 h2 h3)) heq
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
    exact hC X η h0 h1 h2 h3
  
  have hadd : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε g →
      bgCoefGood ε (fun X η => f X η + g X η) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.add hg.1, ?_⟩
    intro X1 m
    obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hf.2 X1 m
    obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := hg.2 X1 m
    refine ⟨C1 + C2, fun X η h0 h1 h2 h3 => ?_⟩
    have hz := hΩ.mem_nhds (hmem X η h0 h2 h3)
    have e : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun X η => f X η + g X η)) (X, η) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) (X, η) + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η) :=
      iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((hf.1.contDiffAt hz).of_le (hle m)) ((hg.1.contDiffAt hz).of_le (hle m))
    rw [e]
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hC1 X η h0 h1 h2 h3) (hC2 X η h0 h1 h2 h3))
  
  have hmul : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε g →
      bgCoefGood ε (fun X η => f X η * g X η) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.mul hg.1, ?_⟩
    intro X1 m
    choose A hA using fun i => hf.2 X1 i
    choose B hB using fun i => hg.2 X1 i
    refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) * A i * B (m - i),
      fun X η h0 h1 h2 h3 => ?_⟩
    have hz := hmem X η h0 h2 h3
    have e : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun X η => f X η * g X η)) (X, η) =
        iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (fun y => (↿f) y * (↿g) y) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) (X, η) :=
      (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hΩ hz).symm
    rw [e]
    refine (norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hf.1 hg.1 hΩ.uniqueDiffOn hz (hle m)).trans ?_
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩ hz, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (m - i) hΩ hz]
    have a1 := hA i X η h0 h1 h2 h3
    have b1 := hB (m - i) X η h0 h1 h2 h3
    have hc : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (m.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a1 hc) b1 (norm_nonneg _)
      (mul_nonneg hc ((norm_nonneg _).trans a1))
  
  have hbasic : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (V : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) V →
      (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ V) → bgCoefGood ε f := by
    intro f V hV hf hsubV
    refine ⟨hf.mono (fun z hz => hsubV z.1 z.2 hz.1 hz.2.1.le hz.2.2.le), ?_⟩
    intro X1 m
    have hK : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) X1 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    have hKV : Icc (0 : ℝ) X1 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ V :=
      fun z hz => hsubV z.1 z.2 (by linarith [hz.1.1]) hz.2.1 hz.2.2
    have hc : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f)) V :=
      (hf.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (hle m) hV.uniqueDiffOn).congr
        (fun z hz => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hV hz).symm)
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hc.mono hKV)
    exact ⟨C, fun X η h0 h1 h2 h3 => hC (X, η) ⟨⟨h0, h1⟩, h2.le, h3.le⟩⟩
  have hconst : ∀ c : ℝ, bgCoefGood ε (fun _ _ => c) := fun c =>
    hbasic (fun _ _ => c) univ isOpen_univ contDiffOn_const (fun _ _ _ _ _ => mem_univ _)
  have hX : bgCoefGood ε (fun X _ => X) :=
    hbasic (fun X _ => X) univ isOpen_univ contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun _ _ _ _ _ => mem_univ _)
  have hη : bgCoefGood ε (fun _ η => η) :=
    hbasic (fun _ η => η) univ isOpen_univ contDiff_snd.contDiffOn (fun _ _ _ _ _ => mem_univ _)
  have hφ : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → bgCoefGood ε (fun (X _ : ℝ) => φ X) := fun φ hφ =>
    hbasic (fun (X _ : ℝ) => φ X) univ isOpen_univ (hφ.comp contDiff_fst).contDiffOn
      (fun _ _ _ _ _ => mem_univ _)
  have hinv : bgCoefGood ε (fun _ η => (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
    refine hbasic _ {w : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < 1 - 2 * h * w.2 ^ 2}
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)) ?_ ?_
    · exact ((contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_snd.pow 2))).contDiffOn).inv
        (fun w hw => ne_of_gt hw)
    · intro X η _ h1 h2
      have hη2 : η ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
      show 0 < 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2
      nlinarith
  
  have hpd : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (v : ℝ × ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), bgCoefGood ε f →
      (∀ X η, ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 → g X η = fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η) v) →
      bgCoefGood ε g := by
    intro f v g hf hgv
    have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hf.1.fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ le_rfl
    have hDg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿f))
        (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hD
    have heq : ∀ z ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1,
        (↿g) z = ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿f)) z := by
      intro z hz
      have := hgv z.1 z.2 hz
      exact this
    refine ⟨hDg.congr heq, ?_⟩
    intro X1 m
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hf.2 X1 (m + 1)
    refine ⟨‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v‖ * C, fun X η h0 h1 h2 h3 => ?_⟩
    have hz := hmem X η h0 h2 h3
    have hev : (↿g) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)] ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿f)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hΩ.mem_nhds hz) heq
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (X, η)‖
        ≤ ‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (X, η)‖ :=
          (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v).norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left
            (hD.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hz)) (hle m)
      _ = ‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) (↿f) (X, η)‖ := by
          rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
      _ ≤ ‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v‖ * C :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC X η h0 h1 h2 h3) (by positivity)
  have hpdX : ∀ f, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (pdX f) := by
    intro f hf
    refine hpd f ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) (pdX f) hf (fun X η hz => ?_)
    have hd : HasFDerivAt (↿f) (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η)) (X, η) :=
      ((hf.1.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => ((Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) X :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X η)
    exact (hd.comp_hasDerivAt X hc).deriv
  have hpdE : ∀ f, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (pdE f) := by
    intro f hf
    refine hpd f ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) (pdE f) hf (fun X η hz => ?_)
    have hd : HasFDerivAt (↿f) (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η)) (X, η) :=
      ((hf.1.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => ((X, e) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) η :=
      (hasDerivAt_const η X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' η)
    exact (hd.comp_hasDerivAt η hc).deriv
  
  have hfreeze : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → bgCoefGood ε f →
      bgCoefGood ε (fun (_ η : ℝ) => f a η) := by
    intro f a ha hf
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
        L = (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hLw : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, L w = (0, w.2) := by intro w; rw [hL]; simp
    obtain ⟨c, hcd⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ × ℝ, c = (a, 0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨F1, hF1d⟩ : ∃ F1 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, F1 = fun w => (↿f) (w + c) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Ω', hΩ'd⟩ : ∃ Ω' : Set (ℝ × ℝ), Ω' = (fun w => w + c) ⁻¹' (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hΩ' : IsOpen Ω' := by rw [hΩ'd]; exact hΩ.preimage (continuous_id.add continuous_const)
    have hLΩ' : IsOpen (L ⁻¹' Ω') := hΩ'.preimage L.continuous
    have hF1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F1 Ω' := by
      rw [hF1d, hΩ'd]
      exact hf.1.comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const).contDiffOn (fun w hw => hw)
    have hLc : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, L w + c = (a, w.2) := by
      intro w; rw [hLw, hcd]; ext <;> simp
    have hrep : (↿(fun (_ η : ℝ) => f a η)) = F1 ∘ L := by
      funext w
      rw [Function.comp_apply, hF1d]
      show f a w.2 = (↿f) (L w + c)
      rw [hLc]
      rfl
    have hmapsL : ∀ z ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, L z ∈ Ω' := by
      intro z hz
      rw [hΩ'd]
      show L z + c ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1
      rw [hLc]
      exact ⟨show -ε < a by linarith, hz.2⟩
    have hL1 : ‖L‖ ≤ 1 := by
      refine L.opNorm_le_bound zero_le_one (fun w => ?_)
      rw [hLw, Prod.norm_mk, norm_zero, one_mul]
      exact max_le (norm_nonneg _) (norm_snd_le w)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hrep]
      exact hF1.comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn hmapsL
    · intro X1 m
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hf.2 a m
      refine ⟨C, fun X η h0 h1 h2 h3 => ?_⟩
      have hz := hmem X η h0 h2 h3
      have hzL : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ L ⁻¹' Ω' := hmapsL _ hz
      rw [hrep, ← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hLΩ' hzL,
        L.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right hF1 hΩ'.uniqueDiffOn hLΩ'.uniqueDiffOn hzL (hle m),
        iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hΩ' hzL, hF1d, iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right, hLc]
      refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      have hp : ‖L‖ ^ m ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hL1
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) (a, η)‖ * ‖L‖ ^ m ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) (a, η)‖ :=
            mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) hp
        _ ≤ C := hC a η ha le_rfl h2 h3
  
  have hsum : ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (Fs : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ i ∈ s, bgCoefGood ε (Fs i)) →
      bgCoefGood ε (fun (X η : ℝ) => ∑ i ∈ s, Fs i X η) := by
    intro s Fs
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => intro _; exact hcongr _ _ (hconst 0) (fun X η => by simp)
    | @insert a s ha ih =>
      intro hf
      exact hcongr _ _ (hadd _ _ (hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s))
        (ih fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))) (fun X η => by rw [Finset.sum_insert ha])
  exact ⟨fun f g hf hg => ⟨hadd f g hf hg, hmul f g hf hg⟩, fun f hf => ⟨hpdX f hf, hpdE f hf⟩,
    hconst, hX, hη, hinv, hφ, hfreeze, hcongrΩ, hsum⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: bg_good_closure
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (ε h : ℝ), 0 < ε → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → (∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε g → bgCoefGood ε (fun (X η : ℝ) => f X η + g X η) ∧ bgCoefGood ε (fun (X η : ℝ) => f X η * g X η)) ∧ (∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (pdX f) ∧ bgCoefGood ε (pdE f)) ∧ (∀ c : ℝ, bgCoefGood ε (fun (_ _ : ℝ) => c)) ∧ bgCoefGood ε (fun (X _ : ℝ) => X) ∧ bgCoefGood ε (fun (_ η : ℝ) => η) ∧ bgCoefGood ε (fun (_ η : ℝ) => (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)⁻¹) ∧ (∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → bgCoefGood ε (fun (X _ : ℝ) => φ X)) ∧ (∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (fun (_ η : ℝ) => f a η)) ∧ (∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → f X η = g X η) → bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε g) ∧ (∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (Fs : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ i ∈ s, bgCoefGood ε (Fs i)) → bgCoefGood ε (fun (X η : ℝ) => ∑ i ∈ s, Fs i X η))

subgoal_signatures.name: profRadAvg_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(profRadAvg g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(profRadAvg g)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ X η : ℝ, -ε < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → X * profRadAvg g X η = profRadInt g X η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * profRadAvg g Y η) (g X η) X)

signature.name: bgOm_good
signature.statement: ∀ (h ε : ℝ) (S : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < ε → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → bgCoefGood ε (S i)) → bgCoefGood ε (bgOm h S k)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h ε S k hh0 hh1 hε hS
  obtain ⟨C1, C2, gc, gX, gE, gL, -, -, -, C10⟩ := bg_good_closure ε h hε hh0 hh1
  have gadd : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε g →
      bgCoefGood ε (fun (X η : ℝ) => f X η + g X η) := fun f g hf hg => (C1 f g hf hg).1
  have gmul : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε g →
      bgCoefGood ε (fun (X η : ℝ) => f X η * g X η) := fun f g hf hg => (C1 f g hf hg).2
  have gcg : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ X η : ℝ, f X η = g X η) → bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε g := by
    intro f g hfg hf
    have e : g = f := funext fun X => funext fun η => (hfg X η).symm
    rw [e]; exact hf
  
  have gUz : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (bgUz f) := by
    intro f hf
    exact gcg _ _ (fun X η => by simp only [bgUz]) (gadd _ _ hf (gmul _ _ gX (C2 f hf).1))
  have gTop : ∀ (b : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (simTop h b f) := by
    intro b f hf
    have h1 := gmul _ _ (gc (-b)) hf
    have h2 := gmul _ _ (gmul _ _ (gc (1 / 2 - h)) gE) (C2 f hf).2
    have h3 := gmul _ _ gX (C2 f hf).1
    have h4 := gmul _ _ (gadd _ _ (gadd _ _ h1 h2) h3) gL
    exact gcg _ _ (fun X η => by simp only [simTop]; ring) h4
  have gZop : ∀ (b : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (simZop h b f) := by
    intro b f hf
    have h1 := gmul _ _ (gmul _ _ (gc (2 * b)) gE) hf
    have h2 := gmul _ _ (gadd _ _ (gc 1) (gmul _ _ (gc (-1)) (gmul _ _ gE gE))) (C2 f hf).2
    have h3 := gmul _ _ (gmul _ _ (gc (-2)) gE) (gmul _ _ gX (C2 f hf).1)
    have h4 := gmul _ _ (gadd _ _ (gadd _ _ h1 h2) h3) gL
    exact gcg _ _ (fun X η => by simp only [simZop]; ring) h4
  have gVx : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), bgCoefGood ε f → bgCoefGood ε (bgVx h n f) := by
    intro n f hf
    have h1 := gmul _ _ (gmul _ _ (gc 2) gE) (gUz f hf)
    have h2 := gmul _ _ (gmul _ _ (gc (-(2 * (1 / 2 - h + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h)))) gE) hf
    have h3 := gmul _ _ (gadd _ _ (gc (-1)) (gmul _ _ (gc 1) (gmul _ _ gE gE))) (C2 f hf).2
    have h4 := gmul _ _ (gadd _ _ (gadd _ _ h1 h2) h3) gL
    exact gcg _ _ (fun X η => by simp only [bgVx]; ring) h4
  
  have gV : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → bgCoefGood ε (bgVx h j (S j)) := fun j hj => gVx j _ (hS j hj)
  
  have gT1 := gTop (-1 + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) _ (gV k le_rfl)
  have gpV := (C2 _ (gV k le_rfl)).1
  have gppV := (C2 _ gpV).1
  have gT2 := gmul _ _ (gc (-2)) (gadd _ _ (gmul _ _ gX gppV) (gmul _ _ (gc 2) gpV))
  
  have gSum : bgCoefGood ε (fun X η => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
        (bgVx h i (S i) X η * (bgVx h (k - i) (S (k - i)) X η / 2 + X * pdX (bgVx h (k - i) (S (k - i))) X η)
          + bgUz (S i) X η * simZop h (-1 + 2 * ((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) (bgVx h (k - i) (S (k - i))) X η)) := by
    refine C10 (Finset.range (k + 1)) (fun i X η =>
        bgVx h i (S i) X η * (bgVx h (k - i) (S (k - i)) X η / 2 + X * pdX (bgVx h (k - i) (S (k - i))) X η)
          + bgUz (S i) X η * simZop h (-1 + 2 * ((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) (bgVx h (k - i) (S (k - i))) X η) ?_
    intro i hi
    have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
    have hki : k - i ≤ k := Nat.sub_le k i
    have a1 := gV i hik
    have a2 := gV (k - i) hki
    have a3 := (C2 _ a2).1
    have a4 := gUz _ (hS i hik)
    have a5 := gZop (-1 + 2 * ((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) _ a2
    exact gcg _ _ (fun X η => by ring)
      (gadd _ _ (gmul _ _ a1 (gadd _ _ (gmul _ _ a2 (gc (1 / 2))) (gmul _ _ gX a3))) (gmul _ _ a4 a5))
  
  have gIf : bgCoefGood ε (fun X η => if 1 ≤ k then simZop h (-1 + 2 * ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h))
        (simZop h (-1 + 2 * ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) (bgVx h (k - 1) (S (k - 1)))) X η else 0) := by
    by_cases hk : 1 ≤ k
    · simp only [hk, ↓reduceIte]
      exact gZop _ _ (gZop _ _ (gV (k - 1) (Nat.sub_le k 1)))
    · simp only [hk, ↓reduceIte]
      exact gc 0
  
  exact gcg _ _ (fun X η => by simp only [bgOm]; ring)
    (gadd _ _ (gadd _ _ (gadd _ _ gT1 gT2) gSum) (gmul _ _ (gc (-1)) gIf))

signature.name: cutoff_mul_good
signature.statement: ∀ (ε Xt Xi : ℝ) (κ : ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 → Xt < Xi → ContDiff ℝ ∞ κ → (∀ X : ℝ, Xt ≤ X → κ X = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioo (-1) Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X1 : ℝ, X1 < Xi → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → bgCoefGood ε (fun (X η : ℝ) => κ X * f X η)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ε Xt Xi κ f hε hε1 hXt hκ hκ0 hf hb
  have hO : IsOpen (Ioo (-1 : ℝ) Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hV : IsOpen (Ioi Xt ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_univ
  have hk : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => κ p.1) := hκ.comp contDiff_fst
  have hG : (↿(fun (X η : ℝ) => κ X * f X η)) = fun p : ℝ × ℝ => κ p.1 * (↿f) p := rfl
  have hGV : ∀ p ∈ Ioi Xt ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ), (↿(fun (X η : ℝ) => κ X * f X η)) p = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    have h1 : Xt < p.1 := hp.1
    rw [hG]
    simp only [hκ0 p.1 (le_of_lt h1), zero_mul]
  have hGO : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => κ p.1 * (↿f) p) (Ioo (-1 : ℝ) Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
    hk.contDiffOn.mul hf
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    intro p hp
    have hp1 : -ε < p.1 := hp.1
    by_cases hpX : p.1 < Xi
    · refine ⟨Ioo (-1 : ℝ) Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, hO, ⟨⟨by linarith, hpX⟩, hp.2⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [hG]
      exact hGO.mono inter_subset_right
    · refine ⟨Ioi Xt ×ˢ univ, hV, ⟨show Xt < p.1 by linarith [not_lt.mp hpX], mem_univ _⟩, ?_⟩
      exact (contDiffOn_const (c := (0:ℝ))).congr (fun q hq => hGV q hq.2)
  · intro X1 m
    obtain ⟨Xs, hXs⟩ : ∃ Xs : ℝ, Xs = (Xt + Xi) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hXs1 : Xt < Xs := by rw [hXs]; linarith
    have hXs2 : Xs < Xi := by rw [hXs]; linarith
    choose Cf hCf using fun i : ℕ => hb Xs hXs2 (m - i)
    have hK : IsCompact (Icc (0:ℝ) Xs ×ˢ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    choose Mk hMk using fun i : ℕ => hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      ((hk.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (m := i)
        (by first | simp | norm_num | exact_mod_cast le_top)).continuousOn)
    refine ⟨max (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) * max (Mk i) 0 * max (Cf i) 0) 0, ?_⟩
    intro X η hX0 hX1 he1 he2
    by_cases hXX : X ≤ Xs
    · have hpO : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
        ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, he1, he2⟩
      have hpK : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) Xs ×ˢ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨⟨hX0, hXX⟩, he1.le, he2.le⟩
      have hL := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hk.contDiffOn hf hO.uniqueDiffOn hpO (n := m)
        (by first | simp | norm_num | exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have hsum : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) *
          ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => κ p.1) (Ioo (-1 : ℝ) Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) (X, η)‖ *
          ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ (m - i) (↿f) (Ioo (-1 : ℝ) Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) (X, η)‖ ≤
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) * max (Mk i) 0 * max (Cf i) 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO hpO, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (m - i) hO hpO]
        have a1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => κ p.1) (X, η)‖ ≤ max (Mk i) 0 :=
          (hMk i _ hpK).trans (le_max_left _ _)
        have a2 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m - i) (↿f) (X, η)‖ ≤ max (Cf i) 0 :=
          (hCf i X η hX0 hXX he1 he2).trans (le_max_left _ _)
        have c0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (m.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
        exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a1 c0) a2 (norm_nonneg _)
          (mul_nonneg c0 (le_max_right _ _))
      have e := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun p : ℝ × ℝ => κ p.1 * (↿f) p) m hO hpO
      rw [hG, ← e]
      exact (hL.trans hsum).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · push_neg at hXX
      have hpV : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi Xt ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) :=
        ⟨show Xt < X by linarith, mem_univ _⟩
      have hev : (↿(fun (X η : ℝ) => κ X * f X η)) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)] fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV.mem_nhds hpV) hGV
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
      exact le_max_right _ _
