signature.statement: ∀ (Xi : ℝ) (κ : ℝ → ℝ) (f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xi → ContDiff ℝ ∞ κ → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioo (-1) Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → BgAnalytic Xi f → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi → g X η = κ X * f X η) → BgAnalytic Xi g

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xi κ f g hXi hκ hfs hf hg k
  choose ρ C fc hρ hcont hX using hf
  have hκc : ∀ j : ℕ, Continuous (iteratedDeriv j κ) := fun j =>
    hκ.continuous_iteratedDeriv j (by first | simp | norm_num | exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hMex : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ M, ∀ x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) Xi, ‖iteratedDeriv j κ x‖ ≤ M := fun j =>
    isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hκc j).continuousOn
  choose M₀ hM₀ using hMex
  have hne : (Finset.range (k+1)).Nonempty := ⟨0, by simp⟩
  have hρ'pos : 0 < (Finset.range (k+1)).inf' hne ρ :=
    (Finset.lt_inf'_iff hne).mpr (fun m _ => hρ m)
  have hstrip : ∀ r r' : ℝ, r ≤ r' → cStrip r ⊆ cStrip r' := by
    intro r r' hrr w hw
    simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw ⊢
    exact ⟨by linarith [hw.1], by linarith [hw.2.1], by linarith [hw.2.2]⟩
  have hSTR : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1),
      cStrip ((Finset.range (k+1)).inf' hne ρ) ⊆ cStrip (ρ (k-j)) := fun j hj =>
    hstrip _ _ (Finset.inf'_le ρ (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by simp at hj; omega)))
  refine ⟨(Finset.range (k+1)).inf' hne ρ,
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), (k.choose j : ℝ) * max (M₀ j) 0 * max (C (k-j)) 0,
    fun X w => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1),
      ((k.choose j : ℂ) * ((iteratedDeriv j κ X : ℝ) : ℂ)) * fc (k-j) X w,
    hρ'pos, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply continuousOn_finsetSum
    intro j hj
    apply ContinuousOn.mul
    · exact (continuous_const.mul
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp ((hκc j).comp continuous_fst))).continuousOn
    · exact (hcont (k-j)).mono (Set.prod_mono subset_rfl (hSTR j hj))
  · intro X h0 h1
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply DifferentiableOn.fun_sum
      intro j hj
      exact ((hX (k-j) X h0 h1).1.mono (hSTR j hj)).const_mul _
    · intro w hw
      refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j hj => ?_)
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast, Complex.norm_real]
      have hXI : X ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) Xi := ⟨h0.le, h1.le⟩
      have a1 : ‖iteratedDeriv j κ X‖ ≤ max (M₀ j) 0 := (hM₀ j X hXI).trans (le_max_left _ _)
      have a2 : ‖fc (k-j) X w‖ ≤ max (C (k-j)) 0 :=
        ((hX (k-j) X h0 h1).2.1 w (hSTR j hj hw)).trans (le_max_left _ _)
      gcongr
    · intro η e1 e2
      have hev : (fun Y => g Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X] (fun Y => κ Y * f Y η) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds h0 h1) (fun Y hY => hg Y η hY.1 hY.2)
      have hκX : ContDiffAt ℝ k κ X :=
        hκ.contDiffAt.of_le (by first | simp | norm_num | exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have hmem : (X, η) ∈ Ioo (-1:ℝ) Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨⟨by linarith, h1⟩, e1, e2⟩
      have hfX : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (↿f) (X, η) :=
        hfs.contDiffAt ((isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo).mem_nhds hmem)
      have hfη : ContDiffAt ℝ k (fun Y => f Y η) X :=
        (hfX.comp X (contDiffAt_id.prodMk contDiffAt_const)).of_le
          (by first | simp | norm_num | exact_mod_cast le_top)
      rw [hev.iteratedDeriv_eq k, show (fun Y => κ Y * f Y η) = κ * (fun Y => f Y η) from rfl,
        iteratedDeriv_mul hκX hfη]
      push_cast
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
      rw [(hX (k-j) X h0 h1).2.2 η e1 e2]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (Xm Xp a b B e : ℝ) (F U G V : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xm → Xm < a → a < b → b < Xp → 0 ≤ B → 0 ≤ e → e ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿V) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿G) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿V) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → (∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 → |F X η| ≤ B ∧ |U X η| ≤ B ∧ |deriv (fun e' => F X e') η| ≤ B ∧ |deriv (fun e' => U X e') η| ≤ B ∧ |G X η - F X η| ≤ e ∧ |V X η - U X η| ≤ e ∧ |deriv (fun e' => G X e') η - deriv (fun e' => F X e') η| ≤ e ∧ |deriv (fun e' => V X e') η - deriv (fun e' => U X e') η| ≤ e) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (rcDisc a b F U G V) (Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedDeriv m (rcDisc a b F U G V) η‖ ≤ K) ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖rcDisc a b F U G V η‖ ≤ (b - a) * (8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2) * e ∧ ‖deriv (rcDisc a b F U G V) η‖ ≤ (b - a) * (8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2) * e

signature.name: rc_discrepancy_jets
signature.statement: ∀ (Xm Xp a b B e : ℝ) (F U G V : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xm → Xm < a → a < b → b < Xp → 0 ≤ B → 0 ≤ e → e ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿V) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿G) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿V) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → (∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 → |F X η| ≤ B ∧ |U X η| ≤ B ∧ |deriv (fun e' => F X e') η| ≤ B ∧ |deriv (fun e' => U X e') η| ≤ B ∧ |G X η - F X η| ≤ e ∧ |V X η - U X η| ≤ e ∧ |deriv (fun e' => G X e') η - deriv (fun e' => F X e') η| ≤ e ∧ |deriv (fun e' => V X e') η - deriv (fun e' => U X e') η| ≤ e) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (rcDisc a b F U G V) (Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedDeriv m (rcDisc a b F U G V) η‖ ≤ K) ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖rcDisc a b F U G V η‖ ≤ (b - a) * (8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2) * e ∧ ‖deriv (rcDisc a b F U G V) η‖ ≤ (b - a) * (8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2) * e

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xm Xp a b B ε F U G V hXm hXma hab hbXp hB he0 he1 hFs hUs hGs hVs hjet hpt
  have hO : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hSO : Icc Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
    fun z hz => ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hXm hz.1.1, hz.2⟩
  have hXp0 : 0 < Xp := by linarith
  have hkinf : ∀ k : ℕ, ((k : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := fun k => by exact_mod_cast le_top
  
  
  
  have L1 : ∀ (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (W : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (x : ℝ), IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W →
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (s : ℝ), (x, s) ∈ W →
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun t => g (x, t)) s| ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (x, s)‖ := by
    intro g W x hW hg
    have hT : IsOpen {t : ℝ | (x, t) ∈ W} := hW.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
    have hP : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ s : ℝ, (x, s) ∈ W →
        iteratedDeriv k (fun t => g (x, t)) s =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (x, s) (fun _ => ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => intro s hs; simp
      | succ k ih =>
        intro s hs
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        have hev : iteratedDeriv k (fun t => g (x, t)) =ᶠ[nhds s]
            fun s' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (x, s') (fun _ => ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hT.mem_nhds hs) (fun s' hs' => ih s' hs')
        rw [hev.deriv_eq]
        have hcd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g (x, s) := hg.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hs)
        have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g) (x, s) :=
          hcd.iteratedFDeriv_right (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
        have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g) (x, s) :=
          h1.differentiableAt (by norm_num)
        have hιd : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (x, t)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) s :=
          (hasDerivAt_const s x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id s)
        have h2 := hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s hιd
        have h3 := (ContinuousMultilinearMap.apply ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ
          (fun _ => ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)))).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s h2
        have h4 : HasDerivAt (fun s' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (x, s') (fun _ => ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))))
            (fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g) (x, s) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) (fun _ => ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)))) s :=
          h3
        rw [h4.deriv, iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left]
        rfl
    intro k s hs
    rw [hP k s hs, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _).trans ?_
    have hv : ‖((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))‖ = 1 := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
    simp [hv]
  
  
  
  have gglob : ∀ φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ →
      axgeGood (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Icc Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) φ := by
    intro φ hφ
    refine ⟨hφ.contDiffOn, fun k => ?_⟩
    have hK : IsCompact (Icc Xm Xp ×ˢ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (ContDiff.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (m := k) (hkinf k) hφ).continuousOn
    exact ⟨C, fun z hz => hC z ⟨hz.1, Ioo_subset_Icc_self hz.2⟩⟩
  have gmul : ∀ φ χ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
      axgeGood (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Icc Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) φ →
      axgeGood (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Icc Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) χ →
      axgeGood (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Icc Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (fun z => φ z * χ z) := by
    intro φ χ hφ hχ
    refine ⟨hφ.1.mul hχ.1, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) φ χ _ _ hO hSO
      hφ.1 hχ.1 hφ.2 hχ.2 k
    have hfun : (fun z => (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) (φ z) (χ z)) = fun z => φ z * χ z :=
      funext fun z => ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply' ℝ ℝ (φ z) (χ z)
    rw [hfun] at hC
    exact ⟨C, hC⟩
  have gsub : ∀ φ χ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
      axgeGood (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Icc Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) φ →
      axgeGood (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Icc Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) χ →
      axgeGood (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Icc Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (fun z => φ z - χ z) := by
    intro φ χ hφ hχ
    refine ⟨hφ.1.sub hχ.1, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C1, h1⟩ := hφ.2 k
    obtain ⟨C2, h2⟩ := hχ.2 k
    refine ⟨C1 + C2, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hzO := hO.mem_nhds (hSO hz)
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => φ z - χ z) z =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k φ z - iteratedFDeriv ℝ k χ z :=
      iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply ((hφ.1.contDiffAt hzO).of_le (hkinf k))
        ((hχ.1.contDiffAt hzO).of_le (hkinf k))
    rw [e1]
    exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (h1 z hz) (h2 z hz))
  have gsq : ∀ φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
      axgeGood (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Icc Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) φ →
      axgeGood (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Icc Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (fun z => φ z ^ 2) := by
    intro φ hφ
    have e1 : (fun z => φ z ^ 2) = fun z => φ z * φ z := funext fun z => sq (φ z)
    rw [e1]
    exact gmul φ φ hφ hφ
  have gbase : ∀ H : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿H) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿H) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) →
      axgeGood (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Icc Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (↿H) := by
    intro H hH hb
    refine ⟨hH, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hb k
    exact ⟨C, fun z hz => hC z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2⟩
  have gF := gbase F hFs (fun m => (hjet m).imp fun C hC X η h1 h2 h3 h4 => (hC X η h1 h2 h3 h4).1)
  have gU := gbase U hUs (fun m => (hjet m).imp fun C hC X η h1 h2 h3 h4 => (hC X η h1 h2 h3 h4).2.1)
  have gG := gbase G hGs (fun m => (hjet m).imp fun C hC X η h1 h2 h3 h4 => (hC X η h1 h2 h3 h4).2.2.1)
  have gV := gbase V hVs (fun m => (hjet m).imp fun C hC X η h1 h2 h3 h4 => (hC X η h1 h2 h3 h4).2.2.2)
  have gfst := gglob (fun z => z.1) contDiff_fst
  have g2x := gglob (fun z => 2 * z.1) (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_fst)
  
  
  
  have hsq : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (f' s : ℝ), HasDerivAt f f' s →
      HasDerivAt (fun t => f t ^ 2) (2 * f s * f') s := by
    intro f f' s h; convert h.pow 2 using 1; norm_num
  have hprod : ∀ s t S T : ℝ, |s| ≤ S → |t| ≤ T → |s * t| ≤ S * T := by
    intro s t S T hs ht
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul hs ht (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans hs)
  have pw : ∀ y η : ℝ, a ≤ y → y ≤ b → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      (|V y η - U y η| ≤ 8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2 * ε ∧
        |deriv (fun t => V y t - U y t) η| ≤ 8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2 * ε) ∧
      (|2 * y * (G y η - F y η)| ≤ 8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2 * ε ∧
        |deriv (fun t => 2 * y * (G y t - F y t)) η| ≤ 8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2 * ε) ∧
      (|V y η * (2 * y * G y η) - U y η * (2 * y * F y η)| ≤ 8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2 * ε ∧
        |deriv (fun t => V y t * (2 * y * G y t) - U y t * (2 * y * F y t)) η| ≤
          8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2 * ε) ∧
      (|(V y η ^ 2 - y * G y η ^ 2) - (U y η ^ 2 - y * F y η ^ 2)| ≤ 8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2 * ε ∧
        |deriv (fun t => (V y t ^ 2 - y * G y t ^ 2) - (U y t ^ 2 - y * F y t ^ 2)) η| ≤
          8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2 * ε) ∧
      (|G y η ^ 2 - F y η ^ 2| ≤ 8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2 * ε ∧
        |deriv (fun t => G y t ^ 2 - F y t ^ 2) η| ≤ 8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2 * ε) := by
    intro y η hy1 hy2 h1 h2
    have hyX1 : Xm ≤ y := by linarith
    have hyX2 : y ≤ Xp := by linarith
    have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := by linarith
    have hmem : (y, η) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨show (0:ℝ) < y by linarith, h1, h2⟩
    have hF := (slice_deriv_facts F _ y η hO hFs hmem).2.1
    have hU := (slice_deriv_facts U _ y η hO hUs hmem).2.1
    have hG := (slice_deriv_facts G _ y η hO hGs hmem).2.1
    have hV := (slice_deriv_facts V _ y η hO hVs hmem).2.1
    obtain ⟨bF, bU, bF1, bU1, bp, bq, bp1, bq1⟩ := hpt y η hyX1 hyX2 h1 h2
    have d0 : deriv (fun t => V y t - U y t) η =
        deriv (fun t => V y t) η - deriv (fun t => U y t) η := (hV.sub hU).deriv
    have d1 : deriv (fun t => 2 * y * (G y t - F y t)) η =
        2 * y * (deriv (fun t => G y t) η - deriv (fun t => F y t) η) :=
      ((hG.sub hF).const_mul (2 * y)).deriv
    have d2 : deriv (fun t => V y t * (2 * y * G y t) - U y t * (2 * y * F y t)) η =
        deriv (fun t => V y t) η * (2 * y * G y η) + V y η * (2 * y * deriv (fun t => G y t) η) -
          (deriv (fun t => U y t) η * (2 * y * F y η) + U y η * (2 * y * deriv (fun t => F y t) η)) :=
      ((hV.mul (hG.const_mul (2 * y))).sub (hU.mul (hF.const_mul (2 * y)))).deriv
    have d3 : deriv (fun t => (V y t ^ 2 - y * G y t ^ 2) - (U y t ^ 2 - y * F y t ^ 2)) η =
        2 * V y η * deriv (fun t => V y t) η - y * (2 * G y η * deriv (fun t => G y t) η) -
          (2 * U y η * deriv (fun t => U y t) η - y * (2 * F y η * deriv (fun t => F y t) η)) :=
      (((hsq _ _ _ hV).sub ((hsq _ _ _ hG).const_mul y)).sub
        ((hsq _ _ _ hU).sub ((hsq _ _ _ hF).const_mul y))).deriv
    have d4 : deriv (fun t => G y t ^ 2 - F y t ^ 2) η =
        2 * G y η * deriv (fun t => G y t) η - 2 * F y η * deriv (fun t => F y t) η :=
      ((hsq _ _ _ hG).sub (hsq _ _ _ hF)).deriv
    rw [d0, d1, d2, d3, d4]
    set F0 := F y η with hF0
    set U0 := U y η with hU0
    set G0 := G y η with hG0
    set V0 := V y η with hV0
    set F1 := deriv (fun t => F y t) η with hF1
    set U1 := deriv (fun t => U y t) η with hU1
    set G1 := deriv (fun t => G y t) η with hG1
    set V1 := deriv (fun t => V y t) η with hV1
    have bG : |G0| ≤ B + 1 := by
      have := abs_add_le (G0 - F0) F0; rw [sub_add_cancel] at this; linarith
    have bV : |V0| ≤ B + 1 := by
      have := abs_add_le (V0 - U0) U0; rw [sub_add_cancel] at this; linarith
    have bG1 : |G1| ≤ B + 1 := by
      have := abs_add_le (G1 - F1) F1; rw [sub_add_cancel] at this; linarith
    have bV1 : |V1| ≤ B + 1 := by
      have := abs_add_le (V1 - U1) U1; rw [sub_add_cancel] at this; linarith
    have bVU : |V0 + U0| ≤ 2 * B + 1 := by have := abs_add_le V0 U0; linarith
    have bGF : |G0 + F0| ≤ 2 * B + 1 := by have := abs_add_le G0 F0; linarith
    have h2y : |2 * y| ≤ 2 * Xp := by rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]; linarith
    have hny : |-y| ≤ Xp := by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hy0]; exact hyX2
    have hn2y : |-2 * y| ≤ 2 * Xp := by rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]; linarith
    have h2a : |(2:ℝ)| ≤ 2 := by norm_num
    have n1 : 0 ≤ ε * B := mul_nonneg he0 hB
    have n2 : 0 ≤ ε * B ^ 2 := mul_nonneg he0 (sq_nonneg B)
    have n3 : 0 ≤ Xp * ε := mul_nonneg hXp0.le he0
    have n4 : 0 ≤ Xp * ε * B := mul_nonneg n3 hB
    have n5 : 0 ≤ Xp * ε * B ^ 2 := mul_nonneg n3 (sq_nonneg B)
    have hK : 8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2 * ε = 8 * ε + 16 * (ε * B) + 8 * (ε * B ^ 2) +
        8 * (Xp * ε) + 16 * (Xp * ε * B) + 8 * (Xp * ε * B ^ 2) := by ring
    rw [hK]
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · linarith
    · linarith
    · have t1 := hprod _ _ _ _ h2y bp
      linarith
    · have t1 := hprod _ _ _ _ h2y bp1
      linarith
    · rw [show V0 * (2 * y * G0) - U0 * (2 * y * F0) =
          2 * y * ((V0 - U0) * G0) + 2 * y * (U0 * (G0 - F0)) by ring]
      have t1 := hprod _ _ _ _ h2y (hprod _ _ _ _ bq bG)
      have t2 := hprod _ _ _ _ h2y (hprod _ _ _ _ bU bp)
      have s1 := abs_add_le (2 * y * ((V0 - U0) * G0)) (2 * y * (U0 * (G0 - F0)))
      linarith
    · rw [show V1 * (2 * y * G0) + V0 * (2 * y * G1) - (U1 * (2 * y * F0) + U0 * (2 * y * F1)) =
          2 * y * ((V1 - U1) * G0) + 2 * y * (U1 * (G0 - F0)) + 2 * y * ((V0 - U0) * G1) +
            2 * y * (U0 * (G1 - F1)) by ring]
      have t1 := hprod _ _ _ _ h2y (hprod _ _ _ _ bq1 bG)
      have t2 := hprod _ _ _ _ h2y (hprod _ _ _ _ bU1 bp)
      have t3 := hprod _ _ _ _ h2y (hprod _ _ _ _ bq bG1)
      have t4 := hprod _ _ _ _ h2y (hprod _ _ _ _ bU bp1)
      have s1 := abs_add_le (2 * y * ((V1 - U1) * G0) + 2 * y * (U1 * (G0 - F0)) +
        2 * y * ((V0 - U0) * G1)) (2 * y * (U0 * (G1 - F1)))
      have s2 := abs_add_le (2 * y * ((V1 - U1) * G0) + 2 * y * (U1 * (G0 - F0)))
        (2 * y * ((V0 - U0) * G1))
      have s3 := abs_add_le (2 * y * ((V1 - U1) * G0)) (2 * y * (U1 * (G0 - F0)))
      linarith
    · rw [show (V0 ^ 2 - y * G0 ^ 2) - (U0 ^ 2 - y * F0 ^ 2) =
          (V0 - U0) * (V0 + U0) + -y * ((G0 - F0) * (G0 + F0)) by ring]
      have t1 := hprod _ _ _ _ bq bVU
      have t2 := hprod _ _ _ _ hny (hprod _ _ _ _ bp bGF)
      have s1 := abs_add_le ((V0 - U0) * (V0 + U0)) (-y * ((G0 - F0) * (G0 + F0)))
      linarith
    · rw [show 2 * V0 * V1 - y * (2 * G0 * G1) - (2 * U0 * U1 - y * (2 * F0 * F1)) =
          2 * ((V0 - U0) * V1) + 2 * (U0 * (V1 - U1)) + -2 * y * ((G0 - F0) * G1) +
            -2 * y * (F0 * (G1 - F1)) by ring]
      have t1 := hprod _ _ _ _ h2a (hprod _ _ _ _ bq bV1)
      have t2 := hprod _ _ _ _ h2a (hprod _ _ _ _ bU bq1)
      have t3 := hprod _ _ _ _ hn2y (hprod _ _ _ _ bp bG1)
      have t4 := hprod _ _ _ _ hn2y (hprod _ _ _ _ bF bp1)
      have s1 := abs_add_le (2 * ((V0 - U0) * V1) + 2 * (U0 * (V1 - U1)) +
        -2 * y * ((G0 - F0) * G1)) (-2 * y * (F0 * (G1 - F1)))
      have s2 := abs_add_le (2 * ((V0 - U0) * V1) + 2 * (U0 * (V1 - U1)))
        (-2 * y * ((G0 - F0) * G1))
      have s3 := abs_add_le (2 * ((V0 - U0) * V1)) (2 * (U0 * (V1 - U1)))
      linarith
    · rw [show G0 ^ 2 - F0 ^ 2 = (G0 - F0) * (G0 + F0) by ring]
      have t1 := hprod _ _ _ _ bp bGF
      linarith
    · rw [show 2 * G0 * G1 - 2 * F0 * F1 = 2 * ((G0 - F0) * G1) + 2 * (F0 * (G1 - F1)) by ring]
      have t1 := hprod _ _ _ _ h2a (hprod _ _ _ _ bp bG1)
      have t2 := hprod _ _ _ _ h2a (hprod _ _ _ _ bF bp1)
      have s1 := abs_add_le (2 * ((G0 - F0) * G1)) (2 * (F0 * (G1 - F1)))
      linarith
  
  
  
  have key : ∀ ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
      axgeGood (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (Icc Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (↿ψ) →
      (∀ y η : ℝ, a ≤ y → y ≤ b → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        |ψ y η| ≤ 8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2 * ε ∧
        |deriv (fun t => ψ y t) η| ≤ 8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2 * ε) →
      EtaJet ((b - a) * (8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2) * ε) (fun η => -∫ x in a..b, ψ x η) := by
    intro ψ hψ hpw
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿ψ) (Ioo Xm Xp ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
      hψ.1.mono (fun z hz => ⟨lt_trans hXm hz.1.1, hz.2⟩)
    obtain ⟨hs, hbd⟩ := param_int_eta_jet ψ Xm a b Xp (-1) 1 hXma hab.le hbXp (by norm_num) hsm
    refine ⟨hs.neg, fun m => ?_, fun η h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hψ.2 m
      refine ⟨(b - a) * C, fun η h1 h2 => ?_⟩
      have hm := hbd m η C h1 h2 (fun y hy1 hy2 =>
        (L1 (↿ψ) _ y hO hψ.1 m η ⟨show (0:ℝ) < y by linarith, h1, h2⟩).trans
          (hC (y, η) ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, h1, h2⟩))
      show |iteratedDeriv m (-(fun η => ∫ x in a..b, ψ x η)) η| ≤ _
      rw [iteratedDeriv_neg, abs_neg]
      exact hm
    · have hb0 := hbd 0 η (8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2 * ε) h1 h2 (fun y hy1 hy2 => by
        rw [iteratedDeriv_zero]; exact (hpw y η hy1 hy2 h1 h2).1)
      have hb1 := hbd 1 η (8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2 * ε) h1 h2 (fun y hy1 hy2 => by
        rw [iteratedDeriv_one]; exact (hpw y η hy1 hy2 h1 h2).2)
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero] at hb0
      have hab' : 0 ≤ b - a := by linarith
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · show |-(∫ x in a..b, ψ x η)| ≤ _
        rw [abs_neg]
        have h0 : |∫ x in a..b, ψ x η| ≤ (b - a) * (8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2 * ε) := hb0
        linarith
      · have e1 : deriv (fun η => -∫ x in a..b, ψ x η) η =
            -(iteratedDeriv 1 (fun η => ∫ x in a..b, ψ x η) η) := by
          show deriv (-(fun η => ∫ x in a..b, ψ x η)) η = _
          rw [← iteratedDeriv_one, iteratedDeriv_neg]
        rw [e1, abs_neg]
        linarith
  
  
  
  have J0 := key (fun x t => V x t - U x t) (gsub (↿V) (↿U) gV gU)
    (fun y η h1 h2 h3 h4 => (pw y η h1 h2 h3 h4).1)
  have J1 := key (fun x t => 2 * x * (G x t - F x t))
    (gmul (fun z => 2 * z.1) (fun z => (↿G) z - (↿F) z) g2x (gsub (↿G) (↿F) gG gF))
    (fun y η h1 h2 h3 h4 => (pw y η h1 h2 h3 h4).2.1)
  have J2 := key (fun x t => V x t * (2 * x * G x t) - U x t * (2 * x * F x t))
    (gsub (fun z => (↿V) z * (2 * z.1 * (↿G) z)) (fun z => (↿U) z * (2 * z.1 * (↿F) z))
      (gmul (↿V) (fun z => 2 * z.1 * (↿G) z) gV (gmul (fun z => 2 * z.1) (↿G) g2x gG))
      (gmul (↿U) (fun z => 2 * z.1 * (↿F) z) gU (gmul (fun z => 2 * z.1) (↿F) g2x gF)))
    (fun y η h1 h2 h3 h4 => (pw y η h1 h2 h3 h4).2.2.1)
  have J3 := key (fun x t => (V x t ^ 2 - x * G x t ^ 2) - (U x t ^ 2 - x * F x t ^ 2)) (by
      have e : (↿(fun x t : ℝ => (V x t ^ 2 - x * G x t ^ 2) - (U x t ^ 2 - x * F x t ^ 2))) =
          fun z : ℝ × ℝ => ((↿V) z ^ 2 - z.1 * (↿G) z ^ 2) - ((↿U) z ^ 2 - z.1 * (↿F) z ^ 2) := by
        funext z
        rfl
      rw [e]
      exact gsub (fun z => (↿V) z ^ 2 - z.1 * (↿G) z ^ 2) (fun z => (↿U) z ^ 2 - z.1 * (↿F) z ^ 2)
        (gsub (fun z => (↿V) z ^ 2) (fun z => z.1 * (↿G) z ^ 2) (gsq (↿V) gV)
          (gmul (fun z => z.1) (fun z => (↿G) z ^ 2) gfst (gsq (↿G) gG)))
        (gsub (fun z => (↿U) z ^ 2) (fun z => z.1 * (↿F) z ^ 2) (gsq (↿U) gU)
          (gmul (fun z => z.1) (fun z => (↿F) z ^ 2) gfst (gsq (↿F) gF))))
    (fun y η h1 h2 h3 h4 => (pw y η h1 h2 h3 h4).2.2.2.1)
  have J4 := key (fun x t => G x t ^ 2 - F x t ^ 2) (by
      have e : (↿(fun x t : ℝ => G x t ^ 2 - F x t ^ 2)) =
          fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (↿G) z ^ 2 - (↿F) z ^ 2 := by
        funext z
        rfl
      rw [e]
      exact gsub (fun z => (↿G) z ^ 2) (fun z => (↿F) z ^ 2) (gsq (↿G) gG) (gsq (↿F) gF))
    (fun y η h1 h2 h3 h4 => (pw y η h1 h2 h3 h4).2.2.2.2)
  have hM : 0 ≤ (b - a) * (8 * (1 + Xp) * (B + 1) ^ 2) * ε :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (by linarith))
      (sq_nonneg _))) he0
  obtain ⟨hbd, hsm, hjt⟩ := fin5_vector_jets _ (rcDisc a b F U G V) _ _ _ _ _ hM J0 J1 J2 J3 J4
    (fun η _ _ => ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩)
  exact ⟨hsm, hjt, hbd⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: param_int_eta_jet
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a' a b b' c d : ℝ), a' < a → a ≤ b → b < b' → c < d → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿ψ) (Ioo a' b' ×ˢ Ioo c d) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) (Ioo c d) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (η B : ℝ), c < η → η < d → (∀ y : ℝ, a ≤ y → y ≤ b → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ψ y e) η| ≤ B) → |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => ∫ y in a..b, ψ y e) η| ≤ (b - a) * B

subgoal_signatures.name: fin5_vector_jets
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (M : ℝ) (d : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ) (r0 r1 r2 r3 r4 : ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ M → EtaJet M r0 → EtaJet M r1 → EtaJet M r2 → EtaJet M r3 → EtaJet M r4 → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → d η 0 = r0 η ∧ d η 1 = r1 η ∧ d η 2 = r2 η ∧ d η 3 = r3 η ∧ d η 4 = r4 η) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖d η‖ ≤ M ∧ ‖deriv d η‖ ≤ M) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ d (Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedDeriv m d η‖ ≤ K

subgoal_signatures.name: slice_deriv_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (x y : ℝ), IsOpen S → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) S → (x, y) ∈ S → HasDerivAt (fun X => f X y) (deriv (fun X => f X y) x) x ∧ HasDerivAt (fun e => f x e) (deriv (fun e => f x e) y) y ∧ |deriv (fun X => f X y) x| ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (↿f) (x, y)‖ ∧ |deriv (fun e => f x e) y| ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (↿f) (x, y)‖ ∧ ContinuousAt (fun e => deriv (fun X => f X e) x) y ∧ ContinuousAt (fun X => deriv (fun e => f X e) y) x

subgoal_signatures.name: iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_bounded_on
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {E F G H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] H) (f : E → F) (g : E → G) (O S : Set E), IsOpen O → S ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g O → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z‖ ≤ C) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g z‖ ≤ C) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) z‖ ≤ C

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (s1 s2 : ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (β i)) → (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (γ j)) → (∀ i x, (x ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ x) → β i x = 0) → (∀ j x, (x ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ x) → γ j x = 0) → ∃ Γ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Γ ∧ ∀ (θ : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ), AxCoef θ c → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(rcRF γ c)) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(rcRU β c)) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(rcRF γ c)) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(rcRU β c)) z‖ ≤ C) ∧ ∀ X η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → HasDerivAt (fun e => rcRF γ c X e) (deriv (fun e => rcRF γ c X e) η) η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun e => rcRU β c X e) (deriv (fun e => rcRU β c X e) η) η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => rcRF γ c Y η) (deriv (fun Y => rcRF γ c Y η) X) X ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => rcRU β c Y η) (deriv (fun Y => rcRU β c Y η) X) X ∧ |rcRF γ c X η| ≤ Γ * θ ∧ |rcRU β c X η| ≤ Γ * θ ∧ |deriv (fun e => rcRF γ c X e) η| ≤ Γ * θ ∧ |deriv (fun e => rcRU β c X e) η| ≤ Γ * θ ∧ |deriv (fun Y => rcRF γ c Y η) X| ≤ Γ * θ ∧ |deriv (fun Y => rcRU β c Y η) X| ≤ Γ * θ

signature.name: rc_bump_regular
signature.statement: ∀ (s1 s2 : ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (β i)) → (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (γ j)) → (∀ i x, (x ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ x) → β i x = 0) → (∀ j x, (x ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ x) → γ j x = 0) → ∃ Γ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Γ ∧ ∀ (θ : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Fin 5 → ℝ), AxCoef θ c → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(rcRF γ c)) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(rcRU β c)) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(rcRF γ c)) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(rcRU β c)) z‖ ≤ C) ∧ ∀ X η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → HasDerivAt (fun e => rcRF γ c X e) (deriv (fun e => rcRF γ c X e) η) η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun e => rcRU β c X e) (deriv (fun e => rcRU β c X e) η) η ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => rcRF γ c Y η) (deriv (fun Y => rcRF γ c Y η) X) X ∧ HasDerivAt (fun Y => rcRU β c Y η) (deriv (fun Y => rcRU β c Y η) X) X ∧ |rcRF γ c X η| ≤ Γ * θ ∧ |rcRU β c X η| ≤ Γ * θ ∧ |deriv (fun e => rcRF γ c X e) η| ≤ Γ * θ ∧ |deriv (fun e => rcRU β c X e) η| ≤ Γ * θ ∧ |deriv (fun Y => rcRF γ c Y η) X| ≤ Γ * θ ∧ |deriv (fun Y => rcRU β c Y η) X| ≤ Γ * θ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro s1 s2 β γ hβs hγs hβ0 hγ0
  have hout : ∀ x : ℝ, x ∉ Icc s1 s2 → (x ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ x) := by
    intro x hx

    push_neg at h
    exact hx ⟨h.1.le, h.2.le⟩
  
  have hsup : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → (∀ x, (x ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ x) → g x = 0) →
      ∃ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ x, |g x| ≤ A ∧ |deriv g x| ≤ A := by
    intro g hg hg0
    have hcs : HasCompactSupport g :=
      HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_Icc (a := s1) (b := s2)) (fun x hx => hg0 x (hout x hx))
    obtain ⟨M0, hM0⟩ := hg.continuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support hcs
    obtain ⟨M1, hM1⟩ :=
      (hg.continuous_deriv (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).bounded_above_of_compact_support hcs.deriv
    refine ⟨max (max M0 M1) 0, le_max_right _ _, fun x => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact (hM0 x).trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _))
    · rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact (hM1 x).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _))
  
  have hGjet : ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (g j)) →
      (∀ j x, (x ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ x) → g j x = 0) →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => fun j => g j z.1) ∧
        ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => fun j => g j z.1) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro n g hg hg0
    obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ → Fin n → ℝ, G = fun x j => g j x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hGs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G := by rw [hG]; exact contDiff_pi.2 hg
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ, L = ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hLz : ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ, L z = z.1 := by intro z; rw [hL]; rfl
    have e1 : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => fun j => g j z.1) = G ∘ L := by
      funext z; simp only [Function.comp, hLz, hG]
    have hcs : HasCompactSupport G := by
      refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_Icc (a := s1) (b := s2)) (fun x hx => ?_)
      rw [hG]
      funext j
      exact hg0 j x (hout x hx)
    rw [e1]
    refine ⟨hGs.comp L.contDiff, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (ContDiff.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (m := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      hGs).bounded_above_of_compact_support (hcs.iteratedFDeriv k)
    refine ⟨C, fun z => ?_⟩
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right L hGs z (by exact_mod_cast le_top)]
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
    have hp : ∏ _i : Fin k, ‖L‖ ≤ 1 := Finset.prod_le_one₀ (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)
      (fun _ _ => by rw [hL]; exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_fst_le ℝ ℝ ℝ)
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k G (L z)‖ * ∏ _i : Fin k, ‖L‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k G (L z)‖ * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ C := by rw [mul_one]; exact hC _
  
  obtain ⟨A1, hA1, hb1⟩ := hsup (β 0) (hβs 0) (hβ0 0)
  obtain ⟨A2, hA2, hb2⟩ := hsup (β 1) (hβs 1) (hβ0 1)
  obtain ⟨A3, hA3, hg1⟩ := hsup (γ 0) (hγs 0) (hγ0 0)
  obtain ⟨A4, hA4, hg2⟩ := hsup (γ 1) (hγs 1) (hγ0 1)
  obtain ⟨A5, hA5, hg3⟩ := hsup (γ 2) (hγs 2) (hγ0 2)
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = max (max (max (max A1 A2) A3) A4) A5 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have e1 : A1 ≤ A := by
    rw [hA]; exact le_max_of_le_left (le_max_of_le_left (le_max_of_le_left (le_max_left _ _)))
  have e2 : A2 ≤ A := by
    rw [hA]; exact le_max_of_le_left (le_max_of_le_left (le_max_of_le_left (le_max_right _ _)))
  have e3 : A3 ≤ A := by
    rw [hA]; exact le_max_of_le_left (le_max_of_le_left (le_max_right _ _))
  have e4 : A4 ≤ A := by
    rw [hA]; exact le_max_of_le_left (le_max_right _ _)
  have e5 : A5 ≤ A := by
    rw [hA]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := hA1.trans e1
  refine ⟨3 * A, by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro θ c hAx
  obtain ⟨hcs, hcjet, hcθ⟩ := hAx
  set O : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 with hOdef
  have hO : IsOpen O := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioo
  
  have hbil : ∀ {F G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G]
      [NormedSpace ℝ G] (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] ℝ) (f : ℝ × ℝ → F) (g : ℝ × ℝ → G),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g O →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ O, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z‖ ≤ C) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ O, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g z‖ ≤ C) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ O, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro F G _ _ _ _ B f g hf hg hbf hbg k
    choose Cf hCf using hbf
    choose Cg hCg using hbg
    refine ⟨‖B‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
        (k.choose i : ℝ) * max (Cf i) 0 * max (Cg (k - i)) 0, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hU : UniqueDiffOn ℝ O := hO.uniqueDiffOn
    have key := ContinuousLinearMap.norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_le_of_bilinear B hf hg hU hz
      (n := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hO hz] at key
    refine key.trans ?_
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg B)
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO hz, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (k - i) hO hz]
    have h1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f z‖ ≤ max (Cf i) 0 := (hCf i z hz).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have h2 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) g z‖ ≤ max (Cg (k - i)) 0 :=
      (hCg (k - i) z hz).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k.choose i := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 h0) h2 (norm_nonneg _)
      (mul_nonneg h0 (le_max_right _ _))
  
  have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => c z.2) O :=
    hcs.comp contDiff_snd.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz.2)
  have hfjet : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ O, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => c z.2) z‖ ≤ C := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hcjet k
    refine ⟨K, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ, L = ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hLz : ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ, L z = z.2 := by intro z; rw [hL]; rfl
    have hPo : IsOpen (L ⁻¹' Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioo.preimage L.continuous
    have hz2 : L z ∈ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := by rw [hLz]; exact hz.2
    have hzP : z ∈ L ⁻¹' Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := hz2
    have e0 : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => c z.2) = c ∘ L := by funext z; simp only [Function.comp, hLz]
    rw [e0, ← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hPo hzP,
      ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L hcs isOpen_Ioo.uniqueDiffOn
        hPo.uniqueDiffOn hz2 (by exact_mod_cast le_top),
      iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k isOpen_Ioo hz2]
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
    have hp : ∏ _i : Fin k, ‖L‖ ≤ 1 := Finset.prod_le_one₀ (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)
      (fun _ _ => by rw [hL]; exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_snd_le ℝ ℝ ℝ)
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k c (L z)‖ * ∏ _i : Fin k, ‖L‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k c (L z)‖ * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖iteratedDeriv k c (L z)‖ := by rw [mul_one, norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
      _ ≤ K := hK _ hz2.1 hz2.2
  
  obtain ⟨BF, hBF⟩ : ∃ BF : (Fin 5 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ,
      ∀ a b, BF a b = a 2 * b 0 + a 3 * b 1 + a 4 * b 2 :=
    ⟨(ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ).bilinearComp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 5 => ℝ) 2)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 0) +
      (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ).bilinearComp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 5 => ℝ) 3)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 1) +
      (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ).bilinearComp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 5 => ℝ) 4)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 2),
      fun a b => by
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply']⟩
  obtain ⟨BU, hBU⟩ : ∃ BU : (Fin 5 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ,
      ∀ a b, BU a b = a 0 * b 0 + a 1 * b 1 :=
    ⟨(ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ).bilinearComp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 5 => ℝ) 0)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) 0) +
      (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ).bilinearComp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 5 => ℝ) 1)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) 1),
      fun a b => by
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply']⟩
  have hRF : (↿(rcRF γ c)) = fun z : ℝ × ℝ => BF (c z.2) (fun j => γ j z.1) := by
    funext z; rw [hBF]; rfl
  have hRU : (↿(rcRU β c)) = fun z : ℝ × ℝ => BU (c z.2) (fun i => β i z.1) := by
    funext z; rw [hBU]; rfl
  obtain ⟨hGγs, hGγj⟩ := hGjet 3 γ hγs hγ0
  obtain ⟨hGβs, hGβj⟩ := hGjet 2 β hβs hβ0
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hRF]
    exact (BF.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hf).clm_apply hGγs.contDiffOn
  · rw [hRU]
    exact (BU.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hf).clm_apply hGβs.contDiffOn
  · intro m
    obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hbil BF (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => c z.2) (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => fun j => γ j z.1) hf
      hGγs.contDiffOn hfjet (fun k => (hGγj k).imp fun C hC z _ => hC z) m
    obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := hbil BU (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => c z.2) (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => fun i => β i z.1) hf
      hGβs.contDiffOn hfjet (fun k => (hGβj k).imp fun C hC z _ => hC z) m
    refine ⟨max C1 C2, fun z hz => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [hRF]; exact (hC1 z hz).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · rw [hRU]; exact (hC2 z hz).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  · intro X η h1 h2
    obtain ⟨hcn, hcd⟩ := hcθ η h1 h2
    have hθ : 0 ≤ θ := (norm_nonneg _).trans hcn
    have hck : ∀ k, |c η k| ≤ θ := fun k => by
      rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact (norm_le_pi_norm (c η) k).trans hcn
    have hcdk : ∀ k, |deriv c η k| ≤ θ := fun k => by
      rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact (norm_le_pi_norm (deriv c η) k).trans hcd
    have hcdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ c η :=
      (hcs.contDiffAt (Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hcD : ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun e => c e k) (deriv c η k) η :=
      fun k => hasDerivAt_pi.1 hcdiff.hasDerivAt k
    have hβd : ∀ i, HasDerivAt (β i) (deriv (β i) X) X :=
      fun i => ((hβs i).differentiable (by simp) X).hasDerivAt
    have hγd : ∀ j, HasDerivAt (γ j) (deriv (γ j) X) X :=
      fun j => ((hγs j).differentiable (by simp) X).hasDerivAt
    have dF1 : HasDerivAt (fun e => rcRF γ c X e)
        (deriv c η 2 * γ 0 X + deriv c η 3 * γ 1 X + deriv c η 4 * γ 2 X) η :=
      (((hcD 2).mul_const (γ 0 X)).add ((hcD 3).mul_const (γ 1 X))).add ((hcD 4).mul_const (γ 2 X))
    have dU1 : HasDerivAt (fun e => rcRU β c X e) (deriv c η 0 * β 0 X + deriv c η 1 * β 1 X) η :=
      ((hcD 0).mul_const (β 0 X)).add ((hcD 1).mul_const (β 1 X))
    have dF2 : HasDerivAt (fun Y => rcRF γ c Y η)
        (c η 2 * deriv (γ 0) X + c η 3 * deriv (γ 1) X + c η 4 * deriv (γ 2) X) X :=
      (((hγd 0).const_mul (c η 2)).add ((hγd 1).const_mul (c η 3))).add ((hγd 2).const_mul (c η 4))
    have dU2 : HasDerivAt (fun Y => rcRU β c Y η) (c η 0 * deriv (β 0) X + c η 1 * deriv (β 1) X) X :=
      ((hβd 0).const_mul (c η 0)).add ((hβd 1).const_mul (c η 1))
    have tri : ∀ a1 a2 a3 b1 b2 b3 : ℝ, |a1| ≤ θ → |a2| ≤ θ → |a3| ≤ θ → |b1| ≤ A → |b2| ≤ A →
        |b3| ≤ A → |a1 * b1 + a2 * b2 + a3 * b3| ≤ 3 * A * θ := by
      intro a1 a2 a3 b1 b2 b3 k1 k2 k3 l1 l2 l3
      have m1 : |a1 * b1| ≤ θ * A := by rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul k1 l1 (abs_nonneg _) hθ
      have m2 : |a2 * b2| ≤ θ * A := by rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul k2 l2 (abs_nonneg _) hθ
      have m3 : |a3 * b3| ≤ θ * A := by rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul k3 l3 (abs_nonneg _) hθ
      have := abs_add_three (a1 * b1) (a2 * b2) (a3 * b3)
      linarith
    have duo : ∀ a1 a2 b1 b2 : ℝ, |a1| ≤ θ → |a2| ≤ θ → |b1| ≤ A → |b2| ≤ A →
        |a1 * b1 + a2 * b2| ≤ 3 * A * θ := by
      intro a1 a2 b1 b2 k1 k2 l1 l2
      have m1 : |a1 * b1| ≤ θ * A := by rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul k1 l1 (abs_nonneg _) hθ
      have m2 : |a2 * b2| ≤ θ * A := by rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul k2 l2 (abs_nonneg _) hθ
      have := abs_add_le (a1 * b1) (a2 * b2)
      have : 0 ≤ θ * A := mul_nonneg hθ hA0
      linarith
    rw [dF1.deriv, dU1.deriv, dF2.deriv, dU2.deriv]
    refine ⟨dF1, dU1, dF2, dU2, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (hck 2) (hck 3) (hck 4) ((hg1 X).1.trans e3) ((hg2 X).1.trans e4)
        ((hg3 X).1.trans e5)
    · exact duo _ _ _ _ (hck 0) (hck 1) ((hb1 X).1.trans e1) ((hb2 X).1.trans e2)
    · exact tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (hcdk 2) (hcdk 3) (hcdk 4) ((hg1 X).1.trans e3) ((hg2 X).1.trans e4)
        ((hg3 X).1.trans e5)
    · exact duo _ _ _ _ (hcdk 0) (hcdk 1) ((hb1 X).1.trans e1) ((hb2 X).1.trans e2)
    · exact tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (hck 2) (hck 3) (hck 4) ((hg1 X).2.trans e3) ((hg2 X).2.trans e4)
        ((hg3 X).2.trans e5)
    · exact duo _ _ _ _ (hck 0) (hck 1) ((hb1 X).2.trans e1) ((hb2 X).2.trans e2)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (f u g v rF rU f0 fP : ℝ → ℝ) (a b r1 s2 r2 : ℝ) (d : Fin 5 → ℝ), 0 < a → a < b → b < r1 → r1 < s2 → s2 < r2 → ContinuousOn f (Icc 0 r2) → ContinuousOn u (Icc 0 r2) → ContinuousOn g (Icc a b) → ContinuousOn v (Icc a b) → Continuous rF → Continuous rU → (∀ x : ℝ, (x ≤ a ∨ b ≤ x) → g x = f x ∧ v x = u x) → (∀ x : ℝ, (x ≤ r1 ∨ s2 ≤ x) → rF x = 0 ∧ rU x = 0) → (∀ x : ℝ, r1 ≤ x → x ≤ r2 → u x = 0 ∧ f x = f0 x) → (∀ x : ℝ, fP x = f0 x + rF x) → IntegrableOn (fun x => f x ^ 2) (Ioi 0) → d 0 = -∫ x in a..b, (v x - u x) → d 1 = -∫ x in a..b, 2 * x * (g x - f x) → d 2 = -∫ x in a..b, (v x * (2 * x * g x) - u x * (2 * x * f x)) → d 3 = -∫ x in a..b, ((v x ^ 2 - x * g x ^ 2) - (u x ^ 2 - x * f x ^ 2)) → d 4 = -∫ x in a..b, (g x ^ 2 - f x ^ 2) → (∫ x in r1..r2, rU x) = d 0 → (∫ x in r1..r2, 2 * x * (fP x - f0 x)) = d 1 → (∫ x in r1..r2, rU x * (2 * x * fP x)) = d 2 → (∫ x in r1..r2, (rU x ^ 2 - x * fP x ^ 2 + x * f0 x ^ 2)) = d 3 → (∫ x in r1..r2, (fP x ^ 2 - f0 x ^ 2)) = d 4 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, (v x + rU x)) = (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, u x) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, 2 * x * (g x + rF x)) = (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, 2 * x * f x) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, (v x + rU x) * (2 * x * (g x + rF x))) = (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, u x * (2 * x * f x)) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, ((v x + rU x) ^ 2 - x * (g x + rF x) ^ 2)) = (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, (u x ^ 2 - x * f x ^ 2)) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => (g x + rF x) ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (g x + rF x) ^ 2) = ∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), f x ^ 2

signature.statement: ∀ (f u g v rF rU f0 fP : ℝ → ℝ) (a b r1 s2 r2 : ℝ) (d : Fin 5 → ℝ), 0 < a → a < b → b < r1 → r1 < s2 → s2 < r2 → ContinuousOn f (Icc 0 r2) → ContinuousOn u (Icc 0 r2) → ContinuousOn g (Icc a b) → ContinuousOn v (Icc a b) → Continuous rF → Continuous rU → (∀ x : ℝ, (x ≤ a ∨ b ≤ x) → g x = f x ∧ v x = u x) → (∀ x : ℝ, (x ≤ r1 ∨ s2 ≤ x) → rF x = 0 ∧ rU x = 0) → (∀ x : ℝ, r1 ≤ x → x ≤ r2 → u x = 0 ∧ f x = f0 x) → (∀ x : ℝ, fP x = f0 x + rF x) → IntegrableOn (fun x => f x ^ 2) (Ioi 0) → d 0 = -∫ x in a..b, (v x - u x) → d 1 = -∫ x in a..b, 2 * x * (g x - f x) → d 2 = -∫ x in a..b, (v x * (2 * x * g x) - u x * (2 * x * f x)) → d 3 = -∫ x in a..b, ((v x ^ 2 - x * g x ^ 2) - (u x ^ 2 - x * f x ^ 2)) → d 4 = -∫ x in a..b, (g x ^ 2 - f x ^ 2) → (∫ x in r1..r2, rU x) = d 0 → (∫ x in r1..r2, 2 * x * (fP x - f0 x)) = d 1 → (∫ x in r1..r2, rU x * (2 * x * fP x)) = d 2 → (∫ x in r1..r2, (rU x ^ 2 - x * fP x ^ 2 + x * f0 x ^ 2)) = d 3 → (∫ x in r1..r2, (fP x ^ 2 - f0 x ^ 2)) = d 4 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, (v x + rU x)) = (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, u x) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, 2 * x * (g x + rF x)) = (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, 2 * x * f x) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, (v x + rU x) * (2 * x * (g x + rF x))) = (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, u x * (2 * x * f x)) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, ((v x + rU x) ^ 2 - x * (g x + rF x) ^ 2)) = (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, (u x ^ 2 - x * f x ^ 2)) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => (g x + rF x) ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (g x + rF x) ^ 2) = ∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), f x ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro f u g v rF rU f0 fP a b r1 s2 r2 d ha hab hbr1 hr1s2 hs2r2 hf hu hg hv hrF hrU hW hZ hP hfP
    hInt hd0 hd1 hd2 hd3 hd4 hR0 hR1 hR2 hR3 hR4
  
  have glue : ∀ (F G : ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn F (Icc 0 r2) → ContinuousOn G (Icc a b) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, (x ≤ a ∨ b ≤ x) → G x = F x) → ContinuousOn G (Icc 0 r2) := by
    intro F G hF hG hGF
    have h1 : ContinuousOn G (Icc 0 a) :=
      (hF.mono (Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl (by linarith))).congr (fun x hx => hGF x (Or.inl hx.2))
    have h3 : ContinuousOn G (Icc b r2) :=
      (hF.mono (Icc_subset_Icc (by linarith) le_rfl)).congr (fun x hx => hGF x (Or.inr hx.1))
    have h12 : ContinuousOn G (Icc 0 b) := by
      rw [← Icc_union_Icc_eq_Icc ha.le hab.le]
      exact h1.union_of_isClosed hG isClosed_Icc isClosed_Icc
    rw [← Icc_union_Icc_eq_Icc (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ b) (by linarith : b ≤ r2)]
    exact h12.union_of_isClosed h3 isClosed_Icc isClosed_Icc
  have hsub : Icc (0:ℝ) s2 ⊆ Icc 0 r2 := Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hs2r2.le
  have hg2 : ContinuousOn g (Icc 0 s2) := (glue f g hf hg (fun x hx => (hW x hx).1)).mono hsub
  have hv2 : ContinuousOn v (Icc 0 s2) := (glue u v hu hv (fun x hx => (hW x hx).2)).mono hsub
  have hf2 : ContinuousOn f (Icc 0 s2) := hf.mono hsub
  have hu2 : ContinuousOn u (Icc 0 s2) := hu.mono hsub
  have hrF2 : ContinuousOn rF (Icc 0 s2) := hrF.continuousOn
  have hrU2 : ContinuousOn rU (Icc 0 s2) := hrU.continuousOn
  have hrF1 : ContinuousOn rF (Icc r1 r2) := hrF.continuousOn
  have hrU1 : ContinuousOn rU (Icc r1 r2) := hrU.continuousOn
  have hf01 : ContinuousOn f0 (Icc r1 r2) :=
    (hf.mono (Icc_subset_Icc (by linarith) le_rfl)).congr (fun x hx => (hP x hx.1 hx.2).2.symm)
  have hfP1 : ContinuousOn fP (Icc r1 r2) :=
    (hf01.add hrF1).congr (fun x _ => hfP x)
  have II0 : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn φ (Icc 0 s2) → IntervalIntegrable φ volume 0 s2 := by
    intro φ hφ
    apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
    rw [uIcc_of_le (by linarith)]
    exact hφ
  have II1 : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn φ (Icc r1 r2) → IntervalIntegrable φ volume r1 r2 := by
    intro φ hφ
    apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
    rw [uIcc_of_le (by linarith)]
    exact hφ
  
  have split : ∀ (D Q P : ℝ → ℝ), IntervalIntegrable D volume 0 s2 →
      IntervalIntegrable P volume r1 r2 →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ a → D x = 0) → (∀ x : ℝ, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → D x = Q x) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, b ≤ x → x ≤ r1 → D x = 0) → (∀ x : ℝ, r1 ≤ x → x ≤ s2 → D x = P x) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, s2 ≤ x → x ≤ r2 → P x = 0) →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, D x) = (∫ x in a..b, Q x) + ∫ x in r1..r2, P x := by
    intro D Q P hD hPi h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
    have m : ∀ p q : ℝ, 0 ≤ p → p ≤ q → q ≤ s2 → IntervalIntegrable D volume p q := by
      intro p q hp hpq hq
      apply hD.mono_set
      rw [uIcc_of_le hpq, uIcc_of_le (by linarith)]
      exact Icc_subset_Icc hp hq
    have mP : ∀ p q : ℝ, r1 ≤ p → p ≤ q → q ≤ r2 → IntervalIntegrable P volume p q := by
      intro p q hp hpq hq
      apply hPi.mono_set
      rw [uIcc_of_le hpq, uIcc_of_le (by linarith)]
      exact Icc_subset_Icc hp hq
    have e1 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (m 0 a le_rfl ha.le (by linarith))
      (m a b ha.le hab.le (by linarith))
    have e2 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
      (m 0 b le_rfl (by linarith) (by linarith)) (m b r1 (by linarith) hbr1.le (by linarith))
    have e3 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
      (m 0 r1 le_rfl (by linarith) (by linarith)) (m r1 s2 (by linarith) hr1s2.le le_rfl)
    have e4 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
      (mP r1 s2 le_rfl hr1s2.le hs2r2.le) (mP s2 r2 hr1s2.le hs2r2.le le_rfl)
    have z1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..a, D x) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..a, (0:ℝ) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x hx
      rw [uIcc_of_le ha.le] at hx
      exact h1 x hx.1 hx.2
    have z2 : (∫ x in a..b, D x) = ∫ x in a..b, Q x := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x hx
      rw [uIcc_of_le hab.le] at hx
      exact h2 x hx.1 hx.2
    have z3 : (∫ x in b..r1, D x) = ∫ x in b..r1, (0:ℝ) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x hx
      rw [uIcc_of_le hbr1.le] at hx
      exact h3 x hx.1 hx.2
    have z4 : (∫ x in r1..s2, D x) = ∫ x in r1..s2, P x := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x hx
      rw [uIcc_of_le hr1s2.le] at hx
      exact h4 x hx.1 hx.2
    have z5 : (∫ x in s2..r2, P x) = ∫ x in s2..r2, (0:ℝ) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x hx
      rw [uIcc_of_le hs2r2.le] at hx
      exact h5 x hx.1 hx.2
    simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_zero] at z1 z3 z5
    linarith
  
  have k0 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, ((v x + rU x) - u x)) =
      (∫ x in a..b, (v x - u x)) + ∫ x in r1..r2, rU x := by
    refine split (fun x => (v x + rU x) - u x) (fun x => v x - u x) (fun x => rU x)
      (II0 _ (by fun_prop)) (II1 _ (by fun_prop)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro x _ hx
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hW x (Or.inl hx)
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := hZ x (Or.inl (by linarith))
      simp only [e1, e2, z1, z2] <;> ring
    · intro x _ hx
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := hZ x (Or.inl (by linarith))
      simp only [z1, z2] <;> ring
    · intro x hx hx'
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hW x (Or.inr hx)
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := hZ x (Or.inl hx')
      simp only [e1, e2, z1, z2] <;> ring
    · intro x hx hx'
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hW x (Or.inr (by linarith))
      obtain ⟨p1, p2⟩ := hP x hx (by linarith)
      simp only [e1, e2, p1, p2, hfP x] <;> ring
    · intro x hx _
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := hZ x (Or.inr hx)
      simp only [z1, z2, hfP x] <;> ring
  have k1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, (2 * x * (g x + rF x) - 2 * x * f x)) =
      (∫ x in a..b, 2 * x * (g x - f x)) + ∫ x in r1..r2, 2 * x * (fP x - f0 x) := by
    refine split (fun x => 2 * x * (g x + rF x) - 2 * x * f x) (fun x => 2 * x * (g x - f x))
      (fun x => 2 * x * (fP x - f0 x)) (II0 _ (by fun_prop)) (II1 _ (by fun_prop)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro x _ hx
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hW x (Or.inl hx)
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := hZ x (Or.inl (by linarith))
      simp only [e1, e2, z1, z2] <;> ring
    · intro x _ hx
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := hZ x (Or.inl (by linarith))
      simp only [z1, z2] <;> ring
    · intro x hx hx'
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hW x (Or.inr hx)
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := hZ x (Or.inl hx')
      simp only [e1, e2, z1, z2] <;> ring
    · intro x hx hx'
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hW x (Or.inr (by linarith))
      obtain ⟨p1, p2⟩ := hP x hx (by linarith)
      simp only [e1, e2, p1, p2, hfP x] <;> ring
    · intro x hx _
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := hZ x (Or.inr hx)
      simp only [z1, z2, hfP x] <;> ring
  have k2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, ((v x + rU x) * (2 * x * (g x + rF x)) - u x * (2 * x * f x))) =
      (∫ x in a..b, (v x * (2 * x * g x) - u x * (2 * x * f x))) +
        ∫ x in r1..r2, rU x * (2 * x * fP x) := by
    refine split (fun x => (v x + rU x) * (2 * x * (g x + rF x)) - u x * (2 * x * f x))
      (fun x => v x * (2 * x * g x) - u x * (2 * x * f x))
      (fun x => rU x * (2 * x * fP x)) (II0 _ (by fun_prop)) (II1 _ (by fun_prop)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro x _ hx
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hW x (Or.inl hx)
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := hZ x (Or.inl (by linarith))
      simp only [e1, e2, z1, z2] <;> ring
    · intro x _ hx
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := hZ x (Or.inl (by linarith))
      simp only [z1, z2] <;> ring
    · intro x hx hx'
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hW x (Or.inr hx)
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := hZ x (Or.inl hx')
      simp only [e1, e2, z1, z2] <;> ring
    · intro x hx hx'
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hW x (Or.inr (by linarith))
      obtain ⟨p1, p2⟩ := hP x hx (by linarith)
      simp only [e1, e2, p1, p2, hfP x] <;> ring
    · intro x hx _
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := hZ x (Or.inr hx)
      simp only [z1, z2, hfP x] <;> ring
  have k3 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, (((v x + rU x) ^ 2 - x * (g x + rF x) ^ 2) - (u x ^ 2 - x * f x ^ 2))) =
      (∫ x in a..b, ((v x ^ 2 - x * g x ^ 2) - (u x ^ 2 - x * f x ^ 2))) +
        ∫ x in r1..r2, (rU x ^ 2 - x * fP x ^ 2 + x * f0 x ^ 2) := by
    refine split (fun x => ((v x + rU x) ^ 2 - x * (g x + rF x) ^ 2) - (u x ^ 2 - x * f x ^ 2))
      (fun x => (v x ^ 2 - x * g x ^ 2) - (u x ^ 2 - x * f x ^ 2))
      (fun x => rU x ^ 2 - x * fP x ^ 2 + x * f0 x ^ 2) (II0 _ (by fun_prop)) (II1 _ (by fun_prop))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro x _ hx
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hW x (Or.inl hx)
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := hZ x (Or.inl (by linarith))
      simp only [e1, e2, z1, z2] <;> ring
    · intro x _ hx
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := hZ x (Or.inl (by linarith))
      simp only [z1, z2] <;> ring
    · intro x hx hx'
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hW x (Or.inr hx)
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := hZ x (Or.inl hx')
      simp only [e1, e2, z1, z2] <;> ring
    · intro x hx hx'
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hW x (Or.inr (by linarith))
      obtain ⟨p1, p2⟩ := hP x hx (by linarith)
      simp only [e1, e2, p1, p2, hfP x] <;> ring
    · intro x hx _
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := hZ x (Or.inr hx)
      simp only [z1, z2, hfP x] <;> ring
  have k4 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, ((g x + rF x) ^ 2 - f x ^ 2)) =
      (∫ x in a..b, (g x ^ 2 - f x ^ 2)) + ∫ x in r1..r2, (fP x ^ 2 - f0 x ^ 2) := by
    refine split (fun x => (g x + rF x) ^ 2 - f x ^ 2) (fun x => g x ^ 2 - f x ^ 2)
      (fun x => fP x ^ 2 - f0 x ^ 2) (II0 _ (by fun_prop)) (II1 _ (by fun_prop)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro x _ hx
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hW x (Or.inl hx)
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := hZ x (Or.inl (by linarith))
      simp only [e1, e2, z1, z2] <;> ring
    · intro x _ hx
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := hZ x (Or.inl (by linarith))
      simp only [z1, z2] <;> ring
    · intro x hx hx'
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hW x (Or.inr hx)
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := hZ x (Or.inl hx')
      simp only [e1, e2, z1, z2] <;> ring
    · intro x hx hx'
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hW x (Or.inr (by linarith))
      obtain ⟨p1, p2⟩ := hP x hx (by linarith)
      simp only [e1, e2, p1, p2, hfP x] <;> ring
    · intro x hx _
      obtain ⟨z1, z2⟩ := hZ x (Or.inr hx)
      simp only [z1, z2, hfP x] <;> ring
  
  have s0 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, ((v x + rU x) - u x)) =
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, (v x + rU x)) - ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, u x :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_sub (II0 _ (by fun_prop)) (II0 _ (by fun_prop))
  have s1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, (2 * x * (g x + rF x) - 2 * x * f x)) =
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, 2 * x * (g x + rF x)) - ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, 2 * x * f x :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_sub (II0 _ (by fun_prop)) (II0 _ (by fun_prop))
  have s2' : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, ((v x + rU x) * (2 * x * (g x + rF x)) - u x * (2 * x * f x))) =
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, (v x + rU x) * (2 * x * (g x + rF x))) -
        ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, u x * (2 * x * f x) :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_sub (II0 _ (by fun_prop)) (II0 _ (by fun_prop))
  have s3 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, (((v x + rU x) ^ 2 - x * (g x + rF x) ^ 2) - (u x ^ 2 - x * f x ^ 2))) =
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, ((v x + rU x) ^ 2 - x * (g x + rF x) ^ 2)) -
        ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, (u x ^ 2 - x * f x ^ 2) :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_sub (II0 _ (by fun_prop)) (II0 _ (by fun_prop))
  have s4 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, ((g x + rF x) ^ 2 - f x ^ 2)) =
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, (g x + rF x) ^ 2) - ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..s2, f x ^ 2 :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_sub (II0 _ (by fun_prop)) (II0 _ (by fun_prop))
  
  have hs20 : (0:ℝ) ≤ s2 := by linarith
  have hφc : ContinuousOn (fun x => (g x + rF x) ^ 2) (Icc 0 s2) := by fun_prop
  have heq : ∀ x : ℝ, s2 < x → (g x + rF x) ^ 2 = f x ^ 2 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [(hW x (Or.inr (by linarith))).1, (hZ x (Or.inr hx.le)).1, add_zero]
  have hφIoc : IntegrableOn (fun x => (g x + rF x) ^ 2) (Ioc 0 s2) :=
    hφc.integrableOn_Icc.mono_set Ioc_subset_Icc_self
  have hψIoi : IntegrableOn (fun x => f x ^ 2) (Ioi s2) := hInt.mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi hs20)
  have hφIoi : IntegrableOn (fun x => (g x + rF x) ^ 2) (Ioi s2) :=
    hψIoi.congr_fun (fun x hx => (heq x hx).symm) measurableSet_Ioi
  have hψIoc : IntegrableOn (fun x => f x ^ 2) (Ioc 0 s2) := hInt.mono_set Ioc_subset_Ioi_self
  have hU : Ioi (0:ℝ) = Ioc 0 s2 ∪ Ioi s2 := (Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hs20).symm
  have hφint : IntegrableOn (fun x => (g x + rF x) ^ 2) (Ioi 0) := by
    rw [hU]; exact hφIoc.union hφIoi
  refine ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, hφint, ?_⟩
  rw [hU, setIntegral_union Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same measurableSet_Ioi hφIoc hφIoi,
    setIntegral_union Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same measurableSet_Ioi hψIoc hψIoi,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hs20, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hs20,
    setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun x hx => heq x hx)]
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h cinf Xb ε Xm Xp a b : ℝ) (F U G V RF RU F' U' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ε → 0 < Xm → Xm < a → a < b → b < Xp → Xp < Xb → ProfileReg h cinf Xb ε F U → (∀ X η : ℝ, (X ≤ a ∨ b ≤ X) → G X η = F X η ∧ V X η = U X η) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿V) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿G) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿V) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿RF) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿RU) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿RF) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿RU) z‖ ≤ C) → (∀ X η : ℝ, (X ≤ a ∨ Xb ≤ X) → RF X η = 0 ∧ RU X η = 0) → (∀ X η : ℝ, F' X η = G X η + RF X η ∧ U' X η = V X η + RU X η) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F' X η) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → IntegrableOn (fun x => F' x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0)) → ProfileReg h cinf Xb ε F' U'

signature.statement: ∀ (h cinf Xb ε Xm Xp a b : ℝ) (F U G V RF RU F' U' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ε → 0 < Xm → Xm < a → a < b → b < Xp → Xp < Xb → ProfileReg h cinf Xb ε F U → (∀ X η : ℝ, (X ≤ a ∨ b ≤ X) → G X η = F X η ∧ V X η = U X η) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿G) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿V) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿G) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿V) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿RF) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿RU) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿RF) z‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿RU) z‖ ≤ C) → (∀ X η : ℝ, (X ≤ a ∨ Xb ≤ X) → RF X η = 0 ∧ RU X η = 0) → (∀ X η : ℝ, F' X η = G X η + RF X η ∧ U' X η = V X η + RU X η) → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F' X η) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → IntegrableOn (fun x => F' x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0)) → ProfileReg h cinf Xb ε F' U'

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h cinf Xb ε Xm Xp a b F U G V RF RU F' U' hε hXm hXma hab hbXp hXpXb hPR hAgr hGs hVs hGbd
    hRFs hRUs hRbd hRvan hDef hPos hInt
  obtain ⟨hFs, hUs, hFpos, hFbd, hFint, hheat⟩ := hPR
  have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith
  have hL : ∀ X η : ℝ, X ≤ a → F' X η = F X η ∧ U' X η = U X η := by
    intro X η hX
    obtain ⟨g1, g2⟩ := hAgr X η (Or.inl hX)
    obtain ⟨r1, r2⟩ := hRvan X η (Or.inl hX)
    rw [(hDef X η).1, (hDef X η).2, g1, g2, r1, r2]
    simp
  have hR : ∀ X η : ℝ, Xb ≤ X → F' X η = F X η ∧ U' X η = U X η := by
    intro X η hX
    obtain ⟨g1, g2⟩ := hAgr X η (Or.inr (by linarith))

  have hpt : ∀ s : ℝ, Xb ≤ s → F s η ^ 2 =
      cinf ^ 2 / 2 * (s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / s) ^ 2) := by
    intro s hs
    have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith
    have hFs := (hL6 s η hs hη1 hη2).2
    have hsq : Real.sqrt (2 * s) ^ 2 = 2 * s := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
    have hpw : s ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * s ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) = s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * s := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hs0, ← Real.rpow_add_one hs0.ne']; congr 1; ring
    have h2s : (2:ℝ) * s ≠ 0 := by positivity
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ h2s
    linear_combination (Real.sqrt (2 * s) * F s η +
        cinf * s ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / s)) * hFs -
      F s η ^ 2 * hsq + cinf ^ 2 * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / s) ^ 2 * hpw
  have hIb : IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi Xb) := by
    have hmaj : IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => cinf ^ 2 / 2 * s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h))) (Ioi Xb) :=
      Integrable.const_mul (integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) hXb) _
    refine Integrable.mono' hmaj
      ((hfc.mono (Ioi_subset_Ioi (by linarith))).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi) ?_
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi (fun s hs => ?_)
    have hs' : Xb < s := hs
    have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith
    have hsr : 0 ≤ s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hs0.le _
    have hZ : 0 < 2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / s := by
      apply div_pos _ hs0
      nlinarith
    have hH := hH1 _ hZ
    have hc : 0 ≤ cinf ^ 2 / 2 := by positivity
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _), hpt s hs'.le]
    calc cinf ^ 2 / 2 * (s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / s) ^ 2)
        ≤ cinf ^ 2 / 2 * (s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) * 1) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hH hsr) hc
      _ = cinf ^ 2 / 2 * s ^ (-(2 + 2 * h)) := by ring
  have hI0 : IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) := by
    rw [← Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hXb.le]
    refine IntegrableOn.union ?_ hIb
    have hc2 : ContinuousOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Icc 0 Xb) :=
      hfc.mono (fun x hx => show -ε < x by linarith [hx.1])
    exact hc2.integrableOn_Icc.mono_set Ioc_subset_Icc_self
  have hC2 : ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X →
      leadPi F X η = leadPi F 0 η + profRadInt (fun x e => F x e ^ 2) X η := by
    intro X hX
    have hIX : IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi X) := hI0.mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi hX)
    have e2 := intervalIntegral.integral_interval_add_Ioi hI0 hIX
    show -(∫ x in Ioi X, F x η ^ 2) =
      -(∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), F x η ^ 2) + ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, F x η ^ 2
    linarith
  refine ⟨hI0, hC2, ?_⟩
  intro X hX
  have hII : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => F x η ^ 2) volume 0 X := by
    apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
    apply hfc.mono
    intro x hx
    rw [mem_uIcc] at hx
    show -ε < x
    rcases hx with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;> linarith
  have hXε : X ∈ Ioi (-ε) := show -ε < X by linarith
  have D := intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right hII
    (ContinuousOn.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter isOpen_Ioi hfc X hXε)
    (hfc.continuousAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hXε))
  have D2 := D.const_add (leadPi F 0 η)
  refine D2.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
  filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hX] with Y hY
  exact hC2 Y (le_of_lt hY)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → S 0 = profRadAvg U → G 0 = F → ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → bgResTh h S G W 0 X η = -(deriv (fun Y => T0th Y η) X + T0th X η / X)

signature.name: bg_lead_th_identity
signature.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → S 0 = profRadAvg U → G 0 = F → ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → bgResTh h S G W 0 X η = -(deriv (fun Y => T0th Y η) X + T0th X η / X)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z S G W hL hS0 hG0 X η hX hη1 hη2
  have hL' := hL
  unfold LeadingProfile at hL'
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, hh1, -⟩, ⟨hFs, -, hFpos, -⟩, -, hT0, ⟨ε, hε, hFe, hUe, hF0pos, -⟩, -⟩ := hL'
  have hηsq : η ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
  have hLpos : 0 < 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hLne : 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 ≠ 0 := hLpos.ne'
  have hF0 : 0 < F X η := hFpos X η hX hη1 hη2
  have hFne : F X η ≠ 0 := hF0.ne'
  have hXne : X ≠ 0 := hX.ne'
  have hFpos' : ∀ Y e : ℝ, 0 ≤ Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → 0 < F Y e := by
    intro Y e hY h1 h2
    rcases hY.lt_or_eq with hY | hY
    · exact hFpos Y e hY h1 h2
    · rw [← hY]; exact hF0pos e h1 h2
  
  have hUz : bgUz (profRadAvg U) X η = U X η := by
    obtain ⟨hA, -, hA3⟩ := profRadAvg_props U ε hε hUe
    have hmem : (X, η) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
      ⟨show -ε < X by linarith, hη1, hη2⟩
    have hca := hA.contDiffAt ((isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo).mem_nhds hmem)
    have hin : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y : ℝ => ((Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ)) X :=
      differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const η)
    have hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y => profRadAvg U Y η) X := by
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿(profRadAvg U)) (X, η) := hca.differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have hc := hd.comp X hin
      exact hc
    have h1 := (hasDerivAt_id' X).mul hg.hasDerivAt
    have h2 := (hA3 X η (by linarith) hη1 hη2).2
    have h3 := h1.unique h2
    unfold bgUz pdX
    linarith
  
  have hfC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => F Y η) (Ioi 0) := by
    have := hFs.comp (contDiffOn_id.prodMk (contDiffOn_const (c := η)))
      (fun Y (hY : Y ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ)) => (⟨hY, hη1, hη2⟩ : ((Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1))
    exact this
  have hgdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y => pdX F Y η) X := by
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (deriv (fun Y => F Y η)) (Ioi 0) :=
      hfC.deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioi
        (by simp)
    exact (h2.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hX)
  have hgX : HasDerivAt (fun Y => pdX F Y η) (pdX (pdX F) X η) X := hgdiff.hasDerivAt
  have hP : HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * (2 * Y * F Y η) * leadQs h F U Y η)
      (2 * X * F X η * axSq h F U X η) X :=
    (ax_source_identity h ε (fun _ => 0) F U hh0 (by linarith) hε hFe hUe hFpos' contDiffOn_const
      X η hX hη1 hη2).1
  have hD : HasDerivAt (fun Y => 2 * Y * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)) (2 * 1 * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)) X :=
    ((hasDerivAt_id' X).const_mul 2).mul_const _
  have hDne : 2 * X * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hE := (hP.div hD hDne).add (((hasDerivAt_id' X).const_mul 2).mul hgX)
  have hev : (fun Y => T0th Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X] (fun Y => Y * (2 * Y * F Y η) * leadQs h F U Y η /
      (2 * Y * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)) + 2 * Y * pdX F Y η) := by
    filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hX] with Y hY
    have hY' : (0:ℝ) < Y := hY
    have hYne : Y ≠ 0 := hY'.ne'
    have hFY : F Y η ≠ 0 := (hFpos Y η hY' hη1 hη2).ne'
    rw [(hT0 Y η hY' hη1 hη2).1]
    unfold leadStressTh shearA pdX
    field_simp
    ring
  have hTd := hE.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  rw [hTd.deriv, (hT0 X η hX hη1 hη2).1]
  
  unfold bgResTh
  rw [if_neg (show ¬ (1:ℕ) ≤ 0 by norm_num)]
  simp only [zero_add, Finset.sum_range_one, Nat.sub_self, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul,
    add_zero, sub_zero, hS0, hG0]
  simp only [simTop, simZop, bgVx, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
  rw [hUz]
  simp only [axSq, leadW, profEtaD, pdX, pdE, leadStressTh, shearA]
  field_simp
  ring

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z S G W hL hS0 hW0 X η hX hη1 hη2
  have hL' := hL
  unfold LeadingProfile at hL'
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, hh1, -⟩, ⟨-, -, hFpos, -⟩, ⟨-, hT0zs, -⟩, hT0eq, ⟨ε, hε, hFs, hUs, hF0, -⟩, -⟩ := hL'
  have hPI := lead_pi_calculus h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z hL
  have hASI : AxSourceId := ax_source_identity
  unfold AxSourceId at hASI
  have hASL : AxStressLocal := ax_stress_local
  unfold AxStressLocal at hASL
  obtain ⟨-, hASL2⟩ := hASL
  
  have hηsq : η ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
  have hhη : h * η ^ 2 < h * 1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hηsq hh0
  have hLpos : 0 < 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hLne : 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 ≠ 0 := hLpos.ne'
  
  have hslice : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a Y e : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioi a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) →
      a < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Z => f Z e) Y := by
    intro f a Y e hf hY he1 he2
    have hca := hf.contDiffAt ((isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo).mem_nhds
      (show (Y, e) ∈ Ioi a ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 from ⟨hY, he1, he2⟩))
    have hin : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Z : ℝ => ((Z, e) : ℝ × ℝ)) Y :=
      differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const e)
    exact (hca.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).comp Y hin
  
  obtain ⟨hS0s, -, hS0d⟩ := profRadAvg_props U ε hε hUs
  have hU0 : ∀ Y e : ℝ, -ε < Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → bgUz (S 0) Y e = U Y e := by
    intro Y e hY he1 he2
    have h1 := (hS0d Y e hY he1 he2).2
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun Z => Z * profRadAvg U Z e)
        (1 * profRadAvg U Y e + Y * deriv (fun Z => profRadAvg U Z e) Y) Y :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' Y).mul (hslice (profRadAvg U) (-ε) Y e hS0s hY he1 he2).hasDerivAt
    have h3 := h2.unique h1
    rw [hS0]
    unfold bgUz pdX
    linarith
  have hXε : -ε < X := by linarith
  
  have hb1 : bgUz (S 0) X η = U X η := hU0 X η hXε hη1 hη2
  have hb2 : ∀ Y : ℝ, -ε < Y → pdX (bgUz (S 0)) Y η = deriv (fun Z => U Z η) Y := by
    intro Y hY
    unfold pdX
    apply Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq
    filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hY] with Z hZ
    exact hU0 Z η hZ hη1 hη2
  have hb3 : pdE (bgUz (S 0)) X η = deriv (fun e => U X e) η := by
    unfold pdE
    apply Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2] with e he
    exact hU0 X e hXε he.1 he.2
  have hb4 : pdX (pdX (bgUz (S 0))) X η = deriv (fun Y => deriv (fun Z => U Z η) Y) X := by
    show deriv (fun Y => pdX (bgUz (S 0)) Y η) X = _
    apply Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq
    filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hXε] with Y hY
    exact hb2 Y hY
  
  have hc1 : pdX (W 0) X η = F X η ^ 2 := by
    unfold pdX

    exact ((hPI η hη1 hη2).2.2 X hX).deriv

    rw [hW0]

  have hc3 : pdE (W 0) X η = deriv (fun e => axPi (leadPi F 0) F X e) η := by
    unfold pdE
    apply Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2] with e he
    exact hc2 e he.1 he.2
  
  have h10 : ¬ ((1:ℕ) ≤ 0) := by norm_num
  have hstar : bgResZ h S G W 0 X η = -(axSn h (leadPi F 0) F U X η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2))

    simp only [bgResZ, h10, if_false, Finset.sum_range_one, Nat.sub_self, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero,
      zero_mul, add_zero, sub_zero, zero_add]
    simp only [simTop, simZop, bgVx]
    rw [hb4, hb2 X hXε, hb3, hb1, hc1, hc2 η hη1 hη2, hc3, hS0]
    simp only [axSn, leadW, pdE, profEtaD, Nat.cast_zero]
    ring
  
  have hFpos0 : ∀ Y e : ℝ, 0 ≤ Y → -1 < e → e < 1 → 0 < F Y e := by
    intro Y e hY he1 he2
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hY with hY0 | hY0
    · rw [← hY0]; exact hF0 e he1 he2
    · exact hFpos Y e hY0 he1 he2
  obtain ⟨ε', hε', hPis, -⟩ :=
    leadPi_smooth_bounds h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z hL
  have hPax : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (leadPi F 0) (Ioo (-1) 1) := by
    have hm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun e : ℝ => ((0 : ℝ), e)) (Ioo (-1) 1) :=
      (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id).contDiffOn
    exact hPis.comp hm (fun e he => ⟨show -ε' < (0:ℝ) by linarith, he⟩)
  have hNs : HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * axNs h (leadPi F 0) F U Y η) (axSn h (leadPi F 0) F U X η) X :=
    (hASI h ε (leadPi F 0) F U hh0 (by linarith) hε hFs hUs hFpos0 hPax X η hX hη1 hη2).2
  have hloc := hASL2 h (leadPi F 0) F U (fun e he1 he2 => ⟨(hPI e he1 he2).1, rfl⟩)
  have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => U Y η) (Ioi (-ε)) := by
    have hm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y : ℝ => ((Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ)) (Ioi (-ε)) :=
      (contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffOn
    exact hUs.comp hm (fun Y hY => ⟨hY, hη1, hη2⟩)
  have hgd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (deriv (fun Y => U Y η)) (Ioi (-ε)) :=
    hg.deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioi (m := ∞) (by first | exact le_rfl | simp)
  have hU'd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y => deriv (fun Z => U Z η) Y) X :=
    (ContDiffOn.differentiableOn hgd (by simp)).differentiableAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hXε)
  have hTd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y => T0z Y η) X := hslice T0z 0 X η hT0zs hX hη1 hη2
  have hR : HasDerivAt (fun Y => Y * axNs h (leadPi F 0) F U Y η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)
        + 2 * (Y * deriv (fun Z => U Z η) Y))
      (axSn h (leadPi F 0) F U X η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)
        + 2 * (1 * deriv (fun Z => U Z η) X + X * deriv (fun Y => deriv (fun Z => U Z η) Y) X)) X :=
    (hNs.div_const _).add (((hasDerivAt_id' X).mul hU'd.hasDerivAt).const_mul 2)

    ((hasDerivAt_id' X).const_mul 2).sqrt (mul_pos two_pos hX).ne'
  have hK : HasDerivAt (fun Y => Real.sqrt (2 * Y) * T0z Y η)

    hsq.mul hTd.hasDerivAt
  have alg : ∀ s f N V Y L : ℝ, s ≠ 0 → f ≠ 0 → L ≠ 0 →
      s * (f * (Y * N / (L * (s * f)) + s * V / f)) = Y * N / L + (s * s) * V := by
    intro s f N V Y L hs hf hL0
    field_simp <;> ring
  have heq : (fun Y => Real.sqrt (2 * Y) * T0z Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X]
      (fun Y => Y * axNs h (leadPi F 0) F U Y η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)

    filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hX] with Y hY
    have hY' : (0:ℝ) < Y := hY

    unfold leadStressTz shearB
    rw [hloc Y η hY' hη1 hη2]
    have e1 := alg (Real.sqrt (2 * Y)) (F Y η) (axNs h (leadPi F 0) F U Y η)
      (deriv (fun Z => U Z η) Y) Y (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)).ne'
      (hFpos Y η hY' hη1 hη2).ne' hLne
    have e2 := Real.mul_self_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * Y by linarith)

  have alg2 : ∀ s T T' Z : ℝ, s ≠ 0 → s * s = 2 * Z →

by
  intro h ε N S G W hh0 hh1 hS hε hsm hvan x t ht hx
  have fα : ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿((fun n => bgVx h n (S n)) n)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
    fun n => (sim_profile_closure h ε 0 n (S n) hh0 hh1 hε (hsm n).1).2.2.2.2.2
  have fγ : ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿((fun n => bgUz (S n)) n)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
    fun n => (sim_profile_closure h ε 0 n (S n) hh0 hh1 hε (hsm n).1).2.2.2.2.1
  have fβ : ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(G n)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := fun n => (hsm n).2.1
  have fP : ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(W n)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := fun n => (hsm n).2.2
  obtain ⟨sα, dα⟩ := sim_sum_calculus h ε (1 / 2) N (fun n : ℕ => -1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h)
    (fun n => bgVx h n (S n)) hh0 hh1 hS hε fα
  obtain ⟨sβ, dβ⟩ := sim_sum_calculus h ε 1 N (fun n : ℕ => -(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) G hh0 hh1 hS hε fβ
  obtain ⟨sγ, dγ⟩ := sim_sum_calculus h ε 1 N (fun n : ℕ => -(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h)
    (fun n => bgUz (S n)) hh0 hh1 hS hε fγ
  obtain ⟨sP, dP⟩ := sim_sum_calculus h ε 1 N (fun n : ℕ => -(1 + 2 * h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) W hh0 hh1 hS hε fP
  have hu : ∀ (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), s < 1 → 0 < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 →
      curl3 (fun w => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgAn h n (S n) w s) y +
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgBn h n (G n) y s =
      simLiftSum h N (1 / 2) (fun n : ℕ => -1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (fun n => bgVx h n (S n))
          (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) (y 2) s • radVec y +
        simLiftSum h N 1 (fun n : ℕ => -(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) G (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) (y 2) s • azVec y +
        simLiftSum h N 1 (fun n : ℕ => -(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (fun n => bgUz (S n))
          (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) (y 2) s • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) := by
    intro y s hs hy
    rw [bg_velocity_frame h ε N S hh0 hh1 hS hε (fun n => (hsm n).1) y s hs hy]
    have hB : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgBn h n (G n) y s =
        simLiftSum h N 1 (fun n : ℕ => -(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) G (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) (y 2) s • azVec y := by
      simp only [simLiftSum, simLift, bgBn, Finset.sum_smul, one_mul, simX, simEta]
    rw [hB]
    abel
  have hp : ∀ (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), s < 1 → 0 < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 →
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgPn h n (W n) y s =
        simLiftSum h N 1 (fun n : ℕ => -(1 + 2 * h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) W (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) (y 2) s := by
    intro y s _ _
    simp only [simLiftSum, simLift, bgPn, one_mul, simX, simEta]
  have hR := axisym_frame_residual
    (fun y s => curl3 (fun w => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgAn h n (S n) w s) y +
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgBn h n (G n) y s)
    (fun y s => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgPn h n (W n) y s)
    (simLiftSum h N (1 / 2) (fun n : ℕ => -1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (fun n => bgVx h n (S n)))
    (simLiftSum h N 1 (fun n : ℕ => -(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) G)

  obtain ⟨b1, b2, b3, b4, b5⟩ := dβ (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) (x 2) t hx ht
  obtain ⟨g1, g2, g3, g4, g5⟩ := dγ (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) (x 2) t hx ht
  obtain ⟨-, p2, -, p4, -⟩ := dP (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) (x 2) t hx ht
  have hq : 0 < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) := (hS.1 (x 2) (1 - t) (by linarith)).1
  rw [hR, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, b1, b2, b3, b4, b5, g1, g2, g3, g4, g5, p2, p4,
    bg_rad_coeff_match h N S G W (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) (x 2) t hq hvan,

bg_residual_expansion.definitions:
noncomputable def simLift (h b : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ρ z s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  simScale h z (1 - s) ^ b * f (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)))

noncomputable def simLiftSum (h : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (e : ℕ → ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ρ z s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), c * simLift h (e n) (f n) ρ z s

noncomputable def cylPs (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ρ z s : ℝ) : ℝ := deriv (fun s' => g ρ z s') s

noncomputable def cylPr (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ρ z s : ℝ) : ℝ := deriv (fun r => g r z s) ρ

noncomputable def cylPz (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ρ z s : ℝ) : ℝ := deriv (fun w => g ρ w s) z

noncomputable def frRadV (ρ a aS aR aRR aZ aZZ b g pR : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  aS + 2 * ρ * a * aR + g * aZ + a ^ 2 - b ^ 2 - (4 * ρ * aRR + 8 * aR + aZZ) + 2 * pR

noncomputable def frThV (ρ a b bS bR bRR bZ bZZ g : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  bS + 2 * ρ * a * bR + g * bZ + 2 * a * b - (4 * ρ * bRR + 8 * bR + bZZ)

noncomputable def frZV (ρ a g gS gR gRR gZ gZZ pZ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  gS + 2 * ρ * a * gR + g * gZ - (4 * ρ * gRR + 4 * gR + gZZ) + pZ

by
  intro E F G _ _ _ _ _ _ g f ρ Ω S T hΩ hT hSΩ hmaps hρ hg hf hgb hfb k
  choose Cg hCg using hgb
  have hfb' : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ i → ∀ w ∈ S,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-(i : ℝ)) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : 1 ≤ i
    · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hfb i hi
      exact ⟨C, fun _ => hC⟩
    · exact ⟨0, fun h => absurd h hi⟩
  choose Cf hCf using hfb'
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cg i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ : ∃ C1 : ℝ, C1 = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (k + 1), |Cf i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩

    have : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (k + 1), |Cf i| :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
    rw [hC1]; linarith
  have hCgA : ∀ i ≤ k, |Cg i| ≤ A := by

    intro i h1 h2

      (Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨h1, (by omega : i < k + 1)⟩)
    rw [hC1]
    linarith
