    _ = (k.factorial : ℝ) * A * C1 ^ k * ρ w ^ (-(k : ℝ)) := by
        rw [hrpow, div_pow, div_eq_mul_inv]; ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (f : E → ℝ) (Ω S : Set E) (p : ℝ), IsOpen Ω → S ⊆ Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → (∀ w ∈ Ω, 0 < f w) → (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w‖ ≤ C * f w ^ (1 - (k : ℝ))) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => f z ^ p) Ω ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => f z ^ p) w‖ ≤ C * f w ^ (p - (k : ℝ))

signature.name: wt_sharp_rpow
signature.statement: ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (f : E → ℝ) (Ω S : Set E) (p : ℝ), IsOpen Ω → S ⊆ Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → (∀ w ∈ Ω, 0 < f w) → (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w‖ ≤ C * f w ^ (1 - (k : ℝ))) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => f z ^ p) Ω ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => f z ^ p) w‖ ≤ C * f w ^ (p - (k : ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro E _ _ f Ω S p hΩ hSΩ hf hpos hd
  have hgs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ => y ^ p) (Ioi 0) := fun y hy =>
    (Real.contDiffAt_rpow_const_of_ne (ne_of_gt hy)).contDiffWithinAt
  have hmaps : MapsTo f Ω (Ioi 0) := fun w hw => hpos w hw
  refine ⟨hgs.comp hf hmaps, ?_⟩
  intro k
  have hd' : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ i → ∀ w ∈ S,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f w‖ ≤ C * f w ^ (1 - (i : ℝ)) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi1 : 1 ≤ i
    · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hd i hi1
      exact ⟨C, fun _ => hC⟩
    · exact ⟨0, fun h1 => absurd h1 hi1⟩
  choose Cq hCq using hd'
  obtain ⟨C', hC'⟩ : ∃ C' : ℝ, C' = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cq i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Cg, hCg⟩ : ∃ Cg : ℝ,
      Cg = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Polynomial.eval p (descPochhammer ℝ i)| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hC'1 : 1 ≤ C' := by
    have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1)) => abs_nonneg (Cq i))
    linarith
  have hCqle : ∀ i ≤ k, |Cq i| ≤ C' := by
    intro i hi
    have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cq i|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
    linarith
  have hCgle : ∀ i ≤ k, |Polynomial.eval p (descPochhammer ℝ i)| ≤ Cg := by
    intro i hi
    have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Polynomial.eval p (descPochhammer ℝ i)|)
      (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
    rw [hCg]
    exact this
  refine ⟨(k.factorial : ℝ) * Cg * C' ^ k, ?_⟩
  intro w hw
  have hwΩ : w ∈ Ω := hSΩ hw
  have hN : Ω ∈ nhds w := hΩ.mem_nhds hwΩ
  obtain ⟨a, ha_def⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = f w := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ha : 0 < a := by rw [ha_def]; exact hpos w hwΩ
  have hai : 0 < a⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr ha
  have hap : 0 < a ^ p := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos ha p
  have hgsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (a⁻¹ • f) Ω := hf.const_smul a⁻¹
  have hgmaps : MapsTo (a⁻¹ • f) Ω (Ioi 0) := fun z hz => by
    show 0 < a⁻¹ • f z
    rw [smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_pos hai (hpos z hz)
  have hgw : (a⁻¹ • f) w = 1 := by
    rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← ha_def]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ ha.ne'
  have hGsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((fun y : ℝ => y ^ p) ∘ (a⁻¹ • f)) Ω := hgs.comp hgsm hgmaps
  have hGk : ContDiffAt ℝ k ((fun y : ℝ => y ^ p) ∘ (a⁻¹ • f)) w :=
    (hGsm.contDiffAt hN).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  
  have hev : (fun z => f z ^ p) =ᶠ[nhds w] (a ^ p) • ((fun y : ℝ => y ^ p) ∘ (a⁻¹ • f)) := by
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hN (fun z hz => ?_)
    show f z ^ p = a ^ p • (a⁻¹ • f z) ^ p
    rw [smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, Real.mul_rpow hai.le (hpos z hz).le, Real.inv_rpow ha.le,
      ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hap.ne', one_mul]
  
  have hout : ∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun y : ℝ => y ^ p) (Ioi 0) ((a⁻¹ • f) w)‖ ≤
      Cg := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hgw, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i isOpen_Ioi (show (1:ℝ) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) from Set.mem_Ioi.mpr one_pos),
      norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate,
      Real.iter_deriv_rpow_const, Real.one_rpow, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hCgle i hi
  
  have hin : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k →
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (a⁻¹ • f) Ω w‖ ≤ (C' * a⁻¹) ^ i := by
    intro i hi1 hik
    have hfi : ContDiffAt ℝ i f w := (hf.contDiffAt hN).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩ hwΩ, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply hfi, norm_smul,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hai]
    have hb : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f w‖ ≤ Cq i * f w ^ (1 - (i : ℝ)) := hCq i hi1 w hw
    rw [← ha_def] at hb
    have e1 : a ^ (1 - (i : ℝ)) = a * a⁻¹ ^ i := by
      rw [Real.rpow_sub ha, Real.rpow_one, Real.rpow_natCast, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
    rw [e1] at hb
    have hP0 : 0 < a⁻¹ ^ i := by positivity
    have hC'i : C' ≤ C' ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hC'1 (by omega)
    calc a⁻¹ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f w‖ ≤ a⁻¹ * (Cq i * (a * a⁻¹ ^ i)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hai.le
      _ = Cq i * (a⁻¹ * a) * a⁻¹ ^ i := by ring
      _ = Cq i * a⁻¹ ^ i := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ ha.ne', mul_one]
      _ ≤ |Cq i| * a⁻¹ ^ i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hP0.le
      _ ≤ C' ^ i * a⁻¹ ^ i :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ((hCqle i hik).trans hC'i) hP0.le
      _ = (C' * a⁻¹) ^ i := (mul_pow _ _ _).symm
  have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hgs hgsm (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn hΩ.uniqueDiffOn hgmaps hwΩ hout hin
  rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hΩ hwΩ] at key
  rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply hGk, norm_smul,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hap, ← ha_def]
  have e2 : a ^ (p - (k : ℝ)) = a ^ p * a⁻¹ ^ k := by
    rw [Real.rpow_sub ha, Real.rpow_natCast, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
  calc a ^ p * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((fun y : ℝ => y ^ p) ∘ (a⁻¹ • f)) w‖
      ≤ a ^ p * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * Cg * (C' * a⁻¹) ^ k) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left key hap.le
    _ = (k.factorial : ℝ) * Cg * C' ^ k * a ^ (p - (k : ℝ)) := by rw [e2, mul_pow]; ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h M : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < M → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 → w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ M * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (simX h z.1 z.2, simEta h z.1 z.2)) w‖ ≤ C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(k : ℝ))

signature.name: simXEta_sharp
signature.statement: ∀ (h M : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < M → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 → w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ M * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (simX h z.1 z.2, simEta h z.1 z.2)) w‖ ≤ C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(k : ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h M hS h0 hh2 hM k
  have hΩo : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
  obtain ⟨S, hSd⟩ : ∃ S : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ), S = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1 ∧
      simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 ∧
      w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ M * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hS1 : ∀ w ∈ S, w.2 < 1 ∧ simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 ∧
      w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ M * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) := by
    rw [hSd]; intro w hw; exact hw
  have hSΩ : S ⊆ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := fun w hw => (hS1 w hw).1
  obtain ⟨hQs, -, hQpos, hQd⟩ := simQ_props h 1 h0 hh2 hS
  have hreg := bg_interior_region_facts h M hS h0 hh2 hM
  have hqpos : ∀ w ∈ S, 0 < simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) := fun w hw => hQpos w (hS1 w hw).1
  have hball : ∀ w ∈ S, ‖w‖ ≤ M + 1 := fun w hw =>
    ((hreg w (hS1 w hw).1).2 (hS1 w hw).2.1 (hS1 w hw).2.2).1
  have hc : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => z.1 i) := fun i =>
    ((EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)).contDiff
  
  have hhigh : ∀ (p : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ p → ∀ (a : ℝ) (j : ℕ), a ≤ (j : ℝ) →
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j p w‖ ≤
        C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (a - (j : ℝ)) := by
    intro p hp a j haj
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := ball_iteratedFDeriv_bound p hp (M + 1) j
    refine ⟨max C 0, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    have h1 : 1 ≤ simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (a - (j : ℝ)) :=
      Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos (hqpos w hw) (hS1 w hw).2.1 (by linarith)
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j p w‖ ≤ C := hC w (hball w hw)
      _ ≤ max C 0 := le_max_left _ _
      _ ≤ max C 0 * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (a - (j : ℝ)) :=
          le_mul_of_one_le_right (le_max_right _ _) h1
  
  have hpow : ∀ p : ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ p) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧
      ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ p) w‖ ≤
          C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (p - (j : ℝ)) := by
    intro p
    exact wt_sharp_rpow (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} S p
      hΩo hSΩ hQs (fun w hw => hQpos w hw) (fun j hj => by
        obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hQd j hj
        exact ⟨C, fun w hw => hC w (hS1 w hw).1 (hS1 w hw).2.1⟩)
  
  have hP : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2) / 2) :=
    (((hc 0).pow 2).add ((hc 1).pow 2)).div_const 2
  have hPb : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2) / 2) w‖ ≤
        C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ ((1 : ℝ) - (j : ℝ)) := by
    intro j
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with rfl | hj
    · refine ⟨M / 2, fun w hw => ?_⟩
      have hnn : 0 ≤ (w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2) / 2 := by positivity
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero, Real.rpow_one]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hnn]
      have := (hS1 w hw).2.2
      linarith
    · exact hhigh _ hP 1 j (Nat.one_le_cast.mpr hj)
  
  have hZb : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => z.1 2) w‖ ≤
        C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ ((1 / 2 - h) - (j : ℝ)) := by
    intro j
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with rfl | hj
    · refine ⟨1, fun w hw => ?_⟩
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero, one_mul]
      have hτ : 0 < 1 - w.2 := by linarith [(hS1 w hw).1]
      have h2 := (hS.2.1 (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) hτ).2
      have hq := hqpos w hw
      have e : simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1 - 2 * h) =
          (simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1 / 2 - h)) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hq.le]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [e] at h2
      exact (abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq h2 (Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _)).le
    · have hj1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) := Nat.one_le_cast.mpr hj
      exact hhigh _ (hc 2) _ j (by linarith)
  
  have hX := wt_sharp_bilinear (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ)
    (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2) / 2)
    (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-1 : ℝ))
    (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} S 1 (-1)
    hΩo hSΩ hqpos hP.contDiffOn (hpow _).1 hPb (hpow _).2
  
  have hE := wt_sharp_bilinear (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ)
    (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => z.1 2)
    (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)))
    (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} S (1 / 2 - h)
    (-(1 / 2 - h)) hΩo hSΩ hqpos (hc 2).contDiffOn (hpow _).1 hZb (hpow _).2
  have eX : (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simX h z.1 z.2) = fun z => ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ
      ((z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2) / 2) (simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-1 : ℝ)) := by
    funext z
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply', Real.rpow_neg_one]
    unfold simX
    ring
  have eE : (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simEta h z.1 z.2) = fun z => ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ
      (z.1 2) (simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) := by
    funext z
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply']
    rfl
  have hXb : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simX h z.1 z.2) w‖ ≤
        C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(j : ℝ)) := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hX j
    refine ⟨C, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    have e : (1 : ℝ) + -1 - (j : ℝ) = -(j : ℝ) := by ring
    have := hC w hw
    rw [e] at this
    rw [eX]
    exact this
  have hEb : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simEta h z.1 z.2) w‖ ≤
        C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(j : ℝ)) := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hE j
    refine ⟨C, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    have e : (1 / 2 - h) + -(1 / 2 - h) - (j : ℝ) = -(j : ℝ) := by ring
    have := hC w hw
    rw [e] at this
    rw [eE]
    exact this
  
  have hpair := (simXEta_wt_bound h M hS h0 hh2 hM).1
  have hXs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simX h z.1 z.2) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
    hpair.fst
  have hEs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simEta h z.1 z.2) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
    hpair.snd
  
  obtain ⟨CX, hCX⟩ := hXb k
  obtain ⟨CE, hCE⟩ := hEb k
  refine ⟨max CX CE, fun w h1 h2 h3 => ?_⟩
  have hw : w ∈ S := by rw [hSd]; exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
  have hwΩ : {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∈ nhds w := hΩo.mem_nhds (hSΩ hw)
  have hq0 := hqpos w hw
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_prodMk (hXs.contDiffAt hwΩ) (hEs.contDiffAt hwΩ)
    (by exact_mod_cast le_top), ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_prod]
  have hqk : 0 ≤ simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(k : ℝ)) := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _).le
  exact max_le ((hCX w hw).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hqk))
    ((hCE w hw).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) hqk))

subgoal_signatures.name: ball_iteratedFDeriv_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (p : ℝ³ × ℝ → F), ContDiff ℝ ∞ p → ∀ (B : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, ‖w‖ ≤ B → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k p w‖ ≤ C

subgoal_signatures.name: bg_interior_region_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h M : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < M → ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → (0 < simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ∧ 0 ≤ simX h w.1 w.2 ∧ -1 < simEta h w.1 w.2 ∧ simEta h w.1 w.2 < 1) ∧ (simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 → w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ M * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) → ‖w‖ ≤ M + 1 ∧ simX h w.1 w.2 ≤ M / 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: simQ_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h qs : ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → SimScaleProps h → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧ IsOpen (simDomain h qs) ∧ (∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → 0 < simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) w‖ ≤ C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1 - (k : ℝ)))

subgoal_signatures.name: simXEta_wt_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h M : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < M → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (simX h z.1 z.2, simEta h z.1 z.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 → w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ M * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (simX h z.1 z.2, simEta h z.1 z.2)) w‖ ≤ C * simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K)

subgoal_signatures.name: wt_sharp_bilinear
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {E F G H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] H) (f : E → F) (g : E → G) (ρ : E → ℝ) (Ω S : Set E) (a a' : ℝ), IsOpen Ω → S ⊆ Ω → (∀ w ∈ S, 0 < ρ w) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g Ω → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (a - (k : ℝ))) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (a' - (k : ℝ))) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (a + a' - (k : ℝ))

subgoal_signatures.name: wt_sharp_rpow
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (f : E → ℝ) (Ω S : Set E) (p : ℝ), IsOpen Ω → S ⊆ Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → (∀ w ∈ Ω, 0 < f w) → (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w‖ ≤ C * f w ^ (1 - (k : ℝ))) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => f z ^ p) Ω ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => f z ^ p) w‖ ≤ C * f w ^ (p - (k : ℝ))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (Sn Gn Wn : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ), 1 ≤ n → bgResTh h (Function.update S n Sn) (Function.update G n Gn) (Function.update W n Wn) n X η = -2 * (X * pdX (pdX Gn) X η + 2 * pdX Gn X η) + bgCoefA h n (G 0) (S 0) 0 X η * Gn X η + bgCoefA h n (G 0) (S 0) 1 X η * (X * pdX Gn X η) + bgCoefA h n (G 0) (S 0) 2 X η * pdE Gn X η + bgCoefA h n (G 0) (S 0) 3 X η * bgUz Sn X η + bgCoefA h n (G 0) (S 0) 4 X η * Sn X η + bgCoefA h n (G 0) (S 0) 5 X η * pdE Sn X η + bgKTh h S G n X η ∧ bgResZ h (Function.update S n Sn) (Function.update G n Gn) (Function.update W n Wn) n X η = -2 * (X * pdX (pdX (bgUz Sn)) X η + pdX (bgUz Sn) X η) + bgCoefB h n (S 0) 0 X η * bgUz Sn X η + bgCoefB h n (S 0) 1 X η * (X * pdX (bgUz Sn) X η) + bgCoefB h n (S 0) 2 X η * pdE (bgUz Sn) X η + bgCoefB h n (S 0) 3 X η * Sn X η + bgCoefB h n (S 0) 4 X η * pdE Sn X η + bgCoefB h n (S 0) 5 X η * Wn X η + bgCoefB h n (S 0) 6 X η * pdE Wn X η + bgCoefB h n (S 0) 7 X η * (X * pdX Wn X η) + bgKZ h S n X η ∧ bgResRad h (Function.update S n Sn) (Function.update G n Gn) (Function.update W n Wn) n X η = pdX Wn X η - 2 * (G 0 X η * Gn X η) - bgKRad h S G n X η

signature.name: bg_res_linear_split
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (Sn Gn Wn : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ), 1 ≤ n → bgResTh h (Function.update S n Sn) (Function.update G n Gn) (Function.update W n Wn) n X η = -2 * (X * pdX (pdX Gn) X η + 2 * pdX Gn X η) + bgCoefA h n (G 0) (S 0) 0 X η * Gn X η + bgCoefA h n (G 0) (S 0) 1 X η * (X * pdX Gn X η) + bgCoefA h n (G 0) (S 0) 2 X η * pdE Gn X η + bgCoefA h n (G 0) (S 0) 3 X η * bgUz Sn X η + bgCoefA h n (G 0) (S 0) 4 X η * Sn X η + bgCoefA h n (G 0) (S 0) 5 X η * pdE Sn X η + bgKTh h S G n X η ∧ bgResZ h (Function.update S n Sn) (Function.update G n Gn) (Function.update W n Wn) n X η = -2 * (X * pdX (pdX (bgUz Sn)) X η + pdX (bgUz Sn) X η) + bgCoefB h n (S 0) 0 X η * bgUz Sn X η + bgCoefB h n (S 0) 1 X η * (X * pdX (bgUz Sn) X η) + bgCoefB h n (S 0) 2 X η * pdE (bgUz Sn) X η + bgCoefB h n (S 0) 3 X η * Sn X η + bgCoefB h n (S 0) 4 X η * pdE Sn X η + bgCoefB h n (S 0) 5 X η * Wn X η + bgCoefB h n (S 0) 6 X η * pdE Wn X η + bgCoefB h n (S 0) 7 X η * (X * pdX Wn X η) + bgKZ h S n X η ∧ bgResRad h (Function.update S n Sn) (Function.update G n Gn) (Function.update W n Wn) n X η = pdX Wn X η - 2 * (G 0 X η * Gn X η) - bgKRad h S G n X η

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h S G W n Sn Gn Wn X η hn
  have hsplit : ∀ f : ℕ → ℝ, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f i =
      f 0 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ioo 0 n, f i + f n := by
    intro f
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.range_eq_Ico,
      Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot (by omega : 0 < n), Finset.Ico_add_one_left_eq_Ioo]
  have hSlt : ∀ i, i < n → Function.update S n Sn i = S i :=
    fun i hi => Function.update_of_ne (by omega) _ _
  have hGlt : ∀ i, i < n → Function.update G n Gn i = G i :=
    fun i hi => Function.update_of_ne (by omega) _ _
  have hS0 : Function.update S n Sn 0 = S 0 := hSlt 0 (by omega)
  have hG0 : Function.update G n Gn 0 = G 0 := hGlt 0 (by omega)
  have hSn : Function.update S n Sn n = Sn := Function.update_self _ _ _
  have hGn : Function.update G n Gn n = Gn := Function.update_self _ _ _
  have hWn : Function.update W n Wn n = Wn := Function.update_self _ _ _
  have hGm : Function.update G n Gn (n - 1) = G (n - 1) := hGlt _ (by omega)
  have hSm : Function.update S n Sn (n - 1) = S (n - 1) := hSlt _ (by omega)
  have hOm : bgOm h (Function.update S n Sn) (n - 1) X η = bgOm h S (n - 1) X η := by
    have hle : ∀ i, i ≤ n - 1 → Function.update S n Sn i = S i := fun i hi => hSlt i (by omega)
    unfold bgOm
    rw [hle (n - 1) le_rfl, hle (n - 1 - 1) (by omega)]
    congr 2
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    have hi' := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    rw [hle i (by omega), hle (n - 1 - i) (by omega)]
  have hmidTh : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ioo 0 n, (bgVx h i (Function.update S n Sn i) X η *
        (Function.update G n Gn (n - i) X η + X * pdX (Function.update G n Gn (n - i)) X η)
        + bgUz (Function.update S n Sn i) X η *
          simZop h (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((n - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) (Function.update G n Gn (n - i)) X η) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ioo 0 n, (bgVx h i (S i) X η * (G (n - i) X η + X * pdX (G (n - i)) X η)
        + bgUz (S i) X η * simZop h (-(1 + h) + 2 * ((n - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) (G (n - i)) X η) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Finset.mem_Ioo.mp hi
    rw [hSlt i h2, hGlt (n - i) (by omega)]
  have hmidZ : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ioo 0 n, (X * bgVx h i (Function.update S n Sn i) X η *
        pdX (bgUz (Function.update S n Sn (n - i))) X η
        + bgUz (Function.update S n Sn i) X η * simZop h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((n - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * h)
          (bgUz (Function.update S n Sn (n - i))) X η) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ioo 0 n, (X * bgVx h i (S i) X η * pdX (bgUz (S (n - i))) X η
        + bgUz (S i) X η * simZop h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((n - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * h)
          (bgUz (S (n - i))) X η) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Finset.mem_Ioo.mp hi
    rw [hSlt i h2, hSlt (n - i) (by omega)]
  have hmidR : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ioo 0 n, Function.update G n Gn i X η * Function.update G n Gn (n - i) X η =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ioo 0 n, G i X η * G (n - i) X η := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Finset.mem_Ioo.mp hi
    rw [hGlt i h2, hGlt (n - i) (by omega)]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold bgResTh
    rw [if_pos hn, hsplit, hmidTh]
    simp only [Nat.sub_zero, Nat.sub_self, hS0, hG0, hSn, hGn, hGm]
    simp only [bgKTh, bgCoefA, Matrix.cons_val, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.head_cons]
    simp only [simTop, simZop, bgVx, Nat.cast_zero]
    ring
  · unfold bgResZ
    rw [if_pos hn, hsplit, hmidZ]
    simp only [Nat.sub_zero, Nat.sub_self, hS0, hSn, hWn, hSm]
    simp only [bgKZ, bgCoefB, Matrix.cons_val, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.head_cons]
    simp only [simTop, simZop, bgVx, Nat.cast_zero]
    ring
  · unfold bgResRad
    rw [if_pos hn, hsplit, hmidR, hOm]
    simp only [Nat.sub_zero, Nat.sub_self, hG0, hGn, hWn]
    unfold bgKRad
    ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (Xi : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xi → BgAnalytic Xi f → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioo 0 Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → BgHolo Xi f

signature.name: bgHolo_of_analytic
signature.statement: ∀ (Xi : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xi → BgAnalytic Xi f → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioo 0 Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → BgHolo Xi f

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xi f _ hA hf
  
  have csOpen : ∀ r : ℝ, IsOpen (cStrip r) := by
    intro r
    have h1 : IsOpen {w : ℂ | |w.im| < r} :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
    have h2 : IsOpen {w : ℂ | -1 - r < w.re} := isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re
    have h3 : IsOpen {w : ℂ | w.re < 1 + r} := isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const
    exact h1.inter (h2.inter h3)
  have csConv : ∀ r : ℝ, Convex ℝ (cStrip r) := by
    intro r
    rw [convex_iff_forall_pos]
    intro w hw z hz a b ha hb hab
    obtain ⟨hw1, hw2, hw3⟩ := hw
    obtain ⟨hz1, hz2, hz3⟩ := hz
    have hre : (a • w + b • z).re = a * w.re + b * z.re := by simp
    have him : (a • w + b • z).im = a * w.im + b * z.im := by simp
    rw [abs_lt] at hw1 hz1
    have hr : a * r + b * r = r := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
    have e1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hw1.2 ha
    have e2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz1.2 hb
    have e3 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hw1.1 ha
    have e4 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz1.1 hb
    have e5 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hw2 ha
    have e6 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz2 hb
    have e7 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hw3 ha
    have e8 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz3 hb
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [him, abs_lt]
      constructor <;> nlinarith
    · rw [hre]; nlinarith
    · rw [hre]; nlinarith
  have csReal : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ((η : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ cStrip r := by
    intro r hr η e1 e2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa using hr
    · simp only [Complex.ofReal_re]; linarith
    · simp only [Complex.ofReal_re]; linarith
  have csMono : ∀ r r' : ℝ, r ≤ r' → cStrip r ⊆ cStrip r' := by
    intro r r' hrr w hw
    obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := hw
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  
  have holoParam : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (a b C : ℝ) (U : Set ℂ), IsOpen U →
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => g p.1 p.2) (Set.uIcc a b ×ˢ U) →
      (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g x) U) →
      (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, ∀ w ∈ U, ‖g x w‖ ≤ C) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => ∫ x in a..b, g x w) U := by
    intro g a b C U hU hc hd hb w₀ hw₀
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hU w₀ hw₀
    have hslice : ∀ w ∈ U, ContinuousOn (fun x => g x w) (Set.uIcc a b) := by
      intro w hw
      exact hc.comp (Continuous.prodMk continuous_id continuous_const).continuousOn
        (fun x hx => ⟨hx, hw⟩)
    have hderiv_bd : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball w₀ (ε / 2),
        ‖deriv (g x) w‖ ≤ C / (ε / 4) := by
      intro x hx w hw
      have hsub : Metric.closedBall w (ε / 4) ⊆ U := by
        intro z hz
        apply hball
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hw ⊢
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hz
        calc dist z w₀ ≤ dist z w + dist w w₀ := dist_triangle _ _ _
          _ < ε := by linarith
      apply Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le (by linarith)
      · apply DifferentiableOn.diffContOnCl
        rw [closure_ball w (by positivity)]
        exact (hd x hx).mono hsub
      · intro z hz
        exact hb x hx z (hsub (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz))
    have hmeas_deriv : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => deriv (g x) w₀)
        (volume.restrict (Set.uIoc a b)) := by
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : ℕ → ℂ, t = fun n : ℕ => (((ε / 2) * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
        ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hpos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < (ε / 2) * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := fun n => by positivity
      have hle : ∀ n : ℕ, (ε / 2) * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ ε / 2 := by
        intro n
        have : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 := by
          rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
          linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg n : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n)]
        nlinarith
      have ht_ne : ∀ n, t n ≠ 0 := by
        intro n
        rw [ht]
        dsimp only
        exact_mod_cast (hpos n).ne'
      have ht_mem : ∀ n, w₀ + t n ∈ U := by
        intro n
        apply hball
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, ht]
        simp only [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        rw [abs_of_pos (hpos n)]
        linarith [hle n]
      have ht_tend : Filter.Tendsto t Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) := by
        apply tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.2
        refine ⟨?_, Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => ht_ne n)⟩
        have h1 := (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat).const_mul (ε / 2)
        rw [mul_zero] at h1
        have h2 := (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp h1
        rw [Complex.ofReal_zero] at h2
        rw [ht]
        exact h2
      apply aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae Filter.atTop
        (f := fun n x => (t n)⁻¹ • (g x (w₀ + t n) - g x w₀))
      · intro n
        have hcn : ContinuousOn (fun x => (t n)⁻¹ • (g x (w₀ + t n) - g x w₀)) (Set.uIcc a b) := by
          have h1 := (hslice _ (ht_mem n)).sub (hslice _ hw₀)
          have h2 := h1.const_smul (t n)⁻¹
          exact h2
        exact (hcn.mono Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
      · rw [ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_uIoc]
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx => ?_)
        have hx' := Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hx
        have hda : HasDerivAt (g x) (deriv (g x) w₀) w₀ :=
          ((hd x hx').differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hw₀)).hasDerivAt
        exact hda.tendsto_slope_zero.comp ht_tend
    have hF_meas : ∀ᶠ w in nhds w₀, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => g x w)
        (volume.restrict (Set.uIoc a b)) := by
      filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hw₀] with w hw
      exact ((hslice w hw).mono Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
    have hF_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => g x w₀) volume a b :=
      (hslice w₀ hw₀).intervalIntegrable
    obtain ⟨-, hD⟩ := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (F := fun w x => g x w) (F' := fun w x => deriv (g x) w) (bound := fun _ => C / (ε / 4))
      (Metric.ball_mem_nhds w₀ (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < ε / 2)) hF_meas hF_int hmeas_deriv
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall
        (fun x hx w hw => hderiv_bd x (Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hx) w hw))
      intervalIntegrable_const
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx w hw =>
        ((hd x (Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hx)).differentiableAt
          (hU.mem_nhds (hball (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hw)))).hasDerivAt))
    exact hD.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  
  have holoId : ∀ (U : Set ℂ) (φ : ℂ → ℂ), IsOpen U → Convex ℝ U →
      (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ((η : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ U) → DifferentiableOn ℂ φ U →
      (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → φ (η : ℂ) = 0) → ∀ w ∈ U, φ w = 0 := by
    intro U φ hU hc hR hd hz w hw
    have h0 : (0 : ℂ) ∈ U := by simpa using hR 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : ℕ → ℂ, u = fun n : ℕ => (((1 : ℝ) / 2 * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hpos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < (1 : ℝ) / 2 * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := fun n => by positivity
    have hle : ∀ n : ℕ, (1 : ℝ) / 2 * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      intro n
      have : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
        linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg n : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n)]
      nlinarith
    have hu_tend : Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) := by
      apply tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.2
      refine ⟨?_, Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => ?_)⟩
      · have h1 := (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat).const_mul ((1 : ℝ) / 2)
        rw [mul_zero] at h1
        have h2 := (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp h1
        rw [Complex.ofReal_zero] at h2
        rw [hu]
        exact h2
      · rw [hu]
        simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        exact_mod_cast (hpos n).ne'
    have hfreq : ∃ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {0}ᶜ, φ z = 0 := by
      apply hu_tend.frequently
      refine (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => ?_)).frequently
      rw [hu]
      exact hz _ (by linarith [hpos n]) (by linarith [hle n])
    exact (hd.analyticOnNhd hU).eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq_zero
      hc.isPreconnected h0 hfreq hw
  
  have slice : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi →
        HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => f Y η)) (iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun Y => f Y η) X) X) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => f Y η)) (Ioo 0 Xi)) := by
    intro η e1 e2
    have hgs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => f Y η) (Ioo 0 Xi) :=
      hf.comp ((contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffOn) (fun Y hY => ⟨hY, e1, e2⟩)
    have hEq : ∀ m : ℕ, EqOn (iteratedDerivWithin m (fun Y => f Y η) (Ioo 0 Xi))
        (iteratedDeriv m (fun Y => f Y η)) (Ioo 0 Xi) :=
      fun m => iteratedDerivWithin_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioo
    have hU : UniqueDiffOn ℝ (Ioo (0 : ℝ) Xi) := isOpen_Ioo.uniqueDiffOn
    refine ⟨fun k X hX0 hX1 => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
    · have hdo := hgs.differentiableOn_iteratedDerivWithin (m := k)
        (by exact_mod_cast ENat.natCast_lt_top k) hU
      have hda : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedDerivWithin k (fun Y => f Y η) (Ioo 0 Xi)) X :=
        (hdo X ⟨hX0, hX1⟩).differentiableAt (Ioo_mem_nhds hX0 hX1)
      have hev : iteratedDerivWithin k (fun Y => f Y η) (Ioo 0 Xi) =ᶠ[nhds X]
          iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => f Y η) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hX0 hX1) (hEq k)
      have hda' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => f Y η)) X :=
        hev.differentiableAt_iff.1 hda
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
      exact hda'.hasDerivAt
    · exact (hgs.continuousOn_iteratedDerivWithin (m := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hU).congr
        (fun x hx => (hEq k hx).symm)
  
  unfold BgAnalytic at hA
  choose ρ₀ C fc hρ₀ hcont hX using hA
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ0, hρs⟩ : ∃ ρ : ℕ → ℝ, ρ 0 = ρ₀ 0 ∧ ∀ k, ρ (k + 1) = min (ρ k) (ρ₀ (k + 1)) :=
    ⟨fun n => Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => ℝ) (ρ₀ 0) (fun j r => min r (ρ₀ (j + 1))) n, rfl,
      fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hρpos : ∀ k, 0 < ρ k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => rw [hρ0]; exact hρ₀ 0
    | succ j ih => rw [hρs]; exact lt_min ih (hρ₀ _)
  have hρle : ∀ k, ρ k ≤ ρ₀ k := by
    intro k
    cases k with
    | zero => rw [hρ0]
    | succ j => rw [hρs]; exact min_le_right _ _
  have hρmono : ∀ k, ρ (k + 1) ≤ ρ k := fun k => by rw [hρs]; exact min_le_left _ _
  
  refine ⟨fc, ρ, C, fun k => ⟨hρpos k, hρmono k⟩,
    fun k => (hcont k).mono (Set.prod_mono subset_rfl (csMono _ _ (hρle k))),
    fun k X h0 h1 => ⟨(hX k X h0 h1).1.mono (csMono _ _ (hρle k)),
      fun w hw => (hX k X h0 h1).2.1 w (csMono _ _ (hρle k) hw)⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro k X w h0 h1 hw
    have hUk : cStrip (ρ (k + 1)) ⊆ cStrip (ρ₀ k) := csMono _ _ ((hρmono k).trans (hρle k))
    have hUk1 : cStrip (ρ (k + 1)) ⊆ cStrip (ρ₀ (k + 1)) := csMono _ _ (hρle (k + 1))
    have hI : ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → Y < Xi → uIcc X Y ⊆ Ioo 0 Xi :=
      fun Y a b => Set.ordConnected_Ioo.uIcc_subset ⟨h0, h1⟩ ⟨a, b⟩
    have key : ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → Y < Xi → fc k Y w = fc k X w + ∫ x in X..Y, fc (k + 1) x w := by
      intro Y hY0 hY1
      have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun z => fc k Y z - fc k X z - ∫ x in X..Y, fc (k + 1) x z) (cStrip (ρ (k + 1))) := by
        refine (((hX k Y hY0 hY1).1.mono hUk).sub ((hX k X h0 h1).1.mono hUk)).sub ?_
        apply holoParam (fc (k + 1)) X Y (C (k + 1)) _ (csOpen _)
        · exact (hcont (k + 1)).mono (Set.prod_mono (hI Y hY0 hY1) hUk1)
        · intro x hx
          obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := hI Y hY0 hY1 hx
          exact (hX (k + 1) x a b).1.mono hUk1
        · intro x hx z hz
          obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := hI Y hY0 hY1 hx
          exact (hX (k + 1) x a b).2.1 z (hUk1 hz)
      have hreal : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
          fc k Y (η : ℂ) - fc k X (η : ℂ) - ∫ x in X..Y, fc (k + 1) x (η : ℂ) = 0 := by
        intro η e1 e2
        obtain ⟨hd, hcon⟩ := slice η e1 e2
        have hint : ∫ x in X..Y, fc (k + 1) x (η : ℂ) =
            ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => f Y η) Y - iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => f Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr
            (g := fun x => ((iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun Y => f Y η) x : ℝ) : ℂ))]
          · rw [intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
            congr 1
            apply intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
            · intro x hx
              obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := hI Y hY0 hY1 hx
              exact hd k x a b
            · exact ((hcon (k + 1)).mono (hI Y hY0 hY1)).intervalIntegrable
          · intro x hx
            obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := hI Y hY0 hY1 hx
            exact (hX (k + 1) x a b).2.2 η e1 e2
        rw [hint, (hX k Y hY0 hY1).2.2 η e1 e2, (hX k X h0 h1).2.2 η e1 e2]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hΦ := holoId (cStrip (ρ (k + 1)))
        (fun z => fc k Y z - fc k X z - ∫ x in X..Y, fc (k + 1) x z) (csOpen _) (csConv _)
        (csReal _ (hρpos _)) hdiff hreal w hw
      linear_combination hΦ
    have hq : ContinuousOn (fun x => fc (k + 1) x w) (Ioo 0 Xi) :=
      (hcont (k + 1)).comp (Continuous.prodMk continuous_id continuous_const).continuousOn
        (fun x hx => ⟨hx, hUk1 hw⟩)
    have hderiv : HasDerivAt (fun Y => ∫ x in X..Y, fc (k + 1) x w) (fc (k + 1) X w) X :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right IntervalIntegrable.refl
        (hq.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter isOpen_Ioo X ⟨h0, h1⟩)
        (hq.continuousAt (Ioo_mem_nhds h0 h1))
    have hev : (fun Y => fc k Y w) =ᶠ[nhds X] (fun Y => fc k X w + ∫ x in X..Y, fc (k + 1) x w) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds h0 h1) (fun Y hY => key Y hY.1 hY.2)
    exact (hderiv.const_add (fc k X w)).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  · intro X η h0 h1 e1 e2
    rw [(hX 0 X h0 h1).2.2 η e1 e2, iteratedDeriv_zero]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (Xi : ℝ) (f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), BgHolo Xi f → BgHolo Xi g → BgHolo Xi (fun X η => f X η + g X η) ∧ BgHolo Xi (fun X η => f X η * g X η)

signature.name: bgHolo_add_mul
signature.statement: ∀ (Xi : ℝ) (f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), BgHolo Xi f → BgHolo Xi g → BgHolo Xi (fun X η => f X η + g X η) ∧ BgHolo Xi (fun X η => f X η * g X η)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xi f g hf hg
  obtain ⟨ff, ρf, Cf, hAf, hBf, hCf, hDf, hEf⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨fg, ρg, Cg, hAg, hBg, hCg, hDg, hEg⟩ := hg
  have hmono : ∀ r r' : ℝ, r ≤ r' → cStrip r ⊆ cStrip r' := by
    intro r r' hr w hw
    simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw ⊢
    exact ⟨by linarith [hw.1], by linarith [hw.2.1], by linarith [hw.2.2]⟩
  have hantf : Antitone ρf := antitone_nat_of_succ_le (fun n => (hAf n).2)
  have hantg : Antitone ρg := antitone_nat_of_succ_le (fun n => (hAg n).2)
  have I1 : ∀ j k : ℕ, j ≤ k → cStrip (min (ρf k) (ρg k)) ⊆ cStrip (ρf j) :=
    fun j k hjk => hmono _ _ ((min_le_left _ _).trans (hantf hjk))
  have I2 : ∀ j k : ℕ, j ≤ k → cStrip (min (ρf k) (ρg k)) ⊆ cStrip (ρg j) :=
    fun j k hjk => hmono _ _ ((min_le_right _ _).trans (hantg hjk))
  have hA : ∀ k, 0 < min (ρf k) (ρg k) ∧ min (ρf (k + 1)) (ρg (k + 1)) ≤ min (ρf k) (ρg k) :=
    fun k => ⟨lt_min (hAf k).1 (hAg k).1, min_le_min (hAf k).2 (hAg k).2⟩
  constructor
  · refine ⟨fun k X w => ff k X w + fg k X w, fun k => min (ρf k) (ρg k), fun k => Cf k + Cg k,
      hA, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k
      exact ((hBf k).mono (Set.prod_mono subset_rfl (I1 k k le_rfl))).add
        ((hBg k).mono (Set.prod_mono subset_rfl (I2 k k le_rfl)))
    · intro k X h0 h1
      refine ⟨((hCf k X h0 h1).1.mono (I1 k k le_rfl)).add
        ((hCg k X h0 h1).1.mono (I2 k k le_rfl)), ?_⟩
      intro w hw
      exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add ((hCf k X h0 h1).2 w (I1 k k le_rfl hw))
        ((hCg k X h0 h1).2 w (I2 k k le_rfl hw)))
    · intro k X w h0 h1 hw
      exact (hDf k X w h0 h1 (I1 (k + 1) (k + 1) le_rfl hw)).add
        (hDg k X w h0 h1 (I2 (k + 1) (k + 1) le_rfl hw))
    · intro X η h0 h1 e1 e2
      simp only [hEf X η h0 h1 e1 e2, hEg X η h0 h1 e1 e2, Complex.ofReal_add]
  · refine ⟨fun k X w => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ((k.choose j : ℕ) : ℂ) * ff j X w * fg (k - j) X w,
      fun k => min (ρf k) (ρg k),
      fun k => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ((k.choose j : ℕ) : ℝ) * Cf j * Cg (k - j),
      hA, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k
      apply continuousOn_finsetSum
      intro j hj
      have hjk : j ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
      exact (continuousOn_const.mul ((hBf j).mono (Set.prod_mono subset_rfl (I1 j k hjk)))).mul
        ((hBg (k - j)).mono (Set.prod_mono subset_rfl (I2 (k - j) k (Nat.sub_le _ _))))
    · intro k X h0 h1
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · apply DifferentiableOn.fun_sum
        intro j hj
        have hjk : j ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
        exact (((hCf j X h0 h1).1.mono (I1 j k hjk)).const_mul _).mul
          ((hCg (k - j) X h0 h1).1.mono (I2 (k - j) k (Nat.sub_le _ _)))
      · intro w hw
        refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum ?_)
        intro j hj
        have hjk : j ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
        have ha := (hCf j X h0 h1).2 w (I1 j k hjk hw)
        have hb := (hCg (k - j) X h0 h1).2 w (I2 (k - j) k (Nat.sub_le _ _) hw)
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (mul_le_mul ha hb (norm_nonneg _) ((norm_nonneg _).trans ha)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    · intro k X w h0 h1 hw
      have hder : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
          HasDerivAt (fun Y => ((k.choose j : ℕ) : ℂ) * ff j Y w * fg (k - j) Y w)
            (((k.choose j : ℕ) : ℂ) * ff (j + 1) X w * fg (k - j) X w +
              ((k.choose j : ℕ) : ℂ) * ff j X w * fg (k - j + 1) X w) X := by
        intro j hj
        have hjk : j ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
        have da := hDf j X w h0 h1 (I1 (j + 1) (k + 1) (by omega) hw)
        have db := hDg (k - j) X w h0 h1 (I2 (k - j + 1) (k + 1) (by omega) hw)
        exact (da.const_mul _).fun_mul db
      have hsum := HasDerivAt.fun_sum hder
      refine hsum.congr_deriv ?_
      beta_reduce
      have key := Finset.sum_choose_succ_mul (fun i l => ff i X w * fg l X w) k
      have e1 : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1 + 1),
            (((k + 1).choose j : ℕ) : ℂ) * ff j X w * fg (k + 1 - j) X w
          = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 2),
            (((k + 1).choose i : ℕ) : ℂ) * (ff i X w * fg (k + 1 - i) X w) :=
        Finset.sum_congr (by rfl) (fun i _ => mul_assoc _ _ _)
      rw [e1, key, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine (add_comm _ _).trans ?_
      congr 1
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        have e : k + 1 - i = k - i + 1 := by omega
        rw [e]
        ring
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        ring
    · intro X η h0 h1 e1 e2
      simp only [zero_add, Finset.sum_range_one, Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one, one_mul,
        Nat.sub_self, hEf X η h0 h1 e1 e2, hEg X η h0 h1 e1 e2, Complex.ofReal_mul]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (Xi : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), BgHolo Xi f → BgHolo Xi (pdX f) ∧ BgHolo Xi (pdE f)

signature.name: bgHolo_pdX_pdE
signature.statement: ∀ (Xi : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), BgHolo Xi f → BgHolo Xi (pdX f) ∧ BgHolo Xi (pdE f)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have L1open : ∀ ρ : ℝ, IsOpen (cStrip ρ) := by
    intro ρ
    have h1 : IsOpen {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ} := isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im.abs continuous_const
    have h2 : IsOpen {w : ℂ | -1 - ρ < w.re} := isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re
    have h3 : IsOpen {w : ℂ | w.re < 1 + ρ} := isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const
    have e : cStrip ρ = {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ} ∩ ({w : ℂ | -1 - ρ < w.re} ∩ {w : ℂ | w.re < 1 + ρ}) := by
      ext w
      simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff]
    rw [e]
    exact h1.inter (h2.inter h3)
  have L1mono : ∀ a ρ : ℝ, a ≤ ρ → cStrip a ⊆ cStrip ρ := by
    intro a ρ h w hw
    simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw ⊢
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hw
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have L1real : ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ((η : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ cStrip ρ := by
    intro ρ hρ η h1 h2
    simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.ofReal_re, abs_zero]
    exact ⟨hρ, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have L1ball : ∀ (a r ρ : ℝ) (w : ℂ), w ∈ cStrip a → 0 ≤ r → a + r ≤ ρ →
      Metric.closedBall w r ⊆ cStrip ρ := by
    intro a r ρ w hw hr har z hz
    simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw ⊢
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hz
    have hre := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (z - w)
    have him := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (z - w)
    rw [Complex.sub_re] at hre
    rw [Complex.sub_im] at him
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hw
    have e1 := abs_le.mp (hre.trans hz)
    have e2 := abs_le.mp (him.trans hz)
    have e3 := abs_lt.mp h1
    exact ⟨abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  
  have L3 : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) (x : ℝ), HasDerivAt φ z x →
      (∀ᶠ y in nhds x, φ y = ((g y : ℝ) : ℂ)) → z = ((deriv g x : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro g φ z x hφ hev
    have hψ : HasDerivAt (fun y => ((g y : ℝ) : ℂ)) z x :=
      hφ.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hev.mono fun y hy => hy.symm)
    have hre0 : HasDerivAt (fun y => Complex.reCLM ((g y : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Complex.reCLM z) x :=
      (Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt).comp_hasDerivAt x hψ
    have him0 : HasDerivAt (fun y => Complex.imCLM ((g y : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Complex.imCLM z) x :=
      (Complex.imCLM.hasFDerivAt).comp_hasDerivAt x hψ
    have hre : HasDerivAt g z.re x := by simpa using hre0
    have him : HasDerivAt (fun _ : ℝ => (0:ℝ)) z.im x := by simpa using him0
    have h0 : z.im = 0 := him.unique (hasDerivAt_const x 0)
    apply Complex.ext
    · rw [hre.deriv]; simp
    · simp [h0]
  
  have L4 : ∀ (I : Set ℝ) (Ω Ω' : Set ℂ) (s : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ), IsOpen I → 0 < s →
      (∀ w ∈ Ω', Metric.closedBall w s ⊆ Ω) →
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => F p.1 p.2) (I ×ˢ Ω) →
      (∀ X ∈ I, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F X) Ω) →
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => deriv (F p.1) p.2) (I ×ˢ Ω') := by
    intro I Ω Ω' s F hI hs hball hcont hdiff
    rintro ⟨X₀, w₀⟩ ⟨hX₀, hw₀⟩
    rw [Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨e, he, heI⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hI X₀ hX₀
    have hJI : Icc (X₀ - e / 2) (X₀ + e / 2) ⊆ I := by
      intro t ht
      apply heI
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]
    have hKΩ : Metric.closedBall w₀ s ⊆ Ω := hball w₀ hw₀
    have hcomp : IsCompact (Icc (X₀ - e / 2) (X₀ + e / 2) ×ˢ Metric.closedBall w₀ s) :=
      isCompact_Icc.prod (isCompact_closedBall _ _)
    have huc := hcomp.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous (hcont.mono (prod_mono hJI hKΩ))
    rw [Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff] at huc
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hu⟩ := huc (ε * s / 4) (div_pos (mul_pos hε hs) (by norm_num))
    have hballΩ : Metric.ball w₀ s ⊆ Ω := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hKΩ
    have hdd : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (F X₀)) (Metric.ball w₀ s) :=
      ((hdiff X₀ hX₀).mono hballΩ).deriv Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hca : ContinuousAt (deriv (F X₀)) w₀ :=
      hdd.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.ball_mem_nhds w₀ hs)
    rw [Metric.continuousAt_iff] at hca
    obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, hc2⟩ := hca (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
    refine ⟨min (min (e / 2) δ₁) (min δ₂ (s / 2)),
      lt_min (lt_min (half_pos he) hδ₁) (lt_min hδ₂ (half_pos hs)), ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨X, w⟩ ⟨hX, hw⟩ hdist
    rw [Prod.dist_eq] at hdist
    have hd1 : dist X X₀ < min (min (e / 2) δ₁) (min δ₂ (s / 2)) :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hdist
    have hd2 : dist w w₀ < min (min (e / 2) δ₁) (min δ₂ (s / 2)) :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hdist
    have hXe : dist X X₀ < e / 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hd1 ((min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
    have hXδ : dist X X₀ < δ₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le hd1 ((min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
    have hwδ : dist w w₀ < δ₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le hd2 ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
    have hws : dist w w₀ < s / 2 :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hd2 ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
    have hXJ : X ∈ Icc (X₀ - e / 2) (X₀ + e / 2) := by
      rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt] at hXe
      constructor <;> linarith [hXe.1, hXe.2]
    have hX₀J : X₀ ∈ Icc (X₀ - e / 2) (X₀ + e / 2) := by constructor <;> linarith
    have hsub : Metric.closedBall w (s / 2) ⊆ Metric.closedBall w₀ s := by
      intro z hz
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hz ⊢
      linarith [dist_triangle z w w₀]
    have hgd : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => F X z - F X₀ z) (Metric.closedBall w (s / 2)) :=
      ((hdiff X hX).sub (hdiff X₀ hX₀)).mono (hsub.trans hKΩ)
    have hgc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z => F X z - F X₀ z) (Metric.ball w (s / 2)) := by
      apply DifferentiableOn.diffContOnCl
      rw [closure_ball w (half_pos hs).ne']
      exact hgd
    have hgb : ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere w (s / 2), ‖F X z - F X₀ z‖ ≤ ε * s / 4 := by
      intro z hz
      have hzK : z ∈ Metric.closedBall w₀ s := hsub (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz)
      have hdz : dist ((X, z) : ℝ × ℂ) (X₀, z) < δ₁ := by
        simp only [Prod.dist_eq, dist_self]
        rw [max_eq_left dist_nonneg]
        exact hXδ
      have := hu (X, z) ⟨hXJ, hzK⟩ (X₀, z) ⟨hX₀J, hzK⟩ hdz
      rw [dist_eq_norm] at this
      exact this.le
    have hcauchy := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le (half_pos hs) hgc hgb
    have hwΩ : Ω ∈ nhds w :=
      Filter.mem_of_superset (Metric.ball_mem_nhds w (half_pos hs))
        (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans (hsub.trans hKΩ))
    have hderiv : deriv (fun z => F X z - F X₀ z) w = deriv (F X) w - deriv (F X₀) w :=
      (((hdiff X hX).differentiableAt hwΩ).hasDerivAt.sub
        ((hdiff X₀ hX₀).differentiableAt hwΩ).hasDerivAt).deriv
    show dist (deriv (F X) w) (deriv (F X₀) w₀) < ε
    have h2 := hc2 hwδ
    rw [dist_eq_norm] at h2 ⊢
    have hsplit : deriv (F X) w - deriv (F X₀) w₀ =
        deriv (fun z => F X z - F X₀ z) w + (deriv (F X₀) w - deriv (F X₀) w₀) := by
      rw [hderiv]; ring
    rw [hsplit]
    have hq : ε * s / 4 / (s / 2) = ε / 2 := by
      rw [div_div_eq_mul_div]
      field_simp
      ring
    calc ‖deriv (fun z => F X z - F X₀ z) w + (deriv (F X₀) w - deriv (F X₀) w₀)‖
        ≤ ‖deriv (fun z => F X z - F X₀ z) w‖ + ‖deriv (F X₀) w - deriv (F X₀) w₀‖ :=
          norm_add_le _ _
      _ < ε / 2 + ε / 2 := by linarith
      _ = ε := by ring
  
  have L5 : ∀ (I : Set ℝ) (Ω Ω' : Set ℂ) (s : ℝ) (F F' : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ), IsOpen I → 0 < s →
      (∀ w ∈ Ω', Metric.closedBall w s ⊆ Ω) →
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => F' p.1 p.2) (I ×ˢ Ω) →
      (∀ X ∈ I, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F X) Ω ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (F' X) Ω) →
      (∀ X ∈ I, ∀ z ∈ Ω, HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => F Y z) (F' X z) X) →
      ∀ X ∈ I, ∀ w ∈ Ω', HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => deriv (F Y) w) (deriv (F' X) w) X := by
    intro I Ω Ω' s F F' hI hs hball hcont hdiff hder X hX w hw
    rw [hasDerivAt_iff_isLittleO, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨e, he, heI⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hI X hX
    have hJI : Icc (X - e / 2) (X + e / 2) ⊆ I := by
      intro t ht
      apply heI
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]
    have hKΩ : Metric.closedBall w s ⊆ Ω := hball w hw
    have hcomp : IsCompact (Icc (X - e / 2) (X + e / 2) ×ˢ Metric.closedBall w s) :=
      isCompact_Icc.prod (isCompact_closedBall _ _)
    have huc := hcomp.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous (hcont.mono (prod_mono hJI hKΩ))
    rw [Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff] at huc
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hu⟩ := huc (c * s) (mul_pos hc hs)
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds X (lt_min (half_pos he) hδ₁)] with Y hY
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] at hY
    have hYe : |Y - X| < e / 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hY (min_le_left _ _)
    have hYδ : |Y - X| < δ₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le hY (min_le_right _ _)
    have hXJ : X ∈ Icc (X - e / 2) (X + e / 2) := by constructor <;> linarith
    have htJ : ∀ t ∈ uIcc X Y, t ∈ Icc (X - e / 2) (X + e / 2) ∧ |t - X| ≤ |Y - X| := by
      intro t ht
      rw [mem_uIcc] at ht
      have hYe' := abs_lt.mp hYe
      rcases ht with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · refine ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ?_⟩
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith), abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
        linarith
      · refine ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ?_⟩
        rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith), abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
        linarith
    have hYI : Y ∈ I := hJI (htJ Y right_mem_uIcc).1
    have hR : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall w s,
        ‖F Y z - F X z - ((Y - X : ℝ) : ℂ) * F' X z‖ ≤ c * s * ‖Y - X‖ := by
      intro z hz
      have hzΩ := hKΩ hz
      have hdR : ∀ t ∈ uIcc X Y, HasDerivWithinAt
          (fun t : ℝ => F t z - F X z - ((t - X : ℝ) : ℂ) * F' X z) (F' t z - F' X z) (uIcc X Y) t := by
        intro t ht
        have h1 := hder t (hJI (htJ t ht).1) z hzΩ
        have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ((t - X : ℝ) : ℂ) * F' X z) (F' X z) t := by
          have := ((hasDerivAt_id t).sub_const X).ofReal_comp.mul_const (F' X z)
          simpa using this
        exact ((h1.sub_const (F X z)).sub h2).hasDerivWithinAt
      have hbd : ∀ t ∈ uIcc X Y, ‖F' t z - F' X z‖ ≤ c * s := by
        intro t ht
        obtain ⟨htJ', hle⟩ := htJ t ht
        have hdz : dist ((t, z) : ℝ × ℂ) (X, z) < δ₁ := by
          simp only [Prod.dist_eq, dist_self]
          rw [max_eq_left dist_nonneg, Real.dist_eq]
          linarith
        have := hu (t, z) ⟨htJ', hz⟩ (X, z) ⟨hXJ, hz⟩ hdz
        rw [dist_eq_norm] at this
        exact this.le
      have := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le hdR hbd (convex_uIcc X Y)
        left_mem_uIcc right_mem_uIcc
      simpa using this
    have hgd : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => F Y z - F X z - ((Y - X : ℝ) : ℂ) * F' X z) Ω :=
      ((hdiff Y hYI).1.sub (hdiff X hX).1).sub ((hdiff X hX).2.const_mul _)
    have hgc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z => F Y z - F X z - ((Y - X : ℝ) : ℂ) * F' X z)
        (Metric.ball w s) := by
      apply DifferentiableOn.diffContOnCl
      rw [closure_ball w hs.ne']
      exact hgd.mono hKΩ
    have hcauchy := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hs hgc
      (fun z hz => hR z (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz))
    have hwΩ : Ω ∈ nhds w :=
      Filter.mem_of_superset (Metric.ball_mem_nhds w hs) (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hKΩ)
    have hd1 := (hdiff Y hYI).1.differentiableAt hwΩ
    have hd2 := (hdiff X hX).1.differentiableAt hwΩ
    have hd3 := (hdiff X hX).2.differentiableAt hwΩ
    have hderiv : deriv (fun z => F Y z - F X z - ((Y - X : ℝ) : ℂ) * F' X z) w =
        deriv (F Y) w - deriv (F X) w - ((Y - X : ℝ) : ℂ) * deriv (F' X) w :=
      ((hd1.hasDerivAt.sub hd2.hasDerivAt).sub (hd3.hasDerivAt.const_mul _)).deriv
    show ‖deriv (F Y) w - deriv (F X) w - (Y - X) • deriv (F' X) w‖ ≤ c * ‖Y - X‖
    rw [Complex.real_smul, ← hderiv]
    have hq : c * s * ‖Y - X‖ / s = c * ‖Y - X‖ := by
      field_simp
    rw [← hq]
    exact hcauchy
  
  intro Xi f hf
  unfold BgHolo at hf
  obtain ⟨fc, ρ, C, H1, H2, H3, H4, H5⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    unfold BgHolo
    refine ⟨fun k => fc (k + 1), fun k => ρ (k + 1), fun k => C (k + 1), fun k => H1 (k + 1),
      fun k => H2 (k + 1), fun k X h0 h1 => H3 (k + 1) X h0 h1,
      fun k X w h0 h1 hw => H4 (k + 1) X w h0 h1 hw, ?_⟩
    intro X η h0 h1 e1 e2
    have hmem : ((η : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ cStrip (ρ (0 + 1)) := L1real _ (H1 1).1 η e1 e2
    have hd := H4 0 X (η : ℂ) h0 h1 hmem
    have hev : ∀ᶠ Y in nhds X, fc 0 Y (η : ℂ) = ((f Y η : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds h0 h1] with Y hY
      exact H5 Y η hY.1 hY.2 e1 e2
    exact L3 (fun Y => f Y η) (fun Y => fc 0 Y (η : ℂ)) _ X hd hev
  · 
    unfold BgHolo
    refine ⟨fun k X w => deriv (fc k X) w, fun k => ρ k / 2, fun k => 2 * C k / ρ k,
      ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k
      have a := (H1 k).1
      have b := (H1 k).2
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · intro k
      have hρ := (H1 k).1
      exact L4 (Ioo 0 Xi) (cStrip (ρ k)) (cStrip (ρ k / 2)) (ρ k / 2) (fc k) isOpen_Ioo
        (half_pos hρ)
        (fun w hw => L1ball (ρ k / 2) (ρ k / 2) (ρ k) w hw (by linarith) (by linarith))
        (H2 k) (fun X hX => (H3 k X hX.1 hX.2).1)
    · intro k X h0 h1
      have hρ := (H1 k).1
      obtain ⟨hdk, hbk⟩ := H3 k X h0 h1
      refine ⟨(hdk.deriv (L1open _)).mono (L1mono _ _ (by linarith)), ?_⟩
      intro w hw
      have hcb : Metric.closedBall w (ρ k / 2) ⊆ cStrip (ρ k) :=
        L1ball (ρ k / 2) (ρ k / 2) (ρ k) w hw (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have hgc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fc k X) (Metric.ball w (ρ k / 2)) := by
        apply DifferentiableOn.diffContOnCl
        rw [closure_ball w (half_pos hρ).ne']
        exact hdk.mono hcb
      have hc := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le (half_pos hρ) hgc
        (fun z hz => hbk z (hcb (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz)))
      calc ‖deriv (fc k X) w‖ ≤ C k / (ρ k / 2) := hc
        _ = 2 * C k / ρ k := by rw [div_div_eq_mul_div, mul_comm (C k) 2]
    · intro k X w h0 h1 hw
      have hρ1 := (H1 (k + 1)).1
      have hle := (H1 k).2
      exact L5 (Ioo 0 Xi) (cStrip (ρ (k + 1))) (cStrip (ρ (k + 1) / 2)) (ρ (k + 1) / 2) (fc k)
        (fc (k + 1)) isOpen_Ioo (half_pos hρ1)
        (fun w hw => L1ball _ _ _ w hw (by linarith) (by linarith)) (H2 (k + 1))
        (fun Y hY => ⟨(H3 k Y hY.1 hY.2).1.mono (L1mono _ _ hle), (H3 (k + 1) Y hY.1 hY.2).1⟩)
        (fun Y hY z hz => H4 k Y z hY.1 hY.2 hz) X ⟨h0, h1⟩ w hw
    · intro X η h0 h1 e1 e2
      have hmem := L1real (ρ 0) (H1 0).1 η e1 e2
      have hda : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fc 0 X) (η : ℂ) :=
        (H3 0 X h0 h1).1.differentiableAt ((L1open _).mem_nhds hmem)
      have hd : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => fc 0 X (y : ℂ)) (deriv (fc 0 X) (η : ℂ)) η :=
        hda.hasDerivAt.comp_ofReal
      have hev : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in nhds η, fc 0 X (y : ℂ) = ((f X y : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds e1 e2] with y hy
        exact H5 X y h0 h1 hy.1 hy.2
      exact L3 (fun e => f X e) (fun y : ℝ => fc 0 X (y : ℂ)) _ η hd hev

signature.name: bgHolo_X_const
signature.statement: ∀ (Xi c : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), BgHolo Xi f → BgHolo Xi (fun X η => X * f X η) ∧ BgHolo Xi (fun X η => c * f X η)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xi c f hf
  obtain ⟨fc, ρ, C, H1, H2, H3, H4, H5⟩ := hf
  have hmono : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → cStrip a ⊆ cStrip b := by
    intro a b hab w hw
    simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw ⊢
    exact ⟨by linarith [hw.1], by linarith [hw.2.1], by linarith [hw.2.2]⟩
  have hanti : Antitone ρ := antitone_nat_of_succ_le (fun k => (H1 k).2)
  have hsub : ∀ k : ℕ, cStrip (ρ k) ⊆ cStrip (ρ (k - 1)) :=
    fun k => hmono _ _ (hanti (Nat.sub_le k 1))
  refine ⟨⟨fun k X w => (X : ℂ) * fc k X w + (k : ℂ) * fc (k - 1) X w, ρ,
      fun k => Xi * |C k| + k * |C (k - 1)|, H1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩,
    ⟨fun k X w => (c : ℂ) * fc k X w, ρ, fun k => |c| * |C k|, H1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro k
    beta_reduce
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => ((p.1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Ioo 0 Xi ×ˢ cStrip (ρ k)) :=
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).continuousOn
    have h2 := (H2 (k - 1)).mono (Set.prod_mono subset_rfl (hsub k))
    exact (h1.mul (H2 k)).add (continuousOn_const.mul h2)
  · intro k X hX0 hXi
    beta_reduce
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ((H3 k X hX0 hXi).1.const_mul _).add
        (((H3 (k - 1) X hX0 hXi).1.mono (hsub k)).const_mul _)
    · intro w hw
      have b1 := (H3 k X hX0 hXi).2 w hw
      have b2 := (H3 (k - 1) X hX0 hXi).2 w (hsub k hw)
      have a1 : C k ≤ |C k| := le_abs_self _
      have a2 : C (k - 1) ≤ |C (k - 1)| := le_abs_self _
      have n1 := norm_nonneg (fc k X w)
      have hk : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg k
      calc ‖(X : ℂ) * fc k X w + (k : ℂ) * fc (k - 1) X w‖
          ≤ ‖(X : ℂ) * fc k X w‖ + ‖(k : ℂ) * fc (k - 1) X w‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = X * ‖fc k X w‖ + (k : ℝ) * ‖fc (k - 1) X w‖ := by
            rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_natCast, Real.norm_eq_abs,
              abs_of_pos hX0]
        _ ≤ Xi * |C k| + (k : ℝ) * |C (k - 1)| :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul hXi.le (b1.trans a1) n1 (by linarith))
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (b2.trans a2) hk)
  · intro k X w hX0 hXi hw
    beta_reduce
    have hid : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => (Y : ℂ)) 1 X := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id X).ofReal_comp
    have hA := hid.mul (H4 k X w hX0 hXi hw)
    have hw' : w ∈ cStrip (ρ (k - 1 + 1)) := hmono _ _ (hanti (by omega)) hw
    have hB := (H4 (k - 1) X w hX0 hXi hw').const_mul (k : ℂ)
    have hS := hA.add hB
    convert hS using 1
    cases k with
    | zero => simp; ring
    | succ j => simp; push_cast; ring
  · intro X η hX0 hXi h1 h2
    beta_reduce
    rw [H5 X η hX0 hXi h1 h2]
    push_cast
    ring
  · intro k
    beta_reduce
    exact continuousOn_const.mul (H2 k)
  · intro k X hX0 hXi
    beta_reduce
    refine ⟨(H3 k X hX0 hXi).1.const_mul _, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (((H3 k X hX0 hXi).2 w hw).trans (le_abs_self _))
      (abs_nonneg _)
  · intro k X w hX0 hXi hw
    beta_reduce
    exact (H4 k X w hX0 hXi hw).const_mul (c : ℂ)
  · intro X η hX0 hXi h1 h2
    beta_reduce
    rw [H5 X η hX0 hXi h1 h2]
    push_cast
    ring

signature.name: bgHolo_profRadAvg
signature.statement: ∀ (Xi : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xi → BgHolo Xi g → BgHolo Xi (profRadAvg g)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hIoc : Set.uIoc (0:ℝ) 1 = Ioc 0 1 := Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one
  have hmem : ∀ s : ℝ, s ∈ Set.uIoc (0:ℝ) 1 → s ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) 1 := fun s hs => by
    rwa [hIoc] at hs
  
  have s1 : ∀ (G : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ) (C : ℝ), IsOpen U →
      (∀ w ∈ U, ContinuousOn (fun s => G s w) (Ioc (0:ℝ) 1)) →
      (∀ s ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, DifferentiableOn ℂ (G s) U) →
      (∀ s ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ w ∈ U, ‖G s w‖ ≤ C) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, G s w) U := by
    intro G U C hU hc hd hb w₀ hw₀
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU w₀ hw₀
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, R = ε / 3 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hR0 : 0 < R := by rw [hR]; positivity
    have hBU : Metric.ball w₀ R ⊆ U := fun z hz =>
      hball (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by rw [hR]; linarith) hz)
    have hcl : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball w₀ R, Metric.closedBall w R ⊆ U := by
      intro w hw z hz
      apply hball
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hw ⊢
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hz
      calc dist z w₀ ≤ dist z w + dist w w₀ := dist_triangle _ _ _
        _ < ε := by rw [hR] at hz hw; linarith
    have hcauchy : ∀ s ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball w₀ R, ‖deriv (G s) w‖ ≤ C / R := by
      intro s hs w hw
      apply Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hR0
      · apply DifferentiableOn.diffContOnCl
        rw [closure_ball w hR0.ne']
        exact (hd s hs).mono (hcl w hw)
      · intro z hz
        exact hb s hs z (hcl w hw (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz))
    have hder : ∀ s ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ w ∈ U, HasDerivAt (G s) (deriv (G s) w) w := by
      intro s hs w hw
      exact ((hd s hs).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hw)).hasDerivAt
    have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun s => deriv (G s) w₀)
        (volume.restrict (Set.uIoc (0:ℝ) 1)) := by
      rw [hIoc]
      obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d : ℕ → ℝ, d = fun n : ℕ => ε / ((n:ℝ) + 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z : ℕ → ℂ, z = fun n : ℕ => w₀ + ((d n : ℝ) : ℂ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hpos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < d n := fun n => by rw [hd]; positivity
      have hzU : ∀ n, z n ∈ U := by
        intro n
        apply hball
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, hz]
        simp only [add_sub_cancel_left, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        rw [abs_of_pos (hpos n), hd]
        dsimp only
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        have : (0:ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
        nlinarith
      have hzne : ∀ n, z n ≠ w₀ := by
        intro n h
        have h1 : z n = w₀ + ((d n : ℝ) : ℂ) := by rw [hz]
        have h2 : ((d n : ℝ) : ℂ) = 0 := by linear_combination h - h1
        have h3 : d n = 0 := Complex.ofReal_eq_zero.mp h2
        linarith [hpos n]
      have hzt : Filter.Tendsto z Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin w₀ {w₀}ᶜ) := by
        apply tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr
        refine ⟨?_, Filter.Eventually.of_forall hzne⟩
        have h1 : Filter.Tendsto d Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
          have := (tendsto_const_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat ε).comp (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat 2)
          refine this.congr (fun n => ?_)
          rw [hd]
          simp [Function.comp, Nat.cast_add]
        have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((d n : ℝ) : ℂ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
          have := (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp h1
          rw [Complex.ofReal_zero] at this
          exact this
        have h3 := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := w₀)).add h2
        rw [add_zero] at h3
        rw [hz]
        exact h3
      apply aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae Filter.atTop
        (f := fun n s => slope (G s) w₀ (z n))
      · intro n
        apply ContinuousOn.aestronglyMeasurable _ measurableSet_Ioc
        have e : (fun s => slope (G s) w₀ (z n)) =
            fun s => (z n - w₀)⁻¹ * (G s (z n) - G s w₀) := by
          funext s
          rw [slope_def_module, smul_eq_mul]
        rw [e]
        exact (continuousOn_const (c := (z n - w₀)⁻¹)).mul ((hc _ (hzU n)).sub (hc _ hw₀))
      · apply ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioc
        intro s hs
        exact (hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope.mp (hder s hs w₀ hw₀)).comp hzt
    have hmain := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (𝕜 := ℂ) (μ := volume) (a := 0) (b := 1) (F := fun w s => G s w)
      (F' := fun w s => deriv (G s) w) (x₀ := w₀) (bound := fun _ => C / R)
      (Metric.ball_mem_nhds w₀ hR0) ?_ ?_ hmeas ?_ intervalIntegrable_const ?_
    · exact hmain.2.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    · filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hw₀] with w hw
      rw [hIoc]
      exact (hc w hw).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioc
    · apply IntervalIntegrable.mono_fun' (g := fun _ => C) intervalIntegrable_const
      · rw [hIoc]
        exact (hc w₀ hw₀).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioc
      · rw [hIoc]
        exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioc (fun s hs => hb s hs w₀ hw₀)
    · exact ae_of_all _ (fun s hs w hw => hcauchy s (hmem s hs) w hw)
    · exact ae_of_all _ (fun s hs w hw => hder s (hmem s hs) w (hBU hw))
  
  have s2 : ∀ (H : ℝ → ℝ × ℂ → ℂ) (T : Set (ℝ × ℂ)) (C : ℝ),
      (∀ s ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, ContinuousOn (H s) T) →
      (∀ p ∈ T, ContinuousOn (fun s => H s p) (Ioc (0:ℝ) 1)) →
      (∀ s ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ p ∈ T, ‖H s p‖ ≤ C) →
      ContinuousOn (fun p => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, H s p) T := by
    intro H T C hc1 hc2 hb p₀ hp₀
    apply intervalIntegral.continuousWithinAt_of_dominated_interval (bound := fun _ => C)
    · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with p hp
      rw [hIoc]
      exact (hc2 p hp).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioc
    · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with p hp
      exact ae_of_all _ (fun s hs => hb s (hmem s hs) p hp)
    · exact intervalIntegrable_const
    · exact ae_of_all _ (fun s hs => hc1 s (hmem s hs) p₀ hp₀)
  
  have s3 : ∀ (A B : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ) (V : Set ℝ) (X C : ℝ), IsOpen V → X ∈ V →
      (∀ Y ∈ V, ContinuousOn (fun s => A s Y) (Ioc (0:ℝ) 1)) →
      ContinuousOn (fun s => B s X) (Ioc (0:ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ s ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ Y ∈ V, ‖B s Y‖ ≤ C) →
      (∀ s ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, ‖A s X‖ ≤ C) →
      (∀ s ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ Y ∈ V, HasDerivAt (A s) (B s Y) Y) →
      HasDerivAt (fun Y => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, A s Y) (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, B s X) X := by
    intro A B V X C hV hX hcA hcB hbB hbA hd
    have hmain := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (𝕜 := ℝ) (μ := volume) (a := 0) (b := 1) (F := fun Y s => A s Y)
      (F' := fun Y s => B s Y) (x₀ := X) (bound := fun _ => C)
      (hV.mem_nhds hX) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ intervalIntegrable_const ?_
    · exact hmain.2
    · filter_upwards [hV.mem_nhds hX] with Y hY
      rw [hIoc]
      exact (hcA Y hY).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioc
    · apply IntervalIntegrable.mono_fun' (g := fun _ => C) intervalIntegrable_const
      · rw [hIoc]
        exact (hcA X hX).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioc
      · rw [hIoc]
        exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioc (fun s hs => hbA s hs)
    · rw [hIoc]
      exact hcB.aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioc
    · exact ae_of_all _ (fun s hs Y hY => hbB s (hmem s hs) Y hY)
    · exact ae_of_all _ (fun s hs Y hY => hd s (hmem s hs) Y hY)
  
  intro Xi g hXi hg
  obtain ⟨gc, ρ, C, hρ, hcont, hhol, hcoh, hreal⟩ := hg
  have F1 : ∀ r, IsOpen (cStrip r) := by
    intro r
    have e : cStrip r = ({w : ℂ | |w.im| < r} ∩ {w : ℂ | -1 - r < w.re}) ∩
        {w : ℂ | w.re < 1 + r} := by
      ext w
      simp [cStrip, and_assoc]
    rw [e]
    exact ((isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re)).inter
      (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const)
  have F2 : ∀ k, cStrip (ρ (k + 1)) ⊆ cStrip (ρ k) := by
    intro k w hw
    simp only [cStrip, mem_setOf_eq] at hw ⊢
    have := (hρ k).2
    exact ⟨by linarith [hw.1], by linarith [hw.2.1], by linarith [hw.2.2]⟩
  have F3 : ∀ s ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi → 0 < s * X ∧ s * X < Xi :=
    fun s hs X h0 h1 => ⟨mul_pos hs.1 h0, lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_of_le_one_left h0.le hs.2) h1⟩
  have F4 : ∀ s ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ m : ℕ, ‖(s:ℂ) ^ m‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro s hs m
    rw [norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hs.1]
    exact pow_le_one₀ hs.1.le hs.2
  have F5 : ∀ (j m : ℕ) (X : ℝ) (w : ℂ), 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip (ρ j) →
      ContinuousOn (fun s : ℝ => (s:ℂ) ^ m * gc j (s * X) w) (Ioc (0:ℝ) 1) := by
    intro j m X w h0 h1 hw
    apply ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.pow m).continuousOn).mul
    have hmap : MapsTo (fun s : ℝ => (s * X, w)) (Ioc (0:ℝ) 1) (Ioo 0 Xi ×ˢ cStrip (ρ j)) :=
      fun s hs => ⟨F3 s hs X h0 h1, hw⟩
    exact (hcont j).comp ((continuous_id.mul continuous_const).prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
      hmap
  have F6 : ∀ (j m : ℕ) (s Y : ℝ) (w : ℂ), s ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) 1 → 0 < Y → Y < Xi →
      w ∈ cStrip (ρ j) → ‖(s:ℂ) ^ m * gc j (s * Y) w‖ ≤ C j := by
    intro j m s Y w hs h0 h1 hw
    rw [norm_mul]
    calc ‖(s:ℂ) ^ m‖ * ‖gc j (s * Y) w‖ ≤ 1 * ‖gc j (s * Y) w‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (F4 s hs m) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ C j := by
          rw [one_mul]
          exact (hhol j (s * Y) (F3 s hs Y h0 h1).1 (F3 s hs Y h0 h1).2).2 w hw
  refine ⟨fun k X w => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, (s:ℂ) ^ k * gc k (s * X) w, ρ, C, hρ, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro k
    refine s2 (fun s p => (s:ℂ) ^ k * gc k (s * p.1) p.2) (Ioo 0 Xi ×ˢ cStrip (ρ k)) (C k)
      (fun s hs => ?_) (fun p hp => F5 k k p.1 p.2 hp.1.1 hp.1.2 hp.2)
      (fun s hs p hp => F6 k k s p.1 p.2 hs hp.1.1 hp.1.2 hp.2)
    apply continuousOn_const.mul
    have hmap : MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => (s * p.1, p.2)) (Ioo 0 Xi ×ˢ cStrip (ρ k))
        (Ioo 0 Xi ×ˢ cStrip (ρ k)) :=
      fun p hp => ⟨F3 s hs p.1 hp.1.1 hp.1.2, hp.2⟩
    exact (hcont k).comp ((continuous_const.mul continuous_fst).prodMk continuous_snd).continuousOn
      hmap
  · 
    intro k X h0 h1
    refine ⟨s1 (fun s w => (s:ℂ) ^ k * gc k (s * X) w) (cStrip (ρ k)) (C k) (F1 _)
      (fun w hw => F5 k k X w h0 h1 hw)
      (fun s hs => ((hhol k (s * X) (F3 s hs X h0 h1).1 (F3 s hs X h0 h1).2).1.const_mul _))
      (fun s hs w hw => F6 k k s X w hs h0 h1 hw), fun w hw => ?_⟩
    have := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := 0) (b := 1) (C := C k)
      (f := fun s => (s:ℂ) ^ k * gc k (s * X) w)
      (fun s hs => F6 k k s X w (hmem s hs) h0 h1 hw)
    simpa using this
  · 
    intro k X w h0 h1 hw
    have hwk := F2 k hw
    refine s3 (fun s Y => (s:ℂ) ^ k * gc k (s * Y) w)
      (fun s Y => (s:ℂ) ^ (k + 1) * gc (k + 1) (s * Y) w) (Ioo 0 Xi) X (max (C k) (C (k + 1)))
      isOpen_Ioo ⟨h0, h1⟩ (fun Y hY => F5 k k Y w hY.1 hY.2 hwk) (F5 (k + 1) (k + 1) X w h0 h1 hw)
      (fun s hs Y hY => (F6 (k + 1) (k + 1) s Y w hs hY.1 hY.2 hw).trans (le_max_right _ _))
      (fun s hs => (F6 k k s X w hs h0 h1 hwk).trans (le_max_left _ _)) (fun s hs Y hY => ?_)
    have e1 := hcoh k (s * Y) w (F3 s hs Y hY.1 hY.2).1 (F3 s hs Y hY.1 hY.2).2 hw
    have e2 : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => s * Y) s Y := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id Y).const_mul s
    have e3 : HasDerivAt (fun Y => (s:ℂ) ^ k * gc k (s * Y) w)
        ((s:ℂ) ^ k * ((s:ℂ) * gc (k + 1) (s * Y) w)) Y := by
      have := (e1.scomp Y e2).const_mul ((s:ℂ) ^ k)
      rw [Complex.real_smul] at this
      exact this
    show HasDerivAt (fun Y => (s:ℂ) ^ k * gc k (s * Y) w)
      ((s:ℂ) ^ (k + 1) * gc (k + 1) (s * Y) w) Y
    have e4 : (s:ℂ) ^ (k + 1) * gc (k + 1) (s * Y) w =
        (s:ℂ) ^ k * ((s:ℂ) * gc (k + 1) (s * Y) w) := by ring
    rw [e4]
    exact e3
  · 
    intro X η h0 h1 e1 e2
    show ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, (s:ℂ) ^ 0 * gc 0 (s * X) (η:ℂ) = ((profRadAvg g X η : ℝ) : ℂ)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae (g := fun s => ((g (s * X) η : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (ae_of_all _ (fun s hs => by
        have := F3 s (hmem s hs) X h0 h1
        simp only [pow_zero, one_mul]
        exact hreal (s * X) η this.1 this.2 e1 e2))]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
    rfl

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (Xi : ℝ) (a : Fin 6 → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (b : Fin 8 → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (g0 s1 s2 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xi → (∀ i, BgHolo Xi (a i)) → (∀ i, BgHolo Xi (b i)) → BgHolo Xi g0 → BgHolo Xi s1 → BgHolo Xi s2 → ∃ r1 r2 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, BgHolo Xi r1 ∧ BgHolo Xi r2 ∧ ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi → -1 < η → η < 1 → r1 X η = a 0 X η * bgKer bgkG r1 X η + a 1 X η * bgKer bgkGp r1 X η + a 2 X η * bgKer bgkG (pdE r1) X η + a 3 X η * bgKer bgkU r2 X η + a 4 X η * bgKer bgkS r2 X η + a 5 X η * bgKer bgkS (pdE r2) X η + s1 X η ∧ r2 X η = b 0 X η * bgKer bgkU r2 X η + b 1 X η * bgKer bgkUp r2 X η + b 2 X η * bgKer bgkU (pdE r2) X η + b 3 X η * bgKer bgkS r2 X η + b 4 X η * bgKer bgkS (pdE r2) X η + b 5 X η * profRadInt (fun x e => g0 x e * bgKer bgkG r1 x e) X η + b 6 X η * profRadInt (fun x e => pdE g0 x e * bgKer bgkG r1 x e + g0 x e * bgKer bgkG (pdE r1) x e) X η + b 7 X η * (X * (g0 X η * bgKer bgkG r1 X η)) + s2 X η

signature.statement: ∀ (Xi : ℝ) (a : Fin 6 → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (b : Fin 8 → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (g0 s1 s2 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xi → (∀ i, BgHolo Xi (a i)) → (∀ i, BgHolo Xi (b i)) → BgHolo Xi g0 → BgHolo Xi s1 → BgHolo Xi s2 → ∃ r1 r2 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, BgHolo Xi r1 ∧ BgHolo Xi r2 ∧ ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi → -1 < η → η < 1 → r1 X η = a 0 X η * bgKer bgkG r1 X η + a 1 X η * bgKer bgkGp r1 X η + a 2 X η * bgKer bgkG (pdE r1) X η + a 3 X η * bgKer bgkU r2 X η + a 4 X η * bgKer bgkS r2 X η + a 5 X η * bgKer bgkS (pdE r2) X η + s1 X η ∧ r2 X η = b 0 X η * bgKer bgkU r2 X η + b 1 X η * bgKer bgkUp r2 X η + b 2 X η * bgKer bgkU (pdE r2) X η + b 3 X η * bgKer bgkS r2 X η + b 4 X η * bgKer bgkS (pdE r2) X η + b 5 X η * profRadInt (fun x e => g0 x e * bgKer bgkG r1 x e) X η + b 6 X η * profRadInt (fun x e => pdE g0 x e * bgKer bgkG r1 x e + g0 x e * bgKer bgkG (pdE r1) x e) X η + b 7 X η * (X * (g0 X η * bgKer bgkG r1 X η)) + s2 X η

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xi a b g0 s1 s2 hXi ha hb hg hs1 hs2
  
  choose ac ρa Ca hρa hCBa hHa hTa using fun i => bgHolo_complexify Xi (a i) hXi (ha i)
  choose bc ρb Cb hρb hCBb hHb hTb using fun i => bgHolo_complexify Xi (b i) hXi (hb i)
  obtain ⟨gc, ρg, Cg, hρg, hCBg, hHg, hTg⟩ := bgHolo_complexify Xi g0 hXi hg
  obtain ⟨c1, ρ1, C1, hρ1, hCB1, hH1, hT1⟩ := bgHolo_complexify Xi s1 hXi hs1
  obtain ⟨c2, ρ2, C2, hρ2, hCB2, hH2, hT2⟩ := bgHolo_complexify Xi s2 hXi hs2
  obtain ⟨ia, hia⟩ := Finite.exists_min ρa
  obtain ⟨ib, hib⟩ := Finite.exists_min ρb
  obtain ⟨ja, hja⟩ := Finite.exists_max Ca
  obtain ⟨jb, hjb⟩ := Finite.exists_max Cb
  obtain ⟨σ, hσa, hσb, hσg, hσ1, hσ2, hσpos⟩ : ∃ σ : ℝ, (∀ i, σ ≤ ρa i) ∧ (∀ i, σ ≤ ρb i) ∧
      σ ≤ ρg ∧ σ ≤ ρ1 ∧ σ ≤ ρ2 ∧ 0 < σ :=
    ⟨min (min (ρa ia) (ρb ib)) (min ρg (min ρ1 ρ2)),
      fun i => le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (hia i)),
      fun i => le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (hib i)),
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _),
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)),
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)),
      lt_min (lt_min (hρa ia) (hρb ib)) (lt_min hρg (lt_min hρ1 hρ2))⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hAa, hAb, hAg, hA1, hA2⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, (∀ i, Ca i ≤ A) ∧ (∀ i, Cb i ≤ A) ∧
      Cg ≤ A ∧ C1 ≤ A ∧ C2 ≤ A :=
    ⟨max (max (Ca ja) (Cb jb)) (max Cg (max C1 C2)),
      fun i => (hja i).trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _)),
      fun i => (hjb i).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _)),
      (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _),
      ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)).trans (le_max_right _ _),
      ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)).trans (le_max_right _ _)⟩
  have hstrip : ∀ s t : ℝ, s ≤ t → cStrip s ⊆ cStrip t := by
    intro s t hst w hw
    simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw ⊢
    exact ⟨by linarith [hw.1], by linarith [hw.2.1], by linarith [hw.2.2]⟩
  have hCBmono : ∀ (s t C D : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ), s ≤ t → C ≤ D → CB Xi t C φ → CB Xi s D φ := by
    intro s t C D φ hst hCD h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := h
    exact ⟨h1.mono (Set.prod_mono subset_rfl (hstrip s t hst)),
      fun X h0 h1' => (h2 X h0 h1').mono (hstrip s t hst),
      fun X w h0 h1' hw => (h3 X w h0 h1' (hstrip s t hst hw)).trans hCD⟩
  have hRealOf : ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      φ X (η : ℂ) = ((f X η : ℝ) : ℂ)) → CReal Xi φ := by
    intro φ f hT X η h0 h1 e1 e2
    rw [hT X η h0 h1 e1 e2, Complex.ofReal_im]
  
  obtain ⟨τ, B, ψ1, ψ2, hτ, hCBψ1, hCBψ2, hRψ1, hRψ2, hfix⟩ :=
    bg_complex_fixed_point Xi σ A ac bc gc c1 c2 hXi hσpos
      (fun i => hCBmono _ _ _ _ _ (hσa i) (hAa i) (hCBa i))
      (fun i => hCBmono _ _ _ _ _ (hσb i) (hAb i) (hCBb i))
      (hCBmono _ _ _ _ _ hσg hAg hCBg) (hCBmono _ _ _ _ _ hσ1 hA1 hCB1)
      (hCBmono _ _ _ _ _ hσ2 hA2 hCB2)
      (fun i => hRealOf _ _ (hTa i)) (fun i => hRealOf _ _ (hTb i))
      (hRealOf _ _ hTg) (hRealOf _ _ hT1) (hRealOf _ _ hT2)
  have hC0 : ∀ (s D : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ), 0 < s → CB Xi s D φ → BgHoloC Xi 0 φ := by
    intro s D φ hs h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := h
    refine ⟨s, D, hs, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
    subst hk0
    refine ⟨?_, fun X h0 h1' => ⟨?_, fun w hw => ?_⟩, fun h => absurd h (lt_irrefl 0)⟩
    · simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using h1
    · simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using h2 X h0 h1'
    · simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using h3 X w h0 h1' hw
  have hreg := bg_complex_regularity Xi τ ac bc gc c1 c2 ψ1 ψ2 hXi hτ (fun j i => hHa i j)
    (fun j i => hHb i j) hHg hH1 hH2 (hC0 τ B ψ1 hτ hCBψ1) (hC0 τ B ψ2 hτ hCBψ2) hfix
  obtain ⟨r1, hr1⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, r = fun (X η : ℝ) => (ψ1 X (η : ℂ)).re := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨r2, hr2⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, r = fun (X η : ℝ) => (ψ2 X (η : ℂ)).re := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hψ1T : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi → -1 < η → η < 1 → ψ1 X (η : ℂ) = ((r1 X η : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro X η h0 h1 e1 e2
    rw [hr1]
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp
    · simp [hRψ1 X η h0 h1 e1 e2]
  have hψ2T : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi → -1 < η → η < 1 → ψ2 X (η : ℂ) = ((r2 X η : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro X η h0 h1 e1 e2
    rw [hr2]
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp
    · simp [hRψ2 X η h0 h1 e1 e2]
  have hBH1 : BgHolo Xi r1 := by
    rw [hr1]; exact bgHolo_of_complex Xi ψ1 (fun j => (hreg j).1) hRψ1
  have hBH2 : BgHolo Xi r2 := by
    rw [hr2]; exact bgHolo_of_complex Xi ψ2 (fun j => (hreg j).2) hRψ2
  refine ⟨r1, r2, hBH1, hBH2, ?_⟩
  
  obtain ⟨tr1, dr1⟩ := bg_real_trace Xi τ ψ1 r1 hτ hψ1T
  obtain ⟨tr2, dr2⟩ := bg_real_trace Xi τ ψ2 r2 hτ hψ2T
  have hd1 := dr1 hCBψ1.2.1
  have hd2 := dr2 hCBψ2.2.1
  obtain ⟨tr1', -⟩ := bg_real_trace Xi τ (cDw ψ1) (pdE r1) hτ hd1
  obtain ⟨tr2', -⟩ := bg_real_trace Xi τ (cDw ψ2) (pdE r2) hτ hd2
  obtain ⟨-, dg⟩ := bg_real_trace Xi ρg gc g0 hρg hTg
  have hdg := dg hCBg.2.1
  have hT5 : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      (fun x z => gc x z * cKer bgkG ψ1 x z) X (η : ℂ) =
        (((fun x e => g0 x e * bgKer bgkG r1 x e) X η : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro X η h0 h1 e1 e2

noncomputable def cKer (k : ℝ → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (X : ℝ) (w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
