noncomputable def cRad (φ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (X : ℝ) (w : ℂ) : ℂ := ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, φ x w


noncomputable def cDw (φ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (X : ℝ) (w : ℂ) : ℂ := deriv (φ X) w


noncomputable def bgT1 (ac : Fin 6 → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (ψ1 ψ2 : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (X : ℝ) (w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ac 0 X w * cKer bgkG ψ1 X w + ac 1 X w * cKer bgkGp ψ1 X w + ac 2 X w * cKer bgkG (cDw ψ1) X w +
  ac 3 X w * cKer bgkU ψ2 X w + ac 4 X w * cKer bgkS ψ2 X w + ac 5 X w * cKer bgkS (cDw ψ2) X w


noncomputable def bgT2 (bc : Fin 8 → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (gc ψ1 ψ2 : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (X : ℝ) (w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  bc 0 X w * cKer bgkU ψ2 X w + bc 1 X w * cKer bgkUp ψ2 X w + bc 2 X w * cKer bgkU (cDw ψ2) X w +
  bc 3 X w * cKer bgkS ψ2 X w + bc 4 X w * cKer bgkS (cDw ψ2) X w +
  bc 5 X w * cRad (fun x z => gc x z * cKer bgkG ψ1 x z) X w +
  bc 6 X w * cRad (fun x z => cDw gc x z * cKer bgkG ψ1 x z + gc x z * cKer bgkG (cDw ψ1) x z) X w +
  bc 7 X w * ((X : ℂ) * (gc X w * cKer bgkG ψ1 X w))


def CB (Xi σ A : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => φ p.1 p.2) (Ioo 0 Xi ×ˢ cStrip σ) ∧
  (∀ X, 0 < X → X < Xi → DifferentiableOn ℂ (φ X) (cStrip σ)) ∧
  ∀ X w, 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip σ → ‖φ X w‖ ≤ A


def CReal (Xi : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi → -1 < η → η < 1 → (φ X (η : ℂ)).im = 0


def BgHoloC (Xi : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ ρ C : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ j →
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => φ Y p.2) p.1) (Ioo 0 Xi ×ˢ cStrip ρ) ∧
    (∀ X, 0 < X → X < Xi →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => φ Y w) X) (cStrip ρ) ∧
      ∀ w ∈ cStrip ρ, ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => φ Y w) X‖ ≤ C) ∧
    (k < j → ∀ X (w : ℂ), 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip ρ →
      HasDerivAt (fun Y => iteratedDeriv k (fun Y' => φ Y' w) Y)
        (iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun Y => φ Y w) X) X)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (Xi : ℝ) (r : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xi → BgHolo Xi r → ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi → -1 < η → η < 1 → X * pdX (bgKer bgkG r) X η = bgKer bgkGp r X η ∧ 2 * (X * pdX (pdX (bgKer bgkG r)) X η + 2 * pdX (bgKer bgkG r) X η) = r X η ∧ bgUz (bgKer bgkS r) X η = bgKer bgkU r X η ∧ X * pdX (bgUz (bgKer bgkS r)) X η = bgKer bgkUp r X η ∧ 2 * (X * pdX (pdX (bgUz (bgKer bgkS r))) X η + pdX (bgUz (bgKer bgkS r)) X η) = r X η ∧ pdE (bgUz (bgKer bgkS r)) X η = pdE (bgKer bgkU r) X η

signature.name: bgKer_identities
signature.statement: ∀ (Xi : ℝ) (r : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xi → BgHolo Xi r → ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi → -1 < η → η < 1 → X * pdX (bgKer bgkG r) X η = bgKer bgkGp r X η ∧ 2 * (X * pdX (pdX (bgKer bgkG r)) X η + 2 * pdX (bgKer bgkG r) X η) = r X η ∧ bgUz (bgKer bgkS r) X η = bgKer bgkU r X η ∧ X * pdX (bgUz (bgKer bgkS r)) X η = bgKer bgkUp r X η ∧ 2 * (X * pdX (pdX (bgUz (bgKer bgkS r))) X η + pdX (bgUz (bgKer bgkS r)) X η) = r X η ∧ pdE (bgUz (bgKer bgkS r)) X η = pdE (bgKer bgkU r) X η

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xi r hXi hr X η hX0 hX1 hη1 hη2
  
  have hderiv : ∀ (F Fh : ℝ → ℝ) (c Y : ℝ), 0 < Y → Y < Xi →
      (∀ Z, 0 < Z → Z < Xi → F Z = Fh Z) → HasDerivAt Fh c Y → deriv F Y = c := by
    intro F Fh c Y h0 h1 hEq hd
    have hev : F =ᶠ[nhds Y] Fh := by
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds h0 h1] with Z hZ
      exact hEq Z hZ.1 hZ.2
    exact (hd.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).deriv
  
  have hC : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 →
      X * pdX (bgKer bgkG r) X e = bgKer bgkGp r X e ∧
      2 * (X * pdX (pdX (bgKer bgkG r)) X e + 2 * pdX (bgKer bgkG r) X e) = r X e ∧
      bgUz (bgKer bgkS r) X e = bgKer bgkU r X e ∧
      X * pdX (bgUz (bgKer bgkS r)) X e = bgKer bgkUp r X e ∧
      2 * (X * pdX (pdX (bgUz (bgKer bgkS r))) X e + pdX (bgUz (bgKer bgkS r)) X e) = r X e := by
    intro e he1 he2
    
    have hs1 : ContinuousOn (fun x => r x e) (Ioo 0 Xi) ∧
        ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x < Xi → |r x e| ≤ M := by
      obtain ⟨fc, ρ, C, hρ, -, hb, hd, h0⟩ := hr
      have hmem : ∀ k, (e : ℂ) ∈ cStrip (ρ k) := by
        intro k
        have := (hρ k).1
        simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.ofReal_re, abs_zero]
        exact ⟨this, by linarith, by linarith⟩
      refine ⟨?_, C 0, fun x hx0 hx1 => ?_⟩
      · intro x hx
        have hca : ContinuousAt (fun Y => (fc 0 Y (e : ℂ)).re) x :=
          Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.comp (hd 0 x _ hx.1 hx.2 (hmem 1)).continuousAt
        have hev : (fun Y => (fc 0 Y (e : ℂ)).re) =ᶠ[nhds x] (fun Y => r Y e) := by
          filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds hx.1 hx.2] with Y hY
          rw [h0 Y e hY.1 hY.2 he1 he2, Complex.ofReal_re]
        exact (hca.congr hev).continuousWithinAt
      · have := (hb 0 x hx0 hx1).2 _ (hmem 0)
        rw [h0 x e hx0 hx1 he1 he2, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
        exact this
    obtain ⟨hc, M, hM⟩ := hs1
    
    have hint : ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → Y < Xi →
        IntervalIntegrable (fun x => r x e) volume 0 Y ∧
        IntervalIntegrable (fun x => x * r x e) volume 0 Y ∧
        IntervalIntegrable (fun x => Real.log x * r x e) volume 0 Y := by
      intro Y hY0 hY
      have hsub : Ioc 0 Y ⊆ Ioo 0 Xi := fun x hx => ⟨hx.1, lt_of_le_of_lt hx.2 hY⟩
      have hcY : ContinuousOn (fun x => r x e) (Ioc 0 Y) := hc.mono hsub
      have hP : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => r x e) volume 0 Y := by
        refine IntervalIntegrable.mono_fun' (g := fun _ => M) intervalIntegrable_const ?_ ?_
        · rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hY0.le]
          exact hcY.aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioc
        · rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hY0.le]
          refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioc (fun x hx => ?_)
          show ‖r x e‖ ≤ M
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hM x hx.1 (lt_of_le_of_lt hx.2 hY)
      refine ⟨hP, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact hP.continuousOn_mul continuousOn_id
      · have hg : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => M * ‖Real.log x‖) volume 0 Y :=
          (intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_log').norm.const_mul M
        refine IntervalIntegrable.mono_fun' hg ?_ ?_
        · rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hY0.le]
          exact ((Real.continuousOn_log.mono (fun x hx => hx.1.ne')).mul hcY).aestronglyMeasurable
            measurableSet_Ioc
        · rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hY0.le]
          refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioc (fun x hx => ?_)
          show ‖Real.log x * r x e‖ ≤ M * ‖Real.log x‖
          rw [norm_mul, mul_comm]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hM x hx.1 (lt_of_le_of_lt hx.2 hY)) (norm_nonneg _)
    
    obtain ⟨P, hPdef⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ → ℝ, P = fun Z => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Z, r x e := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Q, hQdef⟩ : ∃ Q : ℝ → ℝ, Q = fun Z => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Z, x * r x e := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ → ℝ, L = fun Z => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Z, Real.log x * r x e := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    
    have hftc : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (Y : ℝ), 0 < Y → Y < Xi → ContinuousOn f (Ioo 0 Xi) →
        IntervalIntegrable f volume 0 Y → HasDerivAt (fun Z => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Z, f x) (f Y) Y :=
      fun f Y h0 h1 hf hi => intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right hi
        (hf.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter isOpen_Ioo Y ⟨h0, h1⟩) (hf.continuousAt (Ioo_mem_nhds h0 h1))
    have hcQ : ContinuousOn (fun x => x * r x e) (Ioo 0 Xi) := continuousOn_id.mul hc
    have hcL : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.log x * r x e) (Ioo 0 Xi) :=
      (Real.continuousOn_log.mono (fun x hx => hx.1.ne')).mul hc
    have dP : ∀ Y, 0 < Y → Y < Xi → HasDerivAt P (r Y e) Y := fun Y h0 h1 => by
      rw [hPdef]; exact hftc _ Y h0 h1 hc (hint Y h0 h1).1
    have dQ : ∀ Y, 0 < Y → Y < Xi → HasDerivAt Q (Y * r Y e) Y := fun Y h0 h1 => by
      rw [hQdef]; exact hftc (fun x => x * r x e) Y h0 h1 hcQ (hint Y h0 h1).2.1
    have dL : ∀ Y, 0 < Y → Y < Xi → HasDerivAt L (Real.log Y * r Y e) Y := fun Y h0 h1 => by
      rw [hLdef]; exact hftc (fun x => Real.log x * r x e) Y h0 h1 hcL (hint Y h0 h1).2.2
    
    have hlin : ∀ Y, 0 < Y → Y < Xi → ∀ a b c : ℝ,
        (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Y, (a * r x e + b * (x * r x e) + c * (Real.log x * r x e))) =
          a * P Y + b * Q Y + c * L Y := by
      intro Y h0 h1 a b c
      obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3⟩ := hint Y h0 h1
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add ((i1.const_mul a).add (i2.const_mul b)) (i3.const_mul c),
        intervalIntegral.integral_add (i1.const_mul a) (i2.const_mul b),
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hPdef, hQdef, hLdef]
    have hcf : ∀ Y, 0 < Y → Y < Xi →
        bgKer bgkG r Y e = P Y / 2 - Q Y / (2 * Y) ∧ bgKer bgkGp r Y e = Q Y / (2 * Y) ∧
        bgKer bgkU r Y e = (Real.log Y * P Y - L Y) / 2 ∧ bgKer bgkUp r Y e = P Y / 2 ∧
        bgKer bgkS r Y e = Q Y / (2 * Y) - P Y / 2 - L Y / 2 + Real.log Y * P Y / 2 := by
      intro Y h0 h1
      have hY : Y ≠ 0 := h0.ne'
      have hsub : ∀ k : ℝ → ℝ, bgKer k r Y e = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Y, k (x / Y) * r x e := by
        intro k
        unfold bgKer
        have := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right (a := 0) (b := 1)
          (fun x => k (x / Y) * r x e) hY
        simp only [zero_mul, one_mul, smul_eq_mul, ne_eq, hY, not_false_eq_true,
          mul_div_cancel_right₀] at this
        rw [this, mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hY]
      have hae : ∀ (k : ℝ → ℝ) (a b c : ℝ), (∀ x, 0 < x → k (x / Y) * r x e =
          a * r x e + b * (x * r x e) + c * (Real.log x * r x e)) →
          bgKer k r Y e = a * P Y + b * Q Y + c * L Y := by
        intro k a b c hk
        rw [hsub k, ← hlin Y h0 h1 a b c]
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx => ?_))
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le h0.le] at hx
        exact hk x hx.1
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hae bgkG (1 / 2) (-(1 / (2 * Y))) 0 (fun x hx => by unfold bgkG; field_simp; ring)]
        field_simp; ring
      · rw [hae bgkGp 0 (1 / (2 * Y)) 0 (fun x hx => by unfold bgkGp; field_simp; ring)]
        field_simp; ring
      · rw [hae bgkU (Real.log Y / 2) 0 (-(1 / 2)) (fun x hx => by
          unfold bgkU; rw [Real.log_div hx.ne' hY]; ring)]
        ring
      · rw [hae bgkUp (1 / 2) 0 0 (fun x hx => by unfold bgkUp; ring)]
        ring
      · rw [hae bgkS (-(1 / 2) + Real.log Y / 2) (1 / (2 * Y)) (-(1 / 2)) (fun x hx => by
          unfold bgkS; rw [Real.log_div hx.ne' hY]; field_simp; ring)]
        field_simp; ring
    
    have hD1 : ∀ Y, 0 < Y → Y < Xi → deriv (fun Z => bgKer bgkG r Z e) Y = Q Y / (2 * Y * Y) := by
      intro Y h0 h1
      have hY : Y ≠ 0 := h0.ne'
      have hd := ((dP Y h0 h1).div_const 2).sub
        ((dQ Y h0 h1).div ((hasDerivAt_id' Y).const_mul 2) (by positivity))
      rw [hderiv _ _ _ Y h0 h1 (fun Z z0 z1 => (hcf Z z0 z1).1) hd]
      field_simp; ring
    have hD2 : ∀ Y, 0 < Y → Y < Xi →
        deriv (fun Z => bgKer bgkS r Z e) Y = P Y / (2 * Y) - Q Y / (2 * Y * Y) := by
      intro Y h0 h1
      have hY : Y ≠ 0 := h0.ne'
      have hd := ((((dQ Y h0 h1).div ((hasDerivAt_id' Y).const_mul 2) (by positivity)).sub
        ((dP Y h0 h1).div_const 2)).sub ((dL Y h0 h1).div_const 2)).add
        (((Real.hasDerivAt_log hY).mul (dP Y h0 h1)).div_const 2)
      rw [hderiv _ _ _ Y h0 h1 (fun Z z0 z1 => (hcf Z z0 z1).2.2.2.2) hd]
      field_simp; ring
    have hD3 : ∀ Y, 0 < Y → Y < Xi →
        bgUz (bgKer bgkS r) Y e = (Real.log Y * P Y - L Y) / 2 := by
      intro Y h0 h1
      have hY : Y ≠ 0 := h0.ne'
      show bgKer bgkS r Y e + Y * deriv (fun Z => bgKer bgkS r Z e) Y = _
      rw [hD2 Y h0 h1, (hcf Y h0 h1).2.2.2.2]
      field_simp; ring
    have hD4 : ∀ Y, 0 < Y → Y < Xi → pdX (bgUz (bgKer bgkS r)) Y e = P Y / (2 * Y) := by
      intro Y h0 h1
      have hY : Y ≠ 0 := h0.ne'
      have hd := (((Real.hasDerivAt_log hY).mul (dP Y h0 h1)).sub (dL Y h0 h1)).div_const 2
      show deriv (fun Z => bgUz (bgKer bgkS r) Z e) Y = _
      rw [hderiv _ _ _ Y h0 h1 hD3 hd]
      field_simp; ring
    have hXne : X ≠ 0 := hX0.ne'
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show X * deriv (fun Z => bgKer bgkG r Z e) X = _
      rw [hD1 X hX0 hX1, (hcf X hX0 hX1).2.1]
      field_simp
    · have hd : HasDerivAt (fun Z => Q Z / (2 * Z * Z))
          ((X * r X e * (2 * X * X) - Q X * (2 * 1 * X + 2 * X * 1)) / (2 * X * X) ^ 2) X :=
        (dQ X hX0 hX1).div (((hasDerivAt_id' X).const_mul 2).mul (hasDerivAt_id' X))
          (by positivity)
      have e1 : pdX (pdX (bgKer bgkG r)) X e = _ := hderiv _ _ _ X hX0 hX1 hD1 hd
      have e2 : pdX (bgKer bgkG r) X e = Q X / (2 * X * X) := hD1 X hX0 hX1
      rw [e1, e2]
      field_simp; ring
    · rw [hD3 X hX0 hX1, (hcf X hX0 hX1).2.2.1]
    · rw [hD4 X hX0 hX1, (hcf X hX0 hX1).2.2.2.1]
      field_simp
    · have hd : HasDerivAt (fun Z => P Z / (2 * Z))
          ((r X e * (2 * X) - P X * (2 * 1)) / (2 * X) ^ 2) X :=
        (dP X hX0 hX1).div ((hasDerivAt_id' X).const_mul 2) (by positivity)
      have e1 : pdX (pdX (bgUz (bgKer bgkS r))) X e = _ := hderiv _ _ _ X hX0 hX1 hD4 hd
      rw [e1, hD4 X hX0 hX1]
      field_simp; ring
  obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3, i4, i5⟩ := hC η hη1 hη2
  refine ⟨i1, i2, i3, i4, i5, ?_⟩
  show deriv (fun e => bgUz (bgKer bgkS r) X e) η = deriv (fun e => bgKer bgkU r X e) η
  apply Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq
  filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2] with e he
  exact (hC e he.1 he.2).2.2.1

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (Xi : ℝ) (g G Gd K : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xi → BgHolo Xi g → BgHolo Xi G → BgHolo Xi K → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi → -1 < η → η < 1 → pdE G X η = Gd X η) → BgHolo Xi (profRadInt (fun x e => g x e * G x e + K x e)) ∧ ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi → -1 < η → η < 1 → pdX (profRadInt (fun x e => g x e * G x e + K x e)) X η = g X η * G X η + K X η ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => g x e * G x e + K x e) X η = profRadInt (fun x e => g x e * G x e) X η + profRadInt K X η ∧ pdE (profRadInt (fun x e => g x e * G x e + K x e)) X η = profRadInt (fun x e => pdE g x e * G x e + g x e * Gd x e) X η + profRadInt (pdE K) X η

signature.name: bgHolo_radInt_calc
signature.statement: ∀ (Xi : ℝ) (g G Gd K : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xi → BgHolo Xi g → BgHolo Xi G → BgHolo Xi K → (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi → -1 < η → η < 1 → pdE G X η = Gd X η) → BgHolo Xi (profRadInt (fun x e => g x e * G x e + K x e)) ∧ ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi → -1 < η → η < 1 → pdX (profRadInt (fun x e => g x e * G x e + K x e)) X η = g X η * G X η + K X η ∧ profRadInt (fun x e => g x e * G x e + K x e) X η = profRadInt (fun x e => g x e * G x e) X η + profRadInt K X η ∧ pdE (profRadInt (fun x e => g x e * G x e + K x e)) X η = profRadInt (fun x e => pdE g x e * G x e + g x e * Gd x e) X η + profRadInt (pdE K) X η

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xi g G Gd K hXi hg hG hK hGd
  
  have slice : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, BgHolo Xi f → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ContinuousOn (fun x => f x η) (Ioo 0 Xi) ∧
      ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X < Xi → IntervalIntegrable (fun x => f x η) volume 0 X := by
    intro f hf η h1 h2
    obtain ⟨fc, ρ, C, hρ, hcont, hdiff, -, hreal⟩ := hf
    have hmem : (η : ℂ) ∈ cStrip (ρ 0) := by
      have := (hρ 0).1
      simp only [cStrip, mem_setOf_eq, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.ofReal_re, abs_zero]
      exact ⟨this, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn (fun x => f x η) (Ioo 0 Xi) := by
      have h1' : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => fc 0 x (η : ℂ)) (Ioo 0 Xi) :=
        (hcont 0).comp (Continuous.prodMk continuous_id continuous_const).continuousOn
          (fun x hx => ⟨hx, hmem⟩)
      have h2' : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => (fc 0 x (η : ℂ)).re) (Ioo 0 Xi) :=
        Complex.continuous_re.comp_continuousOn h1'
      refine h2'.congr (fun x hx => ?_)
      simp only [hreal x η hx.1 hx.2 h1 h2, Complex.ofReal_re]
    refine ⟨hc, fun X hX0 hXX => ?_⟩
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hX0]
    have hsub : Ioc 0 X ⊆ Ioo 0 Xi := fun x hx => ⟨hx.1, lt_of_le_of_lt hx.2 hXX⟩
    haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Ioc (0:ℝ) X)) :=
      ⟨by rw [Measure.restrict_apply_univ]; exact measure_Ioc_lt_top⟩
    show Integrable (fun x => f x η) (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 X))
    refine Integrable.of_bound (C := C 0)
      ((hc.mono hsub).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioc) ?_
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioc (fun x hx => ?_)
    have hx' := hsub hx
    have hb := (hdiff 0 x hx'.1 hx'.2).2 _ hmem
    rw [hreal x η hx'.1 hx'.2 h1 h2, Complex.norm_real] at hb
    exact hb
  
  have etadiff : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, BgHolo Xi f → ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun e => f X e) η := by
    intro f hf X η hX0 hXX h1 h2
    obtain ⟨fc, ρ, C, hρ, -, hdiff, -, hreal⟩ := hf
    have hopen : IsOpen (cStrip (ρ 0)) := by
      have e : cStrip (ρ 0) = {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ 0} ∩
          ({w : ℂ | -1 - ρ 0 < w.re} ∩ {w : ℂ | w.re < 1 + ρ 0}) := by
        ext w
        simp only [cStrip, mem_setOf_eq, mem_inter_iff]
      rw [e]
      exact (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im.abs continuous_const).inter
        ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
          (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const))
    have hmem : (η : ℂ) ∈ cStrip (ρ 0) := by
      have := (hρ 0).1
      simp only [cStrip, mem_setOf_eq, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.ofReal_re, abs_zero]
      exact ⟨this, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hd : HasDerivAt (fc 0 X) (deriv (fc 0 X) (η : ℂ)) (η : ℂ) :=
      ((hdiff 0 X hX0 hXX).1.differentiableAt (hopen.mem_nhds hmem)).hasDerivAt
    have hr := hd.real_of_complex
    have hev : (fun e => f X e) =ᶠ[nhds η] (fun y : ℝ => (fc 0 X (y : ℂ)).re) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2] with y hy
      rw [hreal X y hX0 hXX hy.1 hy.2, Complex.ofReal_re]
    exact (hr.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).differentiableAt
  
  have repr : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ), profRadInt f X η = 2 * bgKer bgkUp f X η := by
    intro f X η
    unfold profRadInt bgKer bgkUp
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    rcases eq_or_ne X 0 with hX | hX
    · subst hX
      simp
    · have hc := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right (a := 0) (b := 1) (fun x => f x η) hX
      simp only [zero_mul, one_mul, smul_eq_mul] at hc
      rw [hc]
      set I := ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, f x η
      rw [show 2 * (X * (1 / 2 * (X⁻¹ * I))) = (X * X⁻¹) * I by ring, mul_inv_cancel₀ hX, one_mul]
  
  have hgG : BgHolo Xi (fun x e => g x e * G x e) := (bgHolo_add_mul Xi g G hg hG).2
  have hH : BgHolo Xi (fun x e => g x e * G x e + K x e) := (bgHolo_add_mul Xi _ K hgG hK).1
  refine ⟨(bgHolo_kernels Xi _ hXi hH).1, ?_⟩
  intro X η hX0 hXX h1 h2
  
  have split : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 →
      profRadInt (fun x e => g x e * G x e + K x e) X e =
        profRadInt (fun x e => g x e * G x e) X e + profRadInt K X e := by
    intro e e1 e2
    unfold profRadInt

      have h2r : 2 * r * (|K0| + 1) = ε := by
        rw [hr]; field_simp
      refine ⟨iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) '' (Ω ∩ Metric.ball z r),
        Filter.image_mem_map (inter_mem_nhdsWithin Ω (Metric.ball_mem_nhds z hrpos)), ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨q, ⟨hq, hqb⟩, rfl⟩ _ ⟨q', ⟨hq', hqb'⟩, rfl⟩
      have hL := F3 m K0 hK0 q' hq' q hq
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hqb hqb'
      have hd : ‖q - q'‖ < 2 * r := by
        rw [← dist_eq_norm]
        calc dist q q' ≤ dist q z + dist q' z := dist_triangle_right _ _ _
          _ < 2 * r := by linarith
      have hlin : |K0| * (2 * r) = ε - 2 * r := by linear_combination h2r
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) q - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) q'‖ ≤ K0 * ‖q - q'‖ := hL
        _ ≤ |K0| * ‖q - q'‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (norm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ |K0| * (2 * r) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd.le (abs_nonneg _)
        _ < ε := by linarith
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := CompleteSpace.complete hcau
    exact ⟨L, hL⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : (m : ℕ) → ℝ × ℝ → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ,
      E = fun m => extendFrom Ω (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have Econt : ∀ m : ℕ, ContinuousOn (E m) (closure Ω) := by
    intro m; rw [hE]; exact continuousOn_extendFrom subset_rfl (F4 m)
  have Eeq : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ q ∈ Ω, E m q = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) q := by
    intro m q hq; rw [hE]
    exact extendFrom_extends (fun p hp => (F2 m p hp).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt) q hq
  have Etend : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ closure Ω,
      Filter.Tendsto (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f)) (nhdsWithin z Ω) (nhds (E m z)) := by
    intro m z hz; rw [hE]; exact tendsto_extendFrom (F4 m z hz)
  have F6 : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ closure Ω, HasFDerivWithinAt (E m)
      (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ (E (m + 1) z))
      (closure Ω) z := by
    intro m z hz
    have hevq : ∀ q ∈ Ω, E m =ᶠ[nhds q] iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿f) := fun q hq =>
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hΩo.mem_nhds hq) (fun p hp => Eeq m p hp)
    apply hasFDerivWithinAt_closure_of_tendsto_fderiv
    · intro q hq
      exact ((F2 m q hq).congr_of_eventuallyEq (hevq q hq)).differentiableWithinAt
    · exact hΩc
    · exact hΩo
    · intro y hy
      exact (Econt m y hy).mono subset_closure
    · have ht := ((continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ).continuous.tendsto
        (E (m + 1) z)).comp (Etend (m + 1) z hz)
      refine ht.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with q hq
      rw [(hevq q hq).fderiv_eq, fderiv_iteratedFDeriv]
  have hTcl : Ico 0 Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ closure Ω := by
    rw [hΩdef, closure_prod_eq, closure_Ioo hXi.ne, closure_Ioo (by norm_num)]
    exact prod_mono Ico_subset_Icc_self Ioo_subset_Icc_self
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, g = fun X η => if 0 < X then f X η else (E 0 (X, η)) 0 :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hgf : ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → g X η = f X η := by
    intro X η hX; rw [hg]; exact if_pos hX
  have hgΩ : ∀ q ∈ Ω, (↿g) =ᶠ[nhds q] (↿f) := by
    intro q hq
    filter_upwards [hΩo.mem_nhds hq] with p hp
    exact hgf p.1 p.2 hp.1.1
  refine ⟨g, ?_, fun X η h0 _ => hgf X η h0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have hT : HasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω) (↿g) (fun z m => E m z)
        (Ico 0 Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
      apply HasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn.mk
      · intro z hz
        rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.curry0_apply]
        obtain ⟨X, η⟩ := z
        show E 0 (X, η) 0 = g X η
        by_cases hX : 0 < X
        · have hzΩ : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ω := ⟨⟨hX, hz.1.2⟩, hz.2⟩
          rw [Eeq 0 _ hzΩ, iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply, hgf X η hX]
          rfl
        · rw [hg]; exact (if_neg hX).symm
      · intro m _ z hz
        show HasFDerivWithinAt (E m) (E (m + 1) z).curryLeft (Ico 0 Xi ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) z
        have heq : (E (m + 1) z).curryLeft = continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ
            (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ (E (m + 1) z) := by
          refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun x => ContinuousMultilinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
          rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryLeft_apply, continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv_apply]
        rw [heq]
        exact (F6 m z (hTcl hz)).mono hTcl
      · intro m _
        exact (Econt m).mono hTcl
    exact hT.contDiffOn
  · 
    intro m
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := BD m f hf
    refine ⟨C, fun X η h0 h1 e1 e2 => ?_⟩
    have hq : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ω := ⟨⟨h0, h1⟩, e1, e2⟩
    rw [((hgΩ _ hq).iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
    exact hC _ hq
  · 
    intro k
    obtain ⟨ρ', C, fc, hρ', hcont, hX⟩ := AN k
    refine ⟨ρ', C, fc, hρ', hcont, fun X h0 h1 => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := hX X h0 h1
    refine ⟨a, b, fun η e1 e2 => ?_⟩
    have hev : (fun Y => f Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X] (fun Y => g Y η) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds h0 h1] with Y hY
      exact (hgf Y η hY.1).symm
    rw [c η e1 e2, hev.iteratedDeriv_eq k]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h Xi : ℝ) (S G : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 < Xi → 1 ≤ n → (∀ k : ℕ, k < n → BgHolo Xi (S k) ∧ BgHolo Xi (G k)) → (∀ i, BgHolo Xi (bgCoefA h n (G 0) (S 0) i)) ∧ (∀ i, BgHolo Xi (bgCoefB h n (S 0) i)) ∧ BgHolo Xi (bgKTh h S G n) ∧ BgHolo Xi (bgKZ h S n) ∧ BgHolo Xi (bgKRad h S G n)

signature.name: bg_coef_holo
signature.statement: ∀ (h Xi : ℝ) (S G : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 100 → 0 < Xi → 1 ≤ n → (∀ k : ℕ, k < n → BgHolo Xi (S k) ∧ BgHolo Xi (G k)) → (∀ i, BgHolo Xi (bgCoefA h n (G 0) (S 0) i)) ∧ (∀ i, BgHolo Xi (bgCoefB h n (S 0) i)) ∧ BgHolo Xi (bgKTh h S G n) ∧ BgHolo Xi (bgKZ h S n) ∧ BgHolo Xi (bgKRad h S G n)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Xi S G n hh0 hh1 _hXi hn hH
  
  have hgen : ∀ (φ : ℂ → ℂ) (ρ0 B : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ρ0 → DifferentiableOn ℂ φ (cStrip ρ0) →
      (∀ w ∈ cStrip ρ0, ‖φ w‖ ≤ B) → (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → φ (η : ℂ) = ((g η : ℝ) : ℂ)) →
      BgHolo Xi (fun _ η => g η) := by
    intro φ ρ0 B g hρ hd hb hr
    refine ⟨fun k _ w => if k = 0 then φ w else 0, fun _ => ρ0, fun k => if k = 0 then B else 0,
      ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k; exact ⟨hρ, le_rfl⟩
    · intro k
      by_cases hk : k = 0
      · simp only [if_pos hk]
        exact hd.continuousOn.comp continuous_snd.continuousOn (fun p hp => hp.2)
      · simp only [if_neg hk]
        exact continuousOn_const
    · intro k X _ _
      by_cases hk : k = 0
      · simp only [if_pos hk]
        exact ⟨hd, hb⟩
      · simp only [if_neg hk]
        exact ⟨differentiableOn_const _, fun w _ => by simp⟩
    · intro k X w _ _ _
      beta_reduce
      rw [if_neg (Nat.add_one_ne_zero k)]
      exact hasDerivAt_const _ _
    · intro X η _ _ h1 h2
      show (if (0:ℕ) = 0 then φ (η:ℂ) else 0) = ((g η : ℝ) : ℂ)
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      exact hr η h1 h2
  have hconst : ∀ c : ℝ, BgHolo Xi (fun _ _ => c) := fun c =>
    hgen (fun _ => (c : ℂ)) 1 ‖(c : ℂ)‖ (fun _ => c) one_pos (differentiableOn_const _)
      (fun _ _ => le_rfl) (fun _ _ _ => rfl)
  have hEta : BgHolo Xi (fun _ η => η) := by
    refine hgen (fun w => w) 1 3 (fun η => η) one_pos differentiableOn_id ?_ (fun _ _ _ => rfl)
    intro w hw
    simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hw
    have hre : |w.re| < 2 := abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hn' := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im w
    show ‖w‖ ≤ 3
    linarith
  have hLb : ∀ w ∈ cStrip (1 / 4), (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ ‖1 - 2 * (h : ℂ) * w ^ 2‖ := by
    intro w hw
    simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hw
    have hre : |w.re| < 5 / 4 := abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hn' := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im w
    have hw32 : ‖w‖ ≤ 3 / 2 := by linarith
    have hnorm : ‖2 * (h : ℂ) * w ^ 2‖ = 2 * h * ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hh0]
      norm_num
    have hsq : ‖w‖ ^ 2 ≤ 9 / 4 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg w]
    have hsub := norm_sub_norm_le (1 : ℂ) (2 * (h : ℂ) * w ^ 2)
    rw [norm_one, hnorm] at hsub
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hh0.le
    nlinarith
  have hLinv : BgHolo Xi (fun _ η => (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
    refine hgen (fun w => (1 - 2 * (h : ℂ) * w ^ 2)⁻¹) (1 / 4) 2 (fun η => (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)⁻¹)
      (by norm_num) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · have hd0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w : ℂ => 1 - 2 * (h : ℂ) * w ^ 2) (cStrip (1 / 4)) := by
        fun_prop
      have hne : ∀ w ∈ cStrip (1 / 4), 1 - 2 * (h : ℂ) * w ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
        intro w hw h0
        have := hLb w hw
        rw [h0, norm_zero] at this
        linarith
      exact hd0.inv hne
    · intro w hw
      have hx := hLb w hw
      show ‖(1 - 2 * (h : ℂ) * w ^ 2)⁻¹‖ ≤ 2
      rw [norm_inv]
      calc ‖1 - 2 * (h : ℂ) * w ^ 2‖⁻¹ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by norm_num) hx
        _ = 2 := by norm_num
    · intro η _ _
      show (1 - 2 * (h : ℂ) * (η : ℂ) ^ 2)⁻¹ = (((1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)
      push_cast
      try ring
  have hAM := bgHolo_add_mul Xi
  have hadd : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, BgHolo Xi f → BgHolo Xi g →
      BgHolo Xi (fun X η => f X η + g X η) := fun f g hf hg => (hAM f g hf hg).1
  have hmul : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, BgHolo Xi f → BgHolo Xi g →
      BgHolo Xi (fun X η => f X η * g X η) := fun f g hf hg => (hAM f g hf hg).2
  have hpdX : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, BgHolo Xi f → BgHolo Xi (pdX f) :=
    fun f hf => (bgHolo_pdX_pdE Xi f hf).1
  have hpdE : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, BgHolo Xi f → BgHolo Xi (pdE f) :=
    fun f hf => (bgHolo_pdX_pdE Xi f hf).2
  have hXat : BgHolo Xi (fun X _ => X) := by
    refine ⟨fun k X _ => if k = 0 then (X : ℂ) else if k = 1 then 1 else 0, fun _ => 1,
      fun k => if k = 0 then Xi else 1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k; exact ⟨one_pos, le_rfl⟩
    · intro k
      by_cases hk0 : k = 0
      · simp only [if_pos hk0]
        exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).continuousOn
      · by_cases hk1 : k = 1
        · simp only [if_neg hk0, if_pos hk1]
          exact continuousOn_const
        · simp only [if_neg hk0, if_neg hk1]
          exact continuousOn_const
    · intro k X hX0 hXi
      by_cases hk0 : k = 0
      · simp only [if_pos hk0]
        refine ⟨differentiableOn_const _, fun w _ => ?_⟩
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hX0]
        exact hXi.le
      · by_cases hk1 : k = 1
        · simp only [if_neg hk0, if_pos hk1]
          exact ⟨differentiableOn_const _, fun w _ => by simp⟩
        · simp only [if_neg hk0, if_neg hk1]
          exact ⟨differentiableOn_const _, fun w _ => by simp⟩
    · intro k X w _ _ _
      by_cases hk0 : k = 0
      · simp only [if_pos hk0, if_neg (Nat.add_one_ne_zero k), if_pos (show k + 1 = 1 by omega)]
        first
          | simpa using (hasDerivAt_id X).ofReal_comp
          | simpa using Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt (x := X)
      · by_cases hk1 : k = 1
        · simp only [if_neg hk0, if_pos hk1, if_neg (Nat.add_one_ne_zero k),
            if_neg (show k + 1 ≠ 1 by omega)]
          exact hasDerivAt_const _ _
        · simp only [if_neg hk0, if_neg hk1, if_neg (Nat.add_one_ne_zero k),
            if_neg (show k + 1 ≠ 1 by omega)]
          exact hasDerivAt_const _ _
    · intro X η _ _ _ _
      show (if (0:ℕ) = 0 then (X : ℂ) else if (0:ℕ) = 1 then 1 else 0) = ((X : ℝ) : ℂ)
      rw [if_pos rfl]
  have hcmul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), BgHolo Xi f → BgHolo Xi (fun X η => c * f X η) :=
    fun c f hf => hmul (fun _ _ => c) f (hconst c) hf
  have hsub : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, BgHolo Xi f → BgHolo Xi g →
      BgHolo Xi (fun X η => f X η - g X η) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    have e : (fun X η => f X η - g X η) = fun X η => f X η + -1 * g X η := by
      funext X η; ring
    rw [e]
    exact hadd f (fun X η => -1 * g X η) hf (hcmul (-1) g hg)
  have hneg : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, BgHolo Xi f → BgHolo Xi (fun X η => -f X η) := by
    intro f hf
    have e : (fun X η => -f X η) = fun X η => -1 * f X η := by
      funext X η; ring
    rw [e]
    exact hcmul (-1) f hf
  have hdiv : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, BgHolo Xi f → BgHolo Xi (fun X η => (g X η)⁻¹) →
      BgHolo Xi (fun X η => f X η / g X η) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    have e : (fun X η => f X η / g X η) = fun X η => f X η * (g X η)⁻¹ := by
      funext X η; rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    rw [e]
    exact hmul f (fun X η => (g X η)⁻¹) hf hg
  have hpow : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, BgHolo Xi f → BgHolo Xi (fun X η => f X η ^ 2) := by
    intro f hf
    have e : (fun X η => f X η ^ 2) = fun X η => f X η * f X η := by
      funext X η; ring
    rw [e]
    exact hmul f f hf hf
  have hite : ∀ (c : Prop) [Decidable c] (f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), BgHolo Xi f → BgHolo Xi g →
      BgHolo Xi (fun X η => if c then f X η else g X η) := by
    intro c _ f g hf hg
    by_cases hc : c
    · have e : (fun X η => if c then f X η else g X η) = f := by
        funext X η; simp [hc]
      rw [e]; exact hf
    · have e : (fun X η => if c then f X η else g X η) = g := by
        funext X η; simp [hc]
      rw [e]; exact hg
  have hsum : ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ i ∈ s, BgHolo Xi (F i)) →
      BgHolo Xi (fun X η => ∑ i ∈ s, F i X η) := by
    intro s F
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      intro _
      simpa using hconst 0
    | @insert a s ha ih =>
      intro hF
      have e : (fun X η => ∑ i ∈ insert a s, F i X η) =
          fun X η => F a X η + ∑ i ∈ s, F i X η := by
        funext X η; rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
      rw [e]
      exact hadd _ _ (hF a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s))
        (ih fun i hi => hF i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
  have hUz : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, BgHolo Xi f → BgHolo Xi (bgUz f) := by
    intro f hf
    unfold bgUz
    exact hadd _ _ hf (hmul _ _ hXat (hpdX f hf))
  have hZop : ∀ (b : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), BgHolo Xi f → BgHolo Xi (simZop h b f) := by
    intro b f hf
    unfold simZop
    repeat' (first
      | exact hconst _
      | exact hEta
      | exact hLinv
      | exact hXat
      | assumption
      | with_reducible apply hpdX
      | with_reducible apply hpdE
      | with_reducible apply hadd
      | with_reducible apply hsub
      | with_reducible apply hmul
      | with_reducible apply hneg
      | with_reducible apply hdiv
      | with_reducible apply hpow)
  have hTop : ∀ (b : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), BgHolo Xi f → BgHolo Xi (simTop h b f) := by
    intro b f hf
    unfold simTop
    repeat' (first
      | exact hconst _
      | exact hEta
      | exact hLinv
      | exact hXat
      | assumption
      | with_reducible apply hpdX
      | with_reducible apply hpdE
      | with_reducible apply hadd
      | with_reducible apply hsub
      | with_reducible apply hmul
      | with_reducible apply hneg
      | with_reducible apply hdiv
      | with_reducible apply hpow)
  have hVx : ∀ (k : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), BgHolo Xi f → BgHolo Xi (bgVx h k f) := by
    intro k f hf
    have hu := hUz f hf
    unfold bgVx
    repeat' (first
      | exact hconst _
      | exact hEta
      | exact hLinv
      | exact hXat
      | assumption
      | with_reducible apply hUz
      | with_reducible apply hpdX
      | with_reducible apply hpdE
      | with_reducible apply hadd
      | with_reducible apply hsub
      | with_reducible apply hmul
      | with_reducible apply hneg
      | with_reducible apply hdiv
      | with_reducible apply hpow)
  have hOm : ∀ k : ℕ, (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → BgHolo Xi (S i)) → BgHolo Xi (bgOm h S k) := by
    intro k hk
    unfold bgOm
    repeat' (first
      | exact hconst _
      | exact hEta
      | exact hLinv
      | exact hXat
      | (apply hk; omega)
      | with_reducible apply hUz
      | with_reducible apply hVx
      | with_reducible apply hZop
      | with_reducible apply hTop
      | with_reducible apply hpdX
      | with_reducible apply hpdE
      | with_reducible apply hsum
      | with_reducible apply hadd
      | with_reducible apply hsub
      | with_reducible apply hmul
      | with_reducible apply hneg
      | with_reducible apply hdiv
      | with_reducible apply hpow
      | with_reducible apply hite
      | (intro i hi; simp only [Finset.mem_Ioo, Finset.mem_range] at hi; beta_reduce))
  have hSk : ∀ k : ℕ, k < n → BgHolo Xi (S k) := fun k hk => (hH k hk).1
  have hGk : ∀ k : ℕ, k < n → BgHolo Xi (G k) := fun k hk => (hH k hk).2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    fin_cases i <;> dsimp [bgCoefA] <;>
    repeat' (first
      | exact hconst _
      | exact hEta
      | exact hLinv
      | exact hXat
      | (apply hSk; omega)
      | (apply hGk; omega)
      | with_reducible apply hUz
      | with_reducible apply hVx
      | with_reducible apply hZop
      | with_reducible apply hTop
      | with_reducible apply hpdX
      | with_reducible apply hpdE
      | with_reducible apply hadd
      | with_reducible apply hsub
      | with_reducible apply hmul
      | with_reducible apply hneg
      | with_reducible apply hdiv
      | with_reducible apply hpow)
  · intro i
    fin_cases i <;> dsimp [bgCoefB] <;>
    repeat' (first
      | exact hconst _
      | exact hEta
      | exact hLinv
      | exact hXat
      | (apply hSk; omega)
      | (apply hGk; omega)
      | with_reducible apply hUz
      | with_reducible apply hVx
      | with_reducible apply hZop
      | with_reducible apply hTop
      | with_reducible apply hpdX
      | with_reducible apply hpdE
