signature.name: heatProfile_near_one
signature.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h ≤ 1 → ContinuousOn (heatProfile h) (Ioi 0) ∧ ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ Z → |heatProfile h Z - 1| ≤ h * (1 + h) * Z

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h hh0 hh1
  
  have pw : ∀ Z v : ℝ, 0 ≤ Z → 0 ≤ v →
      0 < (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h) ∧ (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h) ≤ 1 ∧ 1 - (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h) ≤ h * (Z * v) := by
    intro Z v hZ hv
    have hs : 0 ≤ Z * v := mul_nonneg hZ hv
    have hp1 : 1 ≤ (1 + Z * v) ^ h := Real.one_le_rpow (by linarith) hh0.le
    have hp2 : (1 + Z * v) ^ h ≤ 1 + h * (Z * v) :=
      rpow_one_add_le_one_add_mul_self (by linarith) hh0.le hh1
    have hk : (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h) = ((1 + Z * v) ^ h)⁻¹ := Real.rpow_neg (by linarith) h
    rw [hk]
    have hp0 : 0 < (1 + Z * v) ^ h := by linarith
    refine ⟨inv_pos.mpr hp0, inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hp1, ?_⟩
    have key : 1 - ((1 + Z * v) ^ h)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + Z * v) ^ h - 1 := by
      rw [show 1 - ((1 + Z * v) ^ h)⁻¹ = ((1 + Z * v) ^ h - 1) / (1 + Z * v) ^ h by
        field_simp]
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hp0]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((1 + Z * v) ^ h - 1)]
    linarith
  have hw0 : ∀ v : ℝ, 0 ≤ v → 0 ≤ Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h := fun v hv =>
    mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.rpow_nonneg hv _)
  have hwint : IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h) (Ioi 0) := by
    have := Real.GammaIntegral_convergent (show 0 < 1 + h by linarith)
    rw [show (1 + h) - 1 = h by ring] at this
    exact this
  have hG1 : Real.Gamma (1 + h) = ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h := by
    rw [Real.Gamma_eq_integral (by linarith), show (1 + h) - 1 = h by ring]
  
  have hcont : ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ Z →
      ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h)) (Ioi 0) := by
    intro Z hZ
    refine ContinuousOn.mul (ContinuousOn.mul (Real.continuous_exp.comp continuous_neg).continuousOn ?_) ?_
    · exact ContinuousOn.rpow_const continuousOn_id (fun x hx => Or.inl (ne_of_gt (mem_Ioi.mp hx)))
    · refine ContinuousOn.rpow_const (continuousOn_const.add (continuousOn_const.mul continuousOn_id)) ?_
      intro x hx
      left
      have hx0 : 0 < x := mem_Ioi.mp hx
      have : 0 ≤ Z * x := mul_nonneg hZ hx0.le
      show 1 + Z * x ≠ 0
      linarith
  
  have hdom : ∀ Z v : ℝ, 0 ≤ Z → 0 ≤ v →
      ‖Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h)‖ ≤ Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h := by
    intro Z v hZ hv
    obtain ⟨k0, k1, -⟩ := pw Z v hZ hv
    have hw := hw0 v hv
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hw k0.le)]
    calc Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h) ≤ Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k1 hw
      _ = Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h := mul_one _
  have hint : ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ Z →
      IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h)) (Ioi 0) := by
    intro Z hZ
    exact Integrable.mono' hwint ((hcont Z hZ).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi)
      (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi (fun v hv => hdom Z v hZ (le_of_lt hv)))
  
  have hb : ∀ Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ Z → 0 ≤ 1 - heatProfile h Z ∧ 1 - heatProfile h Z ≤ h * (1 + h) * Z := by
    intro Z hZ
    have hFint := hint Z hZ
    have hΓpos : 0 < Real.Gamma (1 + h) := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ : ∃ I : ℝ,
        I = ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hH : heatProfile h Z = (Real.Gamma (1 + h))⁻¹ * I := by rw [hI]; rfl
    have hdiff : Real.Gamma (1 + h) - I = ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ),
        (Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h - Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h)) := by
      rw [integral_sub hwint hFint, hG1, hI]
    have hlow : 0 ≤ Real.Gamma (1 + h) - I := by
      rw [hdiff]
      refine setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Ioi (fun v hv => ?_)
      have hv' : 0 ≤ v := le_of_lt hv
      have k1 := (pw Z v hZ hv').2.1
      have hw := hw0 v hv'
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k1 hw
      linarith
    have hint2 : IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => h * Z * (Real.exp (-v) * v ^ (1 + h))) (Ioi 0) := by
      have := Real.GammaIntegral_convergent (show 0 < 2 + h by linarith)
      rw [show (2 + h) - 1 = 1 + h by ring] at this
      exact this.const_mul (h * Z)
    have hG2 : Real.Gamma (2 + h) = ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-v) * v ^ (1 + h) := by
      rw [Real.Gamma_eq_integral (by linarith), show (2 + h) - 1 = 1 + h by ring]
    have hrec : Real.Gamma (2 + h) = (1 + h) * Real.Gamma (1 + h) := by
      rw [show 2 + h = (1 + h) + 1 by ring]
      exact Real.Gamma_add_one (by linarith)
    have hup : Real.Gamma (1 + h) - I ≤ h * Z * Real.Gamma (2 + h) := by
      rw [hdiff, hG2, ← integral_const_mul]
      refine setIntegral_mono_on (hwint.sub hFint) hint2 measurableSet_Ioi (fun v hv => ?_)
      have hv0 : 0 < v := hv
      have k2 := (pw Z v hZ hv0.le).2.2
      have hw := hw0 v hv0.le
      have e : v ^ (1 + h) = v ^ h * v := by rw [add_comm, Real.rpow_add_one hv0.ne']
      rw [e]
      calc Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h - Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h)
          = Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 - (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h)) := by ring
        _ ≤ Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (h * (Z * v)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k2 hw
        _ = h * Z * (Real.exp (-v) * (v ^ h * v)) := by ring
    have hval : 1 - heatProfile h Z = (Real.Gamma (1 + h))⁻¹ * (Real.Gamma (1 + h) - I) := by
      rw [hH, mul_sub, inv_mul_cancel₀ hΓpos.ne']
    rw [hval]
    refine ⟨mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hΓpos.le) hlow, ?_⟩
    calc (Real.Gamma (1 + h))⁻¹ * (Real.Gamma (1 + h) - I)
        ≤ (Real.Gamma (1 + h))⁻¹ * (h * Z * Real.Gamma (2 + h)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hup (inv_nonneg.mpr hΓpos.le)
      _ = h * (1 + h) * Z * ((Real.Gamma (1 + h))⁻¹ * Real.Gamma (1 + h)) := by rw [hrec]; ring
      _ = h * (1 + h) * Z := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hΓpos.ne', mul_one]
  
  have hJ : ContinuousOn
      (fun Z : ℝ => ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h)) (Ioi 0) := by
    refine continuousOn_of_dominated (bound := fun v => Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h) ?_ ?_ hwint ?_
    · intro Z hZ
      exact (hcont Z (le_of_lt hZ)).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi
    · intro Z hZ
      exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi
        (fun v hv => hdom Z v (le_of_lt hZ) (le_of_lt hv))
    · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi (fun v hv => ?_)
      have hv0 : 0 < v := hv
      refine continuousOn_const.mul (ContinuousOn.rpow_const
        (continuousOn_const.add (continuousOn_id.mul continuousOn_const)) ?_)
      intro Z hZ
      left
      have hZ0 : 0 < Z := hZ
      have := mul_pos hZ0 hv0
      show 1 + Z * v ≠ 0
      linarith
  refine ⟨?_, fun Z hZ => ?_⟩
  · show ContinuousOn (fun Z : ℝ => (Real.Gamma (1 + h))⁻¹ *
      ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-v) * v ^ h * (1 + Z * v) ^ (-h)) (Ioi 0)
    exact continuousOn_const.mul hJ
  · obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := hb Z hZ
    rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_of_nonneg b1]
    exact b2

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h R C : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 → 0 < R → 0 ≤ C → ContinuousOn g (Ioi 0) → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ Z → |g Z - 1| ≤ C * Z) → ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → HasDerivAt (fun a' : ℝ => ∫ x in Ioi R, x ^ (-h) * (g (2 * a' / x) - 1)) (((1 - h) * (∫ x in Ioi R, x ^ (-h) * (g (2 * a / x) - 1)) + R ^ (1 - h) * (g (2 * a / R) - 1)) / a) a

signature.name: tail_scaling_hasDerivAt
signature.statement: ∀ (h R C : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 → 0 < R → 0 ≤ C → ContinuousOn g (Ioi 0) → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ Z → |g Z - 1| ≤ C * Z) → ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → HasDerivAt (fun a' : ℝ => ∫ x in Ioi R, x ^ (-h) * (g (2 * a' / x) - 1)) (((1 - h) * (∫ x in Ioi R, x ^ (-h) * (g (2 * a / x) - 1)) + R ^ (1 - h) * (g (2 * a / R) - 1)) / a) a

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h R C g hh _ hR hC hg hb a ha
  set k : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => y ^ (-h) * (g (2 / y) - 1) with hk_def
  have hkc : ContinuousOn k (Ioi 0) := by
    apply ContinuousOn.mul
    · exact continuousOn_id.rpow_const (fun y hy => Or.inl (ne_of_gt hy))
    · apply ContinuousOn.sub _ continuousOn_const
      apply hg.comp (continuousOn_const.div continuousOn_id (fun y hy => ne_of_gt hy))
      intro y hy
      have hy' : (0:ℝ) < y := hy
      show (0:ℝ) < 2 / y
      exact div_pos two_pos hy'
  have hki : ∀ d : ℝ, 0 < d → IntegrableOn k (Ioi d) := by
    intro d hd
    have hG : IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ => (2 * C) * y ^ (-h - 1)) (Ioi d) :=
      (integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) hd).const_mul _
    refine hG.mono' ((hkc.mono (Ioi_subset_Ioi hd.le)).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi) ?_
    refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).mpr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y hy => ?_)
    have hy0 : 0 < y := lt_trans hd hy
    have hp : 0 < y ^ (-h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hy0 _
    have hbd := hb (2 / y) (div_pos two_pos hy0).le
    have e : y ^ (-h - 1) = y ^ (-h) / y := Real.rpow_sub_one hy0.ne' _
    show ‖y ^ (-h) * (g (2 / y) - 1)‖ ≤ 2 * C * y ^ (-h - 1)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hp, e]
    calc y ^ (-h) * |g (2 / y) - 1| ≤ y ^ (-h) * (C * (2 / y)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbd hp.le
      _ = 2 * C * (y ^ (-h) / y) := by ring
  have hΨ : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → HasDerivAt (fun c' : ℝ => ∫ y in Ioi c', k y) (-(k c)) c := by
    intro c hc
    have hd : 0 < c / 2 := by linarith
    have hII : IntervalIntegrable k volume (c / 2) c := by
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      apply hkc.mono
      rw [uIcc_of_le (by linarith)]
      intro y hy
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hd hy.1
    have hF : HasDerivAt (fun u => ∫ y in (c / 2)..u, k y) (k c) c :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right hII
        (hkc.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter isOpen_Ioi c hc) (hkc.continuousAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hc))
    have hev : (fun c' : ℝ => ∫ y in Ioi c', k y) =ᶠ[nhds c]
        (fun c' => (∫ y in Ioi (c / 2), k y) - ∫ y in (c / 2)..c', k y) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds (show c / 2 < c by linarith)] with c' hc'
      have hc'0 : 0 < c' := lt_trans hd hc'
      have hsplit : (∫ y in Ioi (c / 2), k y) = (∫ y in Ioc (c / 2) c', k y) + ∫ y in Ioi c', k y := by
        rw [← Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hc'.le]
        exact setIntegral_union Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same measurableSet_Ioi
          ((hki _ hd).mono_set Ioc_subset_Ioi_self) (hki _ hc'0)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hc'.le, hsplit]
      ring
    exact (hF.const_sub _).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  have hscale : ∀ b : ℝ, 0 < b → (∫ x in Ioi R, x ^ (-h) * (g (2 * b / x) - 1)) =
      b ^ (1 - h) * ∫ y in Ioi (R / b), k y := by
    intro b hb0
    have h1 : (∫ y in Ioi (R / b), (b * y) ^ (-h) * (g (2 * b / (b * y)) - 1)) =
        b⁻¹ * ∫ x in Ioi R, x ^ (-h) * (g (2 * b / x) - 1) := by
      have := integral_comp_mul_left_Ioi (fun x => x ^ (-h) * (g (2 * b / x) - 1)) (R / b) hb0
      rw [mul_div_cancel₀ R hb0.ne', smul_eq_mul] at this
      exact this
    have h2 : (∫ y in Ioi (R / b), (b * y) ^ (-h) * (g (2 * b / (b * y)) - 1)) =
        b ^ (-h) * ∫ y in Ioi (R / b), k y := by
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun y hy => ?_)
      have hy0 : 0 < y := lt_trans (div_pos hR hb0) hy
      have e : 2 * b / (b * y) = 2 / y := by field_simp
      simp only [hk_def]
      rw [Real.mul_rpow hb0.le hy0.le, e]
      ring
    have h3 : b ^ (1 - h) = b * b ^ (-h) := by
      rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Real.rpow_add hb0, Real.rpow_one]
    calc (∫ x in Ioi R, x ^ (-h) * (g (2 * b / x) - 1))
        = b * (b⁻¹ * ∫ x in Ioi R, x ^ (-h) * (g (2 * b / x) - 1)) := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hb0.ne', one_mul]
      _ = b * (b ^ (-h) * ∫ y in Ioi (R / b), k y) := by rw [← h1, h2]
      _ = _ := by rw [h3]; ring
  have hc : HasDerivAt (fun a' : ℝ => R / a') (-(R / a ^ 2)) a := by
    have := (hasDerivAt_inv ha.ne').const_mul R
    convert this using 1
    · funext a'
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    · field_simp
  have hp : HasDerivAt (fun a' : ℝ => a' ^ (1 - h)) ((1 - h) * a ^ (1 - h - 1)) a :=
    Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl ha.ne')
  have hprod := hp.mul ((hΨ (R / a) (div_pos hR ha)).comp a hc)
  have hev : (fun a' : ℝ => ∫ x in Ioi R, x ^ (-h) * (g (2 * a' / x) - 1)) =ᶠ[nhds a]
      (fun a' => a' ^ (1 - h) *
        ((fun c' : ℝ => ∫ y in Ioi c', k y) ∘ (fun a' : ℝ => R / a')) a') := by
    filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds ha] with a' ha'
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    exact hscale a' ha'
  refine (hprod.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).congr_deriv ?_
  rw [hscale a ha]
  have hu : 0 < a ^ (-h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos ha _
  have hv : 0 < R ^ (-h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hR _
  have e1 : a ^ (1 - h - 1) = a ^ (-h) := by congr 1; ring
  have e2 : a ^ (1 - h) = a * a ^ (-h) := by
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Real.rpow_add ha, Real.rpow_one]
  have e3 : R ^ (1 - h) = R * R ^ (-h) := by
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Real.rpow_add hR, Real.rpow_one]
  have e4 : (R / a) ^ (-h) = R ^ (-h) / a ^ (-h) := Real.div_rpow hR.le ha.le _
  have e5 : 2 / (R / a) = 2 * a / R := by field_simp
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  generalize (∫ y in Ioi (R / a), k y) = P
  simp only [hk_def, e1, e2, e3, e4, e5]
  generalize a ^ (-h) = u at hu ⊢
  generalize R ^ (-h) = v at hv ⊢
  field_simp

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h b ε R η : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ε → 0 < R → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → -1 < η → η < 1 → (∀ X : ℝ, R < X → simZop h b F X η = 0) → HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..R, x * F x e) (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..R, x * pdE F x η) η ∧ (∫ X in Ioi (0:ℝ), X * simZop h b F X η) = (2 * (b + 2) * η * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..R, x * F x η) + (1 - η ^ 2) * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..R, x * pdE F x η) - 2 * η * R ^ 2 * F R η) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)

signature.name: zop_first_moment_reduce
signature.statement: ∀ (h b ε R η : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ε → 0 < R → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → -1 < η → η < 1 → (∀ X : ℝ, R < X → simZop h b F X η = 0) → HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..R, x * F x e) (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..R, x * pdE F x η) η ∧ (∫ X in Ioi (0:ℝ), X * simZop h b F X η) = (2 * (b + 2) * η * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..R, x * F x η) + (1 - η ^ 2) * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..R, x * pdE F x η) - 2 * η * R ^ 2 * F R η) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h b ε R η F hε hR hF hη1 hη2 hvan
  have hO : IsOpen (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hsub : ∀ x e : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → -1 < e → e < 1 → (x, e) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
    fun x e hx h1 h2 => mem_prod.mpr ⟨mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith), h1, h2⟩
  
  have hFC : ContinuousOn (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := hF.continuousOn
  have hL : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (↿F)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
    hF.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO (by simp)
  have hfd : ∀ q ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, HasFDerivAt (↿F) (fderiv ℝ (↿F) q) q := fun q hq =>
    ((hF.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hq)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
  have hsX : ∀ X e : ℝ, (X, e) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
      HasDerivAt (fun Y => F Y e) (fderiv ℝ (↿F) (X, e) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) X := by
    intro X e hq
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, e)) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) X :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X e)
    exact (hfd (X, e) hq).comp_hasDerivAt X h1
  have hsE : ∀ X e : ℝ, (X, e) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
      HasDerivAt (fun e' => F X e') (fderiv ℝ (↿F) (X, e) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) e := by
    intro X e hq
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun e' : ℝ => (X, e')) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) e :=
      (hasDerivAt_const e X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' e)
    exact (hfd (X, e) hq).comp_hasDerivAt e h1
  have hpdX : ∀ X e : ℝ, (X, e) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
      pdX F X e = fderiv ℝ (↿F) (X, e) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) := fun X e hq => (hsX X e hq).deriv
  have hpdE : ∀ X e : ℝ, (X, e) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
      pdE F X e = fderiv ℝ (↿F) (X, e) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) := fun X e hq => (hsE X e hq).deriv
  have hXd : ∀ X e : ℝ, (X, e) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
      HasDerivAt (fun Y => F Y e) (pdX F X e) X := fun X e hq => by
    rw [hpdX X e hq]; exact hsX X e hq
  have hEd : ∀ X e : ℝ, (X, e) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
      HasDerivAt (fun e' => F X e') (pdE F X e) e := fun X e hq => by
    rw [hpdE X e hq]; exact hsE X e hq
  have hCX : ContinuousOn (↿(pdX F)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    refine (hL.clm_apply (continuousOn_const (c := ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))))).congr ?_
    intro q hq
    exact hpdX q.1 q.2 hq
  have hCE : ContinuousOn (↿(pdE F)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    refine (hL.clm_apply (continuousOn_const (c := ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))))).congr ?_
    intro q hq
    exact hpdE q.1 q.2 hq
  have slice : ∀ (G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (e : ℝ), -1 < e → e < 1 →
      ContinuousOn (↿G) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) → ContinuousOn (fun x => G x e) (Icc 0 R) := by
    intro G e h1 h2 hG
    exact hG.comp (continuousOn_id.prodMk continuousOn_const) (fun x hx => hsub x e hx.1 h1 h2)
  have hR' : uIoc 0 R = Ioc 0 R := uIoc_of_le hR.le
  
  have hA : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..R, x * F x e)
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..R, x * pdE F x η) η := by
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, δ = min (η + 1) (1 - η) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hm1 := min_le_left (η + 1) (1 - η)
    have hm2 := min_le_right (η + 1) (1 - η)
    have hm0 : 0 < min (η + 1) (1 - η) := lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hδ0 : 0 < δ := by rw [hδ]; linarith
    have hδ1 : δ < η + 1 := by rw [hδ]; linarith
    have hδ2 : δ < 1 - η := by rw [hδ]; linarith
    have hK : IsCompact (Icc 0 R ×ˢ Icc (η - δ) (η + δ)) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    have hKO : Icc 0 R ×ˢ Icc (η - δ) (η + δ) ⊆ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := by
      intro q hq
      exact hsub q.1 q.2 hq.1.1 (by linarith [hq.2.1]) (by linarith [hq.2.2])
    have hcK : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 * pdE F q.1 q.2) (Icc 0 R ×ˢ Icc (η - δ) (η + δ)) :=
      continuousOn_fst.mul (hCE.mono hKO)
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hcK
    have hmeasF : ∀ e : ℝ, -1 < e → e < 1 →
        AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => x * F x e) (volume.restrict (uIoc 0 R)) := by
      intro e h1 h2
      rw [hR']
      exact ((continuousOn_id.mul (slice F e h1 h2 hFC)).mono Ioc_subset_Icc_self).aestronglyMeasurable
        measurableSet_Ioc
    have hmeasE : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => x * pdE F x η) (volume.restrict (uIoc 0 R)) := by
      rw [hR']
      exact ((continuousOn_id.mul (slice (pdE F) η hη1 hη2 hCE)).mono Ioc_subset_Icc_self).aestronglyMeasurable
        measurableSet_Ioc
    refine (intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (𝕜 := ℝ) (μ := volume) (a := 0) (b := R) (bound := fun _ => B)
      (F := fun e x => x * F x e) (F' := fun e x => x * pdE F x e) (x₀ := η)
      (s := Ioo (η - δ) (η + δ)) (Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith))
      ?_ ?_ hmeasE ?_ ?_ ?_).2
    · exact Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hη1 hη2) (fun e he => hmeasF e he.1 he.2)
    · exact (continuousOn_id.mul (slice F η hη1 hη2 hFC)).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hR.le
    · refine ae_of_all _ (fun x hx e he => ?_)
      rw [hR'] at hx
      exact hB (x, e) ⟨⟨hx.1.le, hx.2⟩, he.1.le, he.2.le⟩
    · exact intervalIntegrable_const
    · refine ae_of_all _ (fun x hx e he => ?_)
      rw [hR'] at hx
      exact (hEd x e (hsub x e hx.1.le (by linarith [he.1]) (by linarith [he.2]))).const_mul x
  
  have hFη : ContinuousOn (fun x => F x η) (Icc 0 R) := slice F η hη1 hη2 hFC
  have hXη : ContinuousOn (fun x => pdX F x η) (Icc 0 R) := slice (pdX F) η hη1 hη2 hCX
  have hEη : ContinuousOn (fun x => pdE F x η) (Icc 0 R) := slice (pdE F) η hη1 hη2 hCE
  have hp1 : ContinuousOn (fun x => x * F x η) (Icc 0 R) := continuousOn_id.mul hFη
  have hp2 : ContinuousOn (fun x => x * pdE F x η) (Icc 0 R) := continuousOn_id.mul hEη
  have hp3 : ContinuousOn (fun x => x ^ 2 * pdX F x η) (Icc 0 R) := (continuousOn_id.pow 2).mul hXη
  have hI1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => x * F x η) volume 0 R := hp1.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hR.le
  have hI2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => x * pdE F x η) volume 0 R :=
    hp2.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hR.le
  have hI3 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => x ^ 2 * pdX F x η) volume 0 R :=
    hp3.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hR.le
  have hpt : ∀ X : ℝ, X * simZop h b F X η = (2 * b * η * (X * F X η) + (1 - η ^ 2) * (X * pdE F X η)
      - 2 * η * (X ^ 2 * pdX F X η)) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) := by
    intro X
    simp only [simZop]
    ring
  have hfC : ContinuousOn (fun X => X * simZop h b F X η) (Icc 0 R) := by
    have hc : ContinuousOn (fun X => (2 * b * η * (X * F X η) + (1 - η ^ 2) * (X * pdE F X η)
        - 2 * η * (X ^ 2 * pdX F X η)) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)) (Icc 0 R) :=
      (((continuousOn_const.mul hp1).add (continuousOn_const.mul hp2)).sub
        (continuousOn_const.mul hp3)).div_const _
    refine hc.congr ?_
    intro X _
    exact hpt X
  have hint1 : IntegrableOn (fun X => X * simZop h b F X η) (Ioc 0 R) :=
    hfC.integrableOn_Icc.mono_set Ioc_subset_Icc_self
  have hzero : ∀ X ∈ Ioi R, X * simZop h b F X η = 0 := fun X hX => by
    rw [hvan X hX, mul_zero]
  have hint2 : IntegrableOn (fun X => X * simZop h b F X η) (Ioi R) :=
    integrableOn_zero.congr_fun (fun X hX => (hzero X hX).symm) measurableSet_Ioi
  have hsplit : (∫ X in Ioi (0:ℝ), X * simZop h b F X η) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..R, x * simZop h b F x η := by
    rw [← Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hR.le, setIntegral_union Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same measurableSet_Ioi hint1 hint2,
      setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero hzero, add_zero, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hR.le]
  have hlin : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..R, x * simZop h b F x η) =
      (2 * b * η * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..R, x * F x η) + (1 - η ^ 2) * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..R, x * pdE F x η)
        - 2 * η * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..R, x ^ 2 * pdX F x η)) / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) := by
    simp_rw [hpt]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_div,
      intervalIntegral.integral_sub ((hI1.const_mul _).add (hI2.const_mul _)) (hI3.const_mul _),
      intervalIntegral.integral_add (hI1.const_mul _) (hI2.const_mul _),
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  have hftc : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..R, (2 * (x * F x η) + x ^ 2 * pdX F x η)) =
      R ^ 2 * F R η - (0:ℝ) ^ 2 * F 0 η := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (f := fun x => x ^ 2 * F x η)
    · intro x hx
      rw [uIcc_of_le hR.le] at hx
      have H := (hasDerivAt_pow 2 x).mul (hXd x η (hsub x η hx.1 hη1 hη2))
      convert H using 1
      norm_num
      ring
    · exact (hI1.const_mul 2).add hI3
  have hE : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..R, x ^ 2 * pdX F x η) = R ^ 2 * F R η - 2 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..R, x * F x η) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (hI1.const_mul 2) hI3, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hftc
    have h00 : (0:ℝ) ^ 2 * F 0 η = 0 := by ring
    rw [h00, sub_zero] at hftc
    linarith
  refine ⟨hA, ?_⟩
  rw [hsplit, hlin, hE]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab C : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → 0 ≤ C → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ Z → |heatProfile h Z - 1| ≤ C * Z) → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → 2 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..(Xb + 1), x * F x η) = Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * ((Xb + 1) ^ (1 - h) / (1 - h) - ∫ x in Ioi (Xb + 1), x ^ (-h) * (heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) - 1))

signature.name: lead_tail_moment_formula
signature.statement: ∀ (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab C : ℝ) (F U T0th T0z : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), LeadingProfile h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab F U T0th T0z → 0 ≤ C → (∀ Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ Z → |heatProfile h Z - 1| ≤ C * Z) → ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → 2 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..(Xb + 1), x * F x η) = Real.sqrt 2 * cinf * ((Xb + 1) ^ (1 - h) / (1 - h) - ∫ x in Ioi (Xb + 1), x ^ (-h) * (heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) - 1))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab C F U T0th T0z hLP hC hHb η hη1 hη2
  have hLP' := hLP
  unfold LeadingProfile at hLP'
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, hh1, -, hcinf, -, -, -, hXa, hXap1, hp12, hp2m1, hm12, hm2Xv, hXvXc, hXcXb⟩, -, -, -,
    ⟨ε, hε, hFε, -, -, -⟩, -, hTail, -, -, hMom, -⟩ := hLP'
  have hXb0 : 0 < Xb := by linarith
  have hR : (0:ℝ) < Xb + 1 := by linarith
  have hR0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ Xb + 1 := hR.le
  have ha : 0 ≤ 1 - η ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  obtain ⟨c, hcdef⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = Real.sqrt 2 * cinf := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := by rw [hcdef]; exact mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hcinf.le
  
  have hsq : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → Real.sqrt (2 * x) * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) = Real.sqrt 2 * x ^ (-h) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2) x, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow x, mul_assoc,
      ← Real.rpow_add hx]
    congr 1
    congr 1
    ring
  obtain ⟨m, hmdef⟩ : ∃ m : ℝ → ℝ,
      m = fun x => 2 * x * F x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hm1 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → m x = 2 * x * F x η - c * x ^ (-h) := by
    intro x hx
    have hq := hsq x hx
    simp only [hmdef, hcdef]
    linear_combination (-cinf) * hq
  have hm2 : ∀ x : ℝ, Xb ≤ x →
      m x = c * (x ^ (-h) * (heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) - 1)) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
    have hT := (hTail x η hx hη1 hη2).2
    have hs : Real.sqrt (2 * x) * Real.sqrt (2 * x) = 2 * x := Real.mul_self_sqrt (by linarith)
    have hq := hsq x hx0
    rw [hm1 x hx0]
    linear_combination (-F x η) * hs + Real.sqrt (2 * x) * hT
      + (cinf * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x)) * hq
      - (x ^ (-h) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x)) * hcdef
  
  have hFs : ContinuousOn (fun x => F x η) (Ioi (-ε)) :=
    hFε.continuousOn.comp (continuousOn_id.prodMk continuousOn_const) (fun x hx => ⟨hx, hη1, hη2⟩)
  have hg1 : ContinuousOn (fun x => 2 * x * F x η) (Ioi (-ε)) :=
    (continuousOn_const.mul continuousOn_id).mul hFs
  have hsubIcc : Icc 0 (Xb + 1) ⊆ Ioi (-ε) := fun x hx => by
    simp only [mem_Ioi]; linarith [hx.1]
  have hsubIoi : Ioi (Xb + 1) ⊆ Ioi (-ε) := fun x hx => by
    simp only [mem_Ioi] at hx ⊢; linarith
  
  have hint1 : IntegrableOn (fun x => 2 * x * F x η) (Ioc 0 (Xb + 1)) :=
    ((hg1.mono hsubIcc).integrableOn_Icc).mono_set Ioc_subset_Icc_self
  have hrp : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (-h)) (Ioc 0 (Xb + 1)) :=
    (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hR0).1
      (intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_rpow' (by linarith))
  have hrpv : (∫ x in Ioc (0:ℝ) (Xb + 1), x ^ (-h)) = (Xb + 1) ^ (1 - h) / (1 - h) := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hR0, integral_rpow (Or.inl (by linarith)),
      Real.zero_rpow (by intro h'; linarith), sub_zero, show -h + 1 = 1 - h by ring]
  have hrpc : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => c * x ^ (-h)) (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (Xb + 1))) :=
    Integrable.const_mul hrp c
  have hEq1 : EqOn ((fun x => 2 * x * F x η) - fun x : ℝ => c * x ^ (-h)) m (Ioc 0 (Xb + 1)) :=
    fun x hx => by simp only [Pi.sub_apply]; exact (hm1 x hx.1).symm
  have hI1 : IntegrableOn m (Ioc 0 (Xb + 1)) :=
    IntegrableOn.congr_fun (Integrable.sub hint1 hrpc) hEq1 measurableSet_Ioc
  
  have hmc : ContinuousOn m (Ioi (Xb + 1)) := by
    rw [hmdef]
    refine (hg1.mono hsubIoi).sub ?_
    refine (((continuousOn_const.mul continuousOn_id).sqrt).mul continuousOn_const).mul ?_
    exact continuousOn_id.rpow_const (fun x hx => Or.inl (lt_trans hR hx).ne')
  have hbound : ∀ x ∈ Ioi (Xb + 1), ‖m x‖ ≤ (c * C * (2 * (1 - η ^ 2))) * x ^ (-1 - h) := by
    intro x hx
    have hxR : Xb + 1 < x := hx
    have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_trans hR hxR
    have hZ : 0 ≤ 2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x := div_nonneg (by linarith) hx0.le
    have hH := hHb _ hZ
    have hxp : 0 < x ^ (-h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hx0 _
    have hpow : x ^ (-1 - h) = x ^ (-h) * x⁻¹ := by
      rw [show (-1 - h) = -h + -1 by ring, Real.rpow_add hx0, Real.rpow_neg_one]
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hm2 x (by linarith), abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc,
      abs_of_pos hxp, hpow]
    calc c * (x ^ (-h) * |heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) - 1|)
        ≤ c * (x ^ (-h) * (C * (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hH hxp.le) hc
      _ = c * C * (2 * (1 - η ^ 2)) * (x ^ (-h) * x⁻¹) := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; ring
  have hI2 : IntegrableOn m (Ioi (Xb + 1)) := by
    have hp : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (-1 - h)) (Ioi (Xb + 1)) :=
      integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) hR
    exact Integrable.mono' (Integrable.const_mul hp (c * C * (2 * (1 - η ^ 2))))
      (hmc.aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi)
      (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi hbound)
  
  have hMom' : ∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), m x = 0 := by
    rw [hmdef]
    exact (hMom η hη1 hη2).2.2
  have hsplit : (∫ x in Ioc (0:ℝ) (Xb + 1), m x) + (∫ x in Ioi (Xb + 1), m x) = 0 := by
    rw [← setIntegral_union Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same measurableSet_Ioi hI1 hI2,
      Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hR0]
    exact hMom'
  
  have e1 : (∫ x in Ioc (0:ℝ) (Xb + 1), m x) =
      ∫ x in Ioc (0:ℝ) (Xb + 1), (2 * x * F x η - c * x ^ (-h)) :=
    setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioc (fun x hx => hm1 x hx.1)
  have e2 : (∫ x in Ioc (0:ℝ) (Xb + 1), 2 * x * F x η) =
      2 * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..(Xb + 1), x * F x η := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hR0, ← integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    funext x
    ring
  have hI1v : (∫ x in Ioc (0:ℝ) (Xb + 1), m x) =
      2 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..(Xb + 1), x * F x η) - c * ((Xb + 1) ^ (1 - h) / (1 - h)) := by
    rw [e1, integral_sub hint1 hrpc, integral_const_mul, hrpv, e2]
  
  have hI2v : (∫ x in Ioi (Xb + 1), m x) =
      c * ∫ x in Ioi (Xb + 1), x ^ (-h) * (heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) - 1) := by
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    exact setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      (fun x hx => hm2 x (by have := mem_Ioi.mp hx; linarith))
  
  rw [hI1v, hI2v] at hsplit
  linear_combination hsplit + ((Xb + 1) ^ (1 - h) / (1 - h) -
    ∫ x in Ioi (Xb + 1), x ^ (-h) * (heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / x) - 1)) * hcdef

informal_problem.statement: (ContDiff ℝ ∞ bpsChi ∧ (∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ → bpsChi σ = 0) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ u : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun u : ℝ => bpsChi (Real.exp u)) u| ≤ M) ∧ (ContDiff ℝ ∞ bpsPsi ∧ (∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ → bpsPsi σ = 0) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ u : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun u : ℝ => bpsPsi (Real.exp u)) u| ≤ M)

signature.name: bps_cut_profiles
signature.statement: (ContDiff ℝ ∞ bpsChi ∧ (∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ → bpsChi σ = 0) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ u : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun u : ℝ => bpsChi (Real.exp u)) u| ≤ M) ∧ (ContDiff ℝ ∞ bpsPsi ∧ (∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ → bpsPsi σ = 0) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ u : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun u : ℝ => bpsPsi (Real.exp u)) u| ≤ M)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hgen : ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → (∀ σ : ℝ, σ < 1 / 2 → φ σ = c) →
      (∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ → φ σ = 0) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ u : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun u : ℝ => φ (Real.exp u)) u| ≤ M := by
    intro φ c hφ hc h0 k
    have hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u : ℝ => φ (Real.exp u)) := hφ.comp Real.contDiff_exp
    have hcont : Continuous (iteratedDeriv k (fun u : ℝ => φ (Real.exp u))) :=
      hΦ.continuous_iteratedDeriv k (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := (-1 : ℝ)) (b := 0)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      hcont.continuousOn
    have he : Real.exp (-1) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)]
      have h3 : Real.exp (-1) * Real.exp 1 = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
      have h4 : 0 < Real.exp (-1) := Real.exp_pos _
      nlinarith
    refine ⟨max M₀ |c|, fun u => ?_⟩
    rcases lt_or_ge u (-1) with hu | hu
    · have hev : (fun u : ℝ => φ (Real.exp u)) =ᶠ[nhds u] (fun _ => c) := by
        filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hu] with τ hτ
        apply hc
        have : Real.exp τ < Real.exp (-1) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hτ
        linarith
      rw [hev.iteratedDeriv_eq, iteratedDeriv_const]
      refine le_trans ?_ (le_max_right _ _)
      split_ifs
      · exact le_rfl
      · simp
    · rcases lt_or_ge 0 u with hu' | hu'
      · have hev : (fun u : ℝ => φ (Real.exp u)) =ᶠ[nhds u] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
          filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hu'] with τ hτ
          apply h0
          have : Real.exp 0 < Real.exp τ := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hτ
          rw [Real.exp_zero] at this
          exact this
        rw [hev.iteratedDeriv_eq, iteratedDeriv_const]
        refine le_trans ?_ (le_max_right _ _)
        split_ifs <;> simp
      · have := hM₀ u ⟨hu, hu'⟩
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
        exact le_trans this (le_max_left _ _)
  
  have hgs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun σ : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ)) :=
    (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := ⊤) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Real.smoothTransition).comp
      (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id))
  have hg1 : ∀ σ : ℝ, σ < 1 / 2 → Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ) = 1 := fun σ hσ =>
    Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith)
  have hg0 : ∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ → Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ) = 0 := fun σ hσ =>
    Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
  have hχs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ bpsChi := by unfold bpsChi; exact hgs
  have hχ1 : ∀ σ : ℝ, σ < 1 / 2 → bpsChi σ = 1 := by unfold bpsChi; exact hg1
  have hχ0 : ∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ → bpsChi σ = 0 := by unfold bpsChi; exact hg0
  have hdg1 : ∀ σ : ℝ, σ < 1 / 2 → deriv (fun σ' : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ')) σ = 0 := by
    intro σ hσ
    have hev : (fun σ' : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ')) =ᶠ[nhds σ] (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) := by
      filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hσ] with τ hτ
      exact hg1 τ hτ
    rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
  have hdg0 : ∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ → deriv (fun σ' : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ')) σ = 0 := by
    intro σ hσ
    have hev : (fun σ' : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ')) =ᶠ[nhds σ] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hσ] with τ hτ
      exact hg0 τ hτ
    rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
  have hψs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ bpsPsi := by
    unfold bpsPsi
    exact contDiff_id.mul (contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.mp hgs).2
  have hψ1 : ∀ σ : ℝ, σ < 1 / 2 → bpsPsi σ = 0 := by
    intro σ hσ
    unfold bpsPsi
    rw [hdg1 σ hσ, mul_zero]
  have hψ0 : ∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ → bpsPsi σ = 0 := by
    intro σ hσ
    unfold bpsPsi
    rw [hdg0 σ hσ, mul_zero]
  exact ⟨⟨hχs, hχ0, hgen bpsChi 1 hχs hχ1 hχ0⟩, ⟨hψs, hψ0, hgen bpsPsi 0 hψs hψ1 hψ0⟩⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (wt : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (D : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), 0 < h → ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → (∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ → φ σ = 0) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ u : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun u : ℝ => φ (Real.exp u)) u| ≤ M) → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(T n)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) → D ⊆ Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 → (∀ (m : ℕ) (X η : ℝ), (X, η) ∈ D → 0 ≤ wt m X) → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ m → ∀ X η : ℝ, (X, η) ∈ D → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (↿(T n)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * wt m X) → ∃ Cp : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ, ∀ a : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ j, 1 ≤ a j) → (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) → (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ j → ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1 / a j → |Cp j m| * q ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) / 2) ≤ (1 / 2) ^ j) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (bpsTail h φ a T) (univ ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → q < 1 → (X, η) ∈ D → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (bpsTail h φ a T) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C * q ^ (2 * h) * wt m X

signature.name: bps_log_tail
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (wt : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (D : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), 0 < h → ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → (∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ → φ σ = 0) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ u : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun u : ℝ => φ (Real.exp u)) u| ≤ M) → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(T n)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) → D ⊆ Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 → (∀ (m : ℕ) (X η : ℝ), (X, η) ∈ D → 0 ≤ wt m X) → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ m → ∀ X η : ℝ, (X, η) ∈ D → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (↿(T n)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * wt m X) → ∃ Cp : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ, ∀ a : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ j, 1 ≤ a j) → (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) → (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ j → ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1 / a j → |Cp j m| * q ^ (2 * h * (j : ℝ) / 2) ≤ (1 / 2) ^ j) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (bpsTail h φ a T) (univ ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → q < 1 → (X, η) ∈ D → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (bpsTail h φ a T) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C * q ^ (2 * h) * wt m X

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h φ T wt D hh hφs hφ0 hφM hTs hD hwt hTb
  
  
  have bps_lift_mul : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (univ ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.2.1 w.2.2) (univ ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ (∀ (m : ℕ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), w.2 ∈ Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.2.1 w.2.2) w‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) w.2‖) ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), w.2 ∈ Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.2.1 w.2.2 * f w) w‖ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose k : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿g) w.2‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m - k) f w‖ := by
    intro g f hg hf
    have hO : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hS : IsOpen ((univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) := isOpen_univ.prod hO
    let L : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)
    have hpre : (L : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ) ⁻¹' (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) =
        (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
      ext w
      simp [L]
    have hG : (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.2.1 w.2.2) = (↿g) ∘ (L : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ) := by
      funext w
      rfl
    have hGs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.2.1 w.2.2)
        ((univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) := by
      rw [hG, ← hpre]
      exact hg.comp_continuousLinearMap L
    have hSo : IsOpen ((L : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ) ⁻¹' (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) := hpre ▸ hS
    have hB : ∀ (m : ℕ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), w.2 ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.2.1 w.2.2) w‖ ≤
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) w.2‖ := by
      intro m w hw
      have hwS : w ∈ (L : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ) ⁻¹' (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := hw
      have hLw : L w ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := hw
      have hm : ((m : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
      have E1 := L.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right hg hO.uniqueDiffOn hSo.uniqueDiffOn hLw hm
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hSo hwS, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hO hLw] at E1
      rw [hG, E1]
      refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
      have hL : ‖L‖ ≤ 1 := ContinuousLinearMap.norm_snd_le ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)
      have hp : ∏ _i : Fin m, ‖L‖ ≤ 1 :=
        Finset.prod_le_one₀ (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun _ _ => hL)
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) hp
    refine ⟨hGs, hB, ?_⟩
    intro m w hw
    have hwS : w ∈ (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := ⟨mem_univ _, hw⟩
    have hm : ((m : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
    have h1 := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hGs hf hS.uniqueDiffOn hwS hm
    refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) (le_trans h1 (Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_))
    · rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hS hwS]
    · rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hS hwS, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (m - k) hS hwS]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hB k w hw) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) (norm_nonneg _)
  
  have hprof : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ Mb : ℝ, 0 ≤ Mb ∧ ∀ b c : ℝ, 0 < b → 0 ≤ c → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → ∀ s : ℝ,
      |iteratedDeriv i (fun s : ℝ => φ (b * Real.exp s) * Real.exp s ^ c) s| ≤
        Mb * (1 + c) ^ k * Real.exp s ^ c := by
    obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ : ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℝ, Φ = fun u => φ (Real.exp u) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hΦs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ := by rw [hΦ]; exact hφs.comp Real.contDiff_exp
    have hΦM : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ u : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k Φ u| ≤ M := by rw [hΦ]; exact hφM
    choose M hM using hΦM
    intro k
    obtain ⟨S, hSdef⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, S = ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |M l| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hS0 : 0 ≤ S := by rw [hSdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
    refine ⟨2 ^ k * S, mul_nonneg (by positivity) hS0, ?_⟩
    intro b c hb hc i hi s
    have hML : ∀ l, l ≤ k → ∀ u, |iteratedDeriv l Φ u| ≤ S := by
      intro l hl u
      rw [hSdef]
      exact (hM l u).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun l => |M l|)
        (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))))
    have hfun : (fun s : ℝ => φ (b * Real.exp s) * Real.exp s ^ c) =
        fun s => Φ (s + Real.log b) * Real.exp (c * s) := by
      funext s
      simp only [hΦ]
      rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hb, mul_comm (Real.exp s) b, mul_comm c s, Real.exp_mul]
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Φ (z + Real.log b)) := hΦs.comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ => Real.exp (c * z)) :=
      Real.contDiff_exp.comp (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id)
    rw [hfun, iteratedDeriv_fun_mul (h1.contDiffAt.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      (h2.contDiffAt.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
    have e1 : ∀ l, iteratedDeriv l (fun z => Φ (z + Real.log b)) s = iteratedDeriv l Φ (s + Real.log b) :=
      fun l => congrFun (iteratedDeriv_comp_add_const l Φ (Real.log b)) s
    have e2 : ∀ l, iteratedDeriv l (fun z : ℝ => Real.exp (c * z)) s = c ^ l * Real.exp (c * s) :=
      fun l => congrFun (iteratedDeriv_exp_const_mul l c) s
    simp only [e1, e2]
    have hE : Real.exp s ^ c = Real.exp (c * s) := by rw [mul_comm, Real.exp_mul]
    rw [hE]
    have e0 := Real.exp_pos (c * s)
    refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans ?_
    refine (Finset.sum_le_sum (g := fun l => (i.choose l : ℝ) * (S * (1 + c) ^ k * Real.exp (c * s)))
      ?_).trans ?_
    · intro l hl
      have hl' : l ≤ i := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hl)
      have hD := hML l (by omega) (s + Real.log b)
      have hcpow : c ^ (i - l) ≤ (1 + c) ^ k :=
        (pow_le_pow_left₀ hc (by linarith) _).trans (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by linarith) (by omega))
      have key : |iteratedDeriv l Φ (s + Real.log b)| * (c ^ (i - l) * Real.exp (c * s)) ≤
          S * ((1 + c) ^ k * Real.exp (c * s)) :=
        mul_le_mul hD (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcpow e0.le) (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hc _) e0.le) hS0
      simp only [abs_mul, Nat.abs_cast, abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg hc (i - l)), abs_of_pos e0]
      calc _ = (i.choose l : ℝ) * (|iteratedDeriv l Φ (s + Real.log b)| *
            (c ^ (i - l) * Real.exp (c * s))) := by ring
        _ ≤ (i.choose l : ℝ) * (S * ((1 + c) ^ k * Real.exp (c * s))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left key (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        _ = _ := by ring
    · rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      have hsum : (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose l : ℝ)) = 2 ^ i := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose i
      rw [hsum]
      have h2i : (2:ℝ) ^ i ≤ 2 ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hi
      have hX : 0 ≤ S * (1 + c) ^ k * Real.exp (c * s) :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hS0 (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _)) e0.le
      calc (2:ℝ) ^ i * (S * (1 + c) ^ k * Real.exp (c * s)) ≤
            2 ^ k * (S * (1 + c) ^ k * Real.exp (c * s)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2i hX
        _ = _ := by ring
  choose Mb hMb0 hMb using hprof
  
  have hfS : ∀ b c : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => φ (b * Real.exp s) * Real.exp s ^ c) := fun b c =>
    (hφs.comp (contDiff_const.mul Real.contDiff_exp)).mul
      (Real.contDiff_exp.rpow_const_of_ne (fun s => (Real.exp_pos s).ne'))
  have hfS3 : ∀ b c : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => φ (b * Real.exp w.1) * Real.exp w.1 ^ c) := fun b c =>
    (hfS b c).comp contDiff_fst
  
  have hfst : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → ∀ (m : ℕ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => f w.1) w‖ ≤ |iteratedDeriv m f w.1| := by
    intro f hf m w
    have e : (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => f w.1) = f ∘ ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)) := rfl
    rw [e, ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right _ hf w (by exact_mod_cast le_top)]
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs, ← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
    have hp : ∏ _i : Fin m, ‖ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)‖ ≤ 1 :=
      Finset.prod_le_one₀ (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun _ _ => ContinuousLinearMap.norm_fst_le _ _ _)
    calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)) w)‖ * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := by rw [mul_one]; rfl
  
  have hTb' : ∀ n m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ m → ∀ X η : ℝ, (X, η) ∈ D →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (↿(T n)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * wt m X := by
    intro n m
    by_cases hn : 1 ≤ n
    · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hTb n hn m
      exact ⟨C, fun _ => hC⟩
    · exact ⟨0, fun h1 => absurd h1 hn⟩
  choose Cj hCj using hTb'
  obtain ⟨Cp, hCp⟩ : ∃ Cp : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ,
      Cp = fun (j m : ℕ) => 2 ^ m * Mb m * (1 + 2 * h * (j : ℝ)) ^ m * |Cj j m| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCp0 : ∀ j m, 0 ≤ Cp j m := by
    intro j m
    simp only [hCp]
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (hMb0 m))
      (pow_nonneg (add_nonneg zero_le_one (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg zero_le_two hh.le)
        (Nat.cast_nonneg _))) _)) (abs_nonneg _)
  refine ⟨Cp, ?_⟩
  intro a ha1 ha2 hsm
  have hapos : ∀ j, 0 < a j := fun j => lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (ha1 j)
  have h2pow : ∀ j, (2:ℝ) ^ j ≤ a j := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => simpa using ha1 0
    | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ]; linarith [ha2 k]
  
  obtain ⟨tm, htm⟩ : ∃ tm : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, tm = fun n w =>
      φ (a (n + 1) * Real.exp w.1) * Real.exp w.1 ^ (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h) * T (n + 1) w.2.1 w.2.2 :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hUo : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) :=
    isOpen_univ.prod (isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo)
  have htmS : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (tm n) (univ ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) := by
    intro n
    have lift := bps_lift_mul (T (n + 1))
      (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => φ (a (n + 1) * Real.exp w.1) * Real.exp w.1 ^ (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h))
      (hTs (n + 1) (by omega)) (hfS3 _ _).contDiffOn
    have e : tm n = fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
        (φ (a (n + 1) * Real.exp w.1) * Real.exp w.1 ^ (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h)) * T (n + 1) w.2.1 w.2.2 := by
      rw [htm]
    rw [e]
    exact (hfS3 _ _).contDiffOn.mul lift.1
  
  have hvan : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), 1 < a (n + 1) * Real.exp w.1 →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (tm n) w = 0 := by
    intro n m w hw
    have hV : IsOpen {w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 1 < a (n + 1) * Real.exp w.1} :=
      isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_const.mul (Real.continuous_exp.comp continuous_fst))
    have hev : tm n =ᶠ[nhds w] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hV.mem_nhds hw] with v hv
      have hv' : 1 < a (n + 1) * Real.exp v.1 := hv
      rw [htm]
      simp only [hφ0 _ hv', zero_mul]
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
    rfl
  
  have hest : ∀ n m : ℕ, ∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → (X, η) ∈ D →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (tm n) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤
        Cp (n + 1) m * q ^ (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h) * wt m X := by
    intro n m q X η hq hXD
    have hXO := hD hXD
    have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h := by positivity
    have lift := bps_lift_mul (T (n + 1))
      (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => φ (a (n + 1) * Real.exp w.1) * Real.exp w.1 ^ (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h))
      (hTs (n + 1) (by omega)) (hfS3 _ _).contDiffOn
    have e : tm n = fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => T (n + 1) w.2.1 w.2.2 *
        (φ (a (n + 1) * Real.exp w.1) * Real.exp w.1 ^ (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h)) := by
      rw [htm]; funext w; ring
    rw [e]
    refine (lift.2.2 m (Real.log q, X, η) hXO).trans ?_
    have hexp : Real.exp (Real.log q) = q := Real.exp_log hq
    have hwt0 := hwt m X η hXD
    simp only [hCp]
    have hcast : (1 + 2 * h * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) = 1 + 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h := by push_cast; ring
    rw [hcast]
    have hterm : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        (m.choose k : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(T (n + 1))) (Real.log q, X, η).2‖ *
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m - k) (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
            φ (a (n + 1) * Real.exp w.1) * Real.exp w.1 ^ (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h)) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤
        (m.choose k : ℝ) * ((|Cj (n + 1) m| * wt m X) *
          (Mb m * (1 + 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h) ^ m * q ^ (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h))) := by
      intro k hk
      have hk' : k ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hk)
      have b1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(T (n + 1))) (X, η)‖ ≤ |Cj (n + 1) m| * wt m X :=
        (hCj (n + 1) m (by omega) k hk' X η hXD).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hwt0)
      have b2 := (hfst _ (hfS (a (n + 1)) (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h)) (m - k) (Real.log q, X, η)).trans
        (hMb m (a (n + 1)) _ (hapos _) hc (m - k) (by omega) (Real.log q))
      rw [hexp] at b2
      exact (mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) b2 (norm_nonneg _)
        (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hwt0))).trans_eq (by ring)
    refine (Finset.sum_le_sum hterm).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    have hsum : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose k : ℝ)) = 2 ^ m := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose m
    rw [hsum]
    ring
  
  have hloc : ∀ s₀ : ℝ, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, s₀ - 1 < w.1 →
      bpsTail h φ a T w = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, tm n w := by
    intro s₀
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := pow_unbounded_of_one_lt (Real.exp (1 - s₀)) (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) < 2)
    refine ⟨N, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    have e : bpsTail h φ a T w = ∑' n, tm n w := by rw [htm]; rfl
    rw [e]
    apply tsum_eq_sum
    intro n hn
    have hn' : N ≤ n := by simpa using hn
    have h1 : (2:ℝ) ^ N ≤ a (n + 1) :=
      (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)).trans (h2pow (n + 1))
    have h2 : Real.exp (s₀ - 1) < Real.exp w.1 := Real.exp_lt_exp.2 hw
    have h3 : Real.exp (1 - s₀) * Real.exp (s₀ - 1) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add, show 1 - s₀ + (s₀ - 1) = (0:ℝ) by ring, Real.exp_zero]
    have h4 : 1 < a (n + 1) * Real.exp w.1 := by
      have := mul_lt_mul'' (hN.trans_le h1) h2 (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.exp_pos _).le
      linarith
    rw [htm]
    simp only [hφ0 _ h4, zero_mul]
  
  have hfin : ∀ (N : ℕ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ),
      w ∈ (univ ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) → ∀ m : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, tm n w) w =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (tm n) w := by
    intro N w hw m
    have e1 : (fun w => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, tm n w) = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, tm n :=
      (Finset.sum_fn _ _).symm
    rw [e1, ← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, tm n) m hUo hw,
      iteratedFDerivWithin_sum_apply hUo.uniqueDiffOn hw
        (fun j _ => ((htmS j).contDiffWithinAt hw).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hUo hw)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    intro w₀ _
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hloc w₀.1
    refine ⟨{w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | w₀.1 - 1 < w.1}, isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst,
      by show w₀.1 - 1 < w₀.1; linarith, ?_⟩
    exact ((ContDiffOn.sum (s := Finset.range N) (fun n _ => htmS n)).mono inter_subset_left).congr
      (fun w hw => hN w hw.2)
  · 
    intro m
    obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀m, hj₀2⟩ : ∃ j₀ : ℕ, m ≤ j₀ ∧ 2 ≤ j₀ := ⟨max m 2, le_max_left _ _, le_max_right _ _⟩
    refine ⟨1 + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range j₀, Cp (n + 1) m,
      add_nonneg zero_le_one (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun n _ => hCp0 _ _)), ?_⟩
    intro q X η hq hq1 hXD
    have hXO := hD hXD
    have hw₀ : (Real.log q, X, η) ∈ (univ ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      ⟨mem_univ _, hXO⟩
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hloc (Real.log q)
    have hev : bpsTail h φ a T =ᶠ[nhds (Real.log q, X, η)] fun w => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, tm n w :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
        ((isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst : IsOpen {w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | Real.log q - 1 < w.1}).mem_nhds
          (by show Real.log q - 1 < Real.log q; linarith))
        (fun w hw => hN w hw)
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, hfin N _ hw₀ m]
    refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
    have hwt0 := hwt m X η hXD
    have hQ : 0 ≤ q ^ (2 * h) * wt m X := mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _) hwt0
    have hx : ∀ n ∈ Finset.range N, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (tm n) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤
        ((if n + 1 < j₀ then Cp (n + 1) m else 0) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) * (q ^ (2 * h) * wt m X) := by
      intro n _
      have hb := hest n m q X η hq hXD
      by_cases hj : n + 1 < j₀
      · rw [if_pos hj]
        have hc_ge : 2 * h ≤ 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h := by
          have := (Nat.cast_nonneg n : (0:ℝ) ≤ n); nlinarith
        have hqc := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq hq1.le hc_ge
        have h1 : Cp (n + 1) m * q ^ (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h) * wt m X ≤ Cp (n + 1) m * q ^ (2 * h) * wt m X :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqc (hCp0 _ _)) hwt0
        have h2 : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * (q ^ (2 * h) * wt m X) := mul_nonneg (by positivity) hQ
        calc _ ≤ Cp (n + 1) m * q ^ (2 * h) * wt m X := hb.trans h1
          _ ≤ Cp (n + 1) m * q ^ (2 * h) * wt m X + (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * (q ^ (2 * h) * wt m X) :=
              le_add_of_nonneg_right h2
          _ = _ := by ring
      · rw [if_neg hj, zero_add]
        have hn2 : 2 ≤ n + 1 := by omega
        have hmn : m ≤ n + 1 := by omega
        by_cases hv : 1 < a (n + 1) * q
        · have h0 := hvan n m (Real.log q, X, η)
            (by show 1 < a (n + 1) * Real.exp (Real.log q); rw [Real.exp_log hq]; exact hv)
          rw [h0, norm_zero]
          exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) hQ
        · push_neg at hv
          have hqa : q ≤ 1 / a (n + 1) := by rw [le_div_iff₀ (hapos _), mul_comm]; exact hv
          have hs := hsm (n + 1) (by omega) m hmn q hq hqa
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (hCp0 _ _)] at hs
          have he : 2 * h * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 = h * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by push_cast; ring
          rw [he] at hs
          have hcsplit : q ^ (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h) =
              q ^ (h * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) * q ^ (h * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]; congr 1; ring
          have hn2r : (2:ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hn2
          have hqe : q ^ (h * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ q ^ (2 * h) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq hq1.le (by nlinarith)
          have hqe0 : 0 ≤ q ^ (h * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
          calc _ ≤ Cp (n + 1) m * q ^ (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h) * wt m X := hb
            _ = (Cp (n + 1) m * q ^ (h * ((n : ℝ) + 1))) * q ^ (h * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) * wt m X := by
                rw [hcsplit]; ring
            _ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1) * q ^ (h * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) * wt m X :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs hqe0) hwt0
            _ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1) * q ^ (2 * h) * wt m X :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqe (by positivity)) hwt0
            _ = (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1) * (q ^ (2 * h) * wt m X) := by ring
    have hgeo : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) ≤ 1 := by
      have := sum_geometric_two_le N
      have e : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) =
          (1 / 2) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => by ring)
      rw [e]; linarith
    have hfinp : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (if n + 1 < j₀ then Cp (n + 1) m else 0) ≤
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range j₀, Cp (n + 1) m := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
      · intro n hn
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hn ⊢
        omega
      · intro n _ _; exact hCp0 _ _
    have key : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (if n + 1 < j₀ then Cp (n + 1) m else 0) +
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) ≤ 1 + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range j₀, Cp (n + 1) m := by
      linarith
    calc _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ((if n + 1 < j₀ then Cp (n + 1) m else 0) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) *
          (q ^ (2 * h) * wt m X) := Finset.sum_le_sum hx
      _ = (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (if n + 1 < j₀ then Cp (n + 1) m else 0) +
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) * (q ^ (2 * h) * wt m X) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      _ ≤ (1 + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range j₀, Cp (n + 1) m) * (q ^ (2 * h) * wt m X) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right key hQ
      _ = _ := by ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (Xa Xb Xm Xp aa ab : ℝ) (T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xa → Xa < Xm → Xm < Xp → Xp < Xb → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(T n)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(T n)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ X η : ℝ, X ≤ Xm → T n X η = 0) → (∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → ∀ X η : ℝ, Xp ≤ X → T n X η = 0) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(T 1)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N)) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ N₀ : ℝ, ∀ N : ℝ, N₀ ≤ N → ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ m → ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (↿(T n)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N))

signature.name: bps_stress_weight
signature.statement: ∀ (Xa Xb Xm Xp aa ab : ℝ) (T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xa → Xa < Xm → Xm < Xp → Xp < Xb → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(T n)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(T n)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ X η : ℝ, X ≤ Xm → T n X η = 0) → (∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → ∀ X η : ℝ, Xp ≤ X → T n X η = 0) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(T 1)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N)) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ N₀ : ℝ, ∀ N : ℝ, N₀ ≤ N → ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ m → ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (↿(T n)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xa Xb Xm Xp aa ab T hXa hXam hmp hpb H1 H2 H3 H4 H5 m
  have hew0 : ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X := by
    intro X
    unfold edgeWeight
    split_ifs
    · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
    · exact le_rfl
  have hed : ∀ X : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → 0 < edgeDist Xa Xb X ∧ edgeDist Xa Xb X ≤ 1 := by
    intro X h1 h2
    have hX : 0 < X := by linarith
    unfold edgeDist
    refine ⟨lt_min one_pos (lt_min ?_ ?_), min_le_left _ _⟩
    · exact Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).2 h1)
    · exact Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).2 h2)
  have hlow : ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ X : ℝ, Xm ≤ X → X ≤ Xp → c ≤ edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X := by
    have hXp : 0 < Xp := by linarith
    have la0 : 0 < Real.log (Xm / Xa) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).2 hXam)
    have lb0 : 0 < Real.log (Xb / Xp) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXp).2 hpb)
    refine ⟨Real.exp (-(|aa| / Real.log (Xm / Xa) ^ 2) - |ab| / Real.log (Xb / Xp) ^ 2),
      Real.exp_pos _, ?_⟩
    intro X hX1 hX2
    have hX : 0 < X := by linarith
    unfold edgeWeight
    rw [if_pos ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
    have L1 : Real.log (Xm / Xa) ≤ Real.log (X / Xa) :=
      Real.log_le_log (div_pos (by linarith) hXa) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hX1 hXa.le)
    have L2 : Real.log (Xb / Xp) ≤ Real.log (Xb / X) :=
      Real.log_le_log (div_pos (by linarith) hXp) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hX hX2)
    have S1 : Real.log (Xm / Xa) ^ 2 ≤ Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ la0.le L1 2
    have S2 : Real.log (Xb / Xp) ^ 2 ≤ Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ lb0.le L2 2
    have pa : 0 < Real.log (Xm / Xa) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have pb : 0 < Real.log (Xb / Xp) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have A1 : aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2 ≤ |aa| / Real.log (Xm / Xa) ^ 2 :=
      le_trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self aa) (by positivity))
        (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (abs_nonneg aa) pa S1)
    have A2 : ab / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2 ≤ |ab| / Real.log (Xb / Xp) ^ 2 :=
      le_trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self ab) (by positivity))
        (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (abs_nonneg ab) pb S2)
    linarith
  obtain ⟨c, hc0, hc⟩ := hlow
  choose Cn Nn hN using H5
  refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Nn i|, ?_⟩
  intro N hN0 n hn
  have hNle : ∀ i, i ≤ m → Nn i ≤ N := by
    intro i hi
    have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Nn i|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega : i < m + 1))
    linarith [le_abs_self (Nn i)]
  have hNnn : 0 ≤ N := le_trans (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)) hN0
  rcases (show n = 1 ∨ 2 ≤ n by omega) with rfl | hn2
  · refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Cn i|, ?_⟩
    intro i hi X η h1 h2 h3 h4
    obtain ⟨he0, he1⟩ := hed X h1 h2
    have hb := hN i X η h1 h2 h3 h4
    have ea : edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-Nn i) ≤ edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge he0 he1 (by linarith [hNle i hi])
    have v0 := hew0 X
    have r0 : 0 ≤ edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-Nn i) := Real.rpow_nonneg he0.le _
    have r1 : 0 ≤ edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) := Real.rpow_nonneg he0.le _
    have hCi : |Cn i| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Cn i| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cn i|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (↿(T 1)) (X, η)‖
        ≤ Cn i * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-Nn i) := hb
      _ = Cn i * (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-Nn i)) := by ring
      _ ≤ |Cn i| * (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-Nn i)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (mul_nonneg v0 r0)
      _ ≤ |Cn i| * (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ea v0) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCi (mul_nonneg v0 r1)
  · have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := hn
    choose C hC using H2 n hn1
    obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, S = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |C i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hS0 : 0 ≤ S := by rw [hS]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    refine ⟨S / c, ?_⟩
    intro i hi X η h1 h2 h3 h4
    obtain ⟨he0, he1⟩ := hed X h1 h2
    have hw0 : 0 ≤ edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) :=
      mul_nonneg (hew0 X) (Real.rpow_nonneg he0.le _)
    have hK0 : 0 ≤ S / c := div_nonneg hS0 hc0.le
    have zero_case : ∀ V : Set (ℝ × ℝ), IsOpen V → (X, η) ∈ V → (∀ p ∈ V, T n p.1 p.2 = 0) →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (↿(T n)) (X, η)‖ ≤
          S / c * (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N)) := by
      intro V hV hmem hz
      have hev : (↿(T n)) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV.mem_nhds hmem) (fun p hp => hz p hp)
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ i).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg hK0 hw0
    rcases lt_or_ge X Xm with hXm | hXm
    · exact zero_case {p | p.1 < Xm} (isOpen_lt continuous_fst continuous_const) hXm
        (fun p hp => H3 n hn1 p.1 p.2 (le_of_lt hp))
    rcases lt_or_ge Xp X with hXp | hXp
    · exact zero_case {p | Xp < p.1} (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst) hXp
        (fun p hp => H4 n hn2 p.1 p.2 (le_of_lt hp))
    have hb := hC i X η (by linarith) h3 h4
    have hCi : |C i| ≤ S := by
      rw [hS]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |C i|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
    have hone : 1 ≤ edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) :=
      Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos he0 he1 (by linarith)
    have hcw : c ≤ edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N) := by
      have := mul_le_mul (hc X hXm hXp) hone zero_le_one (hew0 X)
      linarith
    have hSc : S = S / c * c := (div_mul_cancel₀ S hc0.ne').symm
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (↿(T n)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C i := hb
      _ ≤ |C i| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ S := hCi
      _ = S / c * c := hSc
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcw hK0

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (S Vc : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ j, 1 ≤ a j) → (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) → ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, logLift (bgVb h a S Vc) w = Vc 0 w.2.1 w.2.2 + bpsTail h bpsChi a Vc w + bpsTail h bpsPsi a (bpsRcoef h S) w

signature.name: bps_Vb_split
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (S Vc : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ j, 1 ≤ a j) → (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) → ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, logLift (bgVb h a S Vc) w = Vc 0 w.2.1 w.2.2 + bpsTail h bpsChi a Vc w + bpsTail h bpsPsi a (bpsRcoef h S) w

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h a S Vc H1 H2 w
  have hs1 : ∀ j : ℕ, (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ a j := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => simpa using H1 0
    | succ j ih =>
      have e1 := H2 j
      have e2 := H1 j
      push_cast
      linarith
  have hq : 0 < Real.exp w.1 := Real.exp_pos _
  have hs2 : ∀ n : ℕ, ⌈1 / Real.exp w.1⌉₊ ≤ n → 1 < a (n + 1) * Real.exp w.1 := by
    intro n hn
    have h1 : 1 / Real.exp w.1 ≤ (⌈1 / Real.exp w.1⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
    have h2 : (⌈1 / Real.exp w.1⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have h3 := hs1 (n + 1)
    push_cast at h3
    have h4 : 1 / Real.exp w.1 < a (n + 1) := by linarith
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hq] at h4
    linarith
  have hchi : ∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ → bpsChi σ = 0 := by
    intro σ hσ
    unfold bpsChi
    exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
  have hpsi : ∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ → bpsPsi σ = 0 := by
    intro σ hσ
    unfold bpsPsi
    have hev : (fun σ' : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * σ')) =ᶠ[nhds σ] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds (show σ ∈ Set.Ioi (1:ℝ) from hσ)] with τ hτ
      have hτ' : (1:ℝ) < τ := hτ
      exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
    rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const, mul_zero]
  have hfs : Summable (fun n : ℕ => bpsChi (a (n + 1) * Real.exp w.1) *
      Real.exp w.1 ^ (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h) * Vc (n + 1) w.2.1 w.2.2) := by
    apply summable_of_ne_finset_zero (s := Finset.range ⌈1 / Real.exp w.1⌉₊)
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hn
    simp only [hchi _ (hs2 n hn), zero_mul]
  have hgs : Summable (fun n : ℕ => bpsPsi (a (n + 1) * Real.exp w.1) *
      Real.exp w.1 ^ (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h) * bpsRcoef h S (n + 1) w.2.1 w.2.2) := by
    apply summable_of_ne_finset_zero (s := Finset.range ⌈1 / Real.exp w.1⌉₊)
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hn
    simp only [hpsi _ (hs2 n hn), zero_mul]
  have key : logLift (bgVb h a S Vc) w = Vc 0 w.2.1 w.2.2 + ∑' n : ℕ,
      ((bpsChi (a (n + 1) * Real.exp w.1) *
        Real.exp w.1 ^ (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h) * Vc (n + 1) w.2.1 w.2.2) +
      (bpsPsi (a (n + 1) * Real.exp w.1) *
        Real.exp w.1 ^ (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h) * bpsRcoef h S (n + 1) w.2.1 w.2.2)) := by
    unfold logLift bgVb
    congr 1
    apply tsum_congr
    intro n
    simp only [bgCut, bpsChi, bpsPsi, bpsRcoef]
    ring
  rw [key, hfs.tsum_add hgs, add_assoc]
  rfl

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (S : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(S n)) (Ici 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(S n)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bpsRcoef h S n)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ m → ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (↿(bpsRcoef h S n)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * (1 + X)

signature.name: bps_Rcoef_bounds
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (S : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(S n)) (Ici 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(S n)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bpsRcoef h S n)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ m → ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (↿(bpsRcoef h S n)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * (1 + X)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h S hh0 hh1 hSs hSb n hn
  have hO : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hOu : UniqueDiffOn ℝ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := hO.uniqueDiffOn
  
  have leib : ∀ (f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) →
      ∀ (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (w : ℝ), p ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 → 0 ≤ w →
      (∀ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f p‖ ≤ a k * w) → (∀ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g p‖ ≤ b k) →
      ∀ i, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y => f y * g y) p‖ ≤
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose k : ℝ) * a k * b (i - k)) * w := by
    intro f g hf hg a b p w hp hw ha hb i
    have hL := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hf hg hOu hp (n := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO hp] at hL
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    refine hL.trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hO hp, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (i - k) hO hp]
    have h1 := ha k
    have h2 := hb (i - k)
    have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ (i.choose k : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    calc (i.choose k : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f p‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (i - k) g p‖
        ≤ (i.choose k : ℝ) * (a k * w) * b (i - k) := by
          apply mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hc) h2 (norm_nonneg _)
          exact mul_nonneg hc ((norm_nonneg _).trans h1)
      _ = (i.choose k : ℝ) * a k * b (i - k) * w := by ring
  
  obtain ⟨bt, hbt⟩ : ∃ bt : ℝ → ℝ, bt = fun η => -(2 * η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hVo : IsOpen {η : ℝ | 2 * h * η ^ 2 < 1} :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_const.mul (continuous_pow 2)) continuous_const
  have hIccV : Icc (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ {η : ℝ | 2 * h * η ^ 2 < 1} := by
    intro η hη
    show 2 * h * η ^ 2 < 1
    have : η ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [hη.1, hη.2]
    nlinarith
  have hbts : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ bt {η : ℝ | 2 * h * η ^ 2 < 1} := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : ℝ => 2 * η) {η : ℝ | 2 * h * η ^ 2 < 1} :=
      (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id).contDiffOn
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : ℝ => 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) {η : ℝ | 2 * h * η ^ 2 < 1} :=
      (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_id.pow 2))).contDiffOn
    have h3 := (h1.div h2 (fun η hη => by
      have hη' : 2 * h * η ^ 2 < 1 := hη
      exact (show (0:ℝ) < 1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2 by linarith).ne')).neg
    rw [hbt]
    exact h3
  have hbtb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1,
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k bt {η : ℝ | 2 * h * η ^ 2 < 1} η‖ ≤ M := by
    intro k
    exact isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      ((hbts.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hVo.uniqueDiffOn).mono hIccV)
  have hWo : IsOpen (⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) ⁻¹' {η : ℝ | 2 * h * η ^ 2 < 1}) :=
    hVo.preimage (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).continuous
  have hOW : Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆
      ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) ⁻¹' {η : ℝ | 2 * h * η ^ 2 < 1} :=
    fun p hp => hIccV (Ioo_subset_Icc_self hp.2)
  have hβs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (bt ∘ ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)) (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
    hbts.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).contDiff.contDiffOn (fun p hp => hOW hp)
  have hβb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (bt ∘ ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)) p‖ ≤ M := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hbtb k
    refine ⟨M, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    have hpW := hOW hp
    have e := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := bt ∘ ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)) k hWo hpW
    rw [← e, (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right hbts hVo.uniqueDiffOn
      hWo.uniqueDiffOn hpW (by exact_mod_cast le_top)]
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
    have hprod : ∏ _i : Fin k, ‖ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_snd_le ℝ ℝ ℝ)
    have hb := hM (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ p) (Ioo_subset_Icc_self hp.2)
    calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k bt {η : ℝ | 2 * h * η ^ 2 < 1}
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ p)‖ * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ M := by rw [mul_one]; exact hb
  
  have hSO : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(S n)) (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
    (hSs n hn).mono (prod_mono Ioi_subset_Ici_self subset_rfl)
  choose Mβ hMβ using hβb
  choose MS hMS using hSb n hn
  have hQs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (bt ∘ ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)) y * ↿(S n) y)
      (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := hβs.mul hSO
  obtain ⟨MQ, hMQ⟩ : ∃ MQ : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ i, MQ i =
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose k : ℝ) * Mβ k * MS (i - k)) * 1 := ⟨_, fun i => rfl⟩
  have hQb : ∀ (i : ℕ) (p : ℝ × ℝ), p ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y => (bt ∘ ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)) y * ↿(S n) y) p‖ ≤ MQ i := by
    intro i p hp
    rw [hMQ]
    exact leib _ (↿(S n)) hβs hSO Mβ MS p 1 hp zero_le_one
      (fun k => by rw [mul_one]; exact hMβ k p hp)
      (fun k => hMS k p.1 p.2 hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2) i
  
  have hfst : ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : ℝ × ℝ), 0 < p.1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y : ℝ × ℝ => y.1) p‖ ≤ 1 * (1 + p.1) := by
    intro k p hp
    rw [one_mul]
    rcases k with _ | k
    · rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hp]; linarith
    · rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
      have hd : fderiv ℝ (fun y : ℝ × ℝ => y.1) = fun _ => ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ := by
        funext q; exact fderiv_fst
      rw [hd]
      rcases k with _ | k
      · rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]; linarith [ContinuousLinearMap.norm_fst_le ℝ ℝ ℝ]
      · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)]
        simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
        linarith
  
  have hid : ↿(bpsRcoef h S n) = fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      p.1 * ((bt ∘ ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)) p * ↿(S n) p) := by
    funext p
    obtain ⟨X, η⟩ := p
    rw [hbt]
    show bpsRcoef h S n X η = X * (-(2 * η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)) * S n X η)
    unfold bpsRcoef
    ring
  refine ⟨?_, fun m => ?_⟩
  · rw [hid]
    exact contDiffOn_fst.mul hQs
  · refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
      |∑ k ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose k : ℝ) * 1 * MQ (i - k)|,
      fun i hi X η hX hη1 hη2 => ?_⟩
    have hp : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨hX, hη1, hη2⟩
    have hb := leib (fun y : ℝ × ℝ => y.1) _ contDiffOn_fst hQs (fun _ => 1) MQ (X, η) (1 + X) hp
      (by linarith) (fun k => hfst k (X, η) hX) (fun k => hQb k (X, η) hp) i
    rw [hid]
    refine hb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ((le_abs_self _).trans
      (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |∑ k ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose k : ℝ) * 1 * MQ (i - k)|)
        (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega)))) (by linarith))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (univ ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.2.1 w.2.2) (univ ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ (∀ (m : ℕ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), w.2 ∈ Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.2.1 w.2.2) w‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) w.2‖) ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), w.2 ∈ Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.2.1 w.2.2 * f w) w‖ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose k : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿g) w.2‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m - k) f w‖

signature.name: bps_lift_mul
signature.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (univ ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.2.1 w.2.2) (univ ×ˢ (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ (∀ (m : ℕ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), w.2 ∈ Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.2.1 w.2.2) w‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) w.2‖) ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), w.2 ∈ Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.2.1 w.2.2 * f w) w‖ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose k : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿g) w.2‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m - k) f w‖

proof.tactics:
by
  intro g f hg hf
  have hO : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hS : IsOpen ((univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) := isOpen_univ.prod hO
  let L : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)
  have hpre : (L : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ) ⁻¹' (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) =
      (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    ext w
    simp [L]
  have hG : (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.2.1 w.2.2) = (↿g) ∘ (L : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ) := by
    funext w
    rfl
  have hGs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.2.1 w.2.2)
      ((univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) := by
    rw [hG, ← hpre]
    exact hg.comp_continuousLinearMap L
  have hSo : IsOpen ((L : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ) ⁻¹' (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) := hpre ▸ hS
  have hB : ∀ (m : ℕ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), w.2 ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.2.1 w.2.2) w‖ ≤
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿g) w.2‖ := by
    intro m w hw
    have hwS : w ∈ (L : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ) ⁻¹' (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := hw
    have hLw : L w ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := hw
    have hm : ((m : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
    have E1 := L.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right hg hO.uniqueDiffOn hSo.uniqueDiffOn hLw hm
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hSo hwS, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hO hLw] at E1
    rw [hG, E1]
    refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
    have hL : ‖L‖ ≤ 1 := ContinuousLinearMap.norm_snd_le ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)
    have hp : ∏ _i : Fin m, ‖L‖ ≤ 1 :=
      Finset.prod_le_one₀ (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun _ _ => hL)
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) hp
  refine ⟨hGs, hB, ?_⟩
  intro m w hw
  have hwS : w ∈ (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := ⟨mem_univ _, hw⟩
  have hm : ((m : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have h1 := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hGs hf hS.uniqueDiffOn hwS hm
  refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) (le_trans h1 (Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_))
  · rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hS hwS]
  · rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hS hwS, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (m - k) hS hwS]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hB k w hw) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) (norm_nonneg _)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hpt : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, p.1 ≠ 0 →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (↿(fun (X _ : ℝ) => Real.sqrt (2 * X))) p := by
    intro p hp
    have hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * q.1) p :=
      contDiffAt_const.mul contDiffAt_fst
    exact hg.sqrt (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hp)
  refine ⟨fun p hp => (hpt p (ne_of_gt hp.1)).contDiffWithinAt, ?_⟩
  intro X₀ X₁ hX₀ k
  have hK : IsCompact (Icc X₀ X₁ ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  have hc : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(fun (X _ : ℝ) => Real.sqrt (2 * X))))
      (Icc X₀ X₁ ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
    refine continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt (fun p hp => ?_)
    have hp1 : p.1 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le hX₀ hp.1.1)
    exact (hpt p hp1).continuousAt_iteratedFDeriv (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hc
  exact ⟨M, fun X η h1 h2 h3 h4 => hM (X, η) ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3.le, h4.le⟩⟩
