proof.tactics:
by
  intro h ε b n f hh0 hh1 hε hf
  have hΩ : IsOpen (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿f)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
    hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ le_rfl
  have hpd : ∀ (v : ℝ × ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ X η, ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 → g X η = fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η) v) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
    intro v g hgv
    have hDg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿f))
        (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hD
    refine hDg.congr (fun z hz => ?_)
    have := hgv z.1 z.2 hz
    exact this
  have s4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(pdX f)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
    refine hpd ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) (pdX f) (fun X η hz => ?_)
    have hd : HasFDerivAt (↿f) (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η)) (X, η) :=
      ((hf.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => ((Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) X :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X η)
    exact (hd.comp_hasDerivAt X hc).deriv
  have s5 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(pdE f)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
    refine hpd ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) (pdE f) (fun X η hz => ?_)
    have hd : HasFDerivAt (↿f) (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η)) (X, η) :=
      ((hf.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => ((X, e) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) η :=
      (hasDerivAt_const η X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' η)
    exact (hd.comp_hasDerivAt η hc).deriv
  have hX : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.1) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
    contDiff_fst.contDiffOn
  have hη : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.2) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
    contDiff_snd.contDiffOn
  have hinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (1 - 2 * h * z.2 ^ 2)⁻¹)
      (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
    refine ((contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_snd.pow 2))).contDiffOn).inv ?_
    intro w hw
    have h1 : -1 < w.2 := hw.2.1
    have h2 : w.2 < 1 := hw.2.2
    have hη2 : w.2 ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
    have : 0 < 1 - 2 * h * w.2 ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    exact ne_of_gt this
  have s7 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgUz f)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
    refine (hf.add (hX.mul s4)).congr (fun z _ => ?_)
    obtain ⟨X, η⟩ := z
    change bgUz f X η = f X η + X * pdX f X η
    rfl
  have s8 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(simTop h b f)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
    refine ((((contDiffOn_const (c := -b)).mul hf).add
      (((contDiffOn_const (c := (1 / 2 - h))).mul hη).mul s5)).add (hX.mul s4)).mul hinv
      |>.congr (fun z _ => ?_)
    obtain ⟨X, η⟩ := z
    change simTop h b f X η = (-b * f X η + (1 / 2 - h) * η * pdE f X η + X * pdX f X η) *
      (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)⁻¹
    rw [simTop, div_eq_mul_inv]
  have s9 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(simZop h b f)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
    refine ((((((contDiffOn_const (c := 2 * b)).mul hη).mul hf).add
      (((contDiffOn_const (c := (1 : ℝ))).sub (hη.mul hη)).mul s5)).sub
      ((((contDiffOn_const (c := (2 : ℝ))).mul hη).mul hX).mul s4)).mul hinv)
      |>.congr (fun z _ => ?_)
    obtain ⟨X, η⟩ := z
    change simZop h b f X η = (2 * b * η * f X η + (1 - η * η) * pdE f X η -
      2 * η * X * pdX f X η) * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)⁻¹
    rw [simZop, div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  have s10 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(bgVx h n f)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
    refine ((((((contDiffOn_const (c := (2 : ℝ))).mul hη).mul s7).sub
      (((contDiffOn_const (c := 2 * (1 / 2 - h + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h))).mul hη).mul hf)).sub
      (((contDiffOn_const (c := (1 : ℝ))).sub (hη.mul hη)).mul s5)).mul hinv)
      |>.congr (fun z _ => ?_)
    obtain ⟨X, η⟩ := z
    change bgVx h n f X η = (2 * η * bgUz f X η - 2 * (1 / 2 - h + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * η * f X η -
      (1 - η * η) * pdE f X η) * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)⁻¹
    rw [bgVx, div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  exact ⟨s4, s5, s8, s9, s7, s10⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h ε c : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (e : ℕ → ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → SimScaleProps h → 0 < ε → (∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(f n)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => simLiftSum h N c e f w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ ×ˢ Iio (1 : ℝ))) ∧ ∀ ρ z s : ℝ, 0 < ρ → s < 1 → cylPs (simLiftSum h N c e f) ρ z s = simLiftSum h N c (fun n => e n - 1) (fun n => simTop h (e n) (f n)) ρ z s ∧ cylPr (simLiftSum h N c e f) ρ z s = simLiftSum h N (c / 2) (fun n => e n - 1) (fun n => pdX (f n)) ρ z s ∧ cylPr (cylPr (simLiftSum h N c e f)) ρ z s = simLiftSum h N (c / 4) (fun n => e n - 1 - 1) (fun n => pdX (pdX (f n))) ρ z s ∧ cylPz (simLiftSum h N c e f) ρ z s = simLiftSum h N c (fun n => e n - (1 / 2 - h)) (fun n => simZop h (e n) (f n)) ρ z s ∧ cylPz (cylPz (simLiftSum h N c e f)) ρ z s = simLiftSum h N c (fun n => e n - (1 / 2 - h) - (1 / 2 - h)) (fun n => simZop h (e n - (1 / 2 - h)) (simZop h (e n) (f n))) ρ z s

signature.name: sim_sum_calculus
signature.statement: ∀ (h ε c : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (e : ℕ → ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → SimScaleProps h → 0 < ε → (∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(f n)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => simLiftSum h N c e f w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ ×ˢ Iio (1 : ℝ))) ∧ ∀ ρ z s : ℝ, 0 < ρ → s < 1 → cylPs (simLiftSum h N c e f) ρ z s = simLiftSum h N c (fun n => e n - 1) (fun n => simTop h (e n) (f n)) ρ z s ∧ cylPr (simLiftSum h N c e f) ρ z s = simLiftSum h N (c / 2) (fun n => e n - 1) (fun n => pdX (f n)) ρ z s ∧ cylPr (cylPr (simLiftSum h N c e f)) ρ z s = simLiftSum h N (c / 4) (fun n => e n - 1 - 1) (fun n => pdX (pdX (f n))) ρ z s ∧ cylPz (simLiftSum h N c e f) ρ z s = simLiftSum h N c (fun n => e n - (1 / 2 - h)) (fun n => simZop h (e n) (f n)) ρ z s ∧ cylPz (cylPz (simLiftSum h N c e f)) ρ z s = simLiftSum h N c (fun n => e n - (1 / 2 - h) - (1 / 2 - h)) (fun n => simZop h (e n - (1 / 2 - h)) (simZop h (e n) (f n))) ρ z s

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h ε c N e f hh0 hh1 hS hε hf
  have hOo : IsOpen (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  
  have scale : ∀ z τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → 0 < simScale h z τ ∧
      (z * simScale h z τ ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 < 1 ∧
      simScale h z τ ^ (2 * h - 1) = (simScale h z τ ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 ∧
      simScale h z τ ^ (2 * h) = simScale h z τ * (simScale h z τ ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 := by
    intro z τ hτ
    have hq := (hS.1 z τ hτ).1
    have hR4 : simScale h z τ ^ (2 * h - 1) = (simScale h z τ ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hq.le]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
    refine ⟨hq, ?_, hR4, ?_⟩
    · have hz2 := (hS.2.1 z τ hτ).2
      have hprod : simScale h z τ ^ (1 - 2 * h) * simScale h z τ ^ (2 * h - 1) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hq, show 1 - 2 * h + (2 * h - 1) = (0:ℝ) by ring, Real.rpow_zero]
      rw [mul_pow, ← hR4]
      calc z ^ 2 * simScale h z τ ^ (2 * h - 1)
          < simScale h z τ ^ (1 - 2 * h) * simScale h z τ ^ (2 * h - 1) :=
            mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hz2 (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _)
        _ = 1 := hprod
    · have e : simScale h z τ ^ (2 * h) = simScale h z τ ^ (1:ℝ) * simScale h z τ ^ (2 * h - 1) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]; congr 1; ring
      rw [e, Real.rpow_one, hR4]
  have Lpos : ∀ z τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → 0 < 1 - 2 * h * (z * simScale h z τ ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 := by
    intro z τ hτ
    obtain ⟨-, hη, -, -⟩ := scale z τ hτ
    have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hη (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * h)
    linarith
  have qdiff : ∀ z τ : ℝ, 0 < τ →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (z, τ) := fun z τ hτ =>
    (hS.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt (prod_mem_nhds Filter.univ_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hτ))).differentiableAt
      (by norm_num)
  
  have qs : ∀ z s : ℝ, s < 1 → HasDerivAt (fun s' => simScale h z (1 - s'))
      (-1 / (1 - 2 * h * (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2)) s := by
    intro z s hs
    have hτ : (0:ℝ) < 1 - s := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hq, -, hR4, -⟩ := scale z (1 - s) hτ
    have hLne := (Lpos z (1 - s) hτ).ne'
    have hl : HasDerivAt (fun s' : ℝ => ((z, 1 - s') : ℝ × ℝ)) ((0:ℝ), (-1:ℝ)) s :=
      (hasDerivAt_const _ _).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_id' s).const_sub 1)
    have hA0 := (qdiff z (1 - s) hτ).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s hl
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A, HasDerivAt (fun s' => simScale h z (1 - s')) A s := ⟨_, hA0⟩
    have hk := hA.sub ((hasDerivAt_const s (z ^ 2)).mul (hA.rpow_const (p := 2 * h) (Or.inl hq.ne')))
    have hk2 := hk.congr_of_eventuallyEq (f₁ := fun s' : ℝ => 1 - s') (by
      filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hs] with s' hs'
      exact ((hS.1 z (1 - s') (sub_pos.mpr (show s' < 1 from hs'))).2).symm)
    have hrel := hk2.unique ((hasDerivAt_id' s).const_sub 1)
    rw [hR4] at hrel
    convert hA using 1
    rw [div_eq_iff hLne]
    linear_combination (-1:ℝ) * hrel
  
  have qz : ∀ z s : ℝ, s < 1 → HasDerivAt (fun w => simScale h w (1 - s))
      (2 * z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (2 * h) /
        (1 - 2 * h * (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2)) z := by
    intro z s hs
    have hτ : (0:ℝ) < 1 - s := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hq, -, hR4, -⟩ := scale z (1 - s) hτ
    have hLne := (Lpos z (1 - s) hτ).ne'
    have hl : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℝ => ((w, 1 - s) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) z :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' z).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const _ _)
    have hB0 := (qdiff z (1 - s) hτ).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt z hl
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ B, HasDerivAt (fun w => simScale h w (1 - s)) B z := ⟨_, hB0⟩
    have hk := hB.sub ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 z).mul (hB.rpow_const (p := 2 * h) (Or.inl hq.ne')))
    have hk2 := hk.congr_of_eventuallyEq (f₁ := fun _ : ℝ => 1 - s)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun w => ((hS.1 w (1 - s) hτ).2).symm)
    have hrel := hk2.unique (hasDerivAt_const z (1 - s))
    rw [hR4] at hrel
    have e21 : z ^ (2 - 1) = z := by norm_num
    rw [e21] at hrel
    simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at hrel
    convert hB using 1
    rw [div_eq_iff hLne]
    linear_combination (-1:ℝ) * hrel
  
  have chain : ∀ (b : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ∀ (R Zf Q : ℝ → ℝ) (R' Z' Q' u : ℝ), HasDerivAt R R' u → HasDerivAt Zf Z' u →
      HasDerivAt Q Q' u → 0 < Q u → 0 < R u → (Zf u * Q u ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 < 1 →
      HasDerivAt (fun v => Q v ^ b * g (R v / (2 * Q v)) (Zf v * Q v ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))))
        (Q' * b * Q u ^ (b - 1) * g (R u / (2 * Q u)) (Zf u * Q u ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) +
          Q u ^ b * (pdX g (R u / (2 * Q u)) (Zf u * Q u ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) *
              ((R' * (2 * Q u) - R u * (2 * Q')) / (2 * Q u) ^ 2) +
            pdE g (R u / (2 * Q u)) (Zf u * Q u ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) *
              (Z' * Q u ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) +
                Zf u * (Q' * (-(1 / 2 - h)) * Q u ^ (-(1 / 2 - h) - 1))))) u := by
    intro b g hg R Zf Q R' Z' Q' u hR hZ hQ hQp hRp hη
    have hmem : (R u / (2 * Q u), Zf u * Q u ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
      have habs := abs_lt.mp ((sq_lt_one_iff_abs_lt_one _).mp hη)
      have hX0 : 0 < R u / (2 * Q u) := by positivity
      exact ⟨show -ε < R u / (2 * Q u) by linarith, habs.1, habs.2⟩
    obtain ⟨G', hG⟩ : ∃ G', HasFDerivAt (↿g) G' (R u / (2 * Q u), Zf u * Q u ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) :=
      ⟨_, ((hg.contDiffAt (hOo.mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt⟩
    have hgX : HasDerivAt (fun Y => g Y (Zf u * Q u ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)))) (G' (1, 0))
        (R u / (2 * Q u)) := by
      have hl : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, Zf u * Q u ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)))) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))
          (R u / (2 * Q u)) := (hasDerivAt_id' _).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const _ _)
      have := hG.comp_hasDerivAt (R u / (2 * Q u)) hl
      exact this
    have hgE : HasDerivAt (fun e => g (R u / (2 * Q u)) e) (G' (0, 1))
        (Zf u * Q u ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) := by
      have hl : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => (R u / (2 * Q u), e)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))
          (Zf u * Q u ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) := (hasDerivAt_const _ _).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' _)
      have := hG.comp_hasDerivAt (Zf u * Q u ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) hl
      exact this
    have hpdX : pdX g (R u / (2 * Q u)) (Zf u * Q u ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) = G' (1, 0) := hgX.deriv
    have hpdE : pdE g (R u / (2 * Q u)) (Zf u * Q u ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) = G' (0, 1) := hgE.deriv
    have hQb : HasDerivAt (fun v => Q v ^ b) (Q' * b * Q u ^ (b - 1)) u :=
      hQ.rpow_const (Or.inl hQp.ne')
    have hX : HasDerivAt (fun v => R v / (2 * Q v))
        ((R' * (2 * Q u) - R u * (2 * Q')) / (2 * Q u) ^ 2) u :=
      hR.div (hQ.const_mul 2) (by positivity)
    have hE : HasDerivAt (fun v => Zf v * Q v ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)))
        (Z' * Q u ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) + Zf u * (Q' * (-(1 / 2 - h)) * Q u ^ (-(1 / 2 - h) - 1))) u :=
      hZ.mul (hQ.rpow_const (Or.inl hQp.ne'))
    have hC : HasDerivAt (fun v => g (R v / (2 * Q v)) (Zf v * Q v ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))))
        (G' ((R' * (2 * Q u) - R u * (2 * Q')) / (2 * Q u) ^ 2,
          Z' * Q u ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) + Zf u * (Q' * (-(1 / 2 - h)) * Q u ^ (-(1 / 2 - h) - 1)))) u := by
      have := hG.comp_hasDerivAt u (hX.prodMk hE)
      exact this
    have hlin : ∀ a d : ℝ, G' (a, d) = a * G' (1, 0) + d * G' (0, 1) := by
      intro a d
      have e : ((a, d) : ℝ × ℝ) = a • ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) + d • ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) := by ext <;> simp
      rw [e, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    refine (hQb.mul hC).congr_deriv ?_
    rw [hlin, hpdX, hpdE]
    ring
  
  have lift_time : ∀ (b : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ∀ ρ z s : ℝ, 0 < ρ → s < 1 →
      HasDerivAt (fun s' => simLift h b g ρ z s') (simLift h (b - 1) (simTop h b g) ρ z s) s := by
    intro b g hg ρ z s hρ hs
    have hτ : (0:ℝ) < 1 - s := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hq, hη, -, -⟩ := scale z (1 - s) hτ
    have hqne := hq.ne'
    have hLne := (Lpos z (1 - s) hτ).ne'
    have hc := chain b g hg (fun _ => ρ) (fun _ => z) (fun s' => simScale h z (1 - s')) 0 0 _ s
      (hasDerivAt_const _ _) (hasDerivAt_const _ _) (qs z s hs) hq hρ hη
    refine hc.congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [simLift, simTop]
    rw [Real.rpow_sub_one hqne b, Real.rpow_sub_one hqne (-(1 / 2 - h))]
    generalize g (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) = gv
    generalize pdX g (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) = gx
    generalize pdE g (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) = ge
    generalize 1 - 2 * h * (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 = L at hLne ⊢
    generalize simScale h z (1 - s) ^ b = B
    generalize simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) = P
    generalize simScale h z (1 - s) = q at hqne ⊢
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have lift_rad : ∀ (b : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ∀ ρ z s : ℝ, 0 < ρ → s < 1 →
      HasDerivAt (fun r => simLift h b g r z s) (1 / 2 * simLift h (b - 1) (pdX g) ρ z s) ρ := by
    intro b g hg ρ z s hρ hs
    have hτ : (0:ℝ) < 1 - s := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hq, hη, -, -⟩ := scale z (1 - s) hτ
    have hqne := hq.ne'
    have hc := chain b g hg (fun r => r) (fun _ => z) (fun _ => simScale h z (1 - s)) 1 0 0 ρ
      (hasDerivAt_id' ρ) (hasDerivAt_const _ _) (hasDerivAt_const _ _) hq hρ hη
    refine hc.congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [simLift]
    rw [Real.rpow_sub_one hqne b, Real.rpow_sub_one hqne (-(1 / 2 - h))]
    generalize g (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) = gv
    generalize pdX g (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) = gx
    generalize pdE g (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) = ge
    generalize simScale h z (1 - s) ^ b = B
    generalize simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) = P
    generalize simScale h z (1 - s) = q at hqne ⊢
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have lift_axial : ∀ (b : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ∀ ρ z s : ℝ, 0 < ρ → s < 1 →
      HasDerivAt (fun w => simLift h b g ρ w s)
        (simLift h (b - (1 / 2 - h)) (simZop h b g) ρ z s) z := by
    intro b g hg ρ z s hρ hs
    have hτ : (0:ℝ) < 1 - s := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hq, hη, -, hR5⟩ := scale z (1 - s) hτ
    have hqne := hq.ne'
    have hLne := (Lpos z (1 - s) hτ).ne'
    have hc := chain b g hg (fun _ => ρ) (fun w => w) (fun w => simScale h w (1 - s)) 0 1 _ z
      (hasDerivAt_const _ _) (hasDerivAt_id' z) (qz z s hs) hq hρ hη
    refine hc.congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [simLift, simZop]
    have hbD : simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (b - (1 / 2 - h)) =
        simScale h z (1 - s) ^ b * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hq, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [hR5, Real.rpow_sub_one hqne b, Real.rpow_sub_one hqne (-(1 / 2 - h)), hbD]
    generalize g (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) = gv
    generalize pdX g (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) = gx
    generalize pdE g (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) = ge
    rw [show (1:ℝ) - (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 =
      (1 - 2 * h * (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2) -
        (1 - 2 * h) * (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 by ring]
    generalize 1 - 2 * h * (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 = L at hLne ⊢
    generalize simScale h z (1 - s) ^ b = B
    generalize simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) = P
    generalize simScale h z (1 - s) = q at hqne ⊢
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have lift_smooth : ∀ (b : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => simLift h b g w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2)
        (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ ×ˢ Iio (1 : ℝ))) := by
    intro b g hg
    have hQpos : ∀ w ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ ×ˢ Iio (1 : ℝ)), 0 < simScale h w.2.1 (1 - w.2.2) :=
      fun w hw => (hS.1 _ _ (sub_pos.mpr (show w.2.2 < 1 from hw.2.2))).1
    have hQ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.2.1 (1 - w.2.2))
        (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ ×ˢ Iio (1 : ℝ))) := by
      have hin : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => ((w.2.1, 1 - w.2.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
        (contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_snd).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd))
      refine hS.2.2.2.1.comp hin.contDiffOn ?_
      intro w hw
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, sub_pos.mpr (show w.2.2 < 1 from hw.2.2)⟩
    have hQb := hQ.rpow_const_of_ne (p := b) (fun w hw => (hQpos w hw).ne')
    have hP := hQ.rpow_const_of_ne (p := -(1 / 2 - h)) (fun w hw => (hQpos w hw).ne')
    have hX : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => w.1 / (2 * simScale h w.2.1 (1 - w.2.2)))
        (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ ×ˢ Iio (1 : ℝ))) :=
      contDiffOn_fst.div (contDiffOn_const.mul hQ) (fun w hw => by
        have := hQpos w hw; positivity)
    have hE : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => w.2.1 * simScale h w.2.1 (1 - w.2.2) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)))
        (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ ×ˢ Iio (1 : ℝ))) :=
      (contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_snd).contDiffOn.mul hP
    have hmaps : MapsTo (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => ((w.1 / (2 * simScale h w.2.1 (1 - w.2.2)),
        w.2.1 * simScale h w.2.1 (1 - w.2.2) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) : ℝ × ℝ))
        (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ ×ˢ Iio (1 : ℝ))) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
      intro w hw
      have hτ : 0 < 1 - w.2.2 := sub_pos.mpr (show w.2.2 < 1 from hw.2.2)
      obtain ⟨hq, hη, -, -⟩ := scale w.2.1 (1 - w.2.2) hτ
      have hw1 : 0 < w.1 := hw.1
      have habs := abs_lt.mp ((sq_lt_one_iff_abs_lt_one _).mp hη)
      have hX0 : 0 < w.1 / (2 * simScale h w.2.1 (1 - w.2.2)) := by positivity
      exact ⟨show -ε < w.1 / (2 * simScale h w.2.1 (1 - w.2.2)) by linarith, habs.1, habs.2⟩
    have hcomp := hg.comp (hX.prodMk hE) hmaps
    exact hQb.mul hcomp
  
  have gen : ∀ (c' : ℝ) (e' : ℕ → ℝ) (f' : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(f' n)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) →
      ∀ ρ z s : ℝ, 0 < ρ → s < 1 →
      cylPs (simLiftSum h N c' e' f') ρ z s =
          simLiftSum h N c' (fun n => e' n - 1) (fun n => simTop h (e' n) (f' n)) ρ z s ∧
        cylPr (simLiftSum h N c' e' f') ρ z s =
          simLiftSum h N (c' / 2) (fun n => e' n - 1) (fun n => pdX (f' n)) ρ z s ∧
        cylPz (simLiftSum h N c' e' f') ρ z s =
          simLiftSum h N c' (fun n => e' n - (1 / 2 - h)) (fun n => simZop h (e' n) (f' n)) ρ z s := by
    intro c' e' f' hf' ρ z s hρ hs
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold cylPs simLiftSum
      exact (HasDerivAt.fun_sum (fun n _ =>
        (lift_time (e' n) (f' n) (hf' n) ρ z s hρ hs).const_mul c')).deriv
    · unfold cylPr simLiftSum
      refine ((HasDerivAt.fun_sum (fun n _ =>
        (lift_rad (e' n) (f' n) (hf' n) ρ z s hρ hs).const_mul c')).deriv).trans ?_
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => ?_)
      ring
    · unfold cylPz simLiftSum
      exact (HasDerivAt.fun_sum (fun n _ =>
        (lift_axial (e' n) (f' n) (hf' n) ρ z s hρ hs).const_mul c')).deriv
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), c * simLift h (e n) (f n) w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) _
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun n _ => contDiffOn_const.mul (lift_smooth (e n) (f n) (hf n)))
  · intro ρ z s hρ hs
    obtain ⟨d1, d2, d3⟩ := gen c e f hf ρ z s hρ hs
    
    have closure : ∀ (b : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿g) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(pdX g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(simZop h b g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := by
      intro b g hg
      have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
        hg.fderiv_of_isOpen hOo le_rfl
      have hpd : ∀ (v : ℝ × ℝ) (k : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
          (∀ X η, ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 → k X η = fderiv ℝ (↿g) (X, η) v) →
          ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿k) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
        intro v k hkv
        have hDg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿g))
            (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
          (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hD
        refine hDg.congr (fun w hw => ?_)
        have := hkv w.1 w.2 hw
        exact this
      have s4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(pdX g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
        refine hpd ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) (pdX g) (fun X η hz => ?_)
        have hd : HasFDerivAt (↿g) (fderiv ℝ (↿g) (X, η)) (X, η) :=
          ((hg.contDiffAt (hOo.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
        have hc : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => ((Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) X :=
          (hasDerivAt_id' X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X η)
        exact (hd.comp_hasDerivAt X hc).deriv
      have s5 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(pdE g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
        refine hpd ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) (pdE g) (fun X η hz => ?_)
        have hd : HasFDerivAt (↿g) (fderiv ℝ (↿g) (X, η)) (X, η) :=
          ((hg.contDiffAt (hOo.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
        have hc : HasDerivAt (fun e : ℝ => ((X, e) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) η :=
          (hasDerivAt_const η X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' η)
        exact (hd.comp_hasDerivAt η hc).deriv
      have hX : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => w.1) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
        contDiff_fst.contDiffOn
      have hη : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => w.2) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
        contDiff_snd.contDiffOn
      have hinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => (1 - 2 * h * w.2 ^ 2)⁻¹)
          (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
        refine ((contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_snd.pow 2))).contDiffOn).inv ?_
        intro w hw
        have h1 : -1 < w.2 := hw.2.1
        have h2 : w.2 < 1 := hw.2.2
        have hη2 : w.2 ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
        have : 0 < 1 - 2 * h * w.2 ^ 2 := by nlinarith
        exact ne_of_gt this
      have s9 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(simZop h b g)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
        refine ((((((contDiffOn_const (c := 2 * b)).mul hη).mul hg).add
          (((contDiffOn_const (c := (1 : ℝ))).sub (hη.mul hη)).mul s5)).sub
          ((((contDiffOn_const (c := (2 : ℝ))).mul hη).mul hX).mul s4)).mul hinv)
          |>.congr (fun w _ => ?_)
        obtain ⟨X, η⟩ := w
        change simZop h b g X η = (2 * b * η * g X η + (1 - η * η) * pdE g X η -
          2 * η * X * pdX g X η) * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)⁻¹
        rw [simZop, div_eq_mul_inv]
        ring
      exact ⟨s4, s9⟩
    have hpdXf : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(pdX (f n))) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := fun n =>
      (closure 0 (f n) (hf n)).1
    have hZf : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(simZop h (e n) (f n))) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := fun n =>
      (closure (e n) (f n) (hf n)).2
    refine ⟨d1, d2, ?_, d3, ?_⟩
    · have hev : (fun r => cylPr (simLiftSum h N c e f) r z s) =ᶠ[nhds ρ]
          (fun r => simLiftSum h N (c / 2) (fun n => e n - 1) (fun n => pdX (f n)) r z s) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hρ] with r hr
        exact (gen c e f hf r z s hr hs).2.1
      show deriv (fun r => cylPr (simLiftSum h N c e f) r z s) ρ = _
      rw [hev.deriv_eq, show c / 4 = c / 2 / 2 by ring]
      exact (gen (c / 2) (fun n => e n - 1) (fun n => pdX (f n)) hpdXf ρ z s hρ hs).2.1
    · have hfun : (fun w => cylPz (simLiftSum h N c e f) ρ w s) =
          (fun w => simLiftSum h N c (fun n => e n - (1 / 2 - h))
            (fun n => simZop h (e n) (f n)) ρ w s) := by
        funext w
        exact (gen c e f hf ρ w s hρ hs).2.2
      show deriv (fun w => cylPz (simLiftSum h N c e f) ρ w s) z = _
      rw [hfun]
      exact (gen c (fun n => e n - (1 / 2 - h)) (fun n => simZop h (e n) (f n)) hZf ρ z s hρ hs).2.2

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h ε : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (S : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → SimScaleProps h → 0 < ε → (∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(S n)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) → ∀ (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), s < 1 → 0 < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 → curl3 (fun w => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgAn h n (S n) w s) y = simLiftSum h N (1 / 2) (fun n : ℕ => -1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (fun n => bgVx h n (S n)) (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) (y 2) s • radVec y + simLiftSum h N 1 (fun n : ℕ => -(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (fun n => bgUz (S n)) (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) (y 2) s • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)

signature.name: bg_velocity_frame
signature.statement: ∀ (h ε : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (S : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → SimScaleProps h → 0 < ε → (∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(S n)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) → ∀ (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), s < 1 → 0 < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 → curl3 (fun w => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bgAn h n (S n) w s) y = simLiftSum h N (1 / 2) (fun n : ℕ => -1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (fun n => bgVx h n (S n)) (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) (y 2) s • radVec y + simLiftSum h N 1 (fun n : ℕ => -(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (fun n => bgUz (S n)) (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) (y 2) s • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h ε N S hh0 hh1 hS hε hSm y s hs hy
  have hq : 0 < simScale h (y 2) (1 - s) := (hS.1 (y 2) (1 - s) (by linarith)).1
  have hρ : (0 : ℝ) < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 := hy
  
  have hdiff : ∀ n : ℕ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => bgAn h n (S n) w s) y := by
    intro n
    have hsub : Ici (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 :=
      prod_mono (fun x hx => by simp only [mem_Ici] at hx; simp only [mem_Ioi]; linarith)
        subset_rfl
    have hsm := (bg_field_smooth_div h n (S n) hS ((hSm n).mono hsub)).1
    have hO : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
    have hca : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (↿(bgAn h n (S n))) (y, s) :=
      hsm.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds (show (y, s) ∈ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} from hs))
    have hc := hca.comp y ((contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt)
    exact hc.differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  
  have hadd : ∀ (f g : ℝ³ → ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ f y → DifferentiableAt ℝ g y →
      curl3 (fun w => f w + g w) y = curl3 f y + curl3 g y := by
    intro f g hf hg
    simp only [curl3, fderiv_fun_add hf hg, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, PiLp.add_apply]
    module
  have hsum : ∀ (t : Finset ℕ), curl3 (fun w => ∑ n ∈ t, bgAn h n (S n) w s) y =
      ∑ n ∈ t, curl3 (fun w => bgAn h n (S n) w s) y := by
    intro t
    induction t using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp [curl3]
    | @insert a t ha ih =>
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => ∑ n ∈ t, bgAn h n (S n) w s) y :=
        DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun n _ => hdiff n)
      simp only [Finset.sum_insert ha]
      rw [hadd (fun w => bgAn h a (S a) w s) (fun w => ∑ n ∈ t, bgAn h n (S n) w s) (hdiff a) hd,
        ih]
  
  have key : ∀ n : ℕ, curl3 (fun w => bgAn h n (S n) w s) y =
      (1 / 2 * simLift h (-1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (bgVx h n (S n)) (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) (y 2) s) •
          radVec y +
      (1 * simLift h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (bgUz (S n)) (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) (y 2) s) •
        EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) := by
    intro n
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := bgAn_curl_identities h ε n (S n) hh0 hh1 hS hε (hSm n) y s hs hy
    have hL1 : simLift h (-1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (bgVx h n (S n)) (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) (y 2) s =
        simScale h (y 2) (1 - s) ^ (-1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) *
          bgVx h n (S n) (simX h y s) (simEta h y s) := rfl
    have hL2 : simLift h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (bgUz (S n)) (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) (y 2) s =
        simScale h (y 2) (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) *
          bgUz (S n) (simX h y s) (simEta h y s) := rfl
    have hX : simX h y s = (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) / (2 * simScale h (y 2) (1 - s)) := rfl
    rw [hL1, hL2]
    have hc0 : 1 / 2 * (simScale h (y 2) (1 - s) ^ (-1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) *
          bgVx h n (S n) (simX h y s) (simEta h y s)) * (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) =
        simScale h (y 2) (1 - s) ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) *
          (simX h y s * bgVx h n (S n) (simX h y s) (simEta h y s)) := by
      generalize bgVx h n (S n) (simX h y s) (simEta h y s) = V
      have hqne : simScale h (y 2) (1 - s) ≠ 0 := hq.ne'
      rw [hX, Real.rpow_add hq, Real.rpow_neg_one]
      field_simp
    generalize curl3 (fun w => bgAn h n (S n) w s) y = v at h1 h2 h3 ⊢
    generalize 1 / 2 * (simScale h (y 2) (1 - s) ^ (-1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) *
          bgVx h n (S n) (simX h y s) (simEta h y s)) = c0 at hc0 ⊢
    generalize simScale h (y 2) (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) *
          bgUz (S n) (simX h y s) (simEta h y s) = g at h1 ⊢
    generalize simScale h (y 2) (1 - s) ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) *
          (simX h y s * bgVx h n (S n) (simX h y s) (simEta h y s)) = R at h2 hc0
    have i2 : v 0 * y 0 + v 1 * y 1 = R := by
      rw [← h2]
      simp only [radVec, inner_add_right, inner_smul_right, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right,
        conj_trivial, one_mul]
      ring
    have i3 : y 0 * v 1 - y 1 * v 0 = 0 := by
      rw [← h3]
      simp only [azVec, inner_add_right, inner_smul_right, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right,
        conj_trivial, one_mul]
      ring
    have e0 : v 0 = c0 * y 0 := by
      have hm : (v 0 - c0 * y 0) * (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) = 0 := by
        linear_combination y 0 * i2 - y 1 * i3 - y 0 * hc0
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hm with hm | hm
      · linarith
      · linarith
    have e1 : v 1 = c0 * y 1 := by
      have hm : (v 1 - c0 * y 1) * (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) = 0 := by
        linear_combination y 1 * i2 + y 0 * i3 - y 1 * hc0
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hm with hm | hm
      · linarith
      · linarith
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · simp [radVec, e0]
    · simp [radVec, e1]
    · simp [radVec, h1]
  rw [hsum, Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => key n), Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_smul,
    ← Finset.sum_smul]
  rfl

subgoal_signatures.name: bgAn_curl_identities
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h ε : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (S : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → SimScaleProps h → 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿S) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → (curl3 (fun w => bgAn h n S w t) x) 2 = simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * bgUz S (simX h x t) (simEta h x t) ∧ inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => bgAn h n S w t) x) (radVec x) = simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * (simX h x t * bgVx h n S (simX h x t) (simEta h x t)) ∧ inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => bgAn h n S w t) x) (azVec x) = (0 : ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro u p α β γ P hα hβ hγ hP hu hp x t ht hx
  have hΩo : IsOpen (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ ×ˢ Iio (1 : ℝ))) :=
    (isOpen_Ioi (a := (0 : ℝ))).prod ((isOpen_univ (X := ℝ)).prod (isOpen_Iio (a := (1 : ℝ))))
  
  have hpj : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (v : ℝ³), (EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) v = v i := fun i v => rfl
  have hc : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (y : ℝ³), HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ³ => w i)
      (EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) y := fun i y => PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply 2 y i
  obtain ⟨Dσ, hDσ⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ³ → (ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ), ∀ y v, D y v = 2 * y 0 * v 0 + 2 * y 1 * v 1 :=
    ⟨fun y => (2 * y 0) • (EuclideanSpace.proj 0 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) +
        (2 * y 1) • (EuclideanSpace.proj 1 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ),
      fun y v => by simp [hpj]; try ring⟩
  have hσ : ∀ y : ℝ³, HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ³ => w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (Dσ y) y := by
    intro y
    have h := ((hc 0 y).pow 2).add ((hc 1 y).pow 2)
    convert h using 1
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
    rw [hDσ]; simp [hpj]; try ring
  have hΨ : ∀ (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ³ => ((w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2, w 2, s) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))
      ((Dσ y).prod ((EuclideanSpace.proj 2 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).prod (0 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ))) y :=
    fun y s => (hσ y).prodMk ((hc 2 y).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_const s y))
  
  have slice : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ ×ˢ Iio (1 : ℝ))) →
      ∀ ρ z s : ℝ, 0 < ρ → s < 1 →
      HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2)
        (fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) (ρ, z, s)) (ρ, z, s) ∧
      cylPr g ρ z s = fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) (ρ, z, s) (1, 0, 0) ∧
      cylPz g ρ z s = fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) (ρ, z, s) (0, 1, 0) ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun s' => g ρ z s') (cylPs g ρ z s) s := by
    intro g hg ρ z s hρ hs
    have hmem : ((ρ, z, s) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ ×ˢ Iio (1 : ℝ)) :=
      ⟨hρ, mem_univ _, hs⟩
    have hD : HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2)
        (fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) (ρ, z, s)) (ρ, z, s) :=
      ((hg.contDiffAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have k1 : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => g r z s)
        (fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) (ρ, z, s) (1, 0, 0)) ρ := by
      have hf : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => ((r, z, s) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) ρ :=
        (hasDerivAt_id' ρ).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_const ρ z).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const ρ s))
      have := hD.comp_hasDerivAt ρ hf
      exact this
    have k2 : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => g ρ r s)
        (fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) (ρ, z, s) (0, 1, 0)) z := by
      have hf : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => ((ρ, r, s) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) z :=
        (hasDerivAt_const z ρ).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_id' z).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const z s))
      have := hD.comp_hasDerivAt z hf
      exact this
    have k3 : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => g ρ z r)
        (fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) (ρ, z, s) (0, 0, 1)) s := by
      have hf : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => ((ρ, z, r) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) s :=
        (hasDerivAt_const s ρ).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_const s z).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' s))
      have := hD.comp_hasDerivAt s hf
      exact this
    refine ⟨hD, k1.deriv, k2.deriv, ?_⟩
    have e3 : cylPs g ρ z s = fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) (ρ, z, s) (0, 0, 1) :=
      k3.deriv
    rw [e3]; exact k3
  
  have cylsm : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ ×ˢ Iio (1 : ℝ))) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => cylPr g w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ ×ˢ Iio (1 : ℝ))) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => cylPz g w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ ×ˢ Iio (1 : ℝ))) := by
    intro g hg
    have hdf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2))
        (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ ×ˢ Iio (1 : ℝ))) :=
      hg.fderiv_of_isOpen hΩo (by simp)
    constructor
    · refine (hdf.clm_apply (contDiffOn_const (c := ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))))).congr ?_
      rintro ⟨ρ, z, s⟩ ⟨hρ, -, hs⟩
      exact (slice g hg ρ z s hρ hs).2.1
    · refine (hdf.clm_apply (contDiffOn_const (c := ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))))).congr ?_
      rintro ⟨ρ, z, s⟩ ⟨hρ, -, hs⟩
      exact (slice g hg ρ z s hρ hs).2.2.1
  
  have lift : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ ×ˢ Iio (1 : ℝ))) →
      ∀ (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), 0 < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 → s < 1 →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ => g (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) s) y ∧
      ∀ v : ℝ³, fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ => g (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) s) y v =
        2 * cylPr g (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) (y 2) s * (y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1) +
          cylPz g (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) (y 2) s * v 2 := by
    intro g hg y s hy hs
    have hmem : ((y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2, y 2, s) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ ×ˢ Iio (1 : ℝ)) :=
      ⟨hy, mem_univ _, hs⟩
    have hGa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2, y 2, s) :=
      hg.contDiffAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hmem)
    have hΨs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ => ((w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2, w 2, s) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hcd := hGa.comp y hΨs.contDiffAt
    refine ⟨hcd, fun v => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hD, e1, e2, -⟩ := slice g hg _ (y 2) s hy hs
    have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ³ => g (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) s)
        ((fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2, y 2, s)).comp
          ((Dσ y).prod ((EuclideanSpace.proj 2 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).prod (0 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)))) y := by
      have := hD.comp y (hΨ y s)
      exact this
    have hv : ((Dσ y).prod ((EuclideanSpace.proj 2 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).prod (0 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ))) v =
        (2 * (y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1)) • ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) + v 2 • ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) := by
      refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_) <;> simp [hDσ, hpj] <;> ring
    rw [hcomp.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hv, map_add, map_smul, map_smul,
      smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, ← e1, ← e2]
    ring
  
  have hess : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ ×ˢ Iio (1 : ℝ))) →
      ∀ (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), 0 < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 → s < 1 → ∀ v : ℝ³,
      fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ => fderiv ℝ (fun w' : ℝ³ => g (w' 0 ^ 2 + w' 1 ^ 2) (w' 2) s) w v) y v =
        2 * (2 * cylPr (cylPr g) (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) (y 2) s * (y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1) +
            cylPz (cylPr g) (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) (y 2) s * v 2) * (y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1) +
          2 * cylPr g (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) (y 2) s * (v 0 * v 0 + v 1 * v 1) +
          (2 * cylPr (cylPz g) (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) (y 2) s * (y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1) +
            cylPz (cylPz g) (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) (y 2) s * v 2) * v 2 := by
    intro g hg y s hy hs v
    obtain ⟨h1sm, h2sm⟩ := cylsm g hg
    have hUy : {w : ℝ³ | 0 < w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2} ∈ nhds y :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).mem_nhds hy
    have hev : (fun w : ℝ³ => fderiv ℝ (fun w' : ℝ³ => g (w' 0 ^ 2 + w' 1 ^ 2) (w' 2) s) w v) =ᶠ[nhds y]
        fun w => 2 * cylPr g (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) s * (w 0 * v 0 + w 1 * v 1) +
          cylPz g (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) s * v 2 := by
      filter_upwards [hUy] with w hw
      exact (lift g hg w s hw hs).2 v
    obtain ⟨d1, f1⟩ := lift (cylPr g) h1sm y s hy hs
    obtain ⟨d2, f2⟩ := lift (cylPz g) h2sm y s hy hs
    have hlin : HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ³ => w 0 * v 0 + w 1 * v 1)
        (v 0 • (EuclideanSpace.proj 0 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) + v 1 • (EuclideanSpace.proj 1 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)) y :=
      ((hc 0 y).mul_const (v 0)).add ((hc 1 y).mul_const (v 1))
    have H := ((((d1.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt.const_mul (2 : ℝ)).mul hlin).add
      ((d2.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt.mul_const (v 2))).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    rw [H.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, f1, f2, hpj]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨Lr, hLr⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³, ∀ v, L v = radVec v :=
    ⟨(EuclideanSpace.proj 0 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) +
      (EuclideanSpace.proj 1 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)),
      fun v => by simp [radVec, hpj]⟩
  obtain ⟨La, hLa⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³, ∀ v, L v = azVec v :=
    ⟨-(EuclideanSpace.proj 1 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) +
      (EuclideanSpace.proj 0 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)),
      fun v => by simp [azVec, hpj]⟩
  have eLr : radVec = ⇑Lr := funext fun w => (hLr w).symm
  have eLa : azVec = ⇑La := funext fun w => (hLa w).symm
  have hrad : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt radVec Lr y := fun y => by rw [eLr]; exact Lr.hasFDerivAt
  have haz : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt azVec La y := fun y => by rw [eLa]; exact La.hasFDerivAt
  have hRsm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ radVec := by rw [eLr]; exact Lr.contDiff
  have hAsm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ azVec := by rw [eLa]; exact La.contDiff
  
  have frame : ∀ (A B C : ℝ³ → ℝ) (A' B' C' : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (y : ℝ³),
      HasFDerivAt A A' y → HasFDerivAt B B' y → HasFDerivAt C C' y →
      HasFDerivAt (fun w => A w • radVec w + B w • azVec w + C w • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))
        (A y • Lr + A'.smulRight (radVec y) + (B y • La + B'.smulRight (azVec y)) +
          C'.smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))) y :=
    fun A B C A' B' C' y hA hB hC =>
      ((hA.smul (hrad y)).add (hB.smul (haz y))).add (hC.smul_const _)
  have frameV : ∀ (A B C : ℝ³ → ℝ) (y v : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ A y → DifferentiableAt ℝ B y →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ C y →
      fderiv ℝ (fun w => A w • radVec w + B w • azVec w + C w • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) y v =
        A y • radVec v + fderiv ℝ A y v • radVec y + (B y • azVec v + fderiv ℝ B y v • azVec y) +
          fderiv ℝ C y v • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) := by
    intro A B C y v hA hB hC
    rw [(frame A B C _ _ _ y hA.hasFDerivAt hB.hasFDerivAt hC.hasFDerivAt).fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, hLr, hLa]
  
  have hlap : ∀ (g : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (z : ℝ³), Δ g z = ∑ i : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) z (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) := by
    intro g z
    have h := congrFun (InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_orthonormalBasis g
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)) z
    rw [h]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  have hgrad : ∀ (g : ℝ³ → ℝ) (z : ℝ³), gradient g z = ∑ i : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ g z (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) := by
    intro g z
    have h := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr' (gradient g z)
    rw [← h]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    simp only [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
    congr 1
    rw [real_inner_comm]
    exact InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply
  
  have hU : {w : ℝ³ | 0 < w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2} ∈ nhds x :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).mem_nhds hx
  have hevF : (fun y => u y t) =ᶠ[nhds x] (fun w : ℝ³ => α (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • radVec w +
      β (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • azVec w +
      γ (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards [hU] with w hw
    exact hu w t ht hw
  have hevP : (fun y => p y t) =ᶠ[nhds x] (fun w : ℝ³ => P (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t) := by
    filter_upwards [hU] with w hw
    exact hp w t ht hw
  have hevT : (fun s => u x s) =ᶠ[nhds t] (fun s => α (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) (x 2) s • radVec x +
      β (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) (x 2) s • azVec x +
      γ (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) (x 2) s • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds ht] with s hs
    exact hu x s hs hx
  have hux := hu x t ht hx
  
  have T1 : deriv (fun s => u x s) t = cylPs α (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) (x 2) t • radVec x +
      cylPs β (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) (x 2) t • azVec x +
      cylPs γ (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) (x 2) t • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) := by
    rw [hevT.deriv_eq]
    exact ((((slice α hα (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) (x 2) t hx ht).2.2.2.smul_const (radVec x)).add
      ((slice β hβ (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) (x 2) t hx ht).2.2.2.smul_const (azVec x))).add
      ((slice γ hγ (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) (x 2) t hx ht).2.2.2.smul_const
        (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)))).deriv
  
  obtain ⟨cα, fα⟩ := lift α hα x t hx ht
  obtain ⟨cβ, fβ⟩ := lift β hβ x t hx ht
  obtain ⟨cγ, fγ⟩ := lift γ hγ x t hx ht
  obtain ⟨-, fP⟩ := lift P hP x t hx ht
  have hessα := hess α hα x t hx ht
  have hessβ := hess β hβ x t hx ht
  have hessγ := hess γ hγ x t hx ht
  have dα := cα.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have dβ := cβ.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have dγ := cγ.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have dDα : ∀ v : ℝ³, DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun w : ℝ³ => fderiv ℝ (fun w' : ℝ³ => α (w' 0 ^ 2 + w' 1 ^ 2) (w' 2) t) w v) x :=
    fun v => ((cα.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by simp)).differentiableAt (by simp)).clm_apply
      (differentiableAt_const v)
  have dDβ : ∀ v : ℝ³, DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun w : ℝ³ => fderiv ℝ (fun w' : ℝ³ => β (w' 0 ^ 2 + w' 1 ^ 2) (w' 2) t) w v) x :=
    fun v => ((cβ.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by simp)).differentiableAt (by simp)).clm_apply
      (differentiableAt_const v)
  have dDγ : ∀ v : ℝ³, DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun w : ℝ³ => fderiv ℝ (fun w' : ℝ³ => γ (w' 0 ^ 2 + w' 1 ^ 2) (w' 2) t) w v) x :=
    fun v => ((cγ.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by simp)).differentiableAt (by simp)).clm_apply
      (differentiableAt_const v)
  
  have hFsm : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ => α (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • radVec w +
      β (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • azVec w +
      γ (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) x :=
    ((cα.smul hRsm.contDiffAt).add (cβ.smul hAsm.contDiffAt)).add (cγ.smul contDiffAt_const)
  have hDF := (hFsm.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by simp)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hsec : ∀ v : ℝ³, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ => α (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • radVec w +
      β (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • azVec w +
      γ (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))) x v v =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ => α (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • radVec w +
      β (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • azVec w +
      γ (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) y v) x v := by
    intro v
    rw [fderiv_clm_apply hDF (differentiableAt_const v)]
    simp
  have hfd : fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) =ᶠ[nhds x] fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ =>
      α (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • radVec w + β (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • azVec w +
      γ (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) :=
    hevF.eventuallyEq_nhds.mono fun w hw => hw.fderiv_eq
  have hΔ : Δ (fun y => u y t) x = ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ =>
      α (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • radVec w + β (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • azVec w +
      γ (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) y
        (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [hlap, hfd.fderiv_eq]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hsec _)
  have hev2 : ∀ v : ℝ³, (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ =>
      α (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • radVec w + β (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • azVec w +
      γ (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) y v) =ᶠ[nhds x]
      (fun w : ℝ³ => α (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • radVec v +
        fderiv ℝ (fun w' : ℝ³ => α (w' 0 ^ 2 + w' 1 ^ 2) (w' 2) t) w v • radVec w +
        (β (w 0 ^ 2 + w 1 ^ 2) (w 2) t • azVec v +
          fderiv ℝ (fun w' : ℝ³ => β (w' 0 ^ 2 + w' 1 ^ 2) (w' 2) t) w v • azVec w) +
        fderiv ℝ (fun w' : ℝ³ => γ (w' 0 ^ 2 + w' 1 ^ 2) (w' 2) t) w v •
          EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) := by
    intro v
    filter_upwards [hU] with w hw
    exact frameV _ _ _ w v ((lift α hα w t hw ht).1.differentiableAt (by simp))
      ((lift β hβ w t hw ht).1.differentiableAt (by simp))
      ((lift γ hγ w t hw ht).1.differentiableAt (by simp))
  have lapEq := fun v : ℝ³ =>
    (((((dα.hasFDerivAt.smul_const (radVec v)).add ((dDα v).hasFDerivAt.smul (hrad x))).add
      ((dβ.hasFDerivAt.smul_const (azVec v)).add ((dDβ v).hasFDerivAt.smul (haz x)))).add
      ((dDγ v).hasFDerivAt.smul_const (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)))).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (hev2 v)).fderiv
  
  unfold nsResidual
  rw [T1, hevF.fderiv_eq, frameV _ _ _ x (u x t) dα dβ dγ, hΔ, hgrad, hevP.fderiv_eq]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, lapEq, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, hLr, hLa, fα, fβ, fγ, fP, hessα, hessβ, hessγ]
  rw [hux]
  ext k
  fin_cases k <;> simp [radVec, azVec, frRadV, frThV, frZV, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] <;> ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ρ z s : ℝ), 0 < simScale h z (1 - s) → (∀ n : ℕ, N < n → S n = (fun _ _ => 0) ∧ G n = (fun _ _ => 0) ∧ W n = (fun _ _ => 0)) → frRadV ρ (simLiftSum h N (1 / 2) (fun n : ℕ => -1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (fun n => bgVx h n (S n)) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N (1 / 2) (fun n : ℕ => -1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1) (fun n => simTop h (-1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (bgVx h n (S n))) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N (1 / 2 / 2) (fun n : ℕ => -1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1) (fun n => pdX (bgVx h n (S n))) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N (1 / 2 / 4) (fun n : ℕ => -1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1 - 1) (fun n => pdX (pdX (bgVx h n (S n)))) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N (1 / 2) (fun n : ℕ => -1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h)) (fun n => simZop h (-1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (bgVx h n (S n))) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N (1 / 2) (fun n : ℕ => -1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h) - (1 / 2 - h)) (fun n => simZop h (-1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h)) (simZop h (-1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (bgVx h n (S n)))) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N 1 (fun n : ℕ => -(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) G ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N 1 (fun n : ℕ => -(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (fun n => bgUz (S n)) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N (1 / 2) (fun n : ℕ => -(1 + 2 * h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1) (fun n => pdX (W n)) ρ z s) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(2 + 2 * h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) * bgResRad h S G W k (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)))

signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ρ z s : ℝ), 0 < simScale h z (1 - s) → (∀ n : ℕ, N < n → S n = (fun _ _ => 0) ∧ G n = (fun _ _ => 0) ∧ W n = (fun _ _ => 0)) → frRadV ρ (simLiftSum h N (1 / 2) (fun n : ℕ => -1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (fun n => bgVx h n (S n)) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N (1 / 2) (fun n : ℕ => -1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1) (fun n => simTop h (-1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (bgVx h n (S n))) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N (1 / 2 / 2) (fun n : ℕ => -1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1) (fun n => pdX (bgVx h n (S n))) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N (1 / 2 / 4) (fun n : ℕ => -1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1 - 1) (fun n => pdX (pdX (bgVx h n (S n)))) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N (1 / 2) (fun n : ℕ => -1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h)) (fun n => simZop h (-1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (bgVx h n (S n))) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N (1 / 2) (fun n : ℕ => -1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h) - (1 / 2 - h)) (fun n => simZop h (-1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h)) (simZop h (-1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (bgVx h n (S n)))) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N 1 (fun n : ℕ => -(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) G ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N 1 (fun n : ℕ => -(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (fun n => bgUz (S n)) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N (1 / 2) (fun n : ℕ => -(1 + 2 * h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1) (fun n => pdX (W n)) ρ z s) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(2 + 2 * h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) * bgResRad h S G W k (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h N S G W ρ z s hq hvan
  have R1 : ∀ (q e : ℝ), 0 < q → q * q ^ (e - 1) = q ^ e := by
    intro q e hq
    have he : q ^ e = q ^ (1 + (e - 1)) := by congr 1; ring
    rw [he, Real.rpow_add hq, Real.rpow_one]
  have rsub : ∀ a b : ℕ, a ≤ b → Finset.range a ⊆ Finset.range b := fun a b hab =>
    Finset.range_subset.mpr (fun x hx => Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  have trunc : ∀ (L : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℝ), N + 1 ≤ L → (∀ n : ℕ, N < n → F n = 0) →
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), F n = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range L, F k := by
    intro L F hL hF
    refine Finset.sum_subset (rsub _ _ hL) ?_
    intro x _ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hx
    exact hF x (by omega)
  have shift : ∀ (q : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (e : ℕ → ℝ) (y : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ n : ℕ, e n = β + 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h) →
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range L, q ^ (e n) * y n =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (L + 1), q ^ (β + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) * (if 1 ≤ k then y (k - 1) else 0) := by
    intro q L β e y he
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
    have h0 : (if 1 ≤ (0:ℕ) then y (0 - 1) else 0) = 0 := if_neg (by norm_num)
    rw [h0, mul_zero, add_zero]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => ?_)

by
  intro h N S G W ρ z s hq hvan
  
  have hr : ∀ (q e : ℝ), 0 < q → q ^ (e - 1) * q = q ^ e := by
    intro q e hq
    rw [Real.rpow_sub_one hq.ne']
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hq.ne'
  
  have cauchy : ∀ (q α β γ : ℝ) (x y : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < q → α + β = γ → (∀ n, N < n → x n = 0) →
      (∀ n, N < n → y n = 0) →
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), q ^ (α + 2 * (i : ℝ) * h) * x i) *
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), q ^ (β + 2 * (j : ℝ) * h) * y j) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), q ^ (γ + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) *
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), x i * y (k - i) := by
    intro q α β γ x y hq hαβ hx hy
    obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ,
        F = fun i j => q ^ (γ + 2 * ((i + j : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) * (x i * y j) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hL : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), q ^ (α + 2 * (i : ℝ) * h) * x i) *
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), q ^ (β + 2 * (j : ℝ) * h) * y j) =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), F i j := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_))
      rw [hF, ← hαβ]
      beta_reduce
      rw [show α + β + 2 * ((i + j : ℕ) : ℝ) * h = (α + 2 * (i : ℝ) * h) + (β + 2 * (j : ℝ) * h) by
        push_cast; ring, Real.rpow_add hq (α + 2 * (i : ℝ) * h)]
      ring
    have hR : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), q ^ (γ + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) *
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), x i * y (k - i) =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), F i (k - i) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
      have hik : i + (k - i) = k := Nat.add_sub_of_le (Finset.mem_range_succ_iff.mp hi)
      rw [hF]
      simp only [hik]
    rw [hL, hR, Finset.sum_range_diag_flip]
    symm
    calc ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1 - m), F m j
        = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1 - m), F m j := by
          symm
          refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr (by omega)) ?_
          intro m _ hm
          have hNm : N < m := by
            rw [Finset.mem_range] at hm; omega
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j _ => ?_)
          rw [hF]; simp [hx m hNm]
      _ = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), F m j := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m hm => ?_)
          have hm' := Finset.mem_range.mp hm
          symm
          refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr (by omega)) ?_
          intro j _ hj
          have hNj : N < j := by
            rw [Finset.mem_range] at hj; omega
          rw [hF]; simp [hy j hNj]
  
  have single : ∀ (q β : ℝ) (y : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ n, N < n → y n = 0) →
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), q ^ (β + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * y n =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), q ^ (β + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) * y k := by
    intro q β y hy
    refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr (by omega)) ?_
    intro k _ hk
    have hNk : N < k := by rw [Finset.mem_range] at hk; omega
    simp [hy k hNk]
  have shift : ∀ (q β : ℝ) (y : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ n, N < n → y n = 0) →
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), q ^ (β + 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h) * y n =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), q ^ (β + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) *
        (if 1 ≤ k then y (k - 1) else 0) := by
    intro q β y hy
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ' _ (2 * N + 2)]
    have e : ∀ k : ℕ, q ^ (β + 2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) * (if 1 ≤ k + 1 then y (k + 1 - 1) else 0) =
        q ^ (β + 2 * ((k : ℝ) + 1) * h) * y k := by
      intro k
      rw [if_pos (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      push_cast; ring
    rw [if_neg (by norm_num : ¬ (1:ℕ) ≤ 0), mul_zero, add_zero]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => e k)]
    refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr (by omega)) ?_
    intro k _ hk
    have hNk : N < k := by rw [Finset.mem_range] at hk; omega
    simp [hy k hNk]
  
  have gen : ∀ (q X : ℝ) (V U g gR gRR T Z ZZ : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < q → ρ = 2 * q * X →
      (∀ n, N < n → V n = 0) → (∀ n, N < n → U n = 0) → (∀ n, N < n → g n + X * gR n = 0) →
      (∀ n, N < n → Z n = 0) → (∀ n, N < n → ZZ n = 0) →
      (∀ n, N < n → T n - 2 * (X * gRR n + 2 * gR n) = 0) →
      frThV ρ (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 / 2 * (q ^ (-1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * V n))
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 * (q ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * g n))
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 * (q ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1) * T n))
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 / 2 * (q ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1) * gR n))
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 / 4 * (q ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1 - 1) * gRR n))
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 * (q ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h)) * Z n))
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
          1 * (q ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h) - (1 / 2 - h)) * ZZ n))
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 * (q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * U n)) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), q ^ (-(2 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) *
        (T k - 2 * (X * gRR k + 2 * gR k) +
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (V i * (g (k - i) + X * gR (k - i)) + U i * Z (k - i)) -
          (if 1 ≤ k then ZZ (k - 1) else 0)) := by
    intro q X V U g gR gRR T Z ZZ hq hρ hV hU hY hZ hZZ hT
    have hfr : ∀ a b bS bR bRR bZ bZZ gg : ℝ, frThV ρ a b bS bR bRR bZ bZZ gg =
        (bS - (4 * ρ * bRR + 8 * bR)) + (2 * a) * (ρ * bR + b) + gg * bZ - bZZ := by
      intro a b bS bR bRR bZ bZZ gg; unfold frThV; ring
    rw [hfr]
    have hD : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 * (q ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1) * T n)) -
        (4 * ρ * (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 / 4 * (q ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1 - 1) * gRR n)) +
          8 * (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 / 2 * (q ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1) * gR n))) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), q ^ (-(2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) *
          (T n - 2 * (X * gRR n + 2 * gR n)) := by
      rw [hρ, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => ?_)
      rw [show -(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1 = -(2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h by ring]
      linear_combination (-2 * X * gRR n) * hr q (-(2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) hq
    have hB : ρ * (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 / 2 * (q ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1) * gR n)) +
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 * (q ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * g n)) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), q ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * (g n + X * gR n) := by
      rw [hρ, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => ?_)
      linear_combination (X * gR n) * hr q (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) hq
    have hA : 2 * (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 / 2 * (q ^ (-1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * V n)) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), q ^ (-1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * V n := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => ?_)
      ring
    have hC1 : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 * (q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * U n)) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * U n := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => ?_)
      rw [one_mul]
    have hC2 : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 * (q ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h)) * Z n)) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), q ^ (-(3 / 2) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Z n := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => ?_)
      rw [show -(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h) = -(3 / 2) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h by ring, one_mul]
    have hE : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
          1 * (q ^ (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h) - (1 / 2 - h)) * ZZ n)) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), q ^ (-(2 + h) + 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h) * ZZ n := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => ?_)
      rw [show -(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h) - (1 / 2 - h) =
        -(2 + h) + 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h by ring, one_mul]
    rw [hD, hB, hA, hC1, hC2, hE]
    have r1 := single q (-(2 + h)) (fun n => T n - 2 * (X * gRR n + 2 * gR n)) hT
    have r2 := cauchy q (-1) (-(1 + h)) (-(2 + h)) V (fun j => g j + X * gR j) hq (by ring) hV hY

    rw [r1, r2, r3, r4]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    ring
  
  have hz : ∀ b : ℝ, simZop h b (fun _ _ => (0:ℝ)) = fun _ _ => 0 := by
    intro b; funext X η; simp [simZop, pdX, pdE]
  
  obtain ⟨q, hqd⟩ : ∃ q, q = simScale h z (1 - s) := ⟨_, rfl⟩

  obtain ⟨η, hηd⟩ : ∃ η, η = z * q ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  simp only [← hXd, ← hηd]
  have h2q : (2:ℝ) * q ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hρ : ρ = 2 * q * X := by rw [hXd]; field_simp
  refine (gen q X (fun n => bgVx h n (S n) X η) (fun n => bgUz (S n) X η) (fun n => G n X η)
    (fun n => pdX (G n) X η) (fun n => pdX (pdX (G n)) X η)
    (fun n => simTop h (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (G n) X η)
    (fun n => simZop h (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (G n) X η)
    (fun n => simZop h (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h))
      (simZop h (-(1 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (G n)) X η)
    hq hρ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_).trans ?_
  · intro n hn; beta_reduce
    obtain ⟨hS, -, -⟩ := hvan n hn
    rw [hS]; simp [bgVx, bgUz, pdX, pdE]
  · intro n hn; beta_reduce
    obtain ⟨hS, -, -⟩ := hvan n hn
    rw [hS]; simp [bgUz, pdX]
  · intro n hn; beta_reduce
    obtain ⟨-, hG, -⟩ := hvan n hn
    rw [hG]; simp [pdX]
  · intro n hn; beta_reduce
    obtain ⟨-, hG, -⟩ := hvan n hn
    rw [hG, hz]
  · intro n hn; beta_reduce
    obtain ⟨-, hG, -⟩ := hvan n hn
    rw [hG, hz, hz]
  · intro n hn; beta_reduce
    obtain ⟨-, hG, -⟩ := hvan n hn
    rw [hG]; simp [simTop, pdX, pdE]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    rfl
