signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ρ z s : ℝ), 0 < simScale h z (1 - s) → (∀ n : ℕ, N < n → S n = (fun _ _ => 0) ∧ G n = (fun _ _ => 0) ∧ W n = (fun _ _ => 0)) → frZV ρ (simLiftSum h N (1 / 2) (fun n : ℕ => -1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (fun n => bgVx h n (S n)) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N 1 (fun n : ℕ => -(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (fun n => bgUz (S n)) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N 1 (fun n : ℕ => -(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1) (fun n => simTop h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (bgUz (S n))) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N (1 / 2) (fun n : ℕ => -(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1) (fun n => pdX (bgUz (S n))) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N (1 / 4) (fun n : ℕ => -(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1 - 1) (fun n => pdX (pdX (bgUz (S n)))) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N 1 (fun n : ℕ => -(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h)) (fun n => simZop h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (bgUz (S n))) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N 1 (fun n : ℕ => -(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h) - (1 / 2 - h)) (fun n => simZop h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h)) (simZop h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (bgUz (S n)))) ρ z s) (simLiftSum h N 1 (fun n : ℕ => -(1 + 2 * h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h)) (fun n => simZop h (-(1 + 2 * h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (W n)) ρ z s) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) * bgResZ h S G W k (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h)))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h N S G W ρ z s hq hvan
  
  have key : ∀ (q : ℝ) (T P u1 u2 ZZ v u Z : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < q →
      (∀ n : ℕ, N < n → T n = 0 ∧ P n = 0 ∧ u1 n = 0 ∧ u2 n = 0 ∧ ZZ n = 0 ∧ v n = 0 ∧ u n = 0 ∧
        Z n = 0) →
      frZV ρ (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 / 2 * (q ^ (-1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * v n))
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 * (q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * u n))
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 * (q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1) * T n))
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 / 2 * (q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1) * u1 n))
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 / 4 * (q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1 - 1) * u2 n))
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 * (q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h)) * Z n))
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
          1 * (q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h) - (1 / 2 - h)) * ZZ n))
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 * (q ^ (-(1 + 2 * h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h)) * P n)) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) *
        (T k + P k - 2 * (ρ / (2 * q) * u2 k + u1 k)
          + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (ρ / (2 * q) * v i * u1 (k - i) + u i * Z (k - i))
          - (if 1 ≤ k then ZZ (k - 1) else 0)) := by
    intro q T P u1 u2 ZZ v u Z hq hs
    have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := hq.ne'
    
    have H1 : ∀ (g : ℕ → ℝ) (K : ℕ), N + 1 ≤ K → (∀ n : ℕ, N < n → g n = 0) →
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), g n = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, g k := by
      intro g K hK hg
      apply Finset.sum_subset
      · intro x hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hx ⊢
        omega
      · intro x hx hx'
        simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hx hx'
        exact hg x (by omega)
    have H2 : ∀ g : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n : ℕ, N < n → g n = 0) →
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), g n =
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), (if 1 ≤ k then g (k - 1) else 0) := by
      intro g hg
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ' _ (2 * N + 2)]
      have e1 : ∀ k : ℕ, (if 1 ≤ k + 1 then g (k + 1 - 1) else 0) = g k := fun k => by simp
      simp only [e1]
      rw [if_neg (show ¬ (1 ≤ (0:ℕ)) by norm_num), add_zero]
      exact H1 g _ (by omega) hg
    have H3 : ∀ f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ, (∀ i j : ℕ, (N < i ∨ N < j) → f i j = 0) →
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), f i j =
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), f i (k - i) := by
      intro f hf
      calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), f i j
          = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1 - i), f i j := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro m hm
            simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hm
            exact H1 (f m) _ (by omega) (fun n hn => hf m n (Or.inr hn))
        _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1 - i), f i j :=
            H1 (fun m => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1 - m), f m j) (2 * N + 2 + 1) (by omega)
              (fun n hn => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j _ => hf n j (Or.inl hn)))
        _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), f i (k - i) :=
            (Finset.sum_range_diag_flip _ _).symm
    unfold frZV
    set gA := ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 / 2 * (q ^ (-1 + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * v n) with hgA
    set gg := ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 * (q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * u n) with hgg
    set gS := ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 * (q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1) * T n)
      with hgS
    set gR := ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 1 / 2 * (q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1) * u1 n)
      with hgR
    set gRR := ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      1 / 4 * (q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1 - 1) * u2 n) with hgRR
    set gZ := ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      1 * (q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h)) * Z n) with hgZ
    set gZZ := ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      1 * (q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h) - (1 / 2 - h)) * ZZ n) with hgZZ
    set pZ := ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      1 * (q ^ (-(1 + 2 * h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h)) * P n) with hpZ
    
    have hLin : gS + pZ - 4 * ρ * gRR - 4 * gR =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) *
          (T n + P n - 2 * (ρ / (2 * q) * u2 n + u1 n)) := by
      rw [hgS, hpZ, hgRR, hgR, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib,
        ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => ?_)
      have s1 : q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1) = q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) := by
        congr 1; ring
      have s2 : q ^ (-(1 + 2 * h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h)) =
          q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) := by
        congr 1; ring
      have s3 : q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - 1 - 1) =
          q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) / q := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_sub_one hq0]; congr 1; ring
      linear_combination (T n - 2 * u1 n) * s1 + P n * s2 - ρ * u2 n * s3
    
    have hZZ : gZZ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
        q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) * ZZ n := by
      rw [hgZZ]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => ?_)
      have e : -(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h) - (1 / 2 - h) =
          -(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h := by push_cast; ring
      rw [one_mul, e]
    
    have hP1 : 2 * ρ * gA * gR + gg * gZ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
        q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((i + j : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) * (ρ / (2 * q) * v i * u1 j + u i * Z j) := by
      rw [hgA, hgR, hgg, hgZ, mul_assoc (2 * ρ), Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul_sum,
        Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      have r1 : q ^ (-1 + 2 * (i : ℝ) * h) * q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (j : ℝ) * h - 1) =
          q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((i + j : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) / q := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hq, ← Real.rpow_sub_one hq0]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
      have r2 : q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (i : ℝ) * h) *
          q ^ (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (j : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h)) =
          q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((i + j : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
      linear_combination (ρ / 2 * v i * u1 j) * r1 + (u i * Z j) * r2
    
    have hL : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) *
          (T n + P n - 2 * (ρ / (2 * q) * u2 n + u1 n)) =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) *
          (T k + P k - 2 * (ρ / (2 * q) * u2 k + u1 k)) := by
      refine H1 (fun n => q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) *
          (T n + P n - 2 * (ρ / (2 * q) * u2 n + u1 n))) _ (by omega) ?_
      intro n hn
      obtain ⟨e1, e2, e3, e4, -⟩ := hs n hn
      simp [e1, e2, e3, e4]
    have hC := H3 (fun i j => q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((i + j : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) *
        (ρ / (2 * q) * v i * u1 j + u i * Z j)) (by
      intro i j hij
      rcases hij with hi | hj
      · obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, e6, e7, -⟩ := hs i hi
        simp [e6, e7]
      · obtain ⟨-, -, e3, -, -, -, -, e8⟩ := hs j hj
        simp [e3, e8])
    beta_reduce at hC
    have hC2 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
          q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((i + (k - i) : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) *
            (ρ / (2 * q) * v i * u1 (k - i) + u i * Z (k - i)) =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) *
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (ρ / (2 * q) * v i * u1 (k - i) + u i * Z (k - i)) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
      rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le (Finset.mem_range_succ_iff.mp hi)]
    have hZ2 := H2 (fun n => q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) * ZZ n) (by
      intro n hn
      obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, e5, -⟩ := hs n hn
      simp [e5])
    beta_reduce at hZ2
    have hI : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1),
          (if 1 ≤ k then q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * ((k - 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) * ZZ (k - 1) else 0) =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) *
          (if 1 ≤ k then ZZ (k - 1) else 0) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      split_ifs with hk
      · rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hk]
      · simp
    have hsplit : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) *
          (T k + P k - 2 * (ρ / (2 * q) * u2 k + u1 k)
            + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (ρ / (2 * q) * v i * u1 (k - i) + u i * Z (k - i))
            - (if 1 ≤ k then ZZ (k - 1) else 0)) =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) *
            (T k + P k - 2 * (ρ / (2 * q) * u2 k + u1 k))
          + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) *
            ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (ρ / (2 * q) * v i * u1 (k - i) + u i * Z (k - i))
          - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * N + 2 + 1), q ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (k : ℝ) * h) *
            (if 1 ≤ k then ZZ (k - 1) else 0) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      ring
    linear_combination hLin + hP1 - hZZ - hsplit + hL + hC + hC2 - hZ2 - hI
  
  have hpdX0 : ∀ X η : ℝ, pdX (fun _ _ => (0:ℝ)) X η = 0 := fun X η => by simp [pdX]
  have hpdE0 : ∀ X η : ℝ, pdE (fun _ _ => (0:ℝ)) X η = 0 := fun X η => by simp [pdE]
  have hpdXf : pdX (fun _ _ => (0:ℝ)) = fun _ _ => 0 := by
    funext X η; exact hpdX0 X η
  have hUz0 : bgUz (fun _ _ => (0:ℝ)) = fun _ _ => 0 := by
    funext X η; simp [bgUz, hpdX0]
  have hTop0 : ∀ b : ℝ, simTop h b (fun _ _ => (0:ℝ)) = fun _ _ => 0 := by
    intro b; funext X η; simp [simTop, hpdX0, hpdE0]
  have hZop0 : ∀ b : ℝ, simZop h b (fun _ _ => (0:ℝ)) = fun _ _ => 0 := by
    intro b; funext X η; simp [simZop, hpdX0, hpdE0]
  have hVx0 : ∀ n : ℕ, bgVx h n (fun _ _ => (0:ℝ)) = fun _ _ => 0 := by
    intro n; funext X η; simp [bgVx, hUz0, hpdE0]
  exact key (simScale h z (1 - s))
    (fun n => simTop h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (bgUz (S n))
      (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))))
    (fun n => simZop h (-(1 + 2 * h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (W n)
      (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))))
    (fun n => pdX (bgUz (S n))
      (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))))
    (fun n => pdX (pdX (bgUz (S n)))
      (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))))
    (fun n => simZop h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h - (1 / 2 - h))
      (simZop h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (bgUz (S n)))
      (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))))
    (fun n => bgVx h n (S n)
      (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))))
    (fun n => bgUz (S n)
      (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))))
    (fun n => simZop h (-(1 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) (bgUz (S n))
      (ρ / (2 * simScale h z (1 - s))) (z * simScale h z (1 - s) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))))
    hq (fun n hn => by
      obtain ⟨hS, -, hW⟩ := hvan n hn
      simp [hS, hW, hUz0, hTop0, hZop0, hpdXf, hVx0])

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h Xa Xb : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (T1 T2 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < Xa → Xa < Xb → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿T1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿T2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X η : ℝ, (X ≤ Xa ∨ Xb ≤ X) → T1 X η = 0 ∧ T2 X η = 0) → (∀ Y η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y' => T1 Y' η) Y ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y' => T2 Y' η) Y) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(stressDivField h (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * T1 X η) (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * T2 X η))) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧ ((∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿T1) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿T2) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(stressDivField h (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * T1 X η) (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * T2 X η))) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (n : ℝ) - ((m : ℝ) + 3)))

signature.name: bg_stress_term_props
signature.statement: ∀ (h Xa Xb : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (T1 T2 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → 0 < Xa → Xa < Xb → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿T1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿T2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X η : ℝ, (X ≤ Xa ∨ Xb ≤ X) → T1 X η = 0 ∧ T2 X η = 0) → (∀ Y η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y' => T1 Y' η) Y ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y' => T2 Y' η) Y) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(stressDivField h (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * T1 X η) (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * T2 X η))) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧ ((∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿T1) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿T2) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(stressDivField h (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * T1 X η) (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * T2 X η))) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (n : ℝ) - ((m : ℝ) + 3)))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Xa Xb n T1 T2 hS hh0 hh2 hXa hXab hT1 hT2 hv
  
  have gen : ∀ (T : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (φ ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿T) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ (Ioi 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ (Ioi 0) →
      (∀ X η : ℝ, (X ≤ Xa ∨ Xb ≤ X) → T X η = 0) →
      (∀ X η : ℝ, c X η = φ X * deriv (fun Y => T Y η) X + ψ X * T X η) →
      (∀ Y η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y' => T Y' η) Y) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿c) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
      (∀ X η : ℝ, Xb < X → c X η = 0) ∧
      ((∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿T) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) →
        ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿c) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) := by
    intro T φ ψ c hT hφ hψ hvT hc
    have hV : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hz0 : ∀ X η : ℝ, (X < Xa ∨ Xb < X) → (fun Y => T Y η) =ᶠ[nhds X] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
      intro X η hX
      rcases hX with hX | hX
      · filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hX] with Y hY using hvT Y η (Or.inl (le_of_lt hY))
      · filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hX] with Y hY using hvT Y η (Or.inr (le_of_lt hY))
    have hpz : ∀ X η : ℝ, (X < Xa ∨ Xb < X) → c X η = 0 := by
      intro X η hX
      have h1 : deriv (fun Y => T Y η) X = 0 := by rw [(hz0 X η hX).deriv_eq]; simp
      have h2 : T X η = 0 := (hz0 X η hX).eq_of_nhds
      rw [hc, h1, h2]; ring
    have hfdT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿T)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hV).1 hT).2
    have hCR : ∀ w ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt (fun Y => T Y w.2) (fderiv ℝ (↿T) w ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) w.1 := by
      intro w hw
      have hF : HasFDerivAt (↿T) (fderiv ℝ (↿T) w) w :=
        ((hT.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hw)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
      exact hF.comp_hasDerivAt w.1 ((hasDerivAt_id w.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const w.1 w.2))
    have hφV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => φ w.1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
      hφ.comp contDiffOn_fst (fun w hw => hw.1)
    have hψV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ψ w.1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
      hψ.comp contDiffOn_fst (fun w hw => hw.1)
    have hDV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => fderiv ℝ (↿T) w ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) :=
      hfdT.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have hAV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => φ w.1 * fderiv ℝ (↿T) w ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))
        (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := hφV.mul hDV
    have hBV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ψ w.1 * (↿T) w) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) := hψV.mul hT
    have heqV : ∀ w ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
        (↿c) w = ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => φ w.1 * fderiv ℝ (↿T) w ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) +
          (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ψ w.1 * (↿T) w)) w := by
      intro w hw
      show c w.1 w.2 = _
      rw [hc, (hCR w hw).deriv]
      rfl
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun X η hX => hpz X η (Or.inr hX), ?_⟩
    · intro Y η h1 h2
      rcases lt_or_ge Y Xa with hY | hY
      · exact (differentiableAt_const (0:ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq (hz0 Y η (Or.inl hY))
      · exact (hCR (Y, η) ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hXa hY, h1, h2⟩).differentiableAt
    · apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
      intro w hw
      rcases lt_or_ge w.1 Xa with hw1 | hw1
      · refine ⟨{z : ℝ × ℝ | z.1 < Xa}, isOpen_lt continuous_fst continuous_const, hw1, ?_⟩
        exact (contDiffOn_const (c := (0:ℝ))).congr (fun z hz => hpz z.1 z.2 (Or.inl hz.2))
      · refine ⟨{z : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < z.1}, isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst,
          lt_of_lt_of_le hXa hw1, ?_⟩
        refine ((hAV.add hBV).mono ?_).congr ?_
        · intro z hz; exact ⟨hz.2, hz.1.2⟩
        · intro z hz; exact heqV z ⟨hz.2, hz.1.2⟩
    · intro hTb m
      have hSV : Icc Xa Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1 :=
        fun w hw => ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hXa hw.1.1, hw.2⟩
      have hmult : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (Ioi 0) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ,
          ∀ w ∈ Icc Xa Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => f w.1) w‖ ≤ C := by
        intro f hf k
        have hO : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_univ
        have hfO : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => f w.1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ univ) :=
          hf.comp contDiffOn_fst (fun w hw => hw.1)
        have hcont : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => f w.1)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ univ) :=
          (hfO.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hO.uniqueDiffOn).congr
            (fun w hw => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hO hw).symm)
        have hK : IsCompact (Icc Xa Xb ×ˢ ({0} : Set ℝ)) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_singleton
        obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
          (hcont.mono (fun w hw => ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hXa hw.1.1, mem_univ _⟩))
        refine ⟨C, fun w hw => ?_⟩
        have e : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => f w.1) w =
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => f w.1) (w.1, 0) := by
          have := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => f w.1) k
            ((0:ℝ), w.2) (w.1, 0)
          simp only [Prod.fst_add, add_zero, Prod.mk_add_mk, zero_add] at this
          exact this.symm
        rw [e]
        exact hC (w.1, 0) ⟨hw.1, rfl⟩
      have hprod : ∀ f1 f2 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f1 (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
          ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f2 (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
          (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ Icc Xa Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 w‖ ≤ C) →
          (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ Icc Xa Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 w‖ ≤ C) →
          ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ Icc Xa Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => f1 z * f2 z) w‖ ≤ C := by
        intro f1 f2 h1 h2 b1 b2 k
        choose C1 hC1 using b1
        choose C2 hC2 using b2
        refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * (|C1 i| * |C2 (k - i)|), fun w hw => ?_⟩
        have hwV := hSV hw
        rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f1 z * f2 z) k hV hwV]
        refine (norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le h1 h2 hV.uniqueDiffOn hwV
          (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).trans ?_
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hV hwV, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (k - i) hV hwV]
        have a1 := (hC1 i w hw).trans (le_abs_self _)
        have a2 := (hC2 (k - i) w hw).trans (le_abs_self _)
        have a3 := mul_le_mul a1 a2 (norm_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)
        have a4 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) := by positivity
        calc (k.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f1 w‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) f2 w‖
            = (k.choose i : ℝ) * (‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f1 w‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) f2 w‖) := by ring
          _ ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * (|C1 i| * |C2 (k - i)|) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a3 a4
      have hDb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ Icc Xa Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w => fderiv ℝ (↿T) w ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) w‖ ≤ C := by
        intro k
        obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hTb (k + 1)
        refine ⟨‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))‖ * C, fun w hw => ?_⟩
        have hwV := hSV hw
        have e : (fun w => fderiv ℝ (↿T) w ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) =
            (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) ∘ fderiv ℝ (↿T) := rfl
        rw [e]
        refine (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left _
          (hfdT.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hwV)) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).trans ?_
        rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC w.1 w.2 hwV.1 hwV.2.1 hwV.2.2) (norm_nonneg _)
      obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hprod _ _ hφV hDV (hmult φ hφ) hDb m
      obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := hprod _ _ hψV hT (hmult ψ hψ)
        (fun k => (hTb k).imp fun C hC w hw => hC w.1 w.2 (hSV hw).1 (hSV hw).2.1 (hSV hw).2.2) m
      refine ⟨max (C1 + C2) 0, fun X η h0 hXb h1 h2 => ?_⟩
      rcases lt_or_ge X Xa with hX | hX
      · have hev : (↿c) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)] fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((isOpen_lt continuous_fst continuous_const).mem_nhds
            (show (X, η) ∈ {z : ℝ × ℝ | z.1 < Xa} from hX)) (fun z hz => hpz z.1 z.2 (Or.inl hz))
        rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
        simp
      · have hw : (X, η) ∈ Icc Xa Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨⟨hX, hXb⟩, h1, h2⟩
        have hwV := hSV hw
        have hev : (↿c) =ᶠ[nhds (X, η)]
            ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => φ w.1 * fderiv ℝ (↿T) w ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) +
              (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ψ w.1 * (↿T) w)) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV.mem_nhds hwV) heqV
        rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds,
          iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((hAV.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hwV)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
            ((hBV.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hwV)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
        have e1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => φ w.1 * fderiv ℝ (↿T) w ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) (X, η)‖
            ≤ C1 := hC1 _ hw
        have e2 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ψ w.1 * (↿T) w) (X, η)‖ ≤ C2 := hC2 _ hw
        refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
        linarith [le_max_left (C1 + C2) 0]
  
  have hφ1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun _ : ℝ => (-1 : ℝ)) (Ioi 0) := contDiffOn_const
  have hψ1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun X : ℝ => -X⁻¹) (Ioi 0) := by
    have := ((contDiffOn_id : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (id : ℝ → ℝ) (Ioi 0)).inv
      (fun X (hX : X ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ)) => ne_of_gt hX)).neg
    exact this
  have hlin : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun X : ℝ => 2 * X) (Ioi 0) := (contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_id)
  have hlin0 : ∀ X ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ), 2 * X ≠ 0 := fun X hX => (mul_pos two_pos (mem_Ioi.mp hX)).ne'
  have hsq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun X : ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * X)) (Ioi 0) := hlin.sqrt hlin0
  have hφ2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun X : ℝ => -Real.sqrt (2 * X)) (Ioi 0) := hsq.neg
  have hψ2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun X : ℝ => -(Real.sqrt (2 * X) / (2 * X))) (Ioi 0) := by
    have := (hsq.div hlin hlin0).neg
    exact this
  
  obtain ⟨c1, hc1⟩ : ∃ c1 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
      c1 = fun X η => -1 * deriv (fun Y => T1 Y η) X + -X⁻¹ * T1 X η := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨c2, hc2⟩ : ∃ c2 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, c2 = fun X η =>
      -Real.sqrt (2 * X) * deriv (fun Y => T2 Y η) X + -(Real.sqrt (2 * X) / (2 * X)) * T2 X η :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have g1 := gen T1 _ _ c1 hT1 hφ1 hψ1 (fun X η hX => (hv X η hX).1) (fun X η => by rw [hc1])
  have g2 := gen T2 _ _ c2 hT2 hφ2 hψ2 (fun X η hX => (hv X η hX).2) (fun X η => by rw [hc2])
  
  have hΩ : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
  have hQpos : ∀ z ∈ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1}, 0 < simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' : z.2 < 1 := hz
    exact (hS.1 _ _ (by linarith)).1
  have hQne : ∀ z ∈ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1}, simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ≠ 0 :=
    fun z hz => (hQpos z hz).ne'
  have hQs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
    have hlinQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((z.1 2 : ℝ), 1 - z.2)) := by fun_prop
    have := hS.2.2.2.1.comp hlinQ.contDiffOn
      (fun z (hz : z ∈ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1}) =>
        (⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - z.2 by have : z.2 < 1 := hz; linarith⟩ :
          ((z.1 2 : ℝ), 1 - z.2) ∈ (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)))
    exact this
  have hX : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simX h z.1 z.2) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
    have hnum : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2) := by fun_prop
    have hden : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => 2 * simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
      contDiffOn_const.mul hQs
    exact hnum.contDiffOn.div hden (fun z hz => mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (hQne z hz))
  have hE : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simEta h z.1 z.2) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
    have hx2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => z.1 2) := by fun_prop
    exact hx2.contDiffOn.mul (hQs.rpow_const_of_ne (p := -(1 / 2 - h)) hQne)
  have hEta : ∀ z ∈ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1}, -1 < simEta h z.1 z.2 ∧ simEta h z.1 z.2 < 1 := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' : z.2 < 1 := hz
    have hq := hQpos z hz
    have hsq2 := (hS.2.1 (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) (by linarith)).2
    have hp : 0 < simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (1 / 2 - h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _
    have e1 : simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (1 - 2 * h) =
        (simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (1 / 2 - h)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hq.le]
      congr 1; push_cast; ring
    rw [e1] at hsq2
    obtain ⟨l, r⟩ := abs_lt.mp (abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq hsq2 hp.le)
    have e2 : simEta h z.1 z.2 = z.1 2 / simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (1 / 2 - h) := by
      simp only [simEta, Real.rpow_neg hq.le, div_eq_mul_inv]
    rw [e2]
    constructor
    · rw [lt_div_iff₀ hp]; linarith
    · rw [div_lt_iff₀ hp]; linarith
  have hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (simX h z.1 z.2, simEta h z.1 z.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
    hX.prodMk hE
  have hcomp : ∀ c : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿c) (univ ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => c (simX h z.1 z.2) (simEta h z.1 z.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
    intro c hc
    exact hc.comp hP (fun z hz => ⟨mem_univ _, (hEta z hz).1, (hEta z hz).2⟩)
  have hAz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => azVec z.1) := by unfold azVec; fun_prop
  
  obtain ⟨F1, hF1⟩ : ∃ F1 : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ³, F1 = fun z =>
      (simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-(2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * c1 (simX h z.1 z.2) (simEta h z.1 z.2)) •
        azVec z.1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨F2, hF2⟩ : ∃ F2 : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ³, F2 = fun z =>
      (simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * c2 (simX h z.1 z.2) (simEta h z.1 z.2)) •
        EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hF1s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F1 {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
    rw [hF1]
    exact ((hQs.rpow_const_of_ne hQne).mul (hcomp c1 g1.2.1)).smul hAz.contDiffOn
  have hF2s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F2 {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
    rw [hF2]
    exact ((hQs.rpow_const_of_ne hQne).mul (hcomp c2 g2.2.1)).smul contDiffOn_const
  
  have key : ∀ z : ℝ³ × ℝ, z.2 < 1 →
      (↿(stressDivField h (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * T1 X η)
        (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * T2 X η))) z = (F1 + F2) z := by
    intro z hz
    have hq : 0 < simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) := (hS.1 _ _ (by linarith)).1
    rw [Pi.add_apply, hF1, hF2, hc1, hc2]
    change stressDivField h (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * T1 X η)
      (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * T2 X η) z.1 z.2 = _
    simp only [stressDivField]
    rw [deriv_const_mul_field, deriv_const_mul_field, Real.rpow_add hq, Real.rpow_add hq]
    congr 1 <;> congr 1 <;> ring
  have hΦs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(stressDivField h (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * T1 X η)
      (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * T2 X η))) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
    (hF1s.add hF2s).congr (fun z hz => key z hz)
  refine ⟨fun Y η h1 h2 => ⟨g1.1 Y η h1 h2, g2.1 Y η h1 h2⟩, hΦs, ?_⟩
  
  intro hTb m
  have hb1 := g1.2.2.2 (fun k => (hTb k).imp fun C hC X η a b d => (hC X η a b d).1)
  have hb2 := g2.2.2.2 (fun k => (hTb k).imp fun C hC X η a b d => (hC X η a b d).2)
  obtain ⟨-, hB1⟩ := sim_frame_field_bound h hh0 hh2 hS c1 (-(2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) 1 Xb azVec one_pos
    (g1.2.1.mono (fun w hw => ⟨mem_univ _, hw.2⟩)) (fun X η hX _ _ => g1.2.2.1 X η hX) hb1
    (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
  obtain ⟨-, hB2⟩ := sim_frame_field_bound h hh0 hh2 hS c2 (-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) 1 Xb
    (fun _ => EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) one_pos
    (g2.2.1.mono (fun w hw => ⟨mem_univ _, hw.2⟩)) (fun X η hX _ _ => g2.2.2.1 X η hX) hb2
    (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))
  obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hB1 m
  obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := hB2 m
  refine ⟨|C1| + |C2|, fun x t hxt => ?_⟩
  have ht : t < 1 := hxt.1
  have hq : 0 < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) := (hS.1 _ _ (by linarith)).1
  have hq1 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≤ 1 := le_of_lt hxt.2
  have hmem : ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := ht
  have b1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F1 (x, t)‖ ≤
      C1 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ ((-(2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) - (m : ℝ)) := by
    rw [hF1]; exact hC1 x t hxt
  have b2 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F2 (x, t)‖ ≤
      C2 * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ ((-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) - (m : ℝ)) := by
    rw [hF2]; exact hC2 x t hxt
  have hev : (↿(stressDivField h (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * T1 X η)
      (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * T2 X η))) =ᶠ[nhds (x, t)] (F1 + F2) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hΩ.mem_nhds hmem) (fun z hz => key z hz)
  rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds,
    iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((hF1s.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hmem)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      ((hF2s.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hmem)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
  have r1 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ ((-(2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) - (m : ℝ)) ≤
      simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (n : ℝ) - ((m : ℝ) + 3)) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq hq1 (by linarith)
  have r2 : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ ((-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) - (m : ℝ)) ≤
      simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (n : ℝ) - ((m : ℝ) + 3)) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq hq1 (by linarith)
  have p1 := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le ((-(2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) - (m : ℝ))
  have p2 := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le ((-(3 / 2 + h) + 2 * (n : ℝ) * h) - (m : ℝ))
  have b1' : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F1 (x, t)‖ ≤
      |C1| * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (n : ℝ) - ((m : ℝ) + 3)) :=
    b1.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) p1).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left r1 (abs_nonneg _)))
  have b2' : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F2 (x, t)‖ ≤
      |C2| * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * (n : ℝ) - ((m : ℝ) + 3)) :=
    b2.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) p2).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left r2 (abs_nonneg _)))
  refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
  rw [add_mul]
  exact add_le_add b1' b2'

subgoal_signatures.name: sim_frame_field_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → SimScaleProps h → ∀ (c : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (b ε X1 : ℝ) (v : ℝ³ → ℝ³), 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿c) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) → (∀ X η : ℝ, X1 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → c X η = 0) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X1 → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿c) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) → (v = radVec ∨ v = azVec ∨ v = fun _ => EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ b * c (simX h z.1 z.2) (simEta h z.1 z.2)) • v z.1) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (simScale h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ b * c (simX h z.1 z.2) (simEta h z.1 z.2)) • v z.1) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (b - (m : ℝ))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (Tth Tz : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → SimScaleProps h → (∀ j, 1 ≤ a j) → (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) → (∀ (n : ℕ) (Y η : ℝ), -1 < η → η < 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y' => Tth n Y' η) Y ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y' => Tz n Y' η) Y) → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → stressDivField h (bgSum h a Tth) (bgSum h a Tz) x t = cutSum h a (fun n => stressDivField h (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Tth n X η) (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Tz n X η)) x t ∧ ∀ J : ℕ, stressDivField h (bgTsum h Tth J) (bgTsum h Tz J) x t = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), stressDivField h (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Tth n X η) (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Tz n X η) x t

signature.name: bg_stress_cutSum
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (Tth Tz : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → SimScaleProps h → (∀ j, 1 ≤ a j) → (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) → (∀ (n : ℕ) (Y η : ℝ), -1 < η → η < 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y' => Tth n Y' η) Y ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y' => Tz n Y' η) Y) → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), t < 1 → stressDivField h (bgSum h a Tth) (bgSum h a Tz) x t = cutSum h a (fun n => stressDivField h (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Tth n X η) (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Tz n X η)) x t ∧ ∀ J : ℕ, stressDivField h (bgTsum h Tth J) (bgTsum h Tz J) x t = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), stressDivField h (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Tth n X η) (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Tz n X η) x t

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h a Tth Tz hh0 hh1 hS ha1 ha2 hD x t ht
  have htau : 0 < 1 - t := by linarith
  have hq : 0 < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) := (hS.1 (x 2) (1 - t) htau).1
  have hz : x 2 ^ 2 < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (1 - 2 * h) := (hS.2.1 (x 2) (1 - t) htau).2
  
  have hη : -1 < simEta h x t ∧ simEta h x t < 1 := by
    have hr : (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 *
        simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (1 - 2 * h) = 1 := by
      have e : (-(1 / 2 - h)) * ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) + (1 - 2 * h) = 0 := by push_cast; ring
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hq.le, ← Real.rpow_add hq, e, Real.rpow_zero]
    have hr2 : 0 < (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 := by
      have := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq (-(1 / 2 - h))
      positivity
    have hsq : simEta h x t ^ 2 < 1 := by
      have e2 : simEta h x t ^ 2 = x 2 ^ 2 * (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 := by
        unfold simEta; ring
      rw [e2]
      calc x 2 ^ 2 * (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2
          < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (1 - 2 * h) * (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) ^ 2 :=
            mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hz hr2
        _ = 1 := by rw [mul_comm]; exact hr
    constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (simEta h x t + 1), sq_nonneg (simEta h x t - 1)]
  have hDX : ∀ n : ℕ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y' => Tth n Y' (simEta h x t)) (simX h x t) ∧
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y' => Tz n Y' (simEta h x t)) (simX h x t) :=
    fun n => hD n _ _ hη.1 hη.2
  
  have hlin : ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (Tth' Tz' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ Y : ℝ, Tth' (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) Y (simEta h x t) =
        ∑ n ∈ s, c n * Tth n Y (simEta h x t)) →
      (∀ Y : ℝ, Tz' (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) Y (simEta h x t) =
        ∑ n ∈ s, c n * Tz n Y (simEta h x t)) →
      stressDivField h Tth' Tz' x t =
        ∑ n ∈ s, c n • stressDivField h (fun _ X η => Tth n X η) (fun _ X η => Tz n X η) x t := by
    intro s c Tth' Tz' h1 h2
    have d1 : deriv (fun Y => ∑ n ∈ s, c n * Tth n Y (simEta h x t)) (simX h x t) =
        ∑ n ∈ s, c n * deriv (fun Y => Tth n Y (simEta h x t)) (simX h x t) := by
      rw [deriv_fun_sum (fun n _ => ((hDX n).1.const_mul (c n)))]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => deriv_const_mul _ (hDX n).1)
    have d2 : deriv (fun Y => ∑ n ∈ s, c n * Tz n Y (simEta h x t)) (simX h x t) =
        ∑ n ∈ s, c n * deriv (fun Y => Tz n Y (simEta h x t)) (simX h x t) := by
      rw [deriv_fun_sum (fun n _ => ((hDX n).2.const_mul (c n)))]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => deriv_const_mul _ (hDX n).2)
    unfold stressDivField
    simp only [h1, h2]
    rw [d1, d2]
    simp only [Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib,
      Finset.sum_smul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => ?_)
    rw [smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul]
    congr 2 <;> ring
  
  have hscale : ∀ n : ℕ, stressDivField h (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Tth n X η)
      (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Tz n X η) x t =
      simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) •
        stressDivField h (fun _ X η => Tth n X η) (fun _ X η => Tz n X η) x t := by
    intro n
    have := hlin {n} (fun _ => simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h))
      (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Tth n X η) (fun q X η => q ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) * Tz n X η)
      (fun Y => by rw [Finset.sum_singleton]) (fun Y => by rw [Finset.sum_singleton])
    rw [this, Finset.sum_singleton]
  refine ⟨?_, fun J => ?_⟩
  swap
  · rw [hlin (Finset.range (J + 1)) (fun n => simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h))
      (bgTsum h Tth J) (bgTsum h Tz J) (fun Y => rfl) (fun Y => rfl)]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => (hscale n).symm)
  
  have hlinA : ∀ j : ℕ, (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ a j := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => simpa using ha1 0
    | succ k ih =>
      have e1 := ha2 k
      have e2 := ha1 k
      push_cast
      linarith
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := exists_nat_gt (1 / simScale h (x 2) (1 - t))
  have hcut0 : ∀ j : ℕ, N₀ ≤ j → bgCut (a (j + 1)) (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) = 0 := by
    intro j hj
    have h1 : (N₀ : ℝ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hj
    have h2 := hlinA (j + 1)
    push_cast at h2
    have h3 : 1 / simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < a (j + 1) := by linarith
    have h4 : 1 < a (j + 1) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) := by
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hq] at h3
      linarith
    unfold bgCut
    exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℕ → ℝ, c = fun n => if n = 0 then 1 else
      bgCut (a n) (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) * h) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc0 : c 0 = 1 := by rw [hc]; simp
  have hcs : ∀ j : ℕ, c (j + 1) = bgCut (a (j + 1)) (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) *
      simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) := by
    intro j; rw [hc]; simp
  have hsumT : ∀ (T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (Y : ℝ),
      bgSum h a T (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) Y (simEta h x t) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N₀ + 1), c n * T n Y (simEta h x t) := by
    intro T Y
    unfold bgSum
    rw [tsum_eq_sum (s := Finset.range N₀) (fun j hj => by
      rw [hcut0 j (by simpa using hj), zero_mul, zero_mul])]
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', hc0, one_mul]
    refine (add_comm _ _).trans ?_
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    rw [hcs j]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hsc : ∀ b : ℝ, simCut h b x t = bgCut b (simScale h (x 2) (1 - t)) := fun b => rfl
  rw [hlin (Finset.range (N₀ + 1)) c (bgSum h a Tth) (bgSum h a Tz) (hsumT Tth) (hsumT Tz)]
  simp only [cutSum]
  rw [tsum_eq_sum (s := Finset.range N₀) (fun j hj => by
    rw [hsc, hcut0 j (by simpa using hj), zero_smul])]
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
  refine (add_comm _ _).trans ?_
  congr 1
  · rw [hscale 0, hc0, one_smul]
    simp
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    rw [hscale (j + 1), smul_smul, hcs j, hsc]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (a L M Kr : ℕ → ℝ) (A Bv Ψ : ℕ → ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (P : ℕ → ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (A' Bv' Φ0 Ψ' : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (P' : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 / 2 → SimScaleProps h → (∀ j, 1 ≤ a j) → (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(A j)) (simDomain h 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(Bv j)) (simDomain h 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(P j)) (simDomain h 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(Ψ j)) (simDomain h 1)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿A') (simDomain h 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Bv') (simDomain h 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿P') (simDomain h 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Φ0) (simDomain h 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Ψ') (simDomain h 1) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(A j)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(Bv j)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(P j)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿(Ψ j)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K)) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿A') (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿Bv') (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿P') (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿Ψ') (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-K)) → (∀ J k : ℕ, k ≤ J → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 → a J * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < 1 / 2 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => (↿A') z - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), (↿(A j)) z) (x, t)‖ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ J * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * ((J : ℝ) + 1) / 2 - L k) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => (↿Bv') z - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), (↿(Bv j)) z) (x, t)‖ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ J * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * ((J : ℝ) + 1) / 2 - L k) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => (↿P') z - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), (↿(P j)) z) (x, t)‖ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ J * simScale h (x 2) (1 - (Φ0 y s + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), Ψ j y s))) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (2 * h * ((J : ℝ) + 1) - Kr m)) → ∀ m N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ) => nsResidual 1 (fun y' s' => curl3 (fun w => A' w s') y' + Bv' y' s') P' y s - (Φ0 y s + Ψ' y s))) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (N : ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  suffices hRC : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ (A₀ B₀ A₁ B₁ : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (P₀ P₁ : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿A₀) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿B₀) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿P₀) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿A₁) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿B₁) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿P₁) O → ∀ z ∈ O, (ContDiffAt ℝ m (↿(nsResidual 1 (fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A₁ w s) y + B₁ y s) P₁)) z ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ m (↿(nsResidual 1 (fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A₀ w s) y + B₀ y s) P₀)) z) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(nsResidual 1 (fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A₁ w s) y + B₁ y s) P₁)) z - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(nsResidual 1 (fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A₀ w s) y + B₀ y s) P₀)) z‖ ≤ c * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 4), (‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w => (↿A₁) w - (↿A₀) w) z‖ + ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w => (↿B₁) w - (↿B₀) w) z‖ + ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w => (↿P₁) w - (↿P₀) w) z‖)) * (1 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 4), (‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿A₀) z‖ + ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (↿B₀) z‖ + ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w => (↿A₁) w - (↿A₀) w) z‖ + ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w => (↿B₁) w - (↿B₀) w) z‖)) by
    intro h a L M Kr A Bv Ψ P A' Bv' Φ0 Ψ' P' hh0 hh1 hS ha hsmj hsA' hsB' hsP' hsΦ hsΨ' hPer hSum
      htail htr m N
    
    have hΩ : IsOpen (simDomain h 1) := by
      have hU : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
      have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h v.1 v.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
        hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
      have hf : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
      have hg : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2))
          {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
        refine h1.comp hf.continuousOn ?_
        intro w hw
        have hw' : w.2 < 1 := hw
        exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 by linarith⟩
      exact hg.isOpen_inter_preimage hU isOpen_Iio
    have hpos : ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 →
        0 < simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ∧ simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≤ 1 := by
      intro x t hxt
      have ht : t < 1 := hxt.1
      have hlt : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) < 1 := hxt.2
      exact ⟨(hS.1 (x 2) (1 - t) (by linarith)).1, hlt.le⟩
    have hca : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : ℝ³ × ℝ → V) (k : ℕ)
        (z : ℝ³ × ℝ), z ∈ simDomain h 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (simDomain h 1) → ContDiffAt ℝ k f z := by
      intro V _ _ f k z hz hf
      exact (hf.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hz)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hdiffb : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f g : ℝ³ × ℝ → V) (k : ℕ)
        (z : ℝ³ × ℝ), z ∈ simDomain h 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (simDomain h 1) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (simDomain h 1) →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w => f w - g w) z‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z‖ + ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g z‖ := by
      intro V _ _ f g k z hz hf hg
      have e : (fun w => f w - g w) = f - g := rfl
      rw [e, iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply (hca f k z hz hf) (hca g k z hz hg)]
      exact norm_sub_le _ _
    have hsplit3 : ∀ (R1 R0 X2 X3 G : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ³) (z : ℝ³ × ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ m R1 z →
        ContDiffAt ℝ m R0 z → ContDiffAt ℝ m X2 z → ContDiffAt ℝ m X3 z →
        (∀ w, G w = (R1 w - R0 w) + X2 w - X3 w) →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m G z‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m R1 z - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m R0 z‖ +
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m X2 z‖ + ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m X3 z‖ := by
      intro R1 R0 X2 X3 G z h1 h0 h2 h3 hG
      have e1 : G = ((R1 - R0) + X2) - X3 := funext hG
      rw [e1, iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply (f := (R1 - R0) + X2) (g := X3) ((h1.sub h0).add h2) h3,
        iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (f := R1 - R0) (g := X2) (h1.sub h0) h2,
        iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply (f := R1) (g := R0) h1 h0]
      exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) le_rfl)
    have eid : ∀ (r1 r0 φ ψ s : ℝ³), r1 - (φ + ψ) = (r1 - r0) + (r0 - (φ + s)) - (ψ - s) := by
      intro r1 r0 φ ψ s
      abel
    
    obtain ⟨c, hc0, hRD⟩ := hRC m
    choose Kp hKp using hPer
    choose Cp hCp using hKp
    choose Cs Ks hCs using hSum
    have hsingle : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ) (S : ℝ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 4), |f i| = S → ∀ k, k < m + 4 →
        f k ≤ S ∧ |f k| ≤ S ∧ 0 ≤ S := by
      intro f S hS k hk
      rw [← hS]
      have h1 : |f k| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 4), |f i| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |f i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.mpr hk)
      exact ⟨(le_abs_self _).trans h1, h1, (abs_nonneg _).trans h1⟩
    obtain ⟨Kst, hKst⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 4), |Kp i| = S := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Kss, hKss⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 4), |Ks i| = S := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Css, hCss⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 4), |Cs i| = S := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Lst, hLst⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 4), |L i| = S := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hKst0 := (hsingle Kp Kst hKst 0 (by omega)).2.2
    have hKss0 := (hsingle Ks Kss hKss 0 (by omega)).2.2
    have hCss0 := (hsingle Cs Css hCss 0 (by omega)).2.2
    have hLst0 := (hsingle L Lst hLst 0 (by omega)).2.2
    have hN0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (N:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg N
    have hm0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg m
    have habM := abs_nonneg (M m)
    have habK := abs_nonneg (Kr m)
    have hleM := le_abs_self (M m)
    have hleK := le_abs_self (Kr m)
    have hTT : (0:ℝ) ≤ (N:ℝ) + Kst + Lst + |M m| + |Kr m| := by linarith
    obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((m:ℝ) + 3 + ((N:ℝ) + Kst + Lst + |M m| + |Kr m|) / h)
    have hd : 0 ≤ ((N:ℝ) + Kst + Lst + |M m| + |Kr m|) / h := div_nonneg hTT hh0.le
    have hJ1 : m + 3 ≤ J := by
      have : ((m + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) < J := by push_cast; linarith
      exact_mod_cast this.le
    have hJh : (N:ℝ) + Kst + Lst + |M m| + |Kr m| ≤ (J:ℝ) * h := by
      have h1 : ((N:ℝ) + Kst + Lst + |M m| + |Kr m|) / h < J := by linarith
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hh0] at h1
      linarith
    have hJ0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (J:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg J
    have hJh0 : 0 ≤ (J:ℝ) * h := mul_nonneg hJ0 hh0.le
    have eJ : 2 * h * ((J : ℝ) + 1) / 2 = (J:ℝ) * h + h := by ring
    have eJ' : 2 * h * ((J : ℝ) + 1) = 2 * ((J:ℝ) * h) + 2 * h := by ring
    have hJ2 : ∀ k, k < m + 4 → (N:ℝ) + Kst ≤ 2 * h * ((J : ℝ) + 1) / 2 - L k := by
      intro k hk
      have hLk := (hsingle L Lst hLst k hk).1
      rw [eJ]
      linarith
    have hJ3 : (N:ℝ) ≤ 2 * h * ((J : ℝ) + 1) / 2 - M m := by
      rw [eJ]
      linarith
    have hJ4 : (N:ℝ) ≤ 2 * h * ((J : ℝ) + 1) - Kr m := by
      rw [eJ']
      linarith
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 4), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), |Cp i j| = D :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hCpD : ∀ k, k < m + 4 → ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), |Cp k j| ≤ D := by
      intro k hk
      rw [← hD]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), |Cp i j|)
        (fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)) (Finset.mem_range.mpr hk)
    have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)).trans (hCpD 0 (by omega))
    
    have hPS : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (F : ℕ → ℝ³ × ℝ → V) (k : ℕ)
        (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), (x, t) ∈ simDomain h 1 → (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (F j) (simDomain h 1)) →
        (∀ j, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (F j) (x, t)‖ ≤ Cp k j * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-Kp k)) →
        k < m + 4 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), F j w) (x, t)‖ ≤
          D * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-Kst) := by
      intro V _ _ F k x t hxt hF hb hk
      obtain ⟨hq0, hq1⟩ := hpos x t hxt
      have e : (fun w => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), F j w) = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), F j :=
        (Finset.sum_fn _ _).symm
      rw [e, iteratedFDeriv_sum_apply (fun j _ => hca (F j) k (x, t) hxt (hF j))]
      refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
      have hW : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-Kp k) ≤ simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-Kst) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1 (by linarith [(hsingle Kp Kst hKst k hk).1])
      calc ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (F j) (x, t)‖
          ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), |Cp k j| * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-Kst) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => (hb j).trans (le_trans
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _))
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hW (abs_nonneg _))))
        _ = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), |Cp k j|) * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-Kst) :=
            (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
        _ ≤ D * simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (-Kst) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hCpD k hk) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)
    
    have hcomb : ∀ (a1 a2 a3 b1 b2 : ℕ → ℝ) (X Y T1 : ℝ),
        T1 ≤ c * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 4), (a1 k + a2 k + a3 k)) *
          (1 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 4), (b1 k + b2 k + a1 k + a2 k)) →
        (∀ k, k < m + 4 → a1 k ≤ X ∧ a2 k ≤ X ∧ a3 k ≤ X ∧ b1 k ≤ Y ∧ b2 k ≤ Y) →
        (∀ k, 0 ≤ a1 k ∧ 0 ≤ a2 k ∧ 0 ≤ a3 k ∧ 0 ≤ b1 k ∧ 0 ≤ b2 k) →
        T1 ≤ c * (((m : ℝ) + 4) * (3 * X)) * (1 + ((m : ℝ) + 4) * (2 * Y + 2 * X)) := by
      intro a1 a2 a3 b1 b2 X Y T1 hT hb h0
      have hsum : ∀ V : ℝ, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 4), V = ((m : ℝ) + 4) * V := by
        intro V
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hE : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 4), (a1 k + a2 k + a3 k) ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 4) * (3 * X) := by
        rw [← hsum]
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k hk => ?_)
        obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, -, -⟩ := hb k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
        linarith
      have hU : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 4), (b1 k + b2 k + a1 k + a2 k) ≤
          ((m : ℝ) + 4) * (2 * Y + 2 * X) := by
        rw [← hsum]
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k hk => ?_)
        obtain ⟨h1, h2, -, h4, h5⟩ := hb k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
        linarith
      have hE0 : 0 ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 4), (a1 k + a2 k + a3 k) :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => by obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, -, -⟩ := h0 k; linarith)
      have hU0 : 0 ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 4), (b1 k + b2 k + a1 k + a2 k) :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => by obtain ⟨h1, h2, -, h4, h5⟩ := h0 k; linarith)
      exact hT.trans (mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE hc0) (by linarith) (by linarith)
        (mul_nonneg hc0 (hE0.trans hE)))
    have keyI : ∀ (T1 T2 T3 Z W Y D n CJ : ℝ), 0 ≤ n → 0 ≤ D → 0 ≤ Z → Z ≤ W → Z ≤ Y → Z * W = Y →
        T1 ≤ c * (n * (3 * Z)) * (1 + n * (2 * (D * W) + 2 * Z)) → T2 ≤ |CJ| * Y → T3 ≤ Y →
        T1 + T2 + T3 ≤ (|CJ| + c * (3 * n) * (1 + n * (2 * D + 2)) + 1) * Y := by
      intro T1 T2 T3 Z W Y D n CJ hn hD hZ hZW hZY hZWe h1 h2 h3

    intro q Sv E e P C1 C2 b1 b2 d1 d2 α α1 α2 N1 N2 hq0 hq1 hS1 hE he0 he1 hP0 ha1 ha2 hN1 hN2

noncomputable def psiW (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)
noncomputable def psiWd (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  fderiv ℝ (psiW B G γ) ξ (dVdir B.h γ.1)
noncomputable def nPhiC (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℂ :=
  fun i => ((nPhi B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)
noncomputable def nsqC (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℂ :=
  ((dotProduct (nPhi B G γ ξ) (nPhi B G γ ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
noncomputable def pulseMatC (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ :=

  let Hm := Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) s

  let det := Hp.1 * Hm.2 - Hm.1 * Hp.2
  (if γ.2.2 then (Hm.2 * T.1 - Hm.1 * T.2) / det else (Hp.1 * T.2 - Hp.2 * T.1) / det) /
    (2 * Real.sqrt (yAmp4 B G γ ξ))

      C * SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) ∧
    NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (hDetC B G γ η)⁻¹ • (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1),
        Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1))) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b
def SignedClass4 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (Bo : ℝ) : Prop :=

  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) (presW B G (LSc4 B G l0 S))
def StressMeansSame4 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Fin 3) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → mcor B G l0 (stressStep4 B G l0 S) a ξ = mcor B G l0 S a ξ
def SignedCov4 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Prop :=
  ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
    yAvg (fun η => thA (fun θ => covT B G (W0c4 B G) (LSc4 B G l0 S) 0 1 θ η +
      covT B G (LSc4 B G l0 S) (W0c4 B G) 0 1 θ η)) ξ = sigE B G l0 S 2 ξ ∧
    yAvg (fun η => thA (fun θ => covT B G (W0c4 B G) (LSc4 B G l0 S) 0 2 θ η +
      covT B G (LSc4 B G l0 S) (W0c4 B G) 0 2 θ η)) ξ = sigE B G l0 S 1 ξ

noncomputable def sigAmp4 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  let s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ := (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)
  let Hp := Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) s
  let Hm := Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) s
  let T := (qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h) * Qb γ.1 / epsb B.h γ.1) • sigPair B G l0 S ξ
  let det := Hp.1 * Hm.2 - Hm.1 * Hp.2
  (if γ.2.2 then (Hm.2 * T.1 - Hm.1 * T.2) / det else (Hp.1 * T.2 - Hp.2 * T.1) / det) /
    (2 * Real.sqrt (yAmp4 B G γ ξ))
open Classical in
noncomputable def LSc4 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  if ActiveL4 B G γ ∧ inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (2 * G.r0) ξ.2.2.2 ∧ 0 < yAmp4 B G γ ξ then
    (Real.sqrt (epsb B.h γ.1) / 2 * etaL B.h γ ξ * sigAmp4 B G l0 S γ ξ *
      chig G.r0 (xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) * psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)) •
      G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)
  else 0
noncomputable def stressStep4 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : CState :=
  { Aw := S.Aw + potW B G (LSc4 B G l0 S), pw := S.pw + presW B G (LSc4 B G l0 S),
    Psi := S.Psi, bdir := S.bdir }
noncomputable def LSh4 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : WC :=
  fun γ m ξ => if m = 1 ∨ m = -1 then (fun i => ((LSc4 B G l0 S γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) else 0
def StressIn4 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (Bo : ℝ) : Prop :=
  StOrd4 B G l0 S (Bo + 2/5) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS)
def PrimNondegAt4 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l1 : ℕ) (c : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b d : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), l1 ≤ γ.1 → ActiveL4 B G γ → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 →
    ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
    c / Sb γ.1 ≤ |hDetC B G γ ξ| ∧
    c * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) ≤ yAmp4 B G γ ξ ∧
    NB B.h (yAmp4 B G γ) k ξ ≤
      C * SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) ∧
    NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (hDetC B G γ η)⁻¹ • (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1),
        Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1))) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b
def SignedClass4 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (Bo : ℝ) : Prop :=
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo - kapS) (LSh4 B G l0 S) ∧
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) (potW B G (LSc4 B G l0 S)) ∧

  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo + 1/2 - 2 * kapS) (velW B G (potW B G (LSc4 B G l0 S)) - LSh4 B G l0 S) ∧
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) (presW B G (LSc4 B G l0 S))
def StressMeansSame4 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Fin 3) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → mcor B G l0 (stressStep4 B G l0 S) a ξ = mcor B G l0 S a ξ
def SignedCov4 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Prop :=
  ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
    yAvg (fun η => thA (fun θ => covT B G (W0c4 B G) (LSc4 B G l0 S) 0 1 θ η +
      covT B G (LSc4 B G l0 S) (W0c4 B G) 0 1 θ η)) ξ = sigE B G l0 S 2 ξ ∧

    have k2 := key C2 b2 d2 α2 N2 ha2 hN2 (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)

cycle_step_temporal_v4.definitions:
noncomputable def fourY (f : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (k : ℤ × ℤ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), (f (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : ℂ) *
    Complex.exp (-(2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) * ((k.1 : ℂ) * (Y.1 : ℂ) + (k.2 : ℂ) * (Y.2 : ℂ)))


noncomputable def TN (f : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  (∑' k : ℤ × ℤ, if k = 0 then (0:ℂ) else
    fourY f ξ k / (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((bgc * (k.1 : ℝ) + (k.2 : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
      Complex.exp ((2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) * ((k.1 : ℂ) * (ξ.2.2.2.1 : ℂ) + (k.2 : ℂ) * (ξ.2.2.2.2 : ℂ)))).re


noncomputable def dYt (f : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := fderiv ℝ f ξ (0, 0, 0, vtv)


open Classical in
noncomputable def shInd (B : BG) (f : Cyl → ℝ) : Cyl → ℝ :=
  fun ξ => if B.Xa < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < B.Xb then f ξ else 0


noncomputable def Tprim (B : BG) (e : ℕ) (g : Cyl → ℝ) : Cyl → ℝ :=
  fun ξ => ξ.1 ^ (-(e:ℝ)) * Icut B (fun η => η.1 ^ (e:ℝ) * g η) ξ


noncomputable def Arem (B : BG) (e : ℕ) (g : Cyl → ℝ) : Cyl → ℝ :=
  fun ξ => ξ.1 ^ (-(e:ℝ)) * dR B.h (fun η => chiM B (XC B.h η)) ξ *
    ∫ r' in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r' ^ (e:ℝ) * g (pathPt B.h ξ r')


noncomputable def dvT (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Cyl → ℝ :=
  shInd B (fun ξ => -TN (EthP B G l0 S) ξ)

noncomputable def gdT (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Cyl → ℝ :=
  shInd B (fun ξ => -TN (EzP B G l0 S) ξ)

noncomputable def PsiT (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Cyl → ℝ :=
  shInd B (Tprim B 1 (gdT B G l0 S))


noncomputable def tempState (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : CState :=
  ⟨S.Aw, S.pw, fun ξ => S.Psi ξ + nrm B (Aex B.h - 1/2) (PsiT B G l0 S) ξ,
    fun ξ => S.bdir ξ + nrm B (Aex B.h) (dvT B G l0 S) ξ⟩


def TInv (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (H : ℝ) : Prop :=
  InM B (qsOf l0) H (nrm B (Aex B.h) (dvT B G l0 S)) ∧ InM B (qsOf l0) H (nrm B (Aex B.h) (gdT B G l0 S)) ∧
  (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dYt (dvT B G l0 S) ξ = -(EthP B G l0 S ξ - yAvg (EthP B G l0 S) ξ) ∧
     dYt (gdT B G l0 S) ξ = -(EzP B G l0 S ξ - yAvg (EzP B G l0 S) ξ)) ∧
  (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), yAvg (dvT B G l0 S) ξ = 0 ∧ yAvg (gdT B G l0 S) ξ = 0)

noncomputable def fourY (f : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (k : ℤ × ℤ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), (f (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : ℂ) *
    Complex.exp (-(2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) * ((k.1 : ℂ) * (Y.1 : ℂ) + (k.2 : ℂ) * (Y.2 : ℂ)))


noncomputable def TN (f : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  (∑' k : ℤ × ℤ, if k = 0 then (0:ℂ) else
    fourY f ξ k / (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((bgc * (k.1 : ℝ) + (k.2 : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
      Complex.exp ((2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) * ((k.1 : ℂ) * (ξ.2.2.2.1 : ℂ) + (k.2 : ℂ) * (ξ.2.2.2.2 : ℂ)))).re


noncomputable def dYt (f : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := fderiv ℝ f ξ (0, 0, 0, vtv)


open Classical in
noncomputable def shInd (B : BG) (f : Cyl → ℝ) : Cyl → ℝ :=
  fun ξ => if B.Xa < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < B.Xb then f ξ else 0


noncomputable def Tprim (B : BG) (e : ℕ) (g : Cyl → ℝ) : Cyl → ℝ :=
  fun ξ => ξ.1 ^ (-(e:ℝ)) * Icut B (fun η => η.1 ^ (e:ℝ) * g η) ξ


noncomputable def Arem (B : BG) (e : ℕ) (g : Cyl → ℝ) : Cyl → ℝ :=
  fun ξ => ξ.1 ^ (-(e:ℝ)) * dR B.h (fun η => chiM B (XC B.h η)) ξ *
    ∫ r' in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r' ^ (e:ℝ) * g (pathPt B.h ξ r')


noncomputable def dvT (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Cyl → ℝ :=
  shInd B (fun ξ => -TN (EthP B G l0 S) ξ)

noncomputable def gdT (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Cyl → ℝ :=

noncomputable def PsiT (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Cyl → ℝ :=

cycle_step_moment_v4.definitions:
def momUpd (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) : CState :=
  ⟨S.Aw, S.pw, fun ξ => S.Psi ξ + dPsi ξ, fun ξ => S.bdir ξ + dv ξ⟩

noncomputable def momDvP (B : BG) (dv : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) * dv ξ

noncomputable def momPsP (B : BG) (dPsi : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h) * dPsi ξ

noncomputable def momDgP (B : BG) (dPsi : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  dR B.h (momPsP B dPsi) ξ + momPsP B dPsi ξ / ξ.1

noncomputable def momDbP (B : BG) (dPsi : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := -(dZ (momPsP B dPsi) ξ)

def MomShape (B : BG) (f : Cyl → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ ξ a, f (shY ξ a) = f ξ) ∧ ∀ ξ, f ξ ≠ 0 → B.m1 ≤ XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ ≤ B.m2

def MomMeanId (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
    mcor B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 0 ξ = mcor B G l0 S 0 ξ + momDbP B dPsi ξ ∧
    mcor B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 1 ξ = mcor B G l0 S 1 ξ + momDvP B dv ξ ∧
    mcor B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 2 ξ = mcor B G l0 S 2 ξ + momDgP B dPsi ξ ∧
    ∀ a c, Wcov B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) a c ξ = Wcov B G l0 S a c ξ

noncomputable def momRg (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  let b : Cyl → ℝ := fun η => ubase B η 0
  let Gz : Cyl → ℝ := fun η => ubase B η 2
  let β : Cyl → ℝ := mcor B G l0 S 0
  let v : Cyl → ℝ := mcor B G l0 S 1
  let γz : Cyl → ℝ := mcor B G l0 S 2
  let db : Cyl → ℝ := momDbP B dPsi
  let dg : Cyl → ℝ := momDgP B dPsi
  let dw : Cyl → ℝ := momDvP B dv
  (0:ℝ) - dT db ξ - (dR B.h (fun η => 2 * b η * db η + 2 * β η * db η + db η ^ 2) ξ
      + (2 * b ξ * db ξ + 2 * β ξ * db ξ + db ξ ^ 2) / ξ.1)
    - dZ (fun η => b η * dg η + Gz η * db η + β η * dg η + γz η * db η + db η * dg η) ξ
    + (2 * v ξ * dw ξ + dw ξ ^ 2) / ξ.1 + (lap0 B.h db ξ - db ξ / ξ.1 ^ 2)

noncomputable def momDg (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  2 * ubase B ξ 1 * momDvP B dv ξ / ξ.1 + momRg B G l0 S dPsi dv ξ

noncomputable def momDgt (B : BG) (g : Cyl → ℝ) (η : Cyl) : ℝ := g η - rhoP B η * radMom g 0 η.2.1 η.2.2.1

noncomputable def momQth (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) (η : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  mcor B G l0 S 2 η * momDvP B dv η + mcor B G l0 S 1 η * momDgP B dPsi η + momDgP B dPsi η * momDvP B dv η

noncomputable def momQz (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) (η : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  2 * mcor B G l0 S 2 η * momDgP B dPsi η + momDgP B dPsi η ^ 2


def SimNorm (h : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → simScale h z τ ≤ 1 →
    ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (z, τ)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => (simScale h z τ ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
                  (simScale h z τ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖ ≤ C * simScale h z τ

bg_complex_fixed_point.definitions:
def CReg (Xi σ : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => φ p.1 p.2) (Ioo 0 Xi ×ˢ cStrip σ) ∧
  (∀ X, 0 < X → X < Xi → DifferentiableOn ℂ (φ X) (cStrip σ)) ∧
  ∀ s, s < σ → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X w, 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip s → ‖φ X w‖ ≤ C

subgoal_signatures.name: strip_cauchy_nagumo
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (σ₀ : ℝ), (∀ (s s' K : ℝ), s < s' → DifferentiableOn ℂ f (cStrip s') → (∀ z ∈ cStrip s', ‖f z‖ ≤ K) → ∀ w ∈ cStrip s, ‖deriv f w‖ ≤ K / (s' - s)) ∧ (∀ (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ), 0 < σ₀ → 0 ≤ K → DifferentiableOn ℂ f (cStrip σ₀) → (∀ (s : ℝ) (z : ℂ), 0 < s → s < σ₀ → z ∈ cStrip s → ‖f z‖ ≤ K / (σ₀ - s) ^ m) → ∀ (s : ℝ) (w : ℂ), 0 < s → s < σ₀ → w ∈ cStrip s → ‖deriv f w‖ ≤ 3 * ((m : ℝ) + 2) * K / (σ₀ - s) ^ (m + 1))

subgoal_signatures.name: creg_algebra

signature.statement: ∀ (Xi ρ : ℝ) (ac : Fin 6 → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (bc : Fin 8 → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (gc sc1 sc2 ψ1 ψ2 : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ), 0 < Xi → 0 < ρ → (∀ j i, BgHoloC Xi j (ac i)) → (∀ j i, BgHoloC Xi j (bc i)) → (∀ j, BgHoloC Xi j gc) → (∀ j, BgHoloC Xi j sc1) → (∀ j, BgHoloC Xi j sc2) → BgHoloC Xi 0 ψ1 → BgHoloC Xi 0 ψ2 → (∀ X w, 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip ρ → ψ1 X w = bgT1 ac ψ1 ψ2 X w + sc1 X w ∧ ψ2 X w = bgT2 bc gc ψ1 ψ2 X w + sc2 X w) → ∀ j, BgHoloC Xi j ψ1 ∧ BgHoloC Xi j ψ2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xi ρ ac bc gc sc1 sc2 ψ1 ψ2 hXi hρ hac hbc hgc hs1 hs2 h1 h2 hfix
  
  have hmono : ∀ (j : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ), BgHoloC Xi (j + 1) φ → BgHoloC Xi j φ := by
    rintro j φ ⟨r, C, hr, h⟩
    refine ⟨r, C, hr, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := h k (by omega)
    exact ⟨a, b, fun hkj => c (by omega)⟩
  
  have hcongr : ∀ (j : ℕ) (ρ0 : ℝ) (φ χ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ), 0 < ρ0 →
      (∀ X w, 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip ρ0 → φ X w = χ X w) →
      BgHoloC Xi j χ → BgHoloC Xi j φ := by
    rintro j ρ0 φ χ hρ0 heq ⟨r, C, hr, h⟩
    have hsub : ∀ s t : ℝ, s ≤ t → cStrip s ⊆ cStrip t := by
      intro s t hst w hw
      simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw ⊢
      exact ⟨by linarith [hw.1], by linarith [hw.2.1], by linarith [hw.2.2]⟩
    have hs1 : cStrip (min r ρ0) ⊆ cStrip r := hsub _ _ (min_le_left _ _)
    have hs2 : cStrip (min r ρ0) ⊆ cStrip ρ0 := hsub _ _ (min_le_right _ _)
    have hid : ∀ (k : ℕ) (X : ℝ) (w : ℂ), 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip (min r ρ0) →
        iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => φ Y w) X = iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => χ Y w) X := by
      intro k X w h0 h1 hw
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.iteratedDeriv_eq
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds h0 h1] with Y hY
      exact heq Y w hY.1 hY.2 (hs2 hw)
    refine ⟨min r ρ0, C, lt_min hr hρ0, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := h k hk
    refine ⟨?_, fun X h0 h1' => ⟨?_, fun w hw => ?_⟩, fun hkj X w h0 h1' hw => ?_⟩
    · exact (c1.mono (Set.prod_mono subset_rfl hs1)).congr
        (fun p hp => hid k p.1 p.2 hp.1.1 hp.1.2 hp.2)
    · exact ((c2 X h0 h1').1.mono hs1).congr (fun w hw => hid k X w h0 h1' hw)
    · rw [hid k X w h0 h1' hw]
      exact (c2 X h0 h1').2 w (hs1 hw)
    · rw [hid (k + 1) X w h0 h1' hw]
      apply (c3 hkj X w h0 h1' (hs1 hw)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds h0 h1'] with Y hY
      exact hid k Y w hY.1 hY.2 hw
  
  have hD1 : deriv (fun Y : ℝ => (Y : ℂ)) = fun _ => 1 := by
    funext x
    exact ((hasDerivAt_id x).ofReal_comp).deriv.trans (by simp)
  have hD1' : iteratedDeriv 1 (fun Y : ℝ => (Y : ℂ)) = fun _ => 1 := by
    rw [iteratedDeriv_one, hD1]
  have hZ : ∀ k : ℕ, iteratedDeriv k (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℂ)) = fun _ => 0 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih => rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, ih]; simp
  have hDk : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → iteratedDeriv n (fun Y : ℝ => (Y : ℂ)) = fun _ => 0 := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 + 1 := ⟨n - 2, by omega⟩
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', iteratedDeriv_succ', hD1]
    simp only [deriv_const']
    exact hZ m
  have hX : ∀ j : ℕ, BgHoloC Xi j (fun X _ => ((X : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    intro j
    refine ⟨1, Xi + 1, one_pos, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    show ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => iteratedDeriv k (fun Y : ℝ => (Y : ℂ)) p.1)
        (Ioo 0 Xi ×ˢ cStrip 1) ∧
      (∀ X, 0 < X → X < Xi →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun _ : ℂ => iteratedDeriv k (fun Y : ℝ => (Y : ℂ)) X) (cStrip 1) ∧
        ∀ w ∈ cStrip 1, ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun Y : ℝ => (Y : ℂ)) X‖ ≤ Xi + 1) ∧
      (k < j → ∀ X (w : ℂ), 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip 1 →
        HasDerivAt (fun Y => iteratedDeriv k (fun Y' : ℝ => (Y' : ℂ)) Y)
          (iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun Y : ℝ => (Y : ℂ)) X) X)
    have hcases : k = 0 ∨ k = 1 ∨ 2 ≤ k := by omega
    rcases hcases with rfl | rfl | hk2
    · rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, zero_add, hD1']
      refine ⟨(Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).continuousOn,
        fun X h0 _ => ⟨differentiableOn_const _, fun w _ => ?_⟩, fun _ X w _ _ _ => ?_⟩
      · rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos h0]; linarith
      · simpa using (hasDerivAt_id X).ofReal_comp
    · rw [hDk (1 + 1) (by norm_num), hD1']
      refine ⟨continuousOn_const, fun X _ _ => ⟨differentiableOn_const _, fun w _ => ?_⟩,
        fun _ X w _ _ _ => hasDerivAt_const X (1 : ℂ)⟩
      simp only [norm_one]; linarith
    · rw [hDk (k + 1) (by omega), hDk k hk2]
      refine ⟨continuousOn_const, fun X _ _ => ⟨differentiableOn_const _, fun w _ => ?_⟩,
        fun _ X w _ _ _ => hasDerivAt_const X (0 : ℂ)⟩
      simp only [norm_zero]; linarith
  
  have hRad : ∀ (j : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ), BgHoloC Xi j φ → BgHoloC Xi (j + 1) (cRad φ) := by
    intro j φ hφ
    have hK := bgHoloC_cKer Xi j (fun _ => 1) 1 0 0 φ hXi (fun t _ => by ring) hφ
    refine hcongr (j + 1) 1 (cRad φ) (cKer (fun _ => 1) φ) one_pos (fun X w h0 _ _ => ?_) hK
    have hX0 : X ≠ 0 := h0.ne'
    have hsub := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right (fun x => φ x w) hX0 (a := 0) (b := 1)
    simp only [zero_mul, one_mul] at hsub
    unfold cRad cKer
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul]
    rw [hsub]
    have hXc : (X : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hX0
    rw [Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_inv, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hXc, one_mul]
  
  have tG : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → bgkG t = 1 / 2 + (-1 / 2) * t + 0 * Real.log t := by
    intro t _; unfold bgkG; ring
  have tGp : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → bgkGp t = 0 + (1 / 2) * t + 0 * Real.log t := by
    intro t _; unfold bgkGp; ring
  have tU : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → bgkU t = 0 + 0 * t + (-1 / 2) * Real.log t := by
    intro t _; unfold bgkU; ring
  have tUp : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → bgkUp t = 1 / 2 + 0 * t + 0 * Real.log t := by
    intro t _; unfold bgkUp; ring
  have tS : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → bgkS t = -1 / 2 + (1 / 2) * t + (-1 / 2) * Real.log t := by
    intro t _; unfold bgkS; ring
  
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
  | succ j ih =>
    obtain ⟨i1, i2⟩ := ih
    have d1 : BgHoloC Xi j (cDw ψ1) := bgHoloC_cDw Xi j ψ1 i1
    have d2 : BgHoloC Xi j (cDw ψ2) := bgHoloC_cDw Xi j ψ2 i2
    have dg : BgHoloC Xi (j + 1) (cDw gc) := bgHoloC_cDw Xi (j + 1) gc (hgc (j + 1))
    have kG1 := bgHoloC_cKer Xi j bgkG _ _ _ ψ1 hXi tG i1
    have kGp1 := bgHoloC_cKer Xi j bgkGp _ _ _ ψ1 hXi tGp i1
    have kGd1 := bgHoloC_cKer Xi j bgkG _ _ _ (cDw ψ1) hXi tG d1
    have kU2 := bgHoloC_cKer Xi j bgkU _ _ _ ψ2 hXi tU i2
    have kUp2 := bgHoloC_cKer Xi j bgkUp _ _ _ ψ2 hXi tUp i2
    have kUd2 := bgHoloC_cKer Xi j bgkU _ _ _ (cDw ψ2) hXi tU d2
    have kS2 := bgHoloC_cKer Xi j bgkS _ _ _ ψ2 hXi tS i2
    have kSd2 := bgHoloC_cKer Xi j bgkS _ _ _ (cDw ψ2) hXi tS d2
    have P5 := bgHoloC_mul Xi (j + 1) gc (cKer bgkG ψ1) (hgc (j + 1)) kG1
    have R5 := hRad j _ (hmono j _ P5)
    have P6 := bgHoloC_add Xi (j + 1) _ _
      (bgHoloC_mul Xi (j + 1) (cDw gc) (cKer bgkG ψ1) dg kG1)
      (bgHoloC_mul Xi (j + 1) gc (cKer bgkG (cDw ψ1)) (hgc (j + 1)) kGd1)
    have R6 := hRad j _ (hmono j _ P6)
    have P7 := bgHoloC_mul Xi (j + 1) _ _ (hX (j + 1)) P5
    have T1 : BgHoloC Xi (j + 1) (fun X w => bgT1 ac ψ1 ψ2 X w + sc1 X w) :=
      bgHoloC_add Xi (j + 1) _ _
        (bgHoloC_add Xi (j + 1) _ _
          (bgHoloC_add Xi (j + 1) _ _
            (bgHoloC_add Xi (j + 1) _ _
              (bgHoloC_add Xi (j + 1) _ _
                (bgHoloC_add Xi (j + 1) _ _
                  (bgHoloC_mul Xi (j + 1) _ _ (hac (j + 1) 0) kG1)
                  (bgHoloC_mul Xi (j + 1) _ _ (hac (j + 1) 1) kGp1))
                (bgHoloC_mul Xi (j + 1) _ _ (hac (j + 1) 2) kGd1))
              (bgHoloC_mul Xi (j + 1) _ _ (hac (j + 1) 3) kU2))
            (bgHoloC_mul Xi (j + 1) _ _ (hac (j + 1) 4) kS2))
          (bgHoloC_mul Xi (j + 1) _ _ (hac (j + 1) 5) kSd2))
        (hs1 (j + 1))
    have T2 : BgHoloC Xi (j + 1) (fun X w => bgT2 bc gc ψ1 ψ2 X w + sc2 X w) :=
      bgHoloC_add Xi (j + 1) _ _
        (bgHoloC_add Xi (j + 1) _ _
          (bgHoloC_add Xi (j + 1) _ _
            (bgHoloC_add Xi (j + 1) _ _
              (bgHoloC_add Xi (j + 1) _ _
                (bgHoloC_add Xi (j + 1) _ _
                  (bgHoloC_add Xi (j + 1) _ _
                    (bgHoloC_add Xi (j + 1) _ _
                      (bgHoloC_mul Xi (j + 1) _ _ (hbc (j + 1) 0) kU2)
                      (bgHoloC_mul Xi (j + 1) _ _ (hbc (j + 1) 1) kUp2))
                    (bgHoloC_mul Xi (j + 1) _ _ (hbc (j + 1) 2) kUd2))
                  (bgHoloC_mul Xi (j + 1) _ _ (hbc (j + 1) 3) kS2))
                (bgHoloC_mul Xi (j + 1) _ _ (hbc (j + 1) 4) kSd2))
              (bgHoloC_mul Xi (j + 1) _ _ (hbc (j + 1) 5) R5))
            (bgHoloC_mul Xi (j + 1) _ _ (hbc (j + 1) 6) R6))
          (bgHoloC_mul Xi (j + 1) _ _ (hbc (j + 1) 7) P7))
        (hs2 (j + 1))
    exact ⟨hcongr (j + 1) ρ ψ1 _ hρ (fun X w a b c => (hfix X w a b c).1) T1,
      hcongr (j + 1) ρ ψ2 _ hρ (fun X w a b c => (hfix X w a b c).2) T2⟩

  ·

    have hd : HasDerivAt (φ X) (deriv (φ X) (η : ℂ)) (η : ℂ) :=

      exact hre.deriv

by
  intro Xi ψ H1 H2
  choose ρ' C' hρ' hcl using H1

    intro k
    cases k with
    | zero => rw [hρ0]
    | succ k => rw [hρs]; exact min_le_right _ _
  have P3 : ∀ k, ρ (k + 1) ≤ ρ k := fun k => by rw [hρs]; exact min_le_left _ _
  refine ⟨fun k X w => iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => ψ Y w) X, ρ, C', fun k => ⟨P1 k, P3 k⟩,
    ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
