    have e : (|C1| + |C2|) * q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P =
        |C1| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) +
        |C2| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) := by ring
    rw [e]
    linarith
  
  have hNB : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f1 f2 g : Cyl → V) (k : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl),
      ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f1 (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f2 (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), g η = f1 η + f2 η) → NB B.h g k ξ ≤ NB B.h f1 k ξ + NB B.h f2 k ξ := by
    intro V _ _ f1 f2 g k ξ hξ hf1 hf2 heq
    have hn : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∈ nhds ξ := hDopen.mem_nhds hξ
    have hev : g =ᶠ[nhds ξ] f1 + f2 := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hn (fun η hη => heq η hη)
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g ξ = iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ := by
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
      exact iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((hf1.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        ((hf2.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    unfold NB
    rw [e1]
    have e2 : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) +
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) := by
      ext m
      simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e2]
    exact norm_add_le _ _
  
  have hvel_add : ∀ (a1 a2 : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl),
      (∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => a1 γ m η i) ξ) →
      (∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => a2 γ m η i) ξ) →
      velW B G (a1 + a2) γ m ξ = velW B G a1 γ m ξ + velW B G a2 γ m ξ := by
    intro a1 a2 γ m ξ hd1 hd2
    have hfd : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (v : Cyl), fderiv ℝ (fun η => a1 γ m η i + a2 γ m η i) ξ v =
        fderiv ℝ (fun η => a1 γ m η i) ξ v + fderiv ℝ (fun η => a2 γ m η i) ξ v := by
      intro i v
      rw [fderiv_fun_add (hd1 i) (hd2 i), ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [velW, velC, DrC, DzC, dR, dZ, hfd, hd1, hd2] <;> ring
  have hvel_zero : ∀ (a : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), a γ m = 0 → velW B G a γ m = 0 := by
    intro a γ m h0
    funext ξ j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [velW, velC, DrC, DzC, dR, dZ, h0]
  have hvel_congr : ∀ (a a' : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), a γ m = a' γ m →
      velW B G a γ m = velW B G a' γ m := by
    intro a a' γ m h
    funext ξ
    show velC B G a γ m ξ = velC B G a' γ m ξ
    unfold velC
    rw [h]
  
  have hInWg : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (α α1 α2 : ℝ)
      (a1 a2 c : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → V),
      InWg B G (qsOf l0) α1 a1 → InWg B G (qsOf l0) α2 a2 → α ≤ α1 → α ≤ α2 →
      (∃ H : Finset ℤ, (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧ ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → c γ m = 0) →
      (∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), c γ m ξ = a1 γ m ξ + a2 γ m ξ) → InWg B G (qsOf l0) α c := by
    intro V _ _ α α1 α2 a1 a2 c h1 h2 ha1 ha2 hfr heq
    obtain ⟨-, s1, d1, u1, b1⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨-, s2, d2, u2, b2⟩ := h2
    refine ⟨hfr, fun γ m => ((s1 γ m).add (s2 γ m)).congr (heq γ m), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro γ m ξ hξ a ha
      rw [heq γ m _ (hDsh ξ hξ a), heq γ m ξ hξ, d1 γ m ξ hξ a ha, d2 γ m ξ hξ a ha]
    · intro γ m ξ hξ hne
      rw [heq γ m ξ hξ] at hne
      by_cases h : a1 γ m ξ = 0
      · rw [h, zero_add] at hne
        exact u2 γ m ξ hξ hne
      · exact u1 γ m ξ hξ h
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨C1, c1, e1, hb1⟩ := b1 k
      obtain ⟨C2, c2, e2, hb2⟩ := b2 k
      refine ⟨|C1| + |C2|, max c1 c2, max e1 e2, fun γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hq0, hq1, hS1⟩ := hDq ξ hξ
      obtain ⟨hE, he0, he1⟩ := hEdge _ hX1 hX2
      have hn := hNB (a1 γ m) (a2 γ m) (c γ m) k ξ hξ (s1 γ m) (s2 γ m) (heq γ m)
      have hP : 0 ≤ Penv B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by
        unfold Penv
        exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      have := hW (qC B.h ξ) (SC B.h ξ) (Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)))
        (edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ)) (Penv B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2))
        C1 C2 c1 c2 e1 e2 α α1 α2 _ _ hq0 hq1 hS1 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) he0 he1 hP ha1 ha2
        (hb1 γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2) (hb2 γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2)
      exact le_trans hn this
  
  have hWanti : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (a : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → V)
      (α α' : ℝ), α' ≤ α → InWg B G (qsOf l0) α a → InWg B G (qsOf l0) α' a := by
    intro V _ _ a α α' hαα ha
    obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3, c4, c5⟩ := ha
    refine ⟨c1, c2, c3, c4, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, b, d, hC⟩ := c5 k
    refine ⟨|C|, b, d, fun γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hq0, hq1, hS1⟩ := hDq ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨_, he0, _⟩ := hEdge _ hX1 hX2
    refine le_trans (hC γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2) ?_
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by unfold Penv; exact (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos he0 _).le
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
    calc C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) ≤ |C| * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)
      _ ≤ |C| * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α') :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hαα hh0)) (abs_nonneg C)
  
  have hMcongr : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (α : ℝ) (f g : Cyl → V),
      InM B (qsOf l0) α f → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), g ξ = f ξ) → InM B (qsOf l0) α g := by
    intro V _ _ α f g hf heq
    obtain ⟨s1, d1, z1, b1⟩ := hf
    refine ⟨s1.congr heq, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro ξ hξ a ha
      rw [heq _ (hDsh ξ hξ a), heq ξ hξ, d1 ξ hξ a ha]
    · intro ξ hξ hX
      rw [heq ξ hξ, z1 ξ hξ hX]
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨C, b, d, hb⟩ := b1 k
      refine ⟨C, b, d, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
      have hn : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∈ nhds ξ := hDopen.mem_nhds hξ
      have hev : g =ᶠ[nhds ξ] f := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hn (fun η hη => heq η hη)
      have e1 : NB B.h g k ξ = NB B.h f k ξ := by
        unfold NB
        rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
      rw [e1]
      exact hb ξ hξ hX1 hX2
  have hMzero : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (α : ℝ) (g : Cyl → V),
      (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), g ξ = 0) → InM B (qsOf l0) α g := by
    intro V _ _ α g h0
    refine ⟨(contDiffOn_const (c := (0:V))).congr h0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro ξ hξ a _
      rw [h0 _ (hDsh ξ hξ a), h0 ξ hξ]
    · intro ξ hξ _
      exact h0 ξ hξ
    · intro k
      refine ⟨0, 0, 0, fun ξ hξ _ _ => ?_⟩
      have hn : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∈ nhds ξ := hDopen.mem_nhds hξ
      have hev : g =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun _ => (0:V) := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hn (fun η hη => h0 η hη)
      have e1 : NB B.h g k ξ = 0 := by
        unfold NB
        rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds, norm_eq_zero]
        ext m
        simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
      rw [e1]
      simp
  
  have hIn' : StOrd4 B G l0 S (Bo + 2/5) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) := hIn
  unfold StOrd4 at hIn'
  obtain ⟨In1, In2, In3, In4, In5, In6, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, In16, In17, In18, In19, -, In21,
    In22, In23⟩ := hIn'
  have hSC' : SignedClass4 B G l0 S Bo := hSC
  unfold SignedClass4 at hSC'
  obtain ⟨-, SC2, SC3, -, SC5⟩ := hSC'
  have hMS' : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) →
      mcor B G l0 (stressStep4 B G l0 S) a ξ = mcor B G l0 S a ξ := hMS
  
  have e1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ Bo + 1/2 - kapS := by rw [hk]; linarith
  have e2 : (1/2:ℝ) ≤ Bo - kapS := by rw [hk]; linarith
  have e3 : (0.68:ℝ) ≤ Bo - kapS := by
    have h68 : (0.68:ℝ) = 17/25 := by norm_num
    rw [hk, h68]; linarith
  have e4 : Bo - kapS ≤ Bo + 1/2 - kapS := by linarith
  
  have eAw : (stressStep4 B G l0 S).Aw = S.Aw + potW B G (LSc4 B G l0 S) := rfl
  have epw : (stressStep4 B G l0 S).pw = S.pw + presW B G (LSc4 B G l0 S) := rfl
  
  obtain ⟨H1, h01, hH1⟩ := In1.1
  obtain ⟨H2, h02, hH2⟩ := SC2.1
  have h0H : (0:ℤ) ∉ H1 ∪ H2 := by
    rw [Finset.mem_union, not_or]
    exact ⟨h01, h02⟩
  have hfr1 : ∀ γ m, m ∉ H1 ∪ H2 → (stressStep4 B G l0 S).Aw γ m = 0 := by
    intro γ m hm
    rw [Finset.mem_union, not_or] at hm
    rw [eAw]
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    rw [hH1 γ m hm.1, hH2 γ m hm.2, add_zero]
  have b1 : InWg B G (qsOf l0) 1 (stressStep4 B G l0 S).Aw :=
    hInWg 1 1 (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) S.Aw (potW B G (LSc4 B G l0 S)) _ In1 SC2 le_rfl e1
      ⟨H1 ∪ H2, h0H, hfr1⟩ (fun γ m ξ _ => rfl)
  obtain ⟨G1, g01, hG1⟩ := In2.1
  obtain ⟨G2, g02, hG2⟩ := SC5.1
  have b2 : InWg B G (qsOf l0) 1 (stressStep4 B G l0 S).pw := by
    refine hInWg 1 1 (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) S.pw (presW B G (LSc4 B G l0 S)) _ In2 SC5 le_rfl e1
      ⟨G1 ∪ G2, ?_, ?_⟩ (fun γ m ξ _ => rfl)
    · rw [Finset.mem_union, not_or]
      exact ⟨g01, g02⟩
    · intro γ m hm
      rw [Finset.mem_union, not_or] at hm
      rw [epw]
      simp only [Pi.add_apply]
      rw [hG1 γ m hm.1, hG2 γ m hm.2, add_zero]
  
  have hdiffAw : ∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ i,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => S.Aw γ m η i) ξ := fun γ m ξ hξ i =>
    differentiableAt_pi.mp
      (((In1.2.1 γ m).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hDopen.mem_nhds hξ)) i
  have hdiffP : ∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ i,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => potW B G (LSc4 B G l0 S) γ m η i) ξ := fun γ m ξ hξ i =>
    differentiableAt_pi.mp
      (((SC2.2.1 γ m).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hDopen.mem_nhds hξ)) i
  have hvelS2 : ∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), velW B G (stressStep4 B G l0 S).Aw γ m ξ =
      velW B G S.Aw γ m ξ + velW B G (potW B G (LSc4 B G l0 S)) γ m ξ := by
    intro γ m ξ hξ
    rw [eAw]
    exact hvel_add _ _ γ m ξ (hdiffAw γ m ξ hξ) (hdiffP γ m ξ hξ)
  have b16 : InWg B G (qsOf l0) (1/2) (velW B G (stressStep4 B G l0 S).Aw) :=
    hInWg (1/2) (1/2) (Bo - kapS) (velW B G S.Aw) (velW B G (potW B G (LSc4 B G l0 S))) _ In16 SC3
      le_rfl e2 ⟨H1 ∪ H2, h0H, fun γ m hm => hvel_zero _ γ m (hfr1 γ m hm)⟩ hvelS2
  obtain ⟨H7, h07, hH7⟩ := In17.1
  have h0H7 : (0:ℤ) ∉ H7 ∪ H2 := by
    rw [Finset.mem_union, not_or]
    exact ⟨h07, h02⟩
  have hfr17 : ∀ γ m, m ∉ H7 ∪ H2 → (velW B G (stressStep4 B G l0 S).Aw - W0h4 B G) γ m = 0 := by
    intro γ m hm
    rw [Finset.mem_union, not_or] at hm
    have hA : (stressStep4 B G l0 S).Aw γ m = S.Aw γ m := by
      rw [eAw]
      simp only [Pi.add_apply]
      rw [hH2 γ m hm.2, add_zero]
    have e7 := hH7 γ m hm.1
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at e7 ⊢
    rw [hvel_congr _ _ γ m hA]
    exact e7
  have b17 : InWg B G (qsOf l0) 0.68 (velW B G (stressStep4 B G l0 S).Aw - W0h4 B G) :=
    hInWg 0.68 0.68 (Bo - kapS) (velW B G S.Aw - W0h4 B G) (velW B G (potW B G (LSc4 B G l0 S))) _
      In17 SC3 le_rfl e3 ⟨H7 ∪ H2, h0H7, hfr17⟩ (fun γ m ξ hξ => by
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
        rw [hvelS2 γ m ξ hξ]
        abel)
  have b18 : InM B (qsOf l0) 0.9 (nrm B (Aex B.h) (mcor B G l0 (stressStep4 B G l0 S) 1)) :=
    hMcongr 0.9 _ _ In18 (fun ξ hξ => by simp only [nrm]; rw [hMS' 1 ξ hξ])
  have b19 : InM B (qsOf l0) 0.9 (nrm B (Aex B.h) (mcor B G l0 (stressStep4 B G l0 S) 2)) :=
    hMcongr 0.9 _ _ In19 (fun ξ hξ => by simp only [nrm]; rw [hMS' 2 ξ hξ])
  have b21 : InM B (qsOf l0) 1.9 (nrm B (Aex B.h) (mcor B G l0 (stressStep4 B G l0 S) 0)) :=
    hMcongr 1.9 _ _ In21 (fun ξ hξ => by simp only [nrm]; rw [hMS' 0 ξ hξ])
  have hrad : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (e : ℕ) (z t : ℝ), t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 →
      radMom (mcor B G l0 (stressStep4 B G l0 S) a) e z t = radMom (mcor B G l0 S a) e z t := by
    intro a e z t ht hq
    unfold radMom
    refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun r hr => ?_)
    have hr' : (0:ℝ) < r := hr
    have hy : yAvg (mcor B G l0 (stressStep4 B G l0 S) a) (r, z, t, 0) =
        yAvg (mcor B G l0 S a) (r, z, t, 0) := by
      unfold yAvg
      congr 1
      funext Y
      exact hMS' a _ ⟨hr', ht, hq⟩
    show r ^ e * yAvg (mcor B G l0 (stressStep4 B G l0 S) a) (r, z, t, 0) =
      r ^ e * yAvg (mcor B G l0 S a) (r, z, t, 0)
    rw [hy]
  have b22 : ∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 →
      radMom (mcor B G l0 (stressStep4 B G l0 S) 1) 2 z t = 0 := fun z t ht hq => by
    rw [hrad 1 2 z t ht hq]
    exact In22 z t ht hq
  have b23 : ∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 →
      radMom (mcor B G l0 (stressStep4 B G l0 S) 2) 1 z t = 0 := fun z t ht hq => by
    rw [hrad 2 1 z t ht hq]
    exact In23 z t ht hq
  
  have hdAw : (stressStep4 B G l0 S).Aw - S.Aw = potW B G (LSc4 B G l0 S) := by
    rw [eAw]; abel
  have hdpw : (stressStep4 B G l0 S).pw - S.pw = presW B G (LSc4 B G l0 S) := by
    rw [epw]; abel
  have i1 : InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo - kapS) ((stressStep4 B G l0 S).Aw - S.Aw) := by
    rw [hdAw]; exact hWanti _ _ _ e4 SC2
  have i2 : InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo - kapS) (velW B G ((stressStep4 B G l0 S).Aw - S.Aw)) := by
    rw [hdAw]; exact SC3
  have i3 : InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo - kapS) ((stressStep4 B G l0 S).pw - S.pw) := by
    rw [hdpw]; exact hWanti _ _ _ e4 SC5
  have i4 : InM B (qsOf l0) (Bo - kapS) ((stressStep4 B G l0 S).Psi - S.Psi) :=
    hMzero (Bo - kapS) _ (fun ξ _ => by
      show S.Psi ξ - S.Psi ξ = 0
      exact sub_self _)
  have i5 : InM B (qsOf l0) (Bo - kapS) ((stressStep4 B G l0 S).bdir - S.bdir) :=
    hMzero (Bo - kapS) _ (fun ξ _ => by
      show S.bdir ξ - S.bdir ξ = 0
      exact sub_self _)
  have i7 : InM B (qsOf l0) (Bo - kapS + 1)
      (nrm B (Aex B.h) (fun ξ => mcor B G l0 (stressStep4 B G l0 S) 0 ξ - mcor B G l0 S 0 ξ)) :=
    hMzero (Bo - kapS + 1) _ (fun ξ hξ => by
      simp only [nrm]
      rw [hMS' 0 ξ hξ, sub_self, mul_zero])
  have i8 : InM B (qsOf l0) (Bo - kapS)
      (nrm B (Aex B.h) (fun ξ => mcor B G l0 (stressStep4 B G l0 S) 2 ξ - mcor B G l0 S 2 ξ)) :=
    hMzero (Bo - kapS) _ (fun ξ hξ => by
      simp only [nrm]
      rw [hMS' 2 ξ hξ, sub_self, mul_zero])
  exact ⟨⟨b1, b2, In3, In4, In5, In6⟩, ⟨b16, b17, b18, b19, b21, b22, b23⟩,
    ⟨i1, i2, i3, i4, i5, i7, i8⟩⟩

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim4 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ,
    l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (S : CState) (α : ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (grP B G l0 S)) →
    ∀ m N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) → 0 < rad x →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fun y s => radRem B G l0 S (ptOf y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y₀)))) (x, t)‖
        ≤ C * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (N : ℝ)

∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim4 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →
    ∀ (S : CState) (Bo : ℝ), 7/10 ≤ Bo →
    StOrd4 B G l0 S (Bo + 2/5 - kapS) (Bo + 1/2 + 17/100) (Bo + 1/2 - 2 * kapS) (Bo + 1/2 - 2 * kapS) →
    TInv B G l0 S (Bo + 1/2 - 2 * kapS)

∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim4 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →

  intro h _ _ hS

  open Pointwise in
  have hom : ∀ μ z τ : ℝ, 0 < μ →
      simScale h (μ ^ (1/2 - h) * z) (μ * τ) = μ * simScale h z τ := by
    intro μ z τ hμ
    have key : ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p → μ * p - (μ ^ (1/2 - h) * z) ^ 2 * (μ * p) ^ (2 * h) =
        μ * (p - z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h)) := by

      have sq : (μ ^ (1/2 - h)) ^ 2 = μ ^ (1 - 2 * h) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hμ.le]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring
      have split : μ ^ (1 - 2 * h) * μ ^ (2 * h) = μ := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hμ]
        have e : 1 - 2 * h + 2 * h = 1 := by ring
        rw [e, Real.rpow_one]
      rw [mul_pow, sq, Real.mul_rpow hμ.le hp.le]

    have hset : {q : ℝ | 0 < q ∧ μ * τ ≤ q - (μ ^ (1/2 - h) * z) ^ 2 * q ^ (2 * h)} =

      ext q

    rw [hset, Real.sInf_smul_of_nonneg hμ.le, smul_eq_mul]

    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hQ0.le fun y => ?_
    show ‖M y‖ ≤ Q * ‖y‖

    _ ≤ Q * C := mul_le_mul hMn (hC Z T hT0 hZT) (norm_nonneg _) hQ0.le

  have key : ∀ (γ q S W e : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → 1 ≤ S → 0 ≤ W → 0 < e → e ≤ 1 →
      ∀ (C₀ a b₀ d₀ b' d' : ℝ), γ ≤ a → b₀ ≤ b' → d₀ ≤ d' →
      C₀ * q ^ (B.h * a) * S ^ b₀ * W * e ^ (-d₀) ≤
        |C₀| * (q ^ (B.h * γ) * S ^ b' * W * e ^ (-d')) := by
    intro γ q S W e hq0 hq1 hS1 hW he0 he1 C₀ a b₀ d₀ b' d' ha hb hd
    have P := wm C₀ q a γ S b₀ b' hq0 hq1 ha hS1 hb
    have E : e ^ (-d₀) ≤ e ^ (-d') := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge he0 he1 (neg_le_neg hd)

    have hn : 0 ≤ |C₀| * q ^ (B.h * γ) * S ^ b' * W :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _))
        (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)) hW
    calc C₀ * q ^ (B.h * a) * S ^ b₀ * W * e ^ (-d₀)
        ≤ |C₀| * q ^ (B.h * γ) * S ^ b' * W * e ^ (-d₀) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right P hW) hep
      _ ≤ |C₀| * q ^ (B.h * γ) * S ^ b' * W * e ^ (-d') :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left E hn
      _ = _ := by ring
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro α β γ c d f g k hf hg hγα hγβ hk
    obtain ⟨f1, f2, f3, f4⟩ := hf
    obtain ⟨g1, g2, g3, g4⟩ := hg

    · intro ξ hξ a ha
      have hsh : shY ξ a ∈ DomC B.h qs := hξ
      rw [hk _ hsh, f2 ξ hξ a ha, g2 ξ hξ a ha, hk ξ hξ]
    · intro ξ hξ hX

      ring
    · intro n
      obtain ⟨C₁, b₁, d₁, H₁⟩ := f4 n
      obtain ⟨C₂, b₂, d₂, H₂⟩ := g4 n
      refine ⟨|c| * |C₁| + |d| * |C₂|, max b₁ b₂, max d₁ d₂, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
      have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qs := hξ
      have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ'.2.1])).1
      have hq1 : qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 := hξ'.2.2.le.trans hqs1
      have hSC : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
        unfold SC
        exact one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))])
      have hEW : 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) := by
        unfold edgeWeight
        split_ifs
        · positivity
        · exact le_rfl
      have hX0 : 0 < XC B.h ξ := hXa.trans hX1
      have hE0 : 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) := by
        unfold edgeDist
        exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX1))
          (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr hX2)))
      have hE1 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ≤ 1 := by
        unfold edgeDist
        exact min_le_left _ _
      have k1 := (H₁ ξ hξ hX1 hX2).trans (key γ _ _ _ _ hq0 hq1 hSC hEW hE0 hE1 C₁ α b₁ d₁
        (max b₁ b₂) (max d₁ d₂) hγα (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _))
      have k2 := (H₂ ξ hξ hX1 hX2).trans (key γ _ _ _ _ hq0 hq1 hSC hEW hE0 hE1 C₂ β b₂ d₂
        (max b₁ b₂) (max d₁ d₂) hγβ (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
      have hk0 : NB B.h k n ξ ≤ |c| * NB B.h f n ξ + |d| * NB B.h g n ξ :=
        hkb n ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hξ
      exact hk0.trans ((add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k1 (abs_nonneg c))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k2 (abs_nonneg d))).trans (le_of_eq (by ring)))
  · intro α β γ c d F G K hF hG hγα hγβ hK
    obtain ⟨F1, F2⟩ := hF
    obtain ⟨G1, G2⟩ := hG
    obtain ⟨hKsm, hKb⟩ := lin _ F G K c d hΩ F1 G1 (fun w hw => hK w hw.1 hw.2)

    obtain ⟨C₁, b₁, H₁⟩ := F2 n
    obtain ⟨C₂, b₂, H₂⟩ := G2 n
    refine ⟨|c| * |C₁| + |d| * |C₂|, max b₁ b₂, fun w hw1 hw2 => ?_⟩
    have hs0 : 0 < simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) := (hS.1 w.1 (1 - w.2) (by linarith)).1
    have hs1 : simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 := hw2.le.trans hqs1
    have hL : 1 ≤ 1 + |Real.log (simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2))| := by
      linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2)))]
    have k1 := (H₁ w hw1 hw2).trans (wm C₁ _ α γ _ (2 * b₁) (2 * max b₁ b₂) hs0 hs1 hγα hL
      (by linarith [le_max_left b₁ b₂]))
    have k2 := (H₂ w hw1 hw2).trans (wm C₂ _ β γ _ (2 * b₂) (2 * max b₁ b₂) hs0 hs1 hγβ hL
      (by linarith [le_max_right b₁ b₂]))
    have hk0 := hKb n w ((simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
        (simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)) ⟨hw1, hw2⟩
    exact hk0.trans ((add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k1 (abs_nonneg c))
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k2 (abs_nonneg d))).trans (le_of_eq (by ring)))

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (B : BG), B.ok → SimNorm B.h → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →
    ∀ (Pt Jt Jzt : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (α : ℝ),
    InS B (qsOf l0) α (nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h) Pt) → InS B (qsOf l0) α (nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h - 3/2) Jt) →
    InS B (qsOf l0) α (nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h - 1) Jzt) →
    ∃ dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ, MomShape B dPsi ∧ MomShape B dv ∧
      InM B (qsOf l0) α dPsi ∧ InM B (qsOf l0) α dv ∧ InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (Aex B.h) (momDvP B dv)) ∧
      InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (Aex B.h) (momDgP B dPsi)) ∧
      InM B (qsOf l0) (α + 1) (nrm B (Aex B.h) (momDbP B dPsi)) ∧
      ∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 →
        radMom (momDvP B dv) 2 z t = 0 ∧ radMom (momDgP B dPsi) 1 z t = 0 ∧
        radMom (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 1 * momDvP B dv η / η.1) 0 z t = -Pt z t ∧
        radMom (fun η => ubase B η 2 * momDvP B dv η + ubase B η 1 * momDgP B dPsi η) 2 z t = -Jt z t ∧
        radMom (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 2 * momDgP B dPsi η - ubase B η 1 * momDvP B dv η) 1 z t = -Jzt z t

by

  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n0, fun l0 hl0 Pt Jt Jzt α hP hJ hJz => ?_⟩
  
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqs0 : 0 < qsOf l0 := by rw [hQb]; positivity
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hl0) hn0.le
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := hqsB.trans hqB1

    intro ξ hξ
    have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
    exact (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ'.2.1])).1
  
  have ha0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have hab : Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) < Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) := Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by linarith) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨ΦP, ΦJ, Ψ, Ψt, cP, cJ, cΨ, cΨt, sP, sJ, sΨ, sΨt, hΨtd, i1, i2, i3, i4, i5, i6, i7, i8⟩ :=
    mom_inc_profiles_v4 _ _ B.lam ha0 hab hlam
  have hψm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ => -((1 + y ^ 2) / B.cpatch)) := by fun_prop
  have hψp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ => (1 + y ^ 2) / B.cpatch) := by fun_prop
  
  obtain ⟨dPsi, hdPsi⟩ : ∃ f : Cyl → ℝ, f = fun ξ => (-((1 + etaC B.h ξ ^ 2) / B.cpatch)) *
      nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h - 3/2) Jt (ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) * Ψ (ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨dv, hdv⟩ : ∃ f : Cyl → ℝ, f = fun ξ => (-((1 + etaC B.h ξ ^ 2) / B.cpatch)) *
      nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h) Pt (ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) * ΦP (ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ)) +

      ΦJ (ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hXC : ∀ ξ : Cyl, Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) < ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) →
      ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) < Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) → B.m1 ≤ XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ ≤ B.m2 := by
    intro ξ h1 h2
    have hx0 : 0 < ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := ha0.trans h1
    have hs0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := by
      rcases (Real.sqrt_nonneg (qC B.h ξ)).lt_or_eq with h | h
      · exact h
      · rw [← h, div_zero] at hx0
        exact absurd hx0 (lt_irrefl 0)
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := Real.sqrt_pos.mp hs0
    have hsq : Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) ^ 2 = qC B.h ξ := Real.sq_sqrt hq0.le
    have hx2 : (ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ)) ^ 2 = 2 * XC B.h ξ := by
      rw [div_pow, hsq, XC]
      field_simp
    have hm1s : Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) ^ 2 = 2 * B.m1 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
    have hm2s : Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) ^ 2 = 2 * B.m2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
    have e1 := mul_self_lt_mul_self ha0.le h1
    have e2 := mul_self_lt_mul_self hx0.le h2
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  have hshP : MomShape B dPsi := by

    · exact hXC ξ (sP _ h1).1 (sP _ h1).2

  have hv1 := mom_profile_class_v4 B _ α (fun y => -((1 + y ^ 2) / B.cpatch)) ΦP

  have hv2 := mom_profile_class_v4 B _ α (fun y => (1 + y ^ 2) / B.cpatch) ΦJ
      (nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h - 1) Jzt) hok hSN hqs0 hqs1 hψp cJ sJ hJz
  have hcdv : InM B (qsOf l0) α dv := by
    refine hMc α α α 1 1 _ _ _ hv1 hv2 le_rfl le_rfl (fun ξ _ => ?_)
    rw [hdv]
    simp only [one_mul]
  have hcw : InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (Aex B.h) (momDvP B dv)) := by
    refine hMc α α α 1 0 _ _ _ hcdv hcdv le_rfl le_rfl (fun ξ hξ => ?_)
    have hq := hqpos ξ hξ
    simp only [nrm, momDvP]
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hq]
    simp
  have hg0 := mom_profile_class_v4 B _ α (fun y => -((1 + y ^ 2) / B.cpatch)) Ψt
      (nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h - 3/2) Jt) hok hSN hqs0 hqs1 hψm cΨt sΨt hJ
  have hdg : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), nrm B (Aex B.h) (momDgP B dPsi) ξ =

        Ψt (ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ)) := by
    intro ξ hξ

    have hq := hqpos ξ hξ
    have hx : 0 < ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := div_pos hξ'.1 (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq)
    have h6 := mom_dgP_formula_v4 B (qsOf l0) (fun y => -((1 + y ^ 2) / B.cpatch)) Ψ

    rw [hdPsi, hΨtd _ hx]

  have hcg : InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (Aex B.h) (momDgP B dPsi)) := by

  have hcb : InM B (qsOf l0) (α + 1) (nrm B (Aex B.h) (momDbP B dPsi)) :=

  have hdg' : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), momDgP B dPsi ξ = qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) *

    ∀ (S : CState) (bw ca cm cd : ℝ) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ), StOrd4 B G l0 S bw ca cm cd →
    MomShape B dPsi → MomShape B dv → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ dPsi (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ dv (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → MomMeanId B G l0 S dPsi dv →
    (∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 →
        radMom (momDvP B dv) 2 z t = 0 ∧ radMom (momDgP B dPsi) 1 z t = 0 ∧
        radMom (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 1 * momDvP B dv η / η.1) 0 z t = -calP B G l0 S z t ∧
        radMom (fun η => ubase B η 2 * momDvP B dv η + ubase B η 1 * momDgP B dPsi η) 2 z t =
          -calJth B G l0 S z t ∧
        radMom (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 2 * momDgP B dPsi η - ubase B η 1 * momDvP B dv η) 1 z t =
          -calJz B G l0 S z t) →
    (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
        grP B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) ξ = grP B G l0 S ξ + momDg B G l0 S dPsi dv ξ ∧
        pmP B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) ξ = pmP B G l0 S ξ + Icut B (momDgt B (momDg B G l0 S dPsi dv)) ξ) ∧
    ∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 →
      calP B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) z t = calP B G l0 S z t + radMom (momDg B G l0 S dPsi dv) 0 z t ∧
      calP B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) z t = radMom (momRg B G l0 S dPsi dv) 0 z t ∧
      calJth B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) z t = radMom (momQth B G l0 S dPsi dv) 2 z t ∧
      calJz B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) z t =
        radMom (momQz B G l0 S dPsi dv) 1 z t - (1/2) * radMom (momRg B G l0 S dPsi dv) 2 z t ∧
      radMom (mcor B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 1) 2 z t = 0 ∧
      radMom (mcor B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 2) 1 z t = 0

∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim4 B G → SimNorm B.h → ∃ l1 : ℕ,

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∀ (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → IsOpen (cStrip ρ) ∧ cStrip (ρ / 2) ⊆ cStrip ρ ∧

    intro ρ hρ
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩

      have h3 : IsOpen {w : ℂ | w.re < 1 + ρ} := isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const
      have e : cStrip ρ = {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ} ∩ ({w : ℂ | -1 - ρ < w.re} ∩ {w : ℂ | w.re < 1 + ρ}) := by
        ext w; simp [cStrip]

      exact ⟨by linarith [hw.1], by linarith [hw.2.1], by linarith [hw.2.2]⟩

      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hz

      have h2 := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (z - w)

      rw [Complex.sub_re] at h2

    · rw [circleMap_sub_center, norm_circleMap_zero, abs_of_pos hR]
    · rw [deriv_circleMap, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, norm_circleMap_zero, abs_of_pos hR]

      (∀ Y, a < Y → Y < b → DifferentiableOn ℂ (f Y) U) →
      (∀ Y, a < Y → Y < b → DifferentiableOn ℂ (f' Y) U) →

      (∀ Y z, a < Y → Y < b → z ∈ U → ‖f Y z‖ ≤ C) →

    rintro ⟨X0, w0⟩ ⟨hX0, hw0⟩

    have hcb : Metric.closedBall w0 R ⊆ U :=

    have hint : ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ × ℂ => ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..2 * Real.pi,
        deriv (circleMap w0 R) θ • (((circleMap w0 R θ - q.2) ^ 2)⁻¹ • f q.1 (circleMap w0 R θ)))

      apply intervalIntegral.continuousAt_of_dominated_interval
        (bound := fun _ => R * (((R / 2) ^ 2)⁻¹ * |C|))
      · filter_upwards [hN] with q hq
        have e2 : Continuous (fun θ => ((circleMap w0 R θ - q.2) ^ 2)⁻¹) :=

              have h' : circleMap w0 R θ - q.2 = 0 := h

          hjc.continuousAt ((isOpen_Ioo.prod hU).mem_nhds ⟨hX0, hγU θ⟩)

          have hc : ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ × ℂ => ((q.1, circleMap w0 R θ) : ℝ × ℂ)) (X0, w0) :=
            (continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_const).continuousAt

          rw [h, norm_zero] at this
          linarith
        have h2 : ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ × ℂ => ((circleMap w0 R θ - q.2) ^ 2)⁻¹) (X0, w0) :=
          ((continuous_const.sub continuous_snd).pow 2).continuousAt.inv₀ hne
        have h3 : ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ × ℂ =>
            ((circleMap w0 R θ - q.2) ^ 2)⁻¹ • f q.1 (circleMap w0 R θ)) (X0, w0) :=

    ⟨?_, fun X h0 h1 => ⟨?_, fun w hw => ?_⟩, fun hkj X w h0 h1 hw => ?_⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨hk1, hk2, -⟩ := hP k hk
    have hc := s3 0 Xi C (cStrip ρ) (fun Y z => iteratedDeriv k (fun Y' => φ Y' z) Y) hUo hk1
      (fun Y a b => (hk2 Y a b).1) (fun Y z a b hz => (hk2 Y a b).2 z hz)
    refine (hc.mono (prod_mono subset_rfl hsub)).congr ?_
    rintro ⟨X, w⟩ ⟨hX, hw⟩

    intro w hw

    rw [hComm k hk X w h0 h1 hw]
    apply Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hρ2
    · apply DifferentiableOn.diffContOnCl

      have key := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (𝕜 := ℂ)
        (μ := volume) (a := 0) (b := 1) (F := fun w t => ((κ t : ℝ) : ℂ) * ψ (t * X) w)
        (F' := fun w t => ((κ t : ℝ) : ℂ) * deriv (ψ (t * X)) w) (x₀ := w0)

    · 
      intro X w h0 h1 hw

    rw [hK0d]; exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg zero_le_one (fun u _ => abs_nonneg _)

  have hκb : ∀ m : ℕ, ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, |(-β * t - γ) * t ^ m| ≤ |β| + |γ| := by

    have hle : ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, |(-β * t - γ) * t ^ m| ≤ ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, (|β| + |γ|) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on zero_le_one ((hκc m).abs.intervalIntegrable 0 1)

  obtain ⟨Gf, hGf⟩ : ∃ Gf : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ, Gf = fun m Y w =>

  rcases k with _ | m

    have hc : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => φ p.1 p.2) (Ioo 0 Xi ×ˢ cStrip ρ) := by
      simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using (hφk 0 (Nat.zero_le _)).1
    have hd : ∀ X, 0 < X → X < Xi → DifferentiableOn ℂ (φ X) (cStrip ρ) := by

    have hb : ∀ X w, 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip ρ → ‖φ X w‖ ≤ C := by
      intro X w h0 h1 hw
      simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hDb 0 (Nat.zero_le _) w hw X h0 h1
    obtain ⟨m1, m2, m3⟩ := s4 ρ C kk φ hρ hkkI hc hd hb
    simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero]
    refine ⟨?_, fun X h0 h1 => ⟨?_, fun w hw => ?_⟩, fun _ X w h0 h1 hw => ?_⟩
    · exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).continuousOn.mul m1
    · exact (m2 X h0 h1).const_mul (X : ℂ)
    · show ‖(X : ℂ) * ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, ((kk t : ℝ) : ℂ) * φ (t * X) w‖ ≤ _

by

    intro q Sv E e P C1 C2 b1 b2 d1 d2 α α1 α2 N1 N2 hq0 hq1 hS1 hE he0 he1 hP ha1 ha2 hN1 hN2
    have key : ∀ (C b d αi N : ℝ), α ≤ αi → N ≤ C * q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P →

        N ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) := by

        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right m1 hE
      have m3 : q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) ≤
          q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) :=
        mul_le_mul m2 f3 p3 (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p1' p2') hE)
      have hWi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right m3 hP
      have hWi0 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p1 p2) hE) p3) hP
      calc N ≤ C * q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P := hN
        _ = C * (q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P) := by ring
        _ ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) hWi0
        _ ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hWi (abs_nonneg C)
    have k1 := key C1 b1 d1 α1 N1 ha1 hN1 (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
    have k2 := key C2 b2 d2 α2 N2 ha2 hN2 (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
    have e : (|C1| + |C2|) * q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P =
        |C1| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) +
        |C2| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) := by ring
    rw [e]

  have hNB : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f1 f2 g : Cyl → V) (k : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl),
      ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f1 (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f2 (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), g η = f1 η + f2 η) → NB B.h g k ξ ≤ NB B.h f1 k ξ + NB B.h f2 k ξ := by
    intro V _ _ f1 f2 g k ξ hξ hf1 hf2 heq
    have hn : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∈ nhds ξ := hDopen.mem_nhds hξ
    have hev : g =ᶠ[nhds ξ] f1 + f2 := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hn (fun η hη => heq η hη)
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g ξ = iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ := by
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
      exact iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((hf1.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        ((hf2.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    unfold NB
    rw [e1]
    have e2 : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) +
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) := by
      ext m
      simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e2]
    exact norm_add_le _ _
  
  have hvel_add : ∀ (a1 a2 : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl),
      (∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => a1 γ m η i) ξ) →
      (∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => a2 γ m η i) ξ) →
      velW5 B G (a1 + a2) γ m ξ = velW5 B G a1 γ m ξ + velW5 B G a2 γ m ξ := by
    intro a1 a2 γ m ξ hd1 hd2
    have hfd : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (v : Cyl), fderiv ℝ (fun η => a1 γ m η i + a2 γ m η i) ξ v =
        fderiv ℝ (fun η => a1 γ m η i) ξ v + fderiv ℝ (fun η => a2 γ m η i) ξ v := by
      intro i v
      rw [fderiv_fun_add (hd1 i) (hd2 i), ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [velW5, velC5, DrC, DzC, dR, dZ, hfd, hd1, hd2] <;> ring
  have hvel_zero : ∀ (a : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), a γ m = 0 → velW5 B G a γ m = 0 := by
    intro a γ m h0
    funext ξ j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [velW5, velC5, DrC, DzC, dR, dZ, h0]
  
  have hInM : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (α α1 α2 : ℝ) (f1 f2 g : Cyl → V),
      InM B (qsOf l0) α1 f1 → InM B (qsOf l0) α2 f2 → α ≤ α1 → α ≤ α2 →
      (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), g ξ = f1 ξ + f2 ξ) → InM B (qsOf l0) α g := by
    intro V _ _ α α1 α2 f1 f2 g h1 h2 ha1 ha2 heq
    obtain ⟨s1, d1, z1, b1⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨s2, d2, z2, b2⟩ := h2
    refine ⟨(s1.add s2).congr heq, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro ξ hξ a ha
      rw [heq _ (hDsh ξ hξ a), heq ξ hξ, d1 ξ hξ a ha, d2 ξ hξ a ha]
    · intro ξ hξ hX
      rw [heq ξ hξ, z1 ξ hξ hX, z2 ξ hξ hX, add_zero]
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨C1, c1, e1, hb1⟩ := b1 k
      obtain ⟨C2, c2, e2, hb2⟩ := b2 k
      refine ⟨|C1| + |C2|, max c1 c2, max e1 e2, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hq0, hq1, hS1⟩ := hDq ξ hξ
      obtain ⟨hE, he0, he1⟩ := hEdge _ hX1 hX2
      have hn := hNB f1 f2 g k ξ hξ s1 s2 heq
      have := hW (qC B.h ξ) (SC B.h ξ) (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ))
        (edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ)) 1 C1 C2 c1 c2 e1 e2 α α1 α2 (NB B.h f1 k ξ) (NB B.h f2 k ξ)
        hq0 hq1 hS1 hE he0 he1 zero_le_one ha1 ha2
        (le_of_le_of_eq (hb1 ξ hξ hX1 hX2) (mul_one _).symm)
        (le_of_le_of_eq (hb2 ξ hξ hX1 hX2) (mul_one _).symm)
      exact le_trans hn (le_of_le_of_eq this (mul_one _))
  
  have hInWg : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (α α1 α2 : ℝ)
      (a1 a2 c : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → V),
      InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α1 a1 → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α2 a2 → α ≤ α1 → α ≤ α2 →
      (∃ H : Finset ℤ, (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧ ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → c γ m = 0) →
      (∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), c γ m ξ = a1 γ m ξ + a2 γ m ξ) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α c := by
    intro V _ _ α α1 α2 a1 a2 c h1 h2 ha1 ha2 hfr heq
    obtain ⟨-, s1, d1, u1, b1⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨-, s2, d2, u2, b2⟩ := h2
    refine ⟨hfr, fun γ m => ((s1 γ m).add (s2 γ m)).congr (heq γ m), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro γ m ξ hξ a ha
      rw [heq γ m _ (hDsh ξ hξ a), heq γ m ξ hξ, d1 γ m ξ hξ a ha, d2 γ m ξ hξ a ha]
    · intro γ m ξ hξ hne
      rw [heq γ m ξ hξ] at hne
      by_cases h : a1 γ m ξ = 0
      · rw [h, zero_add] at hne
        exact u2 γ m ξ hξ hne
      · exact u1 γ m ξ hξ h
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨C1, c1, e1, hb1⟩ := b1 k
      obtain ⟨C2, c2, e2, hb2⟩ := b2 k
      refine ⟨|C1| + |C2|, max c1 c2, max e1 e2, fun γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hq0, hq1, hS1⟩ := hDq ξ hξ
      obtain ⟨hE, he0, he1⟩ := hEdge _ hX1 hX2
      have hn := hNB (a1 γ m) (a2 γ m) (c γ m) k ξ hξ (s1 γ m) (s2 γ m) (heq γ m)
      have hP : 0 ≤ Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by
        unfold Penv5
        exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      have := hW (qC B.h ξ) (SC B.h ξ) (Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)))
        (edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ)) (Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2))
        C1 C2 c1 c2 e1 e2 α α1 α2 _ _ hq0 hq1 hS1 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) he0 he1 hP ha1 ha2
        (hb1 γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2) (hb2 γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2)
      exact le_trans hn this
  
  obtain ⟨A1, V1, P1, Ps1, Bd1, Pm1, M01, M21⟩ := hI1
  obtain ⟨A2, V2, P2, Ps2, Bd2, Pm2, M02, M22⟩ := hI2
  obtain ⟨H1, h01, hH1⟩ := A1.1
  obtain ⟨H2, h02, hH2⟩ := A2.1
  have h0H : (0:ℤ) ∉ H1 ∪ H2 := by
    rw [Finset.mem_union, not_or]
    exact ⟨h01, h02⟩
  have hfrAw : ∀ γ m, m ∉ H1 ∪ H2 → (S''.Aw - S.Aw) γ m = 0 := by
    intro γ m hm
    rw [Finset.mem_union, not_or] at hm
    have e1 := hH1 γ m hm.1
    have e2 := hH2 γ m hm.2
    have : (S''.Aw - S.Aw) γ m = (S''.Aw - S'.Aw) γ m + (S'.Aw - S.Aw) γ m := by
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
      abel
    rw [this, e1, e2, add_zero]
  have I1 : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) o'' (S''.Aw - S.Aw) :=
    hInWg o'' o o' (S'.Aw - S.Aw) (S''.Aw - S'.Aw) (S''.Aw - S.Aw) A1 A2 ho ho'
      ⟨H1 ∪ H2, h0H, hfrAw⟩ (fun γ m ξ _ => by simp only [Pi.sub_apply]; abel)
  have hsum : S''.Aw - S.Aw = (S'.Aw - S.Aw) + (S''.Aw - S'.Aw) := by abel
  have I2 : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) o'' (velW5 B G (S''.Aw - S.Aw)) := by
    refine hInWg o'' o o' (velW5 B G (S'.Aw - S.Aw)) (velW5 B G (S''.Aw - S'.Aw)) _ V1 V2 ho ho'
      ⟨H1 ∪ H2, h0H, fun γ m hm => hvel_zero _ γ m (hfrAw γ m hm)⟩ ?_
    intro γ m ξ hξ
    rw [hsum]
    apply hvel_add
    · intro i
      exact differentiableAt_pi.mp
        (((A1.2.1 γ m).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hDopen.mem_nhds hξ)) i
    · intro i
      exact differentiableAt_pi.mp
        (((A2.2.1 γ m).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hDopen.mem_nhds hξ)) i
  obtain ⟨G1, g01, hG1⟩ := P1.1
  obtain ⟨G2, g02, hG2⟩ := P2.1
  have I3 : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) o'' (S''.pw - S.pw) := by
    refine hInWg o'' o o' (S'.pw - S.pw) (S''.pw - S'.pw) (S''.pw - S.pw) P1 P2 ho ho'
      ⟨G1 ∪ G2, ?_, ?_⟩ (fun γ m ξ _ => by simp only [Pi.sub_apply]; abel)
    · rw [Finset.mem_union, not_or]
      exact ⟨g01, g02⟩
    · intro γ m hm
      rw [Finset.mem_union, not_or] at hm
      have e1 := hG1 γ m hm.1
      have e2 := hG2 γ m hm.2
      have : (S''.pw - S.pw) γ m = (S''.pw - S'.pw) γ m + (S'.pw - S.pw) γ m := by
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
        abel
      rw [this, e1, e2, add_zero]
  have I4 : InM B (qsOf l0) o'' (S''.Psi - S.Psi) :=
    hInM o'' o o' (S'.Psi - S.Psi) (S''.Psi - S'.Psi) (S''.Psi - S.Psi) Ps1 Ps2 ho ho'
      (fun ξ _ => by simp only [Pi.sub_apply]; ring)
  have I5 : InM B (qsOf l0) o'' (S''.bdir - S.bdir) :=
    hInM o'' o o' (S'.bdir - S.bdir) (S''.bdir - S'.bdir) (S''.bdir - S.bdir) Bd1 Bd2 ho ho'
      (fun ξ _ => by simp only [Pi.sub_apply]; ring)
  have I6 : InM B (qsOf l0) o'' (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (fun ξ => pmP5 B G l0 S'' ξ - pmP5 B G l0 S ξ)) :=
    hInM o'' o o' _ _ _ Pm1 Pm2 ho ho' (fun ξ _ => by simp only [nrm]; ring)
  have I7 : InM B (qsOf l0) (o'' + 1)
      (nrm B (Aex B.h) (fun ξ => mcor5 B G l0 S'' 0 ξ - mcor5 B G l0 S 0 ξ)) :=
    hInM (o'' + 1) (o + 1) (o' + 1) _ _ _ M01 M02 (by linarith) (by linarith)
      (fun ξ _ => by simp only [nrm]; ring)
  have I8 : InM B (qsOf l0) o'' (nrm B (Aex B.h) (fun ξ => mcor5 B G l0 S'' 2 ξ - mcor5 B G l0 S 2 ξ)) :=
    hInM o'' o o' _ _ _ M21 M22 ho ho' (fun ξ _ => by simp only [nrm]; ring)
  exact ⟨I1, I2, I3, I4, I5, I6, I7, I8⟩

  have hrep_ex : ∀ γ : Lab, ∃ c : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, L₀ ≤ γ.1 →

mean_residual_identity_v5.definitions:
noncomputable def mriE (B : BG) : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³ :=
  fun y s => nsResidual 1 (uB B) B.PB y s - stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz y s

noncomputable def mriRes (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (a : Fin 3) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (nsResidual 1 u p (rotPt w.1 θ w.2.1) w.2.2) (frameAt θ (w.1, w.2.1, w.2.2, 0) a))

noncomputable def mriM (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (a : Fin 3) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (u (rotPt w.1 θ w.2.1) w.2.2) (frameAt θ (w.1, w.2.1, w.2.2, 0) a))

noncomputable def mriQ (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (a b : Fin 3) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (u (rotPt w.1 θ w.2.1) w.2.2) (frameAt θ (w.1, w.2.1, w.2.2, 0) a) *
    inner ℝ (u (rotPt w.1 θ w.2.1) w.2.2) (frameAt θ (w.1, w.2.1, w.2.2, 0) b))

noncomputable def mriPm (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  thA (fun θ => p (rotPt w.1 θ w.2.1) w.2.2)

noncomputable def mriPath (h : ℝ) (Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : Cyl :=
  (w.1, w.2.1, w.2.2, Yph h w.1 w.2.2 + Y₀)

noncomputable def mriDq5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (a b : Fin 3) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  ubase B ξ a * mcor5 B G l0 S b ξ + mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ * ubase B ξ b +
    mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ * mcor5 B G l0 S b ξ + Wcov5 B G l0 S a b ξ

noncomputable def dvT5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Cyl → ℝ :=
  shInd B (fun ξ => -TN (EthP5 B G l0 S) ξ)
noncomputable def gdT5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Cyl → ℝ :=

  shInd B (Tprim B 1 (gdT5 B G l0 S))
noncomputable def tempUpd5 (B : BG) (S : CState) (P d : Cyl → ℝ) : CState :=
  ⟨S.Aw, S.pw, fun ξ => S.Psi ξ + nrm B (Aex B.h - 1/2) P ξ, fun ξ => S.bdir ξ + nrm B (Aex B.h) d ξ⟩

  tempUpd5 B S (PsiT5 B G l0 S) (dvT5 B G l0 S)
def TInv5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (H : ℝ) : Prop :=
  InM B (qsOf l0) H (nrm B (Aex B.h) (dvT5 B G l0 S)) ∧ InM B (qsOf l0) H (nrm B (Aex B.h) (gdT5 B G l0 S)) ∧
  (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dYt (dvT5 B G l0 S) ξ = -(EthP5 B G l0 S ξ - yAvg (EthP5 B G l0 S) ξ) ∧
     dYt (gdT5 B G l0 S) ξ = -(EzP5 B G l0 S ξ - yAvg (EzP5 B G l0 S) ξ)) ∧
  (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), yAvg (dvT5 B G l0 S) ξ = 0 ∧ yAvg (gdT5 B G l0 S) ξ = 0)
def TPot5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (H : ℝ) : Prop :=
  InM B (qsOf l0) H (nrm B (Aex B.h - 1/2) (PsiT5 B G l0 S)) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) H (nrm B (Aex B.h) (fun ξ => dR B.h (PsiT5 B G l0 S) ξ + PsiT5 B G l0 S ξ / ξ.1)) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) (H + 1) (nrm B (Aex B.h) (fun ξ => -dZ (PsiT5 B G l0 S) ξ)) ∧
  (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dR B.h (PsiT5 B G l0 S) ξ + PsiT5 B G l0 S ξ / ξ.1
      = gdT5 B G l0 S ξ - Arem B 1 (gdT5 B G l0 S) ξ) ∧
  (∀ m N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      NB B.h (nrm B (Aex B.h) (Arem B 1 (gdT5 B G l0 S))) m ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (N : ℝ)) ∧
  (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (B.m1 ≤ XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ ≤ B.m2) ∨ Arem B 1 (gdT5 B G l0 S) ξ = 0) ∧
  (∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 →
      radMom (fun ξ => dR B.h (PsiT5 B G l0 S) ξ + PsiT5 B G l0 S ξ / ξ.1) 1 z t = 0)
def TMean5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Prop :=
  ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
    mcor5 B G l0 (tempState5 B G l0 S) 1 ξ = mcor5 B G l0 S 1 ξ + dvT5 B G l0 S ξ ∧
    mcor5 B G l0 (tempState5 B G l0 S) 2 ξ = mcor5 B G l0 S 2 ξ + (dR B.h (PsiT5 B G l0 S) ξ + PsiT5 B G l0 S ξ / ξ.1) ∧
    mcor5 B G l0 (tempState5 B G l0 S) 0 ξ = mcor5 B G l0 S 0 ξ - dZ (PsiT5 B G l0 S) ξ ∧
    ∀ a b : Fin 3, Wcov5 B G l0 (tempState5 B G l0 S) a b ξ = Wcov5 B G l0 S a b ξ
def TPres5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (H : ℝ) : Prop :=
  InM B (qsOf l0) H (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (fun ξ => pmP5 B G l0 (tempState5 B G l0 S) ξ - pmP5 B G l0 S ξ)) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) H (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun ξ => grP5 B G l0 (tempState5 B G l0 S) ξ - grP5 B G l0 S ξ)) ∧
  ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), pmP5 B G l0 (tempState5 B G l0 S) ξ - pmP5 B G l0 S ξ =
    Icut B (fun η => (grP5 B G l0 (tempState5 B G l0 S) η - grP5 B G l0 S η)
      - rhoP B η * (calP5 B G l0 (tempState5 B G l0 S) η.2.1 η.2.2.1 - calP5 B G l0 S η.2.1 η.2.2.1)) ξ

cycle_step_moment_v5.definitions:
def MomMeanId5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
    mcor5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 0 ξ = mcor5 B G l0 S 0 ξ + momDbP B dPsi ξ ∧
    mcor5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 1 ξ = mcor5 B G l0 S 1 ξ + momDvP B dv ξ ∧
    mcor5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 2 ξ = mcor5 B G l0 S 2 ξ + momDgP B dPsi ξ ∧
    ∀ a c, Wcov5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) a c ξ = Wcov5 B G l0 S a c ξ

noncomputable def momRg5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  let b : Cyl → ℝ := fun η => ubase B η 0
  let Gz : Cyl → ℝ := fun η => ubase B η 2
  let β : Cyl → ℝ := mcor5 B G l0 S 0
  let v : Cyl → ℝ := mcor5 B G l0 S 1
  let γz : Cyl → ℝ := mcor5 B G l0 S 2
  let db : Cyl → ℝ := momDbP B dPsi
  let dg : Cyl → ℝ := momDgP B dPsi
  let dw : Cyl → ℝ := momDvP B dv
  (0:ℝ) - dT db ξ - (dR B.h (fun η => 2 * b η * db η + 2 * β η * db η + db η ^ 2) ξ
      + (2 * b ξ * db ξ + 2 * β ξ * db ξ + db ξ ^ 2) / ξ.1)
    - dZ (fun η => b η * dg η + Gz η * db η + β η * dg η + γz η * db η + db η * dg η) ξ
    + (2 * v ξ * dw ξ + dw ξ ^ 2) / ξ.1 + (lap0 B.h db ξ - db ξ / ξ.1 ^ 2)

noncomputable def momDg5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  2 * ubase B ξ 1 * momDvP B dv ξ / ξ.1 + momRg5 B G l0 S dPsi dv ξ

noncomputable def momQth5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) (η : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η * momDvP B dv η + mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η * momDgP B dPsi η + momDgP B dPsi η * momDvP B dv η

noncomputable def momQz5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) (η : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  2 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η * momDgP B dPsi η + momDgP B dPsi η ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: mom_class_algebra_v4
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 →
    (∀ (α β γ c d : ℝ) (f g k : Cyl → ℝ), InM B qs α f → InM B qs β g → γ ≤ α → γ ≤ β →
      (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, k ξ = c * f ξ + d * g ξ) → InM B qs γ k) ∧
    (∀ (α β γ c d : ℝ) (F G K : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), InS B qs α F → InS B qs β G → γ ≤ α → γ ≤ β →
      (∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qs → K w = c * F w + d * G w) →
      InS B qs γ K)

subgoal_signatures.name: mom_increment_exists_v4
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (B : BG), B.ok → SimNorm B.h → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →
    ∀ (Pt Jt Jzt : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (α : ℝ),
    InS B (qsOf l0) α (nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h) Pt) → InS B (qsOf l0) α (nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h - 3/2) Jt) →
    InS B (qsOf l0) α (nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h - 1) Jzt) →
    ∃ dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ, MomShape B dPsi ∧ MomShape B dv ∧
      InM B (qsOf l0) α dPsi ∧ InM B (qsOf l0) α dv ∧ InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (Aex B.h) (momDvP B dv)) ∧
      InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (Aex B.h) (momDgP B dPsi)) ∧
      InM B (qsOf l0) (α + 1) (nrm B (Aex B.h) (momDbP B dPsi)) ∧
      ∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 →
        radMom (momDvP B dv) 2 z t = 0 ∧ radMom (momDgP B dPsi) 1 z t = 0 ∧
        radMom (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 1 * momDvP B dv η / η.1) 0 z t = -Pt z t ∧
        radMom (fun η => ubase B η 2 * momDvP B dv η + ubase B η 1 * momDgP B dPsi η) 2 z t = -Jt z t ∧
        radMom (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 2 * momDgP B dPsi η - ubase B η 1 * momDvP B dv η) 1 z t = -Jzt z t

subgoal_signatures.name: mom_mean_update_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →
    ∀ (S : CState) (bw ca cm cd : ℝ) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ), StOrd5 B G l0 S bw ca cm cd →
    MomShape B dPsi → MomShape B dv → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ dPsi (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ dv (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → MomMeanId5 B G l0 S dPsi dv

subgoal_signatures.name: mom_defect_recompute_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →
    ∀ (S : CState) (bw ca cm cd : ℝ) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ), StOrd5 B G l0 S bw ca cm cd →

    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ dv (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → MomMeanId5 B G l0 S dPsi dv →
    (∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 →
        radMom (momDvP B dv) 2 z t = 0 ∧ radMom (momDgP B dPsi) 1 z t = 0 ∧
        radMom (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 1 * momDvP B dv η / η.1) 0 z t = -calP5 B G l0 S z t ∧
        radMom (fun η => ubase B η 2 * momDvP B dv η + ubase B η 1 * momDgP B dPsi η) 2 z t =
          -calJth5 B G l0 S z t ∧
        radMom (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 2 * momDgP B dPsi η - ubase B η 1 * momDvP B dv η) 1 z t =
          -calJz5 B G l0 S z t) →

    ∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 →

proof.tactics:
by
  intro f σ₀
  have P1 : ∀ (s s' K : ℝ), s < s' → DifferentiableOn ℂ f (cStrip s') →
      (∀ z ∈ cStrip s', ‖f z‖ ≤ K) → ∀ w ∈ cStrip s, ‖deriv f w‖ ≤ K / (s' - s) := by
    intro s s' K hss' hd hb w hw
    have hr : 0 < s' - s := sub_pos.mpr hss'
    have hsub : Metric.closedBall w (s' - s) ⊆ cStrip s' := by
      intro z hz
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hz
      have h1 := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (z - w)
      have h2 := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (z - w)
      rw [Complex.sub_im] at h1
      rw [Complex.sub_re] at h2
      simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw ⊢
      obtain ⟨hw1, hw2, hw3⟩ := hw
      rw [abs_lt] at hw1 ⊢
      obtain ⟨h1a, h1b⟩ := abs_le.mp (h1.trans hz)
      obtain ⟨h2a, h2b⟩ := abs_le.mp (h2.trans hz)
      obtain ⟨hw1a, hw1b⟩ := hw1
      refine ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hdc : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball w (s' - s)) := by
      apply DifferentiableOn.diffContOnCl
      rw [closure_ball w hr.ne']
      exact hd.mono hsub
    exact Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr hdc
      (fun z hz => hb z (hsub (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz)))
  have hq3 : ∀ m : ℕ, (((m:ℝ) + 2) / ((m:ℝ) + 1)) ^ m ≤ 3 := by
    intro m
    have hm1 : (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    have hqx : ((m:ℝ) + 2) / ((m:ℝ) + 1) = 1 / ((m:ℝ) + 1) + 1 := by
      field_simp; ring
    have hq0 : 0 ≤ ((m:ℝ) + 2) / ((m:ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
    have h1 : (((m:ℝ) + 2) / ((m:ℝ) + 1)) ^ m ≤ (Real.exp (1 / ((m:ℝ) + 1))) ^ m := by
      apply pow_le_pow_left₀ hq0
      rw [hqx]; exact Real.add_one_le_exp _
    rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul] at h1
    have h2 : (m:ℝ) * (1 / ((m:ℝ) + 1)) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [mul_one_div, div_le_one hm1]; linarith
    have h3 : Real.exp ((m:ℝ) * (1 / ((m:ℝ) + 1))) ≤ Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h2
    have h4 := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
    have h5 : Real.exp 1 < 3 := lt_trans h4 (by norm_num)
    linarith
  refine ⟨P1, ?_⟩
  intro K m hσ₀ hK hd hyp s w hs0 hsσ hw
  have hD : 0 < σ₀ - s := sub_pos.mpr hsσ
  have hDne : σ₀ - s ≠ 0 := hD.ne'
  have hm2 : (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) + 2 := by positivity
  have hm1 : (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  have hm2ne : (m:ℝ) + 2 ≠ 0 := hm2.ne'
  have hm1ne : (m:ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := hm1.ne'
  have hδ : 0 < (σ₀ - s) / ((m:ℝ) + 2) := div_pos hD hm2
  have hδlt : (σ₀ - s) / ((m:ℝ) + 2) < σ₀ - s := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hm2]; nlinarith [mul_pos hD hm1]
  obtain ⟨s', hs'⟩ : ∃ s' : ℝ, s' = s + (σ₀ - s) / ((m:ℝ) + 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hss' : s < s' := by rw [hs']; linarith
  have hs'σ : s' < σ₀ := by rw [hs']; linarith
  have hs'0 : 0 < s' := by linarith
  have hsub : cStrip s' ⊆ cStrip σ₀ := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hz ⊢
    obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have key := P1 s s' (K / (σ₀ - s') ^ m) hss' (hd.mono hsub)
    (fun z hz => hyp s' z hs'0 hs'σ hz) w hw
  have e1 : σ₀ - s' = (σ₀ - s) * ((m:ℝ) + 1) / ((m:ℝ) + 2) := by
    rw [hs']; field_simp; ring
  have e2 : s' - s = (σ₀ - s) / ((m:ℝ) + 2) := by rw [hs']; ring
  rw [e1, e2] at key
  have eq : K / ((σ₀ - s) * ((m:ℝ) + 1) / ((m:ℝ) + 2)) ^ m / ((σ₀ - s) / ((m:ℝ) + 2)) =
      (((m:ℝ) + 2) / ((m:ℝ) + 1)) ^ m * (((m:ℝ) + 2) * K / (σ₀ - s) ^ (m + 1)) := by
    have gen : ∀ D a b : ℝ, D ≠ 0 → a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 →
        K / (D * a / b) ^ m / (D / b) = (b / a) ^ m * (b * K / D ^ (m + 1)) := by
      intro D a b hD0 ha0 hb0
      have hDm : D ^ m ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hD0
      have ham : a ^ m ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ ha0
      have hbm : b ^ m ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hb0
      rw [div_pow, mul_pow, div_pow, pow_succ]
      field_simp <;> ring
    exact gen _ _ _ hDne hm1ne hm2ne
  rw [eq] at key
  have hE : 0 ≤ ((m:ℝ) + 2) * K / (σ₀ - s) ^ (m + 1) :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hm2.le hK) (pow_pos hD _).le
  calc ‖deriv f w‖ ≤ _ := key
    _ ≤ 3 * (((m:ℝ) + 2) * K / (σ₀ - s) ^ (m + 1)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hq3 m) hE
    _ = 3 * ((m : ℝ) + 2) * K / (σ₀ - s) ^ (m + 1) := by ring

  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ hle

by

  have hopen : ∀ ρ : ℝ, IsOpen (cStrip ρ) := by

      ext w

    rw [e]
    exact ((isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const).inter

  have hmono : ∀ s t : ℝ, s ≤ t → cStrip s ⊆ cStrip t := by
    intro s t hst w hw
    simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw ⊢
    exact ⟨by linarith [hw.1], by linarith [hw.2.1], by linarith [hw.2.2]⟩
  have hball : ∀ (s r : ℝ) (w z : ℂ), w ∈ cStrip s → dist z w ≤ r → z ∈ cStrip (s + r) := by
    intro s r w z hw hd
    simp only [cStrip, mem_setOf_eq] at hw ⊢
    rw [Complex.dist_eq] at hd
    have h1 := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (z - w)
    have h2 := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (z - w)
    rw [Complex.sub_re] at h1
    rw [Complex.sub_im] at h2
    have a1 := abs_le.mp (h1.trans hd)
    have a2 := abs_le.mp (h2.trans hd)
    obtain ⟨hw1, hw2, hw3⟩ := hw
    have a3 := abs_lt.mp hw1
    exact ⟨abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hloc : ∀ (s : ℝ) (w : ℂ), w ∈ cStrip s → ∃ t : ℝ, t < s ∧ w ∈ cStrip t := by

    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hw

signature.statement: ∀ (Xi σ₀ A₁ K : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (ac : Fin 6 → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (bc : Fin 8 → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (gc ψ1 ψ2 : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ), 0 < Xi → 0 < σ₀ → σ₀ ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ A₁ → 0 ≤ K → (∀ i X w, 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip σ₀ → ‖ac i X w‖ ≤ A₁) → (∀ i X w, 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip σ₀ → ‖bc i X w‖ ≤ A₁) → (∀ X w, 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip σ₀ → ‖gc X w‖ ≤ A₁ ∧ ‖cDw gc X w‖ ≤ A₁) → (∀ X, 0 < X → X < Xi → DifferentiableOn ℂ (ψ1 X) (cStrip σ₀) ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (ψ2 X) (cStrip σ₀)) → (∀ (s X : ℝ) (w : ℂ), 0 < s → s < σ₀ → 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip s → ‖ψ1 X w‖ ≤ K * X ^ m / (σ₀ - s) ^ m ∧ ‖ψ2 X w‖ ≤ K * X ^ m / (σ₀ - s) ^ m) → ∀ (s X : ℝ) (w : ℂ), 0 < s → s < σ₀ → 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip s → ‖bgT1 ac ψ1 ψ2 X w‖ ≤ 8 * (1 + A₁) ^ 2 * (1 + Xi) * K * X ^ (m + 1) / (((m : ℝ) + 1) * (σ₀ - s) ^ (m + 1)) ∧ ‖bgT2 bc gc ψ1 ψ2 X w‖ ≤ 8 * (1 + A₁) ^ 2 * (1 + Xi) * K * X ^ (m + 1) / (((m : ℝ) + 1) * (σ₀ - s) ^ (m + 1))

proof.tactics:
by
  have strip_cauchy_nagumo : ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (σ₀ : ℝ), (∀ (s s' K : ℝ), s < s' → DifferentiableOn ℂ f (cStrip s') → (∀ z ∈ cStrip s', ‖f z‖ ≤ K) → ∀ w ∈ cStrip s, ‖deriv f w‖ ≤ K / (s' - s)) ∧ (∀ (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ), 0 < σ₀ → 0 ≤ K → DifferentiableOn ℂ f (cStrip σ₀) → (∀ (s : ℝ) (z : ℂ), 0 < s → s < σ₀ → z ∈ cStrip s → ‖f z‖ ≤ K / (σ₀ - s) ^ m) → ∀ (s : ℝ) (w : ℂ), 0 < s → s < σ₀ → w ∈ cStrip s → ‖deriv f w‖ ≤ 3 * ((m : ℝ) + 2) * K / (σ₀ - s) ^ (m + 1)) := by
    intro f σ₀
    have P1 : ∀ (s s' K : ℝ), s < s' → DifferentiableOn ℂ f (cStrip s') →
        (∀ z ∈ cStrip s', ‖f z‖ ≤ K) → ∀ w ∈ cStrip s, ‖deriv f w‖ ≤ K / (s' - s) := by
      intro s s' K hss' hd hb w hw
      have hr : 0 < s' - s := sub_pos.mpr hss'
      have hsub : Metric.closedBall w (s' - s) ⊆ cStrip s' := by
        intro z hz
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hz
        have h1 := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (z - w)
        have h2 := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (z - w)
        rw [Complex.sub_im] at h1
        rw [Complex.sub_re] at h2
        simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw ⊢
        obtain ⟨hw1, hw2, hw3⟩ := hw
        rw [abs_lt] at hw1 ⊢
        obtain ⟨h1a, h1b⟩ := abs_le.mp (h1.trans hz)
        obtain ⟨h2a, h2b⟩ := abs_le.mp (h2.trans hz)
        obtain ⟨hw1a, hw1b⟩ := hw1
        refine ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have hdc : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball w (s' - s)) := by
        apply DifferentiableOn.diffContOnCl
        rw [closure_ball w hr.ne']
        exact hd.mono hsub
      exact Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr hdc
        (fun z hz => hb z (hsub (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz)))
    have hq3 : ∀ m : ℕ, (((m:ℝ) + 2) / ((m:ℝ) + 1)) ^ m ≤ 3 := by
      intro m
      have hm1 : (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
      have hqx : ((m:ℝ) + 2) / ((m:ℝ) + 1) = 1 / ((m:ℝ) + 1) + 1 := by
        field_simp; ring
      have hq0 : 0 ≤ ((m:ℝ) + 2) / ((m:ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
      have h1 : (((m:ℝ) + 2) / ((m:ℝ) + 1)) ^ m ≤ (Real.exp (1 / ((m:ℝ) + 1))) ^ m := by
        apply pow_le_pow_left₀ hq0
        rw [hqx]; exact Real.add_one_le_exp _
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul] at h1
      have h2 : (m:ℝ) * (1 / ((m:ℝ) + 1)) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [mul_one_div, div_le_one hm1]; linarith
      have h3 : Real.exp ((m:ℝ) * (1 / ((m:ℝ) + 1))) ≤ Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h2
      have h4 := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
      have h5 : Real.exp 1 < 3 := lt_trans h4 (by norm_num)
      linarith
    refine ⟨P1, ?_⟩
    intro K m hσ₀ hK hd hyp s w hs0 hsσ hw
    have hD : 0 < σ₀ - s := sub_pos.mpr hsσ
    have hDne : σ₀ - s ≠ 0 := hD.ne'
    have hm2 : (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) + 2 := by positivity
    have hm1 : (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    have hm2ne : (m:ℝ) + 2 ≠ 0 := hm2.ne'
    have hm1ne : (m:ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := hm1.ne'
    have hδ : 0 < (σ₀ - s) / ((m:ℝ) + 2) := div_pos hD hm2
    have hδlt : (σ₀ - s) / ((m:ℝ) + 2) < σ₀ - s := by
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hm2]; nlinarith [mul_pos hD hm1]
    obtain ⟨s', hs'⟩ : ∃ s' : ℝ, s' = s + (σ₀ - s) / ((m:ℝ) + 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hss' : s < s' := by rw [hs']; linarith
    have hs'σ : s' < σ₀ := by rw [hs']; linarith
    have hs'0 : 0 < s' := by linarith
    have hsub : cStrip s' ⊆ cStrip σ₀ := by
      intro z hz
      simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hz ⊢
      obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := hz
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have key := P1 s s' (K / (σ₀ - s') ^ m) hss' (hd.mono hsub)
      (fun z hz => hyp s' z hs'0 hs'σ hz) w hw
    have e1 : σ₀ - s' = (σ₀ - s) * ((m:ℝ) + 1) / ((m:ℝ) + 2) := by
      rw [hs']; field_simp; ring
    have e2 : s' - s = (σ₀ - s) / ((m:ℝ) + 2) := by rw [hs']; ring
    rw [e1, e2] at key
    have eq : K / ((σ₀ - s) * ((m:ℝ) + 1) / ((m:ℝ) + 2)) ^ m / ((σ₀ - s) / ((m:ℝ) + 2)) =
        (((m:ℝ) + 2) / ((m:ℝ) + 1)) ^ m * (((m:ℝ) + 2) * K / (σ₀ - s) ^ (m + 1)) := by
      have gen : ∀ D a b : ℝ, D ≠ 0 → a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 →
          K / (D * a / b) ^ m / (D / b) = (b / a) ^ m * (b * K / D ^ (m + 1)) := by
        intro D a b hD0 ha0 hb0
        have hDm : D ^ m ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hD0
        have ham : a ^ m ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ ha0
        have hbm : b ^ m ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hb0
        rw [div_pow, mul_pow, div_pow, pow_succ]
        field_simp <;> ring
      exact gen _ _ _ hDne hm1ne hm2ne
    rw [eq] at key
    have hE : 0 ≤ ((m:ℝ) + 2) * K / (σ₀ - s) ^ (m + 1) :=
      div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hm2.le hK) (pow_pos hD _).le
    calc ‖deriv f w‖ ≤ _ := key
      _ ≤ 3 * (((m:ℝ) + 2) * K / (σ₀ - s) ^ (m + 1)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hq3 m) hE
      _ = 3 * ((m : ℝ) + 2) * K / (σ₀ - s) ^ (m + 1) := by ring
  intro Xi σ₀ A₁ K m ac bc gc ψ1 ψ2 hXi hσ₀ hσ₀1 hA₁ hK hac hbc hgc hdiff hψ s X w hs0 hsσ hX0 hXXi hw
  have hn0 : (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  have hn1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) + 1 := by have := (Nat.cast_nonneg m : (0:ℝ) ≤ m); linarith
  
  have hmom : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => -Real.log t * t ^ m) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 ∧
      ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, -Real.log t * t ^ m = 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
    have hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => -Real.log t * t ^ m) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
      (intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_log'.neg).mul_continuousOn (continuous_pow m).continuousOn
    refine ⟨hint, ?_⟩
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => t ^ (m + 1) / ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 -
        t ^ m * (t * Real.log t) / ((m:ℝ) + 1)) (Set.Icc 0 1) :=
      (((continuous_pow _).div_const _).sub
        (((continuous_pow m).mul Real.continuous_mul_log).div_const _)).continuousOn
    have hderiv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t ^ (m + 1) / ((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 -
        t ^ m * (t * Real.log t) / ((m:ℝ) + 1)) (-Real.log x * x ^ m) x := by
      intro x hx
      have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := hx.1.ne'
      have h1 := (hasDerivAt_pow (m + 1) x).div_const (((m:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2)
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t * Real.log t) (Real.log x + 1) x := by
        rw [show Real.log x + 1 = 1 * Real.log x + x * x⁻¹ by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hx0]; ring]
        exact (hasDerivAt_id' x).mul (Real.hasDerivAt_log hx0)
      have h3 := ((hasDerivAt_pow m x).mul h2).div_const ((m:ℝ) + 1)
      have h4 := h1.sub h3
      convert h4 using 1
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm | hm
      · subst hm
        simp
      · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = k + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
        simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
        push_cast
        field_simp
        ring
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le zero_le_one hcont hderiv hint]
    simp
  
  have hker : ∀ (c μ Y : ℝ) (kk L : ℝ → ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ), 0 < Y → Y < Xi →
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ 1 → |kk t| ≤ L t) →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => L t * t ^ m) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 →
      ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, L t * t ^ m = μ →
      (∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → y < Xi → ‖g y w‖ ≤ c * y ^ m) →
      ‖cKer kk g Y w‖ ≤ c * Y ^ (m + 1) * μ := by
    intro c μ Y kk L g hY hYXi hL hLi hLμ hg
    unfold cKer
    have hb : ‖∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, ((kk t : ℝ) : ℂ) * g (t * Y) w‖ ≤
        ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, (c * Y ^ m) * (L t * t ^ m) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le zero_le_one
      · refine MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun t ht => ?_)
        obtain ⟨ht0, ht1⟩ := ht
        have hy0 : 0 < t * Y := mul_pos ht0 hY
        have hyX : t * Y < Xi := lt_of_le_of_lt (by nlinarith) hYXi
        have hk := hL t ht0 ht1
        have hL0 : 0 ≤ L t := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hk
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        calc |kk t| * ‖g (t * Y) w‖ ≤ L t * (c * (t * Y) ^ m) :=
              mul_le_mul hk (hg _ hy0 hyX) (norm_nonneg _) hL0
          _ = (c * Y ^ m) * (L t * t ^ m) := by rw [mul_pow]; ring
      · exact hLi.const_mul _
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hLμ] at hb
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hY]
    calc Y * ‖∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, ((kk t : ℝ) : ℂ) * g (t * Y) w‖ ≤ Y * (c * Y ^ m * μ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hY.le
      _ = c * Y ^ (m + 1) * μ := by ring
  
  have hpG : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ 1 → |bgkG t| ≤ (fun t : ℝ => -Real.log t / 2) t := by
    intro t ht0 ht1
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos ht0
    simp only [bgkG]
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hpU : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ 1 → |bgkU t| ≤ (fun t : ℝ => -Real.log t / 2) t := by
    intro t ht0 ht1
    have := Real.log_nonpos ht0.le ht1
    simp only [bgkU]
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hpS : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ 1 → |bgkS t| ≤ (fun t : ℝ => -Real.log t / 2) t := by
    intro t ht0 ht1
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos ht0
    have := Real.log_nonpos ht0.le ht1
    simp only [bgkS]
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hpGp : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ 1 → |bgkGp t| ≤ (fun _ : ℝ => (1:ℝ) / 2) t := by
    intro t ht0 ht1
    simp only [bgkGp]
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hpUp : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ 1 → |bgkUp t| ≤ (fun _ : ℝ => (1:ℝ) / 2) t := by
    intro t _ _
    simp only [bgkUp]
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> norm_num
  
  have eL : (fun t : ℝ => (fun t : ℝ => -Real.log t / 2) t * t ^ m) =
      fun t => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (-Real.log t * t ^ m) := by funext t; ring
  have hLi : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => (fun t : ℝ => -Real.log t / 2) t * t ^ m)
      MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
    rw [eL]; exact hmom.1.const_mul _
  have hLμ : ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, (fun t : ℝ => -Real.log t / 2) t * t ^ m =
      1 / 2 * (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) := by
    rw [eL, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hmom.2]
  have hCi : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => (fun _ : ℝ => (1:ℝ) / 2) t * t ^ m)
      MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
    (continuous_const.mul (continuous_pow m)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have hCμ : ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, (fun _ : ℝ => (1:ℝ) / 2) t * t ^ m = 1 / 2 * (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)) := by
    show ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, (1:ℝ) / 2 * t ^ m = _
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_pow]
    simp
  
  have hD : 0 < σ₀ - s := by linarith
  have hD1 : σ₀ - s ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hw' : w ∈ cStrip σ₀ := by
    simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw ⊢
    exact ⟨by linarith [hw.1], by linarith [hw.2.1], by linarith [hw.2.2]⟩
  obtain ⟨Q0, hQ0⟩ : ∃ q : ℝ, q = K / (σ₀ - s) ^ m := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Q1, hQ1⟩ : ∃ q : ℝ, q = K / (σ₀ - s) ^ (m + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ e : ℝ, e = Q1 * X ^ (m + 1) / ((m : ℝ) + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hQ0nn : 0 ≤ Q0 := by rw [hQ0]; exact div_nonneg hK (pow_nonneg hD.le _)
  have hQ1nn : 0 ≤ Q1 := by rw [hQ1]; exact div_nonneg hK (pow_nonneg hD.le _)
  have hQ01 : Q0 ≤ Q1 := by
    rw [hQ0, hQ1]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hK (pow_pos hD _)
      (pow_le_pow_of_le_one hD.le hD1 (Nat.le_succ m))
  have hE0 : 0 ≤ E := by rw [hE]; exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hQ1nn (pow_nonneg hX0.le _)) hn0.le
  
  have hv1 : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → y < Xi → ‖ψ1 y w‖ ≤ Q0 * y ^ m := fun y hy0 hy =>
    le_of_le_of_eq (hψ s y w hs0 hsσ hy0 hy hw).1 (by rw [hQ0]; ring)
  have hv2 : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → y < Xi → ‖ψ2 y w‖ ≤ Q0 * y ^ m := fun y hy0 hy =>
    le_of_le_of_eq (hψ s y w hs0 hsσ hy0 hy hw).2 (by rw [hQ0]; ring)
  have hd1 : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → y < Xi → ‖cDw ψ1 y w‖ ≤ (3 * ((m : ℝ) + 2) * Q1) * y ^ m := by
    intro y hy0 hy
    have := (strip_cauchy_nagumo (ψ1 y) σ₀).2 (K * y ^ m) m hσ₀
      (mul_nonneg hK (pow_nonneg hy0.le _)) (hdiff y hy0 hy).1
      (fun s' z h1 h2 hz => (hψ s' y z h1 h2 hy0 hy hz).1) s w hs0 hsσ hw
    show ‖deriv (ψ1 y) w‖ ≤ _
    exact le_of_le_of_eq this (by rw [hQ1]; ring)
  have hd2 : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → y < Xi → ‖cDw ψ2 y w‖ ≤ (3 * ((m : ℝ) + 2) * Q1) * y ^ m := by
    intro y hy0 hy
    have := (strip_cauchy_nagumo (ψ2 y) σ₀).2 (K * y ^ m) m hσ₀
      (mul_nonneg hK (pow_nonneg hy0.le _)) (hdiff y hy0 hy).2
      (fun s' z h1 h2 hz => (hψ s' y z h1 h2 hy0 hy hz).2) s w hs0 hsσ hw
    show ‖deriv (ψ2 y) w‖ ≤ _
    exact le_of_le_of_eq this (by rw [hQ1]; ring)
  
  have hμ : 1 / 2 * (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) ≤ 1 / 2 * (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)) := by
    have : ((m : ℝ) + 1) ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    gcongr
  have ar1 : ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → Y ≤ X → Q0 * Y ^ (m + 1) * (1 / 2 * (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2)) ≤ E / 2 := by
    intro Y hY hYX
    have hY' : Y ^ (m + 1) ≤ X ^ (m + 1) := pow_le_pow_left₀ hY.le hYX _
    calc Q0 * Y ^ (m + 1) * (1 / 2 * (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2))
        ≤ Q1 * X ^ (m + 1) * (1 / 2 * (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1))) :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hQ01 hY' (pow_nonneg hY.le _) hQ1nn) hμ (by positivity)
            (mul_nonneg hQ1nn (pow_nonneg hX0.le _))
      _ = E / 2 := by rw [hE]; ring
  have ar2 : ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → Y ≤ X →
      (3 * ((m : ℝ) + 2) * Q1) * Y ^ (m + 1) * (1 / 2 * (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2)) ≤ 3 * E := by
    intro Y hY hYX
    have hY' : Y ^ (m + 1) ≤ X ^ (m + 1) := pow_le_pow_left₀ hY.le hYX _
    have hc0 : 0 ≤ 3 * ((m : ℝ) + 2) * Q1 := mul_nonneg (by positivity) hQ1nn
    have hr : ((m : ℝ) + 2) / (2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]; linarith
    calc (3 * ((m : ℝ) + 2) * Q1) * Y ^ (m + 1) * (1 / 2 * (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2))
        ≤ (3 * ((m : ℝ) + 2) * Q1) * X ^ (m + 1) * (1 / 2 * (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hY' hc0) (by positivity)
      _ = 3 * E * (((m : ℝ) + 2) / (2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1))) := by rw [hE]; (field_simp) <;> ring
      _ ≤ 3 * E := mul_le_of_le_one_right (by linarith) hr
  have ar3 : Q0 * X ^ (m + 1) * (1 / 2 * (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1))) ≤ E / 2 := by
    calc Q0 * X ^ (m + 1) * (1 / 2 * (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)))
        ≤ Q1 * X ^ (m + 1) * (1 / 2 * (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hQ01 (pow_nonneg hX0.le _))
            (by positivity)
      _ = E / 2 := by rw [hE]; ring
  
  have kG1 : ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → Y ≤ X → ‖cKer bgkG ψ1 Y w‖ ≤ E / 2 := fun Y hY hYX =>
    (hker Q0 _ Y bgkG _ ψ1 hY (lt_of_le_of_lt hYX hXXi) hpG hLi hLμ hv1).trans (ar1 Y hY hYX)
  have kGd1 : ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → Y ≤ X → ‖cKer bgkG (cDw ψ1) Y w‖ ≤ 3 * E := fun Y hY hYX =>
    (hker _ _ Y bgkG _ (cDw ψ1) hY (lt_of_le_of_lt hYX hXXi) hpG hLi hLμ hd1).trans (ar2 Y hY hYX)
  have kGp1 : ‖cKer bgkGp ψ1 X w‖ ≤ E / 2 :=
    (hker Q0 _ X bgkGp _ ψ1 hX0 hXXi hpGp hCi hCμ hv1).trans ar3
  have kU2 : ‖cKer bgkU ψ2 X w‖ ≤ E / 2 :=
    (hker Q0 _ X bgkU _ ψ2 hX0 hXXi hpU hLi hLμ hv2).trans (ar1 X hX0 le_rfl)
  have kS2 : ‖cKer bgkS ψ2 X w‖ ≤ E / 2 :=
    (hker Q0 _ X bgkS _ ψ2 hX0 hXXi hpS hLi hLμ hv2).trans (ar1 X hX0 le_rfl)
  have kUp2 : ‖cKer bgkUp ψ2 X w‖ ≤ E / 2 :=
    (hker Q0 _ X bgkUp _ ψ2 hX0 hXXi hpUp hCi hCμ hv2).trans ar3
  have kUd2 : ‖cKer bgkU (cDw ψ2) X w‖ ≤ 3 * E :=
    (hker _ _ X bgkU _ (cDw ψ2) hX0 hXXi hpU hLi hLμ hd2).trans (ar2 X hX0 le_rfl)
  have kSd2 : ‖cKer bgkS (cDw ψ2) X w‖ ≤ 3 * E :=
    (hker _ _ X bgkS _ (cDw ψ2) hX0 hXXi hpS hLi hLμ hd2).trans (ar2 X hX0 le_rfl)
  
  have hrad : ∀ (h : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (B : ℝ), (∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → y ≤ X → ‖h y w‖ ≤ B) →
      ‖cRad h X w‖ ≤ B * X := by
    intro h B hB
    unfold cRad
    have := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := 0) (b := X)
      (f := fun x => h x w) (C := B) (fun x hx => by
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hX0.le] at hx
        exact hB x hx.1 hx.2)
    rw [sub_zero, abs_of_pos hX0] at this
    exact this
  
  have hR : 8 * (1 + A₁) ^ 2 * (1 + Xi) * K * X ^ (m + 1) / (((m : ℝ) + 1) * (σ₀ - s) ^ (m + 1)) =
      8 * (1 + A₁) ^ 2 * (1 + Xi) * E := by
    rw [hE, hQ1]
    have hDp : (σ₀ - s) ^ (m + 1) ≠ 0 := (pow_pos hD _).ne'
    have hnp : (m : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := hn0.ne'
    (field_simp) <;> ring
  rw [hR]
  have hpm : ∀ (a b : ℂ) (B : ℝ), ‖a‖ ≤ A₁ → ‖b‖ ≤ B → ‖a * b‖ ≤ A₁ * B := fun a b B ha hb =>
    (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul ha hb (norm_nonneg _) hA₁)
  have hA : ∀ {a b : ℂ} {x y : ℝ}, ‖a‖ ≤ x → ‖b‖ ≤ y → ‖a + b‖ ≤ x + y := fun h1 h2 =>
    (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add h1 h2)
  have hac' : ∀ i, ‖ac i X w‖ ≤ A₁ := fun i => hac i X w hX0 hXXi hw'
  have hbc' : ∀ i, ‖bc i X w‖ ≤ A₁ := fun i => hbc i X w hX0 hXXi hw'
  constructor
  · unfold bgT1
    have p0 := hpm _ _ _ (hac' 0) (kG1 X hX0 le_rfl)
    have p1 := hpm _ _ _ (hac' 1) kGp1
    have p2 := hpm _ _ _ (hac' 2) (kGd1 X hX0 le_rfl)
    have p3 := hpm _ _ _ (hac' 3) kU2
    have p4 := hpm _ _ _ (hac' 4) kS2
    have p5 := hpm _ _ _ (hac' 5) kSd2
    refine (hA (hA (hA (hA (hA p0 p1) p2) p3) p4) p5).trans ?_
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hA₁ hE0, mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg A₁) hE0, mul_nonneg hXi.le hE0,
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hA₁ hXi.le) hE0, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg A₁) hXi.le) hE0]
  · unfold bgT2
    have p0 := hpm _ _ _ (hbc' 0) kU2
    have p1 := hpm _ _ _ (hbc' 1) kUp2
    have p2 := hpm _ _ _ (hbc' 2) kUd2
    have p3 := hpm _ _ _ (hbc' 3) kS2
    have p4 := hpm _ _ _ (hbc' 4) kSd2

      hrad _ _ (fun y hy0 hyX => by
        show ‖gc y w * cKer bgkG ψ1 y w‖ ≤ _
        exact hpm _ _ _ (hgc y w hy0 (lt_of_le_of_lt hyX hXXi) hw').1 (kG1 y hy0 hyX))
    have r6 : ‖cRad (fun x z => cDw gc x z * cKer bgkG ψ1 x z + gc x z * cKer bgkG (cDw ψ1) x z) X w‖
        ≤ (A₁ * (E / 2) + A₁ * (3 * E)) * X :=
      hrad _ _ (fun y hy0 hyX => by
        show ‖cDw gc y w * cKer bgkG ψ1 y w + gc y w * cKer bgkG (cDw ψ1) y w‖ ≤ _
        have hg := hgc y w hy0 (lt_of_le_of_lt hyX hXXi) hw'
        exact hA (hpm _ _ _ hg.2 (kG1 y hy0 hyX)) (hpm _ _ _ hg.1 (kGd1 y hy0 hyX)))
    have hXn : ‖((X : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = X := by rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hX0]
    have r7 : ‖((X : ℝ) : ℂ) * (gc X w * cKer bgkG ψ1 X w)‖ ≤ X * (A₁ * (E / 2)) := by
      refine (norm_mul_le _ _).trans ?_
      rw [hXn]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpm _ _ _ (hgc X w hX0 hXXi hw').1 (kG1 X hX0 le_rfl)) hX0.le
    have p5 := hpm _ _ _ (hbc' 5) r5
    have p6 := hpm _ _ _ (hbc' 6) r6
    have p7 := hpm _ _ _ (hbc' 7) r7
    refine (hA (hA (hA (hA (hA (hA (hA p0 p1) p2) p3) p4) p5) p6) p7).trans ?_
    have hXE : A₁ ^ 2 * X * E ≤ A₁ ^ 2 * Xi * E :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hXXi.le (sq_nonneg _)) hE0
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hA₁ hE0, mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg A₁) hE0, mul_nonneg hXi.le hE0,
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hA₁ hXi.le) hE0, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg A₁) hXi.le) hE0]
