signature.statement: ∀ (Xi ρ : ℝ) (ac : Fin 6 → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (bc : Fin 8 → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (gc ψ1 ψ2 : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ), 0 < ρ → (∀ i, CReal Xi (ac i)) → (∀ i, CReal Xi (bc i)) → CReal Xi gc → CReal Xi ψ1 → CReal Xi ψ2 → (∀ X, 0 < X → X < Xi → DifferentiableOn ℂ (gc X) (cStrip ρ)) → (∀ X, 0 < X → X < Xi → DifferentiableOn ℂ (ψ1 X) (cStrip ρ)) → (∀ X, 0 < X → X < Xi → DifferentiableOn ℂ (ψ2 X) (cStrip ρ)) → CReal Xi (bgT1 ac ψ1 ψ2) ∧ CReal Xi (bgT2 bc gc ψ1 ψ2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xi ρ ac bc gc ψ1 ψ2 hρ hRa hRb hRg hR1 hR2 hdg hd1 hd2
  have hIntIm : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℂ) (a b : ℝ), a ≤ b → (∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, (f t).im = 0) →
      (∫ t in a..b, f t).im = 0 := by
    intro f a b hab hf
    have hcongr : ∫ t in Ioo a b, f t = ∫ t in Ioo a b, (((f t).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioo (fun t ht => ?_)
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp
      · simp [hf t ht]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab, integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo, hcongr]
    rw [integral_complex_ofReal]; exact Complex.ofReal_im _
  have hK : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ, CReal Xi φ → ∀ kk : ℝ → ℝ, CReal Xi (cKer kk φ) := by
    intro φ hφ kk X η h0 h1 e1 e2
    show ((X : ℂ) * ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, ((kk t : ℝ) : ℂ) * φ (t * X) (η : ℂ)).im = 0
    have hI : (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, ((kk t : ℝ) : ℂ) * φ (t * X) (η : ℂ)).im = 0 := by
      apply hIntIm _ 0 1 zero_le_one
      intro t ht
      have ht0 : 0 < t * X := mul_pos ht.1 h0
      have ht1 : t * X < Xi := by nlinarith [ht.2]
      rw [Complex.mul_im, hφ (t * X) η ht0 ht1 e1 e2, Complex.ofReal_im]
      ring
    rw [Complex.mul_im, hI, Complex.ofReal_im]
    ring
  have hRd : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ, CReal Xi φ → CReal Xi (cRad φ) := by
    intro φ hφ X η h0 h1 e1 e2
    show (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, φ x (η : ℂ)).im = 0
    apply hIntIm _ 0 X h0.le
    intro t ht
    exact hφ t η ht.1 (lt_trans ht.2 h1) e1 e2
  have hopen : IsOpen (cStrip ρ) :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
        (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const))
  have hD : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ, CReal Xi φ →
      (∀ X, 0 < X → X < Xi → DifferentiableOn ℂ (φ X) (cStrip ρ)) → CReal Xi (cDw φ) := by
    intro φ hφ hdφ X η h0 h1 e1 e2
    show (deriv (φ X) (η : ℂ)).im = 0
    have hmem : (η : ℂ) ∈ cStrip ρ := by
      simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.ofReal_re, abs_zero]
      exact ⟨hρ, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hd : HasDerivAt (φ X) (deriv (φ X) (η : ℂ)) (η : ℂ) :=
      ((hdφ X h0 h1).differentiableAt (hopen.mem_nhds hmem)).hasDerivAt
    have hr : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => φ X (y : ℂ)) (deriv (φ X) (η : ℂ)) η := hd.comp_ofReal
    have h2 := Complex.imCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt η hr
    have hev : (fun _ : ℝ => (0:ℝ)) =ᶠ[nhds η] (Complex.imCLM ∘ fun y : ℝ => φ X (y : ℂ)) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds e1 e2] with y hy
      simp [hφ X y h0 h1 hy.1 hy.2]
    have h3 := (h2.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).unique (hasDerivAt_const η (0:ℝ))
    simpa using h3
  have D1 := hD ψ1 hR1 hd1
  have D2 := hD ψ2 hR2 hd2
  have Dg := hD gc hRg hdg
  have F5 : CReal Xi (fun x z => gc x z * cKer bgkG ψ1 x z) := by
    intro X η h0 h1 e1 e2
    simp only [Complex.mul_im, hRg X η h0 h1 e1 e2, hK ψ1 hR1 bgkG X η h0 h1 e1 e2, mul_zero,
      zero_mul, add_zero]
  have F6 : CReal Xi
      (fun x z => cDw gc x z * cKer bgkG ψ1 x z + gc x z * cKer bgkG (cDw ψ1) x z) := by
    intro X η h0 h1 e1 e2
    simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, hRg X η h0 h1 e1 e2, Dg X η h0 h1 e1 e2,
      hK ψ1 hR1 bgkG X η h0 h1 e1 e2, hK _ D1 bgkG X η h0 h1 e1 e2, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
  have R5 := hRd _ F5
  have R6 := hRd _ F6
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro X η h0 h1 e1 e2
    simp only [bgT1, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im,
      hRa 0 X η h0 h1 e1 e2, hRa 1 X η h0 h1 e1 e2, hRa 2 X η h0 h1 e1 e2,
      hRa 3 X η h0 h1 e1 e2, hRa 4 X η h0 h1 e1 e2, hRa 5 X η h0 h1 e1 e2,
      hK ψ1 hR1 bgkG X η h0 h1 e1 e2, hK ψ1 hR1 bgkGp X η h0 h1 e1 e2,
      hK _ D1 bgkG X η h0 h1 e1 e2, hK ψ2 hR2 bgkU X η h0 h1 e1 e2,
      hK ψ2 hR2 bgkS X η h0 h1 e1 e2, hK _ D2 bgkS X η h0 h1 e1 e2,
      mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
  · intro X η h0 h1 e1 e2
    simp only [bgT2, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_im,
      hRb 0 X η h0 h1 e1 e2, hRb 1 X η h0 h1 e1 e2, hRb 2 X η h0 h1 e1 e2,
      hRb 3 X η h0 h1 e1 e2, hRb 4 X η h0 h1 e1 e2, hRb 5 X η h0 h1 e1 e2,
      hRb 6 X η h0 h1 e1 e2, hRb 7 X η h0 h1 e1 e2, hRg X η h0 h1 e1 e2,
      hK ψ1 hR1 bgkG X η h0 h1 e1 e2,
      hK ψ2 hR2 bgkU X η h0 h1 e1 e2, hK ψ2 hR2 bgkUp X η h0 h1 e1 e2,
      hK _ D2 bgkU X η h0 h1 e1 e2, hK ψ2 hR2 bgkS X η h0 h1 e1 e2,
      hK _ D2 bgkS X η h0 h1 e1 e2,
      R5 X η h0 h1 e1 e2, R6 X η h0 h1 e1 e2,
      mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (Xi σ₀ M Λ : ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ), 0 < Xi → 0 < σ₀ → 0 ≤ M → 0 ≤ Λ → (∀ m, CReg Xi σ₀ (F m)) → (∀ (m : ℕ) (s X : ℝ) (w : ℂ), 0 < s → s < σ₀ → 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip s → ‖F m X w‖ ≤ M * Λ ^ m * X ^ m / ((m.factorial : ℝ) * (σ₀ - s) ^ m)) → ∃ u : ℕ → ℝ, Summable u ∧ (∀ (m : ℕ) (X : ℝ) (w : ℂ), 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip (σ₀ / 2) → ‖F m X w‖ ≤ u m) ∧ CB Xi (σ₀ / 2) (∑' m, u m) (fun X w => ∑' m, F m X w)

signature.name: bg_series_props
signature.statement: ∀ (Xi σ₀ M Λ : ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ), 0 < Xi → 0 < σ₀ → 0 ≤ M → 0 ≤ Λ → (∀ m, CReg Xi σ₀ (F m)) → (∀ (m : ℕ) (s X : ℝ) (w : ℂ), 0 < s → s < σ₀ → 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip s → ‖F m X w‖ ≤ M * Λ ^ m * X ^ m / ((m.factorial : ℝ) * (σ₀ - s) ^ m)) → ∃ u : ℕ → ℝ, Summable u ∧ (∀ (m : ℕ) (X : ℝ) (w : ℂ), 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip (σ₀ / 2) → ‖F m X w‖ ≤ u m) ∧ CB Xi (σ₀ / 2) (∑' m, u m) (fun X w => ∑' m, F m X w)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xi σ₀ M Λ F hXi hσ hM hΛ hreg hbd
  have hstrip : ∀ s t : ℝ, s ≤ t → cStrip s ⊆ cStrip t := by
    intro s t hst w hw
    simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw ⊢
    exact ⟨by linarith [hw.1], by linarith [hw.2.1], by linarith [hw.2.2]⟩
  have hopen : ∀ ρ : ℝ, IsOpen (cStrip ρ) := by
    intro ρ
    have e : cStrip ρ = {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ} ∩ ({w : ℂ | -1 - ρ < w.re} ∩ {w : ℂ | w.re < 1 + ρ}) := by
      ext w; simp [cStrip]
    rw [e]
    exact (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
        (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const))
  set c : ℝ := 2 * Λ * Xi / σ₀ with hc
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by positivity
  set u : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => M * (c ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) with hu
  have hus : Summable u := (Real.summable_pow_div_factorial c).mul_left M
  have hσ2 : (0 : ℝ) < σ₀ / 2 := by linarith
  have hσ2' : σ₀ / 2 < σ₀ := by linarith
  have hub : ∀ (m : ℕ) (X : ℝ) (w : ℂ), 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip (σ₀ / 2) → ‖F m X w‖ ≤ u m := by
    intro m X w h0 h1 hw
    have h := hbd m (σ₀ / 2) X w hσ2 hσ2' h0 h1 hw
    have e1 : σ₀ - σ₀ / 2 = σ₀ / 2 := by ring
    rw [e1] at h
    have hf : (0 : ℝ) < (m.factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos m
    have hden : 0 < (m.factorial : ℝ) * (σ₀ / 2) ^ m := by positivity
    have h2 : M * Λ ^ m * X ^ m / ((m.factorial : ℝ) * (σ₀ / 2) ^ m) ≤
        M * Λ ^ m * Xi ^ m / ((m.factorial : ℝ) * (σ₀ / 2) ^ m) := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hden.le
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ h0.le h1.le m
    have e2 : M * Λ ^ m * Xi ^ m / ((m.factorial : ℝ) * (σ₀ / 2) ^ m) = u m := by
      simp only [hu, hc]
      rw [div_pow, div_pow, mul_pow, mul_pow]
      field_simp
    linarith
  refine ⟨u, hus, hub, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply continuousOn_tsum (u := u)
    · intro i
      exact (hreg i).1.mono (Set.prod_mono subset_rfl (hstrip _ _ hσ2'.le))
    · exact hus
    · intro n p hp
      exact hub n p.1 p.2 hp.1.1 hp.1.2 hp.2
  · intro X h0 h1
    exact Complex.differentiableOn_tsum_of_summable_norm hus
      (fun i => ((hreg i).2.1 X h0 h1).mono (hstrip _ _ hσ2'.le)) (hopen _)
      (fun i w hw => hub i X w h0 h1 hw)
  · intro X w h0 h1 hw
    exact tsum_of_norm_bounded hus.hasSum (fun m => hub m X w h0 h1 hw)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (Xi s₁ A₁ : ℝ) (ac : Fin 6 → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (bc : Fin 8 → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (gc : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (F1 F2 : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (u : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < Xi → 0 < s₁ → Summable u → (∀ i, CB Xi s₁ A₁ (ac i)) → (∀ i, CB Xi s₁ A₁ (bc i)) → CB Xi s₁ A₁ gc → CB Xi s₁ A₁ (cDw gc) → (∀ m, CReg Xi s₁ (F1 m) ∧ CReg Xi s₁ (F2 m) ∧ CReg Xi s₁ (cDw (F1 m)) ∧ CReg Xi s₁ (cDw (F2 m)) ∧ CReg Xi s₁ (cKer bgkG (F1 m)) ∧ CReg Xi s₁ (cKer bgkG (cDw (F1 m)))) → (∀ (m : ℕ) (X : ℝ) (w : ℂ), 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip s₁ → ‖F1 m X w‖ ≤ u m ∧ ‖F2 m X w‖ ≤ u m) → ∀ (X : ℝ) (w : ℂ), 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip (s₁ / 2) → HasSum (fun m => bgT1 ac (F1 m) (F2 m) X w) (bgT1 ac (fun Y z => ∑' m, F1 m Y z) (fun Y z => ∑' m, F2 m Y z) X w) ∧ HasSum (fun m => bgT2 bc gc (F1 m) (F2 m) X w) (bgT2 bc gc (fun Y z => ∑' m, F1 m Y z) (fun Y z => ∑' m, F2 m Y z) X w)

signature.name: bgT_hasSum
signature.statement: ∀ (Xi s₁ A₁ : ℝ) (ac : Fin 6 → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (bc : Fin 8 → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (gc : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (F1 F2 : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (u : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < Xi → 0 < s₁ → Summable u → (∀ i, CB Xi s₁ A₁ (ac i)) → (∀ i, CB Xi s₁ A₁ (bc i)) → CB Xi s₁ A₁ gc → CB Xi s₁ A₁ (cDw gc) → (∀ m, CReg Xi s₁ (F1 m) ∧ CReg Xi s₁ (F2 m) ∧ CReg Xi s₁ (cDw (F1 m)) ∧ CReg Xi s₁ (cDw (F2 m)) ∧ CReg Xi s₁ (cKer bgkG (F1 m)) ∧ CReg Xi s₁ (cKer bgkG (cDw (F1 m)))) → (∀ (m : ℕ) (X : ℝ) (w : ℂ), 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip s₁ → ‖F1 m X w‖ ≤ u m ∧ ‖F2 m X w‖ ≤ u m) → ∀ (X : ℝ) (w : ℂ), 0 < X → X < Xi → w ∈ cStrip (s₁ / 2) → HasSum (fun m => bgT1 ac (F1 m) (F2 m) X w) (bgT1 ac (fun Y z => ∑' m, F1 m Y z) (fun Y z => ∑' m, F2 m Y z) X w) ∧ HasSum (fun m => bgT2 bc gc (F1 m) (F2 m) X w) (bgT2 bc gc (fun Y z => ∑' m, F1 m Y z) (fun Y z => ∑' m, F2 m Y z) X w)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xi s₁ A₁ ac bc gc F1 F2 u hXi hs₁ hu hac hbc hgc hdgc hreg hb X w hX0 hXi' hw
  set ψ1 : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun Y z => ∑' m, F1 m Y z with hψ1
  set ψ2 : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun Y z => ∑' m, F2 m Y z with hψ2
  
  have hstripOpen : IsOpen (cStrip s₁) := by
    have e : cStrip s₁ = {z : ℂ | |z.im| < s₁} ∩ ({z : ℂ | -1 - s₁ < z.re} ∩ {z : ℂ | z.re < 1 + s₁}) := by
      ext z; simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff]
    rw [e]
    exact (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
        (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const))
  have hw1 : w ∈ cStrip s₁ := by
    simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw ⊢
    exact ⟨by linarith [hw.1], by linarith [hw.2.1], by linarith [hw.2.2]⟩
  have hu0 : ∀ m, 0 ≤ u m := fun m => le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hb m X w hX0 hXi' hw1).1
  have hA : 0 ≤ A₁ := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hgc.2.2 X w hX0 hXi' hw1)
  have h2s : 0 ≤ 2 / s₁ := div_nonneg (by norm_num) hs₁.le
  
  have hball : ∀ z ∈ cStrip (s₁ / 2), Metric.closedBall z (s₁ / 2) ⊆ cStrip s₁ := by
    intro z hz z' hz'
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hz'
    have h1 : |(z' - z).im| ≤ ‖z' - z‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
    have h2 : |(z' - z).re| ≤ ‖z' - z‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
    rw [Complex.sub_im] at h1
    rw [Complex.sub_re] at h2
    have h3 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub z'.im z.im
    have h4 := abs_le.mp (h2.trans hz')
    simp only [cStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hz ⊢
    obtain ⟨a1, a2, a3⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith [h4.1], by linarith [h4.2]⟩
  have hder : ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (K : ℝ), DifferentiableOn ℂ f (cStrip s₁) →
      (∀ z ∈ cStrip s₁, ‖f z‖ ≤ K) → ∀ z ∈ cStrip (s₁ / 2), ‖deriv f z‖ ≤ 2 / s₁ * K := by
    intro f K hf hK z hz
    have hr : (0:ℝ) < s₁ / 2 := by linarith
    have hd : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball z (s₁ / 2)) := by
      apply DifferentiableOn.diffContOnCl
      rw [closure_ball z hr.ne']
      exact hf.mono (hball z hz)
    have key := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr hd
      (fun z' hz' => hK z' (hball z hz (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz')))
    calc ‖deriv f z‖ ≤ K / (s₁ / 2) := key
      _ = 2 / s₁ * K := by rw [div_div_eq_mul_div]; ring
  
  have SC : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => φ p.1 p.2) (Ioo 0 Xi ×ˢ cStrip s₁) →
      ContinuousOn (fun Y => φ Y w) (Ioo 0 Xi) := by
    intro φ hφ
    exact hφ.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn (fun Y hY => ⟨hY, hw1⟩)
  
  have hKer : ∀ (kk : ℝ → ℝ) (G : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (g : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (v : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℝ),
      ContinuousOn kk (Ioc 0 1) → IntervalIntegrable kk MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 → Summable v →
      0 < x → x < Xi → (∀ m, ContinuousOn (fun Y => G m Y w) (Ioo 0 Xi)) →
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (Y : ℝ), 0 < Y → Y < Xi → ‖G m Y w‖ ≤ v m) →
      (∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → Y < Xi → HasSum (fun m => G m Y w) (g Y w)) →
      HasSum (fun m => cKer kk (G m) x w) (cKer kk g x w) := by
    intro kk G g v x hkk hki hv hx0 hx1 hG hGb hlim
    have hmaps : ∀ t ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, t * x ∈ Ioo 0 Xi := by
      intro t ht
      exact ⟨mul_pos ht.1 hx0, lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_of_le_one_left hx0.le ht.2) hx1⟩
    have huIoc : uIoc (0:ℝ) 1 = Ioc 0 1 := uIoc_of_le zero_le_one
    have key : HasSum (fun m => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, ((kk t : ℝ) : ℂ) * G m (t * x) w)
        (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, ((kk t : ℝ) : ℂ) * g (t * x) w) := by
      refine intervalIntegral.hasSum_integral_of_dominated_convergence
        (F := fun m t => ((kk t : ℝ) : ℂ) * G m (t * x) w)
        (f := fun t => ((kk t : ℝ) : ℂ) * g (t * x) w)
        (fun m t => |kk t| * v m) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro m
        rw [huIoc]
        have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => ((kk t : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Ioc 0 1) :=
          Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp_continuousOn hkk
        have h2 : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => G m (t * x) w) (Ioc 0 1) :=
          (hG m).comp (continuous_id.mul continuous_const).continuousOn hmaps
        exact (h1.mul h2).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioc
      · intro m
        refine MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun t ht => ?_)
        rw [huIoc] at ht
        show ‖((kk t : ℝ) : ℂ) * G m (t * x) w‖ ≤ |kk t| * v m
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hGb m _ (hmaps t ht).1 (hmaps t ht).2) (abs_nonneg _)
      · exact MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun t _ => hv.mul_left _)
      · have e : (fun t => ∑' m, |kk t| * v m) = fun t => |kk t| * ∑' m, v m := by
          funext t; exact tsum_mul_left
        rw [e]
        exact hki.abs.mul_const _
      · refine MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun t ht => ?_)
        rw [huIoc] at ht
        exact (hlim _ (hmaps t ht).1 (hmaps t ht).2).mul_left _
    exact key.mul_left ((x : ℝ) : ℂ)
  
  have hRad : ∀ (H : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (hh : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (v : ℕ → ℝ),
      Summable v → (∀ m, ContinuousOn (fun x => H m x w) (Ioo 0 Xi)) →
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ), 0 < x → x < Xi → ‖H m x w‖ ≤ v m) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x < Xi → HasSum (fun m => H m x w) (hh x w)) →
      HasSum (fun m => cRad (H m) X w) (cRad hh X w) := by
    intro H hh v hv hH hHb hlim
    have hsub : Ioc (0:ℝ) X ⊆ Ioo 0 Xi := fun x hx => ⟨hx.1, lt_of_le_of_lt hx.2 hXi'⟩
    have huIoc : uIoc (0:ℝ) X = Ioc 0 X := uIoc_of_le hX0.le
    exact intervalIntegral.hasSum_integral_of_dominated_convergence
      (F := fun m x => H m x w) (f := fun x => hh x w) (fun m _ => v m)
      (fun m => by
        rw [huIoc]; exact ((hH m).mono hsub).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioc)
      (fun m => MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun x hx => by
        rw [huIoc] at hx; exact hHb m x (hsub hx).1 (hsub hx).2))
      (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun _ _ => hv))
      intervalIntegrable_const
      (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun x hx => by
        rw [huIoc] at hx; exact hlim x (hsub hx).1 (hsub hx).2))
  
  have hKerNorm : ∀ (kk : ℝ → ℝ) (G : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (κ v x : ℝ), 0 < x → x < Xi →
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ 1 → |kk t| ≤ κ) → (∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y → Y < Xi → ‖G Y w‖ ≤ v) →
      ‖cKer kk G x w‖ ≤ x * (κ * v) := by
    intro kk G κ v x hx0 hx1 hk hG
    have hκ : 0 ≤ κ := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hk 1 one_pos le_rfl)
    have hint : ‖∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, ((kk t : ℝ) : ℂ) * G (t * x) w‖ ≤ κ * v * |(1:ℝ) - 0| := by
      apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      intro t ht
      rw [uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have hY0 : 0 < t * x := mul_pos ht.1 hx0
      have hY1 : t * x < Xi := lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_of_le_one_left hx0.le ht.2) hx1
      exact mul_le_mul (hk t ht.1 ht.2) (hG _ hY0 hY1) (norm_nonneg _) hκ
    simp only [sub_zero, abs_one, mul_one] at hint
    show ‖((x : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, ((kk t : ℝ) : ℂ) * G (t * x) w‖ ≤ x * (κ * v)
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hx0]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hint hx0.le
  
  have hlogC : ContinuousOn Real.log (Ioc (0:ℝ) 1) :=
    Real.continuousOn_log.mono (fun t ht => by
      simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; exact ne_of_gt ht.1)
  have kG : ContinuousOn bgkG (Ioc 0 1) ∧ IntervalIntegrable bgkG MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
    have hc : Continuous bgkG := by unfold bgkG; fun_prop
    exact ⟨hc.continuousOn, hc.intervalIntegrable 0 1⟩
  have kGp : ContinuousOn bgkGp (Ioc 0 1) ∧ IntervalIntegrable bgkGp MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
    have hc : Continuous bgkGp := by unfold bgkGp; fun_prop
    exact ⟨hc.continuousOn, hc.intervalIntegrable 0 1⟩
  have kUp : ContinuousOn bgkUp (Ioc 0 1) ∧ IntervalIntegrable bgkUp MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
    have hc : Continuous bgkUp := by unfold bgkUp; fun_prop
    exact ⟨hc.continuousOn, hc.intervalIntegrable 0 1⟩
  have kU : ContinuousOn bgkU (Ioc 0 1) ∧ IntervalIntegrable bgkU MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show ContinuousOn (fun t => -Real.log t / 2) (Ioc 0 1)
      exact hlogC.neg.div_const 2
    · show IntervalIntegrable (fun t => -Real.log t / 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1
      exact (intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_log'.neg).div_const 2
  have kS : ContinuousOn bgkS (Ioc 0 1) ∧ IntervalIntegrable bgkS MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
    have hc1 : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => t - 1) := by fun_prop
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show ContinuousOn (fun t => (t - 1 - Real.log t) / 2) (Ioc 0 1)
      exact (hc1.continuousOn.sub hlogC).div_const 2
    · show IntervalIntegrable (fun t => (t - 1 - Real.log t) / 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1
      exact ((hc1.intervalIntegrable 0 1).sub intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_log').div_const 2
  have kGb : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ 1 → |bgkG t| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    intro t ht0 ht1
    show |(1 - t) / 2| ≤ 1 / 2
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  
  have P1 : ∀ Y z, 0 < Y → Y < Xi → z ∈ cStrip s₁ → HasSum (fun m => F1 m Y z) (ψ1 Y z) :=
    fun Y z a b c => (Summable.of_norm_bounded hu (fun m => (hb m Y z a b c).1)).hasSum
  have P2 : ∀ Y z, 0 < Y → Y < Xi → z ∈ cStrip s₁ → HasSum (fun m => F2 m Y z) (ψ2 Y z) :=
    fun Y z a b c => (Summable.of_norm_bounded hu (fun m => (hb m Y z a b c).2)).hasSum
  have D1 : ∀ Y z, 0 < Y → Y < Xi → z ∈ cStrip s₁ →
      HasSum (fun m => cDw (F1 m) Y z) (cDw ψ1 Y z) := by
    intro Y z a b c
    have := Complex.hasSum_deriv_of_summable_norm (F := fun m => F1 m Y) (U := cStrip s₁) hu
      (fun m => (hreg m).1.2.1 Y a b) hstripOpen (fun m z' hz' => (hb m Y z' a b hz').1) c
    exact this
  have D2 : ∀ Y z, 0 < Y → Y < Xi → z ∈ cStrip s₁ →
      HasSum (fun m => cDw (F2 m) Y z) (cDw ψ2 Y z) := by
    intro Y z a b c
    have := Complex.hasSum_deriv_of_summable_norm (F := fun m => F2 m Y) (U := cStrip s₁) hu
      (fun m => (hreg m).2.1.2.1 Y a b) hstripOpen (fun m z' hz' => (hb m Y z' a b hz').2) c
    exact this
  have DB1 : ∀ m Y, 0 < Y → Y < Xi → ‖cDw (F1 m) Y w‖ ≤ 2 / s₁ * u m :=
    fun m Y a b => hder (F1 m Y) (u m) ((hreg m).1.2.1 Y a b) (fun z hz => (hb m Y z a b hz).1) w hw
  have DB2 : ∀ m Y, 0 < Y → Y < Xi → ‖cDw (F2 m) Y w‖ ≤ 2 / s₁ * u m :=
    fun m Y a b => hder (F2 m Y) (u m) ((hreg m).2.1.2.1 Y a b) (fun z hz => (hb m Y z a b hz).2) w hw
  
  have K1 : ∀ kk : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn kk (Ioc 0 1) ∧ IntervalIntegrable kk MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 →
      ∀ x, 0 < x → x < Xi → HasSum (fun m => cKer kk (F1 m) x w) (cKer kk ψ1 x w) :=
    fun kk hk x a b => hKer kk F1 ψ1 u x hk.1 hk.2 hu a b (fun m => SC _ (hreg m).1.1)
      (fun m Y c d => (hb m Y w c d hw1).1) (fun Y c d => P1 Y w c d hw1)
  have K2 : ∀ kk : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn kk (Ioc 0 1) ∧ IntervalIntegrable kk MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 →
      ∀ x, 0 < x → x < Xi → HasSum (fun m => cKer kk (F2 m) x w) (cKer kk ψ2 x w) :=
    fun kk hk x a b => hKer kk F2 ψ2 u x hk.1 hk.2 hu a b (fun m => SC _ (hreg m).2.1.1)
      (fun m Y c d => (hb m Y w c d hw1).2) (fun Y c d => P2 Y w c d hw1)
  have K3 : ∀ kk : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn kk (Ioc 0 1) ∧ IntervalIntegrable kk MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 →
      ∀ x, 0 < x → x < Xi → HasSum (fun m => cKer kk (cDw (F1 m)) x w) (cKer kk (cDw ψ1) x w) :=
    fun kk hk x a b => hKer kk (fun m => cDw (F1 m)) (cDw ψ1) (fun m => 2 / s₁ * u m) x hk.1 hk.2
      (hu.mul_left _) a b (fun m => SC _ (hreg m).2.2.1.1)
      (fun m Y c d => DB1 m Y c d) (fun Y c d => D1 Y w c d hw1)
  have K4 : ∀ kk : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn kk (Ioc 0 1) ∧ IntervalIntegrable kk MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 →
      ∀ x, 0 < x → x < Xi → HasSum (fun m => cKer kk (cDw (F2 m)) x w) (cKer kk (cDw ψ2) x w) :=
    fun kk hk x a b => hKer kk (fun m => cDw (F2 m)) (cDw ψ2) (fun m => 2 / s₁ * u m) x hk.1 hk.2
      (hu.mul_left _) a b (fun m => SC _ (hreg m).2.2.2.1.1)
      (fun m Y c d => DB2 m Y c d) (fun Y c d => D2 Y w c d hw1)
  
  have R5 : HasSum (fun m => cRad (fun x z => gc x z * cKer bgkG (F1 m) x z) X w)
      (cRad (fun x z => gc x z * cKer bgkG ψ1 x z) X w) := by
    refine hRad (fun m x z => gc x z * cKer bgkG (F1 m) x z) (fun x z => gc x z * cKer bgkG ψ1 x z)
      (fun m => A₁ * (Xi * (1 / 2 * u m))) (((hu.mul_left _).mul_left _).mul_left _) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro m
      exact (SC _ hgc.1).mul (SC _ (hreg m).2.2.2.2.1.1)
    · intro m x a b
      have h1 := hgc.2.2 x w a b hw1
      have h2 := hKerNorm bgkG (F1 m) (1 / 2) (u m) x a b kGb (fun Y c d => (hb m Y w c d hw1).1)
      have h3 : x * (1 / 2 * u m) ≤ Xi * (1 / 2 * u m) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right b.le (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hu0 m))
      show ‖gc x w * cKer bgkG (F1 m) x w‖ ≤ A₁ * (Xi * (1 / 2 * u m))
      rw [norm_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul h1 (h2.trans h3) (norm_nonneg _) hA
    · intro x a b
      exact (K1 bgkG kG x a b).mul_left (gc x w)
  have R6 : HasSum (fun m => cRad (fun x z => cDw gc x z * cKer bgkG (F1 m) x z +
        gc x z * cKer bgkG (cDw (F1 m)) x z) X w)
      (cRad (fun x z => cDw gc x z * cKer bgkG ψ1 x z + gc x z * cKer bgkG (cDw ψ1) x z) X w) := by
    refine hRad (fun m x z => cDw gc x z * cKer bgkG (F1 m) x z + gc x z * cKer bgkG (cDw (F1 m)) x z)
      (fun x z => cDw gc x z * cKer bgkG ψ1 x z + gc x z * cKer bgkG (cDw ψ1) x z)
      (fun m => A₁ * (Xi * (1 / 2 * u m)) + A₁ * (Xi * (1 / 2 * (2 / s₁ * u m))))
      ((((hu.mul_left _).mul_left _).mul_left _).add
        ((((hu.mul_left _).mul_left _).mul_left _).mul_left _)) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro m
      exact ((SC _ hdgc.1).mul (SC _ (hreg m).2.2.2.2.1.1)).add
        ((SC _ hgc.1).mul (SC _ (hreg m).2.2.2.2.2.1))
    · intro m x a b
      have g1 := hdgc.2.2 x w a b hw1
      have g2 := hgc.2.2 x w a b hw1
      have k1 := hKerNorm bgkG (F1 m) (1 / 2) (u m) x a b kGb (fun Y c d => (hb m Y w c d hw1).1)
      have k2 := hKerNorm bgkG (cDw (F1 m)) (1 / 2) (2 / s₁ * u m) x a b kGb
        (fun Y c d => DB1 m Y c d)
      have n1 : 0 ≤ 1 / 2 * u m := mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hu0 m)
      have n2 : 0 ≤ 1 / 2 * (2 / s₁ * u m) := mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (mul_nonneg h2s (hu0 m))
      have k1' := k1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right b.le n1)
      have k2' := k2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right b.le n2)
      show ‖cDw gc x w * cKer bgkG (F1 m) x w + gc x w * cKer bgkG (cDw (F1 m)) x w‖ ≤
        A₁ * (Xi * (1 / 2 * u m)) + A₁ * (Xi * (1 / 2 * (2 / s₁ * u m)))
      refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
      · rw [norm_mul]; exact mul_le_mul g1 k1' (norm_nonneg _) hA
      · rw [norm_mul]; exact mul_le_mul g2 k2' (norm_nonneg _) hA
    · intro x a b

∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n0, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 S bw ca cm cd dPsi dv hSt hshP hshv hcP hcv
  
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hl0) hn0.le
  have hSt' := hSt
  unfold StOrd5 at hSt'
  obtain ⟨hAw, -, hPsi, hbd, -⟩ := hSt'
  unfold MomMeanId5
  intro ξ hξ
  obtain ⟨r, z, t, Y⟩ := ξ
  have hξ' : 0 < r ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hξ
  obtain ⟨hr, ht, hq⟩ := hξ'
  
  have hc0 : ∀ θ : ℝ, (rotPt r θ z) 0 = r * Real.cos θ := by intro θ; simp [rotPt]
  have hc1 : ∀ θ : ℝ, (rotPt r θ z) 1 = r * Real.sin θ := by intro θ; simp [rotPt]
  have hc2 : ∀ θ : ℝ, (rotPt r θ z) 2 = z := by intro θ; simp [rotPt]
  have hrad : ∀ θ : ℝ, rad (rotPt r θ z) = r := by
    intro θ
    unfold rad
    rw [hc0, hc1]
    have e : (r * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (r * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
      calc (r * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (r * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 * (Real.cos θ ^ 2 + Real.sin θ ^ 2) := by ring
        _ = r ^ 2 := by rw [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, mul_one]
    rw [e, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
  have hpt : ∀ θ : ℝ, ptOf (rotPt r θ z) t Y = (r, z, t, Y) := by
    intro θ
    simp only [ptOf, hrad, hc2]
  have hcorr : ∀ θ : ℝ, corrOn B l0 (rotPt r θ z) t := by
    intro θ
    show 0 < rad (rotPt r θ z) ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ((rotPt r θ z) 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0
    rw [hrad, hc2]
    exact ⟨hr, ht, hq⟩
  
  obtain ⟨hUo, hF⟩ := mmu_axoff_smooth_v5 B G l0 S 1 (1/2) t (Y - Yph B.h r t) hok hG hqsB hAw hPsi
  have hb := mmu_bx_continuous_v5 B G l0 S (1/2) t Y hok hqsB hbd
  obtain ⟨F₀, hF₀⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ³ → ℝ³, F = fun y => AX5 B G l0 S y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hF1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F₀ {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0} := by
    rw [hF₀]; exact hF.of_le (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ³ → ℝ³, D = fun y =>
      AX5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t)) - F₀ y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hYinv : ∀ (η : Cyl) (a : ℝ × ℝ), momPsP B dPsi (shY η a) = momPsP B dPsi η := by
    intro η a
    unfold momPsP
    rw [hshP.1 η a]
    rfl
  have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := hok.1.2.2.2.1
  have hqCat : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) := by
    have hw : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (z, 1 - t) :=
      hsm.contDiffAt ((isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds
        ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - t by linarith⟩)
    have hl : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1)) ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) := by
      fun_prop
    have hqe : qC B.h = (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun η : Cyl => (η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1)) := rfl
    rw [hqe]
    exact hw.comp ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) hl
  have hqpos : 0 < qC B.h ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) := (hok.1.1 z (1 - t) (by linarith)).1
  have hDom : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∈ nhds ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) := by
    have h1 : ∀ᶠ η in nhds ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl), (0:ℝ) < η.1 :=
      continuousAt_const.eventually_lt continuous_fst.continuousAt hr
    have h2 : ∀ᶠ η in nhds ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl), η.2.2.1 < (1:ℝ) :=
      (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun η : Cyl => η.2.2.1)).continuousAt.eventually_lt continuousAt_const ht
    have h3 : ∀ᶠ η in nhds ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl), qC B.h η < qsOf l0 :=
      hqCat.continuousAt.eventually_lt continuousAt_const hq
    filter_upwards [h1, h2, h3] with η e1 e2 e3
    exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
  have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (momPsP B dPsi) ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) := by
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h)) ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) :=
      (hqCat.rpow_const_of_ne hqpos.ne').differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ dPsi ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) :=
      (hcP.contDiffAt hDom).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    exact h1.mul h2
  
  have hline : ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (F : E → ℝ) (x v : E),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F x → HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => F (x + s • v)) (fderiv ℝ F x v) 0 := by
    intro E _ _ F x v hFd
    have hl : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => x + s • v) v 0 := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const v).const_add x
    exact hFd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hl (by simp)
  have hφeq : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => momPsP B dPsi (p.1, p.2, t, 0)) =
      (momPsP B dPsi) ∘ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ((p.1, p.2, t, Y) : Cyl)) := by
    funext p
    have e := hYinv (p.1, p.2, t, 0) Y
    simp only [shY, zero_add] at e
    exact e.symm
  have hφd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => momPsP B dPsi (p.1, p.2, t, 0)) (r, z) := by
    rw [hφeq]
    have hι : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ((p.1, p.2, t, Y) : Cyl)) (r, z) := by fun_prop
    exact hdiff.comp (r, z) hι
  have hdir : ∀ a b : ℝ, fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => momPsP B dPsi (p.1, p.2, t, 0)) (r, z) (a, b) =
      fderiv ℝ (momPsP B dPsi) ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) ((a, b, 0, 0) : Cyl) := by
    intro a b
    have h1 := hline (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => momPsP B dPsi (p.1, p.2, t, 0)) (r, z) (a, b) hφd
    have h2 := hline (momPsP B dPsi) ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) ((a, b, 0, 0) : Cyl) hdiff
    have hfun : ∀ s : ℝ, momPsP B dPsi (((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) + s • ((a, b, 0, 0) : Cyl)) =
        momPsP B dPsi ((((r, z) : ℝ × ℝ) + s • ((a, b) : ℝ × ℝ)).1,
          (((r, z) : ℝ × ℝ) + s • ((a, b) : ℝ × ℝ)).2, t, 0) := by
      intro s
      have e : ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) + s • ((a, b, 0, 0) : Cyl) =
          shY ((((r, z) : ℝ × ℝ) + s • ((a, b) : ℝ × ℝ)).1,
            (((r, z) : ℝ × ℝ) + s • ((a, b) : ℝ × ℝ)).2, t, 0) Y := by
        simp [shY]
      rw [e, hYinv]
    exact h1.unique (h2.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s => (hfun s).symm)))
  have hYnull : ∀ u : ℝ × ℝ, fderiv ℝ (momPsP B dPsi) ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) ((0, 0, 0, u) : Cyl) = 0 := by
    intro u
    have h2 := hline (momPsP B dPsi) ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) ((0, 0, 0, u) : Cyl) hdiff
    have hc : ∀ s : ℝ, momPsP B dPsi (((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) + s • ((0, 0, 0, u) : Cyl)) =
        momPsP B dPsi ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) := by
      intro s
      have e : ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) + s • ((0, 0, 0, u) : Cyl) = shY ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) (s • u) := by
        simp [shY]
      rw [e, hYinv]
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => momPsP B dPsi (((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) + s • ((0, 0, 0, u) : Cyl))) 0 0 :=
      (hasDerivAt_const (0:ℝ) (momPsP B dPsi ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl))).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hc)
    exact h2.unique h3
  have hZ' : dZ (momPsP B dPsi) ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => momPsP B dPsi (p.1, p.2, t, 0)) (r, z) (0, 1) := by
    show fderiv ℝ (momPsP B dPsi) ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) ((0, 1, 0, 0) : Cyl) = _
    rw [hdir 0 1]
  have hR' : dR B.h (momPsP B dPsi) ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => momPsP B dPsi (p.1, p.2, t, 0)) (r, z) (1, 0) := by
    show fderiv ℝ (momPsP B dPsi) ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl)
      ((1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * r ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) : Cyl) = _
    have hsplit : ((1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * r ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) : Cyl) =
        ((1, 0, 0, 0) : Cyl) + ((0, 0, 0, (drx B.h * r ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) : Cyl) := by
      simp
    rw [hdir 1 0, hsplit, map_add, hYnull, add_zero]
  have hf0 : momPsP B dPsi ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) = momPsP B dPsi ((r, z, t, 0) : Cyl) := by
    have e := hYinv (r, z, t, 0) Y
    simp only [shY, zero_add] at e
    exact e
  
  have hD : ∀ y ∈ {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0},
      D y = momPsP B dPsi (rad y, y 2, t, 0) • eTh y := by
    intro y hy
    have hc : corrOn B l0 y t := hy
    have hdP : dPsi (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t))) = dPsi (rad y, y 2, t, 0) := by

    have hqq : qC B.h (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t))) = qC B.h (rad y, y 2, t, 0) := rfl
    simp only [hDdef, hF₀, AX5, momUpd, if_pos hc, momPsP]
    rw [hqq, hdP]
    simp only [add_smul, smul_add, smul_smul]
    abel
  have hFD : (fun y => F₀ y + D y) =
      fun y => AX5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t)) := by

    rw [hDdef]
    exact add_sub_cancel _ _
  have hBX : ∀ θ : ℝ, BX B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) (rotPt r θ z) t Y =
      BX B G l0 S (rotPt r θ z) t Y + momDvP B dv ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) • eTh (rotPt r θ z) := by
    intro θ
    simp only [BX, momUpd, if_pos (hcorr θ), hpt θ, momDvP]
    rw [mul_add, add_smul, add_assoc]
  
  have hu0 : ∀ (θ : ℝ) (a : Fin 3), ucyl5 B G l0 S θ ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) a =

  have hu1 : ∀ (θ : ℝ) (a : Fin 3), ucyl5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) θ ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) a =

        momDvP B dv ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) • eTh (rotPt r θ z))) (frameAt θ ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) a) := by
    intro θ a
    rw [hFD]
    simp only [ucyl5, uX5, curlX, evOff, hrad, hBX]
  
  obtain ⟨hmean, hcov⟩ := mmu_circle_avg_shift F₀ D (fun y => BX B G l0 S y t Y)
    (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => momPsP B dPsi (p.1, p.2, t, 0))
    {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0} ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl)
    (momDvP B dv ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl)) hUo hr (fun θ => hcorr θ) hF1 hb hφd hD
  have hthA : ∀ a : Fin 3, thA (fun θ => ucyl5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) θ ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) a) =
      thA (fun θ => ucyl5 B G l0 S θ ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) a) +
        ![-(fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => momPsP B dPsi (p.1, p.2, t, 0)) (r, z) (0, 1)),

          fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => momPsP B dPsi (p.1, p.2, t, 0)) (r, z) (1, 0) +
            momPsP B dPsi ((r, z, t, 0) : Cyl) / r] a := by
    intro a
    simp only [hu0, hu1]
    exact hmean a
  have h0 : thA (fun θ => ucyl5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) θ ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) 0) =
      thA (fun θ => ucyl5 B G l0 S θ ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) 0) +
        -(fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => momPsP B dPsi (p.1, p.2, t, 0)) (r, z) (0, 1)) := hthA 0
  have h1 : thA (fun θ => ucyl5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) θ ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) 1) =
      thA (fun θ => ucyl5 B G l0 S θ ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) 1) + momDvP B dv ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) := hthA 1
  have h2 : thA (fun θ => ucyl5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) θ ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) 2) =
      thA (fun θ => ucyl5 B G l0 S θ ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) 2) +
        (fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => momPsP B dPsi (p.1, p.2, t, 0)) (r, z) (1, 0) +
          momPsP B dPsi ((r, z, t, 0) : Cyl) / r) := hthA 2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show thA (fun θ => ucyl5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) θ ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) 0) - ubase B ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) 0 =
      thA (fun θ => ucyl5 B G l0 S θ ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) 0) - ubase B ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) 0 +
        -(dZ (momPsP B dPsi) ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl))
    rw [h0, hZ']
    ring
  · show thA (fun θ => ucyl5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) θ ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) 1) - ubase B ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) 1 =
      thA (fun θ => ucyl5 B G l0 S θ ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) 1) - ubase B ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) 1 +
        momDvP B dv ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl)

  · show thA (fun θ => ucyl5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) θ ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) 2) - ubase B ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) 2 =
      thA (fun θ => ucyl5 B G l0 S θ ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) 2) - ubase B ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) 2 +
        (dR B.h (momPsP B dPsi) ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) + momPsP B dPsi ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) / r)
    rw [h2, hR', hf0]
    ring
  · intro a c
    simp only [Wcov5, hu0, hu1]
    exact hcov a c

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →
    ∀ (S : CState) (bw ca cm cd : ℝ) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ), StOrd5 B G l0 S bw ca cm cd →
    MomShape B dPsi → MomShape B dv → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ dPsi (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ dv (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → MomMeanId5 B G l0 S dPsi dv →
    (∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 →
        radMom (momDvP B dv) 2 z t = 0 ∧ radMom (momDgP B dPsi) 1 z t = 0 ∧
        radMom (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 1 * momDvP B dv η / η.1) 0 z t = -calP5 B G l0 S z t ∧
        radMom (fun η => ubase B η 2 * momDvP B dv η + ubase B η 1 * momDgP B dPsi η) 2 z t =
          -calJth5 B G l0 S z t ∧
        radMom (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 2 * momDgP B dPsi η - ubase B η 1 * momDvP B dv η) 1 z t =
          -calJz5 B G l0 S z t) →
    (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
        grP5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) ξ = grP5 B G l0 S ξ + momDg5 B G l0 S dPsi dv ξ ∧
        pmP5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) ξ = pmP5 B G l0 S ξ + Icut B (momDgt B (momDg5 B G l0 S dPsi dv)) ξ) ∧
    ∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 →
      calP5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) z t = calP5 B G l0 S z t + radMom (momDg5 B G l0 S dPsi dv) 0 z t ∧
      calP5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) z t = radMom (momRg5 B G l0 S dPsi dv) 0 z t ∧
      calJth5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) z t = radMom (momQth5 B G l0 S dPsi dv) 2 z t ∧
      calJz5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) z t =
        radMom (momQz5 B G l0 S dPsi dv) 1 z t - (1/2) * radMom (momRg5 B G l0 S dPsi dv) 2 z t ∧
      radMom (mcor5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 1) 2 z t = 0 ∧
      radMom (mcor5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 2) 1 z t = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa0, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -, hqB0, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n0, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl S bw ca cm cd dPsi dv hSt hshP hshv hcP hcv hmean heqs
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqs0 : 0 < qsOf l0 := by rw [hQb]; positivity
  have hqB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]; exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hl) hn0.le
  obtain ⟨hDo, hqCs, hqCpos, -, hder, hSV⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  obtain ⟨-, hub, hmc, hWs, -⟩ := state_cyl_smooth_v5 B G l0 S bw ca cm cd hok hG hqB hSt
  have hWsv := wcov5_shell_vanish B G l0 S bw ca cm cd hok hqB hSt
  obtain ⟨hlin, hcongr, hIadd, hIcongr⟩ := mom_moment_linear_v5 B (qsOf l0) hok hqs0
  have hSt' := hSt
  unfold StOrd5 at hSt'
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, c18, c19, -, c21, c22, c23⟩ := hSt'
  
  have gzero : MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) := ⟨contDiffOn_const, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  have gadd : ∀ f g : Cyl → ℝ, MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) f → MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) g →
      MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (fun η => f η + g η) := fun f g hf hg =>
    ⟨hf.1.add hg.1, fun ξ hξ hx => by simp [hf.2 ξ hξ hx, hg.2 ξ hξ hx]⟩
  have gsub : ∀ f g : Cyl → ℝ, MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) f → MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) g →
      MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (fun η => f η - g η) := fun f g hf hg =>
    ⟨hf.1.sub hg.1, fun ξ hξ hx => by simp [hf.2 ξ hξ hx, hg.2 ξ hξ hx]⟩
  have gneg : ∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) f → MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (fun η => -f η) :=
    fun f hf => ⟨hf.1.neg, fun ξ hξ hx => by simp [hf.2 ξ hξ hx]⟩
  have gmul : ∀ f g : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) g →
      MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (fun η => f η * g η) := fun f g hf hg =>
    ⟨hf.mul hg.1, fun ξ hξ hx => by simp [hg.2 ξ hξ hx]⟩
  have gpow : ∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) f → MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (fun η => f η ^ 2) :=
    fun f hf => ⟨hf.1.pow 2, fun ξ hξ hx => by simp [hf.2 ξ hξ hx]⟩
  have hfst0 : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ.1 ≠ 0 := fun ξ hξ =>
    ne_of_gt (show 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 from hξ).1
  have gdiv1 : ∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) f → MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (fun η => f η / η.1) :=
    fun f hf => ⟨hf.1.div contDiffOn_fst hfst0, fun ξ hξ hx => by simp [hf.2 ξ hξ hx]⟩
  have gdiv2 : ∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) f →
      MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (fun η => f η / η.1 ^ 2) :=
    fun f hf => ⟨hf.1.div (contDiffOn_fst.pow 2) (fun ξ hξ => pow_ne_zero 2 (hfst0 ξ hξ)),
      fun ξ hξ hx => by simp [hf.2 ξ hξ hx]⟩
  have gdR : ∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) f → MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (fun η => dR B.h f η) :=
    fun f hf => ⟨(hder f hf.1).1, fun ξ hξ hx => (hSV f hf.2 ξ hξ hx).1⟩
  have gdZ : ∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) f → MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (fun η => dZ f η) :=
    fun f hf => ⟨(hder f hf.1).2.1, fun ξ hξ hx => (hSV f hf.2 ξ hξ hx).2.1⟩
  have gdT : ∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) f → MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (fun η => dT f η) :=
    fun f hf => ⟨(hder f hf.1).2.2, fun ξ hξ hx => (hSV f hf.2 ξ hξ hx).2.2⟩
  have glap : ∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) f → MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (fun η => lap0 B.h f η) :=
    fun f hf => gadd _ _ (gadd _ _ (gdR _ (gdR _ hf)) (gdiv1 _ (gdR _ hf))) (gdZ _ (gdZ _ hf))
  
  have svN : ∀ (e : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ) (α : ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B e f) →
      ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0 := by
    intro e f α hf ξ hξ hx
    have h0 := hf.2.2.1 ξ hξ (hx.imp le_of_lt le_of_lt)
    simp only [nrm] at h0
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h0).resolve_left (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hqCpos ξ hξ) _).ne'
  have svM : ∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, MomShape B f → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0 := by
    intro f hf ξ _ hx
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hf.2 ξ hne
    rcases hx with hx | hx <;> linarith
  have hqCrp : ∀ p : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => qC B.h ξ ^ p) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := fun p =>
    hqCs.rpow_const_of_ne (fun ξ hξ => (hqCpos ξ hξ).ne')
  have hβ : MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (mcor5 B G l0 S 0) := ⟨hmc 0, svN _ _ _ c21⟩
  have hv : MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (mcor5 B G l0 S 1) := ⟨hmc 1, svN _ _ _ c18⟩
  have hγ : MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (mcor5 B G l0 S 2) := ⟨hmc 2, svN _ _ _ c19⟩
  have hWg : ∀ a c : Fin 3, MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (Wcov5 B G l0 S a c) := fun a c =>
    ⟨hWs a c, fun ξ hξ hx => hWsv a c ξ hξ hx⟩
  have hps : MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (momPsP B dPsi) :=
    ⟨(hqCrp _).mul hcP, fun ξ hξ hx => by simp only [momPsP]; rw [svM dPsi hshP ξ hξ hx, mul_zero]⟩
  have hdw : MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (momDvP B dv) :=
    ⟨(hqCrp _).mul hcv, fun ξ hξ hx => by simp only [momDvP]; rw [svM dv hshv ξ hξ hx, mul_zero]⟩
  have hdg : MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (momDgP B dPsi) := gadd _ _ (gdR _ hps) (gdiv1 _ hps)
  have hdb : MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (momDbP B dPsi) := gneg _ (gdZ _ hps)
  have hdwS := hdw.1
  have hdgS := hdg.1
  have hdbS := hdb.1
  
  have hRgG : MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (momRg5 B G l0 S dPsi dv) := by
    show MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (fun ξ => momRg5 B G l0 S dPsi dv ξ)
    dsimp only [momRg5]
    repeat (first
      | assumption | exact hWg _ _ | exact hub _ | exact hmc _
      | exact contDiffOn_const.mul (hub _) | exact contDiffOn_const.mul (hmc _)
      | apply gsub | apply gadd | apply gneg | apply gdiv2 | apply gdiv1 | apply gpow
      | apply glap | exact gzero | apply gdR | apply gdZ | apply gdT | apply gmul)
  have hAG : MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 1 * momDvP B dv η / η.1) := by
    repeat (first
      | assumption | exact hWg _ _ | exact hub _ | exact hmc _
      | exact contDiffOn_const.mul (hub _) | exact contDiffOn_const.mul (hmc _)
      | apply gsub | apply gadd | apply gneg | apply gdiv2 | apply gdiv1 | apply gpow
      | apply glap | exact gzero | apply gdR | apply gdZ | apply gdT | apply gmul)
  have hDgG : MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (momDg5 B G l0 S dPsi dv) := gadd _ _ hAG hRgG
  have hgrG : MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (grP5 B G l0 S) := by
    show MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (fun ξ => grP5 B G l0 S ξ)
    dsimp only [grP5]
    repeat (first
      | assumption | exact hWg _ _ | exact hub _ | exact hmc _

      | apply gsub | apply gadd | apply gneg | apply gdiv2 | apply gdiv1 | apply gpow

    dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ w)) (nPhi5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ w)) ≠ 0

  have alg : ∀ (K s c : ℂ) (n a : Fin 3 → ℂ), c * (K * s) = Complex.I →

    have e1 : ((Complex.I * K) • crossC n (c • crossC n a)) 1 = a 1 := by

  have hprin : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      velW5 B G (potOf5 B G tw) γ m ξ = cutA B G tw γ m ξ + velRem5 B (potOf5 B G tw) γ m ξ := by
    intro γ m ξ hξ
    rw [hstruct]
    congr 1
    by_cases ha0 : cutA B G tw γ m ξ = 0
    · have hD0 : potOf5 B G tw γ m ξ = 0 := by
        rw [hrep]
        show crossC (pulseMult5 B G γ m ξ) (cutA B G tw γ m ξ) = 0
        rw [ha0]
        funext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp [crossC]

      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [crossC]
    · have hm : m ≠ 0 := by
        intro hm
        apply ha0
        rw [show cutA B G tw γ m ξ = ((psiW B G γ ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) • tw γ m ξ from rfl, (h3c γ m hm).1]
        simp
      obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hcoef 0
      have hns : dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) ≠ 0 :=
        (hC γ m ξ hξ (subset_tsupport _ ha0)).1
      have hnsC : nsqC5 B G γ ξ ≠ 0 := by
        simp only [nsqC5]
        exact_mod_cast hns
      have hkb : (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
        have : 0 < kb B.h γ.1 := by
          unfold kb epsb Qb
          exact Nat.ceil_pos.mpr
            (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _) _) _)
        exact_mod_cast this.ne'
      have hmC : (m : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hm
      have hK : (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) * nsqC5 B G γ ξ ≠ 0 :=
        mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hkb hmC) hnsC
      have hc : Complex.I / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) * nsqC5 B G γ ξ) *
          ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) * nsqC5 B G γ ξ) = Complex.I := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hK
      have hpot : potOf5 B G tw γ m ξ = (Complex.I / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) * nsqC5 B G γ ξ)) •
          crossC (nPhiC5 B G γ ξ) (cutA B G tw γ m ξ) := by
        simp only [potOf5, cutA, hm, ↓reduceIte]
      have hs : nsqC5 B G γ ξ = nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 0 * nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 0 + nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 1 * nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 1 +
          nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 2 * nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 2 := by
        simp only [nsqC5, nPhiC5, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hd : nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 0 * cutA B G tw γ m ξ 0 + nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 1 * cutA B G tw γ m ξ 1 +
          nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 2 * cutA B G tw γ m ξ 2 = 0 := by
        have h0 := h4c γ m ξ hξ
        simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three] at h0
        simp only [cutA, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        linear_combination ((psiW B G γ ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * h0
      rw [hpot]
      exact alg ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ)) (nsqC5 B G γ ξ) _ (nPhiC5 B G γ ξ) (cutA B G tw γ m ξ) hc hs hd
  
  have hh0 : 0 ≤ B.h := hok.2.1.1.le
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=

    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  have hDq : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < qC B.h ξ ∧ qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 ∧ 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
    have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
      show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
      exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    intro ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨-, e2, e3⟩ := hξ
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
    refine ⟨hq0, by linarith, ?_⟩
    unfold SC
    have : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| := by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))]
    exact one_le_pow₀ this
  have hDsh : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ a, shY ξ a ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := fun ξ hξ _ => hξ
  have hEdge : ∀ X : ℝ, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb → 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X ∧
      0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ∧ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ≤ 1 := by
    intro X e1 e2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, min_le_left _ _⟩
    · unfold edgeWeight
      split_ifs
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      · exact le_rfl
    · have hX : 0 < X := lt_trans hXa e1
      have l1 : 0 < Real.log (X / B.Xa) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr e1)
      have l2 : 0 < Real.log (B.Xb / X) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr e2)
      exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min l1 l2)
  have hW : ∀ (q Sv E e P C1 C2 b1 b2 d1 d2 α α1 α2 N1 N2 : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → 1 ≤ Sv → 0 ≤ E →
      0 < e → e ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ P → α ≤ α1 → α ≤ α2 →
      N1 ≤ C1 * q ^ (B.h * α1) * Sv ^ b1 * E * e ^ (-d1) * P →
      N2 ≤ C2 * q ^ (B.h * α2) * Sv ^ b2 * E * e ^ (-d2) * P →
      N1 + N2 ≤ (|C1| + |C2|) * q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P := by
    intro q Sv E e P C1 C2 b1 b2 d1 d2 α α1 α2 N1 N2 hq0 hq1 hS1 hE he0 he1 hP0 ha1 ha2 hN1 hN2
    have key : ∀ (C b d αi N : ℝ), α ≤ αi → N ≤ C * q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P →
        b ≤ max b1 b2 → d ≤ max d1 d2 →
        N ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) := by
      intro C b d αi N hα hN hb hd
      have f1 : q ^ (B.h * αi) ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hα hh0)
      have f2 : Sv ^ b ≤ Sv ^ (max b1 b2) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 hb
      have f3 : e ^ (-d) ≤ e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge he0 he1 (neg_le_neg hd)
      have p1 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * αi) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
      have p2 : 0 ≤ Sv ^ b := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have p3 : 0 ≤ e ^ (-d) := Real.rpow_nonneg he0.le _
      have p1' : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
      have p2' : 0 ≤ Sv ^ (max b1 b2) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have m1 : q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) := mul_le_mul f1 f2 p2 p1'
      have m2 : q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right m1 hE
      have m3 : q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) ≤
          q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) :=
        mul_le_mul m2 f3 p3 (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p1' p2') hE)
      have hWi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right m3 hP0
      have hWi0 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p1 p2) hE) p3) hP0
      calc N ≤ C * q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P := hN
        _ = C * (q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P) := by ring
        _ ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) hWi0
        _ ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hWi (abs_nonneg C)
    have k1 := key C1 b1 d1 α1 N1 ha1 hN1 (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
    have k2 := key C2 b2 d2 α2 N2 ha2 hN2 (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
    have e : (|C1| + |C2|) * q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P =
        |C1| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) +
        |C2| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) := by ring
    rw [e]
    linarith
  have hNB : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f1 f2 g : Cyl → V) (k : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl),
      ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f1 (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f2 (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), g η = f1 η + f2 η) → NB B.h g k ξ ≤ NB B.h f1 k ξ + NB B.h f2 k ξ := by
    intro V _ _ f1 f2 g k ξ hξ hf1 hf2 heq
    have hn : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∈ nhds ξ := hDopen.mem_nhds hξ
    have hev : g =ᶠ[nhds ξ] f1 + f2 := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hn (fun η hη => heq η hη)
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g ξ = iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ := by
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
      exact iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((hf1.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        ((hf2.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    unfold NB
    rw [e1]
    have e2 : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) +
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) := by
      ext m
      simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e2]
    exact norm_add_le _ _
  have hInWg : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (α α1 α2 : ℝ)
      (a b c : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → V),
      InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α1 a → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α2 b → α ≤ α1 → α ≤ α2 →
      (∃ H : Finset ℤ, (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧ ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → c γ m = 0) →
      (∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), c γ m ξ = a γ m ξ + b γ m ξ) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α c := by
    intro V _ _ α α1 α2 a b c ea eb ha1 ha2 hHc heq
    obtain ⟨-, sa, da, pa, ba⟩ := ea
    obtain ⟨-, sb, db, pb, bb⟩ := eb
    refine ⟨hHc, fun γ m => ((sa γ m).add (sb γ m)).congr (heq γ m), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro γ m ξ hξ c' hc
      rw [heq γ m _ (hDsh ξ hξ c'), heq γ m ξ hξ, da γ m ξ hξ c' hc, db γ m ξ hξ c' hc]
    · intro γ m ξ hξ hne
      rw [heq γ m ξ hξ] at hne
      by_cases hA : a γ m ξ = 0
      · rw [hA, zero_add] at hne
        exact pb γ m ξ hξ hne
      · exact pa γ m ξ hξ hA
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨C1, c1, e1, hb1⟩ := ba k
      obtain ⟨C2, c2, e2, hb2⟩ := bb k
      refine ⟨|C1| + |C2|, max c1 c2, max e1 e2, fun γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hq0, hq1, hS1⟩ := hDq ξ hξ
      obtain ⟨hE, he0, he1⟩ := hEdge _ hX1 hX2
      have hn := hNB (a γ m) (b γ m) (c γ m) k ξ hξ (sa γ m) (sb γ m) (heq γ m)
      have hP0 : 0 ≤ Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by
        unfold Penv5
        exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      exact le_trans hn (hW _ _ _ _ _ C1 C2 c1 c2 e1 e2 α α1 α2 _ _ hq0 hq1 hS1 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
        he0 he1 hP0 ha1 ha2 (hb1 γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2) (hb2 γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2))
  have hvz : ∀ (a : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), a γ m = 0 → velW5 B G a γ m = 0 := by
    intro a γ m h
    funext ξ j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [velW5, velC5, DrC, DzC, dR, dZ, h]
  obtain ⟨H, H0, Hv⟩ := hD.1
  refine ⟨hD, ?_⟩
  exact hInWg α α (α + 1/2 - kapS) (cutA B G tw) (velRem5 B (potOf5 B G tw)) (velW5 B G (potOf5 B G tw))
    ha hR le_rfl (by rw [hk]; linarith) ⟨H, H0, fun γ m hm => hvz _ γ m (Hv γ m hm)⟩ hprin

pulse_increment_classes_v5.definitions:
noncomputable def pulseMult5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℂ :=
  if m = 0 then 0 else (Complex.I / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) * nsqC5 B G γ ξ)) • nPhiC5 B G γ ξ
noncomputable def velRem5 (B : BG) (D : WC) : WC := fun γ m ξ =>
  ![-(DzC B γ.1 (fun η => D γ m η 1) ξ),
    DzC B γ.1 (fun η => D γ m η 0) ξ - DrC B γ.1 (fun η => D γ m η 2) ξ,

  (((qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * velW5 B G c γ m ξ i +
  ((B.h * qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * rotC (c γ m ξ) i

and_nodes.error_message: RETIRED BY REVIEW: EVIDENCE: The split is right. Resubmit the same 11 children, glue and definitions (rotC, wmoAmp5, wmoPair5, wmoBase), with one statement fix. Child wmo_velocity_split_v5 (the CRUX) is false as stated because it has no GeomPrim5 B G hypothesis. Without G.r0 <= 1/100, SuppW (|xiG| <= r0/4, |etG| <= r0) no longer keeps nonzero coefficients away from the frac0 jumps of rectW. Example: r0 = 4 makes both bounds hold for every Y. At such a jump etG jumps, so vco and phiL5 jump with it. curlX moves the Y argument along vrv as rad y varies, and that path crosses the jump. So the AX5 potential is not differentiable at x, Lean's fderiv returns 0, and the claimed identity fails. Blueprint s2 itself relies on '|lamR| > 0.25 > r0/4', which only GeomPrim5 supplies. Fix: change the binder to 'forall B G, B.ok -> GeomPrim5 B G -> exists l1, ...'. The glue already has hG, so the call becomes 'wmo_velocity_split_v5 B G hok hG'. Optionally fold the s2 jump-avoidance argument (SuppW plus r0 <= 1/100 gives distance > r0/4 from the frac0 discontinuities) into its proof sketch. Everything else passed: the curl/velC5/rotC/(q/Qb)^{1/2} algebra checks out; wave_theta_pair_v5, wmo_pair_class_v5 (Penv5 <= 1 on [0,Lsb]), wmo_amp_class_v5 (mu2 = 2h eta q^h/(1-2h eta^2)), wmo_radial_calculus_v5 (q^{-h kapS} loss), wmo_change_identities_v5 and wmo_state_grP_class_v5 are true and much easier than the target; the two DAG edges are correct; the glue uses every child; the exponent bookkeeping (2Bo >= Bo+1/2, one kapS per conjunct) is right. With that one binder added I would approve this exact split.

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h qs E hS _hqs hE hflat m N
  
  set U := simDomain h qs with hUdef
  have hrot2 : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (v : ℝ³), (rotZ φ v) 2 = v 2 := by
    intro φ v; simp [rotZ]
  have hinv : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (v : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), (v, s) ∈ U → (rotZ φ v, s) ∈ U := by
    intro φ v s hv
    refine ⟨hv.1, ?_⟩
    show simScale h ((rotZ φ v) 2) (1 - s) < qs
    rw [hrot2]; exact hv.2
  have hUo : IsOpen U := by
    have hc : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
      have hp : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
      exact hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.comp hp.continuousOn
        (fun w hw => ⟨mem_univ _, by simp only [mem_Ioi]; simp at hw; linarith⟩)
    exact hc.isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const) (isOpen_Iio (a := qs))
  
  have t1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ³ × ℝ) => rotZ p.1 p.2.1) := by
    unfold rotZ; fun_prop
  have t2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ³ × ℝ) => ((rotZ p.1 p.2.1, p.2.2) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) :=
    t1.prodMk (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd)
  have t3 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ³ => rotZ (-q.1) q.2) := by
    unfold rotZ; fun_prop
  
  set G : ℝ × (ℝ³ × ℝ) → ℝ³ := fun p => rotZ (-p.1) (E (rotZ p.1 p.2.1) p.2.2) with hGdef
  have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (univ ×ˢ U) := by
    have hmaps : MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ³ × ℝ) => ((rotZ p.1 p.2.1, p.2.2) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) (univ ×ˢ U) U :=

    have h4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ³ × ℝ) => E (rotZ p.1 p.2.1) p.2.2) (univ ×ˢ U) :=

    have h5 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ³ × ℝ) => ((p.1, E (rotZ p.1 p.2.1) p.2.2) : ℝ × ℝ³))

    have h6 := t3.comp_contDiffOn h5
    exact h6
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ : ∃ ρ : ℝ → (ℝ³ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] ℝ³), ∀ φ v, ρ φ v = rotZ φ v :=

        invFun := rotZ (-φ)
        map_add' := by
          intro u v; ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [rotZ] <;> ring
        map_smul' := by
          intro c v; ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [rotZ] <;> ring
        left_inv := by
          intro v; ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [rotZ, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
          · linear_combination (v 0) * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq φ
          · linear_combination (v 1) * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq φ
        right_inv := by
          intro v; ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [rotZ, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
          · linear_combination (v 0) * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq φ
          · linear_combination (v 1) * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq φ

    ⟨fun φ =>

          H ∘ (fun z : (ℝ × (ℝ³ × ℝ)) × (ℝ³ × ℝ) => (z.1.1, z.2)) := rfl
      rw [e]
      apply ContDiffAt.comp (g := H) (p, p.2)

      · fun_prop
    exact ContDiffAt.fderiv (f := fun (q : ℝ × (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (w' : ℝ³ × ℝ) => H (q.1, w'))

    have hK : IsCompact (Icc (0:ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ s) := isCompact_Icc.prod (isCompact_closedBall _ _)
    have hKsub : Icc (0:ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ s ⊆ univ ×ˢ U := fun z hz => ⟨mem_univ _, hsU hz.2⟩
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hHs.continuousOn.mono hKsub)

      have hxU : x ∈ U := hsU hx
      have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ H (φ, x) := hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds ⟨mem_univ _, hxU⟩)
      have : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w' => H (φ, w')) x :=
        hHa.comp x (by fun_prop : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w' : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((φ, w') : ℝ × (ℝ³ × ℝ))) x)
      exact (this.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
  have param_bound : ∀ (n : ℕ) {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
      [CompleteSpace F] (H : ℝ × (ℝ³ × ℝ) → F),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H (univ ×ˢ U) → ∀ w ∈ U, ∀ M : ℝ,
      (∀ φ : ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun w' => H (φ, w')) w‖ ≤ M) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun w' => (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ • ∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H (φ, w')) w‖ ≤ M := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro F _ _ _ H _ w _ M hM
      simp only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] at hM ⊢
      have hpi : (0:ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hpi)]
      have h1 := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := 0) (b := 2 * Real.pi)
        (f := fun φ => H (φ, w)) (C := M) (fun φ _ => hM φ)
      rw [sub_zero, abs_of_pos hpi] at h1
      calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ‖∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H (φ, w)‖
          ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (M * (2 * Real.pi)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (inv_nonneg.mpr hpi.le)
        _ = M := by field_simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro F _ _ _ H hH w hw M hM
      set Hs : ℝ × (ℝ³ × ℝ) → ((ℝ³ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] F) :=
        fun p => fderiv ℝ (fun w' => H (p.1, w')) p.2 with hHs_def
      have hHs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Hs (univ ×ˢ U) := param_fderiv H hH
      have hMs : ∀ φ : ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun w' => Hs (φ, w')) w‖ ≤ M := by
        intro φ
        have : (fun w' => Hs (φ, w')) = fderiv ℝ (fun w' => H (φ, w')) := rfl
        rw [this, norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
        exact hM φ
      have hIH := ih Hs hHs w hw M hMs
      have hev : fderiv ℝ (fun w' => (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ • ∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H (φ, w')) =ᶠ[nhds w]
          (fun w' => (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ • ∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Hs (φ, w')) := by
        filter_upwards [hUo.mem_nhds hw] with x hx
        exact ((param_hasFDeriv H hH x hx).const_smul ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹)).fderiv
      rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv, (hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ n).eq_of_nhds]
      exact hIH
  
  have hs2 : ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => E (rotZ φ x) t) →
      thAvgVec (fun x' t' (_ : ℝ × ℝ) => E x' t') x t 0 =
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ • ∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), rotZ (-φ) (E (rotZ φ x) t) := by
    intro x t hcont
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ rad x := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hradrot : ∀ θ, rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) = rad x := by
      intro θ
      have e0 : rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2) 0 = rad x * Real.cos θ := by simp [rotPt]
      have e1 : rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2) 1 = rad x * Real.sin θ := by simp [rotPt]
      have e : (rad x * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (rad x * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = rad x ^ 2 := by
        linear_combination (rad x) ^ 2 * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
      show Real.sqrt ((rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 1 ^ 2) = rad x
      rw [e0, e1, e, Real.sqrt_sq hr0]
    have hunf : thAvgVec (fun x' t' (_ : ℝ × ℝ) => E x' t') x t 0 =
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ • ((∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), inner ℝ (E (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t)
            (eR (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)))) • eR x +
          (∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), inner ℝ (E (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t)
            (eTh (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)))) • eTh x +
          (∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), inner ℝ (E (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t) eZ) • eZ) := by
      simp only [thAvgVec, cyl2cart, thA, frameAt, ptOf, smul_add, smul_smul]
      rfl
    rw [hunf]
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hr0 with hr | hr
    · 
      have hr' : rad x = 0 := hr.symm
      have hsq : x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 ≤ 0 := (Real.sqrt_eq_zero').mp hr'
      have hx0 : x 0 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0), sq_nonneg (x 1)]
      have hx1 : x 1 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0), sq_nonneg (x 1)]
      have hxr : ∀ φ, rotZ φ x = x := by
        intro φ; ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [rotZ, hx0, hx1]
      have hP : ∀ θ, rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2) = x := by
        intro θ; ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [rotPt, hr', hx0, hx1]
      have heR : eR x = 0 := by simp [eR, hr']
      have heTh : eTh x = 0 := by simp [eTh, hr']
      simp only [hP, hxr, heR, heTh, smul_zero, zero_add, intervalIntegral.integral_const]
      set v := E x t with hv
      have hdec : ∀ φ : ℝ, rotZ (-φ) v = Real.cos φ • (v 0 • EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 +
          v 1 • EuclideanSpace.single 1 1)
          + Real.sin φ • (v 1 • EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 - v 0 • EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) + v 2 • eZ := by
        intro φ; ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [rotZ, eZ, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg] <;> ring
      simp only [hdec]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add, intervalIntegral.integral_add, intervalIntegral.integral_smul_const,
        intervalIntegral.integral_smul_const, intervalIntegral.integral_const, integral_cos, integral_sin]
      · ext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp [eZ, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
      all_goals (apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)
    · 
      have hnw : ‖(⟨x 0, x 1⟩ : ℂ)‖ = rad x := by
        rw [Complex.norm_def, Complex.normSq_mk, rad]; congr 1; ring
      obtain ⟨θ₀, hθ₀⟩ : ∃ θ₀, θ₀ = Complex.arg ⟨x 0, x 1⟩ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hx0 : x 0 = rad x * Real.cos θ₀ := by
        have := Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg (⟨x 0, x 1⟩ : ℂ)
        rw [hnw, ← hθ₀] at this; exact this.symm
      have hx1 : x 1 = rad x * Real.sin θ₀ := by
        have := Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg (⟨x 0, x 1⟩ : ℂ)
        rw [hnw, ← hθ₀] at this; exact this.symm
      have hrot : ∀ θ, rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2) = rotZ (θ - θ₀) x := by
        intro θ
        ext i; fin_cases i
        · simp [rotPt, rotZ, Real.cos_sub, Real.sin_sub]
          rw [hx0, hx1]
          linear_combination (-(rad x * Real.cos θ)) * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ₀
        · simp [rotPt, rotZ, Real.cos_sub, Real.sin_sub]
          rw [hx0, hx1]
          linear_combination (-(rad x * Real.sin θ)) * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ₀
        · simp [rotPt, rotZ]
      have hrne : rad x ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
      have key : ∀ (w : ℝ³) (θ : ℝ),
          inner ℝ w (eR (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) • eR x + inner ℝ w (eTh (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) • eTh x
            + inner ℝ w eZ • eZ = rotZ (-(θ - θ₀)) w := by
        intro w θ
        simp only [eR, eTh, hradrot]
        ext i; fin_cases i
        · simp [radVec, azVec, rotPt, rotZ, eZ, inner_add_right, inner_smul_right, inner_neg_right,
            EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, Real.cos_sub, Real.sin_sub]
          rw [hx0, hx1]
          field_simp
          ring
        · simp [radVec, azVec, rotPt, rotZ, eZ, inner_add_right, inner_smul_right, inner_neg_right,
            EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, Real.cos_sub, Real.sin_sub]
          rw [hx0, hx1]
          field_simp
          ring
        · simp [radVec, azVec, rotPt, rotZ, eZ, inner_add_right, inner_smul_right, inner_neg_right,
            EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
      have hcE : Continuous (fun θ => E (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t) := by
        simp_rw [hrot]
        exact hcont.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
      have heRc : Continuous (fun θ => eR (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) := by
        simp_rw [eR, hradrot]
        unfold radVec rotPt
        fun_prop
      have heThc : Continuous (fun θ => eTh (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) := by
        simp_rw [eTh, hradrot]
        unfold azVec rotPt
        fun_prop
      have hc1 : Continuous (fun θ => inner ℝ (E (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t)
          (eR (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) • eR x) :=
        Continuous.smul (Continuous.inner (𝕜 := ℝ) hcE heRc) (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ => eR x)
      have hc2 : Continuous (fun θ => inner ℝ (E (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t)
          (eTh (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) • eTh x) :=
        Continuous.smul (Continuous.inner (𝕜 := ℝ) hcE heThc) (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ => eTh x)
      have hc3 : Continuous (fun θ => inner ℝ (E (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t) eZ • eZ) :=
        Continuous.smul (Continuous.inner (𝕜 := ℝ) hcE (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ => eZ))
          (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ => eZ)
      have hc12 : Continuous (fun θ => inner ℝ (E (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t)
          (eR (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) • eR x +
          inner ℝ (E (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t) (eTh (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) • eTh x) := hc1.add hc2
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_smul_const, ← intervalIntegral.integral_smul_const,
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_smul_const, ← intervalIntegral.integral_add (hc1.intervalIntegrable _ _)
          (hc2.intervalIntegrable _ _),
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_add (hc12.intervalIntegrable _ _) (hc3.intervalIntegrable _ _)]
      congr 1
      have hH : ∀ θ, inner ℝ (E (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t) (eR (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) • eR x +
          inner ℝ (E (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t) (eTh (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) • eTh x +
          inner ℝ (E (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t) eZ • eZ =
          (fun φ => rotZ (-φ) (E (rotZ φ x) t)) (θ - θ₀) := by
        intro θ
        rw [key]
        simp only [hrot]
      simp only [hH]
      have hper : Function.Periodic (fun φ => rotZ (-φ) (E (rotZ φ x) t)) (2 * Real.pi) := by
        intro φ
        have h1 : rotZ (φ + 2 * Real.pi) = rotZ φ := by
          funext y; simp [rotZ, Real.cos_add_two_pi, Real.sin_add_two_pi]
        have h2 : rotZ (-(φ + 2 * Real.pi)) = rotZ (-φ) := by
          rw [show -(φ + 2 * Real.pi) = -φ - 2 * Real.pi by ring]
          funext y; simp only [rotZ, Real.cos_sub_two_pi, Real.sin_sub_two_pi]
        simp only [h1, h2]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_right (fun φ => rotZ (-φ) (E (rotZ φ x) t)) θ₀]
      have := hper.intervalIntegral_add_eq (-θ₀) 0
      rw [show (0:ℝ) - θ₀ = -θ₀ by ring, show 2 * Real.pi - θ₀ = -θ₀ + 2 * Real.pi by ring, this, zero_add]
  
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hflat m N
  refine ⟨C, fun x t hxt => ?_⟩
  have hcirc : ∀ w ∈ U, Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => E (rotZ φ w.1) w.2) := by
    intro w hw
    have hc0 : Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => rotZ φ w.1) := by
      unfold rotZ; fun_prop
    have hc : Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => ((rotZ φ w.1, w.2) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) :=
      hc0.prodMk continuous_const
    have hres := hE.continuousOn.comp_continuous hc (fun φ => hinv φ w.1 w.2 hw)
    exact hres
  have hev : (↿(fun y s => thAvgVec (fun x' t' (_ : ℝ × ℝ) => E x' t') y s 0)) =ᶠ[nhds (x, t)]
      (fun w' => (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ • ∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G (φ, w')) := by
    filter_upwards [hUo.mem_nhds hxt] with w hw
    exact hs2 w.1 w.2 (hcirc w hw)
  rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
  refine param_bound m G hG (x, t) hxt _ (fun φ => ?_)
  rw [hs3 φ (x, t)]
  have := hC (rotZ φ x) t (hinv φ x t hxt)
  rw [hrot2] at this
  exact this

informal_problem.statement:
∀ B : BG, B.ok →
    IsOpen (simDomain B.h B.qB) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(uB B)) (simDomain B.h B.qB) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿B.PB) (simDomain B.h B.qB) ∧
    (∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB → divergence (fun y => uB B y t) x = 0) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(mriE B)) (simDomain B.h B.qB)

signature.statement:
∀ B : BG, B.ok →
    IsOpen (simDomain B.h B.qB) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(uB B)) (simDomain B.h B.qB) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿B.PB) (simDomain B.h B.qB) ∧
    (∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB → divergence (fun y => uB B y t) x = 0) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(mriE B)) (simDomain B.h B.qB)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hok
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  have hBP := hok.2
  unfold BackgroundProps at hBP
  obtain ⟨⟨-, -, hXa, -⟩, -, -, ⟨hAB, hBvB, hPB⟩, hB4, -, -, -, ⟨hTth, hTz, hvan, -⟩, -, -, -⟩ := hBP
  
  have hjet : ∀ (ν : ℝ) (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)), IsOpen O →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(nsResidual ν u p)) O := by
    intro ν u p O hO hu hp
    have s1 : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : ℝ³ × ℝ → F) (x : ℝ³)
        (t : ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ f (x, t) →
        deriv (fun s => f (x, s)) t = fderiv ℝ f (x, t) ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ)) ∧
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => f (y, t)) x =
          (fderiv ℝ f (x, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := by
      intro F _ _ f x t hf
      constructor
      · have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ((x, s) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ)) t :=
          (hasDerivAt_const t x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id t)
        exact (hf.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hγ).deriv
      · exact (hf.hasFDerivAt.comp x (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left x t)).fderiv
    have s2 : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : ℝ³ × ℝ → F) (x : ℝ³)
        (t : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O → (x, t) ∈ O → ∀ a b : ℝ³,
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => f (y, t))) x a b =
          fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (x, t) (a, (0 : ℝ)) (b, (0 : ℝ)) := by
      intro F _ _ f x t hf hxt a b
      have hemb : Continuous (fun y : ℝ³ => ((y, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) :=
        continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const
      have hN : {y : ℝ³ | (y, t) ∈ O} ∈ nhds x := (hO.preimage hemb).mem_nhds hxt
      let Φ : (ℝ³ × ℝ →L[ℝ] F) →L[ℝ] (ℝ³ →L[ℝ] F) :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ ℝ³ (ℝ³ × ℝ) F).flip (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)
      have hΦ : ∀ M, Φ M = M.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := fun M => rfl
      have hev : fderiv ℝ (fun y => f (y, t)) =ᶠ[nhds x] fun y => Φ (fderiv ℝ f (y, t)) := by
        filter_upwards [hN] with y hy
        have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (y, t) :=
          (hf.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
        rw [hΦ]
        exact (s1 f y t hd).2
      have hDf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) O :=
        ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hf).2
      have hD2 : HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ f) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (x, t)) (x, t) :=
        ((hDf.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hxt)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
      have hg : HasFDerivAt (fun y => Φ (fderiv ℝ f (y, t)))
          (Φ.comp ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (x, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ))) x :=
        Φ.hasFDerivAt.comp x (hD2.comp x (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left x t))
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq, hg.fderiv]
      rfl
    have s3 : ∀ (g : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³), gradient g x = ∑ i : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ g x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) := by
      intro g x
      have h := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr' (gradient g x)
      rw [← h]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      simp only [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
      congr 1
      rw [real_inner_comm]
      exact InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply
    have s4 : ∀ (g : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (x : ℝ³), Δ g x = ∑ i : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) := by
      intro g x
      have h := congrFun (InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_orthonormalBasis g
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)) x
      rw [h]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
      simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
    have hDu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿u)) O :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hu).2
    have hD2u : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿u))) O :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hDu).2
    have hDp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿p)) O :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hp).2
    have hT3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿u)) z
        (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) O :=
      ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => (hD2u.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have hT4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (↿p) z
        (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) O :=
      ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => (hDp.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).smul contDiffOn_const
    have hJ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (nsJet ν u p) O := by
      unfold nsJet
      exact (((hDu.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).add
        (hDu.clm_apply (hu.prodMk contDiffOn_const))).sub (hT3.const_smul ν)).add hT4
    have hid : ∀ z ∈ O, (↿(nsResidual ν u p)) z = nsJet ν u p z := by
      rintro ⟨x, t⟩ hz
      have hu' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿u) (x, t) :=
        (hu.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hp' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿p) (x, t) :=
        (hp.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have e1 : deriv (fun s => u x s) t = fderiv ℝ (↿u) (x, t) ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ)) :=
        (s1 (↿u) x t hu').1
      have e2 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) x (u x t) =
          fderiv ℝ (↿u) (x, t) ((↿u) (x, t), (0 : ℝ)) := by
        have h2 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) x =
            (fderiv ℝ (↿u) (x, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := (s1 (↿u) x t hu').2
        rw [h2]
        rfl
      have e3 : Δ (fun y => u y t) x = ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿u)) (x, t)
          (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) := by
        rw [s4]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => s2 (↿u) x t hu hz _ _)

      refine ⟨?_, hf _ _ _ hX.le⟩
      have hev : (fun Y => f (simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t)) Y (simEta B.h x t)) =ᶠ[nhds (simX B.h x t)]
          fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (isOpen_Iio.mem_nhds hX) (fun Y hY => hf _ _ _ (le_of_lt hY))
      rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
    obtain ⟨hd1, hv1⟩ := hz B.Tth (fun q X η h => (hvan q X η (Or.inl h)).1)
    obtain ⟨hd2, hv2⟩ := hz B.Tz (fun q X η h => (hvan q X η (Or.inl h)).2)
    show stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz x t = 0
    simp only [stressDivField, hd1, hv1, hd2, hv2, zero_div, add_zero, mul_zero, neg_zero, zero_smul]
  
  have hSD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz)) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
    apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    intro w hw
    by_cases hr : 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2
    · exact ⟨{w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2}, isOpen_lt continuous_const hR.continuous,
        hr, hoff⟩
    · refine ⟨simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
        2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) - (w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2)) ⁻¹' Ioi 0,
        hU2o, ⟨hw, ?_⟩, hnear⟩
      have h0 : w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.1 hr) (by positivity)
      show 0 < 2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) - (w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2)
      rw [h0, sub_zero]
      exact mul_pos (mul_pos two_pos hXa) (hqpos w hw)
  have hNS := hjet 1 (uB B) B.PB _ hDo huB hPB
  exact ⟨hDo, huB, hPB, hdiv, (hNS.sub hSD).congr (fun z _ => rfl)⟩

informal_problem.statement:
∀ B : BG, B.ok → (∀ ξ : Cyl, sBase B 0 ξ = 0) ∧
    ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (a : Fin 3), 0 < ξ.1 → ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → simScale B.h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) < B.qB →
      mriRes (uB B) B.PB a (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) =
        sBase B a ξ + thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (mriE B (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) ξ.2.2.1) (frameAt θ ξ a))
