signature.statement:
∀ B : BG, B.ok → (∀ ξ : Cyl, sBase B 0 ξ = 0) ∧
    ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (a : Fin 3), 0 < ξ.1 → ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → simScale B.h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) < B.qB →
      mriRes (uB B) B.PB a (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) =
        sBase B a ξ + thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (mriE B (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) ξ.2.2.1) (frameAt θ ξ a))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hok
  
  have K : ∀ (y : ℝ³) (α β : ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
      inner ℝ (α • azVec y + β • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) (![eR y, eTh y, eZ] a) =
        ![0, α * ((rad y)⁻¹ * (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2)), β] a := by
    intro y α β a
    fin_cases a <;>
      simp [eR, eTh, eZ, azVec, radVec, inner_add_left, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_left,
        real_inner_smul_right, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right] <;>
      ring
  
  have hinv : ∀ (x x' : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) (a : Fin 3), x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 = x' 0 ^ 2 + x' 1 ^ 2 → x 2 = x' 2 →
      inner ℝ (stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz x t) (![eR x, eTh x, eZ] a) =
        inner ℝ (stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz x' t) (![eR x', eTh x', eZ] a) := by
    intro x x' t a hρ hz
    have hX : simX B.h x t = simX B.h x' t := by unfold simX; rw [hρ, hz]
    have hE : simEta B.h x t = simEta B.h x' t := by unfold simEta; rw [hz]
    have hq : simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) = simScale B.h (x' 2) (1 - t) := by rw [hz]
    have hr : rad x = rad x' := by unfold rad; rw [hρ]
    unfold stressDivField
    rw [K, K, hX, hE, hq, hr, hρ]
  refine ⟨fun ξ => ?_, ?_⟩
  · show inner ℝ (stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz (rotPt ξ.1 0 ξ.2.1) ξ.2.2.1)
        (![eR (rotPt ξ.1 0 ξ.2.1), eTh (rotPt ξ.1 0 ξ.2.1), eZ] 0) = 0
    unfold stressDivField
    rw [K]
    rfl
  
  
  have hcurl : ∀ (A Bv : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿A) O →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Bv) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A w s) y + Bv y s)) O := by
    intro A Bv O hO hA hB
    let ev : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ((ℝ³ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³) →L[ℝ] ℝ := fun a b =>
      (EuclideanSpace.proj b).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ³ ((EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ) : ℝ³), (0:ℝ)))
    let L : ((ℝ³ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³) →L[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
      (ev 1 2 - ev 2 1).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) +
      (ev 2 0 - ev 0 2).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) +
      (ev 0 1 - ev 1 0).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))
    have hLapp : ∀ Φ : (ℝ³ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³, L Φ =
        (Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1, 0) 2 - Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1, 0) 1) •
            EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1, 0) 0 - Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, 0) 2) •
            EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, 0) 1 - Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1, 0) 0) •
            EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) := by
      intro Φ
      rfl
    have hslice : ∀ z ∈ O, ∀ v : ℝ³,
        fderiv ℝ (fun w => A w z.2) z.1 v = fderiv ℝ (↿A) z (v, 0) := by
      intro z hz v
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿A) z :=
        (hA.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hd' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿A) (z.1, z.2) := hd
      have he : (fun w => A w z.2) = (↿A) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ => (w, z.2)) := rfl
      rw [he, fderiv_comp z.1 hd' (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left z.1 z.2).differentiableAt,
        (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left z.1 z.2).fderiv]
      rfl
    let G : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ³ := fun z => L (fderiv ℝ (↿A) z) + (↿Bv) z
    have hE : ∀ z ∈ O, (↿(fun y s => curl3 (fun w => A w s) y + Bv y s)) z = G z := by
      intro z hz
      show curl3 (fun w => A w z.2) z.1 + Bv z.1 z.2 = L (fderiv ℝ (↿A) z) + Bv z.1 z.2
      rw [hLapp]
      simp only [curl3, hslice z hz]
    have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿A)) O := hA.fderiv_of_isOpen hO (by simp)
    have hLf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => L (fderiv ℝ (↿A) z)) O := hfd.continuousLinearMap_comp L
    have hGs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G O := hLf.add hB
    exact hGs.congr hE
  have hjet : ∀ (ν : ℝ) (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)), IsOpen O →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(nsResidual ν u p)) O := by
    intro ν u p O hO hu hp
    have s1 : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : ℝ³ × ℝ → F) (x : ℝ³)
        (t : ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ f (x, t) →
        deriv (fun s => f (x, s)) t = fderiv ℝ f (x, t) ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ)) ∧
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => f (y, t)) x =
          (fderiv ℝ f (x, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := by
      intro F _ _ f x t hf
      constructor
      · have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ((x, s) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ)) t :=
          (hasDerivAt_const t x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id t)
        exact (hf.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hγ).deriv
      · exact (hf.hasFDerivAt.comp x (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left x t)).fderiv
    have s2 : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : ℝ³ × ℝ → F) (x : ℝ³)
        (t : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O → (x, t) ∈ O → ∀ a b : ℝ³,
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => f (y, t))) x a b =
          fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (x, t) (a, (0 : ℝ)) (b, (0 : ℝ)) := by
      intro F _ _ f x t hf hxt a b
      have hemb : Continuous (fun y : ℝ³ => ((y, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) :=
        continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const
      have hN : {y : ℝ³ | (y, t) ∈ O} ∈ nhds x := (hO.preimage hemb).mem_nhds hxt
      let Φ : (ℝ³ × ℝ →L[ℝ] F) →L[ℝ] (ℝ³ →L[ℝ] F) :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ ℝ³ (ℝ³ × ℝ) F).flip (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)
      have hΦ : ∀ M, Φ M = M.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := fun M => rfl
      have hev : fderiv ℝ (fun y => f (y, t)) =ᶠ[nhds x] fun y => Φ (fderiv ℝ f (y, t)) := by
        filter_upwards [hN] with y hy
        have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (y, t) :=
          (hf.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
        rw [hΦ]
        exact (s1 f y t hd).2
      have hDf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) O :=
        ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hf).2
      have hD2 : HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ f) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (x, t)) (x, t) :=
        ((hDf.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hxt)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
      have hg : HasFDerivAt (fun y => Φ (fderiv ℝ f (y, t)))
          (Φ.comp ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (x, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ))) x :=
        Φ.hasFDerivAt.comp x (hD2.comp x (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left x t))
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq, hg.fderiv]
      rfl
    have s3 : ∀ (g : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³), gradient g x = ∑ i : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ g x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) := by
      intro g x
      have h := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr' (gradient g x)
      rw [← h]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      simp only [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
      congr 1
      rw [real_inner_comm]
      exact InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply
    have s4 : ∀ (g : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (x : ℝ³), Δ g x = ∑ i : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) := by
      intro g x
      have h := congrFun (InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_orthonormalBasis g
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)) x
      rw [h]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
      simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
    have hDu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿u)) O :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hu).2
    have hD2u : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿u))) O :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hDu).2
    have hDp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿p)) O :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hp).2
    have hT3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿u)) z
        (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) O :=
      ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => (hD2u.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have hT4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (↿p) z
        (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) O :=
      ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => (hDp.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).smul contDiffOn_const
    have hJ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (nsJet ν u p) O := by
      unfold nsJet
      exact (((hDu.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).add
        (hDu.clm_apply (hu.prodMk contDiffOn_const))).sub (hT3.const_smul ν)).add hT4
    have hid : ∀ z ∈ O, (↿(nsResidual ν u p)) z = nsJet ν u p z := by
      rintro ⟨x, t⟩ hz
      have hu' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿u) (x, t) :=
        (hu.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hp' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿p) (x, t) :=
        (hp.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have e1 : deriv (fun s => u x s) t = fderiv ℝ (↿u) (x, t) ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ)) :=
        (s1 (↿u) x t hu').1
      have e2 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) x (u x t) =
          fderiv ℝ (↿u) (x, t) ((↿u) (x, t), (0 : ℝ)) := by
        have h2 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) x =
            (fderiv ℝ (↿u) (x, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := (s1 (↿u) x t hu').2
        rw [h2]
        rfl
      have e3 : Δ (fun y => u y t) x = ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿u)) (x, t)
          (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) := by
        rw [s4]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => s2 (↿u) x t hu hz _ _)
      have e4 : gradient (fun y => p y t) x = ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (↿p) (x, t)
          (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) := by
        have h2 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => p y t) x =
            (fderiv ℝ (↿p) (x, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := (s1 (↿p) x t hp').2
        rw [s3, h2]
        rfl
      show nsResidual ν u p x t = nsJet ν u p (x, t)
      rw [nsResidual, e1, e2, e3, e4]
      rfl
    exact hJ.congr hid
  
  have hO : IsOpen (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
    have hS4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1
    have hcoord : Continuous (fun y : ℝ³ => y 2) := (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3)).continuous
    have hφ : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      (hcoord.comp continuous_fst).prodMk (continuous_const.sub continuous_snd)
    have hFc : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
      hS4.continuousOn.comp hφ.continuousOn (fun w hw => ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 by
        have hw' : w.2 < 1 := hw
        linarith⟩)
    have he : simDomain B.h B.qB = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
        (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ⁻¹' Iio B.qB := Set.ext fun _ => Iff.rfl
    rw [he]
    exact hFc.isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const) isOpen_Iio
  have hB3 := hok.2.2.2.2.1
  have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(uB B)) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := hcurl B.AB B.BvB _ hO hB3.1 hB3.2.1
  have hres : ContinuousOn (↿(nsResidual 1 (uB B) B.PB)) (simDomain B.h B.qB) :=
    (hjet 1 (uB B) B.PB _ hO hu hB3.2.2).continuousOn
  
  have tavg : ∀ (N g : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), Continuous N → (∀ θ, g θ = N θ - c) → thA N = c + thA g := by
    intro N g c hN hg
    unfold thA
    simp only [hg]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hN.intervalIntegrable _ _) intervalIntegrable_const,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
    have hpi : (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
    ring
  have tcirc : ∀ (r z t : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (a : Fin 3), 0 < r → ∀ (g : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ³) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)),
      ContinuousOn g O → (∀ θ : ℝ, ((rotPt r θ z, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ O) →
      Continuous (fun θ => inner ℝ (g (rotPt r θ z, t)) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a)) := by
    intro r z t Y a hr g O hres hmem
    have hc0 : ∀ θ, (rotPt r θ z) 0 = r * Real.cos θ := fun θ => by simp [rotPt]
    have hc1 : ∀ θ, (rotPt r θ z) 1 = r * Real.sin θ := fun θ => by simp [rotPt]
    have hsq : ∀ θ, (rotPt r θ z) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt r θ z) 1 ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := fun θ => by
      rw [hc0, hc1]; linear_combination r ^ 2 * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
    have hR : ∀ θ, rad (rotPt r θ z) = r := fun θ => by
      unfold rad; rw [hsq, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
    have hγ : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => ((rotPt r θ z, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) := by
      refine Continuous.prodMk ?_ continuous_const
      unfold rotPt
      fun_prop
    have h1 : Continuous (fun θ => g (rotPt r θ z, t)) := hres.comp_continuous hγ hmem
    have hfa : (fun θ => frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a) = fun θ =>
        ![r⁻¹ • ((r * Real.cos θ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0:Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
            (r * Real.sin θ) • EuclideanSpace.single (1:Fin 3) (1:ℝ)),
          r⁻¹ • (-(r * Real.sin θ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0:Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
            (r * Real.cos θ) • EuclideanSpace.single (1:Fin 3) (1:ℝ)), eZ] a := by
      funext θ
      show ![eR (rotPt r θ z), eTh (rotPt r θ z), eZ] a = _
      unfold eR eTh radVec azVec
      rw [hR, hc0, hc1]
    have h2 : Continuous (fun θ => frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a) := by
      rw [hfa]
      fin_cases a <;> simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk, Fin.isValue,
        Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.tail_cons] <;> fun_prop
    exact h1.inner h2
  rintro ⟨r, z, t, Y⟩ a hr ht hq
  change 0 < r at hr
  change t < 1 at ht
  change simScale B.h z (1 - t) < B.qB at hq
  have hc0 : ∀ θ, (rotPt r θ z) 0 = r * Real.cos θ := fun θ => by simp [rotPt]
  have hc1 : ∀ θ, (rotPt r θ z) 1 = r * Real.sin θ := fun θ => by simp [rotPt]
  have hc2 : ∀ θ, (rotPt r θ z) 2 = z := fun θ => by simp [rotPt]
  have hsq : ∀ θ, (rotPt r θ z) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt r θ z) 1 ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := fun θ => by
    rw [hc0, hc1]; linear_combination r ^ 2 * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
  have hmem : ∀ θ : ℝ, ((rotPt r θ z, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB := fun θ => by
    show t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ((rotPt r θ z) 2) (1 - t) < B.qB
    rw [hc2]
    exact ⟨ht, hq⟩
  have hNc : Continuous (fun θ => inner ℝ ((↿(nsResidual 1 (uB B) B.PB)) (rotPt r θ z, t))
      (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a)) :=
    tcirc r z t Y a hr (↿(nsResidual 1 (uB B) B.PB)) (simDomain B.h B.qB) hres hmem
  have hS : ∀ θ, inner ℝ (stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz (rotPt r θ z) t)
      (![eR (rotPt r θ z), eTh (rotPt r θ z), eZ] a) =
      inner ℝ (stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz (rotPt r 0 z) t)
      (![eR (rotPt r 0 z), eTh (rotPt r 0 z), eZ] a) :=
    fun θ => hinv (rotPt r θ z) (rotPt r 0 z) t a (by rw [hsq, hsq]) (by rw [hc2, hc2])
  have hint : ∀ θ, inner ℝ (mriE B (rotPt r θ z) t) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a) =
      inner ℝ ((↿(nsResidual 1 (uB B) B.PB)) (rotPt r θ z, t)) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a) -
        sBase B a (r, z, t, Y) := by
    intro θ
    have e : mriE B (rotPt r θ z) t = (↿(nsResidual 1 (uB B) B.PB)) (rotPt r θ z, t) -
        stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz (rotPt r θ z) t := rfl
    have e2 : sBase B a (r, z, t, Y) = inner ℝ (stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz (rotPt r 0 z) t)
        (![eR (rotPt r 0 z), eTh (rotPt r 0 z), eZ] a) := rfl
    have e3 : frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a = ![eR (rotPt r θ z), eTh (rotPt r θ z), eZ] a := rfl
    rw [e, e2, e3, inner_sub_left, hS θ]
  have key := tavg _ _ (sBase B a (r, z, t, Y)) hNc hint
  have hf : ∀ θ, frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) a = frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a := fun θ => rfl
  show thA (fun θ => inner ℝ ((↿(nsResidual 1 (uB B) B.PB)) (rotPt r θ z, t)) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) a)) =
    sBase B a (r, z, t, Y) + thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (mriE B (rotPt r θ z) t) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a))
  simp only [hf]
  exact key

signature.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (bw ca cm cd : ℝ), B.ok →

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 S bw ca cm cd hok hG hqsB hSt Y₀
  obtain ⟨hΩo, hΨ, hQs, hrad, heR, heTh⟩ := corr_domain_v5 B l0 Y₀ hok
  set Ω : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ) := {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} with hΩdef
  set Ψ : ℝ³ × ℝ → Cyl := fun w => ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + Y₀) with hΨdef
  have hSP : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  have hBP := hok.2
  unfold BackgroundProps at hBP
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, ⟨hABs, hBvBs, hPBs⟩, hB4, -⟩ := hBP
  obtain ⟨hAw, hpw, hPsi, hbdir, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, hpm, -, -, -⟩ := hSt
  have hΩmem : ∀ w ∈ Ω, corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2 := fun w hw => hw
  have hΩsub : Ω ⊆ simDomain B.h B.qB := fun w hw =>
    ⟨(hΩmem w hw).2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le (hΩmem w hw).2.2 hqsB⟩
  have hΨmaps : MapsTo Ψ Ω (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := fun w hw => hw
  have hQpos : ∀ w ∈ Ω, 0 < simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) := fun w hw =>
    (hSP.1 (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) (by linarith [(hΩmem w hw).2.1])).1
  have hQΩ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) Ω :=
    hQs.mono (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).2.1)
  have hQp : ∀ p : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ p) Ω :=
    fun p => hQΩ.rpow_const_of_ne (fun w hw => (hQpos w hw).ne')
  have heRΩ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => eR w.1) Ω :=
    heR.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).1)
  have heThΩ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => eTh w.1) Ω :=
    heTh.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).1)
  have hradΩ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1) Ω :=
    hrad.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).1)
  have hbase : ∀ (l : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => baseC B l ξ i) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro l i
    have h1 := (geom_slow_base_smooth_v5 B hok).2 l i
    have hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      contDiff_fst.prodMk ((contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_snd).prodMk
        (contDiff_fst.comp (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd)))
    have hmaps : MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h3 : qC B.h ξ < B.qB := lt_of_lt_of_le hξ.2.2 hqsB
      exact ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, h3⟩
    have hcomp := h1.comp hp.contDiffOn hmaps
    refine hcomp.congr (fun ξ _ => ?_)
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, baseC]
  have hwave : ∀ a : WS, (∃ H : Finset ℤ, ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → a γ m = 0) →
      (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (a γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) →
      (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => waveS5 B G a (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w)) Ω := by
    intro a hHa ha hsupp
    obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ := hHa
    have hfac : ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, waveS5 B G a (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) =
        (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, a γ m (Ψ w) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) *
          ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ (Ψ w) : ℂ))) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ))).re := by
      intro w
      unfold waveS5
      congr 1
      refine finsum_congr (fun γ => finsum_congr (fun m => ?_))
      unfold ephase5
      have key : Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((pint5 B G γ : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ) +
          (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ (Ψ w) : ℂ)) =
          Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ (Ψ w) : ℂ)) +
          Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ) := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [key, Complex.exp_add]
      ring
    refine (wave_sum_assembly Ω (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) Ψ
      (fun γ m ξ => a γ m ξ * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))
      (fun γ m => m * pint5 B G γ) H hΩo (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).1) hΨ hΨmaps ?_ ?_
      (fun γ m => wave_coef_phase_smooth_v5 B G (qsOf l0) a hG hbase ha hsupp γ m)).congr
      (fun w _ => hfac w)
    · intro γ m hm ξ _
      simp [hH γ m hm]
    · intro ξ₀ hξ₀
      obtain ⟨U, hU, hξU, T, hT⟩ := etaL_locfin B.h (qsOf l0) hSP ξ₀ hξ₀
      refine ⟨U, hU, hξU, T, fun γ hγ m ξ hξ => ?_⟩
      by_contra hne
      have ha0 : a γ m ξ ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hne (by simp [h0])
      exact hT γ hγ ξ hξ.1 (hsupp γ m ξ hξ.2 ha0).2.1
  obtain ⟨HA, -, hHA⟩ := hAw.1
  have hW : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => waveS5 B G (fun γ m ξ => S.Aw γ m ξ i) (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w)) Ω := by
    intro i
    refine hwave (fun γ m ξ => S.Aw γ m ξ i) ⟨HA, fun γ m hm => ?_⟩
      (fun γ m => contDiffOn_pi.mp (hAw.2.1 γ m) i) (fun γ m ξ hξ hne => ?_)
    · funext ξ
      simp [hHA γ m hm]
    · exact hAw.2.2.2.1 γ m ξ hξ (fun h0 => hne (by simp [h0]))
  obtain ⟨HP, -, hHP⟩ := hpw.1
  have hWp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => waveS5 B G S.pw (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w)) Ω :=
    hwave S.pw ⟨HP, hHP⟩ hpw.2.1 hpw.2.2.2.1
  have hAeq : ∀ w ∈ Ω, (↿(evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) w = B.AB w.1 w.2 +
      simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h) •
        (waveS5 B G (fun γ m ξ => S.Aw γ m ξ 0) (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) • eR w.1 +
         waveS5 B G (fun γ m ξ => S.Aw γ m ξ 1) (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) • eTh w.1 +
         waveS5 B G (fun γ m ξ => S.Aw γ m ξ 2) (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) • eZ +
         S.Psi (Ψ w) • eTh w.1) := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' : corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2 := hw
    change B.AB w.1 w.2 + _ = _
    rw [if_pos hw']
    all_goals rfl
  have hBeq : ∀ w ∈ Ω, (↿(evOff B.h (BX B G l0 S) Y₀)) w = B.BvB w.1 w.2 +
      (simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-Aex B.h) * S.bdir (Ψ w)) • eTh w.1 := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' : corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2 := hw
    change B.BvB w.1 w.2 + _ = _
    rw [if_pos hw']
    all_goals rfl
  have hPeq : ∀ w ∈ Ω, (↿(evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) w = B.PB w.1 w.2 +
      (simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h)) * nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (pmP5 B G l0 S) (Ψ w) +
       simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-2 * Aex B.h) * waveS5 B G S.pw (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w)) := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' : corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2 := hw
    have hq := hQpos w hw
    have e : pmP5 B G l0 S (Ψ w) =
        simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h)) * nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (pmP5 B G l0 S) (Ψ w) := by
      show pmP5 B G l0 S (Ψ w) = simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h)) *
        (simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (2 * Aex B.h) * pmP5 B G l0 S (Ψ w))
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hq, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero, one_mul]
    change B.PB w.1 w.2 + _ = _
    rw [if_pos hw', ← e]
    all_goals rfl
  have hAsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) Ω :=
    ContDiffOn.congr ((hABs.mono hΩsub).add ((hQp (1/2 - Aex B.h)).smul
      (((((hW 0).smul heRΩ).add ((hW 1).smul heThΩ)).add ((hW 2).smul (contDiffOn_const (c := eZ)))).add
        ((hPsi.1.comp hΨ hΨmaps).smul heThΩ)))) hAeq
  have hBsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (BX B G l0 S) Y₀)) Ω :=
    ContDiffOn.congr ((hBvBs.mono hΩsub).add
      (((hQp (-Aex B.h)).mul (hbdir.1.comp hΨ hΨmaps)).smul heThΩ)) hBeq
  have hPsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) Ω :=
    ContDiffOn.congr ((hPBs.mono hΩsub).add (((hQp (-(2 * Aex B.h))).mul (hpm.1.comp hΨ hΨmaps)).add
      ((hQp (-2 * Aex B.h)).mul hWp))) hPeq
  have hUeq : evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y₀ = fun y s =>
      curl3 (fun w => evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) Y₀ w s) y + evOff B.h (BX B G l0 S) Y₀ y s := by
    funext y s
    simp only [evOff, uX5, curlX, add_sub_cancel_left]
  refine ⟨hΩo, ?_, hPsm, ?_⟩
  · rw [hUeq]
    exact (curl_field_contDiffOn_bounded _ _ Ω Ω hΩo subset_rfl hAsm hBsm).1
  · intro x t hxt
    have hxtΩ : (x, t) ∈ Ω := hxt
    have hnhds : Ω ∈ nhds (x, t) := hΩo.mem_nhds hxtΩ
    have hemb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => (y, t)) := contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const
    have hsl : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (g : ℝ³ × ℝ → F),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g Ω → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => g (y, t)) x :=
      fun g hg => (hg.contDiffAt hnhds).comp x hemb.contDiffAt
    have hAat : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) Y₀ y t) x := by
      have := hsl _ hAsm; exact this
    have hcurl := curl3_differentiable_divergence_zero (fun w => evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) Y₀ w t) x
      (hAat.of_le (by norm_num))
    have hBd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (BX B G l0 S) Y₀ y t) x := by
      have := (hsl _ hBsm).differentiableAt (by norm_num); exact this
    have hBvBd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => B.BvB y t) x := by
      have := (hsl _ (hBvBs.mono hΩsub)).differentiableAt (by norm_num); exact this
    set φ : ℝ³ → ℝ := fun y => simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) ^ (-Aex B.h) * S.bdir (Ψ (y, t)) * (rad y)⁻¹
      with hφdef
    have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
        simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-Aex B.h) * S.bdir (Ψ w) * (rad w.1)⁻¹) Ω :=
      ((hQp (-Aex B.h)).mul (hbdir.1.comp hΨ hΨmaps)).mul
        (hradΩ.inv (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).1.ne'))
    have hφd : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ x := by
      have := (hsl _ hf).differentiableAt (by norm_num); exact this
    obtain ⟨hsd, hsdiv⟩ := swirl_div_zero
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h p.2 (1 - t) ^ (-Aex B.h) *
        S.bdir (p.1, p.2, t, Yph B.h p.1 t + Y₀) * p.1⁻¹)
      φ x (fun y => rfl) hφd
    have hBloc : (fun y => evOff B.h (BX B G l0 S) Y₀ y t) =ᶠ[nhds x]
        (fun y => B.BvB y t + φ y • azVec y) := by
      have hO : {y : ℝ³ | (y, t) ∈ Ω} ∈ nhds x :=
        hemb.continuous.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds hnhds
      filter_upwards [hO] with y hy
      have e1 := hBeq (y, t) hy
      have e2 : eTh y = (rad y)⁻¹ • azVec y := rfl
      exact e1.trans (by rw [e2, smul_smul])
    have hdivB : divergence (fun y => evOff B.h (BX B G l0 S) Y₀ y t) x = 0 := by
      have e : divergence (fun y => evOff B.h (BX B G l0 S) Y₀ y t) x =
          divergence (fun y => B.BvB y t + φ y • azVec y) x := by
        unfold divergence
        rw [hBloc.fderiv_eq]
      rw [e, divergence_add hBvBd hsd, (hB4 x t (hΩsub hxtΩ)).1, hsdiv, add_zero]
    rw [hUeq]
    show divergence (fun y => curl3 (fun w => evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) Y₀ w t) y +
      evOff B.h (BX B G l0 S) Y₀ y t) x = 0
    rw [divergence_add hcurl.1 hBd, hcurl.2, hdivB, add_zero]

subgoal_signatures.name: wave_sum_assembly
subgoal_signatures.statement:

      (∀ x s, (x, s) ∈ O → divergence (fun y => u y s) x = 0) → (∀ θ : ℝ, (rotPt r θ z, t) ∈ O) →

      mriRes u p 1 (r, z, t) = thA (fun θ => crRow1 (crU u) (crP p) (r, θ, z, t)) ∧
      mriRes u p 2 (r, z, t) = thA (fun θ => crRow2 (crU u) (crP p) (r, θ, z, t)) := by
    intro u p O hO hu hp hd hc
    have key : ∀ (θ : ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
        inner ℝ (nsResidual 1 u p (rotPt r θ z) t) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) a) =
          inner ℝ (deriv (fun s => u (rotPt r θ z) s) t) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) a) +
          inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) (rotPt r θ z) (u (rotPt r θ z) t)) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) a) -
          inner ℝ (Δ (fun y => u y t) (rotPt r θ z)) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) a) +
          inner ℝ (gradient (fun y => p y t) (rotPt r θ z)) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) a) := by
      intro θ a
      simp only [nsResidual, one_smul, inner_add_left, inner_sub_left]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (nsResidual 1 u p (rotPt r θ z) t) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) 0)) = _
      congr 1
      funext θ
      obtain ⟨hT, hP0, hP1, hP2⟩ := cyl_frame_tp u p O r θ z t hO hu hp hr (hc θ)
      obtain ⟨hC0, hC1, hC2⟩ := cyl_frame_conv u O r θ z t hO hu hr (hc θ)
      obtain ⟨hL0, hL1, hL2⟩ := cyl_frame_lap u O r θ z t hO hu hr (hc θ)
      have hdv := hd _ _ (hc θ)
      rw [key θ 0]
      dsimp only [crRow0]
      linear_combination hT 0 + hC0 - hL0 + hP0 - crU u 0 (r, θ, z, t) * hdv
    · show thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (nsResidual 1 u p (rotPt r θ z) t) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) 1)) = _
      congr 1
      funext θ
      obtain ⟨hT, hP0, hP1, hP2⟩ := cyl_frame_tp u p O r θ z t hO hu hp hr (hc θ)
      obtain ⟨hC0, hC1, hC2⟩ := cyl_frame_conv u O r θ z t hO hu hr (hc θ)
      obtain ⟨hL0, hL1, hL2⟩ := cyl_frame_lap u O r θ z t hO hu hr (hc θ)
      have hdv := hd _ _ (hc θ)
      rw [key θ 1]
      dsimp only [crRow1]
      linear_combination hT 1 + hC1 - hL1 + hP1 - crU u 1 (r, θ, z, t) * hdv
    · show thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (nsResidual 1 u p (rotPt r θ z) t) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) 2)) = _
      congr 1
      funext θ
      obtain ⟨hT, hP0, hP1, hP2⟩ := cyl_frame_tp u p O r θ z t hO hu hp hr (hc θ)
      obtain ⟨hC0, hC1, hC2⟩ := cyl_frame_conv u O r θ z t hO hu hr (hc θ)
      obtain ⟨hL0, hL1, hL2⟩ := cyl_frame_lap u O r θ z t hO hu hr (hc θ)
      have hdv := hd _ _ (hc θ)
      rw [key θ 2]
      dsimp only [crRow2]
      linear_combination hT 2 + hC2 - hL2 + hP2 - crU u 2 (r, θ, z, t) * hdv
  have R₁ := rows u₁ p₁ O₁ hO₁ hu₁ hp₁ hd₁ hc₁
  have R₂ := rows u₂ p₂ O₂ hO₂ hu₂ hp₂ hd₂ hc₂
  
  obtain ⟨W₁, hW₁o, hw₁, hpos₁, hcirc₁⟩ := cyl_tube O₁ r z t hO₁ hr hc₁
  obtain ⟨W₂, hW₂o, hw₂, hpos₂, hcirc₂⟩ := cyl_tube O₂ r z t hO₂ hr hc₂
  have hWo : IsOpen (W₁ ∩ W₂) := hW₁o.inter hW₂o
  have hwW : ((r, z, t) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂ := ⟨hw₁, hw₂⟩
  
  have hsub : ∀ (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)), (∀ w ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂, ∀ θ : ℝ, (rotPt w.1 θ w.2.1, w.2.2) ∈ O) →
      {v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | (v.1, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂} ⊆
        {v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < v.1 ∧ (rotPt v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) ∈ O} := by
    intro O hcirc v hv
    exact ⟨hpos₁ _ hv.1, hcirc _ hv v.2.1⟩
  obtain ⟨-, hsU₁, hsP₁, hpU₁, hpP₁⟩ := cyl_lift_smooth u₁ p₁ O₁ hO₁ hu₁ hp₁
  obtain ⟨-, hsU₂, hsP₂, hpU₂, hpP₂⟩ := cyl_lift_smooth u₂ p₂ O₂ hO₂ hu₂ hp₂
  have hs₁ := hsub O₁ (fun w hw => hcirc₁ w hw.1)
  have hs₂ := hsub O₂ (fun w hw => hcirc₂ w hw.2)
  
  obtain ⟨hMs₁, hQs₁, hPs₁, hA₁0, hA₁1, hA₁2⟩ := cyl_avg_rows (crU u₁) (crP p₁) (W₁ ∩ W₂) (r, z, t) hWo hwW
    (fun a => (hsU₁ a).mono hs₁) (hsP₁.mono hs₁) hpU₁ hpP₁
  obtain ⟨hMs₂, hQs₂, hPs₂, hA₂0, hA₂1, hA₂2⟩ := cyl_avg_rows (crU u₂) (crP p₂) (W₁ ∩ W₂) (r, z, t) hWo hwW
    (fun a => (hsU₂ a).mono hs₂) (hsP₂.mono hs₂) hpU₂ hpP₂
  dsimp only at hA₁0 hA₁1 hA₁2 hA₂0 hA₂1 hA₂2
  
  have TM := fun a => cyl_path_transfer h Y₀ (crAv (crU u₁ a)) (crAv (crU u₂ a)) (dm a) (W₁ ∩ W₂) U (r, z, t)
    hWo hwW (hMs₁ a) (hMs₂ a) hU (hdm a) hr hξU (fun w' hw' => hM w' hw' a)
  have TQ := fun a b => cyl_path_transfer h Y₀ (crAv (fun η => crU u₁ a η * crU u₁ b η))
    (crAv (fun η => crU u₂ a η * crU u₂ b η)) (dq a b) (W₁ ∩ W₂) U (r, z, t)
    hWo hwW (hQs₁ a b) (hQs₂ a b) hU (hdq a b) hr hξU (fun w' hw' => hQ w' hw' a b)
  have TP := cyl_path_transfer h Y₀ (crAv (crP p₁)) (crAv (crP p₂)) dp (W₁ ∩ W₂) U (r, z, t)
    hWo hwW hPs₁ hPs₂ hU hdp hr hξU (fun w' hw' => hP w' hw')
  have hZadd : dZ (fun η => dq 2 2 η + dp η) (mriPath h Y₀ (r, z, t)) =
      dZ (dq 2 2) (mriPath h Y₀ (r, z, t)) + dZ dp (mriPath h Y₀ (r, z, t)) := by
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (dq 2 2) (mriPath h Y₀ (r, z, t)) :=
      ((hdq 2 2).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξU)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ dp (mriPath h Y₀ (r, z, t)) :=
      (hdp.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξU)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    simp only [dZ]
    rw [fderiv_fun_add h1 h2, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
  have e1 : (mriPath h Y₀ (r, z, t)).1 = r := rfl
  rw [e1]
  
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linear_combination R₁.1 - R₂.1 + hA₁0 - hA₂0 + (TM 0).2.2.2.1 + (TQ 0 0).2.1 + (TQ 0 0).1 / r
      + (TQ 2 0).2.2.1 - (TQ 1 1).1 / r - (TM 0).2.2.2.2 + (TM 0).1 / r ^ 2 + TP.2.1
  · linear_combination R₁.2.1 - R₂.2.1 + hA₁1 - hA₂1 + (TM 1).2.2.2.1 + (TQ 0 1).2.1 + 2 * (TQ 0 1).1 / r
      + (TQ 2 1).2.2.1 - (TM 1).2.2.2.2 + (TM 1).1 / r ^ 2
  · linear_combination R₁.2.2 - R₂.2.2 + hA₁2 - hA₂2 + (TM 2).2.2.2.1 + (TQ 0 2).2.1 + (TQ 0 2).1 / r
      + (TQ 2 2).2.2.1 - (TM 2).2.2.2.2 + TP.2.2.1 - hZadd

cyl_reynolds_diff.definitions:
noncomputable def crU (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (a : Fin 3) (v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  inner ℝ (u (rotPt v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1) v.2.2.2) (frameAt v.2.1 (v.1, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2, 0) a)

noncomputable def crP (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  p (rotPt v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1) v.2.2.2

noncomputable def cpR (F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := fderiv ℝ F v (1, 0, 0, 0)
noncomputable def cpTh (F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := fderiv ℝ F v (0, 1, 0, 0)
noncomputable def cpZ (F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := fderiv ℝ F v (0, 0, 1, 0)
noncomputable def cpS (F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := fderiv ℝ F v (0, 0, 0, 1)

noncomputable def crAv (F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  thA (fun θ => F (w.1, θ, w.2.1, w.2.2))

noncomputable def wDr (F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := fderiv ℝ F w (1, 0, 0)
noncomputable def wDz (F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := fderiv ℝ F w (0, 1, 0)
noncomputable def wDt (F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := fderiv ℝ F w (0, 0, 1)
noncomputable def wLap (F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  wDr (wDr F) w + wDr F w / w.1 + wDz (wDz F) w

noncomputable def crRow0 (U : Fin 3 → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (P : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  cpS (U 0) v + cpR (fun η => U 0 η * U 0 η) v + U 0 v * U 0 v / v.1 + cpZ (fun η => U 2 η * U 0 η) v
    + cpTh (fun η => U 1 η * U 0 η) v / v.1 - U 1 v * U 1 v / v.1
    - (cpR (cpR (U 0)) v + cpR (U 0) v / v.1 + cpZ (cpZ (U 0)) v
        + (cpTh (cpTh (U 0)) v - 2 * cpTh (U 1) v - U 0 v) / v.1 ^ 2) + cpR P v

noncomputable def crRow1 (U : Fin 3 → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (P : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  cpS (U 1) v + cpR (fun η => U 0 η * U 1 η) v + 2 * (U 0 v * U 1 v) / v.1 + cpZ (fun η => U 2 η * U 1 η) v
    + cpTh (fun η => U 1 η * U 1 η) v / v.1
    - (cpR (cpR (U 1)) v + cpR (U 1) v / v.1 + cpZ (cpZ (U 1)) v
        + (cpTh (cpTh (U 1)) v + 2 * cpTh (U 0) v - U 1 v) / v.1 ^ 2) + cpTh P v / v.1

noncomputable def crRow2 (U : Fin 3 → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (P : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  cpS (U 2) v + cpR (fun η => U 0 η * U 2 η) v + U 0 v * U 2 v / v.1 + cpZ (fun η => U 2 η * U 2 η) v
    + cpTh (fun η => U 1 η * U 2 η) v / v.1
    - (cpR (cpR (U 2)) v + cpR (U 2) v / v.1 + cpZ (cpZ (U 2)) v + cpTh (cpTh (U 2)) v / v.1 ^ 2) + cpZ P v

noncomputable def crAv (F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=

noncomputable def wDr (F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := fderiv ℝ F w (1, 0, 0)

noncomputable def wLap (F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=

noncomputable def crRow0 (U : Fin 3 → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (P : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  cpS (U 0) v + cpR (fun η => U 0 η * U 0 η) v + U 0 v * U 0 v / v.1 + cpZ (fun η => U 2 η * U 0 η) v
    + cpTh (fun η => U 1 η * U 0 η) v / v.1 - U 1 v * U 1 v / v.1
    - (cpR (cpR (U 0)) v + cpR (U 0) v / v.1 + cpZ (cpZ (U 0)) v
        + (cpTh (cpTh (U 0)) v - 2 * cpTh (U 1) v - U 0 v) / v.1 ^ 2) + cpR P v

noncomputable def crRow1 (U : Fin 3 → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (P : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=

    + cpTh (fun η => U 1 η * U 1 η) v / v.1
    - (cpR (cpR (U 1)) v + cpR (U 1) v / v.1 + cpZ (cpZ (U 1)) v
        + (cpTh (cpTh (U 1)) v + 2 * cpTh (U 0) v - U 1 v) / v.1 ^ 2) + cpTh P v / v.1

noncomputable def crRow2 (U : Fin 3 → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (P : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=

subgoal_signatures.name: cyl_lift_smooth
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)), IsOpen O →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) O →
    IsOpen {v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < v.1 ∧ (rotPt v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) ∈ O} ∧
    (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (crU u a)
      {v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < v.1 ∧ (rotPt v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) ∈ O}) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (crP p) {v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < v.1 ∧ (rotPt v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) ∈ O} ∧
    (∀ (a : Fin 3) (v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), crU u a (v.1, v.2.1 + 2 * Real.pi, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) = crU u a v) ∧
    (∀ v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, crP p (v.1, v.2.1 + 2 * Real.pi, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) = crP p v)

subgoal_signatures.name: cyl_tube
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (r z t : ℝ), IsOpen O → 0 < r → (∀ θ : ℝ, (rotPt r θ z, t) ∈ O) →
    ∃ W : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), IsOpen W ∧ (r, z, t) ∈ W ∧ (∀ w ∈ W, 0 < w.1) ∧
      ∀ w ∈ W, ∀ θ : ℝ, (rotPt w.1 θ w.2.1, w.2.2) ∈ O

subgoal_signatures.name: cyl_frame_tp
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (r θ z t : ℝ), IsOpen O →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) O → 0 < r → (rotPt r θ z, t) ∈ O →
    (∀ a : Fin 3, inner ℝ (deriv (fun s => u (rotPt r θ z) s) t) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) a) =
      cpS (crU u a) (r, θ, z, t)) ∧
    inner ℝ (gradient (fun y => p y t) (rotPt r θ z)) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) 0) = cpR (crP p) (r, θ, z, t) ∧
    inner ℝ (gradient (fun y => p y t) (rotPt r θ z)) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) 1) =
      cpTh (crP p) (r, θ, z, t) / r ∧
    inner ℝ (gradient (fun y => p y t) (rotPt r θ z)) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) 2) = cpZ (crP p) (r, θ, z, t)

subgoal_signatures.name: cyl_frame_conv
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (r θ z t : ℝ), IsOpen O →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) O → 0 < r → (rotPt r θ z, t) ∈ O →
    (inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) (rotPt r θ z) (u (rotPt r θ z) t)) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) 0) +
        crU u 0 (r, θ, z, t) * divergence (fun y => u y t) (rotPt r θ z) =
      cpR (fun η => crU u 0 η * crU u 0 η) (r, θ, z, t) + crU u 0 (r, θ, z, t) * crU u 0 (r, θ, z, t) / r +
        cpZ (fun η => crU u 2 η * crU u 0 η) (r, θ, z, t) + cpTh (fun η => crU u 1 η * crU u 0 η) (r, θ, z, t) / r -
        crU u 1 (r, θ, z, t) * crU u 1 (r, θ, z, t) / r) ∧
    (inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) (rotPt r θ z) (u (rotPt r θ z) t)) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) 1) +
        crU u 1 (r, θ, z, t) * divergence (fun y => u y t) (rotPt r θ z) =
      cpR (fun η => crU u 0 η * crU u 1 η) (r, θ, z, t) + crU u 0 (r, θ, z, t) * crU u 1 (r, θ, z, t) / r +
        cpZ (fun η => crU u 2 η * crU u 1 η) (r, θ, z, t) + cpTh (fun η => crU u 1 η * crU u 1 η) (r, θ, z, t) / r +
        crU u 0 (r, θ, z, t) * crU u 1 (r, θ, z, t) / r) ∧
    (inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) (rotPt r θ z) (u (rotPt r θ z) t)) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) 2) +
        crU u 2 (r, θ, z, t) * divergence (fun y => u y t) (rotPt r θ z) =
      cpR (fun η => crU u 0 η * crU u 2 η) (r, θ, z, t) + crU u 0 (r, θ, z, t) * crU u 2 (r, θ, z, t) / r +

signature.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (l5 : ℕ) (c : ℝ), 0 < c →
    PrimNondegAt4 B G l5 c → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →
    ∀ (S : CState) (Bo : ℝ), 7/10 ≤ Bo → StressIn5 B G l0 S Bo → StressTargetOK5 B G l0 S Bo →
    SignedClass5 B G l0 S Bo

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hB hG l5 c hc h5
  obtain ⟨lP, hP⟩ := pulse_profile_bound_v5 B G hB hG
  obtain ⟨lD, hD⟩ := signed_scalar_amplitude_bound_v5 B G hB hG l5 c hc h5
  obtain ⟨lE, hE⟩ := lsh5_class_from_bounds_v5 B G hB hG l5 c hc h5 lP hP
  obtain ⟨lG, cG, b0, hcG, hGeo⟩ := nphi5_geometry_v5 B G hB hG
  obtain ⟨lF, hF⟩ := wave_potential_transfer_v5 B G hB hG lG cG b0 hcG hGeo
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -⟩ := hB.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨lD + lE + lF + n0, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 S Bo _hBo _hIn hT
  have hr0 : 0 < G.r0 := hG.1.1
  
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0.le
  have hDom : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB := fun ξ hξ =>
    ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ.2.2 hqsB⟩
  
  have hcib : ∀ l : ℕ, 0 < cib B.h l := by
    intro l
    unfold cib
    have hTg : (0:ℝ) < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; positivity
    have hQ : (0:ℝ) < Qb l := by unfold Qb; positivity
    exact mul_pos (zpow_pos hTg _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ _)
  
  have hchig : ∀ s : ℝ, chig G.r0 s ≠ 0 → |s| < G.r0 / 4 := by
    intro s hs
    unfold chig bumpR at hs
    by_contra hcon
    apply hs
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    push_neg at hcon
    have h1 : G.r0 ≤ |4 * s| := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 4)]; linarith
    have h2 : 1 ≤ (4 * s / G.r0) ^ 2 := by
      rw [div_pow, le_div_iff₀ (by positivity), one_mul, ← sq_abs (4 * s)]
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg (4 * s)]
    linarith
  
  have hpsi : ∀ (γ : Lab) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) Y) ≠ 0 →
      |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) Y| < 2 * G.r0 / 3 := by
    intro γ Y hs
    have hc := hcib γ.1
    unfold psiT at hs
    by_contra hcon
    apply hs
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    push_neg at hcon
    have hv : vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) Y - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2 = etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) Y / cib B.h γ.1 := by
      unfold vco Lsb; ring
    rw [hv]
    have hL : 0 < 2 * G.r0 / cib B.h γ.1 := div_pos (by linarith) hc
    apply div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
    · unfold Lsb
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hc]
      have e : 2 * G.r0 / cib B.h γ.1 / 3 = (2 * G.r0 / 3) / cib B.h γ.1 := by ring
      rw [e, sub_nonpos]
      gcongr
    · unfold Lsb
      linarith
  
  have hsupp : ∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), LSc5 B G l0 S γ ξ ≠ 0 →
      ActiveL4 B G γ ∧ etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 ∧ |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ G.r0 / 4 ∧
        |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ 2 * G.r0 / 3 := by
    intro γ ξ _hξ hne
    unfold LSc5 at hne
    split_ifs at hne with hg
    · have h1 : (Real.sqrt (epsb B.h γ.1) / 2 * etaL B.h γ ξ * sigAmp5 B G l0 S γ ξ *
          chig G.r0 (xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) *
          psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0; apply hne; rw [h0, zero_smul]
      obtain ⟨h2, hps⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp h1
      obtain ⟨h3, hch⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp h2
      obtain ⟨h4, -⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp h3
      obtain ⟨-, heta⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp h4
      exact ⟨hg.1, heta, (hchig _ hch).le, (hpsi γ _ hps).le⟩
    · exact absurd rfl hne
  
  have htr : ∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (LSc5 B G l0 S γ ξ) = 0 := by
    intro γ ξ hξ
    by_cases h0 : LSc5 B G l0 S γ ξ = 0
    · rw [h0, dotProduct_zero]
    · obtain ⟨hA, heta, hxi, het⟩ := hsupp γ ξ hξ h0
      have hR : inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) G.r0 ξ.2.2.2 := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have hT0 := tH_transversal_v5 B G hB hG γ ξ hA heta (hDom ξ hξ) hR
      unfold LSc5
      split_ifs
      · rw [dotProduct_smul, hT0, smul_zero]
      · exact dotProduct_zero _
  
  have hσ := hT.2.2.1
  have hsc := hD l0 (by omega) S (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) hσ
  have e1 : Bo + 1/2 - kapS - 1/2 = Bo - kapS := by ring
  simp only [e1] at hsc
  have hL := hE l0 (by omega) S (Bo - kapS) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) hσ hT.1 hsc
  obtain ⟨F1, F2, F3, F4⟩ := hF l0 (by omega) (LSc5 B G l0 S) (Bo - kapS) hsupp htr hL
  have e2 : Bo - kapS + 1/2 = Bo + 1/2 - kapS := by ring
  have e3 : Bo - kapS + 1/2 - kapS = Bo + 1/2 - 2 * kapS := by ring
  rw [e2] at F1 F4
  rw [e3] at F3
  exact ⟨hL, F1, F2, F3, F4⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: tH_transversal_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), ActiveL4 B G γ → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) G.r0 ξ.2.2.2 → dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)) = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: nphi5_geometry_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ (l1 : ℕ) (c b0 : ℝ), 0 < c ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), l1 ≤ γ.1 → ActiveL4 B G γ → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) G.r0 ξ.2.2.2 → B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb → c * SC B.h ξ ^ (-b0) ≤ dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ η i) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => nPhiP5 B G γ η i) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Kmat B G γ η i j) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b) ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (RC γ.1 η)⁻¹) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => RC γ.1 η) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b

subgoal_signatures.name: signed_scalar_amplitude_bound_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (l5 : ℕ) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → PrimNondegAt4 B G l5 c → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (S : CState) (α : ℝ), (∀ e : ℕ, (e = 1 ∨ e = 2) → InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (sigE5 B G l0 S e))) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b d : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ActiveL4 B G γ → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (epsb B.h γ.1) / 2 * sigAmp5 B G l0 S γ η) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α - 1/2)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d)

subgoal_signatures.name: lsh5_class_from_bounds_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (l5 : ℕ) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → PrimNondegAt4 B G l5 c → ∀ lP : ℕ, (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), lP ≤ γ.1 → ActiveL4 B G γ → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb → NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (chig G.r0 (xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2) * psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2)) • G.tH γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2)) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b * Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)) → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (S : CState) (α β : ℝ), (∀ e : ℕ, (e = 1 ∨ e = 2) → InM B (qsOf l0) β (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (sigE5 B G l0 S e))) → (∀ e : ℕ, (e = 1 ∨ e = 2) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → sigE5 B G l0 S e ξ = 0) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b d : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ActiveL4 B G γ → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (epsb B.h γ.1) / 2 * sigAmp5 B G l0 S γ η) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d)) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α (LSh5 B G l0 S)

subgoal_signatures.name: wave_potential_transfer_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (lG : ℕ) (cG b0 : ℝ), 0 < cG → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), lG ≤ γ.1 → ActiveL4 B G γ → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) G.r0 ξ.2.2.2 → B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb → cG * SC B.h ξ ^ (-b0) ≤ dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ η i) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => nPhiP5 B G γ η i) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Kmat B G γ η i j) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b) ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (RC γ.1 η)⁻¹) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => RC γ.1 η) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b) → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (c : Lab → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (α : ℝ), (∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), c γ ξ ≠ 0 → ActiveL4 B G γ ∧ etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 ∧ |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ G.r0 / 4 ∧ |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ 2 * G.r0 / 3) → (∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (c γ ξ) = 0) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α (fun γ m ξ => if m = 1 ∨ m = -1 then (fun i => ((c γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) else 0) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + 1/2) (potW5 B G c) ∧ InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α (velW5 B G (potW5 B G c)) ∧ InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + 1/2 - kapS) (velW5 B G (potW5 B G c) - (fun γ m ξ => if m = 1 ∨ m = -1 then (fun i => ((c γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) else 0)) ∧ InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + 1/2) (presW5 B G c)

search_metadata.last_error: Commit gate: the six children match blueprint s1-s6 one to one, the glue uses every one of them (pulse bound to lsh5, amplitude to lsh5, geometry to transfer, transversality to htr, transfer to F1-F4), and the support/transversality/exponent steps are proved inline. I re-derived the tH_transversal ODE identity (g' = -d*g, with n.Bcol5(.,1)=0), the amplitude exponent q^{h(alpha-1/2)}*sqrt(zeta), and the transfer identity ikm*(n x C)=c when n.c=0. Each child is a separately stated, much smaller reference lemma (7.4, 7.1, 7.6, 7.7, or an exact ODE invariant) with a proof route and §4/§5 evidence. No §10 overlap, no recycling, no ancestor restatement. Risks for the children to watch: the nphi5 lower bound has to come from the tangential pair, because the theta entry alone is only of size eps^{1/2}, and the s5 zero-extension needs bounds that are locally uniform from inside V.

stress5_means_same.definitions:
noncomputable def rotZ (α : ℝ) (y : ℝ³) : ℝ³ :=
  (Real.cos α * y 0 - Real.sin α * y 1) • EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 +
  (Real.sin α * y 0 + Real.cos α * y 1) • EuclideanSpace.single 1 1 + y 2 • EuclideanSpace.single 2 1

noncomputable def zetaY (h t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (y : ℝ³) : Cyl := ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)

open Classical in
noncomputable def waveFld5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (a : WC) (t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (y : ℝ³) : ℝ³ :=
  if corrOn B l0 y t then qC B.h (zetaY B.h t Y0 y) ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h) •
    cyl2cart y (waveV5 B G a (thetaOf y) (zetaY B.h t Y0 y)) else 0

open Classical in
noncomputable def psiFld (B : BG) (l0 : ℕ) (f : Cyl → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (y : ℝ³) : ℝ³ :=
  if corrOn B l0 y t then qC B.h (zetaY B.h t Y0 y) ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h) • (f (zetaY B.h t Y0 y) • eTh y) else 0

  if corrOn B l0 x t then qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h) •
    cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G D (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y)) else 0

open Classical in

noncomputable def sw5Sf (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (D : WC) : Ext ℝ³ :=

and_nodes.error_message: RETIRED BY REVIEW: SHAPE: children stress5_old_fluct_split (s2) and stress5_incr_fluct_split (s3) are false in substance. InMth5 is theta-pointwise and keeps the fast phase exp(i m kb phiL5) inside. Each Lnorm-normalised derivative costs about kb ~ q^(-h/2): the r-column has no Y-shift, the Y-block JpowL(-coarseIdx) carries no kb, and lamT(vrv)=0. The principal parts q^A tSum5 W0c4 and q^A tSum5 L have non-flat amplitude (PrimNondegAt4; Penv5 is O(1) at the centre), so NB_k ~ q^(h(beta-k/2)) breaks every fixed order. Blueprint rev 1 §7 flagged this exact risk. Six independent informal attempts confirmed it, with numerics in those nodes' scratch/. The sibling wave_increment_mean_orders_v5 hit the same defect and was approved after switching layers. KEEP unchanged: proved simscale_normalized_v4 and mom_class_algebra_v4 (re-cite by name), the DAG edges mom_radial_moment_class_v4 and mom_icut_class_v4, stress5_radial_calculus, stress5_change_identities, stress5_state_grP_class, and the crux stress5_yavg_cancel. Its inputs are phase-free InM classes on dWc5 and on dWc5 0 b - covPr5 L b, so it is unaffected. REPLACE s2, s3, theta5_product_class and stress5_cov_expansion with the phase-free amplitude pairing: DAG edges to wmo_velocity_split_v5, wave_theta_pair_v5, wmo_pair_class_v5 and wmo_amp_class_v5 (statements copied verbatim), plus one restated covariance child that outputs the same two facts the glue needs (hCov: dWc5 in M_{Bo+1/2-kapS}(2A) and Wcov5 S in M_1(2A); hRem: dWc5 0 b - covPr5 L b in M_{Bo+17/25-kapS}(2A)). It gets them from q^{2A} dW = pair(A0,AD)+pair(AD,A0)+pair(AD,AD), with A0 = wmoAmp5 S.Aw in W_{1/2} and AD = wmoAmp5(potW5 L) in W_{Bo-kapS}. The principal cross term is pair(mu liftH5 W0c4, mu liftH5 L) with mu=(q/Qb)^(1/2), and the remainders are at order Bo+17/25-kapS. I would approve that split: same glue from hCov/hRem on, with the crux still in stress5_yavg_cancel. Its blueprint must show explicitly that covPr5 equals the pairing's principal cross term.

    have hlpos : (0:ℝ) < l := by linarith
    have hl1pos : (0:ℝ) < (l:ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    have hlog2 := Real.log_two_gt_d9
    have hTgt4 : (4:ℝ) < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; linarith
    have hlogT4 : Real.log 4 < Real.log Tgc := Real.log_lt_log (by norm_num) hTgt4
    have hlog4 : Real.log 4 = 2 * Real.log 2 := by
      rw [show (4:ℝ) = 2 * 2 by norm_num, Real.log_mul two_ne_zero two_ne_zero]; ring
    have hlogTpos : 0 < Real.log Tgc := by linarith
    have hf : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * x) / x ^ 2) =
        ((1 + B.h) * x * Real.log 2 - 2 * Real.log x) / Real.log Tgc := by
      intro x hx
      rw [Real.logb, Real.log_div (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _).ne' (pow_pos hx 2).ne',
        Real.log_rpow two_pos, Real.log_pow]
      norm_num
    have hd0 : Real.log (l:ℝ) ≤ Real.log ((l:ℝ) + 1) := Real.log_le_log hlpos (by linarith)
    have hd1 : Real.log ((l:ℝ) + 1) - Real.log l ≤ 1/40 := by
      rw [← Real.log_div hl1pos.ne' hlpos.ne']
      have w1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hl1pos hlpos)
      have w2 : ((l:ℝ) + 1) / l - 1 = 1 / l := by
        rw [eq_div_iff hlpos.ne', sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hlpos.ne']; ring
      have w3 : 1 / (l:ℝ) ≤ 1 / 40 := one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) hlR
      linarith
    have key : ((1 + B.h) * ((l:ℝ) + 1) * Real.log 2 - 2 * Real.log ((l:ℝ) + 1)) / Real.log Tgc =
        ((1 + B.h) * (l:ℝ) * Real.log 2 - 2 * Real.log (l:ℝ)) / Real.log Tgc +
        ((1 + B.h) * Real.log 2 - 2 * (Real.log ((l:ℝ) + 1) - Real.log l)) / Real.log Tgc := by
      rw [← add_div]; congr 1; ring
    have hN0 : 0 ≤ (1 + B.h) * Real.log 2 - 2 * (Real.log ((l:ℝ) + 1) - Real.log l) := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hh0.le (show (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 by linarith)]
    have hN1 : (1 + B.h) * Real.log 2 - 2 * (Real.log ((l:ℝ) + 1) - Real.log l) < Real.log Tgc := by
      nlinarith [mul_pos (show (0:ℝ) < 1 - B.h by linarith) (show (0:ℝ) < Real.log 2 by linarith)]
    unfold bandIdx
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    rw [hf ((l:ℝ) + 1) hl1pos, hf (l:ℝ) hlpos, key]
    exact hfl _ _ (div_nonneg hN0 hlogTpos.le) ((div_lt_one hlogTpos).mpr hN1)
  
  have hsmall : ∀ x y ε : ℝ, |x| < ε → |y| < ε →
      |(x - bgc * y) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)| < 2 * ε ∧ |(bgc * x + y) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)| < 2 * ε := by
    intro x y ε hx hy

    constructor

    · rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hDpos]

  have hcl0 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (c Y Y₁ : ℝ × ℝ) (ρ ε : ℝ), 2 * (Lgc ^ n + Tgc ^ n) * ε = ρ →
      |lamR (frac0 (Jpow n Y₁ - c))| ≤ ρ → |lamT (frac0 (Jpow n Y₁ - c))| ≤ ρ →
      |Y.1 - Y₁.1| < ε → |Y.2 - Y₁.2| < ε →
      |lamR (Jpow n Y - c - (((round (Jpow n Y₁ - c).1 : ℤ) : ℝ), ((round (Jpow n Y₁ - c).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)))| ≤ 2 * ρ ∧
      |lamT (Jpow n Y - c - (((round (Jpow n Y₁ - c).1 : ℤ) : ℝ), ((round (Jpow n Y₁ - c).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)))| ≤ 2 * ρ := by

    have hL : 0 < Lgc ^ n := zpow_pos hLpos n
    have hT : 0 < Tgc ^ n := zpow_pos hTpos n
    have hε0 : 0 < ε := lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_nonneg _) hd1
    have iR : lamR (Jpow n Y - c - (((round (Jpow n Y₁ - c).1 : ℤ) : ℝ), ((round (Jpow n Y₁ - c).2 : ℤ) : ℝ))) =
        lamR (frac0 (Jpow n Y₁ - c)) + Lgc ^ n * (((Y.1 - Y₁.1) - bgc * (Y.2 - Y₁.2)) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) := by
      unfold lamR frac0
      simp only [Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub, hJ1, hJ2]

    have iT : lamT (Jpow n Y - c - (((round (Jpow n Y₁ - c).1 : ℤ) : ℝ), ((round (Jpow n Y₁ - c).2 : ℤ) : ℝ))) =
        lamT (frac0 (Jpow n Y₁ - c)) + Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * (Y.1 - Y₁.1) + (Y.2 - Y₁.2)) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) := by
      unfold lamT frac0
      simp only [Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub, hJ1, hJ2]

    obtain ⟨u1, u2⟩ := hsmall _ _ _ hd1 hd2
    have bR : |Lgc ^ n * (((Y.1 - Y₁.1) - bgc * (Y.2 - Y₁.2)) / (1 + bgc ^ 2))| ≤ ρ := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hL]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left u1.le hL.le, mul_nonneg hT.le hε0.le]
    have bT : |Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * (Y.1 - Y₁.1) + (Y.2 - Y₁.2)) / (1 + bgc ^ 2))| ≤ ρ := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hT]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left u2.le hT.le, mul_nonneg hL.le hε0.le]
    constructor
    · rw [iR]; exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith)

  have hclos : ∀ (γ : Lab) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ∀ Y ∈ closure (rectAbs B G γ ρ), ∃ k1 k2 : ℤ,
      |lamR (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y - G.ctr γ - ((k1:ℝ), (k2:ℝ)))| ≤ 2 * ρ ∧

    exact ⟨_, _, hcl0 (bandIdx B.h γ.1) (G.ctr γ) Y Y₁ ρ _ hερ hm.1 hm.2 hd.1 hd.2⟩
  
  have hsame : ∀ (W : ℝ × ℝ) (d d' k1 k2 k1' k2' : ℤ) (σ : ℝ), σ ≤ 4 / 100000 → 0 ≤ d → d ≤ 107 →
      0 ≤ d' → d' ≤ 107 →
      |lamR (W - (((d : ℝ) + 1) / 1000, (0 : ℝ)) - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ)))| ≤ σ →
      |lamT (W - (((d : ℝ) + 1) / 1000, (0 : ℝ)) - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ)))| ≤ σ →
      |lamR (W - (((d' : ℝ) + 1) / 1000, (0 : ℝ)) - ((k1' : ℝ), (k2' : ℝ)))| ≤ σ →
      |lamT (W - (((d' : ℝ) + 1) / 1000, (0 : ℝ)) - ((k1' : ℝ), (k2' : ℝ)))| ≤ σ → d = d' := by

    have u2 : (-1 : ℝ) < ((d' - d + 1000 * (k1' - k1) : ℤ) : ℝ) := by

    have v1 : d' - d + 1000 * (k1' - k1) < 1 := by exact_mod_cast u1
    have v2 : -1 < d' - d + 1000 * (k1' - k1) := by exact_mod_cast u2

  have hadj : ∀ (W : ℝ × ℝ) (d d' k1 k2 k1' k2' : ℤ) (σ : ℝ), σ ≤ 4 / 100000 → 0 ≤ d → d ≤ 107 →
      |lamR (W - (((d : ℝ) + 1) / 1000, (0 : ℝ)) - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ)))| ≤ σ →
      |lamT (W - (((d : ℝ) + 1) / 1000, (0 : ℝ)) - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ)))| ≤ σ →

      |lamT ((3 * W.1 + W.2, W.1 + 5 * W.2) - (((d' : ℝ) + 1) / 1000, (0 : ℝ)) - ((k1' : ℝ), (k2' : ℝ)))| ≤ σ →

    intro W d d' k1 k2 k1' k2' σ hσ hd0 hd1 h1 h2 h3 h4

  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro Y hY hY'

by

    intro B hB

  intro h Xa Xb qB hS hh0 hh1 hXa hXab
  
  have hbump : ∀ u : ℝ, bumpR u ≠ 0 → |u| < 1 := by

  have hsq : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (s : ℝ), sqPart μ j s ≠ 0 → |s / μ - j| < 1 := by

  have hsupp : ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), etaL h γ ξ ≠ 0 →

      |chartR h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1 : ℝ)| < 1 ∧
      |chartZ h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.1 : ℝ)| < 1 ∧

    obtain ⟨h23, h4⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp h234
    obtain ⟨h2, h3⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp h23

  have hlev : ∀ (q : ℝ) (l : ℕ), 0 < q → |Real.logb 2 q + (l : ℝ)| < 1 →

    intro q l hq hl

  have hchart : ∀ (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ.2.2.1 < 1 →

      qC h ξ / Qb l - chartZ h l ξ ^ 2 * (qC h ξ / Qb l) ^ (2 * h) = chartT h l ξ ∧

    have hz := (hS.2.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).2
    change 0 < qC h ξ at hq
    change qC h ξ - ξ.2.1 ^ 2 * qC h ξ ^ (2 * h) = 1 - ξ.2.2.1 at heq
    change ξ.2.1 ^ 2 < qC h ξ ^ (1 - 2 * h) at hz
    have hQ : 0 < Qb l := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
    have hQa : 0 < Qb l ^ (1/2 - h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ _
    have hQa2 : (Qb l ^ (1/2 - h)) ^ 2 = Qb l ^ (1 - 2 * h) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_two, ← Real.rpow_mul hQ.le]; congr 1; ring

    have hqA : 0 < qC h ξ ^ (1 - 2 * h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _

    · unfold chartZ chartT
      rw [div_pow, hQa2, Real.div_rpow hq.le hQ.le, div_mul_div_comm, hAB, ← sub_div, heq]
    · unfold chartZ

      exact div_lt_div_of_pos_right hz hA
    · unfold XC chartR
      rw [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hQ.le]
      field_simp
    · unfold etaC chartZ

    · have e : (qC h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - h))) ^ 2 = (qC h ξ ^ (1 - 2 * h))⁻¹ := by

  have hrpow : ∀ e x y : ℝ, |e| ≤ 1 → 1/2 ≤ x → 1/2 ≤ y → |x ^ e - y ^ e| ≤ 4 * |e| * |x - y| := by
    intro e x y he hx hy
    have hd : ∀ u ∈ Ici (1/2:ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => u ^ e) (e * u ^ (e - 1)) u := by

    have hb : ∀ u ∈ Ici (1/2:ℝ), ‖deriv (fun u : ℝ => u ^ e) u‖ ≤ 4 * |e| := by
      intro u hu
      have hu' : (1/2:ℝ) ≤ u := hu

    have := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le (fun u hu => (hd u hu).differentiableAt) hb
      (convex_Ici (1/2:ℝ)) hy hx
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
  have hrb : ∀ e x : ℝ, |e| ≤ 1 → 1/2 ≤ x → x ≤ 2 → x ^ e ≤ 2 := by
    intro e x he hx1 hx2

    · calc x ^ e ≤ 2 ^ e := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by linarith) hx2 he0
        _ ≤ 2 ^ (1:ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (abs_le.mp he).2
        _ = 2 := Real.rpow_one 2
    · calc x ^ e ≤ (1/2) ^ e := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by norm_num) hx1 he0.le
        _ ≤ (1/2) ^ (-1:ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (abs_le.mp he).1

  have hcore : ∀ (μ Xb ρ ρ0 R R0 Z Z0 T T0 P P0 W W0 X X0 : ℝ), 0 < μ → μ ≤ 1/2 → 0 ≤ Xb →
      1/2 < ρ → ρ < 2 → 1/2 < ρ0 → ρ0 < 2 → 0 ≤ R → 0 ≤ R0 →
      X * (2 * ρ) = R ^ 2 → X0 * (2 * ρ0) = R0 ^ 2 → X0 ≤ Xb →
      Z ^ 2 < 2 → Z0 ^ 2 < 2 → 0 ≤ P0 → P0 ≤ 2 → |P - P0| ≤ 8 * h * |ρ - ρ0| →

      |R - R0| < 2 * μ → |Z - Z0| < 2 * μ → |T - T0| < 2 * μ →
      |X - X0| + |Z * W - Z0 * W0| + |ρ - ρ0| ≤ (100 + 100 * Xb) * μ := by
    intro μ Xb ρ ρ0 R R0 Z Z0 T T0 P P0 W W0 X X0 hμ hμ2 hXb hρ1 hρ2 hρ01 hρ02 hR hR0 hX hX0 hX0b
      hZ2 hZ02 hP0 hP0le hP hW hWle hWW hT hT0 hRd hZd hTd
    have hZ : |Z| < 3/2 := by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> nlinarith
    have hZ0 : |Z0| < 3/2 := by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> nlinarith
    have hZZ : |Z + Z0| < 3 := lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_add_le _ _) (by linarith)
    have hDn : 0 ≤ |ρ - ρ0| := abs_nonneg _
    have e1 : ρ - ρ0 = (T - T0) + Z ^ 2 * (P - P0) + (Z - Z0) * (Z + Z0) * P0 := by
      linear_combination hT - hT0
    have b1 : |Z ^ 2 * (P - P0)| ≤ 16 * h * |ρ - ρ0| := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg Z)]
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hZ2.le (abs_nonneg (P - P0))
      linarith
    have b2 : |(Z - Z0) * (Z + Z0) * P0| ≤ 12 * μ := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hP0]

      linarith
    have hD : |ρ - ρ0| ≤ 17 * μ := by
      have h1 : |ρ - ρ0| ≤ |T - T0| + |Z ^ 2 * (P - P0)| + |(Z - Z0) * (Z + Z0) * P0| := by
        rw [e1]; exact abs_add_three _ _ _
      have h2 : h * |ρ - ρ0| ≤ 1/100 * |ρ - ρ0| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh1.le hDn
      linarith
    have hZW : |Z * W - Z0 * W0| ≤ 55 * μ := by
      have e2 : Z * W - Z0 * W0 = (Z - Z0) * W + Z0 * (W - W0) := by ring
      rw [e2]
      refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hW]
      have h1 : |Z - Z0| * W ≤ 2 * μ * 2 := mul_le_mul hZd.le hWle hW (by linarith)
      have h2 : |Z0| * |W - W0| ≤ 3/2 * (2 * |ρ - ρ0|) :=
        mul_le_mul hZ0.le hWW (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      linarith
    have hX0n : 0 ≤ X0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg R0]
    have h1Xb : 0 ≤ 1 + Xb := by linarith
    have hR0sq : R0 ^ 2 ≤ (1 + Xb) ^ 2 := by

      linarith
    have hRR : R + R0 ≤ 3 + 2 * Xb := by

      linear_combination hX - hX0
    have hXX : |X - X0| ≤ 2 * μ * (3 + 2 * Xb) + 34 * Xb * μ := by
      have h0 : |X - X0| * (2 * ρ) = |2 * ρ * (X - X0)| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * ρ)]; ring
      have h3 : |2 * X0 * (ρ0 - ρ)| = 2 * X0 * |ρ - ρ0| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ 2 * X0), abs_sub_comm ρ0 ρ]
      have h1 : |X - X0| * (2 * ρ) ≤ |R ^ 2 - R0 ^ 2| + 2 * X0 * |ρ - ρ0| := by
        rw [h0, key, ← h3]; exact abs_add_le _ _

        mul_le_mul (by linarith) hD hDn (by linarith)
      have h4 : |X - X0| * 1 ≤ |X - X0| * (2 * ρ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (abs_nonneg _)
      linarith
    have h5 : 0 ≤ Xb * μ := mul_nonneg hXb hμ.le
    linarith
  
  have hd : 0 < Xb - Xa := by linarith
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (2 / (Xb - Xa))
  have hN2 : 2 < (N:ℝ) * (Xb - Xa) := by rwa [div_lt_iff₀ hd] at hN
  refine ⟨max 40 N, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro γ hγ hex
  obtain ⟨ξ₀, hξ₀D, hη₀, hX₀a, hX₀b⟩ := hex
  have hl40 : (40:ℝ) ≤ (γ.1:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast le_trans (le_max_left 40 N) hγ
  have hlN : (N:ℝ) ≤ (γ.1:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast le_trans (le_max_right 40 N) hγ
  have hsuppγ := hsupp γ
  have hμe : Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) = ((γ.1:ℝ) ^ 6)⁻¹ := by
    unfold Sb; rw [zpow_neg, show (3:ℤ) = ((3:ℕ):ℤ) by rfl, zpow_natCast, ← pow_mul]
  set μ := Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) with hμdef

  have hμpos : 0 < μ := by rw [hμe]; positivity
  have hμl : μ * (γ.1:ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    calc μ * (γ.1:ℝ) ≤ μ * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 6 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl6 hμpos.le

  have hμ40 : μ ≤ 1/40 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl40 hμpos.le; linarith
  have hμgap : 2 * μ < Xb - Xa := by
    have a1 : μ * 2 < μ * ((N:ℝ) * (Xb - Xa)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hN2 hμpos
    have a2 : μ * (N:ℝ) ≤ 1 := le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlN hμpos.le) hμl
    have a3 : (μ * (N:ℝ)) * (Xb - Xa) ≤ 1 * (Xb - Xa) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right a2 hd.le
    have a4 : μ * ((N:ℝ) * (Xb - Xa)) = (μ * (N:ℝ)) * (Xb - Xa) := by ring
    linarith

  have hclamp : ∀ lo hi x : ℝ, lo ≤ hi → lo - μ ≤ x → x ≤ hi + μ → |x - max lo (min x hi)| ≤ μ := by
    intro lo hi x h1 h2 h3

  have hbox : ∀ a b j : ℝ, |a / μ - j| < 1 → |b / μ - j| < 1 → |a - b| < 2 * μ := by

    have e : a - b = μ * (a / μ - b / μ) := by field_simp

  obtain ⟨hr₀, ht₀, -⟩ := hξ₀D
  obtain ⟨hq₀, hT₀, hZ₀2, hX₀, hE₀, hE₀1⟩ := hchart γ.1 ξ₀ ht₀
  obtain ⟨hL₀, hR₀s, hZ₀s, hT₀s⟩ := hsuppγ ξ₀ hη₀

  have hc1b : c1 ≤ Xb - μ := by rw [hc1]; exact max_le (by linarith) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hc1d : |XC h ξ₀ - c1| ≤ μ := by

  have hc2a : -(1 - μ) ≤ c2 := by rw [hc2]; exact le_max_left _ _

    have := abs_lt.mp hE₀1
    rw [hc2]; exact hclamp _ _ _ (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨(c1, c2, qC h ξ₀ / Qb γ.1), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show Xa < c1; linarith
  · show c1 < Xb; linarith
  · show |c2| ≤ 1 - μ; exact abs_le.mpr ⟨hc2a, hc2b⟩

  show |XC h ξ - c1| + |etaC h ξ - c2| + |qC h ξ / Qb γ.1 - qC h ξ₀ / Qb γ.1| ≤ 600 * (1 + Xb) * μ

  obtain ⟨hρ1, hρ2⟩ := hlev _ _ hq hL

  set ρ := qC h ξ / Qb γ.1 with hρdef
  set ρ0 := qC h ξ₀ / Qb γ.1 with hρ0def
  have he1 : |1 - 2 * h| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have he2 : |2 * h| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

  have hWW : |ρ ^ (-(1/2 - h)) - ρ0 ^ (-(1/2 - h))| ≤ 2 * |ρ - ρ0| := by

          hrpow _ _ _ he3 hρ1.le hρ₀1.le

  have hcr := hcore μ Xb ρ ρ0 (chartR h γ.1 ξ) (chartR h γ.1 ξ₀) (chartZ h γ.1 ξ) (chartZ h γ.1 ξ₀)

  have t2 : |etaC h ξ - c2| ≤ |etaC h ξ - etaC h ξ₀| + |etaC h ξ₀ - c2| := abs_sub_le _ _ _
  have t3 : 0 ≤ Xb * μ := mul_nonneg hXb0 hμpos.le
  linarith

  have hQ : 0 < Qb γ.1 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _

  have hbgc1 : bgc < 1 := by unfold bgc; nlinarith

    · exact one_ne_zero
    · exact h
  have hpang : pang5 B G γ ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero (Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hpint) hkb.ne'
  have hlamR : ∀ a : ℝ, lamT (a • vrv) = 0 := by

  have hlamV : ∀ a : ℝ, lamT (a • vtv) = a := by

  have hRC : ∀ s ∈ Ω, pcRC5 γ.1 s ≠ 0 := fun s hs => div_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hs.1) hsQ.ne'

  have hP2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) Ω := (contDiffOn_const.mul hFa).add (contDiffOn_const.mul (hb 2))
  have hD : ∀ f : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → ∀ e : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,

  have hPs : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s => pcPsi5 B G γ s i) Ω := by

  have hKm : ∀ k j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s => pcKm5 B γ.1 s k j) Ω := by

    | exact (contDiffOn_const : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (0:ℝ)) Ω)

        (fun s => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcB5 B γ.1 2) s ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) Ω)
  have hN1 : ∀ s v, pcN5 B G γ s v 1 = pang5 B G γ / pcRC5 γ.1 s := by

  let Mf : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ := fun s v => pcM5 B G γ s v
  have hMs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => Mf w.1 w.2) (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ) := by

    have hPw : ∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => pcPsi5 B G γ w.1 k) (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ) :=

    have hdot : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ =>
        dotProduct (pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2) (pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2)) (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
      show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ =>
        ∑ k, pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2 k * pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2 k) (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ)
      exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun k _ => (hNw k).mul (hNw k))
    have hne : ∀ w ∈ Ω ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ),
        dotProduct (pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2) (pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2) ≠ 0 := by
      intro w hw
      have h1 : pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2 1 ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hN1]; exact div_ne_zero hpang (hRC _ hw.1)
      have q1 := mul_self_pos.2 h1
      have q0 := mul_self_nonneg (pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2 0)
      have q2 := mul_self_nonneg (pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2 2)

    have hinv := hdot.inv hne

    have hdK : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ =>
        dotProduct (pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2) (fun k => pcKm5 B γ.1 w.1 k j)) (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ) := by

        ∑ k, pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2 k * pcKm5 B γ.1 w.1 k j) (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ)
      exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun k _ => (hNw k).mul (hKw k j))

        (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i j) (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ)
    exact (((hKw i j).neg).add (hinv.mul ((hNw i).mul (hdK.sub (hPw j).neg)))).sub

  have hZs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcZ0_5 B G γ) Ω := by
    have hN0 : ∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s => pcN5 B G γ s 0 k) Ω :=

    have hpos : ∀ s ∈ Ω, 0 < pcN5 B G γ s 0 1 ^ 2 + pcN5 B G γ s 0 2 ^ 2 := by

  have hfrac : ∀ f : ℝ × ℝ, |lamR f| ≤ G.r0 → |lamT f| ≤ G.r0 → |f.1| < 1/2 ∧ |f.2| < 1/2 := by

    have e2 : -bgc * lamR f + lamT f = f.2 := by

    obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_le.mp h1
    obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := abs_le.mp h2
    have k1 := mul_nonneg hbgc0.le (sub_nonneg.2 a2)

  have hs1 : ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) G.r0 Y → ∃ (U : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (C : ℝ), IsOpen U ∧ Y ∈ U ∧

    obtain ⟨hf1, hf2⟩ := hfrac _ hR.1 hR.2
    refine ⟨{Y' | |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).1 -

        ((G.ctr γ).2 + ((round (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y - G.ctr γ).2 : ℤ) : ℝ))) / (1 + bgc ^ 2),
      ?_, (show _ ∧ _ from ⟨hf1, hf2⟩), ?_⟩
    · have hJ : Continuous (fun Y' : ℝ × ℝ => Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ) := by

    · rintro Y' ⟨h1, h2⟩
      have r1 : round (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).1 = round (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y - G.ctr γ).1 := by
        rw [round_eq, Int.floor_eq_iff]; obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := abs_lt.mp h1; constructor <;> linarith
      have r2 : round (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).2 = round (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y - G.ctr γ).2 := by
        rw [round_eq, Int.floor_eq_iff]; obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := abs_lt.mp h2; constructor <;> linarith

      simp only [Jpow, lamT, vrv, vtv, Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add,

  let sl : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ × ℝ :=

  have hslA : ∀ η : Cyl, HasFDerivAt (fun x : Cyl => (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1)) sl η := fun η => sl.hasFDerivAt
  let lT : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    (1 + bgc ^ 2)⁻¹ • (bgc • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ + ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)
  let Yp : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ := (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))
  let VL : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ := (Tgc ^ bandIdx B.h γ.1 / cib B.h γ.1) • (lT.comp Yp)

  have hcomp : ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (η : Cyl), (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ∈ Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω →

        fderiv ℝ f (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) (d.1, d.2.1, d.2.2.1) := by
    intro f η hη h1 d
    have d1 := ((h1.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hη)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have h' : HasFDerivAt (fun η' : Cyl => f (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1)) _ η := d1.comp η (hslA η)
