  refine ⟨Mf, pcZ0_5 B G γ, hMs, hZs, ?_⟩
  intro ξ hξ hR
  have hs : (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ∈ Ω := hξ
  obtain ⟨U, C, hU, hYU, hUv⟩ := hs1 ξ.2.2.2 hR
  have hV : ∀ η : Cyl, η.2.2.2 ∈ U → vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 = VL η + C / cib B.h γ.1 := by
    intro η h; rw [hUv _ h, hVL]; ring
  have tmpl : ∀ (f1 f2 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (η : Cyl), (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ∈ Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f1 Ω →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f2 Ω → ∀ d : Cyl,
      fderiv ℝ (fun η' : Cyl => f1 (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1) - (VL η' + C / cib B.h γ.1) *
          f2 (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1)) η d =
        fderiv ℝ f1 (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) (d.1, d.2.1, d.2.2.1) - ((VL η + C / cib B.h γ.1) *
          fderiv ℝ f2 (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) (d.1, d.2.1, d.2.2.1) + f2 (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) * VL d) := by
    intro f1 f2 η hη h1 h2 d
    have d1 := ((h1.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hη)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have d2 := ((h2.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hη)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have h' : HasFDerivAt (fun η' : Cyl => f1 (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1) - (VL η' + C / cib B.h γ.1) *
          f2 (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1)) _ η :=
      (d1.comp η (hslA η)).sub ((VL.hasFDerivAt.add_const (C / cib B.h γ.1)).mul (d2.comp η (hslA η)))
    rw [h'.fderiv]
    rfl
  have hWo : ∀ η : Cyl, (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ∈ Ω → η.2.2.2 ∈ U →
      {η' : Cyl | (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1) ∈ Ω ∧ η'.2.2.2 ∈ U} ∈ nhds η := by
    intro η hη hηU
    refine IsOpen.mem_nhds ?_ ⟨hη, hηU⟩
    exact (hΩ.preimage (show Continuous (fun η : Cyl => (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1)) by fun_prop)).inter
      (hU.preimage (show Continuous (fun η : Cyl => η.2.2.2) by fun_prop))
  
  have hN : ∀ η : Cyl, (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ∈ Ω → η.2.2.2 ∈ U →
      nPhi5 B G γ η = pcN5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2) := by
    intro η hη hηU
    have hev : phiL5 B G γ =ᶠ[nhds η] (fun η' : Cyl => pcPhi1_5 B G γ (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1) -
        (VL η' + C / cib B.h γ.1) * pcPhi2_5 B G γ (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hWo η hη hηU) (fun η' hη' => by
        show pcPhi1_5 B G γ (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1) - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η'.2.2.2 *
          pcPhi2_5 B G γ (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1) = _
        rw [hV η' hη'.2])
    have hfd := hev.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ)
    have hv := hV η hηU
    have hVR : VL (1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) = 0 := by
      rw [hVL]; show _ * lamT (_ • vrv) = 0; rw [hlamR, mul_zero]
    have hVZ : VL (0, 1, 0, 0) = 0 := by
      rw [hVL]; show _ * lamT (0 : ℝ × ℝ) = 0; simp [lamT]
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · show Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) η (1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) =
        Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi1_5 B G γ) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) -
          vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 *
            (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))
      rw [hfd, tmpl _ _ η hη hP1on hP2, hVR, hv]
      dsimp only
      ring
    · show pang5 B G γ / pcRC5 γ.1 (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) =
        pang5 B G γ / pcRC5 γ.1 (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 * 0
      ring
    · show Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) η (0, 1, 0, 0) =
        Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi1_5 B G γ) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) -
          vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 *
            (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))
      rw [hfd, tmpl _ _ η hη hP1on hP2, hVZ, hv]
      dsimp only
      ring
  
  have hNP : nPhiP5 B G γ ξ = -pcPsi5 B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) := by
    funext i
    have hev : (fun η => nPhi5 B G γ η i) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] (fun η' : Cyl => pcA5 B G γ (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1) i -
        (VL η' + C / cib B.h γ.1) * pcPsi5 B G γ (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1) i) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hWo ξ hs hYU) (fun η' hη' => by
        show nPhi5 B G γ η' i = _
        rw [hN η' hη'.1 hη'.2, hV η' hη'.2]; rfl)
    have hVd : VL (dVdir B.h γ.1) = 1 := by
      rw [hVL]
      show Tgc ^ bandIdx B.h γ.1 / cib B.h γ.1 *
        lamT ((cib B.h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1))) • vtv) = 1
      rw [hlamV, zpow_neg]
      have e : Tgc ^ bandIdx B.h γ.1 / cib B.h γ.1 * (cib B.h γ.1 * (Tgc ^ bandIdx B.h γ.1)⁻¹) =
          (Tgc ^ bandIdx B.h γ.1 * (Tgc ^ bandIdx B.h γ.1)⁻¹) * (cib B.h γ.1 / cib B.h γ.1) := by ring
      rw [e, mul_inv_cancel₀ (zpow_ne_zero _ hT.ne'), div_self hci.ne', mul_one]
    have hd0 : ((dVdir B.h γ.1).1, (dVdir B.h γ.1).2.1, (dVdir B.h γ.1).2.2.1) = (0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) := rfl
    show fderiv ℝ (fun η => nPhi5 B G γ η i) ξ (dVdir B.h γ.1) = -pcPsi5 B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) i
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, tmpl (fun s => pcA5 B G γ s i) (fun s => pcPsi5 B G γ s i) ξ hs (hA i) (hPs i),
      hVd, hd0, map_zero, map_zero]
    ring
  
  have hK : Kmat B G γ ξ = pcKm5 B γ.1 (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) := by
    have e1 : DrC B γ.1 (Fang B γ.1) ξ = Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) *
        fderiv ℝ (pcFa5 B γ.1) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) :=
      congrArg (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * ·) (hcomp (pcFa5 B γ.1) ξ hs hFa (1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv))
    have e2 : DrC B γ.1 (fun η => baseC B γ.1 η 2) ξ = Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) *
        fderiv ℝ (pcB5 B γ.1 2) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) :=
      congrArg (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * ·) (hcomp (pcB5 B γ.1 2) ξ hs (hb 2) (1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv))
    unfold Kmat
    rw [e1, e2]
    rfl
  have hNξ := hN ξ hs hYU
  refine ⟨fun z => ?_, fun hv => ?_⟩
  · have hM : pcM5 B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) =
        APhi5 B G γ ξ - dDamp5 B G γ ξ • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) := by
      unfold pcM5 APhi5 dDamp5
      rw [hNξ, hNP, hK]
    show (pcM5 B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)).mulVec z = _
    rw [hM, Matrix.sub_mulVec]
    first
    | rw [Matrix.smul_mulVec_assoc, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    | rw [Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    | simp
  · rw [hv] at hNξ
    simp only [Bcol5, ntan5, hNξ, hv] <;> rfl

geom_pulse_coeff_v5.definitions:
noncomputable def pcB5 (B : BG) (l : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) (s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  baseC B l (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) i
noncomputable def pcRC5 (l : ℕ) (s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := s.1 / Real.sqrt (Qb l)
noncomputable def pcFa5 (B : BG) (l : ℕ) (s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := pcB5 B l 1 s / pcRC5 l s
noncomputable def pcPhi1_5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  pzr5 B G γ * (s.2.1 / Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2 - B.h)) / epsb B.h γ.1 + sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 * pcRC5 γ.1 s
noncomputable def pcPhi2_5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  pang5 B G γ * pcFa5 B γ.1 s + pzr5 B G γ * pcB5 B γ.1 2 s
noncomputable def pcA5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  ![Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi1_5 B G γ) s ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)), pang5 B G γ / pcRC5 γ.1 s,
    Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi1_5 B G γ) s ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))]
noncomputable def pcPsi5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  ![Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) s ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)), 0,
    Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) s ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))]
noncomputable def pcN5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (v : ℝ) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  fun i => pcA5 B G γ s i - v * pcPsi5 B G γ s i
noncomputable def pcKm5 (B : BG) (l : ℕ) (s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  !![0, -2 * pcFa5 B l s, 0;
     2 * pcFa5 B l s + pcRC5 l s * (Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ (pcFa5 B l) s ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))), 0, 0;
     Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ (pcB5 B l 2) s ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)), 0, 0]
noncomputable def pcM5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (v : ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  -pcKm5 B γ.1 s + (dotProduct (pcN5 B G γ s v) (pcN5 B G γ s v))⁻¹ •
    Matrix.vecMulVec (pcN5 B G γ s v) (Matrix.vecMul (pcN5 B G γ s v) (pcKm5 B γ.1 s) - -pcPsi5 B G γ s)
  - (epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ))^2 * dotProduct (pcN5 B G γ s v) (pcN5 B G γ s v)) •
      (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
noncomputable def pcNt5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (pcN5 B G γ s 0 1 ^ 2 + pcN5 B G γ s 0 2 ^ 2)
noncomputable def pcKa5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  ![0, pcN5 B G γ s 0 1 / pcNt5 B G γ s, pcN5 B G γ s 0 2 / pcNt5 B G γ s]
noncomputable def pcZ0_5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  Penv5 B G γ 0 • ((![1, 0, 0] - (pcN5 B G γ s 0 0 / pcNt5 B G γ s) • pcKa5 B G γ s) +
    (1 * c0f5 B G γ * Real.sqrt (1 + sco B G γ 0 ^ 2)) • ![0, pcKa5 B G γ s 2, -(pcKa5 B G γ s 1)])

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (U : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (M : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (z0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → Fin 3 → ℝ), IsOpen U →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => M w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ z0 U →
    ∃ z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → Fin 3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => z w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) ∧
      ∀ s ∈ U, z s 0 = z0 s ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (z s) (Matrix.mulVec (M s v) (z s v)) v

signature.name: linear_ode_param_smooth_v5
signature.statement:
∀ (U : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (M : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (z0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → Fin 3 → ℝ), IsOpen U →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => M w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ z0 U →
    ∃ z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → Fin 3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => z w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) ∧
      ∀ s ∈ U, z s 0 = z0 s ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (z s) (Matrix.mulVec (M s v) (z s v)) v

proof.tactics:
by
  intro U M z0 hU hM hz0
  have hO : IsOpen (U ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) := hU.prod isOpen_univ
  have Q : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
      (A : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (b : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → E) (y0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → E)
      (z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → E),
      ContDiffOn ℝ k A (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ k b (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ k y0 U →
      (∀ s ∈ U, z s 0 = y0 s ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (z s) (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v)) v) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => z w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro E _ _ _ A b y0 z hA hb hy0 hsol
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, contDiffOn_zero] at hA hb hy0 ⊢
      exact linear_ode_param_continuous E U A b y0 z hU hA hb hy0 hsol
    | succ k ih =>
      intro E _ _ _ A b y0 z hA hb hy0 hsol
      rw [Nat.cast_succ] at hA hb hy0 ⊢
      have hle : (k : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 := le_self_add
      have h1le : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 := le_add_self
      
      have hz : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => z w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
        ih E A b y0 z (hA.of_le hle) (hb.of_le hle) (hy0.of_le hle) hsol
      
      obtain ⟨A', hA'eq⟩ : ∃ A' : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] E) →L[ℝ] ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] E),
          ∀ w, A' w = ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) E E (A w) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨b', hb'eq⟩ : ∃ b' : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] E),
          ∀ w, b' w = (fderiv ℝ A w ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ).flip (z w.1 w.2) +
            fderiv ℝ b w ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
      have hA' : ContDiffOn ℝ k A' (U ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
        rw [contDiffOn_clm_apply]
        intro V
        refine ((hA.of_le hle).clm_comp (contDiffOn_const (c := V))).congr (fun w _ => ?_)
        rw [hA'eq]
        rfl
      have hb' : ContDiffOn ℝ k b' (U ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
        have hdA : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun w => fderiv ℝ A w) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) := hA.fderiv_of_isOpen hO le_rfl
        have hdb : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun w => fderiv ℝ b w) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) := hb.fderiv_of_isOpen hO le_rfl
        have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun w => fderiv ℝ A w ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ)
            (U ×ˢ Set.univ) := hdA.clm_comp contDiffOn_const
        have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun w => fderiv ℝ b w ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ)
            (U ×ˢ Set.univ) := hdb.clm_comp contDiffOn_const
        rw [contDiffOn_clm_apply]
        intro p
        have h3 := ((h1.clm_apply (contDiffOn_const (c := p))).clm_apply hz).add
          (h2.clm_apply (contDiffOn_const (c := p)))
        refine h3.congr (fun w _ => ?_)
        rw [hb'eq]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]
      
      have hW_ex : ∀ s, ∃ Ws : ℝ → ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] E), s ∈ U →
          (Ws 0 = fderiv ℝ y0 s ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt Ws (A' (s, v) (Ws v) + b' (s, v)) v) := by
        intro s
        by_cases hs : s ∈ U
        · have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => ((s, t) : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ)) :=
            continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id
          have hmem : ∀ t : ℝ, ((s, t) : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) ∈ U ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) :=
            fun t => ⟨hs, Set.mem_univ _⟩
          obtain ⟨y, hy0, hy⟩ := linear_ode_global_exists ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] E) (fun t => A' (s, t))
            (fun t => b' (s, t)) (fderiv ℝ y0 s) (hA'.continuousOn.comp_continuous hc hmem)
            (hb'.continuousOn.comp_continuous hc hmem)
          exact ⟨y, fun _ => ⟨hy0, hy⟩⟩
        · exact ⟨0, fun h => absurd h hs⟩
      choose W hW using hW_ex
      
      have hdy0 : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun s => fderiv ℝ y0 s) U := hy0.fderiv_of_isOpen hU le_rfl
      have hWc : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => W w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
        ih ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] E) A' b' (fun s => fderiv ℝ y0 s) W hA' hb' hdy0 (fun s hs => hW s hs)
      
      have hWsol : ∀ s ∈ U, W s 0 = fderiv ℝ y0 s ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (W s)
          ((A (s, v)).comp (W s v) + (fderiv ℝ A (s, v) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ).flip (z s v)
            + fderiv ℝ b (s, v) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) v := by
        intro s hs
        refine ⟨(hW s hs).1, fun v => ?_⟩
        have h := (hW s hs).2 v
        rw [hA'eq, hb'eq, ← add_assoc] at h
        exact h
      
      have hD : ∀ w ∈ U ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), HasFDerivAt (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => z w.1 w.2)
          ((W w.1 w.2).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) +
            (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ).smulRight (A w (z w.1 w.2) + b w)) w := by
        rintro ⟨s, v⟩ ⟨hs, -⟩
        exact linear_ode_param_hasFDerivAt E U A b y0 z W hU (hA.of_le h1le) (hb.of_le h1le)
          (hy0.of_le h1le) hz.continuousOn hWc.continuousOn hsol hWsol s hs v
      
      have hDk : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ =>
          (W w.1 w.2).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) +
            (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ).smulRight (A w (z w.1 w.2) + b w)) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
        (hWc.clm_comp contDiffOn_const).add

subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 →

      InS B qs γ K)

          (∀ η, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 → etaL h γ η = 0) → |φ ξ / μ - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
        intro μ j φ hφ himp
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have hev := s1 μ j φ hφ hc
        apply (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mpr _) hγ
        filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
        exact himp η hη
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have := key 1 (-(γ.1:ℤ)) (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) hLc
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul])
        simpa [div_one, sub_neg_eq_add] using this
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.1 (chartR h γ.1) (by unfold chartR; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.1 (chartZ h γ.1) (by unfold chartZ; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.2 (chartT h γ.1) (by unfold chartT; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
    have hI : ∀ (c : ℝ) (j : ℤ), |c - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 → j ∈ Set.Icc ⌈c - 1⌉ ⌊c + 1⌋ := by
      intro c j hj
      rw [abs_le] at hj
      exact ⟨Int.ceil_le.mpr (by linarith [hj.2]), Int.le_floor.mpr (by linarith [hj.1])⟩
    have hfin : (⋃ n ∈ Set.Iic ⌊1 - Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ)⌋₊, ({n} : Set ℕ) ×ˢ
        ((Set.Icc ⌈chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 1⌉ ⌊chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 1⌋ ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ⌈chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 1⌉ ⌊chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 1⌋ ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ⌈chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 1⌉ ⌊chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 1⌋) ×ˢ
          (Set.univ : Set Bool))).Finite := by
      refine Set.Finite.biUnion (Set.finite_Iic _) (fun n _ => ?_)
      exact (Set.finite_singleton n).prod (((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod
        ((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod (Set.finite_Icc _ _))).prod Set.finite_univ)
    refine hfin.subset ?_
    rintro ⟨n, ⟨a, b, c⟩, σ⟩ hγ
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hwin _ hγ
    rw [abs_le] at h1
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨n, Nat.le_floor (by simp only at h1; linarith [h1.2]), ?_⟩
    exact ⟨rfl, ⟨hI _ _ h2, hI _ _ h3, hI _ _ h4⟩, trivial⟩
  
  have hsubV : ∀ (f g : WC) (a b : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) a f → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) b g →
      ∀ (θ : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) →
        waveV5 B G (g - f) θ ξ = waveV5 B G g θ ξ - waveV5 B G f θ ξ := by
    intro f g a b hf hg θ ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨⟨Hf, -, hHf⟩, -, -, uf, -⟩ := hf
    obtain ⟨⟨Hg, -, hHg⟩, -, -, ug, -⟩ := hg
    have hξ1 : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2.1
    have hΓ := hΓfin B.h ξ hok.1 hξ1
    funext i
    simp only [waveV5, Pi.sub_apply]
    rw [← Complex.sub_re]
    congr 1
    have hin : ∀ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, (g γ m ξ i - f γ m ξ i) * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ =
        ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, g γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ - ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, f γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ := by
      intro γ
      simp_rw [sub_mul]
      apply finsum_sub_distrib
      · refine Set.Finite.subset (Finset.finite_toSet Hg) ?_
        intro m hm
        by_contra hc
        rw [Function.mem_support] at hm
        apply hm
        rw [hHg γ m hc]
        simp
      · refine Set.Finite.subset (Finset.finite_toSet Hf) ?_
        intro m hm
        by_contra hc
        rw [Function.mem_support] at hm
        apply hm
        rw [hHf γ m hc]
        simp
    rw [finsum_congr hin]
    apply finsum_sub_distrib
    · refine Set.Finite.subset hΓ ?_
      intro γ hγ
      by_contra hc
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hγ
      apply hγ
      apply finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
      intro m
      have h0 : g γ m ξ = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hc (ug γ m ξ hξ hne).2.1
      rw [h0]
      simp
    · refine Set.Finite.subset hΓ ?_
      intro γ hγ
      by_contra hc
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hγ
      apply hγ
      apply finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
      intro m
      have h0 : f γ m ξ = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hc (uf γ m ξ hξ hne).2.1
      rw [h0]
      simp
  
  have hsubS : ∀ (f g : WS) (a b : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) a f → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) b g →
      ∀ (θ : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) →
        waveS5 B G (g - f) θ ξ = waveS5 B G g θ ξ - waveS5 B G f θ ξ := by
    intro f g a b hf hg θ ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨⟨Hf, -, hHf⟩, -, -, uf, -⟩ := hf
    obtain ⟨⟨Hg, -, hHg⟩, -, -, ug, -⟩ := hg
    have hξ1 : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2.1
    have hΓ := hΓfin B.h ξ hok.1 hξ1
    simp only [waveS5, Pi.sub_apply]
    rw [← Complex.sub_re]
    congr 1
    have hin : ∀ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, (g γ m ξ - f γ m ξ) * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ =
        ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, g γ m ξ * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ - ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, f γ m ξ * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ := by
      intro γ
      simp_rw [sub_mul]
      apply finsum_sub_distrib
      · refine Set.Finite.subset (Finset.finite_toSet Hg) ?_
        intro m hm
        by_contra hc
        rw [Function.mem_support] at hm
        apply hm
        rw [hHg γ m hc]
        simp
      · refine Set.Finite.subset (Finset.finite_toSet Hf) ?_
        intro m hm
        by_contra hc
        rw [Function.mem_support] at hm
        apply hm
        rw [hHf γ m hc]
        simp
    rw [finsum_congr hin]
    apply finsum_sub_distrib
    · refine Set.Finite.subset hΓ ?_
      intro γ hγ
      by_contra hc
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hγ
      apply hγ
      apply finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
      intro m
      have h0 : g γ m ξ = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hc (ug γ m ξ hξ hne).2.1
      rw [h0]
      simp
    · refine Set.Finite.subset hΓ ?_
      intro γ hγ
      by_contra hc
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hγ
      apply hγ
      apply finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
      intro m
      have h0 : f γ m ξ = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hc (uf γ m ξ hξ hne).2.1
      rw [h0]
      simp
  have hqpos : ∀ x t, corrOn B l0 x t → 0 < qC B.h (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + 0)) := by
    intro x t hc
    have ht : t < 1 := hc.2.1
    exact (hok.1.1 (x 2) (1 - t) (by linarith)).1
  refine ⟨funext fun z => ?_, funext fun z => ?_, funext fun z => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, t⟩ := z
    show AX5 B G l0 S' x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + 0) - AX5 B G l0 S x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + 0) =
      ipb5WV B G l0 (1/2 - Aex B.h) (S'.Aw - S.Aw) (x, t) + ipb5MV B l0 (1/2 - Aex B.h) (S'.Psi - S.Psi) (x, t)
    by_cases hc : corrOn B l0 x t
    · have hW := hsubV S.Aw S'.Aw α β hSA hS'A (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + 0)) hc
      simp only [add_zero] at hW
      simp only [AX5, ipb5WV, ipb5MV, if_pos hc, add_zero, hW]
      simp only [cyl2cart, Pi.sub_apply, sub_smul, smul_add, smul_sub, mul_sub, mul_smul]
      abel
    · simp only [AX5, ipb5WV, ipb5MV, if_neg hc, add_zero, sub_self]
  · obtain ⟨x, t⟩ := z
    show BX B G l0 S' x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + 0) - BX B G l0 S x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + 0) =
      ipb5MV B l0 (-Aex B.h) (S'.bdir - S.bdir) (x, t)
    by_cases hc : corrOn B l0 x t
    · simp only [BX, ipb5MV, if_pos hc, add_zero, Pi.sub_apply, mul_sub, sub_smul]
      abel
    · simp only [BX, ipb5MV, if_neg hc, add_zero, sub_self]
  · obtain ⟨x, t⟩ := z
    show PX5 B G l0 S' x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + 0) - PX5 B G l0 S x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + 0) =
      ipb5MS B l0 (-2 * Aex B.h) (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (fun ξ => pmP5 B G l0 S' ξ - pmP5 B G l0 S ξ)) (x, t) +
        ipb5WS B G l0 (-2 * Aex B.h) (S'.pw - S.pw) (x, t)
    by_cases hc : corrOn B l0 x t
    · have hW := hsubS S.pw S'.pw α β hSp hS'p (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + 0)) hc
      have hq0 := hqpos x t hc
      have hqq : qC B.h (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + 0)) ^ (-2 * Aex B.h) *
          qC B.h (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + 0)) ^ (2 * Aex B.h) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hq0, show -2 * Aex B.h + 2 * Aex B.h = 0 by ring, Real.rpow_zero]
      simp only [add_zero] at hW hqq
      simp only [PX5, ipb5MS, ipb5WS, nrm, if_pos hc, add_zero, hW]
      linear_combination (pmP5 B G l0 S (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t)) -
        pmP5 B G l0 S' (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t))) * hqq
    · simp only [PX5, ipb5MS, ipb5WS, if_neg hc, add_zero, sub_self]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (l0 : ℕ) (e : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa → f ξ = 0) → ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) → divergence (fun y => ipb5MV B l0 e f (y, t)) x = 0 ∧ inner ℝ x (ipb5MV B l0 e f (x, t)) = (0:ℝ) ∧ ipb5MV B l0 e f (x, t) 2 = 0

signature.name: ipb5_azimuthal_div
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (l0 : ℕ) (e : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa → f ξ = 0) → ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) → divergence (fun y => ipb5MV B l0 e f (y, t)) x = 0 ∧ inner ℝ x (ipb5MV B l0 e f (x, t)) = (0:ℝ) ∧ ipb5MV B l0 e f (x, t) 2 = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B l0 e f hok hf hvan x t hxt
  classical
  have hxt' : t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hxt
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  have hτ : 0 < 1 - t := by linarith [hxt'.1]
  
  have swirl : ∀ (G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (φ : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³), (∀ y, φ y = G (rad y, y 2)) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ φ x →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => φ y • azVec y) x ∧ divergence (fun y => φ y • azVec y) x = 0 := by
    intro G φ x hG hφ
    set L : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
      (-(EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) +
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))
      with hLdef
    have hL : (⇑L : ℝ³ → ℝ³) = azVec := by
      funext y
      simp only [hLdef, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply]
      unfold azVec
      simp
    have hA : DifferentiableAt ℝ azVec x := by
      rw [← hL]; exact L.differentiableAt
    have hdivA : divergence azVec x = 0 := by
      unfold divergence
      rw [← hL, ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
      have e : ((L : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ³) =
          ((-(EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)) : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight
            (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) +
          ((EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight
            (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) := rfl
      rw [e, map_add, LinearMap.trace_smulRight, LinearMap.trace_smulRight]
      simp
    have hrot : fderiv ℝ φ x (azVec x) = 0 := by
      set w : ℝ³ := x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
        x 1 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) with hw
      set a : ℝ³ := azVec x with ha
      set c : ℝ → ℝ³ := fun θ => x + ((Real.cos θ - 1) • w + Real.sin θ • a) with hc
      have ha0 : a 0 = -(x 1) := by rw [ha]; unfold azVec; simp
      have ha1 : a 1 = x 0 := by rw [ha]; unfold azVec; simp
      have ha2 : a 2 = 0 := by rw [ha]; unfold azVec; simp
      have hc0 : ∀ θ, c θ 0 = x 0 * Real.cos θ - x 1 * Real.sin θ := by
        intro θ
        simp only [hc, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ha0, hw]
        simp
        ring
      have hc1 : ∀ θ, c θ 1 = x 1 * Real.cos θ + x 0 * Real.sin θ := by
        intro θ
        simp only [hc, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ha1, hw]
        simp
        ring
      have hc2 : ∀ θ, c θ 2 = x 2 := by
        intro θ
        simp only [hc, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ha2, hw]
        simp
      have hrad : ∀ θ, rad (c θ) = rad x := by
        intro θ
        unfold rad
        rw [hc0, hc1]
        congr 1
        linear_combination (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
      have hconst : (φ ∘ c) = fun _ => φ x := by
        funext θ
        simp only [Function.comp_apply]
        rw [hG (c θ), hG x, hrad θ, hc2 θ]
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (φ ∘ c) 0 0 := by
        rw [hconst]; exact hasDerivAt_const _ _
      have hcd : HasDerivAt c a 0 := by
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun θ => (Real.cos θ - 1) • w) ((-Real.sin 0) • w) 0 :=
          ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos 0).sub_const 1).smul_const w
        have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun θ => Real.sin θ • a) (Real.cos 0 • a) 0 :=
          (Real.hasDerivAt_sin 0).smul_const a
        have h3 := (h1.add h2).const_add x
        simp only [Real.sin_zero, Real.cos_zero, neg_zero, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add] at h3
        exact h3
      have hcx : x = c 0 := by simp [hc]
      have hd2 : HasDerivAt (φ ∘ c) (fderiv ℝ φ x a) 0 :=
        HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hφ.hasFDerivAt hcd hcx
      exact hd2.unique hd1
    refine ⟨hφ.smul hA, ?_⟩
    unfold divergence at hdivA ⊢
    have hfd : HasFDerivAt (fun y => φ y • azVec y)
        (φ x • fderiv ℝ azVec x + (fderiv ℝ φ x).smulRight (azVec x)) x :=
      hφ.hasFDerivAt.smul hA.hasFDerivAt
    rw [hfd.fderiv]
    have e : ((φ x • fderiv ℝ azVec x + (fderiv ℝ φ x).smulRight (azVec x) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) :
        ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ³) = φ x • ((fderiv ℝ azVec x : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ³) +
          (fderiv ℝ φ x : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (azVec x) := rfl
    rw [e, map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.trace_smulRight, hdivA, smul_zero, zero_add]
    exact hrot
  
  let Γ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun w =>
    if 0 < w.1 ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h w.2 (1 - t) < qsOf l0 then
      simScale B.h w.2 (1 - t) ^ e * f (w.1, w.2, t, Yph B.h w.1 t + 0) * w.1⁻¹ else 0
  let φ : ℝ³ → ℝ := fun y => Γ (rad y, y 2)
  have hφ1 : ∀ y, corrOn B l0 y t → φ y =
      simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) ^ e * f (rad y, y 2, t, Yph B.h (rad y) t + 0) * (rad y)⁻¹ :=
    fun y h => if_pos h
  have hφ0 : ∀ y, ¬ corrOn B l0 y t → φ y = 0 := fun y h => if_neg h
  have hV : ∀ y, ipb5MV B l0 e f (y, t) = φ y • azVec y := by
    intro y
    by_cases hc : corrOn B l0 y t
    · rw [hφ1 y hc]
      simp only [ipb5MV, eTh, hc, if_true, smul_smul]
      rfl
    · rw [hφ0 y hc, zero_smul]
      simp [ipb5MV, hc]
  have hcoord : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (y : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ => w i) y := by
    intro i y
    have h0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (ι := Fin 3) i) y :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt _
    rwa [EuclideanSpace.coe_proj] at h0
  have hφd : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ x := by
    rcases (Real.sqrt_nonneg (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2)).eq_or_lt with h0 | hpos
    · 
      have hsq : x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 ≤ 0 := Real.sqrt_eq_zero'.1 h0.symm
      have hcont01 : Continuous (fun y : ℝ³ => y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) :=
        continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun y =>
          (((hcoord 0 y).pow 2).add ((hcoord 1 y).pow 2)).continuousAt
      have hN : IsOpen {y : ℝ³ | y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 < 2 * B.Xa * (1 - t)} :=
        isOpen_lt hcont01 continuous_const
      have hxN : x ∈ {y : ℝ³ | y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 < 2 * B.Xa * (1 - t)} := by
        show x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 < 2 * B.Xa * (1 - t)
        have := mul_pos (mul_pos two_pos hXa) hτ
        linarith
      have hev : φ =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
        refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hN.mem_nhds hxN) ?_
        intro y hy
        have hy' : y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 < 2 * B.Xa * (1 - t) := hy
        by_cases hc : corrOn B l0 y t
        · rw [hφ1 y hc]
          obtain ⟨hr, -, hq⟩ := hc
          have hqge : 1 - t ≤ simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) := (hS.2.1 (y 2) (1 - t) hτ).1
          have hqpos : 0 < simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) := by linarith
          have hdom : ((rad y, y 2, t, Yph B.h (rad y) t + 0) : Cyl) ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) :=
            show 0 < rad y ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 from ⟨hr, hxt'.1, hq⟩
          have hrad2 : rad y ^ 2 = y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
          have hXC : XC B.h ((rad y, y 2, t, Yph B.h (rad y) t + 0) : Cyl) ≤ B.Xa := by
            show rad y ^ 2 / (2 * simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t)) ≤ B.Xa
            rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith), hrad2]
            have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqge hXa.le
            nlinarith
          rw [hvan _ hdom hXC, mul_zero, zero_mul]
        · exact hφ0 y hc
      exact (differentiableAt_const (0:ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    · 
      have hr : 0 < rad x := hpos
      have hsum : 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.1 hpos
      have hradD : DifferentiableAt ℝ rad x :=
        (((hcoord 0 _).pow 2).add ((hcoord 1 _).pow 2)).sqrt hsum.ne'
      have hSo : (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) ∈ nhds (x 2, 1 - t) :=
        (isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - t from hτ⟩
      have hSd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (x 2, 1 - t) :=
        (hS.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt hSo).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hσD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t)) x :=
        DifferentiableAt.comp (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2)
          (f := fun y : ℝ³ => (y 2, 1 - t)) x hSd ((hcoord 2 _).prodMk (differentiableAt_const _))
      have hev : ∀ᶠ y in nhds x, corrOn B l0 y t := by
        filter_upwards [hradD.continuousAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hr),
          hσD.continuousAt (Iio_mem_nhds hxt'.2)] with y hy1 hy2
        exact ⟨hy1, hxt'.1, hy2⟩
      have hζ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => ((rad y, y 2, t, Yph B.h (rad y) t + 0) : Cyl)) x := by
        have h4 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => Yph B.h (rad y) t + 0) x :=
          (((hradD.rpow_const (p := drx B.h) (Or.inl hr.ne')).smul_const vrv).add_const
            (t • vtv)).add_const 0
        exact hradD.prodMk ((hcoord 2 _).prodMk ((differentiableAt_const t).prodMk h4))
      have hDom : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∈ nhds ((rad x, x 2, t, Yph B.h (rad x) t + 0) : Cyl) := by
        have hc1 : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => η.1) (rad x, x 2, t, Yph B.h (rad x) t + 0) :=
          continuous_fst.continuousAt
        have hc3 : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => η.2.2.1) (rad x, x 2, t, Yph B.h (rad x) t + 0) :=
          (continuous_fst.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)).continuousAt
        have hψ : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => (η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1))
            (rad x, x 2, t, Yph B.h (rad x) t + 0) :=
          ((continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd).prodMk
            (continuous_const.sub (continuous_fst.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)))).continuousAt
        have hq : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => simScale B.h η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1))
            (rad x, x 2, t, Yph B.h (rad x) t + 0) :=
          ContinuousAt.comp (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2)
            (f := fun η : Cyl => (η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1)) hSd.continuousAt hψ
        filter_upwards [hc1 (Ioi_mem_nhds hr), hc3 (Iio_mem_nhds hxt'.1),
          hq (Iio_mem_nhds hxt'.2)] with η h1 h2 h3
        exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
      have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ f ((rad x, x 2, t, Yph B.h (rad x) t + 0) : Cyl) :=
        (hf.contDiffAt hDom).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hfζ : DifferentiableAt ℝ
          (fun y : ℝ³ => f ((rad y, y 2, t, Yph B.h (rad y) t + 0) : Cyl)) x :=
        hfd.comp x hζ
      have hqd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) ^ e) x :=
        hσD.rpow_const (p := e) (Or.inl (hS.1 (x 2) (1 - t) hτ).1.ne')
      have hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) ^ e *
          f ((rad y, y 2, t, Yph B.h (rad y) t + 0) : Cyl) * (rad y)⁻¹) x :=
        (hqd.mul hfζ).mul (hradD.inv hr.ne')
      refine hg.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
      exact hφ1 y hy
  
  have hin : inner ℝ x (azVec x) = (0:ℝ) := by
    unfold azVec
    rw [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right,
      EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
    simp only [conj_trivial, one_mul]
    ring
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hfun : (fun y => ipb5MV B l0 e f (y, t)) = fun y => φ y • azVec y := funext hV
    rw [hfun]
    exact (swirl Γ φ x (fun y => rfl) hφd).2
  · rw [hV x, real_inner_smul_right, hin, mul_zero]
  · rw [hV x, PiLp.smul_apply]
    unfold azVec
    simp

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ e : ℝ, ∃ L : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ m, 0 ≤ L m) ∧ ∀ (α : ℝ) (a : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ipb5WV B G l0 e a) (simDomain B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (ipb5WV B G l0 e a) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (B.h * α - L m)

signature.name: ipb5_wave_vec_conversion
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ e : ℝ, ∃ L : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ m, 0 ≤ L m) ∧ ∀ (α : ℝ) (a : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ipb5WV B G l0 e a) (simDomain B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (ipb5WV B G l0 e a) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (B.h * α - L m)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  intro B G hok hG
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  obtain ⟨lP, hP⟩ := wv5_phase_bound B G hok hG
  refine ⟨lP + 60, fun l0 hl0 e => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hDo, hWo, hmap, sXi, -, -, hcb⟩ := ipb5_mean_coord_bounds B l0 e hok
  obtain ⟨sF, hFb⟩ := wv5_frame_bounds B l0 e hok
  choose CP KP hPK using hP l0 (by omega)
  set W : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ) := {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < rad z.1 ∧
    B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < 2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 ∧
    rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)} with hWdef
  set Ξ : ℝ³ × ℝ → Cyl := fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => ptOf z.1 z.2 (Yph B.h (rad z.1) z.2 + 0) with hΞdef
  choose Cc Kc hcK using hcb
  choose CF KF hFK using hFb
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (by simp)
  have hq : ∀ z ∈ W, 0 < simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ∧ simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ≤ 1 := by
    intro z hz
    have h1 : z.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < qsOf l0 := hz.1
    exact ⟨(hS.1 (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) (by linarith [h1.1])).1, le_trans h1.2.le hqs1⟩
  have key2 : ∀ (C a b q : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → b ≤ a → C * q ^ a ≤ |C| * q ^ b := by
    intro C a b q hq0 hq1 hba
    calc C * q ^ a ≤ |C| * q ^ a :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)
      _ ≤ |C| * q ^ b :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1 hba) (abs_nonneg C)
  obtain ⟨Kb, hKb⟩ : ∃ Kb : ℕ → ℝ, Kb = fun m => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Kc k| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Cb, hCb⟩ : ∃ Cb : ℕ → ℝ, Cb = fun m => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |Cc k| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨KFb, hKFb⟩ : ∃ K : ℕ → ℝ, K = fun m => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |KF k| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨CFb, hCFb⟩ : ∃ C : ℕ → ℝ, C = fun m => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |CF k| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hKb0 : ∀ m, 0 ≤ Kb m := fun m => by
    rw [hKb]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hKFb0 : ∀ m, 0 ≤ KFb m := fun m => by
    rw [hKFb]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hKle : ∀ m k, k ≤ m → |Kc k| ≤ Kb m := fun m k hk => by
    rw [hKb]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => |Kc k|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  have hCle : ∀ m k, k ≤ m → |Cc k| ≤ Cb m := fun m k hk => by
    rw [hCb]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => |Cc k|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  have hKFle : ∀ m k, k ≤ m → |KF k| ≤ KFb m := fun m k hk => by
    rw [hKFb]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => |KF k|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  have hCFle : ∀ m k, k ≤ m → |CF k| ≤ CFb m := fun m k hk => by
    rw [hCFb]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => |CF k|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  have hco : ∀ m k, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ W,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Ξ z‖ ≤ Cb m * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-Kb m) := by
    intro m k hk z hz
    obtain ⟨q0, q1⟩ := hq z hz
    have hK : -Kb m ≤ -Kc k := by linarith [le_abs_self (Kc k), hKle m k hk]
    have hpn : 0 ≤ simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-Kb m) := Real.rpow_nonneg q0.le _
    refine le_trans (hcK k z hz).1 ?_
    calc Cc k * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-Kc k)
        ≤ |Cc k| * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-Kb m) := key2 _ _ _ _ q0 q1 hK
      _ ≤ Cb m * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-Kb m) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hCle m k hk) hpn
  have hFo : ∀ m k, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ W,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (wv5Frame B e) z‖ ≤ CFb m * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-KFb m) := by
    intro m k hk z hz
    obtain ⟨q0, q1⟩ := hq z hz
    have hK : -KFb m ≤ -KF k := by linarith [le_abs_self (KF k), hKFle m k hk]
    have hpn : 0 ≤ simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-KFb m) := Real.rpow_nonneg q0.le _
    refine le_trans (hFK k z hz) ?_
    calc CF k * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-KF k)
        ≤ |CF k| * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-KFb m) := key2 _ _ _ _ q0 q1 hK
      _ ≤ CFb m * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-KFb m) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hCFle m k hk) hpn
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : ℕ → ℝ,
      L = fun n : ℕ => 2 * (n : ℝ) + 1 + (n : ℝ) * Kb n + |KP n| + KFb n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hLm : ∀ n, L n = 2 * (n : ℝ) + 1 + (n : ℝ) * Kb n + |KP n| + KFb n := fun n => by rw [hL]
  refine ⟨L, fun n => by
    rw [hLm n]
    exact add_nonneg (add_nonneg (add_nonneg (by positivity)
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hKb0 n))) (abs_nonneg _)) (hKFb0 n), ?_⟩
  intro α a ha
  have hFapp : ∀ (z : ℝ³ × ℝ) (c : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      wv5Frame B e z c = simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e • cyl2cart z.1 c := by
    intro z c
    simp only [wv5Frame, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, cyl2cart]
  have ha' := ha
  obtain ⟨⟨H0, -, hH0⟩, hsm, -, hsupp, -⟩ := ha'
  obtain ⟨hloc, hdich⟩ := wv5_window_reduction B G l0 e a hok (fun γ m ξ hξ hX => by
    by_contra hne
    have hs := hsupp γ m ξ hξ hne
    rcases hX with hX | hX
    · exact absurd hs.2.2.2.2.1 (not_le.mpr hX)
    · exact absurd hs.2.2.2.2.2 (not_le.mpr hX))
  obtain ⟨M0, hM0def⟩ : ∃ M0 : ℝ, M0 = ∑ m ∈ H0, |(m : ℝ)| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  set cT : Lab × ℤ → ℝ³ × ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℂ) := fun u w => a u.1 u.2 (Ξ w) with hcT
  set ΦT : Lab × ℤ → ℝ³ × ℝ → ℂ := fun u w => ephase5 B G u.1 u.2 (thetaOf w.1) (Ξ w) with hΦT
  set PT : Lab × ℤ → ℝ³ × ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℂ) := fun u w =>
    (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℂ : ℂ →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (ΦT u w) (cT u w) with hPT
  set RT : Lab × ℤ → ℝ³ × ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ) := fun u w => wv5Re (PT u w) with hRT
  set TT : Lab × ℤ → ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ³ := fun u w => wv5Frame B e w (RT u w) with hTT
  have hclos : ∀ (u : Lab × ℤ) (z : ℝ³ × ℝ), z ∈ W → Ξ z ∈ tsupport (a u.1 u.2) →
      Ξ z ∈ closure {ξ : Cyl | ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ SuppW B G u.1 ξ} := by
    intro u z hz hts
    have hts' : Ξ z ∈ closure (Function.support (a u.1 u.2)) := hts
    rw [mem_closure_iff_nhds]
    intro s hs
    have hs' : s ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∈ nhds (Ξ z) := Filter.inter_mem hs (hDo.mem_nhds (hmap hz))
    obtain ⟨ξ, ⟨hξs, hξD⟩, hξne⟩ := mem_closure_iff_nhds.mp hts' _ hs'
    exact ⟨ξ, hξs, hξD, hsupp u.1 u.2 ξ hξD hξne⟩
  have hets : ∀ (u : Lab × ℤ) (z : ℝ³ × ℝ), z ∈ W → Ξ z ∈ tsupport (a u.1 u.2) →
      Ξ z ∈ tsupport (etaL B.h u.1) := fun u z hz hts =>
    closure_minimal (fun ξ hξ => hξ.2.2.1) (isClosed_tsupport _) (hclos u z hz hts)
  have hmem : ∀ (u : Lab × ℤ) (z : ℝ³ × ℝ), Ξ z ∈ tsupport (a u.1 u.2) → u.2 ∈ H0 := by
    intro u z hts
    by_contra hm
    rw [hH0 u.1 u.2 hm, tsupport_zero] at hts
    exact hts
  have hzero : ∀ (u : Lab × ℤ) (z : ℝ³ × ℝ), z ∈ W → Ξ z ∉ tsupport (a u.1 u.2) →
      TT u =ᶠ[nhds z] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ³)) := by
    intro u z hz hu
    have hcz : ContinuousAt Ξ z := sXi.continuousOn.continuousAt (hWo.mem_nhds hz)
    filter_upwards [hcz.preimage_mem_nhds ((isClosed_tsupport _).isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hu)] with w hw
    have h0 : a u.1 u.2 (Ξ w) = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hw
    simp only [hTT, hRT, hPT, hcT, h0, map_zero]
  have hterm : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ CT : ℝ, ∀ (u : Lab × ℤ) (z : ℝ³ × ℝ), z ∈ W → Ξ z ∈ tsupport (a u.1 u.2) →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (TT u) z ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (TT u) z‖ ≤ CT * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (B.h * α - L n) := by
    intro n
    obtain ⟨C3, hC3⟩ := wv5_raw_coef_bound B G l0 hok hG (by omega) α a ha n
    have hM1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ max 1 (Cb n) := le_max_left _ _
    have hM0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ max 1 (Cb n) := le_trans zero_le_one hM1
    obtain ⟨Cg, hCg⟩ : ∃ Cg : ℝ, Cg = (n.factorial : ℝ) * |C3| * (max 1 (Cb n)) ^ n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hCg0 : 0 ≤ Cg := by
      rw [hCg]; exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (abs_nonneg _)) (pow_nonneg hM0 _)
    have hM00 : 0 ≤ M0 := by rw [hM0def]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
    obtain ⟨CPm, hCPm⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = |CP n| * (1 + M0) ^ n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hCPm0 : 0 ≤ CPm := by
      rw [hCPm]; exact mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
    obtain ⟨CPP, hCPP⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C =
        ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℂ : ℂ →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ))‖ * 2 ^ n * CPm * Cg :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ((Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³)‖ * 2 ^ n * CFb n * (‖wv5Re‖ * CPP),
      fun u z hz hts => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨q0, q1⟩ := hq z hz
    have hmH := hmem u z hts
    obtain ⟨U, hUo, hzU, hΦs, hΦb⟩ := hPK n u.1 u.2 z hz (hclos u z hz hts)
    have hΩo : IsOpen (U ∩ W) := hUo.inter hWo
    have hzΩ : z ∈ U ∩ W := ⟨hzU, hz⟩
    have scT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (cT u) W := (hsm u.1 u.2).comp sXi hmap
    have sΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ΦT u) (U ∩ W) := hΦs.mono inter_subset_left
    have sPT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (PT u) (U ∩ W) :=
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℂ : ℂ →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ)).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn
        sΦ).clm_apply (scT.mono inter_subset_right)
    have sRT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (RT u) (U ∩ W) := wv5Re.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn sPT
    have sTT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (TT u) (U ∩ W) := (sF.mono inter_subset_right).clm_apply sRT
    refine ⟨sTT.contDiffAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hzΩ), ?_⟩
    have hcTb : ∀ j, j ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (cT u) z‖ ≤
        Cg * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (B.h * α - 2 * (n:ℝ) - 1 - (n:ℝ) * Kb n) := by
      intro j hj
      refine le_trans (ipb5_wexp_comp (a u.1 u.2) Ξ W (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) hWo hDo hmap (hsm u.1 u.2)
        sXi j z (simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)) (B.h * α - 2 * (n:ℝ) - 1) |C3| (Cb n) (Kb n) hz q0 q1
        (hKb0 n)
        (fun i hi => le_trans (hC3 u.1 u.2 _ (hmap hz) i (le_trans hi hj))
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (Real.rpow_nonneg q0.le _)))
        (fun i _ hi => hco n i (le_trans hi hj) z hz)) ?_
      have f1 : (j.factorial : ℝ) ≤ n.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le hj
      have f2 : (max 1 (Cb n)) ^ j ≤ (max 1 (Cb n)) ^ n := pow_le_pow_right₀ hM1 hj
      have hj' : (j:ℝ) * Kb n ≤ (n:ℝ) * Kb n :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hj) (hKb0 n)
      have f3 : simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (B.h * α - 2 * (n:ℝ) - 1 - (j:ℝ) * Kb n) ≤
          simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (B.h * α - 2 * (n:ℝ) - 1 - (n:ℝ) * Kb n) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge q0 q1 (by linarith)
      have A1 : (j.factorial : ℝ) * |C3| ≤ n.factorial * |C3| :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right f1 (abs_nonneg _)
      have A2 : (j.factorial : ℝ) * |C3| * (max 1 (Cb n)) ^ j ≤
          n.factorial * |C3| * (max 1 (Cb n)) ^ n :=
        mul_le_mul A1 f2 (pow_nonneg hM0 _) (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (abs_nonneg _))
      rw [hCg]
      exact mul_le_mul A2 f3 (Real.rpow_nonneg q0.le _)
        (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (abs_nonneg _)) (pow_nonneg hM0 _))
    have hmM : 1 + |((u.2 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1 + M0 := by
      have : |((u.2 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ ∑ m ∈ H0, |(m : ℝ)| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun m : ℤ => |(m : ℝ)|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) hmH
      rw [hM0def]; linarith
    have hΦ' : ∀ j, j ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (ΦT u) z‖ ≤
        CPm * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-|KP n|) := by
      intro j hj
      have hb := hΦb j hj
      have hp0 : 0 ≤ simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-KP n) := Real.rpow_nonneg q0.le _
      have hpw : (1 + |((u.2 : ℤ) : ℝ)|) ^ n ≤ (1 + M0) ^ n :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hmM n
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (ΦT u) z‖
          ≤ CP n * (1 + |((u.2 : ℤ) : ℝ)|) ^ n * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-KP n) := hb
        _ ≤ |CP n| * (1 + M0) ^ n * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-KP n) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hp0
          exact mul_le_mul (le_abs_self _) hpw (by positivity) (abs_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ CPm * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-|KP n|) := by
          rw [hCPm]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge q0 q1 (by linarith [le_abs_self (KP n)]))
            (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _))
    have hPTb : ∀ i, i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (PT u) z‖ ≤ CPP * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^
        (-|KP n| + (B.h * α - 2 * (n:ℝ) - 1 - (n:ℝ) * Kb n)) := by
      intro i hi
      refine le_trans (ipb5_wexp_bilin
        (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℂ : ℂ →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (ΦT u) (cT u) (U ∩ W)
        hΩo sΦ (scT.mono inter_subset_right) i z (simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)) (-|KP n|)
        (B.h * α - 2 * (n:ℝ) - 1 - (n:ℝ) * Kb n) CPm Cg hzΩ q0
        (fun j hj => hΦ' j (le_trans hj hi)) (fun j hj => hcTb j (le_trans hj hi))) ?_
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Real.rpow_nonneg q0.le _)
      rw [hCPP]
      have h2 : (2:ℝ) ^ i ≤ 2 ^ n := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hi
      have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2
        (norm_nonneg (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℂ : ℂ →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ)))
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h3 hCPm0) hCg0
    have hRTb : ∀ i, i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (RT u) z‖ ≤ (‖wv5Re‖ * CPP) *
        simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-|KP n| + (B.h * α - 2 * (n:ℝ) - 1 - (n:ℝ) * Kb n)) := by
      intro i hi
      have hca : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (PT u) z := sPT.contDiffAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hzΩ)
      refine le_trans (wv5Re.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left hca (by exact_mod_cast le_top)) ?_
      rw [mul_assoc]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hPTb i hi) (norm_nonneg _)
    have hT := ipb5_wexp_bilin (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ((Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³)) (wv5Frame B e)
      (RT u) (U ∩ W) hΩo (sF.mono inter_subset_right) sRT n z (simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2))
      (-KFb n) (-|KP n| + (B.h * α - 2 * (n:ℝ) - 1 - (n:ℝ) * Kb n)) (CFb n) (‖wv5Re‖ * CPP) hzΩ q0
      (fun i hi => hFo n i hi z hz) hRTb
    have hE : -KFb n + (-|KP n| + (B.h * α - 2 * (n:ℝ) - 1 - (n:ℝ) * Kb n)) = B.h * α - L n := by
      rw [hLm n]; ring
    rw [hE] at hT
    exact hT
  have hTTat : ∀ (u : Lab × ℤ) (z : ℝ³ × ℝ), z ∈ W → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (TT u) z := by
    intro u z hz
    by_cases h : Ξ z ∈ tsupport (a u.1 u.2)
    · obtain ⟨CT, hCT⟩ := hterm 0
      exact (hCT u z hz h).1
    · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hzero u z hz h)
  have hfin : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (Γ : Finset Lab) (H : Finset ℤ), (∀ γ m, a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → γ ∈ Γ ∧ m ∈ H) →
      ∀ (θ : ℝ) (i : Fin 3), (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, a γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ) =
        ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, a γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ := by
    intro ξ Γ H hξ θ i
    have hz : ∀ γ m, (γ ∉ Γ ∨ m ∉ H) → a γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ = 0 := by
      intro γ m h
      by_cases ha0 : a γ m ξ = 0
      · simp [ha0]
      · exfalso
        have := hξ γ m ha0
        tauto
    have hin : ∀ γ, (∑ᶠ m : ℤ, a γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ) =
        ∑ m ∈ H, a γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ := by
      intro γ
      apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
      intro m hm
      by_contra hmH
      exact hm (hz γ m (Or.inr hmH))
    rw [finsum_congr hin]
    apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
    intro γ hγ
    by_contra hγΓ
    exact hγ (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun m _ => hz γ m (Or.inl hγΓ)))
  have hwave : ∀ (w : ℝ³ × ℝ) (Γ : Finset Lab) (H : Finset ℤ),
      (∀ γ m, a γ m (Ξ w) ≠ 0 → γ ∈ Γ ∧ m ∈ H) →
      waveV5 B G a (thetaOf w.1) (ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + 0)) = ∑ u ∈ Γ ×ˢ H, RT u w := by
    intro w Γ H hw
    funext i
    rw [Finset.sum_apply]
    show (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, a γ m (Ξ w) i * ephase5 B G γ m (thetaOf w.1) (Ξ w)).re = _
    rw [hfin (Ξ w) Γ H hw, Finset.sum_product, Complex.re_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
    rw [Complex.re_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
    simp only [hRT, hPT, hcT, hΦT, wv5Re, ContinuousLinearMap.pi_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp',
      Function.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, Complex.reCLM_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  have hlocal : ∀ z ∈ W, ∃ s : Finset (Lab × ℤ),
      ipb5WV B G l0 e a =ᶠ[nhds z] fun w => ∑ u ∈ s, TT u w := by
    intro z hzW
    obtain ⟨N, hNo, hξN, Γ, H, hNloc⟩ := wave5_locfin B G (qsOf l0) α a hok ha (Ξ z) (hmap hzW)
    refine ⟨Γ ×ˢ H, ?_⟩
    have hcz : ContinuousAt Ξ z := sXi.continuousOn.continuousAt (hWo.mem_nhds hzW)
    filter_upwards [hWo.mem_nhds hzW, hcz.preimage_mem_nhds (hNo.mem_nhds hξN)] with w hw hwN
    calc ipb5WV B G l0 e a w
        = wv5Frame B e w (waveV5 B G a (thetaOf w.1) (ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + 0))) := by
          rw [hloc w hw, hFapp]
      _ = wv5Frame B e w (∑ u ∈ Γ ×ˢ H, RT u w) := by
          rw [hwave w Γ H (fun γ m h => hNloc (Ξ w) ⟨hwN, hmap hw⟩ γ m h)]
      _ = ∑ u ∈ Γ ×ˢ H, TT u w := map_sum _ _ _
  have hsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ipb5WV B G l0 e a) (simDomain B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro z hz
    apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
    rcases hdich z hz with hzW | h0
    · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hlocal z hzW
      exact (ContDiffAt.sum (fun u _ => hTTat u z hzW)).congr_of_eventuallyEq hs
    · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq h0
  refine ⟨hsmooth, fun n => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨CT, hCT⟩ := hterm n
  have hmle : ((n : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
  refine ⟨(162 * (H0.card : ℝ)) * |CT|, fun x t hxt => ?_⟩
  have h1 : t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hxt
  have q0 : 0 < simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) := (hS.1 (x 2) (1 - t) (by linarith [h1.1])).1
  have hP0 : 0 ≤ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (B.h * α - L n) := Real.rpow_nonneg q0.le _
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ (162 * (H0.card : ℝ)) * |CT| := by positivity
  rcases hdich (x, t) hxt with hzW | h0
  · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hlocal (x, t) hzW
    have hTn : ∀ u ∈ s, ContDiffAt ℝ n (TT u) (x, t) := fun u _ => (hTTat u (x, t) hzW).of_le hmle
    have hfun : (fun w => ∑ u ∈ s, TT u w) = ∑ u ∈ s, TT u := by
      funext w; rw [Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [(hs.iteratedFDeriv ℝ n).eq_of_nhds, hfun, iteratedFDeriv_sum_apply hTn]
    have hb : ∀ u ∈ s, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (TT u) (x, t)‖ ≤
        if Ξ (x, t) ∈ tsupport (a u.1 u.2) then CT * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (B.h * α - L n)
        else 0 := by
      intro u _
      split_ifs with hu
      · exact (hCT u (x, t) hzW hu).2
      · rw [((hzero u (x, t) hzW hu).iteratedFDeriv ℝ n).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
        simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero, le_refl]
    have hcard : (s.filter (fun u => Ξ (x, t) ∈ tsupport (a u.1 u.2))).card ≤ 162 * H0.card := by
      obtain ⟨Γ2, hΓc, hΓm⟩ := wv5_label_count B.h hS (Ξ (x, t)) h1.1
      calc (s.filter (fun u => Ξ (x, t) ∈ tsupport (a u.1 u.2))).card ≤ (Γ2 ×ˢ H0).card :=
            Finset.card_le_card (fun u hu => by
              rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hu
              exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hΓm u.1 (hets u (x, t) hzW hu.2), hmem u (x, t) hu.2⟩)
        _ = Γ2.card * H0.card := Finset.card_product _ _
        _ ≤ 162 * H0.card := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hΓc
    have hcardR : ((s.filter (fun u => Ξ (x, t) ∈ tsupport (a u.1 u.2))).card : ℝ) ≤
        162 * (H0.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcard
    calc ‖∑ u ∈ s, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (TT u) (x, t)‖
        ≤ ∑ u ∈ s, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (TT u) (x, t)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ u ∈ s, (if Ξ (x, t) ∈ tsupport (a u.1 u.2) then
            CT * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (B.h * α - L n) else 0) := Finset.sum_le_sum hb
      _ = ∑ u ∈ s.filter (fun u => Ξ (x, t) ∈ tsupport (a u.1 u.2)),
            CT * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (B.h * α - L n) := (Finset.sum_filter _ _).symm
      _ = ((s.filter (fun u => Ξ (x, t) ∈ tsupport (a u.1 u.2))).card : ℝ) *
            (CT * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (B.h * α - L n)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ ((s.filter (fun u => Ξ (x, t) ∈ tsupport (a u.1 u.2))).card : ℝ) *
            (|CT| * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (B.h * α - L n)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hP0) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ (162 * (H0.card : ℝ)) * (|CT| * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (B.h * α - L n)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcardR (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hP0)
      _ = (162 * (H0.card : ℝ)) * |CT| * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (B.h * α - L n) := by ring
  · rw [(h0.iteratedFDeriv ℝ n).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg hC0 hP0

ipb5_wave_vec_conversion.definitions:
noncomputable def wv5Frame (B : BG) (e : ℝ) (z : ℝ³ × ℝ) : (Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
  simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e •
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 0).smulRight (eR z.1) +
     (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 1).smulRight (eTh z.1) +
     (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 2).smulRight eZ)

noncomputable def wv5Re : (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ) :=
  ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun j : Fin 3 =>
    Complex.reCLM.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) j))

by
  
  have hc : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), rotZ5 φ y 0 = Real.cos φ * y 0 - Real.sin φ * y 1 ∧

    intro φ y

  have ext3 : ∀ u v : ℝ³, u 0 = v 0 → u 1 = v 1 → u 2 = v 2 → u = v := by

    · exact h0
    · exact h1
    · exact h2
  have hinv : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), rotZ5 φ (rotZ5 (-φ) y) = y := by

    · rw [a1, b0, b1, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]

    · rw [a2, b2]

    intro φ y
    obtain ⟨a0, a1, -⟩ := hc φ y
    unfold rad
    rw [a0, a1]
    congr 1
    linear_combination (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ
  
  have hlin : ∀ φ : ℝ, ∃ L : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³, ∀ v : ℝ³, L v = rotZ5 φ v := by
    intro φ
    let f : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
      { toFun := rotZ5 φ
        map_add' := fun u v => by
          apply ext3 <;> simp [hc] <;> ring
        map_smul' := fun a u => by
          apply ext3 <;> simp [hc] <;> ring }

    obtain ⟨a0, a1, a2⟩ := hc φ u
    obtain ⟨b0, b1, b2⟩ := hc φ v
    rw [a0, a1, a2, b0, b1, b2]
    linear_combination (u 0 * v 0 + u 1 * v 1) * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ

    intro r φ z

  have hframe : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), eR (rotZ5 φ y) = rotZ5 φ (eR y) ∧

    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩

    · apply ext3 <;> simp [eTh, azVec, hc, hrad] <;> ring

    obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ : ∃ w' : ℂ, w' = ⟨rotZ5 φ y 0, rotZ5 φ y 1⟩ := ⟨_, rfl⟩

  have h1 := hcurl θ _ _ (rotPt r 0 z) hGd hev
  rw [hcl _ _ _ _ _ hd1 hd2] at h1
  have hfr : frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a = rotZ5 θ (frameAt 0 (r, z, t, Y) a) := by
    fin_cases a
    · show eR (rotPt r θ z) = rotZ5 θ (eR (rotPt r 0 z))
      rw [hpt r θ z]
      exact (hframe θ _).1
    · show eTh (rotPt r θ z) = rotZ5 θ (eTh (rotPt r 0 z))
      rw [hpt r θ z]
      exact (hframe θ _).2.1
    · show eZ = rotZ5 θ eZ
      exact (hframe θ eZ).2.2.symm
  rw [hpt r θ z, h1, hfr, hinner, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left]

mode_curl_trig_v5.definitions:
noncomputable def rotZ5 (φ : ℝ) (y : ℝ³) : ℝ³ :=
  (Real.cos φ * y 0 - Real.sin φ * y 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
    (Real.sin φ * y 0 + Real.cos φ * y 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
    y 2 • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (qs α : ℝ) (a : WC), qs ≤ B.qB → InWg5 B G qs α a → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeCoef5 B G a γ m) ξ

signature.name: modeCoef5_differentiable_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (qs α : ℝ) (a : WC), qs ≤ B.qB → InWg5 B G qs α a → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeCoef5 B G a γ m) ξ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG qs α a hqs ha γ m ξ hξ
  
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qs))
    have e : DomC B.h qs =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio qs := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  have hDn : DomC B.h qs ∈ nhds ξ := hDopen.mem_nhds hξ
  obtain ⟨hr, ht, hqξ⟩ := id hξ
  
  have hamp : DifferentiableAt ℝ (a γ m) ξ :=
    ((ha.2.1 γ m).contDiffAt hDn).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hai : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ := differentiableAt_pi.1 hamp
  
  set v : Cyl → ℝ × ℝ := fun η => Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ with hv
  have hvc : Continuous v := by
    rw [hv]
    unfold Jpow
    fun_prop
  set U : Set Cyl := DomC B.h qs ∩ {η | |(v η).1 - (v ξ).1| < 1/8} ∩
    {η | |(v η).2 - (v ξ).2| < 1/8} with hU
  have hUo : IsOpen U :=
    (hDopen.inter (isOpen_lt ((hvc.fst.sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const)).inter
      (isOpen_lt ((hvc.snd.sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const)
  have hξU : ξ ∈ U := by
    refine ⟨⟨hξ, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · show |(v ξ).1 - (v ξ).1| < 1/8
      rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; norm_num
    · show |(v ξ).2 - (v ξ).2| < 1/8
      rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; norm_num
  have hUn : U ∈ nhds ξ := hUo.mem_nhds hξU
  by_cases hA : ∀ η ∈ U, a γ m η = 0
  · 
    have hev : modeCoef5 B G a γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hUn (fun η hη => by
        funext i
        simp [modeCoef5, hA η hη])
    exact (differentiableAt_const _).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  · 
    push_neg at hA
    obtain ⟨η1, hη1U, hη1⟩ := hA
    have hη1D : η1 ∈ DomC B.h qs := hη1U.1.1
    obtain ⟨-, -, hxi, het, -, -⟩ := ha.2.2.2.1 γ m η1 hη1D hη1
    have hr0 : G.r0 ≤ 1/100 := hG.1.2.1
    
    have hb0 : 0 ≤ bgc := by unfold bgc; linarith [Real.one_lt_sqrt_two]
    have hb1 : bgc ≤ 1 := by
      unfold bgc
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
    have hden : (1 + bgc ^ 2) * (1 + bgc ^ 2)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity)
    have id1 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.1 = lamR w + bgc * lamT w := by
      intro w
      simp only [lamR, lamT, div_eq_mul_inv]
      linear_combination (-w.1) * hden
    have id2 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.2 = -(bgc * lamR w) + lamT w := by
      intro w
      simp only [lamR, lamT, div_eq_mul_inv]
      linear_combination (-w.2) * hden
    have key : ∀ (R T : ℝ), |R| ≤ G.r0 / 4 → |T| ≤ G.r0 →
        |R + bgc * T| ≤ 1/80 ∧ |-(bgc * R) + T| ≤ 1/80 := by
      intro R T hR hT
      obtain ⟨hR1, hR2⟩ := abs_le.mp hR
      obtain ⟨hT1, hT2⟩ := abs_le.mp hT
      have hr0n : 0 ≤ G.r0 := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hT
      have e1 : bgc * T ≤ G.r0 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hT2), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
      have e2 : -G.r0 ≤ bgc * T := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (show 0 ≤ T + G.r0 by linarith),
          mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
      have e3 : bgc * R ≤ G.r0 / 4 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hR2), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
      have e4 : -(G.r0 / 4) ≤ bgc * R := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (show 0 ≤ R + G.r0 / 4 by linarith),
          mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
      exact ⟨abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
    have hround : ∀ (x : ℝ) (k : ℤ), |x - k| < 1/2 → round x = k := by
      intro x k hk
      rw [round_eq, Int.floor_eq_iff]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hk
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hw1 : |lamR (frac0 (v η1))| ≤ G.r0 / 4 := hxi
    have hw2 : |lamT (frac0 (v η1))| ≤ G.r0 := het
    have hw := key _ _ hw1 hw2
    have ex1 : (v η1).1 - ((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ) =
        lamR (frac0 (v η1)) + bgc * lamT (frac0 (v η1)) := id1 (frac0 (v η1))
    have ex2 : (v η1).2 - ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ) =
        -(bgc * lamR (frac0 (v η1))) + lamT (frac0 (v η1)) := id2 (frac0 (v η1))
    have hx1 : |(v η1).1 - ((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1/80 := by rw [ex1]; exact hw.1
    have hx2 : |(v η1).2 - ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1/80 := by rw [ex2]; exact hw.2
    obtain ⟨kk, hkk⟩ : ∃ kk : ℝ × ℝ,
        kk = (((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ), ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hfr : ∀ η ∈ U, frac0 (v η) = v η - kk := by
      intro η hη
      have h1 : |(v η).1 - (v ξ).1| < 1/8 := hη.1.2
      have h2 : |(v η).2 - (v ξ).2| < 1/8 := hη.2
      have g1 : |(v η1).1 - (v ξ).1| < 1/8 := hη1U.1.2
      have g2 : |(v η1).2 - (v ξ).2| < 1/8 := hη1U.2
      obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_lt.mp h1
      obtain ⟨a3, a4⟩ := abs_lt.mp h2
      obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := abs_lt.mp g1
      obtain ⟨b3, b4⟩ := abs_lt.mp g2
      obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := abs_le.mp hx1
      obtain ⟨c3, c4⟩ := abs_le.mp hx2
      have r1 : round (v η).1 = round (v η1).1 :=
        hround _ _ (abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
      have r2 : round (v η).2 = round (v η1).2 :=
        hround _ _ (abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
      rw [hkk]
      unfold frac0
      rw [r1, r2]
      rfl
    
    have hbase : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => baseC B γ.1 η i) ξ := by
      intro i
      obtain ⟨hO, hsm⟩ := geom_slow_base_smooth_v5 B hok
      have hmem : ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈
          {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
        show 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) < B.qB
        exact ⟨hr, ht, lt_of_lt_of_le hqξ hqs⟩
      have hg := ((hsm γ.1 i).contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have hπ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) ξ := by
        fun_prop
      have h2 := hg.comp ξ hπ
      exact h2
    
    have hZ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => chartZ B.h γ.1 η) ξ := by
      simp only [chartZ, div_eq_mul_inv]
      fun_prop
    have hRC : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => RC γ.1 η) ξ := by
      simp only [RC, div_eq_mul_inv]
      fun_prop
    have hRC0 : RC γ.1 ξ ≠ 0 := by
      have : 0 < RC γ.1 ξ :=
        div_pos hr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _))
      exact this.ne'
    have hFang : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => Fang B γ.1 η) ξ := by
      simp only [Fang, div_eq_mul_inv]
      exact (hbase 1).mul (hRC.inv hRC0)
    have hT : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => lamT (v η - kk)) ξ := by
      simp only [hv, lamT, Jpow, div_eq_mul_inv]
      fun_prop
    have hmd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl =>
        pzr5 B G γ * chartZ B.h γ.1 η / epsb B.h γ.1 + sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 * RC γ.1 η
        - (lamT (v η - kk) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 *
          (pang5 B G γ * Fang B γ.1 η + pzr5 B G γ * baseC B γ.1 η 2)) ξ := by
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
      exact (((hZ.const_mul (pzr5 B G γ)).mul_const (epsb B.h γ.1)⁻¹).add
        (hRC.const_mul (sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar * 2⁻¹))).sub
        (((hT.add_const G.r0).mul_const (cib B.h γ.1)⁻¹).mul
          ((hFang.const_mul (pang5 B G γ)).add ((hbase 2).const_mul (pzr5 B G γ))))
    
    have hev : phiL5 B G γ =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun η : Cyl =>
        pzr5 B G γ * chartZ B.h γ.1 η / epsb B.h γ.1 + sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 * RC γ.1 η
        - (lamT (v η - kk) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 *
          (pang5 B G γ * Fang B γ.1 η + pzr5 B G γ * baseC B γ.1 η 2) := by
      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hUn (fun η hη => ?_)
      have hvco : vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 = (lamT (v η - kk) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 := by
        show (lamT (frac0 (v η)) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 = _
        rw [hfr η hη]
      show phiL5 B G γ η = _
      unfold phiL5
      rw [hvco]
    have hp : DifferentiableAt ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ := hmd.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    
    have hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => ((phiL5 B G γ η : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ :=
      Complex.ofRealCLM.differentiableAt.comp ξ hp
    have hE : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl =>
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ)))) ξ :=
      ((hc.const_mul ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ))).const_mul (Complex.I * (m : ℂ))).cexp
    rw [differentiableAt_pi]
    intro i
    exact (hai i).mul hE

    ∀ (l : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => baseC B l (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) i)

signature.name: modeF5_differentiable_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (h e t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (x : ℝ³), SimScaleProps h → t < 1 → 0 < rad x → DifferentiableAt ℝ c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) → DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeF5 h e t Y0 n c) x

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h e t Y0 n c x hS ht hrad hc
  
  have hcoord : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (y : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ => w i) y := by
    intro i y
    have h0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (ι := Fin 3) i) y :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt _
    rwa [EuclideanSpace.coe_proj] at h0
  
  have hradpos : 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.mp hrad
  have hradD : DifferentiableAt ℝ rad x := by
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) x :=
      ((hcoord 0 x).pow 2).add ((hcoord 1 x).pow 2)
    exact h1.sqrt hradpos.ne'
  have hinv : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => (rad y)⁻¹) x := hradD.inv hrad.ne'
  
  have hq : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => qC h (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) ^ e) x := by
    have hSo : (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) ∈ nhds (x 2, 1 - t) :=
      (isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - t by linarith⟩
    have hSd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (x 2, 1 - t) :=
      (hS.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt hSo).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hgd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => (y 2, 1 - t)) x :=
      (hcoord 2 x).prodMk (differentiableAt_const _)
    have hcomp : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => simScale h (y 2) (1 - t)) x :=
      DifferentiableAt.comp (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2)
        (f := fun y : ℝ³ => (y 2, 1 - t)) x hSd hgd
    have hpos : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≠ 0 := (hS.1 (x 2) (1 - t) (by linarith)).1.ne'
    exact hcomp.rpow_const (Or.inl hpos)
  
  have hP : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) x := by
    have h4 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => Yph h (rad y) t + Y0) x := by
      have h5 := ((hradD.rpow_const (p := drx h) (Or.inl hrad.ne')).smul_const vrv).add_const (t • vtv)
      exact h5.add_const Y0
    exact hradD.prodMk ((hcoord 2 x).prodMk ((differentiableAt_const t).prodMk h4))
  
  have hnormAll : ∀ y : ℝ³, ‖(⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)‖ = rad y := by
    intro y
    rw [Complex.norm_eq_sqrt_sq_add_sq]
    rfl
  have hE : DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun y : ℝ³ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))) x := by
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ³ → ℂ, g = fun y => ((rad y)⁻¹ : ℝ) • (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hz : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)) x := by
      have e1 : (fun y : ℝ³ => (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)) =
          fun y => Complex.ofRealCLM (y 0) + Complex.ofRealCLM (y 1) * Complex.I := by
        funext y
        rw [Complex.mk_eq_add_mul_I]
        simp
      rw [e1]
      exact (Complex.ofRealCLM.differentiableAt.comp x (hcoord 0 x)).add
        ((Complex.ofRealCLM.differentiableAt.comp x (hcoord 1 x)).mul_const Complex.I)
    have hgD : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x := by
      rw [hg]
      exact hinv.smul hz
    have hgx : g x ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hg]
      refine smul_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero hrad.ne') ?_
      intro h0
      have h1 := hnormAll x
      rw [h0, norm_zero] at h1
      linarith
    have hpow : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun u : ℂ => u ^ n) (g x) :=
      differentiableAt_zpow.mpr (Or.inl hgx)
    have hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y ^ n) x := (hpow.restrictScalars ℝ).comp x hgD
    refine hG.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    filter_upwards [hradD.continuousAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hrad)] with y hy
    have hy' : 0 < rad y := hy
    have hne : ((rad y : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hy'.ne'
    have key := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)
    rw [hnormAll y] at key
    have hexp : Complex.exp (((thetaOf y : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = g y := by
      rw [hg]
      show _ = ((rad y)⁻¹ : ℝ) • (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)
      rw [Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_inv, eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq₀ hne]
      exact key
    calc Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))
        = Complex.exp ((n : ℂ) * ((thetaOf y : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
          congr 1
          ring
      _ = Complex.exp ((thetaOf y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n := Complex.exp_int_mul _ _
      _ = g y ^ n := by rw [hexp]
  
  have hcP : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0))) x :=
    hc.comp x hP
  have hv : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ =>
      (c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re) x := by
    intro i
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i) x :=
      differentiableAt_pi.1 hcP i
    have h2 := h1.mul hE
    exact Complex.reCLM.differentiableAt.comp x h2
  
  have heR : DifferentiableAt ℝ eR x := by
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ radVec x :=
      ((hcoord 0 x).smul_const _).add ((hcoord 1 x).smul_const _)

    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ azVec x :=

  have hcyl : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => cyl2cart y (fun i =>

        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re)) x :=
    (((hv 0).smul heR).add ((hv 1).smul heTh)).add ((hv 2).smul_const eZ)
  exact hq.smul hcyl

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG lN c hc hND
  have hS := hok.1
  have hh : 0 < B.h := hok.2.1.1
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  have hP2 := And.intro (pulse_profile_smooth_v5 B G hok hG) (pulse_profile_bound_v5 B G hok hG)
  obtain ⟨lP, hPb⟩ := hP2.2
  obtain ⟨hEsm, -, -, hEb⟩ := etaL_class_v5 B hok
  have hA := sqrt_amp_bound_v5 B G hok hG lN c hc hND (yAmp4_smooth_v5 B G hok hG)
  obtain ⟨lS, hSm⟩ := w0c4_smooth_v5 B G hok hG lN c hc hND
  choose CP bP hPi using hPb
  choose CE bE hEi using hEb
  choose CA bA dA hAi using hA.2
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨lN + lP + lS + n0 + 1, fun l0 hl0 => ?_⟩
  have hQb : ∀ n : ℕ, Qb n = (1/2:ℝ) ^ n := by
    intro n
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(n:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 < B.qB := by
    show Qb l0 < _
    rw [hQb]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0
  have hDom : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB :=
    fun ξ hξ => ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, lt_trans hξ.2.2 hqsB⟩
  have hqpos : ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → 0 < qC B.h ξ :=
    fun ξ ht => (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hOpen : ∀ q : ℝ, IsOpen (DomC B.h q) := by
    intro q
    have hU : IsOpen {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).inter
        (isOpen_lt (continuous_fst.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)) continuous_const)
    have hcq : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1} := by
      have h1 := hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
      have h2 : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) := by fun_prop
      refine h1.comp h2.continuousOn ?_
      intro ξ hξ
      exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by
        linarith [(show 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 from hξ).2]⟩
    have := hcq.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := q))
    convert this using 1
    ext ξ
    simp only [DomC, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Iio]
    tauto
  have hlev : ∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 →
      l0 ≤ γ.1 ∧ Qb γ.1 < 2 * qC B.h ξ := by
    intro γ ξ hξ he
    have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ.2.1
    have h1 : sqPart 1 (-(γ.1:ℤ)) (Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ)) ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul he
    unfold sqPart at h1
    have h2 := (div_ne_zero_iff.mp h1).1
    unfold bumpR at h2
    simp only [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast, div_one, sub_neg_eq_add] at h2
    have h3 : (Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ) + (γ.1:ℝ)) ^ 2 < 1 := by
      by_contra hcon
      exact h2 (Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith [not_lt.mp hcon]))
    have h4 := (abs_lt.mp ((sq_lt_one_iff_abs_lt_one _).mp h3)).1
    have h5 : Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ) < -(l0:ℝ) :=
      (Real.logb_lt_iff_lt_rpow (by norm_num) hq).2 hξ.2.2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have h6 : (l0:ℝ) < (γ.1:ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
      have h7 : l0 < γ.1 + 1 := by exact_mod_cast h6
      omega
    · show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(γ.1:ℝ)) < 2 * qC B.h ξ
      calc (2:ℝ) ^ (-(γ.1:ℝ)) < (2:ℝ) ^ (Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ) + 1) :=
            Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt (by norm_num) (by linarith)
        _ = 2 * qC B.h ξ := by
            rw [Real.rpow_add (by norm_num), Real.rpow_logb (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hq, Real.rpow_one]
            ring
  have hII : ∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (W0c4 B G γ ξ) = 0 := by
    intro γ ξ hξ
    by_cases hne : W0c4 B G γ ξ = 0
    · rw [hne, dotProduct_zero]
    · obtain ⟨hfac, hsup⟩ := w0c4_support_v5 B G hok hG γ ξ (hDom ξ hξ)
      obtain ⟨-, hAct, heta, -, -, hR⟩ := hsup hne
      rw [hfac hAct, dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_smul,
        tH_transversal_v5 B G hok hG γ ξ hAct heta (hDom ξ hξ) hR, smul_zero, smul_zero]
  obtain ⟨ι, hι⟩ : ∃ ι : (Fin 3 → ℝ) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ), ∀ x, ι x = fun i => ((x i : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
    ⟨{ toFun := fun x i => ((x i : ℝ) : ℂ)
       map_add' := by intro x y; funext i; simp
       map_smul' := by intro r x; funext i; simp
       norm_map' := by
         intro x
         apply le_antisymm
         · exact (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg x)).2 (fun i => by

             rw [Complex.norm_real]; exact norm_le_pi_norm x i)
         · refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)).2 (fun i => ?_)
