  have hW0h : ∀ γ m, W0h4 B G γ m = if m = 1 ∨ m = -1 then (ι ∘ W0c4 B G γ) else 0 := by
    intro γ m
    funext ξ
    unfold W0h4
    split_ifs
    · simp only [Function.comp_apply, hι]
    · rfl
  have hNBι : ∀ (f : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (ξ : Cyl) (k : ℕ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ →
      NB B.h (ι ∘ f) k ξ = NB B.h f k ξ := by
    intro f ξ k hf
    have e1 : (ι ∘ f) = ι.toContinuousLinearMap ∘ f := rfl
    unfold NB
    rw [e1, ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left _ hf (by exact_mod_cast le_top)]
    have e2 : (ι.toContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) = ι.toContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)) := by
      ext v; rfl
    rw [e2, LinearIsometry.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap]
  have hNB0 : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V) (k : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl),
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ = 0 → NB B.h f k ξ = 0 := by
    intro V _ _ f k ξ hz
    unfold NB
    rw [hz]
    have h0 : (0 : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => Cyl) V).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) = 0 := by
      ext v; simp
    rw [h0, norm_zero]
  have hz0 : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (k : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl),
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (0 : Cyl → V) ξ = 0 := by
    intro V _ _ k ξ
    have h := (iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun _ : Cyl => (0:V)) = 0)
    exact congrFun h ξ
  have hsum : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ) (k i : ℕ), i ≤ k → |f i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |f j| :=
    fun f k i hi => Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |f j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  have hsum0 : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |f j| :=
    fun f k => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hpowS : ∀ (S b B' : ℝ), 1 ≤ S → |b| ≤ B' → S ^ b ≤ S ^ B' := fun S b B' hS hb =>
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS (le_trans (le_abs_self b) hb)
  have ub1 : ∀ (Cf bf : ℕ → ℝ) (k i : ℕ) (S x : ℝ), i ≤ k → 1 ≤ S → x ≤ Cf i * S ^ bf i →
      x ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cf j|) * S ^ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |bf j|) := by
    intro Cf bf k i S x hi hS hx
    refine le_trans hx (le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _)
      (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)) ?_)
    exact mul_le_mul (hsum Cf k i hi) (hpowS _ _ _ hS (hsum bf k i hi)) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
      (hsum0 Cf k)
  have ub2 : ∀ (Cf bf df : ℕ → ℝ) (k i : ℕ) (S sz ed x : ℝ), i ≤ k → 1 ≤ S → 0 ≤ sz → 0 < ed → ed ≤ 1 →
      x ≤ Cf i * S ^ bf i * sz * ed ^ (-df i) →
      x ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cf j|) * S ^ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |bf j|) * sz *
        ed ^ (-(∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |df j|)) := by
    intro Cf bf df k i S sz ed x hi hS hsz hed0 hed1 hx
    refine le_trans hx ?_
    have hA1 : Cf i * S ^ bf i ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cf j|) * S ^ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |bf j|) :=
      ub1 Cf bf k i S _ hi hS le_rfl
    have hB1 : ed ^ (-df i) ≤ ed ^ (-(∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |df j|)) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hed0 hed1 (by linarith [le_trans (le_abs_self (df i)) (hsum df k i hi)])
    have h0 : 0 ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cf j|) * S ^ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |bf j|) * sz :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hsum0 Cf k) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)) hsz
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hA1 hsz) hB1 (Real.rpow_nonneg hed0.le _) h0
  have fin : ∀ (κ s q SC sz ed P AE AA AP BE BA BP DA K : ℝ), |κ| ≤ s / 2 * q → 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ AE → 0 ≤ AA →
      0 ≤ AP → 0 < SC → 0 ≤ sz → 0 < ed → 0 ≤ P →
      |κ| * K * (AE * SC ^ BE) * (AA * SC ^ BA * sz * ed ^ (-DA)) * (AP * SC ^ BP * P) ≤
        (s / 2 * K * AE * AA * AP) * q * SC ^ (BE + BA + BP) * sz * ed ^ (-DA) * P := by
    intro κ s q SC sz ed P AE AA AP BE BA BP DA K hκ hK hAE hAA hAP hSC hsz hed hP
    rw [Real.rpow_add hSC, Real.rpow_add hSC]
    have h1 : 0 ≤ SC ^ BE := Real.rpow_nonneg hSC.le _
    have h2 : 0 ≤ SC ^ BA := Real.rpow_nonneg hSC.le _
    have h3 : 0 ≤ SC ^ BP := Real.rpow_nonneg hSC.le _
    have h4 : 0 ≤ ed ^ (-DA) := Real.rpow_nonneg hed.le _
    have X0 : 0 ≤ K * AE * AA * AP * SC ^ BE * SC ^ BA * SC ^ BP * sz * ed ^ (-DA) * P := by positivity
    calc |κ| * K * (AE * SC ^ BE) * (AA * SC ^ BA * sz * ed ^ (-DA)) * (AP * SC ^ BP * P)

      _ ≤ (s / 2 * q) * (K * AE * AA * AP * SC ^ BE * SC ^ BA * SC ^ BP * sz * ed ^ (-DA) * P) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hκ X0
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hED : ∀ X : ℝ, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb → 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X := by
    intro X h1 h2
    have hX0 : 0 < X := lt_trans hXa h1
    unfold edgeDist
    exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr h1))
      (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr h2)))
  have hSC1 : ∀ ξ : Cyl, 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := fun ξ => by
    unfold SC; exact one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))])
  have hPen : ∀ (γ : Lab) (v : ℝ), 0 ≤ Penv5 B G γ v := fun γ v => by
    unfold Penv5; exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hR0 : ∀ (C b d : ℝ) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), 0 ≤ C → ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → B.Xa < XC B.h ξ →
      XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → 0 ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (1/2)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b *
        Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) *
        Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by
    intro C b d γ ξ hC hξ hX1 hX2
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC
      (Real.rpow_nonneg (hqpos ξ hξ.2.1).le _)) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith [hSC1 ξ]) _))
      (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) (Real.rpow_nonneg (hED _ hX1 hX2).le _)) (hPen _ _)
  refine ⟨⟨⟨{1, -1}, by simp, fun γ m hm => ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, hII⟩
  · rw [hW0h, if_neg]
    simpa using hm
  · intro γ m
    rw [hW0h]
    split_ifs
    · exact ι.toContinuousLinearMap.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (hSm l0 (by omega) γ).1
    · exact contDiffOn_const
  · intro γ m ξ hξ a ha
    rw [hW0h]
    split_ifs
    · simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [w0c4_deck_v5 B G hok hG γ ξ (hDom ξ hξ) a ha]
    · rfl
  · intro γ m ξ hξ hne
    rw [hW0h] at hne
    split_ifs at hne
    · have h0 : W0c4 B G γ ξ ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hne
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, h0, map_zero]
      exact ((w0c4_support_v5 B G hok hG γ ξ (hDom ξ hξ)).2 h0).1
    · exact absurd rfl hne
  · intro k
    refine ⟨Real.sqrt (2 ^ B.h) / 2 * 3 ^ k * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |CE j|) *
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |CA j|) * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |CP j|),
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |bE j|) + (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |bA j|) +
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |bP j|),
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |dA j|, ?_⟩
    intro γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2
    have hξB := hDom ξ hξ
    have hq0 := hqpos ξ hξ.2.1
    have hed0 := hED _ hX1 hX2
    have hed1 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
    have hC0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 ^ B.h) / 2 * 3 ^ k * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |CE j|) *
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |CA j|) * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |CP j|) := by
      have := hsum0 CE k; have := hsum0 CA k; have := hsum0 CP k; positivity
    by_cases hm : m = 1 ∨ m = -1
    swap
    · rw [hW0h, if_neg hm, hNB0 _ k ξ (hz0 k ξ)]
      exact hR0 _ _ _ γ ξ hC0 hξ hX1 hX2
    rw [hW0h, if_pos hm, hNBι _ ξ k ((hSm l0 (by omega) γ).1.contDiffAt ((hOpen _).mem_nhds hξ))]
    by_cases hAct : ActiveL4 B G γ
    swap

        unfold W0c4
        rw [if_neg (fun h => hAct h.1)]
        rfl

      exact hR0 _ _ _ γ ξ hC0 hξ hX1 hX2
    by_cases heta : etaL B.h γ ξ = 0
    · rw [hNB0 _ k ξ ((hSm l0 (by omega) γ).2 ξ hξ heta k)]
      exact hR0 _ _ _ γ ξ hC0 hξ hX1 hX2
    obtain ⟨hl0', hQ2⟩ := hlev γ ξ hξ heta
    have hev : W0c4 B G γ =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun η => (Real.sqrt (epsb B.h γ.1) / 2 * etaL B.h γ η *
        Real.sqrt (max (yAmp4 B G γ η) 0)) • ((chig G.r0 (xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2) *
        psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2)) •
        G.tH γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((hOpen B.qB).mem_nhds hξB)
        (fun η hη => (w0c4_support_v5 B G hok hG γ η hη).1 hAct)
    have hL := nb_triple_leibniz B.h (Real.sqrt (epsb B.h γ.1) / 2) ξ (etaL B.h γ)
      (fun η => Real.sqrt (max (yAmp4 B G γ η) 0))
      (fun η => (chig G.r0 (xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2) *
        psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2)) •
        G.tH γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2)) k
      ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |CE j|) * SC B.h ξ ^ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |bE j|))
      ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |CA j|) * SC B.h ξ ^ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |bA j|) *
        Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) *
        edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-(∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |dA j|)))
      ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |CP j|) * SC B.h ξ ^ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |bP j|) *
        Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2))
      ((hEsm γ).contDiffAt ((hOpen B.qB).mem_nhds hξB))
      (hA.1 γ ξ (by omega) hAct heta hξB hX1 hX2)
      ((hP2.1 γ).contDiffAt ((hOpen B.qB).mem_nhds hξB))
      (fun i hi => ub1 CE bE k i _ _ hi (hSC1 ξ) (hEi i γ ξ (by omega) hξB heta))
      (fun i hi => ub2 CA bA dA k i _ _ _ _ hi (hSC1 ξ) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hed0 hed1
        (hAi i γ ξ (by omega) hAct heta hξB hX1 hX2))
      (fun i hi => le_trans (hPi i γ ξ (by omega) hAct heta hξB hX1.le hX2.le)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (ub1 CP bP k i _ _ hi (hSC1 ξ) le_rfl) (hPen _ _)))

    show (r, η.2.1, η.2.2.1, η.2.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h - η.1 ^ drx B.h) • vrv) = _
    rw [e]
  
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : Cyl, v = (1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hv1 : v.1 = 1 := by subst hv; rfl
  have hv21 : v.2.1 = 0 := by subst hv; rfl
  have hv221 : v.2.2.1 = 0 := by subst hv; rfl
  have hv222 : v.2.2.2 = (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv := by subst hv; rfl
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ : ∃ π : Cyl → ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ),
      π = fun η => (η.2.1, η.2.2.1, η.2.2.2 - (η.1 ^ drx B.h) • vrv) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ, P = fun ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
      ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), g (r, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ Q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) → ℝ, Q = fun pζ : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) =>
      ∫ r in (0:ℝ)..pζ.1, g (r, pζ.2.1, pζ.2.2.1, pζ.2.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hIcut : Icut B g = fun η => Q (η.1, π η) - chiM B (XC B.h η) * P (π η) := by
    funext η
    rw [hQ, hP, hπ]
    simp only [Icut, hpath]
  have hPξ : P (π ξ) = ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), g (pathPt B.h ξ r) := by
    rw [hP, hπ]
    simp only [hpath]
  
  have hrpow : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ drx B.h) (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) ξ.1 :=
    Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl hr.ne')
  have hfst : HasFDerivAt (fun η : Cyl => η.1) (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) ξ :=
    hasFDerivAt_fst
  have hsnd : HasFDerivAt (fun η : Cyl => η.2) (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) ξ :=
    hasFDerivAt_snd
  have h1 := hrpow.comp_hasFDerivAt ξ hfst
  have h2 := h1.smul_const vrv
  obtain ⟨π', hπ', hπ'v⟩ : ∃ π' : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ), HasFDerivAt π π' ξ ∧ π' v = 0 := by
    subst hπ
    exact ⟨_, hsnd.fst.prodMk (hsnd.snd.fst.prodMk (hsnd.snd.snd.sub h2)),
      by simp [hv1, hv21, hv221, hv222]⟩
  
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hmem : ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) :=
    ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
  have hSc := hok.1.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt ((isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds hmem)
  have hSd := (hSc.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
  have hφ := hsnd.fst.prodMk (hsnd.snd.fst.const_sub (1:ℝ))
  have hqc := hSd.comp ξ hφ
  obtain ⟨q', hq', hq'v⟩ : ∃ q' : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ, HasFDerivAt (qC B.h) q' ξ ∧ q' v = 0 := by
    refine ⟨_, hqc, ?_⟩
    simp [hv21, hv221, Prod.mk_zero_zero]
  have hr2 := (hasDerivAt_pow 2 ξ.1).comp_hasFDerivAt ξ hfst
  have hinv : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y⁻¹) (-((2 * qC B.h ξ) ^ 2)⁻¹) (2 * qC B.h ξ) :=
    hasDerivAt_inv (mul_pos two_pos hq0).ne'
  obtain ⟨X', hX', hX'v⟩ : ∃ X' : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ, HasFDerivAt (XC B.h) X' ξ ∧
      X' v = ξ.1 / qC B.h ξ := by
    have hXeq : XC B.h = fun η => η.1 ^ 2 * (2 * qC B.h η)⁻¹ := by
      funext η; simp only [XC, div_eq_mul_inv]
    rw [hXeq]
    refine ⟨_, hr2.mul (hinv.comp_hasFDerivAt ξ (hq'.const_mul (2:ℝ))), ?_⟩
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', hv1, hq'v, smul_eq_mul, Function.comp_apply, mul_zero,
      zero_add, smul_zero]
    have hq0' : qC B.h ξ ≠ 0 := hq0.ne'
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hχd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (chiM B) (XC B.h ξ) := by
    have e1 : Differentiable ℝ Real.smoothTransition :=
      (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).differentiable (by norm_num)
    have e2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun X : ℝ => (X - B.m1) / (B.m2 - B.m1)) (XC B.h ξ) :=
      (differentiableAt_id.sub_const _).div_const _
    exact (e1 _).comp _ e2
  have hχX := hχd.hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt ξ hX'
  
  have hPd : DifferentiableAt ℝ P (π ξ) := by rw [hP, hπ]; exact H1
  have hQd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Q (ξ.1, π ξ) := by rw [hQ, hπ]; exact H2
  have hι : HasDerivAt (fun p : ℝ => (p, π ξ)) ((1:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) ξ.1 :=
    (hasDerivAt_id ξ.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const ξ.1 (π ξ))
  have hcomp := hQd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt ξ.1 hι
  have hH3 : HasDerivAt (Q ∘ fun p : ℝ => (p, π ξ)) (g ξ) ξ.1 := by
    rw [hQ, hπ]; exact H3
  have hQv : fderiv ℝ Q (ξ.1, π ξ) ((1:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) = g ξ := hcomp.unique hH3
  
  have hσ := hfst.prodMk hπ'
  have hF := (hQd.hasFDerivAt.comp ξ hσ).sub (hχX.mul (hPd.hasFDerivAt.comp ξ hπ'))
  have hev : Icut B g =ᶠ[nhds ξ] (fun η => Q (η.1, π η) - chiM B (XC B.h η) * P (π η)) :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun η => congrFun hIcut η)
  have hF2 := hF.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  unfold dR
  rw [← hv, hF2.fderiv]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', hπ'v, hX'v, hv1, map_zero, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, zero_add,
    Function.comp_apply, hQv]
  rw [hPξ]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ) (g : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (DomC B.h qs) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → g ξ = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), g (r, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) {ζ | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs} ∧ (∀ (k : ℕ) (ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)), ζ.2.1 < 1 → simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs → ∀ v : Fin k → ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ), iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun ζ' : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), g (r, ζ'.1, ζ'.2.1, ζ'.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) ζ v = ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (r, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv) (fun i => ((0:ℝ), (v i).1, (v i).2.1, (v i).2.2))) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, g (r, w.1, w.2, Y)) {w | w.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qs} ∧ (∀ (k : ℕ) (w : ℝ × ℝ), w.2 < 1 → simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qs → ∀ v : Fin k → ℝ × ℝ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w' : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, g (r, w'.1, w'.2, Y)) w v = ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (r, w.1, w.2, Y) (fun i => ((0:ℝ), (v i).1, (v i).2, (0 : ℝ × ℝ)))) ∧ (∀ (ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) (p : ℝ), ζ.2.1 < 1 → simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs → 0 < p → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun pζ : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) => ∫ r in (0:ℝ)..pζ.1, g (r, pζ.2.1, pζ.2.2.1, pζ.2.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) (p, ζ) ∧ HasDerivAt (fun p' : ℝ => ∫ r in (0:ℝ)..p', g (r, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) (g (p, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2 + (p ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) p)

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ) (g : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (DomC B.h qs) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → g ξ = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), g (r, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) {ζ | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs} ∧ (∀ (k : ℕ) (ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)), ζ.2.1 < 1 → simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs → ∀ v : Fin k → ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ), iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun ζ' : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), g (r, ζ'.1, ζ'.2.1, ζ'.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) ζ v = ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (r, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv) (fun i => ((0:ℝ), (v i).1, (v i).2.1, (v i).2.2))) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, g (r, w.1, w.2, Y)) {w | w.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qs} ∧ (∀ (k : ℕ) (w : ℝ × ℝ), w.2 < 1 → simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qs → ∀ v : Fin k → ℝ × ℝ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w' : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, g (r, w'.1, w'.2, Y)) w v = ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (r, w.1, w.2, Y) (fun i => ((0:ℝ), (v i).1, (v i).2, (0 : ℝ × ℝ)))) ∧ (∀ (ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) (p : ℝ), ζ.2.1 < 1 → simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs → 0 < p → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun pζ : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) => ∫ r in (0:ℝ)..pζ.1, g (r, pζ.2.1, pζ.2.2.1, pζ.2.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) (p, ζ) ∧ HasDerivAt (fun p' : ℝ => ∫ r in (0:ℝ)..p', g (r, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) (g (p, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2 + (p ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) p)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs g hok hqs0 hqs1 hgs hgz
  
  
  have engine : ∀ {H A : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] [FiniteDimensional ℝ H]
      [NormedAddCommGroup A] [NormedSpace ℝ A] [FiniteDimensional ℝ A] [MeasurableSpace A] [BorelSpace A]
      (μ : Measure A) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] (Ω : Set H) (W S : Set A) (F : H → A → ℝ),
      IsOpen Ω → IsOpen W → MeasurableSet S → S ⊆ W →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : H × A => F p.1 p.2) (Ω ×ˢ W) →
      (∀ x₀ ∈ Ω, ∃ (U : Set H) (K : Set A), IsOpen U ∧ x₀ ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ Ω ∧ IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ W ∧
        ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ a ∈ S, a ∉ K → F x a = 0) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : H => ∫ a in S, F x a ∂μ) Ω ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Ω, IntegrableOn (fun a => F x a) S μ) ∧
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : H), x ∈ Ω → ∀ v : Fin k → H,
        IntegrableOn (fun a => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' : H => F x' a) x v) S μ ∧
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' : H => ∫ a in S, F x' a ∂μ) x v =
          ∫ a in S, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' : H => F x' a) x v ∂μ := by
    intro H A _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ μ _ Ω W S F hΩ hW hS hSW hF hloc
    choose! U K hUo hxU hUΩ hKc hKW hFz using hloc
    have hΩW : IsOpen (Ω ×ˢ W) := hΩ.prod hW
    have d1 : ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (Ψ : H × A → E),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ (Ω ×ˢ W) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : H × A => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => Ψ (x', p.2)) p.1) (Ω ×ˢ W) := by
      intro E _ _ Ψ hΨ p hp
      have hΨa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Ψ p := hΨ.contDiffAt (hΩW.mem_nhds hp)
      apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry (fun (q : H × A) (x' : H) => Ψ (x', q.2))) (p, p.1) := by
        have e : Function.uncurry (fun (q : H × A) (x' : H) => Ψ (x', q.2)) =
            Ψ ∘ (fun z : (H × A) × H => (z.2, z.1.2)) := rfl
        rw [e]
        apply ContDiffAt.comp (g := Ψ) (p, p.1)
        · simpa using hΨa
        · fun_prop
      exact ContDiffAt.fderiv (f := fun (q : H × A) (x' : H) => Ψ (x', q.2))
        (g := Prod.fst) h1 contDiffAt_fst (le_of_eq ENat.coe_top_add_one)
    have d2 : ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (Ψ : H × A → E),
        (∀ x₀ ∈ Ω, ∀ x ∈ U x₀, ∀ a ∈ S, a ∉ K x₀ → Ψ (x, a) = 0) →
        ∀ x₀ ∈ Ω, ∀ x ∈ U x₀, ∀ a ∈ S, a ∉ K x₀ → fderiv ℝ (fun x' => Ψ (x', a)) x = 0 := by
      intro E _ _ Ψ hZ x₀ hx₀ x hx a ha haK
      have hev : (fun x' => Ψ (x', a)) =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => (0 : E) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((hUo x₀ hx₀).mem_nhds hx) (fun x' hx' => hZ x₀ hx₀ x' hx' a ha haK)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      exact fderiv_const_apply _
    have d3 : ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (Ψ : H × A → E),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ (Ω ×ˢ W) → (∀ x₀ ∈ Ω, ∀ x ∈ U x₀, ∀ a ∈ S, a ∉ K x₀ → Ψ (x, a) = 0) →
        ∀ x ∈ Ω, IntegrableOn (fun a => Ψ (x, a)) S μ := by
      intro E _ _ Ψ hΨ hZ x hx
      have hc : ContinuousOn (fun a => Ψ (x, a)) W :=
        hΨ.continuousOn.comp (Continuous.continuousOn (by fun_prop)) (fun a ha => ⟨hx, ha⟩)
      exact (ContinuousOn.integrableOn_compact (hKc x hx) (hc.mono (hKW x hx))).of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero hS
        (fun a ha => hZ x hx x (hxU x hx) a ha.1 ha.2)
    have d4 : ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (Ψ : H × A → E),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ (Ω ×ˢ W) → (∀ x₀ ∈ Ω, ∀ x ∈ U x₀, ∀ a ∈ S, a ∉ K x₀ → Ψ (x, a) = 0) →
        ∀ x₀ ∈ Ω, HasFDerivAt (fun x => ∫ a in S, Ψ (x, a) ∂μ)
          (∫ a in S, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => Ψ (x', a)) x₀ ∂μ) x₀ := by
      intro E _ _ _ Ψ hΨ hZ x₀ hx₀
      have hD := d1 Ψ hΨ
      have hDZ := d2 Ψ hZ
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (hUo x₀ hx₀) x₀ (hxU x₀ hx₀)
      have hsU : Metric.closedBall x₀ (δ / 2) ⊆ U x₀ :=
        (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
      have hsΩ : Metric.closedBall x₀ (δ / 2) ⊆ Ω := hsU.trans (hUΩ x₀ hx₀)
      have hsn : Metric.closedBall x₀ (δ / 2) ∈ nhds x₀ := Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds x₀ (by linarith)
      have hKK : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall x₀ (δ / 2) ×ˢ K x₀) :=
        (isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod (hKc x₀ hx₀)
      have hKsub : Metric.closedBall x₀ (δ / 2) ×ˢ K x₀ ⊆ Ω ×ˢ W := prod_mono hsΩ (hKW x₀ hx₀)
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hKK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hD.continuousOn.mono hKsub)
      have hcW : ∀ x ∈ Ω, ContinuousOn (fun a => Ψ (x, a)) W := fun x hx =>
        hΨ.continuousOn.comp (Continuous.continuousOn (by fun_prop)) (fun a ha => ⟨hx, ha⟩)
      have hcW' : ContinuousOn (fun a => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => Ψ (x', a)) x₀) W :=
        hD.continuousOn.comp (f := fun a : A => ((x₀, a) : H × A))
          (Continuous.continuousOn (by fun_prop)) (fun a ha => ⟨hx₀, ha⟩)
      have hKm : MeasurableSet (K x₀) := (hKc x₀ hx₀).isClosed.measurableSet
      refine hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (μ := μ.restrict S)
        (F := fun x a => Ψ (x, a)) (F' := fun x a => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => Ψ (x', a)) x)
        (bound := (K x₀).indicator (fun _ => C)) hsn ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · filter_upwards [hΩ.mem_nhds hx₀] with x hx
        exact ((hcW x hx).mono hSW).aestronglyMeasurable hS
      · exact d3 Ψ hΨ hZ x₀ hx₀
      · exact (hcW'.mono hSW).aestronglyMeasurable hS
      · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hS (fun a ha x hx => ?_)
        by_cases haK : a ∈ K x₀
        · rw [indicator_of_mem haK]
          exact hC (x, a) ⟨hx, haK⟩
        · rw [indicator_of_notMem haK, hDZ x₀ hx₀ x (hsU hx) a ha haK, norm_zero]
      · exact ((integrable_indicator_iff hKm).2
          (integrableOn_const (hKc x₀ hx₀).measure_lt_top.ne)).integrableOn
      · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hS (fun a ha x hx => ?_)
        have hxa : (x, a) ∈ Ω ×ˢ W := ⟨hsΩ hx, hSW ha⟩
        have hΨa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Ψ (x, a) := hΨ.contDiffAt (hΩW.mem_nhds hxa)
        have : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x' => Ψ (x', a)) x :=
          hΨa.comp x (by fun_prop : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x' : H => ((x', a) : H × A)) x)
        exact (this.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have d5 : ∀ (k : ℕ) {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
        (Ψ : H × A → E), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ (Ω ×ˢ W) →

        {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs}) ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)))
      (fun p hp => ⟨hp.1.2, show (0:ℝ) < p.1.1 * p.2 from mul_pos hp.1.1 hp.2⟩)
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) × ℝ => p.1.1) := by fun_prop
    have h3 := h2.contDiffOn.mul h1

  have hloc5 : ∀ y₀ ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ
      {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs},

        IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ Ioi 0 ∧ ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ u ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, u ∉ K →
          y.1 * g (y.1 * u, y.2.1, y.2.2.1, y.2.2.2 + ((y.1 * u) ^ drx B.h) • vrv) = 0 := by
    rintro ⟨p₁, ζ₁⟩ ⟨hp₁, hζ₁⟩
    have hp₁' : (0:ℝ) < p₁ := hp₁
    obtain ⟨U, ε, hUo, hxU, hUΩ, hε, hU0⟩ := hcut (ζ₁.1, ζ₁.2.1) hζ₁

    · rintro y ⟨hy1, hy2⟩

      have hy1' : y.1 < 2 * p₁ := hy1.2
      have hlt : y.1 * u < ε := by nlinarith
      have h0 : g (y.1 * u, y.2.1, y.2.2.1, y.2.2.2 + ((y.1 * u) ^ drx B.h) • vrv) = 0 :=
        hU0 (y.2.1, y.2.2.1) hy2 (y.1 * u) (y.2.2.2 + ((y.1 * u) ^ drx B.h) • vrv)

  have E5 := engine (volume : Measure ℝ)
    (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs})
    (Ioi (0:ℝ)) (Ioc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (fun (y : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) (u : ℝ) =>
      y.1 * g (y.1 * u, y.2.1, y.2.2.1, y.2.2.2 + ((y.1 * u) ^ drx B.h) • vrv))
    hΩ5o isOpen_Ioi measurableSet_Ioc Ioc_subset_Ioi_self hF5 hloc5
  refine ⟨E1.1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro k ζ hζ1 hζ2 v
    refine ((E1.2.2 k ζ ⟨hζ1, hζ2⟩ v).2).trans ?_
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun r hr => ?_)
    have hr0 : (0:ℝ) < r := hr
    have hcL : ∀ y : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ), ((r, 0, 0, (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv) : Cyl) + Li y =

      intro y
      rw [hLi, Prod.mk_add_mk, Prod.mk_add_mk, Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero, zero_add, zero_add,
        add_comm ((r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)]
    have hA := affine g (DomC B.h qs) Li ((r, 0, 0, (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv) : Cyl) ζ k hDopen hgs
      (by rw [hcL]; exact ⟨hr0, hζ1, hζ2⟩)
    simp only [hcL] at hA
    show iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
        g (r, x'.1, x'.2.1, x'.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) ζ v =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (r, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)
        (fun i => ((0:ℝ), (v i).1, (v i).2.1, (v i).2.2))
    rw [hA, ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    simp only [hLi]
  · 
    exact E2.1.congr (fun w hw => hM w hw)
  · 
    intro k w hw1 hw2 v
    have hw : w ∈ {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qs} := ⟨hw1, hw2⟩
    have hev : (fun w' : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1,

        (fun w' : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ a in Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1), g (a.1, w'.1, w'.2, a.2)) :=

          iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (a.1, w.1, w.2, a.2) (fun i => ((0:ℝ), (v i).1, (v i).2, (0 : ℝ × ℝ))) := by
      intro a ha

        intro y; rw [hLw]; simp
      have hA := affine g (DomC B.h qs) Lw ((a.1, 0, 0, a.2) : Cyl) w k hDopen hgs
        (by rw [hcL]; exact ⟨ha.1, hw1, hw2⟩)
      simp only [hcL] at hA
      rw [hA, ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
      simp only [hLw]
    refine (setIntegral_congr_fun hSm hpt).trans ?_
    have h := setIntegral_prod _ (hI.congr_fun hpt hSm)

  · 
    intro ζ p hζ1 hζ2 hp
    have hζ : ζ ∈ {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs} := ⟨hζ1, hζ2⟩
    have hmem : ((p, ζ) : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ

    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have hd := (E5.1.contDiffAt (hΩ5o.mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      refine hd.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_

      exact hresc y.1 (fun r => g (r, y.2.1, y.2.2.1, y.2.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) hy.1

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (z t : ℝ) (W : ℝ × ℝ), B.ok → t < 1 → ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), rhoP B (r, z, t, W) = 1

signature.name: rhoP_integral_one_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (z t : ℝ) (W : ℝ × ℝ), B.ok → t < 1 → ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), rhoP B (r, z, t, W) = 1

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B z t W hok ht
  have hq : 0 < simScale B.h z (1 - t) := (hok.1.1 z (1 - t) (by linarith)).1
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  have hXm : B.Xa < B.m1 := hok.2.1.2.2.2.1
  have hm12 : B.m1 < B.m2 := hok.2.1.2.2.2.2.1
  have hσ : 0 < Real.sqrt (simScale B.h z (1 - t)) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq
  have ha0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have hab : Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) < Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) :=
    Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by linarith) (by linarith)
  
  have hpt : ∀ r : ℝ, rhoP B (r, z, t, W) =
      (Real.sqrt (simScale B.h z (1 - t)))⁻¹ *
        rhoHat B ((Real.sqrt (simScale B.h z (1 - t)))⁻¹ * r) := by
    intro r
    show simScale B.h z (1 - t) ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * rhoHat B (r / Real.sqrt (simScale B.h z (1 - t))) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hq.le, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, div_eq_inv_mul]
  have hI : ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), rhoP B (r, z, t, W) = ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), rhoHat B x := by
    simp_rw [hpt]
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
      MeasureTheory.integral_comp_mul_left_Ioi (rhoHat B) 0 (inv_pos.mpr hσ), mul_zero, inv_inv,
      smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hσ.ne', one_mul]
  
  have hvan : ∀ s : ℝ, (s ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) ∨ Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) < s) → rhoHat B s = 0 := by
    intro s hs
    have hw : 0 < (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2 := by linarith
    have hu : 1 ≤ ((s - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) /
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2)) ^ 2 := by
      rcases hs with hs | hs
      · have h1 : (s - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) /
            ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2) ≤ -1 := by
          rw [div_le_iff₀ hw]; linarith
        nlinarith
      · have h1 : 1 < (s - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) /
            ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2) := by
          rw [lt_div_iff₀ hw]; linarith
        nlinarith
    have hnum : bumpR ((s - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) /
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2)) = 0 :=
      Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
    unfold rhoHat
    rw [hnum, zero_div]
  
  have hZpos : 0 < ∫ u in (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1))..(Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)),
      bumpR ((u - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) /
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2)) := by
    have hw : 0 < (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2 := by linarith
    apply intervalIntegral.intervalIntegral_pos_of_pos_on
    · apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable
      unfold bumpR
      exact Real.smoothTransition.continuous.comp (by fun_prop)
    · intro x hx
      have h1 : -1 < (x - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) /
          ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2) := by
        rw [lt_div_iff₀ hw]; linarith [hx.1]
      have h2 : (x - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) /
          ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2) < 1 := by
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ hw]; linarith [hx.2]
      unfold bumpR
      exact Real.smoothTransition.pos_of_pos (by nlinarith)
    · exact hab
  
  have hsub : Set.Ioc (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) ⊆ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) :=
    fun x hx => lt_trans ha0 hx.1
  have hdiff : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) \ Set.Ioc (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)),
      rhoHat B x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    apply hvan
    rcases hx with ⟨-, hx1⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_Ioc, not_and_or, not_lt, not_le] at hx1
    exact hx1
  rw [hI, MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi hsub hdiff,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le]
  unfold rhoHat
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_div]
  exact div_self hZpos.ne'

signature.name: path_integrable_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ) (g : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (DomC B.h qs) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → g ξ = 0) → ∀ ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ), ζ.2.1 < 1 → simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun r : ℝ => g (r, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs g hok hqs0 hqs1 hgs hgz ζ ht hq
  obtain ⟨z, t, Y⟩ := ζ
  simp only at ht hq ⊢
  have hq0 : 0 < simScale B.h z (1 - t) := (hok.1.1 z (1 - t) (by linarith)).1
  have hq1 : simScale B.h z (1 - t) ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  have hXam1 : B.Xa < B.m1 := hok.2.1.2.2.2.1
  have hm12 : B.m1 < B.m2 := hok.2.1.2.2.2.2.1
  have hm2Xb : B.m2 < B.Xb := hok.2.1.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hXb : 0 < B.Xb := by linarith
  have hε0 : 0 < min 1 (B.Xa * simScale B.h z (1 - t)) := lt_min one_pos (mul_pos hXa hq0)
  have hε1 : min 1 (B.Xa * simScale B.h z (1 - t)) ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
  have hε2 : min 1 (B.Xa * simScale B.h z (1 - t)) ≤ B.Xa * simScale B.h z (1 - t) :=
    min_le_right _ _
  have hmem : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ((r, z, t, Y + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv) : Cyl) ∈ DomC B.h qs :=
    fun r hr => ⟨hr, ht, hq⟩
  have hXC : ∀ r : ℝ, XC B.h ((r, z, t, Y + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv) : Cyl) =
      r ^ 2 / (2 * simScale B.h z (1 - t)) := by
    intro r
    rfl
  have hzero : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) \ Set.Icc (min 1 (B.Xa * simScale B.h z (1 - t))) (2 * B.Xb + 1),
      g (r, z, t, Y + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv) = 0 := by
    rintro r ⟨hr0, hrI⟩
    have hr0' : (0:ℝ) < r := hr0
    apply hgz _ (hmem r hr0')
    rw [hXC r]
    rcases not_and_or.mp hrI with h | h
    · left
      have h' : r < min 1 (B.Xa * simScale B.h z (1 - t)) := not_le.mp h
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith
    · right
      have h' : 2 * B.Xb + 1 < r := not_le.mp h
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq1 hXb.le]
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun r : ℝ => g (r, z, t, Y + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv))
      (Set.Icc (min 1 (B.Xa * simScale B.h z (1 - t))) (2 * B.Xb + 1)) := by
    have hγ : ContinuousOn (fun r : ℝ => ((r, z, t, Y + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv) : Cyl))
        (Set.Icc (min 1 (B.Xa * simScale B.h z (1 - t))) (2 * B.Xb + 1)) := by
      have hp : ContinuousOn (fun r : ℝ => r ^ drx B.h)
          (Set.Icc (min 1 (B.Xa * simScale B.h z (1 - t))) (2 * B.Xb + 1)) :=
        ContinuousOn.rpow_const continuousOn_id
          (fun x hx => Or.inl (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le hε0 hx.1)))
      exact continuousOn_id.prodMk (continuousOn_const.prodMk (continuousOn_const.prodMk
        (continuousOn_const.add (hp.smul continuousOn_const))))
    exact hgs.continuousOn.comp hγ (fun r hr => hmem r (lt_of_lt_of_le hε0 hr.1))
  exact (hcont.integrableOn_Icc).of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi hzero

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs e α : ℝ) (g : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → InM B qs α (nrm B e g) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → g ξ = 0

signature.name: g_regular_of_nrm_InM_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs e α : ℝ) (g : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → InM B qs α (nrm B e g) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → g ξ = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs e α g hok hg
  obtain ⟨hs, -, hz, -⟩ := hg
  have hpos : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h η := by
    intro η hη
    obtain ⟨-, h2, -⟩ := hη
    exact (hok.1.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
    hok.1.2.2.2.1
  have hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
      (DomC B.h qs) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
    intro η hη
    obtain ⟨-, h2, -⟩ := hη
    exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - η.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
  have hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) :=
    (hS.comp hφ.contDiffOn hmaps).congr (fun η _ => rfl)
  have hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-e)) (DomC B.h qs) :=
    hq.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hpos η hη).ne')
  have hid : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs, g η = qC B.h η ^ (-e) * nrm B e g η := by
    intro η hη
    have h0 := hpos η hη
    show g η = qC B.h η ^ (-e) * (qC B.h η ^ e * g η)
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add h0, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero, one_mul]

      (fun k => Real.cos (((k.2 * pint5 B G k.1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * θ))
      (fun k => Real.sin (((k.2 * pint5 B G k.1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * θ))
      (fun k i => (modeCoef5 B G a k.1 k.2 (zetaY B.h t (Y - Yph B.h r t) y) i *

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B l0 f hB hqs hf ξ hξ θ
  obtain ⟨r, z, t, Y⟩ := ξ
  have hξ' : 0 < r ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hξ
  obtain ⟨hr, ht, hσ⟩ := hξ'
  show DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => rotZ (-θ) (B.AB (rotZ θ y) t)) (rotPt r 0 z) ∧
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (psiFld B l0 f t (Y - Yph B.h r t)) (rotPt r 0 z)
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hB.1
  have hcoord : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (y : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ => w i) y := by
    intro i y
    have h0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (ι := Fin 3) i) y :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt _
    rwa [EuclideanSpace.coe_proj] at h0
  have hx00 : rotPt r 0 z 0 = r := by simp [rotPt]
  have hx01 : rotPt r 0 z 1 = 0 := by simp [rotPt]
  have hx02 : rotPt r 0 z 2 = z := by simp [rotPt]
  have hradx : rad (rotPt r 0 z) = r := by
    simp [rad, rotPt, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
  have hrot2 : ∀ (α : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), rotZ α y 2 = y 2 := by
    intro α y
    simp [rotZ]
  have hrotD : ∀ (α : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ (rotZ α) y := by
    intro α y
    unfold rotZ
    exact ((((((hcoord 0 y).const_mul (Real.cos α)).sub ((hcoord 1 y).const_mul (Real.sin α))).smul_const
      (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))).add
      ((((hcoord 0 y).const_mul (Real.sin α)).add ((hcoord 1 y).const_mul (Real.cos α))).smul_const
      (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)))).add
      ((hcoord 2 y).smul_const (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))))
  
  have hSo : (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) ∈ nhds (z, 1 - t) :=
    (isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - t by linarith⟩
  have hSd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (z, 1 - t) :=
    (hS.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt hSo).differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have hw2 : rotZ θ (rotPt r 0 z) 2 = z := by rw [hrot2]; exact hx02
  have hmem : (rotZ θ (rotPt r 0 z), t) ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB := by
    show t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (rotZ θ (rotPt r 0 z) 2) (1 - t) < B.qB
    rw [hw2]
    exact ⟨ht, lt_of_lt_of_le hσ hqs⟩
  have hAB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿B.AB) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := hB.2.2.2.2.1.1
  have hSDn : simDomain B.h B.qB ∈ nhds (rotZ θ (rotPt r 0 z), t) := by
    have hc2 : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.2) (rotZ θ (rotPt r 0 z), t) :=
      continuous_snd.continuousAt
    have hψ : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)) (rotZ θ (rotPt r 0 z), t) :=
      ((ContinuousAt.comp (g := fun v : ℝ³ => v 2) (f := fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.1)
        (hcoord 2 (rotZ θ (rotPt r 0 z))).continuousAt continuous_fst.continuousAt).prodMk
        (continuous_const.sub continuous_snd).continuousAt)
    have hSd2 : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (rotZ θ (rotPt r 0 z) 2, 1 - t) := by
      rw [hw2]; exact hSd.continuousAt
    have hq : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) (rotZ θ (rotPt r 0 z), t) :=
      ContinuousAt.comp (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2)
        (f := fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)) hSd2 hψ
    have hlt : simScale B.h (rotZ θ (rotPt r 0 z) 2) (1 - t) < B.qB := by
      rw [hw2]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hσ hqs
    filter_upwards [hc2 (Iio_mem_nhds ht), hq (Iio_mem_nhds hlt)] with w h1 h2
    exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
  have hABd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿B.AB) (rotZ θ (rotPt r 0 z), t) :=
    (hAB.contDiffAt hSDn).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hφ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => (rotZ θ y, t)) (rotPt r 0 z) :=
    (hrotD θ _).prodMk (differentiableAt_const t)
  have hcomp1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => B.AB (rotZ θ y) t) (rotPt r 0 z) :=
    DifferentiableAt.comp (g := ↿B.AB) (f := fun y : ℝ³ => (rotZ θ y, t)) _ hABd hφ
  have hA : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => rotZ (-θ) (B.AB (rotZ θ y) t)) (rotPt r 0 z) :=
    (hrotD (-θ) _).comp _ hcomp1
  
  have hradpos : 0 < rotPt r 0 z 0 ^ 2 + rotPt r 0 z 1 ^ 2 := by
    rw [hx00, hx01]; positivity
  have hradD : DifferentiableAt ℝ rad (rotPt r 0 z) :=
    (((hcoord 0 _).pow 2).add ((hcoord 1 _).pow 2)).sqrt hradpos.ne'
  have hrad0 : 0 < rad (rotPt r 0 z) := by rw [hradx]; exact hr
  have hσD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t)) (rotPt r 0 z) := by
    have hgd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => (y 2, 1 - t)) (rotPt r 0 z) :=
      (hcoord 2 _).prodMk (differentiableAt_const _)
    have hSd' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (rotPt r 0 z 2, 1 - t) := by
      rw [hx02]; exact hSd
    exact DifferentiableAt.comp (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2)
      (f := fun y : ℝ³ => (y 2, 1 - t)) (rotPt r 0 z) hSd' hgd
  have hσ' : simScale B.h (rotPt r 0 z 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := by rw [hx02]; exact hσ
  have hev : ∀ᶠ y in nhds (rotPt r 0 z), corrOn B l0 y t := by
    have h1 := hradD.continuousAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hrad0)
    have h2 := hσD.continuousAt (Iio_mem_nhds hσ')
    filter_upwards [h1, h2] with y hy1 hy2
    exact ⟨hy1, ht, hy2⟩
  have hζ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => zetaY B.h t (Y - Yph B.h r t) y) (rotPt r 0 z) := by
    have h4 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t)) (rotPt r 0 z) :=
      (((hradD.rpow_const (p := drx B.h) (Or.inl hrad0.ne')).smul_const vrv).add_const
        (t • vtv)).add_const (Y - Yph B.h r t)
    exact hradD.prodMk ((hcoord 2 _).prodMk ((differentiableAt_const t).prodMk h4))
  have hζx : zetaY B.h t (Y - Yph B.h r t) (rotPt r 0 z) = ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) := by
    simp only [zetaY, ptOf, hradx, hx02, add_sub_cancel]
  have hDom : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∈ nhds ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) := by
    have hc1 : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => η.1) (r, z, t, Y) := continuous_fst.continuousAt
    have hc3 : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => η.2.2.1) (r, z, t, Y) :=
      (continuous_fst.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)).continuousAt
    have hψ : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => (η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1)) (r, z, t, Y) :=
      ((continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd).prodMk
        (continuous_const.sub (continuous_fst.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)))).continuousAt
    have hq : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => simScale B.h η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1)) (r, z, t, Y) :=
      ContinuousAt.comp (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2)
        (f := fun η : Cyl => (η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1)) hSd.continuousAt hψ
    filter_upwards [hc1 (Ioi_mem_nhds hr), hc3 (Iio_mem_nhds ht), hq (Iio_mem_nhds hσ)] with η h1 h2 h3
    exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
  have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ f ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) :=
    (hf.contDiffAt hDom).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hfζ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => f (zetaY B.h t (Y - Yph B.h r t) y)) (rotPt r 0 z) := by
    have h0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (zetaY B.h t (Y - Yph B.h r t) (rotPt r 0 z)) := by
      rw [hζx]; exact hfd
    exact h0.comp (rotPt r 0 z) hζ
  have hqd : DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun y : ℝ³ => qC B.h (zetaY B.h t (Y - Yph B.h r t) y) ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h)) (rotPt r 0 z) := by
    have hpos : simScale B.h (rotPt r 0 z 2) (1 - t) ≠ 0 :=
      (hS.1 (rotPt r 0 z 2) (1 - t) (by linarith)).1.ne'
    exact hσD.rpow_const (Or.inl hpos)
  have heTh : DifferentiableAt ℝ eTh (rotPt r 0 z) := by
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ azVec (rotPt r 0 z) :=
      ((hcoord 1 _).neg.smul_const _).add ((hcoord 0 _).smul_const _)
    exact (hradD.inv hrad0.ne').smul h1
  have hg := hqd.smul (hfζ.smul heTh)
  refine ⟨hA, hg.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
  simp only [psiFld]
  rw [if_pos hy]
  rfl

    DifferentiableAt ℝ F x → (∀ k ∈ K, DifferentiableAt ℝ (P k) x ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (Q k) x) →

signature.name: curl3_add_sum
signature.statement:
∀ {ι : Type} (F : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (K : Finset ι) (c d : ι → ℝ) (P Q : ι → ℝ³ → ℝ³) (x : ℝ³),
    DifferentiableAt ℝ F x → (∀ k ∈ K, DifferentiableAt ℝ (P k) x ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (Q k) x) →
    curl3 (fun y => F y + ∑ k ∈ K, (c k • P k y - d k • Q k y)) x =
      curl3 F x + ∑ k ∈ K, (c k • curl3 (P k) x - d k • curl3 (Q k) x)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ι F K c d P Q x hF hPQ
  let Φ : (ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
    { toFun := fun L =>
        (L (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) 2 - L (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) 1) •
            EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (L (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) 0 - L (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) 2) •
            EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (L (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) 1 - L (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) 0) •
            EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)
      map_add' := by
        intro L M
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, PiLp.add_apply]
        module
      map_smul' := by
        intro r L
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply]
        module }
  have hΦ : ∀ H : ℝ³ → ℝ³, curl3 H x = Φ (fderiv ℝ H x) := fun H => rfl
  have hS : ∀ k ∈ K, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => c k • P k y - d k • Q k y) x := fun k hk =>
    ((hPQ k hk).1.fun_const_smul (c k)).fun_sub ((hPQ k hk).2.fun_const_smul (d k))
  have hSum : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ∑ k ∈ K, (c k • P k y - d k • Q k y)) x :=
    DifferentiableAt.fun_sum hS
  have hD : fderiv ℝ (fun y => F y + ∑ k ∈ K, (c k • P k y - d k • Q k y)) x =
      fderiv ℝ F x + ∑ k ∈ K, (c k • fderiv ℝ (P k) x - d k • fderiv ℝ (Q k) x) := by
    rw [fderiv_fun_add hF hSum, fderiv_fun_sum hS]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k hk => ?_)
    rw [fderiv_fun_sub ((hPQ k hk).1.fun_const_smul (c k)) ((hPQ k hk).2.fun_const_smul (d k)),
      fderiv_fun_const_smul (hPQ k hk).1, fderiv_fun_const_smul (hPQ k hk).2]
  rw [hΦ, hD, map_add, map_sum]
  simp only [map_sub, map_smul]
  rfl

signature.name: thA_trig_add
signature.statement:
∀ {ι : Type} (f : ℝ → ℝ) (K : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℤ) (α β : ι → ℝ),
    (∀ k ∈ K, n k ≠ 0) →
    thA (fun θ => f θ + ∑ k ∈ K, (Real.cos ((n k : ℝ) * θ) * α k - Real.sin ((n k : ℝ) * θ) * β k)) =

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ι f K n α β hn
  have hcos : ∀ m : ℤ, m ≠ 0 → ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Real.cos ((m : ℝ) * θ) = 0 := by
    intro m hm
    have hc : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hm
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left (fun x => Real.cos x) hc, integral_cos]
    have h1 : (m : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) = ((2 * m : ℤ) : ℝ) * Real.pi := by push_cast; ring
    rw [h1, Real.sin_int_mul_pi, mul_zero, Real.sin_zero, sub_self, smul_zero]
  have hsin : ∀ m : ℤ, m ≠ 0 → ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Real.sin ((m : ℝ) * θ) = 0 := by
    intro m hm
    have hc : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hm
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left (fun x => Real.sin x) hc, integral_sin]
    rw [mul_zero, Real.cos_zero, Real.cos_int_mul_two_pi, sub_self, smul_zero]
  have hgc : ∀ k : ι, Continuous (fun θ : ℝ =>
      Real.cos ((n k : ℝ) * θ) * α k - Real.sin ((n k : ℝ) * θ) * β k) := by
    intro k; fun_prop
  have hTc : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ =>
      ∑ k ∈ K, (Real.cos ((n k : ℝ) * θ) * α k - Real.sin ((n k : ℝ) * θ) * β k)) :=
    continuous_finset_sum K (fun k _ => hgc k)
  have hT : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ =>
      ∑ k ∈ K, (Real.cos ((n k : ℝ) * θ) * α k - Real.sin ((n k : ℝ) * θ) * β k))
      MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := hTc.intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hT0 : ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
      ∑ k ∈ K, (Real.cos ((n k : ℝ) * θ) * α k - Real.sin ((n k : ℝ) * θ) * β k) = 0 := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun k _ => (hgc k).intervalIntegrable _ _)]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro k hk
    have hc1 : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => Real.cos ((n k : ℝ) * θ) * α k) := by fun_prop
    have hs1 : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => Real.sin ((n k : ℝ) * θ) * β k) := by fun_prop
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hc1.intervalIntegrable _ _) (hs1.intervalIntegrable _ _),
      intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const, intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const,
      hcos _ (hn k hk), hsin _ (hn k hk)]
    ring
  unfold thA
  congr 1
  by_cases hf : IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)
  · rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hf hT, hT0, add_zero]
  · have hfT : ¬ IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => f θ + ∑ k ∈ K,
        (Real.cos ((n k : ℝ) * θ) * α k - Real.sin ((n k : ℝ) * θ) * β k))
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro h

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h ξ hS hξ
  
  have s1 : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ → 1 < |φ ξ / μ - (j : ℝ)| →
      ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 := by
    intro μ j φ hφ h1
    have hψ : ContinuousAt (fun η => |φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)|) ξ :=
      ((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs
    have hev := (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : Cyl => (1:ℝ)) ξ).eventually_lt hψ h1
    filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
    have hsq : 1 < (φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)) ^ 2 := (one_lt_sq_iff_one_lt_abs _).mpr hη
    unfold sqPart bumpR
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), zero_div]
  
  have hτ : 0 < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 := by linarith
  have hqpos : 0 < qC h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).1
  have hqcont : ContinuousAt (qC h) ξ := by
    have hU : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
    have hp : ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      ⟨trivial, hτ⟩
    have hg : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)
    have hk : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) ξ := by fun_prop
    have he : qC h = (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
      funext η; rfl
    rw [he]
    exact ContinuousAt.comp hg hk
  have hLc : ContinuousAt (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) ξ := hqcont.logb hqpos.ne'
  
  have hwin : ∀ γ : Lab, ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) →
      |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) + (γ.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
      |chartR h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
      |chartZ h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
      |chartT h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
    intro γ hγ
    have key : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ →
        (∀ η, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 → etaL h γ η = 0) → |φ ξ / μ - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
      intro μ j φ hφ himp
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      have hev := s1 μ j φ hφ hc
      apply (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mpr _) hγ
      filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
      exact himp η hη
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := key 1 (-(γ.1:ℤ)) (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) hLc
        (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul])
      simpa [div_one, sub_neg_eq_add] using this
    · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.1 (chartR h γ.1) (by unfold chartR; fun_prop)
        (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
    · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.1 (chartZ h γ.1) (by unfold chartZ; fun_prop)
        (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
    · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.2 (chartT h γ.1) (by unfold chartT; fun_prop)
        (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
  
  have hI : ∀ (c : ℝ) (j : ℤ), |c - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 → j ∈ Set.Icc ⌈c - 1⌉ ⌊c + 1⌋ := by
    intro c j hj
    rw [abs_le] at hj
    exact ⟨Int.ceil_le.mpr (by linarith [hj.2]), Int.le_floor.mpr (by linarith [hj.1])⟩

        Set.Icc ⌈chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 1⌉ ⌊chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 1⌋) ×ˢ

    refine Set.Finite.biUnion (Set.finite_Iic _) (fun n _ => ?_)

signature.statement:

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G a ξ r z H T hr hH0 hH hT
  
  have hpint : ∀ γ : Lab, pint5 B G γ ≠ 0 := by
    intro γ
    unfold pint5
    split_ifs with h
    · exact one_ne_zero
    · exact h
  
  have hphase : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (θ : ℝ), ephase5 B G γ m (thetaOf (rotPt r θ z)) ξ =
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) := by
    intro γ m θ
    have e0 : rotPt r θ z 0 = r * Real.cos θ := by simp [rotPt]
    have e1 : rotPt r θ z 1 = r * Real.sin θ := by simp [rotPt]
    have hc : (⟨rotPt r θ z 0, rotPt r θ z 1⟩ : ℂ) =
        (r : ℂ) * (Complex.cos (θ : ℂ) + Complex.sin (θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      rw [e0, e1]
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [Complex.cos_ofReal_re, Complex.sin_ofReal_re]
    have hth : thetaOf (rotPt r θ z) = toIocMod Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ := by
      unfold thetaOf
      rw [hc]
      exact Complex.arg_mul_cos_add_sin_mul_I_eq_toIocMod hr θ
    have hn := self_sub_toIocMod Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ
    have hmod : toIocMod Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ =
        θ - ((toIocDiv Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
      rw [zsmul_eq_mul] at hn
      linarith
    have hth' : ((thetaOf (rotPt r θ z) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        (θ : ℂ) - ((toIocDiv Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) := by
      rw [hth, hmod]
      push_cast
      ring
    have key : Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((pint5 B G γ : ℂ) *
          ((θ : ℂ) - ((toIocDiv Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) +
          (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)) =
        (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)) +
          Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) +
        ((-(m * pint5 B G γ * toIocDiv Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ) : ℤ) : ℂ) *
          (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    unfold ephase5
    rw [hth', key, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I, mul_one, Complex.exp_add]
  
  have hgen : ∀ (s : Finset (Lab × ℤ)) (c : Lab × ℤ → ℂ) (k : Lab × ℤ → ℤ), (∀ i ∈ s, k i ≠ 0) →
      Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => (∑ i ∈ s, c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re) ∧
      ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (∑ i ∈ s, c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re = 0 := by
    intro s c k hk
    have hcont : ∀ i, Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))) :=
      fun i => continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
        (continuous_const.mul Complex.continuous_ofReal))
    have hF : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => ∑ i ∈ s, c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))) :=
      continuous_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hcont i)
    refine ⟨Complex.continuous_re.comp hF, ?_⟩
    have h1 : ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (∑ i ∈ s, c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re =
        (∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          ∑ i ∈ s, c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re := by
      have := ContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_comp_comm Complex.reCLM
        (hF.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) 0 (2 * Real.pi))
      simpa only [Complex.reCLM_apply] using this
    rw [h1, intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun i _ => (hcont i).intervalIntegrable _ _)]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero, Complex.zero_re]
    intro i hi
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    have hw : Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero Complex.I_ne_zero (Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr (hk i hi))
    rw [integral_exp_mul_complex hw]
    have e2 : Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        (k i : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [e2, Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I]
    simp
  
  have hfin : ∀ θ' : ℝ, waveS5 B G a θ' ξ =
      (∑ p ∈ T ×ˢ H, a p.1 p.2 ξ * ephase5 B G p.1 p.2 θ' ξ).re := by
    intro θ'
    unfold waveS5
    congr 1
    have hin : ∀ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, a γ m ξ * ephase5 B G γ m θ' ξ =
        ∑ m ∈ H, a γ m ξ * ephase5 B G γ m θ' ξ := by
      intro γ
      apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
      intro m hm
      by_contra hmH
      exact (Function.mem_support.mp hm)
        (by rw [hH γ m (fun h => hmH (Finset.mem_coe.mpr h)), zero_mul])
    rw [finsum_congr hin, finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset (s := T)]
    · exact (Finset.sum_product T H (fun p : Lab × ℤ => a p.1 p.2 ξ * ephase5 B G p.1 p.2 θ' ξ)).symm
    · intro γ hγ
      by_contra hγT
      apply Function.mem_support.mp hγ
      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun m _ => by
        rw [hT γ m (fun h => hγT (Finset.mem_coe.mpr h)), zero_mul])
  
  have hfun : (fun θ : ℝ => waveS5 B G a (thetaOf (rotPt r θ z)) ξ) = fun θ : ℝ =>
      (∑ p ∈ T ×ˢ H, (a p.1 p.2 ξ * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (p.2 : ℂ) *
        ((kb B.h p.1.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G p.1 ξ : ℂ)))) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((p.2 * pint5 B G p.1 : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re := by
    funext θ
    rw [hfin]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro p _
    rw [hphase]
    ring
  
  have hk : ∀ p ∈ T ×ˢ H, p.2 * pint5 B G p.1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro p hp
    have hp2 : p.2 ∈ H := (Finset.mem_product.mp hp).2
    have hne : p.2 ≠ 0 := fun h => hH0 (h ▸ hp2)
    exact mul_ne_zero hne (hpint p.1)
  
  obtain ⟨hC, hI⟩ := hgen (T ×ˢ H)
    (fun p => a p.1 p.2 ξ * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (p.2 : ℂ) *
      ((kb B.h p.1.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G p.1 ξ : ℂ))))
    (fun p => p.2 * pint5 B G p.1) hk
  rw [hfun]
  refine ⟨hC, ?_⟩
  simp only [thA, hI, mul_zero]

noncomputable def dUM5 (B : BG) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  ![momDbP B dPsi ξ, momDvP B dv ξ, momDgP B dPsi ξ]
open Classical in
noncomputable def DXm5 (B : BG) (l0 : ℕ) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) : Ext ℝ³ := fun x t Y =>
  if corrOn B l0 x t then cyl2cart x (dUM5 B dPsi dv (ptOf x t Y)) else 0
noncomputable def wX5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Ext ℝ³ :=
  fun x t Y => uX5 B G l0 S x t Y - thAvgVec (uX5 B G l0 S) x t Y
noncomputable def crossXm (h : ℝ) (W D : Ext ℝ³) : Ext ℝ³ := fun x t Y =>
  fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff h W (Y - Yph h (rad x) t) y t) x (evOff h D (Y - Yph h (rad x) t) x t)
  + fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff h D (Y - Yph h (rad x) t) y t) x (evOff h W (Y - Yph h (rad x) t) x t)
noncomputable def VwT5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (S : CState) : WC := fun γ m ξ =>
  ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-B.h) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • velC5 B G S.Aw γ m ξ
  + ((dZ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-B.h)) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) • ![-(S.Aw γ m ξ 1), S.Aw γ m ξ 0, 0]
noncomputable def crossCoefM5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) : WC := fun γ m ξ =>
  let W : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ := VwT5 B G S γ m
  let D : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℝ := dUM5 B dPsi dv
  let gv : Fin 3 → ℝ := ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) • nPhi5 B G γ ξ
  let Ad : ℂ := Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((D ξ 0 * gv 0 + D ξ 1 * gv 1 + D ξ 2 * gv 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
  let rW := dR B.h W ξ
  let zW := dZ W ξ
  let rD := dR B.h D ξ
  let zD := dZ D ξ
  ((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
    ![(D ξ 0 : ℂ) * rW 0 + (D ξ 2 : ℂ) * zW 0 + Ad * W ξ 0 - 2 * (D ξ 1 : ℂ) * W ξ 1 / (ξ.1 : ℂ)
        + W ξ 0 * (rD 0 : ℂ) + W ξ 2 * (zD 0 : ℂ),
      (D ξ 0 : ℂ) * rW 1 + (D ξ 2 : ℂ) * zW 1 + Ad * W ξ 1 + (D ξ 1 : ℂ) * W ξ 0 / (ξ.1 : ℂ)
        + W ξ 0 * (rD 1 : ℂ) + W ξ 2 * (zD 1 : ℂ) + W ξ 1 * (D ξ 0 : ℂ) / (ξ.1 : ℂ),
      (D ξ 0 : ℂ) * rW 2 + (D ξ 2 : ℂ) * zW 2 + Ad * W ξ 2 + W ξ 0 * (rD 2 : ℂ) + W ξ 2 * (zD 2 : ℂ)]

      exact congrArg (fun F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ => r ^ n * ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, F Y) hfun
    refine hIcc.of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi (fun r hr => ?_)
    obtain ⟨hr0, hrn⟩ := hr

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hB hG
  obtain ⟨lP, CP, bP, hP⟩ := pulse_propagator_v5 B G hB hG
  obtain ⟨l1, hbox⟩ := prof_box_jet_bound_v5 B G hB hG (tH_jet_envelope_v5 B G hB hG lP CP bP hP)
  refine ⟨l1, fun k => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hbox k
  refine ⟨max C 0, b, ?_⟩
  intro γ ξ hl hA heta hD hX1 hX2
  have hr0 : 0 < G.r0 := hG.1.1
  have hr0' : G.r0 ≤ 1/100 := hG.1.2.1
  have hSP : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ b * Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by
    apply mul_nonneg
    · exact Real.rpow_nonneg (by unfold SC; positivity) b
    · unfold Penv5; exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hRHS : 0 ≤ max C 0 * SC B.h ξ ^ b * Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by
    rw [mul_assoc]; exact mul_nonneg (le_max_right _ _) hSP
  by_cases hK : |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ G.r0 / 4 ∧ |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ 2 * G.r0 / 3
  · 
    have h1 := hC γ ξ hl hA heta hD hX1 hX2 hK.1 hK.2
    refine le_trans h1 ?_
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hSP
  · 
    set v : Cyl → ℝ × ℝ := fun η => Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ with hv
    have hvc : Continuous v := by
      rw [hv]
      unfold Jpow
      fun_prop
    have hci : 0 < cib B.h γ.1 := by
      unfold cib
      have hT : (0:ℝ) < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; positivity
      have hQ : (0:ℝ) < Qb γ.1 := by unfold Qb; positivity
      exact mul_pos (zpow_pos hT _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ _)
    have s1 : ∀ s : ℝ, chig G.r0 s ≠ 0 → |s| < G.r0 / 4 := by
      intro s hs
      unfold chig bumpR at hs
      have h3 : (4 * s / G.r0) ^ 2 < 1 := by
        by_contra hcon
        exact hs (Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith [not_lt.mp hcon]))
      have h4 := (sq_lt_one_iff_abs_lt_one _).mp h3
      rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr0, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 4), div_lt_one hr0] at h4
      linarith

        Real.smoothTransition ((2 * r / ci / 3 - |(E + r) / ci - 2 * r / ci / 2|) /

      intro E ci r hci0 hr hs
      have hLpos : 0 < 2 * r / ci := div_pos (by linarith) hci0
      have hden : 0 < 2 * r / ci / 3 - 2 * r / ci / 5 := by linarith
      have hnum : 0 < 2 * r / ci / 3 - |(E + r) / ci - 2 * r / ci / 2| := by
        by_contra hcon
        apply hs
        apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
        exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (not_lt.mp hcon) hden.le
      have hid : (E + r) / ci - 2 * r / ci / 2 = E / ci := by ring
      rw [hid, abs_div, abs_of_pos hci0] at hnum
      have e : 2 * r / ci / 3 = (2 * r / 3) / ci := by ring
      have h5 : |E| / ci < (2 * r / 3) / ci := by linarith
      exact (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hci0).mp h5
    have hb0 : 0 ≤ bgc := by unfold bgc; linarith [Real.one_lt_sqrt_two]
    have hb1 : bgc ≤ 1 := by
      unfold bgc
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
    have hden : (1 + bgc ^ 2) * (1 + bgc ^ 2)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity)
    have id1 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.1 = lamR w + bgc * lamT w := by
      intro w
      simp only [lamR, lamT, div_eq_mul_inv]
      linear_combination (-w.1) * hden
    have id2 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.2 = -(bgc * lamR w) + lamT w := by
      intro w
      simp only [lamR, lamT, div_eq_mul_inv]
      linear_combination (-w.2) * hden
    have key : ∀ (R T : ℝ), |R| ≤ G.r0 / 4 → |T| ≤ G.r0 →
        |R + bgc * T| ≤ 1/80 ∧ |-(bgc * R) + T| ≤ 1/80 := by

      obtain ⟨hR1, hR2⟩ := abs_le.mp hR
      obtain ⟨hT1, hT2⟩ := abs_le.mp hT

        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hT2), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (lG : ℕ) (cG b0 : ℝ), 0 < cG → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), lG ≤ γ.1 → ActiveL4 B G γ → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) G.r0 ξ.2.2.2 → B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb → cG * SC B.h ξ ^ (-b0) ≤ dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ η i) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => nPhiP5 B G γ η i) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Kmat B G γ η i j) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b) ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (RC γ.1 η)⁻¹) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => RC γ.1 η) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b) → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (c : Lab → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (α : ℝ), (∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), c γ ξ ≠ 0 → ActiveL4 B G γ ∧ etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 ∧ |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ G.r0 / 4 ∧ |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ 2 * G.r0 / 3) → (∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (c γ ξ) = 0) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α (fun γ m ξ => if m = 1 ∨ m = -1 then (fun i => ((c γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) else 0) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + 1/2) (potW5 B G c) ∧ InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α (velW5 B G (potW5 B G c)) ∧ InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + 1/2 - kapS) (velW5 B G (potW5 B G c) - (fun γ m ξ => if m = 1 ∨ m = -1 then (fun i => ((c γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) else 0)) ∧ InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + 1/2) (presW5 B G c)

signature.name: wave_potential_transfer_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (lG : ℕ) (cG b0 : ℝ), 0 < cG → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), lG ≤ γ.1 → ActiveL4 B G γ → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) G.r0 ξ.2.2.2 → B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb → cG * SC B.h ξ ^ (-b0) ≤ dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ η i) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => nPhiP5 B G γ η i) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Kmat B G γ η i j) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b) ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (RC γ.1 η)⁻¹) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => RC γ.1 η) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b) → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (c : Lab → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (α : ℝ), (∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), c γ ξ ≠ 0 → ActiveL4 B G γ ∧ etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 ∧ |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ G.r0 / 4 ∧ |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ 2 * G.r0 / 3) → (∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (c γ ξ) = 0) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α (fun γ m ξ => if m = 1 ∨ m = -1 then (fun i => ((c γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) else 0) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + 1/2) (potW5 B G c) ∧ InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α (velW5 B G (potW5 B G c)) ∧ InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + 1/2 - kapS) (velW5 B G (potW5 B G c) - (fun γ m ξ => if m = 1 ∨ m = -1 then (fun i => ((c γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) else 0)) ∧ InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + 1/2) (presW5 B G c)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG lG cG b0 hcG hGeo
  obtain ⟨l2, h2⟩ := pulse_support_good_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨l3, h3⟩ := pulse_mult_coeffs_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨l3', h3'⟩ := pres_mult_coeffs_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨l4, h4⟩ := velRem5_class B G hok hG
  refine ⟨l2 + l3 + l3' + l4, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 c α hsupp htr hL
  have hL' : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α (liftH5 c) := hL
  have hk : kapS = 1 / 100000 := rfl
  
  have hgood : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (liftH5 c γ m) →
      SuppW B G γ ξ ∧ ActiveL4 B G γ ∧ l0 ≤ γ.1 ∧ 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 ∧ qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 ∧
      B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb ∧ |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 ∧
      |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 :=
    fun γ m ξ hξ hts => h2 l0 (by omega) α (liftH5 c) hL' γ m ξ hξ hts
  have hcoef : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      ξ ∈ tsupport (liftH5 c γ m) →
      dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) ≠ 0 ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (pulseMult5 B G γ m) ξ ∧
      NB B.h (pulseMult5 B G γ m) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (1/2)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b ∧
      ∀ c' : ℝ × ℝ, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c' → pulseMult5 B G γ m (shY ξ c') = pulseMult5 B G γ m ξ := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := h3 k
    refine ⟨C, b, fun γ m ξ hξ hts => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨-, hA, hl, q1, q2, x1, x2, e1, e2⟩ := hgood γ m ξ hξ hts
    exact hC l0 (by omega) γ m hA hl ξ hξ q1 q2 x1 x2 e1 e2
  have hcoefP : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      ξ ∈ tsupport (liftH5 c γ m) →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (presMult5 B G γ m) ξ ∧
      NB B.h (presMult5 B G γ m) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (1/2)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b ∧
      ∀ c' : ℝ × ℝ, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c' → presMult5 B G γ m (shY ξ c') = presMult5 B G γ m ξ := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := h3' k
    refine ⟨C, b, fun γ m ξ hξ hts => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨-, hA, hl, q1, q2, x1, x2, e1, e2⟩ := hgood γ m ξ hξ hts
    exact hC l0 (by omega) γ m hA hl ξ hξ q1 q2 x1 x2 e1 e2
  
  have hpot0 : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ¬(m = 1 ∨ m = -1) → potW5 B G c γ m = 0 := by
    intro γ m hm
    funext ξ
    simp only [potW5, if_neg hm]
    rfl
  have hlift0 : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ¬(m = 1 ∨ m = -1) → liftH5 c γ m = 0 := by
    intro γ m hm
    funext ξ
    simp only [liftH5, if_neg hm]
    rfl
  have hliftv : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl), (m = 1 ∨ m = -1) →
      liftH5 c γ m ξ = fun i => ((c γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro γ m ξ hm
    simp only [liftH5, if_pos hm]
  have hm0 : ∀ m : ℤ, (m = 1 ∨ m = -1) → m ≠ 0 := by
    intro m hm
    rcases hm with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  
  have hrep : potW5 B G c = fun γ m ξ => crossC (pulseMult5 B G γ m ξ) (liftH5 c γ m ξ) := by
    funext γ m ξ
    by_cases hm : m = 1 ∨ m = -1
    · rw [hliftv γ m ξ hm]
      simp only [potW5, pulseMult5, if_pos hm, if_neg (hm0 m hm)]
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [crossC, nsqC5, nPhiC5] <;> ring
    · rw [hpot0 γ m hm, hlift0 γ m hm]
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [crossC]
  
  have algP : ∀ (z : ℂ) (n p cc : Fin 3 → ℝ) (K : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ),
      z * (((dotProduct n (K.mulVec cc) - dotProduct p cc) / dotProduct n n : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        dotProduct (z • fun j => ((((dotProduct n n)⁻¹ • (Matrix.vecMul n K - p)) j : ℝ) : ℂ))
          (fun i => ((cc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    intro z n p cc K
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.vecMul, Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hrepP : presW5 B G c = fun γ m ξ => dotProduct (presMult5 B G γ m ξ) (liftH5 c γ m ξ) := by
    funext γ m ξ
    by_cases hm : m = 1 ∨ m = -1
    · rw [hliftv γ m ξ hm]
      simp only [presW5, presMult5, if_pos hm, if_neg (hm0 m hm)]
      exact algP _ _ _ _ _
    · rw [hlift0 γ m hm]
      simp only [presW5, if_neg hm]
      simp
  
  have hF1 : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + 1/2) (potW5 B G c) := by
    rw [hrep]
    refine inWg5_cross_mult B G l0 hok α (1/2) (liftH5 c) (pulseMult5 B G) hL' ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro γ m ξ hξ hts
      obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hcoef 0
      exact (hC γ m ξ hξ hts).2.1
    · intro γ m ξ hξ hne c' hc
      obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hcoef 0
      exact (hC γ m ξ hξ (subset_tsupport _ hne)).2.2.2 c' hc
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hcoef k
      exact ⟨C, b, fun γ m ξ hξ hts _ _ => (hC γ m ξ hξ hts).2.2.1⟩
  
  have hF4 : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + 1/2) (presW5 B G c) := by
    rw [hrepP]
    refine inWg5_dot_mult B G l0 hok α (1/2) (liftH5 c) (presMult5 B G) hL' ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro γ m ξ hξ hts
      obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hcoefP 0
      exact (hC γ m ξ hξ hts).1
    · intro γ m ξ hξ hne c' hc
      obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hcoefP 0
      exact (hC γ m ξ hξ (subset_tsupport _ hne)).2.2 c' hc
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hcoefP k
      exact ⟨C, b, fun γ m ξ hξ hts _ _ => (hC γ m ξ hξ hts).2.1⟩
  
  have hR : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + 1/2 - kapS) (velRem5 B (potW5 B G c)) :=
    h4 l0 (by omega) (α + 1/2) (potW5 B G c) hF1
  
  have hstruct : ∀ (D : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl), velW5 B G D γ m ξ =
      (Complex.I * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ))) • crossC (nPhiC5 B G γ ξ) (D γ m ξ) + velRem5 B D γ m ξ := by
    intro D γ m ξ
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [velW5, velC5, velRem5, crossC, nPhiC5] <;> ring
  
  have alg : ∀ (K s c0 : ℂ) (n a : Fin 3 → ℂ), c0 * (K * s) = Complex.I →
      s = n 0 * n 0 + n 1 * n 1 + n 2 * n 2 → n 0 * a 0 + n 1 * a 1 + n 2 * a 2 = 0 →
      (Complex.I * K) • crossC n (c0 • crossC n a) = a := by
    intro K s c0 n a hc hs hd
    have e0 : ((Complex.I * K) • crossC n (c0 • crossC n a)) 0 = a 0 := by
      simp [crossC]
      linear_combination (Complex.I * K * c0 * n 0) * hd + (-Complex.I * a 0) * hc +
        (Complex.I * K * c0 * a 0) * hs - a 0 * Complex.I_mul_I
    have e1 : ((Complex.I * K) • crossC n (c0 • crossC n a)) 1 = a 1 := by
      simp [crossC]
      linear_combination (Complex.I * K * c0 * n 1) * hd + (-Complex.I * a 1) * hc +
        (Complex.I * K * c0 * a 1) * hs - a 1 * Complex.I_mul_I
    have e2 : ((Complex.I * K) • crossC n (c0 • crossC n a)) 2 = a 2 := by
      simp [crossC]
      linear_combination (Complex.I * K * c0 * n 2) * hd + (-Complex.I * a 2) * hc +
        (Complex.I * K * c0 * a 2) * hs - a 2 * Complex.I_mul_I
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact e0
    · exact e1
    · exact e2
  
  have hprin : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      velW5 B G (potW5 B G c) γ m ξ = liftH5 c γ m ξ + velRem5 B (potW5 B G c) γ m ξ := by
    intro γ m ξ hξ
    rw [hstruct]
    congr 1
    by_cases ha0 : liftH5 c γ m ξ = 0
    · have hD0 : potW5 B G c γ m ξ = 0 := by
        rw [hrep]
        show crossC (pulseMult5 B G γ m ξ) (liftH5 c γ m ξ) = 0
        rw [ha0]
        funext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp [crossC]
      rw [hD0, ha0]
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [crossC]
    · have hm : m = 1 ∨ m = -1 := by
        by_contra hm
        exact ha0 (by rw [hlift0 γ m hm]; rfl)
      obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hcoef 0
      have hns : dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) ≠ 0 :=
        (hC γ m ξ hξ (subset_tsupport _ ha0)).1
      have hnsC : nsqC5 B G γ ξ ≠ 0 := by
        simp only [nsqC5]
        exact_mod_cast hns
      have hkb : (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
        have : 0 < kb B.h γ.1 := by
          unfold kb epsb Qb
          exact Nat.ceil_pos.mpr
            (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _) _) _)
        exact_mod_cast this.ne'
      have hmC : (m : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr (hm0 m hm)
      have hK : (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) * nsqC5 B G γ ξ ≠ 0 :=
        mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hkb hmC) hnsC
      have hc : Complex.I / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) * nsqC5 B G γ ξ) *
          ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) * nsqC5 B G γ ξ) = Complex.I := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hK
      have hpot : potW5 B G c γ m ξ = (Complex.I / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) * nsqC5 B G γ ξ)) •
          crossC (nPhiC5 B G γ ξ) (liftH5 c γ m ξ) := by
        rw [hliftv γ m ξ hm]
        simp only [potW5, if_pos hm]
        rfl
      have hs : nsqC5 B G γ ξ = nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 0 * nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 0 + nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 1 * nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 1 +
          nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 2 * nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 2 := by
        simp only [nsqC5, nPhiC5, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hd : nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 0 * liftH5 c γ m ξ 0 + nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 1 * liftH5 c γ m ξ 1 +
          nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 2 * liftH5 c γ m ξ 2 = 0 := by
        have h0 := htr γ ξ hξ
        simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three] at h0
        rw [hliftv γ m ξ hm]
        simp only [nPhiC5]
        exact_mod_cast h0
      rw [hpot]
      exact alg ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ)) (nsqC5 B G γ ξ) _ (nPhiC5 B G γ ξ) (liftH5 c γ m ξ) hc hs hd
  
  have hh0 : 0 ≤ B.h := hok.2.1.1.le
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3'' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3''
  have hDq : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < qC B.h ξ ∧ qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 ∧ 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
    have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
      show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
      exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    intro ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨-, e2, e3⟩ := hξ
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
    refine ⟨hq0, by linarith, ?_⟩
    unfold SC
    have : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| := by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))]
    exact one_le_pow₀ this
  have hDsh : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ a, shY ξ a ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := fun ξ hξ _ => hξ
  have hEdge : ∀ X : ℝ, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb → 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X ∧
      0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ∧ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ≤ 1 := by
    intro X e1 e2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, min_le_left _ _⟩
    · unfold edgeWeight
      split_ifs
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      · exact le_rfl
    · have hX : 0 < X := lt_trans hXa e1
      have l1 : 0 < Real.log (X / B.Xa) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr e1)
      have l2 : 0 < Real.log (B.Xb / X) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr e2)
      exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min l1 l2)
  have hW : ∀ (q Sv E e P C1 C2 b1 b2 d1 d2 α α1 α2 N1 N2 : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → 1 ≤ Sv → 0 ≤ E →
      0 < e → e ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ P → α ≤ α1 → α ≤ α2 →
      N1 ≤ C1 * q ^ (B.h * α1) * Sv ^ b1 * E * e ^ (-d1) * P →
      N2 ≤ C2 * q ^ (B.h * α2) * Sv ^ b2 * E * e ^ (-d2) * P →
      N1 + N2 ≤ (|C1| + |C2|) * q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P := by
    intro q Sv E e P C1 C2 b1 b2 d1 d2 α α1 α2 N1 N2 hq0 hq1 hS1 hE he0 he1 hP0 ha1 ha2 hN1 hN2
    have key : ∀ (C b d αi N : ℝ), α ≤ αi → N ≤ C * q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P →
        b ≤ max b1 b2 → d ≤ max d1 d2 →
        N ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) := by

        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hα hh0)
      have f2 : Sv ^ b ≤ Sv ^ (max b1 b2) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 hb
      have f3 : e ^ (-d) ≤ e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge he0 he1 (neg_le_neg hd)
      have p1 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * αi) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
      have p2 : 0 ≤ Sv ^ b := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have p3 : 0 ≤ e ^ (-d) := Real.rpow_nonneg he0.le _
      have p1' : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
      have p2' : 0 ≤ Sv ^ (max b1 b2) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have m1 : q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) := mul_le_mul f1 f2 p2 p1'
      have m2 : q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right m1 hE
      have m3 : q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) ≤

        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p1 p2) hE) p3) hP0
      calc N ≤ C * q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P := hN
        _ = C * (q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P) := by ring
        _ ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) hWi0

            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hWi (abs_nonneg C)
    have k1 := key C1 b1 d1 α1 N1 ha1 hN1 (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
    have k2 := key C2 b2 d2 α2 N2 ha2 hN2 (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
    have e : (|C1| + |C2|) * q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P =
        |C1| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) +
        |C2| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) := by ring
    rw [e]
    linarith
  have hNB : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f1 f2 g : Cyl → V) (k : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl),
      ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f1 (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f2 (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), g η = f1 η + f2 η) → NB B.h g k ξ ≤ NB B.h f1 k ξ + NB B.h f2 k ξ := by
    intro V _ _ f1 f2 g k ξ hξ hf1 hf2 heq

      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
      exact iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((hf1.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))

    rw [e1]
    have e2 : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
