        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) +
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) := by
      ext m
      simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e2]

  have hInWg : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (α α1 α2 : ℝ)
      (a b c : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → V),
      InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α1 a → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α2 b → α ≤ α1 → α ≤ α2 →
      (∃ H : Finset ℤ, (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧ ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → c γ m = 0) →

    obtain ⟨-, sb, db, pb, bb⟩ := eb

    · intro γ m ξ hξ hne

      · exact pa γ m ξ hξ hA
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨C1, c1, e1, hb1⟩ := ba k
      obtain ⟨C2, c2, e2, hb2⟩ := bb k
      refine ⟨|C1| + |C2|, max c1 c2, max e1 e2, fun γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hq0, hq1, hS1⟩ := hDq ξ hξ
      obtain ⟨hE, he0, he1⟩ := hEdge _ hX1 hX2

        unfold Penv5
        exact (Real.exp_pos _).le

      (∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), b γ m ξ = a γ m ξ) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α b := by
    intro α a b ea hHb heq

    · intro γ m ξ hξ c' hc

    have e : simDomain h qs = {p : ℝ³ × ℝ | p.2 < 1} ∩

    have hTc : IsOpen ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => w + c) ⁻¹' (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ))) :=
      hT.preimage (continuous_id.add continuous_const)
    have hfc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => σ (w + c))
        ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => w + c) ⁻¹' (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ))) :=
      hP4.comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const).contDiffOn (fun w hw => hw)
    have hSo : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => w + c) ⁻¹' (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)))) :=

      funext x

      show L p + c ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ))

        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k σ (L p + c) := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right k c (L p)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (Q : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Q O → (∀ p ∈ O, 0 < Q p) → (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ O, Q p ≤ 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Q p‖ ≤ C * Q p ^ (1 - (k : ℝ))) → ∀ e : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => Q p ^ e) O ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ O, Q p ≤ 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p => Q p ^ e) p‖ ≤ C * Q p ^ (e - 2 * (j : ℝ))

signature.name: rpow_weight_bounds_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (Q : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Q O → (∀ p ∈ O, 0 < Q p) → (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ O, Q p ≤ 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Q p‖ ≤ C * Q p ^ (1 - (k : ℝ))) → ∀ e : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => Q p ^ e) O ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ O, Q p ≤ 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p => Q p ^ e) p‖ ≤ C * Q p ^ (e - 2 * (j : ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro O Q hO hQs hQpos hQb e
  refine ⟨hQs.rpow_const_of_ne (fun p hp => (hQpos p hp).ne'), fun j => ?_⟩
  
  set A : ℝ := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |Polynomial.eval e (descPochhammer ℝ i)| with hAdef
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hA : ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ j →
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun x : ℝ => x ^ e) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) q‖ ≤ A * q ^ (e - (j : ℝ)) := by
    intro q hq0 hq1 i hi
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i isOpen_Ioi (show q ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) from hq0),
      norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate,
      Real.iter_deriv_rpow_const, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul,
      abs_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _)]
    apply mul_le_mul
    · exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Polynomial.eval e (descPochhammer ℝ i)|)
        (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
    · apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1
      have : (i:ℝ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hi
      linarith
    · exact (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _).le
    · exact hA0
  
  have hQb' : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ k → ∀ p ∈ O, Q p ≤ 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Q p‖ ≤ C * Q p ^ (1 - (k : ℝ)) := by
    intro k
    by_cases hk : 1 ≤ k
    · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hQb k hk
      exact ⟨C, fun _ => hC⟩
    · exact ⟨0, fun h => absurd h hk⟩
  choose C' hC' using hQb'
  set K : ℝ := 1 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |C' k| with hKdef
  have hK1 : 1 ≤ K := by
    have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k (_ : k ∈ Finset.range (j + 1)) => abs_nonneg (C' k))
    linarith
  have hK : ∀ p ∈ O, Q p ≤ 1 → ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ j →
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i Q O p‖ ≤ (K / Q p) ^ i := by
    intro p hp hq1 i hi1 hij
    have hq0 := hQpos p hp
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO hp]
    have h1 := hC' i hi1 p hp hq1
    have hCi : |C' i| ≤ K := by
      have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => |C' k|) (fun k _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hij))
      linarith
    have hpow : Q p ^ (1 - (i:ℝ)) = Q p * (Q p ^ i)⁻¹ := by
      rw [Real.rpow_sub hq0, Real.rpow_one, Real.rpow_natCast, div_eq_mul_inv]
    have hqi : 0 < (Q p ^ i)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (pow_pos hq0 i)
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i Q p‖ ≤ C' i * Q p ^ (1 - (i:ℝ)) := h1
      _ ≤ |C' i| * (Q p * (Q p ^ i)⁻¹) := by
          rw [hpow]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (mul_nonneg hq0.le hqi.le)
      _ = Q p * (|C' i| * (Q p ^ i)⁻¹) := by ring
      _ ≤ |C' i| * (Q p ^ i)⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_of_le_one_left (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hqi.le) hq1
      _ ≤ K ^ i * (Q p ^ i)⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hCi.trans (le_self_pow₀ hK1 (by omega))) hqi.le
      _ = (K / Q p) ^ i := by rw [div_pow, div_eq_mul_inv]
  
  refine ⟨(j.factorial : ℝ) * A * K ^ j, fun p hp hq1 => ?_⟩
  have hq0 := hQpos p hp
  have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => x ^ e) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    (contDiffOn_id (s := Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))).rpow_const_of_ne (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo Q O (Set.Ioi 0) := fun p hp => hQpos p hp
  have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hg hQs (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn hO.uniqueDiffOn hmaps hp (C := A * Q p ^ (e - (j:ℝ))) (D := K / Q p)
    (fun i hi => hA (Q p) hq0 hq1 i hi) (fun i hi1 hij => hK p hp hq1 i hi1 hij)
  rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hO hp] at key
  have e1 : (fun p => Q p ^ e) = (fun x : ℝ => x ^ e) ∘ Q := rfl
  rw [e1]
  refine key.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [div_pow, show e - 2 * (j:ℝ) = (e - j) + -(j:ℝ) by ring, Real.rpow_add hq0,
    Real.rpow_neg hq0.le, Real.rpow_natCast]
  field_simp

informal_problem.statement: ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u : ℝ => deriv (chiM B) u * Real.sqrt (2 * u)) ∧ (∀ i : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ u : ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun u : ℝ => deriv (chiM B) u * Real.sqrt (2 * u)) u‖ ≤ K) ∧ ∀ u : ℝ, (u ≤ B.m1 ∨ B.m2 ≤ u) → deriv (chiM B) u * Real.sqrt (2 * u) = 0

signature.name: chiM_psi_props_v5
signature.statement: ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u : ℝ => deriv (chiM B) u * Real.sqrt (2 * u)) ∧ (∀ i : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ u : ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun u : ℝ => deriv (chiM B) u * Real.sqrt (2 * u)) u‖ ≤ K) ∧ ∀ u : ℝ, (u ≤ B.m1 ∨ B.m2 ≤ u) → deriv (chiM B) u * Real.sqrt (2 * u) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hok
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  have hXm : B.Xa < B.m1 := hok.2.1.2.2.2.1
  have hm12 : B.m1 < B.m2 := hok.2.1.2.2.2.2.1
  have hm1 : 0 < B.m1 := lt_trans hXa hXm
  have hd : 0 < B.m2 - B.m1 := sub_pos.mpr hm12
  have hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (chiM B) := by
    have hin : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u : ℝ => (u - B.m1) / (B.m2 - B.m1)) :=
      (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).div_const _
    exact (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := ⊤)).comp hin
  have hχ' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (deriv (chiM B)) := (contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.mp hχ).2
  have hχ'c : Continuous (deriv (chiM B)) := hχ'.continuous
  have hlt : ∀ v : ℝ, v < B.m1 → deriv (chiM B) v = 0 := by
    intro v hv
    have hev : chiM B =ᶠ[nhds v] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Iio_mem_nhds hv) (fun w hw => ?_)
      have hw' : w < B.m1 := hw
      show Real.smoothTransition ((w - B.m1) / (B.m2 - B.m1)) = 0
      exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
        (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) hd.le)
    rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
  have hgt : ∀ v : ℝ, B.m2 < v → deriv (chiM B) v = 0 := by
    intro v hv
    have hev : chiM B =ᶠ[nhds v] fun _ => (1:ℝ) := by
      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hv) (fun w hw => ?_)
      have hw' : B.m2 < w := hw
      show Real.smoothTransition ((w - B.m1) / (B.m2 - B.m1)) = 1
      exact Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le ((one_le_div hd).mpr (by linarith))
    rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
  have hZ : IsClosed {v : ℝ | deriv (chiM B) v = 0} := isClosed_eq hχ'c continuous_const
  have hle : ∀ v : ℝ, v ≤ B.m1 → deriv (chiM B) v = 0 := by
    intro v hv
    have hsub : closure (Iio B.m1) ⊆ {v : ℝ | deriv (chiM B) v = 0} :=
      (IsClosed.closure_subset_iff hZ).mpr (fun w hw => hlt w hw)
    rw [closure_Iio] at hsub
    exact hsub hv
  have hge : ∀ v : ℝ, B.m2 ≤ v → deriv (chiM B) v = 0 := by
    intro v hv
    have hsub : closure (Ioi B.m2) ⊆ {v : ℝ | deriv (chiM B) v = 0} :=
      (IsClosed.closure_subset_iff hZ).mpr (fun w hw => hgt w hw)
    rw [closure_Ioi] at hsub
    exact hsub hv
  have hz : ∀ u : ℝ, (u ≤ B.m1 ∨ B.m2 ≤ u) → deriv (chiM B) u * Real.sqrt (2 * u) = 0 := by
    intro u hu
    rcases hu with hu | hu
    · rw [hle u hu, zero_mul]
    · rw [hge u hu, zero_mul]
  have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u : ℝ => deriv (chiM B) u * Real.sqrt (2 * u)) := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro u
    by_cases hu : u < B.m1
    · have hev : (fun u : ℝ => deriv (chiM B) u * Real.sqrt (2 * u)) =ᶠ[nhds u]
          fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Iio_mem_nhds hu)
          (fun w hw => hz w (Or.inl (le_of_lt hw)))
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    · have hu' : 0 < u := lt_of_lt_of_le hm1 (not_lt.mp hu)
      have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun v : ℝ => 2 * v) u :=
        (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id).contDiffAt
      have hs : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun v : ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * v)) u :=
        h2.sqrt (by positivity)
      exact hχ'.contDiffAt.mul hs
  have hcs : HasCompactSupport (fun u : ℝ => deriv (chiM B) u * Real.sqrt (2 * u)) := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro (K := Icc B.m1 B.m2) isCompact_Icc (fun x hx => ?_)
    rw [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · exact hz x (Or.inl hx.le)
    · exact hz x (Or.inr hx.le)
  refine ⟨hψ, fun i => ?_, hz⟩
  have hcont : Continuous (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i
      (fun u : ℝ => deriv (chiM B) u * Real.sqrt (2 * u))) :=
    hψ.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  exact hcont.bounded_above_of_compact_support (hcs.iteratedFDeriv i)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro O Q ψ M2 hO hQs hQpos hW hψs hψb hψz
  
  obtain ⟨π0, hπ0⟩ : ∃ π : ℝ³ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ, ∀ p : ℝ³ × ℝ, π p = p.1 0 :=
    ⟨(EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ), fun p => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨π1, hπ1⟩ : ∃ π : ℝ³ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ, ∀ p : ℝ³ × ℝ, π p = p.1 1 :=
    ⟨(EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ), fun p => rfl⟩
  
  have hlin : ∀ (π : ℝ³ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ℕ) (p : ℝ³ × ℝ),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ b π p‖ ≤ ‖π p‖ + ‖π‖ := by
    intro π b p
    rcases b with _ | b
    · rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]; linarith [norm_nonneg π]
    · rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
      have hf : fderiv ℝ π = fun _ => π := funext (fun x => π.fderiv)
      rw [hf]
      rcases b with _ | b
      · rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]; linarith [norm_nonneg (π p)]
      · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (Nat.succ_ne_zero b)]
        simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
        positivity

    have h1 := norm_iteratedFDeriv_mul_le (N := ⊤) π.contDiff π.contDiff p (n := a) le_top
    refine h1.trans ?_
    have hT : 0 ≤ ‖π p‖ + ‖π‖ := by positivity
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (a + 1), (a.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i π p‖ *
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (a - i) π p‖
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (a + 1), (a.choose i : ℝ) * (‖π p‖ + ‖π‖) ^ 2 := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i _
          rw [sq, ← mul_assoc]
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hlin π i p) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
            (hlin π (a - i) p) (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hT)
      _ = 2 ^ a * (‖π p‖ + ‖π‖) ^ 2 := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
          congr 1
          exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose a
  
  obtain ⟨S2, hS2⟩ : ∃ S2 : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ,
      S2 = (1/2 : ℝ) • ((fun p => π0 p * π0 p) + (fun p => π1 p * π1 p)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hS2s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ S2 := by
    rw [hS2]
    exact ((π0.contDiff.mul π0.contDiff).add (π1.contDiff.mul π1.contDiff)).const_smul (1/2 : ℝ)
  have hS2b : ∀ (a : ℕ) (p : ℝ³ × ℝ),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ a S2 p‖ ≤ 2 ^ a * (‖π0 p‖ + ‖π0‖ + (‖π1 p‖ + ‖π1‖)) ^ 2 := by
    intro a p
    have hc0 : ContDiffAt ℝ (a : ℕ∞ω) (fun p => π0 p * π0 p) p :=
      (π0.contDiff.mul π0.contDiff).contDiffAt
    have hc1 : ContDiffAt ℝ (a : ℕ∞ω) (fun p => π1 p * π1 p) p :=
      (π1.contDiff.mul π1.contDiff).contDiffAt
    rw [hS2, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply
      (f := (fun p => π0 p * π0 p) + (fun p => π1 p * π1 p)) (hc0.add hc1),
      iteratedFDeriv_add_apply hc0 hc1, norm_smul]
    have h0 := hsq π0 a p
    have h1 := hsq π1 a p
    have h2 := norm_add_le (iteratedFDeriv ℝ a (fun p => π0 p * π0 p) p)
      (iteratedFDeriv ℝ a (fun p => π1 p * π1 p) p)
    have hn : ‖(1/2 : ℝ)‖ = 1/2 := by norm_num
    rw [hn]
    have t0 : 0 ≤ ‖π0 p‖ + ‖π0‖ := by positivity
    have t1 : 0 ≤ ‖π1 p‖ + ‖π1‖ := by positivity
    have h2a : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ a := by positivity
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg h2a (mul_nonneg t0 t1), mul_nonneg h2a (sq_nonneg (‖π0 p‖ + ‖π0‖)),
      mul_nonneg h2a (sq_nonneg (‖π1 p‖ + ‖π1‖))]
  
  obtain ⟨Xf, hXf⟩ : ∃ X : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ, X = fun p => rad p.1 ^ 2 / (2 * Q p) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have e : (fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ => ψ (rad p.1 ^ 2 / (2 * Q p))) = ψ ∘ Xf := by rw [hXf]; rfl
  have hXeq : Xf = fun p => S2 p * Q p ^ (-1 : ℝ) := by
    funext p
    rw [hXf, hS2]
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, Pi.add_apply, smul_eq_mul, hπ0, hπ1, Real.rpow_neg_one]
    unfold rad
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    ring
  have hWs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => Q p ^ (-1 : ℝ)) O :=
    hQs.rpow_const_of_ne (fun p hp => (hQpos p hp).ne')
  have hXs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Xf O := by
    rw [hXeq]; exact hS2s.contDiffOn.mul hWs
  refine ⟨?_, fun j => ?_⟩
  · rw [e]; exact hψs.comp_contDiffOn hXs
  choose Cw hCw using hW
  
  have hXb : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ Cx : ℝ, 0 ≤ Cx ∧ ∀ p ∈ O, Q p ≤ 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i Xf p‖ ≤
        Cx * ((‖π0 p‖ + ‖π0‖ + (‖π1 p‖ + ‖π1‖)) ^ 2 * Q p ^ (-1 - 2 * (i : ℝ))) := by
    intro i
    refine ⟨∑ b ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose b : ℝ) * 2 ^ b * |Cw (i - b)|,
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => by positivity), fun p hp hq1 => ?_⟩
    have hu := hQpos p hp
    have hL := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le (hS2s.contDiffOn (s := O)) hWs hO.uniqueDiffOn hp
      (n := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO hp] at hL
    rw [hXeq]
    refine hL.trans ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro b _
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen b hO hp, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (i - b) hO hp]
    have e1 := hS2b b p
    have e2 := hCw (i - b) p hp hq1
    have hexp : Q p ^ (-1 - 2 * ((i - b : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ Q p ^ (-1 - 2 * (i : ℝ)) := by
      apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hu hq1
      have : ((i - b : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ i := by exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le i b
      linarith
    have e3 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (i - b) (fun p => Q p ^ (-1 : ℝ)) p‖ ≤
        |Cw (i - b)| * Q p ^ (-1 - 2 * (i : ℝ)) :=
      e2.trans (mul_le_mul (le_abs_self _) hexp (Real.rpow_nonneg hu.le _) (abs_nonneg _))
    have hA : 0 ≤ (‖π0 p‖ + ‖π0‖ + (‖π1 p‖ + ‖π1‖)) ^ 2 := by positivity
    calc (i.choose b : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ b S2 p‖ *
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (i - b) (fun p => Q p ^ (-1 : ℝ)) p‖
        ≤ (i.choose b : ℝ) * (2 ^ b * (‖π0 p‖ + ‖π0‖ + (‖π1 p‖ + ‖π1‖)) ^ 2) *
          (|Cw (i - b)| * Q p ^ (-1 - 2 * (i : ℝ))) := by
          apply mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) e3 (norm_nonneg _)
          positivity
      _ = (i.choose b : ℝ) * 2 ^ b * |Cw (i - b)| *
          ((‖π0 p‖ + ‖π0‖ + (‖π1 p‖ + ‖π1‖)) ^ 2 * Q p ^ (-1 - 2 * (i : ℝ))) := by ring
  choose Cx hCx0 hCx using hXb
  choose Kψ hKψ using hψb
  obtain ⟨K', hK'⟩ : ∃ K' : ℝ, K' = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |Kψ i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hK'0 : 0 ≤ K' := by rw [hK']; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, R = Real.sqrt (2 * |M2|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨A0, hA0⟩ : ∃ A0 : ℝ, A0 = (2 * R + ‖π0‖ + ‖π1‖) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA00 : 0 ≤ A0 := by rw [hA0]; positivity
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), Cx i * A0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), Cx i * A0 :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hCx0 i) hA00)
  have hc1 : 1 ≤ c := by rw [hc]; linarith
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by linarith
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ) * K' * c ^ j :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hK'0) (pow_nonneg hc0 _)
  refine ⟨(j.factorial : ℝ) * K' * c ^ j, fun p hp hq1 => ?_⟩
  have hu := hQpos p hp
  rw [e]
  have hpow : ∀ i : ℕ, Q p ^ (-(3 * (i : ℝ))) = ((Q p ^ 3) ^ i)⁻¹ := by
    intro i
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hu.le, show (3 * (i : ℝ)) = ((3 * i : ℕ) : ℝ) by push_cast; ring,
      Real.rpow_natCast, pow_mul]
  by_cases hcase : M2 < Xf p
  · have hN : IsOpen (O ∩ Xf ⁻¹' Set.Ioi M2) :=
      hXs.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hO isOpen_Ioi
    have hev : (ψ ∘ Xf) =ᶠ[nhds p] fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hN.mem_nhds ⟨hp, hcase⟩)
        (fun q hq => hψz _ (le_of_lt (show M2 < Xf q from hq.2)))
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg hC0 (Real.rpow_nonneg hu.le _)
  · replace hcase : Xf p ≤ M2 := not_lt.mp hcase
    have hu' : Q p ≠ 0 := hu.ne'
    have hX0 : 0 ≤ Xf p := by
      rw [hXf]
      exact div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M2 := le_trans hX0 hcase
    have hrad : rad p.1 ^ 2 = 2 * Q p * Xf p := by
      rw [hXf]
      field_simp
    have hrad2 : p.1 0 ^ 2 + p.1 1 ^ 2 = rad p.1 ^ 2 := by
      unfold rad
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    have hle : p.1 0 ^ 2 + p.1 1 ^ 2 ≤ 2 * |M2| := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hM0, hrad2, hrad]
      nlinarith
    have hy0 : |p.1 0| ≤ R := by
      rw [hR]; exact Real.abs_le_sqrt (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p.1 1)])
    have hy1 : |p.1 1| ≤ R := by
      rw [hR]; exact Real.abs_le_sqrt (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p.1 0)])
    have hAp : (‖π0 p‖ + ‖π0‖ + (‖π1 p‖ + ‖π1‖)) ^ 2 ≤ A0 := by
      rw [hA0, hπ0, hπ1, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity)
      linarith
    have hψbd : ∀ i ≤ j, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ψ Set.univ (Xf p)‖ ≤ K' := by
      intro i hi
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_univ]
      refine (hKψ i (Xf p)).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans ?_)
      rw [hK']
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Kψ i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
    have hXd : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ j → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i Xf O p‖ ≤ (c / Q p ^ 3) ^ i := by
      intro i hi1 hij
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO hp]
      have h1 := hCx i p hp hq1
      have hexp : Q p ^ (-1 - 2 * (i : ℝ)) ≤ Q p ^ (-(3 * (i : ℝ))) := by
        apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hu hq1
        have : (1:ℝ) ≤ i := by exact_mod_cast hi1
        linarith
      have hCi : Cx i * A0 ≤ c ^ i := by
        have h3 := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => Cx i * A0)
          (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hCx0 i) hA00) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hij))
        have h4 := le_self_pow₀ hc1 (by omega : i ≠ 0)
        linarith
      have hqi : 0 ≤ ((Q p ^ 3) ^ i)⁻¹ := by positivity
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i Xf p‖
          ≤ Cx i * ((‖π0 p‖ + ‖π0‖ + (‖π1 p‖ + ‖π1‖)) ^ 2 * Q p ^ (-1 - 2 * (i : ℝ))) := h1
        _ ≤ Cx i * (A0 * Q p ^ (-(3 * (i : ℝ)))) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (hCx0 i)
            exact mul_le_mul hAp hexp (Real.rpow_nonneg hu.le _) hA00
        _ = Cx i * A0 * ((Q p ^ 3) ^ i)⁻¹ := by rw [hpow i]; ring
        _ ≤ c ^ i * ((Q p ^ 3) ^ i)⁻¹ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCi hqi
        _ = (c / Q p ^ 3) ^ i := by rw [div_pow, div_eq_mul_inv]
    have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le (g := ψ) (f := Xf) (t := Set.univ) (s := O)
      (n := j) (N := ∞) hψs.contDiffOn hXs (by exact_mod_cast le_top) uniqueDiffOn_univ
      hO.uniqueDiffOn (Set.mapsTo_univ _ _) hp hψbd hXd
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hO hp] at key
    refine key.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [hpow j, div_pow]
    ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ) (Φ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ), B.ok → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ {ζ | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs} → (∀ k N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ), ζ.2.1 < 1 → simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Φ ζ‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) ^ (N : ℝ)) → (∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ => Φ (p.1 2, p.2, p.2 • vtv + Y₀)) (simDomain B.h qs)) ∧ ∀ k N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (p : ℝ³ × ℝ), p ∈ simDomain B.h qs → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ => Φ (p.1 2, p.2, p.2 • vtv + Y₀)) p‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h (p.1 2) (1 - p.2) ^ (N : ℝ)

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ) (Φ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ), B.ok → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ {ζ | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs} → (∀ k N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ), ζ.2.1 < 1 → simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Φ ζ‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) ^ (N : ℝ)) → (∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ => Φ (p.1 2, p.2, p.2 • vtv + Y₀)) (simDomain B.h qs)) ∧ ∀ k N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (p : ℝ³ × ℝ), p ∈ simDomain B.h qs → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ => Φ (p.1 2, p.2, p.2 • vtv + Y₀)) p‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h (p.1 2) (1 - p.2) ^ (N : ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs Φ hok hΦs hΦb
  
  have hO3 : IsOpen {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1} :=
    isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
  have h4 : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
    hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
  have hφ : Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((ζ.1, 1 - ζ.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((ζ.1, 1 - ζ.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
      {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1} (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
    intro ζ hζ
    have h' : ζ.2.1 < 1 := hζ
    exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ζ.2.1 by linarith⟩
  have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
      (fun ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((ζ.1, 1 - ζ.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
      {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1} := h4.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
  have hΩ : IsOpen {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs} := by
    have h3 := hc.isOpen_inter_preimage hO3 (isOpen_Iio (a := qs))
    have e : {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs} =
        {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1} ∩ ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
          (fun ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((ζ.1, 1 - ζ.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))) ⁻¹' Iio qs := by
      ext ζ
      exact Iff.rfl
    rw [e]
    exact h3
  set Ω := {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs} with hΩdef
  
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ³ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ),
      L = ((EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)).prod ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ³ ℝ).prod
          ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ³ ℝ).smulRight vtv)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hI : ∀ (Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (p : ℝ³ × ℝ),
      L p + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀) = (p.1 2, p.2, p.2 • vtv + Y₀) := by
    intro Y₀ p
    rw [hL]
    simp
  have hT : ∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ,
      IsOpen ((fun z : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => z + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀)) ⁻¹' Ω) := fun Y₀ =>
    hΩ.preimage (continuous_id.add continuous_const)
  have hfc : ∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => Φ (z + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀)))
      ((fun z : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => z + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀)) ⁻¹' Ω) := fun Y₀ =>
    hΦs.comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const).contDiffOn (fun w hw => hw)
  have hpre : ∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ,
      ⇑L ⁻¹' ((fun z : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => z + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀)) ⁻¹' Ω) = simDomain B.h qs := by
    intro Y₀
    ext p
    show L p + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀) ∈ Ω ↔ _
    rw [hI Y₀ p]
    exact Iff.rfl
  have hfun : ∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, (fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ => Φ (p.1 2, p.2, p.2 • vtv + Y₀)) =
      (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => Φ (z + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀))) ∘ ⇑L := by
    intro Y₀
    funext p
    show _ = Φ (L p + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀))
    rw [hI Y₀ p]
  refine ⟨fun Y₀ => ?_, fun k N => ?_⟩
  · rw [hfun Y₀, ← hpre Y₀]
    exact (hfc Y₀).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun p hp => hp)
  · obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hΦb k N
    refine ⟨C₀ * ‖L‖ ^ k, fun Y₀ p hp => ?_⟩
    have hSo : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' ((fun z : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => z + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀)) ⁻¹' Ω)) :=
      (hT Y₀).preimage L.continuous
    have hpS : p ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' ((fun z : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => z + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀)) ⁻¹' Ω) := by
      rw [hpre Y₀]; exact hp
    have hLp : L p ∈ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => z + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀)) ⁻¹' Ω := hpS
    have e1 : iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k
        ((fun z : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => Φ (z + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀))) ∘ ⇑L)
        (⇑L ⁻¹' ((fun z : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => z + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀)) ⁻¹' Ω)) p =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((fun z : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => Φ (z + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀))) ∘ ⇑L) p :=
      iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hSo hpS
    have e2 := L.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right (hfc Y₀) (hT Y₀).uniqueDiffOn hSo.uniqueDiffOn hLp
      (i := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 : iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => Φ (z + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀)))
        ((fun z : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => z + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀)) ⁻¹' Ω) (L p) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => Φ (z + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀))) (L p) :=
      iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k (hT Y₀) hLp
    have e4 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => Φ (z + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀))) (L p) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Φ (L p + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀)) :=
      iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right k ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀) (L p)
    have key : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ => Φ (p.1 2, p.2, p.2 • vtv + Y₀)) p =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Φ ((p.1 2, p.2, p.2 • vtv + Y₀) : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => L) := by
      rw [hfun Y₀, ← e1, e2, e3, e4, hI Y₀ p]
    rw [key]
    have hp' : p.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (p.1 2) (1 - p.2) < qs := hp
    have hb := hC₀ ((p.1 2, p.2, p.2 • vtv + Y₀) : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) hp'.1 hp'.2
    calc ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Φ ((p.1 2, p.2, p.2 • vtv + Y₀) : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => L)‖
        ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Φ ((p.1 2, p.2, p.2 • vtv + Y₀) : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))‖ * ∏ _i : Fin k, ‖L‖ :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _
      _ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Φ ((p.1 2, p.2, p.2 • vtv + Y₀) : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))‖ * ‖L‖ ^ k := by
          rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      _ ≤ (C₀ * simScale B.h (p.1 2) (1 - p.2) ^ (N : ℝ)) * ‖L‖ ^ k :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
      _ = C₀ * ‖L‖ ^ k * simScale B.h (p.1 2) (1 - p.2) ^ (N : ℝ) := by ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (U : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (w : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ p ∈ U, 0 < w p ∧ w p ≤ 1) → (∀ f1 f2 : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f1 U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f2 U → (∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C a : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ U, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f1 p‖ ≤ C * w p ^ (-a)) → (∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C a : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ U, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f2 p‖ ≤ C * w p ^ (-a)) → ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C a : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ U, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p => f1 p * f2 p) p‖ ≤ C * w p ^ (-a)) ∧ (∀ f : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → (∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C a : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ U, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f p‖ ≤ C * w p ^ (-a)) → ∀ (Cg : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (j N : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ g : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → (∀ (i M : ℕ) (p : ℝ³ × ℝ), p ∈ U → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g p‖ ≤ Cg i M * w p ^ (M : ℝ)) → ∀ p ∈ U, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p => f p * g p) p‖ ≤ C * w p ^ (N : ℝ))

signature.name: weight_leibniz_calculus_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (U : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (w : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ p ∈ U, 0 < w p ∧ w p ≤ 1) → (∀ f1 f2 : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f1 U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f2 U → (∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C a : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ U, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f1 p‖ ≤ C * w p ^ (-a)) → (∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C a : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ U, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f2 p‖ ≤ C * w p ^ (-a)) → ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C a : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ U, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p => f1 p * f2 p) p‖ ≤ C * w p ^ (-a)) ∧ (∀ f : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → (∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C a : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ U, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f p‖ ≤ C * w p ^ (-a)) → ∀ (Cg : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (j N : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ g : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → (∀ (i M : ℕ) (p : ℝ³ × ℝ), p ∈ U → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g p‖ ≤ Cg i M * w p ^ (M : ℝ)) → ∀ p ∈ U, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p => f p * g p) p‖ ≤ C * w p ^ (N : ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro U w hU hw
  have leib : ∀ (f g : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → ∀ p ∈ U, ∀ n : ℕ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun p => f p * g p) p‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (n.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f p‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) g p‖ := by
    intro f g hf hg p hp n
    have h := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hf hg hU.uniqueDiffOn hp (n := n)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hU hp] at h
    refine h.trans (le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_))
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hU hp, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (n - i) hU hp]
  have unif : ∀ (F : ℕ → ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ), (∀ i : ℕ, ∃ C a : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ U, F i p ≤ C * w p ^ (-a)) →
      ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ C A : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ p ∈ U, F i p ≤ C * w p ^ (-A) := by
    intro F hF n
    choose Cf af hFb using hF
    refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), |Cf i|, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), |af i|,
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _), Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _), ?_⟩
    intro i hi p hp
    obtain ⟨hw0, hw1⟩ := hw p hp
    have hmem : i ∈ Finset.range (n+1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
    have hC : |Cf i| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), |Cf i| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cf i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) hmem
    have hA : |af i| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), |af i| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |af i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) hmem
    have hpow : w p ^ (-af i) ≤ w p ^ (-(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), |af i|)) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hw0 hw1 (by linarith [le_abs_self (af i)])
    calc F i p ≤ Cf i * w p ^ (-af i) := hFb i p hp
      _ ≤ |Cf i| * w p ^ (-af i) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hw0.le _)
      _ ≤ |Cf i| * w p ^ (-(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), |af i|)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (abs_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC (Real.rpow_nonneg hw0.le _)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro f1 f2 hf1 hf2 hb1 hb2 j
    obtain ⟨C1, A1, hC1, hA1, h1⟩ := unif (fun i p => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f1 p‖) hb1 j
    obtain ⟨C2, A2, hC2, hA2, h2⟩ := unif (fun i p => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f2 p‖) hb2 j
    refine ⟨(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j+1), (j.choose i : ℝ)) * C1 * C2, A1 + A2, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hw0, hw1⟩ := hw p hp
    have e : w p ^ (-(A1 + A2)) = w p ^ (-A1) * w p ^ (-A2) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hw0, neg_add]
    refine (leib f1 f2 hf1 hf2 p hp j).trans ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_
    have hi' : i ≤ j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
    have b1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f1 p‖ ≤ C1 * w p ^ (-A1) := h1 i hi' p hp
    have b2 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j - i) f2 p‖ ≤ C2 * w p ^ (-A2) := h2 (j - i) (Nat.sub_le j i) p hp
    rw [e]
    have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ (j.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have p1 : 0 ≤ w p ^ (-A1) := Real.rpow_nonneg hw0.le _
    calc (j.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f1 p‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j - i) f2 p‖
        ≤ (j.choose i : ℝ) * (C1 * w p ^ (-A1)) * (C2 * w p ^ (-A2)) := by
          apply mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b1 hc) b2 (norm_nonneg _)
          exact mul_nonneg hc (mul_nonneg hC1 p1)
      _ = _ := by ring
  · intro f hf hb Cg j N
    obtain ⟨C1, A1, hC1, hA1, h1⟩ := unif (fun i p => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f p‖) hb j
    refine ⟨C1 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j+1), (j.choose i : ℝ) * |Cg (j - i) (N + ⌈A1⌉₊)|, ?_⟩
    intro g hg hgb p hp
    obtain ⟨hw0, hw1⟩ := hw p hp
    have hpow : w p ^ (-A1) * w p ^ (((N + ⌈A1⌉₊ : ℕ)) : ℝ) ≤ w p ^ (N : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hw0]
      apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hw0 hw1
      push_cast
      linarith [Nat.le_ceil A1]
    refine (leib f g hf hg p hp j).trans ?_
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_
    have hi' : i ≤ j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
    have b1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f p‖ ≤ C1 * w p ^ (-A1) := h1 i hi' p hp
    have b2 := hgb (j - i) (N + ⌈A1⌉₊) p hp
    have b2' : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j - i) g p‖ ≤
        |Cg (j - i) (N + ⌈A1⌉₊)| * w p ^ (((N + ⌈A1⌉₊ : ℕ)) : ℝ) :=
      b2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hw0.le _))
    have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ (j.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have p1 : 0 ≤ w p ^ (-A1) := Real.rpow_nonneg hw0.le _
    have hK : 0 ≤ (j.choose i : ℝ) * C1 * |Cg (j - i) (N + ⌈A1⌉₊)| :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc hC1) (abs_nonneg _)
    calc (j.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f p‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j - i) g p‖
        ≤ (j.choose i : ℝ) * (C1 * w p ^ (-A1)) *
            (|Cg (j - i) (N + ⌈A1⌉₊)| * w p ^ (((N + ⌈A1⌉₊ : ℕ)) : ℝ)) := by
          apply mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b1 hc) b2' (norm_nonneg _)
          exact mul_nonneg hc (mul_nonneg hC1 p1)
      _ = ((j.choose i : ℝ) * C1 * |Cg (j - i) (N + ⌈A1⌉₊)|) *
            (w p ^ (-A1) * w p ^ (((N + ⌈A1⌉₊ : ℕ)) : ℝ)) := by ring
      _ ≤ ((j.choose i : ℝ) * C1 * |Cg (j - i) (N + ⌈A1⌉₊)|) * w p ^ (N : ℝ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow hK
      _ = C1 * ((j.choose i : ℝ) * |Cg (j - i) (N + ⌈A1⌉₊)|) * w p ^ (N : ℝ) := by ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (B : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (g : ℝ → E) (x0 : E), Continuous B → Continuous g → ∃ y : ℝ → E, y 0 = x0 ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt y (B v (y v) + g v) v

signature.name: linear_ode_global_exists
signature.statement: ∀ (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (B : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (g : ℝ → E) (x0 : E), Continuous B → Continuous g → ∃ y : ℝ → E, y 0 = x0 ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt y (B v (y v) + g v) v

proof.tactics:
by
  intro E _ _ _ B g x0 hB hg
  have : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℝ E
  
  have retr : ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ ρ : E → E, (∀ x y, ‖ρ x - ρ y‖ ≤ 2 * ‖x - y‖) ∧
      (∀ x, ‖ρ x‖ ≤ ‖x‖) ∧ (∀ x, ‖ρ x‖ ≤ R) ∧ (∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ R → ρ x = x) := by
    intro R hR
    refine ⟨fun x => (R / max ‖x‖ R) • x, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x y
      have hmx : 0 < max ‖x‖ R := lt_max_of_lt_right hR
      have hmy : 0 < max ‖y‖ R := lt_max_of_lt_right hR
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = R / max ‖x‖ R := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ, b = R / max ‖y‖ R := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by rw [ha]; exact div_nonneg hR.le hmx.le
      have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := by rw [ha]; exact (div_le_one hmx).2 (le_max_right _ _)
      have hyb : ‖y‖ ≤ max ‖y‖ R := le_max_left _ _
      have hab : |a - b| * ‖y‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by
        have e : a - b = a * (max ‖y‖ R - max ‖x‖ R) / max ‖y‖ R := by
          rw [ha, hb]; field_simp
        have hm := abs_max_sub_max_le_abs ‖y‖ ‖x‖ R
        have hn := abs_norm_sub_norm_le y x
        rw [norm_sub_rev] at hn
        rw [e, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha0, abs_of_pos hmy]
        have e2 : a * |max ‖y‖ R - max ‖x‖ R| / max ‖y‖ R * ‖y‖ =
            (a * (‖y‖ / max ‖y‖ R)) * |max ‖y‖ R - max ‖x‖ R| := by ring
        rw [e2]
        have h1 : ‖y‖ / max ‖y‖ R ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hmy).2 hyb
        have h2 : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ / max ‖y‖ R := div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hmy.le
        have h3 : a * (‖y‖ / max ‖y‖ R) ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
        calc a * (‖y‖ / max ‖y‖ R) * |max ‖y‖ R - max ‖x‖ R|
            ≤ 1 * |max ‖y‖ R - max ‖x‖ R| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h3 (abs_nonneg _)
          _ ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by linarith
      have e2 : a • x - b • y = a • (x - y) + (a - b) • y := by
        rw [smul_sub, sub_smul]; abel
      show ‖(R / max ‖x‖ R) • x - (R / max ‖y‖ R) • y‖ ≤ 2 * ‖x - y‖
      rw [← ha, ← hb, e2]
      calc ‖a • (x - y) + (a - b) • y‖ ≤ ‖a • (x - y)‖ + ‖(a - b) • y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = a * ‖x - y‖ + |a - b| * ‖y‖ := by
            rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ha0]
        _ ≤ 1 * ‖x - y‖ + ‖x - y‖ :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha1 (norm_nonneg _)) hab
        _ = 2 * ‖x - y‖ := by ring
    · intro x
      have hmx : 0 < max ‖x‖ R := lt_max_of_lt_right hR
      show ‖(R / max ‖x‖ R) • x‖ ≤ ‖x‖
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hR.le hmx.le)]
      have ha1 : R / max ‖x‖ R ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hmx).2 (le_max_right _ _)
      calc R / max ‖x‖ R * ‖x‖ ≤ 1 * ‖x‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha1 (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = ‖x‖ := one_mul _
    · intro x
      have hmx : 0 < max ‖x‖ R := lt_max_of_lt_right hR
      show ‖(R / max ‖x‖ R) • x‖ ≤ R
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hR.le hmx.le)]
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ hmx]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left _ _) hR.le
    · intro x hx
      show (R / max ‖x‖ R) • x = x
      rw [max_eq_right hx, div_self hR.ne', one_smul]
  
  have fwd : ∀ (r F : ℝ → E) (K ε T : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ ε → 0 ≤ T →
      (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivWithinAt r (F v) (Set.Icc (-T) T) v) →
      (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖F v‖ ≤ K * ‖r v‖ + ε) →
      ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) T, ‖r v‖ ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * T) * Real.exp (K * T) := by
    intro r F K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v hv
    have hcont : ContinuousOn r (Set.Icc 0 T) := fun x hx =>
      ((hd x ⟨by linarith [hx.1], hx.2⟩).continuousWithinAt).mono
        (Set.Icc_subset_Icc (by linarith) le_rfl)
    have h1 := norm_le_gronwallBound_of_norm_deriv_right_le (f := r) (f' := F)
      (δ := ‖r 0‖) (K := K) (ε := ε) (a := 0) (b := T) hcont
      (fun x hx => (hd x ⟨by linarith [hx.1], hx.2.le⟩).mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin
        (Icc_mem_nhdsGE_of_mem ⟨by linarith [hx.1], hx.2⟩)) le_rfl
      (fun x hx => hbd x ⟨by linarith [hx.1], hx.2.le⟩)
      v hv
    rw [sub_zero] at h1
    refine h1.trans ?_
    have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := hv.1
    have hvT : v ≤ T := hv.2
    have hδ : 0 ≤ ‖r 0‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have key : gronwallBound ‖r 0‖ K ε v ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * v) * Real.exp (K * v) := by
      rcases hK.eq_or_lt with h | h
      · subst h
        rw [gronwallBound_K0]
        simp
      · rw [gronwallBound_of_K_ne_0 h.ne']
        have hp := Real.exp_pos (K * v)
        have e1 : Real.exp (K * v) * Real.exp (-(K * v)) = 1 := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
        have e2 := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(K * v))
        have e2' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e2 hp.le
        have e3 : Real.exp (K * v) - 1 ≤ K * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by
          nlinarith
        have hc : ε / K * K = ε := div_mul_cancel₀ ε h.ne'
        have e4 : ε / K * (Real.exp (K * v) - 1) ≤ ε * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by
          calc ε / K * (Real.exp (K * v) - 1) ≤ ε / K * (K * v * Real.exp (K * v)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e3 (div_nonneg hε h.le)
            _ = ε / K * K * (v * Real.exp (K * v)) := by ring
            _ = ε * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by rw [hc]; ring
        nlinarith
    refine key.trans ?_
    apply mul_le_mul
    · nlinarith
    · exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)
    · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
    · nlinarith
  
  have gron : ∀ (r F : ℝ → E) (K ε T : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ ε → 0 ≤ T →
      (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivWithinAt r (F v) (Set.Icc (-T) T) v) →
      (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖F v‖ ≤ K * ‖r v‖ + ε) →
      ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖r v‖ ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * T) * Real.exp (K * T) := by
    intro r F K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v hv
    rcases le_or_gt 0 v with h0 | h0
    · exact fwd r F K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v ⟨h0, hv.2⟩
    · have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (Neg.neg : ℝ → ℝ) (Set.Icc (-T) T) (Set.Icc (-T) T) :=
        fun u hu => ⟨by linarith [hu.2], by linarith [hu.1]⟩
      have hd' : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivWithinAt (fun u => r (-u))
          ((fun u => -F (-u)) u) (Set.Icc (-T) T) u := by
        intro u hu
        have h2 : HasDerivWithinAt (r ∘ Neg.neg) ((-1:ℝ) • F (-u)) (Set.Icc (-T) T) u :=
          (hd (-u) (hmaps hu)).scomp u (hasDerivWithinAt_neg u (Set.Icc (-T) T)) hmaps
        have h3 : (-1:ℝ) • F (-u) = -F (-u) := by simp
        rw [h3] at h2
        exact h2
      have hbd' : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖(fun u => -F (-u)) u‖ ≤
          K * ‖(fun u => r (-u)) u‖ + ε := by
        intro u hu
        simp only [norm_neg]
        exact hbd (-u) (hmaps hu)
      have := fwd (fun u => r (-u)) (fun u => -F (-u)) K ε T hK hε hT hd' hbd' (-v)
        ⟨by linarith, by linarith [hv.1]⟩
      simpa only [neg_neg, neg_zero] using this
  
  have exI : ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∃ α : ℝ → E, α 0 = x0 ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivWithinAt α (B t (α t) + g t) (Set.Icc (-T) T) t := by
    intro T hT
    obtain ⟨CB, hCB⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := -T) (b := T)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      hB.continuousOn
    obtain ⟨Cg, hCg⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := -T) (b := T)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      hg.continuousOn
    obtain ⟨K, hKdef⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = max CB 0 + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨G, hGdef⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ, G = max Cg 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hK : 0 < K := by rw [hKdef]; linarith [le_max_right CB 0]
    have hG : 0 ≤ G := by rw [hGdef]; exact le_max_right _ _
    have hBK : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖B t‖ ≤ K := fun t ht => by
      rw [hKdef]; linarith [hCB t ht, le_max_left CB 0]
    have hgG : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖g t‖ ≤ G := fun t ht => by
      rw [hGdef]; exact (hCg t ht).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, R = (‖x0‖ + G * T) * Real.exp (K * T) + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hR : 0 < R := by
      rw [hRdef]
      have h1 := Real.exp_pos (K * T)
      have h2 : 0 ≤ ‖x0‖ + G * T := add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hG hT.le)
      have h3 := mul_nonneg h2 h1.le
      linarith
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρL, hρn, hρR, hρid⟩ := retr R hR
    have hL0 : 0 ≤ K * R + G := add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK.le hR.le) hG
    have t0mem : (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T := ⟨by linarith, hT.le⟩
    have hPL : IsPicardLindelof (fun t x => B t (ρ x) + g t) (⟨0, t0mem⟩ : Set.Icc (-T) T) x0
        ((K * R + G) * T).toNNReal 0 (K * R + G).toNNReal (2 * K).toNNReal := by
      apply IsPicardLindelof.mk
      · intro t ht
        apply LipschitzWith.lipschitzOnWith
        rw [lipschitzWith_iff_norm_sub_le]
        intro x y
        rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (by linarith)]
        show ‖B t (ρ x) + g t - (B t (ρ y) + g t)‖ ≤ 2 * K * ‖x - y‖
        rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← map_sub]
        calc ‖B t (ρ x - ρ y)‖ ≤ ‖B t‖ * ‖ρ x - ρ y‖ := (B t).le_opNorm _
          _ ≤ K * (2 * ‖x - y‖) := mul_le_mul (hBK t ht) (hρL x y) (norm_nonneg _) hK.le
          _ = 2 * K * ‖x - y‖ := by ring
      · intro x _
        exact ((hB.clm_apply continuous_const).add hg).continuousOn
      · intro t ht x _
        rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ hL0]
        calc ‖B t (ρ x) + g t‖ ≤ ‖B t (ρ x)‖ + ‖g t‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ ‖B t‖ * ‖ρ x‖ + ‖g t‖ := add_le_add ((B t).le_opNorm _) le_rfl
          _ ≤ K * R + G := add_le_add (mul_le_mul (hBK t ht) (hρR x) (norm_nonneg _) hK.le)
              (hgG t ht)
      · rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ hL0, Real.coe_toNNReal _ (mul_nonneg hL0 hT.le)]
        have hmax : max (T - (0:ℝ)) ((0:ℝ) - -T) = T := by simp
        show (K * R + G) * max (T - (0:ℝ)) ((0:ℝ) - -T) ≤ (K * R + G) * T - ((0 : NNReal) : ℝ)
        rw [hmax, NNReal.coe_zero, sub_zero]
    obtain ⟨α, hα0, hα⟩ := hPL.exists_eq_forall_mem_Icc_hasDerivWithinAt₀
    have hα0' : α 0 = x0 := hα0
    have hbound := gron α (fun t => B t (ρ (α t)) + g t) K G T hK.le hG hT.le hα
      (fun t ht => by
        calc ‖B t (ρ (α t)) + g t‖ ≤ ‖B t (ρ (α t))‖ + ‖g t‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ ‖B t‖ * ‖ρ (α t)‖ + ‖g t‖ := add_le_add ((B t).le_opNorm _) le_rfl
          _ ≤ K * ‖α t‖ + G := add_le_add (mul_le_mul (hBK t ht) (hρn _) (norm_nonneg _) hK.le)
              (hgG t ht))
    rw [hα0'] at hbound
    refine ⟨α, hα0', fun t ht => ?_⟩
    have hin : ‖α t‖ ≤ R := by linarith [hbound t ht]
    have h2 : HasDerivWithinAt α (B t (ρ (α t)) + g t) (Set.Icc (-T) T) t := hα t ht
    rw [hρid _ hin] at h2
    exact h2
  
  have uniq : ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∀ α β : ℝ → E,
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivWithinAt α (B t (α t) + g t) (Set.Icc (-T) T) t) →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivWithinAt β (B t (β t) + g t) (Set.Icc (-T) T) t) →
      α 0 = β 0 → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, α t = β t := by
    intro T hT α β hα hβ h0
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := -T) (b := T)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      hB.continuousOn
    have hlip : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T,
        LipschitzOnWith C.toNNReal (fun x => B t x + g t) Set.univ := by
      intro t ht
      apply LipschitzWith.lipschitzOnWith
      rw [lipschitzWith_iff_norm_sub_le]
      intro x y
      show ‖B t x + g t - (B t y + g t)‖ ≤ (C.toNNReal : ℝ) * ‖x - y‖
      rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← map_sub]
      exact ((B t).le_opNorm _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        ((hC t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)).trans (Real.le_coe_toNNReal C)) (norm_nonneg _))
    have hcα : ContinuousOn α (Set.Icc (-T) T) := fun t ht => (hα t ht).continuousWithinAt
    have hcβ : ContinuousOn β (Set.Icc (-T) T) := fun t ht => (hβ t ht).continuousWithinAt
    exact ODE_solution_unique_of_mem_Icc (v := fun t x => B t x + g t) (s := fun _ => Set.univ)
      hlip ⟨by linarith, hT⟩ hcα
      (fun t ht => (hα t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)).hasDerivAt (Icc_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2))
      (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _) hcβ
      (fun t ht => (hβ t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)).hasDerivAt (Icc_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2))
      (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _) h0
  
  choose α hα0 hα using fun n : ℕ => exI ((n:ℝ) + 1) (by positivity)
  have agree : ∀ n m : ℕ, n ≤ m → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ (n:ℝ) + 1 → α n t = α m t := by
    intro n m hnm t ht
    have hnm' : (n:ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.cast_le.mpr hnm
    have hsub : Set.Icc (-((n:ℝ) + 1)) ((n:ℝ) + 1) ⊆ Set.Icc (-((m:ℝ) + 1)) ((m:ℝ) + 1) :=
      Set.Icc_subset_Icc (by linarith) (by linarith)
    exact uniq ((n:ℝ) + 1) (by positivity) (α n) (α m) (hα n)
      (fun s hs => (hα m s (hsub hs)).mono hsub) ((hα0 n).trans (hα0 m).symm) t (abs_le.mp ht)
  refine ⟨fun t => α ⌈|t|⌉₊ t, hα0 _, fun v => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ : ∃ n0 : ℕ, n0 = ⌈|v|⌉₊ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hv : |v| ≤ (n0:ℝ) := by rw [hn0]; exact Nat.le_ceil _
  have hvlt := abs_lt.mp (show |v| < (n0:ℝ) + 1 by linarith)
  have hev : (fun t => α ⌈|t|⌉₊ t) =ᶠ[nhds v] α n0 := by
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds hvlt.1 hvlt.2] with t ht
    have htl : |t| < (n0:ℝ) + 1 := abs_lt.mpr ht
    have hk : |t| ≤ ((⌈|t|⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
    rcases le_total ⌈|t|⌉₊ n0 with h | h
    · exact agree _ _ h t (by linarith)
    · exact (agree _ _ h t htl.le).symm
  have hd : HasDerivAt (α n0) (B v (α n0 v) + g v) v :=
    (hα n0 v ⟨hvlt.1.le, hvlt.2.le⟩).hasDerivAt (Icc_mem_nhds hvlt.1 hvlt.2)
  show HasDerivAt (fun t => α ⌈|t|⌉₊ t) (B v (α ⌈|v|⌉₊ v) + g v) v
  rw [← hn0]
  exact hd.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (U : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (A : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (b : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → E) (z0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → E) (z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → E), IsOpen U → ContinuousOn A (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContinuousOn b (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContinuousOn z0 U → (∀ s ∈ U, z s 0 = z0 s ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (z s) (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v)) v) → ContinuousOn (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => z w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ)

signature.statement: ∀ (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (U : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (A : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (b : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → E) (z0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → E) (z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → E), IsOpen U → ContinuousOn A (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContinuousOn b (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContinuousOn z0 U → (∀ s ∈ U, z s 0 = z0 s ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (z s) (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v)) v) → ContinuousOn (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => z w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro E _ _ _ U A b z0 z hU hA hb hz0 hsol
  
  have fwd : ∀ (r : ℝ → E) (B : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (g : ℝ → E) (K ε T : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ ε → 0 ≤ T →
      (∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt r (B v (r v) + g v) v) → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖B v‖ ≤ K ∧ ‖g v‖ ≤ ε) →
      ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) T, ‖r v‖ ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * T) * Real.exp (K * T) := by
    intro r B g K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v hv
    have hcont : ContinuousOn r (Set.Icc 0 T) := fun x _ => (hd x).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have h1 := norm_le_gronwallBound_of_norm_deriv_right_le (f := r) (f' := fun x => B x (r x) + g x)
      (δ := ‖r 0‖) (K := K) (ε := ε) (a := 0) (b := T) hcont
      (fun x _ => (hd x).hasDerivWithinAt) le_rfl
      (fun x hx => by
        obtain ⟨hB, hg⟩ := hbd x ⟨by linarith [hx.1], hx.2.le⟩
        calc ‖B x (r x) + g x‖ ≤ ‖B x (r x)‖ + ‖g x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ ‖B x‖ * ‖r x‖ + ‖g x‖ := add_le_add ((B x).le_opNorm _) le_rfl
          _ ≤ K * ‖r x‖ + ε := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB (norm_nonneg _)) hg)
      v hv
    rw [sub_zero] at h1
    refine h1.trans ?_
    have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := hv.1
    have hvT : v ≤ T := hv.2
    have hδ : 0 ≤ ‖r 0‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have key : gronwallBound ‖r 0‖ K ε v ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * v) * Real.exp (K * v) := by
      rcases hK.eq_or_lt with h | h
      · subst h
        rw [gronwallBound_K0]
        simp
      · rw [gronwallBound_of_K_ne_0 h.ne']
        have hp := Real.exp_pos (K * v)
        have e1 : Real.exp (K * v) * Real.exp (-(K * v)) = 1 := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
        have e2 := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(K * v))
        have e2' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e2 hp.le
        have e3 : Real.exp (K * v) - 1 ≤ K * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by
          nlinarith
        have hc : ε / K * K = ε := div_mul_cancel₀ ε h.ne'
        have e4 : ε / K * (Real.exp (K * v) - 1) ≤ ε * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by
          calc ε / K * (Real.exp (K * v) - 1) ≤ ε / K * (K * v * Real.exp (K * v)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e3 (div_nonneg hε h.le)
            _ = ε / K * K * (v * Real.exp (K * v)) := by ring
            _ = ε * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by rw [hc]; ring
        nlinarith
    refine key.trans ?_
    apply mul_le_mul
    · nlinarith
    · exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)
    · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
    · nlinarith
  
  have gron : ∀ (r : ℝ → E) (B : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (g : ℝ → E) (K ε T : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ ε → 0 ≤ T →
      (∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt r (B v (r v) + g v) v) → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖B v‖ ≤ K ∧ ‖g v‖ ≤ ε) →
      ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖r v‖ ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * T) * Real.exp (K * T) := by
    intro r B g K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v hv
    rcases le_or_gt 0 v with h0 | h0
    · exact fwd r B g K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v ⟨h0, hv.2⟩
    · have hd' : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun u => r (-u))
          ((fun u => -B (-u)) u ((fun u => r (-u)) u) + (fun u => -g (-u)) u) u := by
        intro u
        have h2 : HasDerivAt (r ∘ Neg.neg) ((-1:ℝ) • (B (-u) (r (-u)) + g (-u))) u :=
          (hd (-u)).scomp u (hasDerivAt_neg u)
        have h3 : (-1:ℝ) • (B (-u) (r (-u)) + g (-u)) = (-B (-u)) (r (-u)) + -g (-u) := by
          simp
        rw [h3] at h2
        exact h2
      have hbd' : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖(fun u => -B (-u)) u‖ ≤ K ∧ ‖(fun u => -g (-u)) u‖ ≤ ε := by
        intro u hu
        simp only [norm_neg]
        exact hbd (-u) ⟨by linarith [hu.2], by linarith [hu.1]⟩
      have := fwd (fun u => r (-u)) (fun u => -B (-u)) (fun u => -g (-u)) K ε T hK hε hT hd' hbd' (-v)
        ⟨by linarith, by linarith [hv.1]⟩
      simpa only [neg_neg, neg_zero] using this
  
  have slice : ∀ (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] (f : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → F) (s0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (T : ℝ),
      ContinuousOn f (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → s0 ∈ U → ∃ ρ > 0, ∃ L : ℝ, 0 ≤ L ∧ Metric.ball s0 ρ ⊆ U ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Metric.ball s0 ρ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖f (s, t)‖ ≤ L) ∧
      ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, δ ≤ ρ ∧ ∀ s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, dist s s0 < δ → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T,
        ‖f (s, t) - f (s0, t)‖ < ε := by
    intro F _ f s0 T hf hs0
    obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU s0 hs0
    have hρ : 0 < ρ₀ / 2 := by linarith
    have hcl : Metric.closedBall s0 (ρ₀ / 2) ⊆ U :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
    have hK : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall s0 (ρ₀ / 2) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-T) T) :=
      (isCompact_closedBall s0 _).prod isCompact_Icc
    have hsub : Metric.closedBall s0 (ρ₀ / 2) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-T) T ⊆ U ×ˢ Set.univ :=
      fun w hw => ⟨hcl hw.1, Set.mem_univ _⟩
    have hfK := hf.mono hsub
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hfK
    have huc := Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp (hK.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hfK)
    refine ⟨ρ₀ / 2, hρ, max C 0, le_max_right _ _, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hcl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro s hs t ht
      exact (hC (s, t) ⟨Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hs, ht⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hδ⟩ := huc ε hε
      refine ⟨min δ₀ (ρ₀ / 2), lt_min hδ₀ hρ, min_le_right _ _, ?_⟩
      intro s hs t ht
      have hs' : s ∈ Metric.closedBall s0 (ρ₀ / 2) :=
        Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr (hs.le.trans (min_le_right _ _))
      have hs0' : s0 ∈ Metric.closedBall s0 (ρ₀ / 2) := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ.le
      have hdeq : dist (s, t) (s0, t) = dist s s0 := by
        rw [Prod.dist_eq]; simp [dist_nonneg]
      have hd : dist (s, t) (s0, t) < δ₀ := by
        rw [hdeq]; exact hs.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
      have := hδ (s, t) ⟨hs', ht⟩ (s0, t) ⟨hs0', ht⟩ hd
      rwa [dist_eq_norm] at this
  
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨s0, v0⟩ := w
  have hs0 : s0 ∈ U := hw.1
  apply ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  rw [Metric.continuousAt_iff]
  intro η hη
  obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ, T = |v0| + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := by rw [hTdef]; positivity
  have hy : Continuous (z s0) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun t => ((hsol s0 hs0).2 t).continuousAt)
  obtain ⟨Y0, hY0⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := -T) (b := T)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hy.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨Y, hYdef⟩ : ∃ Y : ℝ, Y = max Y0 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hY : 0 ≤ Y := by rw [hYdef]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hYb : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖z s0 t‖ ≤ Y := fun t ht => by
    rw [hYdef]; exact (hY0 t ht).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  obtain ⟨ρA, hρA, L, hL, hballA, hLb, hAc⟩ := slice (E →L[ℝ] E) A s0 T hA hs0
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, hbc⟩ := slice E b s0 T hb hs0
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = 2 * (1 + (Y + 1) * T) * Real.exp (L * T) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD1 : 0 < 1 + (Y + 1) * T := by nlinarith
  have hD : 0 < D := by rw [hDdef]; exact mul_pos (mul_pos two_pos hD1) (Real.exp_pos _)
  obtain ⟨η', hη'def⟩ : ∃ η' : ℝ, η' = η / D := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hη' : 0 < η' := by rw [hη'def]; exact div_pos hη hD
  have hkey : (η' + η' * (Y + 1) * T) * Real.exp (L * T) = η / 2 := by
    have e : (η' + η' * (Y + 1) * T) * Real.exp (L * T) = η' * D / 2 := by rw [hDdef]; ring
    rw [e, hη'def, div_mul_cancel₀ η hD.ne']
  obtain ⟨δA, hδA, hδAρ, hδA'⟩ := hAc η' hη'
  obtain ⟨δb, hδb, -, hδb'⟩ := hbc η' hη'
  obtain ⟨δ0, hδ0, hδ0'⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp (hz0.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hs0)) η' hη'
  obtain ⟨δt, hδt, hδt'⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hy.continuousAt (η / 2) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨min (min δA δb) (min δ0 (min δt 1)),
    lt_min (lt_min hδA hδb) (lt_min hδ0 (lt_min hδt one_pos)), ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨s, t⟩ hd
  rw [Prod.dist_eq] at hd
  have hds : dist s s0 < min (min δA δb) (min δ0 (min δt 1)) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hd
  have hdt : dist t v0 < min (min δA δb) (min δ0 (min δt 1)) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hd
  have hsA : dist s s0 < δA := hds.trans_le ((min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
  have hsb : dist s s0 < δb := hds.trans_le ((min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
  have hs00 : dist s s0 < δ0 := hds.trans_le ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
  have htt : dist t v0 < δt :=
    hdt.trans_le ((min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)))
  have ht1 : dist t v0 < 1 :=
    hdt.trans_le ((min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)))
  have hsball : s ∈ Metric.ball s0 ρA := Metric.mem_ball.mpr (hsA.trans_le hδAρ)
  have hsU : s ∈ U := hballA hsball
  have htT : t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T := by
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at ht1
    have h1 := abs_lt.mp ht1
    have h2 := neg_abs_le v0
    have h3 := le_abs_self v0
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hw' : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun u => z s u - z s0 u)
      ((fun u => A (s, u)) u ((fun u => z s u - z s0 u) u) +
        (fun u => (A (s, u) - A (s0, u)) (z s0 u) + (b (s, u) - b (s0, u))) u) u := by
    intro u
    have h := ((hsol s hsU).2 u).sub ((hsol s0 hs0).2 u)
    refine h.congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [map_sub, sub_apply]
    abel
  have hgb : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖(fun u => A (s, u)) u‖ ≤ L ∧
      ‖(fun u => (A (s, u) - A (s0, u)) (z s0 u) + (b (s, u) - b (s0, u))) u‖ ≤ η' * (Y + 1) := by
    intro u hu
    refine ⟨hLb s hsball u hu, ?_⟩
    have e1 := (hδA' s hsA u hu).le
    have e2 := (hδb' s hsb u hu).le
    show ‖(A (s, u) - A (s0, u)) (z s0 u) + (b (s, u) - b (s0, u))‖ ≤ η' * (Y + 1)
    calc ‖(A (s, u) - A (s0, u)) (z s0 u) + (b (s, u) - b (s0, u))‖
        ≤ ‖(A (s, u) - A (s0, u)) (z s0 u)‖ + ‖b (s, u) - b (s0, u)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖A (s, u) - A (s0, u)‖ * ‖z s0 u‖ + ‖b (s, u) - b (s0, u)‖ :=
          add_le_add (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _) le_rfl
      _ ≤ η' * Y + η' := add_le_add (mul_le_mul e1 (hYb u hu) (norm_nonneg _) hη'.le) e2
      _ = η' * (Y + 1) := by ring
  have hG := gron (fun u => z s u - z s0 u) (fun u => A (s, u))
    (fun u => (A (s, u) - A (s0, u)) (z s0 u) + (b (s, u) - b (s0, u))) L (η' * (Y + 1)) T hL
    (mul_nonneg hη'.le (by linarith)) hT hw' hgb t htT
  have h0 : ‖z s 0 - z s0 0‖ ≤ η' := by
    rw [(hsol s hsU).1, (hsol s0 hs0).1, ← dist_eq_norm]
    exact (hδ0' hs00).le
  have hwt : ‖z s t - z s0 t‖ ≤ η / 2 := by
    rw [← hkey]
    calc ‖z s t - z s0 t‖ ≤ (‖z s 0 - z s0 0‖ + η' * (Y + 1) * T) * Real.exp (L * T) := hG
      _ ≤ (η' + η' * (Y + 1) * T) * Real.exp (L * T) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (add_le_add h0 le_rfl) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hyt : ‖z s0 t - z s0 v0‖ < η / 2 := by
    rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact hδt' htt
  show dist (z s t) (z s0 v0) < η
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  calc ‖z s t - z s0 v0‖ = ‖(z s t - z s0 t) + (z s0 t - z s0 v0)‖ := by rw [sub_add_sub_cancel]
    _ ≤ ‖z s t - z s0 t‖ + ‖z s0 t - z s0 v0‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ < η / 2 + η / 2 := by linarith
    _ = η := by ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (U : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (A : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (b : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → E) (z0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → E) (z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → E) (W : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 A (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 b (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 z0 U → ContinuousOn (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => z w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContinuousOn (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => W w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → (∀ s ∈ U, z s 0 = z0 s ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (z s) (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v)) v) → (∀ s ∈ U, W s 0 = fderiv ℝ z0 s ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (W s) ((A (s, v)).comp (W s v) + (fderiv ℝ A (s, v) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ).flip (z s v) + fderiv ℝ b (s, v) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) v) → ∀ s ∈ U, ∀ v : ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => z w.1 w.2) ((W s v).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) + (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ).smulRight (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v))) (s, v)

signature.name: linear_ode_param_hasFDerivAt
signature.statement: ∀ (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (U : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (A : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (b : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → E) (z0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → E) (z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → E) (W : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 A (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 b (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 z0 U → ContinuousOn (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => z w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContinuousOn (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => W w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → (∀ s ∈ U, z s 0 = z0 s ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (z s) (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v)) v) → (∀ s ∈ U, W s 0 = fderiv ℝ z0 s ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (W s) ((A (s, v)).comp (W s v) + (fderiv ℝ A (s, v) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ).flip (z s v) + fderiv ℝ b (s, v) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) v) → ∀ s ∈ U, ∀ v : ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => z w.1 w.2) ((W s v).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) + (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ).smulRight (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v))) (s, v)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro E _ _ _ U A b z0 z W hU hA hb hz0 hzc _ hsol hWsol s hs v
  
  have fwd : ∀ (r : ℝ → E) (B : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (g : ℝ → E) (K ε T : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ ε → 0 ≤ T →
      (∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt r (B v (r v) + g v) v) → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖B v‖ ≤ K ∧ ‖g v‖ ≤ ε) →
      ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) T, ‖r v‖ ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * T) * Real.exp (K * T) := by
    intro r B g K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v hv
    have hcont : ContinuousOn r (Set.Icc 0 T) := fun x _ => (hd x).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have h1 := norm_le_gronwallBound_of_norm_deriv_right_le (f := r) (f' := fun x => B x (r x) + g x)
      (δ := ‖r 0‖) (K := K) (ε := ε) (a := 0) (b := T) hcont
      (fun x _ => (hd x).hasDerivWithinAt) le_rfl
      (fun x hx => by
        obtain ⟨hB, hg⟩ := hbd x ⟨by linarith [hx.1], hx.2.le⟩
        calc ‖B x (r x) + g x‖ ≤ ‖B x (r x)‖ + ‖g x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ ‖B x‖ * ‖r x‖ + ‖g x‖ := add_le_add ((B x).le_opNorm _) le_rfl
          _ ≤ K * ‖r x‖ + ε := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB (norm_nonneg _)) hg)
      v hv
    rw [sub_zero] at h1
    refine h1.trans ?_
    have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := hv.1
    have hvT : v ≤ T := hv.2
    have hδ : 0 ≤ ‖r 0‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have key : gronwallBound ‖r 0‖ K ε v ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * v) * Real.exp (K * v) := by
      rcases hK.eq_or_lt with h | h
      · subst h
        rw [gronwallBound_K0]
        simp
      · rw [gronwallBound_of_K_ne_0 h.ne']
        have hp := Real.exp_pos (K * v)
        have e1 : Real.exp (K * v) * Real.exp (-(K * v)) = 1 := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
        have e2 := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(K * v))
        have e2' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e2 hp.le
        have e3 : Real.exp (K * v) - 1 ≤ K * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by
          nlinarith
        have hc : ε / K * K = ε := div_mul_cancel₀ ε h.ne'
        have e4 : ε / K * (Real.exp (K * v) - 1) ≤ ε * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by
          calc ε / K * (Real.exp (K * v) - 1) ≤ ε / K * (K * v * Real.exp (K * v)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e3 (div_nonneg hε h.le)
            _ = ε / K * K * (v * Real.exp (K * v)) := by ring
            _ = ε * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by rw [hc]; ring
        nlinarith
    refine key.trans ?_
    apply mul_le_mul
    · nlinarith
    · exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)
    · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
    · nlinarith
  
  have gron : ∀ (r : ℝ → E) (B : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (g : ℝ → E) (K ε T : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ ε → 0 ≤ T →
      (∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt r (B v (r v) + g v) v) → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖B v‖ ≤ K ∧ ‖g v‖ ≤ ε) →
      ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖r v‖ ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * T) * Real.exp (K * T) := by
    intro r B g K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v hv
    rcases le_or_gt 0 v with h0 | h0
    · exact fwd r B g K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v ⟨h0, hv.2⟩
    · have hd' : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun u => r (-u))
          ((fun u => -B (-u)) u ((fun u => r (-u)) u) + (fun u => -g (-u)) u) u := by
        intro u
        have h2 : HasDerivAt (r ∘ Neg.neg) ((-1:ℝ) • (B (-u) (r (-u)) + g (-u))) u :=
          (hd (-u)).scomp u (hasDerivAt_neg u)
        have h3 : (-1:ℝ) • (B (-u) (r (-u)) + g (-u)) = (-B (-u)) (r (-u)) + -g (-u) := by
          simp
        rw [h3] at h2
        exact h2
      have hbd' : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖(fun u => -B (-u)) u‖ ≤ K ∧ ‖(fun u => -g (-u)) u‖ ≤ ε := by
        intro u hu
        simp only [norm_neg]
        exact hbd (-u) ⟨by linarith [hu.2], by linarith [hu.1]⟩
      have := fwd (fun u => r (-u)) (fun u => -B (-u)) (fun u => -g (-u)) K ε T hK hε hT hd' hbd' (-v)
        ⟨by linarith, by linarith [hv.1]⟩
      simpa only [neg_neg, neg_zero] using this
  
  obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU s hs
  obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ, T = |v| + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := by rw [hTdef]; positivity
  have hρ : 0 < ρ₀ / 2 := by linarith
  have hcl : Metric.closedBall s (ρ₀ / 2) ⊆ U :=
    (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
  have hKc : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall s (ρ₀ / 2) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-T) T) :=
    (isCompact_closedBall s _).prod isCompact_Icc
  have hKsub : Metric.closedBall s (ρ₀ / 2) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-T) T ⊆ U ×ˢ Set.univ :=
    fun w hw => ⟨hcl hw.1, Set.mem_univ _⟩
  have hO : IsOpen (U ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) := hU.prod isOpen_univ
  have hmemK : ∀ (h : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (t : ℝ), ‖h‖ ≤ ρ₀ / 2 → t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T →
      ((s + h, t) : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) ∈ Metric.closedBall s (ρ₀ / 2) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-T) T := by
    intro h t hh ht
    refine ⟨?_, ht⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left]
    exact hh
  have hs0K : ∀ t : ℝ, t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T →
      ((s, t) : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) ∈ Metric.closedBall s (ρ₀ / 2) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-T) T :=
    fun t ht => ⟨Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ.le, ht⟩
  have hdistK : ∀ (h : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (u : ℝ), dist ((s + h, u) : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) (s, u) = ‖h‖ := by
    intro h u
    rw [Prod.dist_eq]
    simp only [dist_self, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left]
    exact max_eq_left (norm_nonneg _)
  
  have c2 : ∀ (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (G : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → F),
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
        ∀ (h : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (t : ℝ), ‖h‖ < δ → t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T →
          ‖G (s + h, t) - G (s, t)‖ ≤ C * ‖h‖ ∧
          ‖G (s + h, t) - G (s, t) - (fderiv ℝ G (s, t) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) h‖
            ≤ η * ‖h‖ := by
    intro F _ _ G hG
    have hdiff : ∀ w ∈ U ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), HasFDerivAt G (fderiv ℝ G w) w := fun w hw =>
      (((hG.differentiableOn one_ne_zero) w hw).differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds hw)).hasFDerivAt
    have hDc : ContinuousOn (fun w => fderiv ℝ G w ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ)
        (U ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
      (hG.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO le_rfl).clm_comp continuousOn_const
    have hDK := hDc.mono hKsub
    obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hDK
    have huc := Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp (hKc.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hDK)
    have hslice : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), ‖x‖ ≤ ρ₀ / 2 → t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T →
        HasFDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => G (s + x', t))
          (fderiv ℝ G (s + x, t) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) x := by
      intro t x hx ht
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => ((s + x', t) : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ))
          (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) x :=
        ((hasFDerivAt_id x).const_add s).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_const t x)
      exact (hdiff _ (hKsub (hmemK x t hx ht))).comp x h1
    refine ⟨max C₀ 0, le_max_right _ _, fun η hη => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨δu, hδu, hδu'⟩ := huc η hη
    refine ⟨min (ρ₀ / 2) δu, lt_min hρ hδu, fun h t hh ht => ?_⟩
    have hhρ : ‖h‖ < ρ₀ / 2 := hh.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
    have hhu : ‖h‖ < δu := hh.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
    have hball' : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ‖h‖, ‖x‖ ≤ ‖h‖ := fun x hx => by
      rwa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hx
    have hderiv : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ‖h‖,
        HasFDerivWithinAt (fun x' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => G (s + x', t))
          (fderiv ℝ G (s + x, t) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ)
          (Metric.closedBall 0 ‖h‖) x := fun x hx =>
      (hslice t x ((hball' x hx).trans hhρ.le) ht).hasFDerivWithinAt
    have h0mem : (0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ‖h‖ :=
      Metric.mem_closedBall_self (norm_nonneg _)
    have hhmem : h ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ‖h‖ := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    constructor
    · have hbound : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ‖h‖,
          ‖fderiv ℝ G (s + x, t) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ‖ ≤ max C₀ 0 :=
        fun x hx => (hC₀ _ (hmemK x t ((hball' x hx).trans hhρ.le) ht)).trans (le_max_left _ _)
      have := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasFDerivWithin_le hderiv hbound
        (convex_closedBall _ _) h0mem hhmem
      simpa only [add_zero, sub_zero] using this
    · have hbound : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ‖h‖,
          ‖fderiv ℝ G (s + x, t) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ -
            fderiv ℝ G (s, t) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ‖ ≤ η := by
        intro x hx
        have hx1 := hball' x hx
        have hd : dist ((s + x, t) : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) (s, t) < δu := by
          rw [hdistK]; exact lt_of_le_of_lt hx1 hhu
        have := hδu' _ (hmemK x t (hx1.trans hhρ.le) ht) _ (hs0K t ht) hd
        rw [dist_eq_norm] at this
        exact this.le
      have := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasFDerivWithin_le' hderiv hbound
        (convex_closedBall _ _) h0mem hhmem
      simpa only [add_zero, sub_zero] using this
  
  obtain ⟨CA, hCA, hcA⟩ := c2 (E →L[ℝ] E) A hA
  obtain ⟨_, _, hcb⟩ := c2 E b hb
  have hAc : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => A (s, u)) :=
    hA.continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
      (fun u => ⟨hs, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
  obtain ⟨L0, hL0⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := -T) (b := T)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hAc.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = max L0 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hL : 0 ≤ L := by rw [hLdef]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hLb : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖A (s, u)‖ ≤ L := fun u hu => by
    rw [hLdef]; exact (hL0 u hu).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hy : Continuous (z s) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun t => ((hsol s hs).2 t).continuousAt)
  obtain ⟨Y0, hY0⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := -T) (b := T)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hy.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨Y, hYdef⟩ : ∃ Y : ℝ, Y = max Y0 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hY : 0 ≤ Y := by rw [hYdef]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hYb : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖z s t‖ ≤ Y := fun t ht => by
    rw [hYdef]; exact (hY0 t ht).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hzK := hzc.mono hKsub
  have hzuc := Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp (hKc.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hzK)
  have hz0d : HasFDerivAt z0 (fderiv ℝ z0 s) s :=
    (((hz0.differentiableOn one_ne_zero) s hs).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hs)).hasFDerivAt
  
  have hkey : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ (h : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (t : ℝ), ‖h‖ < δ → |t - v| < δ →
      ‖z (s + h) t - z s t - W s t h‖ ≤ η * ‖h‖ := by
    intro η hη
    obtain ⟨C1, hC1def⟩ : ∃ C1 : ℝ, C1 = (1 + (CA + Y + 1) * T) * Real.exp (L * T) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hC1 : 0 < C1 := by
      rw [hC1def]
      have : 0 < 1 + (CA + Y + 1) * T := by nlinarith
      exact mul_pos this (Real.exp_pos _)
    obtain ⟨η', hη'def⟩ : ∃ η' : ℝ, η' = η / C1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hη' : 0 < η' := by rw [hη'def]; exact div_pos hη hC1
    obtain ⟨δA, hδA, hδA'⟩ := hcA η' hη'
    obtain ⟨δb, hδb, hδb'⟩ := hcb η' hη'
    obtain ⟨δz, hδz, hδz'⟩ := hzuc η' hη'
    obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hδ₀'⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp
      ((Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff.mp (hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero.mp hz0d)) hη')
    refine ⟨min (min δA δb) (min (min δz δ₀) (min (ρ₀ / 2) 1)),
      lt_min (lt_min hδA hδb) (lt_min (lt_min hδz hδ₀) (lt_min hρ one_pos)), ?_⟩
    intro h t hh ht
    have hhA : ‖h‖ < δA := hh.trans_le ((min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
    have hhb : ‖h‖ < δb := hh.trans_le ((min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
    have hhz : ‖h‖ < δz :=
      hh.trans_le ((min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)))
    have hh0 : ‖h‖ < δ₀ :=
      hh.trans_le ((min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)))
    have hhρ : ‖h‖ < ρ₀ / 2 :=
      hh.trans_le ((min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)))
    have ht1 : |t - v| < 1 :=
      ht.trans_le ((min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)))
    have htT : t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T := by
      have h1 := abs_lt.mp ht1
      have h2 := neg_abs_le v
      have h3 := le_abs_self v
      rw [hTdef]
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hsh : s + h ∈ U := hcl (by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left]; exact hhρ.le)
    obtain ⟨g, hgdef⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ → E, g = fun u =>
        (A (s + h, u) - A (s, u)) (z (s + h) u - z s u) +
        (A (s + h, u) - A (s, u) - (fderiv ℝ A (s, u) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) h)
          (z s u) +
        (b (s + h, u) - b (s, u) - (fderiv ℝ b (s, u) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) h) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hr : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun u => z (s + h) u - z s u - W s u h)
        ((fun u => A (s, u)) u ((fun u => z (s + h) u - z s u - W s u h) u) + g u) u := by
      intro u
      have h1 := (hsol (s + h) hsh).2 u
      have h2 := (hsol s hs).2 u
      have h3 := ((hWsol s hs).2 u).clm_apply (hasDerivAt_const u h)
      refine ((h1.sub h2).sub h3).congr_deriv ?_
      rw [hgdef]
      simp only [map_sub, sub_apply, add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, map_zero, add_zero]
      abel
    have hgb : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖(fun u => A (s, u)) u‖ ≤ L ∧
        ‖g u‖ ≤ η' * (CA + Y + 1) * ‖h‖ := by
      intro u hu
      refine ⟨hLb u hu, ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨eA1, eA2⟩ := hδA' h u hhA hu
      obtain ⟨-, eb2⟩ := hδb' h u hhb hu
      have hdz : dist ((s + h, u) : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) (s, u) < δz := by rw [hdistK]; exact hhz
      have ez := hδz' _ (hmemK h u hhρ.le hu) _ (hs0K u hu) hdz
      rw [dist_eq_norm] at ez
      have ez' : ‖z (s + h) u - z s u‖ ≤ η' := ez.le
      rw [hgdef]
      calc ‖(A (s + h, u) - A (s, u)) (z (s + h) u - z s u) +
            (A (s + h, u) - A (s, u) - (fderiv ℝ A (s, u) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) h)
              (z s u) +
            (b (s + h, u) - b (s, u) - (fderiv ℝ b (s, u) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) h)‖
          ≤ ‖(A (s + h, u) - A (s, u)) (z (s + h) u - z s u)‖ +
            ‖(A (s + h, u) - A (s, u) - (fderiv ℝ A (s, u) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) h)
              (z s u)‖ +
            ‖b (s + h, u) - b (s, u) - (fderiv ℝ b (s, u) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) h‖ :=
            norm_add₃_le
        _ ≤ ‖A (s + h, u) - A (s, u)‖ * ‖z (s + h) u - z s u‖ +
            ‖A (s + h, u) - A (s, u) - (fderiv ℝ A (s, u) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) h‖ *
              ‖z s u‖ +
            ‖b (s + h, u) - b (s, u) - (fderiv ℝ b (s, u) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) h‖ :=
            add_le_add (add_le_add (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _)
              (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _)) le_rfl
        _ ≤ (CA * ‖h‖) * η' + (η' * ‖h‖) * Y + η' * ‖h‖ :=
            add_le_add (add_le_add
              (mul_le_mul eA1 ez' (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hCA (norm_nonneg _)))
              (mul_le_mul eA2 (hYb u hu) (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hη'.le (norm_nonneg _)))) eb2
        _ = η' * (CA + Y + 1) * ‖h‖ := by ring
    have hε : 0 ≤ η' * (CA + Y + 1) * ‖h‖ :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hη'.le (by linarith)) (norm_nonneg _)
    have hG : ‖z (s + h) t - z s t - W s t h‖ ≤
        (‖z (s + h) 0 - z s 0 - W s 0 h‖ + η' * (CA + Y + 1) * ‖h‖ * T) * Real.exp (L * T) :=
      gron (fun u => z (s + h) u - z s u - W s u h) (fun u => A (s, u)) g L
        (η' * (CA + Y + 1) * ‖h‖) T hL hε hT hr hgb t htT
    have h0 : ‖z (s + h) 0 - z s 0 - W s 0 h‖ ≤ η' * ‖h‖ := by
      rw [(hsol (s + h) hsh).1, (hsol s hs).1, (hWsol s hs).1]
      have hd0 : dist h 0 < δ₀ := by rw [dist_zero_right]; exact hh0
      exact hδ₀' hd0
    calc ‖z (s + h) t - z s t - W s t h‖
        ≤ (‖z (s + h) 0 - z s 0 - W s 0 h‖ + η' * (CA + Y + 1) * ‖h‖ * T) * Real.exp (L * T) := hG
      _ ≤ (η' * ‖h‖ + η' * (CA + Y + 1) * ‖h‖ * T) * Real.exp (L * T) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = η' * C1 * ‖h‖ := by rw [hC1def]; ring
      _ = η * ‖h‖ := by rw [hη'def, div_mul_cancel₀ η hC1.ne']
  
  have hWcont : ContinuousAt (W s) v := ((hWsol s hs).2 v).continuousAt
  have hzder : HasDerivAt (z s) (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v)) v := (hsol s hs).2 v
  rw [hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
  intro c hc
  have hc3 : 0 < c / 3 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hδ₁'⟩ := hkey (c / 3) hc3
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, hδ₂'⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hWcont (c / 3) hc3
  obtain ⟨δ₃, hδ₃, hδ₃'⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp
    ((Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff.mp (hasDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero.mp hzder)) hc3)
  rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff]
  refine ⟨min δ₁ (min δ₂ δ₃), lt_min hδ₁ (lt_min hδ₂ hδ₃), ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨h, k⟩ hp
  rw [dist_zero_right] at hp
  have hh : ‖h‖ ≤ ‖(h, k)‖ := norm_fst_le (h, k)
  have hk : ‖k‖ ≤ ‖(h, k)‖ := norm_snd_le (h, k)
  have hp1 : ‖(h, k)‖ < δ₁ := hp.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have hp2 : ‖(h, k)‖ < δ₂ := hp.trans_le ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
  have hp3 : ‖(h, k)‖ < δ₃ := hp.trans_le ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
  have hkk : |v + k - v| = ‖k‖ := by rw [add_sub_cancel_left, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have e1 := hδ₁' h (v + k) (lt_of_le_of_lt hh hp1) (by rw [hkk]; exact lt_of_le_of_lt hk hp1)
  have e2 : ‖W s (v + k) - W s v‖ < c / 3 := by
    rw [← dist_eq_norm]
    apply hδ₂'
    rw [Real.dist_eq, hkk]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hk hp2
  have e3 : ‖z s (v + k) - z s v - k • (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v))‖ ≤ c / 3 * ‖k‖ := by
    have hd3 : dist k 0 < δ₃ := by rw [dist_zero_right]; exact lt_of_le_of_lt hk hp3
    exact hδ₃' hd3
  have e2' : ‖(W s (v + k) - W s v) h‖ ≤ c / 3 * ‖h‖ :=
    ((W s (v + k) - W s v).le_opNorm h).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right e2.le (norm_nonneg _))
  have hid : z (s + h) (v + k) - z s v - (W s v h + k • (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v))) =
      (z (s + h) (v + k) - z s (v + k) - W s (v + k) h) + (W s (v + k) - W s v) h +
        (z s (v + k) - z s v - k • (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v))) := by
    rw [sub_apply]; abel
  show ‖z (s + h) (v + k) - z s v - (W s v h + k • (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v)))‖ ≤ c * ‖(h, k)‖
  rw [hid]
  have m1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh hc3.le
  have m2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk hc3.le
  calc _ ≤ ‖z (s + h) (v + k) - z s (v + k) - W s (v + k) h‖ + ‖(W s (v + k) - W s v) h‖ +
        ‖z s (v + k) - z s v - k • (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v))‖ := norm_add₃_le
    _ ≤ c / 3 * ‖h‖ + c / 3 * ‖h‖ + c / 3 * ‖k‖ := add_le_add (add_le_add e1 e2') e3
    _ ≤ c * ‖(h, k)‖ := by linarith
