signature.name: etaL_local_finite_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → ∀ ξ0 : Cyl, ξ0.2.2.1 < 1 → ∃ N ∈ nhds ξ0, ∃ Γ : Finset Lab, ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ N → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) → γ ∈ Γ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h hS ξ0 hξ0
  
  have hLc : ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ContinuousAt (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have hτ : 0 < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 := by linarith
    have hqpos : 0 < qC h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).1
    have hqcont : ContinuousAt (qC h) ξ := by
      have hU : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
      have hp : ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
        ⟨trivial, hτ⟩
      have hg : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) :=
        hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)
      have hk : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) ξ := by fun_prop
      have he : qC h = (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘
          (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
        funext η; rfl
      rw [he]
      exact ContinuousAt.comp hg hk
    exact hqcont.logb hqpos.ne'
  
  have hwin : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (γ : Lab), ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) →
      |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) + (γ.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
      |chartR h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
      |chartZ h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
      |chartT h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
    intro ξ γ hξ hγ
    have s1 : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ → 1 < |φ ξ / μ - (j : ℝ)| →
        ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 := by
      intro μ j φ hφ h1
      have hψ : ContinuousAt (fun η => |φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)|) ξ :=
        ((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs
      have hev := (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : Cyl => (1:ℝ)) ξ).eventually_lt hψ h1
      filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
      have hsq : 1 < (φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)) ^ 2 := (one_lt_sq_iff_one_lt_abs _).mpr hη
      unfold sqPart bumpR
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), zero_div]
    have key : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ →
        (∀ η, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 → etaL h γ η = 0) → |φ ξ / μ - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
      intro μ j φ hφ himp
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      have hev := s1 μ j φ hφ hc
      apply (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mpr _) hγ
      filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
      exact himp η hη
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := key 1 (-(γ.1:ℤ)) (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) (hLc ξ hξ)
        (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul])
      simpa [div_one, sub_neg_eq_add] using this
    · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.1 (chartR h γ.1) (by unfold chartR; fun_prop)
        (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
    · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.1 (chartZ h γ.1) (by unfold chartZ; fun_prop)
        (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
    · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.2 (chartT h γ.1) (by unfold chartT; fun_prop)
        (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
  
  obtain ⟨L0, hL0⟩ : ∃ L0 : ℝ, L0 = Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hfin : (⋃ n ∈ Set.Iic ⌊2 - L0⌋₊, ({n} : Set ℕ) ×ˢ
      ((Set.Icc ⌈chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ
        Set.Icc ⌈chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ
        Set.Icc ⌈chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋) ×ˢ
        (Set.univ : Set Bool))).Finite := by
    refine Set.Finite.biUnion (Set.finite_Iic _) (fun n _ => ?_)
    exact (Set.finite_singleton n).prod (((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod
      ((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod (Set.finite_Icc _ _))).prod Set.finite_univ)
  have hI : ∀ (x c : ℝ) (j : ℤ), |x - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 → |x - c| < 1 → j ∈ Set.Icc ⌈c - 2⌉ ⌊c + 2⌋ := by
    intro x c j hj hc
    rw [abs_le] at hj
    rw [abs_lt] at hc
    exact ⟨Int.ceil_le.mpr (by linarith [hj.2, hc.1]), Int.le_floor.mpr (by linarith [hj.1, hc.2])⟩
  
  have hcR : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartR h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartR; fun_prop
  have hcZ : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartZ h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartZ; fun_prop
  have hcT : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartT h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartT; fun_prop
  have hch : ∀ (φ : Cyl → ℝ) (μ : ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ0 →
      ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, |φ ξ / μ - φ ξ0 / μ| < 1 := by
    intro φ μ hφ
    exact (((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs).eventually_lt continuousAt_const
      (by simp)
  have e1 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 :=
    (show ContinuousAt (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.2.2.1) ξ0 by fun_prop).eventually_lt
      continuousAt_const hξ0
  have e2 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) - L0| < 1 :=
    (((hLc ξ0 hξ0).sub continuousAt_const).abs).eventually_lt continuousAt_const
      (by simp [hL0])
  have e3 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊2 - L0⌋₊ + 1),
      |chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
      |chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
      |chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 := by
    rw [Filter.eventually_all_finset]
    intro n _
    exact (hch _ _ (hcR n)).and ((hch _ _ (hcZ n)).and (hch _ _ (hcT n)))
  refine ⟨{ξ | ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) - L0| < 1 ∧
      ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊2 - L0⌋₊ + 1),
      |chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
      |chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
      |chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1}, ?_,
    hfin.toFinset, ?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [e1, e2, e3] with ξ h1 h2 h3
    exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
  
  rintro ⟨n, ⟨a, b, c⟩, σ⟩ ξ ⟨ht, hL, hC⟩ hγ
  obtain ⟨w0, wR, wZ, wT⟩ := hwin ξ _ ht hγ
  simp only at w0 wR wZ wT
  rw [abs_le] at w0
  rw [abs_lt] at hL
  have hn : n ≤ ⌊2 - L0⌋₊ := Nat.le_floor (by linarith [w0.2, hL.1])
  obtain ⟨cR, cZ, cT⟩ := hC n (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn))
  rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
  refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨n, hn, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨rfl, ⟨hI _ _ _ wR cR, hI _ _ _ wZ cZ, hI _ _ _ wT cT⟩, trivial⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, hXm1, hm12, hm2Xb, -, hqB0, hqB1, -, -, haa, hab⟩ := hok.2.1
  have hXab : B.Xa < B.Xb := by linarith
  have hr0 : 0 < G.r0 := hG.1.1
  obtain ⟨lS, hS⟩ := pulse_tw_struct_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lT, hT⟩ := pulse_tw_star_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lG, hGap⟩ := band_coarse_gap_v5 B.h hh0 hh1
  obtain ⟨nq, hnq⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)

(2) The crux sits in a named pointwise child: pulse_tw_star_v5 bounds tw alone at tsupport points with Xa<XC<Xb and 0<v<L, with exactly the InWg5 clause-5 RHS and a route in Appendix A1-A5. informal_problem.statement:

    ∀ (α : ℝ) (f : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α f →
    (∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dotProduct (nPhiC5 B G γ ξ) (pulseTw5 B G f γ m ξ) = 0) ∧
    (∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), psiW B G γ ξ ≠ 0 →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (pulseTw5 B G f γ m) ξ ∧
      dVc B γ.1 (pulseTw5 B G f γ m) ξ = (pulseMatC (APhi5 B G γ ξ)).mulVec (pulseTw5 B G f γ m ξ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lS, hS⟩ := pulse_support_good_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  have hQbpos : ∀ l : ℕ, 0 < Qb l := fun l => Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  
  have hnsq : ∀ (γ : Lab) (η : Cyl), 0 < η.1 → 0 < dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ η) (nPhi5 B G γ η) := by
    intro γ η hη
    have hpint : (pint5 B G γ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      unfold pint5
      split_ifs with h
      · norm_num
      · exact_mod_cast h
    have hkb : (0:ℝ) < (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) := by
      have : 0 < kb B.h γ.1 :=
        Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hQbpos _) _) _)
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hRC : 0 < RC γ.1 η := div_pos hη (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hQbpos _))
    have h1 : nPhi5 B G γ η 1 ≠ 0 := by
      have e : nPhi5 B G γ η 1 = pang5 B G γ / RC γ.1 η := rfl
      rw [e]
      unfold pang5
      exact div_ne_zero (div_ne_zero hpint hkb.ne') hRC.ne'
    simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have := mul_self_pos.mpr h1
    linarith [mul_self_nonneg (nPhi5 B G γ η 0), mul_self_nonneg (nPhi5 B G γ η 2)]
  
  have halg : ∀ (f0 : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (η : Cyl) (Z : Fin 3 → ℂ),
      dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ η) (nPhi5 B G γ η) ≠ 0 →
      dotProduct (nPhiC5 B G γ η) (pulseRhs5 B G f0 γ m η Z) =
        -dotProduct (fun i => ((nPhiP5 B G γ η i : ℝ) : ℂ)) Z
          - ((m : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((dDamp5 B G γ η : ℝ) : ℂ)) * dotProduct (nPhiC5 B G γ η) Z := by
    intro f0 γ m η Z hN
    have hnn : dotProduct (nPhiC5 B G γ η) (nPhiC5 B G γ η) = nsqC5 B G γ η := by
      simp only [nPhiC5, nsqC5, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hnsC : nsqC5 B G γ η ≠ 0 := by
      unfold nsqC5
      exact_mod_cast hN
    have hproj : ∀ s : Fin 3 → ℂ, dotProduct (nPhiC5 B G γ η) (projT5 B G γ η s) = 0 := by
      intro s
      unfold projT5
      rw [dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, hnn, smul_eq_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hnsC, sub_self]
    have hvm : Matrix.vecMul (nPhi5 B G γ η) (APhi5 B G γ η) = -nPhiP5 B G γ η := by
      unfold APhi5
      rw [Matrix.vecMul_add, Matrix.vecMul_neg, Matrix.vecMul_smul, Matrix.vecMul_vecMulVec, smul_smul,
        inv_mul_cancel₀ hN, one_smul]
      abel
    have hvmC : Matrix.vecMul (nPhiC5 B G γ η) (pulseMatC (APhi5 B G γ η)) =
        fun j => ((Matrix.vecMul (nPhi5 B G γ η) (APhi5 B G γ η) j : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      funext j
      simp only [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, pulseMatC, nPhiC5, Matrix.map_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      push_cast
      ring
    unfold pulseRhs5
    rw [dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_sub, hproj, dotProduct_smul, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, hvmC, hvm,
      smul_eq_mul, sub_zero]
    congr 1
    simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.neg_apply]
    push_cast
    ring
  
  have hdecay : ∀ (L : ℝ) (y : ℝ → ℂ) (c : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ w ∈ Icc 0 L, 0 ≤ c w) →
      (∀ w ∈ Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt y (-((c w : ℝ) : ℂ) * y w) w) → y 0 = 0 → ∀ w ∈ Icc 0 L, y w = 0 := by
    intro L y c hc hy hy0 w hw
    have hg : ∀ u ∈ Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt (fun u => ‖y u‖ ^ 2) (-(2 * c u) * ‖y u‖ ^ 2) u := by
      intro u hu
      have := (hy u hu).norm_sq
      convert this using 1
      have e : -((c u : ℝ) : ℂ) * y u = (-c u : ℝ) • y u := by simp [Complex.real_smul]
      rw [e, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
      ring
    have hanti : AntitoneOn (fun u => ‖y u‖ ^ 2) (Icc 0 L) := by
      apply antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos (convex_Icc 0 L)
      · intro u hu
        exact (hg u hu).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      · intro u hu
        rw [interior_Icc] at hu
        exact (hg u (Ioo_subset_Icc_self hu)).hasDerivWithinAt
      · intro u hu
        rw [interior_Icc] at hu
        have := hc u (Ioo_subset_Icc_self hu)
        exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _)
    have h0 : (0:ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 L := ⟨le_rfl, hw.1.trans hw.2⟩
    have h1 := hanti h0 hw hw.1
    simp only [hy0, norm_zero] at h1
    have h4 : ‖y w‖ ^ 2 = 0 :=
      le_antisymm (by linarith [h1, (show (0:ℝ) ^ 2 = 0 by norm_num)]) (sq_nonneg _)
    exact norm_eq_zero.mp (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp h4)
  
  have hTgc : 0 < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; positivity
  have hcib : ∀ l : ℕ, 0 < cib B.h l := fun l =>
    mul_pos (zpow_pos hTgc _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hQbpos l) _)
  have hr0 : 0 < G.r0 := hG.1.1
  have hr01 : G.r0 ≤ 1/100 := hG.1.2.1
  have hLpos : ∀ l, 0 < Lsb B.h G.r0 l := fun l => div_pos (by linarith) (hcib l)
  have hLc : ∀ l, Lsb B.h G.r0 l * cib B.h l = 2 * G.r0 := fun l => by
    unfold Lsb; rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hcib l).ne']
  have hvco : ∀ (γ : Lab) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) Y =
      vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) Y * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0 := by
    intro γ Y; unfold vco; rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hcib γ.1).ne']; ring
  have hshift : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (s : ℝ) (l : ℕ), ξ + s • dVdir B.h l =
      (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, ξ.2.2.2 + s • ((cib B.h l * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx B.h l))) • vtv)) := by
    intro ξ s l
    obtain ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ := ξ
    simp only [dVdir, Prod.smul_mk, Prod.mk_add_mk, smul_zero, add_zero]
  have hdom : ∀ (qs : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (s : ℝ) (l : ℕ), ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs → ξ + s • dVdir B.h l ∈ DomC B.h qs := by
    intro qs ξ s l h; rw [hshift]; exact h
  have hfst : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (s : ℝ) (l : ℕ), (ξ + s • dVdir B.h l).1 = ξ.1 := by
    intro ξ s l; rw [hshift]
  have hpth : ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) (w : ℝ), pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0 + w • dVdir B.h γ.1 =
      ξ + (w - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) • dVdir B.h γ.1 := by
    intro γ ξ w; unfold pulsePth5; rw [add_assoc, ← add_smul]; congr 2; ring
  have hgeo : ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < G.r0 / 2 →
      0 ≤ vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 → vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 ≤ Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 →
      ∀ w ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1),
      xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (ξ + (w - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) • dVdir B.h γ.1).2.2.2 =
        xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 ∧
      etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (ξ + (w - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) • dVdir B.h γ.1).2.2.2 =
        w * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0 := by
    intro γ ξ hx hv0 hvL w hw
    rw [hshift]
    have hwc0 : 0 ≤ w * cib B.h γ.1 := mul_nonneg hw.1 (hcib γ.1).le
    have hwc1 : w * cib B.h γ.1 ≤ 2 * G.r0 := by
      rw [← hLc γ.1]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hw.2 (hcib γ.1).le
    have he : etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 + (w - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) * cib B.h γ.1 =
        w * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0 := by rw [hvco]; ring
    have c2 := (pulse_rect_path_v5 B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) hr0 hr01).1 ξ.2.2.2
      (w - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) (by linarith)
      (by rw [he]; exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
    exact ⟨c2.1, by rw [c2.2, he]⟩
  refine ⟨max lS n0, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 α f hf
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    have e : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
      show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
      rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
    rw [e]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (le_of_max_le_right hl0)) hn0.le
  have hfs : ∀ (γ' : Lab) (m' : ℤ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f γ' m') (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := hf.2.1
  have hRhs0 : ∀ γ m ζ, f γ m ζ = 0 → pulseRhs5 B G f γ m ζ 0 = 0 := by
    intro γ m ζ h0
    simp [pulseRhs5, projT5, srcHat, h0]
  
  have hnormal : ∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      dotProduct (nPhiC5 B G γ ξ) (pulseTw5 B G f γ m ξ) = 0 := by
    intro γ m ξ hξ
    by_cases hgood : pulseGood5 B G γ m ξ
    swap
    · simp only [pulseTw5, if_neg hgood, dotProduct_zero]
    have hg' := hgood
    obtain ⟨-, -, hx, hv0, hvL, -⟩ := hg'
    obtain ⟨V, z, -, hβ0, hz⟩ := pulse_tube_family_v5 B G l0 f γ m ξ hok hG hqsB hfs hξ hx hv0 hvL
    obtain ⟨hz0, hder, -, -, hid⟩ := hz _ hβ0
    have hvI : vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) := ⟨hv0, hvL⟩
    have htw : pulseTw5 B G f γ m ξ =
        z (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by
      simp only [pulseTw5, if_pos hgood]; exact hid _ hvI
    have hnder : ∀ w ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), ∀ i : Fin 3,
        HasDerivAt (fun u => nPhi5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0 + u • dVdir B.h γ.1) i)
          (nPhiP5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0 + w • dVdir B.h γ.1) i) w := by
      intro w hw i
      have hζ := hpth γ ξ w
      obtain ⟨g1, g2⟩ := hgeo γ ξ hx hv0 hvL w hw
      have hdomB : pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0 + w • dVdir B.h γ.1 ∈ DomC B.h B.qB := by
        rw [hζ]
        obtain ⟨d1, d2, d3⟩ := hdom _ ξ (w - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) γ.1 hξ
        exact ⟨d1, d2, lt_of_lt_of_le d3 hqsB⟩
      have hx8 : |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0 + w • dVdir B.h γ.1).2.2.2| < 1/8 := by
        rw [hζ, g1]; linarith
      have hy8 : |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0 + w • dVdir B.h γ.1).2.2.2| < 1/8 := by
        rw [hζ, g2]
        have hwc0 : 0 ≤ w * cib B.h γ.1 := mul_nonneg hw.1 (hcib γ.1).le
        have hwc1 : w * cib B.h γ.1 ≤ 2 * G.r0 := by
          rw [← hLc γ.1]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hw.2 (hcib γ.1).le
        rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
      obtain ⟨U, hUo, hζU, -, hn, -, -⟩ := good_coeff_smooth_v5 B G γ _ hok hdomB hx8 hy8
      have hdn : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ η i)
          (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0 + w • dVdir B.h γ.1) :=
        ((hn i).contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hζU)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have hline : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0 + u • dVdir B.h γ.1)
          ((1:ℝ) • dVdir B.h γ.1) w :=
        ((hasDerivAt_id w).smul_const (dVdir B.h γ.1)).const_add _
      have := hdn.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt w hline
      rw [one_smul] at this
      exact this
    have hyder : ∀ w ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1),
        HasDerivAt (fun u => dotProduct (nPhiC5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0 + u • dVdir B.h γ.1))
            (z (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0) u))
          (-((((m:ℝ) ^ 2 * dDamp5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0 + w • dVdir B.h γ.1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
            dotProduct (nPhiC5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0 + w • dVdir B.h γ.1))
              (z (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0) w)) w := by
      intro w hw
      have hZ := hasDerivAt_pi.1 (hder w hw)
      have hN : ∀ i : Fin 3,
          HasDerivAt (fun u => ((nPhi5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0 + u • dVdir B.h γ.1) i : ℝ) : ℂ))
            ((nPhiP5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0 + w • dVdir B.h γ.1) i : ℝ) : ℂ) w :=
        fun i => (hnder w hw i).ofReal_comp
      have hsum := (((hN 0).mul (hZ 0)).add ((hN 1).mul (hZ 1))).add ((hN 2).mul (hZ 2))
      have hpos : 0 < (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0 + w • dVdir B.h γ.1).1 := by
        rw [hpth, hfst]; exact hξ.1
      have hF := halg f γ m (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0 + w • dVdir B.h γ.1) (z (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0) w)
        (hnsq γ _ hpos).ne'
      simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, nPhiC5] at hF ⊢
      convert hsum using 1
      push_cast
      linear_combination (-1 : ℂ) * hF
    have hc : ∀ w ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1),
        0 ≤ (m:ℝ) ^ 2 * dDamp5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0 + w • dVdir B.h γ.1) := by
      intro w _
      apply mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)
      unfold dDamp5
      refine mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ?_ (sq_nonneg _)) ?_
      · unfold epsb; exact (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hQbpos _) _).le
      · simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        exact add_nonneg (add_nonneg (mul_self_nonneg _) (mul_self_nonneg _)) (mul_self_nonneg _)
    have h0 := hdecay _ _ _ hc hyder (by simp only [hz0, dotProduct_zero]) _ hvI
    have h0' : dotProduct (nPhiC5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0 +
        vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 • dVdir B.h γ.1))
        (z (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)) = 0 := h0
    have hξe : pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0 + vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 • dVdir B.h γ.1 = ξ := by
      rw [hpth, sub_self, zero_smul, add_zero]
    rw [hξe] at h0'
    rw [htw]; exact h0'
  
  have hsupp : ∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), pulseTw5 B G f γ m ξ ≠ 0 →
      |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ G.r0 / 4 ∧ |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ G.r0 := by
    intro γ m ξ hξ hne
    have hgood : pulseGood5 B G γ m ξ := by
      by_contra hng
      apply hne
      simp only [pulseTw5, if_neg hng]
    have hg' := hgood
    obtain ⟨-, -, hx, hv0, hvL, -⟩ := hg'
    have hy : |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ G.r0 := by
      rw [hvco]
      have h1 : 0 ≤ vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 * cib B.h γ.1 := mul_nonneg hv0 (hcib _).le
      have h2 : vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 * cib B.h γ.1 ≤ 2 * G.r0 := by
        rw [← hLc γ.1]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hvL (hcib _).le
      rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
    refine ⟨?_, hy⟩
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    obtain ⟨V, z, -, hβ0, hz⟩ := pulse_tube_family_v5 B G l0 f γ m ξ hok hG hqsB hfs hξ hx hv0 hvL
    obtain ⟨hz0, hder, -, ⟨K, hK0, hK⟩, hid⟩ := hz _ hβ0
    have hsrc : ∀ w ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1),
        f γ m (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0 + w • dVdir B.h γ.1) = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      by_contra hfne

∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →
    ∀ (α : ℝ) (f tw : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α f → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α (cutA B G tw) →

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨ls, hsg⟩ := pulse_support_good_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lp, hpm⟩ := pres_mult_coeffs_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lq, hqm⟩ := pulse_mult_coeffs_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lw, hwt⟩ := pulse_pr_weights_v5 B G hok hG
  refine ⟨ls + lp + lq + lw, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 α f tw hf hA
  have hh0 : 0 ≤ B.h := hok.2.1.1.le
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  have hDq : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < qC B.h ξ ∧ qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 ∧ 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
    have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
      show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
      exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    intro ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨-, e2, e3⟩ := hξ
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
    refine ⟨hq0, by linarith, ?_⟩
    unfold SC
    have : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| := by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))]
    exact one_le_pow₀ this
  have hDsh : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ a, shY ξ a ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := fun ξ hξ _ => hξ
  have hEdge : ∀ X : ℝ, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb → 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X ∧
      0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ∧ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ≤ 1 := by
    intro X e1 e2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, min_le_left _ _⟩
    · unfold edgeWeight
      split_ifs
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      · exact le_rfl
    · have hX : 0 < X := lt_trans hXa e1
      have l1 : 0 < Real.log (X / B.Xa) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr e1)
      have l2 : 0 < Real.log (B.Xb / X) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr e2)
      exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min l1 l2)
  have hW : ∀ (q Sv E e P C1 C2 b1 b2 d1 d2 α α1 α2 N1 N2 : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → 1 ≤ Sv → 0 ≤ E →
      0 < e → e ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ P → α ≤ α1 → α ≤ α2 →
      N1 ≤ C1 * q ^ (B.h * α1) * Sv ^ b1 * E * e ^ (-d1) * P →
      N2 ≤ C2 * q ^ (B.h * α2) * Sv ^ b2 * E * e ^ (-d2) * P →
      N1 + N2 ≤ (|C1| + |C2|) * q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P := by
    intro q Sv E e P C1 C2 b1 b2 d1 d2 α α1 α2 N1 N2 hq0 hq1 hS1 hE he0 he1 hP0 ha1 ha2 hN1 hN2
    have key : ∀ (C b d αi N : ℝ), α ≤ αi → N ≤ C * q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P →
        b ≤ max b1 b2 → d ≤ max d1 d2 →
        N ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) := by
      intro C b d αi N hα hN hb hd
      have f1 : q ^ (B.h * αi) ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hα hh0)
      have f2 : Sv ^ b ≤ Sv ^ (max b1 b2) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 hb
      have f3 : e ^ (-d) ≤ e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge he0 he1 (neg_le_neg hd)
      have p1 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * αi) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
      have p2 : 0 ≤ Sv ^ b := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have p3 : 0 ≤ e ^ (-d) := Real.rpow_nonneg he0.le _
      have p1' : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
      have p2' : 0 ≤ Sv ^ (max b1 b2) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have m1 : q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) := mul_le_mul f1 f2 p2 p1'
      have m2 : q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right m1 hE
      have m3 : q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) ≤
          q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) :=
        mul_le_mul m2 f3 p3 (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p1' p2') hE)
      have hWi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right m3 hP0
      have hWi0 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p1 p2) hE) p3) hP0
      calc N ≤ C * q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P := hN
        _ = C * (q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P) := by ring
        _ ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) hWi0
        _ ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hWi (abs_nonneg C)
    have k1 := key C1 b1 d1 α1 N1 ha1 hN1 (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
    have k2 := key C2 b2 d2 α2 N2 ha2 hN2 (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
    have e : (|C1| + |C2|) * q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P =
        |C1| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) +
        |C2| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) := by ring
    rw [e]
    linarith
  have hNB : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f1 f2 g : Cyl → V) (k : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl),
      ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f1 (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f2 (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), g η = f1 η + f2 η) → NB B.h g k ξ ≤ NB B.h f1 k ξ + NB B.h f2 k ξ := by
    intro V _ _ f1 f2 g k ξ hξ hf1 hf2 heq
    have hn : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∈ nhds ξ := hDopen.mem_nhds hξ
    have hev : g =ᶠ[nhds ξ] f1 + f2 := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hn (fun η hη => heq η hη)
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g ξ = iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ := by
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
      exact iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((hf1.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        ((hf2.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    unfold NB
    rw [e1]
    have e2 : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) +
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) := by
      ext m
      simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e2]
    exact norm_add_le _ _
  have hInWg : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (α α1 α2 : ℝ)
      (a b c : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → V),
      InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α1 a → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α2 b → α ≤ α1 → α ≤ α2 →
      (∃ H : Finset ℤ, (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧ ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → c γ m = 0) →
      (∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), c γ m ξ = a γ m ξ + b γ m ξ) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α c := by
    intro V _ _ α α1 α2 a b c ea eb ha1 ha2 hHc heq
    obtain ⟨-, sa, da, pa, ba⟩ := ea
    obtain ⟨-, sb, db, pb, bb⟩ := eb
    refine ⟨hHc, fun γ m => ((sa γ m).add (sb γ m)).congr (heq γ m), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro γ m ξ hξ c' hc
      rw [heq γ m _ (hDsh ξ hξ c'), heq γ m ξ hξ, da γ m ξ hξ c' hc, db γ m ξ hξ c' hc]
    · intro γ m ξ hξ hne
      rw [heq γ m ξ hξ] at hne
      by_cases hA : a γ m ξ = 0
      · rw [hA, zero_add] at hne
        exact pb γ m ξ hξ hne
      · exact pa γ m ξ hξ hA
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨C1, c1, e1, hb1⟩ := ba k
      obtain ⟨C2, c2, e2, hb2⟩ := bb k
      refine ⟨|C1| + |C2|, max c1 c2, max e1 e2, fun γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hq0, hq1, hS1⟩ := hDq ξ hξ
      obtain ⟨hE, he0, he1⟩ := hEdge _ hX1 hX2
      have hn := hNB (a γ m) (b γ m) (c γ m) k ξ hξ (sa γ m) (sb γ m) (heq γ m)
      have hP0 : 0 ≤ Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by
        unfold Penv5
        exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      exact le_trans hn (hW _ _ _ _ _ C1 C2 c1 c2 e1 e2 α α1 α2 _ _ hq0 hq1 hS1 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
        he0 he1 hP0 ha1 ha2 (hb1 γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2) (hb2 γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2))
  
  obtain ⟨A1, hA1d⟩ : ∃ A1 : WC, A1 = fun γ m ξ =>
      ((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • cutA B G tw γ m ξ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨F1, hF1d⟩ : ∃ F1 : WC, F1 = fun γ m ξ =>
      ((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) * psiW B G γ ξ * rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (-(Aex B.h + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        f γ m ξ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA1 : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α A1 := by
    have e : α = α + 0 := (add_zero α).symm
    rw [e, hA1d]
    refine inWg5_smul_mult B G l0 hok α 0 (cutA B G tw)
      (fun γ η => ((rhoQ B γ η ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) hA ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro γ m ξ hξ hts
      obtain ⟨-, hAct, hlg, r1, r2, -, -, e1, e2⟩ := hsg l0 (by omega) α (cutA B G tw) hA γ m ξ hξ hts
      obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hwt 0
      exact (hC l0 (by omega) γ hAct hlg ξ hξ r1 r2 e1 e2).1
    · intro γ m ξ hξ hne c hc
      have hr : rhoQ B γ (shY ξ c) = rhoQ B γ ξ := rfl
      simp only [hr]
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hwt k
      refine ⟨C, b, fun γ m ξ hξ hts _ _ => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨-, hAct, hlg, r1, r2, -, -, e1, e2⟩ := hsg l0 (by omega) α (cutA B G tw) hA γ m ξ hξ hts
      rw [mul_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
      exact (hC l0 (by omega) γ hAct hlg ξ hξ r1 r2 e1 e2).2.2.1
  have hF1 : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α F1 := by
    have e : α = α + 0 := (add_zero α).symm
    rw [e, hF1d]
    refine inWg5_smul_mult B G l0 hok α 0 f
      (fun γ η => ((rhoQ B γ η ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) * psiW B G γ η * rhoQ B γ η ^ (-(Aex B.h + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      hf ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro γ m ξ hξ hts
      obtain ⟨-, hAct, hlg, r1, r2, -, -, e1, e2⟩ := hsg l0 (by omega) α f hf γ m ξ hξ hts
      obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hwt 0
      exact (hC l0 (by omega) γ hAct hlg ξ hξ r1 r2 e1 e2).2.1
    · intro γ m ξ hξ hne c hc
      have hts : ξ ∈ tsupport (f γ m) := subset_tsupport _ (Function.mem_support.2 hne)
      obtain ⟨-, hAct, hlg, r1, r2, -, -, e1, e2⟩ := hsg l0 (by omega) α f hf γ m ξ hξ hts
      obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hwt 0
      have hdeck := (hC l0 (by omega) γ hAct hlg ξ hξ r1 r2 e1 e2).2.2.2.2 c hc
      have hr : rhoQ B γ (shY ξ c) = rhoQ B γ ξ := rfl
      simp only [hr, hdeck]
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hwt k
      refine ⟨C, b, fun γ m ξ hξ hts _ _ => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨-, hAct, hlg, r1, r2, -, -, e1, e2⟩ := hsg l0 (by omega) α f hf γ m ξ hξ hts
      rw [mul_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
      exact (hC l0 (by omega) γ hAct hlg ξ hξ r1 r2 e1 e2).2.2.2.1
  
  have hT1 : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + 1/2)
      (fun γ m ξ => dotProduct (presMult5 B G γ m ξ) (A1 γ m ξ)) := by
    refine inWg5_dot_mult B G l0 hok α (1/2) A1 (presMult5 B G) hA1 ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro γ m ξ hξ hts
      obtain ⟨-, hAct, hlg, r1, r2, x1, x2, e1, e2⟩ := hsg l0 (by omega) α A1 hA1 γ m ξ hξ hts
      obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hpm 0
      exact (hC l0 (by omega) γ m hAct hlg ξ hξ r1 r2 x1 x2 e1 e2).1
    · intro γ m ξ hξ hne c hc
      have hts : ξ ∈ tsupport (A1 γ m) := subset_tsupport _ (Function.mem_support.2 hne)
      obtain ⟨-, hAct, hlg, r1, r2, x1, x2, e1, e2⟩ := hsg l0 (by omega) α A1 hA1 γ m ξ hξ hts
      obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hpm 0
      exact (hC l0 (by omega) γ m hAct hlg ξ hξ r1 r2 x1 x2 e1 e2).2.2 c hc
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hpm k
      refine ⟨C, b, fun γ m ξ hξ hts _ _ => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨-, hAct, hlg, r1, r2, x1, x2, e1, e2⟩ := hsg l0 (by omega) α A1 hA1 γ m ξ hξ hts
      exact (hC l0 (by omega) γ m hAct hlg ξ hξ r1 r2 x1 x2 e1 e2).2.1
  have hT2 : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + 1/2)
      (fun γ m ξ => dotProduct (pulseMult5 B G γ m ξ) (F1 γ m ξ)) := by
    refine inWg5_dot_mult B G l0 hok α (1/2) F1 (pulseMult5 B G) hF1 ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro γ m ξ hξ hts
      obtain ⟨-, hAct, hlg, r1, r2, x1, x2, e1, e2⟩ := hsg l0 (by omega) α F1 hF1 γ m ξ hξ hts
      obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hqm 0
      exact (hC l0 (by omega) γ m hAct hlg ξ hξ r1 r2 x1 x2 e1 e2).2.1
    · intro γ m ξ hξ hne c hc
      have hts : ξ ∈ tsupport (F1 γ m) := subset_tsupport _ (Function.mem_support.2 hne)
      obtain ⟨-, hAct, hlg, r1, r2, x1, x2, e1, e2⟩ := hsg l0 (by omega) α F1 hF1 γ m ξ hξ hts
      obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hqm 0
      exact (hC l0 (by omega) γ m hAct hlg ξ hξ r1 r2 x1 x2 e1 e2).2.2.2 c hc
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hqm k
      refine ⟨C, b, fun γ m ξ hξ hts _ _ => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨-, hAct, hlg, r1, r2, x1, x2, e1, e2⟩ := hsg l0 (by omega) α F1 hF1 γ m ξ hξ hts
      exact (hC l0 (by omega) γ m hAct hlg ξ hξ r1 r2 x1 x2 e1 e2).2.2.1
  
  have hid : cutS B G (pulsePr5 B G f tw) = fun γ m ξ =>
      dotProduct (presMult5 B G γ m ξ) (A1 γ m ξ) + dotProduct (pulseMult5 B G γ m ξ) (F1 γ m ξ) := by
    funext γ m ξ
    rw [hA1d, hF1d]
    by_cases hm : m = 0
    · simp [cutS, pulsePr5, presMult5, pulseMult5, hm]
    · simp only [cutS, pulsePr5, presMult5, pulseMult5, if_neg hm, nsqC5, srcHat, cutA]
      generalize dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) = ν
      generalize rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) = R
      generalize rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (-(Aex B.h + 1)) = s
      generalize psiW B G γ ξ = ps
      simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.vecMul, pulseMatC, Matrix.map_apply,
        Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.sub_apply, nPhiC5]
      push_cast
      ring
  rw [hid]
  obtain ⟨H1, H10, H1v⟩ := hT1.1
  obtain ⟨H2, H20, H2v⟩ := hT2.1
  refine hInWg (α + 1/2) (α + 1/2) (α + 1/2) _ _ _ hT1 hT2 le_rfl le_rfl
    ⟨H1 ∪ H2, by simp [H10, H20], fun γ m hm => ?_⟩ (fun γ m ξ _ => rfl)
  have e1 := H1v γ m (fun h => hm (Finset.mem_union_left _ h))
  have e2 := H2v γ m (fun h => hm (Finset.mem_union_right _ h))
  funext ξ
  have e1' := congrFun e1 ξ
  have e2' := congrFun e2 ξ
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at e1' e2' ⊢

search_metadata.last_error: Approved. The four-way case split (outside tsupport / off the open shell / on the psiW plateau / Gaussian tail) covers every case and all five new children are used in the glue. The PROVED plin5_window_env is exactly blueprint s8, so replacing s5-s8 with it is a legitimate saving, and 0<=v<=L is proved inline. Each child is true and far easier than the parent. inWg5_jet_vanish_off_shell_v5: the open off-shell region plus radial-scaling limits at XC=Xa,Xb. nb_smul_leibniz_v5: Leibniz for real-scalar smul. Neither nb_mul_le_open (complex mul) nor nb_mul_le_v4 (real mul) covers smul into Fin 3 -> C, so it is not a duplicate. src_coeff_nb_v5 is the heaviest child but concerns one explicit function. Its rounding margin (1+bgc)/8 < 1/2 holds, coarseIdx>=0 for q<=2^-8 gives norm(Lnorm)<=3, and the 4^(i*l) bound has a lot of slack. edge_factor_bound_v5 and gauss_poly_absorb_v5 are 1-D inequalities. edge_weight_window does not give the sqrt(ew)*ed^(-d) bound, and rem_split_offsupp5 is unrelated, so neither duplicates a child. Blueprint s4/s5 evidence is substantive; there is no parameter-value splitting and no ancestor restatement.

          |Ca (k - i)| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P) := by
        refine le_trans (hba (k - i) hjk) ?_
        have : Ca (k - i) * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P =
            Ca (k - i) * (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P) := by
          ring
        rw [this]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hA2
      have a3 : nN i * na (k - i) ≤ (|CN i| * (q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i))) *
          (|Ca (k - i)| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P)) :=
        mul_le_mul a1 a2 (hna _) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hA1)
      have hbsum : bN i + bA (k - i) ≤
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j|) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j| := by
        have s1 : |bN i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |bN j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) hi
        have s2 : |bA (k - i)| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |bA j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) hj
        linarith [le_abs_self (bN i), le_abs_self (bA (k - i))]
      have hdsum : dA (k - i) ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dA j| := by
        have s3 : |dA (k - i)| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dA j| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |dA j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) hj
        linarith [le_abs_self (dA (k - i))]
      have f1 : S ^ (bN i + bA (k - i)) ≤
          S ^ ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j|) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j|) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS hbsum
      have f2 : e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) ≤ e ^ (-(∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dA j|)) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge he0 he1 (neg_le_neg hdsum)
      have eq1 : q ^ (B.h * β) * q ^ (B.h * α) = q ^ (B.h * (α + β)) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]; congr 1; ring
      have pQ : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * (α + β)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
      have a4 : (q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i)) *
          (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P) ≤ X := by
        calc (q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i)) *
              (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P)
            = (q ^ (B.h * β) * q ^ (B.h * α)) * (S ^ (bN i) * S ^ (bA (k - i))) * E *
                e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P := by ring
          _ = q ^ (B.h * (α + β)) * S ^ (bN i + bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P := by
              rw [eq1, ← Real.rpow_add hS0]
          _ ≤ X := by
              rw [hXdef]
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hP0
              apply mul_le_mul _ f2 pe
                (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg pQ (Real.rpow_nonneg hS0.le _)) hE)
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hE
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left f1 pQ
      have hc : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      calc (k.choose i : ℝ) * nN i * na (k - i) = (k.choose i : ℝ) * (nN i * na (k - i)) := by ring
        _ ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * ((|CN i| * (q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i))) *
            (|Ca (k - i)| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a3 hc
        _ = (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)| * ((q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i)) *
            (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P)) := by ring
        _ ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)| * X :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a4
              (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc (abs_nonneg _)) (abs_nonneg _))
    calc K * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * nN i * na (k - i)
        ≤ K * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)| * X :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum hterm) hK
      _ = _ := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hXdef]; ring
  
  have hV : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∉ tsupport (a γ m) →
      (fun η => crossC (N γ m η) (a γ m η)) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ) := by
    intro γ m ξ hξ
    have h1 := (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq).1 hξ
    exact h1.mono (fun η hη => by
      show crossC (N γ m η) (a γ m η) = 0
      rw [hη]
      exact hc0 _)
  refine ⟨⟨H, H0, fun γ m hm => ?_⟩, fun γ m => ?_, fun γ m ξ hξ c hc => ?_,
    fun γ m ξ hξ hne => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · funext ξ
    show crossC (N γ m ξ) (a γ m ξ) = 0
    rw [Hv γ m hm]
    exact hc0 _
  · intro ξ hξ
    apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
    by_cases hts : ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m)
    · have hN' := hsm γ m ξ hξ hts
      have ha' := (sa γ m).contDiffAt (hDopen.mem_nhds hξ)
      show ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => crossC (N γ m η) (a γ m η)) ξ
      rw [hP γ m]
      exact (contDiffAt_const.clm_apply hN').clm_apply ha'
    · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hV γ m ξ hts)
  · show crossC (N γ m (shY ξ c)) (a γ m (shY ξ c)) = crossC (N γ m ξ) (a γ m ξ)
    rw [da γ m ξ hξ c hc]
    by_cases h0 : a γ m ξ = 0
    · rw [h0, hc0, hc0]
    · rw [hdeck γ m ξ hξ h0 c hc]
  · apply pa γ m ξ hξ
    intro h0
    apply hne
    show crossC (N γ m ξ) (a γ m ξ) = 0
    rw [h0]
    exact hc0 _
  · refine ⟨‖Bl‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)|,
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j|) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j|,
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dA j|, fun γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hq0, hq1, hS1⟩ := hDq ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨hE, he0, he1⟩ := hEdge _ hX1 hX2
    have hPv : 0 ≤ Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by
      unfold Penv5
      exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
    show NB B.h (fun η => crossC (N γ m η) (a γ m η)) k ξ ≤ _
    by_cases hts : ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m)
    · have hNk : ContDiffAt ℝ k (N γ m) ξ := (hsm γ m ξ hξ hts).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hNu⟩ := hNk.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
      obtain ⟨O, hOsub, hOopen, hξO⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp (Filter.inter_mem hu (hDopen.mem_nhds hξ))
      have hNO : ContDiffOn ℝ k (N γ m) O := hNu.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).1)
      have haO : ContDiffOn ℝ k (a γ m) O :=
        ((sa γ m).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).2)
      have hL := hLeib (N γ m) (a γ m) O ξ k hOopen hξO hNO haO
      rw [hP γ m]
      refine le_trans hL ?_
      exact comb k (qC B.h ξ) (SC B.h ξ) (Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)))
        (edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ)) (Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)) ‖Bl‖
        (fun i => NB B.h (N γ m) i ξ) (fun j => NB B.h (a γ m) j ξ) hq0 hS1 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
        he0 he1 hPv (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg Bl) (fun i => norm_nonneg _) (fun j => norm_nonneg _)
        (fun i _ => hN i γ m ξ hξ hts hX1 hX2) (fun j _ => hA j γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2)
    · have hev := hV γ m ξ hts
      have h0 : NB B.h (fun η => crossC (N γ m η) (a γ m η)) k ξ = 0 := by
        unfold NB
        rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
        have e : ((0 : Cyl → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => Cyl) (Fin 3 → ℂ)) ξ
            ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) = 0 := by
          ext m
          simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
        rw [e, norm_zero]
      rw [h0]
      have hC0 : 0 ≤ ‖Bl‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)| :=
        mul_nonneg (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg Bl) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ =>
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) (abs_nonneg _)))
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC0
        (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
        (Real.rpow_nonneg he0.le _)) hPv

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (α : ℝ) (a : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → V), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) → SuppW B G γ ξ ∧ ActiveL4 B G γ ∧ l0 ≤ γ.1 ∧ 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 ∧ qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 ∧ B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb ∧ |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 ∧ |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (α : ℝ) (a : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → V), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) → SuppW B G γ ξ ∧ ActiveL4 B G γ ∧ l0 ≤ γ.1 ∧ 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 ∧ qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 ∧ B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb ∧ |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 ∧ |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, hXa, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -, hqB0, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n0, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 V _ _ α a ha γ m ξ hξ hts
  
  have hQb : ∀ l : ℕ, Qb l = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l := by
    intro l
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    show Qb l0 ≤ B.qB
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hl0) hn0.le
  have hU : IsOpen ({ζ : Cyl | 0 < ζ.1} ∩ {ζ : Cyl | ζ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ζ : Cyl | 0 < ζ.1} ∩ {ζ : Cyl | ζ.2.2.1 < 1}) := by
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ζ : Cyl => ((ζ.2.1, 1 - ζ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ζ : Cyl => ((ζ.2.1, 1 - ζ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ζ : Cyl | 0 < ζ.1} ∩ {ζ : Cyl | ζ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ζ hζ
      have h' : ζ.2.2.1 < 1 := hζ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ζ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    exact h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ζ : Cyl | 0 < ζ.1} ∩ {ζ : Cyl | ζ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ζ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  have hqcont : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ContinuousAt (qC B.h) η := by
    intro η hη
    have hη' : 0 < η.1 ∧ η.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h η < qsOf l0 := hη
    exact hcont.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds ⟨hη'.1, hη'.2.1⟩)
  have hqpos : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < qC B.h η := by
    intro η hη
    have hη' : 0 < η.1 ∧ η.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h η < qsOf l0 := hη
    exact (hok.1.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith [hη'.2.1])).1
  have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
  
  have lim : ∀ {Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace Y] (g : Cyl → Y) (S' : Set Cyl) (T : Set Y),
      ContinuousAt g ξ → ξ ∈ closure S' → IsClosed T → (∀ η ∈ S', g η ∈ T) → g ξ ∈ T := by
    intro Y _ g S' T hg hcl hT hmap
    have := hg.continuousWithinAt.mem_closure hcl hmap
    rwa [hT.closure_eq] at this
  
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ : ∃ f : Cyl → V, f = a γ m := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hf] at hts
  have hfc : ContinuousOn f (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    rw [hf]; exact (ha.2.1 γ m).continuousOn
  have hSupp : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), f η ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ η := by
    rw [hf]; exact fun η hη hne => ha.2.2.2.1 γ m η hη hne
  have hSS : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ Function.support f, SuppW B G γ η :=
    fun η hη => hSupp η hη.1 hη.2
  have hξS : ξ ∈ closure (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ Function.support f) :=
    hDopen.inter_closure ⟨hξ, hts⟩
  obtain ⟨η0, hη0U, hη0⟩ := Set.Nonempty.of_closure ⟨ξ, hξS⟩
  have hS0 := hSS η0 ⟨hη0U, hη0⟩
  
  have htsE : ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL B.h γ) :=
    closure_minimal (fun η hη => (hSS η hη).2.1) (isClosed_tsupport _) hξS
  
  have hXCc : ContinuousAt (XC B.h) ξ := by
    have h1 : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ 2) ξ := (continuous_fst.pow 2).continuousAt
    have h2 : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => 2 * qC B.h η) ξ := continuousAt_const.mul (hqcont ξ hξ)
    have h3 : 2 * qC B.h ξ ≠ 0 := by have := hqpos ξ hξ; positivity
    exact h1.div h2 h3
  have hXa' : B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ :=
    lim (XC B.h) _ (Set.Ici B.Xa) hXCc hξS isClosed_Ici (fun η hη => (hSS η hη).2.2.2.2.1)
  have hXb' : XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb :=
    lim (XC B.h) _ (Set.Iic B.Xb) hXCc hξS isClosed_Iic (fun η hη => (hSS η hη).2.2.2.2.2)
  
  have hr0 : 0 < G.r0 := hG.1.1
  have hr1 : G.r0 ≤ 1/100 := hG.1.2.1
  have hbgc0 : 0 ≤ bgc := by
    unfold bgc; nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
  have hbgc1 : bgc ≤ 1 := by
    unfold bgc; nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
  have hinv : ∀ v : ℝ × ℝ, v.1 = lamR v + bgc * lamT v ∧ v.2 = -bgc * lamR v + lamT v := by
    intro v
    have hd : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    unfold lamR lamT
    constructor
    · field_simp; ring
    · field_simp; ring
  have hsmall : ∀ v : ℝ × ℝ, |lamR v| ≤ G.r0 / 4 → |lamT v| ≤ G.r0 →
      |v.1| ≤ 1/80 ∧ |v.2| ≤ 1/80 := by
    intro v h1 h2
    obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hinv v
    rw [abs_le] at h1 h2
    have p1 : bgc * lamT v ≤ bgc * G.r0 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2.2 hbgc0
    have p2 : bgc * (-G.r0) ≤ bgc * lamT v := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2.1 hbgc0
    have p3 : bgc * lamR v ≤ bgc * (G.r0/4) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1.2 hbgc0
    have p4 : bgc * (-(G.r0/4)) ≤ bgc * lamR v := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1.1 hbgc0
    have p5 : bgc * G.r0 ≤ G.r0 := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hbgc1) hr0.le]
    have p6 : bgc * (G.r0/4) ≤ G.r0/4 := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hbgc1) hr0.le]
    constructor
    · rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> nlinarith
    · rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> nlinarith
  have R : ∀ (x : ℝ) (j : ℤ), |x - j| < 1/2 → round x = j := by
    intro x j hx
    rw [round_eq, Int.floor_eq_iff]
    rw [abs_lt] at hx
    constructor <;> linarith
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : Cyl → ℝ × ℝ, w = fun η => Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hwc : Continuous w := by rw [hw]; unfold Jpow; fun_prop
  have hxiw : ∀ η : Cyl, xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 = lamR (frac0 (w η)) := by
    intro η; rw [hw]; rfl
  have hetw : ∀ η : Cyl, etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 = lamT (frac0 (w η)) := by
    intro η; rw [hw]; rfl
  have hNo : IsOpen {η : Cyl | |(w η).1 - (w ξ).1| < 1/4 ∧ |(w η).2 - (w ξ).2| < 1/4} := by
    have h1 : IsOpen {η : Cyl | |(w η).1 - (w ξ).1| < 1/4} :=
      isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
    have h2 : IsOpen {η : Cyl | |(w η).2 - (w ξ).2| < 1/4} :=
      isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
    exact h1.inter h2
  have hξN : ξ ∈ closure ({η : Cyl | |(w η).1 - (w ξ).1| < 1/4 ∧ |(w η).2 - (w ξ).2| < 1/4} ∩
      (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ Function.support f)) :=
    hNo.inter_closure ⟨by simp, hξS⟩
  have hfreeze : ∀ η ∈ {η : Cyl | |(w η).1 - (w ξ).1| < 1/4 ∧ |(w η).2 - (w ξ).2| < 1/4} ∩
      (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ Function.support f),
      frac0 (w η) = ((w η).1 - ((round (w ξ).1 : ℤ) : ℝ), (w η).2 - ((round (w ξ).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)) := by
    rintro η ⟨⟨hN1, hN2⟩, hηS⟩
    have hs := hSS η hηS
    have h1 := hs.2.2.1
    have h2 := hs.2.2.2.1
    rw [hxiw] at h1
    rw [hetw] at h2
    obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := hsmall _ h1 h2
    have b1' : |(w η).1 - ((round (w η).1 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1/80 := b1
    have b2' : |(w η).2 - ((round (w η).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1/80 := b2

def UJet5 {ι : Type} (h : ℝ) (P : ι → Cyl → Prop) (f : ι → Cyl → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ i ξ, P i ξ → ∃ U : Set Cyl, IsOpen U ∧ ξ ∈ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f i) U) ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ i ξ, P i ξ → NB h (f i) k ξ ≤ C * SC h ξ ^ b

def GoodPt5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l1 : ℕ) (i : ℕ × Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : Prop :=
  l1 ≤ i.1 ∧ ActiveL4 B G i.2 ∧ i.1 ≤ i.2.1 ∧ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf i.1) ∧
  1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb i.2.1 ∧ qC B.h ξ / Qb i.2.1 < 4 ∧
  B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb ∧ |xiG B.h i.2 (G.ctr i.2) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 ∧
  |etG B.h i.2 (G.ctr i.2) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8

    have hHs := param_fderiv H hH
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hUo w hw
    set s := Metric.closedBall w (δ / 2) with hs
    have hsU : s ⊆ U := (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
    have hsn : s ∈ nhds w := Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds w (by linarith)
    have hK : IsCompact (Icc (0:ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ s) := isCompact_Icc.prod (isCompact_closedBall _ _)
    have hKsub : Icc (0:ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ s ⊆ univ ×ˢ U := fun z hz => ⟨mem_univ _, hsU hz.2⟩
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hHs.continuousOn.mono hKsub)
    have hcontφ : ∀ x ∈ U, Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => H (φ, x)) := by
      intro x hx
      exact hH.continuousOn.comp_continuous (by fun_prop) (fun φ => ⟨mem_univ _, hx⟩)
    have hcontφ' : ∀ x ∈ U, Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => fderiv ℝ (fun w' => H (φ, w')) x) := by
      intro x hx
      exact hHs.continuousOn.comp_continuous (f := fun φ : ℝ => ((φ, x) : ℝ × Cyl)) (by fun_prop)
        (fun φ => ⟨mem_univ _, hx⟩)
    have hpi : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
    refine intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (μ := volume)
      (F := fun x φ => H (φ, x)) (F' := fun x φ => fderiv ℝ (fun w' => H (φ, w')) x)
      (bound := fun _ => B) hsn ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · filter_upwards [hUo.mem_nhds hw] with x hx
      exact (hcontφ x hx).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact (hcontφ w hw).intervalIntegrable _ _
    · exact (hcontφ' w hw).aestronglyMeasurable
    · refine ae_of_all _ (fun φ hφ x hx => ?_)
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hpi] at hφ
      exact hB (φ, x) ⟨Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hφ, hx⟩
    · exact intervalIntegrable_const
    · refine ae_of_all _ (fun φ _ x hx => ?_)
      have hxU : x ∈ U := hsU hx
      have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ H (φ, x) := hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds ⟨mem_univ _, hxU⟩)
      have : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w' => H (φ, w')) x :=
        hHa.comp x (by fun_prop : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w' : Cyl => ((φ, w') : ℝ × Cyl)) x)
      exact (this.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
  have param_nat : ∀ (k : ℕ) {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
      [CompleteSpace F] (H : ℝ × Cyl → F), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H (univ ×ˢ U) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun w' => ∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H (φ, w')) U := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro F _ _ _ H hH
      have hD : DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun w' => ∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H (φ, w')) U :=
        fun w hw => (param_hasFDeriv H hH w hw).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      rw [Nat.cast_zero]
      exact contDiffOn_zero.mpr hD.continuousOn
    | succ k ih =>
      intro F _ _ _ H hH
      have hD : DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun w' => ∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H (φ, w')) U :=
        fun w hw => (param_hasFDeriv H hH w hw).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      have hCS : CompleteSpace (Cyl →L[ℝ] F) := ContinuousLinearMap.instCompleteSpace (E := Cyl)
      have hIH := @ih (Cyl →L[ℝ] F) _ _ hCS
        (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => fderiv ℝ (fun w' => H (p.1, w')) p.2) (param_fderiv H hH)
      rw [Nat.cast_succ]
      refine (contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hUo).mpr ⟨hD, fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact absurd h (by simp)
      · refine hIH.congr (fun w hw => ?_)
        exact (param_hasFDeriv H hH w hw).fderiv
  exact contDiffOn_infty.mpr (fun k => param_nat k g hg)

signature.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (qs α : ℝ) (a : WC), B.ok → InWg5 B G qs α a →

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G qs α a hok hW ξ₀ hξ₀
  have hξ₀' : 0 < ξ₀.1 ∧ ξ₀.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ₀ < qs := hξ₀
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  obtain ⟨⟨H, -, hH⟩, -, -, hsupp, -⟩ := hW
  
  have etaL_loc : ∀ (h : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → ∀ ξ0 : Cyl, ξ0.2.2.1 < 1 → ∃ N ∈ nhds ξ0,
      ∃ Γ : Finset Lab, ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ N → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) → γ ∈ Γ := by
    intro h hS ξ0 hξ0
    have hLc : ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ContinuousAt (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) ξ := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hτ : 0 < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 := by linarith
      have hqpos : 0 < qC h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).1
      have hqcont : ContinuousAt (qC h) ξ := by
        have hU : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
        have hp : ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
          ⟨trivial, hτ⟩
        have hg : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) :=
          hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)
        have hk : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) ξ := by fun_prop
        have he : qC h = (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘
            (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
          funext η; rfl
        rw [he]
        exact ContinuousAt.comp hg hk
      exact hqcont.logb hqpos.ne'
    have hwin : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (γ : Lab), ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) →
        |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) + (γ.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartR h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartZ h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartT h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
      intro ξ γ hξ hγ
      have s1 : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ → 1 < |φ ξ / μ - (j : ℝ)| →
          ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 := by
        intro μ j φ hφ h1
        have hψ : ContinuousAt (fun η => |φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)|) ξ :=
          ((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs
        have hev := (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : Cyl => (1:ℝ)) ξ).eventually_lt hψ h1
        filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
        have hsq : 1 < (φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)) ^ 2 := (one_lt_sq_iff_one_lt_abs _).mpr hη
        unfold sqPart bumpR
        rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), zero_div]
      have key : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ →
          (∀ η, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 → etaL h γ η = 0) → |φ ξ / μ - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
        intro μ j φ hφ himp
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have hev := s1 μ j φ hφ hc
        apply (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mpr _) hγ
        filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
        exact himp η hη
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have := key 1 (-(γ.1:ℤ)) (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) (hLc ξ hξ)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul])
        simpa [div_one, sub_neg_eq_add] using this
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.1 (chartR h γ.1) (by unfold chartR; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.1 (chartZ h γ.1) (by unfold chartZ; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.2 (chartT h γ.1) (by unfold chartT; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
    obtain ⟨L0, hL0⟩ : ∃ L0 : ℝ, L0 = Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hfin : (⋃ n ∈ Set.Iic ⌊2 - L0⌋₊, ({n} : Set ℕ) ×ˢ
        ((Set.Icc ⌈chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ⌈chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ⌈chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋) ×ˢ
          (Set.univ : Set Bool))).Finite := by
      refine Set.Finite.biUnion (Set.finite_Iic _) (fun n _ => ?_)
      exact (Set.finite_singleton n).prod (((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod
        ((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod (Set.finite_Icc _ _))).prod Set.finite_univ)
    have hI : ∀ (x c : ℝ) (j : ℤ), |x - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 → |x - c| < 1 → j ∈ Set.Icc ⌈c - 2⌉ ⌊c + 2⌋ := by
      intro x c j hj hc
      rw [abs_le] at hj
      rw [abs_lt] at hc
      exact ⟨Int.ceil_le.mpr (by linarith [hj.2, hc.1]), Int.le_floor.mpr (by linarith [hj.1, hc.2])⟩
    have hcR : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartR h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartR; fun_prop
    have hcZ : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartZ h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartZ; fun_prop
    have hcT : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartT h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartT; fun_prop
    have hch : ∀ (φ : Cyl → ℝ) (μ : ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ0 →
        ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, |φ ξ / μ - φ ξ0 / μ| < 1 := by
      intro φ μ hφ
      exact (((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs).eventually_lt continuousAt_const
        (by simp)
    have e1 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 :=
      (show ContinuousAt (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.2.2.1) ξ0 by fun_prop).eventually_lt
        continuousAt_const hξ0
    have e2 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) - L0| < 1 :=
      (((hLc ξ0 hξ0).sub continuousAt_const).abs).eventually_lt continuousAt_const
        (by simp [hL0])
    have e3 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊2 - L0⌋₊ + 1),
        |chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 := by
      rw [Filter.eventually_all_finset]
      intro n _
      exact (hch _ _ (hcR n)).and ((hch _ _ (hcZ n)).and (hch _ _ (hcT n)))
    refine ⟨{ξ | ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) - L0| < 1 ∧
        ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊2 - L0⌋₊ + 1),
        |chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1}, ?_,
      hfin.toFinset, ?_⟩
    · filter_upwards [e1, e2, e3] with ξ h1 h2 h3
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    rintro ⟨n, ⟨a, b, c⟩, σ⟩ ξ ⟨ht, hL, hC⟩ hγ
    obtain ⟨w0, wR, wZ, wT⟩ := hwin ξ _ ht hγ
    simp only at w0 wR wZ wT
    rw [abs_le] at w0
    rw [abs_lt] at hL
    have hn : n ≤ ⌊2 - L0⌋₊ := Nat.le_floor (by linarith [w0.2, hL.1])
    obtain ⟨cR, cZ, cT⟩ := hC n (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn))
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨n, hn, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨rfl, ⟨hI _ _ _ wR cR, hI _ _ _ wZ cZ, hI _ _ _ wT cT⟩, trivial⟩
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀, Γ, hΓ⟩ := etaL_loc B.h hS ξ₀ hξ₀'.2.1
  refine ⟨interior N₀, isOpen_interior, mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr hN₀, Γ, H, ?_⟩
  rintro ξ ⟨hξN, hξD⟩ γ m hne
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have hs := hsupp γ m ξ hξD hne
    exact hΓ γ ξ (interior_subset hξN) hs.2.1
  · by_contra hm
    apply hne
    rw [hH γ m hm]
    rfl

signature.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (qs α : ℝ) (a : WC), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G →

      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => a γ m p.2 i * ephase5 B G γ m p.1 p.2) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h qs)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G qs α a hok hG hqs ha γ m i
  
  have hamp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => a γ m p.2 i) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h qs) := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => a γ m η i) (DomC B.h qs) := contDiffOn_pi.1 (ha.2.1 γ m) i
    exact h1.comp contDiff_snd.contDiffOn (fun p hp => hp.2)
  
  set v : Cyl → ℝ × ℝ := fun η => Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ with hv
  have hvc : Continuous v := by
    rw [hv]
    unfold Jpow
    fun_prop
  
  have hbase : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => baseC B γ.1 η j) (DomC B.h qs) := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨_, hsm⟩ := geom_slow_base_smooth_v5 B hok
    have hπ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      contDiff_fst.prodMk (contDiff_snd.fst.prodMk contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
    have hc := (hsm γ.1 j).comp hπ.contDiffOn
      (fun ξ (hξ : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qs) =>
        (⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ.2.2 hqs⟩ : ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈
          {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}))
    exact hc.congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
  have hZ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => chartZ B.h γ.1 η) := by
    unfold chartZ
    exact contDiff_snd.fst.div_const _
  have hRC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => RC γ.1 η) := by
    unfold RC
    exact contDiff_fst.div_const _
  have hRCpos : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs, RC γ.1 η ≠ 0 := by
    intro η hη
    have hr : 0 < η.1 := hη.1
    have : 0 < RC γ.1 η :=
      div_pos hr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _))
    exact this.ne'
  have hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Fang B γ.1 η) (DomC B.h qs) :=
    ((hbase 1).div hRC.contDiffOn hRCpos).congr (fun η _ => rfl)
  have hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => ((p.1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h qs) :=
    (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp contDiff_fst).contDiffOn.congr
      (fun p _ => by simp only [Function.comp_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply])
  apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
  rintro ⟨θ₀, ξ₀⟩ ⟨-, hξ₀⟩
  set U' : Set Cyl := {η | |(v η).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8} ∩ {η | |(v η).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8} with hU'
  have hU'o : IsOpen U' :=
    (isOpen_lt ((hvc.fst.sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt ((hvc.snd.sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const)
  have hξU : ξ₀ ∈ U' := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show |(v ξ₀).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8
      rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; norm_num
    · show |(v ξ₀).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8
      rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; norm_num
  refine ⟨univ ×ˢ U', isOpen_univ.prod hU'o, ⟨mem_univ _, hξU⟩, ?_⟩
  by_cases hA : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs ∩ U', a γ m η = 0
  · 
    refine (contDiffOn_const (c := (0:ℂ))).congr (fun p hp => ?_)
    have h0 := hA p.2 ⟨hp.1.2, hp.2.2⟩
    simp [h0]
  · 
    push_neg at hA
    obtain ⟨η1, ⟨hη1D, hη1U⟩, hη1⟩ := hA
    obtain ⟨-, -, hxi, het, -, -⟩ := ha.2.2.2.1 γ m η1 hη1D hη1
    have hr0 : G.r0 ≤ 1/100 := hG.1.2.1
    have hb0 : 0 ≤ bgc := by unfold bgc; linarith [Real.one_lt_sqrt_two]
    have hb1 : bgc ≤ 1 := by
      unfold bgc
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
    have hden : (1 + bgc ^ 2) * (1 + bgc ^ 2)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity)
    have id1 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.1 = lamR w + bgc * lamT w := by
      intro w
      simp only [lamR, lamT, div_eq_mul_inv]
      linear_combination (-w.1) * hden
    have id2 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.2 = -(bgc * lamR w) + lamT w := by
      intro w
      simp only [lamR, lamT, div_eq_mul_inv]
      linear_combination (-w.2) * hden
    have key : ∀ (R T : ℝ), |R| ≤ G.r0 / 4 → |T| ≤ G.r0 →
        |R + bgc * T| ≤ 1/80 ∧ |-(bgc * R) + T| ≤ 1/80 := by
      intro R T hR hT
      obtain ⟨hR1, hR2⟩ := abs_le.mp hR
      obtain ⟨hT1, hT2⟩ := abs_le.mp hT
      have hr0n : 0 ≤ G.r0 := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hT
      have e1 : bgc * T ≤ G.r0 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hT2), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
      have e2 : -G.r0 ≤ bgc * T := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (show 0 ≤ T + G.r0 by linarith),
          mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
      have e3 : bgc * R ≤ G.r0 / 4 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hR2), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
      have e4 : -(G.r0 / 4) ≤ bgc * R := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (show 0 ≤ R + G.r0 / 4 by linarith),
          mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
      exact ⟨abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
    have hround : ∀ (x : ℝ) (k : ℤ), |x - k| < 1/2 → round x = k := by
      intro x k hk
      rw [round_eq, Int.floor_eq_iff]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hk
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hw1 : |lamR (frac0 (v η1))| ≤ G.r0 / 4 := hxi
    have hw2 : |lamT (frac0 (v η1))| ≤ G.r0 := het
    have hw := key _ _ hw1 hw2
    have ex1 : (v η1).1 - ((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ) =
        lamR (frac0 (v η1)) + bgc * lamT (frac0 (v η1)) := id1 (frac0 (v η1))
    have ex2 : (v η1).2 - ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ) =
        -(bgc * lamR (frac0 (v η1))) + lamT (frac0 (v η1)) := id2 (frac0 (v η1))
    have hx1 : |(v η1).1 - ((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1/80 := by rw [ex1]; exact hw.1
    have hx2 : |(v η1).2 - ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1/80 := by rw [ex2]; exact hw.2
    obtain ⟨kk, hkk⟩ : ∃ kk : ℝ × ℝ,
        kk = (((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ), ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hfr : ∀ η ∈ U', frac0 (v η) = v η - kk := by
      intro η hη
      have h1 : |(v η).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8 := hη.1
      have h2 : |(v η).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8 := hη.2
      have g1 : |(v η1).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8 := hη1U.1
      have g2 : |(v η1).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8 := hη1U.2
      obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_lt.mp h1
      obtain ⟨a3, a4⟩ := abs_lt.mp h2
      obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := abs_lt.mp g1
      obtain ⟨b3, b4⟩ := abs_lt.mp g2
      obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := abs_le.mp hx1
      obtain ⟨c3, c4⟩ := abs_le.mp hx2
      have r1 : round (v η).1 = round (v η1).1 :=
        hround _ _ (abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
      have r2 : round (v η).2 = round (v η1).2 :=
        hround _ _ (abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
      rw [hkk]
      unfold frac0
      rw [r1, r2]
      rfl
    
    have hT : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => lamT (v η - kk)) := by
      simp only [hv, lamT, Jpow, div_eq_mul_inv]
      fun_prop
    obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ M : Cyl → ℝ, M = fun η : Cyl =>
        pzr5 B G γ * chartZ B.h γ.1 η / epsb B.h γ.1 + sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 * RC γ.1 η
        - (lamT (v η - kk) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 *
          (pang5 B G γ * Fang B γ.1 η + pzr5 B G γ * baseC B γ.1 η 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hM : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ M (DomC B.h qs) := by
      rw [hMdef]
      exact ((((contDiffOn_const (c := pzr5 B G γ)).mul hZ.contDiffOn).div_const (epsb B.h γ.1)).add
        ((contDiffOn_const (c := sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2)).mul hRC.contDiffOn)).sub
        (((hT.contDiffOn.add (contDiffOn_const (c := G.r0))).div_const (cib B.h γ.1)).mul
          (((contDiffOn_const (c := pang5 B G γ)).mul hF).add
            ((contDiffOn_const (c := pzr5 B G γ)).mul (hbase 2))))
    have hmod : ∀ η ∈ U', phiL5 B G γ η = M η := by
      intro η hη
      have hvco : vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 = (lamT (v η - kk) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 := by
        show (lamT (frac0 (v η)) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 = _
        rw [hfr η hη]
      rw [hMdef]
      show phiL5 B G γ η = _
      unfold phiL5
      rw [hvco]
    have hMp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => ((M p.2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h qs) :=
      (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn
        (hM.comp contDiff_snd.contDiffOn (fun p hp => hp.2))).congr
        (fun p _ => by simp only [Function.comp_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply])
    have hE : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) *
        ((pint5 B G γ : ℂ) * ((p.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) + (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((M p.2 : ℝ) : ℂ))))
        (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h qs) :=
      ((contDiffOn_const (c := Complex.I * (m : ℂ))).mul
        (((contDiffOn_const (c := (pint5 B G γ : ℂ))).mul hθ).add
          ((contDiffOn_const (c := (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ))).mul hMp))).cexp
    refine ((hamp.mul hE).mono inter_subset_left).congr (fun p hp => ?_)
    have hpU : p.2 ∈ U' := hp.2.2
    show a γ m p.2 i * ephase5 B G γ m p.1 p.2 = _
    unfold ephase5
    rw [hmod p.2 hpU]

signature.name: thetaOf_periodic_comp
signature.statement:
∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (V : Set E) (Φ : ℝ × E → ℝ),
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ (univ ×ˢ V) → (∀ (θ : ℝ) (e : E), Φ (θ + 2 * Real.pi, e) = Φ (θ, e)) →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × E => Φ (thetaOf p.1, p.2)) ({y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y} ×ˢ V)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro E _ _ V Φ hΦ hper
  set Z : ℝ³ → ℂ := fun y => (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ) with hZdef
  have hp0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => y 0) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
  have hp1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => y 1) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
  have hZeq : Z = fun y => Complex.ofRealCLM (y 0) + Complex.ofRealCLM (y 1) * Complex.I := by
    funext y; apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hZdef]
  have hZ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Z := by
    rw [hZeq]
    exact (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp hp0).add
      ((Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp hp1).mul contDiff_const)
  
  have harg : ∀ z : ℂ, z ∈ Complex.slitPlane → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Complex.arg z := by
    intro z hz
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Complex.log z := (Complex.contDiffAt_log hz).restrict_scalars ℝ
    have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w => (Complex.log w).im) z :=
      Complex.imCLM.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp z h1
    have e : (fun w => (Complex.log w).im) = Complex.arg := by
      funext w; exact Complex.log_im w
    rwa [e] at h2
  
  have hbr : ∀ z : ℂ, z ≠ 0 → ∀ e : E,
      Φ (Complex.arg z, e) = Φ (Complex.arg (-z) + Real.pi, e) := by
    intro z hz e
    rcases lt_trichotomy z.im 0 with h | h | h
    · rw [Complex.arg_neg_eq_arg_add_pi_of_im_neg h,
        show z.arg + Real.pi + Real.pi = z.arg + 2 * Real.pi by ring, hper]
    · have hre : z.re ≠ 0 := by
        intro hr; apply hz; exact Complex.ext (by simp [hr]) (by simp [h])
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hre with hr | hr
      · have h1 : z.arg = Real.pi := Complex.arg_eq_pi_iff.mpr ⟨hr, h⟩
        have h2 : (-z).arg = 0 :=
          Complex.arg_eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨by simp only [Complex.neg_re]; linarith, by simp [h]⟩
        rw [h1, h2, zero_add]
      · have h1 : z.arg = 0 := Complex.arg_eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨hr.le, h⟩
        have h2 : (-z).arg = Real.pi :=
          Complex.arg_eq_pi_iff.mpr ⟨by simp only [Complex.neg_re]; linarith, by simp [h]⟩
        rw [h1, h2, show Real.pi + Real.pi = 0 + 2 * Real.pi by ring, hper]
    · rw [Complex.arg_neg_eq_arg_sub_pi_of_im_pos h, sub_add_cancel]
  
  have hZne : ∀ y : ℝ³, 0 < rad y → Z y ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy h
    have h0 : y 0 = 0 := by
      have := congrArg Complex.re h; simpa [hZdef] using this
    have h1 : y 1 = 0 := by
      have := congrArg Complex.im h; simpa [hZdef] using this
    simp [rad, h0, h1] at hy
  
  set N₁ : Set ℝ³ := Z ⁻¹' Complex.slitPlane with hN₁def
  set N₂ : Set ℝ³ := (fun y => -Z y) ⁻¹' Complex.slitPlane with hN₂def
  have hN₁ : IsOpen N₁ := Complex.isOpen_slitPlane.preimage hZ.continuous
  have hN₂ : IsOpen N₂ := Complex.isOpen_slitPlane.preimage hZ.continuous.neg
  have hcov : ∀ y : ℝ³, 0 < rad y → y ∈ N₁ ∨ y ∈ N₂ := by
    intro y hy
    by_cases h : Z y ∈ Complex.slitPlane
    · exact Or.inl h
    · right
      rw [Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff] at h
      push_neg at h
      have hre : (Z y).re ≠ 0 := fun hr =>
        hZne y hy (Complex.ext (by simp [hr]) (by simp [h.2]))
      show -Z y ∈ Complex.slitPlane
      rw [Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff]
      left
      simp only [Complex.neg_re]
      exact neg_pos.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne h.1 hre)
  
  have hα₁ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Complex.arg (Z y)) N₁ := fun y hy =>
    ((harg _ hy).comp y hZ.contDiffAt).contDiffWithinAt
  have hα₂ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Complex.arg (-Z y) + Real.pi) N₂ := fun y hy =>
    (((harg _ hy).comp y hZ.neg.contDiffAt).add contDiffAt_const).contDiffWithinAt
  have hcomp : ∀ (α : ℝ³ → ℝ) (N : Set ℝ³), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ α N →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × E => Φ (α p.1, p.2)) (N ×ˢ V) := by
    intro α N hα
    have hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × E => (α p.1, p.2)) (N ×ˢ V) :=
      (hα.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun p hp => hp.1)).prodMk contDiff_snd.contDiffOn
    exact hΦ.comp hψ (fun p hp => ⟨mem_univ _, hp.2⟩)
  
  apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
  rintro ⟨y, e⟩ ⟨hy, he⟩
  rcases hcov y hy with h | h
  · refine ⟨N₁ ×ˢ univ, hN₁.prod isOpen_univ, ⟨h, mem_univ _⟩, ?_⟩
    exact ((hcomp _ N₁ hα₁).mono (fun q hq => ⟨hq.2.1, hq.1.2⟩)).congr (fun q _ => rfl)
  · refine ⟨N₂ ×ˢ univ, hN₂.prod isOpen_univ, ⟨h, mem_univ _⟩, ?_⟩
    refine ((hcomp _ N₂ hα₂).mono (fun q hq => ⟨hq.2.1, hq.1.2⟩)).congr (fun q hq => ?_)
    exact hbr (Z q.1) (hZne q.1 hq.1.1) q.2
