proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 S hok hqB hPsi hW
  have hσ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
    hok.1.2.2.2.1
  have hc : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x i) := fun i => contDiff_piLp_apply 2
  
  have hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) := ((hc 0).pow 2).add ((hc 1).pow 2)
  have hrad : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ rad {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} := by
    have h := hf.contDiffOn.sqrt (s := {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x}) (fun x hx => by
      have hx' : 0 < Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) := hx
      exact (Real.sqrt_pos.mp hx').ne')
    exact h
  have hinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (rad x)⁻¹) {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} :=
    hrad.inv (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
  have hrv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ radVec := by
    have h : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
        x 1 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) :=
      ((hc 0).smul contDiff_const).add ((hc 1).smul contDiff_const)
    exact h
  have haz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ azVec := by
    have h : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => -(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
        x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) :=
      ((hc 1).neg.smul contDiff_const).add ((hc 0).smul contDiff_const)
    exact h
  have heR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ eR {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} := hinv.smul hrv.contDiffOn
  have heTh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ eTh {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} := hinv.smul haz.contDiffOn
  
  have hfst : MapsTo (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => w.1) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1}
      {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} := fun w hw => hw.1
  have c1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => rad w.1)
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} :=
    hrad.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn hfst
  have c2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => w.1 2)
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} :=
    ((hc 2).comp contDiff_fst).contDiffOn
  have c3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => w.2.1)
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} :=
    contDiff_snd.fst.contDiffOn
  have c4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2.1 + w.2.2)
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} := by
    have hp := c1.rpow_const_of_ne (p := drx B.h) (fun w hw => ne_of_gt hw.1)
    exact ((hp.smul contDiffOn_const).add (c3.smul contDiffOn_const)).add contDiff_snd.snd.contDiffOn
  have hξ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ptOf w.1 w.2.1 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2.1 + w.2.2))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} :=
    c1.prodMk (c2.prodMk (c3.prodMk c4))
  have hmap : MapsTo (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ptOf w.1 w.2.1 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2.1 + w.2.2))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    fun w hw => ⟨hw.1, hw.2.1, hw.2.2⟩
  
  have hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2.1))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} := by
    have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      ((hc 2).comp contDiff_fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.fst)
    exact hσ.comp hg.contDiffOn (fun w hw =>
      ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2.1 by linarith [hw.2.1]⟩)
  have hpref : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
      simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2.1) ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} :=
    hq.rpow_const_of_ne (fun w hw =>
      ((hok.1.1 (w.1 2) (1 - w.2.1) (by linarith [hw.2.1])).1).ne')
  
  have hBP := hok.2
  unfold BackgroundProps at hBP
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, ⟨hAB0, -, -⟩, -⟩ := hBP
  have hABc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => B.AB w.1 w.2.1)
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} := by
    have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((w.1, w.2.1) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) :=
      contDiff_fst.prodMk contDiff_snd.fst
    exact hAB0.comp hg.contDiffOn (fun w hw => ⟨hw.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hw.2.2 hqB⟩)
  
  have hwave : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
      waveV5 B G S.Aw (thetaOf w.1) (ptOf w.1 w.2.1 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2.1 + w.2.2)) i)
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} := fun i =>
    (hW i).comp (contDiff_fst.contDiffOn.prodMk hξ) (fun w hw => ⟨hw.1, hmap hw⟩)
  have hPs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
      S.Psi (ptOf w.1 w.2.1 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2.1 + w.2.2)))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} :=
    hPsi.1.comp hξ hmap
  have heRc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => eR w.1)
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} :=
    heR.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn hfst
  have heThc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => eTh w.1)
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} :=
    heTh.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn hfst
  have hinner := ((((hwave 0).smul heRc).add ((hwave 1).smul heThc)).add
    ((hwave 2).smul (contDiffOn_const (c := eZ)))).add (hPs.smul heThc)
  have hall := hABc.add (hpref.smul hinner)
  refine hall.congr (fun w hw => ?_)
  have hw' : corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1 := hw
  simp only [AX5, cyl2cart, if_pos hw'] <;> rfl

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 S hok hqB hbdir hF a
  generalize hFdef : (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
    AX5 B G l0 S w.1 w.2.1 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2.1 + w.2.2)) = F at hF
  have hS := hok.1
  have hc : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x i) := fun i => contDiff_piLp_apply 2
  
  have hrot0 : ∀ r θ z : ℝ, rotPt r θ z 0 = r * Real.cos θ := by intro r θ z; simp [rotPt]
  have hrot1 : ∀ r θ z : ℝ, rotPt r θ z 1 = r * Real.sin θ := by intro r θ z; simp [rotPt]
  have hrot2 : ∀ r θ z : ℝ, rotPt r θ z 2 = z := by intro r θ z; simp [rotPt]
  have hradrot : ∀ r θ z : ℝ, 0 < r → rad (rotPt r θ z) = r := by
    intro r θ z hr
    show Real.sqrt ((rotPt r θ z) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt r θ z) 1 ^ 2) = r
    rw [hrot0, hrot1]
    have e : (r * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (r * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
      linear_combination r ^ 2 * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
    rw [e, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
  
  have hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) := ((hc 0).pow 2).add ((hc 1).pow 2)
  have hradS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ rad {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} := by
    have h := hf.contDiffOn.sqrt (s := {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x}) (fun x hx => by
      have hx' : 0 < Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) := hx
      exact (Real.sqrt_pos.mp hx').ne')
    exact h
  have hinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (rad x)⁻¹) {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} :=
    hradS.inv (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
  have hrv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ radVec := by
    have h : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
        x 1 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) :=
      ((hc 0).smul contDiff_const).add ((hc 1).smul contDiff_const)
    exact h
  have haz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ azVec := by
    have h : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => -(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
        x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) :=
      ((hc 1).neg.smul contDiff_const).add ((hc 0).smul contDiff_const)
    exact h
  have heR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ eR {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} := hinv.smul hrv.contDiffOn
  have heTh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ eTh {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} := hinv.smul haz.contDiffOn
  have hradc : Continuous rad := Real.continuous_sqrt.comp hf.continuous
  have hΩ : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} := by
    have hR : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | 0 < rad w.1} :=
      isOpen_lt continuous_const (hradc.comp continuous_fst)
    have hT : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | w.2.1 < 1} :=
      isOpen_lt continuous_snd.fst continuous_const
    have hφ : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2.1))
        {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | w.2.1 < 1} := by
      have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
        ((hc 2).comp contDiff_fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.fst)
      exact (hS.2.2.2.1.comp hg.contDiffOn (fun w (hw : w.2.1 < 1) =>
        (⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2.1 by linarith⟩ :
          ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)))).continuousOn
    have h2 := hφ.isOpen_inter_preimage hT (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} =
        {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | 0 < rad w.1} ∩ ({w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | w.2.1 < 1} ∩
          (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2.1)) ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0)) := by
      ext w; exact Iff.rfl
    rw [e]; exact hR.inter h2
  have hrotS : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) := by
    have h : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl =>
        (p.2.1 * Real.cos p.1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
        (p.2.1 * Real.sin p.1) • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
        p.2.2.1 • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) :=
      (((contDiff_snd.fst.mul (Real.contDiff_cos.comp contDiff_fst)).smul contDiff_const).add
        ((contDiff_snd.fst.mul (Real.contDiff_sin.comp contDiff_fst)).smul contDiff_const)).add
        (contDiff_snd.snd.fst.smul contDiff_const)
    exact h
  have hrpos : MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0))
      {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} := by
    intro p hp
    have hr0 : 0 < p.2.1 := hp.2.1
    show 0 < rad (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1)
    rw [hradrot _ _ _ hr0]
    exact hr0
  
  have hpw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => p.2.1 ^ drx B.h) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    contDiff_snd.fst.contDiffOn.rpow_const_of_ne (fun p hp => ne_of_gt hp.2.1)
  have hYo : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1)
      (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    contDiff_snd.snd.snd.snd.contDiffOn.sub ((hpw.smul contDiffOn_const).add
      (contDiff_snd.snd.snd.fst.contDiffOn.smul contDiffOn_const))
  have hι : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => ((rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1,
      p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1) : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))
      (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    hrotS.contDiffOn.prodMk (contDiff_snd.snd.snd.fst.contDiffOn.prodMk hYo)
  have hmaps : MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => ((rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1,
      p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1) : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))
      (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} := by
    intro p hp
    have hr0 : 0 < p.2.1 := hp.2.1
    have ht : p.2.2.2.1 < 1 := hp.2.2.1
    have hq : simScale B.h p.2.2.1 (1 - p.2.2.2.1) < qsOf l0 := hp.2.2.2
    show 0 < rad (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) ∧ p.2.2.2.1 < 1 ∧
      simScale B.h ((rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) 2) (1 - p.2.2.2.1) < qsOf l0
    rw [hradrot _ _ _ hr0, hrot2]
    exact ⟨hr0, ht, hq⟩
  
  have hDF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} :=
    ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ).1 hF).2
  have hDι := hDF.comp hι hmaps
  have hG : ∀ (v : ℝ³) (k : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl =>
      fderiv ℝ F (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1)
        (v, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) k) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro v k
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl =>
        fderiv ℝ F (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1)
          (v, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      hDι.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact (hc k).comp_contDiffOn h1
  have hCur : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl =>
      (fderiv ℝ F (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 2 -
        fderiv ℝ F (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 1) •
          EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
      (fderiv ℝ F (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 0 -
        fderiv ℝ F (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 2) •
          EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
      (fderiv ℝ F (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 1 -
        fderiv ℝ F (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 0) •
          EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    ((((hG _ 2).sub (hG _ 1)).smul contDiffOn_const).add
      (((hG _ 0).sub (hG _ 2)).smul contDiffOn_const)).add
      (((hG _ 1).sub (hG _ 0)).smul contDiffOn_const)
  
  have hcurl : ∀ p ∈ univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      curlX B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) p.2.2.2.1 p.2.2.2.2 =
      (fderiv ℝ F (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 2 -
        fderiv ℝ F (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 1) •
          EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
      (fderiv ℝ F (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 0 -
        fderiv ℝ F (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 2) •
          EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
      (fderiv ℝ F (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 1 -
        fderiv ℝ F (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 0) •
          EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) := by
    intro p hp
    have hr0 : 0 < p.2.1 := hp.2.1
    have hw := hmaps hp
    have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F
        (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1) :=
      (hF.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hw)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hsl : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => F (y, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1))
        ((fderiv ℝ F (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1)).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))) (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) :=
      HasFDerivAt.comp (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) hFd.hasFDerivAt
        (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1)
          ((p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1) : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))
    have hfd : ∀ v : ℝ³, fderiv ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => F (y, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1))
        (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) v =
        fderiv ℝ F (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1)
          (v, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) := by
      intro v
      rw [hsl.fderiv]
      rfl
    have heq : curlX B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) p.2.2.2.1 p.2.2.2.2 =
        curl3 (fun y : ℝ³ => F (y, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h p.2.1 p.2.2.2.1))
          (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) := by
      show curl3 (fun y => evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S)
        (p.2.2.2.2 - Yph B.h (rad (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1)) p.2.2.2.1) y p.2.2.2.1)
          (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) = _
      rw [hradrot _ _ _ hr0, ← hFdef]
      rfl
    rw [heq]
    simp only [curl3, hfd]
  
  have hBXeq : ∀ p ∈ univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      BX B G l0 S (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) p.2.2.2.1 p.2.2.2.2 =
      B.BvB (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) p.2.2.2.1 +
        (qC B.h p.2 ^ (-Aex B.h) * S.bdir p.2) • eTh (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) := by
    intro p hp
    have hw : corrOn B l0 (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) p.2.2.2.1 := hmaps hp
    have hpt : ptOf (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) p.2.2.2.1 p.2.2.2.2 = p.2 := by
      show (rad (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1), (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) 2, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2) = p.2
      rw [hradrot _ _ _ hp.2.1, hrot2]
    simp only [BX, if_pos hw, hpt]
  have hBP := hok.2
  unfold BackgroundProps at hBP
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, ⟨-, hBv0, -⟩, -⟩ := hBP
  have hBvc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => B.BvB (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) p.2.2.2.1)
      (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => ((rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) :=
      hrotS.prodMk contDiff_snd.snd.snd.fst
    refine hBv0.comp hg.contDiffOn (fun p hp => ?_)
    have ht : p.2.2.2.1 < 1 := hp.2.2.1
    have hq : simScale B.h p.2.2.1 (1 - p.2.2.2.1) < qsOf l0 := hp.2.2.2
    show p.2.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ((rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) 2) (1 - p.2.2.2.1) < B.qB
    rw [hrot2]
    exact ⟨ht, lt_of_lt_of_le hq hqB⟩
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have hπq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) :=
      contDiff_snd.fst.prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
    exact hS.2.2.2.1.comp hπq.contDiffOn (fun ξ (hξ : ξ.2.2.1 < 1) =>
      (⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩ : (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) ∈ univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)))
  have hq1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => qC B.h p.2) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    hqC.comp contDiff_snd.contDiffOn (fun p hp => hp.2.2.1)
  have hq2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => qC B.h p.2 ^ (-Aex B.h)) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    hq1.rpow_const_of_ne (fun p hp => by
      have ht : p.2.2.2.1 < 1 := hp.2.2.1
      exact (hS.1 p.2.2.1 (1 - p.2.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1.ne')
  have hbd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => S.bdir p.2) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    hbdir.1.comp contDiff_snd.contDiffOn (fun p hp => hp.2)
  have heRc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => eR (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1))
      (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := heR.comp hrotS.contDiffOn hrpos
  have heThc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => eTh (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1))
      (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := heTh.comp hrotS.contDiffOn hrpos
  have hBXs := hBvc.add ((hq2.mul hbd).smul heThc)
  
  have hfr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => frameAt p.1 p.2 a) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    fin_cases a
    · exact heRc
    · exact heThc
    · exact contDiffOn_const
  
  have hsum := (hCur.add hBXs).inner ℝ hfr

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  intro h ξ hq0 hq1
  
  have hbump0 : ∀ u : ℝ, bumpR u ≠ 0 → |u| < 1 := by
    intro u hu
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    apply hu
    unfold bumpR
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    have : 1 ≤ u ^ 2 := (one_le_sq_iff_one_le_abs u).mpr hc
    linarith
  have hwin : ∀ (x : ℝ) (j : ℤ), bumpR (x - j) ≠ 0 → ⌊x⌋ ≤ j ∧ j ≤ ⌊x⌋ + 1 := by
    intro x j hj
    have h1 := abs_lt.mp (hbump0 _ hj)
    have h2 := Int.floor_le x
    have h3 := Int.lt_floor_add_one x
    constructor
    · have h4 : (⌊x⌋ : ℝ) < (j : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
      have h5 : ⌊x⌋ < j + 1 := by exact_mod_cast h4
      omega
    · have h4 : (j : ℝ) < (⌊x⌋ : ℝ) + 2 := by linarith
      have h5 : j < ⌊x⌋ + 2 := by exact_mod_cast h4
      omega
  have hvan : ∀ (x : ℝ) (n : ℤ), n ∉ ({⌊x⌋, ⌊x⌋ + 1} : Finset ℤ) → bumpR (x - n) = 0 := by
    intro x n hn
    by_contra hc
    obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := hwin x n hc
    apply hn
    rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    omega
  have hD : ∀ x : ℝ, (∑' n : ℤ, bumpR (x - n) ^ 2) =
      bumpR (x - ⌊x⌋) ^ 2 + bumpR (x - ((⌊x⌋ + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [tsum_eq_sum (s := ({⌊x⌋, ⌊x⌋ + 1} : Finset ℤ))]
    · rw [Finset.sum_pair (by omega)]
    · intro n hn
      rw [hvan x n hn]
      ring
  have hDpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < bumpR (x - ⌊x⌋) ^ 2 + bumpR (x - ((⌊x⌋ + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    have h2 := Int.floor_le x
    have h3 := Int.lt_floor_add_one x
    by_cases ht : x - ⌊x⌋ ≤ 1/2
    · have hp : 0 < bumpR (x - ⌊x⌋) := by
        unfold bumpR
        apply Real.smoothTransition.pos_of_pos
        nlinarith
      have := sq_nonneg (bumpR (x - ((⌊x⌋ + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ)))
      have := pow_pos hp 2
      linarith
    · have hp : 0 < bumpR (x - ((⌊x⌋ + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ)) := by
        unfold bumpR
        apply Real.smoothTransition.pos_of_pos
        push_cast
        push_neg at ht
        nlinarith
      have := sq_nonneg (bumpR (x - ⌊x⌋))
      have := pow_pos hp 2
      linarith
  have hsum : ∀ (μ s : ℝ) (U : Finset ℤ), ⌊s / μ⌋ ∈ U → ⌊s / μ⌋ + 1 ∈ U →
      ∑ j ∈ U, sqPart μ j s ^ 2 = 1 := by
    intro μ s U h1 h2
    have hDp := hDpos (s / μ)
    have hsq : ∀ j : ℤ, sqPart μ j s ^ 2 = bumpR (s / μ - j) ^ 2 /
        (bumpR (s / μ - ⌊s / μ⌋) ^ 2 + bumpR (s / μ - ((⌊s / μ⌋ + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ)) ^ 2) := by
      intro j
      unfold sqPart
      rw [hD (s / μ), div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hDp.le]
    simp only [hsq]
    rw [← Finset.sum_div]
    rw [← Finset.sum_subset (s₁ := ({⌊s / μ⌋, ⌊s / μ⌋ + 1} : Finset ℤ))]
    · rw [Finset.sum_pair (by omega)]
      exact div_self hDp.ne'
    · intro j hj
      rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hj
      rcases hj with rfl | rfl
      · exact h1
      · exact h2
    · intro j _ hj
      rw [hvan (s / μ) j hj]
      ring
  have hsqwin : ∀ (μ s : ℝ) (j : ℤ), sqPart μ j s ≠ 0 →
      |s / μ - j| < 1 ∧ ⌊s / μ⌋ ≤ j ∧ j ≤ ⌊s / μ⌋ + 1 := by
    intro μ s j hne
    have hb : bumpR (s / μ - j) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hne
      unfold sqPart
      rw [h0, zero_div]
    exact ⟨hbump0 _ hb, hwin _ _ hb⟩
  
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s = Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsneg : s < 0 := by rw [hs]; exact Real.logb_neg (by norm_num) hq0 hq1
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℤ, a = ⌊s⌋ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hale : a ≤ -1 := by
    have h1 : (a : ℝ) ≤ s := by rw [ha]; exact Int.floor_le s
    have h2 : (a : ℝ) < 0 := by linarith
    have h3 : a < 0 := by exact_mod_cast h2
    omega
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, (m : ℤ) = -a - 1 := ⟨(-a - 1).toNat, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)⟩
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : Finset ℕ, L = {m, m + 1} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ : ∃ μ : ℕ → ℝ, μ = fun l => Sb l ^ (-3:ℤ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : ℕ → Finset (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ), W = fun l =>
      ({⌊chartR h l ξ / μ l⌋, ⌊chartR h l ξ / μ l⌋ + 1} : Finset ℤ) ×ˢ
      (({⌊chartZ h l ξ / μ l⌋, ⌊chartZ h l ξ / μ l⌋ + 1} : Finset ℤ) ×ˢ
       ({⌊chartT h l ξ / μ l⌋, ⌊chartT h l ξ / μ l⌋ + 1} : Finset ℤ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hfac : ∀ (l : ℕ) (k : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) (σ : Bool), etaL h (l, k, σ) ξ =
      sqPart 1 (-(l:ℤ)) s * (sqPart (μ l) k.1 (chartR h l ξ) * sqPart (μ l) k.2.1 (chartZ h l ξ) *
        sqPart (μ l) k.2.2 (chartT h l ξ)) := by
    intro l k σ
    rw [hs, hμ]
    rfl
  have hnz : ∀ (l : ℕ) (k : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) (σ : Bool), etaL h (l, k, σ) ξ ≠ 0 →
      (-s - 1 < (l:ℝ)) ∧ l ∈ L ∧ k ∈ W l := by
    intro l k σ hne
    rw [hfac] at hne
    obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hne
    obtain ⟨hB12, hB3⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hB
    obtain ⟨hB1, hB2⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hB12
    obtain ⟨wA, wA1, wA2⟩ := hsqwin _ _ _ hA
    rw [div_one, ← ha] at wA1 wA2
    rw [div_one] at wA
    push_cast at wA
    obtain ⟨-, w1a, w1b⟩ := hsqwin _ _ _ hB1
    obtain ⟨-, w2a, w2b⟩ := hsqwin _ _ _ hB2
    obtain ⟨-, w3a, w3b⟩ := hsqwin _ _ _ hB3
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := (abs_lt.mp wA).1
      linarith
    · rw [hL, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
      omega
    · rw [hW]
      simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
      omega
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    apply Set.Finite.subset (Finset.finite_toSet
      (L.biUnion (fun l => ({l} : Finset ℕ) ×ˢ (W l ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset Bool)))))
    intro γ hγ
    obtain ⟨l, k, σ⟩ := γ
    obtain ⟨-, h1, h2⟩ := hnz l k σ hγ
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_biUnion]
    exact ⟨l, h1, Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_singleton_self _,
      Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨h2, Finset.mem_univ _⟩⟩⟩
  · 
    intro γ hγ
    obtain ⟨l, k, σ⟩ := γ
    obtain ⟨h1, -, -⟩ := hnz l k σ hγ
    rw [← hs]
    exact h1
  · 
    obtain ⟨P, hPdef⟩ : ∃ P : Finset (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ)),
        P = L.biUnion (fun l => ({l} : Finset ℕ) ×ˢ W l) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hP : ∀ p : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ), p ∈ P ↔ p.1 ∈ L ∧ p.2 ∈ W p.1 := by
      intro p
      rw [hPdef, Finset.mem_biUnion]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨l, hl, hp⟩
        rw [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_singleton] at hp
        rw [hp.1]
        exact ⟨hl, hp.1 ▸ hp.2⟩
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
        exact ⟨p.1, h1, Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_singleton_self _, h2⟩⟩
    have hsupp : Function.support (fun p : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) => etaL h (p.1, p.2, true) ξ ^ 2) ⊆ ↑P := by
      intro p hp
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hp
      have hne : etaL h (p.1, p.2, true) ξ ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hp (by rw [h0]; ring)
      obtain ⟨-, h1, h2⟩ := hnz p.1 p.2 true hne
      exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr ((hP p).mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩)
    have hinner : ∀ l : ℕ, ∑ k ∈ W l, etaL h (l, k, true) ξ ^ 2 = sqPart 1 (-(l:ℤ)) s ^ 2 := by
      intro l
      have e1 := hsum (μ l) (chartR h l ξ) ({⌊chartR h l ξ / μ l⌋, ⌊chartR h l ξ / μ l⌋ + 1} : Finset ℤ)
        (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _) (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _))
      have e2 := hsum (μ l) (chartZ h l ξ) ({⌊chartZ h l ξ / μ l⌋, ⌊chartZ h l ξ / μ l⌋ + 1} : Finset ℤ)
        (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _) (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _))
      have e3 := hsum (μ l) (chartT h l ξ) ({⌊chartT h l ξ / μ l⌋, ⌊chartT h l ξ / μ l⌋ + 1} : Finset ℤ)
        (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _) (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _))
      have hWl : W l = ({⌊chartR h l ξ / μ l⌋, ⌊chartR h l ξ / μ l⌋ + 1} : Finset ℤ) ×ˢ
          (({⌊chartZ h l ξ / μ l⌋, ⌊chartZ h l ξ / μ l⌋ + 1} : Finset ℤ) ×ˢ
           ({⌊chartT h l ξ / μ l⌋, ⌊chartT h l ξ / μ l⌋ + 1} : Finset ℤ)) := by rw [hW]
      rw [hWl]
      calc _ = ∑ k1 ∈ ({⌊chartR h l ξ / μ l⌋, ⌊chartR h l ξ / μ l⌋ + 1} : Finset ℤ),
              ∑ k2 ∈ ({⌊chartZ h l ξ / μ l⌋, ⌊chartZ h l ξ / μ l⌋ + 1} : Finset ℤ),
              ∑ k3 ∈ ({⌊chartT h l ξ / μ l⌋, ⌊chartT h l ξ / μ l⌋ + 1} : Finset ℤ),
                sqPart 1 (-(l:ℤ)) s ^ 2 * (sqPart (μ l) k1 (chartR h l ξ) ^ 2 *
                  (sqPart (μ l) k2 (chartZ h l ξ) ^ 2 * sqPart (μ l) k3 (chartT h l ξ) ^ 2)) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_product]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro k1 _
            rw [Finset.sum_product]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro k2 _
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro k3 _
            rw [hfac]
            ring
        _ = sqPart 1 (-(l:ℤ)) s ^ 2 *
            ((∑ j ∈ ({⌊chartR h l ξ / μ l⌋, ⌊chartR h l ξ / μ l⌋ + 1} : Finset ℤ),
                sqPart (μ l) j (chartR h l ξ) ^ 2) *
             ((∑ j ∈ ({⌊chartZ h l ξ / μ l⌋, ⌊chartZ h l ξ / μ l⌋ + 1} : Finset ℤ),
                sqPart (μ l) j (chartZ h l ξ) ^ 2) *
              (∑ j ∈ ({⌊chartT h l ξ / μ l⌋, ⌊chartT h l ξ / μ l⌋ + 1} : Finset ℤ),
                sqPart (μ l) j (chartT h l ξ) ^ 2))) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro k1 _
            simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = sqPart 1 (-(l:ℤ)) s ^ 2 := by rw [e1, e2, e3]; ring
    have hout : ∑ l ∈ L, sqPart 1 (-(l:ℤ)) s ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have hpair := hsum 1 s ({a, a + 1} : Finset ℤ)
        (by rw [div_one, ← ha]; exact Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
        (by rw [div_one, ← ha]; exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _))
      rw [Finset.sum_pair (by omega)] at hpair
      have e1 : -((m : ℕ) : ℤ) = a + 1 := by omega
      have e2 : -(((m + 1 : ℕ)) : ℤ) = a := by push_cast; omega
      rw [hL, Finset.sum_pair (by omega), e1, e2]
      linarith
    rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ hsupp, Finset.sum_finset_product P L W hP, ← hout]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => hinner l)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hG c c' η F b hη hF hc hc'
  
  have hcos : ∀ (p : ℤ) (φ : ℝ), p ≠ 0 →
      ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Real.cos ((p : ℝ) * θ + φ) ^ 2 = Real.pi := by
    intro p φ hp
    have hP : (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hp
    have h1 := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_add (a := 0) (b := 2 * Real.pi)
      (fun x => Real.cos x ^ 2) hP φ
    rw [h1, integral_cos_sq]
    have e : (p:ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) + φ = φ + (p:ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by ring
    rw [e, Real.cos_add_int_mul_two_pi, Real.sin_add_int_mul_two_pi, mul_zero, zero_add, smul_eq_mul]
    have e2 : Real.cos φ * Real.sin φ - Real.cos φ * Real.sin φ + (φ + (p:ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)) - φ =
        (p:ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by ring
    rw [e2]
    field_simp
  
  have hp0 : ∀ γ, pint5 B G γ ≠ 0 := by
    intro γ
    unfold pint5
    split_ifs with h
    · exact one_ne_zero
    · exact h
  
  have hsupp : ∀ (d : Lab → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (e : Fin 3) (θ : ℝ) (γ : Lab),
      tPart5 B G d γ θ η e ≠ 0 → d γ η ≠ 0 := by
    intro d e θ γ h hz
    apply h
    simp [tPart5, hz]
  
  have hdiag : ∀ (d d' : Lab → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)),
      (∀ γ : Lab, d γ η ≠ 0 → G.lmin ≤ γ.1 ∧ inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (2 * G.r0) η.2.2.2 ∧ etaL B.h γ η ≠ 0) →
      (∀ γ : Lab, d' γ η ≠ 0 → G.lmin ≤ γ.1 ∧ inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (2 * G.r0) η.2.2.2 ∧ etaL B.h γ η ≠ 0) →
      ∀ (e e' : Fin 3) (θ : ℝ),
      covT5 B G d d' e e' θ η = ∑ γ ∈ F, tPart5 B G d γ θ η e * tPart5 B G d' γ θ η e' := by
    intro d d' hd hd' e e' θ
    unfold covT5
    rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset (s := F) _
        (fun γ hγ => Finset.mem_coe.mpr (hF γ (hd γ (hsupp d e θ γ hγ)).2.2)),
      finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset (s := F) _
        (fun γ hγ => Finset.mem_coe.mpr (hF γ (hd' γ (hsupp d' e' θ γ hγ)).2.2)),
      Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro γ hγ
    apply Finset.sum_eq_single γ
    · intro γ' _ hne
      by_contra hprod
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hprod
      obtain ⟨l1, r1, e1⟩ := hd γ (hsupp d e θ γ h1)
      obtain ⟨l2, r2, e2⟩ := hd' γ' (hsupp d' e' θ γ' h2)
      have hdisj := hG.2.1 γ γ' (Ne.symm hne) l1 l2 ⟨η, hη, e1, e2⟩
      have m1 : η.2.2.2 ∈ rectAbs B G γ (2 * G.r0) := r1
      have m2 : η.2.2.2 ∈ rectAbs B G γ' (2 * G.r0) := r2
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj (subset_closure m1) (subset_closure m2)
    · intro h
      exact absurd hγ h
  
  have hpt : ∀ θ : ℝ, covT5 B G c c' 0 b θ η + covT5 B G c' c 0 b θ η =
      ∑ γ ∈ F, (4 * (qC B.h η ^ (-B.h) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) ^ 2 *
        (c γ η 0 * c' γ η b + c' γ η 0 * c γ η b)) *
        Real.cos ((pint5 B G γ : ℝ) * θ + (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * phiL5 B G γ η) ^ 2 := by
    intro θ
    rw [hdiag c c' hc hc' 0 b θ, hdiag c' c hc' hc 0 b θ, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro γ _
    simp only [tPart5]
    ring
  have hfun : (fun θ : ℝ => covT5 B G c c' 0 b θ η + covT5 B G c' c 0 b θ η) =
      fun θ : ℝ => ∑ γ ∈ F, (4 * (qC B.h η ^ (-B.h) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) ^ 2 *
        (c γ η 0 * c' γ η b + c' γ η 0 * c γ η b)) *
        Real.cos ((pint5 B G γ : ℝ) * θ + (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * phiL5 B G γ η) ^ 2 := funext hpt
  unfold thA
  rw [hfun, intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum
      (fun γ _ => Continuous.intervalIntegrable (by fun_prop) _ _), Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro γ _
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hcos _ _ (hp0 γ)]
  have hpi : Real.pi ≠ 0 := Real.pi_ne_zero
  field_simp
  ring

    (∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, (1/4 ≤ |w.1| ∨ 1/4 ≤ |w.2|) → Φ w = 0) →
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => Φ (frac0 (Jpow (n : ℤ) Y - c)))
      (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ∧
    ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), Φ (frac0 (Jpow (n : ℤ) Y - c)) = ∫ w : ℝ × ℝ, Φ w

signature.name: torus_jpow_average
signature.statement:
∀ (Φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ × ℝ), Continuous Φ →
    (∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, (1/4 ≤ |w.1| ∨ 1/4 ≤ |w.2|) → Φ w = 0) →
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => Φ (frac0 (Jpow (n : ℤ) Y - c)))
      (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ∧
    ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), Φ (frac0 (Jpow (n : ℤ) Y - c)) = ∫ w : ℝ × ℝ, Φ w

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Φ n c hΦ hv
  
  have tL1 : (∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, Jpow 0 Y = Y) ∧ ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ),
      Jpow (n + 1) Y = (3 * (Jpow n Y).1 + (Jpow n Y).2, (Jpow n Y).1 + 5 * (Jpow n Y).2) := by
    have hs : Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
    have hs0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
    have hs4 : Real.sqrt 2 < 4 := by nlinarith
    have hc : bgc ^ 2 = 1 - 2 * bgc := by unfold bgc; linear_combination hs
    have hD : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hL : Lgc ≠ 0 := (by unfold Lgc; linarith : (0:ℝ) < Lgc).ne'
    have hT : Tgc ≠ 0 := (by unfold Tgc; linarith : (0:ℝ) < Tgc).ne'
    have hLc : Lgc = 3 - bgc := by unfold Lgc bgc; ring
    have hTc : Tgc = bgc + 5 := by unfold Tgc bgc; ring
    constructor
    · intro Y
      unfold Jpow
      simp only [zpow_zero, one_mul, vrv, vtv]
      ext
      · simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.smul_fst, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
        ring
      · simp only [Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
        ring
    · intro n Y
      unfold Jpow
      rw [zpow_add_one₀ hL, zpow_add_one₀ hT]
      generalize Lgc ^ n = p
      generalize Tgc ^ n = q
      generalize (Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) = a
      generalize (bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) = b
      rw [hLc, hTc]
      simp only [vrv, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, Prod.mk_add_mk, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk.injEq]
      constructor
      · linear_combination (q * b) * hc
      · linear_combination (p * a) * hc
  
  have tL3 : ∀ G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), G (Y.2, Y.1) =
      ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), G Y := by
    intro G
    have h : (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (ℝ × ℝ)).restrict
        (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) =
        (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)).prod
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)) := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod, MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_restrict]
    rw [h]
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_prod_swap G
  
  have tL2 : ∀ (G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (m k : ℤ) (a : ℝ), Continuous G →
      (∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, G (w.1, w.2 + 1) = G w) →
      m ≠ 0 → ∀ F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, (∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, F Y = G (Y.1, (m:ℝ) * Y.2 + (k:ℝ) * Y.1 + a)) →
      ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), F Y =
        ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), G Y := by
    intro G m k a hG hp hm F hF
    simp_rw [hF]
    have hK : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    have hc1 : Continuous (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => G (Y.1, (m : ℝ) * Y.2 + (k : ℝ) * Y.1 + a)) := by
      fun_prop
    have hi1 := hc1.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hK
    have hi2 := hG.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hK
    rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod] at hi1 hi2 ⊢
    rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_prod _ hi1, MeasureTheory.setIntegral_prod _ hi2]
    refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc (fun x _ => ?_)
    simp only
    simp_rw [add_assoc]
    have hM : (m:ℝ) ≠ 0 := Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hm
    have hgc : Continuous (fun y => G (x, y)) := by fun_prop
    have hgp : Function.Periodic (fun y => G (x, y)) 1 := fun y => hp (x, y)
    have h1 := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_add (a := 0) (b := 1) (fun y => G (x, y)) hM
      ((k:ℝ) * x + a)
    have h2 := hgp.intervalIntegral_add_zsmul_eq m ((k:ℝ) * x + a)
      (fun t1 t2 => hgc.intervalIntegrable t1 t2)
    have h3 := hgp.intervalIntegral_add_eq ((k:ℝ) * x + a) 0
    simp only [mul_zero, zero_add, mul_one, zsmul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul] at h1 h2 h3
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one,
      MeasureTheory.integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one]
    rw [h1, add_comm (m:ℝ) ((k:ℝ) * x + a), h2, h3, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hM, one_mul]
  
  have tL4 : Continuous (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Φ (frac0 w)) ∧
      (∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, Φ (frac0 (w.1 + 1, w.2)) = Φ (frac0 w) ∧
        Φ (frac0 (w.1, w.2 + 1)) = Φ (frac0 w)) ∧
      (∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, |w.1| ≤ 1/2 → |w.2| ≤ 1/2 → Φ (frac0 w) = Φ w) := by
    have K : ∀ x0 : ℝ, ∃ n : ℤ, ∃ U : Set ℝ, IsOpen U ∧ x0 ∈ U ∧ ∀ x ∈ U,
        (x - ((round x : ℤ) : ℝ) = x - n) ∨ (1/4 ≤ |x - ((round x : ℤ) : ℝ)| ∧ 1/4 ≤ |x - n|) := by
      intro x0
      refine ⟨round x0, ?_⟩
      by_cases h : |x0 - ((round x0 : ℤ) : ℝ)| < 1/2
      · refine ⟨Set.Ioo (((round x0 : ℤ) : ℝ) - 1/2) (((round x0 : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1/2), isOpen_Ioo, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [abs_lt] at h
          constructor <;> linarith
        · intro x hx
          left
          have : round x = round x0 := by
            rw [round_eq, Int.floor_eq_iff]
            constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2]
          rw [this]
      · push_neg at h
        refine ⟨Set.Ioo (x0 - 1/4) (x0 + 1/4), isOpen_Ioo, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ?_⟩
        intro x hx
        right
        have hk : ∀ k : ℤ, 1/4 ≤ |x - (k:ℝ)| := by
          intro k
          have h1 := round_le x0 k
          have h2 : |x - x0| < 1/4 := by
            rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2]
          have h3 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (x0 - k) (x - k)
          have h4 : (x0 - k) - (x - k) = -(x - x0) := by ring
          rw [h4, abs_neg] at h3
          linarith
        exact ⟨hk _, hk _⟩
    have hcont : Continuous (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Φ (frac0 w)) := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro w0
      obtain ⟨n, U, hU, hxU, hUp⟩ := K w0.1
      obtain ⟨m, V, hV, hyV, hVp⟩ := K w0.2
      have hev : (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Φ (w.1 - n, w.2 - m)) =ᶠ[nhds w0] (fun w => Φ (frac0 w)) := by
        filter_upwards [(hU.prod hV).mem_nhds ⟨hxU, hyV⟩] with w hw
        obtain ⟨hw1, hw2⟩ := hw
        simp only [frac0]
        rcases hUp w.1 hw1 with h1 | h1
        · rcases hVp w.2 hw2 with h2 | h2
          · rw [h1, h2]
          · rw [hv (w.1 - n, w.2 - m) (Or.inr h2.2),
              hv (w.1 - ((round w.1 : ℤ) : ℝ), w.2 - ((round w.2 : ℤ) : ℝ)) (Or.inr h2.1)]
        · rw [hv (w.1 - n, w.2 - m) (Or.inl h1.2),
            hv (w.1 - ((round w.1 : ℤ) : ℝ), w.2 - ((round w.2 : ℤ) : ℝ)) (Or.inl h1.1)]
      exact ContinuousAt.congr
        ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Φ (w.1 - n, w.2 - m)).continuousAt) hev
    have hper : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, Φ (frac0 (w.1 + 1, w.2)) = Φ (frac0 w) ∧
        Φ (frac0 (w.1, w.2 + 1)) = Φ (frac0 w) := by
      intro w
      refine ⟨congrArg Φ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_), congrArg Φ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_)⟩ <;>
        simp only [frac0, round_add_one, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one] <;> ring
    have h1d : ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ≤ 1/2 → (x - ((round x : ℤ) : ℝ) = x) ∨
        (1/4 ≤ |x - ((round x : ℤ) : ℝ)| ∧ 1/4 ≤ |x|) := by
      intro x hx
      rw [abs_le] at hx
      by_cases hs : |x| < 1/4
      · left
        have : round x = 0 := by
          rw [round_eq_zero_iff]
          rw [abs_lt] at hs
          constructor <;> linarith
        rw [this]; simp
      · right
        push_neg at hs
        refine ⟨?_, hs⟩
        have a1 := sub_half_lt_round x
        have a2 := round_le_add_half x
        have b1 : (-1:ℝ) < ((round x : ℤ) : ℝ) := by linarith
        have b2 : ((round x : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by linarith
        have c1 : (-1:ℤ) < round x := by exact_mod_cast b1
        have c2 : round x ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast b2
        rcases (show round x = 0 ∨ round x = 1 by omega) with h | h
        · rw [h]; simpa using hs
        · have hx2 : x = 1/2 := by
            rw [h] at a2; push_cast at a2; linarith
          rw [h, hx2, le_abs]
          right
          norm_num
    have hbox : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, |w.1| ≤ 1/2 → |w.2| ≤ 1/2 → Φ (frac0 w) = Φ w := by
      intro w h1 h2
      simp only [frac0]
      rcases h1d w.1 h1 with a | a
      · rcases h1d w.2 h2 with b | b
        · rw [a, b]
        · rw [hv (w.1 - ((round w.1 : ℤ) : ℝ), w.2 - ((round w.2 : ℤ) : ℝ)) (Or.inr b.1),
            hv w (Or.inr b.2)]
      · rw [hv (w.1 - ((round w.1 : ℤ) : ℝ), w.2 - ((round w.2 : ℤ) : ℝ)) (Or.inl a.1),
          hv w (Or.inl a.2)]
    exact ⟨hcont, hper, hbox⟩
  obtain ⟨L1a, L1b⟩ := tL1
  obtain ⟨hΨc, hΨp, hΨb⟩ := tL4
  have hSm : MeasurableSet (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :=
    measurableSet_Icc.prod measurableSet_Icc
  have gcong : ∀ (G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (a b c d : ℝ), a = c → b = d → G (a, b) = G (c, d) := by
    intro G a b c d h1 h2; rw [h1, h2]
  
  have shift : ∀ G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, (∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, G (w.1 + 1, w.2) = G w) →
      (∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, G (w.1, w.2 + 1) = G w) → ∀ (p q : ℕ) (a b : ℝ),
        G (a + p, b + q) = G (a, b) := by
    intro G h1 h2 p q
    induction p with
    | zero =>
      induction q with
      | zero => intro a b; simp
      | succ q ih =>
        intro a b
        rw [← ih a b, ← h2 (a + ((0:ℕ):ℝ), b + q)]
        exact gcong G _ _ _ _ rfl (by push_cast; ring)
    | succ p ih =>
      intro a b
      rw [← ih a b, ← h1 (a + p, b + q)]
      exact gcong G _ _ _ _ (by push_cast; ring) rfl
  
  have jmat : ∀ G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, Continuous G → (∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, G (w.1 + 1, w.2) = G w) →
      (∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, G (w.1, w.2 + 1) = G w) →
      ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), G (3 * Y.1 + Y.2, Y.1 + 5 * Y.2) =
        ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), G Y := by
    intro G hG h1 h2
    have s31 : ∀ a b : ℝ, G (a + 3, b + 1) = G (a, b) := by
      intro a b; have := shift G h1 h2 3 1 a b; push_cast at this; exact this
    have s10 : ∀ a b : ℝ, G (a + 1, b) = G (a, b) := fun a b => h1 (a, b)
    calc ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), G (3 * Y.1 + Y.2, Y.1 + 5 * Y.2)
        = ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1),
            G (3 * (Y.1 + 5 * Y.2) - 14 * Y.2, Y.1 + 5 * Y.2) := by
          refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hSm (fun Y _ => ?_)
          exact gcong G _ _ _ _ (by ring) (by ring)
      _ = ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1),
            G (3 * (Y.2 + 5 * Y.1) - 14 * Y.1, Y.2 + 5 * Y.1) :=
          tL3 (fun Y => G (3 * (Y.2 + 5 * Y.1) - 14 * Y.1, Y.2 + 5 * Y.1))
      _ = ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), G (3 * Y.2 - 14 * Y.1, Y.2) := by
          refine tL2 (fun Y => G (3 * Y.2 - 14 * Y.1, Y.2)) 1 5 0 (by fun_prop) ?_ one_ne_zero _ ?_
          · intro w
            dsimp only
            rw [← s31 (3 * w.2 - 14 * w.1) w.2]
            exact gcong G _ _ _ _ (by ring) rfl
          · intro Y
            dsimp only
            exact gcong G _ _ _ _ (by push_cast; ring) (by push_cast; ring)
      _ = ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), G (3 * Y.1 - 14 * Y.2, Y.1) :=
          tL3 (fun Y => G (3 * Y.1 - 14 * Y.2, Y.1))
      _ = ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), G (Y.2, Y.1) := by
          refine tL2 (fun Y => G (Y.2, Y.1)) (-14) 3 0 (by fun_prop) ?_ (by norm_num) _ ?_
          · intro w
            dsimp only
            exact s10 w.2 w.1
          · intro Y
            dsimp only
            exact gcong G _ _ _ _ (by push_cast; ring) rfl
      _ = ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), G Y := tL3 G
  
  have trans : ∀ G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, Continuous G → (∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, G (w.1 + 1, w.2) = G w) →
      (∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, G (w.1, w.2 + 1) = G w) → ∀ a : ℝ × ℝ,
      ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), G (Y.1 + a.1, Y.2 + a.2) =
        ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), G Y := by
    intro G hG h1 h2 a
    calc ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), G (Y.1 + a.1, Y.2 + a.2)
        = ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), G (Y.1 + a.1, Y.2) := by
          refine tL2 (fun Y => G (Y.1 + a.1, Y.2)) 1 0 a.2 (by fun_prop) ?_ one_ne_zero _ ?_
          · intro w
            dsimp only
            exact h2 (w.1 + a.1, w.2)
          · intro Y
            dsimp only
            exact gcong G _ _ _ _ rfl (by push_cast; ring)
      _ = ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), G (Y.2 + a.1, Y.1) :=
          (tL3 (fun Y => G (Y.1 + a.1, Y.2))).symm
      _ = ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), G (Y.2, Y.1) := by
          refine tL2 (fun Y => G (Y.2, Y.1)) 1 0 a.1 (by fun_prop) ?_ one_ne_zero _ ?_
          · intro w
            dsimp only
            exact h1 (w.2, w.1)
          · intro Y
            dsimp only
            exact gcong G _ _ _ _ (by push_cast; ring) rfl
      _ = ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), G Y := tL3 G
  
  have iter : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, Continuous G → (∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, G (w.1 + 1, w.2) = G w) →
      (∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, G (w.1, w.2 + 1) = G w) →
      ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), G (Jpow (m : ℤ) Y) =
        ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), G Y := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro G _ _ _
      have e : ∀ Y, Jpow ((0:ℕ):ℤ) Y = Y := fun Y => by rw [Nat.cast_zero]; exact L1a Y
      simp only [e]
    | succ m ih =>
      intro G hG h1 h2
      have e : ∀ Y, Jpow ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) Y =
          (3 * (Jpow m Y).1 + (Jpow m Y).2, (Jpow m Y).1 + 5 * (Jpow m Y).2) := fun Y => by
        rw [Nat.cast_succ]; exact L1b m Y
      simp only [e]
      have s31 : ∀ a b : ℝ, G (a + 3, b + 1) = G (a, b) := by
        intro a b; have := shift G h1 h2 3 1 a b; push_cast at this; exact this
      have s15 : ∀ a b : ℝ, G (a + 1, b + 5) = G (a, b) := by
        intro a b; have := shift G h1 h2 1 5 a b; push_cast at this; exact this
      have hG'c : Continuous (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => G (3 * w.1 + w.2, w.1 + 5 * w.2)) := by fun_prop
      have hG'1 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ,
          (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => G (3 * w.1 + w.2, w.1 + 5 * w.2)) (w.1 + 1, w.2) =
          (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => G (3 * w.1 + w.2, w.1 + 5 * w.2)) w := by
        intro w
        dsimp only
        rw [← s31 (3 * w.1 + w.2) (w.1 + 5 * w.2)]
        exact gcong G _ _ _ _ (by ring) (by ring)
      have hG'2 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ,
          (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => G (3 * w.1 + w.2, w.1 + 5 * w.2)) (w.1, w.2 + 1) =
          (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => G (3 * w.1 + w.2, w.1 + 5 * w.2)) w := by
        intro w
        dsimp only
        rw [← s15 (3 * w.1 + w.2) (w.1 + 5 * w.2)]
        exact gcong G _ _ _ _ (by ring) (by ring)
      exact (ih _ hG'c hG'1 hG'2).trans (jmat G hG h1 h2)
  
  have hJc : Continuous (Jpow (n : ℤ)) := by
    unfold Jpow
    fun_prop
  have hFc : Continuous (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => Φ (frac0 (Jpow (n : ℤ) Y - c))) :=
    hΨc.comp (hJc.sub continuous_const)
  refine ⟨hFc.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc), ?_⟩
  have hGtc : Continuous (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => Φ (frac0 (Y - c))) :=
    hΨc.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
  have hGt1 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, Φ (frac0 ((w.1 + 1, w.2) - c)) = Φ (frac0 (w - c)) := by
    intro w
    have e : ((w.1 + 1, w.2) - c : ℝ × ℝ) = ((w - c).1 + 1, (w - c).2) := by
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
      · simp only [Prod.fst_sub]; ring
      · simp only [Prod.snd_sub]
    rw [e]; exact (hΨp (w - c)).1
  have hGt2 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, Φ (frac0 ((w.1, w.2 + 1) - c)) = Φ (frac0 (w - c)) := by
    intro w
    have e : ((w.1, w.2 + 1) - c : ℝ × ℝ) = ((w - c).1, (w - c).2 + 1) := by
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
      · simp only [Prod.fst_sub]
      · simp only [Prod.snd_sub]; ring
    rw [e]; exact (hΨp (w - c)).2
  have step1 := iter n (fun Y => Φ (frac0 (Y - c))) hGtc hGt1 hGt2
  have step2 := trans (fun Y => Φ (frac0 (Y - c))) hGtc hGt1 hGt2 (c.1 - 1/2, c.2 - 1/2)
  have step3 : ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1),
      Φ (frac0 ((Y.1 + (c.1 - 1/2), Y.2 + (c.2 - 1/2)) - c)) =
      ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), Φ (Y - ((1:ℝ)/2, (1:ℝ)/2)) := by
    refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hSm (fun Y hY => ?_)
    have e : ((Y.1 + (c.1 - 1/2), Y.2 + (c.2 - 1/2)) - c : ℝ × ℝ) =
        Y - ((1:ℝ)/2, (1:ℝ)/2) := by
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
      · simp only [Prod.fst_sub]; ring
      · simp only [Prod.snd_sub]; ring
    show Φ (frac0 ((Y.1 + (c.1 - 1/2), Y.2 + (c.2 - 1/2)) - c)) = Φ (Y - ((1:ℝ)/2, (1:ℝ)/2))
    rw [e]
    obtain ⟨⟨a1, a2⟩, ⟨b1, b2⟩⟩ := hY
    refine hΨb _ ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Prod.fst_sub]; rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
    · simp only [Prod.snd_sub]; rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have step4 : ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), Φ (Y - ((1:ℝ)/2, (1:ℝ)/2)) =
      ∫ Y : ℝ × ℝ, Φ (Y - ((1:ℝ)/2, (1:ℝ)/2)) := by
    refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero (fun Y hY => ?_)
    apply hv
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hc
    simp only [Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub] at h1 h2
    rw [abs_lt] at h1 h2
    exact hY ⟨⟨by linarith [h1.1], by linarith [h1.2]⟩, ⟨by linarith [h2.1], by linarith [h2.2]⟩⟩
  have step5 := MeasureTheory.integral_sub_right_eq_self (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
    (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Φ w) ((1:ℝ)/2, (1:ℝ)/2)
  calc ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), Φ (frac0 (Jpow (n : ℤ) Y - c))
      = ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), Φ (frac0 (Y - c)) := step1
    _ = ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1),
          Φ (frac0 ((Y.1 + (c.1 - 1/2), Y.2 + (c.2 - 1/2)) - c)) := step2.symm
    _ = _ := step3
    _ = _ := step4
    _ = _ := step5

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (R : ℝ), Continuous f → Continuous g →
    (∀ u : ℝ, R ≤ |u| → f u = 0 ∧ g u = 0) →
    ∫ w : ℝ × ℝ, f (lamR w) * g (lamT w) = (1 + bgc ^ 2) * ((∫ u : ℝ, f u) * ∫ s : ℝ, g s)

signature.name: lam_coords_integral
signature.statement:
∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (R : ℝ), Continuous f → Continuous g →
    (∀ u : ℝ, R ≤ |u| → f u = 0 ∧ g u = 0) →
    ∫ w : ℝ × ℝ, f (lamR w) * g (lamT w) = (1 + bgc ^ 2) * ((∫ u : ℝ, f u) * ∫ s : ℝ, g s)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro f g R hf hg _
  have hk0 : 0 < 1 + bgc ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hkne : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := hk0.ne'
  let L : ℝ × ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ :=
    Matrix.toLin (Module.Basis.finTwoProd ℝ) (Module.Basis.finTwoProd ℝ)
      !![1 / (1 + bgc ^ 2), -bgc / (1 + bgc ^ 2); bgc / (1 + bgc ^ 2), 1 / (1 + bgc ^ 2)]
  have hL : ∀ w, L w = (lamR w, lamT w) := by
    intro w
    simp only [L, Matrix.toLin_finTwoProd_apply]
    unfold lamR lamT
    ext
    · simp only
      field_simp
      ring
    · simp only
      field_simp
  have hdet : LinearMap.det L = 1 / (1 + bgc ^ 2) := by
    simp only [L, LinearMap.det_toLin, Matrix.det_fin_two_of]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hdet0 : LinearMap.det L ≠ 0 := by rw [hdet]; positivity
  have hmap := MeasureTheory.Measure.map_linearMap_addHaar_eq_smul_addHaar
    (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (ℝ × ℝ)) hdet0
  rw [hdet, one_div, inv_inv, abs_of_pos hk0] at hmap
  have hLc : Continuous L := LinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional L
  have hFc : Continuous (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => f z.1 * g z.2) :=
    (hf.comp continuous_fst).mul (hg.comp continuous_snd)
  have h1 : ∫ w : ℝ × ℝ, f (lamR w) * g (lamT w) =
      ∫ w : ℝ × ℝ, (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => f z.1 * g z.2) (L w) := by
    congr 1
    funext w
    rw [hL w]
  rw [h1, ← MeasureTheory.integral_map hLc.aemeasurable hFc.aestronglyMeasurable, hmap,
    MeasureTheory.integral_smul_measure, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hk0.le, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod, MeasureTheory.integral_prod_mul]

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G →
    ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) (b : Fin 3), (b = 1 ∨ b = 2) → G.lmin ≤ γ.1 → ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB →
    0 ≤ bandIdx B.h γ.1 ∧
    Continuous (sc5ProfF G.r0) ∧ Continuous (sc5ProfG B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) b) ∧
    (∀ u : ℝ, 1 ≤ |u| → sc5ProfF G.r0 u = 0 ∧ sc5ProfG B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) b u = 0) ∧
    (∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, (1/4 ≤ |w.1| ∨ 1/4 ≤ |w.2|) →
      sc5ProfF G.r0 (lamR w) * sc5ProfG B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) b (lamT w) = 0) ∧
    (∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, ¬ inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (2 * G.r0) Y →
      sc5ProfF G.r0 (lamR (rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) Y)) *
        sc5ProfG B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) b (lamT (rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) Y)) = 0) ∧
    (1 + bgc ^ 2) * ((∫ u : ℝ, sc5ProfF G.r0 u) * ∫ u : ℝ, sc5ProfG B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) b u) =
      2 * (if b = 1 then (Hcol B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).1 else (Hcol B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).2)

signature.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G →
    ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) (b : Fin 3), (b = 1 ∨ b = 2) → G.lmin ≤ γ.1 → ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB →
    0 ≤ bandIdx B.h γ.1 ∧
    Continuous (sc5ProfF G.r0) ∧ Continuous (sc5ProfG B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) b) ∧

    (∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, (1/4 ≤ |w.1| ∨ 1/4 ≤ |w.2|) →
      sc5ProfF G.r0 (lamR w) * sc5ProfG B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) b (lamT w) = 0) ∧

        sc5ProfG B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) b (lamT (rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) Y)) = 0) ∧

      2 * (if b = 1 then (Hcol B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).1 else (Hcol B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hB hG γ ξ b hb hl hξ
  obtain ⟨⟨hr0, hr0le, -, -, hlmin⟩, -, -, -, -, -, hGc⟩ := hG
  have hh : 0 < B.h := hB.2.1.1
  have hTgc1 : 1 < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; have := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2; linarith
  have hci : 0 < cib B.h γ.1 := by unfold cib Tgc Qb; positivity
  have hLs : 0 < Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 := by unfold Lsb; exact div_pos (by linarith) hci
  have hbgc0 : 0 < bgc := by unfold bgc; linarith [Real.one_lt_sqrt_two]
  have hbgc1 : bgc < 1 := by
    unfold bgc
    have h2 := Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
  
  have hchig : ∀ u : ℝ, G.r0 / 4 ≤ |u| → chig G.r0 u = 0 := by
    intro u hu
    unfold chig bumpR
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    have h1 : 1 ≤ |4 * u / G.r0| := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 4), abs_of_pos hr0, le_div_iff₀ hr0]
      linarith
    have h2 : 1 ≤ (4 * u / G.r0) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs]; nlinarith
    linarith
  have hpsi0 : ∀ L v : ℝ, 0 < L → L / 3 ≤ |v - L / 2| → psiT L v = 0 := by
    intro L v hL hv
    unfold psiT
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    apply div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg <;> linarith
  have hpsiS : ∀ L v : ℝ, 0 < L → psiT L v ≠ 0 → 0 < v ∧ v ≤ L := by
    intro L v hL hne
    by_contra hc
    apply hne
    apply hpsi0 L v hL
    rcases not_and_or.mp hc with h | h
    · rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]; linarith
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]; linarith
  have hpsiu : ∀ u : ℝ, 2 * G.r0 / 3 ≤ |u| →
      psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) ((u + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1) = 0 := by
    intro u hu
    apply hpsi0 _ _ hLs
    have e : (u + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2 = u / cib B.h γ.1 := by
      unfold Lsb; ring
    have e2 : Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 3 = (2 * G.r0 / 3) / cib B.h γ.1 := by
      unfold Lsb; ring
    rw [e, e2, abs_div, abs_of_pos hci]
    gcongr
  have hFz : ∀ u : ℝ, G.r0 / 4 ≤ |u| → sc5ProfF G.r0 u = 0 := by
    intro u hu; unfold sc5ProfF; rw [hchig u hu]; ring
  have hGz : ∀ u : ℝ, 2 * G.r0 / 3 ≤ |u| → sc5ProfG B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) b u = 0 := by
    intro u hu; unfold sc5ProfG; rw [hpsiu u hu]; ring
  
  have hT : Continuous (G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)) := by
    have hc := (hGc γ).continuousOn
    exact hc.comp_continuous
      (Continuous.prodMk continuous_const continuous_id :
        Continuous fun v : ℝ => (((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), v))
      (fun v => ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, hξ.2.2⟩)
  have hTc : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous fun v => G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v i :=
    fun i => (continuous_apply i).comp hT
  have hst := Real.smoothTransition.continuous
  have hpsic : ∀ L : ℝ, Continuous (psiT L) := by
    intro L; unfold psiT
    exact hst.comp ((continuous_const.sub ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).abs)).div_const _)
  have hFc : Continuous (sc5ProfF G.r0) := by
    unfold sc5ProfF chig bumpR
    exact (hst.comp (continuous_const.sub
      (((continuous_const.mul continuous_id).div_const _).pow 2))).pow 2
  have haff : Continuous fun u : ℝ => (u + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 :=
    (continuous_id.add continuous_const).div_const _
  have hGc' : Continuous (sc5ProfG B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) b) := by
    unfold sc5ProfG
    exact (((hpsic _).comp haff).pow 2).mul (((hTc 0).comp haff).mul ((hTc b).comp haff))
  
  have hl4 : 4 ≤ γ.1 := by omega
  have hnat : ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → n ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ n := by
    intro n hn
    induction n, hn using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => norm_num
    | succ k hk ih =>
      rw [pow_succ 2 k]
      nlinarith [Nat.mul_le_mul hk hk]
  have C1 : 0 ≤ bandIdx B.h γ.1 := by
    unfold bandIdx
    apply Int.floor_nonneg.mpr
    apply Real.logb_nonneg hTgc1
    have hl0 : (0:ℝ) < (γ.1:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < γ.1 by omega)
    rw [one_le_div (pow_pos hl0 2)]
    have h1 : ((γ.1:ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ γ.1 := by exact_mod_cast hnat γ.1 hl4
    have h2 : (2:ℝ) ^ γ.1 = (2:ℝ) ^ ((γ.1:ℕ):ℝ) := (Real.rpow_natCast 2 γ.1).symm
    have h3 : (2:ℝ) ^ ((γ.1:ℕ):ℝ) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (γ.1:ℝ)) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hh.le hl0.le])
    linarith
  
  have C5 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, (1/4 ≤ |w.1| ∨ 1/4 ≤ |w.2|) →
      sc5ProfF G.r0 (lamR w) * sc5ProfG B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) b (lamT w) = 0 := by
    intro w hw
    by_cases hA : G.r0 / 4 ≤ |lamR w|
    · rw [hFz _ hA, zero_mul]
    by_cases hB2 : 2 * G.r0 / 3 ≤ |lamT w|
    · rw [hGz _ hB2, mul_zero]
    exfalso
    push_neg at hA hB2
    have hd : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have e1 : w.1 = lamR w + bgc * lamT w := by unfold lamR lamT; field_simp; ring
    have e2 : w.2 = -bgc * lamR w + lamT w := by unfold lamR lamT; field_simp; ring
    have k1 : |w.1| < 1/4 := by
      rw [e1]
      have := abs_add_le (lamR w) (bgc * lamT w)
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hbgc0] at this
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbgc1.le (abs_nonneg (lamT w))]
    have k2 : |w.2| < 1/4 := by
      rw [e2]
      have := abs_add_le (-bgc * lamR w) (lamT w)
      rw [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_pos hbgc0] at this
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbgc1.le (abs_nonneg (lamR w))]
    rcases hw with h | h <;> linarith
  
  have C6 : ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, ¬ inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (2 * G.r0) Y →
      sc5ProfF G.r0 (lamR (rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) Y)) *
        sc5ProfG B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) b (lamT (rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) Y)) = 0 := by
    intro Y hY
    unfold inRect xiG etG at hY
    rcases not_and_or.mp hY with h | h
    · rw [hFz _ (by linarith [not_le.mp h]), zero_mul]
    · rw [hGz _ (by linarith [not_le.mp h]), mul_zero]
  
  have hIF : ∫ u, sc5ProfF G.r0 u = ∫ u in (-G.r0)..G.r0, chig G.r0 u ^ 2 := by
    symm
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_eq_integral_of_support_subset
    rw [Function.support_subset_iff']
    intro u hu
    have hu' : G.r0 / 4 ≤ |u| := by
      simp only [Set.mem_Ioc, not_and_or, not_lt, not_le] at hu
      rcases hu with h | h
      · rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]; linarith
      · rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]; linarith
    show chig G.r0 u ^ 2 = 0
    rw [hchig u hu']; ring
  have hKint : ∫ v, psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) v ^ 2 *
      (G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v 0 * G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v b) =
      ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..(Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) v ^ 2 *
      (G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v 0 * G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v b) := by
    symm
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_eq_integral_of_support_subset
    rw [Function.support_subset_iff']
    intro v hv
    show psiT _ v ^ 2 * _ = 0
    by_contra hne
    apply hv
    apply hpsiS _ v hLs
    intro h0; apply hne; rw [h0]; ring
  have hsub : ∫ u, sc5ProfG B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) b u = cib B.h γ.1 *
      ∫ v, psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) v ^ 2 *
      (G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v 0 * G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v b) := by
    have gen : ∀ k : ℝ → ℝ, ∫ u, k ((u + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1) = cib B.h γ.1 * ∫ v, k v := by
      intro k
      have e1 : ∫ u, k ((u + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1) = ∫ u, k (u / cib B.h γ.1) :=
        MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self (fun x => k (x / cib B.h γ.1)) G.r0
      rw [e1, MeasureTheory.Measure.integral_comp_div k (cib B.h γ.1), abs_of_pos hci, smul_eq_mul]
    exact gen (fun v => psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) v ^ 2 *
      (G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v 0 * G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v b))
  have hpair : ∀ (p q r : ℝ → ℝ) (a c : ℝ), Continuous p → Continuous q → Continuous r →
      (∫ v in a..c, p v • (q v, r v)).1 = ∫ v in a..c, p v * q v ∧
      (∫ v in a..c, p v • (q v, r v)).2 = ∫ v in a..c, p v * r v := by
    intro p q r a c hp hq hr
    have hf : Continuous fun v => p v • (q v, r v) := hp.smul (hq.prodMk hr)
    have hI := hf.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) a c
    constructor
    · have := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).intervalIntegral_comp_comm hI
      first | exact this.symm | simpa using this.symm
    · have := (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).intervalIntegral_comp_comm hI
      first | exact this.symm | simpa using this.symm
  have hH := hpair (fun v => psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) v ^ 2 * G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v 0)
    (fun v => G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v 1) (fun v => G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v 2)
    0 (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (((hpsic _).pow 2).mul (hTc 0)) (hTc 1) (hTc 2)
  have hH1 : (Hcol B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).1 =
      ((1 + bgc ^ 2) / 2 * (∫ u in (-G.r0)..G.r0, chig G.r0 u ^ 2) * cib B.h γ.1) *
        ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..(Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) v ^ 2 *
          G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v 0 * G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v 1 := by
    unfold Hcol
    rw [Prod.smul_fst, smul_eq_mul, hH.1]
  have hH2 : (Hcol B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).2 =
      ((1 + bgc ^ 2) / 2 * (∫ u in (-G.r0)..G.r0, chig G.r0 u ^ 2) * cib B.h γ.1) *
        ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..(Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) v ^ 2 *
          G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v 0 * G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v 2 := by
    unfold Hcol
    rw [Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul, hH.2]
  refine ⟨C1, hFc, hGc', fun u hu => ⟨hFz u (by linarith), hGz u (by linarith)⟩, C5, C6, ?_⟩
  rw [hIF, hsub, hKint]
  rcases hb with rfl | rfl
  · rw [if_pos rfl, hH1]
    have hc : ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..(Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) v ^ 2 *

  have hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) := ((hc 0).pow 2).add ((hc 1).pow 2)

  have hradc : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1) :=

by

    intro h hS ξ0 hξ0
    
    have hLc : ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ContinuousAt (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) ξ := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hτ : 0 < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 := by linarith
      have hqpos : 0 < qC h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).1
      have hqcont : ContinuousAt (qC h) ξ := by
        have hU : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
        have hp : ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
          ⟨trivial, hτ⟩
        have hg : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) :=
          hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)
        have hk : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) ξ := by fun_prop
        have he : qC h = (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘
            (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
          funext η; rfl
        rw [he]
        exact ContinuousAt.comp hg hk
      exact hqcont.logb hqpos.ne'
    
    have hwin : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (γ : Lab), ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) →
        |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) + (γ.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartR h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartZ h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartT h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
      intro ξ γ hξ hγ
      have s1 : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ → 1 < |φ ξ / μ - (j : ℝ)| →
          ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 := by
        intro μ j φ hφ h1
        have hψ : ContinuousAt (fun η => |φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)|) ξ :=
          ((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs
        have hev := (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : Cyl => (1:ℝ)) ξ).eventually_lt hψ h1
        filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
        have hsq : 1 < (φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)) ^ 2 := (one_lt_sq_iff_one_lt_abs _).mpr hη
        unfold sqPart bumpR
        rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), zero_div]
      have key : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ →
          (∀ η, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 → etaL h γ η = 0) → |φ ξ / μ - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
        intro μ j φ hφ himp
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have hev := s1 μ j φ hφ hc
        apply (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mpr _) hγ
        filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
        exact himp η hη
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have := key 1 (-(γ.1:ℤ)) (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) (hLc ξ hξ)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul])
        simpa [div_one, sub_neg_eq_add] using this
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.1 (chartR h γ.1) (by unfold chartR; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.1 (chartZ h γ.1) (by unfold chartZ; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.2 (chartT h γ.1) (by unfold chartT; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
    
    obtain ⟨L0, hL0⟩ : ∃ L0 : ℝ, L0 = Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hfin : (⋃ n ∈ Set.Iic ⌊2 - L0⌋₊, ({n} : Set ℕ) ×ˢ
        ((Set.Icc ⌈chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ

          Set.Icc ⌈chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋) ×ˢ
          (Set.univ : Set Bool))).Finite := by
      refine Set.Finite.biUnion (Set.finite_Iic _) (fun n _ => ?_)
      exact (Set.finite_singleton n).prod (((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod
        ((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod (Set.finite_Icc _ _))).prod Set.finite_univ)

      intro x c j hj hc
      rw [abs_le] at hj
      rw [abs_lt] at hc
      exact ⟨Int.ceil_le.mpr (by linarith [hj.2, hc.1]), Int.le_floor.mpr (by linarith [hj.1, hc.2])⟩

    have hcT : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartT h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartT; fun_prop

        ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, |φ ξ / μ - φ ξ0 / μ| < 1 := by

    have e1 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 :=
      (show ContinuousAt (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.2.2.1) ξ0 by fun_prop).eventually_lt
        continuousAt_const hξ0
    have e2 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) - L0| < 1 :=
      (((hLc ξ0 hξ0).sub continuousAt_const).abs).eventually_lt continuousAt_const
        (by simp [hL0])
    have e3 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊2 - L0⌋₊ + 1),
        |chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 := by
      rw [Filter.eventually_all_finset]
      intro n _
      exact (hch _ _ (hcR n)).and ((hch _ _ (hcZ n)).and (hch _ _ (hcT n)))
    refine ⟨{ξ | ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) - L0| < 1 ∧
        ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊2 - L0⌋₊ + 1),
        |chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1}, ?_,
      hfin.toFinset, ?_⟩
    · filter_upwards [e1, e2, e3] with ξ h1 h2 h3
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    
    rintro ⟨n, ⟨a, b, c⟩, σ⟩ ξ ⟨ht, hL, hC⟩ hγ
    obtain ⟨w0, wR, wZ, wT⟩ := hwin ξ _ ht hγ

    rw [abs_le] at w0
    rw [abs_lt] at hL

    obtain ⟨cR, cZ, cT⟩ := hC n (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn))
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨n, hn, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨rfl, ⟨hI _ _ _ wR cR, hI _ _ _ wZ cZ, hI _ _ _ wT cT⟩, trivial⟩
  intro h qs hS ξ₀ hξ₀
  have ht : ξ₀.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ₀.2.1
  obtain ⟨N, hN, Γ, hΓ⟩ := hloc h hS ξ₀ ht

      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hR2), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
    have e4 : -(G.r0 / 4) ≤ bgc * R := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (show 0 ≤ R + G.r0 / 4 by linarith),
        mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
    exact ⟨abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
  have hround : ∀ (x : ℝ) (k : ℤ), |x - k| < 1/2 → round x = k := by
    intro x k hk
    rw [round_eq, Int.floor_eq_iff]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hk
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  have hZ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => chartZ B.h γ.1 η) (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => chartZ B.h γ.1 η) := by
      simp only [chartZ, div_eq_mul_inv]
      fun_prop
    exact this.contDiffOn
  have hRCd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => RC γ.1 η) := by
    simp only [RC, div_eq_mul_inv]
    fun_prop
  have hRC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => RC γ.1 η) (DomC B.h qs) := hRCd.contDiffOn
  have hRC0 : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs, RC γ.1 η ≠ 0 := by
    intro η hη
    have : 0 < RC γ.1 η :=
      div_pos hη.1 (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _))
    exact this.ne'
  have hFang : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Fang B γ.1 η) (DomC B.h qs) := by
    simp only [Fang, div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact (hb γ.1 1).mul (hRC.inv hRC0)
  apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
  intro ξ₀ hξ₀
  refine ⟨{η | |(v η).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8} ∩ {η | |(v η).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8}, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (isOpen_lt ((hvc.fst.sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt ((hvc.snd.sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const)
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show |(v ξ₀).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8
      rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; norm_num
    · show |(v ξ₀).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8
      rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; norm_num
  · by_cases hA : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs ∩ ({η | |(v η).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8} ∩
        {η | |(v η).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8}), a γ m η = 0
    · 
      exact (contDiffOn_const (c := (0:ℂ))).congr (fun η hη => by simp [hA η hη])
    · 
      push_neg at hA
      obtain ⟨η1, hη1U, hη1⟩ := hA
      obtain ⟨-, -, hxi, het, -, -⟩ := hs γ m η1 hη1U.1 hη1
      have hw1 : |lamR (frac0 (v η1))| ≤ G.r0 / 4 := hxi
      have hw2 : |lamT (frac0 (v η1))| ≤ G.r0 := het
      have hw := key _ _ hw1 hw2
      have ex1 : (v η1).1 - ((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ) =
          lamR (frac0 (v η1)) + bgc * lamT (frac0 (v η1)) := id1 (frac0 (v η1))
      have ex2 : (v η1).2 - ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ) =
          -(bgc * lamR (frac0 (v η1))) + lamT (frac0 (v η1)) := id2 (frac0 (v η1))
      have hx1 : |(v η1).1 - ((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1/80 := by rw [ex1]; exact hw.1
      have hx2 : |(v η1).2 - ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1/80 := by rw [ex2]; exact hw.2
      obtain ⟨kk, hkk⟩ : ∃ kk : ℝ × ℝ,
          kk = (((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ), ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hfr : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs ∩ ({η | |(v η).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8} ∩
          {η | |(v η).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8}), frac0 (v η) = v η - kk := by
        intro η hη
        have h1 : |(v η).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8 := hη.2.1
        have h2 : |(v η).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8 := hη.2.2
        have g1 : |(v η1).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8 := hη1U.2.1
        have g2 : |(v η1).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8 := hη1U.2.2
        obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_lt.mp h1
        obtain ⟨a3, a4⟩ := abs_lt.mp h2
        obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := abs_lt.mp g1
        obtain ⟨b3, b4⟩ := abs_lt.mp g2
        obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := abs_le.mp hx1
        obtain ⟨c3, c4⟩ := abs_le.mp hx2
        have r1 : round (v η).1 = round (v η1).1 :=
          hround _ _ (abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
        have r2 : round (v η).2 = round (v η1).2 :=
          hround _ _ (abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
        rw [hkk]
        unfold frac0
        rw [r1, r2]
        rfl
      have hT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => lamT (v η - kk)) (DomC B.h qs) := by
        have : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => lamT (v η - kk)) := by
          simp only [hv, lamT, Jpow, div_eq_mul_inv]
          fun_prop
        exact this.contDiffOn
      obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : Cyl → ℝ, M = fun η : Cyl =>
          pzr5 B G γ * chartZ B.h γ.1 η / epsb B.h γ.1 + sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 * RC γ.1 η
          - (lamT (v η - kk) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 *
            (pang5 B G γ * Fang B γ.1 η + pzr5 B G γ * baseC B γ.1 η 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hmd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ M (DomC B.h qs) := by
        rw [hM]
        simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
        exact (((contDiffOn_const.mul hZ).mul contDiffOn_const).add (contDiffOn_const.mul hRC)).sub
          (((hT.add contDiffOn_const).mul contDiffOn_const).mul
            ((contDiffOn_const.mul hFang).add (contDiffOn_const.mul (hb γ.1 2))))
      have hmodel : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs ∩ ({η | |(v η).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8} ∩
          {η | |(v η).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8}), phiL5 B G γ η = M η := by
        intro η hη
        have hvco : vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 = (lamT (v η - kk) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 := by
          show (lamT (frac0 (v η)) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 = _
          rw [hfr η hη]
        rw [hM]
        show phiL5 B G γ η = _
        unfold phiL5
        rw [hvco]
      have hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((M η : ℝ) : ℂ)) (DomC B.h qs) :=
        Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hmd
      have hE : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl =>
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((M η : ℝ) : ℂ)))) (DomC B.h qs) :=
        (contDiffOn_const.mul (contDiffOn_const.mul hc)).cexp
      have hFt := ((ha γ m).mul hE).mono (inter_subset_left (s := DomC B.h qs)
        (t := {η | |(v η).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8} ∩ {η | |(v η).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8}))
      refine hFt.congr (fun η hη => ?_)
      show a γ m η * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) =
        a γ m η * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((M η : ℝ) : ℂ)))
      rw [hmodel η hη]

      c γ m ξ = 0) →

      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (N γ m : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ))).re) Ω

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Ω D Ψ c N H hΩ hrad hΨ hmaps hH hloc hc
  set Z : ℝ³ → ℂ := fun y => (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ) with hZdef
  have hp0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => y 0) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
  have hp1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => y 1) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
  have hZeq : Z = fun y => Complex.ofRealCLM (y 0) + Complex.ofRealCLM (y 1) * Complex.I := by
    funext y; apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hZdef]
  have hZ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Z := by
    rw [hZeq]
    exact (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp hp0).add
      ((Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp hp1).mul contDiff_const)
  have hnorm : ∀ y : ℝ³, ‖Z y‖ = rad y := by
    intro y
    rw [Complex.norm_eq_sqrt_sq_add_sq]
    rfl
  have hZne : ∀ y : ℝ³, 0 < rad y → Z y ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy h
    rw [← hnorm y, h, norm_zero] at hy
    exact lt_irrefl _ hy
  
  have hR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => ((rad y : ℝ) : ℂ)) {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y} := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => ‖Z y‖) y :=
      (contDiffAt_norm ℝ (hZne y hy)).comp y hZ.contDiffAt
    have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => Complex.ofRealCLM ‖Z y‖) y :=
      Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp y h1
    have e : (fun y => Complex.ofRealCLM ‖Z y‖) = fun y : ℝ³ => ((rad y : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      funext y; simp [hnorm]
    rw [e] at h2
    exact h2.contDiffWithinAt
  obtain ⟨u, hu_def⟩ : ∃ u : ℝ³ → ℂ, u = fun y => ((rad y : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ * Z y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y} := by
    rw [hu_def]
    exact (hR.inv (fun y hy => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hy))).mul hZ.contDiffOn
  have hune : ∀ y ∈ {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y}, u y ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hu_def]
    exact mul_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hy))) (hZne y hy)
  
  have hE : ∀ K : ℤ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun y : ℝ³ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (K : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))) {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y} := by
    intro K
    have hid : ∀ y ∈ {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y},
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (K : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ)) = u y ^ K := by
      intro y hy
      have h1 := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I (Z y)
      have hth : thetaOf y = Complex.arg (Z y) := rfl
      have hr : ((‖Z y‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hnorm y]; exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hy)
      have h2 : Complex.exp ((thetaOf y : ℂ) * Complex.I) = u y := by
        rw [hth, hu_def]
        show _ = ((rad y : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ * Z y
        rw [← hnorm y, eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq₀ hr]
        exact h1
      rw [show Complex.I * (K : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ) = (K : ℂ) * ((thetaOf y : ℂ) * Complex.I) by ring,
        Complex.exp_int_mul, h2]
    refine ContDiffOn.congr ?_ hid
    cases K with
    | ofNat n =>
      refine (hu.pow n).congr (fun y _ => ?_)
      simp
    | negSucc n =>
      refine ((hu.pow (n + 1)).inv (fun y hy => pow_ne_zero _ (hune y hy))).congr (fun y _ => ?_)
      exact zpow_negSucc _ _
  
  have hF : ∀ T : Finset Lab, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (∑ γ ∈ T, ∑ m ∈ H, c γ m (Ψ w) *
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (N γ m : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ))).re) Ω := by
    intro T
    have hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ∑ γ ∈ T, ∑ m ∈ H, c γ m (Ψ w) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (N γ m : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ))) Ω := by
      apply ContDiffOn.sum
      intro γ _
      apply ContDiffOn.sum
      intro m _
      exact ((hc γ m).comp hΨ hmaps).mul
        ((hE (N γ m)).comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun w hw => hrad w hw))
    refine (Complex.reCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hs).congr (fun w _ => ?_)
    simp
  
  apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
  intro w₀ hw₀
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hξU, T, hT⟩ := hloc (Ψ w₀) (hmaps hw₀)
  refine ⟨Ω ∩ Ψ ⁻¹' U, hΨ.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hΩ hU, ⟨hw₀, hξU⟩, ?_⟩
  refine ((hF T).mono inter_subset_left).congr (fun w hw => ?_)
  have hwΩ : w ∈ Ω := hw.1
  have hwU : Ψ w ∈ U := hw.2.2
  have hwD : Ψ w ∈ D := hmaps hwΩ
  congr 1
  have hin : ∀ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, c γ m (Ψ w) *
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (N γ m : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ)) =
      ∑ m ∈ H, c γ m (Ψ w) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (N γ m : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ)) := by
    intro γ
    apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
    intro m hm
    by_contra hmH
    exact hm (by simp [hH γ m hmH (Ψ w) hwD])
  rw [finsum_congr hin]
  apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
  intro γ hγ
  by_contra hγT
  apply hγ
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro m _
  simp [hT γ hγT m (Ψ w) ⟨hwU, hwD⟩]
