proof.tactics:
by
  intro G φ x hG hφ
  
  set L : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
    (-(EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) +
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))
    with hLdef
  have hL : (⇑L : ℝ³ → ℝ³) = azVec := by
    funext y
    simp only [hLdef, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply]
    unfold azVec
    simp
  have hA : DifferentiableAt ℝ azVec x := by
    rw [← hL]; exact L.differentiableAt
  have hdivA : divergence azVec x = 0 := by
    unfold divergence
    rw [← hL, ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    have e : ((L : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ³) =
        ((-(EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)) : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight
          (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) +
        ((EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight
          (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) := rfl
    rw [e, map_add, LinearMap.trace_smulRight, LinearMap.trace_smulRight]
    simp
  
  have hrot : fderiv ℝ φ x (azVec x) = 0 := by
    set w : ℝ³ := x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
      x 1 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) with hw
    set a : ℝ³ := azVec x with ha
    set c : ℝ → ℝ³ := fun θ => x + ((Real.cos θ - 1) • w + Real.sin θ • a) with hc
    have ha0 : a 0 = -(x 1) := by rw [ha]; unfold azVec; simp
    have ha1 : a 1 = x 0 := by rw [ha]; unfold azVec; simp
    have ha2 : a 2 = 0 := by rw [ha]; unfold azVec; simp
    have hc0 : ∀ θ, c θ 0 = x 0 * Real.cos θ - x 1 * Real.sin θ := by
      intro θ
      simp only [hc, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ha0, hw]
      simp
      ring
    have hc1 : ∀ θ, c θ 1 = x 1 * Real.cos θ + x 0 * Real.sin θ := by
      intro θ
      simp only [hc, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ha1, hw]
      simp
      ring
    have hc2 : ∀ θ, c θ 2 = x 2 := by
      intro θ
      simp only [hc, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ha2, hw]
      simp
    have hrad : ∀ θ, rad (c θ) = rad x := by
      intro θ
      unfold rad
      rw [hc0, hc1]
      congr 1
      linear_combination (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
    have hconst : (φ ∘ c) = fun _ => φ x := by
      funext θ
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [hG (c θ), hG x, hrad θ, hc2 θ]
    have hd1 : HasDerivAt (φ ∘ c) 0 0 := by
      rw [hconst]; exact hasDerivAt_const _ _
    have hcd : HasDerivAt c a 0 := by
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun θ => (Real.cos θ - 1) • w) ((-Real.sin 0) • w) 0 :=
        ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos 0).sub_const 1).smul_const w
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun θ => Real.sin θ • a) (Real.cos 0 • a) 0 :=
        (Real.hasDerivAt_sin 0).smul_const a
      have h3 := (h1.add h2).const_add x
      simp only [Real.sin_zero, Real.cos_zero, neg_zero, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add] at h3
      exact h3
    have hcx : x = c 0 := by simp [hc]
    have hd2 : HasDerivAt (φ ∘ c) (fderiv ℝ φ x a) 0 :=
      HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hφ.hasFDerivAt hcd hcx
    exact hd2.unique hd1
  refine ⟨hφ.smul hA, ?_⟩
  unfold divergence at hdivA ⊢
  have hfd : HasFDerivAt (fun y => φ y • azVec y)
      (φ x • fderiv ℝ azVec x + (fderiv ℝ φ x).smulRight (azVec x)) x :=
    hφ.hasFDerivAt.smul hA.hasFDerivAt
  rw [hfd.fderiv]
  have e : ((φ x • fderiv ℝ azVec x + (fderiv ℝ φ x).smulRight (azVec x) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) :
      ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ³) = φ x • ((fderiv ℝ azVec x : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ³) +
        (fderiv ℝ φ x : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (azVec x) := rfl
  rw [e, map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.trace_smulRight, hdivA, smul_zero, zero_add]
  exact hrot

∀ (B : BG) (qs α β : ℝ) (f g : ℝ → Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 →
    InMth5 B qs α f → InMth5 B qs β g → InM B qs (α + β) (fun ξ => thA (fun θ => f θ ξ * g θ ξ))

∀ (B : BG), B.ok → SimNorm B.h → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →
    (∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (e α : ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B e f) →
      InM B (qsOf l0) (α - kapS) (nrm B (e + 1/2) (dR B.h f)) ∧
      InM B (qsOf l0) (α + 1 - kapS) (nrm B (e + 1/2) (dZ f)) ∧
      InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (e + 1/2) (fun ξ => f ξ / ξ.1)) ∧
      InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B e (yAvg f)) ∧
      ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), yAvg (dR B.h f) ξ = dR B.h (yAvg f) ξ ∧ yAvg (dZ f) ξ = dZ (yAvg f) ξ ∧
        yAvg (fun η => f η / η.1) ξ = yAvg f ξ / ξ.1) ∧
    (∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ) (e α β c d : ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B e f) → InM B (qsOf l0) β (nrm B e g) →
      ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), yAvg (fun η => c * f η + d * g η) ξ = c * yAvg f ξ + d * yAvg g ξ)

∀ (B : BG), B.ok → SimNorm B.h → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →
    (∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (e α : ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B e f) →
      InM B (qsOf l0) (α - kapS) (nrm B (e + 1/2) (dR B.h f)) ∧
      InM B (qsOf l0) (α + 1 - kapS) (nrm B (e + 1/2) (dZ f)) ∧
      InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (e + 1/2) (fun ξ => f ξ / ξ.1)) ∧
      InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B e (yAvg f)) ∧
      ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), yAvg (dR B.h f) ξ = dR B.h (yAvg f) ξ ∧ yAvg (dZ f) ξ = dZ (yAvg f) ξ ∧
        yAvg (fun η => f η / η.1) ξ = yAvg f ξ / ξ.1) ∧

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hB hSN
  obtain ⟨lw, hw⟩ := wmo_radial_calculus_v5 B hB hSN
  have hdeck := (stp5_int_deck B.h hB.2.1.1 hB.2.1.2.1).2.2
  refine ⟨lw + 7, fun l0 hl0 => ?_⟩
  have h7 : 7 ≤ l0 := by omega
  have hlw : lw ≤ l0 := by omega
  obtain ⟨hUo, -, hqpos, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hB
  set U := DomC B.h (qsOf l0) with hUdef
  
  have hsl : ∀ ζ ∈ U, ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, ((ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) ∈ U := fun ζ hζ Y => hζ
  have hK : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  have hKm : MeasurableSet (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :=
    measurableSet_Icc.prod measurableSet_Icc
  have hslc : Continuous (fun p : Cyl × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((p.1.1, p.1.2.1, p.1.2.2.1, p.2) : Cyl)) := by
    fun_prop
  have sliceC : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F'] (g : Cyl → F'),
      ContinuousOn g U → ∀ ξ ∈ U, Continuous (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl)) := by
    intro F' _ _ g hg ξ hξ
    have h := ContinuousOn.comp_continuous (g := g)
      (f := fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl)) hg (by fun_prop) (fun Y => hsl ξ hξ Y)
    exact h
  have intK : ∀ (g : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousOn g U → ∀ ξ ∈ U,
      IntegrableOn (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl))
        (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :=
    fun g hg ξ hξ => (sliceC g hg ξ hξ).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hK
  have regD : ∀ g : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U →
      ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ g) U ∧ ∀ p ∈ U, HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℝ g p) p := fun g hg =>
    ⟨hg.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hUo (by simp), fun p hp =>
      ((hg.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hUo.mem_nhds hp)).hasFDerivAt⟩
  
  have LIN : ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ) (c d : ℝ), ContinuousOn f U → ContinuousOn g U → ∀ ξ ∈ U,
      yAvg (fun η => c * f η + d * g η) ξ = c * yAvg f ξ + d * yAvg g ξ := by
    intro f g c d hf hg ξ hξ
    simp only [yAvg]
    rw [integral_add (Integrable.const_mul (intK f hf ξ hξ) c) (Integrable.const_mul (intK g hg ξ hξ) d),
      integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
  
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl, ∀ x : Cyl, L x = (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, 0) :=
    ⟨(ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (0 : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)))), fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hslD : ∀ (x : Cyl) (Y : ℝ × ℝ),
      HasFDerivAt (fun x' : Cyl => ((x'.1, x'.2.1, x'.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl)) L x := by
    intro x Y
    have e : (fun x' : Cyl => ((x'.1, x'.2.1, x'.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl)) =
        fun x' => L x' + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y) := by
      funext x'
      rw [hL]
      simp
    rw [e]
    exact L.hasFDerivAt.add_const _
  
  have DER : ∀ g : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → ∀ ξ ∈ U,
      HasFDerivAt (yAvg g) (∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
        (fderiv ℝ g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl)).comp L) ξ := by
    intro g hg ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨hgf, hgd⟩ := regD g hg
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hUo ξ hξ
    have hsU : Metric.closedBall ξ (δ / 2) ⊆ U :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
    have hsn : Metric.closedBall ξ (δ / 2) ∈ nhds ξ := Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds ξ (by linarith)
    have hC : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall ξ (δ / 2) ×ˢ (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)) :=
      (isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod hK
    have hcont : ContinuousOn
        (fun p : Cyl × (ℝ × ℝ) => (fderiv ℝ g ((p.1.1, p.1.2.1, p.1.2.2.1, p.2) : Cyl)).comp L)
        (Metric.closedBall ξ (δ / 2) ×ˢ (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)) := by
      have h1 : ContinuousOn
          (fun p : Cyl × (ℝ × ℝ) => fderiv ℝ g ((p.1.1, p.1.2.1, p.1.2.2.1, p.2) : Cyl))
          (Metric.closedBall ξ (δ / 2) ×ˢ (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)) :=
        hgf.comp hslc.continuousOn (fun p hp => hsl p.1 (hsU hp.1) p.2)
      exact h1.clm_comp continuousOn_const
    obtain ⟨Cb, hCb⟩ := hC.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hcont
    show HasFDerivAt (fun x : Cyl => ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
      g ((x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl)) _ ξ
    refine hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ)
      (μ := volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1))
      (F := fun x Y => g ((x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl))
      (F' := fun x Y => (fderiv ℝ g ((x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl)).comp L)
      (bound := fun _ => Cb) hsn ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · filter_upwards [hUo.mem_nhds hξ] with x hx
      exact (sliceC g hg.continuousOn x hx).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact intK g hg.continuousOn ξ hξ
    · exact ((sliceC _ hgf ξ hξ).clm_comp continuous_const).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hKm (fun Y hY x hx => hCb (x, Y) ⟨hx, hY⟩)
    · exact continuousOn_const.integrableOn_compact hK
    · exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hKm (fun Y _ x hx =>
        (hgd _ (hsl x (hsU hx) Y)).comp x (hslD x Y))
  have DERv : ∀ g : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → ∀ ξ ∈ U, ∀ v : Cyl,
      fderiv ℝ (yAvg g) ξ v = yAvg (fun η => fderiv ℝ g η (L v)) ξ := by
    intro g hg ξ hξ v
    rw [(DER g hg ξ hξ).fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply]
    · rfl
    · exact ((sliceC _ (regD g hg).1 ξ hξ).clm_comp continuous_const).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hK
  
  have FTC : ∀ (φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous φ' → (∀ s, HasDerivAt φ (φ' s) s) → φ 1 = φ 0 →
      ∫ s in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, φ' s = 0 := by
    intro φ φ' hc hd hp
    rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one,
      intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun s _ => hd s) (hc.intervalIntegrable 0 1), hp,
      sub_self]
  
  have YZ : ∀ g : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → ∀ ξ ∈ U,
      (∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y + ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) : Cyl) = g (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y)) →
      (∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) : Cyl) = g (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y)) →
      ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, yAvg (fun η => fderiv ℝ g η ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), w)) ξ = 0 := by
    intro g hg ξ hξ hp1 hp2 w
    obtain ⟨hgf, hgd⟩ := regD g hg
    obtain ⟨D1, hD1⟩ : ∃ D1 : Cyl → ℝ,
        D1 = fun η => fderiv ℝ g η ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨D2, hD2⟩ : ∃ D2 : Cyl → ℝ,
        D2 = fun η => fderiv ℝ g η ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hD1c : ContinuousOn D1 U := by rw [hD1]; exact hgf.clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have hD2c : ContinuousOn D2 U := by rw [hD2]; exact hgf.clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have hsplit : (fun η => fderiv ℝ g η ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), w)) = fun η => w.1 * D1 η + w.2 * D2 η := by
      funext η
      have e : ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), w) = w.1 • ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) +
          w.2 • ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) := by
        obtain ⟨w1, w2⟩ := w
        simp
      rw [hD1, hD2, e, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hI2 : yAvg D2 ξ = 0 := by
      show ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, D2 ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) = 0
      have hint : IntegrableOn (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => D2 ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl))
          (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod volume) := by
        rw [← Measure.volume_eq_prod]; exact intK D2 hD2c ξ hξ
      rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod ℝ ℝ, setIntegral_prod _ hint]
      have hin : ∀ a : ℝ, ∫ b in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, D2 ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (a, b)) : Cyl) = 0 := by
        intro a
        refine FTC (fun s => g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (a, s)) : Cyl))
          (fun s => D2 ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (a, s)) : Cyl)) ?_ ?_ ?_
        · exact (sliceC D2 hD2c ξ hξ).comp (by fun_prop : Continuous fun s : ℝ => ((a, s) : ℝ × ℝ))
        · intro s
          have hc : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (a, s)) : Cyl))
              ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) s :=
            (hasDerivAt_const s ξ.1).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_const s ξ.2.1).prodMk
              ((hasDerivAt_const s ξ.2.2.1).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_const s a).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' s))))
          have := (hgd ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (a, s)) : Cyl) (hsl ξ hξ (a, s))).comp_hasDerivAt s hc
          rw [hD2]
          exact this
        · have h := hp2 (a, 0)
          simp only [Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero, zero_add] at h
          exact h
      simp only [hin, integral_zero]
    have hI1 : yAvg D1 ξ = 0 := by
      show ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, D1 ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) = 0
      rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod ℝ ℝ, ← setIntegral_prod_swap (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
        (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => D1 ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl))]
      have hint : IntegrableOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => D1 ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, z.swap) : Cyl))
          (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod volume) := by
        rw [← Measure.volume_eq_prod]
        exact ((sliceC D1 hD1c ξ hξ).comp continuous_swap).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hK
      rw [setIntegral_prod _ hint]
      have hin : ∀ a : ℝ, ∫ b in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, D1 ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (b, a)) : Cyl) = 0 := by
        intro a
        refine FTC (fun s => g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (s, a)) : Cyl))
          (fun s => D1 ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (s, a)) : Cyl)) ?_ ?_ ?_
        · exact (sliceC D1 hD1c ξ hξ).comp (by fun_prop : Continuous fun s : ℝ => ((s, a) : ℝ × ℝ))
        · intro s
          have hc : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (s, a)) : Cyl))
              ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) s :=
            (hasDerivAt_const s ξ.1).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_const s ξ.2.1).prodMk
              ((hasDerivAt_const s ξ.2.2.1).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_id' s).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const s a))))
          have := (hgd ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (s, a)) : Cyl) (hsl ξ hξ (s, a))).comp_hasDerivAt s hc
          rw [hD1]
          exact this
        · have h := hp1 (0, a)
          simp only [Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero, zero_add] at h
          exact h
      simp only [Prod.swap_prod_mk, hin, integral_zero]
    rw [hsplit, LIN D1 D2 w.1 w.2 hD1c hD2c ξ hξ, hI1, hI2]
    ring
  
  have PER : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (e α : ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B e f) → ∀ ζ ∈ U, ∀ n m : ℤ,
      f (shY ζ ((n:ℝ), (m:ℝ))) = f ζ := by
    intro f e α hF ζ hζ n m
    have hq := hqpos ζ hζ
    have hζ' : 0 < ζ.1 ∧ ζ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ζ < qsOf l0 := hζ
    have hdk : IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ζ) ((n:ℝ), (m:ℝ)) := hdeck l0 h7 (qC B.h ζ) hq hζ'.2.2 n m
    have h := hF.2.1 ζ hζ _ hdk
    simp only [nrm] at h

  have hE3 : Aex B.h + Aex B.h + 1/2 = 2 * Aex B.h + 1/2 := by ring

  have hW' : ∀ a b : Fin 3, InM B (qsOf l0) 1 (nrm B (Aex B.h + Aex B.h) (Wcov5 B G l0 S a b)) :=

  obtain ⟨t1, ht1⟩ : ∃ f : Cyl → ℝ, f = dT (mcor5 B G l0 S 0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩

  obtain ⟨F1, hF1⟩ : ∃ f : Cyl → ℝ, f = fun η => 2 * ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η +

  obtain ⟨t5, ht5⟩ : ∃ f : Cyl → ℝ, f = fun ξ => F3 ξ / ξ.1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 S S2 c Bo hB hBo hTP hMS hF
  have hq0 : 0 < qsOf l0 := by
    show (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ))
    positivity
  have hq1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (by simp)
  have alg : ∀ (α β γ c d : ℝ) (f g k : Cyl → ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) α f → InM B (qsOf l0) β g →
      γ ≤ α → γ ≤ β → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), k ξ = c * f ξ + d * g ξ) → InM B (qsOf l0) γ k := by
    have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hB.1
    have hh : 0 < B.h := hB.2.1.1
    have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hB.2.1.2.2.1
    have hΩ : IsOpen {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qsOf l0} := by
      have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
        hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
      have hφ : Continuous (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ((w.1, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
        continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_const.sub continuous_snd)
      have hcomp : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2)) {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
        hcont.comp hφ.continuousOn (fun w hw => ⟨mem_univ _, by
          have hw' : w.2 < 1 := hw
          show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2
          linarith⟩)
      exact hcomp.isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const) isOpen_Iio
    have hD : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
      have hπ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
        (continuous_snd.fst).prodMk (continuous_snd.snd.fst)
      exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).inter (hΩ.preimage hπ)
    have lin : ∀ (U : Set Cyl) (f g k : Cyl → ℝ)
        (c d : ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U →
        (∀ x ∈ U, k x = c * f x + d * g x) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ k U ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Cyl) (L : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl), x ∈ U →
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n k x).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L)‖ ≤
            |c| * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L)‖ +
            |d| * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L)‖ := by
      intro U f g k c d hU hf hg hk
      have hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => c * f y + d * g y) U :=
        (contDiffOn_const.mul hf).add (contDiffOn_const.mul hg)
      refine ⟨hp.congr hk, ?_⟩
      intro n x L hx
      have hev : k =ᶠ[nhds x] (c • f + d • g) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => by simp [hk y hy, smul_eq_mul])
      have hfa : ContDiffAt ℝ n f x := (hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have hga : ContDiffAt ℝ n g x := (hg.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have heq : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n k x =
          c • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x + d • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x := by
        have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (c • f + d • g) x =
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (c • f) x + iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (d • g) x :=
          iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (hfa.const_smul c) (hga.const_smul d)
        rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ n).eq_of_nhds, e1,
          iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply hfa, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply hga]
      have hlin : (c • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x + d • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => L) =
          c • (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) +
          d • (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
        ext v; simp
      rw [heq, hlin]
      refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
      rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have wm : ∀ (C q α γ S b b' : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → γ ≤ α → 1 ≤ S → b ≤ b' →
        C * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ b ≤ |C| * q ^ (B.h * γ) * S ^ b' := by
      intro C q α γ S b b' hq0 hq1 hγ hS1 hb
      have h1 : q ^ (B.h * α) ≤ q ^ (B.h * γ) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hγ hh.le)
      have h2 : S ^ b ≤ S ^ b' := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 hb
      have h3 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _

  have hL : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => ((rotPt v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) := by

    fun_prop
  have hSo : IsOpen {v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < v.1 ∧ (rotPt v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) ∈ O} := by
    have h := (isOpen_lt (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (0 : ℝ))

    exact h
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => ((rotPt v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) : ℝ³ × ℝ))

  have hgU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => u (rotPt v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1) v.2.2.2)

    (hu.comp hL.contDiffOn hmaps).congr (fun v _ => rfl)

      {v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < v.1 ∧ (rotPt v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) ∈ O} :=
    (hp.comp hL.contDiffOn hmaps).congr (fun v _ => rfl)
  have hframeG : ∀ (r θ z s : ℝ), 0 < r →
      frameAt θ (r, z, s, 0) 0 = Real.cos θ • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +
        Real.sin θ • (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) ∧
      frameAt θ (r, z, s, 0) 1 = (-Real.sin θ) • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +
        Real.cos θ • (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) ∧
      frameAt θ (r, z, s, 0) 2 = (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) := by

    have e0 : rotPt r θ z 0 = r * Real.cos θ := by simp [rotPt]
    have e1 : rotPt r θ z 1 = r * Real.sin θ := by simp [rotPt]
    have hrad : rad (rotPt r θ z) = r := by
      have e : (r * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (r * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
        linear_combination r ^ 2 * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
      show Real.sqrt ((rotPt r θ z) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt r θ z) 1 ^ 2) = r
      rw [e0, e1, e, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
    have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show eR (rotPt r θ z) = _
      rw [eR, hrad, radVec, e0, e1, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul,
        inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hr0, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hr0]
    · show eTh (rotPt r θ z) = _
      rw [eTh, hrad, azVec, e0, e1, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_neg,

  have hUs : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (crU u a)

          frameAt v.2.1 (v.1, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2, 0) a = F v := by
      fin_cases a
      · exact ⟨fun v => Real.cos v.2.1 • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +
          Real.sin v.2.1 • (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³), by fun_prop,
          fun v hv => (hframeG v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2 hv.1).1⟩
      · exact ⟨fun v => (-Real.sin v.2.1) • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +
          Real.cos v.2.1 • (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³), by fun_prop,
          fun v hv => (hframeG v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2 hv.1).2.1⟩
      · exact ⟨fun _ => (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³), contDiff_const,

    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s => u (rotPt r θ z) s)
        (fderiv ℝ (↿u) (rotPt r θ z, t) ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ))) t :=
      hdu.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hκ
    have hlam : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ((r, θ, z, s) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) t :=
      (hasDerivAt_const t r).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_const t θ).prodMk
        ((hasDerivAt_const t z).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' t)))
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s => crU u a (r, θ, z, s)) (cpS (crU u a) (r, θ, z, t)) t := by
      have h := (hdU a).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hlam
      exact h
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun s => crU u a (r, θ, z, s))
        (inner ℝ (u (rotPt r θ z) t) (0 : ℝ³) +
          inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿u) (rotPt r θ z, t) ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ))) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) a)) t :=
      h1.inner ℝ (hasDerivAt_const t (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) a))
    rw [h1.deriv, h2.unique h3, inner_zero_right, zero_add]

    have h := hdp.comp (rotPt r θ z) hf
    exact h
  have hgF := hg.hasFDerivAt
  have hG : ∀ w : ℝ³, inner ℝ (gradient (fun y => p y t) (rotPt r θ z)) w =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => p y t) (rotPt r θ z) w := fun w => inner_gradient_left
  have hmR : HasDerivAt (fun ρ : ℝ => rotPt ρ θ z)
      (Real.cos θ • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +
        Real.sin θ • (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³)) r := by
    unfold rotPt
    exact ((((hasDerivAt_mul_const (Real.cos θ)).smul_const
      (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³)).add
      ((hasDerivAt_mul_const (Real.sin θ)).smul_const
      (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³))).add
      (hasDerivAt_const r (z • (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³)))).congr_deriv
      (add_zero _)
  have hmTh : HasDerivAt (fun φ : ℝ => rotPt r φ z)
      (r • ((-Real.sin θ) • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +
        Real.cos θ • (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³))) θ := by
    unfold rotPt
    exact (((((Real.hasDerivAt_cos θ).const_mul r).smul_const
      (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³)).add
      (((Real.hasDerivAt_sin θ).const_mul r).smul_const
      (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³))).add
      (hasDerivAt_const θ (z • (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³)))).congr_deriv

    unfold rotPt
    exact ((hasDerivAt_const z ((r * Real.cos θ) • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +

      ((hasDerivAt_id' z).smul_const (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³))).congr_deriv

  have cR1 : HasDerivAt (fun ρ => crP p (ρ, θ, z, t))

      (fderiv ℝ (fun y => p y t) (rotPt r θ z) (r • ((-Real.sin θ) • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +

  refine ⟨hT, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [f0, hG]
    exact (cR2.unique cR1).symm
  · rw [f1, hG, cTh2.unique cTh1, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  · rw [f2, hG]
    exact (cZ2.unique cZ1).symm

      cpR (fun η => crU u 0 η * crU u 0 η) (r, θ, z, t) + crU u 0 (r, θ, z, t) * crU u 0 (r, θ, z, t) / r +
        cpZ (fun η => crU u 2 η * crU u 0 η) (r, θ, z, t) + cpTh (fun η => crU u 1 η * crU u 0 η) (r, θ, z, t) / r -
        crU u 1 (r, θ, z, t) * crU u 1 (r, θ, z, t) / r) ∧

        crU u 2 (r, θ, z, t) * divergence (fun y => u y t) (rotPt r θ z) =
      cpR (fun η => crU u 0 η * crU u 2 η) (r, θ, z, t) + crU u 0 (r, θ, z, t) * crU u 2 (r, θ, z, t) / r +

    have e : D (u (rotPt r θ z) t) = D (crU u 0 (r, θ, z, t) • frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) 0 +
        crU u 1 (r, θ, z, t) • frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) 1 +
        crU u 2 (r, θ, z, t) • frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) 2) := congrArg D hw
    rw [e]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left]
  have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
  rw [← hD]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hDw 0, hdiv]
    simp only [hpR, hpZ, hpTh, hR, hZ, hTh0, hTh1]
    field_simp
    ring
  · rw [hDw 1, hdiv]
    simp only [hpR, hpZ, hpTh, hR, hZ, hTh1]
    field_simp
    ring
  · rw [hDw 2, hdiv]
    simp only [hpR, hpZ, hpTh, hR, hZ, hTh1, hTh2]
    field_simp
    ring

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (r θ z t : ℝ), IsOpen O →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) O → 0 < r → (rotPt r θ z, t) ∈ O →
    inner ℝ (Δ (fun y => u y t) (rotPt r θ z)) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) 0) =
      cpR (cpR (crU u 0)) (r, θ, z, t) + cpR (crU u 0) (r, θ, z, t) / r + cpZ (cpZ (crU u 0)) (r, θ, z, t) +
        (cpTh (cpTh (crU u 0)) (r, θ, z, t) - 2 * cpTh (crU u 1) (r, θ, z, t) - crU u 0 (r, θ, z, t)) / r ^ 2 ∧
    inner ℝ (Δ (fun y => u y t) (rotPt r θ z)) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) 1) =
      cpR (cpR (crU u 1)) (r, θ, z, t) + cpR (crU u 1) (r, θ, z, t) / r + cpZ (cpZ (crU u 1)) (r, θ, z, t) +
        (cpTh (cpTh (crU u 1)) (r, θ, z, t) + 2 * cpTh (crU u 0) (r, θ, z, t) - crU u 1 (r, θ, z, t)) / r ^ 2 ∧
    inner ℝ (Δ (fun y => u y t) (rotPt r θ z)) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, 0) 2) =
      cpR (cpR (crU u 2)) (r, θ, z, t) + cpR (crU u 2) (r, θ, z, t) / r + cpZ (cpZ (crU u 2)) (r, θ, z, t) +
        cpTh (cpTh (crU u 2)) (r, θ, z, t) / r ^ 2

∀ (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (r θ z t : ℝ), IsOpen O →

proof.tactics:
by
  intro u O r θ z t hO hu hr hmem
  have hL : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
      ((rotPt v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) := by
    unfold rotPt
    fun_prop
  have hSo : IsOpen {v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < v.1 ∧ (rotPt v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) ∈ O} := by
    have h := (isOpen_lt (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (0 : ℝ))
      continuous_fst).inter (hO.preimage hL.continuous)
    exact h
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => ((rotPt v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) : ℝ³ × ℝ))
      {v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < v.1 ∧ (rotPt v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) ∈ O} O :=
    fun v hv => hv.2
  have hgU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => u (rotPt v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1) v.2.2.2)
      {v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < v.1 ∧ (rotPt v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) ∈ O} :=
    (hu.comp hL.contDiffOn hmaps).congr (fun v _ => rfl)
  have hframeG : ∀ (r θ z s : ℝ), 0 < r →
      frameAt θ (r, z, s, 0) 0 = Real.cos θ • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +
        Real.sin θ • (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) ∧
      frameAt θ (r, z, s, 0) 1 = (-Real.sin θ) • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +
        Real.cos θ • (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) ∧
      frameAt θ (r, z, s, 0) 2 = (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) := by
    intro r θ z s hr
    have e0 : rotPt r θ z 0 = r * Real.cos θ := by simp [rotPt]
    have e1 : rotPt r θ z 1 = r * Real.sin θ := by simp [rotPt]
    have hrad : rad (rotPt r θ z) = r := by
      have e : (r * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (r * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
        linear_combination r ^ 2 * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
      show Real.sqrt ((rotPt r θ z) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt r θ z) 1 ^ 2) = r
      rw [e0, e1, e, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
    have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show eR (rotPt r θ z) = _
      rw [eR, hrad, radVec, e0, e1, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul,
        inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hr0, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hr0]
    · show eTh (rotPt r θ z) = _
      rw [eTh, hrad, azVec, e0, e1, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_neg,
        inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hr0, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hr0]
    · rfl
  have hUs : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (crU u a)
      {v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < v.1 ∧ (rotPt v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) ∈ O} := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨F, hFs, hFe⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ³, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F ∧
        ∀ v ∈ {v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < v.1 ∧ (rotPt v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) ∈ O},
          frameAt v.2.1 (v.1, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2, 0) a = F v := by
      fin_cases a
      · exact ⟨fun v => Real.cos v.2.1 • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +
          Real.sin v.2.1 • (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³), by fun_prop,
          fun v hv => (hframeG v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2 hv.1).1⟩
      · exact ⟨fun v => (-Real.sin v.2.1) • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +
          Real.cos v.2.1 • (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³), by fun_prop,
          fun v hv => (hframeG v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2 hv.1).2.1⟩
      · exact ⟨fun _ => (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³), contDiff_const,
          fun v hv => (hframeG v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2 hv.1).2.2⟩
    refine (hgU.inner ℝ hFs.contDiffOn).congr (fun v hv => ?_)
    simp only [crU, hFe v hv]
  have hv : ((r, θ, z, t) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈
      {v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < v.1 ∧ (rotPt v.1 v.2.1 v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) ∈ O} := ⟨hr, hmem⟩
  have hUC : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (ρ φ ζ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → (rotPt ρ φ ζ, t) ∈ O →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (crU u a) (ρ, φ, ζ, t) :=
    fun a ρ φ ζ hρ hO' => (hUs a).contDiffAt (hSo.mem_nhds ⟨hρ, hO'⟩)
  have hUd : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (ρ φ ζ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → (rotPt ρ φ ζ, t) ∈ O →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (crU u a) (ρ, φ, ζ, t) :=
    fun a ρ φ ζ hρ hO' => (hUC a ρ φ ζ hρ hO').differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ³ → ℝ³, g = fun y => u y t := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨F0, hF0⟩ : ∃ F0 : ℝ → ℝ³, F0 = fun φ =>
      Real.cos φ • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +
        Real.sin φ • (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨F1, hF1⟩ : ∃ F1 : ℝ → ℝ³, F1 = fun φ =>
      (-Real.sin φ) • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +
        Real.cos φ • (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨E2, hE2⟩ : ∃ E2 : ℝ³, E2 = (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hfr : ∀ ρ φ ζ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → frameAt φ (ρ, ζ, t, 0) 0 = F0 φ ∧
      frameAt φ (ρ, ζ, t, 0) 1 = F1 φ ∧ frameAt φ (ρ, ζ, t, 0) 2 = E2 := by
    intro ρ φ ζ hρ
    rw [hF0, hF1, hE2]
    exact hframeG ρ φ ζ t hρ
  have hcrU : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (ρ φ ζ : ℝ),
      crU u a (ρ, φ, ζ, t) = inner ℝ (g (rotPt ρ φ ζ)) (frameAt φ (ρ, ζ, t, 0) a) := by
    intro a ρ φ ζ
    rw [hg]
    rfl
  have hF0d : ∀ φ : ℝ, HasDerivAt F0 (F1 φ) φ := by
    intro φ
    simp only [hF0, hF1]
    exact ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos φ).smul_const _).add ((Real.hasDerivAt_sin φ).smul_const _)
  have hF1d : ∀ φ : ℝ, HasDerivAt F1 (-(F0 φ)) φ := by
    intro φ
    simp only [hF0, hF1]
    exact (((Real.hasDerivAt_sin φ).neg.smul_const _).add ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos φ).smul_const _)).congr_deriv
      (by rw [neg_add, neg_smul, neg_smul])
  
  have hmR : ∀ ρ φ ζ : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun σ : ℝ => rotPt σ φ ζ) (F0 φ) ρ := by
    intro ρ φ ζ
    simp only [hF0]
    unfold rotPt
    exact ((((hasDerivAt_mul_const (Real.cos φ)).smul_const
      (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³)).add
      ((hasDerivAt_mul_const (Real.sin φ)).smul_const
      (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³))).add
      (hasDerivAt_const ρ (ζ • (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³)))).congr_deriv
      (add_zero _)
  have hmTh : ∀ ρ φ ζ : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun σ : ℝ => rotPt ρ σ ζ) (ρ • F1 φ) φ := by
    intro ρ φ ζ
    simp only [hF1]
    unfold rotPt
    exact (((((Real.hasDerivAt_cos φ).const_mul ρ).smul_const
      (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³)).add
      (((Real.hasDerivAt_sin φ).const_mul ρ).smul_const
      (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³))).add
      (hasDerivAt_const φ (ζ • (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³)))).congr_deriv
      (by rw [add_zero, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul])
  have hmZ : ∀ ρ φ ζ : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun σ : ℝ => rotPt ρ φ σ) E2 ζ := by
    intro ρ φ ζ
    rw [hE2]
    unfold rotPt
    exact ((hasDerivAt_const ζ ((ρ * Real.cos φ) • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +
      (ρ * Real.sin φ) • (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³))).add
      ((hasDerivAt_id' ζ).smul_const (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³))).congr_deriv
      (by rw [zero_add, one_smul])
  
  have hgC : ∀ y : ℝ³, (y, t) ∈ O → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hg]
    exact (hu.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hy)).comp y
      ((contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt)
  have hgd : ∀ y : ℝ³, (y, t) ∈ O → DifferentiableAt ℝ g y :=
    fun y hy => (hgC y hy).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hBd : HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ g) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) (rotPt r θ z)) (rotPt r θ z) :=
    (((hgC _ hmem).fderiv_right (m := 1) (by simp)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
  
  have hLR : ∀ (F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (ρ φ ζ : ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ F (ρ, φ, ζ, t) →
      HasDerivAt (fun σ => F (σ, φ, ζ, t)) (cpR F (ρ, φ, ζ, t)) ρ := by
    intro F ρ φ ζ hF
    have h := hF.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt ρ ((hasDerivAt_id' ρ).prodMk
      ((hasDerivAt_const ρ φ).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_const ρ ζ).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const ρ t))))
    exact h
  have hLTh : ∀ (F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (ρ φ ζ : ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ F (ρ, φ, ζ, t) →
      HasDerivAt (fun σ => F (ρ, σ, ζ, t)) (cpTh F (ρ, φ, ζ, t)) φ := by
    intro F ρ φ ζ hF
    have h := hF.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt φ ((hasDerivAt_const φ ρ).prodMk
      ((hasDerivAt_id' φ).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_const φ ζ).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const φ t))))
    exact h
  have hLZ : ∀ (F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (ρ φ ζ : ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ F (ρ, φ, ζ, t) →
      HasDerivAt (fun σ => F (ρ, φ, σ, t)) (cpZ F (ρ, φ, ζ, t)) ζ := by
    intro F ρ φ ζ hF
    have h := hF.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt ζ ((hasDerivAt_const ζ ρ).prodMk
      ((hasDerivAt_const ζ φ).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_id' ζ).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const ζ t))))
    exact h
  
  have hevR : ∀ᶠ σ in nhds r, 0 < σ ∧ (rotPt σ θ z, t) ∈ O := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun σ : ℝ => ((σ, θ, z, t) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    exact hc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (hSo.mem_nhds hv)
  have hevTh : ∀ᶠ φ in nhds θ, 0 < r ∧ (rotPt r φ z, t) ∈ O := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => ((r, φ, z, t) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    exact hc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (hSo.mem_nhds hv)
  have hevZ : ∀ᶠ ζ in nhds z, 0 < r ∧ (rotPt r θ ζ, t) ∈ O := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => ((r, θ, ζ, t) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    exact hc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (hSo.mem_nhds hv)
  
  have key : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (W Wd Wdd : ℝ → ℝ³),
      (∀ ρ φ ζ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → frameAt φ (ρ, ζ, t, 0) a = W φ) →
      (∀ φ, HasDerivAt W (Wd φ) φ) → (∀ φ, HasDerivAt Wd (Wdd φ) φ) →
      crU u a (r, θ, z, t) = inner ℝ (g (rotPt r θ z)) (W θ) ∧
      cpR (crU u a) (r, θ, z, t) = inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ g (rotPt r θ z) (F0 θ)) (W θ) ∧
      cpR (cpR (crU u a)) (r, θ, z, t) =
        inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) (rotPt r θ z) (F0 θ) (F0 θ)) (W θ) ∧
      cpZ (cpZ (crU u a)) (r, θ, z, t) =
        inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) (rotPt r θ z) E2 E2) (W θ) ∧
      cpTh (crU u a) (r, θ, z, t) =
        r * inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ g (rotPt r θ z) (F1 θ)) (W θ) + inner ℝ (g (rotPt r θ z)) (Wd θ) ∧
      cpTh (cpTh (crU u a)) (r, θ, z, t) =
        r ^ 2 * inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) (rotPt r θ z) (F1 θ) (F1 θ)) (W θ)
          - r * inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ g (rotPt r θ z) (F0 θ)) (W θ)
          + 2 * r * inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ g (rotPt r θ z) (F1 θ)) (Wd θ)
          + inner ℝ (g (rotPt r θ z)) (Wdd θ) := by
    intro a W Wd Wdd hW hWd hWdd
    have hU' : ∀ ρ φ ζ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → crU u a (ρ, φ, ζ, t) = inner ℝ (g (rotPt ρ φ ζ)) (W φ) := by
      intro ρ φ ζ hρ
      rw [hcrU, hW ρ φ ζ hρ]
    have hFR : ∀ ρ φ ζ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → (rotPt ρ φ ζ, t) ∈ O →
        cpR (crU u a) (ρ, φ, ζ, t) = inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ g (rotPt ρ φ ζ) (F0 φ)) (W φ) := by
      intro ρ φ ζ hρ hO'
      have h2 := hLR (crU u a) ρ φ ζ (hUd a ρ φ ζ hρ hO')
      have hc := (hgd _ hO').hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt ρ (hmR ρ φ ζ)
      have h1 := hc.inner ℝ (hasDerivAt_const ρ (W φ))
      have h3 : (fun σ => crU u a (σ, φ, ζ, t)) =ᶠ[nhds ρ]
          (fun σ => inner ℝ (g (rotPt σ φ ζ)) (W φ)) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hρ] with σ hσ
        exact hU' σ φ ζ hσ
      rw [h2.unique (h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq h3), inner_zero_right, zero_add]
    have hFZ : ∀ ρ φ ζ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → (rotPt ρ φ ζ, t) ∈ O →
        cpZ (crU u a) (ρ, φ, ζ, t) = inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ g (rotPt ρ φ ζ) E2) (W φ) := by
      intro ρ φ ζ hρ hO'
      have h2 := hLZ (crU u a) ρ φ ζ (hUd a ρ φ ζ hρ hO')
      have hc := (hgd _ hO').hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt ζ (hmZ ρ φ ζ)
      have h1 := hc.inner ℝ (hasDerivAt_const ζ (W φ))
      have h3 : (fun σ => crU u a (ρ, φ, σ, t)) =ᶠ[nhds ζ]
          (fun σ => inner ℝ (g (rotPt ρ φ σ)) (W φ)) := by
        filter_upwards with σ
        exact hU' ρ φ σ hρ
      rw [h2.unique (h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq h3), inner_zero_right, zero_add]
    have hFTh : ∀ ρ φ ζ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → (rotPt ρ φ ζ, t) ∈ O →
        cpTh (crU u a) (ρ, φ, ζ, t) =
          ρ * inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ g (rotPt ρ φ ζ) (F1 φ)) (W φ) + inner ℝ (g (rotPt ρ φ ζ)) (Wd φ) := by
      intro ρ φ ζ hρ hO'
      have h2 := hLTh (crU u a) ρ φ ζ (hUd a ρ φ ζ hρ hO')
      have hc := (hgd _ hO').hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt φ (hmTh ρ φ ζ)
      have h1 := hc.inner ℝ (hWd φ)
      have h3 : (fun σ => crU u a (ρ, σ, ζ, t)) =ᶠ[nhds φ]
          (fun σ => inner ℝ (g (rotPt ρ σ ζ)) (W σ)) := by
        filter_upwards with σ
        exact hU' ρ σ ζ hρ
      rw [h2.unique (h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq h3)]
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, map_smul, real_inner_smul_left]
      ring
    have hD2 : ∀ e : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ (crU u a) w e) (r, θ, z, t) := fun e =>
      (((hUC a r θ z hr hmem).fderiv_right (m := 1) (by simp)).differentiableAt (by simp)).clm_apply
        (differentiableAt_const e)
    have hRR : cpR (cpR (crU u a)) (r, θ, z, t) =
        inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) (rotPt r θ z) (F0 θ) (F0 θ)) (W θ) := by
      have h2 := hLR (cpR (crU u a)) r θ z (hD2 (1, 0, 0, 0))
      have hcB := hBd.comp_hasDerivAt r (hmR r θ z)
      have h1 := (hcB.clm_apply (hasDerivAt_const r (F0 θ))).inner ℝ (hasDerivAt_const r (W θ))
      have h3 : (fun σ => cpR (crU u a) (σ, θ, z, t)) =ᶠ[nhds r]
          (fun σ => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ g (rotPt σ θ z) (F0 θ)) (W θ)) := by
        filter_upwards [hevR] with σ hσ
        exact hFR σ θ z hσ.1 hσ.2
      rw [h2.unique (h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq h3)]
      simp only [inner_zero_right, zero_add, map_zero, add_zero, Function.comp_apply]
    have hZZ : cpZ (cpZ (crU u a)) (r, θ, z, t) =
        inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) (rotPt r θ z) E2 E2) (W θ) := by
      have h2 := hLZ (cpZ (crU u a)) r θ z (hD2 (0, 0, 1, 0))
      have hcB := hBd.comp_hasDerivAt z (hmZ r θ z)
      have h1 := (hcB.clm_apply (hasDerivAt_const z E2)).inner ℝ (hasDerivAt_const z (W θ))
      have h3 : (fun σ => cpZ (crU u a) (r, θ, σ, t)) =ᶠ[nhds z]
          (fun σ => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ g (rotPt r θ σ) E2) (W θ)) := by
        filter_upwards [hevZ] with σ hσ
        exact hFZ r θ σ hσ.1 hσ.2
      rw [h2.unique (h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq h3)]
      simp only [inner_zero_right, zero_add, map_zero, add_zero, Function.comp_apply]
    have hThTh : cpTh (cpTh (crU u a)) (r, θ, z, t) =
        r ^ 2 * inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) (rotPt r θ z) (F1 θ) (F1 θ)) (W θ)
          - r * inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ g (rotPt r θ z) (F0 θ)) (W θ)
          + 2 * r * inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ g (rotPt r θ z) (F1 θ)) (Wd θ)
          + inner ℝ (g (rotPt r θ z)) (Wdd θ) := by
      have h2 := hLTh (cpTh (crU u a)) r θ z (hD2 (0, 1, 0, 0))
      have hcB := hBd.comp_hasDerivAt θ (hmTh r θ z)
      have hA := (hcB.clm_apply (hF1d θ)).inner ℝ (hWd θ)
      have hc := (hgd _ hmem).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt θ (hmTh r θ z)
      have h1 := (hA.const_mul r).add (hc.inner ℝ (hWdd θ))
      have h3 : (fun φ => cpTh (crU u a) (r, φ, z, t)) =ᶠ[nhds θ]
          (fun φ => r * inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ g (rotPt r φ z) (F1 φ)) (W φ) +
            inner ℝ (g (rotPt r φ z)) (Wd φ)) := by
        filter_upwards [hevTh] with φ hφ
        exact hFTh r φ z hr hφ.2
      rw [h2.unique (h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq h3)]
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, map_smul, map_neg, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        inner_add_left, inner_neg_left, real_inner_smul_left, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    exact ⟨hU' r θ z hr, hFR r θ z hr hmem, hRR, hZZ, hFTh r θ z hr hmem, hThTh⟩
  
  have hLap : ∀ w : ℝ³, inner ℝ (Δ g (rotPt r θ z)) w =
      inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) (rotPt r θ z) (F0 θ) (F0 θ)) w +
      inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) (rotPt r θ z) (F1 θ) (F1 θ)) w +
      inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) (rotPt r θ z) E2 E2) w := by
    intro w
    rw [InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_orthonormalBasis g
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, iteratedFDeriv_two_apply,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]
    rw [hF0, hF1, hE2]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, map_neg, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, inner_add_left,
      inner_neg_left, real_inner_smul_left, neg_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    linear_combination (-(inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) (rotPt r θ z)
      (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³)) w +
      inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) (rotPt r θ z)
      (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³)) w)) *
      Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
  
  obtain ⟨V0, A0, P0, Z0, T0, TT0⟩ := key 0 F0 F1 (fun φ => -(F0 φ))
    (fun ρ φ ζ hρ => (hfr ρ φ ζ hρ).1) hF0d hF1d
  obtain ⟨V1, A1, P1, Z1, T1, TT1⟩ := key 1 F1 (fun φ => -(F0 φ)) (fun φ => -(F1 φ))
    (fun ρ φ ζ hρ => (hfr ρ φ ζ hρ).2.1) hF1d (fun φ => (hF0d φ).neg)
  obtain ⟨V2, A2, P2, Z2, T2, TT2⟩ := key 2 (fun _ => E2) (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0)
    (fun ρ φ ζ hρ => (hfr ρ φ ζ hρ).2.2) (fun φ => hasDerivAt_const φ E2)
    (fun φ => hasDerivAt_const φ (0 : ℝ³))
  have hΔ : Δ (fun y => u y t) (rotPt r θ z) = Δ g (rotPt r θ z) := by rw [hg]
  obtain ⟨f0, f1, f2⟩ := hfr r θ z hr
  have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
  rw [hΔ, f0, f1, f2]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hLap, P0, A0, Z0, TT0, T1, V0]
    simp only [inner_neg_right, inner_zero_right]
    field_simp
    ring
  · rw [hLap, P1, A1, Z1, TT1, T0, V1]
    simp only [inner_neg_right, inner_zero_right]
    field_simp
    ring
  · rw [hLap, P2, A2, Z2, TT2]
    simp only [inner_neg_right, inner_zero_right, mul_zero, add_zero]
    field_simp
    ring

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (U : Fin 3 → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (P : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (W : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))
    (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), IsOpen W → w ∈ W →
    (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (U a) {v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | (v.1, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) ∈ W}) →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P {v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | (v.1, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) ∈ W} →
    (∀ (a : Fin 3) (v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), U a (v.1, v.2.1 + 2 * Real.pi, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) = U a v) →
    (∀ v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, P (v.1, v.2.1 + 2 * Real.pi, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) = P v) →
    (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (crAv (U a)) W) ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (crAv (fun η => U a η * U b η)) W) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (crAv P) W ∧
    thA (fun θ => crRow0 U P (w.1, θ, w.2.1, w.2.2)) =
      wDt (crAv (U 0)) w + wDr (crAv (fun η => U 0 η * U 0 η)) w + crAv (fun η => U 0 η * U 0 η) w / w.1 +
        wDz (crAv (fun η => U 2 η * U 0 η)) w - crAv (fun η => U 1 η * U 1 η) w / w.1 -
        (wLap (crAv (U 0)) w - crAv (U 0) w / w.1 ^ 2) + wDr (crAv P) w ∧
    thA (fun θ => crRow1 U P (w.1, θ, w.2.1, w.2.2)) =
      wDt (crAv (U 1)) w + wDr (crAv (fun η => U 0 η * U 1 η)) w + 2 * crAv (fun η => U 0 η * U 1 η) w / w.1 +
        wDz (crAv (fun η => U 2 η * U 1 η)) w - (wLap (crAv (U 1)) w - crAv (U 1) w / w.1 ^ 2) ∧
    thA (fun θ => crRow2 U P (w.1, θ, w.2.1, w.2.2)) =
      wDt (crAv (U 2)) w + wDr (crAv (fun η => U 0 η * U 2 η)) w + crAv (fun η => U 0 η * U 2 η) w / w.1 +
        wDz (crAv (fun η => U 2 η * U 2 η)) w - wLap (crAv (U 2)) w + wDz (crAv P) w

proof.tactics:
by
  intro U P W w hW hw hU hP hUper hPper
  set S : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) := {v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | (v.1, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) ∈ W} with hSdef
  have hS : IsOpen S :=
    hW.preimage (f := fun v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (v.1, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2)) (by fun_prop)
  
  have hcp : ∀ G : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G S → ∀ e : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun v => fderiv ℝ G v e) S :=
    fun G hG e => (hG.fderiv_of_isOpen hS (le_of_eq ENat.coe_top_add_one)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hcpR : ∀ G : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G S → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (cpR G) S :=
    fun G hG => hcp G hG (1, 0, 0, 0)
  have hcpTh : ∀ G : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G S → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (cpTh G) S :=
    fun G hG => hcp G hG (0, 1, 0, 0)
  have hcpZ : ∀ G : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G S → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (cpZ G) S :=
    fun G hG => hcp G hG (0, 0, 1, 0)
  have hcpS : ∀ G : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G S → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (cpS G) S :=
    fun G hG => hcp G hG (0, 0, 0, 1)
  have hper : ∀ G : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
      (∀ v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, G (v.1, v.2.1 + 2 * Real.pi, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) = G v) →
      ∀ v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, cpTh G (v.1, v.2.1 + 2 * Real.pi, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) = cpTh G v := by
    intro G hG v
    have hadd : ∀ x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, x + ((0:ℝ), 2 * Real.pi, (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) =
        (x.1, x.2.1 + 2 * Real.pi, x.2.2.1, x.2.2.2) := by
      intro x
      refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_)) <;> simp
    have hfun : (fun x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => G (x + ((0:ℝ), 2 * Real.pi, (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))) = G := by
      funext x
      rw [hadd, hG]
    have h1 : fderiv ℝ G (v + ((0:ℝ), 2 * Real.pi, (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) = fderiv ℝ G v := by
      rw [← fderiv_comp_add_right (f := G) (x := v) ((0:ℝ), 2 * Real.pi, (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)), hfun]
    show fderiv ℝ G (v.1, v.2.1 + 2 * Real.pi, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) (0, 1, 0, 0) = fderiv ℝ G v (0, 1, 0, 0)
    rw [← hadd v, h1]
  
  have hcc : ∀ G : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G S →
      Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => G (w.1, θ, w.2.1, w.2.2)) := by
    intro G hG
    exact hG.continuousOn.comp_continuous
      (f := fun θ : ℝ => ((w.1, θ, w.2.1, w.2.2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (by fun_prop) (fun θ => hw)
  
  have hzero : ∀ G : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G S →
      (∀ v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, G (v.1, v.2.1 + 2 * Real.pi, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) = G v) →
      crAv (cpTh G) w = 0 := by
    intro G hG hGp
    have hderiv : ∀ θ : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun θ : ℝ => G (w.1, θ, w.2.1, w.2.2))
        (cpTh G (w.1, θ, w.2.1, w.2.2)) θ := by
      intro θ
      have hGd : DifferentiableAt ℝ G (w.1, θ, w.2.1, w.2.2) :=
        (hG.contDiffAt (hS.mem_nhds
          (show ((w.1, θ, w.2.1, w.2.2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈ S from hw))).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hcd : HasDerivAt (fun θ : ℝ => ((w.1, θ, w.2.1, w.2.2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))
          ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) θ :=
        (hasDerivAt_const θ w.1).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_id θ).prodMk
          ((hasDerivAt_const θ w.2.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const θ w.2.2)))
      exact hGd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt θ hcd
    have hint : ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), cpTh G (w.1, θ, w.2.1, w.2.2) =
        G (w.1, 2 * Real.pi, w.2.1, w.2.2) - G (w.1, 0, w.2.1, w.2.2) :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun θ _ => hderiv θ)
        ((hcc _ (hcpTh G hG)).intervalIntegrable _ _)
    have hp : G (w.1, 2 * Real.pi, w.2.1, w.2.2) = G (w.1, 0, w.2.1, w.2.2) := by
      have := hGp (w.1, 0, w.2.1, w.2.2)
      simpa only [zero_add] using this
    show (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), cpTh G (w.1, θ, w.2.1, w.2.2) = 0
    rw [hint, hp, sub_self, mul_zero]
  
  have hO : IsOpen ((univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ W) := isOpen_univ.prod hW
  have param_fderiv : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
      (H : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → F), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H (univ ×ˢ W) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) => fderiv ℝ (fun w' => H (p.1, w')) p.2)
        (univ ×ˢ W) := by
    intro F _ _ H hH p hp
    have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ H p := hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hp)
    apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (Function.uncurry (fun (q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (w' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) => H (q.1, w'))) (p, p.2) := by
      have e : Function.uncurry (fun (q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (w' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) => H (q.1, w')) =
          H ∘ (fun z : (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) => (z.1.1, z.2)) := rfl
      rw [e]
      apply ContDiffAt.comp (g := H) (p, p.2)
      · simpa using hHa
      · fun_prop
    exact ContDiffAt.fderiv (f := fun (q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (w' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) => H (q.1, w'))
      (g := Prod.snd) h1 contDiffAt_snd (le_of_eq ENat.coe_top_add_one)
  have param_cont : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
      (H : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → F), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H (univ ×ˢ W) → ∀ x ∈ W,
      Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => fderiv ℝ (fun w' => H (φ, w')) x) := by
    intro F _ _ H hH x hx
    exact (param_fderiv H hH).continuousOn.comp_continuous
      (f := fun φ : ℝ => ((φ, x) : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))) (by fun_prop) (fun φ => ⟨mem_univ _, hx⟩)
  have param_hasFDeriv : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
      (H : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → F), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H (univ ×ˢ W) → ∀ y ∈ W,
      HasFDerivAt (fun w' => ∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H (φ, w'))
        (∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), fderiv ℝ (fun w' => H (φ, w')) y) y := by
    intro F _ _ _ H hH y hy
    have hHs := param_fderiv H hH
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW y hy
    set s := Metric.closedBall y (δ / 2) with hs
    have hsU : s ⊆ W := (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
    have hsn : s ∈ nhds y := Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds y (by linarith)
    have hK : IsCompact (Icc (0:ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ s) := isCompact_Icc.prod (isCompact_closedBall _ _)
    have hKsub : Icc (0:ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ s ⊆ univ ×ˢ W := fun z hz => ⟨mem_univ _, hsU hz.2⟩
    obtain ⟨Bd, hB⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hHs.continuousOn.mono hKsub)
    have hcontφ : ∀ x ∈ W, Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => H (φ, x)) := by
      intro x hx
      exact hH.continuousOn.comp_continuous (by fun_prop) (fun φ => ⟨mem_univ _, hx⟩)
    have hpi : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
    refine intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (μ := volume)
      (F := fun x φ => H (φ, x)) (F' := fun x φ => fderiv ℝ (fun w' => H (φ, w')) x)
      (bound := fun _ => Bd) hsn ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · filter_upwards [hW.mem_nhds hy] with x hx
      exact (hcontφ x hx).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact (hcontφ y hy).intervalIntegrable _ _
    · exact (param_cont H hH y hy).aestronglyMeasurable
    · refine ae_of_all _ (fun φ hφ x hx => ?_)
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hpi] at hφ
      exact hB (φ, x) ⟨Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hφ, hx⟩
    · exact intervalIntegrable_const
    · refine ae_of_all _ (fun φ _ x hx => ?_)
      have hxU : x ∈ W := hsU hx
      have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ H (φ, x) := hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds ⟨mem_univ _, hxU⟩)
      have : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w' => H (φ, w')) x :=
        hHa.comp x (by fun_prop : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => ((φ, w') : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))) x)
      exact (this.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
  
  have param_nat : ∀ (k : ℕ) {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
      [CompleteSpace F] (H : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → F), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H (univ ×ˢ W) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun w' => ∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H (φ, w')) W := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro F _ _ _ H hH
      have hD : DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun w' => ∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H (φ, w')) W :=
        fun y hy => (param_hasFDeriv H hH y hy).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      rw [Nat.cast_zero]
      exact contDiffOn_zero.mpr hD.continuousOn
    | succ k ih =>
      intro F _ _ _ H hH
      have hD : DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun w' => ∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H (φ, w')) W :=
        fun y hy => (param_hasFDeriv H hH y hy).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      have hCS : CompleteSpace ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] F) :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.instCompleteSpace (E := ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)
      have hIH := @ih ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] F) _ _ hCS
        (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) => fderiv ℝ (fun w' => H (p.1, w')) p.2) (param_fderiv H hH)
      rw [Nat.cast_succ]
      refine (contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hW).mpr ⟨hD, fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact absurd h (by simp)
      · refine hIH.congr (fun y hy => ?_)
        exact (param_hasFDeriv H hH y hy).fderiv
  
  have hs3 : ∀ F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F S → ∀ y ∈ W, ∀ e : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,
      fderiv ℝ (crAv F) y e = crAv (fun v => fderiv ℝ F v (e.1, 0, e.2.1, e.2.2)) y := by
    intro F hF y hy e
    have hH : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) => F (p.2.1, p.1, p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2))
        (univ ×ˢ W) :=
      hF.comp (by fun_prop : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) =>
        ((p.2.1, p.1, p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))).contDiffOn (fun p hp => hp.2)
    have hD : HasFDerivAt
        (fun y' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => ∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F (y'.1, φ, y'.2.1, y'.2.2))
        (∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          fderiv ℝ (fun y' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => F (y'.1, φ, y'.2.1, y'.2.2)) y) y :=
      param_hasFDeriv (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) => F (p.2.1, p.1, p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2)) hH y hy
    have hcD : Continuous
        (fun φ : ℝ => fderiv ℝ (fun y' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => F (y'.1, φ, y'.2.1, y'.2.2)) y) :=
      param_cont (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) => F (p.2.1, p.1, p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2)) hH y hy
    have hD2 : HasFDerivAt (crAv F) ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ • ∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        fderiv ℝ (fun y' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => F (y'.1, φ, y'.2.1, y'.2.2)) y) y :=
      hD.const_mul ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹)
    have hDθ : ∀ θ : ℝ, fderiv ℝ (fun y' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => F (y'.1, θ, y'.2.1, y'.2.2)) y e =
        fderiv ℝ F (y.1, θ, y.2.1, y.2.2) (e.1, 0, e.2.1, e.2.2) := by
      intro θ
      have hι : HasFDerivAt (fun y' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => ((y'.1, θ, y'.2.1, y'.2.2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))
          ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).prod
            ((0 : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).prod (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)))) y :=
        hasFDerivAt_fst.prodMk ((hasFDerivAt_const θ y).prodMk hasFDerivAt_snd)
      have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (y.1, θ, y.2.1, y.2.2) :=
        (hF.contDiffAt (hS.mem_nhds
          (show ((y.1, θ, y.2.1, y.2.2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈ S from hy))).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have h2 : fderiv ℝ (fun y' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => F (y'.1, θ, y'.2.1, y'.2.2)) y =
          (fderiv ℝ F (y.1, θ, y.2.1, y.2.2)).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).prod
            ((0 : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).prod (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)))) :=
        (hFd.hasFDerivAt.comp y hι).fderiv
      rw [h2]
      first
        | rfl
        | simp
    rw [hD2.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      ContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_apply (hcD.intervalIntegrable _ _) e]
    show _ = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
      fderiv ℝ F (y.1, θ, y.2.1, y.2.2) (e.1, 0, e.2.1, e.2.2)
    congr 1
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun θ _ => hDθ θ)
  have hR : ∀ F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F S → ∀ y ∈ W,
      wDr (crAv F) y = crAv (cpR F) y := fun F hF y hy => hs3 F hF y hy (1, 0, 0)
  have hZ : ∀ F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F S → ∀ y ∈ W,
      wDz (crAv F) y = crAv (cpZ F) y := fun F hF y hy => hs3 F hF y hy (0, 1, 0)
  have hT : ∀ F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F S → ∀ y ∈ W,
      wDt (crAv F) y = crAv (cpS F) y := fun F hF y hy => hs3 F hF y hy (0, 0, 1)
  
  have h2R : ∀ F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F S →
      crAv (cpR (cpR F)) w = wDr (wDr (crAv F)) w := by
    intro F hF
    have hev : crAv (cpR F) =ᶠ[nhds w] wDr (crAv F) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hw) (fun y hy => (hR F hF y hy).symm)
    have h1 : fderiv ℝ (crAv (cpR F)) w = fderiv ℝ (wDr (crAv F)) w := hev.fderiv_eq
    calc crAv (cpR (cpR F)) w = wDr (crAv (cpR F)) w := (hR (cpR F) (hcpR F hF) w hw).symm
      _ = fderiv ℝ (crAv (cpR F)) w (1, 0, 0) := rfl
      _ = fderiv ℝ (wDr (crAv F)) w (1, 0, 0) := by rw [h1]
      _ = wDr (wDr (crAv F)) w := rfl
  have h2Z : ∀ F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F S →
      crAv (cpZ (cpZ F)) w = wDz (wDz (crAv F)) w := by
    intro F hF
    have hev : crAv (cpZ F) =ᶠ[nhds w] wDz (crAv F) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hw) (fun y hy => (hZ F hF y hy).symm)
    have h1 : fderiv ℝ (crAv (cpZ F)) w = fderiv ℝ (wDz (crAv F)) w := hev.fderiv_eq
    calc crAv (cpZ (cpZ F)) w = wDz (crAv (cpZ F)) w := (hZ (cpZ F) (hcpZ F hF) w hw).symm
      _ = fderiv ℝ (crAv (cpZ F)) w (0, 1, 0) := rfl
      _ = fderiv ℝ (wDz (crAv F)) w (0, 1, 0) := by rw [h1]
      _ = wDz (wDz (crAv F)) w := rfl
  
  have hsm : ∀ G : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G S → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (crAv G) W := by
    intro G hG
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) => G (p.2.1, p.1, p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2))
        (univ ×ˢ W) :=
      hG.comp (by fun_prop : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) =>
        ((p.2.1, p.1, p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))).contDiffOn (fun p hp => hp.2)
    have hJ2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun y : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G (y.1, θ, y.2.1, y.2.2)) W :=
      contDiffOn_infty.mpr (fun k => param_nat k _ hg)
    have := (contDiffOn_const (c := (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹)).mul hJ2
    exact this
  
  have hUab : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => U a η * U b η) S :=
    fun a b => (hU a).mul (hU b)
  have hUabp : ∀ (a b : Fin 3) (v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ),
      (fun η => U a η * U b η) (v.1, v.2.1 + 2 * Real.pi, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2) =
        (fun η => U a η * U b η) v := by
    intro a b v
    show U a _ * U b _ = U a v * U b v
    rw [hUper a v, hUper b v]
  
  have lin0 : ∀ (t1 t2 t3 t4 t5 t6 t7 t8 t9 t10 t11 t12 t13 : ℝ → ℝ) (r : ℝ),
      Continuous t1 → Continuous t2 → Continuous t3 → Continuous t4 → Continuous t5 →
      Continuous t6 → Continuous t7 → Continuous t8 → Continuous t9 → Continuous t10 →
      Continuous t11 → Continuous t12 → Continuous t13 →
      thA (fun θ => t1 θ + t2 θ + t3 θ / r + t4 θ + t5 θ / r - t6 θ / r
        - (t7 θ + t8 θ / r + t9 θ + (t10 θ - 2 * t11 θ - t12 θ) / r ^ 2) + t13 θ) =
      thA t1 + thA t2 + thA t3 / r + thA t4 + thA t5 / r - thA t6 / r
        - (thA t7 + thA t8 / r + thA t9 + (thA t10 - 2 * thA t11 - thA t12) / r ^ 2) + thA t13 := by
    intro t1 t2 t3 t4 t5 t6 t7 t8 t9 t10 t11 t12 t13 r h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7 h8 h9 h10 h11 h12 h13
    unfold thA
    simp (disch := (apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)) only
      [intervalIntegral.integral_add, intervalIntegral.integral_sub, intervalIntegral.integral_div,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    ring
  have lin1 : ∀ (t1 t2 t3 t4 t5 t6 t7 t8 t9 t10 t11 t12 : ℝ → ℝ) (r : ℝ),
      Continuous t1 → Continuous t2 → Continuous t3 → Continuous t4 → Continuous t5 →
      Continuous t6 → Continuous t7 → Continuous t8 → Continuous t9 → Continuous t10 →
      Continuous t11 → Continuous t12 →
      thA (fun θ => t1 θ + t2 θ + 2 * t3 θ / r + t4 θ + t5 θ / r
        - (t6 θ + t7 θ / r + t8 θ + (t9 θ + 2 * t10 θ - t11 θ) / r ^ 2) + t12 θ / r) =
      thA t1 + thA t2 + 2 * thA t3 / r + thA t4 + thA t5 / r
        - (thA t6 + thA t7 / r + thA t8 + (thA t9 + 2 * thA t10 - thA t11) / r ^ 2) + thA t12 / r := by
    intro t1 t2 t3 t4 t5 t6 t7 t8 t9 t10 t11 t12 r h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7 h8 h9 h10 h11 h12
    unfold thA
    simp (disch := (apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)) only
      [intervalIntegral.integral_add, intervalIntegral.integral_sub, intervalIntegral.integral_div,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    ring
  have lin2 : ∀ (t1 t2 t3 t4 t5 t6 t7 t8 t9 t10 : ℝ → ℝ) (r : ℝ),
      Continuous t1 → Continuous t2 → Continuous t3 → Continuous t4 → Continuous t5 →
      Continuous t6 → Continuous t7 → Continuous t8 → Continuous t9 → Continuous t10 →
      thA (fun θ => t1 θ + t2 θ + t3 θ / r + t4 θ + t5 θ / r
        - (t6 θ + t7 θ / r + t8 θ + t9 θ / r ^ 2) + t10 θ) =
      thA t1 + thA t2 + thA t3 / r + thA t4 + thA t5 / r
        - (thA t6 + thA t7 / r + thA t8 + thA t9 / r ^ 2) + thA t10 := by
    intro t1 t2 t3 t4 t5 t6 t7 t8 t9 t10 r h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7 h8 h9 h10
    unfold thA
    simp (disch := (apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)) only
      [intervalIntegral.integral_add, intervalIntegral.integral_sub, intervalIntegral.integral_div,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    ring
  refine ⟨fun a => hsm _ (hU a), fun a b => hsm _ (hUab a b), hsm _ hP, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have L0 := lin0 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ w.1
      (hcc _ (hcpS _ (hU 0))) (hcc _ (hcpR _ (hUab 0 0))) (hcc _ (hUab 0 0))
      (hcc _ (hcpZ _ (hUab 2 0))) (hcc _ (hcpTh _ (hUab 1 0))) (hcc _ (hUab 1 1))
      (hcc _ (hcpR _ (hcpR _ (hU 0)))) (hcc _ (hcpR _ (hU 0))) (hcc _ (hcpZ _ (hcpZ _ (hU 0))))
      (hcc _ (hcpTh _ (hcpTh _ (hU 0)))) (hcc _ (hcpTh _ (hU 1))) (hcc _ (hU 0))
      (hcc _ (hcpR _ hP))
    have L0' : thA (fun θ => crRow0 U P (w.1, θ, w.2.1, w.2.2)) =
        crAv (cpS (U 0)) w + crAv (cpR (fun η => U 0 η * U 0 η)) w
          + crAv (fun η => U 0 η * U 0 η) w / w.1 + crAv (cpZ (fun η => U 2 η * U 0 η)) w
          + crAv (cpTh (fun η => U 1 η * U 0 η)) w / w.1 - crAv (fun η => U 1 η * U 1 η) w / w.1
          - (crAv (cpR (cpR (U 0))) w + crAv (cpR (U 0)) w / w.1 + crAv (cpZ (cpZ (U 0))) w
            + (crAv (cpTh (cpTh (U 0))) w - 2 * crAv (cpTh (U 1)) w - crAv (U 0) w) / w.1 ^ 2)
          + crAv (cpR P) w := L0
    have f1 := (hT _ (hU 0) w hw).symm
    have f2 := (hR _ (hUab 0 0) w hw).symm
    have f4 := (hZ _ (hUab 2 0) w hw).symm
    have f5 := hzero _ (hUab 1 0) (hUabp 1 0)
    have f7 := h2R _ (hU 0)
    have f8 := (hR _ (hU 0) w hw).symm
    have f9 := h2Z _ (hU 0)
    have f10 := hzero _ (hcpTh _ (hU 0)) (hper _ (hUper 0))
    have f11 := hzero _ (hU 1) (hUper 1)
    have f13 := (hR _ hP w hw).symm
    simp only [wLap]
    linear_combination L0' + f1 + f2 + f4 + f5 / w.1 - f7 - f8 / w.1 - f9 - f10 / w.1 ^ 2
      + 2 * f11 / w.1 ^ 2 + f13
  · 
    have L1 := lin1 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ w.1
      (hcc _ (hcpS _ (hU 1))) (hcc _ (hcpR _ (hUab 0 1))) (hcc _ (hUab 0 1))
      (hcc _ (hcpZ _ (hUab 2 1))) (hcc _ (hcpTh _ (hUab 1 1)))
      (hcc _ (hcpR _ (hcpR _ (hU 1)))) (hcc _ (hcpR _ (hU 1))) (hcc _ (hcpZ _ (hcpZ _ (hU 1))))
      (hcc _ (hcpTh _ (hcpTh _ (hU 1)))) (hcc _ (hcpTh _ (hU 0))) (hcc _ (hU 1))
      (hcc _ (hcpTh _ hP))
    have L1' : thA (fun θ => crRow1 U P (w.1, θ, w.2.1, w.2.2)) =
        crAv (cpS (U 1)) w + crAv (cpR (fun η => U 0 η * U 1 η)) w
          + 2 * crAv (fun η => U 0 η * U 1 η) w / w.1 + crAv (cpZ (fun η => U 2 η * U 1 η)) w
          + crAv (cpTh (fun η => U 1 η * U 1 η)) w / w.1
          - (crAv (cpR (cpR (U 1))) w + crAv (cpR (U 1)) w / w.1 + crAv (cpZ (cpZ (U 1))) w
            + (crAv (cpTh (cpTh (U 1))) w + 2 * crAv (cpTh (U 0)) w - crAv (U 1) w) / w.1 ^ 2)
          + crAv (cpTh P) w / w.1 := L1
    have f1 := (hT _ (hU 1) w hw).symm
    have f2 := (hR _ (hUab 0 1) w hw).symm
    have f4 := (hZ _ (hUab 2 1) w hw).symm
    have f5 := hzero _ (hUab 1 1) (hUabp 1 1)
    have f6 := h2R _ (hU 1)
    have f7 := (hR _ (hU 1) w hw).symm
    have f8 := h2Z _ (hU 1)
    have f9 := hzero _ (hcpTh _ (hU 1)) (hper _ (hUper 1))
    have f10 := hzero _ (hU 0) (hUper 0)
    have f12 := hzero _ hP hPper
    simp only [wLap]
    linear_combination L1' + f1 + f2 + f4 + f5 / w.1 - f6 - f7 / w.1 - f8 - f9 / w.1 ^ 2
      - 2 * f10 / w.1 ^ 2 + f12 / w.1
  · 
    have L2 := lin2 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ w.1
      (hcc _ (hcpS _ (hU 2))) (hcc _ (hcpR _ (hUab 0 2))) (hcc _ (hUab 0 2))
      (hcc _ (hcpZ _ (hUab 2 2))) (hcc _ (hcpTh _ (hUab 1 2)))
      (hcc _ (hcpR _ (hcpR _ (hU 2)))) (hcc _ (hcpR _ (hU 2))) (hcc _ (hcpZ _ (hcpZ _ (hU 2))))
      (hcc _ (hcpTh _ (hcpTh _ (hU 2)))) (hcc _ (hcpZ _ hP))
    have L2' : thA (fun θ => crRow2 U P (w.1, θ, w.2.1, w.2.2)) =
        crAv (cpS (U 2)) w + crAv (cpR (fun η => U 0 η * U 2 η)) w
          + crAv (fun η => U 0 η * U 2 η) w / w.1 + crAv (cpZ (fun η => U 2 η * U 2 η)) w
          + crAv (cpTh (fun η => U 1 η * U 2 η)) w / w.1
          - (crAv (cpR (cpR (U 2))) w + crAv (cpR (U 2)) w / w.1 + crAv (cpZ (cpZ (U 2))) w
            + crAv (cpTh (cpTh (U 2))) w / w.1 ^ 2)
          + crAv (cpZ P) w := L2
    have f1 := (hT _ (hU 2) w hw).symm
    have f2 := (hR _ (hUab 0 2) w hw).symm
    have f4 := (hZ _ (hUab 2 2) w hw).symm
    have f5 := hzero _ (hUab 1 2) (hUabp 1 2)
    have f6 := h2R _ (hU 2)
    have f7 := (hR _ (hU 2) w hw).symm
    have f8 := h2Z _ (hU 2)
    have f9 := hzero _ (hcpTh _ (hU 2)) (hper _ (hUper 2))
    have f10 := (hZ _ hP w hw).symm
    simp only [wLap]
    linear_combination L2' + f1 + f2 + f4 + f5 / w.1 - f6 - f7 / w.1 - f8 - f9 / w.1 ^ 2 + f10

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (h : ℝ) (Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (F₁ F₂ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (G : Cyl → ℝ) (W : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))
    (U : Set Cyl) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), IsOpen W → w ∈ W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F₁ W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F₂ W →
    IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G U → 0 < w.1 → mriPath h Y₀ w ∈ U →
    (∀ w' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, mriPath h Y₀ w' ∈ U → F₁ w' - F₂ w' = G (mriPath h Y₀ w')) →
    F₁ w - F₂ w = G (mriPath h Y₀ w) ∧ wDr F₁ w - wDr F₂ w = dR h G (mriPath h Y₀ w) ∧
    wDz F₁ w - wDz F₂ w = dZ G (mriPath h Y₀ w) ∧ wDt F₁ w - wDt F₂ w = dT G (mriPath h Y₀ w) ∧
    wLap F₁ w - wLap F₂ w = lap0 h G (mriPath h Y₀ w)

∀ (h : ℝ) (Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (F₁ F₂ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (G : Cyl → ℝ) (W : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))
    (U : Set Cyl) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), IsOpen W → w ∈ W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F₁ W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F₂ W →
