    F₁ w - F₂ w = G (mriPath h Y₀ w) ∧ wDr F₁ w - wDr F₂ w = dR h G (mriPath h Y₀ w) ∧
    wDz F₁ w - wDz F₂ w = dZ G (mriPath h Y₀ w) ∧ wDt F₁ w - wDt F₂ w = dT G (mriPath h Y₀ w) ∧
    wLap F₁ w - wLap F₂ w = lap0 h G (mriPath h Y₀ w)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Y₀ F₁ F₂ G W U w hW hwW hF₁ hF₂ hU hG hw hwU hEq
  
  have hγ : ∀ x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, 0 < x.1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ (mriPath h Y₀) x ∧
      fderiv ℝ (mriPath h Y₀) x (1, 0, 0) =
        ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (drx h * x.1 ^ (drx h - 1)) • vrv) ∧
      fderiv ℝ (mriPath h Y₀) x (0, 1, 0) = ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) ∧
      fderiv ℝ (mriPath h Y₀) x (0, 0, 1) = ((0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ), vtv) := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := (Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (x := x.1) (p := drx h) (Or.inl hx.ne')).comp_hasFDerivAt x
      (hasFDerivAt_fst (𝕜 := ℝ) (p := x))
    have h2 := h1.smul_const vrv
    have h3 := (hasFDerivAt_snd (𝕜 := ℝ) (p := x)).snd
    have h4 := h3.smul_const vtv
    have h5 := (h2.add h4).add_const Y₀
    have h6 := (hasFDerivAt_snd (𝕜 := ℝ) (p := x)).fst
    have h7 := (hasFDerivAt_fst (𝕜 := ℝ) (p := x)).prodMk (h6.prodMk (h3.prodMk h5))
    have h8 : HasFDerivAt (mriPath h Y₀) _ x := h7
    refine ⟨h8.differentiableAt, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rw [h8.fderiv] <;> simp
  
  have chain : ∀ (K : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (H : Cyl → ℝ) (x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), 0 < x.1 →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ H (mriPath h Y₀ x) → K =ᶠ[nhds x] (fun y => H (mriPath h Y₀ y)) →
      wDr K x = dR h H (mriPath h Y₀ x) ∧ wDz K x = dZ H (mriPath h Y₀ x) ∧
        wDt K x = dT H (mriPath h Y₀ x) := by
    intro K H x hx hH hK
    obtain ⟨hd, e1, e2, e3⟩ := hγ x hx
    have hf : fderiv ℝ K x = (fderiv ℝ H (mriPath h Y₀ x)).comp (fderiv ℝ (mriPath h Y₀) x) := by
      rw [hK.fderiv_eq]
      exact fderiv_comp x hH hd
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show fderiv ℝ K x (1, 0, 0) =
        fderiv ℝ H (mriPath h Y₀ x) (1, 0, 0, (drx h * x.1 ^ (drx h - 1)) • vrv)
      rw [hf, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, e1]
    · show fderiv ℝ K x (0, 1, 0) = fderiv ℝ H (mriPath h Y₀ x) (0, 1, 0, 0)
      rw [hf, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, e2]
    · show fderiv ℝ K x (0, 0, 1) = fderiv ℝ H (mriPath h Y₀ x) (0, 0, 1, vtv)
      rw [hf, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, e3]
  
  have hdF : ∀ (F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W → ∀ x ∈ W,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F x ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (wDr F) x ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (wDz F) x := by
    intro F hF x hx
    have hF' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) W := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hW).1 hF).2
    have hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) W :=
      hF'.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) W :=
      hF'.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact ⟨(hF.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp),
      (hr.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp),
      (hz.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)⟩
  
  have hPo : IsOpen (W ∩ {x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < x.1}) :=
    hW.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst)
  have hγc : ContinuousOn (mriPath h Y₀) (W ∩ {x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < x.1}) :=
    fun x hx => ((hγ x hx.2).1.continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), D = (W ∩ {x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < x.1}) ∩ mriPath h Y₀ ⁻¹' U :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hDo : IsOpen D := by rw [hD]; exact hγc.isOpen_inter_preimage hPo hU
  
  have first : ∀ x ∈ D, wDr F₁ x - wDr F₂ x = dR h G (mriPath h Y₀ x) ∧
      wDz F₁ x - wDz F₂ x = dZ G (mriPath h Y₀ x) ∧ wDt F₁ x - wDt F₂ x = dT G (mriPath h Y₀ x) := by
    intro x hx
    have hxD := hx
    rw [hD] at hx
    obtain ⟨⟨hxW, hx0⟩, hxU⟩ := hx
    have hK : (fun y => F₁ y - F₂ y) =ᶠ[nhds x] (fun y => G (mriPath h Y₀ y)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hDo.mem_nhds hxD) (fun y hy => by
        rw [hD] at hy
        exact hEq y hy.2)
    have hGd : DifferentiableAt ℝ G (mriPath h Y₀ x) :=
      (hG.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hxU)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := chain _ G x hx0 hGd hK
    have hs : fderiv ℝ (fun y => F₁ y - F₂ y) x = fderiv ℝ F₁ x - fderiv ℝ F₂ x :=
      fderiv_fun_sub (hdF F₁ hF₁ x hxW).1 (hdF F₂ hF₂ x hxW).1
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← c1]
      show fderiv ℝ F₁ x (1, 0, 0) - fderiv ℝ F₂ x (1, 0, 0) =
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => F₁ y - F₂ y) x (1, 0, 0)
      rw [hs, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
    · rw [← c2]
      show fderiv ℝ F₁ x (0, 1, 0) - fderiv ℝ F₂ x (0, 1, 0) =
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => F₁ y - F₂ y) x (0, 1, 0)
      rw [hs, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
    · rw [← c3]
      show fderiv ℝ F₁ x (0, 0, 1) - fderiv ℝ F₂ x (0, 0, 1) =
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => F₁ y - F₂ y) x (0, 0, 1)
      rw [hs, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
  have hwD : w ∈ D := by rw [hD]; exact ⟨⟨hwW, hw⟩, hwU⟩
  have hDn : D ∈ nhds w := hDo.mem_nhds hwD
  
  have hG' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ G) U := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hG).2
  have hγwpos : 0 < (mriPath h Y₀ w).1 := hw
  have hdRd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (dR h G) (mriPath h Y₀ w) := by
    have hm : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => drx h * η.1 ^ (drx h - 1)) (mriPath h Y₀ w) :=
      contDiffAt_const.mul (contDiffAt_fst.rpow_const_of_ne hγwpos.ne')
    have hs : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (drx h * η.1 ^ (drx h - 1)) • vrv) (mriPath h Y₀ w) :=
      hm.smul contDiffAt_const
    have hdir : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (fun η : Cyl => ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (drx h * η.1 ^ (drx h - 1)) • vrv))
        (mriPath h Y₀ w) :=
      contDiffAt_const.prodMk (contDiffAt_const.prodMk (contDiffAt_const.prodMk hs))
    have := (hG'.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hwU)).clm_apply hdir
    exact this.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hdZd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (dZ G) (mriPath h Y₀ w) := by
    have := (hG'.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hwU)).clm_apply
      (contDiffAt_const (c := ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ))))
    exact this.differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have hKr : (fun y => wDr F₁ y - wDr F₂ y) =ᶠ[nhds w] (fun y => dR h G (mriPath h Y₀ y)) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hDn (fun y hy => (first y hy).1)
  have hKz : (fun y => wDz F₁ y - wDz F₂ y) =ᶠ[nhds w] (fun y => dZ G (mriPath h Y₀ y)) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hDn (fun y hy => (first y hy).2.1)
  have R2 := (chain _ (dR h G) w hw hdRd hKr).1
  have Z2 := (chain _ (dZ G) w hw hdZd hKz).2.1
  have hsr : fderiv ℝ (fun y => wDr F₁ y - wDr F₂ y) w = fderiv ℝ (wDr F₁) w - fderiv ℝ (wDr F₂) w :=
    fderiv_fun_sub (hdF F₁ hF₁ w hwW).2.1 (hdF F₂ hF₂ w hwW).2.1
  have hsz : fderiv ℝ (fun y => wDz F₁ y - wDz F₂ y) w = fderiv ℝ (wDz F₁) w - fderiv ℝ (wDz F₂) w :=
    fderiv_fun_sub (hdF F₁ hF₁ w hwW).2.2 (hdF F₂ hF₂ w hwW).2.2
  have R2' : wDr (wDr F₁) w - wDr (wDr F₂) w = dR h (dR h G) (mriPath h Y₀ w) := by
    rw [← R2]
    show fderiv ℝ (wDr F₁) w (1, 0, 0) - fderiv ℝ (wDr F₂) w (1, 0, 0) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => wDr F₁ y - wDr F₂ y) w (1, 0, 0)
    rw [hsr, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
  have Z2' : wDz (wDz F₁) w - wDz (wDz F₂) w = dZ (dZ G) (mriPath h Y₀ w) := by
    rw [← Z2]
    show fderiv ℝ (wDz F₁) w (0, 1, 0) - fderiv ℝ (wDz F₂) w (0, 1, 0) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => wDz F₁ y - wDz F₂ y) w (0, 1, 0)
    rw [hsz, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
  
  obtain ⟨E1, E2, E3⟩ := first w hwD
  refine ⟨hEq w hwU, E1, E2, E3, ?_⟩
  have e : (mriPath h Y₀ w).1 = w.1 := rfl
  show (wDr (wDr F₁) w + wDr F₁ w / w.1 + wDz (wDz F₁) w) -
      (wDr (wDr F₂) w + wDr F₂ w / w.1 + wDz (wDz F₂) w) =
    dR h (dR h G) (mriPath h Y₀ w) + dR h G (mriPath h Y₀ w) / (mriPath h Y₀ w).1 +
      dZ (dZ G) (mriPath h Y₀ w)
  rw [e]
  linear_combination R2' + E1 / w.1 + Z2'

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →
    InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 (primState5 B G).Aw → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 (primState5 B G).pw →
    (∀ (a : Fin 3), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), mcor5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) a ξ = 0) →
    ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t →
      resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) (PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) x t Y -
        thAvgVec (resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) (PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G))) x t Y =
      pwrFB B x t Y + (pwrLin B G l0 x t Y - thAvgVec (pwrLin B G l0) x t Y)
        + (pwrQ B G l0 x t Y - thAvgVec (pwrQ B G l0) x t Y)

signature.name: pwr5_split_identity
signature.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →
    InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 (primState5 B G).Aw → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 (primState5 B G).pw →
    (∀ (a : Fin 3), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), mcor5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) a ξ = 0) →
    ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t →
      resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) (PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) x t Y -
        thAvgVec (resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) (PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G))) x t Y =
      pwrFB B x t Y + (pwrLin B G l0 x t Y - thAvgVec (pwrLin B G l0) x t Y)
        + (pwrQ B G l0 x t Y - thAvgVec (pwrQ B G l0) x t Y)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨a1, h1⟩ := pws_fields_smooth B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨a2, h2⟩ := pws_prim_grP_regular B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, hqB1, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n0 + a1 + a2, fun l0 hl0 hAw hpw hm0 => ?_⟩
  intro x t Y hxt
  have hxt' : 0 < rad x ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hxt
  
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqs0 : 0 < qsOf l0 := by rw [hQb]; positivity
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0.le
  have hq1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := le_trans hqsB hqB1
  
  have hF := h1 l0 (by omega) hAw hpw
  obtain ⟨hgr, hsh⟩ := h2 l0 (by omega) hAw hm0
  have hpm : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), DifferentiableAt ℝ (pmP5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) ξ :=
    pws_icut_diff B (qsOf l0) _ hok hqs0 hq1 hgr hsh
  have hsplit := pws_pointwise_split B G l0 hok hqsB (fun Y₀ => (hF Y₀).1) (fun Y₀ => (hF Y₀).2.1)
    (fun Y₀ => (hF Y₀).2.2.1) hpm
  
  have hr0 : 0 < rad x := hxt'.1
  have hrot : ∀ θ : ℝ, rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) = rad x ∧ (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 2 = x 2 := by
    intro θ
    have e0 : (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 0 = rad x * Real.cos θ := by simp [rotPt]
    have e1 : (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 1 = rad x * Real.sin θ := by simp [rotPt]
    have e2 : (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 2 = x 2 := by simp [rotPt]
    refine ⟨?_, e2⟩
    have hsq : (rad x * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (rad x * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = rad x ^ 2 := by
      have hcs := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
      calc (rad x * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (rad x * Real.sin θ) ^ 2
          = rad x ^ 2 * (Real.cos θ ^ 2 + Real.sin θ ^ 2) := by ring
        _ = rad x ^ 2 := by rw [hcs, mul_one]
    rw [show rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) =
        Real.sqrt ((rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 1 ^ 2) from rfl, e0, e1, hsq,
      Real.sqrt_sq hr0.le]
  have hcirc : ∀ θ : ℝ, corrOn B l0 (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t := by
    intro θ
    obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hrot θ
    show 0 < rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ((rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact hxt'
  
  obtain ⟨FS, hFSv⟩ : ∃ F : Ext ℝ³, ∀ y s Y0, F y s Y0 = stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz y s :=
    ⟨fun y s _ => stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz y s, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨FG, hFGv⟩ : ∃ F : Ext ℝ³, ∀ y s Y0, F y s Y0 =
      gradient (fun w => PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) w s (Yph B.h (rad w) s + (Y0 - Yph B.h (rad y) s))
        - B.PB w s - pwrP5 B G l0 w s (Yph B.h (rad w) s + (Y0 - Yph B.h (rad y) s))) y :=
    ⟨fun y s Y0 => gradient (fun w => PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) w s
        (Yph B.h (rad w) s + (Y0 - Yph B.h (rad y) s))
        - B.PB w s - pwrP5 B G l0 w s (Yph B.h (rad w) s + (Y0 - Yph B.h (rad y) s))) y,
      fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hR : ∀ y, corrOn B l0 y t →
      resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) (PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) y t Y =
        pwrE B y t Y + FS y t Y + pwrLin B G l0 y t Y + pwrQ B G l0 y t Y + FG y t Y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hFSv, hFGv]
    exact hsplit y t Y hy
  obtain ⟨c1, c2, hst⟩ := pws_stress_frame B.h B.Tth B.Tz (rad x) (x 2) t hr0
  obtain ⟨d0, d2, hgf⟩ := pws_pm_grad_frame B G l0 hok hpm x t Y hxt
  obtain ⟨hFSavg, hFSint⟩ := pws_frame_avg FS x t Y 0 c1 c2 hr0 (fun θ => by
    obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hrot θ
    rw [hFSv, hst _ e1 e2, zero_smul, zero_add])
  obtain ⟨hFGavg, hFGint⟩ := pws_frame_avg FG x t Y d0 0 d2 hr0 (fun θ => by
    obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hrot θ
    rw [hFGv, hgf _ e1 e2, zero_smul, add_zero])
  
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hmriE⟩ := bg_flow_props B hok
  have hEc : ContinuousOn (fun y => pwrE B y t Y) {y : ℝ³ | (y, t) ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB} := by
    have := hmriE.continuousOn.comp (f := fun y : ℝ³ => (y, t))
      (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn (fun y hy => hy)
    exact this
  have hEint := pws_circle_integrable (pwrE B) x t Y {y : ℝ³ | (y, t) ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB} hr0 hEc
    (fun θ => by
      obtain ⟨-, e2⟩ := hrot θ
      show t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ((rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 2) (1 - t) < B.qB
      rw [e2]
      exact ⟨hxt'.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hxt'.2.2 hqsB⟩)
  have hoff : ∀ θ : ℝ, Yph B.h (rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) = Y := by
    intro θ
    rw [(hrot θ).1]
    abel
  have hLint0 := pws_circle_integrable (fun y s _ => evOff B.h (pwrLin B G l0) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y s)
    x t Y {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t} hr0 ((hF (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)).2.2.2.1 t) hcirc
  have hQint0 := pws_circle_integrable (fun y s _ => evOff B.h (pwrQ B G l0) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y s)
    x t Y {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t} hr0 ((hF (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)).2.2.2.2 t) hcirc
  have hLint : ∀ a : Fin 3, IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => inner ℝ (pwrLin B G l0 (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y)
      (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro a
    have e : (fun θ => inner ℝ (pwrLin B G l0 (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) =
        (fun θ => inner ℝ ((fun y s _ => evOff B.h (pwrLin B G l0) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y s)
          (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) := by
      funext θ
      simp only [evOff, hoff θ]
    rw [e]
    exact hLint0 a
  have hQint : ∀ a : Fin 3, IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => inner ℝ (pwrQ B G l0 (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y)
      (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro a
    have e : (fun θ => inner ℝ (pwrQ B G l0 (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) =
        (fun θ => inner ℝ ((fun y s _ => evOff B.h (pwrQ B G l0) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y s)
          (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) := by
      funext θ
      simp only [evOff, hoff θ]
    rw [e]
    exact hQint0 a
  
  have hsum := pws_avg_add5 (resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) (PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)))
    (pwrE B) FS (pwrLin B G l0) (pwrQ B G l0) FG x t Y (fun θ => hR _ (hcirc θ))
    hEint hFSint hLint hQint hFGint
  have hFSx : thAvgVec FS x t Y = FS x t Y := by
    rw [hFSavg, hFSv, hst x rfl rfl]
    simp
  have hFGx : thAvgVec FG x t Y = FG x t Y := by
    rw [hFGavg, hFGv, hgf x rfl rfl]
    simp
  rw [hsum, hR x hxt, hFSx, hFGx]
  rw [show pwrFB B x t Y = pwrE B x t Y - thAvgVec (pwrE B) x t Y from rfl]

    have hqH : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2))
        {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.comp hψ.contDiffOn (fun w hw =>
        ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 by linarith [show w.2 < 1 from hw]⟩)
    have hHo : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
    have hDo : IsOpen (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      have e : simDomain B.h B.qB = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
          (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ⁻¹' Iio B.qB := Set.ext fun _ => Iff.rfl
      rw [e]
      exact hqH.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hHo isOpen_Iio
    have hqD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2))
        (simDomain B.h B.qB) := hqH.mono (fun w hw => hw.1)
    have hqpos : ∀ w ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB, 0 < simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) := fun w hw =>
      (hS.1 (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) (by linarith [hw.1])).1
    have hqbd : ∀ w ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB,
        (w.1 2) ^ 2 < simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1 - 2 * B.h) := fun w hw =>
      (hS.2.1 (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) (by linarith [hw.1])).2
    have heta : ∀ w ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB, -1 < simEta B.h w.1 w.2 ∧ simEta B.h w.1 w.2 < 1 := by
      intro w hw
      have hq := hqpos w hw
      have hz := hqbd w hw
      have hp : 0 < simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1 - 2 * B.h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _
      have ha : (simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))) ^ 2 =
          (simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1 - 2 * B.h))⁻¹ := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hq.le, ← Real.rpow_neg hq.le]
        congr 1; push_cast; ring
      have hsq : (simEta B.h w.1 w.2) ^ 2 < 1 := by
        show (w.1 2 * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))) ^ 2 < 1
        rw [mul_pow, ha, ← div_eq_mul_inv, div_lt_one hp]
        exact hz
      exact abs_lt.1 ((sq_lt_one_iff_abs_lt_one _).1 hsq)
    have huB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(uB B)) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      let ev : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ((ℝ³ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³) →L[ℝ] ℝ := fun a b =>
        (EuclideanSpace.proj b).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ³ ((EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ) : ℝ³), (0:ℝ)))
      let L : ((ℝ³ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³) →L[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
        (ev 1 2 - ev 2 1).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) +
        (ev 2 0 - ev 0 2).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) +
        (ev 0 1 - ev 1 0).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))
      have hLapp : ∀ Φ : (ℝ³ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³, L Φ =
          (Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1, 0) 2 - Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1, 0) 1) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
            (Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1, 0) 0 - Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, 0) 2) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
            (Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, 0) 1 - Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1, 0) 0) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) := by
        intro Φ
        rfl
      have hslice : ∀ z ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB, ∀ v : ℝ³,
          fderiv ℝ (fun w => B.AB w z.2) z.1 v = fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (v, 0) := by
        intro z hz v
        have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿B.AB) z :=
          (hAB.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
        have hd' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿B.AB) (z.1, z.2) := hd
        have he : (fun w => B.AB w z.2) = (↿B.AB) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ => (w, z.2)) := rfl
        rw [he, fderiv_comp z.1 hd' (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left z.1 z.2).differentiableAt,
          (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left z.1 z.2).fderiv]
        rfl
      have hE : ∀ z ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB, (↿(uB B)) z = L (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z) + (↿B.BvB) z := by
        intro z hz
        show curl3 (fun w => B.AB w z.2) z.1 + B.BvB z.1 z.2 = L (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z) + B.BvB z.1 z.2
        rw [hLapp]
        simp only [curl3, hslice z hz]
      have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB)) (simDomain B.h B.qB) :=
        hAB.fderiv_of_isOpen hDo (by simp)
      exact ((hfd.continuousLinearMap_comp L).add hBvB).congr hE
    have hVo : IsOpen (Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) :=
      isOpen_Iio.prod (isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo)
    have hder : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift f) (Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) →
        ∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q →
        ((Real.log q, X, η) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) →
        deriv (fun Y => f q Y η) X =
          fderiv ℝ (logLift f) (Real.log q, X, η) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) := by
      intro f hf q X η hq hm
      have hcv : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => ((Real.log q, Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) X :=
        (hasDerivAt_const X (Real.log q)).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_id X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X η))
      have hF : HasFDerivAt (logLift f) (fderiv ℝ (logLift f) (Real.log q, X, η)) (Real.log q, X, η) :=
        ((hf.contDiffAt (hVo.mem_nhds hm)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
      have h2 := hF.comp_hasDerivAt X hcv
      have he : (logLift f ∘ fun Y : ℝ => ((Real.log q, Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) = fun Y => f q Y η := by
        funext Y
        simp [Function.comp, logLift, Real.exp_log hq]
      rw [he] at h2
      exact h2.deriv
    have hoff : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz))
        (simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2}) := by
      have hQ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2))
          (simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2}) := hqD.mono inter_subset_left
      have hQne : ∀ w ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2},
          simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≠ 0 := fun w hw => (hqpos w hw.1).ne'
      have hXpos : ∀ w ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2},
          0 < simX B.h w.1 w.2 := fun w hw => div_pos hw.2 (mul_pos two_pos (hqpos w hw.1))
      have hX : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simX B.h w.1 w.2)
          (simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2}) := by
        have : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
            (w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2) / (2 * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)))
            (simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2}) :=
          hR.contDiffOn.div (contDiffOn_const.mul hQ) (fun w hw => (mul_pos two_pos (hqpos w hw.1)).ne')
        exact this
      have h2X : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => 2 * simX B.h w.1 w.2)
          (simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2}) := contDiffOn_const.mul hX
      have hE : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simEta B.h w.1 w.2)
          (simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2}) := by
        have : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
            w.1 2 * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)))
            (simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2}) :=
          (hc 2).contDiffOn.mul (hQ.rpow_const_of_ne hQne)
        exact this
      have hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((Real.log (simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)),
          simX B.h w.1 w.2, simEta B.h w.1 w.2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))
          (simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2}) :=
        (hQ.log hQne).prodMk (hX.prodMk hE)
      have hmaps : MapsTo (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((Real.log (simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)),
          simX B.h w.1 w.2, simEta B.h w.1 w.2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))
          (simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2})
          (Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) := fun w hw =>
        ⟨Real.log_lt_log (hqpos w hw.1) hw.1.2, hXpos w hw, heta w hw.1⟩
      have hL : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
          ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift f) (Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) →
          ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => logLift f (Real.log (simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)),
            simX B.h w.1 w.2, simEta B.h w.1 w.2))
            (simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2}) ∧
          ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => fderiv ℝ (logLift f)
            (Real.log (simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)), simX B.h w.1 w.2, simEta B.h w.1 w.2)
            ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))
            (simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2}) := fun f hf =>
        ⟨hf.comp hΦ hmaps,
          ((((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hVo).1 hf).2).comp hΦ hmaps).clm_apply
            contDiffOn_const⟩
      have haz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => azVec w.1) := by
        have : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => -(w.1 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
            w.1 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) :=
          ((hc 1).neg.smul contDiff_const).add ((hc 0).smul contDiff_const)
        exact this
      obtain ⟨hT1, hT2⟩ := hL B.Tth hTth
      obtain ⟨hZ1, hZ2⟩ := hL B.Tz hTz
      have hXne : ∀ w ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2},
          simX B.h w.1 w.2 ≠ 0 := fun w hw => (hXpos w hw).ne'
      have h2Xne : ∀ w ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2},
          2 * simX B.h w.1 w.2 ≠ 0 := fun w hw => (mul_pos two_pos (hXpos w hw)).ne'
      have ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => -(simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(2 + B.h)) *
          (fderiv ℝ (logLift B.Tth)
            (Real.log (simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)), simX B.h w.1 w.2, simEta B.h w.1 w.2)
            ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) +
           logLift B.Tth (Real.log (simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)), simX B.h w.1 w.2,
            simEta B.h w.1 w.2) / simX B.h w.1 w.2)))
          (simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2}) :=
        ((hQ.rpow_const_of_ne hQne).mul (hT2.add (hT1.div hX hXne))).neg
      have hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => -(Real.sqrt (2 * simX B.h w.1 w.2) *
          simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(3 / 2 + B.h)) *
          (fderiv ℝ (logLift B.Tz)
            (Real.log (simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)), simX B.h w.1 w.2, simEta B.h w.1 w.2)
            ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) +
           logLift B.Tz (Real.log (simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)), simX B.h w.1 w.2,
            simEta B.h w.1 w.2) / (2 * simX B.h w.1 w.2))))
          (simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2}) :=
        (((h2X.sqrt h2Xne).mul (hQ.rpow_const_of_ne hQne)).mul (hZ2.add (hZ1.div h2X h2Xne))).neg
      have hG := (ha.smul haz.contDiffOn).add
        (hb.smul (contDiffOn_const (c := EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))))
      refine hG.congr ?_
      rintro ⟨x, t⟩ hw
      have hq : 0 < simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) := hqpos _ hw.1
      have hm : ((Real.log (simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t)), simX B.h x t, simEta B.h x t) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈
          Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := hmaps hw
      have hd1 := hder B.Tth hTth (simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t)) (simX B.h x t) (simEta B.h x t) hq hm
      have hd2 := hder B.Tz hTz (simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t)) (simX B.h x t) (simEta B.h x t) hq hm
      have hv1 : B.Tth (simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t)) (simX B.h x t) (simEta B.h x t) =
          logLift B.Tth (Real.log (simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t)), simX B.h x t, simEta B.h x t) := by
        simp only [logLift, Real.exp_log hq]
      have hv2 : B.Tz (simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t)) (simX B.h x t) (simEta B.h x t) =
          logLift B.Tz (Real.log (simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t)), simX B.h x t, simEta B.h x t) := by
        simp only [logLift, Real.exp_log hq]
      show stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz x t = _
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply', stressDivField, hd1, hd2, hv1, hv2]
    have hU2o : IsOpen (simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
        2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) - (w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2)) ⁻¹' Ioi 0) :=
      ((contDiffOn_const.mul hqD).sub hR.contDiffOn).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hDo isOpen_Ioi
    have hnear : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz))
        (simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ (simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
          2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) - (w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2)) ⁻¹' Ioi 0)) := by
      refine (contDiffOn_const (c := (0:ℝ³))).congr ?_
      rintro ⟨x, t⟩ ⟨hD, -, hk⟩
      have hq : 0 < simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) := hqpos _ hD
      have hk' : 0 < 2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) - (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) := hk
      have hX : simX B.h x t < B.Xa := by
        show (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) / (2 * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t)) < B.Xa
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ (mul_pos two_pos hq)]
        nlinarith
      have hz : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ q X η : ℝ, X ≤ B.Xa → f q X η = 0) →
          deriv (fun Y => f (simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t)) Y (simEta B.h x t)) (simX B.h x t) = 0 ∧
          f (simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t)) (simX B.h x t) (simEta B.h x t) = 0 := by
        intro f hf
        refine ⟨?_, hf _ _ _ hX.le⟩
        have hev : (fun Y => f (simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t)) Y (simEta B.h x t)) =ᶠ[nhds (simX B.h x t)]
            fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (isOpen_Iio.mem_nhds hX) (fun Y hY => hf _ _ _ (le_of_lt hY))
        rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
      obtain ⟨hd1, hv1⟩ := hz B.Tth (fun q X η h => (hvan q X η (Or.inl h)).1)
      obtain ⟨hd2, hv2⟩ := hz B.Tz (fun q X η h => (hvan q X η (Or.inl h)).2)
      show stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz x t = 0
      simp only [stressDivField, hd1, hv1, hd2, hv2, zero_div, add_zero, mul_zero, neg_zero, zero_smul]
    have hSD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz)) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
      intro w hw
      by_cases hr : 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2
      · exact ⟨{w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2}, isOpen_lt continuous_const hR.continuous,
          hr, hoff⟩
      · refine ⟨simDomain B.h B.qB ∩ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
          2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) - (w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2)) ⁻¹' Ioi 0,
          hU2o, ⟨hw, ?_⟩, hnear⟩
        have h0 : w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.1 hr) (by positivity)
        show 0 < 2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) - (w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2)
        rw [h0, sub_zero]
        exact mul_pos (mul_pos two_pos hXa) (hqpos w hw)
    have hNS := hjet 1 (uB B) B.PB _ hDo huB hPB
    exact (hNS.sub hSD).congr (fun z _ => rfl)
  have hE : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(mriE B)) U := hbgE.mono hUB
  have hflat : ∀ m N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ U →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(mriE B)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (N : ℝ) := by
    intro m N
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hflatB m N
    exact ⟨C, fun x t hxt => hC x t (hUB hxt)⟩
  obtain ⟨hAs, hAf⟩ := pkg (mriE B) hE hflat
  
  have hK : ∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, (↿(evOff B.h (pwrFB B) Y₀)) =
      (↿(mriE B)) - (↿(fun y s => thAvgVec (fun x' t' (_ : ℝ × ℝ) => mriE B x' t') y s 0)) := by
    intro Y₀
    funext z
    rfl
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro m N
    obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hflat m N
    obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := hAf m N
    refine ⟨C1 + C2, fun Y₀ x t hxt => ?_⟩
    rw [hK Y₀]
    have hmem : U ∈ nhds (x, t) := hUo.mem_nhds hxt
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply ((hE.contDiffAt hmem).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      ((hAs.contDiffAt hmem).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
    calc _ ≤ _ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ C1 * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (N : ℝ) + C2 * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (N : ℝ) :=
          add_le_add (hC1 x t hxt) (hC2 x t hxt)
      _ = (C1 + C2) * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (N : ℝ) := by ring
  · intro Y₀
    rw [hK Y₀]
    exact (hE.sub hAs).mono (fun z hz => ⟨hz.2.1, hz.2.2⟩)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨a1, h1⟩ := plin5_mode_rep B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨a4, h4⟩ := plin5_principal_support B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨a5, h5⟩ := plin5_remainder_class B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨a6, h6⟩ := plin5_tail_flat B G hok hG
  refine ⟨a1 + a4 + a5 + a6, fun l0 hl0 hW0 htr hAw hpw hvel hdiff => ?_⟩
  have hsupp := h4 l0 (by omega) hW0 htr
  have hg := h5 l0 (by omega) hW0 htr hAw hpw hvel hdiff
  have hFl := h6 l0 (by omega) hW0 hpw hsupp
  have hrep := h1 l0 (by omega) hAw hpw
  have hgc := hg
  obtain ⟨⟨Hg, hHg0, hHg⟩, -, -, hSg, -⟩ := hgc
  
  have hfin : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∃ (Γ : Finset Lab) (H : Finset ℤ), (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧
      ∀ γ m, (γ ∉ Γ ∨ m ∉ H) → (linC5 B G - princC5 B G) γ m ξ = 0 ∧ princC5 B G γ m ξ = 0 ∧
        linC5 B G γ m ξ = 0 := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
    obtain ⟨N, hN, Γ, hΓ⟩ := etaL_local_finite_v5 B.h hok.1 ξ hξ'.2.1
    have hS : ∀ γ, SuppW B G γ ξ → γ ∈ Γ := by
      intro γ hs
      obtain ⟨-, hts, -⟩ := hs
      exact hΓ γ ξ (mem_of_mem_nhds hN) hts
    refine ⟨Γ, insert 1 (insert (-1) Hg), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hmem
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hmem with h | hmem
      · norm_num at h
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hmem with h | h
      · norm_num at h
      · exact hHg0 h
    · intro γ m hγm
      have hgz : (linC5 B G - princC5 B G) γ m ξ = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        have hs := hSg γ m ξ hξ hne
        rcases hγm with hγ | hm
        · exact hγ (hS γ hs)
        · have hm' : m ∉ Hg := fun h => hm (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem h))
          exact hne (by rw [hHg γ m hm']; rfl)
      have hpz : princC5 B G γ m ξ = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        obtain ⟨hm1, hs, -⟩ := hsupp γ m ξ hξ hne
        rcases hγm with hγ | hm
        · exact hγ (hS γ hs)
        · apply hm
          rcases hm1 with rfl | rfl <;> simp
      refine ⟨hgz, hpz, ?_⟩
      have e : linC5 B G γ m ξ = (linC5 B G - princC5 B G) γ m ξ + princC5 B G γ m ξ :=
        (sub_add_cancel (linC5 B G γ m ξ) (princC5 B G γ m ξ)).symm
      rw [e, hgz, hpz, add_zero]
  
  have hsum : ∀ (F : Lab → ℤ → ℂ) (Γ : Finset Lab) (H : Finset ℤ),
      (∀ γ m, (γ ∉ Γ ∨ m ∉ H) → F γ m = 0) →
      ∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, F γ m = ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, F γ m := by
    intro F Γ H hF
    have hin : ∀ γ, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, F γ m = ∑ m ∈ H, F γ m := by
      intro γ
      apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
      intro m hm
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hm
      by_contra h
      exact hm (hF γ m (Or.inr (by simpa using h)))
    simp_rw [hin]
    apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
    intro γ hγ
    rw [Function.mem_support] at hγ
    by_contra h
    exact hγ (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun m _ => hF γ m (Or.inl (by simpa using h))))
  
  have hadd : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ θ : ℝ, waveV5 B G (linC5 B G) θ ξ =
      waveV5 B G (linC5 B G - princC5 B G) θ ξ + waveV5 B G (princC5 B G) θ ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ θ
    obtain ⟨Γ, H, -, hz⟩ := hfin ξ hξ
    funext i
    have e1 : ∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, linC5 B G γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ =
        ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, linC5 B G γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ :=
      hsum (fun γ m => linC5 B G γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ) Γ H (fun γ m h => by
        show linC5 B G γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ = 0
        rw [(hz γ m h).2.2]; simp)
    have e2 : ∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, (linC5 B G - princC5 B G) γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ =
        ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, (linC5 B G - princC5 B G) γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ :=
      hsum (fun γ m => (linC5 B G - princC5 B G) γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ) Γ H (fun γ m h => by
        show (linC5 B G - princC5 B G) γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ = 0
        rw [(hz γ m h).1]; simp)
    have e3 : ∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, princC5 B G γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ =
        ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, princC5 B G γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ :=
      hsum (fun γ m => princC5 B G γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ) Γ H (fun γ m h => by
        show princC5 B G γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ = 0
        rw [(hz γ m h).2.1]; simp)
    show (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, linC5 B G γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ).re =
      (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, (linC5 B G - princC5 B G) γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ).re +
      (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, princC5 B G γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ).re
    rw [e1, e2, e3, ← Complex.add_re, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
    rw [← add_mul]
    congr 1
    exact (sub_add_cancel (linC5 B G γ m ξ i) (princC5 B G γ m ξ i)).symm
  
  have hrot : ∀ r θ z : ℝ, 0 < r → rad (rotPt r θ z) = r ∧ rotPt r θ z 2 = z := by
    intro r θ z hr
    constructor
    · have h : (rotPt r θ z) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt r θ z) 1 ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
        simp [rotPt]
        rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, ← mul_add, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, mul_one]
      unfold rad
      rw [h, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
    · simp [rotPt]
  have hframe : ∀ (y : ℝ³), 0 < rad y → ∀ (v : Fin 3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
      inner ℝ (cyl2cart y v) (![eR y, eTh y, eZ] a) = v a := by
    intro y hy v a
    have hr2 : rad y ^ 2 = y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
    have hne : rad y ≠ 0 := hy.ne'
    have hs : (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) = 1 := by
      rw [← hr2]; field_simp
    fin_cases a <;>
      simp [cyl2cart, eR, eTh, eZ, radVec, azVec, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three] <;>
      first
      | linear_combination (v 0) * hs
      | linear_combination (v 1) * hs
  have hlin : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), thA (fun θ => c * f θ) = c * thA f := by
    intro c f
    simp only [thA, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    ring
  refine ⟨linC5 B G - princC5 B G, tailF5 B G l0, hg, hFl, ?_⟩
  intro x t Y hxt
  have hxt' : 0 < rad x ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hxt
  have hξ : ptOf x t Y ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := hxt
  have hrx : 0 < rad x := hxt'.1
  
  have hmean : thAvgVec (pwrLin B G l0) x t Y = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨Γ, H, hH0, hz⟩ := hfin _ hξ
    have hcomp : ∀ a : Fin 3, thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (pwrLin B G l0 (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y)
        (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) = 0 := by
      intro a
      have hfun : (fun θ => inner ℝ (pwrLin B G l0 (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y)
          (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) =
          fun θ => qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) *
            waveS5 B G (fun γ m η => linC5 B G γ m η a) (thetaOf (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) (ptOf x t Y) := by
        funext θ
        obtain ⟨hr, hzz⟩ := hrot (rad x) θ (x 2) hrx
        have hc : corrOn B l0 (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t := by
          show 0 < rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) ∧ t < 1 ∧
            simScale B.h ((rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0
          rw [hr, hzz]
          exact hxt'
        have hp : ptOf (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y = ptOf x t Y := by
          show (rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)), (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 2, t, Y) = (rad x, x 2, t, Y)
          rw [hr, hzz]
        rw [hrep _ t Y hc, hp, real_inner_smul_left]
        have hf : frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a =
            ![eR (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)), eTh (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)), eZ] a := rfl
        rw [hf, hframe _ (by rw [hr]; exact hrx)]
        rfl
      have h0 := (waveS5_circle_mean_zero B G (fun γ m η => linC5 B G γ m η a) (ptOf x t Y) (rad x) (x 2)
        H Γ hrx hH0 (fun γ m hm => by simp [(hz γ m (Or.inr hm)).2.2])
        (fun γ m hγ => by simp [(hz γ m (Or.inl hγ)).2.2])).2
      rw [hfun, hlin, h0, mul_zero]
    unfold thAvgVec
    have hzero : (fun a => thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (pwrLin B G l0 (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y)
        (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a))) = fun _ => 0 := funext hcomp
    rw [hzero]
    simp [cyl2cart]
  have htail : tailF5 B G l0 x t Y = qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) •
      cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (princC5 B G) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y)) := if_pos hxt
  have hc : ∀ (u v : Fin 3 → ℝ), cyl2cart x (u + v) = cyl2cart x u + cyl2cart x v := by
    intro u v
    simp only [cyl2cart, Pi.add_apply, add_smul]
    abel
  rw [hmean, sub_zero, hrep x t Y hxt, hadd _ hξ, htail, hc, smul_add]

pwr5_linear_harmonics.definitions:
noncomputable def mcurlC (h : ℝ) (n : ℤ) (C : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℂ :=
  ![Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (ξ.1 : ℂ) * C ξ 2 - dZ (fun η => C η 1) ξ,
    dZ (fun η => C η 0) ξ - dR h (fun η => C η 2) ξ,
    dR h (fun η => C η 1) ξ + C ξ 1 / (ξ.1 : ℂ) - Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (ξ.1 : ℂ) * C ξ 0]

noncomputable def mlapC (h : ℝ) (n : ℤ) (f : Cyl → ℂ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℂ :=
  dR h (dR h f) ξ + dR h f ξ / (ξ.1 : ℂ) + dZ (dZ f) ξ - (n : ℂ) ^ 2 / (ξ.1 : ℂ) ^ 2 * f ξ

noncomputable def mresC (B : BG) (n : ℤ) (a : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (p : Cyl → ℂ) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℂ :=
  let h := B.h
  let r : ℂ := (ξ.1 : ℂ)
  let iN : ℂ := Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / r
  let b : ℂ := ((ubase B ξ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ)
  let V : ℂ := ((ubase B ξ 1 : ℝ) : ℂ)
  let Gz : ℂ := ((ubase B ξ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
  let aR : Fin 3 → ℂ := fun i => dR h (fun η => a η i) ξ
  let aZ : Fin 3 → ℂ := fun i => dZ (fun η => a η i) ξ
  let uR : Fin 3 → ℂ := fun i => ((dR h (fun η => ubase B η i) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ)
  let uZ : Fin 3 → ℂ := fun i => ((dZ (fun η => ubase B η i) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ)
  ![dT (fun η => a η 0) ξ - (mlapC h n (fun η => a η 0) ξ - a ξ 0 / r ^ 2 - 2 * iN * a ξ 1 / r) + dR h p ξ
      + (b * aR 0 + V * (iN * a ξ 0 - a ξ 1 / r) + Gz * aZ 0)
      + (a ξ 0 * uR 0 + a ξ 2 * uZ 0 - V * a ξ 1 / r),
    dT (fun η => a η 1) ξ - (mlapC h n (fun η => a η 1) ξ - a ξ 1 / r ^ 2 + 2 * iN * a ξ 0 / r) + iN * p ξ
      + (b * aR 1 + V * (iN * a ξ 1 + a ξ 0 / r) + Gz * aZ 1)
      + (a ξ 0 * uR 1 + a ξ 2 * uZ 1 + b * a ξ 1 / r),
    dT (fun η => a η 2) ξ - mlapC h n (fun η => a η 2) ξ + dZ p ξ
      + (b * aR 2 + V * iN * a ξ 2 + Gz * aZ 2)
      + (a ξ 0 * uR 2 + a ξ 2 * uZ 2)]

noncomputable def linC5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) : WC := fun γ m ξ =>
  let E : Cyl → ℂ := fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ)))
  (((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (E ξ)⁻¹) •
    mresC B (m * pint5 B G γ)
      (mcurlC B.h (m * pint5 B G γ)
        (fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (E η • (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η)))
      (fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-2 * Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (E η * (primState5 B G).pw γ m η)) ξ

noncomputable def princC5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) : WC := fun γ m ξ =>
  (((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
    (dVc B γ.1 (W0h4 B G γ m) ξ + (pulseMatC (Kmat B G γ ξ)).mulVec (W0h4 B G γ m ξ)
      + ((m : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((dDamp5 B G γ ξ : ℝ) : ℂ)) • W0h4 B G γ m ξ)
  + ((((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1/2 : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ))
      * (primState5 B G).pw γ m ξ) • nPhiC5 B G γ ξ

open Classical in
noncomputable def tailF5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) : Ext ℝ³ := fun x t Y =>
  if corrOn B l0 x t then qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) •
    cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (princC5 B G) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y)) else 0

      + (a ξ 0 * uR 2 + a ξ 2 * uZ 2)]

noncomputable def linC5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) : WC := fun γ m ξ =>
  let E : Cyl → ℂ := fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ)))
  (((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (E ξ)⁻¹) •

        (fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (E η • (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η)))
      (fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-2 * Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (E η * (primState5 B G).pw γ m η)) ξ

noncomputable def princC5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) : WC := fun γ m ξ =>
  (((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
    (dVc B γ.1 (W0h4 B G γ m) ξ + (pulseMatC (Kmat B G γ ξ)).mulVec (W0h4 B G γ m ξ)
      + ((m : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((dDamp5 B G γ ξ : ℝ) : ℂ)) • W0h4 B G γ m ξ)
  + ((((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1/2 : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ))

  ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-B.h) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • velW5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ m ξ
  + ((dZ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-B.h)) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
      ![-((primState5 B G).Aw γ m ξ 1), (primState5 B G).Aw γ m ξ 0, 0]
noncomputable def pq5TrM (h : ℝ) (n : ℤ) (U : Fin 3 → ℂ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℂ :=
  ![U 0 * dR h c ξ 0 + U 1 * (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (ξ.1 : ℂ) * c ξ 0) + U 2 * dZ c ξ 0 - U 1 * c ξ 1 / (ξ.1 : ℂ),
    U 0 * dR h c ξ 1 + U 1 * (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (ξ.1 : ℂ) * c ξ 1) + U 2 * dZ c ξ 1 + U 1 * c ξ 0 / (ξ.1 : ℂ),
    U 0 * dR h c ξ 2 + U 1 * (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (ξ.1 : ℂ) * c ξ 2) + U 2 * dZ c ξ 2]
noncomputable def pq5QOf (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (V : WC) : WC := fun γ M ξ =>
  (((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))⁻¹) •
    ∑ m ∈ ({1, -1} : Finset ℤ), ∑ m' ∈ ({1, -1} : Finset ℤ),
      ((if m + m' = M then pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') ξ
          else 0) +
       (if m' - m = M then pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (fun i => starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ i))
          (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') ξ else 0))
noncomputable def pq5Osc (Q : WC) : WC := fun γ M ξ => if M = 0 then 0 else Q γ M ξ

        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right m1 hE

          q ^ (B.h * a) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) :=
        mul_le_mul m2 f3 p3 (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p1' p2') hE)
      have hWi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right m3 hP
      have hWi0 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * ai) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p1 p2) hE) p3) hP
      calc N ≤ C * q ^ (B.h * ai) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P := hN
        _ = C * (q ^ (B.h * ai) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P) := by ring
        _ ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * ai) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) hWi0
        _ ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * a) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hWi (abs_nonneg C)
    have k1 := key C1 b1 d1 a1 N1 ha1 hN1 (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
    have k2 := key C2 b2 d2 a2 N2 ha2 hN2 (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
    have e : (|C1| + |C2|) * q ^ (B.h * a) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P =
        |C1| * (q ^ (B.h * a) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) +
        |C2| * (q ^ (B.h * a) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) := by ring
    rw [e]
    linarith
  
  have hNB : ∀ (f1 f2 g0 : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (k : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl),
      ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f1 (DomC B.h qs) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f2 (DomC B.h qs) →
      (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs, g0 η = f1 η + f2 η) → NB B.h g0 k ξ ≤ NB B.h f1 k ξ + NB B.h f2 k ξ := by
    intro f1 f2 g0 k ξ hξ hf1 hf2 heq
    have hn : DomC B.h qs ∈ nhds ξ := hDopen.mem_nhds hξ
    have hev : g0 =ᶠ[nhds ξ] f1 + f2 := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hn (fun η hη => heq η hη)
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g0 ξ = iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ := by
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
      exact iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((hf1.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        ((hf2.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    unfold NB
    rw [e1]
    have e2 : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) +
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) := by
      ext m
      simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e2]
    exact norm_add_le _ _
  obtain ⟨⟨Hf, h0f, hHf⟩, sf, df, uf, bf⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨⟨Hg, h0g, hHg⟩, sg, dg, ug, bg⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨⟨⟨Hf ∪ Hg, ?_, ?_⟩, fun γ m => ((sf γ m).add (sg γ m)).congr (fun _ _ => rfl), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.mem_union, not_or]
    exact ⟨h0f, h0g⟩
  · intro γ m hm
    rw [Finset.mem_union, not_or] at hm
    show f γ m + g γ m = 0
    rw [hHf γ m hm.1, hHg γ m hm.2, add_zero]
  · intro γ m ξ hξ c hc
    show f γ m (shY ξ c) + g γ m (shY ξ c) = f γ m ξ + g γ m ξ
    rw [df γ m ξ hξ c hc, dg γ m ξ hξ c hc]
  · intro γ m ξ hξ hne
    change f γ m ξ + g γ m ξ ≠ 0 at hne
    by_cases h : f γ m ξ = 0
    · rw [h, zero_add] at hne
      exact ug γ m ξ hξ hne
    · exact uf γ m ξ hξ h
  · intro k
    obtain ⟨C1, c1, e1, hb1⟩ := bf k
    obtain ⟨C2, c2, e2, hb2⟩ := bg k
    refine ⟨|C1| + |C2|, max c1 c2, max e1 e2, fun γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hq0, hq1, hS1⟩ := hDq ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨hE, he0, he1⟩ := hEdge _ hX1 hX2
    have hn := hNB (f γ m) (g γ m) ((f + g) γ m) k ξ hξ (sf γ m) (sg γ m) (fun _ _ => rfl)
    have hP : 0 ≤ Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by
      unfold Penv5
      exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
    have := hW (qC B.h ξ) (SC B.h ξ) (Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)))
      (edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ)) (Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2))
      C1 C2 c1 c2 e1 e2 (min α β) α β _ _ hq0 hq1 hS1 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) he0 he1 hP
      (min_le_left α β) (min_le_right α β)
      (hb1 γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2) (hb2 γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2)
    exact le_trans hn this
  · 
    intro θ ξ hξ
    have hξ1 : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := by
      obtain ⟨-, h2, -⟩ := hξ
      exact h2
    have hΓ := hΓfin B.h ξ hok.1 hξ1
    funext i
    simp only [waveV5, Pi.add_apply]
    rw [← Complex.add_re]
    congr 1
    have hin : ∀ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, (f γ m ξ i + g γ m ξ i) * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ =
        ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, f γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ + ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, g γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ := by
      intro γ
      simp_rw [add_mul]
      apply finsum_add_distrib
      · refine Set.Finite.subset (Finset.finite_toSet Hf) ?_
        intro m hm
        by_contra hc
        rw [Function.mem_support] at hm
        apply hm
        rw [hHf γ m hc]
        simp
      · refine Set.Finite.subset (Finset.finite_toSet Hg) ?_
        intro m hm
        by_contra hc
        rw [Function.mem_support] at hm
        apply hm
        rw [hHg γ m hc]
        simp
    rw [finsum_congr hin]
    apply finsum_add_distrib
    · refine Set.Finite.subset hΓ ?_
      intro γ hγ
      by_contra hc
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hγ
      apply hγ
      apply finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
      intro m
      have h0 : f γ m ξ = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hc (uf γ m ξ hξ hne).2.1
      rw [h0]
      simp
    · refine Set.Finite.subset hΓ ?_
      intro γ hγ
      by_contra hc
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hγ
      apply hγ
      apply finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
      intro m
      have h0 : g γ m ξ = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hc (ug γ m ξ hξ hne).2.1
      rw [h0]
      simp

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl), IsOpen U → ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℂ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → ∀ ξ ∈ U, ∀ k : ℕ, NB h (fun η => f η * g η) k ξ ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h g (k - i) ξ

signature.name: nb_mul_le_open
signature.statement:
∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl), IsOpen U → ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℂ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → ∀ ξ ∈ U, ∀ k : ℕ, NB h (fun η => f η * g η) k ξ ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h g (k - i) ξ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h U hU f g hf hg ξ hξ k
  unfold NB
  generalize Lnorm h ξ = L
  obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hs : IsOpen s := by
    rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
  have hO : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage L.continuous
  have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
    rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
  have hL0s : L 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
  have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
  have hsm : ∀ F : Cyl → ℂ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
    intro F hF
    exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
      (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
  have hsmO : ∀ F : Cyl → ℂ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by
    intro F hF
    exact (hsm F hF).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
  have key : ∀ F : Cyl → ℂ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
    intro F hF i
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i ξ 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑L) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => L) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => L) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => L) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  have hfg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => f η * g η) U := hf.mul hg
  have leib := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le (hsmO f hf) (hsmO g hg) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O
    (n := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => f (ξ + L y) * g (ξ + L y)) k hO h0O] at leib
  rw [← key _ hfg k]
  calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => (fun η => f η * g η) (ξ + L z)) 0‖
      = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => f (ξ + L y) * g (ξ + L y)) 0‖ := rfl
    _ ≤ _ := leib
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O,
        iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => g (ξ + L z)) (k - i) hO h0O,
        key f hf i, key g hg (k - i)]

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∀ (p : ℝ), 0 < p → p ≤ 2 → ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ,

      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η / c) ^ p : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ ≤ K * (qC B.h ξ / c) ^ p

signature.name: qC_ratio_rpow_nb
signature.statement:
∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∀ (p : ℝ), 0 < p → p ≤ 2 → ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ,
    ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 →

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hB p _ _ j
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hB.1
  have h0 : 0 < B.h := hB.2.1.1
  have h1 : B.h < 1/100 := hB.2.1.2.1
  have hN : SimNorm B.h := by
    clear h0 h1
    have hS' := hS
    obtain ⟨hS1, -, -, -, hS5⟩ := hS'
    open Pointwise in
    have hom : ∀ μ z τ : ℝ, 0 < μ →
        simScale B.h (μ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * z) (μ * τ) = μ * simScale B.h z τ := by
      intro μ z τ hμ
      have key : ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p → μ * p - (μ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * z) ^ 2 * (μ * p) ^ (2 * B.h) =
          μ * (p - z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * B.h)) := by
        intro p hp
        have sq : (μ ^ (1/2 - B.h)) ^ 2 = μ ^ (1 - 2 * B.h) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hμ.le]
          congr 1
          push_cast
          ring
        have split : μ ^ (1 - 2 * B.h) * μ ^ (2 * B.h) = μ := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hμ]
          have e : 1 - 2 * B.h + 2 * B.h = 1 := by ring
          rw [e, Real.rpow_one]
        rw [mul_pow, sq, Real.mul_rpow hμ.le hp.le]
        linear_combination (-(z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * B.h))) * split
      have hset : {q : ℝ | 0 < q ∧ μ * τ ≤ q - (μ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * z) ^ 2 * q ^ (2 * B.h)} =
          μ • {p : ℝ | 0 < p ∧ τ ≤ p - z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * B.h)} := by
        ext q
        rw [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem₀ hμ.ne', smul_eq_mul]
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
        have hq : q = μ * (μ⁻¹ * q) := by field_simp
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hq0, hle⟩
          have hp : 0 < μ⁻¹ * q := mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hμ) hq0
          refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
          rw [hq, key _ hp] at hle
          exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hle hμ
        · rintro ⟨hp, hle⟩
          refine ⟨by rw [hq]; exact mul_pos hμ hp, ?_⟩
          rw [hq, key _ hp]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle hμ.le
      unfold simScale
      rw [hset, Real.sInf_smul_of_nonneg hμ.le, smul_eq_mul]
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z T : ℝ, 0 < T → simScale B.h Z T = 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Z, T)‖ ≤ C := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk | hk
      · subst hk
        refine ⟨1, fun Z T _ h1 => ?_⟩
        rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]
        show ‖simScale B.h Z T‖ ≤ 1
        rw [h1, norm_one]
      · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hS5 k hk
        refine ⟨C, fun Z T hT h1 => ?_⟩
        have := hC Z T hT h1.le
        rwa [h1, Real.one_rpow, mul_one] at this
    refine ⟨C, fun z τ hτ _ => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hQ0, -⟩ := hS1 z τ hτ
    obtain ⟨Q, hQd⟩ : ∃ Q, Q = simScale B.h z τ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hQd] at hQ0 ⊢
    obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ : ∃ Z : ℝ, Z = Q ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) * z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ, T = Q⁻¹ * τ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hT0 : 0 < T := by rw [hT]; exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hQ0) hτ
    have hZT : simScale B.h Z T = 1 := by
      have := hom Q⁻¹ z τ (inv_pos.mpr hQ0)
      rw [Real.inv_rpow hQ0.le, ← Real.rpow_neg hQ0.le, ← hQd, inv_mul_cancel₀ hQ0.ne'] at this
      rw [hZ, hT]
      exact this
    have hzb : Q ^ (1/2 - B.h) * Z = z := by
      rw [hZ, ← mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hQ0]
      simp
    have hτb : Q * T = τ := by
      rw [hT]
      exact mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hQ0.ne' τ
    have hpa : 0 < Q ^ (1/2 - B.h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ0 _
    let e₁ : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 (Q ^ (1/2 - B.h)) hpa.ne')
    let e₂ : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 Q hQ0.ne')
    let L : (ℝ × ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) := e₁.prodCongr e₂
    let M : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 Q hQ0.ne')
    have hL : ∀ x : ℝ × ℝ, L x = (Q ^ (1/2 - B.h) * x.1, Q * x.2) := by
      intro x
      simp [L, e₁, e₂, mul_comm]
    have hM : ∀ y : ℝ, M y = Q * y := by
      intro y
      simp [M, mul_comm]
    have hfun : (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ L =
        M ∘ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) := by
      funext w
      simp only [Function.comp, hL, hM]
      exact hom Q w.1 w.2 hQ0
    have hLclm : (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)) =
        (Q ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (Q • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro x
      apply Prod.ext
      · simp [hL]
      · simp [hL]
    have hLv : L (Z, T) = (z, τ) := by
      rw [hL]
      exact Prod.ext hzb hτb
    have hcomp : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ L) (Z, T) =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (L (Z, T))).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ))) := by
      have := L.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2)
        uniqueDiffOn_univ (Set.mem_univ (L (Z, T))) k
      rwa [Set.preimage_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ] at this
    have key : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (z, τ)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ))) =
        (M : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Z, T)) := by
      rw [← hLv, ← hcomp, hfun, M.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left]
    have hMn : ‖(M : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ ≤ Q := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hQ0.le fun y => ?_
      show ‖M y‖ ≤ Q * ‖y‖
      rw [hM, norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs Q, abs_of_pos hQ0]
    rw [← hLclm, key]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(M : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ *
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Z, T)‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
      _ ≤ Q * C := mul_le_mul hMn (hC Z T hT0 hZT) (norm_nonneg _) hQ0.le
      _ = C * Q := mul_comm _ _
  unfold SimNorm at hN
  choose C hC using hN
  
  have key : ∀ {E G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup G]
      [NormedSpace ℝ G] (F : E → G) (V : Set E) (a : E) (T : Cyl →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → a ∈ V → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro E G _ _ _ _ F V a T hV hF ha i
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set E, s = (fun z : E => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : E) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
    have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  
  obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ,
      A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |Polynomial.eval p (descPochhammer ℝ i)| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by rw [hAdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |C i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by
    have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k (_ : k ∈ Finset.range (j + 1)) => abs_nonneg (C k))
    rw [hDdef]; linarith
  refine ⟨(j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j, ?_⟩
  intro c hc ξ hξ hq1
  
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      (contDiff_snd.fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
    exact h1.comp h2.contDiffOn (fun η (hη : η.2.2.1 < 1) =>
      ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith)⟩)
  have hqpos : ∀ η : Cyl, η.2.2.1 < 1 → 0 < qC B.h η := fun η h =>
    (hS.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
  have hU : IsOpen {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd.snd.fst continuous_const
  
  obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : Cyl → ℂ, F = fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η / c) ^ p : ℝ) : ℂ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨a, hadef⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = (qC B.h ξ / c) ^ p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  suffices hmain : NB B.h F j ξ ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j * a by
    rw [hFdef, hadef] at hmain; exact hmain
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by rw [hadef]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg (div_nonneg hq0.le hc.le) _
  have hFU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (qC B.h η / c) ^ p) {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} :=
      (hqC.div_const c).rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (div_pos (hqpos η hη) hc).ne')
    rw [hFdef]
    exact Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h3
  
  obtain ⟨Pm, hPmdef⟩ : ∃ Pm : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
      Pm = ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))).prod
        (-((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPapp : ∀ η : Cyl, Pm η = (η.2.1, -η.2.2.1) := by
    intro η; rw [hPmdef]; simp
  have hP1 : ‖Pm‖ ≤ 1 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun η => ?_)
    rw [hPapp η, one_mul, Prod.norm_def (η.2.1, -η.2.2.1)]
    refine max_le ?_ ?_
    · exact (norm_fst_le η.2).trans (norm_snd_le η)
    · exact (norm_neg η.2.2.1).trans_le
        (((norm_fst_le η.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le η.2)).trans (norm_snd_le η))
  obtain ⟨Mq, hMqdef⟩ : ∃ Mq : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
      Mq = (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
        (qC B.h ξ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ, T = Mq.comp Pm := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨w0, hw0def⟩ : ∃ w0 : ℝ × ℝ, w0 = (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hW : IsOpen (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
  have hw0 : w0 ∈ (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := by
    rw [hw0def]; exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
  
  have hid : ∀ v : Cyl, qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) = simScale B.h (w0 + T v).1 (w0 + T v).2 := by
    intro v
    have e1 : (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.1 = qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1 := by
      simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
    have e2 : (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 = qC B.h ξ * v.2.2.1 := by
      simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
    have e3 : T v = (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1, qC B.h ξ * (-v.2.2.1)) := by
      rw [hTdef, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hPapp v, hMqdef]
      simp [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
    rw [e3, hw0def]
    show simScale B.h (ξ.2.1 + (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.1) (1 - (ξ.2.2.1 + (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1)) =
      simScale B.h (ξ.2.1 + qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1) ((1 - ξ.2.2.1) + qC B.h ξ * (-v.2.2.1))
    rw [e1, e2]
    congr 1
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set Cyl, O = {v : Cyl | (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 < 1} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hOmem : ∀ v, v ∈ O ↔ (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 < 1 := by
    intro v; rw [hOdef]; rfl
  have hcontO : Continuous (fun v : Cyl => (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1) :=
    ((continuous_const.add (Lnorm B.h ξ).continuous).snd.snd.fst)
  have hO : IsOpen O := by rw [hOdef]; exact isOpen_lt hcontO continuous_const
  have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ O := by
    rw [hOmem, map_zero, add_zero]; exact hξ
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψdef⟩ : ∃ ψ : Cyl → ℝ, ψ = fun v => qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) / qC B.h ξ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ O := by
    rw [hψdef]
    exact (hqC.comp (contDiff_const.add (Lnorm B.h ξ).contDiff).contDiffOn
      (fun v hv => (hOmem v).1 hv)).div_const _
  have hψpos : ∀ v ∈ O, 0 < ψ v := by
    intro v hv; rw [hψdef]; exact div_pos (hqpos _ ((hOmem v).1 hv)) hq0
  have hψ0 : ψ 0 = 1 := by
    rw [hψdef]
    show qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ 0) / qC B.h ξ = 1
    rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact div_self hq0.ne'
  have hψeq : ψ = (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ • (fun z : Cyl => simScale B.h (w0 + T z).1 (w0 + T z).2) := by
    rw [hψdef]; funext v
    show qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) / qC B.h ξ =
      (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * simScale B.h (w0 + T v).1 (w0 + T v).2
    rw [hid v, div_eq_inv_mul]
  have hΦ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : Cyl => simScale B.h (w0 + T z).1 (w0 + T z).2) 0 := by
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (w0 + T 0) := by
      rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact hS.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hw0)
    exact ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (f := fun z : Cyl => w0 + T z)
      (0 : Cyl) h1 (contDiff_const.add T.contDiff).contDiffAt
  
  have hDψ : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ j → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ψ O 0‖ ≤ D ^ i := by
    intro i hi1 hij
    have hcomp : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Mq.comp Pm) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Mq)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Pm) := by
      ext m; rfl
    have hCi : ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Mq)‖ ≤ C i * qC B.h ξ := by
      rw [hMqdef, hw0def]; exact hC i ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith) hq1
    have hprod : ∏ k : Fin i, ‖Pm‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hP1
    have hb1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Mq)) (fun _ : Fin i => Pm)
    have hb2 := hb1.trans ((mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) hprod).trans hCi)
    have hCiD : C i ≤ D := by
      have h2 : |C i| ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |C k| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => |C k|) (fun k _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hij))
      have h3 := le_abs_self (C i)
      rw [hDdef]; linarith
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO h0O, hψeq,
      iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply (hΦ.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)),
      key (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) w0 T hW hS.2.2.2.1 hw0 i,
      norm_smul, hTdef, hcomp, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le)]
    calc (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * ‖((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Mq)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Pm)‖
        ≤ (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * (C i * qC B.h ξ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb2 (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le)
      _ = C i := by rw [mul_comm (C i), ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0.ne', one_mul]
      _ ≤ D := hCiD
      _ ≤ D ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
  
  have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    (contDiffOn_id (s := Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))).rpow_const_of_ne (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
  have hψmaps : Set.MapsTo ψ O (Set.Ioi 0) := fun v hv => hψpos v hv
  have hCg : ∀ i ≤ j, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) (Set.Ioi 0) (ψ 0)‖ ≤ A := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hψ0, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i isOpen_Ioi (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (zero_lt_one' ℝ)),
      norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate,
      Real.iter_deriv_rpow_const, Real.one_rpow, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, hAdef]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Polynomial.eval p (descPochhammer ℝ i)|)

    isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn hO.uniqueDiffOn hψmaps h0O (C := A) (D := D) hCg hDψ
  
  obtain ⟨gl, hgldef⟩ : ∃ gl : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ, gl = a • Complex.ofRealCLM := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hgl : ‖gl‖ ≤ a := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ ha0 (fun x => le_of_eq (by
    rw [hgldef, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, norm_smul, Complex.norm_real,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg ha0]))
  have hEq : Set.EqOn (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) (⇑gl ∘ ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) ∘ ψ)) O := by
    intro z hz
    have hψz := hψpos z hz
    have e : qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z) / c = (qC B.h ξ / c) * ψ z := by
      rw [hψdef]
      show _ = qC B.h ξ / c * (qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z) / qC B.h ξ)
      rw [div_mul_div_comm, mul_comm (qC B.h ξ), mul_div_mul_right _ _ hq0.ne']
    show F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z) = gl (ψ z ^ p)
    rw [hFdef, hgldef, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply]
    show (((qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z) / c) ^ p : ℝ) : ℂ) = a • ((ψ z ^ p : ℝ) : ℂ)
    rw [e, Real.mul_rpow (div_nonneg hq0.le hc.le) hψz.le, ← hadef, Complex.real_smul,
      Complex.ofReal_mul]
  have hgψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) ∘ ψ) O := hg.comp hψ hψmaps
  have hNB : NB B.h F j ξ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) 0‖ := by
    unfold NB
    rw [key F {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hU hFU hξ j]
  calc NB B.h F j ξ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) 0‖ := hNB
    _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) O 0‖ := by
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hO h0O]
    _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j (⇑gl ∘ ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) ∘ ψ)) O 0‖ := by
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_congr hEq h0O j]
    _ = ‖gl.compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) ∘ ψ) O 0)‖ := by
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_left gl (hgψ.contDiffWithinAt h0O)
          hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O (i := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)]
    _ ≤ ‖gl‖ * ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) ∘ ψ) O 0‖ :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
    _ ≤ a * ((j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j) := mul_le_mul hgl hFdB (norm_nonneg _) ha0
    _ = (j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j * a := by ring

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (a b lam : ℝ), 0 < a → a < b → 0 < lam → ∃ ΦP ΦJ Ψ Ψt : ℝ → ℝ,
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ ΦP ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ ΦJ ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ Ψ ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ Ψt ∧
    (∀ x, ΦP x ≠ 0 → a < x ∧ x < b) ∧ (∀ x, ΦJ x ≠ 0 → a < x ∧ x < b) ∧ (∀ x, Ψ x ≠ 0 → a < x ∧ x < b) ∧
    (∀ x, Ψt x ≠ 0 → a < x ∧ x < b) ∧ (∀ x, 0 < x → Ψt x = deriv Ψ x + Ψ x / x) ∧
    (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), x ^ 2 * ΦP x) = 0 ∧ (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), x ^ 2 * ΦJ x) = 0 ∧
    (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), 2 * (x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + lam)) / x * ΦP x) = 1 ∧
    (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), 2 * (x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + lam)) / x * ΦJ x) = 0 ∧
    (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), x * (x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + lam)) * ΦP x) = 0 ∧
    (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), x * (x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + lam)) * ΦJ x) = 1 ∧
    (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), x * Ψt x) = 0 ∧
    (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), x ^ 2 * (x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + lam)) * Ψt x) = 1

proof.tactics:
by
  intro a b lam ha hab hlam
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : ℝ, p = (3 * a + b) / 4 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q : ℝ, q = (a + 3 * b) / 4 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hap : a < p := by rw [hp]; linarith
  have hpq : p < q := by rw [hp, hq]; linarith
  have hqb : q < b := by rw [hq]; linarith
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  
  obtain ⟨k, hkC, hks, hkpos⟩ : ∃ k : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ k ∧ (∀ x, k x ≠ 0 → p < x ∧ x < q) ∧
      (∀ x, p < x → x < q → 0 < k x) := by
    let kb : ContDiffBump ((a + b) / 2 : ℝ) := ⟨(b - a) / 8, (b - a) / 4, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hball : Metric.ball ((a + b) / 2 : ℝ) kb.rOut = Ioo p q := by
      rw [Real.ball_eq_Ioo, hp, hq]
      show Ioo ((a + b) / 2 - (b - a) / 4) ((a + b) / 2 + (b - a) / 4) = _
      congr 1 <;> ring
    refine ⟨kb, kb.contDiff, fun x hx => ?_,
      fun x h1 h2 => kb.pos_of_mem_ball (by rw [hball]; exact ⟨h1, h2⟩)⟩
    have hx' : x ∈ Function.support kb := hx
    rw [kb.support_eq, hball] at hx'
    exact hx'
  have hkD : Differentiable ℝ k := (contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.mp hkC).1

      simp only [hΨt, hΨd, hΨv, Pi.mul_apply]
      set W := (x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + lam))
      field_simp
      ring
    · exact continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt fun x hx => by
        have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith [hx.1]
        simp only [hΨt, hΨd, hΨv]
        fun_prop (disch := first | assumption | positivity | exact Or.inl (by positivity))
    · exact continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt fun x hx => by
        have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith [hx.1]
        fun_prop (disch := first | assumption | positivity | exact Or.inl (by positivity))
    · simp [hk0 a (Or.inl hap)]
    · simp [hk0 b (Or.inr hqb)]
    · show ∫ x in a..b, 2 * lam * (x * (x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + lam)) * k x) / DT = 1
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_div, ← hDTdef, div_self hDT']

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (qs α : ℝ) (ψ Φ : ℝ → ℝ) (G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), B.ok →
    SimNorm B.h → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ →
    (∀ x, Φ x ≠ 0 → Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) < x ∧ x < Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) → InS B qs α G →
    InM B qs α (fun ξ => ψ (etaC B.h ξ) * G (ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) * Φ (ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ)))
