proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs α ψ Φ G hok hSN hqs0 hqs1 hψ hΦ hΦs hG
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  have key : ∀ {E G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup G]
      [NormedSpace ℝ G] (F : E → G) (V : Set E) (a : E) (T : Cyl →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → a ∈ V → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro E G _ _ _ _ F V a T hV hF ha i
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set E, s = (fun z : E => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : E) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
    have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  have hU : IsOpen {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd.snd.fst continuous_const
  have hqCU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      (contDiff_snd.fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
    exact h1.comp h2.contDiffOn (fun η (hη : η.2.2.1 < 1) =>
      ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith)⟩)
  have hqposU : ∀ η : Cyl, η.2.2.1 < 1 → 0 < qC B.h η := fun η h =>
    (hS.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hDsub : DomC B.h qs ⊆ {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := fun η hη => hη.2.1
  have hDo : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have h1 : IsOpen ({η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} ∩ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) ⁻¹' Set.Iio qs) :=
      hqCU.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hU isOpen_Iio
    have h2 : IsOpen {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst
    have e : DomC B.h qs =
        {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} ∩ ({η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} ∩ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) ⁻¹' Set.Iio qs) := by
      ext η
      simp only [DomC, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Iio]
    rw [e]; exact h2.inter h1
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) (DomC B.h qs) := hqCU.mono hDsub
  have hqpos : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ := fun ξ hξ => hqposU ξ (hDsub hξ)
  have hmul : ∀ (U : Set Cyl) (f g : Cyl → ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → ∀ ξ ∈ U, ∀ k : ℕ,
        NB B.h (fun η => f η * g η) k ξ ≤
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h f i ξ * NB B.h g (k - i) ξ := by
    intro U f g hU' hf hg ξ hξ k
    have hfg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => f η * g η) U := hf.mul hg
    have kf := key f U ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hU' hf hξ
    have kg := key g U ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hU' hg hξ
    have kfg := key (fun η => f η * g η) U ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hU' hfg hξ k
    unfold NB
    obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set Cyl, O = (fun v => ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hO : IsOpen O := by
      rw [hOdef]; exact hU'.preimage (continuous_const.add (Lnorm B.h ξ).continuous)
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ O := by
      rw [hOdef]; show ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ 0 ∈ U; rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact hξ
    have hsmO : ∀ F : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) O := by
      intro F hF
      exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add (Lnorm B.h ξ).contDiff).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hOdef] at hz; exact hz)
    have leib := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le (hsmO f hf) (hsmO g hg) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O
      (n := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen
      (f := fun y => f (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ y) * g (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ y)) k hO h0O] at leib
    rw [← kfg]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => (fun η => f η * g η) (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) 0‖
        = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => f (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ y) * g (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ y)) 0‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ _ := leib
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) i hO h0O,
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => g (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) (k - i) hO h0O,
          kf i, kg (k - i)]
  have hqpow : ∀ (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs,
      NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c) j ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ c := by
    intro c j
    have hN := hSN
    unfold SimNorm at hN
    choose C hC using hN
    obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ,
        A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |Polynomial.eval c (descPochhammer ℝ i)| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |C i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by
      have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k (_ : k ∈ Finset.range (j + 1)) => abs_nonneg (C k))
      rw [hDdef]; linarith
    refine ⟨(j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j, ?_⟩
    intro ξ hξD
    have hξD' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qs := hξD
    have hξ : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξD'.2.1
    have hq1 : qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 := le_trans hξD'.2.2.le hqs1
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqposU ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : Cyl → ℝ, F = fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, hadef⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = qC B.h ξ ^ c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    suffices hmain : NB B.h F j ξ ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j * a by
      rw [hFdef, hadef] at hmain; exact hmain
    have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by rw [hadef]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
    have hFU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
      rw [hFdef]
      exact hqCU.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqposU η hη).ne')
    obtain ⟨Pm, hPmdef⟩ : ∃ Pm : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
        Pm = ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))).prod
          (-((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
            (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hPapp : ∀ η : Cyl, Pm η = (η.2.1, -η.2.2.1) := by
      intro η; rw [hPmdef]; simp
    have hP1 : ‖Pm‖ ≤ 1 := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun η => ?_)
      rw [hPapp η, one_mul, Prod.norm_def (η.2.1, -η.2.2.1)]
      refine max_le ?_ ?_
      · exact (norm_fst_le η.2).trans (norm_snd_le η)
      · exact (norm_neg η.2.2.1).trans_le
          (((norm_fst_le η.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le η.2)).trans (norm_snd_le η))
    obtain ⟨Mq, hMqdef⟩ : ∃ Mq : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
        Mq = (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
          (qC B.h ξ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ, T = Mq.comp Pm := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨w0, hw0def⟩ : ∃ w0 : ℝ × ℝ, w0 = (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hW : IsOpen (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
    have hw0 : w0 ∈ (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := by
      rw [hw0def]; exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hid : ∀ v : Cyl, qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) = simScale B.h (w0 + T v).1 (w0 + T v).2 := by
      intro v
      have e1 : (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.1 = qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1 := by
        simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
      have e2 : (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 = qC B.h ξ * v.2.2.1 := by
        simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
      have e3 : T v = (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1, qC B.h ξ * (-v.2.2.1)) := by
        rw [hTdef, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hPapp v, hMqdef]
        simp [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
      rw [e3, hw0def]
      show simScale B.h (ξ.2.1 + (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.1) (1 - (ξ.2.2.1 + (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1)) =
        simScale B.h (ξ.2.1 + qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1) ((1 - ξ.2.2.1) + qC B.h ξ * (-v.2.2.1))
      rw [e1, e2]
      congr 1
      ring
    obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set Cyl, O = {v : Cyl | (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 < 1} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hOmem : ∀ v, v ∈ O ↔ (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 < 1 := by
      intro v; rw [hOdef]; rfl
    have hcontO : Continuous (fun v : Cyl => (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1) :=
      ((continuous_const.add (Lnorm B.h ξ).continuous).snd.snd.fst)
    have hO : IsOpen O := by rw [hOdef]; exact isOpen_lt hcontO continuous_const
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ O := by
      rw [hOmem, map_zero, add_zero]; exact hξ
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψdef⟩ : ∃ ψ : Cyl → ℝ, ψ = fun v => qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) / qC B.h ξ :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ O := by
      rw [hψdef]
      exact (hqCU.comp (contDiff_const.add (Lnorm B.h ξ).contDiff).contDiffOn
        (fun v hv => (hOmem v).1 hv)).div_const _
    have hψpos : ∀ v ∈ O, 0 < ψ v := by
      intro v hv; rw [hψdef]; exact div_pos (hqposU _ ((hOmem v).1 hv)) hq0
    have hψ0 : ψ 0 = 1 := by
      rw [hψdef]
      show qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ 0) / qC B.h ξ = 1
      rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact div_self hq0.ne'
    have hψeq : ψ = (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ • (fun z : Cyl => simScale B.h (w0 + T z).1 (w0 + T z).2) := by
      rw [hψdef]; funext v
      show qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) / qC B.h ξ =
        (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * simScale B.h (w0 + T v).1 (w0 + T v).2
      rw [hid v, div_eq_inv_mul]
    have hΦ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : Cyl => simScale B.h (w0 + T z).1 (w0 + T z).2) 0 := by
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (w0 + T 0) := by
        rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact hS.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hw0)
      exact ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (f := fun z : Cyl => w0 + T z)
        (0 : Cyl) h1 (contDiff_const.add T.contDiff).contDiffAt
    have hDψ : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ j → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ψ O 0‖ ≤ D ^ i := by
      intro i hi1 hij
      have hcomp : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Mq.comp Pm) =
          ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Mq)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Pm) := by
        ext m; rfl
      have hCi : ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Mq)‖ ≤ C i * qC B.h ξ := by
        rw [hMqdef, hw0def]; exact hC i ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith) hq1
      have hprod : ∏ k : Fin i, ‖Pm‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
        exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hP1
      have hb1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Mq)) (fun _ : Fin i => Pm)
      have hb2 := hb1.trans ((mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) hprod).trans hCi)
      have hCiD : C i ≤ D := by
        have h2 : |C i| ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |C k| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => |C k|) (fun k _ => abs_nonneg _)
            (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hij))
        have h3 := le_abs_self (C i)
        rw [hDdef]; linarith
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO h0O, hψeq,
        iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply (hΦ.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)),
        key (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) w0 T hW hS.2.2.2.1 hw0 i,
        norm_smul, hTdef, hcomp, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le)]
      calc (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * ‖((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Mq)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Pm)‖
          ≤ (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * (C i * qC B.h ξ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb2 (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le)
        _ = C i := by rw [mul_comm (C i), ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0.ne', one_mul]
        _ ≤ D := hCiD
        _ ≤ D ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      (contDiffOn_id (s := Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))).rpow_const_of_ne (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
    have hψmaps : Set.MapsTo ψ O (Set.Ioi 0) := fun v hv => hψpos v hv
    have hCg : ∀ i ≤ j, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) (Set.Ioi 0) (ψ 0)‖ ≤ A := by
      intro i hi
      rw [hψ0, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i isOpen_Ioi (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (zero_lt_one' ℝ)),
        norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate,
        Real.iter_deriv_rpow_const, Real.one_rpow, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, hAdef]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Polynomial.eval c (descPochhammer ℝ i)|)
        (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
    have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hg hψ (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn hO.uniqueDiffOn hψmaps h0O (C := A) (D := D) hCg hDψ
    obtain ⟨gl, hgldef⟩ : ∃ gl : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ, gl = a • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hgl : ‖gl‖ ≤ a := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ ha0 (fun x => le_of_eq (by
      rw [hgldef, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, norm_smul,
        Real.norm_of_nonneg ha0]))
    have hEq : Set.EqOn (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) (⇑gl ∘ ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) ∘ ψ)) O := by
      intro z hz
      have hψz := hψpos z hz
      have e : qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z) = qC B.h ξ * ψ z := by

          Real.log_le_log (div_pos hm1pos hXa) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hm1X hXa.le)
        have l2 : Real.log (B.Xb / B.m2) ≤ Real.log (B.Xb / XC B.h ξ) :=
          Real.log_le_log (div_pos hXbpos hm2pos) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hXbpos.le hXCpos hXm2)
        have s1 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hla.le l1 2
        have s2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hlb.le l2 2
        have d1 : B.aa / Real.log (XC B.h ξ / B.Xa) ^ 2 ≤ B.aa / Real.log (B.m1 / B.Xa) ^ 2 :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left haa.le (pow_pos hla 2) s1
        have d2 : B.ab / Real.log (B.Xb / XC B.h ξ) ^ 2 ≤ B.ab / Real.log (B.Xb / B.m2) ^ 2 :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hab.le (pow_pos hlb 2) s2
        linarith
      calc _ ≤ Mt * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * (1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)|) ^ (2 * bs)) := hb
        _ = (Mt / es * es) * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * (1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)|) ^ (2 * bs)) := by
            rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hes0.ne']
        _ ≤ (Mt / es * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) *
              (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * (1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)|) ^ (2 * bs)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hew (div_nonneg hMt0 hes0.le))
              (mul_nonneg hqa hL0)
        _ = _ := by ring
    · have hNo : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs ∩ (fun η : Cyl => η.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h η)) ⁻¹'
          (Set.Icc (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)))ᶜ) :=
        hxS.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hDo isClosed_Icc.isOpen_compl
      have h0 := hzero (fun ξ => ψ (etaC B.h ξ) * G (ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) * Φ (ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ)))
        ξ _ hNo ⟨hξ, fun h => hin ⟨h.1, h.2⟩⟩ (fun η hη => by
          have hΦ0 : Φ (η.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h η)) = 0 := by
            by_contra hne
            obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hΦs _ hne
            exact hη.2 ⟨h1.le, h2.le⟩
          simp only [hΦ0, mul_zero]) k
      rw [h0]
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hMt0 hes0.le) hqa) hL0) (hEW0 _)

signature.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (qs α : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → SimNorm B.h → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 →
    InM B qs α f → MomShape B f → InM B qs (α + 1) (nrm B (Aex B.h) (momDbP B f))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs α f hok hSN hqs0 hqs1 hf hMS
  obtain ⟨hDo, hqsm, hqpos, hXc, hdiff, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B qs hok
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨hf1, -, -, hfb⟩ := hf
  
  have nbnn : ∀ (u : Cyl → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), 0 ≤ NB B.h u j ξ := fun u j ξ => norm_nonneg _
  have nbmul : ∀ (U : Set Cyl), IsOpen U → ∀ (u v : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v U → ∀ ξ ∈ U, ∀ k : ℕ, NB B.h (fun η => u η * v η) k ξ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h u i ξ * NB B.h v (k - i) ξ := by
    intro U hU u v hu hv ξ hξ k
    unfold NB
    generalize Lnorm B.h ξ = L
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage L.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
    have hL0s : L 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
    have hsm : ∀ F : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
      intro F hF
      exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have hsmO : ∀ F : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by
      intro F hF
      exact (hsm F hF).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
    have key : ∀ F : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → ∀ i : ℕ,
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0 =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
      intro F hF i
      have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O
      have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
        hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + z)) i hs h0s
      have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i ξ 0
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0
          = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑L) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := e2
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [map_zero]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [e3]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
    have huv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => u η * v η) U := hu.mul hv
    have leib := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le (hsmO u hu) (hsmO v hv) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O
      (n := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => u (ξ + L y) * v (ξ + L y)) k hO h0O] at leib
    rw [← key _ huv k]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => (fun η => u η * v η) (ξ + L z)) 0‖
        = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => u (ξ + L y) * v (ξ + L y)) 0‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ _ := leib
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => u (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O,
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => v (ξ + L z)) (k - i) hO h0O,
          key u hu i, key v hv (k - i)]
  have nbneg : ∀ (u : Cyl → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), NB B.h (fun η => -(u η)) j ξ = NB B.h u j ξ := by
    intro u j ξ
    unfold NB
    have e0 : (fun η => -(u η)) = -u := rfl
    rw [e0, iteratedFDeriv_neg_apply]
    have e : (-(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j u ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
        -((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j u ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)) := by
      ext v; simp
    rw [e, norm_neg]
  have nbdZ : ∀ (U : Set Cyl) (u : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (j : ℕ), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u U → 0 < qC B.h ξ →
      NB B.h (dZ u) j ξ ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) * NB B.h u (j + 1) ξ := by
    intro U u ξ j hU hξ hu hq
    have hs0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _
    have hs1 : qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) = 1 := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg hq.le, mul_inv_cancel₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _).ne']
    obtain ⟨e₀, he₀⟩ : ∃ e₀ : Cyl, e₀ = ((0:ℝ), qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hLe : Lnorm B.h ξ e₀ = ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
      rw [he₀]
      have e1 : ∀ (c x : ℝ), (c • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) x = c * x := fun c x => rfl
      show ((Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) 0,
        (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) (qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))),
        (qC B.h ξ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) 0, JpowL (-(coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ))) 0) = _
      rw [e1, e1, e1, hs1, map_zero, mul_zero, mul_zero]
    have hne₀ : ‖e₀‖ = qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) := by
      rw [he₀]; simp [Prod.norm_def, abs_of_pos hs0, hs0.le, Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le]
    have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ u) U := hu.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    have hfdA : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ u) ξ := hfd.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)
    have hdz : dZ u = ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ))) ∘
        fderiv ℝ u := by
      funext η; rfl
    have key := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left
      (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ))) hfdA (i := j)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    unfold NB
    rw [hdz, key]
    apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (mul_nonneg hs0.le (norm_nonneg _))
    intro v
    have hsn : (Fin.snoc (fun i => Lnorm B.h ξ (v i)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) :
        Fin (j+1) → Cyl) = fun i => Lnorm B.h ξ ((Fin.snoc v e₀ : Fin (j+1) → Cyl) i) := by
      funext i
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
      · simp only [Fin.snoc_last, hLe]
      · simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
    have h1 : (((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ))).compContinuousMultilinearMap
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fderiv ℝ u) ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)) v =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j+1) u ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ))
          (Fin.snoc v e₀) := by
      rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
        ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, ← hsn, iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right]
      simp only [Fin.init_snoc, Fin.snoc_last, ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe,
        Function.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply]
    rw [h1]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j+1) u ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)‖ *
          ∏ i, ‖(Fin.snoc v e₀ : Fin (j+1) → Cyl) i‖ := ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ = qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) *
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j+1) u ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)‖ *
            ∏ i, ‖v i‖ := by
        rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
        simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last, hne₀]
        ring
  
  have hQs : ∀ c : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c) (DomC B.h qs) := fun c =>
    hqsm.rpow_const_of_ne (fun x hx => (hqpos x hx).ne')
  have hPe : momPsP B f = fun η => qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h) * f η := rfl
  have hPs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (momPsP B f) (DomC B.h qs) := by
    rw [hPe]; exact (hQs _).mul hf1
  have hF2s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => -(dZ (momPsP B f) η)) (DomC B.h qs) :=
    (hdiff _ hPs).2.1.neg
  have hge : nrm B (Aex B.h) (momDbP B f) = fun η => qC B.h η ^ Aex B.h * -(dZ (momPsP B f) η) := rfl
  
  have hPtr : ∀ a : ℝ × ℝ, (fun η => momPsP B f (η + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), a))) = momPsP B f := by
    intro a
    funext η
    have h1 : η + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), a) = shY η a := by
      ext <;> simp [shY]
    rw [h1]
    simp only [momPsP]
    rw [hMS.1 η a]
    rfl
  rw [hge]
  refine ⟨(hQs _).mul hF2s, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro ξ _ a _
    have h1 : shY ξ a = ξ + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), a) := by
      ext <;> simp [shY]
    have h2 : dZ (momPsP B f) (shY ξ a) = dZ (momPsP B f) ξ := by
      unfold dZ
      rw [h1, ← fderiv_comp_add_right, hPtr a]
    show qC B.h (shY ξ a) ^ Aex B.h * -(dZ (momPsP B f) (shY ξ a)) =
      qC B.h ξ ^ Aex B.h * -(dZ (momPsP B f) ξ)
    rw [h2]
    rfl
  · 
    intro ξ hξ hX
    have hloc : ∀ N : Set Cyl, IsOpen N → ξ ∈ N → (∀ η ∈ N, f η = 0) →
        dZ (momPsP B f) ξ = 0 := by
      intro N hN hξN h0
      have hev : momPsP B f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hN.mem_nhds hξN)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [momPsP]; rw [h0 η hη, mul_zero])
      unfold dZ
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    have hz : dZ (momPsP B f) ξ = 0 := by
      rcases hX with h | h
      · refine hloc (DomC B.h qs ∩ XC B.h ⁻¹' Set.Iio B.m1)
          (hXc.isOpen_inter_preimage hDo isOpen_Iio)
          ⟨hξ, show XC B.h ξ < B.m1 by linarith⟩ ?_
        intro η hη
        by_contra hne
        have e1 := (hMS.2 η hne).1
        have e2 : XC B.h η < B.m1 := hη.2
        linarith
      · refine hloc (DomC B.h qs ∩ XC B.h ⁻¹' Set.Ioi B.m2)
          (hXc.isOpen_inter_preimage hDo isOpen_Ioi)
          ⟨hξ, show B.m2 < XC B.h ξ by linarith⟩ ?_
        intro η hη
        by_contra hne
        have e1 := (hMS.2 η hne).2
        have e2 : B.m2 < XC B.h η := hη.2
        linarith
    show qC B.h ξ ^ Aex B.h * -(dZ (momPsP B f) ξ) = 0
    rw [hz, neg_zero, mul_zero]
  · 
    intro k
    choose Cf bf df hCf using hfb
    choose QA hQA using nb_qpow_v4 B qs (Aex B.h) hok hSN hqs0 hqs1
    choose QP hQP using nb_qpow_v4 B qs (1/2 - Aex B.h) hok hSN hqs0 hqs1
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), |Cf j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨bb, hbb⟩ : ∃ bb : ℝ, bb = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), |bf j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨dd, hdd⟩ : ∃ dd : ℝ, dd = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), |df j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨KP, hKP⟩ : ∃ KP : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ i, KP i =
        (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose l : ℝ) * |QP l|) * M := ⟨fun i => _, fun i => rfl⟩
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by rw [hM]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
    refine ⟨∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose j : ℝ) * |QA j| * KP (k - j + 1), bb, dd, ?_⟩
    intro ξ hξ hX1 hX2
    have hq := hqpos ξ hξ
    have hSC1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
      unfold SC; exact one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))])
    have hED0 : 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) := by
      have hX0 : 0 < XC B.h ξ := lt_trans hXa hX1
      unfold edgeDist
      exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX1))
        (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr hX2)))
    have hED1 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ≤ 1 := by unfold edgeDist; exact min_le_left _ _
    have hEW : 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) := by
      unfold edgeWeight
      split_ifs
      · positivity
      · exact le_rfl
    obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ, W = SC B.h ξ ^ bb * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
        edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-dd) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ, T = qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * W := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hqa : 0 < qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _
    have hfM : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k + 1 → NB B.h f j ξ ≤ M * T := by
      intro j hj
      have hjm : j ∈ Finset.range (k + 2) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
      have hC : |Cf j| ≤ M := by
        rw [hM]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cf i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) hjm
      have hb : |bf j| ≤ bb := by
        rw [hbb]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |bf i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) hjm
      have hd : |df j| ≤ dd := by
        rw [hdd]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |df i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) hjm
      have e1 : SC B.h ξ ^ bf j ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bb :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hSC1 ((le_abs_self _).trans hb)
      have e2 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df j) ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-dd) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hED0 hED1 (by linarith [le_abs_self (df j)])
      have hS1 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bf j := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have hE1 : 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df j) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hED0 _
      have a1 : Cf j * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bf j *
          edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df j) ≤
          M * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bf j *
          edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df j) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hE1.le
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hEW
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hS1
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ((le_abs_self _).trans hC) hqa.le
      have a2 : M * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bf j *
          edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df j) ≤
          M * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bb *
          edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-dd) := by
        apply mul_le_mul _ e2 hE1.le
          (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hM0 hqa.le) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)) hEW)
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hEW
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e1 (mul_nonneg hM0 hqa.le)
      calc NB B.h f j ξ ≤ _ := hCf j ξ hξ hX1 hX2
        _ ≤ _ := a1

by
  intro B qs Pt Jt Jzt ΦP ΦJ Ψ Ψt dv dPsi hok hqsB hpatch hdg cP cJ cΨ cΨt sP sJ sΨ sΨt hΨtd
    i1 i2 i3 i4 i5 i6 i7 i8 hdv hdPsi z t ht hq
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -, hqB0, hqB1, hlam, hcp, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨q, hqd⟩ : ∃ q, q = simScale B.h z (1 - t) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by rw [hqd]; exact (hok.1.1 z (1 - t) (by linarith)).1
  obtain ⟨s, hsd⟩ : ∃ s, s = Real.sqrt q := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by rw [hsd]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq0
  have hsne : s ≠ 0 := hs0.ne'
  have hss : s ^ 2 = q := by rw [hsd]; exact Real.sq_sqrt hq0.le
  have ha0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have ha2 : Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) ^ 2 = 2 * B.m1 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hb2 : Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) ^ 2 = 2 * B.m2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c, c = q ^ (-Aex B.h) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ : ∃ k, k = (1 + (z * q ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))) ^ 2) / B.cpatch := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hκ0 : 0 < κ := by rw [hκ]; exact div_pos (by positivity) hcp
  obtain ⟨P0, hP0⟩ : ∃ v, v = nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h) Pt (z, t) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨J0, hJ0⟩ : ∃ v, v = nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h - 3/2) Jt (z, t) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Z0, hZ0⟩ : ∃ v, v = nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h - 1) Jzt (z, t) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have e1 : ∀ x : ℝ, ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, qC B.h (s * x, z, t, Y) = q := fun x Y => by rw [hqd]; rfl
  have e1' : ∀ x : ℝ, ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, Real.sqrt (qC B.h (s * x, z, t, Y)) = s := fun x Y => by
    rw [e1, hsd]
  have e2 : ∀ x : ℝ, ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, etaC B.h (s * x, z, t, Y) = z * q ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) := fun x Y => by
    rw [hqd]; rfl
  have e3 : ∀ x : ℝ, s * x / s = x := fun x => by field_simp
  
  have hsubst : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ) (e : ℕ),
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, f (s * x, z, t, Y) = F x) →
      radMom f e z t = s ^ (e + 1) * ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), x ^ e * F x := by
    intro f F e hf
    have hvol : (volume (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)).toReal = 1 := by
      rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod, Measure.prod_prod, Real.volume_Icc]; simp
    have hsi : 0 < s⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hs0
    have h1 : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ e * yAvg f (r, z, t, 0) =
        (s * (s⁻¹ * r)) ^ e * F (s⁻¹ * r) := by
      intro r hr
      have hsr : s * (s⁻¹ * r) = r := by rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hsne, one_mul]
      have hY : ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, f (r, z, t, Y) =

        apply setIntegral_congr_fun (measurableSet_Icc.prod measurableSet_Icc)
        intro Y _
        have := hf (s⁻¹ * r) (mul_pos hsi hr) Y
        rw [hsr] at this
        exact this
      show r ^ e * (∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, f (r, z, t, Y)) = _
      rw [hY, setIntegral_const, measureReal_def, hvol, one_smul, hsr]
    have key : ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), (s * (s⁻¹ * x)) ^ e * F (s⁻¹ * x) =

      integral_comp_mul_left_Ioi (fun x => (s * x) ^ e * F x) 0 hsi
    unfold radMom
    rw [setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi h1, key, mul_zero, inv_inv, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [show (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), (s * x) ^ e * F x) =
        ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), s ^ e * (x ^ e * F x) from by congr 1; funext x; ring]
    rw [integral_const_mul]; ring
  
  have pw_dv : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ,
      momDvP B dv (s * x, z, t, Y) = c * ((-κ) * P0 * ΦP x + κ * Z0 * ΦJ x) := by
    intro x hx Y
    unfold momDvP
    rw [hdv]
    dsimp only
    rw [e1', e1, e2, e3, hc, hκ, hP0, hZ0]
  have pw_dg : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ,
      momDgP B dPsi (s * x, z, t, Y) = c * ((-κ) * J0 * Ψt x) := by
    intro x hx Y
    have hmem : ((s * x, z, t, Y) : Cyl) ∈ DomC B.h qs :=
      show 0 < s * x ∧ t < 1 ∧ qC B.h (s * x, z, t, Y) < qs from
        ⟨mul_pos hs0 hx, ht, by rw [e1, hqd]; exact hq⟩
    rw [hdg _ hmem]
    dsimp only
    rw [e1', e1, e2, e3, hc, hκ, hJ0]
  have upatch : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ,
      Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) < x ∧ x < Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) →
      ubase B (s * x, z, t, Y) 1 = c * (κ⁻¹ * (x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + B.lam))) ∧
      ubase B (s * x, z, t, Y) 2 = 0 := by
    intro x hx Y hab
    have hXC : XC B.h (s * x, z, t, Y) = x ^ 2 / 2 := by
      show (s * x) ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h (s * x, z, t, Y)) = x ^ 2 / 2
      rw [e1, mul_pow, hss, div_eq_div_iff (mul_pos two_pos hq0).ne' two_ne_zero]
      ring
    have hx2a := pow_lt_pow_left₀ hab.1 ha0.le two_ne_zero
    have hx2b := pow_lt_pow_left₀ hab.2 hx.le two_ne_zero
    have hqB : qC B.h (s * x, z, t, Y) < B.qB := by
      rw [e1, hqd]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hq hqsB
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hpatch (s * x, z, t, Y) (mul_pos hs0 hx) ht hqB
      (by rw [hXC]; linarith) (by rw [hXC]; linarith)
    refine ⟨?_, h2⟩
    rw [h1, hXC, e1, e2, hc, hκ, Aex]
    field_simp
  have pw_u1dv : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ,
      ubase B (s * x, z, t, Y) 1 * momDvP B dv (s * x, z, t, Y) =
        c ^ 2 * ((-P0) * ((x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + B.lam)) * ΦP x) +
          Z0 * ((x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + B.lam)) * ΦJ x)) ∧
      ubase B (s * x, z, t, Y) 2 * momDvP B dv (s * x, z, t, Y) = 0 := by
    intro x hx Y
    rw [pw_dv x hx Y]
    by_cases hZ : ΦP x = 0 ∧ ΦJ x = 0
    · rw [hZ.1, hZ.2]; constructor <;> ring
    · have hab : Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) < x ∧ x < Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) := by
        by_cases h1 : ΦP x = 0
        · exact sJ x (fun h2 => hZ ⟨h1, h2⟩)
        · exact sP x h1
      obtain ⟨hU1, hU2⟩ := upatch x hx Y hab
      have hk : κ⁻¹ * κ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hκ0.ne'
      rw [hU1, hU2]
      constructor
      · linear_combination (c ^ 2 * (x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + B.lam)) * (-P0 * ΦP x + Z0 * ΦJ x)) * hk
      · ring
  have pw_udg : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ,
      ubase B (s * x, z, t, Y) 1 * momDgP B dPsi (s * x, z, t, Y) =

      ubase B (s * x, z, t, Y) 2 * momDgP B dPsi (s * x, z, t, Y) = 0 := by
    intro x hx Y
    rw [pw_dg x hx Y]
    by_cases hZ : Ψt x = 0
    · rw [hZ]; constructor <;> ring
    · obtain ⟨hU1, hU2⟩ := upatch x hx Y (sΨt x hZ)
      have hk : κ⁻¹ * κ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hκ0.ne'
      rw [hU1, hU2]
      constructor
      · linear_combination (-(c ^ 2 * J0 * ((x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + B.lam)) * Ψt x))) * hk

  have hsr : s = q ^ ((1:ℝ)/2) := by rw [hsd, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]

    convert Real.rpow_zero q using 2

  have key5 : s ^ 2 * c ^ 2 * q ^ (2 * Aex B.h - 1) = 1 := by
    rw [hsr, hc, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hq0.le,
      ← Real.rpow_mul hq0.le, ← Real.rpow_add hq0, ← Real.rpow_add hq0]
    convert Real.rpow_zero q using 2

  have hcI : ∀ (g Φ : ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2))) →

    refine IntegrableOn.of_forall_diff_eq_zero ((hg.mul hΦ.continuousOn).integrableOn_Icc)
      measurableSet_Ioi ?_
    intro x hx
    by_contra hne
    have h0 : Φ x ≠ 0 := fun h => hne (by simp [h])
    exact hx.2 ⟨(hsupp x h0).1.le, (hsupp x h0).2.le⟩
  have hWc : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => (x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + B.lam)))

  have hP3 : IntegrableOn (fun x => 2 * (x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + B.lam)) / x * ΦP x) (Set.Ioi 0) :=

      integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, i1, i2]
    ring
  have E2 : radMom (momDgP B dPsi) 1 z t = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, F = fun x => c * ((-κ) * J0 * Ψt x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [hsubst (momDgP B dPsi) F 1 (fun x hx Y => by simp only [hF]; exact pw_dg x hx Y)]
    rw [show (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), x ^ 1 * F x) = ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ),
        (c * (-κ) * J0) * (x * Ψt x) from by
      congr 1; funext x; simp only [hF]; ring]
    rw [integral_const_mul, i7]
    ring
  have E3 : radMom (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 1 * momDvP B dv η / η.1) 0 z t = -Pt z t := by
    obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, F = fun x => c ^ 2 / s *
        ((-P0) * (2 * (x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + B.lam)) / x * ΦP x) +
          Z0 * (2 * (x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + B.lam)) / x * ΦJ x)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have pw : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ,
        (fun η : Cyl => 2 * ubase B η 1 * momDvP B dv η / η.1) (s * x, z, t, Y) = F x := by
      intro x hx Y
      show 2 * ubase B (s * x, z, t, Y) 1 * momDvP B dv (s * x, z, t, Y) / (s * x) = F x
      rw [show 2 * ubase B (s * x, z, t, Y) 1 * momDvP B dv (s * x, z, t, Y) / (s * x) =
          2 * (ubase B (s * x, z, t, Y) 1 * momDvP B dv (s * x, z, t, Y)) / (s * x) from by ring,
        (pw_u1dv x hx Y).1]
      simp only [hF]
      field_simp
    rw [hsubst (fun η : Cyl => 2 * ubase B η 1 * momDvP B dv η / η.1) F 0 pw]
    rw [show (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), x ^ 0 * F x) = ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ),
        ((c ^ 2 / s * (-P0)) * (2 * (x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + B.lam)) / x * ΦP x) +
          (c ^ 2 / s * Z0) * (2 * (x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + B.lam)) / x * ΦJ x)) from by
      congr 1; funext x; simp only [hF]; ring]
    rw [integral_add (Integrable.const_mul hP3 _) (Integrable.const_mul hJ3 _),
      integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, i3, i4]
    simp only [hP0, nrmS]
    rw [← hqd]
    field_simp
    linear_combination (-(s * Pt z t)) * key3
  have E4 : radMom (fun η => ubase B η 2 * momDvP B dv η + ubase B η 1 * momDgP B dPsi η) 2 z t =
      -Jt z t := by
    obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ,
        F = fun x => -(c ^ 2 * J0 * ((x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + B.lam)) * Ψt x)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have pw : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ,
        (fun η : Cyl => ubase B η 2 * momDvP B dv η + ubase B η 1 * momDgP B dPsi η)
          (s * x, z, t, Y) = F x := by
      intro x hx Y
      show ubase B (s * x, z, t, Y) 2 * momDvP B dv (s * x, z, t, Y) +
        ubase B (s * x, z, t, Y) 1 * momDgP B dPsi (s * x, z, t, Y) = F x
      rw [(pw_u1dv x hx Y).2, (pw_udg x hx Y).1, zero_add, hF]
    rw [hsubst (fun η : Cyl => ubase B η 2 * momDvP B dv η + ubase B η 1 * momDgP B dPsi η) F 2 pw]
    rw [show (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), x ^ 2 * F x) = ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ),
        (-(c ^ 2 * J0)) * (x ^ 2 * (x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + B.lam)) * Ψt x) from by
      congr 1; funext x; simp only [hF]; ring]
    rw [integral_const_mul, i8]
    simp only [hJ0, nrmS]
    rw [← hqd]
    linear_combination (-(Jt z t)) * key4
  have E5 : radMom (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 2 * momDgP B dPsi η - ubase B η 1 * momDvP B dv η) 1 z t =
      -Jzt z t := by
    obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, F = fun x => -(c ^ 2 * ((-P0) * ((x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + B.lam)) * ΦP x) +
        Z0 * ((x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + B.lam)) * ΦJ x))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have pw : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ,
        (fun η : Cyl => 2 * ubase B η 2 * momDgP B dPsi η - ubase B η 1 * momDvP B dv η)
          (s * x, z, t, Y) = F x := by
      intro x hx Y
      show 2 * ubase B (s * x, z, t, Y) 2 * momDgP B dPsi (s * x, z, t, Y) -
        ubase B (s * x, z, t, Y) 1 * momDvP B dv (s * x, z, t, Y) = F x
      rw [mul_assoc (2:ℝ), (pw_udg x hx Y).2, (pw_u1dv x hx Y).1]
      simp only [hF]
      ring
    rw [hsubst (fun η : Cyl => 2 * ubase B η 2 * momDgP B dPsi η - ubase B η 1 * momDvP B dv η) F 1 pw]
    rw [show (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), x ^ 1 * F x) = ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ),
        ((c ^ 2 * P0) * (x * (x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + B.lam)) * ΦP x) +
          (-(c ^ 2 * Z0)) * (x * (x ^ 2 / 2) ^ (-(1/2 + B.lam)) * ΦJ x)) from by
      congr 1; funext x; simp only [hF]; ring]
    rw [integral_add (Integrable.const_mul hP5 _) (Integrable.const_mul hJ5 _),
      integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, i5, i6]
    simp only [hZ0, nrmS]
    rw [← hqd]
    linear_combination (-(Jzt z t)) * key5
  exact ⟨E1, E2, E3, E4, E5⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (d s1 s2 : ℝ), 1 ≤ d → d ≤ 2 → 0 < s1 → s1 < s2 → ∀ p : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (n : ℕ) (ρ M : ℝ) (F : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ) (W : ℝ × ℝ), 0 < ρ → ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → (∀ (s : ℝ) (Y c : ℝ × ℝ), (∃ i j : ℤ, Jpow (n:ℤ) c = ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))) → F (s, Y + c) = F (s, Y)) → (∀ (s : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), (s ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ s) → F (s, Y) = 0) → (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 3 * p + 6 → ∀ (s : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F (s, Y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (JpowL (-(n:ℤ))))‖ ≤ M) → |∫ s in s1..s2, (F (s, W + (ρ ^ d * s ^ d) • vrv) - ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, F (s, Y))| ≤ C * M * (Lgc ^ n * ρ ^ d) ^ (-(p:ℝ))

signature.statement: ∀ (d s1 s2 : ℝ), 1 ≤ d → d ≤ 2 → 0 < s1 → s1 < s2 → ∀ p : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (n : ℕ) (ρ M : ℝ) (F : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ) (W : ℝ × ℝ), 0 < ρ → ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → (∀ (s : ℝ) (Y c : ℝ × ℝ), (∃ i j : ℤ, Jpow (n:ℤ) c = ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))) → F (s, Y + c) = F (s, Y)) → (∀ (s : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), (s ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ s) → F (s, Y) = 0) → (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 3 * p + 6 → ∀ (s : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F (s, Y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (JpowL (-(n:ℤ))))‖ ≤ M) → |∫ s in s1..s2, (F (s, W + (ρ ^ d * s ^ d) • vrv) - ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, F (s, Y))| ≤ C * M * (Lgc ^ n * ρ ^ d) ^ (-(p:ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro d s1 s2 hd1 _hd2 hs1 hs12 p
  
  have hsq2 : Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hsq0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
  have hsqlt : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := by nlinarith
  have hL : 0 < Lgc := by unfold Lgc; linarith
  have hT : 0 < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; linarith
  have hD : 0 < 1 + bgc ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hDne : 1 + bgc ^ 2 ≠ 0 := hD.ne'
  
  have hJcomp : ∀ (a b : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), Jpow a (Jpow b Y) = Jpow (a + b) Y := by
    intro a b Y
    ext <;> simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, Prod.mk_add_mk, smul_eq_mul, zpow_add₀ hL.ne',
      zpow_add₀ hT.ne'] <;> field_simp <;> ring
  have hJ0 : ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, Jpow 0 Y = Y := by
    intro Y
    ext <;> simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, Prod.mk_add_mk, smul_eq_mul, zpow_zero, one_mul] <;>
      field_simp <;> ring
  have hJL : ∀ (a : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), JpowL a Y = Jpow a Y := by
    intro a Y
    ext <;> simp [JpowL, Jpow, vrv, vtv] <;> ring
  
  have hbad : ∀ m : ℤ × ℤ, m ≠ 0 → 1 ≤ |(m.1:ℝ) - bgc * (m.2:ℝ)| * (|(m.1:ℝ)| + 3 * |(m.2:ℝ)|) := by
    intro m hm
    obtain ⟨m1, m2⟩ := m
    show 1 ≤ |(m1:ℝ) - bgc * (m2:ℝ)| * (|(m1:ℝ)| + 3 * |(m2:ℝ)|)
    have hkey : ((m1:ℝ) - bgc * (m2:ℝ)) * ((m1:ℝ) + (Real.sqrt 2 + 1) * (m2:ℝ)) =
        ((m1 ^ 2 + 2 * m1 * m2 - m2 ^ 2 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      simp only [bgc]; push_cast; linear_combination (-(m2:ℝ) ^ 2) * hsq2
    have hKz : (m1 ^ 2 + 2 * m1 * m2 - m2 ^ 2 : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      by_cases hm2 : m2 = 0
      · subst hm2
        simp at h0
        exact hm (by simp [h0])
      · have hq : ((m1:ℝ) + (m2:ℝ)) ^ 2 = 2 * (m2:ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          have h0' : ((m1 ^ 2 + 2 * m1 * m2 - m2 ^ 2 : ℤ) : ℝ) = 0 := by exact_mod_cast h0
          push_cast at h0'
          linarith
        have hb' : (m2:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hm2
        have hq' : ((((m1 + m2 : ℤ) : ℚ) / (m2 : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) ^ 2 = 2 := by
          push_cast
          field_simp
          linarith
        have h2 : Real.sqrt 2 = ((|(((m1 + m2 : ℤ) : ℚ) / (m2 : ℚ))| : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
          rw [← hq', Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]; push_cast; rfl
        exact irrational_sqrt_two.ne_rat _ h2
    have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ |((m1 ^ 2 + 2 * m1 * m2 - m2 ^ 2 : ℤ) : ℝ)| := by
      exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hKz
    rw [← hkey, abs_mul] at h1
    have h2 : |(m1:ℝ) + (Real.sqrt 2 + 1) * (m2:ℝ)| ≤ |(m1:ℝ)| + 3 * |(m2:ℝ)| := by
      calc _ ≤ |(m1:ℝ)| + |(Real.sqrt 2 + 1) * (m2:ℝ)| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |(m1:ℝ)| + (Real.sqrt 2 + 1) * |(m2:ℝ)| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (show (0:ℝ) < Real.sqrt 2 + 1 by positivity)]
        _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (m2:ℝ)]
    calc (1:ℝ) ≤ _ := h1
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (abs_nonneg _)
  
  have hφ : Summable (fun k : ℤ => 1 / (1 + |(k:ℝ)|) ^ 2) := by
    have hn : Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) := by
      have := (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr (Real.summable_one_div_nat_pow.mpr one_lt_two)
      simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using this
    rw [summable_int_iff_summable_nat_and_neg]
    constructor
    · refine hn.congr (fun n => ?_)
      simp [add_comm]
    · refine hn.congr (fun n => ?_)
      simp [add_comm]
  have hw2 : Summable (fun m : ℤ × ℤ => 1 / ((1 + |(m.1:ℝ)|) ^ 2 * (1 + |(m.2:ℝ)|) ^ 2)) := by
    have := Summable.mul_of_nonneg hφ hφ (fun k => by simp only [Pi.zero_apply]; positivity)
      (fun k => by simp only [Pi.zero_apply]; positivity)
    refine this.congr (fun m => ?_)
    rw [one_div_mul_one_div]
  
  have arith : ∀ (X a b μ Q : ℝ), 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → 0 < Q → 1 ≤ |μ| * (a + 3 * b) →
      X / ((1 + a) ^ (p + 2) * (1 + b) ^ (p + 2)) / (Q ^ p * |μ| ^ p) ≤
        X * 3 ^ p / Q ^ p * (1 / ((1 + a) ^ 2 * (1 + b) ^ 2)) := by
    intro X a b μ Q hX ha hb hQ h6
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : ℝ, u = (1 + a) * (1 + b) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hu1 : 1 ≤ u := by rw [hu]; nlinarith
    have hu0 : 0 < u := by linarith
    have h3 : a + 3 * b ≤ 3 * u := by rw [hu]; nlinarith
    have hμu : 1 ≤ 3 * u * |μ| := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (abs_nonneg μ)]
    have hμ0 : 0 < |μ| := by
      rcases (abs_nonneg μ).lt_or_eq with h | h
      · exact h
      · rw [← h] at hμu; linarith
    have e1 : (1 + a) ^ (p + 2) * (1 + b) ^ (p + 2) = u ^ 2 * u ^ p := by
      rw [← mul_pow, ← hu]; ring
    have e2 : (1 + a) ^ 2 * (1 + b) ^ 2 = u ^ 2 := by rw [← mul_pow, ← hu]
    have hpow : 1 ≤ (3 * u * |μ|) ^ p := one_le_pow₀ hμu
    rw [e1, e2, div_div, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    have e3 : X * 3 ^ p / Q ^ p * (1 / u ^ 2) * (u ^ 2 * u ^ p * (Q ^ p * |μ| ^ p)) =
        X * (3 * u * |μ|) ^ p := by
      field_simp; ring
    rw [e3]
    exact le_mul_of_one_le_right hX hpow
  
  obtain ⟨K, hK0, hK⟩ := power_subst_v5 d s1 s2 hd1 hs1 hs12 p
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hw2
  have hd0 : 0 < d := by linarith
  have hαβ : s1 ^ d < s2 ^ d := Real.rpow_lt_rpow hs1.le hs12 hd0
  refine ⟨(s2 ^ d - s1 ^ d) * K * 4 ^ (p + 2) * 3 ^ p * S / (2 * Real.pi) ^ p, ?_⟩
  intro n ρ M F W hρ hF hper hsupp hbd
  
  set G : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ := fun x => F (x.1, JpowL (-(n:ℤ)) x.2) with hGdef
  have hGΛ : G = F ∘ ⇑((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (JpowL (-(n:ℤ)))) := by
    funext x; rfl
  have hGs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G := by
    rw [hGΛ]; exact hF.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.contDiff _)
  have hGb : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 3 * p + 6 → ∀ x : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k G x‖ ≤ M := by
    intro k hk x
    rw [hGΛ, ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right _ hF x (by exact_mod_cast le_top)]
    exact hbd k hk x.1 (JpowL (-(n:ℤ)) x.2)
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hbd 0 (by omega) 0 0)
  have hGper : ∀ (s : ℝ) (Z : ℝ × ℝ) (i j : ℤ), G (s, Z + ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))) = G (s, Z) := by
    intro s Z i j
    show F (s, JpowL (-(n:ℤ)) (Z + ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ)))) = F (s, JpowL (-(n:ℤ)) Z)
    rw [map_add]
    apply hper
    refine ⟨i, j, ?_⟩
    rw [hJL, hJcomp, add_neg_cancel, hJ0]
  have hFG : ∀ (s : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), F (s, Y) = G (s, Jpow (n:ℤ) Y) := by
    intro s Y
    show F (s, Y) = F (s, JpowL (-(n:ℤ)) (Jpow (n:ℤ) Y))
    rw [hJL, hJcomp, neg_add_cancel, hJ0]
  have hJpath : ∀ t : ℝ, Jpow (n:ℤ) (W + t • vrv) = Jpow (n:ℤ) W + (Lgc ^ n * t) • vrv := by
    intro t
    ext <;> simp [Jpow, vrv, vtv, zpow_natCast] <;> field_simp <;> ring
  have hGc : ∀ s : ℝ, Continuous (fun Z : ℝ × ℝ => G (s, Z)) := fun s =>
    hGs.continuous.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  have hmean : ∀ s : ℝ, ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, F (s, Y) =
      ∫ Z in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, G (s, Z) := by
    intro s
    have h2 := torus_mean_jpow_invariant_v5 n (fun Z => G (s, Z)) (hGc s) (fun Z i j => hGper s Z i j)
    calc ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, F (s, Y)
        = ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, G (s, Jpow (n:ℤ) Y) := by
          congr 1; funext Y; exact hFG s Y
      _ = _ := h2
  obtain ⟨Ω, hΩ⟩ : ∃ Ω : ℝ, Ω = Lgc ^ n * ρ ^ d := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hΩ]
  have hΩ0 : 0 < Ω := by rw [hΩ]; exact mul_pos (pow_pos hL n) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ d)
  have hΩne : Ω ≠ 0 := hΩ0.ne'
  have hpine : Real.pi ≠ 0 := Real.pi_ne_zero
  set W' : ℝ × ℝ := Jpow (n:ℤ) W with hW'
  set Zs : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ := fun s => W' + (Ω * s ^ d) • vrv with hZs
  have hpath : ∀ s : ℝ, F (s, W + (ρ ^ d * s ^ d) • vrv) = G (s, Zs s) := by
    intro s
    rw [hFG, hJpath]
    have e : Lgc ^ n * (ρ ^ d * s ^ d) = Ω * s ^ d := by rw [hΩ]; ring
    rw [e]
  
  set c : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ → ℂ := fun m s => ∫ Z in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
    (G (s, Z) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-(2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ((m.1 : ℂ) * (Z.1 : ℂ) + (m.2 : ℂ) * (Z.2 : ℂ))))
    with hcdef
  have hbox := box_coef_decay_v5 (p + 2) p M G hGs hGper (fun k hk x => hGb k (by omega) x)
  have hcs : ∀ m, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (c m) := fun m => (hbox m).1
  have hcd : ∀ m : ℤ × ℤ, ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p → ∀ s, ‖iteratedDeriv j (c m) s‖ ≤
      4 ^ (p + 2) * M / ((1 + |(m.1:ℝ)|) ^ (p + 2) * (1 + |(m.2:ℝ)|) ^ (p + 2)) := fun m => (hbox m).2
  have hw2le : ∀ m : ℤ × ℤ, (1 + |(m.1:ℝ)|) ^ 2 * (1 + |(m.2:ℝ)|) ^ 2 ≤
      (1 + |(m.1:ℝ)|) ^ (p + 2) * (1 + |(m.2:ℝ)|) ^ (p + 2) := by
    intro m
    have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + |(m.1:ℝ)| := by linarith [abs_nonneg (m.1:ℝ)]
    have h2 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + |(m.2:ℝ)| := by linarith [abs_nonneg (m.2:ℝ)]
    exact mul_le_mul (pow_le_pow_right₀ h1 (by omega)) (pow_le_pow_right₀ h2 (by omega))
      (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have h4M : 0 ≤ 4 ^ (p + 2) * M := mul_nonneg (by positivity) hM0
  have hc0b : ∀ m s, ‖c m s‖ ≤ 4 ^ (p + 2) * M / ((1 + |(m.1:ℝ)|) ^ 2 * (1 + |(m.2:ℝ)|) ^ 2) := by
    intro m s
    have := hcd m 0 (Nat.zero_le _) s
    rw [iteratedDeriv_zero] at this
    exact this.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left h4M (by positivity) (hw2le m))
  have hcsupp : ∀ m s, (s ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ s) → c m s = 0 := by
    intro m s hs
    simp only [hcdef, hGdef, fun Y => hsupp s Y hs, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul,
      MeasureTheory.integral_zero]
  have hc0 : ∀ s, c 0 s = ((∫ Z in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, G (s, Z) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro s
    rw [← integral_complex_ofReal]
    simp only [hcdef, Prod.fst_zero, Prod.snd_zero, Int.cast_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, mul_zero,
      neg_zero, Complex.exp_zero, mul_one]
  have hexpn : ∀ (m : ℤ × ℤ) (Z : ℝ × ℝ),
      ‖Complex.exp (2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ((m.1 : ℂ) * (Z.1 : ℂ) + (m.2 : ℂ) * (Z.2 : ℂ)))‖ = 1 := by

  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ : ∃ l : ℕ, l = l' - 4 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hlR : (l:ℝ) = l' - 4 := by rw [hl, Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]; norm_num
  have hl7 : 7 ≤ l := by omega
  have hlR7 : (7:ℝ) ≤ l := by exact_mod_cast hl7
  have hu1' : -Real.log q ≤ ((l:ℝ) + 4) * Real.log 2 := by
    have e : (l:ℝ) + 4 = l' := by linarith
    rw [e]; exact hu1
  have hu2' : ((l:ℝ) + 3) * Real.log 2 < -Real.log q := by
    have e : (l:ℝ) + 3 = l' - 1 := by linarith
    rw [e]; exact hu2
  have hcI : coarseIdx h q = ⌊φ l / Real.log Tgc⌋ := by
    rw [← hφdef l (by omega)]; unfold coarseIdx; rw [← hl', ← hl]
  have hφl : 0 ≤ φ l := le_trans hφ4 (hmono 4 l (by norm_num) (by omega))
  have hn1 : ((coarseIdx h q : ℤ) : ℝ) * Real.log Tgc ≤ φ l := by
    rw [hcI]; exact (le_div_iff₀ hlT0).mp (Int.floor_le _)
  have hn2 : φ l - Real.log Tgc < ((coarseIdx h q : ℤ) : ℝ) * Real.log Tgc := by
    rw [hcI]
    have h1 := Int.sub_one_lt_floor (φ l / Real.log Tgc)
    have h' : φ l / Real.log Tgc < (⌊φ l / Real.log Tgc⌋ : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hlT0] at h'
    linarith
  have hloglnn : 0 ≤ Real.log (l:ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hlogl : Real.log (l:ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 + Real.log (1 + -Real.log q) := by
    rw [← Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hu0.ne']
    apply Real.log_le_log (by linarith)
    have h12 : (1:ℝ)/2 < Real.log 2 := by have := Real.log_two_gt_d9; linarith
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h12.le (show (0:ℝ) ≤ l by linarith)]
  
  have hii : Tgc ^ (coarseIdx h q) ≤ q ^ (-(2:ℝ)) := by
    rw [← Real.log_le_log_iff (zpow_pos hT0 _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _), Real.log_zpow,
      Real.log_rpow hq0]
    have hA : 0 ≤ (l:ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by positivity
    have hB : (1 + h) * ((l:ℝ) * Real.log 2) ≤ 2 * ((l:ℝ) * Real.log 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hA
    rw [hφv] at hn1
    nlinarith
  
  have habs : |Real.log q| = -Real.log q := abs_of_neg hlq
  have h64 : Real.log 64 = 6 * Real.log 2 := by
    rw [show (64:ℝ) = 2 ^ 6 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]; norm_num
  have hiii : (64 * Tgc)⁻¹ * q ^ (-(h * kapS)) * (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ (-(2:ℝ)) ≤
      Lgc ^ (coarseIdx h q) * q ^ (drx h / 2) := by
    rw [habs]
    have hP1 : 0 < (64 * Tgc)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (by linarith)
    have hP2 : 0 < q ^ (-(h * kapS)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _
    have hP3 : 0 < (1 + -Real.log q) ^ (-(2:ℝ)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hu0 _
    have hR1 : 0 < Lgc ^ (coarseIdx h q) := zpow_pos hL0 _
    have hR2 : 0 < q ^ (drx h / 2) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _
    rw [← Real.log_le_log_iff (mul_pos (mul_pos hP1 hP2) hP3) (mul_pos hR1 hR2),
      Real.log_mul (mul_pos hP1 hP2).ne' hP3.ne', Real.log_mul hP1.ne' hP2.ne',
      Real.log_inv, Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hT0.ne', h64, Real.log_rpow hq0,
      Real.log_rpow hu0, Real.log_mul hR1.ne' hR2.ne', Real.log_zpow, Real.log_rpow hq0, hdrx]
    have hA := hn2
    rw [hφv] at hA
    have hnL : ((coarseIdx h q : ℤ) : ℝ) * Real.log Lgc =
        θ * (((coarseIdx h q : ℤ) : ℝ) * Real.log Tgc) := by rw [← hθb]; ring
    have hθ0' : 0 ≤ θ := by linarith
    have f1 : θ * ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ) * Real.log 2 - 2 * Real.log (l:ℝ) - Real.log Tgc) ≤
        θ * (((coarseIdx h q : ℤ) : ℝ) * Real.log Tgc) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA.le hθ0'
    have f2 : θ * Real.log Tgc ≤ Real.log Tgc := mul_le_of_le_one_left hlT0.le (by linarith)
    have f3 : (1 + h) * θ * (-Real.log q - 4 * Real.log 2) ≤ (1 + h) * θ * ((l:ℝ) * Real.log 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hθ0
    have f4 : (1 + h) * θ * (4 * Real.log 2) ≤ 4 * Real.log 2 :=
      mul_le_of_le_one_left (by linarith) hθh3
    have f5 : θ * Real.log (l:ℝ) ≤ Real.log (l:ℝ) := mul_le_of_le_one_left hloglnn (by linarith)
    rw [hnL]
    nlinarith [f1, f2, f3, f4, f5, hlogl]
  refine ⟨?_, hii, hiii, ?_⟩
  · rw [hcI]; exact Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (div_nonneg hφl hlT0.le)
  · have hpow : 0 < (2:ℝ) ^ (-((l':ℝ) - 1)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _
    have hqlt : q < (2:ℝ) ^ (-((l':ℝ) - 1)) := by
      rw [← Real.log_lt_log_iff hq0 hpow, Real.log_rpow two_pos]; linarith
    refine ⟨(2:ℝ) ^ (-((l':ℝ) - 1)) - q, by linarith, fun q' hq'0 hq'd => ?_⟩
    have hq'lt : q' < (2:ℝ) ^ (-((l':ℝ) - 1)) := by
      have := (abs_sub_lt_iff.mp hq'd).1; linarith
    have hlog' : Real.log q' < -((l':ℝ) - 1) * Real.log 2 := by
      have := Real.log_lt_log hq'0 hq'lt
      rwa [Real.log_rpow two_pos] at this
    have hx' : ((l' - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) < -Real.log q' / Real.log 2 := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega), lt_div_iff₀ hl2]; push_cast; linarith
    have hb' : l' ≤ bandOf q' := by
      have := Nat.lt_ceil.mpr hx'
      rw [← hbof q' hq'0] at this; omega
    have e1 : coarseIdx h q = bandIdx h l := by unfold coarseIdx; rw [← hl', ← hl]
    have e2 : coarseIdx h q' = bandIdx h (bandOf q' - 4) := rfl
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact hbmono l (bandOf q' - 4) (by omega) (by omega)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h qs e : ℝ) (Φ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ), SimScaleProps h → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ {ζ | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs} → (∀ k N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ), ζ.2.1 < 1 → simScale h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Φ ζ‖ ≤ C * simScale h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) ^ (N : ℝ)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => simScale h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) ^ (-e) * Φ ζ) {ζ | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs} ∧ ∀ k N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ), ζ.2.1 < 1 → simScale h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun ζ' : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => simScale h ζ'.1 (1 - ζ'.2.1) ^ (-e) * Φ ζ') ζ‖ ≤ C * simScale h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) ^ (N : ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h qs e Φ hS hqs0 hqs1 hΦ hflat
  
  have hRpow : ∀ (O : Set (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) (Q : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Q O →
      (∀ p ∈ O, 0 < Q p) → (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ O, Q p ≤ 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Q p‖ ≤ C * Q p ^ (1 - (k : ℝ))) → ∀ e : ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => Q p ^ e) O ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ O, Q p ≤ 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p => Q p ^ e) p‖ ≤ C * Q p ^ (e - 2 * (j : ℝ)) := by
    intro O Q hO hQs hQpos hQb e
    refine ⟨hQs.rpow_const_of_ne (fun p hp => (hQpos p hp).ne'), fun j => ?_⟩
    set A : ℝ := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |Polynomial.eval e (descPochhammer ℝ i)| with hAdef
    have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have hA : ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ j →
        ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun x : ℝ => x ^ e) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) q‖ ≤ A * q ^ (e - (j : ℝ)) := by
      intro q hq0 hq1 i hi
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i isOpen_Ioi (show q ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) from hq0),
        norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate,
        Real.iter_deriv_rpow_const, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul,
        abs_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _)]
      apply mul_le_mul
      · exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Polynomial.eval e (descPochhammer ℝ i)|)
          (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
      · apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1
        have : (i:ℝ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hi
        linarith
      · exact (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _).le
      · exact hA0
    have hQb' : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ k → ∀ p ∈ O, Q p ≤ 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Q p‖ ≤ C * Q p ^ (1 - (k : ℝ)) := by
      intro k
      by_cases hk : 1 ≤ k
      · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hQb k hk
        exact ⟨C, fun _ => hC⟩
      · exact ⟨0, fun h => absurd h hk⟩
    choose C' hC' using hQb'
    set K : ℝ := 1 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |C' k| with hKdef
    have hK1 : 1 ≤ K := by
      have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k (_ : k ∈ Finset.range (j + 1)) => abs_nonneg (C' k))
      linarith
    have hK : ∀ p ∈ O, Q p ≤ 1 → ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ j →
        ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i Q O p‖ ≤ (K / Q p) ^ i := by
      intro p hp hq1 i hi1 hij
      have hq0 := hQpos p hp
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO hp]
      have h1 := hC' i hi1 p hp hq1
      have hCi : |C' i| ≤ K := by
        have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => |C' k|) (fun k _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hij))
        linarith
      have hpow : Q p ^ (1 - (i:ℝ)) = Q p * (Q p ^ i)⁻¹ := by
        rw [Real.rpow_sub hq0, Real.rpow_one, Real.rpow_natCast, div_eq_mul_inv]
      have hqi : 0 < (Q p ^ i)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (pow_pos hq0 i)
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i Q p‖ ≤ C' i * Q p ^ (1 - (i:ℝ)) := h1
        _ ≤ |C' i| * (Q p * (Q p ^ i)⁻¹) := by
            rw [hpow]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (mul_nonneg hq0.le hqi.le)
        _ = Q p * (|C' i| * (Q p ^ i)⁻¹) := by ring
        _ ≤ |C' i| * (Q p ^ i)⁻¹ :=
            mul_le_of_le_one_left (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hqi.le) hq1
        _ ≤ K ^ i * (Q p ^ i)⁻¹ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hCi.trans (le_self_pow₀ hK1 (by omega))) hqi.le
        _ = (K / Q p) ^ i := by rw [div_pow, div_eq_mul_inv]
    refine ⟨(j.factorial : ℝ) * A * K ^ j, fun p hp hq1 => ?_⟩
    have hq0 := hQpos p hp
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => x ^ e) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      (contDiffOn_id (s := Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))).rpow_const_of_ne (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo Q O (Set.Ioi 0) := fun p hp => hQpos p hp
    have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hg hQs (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn hO.uniqueDiffOn hmaps hp (C := A * Q p ^ (e - (j:ℝ))) (D := K / Q p)
      (fun i hi => hA (Q p) hq0 hq1 i hi) (fun i hi1 hij => hK p hp hq1 i hi1 hij)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hO hp] at key
    have e1 : (fun p => Q p ^ e) = (fun x : ℝ => x ^ e) ∘ Q := rfl
    rw [e1]
    refine key.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [div_pow, show e - 2 * (j:ℝ) = (e - j) + -(j:ℝ) by ring, Real.rpow_add hq0,
      Real.rpow_neg hq0.le, Real.rpow_natCast]
    field_simp
  
  have hLeib : ∀ (U : Set (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) (w : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ), IsOpen U →
      (∀ p ∈ U, 0 < w p ∧ w p ≤ 1) → ∀ f : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
      (∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C a : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ U, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f p‖ ≤ C * w p ^ (-a)) →
      ∀ (Cg : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (j N : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ g : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U →
      (∀ (i M : ℕ) (p : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)), p ∈ U → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g p‖ ≤ Cg i M * w p ^ (M : ℝ)) →
      ∀ p ∈ U, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p => f p * g p) p‖ ≤ C * w p ^ (N : ℝ) := by
    intro U w hU hw
    have leib : ∀ (f g : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U →
        ∀ p ∈ U, ∀ n : ℕ,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun p => f p * g p) p‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (n.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f p‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) g p‖ := by
      intro f g hf hg p hp n
      have h := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hf hg hU.uniqueDiffOn hp (n := n)
        (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hU hp] at h
      refine h.trans (le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_))
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hU hp, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (n - i) hU hp]
    have unif : ∀ (F : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ),
        (∀ i : ℕ, ∃ C a : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ U, F i p ≤ C * w p ^ (-a)) →
        ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ C A : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ p ∈ U, F i p ≤ C * w p ^ (-A) := by
      intro F hF n
      choose Cf af hFb using hF
      refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), |Cf i|, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), |af i|,
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _), Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _), ?_⟩
      intro i hi p hp
      obtain ⟨hw0, hw1⟩ := hw p hp
      have hmem : i ∈ Finset.range (n+1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
      have hC : |Cf i| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), |Cf i| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cf i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) hmem
      have hA : |af i| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), |af i| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |af i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) hmem
      have hpow : w p ^ (-af i) ≤ w p ^ (-(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), |af i|)) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hw0 hw1 (by linarith [le_abs_self (af i)])
      calc F i p ≤ Cf i * w p ^ (-af i) := hFb i p hp
        _ ≤ |Cf i| * w p ^ (-af i) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hw0.le _)
        _ ≤ |Cf i| * w p ^ (-(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), |af i|)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (abs_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC (Real.rpow_nonneg hw0.le _)
    intro f hf hb Cg j N
    obtain ⟨C1, A1, hC1, hA1, h1⟩ := unif (fun i p => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f p‖) hb j
    refine ⟨C1 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j+1), (j.choose i : ℝ) * |Cg (j - i) (N + ⌈A1⌉₊)|, ?_⟩
    intro g hg hgb p hp
    obtain ⟨hw0, hw1⟩ := hw p hp
    have hpow : w p ^ (-A1) * w p ^ (((N + ⌈A1⌉₊ : ℕ)) : ℝ) ≤ w p ^ (N : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hw0]
      apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hw0 hw1
      push_cast
      linarith [Nat.le_ceil A1]
    refine (leib f g hf hg p hp j).trans ?_
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_
    have hi' : i ≤ j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
    have b1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f p‖ ≤ C1 * w p ^ (-A1) := h1 i hi' p hp
    have b2 := hgb (j - i) (N + ⌈A1⌉₊) p hp
    have b2' : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j - i) g p‖ ≤
        |Cg (j - i) (N + ⌈A1⌉₊)| * w p ^ (((N + ⌈A1⌉₊ : ℕ)) : ℝ) :=
      b2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hw0.le _))
    have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ (j.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have p1 : 0 ≤ w p ^ (-A1) := Real.rpow_nonneg hw0.le _
    have hK : 0 ≤ (j.choose i : ℝ) * C1 * |Cg (j - i) (N + ⌈A1⌉₊)| :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc hC1) (abs_nonneg _)
    calc (j.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f p‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j - i) g p‖
        ≤ (j.choose i : ℝ) * (C1 * w p ^ (-A1)) *
            (|Cg (j - i) (N + ⌈A1⌉₊)| * w p ^ (((N + ⌈A1⌉₊ : ℕ)) : ℝ)) := by
          apply mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b1 hc) b2' (norm_nonneg _)
          exact mul_nonneg hc (mul_nonneg hC1 p1)
      _ = ((j.choose i : ℝ) * C1 * |Cg (j - i) (N + ⌈A1⌉₊)|) *
            (w p ^ (-A1) * w p ^ (((N + ⌈A1⌉₊ : ℕ)) : ℝ)) := by ring
      _ ≤ ((j.choose i : ℝ) * C1 * |Cg (j - i) (N + ⌈A1⌉₊)|) * w p ^ (N : ℝ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow hK
      _ = C1 * ((j.choose i : ℝ) * |Cg (j - i) (N + ⌈A1⌉₊)|) * w p ^ (N : ℝ) := by ring
  
  obtain ⟨hP1, -, -, hP4, hP5⟩ := hS
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ σ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, σ = fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hO1 : IsOpen {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1} := isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
  have hAcd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((ζ.1, 1 - ζ.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
    contDiff_fst.prodMk (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_snd))
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((ζ.1, 1 - ζ.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
      {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1} (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
    intro ζ hζ
    have h' : ζ.2.1 < 1 := hζ
    exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ζ.2.1 by linarith⟩
  have hQs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => simScale h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1))
      {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1} :=
    hP4.comp hAcd.contDiffOn hmaps
  have hΩo : IsOpen {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs} := by
    have h3 := hQs.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hO1 (isOpen_Iio (a := qs))
    have e : {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs} =
        {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1} ∩
          (fun ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => simScale h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1)) ⁻¹' Iio qs := by
      ext ζ
      exact Iff.rfl
    rw [e]
    exact h3
  have hQd : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ), p.2.1 < 1 →
      simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2.1) ≤ 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2.1)) p‖ ≤
        C * simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2.1) ^ (1 - (k : ℝ)) := by
    intro k hk
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hP5 k hk
    rw [← hσ] at hP4 hC
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
        L = (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).prod
          (-((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp
            (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ × ℝ, c = ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hI : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ), L p + c = ((p.1, 1 - p.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) := by
      intro p
      rw [hL, hc]
      ext
      · simp
      · simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply, Prod.snd_add, neg_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp', Function.comp_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd']
        ring
    have hT : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
    have hTc : IsOpen ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => w + c) ⁻¹' (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ))) :=
      hT.preimage (continuous_id.add continuous_const)
    have hfc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => σ (w + c))
        ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => w + c) ⁻¹' (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ))) :=
      hP4.comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const).contDiffOn (fun w hw => hw)
    have hSo : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => w + c) ⁻¹' (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)))) :=
      hTc.preimage L.continuous
    have hfun : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2.1)) =
        (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => σ (w + c)) ∘ ⇑L := by
      funext x
      show _ = σ (L x + c)
      rw [hI x, hσ]
    refine ⟨C * ‖L‖ ^ k, fun p hp hq1 => ?_⟩
    have hLp : L p ∈ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => w + c) ⁻¹' (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)) := by
      show L p + c ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ))
      rw [hI p]
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - p.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hpS : p ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => w + c) ⁻¹' (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ))) := hLp
    have e1 : iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => σ (w + c)) ∘ ⇑L)
        (⇑L ⁻¹' ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => w + c) ⁻¹' (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)))) p =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => σ (w + c)) ∘ ⇑L) p :=
      iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hSo hpS
    have e2 := L.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right hfc hTc.uniqueDiffOn hSo.uniqueDiffOn hLp
      (i := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 : iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => σ (w + c))
        ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => w + c) ⁻¹' (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ))) (L p) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => σ (w + c)) (L p) :=
      iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hTc hLp
    have e4 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => σ (w + c)) (L p) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k σ (L p + c) := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right k c (L p)
    have key : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2.1)) p =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k σ ((p.1, 1 - p.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
      rw [hfun, ← e1, e2, e3, e4, hI p]
    rw [key]
    have hb := hC p.1 (1 - p.2.1) (by linarith) hq1
    calc ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k σ ((p.1, 1 - p.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L)‖
        ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k σ ((p.1, 1 - p.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)‖ * ∏ _i : Fin k, ‖L‖ :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _
      _ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k σ ((p.1, 1 - p.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)‖ * ‖L‖ ^ k := by
          rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      _ ≤ (C * simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2.1) ^ (1 - (k : ℝ))) * ‖L‖ ^ k :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
      _ = C * ‖L‖ ^ k * simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2.1) ^ (1 - (k : ℝ)) := by ring
  
  have hpos : ∀ p ∈ {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs},
      0 < simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2.1) := fun p hp => (hP1 p.1 (1 - p.2.1) (by linarith [hp.1])).1
  have hle : ∀ p ∈ {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs},
      simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2.1) ≤ 1 := fun p hp => le_trans hp.2.le hqs1
  obtain ⟨hW1, hW2⟩ := hRpow _ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2.1)) hΩo
    (hQs.mono (fun p hp => hp.1)) hpos
    (fun k hk => by
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hQd k hk
      exact ⟨C, fun p hp hq1 => hC p hp.1 hq1⟩) (-e)
  refine ⟨hW1.mul hΦ, fun k N => ?_⟩
  choose Cg hCg using hflat
  have hfb : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C a : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs},
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2.1) ^ (-e)) p‖ ≤
        C * simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2.1) ^ (-a) := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hW2 j
    refine ⟨C, e + 2 * (j : ℝ), fun p hp => ?_⟩
    have := hC p hp (hle p hp)
    rwa [show -(e + 2 * (j : ℝ)) = -e - 2 * (j : ℝ) by ring]
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hLeib _ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2.1)) hΩo
    (fun p hp => ⟨hpos p hp, hle p hp⟩) _ hW1 hfb Cg k N
  exact ⟨C, fun ζ ht hq => hC Φ hΦ (fun i M p hp => hCg i M p hp.1 hp.2) ζ ⟨ht, hq⟩⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ i j : ℤ, f (shY ξ ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))) = f ξ) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => (∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), f (r, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) - radMom f 0 ζ.1 ζ.2.1) {ζ | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs} ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)), ζ.2.1 < 1 → simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs → ∀ v : Fin k → ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ), iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun ζ' : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => (∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), f (r, ζ'.1, ζ'.2.1, ζ'.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) - radMom f 0 ζ'.1 ζ'.2.1) ζ v = ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f (r, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv) (fun i => ((0:ℝ), (v i).1, (v i).2.1, (v i).2.2)) - ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f (r, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, Y) (fun i => ((0:ℝ), (v i).1, (v i).2.1, (v i).2.2)))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have ht3 : ∀ (U : Set Cyl) (f : Cyl → ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ η ∈ U, ∀ a : ℝ × ℝ, shY η a ∈ U) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → (∀ η ∈ U, ∀ i j : ℤ, f (shY η ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))) = f η) →
      ∀ η ∈ U, ∀ (k : ℕ) (v : Fin k → Cyl),
      ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1, Y) v =
      ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1, Y)
        (fun i => ((v i).1, (v i).2.1, (v i).2.2.1, (0 : ℝ × ℝ))) := by
    intro U f hU hsh hf hper η hη k v
    have hSqc : IsCompact (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    have hSqm : MeasurableSet (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1) := measurableSet_Icc.prod measurableSet_Icc
    have hadd : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, x + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y) ∈ U := by
      intro x hx Y
      have h := hsh x hx Y
      have e : x + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y) = shY x Y := by
        simp only [shY]; ext <;> simp
      rw [e]; exact h
    have hcont : ∀ m : ℕ, ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f) U := by
      intro m ξ hξ
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ := hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)
      have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 0 (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f) ξ :=
        h1.iteratedFDeriv_right (by rw [zero_add]; exact_mod_cast le_top)
      exact h2.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have hce : ∀ x : Cyl, Continuous (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => x + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y)) :=
      fun x => by fun_prop
    have hcm : Continuous (fun p : Cyl × (ℝ × ℝ) => p.1 + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), p.2)) := by fun_prop
    have hcY : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ U, Continuous
        (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (x + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y))) :=
      fun m x hx => (hcont m).comp_continuous (hce x) (fun Y => hadd x hx Y)
    have hInt : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ U, IntegrableOn
        (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (x + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y)))
        (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :=
      fun m x hx => (hcY m x hx).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hSqc
    have hcl : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ g : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => Cyl) ℝ,
        continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => Cyl) ℝ g = g.curryLeft := by
      intro m g
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun v => ContinuousMultilinearMap.ext (fun w => ?_))
      rw [continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv_apply, ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryLeft_apply]
    have hder : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ U, HasFDerivAt (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f)
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f y).curryLeft) y := by
      intro m y hy
      have hca : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f y := hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
      have hd := hca.differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv (m := m)
        (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.2 (ENat.natCast_lt_top m))
      have := hd.hasFDerivAt
      rw [fderiv_iteratedFDeriv, Function.comp_apply, hcl] at this
      exact this
    have hstep : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ x₀ ∈ U,
        HasFDerivAt (fun x => ∫ Y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (x + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y)))
          ((∫ Y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f (x₀ + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y))).curryLeft) x₀ := by
      intro m x₀ hx₀
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU x₀ hx₀
      have hcb : Metric.closedBall x₀ (δ / 2) ⊆ U :=
        (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
      have hgc : ContinuousOn
          (fun p : Cyl × (ℝ × ℝ) => iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f (p.1 + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), p.2)))
          (Metric.closedBall x₀ (δ / 2) ×ˢ (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1)) :=
        (hcont (m + 1)).comp hcm.continuousOn (fun p hp => hadd p.1 (hcb hp.1) p.2)
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := ((isCompact_closedBall x₀ (δ / 2)).prod hSqc).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hgc
      have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable
          (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f (x₀ + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y))).curryLeft)
          (volume.restrict (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1)) := by
        have := (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => Cyl) ℝ).continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable
          (hInt (m + 1) x₀ hx₀).aestronglyMeasurable
        refine this.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => ?_))
        simp only [hcl]
      have hbm : Metric.ball x₀ (δ / 2) ∈ nhds x₀ := Metric.ball_mem_nhds x₀ (half_pos hδ)
      have key := hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
        (μ := volume.restrict (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1))
        (F := fun x Y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (x + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y)))
        (F' := fun x Y => (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f (x + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y))).curryLeft)
        (bound := fun _ => C) hbm
        (Filter.eventually_of_mem hbm
          (fun x hx => (hInt m x (hcb (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx))).aestronglyMeasurable))
        (hInt m x₀ hx₀) hmeas ?_ ?_ ?_
      · have hcomm : ∫ Y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
              (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f (x₀ + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y))).curryLeft =
            (∫ Y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
              iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f (x₀ + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y))).curryLeft := by
          have := ContinuousLinearEquiv.integral_comp_comm (𝕜 := ℝ)
            (E := ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => Cyl) ℝ)
            (F := Cyl →L[ℝ] ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => Cyl) ℝ)
            (μ := volume.restrict (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1))
            (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => Cyl) ℝ).toContinuousLinearEquiv
            (fun Y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f (x₀ + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y)))
          simpa only [LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_toContinuousLinearEquiv, hcl] using this
        rw [hcomm] at key
        exact key
      · refine (ae_restrict_iff' hSqm).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun Y hY x hx => ?_))
        rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryLeft_norm]
        exact hC (x, Y) ⟨Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx, hY⟩
      · exact continuousOn_const.integrableOn_compact hSqc
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun Y x hx => ?_)
        have h := (hder m _ (hadd x (hcb (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx)) Y)).comp x
          ((hasFDerivAt_id x).add_const ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y))
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_id] at h
        exact h
    obtain ⟨Γ, hΓ⟩ : ∃ Γ : Cyl → ℝ, ∀ x, Γ x =
        ∫ Y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, f (x + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y)) := ⟨_, fun x => rfl⟩
