          (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 2 -
        fderiv ℝ F (p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2 - Yph B.h (rad p.1) p.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 1) •
          EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
      (fderiv ℝ F (p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2 - Yph B.h (rad p.1) p.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 0 -
        fderiv ℝ F (p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2 - Yph B.h (rad p.1) p.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 2) •
          EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
      (fderiv ℝ F (p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2 - Yph B.h (rad p.1) p.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 1 -
        fderiv ℝ F (p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2 - Yph B.h (rad p.1) p.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 0) •
          EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} :=
    ((((hGc _ 2).sub (hGc _ 1)).smul contDiffOn_const).add
      (((hGc _ 0).sub (hGc _ 2)).smul contDiffOn_const)).add
      (((hGc _ 1).sub (hGc _ 0)).smul contDiffOn_const)
  have hcurl : ∀ p ∈ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1},
      curlX B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 =
      (fderiv ℝ F (p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2 - Yph B.h (rad p.1) p.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 2 -
        fderiv ℝ F (p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2 - Yph B.h (rad p.1) p.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 1) •
          EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
      (fderiv ℝ F (p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2 - Yph B.h (rad p.1) p.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 0 -
        fderiv ℝ F (p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2 - Yph B.h (rad p.1) p.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 2) •
          EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
      (fderiv ℝ F (p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2 - Yph B.h (rad p.1) p.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 1 -
        fderiv ℝ F (p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2 - Yph B.h (rad p.1) p.2.1)
          (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) 0) •
          EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) := by
    intro p hp
    have hw := hιm hp
    have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2 - Yph B.h (rad p.1) p.2.1) :=
      (hAX.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hw)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hsl : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => F (y, p.2.1, p.2.2 - Yph B.h (rad p.1) p.2.1))
        ((fderiv ℝ F (p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2 - Yph B.h (rad p.1) p.2.1)).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))) p.1 :=
      HasFDerivAt.comp p.1 hFd.hasFDerivAt
        (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left p.1 ((p.2.1, p.2.2 - Yph B.h (rad p.1) p.2.1) : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))
    have hfd : ∀ v : ℝ³, fderiv ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => F (y, p.2.1, p.2.2 - Yph B.h (rad p.1) p.2.1)) p.1 v =
        fderiv ℝ F (p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2 - Yph B.h (rad p.1) p.2.1) (v, (0 : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) := by
      intro v
      rw [hsl.fderiv]
      rfl
    have heq : curlX B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 =
        curl3 (fun y : ℝ³ => F (y, p.2.1, p.2.2 - Yph B.h (rad p.1) p.2.1)) p.1 := by
      rw [← hFdef]
      rfl
    rw [heq]
    simp only [curl3, hfd]
  have hBP := hok.2
  unfold BackgroundProps at hBP
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, ⟨-, hBvBs, hPBs⟩, -⟩ := hBP
  have hpr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((w.1, w.2.1) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) :=
    contDiff_fst.prodMk contDiff_snd.fst
  have hprm : MapsTo (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((w.1, w.2.1) : ℝ³ × ℝ))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} (simDomain B.h B.qB) :=
    fun w hw => ⟨hw.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hw.2.2 hqB⟩
  have hBvc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => B.BvB w.1 w.2.1)
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} := hBvBs.comp hpr.contDiffOn hprm
  have hPBc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => B.PB w.1 w.2.1)
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} := hPBs.comp hpr.contDiffOn hprm
  have hBXeq : ∀ p ∈ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1},
      BX B G l0 S p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 = B.BvB p.1 p.2.1 +
        (simScale B.h (p.1 2) (1 - p.2.1) ^ (-Aex B.h) * S.bdir (ptOf p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) • eTh p.1 := by
    intro p hp
    have hw : corrOn B l0 p.1 p.2.1 := hp
    change B.BvB p.1 p.2.1 + _ = _
    rw [if_pos hw]
    all_goals rfl
  have hBXs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => B.BvB p.1 p.2.1 +
        (simScale B.h (p.1 2) (1 - p.2.1) ^ (-Aex B.h) * S.bdir (ptOf p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) • eTh p.1)
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} :=
    hBvc.add (((hQp (-Aex B.h)).mul (c4.1.comp hσ hσm)).smul heThΩ)
  have hC2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => uX5 B G l0 S p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)
      {p | corrOn B l0 p.1 p.2.1} := by
    refine (hCur.add hBXs).congr (fun p hp => ?_)
    show curlX B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 + BX B G l0 S p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 = _
    rw [hcurl p hp, hBXeq p hp]
  
  obtain ⟨HP, -, hHP⟩ := c2.1
  have hWp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
      waveS5 B G S.pw (thetaOf p.1) (ptOf p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} :=
    (hwS S.pw ⟨HP, hHP⟩ c2.2.1 c2.2.2.2.1).comp hτ hτm
  have hPeq : ∀ p ∈ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1},
      PX5 B G l0 S p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 = B.PB p.1 p.2.1 +
        (pmP5 B G l0 S (ptOf p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) +
          simScale B.h (p.1 2) (1 - p.2.1) ^ (-2 * Aex B.h) *
            waveS5 B G S.pw (thetaOf p.1) (ptOf p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) := by
    intro p hp
    have hw : corrOn B l0 p.1 p.2.1 := hp
    change B.PB p.1 p.2.1 + _ = _
    rw [if_pos hw]
    all_goals rfl
  have hC3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => PX5 B G l0 S p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)
      {p | corrOn B l0 p.1 p.2.1} :=
    (hPBc.add ((hpm.comp hσ hσm).add ((hQp (-2 * Aex B.h)).mul hWp))).congr hPeq
  
  obtain ⟨HV, -, hHV⟩ := c16.1
  have hofR : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (s : Set Cyl), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => ((f ξ : ℝ) : ℂ)) s := fun f s hf =>
    (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hf).congr
      (fun ξ _ => by simp only [Function.comp_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply])
  have hgO : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ (-B.h)) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
    hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (fun ξ hξ => (hqposO ξ hξ).ne')
  have hdg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => dZ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-B.h)) ξ) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h1 := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hgO).2
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => fderiv ℝ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ (-B.h)) ξ
        ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ))) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
      h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact h2.congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
  have hVcomp : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (i : Fin 3),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => VwT5 B G S γ m ξ i) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro γ m i
    have hc1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (((qC B.h ξ ^ (-B.h) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      hofR _ _ ((hgO.mono hDO).mul contDiffOn_const)
    have hc2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ((dZ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-B.h)) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ))
        (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      hofR _ _ (hdg.mono hDO)
    have hvel : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => velC5 B G S.Aw γ m ξ i) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      contDiffOn_pi.mp (c16.2.1 γ m) i
    have hA : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => S.Aw γ m ξ j) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      fun j => contDiffOn_pi.mp (c1.2.1 γ m) j
    have hvec : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => (![-(S.Aw γ m ξ 1), S.Aw γ m ξ 0, 0] : Fin 3 → ℂ) i)
        (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
      fin_cases i
      · exact (hA 1).neg.congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
      · exact (hA 0).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
      · exact contDiffOn_const.congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
    refine ((hc1.mul hvel).add (hc2.mul hvec)).congr (fun ξ _ => ?_)
    simp only [VwT5, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hVH : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), m ∉ HA ∪ HV → (fun ξ => VwT5 B G S γ m ξ i) = 0 := by
    intro i γ m hm
    have h1 : S.Aw γ m = 0 := hHA γ m (fun h => hm (Finset.mem_union_left _ h))
    have h2 : velW5 B G S.Aw γ m = 0 := hHV γ m (fun h => hm (Finset.mem_union_right _ h))
    funext ξ
    have h1' : S.Aw γ m ξ = 0 := congrFun h1 ξ
    have h2' : velC5 B G S.Aw γ m ξ = 0 := congrFun h2 ξ
    fin_cases i <;> simp [VwT5, h1', h2']
  have hVS : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) →

    intro i γ m ξ hξ hne
    by_contra hns
    apply hne
    have h1' : S.Aw γ m ξ = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact hns (c1.2.2.2.1 γ m ξ hξ h)
    have h2' : velC5 B G S.Aw γ m ξ = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact hns (c16.2.2.2.1 γ m ξ hξ h)
    fin_cases i <;> simp [VwT5, h1', h2']
  have hWV : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
      waveV5 B G (VwT5 B G S) (thetaOf p.1) (ptOf p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) i)
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} := by
    intro i
    have h := hwS (fun γ m ξ => VwT5 B G S γ m ξ i) ⟨HA ∪ HV, hVH i⟩ (fun γ m => hVcomp γ m i) (hVS i)

  have hC4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
      cyl2cart p.1 (waveV5 B G (VwT5 B G S) (thetaOf p.1) (ptOf p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)))

    ((((hWV 0).smul heRΩ).add ((hWV 1).smul heThΩ)).add
      ((hWV 2).smul (contDiffOn_const (c := eZ)))).congr (fun p _ => rfl)
  exact ⟨hC1, hC2, hC3, hC4⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 S α dPsi dv hok hPsi _hdv hA Y₀ x t hc
  have hr : 0 < rad x := hc.1
  have ht : t < 1 := hc.2.1
  have hr0 : rad x ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
  have hs : 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.mp hr
  have hr2 : rad x ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt hs.le
  have hu : (rad x)⁻¹ * rad x = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hr0
  have hpj : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => y i) (EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) x := by
    intro i
    have := (EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt (x := x)
    exact this
  
  obtain ⟨R', hR, hR0, hR1, hR2⟩ : ∃ R' : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ, HasFDerivAt rad R' x ∧
      R' (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) = x 0 / rad x ∧ R' (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) = x 1 / rad x ∧
      R' (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) = 0 := by
    have hq := (((hpj 0).pow 2).add ((hpj 1).pow 2)).sqrt hs.ne'
    refine ⟨_, hq, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [rad]
      field_simp
    · simp [rad]
      field_simp
    · simp
  
  have hSC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := hok.1.2.2.2.1
  have hmemO : (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) ∈ nhds ((x 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) :=
    (isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - t by linarith⟩
  have hout : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ((x 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) :=
    (hSC.contDiffAt hmemO).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hin : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ³ => ((y 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ))
      ((EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).prod 0) x :=
    (hpj 2).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_const _ _)
  have hq : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t)) x := by
    have := DifferentiableAt.comp x hout hin.differentiableAt
    exact this.continuousAt
  
  have hN : ∀ᶠ y in nhds x, corrOn B l0 y t := by
    filter_upwards [Filter.Tendsto.eventually_const_lt hr hR.continuousAt,
      Filter.Tendsto.eventually_lt_const hc.2.2 hq] with y h1 h2
    exact ⟨h1, ht, h2⟩
  
  have hinC : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun ζ' : Cyl => ((ζ'.2.1, 1 - ζ'.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
      (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) := by fun_prop
  have hqC : DifferentiableAt ℝ (qC B.h) (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) := by
    have := hout.comp (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) hinC
    exact this
  have hqpos : 0 < qC B.h (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) :=
    (hok.1.1 (x 2) (1 - t) (by linarith)).1
  have hDom : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∈ nhds (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) := by
    have h1 : ∀ᶠ ζ' in nhds (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)), 0 < ζ'.1 :=
      Filter.Tendsto.eventually_const_lt hr continuous_fst.continuousAt
    have h2 : ∀ᶠ ζ' in nhds (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)), ζ'.2.2.1 < 1 :=
      Filter.Tendsto.eventually_lt_const ht
        (by fun_prop : Continuous fun ζ' : Cyl => ζ'.2.2.1).continuousAt
    have h3 : ∀ᶠ ζ' in nhds (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)), qC B.h ζ' < qsOf l0 :=
      Filter.Tendsto.eventually_lt_const hc.2.2 hqC.continuousAt
    filter_upwards [h1, h2, h3] with ζ' a b c
    exact ⟨a, b, c⟩
  have hgd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (momPsP B dPsi) (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) := by
    have hdP : DifferentiableAt ℝ dPsi (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) :=
      (hPsi.1.contDiffAt hDom).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have hpow : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun ξ => qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h))
        (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) :=
      hqC.rpow_const (Or.inl hqpos.ne')
    exact hpow.mul hdP
  
  have key : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => momPsP B dPsi (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀)) • eTh y) x ∧
      curl3 (fun y => momPsP B dPsi (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀)) • eTh y) x =
        (-(dZ (momPsP B dPsi) (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)))) • eR x +
        (dR B.h (momPsP B dPsi) (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) +
          momPsP B dPsi (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) / rad x) • eZ := by
    generalize momPsP B dPsi = g at hgd ⊢
    have hinv : HasFDerivAt (fun y => (rad y)⁻¹)
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ (-(rad x ^ 2)⁻¹)).comp R') x :=
      (hasFDerivAt_inv hr0).comp x hR
    have haz : HasFDerivAt azVec
        ((-(EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) +
          (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))) x := by
      have := ((hpj 1).neg.smul_const (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))).add
        ((hpj 0).smul_const (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)))
      convert this using 1
      funext y
      simp [azVec]
    have heTh : HasFDerivAt eTh _ x := hinv.fun_smul haz
    obtain ⟨P', hP'⟩ : ∃ P' : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] Cyl, P' = R'.prod ((EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).prod
        ((0 : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).prod (((drx B.h * rad x ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • R').smulRight vrv))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hP : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀)) P' x := by
      have := hR.prodMk ((hpj 2).prodMk ((hasFDerivAt_const t x).prodMk
        ((((hR.rpow_const (p := drx B.h) (Or.inl hr0)).smul_const vrv).add_const (t • vtv)).add_const Y₀)))
      rw [hP']
      exact this
    obtain ⟨Φ', hΦ'⟩ : ∃ Φ' : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ,
        Φ' = (fderiv ℝ g (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀))).comp P' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hΦ : HasFDerivAt (fun y => g (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀))) Φ' x := by
      rw [hΦ']
      exact hgd.hasFDerivAt.comp x hP
    have hz : Φ' (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) = dZ g (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) := by
      rw [hΦ', ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
      unfold dZ
      congr 1
      rw [hP']
      simp [hR2]
    have hS : x 0 * (x 0 / rad x) + x 1 * (x 1 / rad x) = rad x := by
      have e : x 0 * (x 0 / rad x) + x 1 * (x 1 / rad x) = (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) / rad x := by ring
      rw [e, ← hr2, pow_two, mul_div_assoc, div_self hr0, mul_one]
    have hcmb : x 0 * Φ' (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) + x 1 * Φ' (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) =
        rad x * dR B.h g (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) := by
      have e1 : x 0 * Φ' (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) + x 1 * Φ' (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) =
          Φ' (x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 + x 1 • EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) := by
        simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      have e2 : P' (x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 + x 1 • EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) =
          rad x • ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * rad x ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) := by
        rw [hP']
        simp only [map_add, map_smul]
        ext
        · simp [hR0, hR1]; linear_combination hS
        · simp
        · simp
        · simp [hR0, hR1]; linear_combination (drx B.h * rad x ^ (drx B.h - 1) * vrv.1) * hS
        · simp [hR0, hR1]; linear_combination (drx B.h * rad x ^ (drx B.h - 1) * vrv.2) * hS
      rw [e1, hΦ', ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, e2, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      rfl
    refine ⟨(hΦ.fun_smul heTh).differentiableAt, ?_⟩
    have hD := (hΦ.fun_smul heTh).fderiv
    unfold curl3
    rw [hD]
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · simp [eR, eTh, eZ, azVec, radVec, hR0, hR1, hR2, hz]
    · simp [eR, eTh, eZ, azVec, radVec, hR0, hR1, hR2, hz]
    · simp [eR, eTh, eZ, azVec, radVec, hR0, hR1, hR2]
      linear_combination (rad x)⁻¹ * hcmb +
        (dR B.h g (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) -
          g (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) * (rad x)⁻¹ * (1 + (rad x)⁻¹ * rad x)) * hu +
        g (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) * (rad x)⁻¹ ^ 3 * hr2
  obtain ⟨hΔd, hΔc⟩ := key
  
  have hV2 : ∀ y, corrOn B l0 y t → AX5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀) =
      AX5 B G l0 S y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀) +
        momPsP B dPsi (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀)) • eTh y := by
    intro y hy
    simp only [AX5, if_pos hy, momUpd, momPsP, add_smul, smul_add, smul_smul]
    abel
  have hev : (fun y => AX5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀)) =ᶠ[nhds x]
      (fun y => AX5 B G l0 S y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀) +
        momPsP B dPsi (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀)) • eTh y) :=
    hN.mono (fun y hy => hV2 y hy)
  have hcurlX : ∀ T : CState, curlX B.h (AX5 B G l0 T) x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀) =
      curl3 (fun y => AX5 B G l0 T y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀)) x := by
    intro T
    show curl3 (fun y => evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 T) (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀ - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y t) x = _
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
    rfl
  have hcc : curl3 (fun y => AX5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀)) x =
      curl3 (fun y => AX5 B G l0 S y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀) +
        momPsP B dPsi (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀)) • eTh y) x := by
    unfold curl3
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  have hsplit : curl3 (fun y => AX5 B G l0 S y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀) +
        momPsP B dPsi (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀)) • eTh y) x =
      curl3 (fun y => AX5 B G l0 S y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀)) x +
      curl3 (fun y => momPsP B dPsi (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀)) • eTh y) x := by
    unfold curl3
    rw [fderiv_fun_add (hA t Y₀ x hc) hΔd]
    first
      | (simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, PiLp.add_apply]; module)
      | (ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp <;> ring)
  have hBX : BX B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀) =
      BX B G l0 S x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀) +
        momDvP B dv (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) • eTh x := by
    simp only [BX, if_pos hc, momUpd, momDvP, mul_add, add_smul]
    abel
  have hDX : DXm5 B l0 dPsi dv x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀) =
      cyl2cart x (dUM5 B dPsi dv (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀))) := by
    simp only [DXm5, if_pos hc]
  have hcyl : cyl2cart x (dUM5 B dPsi dv (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀))) =
      (-(dZ (momPsP B dPsi) (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)))) • eR x +
        momDvP B dv (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) • eTh x +
      (dR B.h (momPsP B dPsi) (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) +
          momPsP B dPsi (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) / rad x) • eZ := rfl
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · show curlX B.h (AX5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv)) x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀) +
        BX B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀) =
      (curlX B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀) +
        BX B G l0 S x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) + DXm5 B l0 dPsi dv x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)
    rw [hcurlX, hcurlX, hcc, hsplit, hΔc, hBX, hDX, hcyl]
    abel
  · show PX5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀) =
      PX5 B G l0 S x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀) + _
    simp only [PX5, if_pos hc, momUpd]
    ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (S : CState) (bw ca cm cd : ℝ), StOrd5 B G l0 S bw ca cm cd → (∀ ξ₀ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∃ (U : Set Cyl) (Γ : Finset Lab), IsOpen U ∧ ξ₀ ∈ U ∧ ∀ ξ ∈ U, ∀ γ, γ ∉ Γ → ¬ SuppW B G γ ξ) → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → wX5 B G l0 S x t Y = cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (VwT5 B G S) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))

signature.name: mwh5_wave_velocity_rep
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (S : CState) (bw ca cm cd : ℝ), StOrd5 B G l0 S bw ca cm cd → (∀ ξ₀ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∃ (U : Set Cyl) (Γ : Finset Lab), IsOpen U ∧ ξ₀ ∈ U ∧ ∀ ξ ∈ U, ∀ γ, γ ∉ Γ → ¬ SuppW B G γ ξ) → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → wX5 B G l0 S x t Y = cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (VwT5 B G S) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨l1, hsplit⟩ := wmo_velocity_split_v5 B G hok hG
  refine ⟨l1, fun l0 hl0 S bw ca cm cd hSt hLF x t Y hxt => ?_⟩
  have hSt' := hSt
  unfold StOrd5 at hSt'
  obtain ⟨c1, -, c3, c4, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, c16, -⟩ := hSt'
  have hξ : ptOf x t Y ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := ⟨hxt.1, hxt.2.1, hxt.2.2⟩
  have hq : 0 < qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) :=
    (hok.1.1 (ptOf x t Y).2.1 (1 - (ptOf x t Y).2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ.2.1])).1
  
  have hFc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2)
      ((ptOf x t Y).2.1, 1 - (ptOf x t Y).2.2.1) :=
    hok.1.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt ((isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds
      ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - (ptOf x t Y).2.2.1 by linarith [hξ.2.1]⟩)
  have hqd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (qC B.h) (ptOf x t Y) := by
    have hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) (ptOf x t Y) := by
      fun_prop
    have hcomp : DifferentiableAt ℝ ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))) (ptOf x t Y) :=
      DifferentiableAt.comp (ptOf x t Y) (hFc.differentiableAt (by simp)) hg
    exact hcomp
  have hF := hqd.hasFDerivAt
  have hd1 : dZ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-B.h)) (ptOf x t Y) =
      (-B.h * qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-B.h - 1)) * dZ (qC B.h) (ptOf x t Y) := by
    unfold dZ
    rw [(hF.rpow_const (p := -B.h) (Or.inl hq.ne')).fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hd2 : dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) (ptOf x t Y) =
      (qC B.h (ptOf x t Y))⁻¹ * dZ (qC B.h) (ptOf x t Y) := by
    unfold dZ
    rw [(hF.log hq.ne').fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hA : qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) * qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (1/2:ℝ) =
      qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-B.h) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]
    congr 1
    unfold Aex
    ring
  have hcoef : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (i : Fin 3),
      ((qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) * wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw γ m (ptOf x t Y) i =
        VwT5 B G S γ m (ptOf x t Y) i := by
    intro γ m i
    have hQ : 0 < Qb γ.1 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
    have e1 : ((qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (((qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        ((qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-B.h) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul]
      congr 1
      rw [Real.div_rpow hq.le hQ.le, Real.rpow_neg hQ.le, div_eq_mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, hA]
    have e2 : ((qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ((B.h * qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) (ptOf x t Y) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        -((dZ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-B.h)) (ptOf x t Y) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_neg]
      congr 1
      rw [hd1, hd2, Real.rpow_sub_one hq.ne']
      calc qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) *
            (B.h * qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (1/2:ℝ) * ((qC B.h (ptOf x t Y))⁻¹ * dZ (qC B.h) (ptOf x t Y)))
          = B.h * (qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) * qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (1/2:ℝ)) *
              (qC B.h (ptOf x t Y))⁻¹ * dZ (qC B.h) (ptOf x t Y) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hA]; ring
    have hw : ∀ c : Fin 3 → ℂ, (![-(c 1), c 0, 0] : Fin 3 → ℂ) i = -(rotC c i) := by
      intro c
      fin_cases i <;> simp [rotC]
    simp only [wmoAmp5, VwT5, velW5, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hw]
    linear_combination (velC5 B G S.Aw γ m (ptOf x t Y) i) * e1 + (rotC (S.Aw γ m (ptOf x t Y)) i) * e2
  have hwave : ∀ (θ : ℝ) (i : Fin 3),
      qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) θ (ptOf x t Y) i =
        waveV5 B G (VwT5 B G S) θ (ptOf x t Y) i := by
    intro θ i
    simp only [waveV5]
    rw [← Complex.re_ofReal_mul, mul_finsum]
    congr 1
    refine finsum_congr (fun γ => ?_)
    rw [mul_finsum]
    refine finsum_congr (fun m => ?_)
    rw [← mul_assoc, hcoef γ m i]
  
  obtain ⟨H1, h0H1, hH1⟩ := c1.1
  obtain ⟨H2, h0H2, hH2⟩ := c16.1
  obtain ⟨U, Γ, -, hξU, hΓ⟩ := hLF (ptOf x t Y) hξ
  have hH0 : (0:ℤ) ∉ H1 ∪ H2 := by
    rw [Finset.mem_union]
    rintro (h | h)
    · exact h0H1 h
    · exact h0H2 h
  have hAw0 : ∀ γ m, (m ∉ H1 ∪ H2 ∨ γ ∉ Γ) → S.Aw γ m (ptOf x t Y) = 0 := by
    intro γ m h
    rcases h with h | h
    · have hm : m ∉ H1 := fun hm => h (Finset.mem_union_left _ hm)
      exact congrFun (hH1 γ m hm) _
    · by_contra hne
      exact hΓ (ptOf x t Y) hξU γ h (c1.2.2.2.1 γ m (ptOf x t Y) hξ hne)
  have hvel0 : ∀ γ m, (m ∉ H1 ∪ H2 ∨ γ ∉ Γ) → velW5 B G S.Aw γ m (ptOf x t Y) = 0 := by
    intro γ m h
    rcases h with h | h
    · have hm : m ∉ H2 := fun hm => h (Finset.mem_union_right _ hm)
      exact congrFun (hH2 γ m hm) _
    · by_contra hne
      exact hΓ (ptOf x t Y) hξU γ h (c16.2.2.2.1 γ m (ptOf x t Y) hξ hne)
  have hV0 : ∀ γ m (i : Fin 3), (m ∉ H1 ∪ H2 ∨ γ ∉ Γ) → VwT5 B G S γ m (ptOf x t Y) i = 0 := by
    intro γ m i h
    have e1 := hAw0 γ m h
    have e2 : velC5 B G S.Aw γ m (ptOf x t Y) = 0 := hvel0 γ m h
    fin_cases i <;> simp [VwT5, e1, e2]
  
  have hpint : ∀ γ : Lab, pint5 B G γ ≠ 0 := by
    intro γ
    unfold pint5
    split_ifs with h
    · exact one_ne_zero
    · exact h
  have hgen : ∀ (s : Finset (Lab × ℤ)) (c : Lab × ℤ → ℂ) (k : Lab × ℤ → ℤ), (∀ i ∈ s, k i ≠ 0) →
      Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => (∑ i ∈ s, c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re) ∧
      ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (∑ i ∈ s, c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re = 0 := by
    intro s c k hk
    have hcont : ∀ i, Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))) :=
      fun i => continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
        (continuous_const.mul Complex.continuous_ofReal))
    have hF : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => ∑ i ∈ s, c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))) :=
      continuous_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hcont i)
    refine ⟨Complex.continuous_re.comp hF, ?_⟩
    have h1 : ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (∑ i ∈ s, c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re =
        (∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          ∑ i ∈ s, c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re := by

twg5_cross_identity.definitions:
noncomputable def mcK5 (h : ℝ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (d : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (n : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℂ :=
  let rc := dR h c ξ
  let zc := dZ c ξ
  let rd := dR h d ξ
  let zd := dZ d ξ
  let An : ℂ := Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((d ξ 1 / ξ.1 : ℝ) : ℂ)
  ![(d ξ 0 : ℂ) * rc 0 + (d ξ 2 : ℂ) * zc 0 + An * c ξ 0 - 2 * (d ξ 1 : ℂ) * c ξ 1 / (ξ.1 : ℂ)
      + c ξ 0 * (rd 0 : ℂ) + c ξ 2 * (zd 0 : ℂ),
    (d ξ 0 : ℂ) * rc 1 + (d ξ 2 : ℂ) * zc 1 + An * c ξ 1 + (d ξ 1 : ℂ) * c ξ 0 / (ξ.1 : ℂ)
      + c ξ 0 * (rd 1 : ℂ) + c ξ 2 * (zd 1 : ℂ) + c ξ 1 * (d ξ 0 : ℂ) / (ξ.1 : ℂ),
    (d ξ 0 : ℂ) * rc 2 + (d ξ 2 : ℂ) * zc 2 + An * c ξ 2 + c ξ 0 * (rd 2 : ℂ) + c ξ 2 * (zd 2 : ℂ)]

search_metadata.last_error: Approved at commit gate. Both new children are true, pointwise, single-mode statements, and both are massively easier than the target. twg5_mode_cross_formula is the cylindrical product rule for one Fourier mode with arbitrary c and d: with rad x > 0 the frame, e^{in theta} = (w/|w|)^n and the Yph rpow are all smooth, and E1 checks it to 1e-9 including points on the negative x-axis; blueprint s1-s3 are its natural children. twg5_coef_match is pure algebra: kb >= 1 and RC = r/sqrt(Qb) give gv = (kb dR phi, pint5/r, kb dZ phi), the rows of mcK5(W*E) match the rows of crossCoefM5 term by term, and q^{-e} q^{e} = 1; E2 checks it to 6.5e-10. The glue consumes every child: mode_cross_formula in hFd and h4, coef_match in the hmode dichotomy branch, and the PROVED geom_slow_base_smooth_v5 edge (statement identical to section 10) in hbase. The blueprint has no CRUX, and the divergence (s5-s7 and s9-s12 inline, s1-s3 deferred under s4) is documented in findings. No child duplicates twg5_cross_offsupp, mode_curl_axis_v5, cub5_algebra or pwr5_split_identity, and there is no cycle, no split on parameter values and no guessed constant.

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (S : CState) (bw ca cm cd : ℝ) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) (Hx : ℝ), StOrd5 B G l0 S bw ca cm cd → InM B (qsOf l0) Hx dPsi → InM B (qsOf l0) Hx dv → InM B (qsOf l0) Hx (nrm B (Aex B.h) (momDvP B dv)) → InM B (qsOf l0) Hx (nrm B (Aex B.h) (momDgP B dPsi)) → InM B (qsOf l0) (Hx + 1) (nrm B (Aex B.h) (momDbP B dPsi)) → (∃ H : Finset ℤ, (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧ ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → crossCoefM5 B G S dPsi dv γ m = 0) ∧ (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (crossCoefM5 B G S dPsi dv γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) ∧ (∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ c, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c → crossCoefM5 B G S dPsi dv γ m (shY ξ c) = crossCoefM5 B G S dPsi dv γ m ξ) ∧ (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → crossCoefM5 B G S dPsi dv γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ)

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (S : CState) (bw ca cm cd : ℝ) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) (Hx : ℝ), StOrd5 B G l0 S bw ca cm cd → InM B (qsOf l0) Hx dPsi → InM B (qsOf l0) Hx dv → InM B (qsOf l0) Hx (nrm B (Aex B.h) (momDvP B dv)) → InM B (qsOf l0) Hx (nrm B (Aex B.h) (momDgP B dPsi)) → InM B (qsOf l0) (Hx + 1) (nrm B (Aex B.h) (momDbP B dPsi)) → (∃ H : Finset ℤ, (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧ ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → crossCoefM5 B G S dPsi dv γ m = 0) ∧ (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (crossCoefM5 B G S dPsi dv γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) ∧ (∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ c, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c → crossCoefM5 B G S dPsi dv γ m (shY ξ c) = crossCoefM5 B G S dPsi dv γ m ξ) ∧ (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → crossCoefM5 B G S dPsi dv γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lP, hP⟩ := pulse_support_good_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨lB, hB⟩ := band_coarse_gap_v5 B.h hh0 hh1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨lP + lB + n0 + 7, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 S bw ca cm cd dPsi dv Hx hSt _ _ hdw hdg hdb
  
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0.le
  unfold StOrd5 at hSt
  obtain ⟨hAw, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, hvW, -⟩ := hSt
  
  have hT : IsOpen {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd.snd.fst continuous_const
  have hπq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) :=
    contDiff_snd.fst.prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h4 := hok.1.2.2.2.1
    exact h4.comp hπq.contDiffOn (fun ξ (hξ : ξ.2.2.1 < 1) =>
      (⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩ : (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) ∈ univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)))
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have h1 : IsOpen {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst
    have h2 := hqC.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hT (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ ({ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0)) := by
      ext ξ; exact Iff.rfl
    rw [e]; exact h1.inter h2
  have hqpos : ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → 0 < qC B.h ξ := fun ξ hξ =>
    (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hdom : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 :=
    fun ξ hξ => hξ
  have hDT : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ⊆ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} := fun ξ hξ => (hdom ξ hξ).2.1
  have ofR : ∀ {f : Cyl → ℝ} {s : Set Cyl}, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) s := fun hf =>
    (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hf).congr (fun η _ => by simp)
  have hdRZ : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (F : Cyl → V) (O : Set Cyl),
      IsOpen O → (∀ η ∈ O, 0 < η.1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F O →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h F) O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ F) O := by
    intro V _ _ F O hO hpos hF
    have hDf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) O :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hF).2
    have hpow : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) O :=
      contDiff_fst.contDiffOn.rpow_const_of_ne (fun ξ hξ => (hpos ξ hξ).ne')
    have hY : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) O :=
      (contDiffOn_const.mul hpow).smul_const _
    have hvR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl =>
        ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)) O :=
      contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk hY))
    exact ⟨(hDf.clm_apply hvR).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl),
      (hDf.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)⟩
  
  have hgr : ∀ (g : Cyl → ℝ) (α : ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (Aex B.h) g) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro g α hg
    have hqa : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      (hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (p := -Aex B.h) (fun ξ hξ => (hqpos ξ hξ).ne')).mono hDT
    refine (hqa.mul hg.1).congr (fun η hη => ?_)
    have hq := hqpos η (hDT hη)
    show g η = qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h) * (qC B.h η ^ Aex B.h * g η)
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hq, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero, one_mul]
  have hgd : ∀ (g : Cyl → ℝ) (α : ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (Aex B.h) g) →
      ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ c, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h η) c → g (shY η c) = g η := by
    intro g α hg η hη c hc
    have h := hg.2.1 η hη c hc
    have hq := hqpos η (hDT hη)
    have h' : qC B.h η ^ Aex B.h * g (shY η c) = qC B.h η ^ Aex B.h * g η := h
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _).ne' h'
  have hDU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dUM5 B dPsi dv) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have e1 := hgr _ _ hdb
    have e2 := hgr _ _ hdw
    have e3 := hgr _ _ hdg
    refine contDiffOn_pi.mpr (fun i => ?_)
    fin_cases i
    · exact e1
    · exact e2
    · exact e3
  
  have hqh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-B.h)) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
    hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (p := -B.h) (fun ξ hξ => (hqpos ξ hξ).ne')
  have hvec : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun η => (![-(S.Aw γ m η 1), S.Aw γ m η 0, 0] : Fin 3 → ℂ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro γ m
    have hA := hAw.2.1 γ m
    refine contDiffOn_pi.mpr fun i => ?_
    fin_cases i
    · simpa using (contDiffOn_pi.mp hA 1).neg
    · simpa using (contDiffOn_pi.mp hA 0)
    · simpa using (contDiffOn_const : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun _ : Cyl => (0:ℂ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)))
  have hWs : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (VwT5 B G S γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro γ m
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (-B.h) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := ofR ((hqh.mono hDT).mul contDiffOn_const)
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((dZ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-B.h)) η : ℝ) : ℂ))
        (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      ofR (hdRZ _ _ hDopen (fun η hη => (hdom η hη).1) (hqh.mono hDT)).2
    exact ((h1.smul (hvW.2.1 γ m)).add (h2.smul (hvec γ m))).congr (fun η _ => rfl)
  
  have hWz : ∀ γ m η, S.Aw γ m η = 0 → velW5 B G S.Aw γ m η = 0 → VwT5 B G S γ m η = 0 := by
    intro γ m η h1 h2
    have h2' : velC5 B G S.Aw γ m η = 0 := h2
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [VwT5, h1, h2']
  have hLz : ∀ γ m ξ, S.Aw γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → velW5 B G S.Aw γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 →
      crossCoefM5 B G S dPsi dv γ m ξ = 0 := by
    intro γ m ξ h1 h2
    have hev : VwT5 B G S γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] (fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ)) := by
      filter_upwards [h1, h2] with η e1 e2
      exact hWz γ m η e1 e2
    have hW0 : VwT5 B G S γ m ξ = 0 := hev.eq_of_nhds
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (VwT5 B G S γ m) ξ = 0 := by
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]; exact fderiv_const_apply _
    have hr : dR B.h (VwT5 B G S γ m) ξ = 0 := by
      unfold dR; rw [hfd, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    have hz : dZ (VwT5 B G S γ m) ξ = 0 := by
      unfold dZ; rw [hfd, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [crossCoefM5, hW0, hr, hz]
  
  have hgen : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (O : Set Cyl), IsOpen O → O ⊆ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) →
      (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => nPhi5 B G γ η i) O) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (crossCoefM5 B G S dPsi dv γ m) O := by
    intro γ m O hO hOD hnO
    have hpos : ∀ η ∈ O, 0 < η.1 := fun η hη => (hdom η (hOD hη)).1
    have hWO := (hWs γ m).mono hOD
    have hDO := hDU.mono hOD
    obtain ⟨hrWO, hzWO⟩ := hdRZ _ O hO hpos hWO
    obtain ⟨hrDO, hzDO⟩ := hdRZ _ O hO hpos hDO
    have hW : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => VwT5 B G S γ m η i) O :=
      fun i => contDiffOn_pi.mp hWO i
    have hrW : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => dR B.h (VwT5 B G S γ m) η i) O :=
      fun i => contDiffOn_pi.mp hrWO i
    have hzW : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => dZ (VwT5 B G S γ m) η i) O :=
      fun i => contDiffOn_pi.mp hzWO i
    have hD : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((dUM5 B dPsi dv η i : ℝ) : ℂ)) O :=
      fun i => ofR (contDiffOn_pi.mp hDO i)
    have hrD : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((dR B.h (dUM5 B dPsi dv) η i : ℝ) : ℂ)) O :=
      fun i => ofR (contDiffOn_pi.mp hrDO i)
    have hzD : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((dZ (dUM5 B dPsi dv) η i : ℝ) : ℂ)) O :=
      fun i => ofR (contDiffOn_pi.mp hzDO i)
    have hn : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((nPhi5 B G γ η i : ℝ) : ℂ)) O :=
      fun i => ofR (hnO i)
    have hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) O :=
      ofR ((hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (p := 2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun ξ hξ => (hqpos ξ hξ).ne')).mono
        (fun η hη => hDT (hOD hη)))
    have hinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.1 : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹) O := by
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => η.1⁻¹) O :=
        contDiff_fst.contDiffOn.inv (fun η hη => (hpos η hη).ne')
      exact (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h1).congr (fun η _ => by simp)
    have hW0 := hW 0; have hW1 := hW 1; have hW2 := hW 2
    have hrW0 := hrW 0; have hrW1 := hrW 1; have hrW2 := hrW 2
    have hzW0 := hzW 0; have hzW1 := hzW 1; have hzW2 := hzW 2
    have hD0 := hD 0; have hD1 := hD 1; have hD2 := hD 2
    have hrD0 := hrD 0; have hrD1 := hrD 1; have hrD2 := hrD 2
    have hzD0 := hzD 0; have hzD1 := hzD 1; have hzD2 := hzD 2
    have hn0 := hn 0; have hn1 := hn 1; have hn2 := hn 2
    have e0 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => crossCoefM5 B G S dPsi dv γ m η 0) O := by
      simp only [crossCoefM5, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.ofReal_mul,
        div_eq_mul_inv, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      fun_prop
    have e1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => crossCoefM5 B G S dPsi dv γ m η 1) O := by
      simp only [crossCoefM5, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.ofReal_mul,
        div_eq_mul_inv, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      fun_prop
    have e2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => crossCoefM5 B G S dPsi dv γ m η 2) O := by
      simp only [crossCoefM5, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.ofReal_mul,
        div_eq_mul_inv, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.head_cons]
      fun_prop
    refine contDiffOn_pi.mpr fun i => ?_
    fin_cases i
    · exact e0
    · exact e1
    · exact e2
  obtain ⟨H1, h01, hH1⟩ := hAw.1
  obtain ⟨H2, h02, hH2⟩ := hvW.1
  refine ⟨⟨H1 ∪ H2, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    simp only [Finset.mem_union, not_or]
    exact ⟨h01, h02⟩
  · 
    intro γ m hm
    simp only [Finset.mem_union, not_or] at hm
    funext ξ
    show crossCoefM5 B G S dPsi dv γ m ξ = 0
    apply hLz γ m ξ
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun η => by rw [hH1 γ m hm.1])
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun η => by rw [hH2 γ m hm.2])
  · 
    intro γ m
    apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    intro ξ hξ
    by_cases hsup : ξ ∈ tsupport (S.Aw γ m) ∨ ξ ∈ tsupport (velW5 B G S.Aw γ m)
    · have hgood : |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 ∧ |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 := by
        rcases hsup with h | h
        · have := hP l0 (by omega) 1 S.Aw hAw γ m ξ hξ h
          exact ⟨this.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, this.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2⟩
        · have := hP l0 (by omega) (1/2) (velW5 B G S.Aw) hvW γ m ξ hξ h
          exact ⟨this.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, this.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2⟩
      have hξB : ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB :=
        ⟨(hdom ξ hξ).1, (hdom ξ hξ).2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le (hdom ξ hξ).2.2 hqsB⟩
      obtain ⟨U, hUo, hξU, -, hnU, -, -⟩ := good_coeff_smooth_v5 B G γ ξ hok hξB hgood.1 hgood.2
      refine ⟨U, hUo, hξU, ?_⟩
      exact hgen γ m _ (hDopen.inter hUo) inter_subset_left
        (fun i => (hnU i).mono inter_subset_right)
    · obtain ⟨hs1, hs2⟩ := not_or.mp hsup
      refine ⟨(tsupport (S.Aw γ m))ᶜ ∩ (tsupport (velW5 B G S.Aw γ m))ᶜ,
        (isClosed_tsupport _).isOpen_compl.inter (isClosed_tsupport _).isOpen_compl, ⟨hs1, hs2⟩, ?_⟩
      refine (contDiffOn_const (c := (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ))).congr (fun η hη => ?_)
      exact hLz γ m η (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hη.2.1)
        (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hη.2.2)
  · 
    intro γ m ξ hξ c hc
    have hloc : ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ IsDeck B.h (qC B.h η) c := by
      filter_upwards [hDopen.mem_nhds hξ, deck_locally_stable_v5 B l0 hok (by omega) ξ hξ c hc]
        with η h1 h2
      exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : Cyl, e = ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), c) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hsh : ∀ η : Cyl, shY η c = η + e := by
      intro η
      rw [he]
      simp only [shY]
      ext <;> simp
    have htr : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (F : Cyl → V) (x : Cyl),
        (∀ᶠ η in nhds x, F (shY η c) = F η) →
        F (shY x c) = F x ∧ dR B.h F (shY x c) = dR B.h F x ∧ dZ F (shY x c) = dZ F x := by
      intro V _ _ F x hF
      have hfd : fderiv ℝ F (shY x c) = fderiv ℝ F x := by
        have hev : (fun y => F (y + e)) =ᶠ[nhds x] F := hF.mono (fun η hη => by
          show F (η + e) = F η
          rw [← hsh η, hη])
        rw [hsh x, ← fderiv_comp_add_right]
        exact hev.fderiv_eq
      refine ⟨hF.self_of_nhds, ?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold dR
        rw [hfd]
        try rfl
      · unfold dZ
        rw [hfd]
    have hqsh : ∀ η : Cyl, qC B.h (shY η c) = qC B.h η := fun _ => rfl
    have hWl : ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, VwT5 B G S γ m (shY η c) = VwT5 B G S γ m η := by
      filter_upwards [hloc] with η hη
      obtain ⟨hηD, hηc⟩ := hη
      have e1 : S.Aw γ m (shY η c) = S.Aw γ m η := hAw.2.2.1 γ m η hηD c hηc
      have e2 : velC5 B G S.Aw γ m (shY η c) = velC5 B G S.Aw γ m η := hvW.2.2.1 γ m η hηD c hηc
      have e3 : dZ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-B.h)) (shY η c) = dZ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-B.h)) η :=
        (htr (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-B.h)) η (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => rfl))).2.2
      simp only [VwT5, e1, e2, e3, hqsh]
    have hDl : ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, dUM5 B dPsi dv (shY η c) = dUM5 B dPsi dv η := by
      filter_upwards [hloc] with η hη
      obtain ⟨hηD, hηc⟩ := hη
      have e1 := hgd _ _ hdb η hηD c hηc
      have e2 := hgd _ _ hdw η hηD c hηc
      have e3 := hgd _ _ hdg η hηD c hηc
      funext i
      fin_cases i
      · exact e1
      · exact e2
      · exact e3

by

    intro X e1 e2

    · unfold edgeWeight

    · have hX : 0 < X := lt_trans hXa e1

  obtain ⟨b1, d1, hD⟩ := hDc l0 (by omega) S dPsi dv Hx hw hg hb k
  obtain ⟨b2, d2, hW⟩ := hWc l0 (by omega) S bw ca cm cd hSt k

  have hPq : ∀ γ m ξ, goodX5 B l0 S γ m ξ → 0 < qC B.h ξ ∧ qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 := by

    exact ⟨(hDq ξ h1).1, (hDq ξ h1).2.1⟩
  have hS1 : ∀ γ m ξ, goodX5 B l0 S γ m ξ → 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by

  have hwW : ∀ γ m ξ, goodX5 B l0 S γ m ξ → 0 ≤ wtW5 B G b2 d2 γ ξ := by

  let Qc : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ := fun _ _ η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ)

  let SDG : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ :=
    cxAdd5 (cxAdd5 (cxMul5 (Dc 0) (Gc 0)) (cxMul5 (Dc 1) (Gc 1))) (cxMul5 (Dc 2) (Gc 2))
  let Ec0 : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ :=

  have hSDG : CUB5 B (goodX5 B l0 S) k SDG ((-Aex B.h + B.h * Hx) + (-(1/2) - B.h / 2))

def CUB5 (B : BG) (P : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → Prop) (k : ℕ) (f : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) (e : ℝ)
    (w : Lab → Cyl → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ γ m ξ, P γ m ξ → 0 ≤ w γ ξ ∧
    (∃ U : Set Cyl, IsOpen U ∧ ξ ∈ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f γ m) U) ∧
    ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB B.h (f γ m) j ξ ≤ c * qC B.h ξ ^ e * w γ ξ
noncomputable def cxMul5 (f g : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ := fun γ m η => f γ m η * g γ m η
noncomputable def cxAdd5 (f g : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ := fun γ m η => f γ m η + g γ m η
noncomputable def cxSub5 (f g : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ := fun γ m η => f γ m η - g γ m η
noncomputable def cxSmul5 (c : ℂ) (f : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ := fun γ m η => c * f γ m η
def goodX5 (B : BG) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → Prop := fun γ m ξ =>
  ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ B.Xa < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < B.Xb ∧ ξ ∈ tsupport (S.Aw γ m)
noncomputable def wtD5 (B : BG) (b d : ℝ) : Lab → Cyl → ℝ := fun _ ξ =>
  SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d)
noncomputable def wtW5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (b d : ℝ) : Lab → Cyl → ℝ := fun γ ξ =>
  SC B.h ξ ^ b * Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) *
    Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)

  have hΓfin : ∀ (h : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl), SimScaleProps h → ξ.2.2.1 < 1 →
      {γ : Lab | ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ)}.Finite := by
    intro h ξ hS hξ
    have s1 : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ → 1 < |φ ξ / μ - (j : ℝ)| →

      intro μ j φ hφ h1

        ((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs
      have hev := (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : Cyl => (1:ℝ)) ξ).eventually_lt hψ h1

      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.1 (chartZ h γ.1) (by unfold chartZ; fun_prop)

      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.2 (chartT h γ.1) (by unfold chartT; fun_prop)

    have hI : ∀ (c : ℝ) (j : ℤ), |c - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 → j ∈ Set.Icc ⌈c - 1⌉ ⌊c + 1⌋ := by
      intro c j hj

    have hfin : (⋃ n ∈ Set.Iic ⌊1 - Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ)⌋₊, ({n} : Set ℕ) ×ˢ

  have hDq : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ ∧ qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 ∧ 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by

  have hW : ∀ (q Sv E e P C1 C2 b1 b2 d1 d2 a a1 a2 N1 N2 : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → 1 ≤ Sv → 0 ≤ E →

      N1 ≤ C1 * q ^ (B.h * a1) * Sv ^ b1 * E * e ^ (-d1) * P →
      N2 ≤ C2 * q ^ (B.h * a2) * Sv ^ b2 * E * e ^ (-d2) * P →
      N1 + N2 ≤ (|C1| + |C2|) * q ^ (B.h * a) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P := by
    intro q Sv E e P C1 C2 b1 b2 d1 d2 a a1 a2 N1 N2 hq0 hq1 hS1 hE he0 he1 hP ha1 ha2 hN1 hN2
    have key : ∀ (C b d ai N : ℝ), a ≤ ai → N ≤ C * q ^ (B.h * ai) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P →

        N ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * a) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) := by
      intro C b d ai N hα hN hb hd
      have f1 : q ^ (B.h * ai) ≤ q ^ (B.h * a) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hα hh0)

      have f3 : e ^ (-d) ≤ e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge he0 he1 (neg_le_neg hd)
      have p1 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * ai) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
      have p2 : 0 ≤ Sv ^ b := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have p3 : 0 ≤ e ^ (-d) := Real.rpow_nonneg he0.le _
      have p1' : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * a) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
      have p2' : 0 ≤ Sv ^ (max b1 b2) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have m1 : q ^ (B.h * ai) * Sv ^ b ≤ q ^ (B.h * a) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) := mul_le_mul f1 f2 p2 p1'
      have m2 : q ^ (B.h * ai) * Sv ^ b * E ≤ q ^ (B.h * a) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right m1 hE
      have m3 : q ^ (B.h * ai) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) ≤
          q ^ (B.h * a) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) :=
        mul_le_mul m2 f3 p3 (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p1' p2') hE)
      have hWi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right m3 hP
      have hWi0 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * ai) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p1 p2) hE) p3) hP
      calc N ≤ C * q ^ (B.h * ai) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P := hN

    have k1 := key C1 b1 d1 a1 N1 ha1 hN1 (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
    have k2 := key C2 b2 d2 a2 N2 ha2 hN2 (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)

  have hNB : ∀ (f1 f2 g0 : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (k : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl),

  obtain ⟨⟨Hf, h0f, hHf⟩, sf, df, uf, bf⟩ := hf

      C1 C2 c1 c2 e1 e2 (min α β) α β _ _ hq0 hq1 hS1 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) he0 he1 hP
      (min_le_left α β) (min_le_right α β)
      (hb1 γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2) (hb2 γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2)

  · 
    intro θ ξ hξ
    have hξ1 : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := by

      rw [h0]
      simp

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (α β t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α S.Aw → InM B (qsOf l0) β S.Psi → IsOpen {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => AX5 B G l0 S y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y0)) {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0}

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (α β t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α S.Aw → InM B (qsOf l0) β S.Psi → IsOpen {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => AX5 B G l0 S y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y0)) {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0}

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have geom_slow : ∀ B : BG, B.ok →
      IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} ∧
      ∀ (l : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => baseC B l (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) i)
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
    intro B hB
    obtain ⟨hS, hBP⟩ := hB
    have hsc : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hA : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
      have hm : Continuous (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2)) := by fun_prop
      have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2)))
          {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} := by
        refine hsc.comp hm.continuousOn ?_
        intro s hs
        have hs' : s.2.2 < 1 := hs
        exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - s.2.2 by linarith⟩
      have hU : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
      have h1 := hc.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := B.qB))
      have h2 : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst
      have e : {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} =
          {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1} ∩ ({s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} ∩
            ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2))) ⁻¹'
              Iio B.qB) := by
        ext s
        simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_inter_iff, mem_preimage, mem_Iio, Function.comp]
      rw [e]
      exact h2.inter h1
    have hD : IsOpen (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      have hm : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)) := by fun_prop
      have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)))
          {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
        refine hsc.comp hm.continuousOn ?_
        intro w hw
        have hw' : w.2 < 1 := hw
        exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 by linarith⟩
      have hU : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
      have h1 := hc.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := B.qB))
      have e : simDomain B.h B.qB = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
          ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2))) ⁻¹' Iio B.qB := by
        ext w
        simp only [simDomain, mem_setOf_eq, mem_inter_iff, mem_preimage, mem_Iio, Function.comp]
      rw [e]
      exact h1
    have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(uB B)) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      have hAB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿B.AB) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := hBP.2.2.2.1.1
      have hBv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿B.BvB) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := hBP.2.2.2.1.2.1
      have hDA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z) (simDomain B.h B.qB) :=
        ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hD).1 hAB).2
      have hc : ∀ (v : ℝ³) (j : Fin 3),
          ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (v, (0:ℝ)) j) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
        intro v j
        have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (v, (0:ℝ))) (simDomain B.h B.qB) :=
          hDA.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
        exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h1
      let e0 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1
      let e1 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 1 1
      let e2 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 2 1
      have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e1, (0:ℝ)) 2 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e2, (0:ℝ)) 1) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e2, (0:ℝ)) 0 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e0, (0:ℝ)) 2) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e0, (0:ℝ)) 1 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e1, (0:ℝ)) 0) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) + (↿B.BvB) z) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
        refine ((((hc e1 2).sub (hc e2 1)).smul contDiffOn_const).add
          (((hc e2 0).sub (hc e0 2)).smul contDiffOn_const)).add
          (((hc e0 1).sub (hc e1 0)).smul contDiffOn_const) |>.add hBv
      refine hg.congr ?_
      rintro ⟨y, s⟩ hz
      have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s) :=
        (hAB.contDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have hpart : fderiv ℝ (fun w => B.AB w s) y =
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := by
        have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ³ => (w, s)) (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) y :=
          hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left y s
        have h2 : HasFDerivAt ((↿B.AB) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ => (w, s)))
            ((fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)) y :=
          HasFDerivAt.comp (g := ↿B.AB) y hdiff.hasFDerivAt h1
        exact h2.fderiv
      show curl3 (fun w => B.AB w s) y + B.BvB y s = _
      unfold curl3
      rw [hpart]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.inl_apply]
      rfl
    have frame : ∀ r z : ℝ, 0 < r → (rotPt r 0 z) 2 = z ∧
        eR (rotPt r 0 z) = EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) ∧
        eTh (rotPt r 0 z) = EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) := by
      intro r z hr
      have h0 : (rotPt r 0 z) 0 = r := by simp [rotPt]
      have h1 : (rotPt r 0 z) 1 = 0 := by simp [rotPt]
      have h2 : (rotPt r 0 z) 2 = z := by simp [rotPt]
      have hrad : rad (rotPt r 0 z) = r := by
        unfold rad
        rw [h0, h1]
        simp [Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
      refine ⟨h2, ?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold eR radVec
        rw [hrad, h0, h1, zero_smul, add_zero, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
      · unfold eTh azVec
        rw [hrad, h0, h1, neg_zero, zero_smul, zero_add, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
    let ψ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ³ × ℝ := fun s => (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1, s.2.2)
    have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ := by
      have hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1) := by
        unfold rotPt
        fun_prop
      exact hr.prodMk (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd)
    have hmaps : MapsTo ψ {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}
        (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      intro s hs
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hs
      show s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ((rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1) 2) (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB
      rw [(frame s.1 s.2.1 h1).1]
      exact ⟨h2, h3⟩
    refine ⟨hA, fun l i => ?_⟩
    have hcomp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((↿(uB B)) ∘ ψ)
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} :=
      hu.comp hψ.contDiffOn hmaps
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s => Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * inner ℝ (((↿(uB B)) ∘ ψ) s)
        ((![EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ), eZ] :
          Fin 3 → ℝ³) i))
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} :=
      contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.inner ℝ hcomp contDiffOn_const)
    refine hg.congr ?_
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨_, f2, f3⟩ := frame s.1 s.2.1 hs.1
    show Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * inner ℝ (uB B (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1) s.2.2)
        (![eR (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1), eTh (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1), eZ] i) = _
    rw [f2, f3]
    rfl
  
  have etaL_loc : ∀ (h : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → ∀ ξ0 : Cyl, ξ0.2.2.1 < 1 → ∃ N ∈ nhds ξ0,
      ∃ Γ : Finset Lab, ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ N → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) → γ ∈ Γ := by
    intro h hS ξ0 hξ0
    have hLc : ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ContinuousAt (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) ξ := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hτ : 0 < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 := by linarith
      have hqpos : 0 < qC h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).1
      have hqcont : ContinuousAt (qC h) ξ := by
        have hU : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
        have hp : ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
          ⟨trivial, hτ⟩
        have hg : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) :=
          hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)
        have hk : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) ξ := by fun_prop
        have he : qC h = (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘
            (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
          funext η; rfl
        rw [he]
        exact ContinuousAt.comp hg hk
      exact hqcont.logb hqpos.ne'
    have hwin : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (γ : Lab), ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) →
        |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) + (γ.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartR h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartZ h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartT h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
      intro ξ γ hξ hγ
      have s1 : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ → 1 < |φ ξ / μ - (j : ℝ)| →
          ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 := by
        intro μ j φ hφ h1
        have hψ : ContinuousAt (fun η => |φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)|) ξ :=
          ((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs
        have hev := (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : Cyl => (1:ℝ)) ξ).eventually_lt hψ h1
        filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
        have hsq : 1 < (φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)) ^ 2 := (one_lt_sq_iff_one_lt_abs _).mpr hη
        unfold sqPart bumpR
        rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), zero_div]
      have key : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ →
          (∀ η, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 → etaL h γ η = 0) → |φ ξ / μ - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
        intro μ j φ hφ himp
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have hev := s1 μ j φ hφ hc
        apply (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mpr _) hγ
        filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
        exact himp η hη
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have := key 1 (-(γ.1:ℤ)) (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) (hLc ξ hξ)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul])
        simpa [div_one, sub_neg_eq_add] using this
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.1 (chartR h γ.1) (by unfold chartR; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.1 (chartZ h γ.1) (by unfold chartZ; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.2 (chartT h γ.1) (by unfold chartT; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
    obtain ⟨L0, hL0⟩ : ∃ L0 : ℝ, L0 = Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hfin : (⋃ n ∈ Set.Iic ⌊2 - L0⌋₊, ({n} : Set ℕ) ×ˢ
        ((Set.Icc ⌈chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ⌈chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ⌈chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋) ×ˢ
          (Set.univ : Set Bool))).Finite := by
      refine Set.Finite.biUnion (Set.finite_Iic _) (fun n _ => ?_)
      exact (Set.finite_singleton n).prod (((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod
        ((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod (Set.finite_Icc _ _))).prod Set.finite_univ)
    have hI : ∀ (x c : ℝ) (j : ℤ), |x - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 → |x - c| < 1 → j ∈ Set.Icc ⌈c - 2⌉ ⌊c + 2⌋ := by
      intro x c j hj hc
      rw [abs_le] at hj
      rw [abs_lt] at hc
      exact ⟨Int.ceil_le.mpr (by linarith [hj.2, hc.1]), Int.le_floor.mpr (by linarith [hj.1, hc.2])⟩
    have hcR : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartR h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartR; fun_prop
    have hcZ : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartZ h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartZ; fun_prop
    have hcT : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartT h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartT; fun_prop
    have hch : ∀ (φ : Cyl → ℝ) (μ : ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ0 →
        ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, |φ ξ / μ - φ ξ0 / μ| < 1 := by
      intro φ μ hφ
      exact (((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs).eventually_lt continuousAt_const
        (by simp)
    have e1 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 :=
      (show ContinuousAt (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.2.2.1) ξ0 by fun_prop).eventually_lt
        continuousAt_const hξ0
    have e2 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) - L0| < 1 :=
      (((hLc ξ0 hξ0).sub continuousAt_const).abs).eventually_lt continuousAt_const
        (by simp [hL0])
    have e3 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊2 - L0⌋₊ + 1),
        |chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 := by
      rw [Filter.eventually_all_finset]
      intro n _
      exact (hch _ _ (hcR n)).and ((hch _ _ (hcZ n)).and (hch _ _ (hcT n)))
    refine ⟨{ξ | ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) - L0| < 1 ∧
        ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊2 - L0⌋₊ + 1),
        |chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1}, ?_,
      hfin.toFinset, ?_⟩
    · filter_upwards [e1, e2, e3] with ξ h1 h2 h3
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    rintro ⟨n, ⟨a, b, c⟩, σ⟩ ξ ⟨ht, hL, hC⟩ hγ
    obtain ⟨w0, wR, wZ, wT⟩ := hwin ξ _ ht hγ
    simp only at w0 wR wZ wT
    rw [abs_le] at w0
    rw [abs_lt] at hL
    have hn : n ≤ ⌊2 - L0⌋₊ := Nat.le_floor (by linarith [w0.2, hL.1])
    obtain ⟨cR, cZ, cT⟩ := hC n (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn))
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨n, hn, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨rfl, ⟨hI _ _ _ wR cR, hI _ _ _ wZ cZ, hI _ _ _ wT cT⟩, trivial⟩
  
  have wave5_term : ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (qs α : ℝ) (a : WC), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G →
      qs ≤ B.qB → InWg5 B G qs α a → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (i : Fin 3),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => a γ m p.2 i * ephase5 B G γ m p.1 p.2) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h qs) := by
    intro B G qs α a hok hG hqs ha γ m i
    have hamp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => a γ m p.2 i) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h qs) := by
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => a γ m η i) (DomC B.h qs) := contDiffOn_pi.1 (ha.2.1 γ m) i
      exact h1.comp contDiff_snd.contDiffOn (fun p hp => hp.2)
    set v : Cyl → ℝ × ℝ := fun η => Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ with hv
    have hvc : Continuous v := by
      rw [hv]
      unfold Jpow
      fun_prop
    have hbase : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => baseC B γ.1 η j) (DomC B.h qs) := by
      intro j
      obtain ⟨_, hsm⟩ := geom_slow B hok

        {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} := by
      have hp := c1.rpow_const_of_ne (p := drx B.h) (fun w hw => ne_of_gt hw.1)
      exact ((hp.smul contDiffOn_const).add (c3.smul contDiffOn_const)).add contDiff_snd.snd.contDiffOn
    have hξ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ptOf w.1 w.2.1 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2.1 + w.2.2))
        {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} :=
      c1.prodMk (c2.prodMk (c3.prodMk c4))
    have hmap : MapsTo (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ptOf w.1 w.2.1 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2.1 + w.2.2))
        {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      fun w hw => ⟨hw.1, hw.2.1, hw.2.2⟩
    have hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2.1))
        {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} := by
      have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
        ((hc 2).comp contDiff_fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.fst)
      exact hσ.comp hg.contDiffOn (fun w hw =>
        ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2.1 by linarith [hw.2.1]⟩)
    have hpref : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
        simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2.1) ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h))
        {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} :=
      hq.rpow_const_of_ne (fun w hw =>
        ((hok.1.1 (w.1 2) (1 - w.2.1) (by linarith [hw.2.1])).1).ne')
    have hBP := hok.2
    unfold BackgroundProps at hBP
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, ⟨hAB0, -, -⟩, -⟩ := hBP
    have hABc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => B.AB w.1 w.2.1)
        {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} := by
      have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((w.1, w.2.1) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) :=
        contDiff_fst.prodMk contDiff_snd.fst
      exact hAB0.comp hg.contDiffOn (fun w hw => ⟨hw.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hw.2.2 hqB⟩)
    have hwave : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
        waveV5 B G S.Aw (thetaOf w.1) (ptOf w.1 w.2.1 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2.1 + w.2.2)) i)
        {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} := fun i =>
      (hW i).comp (contDiff_fst.contDiffOn.prodMk hξ) (fun w hw => ⟨hw.1, hmap hw⟩)
    have hPs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
        S.Psi (ptOf w.1 w.2.1 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2.1 + w.2.2)))
        {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} :=
      hPsi.comp hξ hmap
    have heRc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => eR w.1)
        {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} :=
      heR.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn hfst
    have heThc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => eTh w.1)
        {w : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1} :=
      heTh.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn hfst
    have hinner := ((((hwave 0).smul heRc).add ((hwave 1).smul heThc)).add
      ((hwave 2).smul (contDiffOn_const (c := eZ)))).add (hPs.smul heThc)
    have hall := hABc.add (hpref.smul hinner)
    refine hall.congr (fun w hw => ?_)
    have hw' : corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2.1 := hw
    simp only [AX5, cyl2cart, if_pos hw'] <;> rfl
  
  intro B G l0 S α β t Y0 hok hG hqB hAw hPsi
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    by_cases ht : t < 1
    · have hσ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
        hok.1.2.2.2.1
      have hc2 : Continuous (fun y : ℝ³ => ((y 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
        ((contDiff_piLp_apply 2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x 2)).continuous).prodMk continuous_const
      have hσc : Continuous (fun y : ℝ³ => simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t)) :=
        hσ.continuousOn.comp_continuous hc2
          (fun y => ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - t by linarith⟩)
      have hf : Continuous (fun x : ℝ³ => x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) :=
        (((contDiff_piLp_apply 2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x 0)).continuous).pow 2).add
          (((contDiff_piLp_apply 2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x 1)).continuous).pow 2)
      have hradc : Continuous rad := by
        have h : Continuous (fun x : ℝ³ => Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2)) := hf.sqrt
        exact h
      have e : {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0} =
          {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y} ∩ {y : ℝ³ | simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0} := by
        ext y
        exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.2⟩, fun h => ⟨h.1, ht, h.2⟩⟩
      rw [e]
      exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const hradc).inter (isOpen_lt hσc continuous_const)
    · have e : {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0} = ∅ := by
        ext y
        exact ⟨fun h => absurd h.2.1 ht, fun h => absurd h (Set.notMem_empty y)⟩
      rw [e]
      exact isOpen_empty
  · 
    have hper_e : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (θ : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl),
        ephase5 B G γ m (θ + 2 * Real.pi) ξ = ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ := by
      intro γ m θ ξ
      simp only [ephase5]
      have e : Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((pint5 B G γ : ℂ) * ((θ + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) +
          (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)) =
          Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((pint5 B G γ : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ) + (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)) +
          ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [e, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I, mul_one]
    have hper_w : ∀ (θ : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (i : Fin 3),
        waveV5 B G S.Aw (θ + 2 * Real.pi) ξ i = waveV5 B G S.Aw θ ξ i := by
      intro θ ξ i
      simp only [waveV5, hper_e]
    have hterm := wave5_term B G (qsOf l0) α S.Aw hok hG hqB hAw
    have hwave : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => waveV5 B G S.Aw p.1 p.2 i)
        (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
      intro i
      apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
      rintro ⟨θ₀, ξ₀⟩ ⟨-, hξ₀⟩
      obtain ⟨N, hNo, hξN, Γ, H, hΓ⟩ := wave5_lf B G (qsOf l0) α S.Aw hok hAw ξ₀ hξ₀
      refine ⟨univ ×ˢ N, isOpen_univ.prod hNo, ⟨mem_univ _, hξN⟩, ?_⟩
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl =>
          ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, S.Aw γ m p.2 i * ephase5 B G γ m p.1 p.2) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
        ContDiffOn.sum (fun γ _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun m _ => hterm γ m i))
      have hsum := Complex.reCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h1
      refine (hsum.mono inter_subset_left).congr ?_
      rintro ⟨θ, ξ⟩ ⟨⟨-, hξD⟩, ⟨-, hξN'⟩⟩
      have hmem : ξ ∈ N ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := ⟨hξN', hξD⟩
      simp only [waveV5, Function.comp_apply, Complex.reCLM_apply]
      congr 1
      have hin : ∀ γ, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, S.Aw γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ =
          ∑ m ∈ H, S.Aw γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ := by
        intro γ
        apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
        intro m hm
        rw [Function.mem_support] at hm
        have hne : S.Aw γ m ξ ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0; apply hm; simp [h0]
        exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr (hΓ ξ hmem γ m hne).2
      rw [finsum_congr hin]
      apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
      intro γ hγ
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hγ
      apply Finset.mem_coe.mpr
      by_contra hnot
      apply hγ
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro m _
      have h0 : S.Aw γ m ξ = 0 := by
        by_contra h0
        exact hnot (hΓ ξ hmem γ m h0).1
      simp [h0]
    have hwθ : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × Cyl => waveV5 B G S.Aw (thetaOf p.1) p.2 i)
        ({y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y} ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := fun i =>
      thetaOf_pc (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) (fun q : ℝ × Cyl => waveV5 B G S.Aw q.1 q.2 i) (hwave i)
        (fun θ e => hper_w θ e i)
    have hAX := ax5_lift B G l0 S hok hqB hPsi.1 hwθ
    have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => ((y, t, Y0) : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) :=
      contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const
    exact (hAX.comp hg.contDiffOn (fun y hy => hy)).congr (fun y _ => rfl)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (F₀ D b : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (U : Set ℝ³) (ξ : Cyl) (ψ : ℝ), IsOpen U → 0 < ξ.1 → (∀ θ : ℝ, rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1 ∈ U) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F₀ U → ContinuousOn b U → DifferentiableAt ℝ φ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1) → (∀ y ∈ U, D y = φ (rad y, y 2) • eTh y) → (∀ a : Fin 3, thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (curl3 (fun y => F₀ y + D y) (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) + (b (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) + ψ • eTh (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1))) (frameAt θ ξ a)) = thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (curl3 F₀ (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) + b (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1)) (frameAt θ ξ a)) + ![-(fderiv ℝ φ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1) (0, 1)), ψ, fderiv ℝ φ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1) (1, 0) + φ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1) / ξ.1] a) ∧ (∀ a a' : Fin 3, thA (fun θ => (inner ℝ (curl3 (fun y => F₀ y + D y) (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) + (b (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) + ψ • eTh (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1))) (frameAt θ ξ a) - thA (fun θ' => inner ℝ (curl3 (fun y => F₀ y + D y) (rotPt ξ.1 θ' ξ.2.1) + (b (rotPt ξ.1 θ' ξ.2.1) + ψ • eTh (rotPt ξ.1 θ' ξ.2.1))) (frameAt θ' ξ a))) * (inner ℝ (curl3 (fun y => F₀ y + D y) (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) + (b (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) + ψ • eTh (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1))) (frameAt θ ξ a') - thA (fun θ' => inner ℝ (curl3 (fun y => F₀ y + D y) (rotPt ξ.1 θ' ξ.2.1) + (b (rotPt ξ.1 θ' ξ.2.1) + ψ • eTh (rotPt ξ.1 θ' ξ.2.1))) (frameAt θ' ξ a')))) = thA (fun θ => (inner ℝ (curl3 F₀ (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) + b (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1)) (frameAt θ ξ a) - thA (fun θ' => inner ℝ (curl3 F₀ (rotPt ξ.1 θ' ξ.2.1) + b (rotPt ξ.1 θ' ξ.2.1)) (frameAt θ' ξ a))) * (inner ℝ (curl3 F₀ (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) + b (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1)) (frameAt θ ξ a') - thA (fun θ' => inner ℝ (curl3 F₀ (rotPt ξ.1 θ' ξ.2.1) + b (rotPt ξ.1 θ' ξ.2.1)) (frameAt θ' ξ a')))))
