signature.statement: ∀ (F₀ D b : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (U : Set ℝ³) (ξ : Cyl) (ψ : ℝ), IsOpen U → 0 < ξ.1 → (∀ θ : ℝ, rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1 ∈ U) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F₀ U → ContinuousOn b U → DifferentiableAt ℝ φ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1) → (∀ y ∈ U, D y = φ (rad y, y 2) • eTh y) → (∀ a : Fin 3, thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (curl3 (fun y => F₀ y + D y) (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) + (b (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) + ψ • eTh (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1))) (frameAt θ ξ a)) = thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (curl3 F₀ (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) + b (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1)) (frameAt θ ξ a)) + ![-(fderiv ℝ φ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1) (0, 1)), ψ, fderiv ℝ φ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1) (1, 0) + φ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1) / ξ.1] a) ∧ (∀ a a' : Fin 3, thA (fun θ => (inner ℝ (curl3 (fun y => F₀ y + D y) (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) + (b (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) + ψ • eTh (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1))) (frameAt θ ξ a) - thA (fun θ' => inner ℝ (curl3 (fun y => F₀ y + D y) (rotPt ξ.1 θ' ξ.2.1) + (b (rotPt ξ.1 θ' ξ.2.1) + ψ • eTh (rotPt ξ.1 θ' ξ.2.1))) (frameAt θ' ξ a))) * (inner ℝ (curl3 (fun y => F₀ y + D y) (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) + (b (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) + ψ • eTh (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1))) (frameAt θ ξ a') - thA (fun θ' => inner ℝ (curl3 (fun y => F₀ y + D y) (rotPt ξ.1 θ' ξ.2.1) + (b (rotPt ξ.1 θ' ξ.2.1) + ψ • eTh (rotPt ξ.1 θ' ξ.2.1))) (frameAt θ' ξ a')))) = thA (fun θ => (inner ℝ (curl3 F₀ (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) + b (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1)) (frameAt θ ξ a) - thA (fun θ' => inner ℝ (curl3 F₀ (rotPt ξ.1 θ' ξ.2.1) + b (rotPt ξ.1 θ' ξ.2.1)) (frameAt θ' ξ a))) * (inner ℝ (curl3 F₀ (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) + b (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1)) (frameAt θ ξ a') - thA (fun θ' => inner ℝ (curl3 F₀ (rotPt ξ.1 θ' ξ.2.1) + b (rotPt ξ.1 θ' ξ.2.1)) (frameAt θ' ξ a')))))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro F₀ D b φ U ξ ψ hU hr hcirc hF₀ hb hφ hD
  obtain ⟨r, z, t, Y⟩ := ξ
  dsimp only at hr hcirc hφ ⊢
  have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
  
  have hcoord : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (y : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ => w i) y := by
    intro i y
    have h0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (ι := Fin 3) i) y :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt _
    rwa [EuclideanSpace.coe_proj] at h0
  have hc0 : ∀ ρ θ ζ : ℝ, rotPt ρ θ ζ 0 = ρ * Real.cos θ := by intro ρ θ ζ; simp [rotPt]
  have hc1 : ∀ ρ θ ζ : ℝ, rotPt ρ θ ζ 1 = ρ * Real.sin θ := by intro ρ θ ζ; simp [rotPt]
  have hc2 : ∀ ρ θ ζ : ℝ, rotPt ρ θ ζ 2 = ζ := by intro ρ θ ζ; simp [rotPt]
  have hsq : ∀ ρ θ : ℝ, (ρ * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (ρ * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = ρ ^ 2 := by
    intro ρ θ; linear_combination ρ ^ 2 * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
  have hradG : ∀ ρ θ ζ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → rad (rotPt ρ θ ζ) = ρ := by
    intro ρ θ ζ hρ
    show Real.sqrt ((rotPt ρ θ ζ) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt ρ θ ζ) 1 ^ 2) = ρ
    rw [hc0, hc1, hsq, Real.sqrt_sq hρ.le]
  have heR : ∀ θ : ℝ, eR (rotPt r θ z) = Real.cos θ • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +
      Real.sin θ • (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) := by
    intro θ
    rw [eR, hradG r θ z hr, radVec, hc0, hc1, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul,
      inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hr0, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hr0]
  have heTh : ∀ θ : ℝ, eTh (rotPt r θ z) = (-Real.sin θ) • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +
      Real.cos θ • (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) := by
    intro θ
    rw [eTh, hradG r θ z hr, azVec, hc0, hc1, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_neg,
      inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hr0, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hr0]
  
  have hinF : ∀ (θ c0 c1 c2 : ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
      inner ℝ (c0 • eR (rotPt r θ z) + c1 • eTh (rotPt r θ z) + c2 • eZ) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a) =
        ![c0, c1, c2] a := by
    intro θ c0 c1 c2 a
    have hf : frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) = ![eR (rotPt r θ z), eTh (rotPt r θ z), eZ] := rfl
    rw [hf, heR, heTh]
    obtain rfl | rfl | rfl : a = 0 ∨ a = 1 ∨ a = 2 := by fin_cases a <;> simp
    · simp [eZ, inner_add_left, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
        EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
      linear_combination c0 * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
    · simp [eZ, inner_add_left, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
        EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
      linear_combination c1 * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
    · simp [eZ, inner_add_left, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
        EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
  
  set L : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
    (-(EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) +
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))
    with hLdef
  have hL : (⇑L : ℝ³ → ℝ³) = azVec := by
    funext y
    simp only [hLdef, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply]
    unfold azVec
    simp
  have hLv : ∀ v : ℝ³, L v = azVec v := fun v => by rw [hL]
  
  have hpt : ∀ (θ : ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
      inner ℝ (curl3 (fun y => F₀ y + D y) (rotPt r θ z) + (b (rotPt r θ z) + ψ • eTh (rotPt r θ z)))
        (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a) =
      inner ℝ (curl3 F₀ (rotPt r θ z) + b (rotPt r θ z)) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a) +
        ![-(fderiv ℝ φ (r, z) (0, 1)), ψ, fderiv ℝ φ (r, z) (1, 0) + φ (r, z) / r] a := by
    intro θ a
    have hxU : rotPt r θ z ∈ U := hcirc θ
    have hUx : U ∈ nhds (rotPt r θ z) := hU.mem_nhds hxU
    have hF0d : DifferentiableAt ℝ F₀ (rotPt r θ z) :=
      (hF₀.differentiableOn one_ne_zero).differentiableAt hUx
    obtain ⟨g, hgdef⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ³ → ℝ, g = fun y => φ (rad y, y 2) * (rad y)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hsum : 0 < rotPt r θ z 0 ^ 2 + rotPt r θ z 1 ^ 2 := by
      rw [hc0, hc1, hsq]; positivity
    have hradD : DifferentiableAt ℝ rad (rotPt r θ z) :=
      (((hcoord 0 _).pow 2).add ((hcoord 1 _).pow 2)).sqrt hsum.ne'
    have hrx : rad (rotPt r θ z) = r := hradG r θ z hr
    have hφ' : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ (rad (rotPt r θ z), rotPt r θ z 2) := by
      rw [hrx, hc2]; exact hφ
    have hgd : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (rotPt r θ z) := by
      rw [hgdef]
      exact (DifferentiableAt.comp (f := fun y : ℝ³ => (rad y, y 2)) (rotPt r θ z) hφ'
        (hradD.prodMk (hcoord 2 _))).mul (hradD.inv (by rw [hrx]; exact hr0))
    obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ, HasFDerivAt g G (rotPt r θ z) := ⟨_, hgd.hasFDerivAt⟩
    have hAz : HasFDerivAt azVec L (rotPt r θ z) := by rw [← hL]; exact L.hasFDerivAt
    have hev : D =ᶠ[nhds (rotPt r θ z)] fun y => g y • azVec y := by
      filter_upwards [hUx] with y hy
      rw [hD y hy, hgdef, eTh, smul_smul]
    have hDfd : HasFDerivAt D (g (rotPt r θ z) • L + G.smulRight (azVec (rotPt r θ z))) (rotPt r θ z) :=
      (hG.smul hAz).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    
    have hmZ : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℝ => rotPt r θ ζ) (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) z := by
      unfold rotPt
      exact ((hasDerivAt_const z ((r * Real.cos θ) • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +
        (r * Real.sin θ) • (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³))).add
        ((hasDerivAt_id' z).smul_const (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³))).congr_deriv
        (by rw [zero_add, one_smul])
    have hv1 : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℝ => g (rotPt r θ ζ)) (G (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))) z :=
      hG.comp_hasDerivAt z hmZ
    have hv2 : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℝ => φ (r, ζ) * r⁻¹) (fderiv ℝ φ (r, z) (0, 1) * r⁻¹) z := by
      have h := (hφ.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt z ((hasDerivAt_const z r).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' z))).mul_const r⁻¹
      exact h
    have hv3 : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℝ => g (rotPt r θ ζ)) (fderiv ℝ φ (r, z) (0, 1) * r⁻¹) z := by
      refine hv2.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ζ => ?_)
      simp only [hgdef, hradG r θ ζ hr, hc2]
    have hGz := hv1.unique hv3
    have hGz2 : r * G (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) = fderiv ℝ φ (r, z) (0, 1) := by
      rw [hGz]; field_simp
    
    have hmR : HasDerivAt (fun ρ : ℝ => rotPt ρ θ z)
        (Real.cos θ • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +
          Real.sin θ • (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³)) r := by
      unfold rotPt
      exact ((((hasDerivAt_mul_const (Real.cos θ)).smul_const
        (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³)).add
        ((hasDerivAt_mul_const (Real.sin θ)).smul_const
        (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³))).add
        (hasDerivAt_const r (z • (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³)))).congr_deriv
        (add_zero _)
    have hr1 : HasDerivAt (fun ρ : ℝ => g (rotPt ρ θ z))
        (G (Real.cos θ • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +
          Real.sin θ • (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³))) r :=
      hG.comp_hasDerivAt r hmR
    have hr2 : HasDerivAt (fun ρ : ℝ => φ (ρ, z) * ρ⁻¹)
        (fderiv ℝ φ (r, z) (1, 0) * r⁻¹ + φ (r, z) * (-(r ^ 2)⁻¹)) r := by
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun ρ : ℝ => φ (ρ, z)) (fderiv ℝ φ (r, z) (1, 0)) r := by
        have h := hφ.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt r ((hasDerivAt_id' r).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const r z))
        exact h
      exact h1.mul (hasDerivAt_inv hr0)
    have hr3 : HasDerivAt (fun ρ : ℝ => g (rotPt ρ θ z))
        (fderiv ℝ φ (r, z) (1, 0) * r⁻¹ + φ (r, z) * (-(r ^ 2)⁻¹)) r := by
      refine hr2.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hr] with ρ hρ
      simp only [hgdef, hradG ρ θ z hρ, hc2]
    have hGr := hr1.unique hr3
    rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul] at hGr
    have hGr2 : r * (Real.cos θ * G (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) +
        Real.sin θ * G (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))) =
        fderiv ℝ φ (r, z) (1, 0) - φ (r, z) / r := by
      rw [hGr]; field_simp; ring
    
    have hgx : g (rotPt r θ z) = φ (r, z) * r⁻¹ := by simp only [hgdef, hrx, hc2]
    have hcurlD : curl3 D (rotPt r θ z) = (-(fderiv ℝ φ (r, z) (0, 1))) • eR (rotPt r θ z) +
        (fderiv ℝ φ (r, z) (1, 0) + φ (r, z) / r) • eZ := by
      unfold curl3
      rw [hDfd.fderiv, heR θ, hgx]
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      · simp [eZ, hLv, azVec, hc0, hc1]
        linear_combination (Real.cos θ) * hGz2
      · simp [eZ, hLv, azVec, hc0, hc1]
        linear_combination (Real.sin θ) * hGz2
      · simp [eZ, hLv, azVec, hc0, hc1]
        linear_combination hGr2
    have hDd : DifferentiableAt ℝ D (rotPt r θ z) := hDfd.differentiableAt
    have hadd : curl3 (fun y => F₀ y + D y) (rotPt r θ z) = curl3 F₀ (rotPt r θ z) + curl3 D (rotPt r θ z) := by
      unfold curl3
      rw [fderiv_fun_add hF0d hDd]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, PiLp.add_apply]
      module
    rw [hadd, hcurlD]
    have e : curl3 F₀ (rotPt r θ z) + ((-(fderiv ℝ φ (r, z) (0, 1))) • eR (rotPt r θ z) +
        (fderiv ℝ φ (r, z) (1, 0) + φ (r, z) / r) • eZ) + (b (rotPt r θ z) + ψ • eTh (rotPt r θ z)) =
        (curl3 F₀ (rotPt r θ z) + b (rotPt r θ z)) + ((-(fderiv ℝ φ (r, z) (0, 1))) • eR (rotPt r θ z) +
          ψ • eTh (rotPt r θ z) + (fderiv ℝ φ (r, z) (1, 0) + φ (r, z) / r) • eZ) := by abel
    rw [e, inner_add_left (curl3 F₀ (rotPt r θ z) + b (rotPt r θ z)), hinF]
  
  let Φ : (ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
    { toFun := fun L =>
        (L (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) 2 - L (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) 1) •
            EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (L (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) 0 - L (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) 2) •
            EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (L (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) 1 - L (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) 0) •
            EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)
      map_add' := by
        intro L M
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, PiLp.add_apply]
        module
      map_smul' := by
        intro c L
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply]
        module }
  have hγ : Continuous fun θ : ℝ => rotPt r θ z := by unfold rotPt; fun_prop
  have hfdC : Continuous fun θ : ℝ => fderiv ℝ F₀ (rotPt r θ z) := by
    have h := (hF₀.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU le_rfl).comp_continuous hγ hcirc
    exact h
  have hcurlC : Continuous fun θ : ℝ => curl3 F₀ (rotPt r θ z) := by
    have e : (fun θ : ℝ => curl3 F₀ (rotPt r θ z)) = fun θ => Φ (fderiv ℝ F₀ (rotPt r θ z)) := rfl
    rw [e]
    exact (LinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional Φ).comp hfdC
  have hbC : Continuous fun θ : ℝ => b (rotPt r θ z) := by
    have h := hb.comp_continuous hγ hcirc
    exact h
  have hfrC : ∀ a : Fin 3, Continuous fun θ => frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a := by
    intro a
    obtain rfl | rfl | rfl : a = 0 ∨ a = 1 ∨ a = 2 := by fin_cases a <;> simp
    · have e : (fun θ => frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) 0) = fun θ =>
          Real.cos θ • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +
            Real.sin θ • (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) := funext fun θ => heR θ
      rw [e]; fun_prop
    · have e : (fun θ => frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) 1) = fun θ =>
          (-Real.sin θ) • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) +
            Real.cos θ • (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) : ℝ³) := funext fun θ => heTh θ
      rw [e]; fun_prop
    · have e : (fun θ => frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) 2) = fun _ => eZ := rfl
      rw [e]; exact continuous_const
  have hcont : ∀ a : Fin 3, Continuous fun θ =>
      inner ℝ (curl3 F₀ (rotPt r θ z) + b (rotPt r θ z)) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a) :=
    fun a => (hcurlC.add hbC).inner (hfrC a)
  
  have hshift : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), Continuous f → thA (fun θ => f θ + c) = thA f + c := by
    intro f c hf
    simp only [thA]
    have hπ : (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (hf.intervalIntegrable _ _) (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _),
      intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, sub_zero, mul_add, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hπ]
  refine ⟨fun a => ?_, fun a a' => ?_⟩
  · simp only [hpt]
    exact hshift _ _ (hcont a)
  · simp only [hpt]
    rw [hshift _ _ (hcont a), hshift _ _ (hcont a')]
    congr 1
    funext θ
    ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (β t : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), B.ok → qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB → InM B (qsOf l0) β S.bdir → ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ³ => BX B G l0 S y t Y) {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0}

signature.name: mmu_bx_continuous_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (β t : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), B.ok → qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB → InM B (qsOf l0) β S.bdir → ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ³ => BX B G l0 S y t Y) {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0}

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 S β t Y hok hqB hbdir
  have hS := hok.1
  have hc : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x i) := fun i => contDiff_piLp_apply 2
  have hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) := ((hc 0).pow 2).add ((hc 1).pow 2)
  have hradS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ rad {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} := by
    have h := hf.contDiffOn.sqrt (s := {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x}) (fun x hx => by
      have hx' : 0 < Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) := hx
      exact (Real.sqrt_pos.mp hx').ne')
    exact h
  have hinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (rad x)⁻¹) {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} :=
    hradS.inv (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
  have haz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ azVec := by
    have h : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => -(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
        x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) :=
      ((hc 1).neg.smul contDiff_const).add ((hc 0).smul contDiff_const)
    exact h
  have heTh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ eTh {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} := hinv.smul haz.contDiffOn
  set U : Set ℝ³ := {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0} with hU
  have heThU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ eTh U := heTh.mono (fun y hy => hy.1)
  have hradU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ rad U := hradS.mono (fun y hy => hy.1)
  have hπ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => ((rad y, y 2, t, Y) : Cyl)) U :=
    hradU.prodMk ((hc 2).contDiffOn.prodMk contDiffOn_const)
  have hmapsD : MapsTo (fun y : ℝ³ => ((rad y, y 2, t, Y) : Cyl)) U (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    fun y hy => hy
  have hBXeq : ∀ y ∈ U, BX B G l0 S y t Y =
      B.BvB y t + (qC B.h ((rad y, y 2, t, Y) : Cyl) ^ (-Aex B.h) *
        S.bdir ((rad y, y 2, t, Y) : Cyl)) • eTh y := by
    intro y hy
    have hw : corrOn B l0 y t := hy
    simp only [BX, if_pos hw, ptOf]
  have hBP := hok.2
  unfold BackgroundProps at hBP
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, ⟨-, hBv0, -⟩, -⟩ := hBP
  have hBvc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => B.BvB y t) U := by
    have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => ((y, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) := contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const
    refine hBv0.comp hg.contDiffOn (fun y hy => ?_)
    show t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < B.qB
    exact ⟨hy.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hy.2.2 hqB⟩
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have hπq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) :=
      contDiff_snd.fst.prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
    exact hS.2.2.2.1.comp hπq.contDiffOn (fun ξ (hξ : ξ.2.2.1 < 1) =>
      (⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩ : (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) ∈ univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)))
  have hq1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => qC B.h ((rad y, y 2, t, Y) : Cyl)) U :=
    hqC.comp hπ (fun y hy => hy.2.1)
  have hq2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => qC B.h ((rad y, y 2, t, Y) : Cyl) ^ (-Aex B.h)) U :=
    hq1.rpow_const_of_ne (fun y hy => by
      have ht : t < 1 := hy.2.1
      exact (hS.1 (y 2) (1 - t) (by linarith)).1.ne')
  have hbd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => S.bdir ((rad y, y 2, t, Y) : Cyl)) U :=
    hbdir.1.comp hπ hmapsD
  have hE := hBvc.add ((hq2.mul hbd).smul heThU)
  refine hE.continuousOn.congr (fun y hy => ?_)
  rw [hBXeq y hy]
  rfl

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (V : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (k : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (a b c : ℝ), IsOpen V → c ∈ Set.Ioo a b → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => k x.1 x.2) (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ V) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ∫ s in c..x.1, k s x.2) (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ V)

signature.name: stp5_param_prim_smooth
signature.statement: ∀ (V : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (k : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (a b c : ℝ), IsOpen V → c ∈ Set.Ioo a b → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => k x.1 x.2) (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ V) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ∫ s in c..x.1, k s x.2) (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ V)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro V k a b c hV hc hk
  obtain ⟨hac, hcb⟩ := hc
  have hUo : IsOpen (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ V) := isOpen_Ioo.prod hV
  have hφc : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) => (((p.2.1 - c) * p.1 + c, p.2.2) : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) := by
    fun_prop
  have hO : IsOpen ((fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) => (((p.2.1 - c) * p.1 + c, p.2.2) : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))
      ⁻¹' (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ V)) := hUo.preimage hφc.continuous
  have hsub : Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ V) ⊆
      (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) => (((p.2.1 - c) * p.1 + c, p.2.2) : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))
        ⁻¹' (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ V) := by
    rintro ⟨u, t, v⟩ ⟨⟨hu0, hu1⟩, ⟨ht1, ht2⟩, hv⟩
    show ((t - c) * u + c, v) ∈ Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ V
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, hv⟩
    · rcases le_total c t with h | h
      · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h) hu0]
      · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h) (sub_nonneg.mpr hu1)]
    · rcases le_total c t with h | h
      · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h) (sub_nonneg.mpr hu1)]
      · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h) hu0]
  have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) => k ((p.2.1 - c) * p.1 + c) p.2.2)
      ((fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) => (((p.2.1 - c) * p.1 + c, p.2.2) : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))
        ⁻¹' (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ V)) :=
    hk.comp hφc.contDiffOn (fun p hp => hp)
  
  have unit_leibniz : ∀ (U : Set (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) (W : Set (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))),
      IsOpen U → IsOpen W → Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ U ⊆ W → ∀ (n : ℕ) {F : Type}
      [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F] (H : ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) → F),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H W → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun w' => ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, H (u, w')) U := by
    intro U W hUo hO hsub
    have param_fderiv : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
        (H : ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) → F), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H W →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) => fderiv ℝ (fun w' => H (p.1, w')) p.2) W := by
      intro F _ _ H hH p hp
      have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ H p := hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hp)
      apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
          (Function.uncurry (fun (q : ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) (w' : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) => H (q.1, w')))
          (p, p.2) := by
        have e : Function.uncurry
            (fun (q : ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) (w' : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) => H (q.1, w')) =
            H ∘ (fun z : (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) => (z.1.1, z.2)) := rfl
        rw [e]
        apply ContDiffAt.comp (g := H) (p, p.2)
        · simpa using hHa
        · fun_prop
      exact ContDiffAt.fderiv (f := fun (q : ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) (w' : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) => H (q.1, w'))
        (g := Prod.snd) h1 contDiffAt_snd (le_of_eq ENat.coe_top_add_one)
    have param_hasFDeriv : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
        (H : ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) → F), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H W → ∀ w ∈ U,
        HasFDerivAt (fun w' => ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, H (u, w'))
          (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, fderiv ℝ (fun w' => H (u, w')) w) w := by
      intro F _ _ _ H hH w hw
      have hHs := param_fderiv H hH
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hUo w hw
      set s := Metric.closedBall w (δ / 2) with hs
      have hsU : s ⊆ U := (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
      have hsn : s ∈ nhds w := Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds w (by linarith)
      have hK : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ s) := isCompact_Icc.prod (isCompact_closedBall _ _)
      have hKsub : Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ s ⊆ W := fun z hz => hsub ⟨hz.1, hsU hz.2⟩
      obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hHs.continuousOn.mono hKsub)
      have hcont : ∀ x ∈ U, ContinuousOn (fun u : ℝ => H (u, x)) (Set.Icc 0 1) := by
        intro x hx
        exact hH.continuousOn.comp (f := fun u : ℝ => ((u, x) : ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))
          (Continuous.continuousOn (by fun_prop)) (fun u hu => hsub ⟨hu, hx⟩)
      have hcont' : ∀ x ∈ U,
          ContinuousOn (fun u : ℝ => fderiv ℝ (fun w' => H (u, w')) x) (Set.Icc 0 1) := by
        intro x hx
        exact hHs.continuousOn.comp (f := fun u : ℝ => ((u, x) : ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))
          (Continuous.continuousOn (by fun_prop)) (fun u hu => hsub ⟨hu, hx⟩)
      have hIoc : Set.uIoc (0:ℝ) 1 ⊆ Set.Icc 0 1 := by
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one]
        exact Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self
      refine intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (μ := volume)
        (F := fun x u => H (u, x)) (F' := fun x u => fderiv ℝ (fun w' => H (u, w')) x)
        (bound := fun _ => B) hsn ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · filter_upwards [hUo.mem_nhds hw] with x hx
        exact ((hcont x hx).mono hIoc).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
      · exact ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one (hcont w hw)
      · exact ((hcont' w hw).mono hIoc).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
      · refine ae_of_all _ (fun u hu x hx => ?_)
        exact hB (u, x) ⟨hIoc hu, hx⟩
      · exact intervalIntegrable_const
      · refine ae_of_all _ (fun u hu x hx => ?_)
        have hxU : x ∈ U := hsU hx
        have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ H (u, x) := hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds (hsub ⟨hIoc hu, hxU⟩))
        have : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w' => H (u, w')) x :=
          hHa.comp x (by fun_prop : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
            (fun w' : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((u, w') : ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))) x)
        exact (this.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro F _ _ _ H hH
      have hD : DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun w' => ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, H (u, w')) U :=
        fun w hw => (param_hasFDeriv H hH w hw).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      rw [Nat.cast_zero]
      exact contDiffOn_zero.mpr hD.continuousOn
    | succ n ih =>
      intro F _ _ _ H hH
      have hD : DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun w' => ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, H (u, w')) U :=
        fun w hw => (param_hasFDeriv H hH w hw).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      have hCS : CompleteSpace ((ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) →L[ℝ] F) :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.instCompleteSpace (E := ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))
      have hIH := @ih ((ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) →L[ℝ] F) _ _ hCS
        (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) => fderiv ℝ (fun w' => H (p.1, w')) p.2) (param_fderiv H hH)
      rw [Nat.cast_succ]
      refine (contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hUo).mpr ⟨hD, fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact absurd h (by simp)
      · refine hIH.congr (fun w hw => ?_)
        exact (param_hasFDeriv H hH w hw).fderiv
  have hI : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun x : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, k ((x.1 - c) * u + c) x.2)
      (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ V) :=
    contDiffOn_infty.mpr (fun n => unit_leibniz _ _ hUo hO hsub n _ hG)
  have hprod : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun x : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => (x.1 - c) * ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, k ((x.1 - c) * u + c) x.2)
      (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ V) :=
    (contDiffOn_fst.sub contDiffOn_const).mul hI
  refine hprod.congr (fun x _ => ?_)
  have h := intervalIntegral.mul_integral_comp_mul_add (a := 0) (b := 1)
    (f := fun s => k s x.2) (x.1 - c) c
  simp only [mul_zero, zero_add, mul_one, sub_add_cancel] at h
  exact h.symm

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hB e _he
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hB.2.1.2.2.1
  have hXm : B.Xa < B.m1 := hB.2.1.2.2.2.1
  have hm12 : B.m1 < B.m2 := hB.2.1.2.2.2.2.1
  have ha0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have hab : Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) < Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) :=
    Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hw : 0 < (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2 := by linarith
  
  have hvan : ∀ s : ℝ, (s ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) ∨ Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) ≤ s) → rhoHat B s = 0 := by
    intro s hs
    have hu : 1 ≤ ((s - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) /
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2)) ^ 2 := by
      rcases hs with hs | hs
      · have h1 : (s - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) /
            ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2) ≤ -1 := by
          rw [div_le_iff₀ hw]; linarith
        nlinarith
      · have h1 : 1 ≤ (s - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) /
            ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2) := by
          rw [le_div_iff₀ hw]; linarith
        nlinarith
    have hnum : bumpR ((s - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) /
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2)) = 0 :=
      Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
    unfold rhoHat
    rw [hnum, zero_div]
  
  have hbcont : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => bumpR ((u - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) /
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2))) := by
    unfold bumpR
    exact Real.smoothTransition.continuous.comp (by fun_prop)
  have hbpos : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)),
      0 < bumpR ((x - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) /
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2)) := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 : -1 < (x - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) /
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2) := by
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ hw]; linarith [hx.1]
    have h2 : (x - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) /
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2) < 1 := by
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hw]; linarith [hx.2]
    unfold bumpR
    exact Real.smoothTransition.pos_of_pos (by nlinarith)
  have hZpos : 0 < ∫ u in (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1))..(Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)),
      bumpR ((u - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) /
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2)) :=
    intervalIntegral.intervalIntegral_pos_of_pos_on (hbcont.intervalIntegrable _ _) hbpos hab
  have hrcont : Continuous (rhoHat B) := by
    unfold rhoHat
    exact hbcont.div_const _
  have hrpos : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)), 0 < rhoHat B x := by
    intro x hx
    unfold rhoHat
    exact div_pos (hbpos x hx) hZpos
  have hNpos : 0 < ∫ u in (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1))..(Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)), u ^ e * rhoHat B u :=
    intervalIntegral.intervalIntegral_pos_of_pos_on
      (((continuous_pow e).mul hrcont).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      (fun x hx => mul_pos (pow_pos (lt_trans ha0 hx.1) e) (hrpos x hx)) hab
  have hbvan : ∀ s : ℝ, (s ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) ∨ Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) ≤ s) → bHatE B e s = 0 := by
    intro s hs
    unfold bHatE
    rw [hvan s hs, zero_div]
  refine ⟨fun z t ht => ?_, fun ξ h1 h2 hX => ?_⟩
  · have hq : 0 < simScale B.h z (1 - t) := (hB.1.1 z (1 - t) (by linarith)).1
    have hσ : 0 < Real.sqrt (simScale B.h z (1 - t)) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq
    have hpow : simScale B.h z (1 - t) ^ (-(((e:ℝ) + 1) / 2)) =
        ((Real.sqrt (simScale B.h z (1 - t)))⁻¹) ^ (e + 1) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_neg hq.le, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hq.le]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    have hpt : ∀ r : ℝ, r ^ e * bE B e (r, z, t, 0) =
        (Real.sqrt (simScale B.h z (1 - t)))⁻¹ *
          (((Real.sqrt (simScale B.h z (1 - t)))⁻¹ * r) ^ e *
            bHatE B e ((Real.sqrt (simScale B.h z (1 - t)))⁻¹ * r)) := by
      intro r
      show r ^ e * (simScale B.h z (1 - t) ^ (-(((e:ℝ) + 1) / 2)) *
        bHatE B e (r / Real.sqrt (simScale B.h z (1 - t)))) = _
      rw [hpow, div_eq_inv_mul, mul_pow, pow_succ]
      ring
    have hcv := MeasureTheory.integral_comp_mul_left_Ioi (fun x : ℝ => x ^ e * bHatE B e x) 0
      (inv_pos.mpr hσ)
    have hI : ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ e * bE B e (r, z, t, 0) =
        ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), x ^ e * bHatE B e x := by
      simp_rw [hpt]
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, hcv, mul_zero, inv_inv,
        smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hσ.ne', one_mul]
    have hsub : Set.Ioc (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) ⊆ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) :=
      fun x hx => lt_trans ha0 hx.1
    have hdiff : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) \ Set.Ioc (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)),
        x ^ e * bHatE B e x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨-, hx1⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_Ioc, not_and_or, not_lt, not_le] at hx1
      rw [hbvan x (hx1.imp id le_of_lt), mul_zero]
    rw [hI, MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi hsub hdiff,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le]
    unfold bHatE
    simp_rw [← mul_div_assoc]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_div]
    exact div_self hNpos.ne'
  · have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hB.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
    have hσ : 0 < Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq
    have hR : 0 < ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := div_pos h1 hσ
    have hR2 : (ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ)) ^ 2 = 2 * XC B.h ξ := by
      rw [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hq.le]
      unfold XC
      field_simp
    have hzero : bHatE B e (ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ)) = 0 := by
      apply hbvan
      rcases hX with hX | hX
      · left
        rw [← Real.sqrt_sq hR.le]
        exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by rw [hR2]; linarith)
      · right
        rw [← Real.sqrt_sq hR.le]
        exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by rw [hR2]; linarith)
    unfold bE
    rw [hzero, mul_zero]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (α : ℝ) (e : ℕ), B.ok → (e = 1 ∨ e = 2) → InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (FE5 B G l0 S e)) → (∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → (∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ e * bE B e (r, z, t, 0)) = 1) → (∀ ξ : Cyl, 0 < ξ.1 → ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.m1 ∨ B.m2 ≤ XC B.h ξ) → bE B e ξ = 0) → (∀ (V : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (k : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (a b c : ℝ), IsOpen V → c ∈ Set.Ioo a b → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => k x.1 x.2) (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ V) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ∫ s in c..x.1, k s x.2) (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ V)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (sigE5 B G l0 S e) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → sigE5 B G l0 S e ξ = 0) ∧ (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dR B.h (sigE5 B G l0 S e) ξ + (e : ℝ) / ξ.1 * sigE5 B G l0 S e ξ = -FE5 B G l0 S e ξ + bE B e ξ * ME5 B G l0 S e ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 S α e hB he hF hnorm hbE hPP
  
  have vanishA : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (e : ℕ) (M r : ℝ), 0 ≤ r →
      (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ r → f s = 0 ∧ g s = 0) →
      ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..r, s ^ e * (f s - g s * M) = 0 := by
    intro f g e M r hr H
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hr]
    rw [setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioc (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ)) ?_]
    · simp
    · intro s hs
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := H s hs.1 hs.2
      simp [h1, h2]
  have vanishB : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (e : ℕ) (c r : ℝ), 0 < c → c ≤ r →
      ContinuousOn f (Ioi 0) → ContinuousOn g (Ioi 0) →
      (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → (s ≤ c ∨ r ≤ s) → f s = 0 ∧ g s = 0) →
      (∫ s in Ioi (0:ℝ), s ^ e * g s) = 1 →
      ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..r, s ^ e * (f s - g s * ∫ s' in Ioi (0:ℝ), s' ^ e * f s') = 0 := by
    intro f g e c r hc hcr hf hg H hn
    have hsub : ∀ x ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) \ Icc c r, x ≤ c ∨ r ≤ x := by
      intro x hx
      rcases le_or_gt x c with h | h
      · exact Or.inl h
      · right
        by_contra h'
        push Not at h'
        exact hx.2 ⟨h.le, h'.le⟩
    have hIcc : Icc c r ⊆ Ioi (0:ℝ) := fun x hx => lt_of_lt_of_le hc hx.1
    have i1 : IntegrableOn (fun s => s ^ e * f s) (Ioi (0:ℝ)) := by
      apply IntegrableOn.of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero (s := Icc c r)
      · exact ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc ((continuousOn_pow e).mul (hf.mono hIcc))
      · exact measurableSet_Ioi
      · intro x hx
        simp [(H x hx.1 (hsub x hx)).1]
    have i2 : IntegrableOn (fun s => s ^ e * g s) (Ioi (0:ℝ)) := by
      apply IntegrableOn.of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero (s := Icc c r)
      · exact ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc ((continuousOn_pow e).mul (hg.mono hIcc))
      · exact measurableSet_Ioi
      · intro x hx
        simp [(H x hx.1 (hsub x hx)).2]
    set M := ∫ s' in Ioi (0:ℝ), s' ^ e * f s' with hM
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := (hc.le.trans hcr)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hr0]
    rw [← setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi Ioc_subset_Ioi_self ?_]
    · have e1 : ∫ s in Ioi (0:ℝ), s ^ e * (f s - g s * M) =
          ∫ s in Ioi (0:ℝ), (s ^ e * f s - M * (s ^ e * g s)) := by
        congr 1
        funext s
        ring
      rw [e1, integral_sub i1 (i2.const_mul M), integral_const_mul, hn, ← hM]
      ring
    · intro x hx
      have hx0 : 0 < x := hx.1
      have : r ≤ x := by
        by_contra h'
        push Not at h'
        exact hx.2 ⟨hx0, h'.le⟩
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := H x hx0 (Or.inr this)
      simp [h1, h2]
  have hderiv : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (e : ℕ) (r ρ0 : ℝ), 1 ≤ e → 0 < r → 0 < ρ0 →
      ContinuousOn f (Ioi 0) → ContinuousOn g (Ioi 0) →
      (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ ρ0 → f s = 0 ∧ g s = 0) →
      HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => -(x ^ e)⁻¹ * ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..x, s ^ e * (f s - g s * M))
        (-((e : ℝ) / r) * (-(r ^ e)⁻¹ * ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..r, s ^ e * (f s - g s * M)) - f r + g r * M) r := by
    intro f g M e r ρ0 he hr hρ0 hf hg H
    have hk : ContinuousOn (fun s => s ^ e * (f s - g s * M)) (Ioi 0) :=
      (continuousOn_pow e).mul (hf.sub (hg.mul continuousOn_const))
    have hc : 0 < min ρ0 r := lt_min hρ0 hr
    have int1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => s ^ e * (f s - g s * M)) volume 0 (min ρ0 r) := by
      rw [intervalIntegrable_iff, uIoc_of_le hc.le]
      refine (integrableOn_zero).congr_fun (fun s hs => ?_) measurableSet_Ioc
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := H s hs.1 (hs.2.trans (min_le_left _ _))
      simp [h1, h2]
    have int2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => s ^ e * (f s - g s * M)) volume (min ρ0 r) r := by
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      apply hk.mono
      rw [uIcc_of_le (min_le_right _ _)]
      exact fun x hx => lt_of_lt_of_le hc hx.1
    have hI := intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (int1.trans int2)
      (hk.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter isOpen_Ioi r hr) (hk.continuousAt (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds hr))
    have hpow := hasDerivAt_pow e r
    have hinv := hpow.inv (pow_ne_zero e hr.ne')
    have hprod := hinv.neg.mul hI
    refine hprod.congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [Pi.neg_apply, Pi.inv_apply]
    generalize (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..r, s ^ e * (f s - g s * M)) = I
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, e = n + 1 := ⟨e - 1, by omega⟩
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    have hrn : r ^ n ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero n hr.ne'
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring

  have hsigEq : sigE5 B G l0 S e = fun η : Cyl => -(η.1 ^ e)⁻¹ * ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..η.1, s ^ e *
      (FE5 B G l0 S e (s, η.2.1, η.2.2.1, 0) - bE B e (s, η.2.1, η.2.2.1, 0) *
        ∫ s' in Ioi (0:ℝ), s' ^ e * FE5 B G l0 S e (s', η.2.1, η.2.2.1, 0)) := by
    funext η
    unfold sigE5 ME5
    rfl
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hsigEq]
    exact hP.1.mono (fun ξ hξ => ⟨hξ.1, Umem hξ.2.1 hξ.2.2⟩)
  · 
    intro ξ hξ hX
    have hpU : ((ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ U := Umem hξ.2.1 hξ.2.2
    have hr : 0 < ξ.1 := hξ.1
    have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨hfc, hgc⟩ := hcont ξ hξ
    have hmono : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ ξ.1 → XC B.h (s, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0) ≤ XC B.h ξ := by
      intro s hs hsr
      show s ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ) ≤ ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ)
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ hs.le hsr 2) (by linarith)
    have hmono' : ∀ s : ℝ, ξ.1 ≤ s → XC B.h ξ ≤ XC B.h (s, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0) := by
      intro s hrs
      show ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ) ≤ s ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ)
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ hr.le hrs 2) (by linarith)
    rcases hX with hX | hX
    · have h0 := vanishA (fun s => FE5 B G l0 S e (s, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0))
        (fun s => bE B e (s, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0)) e
        (∫ s' in Ioi (0:ℝ), s' ^ e * FE5 B G l0 S e (s', ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0)) ξ.1 hr.le
        (fun s hs hsr => hVT _ hpU s hs (Or.inl ((hmono s hs hsr).trans hX)))
      have hs : sigE5 B G l0 S e ξ = -(ξ.1 ^ e)⁻¹ * (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..ξ.1, s ^ e *
          (FE5 B G l0 S e (s, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0) - bE B e (s, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0) *
            ∫ s' in Ioi (0:ℝ), s' ^ e * FE5 B G l0 S e (s', ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0))) := by
        rw [hsigEq]
      rw [hs, h0, mul_zero]
    · obtain ⟨V, -, hpV, -, ρ0, ρ1, hρ0, -, hV⟩ := hloc _ hpU
      have hc : 0 < min ρ0 ξ.1 := lt_min hρ0 hr
      have Hs : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → (s ≤ min ρ0 ξ.1 ∨ ξ.1 ≤ s) →
          FE5 B G l0 S e (s, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0) = 0 ∧ bE B e (s, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0) = 0 := by
        intro s hs hor
        rcases hor with h | h
        · exact hVT _ hpU s hs (hV _ hpV s hs (Or.inl (h.trans (min_le_left _ _))))
        · exact hVT _ hpU s hs (Or.inr (hX.trans (hmono' s h)))
      have h0 := vanishB (fun s => FE5 B G l0 S e (s, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0))
        (fun s => bE B e (s, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0)) e (min ρ0 ξ.1) ξ.1 hc (min_le_right _ _) hfc hgc Hs
        (hnorm ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 hξ.2.1)
      have hs : sigE5 B G l0 S e ξ = -(ξ.1 ^ e)⁻¹ * (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..ξ.1, s ^ e *
          (FE5 B G l0 S e (s, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0) - bE B e (s, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0) *
            ∫ s' in Ioi (0:ℝ), s' ^ e * FE5 B G l0 S e (s', ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0))) := by
        rw [hsigEq]
      rw [hs, h0, mul_zero]
  · 
    intro ξ hξ
    have hpU : ((ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ U := Umem hξ.2.1 hξ.2.2
    have hr : 0 < ξ.1 := hξ.1
    obtain ⟨hfc, hgc⟩ := hcont ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨V, -, hpV, -, ρ0, ρ1, hρ0, -, hV⟩ := hloc _ hpU
    have H0 : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ ρ0 →
        FE5 B G l0 S e (s, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0) = 0 ∧ bE B e (s, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0) = 0 :=
      fun s hs h => hVT _ hpU s hs (hV _ hpV s hs (Or.inl h))
    have hME : ME5 B G l0 S e ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 =
        ∫ s' in Ioi (0:ℝ), s' ^ e * FE5 B G l0 S e (s', ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0) := rfl
    have hD := hderiv (fun s => FE5 B G l0 S e (s, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0))
      (fun s => bE B e (s, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0))
      (∫ s' in Ioi (0:ℝ), s' ^ e * FE5 B G l0 S e (s', ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0)) e ξ.1 ρ0 he1 hr hρ0
      hfc hgc H0
    have hd := hP.2 ξ ((drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) _ ⟨hr, hpU⟩ hD
    have hFξ : FE5 B G l0 S e (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0) = FE5 B G l0 S e ξ := by
      unfold FE5 yAvg
      rfl
    have hbξ : bE B e (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0) = bE B e ξ := by
      unfold bE qC
      rfl
    have hsξ : -(ξ.1 ^ e)⁻¹ * (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..ξ.1, s ^ e *
        (FE5 B G l0 S e (s, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0) - bE B e (s, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0) *
          ∫ s' in Ioi (0:ℝ), s' ^ e * FE5 B G l0 S e (s', ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0))) =
        sigE5 B G l0 S e ξ := by
      rw [hsigEq]
    have hdR : dR B.h (sigE5 B G l0 S e) ξ = -((e : ℝ) / ξ.1) * sigE5 B G l0 S e ξ -
        FE5 B G l0 S e ξ + bE B e ξ * ME5 B G l0 S e ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 := by
      rw [← hsξ, ← hFξ, ← hbξ, hME, hsigEq]
      exact hd
    rw [hdR]
    ring

signature.name: stp5_simscale_rpow_norm
signature.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h < 1/100 → SimScaleProps h → SimNorm h → ∀ (p : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → simScale h z τ ≤ 1 → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2 ^ p) (z, τ)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => (simScale h z τ ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (simScale h z τ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖ ≤ C * simScale h z τ ^ p

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h _ _ hS _ p k
  obtain ⟨hS1, -, -, hS4, hS5⟩ := hS
  
  open Pointwise in
  have hom : ∀ μ z τ : ℝ, 0 < μ →
      simScale h (μ ^ (1/2 - h) * z) (μ * τ) = μ * simScale h z τ := by
    intro μ z τ hμ
    have key : ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p → μ * p - (μ ^ (1/2 - h) * z) ^ 2 * (μ * p) ^ (2 * h) =
        μ * (p - z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h)) := by
      intro p hp
      have sq : (μ ^ (1/2 - h)) ^ 2 = μ ^ (1 - 2 * h) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hμ.le]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring
      have split : μ ^ (1 - 2 * h) * μ ^ (2 * h) = μ := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hμ]
        have e : 1 - 2 * h + 2 * h = 1 := by ring
        rw [e, Real.rpow_one]
      rw [mul_pow, sq, Real.mul_rpow hμ.le hp.le]
      linear_combination (-(z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h))) * split
    have hset : {q : ℝ | 0 < q ∧ μ * τ ≤ q - (μ ^ (1/2 - h) * z) ^ 2 * q ^ (2 * h)} =
        μ • {p : ℝ | 0 < p ∧ τ ≤ p - z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h)} := by
      ext q
      rw [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem₀ hμ.ne', smul_eq_mul]
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      have hq : q = μ * (μ⁻¹ * q) := by field_simp
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hq0, hle⟩
        have hp : 0 < μ⁻¹ * q := mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hμ) hq0
        refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
        rw [hq, key _ hp] at hle
        exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hle hμ
      · rintro ⟨hp, hle⟩
        refine ⟨by rw [hq]; exact mul_pos hμ hp, ?_⟩
        rw [hq, key _ hp]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle hμ.le
    unfold simScale
    rw [hset, Real.sInf_smul_of_nonneg hμ.le, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hnn : ∀ z τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ simScale h z τ := by
    intro z τ
    unfold simScale
    exact Real.sInf_nonneg (fun x hx => hx.1.le)
  
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z T : ℝ, 0 < T → simScale h Z T = 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2 ^ p) (Z, T)‖ ≤ C := by
    set A : ℝ := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Polynomial.eval p (descPochhammer ℝ i)| with hAdef
    have hA : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k →
        ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) 1‖ ≤ A := by
      intro i hi
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i isOpen_Ioi (show (1:ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) from Set.mem_Ioi.mpr one_pos),
        norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate,
        Real.iter_deriv_rpow_const, Real.one_rpow, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Polynomial.eval p (descPochhammer ℝ i)|)
        (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
    have hS5' : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ i → ∀ z τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → simScale h z τ ≤ 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (z, τ)‖ ≤
          C * simScale h z τ ^ (1 - (i : ℝ)) := by
      intro i
      by_cases hi : 1 ≤ i
      · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hS5 i hi
        exact ⟨C, fun _ => hC⟩
      · exact ⟨0, fun h => absurd h hi⟩
    choose C' hC' using hS5'
    set K : ℝ := 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |C' i| with hKdef
    have hK1 : 1 ≤ K := by
      have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1)) => abs_nonneg (C' i))
      linarith
    have hOopen : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
    refine ⟨(k.factorial : ℝ) * A * K ^ k, fun Z T hT h1 => ?_⟩
    have hmem : ((Z, T) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := ⟨mem_univ _, hT⟩
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      (contDiffOn_id (s := Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))).rpow_const_of_ne (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ))
        (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      fun w hw => (hS1 w.1 w.2 hw.2).1
    have hK : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k →
        ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ))
          (Z, T)‖ ≤ K ^ i := by
      intro i hi1 hik
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hOopen hmem]
      have h2 := hC' i hi1 Z T hT h1.le
      rw [h1, Real.one_rpow, mul_one] at h2
      have hCi : |C' i| ≤ K := by
        have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |C' i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hik))
        linarith
      exact h2.trans ((le_abs_self _).trans (hCi.trans (le_self_pow₀ hK1 (by omega))))
    have hA' : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k →
        ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))
          ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (Z, T))‖ ≤ A := by
      intro i hi
      show ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) (simScale h Z T)‖ ≤ A
      rw [h1]
      exact hA i hi
    have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hg hS4 (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn hOopen.uniqueDiffOn hmaps hmem (C := A) (D := K) hA' hK
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hOopen hmem] at key
    exact key
  
  refine ⟨C, fun z τ hτ _ => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hQ0, -⟩ := hS1 z τ hτ
  obtain ⟨Q, hQd⟩ : ∃ Q, Q = simScale h z τ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hQd] at hQ0 ⊢
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ : ∃ Z : ℝ, Z = Q ^ (-(1/2 - h)) * z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ, T = Q⁻¹ * τ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hT0 : 0 < T := by rw [hT]; exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hQ0) hτ
  have hZT : simScale h Z T = 1 := by
    have := hom Q⁻¹ z τ (inv_pos.mpr hQ0)
    rw [Real.inv_rpow hQ0.le, ← Real.rpow_neg hQ0.le, ← hQd, inv_mul_cancel₀ hQ0.ne'] at this
    rw [hZ, hT]
    exact this
  have hzb : Q ^ (1/2 - h) * Z = z := by
    rw [hZ, ← mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hQ0]
    simp
  have hτb : Q * T = τ := by
    rw [hT]
    exact mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hQ0.ne' τ
  
  have hpa : 0 < Q ^ (1/2 - h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ0 _
  have hQp : 0 < Q ^ p := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ0 _
  let e₁ : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 (Q ^ (1/2 - h)) hpa.ne')
  let e₂ : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 Q hQ0.ne')
  let L : (ℝ × ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) := e₁.prodCongr e₂
  let M : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 (Q ^ p) hQp.ne')
  have hL : ∀ x : ℝ × ℝ, L x = (Q ^ (1/2 - h) * x.1, Q * x.2) := by
    intro x
    simp [L, e₁, e₂, mul_comm]
  have hM : ∀ y : ℝ, M y = Q ^ p * y := by
    intro y
    simp [M, mul_comm]
  have hfun : (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2 ^ p) ∘ L =
      M ∘ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2 ^ p) := by
    funext w
    simp only [Function.comp, hL, hM]
    rw [hom Q w.1 w.2 hQ0, Real.mul_rpow hQ0.le (hnn w.1 w.2)]
  have hLclm : (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)) =
      (Q ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (Q • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    apply Prod.ext
    · simp [hL]
    · simp [hL]
  have hLv : L (Z, T) = (z, τ) := by
    rw [hL]
    exact Prod.ext hzb hτb
  have hcomp : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2 ^ p) ∘ L) (Z, T) =
      (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2 ^ p) (L (Z, T))).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ))) := by
    have := L.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2 ^ p)
      uniqueDiffOn_univ (mem_univ (L (Z, T))) k
    rwa [preimage_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ] at this
  have key : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2 ^ p) (z, τ)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ))) =
      (M : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).compContinuousMultilinearMap
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2 ^ p) (Z, T)) := by
    rw [← hLv, ← hcomp, hfun, M.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left]
  have hMn : ‖(M : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ ≤ Q ^ p := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hQp.le fun y => ?_
    show ‖M y‖ ≤ Q ^ p * ‖y‖
    rw [hM, norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs (Q ^ p), abs_of_pos hQp]
  
  rw [← hLclm, key]
  calc _ ≤ ‖(M : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ *
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2 ^ p) (Z, T)‖ :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
    _ ≤ Q ^ p * C := mul_le_mul hMn (hC Z T hT0 hZT) (norm_nonneg _) hQp.le
    _ = C * Q ^ p := mul_comm _ _

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xa Xb aa ab d hXa hXab haa hab hd
  
  have kap0 : ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → 0 ≤ d / 2 * Real.log (1 + d / (2 * a)) := by
    intro a ha
    have : 0 ≤ d / (2 * a) := by positivity
    exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) (Real.log_nonneg (by linarith))
  
  have core : ∀ a u' u : ℝ, 0 < a → 0 < u' → u' ≤ u → u ≤ 1 →
      -(a / u' ^ 2) - d * Real.log u' ≤
        d / 2 * Real.log (1 + d / (2 * a)) - a / u ^ 2 - d * Real.log u := by
    intro a u' u ha hu' huu hu1
    have hu : 0 < u := lt_of_lt_of_le hu' huu
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ : ∃ l : ℝ, l = 1 + d / (2 * a) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hl]
    have hl1 : 1 ≤ l := by
      have : 0 ≤ d / (2 * a) := by positivity
      linarith
    have hlpos : 0 < l := by linarith
    have hdl : d / 2 = a * (l - 1) := by rw [hl]; field_simp; ring
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℝ, k = u ^ 2 / (u' ^ 2 * l) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hkpos : 0 < k := by rw [hk]; positivity
    have hlogk : Real.log k = 2 * Real.log u - 2 * Real.log u' - Real.log l := by
      rw [hk, Real.log_div (by positivity) (by positivity),
        Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow]
      push_cast; ring
    have hlk := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hkpos
    have hkl : k * l = u ^ 2 / u' ^ 2 := by rw [hk]; field_simp
    have hkl1 : 1 ≤ k * l := by
      rw [hkl, one_le_div (by positivity)]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hu'.le huu 2
    have hsum : 2 ≤ l + k := by
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (l - 1), mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hc hlpos]
    have hprod : (l - 1) * (k - 1) ≤ k * l - 1 := by nlinarith
    have hQ : 1 ≤ 1 / u ^ 2 := by
      rw [one_le_div (by positivity)]
      nlinarith
    have hdiff : a / u' ^ 2 - a / u ^ 2 = a * (1 / u ^ 2) * (k * l - 1) := by
      rw [hkl]; field_simp
    have h1 : a * (k * l - 1) ≤ a / u' ^ 2 - a / u ^ 2 := by
      rw [hdiff]
      have h0 : 0 ≤ a * (k * l - 1) := mul_nonneg ha.le (by linarith)
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQ h0]
    have h2 : d / 2 * Real.log k ≤ d / 2 * (k - 1) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlk (by linarith)
    have h3 : d / 2 * (k - 1) ≤ a * (k * l - 1) := by
      rw [hdl]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod ha.le]
    rw [hlogk] at h2
    nlinarith
  
  have T1 : ∀ a u' u : ℝ, 0 < a → 0 < u' → u' ≤ u →
      -(a / u' ^ 2) - d * Real.log (min 1 u') ≤
        d / 2 * Real.log (1 + d / (2 * a)) + (-(a / u ^ 2) - d * Real.log (min 1 u)) := by
    intro a u' u ha hu' huu
    have hk0 := kap0 a ha
    rcases le_or_gt u 1 with hu1 | hu1
    · rw [min_eq_right hu1, min_eq_right (huu.trans hu1)]
      have := core a u' u ha hu' huu hu1
      linarith
    · rw [min_eq_left hu1.le, Real.log_one, mul_zero, sub_zero]
      rcases le_or_gt u' 1 with hu'1 | hu'1
      · rw [min_eq_right hu'1]
        have := core a u' 1 ha hu' hu'1 le_rfl
        rw [Real.log_one, mul_zero, sub_zero, one_pow, div_one] at this
        have h2 : a / u ^ 2 ≤ a := div_le_self ha.le (by nlinarith)
        linarith
      · rw [min_eq_left hu'1.le, Real.log_one, mul_zero, sub_zero]
        have h2 : a / u ^ 2 ≤ a / u' ^ 2 :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left ha.le (by positivity) (pow_le_pow_left₀ hu'.le huu 2)
        linarith
  have T2 : ∀ a u : ℝ, 0 < a → 0 < u →
      -(a / u ^ 2) - d * Real.log (min 1 u) ≤ d / 2 * Real.log (1 + d / (2 * a)) := by
    intro a u ha hu
    have hk0 := kap0 a ha
    rcases le_or_gt u 1 with hu1 | hu1
    · rw [min_eq_right hu1]
      have := core a u 1 ha hu hu1 le_rfl
      rw [Real.log_one, mul_zero, sub_zero, one_pow, div_one] at this
      linarith
    · rw [min_eq_left hu1.le, Real.log_one, mul_zero, sub_zero]
      have : 0 ≤ a / u ^ 2 := by positivity
      linarith
  
  have half : ∀ a b u' v' u v L : ℝ, 0 < a → 0 < b → 0 < u' → u' ≤ u → u ≤ v → u' ≤ v' →
      0 < L → L / 2 ≤ v →
      -(a / u' ^ 2) - b / v' ^ 2 - d * Real.log (min 1 (min u' v')) ≤
        d / 2 * Real.log (1 + d / (2 * a)) + 4 * b / L ^ 2 +
          (-(a / u ^ 2) - b / v ^ 2 - d * Real.log (min 1 (min u v))) := by
    intro a b u' v' u v L ha hb hu' huu huv hu'v' hL hLv
    rw [min_eq_left huv, min_eq_left hu'v']
    have h1 := T1 a u' u ha hu' huu
    have h2 : 0 ≤ b / v' ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hv : 0 < v := by linarith
    have h3 : b / v ^ 2 ≤ 4 * b / L ^ 2 := by
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      have hsq : L ^ 2 ≤ (2 * v) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hL.le (by linarith) 2
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hb.le]
    linarith
  have bnd : ∀ a b u v : ℝ, 0 < a → 0 ≤ b → 0 < u → u ≤ v →
      -(a / u ^ 2) - b / v ^ 2 - d * Real.log (min 1 (min u v)) ≤
        d / 2 * Real.log (1 + d / (2 * a)) := by
    intro a b u v ha hb hu huv
    rw [min_eq_left huv]
    have := T2 a u ha hu
    have h2 : 0 ≤ b / v ^ 2 := div_nonneg hb (sq_nonneg v)
    linarith
  
  have repr : ∀ X : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb →
      edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-d) =
        Real.exp (-(aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2) - ab / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2 -
          d * Real.log (min 1 (min (Real.log (X / Xa)) (Real.log (Xb / X))))) := by
    intro X h1 h2
    have hX : 0 < X := hXa.trans h1
    have hu : 0 < Real.log (X / Xa) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr h1)
    have hv : 0 < Real.log (Xb / X) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr h2)
    have hδ : 0 < edgeDist Xa Xb X := lt_min one_pos (lt_min hu hv)
    unfold edgeWeight
    rw [if_pos ⟨h1, h2⟩, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hδ, ← Real.exp_add]
    unfold edgeDist
    congr 1
    ring
  
  have hXb : 0 < Xb := hXa.trans hXab
  have hab_log : Real.log Xa < Real.log Xb := Real.log_lt_log hXa hXab
  have hu_eq : ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → Real.log (X / Xa) = Real.log X - Real.log Xa :=
    fun X hX => Real.log_div hX.ne' hXa.ne'
  have hv_eq : ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → Real.log (Xb / X) = Real.log Xb - Real.log X :=
    fun X hX => Real.log_div hXb.ne' hX.ne'
  obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = Real.log (Xb / Xa) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hL_eq : L = Real.log Xb - Real.log Xa := by rw [hLdef]; exact Real.log_div hXb.ne' hXa.ne'
  have hL : 0 < L := by rw [hL_eq]; linarith
  have hm : Real.log (Real.sqrt (Xa * Xb)) = (Real.log Xa + Real.log Xb) / 2 := by
    rw [Real.log_sqrt (by positivity), Real.log_mul hXa.ne' hXb.ne']
  have hsq_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt (Xa * Xb) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  have kA := kap0 aa haa
  have kB := kap0 ab hab
  have h4a : 0 ≤ 4 * aa / L ^ 2 := by positivity
  have h4b : 0 ≤ 4 * ab / L ^ 2 := by positivity
  
  refine ⟨Real.exp (d / 2 * Real.log (1 + d / (2 * aa)) + d / 2 * Real.log (1 + d / (2 * ab)) +
    4 * aa / L ^ 2 + 4 * ab / L ^ 2), Real.exp_pos _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro X X' (⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ | ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩)
    · have hX' : 0 < X' := hXa.trans h1
      have hX : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hX' h2
      have l1 : Real.log X' ≤ Real.log X := Real.log_le_log hX' h2
      have l2 : Real.log X ≤ Real.log (Real.sqrt (Xa * Xb)) := Real.log_le_log hX h3
      have hXXb : X < Xb := by
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have := Real.log_le_log hXb hc
        linarith
      rw [repr X' h1 (lt_of_le_of_lt h2 hXXb), repr X (lt_of_lt_of_le h1 h2) hXXb,
        ← Real.exp_add, Real.exp_le_exp]
      have key := half aa ab (Real.log (X' / Xa)) (Real.log (Xb / X')) (Real.log (X / Xa))
        (Real.log (Xb / X)) L haa hab (by rw [hu_eq X' hX']; linarith [Real.log_lt_log hXa h1])
        (by rw [hu_eq X' hX', hu_eq X hX]; linarith)
        (by rw [hu_eq X hX, hv_eq X hX]; linarith)
        (by rw [hu_eq X' hX', hv_eq X' hX']; linarith)
        hL (by rw [hv_eq X hX, hL_eq]; linarith)
      linarith
    · have hX : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hsq_pos h1
      have hX' : 0 < X' := lt_of_lt_of_le hX h2
      have l1 : Real.log X ≤ Real.log X' := Real.log_le_log hX h2
      have l2 : Real.log (Real.sqrt (Xa * Xb)) ≤ Real.log X := Real.log_le_log hsq_pos h1
      have hXaX : Xa < X := by
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have := Real.log_le_log hX hc
        linarith
      rw [repr X' (lt_of_lt_of_le hXaX h2) h3, repr X hXaX (lt_of_le_of_lt h2 h3),
        ← Real.exp_add, Real.exp_le_exp]
      have key := half ab aa (Real.log (Xb / X')) (Real.log (X' / Xa)) (Real.log (Xb / X))
        (Real.log (X / Xa)) L hab haa (by rw [hv_eq X' hX']; linarith [Real.log_lt_log hX' h3])
        (by rw [hv_eq X' hX', hv_eq X hX]; linarith)
        (by rw [hu_eq X hX, hv_eq X hX]; linarith)
        (by rw [hu_eq X' hX', hv_eq X' hX']; linarith)
        hL (by rw [hu_eq X hX, hL_eq]; linarith)
      rw [min_comm (Real.log (Xb / X')), min_comm (Real.log (Xb / X))] at key
      linarith
  · intro X h1 h2
    have hX : 0 < X := hXa.trans h1
    rw [repr X h1 h2, Real.exp_le_exp]
    have hu : 0 < Real.log (X / Xa) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr h1)
    have hv : 0 < Real.log (Xb / X) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr h2)
    rcases le_total (Real.log (X / Xa)) (Real.log (Xb / X)) with huv | huv
    · have := bnd aa ab _ _ haa hab.le hu huv
      linarith
    · have := bnd ab aa _ _ hab haa.le hv huv
      rw [min_comm (Real.log (Xb / X))] at this
      linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (α : ℝ) (e : ℕ), B.ok → SimNorm B.h → (e = 1 ∨ e = 2) → (∀ (p : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → simScale B.h z τ ≤ 1 → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2 ^ p) (z, τ)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => (simScale B.h z τ ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (simScale B.h z τ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h z τ ^ p) → (∀ d : ℝ, 0 ≤ d → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ (∀ X X' : ℝ, ((B.Xa < X' ∧ X' ≤ X ∧ X ≤ Real.sqrt (B.Xa * B.Xb)) ∨ (Real.sqrt (B.Xa * B.Xb) ≤ X ∧ X ≤ X' ∧ X' < B.Xb)) → edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X' * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X' ^ (-d) ≤ C * (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ^ (-d))) ∧ (∀ X : ℝ, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb → edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ^ (-d) ≤ C)) → InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (FE5 B G l0 S e)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (sigE5 B G l0 S e) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → sigE5 B G l0 S e ξ = 0) → InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (sigE5 B G l0 S e))

by
  intro B G l0 S α e hB hSN he hS8 hEM hFt hsm hsh
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -, hqB0, -, -, -, haa, hab⟩ := hB.2.1
  have hXaXb : B.Xa < B.Xb := by linarith
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1

    (hB.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1

    have h2 := hB.1.2.2.2.1.comp h1.contDiffOn (s := {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1})
      (fun ξ hξ => Set.mk_mem_prod (Set.mem_univ _)

    exact h2
  have hfC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (sigE5 B G l0 S e)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have hsub : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ⊆ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} := fun ξ hξ => hξ.2.1

    convert this using 1

  refine ⟨hfC, fun ξ _ a _ => rfl, fun ξ hξ hX => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩

  intro ξ0 hξ0 hX1 hX2

    have h1 := (Real.lt_sqrt hrho0.le).mpr

  have hw0 : 0 ≤ sgc5w B d (XC B.h ξ0) := by
    unfold sgc5w

  have hch0 : sgc5ch B.h ξ0 0 = (ξ0.1, ξ0.2.1, ξ0.2.2.1, (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) := by simp [sgc5ch]

  have hNB := stp5sc_cyl_reduce B.h (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (sigE5 B G l0 S e)) U ξ0 k hUo hξ0U

  have hsubV1 : {a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | sgc5ch B.h ξ0 a ∈ U} ⊆ {a | (sgc5ch B.h ξ0 a).2.2.1 < 1} :=

stp5_sig_class.definitions:
noncomputable def sgc5ch (h : ℝ) (ξ0 : Cyl) (a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : Cyl :=
  (ξ0.1 + Real.sqrt (qC h ξ0) * a.1, ξ0.2.1 + qC h ξ0 ^ (1/2 - h) * a.2.1, ξ0.2.2.1 + qC h ξ0 * a.2.2,
    (0 : ℝ × ℝ))
noncomputable def sgc5rho (h : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC h ξ)
noncomputable def sgc5I (F : Cyl → ℝ) (e : ℕ) (c d : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  ∫ u in c..d, u ^ e * F (u * ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (0 : ℝ × ℝ))
noncomputable def sgc5beta (B : BG) (e : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..ρ, s ^ e * bHatE B e s
noncomputable def sgc5betaR (B : BG) (e : ℕ) (U ρ : ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ s in ρ..(U * ρ), s ^ e * bHatE B e s
noncomputable def sgc5c0 (B : BG) : ℝ := Real.sqrt (B.Xa / B.Xb) / 4
noncomputable def sgc5U0 (B : BG) : ℝ := 2 * Real.sqrt (B.Xb / B.Xa)
noncomputable def sgc5w (B : BG) (d X : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ^ (-d)

    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun r : ℝ => r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) (Set.Ioi 0) (Set.Ioi 0) := fun r hr => by
      have hr' : (0:ℝ) < r := hr
      show (0:ℝ) < r ^ 2 / (2 * q)
      positivity
    refine ⟨hT.continuousOn.comp hXc.continuousOn hmaps,
      (hT.continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioi (by simp)).comp hXc.continuousOn hmaps,
      fun r hr => ?_⟩
    have hX' : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) (2 * r / (2 * q)) r :=
      ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 r).div_const (2 * q)).congr_deriv (by norm_num)
    have hTd : HasDerivAt T (deriv T (r ^ 2 / (2 * q))) (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) :=
      ((hT.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds (hmaps hr))).hasDerivAt
    exact hTd.comp r hX'
  
  have sh : ∀ (a b q : ℝ), 0 < a → a < b → 0 < q →
      0 < Real.sqrt (2 * a * q) ∧ Real.sqrt (2 * a * q) ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * b * q) ∧
      (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → (r ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * a * q) ∨ Real.sqrt (2 * b * q) ≤ r) →
        (r ^ 2 / (2 * q) ≤ a ∨ b ≤ r ^ 2 / (2 * q))) ∧
      Real.sqrt (2 * a * q) ^ 2 / (2 * q) = a ∧ Real.sqrt (2 * b * q) ^ 2 / (2 * q) = b := by
    intro a b q ha hab hq
    have hsa : Real.sqrt (2 * a * q) ^ 2 = 2 * a * q := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
    have hsb : Real.sqrt (2 * b * q) ^ 2 = 2 * b * q := Real.sq_sqrt (by nlinarith)
    refine ⟨Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity), Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith), fun r hr h => ?_,
      by rw [hsa]; field_simp, by rw [hsb]; field_simp⟩
    rcases h with h | h
    · left
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * a * q)]
    · right
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * b * q)]
  
  have mom2 : ∀ (T : ℝ → ℝ) (a b q c : ℝ), 0 < a → a < b → 0 < q → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ T (Set.Ioi 0) →
      (∀ Y : ℝ, (Y ≤ a ∨ b ≤ Y) → T Y = 0) →
      (∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ 2 * (-(c * (deriv T (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) +
        T (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) / (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)))) * r)) = 0 ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun r : ℝ => -(c * (deriv T (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) +
        T (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) / (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)))) * r) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    intro T a b q c ha hab hq hT hvT
    obtain ⟨hc1, hc2, hd⟩ := reg T q hq hT
    have hXc : ContinuousOn (fun r : ℝ => r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      ((continuous_pow 2).div_const _).continuousOn
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun r : ℝ => -(c * (deriv T (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) +
        T (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) / (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)))) * r) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      ((continuousOn_const.mul (hc2.add (hc1.div hXc (fun r hr => by
        have hr' : (0:ℝ) < r := hr
        positivity)))).neg).mul continuousOn_id
    refine ⟨?_, hcont⟩
    obtain ⟨hu, huv, hoff, hXu, hXv⟩ := sh a b q ha hab hq
    refine ftc (fun r : ℝ => r ^ 2 * (-(c * (deriv T (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) +
        T (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) / (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)))) * r))
      (fun r : ℝ => -(c * q) * (r ^ 2 * T (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)))) _ _ hu huv
      ((continuous_pow 2).continuousOn.mul hcont) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro r hr hr'
      have hX := hoff r hr hr'
      show r ^ 2 * (-(c * (deriv T (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) +
        T (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) / (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)))) * r) = 0
      rw [hvT _ hX, dz T a b _ hvT hX]
      simp
    · intro r hr
      have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
      have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := hq.ne'
      have h3 := ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 r).mul (hd r hr)).const_mul (-(c * q))
      refine h3.congr_deriv ?_
      rw [show (2:ℕ) - 1 = 1 from rfl, pow_one]
      push_cast
      field_simp
      ring
    · show -(c * q) * (Real.sqrt (2 * a * q) ^ 2 * T (Real.sqrt (2 * a * q) ^ 2 / (2 * q))) = 0
      rw [hXu, hvT a (Or.inl le_rfl)]
      ring
    · show -(c * q) * (Real.sqrt (2 * b * q) ^ 2 * T (Real.sqrt (2 * b * q) ^ 2 / (2 * q))) = 0
      rw [hXv, hvT b (Or.inr le_rfl)]
      ring
  
  have mom1 : ∀ (T : ℝ → ℝ) (a b q c : ℝ), 0 < a → a < b → 0 < q → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ T (Set.Ioi 0) →
      (∀ Y : ℝ, (Y ≤ a ∨ b ≤ Y) → T Y = 0) →
      (∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r * (-(Real.sqrt (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q))) * c *
        (deriv T (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) + T (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) / (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q))))))) = 0 ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun r : ℝ => -(Real.sqrt (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q))) * c *
        (deriv T (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) + T (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) / (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)))))) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    intro T a b q c ha hab hq hT hvT
    obtain ⟨hc1, hc2, hd⟩ := reg T q hq hT
    have hXc : Continuous (fun r : ℝ => r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) := (continuous_pow 2).div_const _
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun r : ℝ => -(Real.sqrt (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q))) * c *
        (deriv T (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) + T (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) / (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)))))) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      ((((Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_const.mul hXc)).continuousOn.mul continuousOn_const).mul
        (hc2.add (hc1.div (continuous_const.mul hXc).continuousOn (fun r hr => by
          have hr' : (0:ℝ) < r := hr
          show (2:ℝ) * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) ≠ 0
          positivity))))).neg
    refine ⟨?_, hcont⟩
    obtain ⟨hu, huv, hoff, hXu, hXv⟩ := sh a b q ha hab hq
    obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ q = s ^ 2 :=
      ⟨Real.sqrt q, Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq, (Real.sq_sqrt hq.le).symm⟩
    refine ftc (fun r : ℝ => r * (-(Real.sqrt (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2))) * c *
        (deriv T (r ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2)) + T (r ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2)) / (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2)))))))
      (fun r : ℝ => -(c * s) * (r * T (r ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2)))) _ _ hu huv
      (continuousOn_id.mul hcont) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro r hr hr'
      have hX := hoff r hr hr'
      show r * (-(Real.sqrt (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2))) * c *
        (deriv T (r ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2)) + T (r ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2)) / (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2)))))) = 0
      rw [hvT _ hX, dz T a b _ hvT hX]
      simp
    · intro r hr
      have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
      have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := hs.ne'
      have hsq : Real.sqrt (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2))) = r / s := by
        rw [show 2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2)) = (r / s) ^ 2 by field_simp]
        exact Real.sqrt_sq (div_pos hr hs).le
      have h3 := ((hasDerivAt_id' r).mul (hd r hr)).const_mul (-(c * s))
      refine h3.congr_deriv ?_
      rw [hsq]
      field_simp
      ring
    · show -(c * s) * (Real.sqrt (2 * a * s ^ 2) * T (Real.sqrt (2 * a * s ^ 2) ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2))) = 0
      rw [hXu, hvT a (Or.inl le_rfl)]
      ring
    · show -(c * s) * (Real.sqrt (2 * b * s ^ 2) * T (Real.sqrt (2 * b * s ^ 2) ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2))) = 0
      rw [hXv, hvT b (Or.inr le_rfl)]
      ring
  
  have K1 : ∀ (y : ℝ³) (α β : ℝ),
      inner ℝ (α • azVec y + β • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) (eTh y) =
        α * ((rad y)⁻¹ * (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2)) := by
    intro y α β
    simp [eTh, azVec, inner_add_left, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_left,
      real_inner_smul_right, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right] <;>
      ring
  have K2 : ∀ (y : ℝ³) (α β : ℝ),
      inner ℝ (α • azVec y + β • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) eZ = β := by
    intro y α β
    simp [eZ, azVec, inner_add_left, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_left,
      real_inner_smul_right, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
  have frame : ∀ (r z t : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (q η X : ℝ), 0 < r → q = simScale B.h z (1 - t) →
      η = z * q ^ (-(1 / 2 - B.h)) → X = r ^ 2 / (2 * q) →
      sBase B 1 (r, z, t, Y) = -(q ^ (-(2 + B.h)) * (deriv (fun Y' => B.Tth q Y' η) X +
        B.Tth q X η / X)) * r ∧
      sBase B 2 (r, z, t, Y) = -(Real.sqrt (2 * X) * q ^ (-(3 / 2 + B.h)) *
        (deriv (fun Y' => B.Tz q Y' η) X + B.Tz q X η / (2 * X))) := by
    intro r z t Y q η X hr hq hη hX
    subst hX hη hq
    have hc0 : (rotPt r 0 z) 0 = r := by simp [rotPt]
    have hc1 : (rotPt r 0 z) 1 = 0 := by simp [rotPt]
    have hc2 : (rotPt r 0 z) 2 = z := by simp [rotPt]
    have hrad : rad (rotPt r 0 z) = r := by
      unfold rad
      rw [hc0, hc1, show r ^ 2 + (0:ℝ) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 by ring, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
    have hsX : simX B.h (rotPt r 0 z) t = r ^ 2 / (2 * simScale B.h z (1 - t)) := by
      unfold simX
      rw [hc0, hc1, hc2]
      ring
    have hsE : simEta B.h (rotPt r 0 z) t = z * simScale B.h z (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - B.h)) := by
      unfold simEta
      rw [hc2]
    have hfac : r⁻¹ * (r ^ 2 + (0:ℝ) ^ 2) = r := by
      rw [show r ^ 2 + (0:ℝ) ^ 2 = r * r by ring, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_mul]
    constructor
    · show inner ℝ (stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz (rotPt r 0 z) t) (eTh (rotPt r 0 z)) = _
      unfold stressDivField
      rw [K1, hsX, hsE, hc2, hrad, hc0, hc1, hfac]
    · show inner ℝ (stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz (rotPt r 0 z) t) eZ = _
      unfold stressDivField
      rw [K2, hsX, hsE, hc2]
  
  have prof : ∀ (z t q η : ℝ), t < 1 → q = simScale B.h z (1 - t) → η = z * q ^ (-(1 / 2 - B.h)) →
      q < B.qB → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => B.Tth q Y η) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => B.Tz q Y η) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    intro z t q η ht hqd hηd hqB
    have hτ : 0 < 1 - t := by linarith
    have hq : 0 < q := by rw [hqd]; exact (hB.1.1 z (1 - t) hτ).1
    have hz2 : z ^ 2 < q ^ (1 - 2 * B.h) := by rw [hqd]; exact (hB.1.2.1 z (1 - t) hτ).2
    have hη2 : η ^ 2 < 1 := by
      rw [hηd, mul_pow, ← Real.rpow_natCast (q ^ (-(1 / 2 - B.h))) 2, ← Real.rpow_mul hq.le]
      have he : q ^ (-(1 / 2 - B.h) * ((2:ℕ):ℝ)) = (q ^ (1 - 2 * B.h))⁻¹ := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_neg hq.le]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring
      have hp : 0 < q ^ (1 - 2 * B.h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _
      rw [he, ← div_eq_mul_inv, div_lt_one hp]
      exact hz2
    have hη := abs_lt.mp ((sq_lt_one_iff_abs_lt_one η).mp hη2)
    have hlog : Real.log q < Real.log B.qB := Real.log_lt_log hq hqB
    have hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun Y : ℝ => ((Real.log q, Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      contDiff_const.prodMk (contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const)
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun Y : ℝ => ((Real.log q, Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (Set.Ioi 0)
        (Set.Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)) := fun Y hY =>
      Set.mk_mem_prod hlog (Set.mk_mem_prod hY ⟨hη.1, hη.2⟩)
    refine ⟨(c9a.comp hφ.contDiffOn hmaps).congr (fun Y _ => ?_),
      (c9b.comp hφ.contDiffOn hmaps).congr (fun Y _ => ?_)⟩
    · show B.Tth q Y η = B.Tth (Real.exp (Real.log q)) Y η
      rw [Real.exp_log hq]
    · show B.Tz q Y η = B.Tz (Real.exp (Real.log q)) Y η
      rw [Real.exp_log hq]
  
  refine ⟨fun z t ht hqB => ?_, fun ξ h1 _ _ hX => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨q, hqd⟩ : ∃ q, q = simScale B.h z (1 - t) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨η, hηd⟩ : ∃ η, η = z * q ^ (-(1 / 2 - B.h)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hq : 0 < q := by rw [hqd]; exact (hB.1.1 z (1 - t) (by linarith)).1
    obtain ⟨hθ, hzz⟩ := prof z t q η ht hqd hηd (by rw [hqd]; exact hqB)
    have M2 := mom2 (fun Y => B.Tth q Y η) B.Xa B.Xb q (q ^ (-(2 + B.h))) hXa hab hq hθ
      (fun Y hY => (hvan q Y η hY).1)
    have M1 := mom1 (fun Y => B.Tz q Y η) B.Xa B.Xb q (q ^ (-(3 / 2 + B.h))) hXa hab hq hzz
      (fun Y hY => (hvan q Y η hY).2)
    have hI1 : (∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ 2 * sBase B 1 (r, z, t, 0)) =
        ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ 2 * (-(q ^ (-(2 + B.h)) * (deriv (fun Y' => B.Tth q Y' η) (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) +
          B.Tth q (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) η / (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)))) * r) := by
      refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun r hr => ?_)
      show r ^ 2 * sBase B 1 (r, z, t, 0) = _
      rw [(frame r z t 0 q η (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) hr hqd hηd rfl).1]
    have hI2 : (∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r * sBase B 2 (r, z, t, 0)) =
        ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r * (-(Real.sqrt (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q))) * q ^ (-(3 / 2 + B.h)) *
          (deriv (fun Y' => B.Tz q Y' η) (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) +
            B.Tz q (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) η / (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)))))) := by
      refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun r hr => ?_)
      show r * sBase B 2 (r, z, t, 0) = _
      rw [(frame r z t 0 q η (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) hr hqd hηd rfl).2]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hI1]; exact M2.1
    · rw [hI2]; exact M1.1
    · exact M2.2.congr (fun r hr => (frame r z t 0 q η (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) hr hqd hηd rfl).1)
    · exact M1.2.congr (fun r hr => (frame r z t 0 q η (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) hr hqd hηd rfl).2)
  · obtain ⟨r, z, t, Y⟩ := ξ
    change 0 < r at h1
    obtain ⟨q, hqd⟩ : ∃ q, q = simScale B.h z (1 - t) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨η, hηd⟩ : ∃ η, η = z * q ^ (-(1 / 2 - B.h)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨X, hXd⟩ : ∃ X, X = r ^ 2 / (2 * q) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hX' : X ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ X := by
      rw [hXd, hqd]
      exact hX
    obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := frame r z t Y q η X h1 hqd hηd hXd
    rw [e1, e2, dz (fun Y' => B.Tth q Y' η) B.Xa B.Xb X (fun Y' hY' => (hvan q Y' η hY').1) hX',
      dz (fun Y' => B.Tz q Y' η) B.Xa B.Xb X (fun Y' hY' => (hvan q Y' η hY').2) hX',
      (hvan q X η hX').1, (hvan q X η hX').2]
    simp

informal_problem.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h < 1/100 → (∀ l : ℕ, 4 ≤ l → 0 ≤ bandIdx h l) ∧ (∀ k : ℤ, 0 ≤ k → ∀ n m : ℤ, ∃ n' m' : ℤ, Jpow k ((n : ℝ), (m : ℝ)) = ((n' : ℝ), (m' : ℝ))) ∧ ∀ l0 : ℕ, 7 ≤ l0 → ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q < qsOf l0 → ∀ n m : ℤ, IsDeck h q ((n : ℝ), (m : ℝ))

signature.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h < 1/100 → (∀ l : ℕ, 4 ≤ l → 0 ≤ bandIdx h l) ∧ (∀ k : ℤ, 0 ≤ k → ∀ n m : ℤ, ∃ n' m' : ℤ, Jpow k ((n : ℝ), (m : ℝ)) = ((n' : ℝ), (m' : ℝ))) ∧ ∀ l0 : ℕ, 7 ≤ l0 → ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q < qsOf l0 → ∀ n m : ℤ, IsDeck h q ((n : ℝ), (m : ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h hh0 _
  
  have hA : ∀ l : ℕ, 4 ≤ l → 0 ≤ bandIdx h l := by
    intro l hl
    have hnat : l ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ l := by
      induction l, hl using Nat.le_induction with
      | base => norm_num
      | succ n hn ih =>
        have e : 2 ^ (n + 1) = 2 ^ n * 2 := pow_succ 2 n
        rw [e]
        nlinarith
    have hreal : (l:ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ l := by exact_mod_cast hnat
    have hl0 : (0:ℝ) < (l:ℝ) := by
      have : (4:ℝ) ≤ (l:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hl
      linarith
    have hexp : (l:ℝ) ≤ (1 + h) * (l:ℝ) := by nlinarith
    have hrp : (2:ℝ) ^ (l:ℝ) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) hexp
    rw [Real.rpow_natCast] at hrp
    have hX : 1 ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / (l:ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      linarith
    have hT1 : 1 < Tgc := by
      unfold Tgc
      have := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
      linarith
    unfold bandIdx
    exact Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (Real.logb_nonneg hT1 hX)
  
  have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hsq0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
  have hL0 : Lgc ≠ 0 := by
    unfold Lgc
    apply ne_of_gt
    nlinarith
  have hT0 : Tgc ≠ 0 := by
    unfold Tgc
    positivity
  have hD : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hDinv : (1 + bgc ^ 2) * (1 + bgc ^ 2)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hD
  have hL' : Lgc = 3 - bgc := by unfold Lgc bgc; ring
  have hT' : Tgc * bgc = 3 * bgc + 1 := by unfold Tgc bgc; linear_combination hs2
  have hLb : bgc * Lgc = 5 * bgc - 1 := by unfold Lgc bgc; linear_combination (-1:ℝ) * hs2
  have hT'' : Tgc = bgc + 5 := by unfold Tgc bgc; ring
  have hJ0 : ∀ c : ℝ × ℝ, Jpow 0 c = c := by
    rintro ⟨c1, c2⟩
    simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, zpow_zero, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk, Prod.mk.injEq]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · linear_combination c1 * hDinv
    · linear_combination c2 * hDinv
  have hJs : ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ × ℝ), (∃ i j : ℤ, Jpow (n:ℤ) c = ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))) →
      ∃ i j : ℤ, Jpow ((n:ℤ) + 1) c = ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ)) := by
    rintro n ⟨c1, c2⟩ ⟨i, j, hij⟩
    refine ⟨3 * i + j, i + 5 * j, ?_⟩
    unfold Jpow at hij ⊢
    rw [zpow_add_one₀ hL0, zpow_add_one₀ hT0]
    simp only [vrv, vtv, zpow_natCast, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk,
      Prod.mk.injEq] at hij ⊢
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hij
    push_cast
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · linear_combination 3 * h1 + h2 + (Lgc ^ n * ((c1 - bgc * c2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2))) * hL'
        + (Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * c1 + c2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2))) * hT'
    · linear_combination h1 + 5 * h2 - (Lgc ^ n * ((c1 - bgc * c2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2))) * hLb

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ) ∧ ContinuousOn (XC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dT f) (DomC B.h qs)) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → dR B.h f ξ = 0 ∧ dZ f ξ = 0 ∧ dT f ξ = 0)

noncomputable def axV5 (h e : ℝ) (n : ℤ) (C : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℂ :=
  ![Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (ξ.1 : ℂ) * C ξ 2 - dZ (fun η => C η 1) ξ
      - ((e * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC h η)) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * C ξ 1,
    dZ (fun η => C η 0) ξ - dR h (fun η => C η 2) ξ
      + ((e * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC h η)) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * C ξ 0,
    dR h (fun η => C η 1) ξ + C ξ 1 / (ξ.1 : ℂ) - Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (ξ.1 : ℂ) * C ξ 0]

Blueprint section 4 (R1-R5 numerics) and section 5 (F1-F8) are adequate. No child is false, none restates an ancestor, and there is no split on parameter values.

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →
    ∀ (a b : WC), (∃ H : Finset ℤ, (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧ ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → a γ m = 0 ∧ b γ m = 0) →
    (∀ γ m, ContinuousOn (a γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ContinuousOn (b γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) →
    (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → (a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) ∧ (b γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ)) →
    ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      Continuous (fun θ => waveV5 B G a θ ξ i) ∧ thA (fun θ => waveV5 B G a θ ξ i) = 0 ∧
      (∀ θ, waveV5 B G (a + b) θ ξ i = waveV5 B G a θ ξ i + waveV5 B G b θ ξ i) ∧
      thA (fun θ => waveV5 B G a θ ξ i * waveV5 B G b θ ξ j) = wmoPair5 a b i j ξ
