proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n0, ?_⟩
  rintro l0 hl0 a b ⟨H, hH0, hH⟩ hc hs ξ hξ i j
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]; exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hl0) hn0.le
  have hD : ∀ η, η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → 0 < η.1 ∧ η.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h η < qsOf l0 :=
    fun η h => h
  have hsq : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (s : ℝ), sqPart μ j s ≠ 0 → (s / μ - j) ^ 2 < 1 := by
    intro μ j s hne
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    apply hne
    unfold sqPart bumpR
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), zero_div]
  have hsq' : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (s : ℝ), (s / μ - j) ^ 2 < 1 → sqPart μ j s ≠ 0 := by
    intro μ j s hlt
    have hpos : 0 < bumpR (s / μ - j) := Real.smoothTransition.pos_of_pos (by linarith)
    have hsum : Summable (fun n : ℤ => bumpR (s / μ - n) ^ 2) := by
      apply summable_of_ne_finset_zero (s := Finset.Icc (⌊s / μ⌋ - 1) (⌊s / μ⌋ + 1))
      intro n hn
      have hn' : n ≤ ⌊s / μ⌋ - 2 ∨ ⌊s / μ⌋ + 2 ≤ n := by
        simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le] at hn; omega
      have h1 : 1 ≤ (s / μ - n) ^ 2 := by
        rcases hn' with h | h
        · have : (n:ℝ) ≤ (⌊s / μ⌋:ℝ) - 2 := by exact_mod_cast h
          nlinarith [Int.floor_le (s / μ)]
        · have : (⌊s / μ⌋:ℝ) + 2 ≤ (n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
          nlinarith [Int.lt_floor_add_one (s / μ)]
      show bumpR (s / μ - n) ^ 2 = 0
      unfold bumpR
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)]; ring
    have hle : bumpR (s / μ - j) ^ 2 ≤ ∑' n : ℤ, bumpR (s / μ - n) ^ 2 :=
      hsum.le_tsum j (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _)
    unfold sqPart
    exact (div_pos hpos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le (pow_pos hpos 2) hle))).ne'
  have hqcont : ∀ x : Cyl, x.2.2.1 < 1 → ContinuousAt (qC B.h) x := by
    intro x hx
    have hτ : 0 < 1 - x.2.2.1 := by linarith
    have hU : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
    have hp : ((x.2.1, 1 - x.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := ⟨trivial, hτ⟩
    have hg : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (x.2.1, 1 - x.2.2.1) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)
    have hk : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) x := by fun_prop
    have he : qC B.h = (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
      funext η; rfl
    rw [he]
    exact ContinuousAt.comp hg hk
  have hΩo : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hx1, hx2, hx3⟩ := hD x hx
    have e1 : ∀ᶠ η in nhds x, 0 < η.1 :=
      continuousAt_const.eventually_lt (show ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => η.1) x by fun_prop) hx1
    have e2 : ∀ᶠ η in nhds x, η.2.2.1 < 1 :=
      (show ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => η.2.2.1) x by fun_prop).eventually_lt continuousAt_const hx2
    have e3 : ∀ᶠ η in nhds x, qC B.h η < qsOf l0 :=
      (hqcont x hx2).eventually_lt continuousAt_const hx3
    filter_upwards [e1, e2, e3] with η h1 h2 h3
    exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
  have hopen : ∀ (γ : Lab) (x : Cyl), x.2.2.1 < 1 → etaL B.h γ x ≠ 0 →
      ∀ᶠ η in nhds x, etaL B.h γ η ≠ 0 := by
    intro γ x hx hne
    have hfac : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ x → sqPart μ j (φ x) ≠ 0 →
        ∀ᶠ η in nhds x, sqPart μ j (φ η) ≠ 0 := by
      intro μ j φ hφ h0
      have hlt := hsq μ j (φ x) h0
      have hcφ : ContinuousAt (fun η => (φ η / μ - j) ^ 2) x :=
        ((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).pow 2
      filter_upwards [hcφ.eventually_lt continuousAt_const hlt] with η hη
      exact hsq' μ j (φ η) hη
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h x := (hS.1 x.2.1 (1 - x.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
    unfold etaL at hne
    have e0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hne
    have r := right_ne_zero_of_mul hne
    have e3 := right_ne_zero_of_mul r
    have r2 := left_ne_zero_of_mul r
    have e1 := left_ne_zero_of_mul r2
    have e2 := right_ne_zero_of_mul r2
    filter_upwards [hfac 1 _ (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC B.h η)) ((hqcont x hx).logb hq0.ne') e0,
      hfac _ _ (chartR B.h γ.1) (by unfold chartR; fun_prop) e1,
      hfac _ _ (chartZ B.h γ.1) (by unfold chartZ; fun_prop) e2,
      hfac _ _ (chartT B.h γ.1) (by unfold chartT; fun_prop) e3] with η k0 k1 k2 k3
    exact mul_ne_zero k0 (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero k1 k2) k3)
  have hdisj : ∀ (γ γ' : Lab) (m m' : ℤ), γ ≠ γ' → a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → b γ' m' ξ ≠ 0 → False := by
    intro γ γ' m m' hne ha hb
    have hSa := (hs γ m ξ hξ).1 ha
    have hSb := (hs γ' m' ξ hξ).2 hb
    have hPev : ∀ x, (x ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ a γ m x ≠ 0 ∧ b γ' m' x ≠ 0) →
        ∀ᶠ η in nhds x, η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ a γ m η ≠ 0 ∧ b γ' m' η ≠ 0 := by
      rintro x ⟨hx, hax, hbx⟩
      have hn : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∈ nhds x := hΩo.mem_nhds hx
      filter_upwards [hn, ((hc γ m).1.continuousAt hn).preimage_mem_nhds (compl_singleton_mem_nhds hax),
        ((hc γ' m').2.continuousAt hn).preimage_mem_nhds (compl_singleton_mem_nhds hbx)]
        with η h1 h2 h3
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    have hfr1 : ∃ᶠ η in nhds ξ, etaL B.h γ η ≠ 0 := mem_closure_iff_frequently.mp hSa.2.1
    obtain ⟨η1, hη1e, hη1P⟩ := (hfr1.and_eventually (hPev ξ ⟨hξ, ha, hb⟩)).exists
    have hSb1 := (hs γ' m' η1 hη1P.1).2 hη1P.2.2
    have hfr2 : ∃ᶠ η in nhds η1, etaL B.h γ' η ≠ 0 := mem_closure_iff_frequently.mp hSb1.2.1
    obtain ⟨η2, hη2e', hη2P, hη2e⟩ := (hfr2.and_eventually ((hPev η1 hη1P).and
      (hopen γ η1 (hD η1 hη1P.1).2.1 hη1e))).exists
    have hlm : G.lmin ≤ γ.1 := hSa.1.1
    have hlm' : G.lmin ≤ γ'.1 := hSb.1.1
    have hη2D : η2 ∈ DomC B.h B.qB :=
      ⟨(hD η2 hη2P.1).1, (hD η2 hη2P.1).2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le (hD η2 hη2P.1).2.2 hqsB⟩
    have hd := hG.2.1 γ γ' hne hlm hlm' ⟨η2, hη2D, hη2e, hη2e'⟩
    have hr0 : 0 < G.r0 := hG.1.1
    have m1 : ξ.2.2.2 ∈ rectAbs B G γ (2 * G.r0) := by
      show |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ 2 * G.r0 ∧ |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ 2 * G.r0
      exact ⟨by linarith [hSa.2.2.1], by linarith [hSa.2.2.2.1]⟩
    have m2 : ξ.2.2.2 ∈ rectAbs B G γ' (2 * G.r0) := by
      show |xiG B.h γ' (G.ctr γ') ξ.2.2.2| ≤ 2 * G.r0 ∧ |etG B.h γ' (G.ctr γ') ξ.2.2.2| ≤ 2 * G.r0
      exact ⟨by linarith [hSb.2.2.1], by linarith [hSb.2.2.2.1]⟩
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hd (subset_closure m1) (subset_closure m2)
  have etaLfin : ∀ (h : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → ∀ ξ0 : Cyl, ξ0.2.2.1 < 1 → ∃ N ∈ nhds ξ0,
      ∃ Γ : Finset Lab, ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ N → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) → γ ∈ Γ := by
    intro h hS ξ0 hξ0
    have hLc : ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ContinuousAt (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) ξ := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hτ : 0 < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 := by linarith
      have hqpos : 0 < qC h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).1
      have hqcont : ContinuousAt (qC h) ξ := by
        have hU : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
        have hp : ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
          ⟨trivial, hτ⟩
        have hg : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) :=
          hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)
        have hk : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) ξ := by fun_prop
        have he : qC h = (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘
            (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
          funext η; rfl
        rw [he]
        exact ContinuousAt.comp hg hk
      exact hqcont.logb hqpos.ne'
    have hwin : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (γ : Lab), ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) →
        |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) + (γ.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartR h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartZ h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartT h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
      intro ξ γ hξ hγ
      have s1 : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ → 1 < |φ ξ / μ - (j : ℝ)| →
          ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 := by
        intro μ j φ hφ h1
        have hψ : ContinuousAt (fun η => |φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)|) ξ :=
          ((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs
        have hev := (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : Cyl => (1:ℝ)) ξ).eventually_lt hψ h1
        filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
        have hsq : 1 < (φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)) ^ 2 := (one_lt_sq_iff_one_lt_abs _).mpr hη
        unfold sqPart bumpR
        rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), zero_div]
      have key : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ →
          (∀ η, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 → etaL h γ η = 0) → |φ ξ / μ - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
        intro μ j φ hφ himp
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have hev := s1 μ j φ hφ hc
        apply (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mpr _) hγ
        filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
        exact himp η hη
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have := key 1 (-(γ.1:ℤ)) (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) (hLc ξ hξ)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul])
        simpa [div_one, sub_neg_eq_add] using this
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.1 (chartR h γ.1) (by unfold chartR; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.1 (chartZ h γ.1) (by unfold chartZ; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.2 (chartT h γ.1) (by unfold chartT; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
    obtain ⟨L0, hL0⟩ : ∃ L0 : ℝ, L0 = Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hfin : (⋃ n ∈ Set.Iic ⌊2 - L0⌋₊, ({n} : Set ℕ) ×ˢ
        ((Set.Icc ⌈chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ⌈chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ⌈chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋) ×ˢ
          (Set.univ : Set Bool))).Finite := by
      refine Set.Finite.biUnion (Set.finite_Iic _) (fun n _ => ?_)
      exact (Set.finite_singleton n).prod (((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod
        ((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod (Set.finite_Icc _ _))).prod Set.finite_univ)
    have hI : ∀ (x c : ℝ) (j : ℤ), |x - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 → |x - c| < 1 → j ∈ Set.Icc ⌈c - 2⌉ ⌊c + 2⌋ := by
      intro x c j hj hc
      rw [abs_le] at hj
      rw [abs_lt] at hc
      exact ⟨Int.ceil_le.mpr (by linarith [hj.2, hc.1]), Int.le_floor.mpr (by linarith [hj.1, hc.2])⟩
    have hcR : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartR h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartR; fun_prop
    have hcZ : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartZ h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartZ; fun_prop
    have hcT : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartT h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartT; fun_prop
    have hch : ∀ (φ : Cyl → ℝ) (μ : ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ0 →
        ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, |φ ξ / μ - φ ξ0 / μ| < 1 := by
      intro φ μ hφ
      exact (((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs).eventually_lt continuousAt_const
        (by simp)
    have e1 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 :=
      (show ContinuousAt (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.2.2.1) ξ0 by fun_prop).eventually_lt
        continuousAt_const hξ0
    have e2 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) - L0| < 1 :=
      (((hLc ξ0 hξ0).sub continuousAt_const).abs).eventually_lt continuousAt_const
        (by simp [hL0])
    have e3 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊2 - L0⌋₊ + 1),
        |chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 := by
      rw [Filter.eventually_all_finset]
      intro n _
      exact (hch _ _ (hcR n)).and ((hch _ _ (hcZ n)).and (hch _ _ (hcT n)))
    refine ⟨{ξ | ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) - L0| < 1 ∧
        ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊2 - L0⌋₊ + 1),
        |chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1}, ?_,
      hfin.toFinset, ?_⟩
    · filter_upwards [e1, e2, e3] with ξ h1 h2 h3
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    rintro ⟨n, ⟨a, b, c⟩, σ⟩ ξ ⟨ht, hL, hC⟩ hγ
    obtain ⟨w0, wR, wZ, wT⟩ := hwin ξ _ ht hγ
    simp only at w0 wR wZ wT
    rw [abs_le] at w0
    rw [abs_lt] at hL
    have hn : n ≤ ⌊2 - L0⌋₊ := Nat.le_floor (by linarith [w0.2, hL.1])
    obtain ⟨cR, cZ, cT⟩ := hC n (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn))
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨n, hn, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨rfl, ⟨hI _ _ _ wR cR, hI _ _ _ wZ cZ, hI _ _ _ wT cT⟩, trivial⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN, Γ, hΓ⟩ := etaLfin B.h hS ξ (hD ξ hξ).2.1
  have hΓa : ∀ γ m, a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → γ ∈ Γ := fun γ m h =>
    hΓ γ ξ (mem_of_mem_nhds hN) ((hs γ m ξ hξ).1 h).2.1
  have hΓb : ∀ γ m, b γ m ξ ≠ 0 → γ ∈ Γ := fun γ m h =>
    hΓ γ ξ (mem_of_mem_nhds hN) ((hs γ m ξ hξ).2 h).2.1
  have haH : ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → a γ m = 0 := fun γ m h => (hH γ m h).1
  have hbH : ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → b γ m = 0 := fun γ m h => (hH γ m h).2
  have habH : ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → (a + b) γ m = 0 := by
    intro γ m h; show a γ m + b γ m = 0; rw [(hH γ m h).1, (hH γ m h).2, add_zero]
  have habΓ : ∀ γ m, (a + b) γ m ξ ≠ 0 → γ ∈ Γ := by
    intro γ m h
    by_cases ha : a γ m ξ = 0
    · apply hΓb γ m; intro hb; apply h; show a γ m ξ + b γ m ξ = 0; rw [ha, hb, add_zero]
    · exact hΓa γ m ha
  have hrep : ∀ (c : WC), (∀ γ m, m ∉ H → c γ m = 0) → (∀ γ m, c γ m ξ ≠ 0 → γ ∈ Γ) → ∀ k θ,
      waveV5 B G c θ ξ k = ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, (c γ m ξ k * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ).re := by
    intro c hcH hcΓ k θ
    have h1 : ∀ γ, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, c γ m ξ k * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ =
        ∑ m ∈ H, c γ m ξ k * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ := by
      intro γ
      apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
      intro m hm
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hm
      rw [Finset.mem_coe]
      by_contra hmH
      exact hm (by rw [hcH γ m hmH, Pi.zero_apply, Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul])
    have h2 : ∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, c γ m ξ k * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ =
        ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, c γ m ξ k * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ := by
      apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
      intro γ hγ
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hγ
      rw [Finset.mem_coe]
      by_contra hγΓ
      have h0 : ∀ m, c γ m ξ = 0 := fun m => by
        by_contra h; exact hγΓ (hcΓ γ m h)
      exact hγ (by simp [h0])
    show (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, c γ m ξ k * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ).re = _
    rw [h2, Complex.re_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
    rw [h1 γ, Complex.re_sum]
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : ℂ → ℤ → ℝ → ℝ,
      T = fun (C : ℂ) (u : ℤ) (θ : ℝ) => (C * Complex.exp ((((u:ℝ) * θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hTdef : ∀ C u θ, T C u θ = (C * Complex.exp ((((u:ℝ) * θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re := by
    subst hT; intro C u θ; rfl
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : Lab → ℤ → ℂ, E = fun (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) =>
      Complex.exp ((((m:ℝ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * phiL5 B G γ ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hEdef : ∀ γ m, E γ m =
      Complex.exp ((((m:ℝ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * phiL5 B G γ ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    subst hE; intro γ m; rfl
  have hTf : ∀ (C : ℂ) (u : ℤ) (θ : ℝ),
      T C u θ = Real.cos ((u:ℝ) * θ) * C.re - Real.sin ((u:ℝ) * θ) * C.im := by
    intro C u θ
    rw [hTdef, Complex.exp_mul_I, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin]
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
    ring
  have hTc : ∀ (C : ℂ) (u : ℤ), Continuous (fun θ => T C u θ) := by
    intro C u
    exact Continuous.congr (by fun_prop) (fun θ => (hTf C u θ).symm)
  have hT0 : ∀ (u : ℤ) (θ : ℝ), T 0 u θ = 0 := by
    intro u θ; rw [hTf]; simp
  have hTadd : ∀ (C D : ℂ) (u : ℤ) (θ : ℝ), T (C + D) u θ = T C u θ + T D u θ := by
    intro C D u θ
    rw [hTf, hTf, hTf]
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im]
    ring
  have hTmul : ∀ (C D : ℂ) (u w : ℤ) (θ : ℝ), T C u θ * T D w θ =
      1/2 * T (C * star D) (u - w) θ + 1/2 * T (C * D) (u + w) θ := by
    intro C D u w θ
    rw [hTf, hTf, hTf, hTf]
    have e1 : ((u - w : ℤ) : ℝ) * θ = (u:ℝ) * θ - (w:ℝ) * θ := by push_cast; ring
    have e2 : ((u + w : ℤ) : ℝ) * θ = (u:ℝ) * θ + (w:ℝ) * θ := by push_cast; ring
    rw [e1, e2, Real.cos_sub, Real.sin_sub, Real.cos_add, Real.sin_add]
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im]
    ring
  have hcos : ∀ m : ℤ, m ≠ 0 → ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Real.cos ((m : ℝ) * θ) = 0 := by
    intro m hm
    have hcm : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hm
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left (fun x => Real.cos x) hcm, integral_cos]
    have h1 : (m : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) = ((2 * m : ℤ) : ℝ) * Real.pi := by push_cast; ring
    rw [h1, Real.sin_int_mul_pi, mul_zero, Real.sin_zero, sub_self, smul_zero]
  have hsin : ∀ m : ℤ, m ≠ 0 → ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Real.sin ((m : ℝ) * θ) = 0 := by
    intro m hm
    have hcm : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hm
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left (fun x => Real.sin x) hcm, integral_sin]
    rw [mul_zero, Real.cos_zero, Real.cos_int_mul_two_pi, sub_self, smul_zero]
  have hthT : ∀ (C : ℂ) (u : ℤ), thA (fun θ => T C u θ) = if u = 0 then C.re else 0 := by
    intro C u
    refine (congrArg thA (funext (hTf C u))).trans ?_
    split_ifs with hu
    · subst hu
      unfold thA
      simp only [Int.cast_zero, zero_mul, Real.cos_zero, Real.sin_zero, one_mul, zero_mul, sub_zero,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
    · unfold thA
      have hc1 : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => Real.cos ((u : ℝ) * θ) * C.re) := by fun_prop
      have hs1 : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => Real.sin ((u : ℝ) * θ) * C.im) := by fun_prop
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hc1.intervalIntegrable _ _) (hs1.intervalIntegrable _ _),
        intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const, intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const, hcos u hu, hsin u hu]
      ring
  have hlin : ∀ (c d : ℝ) (f g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → Continuous g →
      thA (fun θ => c * f θ + d * g θ) = c * thA f + d * thA g := by
    intro c d f g hf hg
    unfold thA
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add ((hf.const_mul c).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      ((hg.const_mul d).intervalIntegrable _ _),
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    ring
  have hthT2 : ∀ (C D : ℂ) (u w : ℤ), thA (fun θ => 1/2 * T C u θ + 1/2 * T D w θ) =
      1/2 * (if u = 0 then C.re else 0) + 1/2 * (if w = 0 then D.re else 0) := by
    intro C D u w
    rw [hlin _ _ _ _ (hTc C u) (hTc D w), hthT, hthT]
  have hsumA : ∀ {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ x, Continuous (F x)) →
      thA (fun θ => ∑ x ∈ s, F x θ) = ∑ x ∈ s, thA (F x) := by
    intro ι s F hF
    unfold thA
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun x _ => (hF x).intervalIntegrable _ _), Finset.mul_sum]
  have hp : ∀ γ, pint5 B G γ ≠ 0 := by
    intro γ; unfold pint5; split_ifs with h
    · norm_num
    · exact h
  have hEs : ∀ γ m, star (E γ m) = E γ (-m) := by
    intro γ m
    rw [hEdef, hEdef, Complex.star_def, ← Complex.exp_conj]
    congr 1
    simp only [map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_I]
    push_cast; ring
  have hEm : ∀ γ m, E γ m * E γ (-m) = 1 := by
    intro γ m
    rw [hEdef, hEdef, ← Complex.exp_add, ← Complex.exp_zero]
    congr 1
    push_cast; ring
  have hterm : ∀ (C : ℂ) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (θ : ℝ),
      (C * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ).re = T (C * E γ m) (m * pint5 B G γ) θ := by
    intro C γ m θ
    have hx : ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ =
        E γ m * Complex.exp (((((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℝ) * θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      rw [hEdef]
      unfold ephase5
      rw [← Complex.exp_add]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hTdef, hx, mul_assoc]
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ : ∃ X : WC → Fin 3 → Lab → ℝ → ℝ,
      X = fun c k γ θ => ∑ m ∈ H, T (c γ m ξ k * E γ m) (m * pint5 B G γ) θ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hXdef : ∀ c k γ θ, X c k γ θ = ∑ m ∈ H, T (c γ m ξ k * E γ m) (m * pint5 B G γ) θ := by
    subst hX; intro c k γ θ; rfl
  have hXc : ∀ c k γ, Continuous (X c k γ) := by
    intro c k γ
    exact (continuous_finsetSum H (fun m _ => hTc (c γ m ξ k * E γ m) (m * pint5 B G γ))).congr
      (fun θ => (hXdef c k γ θ).symm)
  have hrepX : ∀ (c : WC), (∀ γ m, m ∉ H → c γ m = 0) → (∀ γ m, c γ m ξ ≠ 0 → γ ∈ Γ) → ∀ k θ,
      waveV5 B G c θ ξ k = ∑ γ ∈ Γ, X c k γ θ := by
    intro c h1 h2 k θ
    rw [hrep c h1 h2 k θ]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
    rw [hXdef]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => hterm _ _ _ _)
  have hcross : ∀ γ γ' : Lab, γ ≠ γ' → ∀ θ, X a i γ θ * X b j γ' θ = 0 := by
    intro γ γ' hne θ
    by_cases hA : ∀ m, a γ m ξ = 0
    · have h0 : X a i γ θ = 0 := by
        rw [hXdef]; apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro m _
        rw [hA m, Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul]; exact hT0 _ _
      rw [h0, zero_mul]
    · push_neg at hA
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hA
      have hB : ∀ m', b γ' m' ξ = 0 := fun m' => by
        by_contra h; exact hdisj γ γ' m m' hne hm h
      have h0 : X b j γ' θ = 0 := by
        rw [hXdef]; apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro m' _
        rw [hB m', Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul]; exact hT0 _ _
      rw [h0, mul_zero]
  have hsumm' : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), m ∈ H →
      ∑ m' ∈ H, thA (fun θ => T (a γ m ξ i * E γ m) (m * pint5 B G γ) θ *
        T (b γ m' ξ j * E γ m') (m' * pint5 B G γ) θ) =
      (1/2 : ℝ) * (a γ m ξ i * star (b γ m ξ j) + a γ m ξ i * b γ (-m) ξ j).re := by
    intro γ m hm
    have hpt : ∀ m' : ℤ, thA (fun θ => T (a γ m ξ i * E γ m) (m * pint5 B G γ) θ *
        T (b γ m' ξ j * E γ m') (m' * pint5 B G γ) θ) =
        1/2 * (if m * pint5 B G γ - m' * pint5 B G γ = 0 then
          (a γ m ξ i * E γ m * star (b γ m' ξ j * E γ m')).re else 0) +
        1/2 * (if m * pint5 B G γ + m' * pint5 B G γ = 0 then
          (a γ m ξ i * E γ m * (b γ m' ξ j * E γ m')).re else 0) := by
      intro m'
      simp only [hTmul]
      exact hthT2 _ _ _ _
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m' _ => hpt m'), Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
      ← Finset.mul_sum]
    have s1 : ∑ m' ∈ H, (if m * pint5 B G γ - m' * pint5 B G γ = 0 then
          (a γ m ξ i * E γ m * star (b γ m' ξ j * E γ m')).re else 0) =
        (a γ m ξ i * star (b γ m ξ j)).re := by
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem m hm]
      · rw [if_pos (show m * pint5 B G γ - m * pint5 B G γ = 0 by ring), star_mul, hEs]
        congr 1
        linear_combination (a γ m ξ i * star (b γ m ξ j)) * hEm γ m
      · intro m' _ hne
        rw [if_neg]
        intro h
        exact hne (mul_right_cancel₀ (hp γ) (by linarith))
    have s2 : ∑ m' ∈ H, (if m * pint5 B G γ + m' * pint5 B G γ = 0 then
          (a γ m ξ i * E γ m * (b γ m' ξ j * E γ m')).re else 0) =
        (a γ m ξ i * b γ (-m) ξ j).re := by
      by_cases hmH : -m ∈ H
      · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem (-m) hmH]
        · rw [if_pos (show m * pint5 B G γ + -m * pint5 B G γ = 0 by ring)]
          congr 1
          linear_combination (a γ m ξ i * b γ (-m) ξ j) * hEm γ m
        · intro m' _ hne
          rw [if_neg]
          intro h
          exact hne (mul_right_cancel₀ (hp γ) (by linarith))
      · rw [(hH γ (-m) hmH).2]
        simp only [Pi.zero_apply, mul_zero, Complex.zero_re]
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro m' hm'
        rw [if_neg]
        intro h
        apply hmH
        have : m' = -m := mul_right_cancel₀ (hp γ) (by linarith)
        rw [← this]; exact hm'
    rw [s1, s2, Complex.add_re]
    ring
  have hW : wmoPair5 a b i j ξ = ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H,
      (1/2 : ℝ) * (a γ m ξ i * star (b γ m ξ j) + a γ m ξ i * b γ (-m) ξ j).re := by
    unfold wmoPair5
    rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset (s := Γ)]
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
      apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
      intro m hm
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hm
      rw [Finset.mem_coe]
      by_contra hmH
      apply hm
      rw [(hH γ m hmH).1]
      simp
    · intro γ hγ
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hγ
      rw [Finset.mem_coe]
      by_contra hγΓ
      apply hγ
      have h0 : ∀ m, a γ m ξ = 0 := fun m => by
        by_contra h; exact hγΓ (hΓa γ m h)
      simp [h0]
  have hprod : ∀ θ, waveV5 B G a θ ξ i * waveV5 B G b θ ξ j = ∑ γ ∈ Γ, X a i γ θ * X b j γ θ := by
    intro θ
    rw [hrepX a haH hΓa i θ, hrepX b hbH hΓb j θ, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ hγ => ?_)
    exact Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem γ hγ (fun γ' _ hne => hcross γ γ' (Ne.symm hne) θ)
  have hXX : ∀ γ θ, X a i γ θ * X b j γ θ = ∑ m ∈ H, ∑ m' ∈ H,
      T (a γ m ξ i * E γ m) (m * pint5 B G γ) θ * T (b γ m' ξ j * E γ m') (m' * pint5 B G γ) θ := by
    intro γ θ
    rw [hXdef, hXdef, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (continuous_finsetSum Γ (fun γ _ => hXc a i γ)).congr
      (fun θ => (hrepX a haH hΓa i θ).symm)
  · refine (congrArg thA (funext (hrepX a haH hΓa i))).trans ?_
    rw [hsumA Γ (fun γ θ => X a i γ θ) (fun γ => hXc a i γ)]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro γ _
    refine (congrArg thA (funext (hXdef a i γ))).trans ?_
    rw [hsumA H (fun m θ => T (a γ m ξ i * E γ m) (m * pint5 B G γ) θ) (fun m => hTc _ _)]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro m hm
    exact (hthT _ _).trans (if_neg (mul_ne_zero (fun h => hH0 (h ▸ hm)) (hp γ)))
  · intro θ
    rw [hrepX (a + b) habH habΓ i θ, hrepX a haH hΓa i θ, hrepX b hbH hΓb i θ,
      ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
    rw [hXdef, hXdef, hXdef, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
    show T ((a γ m ξ i + b γ m ξ i) * E γ m) _ θ = _
    rw [add_mul, hTadd]
  · refine (congrArg thA (funext hprod)).trans ?_
    rw [hsumA Γ (fun γ θ => X a i γ θ * X b j γ θ) (fun γ => (hXc a i γ).mul (hXc b j γ)), hW]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
    refine (congrArg thA (funext (hXX γ))).trans ?_
    rw [hsumA H (fun m θ => ∑ m' ∈ H, T (a γ m ξ i * E γ m) (m * pint5 B G γ) θ *
        T (b γ m' ξ j * E γ m') (m' * pint5 B G γ) θ)
      (fun m => continuous_finsetSum _ (fun m' _ => (hTc _ _).mul (hTc _ _)))]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m hm => ?_)
    rw [hsumA H (fun m' θ => T (a γ m ξ i * E γ m) (m * pint5 B G γ) θ *
        T (b γ m' ξ j * E γ m') (m' * pint5 B G γ) θ) (fun m' => (hTc _ _).mul (hTc _ _))]
    exact hsumm' γ m hm

signature.name: wmo_pair_class_v5
signature.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →
    ∀ (a b : WC) (α β : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β b →
    ∀ i j : Fin 3, InM B (qsOf l0) (α + β) (wmoPair5 a b i j)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lP, hP⟩ := pulse_support_good_v5 B G hok hG
  refine ⟨lP, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 a b α β ha hb i j
  
  have hPWC : ∀ (k : ℕ) (hh α β q S E e P : ℝ) (Ca ba da Cb bb db na nb : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < q → 1 ≤ S → 0 ≤ E →
      0 < e → e ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ P → P ≤ 1 →
      (∀ n, n ≤ k → 0 ≤ na n ∧ na n ≤ Ca n * q ^ (hh * α) * S ^ (ba n) * Real.sqrt E * e ^ (-(da n)) * P) →
      (∀ n, n ≤ k → 0 ≤ nb n ∧ nb n ≤ Cb n * q ^ (hh * β) * S ^ (bb n) * Real.sqrt E * e ^ (-(db n)) * P) →
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose n : ℝ) * na n * nb (k - n) ≤
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose n : ℝ) * |Ca n| * |Cb (k - n)|) * q ^ (hh * (α + β)) *
          S ^ (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (|ba n| + |bb n|)) * E *
          e ^ (-(∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (|da n| + |db n|))) := by
    intro k hh α β q S E e P Ca ba da Cb bb db na nb hq hS hE he0 he1 hP0 hP1 hna hnb
    have hS0 : 0 < S := by linarith
    obtain ⟨Bt, hBt⟩ : ∃ Bt : ℝ, Bt = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (|ba n| + |bb n|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Dt, hDt⟩ : ∃ Dt : ℝ, Dt = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (|da n| + |db n|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hBt, ← hDt]
    obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ, W = q ^ (hh * (α + β)) * S ^ Bt * E * e ^ (-Dt) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hBt' : Bt = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |ba n| + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb n| := by
      rw [hBt, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    have hDt' : Dt = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |da n| + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |db n| := by
      rw [hDt, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    have key : ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose n : ℝ) * na n * nb (k - n) ≤
        (k.choose n : ℝ) * |Ca n| * |Cb (k - n)| * W := by
      intro n hn
      have hnk : n ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hn)
      have hn' : k - n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
      obtain ⟨a0, a1⟩ := hna n hnk
      obtain ⟨b0, b1⟩ := hnb (k - n) (Nat.sub_le k n)
      set Ra := q ^ (hh * α) * S ^ (ba n) * Real.sqrt E * e ^ (-(da n)) * P with hRa
      set Rb := q ^ (hh * β) * S ^ (bb (k - n)) * Real.sqrt E * e ^ (-(db (k - n))) * P with hRb

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →
    ∀ (S S' : CState), (∀ (a : Fin 3), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), mcor5 B G l0 S' a ξ = mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) →
    (∀ a : Fin 3, ∃ α : ℝ, InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (Aex B.h) (mcor5 B G l0 S a))) →
    (∀ a b : Fin 3, (∃ α : ℝ, InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (Wcov5 B G l0 S a b))) ∧
      ∃ α : ℝ, InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (Wcov5 B G l0 S' a b))) →
    ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      EthP5 B G l0 S' ξ = EthP5 B G l0 S ξ + (dR B.h (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S' 0 1 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 1 η) ξ
        + 2 * (Wcov5 B G l0 S' 0 1 ξ - Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 1 ξ) / ξ.1
        + dZ (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S' 2 1 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 1 η) ξ) ∧
      grP5 B G l0 S' ξ - grP5 B G l0 S ξ =
        -(dR B.h (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S' 0 0 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 0 η) ξ
          + (Wcov5 B G l0 S' 0 0 ξ - Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 0 ξ) / ξ.1)
        - dZ (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S' 2 0 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 0 η) ξ
        + (Wcov5 B G l0 S' 1 1 ξ - Wcov5 B G l0 S 1 1 ξ) / ξ.1 ∧
      ((∃ α : ℝ, InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (pmP5 B G l0 S))) →
       (∃ α : ℝ, InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (pmP5 B G l0 S'))) →
        EzP5 B G l0 S' ξ = EzP5 B G l0 S ξ + (dR B.h (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S' 0 2 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 2 η) ξ
          + (Wcov5 B G l0 S' 0 2 ξ - Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 2 ξ) / ξ.1
          + dZ (fun η => (Wcov5 B G l0 S' 2 2 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 2 η) +
              (pmP5 B G l0 S' η - pmP5 B G l0 S η)) ξ)) ∧
      calP5 B G l0 S' ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 = calP5 B G l0 S ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 +
        radMom (fun η => grP5 B G l0 S' η - grP5 B G l0 S η) 0 ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 ∧
      calJth5 B G l0 S' ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 = calJth5 B G l0 S ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 +
        radMom (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S' 2 1 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 1 η) 2 ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 ∧
      calJz5 B G l0 S' ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 = calJz5 B G l0 S ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 +
        radMom (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S' 2 2 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 2 η) 1 ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 -
        (1/2) * radMom (fun η => grP5 B G l0 S' η - grP5 B G l0 S η) 2 ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 ∧
      pmP5 B G l0 S' ξ = pmP5 B G l0 S ξ +
        Icut B (momDgt B (fun η => grP5 B G l0 S' η - grP5 B G l0 S η)) ξ

∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →

    (∀ a : Fin 3, ∃ α : ℝ, InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (Aex B.h) (mcor5 B G l0 S a))) →

        + (Wcov5 B G l0 S' 1 1 ξ - Wcov5 B G l0 S 1 1 ξ) / ξ.1 ∧
      ((∃ α : ℝ, InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (pmP5 B G l0 S))) →

          + (Wcov5 B G l0 S' 0 2 ξ - Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 2 ξ) / ξ.1
          + dZ (fun η => (Wcov5 B G l0 S' 2 2 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 2 η) +

      calJth5 B G l0 S' ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 = calJth5 B G l0 S ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 +
        radMom (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S' 2 1 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 1 η) 2 ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 ∧

        radMom (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S' 2 2 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 2 η) 1 ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 -

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok
  obtain ⟨-, -, hXa, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -, hqB0, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n0, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 S S' hmc hmS hW ξ hξ
  
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hl0) hn0.le
  
  have hUo : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := (domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok).1
  have hub : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ubase B η a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro a
    refine ((ubase5_axisym B hok).2 a).mono ?_
    intro η hη
    have hη' : 0 < η.1 ∧ η.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h η < qsOf l0 := hη
    exact ⟨hη'.1, hη'.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hη'.2.2 hqsB⟩
  
  have hmSr : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mcor5 B G l0 S a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧
      ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ = 0 := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := hmS a
    exact g_regular_of_nrm_InM_v5 B _ _ _ _ hok hα
  have hWSr : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Wcov5 B G l0 S a b) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧
      ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → Wcov5 B G l0 S a b ξ = 0 := by
    intro a b
    obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := (hW a b).1
    exact g_regular_of_nrm_InM_v5 B _ _ _ _ hok hα
  have hWS'r : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Wcov5 B G l0 S' a b) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧
      ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → Wcov5 B G l0 S' a b ξ = 0 := by
    intro a b
    obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := (hW a b).2
    exact g_regular_of_nrm_InM_v5 B _ _ _ _ hok hα
  have hm : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mcor5 B G l0 S a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := fun a => (hmSr a).1
  have hm' : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mcor5 B G l0 S' a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    fun a => (hm a).congr (fun η hη => hmc a η hη)
  have hWS : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Wcov5 B G l0 S a b) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    fun a b => (hWSr a b).1
  have hWS' : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Wcov5 B G l0 S' a b) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    fun a b => (hWS'r a b).1
  have hdW : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S' a b η - Wcov5 B G l0 S a b η)
      (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := fun a b => (hWS' a b).sub (hWS a b)
  have hm0 : ∀ a : Fin 3, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) →
      mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ = 0 := fun a η hη hX => (hmSr a).2 η hη (hX.imp le_of_lt le_of_lt)
  have hm0' : ∀ a : Fin 3, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) →
      mcor5 B G l0 S' a ξ = 0 := fun a η hη hX => (hmc a η hη).trans (hm0 a η hη hX)
  have hW0 : ∀ a c : Fin 3, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) →
      Wcov5 B G l0 S a c ξ = 0 := fun a c η hη hX => (hWSr a c).2 η hη (hX.imp le_of_lt le_of_lt)
  have hW0' : ∀ a c : Fin 3, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) →
      Wcov5 B G l0 S' a c ξ = 0 := fun a c η hη hX => (hWS'r a c).2 η hη (hX.imp le_of_lt le_of_lt)
  
  have hL : ∀ (F F' : Cyl → ℝ), (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), F' η = F η) →
      ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), fderiv ℝ F' η = fderiv ℝ F η := by
    intro F F' h η hη
    exact Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hη) h)
  have hLR : ∀ (F F' : Cyl → ℝ), (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), F' η = F η) →
      ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dR B.h F' η = dR B.h F η := by
    intro F F' h η hη
    unfold dR
    rw [hL F F' h η hη]
  have hLZ : ∀ (F F' : Cyl → ℝ), (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), F' η = F η) →
      ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dZ F' η = dZ F η := by
    intro F F' h η hη
    unfold dZ
    rw [hL F F' h η hη]
  have hLT : ∀ (F F' : Cyl → ℝ), (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), F' η = F η) →
      ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dT F' η = dT F η := by
    intro F F' h η hη
    unfold dT
    rw [hL F F' h η hη]
  have hlap : ∀ (F F' : Cyl → ℝ), (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), F' η = F η) →
      ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), lap0 B.h F' η = lap0 B.h F η := by
    intro F F' h η hη
    unfold lap0
    rw [hLR (dR B.h F) (dR B.h F') (hLR F F' h) η hη, hLR F F' h η hη,
      hLZ (dZ F) (dZ F') (hLZ F F' h) η hη]
  
  have hdiff : ∀ F : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), DifferentiableAt ℝ F η :=
    fun F hF η hη => (hF.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hη)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hfadd : ∀ (F D F' : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ D (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), F' η = F η + D η) → ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ v : Cyl,
      fderiv ℝ F' η v = fderiv ℝ F η v + fderiv ℝ D η v := by
    intro F D F' hF hD h η hη v
    rw [hL (fun ζ => F ζ + D ζ) F' h η hη, fderiv_fun_add (hdiff F hF η hη) (hdiff D hD η hη)]
    rfl
  have hAR : ∀ (F D F' : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ D (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), F' η = F η + D η) → ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      dR B.h F' η = dR B.h F η + dR B.h D η :=
    fun F D F' hF hD h η hη => hfadd F D F' hF hD h η hη _
  have hAZ : ∀ (F D F' : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ D (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), F' η = F η + D η) → ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      dZ F' η = dZ F η + dZ D η :=
    fun F D F' hF hD h η hη => hfadd F D F' hF hD h η hη _
  
  have C1 : EthP5 B G l0 S' ξ = EthP5 B G l0 S ξ + (dR B.h (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S' 0 1 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 1 η) ξ
        + 2 * (Wcov5 B G l0 S' 0 1 ξ - Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 1 ξ) / ξ.1
        + dZ (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S' 2 1 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 1 η) ξ) := by
    have eT := hLT (mcor5 B G l0 S 1) (mcor5 B G l0 S' 1) (hmc 1) ξ hξ
    have eL := hlap (mcor5 B G l0 S 1) (mcor5 B G l0 S' 1) (hmc 1) ξ hξ
    have eR : dR B.h (fun η => ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S' 1 η + mcor5 B G l0 S' 0 η * ubase B η 1
          + mcor5 B G l0 S' 0 η * mcor5 B G l0 S' 1 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S' 0 1 η) ξ =
        dR B.h (fun η => ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * ubase B η 1
          + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 1 η) ξ
        + dR B.h (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S' 0 1 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 1 η) ξ := by
      refine hAR _ _ _ ?_ (hdW 0 1) ?_ ξ hξ
      · exact ((((hub 0).mul (hm 1)).add ((hm 0).mul (hub 1))).add ((hm 0).mul (hm 1))).add (hWS 0 1)
      · intro η hη
        simp only [hmc 0 η hη, hmc 1 η hη] <;> ring
    have eZ : dZ (fun η => ubase B η 2 * mcor5 B G l0 S' 1 η + ubase B η 1 * mcor5 B G l0 S' 2 η
          + mcor5 B G l0 S' 2 η * mcor5 B G l0 S' 1 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S' 2 1 η) ξ =
        dZ (fun η => ubase B η 2 * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η + ubase B η 1 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η
          + mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 1 η) ξ
        + dZ (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S' 2 1 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 1 η) ξ := by
      refine hAZ _ _ _ ?_ (hdW 2 1) ?_ ξ hξ
      · exact ((((hub 2).mul (hm 1)).add ((hub 1).mul (hm 2))).add ((hm 2).mul (hm 1))).add (hWS 2 1)
      · intro η hη
        simp only [hmc 1 η hη, hmc 2 η hη] <;> ring
    simp only [EthP5]
    rw [eT, eL, eR, eZ, hmc 0 ξ hξ, hmc 1 ξ hξ]
    ring
  
  have C2 : grP5 B G l0 S' ξ - grP5 B G l0 S ξ =
        -(dR B.h (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S' 0 0 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 0 η) ξ
          + (Wcov5 B G l0 S' 0 0 ξ - Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 0 ξ) / ξ.1)
        - dZ (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S' 2 0 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 0 η) ξ
        + (Wcov5 B G l0 S' 1 1 ξ - Wcov5 B G l0 S 1 1 ξ) / ξ.1 := by
    have eT := hLT (mcor5 B G l0 S 0) (mcor5 B G l0 S' 0) (hmc 0) ξ hξ
    have eL := hlap (mcor5 B G l0 S 0) (mcor5 B G l0 S' 0) (hmc 0) ξ hξ
    have eR : dR B.h (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S' 0 η + mcor5 B G l0 S' 0 η ^ 2
          + Wcov5 B G l0 S' 0 0 η) ξ =
        dR B.h (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η ^ 2
          + Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 0 η) ξ
        + dR B.h (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S' 0 0 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 0 η) ξ := by
      refine hAR _ _ _ ?_ (hdW 0 0) ?_ ξ hξ
      · exact (((contDiffOn_const.mul (hub 0)).mul (hm 0)).add ((hm 0).pow 2)).add (hWS 0 0)
      · intro η hη
        simp only [hmc 0 η hη] <;> ring
    have eZ : dZ (fun η => ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S' 2 η + ubase B η 2 * mcor5 B G l0 S' 0 η
          + mcor5 B G l0 S' 0 η * mcor5 B G l0 S' 2 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S' 2 0 η) ξ =
        dZ (fun η => ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + ubase B η 2 * mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η
          + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 0 η) ξ
        + dZ (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S' 2 0 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 0 η) ξ := by
      refine hAZ _ _ _ ?_ (hdW 2 0) ?_ ξ hξ
      · exact ((((hub 0).mul (hm 2)).add ((hub 2).mul (hm 0))).add ((hm 0).mul (hm 2))).add (hWS 2 0)
      · intro η hη
        simp only [hmc 0 η hη, hmc 2 η hη] <;> ring
    simp only [grP5]
    rw [eT, eL, eR, eZ, hmc 0 ξ hξ, hmc 1 ξ hξ]
    ring
  
  have C3 : (∃ α : ℝ, InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (pmP5 B G l0 S))) →
       (∃ α : ℝ, InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (pmP5 B G l0 S'))) →
        EzP5 B G l0 S' ξ = EzP5 B G l0 S ξ + (dR B.h (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S' 0 2 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 2 η) ξ
          + (Wcov5 B G l0 S' 0 2 ξ - Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 2 ξ) / ξ.1
          + dZ (fun η => (Wcov5 B G l0 S' 2 2 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 2 η) +
              (pmP5 B G l0 S' η - pmP5 B G l0 S η)) ξ) := by
    rintro ⟨α1, hp1⟩ ⟨α2, hp2⟩
    have hpS := (g_regular_of_nrm_InM_v5 B _ _ _ _ hok hp1).1
    have hpS' := (g_regular_of_nrm_InM_v5 B _ _ _ _ hok hp2).1
    have eT := hLT (mcor5 B G l0 S 2) (mcor5 B G l0 S' 2) (hmc 2) ξ hξ
    have eL := hlap (mcor5 B G l0 S 2) (mcor5 B G l0 S' 2) (hmc 2) ξ hξ
    have eR : dR B.h (fun η => ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S' 2 η + mcor5 B G l0 S' 0 η * ubase B η 2
          + mcor5 B G l0 S' 0 η * mcor5 B G l0 S' 2 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S' 0 2 η) ξ =
        dR B.h (fun η => ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * ubase B η 2
          + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 2 η) ξ
        + dR B.h (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S' 0 2 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 2 η) ξ := by
      refine hAR _ _ _ ?_ (hdW 0 2) ?_ ξ hξ
      · exact ((((hub 0).mul (hm 2)).add ((hm 0).mul (hub 2))).add ((hm 0).mul (hm 2))).add (hWS 0 2)
      · intro η hη
        simp only [hmc 0 η hη, hmc 2 η hη] <;> ring
    have eZ : dZ (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 2 * mcor5 B G l0 S' 2 η + mcor5 B G l0 S' 2 η ^ 2
          + Wcov5 B G l0 S' 2 2 η + pmP5 B G l0 S' η) ξ =
        dZ (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 2 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η ^ 2
          + Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 2 η + pmP5 B G l0 S η) ξ
        + dZ (fun η => (Wcov5 B G l0 S' 2 2 η - Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 2 η) +
              (pmP5 B G l0 S' η - pmP5 B G l0 S η)) ξ := by
      refine hAZ _ _ _ ?_ ((hdW 2 2).add (hpS'.sub hpS)) ?_ ξ hξ
      · exact ((((contDiffOn_const.mul (hub 2)).mul (hm 2)).add ((hm 2).pow 2)).add (hWS 2 2)).add hpS
      · intro η hη

    simp only [EzP5]
    rw [eT, eL, eR, eZ, hmc 0 ξ hξ, hmc 2 ξ hξ]
    ring
  
  have hgS := grP5_contDiffOn_v5 B G l0 S hUo hub hm hWS
  have hgS' := grP5_contDiffOn_v5 B G l0 S' hUo hub hm' hWS'

  have gvS' := grP5_shell_vanish_v5 B G l0 S' hok hm0' hW0'

    (fun η _ => show grP5 B G l0 S' η = grP5 B G l0 S η + (grP5 B G l0 S' η - grP5 B G l0 S η) by ring)
  have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
  obtain ⟨-, ht, hq⟩ := hξ'
  have hq' : simScale B.h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) < qsOf l0 := hq

      Icut B (momDgt B (fun η => grP5 B G l0 S' η - grP5 B G l0 S η)) ξ := by
    have := (hsp.2 ξ hξ).1

  have shell : ∀ (z t : ℝ), t < 1 → ∃ a b : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ ∀ (r : ℝ) (W : ℝ × ℝ), 0 < r →
      r ∉ Set.Icc a b → XC B.h (r, z, t, W) < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h (r, z, t, W) := by
    intro z t ht
    have hq : 0 < simScale B.h z (1 - t) := (hok.1.1 z (1 - t) (by linarith)).1
    refine ⟨Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h z (1 - t)), Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xb * simScale B.h z (1 - t)),
      Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity), ?_⟩
    intro r W hr hn
    have hX : XC B.h (r, z, t, W) = r ^ 2 / (2 * simScale B.h z (1 - t)) := rfl
    rw [hX]
    rw [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or] at hn

    · left
      have h1' : r < Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h z (1 - t)) := not_le.mp h1

      linarith
  have mem : ∀ (r z t : ℝ) (W : ℝ × ℝ), 0 < r → t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 →
      ((r, z, t, W) : Cyl) ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := by
    intro r z t W hr ht hq
    show 0 < r ∧ t < 1 ∧ qC B.h (r, z, t, W) < qsOf l0
    exact ⟨hr, ht, hq⟩
  have yavg : ∀ (F : Cyl → ℝ) (z t : ℝ) (e : ℕ), t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 →
      ContinuousOn F (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → F ξ = 0) →
      (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => F (r, z, t, Y))
        (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)) ∧
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun r : ℝ => r ^ e * yAvg F (r, z, t, 0)) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    intro F z t e ht hq hF hFv
    obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hsh⟩ := shell z t ht
    have hcomp : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    refine ⟨fun r hr => ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hcont : Continuous (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => F (r, z, t, Y)) :=
        hF.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk
          (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))) (fun Y => mem r z t Y hr ht hq)
      exact hcont.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hcomp
    · let f : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun r Y => F (max r a, z, t, Y)
      have hf : Continuous (Function.uncurry f) :=
        hF.comp_continuous ((continuous_fst.max continuous_const).prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk

          (fun p => mem (max p.1 a) z t p.2 (lt_of_lt_of_le ha (le_max_right _ _)) ht hq)
      have hΦ : Continuous (fun r : ℝ => ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, f r Y) :=
        continuous_parametric_integral_of_continuous hf hcomp
      have hI : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun r : ℝ => r ^ e * yAvg F (r, z, t, 0)) (Set.Icc a b) := by
        apply ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc
        refine (((continuous_pow e).mul hΦ).continuousOn).congr ?_
        intro r hr
        show r ^ e * (∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, F (r, z, t, Y)) =
          r ^ e * ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, F (max r a, z, t, Y)
        rw [max_eq_left hr.1]
      refine hI.of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi ?_
      intro r hr
      show r ^ e * (∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, F (r, z, t, Y)) = 0
      have h0 : ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, F (r, z, t, Y) = 0 := fun Y =>
        hFv _ (mem r z t Y hr.1 ht hq) (hsh r Y hr.1 hr.2)
      simp only [h0, MeasureTheory.integral_zero, mul_zero]
  have rad_add : ∀ (F F2 K : Cyl → ℝ) (e : ℕ) (z t : ℝ),
      (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => F (r, z, t, Y))
        (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)) →
      (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => F2 (r, z, t, Y))

      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun r : ℝ => r ^ e * yAvg F (r, z, t, 0)) (Set.Ioi 0) →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun r : ℝ => r ^ e * yAvg F2 (r, z, t, 0)) (Set.Ioi 0) →
      (∀ (r : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), 0 < r → K (r, z, t, Y) = F (r, z, t, Y) + F2 (r, z, t, Y)) →

    rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun
      (g := fun r => r ^ e * yAvg F (r, z, t, 0) + r ^ e * yAvg F2 (r, z, t, 0))

  have radLin : ∀ (F D K : Cyl → ℝ) (e : ℕ) (z t : ℝ), t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 →

    unfold calJth5

    · exact (((((hub 2).mul (hm 1)).add ((hub 1).mul (hm 2))).add ((hm 2).mul (hm 1))).add

by

      contDiff_fst.contDiffOn.rpow_const_of_ne
        (fun ξ (hξ : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qs) => hξ.1.ne')
    have hY : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) (DomC B.h qs) :=
      (contDiffOn_const.mul hpow).smul_const _
    have hvR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl =>
        ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)) (DomC B.h qs) :=
      contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk hY))
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (hDf.clm_apply hvR).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
    · exact (hDf.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
    · exact (hDf.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
  · intro f hz ξ hξ hX
    have hO : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs ∩ XC B.h ⁻¹' (Iio B.Xa ∪ Ioi B.Xb)) :=
      hXC.isOpen_inter_preimage hDopen (isOpen_Iio.union isOpen_Ioi)
    have hξO : ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs ∩ XC B.h ⁻¹' (Iio B.Xa ∪ Ioi B.Xb) := ⟨hξ, hX⟩
    have hev : f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hξO) (fun η hη => hz η hη.1 hη.2)
    have hd : fderiv ℝ f ξ = 0 := by
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]; exact fderiv_const_apply _
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold dR; rw [hd]; rfl
    · unfold dZ; rw [hd]; rfl
    · unfold dT; rw [hd]; rfl

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ), IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dT f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mcor5 B G l0 S a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => ubase B ξ a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ a c : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Wcov5 B G l0 S a c) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (momDbP B dPsi) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (momDgP B dPsi) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (momDvP B dv) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → MomMeanId5 B G l0 S dPsi dv → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), grP5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) ξ = grP5 B G l0 S ξ + momDg5 B G l0 S dPsi dv ξ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 S dPsi dv hDo hcl hmc hub hW hdb hdg hdw hmean ξ hξ
  have hdiff : ∀ φ : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), DifferentiableAt ℝ φ η := by
    intro φ hφ η hη
    exact (hφ.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hDo.mem_nhds hη)
  have split : ∀ (f g k : Cyl → ℝ) (x w : Cyl), x ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) →
      (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), f η = g η + k η) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ g x → DifferentiableAt ℝ k x →
      fderiv ℝ f x w = fderiv ℝ g x w + fderiv ℝ k x w := by
    intro f g k x w hx hfgk hg hk
    have hev : f =ᶠ[nhds x] fun η => g η + k η :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hDo.mem_nhds hx) hfgk
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    exact congrArg (fun L : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ => L w) ((hg.hasFDerivAt.add hk.hasFDerivAt).fderiv)
  have lapsplit : ∀ (f g k : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ k (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), f η = g η + k η) →
      lap0 B.h f ξ = lap0 B.h g ξ + lap0 B.h k ξ := by
    intro f g k hg hk hfgk
    have hR : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dR B.h f η = dR B.h g η + dR B.h k η := fun η hη =>
      split f g k η _ hη hfgk (hdiff g hg η hη) (hdiff k hk η hη)
    have hZ : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dZ f η = dZ g η + dZ k η := fun η hη =>
      split f g k η _ hη hfgk (hdiff g hg η hη) (hdiff k hk η hη)
    have hRR : dR B.h (dR B.h f) ξ = dR B.h (dR B.h g) ξ + dR B.h (dR B.h k) ξ :=
      split _ _ _ ξ _ hξ hR (hdiff _ (hcl g hg).1 ξ hξ) (hdiff _ (hcl k hk).1 ξ hξ)
    have hZZ : dZ (dZ f) ξ = dZ (dZ g) ξ + dZ (dZ k) ξ :=
      split _ _ _ ξ _ hξ hZ (hdiff _ (hcl g hg).2.1 ξ hξ) (hdiff _ (hcl k hk).2.1 ξ hξ)
    unfold lap0
    rw [hRR, hZZ, hR ξ hξ]
    ring
  have hT : dT (mcor5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 0) ξ =
      dT (mcor5 B G l0 S 0) ξ + dT (momDbP B dPsi) ξ :=
    split _ _ _ ξ _ hξ (fun η hη => (hmean η hη).1) (hdiff _ (hmc 0) ξ hξ) (hdiff _ hdb ξ hξ)
  have hR : dR B.h (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 0 η +
        mcor5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 0 η ^ 2 + Wcov5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 0 0 η) ξ =
      dR B.h (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η ^ 2 +
        Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 0 η) ξ +
      dR B.h (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 0 * momDbP B dPsi η + 2 * mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * momDbP B dPsi η +
        momDbP B dPsi η ^ 2) ξ := by
    refine split _ _ _ ξ _ hξ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro η hη
      obtain ⟨m0, -, -, mW⟩ := hmean η hη
      simp only [m0, mW]
      ring
    · apply hdiff _ _ ξ hξ
      exact (((contDiffOn_const.mul (hub 0)).mul (hmc 0)).add ((hmc 0).pow 2)).add (hW 0 0)
    · apply hdiff _ _ ξ hξ
      exact (((contDiffOn_const.mul (hub 0)).mul hdb).add
        ((contDiffOn_const.mul (hmc 0)).mul hdb)).add (hdb.pow 2)
  have hZ : dZ (fun η => ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 2 η +
        ubase B η 2 * mcor5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 0 η +
        mcor5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 0 η * mcor5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 2 η +
        Wcov5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 2 0 η) ξ =
      dZ (fun η => ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + ubase B η 2 * mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η +
        mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 0 η) ξ +
      dZ (fun η => ubase B η 0 * momDgP B dPsi η + ubase B η 2 * momDbP B dPsi η +
        mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * momDgP B dPsi η + mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η * momDbP B dPsi η +
        momDbP B dPsi η * momDgP B dPsi η) ξ := by
    refine split _ _ _ ξ _ hξ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro η hη
      obtain ⟨m0, -, m2, mW⟩ := hmean η hη
      simp only [m0, m2, mW]
      ring
    · apply hdiff _ _ ξ hξ
      exact ((((hub 0).mul (hmc 2)).add ((hub 2).mul (hmc 0))).add ((hmc 0).mul (hmc 2))).add (hW 2 0)
    · apply hdiff _ _ ξ hξ
      exact (((((hub 0).mul hdg).add ((hub 2).mul hdb)).add ((hmc 0).mul hdg)).add
        ((hmc 2).mul hdb)).add (hdb.mul hdg)
  have hL : lap0 B.h (mcor5 B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 0) ξ =
      lap0 B.h (mcor5 B G l0 S 0) ξ + lap0 B.h (momDbP B dPsi) ξ :=
    lapsplit _ _ _ (hmc 0) hdb (fun η hη => (hmean η hη).1)
  obtain ⟨m0, m1, m2, mW⟩ := hmean ξ hξ
  simp only [grP5, momDg5, momRg5]
  rw [hT, hR, hZ, hL]
  simp only [m0, m1, m2, mW]
  ring

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hSN

  obtain ⟨hMc, -⟩ := mom_class_algebra_v4 B (qsOf l0) hok hqs0 hqs1
  have hk : kapS = 1 / 100000 := rfl
  have h09 : (0.9 : ℝ) = 9 / 10 := by norm_num

  have hexp : ∀ (c e e' : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) c (nrm B e f) → e = e' →

      r ∉ Set.Icc a b → XC B.h (r, z, t, W) < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h (r, z, t, W) := by
    intro z t ht
    have hq : 0 < simScale B.h z (1 - t) := (hok.1.1 z (1 - t) (by linarith)).1
    refine ⟨Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h z (1 - t)), Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xb * simScale B.h z (1 - t)),
      Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity), ?_⟩
    intro r W hr hn
    have hX : XC B.h (r, z, t, W) = r ^ 2 / (2 * simScale B.h z (1 - t)) := rfl
    rw [hX]
    rw [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or] at hn
    rcases hn with h1 | h1
    · left
      have h1' : r < Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h z (1 - t)) := not_le.mp h1
      have h2 := (Real.lt_sqrt hr.le).mp h1'
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      linarith
    · right
      have h1' : Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xb * simScale B.h z (1 - t)) < r := not_le.mp h1
      have h2 := (Real.sqrt_lt' hr).mp h1'
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      linarith
  
  have mem : ∀ (r z t : ℝ) (W : ℝ × ℝ), 0 < r → t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 →
      ((r, z, t, W) : Cyl) ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := by
    intro r z t W hr ht hq
    show 0 < r ∧ t < 1 ∧ qC B.h (r, z, t, W) < qsOf l0
    exact ⟨hr, ht, hq⟩
  
  have curve : ∀ (F : Cyl → ℝ) (z t : ℝ) (W : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ), t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 →
      ContinuousOn F (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → F ξ = 0) →
      ContinuousOn W (Set.Ioi 0) →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun r : ℝ => F (r, z, t, W r)) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    intro F z t W ht hq hF hFv hW
    obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hsh⟩ := shell z t ht
    have hsub : Set.Icc a b ⊆ Set.Ioi 0 := fun r hr => lt_of_lt_of_le ha hr.1
    have hcc : ContinuousOn (fun r : ℝ => ((r, z, t, W r) : Cyl)) (Set.Icc a b) :=
      continuousOn_id.prodMk (continuousOn_const.prodMk (continuousOn_const.prodMk (hW.mono hsub)))
    have hI : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun r : ℝ => F (r, z, t, W r)) (Set.Icc a b) := by
      apply ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc
      exact hF.comp hcc (fun r hr => mem r z t (W r) (hsub hr) ht hq)
    refine hI.of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi ?_
    intro r hr
    exact hFv _ (mem r z t (W r) hr.1 ht hq) (hsh r (W r) hr.1 hr.2)
  
  have yavg : ∀ (F : Cyl → ℝ) (z t : ℝ), t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 →
      ContinuousOn F (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → F ξ = 0) →
      (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => F (r, z, t, Y))
        (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)) ∧
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun r : ℝ => yAvg F (r, z, t, 0)) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    intro F z t ht hq hF hFv
    obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hsh⟩ := shell z t ht
    have hcomp : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    refine ⟨fun r hr => ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hcont : Continuous (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => F (r, z, t, Y)) :=
        hF.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk
          (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))) (fun Y => mem r z t Y hr ht hq)
      exact hcont.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hcomp
    · let f : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun r Y => F (max r a, z, t, Y)
      have hf : Continuous (Function.uncurry f) :=
        hF.comp_continuous ((continuous_fst.max continuous_const).prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk
          (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_snd)))
          (fun p => mem (max p.1 a) z t p.2 (lt_of_lt_of_le ha (le_max_right _ _)) ht hq)
      have hΦ : Continuous (fun r : ℝ => ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, f r Y) :=
        continuous_parametric_integral_of_continuous hf hcomp
      have hI : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun r : ℝ => yAvg F (r, z, t, 0)) (Set.Icc a b) := by
        apply ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc
        refine hΦ.continuousOn.congr ?_
        intro r hr
        show (∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, F (r, z, t, Y)) =
          ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, F (max r a, z, t, Y)
        rw [max_eq_left hr.1]
      refine hI.of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi ?_
      intro r hr
      show (∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, F (r, z, t, Y)) = 0
      have h0 : ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, F (r, z, t, Y) = 0 := fun Y =>
        hFv _ (mem r z t Y hr.1 ht hq) (hsh r Y hr.1 hr.2)
      simp only [h0, MeasureTheory.integral_zero]
  
  have icut_add : ∀ (k k1 k2 : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl), 0 < ξ.1 →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun r' : ℝ => k1 (pathPt B.h ξ r')) (Set.Ioi 0) →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun r' : ℝ => k2 (pathPt B.h ξ r')) (Set.Ioi 0) →
      (∀ r' : ℝ, 0 < r' → k (pathPt B.h ξ r') = k1 (pathPt B.h ξ r') + k2 (pathPt B.h ξ r')) →
      Icut B k ξ = Icut B k1 ξ + Icut B k2 ξ := by
    intro k k1 k2 ξ hξ h1 h2 hk
    have e1 : (∫ r' in (0:ℝ)..ξ.1, k (pathPt B.h ξ r')) =
        (∫ r' in (0:ℝ)..ξ.1, k1 (pathPt B.h ξ r')) + ∫ r' in (0:ℝ)..ξ.1, k2 (pathPt B.h ξ r') := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hξ.le, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hξ.le,
        intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hξ.le]
      rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun
        (g := fun r' => k1 (pathPt B.h ξ r') + k2 (pathPt B.h ξ r')) measurableSet_Ioc
        (fun r' hr' => hk r' hr'.1)]
      exact MeasureTheory.integral_add (h1.mono_set Set.Ioc_subset_Ioi_self)
        (h2.mono_set Set.Ioc_subset_Ioi_self)
    have e2 : (∫ r' in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), k (pathPt B.h ξ r')) =
        (∫ r' in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), k1 (pathPt B.h ξ r')) + ∫ r' in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), k2 (pathPt B.h ξ r') := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun
        (g := fun r' => k1 (pathPt B.h ξ r') + k2 (pathPt B.h ξ r')) measurableSet_Ioi
        (fun r' hr' => hk r' hr')]
      exact MeasureTheory.integral_add h1 h2
    unfold Icut
    rw [e1, e2]
    ring
  
  have rad_add : ∀ (F F2 K : Cyl → ℝ) (z t : ℝ),
      (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => F (r, z, t, Y))
        (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)) →
      (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => F2 (r, z, t, Y))
        (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)) →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun r : ℝ => yAvg F (r, z, t, 0)) (Set.Ioi 0) →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun r : ℝ => yAvg F2 (r, z, t, 0)) (Set.Ioi 0) →
      (∀ (r : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), 0 < r → K (r, z, t, Y) = F (r, z, t, Y) + F2 (r, z, t, Y)) →
      radMom K 0 z t = radMom F 0 z t + radMom F2 0 z t := by
    intro F F2 K z t hF1 hG1 hF2 hG2 hK
    have hpt : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → yAvg K (r, z, t, 0) = yAvg F (r, z, t, 0) + yAvg F2 (r, z, t, 0) := by
      intro r hr
      show (∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, K (r, z, t, Y)) =
        (∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, F (r, z, t, Y)) +
          ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, F2 (r, z, t, Y)
      rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun (g := fun Y => F (r, z, t, Y) + F2 (r, z, t, Y))
        (measurableSet_Icc.prod measurableSet_Icc) (fun Y _ => hK r Y hr)]
      exact MeasureTheory.integral_add (hF1 r hr) (hG1 r hr)
    unfold radMom
    simp only [pow_zero, one_mul]
    rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun (g := fun r => yAvg F (r, z, t, 0) + yAvg F2 (r, z, t, 0))
      measurableSet_Ioi (fun r hr => hpt r hr)]
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_add hF2 hG2
  
  have hA : ∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 →
      calP5 B G l0 S' z t = calP5 B G l0 S z t + radMom g 0 z t := by
    intro z t ht hq
    obtain ⟨hF1, hF2⟩ := yavg (grP5 B G l0 S) z t ht hq hc (fun ξ hξ hX => (hvan ξ hξ hX).1)
    obtain ⟨hG1, hG2⟩ := yavg g z t ht hq hgc (fun ξ hξ hX => (hvan ξ hξ hX).2)
    exact rad_add _ _ _ z t hF1 hG1 hF2 hG2 (fun r Y hr => hS' _ (mem r z t Y hr ht hq))
  refine ⟨hA, fun ξ hξ => ?_⟩
  have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
  obtain ⟨hr0, ht, hq⟩ := hξ'
  have hq' : simScale B.h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) < qsOf l0 := hq
  have hW : ContinuousOn (fun r' : ℝ => ξ.2.2.2 + (r' ^ drx B.h - ξ.1 ^ drx B.h) • vrv) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    continuousOn_const.add (((continuousOn_id.rpow_const
      (fun x hx => Or.inl (Set.mem_Ioi.mp hx).ne')).sub continuousOn_const).smul continuousOn_const)
  have Ig : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun r' : ℝ => grP5 B G l0 S (pathPt B.h ξ r')) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    curve _ ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 _ ht hq' hc (fun η hη hX => (hvan η hη hX).1) hW
  have Iγ : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun r' : ℝ => g (pathPt B.h ξ r')) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    curve _ ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 _ ht hq' hgc (fun η hη hX => (hvan η hη hX).2) hW
  have Iρ : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun r' : ℝ => rhoP B (pathPt B.h ξ r')) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
    have hsq : 0 < Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq0
    have hm1 : 0 < B.m1 := lt_trans hXa hXam1
    have hw : 0 < (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2 := by
      have := Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by linarith) (by linarith : 2 * B.m1 < 2 * B.m2)
      linarith
    set c : ℝ := (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2 with hc_def
    set w : ℝ := (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2 with hw_def
    have e : (fun r' : ℝ => rhoP B (pathPt B.h ξ r')) =
        fun r' : ℝ => qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * rhoHat B (r' / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ)) := rfl
    rw [e]
    have hb : Continuous bumpR := by
      unfold bumpR
      exact Real.smoothTransition.continuous.comp (continuous_const.sub (continuous_id.pow 2))
    have hrh : Continuous (rhoHat B) := by
      unfold rhoHat
      exact (hb.comp ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).div_const _)).div_const _
    have hcont : Continuous (fun r' : ℝ => qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * rhoHat B (r' / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))) :=
      continuous_const.mul (hrh.comp (continuous_id.div_const _))
    have hbz : ∀ u : ℝ, 1 ≤ |u| → bumpR u = 0 := by
      intro u hu
      unfold bumpR
      apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
      have h2 := sq_abs u
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg u]
    have hrz : ∀ s : ℝ, w ≤ |s - c| → rhoHat B s = 0 := by
      intro s hs
      show bumpR ((s - c) / w) / (∫ u in (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1))..(Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)),
        bumpR ((u - c) / w)) = 0
      rw [hbz _ (by rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hw, le_div_iff₀ hw, one_mul]; exact hs), zero_div]
    have hI : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun r' : ℝ => qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * rhoHat B (r' / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ)))
        (Set.Icc ((c - w) * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ)) ((c + w) * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))) :=
      hcont.continuousOn.integrableOn_Icc
    refine hI.of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi ?_
    intro r hr
    have hn := hr.2
    rw [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or] at hn
    rw [hrz _ ?_, mul_zero]
    rcases hn with h1 | h1
    · have h2 : r / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) < c - w := (div_lt_iff₀ hsq).mpr (not_le.mp h1)
      rw [abs_sub_comm]
      exact le_abs.mpr (Or.inl (by linarith))
    · have h2 : c + w < r / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := (lt_div_iff₀ hsq).mpr (not_le.mp h1)
      exact le_abs.mpr (Or.inl (by linarith))
  have I1 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun r' : ℝ =>
      (fun η => grP5 B G l0 S η - rhoP B η * calP5 B G l0 S η.2.1 η.2.2.1) (pathPt B.h ξ r'))
      (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    Ig.sub (Iρ.mul_const (calP5 B G l0 S ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1))
  have I2 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun r' : ℝ => momDgt B g (pathPt B.h ξ r')) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    Iγ.sub (Iρ.mul_const (radMom g 0 ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1))
  have key : ∀ r' : ℝ, 0 < r' → pathPt B.h ξ r' ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := fun r' hr' =>
    mem r' ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 _ hr' ht hq'
  have hm := hA ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 ht hq'
  have hpt1 : ∀ r' : ℝ, 0 < r' →
      (fun η => grP5 B G l0 S' η - rhoP B η * calP5 B G l0 S' η.2.1 η.2.2.1) (pathPt B.h ξ r') =
      (fun η => grP5 B G l0 S η - rhoP B η * calP5 B G l0 S η.2.1 η.2.2.1) (pathPt B.h ξ r') +
        momDgt B g (pathPt B.h ξ r') := by
    intro r' hr'
    show grP5 B G l0 S' (pathPt B.h ξ r') - rhoP B (pathPt B.h ξ r') * calP5 B G l0 S' ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 =
      (grP5 B G l0 S (pathPt B.h ξ r') - rhoP B (pathPt B.h ξ r') * calP5 B G l0 S ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1) +
        (g (pathPt B.h ξ r') - rhoP B (pathPt B.h ξ r') * radMom g 0 ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1)
    rw [hS' _ (key r' hr'), hm]
    ring
  have B1' := icut_add (fun η => grP5 B G l0 S' η - rhoP B η * calP5 B G l0 S' η.2.1 η.2.2.1)
    (fun η => grP5 B G l0 S η - rhoP B η * calP5 B G l0 S η.2.1 η.2.2.1) (momDgt B g) ξ hr0 I1 I2 hpt1
  have B1 : pmP5 B G l0 S' ξ - pmP5 B G l0 S ξ = Icut B (momDgt B g) ξ := by
    unfold pmP5
    rw [B1']
    ring
  have hpt2 : ∀ r' : ℝ, 0 < r' →
      (fun η => (grP5 B G l0 S' η - grP5 B G l0 S η) - rhoP B η *
        (calP5 B G l0 S' η.2.1 η.2.2.1 - calP5 B G l0 S η.2.1 η.2.2.1)) (pathPt B.h ξ r') =
      momDgt B g (pathPt B.h ξ r') + (fun _ : Cyl => (0:ℝ)) (pathPt B.h ξ r') := by
    intro r' hr'
    show (grP5 B G l0 S' (pathPt B.h ξ r') - grP5 B G l0 S (pathPt B.h ξ r')) - rhoP B (pathPt B.h ξ r') *
        (calP5 B G l0 S' ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 - calP5 B G l0 S ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1) =
      (g (pathPt B.h ξ r') - rhoP B (pathPt B.h ξ r') * radMom g 0 ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1) + 0
    rw [hS' _ (key r' hr'), hm]
    ring
  have hz : Icut B (fun _ : Cyl => (0:ℝ)) ξ = 0 := by simp [Icut]
  have B2' := icut_add (fun η => (grP5 B G l0 S' η - grP5 B G l0 S η) - rhoP B η *
        (calP5 B G l0 S' η.2.1 η.2.2.1 - calP5 B G l0 S η.2.1 η.2.2.1)) (momDgt B g)
    (fun _ : Cyl => (0:ℝ)) ξ hr0 I2 MeasureTheory.integrableOn_zero hpt2
  refine ⟨B1, ?_⟩
  rw [B1, B2', hz, add_zero]

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lm, hlm⟩ := mom_mean_update_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, hXa, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨lm + n0, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 S bw ca cm cd α dPsi dv hSt hshP hshv hP hv
  
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqs0 : 0 < qsOf l0 := by rw [hQb]; positivity
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by rw [hQb]; exact pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hqB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0.le
  
  obtain ⟨hDo, hqCs, hqC0, -, hCl, hSVd⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  obtain ⟨-, hub, hmS, hWS, -⟩ := state_cyl_smooth_v5 B G l0 S bw ca cm cd hok hG hqB hSt
  have hWv := wcov5_shell_vanish B G l0 S bw ca cm cd hok hqB hSt
  have hMM := hlm l0 (by omega) S bw ca cm cd dPsi dv hSt hshP hshv hP.1 hv.1
  have hdPsi := hP.1
  have hdv := hv.1
  have hmemD : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 :=
    fun ξ hξ => hξ
  have hSt' := hSt
  unfold StOrd5 at hSt'
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, hm1, hm2, -, hm0, -, -⟩ := hSt'
  have keyV : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (α' : ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) α' (nrm B (Aex B.h) f) →

    obtain ⟨_, _, hq⟩ := hmemD ξ hξ
