informal_problem.statement:
{P E' F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ P] [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace ℝ E'] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E']
    [MeasurableSpace E'] [BorelSpace E'] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E') [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ]
    (U : Set P) (V K : Set E') (G : P → E' → F) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKV : K ⊆ V) (hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => G z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V)) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) x =
      ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ)

signature.name: param_integral_contDiff
signature.statement:
{P E' F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ P] [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace ℝ E'] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E']
    [MeasurableSpace E'] [BorelSpace E'] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E') [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ]
    (U : Set P) (V K : Set E') (G : P → E' → F) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKV : K ⊆ V) (hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => G z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V)) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) x =
      ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hO : IsOpen (U ×ˢ V) := hU.prod hV
  have hKm : MeasurableSet K := hK.isClosed.measurableSet
  
  have slice : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F'] (H : P → E' → F'),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) →
      ∀ x ∈ U, ContinuousOn (fun y => H x y) K := by
    intro F' _ _ H hH x hx
    have hc : Continuous (fun y : E' => ((x, y) : P × E')) := by fun_prop
    have h := ContinuousOn.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (f := fun y : E' => ((x, y) : P × E'))
      hH.continuousOn hc.continuousOn (fun y hy => ⟨hx, hKV hy⟩)
    exact h
  
  have param_fderiv : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F'] (H : P → E' → F'),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => H x' z.2) z.1) (U ×ˢ V) := by
    intro F' _ _ H hH p hp
    have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) p := hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hp)
    apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry (fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2)) (p, p.1) := by
      have e : Function.uncurry (fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2) =
          (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) ∘ (fun w : (P × E') × P => (w.2, w.1.2)) := rfl
      rw [e]
      apply ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (p, p.1)
      · simpa using hHa
      · fun_prop
    exact ContDiffAt.fderiv (f := fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2)
      (g := Prod.fst) h1 contDiffAt_fst (le_of_eq ENat.coe_top_add_one)
  
  have param_hasFDeriv : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F']
      (H : P → E' → F'), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) → ∀ x ∈ U,
      HasFDerivAt (fun x' => ∫ y in K, H x' y ∂μ) (∫ y in K, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => H x' y) x ∂μ) x := by
    intro F' _ _ H hH x hx
    have hHs := param_fderiv H hH
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU x hx
    have hsU : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ⊆ U :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
    have hsn : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ∈ nhds x := Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds x (by linarith)
    have hC : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ×ˢ K) := (isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod hK
    have hCsub : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ×ˢ K ⊆ U ×ˢ V := fun z hz => ⟨hsU hz.1, hKV hz.2⟩
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hC.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hHs.continuousOn.mono hCsub)
    refine hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (μ := μ.restrict K)
      (F := fun x' y => H x' y) (F' := fun x' y => fderiv ℝ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x')
      (bound := fun _ => B) hsn ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hx] with x' hx'
      exact (slice H hH x' hx').aestronglyMeasurable_of_isCompact hK hKm
    · exact (slice H hH x hx).integrableOn_compact hK
    · exact (slice (fun x' y => fderiv ℝ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x') hHs x hx).aestronglyMeasurable_of_isCompact
        hK hKm
    · exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hKm (fun y hy x' hx' => hB (x', y) ⟨hx', hy⟩)
    · exact continuousOn_const.integrableOn_compact hK
    · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hKm (fun y hy x' hx' => ?_)
      have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (x', y) :=
        hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds ⟨hsU hx', hKV hy⟩)
      have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x'' : P => ((x'', y) : P × E')) x' := by fun_prop
      have h2 := ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) x' hHa hc
      have : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x' := h2
      exact (this.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
  
  have hD0 : ∀ x y, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun x' => G x' y) x =
      (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm (G x y) := by
    intro x y; rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp]; rfl
  have hDs : ∀ (k : ℕ) x y, iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) (fun x' => G x' y) x =
      (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm
        (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') x) := by
    intro k x y; rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left]; rfl
  have D_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) (U ×ˢ V) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      have e : (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) =
          (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm ∘ (fun z : P × E' => G z.1 z.2) := by
        funext z; exact hD0 z.1 z.2
      rw [e]
      exact (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hG
    | succ k ih =>
      have e : (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) =
          (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm ∘
            (fun z : P × E' => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' z.2) x') z.1) := by
        funext z; exact hDs k z.1 z.2
      rw [e]
      have h2 := param_fderiv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') ih
      exact (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h2
  
  have formula : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) x =
      ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro x _
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp (f := fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ)]
      simp only [hD0]
      exact (ContinuousLinearEquiv.integral_comp_comm
        (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv (fun y => G x y)).symm
    | succ k ih =>
      intro x hx
      have hα : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) =ᶠ[nhds x]
          (fun x' => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x' ∂μ) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hx) ih
      have hβ := (param_hasFDeriv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x')
        (D_smooth k) x hx).fderiv
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left (f := fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ), Function.comp_apply,
        hα.fderiv_eq, hβ]
      simp only [hDs]
      have hL := ContinuousLinearEquiv.integral_comp_comm (μ := μ.restrict K) (𝕜 := ℝ)
        (E := P →L[ℝ] ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => P) F)
        (F := ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F)
        (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv
        (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') x)
      exact hL.symm
  
  have hsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U := by
    have key : ∀ m : ℕ, EqOn (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U)
        (fun x => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ) U := by
      intro m x hx
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hU hx]
      exact formula m x hx
    have hdiff : ∀ m : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℝ
        (fun x => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ) U :=
      fun m x hx => (param_hasFDeriv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x'' => G x'' y) x')
        (D_smooth m) x hx).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    exact contDiffOn_of_continuousOn_differentiableOn (n := ⊤)
      (fun m _ => ((hdiff m).continuousOn).congr (key m))
      (fun m _ => (hdiff m).congr (key m))
  exact ⟨hsmooth, formula⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(h : ℝ) (hS : SimScaleProps h) (hN : SimNorm h) (i : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → simScale h z (1 - t) ≤ 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun u : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (simScale h (z + simScale h z (1 - t) ^ (1/2 - h) * u.1)
        (1 - (t + simScale h z (1 - t) * u.2)) / simScale h z (1 - t))) 0‖ ≤ M

signature.name: simnorm_sqrt_ratio_bound
signature.statement:
(h : ℝ) (hS : SimScaleProps h) (hN : SimNorm h) (i : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → simScale h z (1 - t) ≤ 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun u : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (simScale h (z + simScale h z (1 - t) ^ (1/2 - h) * u.1)
        (1 - (t + simScale h z (1 - t) * u.2)) / simScale h z (1 - t))) 0‖ ≤ M

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨hS1, -, -, hS4, -⟩ := hS
  choose C hC using hN
  
  set A : ℝ := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), |Polynomial.eval (1/2 : ℝ) (descPochhammer ℝ k)| with hAdef
  set D : ℝ := 1 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), |C k| with hDdef
  have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by
    have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k (_ : k ∈ Finset.range (i + 1)) => abs_nonneg (C k))
    linarith
  have hA : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ i →
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1/2 : ℝ)) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) 1‖ ≤ A := by
    intro k hk
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k isOpen_Ioi (show (1:ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) from Set.mem_Ioi.mpr one_pos),
      norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate,
      Real.iter_deriv_rpow_const, Real.one_rpow, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => |Polynomial.eval (1/2 : ℝ) (descPochhammer ℝ k)|)
      (fun k _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk))
  refine ⟨(i.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ i, fun z t ht hq1 => ?_⟩
  have hτ : 0 < 1 - t := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hq0, -⟩ := hS1 z (1 - t) hτ
  obtain ⟨q, hqd⟩ : ∃ q, q = simScale h z (1 - t) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCq : ∀ k : ℕ, ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (z, 1 - t)).compContinuousLinearMap
      (fun _ => (q ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
                (q • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖ ≤ C k * q := by
    intro k
    rw [hqd]
    exact hC k z (1 - t) hτ hq1
  rw [← hqd] at hq0 hq1 ⊢
  
  have hpa : 0 < q ^ (1/2 - h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _
  let e₁ : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 (q ^ (1/2 - h)) hpa.ne')
  let e₂ : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 (-q) (neg_ne_zero.mpr hq0.ne'))
  let L : (ℝ × ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) := e₁.prodCongr e₂
  let M : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 q⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero hq0.ne'))
  have hL : ∀ x : ℝ × ℝ, L x = (q ^ (1/2 - h) * x.1, -q * x.2) := by
    intro x
    apply Prod.ext <;> (simp [L, e₁, e₂]; try ring)
  have hM : ∀ y : ℝ, M y = q⁻¹ * y := by
    intro y
    simp [M, mul_comm]
  have hMn : ‖(M : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ ≤ q⁻¹ := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le) fun y => ?_
    show ‖M y‖ ≤ q⁻¹ * ‖y‖
    rw [hM, norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs q⁻¹, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hq0)]
  let σ : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ := (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (-ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)
  have hσ : ‖σ‖ ≤ 1 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun x => ?_)
    rw [one_mul]
    simp [σ, Prod.norm_def]
  have hLclm : (L : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ) =
      ((q ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (q • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)).comp σ := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    simp only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe]
    rw [hL]
    apply Prod.ext <;> (simp [σ]; try ring)
  have hw1 : ∀ u : ℝ × ℝ, (((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) + L u).1 = z + q ^ (1/2 - h) * u.1 := by
    intro u
    simp only [Prod.fst_add, hL]
  have hw2 : ∀ u : ℝ × ℝ, (((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) + L u).2 = 1 - (t + q * u.2) := by
    intro u
    simp only [Prod.snd_add, hL]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨Qf, hQfd⟩ : ∃ Qf : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, Qf = M ∘ ((fun v : ℝ × ℝ =>
      simScale h (((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) + v).1 (((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) + v).2) ∘ L) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨O, hOd⟩ : ∃ O : Set (ℝ × ℝ), O = (fun u : ℝ × ℝ => ((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) + L u) ⁻¹'
      (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hUo : IsOpen (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
  have hO : IsOpen O := by
    rw [hOd]
    exact hUo.preimage (continuous_const.add L.continuous)
  have h0O : (0 : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ O := by
    rw [hOd]
    show ((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) + L 0 ∈ Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)
    rw [map_zero, add_zero]
    exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, hτ⟩
  have hQs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Qf O := by
    rw [hQfd, hOd]
    exact M.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn
      (hS4.comp (contDiff_const.add L.contDiff).contDiffOn (fun u hu => hu))
  have hQpos : ∀ u ∈ O, 0 < Qf u := by
    intro u hu
    rw [hOd] at hu
    rw [hQfd]
    show 0 < M (simScale h (((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) + L u).1 (((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) + L u).2)
    rw [hM]
    exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hq0) (hS1 _ _ hu.2).1
  have hQ0 : Qf 0 = 1 := by
    rw [hQfd]
    show M (simScale h (((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) + L 0).1 (((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) + L 0).2) = 1
    rw [hM, map_zero, add_zero]
    show q⁻¹ * simScale h z (1 - t) = 1
    rw [← hqd]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0.ne'
  have hfun : (fun u : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (simScale h (z + q ^ (1/2 - h) * u.1)
      (1 - (t + q * u.2)) / q)) = (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1/2 : ℝ)) ∘ Qf := by
    funext u
    rw [hQfd]
    show Real.sqrt (simScale h (z + q ^ (1/2 - h) * u.1) (1 - (t + q * u.2)) / q) =
      (M (simScale h (((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) + L u).1 (((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) + L u).2)) ^ (1/2 : ℝ)
    rw [hM, hw1 u, hw2 u, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, div_eq_inv_mul]
  
  have hK : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ i → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k Qf O 0‖ ≤ D ^ k := by
    intro k hk1 hki
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hO h0O, hQfd, M.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left]
    have hcomp : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((fun v : ℝ × ℝ =>
        simScale h (((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) + v).1 (((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) + v).2) ∘ L) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun v : ℝ × ℝ =>
          simScale h (((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) + v).1 (((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) + v).2) (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ))) := by
      have := L.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right (fun v : ℝ × ℝ =>
          simScale h (((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) + v).1 (((z, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) + v).2)
        uniqueDiffOn_univ (Set.mem_univ (L 0)) k
      rwa [Set.preimage_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ] at this
    rw [hcomp, map_zero, iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (f := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2),
      add_zero, hLclm]
    have hsplit : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (z, 1 - t)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => ((q ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
          (q • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)).comp σ) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (z, 1 - t)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => (q ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
            (q • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => σ) :=
      ContinuousMultilinearMap.ext (fun m => rfl)
    rw [hsplit]
    have hX := hCq k
    have hX0 : 0 ≤ C k * q := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) hX
    have hY : ‖((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (z, 1 - t)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => (q ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
            (q • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => σ)‖ ≤ C k * q := by
      refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      calc _ ≤ (C k * q) * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul hX (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hσ) (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _) hX0
        _ = C k * q := mul_one _
    have hCk : |C k| ≤ D := by
      have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => |C k|) (fun k _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hki))
      linarith
    calc _ ≤ ‖(M : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ * (C k * q) :=
          le_trans (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _)
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hY (norm_nonneg _))
      _ ≤ q⁻¹ * (C k * q) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hMn hX0
      _ = C k := by field_simp
      _ ≤ D ^ k := (le_abs_self _).trans (hCk.trans (le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)))
  
  have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1/2 : ℝ)) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    (contDiffOn_id (s := Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))).rpow_const_of_ne (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
  have hA' : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ i →
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1/2 : ℝ)) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) (Qf 0)‖ ≤ A := by
    intro k hk
    rw [hQ0]
    exact hA k hk
  have key := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hg hQs (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn hO.uniqueDiffOn (fun u hu => hQpos u hu) h0O (C := A) (D := D) hA' hK
  rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO h0O] at key
  rw [hfun]
  exact key

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨hS, hBP⟩ := hB
  obtain ⟨-, -, hXa, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, haa, hab⟩ := hBP.1
  
  have core : ∀ (c δ d : ℝ) (m : ℕ), 0 < c → 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → d ≤ 2 * (m:ℝ) →
      Real.exp (-(c / δ ^ 2)) * δ ^ (-d) ≤ (m.factorial : ℝ) / c ^ m := by
    intro c δ d m hc hδ hδ1 hd
    have h1 : δ ^ (-d) ≤ δ ^ (-(2 * (m:ℝ))) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hδ hδ1 (by linarith)
    have h2 : δ ^ (-(2 * (m:ℝ))) = (1 / δ ^ 2) ^ m := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg hδ.le, Real.rpow_mul hδ.le, Real.rpow_two, Real.rpow_natCast, one_div,
        inv_pow]
    have hx : 0 ≤ c * (1 / δ ^ 2) := by positivity
    have h3 := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (c * (1 / δ ^ 2)) hx m
    have hfac : (0:ℝ) < m.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos m
    have hcm : (0:ℝ) < c ^ m := pow_pos hc m
    have he : Real.exp (-(c / δ ^ 2)) = Real.exp (-(c * (1 / δ ^ 2))) := by rw [mul_one_div]
    have hee : Real.exp (-(c * (1 / δ ^ 2))) * Real.exp (c * (1 / δ ^ 2)) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
    calc Real.exp (-(c / δ ^ 2)) * δ ^ (-d) ≤ Real.exp (-(c / δ ^ 2)) * (1 / δ ^ 2) ^ m := by
          rw [← h2]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = (m.factorial : ℝ) / c ^ m *
            (Real.exp (-(c * (1 / δ ^ 2))) * ((c * (1 / δ ^ 2)) ^ m / m.factorial)) := by
          rw [he, mul_pow]; field_simp
      _ ≤ (m.factorial : ℝ) / c ^ m *
            (Real.exp (-(c * (1 / δ ^ 2))) * Real.exp (c * (1 / δ ^ 2))) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = (m.factorial : ℝ) / c ^ m := by rw [hee, mul_one]
  
  have edge : ∀ d : ℝ, ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ X : ℝ, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb →
      edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ^ (-d) ≤ M := by
    intro d
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, m = ⌈d / 2⌉₊ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hdm : d ≤ 2 * (m:ℝ) := by
      have := Nat.le_ceil (d / 2); rw [← hm] at this; linarith
    have hfa : 0 ≤ (m.factorial : ℝ) / B.aa ^ m := by positivity
    have hfb : 0 ≤ (m.factorial : ℝ) / B.ab ^ m := by positivity
    refine ⟨1 + (m.factorial : ℝ) / B.aa ^ m + (m.factorial : ℝ) / B.ab ^ m, by linarith, ?_⟩
    intro X hX1 hX2
    have hX0 : 0 < X := lt_trans hXa hX1
    have hda : 0 < Real.log (X / B.Xa) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX1)
    have hdb : 0 < Real.log (B.Xb / X) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr hX2)
    have hEW : edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X =
        Real.exp (-(B.aa / Real.log (X / B.Xa) ^ 2) - B.ab / Real.log (B.Xb / X) ^ 2) := by
      unfold edgeWeight; rw [if_pos ⟨hX1, hX2⟩]
    have hta : 0 ≤ B.aa / Real.log (X / B.Xa) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have htb : 0 ≤ B.ab / Real.log (B.Xb / X) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hED1 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
    rcases min_choice 1 (min (Real.log (X / B.Xa)) (Real.log (B.Xb / X))) with h | h
    · have hE : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X = 1 := h
      rw [hE, Real.one_rpow, mul_one, hEW]
      have : Real.exp (-(B.aa / Real.log (X / B.Xa) ^ 2) - B.ab / Real.log (B.Xb / X) ^ 2) ≤ 1 :=
        Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)
      linarith
    · rcases min_choice (Real.log (X / B.Xa)) (Real.log (B.Xb / X)) with h' | h'
      · have hE : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X = Real.log (X / B.Xa) := by
          unfold edgeDist; rw [h, h']
        have hle1 : Real.log (X / B.Xa) ≤ 1 := by rw [← hE]; exact hED1
        calc edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ^ (-d)
            ≤ Real.exp (-(B.aa / Real.log (X / B.Xa) ^ 2)) * Real.log (X / B.Xa) ^ (-d) := by
              rw [hEW, hE]
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Real.rpow_nonneg hda.le _)
              exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
          _ ≤ (m.factorial : ℝ) / B.aa ^ m := core _ _ _ _ haa hda hle1 hdm
          _ ≤ _ := by linarith
      · have hE : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X = Real.log (B.Xb / X) := by
          unfold edgeDist; rw [h, h']
        have hle1 : Real.log (B.Xb / X) ≤ 1 := by rw [← hE]; exact hED1
        calc edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ^ (-d)
            ≤ Real.exp (-(B.ab / Real.log (B.Xb / X) ^ 2)) * Real.log (B.Xb / X) ^ (-d) := by
              rw [hEW, hE]
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Real.rpow_nonneg hdb.le _)
              exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
          _ ≤ (m.factorial : ℝ) / B.ab ^ m := core _ _ _ _ hab hdb hle1 hdm
          _ ≤ _ := by linarith
  
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hf4⟩ := hf
  choose Cc bb dd hCbd using hf4
  choose M hM0 hM using fun j => edge (dd j)
  refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cc i| * M i, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i|, ?_⟩
  
  intro ξ hξ hX1 hX2 j hj
  have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qs := hξ
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ'.2.1])).1
  have hjr : j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
  have hP : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
  have hL1 : 1 ≤ 1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| := by
    have := abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ)); linarith
  have hS1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
    show 1 ≤ (1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)|) ^ 2
    nlinarith
  have hbj : bb j ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i| :=
    le_trans (le_abs_self _)
      (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |bb i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) hjr)
  have hSb : SC B.h ξ ^ bb j ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i|) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 hbj
  have hSbj0 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bb j := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
  have hSb0 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i|) :=
    Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
  have hEW0 : 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) := by
    unfold edgeWeight; split_ifs
    · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
    · exact le_rfl
  have hX0 : 0 < XC B.h ξ := lt_trans hXa hX1
  have hED0 : 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) :=
    lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX1))
      (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr hX2)))
  have hE0 : 0 ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-dd j) := Real.rpow_nonneg hED0.le _
  have hWt := hM j (XC B.h ξ) hX1 hX2
  have hAj : |Cc j| * M j ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cc i| * M i :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cc i| * M i)
      (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (hM0 i)) hjr
  have hSeq : SC B.h ξ ^ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i|) =
      (1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)|) ^ (2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i|) := by
    show ((1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)|) ^ 2) ^ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i|) = _
    rw [← Real.rpow_two, ← Real.rpow_mul (by linarith)]
  calc NB B.h f j ξ
      ≤ Cc j * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bb j *
          edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-dd j) :=
        hCbd j ξ hξ hX1 hX2
    _ = Cc j * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * (SC B.h ξ ^ bb j *
          (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
            edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-dd j)))) := by ring
    _ ≤ |Cc j| * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) *
          (SC B.h ξ ^ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i|) * M j)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul (le_abs_self _) _
          (mul_nonneg hP (mul_nonneg hSbj0 (mul_nonneg hEW0 hE0))) (abs_nonneg _)
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hP
        exact mul_le_mul hSb hWt (mul_nonneg hEW0 hE0) hSb0
    _ = (|Cc j| * M j) * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) *
          SC B.h ξ ^ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i|)) := by ring
    _ ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cc i| * M i) * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) *
          SC B.h ξ ^ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i|)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAj (mul_nonneg hP hSb0)
    _ = _ := by rw [hSeq]; ring

(h qs R2 : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ) (k e : ℕ) (M : ℕ → ℝ) (hS : SimScaleProps h)
    (hqs : qs ≤ 1) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC h qs))
    (hM : ∀ i : ℕ, ∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → simScale h z (1 - t) < qs →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun u : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (simScale h (z + simScale h z (1 - t) ^ (1/2 - h) * u.1)
        (1 - (t + simScale h z (1 - t) * u.2)) / simScale h z (1 - t))) 0‖ ≤ M i)
    (p : ℝ × ℝ) (R : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (Cf : ℝ) (hp1 : p.2 < 1) (hp2 : simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2) < qs)
    (hR : 0 < R) (hR2 : R ≤ R2)
    (hCf : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB h f j (Real.sqrt (simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2)) * R, p.1, p.2, Y) ≤ Cf) :
    ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p' : ℝ × ℝ =>
        R ^ e * f (Real.sqrt (simScale h p'.1 (1 - p'.2)) * R, p'.1, p'.2, Y)) p).compContinuousLinearMap
      (fun _ => (simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2) ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
        (simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖ ≤
      R ^ e * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * Cf * (1 + R2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), M i) ^ k)

signature.name: radmom_chain_bound
signature.statement:
(h qs R2 : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ) (k e : ℕ) (M : ℕ → ℝ) (hS : SimScaleProps h)
    (hqs : qs ≤ 1) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC h qs))
    (hM : ∀ i : ℕ, ∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → simScale h z (1 - t) < qs →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun u : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (simScale h (z + simScale h z (1 - t) ^ (1/2 - h) * u.1)
        (1 - (t + simScale h z (1 - t) * u.2)) / simScale h z (1 - t))) 0‖ ≤ M i)
    (p : ℝ × ℝ) (R : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (Cf : ℝ) (hp1 : p.2 < 1) (hp2 : simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2) < qs)
    (hR : 0 < R) (hR2 : R ≤ R2)
    (hCf : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB h f j (Real.sqrt (simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2)) * R, p.1, p.2, Y) ≤ Cf) :
    ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p' : ℝ × ℝ =>
        R ^ e * f (Real.sqrt (simScale h p'.1 (1 - p'.2)) * R, p'.1, p'.2, Y)) p).compContinuousLinearMap
      (fun _ => (simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2) ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
        (simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖ ≤
      R ^ e * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * Cf * (1 + R2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), M i) ^ k)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have key : ∀ {E G H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup G]
      [NormedSpace ℝ G] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] (F : E → G) (V : Set E) (a : E)
      (T : H →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → a ∈ V → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro E G H _ _ _ _ _ _ F V a T hV hF ha i
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set E, s = (fun z : E => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : E) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
    have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : H) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦd⟩ : ∃ Φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, Φ = fun p' : ℝ × ℝ =>
      R ^ e * f (Real.sqrt (simScale h p'.1 (1 - p'.2)) * R, p'.1, p'.2, Y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hΦd]
  obtain ⟨q, hqd⟩ : ∃ q : ℝ, q = simScale h p.1 (1 - p.2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨L, hLd⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
      L = (q ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (q • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨D, hDd⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = 1 + R2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), M i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hqd, ← hLd, ← hDd]
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by rw [hqd]; exact (hS.1 p.1 (1 - p.2) (by linarith)).1
  have hL : ∀ u : ℝ × ℝ, L u = (q ^ (1/2 - h) * u.1, q * u.2) := by
    intro u; rw [hLd]; first | rfl | simp [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap', Prod.map]
  have hMp : ∀ i : ℕ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun u : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (simScale h
      (p.1 + q ^ (1/2 - h) * u.1) (1 - (p.2 + q * u.2)) / q)) 0‖ ≤ M i := by
    intro i; have := hM i p.1 p.2 hp1 hp2; rw [← hqd] at this; exact this
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρd⟩ : ∃ ρ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ρ = fun u : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (simScale h
      (p.1 + q ^ (1/2 - h) * u.1) (1 - (p.2 + q * u.2)) / q) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hρd] at hMp
  have hM0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ M i := fun i => le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hMp i)
  have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), M i := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hM0 i)
  have hR20 : 0 ≤ R2 := le_trans hR.le hR2
  have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by rw [hDd]; have := mul_nonneg hR20 hsum0; linarith
  
  have hP4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) :=
    hS.2.2.2.1
  have hσ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 (1 - w.2)) {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
    hP4.comp (contDiff_fst.prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd)).contDiffOn
      (fun w (hw : w.2 < 1) => ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith)⟩)
  have hσpos : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → 0 < simScale h w.1 (1 - w.2) := fun w hw =>
    (hS.1 w.1 (1 - w.2) (by linarith)).1
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC h η) {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} :=
    hP4.comp ((contDiff_snd.fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)).contDiffOn
      (fun η (hη : η.2.2.1 < 1) => ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith)⟩)
  have hU : IsOpen {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd.snd.fst continuous_const
  have hDom : IsOpen (DomC h qs) := by
    have h1 := hqC.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qs))
    have h2 : IsOpen {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst
    exact h2.inter h1
  obtain ⟨Ω, hΩd⟩ : ∃ Ω : Set (ℝ × ℝ),
      Ω = {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.2 < 1 ∧ simScale h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qs} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmemΩ : ∀ w, w ∈ Ω ↔ (w.2 < 1 ∧ simScale h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qs) := by
    intro w; rw [hΩd]; rfl
  have hΩo : IsOpen Ω := by
    rw [hΩd]
    exact hσ.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const)
      (isOpen_Iio (a := qs))
  have hpΩ : p ∈ Ω := (hmemΩ p).2 ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
  have hΨ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (simScale h w.1 (1 - w.2)) * R, w.1, w.2, Y) : Cyl)) Ω :=
    (((hσ.mono (fun w hw => ((hmemΩ w).1 hw).1)).sqrt
      (fun w hw => (hσpos w ((hmemΩ w).1 hw).1).ne')).mul contDiffOn_const).prodMk
      (contDiffOn_fst.prodMk (contDiffOn_snd.prodMk contDiffOn_const))
  have hΨmaps : Set.MapsTo
      (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (simScale h w.1 (1 - w.2)) * R, w.1, w.2, Y) : Cyl)) Ω
      (DomC h qs) := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' := (hmemΩ w).1 hw
    exact ⟨mul_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hσpos w hw'.1)) hR, hw'.1, hw'.2⟩
  have hΦsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ Ω := by
    rw [hΦd]; exact contDiffOn_const.mul (hf.comp hΨ hΨmaps)
  
  obtain ⟨ξ0, hξ0d⟩ : ∃ ξ0 : Cyl, ξ0 = (Real.sqrt q * R, p.1, p.2, Y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCf' : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB h f j ξ0 ≤ Cf := by
    intro j hj; rw [hξ0d, hqd]; exact hCf j hj
  have hqξ0 : qC h ξ0 = q := by rw [hξ0d, hqd]; rfl
  have hξ0mem : ξ0 ∈ DomC h qs := by
    rw [hξ0d]; exact ⟨mul_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq0) hR, hp1, hp2⟩
  have hΛ : ∀ v : Cyl, Lnorm h ξ0 v =
      (Real.sqrt q * v.1, q ^ (1/2 - h) * v.2.1, q * v.2.2.1, JpowL (-(coarseIdx h q)) v.2.2.2) := by
    intro v
    simp only [Lnorm, hqξ0]
    first | rfl | (simp [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap', Prod.map]) | (ext <;> simp [Prod.map])
  obtain ⟨θ, hθd⟩ : ∃ θ : ℝ × ℝ → Cyl,
      θ = fun u : ℝ × ℝ => ((R * (ρ u - 1), u.1, u.2, (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) : Cyl) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hgd⟩ : ∃ g : Cyl → ℝ, g = fun v : Cyl => f (ξ0 + Lnorm h ξ0 v) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hid : ∀ u : ℝ × ℝ, ((Real.sqrt (simScale h (p + L u).1 (1 - (p + L u).2)) * R,
      (p + L u).1, (p + L u).2, Y) : Cyl) = ξ0 + Lnorm h ξ0 (θ u) := by
    intro u
    have e1 : (p + L u).1 = p.1 + q ^ (1/2 - h) * u.1 := by rw [Prod.fst_add, hL]
    have e2 : (p + L u).2 = p.2 + q * u.2 := by rw [Prod.snd_add, hL]
    obtain ⟨S', hS'd⟩ : ∃ S', S' = simScale h (p.1 + q ^ (1/2 - h) * u.1) (1 - (p.2 + q * u.2)) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hρu : ρ u = Real.sqrt (S' / q) := by rw [hρd, hS'd]
    have hsq : Real.sqrt S' = Real.sqrt q * Real.sqrt (S' / q) := by
      rw [← Real.sqrt_mul hq0.le, mul_div_cancel₀ S' hq0.ne']
    rw [e1, e2, hΛ, hθd, hξ0d]
    simp only [hρu, ← hS'd, map_zero, Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero]
    rw [hsq]
    congr 1
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨O, hOd⟩ : ∃ O : Set (ℝ × ℝ), O = (fun u : ℝ × ℝ => p + L u) ⁻¹' Ω := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmemO : ∀ u, u ∈ O ↔ p + L u ∈ Ω := by intro u; rw [hOd]; rfl
  have hOo : IsOpen O := by rw [hOd]; exact hΩo.preimage (continuous_const.add L.continuous)
  have h0O : (0 : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ O := by rw [hmemO, map_zero, add_zero]; exact hpΩ
  have hρeq : ρ = fun u : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (simScale h (p + L u).1 (1 - (p + L u).2) / q) := by
    funext u; rw [hρd, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, hL]
  have hσL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun u : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h (p + L u).1 (1 - (p + L u).2)) O :=
    hσ.comp (contDiff_const.add L.contDiff).contDiffOn
      (fun u hu => ((hmemΩ _).1 ((hmemO u).1 hu)).1)
  have hσLpos : ∀ u ∈ O, 0 < simScale h (p + L u).1 (1 - (p + L u).2) := fun u hu =>
    hσpos _ ((hmemΩ _).1 ((hmemO u).1 hu)).1
  have hρO : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ρ O := by
    rw [hρeq]; exact (hσL.div_const q).sqrt (fun u hu => (div_pos (hσLpos u hu) hq0).ne')
  have hρat : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ ρ 0 := hρO.contDiffAt (hOo.mem_nhds h0O)
  have hθO : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ θ O := by
    rw [hθd]
    exact (contDiffOn_const.mul (hρO.sub contDiffOn_const)).prodMk
      (contDiffOn_fst.prodMk (contDiffOn_snd.prodMk contDiffOn_const))
  
  obtain ⟨T, hTd⟩ : ∃ T : Set Cyl, T = (fun v : Cyl => ξ0 + Lnorm h ξ0 v) ⁻¹' DomC h qs :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmemT : ∀ v, v ∈ T ↔ ξ0 + Lnorm h ξ0 v ∈ DomC h qs := by intro v; rw [hTd]; rfl
  have hTo : IsOpen T := by
    rw [hTd]; exact hDom.preimage (continuous_const.add (Lnorm h ξ0).continuous)
  have h0T : (0 : Cyl) ∈ T := by rw [hmemT, map_zero, add_zero]; exact hξ0mem
  have hgT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g T := by
    rw [hgd]
    exact hf.comp (contDiff_const.add (Lnorm h ξ0).contDiff).contDiffOn
      (fun v hv => (hmemT v).1 hv)
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo θ O T := by
    intro u hu
    rw [hmemT, ← hid u]
    exact hΨmaps ((hmemO u).1 hu)
  have hρ0 : ρ 0 = 1 := by
    rw [hρd]
    simp only [Prod.fst_zero, Prod.snd_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
    rw [← hqd, div_self hq0.ne', Real.sqrt_one]
  have hθ0 : θ 0 = 0 := by
    rw [hθd]
    simp only [hρ0, sub_self, mul_zero]
    rfl
  
  have hCb : ∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i g T (θ 0)‖ ≤ Cf := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hθ0, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hTo h0T, hgd,
      key f (DomC h qs) ξ0 (Lnorm h ξ0) hDom hf hξ0mem i]
    exact hCf' i hi
  
  obtain ⟨ι, hιd⟩ : ∃ ι : ℝ →L[ℝ] Cyl, ι = ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hAd⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] Cyl, A = (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).prod
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).prod (0 : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hAapp : ∀ u : ℝ × ℝ, A u = ((0 : ℝ), u.1, u.2, (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
    intro u; rw [hAd]; rfl
  have hιapp : ∀ x : ℝ, ι x = (x, (0 : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) := by
    intro x; rw [hιd]; rfl
  have hιn : ‖ι‖ ≤ 1 := by rw [hιd]; exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_inl_le_one ℝ ℝ _
  have hAn : ‖A‖ ≤ 1 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun u => ?_)
    rw [hAapp, one_mul]
    refine norm_prod_le_iff.mpr ⟨by simp, norm_prod_le_iff.mpr ⟨norm_fst_le u,
      norm_prod_le_iff.mpr ⟨norm_snd_le u, by simp⟩⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨σ', hσ'd⟩ : ∃ σ' : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, σ' = R • ρ - (fun _ => R) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hθsplit : θ = (⇑ι ∘ σ') + ⇑A := by
    funext u
    rw [hθd, Pi.add_apply, Function.comp_apply, hιapp, hAapp, hσ'd]
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero, zero_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hσ'at : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ σ' 0 := by
    rw [hσ'd]; exact (hρat.const_smul R).sub contDiffAt_const
  have hDθ : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i θ 0‖ ≤ R * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i ρ 0‖ + 1 := by
    intro i hi
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ i (⇑ι ∘ σ') 0 :=
      (ContDiff.comp_contDiffAt 0 ι.contDiff hσ'at).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ i (⇑A) 0 := A.contDiff.contDiffAt
    have hσ'i : iteratedFDeriv ℝ i σ' 0 = R • iteratedFDeriv ℝ i ρ 0 := by
      rw [hσ'd]
      have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (R • ρ - fun _ => R) 0 =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (R • ρ) 0 - iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => R) 0 :=
        iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply (f := R • ρ) (g := fun _ => R)
          ((hρat.const_smul R).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)) contDiffAt_const
      rw [e1, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply (hρat.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)),
        iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (by omega : i ≠ 0)]
      simp
    have hι' : ‖ι.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i σ' 0)‖ ≤
        R * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i ρ 0‖ := by
      refine (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
      rw [hσ'i, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hR.le]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (mul_nonneg hR.le (norm_nonneg _)) hιn
    have hA' : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (⇑A) 0‖ ≤ 1 := by
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, i = n + 1 := ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
      rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
      have hfd : fderiv ℝ (⇑A) = fun _ => A := by funext x; exact A.fderiv
      rw [hfd]
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with hn | hn
      · subst hn; rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]; exact hAn
      · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (by omega : n ≠ 0)]; simp
    rw [hθsplit, iteratedFDeriv_add_apply h1 h2,
      ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left ι hσ'at (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)]
    calc ‖ι.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i σ' 0) + iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (⇑A) 0‖
        ≤ ‖ι.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i σ' 0)‖ +
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (⇑A) 0‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ R * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i ρ 0‖ + 1 := add_le_add hι' hA'
  have hDb : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i θ O 0‖ ≤ D ^ i := by
    intro i hi1 hik
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hOo h0O]
    have hMi : M i ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), M j :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := M) (fun j _ => hM0 j) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
    have h1 : R * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i ρ 0‖ ≤ R * M i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hMp i) hR.le
    have h2 : R * M i ≤ R2 * M i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hR2 (hM0 i)
    have h3 : R2 * M i ≤ R2 * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), M j :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hMi hR20
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i θ 0‖ ≤ R * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i ρ 0‖ + 1 := hDθ i hi1
      _ ≤ D := by rw [hDd]; linarith
      _ ≤ D ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
  
  have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hgT hθO (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    hTo.uniqueDiffOn hOo.uniqueDiffOn hmaps h0O (C := Cf) (D := D) hCb hDb

  intro B qs α hok hSN hqs0 hqs1 F hF

    intro η hη
    have h2 : η.2.2.1 < 1 := hη.2.1
    exact (hok.1.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  
  have hab' : Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) < Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) :=
    Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hvan : ∀ s : ℝ, (s ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) ∨ Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) < s) → rhoHat B s = 0 := by
    intro s hs
    have hw : 0 < (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2 := by linarith
    have hu : 1 ≤ ((s - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) /
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2)) ^ 2 := by

          rw [lt_div_iff₀ hw]; linarith

        ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2)) = 0 :=
      Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
    unfold rhoHat
    rw [hnum, zero_div]

    unfold rhoHat bumpR
    apply ContDiff.div_const

    · exact hvan _ (Or.inr (Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by linarith) (by linarith)))

      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev

      have hsq : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun Y : ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * Y)) X :=

  have hm2pos : 0 < B.m2 := by linarith
  have hl2 : 0 < Real.log (B.Xb / B.m2) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hm2pos).mpr hm2b)
  obtain ⟨cE, hcEdef⟩ : ∃ cE : ℝ,

    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hcE : 0 < cE := by rw [hcEdef]; exact Real.exp_pos _
  have hEW : ∀ X : ℝ, B.m1 ≤ X → X ≤ B.m2 → cE ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X := by
    intro X h1 h2
    have hX0 : 0 < X := by linarith
    unfold edgeWeight

    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have e1 : Real.log (B.m1 / B.Xa) ≤ Real.log (X / B.Xa) :=
      Real.log_le_log (div_pos (by linarith) hXa) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 hXa.le)
    have e2 : Real.log (B.Xb / B.m2) ≤ Real.log (B.Xb / X) :=
      Real.log_le_log (div_pos (by linarith) hm2pos) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hX0 h2)
    have f1 : B.aa / Real.log (X / B.Xa) ^ 2 ≤ B.aa / Real.log (B.m1 / B.Xa) ^ 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left haa.le (pow_pos hs1 2) (pow_le_pow_left₀ hs1.le e1 2)
    have f2 : B.ab / Real.log (B.Xb / X) ^ 2 ≤ B.ab / Real.log (B.Xb / B.m2) ^ 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hab.le (pow_pos hl2 2) (pow_le_pow_left₀ hl2.le e2 2)

  obtain ⟨Pm, hPmdef⟩ : ∃ Pm : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,

        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))).prod
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPapp : ∀ η : Cyl, Pm η = (η.2.1, η.2.2.1) := by
    intro η; rw [hPmdef]; simp

      apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
      exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (not_lt.mp hcon) hden.le
    have hid : (E + r) / ci - 2 * r / ci / 2 = E / ci := by ring
    rw [hid, abs_div, abs_of_pos hci0] at hnum
    have e : 2 * r / ci / 3 = (2 * r / 3) / ci := by ring
    have h5 : |E| / ci < (2 * r / 3) / ci := by linarith
    exact (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hci0).mp h5
  
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ bgc := by unfold bgc; linarith [Real.one_lt_sqrt_two]
  have hb1 : bgc ≤ 1 := by
    unfold bgc
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
  have hden : (1 + bgc ^ 2) * (1 + bgc ^ 2)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity)
  have id1 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.1 = lamR w + bgc * lamT w := by
    intro w
    simp only [lamR, lamT, div_eq_mul_inv]
    linear_combination (-w.1) * hden
  have id2 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.2 = -(bgc * lamR w) + lamT w := by
    intro w
    simp only [lamR, lamT, div_eq_mul_inv]
    linear_combination (-w.2) * hden
  have hr0' : G.r0 ≤ 1/100 := hG.1.2.1
  have key : ∀ (R T : ℝ), |R| ≤ G.r0 / 4 → |T| ≤ G.r0 →
      |R + bgc * T| ≤ 1/80 ∧ |-(bgc * R) + T| ≤ 1/80 := by
    intro R T hR hT
    obtain ⟨hR1, hR2⟩ := abs_le.mp hR
    obtain ⟨hT1, hT2⟩ := abs_le.mp hT
    have hr0n : 0 ≤ G.r0 := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hT
    have e1 : bgc * T ≤ G.r0 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hT2), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
    have e2 : -G.r0 ≤ bgc * T := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (show 0 ≤ T + G.r0 by linarith),
        mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
    have e3 : bgc * R ≤ G.r0 / 4 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hR2), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
    have e4 : -(G.r0 / 4) ≤ bgc * R := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (show 0 ≤ R + G.r0 / 4 by linarith),
        mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
    exact ⟨abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
  have hround : ∀ (x : ℝ) (k : ℤ), |x - k| < 1/2 → round x = k := by
    intro x k hk
    rw [round_eq, Int.floor_eq_iff]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hk
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
  intro ξ₀ hξ₀
  refine ⟨{η | |(v η).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8} ∩ {η | |(v η).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8}, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (isOpen_lt ((hvc.fst.sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt ((hvc.snd.sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const)
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show |(v ξ₀).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8
      rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; norm_num
    · show |(v ξ₀).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8
      rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; norm_num
  · by_cases hA : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB ∩ ({η | |(v η).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8} ∩
        {η | |(v η).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8}),
        chig G.r0 (xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2) *
          psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2) = 0
    · 
      exact (contDiffOn_const (c := (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ))).congr (fun η hη => by
        simp only [hA η hη, zero_smul])
    · 
      push_neg at hA
      obtain ⟨η1, hη1U, hη1⟩ := hA
      obtain ⟨hc1, hp1⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hη1
      have hxi1 := s1 _ hc1
      have het1 := s2gen (etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η1.2.2.2) (cib B.h γ.1) G.r0 hci hr0 hp1
      have hw1 : |lamR (frac0 (v η1))| ≤ G.r0 / 4 := hxi1.le
      have hw2 : |lamT (frac0 (v η1))| ≤ G.r0 := by
        have : |lamT (frac0 (v η1))| < 2 * G.r0 / 3 := het1
        linarith
      have hw := key _ _ hw1 hw2
      have ex1 : (v η1).1 - ((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ) =
          lamR (frac0 (v η1)) + bgc * lamT (frac0 (v η1)) := id1 (frac0 (v η1))
      have ex2 : (v η1).2 - ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ) =
          -(bgc * lamR (frac0 (v η1))) + lamT (frac0 (v η1)) := id2 (frac0 (v η1))
      have hx1 : |(v η1).1 - ((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1/80 := by rw [ex1]; exact hw.1
      have hx2 : |(v η1).2 - ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1/80 := by rw [ex2]; exact hw.2
      obtain ⟨kk, hkk⟩ : ∃ kk : ℝ × ℝ,
          kk = (((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ), ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hfr : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB ∩ ({η | |(v η).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8} ∩
          {η | |(v η).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8}), frac0 (v η) = v η - kk := by
        intro η hη
        have h1 : |(v η).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8 := hη.2.1
        have h2 : |(v η).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8 := hη.2.2
        have g1 : |(v η1).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8 := hη1U.2.1
        have g2 : |(v η1).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8 := hη1U.2.2
        obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_lt.mp h1
        obtain ⟨a3, a4⟩ := abs_lt.mp h2
        obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := abs_lt.mp g1
        obtain ⟨b3, b4⟩ := abs_lt.mp g2
        obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := abs_le.mp hx1
        obtain ⟨c3, c4⟩ := abs_le.mp hx2
        have r1 : round (v η).1 = round (v η1).1 :=
          hround _ _ (abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
        have r2 : round (v η).2 = round (v η1).2 :=
          hround _ _ (abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
        rw [hkk]
        unfold frac0
        rw [r1, r2]
        rfl
      
      have hR : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => lamR (v η - kk)) := by
        simp only [hv, lamR, Jpow, div_eq_mul_inv]
        fun_prop
      have hT : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => lamT (v η - kk)) := by
        simp only [hv, lamT, Jpow, div_eq_mul_inv]
        fun_prop
      have hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (lamT (v η - kk) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1) :=
        (hT.add contDiff_const).div_const _
      have hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl =>
          ((η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1), (lamT (v η - kk) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1)) :=
        ContDiff.prodMk (by fun_prop) hV
      have hTH : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl =>
          G.tH γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((lamT (v η - kk) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1)) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
        (hG.2.2.2.2.2.2 γ).comp hφ.contDiffOn (fun η hη => hη)
      have hM : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl =>
          (chig G.r0 (lamR (v η - kk)) * psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) ((lamT (v η - kk) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1)) •
            G.tH γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((lamT (v η - kk) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1)) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
        ((hchig.comp hR).mul (hpsiL.comp hV)).contDiffOn.smul hTH
      refine (hM.mono inter_subset_left).congr (fun η hη => ?_)
      have hxi : xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 = lamR (v η - kk) := by
        show lamR (frac0 (v η)) = _
        rw [hfr η hη]
      have hvco : vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 = (lamT (v η - kk) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 := by
        show (lamT (frac0 (v η)) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 = _
        rw [hfr η hη]
      show (chig G.r0 (xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2) *
          psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2)) •
          G.tH γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2) = _
      rw [hxi, hvco]

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ γ : Lab, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hDetC B G γ) (DomC B.h B.qB) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (yAmp4 B G γ) {ξ : Cyl | ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB ∧ hDetC B G γ ξ ≠ 0}

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have leib : ∀ (Ω : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), IsOpen Ω → Continuous w →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
      (H : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → F), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun s => ∫ v in a..b, w v • H (s, v)) Ω := by
    intro Ω w a b hΩ hw
    have hO : IsOpen (Ω ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) := hΩ.prod isOpen_univ
    have param_fderiv : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
        (H : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → F), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => fderiv ℝ (fun s' => H (s', p.2)) p.1)
          (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
      intro F _ _ H hH p hp
      have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ H p := hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hp)
      apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
          (Function.uncurry (fun (q : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) (s' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) => H (s', q.2))) (p, p.1) := by
        have e : Function.uncurry (fun (q : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) (s' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) => H (s', q.2)) =
            H ∘ (fun z : ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) => (z.2, z.1.2)) := rfl
        rw [e]
        apply ContDiffAt.comp (g := H) (p, p.1)
        · simpa using hHa
        · fun_prop
      exact ContDiffAt.fderiv (f := fun (q : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) (s' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) => H (s', q.2))
        (g := Prod.fst) h1 contDiffAt_fst (le_of_eq ENat.coe_top_add_one)
    have param_hasFDeriv : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
        (H : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → F), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ) → ∀ s₀ ∈ Ω,
        HasFDerivAt (fun s => ∫ v in a..b, w v • H (s, v))
          (∫ v in a..b, w v • fderiv ℝ (fun s' => H (s', v)) s₀) s₀ := by
      intro F _ _ _ H hH s₀ hs₀
      have hHs := param_fderiv H hH
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hΩ s₀ hs₀
      have hSΩ : Metric.closedBall s₀ (δ / 2) ⊆ Ω :=
        (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
      have hSn : Metric.closedBall s₀ (δ / 2) ∈ nhds s₀ := Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds s₀ (by linarith)
      have hK : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall s₀ (δ / 2) ×ˢ Set.uIcc a b) :=
        (isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod isCompact_uIcc
      have hKsub : Metric.closedBall s₀ (δ / 2) ×ˢ Set.uIcc a b ⊆ Ω ×ˢ Set.univ :=
        fun z hz => ⟨hSΩ hz.1, Set.mem_univ _⟩
      have hc1 : ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => w p.2 • fderiv ℝ (fun s' => H (s', p.2)) p.1)
          (Metric.closedBall s₀ (δ / 2) ×ˢ Set.uIcc a b) :=
        ((hw.comp continuous_snd).continuousOn).smul (hHs.continuousOn.mono hKsub)
      obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hc1
      have hcont : ∀ x ∈ Ω, Continuous (fun v : ℝ => w v • H (x, v)) := by
        intro x hx
        refine hw.smul ?_
        exact hH.continuousOn.comp_continuous (f := fun v : ℝ => ((x, v) : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ))
          (by fun_prop) (fun v => ⟨hx, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
      have hcont' : ∀ x ∈ Ω, Continuous (fun v : ℝ => w v • fderiv ℝ (fun s' => H (s', v)) x) := by
        intro x hx
        refine hw.smul ?_
        exact hHs.continuousOn.comp_continuous (f := fun v : ℝ => ((x, v) : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ))
          (by fun_prop) (fun v => ⟨hx, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
      refine intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ)
        (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
        (F := fun x v => w v • H (x, v)) (F' := fun x v => w v • fderiv ℝ (fun s' => H (s', v)) x)
        (bound := fun _ => M) hSn ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · filter_upwards [hΩ.mem_nhds hs₀] with x hx
        exact (hcont x hx).aestronglyMeasurable
      · exact (hcont s₀ hs₀).intervalIntegrable _ _
      · exact (hcont' s₀ hs₀).aestronglyMeasurable
      · refine MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun v hv x hx => ?_)
        exact hM (x, v) ⟨hx, Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hv⟩
      · exact intervalIntegrable_const
      · refine MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun v _ x hx => ?_)
        have hxΩ : x ∈ Ω := hSΩ hx
        have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ H (x, v) := hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds ⟨hxΩ, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
        have hsl : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s' => H (s', v)) x :=
          hHa.comp x (by fun_prop : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
            (fun s' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => ((s', v) : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ)) x)
        exact ((hsl.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt).const_smul (w v)
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro F _ _ _ H hH
      have hD : DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun s => ∫ v in a..b, w v • H (s, v)) Ω :=
        fun s hs => (param_hasFDeriv H hH s hs).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      rw [Nat.cast_zero]
      exact contDiffOn_zero.mpr hD.continuousOn
    | succ n ih =>
      intro F _ _ _ H hH
      have hD : DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun s => ∫ v in a..b, w v • H (s, v)) Ω :=
        fun s hs => (param_hasFDeriv H hH s hs).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      have hCS : CompleteSpace ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] F) := inferInstance
      have hIH := @ih ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] F) _ _ hCS
        (fun p : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => fderiv ℝ (fun s' => H (s', p.2)) p.1) (param_fderiv H hH)
      rw [Nat.cast_succ]
      refine (contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ).mpr ⟨hD, fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact absurd h (by simp)
      · refine hIH.congr (fun s hs => ?_)
        exact (param_hasFDeriv H hH s hs).fderiv
  intro B G hok hG γ
  have hqpos : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, 0 < qC B.h ξ :=
    fun ξ hξ => (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ.2.1])).1
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) (DomC B.h B.qB) := by
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    exact hok.1.2.2.2.1.comp h2.contDiffOn
      (fun ξ hξ => ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith [hξ.2.1]⟩)
  have hDo : IsOpen (DomC B.h B.qB) := by
    have hU : IsOpen {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).inter
        (isOpen_lt (continuous_fst.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)) continuous_const)
    have hcq : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1} := by
      have h1 := hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
      have h2 : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) := by fun_prop
      refine h1.comp h2.continuousOn ?_
      intro ξ hξ
      exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by
        linarith [(show 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 from hξ).2]⟩
    have := hcq.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := B.qB))
    convert this using 1
    ext ξ
    simp only [DomC, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Iio]
    tauto
  have hΩo : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} :=
    hDo.preimage (show Continuous (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => ((s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) : Cyl)) by
      fun_prop)
  
  have hHcol : ∀ γ' : Lab, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Hcol B G γ')
      {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
    intro γ'
    have hT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => G.tH γ' p.1 p.2)
        ({s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
      (hG.2.2.2.2.2.2 γ').mono (fun p hp => hp.1)
    have hc : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => G.tH γ' p.1 p.2 i)
        ({s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
      fun i => contDiffOn_pi.mp hT i
    have hGγ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ =>
        (G.tH γ' p.1 p.2 0) • ((G.tH γ' p.1 p.2 1, G.tH γ' p.1 p.2 2) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
      (hc 0).smul ((hc 1).prodMk (hc 2))
    have hw : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ'.1) v ^ 2) := by
      unfold psiT
      exact (Real.smoothTransition.continuous.comp
        ((continuous_const.sub ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).abs)).div_const _)).pow 2
    have hI : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..(Lsb B.h G.r0 γ'.1),
        psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ'.1) v ^ 2 • ((G.tH γ' s v 0) • ((G.tH γ' s v 1, G.tH γ' s v 2) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} :=
      contDiffOn_infty.mpr (fun n => leib _ (fun v : ℝ => psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ'.1) v ^ 2) 0
        (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ'.1) hΩo hw n _ hGγ)
    refine (hI.const_smul ((1 + bgc^2) / 2 * (∫ u in (-G.r0)..G.r0, chig G.r0 u ^ 2) * cib B.h γ'.1)).congr
      (fun s _ => ?_)
    show Hcol B G γ' s = ((1 + bgc^2) / 2 * (∫ u in (-G.r0)..G.r0, chig G.r0 u ^ 2) * cib B.h γ'.1) •
      ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..(Lsb B.h G.r0 γ'.1),
        psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ'.1) v ^ 2 • ((G.tH γ' s v 0) • ((G.tH γ' s v 1, G.tH γ' s v 2) : ℝ × ℝ))
    unfold Hcol
    congr 1
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun v _ => ?_)
    simp only [smul_smul]
  have hπ : ∀ γ' : Lab, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => Hcol B G γ' (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1))
      (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
    fun γ' => (hHcol γ').comp
      (by fun_prop : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))).contDiffOn
      (fun ξ hξ => hξ)
  have hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hDetC B G γ) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
    ((hπ (γ.1, γ.2.1, true)).fst.mul (hπ (γ.1, γ.2.1, false)).snd).sub
      ((hπ (γ.1, γ.2.1, false)).fst.mul (hπ (γ.1, γ.2.1, true)).snd)
  
  have hT0 : ∀ l : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (T0star4 B l) (DomC B.h B.qB) := by
    intro l
    have hq0 : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, qC B.h ξ ≠ 0 := fun ξ hξ => (hqpos ξ hξ).ne'
    have hXC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (XC B.h) (DomC B.h B.qB) := by
      have : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ)) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
        (contDiffOn_fst.pow 2).div (contDiffOn_const.mul hqC)
          (fun ξ hξ => mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (hq0 ξ hξ))
      exact this
    have hrp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
      hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (fun ξ hξ => hq0 ξ hξ)
    have hEta : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (etaC B.h) (DomC B.h B.qB) := by
      have : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.2.1 * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
        (by fun_prop : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.2.1)).contDiffOn.mul hrp
      exact this
    have hrange : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB,
        (XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hq := hqpos ξ hξ
      have hz := (hok.1.2.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ.2.1])).2
      change ξ.2.1 ^ 2 < qC B.h ξ ^ (1 - 2 * B.h) at hz
      have hr : 0 < qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _
      have hr2 : qC B.h ξ ^ (1 - 2 * B.h) = (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h)) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hq.le]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [hr2] at hz
      have habs : |ξ.2.1| < qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) := abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq hz hr.le
      have heta : etaC B.h ξ = ξ.2.1 / qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) := by
        unfold etaC
        rw [Real.rpow_neg hq.le, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
      have h1 : |etaC B.h ξ| < 1 := by
        rw [heta, abs_div, abs_of_pos hr, div_lt_one hr]
        exact habs
      refine Set.mk_mem_prod ?_ (Set.mem_Ioo.mpr ⟨(abs_lt.mp h1).1, (abs_lt.mp h1).2⟩)
      show 0 < ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ)
      exact div_pos (pow_pos hξ.1 2) (by linarith)
    have hpair : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ)) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
      hXC.prodMk hEta
    have hTth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => B.T0th (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ)) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
      hok.2.2.2.1.1.comp hpair hrange
    have hTz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => B.T0z (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ)) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
      hok.2.2.2.1.2.1.comp hpair hrange
    have hQ : 0 < Qb l := by unfold Qb; positivity
    have hpre : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (Qb l / qC B.h ξ) ^ (1 - B.h)) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
      (contDiffOn_const.div hqC hq0).rpow_const_of_ne (fun ξ hξ => (div_pos hQ (hqpos ξ hξ)).ne')
    exact hpre.smul (hTth.prodMk hTz)
  refine ⟨hA, ?_⟩
  have hS : {ξ : Cyl | ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB ∧ hDetC B G γ ξ ≠ 0} ⊆ DomC B.h B.qB := fun ξ hξ => hξ.1
  have hden : ∀ ξ ∈ {ξ : Cyl | ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB ∧ hDetC B G γ ξ ≠ 0}, hDetC B G γ ξ ≠ 0 :=
    fun ξ hξ => hξ.2
  have hP := hπ (γ.1, γ.2.1, true)
  have hM := hπ (γ.1, γ.2.1, false)
  have hTl := hT0 γ.1
  by_cases hb : γ.2.2 = true
  · have hnum : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl =>
        (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).2 * (T0star4 B γ.1 ξ).1 -
        (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).1 * (T0star4 B γ.1 ξ).2) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
      (hM.snd.mul hTl.fst).sub (hM.fst.mul hTl.snd)
    refine ((hnum.mono hS).div (hA.mono hS) hden).congr (fun ξ _ => ?_)
    simp only [yAmp4, if_pos hb] <;> rfl
  · have hnum : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl =>
        (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).1 * (T0star4 B γ.1 ξ).2 -
        (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).2 * (T0star4 B γ.1 ξ).1) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
      (hP.fst.mul hTl.snd).sub (hP.snd.mul hTl.fst)
    refine ((hnum.mono hS).div (hA.mono hS) hden).congr (fun ξ _ => ?_)
    simp only [yAmp4, if_neg hb] <;> rfl

by

    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h234 with h23 | h4
