  have hloc : ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), lN ≤ γ.1 → ActiveL4 B G γ → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 →
      ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
      ∃ U : Set Cyl, IsOpen U ∧ ξ ∈ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (yAmp4 B G γ) U ∧
        (∀ η ∈ U, 0 < yAmp4 B G γ η) ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (max (yAmp4 B G γ η) 0)) U := by
    intro γ ξ hl hAct heta hξ hX1 hX2
    obtain ⟨hDsm, hysm⟩ := hsm γ
    obtain ⟨C0, b0, d0, h0⟩ := hND 0
    have hz : 0 < edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) := by
      unfold edgeWeight; rw [if_pos ⟨hX1, hX2⟩]; exact Real.exp_pos _
    have ha : 0 < yAmp4 B G γ ξ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hc hz) (h0 γ ξ hl hAct heta hξ hX1 hX2).2.1
    have hdet : hDetC B G γ ξ ≠ 0 := by
      intro hd
      have hd' := hd
      unfold hDetC at hd'
      have hy0 : yAmp4 B G γ ξ = 0 := by
        first
          | simp only [yAmp4, hd', div_zero, ite_self]
          | (unfold yAmp4; dsimp only; rw [hd']; split_ifs <;> simp)
      linarith
    obtain ⟨O, hOd⟩ : ∃ O : Set Cyl, O = {η : Cyl | η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB ∧ hDetC B G γ η ≠ 0} :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hOo : IsOpen O := by
      have := hDsm.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hDomOpen (isOpen_compl_singleton (x := (0:ℝ)))
      rw [hOd]; exact this
    have hyO : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (yAmp4 B G γ) O := by rw [hOd]; exact hysm
    have hUo : IsOpen (O ∩ yAmp4 B G γ ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hyO.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hOo isOpen_Ioi
    have hyU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (yAmp4 B G γ) (O ∩ yAmp4 B G γ ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hyO.mono Set.inter_subset_left
    have hpos : ∀ η ∈ O ∩ yAmp4 B G γ ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0, 0 < yAmp4 B G γ η := fun η hη => hη.2
    refine ⟨O ∩ yAmp4 B G γ ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0, hUo, ⟨by rw [hOd]; exact ⟨hξ, hdet⟩, ha⟩, hyU, hpos, ?_⟩
    exact (hyU.sqrt (fun η hη => (hpos η hη).ne')).congr
      (fun η hη => by rw [max_eq_left (hpos η hη).le])
  refine ⟨fun γ ξ hl hAct heta hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨U, hUo, hξU, -, -, hAU⟩ := hloc γ ξ hl hAct heta hξ hX1 hX2
    exact hAU.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hξU)
  · have hND' := hND
    unfold PrimNondegAt4 at hND'
    choose Cf bf df hf using hND'
    obtain ⟨Cu, hCud⟩ : ∃ Cu : ℝ, Cu = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cf j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨bu, hbud⟩ : ∃ bu : ℝ, bu = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bf j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨du, hdud⟩ : ∃ du : ℝ, du = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |df j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Cg, hCgd⟩ : ∃ Cg : ℝ,
        Cg = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Polynomial.eval (1/2:ℝ) (descPochhammer ℝ i)| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hCu0 : 0 ≤ Cu := by rw [hCud]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have hbu0 : 0 ≤ bu := by rw [hbud]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have hdu0 : 0 ≤ du := by rw [hdud]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have hCg0 : 0 ≤ Cg := by rw [hCgd]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have hsum : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ) (i : ℕ), i ≤ k → f i ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |f j| :=
      fun f i hi => (le_abs_self _).trans (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |f j|)
        (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)))
    refine ⟨(k.factorial : ℝ) * Cg * (1 + Cu / c) ^ k * (1 + Cu), ((k:ℝ) + 1) * bu,
      ((k:ℝ) + 1) * du, ?_⟩
    intro γ ξ hl hAct heta hξ hX1 hX2
    obtain ⟨U, hUo, hξU, hyU, hpos, hAU⟩ := hloc γ ξ hl hAct heta hξ hX1 hX2
    have hz : 0 < edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) := by
      unfold edgeWeight; rw [if_pos ⟨hX1, hX2⟩]; exact Real.exp_pos _
    have hed0 : 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) := by
      have hX0 : 0 < XC B.h ξ := lt_trans hXa hX1
      unfold edgeDist
      exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX1))
        (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr hX2)))
    have hed1 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
    have hSC1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
      unfold SC; exact one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))])
    have hNBi : ∀ i, i ≤ k → NB B.h (yAmp4 B G γ) i ξ ≤
        Cu * SC B.h ξ ^ bu * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
          edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-du) := by
      intro i hi
      refine ((hf i γ ξ hl hAct heta hξ hX1 hX2).2.2.1).trans ?_
      have e1 : Cf i * SC B.h ξ ^ bf i ≤ Cu * SC B.h ξ ^ bu :=
        mul_le_mul (by rw [hCud]; exact hsum Cf i hi)
          (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hSC1 (by rw [hbud]; exact hsum bf i hi))
          (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _) hCu0
      have e3 : df i ≤ du := by rw [hdud]; exact hsum df i hi
      exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right e1 hz.le)
        (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hed0 hed1 (by linarith))
        (Real.rpow_nonneg hed0.le _)
        (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCu0 (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)) hz.le)
    obtain ⟨a, had⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = yAmp4 B G γ ξ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have ha : 0 < a := by rw [had]; exact hpos ξ hξU
    have hca : c * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) ≤ a := by
      rw [had]; exact (hf 0 γ ξ hl hAct heta hξ hX1 hX2).2.1
    
    obtain ⟨O', hO'd⟩ : ∃ O' : Set Cyl, O' = (fun v : Cyl => ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hO'm : ∀ v, v ∈ O' ↔ ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v ∈ U := by intro v; rw [hO'd]; rfl
    have hO' : IsOpen O' := by
      rw [hO'd]; exact hUo.preimage (continuous_const.add (Lnorm B.h ξ).continuous)
    have h0O' : (0:Cyl) ∈ O' := by rw [hO'm, map_zero, add_zero]; exact hξU
    have hfO : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun v : Cyl => yAmp4 B G γ (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v)) O' :=
      hyU.comp (contDiff_const.add (Lnorm B.h ξ).contDiff).contDiffOn (fun v hv => (hO'm v).1 hv)
    have hf0 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun v : Cyl => yAmp4 B G γ (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v)) 0 :=
      hfO.contDiffAt (hO'.mem_nhds h0O')
    have haM : a ≤ Cu * SC B.h ξ ^ bu * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
        edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-du) := by
      refine le_trans ?_ (hNBi 0 (Nat.zero_le _))
      unfold NB
      rw [← key (yAmp4 B G γ) U ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hUo hyU hξU 0, norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]
      show a ≤ ‖yAmp4 B G γ (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ 0)‖
      rw [map_zero, add_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, ← had]
      exact le_abs_self _
    
    obtain ⟨W, hWd⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ, W = SC B.h ξ ^ bu * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-du) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hW1 : 1 ≤ W := by
      rw [hWd]
      exact one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le (Real.one_le_rpow hSC1 hbu0)
        (Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hed0 hed1 (by linarith))
    obtain ⟨D, hDd⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = 1 + Cu / c * W := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hCc : 0 ≤ Cu / c := div_nonneg hCu0 hc.le
    have hCW : 0 ≤ Cu / c * W := mul_nonneg hCc (by linarith)
    have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by rw [hDd]; linarith
    have hcc : c * (Cu / c) = Cu := by field_simp
    have hNBD : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → NB B.h (yAmp4 B G γ) i ξ ≤ a * D ^ i := by
      intro i hi1 hik
      have hM : Cu * SC B.h ξ ^ bu * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
          edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-du) =
          (c * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * (Cu / c * W) := by
        rw [hWd]
        linear_combination (-(edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
          (SC B.h ξ ^ bu * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-du)))) * hcc
      calc NB B.h (yAmp4 B G γ) i ξ
          ≤ Cu * SC B.h ξ ^ bu * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
              edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-du) := hNBi i hik
        _ = (c * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * (Cu / c * W) := hM
        _ ≤ a * D := mul_le_mul hca (by rw [hDd]; linarith) hCW ha.le
        _ ≤ a * D ^ i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)) ha.le
    
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψd⟩ : ∃ ψ : Cyl → ℝ, ψ = fun v => a⁻¹ * yAmp4 B G γ (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hψv : ∀ v, ψ v = a⁻¹ * yAmp4 B G γ (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) := by intro v; rw [hψd]
    have hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ O' := by rw [hψd]; exact contDiffOn_const.mul hfO
    have hψpos : ∀ v ∈ O', 0 < ψ v := fun v hv => by
      rw [hψv]; exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr ha) (hpos _ ((hO'm v).1 hv))
    have hψ0 : ψ 0 = 1 := by
      rw [hψv, map_zero, add_zero, ← had]; exact inv_mul_cancel₀ ha.ne'
    have hψeq : ψ = a⁻¹ • (fun v : Cyl => yAmp4 B G γ (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v)) := by
      funext v; rw [hψv]; rfl
    have hDψ : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ψ O' 0‖ ≤ D ^ i := by
      intro i hi1 hik
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO' h0O', hψeq,
        iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply (hf0.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)),
        key (yAmp4 B G γ) U ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hUo hyU hξU i, norm_smul,
        Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr ha.le)]
      calc a⁻¹ * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (yAmp4 B G γ) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)‖
          ≤ a⁻¹ * (a * D ^ i) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hNBD i hi1 hik) (inv_nonneg.mpr ha.le)
        _ = D ^ i := inv_mul_cancel_left₀ ha.ne' _
    
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1/2:ℝ)) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      (contDiffOn_id (s := Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))).rpow_const_of_ne (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
    have hψmaps : Set.MapsTo ψ O' (Set.Ioi 0) := fun v hv => hψpos v hv
    have hCg : ∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1/2:ℝ)) (Set.Ioi 0) (ψ 0)‖ ≤ Cg := by
      intro i hi
      rw [hψ0, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i isOpen_Ioi (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (zero_lt_one' ℝ)),
        norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate,
        Real.iter_deriv_rpow_const, Real.one_rpow, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, hCgd]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Polynomial.eval (1/2:ℝ) (descPochhammer ℝ i)|)
        (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
    have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hg hψ (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn hO'.uniqueDiffOn hψmaps h0O' (C := Cg) (D := D) hCg hDψ
    
    obtain ⟨A, hAd⟩ : ∃ A : Cyl → ℝ, A = fun η => Real.sqrt (max (yAmp4 B G γ η) 0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hAv : ∀ η, A η = Real.sqrt (max (yAmp4 B G γ η) 0) := by intro η; rw [hAd]
    have hAU' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A U := by rw [hAd]; exact hAU
    suffices hmain : NB B.h A k ξ ≤ Real.sqrt a * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * Cg * D ^ k) by
      rw [hAd] at hmain
      refine hmain.trans ?_
      rw [hDd, hWd]
      exact scal c Cu (SC B.h ξ) (edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ)) bu du
        (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) a ((k.factorial : ℝ) * Cg) k hc hCu0 hSC1
        hed0 hed1 hbu0 hdu0 hz.le (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hCg0) haM
    obtain ⟨gl, hgld⟩ : ∃ gl : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ, gl = Real.sqrt a • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hglx : ∀ x, gl x = Real.sqrt a * x := by intro x; rw [hgld]; rfl
    have hgl : ‖gl‖ ≤ Real.sqrt a :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (fun x => by
        rw [hglx, norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)])
    have hEq : Set.EqOn (fun z => A (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z))
        (⇑gl ∘ ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1/2:ℝ)) ∘ ψ)) O' := by
      intro v hv
      have hp := hpos _ ((hO'm v).1 hv)
      show A (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) = gl (ψ v ^ (1/2:ℝ))
      rw [hAv, hψv, hglx, max_eq_left hp.le, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.sqrt_mul ha.le,
        mul_inv_cancel_left₀ ha.ne']
    have hgψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1/2:ℝ)) ∘ ψ) O' := hg.comp hψ hψmaps
    calc NB B.h A k ξ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => A (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) 0‖ := by
          unfold NB; rw [key A U ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hUo hAU' hξU k]
      _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k (fun z => A (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) O' 0‖ := by
          rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hO' h0O']
      _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k (⇑gl ∘ ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1/2:ℝ)) ∘ ψ)) O' 0‖ := by
          rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_congr hEq h0O' k]
      _ = ‖gl.compContinuousMultilinearMap
            (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1/2:ℝ)) ∘ ψ) O' 0)‖ := by
          rw [ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_left gl (hgψ.contDiffWithinAt h0O')
            hO'.uniqueDiffOn h0O' (i := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)]
      _ ≤ ‖gl‖ * ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ (1/2:ℝ)) ∘ ψ) O' 0‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt a * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * Cg * D ^ k) :=
          mul_le_mul hgl hFdB (norm_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, (ActiveL4 B G γ → W0c4 B G γ ξ = (Real.sqrt (epsb B.h γ.1) / 2 * etaL B.h γ ξ * Real.sqrt (max (yAmp4 B G γ ξ) 0)) • ((chig G.r0 (xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) * psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)) • G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2))) ∧ (W0c4 B G γ ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ ∧ ActiveL4 B G γ ∧ etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 ∧ B.Xa < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < B.Xb ∧ inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) G.r0 ξ.2.2.2)

signature.name: w0c4_support_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, (ActiveL4 B G γ → W0c4 B G γ ξ = (Real.sqrt (epsb B.h γ.1) / 2 * etaL B.h γ ξ * Real.sqrt (max (yAmp4 B G γ ξ) 0)) • ((chig G.r0 (xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) * psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)) • G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2))) ∧ (W0c4 B G γ ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ ∧ ActiveL4 B G γ ∧ etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 ∧ B.Xa < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < B.Xb ∧ inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) G.r0 ξ.2.2.2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG γ ξ hξ
  have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < B.qB := hξ
  have hr0 : 0 < G.r0 := hG.1.1
  have hci : 0 < cib B.h γ.1 := by
    unfold cib
    have hT : (0:ℝ) < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; positivity
    have hQ : (0:ℝ) < Qb γ.1 := by unfold Qb; positivity
    exact mul_pos (zpow_pos hT _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ _)
  have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ'.2.1])).1
  have hX : 0 < XC B.h ξ := by
    unfold XC
    exact div_pos (pow_pos hξ'.1 2) (by linarith)
  
  have s1 : ∀ s : ℝ, chig G.r0 s ≠ 0 → |s| < G.r0 / 4 := by
    intro s hs
    unfold chig bumpR at hs
    have h3 : (4 * s / G.r0) ^ 2 < 1 := by
      by_contra hcon
      exact hs (Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith [not_lt.mp hcon]))
    have h4 := (sq_lt_one_iff_abs_lt_one _).mp h3
    rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr0, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 4), div_lt_one hr0] at h4
    linarith
  
  have s2gen : ∀ E ci r : ℝ, 0 < ci → 0 < r →
      Real.smoothTransition ((2 * r / ci / 3 - |(E + r) / ci - 2 * r / ci / 2|) /
        (2 * r / ci / 3 - 2 * r / ci / 5)) ≠ 0 → |E| < 2 * r / 3 := by
    intro E ci r hci0 hr hs
    have hLpos : 0 < 2 * r / ci := div_pos (by linarith) hci0
    have hden : 0 < 2 * r / ci / 3 - 2 * r / ci / 5 := by linarith
    have hnum : 0 < 2 * r / ci / 3 - |(E + r) / ci - 2 * r / ci / 2| := by
      by_contra hcon
      apply hs
      apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
      exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (not_lt.mp hcon) hden.le
    have hid : (E + r) / ci - 2 * r / ci / 2 = E / ci := by ring
    rw [hid, abs_div, abs_of_pos hci0] at hnum
    have e : 2 * r / ci / 3 = (2 * r / 3) / ci := by ring
    have h5 : |E| / ci < (2 * r / 3) / ci := by linarith
    exact (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hci0).mp h5
  have s2 : psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) ≠ 0 →
      |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 2 * G.r0 / 3 := fun hs =>
    s2gen (etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) (cib B.h γ.1) G.r0 hci hr0 hs
  
  have s4 : (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → Real.sqrt (max (yAmp4 B G γ ξ) 0) = 0 := by
    intro hout
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hok.2.2.2.1.2.2.1 (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) hX hout
    have hT : T0star4 B γ.1 ξ = (0, 0) := by
      unfold T0star4
      rw [h1, h2]
      simp
    have hy : yAmp4 B G γ ξ = 0 := by
      unfold yAmp4
      simp [hT]
    rw [hy, max_self, Real.sqrt_zero]
  refine ⟨fun hAct => ?_, fun hne => ?_⟩
  · unfold W0c4
    by_cases hR : inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (2 * G.r0) ξ.2.2.2
    · rw [if_pos ⟨hAct, hR⟩, smul_smul]
      congr 1
      ring
    · rw [if_neg (fun h => hR h.2)]
      have hχψ : chig G.r0 (xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) *
          psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        obtain ⟨hc, hp⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hne
        have hx := s1 _ hc
        have hE := s2 hp
        exact hR ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      rw [hχψ, zero_smul, smul_zero]
  · unfold W0c4 at hne
    by_cases hc : ActiveL4 B G γ ∧ inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (2 * G.r0) ξ.2.2.2
    swap
    · exact absurd (if_neg hc) hne
    rw [if_pos hc] at hne
    obtain ⟨hAct, -⟩ := hc
    have hsc := (smul_ne_zero_iff.mp hne).1
    obtain ⟨h1, hψ⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hsc
    obtain ⟨h2, hχ⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp h1
    obtain ⟨h3, hAm⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp h2
    obtain ⟨-, he⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp h3
    have hXa : B.Xa < XC B.h ξ := by
      by_contra hcon
      exact hAm (s4 (Or.inl (not_lt.mp hcon)))
    have hXb : XC B.h ξ < B.Xb := by
      by_contra hcon
      exact hAm (s4 (Or.inr (not_lt.mp hcon)))
    have hx := s1 _ hχ
    have hE := s2 hψ
    refine ⟨⟨⟨hAct.1, ξ, he, hXa.le, hXb.le⟩, subset_tsupport _ (Function.mem_support.mpr he),
      hx.le, by linarith, hXa.le, hXb.le⟩, hAct, he, hXa, hXb, by linarith, by linarith⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, ∀ a : ℝ × ℝ, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) a → W0c4 B G γ (shY ξ a) = W0c4 B G γ ξ

signature.name: w0c4_deck_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, ∀ a : ℝ × ℝ, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) a → W0c4 B G γ (shY ξ a) = W0c4 B G γ ξ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG γ ξ hξ a ha
  have hh : 0 < B.h := hok.2.1.1
  have he : etaL B.h γ (shY ξ a) = etaL B.h γ ξ := rfl
  have hY : (shY ξ a).2.2.2 = ξ.2.2.2 + a := rfl
  by_cases hAct : ActiveL4 B G γ
  swap
  · unfold W0c4
    simp [hAct]
  by_cases heta : etaL B.h γ ξ = 0
  · unfold W0c4
    rw [he]
    split_ifs <;> simp [heta]
  have hl40 : 40 ≤ γ.1 := le_trans hG.1.2.2.2.2 hAct.1
  
  have hwin : γ.1 ≤ bandOf (qC B.h ξ) ∧ bandOf (qC B.h ξ) ≤ γ.1 + 1 := by
    have h1 : sqPart 1 (-(γ.1:ℤ)) (Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ)) ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul heta
    unfold sqPart at h1
    have h2 := (div_ne_zero_iff.mp h1).1
    unfold bumpR at h2
    simp only [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast, div_one, sub_neg_eq_add] at h2
    have h3 : (Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ) + (γ.1:ℝ)) ^ 2 < 1 := by
      by_contra hcon
      exact h2 (Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith [not_lt.mp hcon]))
    have h4 := abs_lt.mp ((sq_lt_one_iff_abs_lt_one _).mp h3)
    have hb : bandOf (qC B.h ξ) = ⌈-Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ)⌉₊ := by
      unfold bandOf
      rw [one_div, Real.logb_inv]
    rw [hb]
    constructor
    · have h5 := Nat.le_ceil (-Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ))
      have h6 : (γ.1:ℝ) < (⌈-Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ)⌉₊ : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith [h4.1, h4.2]
      have h7 : γ.1 < ⌈-Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ)⌉₊ + 1 := by exact_mod_cast h6
      omega
    · rw [Nat.ceil_le]
      push_cast
      linarith [h4.1, h4.2]
  
  have hmono : ∀ m l : ℕ, 3 ≤ m → m ≤ l → bandIdx B.h m ≤ bandIdx B.h l := by
    have hT1 : 1 < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; have := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2; linarith
    have hpos : ∀ x : ℕ, 1 ≤ x → 0 < (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (x:ℝ)) / ((x:ℝ) ^ 2) := by
      intro x hx
      have : (1:ℝ) ≤ x := by exact_mod_cast hx
      exact div_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _) (pow_pos (by linarith) 2)
    have hstep : ∀ x : ℕ, 3 ≤ x → (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (x:ℝ)) / ((x:ℝ) ^ 2) ≤
        (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * ((x+1:ℕ):ℝ)) / (((x+1:ℕ):ℝ) ^ 2) := by
      intro x hx
      have hx3 : (3:ℝ) ≤ x := by exact_mod_cast hx
      have hx0 : (0:ℝ) < (x:ℝ) := by linarith
      have hx1 : (0:ℝ) < ((x+1:ℕ):ℝ) := by push_cast; linarith
      have hP : 0 < (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (x:ℝ)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
      have e : (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * ((x+1:ℕ):ℝ)) =
          (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (x:ℝ)) * (2:ℝ) ^ (1 + B.h) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num)]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring
      have h2 : (2:ℝ) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ (1 + B.h) := by
        have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2)
          (by linarith : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + B.h)
        rwa [Real.rpow_one] at this
      rw [e, div_le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hx0 2) (pow_pos hx1 2)]
      push_cast
      have hq : ((x:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ (1 + B.h) * (x:ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (sq_nonneg (x:ℝ)),
          mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hx3) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ (x:ℝ) + 1)]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq hP.le]
    intro m l hm hml
    have hg : (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (m:ℝ)) / ((m:ℝ) ^ 2) ≤
        (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l:ℝ) ^ 2) := by
      induction l, hml using Nat.le_induction with
      | base => exact le_rfl
      | succ n hn ih => exact le_trans ih (hstep n (by omega))
    unfold bandIdx
    exact Int.floor_le_floor (Real.logb_le_logb_of_le hT1 (hpos m (by omega)) hg)
  
  have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hsq0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
  have hL0 : Lgc ≠ 0 := by
    unfold Lgc
    apply ne_of_gt
    nlinarith
  have hT0 : Tgc ≠ 0 := by
    unfold Tgc
    positivity
  have hL' : Lgc = 3 - bgc := by unfold Lgc bgc; ring
  have hT' : Tgc * bgc = 3 * bgc + 1 := by unfold Tgc bgc; linear_combination hs2
  have hLb : bgc * Lgc = 5 * bgc - 1 := by unfold Lgc bgc; linear_combination (-1:ℝ) * hs2
  have hT'' : Tgc = bgc + 5 := by unfold Tgc bgc; ring
  have hJs : ∀ (n : ℤ) (c : ℝ × ℝ), (∃ i j : ℤ, Jpow n c = ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))) →
      ∃ i j : ℤ, Jpow (n + 1) c = ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ)) := by
    rintro n ⟨c1, c2⟩ ⟨i, j, hij⟩
    refine ⟨3 * i + j, i + 5 * j, ?_⟩
    unfold Jpow at hij ⊢
    rw [zpow_add_one₀ hL0, zpow_add_one₀ hT0]
    simp only [vrv, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk, Prod.mk.injEq] at hij ⊢
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hij
    push_cast
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · linear_combination 3 * h1 + h2 + (Lgc ^ n * ((c1 - bgc * c2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2))) * hL'
        + (Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * c1 + c2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2))) * hT'
    · linear_combination h1 + 5 * h2 - (Lgc ^ n * ((c1 - bgc * c2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2))) * hLb
        + (Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * c1 + c2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2))) * hT''
  have hlat : ∀ (ci : ℤ) (d : ℕ) (c : ℝ × ℝ), (∃ i j : ℤ, Jpow ci c = ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))) →
      ∃ i j : ℤ, Jpow (ci + (d:ℤ)) c = ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ)) := by
    intro ci d c hc
    induction d with
    | zero => simp only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero]; exact hc
    | succ d ih =>
      have e : ci + ((d+1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (ci + (d:ℤ)) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
      rw [e]
      exact hJs _ c ih
  have hadd : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y b : ℝ × ℝ), Jpow n (Y + b) = Jpow n Y + Jpow n b := by
    rintro n ⟨y1, y2⟩ ⟨b1, b2⟩
    simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.mk_add_mk, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk.injEq]
    constructor <;> ring
  have hfrac : ∀ (w : ℝ × ℝ) (k1 k2 : ℤ), frac0 (w + ((k1:ℝ), (k2:ℝ))) = frac0 w := by
    rintro ⟨w1, w2⟩ k1 k2
    simp only [frac0, Prod.mk_add_mk, round_add_intCast, Int.cast_add, Prod.mk.injEq]
    constructor <;> ring
  
  obtain ⟨hl1, hl2⟩ := hwin
  have hci : coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ) ≤ bandIdx B.h γ.1 := by
    unfold coarseIdx
    exact hmono _ _ (by omega) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d : ℕ, bandIdx B.h γ.1 = coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ) + (d:ℤ) :=
    ⟨(bandIdx B.h γ.1 - coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)).toNat, by
      rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)]; ring⟩
  obtain ⟨k1, k2, hk⟩ := hlat _ d a ha
  rw [← hd] at hk
  have hrect : rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (ξ.2.2.2 + a) = rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 := by
    unfold rectW
    rw [hadd, hk]
    have e : Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 + ((k1:ℝ), (k2:ℝ)) - G.ctr γ =
        (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ) + ((k1:ℝ), (k2:ℝ)) := by abel
    rw [e, hfrac]
  have hxi : xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (ξ.2.2.2 + a) = xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 := by
    unfold xiG; rw [hrect]
  have hvco : vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) (ξ.2.2.2 + a) = vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 := by
    unfold vco etG; rw [hrect]
  have hin : inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (2 * G.r0) (ξ.2.2.2 + a) ↔
      inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (2 * G.r0) ξ.2.2.2 := by
    unfold inRect xiG etG; rw [hrect]
  unfold W0c4
  rw [hY, hxi, hvco]
  by_cases hR : inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (2 * G.r0) ξ.2.2.2
  · rw [if_pos (And.intro hAct (hin.2 hR)), if_pos (And.intro hAct hR)]
    all_goals rfl
  · rw [if_neg (fun h : ActiveL4 B G γ ∧ inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (2 * G.r0) (ξ.2.2.2 + a) => hR (hin.1 h.2)),
      if_neg (fun h : ActiveL4 B G γ ∧ inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (2 * G.r0) ξ.2.2.2 => hR h.2)]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h c : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (a e : Cyl → ℝ) (P : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (k : ℕ) (A E Q : ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ a ξ → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ e ξ → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ P ξ → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h a i ξ ≤ A) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h e i ξ ≤ E) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h P i ξ ≤ Q) → NB h (fun η => (c * a η * e η) • P η) k ξ ≤ |c| * 3 ^ k * A * E * Q

signature.name: nb_triple_leibniz
signature.statement: ∀ (h c : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (a e : Cyl → ℝ) (P : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (k : ℕ) (A E Q : ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ a ξ → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ e ξ → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ P ξ → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h a i ξ ≤ A) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h e i ξ ≤ E) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h P i ξ ≤ Q) → NB h (fun η => (c * a η * e η) • P η) k ξ ≤ |c| * 3 ^ k * A * E * Q

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h c ξ a e P k A E Q ha he hP hA hE hQ
  have hNBnn : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V) (i : ℕ),
      0 ≤ NB h f i ξ := fun f i => norm_nonneg _
  
  have leib : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (U : Set Cyl) (n : ℕ),
      IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (g : Cyl → V), ContDiffOn ℝ n f U → ContDiffOn ℝ n g U →
      NB h (fun η => f η • g η) n ξ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h g (n - i) ξ := by
    intro V _ _ U n hU hξ f g hf hg
    unfold NB
    generalize Lnorm h ξ = L
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage L.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
    have hL0s : L 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
    have hsm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have hsmO : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact (hsm F hF).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
    have key : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n →
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0 =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF i hi
      have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O
      have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
        hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
      have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + z)) i hs h0s
      have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i ξ 0
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0
          = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑L) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := e2
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [map_zero]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [e3]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
    have hfg : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun η => f η • g η) U := hf.smul hg
    have hl := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_smul_le (hsmO f hf) (hsmO g hg) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O
      (n := n) le_rfl
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => f (ξ + L y) • g (ξ + L y)) n hO h0O] at hl
    rw [← key _ hfg n le_rfl]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => (fun η => f η • g η) (ξ + L z)) 0‖
        = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f (ξ + L y) • g (ξ + L y)) 0‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ _ := hl
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        have hik : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O,
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => g (ξ + L z)) (n - i) hO h0O,
          key f hf i hik, key g hg (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i)]
  
  have cmul : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (i : ℕ), ContDiffAt ℝ i f ξ →
      NB h (fun η => c * f η) i ξ = |c| * NB h f i ξ := by
    intro f i hf
    unfold NB
    have e0 : (fun η => c * f η) = fun η => c • f η := rfl
    have e : iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun η => c • f η) ξ = c • iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f ξ :=
      iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply' hf
    rw [e0, e]
    have e2 : (c • iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) =
        c • (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) := by
      ext v; simp
    rw [e2, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := le_trans (hNBnn a 0) (hA 0 (Nat.zero_le k))
  have hE0 : 0 ≤ E := le_trans (hNBnn e 0) (hE 0 (Nat.zero_le k))
  have hQ0 : 0 ≤ Q := le_trans (hNBnn P 0) (hQ 0 (Nat.zero_le k))
  
  have ha' : ContDiffAt ℝ k a ξ := ha.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have he' : ContDiffAt ℝ k e ξ := he.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hP' : ContDiffAt ℝ k P ξ := hP.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  obtain ⟨ua, hua, hau⟩ := ha'.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
  obtain ⟨ue, hue, heu⟩ := he'.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
  obtain ⟨uP, huP, hPu⟩ := hP'.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
  obtain ⟨O, hOsub, hOopen, hξO⟩ :=
    mem_nhds_iff.mp (Filter.inter_mem hua (Filter.inter_mem hue huP))
  have haO : ContDiffOn ℝ k a O := hau.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).1)
  have heO : ContDiffOn ℝ k e O := heu.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).2.1)
  have hPO : ContDiffOn ℝ k P O := hPu.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).2.2)
  
  have hgO : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun η => c * a η * e η) O := (contDiffOn_const.mul haO).mul heO
  have hg : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h (fun η => c * a η * e η) i ξ ≤ |c| * A * E * 2 ^ i := by
    intro i hi
    have hik : ((i : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ((k : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast hi
    have l1 := leib O i hOopen hξO (fun η => c * a η) e
      (contDiffOn_const.mul (haO.of_le hik)) (heO.of_le hik)
    have l1' : NB h (fun η => c * a η * e η) i ξ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1),
        (i.choose j : ℝ) * NB h (fun η => c * a η) j ξ * NB h e (i - j) ξ := l1
    refine le_trans l1' ?_
    calc ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose j : ℝ) * NB h (fun η => c * a η) j ξ * NB h e (i - j) ξ
        ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose j : ℝ) * (|c| * A) * E := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro j hj
          have hji : j ≤ i := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
          have h1 : NB h (fun η => c * a η) j ξ ≤ |c| * A := by
            rw [cmul a j (ha.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hA j (le_trans hji hi)) (abs_nonneg c)
          have h2 : NB h e (i - j) ξ ≤ E := hE _ (le_trans (Nat.sub_le i j) hi)
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) h2 (hNBnn _ _)
            (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg c) hA0))
      _ = |c| * A * E * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose j : ℝ) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _; ring
      _ = |c| * A * E * 2 ^ i := by
          congr 1; exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose i
  
  have l2 := leib O k hOopen hξO (fun η => c * a η * e η) P hgO hPO
  refine le_trans l2 ?_
  calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB h (fun η => c * a η * e η) i ξ *
        NB h P (k - i) ξ
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * (|c| * A * E * 2 ^ i) * Q := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hg i hik) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
          (hQ _ (Nat.sub_le k i)) (hNBnn _ _)
          (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg c) hA0) hE0)
            (pow_nonneg (by norm_num) i)))
    _ = |c| * A * E * Q * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (2:ℝ) ^ i * 1 ^ (k - i) * (k.choose i : ℝ) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; rw [one_pow]; ring
    _ = |c| * 3 ^ k * A * E * Q := by
        rw [← add_pow]; ring

signature.name: w0c4_smooth_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (lN : ℕ) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → PrimNondegAt4 B G lN c → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ γ : Lab, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (W0c4 B G γ) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), etaL B.h γ ξ = 0 → ∀ k : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (W0c4 B G γ) ξ = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG lN c hc hND
  have hS := hok.1
  obtain ⟨-, -, hXa, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -, hqB0, -, -, -, haa, hab⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨hEsm, hEfl, -, -⟩ := etaL_class_v5 B hok
  have hA := sqrt_amp_bound_v5 B G hok hG lN c hc hND (yAmp4_smooth_v5 B G hok hG)
  have hJ := w0c4_jet_tendsto_v5 B G hok hG lN c hc hND lnorm_two_sided_bound_v5 edge_factor_limits_v5
    hEsm hEfl
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨lN + n0, fun l0 hl0 γ => ?_⟩
  
  have hQb : ∀ n : ℕ, Qb n = (1/2:ℝ) ^ n := by
    intro n
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(n:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 < B.qB := by
    show Qb l0 < _
    rw [hQb]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0
  have hDom : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB :=
    fun ξ hξ => ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, lt_trans hξ.2.2 hqsB⟩
  have hqpos : ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → 0 < qC B.h ξ :=
    fun ξ ht => (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hcq : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h1 := hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have h2 : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) := by fun_prop
    refine h1.comp h2.continuousOn ?_
    intro ξ hξ
    exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by
      linarith [(show 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 from hξ).2]⟩
  have hOpen : ∀ q : ℝ, IsOpen (DomC B.h q) := by
    intro q
    have hU : IsOpen {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).inter
        (isOpen_lt (continuous_fst.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)) continuous_const)
    have := hcq.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := q))
    convert this using 1
    ext ξ
    simp only [DomC, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Iio]
    tauto
  have hXC : ContinuousOn (XC B.h) {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have e : XC B.h = fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ) := rfl
    rw [e]
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.1 ^ 2) {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
      (continuous_fst.pow 2).continuousOn
    have h2 : ContinuousOn (fun ξ : Cyl => 2 * qC B.h ξ) {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
      continuousOn_const.mul hcq
    refine h1.div h2 (fun ξ hξ => ?_)
    have := hqpos ξ (show 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 from hξ).2
    positivity
  have hlev : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → l0 ≤ γ.1 := by
    intro ξ hξ he
    have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ.2.1
    have h1 : sqPart 1 (-(γ.1:ℤ)) (Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ)) ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul he
    unfold sqPart at h1
    have h2 := (div_ne_zero_iff.mp h1).1
    unfold bumpR at h2
    simp only [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast, div_one, sub_neg_eq_add] at h2
    have h3 : (Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ) + (γ.1:ℝ)) ^ 2 < 1 := by
      by_contra hcon
      exact h2 (Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith [not_lt.mp hcon]))
    have h4 := (abs_lt.mp ((sq_lt_one_iff_abs_lt_one _).mp h3)).1
    have h5 : Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ) < -(l0:ℝ) :=
      (Real.logb_lt_iff_lt_rpow (by norm_num) hq).2 hξ.2.2
    have h6 : (l0:ℝ) < (γ.1:ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    have h7 : l0 < γ.1 + 1 := by exact_mod_cast h6
    omega
  have hz0 : ∀ (k : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun _ : Cyl => (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ)) ξ = 0 := by
    intro k ξ
    have h := (iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun _ : Cyl => (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ)) = 0)
    exact congrFun h ξ
  have hUo := hOpen (qsOf l0)
  
  by_cases hM : ActiveL4 B G γ ∧ l0 ≤ γ.1
  swap
  · 
    have hZ : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), W0c4 B G γ η = 0 := by
      intro η hη
      by_contra hne
      obtain ⟨-, hAct, heta, -, -, -⟩ := (w0c4_support_v5 B G hok hG γ η (hDom η hη)).2 hne
      exact hM ⟨hAct, hlev η hη heta⟩
    refine ⟨contDiffOn_const.congr hZ, fun ξ hξ _ k => ?_⟩
    have hev : W0c4 B G γ =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hξ) hZ
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
    exact hz0 k ξ
  
  obtain ⟨hAct, hlγ⟩ := hM
  have hlN : lN ≤ γ.1 := by omega
  have hW0 : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB,
      ¬(etaL B.h γ η ≠ 0 ∧ B.Xa < XC B.h η ∧ XC B.h η < B.Xb) → W0c4 B G γ η = 0 := by
    intro η hη hn
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨-, -, he, h1, h2, -⟩ := (w0c4_support_v5 B G hok hG γ η hη).2 hne
    exact hn ⟨he, h1, h2⟩
  have hsubU : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ⊆ {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
    fun ξ hξ => ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1⟩
  have hXCU : ContinuousOn (XC B.h) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := hXC.mono hsubU
  have hEU : ContinuousOn (etaL B.h γ) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    (hEsm γ).continuousOn.mono (fun ξ hξ => hDom ξ hξ)
  
  have hO : IsOpen {p : ℝ × ℝ | (p.1 ≠ 0 ∧ B.Xa < p.2 ∧ p.2 < B.Xb) ∨ p.2 < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < p.2} := by
    show IsOpen ({p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ≠ 0} ∩ ({p : ℝ × ℝ | B.Xa < p.2} ∩ {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.2 < B.Xb}) ∪
      ({p : ℝ × ℝ | p.2 < B.Xa} ∪ {p : ℝ × ℝ | B.Xb < p.2}))
    exact ((isOpen_ne_fun continuous_fst continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_snd).inter (isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const))).union
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const).union (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_snd))
  have hO2 : IsOpen {p : ℝ | p < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < p} := by
    show IsOpen ({p : ℝ | p < B.Xa} ∪ {p : ℝ | B.Xb < p})
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_id continuous_const).union (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_id)
  obtain ⟨V, hVdef⟩ : ∃ V : Set Cyl, V = {η : Cyl | η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧
      ((etaL B.h γ η ≠ 0 ∧ B.Xa < XC B.h η ∧ XC B.h η < B.Xb) ∨ XC B.h η < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h η)} :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨W23, hWdef⟩ : ∃ W : Set Cyl, W = {η : Cyl | η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧
      (XC B.h η < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h η)} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hVo : IsOpen V := by
    have := (hEU.prodMk hXCU).isOpen_inter_preimage hUo hO
    rw [hVdef]
    exact this
  have hWo : IsOpen W23 := by
    have := hXCU.isOpen_inter_preimage hUo hO2
    rw [hWdef]
    exact this
  have hW23ev : ∀ y ∈ W23, W0c4 B G γ =ᶠ[nhds y] fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) := by
    intro y hy
    apply Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hWo.mem_nhds hy)
    intro η hη
    rw [hWdef] at hη
    apply hW0 η (hDom η hη.1)
    rintro ⟨-, h1, h2⟩
    rcases hη.2 with h | h <;> linarith
  
  have hsmV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (W0c4 B G γ) V := by
    intro y hy
    apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
    rw [hVdef] at hy
    obtain ⟨hyU, hy2⟩ := hy
    rcases hy2 with ⟨he, h1, h2⟩ | h
    · have hyN := hDom y hyU
      have hNy := (hOpen B.qB).mem_nhds hyN
      have hev : W0c4 B G γ =ᶠ[nhds y] fun η => (Real.sqrt (epsb B.h γ.1) / 2 * etaL B.h γ η *
          Real.sqrt (max (yAmp4 B G γ η) 0)) • ((chig G.r0 (xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2) *
          psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2)) •
          G.tH γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hNy (fun η hη => (w0c4_support_v5 B G hok hG γ η hη).1 hAct)
      refine ContDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_ hev
      exact ((contDiffAt_const.mul ((hEsm γ).contDiffAt hNy)).mul
        (hA.1 γ y hlN hAct he hyN h1 h2)).smul
        ((pulse_profile_smooth_v5 B G hok hG γ).contDiffAt hNy)
    · have hyW : y ∈ W23 := by rw [hWdef]; exact ⟨hyU, h⟩
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hW23ev y hyW)
  
  have hUV : ∀ x ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), x ∉ V → W0c4 B G γ x = 0 ∧ B.Xa ≤ XC B.h x ∧
      XC B.h x ≤ B.Xb ∧ (etaL B.h γ x = 0 ∨ XC B.h x = B.Xa ∨ XC B.h x = B.Xb) := by
    intro x hx hxV
    have hn : ¬((etaL B.h γ x ≠ 0 ∧ B.Xa < XC B.h x ∧ XC B.h x < B.Xb) ∨
        XC B.h x < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h x) := by
      intro h
      apply hxV
      rw [hVdef]
      exact ⟨hx, h⟩
    have h2 : B.Xa ≤ XC B.h x := not_lt.mp (fun h => hn (Or.inr (Or.inl h)))
    have h3 : XC B.h x ≤ B.Xb := not_lt.mp (fun h => hn (Or.inr (Or.inr h)))
    have h1 : ¬(etaL B.h γ x ≠ 0 ∧ B.Xa < XC B.h x ∧ XC B.h x < B.Xb) := fun h => hn (Or.inl h)
    refine ⟨hW0 x (hDom x hx) h1, h2, h3, ?_⟩
    by_cases he : etaL B.h γ x = 0
    · exact Or.inl he
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h2 with h | h
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h.symm)
      · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h3 with h' | h'
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h')
        · exact absurd ⟨he, h, h'⟩ h1
  
  have hlim : ∀ x ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), x ∉ V → ∀ k : ℕ,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (W0c4 B G γ) y) (nhdsWithin x V) (nhds 0) := by
    intro x hx hxV k
    obtain ⟨-, h2, h3, hd⟩ := hUV x hx hxV
    have h1 := hJ γ x k hlN hAct (hDom x hx) h2 h3 hd
    have hsub : V ⊆ {η : Cyl | η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB ∧ etaL B.h γ η ≠ 0 ∧ B.Xa < XC B.h η ∧
        XC B.h η < B.Xb} ∪ W23 := by
      intro η hη
      rw [hVdef] at hη
      obtain ⟨hηU, hη2⟩ := hη
      rcases hη2 with ⟨he, a, b⟩ | h
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hDom η hηU, he, a, b⟩
      · right
        rw [hWdef]
        exact ⟨hηU, h⟩
    have h2' : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (W0c4 B G γ) y) (nhdsWithin x W23)
        (nhds 0) := by
      refine Filter.Tendsto.congr' ?_ tendsto_const_nhds
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with y hy
      exact ((((hW23ev y hy).iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds).trans (hz0 k y)).symm
    refine (h1.sup h2').mono_left ?_
    rw [← nhdsWithin_union]
    exact nhdsWithin_mono x hsub
  
  have hVU : V ⊆ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := by
    intro η hη
    rw [hVdef] at hη
    exact hη.1
  obtain ⟨hsmU, hjet⟩ := flat_zero_extension_cyl (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) V (W0c4 B G γ) hUo hVo hVU
    hsmV (fun x hx hxV => (hUV x hx hxV).1) hlim
  refine ⟨hsmU, fun ξ hξ he k => ?_⟩
  by_cases hξV : ξ ∈ V
  · have hξV' := hξV
    rw [hVdef] at hξV'
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := hξV'
    rcases h with ⟨hne, -, -⟩ | h
    · exact absurd he hne
    · have hξW : ξ ∈ W23 := by rw [hWdef]; exact ⟨hξ, h⟩
      rw [((hW23ev ξ hξW).iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
      exact hz0 k ξ
  · exact hjet ξ hξ hξV k

    have hB0 : 0 ≤ B.ab * w ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hsw0 : 0 ≤ sw := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hsw1 : sw ≤ 1 := by
      rw [hsw]; apply Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr; rw [hay, hbz]; linarith
    have hswa : sw ≤ Real.exp (-(B.aa * u ^ 2 / 2)) := by
      rw [hsw]; apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr; rw [hay, hbz]; linarith
    have hswb : sw ≤ Real.exp (-(B.ab * w ^ 2 / 2)) := by
      rw [hsw]; apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr; rw [hay, hbz]; linarith
    set ed := edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X with heddef
    have hed : ed = min 1 (min y z) := by rw [heddef, hydef, hzdef]; rfl
    have hed0 : 0 < ed := by rw [hed]; exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min hy hz)
    have hed1 : ed ≤ 1 := by rw [hed]; exact min_le_left _ _
    have hedd : ed ^ (-d) ≤ (ed⁻¹) ^ n := by
      calc ed ^ (-d) ≤ ed ^ (-(n:ℝ)) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hed0 hed1 (by linarith)
        _ = (ed⁻¹) ^ n := by rw [Real.rpow_neg hed0.le, Real.rpow_natCast, inv_pow]
    have hun : 0 ≤ u ^ n := pow_nonneg hu0 n
    have hwn : 0 ≤ w ^ n := pow_nonneg hw0 n
    have hedn : (ed⁻¹) ^ n ≤ 1 + u ^ n + w ^ n := by
      rcases min_choice (1:ℝ) (min y z) with hm1 | hm1
      · rw [hed, hm1, inv_one, one_pow]; linarith
      · rcases min_choice y z with hm2 | hm2
        · rw [hed, hm1, hm2, ← hudef]; linarith
        · rw [hed, hm1, hm2, ← hwdef]; linarith
    have hedd0 : 0 ≤ ed ^ (-d) := Real.rpow_nonneg hed0.le _
    have gA := gauss n B.aa u haa hu0
    have gB := gauss n B.ab w hab hw0
    have hEdge : sw * ed ^ (-d) ≤
        3 + (2 / B.aa) ^ n * (n.factorial : ℝ) + (2 / B.ab) ^ n * (n.factorial : ℝ) := by
      have f1 : sw * ed ^ (-d) ≤ sw + sw * u ^ n + sw * w ^ n :=
        calc sw * ed ^ (-d) ≤ sw * (1 + u ^ n + w ^ n) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_trans hedd hedn) hsw0
          _ = sw + sw * u ^ n + sw * w ^ n := by ring
      have f2 : sw * u ^ n ≤ Real.exp (-(B.aa * u ^ 2 / 2)) * u ^ n :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hswa hun
      have f3 : sw * w ^ n ≤ Real.exp (-(B.ab * w ^ 2 / 2)) * w ^ n :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hswb hwn
      linarith
    have hqi : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (-1:ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
    have hSC' : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ b := Real.rpow_nonneg (by unfold SC; positivity) _
    obtain ⟨Q, hQdef⟩ : ∃ Q : ℝ, Q = qC B.h ξ ^ (-1:ℝ) * SC B.h ξ ^ b := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hQ0 : 0 ≤ Q := by rw [hQdef]; exact mul_nonneg hqi hSC'
    obtain ⟨K, hKdef⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ,
        K = 3 + (2 / B.aa) ^ n * (n.factorial : ℝ) + (2 / B.ab) ^ n * (n.factorial : ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hKdef] at hEdge
    have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := le_trans (mul_nonneg hsw0 hedd0) hEdge
    have hb5' : NB B.h (princG5 B G Lh E γ m) k ξ ≤
        C5 * Q * ((sw * ed ^ (-d)) * Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)) := by
      rw [hQdef]
      calc NB B.h (princG5 B G Lh E γ m) k ξ ≤ C5 * qC B.h ξ ^ (-1:ℝ) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * sw *
            ed ^ (-d) * Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := hb5
        _ = _ := by ring
    have s1 : (sw * ed ^ (-d)) * Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) ≤
        K * Real.exp (-c * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2) := mul_le_mul hEdge hP hP0 hK0
    have s2 : C5 * Q ≤ |C5| * Q := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hQ0
    have s3 : C5 * Q * ((sw * ed ^ (-d)) * Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)) ≤
        |C5| * Q * (K * Real.exp (-c * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul s2 s1 (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hsw0 hedd0) hP0) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hQ0)
    rw [← hKdef]
    calc NB B.h (princG5 B G Lh E γ m) k ξ ≤ |C5| * Q * (K * Real.exp (-c * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2)) :=
          le_trans hb5' s3
      _ = |C5| * K * qC B.h ξ ^ (-1:ℝ) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * Real.exp (-c * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
          rw [hQdef]; ring
  have hflat := plin5_nb_gauss_flat B G hok l0 hqs (princG5 B G Lh E) c hcpos hsm
    (fun γ m ξ hξ hne => by
      obtain ⟨-, hS, -⟩ := hsupp γ m ξ hξ hne
      obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hXa', hXb'⟩ := hS
      exact ⟨hXa', hXb', hact γ m ξ hξ hne⟩) hgauss
  have hph := h8 l0 (by omega) (princG5 B G Lh E) hsm
    (fun γ m ξ hξ hne => ⟨(hsupp γ m ξ hξ hne).1, (hsupp γ m ξ hξ hne).2.1, hact γ m ξ hξ hne⟩) hflat
  have hFl : FlatS5 B l0 (tailG5 B G l0 (princG5 B G Lh E)) :=
    h9 l0 (by omega) (princG5 B G Lh E) (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (tailG5 B G l0 (princG5 B G Lh E))
      ⟨({1, -1} : Finset ℤ), fun γ m hm ξ hξ => by
        by_contra hne
        rcases (hsupp γ m ξ hξ hne).1 with rfl | rfl <;> simp at hm⟩
      (fun γ m ξ hξ hne => ⟨(hsupp γ m ξ hξ hne).2.1, hact γ m ξ hξ hne⟩)
      (fun i γ m => (hph i).1 γ m) (fun i k N => (hph i).2 k N)
      (fun x t Y h => if_pos h) (fun x t Y h => if_neg h)
  
  have hgc := e5
  obtain ⟨⟨Hg, hHg0, hHg⟩, -, -, hSg, -⟩ := hgc
  have hfin : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∃ (Γ : Finset Lab) (H : Finset ℤ), (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧
      ∀ γ m, (γ ∉ Γ ∨ m ∉ H) → g γ m ξ = 0 ∧ princG5 B G Lh E γ m ξ = 0 ∧
        linG5 B G D E γ m ξ = 0 := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
    obtain ⟨N, hN, Γ, hΓ⟩ := etaL_local_finite_v5 B.h hok.1 ξ hξ'.2.1
    have hS : ∀ γ, SuppW B G γ ξ → γ ∈ Γ := by
      intro γ hs
      obtain ⟨-, hts, -⟩ := hs
      exact hΓ γ ξ (mem_of_mem_nhds hN) hts
    refine ⟨Γ, insert 1 (insert (-1) Hg), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hmem
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hmem with h | hmem
      · norm_num at h
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hmem with h | h
      · norm_num at h
      · exact hHg0 h
    · intro γ m hγm
      have hgz : g γ m ξ = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        have hs := hSg γ m ξ hξ hne
        rcases hγm with hγ | hm
        · exact hγ (hS γ hs)
        · have hm' : m ∉ Hg := fun h => hm (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem h))
          exact hne (by rw [hHg γ m hm']; rfl)
      have hpz : princG5 B G Lh E γ m ξ = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        obtain ⟨hm1, hs, -⟩ := hsupp γ m ξ hξ hne
        rcases hγm with hγ | hm
        · exact hγ (hS γ hs)
        · apply hm
          rcases hm1 with rfl | rfl <;> simp
      refine ⟨hgz, hpz, ?_⟩
      rw [hid γ m ξ hξ, hgz, hpz, add_zero]
  have hsum : ∀ (F : Lab → ℤ → ℂ) (Γ : Finset Lab) (H : Finset ℤ),
      (∀ γ m, (γ ∉ Γ ∨ m ∉ H) → F γ m = 0) →
      ∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, F γ m = ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, F γ m := by
    intro F Γ H hF
    have hin : ∀ γ, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, F γ m = ∑ m ∈ H, F γ m := by
      intro γ
      apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
      intro m hm
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hm
      by_contra h
      exact hm (hF γ m (Or.inr (by simpa using h)))
    simp_rw [hin]
    apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
    intro γ hγ
    rw [Function.mem_support] at hγ
    by_contra h
    exact hγ (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun m _ => hF γ m (Or.inl (by simpa using h))))
  have hadd : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ θ : ℝ, waveV5 B G (linG5 B G D E) θ ξ =
      waveV5 B G g θ ξ + waveV5 B G (princG5 B G Lh E) θ ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ θ
    obtain ⟨Γ, H, -, hz⟩ := hfin ξ hξ
    funext i
    have f1 : ∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, linG5 B G D E γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ =
        ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, linG5 B G D E γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ :=
      hsum (fun γ m => linG5 B G D E γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ) Γ H (fun γ m h => by
        show linG5 B G D E γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ = 0
        rw [(hz γ m h).2.2]; simp)
    have f2 : ∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, g γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ =
        ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, g γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ :=
      hsum (fun γ m => g γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ) Γ H (fun γ m h => by
        show g γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ = 0
        rw [(hz γ m h).1]; simp)
    have f3 : ∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, princG5 B G Lh E γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ =
        ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, princG5 B G Lh E γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ :=
      hsum (fun γ m => princG5 B G Lh E γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ) Γ H (fun γ m h => by
        show princG5 B G Lh E γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ = 0
        rw [(hz γ m h).2.1]; simp)
    show (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, linG5 B G D E γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ).re =
      (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, g γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ).re +
      (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, princG5 B G Lh E γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ).re
    rw [f1, f2, f3, ← Complex.add_re, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
    rw [← add_mul]
    congr 1
    rw [hid γ m ξ hξ]
    rfl
  have hrot : ∀ r θ z : ℝ, 0 < r → rad (rotPt r θ z) = r ∧ rotPt r θ z 2 = z := by
    intro r θ z hr
    constructor
    · have h : (rotPt r θ z) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt r θ z) 1 ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
        simp [rotPt]
        rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, ← mul_add, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, mul_one]
      unfold rad
      rw [h, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
    · simp [rotPt]
  have hframe : ∀ (y : ℝ³), 0 < rad y → ∀ (v : Fin 3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
      inner ℝ (cyl2cart y v) (![eR y, eTh y, eZ] a) = v a := by
    intro y hy v a
    have hr2 : rad y ^ 2 = y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
    have hne : rad y ≠ 0 := hy.ne'
    have hs : (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) = 1 := by
      rw [← hr2]; field_simp
    fin_cases a <;>
      simp [cyl2cart, eR, eTh, eZ, radVec, azVec, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three] <;>
      first
      | linear_combination (v 0) * hs
      | linear_combination (v 1) * hs
  have hlin : ∀ (c' : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), thA (fun θ => c' * f θ) = c' * thA f := by
    intro c' f
    simp only [thA, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    ring
  refine ⟨g, tailG5 B G l0 (princG5 B G Lh E), e5, hFl, ?_⟩
  intro x t Y hxt
  have hxt' : 0 < rad x ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hxt
  have hξ : ptOf x t Y ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := hxt
  have hrx : 0 < rad x := hxt'.1
  have hmean : thAvgVec (sw5L B G l0 D E) x t Y = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨Γ, H, hH0, hz⟩ := hfin _ hξ
    have hcomp : ∀ a : Fin 3, thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (sw5L B G l0 D E (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y)
        (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) = 0 := by
      intro a
      have hfun : (fun θ => inner ℝ (sw5L B G l0 D E (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y)
          (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) =
          fun θ => qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) *
            waveS5 B G (fun γ m η => linG5 B G D E γ m η a) (thetaOf (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)))
              (ptOf x t Y) := by
        funext θ
        obtain ⟨hr, hzz⟩ := hrot (rad x) θ (x 2) hrx
        have hc : corrOn B l0 (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t := by
          show 0 < rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) ∧ t < 1 ∧
            simScale B.h ((rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0
          rw [hr, hzz]
          exact hxt'
        have hp : ptOf (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y = ptOf x t Y := by
          show (rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)), (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 2, t, Y) = (rad x, x 2, t, Y)
          rw [hr, hzz]
        rw [hrep _ t Y hc, hp, real_inner_smul_left]
        have hf : frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a =
            ![eR (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)), eTh (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)), eZ] a := rfl
        rw [hf, hframe _ (by rw [hr]; exact hrx)]
        rfl
      have h0 := (waveS5_circle_mean_zero B G (fun γ m η => linG5 B G D E γ m η a) (ptOf x t Y)
        (rad x) (x 2) H Γ hrx hH0 (fun γ m hm => by simp [(hz γ m (Or.inr hm)).2.2])
        (fun γ m hγ => by simp [(hz γ m (Or.inl hγ)).2.2])).2
      rw [hfun, hlin, h0, mul_zero]
    unfold thAvgVec
    have hzero : (fun a => thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (sw5L B G l0 D E (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y)
        (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a))) = fun _ => 0 := funext hcomp
    rw [hzero]
    simp [cyl2cart]
  have htail : tailG5 B G l0 (princG5 B G Lh E) x t Y = qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) •
      cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (princG5 B G Lh E) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y)) := if_pos hxt
  have hcy : ∀ (u v : Fin 3 → ℝ), cyl2cart x (u + v) = cyl2cart x u + cyl2cart x v := by
    intro u v
    simp only [cyl2cart, Pi.add_apply, add_smul]
    abel
  rw [hmean, sub_zero, hrep x t Y hxt, hadd _ hξ, htail, hcy, smul_add]

stress5_linear_harmonics.definitions:
noncomputable def linG5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (D : WC) (E : WS) : WC := fun γ m ξ =>
  let Ep : Cyl → ℂ := fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ)))
  (((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Ep ξ)⁻¹) •
    mresC B (m * pint5 B G γ)
      (mcurlC B.h (m * pint5 B G γ)
        (fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (Ep η • D γ m η)))
      (fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-2 * Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Ep η * E γ m η)) ξ

noncomputable def princG5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (c : WC) (E : WS) : WC := fun γ m ξ =>
  (((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
    (dVc B γ.1 (c γ m) ξ + (pulseMatC (Kmat B G γ ξ)).mulVec (c γ m ξ)
      + ((m : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((dDamp5 B G γ ξ : ℝ) : ℂ)) • c γ m ξ)
  + ((((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1/2 : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ)) * E γ m ξ)
      • nPhiC5 B G γ ξ

noncomputable def ampDG5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (c Lh : WC) : WC := fun γ m η =>
  wmoAmp5 B G c γ m η - (((rhoQ B γ η ^ (1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • Lh γ m η

open Classical in
noncomputable def tailG5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (a : WC) : Ext ℝ³ := fun x t Y =>
  if corrOn B l0 x t then qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) •
    cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G a (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y)) else 0

sw5_cross_harmonics.definitions:
noncomputable def cr5Vel (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (c : WC) : WC := fun γ m η =>
  ((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) • wmoAmp5 B G c γ m η
noncomputable def cr5Mc (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ) :=
  fun η i => ((mcor5 B G l0 S i η : ℝ) : ℂ)
noncomputable def cr5Ph (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (M : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℂ :=
  (((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))⁻¹)
noncomputable def cr5WW (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (H : Finset ℤ) (V V' : WC) : WC := fun γ M ξ =>
  ((1/2 : ℂ) * cr5Ph B G γ M ξ) •
    ∑ m ∈ H, ∑ m' ∈ H,
      ((if m + m' = M then pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ) (modeCoef5 B G V' γ m') ξ else 0) +
       (if m' - m = M then pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (fun a => starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ a))
          (modeCoef5 B G V' γ m') ξ else 0))
noncomputable def cr5MW (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (V : WC) : WC := fun γ m ξ =>
  cr5Ph B G γ m ξ • (pq5TrM B.h (m * pint5 B G γ) (cr5Mc B G l0 S ξ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m) ξ +
    pq5TrM B.h 0 (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ) (cr5Mc B G l0 S) ξ)
noncomputable def cr5Q (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (H : Finset ℤ) (Vo Vn : WC) : WC :=
  cr5WW B G H Vo Vn + cr5WW B G H Vn Vo + cr5MW B G l0 S Vn
noncomputable def cr5Osc (Q : WC) : WC := fun γ M ξ => if M = 0 then 0 else Q γ M ξ

and_nodes.definitions_block:
noncomputable def cr5Vel (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (c : WC) : WC := fun γ m η =>
  ((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) • wmoAmp5 B G c γ m η
noncomputable def cr5Mc (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ) :=
  fun η i => ((mcor5 B G l0 S i η : ℝ) : ℂ)
noncomputable def cr5Ph (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (M : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℂ :=
  (((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))⁻¹)
noncomputable def cr5WW (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (H : Finset ℤ) (V V' : WC) : WC := fun γ M ξ =>
  ((1/2 : ℂ) * cr5Ph B G γ M ξ) •
    ∑ m ∈ H, ∑ m' ∈ H,
      ((if m + m' = M then pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ) (modeCoef5 B G V' γ m') ξ else 0) +
       (if m' - m = M then pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (fun a => starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ a))
          (modeCoef5 B G V' γ m') ξ else 0))
noncomputable def cr5MW (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (V : WC) : WC := fun γ m ξ =>
  cr5Ph B G γ m ξ • (pq5TrM B.h (m * pint5 B G γ) (cr5Mc B G l0 S ξ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m) ξ +
    pq5TrM B.h 0 (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ) (cr5Mc B G l0 S) ξ)
noncomputable def cr5Q (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (H : Finset ℤ) (Vo Vn : WC) : WC :=
  cr5WW B G H Vo Vn + cr5WW B G H Vn Vo + cr5MW B G l0 S Vn
noncomputable def cr5Osc (Q : WC) : WC := fun γ M ξ => if M = 0 then 0 else Q γ M ξ

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (S : CState) (D : WC) (β1 β2 : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β1 S.Aw → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1/2) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β2 D → InM B (qsOf l0) (1/2) S.Psi → InM B (qsOf l0) (1/2) S.bdir → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → uX5 B G l0 S x t Y - pwrUB B x t Y = cyl2cart x (fun a => mcor5 B G l0 S a (ptOf x t Y)) + cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (cr5Vel B G S.Aw) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y)) ∧ sw5W B G l0 D x t Y = cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (cr5Vel B G D) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (S : CState) (D Vo Vn : WC) (H : Finset ℤ), (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Vo γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Vn γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ γ m, m ∉ H → Vo γ m = 0 ∧ Vn γ m = 0) → (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → (Vo γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) ∧ (Vn γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ)) → (∀ (γ γ' : Lab) (m m' : ℤ), γ ≠ γ' → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (Vo γ m ξ ≠ 0 → ξ ∉ tsupport (Vn γ' m')) ∧ (Vn γ m ξ ≠ 0 → ξ ∉ tsupport (Vo γ' m'))) → (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mcor5 B G l0 S a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → uX5 B G l0 S x t Y - pwrUB B x t Y = cyl2cart x (fun a => mcor5 B G l0 S a (ptOf x t Y)) + cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G Vo (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y)) ∧ sw5W B G l0 D x t Y = cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G Vn (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∃ T : Finset Lab, ∀ γ M, γ ∉ T → cr5Q B G l0 S H Vo Vn γ M ξ = 0) ∧ ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → sw5Cr B G l0 S D x t Y = (qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2))) • cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (cr5Q B G l0 S H Vo Vn) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))

subgoal_signatures.name: cr5_osc_split
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (F : Ext ℝ³) (Q : WC) (e : ℝ) (HQ : Finset ℤ), B.ok → (∀ γ M, M ∉ HQ → Q γ M = 0) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∃ T : Finset Lab, ∀ γ M, γ ∉ T → Q γ M ξ = 0) → (∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → F x t Y = (qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-e)) • cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G Q (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))) → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → F x t Y - thAvgVec F x t Y = (qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-e)) • cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (cr5Osc Q) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))

subgoal_signatures.name: pq5_label_disjoint

noncomputable def ssh5Vw (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (D : WC) : WC := fun γ m ξ =>
  ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-B.h) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • velW5 B G D γ m ξ
  + ((dZ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-B.h)) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) • ![-(D γ m ξ 1), D γ m ξ 0, 0]
noncomputable def ssh5TrM (h : ℝ) (n : ℤ) (U : Fin 3 → ℂ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℂ :=
  ![U 0 * dR h c ξ 0 + U 1 * (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (ξ.1 : ℂ) * c ξ 0) + U 2 * dZ c ξ 0 - U 1 * c ξ 1 / (ξ.1 : ℂ),
    U 0 * dR h c ξ 1 + U 1 * (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (ξ.1 : ℂ) * c ξ 1) + U 2 * dZ c ξ 1 + U 1 * c ξ 0 / (ξ.1 : ℂ),
    U 0 * dR h c ξ 2 + U 1 * (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (ξ.1 : ℂ) * c ξ 2) + U 2 * dZ c ξ 2]

  (((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))⁻¹) •
    ∑ m ∈ H, ∑ m' ∈ H,
      ((if m + m' = M then ssh5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') ξ
          else 0) +
       (if m' - m = M then ssh5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (fun i => starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ i))
          (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') ξ else 0))

    (w : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℂ := fun i =>
  ((Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (u 0 * dR B.h (fun η => w η i) ξ + u 2 * dZ (fun η => w η i) ξ)
  + ((Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) / ξ.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * u 1 * crossC ![0, 0, 1] (w ξ) i
  + ((-(Aex B.h) * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * u 2 * w ξ i
  + Complex.I * (s : ℂ) * (((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      dotProduct u (fun j => (nPhi5 B G γ ξ j : ℂ)) * w ξ i

  ((Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (u 0 * dR B.h (fun η => w η i) ξ + u 2 * dZ (fun η => w η i) ξ)
  + ((Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) / ξ.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * u 1 * crossC ![0, 0, 1] (w ξ) i
  + ((-(Aex B.h) * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * u 2 * w ξ i
  + Complex.I * (s : ℂ) * (((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      dotProduct u (fun j => (nPhi5 B G γ ξ j : ℂ)) * w ξ i
noncomputable def ssh5PF (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (H : Finset ℤ) (W : WC) : WC := fun γ M ξ =>
  if M = 0 then 0 else (1/2 : ℂ) • ∑ m ∈ H, ∑ m' ∈ H,
    ((if m + m' = M then ssh5T B G γ m' (W γ m ξ) (W γ m') ξ else 0) +
     (if m' - m = M then ssh5T B G γ m' (fun i => starRingEnd ℂ (W γ m ξ i)) (W γ m') ξ else 0))

      (nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) ξ.2.2.1)
      (frameAt θ ξ a))) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro a
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => inner ℝ
        (nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)
          (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) p.2.2.2.1) (frameAt p.1 p.2 a)) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      (hRes.comp hρ.contDiffOn hmapsΩ).inner ℝ (hfr a)
    have hI := cyl_param_integral_contDiffOn _ _ hDopen hg
    exact (contDiffOn_const.mul hI).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
  have hT2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => cyl2cart z.1 (fun a => thA (fun θ => inner ℝ
      (nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)
        (rotPt (Ψ z).1 θ (Ψ z).2.1) (Ψ z).2.2.1) (frameAt θ (Ψ z) a)))) Ω :=
    (((((hM 0).comp hΨ hΨmaps).smul heRΩ).add (((hM 1).comp hΨ hΨmaps).smul heThΩ)).add
      (((hM 2).comp hΨ hΨmaps).smul (contDiffOn_const (c := eZ)))).congr (fun z _ => rfl)
  
  have hWf := hWv f α hf
  have hT3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => qC B.h (Ψ z) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) •
      cyl2cart z.1 (waveV5 B G f (thetaOf z.1) (Ψ z))) Ω :=
    ((hQp (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2))).smul ((((hWf 0).smul heRΩ).add ((hWf 1).smul heThΩ)).add
      ((hWf 2).smul (contDiffOn_const (c := eZ))))).congr (fun z _ => rfl)
  
  refine ((hRes.sub hT2).sub hT3).congr (fun z hz => ?_)
  obtain ⟨x, t⟩ := z
  have hz' : corrOn B l0 x t := hz
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ rad x := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have h := hid x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀) hz'
  have hrr : ∀ θ : ℝ, resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (PX5 B G l0 S) (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t
      (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀) =
      nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t := by
    intro θ
    show nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀ - Yph B.h (rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) t))
      (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀ - Yph B.h (rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) t))
      (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t = _
    rw [hradrot _ _ _ hx0, add_sub_cancel_left]
  have hR : resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (PX5 B G l0 S) x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀) =
      nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) x t := by
    show nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀ - Yph B.h (rad x) t))
      (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀ - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) x t = _
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
  have hΘ : thAvgVec (resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (PX5 B G l0 S)) x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀) =
      cyl2cart x (fun a => thA (fun θ => inner ℝ
        (nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t)
        (frameAt θ (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) a))) := by
    unfold thAvgVec
    simp only [hrr]
  rw [hΘ, hR] at h
  have hF := eq_sub_of_add_eq ((add_comm _ _).trans h.symm)
  show Fl x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀) = _
  rw [hF]

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  have hSim : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  have hBP := hok.2
  unfold BackgroundProps at hBP
  obtain ⟨hB0, -⟩ := hBP
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hB0
  have hXb : 0 < B.Xb := by linarith
  obtain ⟨lw, hw⟩ := ipb5_wave_vec_conversion B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lm, hmc⟩ := ipb5_mean_conversion B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lo, ho⟩ := sw5_O1_flat_smooth B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n0 + lw + lm + lo, fun l0 hl0 => ?_⟩
  
  have hqcont : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
    have hmap : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      (((EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.comp continuous_fst).prodMk
        (continuous_const.sub continuous_snd))
    refine hSim.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.comp hmap.continuousOn ?_
    intro w hw
    exact ⟨mem_univ _, mem_Ioi.mpr (sub_pos.mpr hw)⟩
  have hΩ : IsOpen (simDomain B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have e : simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
        (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := rfl
    rw [e]
    exact hqcont.isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const) isOpen_Iio
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqs0 : 0 < qsOf l0 := by rw [hQb]; positivity
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0.le
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (by simp)
  have hq : ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) →
      0 < simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ≤ 1 := by
    intro x t hxt
    have hxt' : t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hxt
    exact ⟨(hSim.1 (x 2) (1 - t) (by linarith [hxt'.1])).1, le_trans hxt'.2.le hqs1⟩
  have key2 : ∀ (C a b q : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → b ≤ a → C * q ^ a ≤ |C| * q ^ b := by
    intro C a b q hq0 hq1 hba
    calc C * q ^ a ≤ |C| * q ^ a :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)
      _ ≤ |C| * q ^ b :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1 hba) (abs_nonneg C)
  have hmle : ∀ m : ℕ, ((m : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := fun m => by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hcd := corr_domain_v5 B l0 0 hok
  have hUo : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} := hcd.1
  have hERU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => eR w.1) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} :=
    hcd.2.2.2.2.1.comp contDiffOn_fst (fun w hw => hw.1)
  have hUΩ : {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} ⊆ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) :=
    fun w hw => ⟨hw.2.1, hw.2.2⟩
  
  have assemble : ∀ (m : ℕ) (Res A1 A2 A3 A4 A5 A6 A7 : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ³) (z : ℝ³ × ℝ),
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Res z → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A1 z → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A2 z → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A4 z →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A5 z → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A6 z → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A7 z →
      (Res =ᶠ[nhds z] fun w => A1 w + A2 w + A3 w + A4 w + A5 w + A6 w - A7 w) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Res z‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A1 z‖ + ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A2 z‖ +
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A3 z‖ + ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A4 z‖ + ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A5 z‖ +
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A6 z‖ + ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A7 z‖ := by
    intro m Res A1 A2 A3 A4 A5 A6 A7 z hR h1 h2 h4 h5 h6 h7 hEq
    have c : ∀ {f : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ³}, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f z → ContDiffAt ℝ (m : ℕ) f z :=
      fun hf => hf.of_le (hmle m)
    have hG : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (A1 + A2 + A4 + A5 + A6 - A7) z :=
      ((((h1.add h2).add h4).add h5).add h6).sub h7
    have hEv : (Res - (A1 + A2 + A4 + A5 + A6 - A7)) =ᶠ[nhds z] A3 := by
      refine hEq.mono (fun w hw => ?_)
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, hw]
      abel
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (Res - (A1 + A2 + A4 + A5 + A6 - A7)) z =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Res z - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (A1 + A2 + A4 + A5 + A6 - A7) z :=
      iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply (c hR) (c hG)
    have e2 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (Res - (A1 + A2 + A4 + A5 + A6 - A7)) z = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A3 z :=
      (hEv.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds
    have e3 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (A1 + A2 + A4 + A5 + A6 - A7) z =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A1 z + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A2 z + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A4 z +
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A5 z + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A6 z - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A7 z := by
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply (f := A1 + A2 + A4 + A5 + A6) (g := A7)
          (c ((((h1.add h2).add h4).add h5).add h6)) (c h7),
        iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (f := A1 + A2 + A4 + A5) (g := A6)
          (c (((h1.add h2).add h4).add h5)) (c h6),
        iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (f := A1 + A2 + A4) (g := A5) (c ((h1.add h2).add h4)) (c h5),
        iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (f := A1 + A2) (g := A4) (c (h1.add h2)) (c h4),
        iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (f := A1) (g := A2) (c h1) (c h2)]
    have hsplit : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Res z = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A3 z +
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A1 z + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A2 z + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A4 z +
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A5 z + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A6 z - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A7 z) := by
      rw [← e2, e1, e3]; abel
    rw [hsplit]
    generalize iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A1 z = D1
    generalize iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A2 z = D2
    generalize iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A3 z = D3
    generalize iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A4 z = D4
    generalize iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A5 z = D5
    generalize iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A6 z = D6
    generalize iteratedFDeriv ℝ m A7 z = D7
    have n1 := norm_add_le D3 (D1 + D2 + D4 + D5 + D6 - D7)
    have n2 := norm_sub_le (D1 + D2 + D4 + D5 + D6) D7
    have n3 := norm_add_le (D1 + D2 + D4 + D5) D6
    have n4 := norm_add_le (D1 + D2 + D4) D5
    have n5 := norm_add_le (D1 + D2) D4
    have n6 := norm_add_le D1 D2
    linarith
  have heZ : ∀ (m : ℕ) (Z : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ) (z : ℝ³ × ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Z z →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w => Z w • eZ) z‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Z z‖ := by
    intro m Z z hZ
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_smul_const_apply (hZ.of_le (hmle m))]
    refine (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
    have hn : ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).smulRight eZ‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply]
      have h1 : ‖eZ‖ = 1 := by
        simp only [eZ, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one]
      rw [h1, mul_one]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id_le
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hn
  
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : ℝ, e = -(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Lw, hLw, HW⟩ := hw l0 (by omega) e
  obtain ⟨Lm, hLm, HM⟩ := hmc l0 (by omega) e
  obtain ⟨Lbar, hLbar⟩ : ∃ Lb : ℕ → ℝ, Lb = fun m => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), Lm i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hLbar0 : ∀ m, 0 ≤ Lbar m := fun m => by
    rw [hLbar]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hLm i)
  have hLmle : ∀ m i, i ≤ m → Lm i ≤ Lbar m := fun m i hi => by
    rw [hLbar]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := Lm) (fun j _ => hLm j) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  refine ⟨fun m => Lw m + Lbar m + m, fun m => by
    have := hLw m; have := hLbar0 m; have : (0:ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.cast_nonneg m; linarith, ?_⟩
  intro S bw ca cm cd hSt hMI m N
  show ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) →

    · have hf : frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) 1 = (rad (rotPt r θ z))⁻¹ • azVec (rotPt r θ z) := rfl
      rw [hf, real_inner_smul_right, hrad]
      exact congrArg (fun v => r⁻¹ * v) hEq
    · have hf : frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) 2 = EuclideanSpace.single 2 1 := rfl
      rw [hf, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, conj_trivial, one_mul]
      exact hUq
  have hind : ∀ (θ : ℝ) (b : Fin 3),
      inner ℝ (uB B (rotPt r θ z) t) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) b) = ubase B (r, z, t, Y) b := by
    intro θ b
    obtain ⟨k0, k1, k2⟩ := key θ
    obtain ⟨m0, m1, m2⟩ := key 0
    obtain rfl | rfl | rfl : b = 0 ∨ b = 1 ∨ b = 2 := by fin_cases b <;> simp
    · exact k0.trans m0.symm
    · exact k1.trans m1.symm
    · exact k2.trans m2.symm
  have hu : ∀ (θ : ℝ) (b : Fin 3), ucyl5 B G l0 S θ (r, z, t, Y) b = ubase B (r, z, t, Y) b := by
    intro θ b
    show inner ℝ (uX5 B G l0 S (rotPt r θ z) t Y) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) b) = _
    rw [huX θ]
    exact hind θ b
  
  have hthc : ∀ c0 : ℝ, thA (fun _ => c0) = c0 := by
    intro c0
    simp only [thA]
    have hπ : (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, sub_zero, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hπ, one_mul]
  show thA (fun θ => (ucyl5 B G l0 S θ (r, z, t, Y) a - thA (fun θ' => ucyl5 B G l0 S θ' (r, z, t, Y) a)) *
      (ucyl5 B G l0 S θ (r, z, t, Y) c - thA (fun θ' => ucyl5 B G l0 S θ' (r, z, t, Y) c))) = 0
  simp only [hu, hthc, sub_self, mul_zero]

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState), IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => ubase B ξ a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mcor5 B G l0 S a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Wcov5 B G l0 S a b) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (grP5 B G l0 S) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 S hD hub hmc hW
  have hcl : ∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dT f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro f hf
    have hDf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hD).1 hf).2
    have hpow : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      contDiff_fst.contDiffOn.rpow_const_of_ne
        (fun ξ (hξ : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0) => hξ.1.ne')
    have hY : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)
        (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      (contDiffOn_const.mul hpow).smul_const _
    have hvR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl =>
        ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk hY))
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (hDf.clm_apply hvR).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
    · exact (hDf.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
    · exact (hDf.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
  have hne : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ.1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have h : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
    exact h.1.ne'
  have hne2 : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ.1 ^ 2 ≠ 0 := fun ξ hξ => pow_ne_zero 2 (hne ξ hξ)
  have hfst : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.1) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := contDiff_fst.contDiffOn
  have hβs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mcor5 B G l0 S 0) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := hmc 0
  have hvs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mcor5 B G l0 S 1) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := hmc 1
  have hγs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mcor5 B G l0 S 2) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := hmc 2
  have hF0s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η ^ 2
      + Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 0 η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have h := ((((contDiffOn_const (c := (2:ℝ))).mul (hub 0)).mul hβs).add (hβs.pow 2)).add (hW 0 0)
    exact h
  have hF2s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + ubase B η 2 * mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η
      + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 0 η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have h := ((((hub 0).mul hγs).add ((hub 2).mul hβs)).add (hβs.mul hγs)).add (hW 2 0)
    exact h
  have hF11 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 1 * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η + mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η ^ 2
      + Wcov5 B G l0 S 1 1 η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have h := ((((contDiffOn_const (c := (2:ℝ))).mul (hub 1)).mul hvs).add (hvs.pow 2)).add (hW 1 1)
    exact h
  have hdβ := hcl _ hβs
  have hdRRβ := (hcl _ hdβ.1).1
  have hdZZβ := (hcl _ hdβ.2.1).2.1
  have hdRF0 := (hcl _ hF0s).1
  have hdZF2 := (hcl _ hF2s).2.1
  have hR := (((((contDiffOn_const (c := (0:ℝ))).sub hdβ.2.2).sub (hdRF0.add (hF0s.div hfst hne))).sub
    hdZF2).add (hF11.div hfst hne)).add
    (((hdRRβ.add (hdβ.1.div hfst hne)).add hdZZβ).sub (hβs.div (hfst.pow 2) hne2))
  exact hR.congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
