signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState), B.ok → (∀ a : Fin 3, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ = 0) → (∀ a c : Fin 3, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → Wcov5 B G l0 S a c ξ = 0) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → grP5 B G l0 S ξ = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 S hok hm hWv ξ hξ hX
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, hsv⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  have SV0 := hm 0
  have SV1 := hm 1
  have SV2 := hm 2
  have SVF0 : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h η < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h η) →
      (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η ^ 2
        + Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 0 η) η = 0 := by
    intro η hη hX'
    simp only [SV0 η hη hX', hWv 0 0 η hη hX']
    ring
  have SVF2 : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h η < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h η) →
      (fun η => ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + ubase B η 2 * mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η
        + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 0 η) η = 0 := by
    intro η hη hX'
    simp only [SV0 η hη hX', SV2 η hη hX', hWv 2 0 η hη hX']
    ring
  have hRF0 := (hsv _ SVF0 ξ hξ hX).1
  have hZF2 := (hsv _ SVF2 ξ hξ hX).2.1
  have hb3 := hsv (mcor5 B G l0 S 0) SV0
  obtain ⟨hRβ, -, hTβ⟩ := hb3 ξ hξ hX
  have hRR := (hsv (dR B.h (mcor5 B G l0 S 0)) (fun η hη hX' => (hb3 η hη hX').1) ξ hξ hX).1
  have hZZ := (hsv (dZ (mcor5 B G l0 S 0)) (fun η hη hX' => (hb3 η hη hX').2.1) ξ hξ hX).2.1
  show (0:ℝ) - dT (mcor5 B G l0 S 0) ξ
      - (dR B.h (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η ^ 2
          + Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 0 η) ξ
        + (2 * ubase B ξ 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 0 ξ + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 ξ ^ 2 + Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 0 ξ) / ξ.1)
      - dZ (fun η => ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + ubase B η 2 * mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η
          + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 0 η) ξ
      + (2 * ubase B ξ 1 * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 ξ + mcor5 B G l0 S 1 ξ ^ 2 + Wcov5 B G l0 S 1 1 ξ) / ξ.1
      + ((dR B.h (dR B.h (mcor5 B G l0 S 0)) ξ + dR B.h (mcor5 B G l0 S 0) ξ / ξ.1
          + dZ (dZ (mcor5 B G l0 S 0)) ξ) - mcor5 B G l0 S 0 ξ / ξ.1 ^ 2) = 0
  rw [hTβ, hRF0, hZF2, hRR, hRβ, hZZ, SV0 ξ hξ hX, SV1 ξ hξ hX, hWv 0 0 ξ hξ hX, hWv 1 1 ξ hξ hX]
  simp

by
  intro B G l0 S hok hgr hgv hub hmc hWc hmv hWv hdvs hdvv hΓs hΓv hDgs hDgv hMn z t ht hq
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqs0 : 0 < qsOf l0 := by rw [hQb]; positivity
  obtain ⟨hlin, hcongr, -, -⟩ := mom_moment_linear_v5 B (qsOf l0) hok hqs0
  
  have gadd : ∀ f g : Cyl → ℝ, MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) f → MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) g →
      MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (fun η => f η + g η) := fun f g hf hg =>
    ⟨hf.1.add hg.1, fun ξ hξ hx => by simp [hf.2 ξ hξ hx, hg.2 ξ hξ hx]⟩
  have gmul : ∀ f g : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) g →
      MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (fun η => f η * g η) := fun f g hf hg =>
    ⟨hf.mul hg.1, fun ξ hξ hx => by simp [hg.2 ξ hξ hx]⟩
  have gpow : ∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) f → MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (fun η => f η ^ 2) :=
    fun f hf => ⟨hf.1.pow 2, fun ξ hξ hx => by simp [hf.2 ξ hξ hx]⟩
  
  have hgrG : MomGood5 B (qsOf l0) (grP5 B G l0 S) := ⟨hgr, hgv⟩
  have hDgG : MomGood5 B (qsOf l0)

∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs →
    (∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ) (c d : ℝ) (e : ℕ) (z t : ℝ), MomGood5 B qs f → MomGood5 B qs g →
      t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qs →
      radMom (fun η => c * f η + d * g η) e z t = c * radMom f e z t + d * radMom g e z t) ∧
    (∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ) (e : ℕ) (z t : ℝ), (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, f ξ = g ξ) →
      t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qs → radMom f e z t = radMom g e z t) ∧
    (∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ) (cf cg : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), MomGood5 B qs f → MomGood5 B qs g →
      ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs,
        Icut B (fun η => (f η + g η) - rhoP B η * (cf η.2.1 η.2.2.1 + cg η.2.1 η.2.2.1)) ξ =
          Icut B (fun η => f η - rhoP B η * cf η.2.1 η.2.2.1) ξ +
            Icut B (fun η => g η - rhoP B η * cg η.2.1 η.2.2.1) ξ) ∧
    (∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ), (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, f ξ = g ξ) →
      ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, Icut B f ξ = Icut B g ξ)

              unfold edgeDist; rw [h, h']
            have hle1 : Real.log (B.Xb / X) ≤ 1 := by rw [← hE]; exact hED1
            calc edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ^ (-d)
                ≤ Real.exp (-(B.ab / Real.log (B.Xb / X) ^ 2)) * Real.log (B.Xb / X) ^ (-d) := by
                  rw [hEW, hE]
                  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Real.rpow_nonneg hdb.le _)
                  exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
              _ ≤ (m.factorial : ℝ) / B.ab ^ m := core _ _ _ _ hab hdb hle1 hdm
              _ ≤ _ := by linarith
      obtain ⟨-, -, -, hf4⟩ := hf
      choose Cc bb dd hCbd using hf4
      choose M hM0 hM using fun j => edge (dd j)
      refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cc i| * M i, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i|, ?_⟩
      intro ξ hξ hX1 hX2 j hj
      have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qs := hξ
      have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ'.2.1])).1
      have hjr : j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
      have hP : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
      have hL1 : 1 ≤ 1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| := by
        have := abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ)); linarith
      have hS1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
        show 1 ≤ (1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)|) ^ 2
        nlinarith
      have hbj : bb j ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i| :=
        le_trans (le_abs_self _)
          (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |bb i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) hjr)
      have hSb : SC B.h ξ ^ bb j ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i|) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 hbj
      have hSbj0 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bb j := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have hSb0 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i|) :=
        Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have hEW0 : 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) := by
        unfold edgeWeight; split_ifs
        · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
        · exact le_rfl
      have hX0 : 0 < XC B.h ξ := lt_trans hXa hX1
      have hED0 : 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) :=
        lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX1))
          (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr hX2)))
      have hE0 : 0 ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-dd j) := Real.rpow_nonneg hED0.le _
      have hWt := hM j (XC B.h ξ) hX1 hX2
      have hAj : |Cc j| * M j ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cc i| * M i :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cc i| * M i)
          (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (hM0 i)) hjr
      have hSeq : SC B.h ξ ^ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i|) =
          (1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)|) ^ (2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i|) := by
        show ((1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)|) ^ 2) ^ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i|) = _
        rw [← Real.rpow_two, ← Real.rpow_mul (by linarith)]
      calc NB B.h u j ξ
          ≤ Cc j * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bb j *
              edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-dd j) :=
            hCbd j ξ hξ hX1 hX2
        _ = Cc j * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * (SC B.h ξ ^ bb j *
              (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
                edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-dd j)))) := by ring
        _ ≤ |Cc j| * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) *
              (SC B.h ξ ^ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i|) * M j)) := by
            apply mul_le_mul (le_abs_self _) _
              (mul_nonneg hP (mul_nonneg hSbj0 (mul_nonneg hEW0 hE0))) (abs_nonneg _)
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hP
            exact mul_le_mul hSb hWt (mul_nonneg hEW0 hE0) hSb0
        _ = (|Cc j| * M j) * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) *
              SC B.h ξ ^ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i|)) := by ring
        _ ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cc i| * M i) * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) *
              SC B.h ξ ^ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i|)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAj (mul_nonneg hP hSb0)
        _ = _ := by rw [hSeq]; ring
    choose Cc bb dd hCbd using hF.2.2.2
    obtain ⟨A, b₂, hAG⟩ := unif β (nrm B e₂ g) hG k
    obtain ⟨Bb, hBb⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Dd, hDd⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dd i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cc i|) * |A|, Bb + b₂, Dd, ?_⟩
    intro ξ hξ hX1 hX2
    have hq0 := hq ξ hξ
    have hNB0 : ∀ (w : Cyl → ℝ) (j : ℕ), 0 ≤ NB B.h w j ξ := fun w j => norm_nonneg _
    have hev : nrm B (e₁ + e₂) (fun ξ => f ξ * g ξ) =ᶠ[nhds ξ]
        (fun η => nrm B e₁ f η * nrm B e₂ g η) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hDopen.mem_nhds hξ) hpt
    have hNBeq : NB B.h (nrm B (e₁ + e₂) (fun ξ => f ξ * g ξ)) k ξ =
        NB B.h (fun η => nrm B e₁ f η * nrm B e₂ g η) k ξ := by
      unfold NB
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
    have hLb := leibR _ hDopen _ _ hF.1 hG.1 ξ hξ k
    have hP : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
    have hPb : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * β) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
    have hL1 : 1 ≤ 1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| := by
      have := abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ)); linarith
    have hS1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
      show 1 ≤ (1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)|) ^ 2
      nlinarith
    have hEW0 : 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) := by
      unfold edgeWeight; split_ifs
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      · exact le_rfl
    have hX0 : 0 < XC B.h ξ := lt_trans hXa hX1
    have hED0 : 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) :=
      lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX1))
        (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr hX2)))
    have hED1 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
    have hSB0 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ Bb := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    have hDD0 : 0 ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-Dd) := Real.rpow_nonneg hED0.le _
    obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ Bb *
        edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-Dd) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Y, hY⟩ : ∃ y : ℝ, y = qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * β) * (1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)|) ^ (2 * b₂) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hY0 : 0 ≤ Y := by rw [hY]; exact mul_nonneg hPb (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
    have hFi : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), NB B.h (nrm B e₁ f) i ξ ≤ |Cc i| * X := by
      intro i hi
      have hbi : bb i ≤ Bb := by
        rw [hBb]
        exact le_trans (le_abs_self _)
          (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |bb i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) hi)
      have hdi : dd i ≤ Dd := by
        rw [hDd]
        exact le_trans (le_abs_self _)
          (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |dd i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) hi)
      have h1 : SC B.h ξ ^ bb i ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ Bb := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 hbi
      have h2 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-dd i) ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-Dd) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hED0 hED1 (by linarith)
      have h1' : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bb i := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have h2' : 0 ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-dd i) := Real.rpow_nonneg hED0.le _
      calc NB B.h (nrm B e₁ f) i ξ
          ≤ Cc i * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bb i *
              edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-dd i) :=
            hCbd i ξ hξ hX1 hX2
        _ = Cc i * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bb i *
              edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-dd i)) := by
            ring
        _ ≤ |Cc i| * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ Bb *
              edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-Dd)) := by
            apply mul_le_mul (le_abs_self _) _
              (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hP h1') hEW0) h2') (abs_nonneg _)
            exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hP) hEW0) h2 h2'
              (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hP hSB0) hEW0)
        _ = |Cc i| * X := by rw [hX]
    have hGj : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB B.h (nrm B e₂ g) j ξ ≤ |A| * Y := by
      intro j hj
      calc NB B.h (nrm B e₂ g) j ξ
          ≤ A * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * β) * (1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)|) ^ (2 * b₂) := hAG ξ hξ hX1 hX2 j hj
        _ = A * Y := by rw [hY]; ring
        _ ≤ |A| * Y := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hY0
    have hSC0 : 0 < SC B.h ξ := by linarith
    have hSeq : SC B.h ξ ^ b₂ = (1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)|) ^ (2 * b₂) := by
      show ((1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)|) ^ 2) ^ b₂ = _
      rw [← Real.rpow_two, ← Real.rpow_mul (by linarith)]
    calc NB B.h (nrm B (e₁ + e₂) (fun ξ => f ξ * g ξ)) k ξ
        = NB B.h (fun η => nrm B e₁ f η * nrm B e₂ g η) k ξ := hNBeq
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
            (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h (nrm B e₁ f) i ξ * NB B.h (nrm B e₂ g) (k - i) ξ := hLb
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ((k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cc i|) * (|A| * (X * Y)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          have hik : k - i ≤ k := Nat.sub_le k i
          have hm := mul_le_mul (hFi i hi) (hGj (k - i) hik) (hNB0 _ _)
            (le_trans (hNB0 _ _) (hFi i hi))
          calc (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h (nrm B e₁ f) i ξ * NB B.h (nrm B e₂ g) (k - i) ξ
              = (k.choose i : ℝ) * (NB B.h (nrm B e₁ f) i ξ * NB B.h (nrm B e₂ g) (k - i) ξ) := by
                ring
            _ ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * ((|Cc i| * X) * (|A| * Y)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
            _ = ((k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cc i|) * (|A| * (X * Y)) := by ring
      _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cc i|) * (|A| * (X * Y)) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cc i|) * |A| *
            qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α + β)) * SC B.h ξ ^ (Bb + b₂) *
            edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-Dd) := by
          rw [hX, hY, show B.h * (α + β) = B.h * α + B.h * β by ring, Real.rpow_add hq0,
            Real.rpow_add hSC0, hSeq]
          ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → SimNorm B.h → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (α e : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B e f) → InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (e + Aex B.h) (fun ξ => ubase B ξ 1 * f ξ)) ∧ InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (e + Aex B.h) (fun ξ => ubase B ξ 2 * f ξ))

signature.name: inm_ubase_mul_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → SimNorm B.h → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (α e : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B e f) → InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (e + Aex B.h) (fun ξ => ubase B ξ 1 * f ξ)) ∧ InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (e + Aex B.h) (fun ξ => ubase B ξ 2 * f ξ))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hB _
  obtain ⟨-, -, hXa, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hB.2.1
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, hc6, ⟨hGE, hGU, -, -⟩, -⟩ := hB.2
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hB.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  
  have hqpos : ∀ η : Cyl, η.2.2.1 < 1 → 0 < qC B.h η := fun η h =>
    (hS.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hqC' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      (contDiff_snd.fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
    exact h1.comp h2.contDiffOn (fun η (hη : η.2.2.1 < 1) =>
      ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith)⟩)
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
    hqC'.mono (fun η hη => hη.2.1)
  have hDog : ∀ s : ℝ, IsOpen (DomC B.h s) := by
    intro s
    have hT : IsOpen {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd.snd.fst continuous_const
    have h1 : IsOpen ({η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} ∩ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) ⁻¹' Iio s) :=
      hqC'.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hT isOpen_Iio
    have h2 : IsOpen {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst
    have e : DomC B.h s = {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} ∩
        ({η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} ∩ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) ⁻¹' Iio s) := by
      ext η
      exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2⟩, fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2⟩⟩
    rw [e]; exact h2.inter h1
  have hDo : IsOpen (DomC B.h B.qB) := hDog B.qB
  have hne : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, qC B.h η ≠ 0 := fun η hη => (hqpos η hη.2.1).ne'
  have hφ1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Real.log (qC B.h η)) (DomC B.h B.qB) := hqC.log hne
  have hφ2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (XC B.h) (DomC B.h B.qB) := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ 2) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
      (contDiff_fst.pow 2).contDiffOn
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => 2 * qC B.h η) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
      contDiffOn_const.mul hqC
    exact (h1.div h2 (fun η hη => mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (hne η hη))).congr (fun η _ => rfl)
  have hφ3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (etaC B.h) (DomC B.h B.qB) := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => η.2.1) (DomC B.h B.qB) := contDiff_snd.fst.contDiffOn
    exact (h1.mul (hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (p := -(1/2 - B.h)) hne)).congr (fun η _ => rfl)
  have hWo : IsOpen (Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) :=
    isOpen_Iio.prod (isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo)
  have hmaps : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, (Real.log (qC B.h η), XC B.h η, etaC B.h η) ∈
      Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    intro η hη
    have hqη := hqpos η hη.2.1
    have hs : 0 < qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - B.h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hqη _
    have hs2 : (qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - B.h)) ^ 2 = qC B.h η ^ (1 - 2 * B.h) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hqη.le]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
    have hz : η.2.1 ^ 2 < (qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - B.h)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hs2]; exact (hS.2.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith [hη.2.1])).2
    have habs := abs_lt.mp (abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq hz hs.le)
    have he : etaC B.h η = η.2.1 / qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - B.h) := by
      unfold etaC; rw [Real.rpow_neg hqη.le]; exact (div_eq_mul_inv _ _).symm
    refine Set.mk_mem_prod (Set.mem_Iio.mpr (Real.log_lt_log hqη hη.2.2))
      (Set.mk_mem_prod (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr ?_) (Set.mem_Ioo.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩))
    · exact div_pos (pow_pos hη.1 2) (mul_pos two_pos hqη)
    · rw [he, lt_div_iff₀ hs]; linarith
    · rw [he, div_lt_iff₀ hs]; linarith
  have hGEs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => logLift B.Eb (Real.log (qC B.h η), XC B.h η, etaC B.h η))
      (DomC B.h B.qB) := hGE.comp (hφ1.prodMk (hφ2.prodMk hφ3)) hmaps
  have hGUs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => logLift B.Ub (Real.log (qC B.h η), XC B.h η, etaC B.h η))
      (DomC B.h B.qB) := hGU.comp (hφ1.prodMk (hφ2.prodMk hφ3)) hmaps
  
  have hrep : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB,
      logLift B.Eb (Real.log (qC B.h η), XC B.h η, etaC B.h η) = qC B.h η ^ Aex B.h * ubase B η 1 ∧
      logLift B.Ub (Real.log (qC B.h η), XC B.h η, etaC B.h η) = qC B.h η ^ Aex B.h * ubase B η 2 := by
    intro η hη
    have hqη : 0 < qC B.h η := hqpos η hη.2.1
    have hr0 : η.1 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hη.1
    have hx0 : (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) 0 = η.1 := by simp [rotPt]
    have hx1 : (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) 1 = 0 := by simp [rotPt]
    have hx2 : (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) 2 = η.2.1 := by simp [rotPt]
    have hsq : (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) 1 ^ 2 = η.1 ^ 2 := by
      rw [hx0, hx1]; ring
    have hrad : rad (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) = η.1 := by
      unfold rad; rw [hsq]; exact Real.sqrt_sq hη.1.le
    have hS2 : simScale B.h ((rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) 2) (1 - η.2.2.1) = qC B.h η := by
      rw [hx2]; rfl
    have hmem : ((rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1), η.2.2.1) ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB :=
      ⟨hη.2.1, by show simScale B.h ((rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) 2) (1 - η.2.2.1) < B.qB; rw [hS2]; exact hη.2.2⟩
    have hpos : 0 < (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) 1 ^ 2 := by
      rw [hsq]; exact pow_pos hη.1 2
    obtain ⟨h6a, h6b, -⟩ := hc6 (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) η.2.2.1 hmem hpos
    have hsX : simX B.h (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) η.2.2.1 = XC B.h η := by
      unfold simX XC; rw [hsq, hS2]
    have hsE : simEta B.h (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) η.2.2.1 = etaC B.h η := by
      unfold simEta etaC; rw [hS2, hx2]
    rw [hS2, hsX, hsE, hsq, Real.sqrt_sq hη.1.le] at h6a
    rw [hS2, hsX, hsE] at h6b
    have hl : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, logLift g (Real.log (qC B.h η), XC B.h η, etaC B.h η) =
        g (qC B.h η) (XC B.h η) (etaC B.h η) := by
      intro g; unfold logLift; rw [Real.exp_log hqη]
    have hu1 : ubase B η 1 = qC B.h η ^ (-(1/2 + B.h)) * B.Eb (qC B.h η) (XC B.h η) (etaC B.h η) := by
      show inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => B.AB w η.2.2.1) (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) + B.BvB (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) η.2.2.1)
        (eTh (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1)) = _
      rw [eTh, real_inner_smul_right, h6a, hrad, mul_assoc η.1, ← mul_assoc η.1⁻¹,
        inv_mul_cancel₀ hr0, one_mul]
    have hu2 : ubase B η 2 = qC B.h η ^ (-(1/2 + B.h)) * B.Ub (qC B.h η) (XC B.h η) (etaC B.h η) := by
      have hz : ∀ v : ℝ³, inner ℝ v eZ = v 2 := by
        intro v; simp [eZ, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
      show inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => B.AB w η.2.2.1) (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) + B.BvB (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) η.2.2.1)
        eZ = _
      rw [hz, h6b]
    have hA : qC B.h η ^ Aex B.h * qC B.h η ^ (-(1/2 + B.h)) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hqη, show Aex B.h + -(1/2 + B.h) = 0 by unfold Aex; ring, Real.rpow_zero]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hl, hu1, ← mul_assoc, hA, one_mul]
    · rw [hl, hu2, ← mul_assoc, hA, one_mul]
  
  choose C3 hC3 using outer_profile_bounds_v5 B hB
  have h4 : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, 1 ≤ i →
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.log (qC B.h η)) i ξ ≤ C := by
    intro i
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with hi | hi
    · exact ⟨0, fun ξ _ h => absurd h (by omega)⟩
    · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := logqC_nb_v5 B hB i hi
      exact ⟨C, fun ξ hξ _ => hC ξ hξ⟩
  choose C4 hC4 using h4
  choose C5 hC5 using xc_etac_nb_v5 B hB
  have hcomp : ∀ (G : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) →
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m G (Real.log (qC B.h ξ), XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ)‖ ≤ |C3 m|) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → ∀ i, i ≤ k →
        NB B.h (fun η => G (Real.log (qC B.h η), XC B.h η, etaC B.h η)) i ξ ≤ M := by
    intro G hG hGb k
    have hsum : ∀ (g : ℕ → ℝ) (j : ℕ), j ≤ k → |g j| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |g i| :=
      fun g j hj => Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |g i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
    have hs0 : ∀ g : ℕ → ℝ, 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |g i| :=
      fun g => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
    obtain ⟨SG, hSG⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |C3 i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |C4 i| +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |C5 i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hSG0 : 0 ≤ SG := by rw [hSG]; exact hs0 C3
    have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by rw [hD]; linarith [hs0 C4, hs0 C5]
    refine ⟨(k.factorial : ℝ) * SG * (3 * D) ^ k, fun ξ hξU hX1 hX2 i hi => ?_⟩
    have hX2' : XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb := by linarith
    have h := nb_comp3_v5 B.h (DomC B.h B.qB) _ ξ G (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) (XC B.h) (etaC B.h)
      i SG D hDo hWo hξU hG hφ1 hφ2 hφ3 hmaps hD1
      (fun m hm => (hGb m ξ hξU hX1 hX2).trans (by rw [hSG]; exact hsum C3 m (hm.trans hi)))
      (fun j hj1 hji => ⟨(hC4 j ξ hξU hj1).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans
          (by rw [hD]; linarith [hsum C4 j (hji.trans hi), hs0 C5])),
        ((hC5 j ξ hξU hX2').1).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans
          (by rw [hD]; linarith [hsum C5 j (hji.trans hi), hs0 C4])),
        ((hC5 j ξ hξU hX2').2).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans
          (by rw [hD]; linarith [hsum C5 j (hji.trans hi), hs0 C4]))⟩)
    refine h.trans ?_
    have hf : (i.factorial : ℝ) ≤ k.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le hi
    have h3 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 3 * D := by linarith
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hf hSG0) (pow_le_pow_right₀ h3 hi)
      (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _) (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hSG0)
  
  have key : ∀ (c C P S1 S2 W d1 d2 : ℝ), c ≤ C → 0 ≤ C → 0 ≤ P → 0 ≤ S1 → S1 ≤ S2 → 0 ≤ W →
      0 ≤ d1 → d1 ≤ d2 → c * P * S1 * W * d1 ≤ C * P * S2 * W * d2 := by
    intro c C P S1 S2 W d1 d2 h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7 h8
    have hY1 : 0 ≤ P * S1 * W * d1 := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg h3 h4) h6) h7
    have hY12 : P * S1 * W * d1 ≤ P * S2 * W * d2 :=
      mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h5 h3) h6) h8 h7
        (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg h3 (h4.trans h5)) h6)
    calc c * P * S1 * W * d1 = c * (P * S1 * W * d1) := by ring
      _ ≤ C * (P * S1 * W * d1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hY1
      _ ≤ C * (P * S2 * W * d2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hY12 h2
      _ = C * P * S2 * W * d2 := by ring
  
  have hmain : ∀ (m u : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m (DomC B.h B.qB) →
      (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, m η = qC B.h η ^ Aex B.h * u η) →
      (∀ (ξ : Cyl) (c : ℝ × ℝ), u (shY ξ c) = u ξ) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → ∀ i, i ≤ k →
        NB B.h m i ξ ≤ M) →
      ∀ l0 : ℕ, n0 ≤ l0 → ∀ (α e : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B e f) →
      InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (e + Aex B.h) (fun ξ => u ξ * f ξ)) := by
    intro m u hm hmu hu hNB l0 hl0 α e f hF
    have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
      show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
      rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
    have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
      rw [hQb]; exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hl0) hn0.le
    have hDU : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB :=
      fun ξ hξ => ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ.2.2 hqsB⟩
    have hDs : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := hDog _
    obtain ⟨F1, F2, F3, F4⟩ := hF
    have hid : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
        nrm B (e + Aex B.h) (fun ξ => u ξ * f ξ) ξ = m ξ * nrm B e f ξ := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hq := hqpos ξ hξ.2.1
      rw [hmu ξ (hDU ξ hξ)]
      simp only [nrm]
      rw [Real.rpow_add hq]
      ring
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ((hm.mono hDU).mul F1).congr hid
    · intro ξ hξ c hc
      have hξ' : shY ξ c ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := hξ
      have hqs : qC B.h (shY ξ c) = qC B.h ξ := rfl
      rw [hid _ hξ', hid ξ hξ, F2 ξ hξ c hc, hmu _ (hDU _ hξ'), hmu ξ (hDU ξ hξ), hu ξ c, hqs]
    · intro ξ hξ hX
      rw [hid ξ hξ, F3 ξ hξ hX, mul_zero]
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hNB k
      choose Cf bf df hCf using F4
      have hsum : ∀ (g : ℕ → ℝ) (j : ℕ), j ≤ k → |g j| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |g i| :=
        fun g j hj => Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |g i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
      obtain ⟨Cs, hCs⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cf i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨bs, hbs⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bf i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨ds, hds⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |df i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨2 ^ k * |M| * Cs, bs, ds, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
      have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ.2.1
      have hP0 : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _).le
      have hSC1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
        unfold SC; exact one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))])
      have hew : 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) := by
        unfold edgeWeight
        split_ifs
        · positivity
        · exact le_rfl
      have hδ0 : 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) := by
        have hX0 : 0 < XC B.h ξ := lt_trans hXa hX1
        unfold edgeDist
        exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX1))
          (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr hX2)))
      have hδ1 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ≤ 1 := by unfold edgeDist; exact min_le_left _ _
      obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = Cs * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bs *
          edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hFb : ∀ i, i ≤ k → NB B.h (nrm B e f) i ξ ≤ E := by
        intro i hi
        refine (hCf i ξ hξ hX1 hX2).trans ?_
        have hC : Cf i ≤ Cs := (le_abs_self _).trans (by rw [hCs]; exact hsum Cf i hi)
        have hCs0 : 0 ≤ Cs := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (by rw [hCs]; exact hsum Cf i hi)
        have hSb : SC B.h ξ ^ bf i ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bs :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hSC1
            ((le_abs_self _).trans (by rw [hbs]; exact hsum bf i hi))
        have hdi : df i ≤ ds := (le_abs_self _).trans (by rw [hds]; exact hsum df i hi)
        have hdb : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df i) ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hδ0 hδ1 (by linarith)
        rw [hE]
        exact key _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hC hCs0 hP0 (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _) hSb hew
          (Real.rpow_nonneg hδ0.le _) hdb
      have hDsξ := hDs.mem_nhds hξ
      have hev : nrm B (e + Aex B.h) (fun ξ => u ξ * f ξ) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun η => m η * nrm B e f η :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hDsξ hid
      have hNBeq : NB B.h (nrm B (e + Aex B.h) (fun ξ => u ξ * f ξ)) k ξ =
          NB B.h (fun η => m η * nrm B e f η) k ξ := by
        unfold NB; rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
      rw [hNBeq]
      have hmul := nb_real_mul_le_v5 B.h ξ m (nrm B e f) k |M| E
        (hm.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds (hDU ξ hξ))) (F1.contDiffAt hDsξ)
        (fun i hi => (hM ξ (hDU ξ hξ) hX1 hX2 i hi).trans (le_abs_self _)) hFb
      refine hmul.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      rw [hE]; ring
  refine ⟨n0, fun l0 hl0 α e f hf => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · exact hmain _ (fun ξ => ubase B ξ 1) hGEs (fun η hη => (hrep η hη).1) (fun ξ c => rfl)
      (hcomp _ hGE (fun m ξ hξU hX1 hX2 =>
        ((hC3 m (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) (hqpos ξ hξU.2.1) hξU.2.2 (by linarith)
          (by linarith) (hmaps ξ hξU).2.2.1 (hmaps ξ hξU).2.2.2).1).trans (le_abs_self _)))
      l0 hl0 α e f hf
  · exact hmain _ (fun ξ => ubase B ξ 2) hGUs (fun η hη => (hrep η hη).2) (fun ξ c => rfl)
      (hcomp _ hGU (fun m ξ hξU hX1 hX2 =>
        ((hC3 m (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) (hqpos ξ hξU.2.1) hξU.2.2 (by linarith)
          (by linarith) (hmaps ξ hξU).2.2.1 (hmaps ξ hξU).2.2.2).2).trans (le_abs_self _)))
      l0 hl0 α e f hf

subgoal_signatures.name: outer_profile_bounds_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → q < B.qB → B.Xa / 2 ≤ X → X ≤ 2 * B.Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift B.Eb) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift B.Ub) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C

subgoal_signatures.name: logqC_nb_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.log (qC B.h η)) i ξ ≤ C

subgoal_signatures.name: xc_etac_nb_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb → NB B.h (XC B.h) i ξ ≤ C ∧ NB B.h (etaC B.h) i ξ ≤ C

subgoal_signatures.name: nb_comp3_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (W : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (ξ : Cyl) (G : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (φ₁ φ₂ φ₃ : Cyl → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (C D : ℝ), IsOpen U → IsOpen W → ξ ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ₁ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ₂ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ₃ U → (∀ η ∈ U, (φ₁ η, φ₂ η, φ₃ η) ∈ W) → 1 ≤ D → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G (φ₁ ξ, φ₂ ξ, φ₃ ξ)‖ ≤ C) → (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → NB h φ₁ i ξ ≤ D ∧ NB h φ₂ i ξ ≤ D ∧ NB h φ₃ i ξ ≤ D) → NB h (fun η => G (φ₁ η, φ₂ η, φ₃ η)) k ξ ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) * C * (3 * D) ^ k

subgoal_signatures.name: nb_real_mul_le_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (a b : Cyl → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (A E : ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ a ξ → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ b ξ → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h a i ξ ≤ A) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h b i ξ ≤ E) → NB h (fun η => a η * b η) k ξ ≤ 2 ^ k * A * E

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState),
    IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
    (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dT f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) →
    (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mcor5 B G l0 S a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) →
    (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => ubase B ξ a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) →
    (∀ a c : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Wcov5 B G l0 S a c) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pmP5 B G l0 S) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => pmP5 B G l0 (tempState5 B G l0 S) ξ - pmP5 B G l0 S ξ) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dvT5 B G l0 S) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gdT5 B G l0 S) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => dR B.h (PsiT5 B G l0 S) ξ + PsiT5 B G l0 S ξ / ξ.1) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => -dZ (PsiT5 B G l0 S) ξ) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
    TMean5 B G l0 S →
    (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dR B.h (PsiT5 B G l0 S) ξ + PsiT5 B G l0 S ξ / ξ.1
        = gdT5 B G l0 S ξ - Arem B 1 (gdT5 B G l0 S) ξ) →
    ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      EthP5 B G l0 (tempState5 B G l0 S) ξ - EthP5 B G l0 S ξ - dYt (dvT5 B G l0 S) ξ = tempRemTh5 B G l0 S ξ ∧
      EzP5 B G l0 (tempState5 B G l0 S) ξ - EzP5 B G l0 S ξ - dYt (gdT5 B G l0 S) ξ =
        tempRemZ5 B G l0 S ξ + -dYt (Arem B 1 (gdT5 B G l0 S)) ξ

signature.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState),
    IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
    (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dT f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) →
    (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mcor5 B G l0 S a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) →
    (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => ubase B ξ a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) →

      shY ξ a + s • (((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), vtv) : Cyl) =
        shY (ξ + s • (((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), vtv) : Cyl)) a := by
    intro ξ a s
    ext <;> simp [shY] <;> ring
  have hγ : ∀ ξ : Cyl, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ξ + s • (((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), vtv) : Cyl))
      (((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), vtv) : Cyl) 0 := fun ξ => by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const (((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), vtv) : Cyl)).const_add ξ
  have hlineD : ∀ (G : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl), DifferentiableAt ℝ G ξ →
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => G (ξ + s • (((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), vtv) : Cyl))) (dYt G ξ) 0 := by
    intro G ξ hd
    have h0 : ξ + (0:ℝ) • (((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), vtv) : Cyl) = ξ := by simp
    have hd' : HasFDerivAt G (fderiv ℝ G ξ) (ξ + (0:ℝ) • (((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), vtv) : Cyl)) := by
      rw [h0]; exact hd.hasFDerivAt
    exact hd'.comp_hasDerivAt (x := (0:ℝ)) (hγ ξ)
  have hdiff : ∀ G : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (DomC B.h qs) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ G ξ := fun G hG ξ hξ =>
    (hG.contDiffAt (hDopen.mem_nhds hξ)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have hqv0 : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, dYt (qC B.h) ξ = 0 := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have hc := hlineD (qC B.h) ξ (hdiff _ hqCs ξ hξ)
    have hconst : (fun s : ℝ => qC B.h (ξ + s • (((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), vtv) : Cyl))) =
        fun _ => qC B.h ξ := funext (fun s => hqline ξ s)
    rw [hconst] at hc
    exact hc.unique (hasDerivAt_const (0:ℝ) (qC B.h ξ))
  
  have hfac : ∀ (p : ℝ) (G : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs → DifferentiableAt ℝ G ξ →
      dYt (nrm B p G) ξ = qC B.h ξ ^ p * dYt G ξ := by
    intro p G ξ hξ hGd
    have hq := hqpos ξ hξ
    have hqd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (qC B.h) ξ := hdiff _ hqCs ξ hξ
    have hpow : HasFDerivAt (fun η => qC B.h η ^ p)
        ((p * qC B.h ξ ^ (p - 1)) • fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) ξ) ξ :=
      hqd.hasFDerivAt.rpow_const (Or.inl hq.ne')
    have hprod := hpow.mul hGd.hasFDerivAt
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (nrm B p G) ξ =
        (qC B.h ξ ^ p) • fderiv ℝ G ξ + G ξ • ((p * qC B.h ξ ^ (p - 1)) • fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) ξ) :=
      hprod.fderiv
    have h0 := hqv0 ξ hξ
    unfold dYt at h0 ⊢
    rw [hfd]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [h0]
    ring
  
  have hreg : ∀ G : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (nrm B (Aex B.h) G) (DomC B.h qs) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (DomC B.h qs) := by
    intro G hG
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-(Aex B.h)) * nrm B (Aex B.h) G η) (DomC B.h qs) :=
      (hqCs.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos η hη).ne')).mul hG
    refine h1.congr (fun η hη => ?_)
    have hq := hqpos η hη
    show G η = qC B.h η ^ (-(Aex B.h)) * (qC B.h η ^ (Aex B.h) * G η)
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hq, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero, one_mul]
  have hgs := hreg g H1.1
  have hds := hreg d H2.1
  have hArgd : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, Ar ξ = g ξ - d ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have := H3 ξ hξ
    linarith
  have hArS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ar (DomC B.h qs) := (hgs.sub hds).congr hArgd
  have hdeckG : ∀ G : Cyl → ℝ, (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ a, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) a →
      nrm B (Aex B.h) G (shY ξ a) = nrm B (Aex B.h) G ξ) →
      ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ a, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) a → G (shY ξ a) = G ξ := by
    intro G hG ξ hξ a ha
    have e : qC B.h ξ ^ Aex B.h * G (shY ξ a) = qC B.h ξ ^ Aex B.h * G ξ := hG ξ hξ a ha
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hqpos ξ hξ) _).ne' e
  have hgdeck := hdeckG g H1.2.1
  have hddeck := hdeckG d H2.2.1
  have hArdeck : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ a, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) a → Ar (shY ξ a) = Ar ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ a ha
    rw [hArgd _ (hshD ξ hξ a), hArgd ξ hξ, hgdeck ξ hξ a ha, hddeck ξ hξ a ha]
  have hFS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (nrm B (Aex B.h) Ar) (DomC B.h qs) := by
    refine (H1.1.sub H2.1).congr (fun ξ hξ => ?_)
    show qC B.h ξ ^ Aex B.h * Ar ξ = qC B.h ξ ^ Aex B.h * g ξ - qC B.h ξ ^ Aex B.h * d ξ
    rw [hArgd ξ hξ]
    ring
  
  have hkf : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun ξ => -dYt Ar ξ) ξ =
      -(qC B.h ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) * dYt (nrm B (Aex B.h) Ar) ξ) := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have hq := hqpos ξ hξ
    show qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * -dYt Ar ξ =
      -(qC B.h ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) * dYt (nrm B (Aex B.h) Ar) ξ)
    rw [hfac _ Ar ξ hξ (hdiff _ hArS ξ hξ)]
    have r : qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) = qC B.h ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) * qC B.h ξ ^ Aex B.h := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [r]
    ring
  have hkS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => -(qC B.h η ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) * dYt (nrm B (Aex B.h) Ar) η))
      (DomC B.h qs) :=
    ((hqCs.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos η hη).ne')).mul (hdYs _ hFS)).neg
  have hfS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun ξ => -dYt Ar ξ)) (DomC B.h qs) :=
    hkS.congr (fun η hη => hkf η hη)
  
  have hdYdeck : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ a, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) a → dYt Ar (shY ξ a) = dYt Ar ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ a ha
    have e1 := hlineD Ar ξ (hdiff _ hArS ξ hξ)
    have e2 := hlineD Ar (shY ξ a) (hdiff _ hArS _ (hshD ξ hξ a))
    have hfun : (fun s : ℝ => Ar (shY ξ a + s • (((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), vtv) : Cyl))) =
        fun s => Ar (ξ + s • (((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), vtv) : Cyl)) := by
      funext s
      rw [hshl ξ a s]
      exact hArdeck _ (hDline ξ hξ s) a (by rw [hqline]; exact ha)
    rw [hfun] at e2
    exact e2.unique e1
  have hfdeck : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ a, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) a →
      nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun ξ => -dYt Ar ξ) (shY ξ a) =
        nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun ξ => -dYt Ar ξ) ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ a ha
    show qC B.h (shY ξ a) ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * -dYt Ar (shY ξ a) =
      qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * -dYt Ar ξ
    rw [hdYdeck ξ hξ a ha]
    rfl
  
  have hfwin : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (B.m1 ≤ XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ ≤ B.m2) ∨
      nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun ξ => -dYt Ar ξ) ξ = 0 := by
    intro ξ hξ
    by_cases hw : B.m1 ≤ XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ ≤ B.m2
    · exact Or.inl hw
    · right
      have hout : XC B.h ξ < B.m1 ∨ B.m2 < XC B.h ξ := by
        rcases not_and_or.mp hw with h | h
        · exact Or.inl (not_le.mp h)
        · exact Or.inr (not_le.mp h)
      have hUo : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs ∩ XC B.h ⁻¹' (Set.Iio B.m1 ∪ Set.Ioi B.m2)) :=
        hXc.isOpen_inter_preimage hDopen (isOpen_Iio.union isOpen_Ioi)
      have hξU : ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs ∩ XC B.h ⁻¹' (Set.Iio B.m1 ∪ Set.Ioi B.m2) := ⟨hξ, hout⟩
      have hev : Ar =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
        apply Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hξU)
        intro η hη
        rcases H5 η hη.1 with ⟨e1, e2⟩ | e0
        · exfalso
          rcases hη.2 with e | e
          · have : XC B.h η < B.m1 := e
            linarith
          · have : B.m2 < XC B.h η := e
            linarith
        · exact e0
      have hz : dYt Ar ξ = 0 := by
        unfold dYt
        rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
        simp
      show qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * -dYt Ar ξ = 0
      rw [hz, neg_zero, mul_zero]
  
  have hflat : ∀ m N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs,
      NB B.h (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun ξ => -dYt Ar ξ)) m ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (N : ℝ) := by
    intro m N
    choose Cφ hCφ using hqpow (Aex B.h + 1/2)
    choose CF hCF using fun j => H4 j N
    refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) * |Cφ i| * |CF (m - i + 1)|, ?_⟩
    intro ξ hξ
    have hq := hqpos ξ hξ
    have hNBeq : NB B.h (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun ξ => -dYt Ar ξ)) m ξ =
        NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) * dYt (nrm B (Aex B.h) Ar) η) m ξ := by
      have hev : nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun ξ => -dYt Ar ξ) =ᶠ[nhds ξ]
          -(fun η => qC B.h η ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) * dYt (nrm B (Aex B.h) Ar) η) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hDopen.mem_nhds hξ) (fun η hη => by rw [hkf η hη]; rfl)
      unfold NB
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_neg_apply]
      have e : ∀ (M : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => Cyl) ℝ),
          (-M).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
            -(M.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)) := by
        intro M
        ext x
        simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
      rw [e, norm_neg]
    rw [hNBeq]
    have hφS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2)) (DomC B.h qs) :=
      hqCs.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos η hη).ne')
    have hψS := hdYs _ hFS
    have hl := leib ξ (DomC B.h qs) m hDopen hξ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2))
      (dYt (nrm B (Aex B.h) Ar)) (hφS.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      (hψS.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    refine le_trans hl ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    have b1 : NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2)) i ξ ≤
        |Cφ i| * qC B.h ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) :=
      (hCφ i ξ hξ).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _))
    have b2 : NB B.h (dYt (nrm B (Aex B.h) Ar)) (m - i) ξ ≤
        qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * (|CF (m - i + 1)| * qC B.h ξ ^ (N : ℝ)) :=
      (hdYle _ hFS ξ hξ (m - i)).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((hCF (m - i + 1) ξ hξ).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _)))
        (Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _))
    have hexp : qC B.h ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]
      have e0 : Aex B.h + 1/2 + -(1 + B.h) = 0 := by unfold Aex; ring
      rw [e0, Real.rpow_zero]
    calc (m.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2)) i ξ *
          NB B.h (dYt (nrm B (Aex B.h) Ar)) (m - i) ξ
        ≤ (m.choose i : ℝ) * (|Cφ i| * qC B.h ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2)) *
            (qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * (|CF (m - i + 1)| * qC B.h ξ ^ (N : ℝ))) :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) b2 (norm_nonneg _)
            (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _)))
      _ = (m.choose i : ℝ) * |Cφ i| * |CF (m - i + 1)| * qC B.h ξ ^ (N : ℝ) *
            (qC B.h ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1 + B.h))) := by ring
      _ = (m.choose i : ℝ) * |Cφ i| * |CF (m - i + 1)| * qC B.h ξ ^ (N : ℝ) := by
          rw [hexp, mul_one]
  exact inM_of_flat_window_v5 B qs _ hok hqs0 hqs1 hfS hfdeck hfwin hflat β

subgoal_signatures.name: inM_of_flat_window_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) →
    (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ a, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) a → f (shY ξ a) = f ξ) →
    (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (B.m1 ≤ XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ ≤ B.m2) ∨ f ξ = 0) →
    (∀ m N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, NB B.h f m ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (N : ℝ)) →
    ∀ β : ℝ, InM B qs β f

signature.name: inm_yavg_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs α : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → InM B qs α f → InM B qs α (yAvg f)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs α f hok hF
  
  
  have PIC : ∀ {P E' F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
      [FiniteDimensional ℝ P] [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace ℝ E'] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E']
      [MeasurableSpace E'] [BorelSpace E'] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
      (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E') [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ]
      (U : Set P) (V K : Set E') (G : P → E' → F) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hK : IsCompact K)
      (hKV : K ⊆ V) (hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => G z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V)),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) x =
        ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ) := by
    intro P E' F _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ μ _ U V K G hU hV hK hKV hG
    have hO : IsOpen (U ×ˢ V) := hU.prod hV
    have hKm : MeasurableSet K := hK.isClosed.measurableSet
    have slice : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F'] (H : P → E' → F'),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) →
        ∀ x ∈ U, ContinuousOn (fun y => H x y) K := by
      intro F' _ _ H hH x hx
      have hc : Continuous (fun y : E' => ((x, y) : P × E')) := by fun_prop
      have h := ContinuousOn.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (f := fun y : E' => ((x, y) : P × E'))
        hH.continuousOn hc.continuousOn (fun y hy => ⟨hx, hKV hy⟩)
      exact h
    have param_fderiv : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F'] (H : P → E' → F'),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => H x' z.2) z.1) (U ×ˢ V) := by
      intro F' _ _ H hH p hp
      have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) p := hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hp)
      apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry (fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2)) (p, p.1) := by
        have e : Function.uncurry (fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2) =
            (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) ∘ (fun w : (P × E') × P => (w.2, w.1.2)) := rfl
        rw [e]
        apply ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (p, p.1)
        · simpa using hHa
        · fun_prop
      exact ContDiffAt.fderiv (f := fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2)
        (g := Prod.fst) h1 contDiffAt_fst (le_of_eq ENat.coe_top_add_one)
    have param_hasFDeriv : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F']
        (H : P → E' → F'), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) → ∀ x ∈ U,
        HasFDerivAt (fun x' => ∫ y in K, H x' y ∂μ) (∫ y in K, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => H x' y) x ∂μ) x := by
      intro F' _ _ H hH x hx
      have hHs := param_fderiv H hH
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU x hx
      have hsU : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ⊆ U :=
        (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
      have hsn : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ∈ nhds x := Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds x (by linarith)
      have hC : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ×ˢ K) := (isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod hK
      have hCsub : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ×ˢ K ⊆ U ×ˢ V := fun z hz => ⟨hsU hz.1, hKV hz.2⟩
      obtain ⟨Bd, hB⟩ := hC.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hHs.continuousOn.mono hCsub)
      refine hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (μ := μ.restrict K)
        (F := fun x' y => H x' y) (F' := fun x' y => fderiv ℝ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x')
        (bound := fun _ => Bd) hsn ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hx] with x' hx'
        exact (slice H hH x' hx').aestronglyMeasurable_of_isCompact hK hKm
      · exact (slice H hH x hx).integrableOn_compact hK
      · exact (slice (fun x' y => fderiv ℝ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x') hHs x hx).aestronglyMeasurable_of_isCompact
          hK hKm
      · exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hKm (fun y hy x' hx' => hB (x', y) ⟨hx', hy⟩)
      · exact continuousOn_const.integrableOn_compact hK
      · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hKm (fun y hy x' hx' => ?_)
        have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (x', y) :=
          hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds ⟨hsU hx', hKV hy⟩)
        have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x'' : P => ((x'', y) : P × E')) x' := by fun_prop
        have h2 := ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) x' hHa hc
        have : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x' := h2
        exact (this.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have hD0 : ∀ x y, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun x' => G x' y) x =
        (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm (G x y) := by
      intro x y; rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp]; rfl
    have hDs : ∀ (k : ℕ) x y, iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) (fun x' => G x' y) x =
        (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm
          (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') x) := by
      intro k x y; rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left]; rfl
    have D_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) (U ×ˢ V) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        have e : (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) =
            (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm ∘ (fun z : P × E' => G z.1 z.2) := by
          funext z; exact hD0 z.1 z.2
        rw [e]
        exact (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hG
      | succ k ih =>
        have e : (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) =
            (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm ∘
              (fun z : P × E' => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' z.2) x') z.1) := by
          funext z; exact hDs k z.1 z.2
        rw [e]
        have h2 := param_fderiv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') ih
        exact (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h2
    have formula : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) x =
        ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro x _
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp (f := fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ)]
        simp only [hD0]
        exact (ContinuousLinearEquiv.integral_comp_comm
          (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv (fun y => G x y)).symm
      | succ k ih =>
        intro x hx
        have hα : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) =ᶠ[nhds x]
            (fun x' => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x' ∂μ) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hx) ih
        have hβ := (param_hasFDeriv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x')
          (D_smooth k) x hx).fderiv
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left (f := fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ), Function.comp_apply,
          hα.fderiv_eq, hβ]
        simp only [hDs]
        have hL := ContinuousLinearEquiv.integral_comp_comm (μ := μ.restrict K) (𝕜 := ℝ)
          (E := P →L[ℝ] ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => P) F)
          (F := ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F)
          (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv
          (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') x)
        exact hL.symm
    have hsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U := by
      have key : ∀ m : ℕ, EqOn (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U)
          (fun x => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ) U := by
        intro m x hx
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hU hx]
        exact formula m x hx
      have hdiff : ∀ m : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℝ
          (fun x => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ) U :=
        fun m x hx => (param_hasFDeriv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x'' => G x'' y) x')
          (D_smooth m) x hx).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      exact contDiffOn_of_continuousOn_differentiableOn (n := ⊤)
        (fun m _ => ((hdiff m).continuousOn).congr (key m))
        (fun m _ => (hdiff m).congr (key m))
    exact ⟨hsmooth, formula⟩
  
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qs))
    have e : DomC B.h qs =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio qs := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  
  have key : ∀ (F : Cyl → ℝ) (V : Set Cyl) (a : Cyl) (T : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl), IsOpen V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → a ∈ V → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro F V a T hV hF ha i
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
    have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  
  have hM : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) ∈ DomC B.h qs :=
    fun ξ hξ Y => ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, hξ.2.2⟩
  have hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : Cyl × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((z.1.1, z.1.2.1, z.1.2.2.1, z.2) : Cyl)) :=
    contDiff_fst.fst.prodMk (contDiff_fst.snd.fst.prodMk (contDiff_fst.snd.snd.fst.prodMk contDiff_snd))
  have hKc : IsCompact (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ : ∃ π : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl, ∀ w : Cyl, π w = (w.1, w.2.1, w.2.2.1, 0) :=
    ⟨(ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (0 : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)))), fun w => rfl⟩
  have hcon : ∀ w : Cyl, ‖π w‖ ≤ ‖w‖ := by
    intro w
    rw [hπ]
    simp only [Prod.norm_def]
    refine max_le_max le_rfl (max_le_max le_rfl (max_le_max le_rfl ?_))
    exact le_trans (le_of_eq (by simp)) (le_max_of_le_left (norm_nonneg _))
  
  have NBle : ∀ (F : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (DomC B.h qs) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ (k : ℕ) (W : ℝ),
      (∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, NB B.h F k (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) ≤ W) → NB B.h (yAvg F) k ξ ≤ W := by
    intro F hFs ξ hξ k W hW
    have hGF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : Cyl × (ℝ × ℝ) => F (z.1.1, z.1.2.1, z.1.2.2.1, z.2))
        (DomC B.h qs ×ˢ univ) :=
      hFs.comp hΦ.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hM z.1 hz.1 z.2)
    have hPF := PIC MeasureTheory.volume (DomC B.h qs) univ (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
      (fun x Y => F (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y)) hDopen isOpen_univ hKc (subset_univ _) hGF
    have hformula : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (yAvg F) ξ = ∫ Y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x : Cyl => F (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y)) ξ := hPF.2 k ξ hξ
    have hN0 : 0 ≤ NB B.h F k (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0) := norm_nonneg _
    have hW0 : 0 ≤ W := le_trans hN0 (hW 0)
    have hcomm : ∀ (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (w : Cyl),
        π (Lnorm B.h ξ w) = Lnorm B.h (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) (π w) := by
      intro Y w
      show π (Lnorm B.h ξ w) = Lnorm B.h ξ (π w)
      rw [hπ, hπ]
      simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
    have hslice : ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x : Cyl => F (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y)) ξ =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => π) := by
      intro Y
      have e4 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : Cyl => F ((ξ + z).1, (ξ + z).2.1, (ξ + z).2.2.1, Y)) 0 =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x : Cyl => F (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y)) ξ := by
        have := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun x : Cyl => F (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y)) k ξ 0
        rw [add_zero] at this
        exact this
      have efun : (fun z : Cyl => F ((ξ + z).1, (ξ + z).2.1, (ξ + z).2.2.1, Y)) =
          fun z => F ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) + π z) := by
        funext z
        rw [hπ]
        simp only [Prod.mk_add_mk, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, add_zero]
      rw [← e4, efun]
      exact key F (DomC B.h qs) _ π hDopen hFs (hM ξ hξ Y) k
    have hpt : ∀ (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (v : Fin k → Cyl),
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x : Cyl => F (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y)) ξ (fun i => Lnorm B.h ξ (v i))‖ ≤
          W * ∏ i, ‖v i‖ := by
      intro Y v
      rw [hslice Y]
      simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
      have e : (fun i => π (Lnorm B.h ξ (v i))) =
          fun i => Lnorm B.h (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) (π (v i)) := by
        funext i; exact hcomm Y (v i)
      rw [e]
      have e2 : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y))
            (fun i => Lnorm B.h (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) (π (v i))) =
          ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Lnorm B.h (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y))) (fun i => π (v i)) := by
        rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
      rw [e2]
      calc _ ≤ NB B.h F k (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) * ∏ i, ‖π (v i)‖ :=
            ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
        _ ≤ W * ∏ i, ‖v i‖ :=
            mul_le_mul (hW Y) (by gcongr with i; exact hcon (v i))
              (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)) hW0
    unfold NB
    rw [hformula]
    refine ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound hW0 (fun v => ?_)
    simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    by_cases hint : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun Y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x : Cyl => F (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y)) ξ)
        (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1))
    · rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.integral_apply hint]
      have hvol : MeasureTheory.volume (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1) = 1 := by
        rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod, MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_prod, Real.volume_Icc]
        simp
      calc _ ≤ (W * ∏ i, ‖v i‖) * (MeasureTheory.volume.real (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1)) :=
            MeasureTheory.norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const (by rw [hvol]; exact ENNReal.one_lt_top)
              (fun Y _ => hpt Y v)
        _ = W * ∏ i, ‖v i‖ := by rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, hvol]; simp
    · rw [MeasureTheory.integral_undef hint]
      simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.zero_apply, norm_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg hW0 (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _))
  
  obtain ⟨hs, -, hshell, hbd⟩ := hF
  have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : Cyl × (ℝ × ℝ) => f (z.1.1, z.1.2.1, z.1.2.2.1, z.2))
      (DomC B.h qs ×ˢ univ) :=
    hs.comp hΦ.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hM z.1 hz.1 z.2)
  have hP := PIC MeasureTheory.volume (DomC B.h qs) univ (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (fun x Y => f (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y)) hDopen isOpen_univ hKc (subset_univ _) hG
  refine ⟨hP.1, fun ξ _ a _ => rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ξ hξ hX
    show ∫ Y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, f (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) = 0
    exact MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero (fun Y _ => hshell _ (hM ξ hξ Y) hX)
  · intro k
    obtain ⟨C, b, d, hC⟩ := hbd k
    refine ⟨C, b, d, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
    exact NBle f hs ξ hξ k
      (C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
        edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d))
      (fun Y => hC _ (hM ξ hξ Y) hX1 hX2)

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs →
    (∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ) (c d : ℝ) (e : ℕ) (z t : ℝ), MomGood5 B qs f → MomGood5 B qs g →
      t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qs →
      radMom (fun η => c * f η + d * g η) e z t = c * radMom f e z t + d * radMom g e z t) ∧
    (∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ) (e : ℕ) (z t : ℝ), (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, f ξ = g ξ) →
      t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qs → radMom f e z t = radMom g e z t) ∧
    (∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ) (cf cg : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), MomGood5 B qs f → MomGood5 B qs g →
      ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs,
        Icut B (fun η => (f η + g η) - rhoP B η * (cf η.2.1 η.2.2.1 + cg η.2.1 η.2.2.1)) ξ =
          Icut B (fun η => f η - rhoP B η * cf η.2.1 η.2.2.1) ξ +
            Icut B (fun η => g η - rhoP B η * cg η.2.1 η.2.2.1) ξ) ∧
    (∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ), (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, f ξ = g ξ) →
      ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, Icut B f ξ = Icut B g ξ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs hok hqs
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  have hXam1 : B.Xa < B.m1 := hok.2.1.2.2.2.1
  have hm12 : B.m1 < B.m2 := hok.2.1.2.2.2.2.1
  have hm2Xb : B.m2 < B.Xb := hok.2.1.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hXb : 0 < B.Xb := by linarith
  
  have shell : ∀ q r : ℝ, 0 < q → 0 < r →
      (r < Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xa * q) ∨ Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xb * q) < r) →
      (r ^ 2 / (2 * q) < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) := by
    intro q r hq hr h
    rcases h with h | h

by
  intro B qs α f hok hqs0 hqs10 hf k K
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, hXm1, hm12, hm2Xb, -, -, -, -, -, haa, hab⟩ := hok.2.1
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qs))
    have e : DomC B.h qs =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio qs := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  
  have castL : ∀ (F : Cyl → ℝ) (y : Cyl) (a b : ℕ) (h : a = b) (g : Fin b → Cyl),
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ a F y (g ∘ Fin.cast h) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ b F y g := by
    intro F y a b h g
    subst h
    rfl
  have stepA : ∀ (j k : ℕ) (F : Cyl → ℝ) (y : Cyl) (w : Fin j → Cyl) (v : Fin k → Cyl),
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F) y w v =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j + k) F y (Fin.append w v) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro k F y w v
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply, Fin.append_left_nil w v rfl]
      exact (castL F y (0 + k) k (Nat.zero_add k) v).symm
    | succ j ih =>
      intro k F y w v
      have hE : (fun y => fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F) y) =
          ((continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k+1) => Cyl) ℝ).toContinuousLinearEquiv)
            ∘ iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F := by
        funext y'
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left]
        simp
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right, hE, ContinuousLinearEquiv.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left]
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply]
      show (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k+1) => Cyl) ℝ
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) F) y (Fin.init w))) (w (Fin.last j)) v = _
      rw [continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv_apply, ih, Fin.append_right_cons, Fin.snoc_init_self]
      exact castL F y (j + (k + 1)) (j + 1 + k) (by omega) (Fin.append w v)
  
  have t_jpow : (∀ n : ℤ, ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, JpowL (-n) (JpowL n Y) = Y) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, 0 ≤ n → ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, ‖JpowL n Y‖ ≤ 4 * Tgc ^ n * ‖Y‖) := by
    have hs1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := by
      rw [show (1:ℝ) = Real.sqrt 1 by simp]; exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by norm_num)
    have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 ≤ 3/2 := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by norm_num)]; norm_num
    have hb0 : 0 ≤ bgc := by unfold bgc; linarith
    have hb1 : bgc ≤ 1 := by unfold bgc; linarith
    have hL0 : 0 < Lgc := by unfold Lgc; linarith
    have hLT : Lgc ≤ Tgc := by unfold Lgc Tgc; linarith
    have hT0 : 0 < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; linarith
    have hD : 0 < 1 + bgc ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hJ : ∀ n : ℤ, ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, JpowL n Y = Jpow n Y := by
      intro n Y
      ext <;> simp [JpowL, Jpow, vrv, vtv] <;> ring
    refine ⟨fun n Y => ?_, fun n hn Y => ?_⟩
    · rw [hJ, hJ]
      have key : ∀ (L T b x y : ℝ), L ≠ 0 → T ≠ 0 → 1 + b ^ 2 ≠ 0 →
          let P : ℝ × ℝ := ((L * ((x - b * y) / (1 + b ^ 2))) • ((1:ℝ), -b)) +
            ((T * ((b * x + y) / (1 + b ^ 2))) • (b, (1:ℝ)))
          ((L⁻¹ * ((P.1 - b * P.2) / (1 + b ^ 2))) • ((1:ℝ), -b)) +
            ((T⁻¹ * ((b * P.1 + P.2) / (1 + b ^ 2))) • (b, (1:ℝ))) = (x, y) := by
        intro L T b x y hL hT hb
        simp only
        ext <;> simp <;> field_simp <;> ring
      have := key (Lgc ^ n) (Tgc ^ n) bgc Y.1 Y.2 (zpow_ne_zero _ hL0.ne') (zpow_ne_zero _ hT0.ne') hD.ne'
      simp only at this
      unfold Jpow
      rw [zpow_neg, zpow_neg]
      simpa [vrv, vtv] using this
    · rw [hJ]
      have hn1 : Lgc ^ n ≤ Tgc ^ n := zpow_le_zpow_left₀ hn hL0.le hLT
      have hLn : 0 < Lgc ^ n := zpow_pos hL0 n
      have hY1 : |Y.1| ≤ ‖Y‖ := by simpa using norm_fst_le Y
      have hY2 : |Y.2| ≤ ‖Y‖ := by simpa using norm_snd_le Y
      have hvr : ‖vrv‖ ≤ 1 := by
        simp only [vrv, Prod.norm_def, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_one, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hb0]
        exact max_le le_rfl hb1
      have hvt : ‖vtv‖ ≤ 1 := by
        simp only [vtv, Prod.norm_def, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_one, abs_of_nonneg hb0]
        exact max_le hb1 le_rfl
      have ha : |(Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)| ≤ 2 * ‖Y‖ := by
        rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hD, div_le_iff₀ hD]
        have e1 : |Y.1 - bgc * Y.2| ≤ |Y.1| + bgc * |Y.2| := by
          calc |Y.1 - bgc * Y.2| ≤ |Y.1| + |bgc * Y.2| := abs_sub _ _
            _ = |Y.1| + bgc * |Y.2| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hb0]
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg Y, sq_nonneg bgc, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hY2 hb0]
      have hb : |(bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)| ≤ 2 * ‖Y‖ := by
        rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hD, div_le_iff₀ hD]
        have e1 : |bgc * Y.1 + Y.2| ≤ bgc * |Y.1| + |Y.2| := by
          calc |bgc * Y.1 + Y.2| ≤ |bgc * Y.1| + |Y.2| := abs_add_le _ _
            _ = bgc * |Y.1| + |Y.2| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hb0]
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg Y, sq_nonneg bgc, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hY1 hb0]
      unfold Jpow
      calc ‖(Lgc ^ n * ((Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2))) • vrv +
            (Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2))) • vtv‖
          ≤ ‖(Lgc ^ n * ((Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2))) • vrv‖ +
            ‖(Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2))) • vtv‖ := norm_add_le _ _

            (Tgc ^ n * |(bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)|) * ‖vtv‖ := by
            rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul,
              abs_of_pos hLn, abs_of_pos (zpow_pos hT0 n)]
        _ ≤ (Lgc ^ n * (2 * ‖Y‖)) * 1 + (Tgc ^ n * (2 * ‖Y‖)) * 1 := by
            gcongr
        _ ≤ 4 * Tgc ^ n * ‖Y‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg Y]
  
  have t_edge : ∀ (Xa Xb aa ab d : ℝ), 0 < Xa → Xa < Xb → 0 < aa → 0 < ab → ∃ E : ℝ, 0 ≤ E ∧
      ∀ X : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-d) ≤ E := by
    intro Xa Xb aa ab d hXa hXab haa hab
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : ℕ, N = ⌈max d 0 / 2⌉₊ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hdN : max d 0 ≤ 2 * (N:ℝ) := by
      have := Nat.le_ceil (max d 0 / 2); rw [← hN] at this; linarith
    have core : ∀ (a u : ℝ), 0 < a → 0 < u → u ≤ 1 →
        Real.exp (-(a / u ^ 2)) * u ^ (-(max d 0)) ≤ N.factorial / a ^ N := by
      intro a u ha hu hu1
      have hx : 0 < a / u ^ 2 := by positivity
      have h1 := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp _ hx.le N
      have hf : (0:ℝ) < N.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos N
      have hexp : Real.exp (-(a / u ^ 2)) ≤ N.factorial * (u ^ 2) ^ N / a ^ N := by
        have hpos : 0 < (a / u ^ 2) ^ N / (N.factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
        have h2 := (inv_le_inv₀ (Real.exp_pos _) hpos).mpr h1
        rw [Real.exp_neg]
        refine le_trans h2 (le_of_eq ?_)
        have hu0 : u ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
        have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := ha.ne'
        field_simp
        rw [← mul_pow, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hu0]
      have hu2 : u ^ (-(max d 0)) ≤ u ^ (-(2 * (N:ℝ))) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hu hu1 (by linarith)
      have hcancel : (u ^ 2) ^ N * u ^ (-(2 * (N:ℝ))) = 1 := by
        rw [← pow_mul, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_add hu]
        push_cast
        simp
      calc Real.exp (-(a / u ^ 2)) * u ^ (-(max d 0))
          ≤ (N.factorial * (u ^ 2) ^ N / a ^ N) * u ^ (-(2 * (N:ℝ))) :=
            mul_le_mul hexp hu2 (Real.rpow_nonneg hu.le _) (by positivity)
        _ = N.factorial / a ^ N * ((u ^ 2) ^ N * u ^ (-(2 * (N:ℝ)))) := by ring
        _ = N.factorial / a ^ N := by rw [hcancel, mul_one]
    refine ⟨1 + N.factorial / aa ^ N + N.factorial / ab ^ N, by positivity, fun X h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    have hX0 : 0 < X := lt_trans hXa h1
    set u1 := Real.log (X / Xa) with hu1
    set u2 := Real.log (Xb / X) with hu2
    have hu1p : 0 < u1 := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr h1)
    have hu2p : 0 < u2 := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr h2)
    have hEW : edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X = Real.exp (-(aa / u1 ^ 2) - ab / u2 ^ 2) := by
      unfold edgeWeight; rw [if_pos ⟨h1, h2⟩]
    have hA : 0 ≤ aa / u1 ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hB : 0 ≤ ab / u2 ^ 2 := by positivity

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) → ∀ (k : ℕ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: coarseIdx_arith_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h < 1/100 → (1 ≤ drx h ∧ drx h ≤ 2) ∧ ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q < (2:ℝ) ^ (-(10:ℝ)) → 0 ≤ coarseIdx h q ∧ Tgc ^ (coarseIdx h q) ≤ q ^ (-(2:ℝ)) ∧ (64 * Tgc)⁻¹ * q ^ (-(h * kapS)) * (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ (-(2:ℝ)) ≤ Lgc ^ (coarseIdx h q) * q ^ (drx h / 2) ∧ ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ q' : ℝ, 0 < q' → |q' - q| < δ → coarseIdx h q ≤ coarseIdx h q'

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →
    ∀ (S : CState) (D : WC) (E : WS) (β β' : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 S.Aw → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 S.pw →
    InM B (qsOf l0) (1/2) S.Psi → InM B (qsOf l0) (1/2) S.bdir → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β D →
    InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β' E → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pmP5 B G l0 S) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pmP5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
    ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t →
      resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E)) (PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E)) x t Y
        - thAvgVec (resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E)) (PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E))) x t Y =
      (resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (PX5 B G l0 S) x t Y - thAvgVec (resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (PX5 B G l0 S)) x t Y)
        + (LinT5 B G l0 D E x t Y - thAvgVec (LinT5 B G l0 D E) x t Y)
        + (CrT5 B G l0 S D x t Y - thAvgVec (CrT5 B G l0 S D) x t Y)
        + (SfT5 B G l0 D x t Y - thAvgVec (SfT5 B G l0 D) x t Y)
