proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, hqB1, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n0, fun l0 hl0 S D E β β' hAw hpw hPsi hbd hD hE hpmS hpmS' => ?_⟩
  intro x t Y hxt
  have hxt' : 0 < rad x ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hxt
  
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0.le
  
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  have hc3 : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.1 i) := fun i =>
    (EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp contDiff_fst
  have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
    (hc3 2).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd)
  have hqH : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
    hS.2.2.2.1.comp hψ.contDiffOn (fun w hw =>
      ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 by linarith [show w.2 < 1 from hw]⟩)
  have hHo : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
  have hradc : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1) := by
    unfold rad
    fun_prop
  have hCO : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} := by
    have h1 : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < rad w.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const hradc
    have h2 : IsOpen ({w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
        (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0)) :=
      hqH.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hHo isOpen_Iio
    have e : {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < rad w.1} ∩
        ({w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
          (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0)) := by
      ext w; rfl
    rw [e]; exact h1.inter h2
  have hsubCO : {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} ⊆ simDomain B.h B.qB :=
    fun z hz => ⟨hz.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hz.2.2 hqsB⟩
  
  obtain ⟨hDo, hub, -, -, -⟩ := bg_flow_props B hok
  have huBd : ∀ (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), corrOn B l0 y s → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => uB B w s) y := by
    intro y s hc
    have hmemD : ((y, s) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB := hsubCO hc
    exact ((hub.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hmemD)).comp y
      ((contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have hfsV : ∀ (α : ℝ) (a : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ (θ : ℝ) (i : Fin 3),
      (∀ γ, Function.HasFiniteSupport (fun m : ℤ => a γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ)) ∧
      Function.HasFiniteSupport (fun γ : Lab => ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, a γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ) := by
    intro α a ea ξ hξ θ i
    obtain ⟨H, -, hH⟩ := ea.1
    obtain ⟨N, hN, Γ, hΓ⟩ := etaL_local_finite_v5 B.h hok.1 ξ hξ.2.1
    refine ⟨fun γ => ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine Set.Finite.subset H.finite_toSet (fun m hm => ?_)
      by_contra hmH
      apply hm
      simp [hH γ m hmH]
    · refine Set.Finite.subset Γ.finite_toSet (fun γ hγ => ?_)
      by_contra hγΓ
      apply hγ
      apply finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
      intro m
      have h0 : a γ m ξ = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hγΓ (hΓ γ ξ (mem_of_mem_nhds hN) (ea.2.2.2.1 γ m ξ hξ hne).2.1)
      simp [h0]
  have hfsS : ∀ (α : ℝ) (a : WS), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ (θ : ℝ),
      (∀ γ, Function.HasFiniteSupport (fun m : ℤ => a γ m ξ * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ)) ∧
      Function.HasFiniteSupport (fun γ : Lab => ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, a γ m ξ * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ) := by
    intro α a ea ξ hξ θ
    obtain ⟨H, -, hH⟩ := ea.1
    obtain ⟨N, hN, Γ, hΓ⟩ := etaL_local_finite_v5 B.h hok.1 ξ hξ.2.1
    refine ⟨fun γ => ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine Set.Finite.subset H.finite_toSet (fun m hm => ?_)
      by_contra hmH
      apply hm
      simp [hH γ m hmH]
    · refine Set.Finite.subset Γ.finite_toSet (fun γ hγ => ?_)
      by_contra hγΓ
      apply hγ
      apply finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
      intro m
      have h0 : a γ m ξ = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hγΓ (hΓ γ ξ (mem_of_mem_nhds hN) (ea.2.2.2.1 γ m ξ hξ hne).2.1)
      simp [h0]
  have hwV : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ θ : ℝ,
      waveV5 B G (S.Aw + D) θ ξ = waveV5 B G S.Aw θ ξ + waveV5 B G D θ ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ θ
    funext i
    obtain ⟨ha1, ha2⟩ := hfsV 1 S.Aw hAw ξ hξ θ i
    obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := hfsV β D hD ξ hξ θ i
    show (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, (S.Aw + D) γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ).re =
      (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, S.Aw γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ).re +
        (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, D γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ).re
    rw [← Complex.add_re, ← finsum_add_distrib ha2 hb2]
    congr 1
    refine finsum_congr (fun γ => ?_)
    rw [← finsum_add_distrib (ha1 γ) (hb1 γ)]
    refine finsum_congr (fun m => ?_)
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, add_mul]
  have hwS : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ θ : ℝ,
      waveS5 B G (S.pw + E) θ ξ = waveS5 B G S.pw θ ξ + waveS5 B G E θ ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ θ
    obtain ⟨ha1, ha2⟩ := hfsS 1 S.pw hpw ξ hξ θ
    obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := hfsS β' E hE ξ hξ θ
    show (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, (S.pw + E) γ m ξ * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ).re =
      (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, S.pw γ m ξ * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ).re +
        (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, E γ m ξ * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ).re
    rw [← Complex.add_re, ← finsum_add_distrib ha2 hb2]
    congr 1
    refine finsum_congr (fun γ => ?_)
    rw [← finsum_add_distrib (ha1 γ) (hb1 γ)]
    refine finsum_congr (fun m => ?_)
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, add_mul]
  have hcyl : ∀ (y : ℝ³) (u v : Fin 3 → ℝ), cyl2cart y (u + v) = cyl2cart y u + cyl2cart y v := by
    intro y u v
    simp only [cyl2cart, Pi.add_apply, add_smul]
    abel
  
  have hAadd : ∀ (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ) (Z : ℝ × ℝ),
      AX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) y s Z = AX5 B G l0 S y s Z + AincX5 B G l0 D y s Z := by
    intro y s Z
    by_cases hc : corrOn B l0 y s
    · have hmem : ptOf y s Z ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := hc
      simp only [AX5, AincX5, waveAdd, if_pos hc]
      rw [hwV _ hmem, hcyl]
      simp only [smul_add]
      abel
    · simp only [AX5, AincX5, if_neg hc, add_zero]
  
  have hgd : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => pmP5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) η - pmP5 B G l0 S η) ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ
    exact ((hpmS'.contDiffAt (hDopen.mem_nhds hξ)).differentiableAt (by simp)).sub
      ((hpmS.contDiffAt (hDopen.mem_nhds hξ)).differentiableAt (by simp))
  have hMon : ∀ (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ) (Y'' : ℝ × ℝ), corrOn B l0 y s →
      (fun y s Y'' => PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) y s Y'' - PX5 B G l0 S y s Y''
        - pwIncX5 B G l0 E y s Y'') y s Y'' =
      (fun η => pmP5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) η - pmP5 B G l0 S η) (ptOf y s Y'') := by
    intro y s Y'' hc
    have hmem : ptOf y s Y'' ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := hc
    simp only [PX5, pwIncX5, waveAdd, if_pos hc]
    rw [hwS _ hmem]
    ring
  have hMoff : ∀ (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ) (Y'' : ℝ × ℝ), ¬ corrOn B l0 y s →
      (fun y s Y'' => PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) y s Y'' - PX5 B G l0 S y s Y''
        - pwIncX5 B G l0 E y s Y'') y s Y'' = 0 := by
    intro y s Y'' hc
    simp only [PX5, pwIncX5, if_neg hc]
    ring
  have hs4 := psi5_pm_grad_frame B l0 (fun η => pmP5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) η - pmP5 B G l0 S η)
    (fun y s Y'' => PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) y s Y'' - PX5 B G l0 S y s Y''
      - pwIncX5 B G l0 E y s Y'') hok hgd hMon hMoff
  have hMd : ∀ (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ) (Z : ℝ × ℝ), corrOn B l0 y s →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) w s (Yph B.h (rad w) s + (Z - Yph B.h (rad y) s))
        - PX5 B G l0 S w s (Yph B.h (rad w) s + (Z - Yph B.h (rad y) s))
        - pwIncX5 B G l0 E w s (Yph B.h (rad w) s + (Z - Yph B.h (rad y) s))) y := by
    intro y s Z hc
    obtain ⟨c0, c2, h⟩ := hs4 y s Z hc
    exact (h y rfl rfl).1
  
  have hF1 := fun Y₀ => psi5_state_fields_smooth B G l0 S 1 1 (1/2) (1/2) Y₀ hok hG hqsB hAw hpw hPsi hbd hpmS
  have hF2 := fun Y₀ => psi5_incr_fields_smooth B G l0 D E β β' Y₀ hok hG hqsB hD hE
  
  have hsplit := psi5_pointwise_split B G l0 S D E hCO (nsResidual_local_and_zero.1 1)
    (fun Y₀ => (hF1 Y₀).1) (fun Y₀ => (hF1 Y₀).2.1) (fun Y₀ => (hF1 Y₀).2.2)
    (fun Y₀ => (hF2 Y₀).1) (fun Y₀ => (hF2 Y₀).2.1) (fun Y₀ => (hF2 Y₀).2.2) huBd hAadd hMd
  
  have hr0 : 0 < rad x := hxt'.1
  have hrot : ∀ θ : ℝ, rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) = rad x ∧ (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 2 = x 2 := by
    intro θ
    have e0 : (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 0 = rad x * Real.cos θ := by simp [rotPt]
    have e1 : (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 1 = rad x * Real.sin θ := by simp [rotPt]
    have e2 : (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 2 = x 2 := by simp [rotPt]
    refine ⟨?_, e2⟩
    have hsq : (rad x * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (rad x * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = rad x ^ 2 := by
      have hcs := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
      calc (rad x * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (rad x * Real.sin θ) ^ 2
          = rad x ^ 2 * (Real.cos θ ^ 2 + Real.sin θ ^ 2) := by ring
        _ = rad x ^ 2 := by rw [hcs, mul_one]
    rw [show rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) =
        Real.sqrt ((rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 1 ^ 2) from rfl, e0, e1, hsq,
      Real.sqrt_sq hr0.le]
  have hcirc : ∀ θ : ℝ, corrOn B l0 (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t := by
    intro θ
    obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hrot θ
    show 0 < rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ((rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact hxt'
  obtain ⟨Z0, hZ0⟩ : ∃ Z0 : ℝ × ℝ, Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t = Z0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hoff : ∀ θ : ℝ, Yph B.h (rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) t + Z0 = Y := by
    intro θ
    rw [← hZ0, (hrot θ).1]
    abel
  
  obtain ⟨FG, hFGv⟩ : ∃ F : Ext ℝ³, ∀ y s Y0, F y s Y0 =
      gradient (fun w => PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) w s (Yph B.h (rad w) s + (Y0 - Yph B.h (rad y) s))
        - PX5 B G l0 S w s (Yph B.h (rad w) s + (Y0 - Yph B.h (rad y) s))
        - pwIncX5 B G l0 E w s (Yph B.h (rad w) s + (Y0 - Yph B.h (rad y) s))) y :=
    ⟨fun y s Y0 => gradient (fun w => PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) w s (Yph B.h (rad w) s + (Y0 - Yph B.h (rad y) s))
        - PX5 B G l0 S w s (Yph B.h (rad w) s + (Y0 - Yph B.h (rad y) s))
        - pwIncX5 B G l0 E w s (Yph B.h (rad w) s + (Y0 - Yph B.h (rad y) s))) y, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hR : ∀ y, corrOn B l0 y t →
      resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E)) (PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E)) y t Y =
        resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (PX5 B G l0 S) y t Y + LinT5 B G l0 D E y t Y + CrT5 B G l0 S D y t Y
          + SfT5 B G l0 D y t Y + FG y t Y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hFGv]
    exact hsplit y t Y hy
  obtain ⟨d0, d2, hgf⟩ := hs4 x t Y hxt
  obtain ⟨hFGavg, hFGint⟩ := pws_frame_avg FG x t Y d0 0 d2 hr0 (fun θ => by
    obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hrot θ
    rw [hFGv, zero_smul, add_zero]

pulse_cross_harmonics_v5.definitions:
noncomputable def pchTr5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (n : ℤ) (al : Fin 3 → ℂ)
    (bt : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℂ :=
  let gv : Fin 3 → ℝ := ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) • nPhi5 B G γ ξ
  let ph : ℂ := Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (al 0 * (gv 0 : ℂ) + al 1 * (gv 1 : ℂ) + al 2 * (gv 2 : ℂ))
  let rb := dR B.h bt ξ
  let zb := dZ bt ξ
  ![al 0 * rb 0 + al 2 * zb 0 + ph * bt ξ 0 - al 1 * bt ξ 1 / (ξ.1 : ℂ),
    al 0 * rb 1 + al 2 * zb 1 + ph * bt ξ 1 + al 1 * bt ξ 0 / (ξ.1 : ℂ),
    al 0 * rb 2 + al 2 * zb 2 + ph * bt ξ 2]
noncomputable def pchAmp5 (B : BG) (P : WC) : WC := fun γ m ξ => ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) • P γ m ξ
noncomputable def pchMnC5 (Mn : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℝ) : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ := fun ξ i => ((Mn ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)
noncomputable def pchPair5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (P Q : WC) (N : ℤ) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℂ :=
  ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, ((1/2 : ℂ) • pchTr5 B G γ (N - m) (P γ m ξ) (Q γ (N - m)) ξ +
    (1/2 : ℂ) • pchTr5 B G γ (N + m) (fun i => star (P γ m ξ i)) (Q γ (N + m)) ξ)
noncomputable def pchHar5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (Mn : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℝ) (P Q : WC) (γ : Lab) (N : ℤ)
    (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℂ :=
  pchTr5 B G γ N (pchMnC5 Mn ξ) (pchAmp5 B Q γ N) ξ + pchTr5 B G γ 0 (pchAmp5 B Q γ N ξ) (pchMnC5 Mn) ξ
    + pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B P) (pchAmp5 B Q) N γ ξ + pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B Q) (pchAmp5 B P) N γ ξ
noncomputable def pchG5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (Mn : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℝ) (P Q : WC) : WC := fun γ N ξ =>
  if N = 0 then 0 else ((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • pchHar5 B G Mn P Q γ N ξ
noncomputable def pchZ5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (Mn : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℝ) (P Q : WC) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  fun i => (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, pchHar5 B G Mn P Q γ 0 ξ i).re
noncomputable def pchPh5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (c : WC) : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ := fun γ m ξ =>
  ((qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    (((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * wmoAmp5 B G c γ m ξ 0 + ((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * wmoAmp5 B G c γ m ξ 1
      + ((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * wmoAmp5 B G c γ m ξ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B l0 Fl Gf hS hXa hFl hFlsm hGf
  have hQpos : ∀ z : ℝ³ × ℝ, z.2 < 1 → 0 < simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) :=
    fun z hz => (hS.1 (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) (by linarith)).1
  have hQc : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2))
      {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z.2 < 1} := by
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((z.1 2, 1 - z.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((z.1 2, 1 - z.2) : ℝ × ℝ))
        {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z.2 < 1} (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro z hz
      have h' : z.2 < 1 := hz
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - z.2 by linarith⟩
    exact h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
  have hs0 : IsOpen {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
  have hDo : IsOpen (simDomain B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have := hQc.isOpen_inter_preimage hs0 (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) = {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z.2 < 1} ∩
        (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)) ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2⟩
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2⟩
    rw [e]
    exact this
  have hrad : Continuous (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad z.1) := by
    unfold rad
    fun_prop
  have hCOo : IsOpen {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2} := by
    have e : {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2} =
        {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < rad z.1} ∩ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const hrad).inter hDo
  have hVo : IsOpen (simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∩
      {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | rad z.1 ^ 2 < 2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)}) := by
    have hg : ContinuousOn
        (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => 2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) - rad z.1 ^ 2)
        (simDomain B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      (continuousOn_const.mul (hQc.mono (fun z hz => hz.1))).sub (hrad.pow 2).continuousOn
    have := hg.isOpen_inter_preimage hDo (isOpen_Ioi (a := (0:ℝ)))
    have e : simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∩
        {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | rad z.1 ^ 2 < 2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)} =
        simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
          2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) - rad z.1 ^ 2) ⁻¹' Ioi 0 := by
      ext z
      simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_setOf_eq, mem_preimage, mem_Ioi, sub_pos]
    rw [e]
    exact this
  intro m N
  obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hFl m N
  obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := hGf.1 m N
  refine ⟨|C1| + |C2|, fun Y₀ x t hD => ?_⟩
  have hQ : 0 < simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) := hQpos (x, t) hD.1
  have hQN : 0 ≤ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (N:ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hQ.le _
  have b1 := hC1 Y₀ x t hD
  have b2 := hC2 Y₀ x t hD
  have a1 : C1 * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (N:ℝ) ≤ |C1| * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (N:ℝ) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C1) hQN
  have a2 : C2 * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (N:ℝ) ≤ |C2| * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (N:ℝ) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C2) hQN
  have a3 : 0 ≤ |C2| * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (N:ℝ) := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hQN
  have hsum : (↿(evOff B.h (fun x t Y => Fl x t Y + Gf x t Y) Y₀)) =
      ↿(evOff B.h Fl Y₀) + ↿(evOff B.h Gf Y₀) := by
    funext z
    rfl
  by_cases hr : 0 < rad x
  · have hCO : (x, t) ∈ {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2} := ⟨hr, hD.1, hD.2⟩
    have h1 := (hFlsm Y₀).contDiffAt (hCOo.mem_nhds hCO)
    have h2 := (hGf.2.1 Y₀).contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hD)
    rw [hsum, iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (h1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      (h2.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
    calc _ ≤ _ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ C1 * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (N:ℝ) + C2 * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (N:ℝ) :=
          add_le_add b1 b2
      _ ≤ _ := by rw [add_mul]; exact add_le_add a1 a2
  · have hr0 : rad x = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hr) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    have hpos := mul_pos (mul_pos (two_pos : (0:ℝ) < 2) hXa) hQ
    have hV : (x, t) ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∩
        {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | rad z.1 ^ 2 < 2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)} := by
      refine ⟨hD, ?_⟩
      show rad x ^ 2 < 2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t)
      rw [hr0]
      linarith
    have hev : (↿(evOff B.h (fun x t Y => Fl x t Y + Gf x t Y) Y₀)) =ᶠ[nhds (x, t)]
        ↿(evOff B.h Fl Y₀) := by
      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hVo.mem_nhds hV) (fun z hz => ?_)
      rw [hsum]
      show (↿(evOff B.h Fl Y₀)) z + (↿(evOff B.h Gf Y₀)) z = (↿(evOff B.h Fl Y₀)) z
      have h0 : (↿(evOff B.h Gf Y₀)) z = 0 := hGf.2.2 z.1 z.2 _ hz.1 hz.2
      rw [h0, add_zero]
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
    calc _ ≤ _ := b1
      _ ≤ |C1| * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (N:ℝ) := a1
      _ ≤ _ := by rw [add_mul]; linarith

    InM B (qsOf l0) (1/2) S.Psi → InM B (qsOf l0) (1/2) S.bdir →
    InM B (qsOf l0) 0.9 (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (pmP5 B G l0 S)) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α f →
    (∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t →
      resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (PX5 B G l0 S) x t Y - thAvgVec (resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (PX5 B G l0 S)) x t Y =

          + Fl x t Y) →
    ∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h Fl Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2}

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n0, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 S α f Fl hAw hpw hPsi hbdir hpm hf hid Y₀
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hl0) hn0.le
  
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  
  obtain ⟨hΩo, hΨ, hQs, hrad, heR, heTh⟩ := corr_domain_v5 B l0 Y₀ hok
  set Ω : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ) := {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} with hΩdef
  set Ψ : ℝ³ × ℝ → Cyl := fun w => ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + Y₀) with hΨdef
  have hSP : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  have hBP := hok.2
  unfold BackgroundProps at hBP
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, ⟨hABs, hBvBs, hPBs⟩, -, -⟩ := hBP
  have hΩmem : ∀ w ∈ Ω, corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2 := fun w hw => hw
  have hΩsub : Ω ⊆ simDomain B.h B.qB := fun w hw =>
    ⟨(hΩmem w hw).2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le (hΩmem w hw).2.2 hqsB⟩
  have hΨmaps : MapsTo Ψ Ω (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := fun w hw => hw
  have hQpos : ∀ w ∈ Ω, 0 < simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) := fun w hw =>
    (hSP.1 (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) (by linarith [(hΩmem w hw).2.1])).1
  have hQΩ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) Ω :=
    hQs.mono (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).2.1)
  have hQp : ∀ p : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ p) Ω :=
    fun p => hQΩ.rpow_const_of_ne (fun w hw => (hQpos w hw).ne')
  have heRΩ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => eR w.1) Ω :=
    heR.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).1)
  have heThΩ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => eTh w.1) Ω :=
    heTh.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).1)
  have hbase : ∀ (l : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => baseC B l ξ i) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro l i
    have h1 := (geom_slow_base_smooth_v5 B hok).2 l i
    have hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      contDiff_fst.prodMk ((contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_snd).prodMk
        (contDiff_fst.comp (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd)))
    have hmaps : MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h3 : qC B.h ξ < B.qB := lt_of_lt_of_le hξ.2.2 hqsB
      exact ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, h3⟩
    have hcomp := h1.comp hp.contDiffOn hmaps
    refine hcomp.congr (fun ξ _ => ?_)
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, baseC]
  have hwave : ∀ a : WS, (∃ H : Finset ℤ, ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → a γ m = 0) →
      (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (a γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) →
      (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => waveS5 B G a (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w)) Ω := by
    intro a hHa ha hsupp
    obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ := hHa
    have hfac : ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, waveS5 B G a (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) =
        (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, a γ m (Ψ w) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) *
          ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ (Ψ w) : ℂ))) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ))).re := by
      intro w
      unfold waveS5
      congr 1
      refine finsum_congr (fun γ => finsum_congr (fun m => ?_))
      unfold ephase5
      have key : Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((pint5 B G γ : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ) +
          (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ (Ψ w) : ℂ)) =
          Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ (Ψ w) : ℂ)) +
          Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ) := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [key, Complex.exp_add]
      ring
    refine (wave_sum_assembly Ω (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) Ψ
      (fun γ m ξ => a γ m ξ * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))
      (fun γ m => m * pint5 B G γ) H hΩo (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).1) hΨ hΨmaps ?_ ?_
      (fun γ m => wave_coef_phase_smooth_v5 B G (qsOf l0) a hG hbase ha hsupp γ m)).congr
      (fun w _ => hfac w)
    · intro γ m hm ξ _
      simp [hH γ m hm]
    · intro ξ₀ hξ₀
      obtain ⟨U, hU, hξU, T, hT⟩ := etaL_locfin B.h (qsOf l0) hSP ξ₀ hξ₀
      refine ⟨U, hU, hξU, T, fun γ hγ m ξ hξ => ?_⟩
      by_contra hne
      have ha0 : a γ m ξ ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hne (by simp [h0])
      exact hT γ hγ ξ hξ.1 (hsupp γ m ξ hξ.2 ha0).2.1
  have hWv : ∀ (c : WC) (β : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β c → ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => waveS5 B G (fun γ m ξ => c γ m ξ i) (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w)) Ω := by
    intro c β hc i
    obtain ⟨HA, -, hHA⟩ := hc.1
    refine hwave (fun γ m ξ => c γ m ξ i) ⟨HA, fun γ m hm => ?_⟩
      (fun γ m => contDiffOn_pi.mp (hc.2.1 γ m) i) (fun γ m ξ hξ hne => ?_)
    · funext ξ
      simp [hHA γ m hm]
    · exact hc.2.2.2.1 γ m ξ hξ (fun h0 => hne (by simp [h0]))
  have hW := hWv S.Aw 1 hAw
  obtain ⟨HP, -, hHP⟩ := hpw.1
  have hWp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => waveS5 B G S.pw (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w)) Ω :=
    hwave S.pw ⟨HP, hHP⟩ hpw.2.1 hpw.2.2.2.1
  have hAeq : ∀ w ∈ Ω, (↿(evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) w = B.AB w.1 w.2 +
      simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h) •
        (waveS5 B G (fun γ m ξ => S.Aw γ m ξ 0) (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) • eR w.1 +
         waveS5 B G (fun γ m ξ => S.Aw γ m ξ 1) (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) • eTh w.1 +
         waveS5 B G (fun γ m ξ => S.Aw γ m ξ 2) (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) • eZ +
         S.Psi (Ψ w) • eTh w.1) := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' : corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2 := hw
    change B.AB w.1 w.2 + _ = _
    rw [if_pos hw']
    all_goals rfl
  have hBeq : ∀ w ∈ Ω, (↿(evOff B.h (BX B G l0 S) Y₀)) w = B.BvB w.1 w.2 +
      (simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-Aex B.h) * S.bdir (Ψ w)) • eTh w.1 := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' : corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2 := hw
    change B.BvB w.1 w.2 + _ = _
    rw [if_pos hw']
    all_goals rfl
  have hPeq : ∀ w ∈ Ω, (↿(evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) w = B.PB w.1 w.2 +
      (simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h)) * nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (pmP5 B G l0 S) (Ψ w) +
       simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-2 * Aex B.h) * waveS5 B G S.pw (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w)) := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' : corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2 := hw
    have hq := hQpos w hw
    have e : pmP5 B G l0 S (Ψ w) =
        simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h)) * nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (pmP5 B G l0 S) (Ψ w) := by
      show pmP5 B G l0 S (Ψ w) = simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h)) *
        (simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (2 * Aex B.h) * pmP5 B G l0 S (Ψ w))
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hq, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero, one_mul]
    change B.PB w.1 w.2 + _ = _
    rw [if_pos hw', ← e]
    all_goals rfl
  have hAsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) Ω :=
    ContDiffOn.congr ((hABs.mono hΩsub).add ((hQp (1/2 - Aex B.h)).smul
      (((((hW 0).smul heRΩ).add ((hW 1).smul heThΩ)).add ((hW 2).smul (contDiffOn_const (c := eZ)))).add
        ((hPsi.1.comp hΨ hΨmaps).smul heThΩ)))) hAeq
  have hBsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (BX B G l0 S) Y₀)) Ω :=
    ContDiffOn.congr ((hBvBs.mono hΩsub).add
      (((hQp (-Aex B.h)).mul (hbdir.1.comp hΨ hΨmaps)).smul heThΩ)) hBeq
  have hPsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) Ω :=
    ContDiffOn.congr ((hPBs.mono hΩsub).add (((hQp (-(2 * Aex B.h))).mul (hpm.1.comp hΨ hΨmaps)).add
      ((hQp (-2 * Aex B.h)).mul hWp))) hPeq
  have hUeq : evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y₀ = fun y s =>
      curl3 (fun w => evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) Y₀ w s) y + evOff B.h (BX B G l0 S) Y₀ y s := by
    funext y s
    simp only [evOff, uX5, curlX, add_sub_cancel_left]
  have hUsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) Ω := by
    rw [hUeq]
    exact (curl_field_contDiffOn_bounded _ _ Ω Ω hΩo subset_rfl hAsm hBsm).1
  
  have hRes : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (↿(nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀))) Ω :=
    (nsResidual_contDiffOn_eq_jet 1 _ _ Ω hΩo hUsm hPsm).1
  
  have hradrot : ∀ r θ z : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → rad (rotPt r θ z) = r := by
    intro r θ z hr
    have h0 : (rotPt r θ z) 0 = r * Real.cos θ := by simp [rotPt]
    have h1 : (rotPt r θ z) 1 = r * Real.sin θ := by simp [rotPt]
    unfold rad
    rw [h0, h1, mul_pow, mul_pow, ← mul_add, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, mul_one, Real.sqrt_sq hr]
  have hrot2 : ∀ r θ z : ℝ, (rotPt r θ z) 2 = z := by
    intro r θ z
    simp [rotPt]
  have hrotC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) := by
    unfold rotPt
    fun_prop
  have hρ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => ((rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) :=
    hrotC.prodMk (by fun_prop)
  have hmapsRad : MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0))
      {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} := by
    intro p hp
    have hξ : 0 < p.2.1 ∧ p.2.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h p.2 < qsOf l0 := hp.2
    show 0 < rad (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1)
    rw [hradrot _ _ _ hξ.1.le]
    exact hξ.1
  have hmapsΩ : MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => ((rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1) : ℝ³ × ℝ))
      (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) Ω := by
    intro p hp
    have hξ : 0 < p.2.1 ∧ p.2.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h p.2 < qsOf l0 := hp.2
    show corrOn B l0 (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) p.2.2.2.1
    refine ⟨?_, hξ.2.1, ?_⟩
    · rw [hradrot _ _ _ hξ.1.le]
      exact hξ.1
    · rw [hrot2]
      exact hξ.2.2
  have hfr : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => frameAt p.1 p.2 a)
      (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro a
    fin_cases a
    · exact (heR.comp hrotC.contDiffOn hmapsRad).congr (fun p _ => rfl)
    · exact (heTh.comp hrotC.contDiffOn hmapsRad).congr (fun p _ => rfl)
    · exact (contDiffOn_const (c := eZ)).congr (fun p _ => rfl)
  
  have hM : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => thA (fun θ => inner ℝ
      (nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) (rotPt ξ.1 θ ξ.2.1) ξ.2.2.1)
      (frameAt θ ξ a))) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro a
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => inner ℝ
        (nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)
          (rotPt p.2.1 p.1 p.2.2.1) p.2.2.2.1) (frameAt p.1 p.2 a)) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      (hRes.comp hρ.contDiffOn hmapsΩ).inner ℝ (hfr a)
    have hI := cyl_param_integral_contDiffOn _ _ hDopen hg
    exact (contDiffOn_const.mul hI).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
  have hT2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => cyl2cart z.1 (fun a => thA (fun θ => inner ℝ
      (nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)
        (rotPt (Ψ z).1 θ (Ψ z).2.1) (Ψ z).2.2.1) (frameAt θ (Ψ z) a)))) Ω :=
    (((((hM 0).comp hΨ hΨmaps).smul heRΩ).add (((hM 1).comp hΨ hΨmaps).smul heThΩ)).add
      (((hM 2).comp hΨ hΨmaps).smul (contDiffOn_const (c := eZ)))).congr (fun z _ => rfl)
  
  have hWf := hWv f α hf
  have hT3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => qC B.h (Ψ z) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) •
      cyl2cart z.1 (waveV5 B G f (thetaOf z.1) (Ψ z))) Ω :=
    ((hQp (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2))).smul ((((hWf 0).smul heRΩ).add ((hWf 1).smul heThΩ)).add
      ((hWf 2).smul (contDiffOn_const (c := eZ))))).congr (fun z _ => rfl)
  
  refine ((hRes.sub hT2).sub hT3).congr (fun z hz => ?_)
  obtain ⟨x, t⟩ := z
  have hz' : corrOn B l0 x t := hz
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ rad x := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have h := hid x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀) hz'
  have hrr : ∀ θ : ℝ, resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (PX5 B G l0 S) (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t
      (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀) =
      nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t := by
    intro θ
    show nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀ - Yph B.h (rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) t))
      (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀ - Yph B.h (rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) t))
      (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t = _
    rw [hradrot _ _ _ hx0, add_sub_cancel_left]
  have hR : resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (PX5 B G l0 S) x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀) =
      nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) x t := by
    show nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀ - Yph B.h (rad x) t))
      (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀ - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) x t = _
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
  have hΘ : thAvgVec (resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (PX5 B G l0 S)) x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀) =
      cyl2cart x (fun a => thA (fun θ => inner ℝ
        (nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀) (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t)
        (frameAt θ (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) a))) := by
    unfold thAvgVec
    simp only [hrr]
  rw [hΘ, hR] at h
  have hF := eq_sub_of_add_eq ((add_comm _ _).trans h.symm)
  show Fl x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀) = _
  rw [hF]
  rfl

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState), B.ok →
    (∀ (a : Fin 3), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ = 0) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
    EthP5 B G l0 S ξ = dR B.h (Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 1) ξ + 2 * Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 1 ξ / ξ.1 +
      dZ (Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 1) ξ + sBase B 1 ξ ∧
    EzP5 B G l0 S ξ = dR B.h (Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 2) ξ + Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 2 ξ / ξ.1 +
      dZ (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 2 η + pmP5 B G l0 S η) ξ + sBase B 2 ξ ∧
    grP5 B G l0 S ξ = -(dR B.h (Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 0) ξ + Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 0 ξ / ξ.1) -
      dZ (Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 0) ξ + Wcov5 B G l0 S 1 1 ξ / ξ.1 ∧
    calJth5 B G l0 S ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 = radMom (Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 1) 2 ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 ∧
    calJz5 B G l0 S ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 = radMom (Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 2) 1 ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 -
      (1/2) * radMom (grP5 B G l0 S) 2 ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1

signature.name: pmr_reduced_identities_v5
signature.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState), B.ok →
    (∀ (a : Fin 3), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ = 0) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
    EthP5 B G l0 S ξ = dR B.h (Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 1) ξ + 2 * Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 1 ξ / ξ.1 +
      dZ (Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 1) ξ + sBase B 1 ξ ∧
    EzP5 B G l0 S ξ = dR B.h (Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 2) ξ + Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 2 ξ / ξ.1 +
      dZ (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 2 η + pmP5 B G l0 S η) ξ + sBase B 2 ξ ∧
    grP5 B G l0 S ξ = -(dR B.h (Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 0) ξ + Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 0 ξ / ξ.1) -
      dZ (Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 0) ξ + Wcov5 B G l0 S 1 1 ξ / ξ.1 ∧
    calJth5 B G l0 S ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 = radMom (Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 1) 2 ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 ∧
    calJz5 B G l0 S ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 = radMom (Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 2) 1 ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 -
      (1/2) * radMom (grP5 B G l0 S) 2 ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 S hok H ξ hξ
  have hOpen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := (domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok).1
  have hfd : ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ), (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), f η = g η) →
      ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), fderiv ℝ f η = fderiv ℝ g η := by
    intro f g hfg η hη
    exact (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hOpen.mem_nhds hη) (fun x hx => hfg x hx)).fderiv_eq
  have hz : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ), (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), f η = 0) →
      ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dR B.h f η = 0 ∧ dZ f η = 0 ∧ dT f η = 0 := by
    intro f hf η hη
    have e := hfd f (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) hf η hη
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold dR; rw [e]; simp
    · unfold dZ; rw [e]; simp
    · unfold dT; rw [e]; simp
  have hlap : ∀ a : Fin 3, lap0 B.h (mcor5 B G l0 S a) ξ = 0 := by
    intro a
    have ha := hz _ (H a)
    have h1 := (hz (dR B.h (mcor5 B G l0 S a)) (fun η hη => (ha η hη).1) ξ hξ).1
    have h2 := (hz (dZ (mcor5 B G l0 S a)) (fun η hη => (ha η hη).2.1) ξ hξ).2.1
    show dR B.h (dR B.h (mcor5 B G l0 S a)) ξ + dR B.h (mcor5 B G l0 S a) ξ / ξ.1
      + dZ (dZ (mcor5 B G l0 S a)) ξ = 0
    rw [h1, h2, (ha ξ hξ).1]
    simp
  have hdR : ∀ f g : Cyl → ℝ, (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), f η = g η) → dR B.h f ξ = dR B.h g ξ := by
    intro f g hfg
    unfold dR
    rw [hfd f g hfg ξ hξ]
  have hdZ : ∀ f g : Cyl → ℝ, (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), f η = g η) → dZ f ξ = dZ g ξ := by
    intro f g hfg
    unfold dZ
    rw [hfd f g hfg ξ hξ]
  have hrm : ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ) (e : ℕ), (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), f η = g η) →
      radMom f e ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 = radMom g e ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 := by
    intro f g e hfg
    unfold radMom
    refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun r hr => ?_)
    have hr' : (0:ℝ) < r := hr
    show r ^ e * yAvg f (r, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0) = r ^ e * yAvg g (r, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0)
    congr 1
    unfold yAvg
    congr 1
    funext Y
    exact hfg _ ⟨hr', hξ.2.1, hξ.2.2⟩
  have T0 := (hz _ (H 0) ξ hξ).2.2
  have T1 := (hz _ (H 1) ξ hξ).2.2
  have T2 := (hz _ (H 2) ξ hξ).2.2
  have Z0 := H 0 ξ hξ
  have Z1 := H 1 ξ hξ
  have Z2 := H 2 ξ hξ
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have e01 : dR B.h (fun η => ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * ubase B η 1
        + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 1 η) ξ
        = dR B.h (Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 1) ξ :=
      hdR _ _ (fun η hη => by simp only [H 0 η hη, H 1 η hη]; ring)
    have e21 : dZ (fun η => ubase B η 2 * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η + ubase B η 1 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η
        + mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 1 η) ξ
        = dZ (Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 1) ξ :=
      hdZ _ _ (fun η hη => by simp only [H 1 η hη, H 2 η hη]; ring)
    show dT (mcor5 B G l0 S 1) ξ
        + dR B.h (fun η => ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * ubase B η 1
          + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 1 η) ξ
        + 2 * (ubase B ξ 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 ξ + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 ξ * ubase B ξ 1
          + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 ξ * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 ξ + Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 1 ξ) / ξ.1
        + dZ (fun η => ubase B η 2 * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η + ubase B η 1 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η
          + mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 1 η) ξ
        - (lap0 B.h (mcor5 B G l0 S 1) ξ - mcor5 B G l0 S 1 ξ / ξ.1 ^ 2) + sBase B 1 ξ = _
    rw [T1, e01, e21, hlap 1, Z0, Z1]
    ring
  · 
    have e02 : dR B.h (fun η => ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * ubase B η 2
        + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 2 η) ξ
        = dR B.h (Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 2) ξ :=
      hdR _ _ (fun η hη => by simp only [H 0 η hη, H 2 η hη]; ring)
    have e22 : dZ (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 2 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η ^ 2
        + Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 2 η + pmP5 B G l0 S η) ξ
        = dZ (fun η => Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 2 η + pmP5 B G l0 S η) ξ :=
      hdZ _ _ (fun η hη => by simp only [H 2 η hη]; ring)
    show dT (mcor5 B G l0 S 2) ξ
        + dR B.h (fun η => ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * ubase B η 2
          + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 2 η) ξ
        + (ubase B ξ 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 ξ + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 ξ * ubase B ξ 2
          + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 ξ * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 ξ + Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 2 ξ) / ξ.1
        + dZ (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 2 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η ^ 2
          + Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 2 η + pmP5 B G l0 S η) ξ
        - lap0 B.h (mcor5 B G l0 S 2) ξ + sBase B 2 ξ = _
    rw [T2, e02, e22, hlap 2, Z0, Z2]
    ring
  · 
    have e00 : dR B.h (fun η => 2 * ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η ^ 2
        + Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 0 η) ξ = dR B.h (Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 0) ξ :=
      hdR _ _ (fun η hη => by simp only [H 0 η hη]; ring)
    have e20 : dZ (fun η => ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + ubase B η 2 * mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η
        + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 0 η) ξ
        = dZ (Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 0) ξ :=
      hdZ _ _ (fun η hη => by simp only [H 0 η hη, H 2 η hη]; ring)

          + (2 * ubase B ξ 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 0 ξ + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 ξ ^ 2 + Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 0 ξ) / ξ.1)
        - dZ (fun η => ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + ubase B η 2 * mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η
            + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 0 η) ξ
        + (2 * ubase B ξ 1 * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 ξ + mcor5 B G l0 S 1 ξ ^ 2 + Wcov5 B G l0 S 1 1 ξ) / ξ.1
        + (lap0 B.h (mcor5 B G l0 S 0) ξ - mcor5 B G l0 S 0 ξ / ξ.1 ^ 2) = _
    rw [T0, e00, e20, hlap 0, Z0, Z1]
    ring
  · 
    unfold calJth5
    refine hrm _ _ _ ?_
    intro η hη
    simp only [H 1 η hη, H 2 η hη]

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lP, hPS⟩ := pulse_support_good_v5 B G hok hG
  refine ⟨lP, fun l0 hl0 c H1 H2 H3 => ?_⟩
  have hk : kapS = 1 / 100000 := rfl
  have hh0 : 0 < B.h := hok.2.1.1
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  obtain ⟨hOpen, hqCsm, hq0, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  have hQb : ∀ l : ℕ, 0 < Qb l := fun l => by unfold Qb; positivity
  have h42 : (4:ℝ) ^ (1/2:ℝ) = 2 := by
    rw [← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, show (4:ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num]
    exact Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)
  have hofR : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ := by
    intro f ξ hf
    have := (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff (n := ∞)).contDiffAt.comp ξ hf
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using this
  
  have M1 : ∀ (α : ℝ) (a : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a →
      InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α (fun γ m ξ => (((qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) • a γ m ξ) := by
    intro α a ha
    have sm : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) →
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ := by
      intro γ m ξ hξ _
      exact hofR _ ξ (((hqCsm.contDiffAt (hOpen.mem_nhds hξ)).div_const (Qb γ.1)).rpow_const_of_ne
        (ne_of_gt (div_pos (hq0 ξ hξ) (hQb γ.1))))
    have dk : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → ∀ c : ℝ × ℝ,
        IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c →
        (fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) (shY ξ c) =
          (fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ := by
      intro γ m ξ _ _ c _
      rfl
    have bd : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) →
        B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
        NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤
          C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * 0) * SC B.h ξ ^ b := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := qC_ratio_rpow_nb B hok (1/2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) k
      refine ⟨2 * |K|, 0, fun γ m ξ hξ hts _ _ => ?_⟩
      have hr := (hPS l0 hl0 α a ha γ m ξ hξ hts).2.2.2.2.1
      have hrnn : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 := (div_pos (hq0 ξ hξ) (hQb γ.1)).le
      have hs : (qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ) ≤ 2 := by
        calc (qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ) ≤ (4:ℝ) ^ (1/2:ℝ) :=
              Real.rpow_le_rpow hrnn hr.le (by norm_num)
          _ = 2 := h42
      have hs0 : 0 ≤ (qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hrnn _
      have hb := hK (Qb γ.1) (hQb γ.1) ξ hξ.2.1 (le_trans hξ.2.2.le hqs1)
      simp only [mul_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
      calc _ ≤ K * (qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ) := hb
        _ ≤ |K| * (qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self K) hs0
        _ ≤ |K| * 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (abs_nonneg K)
        _ = 2 * |K| := by ring
    have := inWg5_smul_mult B G l0 hok α 0 a
      (fun γ η => (((qC B.h η / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ha sm dk bd
    simpa only [add_zero] using this
  
  have hA := M1 (1/2) (W0h4 B G) H2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · convert hA using 1
    funext γ m ξ i
    simp only [pmrP, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hB1 := M1 (1 - kapS) _ H3
  
  have bdN : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (c γ m) →
      B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
      NB B.h (fun _ : Cyl => (![0, 0, -1] : Fin 3 → ℂ)) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * 0) * SC B.h ξ ^ b := by
    intro k
    refine ⟨‖(![0, 0, -1] : Fin 3 → ℂ)‖, 0, fun γ m ξ _ _ _ _ => ?_⟩
    simp only [mul_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
    unfold NB
    refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk0 | hk0
    · subst hk0
      simp [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]
    · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp hk0)]
      simp
  have hB2' := inWg5_cross_mult B G l0 hok 1 0 c (fun _ _ _ => (![0, 0, -1] : Fin 3 → ℂ)) H1
    (fun γ m ξ _ _ => contDiffAt_const) (fun γ m ξ _ _ c' _ => rfl) bdN
  have hB2 : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 (fun γ m ξ => crossC (![0, 0, -1] : Fin 3 → ℂ) (c γ m ξ)) := by
    simpa only [add_zero] using hB2'
  
  obtain ⟨hm2s, hm2d, hm2b⟩ := pmr_mu2_nb_v5 B l0 hok
  have bd2 : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      ξ ∈ tsupport ((fun γ m ξ => crossC (![0, 0, -1] : Fin 3 → ℂ) (c γ m ξ)) γ m) →
      B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (((B.h * qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun ζ => Real.log (qC B.h ζ)) η : ℝ)) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤
        C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (-kapS)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hm2b k
    refine ⟨|C|, 0, fun γ m ξ hξ _ _ _ => ?_⟩
    have hq := hq0 ξ hξ
    have hq1 : qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 := le_trans hξ.2.2.le hqs1
    have hexp : B.h * (-kapS) ≤ B.h := by rw [hk]; linarith
    have hmono : qC B.h ξ ^ B.h ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (-kapS)) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq hq1 hexp
    have hpos : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ B.h := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    simp only [Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
    calc _ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ B.h := hC ξ hξ
      _ ≤ |C| * qC B.h ξ ^ B.h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) hpos
      _ ≤ |C| * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (-kapS)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono (abs_nonneg C)
  have hB3' := inWg5_smul_mult B G l0 hok 1 (-kapS)
    (fun γ m ξ => crossC (![0, 0, -1] : Fin 3 → ℂ) (c γ m ξ))
    (fun _ η => (((B.h * qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun ζ => Real.log (qC B.h ζ)) η : ℝ)) : ℂ))
    hB2 (fun γ m ξ hξ _ => hm2s ξ hξ) (fun γ m ξ _ _ c' _ => hm2d ξ c') bd2
  
  have hB4 := (pwr5_waveV_add B G hok (qsOf l0) hqs1 _ _ (1 - kapS) (1 + -kapS) hB1 hB3').1
  have e1 : min (1 - kapS) (1 + -kapS) = 1 - kapS := by rw [← sub_eq_add_neg, min_self]
  rw [e1] at hB4
  
  convert hB4 using 1
  funext γ m ξ i
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, wmoAmp5, pmrP]
  fin_cases i <;> simp [rotC, crossC] <;> ring

∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →
    ∀ (f g s : Cyl → ℝ) (c α β e : ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B e f) → InM B (qsOf l0) β (nrm B e g) →
    (∀ (η : Cyl) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), s (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1, Y) = s η) →
    ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),

        dR B.h (yAvg f) ξ + c * yAvg f ξ / ξ.1 + dZ (yAvg g) ξ + s ξ

  have eZ : dZ (yAvg g) ξ = ∫ Y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1,

by
  intro B qs hok
  have hS := hok.1
  have hT : IsOpen {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
    isOpen_lt continuous_snd.snd.fst continuous_const
  have hπq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) :=
    contDiff_snd.fst.prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h4 := hS.2.2.2.1
    have hc := h4.comp hπq.contDiffOn (fun ξ (hξ : ξ.2.2.1 < 1) =>

    exact hc

    have h1 : IsOpen {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst
    have h2 := hqC.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hT (isOpen_Iio (a := qs))
    have e : DomC B.h qs =

      ext ξ; exact Iff.rfl

  have hqpos : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qs := hξ

  have hqCD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) :=
    hqC.mono (fun ξ (hξ : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qs) => hξ.2.1)
  have hXC : ContinuousOn (XC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have hnum : ContinuousOn (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.1 ^ 2) (DomC B.h qs) :=
      (continuous_fst.pow 2).continuousOn
    have hden : ContinuousOn (fun ξ : Cyl => 2 * qC B.h ξ) (DomC B.h qs) :=
      continuousOn_const.mul hqCD.continuousOn

  have hO : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs ∩ XC B.h ⁻¹' Ioo B.Xa B.Xb) :=

    intro f g ξ hξ hX1 hX2 hfg
    exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds ⟨hξ, hX1, hX2⟩)
      (fun η hη => hfg η hη.1 hη.2.1 hη.2.2)
  refine ⟨hDopen, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro f g ξ hξ hX1 hX2 hfg

    unfold dR

  · intro α β f g hf hg hfg

    obtain ⟨C, b, d, hC⟩ := g4 k
    refine ⟨C, b, d, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
    have hev := hloc f g ξ hξ hX1 hX2 hfg
    have hk : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ = iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g ξ :=

    rw [hNB]
    exact hC ξ hξ hX1 hX2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs c hB hN hqs0 hqs1 j
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hB.1
  unfold SimNorm at hN
  choose C hC using hN
  
  have key : ∀ {E G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup G]
      [NormedSpace ℝ G] (F : E → G) (V : Set E) (a : E) (T : Cyl →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → a ∈ V → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro E G _ _ _ _ F V a T hV hF ha i
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set E, s = (fun z : E => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : E) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
    have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  
  obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ,
      A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |Polynomial.eval c (descPochhammer ℝ i)| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by rw [hAdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)

  have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by
    have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k (_ : k ∈ Finset.range (j + 1)) => abs_nonneg (C k))
    rw [hDdef]; linarith
  refine ⟨(j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j, ?_⟩
  intro ξ hξD
  have hξD' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qs := hξD
  have hξ : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξD'.2.1
  have hq1 : qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 := le_trans hξD'.2.2.le hqs1
  
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      (contDiff_snd.fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
    exact h1.comp h2.contDiffOn (fun η (hη : η.2.2.1 < 1) =>
      ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith)⟩)
  have hqpos : ∀ η : Cyl, η.2.2.1 < 1 → 0 < qC B.h η := fun η h =>
    (hS.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
  have hU : IsOpen {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd.snd.fst continuous_const
  
  obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : Cyl → ℝ, F = fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨a, hadef⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = qC B.h ξ ^ c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  suffices hmain : NB B.h F j ξ ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j * a by
    rw [hFdef, hadef] at hmain; exact hmain
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by rw [hadef]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
  have hFU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    rw [hFdef]
    exact hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos η hη).ne')
  
  obtain ⟨Pm, hPmdef⟩ : ∃ Pm : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
      Pm = ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))).prod
        (-((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp

    intro η; rw [hPmdef]; simp

    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun η => ?_)

    refine max_le ?_ ?_
    · exact (norm_fst_le η.2).trans (norm_snd_le η)
    · exact (norm_neg η.2.2.1).trans_le
        (((norm_fst_le η.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le η.2)).trans (norm_snd_le η))
  obtain ⟨Mq, hMqdef⟩ : ∃ Mq : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
      Mq = (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap

  obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ, T = Mq.comp Pm := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨w0, hw0def⟩ : ∃ w0 : ℝ × ℝ, w0 = (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hW : IsOpen (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
  have hw0 : w0 ∈ (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := by
    rw [hw0def]; exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
  
  have hid : ∀ v : Cyl, qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) = simScale B.h (w0 + T v).1 (w0 + T v).2 := by
    intro v
    have e1 : (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.1 = qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1 := by
      simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
    have e2 : (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 = qC B.h ξ * v.2.2.1 := by
      simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
    have e3 : T v = (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1, qC B.h ξ * (-v.2.2.1)) := by
      rw [hTdef, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hPapp v, hMqdef]
      simp [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
    rw [e3, hw0def]
    show simScale B.h (ξ.2.1 + (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.1) (1 - (ξ.2.2.1 + (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1)) =
      simScale B.h (ξ.2.1 + qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1) ((1 - ξ.2.2.1) + qC B.h ξ * (-v.2.2.1))
    rw [e1, e2]
    congr 1
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set Cyl, O = {v : Cyl | (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 < 1} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hOmem : ∀ v, v ∈ O ↔ (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 < 1 := by
    intro v; rw [hOdef]; rfl
  have hcontO : Continuous (fun v : Cyl => (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1) :=
    ((continuous_const.add (Lnorm B.h ξ).continuous).snd.snd.fst)
  have hO : IsOpen O := by rw [hOdef]; exact isOpen_lt hcontO continuous_const
  have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ O := by
    rw [hOmem, map_zero, add_zero]; exact hξ
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψdef⟩ : ∃ ψ : Cyl → ℝ, ψ = fun v => qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) / qC B.h ξ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ O := by
    rw [hψdef]
    exact (hqC.comp (contDiff_const.add (Lnorm B.h ξ).contDiff).contDiffOn
      (fun v hv => (hOmem v).1 hv)).div_const _
  have hψpos : ∀ v ∈ O, 0 < ψ v := by
    intro v hv; rw [hψdef]; exact div_pos (hqpos _ ((hOmem v).1 hv)) hq0
  have hψ0 : ψ 0 = 1 := by
    rw [hψdef]
    show qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ 0) / qC B.h ξ = 1
    rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact div_self hq0.ne'
  have hψeq : ψ = (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ • (fun z : Cyl => simScale B.h (w0 + T z).1 (w0 + T z).2) := by
    rw [hψdef]; funext v
    show qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) / qC B.h ξ =
      (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * simScale B.h (w0 + T v).1 (w0 + T v).2
    rw [hid v, div_eq_inv_mul]
  have hΦ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : Cyl => simScale B.h (w0 + T z).1 (w0 + T z).2) 0 := by
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (w0 + T 0) := by
      rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact hS.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hw0)
    exact ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (f := fun z : Cyl => w0 + T z)
      (0 : Cyl) h1 (contDiff_const.add T.contDiff).contDiffAt
  
  have hDψ : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ j → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ψ O 0‖ ≤ D ^ i := by
    intro i hi1 hij
    have hcomp : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Mq.comp Pm) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Mq)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Pm) := by
      ext m; rfl
    have hCi : ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Mq)‖ ≤ C i * qC B.h ξ := by
      rw [hMqdef, hw0def]; exact hC i ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith) hq1
    have hprod : ∏ k : Fin i, ‖Pm‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hP1
    have hb1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Mq)) (fun _ : Fin i => Pm)
    have hb2 := hb1.trans ((mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) hprod).trans hCi)
    have hCiD : C i ≤ D := by
      have h2 : |C i| ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |C k| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => |C k|) (fun k _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hij))
      have h3 := le_abs_self (C i)
      rw [hDdef]; linarith
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO h0O, hψeq,
      iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply (hΦ.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)),
      key (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) w0 T hW hS.2.2.2.1 hw0 i,
      norm_smul, hTdef, hcomp, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le)]
    calc (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * ‖((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Mq)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Pm)‖
        ≤ (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * (C i * qC B.h ξ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb2 (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le)
      _ = C i := by rw [mul_comm (C i), ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0.ne', one_mul]
      _ ≤ D := hCiD
      _ ≤ D ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
  
  have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    (contDiffOn_id (s := Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))).rpow_const_of_ne (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
  have hψmaps : Set.MapsTo ψ O (Set.Ioi 0) := fun v hv => hψpos v hv
  have hCg : ∀ i ≤ j, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) (Set.Ioi 0) (ψ 0)‖ ≤ A := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hψ0, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i isOpen_Ioi (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (zero_lt_one' ℝ)),
      norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate,
      Real.iter_deriv_rpow_const, Real.one_rpow, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, hAdef]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Polynomial.eval c (descPochhammer ℝ i)|)
      (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
  have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hg hψ (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn hO.uniqueDiffOn hψmaps h0O (C := A) (D := D) hCg hDψ
  
  obtain ⟨gl, hgldef⟩ : ∃ gl : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ, gl = a • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hgl : ‖gl‖ ≤ a := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ ha0 (fun x => le_of_eq (by
    rw [hgldef, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, norm_smul,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg ha0]))
  have hEq : Set.EqOn (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) (⇑gl ∘ ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) ∘ ψ)) O := by
    intro z hz
    have hψz := hψpos z hz
    have e : qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z) = qC B.h ξ * ψ z := by
      rw [hψdef]
      show _ = qC B.h ξ * (qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z) / qC B.h ξ)
      field_simp
    show F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z) = gl (ψ z ^ c)
    rw [hFdef, hgldef, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    show qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z) ^ c = a * ψ z ^ c
    rw [e, Real.mul_rpow hq0.le hψz.le, ← hadef]
  have hgψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) ∘ ψ) O := hg.comp hψ hψmaps
  have hNB : NB B.h F j ξ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) 0‖ := by
    unfold NB
    rw [key F {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hU hFU hξ j]
  calc NB B.h F j ξ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) 0‖ := hNB
    _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) O 0‖ := by
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hO h0O]
    _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j (⇑gl ∘ ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) ∘ ψ)) O 0‖ := by
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_congr hEq h0O j]
    _ = ‖gl.compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) ∘ ψ) O 0)‖ := by
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_left gl (hgψ.contDiffWithinAt h0O)
          hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O (i := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)]
    _ ≤ ‖gl‖ * ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) ∘ ψ) O 0‖ :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
    _ ≤ a * ((j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j) := mul_le_mul hgl hFdB (norm_nonneg _) ha0
    _ = (j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j * a := by ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ (lP : ℕ) (CP bP : ℝ), ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), lP ≤ γ.1 → ActiveL4 B G γ → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb → inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) G.r0 ξ.2.2.2 → ∀ (x : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (w : ℝ), 0 ≤ w → w ≤ Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), HasDerivAt x ((APhi5 B G γ (ξ + (v - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) • dVdir B.h γ.1)).mulVec (x v) - dDamp5 B G γ (ξ + (v - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) • dVdir B.h γ.1) • x v) v) → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), ‖x v‖ ≤ CP * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ bP * (Penv5 B G γ v / Penv5 B G γ w) * ‖x w‖

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ (lP : ℕ) (CP bP : ℝ), ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), lP ≤ γ.1 → ActiveL4 B G γ → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb → inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) G.r0 ξ.2.2.2 → ∀ (x : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (w : ℝ), 0 ≤ w → w ≤ Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), HasDerivAt x ((APhi5 B G γ (ξ + (v - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) • dVdir B.h γ.1)).mulVec (x v) - dDamp5 B G γ (ξ + (v - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) • dVdir B.h γ.1) • x v) v) → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), ‖x v‖ ≤ CP * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ bP * (Penv5 B G γ v / Penv5 B G γ w) * ‖x w‖

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hB hG
  obtain ⟨l2, M, C1, hM1, hC1, hpd⟩ := prop_path_data5 B G hB hG
  obtain ⟨δ0, K0, hδ0, hK0, hA⟩ := prop_abstract5 M hM1
  have hr0 : 0 < G.r0 := hG.1.1
  have hr0' : G.r0 ≤ 1/100 := hG.1.2.1
  have hu0 : 0 < G.ustar := hG.1.2.2.1
  have h2r0 : 0 < 2 * G.r0 := by linarith
  have hTgc0 : (0:ℝ) < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; positivity
  have hM0 : 0 < M := by linarith
  obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ : ∃ C2 : ℝ, C2 = C1 + M / (2 * G.r0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hMr : 0 < M / (2 * G.r0) := div_pos hM0 h2r0
  have hC2pos : 0 < C2 := by rw [hC2]; linarith
  refine ⟨l2 + 1 + ⌈C2 / δ0⌉₊, K0 * Real.exp (K0 * (2 * G.r0 * Tgc * C2)) * (1 + 2 * G.r0 * Tgc / C2), 4, ?_⟩
  intro γ ξ hl hAct heta hD hX1 hX2 hR x w hw0 hwL hx v hv
  have hl2 : l2 ≤ γ.1 := by omega
  have hl1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (γ.1:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ γ.1)
  have hlc : C2 / δ0 ≤ (γ.1:ℝ) := by
    have h1 := Nat.le_ceil (C2 / δ0)
    have h2 : ((⌈C2 / δ0⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (γ.1 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : ⌈C2 / δ0⌉₊ ≤ γ.1)
    linarith
  have hℓpos : (0:ℝ) < (γ.1:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hℓ2pos : (0:ℝ) < (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, δ = C2 / (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := by rw [hδ]; exact div_pos hC2pos hℓ2pos
  have hδ0' : δ ≤ δ0 := by
    have h1 : C2 ≤ (γ.1:ℝ) * δ0 := (div_le_iff₀ hδ0).mp hlc
    have h2 : (γ.1:ℝ) * δ0 ≤ (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 * δ0 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith) hδ0.le
    rw [hδ, div_le_iff₀ hℓ2pos]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨hcib1, hcib2⟩ := cib_band_bounds5 B.h γ.1 (by omega)
  have hTl : (0:ℝ) < Tgc * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 := mul_pos hTgc0 hℓ2pos
  have hcibpos : 0 < cib B.h γ.1 := lt_trans (div_pos one_pos hTl) hcib1
  have hLlow : 2 * G.r0 * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 := by
    show 2 * G.r0 * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * G.r0 / cib B.h γ.1
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hcibpos]
    have h1 : cib B.h γ.1 * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := (le_div_iff₀ hℓ2pos).mp hcib2
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 h2r0.le]
  have hLup : Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 < 2 * G.r0 * Tgc * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    show 2 * G.r0 / cib B.h γ.1 < 2 * G.r0 * Tgc * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hcibpos]
    have h1 : 1 < cib B.h γ.1 * (Tgc * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2) := (div_lt_iff₀ hTl).mp hcib1
    nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h1 h2r0]
  have hLpos : 0 < Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 := lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos h2r0 hℓ2pos) hLlow
  obtain ⟨hpar, hline⟩ := hpd γ ξ hl2 hAct heta hD hX1 hX2 hR
  obtain ⟨p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8, p9, p10, p11, p12⟩ := hpar
  have hC1δ : C1 / (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ δ := by
    rw [hδ]
    exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hℓ2pos).mpr (by rw [hC2]; linarith)
  have huL : G.ustar / Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 ≤ δ := by
    rw [hδ, div_le_div_iff₀ hLpos hℓ2pos]
    have h2 : M / (2 * G.r0) ≤ C2 := by rw [hC2]; linarith
    calc G.ustar * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ M * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right p12 hℓ2pos.le
      _ = M / (2 * G.r0) * (2 * G.r0 * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2) := by
          rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff h2r0.ne']; ring
      _ ≤ C2 * (2 * G.r0 * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (mul_pos h2r0 hℓ2pos).le
      _ ≤ C2 * Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLlow hC2pos.le
  have hsg : sgn γ.2.2 = 1 ∨ sgn γ.2.2 = -1 := by
    unfold sgn; split_ifs
    · left; rfl
    · right; rfl
  have hderiv : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), ∀ i : Fin 3,
      HasDerivAt (fun y => nPhi5 B G γ (ξ + (y - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) • dVdir B.h γ.1) i)
        (nPhiP5 B G γ (ξ + (v - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) • dVdir B.h γ.1) i) v := by
    intro v hv i
    have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := le_trans hw0 hv.1
    obtain ⟨-, -, hloc⟩ := pulse_line_rect5 B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 hr0 hr0' hR v hv0 hv.2
    have hPv : ξ + (v - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) • dVdir B.h γ.1 =
        (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, ξ.2.2.2 + (v - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) •
          ((cib B.h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1))) • vtv)) := by
      refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_)) <;> simp [dVdir]
    have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ η i)
        (ξ + (v - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) • dVdir B.h γ.1) := by
      rw [hPv]
      exact nphi5_diffAt_local5 B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, ξ.2.2.2 + (v - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) •
          ((cib B.h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1))) • vtv)) hB ⟨hD.1, hD.2.1, hD.2.2⟩ hloc i
    have hP : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => ξ + (y - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) • dVdir B.h γ.1)
        (dVdir B.h γ.1) v := by
      simpa using (((hasDerivAt_id' v).sub_const (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)).smul_const
        (dVdir B.h γ.1)).const_add ξ
    exact hdiff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt v hP
  have key := hA (F0r5 B G γ) (eN (g0r5 B G γ)) (Nfr5 B G γ).1 (Nfr5 B G γ).2 (Bs5 B G γ)
    (epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ))^2) (lam0_5 B G γ) G.ustar (sgn γ.2.2) δ (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) w
    (fun y => nPhi5 B G γ (ξ + (y - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) • dVdir B.h γ.1))
    (fun y => nPhiP5 B G γ (ξ + (y - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) • dVdir B.h γ.1))
    (fun y => Kmat B G γ (ξ + (y - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) • dVdir B.h γ.1)) x
    p1 p2 p3 p4 p5 p6 p7 rfl p8 p9 p10 p11 hsg hu0.le p12 hδpos hδ0' hLpos huL hw0 hwL
    (fun v hv i => by
      have h := (hline v (le_trans hw0 hv.1) hv.2).1 i
      exact ⟨h.1.trans hC1δ, h.2⟩)
    (fun v hv i j => ((hline v (le_trans hw0 hv.1) hv.2).2 i j).trans hC1δ)
    hderiv hx v hv
  change ‖x v‖ ≤ K0 * Real.exp (K0 * δ * (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 - w)) * (1 + (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 - w) / δ) *
    (Penv5 B G γ v / Penv5 B G γ w) * ‖x w‖ at key
  have hT0 : 0 ≤ Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 - w := by linarith
  have hTle : Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 - w ≤ 2 * G.r0 * Tgc * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 := by linarith
  have hT1 : δ * (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 - w) ≤ 2 * G.r0 * Tgc * C2 := by
    calc δ * (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 - w) ≤ δ * (2 * G.r0 * Tgc * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hTle hδpos.le
      _ = 2 * G.r0 * Tgc * C2 := by
          rw [hδ, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_eq_iff hℓ2pos.ne']; ring
  have hexp : Real.exp (K0 * δ * (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 - w)) ≤ Real.exp (K0 * (2 * G.r0 * Tgc * C2)) := by
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    rw [mul_assoc]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT1 hK0.le
  have hT2 : (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 - w) / δ ≤ 2 * G.r0 * Tgc / C2 * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 4 := by
    rw [hδ, div_div_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ hC2pos]
    have e : 2 * G.r0 * Tgc / C2 * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 4 * C2 = 2 * G.r0 * Tgc * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      field_simp <;> ring
    rw [e]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hTle hℓ2pos.le
  have h4 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 4 := one_le_pow₀ hl1
  have hT3 : 1 + (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 - w) / δ ≤ (1 + 2 * G.r0 * Tgc / C2) * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 4 := by
    nlinarith
  have h4r : (γ.1:ℝ) ^ (4:ℝ) = (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 4 := by
    rw [show (4:ℝ) = ((4:ℕ):ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_natCast]
  have hbound : K0 * Real.exp (K0 * δ * (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 - w)) * (1 + (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 - w) / δ) ≤
      K0 * Real.exp (K0 * (2 * G.r0 * Tgc * C2)) * (1 + 2 * G.r0 * Tgc / C2) * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ (4:ℝ) := by
    rw [h4r]
    have hq : 0 ≤ 1 + (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 - w) / δ := by
      have := div_nonneg hT0 hδpos.le
      linarith
    calc K0 * Real.exp (K0 * δ * (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 - w)) * (1 + (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 - w) / δ)
        ≤ K0 * Real.exp (K0 * (2 * G.r0 * Tgc * C2)) * ((1 + 2 * G.r0 * Tgc / C2) * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 4) :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp hK0.le) hT3 hq
            (mul_nonneg hK0.le (Real.exp_pos _).le)

      have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
      have hsm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
          ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
        intro W _ _ F hF
        exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
          (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
      have hsmO : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
          ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by
        intro W _ _ F hF
        exact (hsm F hF).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
      have key : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
          ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n →
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0 =
            (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
        intro W _ _ F hF i hi
        have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O
        have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
          hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
        have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + z)) i hs h0s
        have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i ξ 0
        calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0
            = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑L) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
          _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
                (fun _ => L) := e2
          _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
                (fun _ => L) := by rw [map_zero]
          _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
                (fun _ => L) := by rw [e3]
          _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
      have hfg : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun η => f η • g η) U := hf.smul hg
      have hl := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_smul_le (hsmO f hf) (hsmO g hg) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O
        (n := n) le_rfl
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => f (ξ + L y) • g (ξ + L y)) n hO h0O] at hl
      rw [← key _ hfg n le_rfl]
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => (fun η => f η • g η) (ξ + L z)) 0‖
          = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f (ξ + L y) • g (ξ + L y)) 0‖ := rfl
        _ ≤ _ := hl
        _ = _ := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i hi
          have hik : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O,
            iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => g (ξ + L z)) (n - i) hO h0O,
            key f hf i hik, key g hg (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i)]
    have cmul : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (i : ℕ), ContDiffAt ℝ i f ξ →
        NB h (fun η => c * f η) i ξ = |c| * NB h f i ξ := by
      intro f i hf
      unfold NB
      have e0 : (fun η => c * f η) = fun η => c • f η := rfl
      have e : iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun η => c • f η) ξ = c • iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f ξ :=
        iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply' hf
      rw [e0, e]
      have e2 : (c • iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) =
          c • (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) := by
        ext v; simp
      rw [e2, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := le_trans (hNBnn a 0) (hA 0 (Nat.zero_le k))
    have hE0 : 0 ≤ E := le_trans (hNBnn e 0) (hE 0 (Nat.zero_le k))
    have hQ0 : 0 ≤ Q := le_trans (hNBnn P 0) (hQ 0 (Nat.zero_le k))
    have ha' : ContDiffAt ℝ k a ξ := ha.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have he' : ContDiffAt ℝ k e ξ := he.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hP' : ContDiffAt ℝ k P ξ := hP.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    obtain ⟨ua, hua, hau⟩ := ha'.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
    obtain ⟨ue, hue, heu⟩ := he'.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
    obtain ⟨uP, huP, hPu⟩ := hP'.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
    obtain ⟨O, hOsub, hOopen, hξO⟩ :=
      mem_nhds_iff.mp (Filter.inter_mem hua (Filter.inter_mem hue huP))
    have haO : ContDiffOn ℝ k a O := hau.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).1)
    have heO : ContDiffOn ℝ k e O := heu.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).2.1)
    have hPO : ContDiffOn ℝ k P O := hPu.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).2.2)
    have hgO : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun η => c * a η * e η) O := (contDiffOn_const.mul haO).mul heO
    have hg : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h (fun η => c * a η * e η) i ξ ≤ |c| * A * E * 2 ^ i := by
      intro i hi
      have hik : ((i : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ((k : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast hi
      have l1 := leib O i hOopen hξO (fun η => c * a η) e
        (contDiffOn_const.mul (haO.of_le hik)) (heO.of_le hik)
      have l1' : NB h (fun η => c * a η * e η) i ξ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1),
          (i.choose j : ℝ) * NB h (fun η => c * a η) j ξ * NB h e (i - j) ξ := l1
      refine le_trans l1' ?_
      calc ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose j : ℝ) * NB h (fun η => c * a η) j ξ * NB h e (i - j) ξ
          ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose j : ℝ) * (|c| * A) * E := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro j hj
            have hji : j ≤ i := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
            have h1 : NB h (fun η => c * a η) j ξ ≤ |c| * A := by
              rw [cmul a j (ha.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hA j (le_trans hji hi)) (abs_nonneg c)
            have h2 : NB h e (i - j) ξ ≤ E := hE _ (le_trans (Nat.sub_le i j) hi)
            exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) h2 (hNBnn _ _)
              (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg c) hA0))
        _ = |c| * A * E * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose j : ℝ) := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _; ring
        _ = |c| * A * E * 2 ^ i := by
            congr 1; exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose i
    have l2 := leib O k hOopen hξO (fun η => c * a η * e η) P hgO hPO
    refine le_trans l2 ?_
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB h (fun η => c * a η * e η) i ξ *
          NB h P (k - i) ξ
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * (|c| * A * E * 2 ^ i) * Q := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hg i hik) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
            (hQ _ (Nat.sub_le k i)) (hNBnn _ _)
            (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg c) hA0) hE0)
              (pow_nonneg (by norm_num) i)))
      _ = |c| * A * E * Q * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (2:ℝ) ^ i * 1 ^ (k - i) * (k.choose i : ℝ) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; rw [one_pow]; ring
      _ = |c| * 3 ^ k * A * E * Q := by
          rw [← add_pow]; ring
  have hlb := nb_triple_leibniz B.h 1 ξ _ _ _ k A E
    (Cs * SC B.h ξ ^ Bm * Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ c ξ.2.2.2) * (6601 * SC B.h ξ) ^ k)
    hca hce hcP hNa hNe hNP
  have hNBeq : NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (chig G.r0 (xiG B.h γ c η.2.2.2) *
      psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ c η.2.2.2)) •
        G.tH γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ c η.2.2.2)) k ξ =
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (1 * bumpR (4 * xiG B.h γ c ξ.2.2.2 / G.r0 + Ta (η - ξ)) *
        psiT 1 ((etG B.h γ c ξ.2.2.2 + G.r0) / (2 * G.r0) + Te (η - ξ))) •
        G.tH γ (p3 η) (vco B.h G.r0 γ c ξ.2.2.2 + Tv (η - ξ))) k ξ := by
    unfold NB
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
  rw [hNBeq]
  refine le_trans hlb (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [abs_one, Real.rpow_add hSCpos, Real.rpow_natCast, mul_pow]
  ring
