proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xa Xb m1 m2 aa ab D hXa hXam1 hm12 hm2Xb haa hab
  
  have s1 : ∀ (D p p' q q' q0 : ℝ), 0 < p' → p' ≤ p → 0 < q0 → q0 ≤ q → q0 ≤ q' →
      D * (Real.log (min 1 (min p q)) - Real.log (min 1 (min p' q'))) ≤
        |D| * (Real.log (p / p') - Real.log (min 1 q0)) := by
    intro D p p' q q' q0 hp' hpp hq0 hq hq'
    have hp : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le hp' hpp
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = min 1 q0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = min 1 (min p q) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨δ', hδ'⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = min 1 (min p' q') := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hσ, ← hδ, ← hδ']
    have hσ0 : 0 < σ := by rw [hσ]; exact lt_min one_pos hq0
    have hσ1 : σ ≤ 1 := by rw [hσ]; exact min_le_left _ _
    have hσq0 : σ ≤ q0 := by rw [hσ]; exact min_le_right _ _
    have hδ0 : 0 < δ := by rw [hδ]; exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min hp (lt_of_lt_of_le hq0 hq))
    have hδ'0 : 0 < δ' := by rw [hδ']; exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min hp' (lt_of_lt_of_le hq0 hq'))
    have hδ1 : δ ≤ 1 := by rw [hδ]; exact min_le_left _ _
    have hδp : δ ≤ p := by rw [hδ]; exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
    have hδ'1 : δ' ≤ 1 := by rw [hδ']; exact min_le_left _ _
    have hδ'p : δ' ≤ p' := by rw [hδ']; exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
    
    have hσδ1 : σ * δ ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
    have hσδp : σ * δ ≤ p := by nlinarith
    have hp'δ : p' * δ ≤ p := by nlinarith
    have e1 : σ * p' * δ ≤ p * 1 := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hσδ1 hp'.le]
    have e2 : σ * p' * δ ≤ p * p' := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hσδp hp'.le]
    have e3 : σ * p' * δ ≤ p * q' := by
      have := mul_le_mul (hσq0.trans hq') hp'δ (by positivity) (by linarith)
      nlinarith
    have hA : σ * p' * δ ≤ p * δ' := by
      rcases min_choice 1 (min p' q') with h | h
      · rw [hδ', h]; exact e1
      · rw [hδ', h]
        rcases min_choice p' q' with h' | h'
        · rw [h']; exact e2
        · rw [h']; exact e3
    
    have hB : σ * δ' ≤ δ := by
      rw [hδ]
      refine le_min (by nlinarith) (le_min (by nlinarith) ?_)
      have : σ * δ' ≤ σ := by nlinarith
      linarith
    have lA := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) hA
    have lB := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) hB
    rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) hδ0.ne', Real.log_mul hσ0.ne' hp'.ne',
      Real.log_mul hp.ne' hδ'0.ne'] at lA
    rw [Real.log_mul hσ0.ne' hδ'0.ne'] at lB
    have hpp' : Real.log p' ≤ Real.log p := Real.log_le_log hp' hpp
    have hlσ : Real.log σ ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos hσ0.le hσ1
    rw [Real.log_div hp.ne' hp'.ne']
    rcases le_total 0 D with hD | hD
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg hD]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hD
    · rw [abs_of_nonpos hD]
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (show -(Real.log δ - Real.log δ') ≤ Real.log p - Real.log p' - Real.log σ by linarith)
        (neg_nonneg.mpr hD)
      linarith
  
  have s2 : ∀ (a A S s s' : ℝ), 0 < a → 0 ≤ A → 0 < s' → s' ≤ s → s ≤ S →
      a / s ^ 2 - a / s' ^ 2 + A * Real.log (s / s') ≤ A ^ 2 * S ^ 2 / (4 * a) := by
    intro a A S s s' ha hA hs' hss hsS
    have hs : 0 < s := lt_of_lt_of_le hs' hss
    have hS : 0 < S := lt_of_lt_of_le hs hsS
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = s / s' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = a / s ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = a / S ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hu1 : 1 ≤ u := by rw [hu]; exact (one_le_div hs').mpr hss
    have hlog : Real.log u ≤ u - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by linarith)
    have hβ0 : 0 < β := by rw [hβ]; positivity
    have hβγ : β ≤ γ := by
      rw [hβ, hγ]

    have hs'u : a / s' ^ 2 = γ * u ^ 2 := by rw [hγ, hu]; field_simp
    have key1 : A * Real.log u ≤ A * (u - 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog hA
    have key2 : β * (u - 1) ^ 2 ≤ γ * u ^ 2 - γ := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hβγ) (sq_nonneg (u - 1)),
        mul_nonneg (hβ0.le.trans hβγ) (sub_nonneg.mpr hu1)]
    have key3 : A * (u - 1) - β * (u - 1) ^ 2 ≤ A ^ 2 / (4 * β) := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (A - 2 * β * (u - 1))]
    have e : A ^ 2 / (4 * β) = A ^ 2 * S ^ 2 / (4 * a) := by
      rw [hβ]; field_simp
    rw [hs'u, ← hu, ← hγ, ← e]
    linarith
  
  have s3 : ∀ X, Xa < X → X < Xb → 0 < Real.log (X / Xa) ∧ 0 < Real.log (Xb / X) ∧
      edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-D) =
        Real.exp (-(aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2) - ab / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2 -
          D * Real.log (min 1 (min (Real.log (X / Xa)) (Real.log (Xb / X))))) := by
    intro X h1 h2
    have hX0 : 0 < X := hXa.trans h1
    have hs := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr h1)
    have hl := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr h2)
    have hd : 0 < edgeDist Xa Xb X := lt_min one_pos (lt_min hs hl)
    refine ⟨hs, hl, ?_⟩
    rw [edgeWeight, if_pos ⟨h1, h2⟩, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hd, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    unfold edgeDist
    ring
  
  have hm1 : 0 < m1 := hXa.trans hXam1
  have hm2 : 0 < m2 := hm1.trans_le hm12
  have hXb0 : 0 < Xb := hm2.trans hm2Xb
  obtain ⟨l2, hl2d⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = Real.log (Xb / m2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨S2, hS2d⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = Real.log (m2 / Xa) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨s1v, hs1d⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = Real.log (m1 / Xa) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨L1, hL1d⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = Real.log (Xb / m1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hl2 : 0 < l2 := by rw [hl2d]; exact Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hm2).mpr hm2Xb)
  have hs1 : 0 < s1v := by rw [hs1d]; exact Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hXam1)
  obtain ⟨k1, hk1⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = ab / l2 ^ 2 + |D| * (-Real.log (min 1 l2)) + |D| ^ 2 * S2 ^ 2 / (4 * aa) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨k2, hk2⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = aa / s1v ^ 2 + |D| * (-Real.log (min 1 s1v)) + |D| ^ 2 * L1 ^ 2 / (4 * ab) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨k3, hk3⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = aa / s1v ^ 2 + ab / l2 ^ 2 + |D| * (-Real.log (min 1 (min s1v l2))) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨Real.exp (max k1 k2), Real.exp (-k3), Real.exp_pos _, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro X' X h1 h2 h3
    have hX : Xa < X := h1.trans_le h2
    have hXb : X < Xb := h3.trans_lt hm2Xb
    have hX'b : X' < Xb := h2.trans_lt hXb
    have hX'0 : 0 < X' := hXa.trans h1
    have hX0 : 0 < X := hXa.trans hX
    obtain ⟨hs', hl', e'⟩ := s3 X' h1 hX'b
    obtain ⟨hs, hl, e⟩ := s3 X hX hXb
    rw [e, e', ← Real.exp_add]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hss : Real.log (X' / Xa) ≤ Real.log (X / Xa) :=
      Real.log_le_log (div_pos hX'0 hXa) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h2 hXa.le)
    have hsS : Real.log (X / Xa) ≤ S2 := by
      rw [hS2d]; exact Real.log_le_log (div_pos hX0 hXa) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h3 hXa.le)
    have hll : Real.log (Xb / X) ≤ Real.log (Xb / X') :=
      Real.log_le_log (div_pos hXb0 hX0) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hXb0.le hX'0 h2)
    have hlb : l2 ≤ Real.log (Xb / X) := by
      rw [hl2d]; exact Real.log_le_log (div_pos hXb0 hm2) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hXb0.le hX0 h3)
    have ha := s1 D _ _ _ _ l2 hs' hss hl2 hlb (hlb.trans hll)
    have hb := s2 aa |D| S2 _ _ haa (abs_nonneg D) hs' hss hsS
    have hc1 : 0 ≤ ab / Real.log (Xb / X') ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hc2 : ab / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2 ≤ ab / l2 ^ 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hab.le (by positivity) (pow_le_pow_left₀ hl2.le hlb 2)
    have hm := le_max_left k1 k2
    linarith
  · 
    intro X X' h1 h2 h3

    rw [e, e', ← Real.exp_add]

    rw [min_comm (Real.log (Xb / X)) (Real.log (X / Xa)),
      min_comm (Real.log (Xb / X')) (Real.log (X' / Xa))] at ha

    have hc1 : 0 ≤ aa / Real.log (X' / Xa) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hc2 : aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2 ≤ aa / s1v ^ 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left haa.le (by positivity) (pow_le_pow_left₀ hs1.le hsb 2)
    have hm := le_max_right k1 k2

    have hX0 : 0 < X := hXa.trans hX

    have hlb : l2 ≤ Real.log (Xb / X) := by
      rw [hl2d]; exact Real.log_le_log (div_pos hXb0 hm2) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hXb0.le hX0 h2)

    have hD : D * Real.log (min 1 (min (Real.log (X / Xa)) (Real.log (Xb / X)))) ≤

      rcases le_total 0 D with hD | hD

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 →
    ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) →
    (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ∫ r' in (0:ℝ)..η.1, f (pathPt B.h η r')) (DomC B.h qs) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ∫ r' in Set.Ioi η.1, f (pathPt B.h η r')) (DomC B.h qs) ∧
    ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
      NB B.h (fun η => ∫ r' in (0:ℝ)..η.1, f (pathPt B.h η r')) k ξ ≤
        C * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ∫ r' in (0:ℝ)..ξ.1, NB B.h f i (pathPt B.h ξ r') ∧
      NB B.h (fun η => ∫ r' in Set.Ioi η.1, f (pathPt B.h η r')) k ξ ≤
        C * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ∫ r' in Set.Ioi ξ.1, NB B.h f i (pathPt B.h ξ r')

      exact hXCs.comp (contDiff_const.add (Lnorm B.h ξ).contDiff).contDiffOn
        (fun v hv => by rw [hOdef] at hv; exact hv)
    have hχmaps : Set.MapsTo χ O (Set.Ioi 0) := by
      intro v hv
      rw [hOdef] at hv
      rw [hχdef]
      exact hXCpos _ hv
    have hχ0 : χ 0 = XC B.h ξ := by
      rw [hχdef]; show XC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ 0) = _; rw [map_zero, add_zero]
    have hDχ : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i χ O 0‖ ≤ D ^ i := by
      intro i h1 h2
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO h0O, hχdef,
        key (XC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hDo hXCs hξ i]
      exact hD i h1 h2
    have hAχ : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i φ (Set.Ioi 0) (χ 0)‖ ≤ A := by
      intro i hi; rw [hχ0]; exact hA i hi
    have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hφ hχ (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      (uniqueDiffOn_Ioi 0) hO.uniqueDiffOn hχmaps h0O (C := A) (D := D) hAχ hDχ
    have hNBeq : NB B.h (fun η => φ (XC B.h η)) m ξ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (φ ∘ χ) O 0‖ := by
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hO h0O, hχdef]
      unfold NB
      exact congrArg norm
        (key (fun η => φ (XC B.h η)) (DomC B.h qs) ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hDo hgs hξ m).symm
    rw [hNBeq]
    exact hFdB
  refine ⟨hqcs.mul hgs, fun k => ?_⟩
  choose Cq hCq using hqpow c
  obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |M i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |E i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by
    have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1)) => abs_nonneg (E i))
    rw [hDdef]; linarith
  have hMA : ∀ i ≤ k, M i ≤ A := by
    intro i hi
    have h2 : |M i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |M j| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |M j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
    rw [hAdef]; exact (le_abs_self _).trans h2
  have hED : ∀ i ≤ k, E i ≤ D := by
    intro i hi
    have h2 : |E i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |E j| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |E j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
    have h3 := le_abs_self (E i)
    rw [hDdef]; linarith
  refine ⟨∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
    (k.choose j : ℝ) * |Cq j| * (((k - j).factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ (k - j)), ?_⟩
  intro ξ hξ h1 h2
  have hq := hqpos ξ hξ
  have hpc : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ c := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
  have hφm : ∀ m ≤ k, NB B.h (fun η => φ (XC B.h η)) m ξ ≤ (m.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ m := by
    intro m hm
    refine hchain ξ hξ m A D
      (fun i hi => (hM i (XC B.h ξ) ⟨h1.le, h2.le⟩).trans (hMA i (hi.trans hm)))
      (fun i hi1 hi2 => ?_)
    calc NB B.h (XC B.h) i ξ ≤ E i := hXCE i ξ hξ h2
      _ ≤ D := hED i (hi2.trans hm)
      _ ≤ D ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
  have hprod := hmul (DomC B.h qs) (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c)
    (fun η => φ (XC B.h η)) hDo hqcs hgs ξ hξ k
  refine hprod.trans ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ?_)
  have e1 : NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c) j ξ ≤ |Cq j| * qC B.h ξ ^ c :=
    (hCq j ξ hξ).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hpc)
  have e2 := hφm (k - j) (Nat.sub_le k j)
  calc (k.choose j : ℝ) * NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c) j ξ *
        NB B.h (fun η => φ (XC B.h η)) (k - j) ξ
      ≤ (k.choose j : ℝ) * (|Cq j| * qC B.h ξ ^ c) *
          (((k - j).factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ (k - j)) :=
        mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) e2 (norm_nonneg _)
          (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hpc))
    _ = (k.choose j : ℝ) * |Cq j| * (((k - j).factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ (k - j)) *
          qC B.h ξ ^ c := by ring

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hB
  have hBP := hB.2
  unfold BackgroundProps at hBP
  obtain ⟨⟨-, -, hXa, hXm1, hm12, hm2Xb, -⟩, ⟨hFs, hUs, hFpos, hbd⟩,
    ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, ⟨κ, hκ0, hκ2, hK⟩⟩, -⟩ := hBP
  have hXab : B.Xa < B.Xb := by linarith
  have hopen : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  
  have slice : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => f Y η) (Ioi 0) := by
    intro f hf η h1 h2
    have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, η)) := contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const
    exact hf.comp hg.contDiffOn (fun Y hY => ⟨hY, h1, h2⟩)
  
  have hderiv : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      |deriv (fun Y => f Y η) X| ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (↿f) (X, η)‖ := by
    intro f hf X η hX h1 h2
    have hmem : (X, η) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨hX, h1, h2⟩
    have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿f) (X, η) :=
      (hf.contDiffAt (hopen.mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hcurve : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, η)) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) X :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X η)
    have hcomp := hdiff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt X hcurve
    have heq : deriv (fun Y => f Y η) X = fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) := hcomp.deriv
    rw [heq, norm_iteratedFDeriv_one, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc ‖fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))‖
        ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η)‖ * ‖((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))‖ := (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η)).le_opNorm _
      _ = ‖fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η)‖ := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
  
  have cont : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ContinuousOn (fun X => B.F X η) (Ioi 0) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun X => shearA B.F X η) (Ioi 0) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun X => shearB B.F B.U X η) (Ioi 0) := by
    intro η h1 h2
    have sF := slice B.F hFs η h1 h2
    have sU := slice B.U hUs η h1 h2
    have cF : ContinuousOn (fun X => B.F X η) (Ioi 0) := sF.continuousOn
    have dF : ContinuousOn (deriv fun Y => B.F Y η) (Ioi 0) :=
      sF.continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioi (by simp)
    have dU : ContinuousOn (deriv fun Y => B.U Y η) (Ioi 0) :=
      sU.continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioi (by simp)
    have hne : ∀ X ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ), B.F X η ≠ 0 := fun X hX => (hFpos X η hX h1 h2).ne'
    refine ⟨cF, ?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold shearA
      exact ((continuousOn_const.mul continuousOn_id).mul dF).div cF hne
    · unfold shearB
      exact (((Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).continuousOn).mul
        dU).div cF hne
  
  have clos : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn f (Ioi 0) → ContinuousOn g (Ioi 0) →
      (∀ X, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb → f X ≤ g X) → ∀ X, B.Xa ≤ X → X ≤ B.Xb → f X ≤ g X := by
    intro f g hf hg hle X h1 h2
    have hX0 : X ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) := show (0:ℝ) < X by linarith
    have hcl : X ∈ closure (Ioo B.Xa B.Xb) := by rw [closure_Ioo hXab.ne]; exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact ContinuousWithinAt.closure_le hcl
      ((hf.continuousAt (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds hX0)).continuousWithinAt)
      ((hg.continuousAt (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds hX0)).continuousWithinAt)
      (fun y hy => hle y hy.1 hy.2)
  
  have alg : ∀ a b k : ℝ, 0 < a → k ≤ a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) - 2 → (2 + k) * a ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
    intro a b k ha h
    have h1 : a * (b / a) = b := by field_simp [ha.ne']
    have hid : a * (a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2)) = a ^ 2 + (a * (b / a)) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [h1] at hid
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show 2 + k ≤ a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) by linarith) ha.le
    nlinarith
  
  obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := hbd B.Xa B.Xb hXa 0
  obtain ⟨C1', hC1'⟩ := hbd B.Xa B.Xb hXa 1
  obtain ⟨C1, hC1def⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = max C0 C1' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hC0le : C0 ≤ C1 := by rw [hC1def]; exact le_max_left _ _
  have hC1le : C1' ≤ C1 := by rw [hC1def]; exact le_max_right _ _
  refine ⟨κ, max κ (max C1 (max (2 * B.Xb * C1 / κ) (Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xb) * C1 / κ))),
    hκ0, hκ2, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro X η h1 h2 h3 h4
  obtain ⟨cF, cA, cB⟩ := cont η h3 h4
  have hX0 : 0 < X := by linarith
  have L1 : κ ≤ B.F X η := clos (fun _ => κ) (fun X => B.F X η) continuousOn_const cF
    (fun X' a b => (hK X' η a b h3 h4).1) X h1 h2
  have L2 : κ ≤ shearA B.F X η := clos (fun _ => κ) (fun X => shearA B.F X η) continuousOn_const cA
    (fun X' a b => (hK X' η a b h3 h4).2.1) X h1 h2
  have L3 : (2 + κ) * shearA B.F X η ≤ shearA B.F X η ^ 2 + shearB B.F B.U X η ^ 2 :=
    clos (fun X => (2 + κ) * shearA B.F X η)
      (fun X => shearA B.F X η ^ 2 + shearB B.F B.U X η ^ 2)
      (continuousOn_const.mul cA) ((cA.pow 2).add (cB.pow 2))
      (fun X' a b => by
        obtain ⟨k1, k2, k3, -⟩ := hK X' η a b h3 h4
        exact alg _ _ κ (by linarith) k3) X h1 h2
  obtain ⟨b0F, -⟩ := hC0 X η h1 h2 h3 h4
  obtain ⟨b1F, b1U⟩ := hC1' X η h1 h2 h3 h4
  rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at b0F
  have dFb : |deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η) X| ≤ C1 :=
    ((hderiv B.F hFs X η hX0 h3 h4).trans b1F).trans hC1le
  have dUb : |deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η) X| ≤ C1 :=
    ((hderiv B.U hUs X η hX0 h3 h4).trans b1U).trans hC1le
  have Fb : |B.F X η| ≤ C1 := b0F.trans hC0le
  have hC1nn : 0 ≤ C1 := (abs_nonneg _).trans Fb
  have hFp : 0 < B.F X η := by linarith
  have hXb0 : 0 ≤ B.Xb := by linarith
  have U2 : shearA B.F X η ≤ 2 * B.Xb * C1 / κ := by
    unfold shearA
    have hd := abs_le.mp dFb
    have e1 : -2 * X * deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η) X ≤ 2 * B.Xb * C1 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hX0.le (show 0 ≤ deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η) X + C1 by linarith),
        mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ B.Xb - X by linarith) hC1nn]
    calc -2 * X * deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η) X / B.F X η ≤ 2 * B.Xb * C1 / B.F X η :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right e1 hFp.le
      _ ≤ 2 * B.Xb * C1 / κ :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hXb0) hC1nn) hκ0 L1
  have U3 : |shearB B.F B.U X η| ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xb) * C1 / κ := by
    unfold shearB
    rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), abs_of_pos hFp]
    have e2 : Real.sqrt (2 * X) * |deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η) X| ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xb) * C1 :=
      mul_le_mul (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)) dUb (abs_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    calc Real.sqrt (2 * X) * |deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η) X| / B.F X η
        ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xb) * C1 / B.F X η := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right e2 hFp.le
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xb) * C1 / κ :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hC1nn) hκ0 L1
  refine ⟨L1, ?_, L2, ?_, ?_, L3⟩
  · exact (((le_abs_self _).trans Fb).trans (le_max_left _ _)).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  · exact U2.trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)))
  · exact U3.trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)))

    ∃ Lp : ℝ, 0 ≤ Lp ∧ ∀ X X' η η' : ℝ, B.Xa ≤ X → X ≤ B.Xb → B.Xa ≤ X' → X' ≤ B.Xb →

by
  intro B hB κ hκ hκF
  obtain ⟨-, -, hXa, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -⟩ := hB.2.1
  obtain ⟨hFs, hUs, -, hbd⟩ := hB.2.2.1
  have hXab : B.Xa < B.Xb := by linarith
  have core : ∀ (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (Xa Xb : ℝ), 0 < Xa → Xa < Xb →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      (∀ X₀ X₁ : ℝ, 0 < X₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₀ ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (Function.uncurry F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (Function.uncurry U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) →
      (∀ X η : ℝ, Xa ≤ X → X ≤ Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → κ ≤ F X η) →
      ∃ Lp : ℝ, 0 ≤ Lp ∧ ∀ X X' η η' : ℝ, Xa ≤ X → X ≤ Xb → Xa ≤ X' → X' ≤ Xb →
        -1 < η → η < 1 → -1 < η' → η' < 1 →
        |F X η - F X' η'| + |shearA F X η - shearA F X' η'| +
          |shearB F U X η - shearB F U X' η'| ≤ Lp * (|X - X'| + |η - η'|) := by
    intro F U Xa Xb hXa hXab hFs hUs hbd hκF
    obtain ⟨Ca, hCa⟩ := hbd Xa Xb hXa 1
    obtain ⟨Cb, hCb⟩ := hbd Xa Xb hXa 2
    have hO : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hSc : Convex ℝ (Icc Xa Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := (convex_Icc Xa Xb).prod (convex_Ioo (-1) 1)
    have hSO : ∀ z ∈ Icc Xa Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, z ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := fun z hz =>
      ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hXa hz.1.1, hz.2⟩
    have e1 : ‖((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))‖ = 1 := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
    
    have mvt : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry f) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
        (∀ X η : ℝ, Xa ≤ X → X ≤ Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (Function.uncurry f) (X, η)‖ ≤ max Ca 0 ∧
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (Function.uncurry f) (X, η)‖ ≤ max Cb 0) →
        ∀ X X' η η' : ℝ, Xa ≤ X → X ≤ Xb → Xa ≤ X' → X' ≤ Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → -1 < η' → η' < 1 →
        |f X η - f X' η'| ≤ max Ca 0 * (|X - X'| + |η - η'|) ∧
        deriv (fun Y => f Y η) X = fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X, η) (1, 0) ∧
        |fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X, η) (1, 0)| ≤ max Ca 0 ∧
        |fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X, η) (1, 0) -
            fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X', η') (1, 0)| ≤ max Cb 0 * (|X - X'| + |η - η'|) := by
      intro f hs hb X X' η η' h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7 h8
      have hca : ∀ z ∈ Icc Xa Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry f) z :=
        fun z hz => hs.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds (hSO z hz))
      have hd1 : ∀ z ∈ Icc Xa Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, DifferentiableAt ℝ (Function.uncurry f) z :=
        fun z hz => (hca z hz).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hd2 : ∀ z ∈ Icc Xa Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
          DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f)) z := fun z hz =>
        ((hca z hz).fderiv_right (m := 1) (by simp)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have hb1 : ∀ z ∈ Icc Xa Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, ‖fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) z‖ ≤ max Ca 0 :=
        fun z hz => by
          rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_one]
          exact (hb z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2).1
      have hb2 : ∀ z ∈ Icc Xa Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
          ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f)) z‖ ≤ max Cb 0 := fun z hz => by
        rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_one, norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
        exact (hb z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2).2
      have hz : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Icc Xa Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h5, h6⟩
      have hz' : ((X', η') : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Icc Xa Xb ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨⟨h3, h4⟩, h7, h8⟩
      have hnorm : ‖((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) - (X', η')‖ ≤ |X - X'| + |η - η'| := by
        rw [Prod.mk_sub_mk, Prod.norm_def, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact max_le (le_add_of_nonneg_right (abs_nonneg _)) (le_add_of_nonneg_left (abs_nonneg _))
      have hC1 : 0 ≤ max Ca 0 := le_max_right _ _
      have hC2 : 0 ≤ max Cb 0 := le_max_right _ _
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have := hSc.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hd1 hb1 hz' hz
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
        exact this.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm hC1)
      · have hF := (hd1 _ hz).hasFDerivAt
        have hc : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => (id Y, η)) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) X :=
          (hasDerivAt_id X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X η)
        exact (hF.comp_hasDerivAt X hc).deriv
      · calc |fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X, η) (1, 0)|
            = ‖fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X, η) (1, 0)‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
          _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X, η)‖ * ‖((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))‖ :=
              ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
          _ ≤ max Ca 0 := by rw [e1, mul_one]; exact hb1 _ hz
      · have := hSc.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hd2 hb2 hz' hz
        calc |fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X, η) (1, 0) -
              fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X', η') (1, 0)|
            = ‖(fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X, η) -
                fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X', η')) (1, 0)‖ := by
              rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
          _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X, η) - fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X', η')‖ *
                ‖((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
          _ ≤ max Cb 0 * (|X - X'| + |η - η'|) := by
              rw [e1, mul_one]; exact this.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm hC2)
    have hbF : ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa ≤ X → X ≤ Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (Function.uncurry F) (X, η)‖ ≤ max Ca 0 ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (Function.uncurry F) (X, η)‖ ≤ max Cb 0 := fun X η a b c d =>
      ⟨(hCa X η a b c d).1.trans (le_max_left _ _), (hCb X η a b c d).1.trans (le_max_left _ _)⟩
    have hbU : ∀ X η : ℝ, Xa ≤ X → X ≤ Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (Function.uncurry U) (X, η)‖ ≤ max Ca 0 ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (Function.uncurry U) (X, η)‖ ≤ max Cb 0 := fun X η a b c d =>
      ⟨(hCa X η a b c d).2.trans (le_max_left _ _), (hCb X η a b c d).2.trans (le_max_left _ _)⟩
    
    have quot : ∀ n n' p p' : ℝ, κ ≤ p → κ ≤ p' →
        |n / p - n' / p'| ≤ |n - n'| / κ + |n'| * |p - p'| / κ ^ 2 := by
      intro n n' p p' hp hp'
      have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le hκ hp
      have hp0' : 0 < p' := lt_of_lt_of_le hκ hp'
      have e : n / p - n' / p' = (n - n') / p + n' * (p' - p) / (p * p') := by
        field_simp; ring
      rw [e]
      refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
      · rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hp0]
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (abs_nonneg _) hκ hp
      · rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (mul_pos hp0 hp0'), abs_sub_comm p' p]
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity) (by nlinarith)
    set C1 := max Ca 0 with hC1def
    set C2 := max Cb 0 with hC2def
    have hC1 : 0 ≤ C1 := le_max_right _ _
    have hC2 : 0 ≤ C2 := le_max_right _ _
    have hXb0 : 0 < Xb := lt_trans hXa hXab
    have hr : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * Xa) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
    set r := Real.sqrt (2 * Xa) with hrdef
    set sb := Real.sqrt (2 * Xb) with hsbdef
    have hsb0 : 0 ≤ sb := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    refine ⟨C1 + (2 * (C1 + Xb * C2) / κ + 2 * Xb * C1 * C1 / κ ^ 2) +
        ((2 * C1 / r + sb * C2) / κ + sb * C1 * C1 / κ ^ 2), by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro X X' η η' h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7 h8
    obtain ⟨F1, F2, F3, F4⟩ := mvt F hFs hbF X X' η η' h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7 h8
    obtain ⟨-, F2', F3', -⟩ := mvt F hFs hbF X' X η' η h3 h4 h1 h2 h7 h8 h5 h6
    obtain ⟨-, U2, U3, U4⟩ := mvt U hUs hbU X X' η η' h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7 h8
    obtain ⟨-, U2', U3', -⟩ := mvt U hUs hbU X' X η' η h3 h4 h1 h2 h7 h8 h5 h6
    unfold shearA shearB
    rw [F2, F2', U2, U2']
    set δ := |X - X'| + |η - η'| with hδdef
    set φ := fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry F) (X, η) (1, 0) with hφ
    set φ' := fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry F) (X', η') (1, 0) with hφ'
    set ψ := fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry U) (X, η) (1, 0) with hψ
    set ψ' := fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry U) (X', η') (1, 0) with hψ'
    have hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ := by positivity
    have hXδ : |X - X'| ≤ δ := le_add_of_nonneg_right (abs_nonneg _)
    have hp := hκF X η h1 h2 h5 h6
    have hp' := hκF X' η' h3 h4 h7 h8
    have hX0 : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hXa h1
    have hX0' : 0 < X' := lt_of_lt_of_le hXa h3
    have hκ2 : 0 < κ ^ 2 := by positivity
    
    have hA : |-2 * X * φ / F X η - -2 * X' * φ' / F X' η'| ≤
        (2 * (C1 + Xb * C2) / κ + 2 * Xb * C1 * C1 / κ ^ 2) * δ := by
      refine (quot _ _ _ _ hp hp').trans ?_
      have k1 : |(X - X') * φ| ≤ δ * C1 := by
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hXδ F3 (abs_nonneg _) hδ0
      have k2 : |X' * (φ - φ')| ≤ Xb * (C2 * δ) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hX0']; exact mul_le_mul h4 F4 (abs_nonneg _) hXb0.le
      have k3 : |-2 * X * φ - -2 * X' * φ'| ≤ 2 * (C1 + Xb * C2) * δ := by
        have e : -2 * X * φ - -2 * X' * φ' = -2 * ((X - X') * φ + X' * (φ - φ')) := by ring
        rw [e, abs_mul, show |(-2:ℝ)| = 2 by norm_num]
        have := abs_add_le ((X - X') * φ) (X' * (φ - φ'))
        linarith
      have k4 : |-2 * X' * φ'| ≤ 2 * Xb * C1 := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hX0', show |(-2:ℝ)| = 2 by norm_num]
        have := mul_le_mul h4 F3' (abs_nonneg _) hXb0.le
        linarith
      have k5 : |F X η - F X' η'| ≤ C1 * δ := F1
      have q1 : |-2 * X * φ - -2 * X' * φ'| / κ ≤ 2 * (C1 + Xb * C2) * δ / κ :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right k3 hκ.le
      have q2 : |-2 * X' * φ'| * |F X η - F X' η'| / κ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Xb * C1 * (C1 * δ) / κ ^ 2 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul k4 k5 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)) hκ2.le
      have e2 : (2 * (C1 + Xb * C2) / κ + 2 * Xb * C1 * C1 / κ ^ 2) * δ =
          2 * (C1 + Xb * C2) * δ / κ + 2 * Xb * C1 * (C1 * δ) / κ ^ 2 := by ring
      linarith
    
    have hB : |Real.sqrt (2 * X) * ψ / F X η - Real.sqrt (2 * X') * ψ' / F X' η'| ≤
        ((2 * C1 / r + sb * C2) / κ + sb * C1 * C1 / κ ^ 2) * δ := by
      refine (quot _ _ _ _ hp hp').trans ?_
      have hs : r ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * X) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
      have hs0' : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * X') := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have hsb' : Real.sqrt (2 * X') ≤ sb := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
      have hsum : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * X) + Real.sqrt (2 * X') := by linarith
      have hsd : Real.sqrt (2 * X) - Real.sqrt (2 * X') =
          2 * (X - X') / (Real.sqrt (2 * X) + Real.sqrt (2 * X')) := by
        rw [eq_div_iff hsum.ne']
        linear_combination (Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * X by linarith)) -
          (Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * X' by linarith))
      have hsdb : |Real.sqrt (2 * X) - Real.sqrt (2 * X')| ≤ 2 * δ / r := by
        rw [hsd, abs_div, abs_of_pos hsum, abs_mul, abs_two]
        exact div_le_div₀ (by positivity) (by linarith) hr (by linarith)
      have k1 : |(Real.sqrt (2 * X) - Real.sqrt (2 * X')) * ψ| ≤ 2 * δ / r * C1 := by
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hsdb U3 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      have k2 : |Real.sqrt (2 * X') * (ψ - ψ')| ≤ sb * (C2 * δ) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hs0']; exact mul_le_mul hsb' U4 (abs_nonneg _) hsb0
      have k3 : |Real.sqrt (2 * X) * ψ - Real.sqrt (2 * X') * ψ'| ≤
          2 * δ / r * C1 + sb * (C2 * δ) := by
        have e : Real.sqrt (2 * X) * ψ - Real.sqrt (2 * X') * ψ' =
            (Real.sqrt (2 * X) - Real.sqrt (2 * X')) * ψ + Real.sqrt (2 * X') * (ψ - ψ') := by ring
        rw [e]
        exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add k1 k2)
      have k4 : |Real.sqrt (2 * X') * ψ'| ≤ sb * C1 := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hs0']; exact mul_le_mul hsb' U3' (abs_nonneg _) hsb0
      have k5 : |F X η - F X' η'| ≤ C1 * δ := F1
      have q1 : |Real.sqrt (2 * X) * ψ - Real.sqrt (2 * X') * ψ'| / κ ≤
          (2 * δ / r * C1 + sb * (C2 * δ)) / κ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right k3 hκ.le
      have q2 : |Real.sqrt (2 * X') * ψ'| * |F X η - F X' η'| / κ ^ 2 ≤
          sb * C1 * (C1 * δ) / κ ^ 2 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul k4 k5 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)) hκ2.le
      have e2 : ((2 * C1 / r + sb * C2) / κ + sb * C1 * C1 / κ ^ 2) * δ =
          (2 * δ / r * C1 + sb * (C2 * δ)) / κ + sb * C1 * (C1 * δ) / κ ^ 2 := by ring
      linarith
    have hF1 : |F X η - F X' η'| ≤ C1 * δ := F1
    have e3 : (C1 + (2 * (C1 + Xb * C2) / κ + 2 * Xb * C1 * C1 / κ ^ 2) +
        ((2 * C1 / r + sb * C2) / κ + sb * C1 * C1 / κ ^ 2)) * δ =
        C1 * δ + (2 * (C1 + Xb * C2) / κ + 2 * Xb * C1 * C1 / κ ^ 2) * δ +
        ((2 * C1 / r + sb * C2) / κ + sb * C1 * C1 / κ ^ 2) * δ := by ring
    linarith
  exact core B.F B.U B.Xa B.Xb hXa hXab hFs hUs hbd hκF

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (κ D : ℝ), 0 < κ → κ < 2 → κ ≤ D → ∃ (c C : ℝ), 0 < c ∧
    ∀ (s p a b F0 lam : ℝ) (g N : ℝ × ℝ), 1/4 ≤ s → s ≤ 4 → κ ≤ p → p ≤ D → κ ≤ a → a ≤ D →
      |b| ≤ D → (2 + κ) * a ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 → F0 = s * p → g = F0 • (-a, b) →
      N = (eN g)⁻¹ • g → lam = Real.sqrt (-(2 * F0 * N.1) * (2 * F0 * N.1 + eN g)) →
      c ≤ F0 ∧ F0 ≤ C ∧ c ≤ eN g ∧ eN g ≤ C ∧ N.1 ≤ -c ∧ c ≤ lam ∧ lam ≤ C ∧
      lam / (2 * F0 * N.1) ≤ -c ∧ -C ≤ lam / (2 * F0 * N.1)

∀ (κ D : ℝ), 0 < κ → κ < 2 → κ ≤ D → ∃ (c C : ℝ), 0 < c ∧

      |b| ≤ D → (2 + κ) * a ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 → F0 = s * p → g = F0 • (-a, b) →

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ D hκ hκ2 hκD
  have hD : 0 < D := lt_of_lt_of_le hκ hκD
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℝ, m = min 1 (κ ^ 5 / (32 * D ^ 2)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = 1 + 32 * D ^ 3 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by rw [hm]; exact lt_min one_pos (by positivity)
  have hm1 : m ≤ 1 := by rw [hm]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hm2 : m ≤ κ ^ 5 / (32 * D ^ 2) := by rw [hm]; exact min_le_right _ _
  have hM1 : 1 ≤ M := by
    have : 0 < D ^ 3 := by positivity
    rw [hM]; linarith
  have hM0 : 0 < M := by linarith
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ,
      c = min (κ / 4) (min (κ ^ 2 / 4) (min (κ / (2 * D)) (min m (m / (8 * D))))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = max (4 * D) (max (8 * D ^ 2) (max M (4 * D * M / κ ^ 2))) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc1 : c ≤ κ / 4 := by rw [hc]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hc2 : c ≤ κ ^ 2 / 4 := by rw [hc]; exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hc3 : c ≤ κ / (2 * D) := by
    rw [hc]; exact (min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
  have hc4 : c ≤ m := by
    rw [hc]
    exact (min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans
      ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)))
  have hc5 : c ≤ m / (8 * D) := by
    rw [hc]
    exact (min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans
      ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)))
  have hcpos : 0 < c := by
    have h5 : 0 < m / (8 * D) := by positivity
    rw [hc]
    exact lt_min (by positivity) (lt_min (by positivity) (lt_min (by positivity) (lt_min hm0 h5)))
  have hC1 : 4 * D ≤ C := by rw [hC]; exact le_max_left _ _
  have hC2 : 8 * D ^ 2 ≤ C := by rw [hC]; exact (le_max_right _ _).trans' (le_max_left _ _)
  have hC3 : M ≤ C := by
    rw [hC]; exact ((le_max_right _ _).trans' (le_max_left _ _)).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hC4 : 4 * D * M / κ ^ 2 ≤ C := by
    rw [hC]; exact ((le_max_right _ _).trans' (le_max_right _ _)).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := by linarith
  refine ⟨c, C, hcpos, ?_⟩
  intro s p a b F0 lam g N hs1 hs2 hp1 hp2 ha1 ha2 hb hadm hF0 hg hN hlam
  
  have hF0l : κ / 4 ≤ F0 := by
    have := mul_le_mul hs1 hp1 hκ.le (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ s)
    rw [hF0]; linarith
  have hF0u : F0 ≤ 4 * D := by
    have := mul_le_mul hs2 hp2 (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ p) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 4)
    rw [hF0]; linarith
  have hF0pos : 0 < F0 := by linarith
  have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith
  
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := abs_le.mp hb
  have hb2' : b ^ 2 ≤ D ^ 2 := sq_le_sq' hb1 hb2
  have ha2' : a ^ 2 ≤ D ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ ha0.le ha2 2
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, R = Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hRsq : R ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by rw [hR]; exact Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ R := by rw [hR]; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have haR : a ≤ R := by
    rw [hR]; exact Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le (by linarith [sq_nonneg b])
  have hR2D : R ≤ 2 * D := by
    rw [hR, Real.sqrt_le_left (by linarith), show (2 * D) ^ 2 = 4 * D ^ 2 by ring]
    linarith [sq_nonneg D]
  have hRpos : 0 < R := by linarith
  
  have hg1 : g.1 = -(F0 * a) := by rw [hg]; simp
  have hg2 : g.2 = F0 * b := by rw [hg]; simp
  have hE : eN g = F0 * R := by
    unfold eN
    have e : (-(F0 * a)) ^ 2 + (F0 * b) ^ 2 = F0 ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by ring
    rw [hg1, hg2, e, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq hF0pos.le, hR]
  
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : ℝ, u = a / R := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have huR : u * R = a := by rw [hu]; field_simp
  have hN1 : N.1 = -u := by
    rw [hN, Prod.smul_fst, smul_eq_mul, hE, hg1, hu]
    field_simp
  have hu1 : u ≤ 1 := by rw [hu, div_le_one hRpos]; exact haR
  have hul : κ / (2 * D) ≤ u := by
    rw [hu, le_div_iff₀ hRpos]
    calc κ / (2 * D) * R ≤ κ / (2 * D) * (2 * D) := by gcongr
      _ = κ := by field_simp
      _ ≤ a := ha1
  have hu0 : 0 < u := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hul
  
  have hadmR : (2 + κ) * u * R ≤ R * R := by
    calc (2 + κ) * u * R = (2 + κ) * a := by rw [mul_assoc, huR]
      _ ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := hadm
      _ = R * R := by rw [← hRsq]; ring
  have hadm' : (2 + κ) * u ≤ R := le_of_mul_le_mul_right hadmR hRpos
  have hQ : -(2 * F0 * N.1) * (2 * F0 * N.1 + eN g) = 2 * F0 ^ 2 * (a - 2 * u ^ 2) := by
    rw [hN1, hE]; linear_combination (2 * F0 ^ 2) * huR
  have hku : κ * u ^ 2 ≤ a - 2 * u ^ 2 := by
    have h := mul_nonneg hu0.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hadm')
    have e : a - 2 * u ^ 2 - κ * u ^ 2 = u * (R - (2 + κ) * u) := by
      rw [← huR]; ring
    linarith
  have hF0sq : (κ / 4) ^ 2 ≤ F0 ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hF0l 2
  have husq : (κ / (2 * D)) ^ 2 ≤ u ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hul 2
  have hQl : κ ^ 5 / (32 * D ^ 2) ≤ 2 * F0 ^ 2 * (a - 2 * u ^ 2) := by
    calc κ ^ 5 / (32 * D ^ 2) = 2 * (κ / 4) ^ 2 * κ * (κ / (2 * D)) ^ 2 := by
          field_simp; ring
      _ ≤ 2 * F0 ^ 2 * κ * u ^ 2 := by gcongr
      _ = 2 * F0 ^ 2 * (κ * u ^ 2) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 * F0 ^ 2 * (a - 2 * u ^ 2) := by gcongr
  have hQu : 2 * F0 ^ 2 * (a - 2 * u ^ 2) ≤ M := by
    have h0 : 0 ≤ F0 ^ 2 * u ^ 2 := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg F0) (sq_nonneg u)
    have h1 : 2 * F0 ^ 2 * (a - 2 * u ^ 2) = 2 * F0 ^ 2 * a - 4 * (F0 ^ 2 * u ^ 2) := by ring
    have h2 : 2 * F0 ^ 2 * a ≤ 2 * (4 * D) ^ 2 * D := by gcongr
    have h4 : 2 * (4 * D) ^ 2 * D = 32 * D ^ 3 := by ring
    rw [hM]; linarith
  
  rw [hQ] at hlam
  have hlaml : m ≤ lam := by
    rw [hlam, Real.le_sqrt' hm0]
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm1 hm0.le
    have e : m ^ 2 = m * m := by ring
    linarith
  have hlamu : lam ≤ M := by
    rw [hlam, Real.sqrt_le_left hM0.le]
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hM1 hM0.le
    have e : M ^ 2 = M * M := by ring
    linarith
  
  have hden : 2 * F0 * N.1 = -(2 * F0 * u) := by rw [hN1]; ring
  have hw0 : 0 < 2 * F0 * u := by positivity
  have hw8 : 2 * F0 * u ≤ 8 * D := by
    have h := mul_le_mul hF0u hu1 hu0.le (by linarith)
    linarith
  have hwl : κ ^ 2 / (4 * D) ≤ 2 * F0 * u := by
    calc κ ^ 2 / (4 * D) = 2 * (κ / 4) * (κ / (2 * D)) := by field_simp
      _ ≤ 2 * F0 * u := by gcongr

by
  intro κ D hκ hκ2 hκD

informal_problem.statement:
∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h < 1/4 →
    (∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1/256 → 0 ≤ coarseIdx h q) ∧

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h hh0 hh1
  have JP : (∀ (n i j : ℤ), 0 ≤ n → ∃ i' j' : ℤ, Jpow n ((i : ℝ), (j : ℝ)) = ((i' : ℝ), (j' : ℝ))) ∧
      (∀ (m n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), Jpow m (Jpow n Y) = Jpow (m + n) Y) ∧
      (∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, Jpow 0 Y = Y) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (Y W : ℝ × ℝ), (Jpow n Y).1 * W.1 + (Jpow n Y).2 * W.2 =
        Y.1 * (Jpow n W).1 + Y.2 * (Jpow n W).2) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), bgc * (Jpow n Y).1 + (Jpow n Y).2 = Tgc ^ n * (bgc * Y.1 + Y.2)) := by
    have hs : Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
    have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := (Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)).mpr (by norm_num)
    have hL : Lgc ≠ 0 := by unfold Lgc; intro h0; linarith
    have hT : Tgc ≠ 0 := by unfold Tgc; intro h0; linarith
    have hN : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have c1 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), (Jpow n Y).1 = Lgc ^ n * ((Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) +
        Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) * bgc := by
      intro n Y
      simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk]
      ring
    have c2 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), (Jpow n Y).2 = -(Lgc ^ n * ((Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) * bgc) +
        Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) := by
      intro n Y
      simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk]
      ring
    have hcomp : ∀ (m n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), Jpow m (Jpow n Y) = Jpow (m + n) Y := by
      intro m n Y
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
      · rw [c1 m, c1 (m + n), c1 n, c2 n, zpow_add₀ hL, zpow_add₀ hT]
        field_simp
        ring
      · rw [c2 m, c2 (m + n), c1 n, c2 n, zpow_add₀ hL, zpow_add₀ hT]
        field_simp
        ring
    have hid : ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, Jpow 0 Y = Y := by
      intro Y
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
      · rw [c1, zpow_zero, zpow_zero]
        field_simp
        ring
      · rw [c2, zpow_zero, zpow_zero]
        field_simp
        ring
    have hsym : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y W : ℝ × ℝ), (Jpow n Y).1 * W.1 + (Jpow n Y).2 * W.2 =
        Y.1 * (Jpow n W).1 + Y.2 * (Jpow n W).2 := by
      intro n Y W
      rw [c1 n Y, c2 n Y, c1 n W, c2 n W]
      field_simp
      ring
    have heig : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), bgc * (Jpow n Y).1 + (Jpow n Y).2 = Tgc ^ n * (bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) := by
      intro n Y
      rw [c1 n Y, c2 n Y]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hNinv : ∀ x : ℝ, x / (1 + bgc ^ 2) = x * (2 + Real.sqrt 2) / 4 := by
      intro x
      rw [div_eq_div_iff hN (by norm_num)]
      unfold bgc
      linear_combination (-x * Real.sqrt 2) * hs
    have hJ1 : ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, Jpow 1 Y = (3 * Y.1 + Y.2, Y.1 + 5 * Y.2) := by
      intro Y
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
      · rw [c1, zpow_one, zpow_one, hNinv, hNinv]
        unfold Lgc Tgc bgc
        linear_combination ((Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 + 4 * Real.sqrt 2 - 2) * Y.1 + 2 * (Real.sqrt 2 + 1) * Y.2) / 4 * hs
      · rw [c2, zpow_one, zpow_one, hNinv, hNinv]
        unfold Lgc Tgc bgc
        linear_combination (2 * (Real.sqrt 2 + 1) * Y.1 - (Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 - 4 * Real.sqrt 2 - 2) * Y.2) / 4 * hs
    have hint : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ i j : ℤ, ∃ i' j' : ℤ,
        Jpow (k : ℤ) ((i : ℝ), (j : ℝ)) = ((i' : ℝ), (j' : ℝ)) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => intro i j; exact ⟨i, j, by rw [Nat.cast_zero, hid]⟩
      | succ k ih =>
        intro i j
        obtain ⟨i', j', h'⟩ := ih i j
        refine ⟨3 * i' + j', i' + 5 * j', ?_⟩
        have e : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 1 + (k : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
        rw [e, ← hcomp 1 k, h', hJ1]
        push_cast
        rfl
    refine ⟨fun n i j hn => ?_, hcomp, hid, hsym, heig⟩
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hn
    exact hint k i j
  have BP : (∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1/256 → 0 ≤ coarseIdx h q) ∧
      (∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → q < 2 * (2:ℝ) ^ (-(bandOf q : ℝ))) ∧
      (∀ q q' : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1/256 → 0 < q' → q' < 2 * (2:ℝ) ^ (-(bandOf q : ℝ)) →
        coarseIdx h q ≤ coarseIdx h q') ∧
      (∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1/256 →
        Tgc ^ (-(coarseIdx h q)) ≤ 2 ^ 5 * Tgc / Real.log 2 ^ 2 * q ^ (1 + h) * (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ 2) := by
    have hT1 : 1 < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
    have hT0 : 0 < Tgc := by linarith
    have hpowx : ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → (2:ℝ) ^ (-Real.logb 2 (1 / q)) = q := by
      intro q hq
      rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_logb (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by positivity),
        one_div, inv_inv]
    have hx8 : ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1/256 → 8 ≤ Real.logb 2 (1 / q) := by
      intro q hq hq1
      rw [Real.le_logb_iff_rpow_le (by norm_num) (by positivity)]
      have e : (2:ℝ) ^ (8:ℝ) = 256 := by
        rw [show (8:ℝ) = ((8:ℕ):ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_natCast]; norm_num
      rw [e, le_div_iff₀ hq]
      linarith
    have hN8 : ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1/256 → 8 ≤ bandOf q := by
      intro q hq hq1
      have h1 := hx8 q hq hq1
      have h2 : Real.logb 2 (1 / q) ≤ (bandOf q : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
      exact_mod_cast (show (8:ℝ) ≤ bandOf q by linarith)
    obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : ℕ → ℝ, R = fun l : ℕ => (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hband : ∀ l : ℕ, bandIdx h l = ⌊Real.logb Tgc (R l)⌋ := by
      intro l; rw [hRdef]; rfl
    have hpowl : ∀ l : ℕ, 4 ≤ l → (l:ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ l := by
      intro l hl
      induction l, hl using Nat.le_induction with
      | base => norm_num
      | succ n hn ih =>
        have hn' : (4:ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
        push_cast
        rw [pow_succ (2:ℝ) n]
        nlinarith [ih, mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hn') (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ) + 2)]
    have hR1 : ∀ l : ℕ, 4 ≤ l → 1 ≤ R l := by
      intro l hl
      have hl' : (4:ℝ) ≤ l := by exact_mod_cast hl
      have hlpos : 0 < (l:ℝ) ^ 2 := pow_pos (by linarith) 2
      rw [hRdef]
      show 1 ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2)
      rw [one_le_div hlpos]
      calc (l:ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ l := hpowl l hl
        _ = (2:ℝ) ^ (l:ℝ) := (Real.rpow_natCast 2 l).symm
        _ ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by nlinarith)
    have hRstep : ∀ l : ℕ, 4 ≤ l → R l ≤ R (l + 1) := by
      intro l hl
      have hl' : (4:ℝ) ≤ l := by exact_mod_cast hl
      have hc : 0 < (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
      have h2 : (2:ℝ) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ (1 + h) := by
        calc (2:ℝ) = 2 ^ (1:ℝ) := (Real.rpow_one 2).symm
          _ ≤ 2 ^ (1 + h) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
      have e : (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * ((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
          (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) * (2:ℝ) ^ (1 + h) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num)]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
      rw [hRdef]
      show (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤
        (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * ((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) / (((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)
      have hlp : 0 < (l:ℝ) ^ 2 := pow_pos (by linarith) 2
      have hlp1 : 0 < ((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 := pow_pos (by push_cast; linarith) 2
      rw [e, div_le_div_iff₀ hlp hlp1]
      push_cast
      have key : ((l:ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ (1 + h) * (l:ℝ) ^ 2 := by

          mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hl') (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ (l:ℝ) + 2)]
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left key hc.le
      linarith
    have hRmono : ∀ l l' : ℕ, 4 ≤ l → l ≤ l' → R l ≤ R l' := by
      intro l l' hl hll'
      induction l', hll' using Nat.le_induction with
      | base => exact le_rfl
      | succ n hn ih => exact le_trans ih (hRstep n (le_trans hl hn))
    have hbandmono : ∀ l l' : ℕ, 4 ≤ l → l ≤ l' → bandIdx h l ≤ bandIdx h l' := by
      intro l l' hl hll'
      rw [hband, hband]
      apply Int.floor_mono
      exact Real.logb_le_logb_of_le hT1 (by linarith [hR1 l hl]) (hRmono l l' hl hll')
    have hbandnn : ∀ l : ℕ, 4 ≤ l → 0 ≤ bandIdx h l := by
      intro l hl
      rw [hband]
      exact Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (Real.logb_nonneg hT1 (hR1 l hl))
    refine ⟨fun q hq hq1 => ?_, fun q hq hq1 => ?_, fun q q' hq hq1 hq' hq'2 => ?_, fun q hq hq1 => ?_⟩

      have := hN8 q hq hq1
      exact hbandnn _ (by omega)

        Real.logb_nonneg (by norm_num) (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hq]; linarith)

        Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt (by norm_num) (by linarith)
      have h2 : (2:ℝ) ^ (-Real.logb 2 (1 / q) - 1) = q / 2 := by
        rw [Real.rpow_sub (by norm_num), Real.rpow_one, hpowx q hq]
      linarith

      have hx' : (bandOf q : ℝ) - 1 < Real.logb 2 (1 / q') := by

          rw [Real.rpow_sub (by norm_num), Real.rpow_one, Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num)]
          field_simp
        rw [e, one_div]
        exact (inv_lt_inv₀ (by positivity) hq').mpr hq'2
      have hb : bandOf q - 1 < bandOf q' := by
        show bandOf q - 1 < ⌈Real.logb 2 (1 / q')⌉₊

      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, Real.logb 2 (1 / q) = x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hx8' : 8 ≤ x := hx ▸ hx8 q hq hq1
      have hN := hN8 q hq hq1
      have hceil_le : x ≤ (bandOf q : ℝ) := hx ▸ Nat.le_ceil _
      have hceil_lt : (bandOf q : ℝ) < x + 1 := hx ▸ Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by linarith)
      have hpowx' : (2:ℝ) ^ (-x) = q := hx ▸ hpowx q hq
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, m = bandOf q - 4 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hm4 : 4 ≤ m := by omega
      have hmcast : (m:ℝ) = (bandOf q : ℝ) - 4 := by
        rw [hm, Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]; norm_num
      have hm4' : (4:ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm4
      have hR0 : 0 < R m := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (hR1 m hm4)
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y : ℝ, y = Real.logb Tgc (R m) := ⟨_, rfl⟩

        rw [hy, ← hband, hm]; rfl
      rw [hci]

        push_cast
        have hfl := Int.sub_one_lt_floor y

              Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hT1.le (by linarith)
          _ = Tgc / R m := by
              rw [Real.rpow_sub hT0, Real.rpow_one, hy, Real.rpow_logb hT0 hT1.ne' hR0]
          _ = _ := by
              rw [hRdef]
              show Tgc / ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (m:ℝ)) / ((m : ℝ) ^ 2)) = _
              rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), div_div_eq_mul_div, div_eq_mul_inv]
      have hW2 : (2:ℝ) ^ (-((1 + h) * (m:ℝ))) ≤ 2 ^ 5 * q ^ (1 + h) := by

          rw [Real.rpow_add two_pos, Real.rpow_mul two_pos.le, hpowx',
            show (5:ℝ) = ((5:ℕ):ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_natCast]

        have : (1 + h) * (x - m) ≤ (1 + h) * 4 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by linarith)
        nlinarith
      have hlog2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
      have hlq : Real.log q ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos hq.le (by linarith)
      have hxeq : x = |Real.log q| / Real.log 2 := by
        rw [← hx, abs_of_nonpos hlq, Real.logb, one_div, Real.log_inv]
      have hmx : (m:ℝ) ≤ (1 + |Real.log q|) / Real.log 2 := by
        have hmx0 : (m:ℝ) ≤ x := by linarith
        calc (m:ℝ) ≤ x := hmx0
          _ = |Real.log q| / Real.log 2 := hxeq
          _ ≤ (1 + |Real.log q|) / Real.log 2 := by
              rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hlog2 hlog2]; nlinarith
      have hW3 : (m:ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ 2 / Real.log 2 ^ 2 := by
        rw [← div_pow]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hmx 2
      have hA : 0 ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ (-((1 + h) * (m:ℝ))) := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _).le
      calc Tgc ^ (-⌊y⌋) ≤ Tgc * (m:ℝ) ^ 2 * (2:ℝ) ^ (-((1 + h) * (m:ℝ))) := hW1
        _ ≤ Tgc * ((1 + |Real.log q|) ^ 2 / Real.log 2 ^ 2) * (2 ^ 5 * q ^ (1 + h)) :=
            mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hW3 hT0.le) hW2 hA
              (mul_nonneg hT0.le (by positivity))
        _ = _ := by ring
  obtain ⟨A2, A3, A4, A5, A6⟩ := JP
  obtain ⟨B1, B7, B8, B9⟩ := BP
  exact ⟨B1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B7, B8, B9⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: tn_fast_coef_bound_v5

    IsOpen U → (∀ η ∈ U, ∀ a : ℝ × ℝ, shY η a ∈ U) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U →

      Jpow (coarseIdx h (qC h ξ)) ((κ'.1 : ℝ), (κ'.2 : ℝ)) = ((κ.1 : ℝ), (κ.2 : ℝ)) →

        (1 + |(κ'.1 : ℝ)| + |(κ'.2 : ℝ)|) ^ 5 ≤ 729 * M * ∏ i, ‖w i‖

      · unfold eR radVec
        rw [hrad, h0, h1, zero_smul, add_zero, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
      · unfold eTh azVec
        rw [hrad, h0, h1, neg_zero, zero_smul, zero_add, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
    let ψ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ³ × ℝ := fun s => (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1, s.2.2)
    have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ := by
      have hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1) := by
        unfold rotPt
        fun_prop
      exact hr.prodMk (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd)
    have hmaps : MapsTo ψ {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}
        (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      intro s hs
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hs
      show s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ((rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1) 2) (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB
      rw [(frame s.1 s.2.1 h1).1]
      exact ⟨h2, h3⟩
    refine ⟨hA, fun l i => ?_⟩
    have hcomp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((↿(uB B)) ∘ ψ)
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} :=
      hu.comp hψ.contDiffOn hmaps
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s => Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * inner ℝ (((↿(uB B)) ∘ ψ) s)
        ((![EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ), eZ] :
          Fin 3 → ℝ³) i))
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} :=
      contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.inner ℝ hcomp contDiffOn_const)
    refine hg.congr ?_
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨_, f2, f3⟩ := frame s.1 s.2.1 hs.1
    show Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * inner ℝ (uB B (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1) s.2.2)
        (![eR (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1), eTh (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1), eZ] i) = _
    rw [f2, f3]
    rfl
  have hbase : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => baseC B γ.1 η j) ξ := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨hU, hS⟩ := hslow
    have hpξ : ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := hD
    have hAt := (hS γ.1 j).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hpξ)
    have hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hc := ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => baseC B γ.1 (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) j)
      ξ hAt hp.contDiffAt
    exact hc
  
  have hξ1 : 0 < ξ.1 := hD.1
  have hQ : 0 < Qb γ.1 := by unfold Qb; positivity
  have hsQ : 0 < Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQ
  have hRC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => RC γ.1 η) := by
    unfold RC; fun_prop
  have hRCne : RC γ.1 ξ ≠ 0 := by unfold RC; exact (div_pos hξ1 hsQ).ne'
  have hchartZ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => chartZ B.h γ.1 η) := by
    unfold chartZ; fun_prop
  have hFang : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Fang B γ.1 η) ξ := by
    unfold Fang
    exact (hbase 1).div hRC.contDiffAt hRCne
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hk
  have hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl =>
      (lamT (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ - k) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1) := by
    unfold lamT Jpow; fun_prop
  obtain ⟨φt, hφt⟩ : ∃ f : Cyl → ℝ, f = fun η : Cyl => pzr5 B G γ * chartZ B.h γ.1 η / epsb B.h γ.1 +
      sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 * RC γ.1 η -
      ((lamT (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ - k) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1) *
        (pang5 B G γ * Fang B γ.1 η + pzr5 B G γ * baseC B γ.1 η 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hφ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ φt ξ := by
    rw [hφt]
    exact (((contDiffAt_const.mul hchartZ.contDiffAt).div_const _).add
      (contDiffAt_const.mul hRC.contDiffAt)).sub
      (hv.contDiffAt.mul ((contDiffAt_const.mul hFang).add (contDiffAt_const.mul (hbase 2))))
  
  have hπ : Continuous (fun η : Cyl => η.2.2.2) := by fun_prop
  have hev : ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 =
      Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ - k :=
    hπ.continuousAt.tendsto.eventually hk
  have hEq : phiL5 B G γ =ᶠ[nhds ξ] φt := by
    refine hev.mono fun η hη => ?_
    rw [hφt]
    simp only [phiL5, vco, etG, hη]
  
  have transfer : ∀ (d : Cyl → Cyl), DifferentiableAt ℝ d ξ →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : Cyl => fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) y (d y)) ξ := by
    intro d hd
    have h1 : fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fderiv ℝ φt := hEq.fderiv
    have h2 : (fun y => fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) y (d y)) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] (fun y => fderiv ℝ φt y (d y)) :=
      h1.mono fun y hy => by dsimp only; rw [hy]
    have h3 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ φt) ξ := hφ.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)
    have h4 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ φt) ξ := h3.differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    exact (h4.clm_apply hd).congr_of_eventuallyEq h2
  
  fin_cases i
  · show DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) *
      fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) η ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)) ξ
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) ξ :=
      differentiableAt_fst.rpow_const (Or.inl hξ1.ne')
    have hdir : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl =>
        (((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) : Cyl)) ξ :=
      DifferentiableAt.prodMk (differentiableAt_const _) (DifferentiableAt.prodMk (differentiableAt_const _)
        (DifferentiableAt.prodMk (differentiableAt_const _) ((h1.const_mul _).smul_const vrv)))
    exact (transfer _ hdir).const_mul _
  · show DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => pang5 B G γ / RC γ.1 η) ξ
    exact (contDiffAt_const.div hRC.contDiffAt hRCne).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  · show DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) *
      fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) η (((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) : Cyl)) ξ
    exact (transfer (fun _ => (((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) : Cyl)) (differentiableAt_const _)).const_mul _

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ), B.ok → ∀ (α β : ℝ) (a : WC) (N : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → (∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (N γ m) ξ) → (∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → ∀ c : ℝ × ℝ, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c → N γ m (shY ξ c) = N γ m ξ) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) → B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (N γ m) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * β) * SC B.h ξ ^ b) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + β) (fun γ m ξ => dotProduct (N γ m ξ) (a γ m ξ))

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ), B.ok → ∀ (α β : ℝ) (a : WC) (N : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → (∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (N γ m) ξ) → (∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → ∀ c : ℝ × ℝ, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c → N γ m (shY ξ c) = N γ m ξ) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) → B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (N γ m) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * β) * SC B.h ξ ^ b) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + β) (fun γ m ξ => dotProduct (N γ m ξ) (a γ m ξ))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 hok α β a N ha hsm hdeck hbd
  
  obtain ⟨Bl, hBl⟩ : ∃ Bl : (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] ℂ,
      ∀ u v, Bl u v = dotProduct u v := by
    let Bl0 : (Fin 3 → ℂ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℂ :=
      LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ (fun u v : Fin 3 → ℂ => dotProduct u v)
        (fun m1 m2 n => by
          first
          | exact add_dotProduct m1 m2 n
          | (simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.add_apply]; ring))
        (fun c m n => by
          first
          | exact smul_dotProduct c m n
          | (simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.smul_apply, Complex.real_smul]; ring))
        (fun m n1 n2 => by
          first
          | exact dotProduct_add m n1 n2
          | (simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.add_apply]; ring))
        (fun c m n => by
          first
          | exact dotProduct_smul c m n
          | (simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.smul_apply, Complex.real_smul]; ring))
    refine ⟨LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
      ((LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap : ((Fin 3 → ℂ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℂ) ≃ₗ[ℝ]
        ((Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] ℂ)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ Bl0), fun u v => rfl⟩
  have hc0 : ∀ u : Fin 3 → ℂ, dotProduct u 0 = 0 := fun u => dotProduct_zero u
  have hP : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), (fun ξ => dotProduct (N γ m ξ) (a γ m ξ)) =
      fun η => Bl (N γ m η) (a γ m η) := by
    intro γ m; funext ξ; rw [hBl]
  
  have hLeib : ∀ (f g : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (k : ℕ), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ k f U → ContDiffOn ℝ k g U →
      NB B.h (fun η => Bl (f η) (g η)) k ξ ≤
        ‖Bl‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h f i ξ * NB B.h g (k - i) ξ := by
    intro f g U ξ k hU hξ hf hg
    unfold NB
    generalize Lnorm B.h ξ = L
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage L.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
    have hL0s : L 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
    have hsm' : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (F : Cyl → V),
        ContDiffOn ℝ k F U → ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
      intro V _ _ F hF
      exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have hsmO : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (F : Cyl → V),
        ContDiffOn ℝ k F U → ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by
      intro V _ _ F hF
      exact (hsm' F hF).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
    have key : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (F : Cyl → V),
        ContDiffOn ℝ k F U → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k →
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0 =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
      intro V _ _ F hF i hi
      have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O
      have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L (hsm' F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
        hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
      have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + z)) i hs h0s
      have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i ξ 0
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0
          = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑L) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := e2
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [map_zero]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [e3]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
    have hfg : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun η => Bl (f η) (g η)) U :=
      (contDiffOn_const.clm_apply hf).clm_apply hg
    have leib := Bl.norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_le_of_bilinear (hsmO f hf) (hsmO g hg)
      hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O (n := k) le_rfl
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => Bl (f (ξ + L y)) (g (ξ + L y))) k hO h0O]
      at leib
    rw [← key _ hfg k le_rfl]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => (fun η => Bl (f η) (g η)) (ξ + L z)) 0‖
        = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => Bl (f (ξ + L y)) (g (ξ + L y))) 0‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ _ := leib
      _ = _ := by
        congr 1
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O,
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => g (ξ + L z)) (k - i) hO h0O,
          key f hf i hik, key g hg (k - i) (Nat.sub_le k i)]
  
  have hh0 : 0 ≤ B.h := hok.2.1.1.le
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  have hDq : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < qC B.h ξ ∧ qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 ∧ 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
    have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
      show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
      exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    intro ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨-, e2, e3⟩ := hξ
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
    refine ⟨hq0, by linarith, ?_⟩
    unfold SC
    have : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| := by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))]
    exact one_le_pow₀ this
  have hEdge : ∀ X : ℝ, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb → 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X ∧
      0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ∧ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ≤ 1 := by
    intro X e1 e2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, min_le_left _ _⟩
    · unfold edgeWeight
      split_ifs
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      · exact le_rfl
    · have hX : 0 < X := lt_trans hXa e1
      have l1 : 0 < Real.log (X / B.Xa) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr e1)
      have l2 : 0 < Real.log (B.Xb / X) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr e2)
      exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min l1 l2)
  obtain ⟨⟨H, H0, Hv⟩, sa, da, pa, ba⟩ := ha
  choose CN bN hN using hbd
  choose Ca bA dA hA using ba
  
  have comb : ∀ (k : ℕ) (q S E e P K : ℝ) (nN na : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < q → 1 ≤ S → 0 ≤ E → 0 < e →
      e ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ P → 0 ≤ K → (∀ i, 0 ≤ nN i) → (∀ j, 0 ≤ na j) →
      (∀ i, i ≤ k → nN i ≤ CN i * q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i)) →
      (∀ j, j ≤ k → na j ≤ Ca j * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA j) * E * e ^ (-(dA j)) * P) →
      K * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * nN i * na (k - i) ≤
        (K * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)|) *
          q ^ (B.h * (α + β)) *
          S ^ ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j|) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j|) * E *
          e ^ (-(∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dA j|)) * P := by
    intro k q S E e P K nN na hq hS hE he0 he1 hP0 hK hnN hna hbN hba
    have hS0 : 0 < S := by linarith
    obtain ⟨X, hXdef⟩ : ∃ X : ℝ, X = q ^ (B.h * (α + β)) *
        S ^ ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j|) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j|) * E *
        e ^ (-(∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dA j|)) * P := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * nN i * na (k - i) ≤

      have a1 : nN i ≤ |CN i| * (q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i)) := by

          |Ca (k - i)| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P) := by
        refine le_trans (hba (k - i) hjk) ?_
        have : Ca (k - i) * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P =
            Ca (k - i) * (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P) := by
          ring
        rw [this]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hA2
      have a3 : nN i * na (k - i) ≤ (|CN i| * (q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i))) *
          (|Ca (k - i)| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P)) :=
        mul_le_mul a1 a2 (hna _) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hA1)
      have hbsum : bN i + bA (k - i) ≤
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j|) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j| := by
        have s1 : |bN i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |bN j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) hi
        have s2 : |bA (k - i)| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |bA j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) hj
        linarith [le_abs_self (bN i), le_abs_self (bA (k - i))]
      have hdsum : dA (k - i) ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dA j| := by
        have s3 : |dA (k - i)| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dA j| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |dA j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) hj
        linarith [le_abs_self (dA (k - i))]
      have f1 : S ^ (bN i + bA (k - i)) ≤
          S ^ ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j|) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j|) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS hbsum
      have f2 : e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) ≤ e ^ (-(∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dA j|)) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge he0 he1 (neg_le_neg hdsum)
      have eq1 : q ^ (B.h * β) * q ^ (B.h * α) = q ^ (B.h * (α + β)) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]; congr 1; ring

      have a4 : (q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i)) *
          (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P) ≤ X := by
        calc (q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i)) *

                e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P := by ring
          _ = q ^ (B.h * (α + β)) * S ^ (bN i + bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P := by
              rw [eq1, ← Real.rpow_add hS0]

      have hc : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _

        _ ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * ((|CN i| * (q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i))) *
            (|Ca (k - i)| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a3 hc
        _ = (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)| * ((q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i)) *

            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a4

    calc K * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * nN i * na (k - i)

  have hV : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∉ tsupport (a γ m) →

  · refine ⟨‖Bl‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)|,
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j|) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j|,

    have hPv : 0 ≤ Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by
      unfold Penv5

      have hNO : ContDiffOn ℝ k (N γ m) O := hNu.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).1)

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ,
    ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (l0 : ℕ), l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ActiveL4 B G γ → l0 ≤ γ.1 →
    ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 → qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 →
    B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb → |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 →
    |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 →

    ∀ c : ℝ × ℝ, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c → presMult5 B G γ m (shY ξ c) = presMult5 B G γ m ξ

by

  obtain ⟨l23, H23⟩ := good_nphiP5_nb_v5 B G hB hG

  choose C23 hC23 using H23
  choose C24 hC24 using H24

  intro l0 hl0 γ m hA hlγ ξ hξ hq1 hq2 hX1 hX2 hxi het

    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _

    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0.le

      (nPhi5 B G γ η 0 * Kmat B G γ η 0 j + nPhi5 B G γ η 1 * Kmat B G γ η 1 j +

  have hfs : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f j) U := by
    intro j
    rw [hf]
    apply ContDiffOn.mul
    · exact ContDiffOn.inv ((((hn 0).mul (hn 0)).add ((hn 1).mul (hn 1))).add ((hn 2).mul (hn 2)))

    · exact ((((hn 0).mul (hK 0 j)).add ((hn 1).mul (hK 1 j))).add ((hn 2).mul (hK 2 j))).sub (hp j)
  have hid : ∀ η, presMult5 B G γ m η =
      fun j => Complex.I / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ)) * ((f j η : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro η

    simp only [presMult5, if_neg hm, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.sub_apply, Matrix.vecMul,

  have hsmooth : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (presMult5 B G γ m) ξ := by
    rw [show presMult5 B G γ m = fun η j => Complex.I / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ)) *

plin5_mode_rep.definitions:
noncomputable def mvec5 (h : ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³ := fun y s =>
  cyl2cart y (fun i => (c (ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0)) i *
    Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re)

noncomputable def msc5 (h : ℝ) (n : ℤ) (p : Cyl → ℂ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ := fun y s =>
  (p (ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0)) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re

noncomputable def mthC (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℂ :=
  ![Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (ξ.1 : ℂ) * c ξ 0 - c ξ 1 / (ξ.1 : ℂ),
    Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (ξ.1 : ℂ) * c ξ 1 + c ξ 0 / (ξ.1 : ℂ),
    Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (ξ.1 : ℂ) * c ξ 2]

noncomputable def cofA5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ) := fun η =>
  (((qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
    (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) • (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η)

noncomputable def cofP5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) : Cyl → ℂ := fun η =>
  (((qC B.h η ^ (-2 * Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) * (primState5 B G).pw γ m η)

subgoal_signatures.name: mode5_curl
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} (h : ℝ) (K : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℤ) (c : ι → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ η ∈ U, 0 < η.1) → (∀ k ∈ K, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (c k) U) → 0 < rad y → ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0) ∈ U → curl3 (fun z => ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 h (n k) (c k) Y0 z s) y = ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 h (n k) (mcurlC h (n k) (c k)) Y0 y s

subgoal_signatures.name: mode5_linres
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} (B : BG) (K : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℤ) (a : ι → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (p : ι → Cyl → ℂ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), IsOpen U → IsOpen O → (∀ η ∈ U, 0 < η.1) → (x, t) ∈ O → (∀ y s, (y, s) ∈ O → 0 < rad y ∧ ptOf y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y0) ∈ U ∧ uB B y s = cyl2cart y (fun i => ubase B (ptOf y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y0)) i)) → (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ubase B η i) U) → (∀ k ∈ K, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (a k) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (p k) U) → deriv (fun s => ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 x s) t - Δ (fun y => ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 y t) x + gradient (fun y => ∑ k ∈ K, msc5 B.h (n k) (p k) Y0 y t) x + fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 y t) x (uB B x t) + fderiv ℝ (fun y => uB B y t) x (∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 x t) = ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (mresC B (n k) (a k) (p k)) Y0 x t
