signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1/2) (W0h4 B G) → (∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (W0c4 B G γ ξ) = 0) → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), princC5 B G γ m ξ ≠ 0 → (m = 1 ∨ m = -1) ∧ SuppW B G γ ξ ∧ Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 5 ≤ |vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2|

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  obtain ⟨hh0, -, hXa, -, -, -, -, hqB0, hqB1, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n0, fun l0 hl0 hW0 _htr γ m ξ hξ hne => ?_⟩
  have hr0 : 0 < G.r0 := hG.1.1
  have hr1 : G.r0 ≤ 1/100 := hG.1.2.1
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 < B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hl0) hn0
  have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
  have hξB : ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB := ⟨hξ'.1, hξ'.2.1, hξ'.2.2.trans hqsB⟩
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ'.2.1])).1
  have hqcont : ContinuousOn (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h4 := hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hm : MapsTo (fun η : Cyl => (η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1)) {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro η hη
      have hη' : η.2.2.1 < 1 := hη
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - η.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    exact h4.comp (f := fun η : Cyl => (η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1)) (Continuous.continuousOn (by fun_prop)) hm
  have hT1o : IsOpen {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
  have hDo : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) = {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} ∩
        ({η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} ∩ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0)) := by
      ext η
      simp only [DomC, mem_setOf_eq, mem_inter_iff, mem_preimage, mem_Iio]
    rw [e]
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).inter
      (hqcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hT1o isOpen_Iio)
  have hDn : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∈ nhds ξ := hDo.mem_nhds hξ
  
  have hm : m = 1 ∨ m = -1 := by
    by_contra hm
    apply hne
    have hF0 : W0h4 B G γ m = fun _ => 0 := by
      funext η
      simp only [W0h4, if_neg hm]
    have hp0 : (primState5 B G).pw γ m ξ = 0 := by
      simp only [primState5, presW5, if_neg hm, mul_zero]
    unfold princC5
    rw [hp0, hF0]
    simp [dVc]
  
  have hQ : 0 < Qb γ.1 := by unfold Qb; positivity
  have hkpos : 0 < kb B.h γ.1 := by
    unfold kb epsb
    exact Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ _) _)
  have hk : (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hkpos.ne'
  have hmC : (m : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by rcases hm with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
  have hm2 : (m : ℂ) ^ 2 = 1 := by rcases hm with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
  have hρ0 : 0 < rhoQ B γ ξ := div_pos hq0 hQ
  have hρ : rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) = rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hρ0]
    congr 1
    ring
  
  have hmul : (pulseMatC (Kmat B G γ ξ)).mulVec (fun j => ((W0c4 B G γ ξ j : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
      fun i => (((Kmat B G γ ξ).mulVec (W0c4 B G γ ξ) i : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    funext i
    simp [pulseMatC, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Complex.ofReal_sum, Complex.ofReal_mul]
  have hform : ∀ i, princC5 B G γ m ξ i = ((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (dVc B γ.1 (W0h4 B G γ m) ξ i + ((((Kmat B G γ ξ).mulVec (W0c4 B G γ ξ)) i +
        dDamp5 B G γ ξ * W0c4 B G γ ξ i -
        ((dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) ((Kmat B G γ ξ).mulVec (W0c4 B G γ ξ)) -
          dotProduct (nPhiP5 B G γ ξ) (W0c4 B G γ ξ)) / dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ)) *
          nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    intro i
    have hW : W0h4 B G γ m ξ = fun j => ((W0c4 B G γ ξ j : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      simp only [W0h4, if_pos hm]
    have hpw : (primState5 B G).pw γ m ξ = ((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (Complex.I / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ)) *
          ((((dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) ((Kmat B G γ ξ).mulVec (W0c4 B G γ ξ)) -
            dotProduct (nPhiP5 B G γ ξ) (W0c4 B G γ ξ)) / dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
      simp only [primState5, presW5, if_pos hm]
      rfl
    have hI' : ∀ X : ℝ, ((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ)) *
        (((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ)) * ((X : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
        -(((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((X : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
      intro X
      have e : ((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ)) *
          (((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ)) * ((X : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
          (Complex.I * Complex.I) * (((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
            ((X : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ)) / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ))) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [e, Complex.I_mul_I, div_self (mul_ne_zero hk hmC), hρ]
      ring
    unfold princC5
    rw [hW, hpw, hmul, hI']
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, nPhiC5, hm2, one_mul]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hkill : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, dVc B γ.1 (W0h4 B G γ m) ξ = (fun i => ((v i : ℝ) : ℂ)) →
      (∀ i, v i + (Kmat B G γ ξ).mulVec (W0c4 B G γ ξ) i + dDamp5 B G γ ξ * W0c4 B G γ ξ i -
        ((dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) ((Kmat B G γ ξ).mulVec (W0c4 B G γ ξ)) -
          dotProduct (nPhiP5 B G γ ξ) (W0c4 B G γ ξ)) / dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ)) *
          nPhi5 B G γ ξ i = 0) → False := by
    intro v hv hz
    apply hne
    funext i
    rw [hform i, hv]
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply]
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_add, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_eq_zero]
    apply mul_eq_zero_of_right
    linarith [hz i]
  
  have halg : ∀ (n n' t : Fin 3 → ℝ) (K : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (d σ : ℝ) (i : Fin 3),
      σ * ((-K + (dotProduct n n)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec n (Matrix.vecMul n K - n')).mulVec t - d • t) i +
        K.mulVec (σ • t) i + d * (σ • t) i -
        ((dotProduct n (K.mulVec (σ • t)) - dotProduct n' (σ • t)) / dotProduct n n) * n i = 0 := by
    intro n n' t K d σ i
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Matrix.vecMul,
      Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (W0h4 B G γ m) ξ :=
    ((hW0.2.1 γ m).contDiffAt hDn).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hlineD : ∀ (g : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (g' : Fin 3 → ℂ),
      (∀ᶠ s in nhds (0:ℝ), W0h4 B G γ m (ξ + s • dVdir B.h γ.1) = g s) → HasDerivAt g g' 0 →
      dVc B γ.1 (W0h4 B G γ m) ξ = g' := by
    intro g g' hev hg
    have hl : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ξ + s • dVdir B.h γ.1) (dVdir B.h γ.1) 0 := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const (dVdir B.h γ.1)).const_add ξ
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => W0h4 B G γ m (ξ + s • dVdir B.h γ.1))
        (fderiv ℝ (W0h4 B G γ m) ξ (dVdir B.h γ.1)) 0 :=
      HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) hFd.hasFDerivAt hl (by simp)
    exact (hc.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hev.mono (fun s hs => hs.symm))).unique hg
  
  have hFnz : ¬ (∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, W0h4 B G γ m η = 0) := by
    intro hev
    have hd : dVc B γ.1 (W0h4 B G γ m) ξ = fun i => (((0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) i : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      have hev' : W0h4 B G γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ) := hev
      unfold dVc
      rw [hev'.fderiv_eq]
      funext i
      simp
    have hc0 : W0c4 B G γ ξ = 0 := by
      have h0 := hev.self_of_nhds
      funext i
      have := congrFun h0 i
      simp only [W0h4, if_pos hm, Pi.zero_apply] at this
      exact_mod_cast this
    exact hkill _ hd (fun i => by simp [hc0])
  
  have hAct : ActiveL4 B G γ := by
    by_contra hA
    apply hFnz
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun η => ?_)
    have h0 : W0c4 B G γ η = 0 := by
      unfold W0c4
      rw [if_neg (fun h => hA h.1)]
    funext i
    simp [W0h4, hm, h0]
  have hfreq : ∃ᶠ η in nhds ξ, SuppW B G γ η :=
    ((Filter.not_eventually.mp hFnz).and_eventually hDn).mono
      (fun η h => hW0.2.2.2.1 γ m η h.2 h.1)
  
  have hbgc : 0 ≤ bgc ∧ bgc < 1/2 := by
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
    have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
    unfold bgc
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  have hDen : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hinv : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.1 = lamR w + bgc * lamT w ∧ w.2 = lamT w - bgc * lamR w := by
    intro w
    constructor
    · have e : lamR w + bgc * lamT w = (w.1 - bgc * w.2 + bgc * (bgc * w.1 + w.2)) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) := by
        unfold lamR lamT; ring
      rw [e, eq_div_iff hDen]; ring
    · have e : lamT w - bgc * lamR w = (bgc * w.1 + w.2 - bgc * (w.1 - bgc * w.2)) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) := by
        unfold lamR lamT; ring
      rw [e, eq_div_iff hDen]; ring
  have hJc : Continuous (fun Y' : ℝ × ℝ => Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ) := by
    unfold Jpow; fun_prop
  have hJη : Continuous (fun η : Cyl => Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ) :=
    hJc.comp (by fun_prop)
  have hE1 : ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1 -
      (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1| < 1/8 :=
    ((hJη.fst.sub continuous_const).abs.continuousAt).eventually_lt continuousAt_const (by simp)
  have hE2 : ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2 -
      (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2| < 1/8 :=
    ((hJη.snd.sub continuous_const).abs.continuousAt).eventually_lt continuousAt_const (by simp)
  obtain ⟨η1, hS1, hc1, hc2⟩ := (hfreq.and_eventually (hE1.and hE2)).exists
  obtain ⟨w1, hw1d⟩ : ∃ w : ℝ × ℝ, w = rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η1.2.2.2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨K1, hK1⟩ : ∃ K : ℤ, K = round ((Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η1.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨K2, hK2⟩ : ∃ K : ℤ, K = round ((Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η1.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hw1e : w1.1 = (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η1.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1 - (K1 : ℝ) := by
    rw [hw1d, hK1]; rfl
  have hw2e : w1.2 = (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η1.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2 - (K2 : ℝ) := by
    rw [hw1d, hK2]; rfl
  have hxi1 : |lamR w1| ≤ G.r0 / 4 := by rw [hw1d]; exact hS1.2.2.1
  have het1 : |lamT w1| ≤ G.r0 := by rw [hw1d]; exact hS1.2.2.2.1
  have hb1 : |bgc * lamT w1| ≤ 1/2 * G.r0 := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hbgc.1]
    exact mul_le_mul hbgc.2.le het1 (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
  have hb2 : |bgc * lamR w1| ≤ 1/2 * (G.r0 / 4) := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hbgc.1]
    exact mul_le_mul hbgc.2.le hxi1 (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
  have hw1 : |w1.1| < 1/50 := by
    rw [(hinv w1).1]
    obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_le.mp hxi1
    obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := abs_le.mp hb1
    exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hw2 : |w1.2| < 1/50 := by
    rw [(hinv w1).2]
    obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_le.mp het1
    obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := abs_le.mp hb2
    exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hround : ∀ (x : ℝ) (K : ℤ), |x - (K : ℝ)| < 1/2 → round x = K := by
    intro x K hx
    rw [round_eq, Int.floor_eq_iff]
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := abs_lt.mp hx
    constructor <;> linarith
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ : ∃ V : Set (ℝ × ℝ), V =
      {Y' : ℝ × ℝ | |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).1 - (K1 : ℝ)| < 1/2} ∩
      {Y' : ℝ × ℝ | |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).2 - (K2 : ℝ)| < 1/2} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hVo : IsOpen V := by
    rw [hV]
    exact (isOpen_lt ((hJc.fst).sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt ((hJc.snd).sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const)
  have hYV : ξ.2.2.2 ∈ V := by
    rw [hV]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1 - (K1 : ℝ)| < 1/2
      obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hc1
      obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hw1
      rw [hw1e] at b1 b2
      exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · show |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2 - (K2 : ℝ)| < 1/2
      obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hc2
      obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hw2
      rw [hw2e] at b1 b2
      exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hfr : ∀ Y' ∈ V, rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) Y' =
      Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ - ((K1 : ℝ), (K2 : ℝ)) := by
    intro Y' hY'
    rw [hV] at hY'
    have r1 : round ((Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).1) = K1 := hround _ _ hY'.1
    have r2 : round ((Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).2) = K2 := hround _ _ hY'.2
    unfold rectW frac0
    rw [r1, r2]
    ext <;> simp
  
  have hVn : ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, η.2.2.2 ∈ V :=
    (hVo.preimage (by fun_prop : Continuous fun η : Cyl => η.2.2.2)).mem_nhds hYV
  have hfr2 := hfreq.and_eventually hVn
  have hxiC : Continuous (fun η : Cyl =>
      lamR (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ - ((K1 : ℝ), (K2 : ℝ)))) := by
    unfold lamR Jpow; fun_prop
  have hetC : Continuous (fun η : Cyl =>
      lamT (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ - ((K1 : ℝ), (K2 : ℝ)))) := by
    unfold lamT Jpow; fun_prop
  have hxi0 : |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ G.r0 / 4 := by
    have hmem : (fun η : Cyl => lamR (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ - ((K1 : ℝ), (K2 : ℝ)))) ξ ∈
        {x : ℝ | |x| ≤ G.r0 / 4} :=
      (isClosed_le continuous_abs continuous_const).mem_of_frequently_of_tendsto
        (hfr2.mono (fun η h => by
          show |lamR (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ - ((K1 : ℝ), (K2 : ℝ)))| ≤ G.r0 / 4
          rw [← hfr _ h.2]
          exact h.1.2.2.1)) (hxiC.tendsto ξ)
    have e : xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 =
        lamR (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ - ((K1 : ℝ), (K2 : ℝ))) := by
      unfold xiG; rw [hfr _ hYV]
    rw [e]; exact hmem
  have het0' : |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ G.r0 := by
    have hmem : (fun η : Cyl => lamT (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ - ((K1 : ℝ), (K2 : ℝ)))) ξ ∈
        {x : ℝ | |x| ≤ G.r0} :=
      (isClosed_le continuous_abs continuous_const).mem_of_frequently_of_tendsto
        (hfr2.mono (fun η h => by
          show |lamT (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ - ((K1 : ℝ), (K2 : ℝ)))| ≤ G.r0
          rw [← hfr _ h.2]
          exact h.1.2.2.2.1)) (hetC.tendsto ξ)
    have e : etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 =
        lamT (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ - ((K1 : ℝ), (K2 : ℝ))) := by
      unfold etG; rw [hfr _ hYV]
    rw [e]; exact hmem
  have hqa : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) ξ := hqcont.continuousAt (hT1o.mem_nhds hξ'.2.1)
  have hXCc : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => XC B.h η) ξ := by
    have h1 : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ 2) ξ := by fun_prop
    have h2 : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => 2 * qC B.h η) ξ := continuousAt_const.mul hqa
    exact h1.div h2 (mul_pos two_pos hq0).ne'
  have hXa' : B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ :=
    isClosed_Ici.mem_of_frequently_of_tendsto (hfreq.mono fun η h => h.2.2.2.2.1) hXCc.tendsto
  have hXb' : XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb :=
    isClosed_Iic.mem_of_frequently_of_tendsto (hfreq.mono fun η h => h.2.2.2.2.2) hXCc.tendsto
  have htsupp : ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL B.h γ) :=
    (isClosed_tsupport _).mem_of_frequently_of_tendsto (hfreq.mono fun η h => h.2.1) Filter.tendsto_id
  have hSupp : SuppW B G γ ξ := ⟨hS1.1, htsupp, hxi0, het0', hXa', hXb'⟩
  refine ⟨hm, hSupp, ?_⟩
  
  by_contra hlt
  push_neg at hlt
  have hTgc : 0 < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; positivity
  have hcib : 0 < cib B.h γ.1 := by
    unfold cib
    exact mul_pos (zpow_pos hTgc _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ _)
  have hLs : Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 = 2 * G.r0 / cib B.h γ.1 := rfl
  have hvLgen : ∀ E : ℝ, (E + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2 = E / cib B.h γ.1 := by
    intro E
    rw [hLs]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hplat : ∀ E : ℝ, |(E + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2| < Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 5 ↔
      |E| < 2 * G.r0 / 5 := by
    intro E
    rw [hvLgen, abs_div, abs_of_pos hcib, hLs, div_lt_iff₀ hcib]
    have : 2 * G.r0 / cib B.h γ.1 / 5 * cib B.h γ.1 = 2 * G.r0 / 5 := by
      field_simp
    rw [this]
  have het0 : |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 2 * G.r0 / 5 := (hplat _).mp hlt
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩ : ∃ ℓ : ℝ, ℓ = cib B.h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hline : ∀ s : ℝ, ξ + s • dVdir B.h γ.1 = (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, ξ.2.2.2 + (s * ℓ) • vtv) := by
    intro s
    rw [hℓ]
    refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_)) <;> simp [dVdir, smul_smul]
  have hlamR : ∀ (w : ℝ × ℝ) (u : ℝ), lamR (w + u • vtv) = lamR w := by
    intro w u
    unfold lamR vtv
    congr 1
    simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hlamT : ∀ (w : ℝ × ℝ) (u : ℝ), lamT (w + u • vtv) = lamT w + u := by
    intro w u
    unfold lamT vtv
    rw [div_add' _ _ _ hDen]
    congr 1
    simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hJline : ∀ s : ℝ, Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) (ξ.2.2.2 + (s * ℓ) • vtv) - G.ctr γ =
      (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ) + (s * cib B.h γ.1) • vtv := by
    intro s
    have hJ : ∀ Z, Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Z = (Lgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) * lamR Z) • vrv +
        (Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) * lamT Z) • vtv := fun Z => rfl
    have hTN : Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ≠ 0 := zpow_ne_zero _ hTgc.ne'
    have hT : Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) * (s * ℓ) = s * cib B.h γ.1 := by
      rw [hℓ, zpow_neg]
      field_simp
    rw [hJ, hJ, hlamR, hlamT, mul_add, add_smul, hT]
    abel
  have hYt : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ξ.2.2.2 + (s * ℓ) • vtv) (nhds 0) (nhds ξ.2.2.2) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => ξ.2.2.2 + (s * ℓ) • vtv) := by fun_prop
    simpa using hc.tendsto 0
  have hsV : ∀ᶠ s in nhds (0:ℝ), ξ.2.2.2 + (s * ℓ) • vtv ∈ V := hYt.eventually (hVo.mem_nhds hYV)
  have hsE : ∀ᶠ s in nhds (0:ℝ), |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 + s * cib B.h γ.1| < 2 * G.r0 / 5 :=
    (by fun_prop : Continuous fun s : ℝ => |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 + s * cib B.h γ.1|).continuousAt.eventually_lt
      continuousAt_const (by simpa using het0)
  obtain ⟨σ0, hσ0⟩ : ∃ σ : ℝ, σ = Real.sqrt (epsb B.h γ.1) / 2 * etaL B.h γ ξ *
      Real.sqrt (max (yAmp4 B G γ ξ) 0) * chig G.r0 (xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hW0line : ∀ᶠ s in nhds (0:ℝ), W0c4 B G γ (ξ + s • dVdir B.h γ.1) =
      σ0 • G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 + s) := by
    filter_upwards [hsV, hsE] with s hs1 hs2
    have hrw : rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (ξ.2.2.2 + (s * ℓ) • vtv) =
        rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 + (s * cib B.h γ.1) • vtv := by
      rw [hfr _ hs1, hfr _ hYV, hJline]
      abel
    have hxs : xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (ξ.2.2.2 + (s * ℓ) • vtv) = xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 := by
      unfold xiG; rw [hrw, hlamR]
    have hes : etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (ξ.2.2.2 + (s * ℓ) • vtv) =
        etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 + s * cib B.h γ.1 := by
      unfold etG; rw [hrw, hlamT]
    have hvs : vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) (ξ.2.2.2 + (s * ℓ) • vtv) =
        vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 + s := by
      unfold vco; rw [hes]; field_simp; ring
    have hps : psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) (ξ.2.2.2 + (s * ℓ) • vtv)) = 1 := by
      have hLpos : 0 < Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 := by rw [hLs]; positivity
      have hlt2 : |vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) (ξ.2.2.2 + (s * ℓ) • vtv) - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2| <
          Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 5 := by
        unfold vco
        rw [hes]
        exact (hplat _).mpr hs2
      unfold psiT
      apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
      rw [one_le_div (by linarith)]
      linarith
    have hR : inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (2 * G.r0) (ξ.2.2.2 + (s * ℓ) • vtv) := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hxs]; linarith [hxi0]
      · rw [hes]; linarith [(abs_lt.mp hs2).1, (abs_lt.mp hs2).2, le_abs_self (etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 + s * cib B.h γ.1), neg_abs_le (etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 + s * cib B.h γ.1)]
    rw [hline s]
    unfold W0c4
    dsimp only
    rw [if_pos ⟨hAct, hR⟩, hps, hxs, hvs, mul_one, hσ0]
    rfl
  have hc : W0c4 B G γ ξ = σ0 • G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by
    have h := hW0line.self_of_nhds
    simpa using h
  by_cases hη : etaL B.h γ ξ = 0
  · have hσz : σ0 = 0 := by rw [hσ0, hη]; ring
    have hc0 : W0c4 B G γ ξ = 0 := by rw [hc, hσz, zero_smul]
    have hd : dVc B γ.1 (W0h4 B G γ m) ξ = fun i => (((0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) i : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      apply hlineD (fun _ => fun i => (((0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) i : ℝ) : ℂ)) _
      · filter_upwards [hW0line] with s hs
        funext i
        simp [W0h4, hm, hs, hσz]
      · exact hasDerivAt_const _ _
    exact hkill _ hd (fun i => by simp [hc0])
  · obtain ⟨T', hGPd, hT'⟩ : ∃ T' : Fin 3 → ℝ, HasDerivAt (G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)) T'
        (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) ∧
        T' = (APhi5 B G γ ξ).mulVec (G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2))
          - dDamp5 B G γ ξ • G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) :=
      ⟨_, (hG.2.2.2.2.2.1 γ hAct ξ hξB hη ⟨by linarith [hxi0], by linarith [het0, le_abs_self (etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)]⟩).1, rfl⟩
    have hT0 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 + s))
        T' 0 := by
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)) T' (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 + 0) := by
        rw [add_zero]; exact hGPd
      exact h2.comp_const_add (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) 0
    have hg : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => fun i => ((σ0 * G.tH γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)
        (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 + s) i : ℝ) : ℂ)) (fun i => ((σ0 * T' i : ℝ) : ℂ)) 0 := by
      apply hasDerivAt_pi.mpr
      intro i
      exact ((hasDerivAt_pi.mp hT0 i).const_mul σ0).ofReal_comp
    have hd : dVc B γ.1 (W0h4 B G γ m) ξ = fun i => ((σ0 * T' i : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      apply hlineD _ _ _ hg
      filter_upwards [hW0line] with s hs
      funext i
      simp only [W0h4, if_pos hm, hs, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    apply hkill (fun i => σ0 * T' i) hd
    intro i
    rw [hc, hT']
    exact halg _ _ _ _ _ _ i

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1/2) (W0h4 B G) → (∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (W0c4 B G γ ξ) = 0) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 (primState5 B G).Aw → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 (primState5 B G).pw → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1/2) (velW5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1 - kapS) (velW5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw - W0h4 B G) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1 - 3 * kapS) (linC5 B G - princC5 B G)

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1/2) (W0h4 B G) → (∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (W0c4 B G γ ξ) = 0) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 (primState5 B G).Aw → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 (primState5 B G).pw → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1/2) (velW5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1 - kapS) (velW5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw - W0h4 B G) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1 - 3 * kapS) (linC5 B G - princC5 B G)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨l1, h1⟩ := plin5_rem_split B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨l2, h2⟩ := wmo_amp_class_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨l3, h3⟩ := plin5_ampD_class B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨l4, h4⟩ := plin5_slow_class B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨l5, h5⟩ := plin5_pres_class B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨l6, h6⟩ := plin5_phase_class B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨l7, h7⟩ := plin5_visc_class B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨l8, h8⟩ := plin5_base_class B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨l9, h9⟩ := plin5_prin_small_class B G hok hG
  refine ⟨l1 + l2 + l3 + l4 + l5 + l6 + l7 + l8 + l9, fun l0 hl0 hW0 _htr hAw hpw hvel hdiff => ?_⟩
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  have hq1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (by simp)
  have eh : (1/2 : ℝ) + 1/2 = 1 := by norm_num
  have e1 : (1/2 : ℝ) + 1/2 - 3 * kapS = 1 - 3 * kapS := by norm_num
  have e2 : (1 : ℝ) - kapS - 2 * kapS = 1 - 3 * kapS := by ring
  have hAw' : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1/2 + 1/2) (primState5 B G).Aw := by rw [eh]; exact hAw
  have hpw' : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1/2 + 1/2) (primState5 B G).pw := by rw [eh]; exact hpw
  
  have hw : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1/2) (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw) :=
    (h2 l0 (by omega)).1 _ (1/2) hAw' hvel
  
  have P1 : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1 - 3 * kapS) (remSlow5 B (ampA5 B G)) := by
    have := h4 l0 (by omega) (1/2) _ hw
    rw [e1] at this
    exact this
  have P2 : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1 - 3 * kapS) (remPhase5 B G (ampA5 B G)) := by
    have := h6 l0 (by omega) (1/2) _ hw
    rw [e1] at this
    exact this
  have P3 : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1 - 3 * kapS) (remPres5 B (presP5 B G)) := by
    have := h5 l0 (by omega) (1/2) _ hpw'
    rw [e1] at this
    exact this
  have P4 : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1 - 3 * kapS) (remVisc5 B G (ampA5 B G)) := by
    have := h7 l0 (by omega) (1/2) _ hw
    rw [e1] at this
    exact this
  have P5 : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1 - 3 * kapS) (remBase5 B (ampA5 B G)) := by
    have := h8 l0 (by omega) (1/2) _ hw
    rw [e1] at this
    exact this
  have hD : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1 - kapS) (ampD5 B G) := h3 l0 (by omega) hAw hW0 hdiff
  have P6 : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1 - 3 * kapS)
      (primOp5 B G (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • ampD5 B G γ' m' η)) := by
    have := h9 l0 (by omega) (1 - kapS) _ hD
    rw [e2] at this
    exact this
  
  have addc : ∀ f g : WC, InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1 - 3 * kapS) f → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1 - 3 * kapS) g →
      InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1 - 3 * kapS) (f + g) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    have := (pwr5_waveV_add B G hok (qsOf l0) hq1 f g _ _ hf hg).1
    rwa [min_self] at this
  have hSum := addc _ _ (addc _ _ (addc _ _ (addc _ _ (addc _ _ P1 P2) P3) P4) P5) P6
  have hsplit := h1 l0 (by omega) hAw hpw hW0
  
  have hDo : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have h4c := hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hm : MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hξ' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun ξ : Cyl => simScale B.h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1)) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
      h4c.comp (f := fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) (Continuous.continuousOn (by fun_prop)) hm
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) = {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ ({ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} ∩
        (fun ξ : Cyl => simScale B.h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1)) ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0)) := by
      ext ξ
      exact Iff.rfl
    rw [e]
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).inter
      (hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const) isOpen_Iio)
  
  have hcurl0 : ∀ n : ℤ, mcurlC B.h n (fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ)) = fun _ => 0 := by
    intro n
    funext ξ
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [mcurlC, dZ, dR]
  have hdZ0 : dZ (fun _ : Cyl => (0 : ℂ)) = fun _ => 0 := by
    funext ξ; simp [dZ]
  have hdR0 : dR B.h (fun _ : Cyl => (0 : ℂ)) = fun _ => 0 := by
    funext ξ; simp [dR]
  have hdT0 : dT (fun _ : Cyl => (0 : ℂ)) = fun _ => 0 := by
    funext ξ; simp [dT]
  have hres0 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl), mresC B n (fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ)) (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) ξ = 0 := by
    intro n ξ
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [mresC, mlapC, hdZ0, hdR0, hdT0]
  have hcl1 : ∃ H : Finset ℤ, (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧ ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → (linC5 B G - princC5 B G) γ m = 0 := by
    refine ⟨{1, -1}, by simp, fun γ m hm => ?_⟩
    have hm' : ¬ (m = 1 ∨ m = -1) := by simpa using hm
    have hAw0 : (primState5 B G).Aw γ m = fun _ => 0 := by
      funext η
      show potW5 B G (W0c4 B G) γ m η = 0
      simp [potW5, hm']
    have hpw0 : (primState5 B G).pw γ m = fun _ => 0 := by
      funext η
      show (((qC B.h η / Qb γ.1) ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * presW5 B G (W0c4 B G) γ m η = 0
      simp [presW5, hm']
    have hW00 : W0h4 B G γ m = fun _ => 0 := by
      funext η
      simp [W0h4, hm']
    funext ξ
    show linC5 B G γ m ξ - princC5 B G γ m ξ = 0
    simp [linC5, princC5, hAw0, hpw0, hW00, hcurl0, hres0, dVc]
  obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3, c4, c5⟩ := hSum
  refine ⟨hcl1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro γ m
    exact (c2 γ m).congr (fun ξ hξ => hsplit γ m ξ hξ)
  · intro γ m ξ hξ c hc
    have hsh : shY ξ c ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := hξ
    rw [hsplit γ m _ hsh, hsplit γ m ξ hξ]
    exact c3 γ m ξ hξ c hc
  · intro γ m ξ hξ hne
    apply c4 γ m ξ hξ
    rwa [← hsplit γ m ξ hξ]
  · intro k
    obtain ⟨C, b, d, hC⟩ := c5 k

    have b2 := hinv ξ hr (k - i)
    rw [← hs] at b2
    have hpow : (s * ξ.1⁻¹) ^ (k - i + 1) ≤ ρ ^ (k - i + 1) := pow_le_pow_left₀ ht0 hsr _
    calc (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ)) i ξ *
          NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1⁻¹) (k - i) ξ
        ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * (|C i| * s) *
            (((k - i).factorial : ℝ) * ξ.1⁻¹ ^ (k - i + 1) * s ^ (k - i)) :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) b2 (norm_nonneg _)
            (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hs0))
      _ = (k.choose i : ℝ) * (|C i| * ((k - i).factorial : ℝ) * (s * ξ.1⁻¹) ^ (k - i + 1)) := by
          ring
      _ ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * (|C i| * ((k - i).factorial : ℝ) * ρ ^ (k - i + 1)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))
            (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  
  have hmF : InM B qs α (fun ξ => (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * ξ.1⁻¹) * nrm B e f ξ) := by
    obtain ⟨F1, F2, F3, F4⟩ := hF
    have hm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * η.1⁻¹) (DomC B.h qs) :=
      hf1.mul hf2
    refine ⟨hm.mul F1, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro ξ hξ a ha
      show (qC B.h (shY ξ a) ^ (1/2:ℝ) * (shY ξ a).1⁻¹) * nrm B e f (shY ξ a) =
        (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * ξ.1⁻¹) * nrm B e f ξ
      rw [F2 ξ hξ a ha]
      rfl
    · intro ξ hξ hX
      show (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * ξ.1⁻¹) * nrm B e f ξ = 0
      rw [F3 ξ hξ hX, mul_zero]
    · intro k
      choose M hM using hmbound
      choose C b d hC using F4
      obtain ⟨Cs, hCs⟩ : ∃ Cs : ℝ, Cs = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |C j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨bs, hbs⟩ : ∃ bs : ℝ, bs = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |b j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨ds, hds⟩ : ∃ ds : ℝ, ds = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |d j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨Ms, hMs⟩ : ∃ Ms : ℝ, Ms = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |M j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hCs0 : 0 ≤ Cs := by rw [hCs]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
      have hMs0 : 0 ≤ Ms := by rw [hMs]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
      have mem : ∀ j, j ≤ k → j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) :=
        fun j hj => Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj)
      have hCj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → C j ≤ Cs := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
        rw [hCs]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |C j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
      have hbj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → b j ≤ bs := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
        rw [hbs]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |b j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
      have hdj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → d j ≤ ds := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
        rw [hds]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |d j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
      have hMj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → M j ≤ Ms := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
        rw [hMs]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |M j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
      refine ⟨2 ^ k * Ms * Cs, bs, ds, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
      have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
      have hS1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
        unfold SC
        exact one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))])
      have hE : 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) := by
        unfold edgeWeight
        split_ifs
        · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
        · exact le_rfl
      have hδ0 : 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) := by
        have hX : 0 < XC B.h ξ := lt_trans hXa hX1
        unfold edgeDist
        exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX1))
          (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr hX2)))
      have hδ1 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
      have hqa : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
      have p3 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bs := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ, W = qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bs *
          edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hFb : ∀ j, j ≤ k → NB B.h (nrm B e f) j ξ ≤ Cs * W := by
        intro j hj
        have h1 := hC j ξ hξ hX1 hX2
        have hb : SC B.h ξ ^ (b j) ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bs := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 (hbj j hj)
        have hd : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d j) ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hδ0 hδ1 (neg_le_neg (hdj j hj))
        have p1 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ (b j) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
        have p2 : 0 ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d j) := Real.rpow_nonneg hδ0.le _
        calc NB B.h (nrm B e f) j ξ
            ≤ C j * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ (b j) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
                edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d j) := h1
          _ = C j * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ (b j) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
                edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d j)) := by ring
          _ ≤ Cs * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ (b j) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
                edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d j)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hCj j hj)
                (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hqa p1) hE) p2)
          _ ≤ Cs * W := by
              rw [hW]
              refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hCs0
              exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hqa) hE) hd p2
                (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hqa p3) hE)
      have hl := leib ξ (DomC B.h qs) k hDopen hξ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * η.1⁻¹)
        (nrm B e f) (hm.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)) (F1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      calc NB B.h (fun ξ => (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * ξ.1⁻¹) * nrm B e f ξ) k ξ
          ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) *
              NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * η.1⁻¹) i ξ * NB B.h (nrm B e f) (k - i) ξ := hl
        _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * Ms * (Cs * W) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro i hi
            have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
            exact mul_le_mul
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((hM i ξ hξ hX1).trans (hMj i hik)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
              (hFb _ (Nat.sub_le k i)) (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hMs0)
        _ = 2 ^ k * Ms * Cs * W := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul]
            have hs2 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) = 2 ^ k := by
              exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose k
            rw [hs2]; ring
        _ = 2 ^ k * Ms * Cs * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bs *
              edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) := by
            rw [hW]; ring
  
  have heq : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, nrm B (e + 1/2) (fun ξ => f ξ / ξ.1) ξ =
      (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * ξ.1⁻¹) * nrm B e f ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
    simp only [nrm]
    rw [Real.rpow_add hq e (1/2), div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  obtain ⟨G1, G2, G3, G4⟩ := hmF
  refine ⟨G1.congr heq, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ξ hξ a ha
    rw [heq _ hξ, heq (shY ξ a) hξ]
    exact G2 ξ hξ a ha
  · intro ξ hξ hX
    rw [heq _ hξ]
    exact G3 ξ hξ hX
  · intro k
    obtain ⟨C, b, d, hC⟩ := G4 k
    refine ⟨C, b, d, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
    have hev : nrm B (e + 1/2) (fun ξ => f ξ / ξ.1) =ᶠ[nhds ξ]
        (fun ξ => (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * ξ.1⁻¹) * nrm B e f ξ) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hDopen.mem_nhds hξ) heq
    have hNBeq : NB B.h (nrm B (e + 1/2) (fun ξ => f ξ / ξ.1)) k ξ =
        NB B.h (fun ξ => (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * ξ.1⁻¹) * nrm B e f ξ) k ξ := by
      unfold NB
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
    rw [hNBeq]
    exact hC ξ hξ hX1 hX2

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∀ (qs : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ) (e α : ℝ), InM B qs α (nrm B e f) → InM B qs α (nrm B e (yAvg f))

signature.name: wmo_rc_yavg_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∀ (qs : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ) (e α : ℝ), InM B qs α (nrm B e f) → InM B qs α (nrm B e (yAvg f))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hok qs f e α hF
  
  have PIC : ∀ {P E' F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
      [FiniteDimensional ℝ P] [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace ℝ E'] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E']
      [MeasurableSpace E'] [BorelSpace E'] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
      (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E') [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ]
      (U : Set P) (V K : Set E') (G : P → E' → F) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hK : IsCompact K)
      (hKV : K ⊆ V) (hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => G z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V)),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) x =
        ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ) := by
    intro P E' F _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ μ _ U V K G hU hV hK hKV hG
    have hO : IsOpen (U ×ˢ V) := hU.prod hV
    have hKm : MeasurableSet K := hK.isClosed.measurableSet
    have slice : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F'] (H : P → E' → F'),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) →
        ∀ x ∈ U, ContinuousOn (fun y => H x y) K := by
      intro F' _ _ H hH x hx
      have hc : Continuous (fun y : E' => ((x, y) : P × E')) := by fun_prop
      have h := ContinuousOn.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (f := fun y : E' => ((x, y) : P × E'))
        hH.continuousOn hc.continuousOn (fun y hy => ⟨hx, hKV hy⟩)
      exact h
    have param_fderiv : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F'] (H : P → E' → F'),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => H x' z.2) z.1) (U ×ˢ V) := by
      intro F' _ _ H hH p hp
      have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) p := hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hp)
      apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry (fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2)) (p, p.1) := by
        have e : Function.uncurry (fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2) =
            (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) ∘ (fun w : (P × E') × P => (w.2, w.1.2)) := rfl
        rw [e]
        apply ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (p, p.1)
        · simpa using hHa
        · fun_prop
      exact ContDiffAt.fderiv (f := fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2)
        (g := Prod.fst) h1 contDiffAt_fst (le_of_eq ENat.coe_top_add_one)
    have param_hasFDeriv : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F']
        (H : P → E' → F'), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) → ∀ x ∈ U,
        HasFDerivAt (fun x' => ∫ y in K, H x' y ∂μ) (∫ y in K, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => H x' y) x ∂μ) x := by
      intro F' _ _ H hH x hx
      have hHs := param_fderiv H hH
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU x hx
      have hsU : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ⊆ U :=
        (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
      have hsn : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ∈ nhds x := Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds x (by linarith)
      have hC : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ×ˢ K) := (isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod hK
      have hCsub : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ×ˢ K ⊆ U ×ˢ V := fun z hz => ⟨hsU hz.1, hKV hz.2⟩
      obtain ⟨Bd, hB⟩ := hC.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hHs.continuousOn.mono hCsub)
      refine hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (μ := μ.restrict K)
        (F := fun x' y => H x' y) (F' := fun x' y => fderiv ℝ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x')
        (bound := fun _ => Bd) hsn ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hx] with x' hx'
        exact (slice H hH x' hx').aestronglyMeasurable_of_isCompact hK hKm
      · exact (slice H hH x hx).integrableOn_compact hK
      · exact (slice (fun x' y => fderiv ℝ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x') hHs x hx).aestronglyMeasurable_of_isCompact
          hK hKm
      · exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hKm (fun y hy x' hx' => hB (x', y) ⟨hx', hy⟩)
      · exact continuousOn_const.integrableOn_compact hK
      · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hKm (fun y hy x' hx' => ?_)
        have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (x', y) :=
          hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds ⟨hsU hx', hKV hy⟩)
        have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x'' : P => ((x'', y) : P × E')) x' := by fun_prop
        have h2 := ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) x' hHa hc
        have : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x' := h2
        exact (this.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have hD0 : ∀ x y, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun x' => G x' y) x =
        (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm (G x y) := by
      intro x y; rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp]; rfl
    have hDs : ∀ (k : ℕ) x y, iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) (fun x' => G x' y) x =
        (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm
          (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') x) := by
      intro k x y; rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left]; rfl
    have D_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) (U ×ˢ V) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        have e : (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) =
            (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm ∘ (fun z : P × E' => G z.1 z.2) := by
          funext z; exact hD0 z.1 z.2
        rw [e]
        exact (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hG
      | succ k ih =>
        have e : (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) =
            (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm ∘
              (fun z : P × E' => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' z.2) x') z.1) := by
          funext z; exact hDs k z.1 z.2
        rw [e]
        have h2 := param_fderiv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') ih
        exact (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h2
    have formula : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) x =
        ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro x _
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp (f := fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ)]
        simp only [hD0]
        exact (ContinuousLinearEquiv.integral_comp_comm
          (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv (fun y => G x y)).symm
      | succ k ih =>
        intro x hx
        have hα : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) =ᶠ[nhds x]
            (fun x' => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x' ∂μ) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hx) ih
        have hβ := (param_hasFDeriv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x')
          (D_smooth k) x hx).fderiv
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left (f := fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ), Function.comp_apply,
          hα.fderiv_eq, hβ]
        simp only [hDs]
        have hL := ContinuousLinearEquiv.integral_comp_comm (μ := μ.restrict K) (𝕜 := ℝ)
          (E := P →L[ℝ] ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => P) F)
          (F := ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F)
          (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv
          (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') x)
        exact hL.symm
    have hsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U := by
      have key : ∀ m : ℕ, EqOn (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U)
          (fun x => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ) U := by
        intro m x hx
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hU hx]
        exact formula m x hx
      have hdiff : ∀ m : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℝ
          (fun x => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ) U :=
        fun m x hx => (param_hasFDeriv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x'' => G x'' y) x')
          (D_smooth m) x hx).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      exact contDiffOn_of_continuousOn_differentiableOn (n := ⊤)
        (fun m _ => ((hdiff m).continuousOn).congr (key m))
        (fun m _ => (hdiff m).congr (key m))
    exact ⟨hsmooth, formula⟩
  
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qs))
    have e : DomC B.h qs =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio qs := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  
  have key : ∀ (F : Cyl → ℝ) (V : Set Cyl) (a : Cyl) (T : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl), IsOpen V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → a ∈ V → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro F V a T hV hF ha i
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
    have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  
  have hM : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) ∈ DomC B.h qs :=
    fun ξ hξ Y => ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, hξ.2.2⟩
  have hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : Cyl × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((z.1.1, z.1.2.1, z.1.2.2.1, z.2) : Cyl)) :=
    contDiff_fst.fst.prodMk (contDiff_fst.snd.fst.prodMk (contDiff_fst.snd.snd.fst.prodMk contDiff_snd))
  have hKc : IsCompact (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ : ∃ π : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl, ∀ w : Cyl, π w = (w.1, w.2.1, w.2.2.1, 0) :=
    ⟨(ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (0 : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)))), fun w => rfl⟩
  have hcon : ∀ w : Cyl, ‖π w‖ ≤ ‖w‖ := by
    intro w
    rw [hπ]
    simp only [Prod.norm_def]
    refine max_le_max le_rfl (max_le_max le_rfl (max_le_max le_rfl ?_))
    exact le_trans (le_of_eq (by simp)) (le_max_of_le_left (norm_nonneg _))
  
  have NBle : ∀ (F : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (DomC B.h qs) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ (k : ℕ) (W : ℝ),
      (∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, NB B.h F k (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) ≤ W) → NB B.h (yAvg F) k ξ ≤ W := by
    intro F hFs ξ hξ k W hW
    have hGF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : Cyl × (ℝ × ℝ) => F (z.1.1, z.1.2.1, z.1.2.2.1, z.2))
        (DomC B.h qs ×ˢ univ) :=
      hFs.comp hΦ.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hM z.1 hz.1 z.2)
    have hPF := PIC MeasureTheory.volume (DomC B.h qs) univ (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
      (fun x Y => F (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y)) hDopen isOpen_univ hKc (subset_univ _) hGF
    have hformula : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (yAvg F) ξ = ∫ Y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x : Cyl => F (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y)) ξ := hPF.2 k ξ hξ
    have hN0 : 0 ≤ NB B.h F k (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, 0) := norm_nonneg _
    have hW0 : 0 ≤ W := le_trans hN0 (hW 0)
    have hcomm : ∀ (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (w : Cyl),
        π (Lnorm B.h ξ w) = Lnorm B.h (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) (π w) := by
      intro Y w
      show π (Lnorm B.h ξ w) = Lnorm B.h ξ (π w)
      rw [hπ, hπ]
      simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
    have hslice : ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x : Cyl => F (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y)) ξ =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => π) := by
      intro Y
      have e4 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : Cyl => F ((ξ + z).1, (ξ + z).2.1, (ξ + z).2.2.1, Y)) 0 =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x : Cyl => F (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y)) ξ := by
        have := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun x : Cyl => F (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y)) k ξ 0
        rw [add_zero] at this
        exact this
      have efun : (fun z : Cyl => F ((ξ + z).1, (ξ + z).2.1, (ξ + z).2.2.1, Y)) =
          fun z => F ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) + π z) := by
        funext z
        rw [hπ]
        simp only [Prod.mk_add_mk, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, add_zero]
      rw [← e4, efun]
      exact key F (DomC B.h qs) _ π hDopen hFs (hM ξ hξ Y) k
    have hpt : ∀ (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (v : Fin k → Cyl),
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x : Cyl => F (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y)) ξ (fun i => Lnorm B.h ξ (v i))‖ ≤
          W * ∏ i, ‖v i‖ := by
      intro Y v
      rw [hslice Y]
      simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
      have e : (fun i => π (Lnorm B.h ξ (v i))) =
          fun i => Lnorm B.h (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) (π (v i)) := by
        funext i; exact hcomm Y (v i)
      rw [e]
      have e2 : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y))
            (fun i => Lnorm B.h (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) (π (v i))) =
          ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Lnorm B.h (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y))) (fun i => π (v i)) := by
        rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
      rw [e2]
      calc _ ≤ NB B.h F k (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) * ∏ i, ‖π (v i)‖ :=
            ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
        _ ≤ W * ∏ i, ‖v i‖ :=
            mul_le_mul (hW Y) (by gcongr with i; exact hcon (v i))
              (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)) hW0
    unfold NB
    rw [hformula]
    refine ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound hW0 (fun v => ?_)
    simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    by_cases hint : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun Y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x : Cyl => F (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y)) ξ)
        (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1))
    · rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.integral_apply hint]
      have hvol : MeasureTheory.volume (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1) = 1 := by
        rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod, MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_prod, Real.volume_Icc]
        simp
      calc _ ≤ (W * ∏ i, ‖v i‖) * (MeasureTheory.volume.real (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1)) :=
            MeasureTheory.norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const (by rw [hvol]; exact ENNReal.one_lt_top)
              (fun Y _ => hpt Y v)
        _ = W * ∏ i, ‖v i‖ := by rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, hvol]; simp
    · rw [MeasureTheory.integral_undef hint]
      simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.zero_apply, norm_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg hW0 (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _))
  
  have hid : nrm B e (yAvg f) = yAvg (nrm B e f) := by
    funext ξ
    show qC B.h ξ ^ e * (∫ Y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, f (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y)) =
      ∫ Y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, qC B.h ξ ^ e * f (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y)
    exact (MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul _ _).symm
  rw [hid]
  obtain ⟨hs, -, hshell, hbd⟩ := hF
  have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : Cyl × (ℝ × ℝ) => nrm B e f (z.1.1, z.1.2.1, z.1.2.2.1, z.2))
      (DomC B.h qs ×ˢ univ) :=
    hs.comp hΦ.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hM z.1 hz.1 z.2)
  have hP := PIC MeasureTheory.volume (DomC B.h qs) univ (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (fun x Y => nrm B e f (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y)) hDopen isOpen_univ hKc (subset_univ _) hG
  refine ⟨hP.1, fun ξ _ a _ => rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ξ hξ hX
    show ∫ Y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, nrm B e f (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) = 0
    exact MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero (fun Y _ => hshell _ (hM ξ hξ Y) hX)
  · intro k
    obtain ⟨C, b, d, hC⟩ := hbd k
    refine ⟨C, b, d, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
    exact NBle (nrm B e f) hs ξ hξ k
      (C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
        edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d))
      (fun Y => hC _ (hM ξ hξ Y) hX1 hX2)

by
  intro B qs g hok hqs0 hqs1 hgs hsh ξ hξ
  have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qs := hξ

  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  unfold shInd
  by_cases hin : B.Xa < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < B.Xb
  · rw [if_pos hin]
  rw [if_neg hin]
  have hcase : XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ := by
    rcases not_and_or.mp hin with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (not_lt.mp h)
    · exact Or.inr (not_lt.mp h)
  have hXp : ∀ r' : ℝ, XC B.h (pathPt B.h ξ r') = r' ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ) := fun r' => rfl
  have hXξ : XC B.h ξ = ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ) := rfl
  have h2q : 0 < 2 * qC B.h ξ := by linarith
  set F : ℝ → ℝ := fun r' => (pathPt B.h ξ r').1 ^ ((1:ℕ):ℝ) * g (pathPt B.h ξ r') with hF
  have hIc : Icut B (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ ((1:ℕ):ℝ) * g η) ξ =
      (∫ r' in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) ξ.1, F r') - chiM B (XC B.h ξ) * ∫ r' in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), F r' := by
    show (∫ r' in (0:ℝ)..ξ.1, F r') - chiM B (XC B.h ξ) * (∫ r' in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), F r') = _
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hr.le]
  have hI0 : Icut B (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ ((1:ℕ):ℝ) * g η) ξ = 0 := by
    rw [hIc]
    rcases hcase with hc | hc
    · have hchi : chiM B (XC B.h ξ) = 0 := by
        unfold chiM
        apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
        exact div_nonpos_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
      have h1 : (∫ r' in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) ξ.1, F r') = 0 := by
        apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero

        have hX : XC B.h (pathPt B.h ξ r') ≤ B.Xa := by
          rw [hXp]
          calc r' ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ) ≤ ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ) :=
                div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsq h2q.le
            _ = XC B.h ξ := hXξ.symm
            _ ≤ B.Xa := hc
        show (pathPt B.h ξ r').1 ^ ((1:ℕ):ℝ) * g (pathPt B.h ξ r') = 0
        rw [hsh _ (Or.inl hX), mul_zero]
      rw [h1, hchi]
      ring
    · have hchi : chiM B (XC B.h ξ) = 1 := by
        unfold chiM
        apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
        rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]
        linarith
      have h2 : (∫ r' in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), F r') = ∫ r' in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) ξ.1, F r' := by
        apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi
          Set.Ioc_subset_Ioi_self
        intro r' hr'
        obtain ⟨h0, hn⟩ := hr'
        have h0' : (0:ℝ) < r' := h0
        have hlt : ξ.1 < r' := by
          by_contra hh
          exact hn ⟨h0', not_lt.mp hh⟩
        have hsq : ξ.1 ^ 2 ≤ r' ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hr.le hlt.le 2
        have hX : B.Xb ≤ XC B.h (pathPt B.h ξ r') := by
          rw [hXp]
          calc B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ := hc
            _ = ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ) := hXξ
            _ ≤ r' ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsq h2q.le
        show (pathPt B.h ξ r').1 ^ ((1:ℕ):ℝ) * g (pathPt B.h ξ r') = 0
        rw [hsh _ (Or.inr hX), mul_zero]
      rw [h2, hchi]
      ring
  show (0:ℝ) = ξ.1 ^ (-((1:ℕ):ℝ)) * Icut B (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ ((1:ℕ):ℝ) * g η) ξ
  rw [hI0, mul_zero]

  have hmem : ((ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, ξ.2.2.2 - (ξ.1 ^ drx B.h) • vrv) : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) ∈

  have hP : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
      ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), G (r, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv))

      G (r, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (ξ.2.2.2 - (ξ.1 ^ drx B.h) • vrv) + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) (G ξ) ξ.1 := by

  have hdec : Icut B G = fun η : Cyl =>
      (fun pζ : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) =>
        ∫ r in (0:ℝ)..pζ.1, G (r, pζ.2.1, pζ.2.2.1, pζ.2.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv))

      - chiM B (XC B.h η) *
        (fun ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), G (r, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv))

    show (∫ r' in (0:ℝ)..η.1, G (pathPt B.h η r')) -

    simp only [hpath]
  have hπ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl =>

    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ drx B.h) ξ :=

    have h3 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => η.2.2.1) ξ := differentiableAt_snd.snd.fst
    have h4 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => η.2.2.2) ξ := differentiableAt_snd.snd.snd

    (hqCs.contDiffAt (hDopen.mem_nhds hξ)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hXd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (XC B.h) ξ := by
    have e : XC B.h = fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ 2 * (2 * qC B.h η)⁻¹ := by

    rw [e]
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ 2) ξ := differentiableAt_fst.pow 2

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ) (g : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (DomC B.h qs) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → g ξ = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), g (r, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) {ζ | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs} ∧ (∀ (k : ℕ) (ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)), ζ.2.1 < 1 → simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs → ∀ v : Fin k → ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ), iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun ζ' : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), g (r, ζ'.1, ζ'.2.1, ζ'.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) ζ v = ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (r, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv) (fun i => ((0:ℝ), (v i).1, (v i).2.1, (v i).2.2))) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, g (r, w.1, w.2, Y)) {w | w.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qs} ∧ (∀ (k : ℕ) (w : ℝ × ℝ), w.2 < 1 → simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qs → ∀ v : Fin k → ℝ × ℝ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w' : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, g (r, w'.1, w'.2, Y)) w v = ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (r, w.1, w.2, Y) (fun i => ((0:ℝ), (v i).1, (v i).2, (0 : ℝ × ℝ)))) ∧ (∀ (ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) (p : ℝ), ζ.2.1 < 1 → simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs → 0 < p → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun pζ : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) => ∫ r in (0:ℝ)..pζ.1, g (r, pζ.2.1, pζ.2.2.1, pζ.2.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) (p, ζ) ∧ HasDerivAt (fun p' : ℝ => ∫ r in (0:ℝ)..p', g (r, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) (g (p, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2 + (p ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) p)

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (g : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl), B.ok → 0 < ξ.1 → ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), g (r, ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) (ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, ξ.2.2.2 - (ξ.1 ^ drx B.h) • vrv) → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun pζ : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) => ∫ r in (0:ℝ)..pζ.1, g (r, pζ.2.1, pζ.2.2.1, pζ.2.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) (ξ.1, (ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, ξ.2.2.2 - (ξ.1 ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) → HasDerivAt (fun p : ℝ => ∫ r in (0:ℝ)..p, g (r, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (ξ.2.2.2 - (ξ.1 ^ drx B.h) • vrv) + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) (g ξ) ξ.1 → dR B.h (Icut B g) ξ = g ξ - deriv (chiM B) (XC B.h ξ) * (ξ.1 / qC B.h ξ) * ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), g (pathPt B.h ξ r)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs hok hSN hqs0 hqs1 c e α f hf
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  
  have key : ∀ {E G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup G]
      [NormedSpace ℝ G] (F : E → G) (V : Set E) (a : E) (T : Cyl →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → a ∈ V → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro E G _ _ _ _ F V a T hV hF ha i
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set E, s = (fun z : E => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩

      rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : E) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
    have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn

    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  
  have hU : IsOpen {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd.snd.fst continuous_const
  have hqCU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by

      hS.2.2.2.1
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      (contDiff_snd.fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
    exact h1.comp h2.contDiffOn (fun η (hη : η.2.2.1 < 1) =>
      ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith)⟩)
  have hqposU : ∀ η : Cyl, η.2.2.1 < 1 → 0 < qC B.h η := fun η h =>
    (hS.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hDsub : DomC B.h qs ⊆ {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := fun η hη => hη.2.1
  have hDo : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have h1 : IsOpen ({η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} ∩ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) ⁻¹' Set.Iio qs) :=
      hqCU.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hU isOpen_Iio
    have h2 : IsOpen {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst
    have e : DomC B.h qs =
        {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} ∩ ({η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} ∩ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) ⁻¹' Set.Iio qs) := by
      ext η

    rw [e]; exact h2.inter h1
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) (DomC B.h qs) := hqCU.mono hDsub
  have hqpos : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ := fun ξ hξ => hqposU ξ (hDsub hξ)
  
  have hmul : ∀ (U : Set Cyl) (f g : Cyl → ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → ∀ ξ ∈ U, ∀ k : ℕ,

          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h f i ξ * NB B.h g (k - i) ξ := by
    intro U f g hU' hf hg ξ hξ k

    have kg := key g U ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hU' hg hξ
    have kfg := key (fun η => f η * g η) U ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hU' hfg hξ k

    have hsmO : ∀ F : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) O := by
      intro F hF

    have leib := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le (hsmO f hf) (hsmO g hg) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O
      (n := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen
      (f := fun y => f (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ y) * g (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ y)) k hO h0O] at leib
    rw [← kfg]

      intro i ξ hξ hX
      have hq := hqpos ξ hξ
      have hprod := hmul (DomC B.h qs) (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ 2 / 2)
        (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-1:ℝ)) hDo hf0.contDiffOn hqm1 ξ hξ i
      have hr2 : ξ.1 ^ 2 + qC B.h ξ ≤ (2 * B.Xb + 1) * qC B.h ξ := by
        have h' : ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ) < B.Xb := hX
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by linarith)] at h'
        linarith
      rw [hXCdef]

      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a _ => ?_)
      have h1 := hfsq ξ hq a
      have h2 : NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-1:ℝ)) (i - a) ξ ≤ |Ci (i - a)| * (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ := by
        refine (hCi (i - a) ξ hξ).trans ?_
        rw [Real.rpow_neg_one]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (inv_nonneg.mpr hq.le)
      calc (i.choose a : ℝ) * NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ 2 / 2) a ξ *
            NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-1:ℝ)) (i - a) ξ
          ≤ (i.choose a : ℝ) * (ξ.1 ^ 2 + qC B.h ξ) * (|Ci (i - a)| * (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹) :=
            mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) h2 (norm_nonneg _)
              (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hq.le))
        _ ≤ (i.choose a : ℝ) * ((2 * B.Xb + 1) * qC B.h ξ) * (|Ci (i - a)| * (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr2 (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
              (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (inv_nonneg.mpr hq.le))
        _ = (2 * B.Xb + 1) * ((i.choose a : ℝ) * |Ci (i - a)|) * (qC B.h ξ * (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹) := by
            ring
        _ = (2 * B.Xb + 1) * ((i.choose a : ℝ) * |Ci (i - a)|) := by
            rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hq.ne', mul_one]
    obtain ⟨E, hEdef⟩ : ∃ E : ℕ → ℝ, E = fun i =>
        (2 * B.Xb + 1) * ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose a : ℝ) * |Ci (i - a)| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hXCE : ∀ i : ℕ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (XC B.h) i ξ ≤ E i := by
      intro i ξ hξ hX
      rw [hEdef]
      exact hXCnb i ξ hξ hX
    
    have hφb : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc B.Xa B.Xb,
        ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i φ (Set.Ioi 0) x‖ ≤ M := by
      intro i
      have hc := hφ.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (m := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)

      exact isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        (hc.mono (fun x hx => show (0:ℝ) < x from lt_of_lt_of_le hXa hx.1))
    choose M hM using hφb
    
    have hchain : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ (m : ℕ) (A D : ℝ),
        (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i φ (Set.Ioi 0) (XC B.h ξ)‖ ≤ A) →
        (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m → NB B.h (XC B.h) i ξ ≤ D ^ i) →
        NB B.h (fun η => φ (XC B.h η)) m ξ ≤ (m.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ m := by
      intro ξ hξ m A D hA hD
      obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set Cyl, O = (fun v => ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) ⁻¹' DomC B.h qs :=

      have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ O := by
        rw [hOdef]; show ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ 0 ∈ DomC B.h qs; rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact hξ
      obtain ⟨χ, hχdef⟩ : ∃ χ : Cyl → ℝ, χ = fun v => XC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) := ⟨_, rfl⟩

        rw [hχdef]
        exact hXCs.comp (contDiff_const.add (Lnorm B.h ξ).contDiff).contDiffOn

      have hχmaps : Set.MapsTo χ O (Set.Ioi 0) := by
        intro v hv
        rw [hOdef] at hv
        rw [hχdef]
        exact hXCpos _ hv
      have hχ0 : χ 0 = XC B.h ξ := by
        rw [hχdef]; show XC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ 0) = _; rw [map_zero, add_zero]
      have hDχ : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i χ O 0‖ ≤ D ^ i := by
        intro i h1 h2
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO h0O, hχdef,
          key (XC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hDo hXCs hξ i]
        exact hD i h1 h2
      have hAχ : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i φ (Set.Ioi 0) (χ 0)‖ ≤ A := by
        intro i hi; rw [hχ0]; exact hA i hi
      have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hφ hχ (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
        (uniqueDiffOn_Ioi 0) hO.uniqueDiffOn hχmaps h0O (C := A) (D := D) hAχ hDχ
      have hNBeq : NB B.h (fun η => φ (XC B.h η)) m ξ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (φ ∘ χ) O 0‖ := by
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hO h0O, hχdef]
        unfold NB
        exact congrArg norm
          (key (fun η => φ (XC B.h η)) (DomC B.h qs) ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hDo hgs hξ m).symm
      rw [hNBeq]
      exact hFdB
    refine ⟨hqcs.mul hgs, fun k => ?_⟩
    choose Cq hCq using hqpow c
    obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |M i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |E i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by
      have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1)) => abs_nonneg (E i))
      rw [hDdef]; linarith
    have hMA : ∀ i ≤ k, M i ≤ A := by
      intro i hi
      have h2 : |M i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |M j| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |M j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
      rw [hAdef]; exact (le_abs_self _).trans h2
    have hED : ∀ i ≤ k, E i ≤ D := by
      intro i hi
      have h2 : |E i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |E j| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |E j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
      have h3 := le_abs_self (E i)
      rw [hDdef]; linarith
    refine ⟨∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
      (k.choose j : ℝ) * |Cq j| * (((k - j).factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ (k - j)), ?_⟩
    intro ξ hξ h1 h2
    have hq := hqpos ξ hξ
    have hpc : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ c := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    have hφm : ∀ m ≤ k, NB B.h (fun η => φ (XC B.h η)) m ξ ≤ (m.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ m := by
      intro m hm
      refine hchain ξ hξ m A D
        (fun i hi => (hM i (XC B.h ξ) ⟨h1.le, h2.le⟩).trans (hMA i (hi.trans hm)))
        (fun i hi1 hi2 => ?_)
      calc NB B.h (XC B.h) i ξ ≤ E i := hXCE i ξ hξ h2
        _ ≤ D := hED i (hi2.trans hm)
        _ ≤ D ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
    have hprod := hmul (DomC B.h qs) (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c)
      (fun η => φ (XC B.h η)) hDo hqcs hgs ξ hξ k
    refine hprod.trans ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ?_)
    have e1 : NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c) j ξ ≤ |Cq j| * qC B.h ξ ^ c :=
      (hCq j ξ hξ).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hpc)
    have e2 := hφm (k - j) (Nat.sub_le k j)
    calc (k.choose j : ℝ) * NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c) j ξ *
          NB B.h (fun η => φ (XC B.h η)) (k - j) ξ
        ≤ (k.choose j : ℝ) * (|Cq j| * qC B.h ξ ^ c) *
            (((k - j).factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ (k - j)) :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) e2 (norm_nonneg _)
            (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hpc))
      _ = (k.choose j : ℝ) * |Cq j| * (((k - j).factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ (k - j)) *
            qC B.h ξ ^ c := by ring
  
  
  have hh : 0 < B.h := hok.2.1.1
  have hh0 : B.h ≠ 0 := hh.ne'
  have hlin : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun X : ℝ => 2 * X) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id).contDiffOn
  have hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun X : ℝ => (2 * X) ^ (e / 2)) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    hlin.rpow_const_of_ne (fun X (hX : (0:ℝ) < X) => by positivity)
  obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ M : Cyl → ℝ,
      M = fun η => qC B.h η ^ (c + e / 2) * (2 * XC B.h η) ^ (e / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hMs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ M (DomC B.h qs) := by
    rw [hMdef]; exact (hprof _ (c + e / 2) hφ).1
  have hMb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ CM : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
      NB B.h M k ξ ≤ CM * qC B.h ξ ^ (c + e / 2) := by
    rw [hMdef]; exact (hprof _ (c + e / 2) hφ).2
  have heq : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs, qC B.h η ^ c * η.1 ^ e * f η = M η * f η := by
    intro η hη
    have hη' : 0 < η.1 ∧ η.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h η < qs := hη
    have hr : 0 < η.1 := hη'.1
    have hq : 0 < qC B.h η := hqpos η hη
    have hq0 : qC B.h η ≠ 0 := hq.ne'
    have h2X : 2 * XC B.h η = η.1 ^ 2 / qC B.h η := by
      show 2 * (η.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h η)) = η.1 ^ 2 / qC B.h η
      first
        | (field_simp; ring)
        | field_simp
    have hre : (η.1 ^ 2) ^ (e / 2) = η.1 ^ e := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hr.le]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    have hqe : qC B.h η ^ (c + e / 2) = qC B.h η ^ c * qC B.h η ^ (e / 2) :=
      Real.rpow_add hq c (e / 2)
    have hqe0 : qC B.h η ^ (e / 2) ≠ 0 := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _).ne'
    have hcancel : qC B.h η ^ (e / 2) * (η.1 ^ e / qC B.h η ^ (e / 2)) = η.1 ^ e := by
      field_simp
    rw [hMdef]
    show qC B.h η ^ c * η.1 ^ e * f η = qC B.h η ^ (c + e / 2) * (2 * XC B.h η) ^ (e / 2) * f η
    rw [h2X, Real.div_rpow (sq_nonneg _) hq.le, hre, hqe]
    calc qC B.h η ^ c * η.1 ^ e * f η
        = qC B.h η ^ c * (qC B.h η ^ (e / 2) * (η.1 ^ e / qC B.h η ^ (e / 2))) * f η := by
          rw [hcancel]
      _ = qC B.h η ^ c * qC B.h η ^ (e / 2) * (η.1 ^ e / qC B.h η ^ (e / 2)) * f η := by ring
  obtain ⟨F1, F2, F3, F4⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨(hMs.mul F1).congr heq, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ξ hξ a ha
    show qC B.h (shY ξ a) ^ c * (shY ξ a).1 ^ e * f (shY ξ a) = qC B.h ξ ^ c * ξ.1 ^ e * f ξ
    rw [F2 ξ hξ a ha]
    rfl
  · intro ξ hξ hX
    show qC B.h ξ ^ c * ξ.1 ^ e * f ξ = 0
    rw [F3 ξ hξ hX, mul_zero]
  · intro k
    choose CM hCM using hMb
    choose C b d hC using F4
    obtain ⟨Cs, hCs⟩ : ∃ Cs : ℝ, Cs = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |C j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨bs, hbs⟩ : ∃ bs : ℝ, bs = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |b j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨ds, hds⟩ : ∃ ds : ℝ, ds = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |d j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Ms, hMs'⟩ : ∃ Ms : ℝ, Ms = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |CM j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hCs0 : 0 ≤ Cs := by rw [hCs]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have hMs0 : 0 ≤ Ms := by rw [hMs']; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have mem : ∀ j, j ≤ k → j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) :=
      fun j hj => Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj)
    have hCj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → C j ≤ Cs := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hCs]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |C j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    have hbj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → b j ≤ bs := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hbs]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |b j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    have hdj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → d j ≤ ds := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hds]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |d j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    have hMj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → CM j ≤ Ms := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hMs']; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |CM j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    refine ⟨2 ^ k * Ms * Cs, bs, ds, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
    have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
    have hqc : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (c + e / 2) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    have hS1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
      unfold SC
      exact one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))])
    have hE : 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) := by
      unfold edgeWeight
      split_ifs
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      · exact le_rfl
    have hδ0 : 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) := by
      have hX : 0 < XC B.h ξ := lt_trans hXa hX1
      unfold edgeDist
      exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX1))
        (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr hX2)))
    have hδ1 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
    have hqa : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    have p3 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bs := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ, W = qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bs *
        edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hFb : ∀ j, j ≤ k → NB B.h f j ξ ≤ Cs * W := by
      intro j hj
      have h1 := hC j ξ hξ hX1 hX2
      have hb : SC B.h ξ ^ (b j) ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bs := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 (hbj j hj)
      have hd : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d j) ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hδ0 hδ1 (neg_le_neg (hdj j hj))
      have p1 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ (b j) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have p2 : 0 ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d j) := Real.rpow_nonneg hδ0.le _
      calc NB B.h f j ξ
          ≤ C j * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ (b j) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
              edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d j) := h1
        _ = C j * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ (b j) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
              edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d j)) := by ring
        _ ≤ Cs * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ (b j) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
              edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d j)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hCj j hj)

      rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]

    have hNBeq : NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c * η.1 ^ e * f η) k ξ =
        NB B.h (fun η => M η * f η) k ξ := by
      unfold NB
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
    have hl := hmul (DomC B.h qs) M f hDo hMs F1 ξ hξ k
    calc NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c * η.1 ^ e * f η) k ξ
        = NB B.h (fun η => M η * f η) k ξ := hNBeq
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h M i ξ * NB B.h f (k - i) ξ := hl
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * (Ms * qC B.h ξ ^ (c + e / 2)) * (Cs * W) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum

            (hCM i ξ hξ hX1 hX2).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hMj i hik) hqc)

            (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hMs0 hqc))
      _ = 2 ^ k * (Ms * qC B.h ξ ^ (c + e / 2)) * (Cs * W) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul]
          have hs2 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) = 2 ^ k := by
            exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose k
          rw [hs2]
      _ = 2 ^ k * Ms * Cs * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α + (c + e / 2) / B.h)) * SC B.h ξ ^ bs *
            edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) := by
          rw [hexp, hW]; ring

∀ (B : BG) (qs c : ℝ) (Φ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ {ζ | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs} →
    (∀ k N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ), ζ.2.1 < 1 → simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs →

  obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ : ∃ H : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, H = fun Y' r' =>
