      have hA1 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i) := mul_nonneg pq1 pS1
      have hA2 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg pq2 pS2) hE) pe) hP0
      have a1 : nN i ≤ |CN i| * (q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i)) := by
        refine le_trans (hbN i hik) ?_
        rw [mul_assoc]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hA1
      have a2 : na (k - i) ≤
          |Ca (k - i)| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P) := by
        refine le_trans (hba (k - i) hjk) ?_
        have : Ca (k - i) * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P =
            Ca (k - i) * (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P) := by
          ring
        rw [this]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hA2
      have a3 : nN i * na (k - i) ≤ (|CN i| * (q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i))) *
          (|Ca (k - i)| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P)) :=
        mul_le_mul a1 a2 (hna _) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hA1)
      have hbsum : bN i + bA (k - i) ≤
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j|) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j| := by
        have s1 : |bN i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |bN j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) hi
        have s2 : |bA (k - i)| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |bA j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) hj
        linarith [le_abs_self (bN i), le_abs_self (bA (k - i))]
      have hdsum : dA (k - i) ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dA j| := by
        have s3 : |dA (k - i)| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dA j| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |dA j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) hj
        linarith [le_abs_self (dA (k - i))]
      have f1 : S ^ (bN i + bA (k - i)) ≤
          S ^ ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j|) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j|) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS hbsum
      have f2 : e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) ≤ e ^ (-(∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dA j|)) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge he0 he1 (neg_le_neg hdsum)
      have eq1 : q ^ (B.h * β) * q ^ (B.h * α) = q ^ (B.h * (α + β)) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]; congr 1; ring
      have pQ : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * (α + β)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
      have a4 : (q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i)) *
          (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P) ≤ X := by
        calc (q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i)) *
              (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P)
            = (q ^ (B.h * β) * q ^ (B.h * α)) * (S ^ (bN i) * S ^ (bA (k - i))) * E *
                e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P := by ring
          _ = q ^ (B.h * (α + β)) * S ^ (bN i + bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P := by
              rw [eq1, ← Real.rpow_add hS0]
          _ ≤ X := by
              rw [hXdef]
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hP0
              apply mul_le_mul _ f2 pe
                (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg pQ (Real.rpow_nonneg hS0.le _)) hE)
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hE
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left f1 pQ
      have hc : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      calc (k.choose i : ℝ) * nN i * na (k - i) = (k.choose i : ℝ) * (nN i * na (k - i)) := by ring
        _ ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * ((|CN i| * (q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i))) *
            (|Ca (k - i)| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a3 hc
        _ = (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)| * ((q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i)) *
            (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P)) := by ring
        _ ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)| * X :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a4
              (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc (abs_nonneg _)) (abs_nonneg _))
    calc K * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * nN i * na (k - i)
        ≤ K * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)| * X :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum hterm) hK
      _ = _ := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hXdef]; ring
  
  have hV : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∉ tsupport (a γ m) →
      (fun η => μ γ η • a γ m η) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ) := by
    intro γ m ξ hξ
    have h1 := (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq).1 hξ
    exact h1.mono (fun η hη => by
      show μ γ η • a γ m η = 0
      rw [hη]
      exact hc0 _)
  refine ⟨⟨H, H0, fun γ m hm => ?_⟩, fun γ m => ?_, fun γ m ξ hξ c hc => ?_,
    fun γ m ξ hξ hne => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · funext ξ
    show μ γ ξ • a γ m ξ = 0
    rw [Hv γ m hm]
    exact hc0 _
  · intro ξ hξ
    apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
    by_cases hts : ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m)
    · have hN' := hsm γ m ξ hξ hts
      have ha' := (sa γ m).contDiffAt (hDopen.mem_nhds hξ)
      show ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => μ γ η • a γ m η) ξ
      rw [hP γ m]
      exact (contDiffAt_const.clm_apply hN').clm_apply ha'
    · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hV γ m ξ hts)
  · show μ γ (shY ξ c) • a γ m (shY ξ c) = μ γ ξ • a γ m ξ
    rw [da γ m ξ hξ c hc]
    by_cases h0 : a γ m ξ = 0
    · rw [h0, hc0, hc0]
    · rw [hdeck γ m ξ hξ h0 c hc]
  · apply pa γ m ξ hξ
    intro h0
    apply hne
    show μ γ ξ • a γ m ξ = 0
    rw [h0]
    exact hc0 _
  · refine ⟨‖Bl‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)|,
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j|) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j|,
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dA j|, fun γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hq0, hq1, hS1⟩ := hDq ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨hE, he0, he1⟩ := hEdge _ hX1 hX2
    have hPv : 0 ≤ Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by
      unfold Penv5
      exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
    show NB B.h (fun η => μ γ η • a γ m η) k ξ ≤ _
    by_cases hts : ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m)
    · have hNk : ContDiffAt ℝ k (μ γ) ξ := (hsm γ m ξ hξ hts).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hNu⟩ := hNk.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
      obtain ⟨O, hOsub, hOopen, hξO⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp (Filter.inter_mem hu (hDopen.mem_nhds hξ))
      have hNO : ContDiffOn ℝ k (μ γ) O := hNu.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).1)
      have haO : ContDiffOn ℝ k (a γ m) O :=
        ((sa γ m).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).2)
      have hL := hLeib (μ γ) (a γ m) O ξ k hOopen hξO hNO haO
      rw [hP γ m]
      refine le_trans hL ?_
      exact comb k (qC B.h ξ) (SC B.h ξ) (Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)))
        (edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ)) (Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)) ‖Bl‖
        (fun i => NB B.h (μ γ) i ξ) (fun j => NB B.h (a γ m) j ξ) hq0 hS1 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
        he0 he1 hPv (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg Bl) (fun i => norm_nonneg _) (fun j => norm_nonneg _)
        (fun i _ => hN i γ m ξ hξ hts hX1 hX2) (fun j _ => hA j γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2)
    · have hev := hV γ m ξ hts
      have h0 : NB B.h (fun η => μ γ η • a γ m η) k ξ = 0 := by
        unfold NB
        rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
        have e : ((0 : Cyl → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => Cyl) (Fin 3 → ℂ)) ξ
            ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) = 0 := by
          ext m
          simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
        rw [e, norm_zero]
      rw [h0]
      have hC0 : 0 ≤ ‖Bl‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)| :=
        mul_nonneg (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg Bl) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ =>
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) (abs_nonneg _)))
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC0
        (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
        (Real.rpow_nonneg he0.le _)) hPv

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (l0 : ℕ), B.ok → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (((B.h * qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun ζ => Real.log (qC B.h ζ)) η : ℝ)) : ℂ)) ξ) ∧ (∀ (ξ : Cyl) (c : ℝ × ℝ), (((B.h * qC B.h (shY ξ c) ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun ζ => Real.log (qC B.h ζ)) (shY ξ c) : ℝ)) : ℂ) = (((B.h * qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun ζ => Real.log (qC B.h ζ)) ξ : ℝ)) : ℂ)) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (((B.h * qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun ζ => Real.log (qC B.h ζ)) η : ℝ)) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ B.h

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (l0 : ℕ), B.ok → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (((B.h * qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun ζ => Real.log (qC B.h ζ)) η : ℝ)) : ℂ)) ξ) ∧ (∀ (ξ : Cyl) (c : ℝ × ℝ), (((B.h * qC B.h (shY ξ c) ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun ζ => Real.log (qC B.h ζ)) (shY ξ c) : ℝ)) : ℂ) = (((B.h * qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun ζ => Real.log (qC B.h ζ)) ξ : ℝ)) : ℂ)) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (((B.h * qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun ζ => Real.log (qC B.h ζ)) η : ℝ)) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ B.h

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B l0 hok
  have hh0 : 0 < B.h := hok.2.1.1
  have hh1 : B.h < 1/100 := hok.2.1.2.1
  have hqs0 : 0 < qsOf l0 := by
    show (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ))
    positivity
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  obtain ⟨hOpen, hqCsm, hq0, -, hcal, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  have hSN : SimNorm B.h := simscale_normalized_v4 B.h hh0 hh1 hok.1
  have hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    hqCsm.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hq0 η hη).ne')
  have hlog : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : Cyl => Real.log (qC B.h ζ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    hqCsm.log (fun η hη => (hq0 η hη).ne')
  
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ : ∃ G : (Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℂ, G = (2 * B.h) •
      (Complex.ofRealCLM.comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ (((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) : Cyl))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hGapp : ∀ T : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ,
      G T = (((2 * B.h * T (((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) : Cyl)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro T
    rw [hG, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, Complex.real_smul]
    push_cast
    ring
  
  have hshift : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (f : Cyl → ℝ) (k : ℕ), 0 < qC B.h ξ → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ →
      NB B.h (fun η => G (fderiv ℝ f η)) k ξ ≤
        |2 * B.h| * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) * NB B.h f (k + 1) ξ) := by
    intro ξ f k hq hf
    have hfd : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (fderiv ℝ f) ξ :=
      hf.fderiv_right (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hcomp : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => G (fderiv ℝ f η)) ξ =
        G.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ f) ξ) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left G hfd (i := k) le_rfl
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : Cyl, w = ((0:ℝ), qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hwpos : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    have he : qC B.h ξ ^ (2⁻¹ - B.h) * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 2⁻¹) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hq, show (2⁻¹ - B.h + (B.h - 2⁻¹) : ℝ) = 0 by ring, Real.rpow_zero]
    have hwpos' : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 2⁻¹) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    have hLw : Lnorm B.h ξ w = (((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) : Cyl) := by
      rw [hw]
      simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap', he]
    have hnw : ‖w‖ ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) := by
      rw [hw, Prod.norm_mk]
      refine max_le (by simp [hwpos, hwpos']) ?_
      rw [Prod.norm_mk]
      refine max_le (by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hwpos]) ?_
      rw [Prod.norm_mk]
      exact max_le (by simp [hwpos, hwpos']) (by simp [hwpos, hwpos'])
    unfold NB
    rw [hcomp]
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ |2 * B.h| * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) *
        ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)‖) :=
      mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hwpos (norm_nonneg _))
    refine ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound hM0 (fun v => ?_)
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply, hGapp]
    have hsucc : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ f) ξ (fun i => Lnorm B.h ξ (v i)))
        (((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) : Cyl) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ))
          (Fin.snoc v w) := by
      rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right]
      have h1 : Fin.init (fun i : Fin (k + 1) => Lnorm B.h ξ (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) v w i)) =
          fun i => Lnorm B.h ξ (v i) := by
        funext i
        simp [Fin.init]
      rw [h1]
      simp only [Fin.snoc_last, hLw]
    rw [hsucc, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    have hb := ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)) (Fin.snoc v w)
    rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc] at hb
    simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last] at hb
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hb
    generalize ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)) = T at hb ⊢
    have hprod : 0 ≤ ∏ i, ‖v i‖ := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
    calc |2 * B.h| * |T (Fin.snoc v w)|
        ≤ |2 * B.h| * (‖T‖ * ((∏ i, ‖v i‖) * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnw hprod) (norm_nonneg _))) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = |2 * B.h| * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) * ‖T‖) * ∏ i, ‖v i‖ := by ring
  
  have hid : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.h * qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun ζ => Real.log (qC B.h ζ)) η =
      2 * B.h * dZ (fun ζ => qC B.h ζ ^ (1/2:ℝ)) η := by
    intro η hη
    have hqη := hq0 η hη
    have hD : HasFDerivAt (qC B.h) (fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) η) η :=
      ((hqCsm.contDiffAt (hOpen.mem_nhds hη)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have e1 := (hD.log hqη.ne').fderiv
    have e2 := (hD.rpow_const (p := (1/2:ℝ)) (Or.inl hqη.ne')).fderiv
    unfold dZ
    rw [e1, e2]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [Real.rpow_sub_one hqη.ne']
    field_simp
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro ξ hξ
    have hm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => B.h * qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) *
        dZ (fun ζ => Real.log (qC B.h ζ)) η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      (contDiffOn_const.mul hs).mul (hcal _ hlog).2.1
    have := (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff (n := ∞)).contDiffAt.comp ξ (hm.contDiffAt (hOpen.mem_nhds hξ))
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using this
  · 
    intro ξ c
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : Cyl, a = ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), c) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have e1 : shY ξ c = ξ + a := by
      rw [ha]
      ext <;> simp [shY]
    have h3 : fderiv ℝ (fun ζ : Cyl => Real.log (qC B.h ζ)) (ξ + a) =
        fderiv ℝ (fun ζ : Cyl => Real.log (qC B.h ζ)) ξ := by
      rw [← fderiv_comp_add_right a]
      congr 1
      funext x
      simp [qC, ha]
    have hd : dZ (fun ζ => Real.log (qC B.h ζ)) (shY ξ c) = dZ (fun ζ => Real.log (qC B.h ζ)) ξ := by
      unfold dZ
      rw [e1, h3]
    have hq : qC B.h (shY ξ c) = qC B.h ξ := rfl
    rw [hq, hd]
  · 
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C', hC'⟩ := nb_qpow_v4 B (qsOf l0) (1/2) hok hSN hqs0 hqs1 (k + 1)
    refine ⟨|2 * B.h| * C', fun ξ hξ => ?_⟩
    have hq := hq0 ξ hξ
    have hsA : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : Cyl => qC B.h ζ ^ (1/2:ℝ)) ξ := hs.contDiffAt (hOpen.mem_nhds hξ)
    have hgerm : (fun η : Cyl => (((B.h * qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun ζ => Real.log (qC B.h ζ)) η : ℝ)) : ℂ))
        =ᶠ[nhds ξ] (fun η => G (fderiv ℝ (fun ζ : Cyl => qC B.h ζ ^ (1/2:ℝ)) η)) := by
      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hOpen.mem_nhds hξ) (fun η hη => ?_)
      show (((B.h * qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun ζ => Real.log (qC B.h ζ)) η : ℝ)) : ℂ) =
        G (fderiv ℝ (fun ζ : Cyl => qC B.h ζ ^ (1/2:ℝ)) η)
      rw [hid η hη, hGapp]
      rfl
    have hNBeq : NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (((B.h * qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) *
        dZ (fun ζ => Real.log (qC B.h ζ)) η : ℝ)) : ℂ)) k ξ =
        NB B.h (fun η => G (fderiv ℝ (fun ζ : Cyl => qC B.h ζ ^ (1/2:ℝ)) η)) k ξ := by
      unfold NB
      rw [(hgerm.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
    rw [hNBeq]
    calc _ ≤ |2 * B.h| * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) *
          NB B.h (fun ζ : Cyl => qC B.h ζ ^ (1/2:ℝ)) (k + 1) ξ) := hshift ξ _ k hq hsA
      _ ≤ |2 * B.h| * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) * (C' * qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC' ξ hξ)
            (Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _)) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = |2 * B.h| * C' * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) * qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ)) := by ring
      _ = |2 * B.h| * C' * qC B.h ξ ^ B.h := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hq, sub_add_cancel]

subgoal_signatures.name: domc_open_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ) ∧ ContinuousOn (XC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dT f) (DomC B.h qs)) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → dR B.h f ξ = 0 ∧ dZ f ξ = 0 ∧ dT f ξ = 0)

signature.name: flat_zero_extension_cyl
signature.statement: ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (U V : Set Cyl) (f : Cyl → F), IsOpen U → IsOpen V → V ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V → (∀ x ∈ U, x ∉ V → f x = 0) → (∀ x ∈ U, x ∉ V → ∀ k : ℕ, Filter.Tendsto (fun y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f y) (nhdsWithin x V) (nhds 0)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U ∧ ∀ x ∈ U, x ∉ V → ∀ k : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f x = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro F _ _ U V f hU hV _hVU hf h0 hlim
  
  have key : ∀ {G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (g : Cyl → G),
      DifferentiableOn ℝ g V → (∀ x ∈ U, x ∉ V → g x = 0) →
      (∀ x ∈ U, x ∉ V → Filter.Tendsto g (nhdsWithin x V) (nhds 0)) →
      (∀ x ∈ U, x ∉ V → Filter.Tendsto (fun y => fderiv ℝ g y) (nhdsWithin x V) (nhds 0)) →
      ∀ x ∈ U, x ∉ V → HasFDerivAt g (0 : Cyl →L[ℝ] G) x := by
    intro G _ _ g hgd hg0 hglim hdlim x hxU hxV
    apply HasFDerivAt.of_isLittleO
    have hgx : g x = 0 := hg0 x hxU hxV
    have e : (fun x' => g x' - g x - (0 : Cyl →L[ℝ] G) (x' - x)) = g := by
      funext x'; simp [hgx]
    rw [e, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hd⟩ := Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds.1 (hdlim x hxU hxV) c hc
    obtain ⟨δU, hδU, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hU x hxU
    rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff]
    refine ⟨min δ₁ δU, lt_min hδ₁ hδU, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    have hy1 : dist y x < δ₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le hy (min_le_left _ _)
    have hyU' : dist y x < δU := lt_of_lt_of_le hy (min_le_right _ _)
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ ‖y - x‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hrd : dist y x = ‖y - x‖ := dist_eq_norm y x
    by_cases hyV : y ∈ V
    swap
    · have : g y = 0 := hg0 y (hball (Metric.mem_ball.2 hyU')) hyV
      rw [this, norm_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg hc.le hr0
    
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : ℝ → Cyl, p = fun s => x + s • (y - x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hpc : Continuous p := by
      rw [hp]; exact continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)
    have hpdist : ∀ s t : ℝ, dist (p t) (p s) = |t - s| * ‖y - x‖ := by
      intro s t
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      have : p t - p s = (t - s) • (y - x) := by simp only [hp]; module
      rw [this, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hp0 : p 0 = x := by rw [hp]; simp
    have hp1 : p 1 = y := by rw [hp]; simp
    obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : Set ℝ, S = Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ∩ p ⁻¹' Vᶜ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hSc : IsClosed S := by
      rw [hS]; exact isClosed_Icc.inter (hV.isClosed_compl.preimage hpc)
    have hSne : S.Nonempty := by
      refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      rw [hS]
      refine ⟨⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩, ?_⟩
      show p 0 ∉ V
      rw [hp0]; exact hxV
    have hSb : BddAbove S := ⟨1, fun s hs => by rw [hS] at hs; exact hs.1.2⟩
    obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀⟩ : ∃ s₀ : ℝ, s₀ = sSup S := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs₀S : s₀ ∈ S := by rw [hs₀]; exact hSc.csSup_mem hSne hSb
    rw [hS] at hs₀S
    have hs₀0 : 0 ≤ s₀ := hs₀S.1.1
    have hs₀le : s₀ ≤ 1 := hs₀S.1.2
    have hs₀V : p s₀ ∉ V := hs₀S.2
    have hs₀1 : s₀ < 1 := by
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hs₀le with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso; apply hs₀V; rw [h, hp1]; exact hyV
    have htail : ∀ s, s₀ < s → s ≤ 1 → p s ∈ V := by
      intro s h1 h2
      by_contra hn
      have hsS : s ∈ S := by rw [hS]; exact ⟨⟨by linarith, h2⟩, hn⟩
      have := le_csSup hSb hsS
      rw [← hs₀] at this
      linarith
    have hzdist : dist (p s₀) x = s₀ * ‖y - x‖ := by
      have := hpdist 0 s₀
      rw [hp0, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hs₀0] at this
      exact this
    have hzU : p s₀ ∈ U := by
      apply hball
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, hzdist]
      have : s₀ * ‖y - x‖ ≤ ‖y - x‖ := mul_le_of_le_one_left hr0 hs₀le
      linarith
    
    have hmvt : ∀ s', s₀ < s' → s' ≤ 1 → ‖g y - g (p s')‖ ≤ c * ‖y - x‖ := by
      intro s' h1 h2
      have hseg : ∀ u ∈ segment ℝ (p s') y, u ∈ V ∧ dist u x < δ₁ := by
        intro u hu
        rw [segment_eq_image'] at hu
        obtain ⟨θ, ⟨hθ0, hθ1⟩, rfl⟩ := hu
        have e : p s' + θ • (y - p s') = p (s' + θ * (1 - s')) := by
          rw [hp]; simp only; module
        show p s' + θ • (y - p s') ∈ V ∧ dist (p s' + θ • (y - p s')) x < δ₁
        rw [e]
        have hA : 0 ≤ θ * (1 - s') := mul_nonneg hθ0 (by linarith)
        have hB : 0 ≤ (1 - θ) * (1 - s') := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
        have hs_nonneg : 0 ≤ s' + θ * (1 - s') := by linarith
        have hs_le : s' + θ * (1 - s') ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
        refine ⟨htail _ (by linarith) hs_le, ?_⟩
        have := hpdist 0 (s' + θ * (1 - s'))
        rw [hp0, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hs_nonneg] at this
        rw [this]
        have : (s' + θ * (1 - s')) * ‖y - x‖ ≤ ‖y - x‖ := mul_le_of_le_one_left hr0 hs_le
        linarith
      have hmv := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := g) (C := c)
        (s := segment ℝ (p s') y)
        (fun u hu => hgd.differentiableAt (hV.mem_nhds (hseg u hu).1))
        (fun u hu => by
          have := hd (hseg u hu).1 (hseg u hu).2
          rw [dist_zero_right] at this
          exact this.le)
        (convex_segment _ _) (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _) (right_mem_segment ℝ _ _)
      refine le_trans hmv ?_
      have hd2 : ‖y - p s'‖ = (1 - s') * ‖y - x‖ := by
        have := hpdist s' 1
        rw [hp1, dist_eq_norm, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)] at this
        exact this
      rw [hd2]
      have : (1 - s') * ‖y - x‖ ≤ ‖y - x‖ := mul_le_of_le_one_left hr0 (by linarith)
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this hc.le
    
    apply le_of_forall_pos_lt_add
    intro η hη
    obtain ⟨δ', hδ', hδ'g⟩ := Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds.1 (hglim _ hzU hs₀V) η hη
    have hpos : 0 < δ' / (2 * (‖y - x‖ + 1)) := by positivity
    obtain ⟨s', hs'⟩ : ∃ s' : ℝ, s' = min 1 (s₀ + δ' / (2 * (‖y - x‖ + 1))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs'1 : s' ≤ 1 := by rw [hs']; exact min_le_left _ _
    have hs'0 : s₀ < s' := by rw [hs']; exact lt_min hs₀1 (by linarith)
    have hs'le : s' ≤ s₀ + δ' / (2 * (‖y - x‖ + 1)) := by rw [hs']; exact min_le_right _ _
    have hpV := htail s' hs'0 hs'1
    have hdz : dist (p s') (p s₀) < δ' := by
      rw [hpdist s₀ s', abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
      have h1 : (s' - s₀) * ‖y - x‖ ≤ δ' / (2 * (‖y - x‖ + 1)) * ‖y - x‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hr0
      have h2 : δ' / (2 * (‖y - x‖ + 1)) * ‖y - x‖ < δ' := by
        rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        nlinarith
      linarith
    have hgs := hδ'g hpV hdz
    rw [dist_zero_right] at hgs
    have := hmvt s' hs'0 hs'1
    calc ‖g y‖ ≤ ‖g y - g (p s')‖ + ‖g (p s')‖ := norm_le_norm_sub_add _ _
      _ < c * ‖y - x‖ + η := by linarith
  
  have hFD : ∀ m : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f) V := by
    intro m y hy
    have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f y := hf.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hy)
    exact (hc.differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv
      (by exact_mod_cast ENat.natCast_lt_top m)).differentiableWithinAt
  
  have hDlim : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ U, x ∉ V →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun y => fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f) y) (nhdsWithin x V) (nhds 0) := by
    intro m x hx hxV
    have h1 := tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.1 (hlim x hx hxV (m + 1))
    have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => ‖fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f) y‖) (nhdsWithin x V) (nhds 0) :=
      h1.congr (fun y => norm_fderiv_iteratedFDeriv.symm)
    exact (tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero
      (E := Cyl →L[ℝ] ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => Cyl) F)).2 h2
  
  have hZ : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ U, x ∉ V → iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f x = 0 := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro x hx hxV
      rw [← norm_eq_zero, norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, h0 x hx hxV, norm_zero]
    | succ m ih =>
      intro x hx hxV
      have hd := key (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f) (hFD m) ih (fun x hx hxV => hlim x hx hxV m)
        (hDlim m) x hx hxV
      have hfd : fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f) x = 0 := hd.fderiv
      rw [← norm_eq_zero, ← norm_fderiv_iteratedFDeriv, hfd]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_zero
  
  have hDU : ∀ m : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f) U := by
    intro m x hx
    by_cases hxV : x ∈ V
    · exact ((hFD m).differentiableAt (hV.mem_nhds hxV)).differentiableWithinAt
    · exact (key _ (hFD m) (hZ m) (fun x hx hxV => hlim x hx hxV m) (hDlim m) x hx
        hxV).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  refine ⟨?_, fun x hx hxV k => hZ k x hx hxV⟩
  apply contDiffOn_of_differentiableOn
  intro m _
  exact (hDU m).congr (fun x hx => iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hU hx)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h q0 : ℝ), 0 ≤ h → h ≤ 1/2 → 0 < q0 → ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ ξ : Cyl, q0 ≤ qC h ξ → qC h ξ ≤ 1 → ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V) (k : ℕ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ‖ ≤ M ^ k * NB h f k ξ ∧ NB h f k ξ ≤ M ^ k * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ‖

signature.name: lnorm_two_sided_bound_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (h q0 : ℝ), 0 ≤ h → h ≤ 1/2 → 0 < q0 → ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ ξ : Cyl, q0 ≤ qC h ξ → qC h ξ ≤ 1 → ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V) (k : ℕ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ‖ ≤ M ^ k * NB h f k ξ ∧ NB h f k ξ ≤ M ^ k * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ‖

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h q0 hh0 hh1 hq0
  
  have hL : Lgc ≠ 0 := by
    unfold Lgc; intro h0
    have : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := (Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)).mpr (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hT : Tgc ≠ 0 := by unfold Tgc; intro h0; linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
  have hN : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have c1 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), (Jpow n Y).1 = Lgc ^ n * ((Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) +
      Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) * bgc := by
    intro n Y
    simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk]
    ring
  have c2 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), (Jpow n Y).2 = -(Lgc ^ n * ((Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) * bgc) +
      Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) := by
    intro n Y
    simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk]
    ring
  have hcomp : ∀ (m n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), Jpow m (Jpow n Y) = Jpow (m + n) Y := by
    intro m n Y
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · rw [c1 m, c1 (m + n), c1 n, c2 n, zpow_add₀ hL, zpow_add₀ hT]
      field_simp
      ring
    · rw [c2 m, c2 (m + n), c1 n, c2 n, zpow_add₀ hL, zpow_add₀ hT]
      field_simp
      ring
  have hid : ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, Jpow 0 Y = Y := by
    intro Y
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · rw [c1, zpow_zero, zpow_zero]
      field_simp
      ring
    · rw [c2, zpow_zero, zpow_zero]
      field_simp
      ring
  have hJ : ∀ (m : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), JpowL m Y = Jpow m Y := by
    intro m Y
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · simp only [JpowL, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', Prod.fst_add, Prod.smul_fst,
        smul_eq_mul]
      rw [c1, c1, c1]
      ring
    · simp only [JpowL, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_snd,
        smul_eq_mul]
      rw [c2, c2, c2]
      ring
  have hJinv : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), JpowL (-n) (JpowL n Y) = Y := by
    intro n Y
    rw [hJ, hJ, hcomp, neg_add_cancel, hid]
  
  obtain ⟨S, hSdef⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, S = ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (bandOf q0 + 1),
      (‖JpowL (-(bandIdx h l))‖ + ‖JpowL (bandIdx h l)‖) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ S := by
    rw [hSdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun l _ => by positivity)
  obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = 1 + 1 / q0 + S := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hq0inv : 0 < q0⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hq0
  have hM1 : 1 ≤ M := by rw [hMdef, one_div]; linarith
  have hMq : q0⁻¹ ≤ M := by rw [hMdef, one_div]; linarith
  have hMS : S ≤ M := by rw [hMdef, one_div]; linarith
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by linarith
  refine ⟨M, hM0, ?_⟩
  intro ξ hlo hhi V _ _ f k
  
  have hq : 0 < qC h ξ := lt_of_lt_of_le hq0 hlo
  have hband : bandOf (qC h ξ) ≤ bandOf q0 := by
    unfold bandOf
    apply Nat.ceil_mono
    apply Real.logb_le_logb_of_le one_lt_two (by positivity)
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hq0 hlo
  have hl : bandOf (qC h ξ) - 4 ∈ Finset.range (bandOf q0 + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
  have hsingle := Finset.single_le_sum
    (f := fun l => ‖JpowL (-(bandIdx h l))‖ + ‖JpowL (bandIdx h l)‖) (fun l _ => by positivity) hl
  have hci : coarseIdx h (qC h ξ) = bandIdx h (bandOf (qC h ξ) - 4) := rfl
  have hJm : ‖JpowL (-(coarseIdx h (qC h ξ)))‖ ≤ S := by
    rw [hSdef, hci]
    exact le_trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (norm_nonneg _)) hsingle
  have hJp : ‖JpowL (coarseIdx h (qC h ξ))‖ ≤ S := by
    rw [hSdef, hci]
    exact le_trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left (norm_nonneg _)) hsingle
  
  have hsq0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (qC h ξ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq
  have hsq1 : Real.sqrt (qC h ξ) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← Real.sqrt_one]; exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hhi
  have hqsq : qC h ξ ≤ Real.sqrt (qC h ξ) := by
    have e := Real.mul_self_sqrt hq.le
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq1 hsq0.le
    nlinarith
  have hqe0 : 0 < qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _
  have hqe1 : qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one hq.le hhi (by linarith)
  have hqqe : qC h ξ ≤ qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) := by
    have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq hhi (show 1/2 - h ≤ 1 by linarith)
    rwa [Real.rpow_one] at this
  have hi1 : (Real.sqrt (qC h ξ))⁻¹ ≤ M := le_trans (inv_anti₀ hq0 (le_trans hlo hqsq)) hMq
  have hi2 : (qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h))⁻¹ ≤ M := le_trans (inv_anti₀ hq0 (le_trans hlo hqqe)) hMq
  have hi3 : (qC h ξ)⁻¹ ≤ M := le_trans (inv_anti₀ hq0 hlo) hMq
  
  have hnorm4 : ∀ (a b c : ℝ) (d : ℝ × ℝ) (r : ℝ), ‖a‖ ≤ r → ‖b‖ ≤ r → ‖c‖ ≤ r → ‖d‖ ≤ r →
      ‖((a, b, c, d) : Cyl)‖ ≤ r := by
    intro a b c d r ha hb hc hd
    exact norm_prod_le_iff.mpr ⟨ha, norm_prod_le_iff.mpr ⟨hb, norm_prod_le_iff.mpr ⟨hc, hd⟩⟩⟩
  have hsc : ∀ (c x r : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → c ≤ M → ‖x‖ ≤ r → ‖c * x‖ ≤ M * r := by
    intro c x r hc hcM hx
    rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hc]
    exact mul_le_mul hcM hx (norm_nonneg _) hM0
  have hlin : ∀ (T : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)) (x : ℝ × ℝ) (r : ℝ), ‖T‖ ≤ S → ‖x‖ ≤ r →
      ‖T x‖ ≤ M * r := by
    intro T x r hTS hx
    have hr : 0 ≤ r := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) hx
    calc ‖T x‖ ≤ ‖T‖ * ‖x‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ ≤ S * r := mul_le_mul hTS hx (norm_nonneg _) hS0
      _ ≤ M * r := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hMS hr
  have hu1 : ∀ u : Cyl, ‖u.1‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := fun u => norm_fst_le u
  have hu2 : ∀ u : Cyl, ‖u.2.1‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := fun u => (norm_fst_le u.2).trans (norm_snd_le u)
  have hu3 : ∀ u : Cyl, ‖u.2.2.1‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := fun u =>
    ((norm_fst_le u.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le u.2)).trans (norm_snd_le u)
  have hu4 : ∀ u : Cyl, ‖u.2.2.2‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := fun u =>
    ((norm_snd_le u.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le u.2)).trans (norm_snd_le u)
  
  have hLap : ∀ u : Cyl, Lnorm h ξ u = (Real.sqrt (qC h ξ) * u.1, qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) * u.2.1,
      qC h ξ * u.2.2.1, JpowL (-(coarseIdx h (qC h ξ))) u.2.2.2) := fun u => rfl
  obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl,
      R = ((Real.sqrt (qC h ξ))⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
        (((qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h))⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
          (((qC h ξ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (JpowL (coarseIdx h (qC h ξ))))) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hRap : ∀ u : Cyl, R u = ((Real.sqrt (qC h ξ))⁻¹ * u.1, (qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h))⁻¹ * u.2.1,
      (qC h ξ)⁻¹ * u.2.2.1, JpowL (coarseIdx h (qC h ξ)) u.2.2.2) := by
    intro u; rw [hRdef]; rfl
  have hP : ∀ u : Cyl, ‖Lnorm h ξ u‖ ≤ M * ‖u‖ := by
    intro u
    rw [hLap]
    exact hnorm4 _ _ _ _ _ (hsc _ _ _ hsq0.le (le_trans hsq1 hM1) (hu1 u))
      (hsc _ _ _ hqe0.le (le_trans hqe1 hM1) (hu2 u))
      (hsc _ _ _ hq.le (le_trans hhi hM1) (hu3 u)) (hlin _ _ _ hJm (hu4 u))
  have hR : ∀ u : Cyl, ‖R u‖ ≤ M * ‖u‖ := by
    intro u
    rw [hRap]
    exact hnorm4 _ _ _ _ _ (hsc _ _ _ (inv_nonneg.mpr hsq0.le) hi1 (hu1 u))
      (hsc _ _ _ (inv_nonneg.mpr hqe0.le) hi2 (hu2 u))
      (hsc _ _ _ (inv_nonneg.mpr hq.le) hi3 (hu3 u)) (hlin _ _ _ hJp (hu4 u))
  have hPR : ∀ u : Cyl, Lnorm h ξ (R u) = u := by
    intro u
    obtain ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ := u
    rw [hRap, hLap]
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
    refine ⟨mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hsq0.ne' a, mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hqe0.ne' b,
      mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hq.ne' c, hJinv _ d⟩
  have hPn : ‖Lnorm h ξ‖ ≤ M := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hM0 hP
  have hRn : ‖R‖ ≤ M := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hM0 hR
  
  have gen : ∀ (B : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => Cyl) V) (T : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl),
      ‖T‖ ≤ M → ‖B.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T)‖ ≤ M ^ k * ‖B‖ := by
    intro B T hTM
    have h1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le B (fun _ : Fin k => T)
    rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h1
    calc _ ≤ ‖B‖ * ‖T‖ ^ k := h1
      _ ≤ ‖B‖ * M ^ k :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hTM k) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = M ^ k * ‖B‖ := mul_comm _ _
  unfold NB
  obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A, A = iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hAdef]
  have hA : A = (A.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap
      (fun _ => R) := by
    ext m
    simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, hPR]
  constructor
  · calc ‖A‖ = ‖(A.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => R)‖ := congrArg _ hA
      _ ≤ M ^ k * ‖A.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ := gen _ R hRn
  · exact gen A _ hPn

proof.tactics:
by
  intro Xa Xb aa ab d hXa hab haa hab'
  have hXa0 : Xa ≠ 0 := hXa.ne'
  have hXb0 : 0 < Xb := hXa.trans hab
  
  have core : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-(c / s ^ 2)) * s ^ (-d))
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) := by
    intro c hc
    have ht : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (s⁻¹) ^ 2) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) Filter.atTop :=
      (Filter.tendsto_pow_atTop two_ne_zero).comp tendsto_inv_nhdsGT_zero
    have H := (tendsto_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_atTop_nhds_zero (d / 2) c hc).comp ht
    refine H.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
    have hs' : (0:ℝ) < s := hs
    show ((s⁻¹) ^ 2) ^ (d / 2) * Real.exp (-c * (s⁻¹) ^ 2) = Real.exp (-(c / s ^ 2)) * s ^ (-d)
    have e1 : -c * (s⁻¹) ^ 2 = -(c / s ^ 2) := by rw [inv_pow]; ring
    have e2 : ((s⁻¹) ^ 2) ^ (d / 2) = s ^ (-d) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_two, ← Real.rpow_mul (inv_nonneg.mpr hs'.le),
        show (2:ℝ) * (d / 2) = d by ring, Real.inv_rpow hs'.le, Real.rpow_neg hs'.le]
    rw [e1, e2, mul_comm]
  
  have hI : ∀ X ∈ Set.Ioo Xa Xb, 0 < Real.log (X / Xa) ∧ 0 < Real.log (Xb / X) := fun X hX =>
    ⟨Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX.1), Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div (hXa.trans hX.1)).mpr hX.2)⟩
  have hEW : ∀ X ∈ Set.Ioo Xa Xb, edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X =
      Real.exp (-(aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2) - ab / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2) := by
    intro X hX
    unfold edgeWeight
    rw [if_pos (show Xa < X ∧ X < Xb from hX)]
  have hED : ∀ X ∈ Set.Ioo Xa Xb, 0 < edgeDist Xa Xb X := by
    intro X hX
    unfold edgeDist
    exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (hI X hX).1 (hI X hX).2)
  
  have hL1c : ContinuousOn (fun X => Real.log (X / Xa)) (Set.Ioo Xa Xb) :=
    (continuousOn_id.div_const Xa).log (fun X hX => (div_pos (hXa.trans hX.1) hXa).ne')
  have hL2c : ContinuousOn (fun X => Real.log (Xb / X)) (Set.Ioo Xa Xb) :=
    (continuousOn_const.div continuousOn_id (fun X hX => (hXa.trans hX.1).ne')).log
      (fun X hX => (div_pos hXb0 (hXa.trans hX.1)).ne')
  have hEc : ContinuousOn (fun X => Real.sqrt (Real.exp (-(aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2) -
      ab / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2))) (Set.Ioo Xa Xb) :=
    ((((continuousOn_const.div (hL1c.pow 2) (fun X hX => pow_ne_zero 2 (hI X hX).1.ne')).neg).sub
      (continuousOn_const.div (hL2c.pow 2) (fun X hX => pow_ne_zero 2 (hI X hX).2.ne'))).rexp).sqrt
  have hDm : ContinuousOn (fun X => min 1 (min (Real.log (X / Xa)) (Real.log (Xb / X))))
      (Set.Ioo Xa Xb) :=
    continuous_min.comp_continuousOn
      (continuousOn_const.prodMk (continuous_min.comp_continuousOn (hL1c.prodMk hL2c)))
  have hD : ContinuousOn (fun X => edgeDist Xa Xb X) (Set.Ioo Xa Xb) := hDm
  have hDc : ContinuousOn (fun X => edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-d)) (Set.Ioo Xa Xb) :=
    hD.rpow_const (fun X hX => Or.inl (hED X hX).ne')
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun X => Real.sqrt (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X) * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-d))
      (Set.Ioo Xa Xb) :=
    (hEc.mul hDc).congr (fun X hX => by simp only [hEW X hX, Pi.mul_apply])
  have hpos : 0 < Real.log (Xb / Xa) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hab)
  have hnn : ∀ᶠ X in nhdsWithin Xa (Set.Ioo Xa Xb) ⊔ nhdsWithin Xb (Set.Ioo Xa Xb),
      (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X) * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-d) := by
    have hm : Set.Ioo Xa Xb ∈ nhdsWithin Xa (Set.Ioo Xa Xb) ⊔ nhdsWithin Xb (Set.Ioo Xa Xb) :=
      Filter.mem_sup.mpr ⟨self_mem_nhdsWithin, self_mem_nhdsWithin⟩
    filter_upwards [hm] with X hX
    exact mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (hED X hX).le _)
  refine ⟨hcont, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have hc1 : ContinuousAt (fun X => Real.log (X / Xa)) Xa :=
      (continuousAt_id.div_const Xa).log (by rw [id, div_self hXa0]; exact one_ne_zero)
    have hL1a' : Filter.Tendsto (fun X => Real.log (X / Xa)) (nhds Xa) (nhds (Real.log (Xa / Xa))) :=
      hc1.tendsto
    rw [div_self hXa0, Real.log_one] at hL1a'
    have hL1a := hL1a'.mono_left (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := Set.Ioo Xa Xb))
    have hc2 : ContinuousAt (fun X => Real.log (Xb / X)) Xa :=
      (continuousAt_const.div continuousAt_id hXa0).log (div_pos hXb0 hXa).ne'
    have hL2a' : Filter.Tendsto (fun X => Real.log (Xb / X)) (nhds Xa) (nhds (Real.log (Xb / Xa))) :=
      hc2.tendsto
    have hL2a := hL2a'.mono_left (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := Set.Ioo Xa Xb))
    have hT : Filter.Tendsto (fun X => Real.log (X / Xa)) (nhdsWithin Xa (Set.Ioo Xa Xb))
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) :=
      tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hL1a, eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall (fun X hX => (hI X hX).1)⟩
    have hG := (core (aa / 2) (half_pos haa)).comp hT
    refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds hG
      (hnn.filter_mono le_sup_left) ?_
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, Filter.Tendsto.eventually_lt_const zero_lt_one hL1a,
      hL1a.eventually_lt hL2a hpos] with X hX h1 h2
    have hDX : edgeDist Xa Xb X = Real.log (X / Xa) := by
      unfold edgeDist
      rw [min_eq_left h2.le, min_eq_right h1.le]
    show Real.sqrt (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X) * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-d) ≤
      Real.exp (-((aa / 2) / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2)) * Real.log (X / Xa) ^ (-d)
    rw [hDX, hEW X hX]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Real.rpow_nonneg (hI X hX).1.le _)
    rw [show -((aa / 2) / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2) = (-(aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2)) / 2 by ring,
      Real.exp_half]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have : 0 ≤ ab / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2 := div_nonneg hab'.le (sq_nonneg _)
    linarith
  · 
    have hXb0' : Xb ≠ 0 := hXb0.ne'
    have hc2 : ContinuousAt (fun X => Real.log (Xb / X)) Xb :=
      (continuousAt_const.div continuousAt_id hXb0').log (by simp [hXb0'])
    have hL2b' : Filter.Tendsto (fun X => Real.log (Xb / X)) (nhds Xb) (nhds (Real.log (Xb / Xb))) :=
      hc2.tendsto
    rw [div_self hXb0', Real.log_one] at hL2b'
    have hL2b := hL2b'.mono_left (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := Set.Ioo Xa Xb))
    have hc1 : ContinuousAt (fun X => Real.log (X / Xa)) Xb :=
      (continuousAt_id.div_const Xa).log (div_pos hXb0 hXa).ne'
    have hL1b' : Filter.Tendsto (fun X => Real.log (X / Xa)) (nhds Xb) (nhds (Real.log (Xb / Xa))) :=
      hc1.tendsto
    have hL1b := hL1b'.mono_left (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := Set.Ioo Xa Xb))
    have hT : Filter.Tendsto (fun X => Real.log (Xb / X)) (nhdsWithin Xb (Set.Ioo Xa Xb))
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) :=
      tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hL2b, eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall (fun X hX => (hI X hX).2)⟩
    have hG := (core (ab / 2) (half_pos hab')).comp hT
    refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds hG
      (hnn.filter_mono le_sup_right) ?_
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, Filter.Tendsto.eventually_lt_const zero_lt_one hL2b,
      hL2b.eventually_lt hL1b hpos] with X hX h1 h2
    have hDX : edgeDist Xa Xb X = Real.log (Xb / X) := by
      unfold edgeDist
      rw [min_eq_right h2.le, min_eq_right h1.le]
    show Real.sqrt (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X) * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-d) ≤
      Real.exp (-((ab / 2) / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2)) * Real.log (Xb / X) ^ (-d)
    rw [hDX, hEW X hX]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Real.rpow_nonneg (hI X hX).2.le _)
    rw [show -((ab / 2) / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2) = (-(ab / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2)) / 2 by ring,
      Real.exp_half]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have : 0 ≤ aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2 := div_nonneg haa.le (sq_nonneg _)
    linarith

  have hED : ∀ X : ℝ, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb → 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X := by

  have hxNn : DomC B.h B.qB ∈ nhds x := hNo.mem_nhds hxN
  
  obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : Cyl → ℝ, A = fun η => Real.sqrt (max (yAmp4 B G γ η) 0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩

    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds x0 one_pos] with x hx
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] at hx
    exact hloc x0 x hx
  have hSigpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < ∑' n : ℤ, bumpR (x - n) ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    have hsum : Summable (fun n : ℤ => bumpR (x - n) ^ 2) :=
      summable_of_ne_finset_zero (s := Finset.Icc (⌊x⌋ - 1) (⌊x⌋ + 2))
        (fun n hn => hwin x x (by simp) n hn)
    have hr : |x - (round x : ℝ)| < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_sub_round x) (by norm_num)
    have hp : 0 < bumpR (x - round x) ^ 2 := pow_pos (hb4 _ hr) 2
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hp (hsum.le_tsum (round x) (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _))
  have hsqrtC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => Real.sqrt (∑' n : ℤ, bumpR (x - n) ^ 2)) :=
    hSigC.sqrt (fun x => (hSigpos x).ne')
  have hsqne : ∀ x : ℝ, Real.sqrt (∑' n : ℤ, bumpR (x - n) ^ 2) ≠ 0 := fun x =>
    (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hSigpos x)).ne'
  have hψC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => bumpR x / Real.sqrt (∑' n : ℤ, bumpR (x - n) ^ 2)) :=
    hb1.div hsqrtC hsqne
  
  have hid : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (s : ℝ), sqPart μ j s =
      (fun x : ℝ => bumpR x / Real.sqrt (∑' n : ℤ, bumpR (x - n) ^ 2)) (s / μ - j) := by
    intro μ j s
    have key : ∑' n : ℤ, bumpR (s / μ - n) ^ 2 = ∑' n : ℤ, bumpR (s / μ - j - n) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← (Equiv.addLeft j).tsum_eq (fun m : ℤ => bumpR (s / μ - m) ^ 2)]
      apply tsum_congr
      intro c
      simp only [Equiv.coe_addLeft, Int.cast_add, sub_add_eq_sub_sub]
    show bumpR (s / μ - j) / Real.sqrt (∑' n : ℤ, bumpR (s / μ - n) ^ 2) =
      bumpR (s / μ - j) / Real.sqrt (∑' n : ℤ, bumpR (s / μ - j - n) ^ 2)
    rw [key]
  
  have hsupp : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ |x| →
      (fun x : ℝ => bumpR x / Real.sqrt (∑' n : ℤ, bumpR (x - n) ^ 2)) x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    show bumpR x / Real.sqrt (∑' n : ℤ, bumpR (x - n) ^ 2) = 0
    rw [hb2 x hx, zero_div]
  
  have hgen : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → (∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ |x| → φ x = 0) →
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n φ x‖ ≤ K) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ |x| → ∀ n : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n φ x = 0) := by
    intro φ hφ hzero
    have hcont : ∀ n : ℕ, Continuous (fun x => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n φ x) := fun n =>
      hφ.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hcs : HasCompactSupport φ := by
      apply HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_Icc (a := (-1:ℝ)) (b := 1))
      intro x hx
      apply hzero
      rw [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at hx
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith
      · rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith
    refine ⟨fun n => ?_, fun x hx n => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := (hcont n).bounded_above_of_compact_support (hcs.iteratedFDeriv n)
      exact ⟨K, hK⟩
    · have hopen : ∀ y : ℝ, 1 < |y| → iteratedFDeriv ℝ n φ y = 0 := by
        intro y hy
        have hO : IsOpen {z : ℝ | 1 < |z|} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_abs
        have hev : φ =ᶠ[nhds y] fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hy) (fun z (hz : 1 < |z|) => hzero z hz.le)
        have e := (hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ n).eq_of_nhds
        rw [e, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
        try rfl
      have hZ : IsClosed {y : ℝ | iteratedFDeriv ℝ n φ y = 0} :=
        isClosed_eq (hcont n) continuous_const
      have ht : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (1 + 1 / ((m:ℝ) + 1)) * x) Filter.atTop (nhds x) := by
        have h1 := (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat).const_add (1:ℝ)
        have h2 := h1.mul_const x
        rw [add_zero, one_mul] at h2
        exact h2
      refine hZ.mem_of_tendsto ht (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun m => ?_)
      have hm : (0:ℝ) < 1 / ((m:ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
      refine hopen _ ?_
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 1 + 1 / ((m:ℝ)+1))]
      nlinarith [mul_pos hm (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < |x|)]
  obtain ⟨hK, hF⟩ := hgen _ hψC hsupp
  refine ⟨fun x => bumpR x / Real.sqrt (∑' n : ℤ, bumpR (x - n) ^ 2), hψC, hid, hsupp, hK, ?_⟩
  intro x hx n
  apply hF x _ n
  by_contra hlt
  push_neg at hlt
  have hp : 0 < bumpR x / Real.sqrt (∑' n : ℤ, bumpR (x - n) ^ 2) :=
    div_pos (hb4 x hlt) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hSigpos x))
  exact hp.ne' hx

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (U : Set Cyl), IsOpen U → ∀ ξ ∈ U, (∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (a : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U → (∀ n : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n ψ (a ξ) = 0) → ∀ n : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun η => ψ (a η)) ξ = 0) ∧ (∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → (∀ n : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f ξ = 0) → ∀ n : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun η => f η * g η) ξ = 0 ∧ iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun η => g η * f η) ξ = 0)

signature.name: flat_jet_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (U : Set Cyl), IsOpen U → ∀ ξ ∈ U, (∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (a : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U → (∀ n : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n ψ (a ξ) = 0) → ∀ n : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun η => ψ (a η)) ξ = 0) ∧ (∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → (∀ n : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f ξ = 0) → ∀ n : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun η => f η * g η) ξ = 0 ∧ iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun η => g η * f η) ξ = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro U hU ξ hξ
  have hUD : UniqueDiffOn ℝ U := hU.uniqueDiffOn
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ψ a hψ ha hflat n
    have hle : (n : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
    set D : ℝ := 1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j a U ξ‖ with hD
    have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by
      have : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j a U ξ‖ :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _)
      linarith
    have hbound := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le (g := ψ) (f := a) (t := Set.univ) (s := U)
      (x := ξ) (n := n) hψ.contDiffOn ha hle uniqueDiffOn_univ hUD (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _) hξ
      (C := 0) (D := D)
      (fun i _ => by rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_univ, hflat i, norm_zero])
      (fun i hi1 hin => by
        have h1 : ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i a U ξ‖ ≤
            ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j a U ξ‖ :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j a U ξ‖)
            (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
        have h2 : D ≤ D ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
        linarith)
    rw [mul_zero, zero_mul] at hbound
    have h0 : iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ n (ψ ∘ a) U ξ = 0 := norm_le_zero_iff.mp hbound
    rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hU hξ]
    exact h0
  · intro f g hf hg hflat n
    have hle : (n : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
    have key : ∀ i : ℕ, iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i f U ξ = 0 := fun i => by
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hU hξ]; exact hflat i
    have hfg : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun η => f η * g η) ξ = 0 := by
      have hb := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hf hg hUD hξ hle
      simp only [key, norm_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero] at hb
      rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hU hξ]
      exact norm_le_zero_iff.mp hb
    refine ⟨hfg, ?_⟩
    have e : (fun η => g η * f η) = (fun η => f η * g η) := funext fun η => mul_comm _ _
    rw [e]
    exact hfg

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (a b : Cyl → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (A E : ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ a ξ → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ b ξ → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h a i ξ ≤ A) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h b i ξ ≤ E) → NB h (fun η => a η * b η) k ξ ≤ 2 ^ k * A * E

signature.name: nb_real_mul_le_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (a b : Cyl → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (A E : ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ a ξ → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ b ξ → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h a i ξ ≤ A) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h b i ξ ≤ E) → NB h (fun η => a η * b η) k ξ ≤ 2 ^ k * A * E

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h ξ a b k A E ha hb hA hE
  have hNBnn : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V) (i : ℕ),
      0 ≤ NB h f i ξ := fun f i => norm_nonneg _
  
  have leib : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (U : Set Cyl) (n : ℕ),
      IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (g : Cyl → V), ContDiffOn ℝ n f U → ContDiffOn ℝ n g U →
      NB h (fun η => f η • g η) n ξ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h g (n - i) ξ := by
    intro V _ _ U n hU hξ f g hf hg
    unfold NB
    generalize Lnorm h ξ = L
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage L.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
    have hL0s : L 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
    have hsm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have hsmO : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact (hsm F hF).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
    have key : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n →
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0 =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF i hi
      have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O
      have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
        hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
      have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + z)) i hs h0s
      have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i ξ 0
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0
          = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑L) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := e2
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [map_zero]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [e3]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
    have hfg : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun η => f η • g η) U := hf.smul hg
    have hl := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_smul_le (hsmO f hf) (hsmO g hg) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O
      (n := n) le_rfl
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => f (ξ + L y) • g (ξ + L y)) n hO h0O] at hl
    rw [← key _ hfg n le_rfl]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => (fun η => f η • g η) (ξ + L z)) 0‖
        = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f (ξ + L y) • g (ξ + L y)) 0‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ _ := hl
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        have hik : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O,
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => g (ξ + L z)) (n - i) hO h0O,
          key f hf i hik, key g hg (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i)]
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := le_trans (hNBnn a 0) (hA 0 (Nat.zero_le k))
  have hE0 : 0 ≤ E := le_trans (hNBnn b 0) (hE 0 (Nat.zero_le k))
  
  have ha' : ContDiffAt ℝ k a ξ := ha.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hb' : ContDiffAt ℝ k b ξ := hb.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  obtain ⟨ua, hua, hau⟩ := ha'.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
  obtain ⟨ub, hub, hbu⟩ := hb'.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
  obtain ⟨O, hOsub, hOopen, hξO⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp (Filter.inter_mem hua hub)
  have haO : ContDiffOn ℝ k a O := hau.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).1)
  have hbO : ContDiffOn ℝ k b O := hbu.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).2)
  have l1 := leib O k hOopen hξO a b haO hbO
  have l1' : NB h (fun η => a η * b η) k ξ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
      (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB h a i ξ * NB h b (k - i) ξ := l1
  refine le_trans l1' ?_
  calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB h a i ξ * NB h b (k - i) ξ
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * A * E := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hA i hik) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
          (hE _ (Nat.sub_le k i)) (hNBnn _ _) (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hA0)
    _ = A * E * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; ring
    _ = 2 ^ k * A * E := by
        have hs : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) = 2 ^ k := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose k
        rw [hs]; ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (lam : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ) (d : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (n : ℕ) (K c : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → (∀ x : ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n ψ x‖ ≤ K) → 0 ≤ c → (∀ w : Cyl, |lam (Lnorm h ξ w)| ≤ c * ‖w‖) → NB h (fun η : Cyl => ψ (lam η + d)) n ξ ≤ K * c ^ n

signature.name: nb_comp_affine_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (lam : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ) (d : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (n : ℕ) (K c : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → (∀ x : ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n ψ x‖ ≤ K) → 0 ≤ c → (∀ w : Cyl, |lam (Lnorm h ξ w)| ≤ c * ‖w‖) → NB h (fun η : Cyl => ψ (lam η + d)) n ξ ≤ K * c ^ n

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h ψ lam d ξ n K c hψ hK hc hlam
  have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ => ψ (y + d)) := hψ.comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)
  have hfun : (fun η : Cyl => ψ (lam η + d)) = (fun y : ℝ => ψ (y + d)) ∘ ⇑lam := rfl
  have h2 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun η : Cyl => ψ (lam η + d)) ξ =
      (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y : ℝ => ψ (y + d)) (lam ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => lam) := by
    rw [hfun]
    exact lam.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right hg ξ (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have h3 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y : ℝ => ψ (y + d)) (lam ξ) =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ n ψ (lam ξ + d) := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right n d (lam ξ)
  set M := iteratedFDeriv ℝ n ψ (lam ξ + d) with hM
  set T : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ := lam.comp (Lnorm h ξ) with hT
  have e : (M.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => lam)).compContinuousLinearMap
      (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) = M.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    ext v
    rfl
  have h4 : NB h (fun η : Cyl => ψ (lam η + d)) n ξ =
      ‖M.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T)‖ := by
    unfold NB
    rw [h2, h3, e]
  have h5 : ‖M.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T)‖ ≤ ‖M‖ * ∏ _i : Fin n, ‖T‖ :=
    ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _
  have h6 : ‖T‖ ≤ c := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hc (fun w => ?_)
    rw [hT, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hlam w
  have hprod : ∏ _i : Fin n, ‖T‖ = ‖T‖ ^ n := by
    rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hpow : ‖T‖ ^ n ≤ c ^ n := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h6 n
  have hMK : ‖M‖ ≤ K := hK _
  rw [h4]
  refine h5.trans ?_
  rw [hprod]
  exact mul_le_mul hMK hpow (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) n) ((norm_nonneg _).trans hMK)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n ψ x‖ ≤ K) → ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ (c : ℝ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => ψ (Real.logb 2 (qC B.h η) + c)) n ξ ≤ M

signature.name: logq_factor_nb_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n ψ x‖ ≤ K) → ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ (c : ℝ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => ψ (Real.logb 2 (qC B.h η) + c)) n ξ ≤ M

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hok ψ hψ hK n
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB1, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  
  have simN : ∀ h : ℝ, SimScaleProps h → SimNorm h := by
    intro h hS
    obtain ⟨hS1, -, -, -, hS5⟩ := hS
    open Pointwise in
    have hom : ∀ μ z τ : ℝ, 0 < μ →
        simScale h (μ ^ (1/2 - h) * z) (μ * τ) = μ * simScale h z τ := by
      intro μ z τ hμ
      have key : ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p → μ * p - (μ ^ (1/2 - h) * z) ^ 2 * (μ * p) ^ (2 * h) =
          μ * (p - z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h)) := by

        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Mq)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Pm) := by
      ext m; rfl
    have hCi : ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Mq)‖ ≤ C i * qC B.h ξ := by
      rw [hMqdef, hw0def]; exact hC i ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith) hq1
    have hprod : ∏ k : Fin i, ‖Pm‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hP1
    have hb1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Mq)) (fun _ : Fin i => Pm)
    have hb2 := hb1.trans ((mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) hprod).trans hCi)
    have hCiD : C i ≤ D := by
      have h2 : |C i| ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |C k| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => |C k|) (fun k _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hij))
      have h3 := le_abs_self (C i)
      rw [hDdef]; linarith
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO h0O, hReq,
      iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply (hΦ.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)),
      key (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) w0 T hW hS.2.2.2.1 hw0 i,
      norm_smul, hTdef, hcomp, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le)]
    calc (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * ‖((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Mq)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Pm)‖
        ≤ (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * (C i * qC B.h ξ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb2 (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le)
      _ = C i := by rw [mul_comm (C i), ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0.ne', one_mul]
      _ ≤ D := hCiD
      _ ≤ D ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
  
  have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => ψ (Real.logb 2 x + (Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ) + c)))
      (Set.Ioi 0) := hψ.comp_contDiffOn (hlog.add contDiffOn_const)
  have hRmaps : Set.MapsTo R O (Set.Ioi 0) := fun v hv => hRpos v hv
  have hEq : Set.EqOn (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z))
      ((fun x : ℝ => ψ (Real.logb 2 x + (Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ) + c))) ∘ R) O := by
    intro z hz
    have hRz := hRpos z hz
    have e : qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z) = qC B.h ξ * R z := by
      rw [hRdef]
      show _ = qC B.h ξ * (qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z) / qC B.h ξ)
      field_simp
    show F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z) = ψ (Real.logb 2 (R z) + (Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ) + c))
    rw [hFdef]
    show ψ (Real.logb 2 (qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) + c) =
      ψ (Real.logb 2 (R z) + (Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ) + c))
    rw [e, Real.logb_mul hq0.ne' hRz.ne']
    congr 1
    ring
  
  have hCg : ∀ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i
      (fun x : ℝ => ψ (Real.logb 2 x + (Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ) + c))) (Set.Ioi 0) (R 0)‖ ≤
        (n.factorial : ℝ) * Kb * D0 ^ n := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hR0]
    exact hGb _ i hi
  have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hg hR (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn hO.uniqueDiffOn hRmaps h0O
    (C := (n.factorial : ℝ) * Kb * D0 ^ n) (D := D) hCg hDR
  have hNB : NB B.h F n ξ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) 0‖ := by
    unfold NB
    rw [key F {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hU hFU hξ n]
  calc NB B.h F n ξ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) 0‖ := hNB
    _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) O 0‖ := by
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hO h0O]
    _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ n
          ((fun x : ℝ => ψ (Real.logb 2 x + (Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ) + c))) ∘ R) O 0‖ := by
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_congr hEq h0O n]
    _ ≤ _ := hFdB

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∀ (qs : ℝ), qs ≤ 1 → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => Real.sqrt (qC B.h η)) ξ ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => B.h * qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun η' => Real.log (qC B.h η')) η) ξ) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, NB B.h (fun η => Real.sqrt (qC B.h η)) k ξ ≤ C * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) ∧ NB B.h (fun η => B.h * qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun η' => Real.log (qC B.h η')) η) k ξ ≤ C

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∀ (qs : ℝ), qs ≤ 1 → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => Real.sqrt (qC B.h η)) ξ ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => B.h * qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun η' => Real.log (qC B.h η')) η) ξ) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, NB B.h (fun η => Real.sqrt (qC B.h η)) k ξ ≤ C * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) ∧ NB B.h (fun η => B.h * qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun η' => Real.log (qC B.h η')) η) k ξ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hok qs hqs
  have hh0 : 0 < B.h := hok.2.1.1
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  
  have hSNgen : ∀ h : ℝ, SimScaleProps h → SimNorm h := by
    intro h hS
    obtain ⟨hS1, -, -, -, hS5⟩ := hS
    open Pointwise in
    have hom : ∀ μ z τ : ℝ, 0 < μ →
        simScale h (μ ^ (1/2 - h) * z) (μ * τ) = μ * simScale h z τ := by
      intro μ z τ hμ
      have key : ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p → μ * p - (μ ^ (1/2 - h) * z) ^ 2 * (μ * p) ^ (2 * h) =
          μ * (p - z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h)) := by
        intro p hp
        have sq : (μ ^ (1/2 - h)) ^ 2 = μ ^ (1 - 2 * h) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hμ.le]
          congr 1
          push_cast
          ring
        have split : μ ^ (1 - 2 * h) * μ ^ (2 * h) = μ := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hμ]
          have e : 1 - 2 * h + 2 * h = 1 := by ring
          rw [e, Real.rpow_one]
        rw [mul_pow, sq, Real.mul_rpow hμ.le hp.le]
        linear_combination (-(z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h))) * split
      have hset : {q : ℝ | 0 < q ∧ μ * τ ≤ q - (μ ^ (1/2 - h) * z) ^ 2 * q ^ (2 * h)} =
          μ • {p : ℝ | 0 < p ∧ τ ≤ p - z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h)} := by
        ext q
        rw [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem₀ hμ.ne', smul_eq_mul]
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
        have hq : q = μ * (μ⁻¹ * q) := by field_simp
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hq0, hle⟩
          have hp : 0 < μ⁻¹ * q := mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hμ) hq0
          refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
          rw [hq, key _ hp] at hle
          exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hle hμ
        · rintro ⟨hp, hle⟩
          refine ⟨by rw [hq]; exact mul_pos hμ hp, ?_⟩
          rw [hq, key _ hp]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle hμ.le
      unfold simScale
      rw [hset, Real.sInf_smul_of_nonneg hμ.le, smul_eq_mul]
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z T : ℝ, 0 < T → simScale h Z T = 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (Z, T)‖ ≤ C := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk | hk
      · subst hk
        refine ⟨1, fun Z T _ h1 => ?_⟩
        rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]
        show ‖simScale h Z T‖ ≤ 1
        rw [h1, norm_one]
      · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hS5 k hk
        refine ⟨C, fun Z T hT h1 => ?_⟩
        have := hC Z T hT h1.le
        rwa [h1, Real.one_rpow, mul_one] at this
    refine ⟨C, fun z τ hτ _ => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hQ0, -⟩ := hS1 z τ hτ
    obtain ⟨Q, hQd⟩ : ∃ Q, Q = simScale h z τ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hQd] at hQ0 ⊢
    obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ : ∃ Z : ℝ, Z = Q ^ (-(1/2 - h)) * z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ, T = Q⁻¹ * τ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hT0 : 0 < T := by rw [hT]; exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hQ0) hτ
    have hZT : simScale h Z T = 1 := by
      have := hom Q⁻¹ z τ (inv_pos.mpr hQ0)
      rw [Real.inv_rpow hQ0.le, ← Real.rpow_neg hQ0.le, ← hQd, inv_mul_cancel₀ hQ0.ne'] at this
      rw [hZ, hT]
      exact this
    have hzb : Q ^ (1/2 - h) * Z = z := by
      rw [hZ, ← mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hQ0]
      simp
    have hτb : Q * T = τ := by
      rw [hT]
      exact mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hQ0.ne' τ
    have hpa : 0 < Q ^ (1/2 - h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ0 _
    let e₁ : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 (Q ^ (1/2 - h)) hpa.ne')
    let e₂ : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 Q hQ0.ne')
    let L : (ℝ × ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) := e₁.prodCongr e₂
    let M : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 Q hQ0.ne')
    have hL : ∀ x : ℝ × ℝ, L x = (Q ^ (1/2 - h) * x.1, Q * x.2) := by
      intro x
      simp [L, e₁, e₂, mul_comm]
    have hM : ∀ y : ℝ, M y = Q * y := by
      intro y
      simp [M, mul_comm]
    have hfun : (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘ L =
        M ∘ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) := by
      funext w
      simp only [Function.comp, hL, hM]
      exact hom Q w.1 w.2 hQ0
    have hLclm : (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)) =
        (Q ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (Q • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro x
      apply Prod.ext
      · simp [hL]
      · simp [hL]
    have hLv : L (Z, T) = (z, τ) := by
      rw [hL]
      exact Prod.ext hzb hτb
    have hcomp : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘ L) (Z, T) =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (L (Z, T))).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ))) := by
      have := L.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2)
        uniqueDiffOn_univ (mem_univ (L (Z, T))) k
      rwa [preimage_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ] at this
    have key : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (z, τ)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ))) =
        (M : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (Z, T)) := by
      rw [← hLv, ← hcomp, hfun, M.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left]
    have hMn : ‖(M : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ ≤ Q := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hQ0.le fun y => ?_
      show ‖M y‖ ≤ Q * ‖y‖
      rw [hM, norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs Q, abs_of_pos hQ0]
    rw [← hLclm, key]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(M : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ *
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (Z, T)‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
      _ ≤ Q * C := mul_le_mul hMn (hC Z T hT0 hZT) (norm_nonneg _) hQ0.le
      _ = C * Q := mul_comm _ _
  have hSN : SimNorm B.h := hSNgen B.h hS
  
  have hqpow : ∀ (B : BG) (qs c : ℝ), B.ok → SimNorm B.h → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ,
      ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ c := by
    intro B qs c hB hN hqs0 hqs1 j
    have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hB.1
    unfold SimNorm at hN
    choose C hC using hN
    have key : ∀ {E G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup G]
        [NormedSpace ℝ G] (F : E → G) (V : Set E) (a : E) (T : Cyl →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen V →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → a ∈ V → ∀ i : ℕ,
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
      intro E G _ _ _ _ F V a T hV hF ha i
      obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set E, s = (fun z : E => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hs : IsOpen s := by
        rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
      have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
      have h0s : (0 : E) ∈ s := by
        rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
      have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
      have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
      have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (a + z)) s :=
        hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
          (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
      have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O
      have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
        hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s
      have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
          = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => T) := e2
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
    obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ,
        A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |Polynomial.eval c (descPochhammer ℝ i)| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by rw [hAdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
    obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |C i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by
      have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k (_ : k ∈ Finset.range (j + 1)) => abs_nonneg (C k))
      rw [hDdef]; linarith
    refine ⟨(j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j, ?_⟩
    intro ξ hξD
    have hξD' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qs := hξD
    have hξ : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξD'.2.1
    have hq1 : qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 := le_trans hξD'.2.2.le hqs1
    have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) :=
        hS.2.2.2.1
      have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
        (contDiff_snd.fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
      exact h1.comp h2.contDiffOn (fun η (hη : η.2.2.1 < 1) =>
        ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith)⟩)
    have hqpos : ∀ η : Cyl, η.2.2.1 < 1 → 0 < qC B.h η := fun η h =>
      (hS.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
    have hU : IsOpen {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd.snd.fst continuous_const
    obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : Cyl → ℝ, F = fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, hadef⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = qC B.h ξ ^ c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    suffices hmain : NB B.h F j ξ ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j * a by
      rw [hFdef, hadef] at hmain; exact hmain
    have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by rw [hadef]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
    have hFU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
      rw [hFdef]
      exact hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos η hη).ne')
    obtain ⟨Pm, hPmdef⟩ : ∃ Pm : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
        Pm = ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))).prod
          (-((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
            (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hPapp : ∀ η : Cyl, Pm η = (η.2.1, -η.2.2.1) := by
      intro η; rw [hPmdef]; simp
    have hP1 : ‖Pm‖ ≤ 1 := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun η => ?_)
      rw [hPapp η, one_mul, Prod.norm_def (η.2.1, -η.2.2.1)]
      refine max_le ?_ ?_
      · exact (norm_fst_le η.2).trans (norm_snd_le η)
      · exact (norm_neg η.2.2.1).trans_le
          (((norm_fst_le η.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le η.2)).trans (norm_snd_le η))
    obtain ⟨Mq, hMqdef⟩ : ∃ Mq : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
        Mq = (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
          (qC B.h ξ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ, T = Mq.comp Pm := ⟨_, rfl⟩

          NB B.h (fun η => g (dZ (fun ζ => qC B.h ζ ^ (1/2:ℝ)) η)) k ξ := by
        unfold NB
        rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
      have hA := hshift (fun ζ => qC B.h ζ ^ (1/2:ℝ)) ξ k hq (hsU.contDiffAt hn)
      have hB := hC2 ξ hξ1
      have hgN := norm_nonneg g
      have hap : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
      have hqh : qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) * qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) = qC B.h ξ ^ B.h := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]; congr 1; ring
      have hqh1 : qC B.h ξ ^ B.h ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one hq.le hq1 hh0.le
      have hqh0 : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ B.h := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
      rw [hNBeq]
      calc NB B.h (fun η => g (dZ (fun ζ => qC B.h ζ ^ (1/2:ℝ)) η)) k ξ
          ≤ ‖g‖ * NB B.h (dZ (fun ζ => qC B.h ζ ^ (1/2:ℝ))) k ξ :=
            hNBc g _ ξ k ((hdZU _ hsU).contDiffAt hn)
        _ ≤ ‖g‖ * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) * (C2 * qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hA.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB hap)) hgN
        _ = ‖g‖ * C2 * qC B.h ξ ^ B.h := by rw [← hqh]; ring
        _ ≤ ‖g‖ * |C2| * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_abs_self C2) hgN) hqh1 hqh0
              (mul_nonneg hgN (abs_nonneg _))
        _ ≤ max |C1| (‖g‖ * |C2|) := by rw [mul_one]; exact le_max_right _ _
