proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n0, fun l0 hl0 hAw hpw Y₀ => ?_⟩
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hl0) hn0.le
  obtain ⟨hΩo, hΨ, hQs, -, heR, heTh⟩ := corr_domain_v5 B l0 Y₀ hok
  set Ω : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ) := {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} with hΩdef
  set Ψ : ℝ³ × ℝ → Cyl := fun w => ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + Y₀) with hΨdef
  have hSP : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  have hBP := hok.2
  unfold BackgroundProps at hBP
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, ⟨hABs, hBvBs, -⟩, -⟩ := hBP
  have hΩmem : ∀ w ∈ Ω, corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2 := fun w hw => hw
  have hΩsub : Ω ⊆ simDomain B.h B.qB := fun w hw =>
    ⟨(hΩmem w hw).2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le (hΩmem w hw).2.2 hqsB⟩
  have hΨmaps : MapsTo Ψ Ω (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := fun w hw => hw
  have hQpos : ∀ w ∈ Ω, 0 < simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) := fun w hw =>
    (hSP.1 (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) (by linarith [(hΩmem w hw).2.1])).1
  have hQΩ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) Ω :=
    hQs.mono (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).2.1)
  have hQp : ∀ p : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ p) Ω :=
    fun p => hQΩ.rpow_const_of_ne (fun w hw => (hQpos w hw).ne')
  have heRΩ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => eR w.1) Ω :=
    heR.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).1)
  have heThΩ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => eTh w.1) Ω :=
    heTh.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).1)
  have hbase : ∀ (l : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => baseC B l ξ i) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro l i
    have h1 := (geom_slow_base_smooth_v5 B hok).2 l i
    have hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      contDiff_fst.prodMk ((contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_snd).prodMk
        (contDiff_fst.comp (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd)))
    have hmaps : MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h3 : qC B.h ξ < B.qB := lt_of_lt_of_le hξ.2.2 hqsB
      exact ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, h3⟩
    have hcomp := h1.comp hp.contDiffOn hmaps
    refine hcomp.congr (fun ξ _ => ?_)
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, baseC]
  have hwave : ∀ a : WS, (∃ H : Finset ℤ, ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → a γ m = 0) →
      (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (a γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) →
      (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => waveS5 B G a (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w)) Ω := by
    intro a hHa ha hsupp
    obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ := hHa
    have hfac : ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, waveS5 B G a (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) =
        (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, a γ m (Ψ w) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) *
          ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ (Ψ w) : ℂ))) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ))).re := by
      intro w
      unfold waveS5
      congr 1
      refine finsum_congr (fun γ => finsum_congr (fun m => ?_))
      unfold ephase5
      have key : Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((pint5 B G γ : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ) +
          (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ (Ψ w) : ℂ)) =
          Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ (Ψ w) : ℂ)) +
          Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ) := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [key, Complex.exp_add]
      ring
    refine (wave_sum_assembly Ω (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) Ψ
      (fun γ m ξ => a γ m ξ * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))
      (fun γ m => m * pint5 B G γ) H hΩo (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).1) hΨ hΨmaps ?_ ?_
      (fun γ m => wave_coef_phase_smooth_v5 B G (qsOf l0) a hG hbase ha hsupp γ m)).congr
      (fun w _ => hfac w)
    · intro γ m hm ξ _
      simp [hH γ m hm]
    · intro ξ₀ hξ₀
      obtain ⟨U, hU, hξU, T, hT⟩ := etaL_locfin B.h (qsOf l0) hSP ξ₀ hξ₀
      refine ⟨U, hU, hξU, T, fun γ hγ m ξ hξ => ?_⟩
      by_contra hne
      have ha0 : a γ m ξ ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hne (by simp [h0])
      exact hT γ hγ ξ hξ.1 (hsupp γ m ξ hξ.2 ha0).2.1
  obtain ⟨HA, -, hHA⟩ := hAw.1
  have hW : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => waveS5 B G (fun γ m ξ => (primState5 B G).Aw γ m ξ i) (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w)) Ω := by
    intro i
    refine hwave (fun γ m ξ => (primState5 B G).Aw γ m ξ i) ⟨HA, fun γ m hm => ?_⟩
      (fun γ m => contDiffOn_pi.mp (hAw.2.1 γ m) i) (fun γ m ξ hξ hne => ?_)
    · funext ξ
      simp [hHA γ m hm]
    · exact hAw.2.2.2.1 γ m ξ hξ (fun h0 => hne (by simp [h0]))
  obtain ⟨HP, -, hHP⟩ := hpw.1
  have hWp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => waveS5 B G (primState5 B G).pw (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w)) Ω :=
    hwave (primState5 B G).pw ⟨HP, hHP⟩ hpw.2.1 hpw.2.2.2.1
  
  have hAeq : ∀ w ∈ Ω, (↿(evOff B.h (pwrA5 B G l0) Y₀)) w =
      simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h) •
        (waveS5 B G (fun γ m ξ => (primState5 B G).Aw γ m ξ 0) (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) • eR w.1 +
         waveS5 B G (fun γ m ξ => (primState5 B G).Aw γ m ξ 1) (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) • eTh w.1 +
         waveS5 B G (fun γ m ξ => (primState5 B G).Aw γ m ξ 2) (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) • eZ) := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' : corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2 := hw
    show pwrA5 B G l0 w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + Y₀) = _
    unfold pwrA5
    rw [if_pos hw']
    rfl
  have hAsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (pwrA5 B G l0) Y₀)) Ω :=
    ContDiffOn.congr ((hQp (1/2 - Aex B.h)).smul
      ((((hW 0).smul heRΩ).add ((hW 1).smul heThΩ)).add ((hW 2).smul (contDiffOn_const (c := eZ))))) hAeq
  
  have hWeq : evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) Y₀ = fun y s =>
      curl3 (fun w => evOff B.h (pwrA5 B G l0) Y₀ w s) y + (fun (_ : ℝ³) (_ : ℝ) => (0:ℝ³)) y s := by
    funext y s
    simp only [evOff, pwrW5, curlX, add_sub_cancel_left, add_zero]
  have h0sm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun (_ : ℝ³) (_ : ℝ) => (0:ℝ³))) Ω :=
    (contDiffOn_const (c := (0:ℝ³))).congr (fun _ _ => rfl)
  have hWsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) Y₀)) Ω := by
    rw [hWeq]
    exact (curl_field_contDiffOn_bounded _ _ Ω Ω hΩo subset_rfl hAsm h0sm).1
  
  have hPeq : ∀ w ∈ Ω, (↿(evOff B.h (pwrP5 B G l0) Y₀)) w =
      simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-2 * Aex B.h) *
        waveS5 B G (primState5 B G).pw (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' : corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2 := hw
    show pwrP5 B G l0 w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + Y₀) = _
    unfold pwrP5
    rw [if_pos hw']
    rfl
  have hPsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (pwrP5 B G l0) Y₀)) Ω :=
    ContDiffOn.congr ((hQp (-2 * Aex B.h)).mul hWp) hPeq
  
  have huB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(uB B)) Ω :=
    (curl_field_contDiffOn_bounded B.AB B.BvB Ω Ω hΩo subset_rfl (hABs.mono hΩsub) (hBvBs.mono hΩsub)).1
  
  have hslice : ∀ (u v : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (t : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿v) Ω →
      ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun y' => v y' t) y (u y t)) {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t} := by
    intro u v t hu hv
    have hι : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => (y, t)) := contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const
    have hOt : IsOpen {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t} := hΩo.preimage hι.continuous
    have hmaps : MapsTo (fun y : ℝ³ => (y, t)) {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t} Ω := fun y hy => hy
    have hv' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y' => v y' t) {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t} := by
      have := hv.comp hι.contDiffOn hmaps
      exact this
    have hu' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y' => u y' t) {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t} := by
      have := hu.comp hι.contDiffOn hmaps
      exact this
    exact (hv'.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hOt (by norm_num)).clm_apply hu'.continuousOn
  have hns := (nsResidual_contDiffOn_eq_jet 1 (evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) Y₀) (evOff B.h (pwrP5 B G l0) Y₀)
    Ω hΩo hWsm hPsm).1
  have hRc : ∀ t : ℝ, ContinuousOn
      (fun y => nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) Y₀) (evOff B.h (pwrP5 B G l0) Y₀) y t)
      {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t} := by
    intro t
    have hι : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => (y, t)) := contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const
    have hmaps : MapsTo (fun y : ℝ³ => (y, t)) {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t} Ω := fun y hy => hy
    have := hns.continuousOn.comp hι.continuous.continuousOn hmaps
    exact this
  refine ⟨hAsm, hWsm, hPsm, fun t => ?_, fun t => ?_⟩
  · have hL : ContinuousOn (fun y =>
        nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) Y₀) (evOff B.h (pwrP5 B G l0) Y₀) y t
          - fderiv ℝ (fun y' => evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) Y₀ y' t) y (evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) Y₀ y t)
          + fderiv ℝ (fun y' => evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) Y₀ y' t) y (uB B y t)
          + fderiv ℝ (fun y' => uB B y' t) y (evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) Y₀ y t))
        {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t} :=
      (((hRc t).sub (hslice _ _ t hWsm hWsm)).add (hslice _ _ t huB hWsm)).add (hslice _ _ t hWsm huB)
    refine hL.congr (fun y _ => ?_)
    simp only [evOff, pwrLin, resX, pwrQ, pwrTr, pwrUB, add_sub_cancel_left]
  · refine (hslice _ _ t hWsm hWsm).congr (fun y _ => ?_)
    simp only [evOff, pwrQ, pwrTr, add_sub_cancel_left]

subgoal_signatures.name: wave_sum_assembly
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (Ω : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (D : Set Cyl) (Ψ : ℝ³ × ℝ → Cyl) (c : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ)
    (N : Lab → ℤ → ℤ) (H : Finset ℤ), IsOpen Ω → (∀ w ∈ Ω, 0 < rad w.1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ Ω →
    MapsTo Ψ Ω D → (∀ γ m, m ∉ H → ∀ ξ ∈ D, c γ m ξ = 0) →

      c γ m ξ = 0) →
    (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (c γ m) D) →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, c γ m (Ψ w) *
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (N γ m : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ))).re) Ω

subgoal_signatures.name: nsResidual_contDiffOn_eq_jet
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (ν : ℝ) (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(nsResidual ν u p)) O ∧ ∀ z ∈ O, (↿(nsResidual ν u p)) z = nsJet ν u p z

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 (primState5 B G).Aw → (∀ (a : Fin 3), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), mcor5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) a ξ = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (grP5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → grP5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) ξ = 0

signature.name: pws_prim_grP_regular
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 (primState5 B G).Aw → (∀ (a : Fin 3), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), mcor5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) a ξ = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (grP5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → grP5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) ξ = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, hqB1, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n0, fun l0 hl0 hAw hm0 => ?_⟩
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hl0) hn0.le
  have hS := hok.1
  
  have hT : IsOpen {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
    isOpen_lt continuous_snd.snd.fst continuous_const
  have hπq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) :=
    contDiff_snd.fst.prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h4 := hS.2.2.2.1
    have hc := h4.comp hπq.contDiffOn (fun ξ (hξ : ξ.2.2.1 < 1) =>
      (⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩ : (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) ∈ univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)))
    exact hc
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have h1 : IsOpen {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst
    have h2 := hqC.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hT (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ ({ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0)) := by
      ext ξ; exact Iff.rfl
    rw [e]; exact h1.inter h2
  
  have hub : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => ubase B ξ a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro a
    have h := (geom_slow_base_smooth_v5 B hok).2 0 a
    have hπ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)) :=
      contDiff_fst.prodMk (contDiff_snd.fst.prodMk contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
    have hc := h.comp hπ.contDiffOn (fun ξ (hξ : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0) =>
      (⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ.2.2 hqB⟩ : (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ∈
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}))
    refine hc.congr (fun ξ _ => ?_)
    have hQ : Qb 0 = 1 := by simp [Qb]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, baseC, ubase, frameAt, hQ, Real.one_rpow, one_mul]
  
  have hmc : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mcor5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    fun a => (contDiffOn_const (c := (0:ℝ))).congr (fun ξ hξ => hm0 a ξ hξ)
  
  have hZ : InM B (qsOf l0) (1/2) (fun _ : Cyl => (0:ℝ)) := by
    refine ⟨contDiffOn_const, fun _ _ _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ _ => rfl, fun k => ⟨0, 0, 0, fun ξ _ _ _ => ?_⟩⟩
    have hz : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun _ : Cyl => (0:ℝ)) ξ = 0 := by
      have h := (iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun _ : Cyl => (0:ℝ)) = 0)
      exact congrFun h ξ
    unfold NB
    rw [hz]
    have h0 : ((0 : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => Cyl) ℝ).compContinuousLinearMap
        fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) = 0 := by
      ext v
      simp
    rw [h0]
    simp
  
  have wsm : ∀ S : CState, InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 S.Aw → InM B (qsOf l0) (1/2) S.Psi →
      InM B (qsOf l0) (1/2) S.bdir →
      (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mcor5 B G l0 S a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) →
      ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Wcov5 B G l0 S a b) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro S c1 c3 c4 hmcS
    have hper_e : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (θ : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl),
        ephase5 B G γ m (θ + 2 * Real.pi) ξ = ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ := by
      intro γ m θ ξ
      simp only [ephase5]
      have e : Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((pint5 B G γ : ℂ) * ((θ + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) +
          (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)) =
          Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((pint5 B G γ : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ) + (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)) +
          ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [e, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I, mul_one]
    have hper_w : ∀ (θ : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (i : Fin 3),
        waveV5 B G S.Aw (θ + 2 * Real.pi) ξ i = waveV5 B G S.Aw θ ξ i := by
      intro θ ξ i
      simp only [waveV5, hper_e]
    have hterm := wave5_term_contDiffOn B G (qsOf l0) 1 S.Aw hok hG hqB c1
    have hwave : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => waveV5 B G S.Aw p.1 p.2 i)
        (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
      intro i
      apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
      rintro ⟨θ₀, ξ₀⟩ ⟨-, hξ₀⟩
      obtain ⟨N, hNo, hξN, Γ, H, hΓ⟩ := wave5_locfin B G (qsOf l0) 1 S.Aw hok c1 ξ₀ hξ₀
      refine ⟨univ ×ˢ N, isOpen_univ.prod hNo, ⟨mem_univ _, hξN⟩, ?_⟩
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl =>
          ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, S.Aw γ m p.2 i * ephase5 B G γ m p.1 p.2) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
        ContDiffOn.sum (fun γ _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun m _ => hterm γ m i))
      have hsum := Complex.reCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h1
      refine (hsum.mono inter_subset_left).congr ?_
      rintro ⟨θ, ξ⟩ ⟨⟨-, hξD⟩, ⟨-, hξN'⟩⟩
      have hmem : ξ ∈ N ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := ⟨hξN', hξD⟩
      simp only [waveV5, Function.comp_apply, Complex.reCLM_apply]
      congr 1
      have hin : ∀ γ, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, S.Aw γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ =
          ∑ m ∈ H, S.Aw γ m ξ i * ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ := by
        intro γ
        apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
        intro m hm
        rw [Function.mem_support] at hm
        have hne : S.Aw γ m ξ ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0; apply hm; simp [h0]
        exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr (hΓ ξ hmem γ m hne).2
      rw [finsum_congr hin]
      apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
      intro γ hγ
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hγ
      apply Finset.mem_coe.mpr
      by_contra hnot
      apply hγ
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro m _
      have h0 : S.Aw γ m ξ = 0 := by
        by_contra h0
        exact hnot (hΓ ξ hmem γ m h0).1
      simp [h0]
    have hwθ : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × Cyl => waveV5 B G S.Aw (thetaOf p.1) p.2 i)
        ({y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y} ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := fun i =>
      thetaOf_periodic_comp (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) (fun q : ℝ × Cyl => waveV5 B G S.Aw q.1 q.2 i) (hwave i)
        (fun θ e => hper_w θ e i)
    have hAX := ax5_lift_contDiffOn B G l0 S hok hqB c3 hwθ
    have hucyl := ucyl5_of_ax5_lift B G l0 S hok hqB c4 hAX
    intro a b
    have hMp : ∀ c : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl => mcor5 B G l0 S c p.2 + ubase B p.2 c)
        (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      fun c => ((hmcS c).add (hub c)).comp contDiff_snd.contDiffOn (fun p hp => hp.2)
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × Cyl =>
        (ucyl5 B G l0 S p.1 p.2 a - (mcor5 B G l0 S a p.2 + ubase B p.2 a)) *
        (ucyl5 B G l0 S p.1 p.2 b - (mcor5 B G l0 S b p.2 + ubase B p.2 b))) (univ ×ˢ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      ((hucyl a).sub (hMp a)).mul ((hucyl b).sub (hMp b))
    have hI := cyl_param_integral_contDiffOn (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) _ hDopen hg
    refine ((contDiffOn_const (c := (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹)).mul hI).congr (fun ξ _ => ?_)
    simp only [Wcov5, thA, mcor5, sub_add_cancel]
  
  have wsh : ∀ S : CState, InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 S.Aw → ShellSupp B S.Psi → ShellSupp B S.bdir →
      ∀ a c : Fin 3, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) →
        Wcov5 B G l0 S a c ξ = 0 := by
    intro S hAw hShP hShb a c ξ hξ hsh
    have hqsB := hqB
    obtain ⟨r, z, t, Y⟩ := ξ
    obtain ⟨hr, ht, hqs⟩ : 0 < r ∧ t < 1 ∧ qC B.h (r, z, t, Y) < qsOf l0 := hξ
    obtain ⟨hS1, -, -, hS4, -⟩ := hok.1
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, hVel, -⟩ := hok.2
    have hτ : 0 < 1 - t := by linarith
    obtain ⟨q, hqdef⟩ : ∃ q : ℝ, q = qC B.h (r, z, t, Y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hq : 0 < q := by rw [hqdef]; exact (hS1 z (1 - t) hτ).1
    have hqs' : q < qsOf l0 := by rw [hqdef]; exact hqs
    have hXC : XC B.h (r, z, t, Y) = r ^ 2 / (2 * q) := by rw [hqdef]; rfl
    have hc0 : ∀ ρ θ ζ : ℝ, rotPt ρ θ ζ 0 = ρ * Real.cos θ := by intro ρ θ ζ; simp [rotPt]
    have hc1 : ∀ ρ θ ζ : ℝ, rotPt ρ θ ζ 1 = ρ * Real.sin θ := by intro ρ θ ζ; simp [rotPt]
    have hc2 : ∀ ρ θ ζ : ℝ, rotPt ρ θ ζ 2 = ζ := by intro ρ θ ζ; simp [rotPt]
    have hsq : ∀ θ : ℝ, rotPt r θ z 0 ^ 2 + rotPt r θ z 1 ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
      intro θ; rw [hc0, hc1]; linear_combination r ^ 2 * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
    have hrad : ∀ θ : ℝ, rad (rotPt r θ z) = r := by
      intro θ
      show Real.sqrt (rotPt r θ z 0 ^ 2 + rotPt r θ z 1 ^ 2) = r
      rw [hsq, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
    have hsx : ∀ θ : ℝ, simScale B.h (rotPt r θ z 2) (1 - t) = q := by
      intro θ; rw [hc2, hqdef]; rfl
    have hco : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous fun w : ℝ³ => w i := by
      intro i
      have h0 : Continuous (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (ι := Fin 3) i) := ContinuousLinearMap.continuous _
      rwa [EuclideanSpace.coe_proj] at h0
    have hscont : Continuous fun y : ℝ³ => simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) := by
      have hg : Continuous fun y : ℝ³ => ((y 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) := (hco 2).prodMk continuous_const
      exact hS4.continuousOn.comp_continuous hg (fun y => ⟨mem_univ _, hτ⟩)
    have hsum : Continuous fun y : ℝ³ => y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 := ((hco 0).pow 2).add ((hco 1).pow 2)
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : Set ℝ³, N = {y | y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 < 2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t)} ∪
        {y | 2 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hNo : IsOpen N := by
      rw [hN]
      exact (isOpen_lt hsum (continuous_const.mul hscont)).union (isOpen_lt (continuous_const.mul hscont) hsum)
    have hxN : ∀ θ : ℝ, rotPt r θ z ∈ N := by
      intro θ
      rw [hN]
      rcases hsh with h | h
      · refine Set.mem_union_left _ ?_
        show rotPt r θ z 0 ^ 2 + rotPt r θ z 1 ^ 2 < 2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (rotPt r θ z 2) (1 - t)
        rw [hsq, hsx]
        rw [hXC, div_lt_iff₀ (by linarith)] at h
        linarith
      · refine Set.mem_union_right _ ?_
        show 2 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (rotPt r θ z 2) (1 - t) < rotPt r θ z 0 ^ 2 + rotPt r θ z 1 ^ 2
        rw [hsq, hsx]
        rw [hXC, lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith)] at h
        linarith
    have hshell : ∀ y ∈ N, ∀ Y' : ℝ × ℝ, corrOn B l0 y t →
        ptOf y t Y' ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧
          (XC B.h (ptOf y t Y') < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h (ptOf y t Y')) := by
      intro y hy Y' hc
      obtain ⟨hc1, hc2', hc3⟩ := hc
      refine ⟨(show ptOf y t Y' ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) from ⟨hc1, hc2', hc3⟩), ?_⟩
      have hsy : 0 < simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) := (hS1 (y 2) (1 - t) hτ).1
      have hXy : XC B.h (ptOf y t Y') = (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) / (2 * simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t)) := by
        show rad y ^ 2 / (2 * simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t)) = _
        rw [rad, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      rw [hXy]
      rw [hN] at hy
      rcases hy with h | h
      · have h' : y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 < 2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) := h
        left
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by linarith)]
        linarith
      · have h' : 2 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 := h
        right
        rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]
        linarith
    have hAX : ∀ y ∈ N, ∀ Y' : ℝ × ℝ, AX5 B G l0 S y t Y' = B.AB y t := by
      intro y hy Y'
      unfold AX5
      by_cases hc : corrOn B l0 y t
      · rw [if_pos hc]
        obtain ⟨hD, hsh'⟩ := hshell y hy Y' hc
        have hz : ∀ γ m, S.Aw γ m (ptOf y t Y') = 0 := by
          intro γ m
          by_contra hne
          have hW := hAw.2.2.2.1 γ m (ptOf y t Y') hD hne
          obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, h5, h6⟩ := hW
          rcases hsh' with h | h <;> linarith
        have hwave : waveV5 B G S.Aw (thetaOf y) (ptOf y t Y') = 0 := by
          funext i
          simp only [waveV5, hz, Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul, finsum_zero, Complex.zero_re]
        have hpsi : S.Psi (ptOf y t Y') = 0 := hShP _ (hsh'.imp le_of_lt le_of_lt)
        rw [hwave, hpsi]
        simp [cyl2cart]
      · rw [if_neg hc, add_zero]
    have hcurl : ∀ θ : ℝ, curlX B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) (rotPt r θ z) t Y =
        curl3 (fun w => B.AB w t) (rotPt r θ z) := by
      intro θ
      have hev : (fun y => evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) (Y - Yph B.h (rad (rotPt r θ z)) t) y t)
          =ᶠ[nhds (rotPt r θ z)] (fun w => B.AB w t) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hNo.mem_nhds (hxN θ)) (fun y hy => by
          show AX5 B G l0 S y t _ = B.AB y t
          exact hAX y hy _)
      show curl3 (fun y => evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) (Y - Yph B.h (rad (rotPt r θ z)) t) y t) (rotPt r θ z) = _
      simp only [curl3, hev.fderiv_eq]
    have hptx : ∀ θ : ℝ, ptOf (rotPt r θ z) t Y = (r, z, t, Y) := by
      intro θ
      show (rad (rotPt r θ z), rotPt r θ z 2, t, Y) = _
      rw [hrad, hc2]
    have hbd : S.bdir (r, z, t, Y) = 0 := hShb _ (hsh.imp le_of_lt le_of_lt)
    have hBX : ∀ θ : ℝ, BX B G l0 S (rotPt r θ z) t Y = B.BvB (rotPt r θ z) t := by
      intro θ
      unfold BX
      rw [hptx θ, hbd, mul_zero, zero_smul, ite_self, add_zero]
    have huX : ∀ θ : ℝ, uX5 B G l0 S (rotPt r θ z) t Y = uB B (rotPt r θ z) t := by
      intro θ
      show curlX B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) (rotPt r θ z) t Y + BX B G l0 S (rotPt r θ z) t Y = _
      rw [hcurl θ, hBX θ]
      rfl
    have hX : ∀ θ : ℝ, simX B.h (rotPt r θ z) t = r ^ 2 / (2 * q) := by
      intro θ; unfold simX; rw [hsx, hsq]
    have hE : ∀ θ : ℝ, simEta B.h (rotPt r θ z) t = z * q ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) := by
      intro θ; unfold simEta; rw [hsx, hc2]
    have hmem : ∀ θ : ℝ, (rotPt r θ z, t) ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB := by
      intro θ
      show t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (rotPt r θ z 2) (1 - t) < B.qB
      rw [hsx]
      exact ⟨ht, lt_of_lt_of_le hqs' hqsB⟩
    have hpos : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < rotPt r θ z 0 ^ 2 + rotPt r θ z 1 ^ 2 := by
      intro θ; rw [hsq]; positivity
    have key : ∀ θ : ℝ,
        inner ℝ (uB B (rotPt r θ z) t) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) 0) =
            r⁻¹ * B.Vb q (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) (z * q ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))) ∧
        inner ℝ (uB B (rotPt r θ z) t) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) 1) =
            r⁻¹ * (r * q ^ (-(1/2 + B.h)) * B.Eb q (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) (z * q ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)))) ∧
        inner ℝ (uB B (rotPt r θ z) t) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) 2) =
            q ^ (-(1/2 + B.h)) * B.Ub q (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) (z * q ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))) := by
      intro θ
      obtain ⟨hEq, hUq, hVq⟩ := hVel (rotPt r θ z) t (hmem θ) (hpos θ)
      simp only [hsx, hX, hE] at hEq hUq hVq
      rw [hsq, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le] at hEq
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have hf : frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) 0 = (rad (rotPt r θ z))⁻¹ • radVec (rotPt r θ z) := rfl
        rw [hf, real_inner_smul_right, hrad]
        exact congrArg (fun v => r⁻¹ * v) hVq
      · have hf : frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) 1 = (rad (rotPt r θ z))⁻¹ • azVec (rotPt r θ z) := rfl
        rw [hf, real_inner_smul_right, hrad]
        exact congrArg (fun v => r⁻¹ * v) hEq
      · have hf : frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) 2 = EuclideanSpace.single 2 1 := rfl
        rw [hf, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, conj_trivial, one_mul]
        exact hUq
    have hind : ∀ (θ : ℝ) (b : Fin 3),
        inner ℝ (uB B (rotPt r θ z) t) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) b) = ubase B (r, z, t, Y) b := by
      intro θ b
      obtain ⟨k0, k1, k2⟩ := key θ
      obtain ⟨m0, m1, m2⟩ := key 0
      obtain rfl | rfl | rfl : b = 0 ∨ b = 1 ∨ b = 2 := by fin_cases b <;> simp
      · exact k0.trans m0.symm
      · exact k1.trans m1.symm
      · exact k2.trans m2.symm
    have hu : ∀ (θ : ℝ) (b : Fin 3), ucyl5 B G l0 S θ (r, z, t, Y) b = ubase B (r, z, t, Y) b := by
      intro θ b
      show inner ℝ (uX5 B G l0 S (rotPt r θ z) t Y) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) b) = _
      rw [huX θ]
      exact hind θ b
    have hthc : ∀ c0 : ℝ, thA (fun _ => c0) = c0 := by
      intro c0
      simp only [thA]
      have hπ : (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, sub_zero, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hπ, one_mul]
    show thA (fun θ => (ucyl5 B G l0 S θ (r, z, t, Y) a - thA (fun θ' => ucyl5 B G l0 S θ' (r, z, t, Y) a)) *
        (ucyl5 B G l0 S θ (r, z, t, Y) c - thA (fun θ' => ucyl5 B G l0 S θ' (r, z, t, Y) c))) = 0
    simp only [hu, hthc, sub_self, mul_zero]
  
  have hWs := wsm (primState5 B G) hAw hZ hZ hmc
  have hWv := wsh (primState5 B G) hAw (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl)
  exact ⟨grP5_contDiffOn_v5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) hDopen hub hmc hWs,
    grP5_shell_vanish_v5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) hok (fun a ξ hξ _ => hm0 a ξ hξ) hWv⟩

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ) (g : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (DomC B.h qs) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → g ξ = 0) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, DifferentiableAt ℝ (Icut B (fun η => g η - rhoP B η * radMom g 0 η.2.1 η.2.2.1)) ξ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs g hok hqs0 hqs1 hg hsh ξ hξ
  obtain ⟨hD, hqC, hqpos, -, -, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B qs hok
  obtain ⟨hrho, hrho0⟩ := rhoP_regular_v5 B qs hok
  have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qs := hξ
  
  have hg' : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h η ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h η) → g η = 0 := by
    intro η hη hsh'
    have hη' : 0 < η.1 ∧ η.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h η < qs := hη
    have hφD : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ((s * η.1, η.2) : Cyl) ∈ DomC B.h qs := fun s hs =>
      ⟨mul_pos hs hη'.1, hη'.2.1, hη'.2.2⟩
    have hXCφ : ∀ s : ℝ, XC B.h ((s * η.1, η.2) : Cyl) = s ^ 2 * XC B.h η := by
      intro s
      show (s * η.1) ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h η) = s ^ 2 * (η.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h η))
      ring
    have hXCpos : 0 < XC B.h η :=
      div_pos (pow_pos hη'.1 2) (mul_pos two_pos (hqpos η hη))
    have hgc : ContinuousAt g η := (hg.contDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hη)).continuousAt
    have hφc : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => ((s * η.1, η.2) : Cyl)) :=
      (continuous_id.mul continuous_const).prodMk continuous_const
    have h1 : (((1:ℝ) * η.1, η.2) : Cyl) = η := Prod.ext (one_mul _) rfl
    have hT : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => g (s * η.1, η.2)) (nhds 1) (nhds (g η)) :=
      hgc.tendsto.comp (hφc.tendsto' 1 η h1)
    rcases hsh' with hle | hge
    · have hev : (fun s : ℝ => g (s * η.1, η.2)) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Iio 1)] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsLT (zero_lt_one : (0:ℝ) < 1)] with s hs
        apply hsh _ (hφD s hs.1)
        left
        rw [hXCφ]
        have hs2 : s ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith [hs.1, hs.2]
        have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hs2 hXCpos
        linarith
      have hT0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => g (s * η.1, η.2)) (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Iio 1)) (nhds 0) :=
        tendsto_const_nhds.congr' hev.symm
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hT.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds) hT0
    · have hev : (fun s : ℝ => g (s * η.1, η.2)) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Ioi 1)] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (one_lt_two : (1:ℝ) < 2)] with s hs
        apply hsh _ (hφD s (by linarith [hs.1]))
        right
        rw [hXCφ]
        have hs2 : 1 < s ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hs.1, hs.2]
        have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hs2 hXCpos
        linarith
      have hT0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => g (s * η.1, η.2)) (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Ioi 1)) (nhds 0) :=
        tendsto_const_nhds.congr' hev.symm
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hT.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds) hT0
  
  have P0 := path_integral_smooth_v5 B qs g hok hqs0 hqs1 hg hg'
  have hrad : ∀ z t : ℝ, radMom g 0 z t =
      ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, g (r, z, t, Y) := by
    intro z t
    simp only [radMom, yAvg, pow_zero, one_mul]
  have hRM : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => radMom g 0 η.2.1 η.2.2.1) (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have e : (fun η : Cyl => radMom g 0 η.2.1 η.2.2.1) =
        (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, g (r, w.1, w.2, Y))
          ∘ (fun η : Cyl => (η.2.1, η.2.2.1)) := by
      funext η
      simp only [Function.comp, hrad]
    rw [e]
    refine P0.2.2.1.comp (contDiff_snd.fst.prodMk contDiff_snd.snd.fst).contDiffOn ?_
    intro η hη
    have hη' : 0 < η.1 ∧ η.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h η < qs := hη
    exact ⟨hη'.2.1, hη'.2.2⟩
  have hGs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => g η - rhoP B η * radMom g 0 η.2.1 η.2.2.1) (DomC B.h qs) :=
    hg.sub (hrho.mul hRM)
  have hG0 : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h η ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h η) →
      (fun η => g η - rhoP B η * radMom g 0 η.2.1 η.2.2.1) η = 0 := by
    intro η hη hs
    show g η - rhoP B η * radMom g 0 η.2.1 η.2.2.1 = 0
    rw [hg' η hη hs, hrho0 η hη hs]
    ring
  generalize (fun η => g η - rhoP B η * radMom g 0 η.2.1 η.2.2.1) = G at hGs hG0 ⊢
  have P := path_integral_smooth_v5 B qs G hok hqs0 hqs1 hGs hG0
  
  have hIcut : Icut B G = fun η : Cyl =>
      (fun pζ : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) =>
          ∫ r in (0:ℝ)..pζ.1, G (r, pζ.2.1, pζ.2.2.1, pζ.2.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv))
        (η.1, (η.2.1, η.2.2.1, η.2.2.2 - (η.1 ^ drx B.h) • vrv))
      - chiM B (XC B.h η) *
        (fun ζ' : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
            ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), G (r, ζ'.1, ζ'.2.1, ζ'.2.2 + (r ^ drx B.h) • vrv))
          (η.2.1, η.2.2.1, η.2.2.2 - (η.1 ^ drx B.h) • vrv) := by
    funext η
    have hp : ∀ r' : ℝ, pathPt B.h η r' =
        (r', η.2.1, η.2.2.1, (η.2.2.2 - (η.1 ^ drx B.h) • vrv) + (r' ^ drx B.h) • vrv) := by
      intro r'
      refine Prod.ext rfl (Prod.ext rfl (Prod.ext rfl ?_))
      show η.2.2.2 + (r' ^ drx B.h - η.1 ^ drx B.h) • vrv =
        (η.2.2.2 - (η.1 ^ drx B.h) • vrv) + (r' ^ drx B.h) • vrv
      rw [sub_smul]
      abel
    simp only [Icut, hp]
  
  have hζd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => (η.2.1, η.2.2.1, η.2.2.2 - (η.1 ^ drx B.h) • vrv)) ξ := by
    have hpow : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ drx B.h) ξ :=
      differentiableAt_fst.rpow_const (Or.inl hξ'.1.ne')
    exact differentiableAt_snd.fst.prodMk
      (differentiableAt_snd.snd.fst.prodMk (differentiableAt_snd.snd.snd.sub (hpow.smul_const vrv)))
  have hXC : DifferentiableAt ℝ (XC B.h) ξ := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h η)) (DomC B.h qs) :=
      (contDiffOn_fst.pow 2).div (contDiffOn_const.mul hqC)
        (fun η hη => (mul_pos two_pos (hqpos η hη)).ne')
    exact (h1.contDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hξ)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hchi : Differentiable ℝ (chiM B) := by
    have h1 : Differentiable ℝ Real.smoothTransition :=
      (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).differentiable (by norm_num)
    intro X
    exact (h1 _).comp X ((differentiableAt_id.sub_const _).div_const _)
  
  have hF1 := (P.2.2.2.2 (ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, ξ.2.2.2 - (ξ.1 ^ drx B.h) • vrv) ξ.1 hξ'.2.1 hξ'.2.2 hξ'.1).1
  have hWo : IsOpen {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs} := by
    have e : {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs} =
        (fun ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => (((1:ℝ), ζ) : Cyl)) ⁻¹' DomC B.h qs := by
      ext ζ
      exact ⟨fun h => ⟨zero_lt_one, h.1, h.2⟩, fun h => ⟨h.2.1, h.2.2⟩⟩
    rw [e]
    exact hD.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  have hζW : (ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, ξ.2.2.2 - (ξ.1 ^ drx B.h) • vrv) ∈
      {ζ : ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | ζ.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ζ.1 (1 - ζ.2.1) < qs} := ⟨hξ'.2.1, hξ'.2.2⟩
  have hF2 := (P.1.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hζW)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  
  rw [hIcut]
  exact (hF1.comp ξ (differentiableAt_fst.prodMk hζd)).sub
    (((hchi _).comp ξ hXC).mul (hF2.comp ξ hζd))

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (rhoP B) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → rhoP B ξ = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: domc_open_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ) ∧ ContinuousOn (XC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dT f) (DomC B.h qs)) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → dR B.h f ξ = 0 ∧ dZ f ξ = 0 ∧ dT f ξ = 0)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ), B.ok → qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB → (∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (pwrA5 B G l0) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2}) → (∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2}) → (∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (pwrP5 B G l0) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2}) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), DifferentiableAt ℝ (pmP5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) ξ) → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) (PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) x t Y = pwrE B x t Y + stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz x t + pwrLin B G l0 x t Y + pwrQ B G l0 x t Y + gradient (fun y => PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) - B.PB y t - pwrP5 B G l0 y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t))) x

signature.name: pws_pointwise_split
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ), B.ok → qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB → (∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (pwrA5 B G l0) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2}) → (∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2}) → (∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (pwrP5 B G l0) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2}) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), DifferentiableAt ℝ (pmP5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) ξ) → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) (PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) x t Y = pwrE B x t Y + stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz x t + pwrLin B G l0 x t Y + pwrQ B G l0 x t Y + gradient (fun y => PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) - B.PB y t - pwrP5 B G l0 y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t))) x

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  intro B G l0 hok hqB hA hW hP hpm x t Y hxt
  
  have hBP := hok.2
  unfold BackgroundProps at hBP
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, ⟨hAB, hBvB, hPB⟩, -⟩ := hBP
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  have hc : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.1 i) := fun i =>
    (EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp contDiff_fst
  have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
    (hc 2).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd)
  have hqH : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
    hS.2.2.2.1.comp hψ.contDiffOn (fun w hw =>
      ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 by linarith [show w.2 < 1 from hw]⟩)
  have hHo : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
  have hDo : IsOpen (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
    have e : simDomain B.h B.qB = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
        (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ⁻¹' Iio B.qB := Set.ext fun _ => Iff.rfl
    rw [e]
    exact hqH.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hHo isOpen_Iio
  have hradc : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1) := by
    unfold rad
    fun_prop
  have hCO : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} := by
    have h1 : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < rad w.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const hradc
    have h2 : IsOpen ({w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
        (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0)) :=
      hqH.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hHo isOpen_Iio
    have e : {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < rad w.1} ∩
        ({w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
          (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0)) := by
      ext w; rfl
    rw [e]; exact h1.inter h2
  have hsub : ∀ z : ℝ³ × ℝ, corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2 → z ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB :=
    fun z hz => ⟨hz.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hz.2.2 hqB⟩
  have hxD : ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB := hsub (x, t) hxt
  have hxC : ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} := hxt
  
  have hsl : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : ℝ³ → ℝ → F)
      (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) O → (y, s) ∈ O →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => f w s) y := by
    intro F _ _ f O y s hO hf hys
    exact ((hf.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hys)).comp y
      ((contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have huB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(uB B)) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
    let ev : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ((ℝ³ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³) →L[ℝ] ℝ := fun a b =>
      (EuclideanSpace.proj b).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ³ ((EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ) : ℝ³), (0:ℝ)))
    let L : ((ℝ³ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³) →L[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
      (ev 1 2 - ev 2 1).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) +
      (ev 2 0 - ev 0 2).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) +
      (ev 0 1 - ev 1 0).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))
    have hLapp : ∀ Φ : (ℝ³ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³, L Φ =
        (Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1, 0) 2 - Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1, 0) 1) •
            EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1, 0) 0 - Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, 0) 2) •
            EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, 0) 1 - Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1, 0) 0) •
            EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) := by
      intro Φ
      rfl
    have hslice : ∀ z ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB, ∀ v : ℝ³,
        fderiv ℝ (fun w => B.AB w z.2) z.1 v = fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (v, 0) := by
      intro z hz v
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿B.AB) z :=
        (hAB.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hd' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿B.AB) (z.1, z.2) := hd
      have he : (fun w => B.AB w z.2) = (↿B.AB) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ => (w, z.2)) := rfl
      rw [he, fderiv_comp z.1 hd' (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left z.1 z.2).differentiableAt,
        (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left z.1 z.2).fderiv]
      rfl
    have hE : ∀ z ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB, (↿(uB B)) z = L (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z) + (↿B.BvB) z := by
      intro z hz
      show curl3 (fun w => B.AB w z.2) z.1 + B.BvB z.1 z.2 = L (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z) + B.BvB z.1 z.2
      rw [hLapp]
      simp only [curl3, hslice z hz]
    have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB)) (simDomain B.h B.qB) :=
      hAB.fderiv_of_isOpen hDo (by simp)
    exact ((hfd.continuousLinearMap_comp L).add hBvB).congr hE
  
  have hcurl_add : ∀ (F₁ F₂ : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (y : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ F₁ y →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F₂ y → curl3 (fun w => F₁ w + F₂ w) y = curl3 F₁ y + curl3 F₂ y := by
    intro F₁ F₂ y h1 h2
    unfold curl3
    rw [fderiv_fun_add h1 h2]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, PiLp.add_apply, add_sub_add_comm, add_smul]
    abel
  
  have hAX : ∀ w s Z, AX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) w s Z = B.AB w s + pwrA5 B G l0 w s Z := by
    intro w s Z
    by_cases hcw : corrOn B l0 w s
    · simp only [AX5, pwrA5, if_pos hcw]
      rw [show (primState5 B G).Psi = fun _ => 0 from rfl]
      simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]
    · simp only [AX5, pwrA5, if_neg hcw]
  have hBX : ∀ w s Z, BX B G l0 (primState5 B G) w s Z = B.BvB w s := by
    intro w s Z
    by_cases hcw : corrOn B l0 w s
    · simp only [BX, if_pos hcw]
      rw [show (primState5 B G).bdir = fun _ => 0 from rfl]
      simp only [mul_zero, zero_smul, add_zero]
    · simp only [BX, if_neg hcw, add_zero]
  
  have hlocal : ∀ (u₁ u₂ : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p₁ p₂ : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)), IsOpen O →
      (∀ z ∈ O, (↿u₁) z = (↿u₂) z) → (∀ z ∈ O, (↿p₁) z = (↿p₂) z) → ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ O →
      nsResidual 1 u₁ p₁ x t = nsResidual 1 u₂ p₂ x t := by
    intro u₁ u₂ p₁ p₂ O hO hu hp hz
    have hNt : {s : ℝ | ((x, s) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ O} ∈ nhds t :=
      (hO.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mem_nhds hz
    have hNx : {y : ℝ³ | ((y, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ O} ∈ nhds x :=
      (hO.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mem_nhds hz
    have E1 : (fun s => u₁ x s) =ᶠ[nhds t] (fun s => u₂ x s) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hNt (fun s hs => hu (x, s) hs)
    have E2 : (fun y => u₁ y t) =ᶠ[nhds x] (fun y => u₂ y t) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hNx (fun y hy => hu (y, t) hy)
    have E3 : (fun y => p₁ y t) =ᶠ[nhds x] (fun y => p₂ y t) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hNx (fun y hy => hp (y, t) hy)
    have E0 : u₁ x t = u₂ x t := hu (x, t) hz
    have h4 : deriv (fun s => u₁ x s) t = deriv (fun s => u₂ x s) t := E1.deriv_eq
    have h5 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => u₁ y t) x = fderiv ℝ (fun y => u₂ y t) x := E2.fderiv_eq
    have h6 : Δ (fun y => u₁ y t) x = Δ (fun y => u₂ y t) x :=
      (InnerProductSpace.laplacian_congr_nhds E2).eq_of_nhds
    have h7 : gradient (fun y => p₁ y t) x = gradient (fun y => p₂ y t) x := E3.gradient_eq
    unfold nsResidual
    rw [h4, h5, h6, h7, E0]
  
  have hexp : ∀ (u w : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p π₁ π₂ : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (↿u) (x, t) →
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (↿w) (x, t) → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => p y t) x →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => π₁ y t) x → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => π₂ y t) x →
      nsResidual 1 (fun y s => u y s + w y s) (fun y s => p y s + π₁ y s + π₂ y s) x t =
        nsResidual 1 u p x t + nsResidual 1 w π₁ x t + gradient (fun y => π₂ y t) x +
          fderiv ℝ (fun y => w y t) x (u x t) + fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) x (w x t) := by
    intro u w p π₁ π₂ hu hw hp h1 h2
    have hus : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun y => u y t) x :=
      hu.comp x ((contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt)
    have hws : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun y => w y t) x :=
      hw.comp x ((contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt)
    have hut : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s => u x s) t :=
      (hu.comp t ((contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id).contDiffAt)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hwt : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s => w x s) t :=
      (hw.comp t ((contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id).contDiffAt)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hud : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => u y t) x := hus.differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hwd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => w y t) x := hws.differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hL : Δ (fun y => u y t + w y t) x = Δ (fun y => u y t) x + Δ (fun y => w y t) x :=
      hus.laplacian_add hws
    have hG : gradient (fun y => p y t + π₁ y t + π₂ y t) x =
        gradient (fun y => p y t) x + gradient (fun y => π₁ y t) x + gradient (fun y => π₂ y t) x := by
      simp only [gradient, fderiv_fun_add (hp.fun_add h1) h2, fderiv_fun_add hp h1, map_add]
    simp only [nsResidual]
    rw [deriv_fun_add hut hwt, fderiv_fun_add hud hwd, hL, hG]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, map_add, smul_add]
    abel
  
  show nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t))
      (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) x t =
    (nsResidual 1 (uB B) B.PB x t - stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz x t) + stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz x t +
    (nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t))
        (evOff B.h (pwrP5 B G l0) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) x t
      - fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y t) x
          (evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) x t)
      + fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y t) x (uB B x t)
      + fderiv ℝ (fun y => uB B y t) x (evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) x t)) +
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y t) x
      (evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) x t) +
    gradient (fun y => PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t))
      - B.PB y t - pwrP5 B G l0 y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t))) x
  obtain ⟨Y', hY'⟩ : ∃ Y' : ℝ × ℝ, Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t = Y' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [hY']
  
  have hU : ∀ z ∈ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2},
      (↿(evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) Y')) z =
        (↿(fun y s => uB B y s + evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) Y' y s)) z := by
    rintro ⟨y, s⟩ hz
    have hd1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => B.AB w s) y := hsl B.AB _ y s hDo hAB (hsub (y, s) hz)
    have hd2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => evOff B.h (pwrA5 B G l0) Y' w s) y :=
      hsl _ _ y s hCO (hA Y') hz
    have e1 : evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) Y' y s =
        curl3 (fun w => AX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) w s (Yph B.h (rad w) s + Y')) y +
          BX B G l0 (primState5 B G) y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y') := by
      show curl3 (fun w => AX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) w s
          (Yph B.h (rad w) s + (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y' - Yph B.h (rad y) s))) y +
          BX B G l0 (primState5 B G) y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y') = _
      rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
    have e2 : evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) Y' y s =
        curl3 (fun w => evOff B.h (pwrA5 B G l0) Y' w s) y := by
      show curl3 (fun w => pwrA5 B G l0 w s
          (Yph B.h (rad w) s + (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y' - Yph B.h (rad y) s))) y = _
      rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
      rfl
    have hfA : (fun w => AX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) w s (Yph B.h (rad w) s + Y')) =
        fun w => B.AB w s + evOff B.h (pwrA5 B G l0) Y' w s := by
      funext w
      exact hAX w s _
    have hcA : curl3 (fun w => B.AB w s + evOff B.h (pwrA5 B G l0) Y' w s) y =
        curl3 (fun w => B.AB w s) y + curl3 (fun w => evOff B.h (pwrA5 B G l0) Y' w s) y :=
      hcurl_add _ _ y hd1 hd2
    show evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) Y' y s =
      (curl3 (fun w => B.AB w s) y + B.BvB y s) + evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) Y' y s
    rw [e1, e2, hfA, hcA, hBX]
    abel
  
  have hPr : ∀ z ∈ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2},
      (↿(evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) Y')) z =
        (↿(fun y s => B.PB y s + evOff B.h (pwrP5 B G l0) Y' y s +
          (PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y') - B.PB y s
            - pwrP5 B G l0 y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')))) z := by
    rintro ⟨y, s⟩ _
    show PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y') =
      B.PB y s + pwrP5 B G l0 y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y') +
        (PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y') - B.PB y s
          - pwrP5 B G l0 y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y'))
    ring
  have hloc := hlocal _ _ _ _ _ hCO hU hPr hxC
  
  have hu2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (↿(uB B)) (x, t) :=
    (huB.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hxD)).of_le (by norm_num)
  have hw2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (↿(evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) Y')) (x, t) :=
    ((hW Y').contDiffAt (hCO.mem_nhds hxC)).of_le (by norm_num)
  have hp1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => B.PB y t) x := hsl B.PB _ x t hDo hPB hxD
  have hp2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (pwrP5 B G l0) Y' y t) x :=
    hsl _ _ x t hCO (hP Y') hxC
  
  have hradd : ∀ y : ℝ³, 0 < rad y → DifferentiableAt ℝ rad y := by
    intro y hy
    have hpos : y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mp hy).ne'
    have h0 := ((EuclideanSpace.proj (0:Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).differentiableAt (x := y)).pow 2
    have h1 := ((EuclideanSpace.proj (1:Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).differentiableAt (x := y)).pow 2
    exact (h0.fun_add h1).sqrt hpos
  have hκd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')) x := by
    have hr := hradd x hxt.1
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => rad y ^ drx B.h) x :=
      hr.rpow_const (Or.inl hxt.1.ne')
    have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y') x := by
      unfold Yph
      exact ((h1.smul_const vrv).add_const _).add_const _
    exact hr.prodMk (((EuclideanSpace.proj (2:Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).differentiableAt).prodMk
      ((differentiableAt_const t).prodMk h2))
  have hmem : ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y') ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := hxt
  have hcd : DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun y => pmP5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y'))) x :=
    (hpm _ hmem).comp x hκd
  have hMd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')
      - B.PB y t - pwrP5 B G l0 y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')) x := by
    refine hcd.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    filter_upwards [(hCO.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mem_nhds hxt] with y hy
    have hcy : corrOn B l0 y t := hy
    simp only [PX5, pwrP5, if_pos hcy]
    ring
  have hE : nsResidual 1 (fun y s => uB B y s + evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) Y' y s)
      (fun y s => B.PB y s + evOff B.h (pwrP5 B G l0) Y' y s +
          (PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y') - B.PB y s
            - pwrP5 B G l0 y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y'))) x t =
      nsResidual 1 (uB B) B.PB x t +
        nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) Y') (evOff B.h (pwrP5 B G l0) Y') x t +
        gradient (fun y => PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')
          - B.PB y t - pwrP5 B G l0 y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')) x +
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) Y' y t) x (uB B x t) +
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => uB B y t) x (evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) Y' x t) :=
    hexp (uB B) (evOff B.h (pwrW5 B G l0) Y') B.PB (evOff B.h (pwrP5 B G l0) Y')
      (fun y s => PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y') - B.PB y s
        - pwrP5 B G l0 y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')) hu2 hw2 hp1 hp2 hMd
  rw [hloc, hE]
  abel

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (Tth Tz : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (r z t : ℝ), 0 < r → ∃ c1 c2 : ℝ, ∀ y : ℝ³, rad y = r → y 2 = z → stressDivField h Tth Tz y t = c1 • eTh y + c2 • eZ

signature.name: pws_stress_frame
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (Tth Tz : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (r z t : ℝ), 0 < r → ∃ c1 c2 : ℝ, ∀ y : ℝ³, rad y = r → y 2 = z → stressDivField h Tth Tz y t = c1 • eTh y + c2 • eZ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h Tth Tz r z t hr
  refine ⟨(-(simScale h z (1 - t) ^ (-(2 + h)) *
      (deriv (fun Y => Tth (simScale h z (1 - t)) Y (z * simScale h z (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))))
          (r ^ 2 / (2 * simScale h z (1 - t)))
        + Tth (simScale h z (1 - t)) (r ^ 2 / (2 * simScale h z (1 - t)))
            (z * simScale h z (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) / (r ^ 2 / (2 * simScale h z (1 - t)))))) * r,
    -(Real.sqrt (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * simScale h z (1 - t)))) * simScale h z (1 - t) ^ (-(3 / 2 + h)) *
      (deriv (fun Y => Tz (simScale h z (1 - t)) Y (z * simScale h z (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))))
          (r ^ 2 / (2 * simScale h z (1 - t)))
        + Tz (simScale h z (1 - t)) (r ^ 2 / (2 * simScale h z (1 - t)))
            (z * simScale h z (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - h))) / (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * simScale h z (1 - t)))))), ?_⟩
  intro y hy hz
  have hs : y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
    rw [← hy]
    unfold rad
    exact (Real.sq_sqrt (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _))).symm
  have haz : azVec y = r • eTh y := by
    unfold eTh
    rw [hy, smul_inv_smul₀ hr.ne']
  unfold stressDivField simX simEta
  rw [hz, hs, haz, smul_smul]
  rfl

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ), B.ok → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), DifferentiableAt ℝ (pmP5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) ξ) → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), corrOn B l0 x t → ∃ c0 c2 : ℝ, ∀ y : ℝ³, rad y = rad x → y 2 = x 2 → gradient (fun w => PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) w t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad y) t)) - B.PB w t - pwrP5 B G l0 w t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad y) t))) y = c0 • eR y + c2 • eZ

signature.name: pws_pm_grad_frame
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ), B.ok → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), DifferentiableAt ℝ (pmP5 B G l0 (primState5 B G)) ξ) → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), corrOn B l0 x t → ∃ c0 c2 : ℝ, ∀ y : ℝ³, rad y = rad x → y 2 = x 2 → gradient (fun w => PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) w t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad y) t)) - B.PB w t - pwrP5 B G l0 w t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad y) t))) y = c0 • eR y + c2 • eZ

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  intro B G l0 hok hpm x t Y hxt
  obtain ⟨hr, ht, hs⟩ := hxt
  
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦdef⟩ : ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ a b, Φ a b =
      if (0 < a ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h b (1 - t) < qsOf l0) then
        pmP5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) (a, b, t, Yph B.h a t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) else 0 :=
    ⟨fun a b => if (0 < a ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h b (1 - t) < qsOf l0) then
        pmP5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) (a, b, t, Yph B.h a t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) else 0,
      fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  
  obtain ⟨κ, hκdef⟩ : ∃ κ : ℝ × ℝ → Cyl,
      κ = fun p => (p.1, p.2, t, Yph B.h p.1 t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hκd : DifferentiableAt ℝ κ (rad x, x 2) := by
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 ^ drx B.h) (rad x, x 2) :=
      differentiableAt_fst.rpow_const (Or.inl hr.ne')
    have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Yph B.h p.1 t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t))
        (rad x, x 2) := by
      unfold Yph
      exact ((h1.smul_const vrv).add_const _).add_const _
    rw [hκdef]
    exact differentiableAt_fst.prodMk (differentiableAt_snd.prodMk
      ((differentiableAt_const t).prodMk h2))
  have hmem : κ (rad x, x 2) ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := by
    rw [hκdef]
    show 0 < rad x ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0
    exact ⟨hr, ht, hs⟩
  have hcompd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (pmP5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) ∘ κ) (rad x, x 2) :=
    (hpm _ hmem).comp _ hκd
  have hcont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h p.2 (1 - t)) := by
    have := hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.comp_continuous (f := fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.2, 1 - t))
      (by fun_prop) (fun p => ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - t by linarith⟩)
    exact this
  have hU : IsOpen ({p : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < p.1} ∩ {p : ℝ × ℝ | simScale B.h p.2 (1 - t) < qsOf l0}) :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).inter (isOpen_lt hcont continuous_const)
  have hΦd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Φ p.1 p.2) (rad x, x 2) := by
    refine hcompd.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    have hin : ((rad x, x 2) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ ({p : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < p.1} ∩
        {p : ℝ × ℝ | simScale B.h p.2 (1 - t) < qsOf l0}) := ⟨hr, hs⟩
    filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hin] with p hp
    obtain ⟨hp1, hp2⟩ := hp
    have hp1' : 0 < p.1 := hp1
    have hp2' : simScale B.h p.2 (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hp2
    rw [hΦdef, if_pos ⟨hp1', ht, hp2'⟩, hκdef]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ,
      L = fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Φ p.1 p.2) (rad x, x 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hlin : ∀ a b : ℝ, L (a, b) = a * L (1, 0) + b * L (0, 1) := by
    intro a b
    have e : ((a, b) : ℝ × ℝ) = a • ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) + b • ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) := by
      ext <;> simp
    rw [e, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  refine ⟨L (1, 0), L (0, 1), fun y hy hz => ?_⟩
  have hry : 0 < rad y := by rw [hy]; exact hr
  
  have hfun : (fun w => PX5 B G l0 (primState5 B G) w t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad y) t))
      - B.PB w t - pwrP5 B G l0 w t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad y) t))) =
      fun w => Φ (rad w) (w 2) := by
    funext w
    rw [hy, hΦdef]
    by_cases hc : corrOn B l0 w t
    · have hc' : 0 < rad w ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (w 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hc
      rw [if_pos hc']
      simp only [PX5, pwrP5, if_pos hc, ptOf]
      ring
    · have hc' : ¬ (0 < rad w ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (w 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0) := hc
      rw [if_neg hc']
      simp only [PX5, pwrP5, if_neg hc]
      ring
  
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ, D = (rad y)⁻¹ •
      ((y 0) • (EuclideanSpace.proj (0:Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
        + (y 1) • (EuclideanSpace.proj (1:Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD : HasFDerivAt rad D y := by
    have hpos : 0 < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.mp hry
    have h0 := ((EuclideanSpace.proj (0:Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt (x := y)).pow 2
    have h1 := ((EuclideanSpace.proj (1:Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt (x := y)).pow 2
    have hsq := (h0.add h1).sqrt (by exact hpos.ne')
    refine hsq.congr_fderiv ?_
    rw [hDdef]
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
    have hp : ∀ i, (EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) v = v i := fun i => rfl
    have hq : ∀ i, (EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) y = y i := fun i => rfl
    have hr2 : Real.sqrt (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) = rad y := rfl
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, smul_eq_mul, hp, hq,
      Pi.add_apply, hr2]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hψ : HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ³ => (rad w, w 2))
      (D.prod (EuclideanSpace.proj (2:Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)) y :=
    hD.prodMk ((EuclideanSpace.proj (2:Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt (x := y))
  have hpt : ((rad y, y 2) : ℝ × ℝ) = (rad x, x 2) := by rw [hy, hz]
  have hL : HasFDerivAt (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Φ p.1 p.2) L (rad y, y 2) := by
    rw [hpt, hLdef]
    exact hΦd.hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp := hL.comp y hψ
  rw [hfun]
  apply HasGradientAt.gradient
  rw [hasGradientAt_iff_hasFDerivAt]
  refine hcomp.congr_fderiv ?_
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
  rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply]
  have hDv : D v = (rad y)⁻¹ * (y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1) := by rw [hDdef]; rfl
  have hP2 : (EuclideanSpace.proj (2:Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) v = v 2 := rfl
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply, hDv, hP2, hlin]
  unfold eR radVec eZ
  simp only [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, map_one,
    one_mul]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (F : Ext ℝ³) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (c0 c1 c2 : ℝ), 0 < rad x → (∀ θ : ℝ, F (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y = c0 • eR (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) + c1 • eTh (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) + c2 • eZ) → thAvgVec F x t Y = c0 • eR x + c1 • eTh x + c2 • eZ ∧ ∀ a : Fin 3, IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => inner ℝ (F (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)

signature.name: pws_frame_avg
signature.statement: ∀ (F : Ext ℝ³) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (c0 c1 c2 : ℝ), 0 < rad x → (∀ θ : ℝ, F (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y = c0 • eR (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) + c1 • eTh (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) + c2 • eZ) → thAvgVec F x t Y = c0 • eR x + c1 • eTh x + c2 • eZ ∧ ∀ a : Fin 3, IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => inner ℝ (F (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro F x t Y c0 c1 c2 hr hF
  
  have hrad : ∀ θ : ℝ, rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) = rad x := by
    intro θ
    have e0 : (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 0 = rad x * Real.cos θ := by simp [rotPt]
    have e1 : (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 1 = rad x * Real.sin θ := by simp [rotPt]
    have hsq : (rad x * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (rad x * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = rad x ^ 2 := by
      have hcs := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
      calc (rad x * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (rad x * Real.sin θ) ^ 2
          = rad x ^ 2 * (Real.cos θ ^ 2 + Real.sin θ ^ 2) := by ring
        _ = rad x ^ 2 := by rw [hcs, mul_one]
    rw [show rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) =
        Real.sqrt ((rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 1 ^ 2) from rfl, e0, e1, hsq,
      Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
  
  have hcoef : ∀ y : ℝ³, 0 < rad y →
      inner ℝ (c0 • eR y + c1 • eTh y + c2 • eZ) (eR y) = c0 ∧
      inner ℝ (c0 • eR y + c1 • eTh y + c2 • eZ) (eTh y) = c1 ∧
      inner ℝ (c0 • eR y + c1 • eTh y + c2 • eZ) eZ = c2 := by
    intro y hy
    have hS : (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) = 1 := by
      have h1 : rad y ^ 2 = y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 :=
        Real.sq_sqrt (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _))
      rw [← h1, inv_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hy.ne')]
    simp only [eR, eTh, eZ, radVec, azVec]
    generalize (rad y)⁻¹ = a at hS ⊢
    simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply,
      EuclideanSpace.single_apply, smul_eq_mul, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> (try norm_num) <;>
      first
        | linear_combination c0 * hS
        | linear_combination c1 * hS
        | ring
  
  have hconst : ∀ a : Fin 3, (fun θ => inner ℝ (F (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y)
      (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) = fun _ => ![c0, c1, c2] a := by
    intro a
    funext θ
    have hy : 0 < rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) := by rw [hrad θ]; exact hr
    obtain ⟨e0, e1, e2⟩ := hcoef _ hy
    rw [hF θ]
    fin_cases a
    · exact e0
    · exact e1
    · exact e2
  have hthA : ∀ c : ℝ, thA (fun _ => c) = c := by
    intro c
    unfold thA
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, sub_zero, ← mul_assoc,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity), one_mul]
  refine ⟨?_, fun a => ?_⟩
  · have hfun : (fun a => thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (F (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y)
        (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a))) = ![c0, c1, c2] := by
      funext a
      rw [hconst a, hthA]
    unfold thAvgVec
    rw [hfun]
    rfl
  · rw [hconst a]
    exact intervalIntegrable_const

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (F : Ext ℝ³) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (O : Set ℝ³), 0 < rad x → ContinuousOn (fun y => F y t Y) O → (∀ θ : ℝ, rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2) ∈ O) → ∀ a : Fin 3, IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => inner ℝ (F (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)

signature.name: pws_circle_integrable
signature.statement: ∀ (F : Ext ℝ³) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (O : Set ℝ³), 0 < rad x → ContinuousOn (fun y => F y t Y) O → (∀ θ : ℝ, rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2) ∈ O) → ∀ a : Fin 3, IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => inner ℝ (F (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro F x t Y O hr hF hO a
  apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable
  have hc : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) := by
    unfold rotPt
    fun_prop
  have hφ : Continuous (fun θ => F (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) :=
    hF.comp_continuous hc hO
  have e0 : ∀ θ : ℝ, (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 0 = rad x * Real.cos θ := fun θ => by simp [rotPt]
  have e1 : ∀ θ : ℝ, (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 1 = rad x * Real.sin θ := fun θ => by simp [rotPt]
  have hrad : ∀ θ : ℝ, rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) = rad x := by
    intro θ
    have hsq : (rad x * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (rad x * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = rad x ^ 2 := by
      have hcs := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
      calc (rad x * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (rad x * Real.sin θ) ^ 2
          = rad x ^ 2 * (Real.cos θ ^ 2 + Real.sin θ ^ 2) := by ring
        _ = rad x ^ 2 := by rw [hcs, mul_one]
    rw [show rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) =
        Real.sqrt ((rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 1 ^ 2) from rfl, e0, e1, hsq,
      Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
  have hR : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => eR (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) := by
    have e : (fun θ : ℝ => eR (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) = fun θ : ℝ =>
        (rad x)⁻¹ • ((rad x * Real.cos θ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
          (rad x * Real.sin θ) • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) := by
      funext θ
      rw [eR, hrad θ, radVec, e0, e1]
    rw [e]
    fun_prop
  have hT : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => eTh (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) := by
    have e : (fun θ : ℝ => eTh (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) = fun θ : ℝ =>
        (rad x)⁻¹ • (-(rad x * Real.sin θ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
          (rad x * Real.cos θ) • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) := by
      funext θ
      rw [eTh, hrad θ, azVec, e0, e1]
    rw [e]
    fun_prop
  have hframe : Continuous (fun θ => frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a) := by
    fin_cases a
    · exact hR
    · exact hT
    · exact continuous_const
  exact hφ.inner hframe

proof.tactics:
by
  intro R F1 F2 F3 F4 F5 x t Y H0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  have lin : ∀ (f g1 g2 g3 g4 g5 : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ θ, f θ = g1 θ + g2 θ + g3 θ + g4 θ + g5 θ) →
      IntervalIntegrable g1 MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) →
      IntervalIntegrable g2 MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) →
      IntervalIntegrable g3 MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) →
      IntervalIntegrable g4 MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) →
      IntervalIntegrable g5 MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) →
      thA f = thA g1 + thA g2 + thA g3 + thA g4 + thA g5 := by
    intro f g1 g2 g3 g4 g5 hf i1 i2 i3 i4 i5
    have hfe : f = fun θ => g1 θ + g2 θ + g3 θ + g4 θ + g5 θ := funext hf
    subst hfe
    have e1 : (∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g1 θ + g2 θ + g3 θ + g4 θ + g5 θ) =
        (∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g1 θ + g2 θ + g3 θ + g4 θ) +
          ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g5 θ :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_add (((i1.add i2).add i3).add i4) i5
    have e2 : (∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g1 θ + g2 θ + g3 θ + g4 θ) =
        (∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g1 θ + g2 θ + g3 θ) +
          ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g4 θ :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_add ((i1.add i2).add i3) i4
    have e3 : (∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g1 θ + g2 θ + g3 θ) =
        (∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g1 θ + g2 θ) +
          ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g3 θ :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_add (i1.add i2) i3
    have e4 : (∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g1 θ + g2 θ) =
        (∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g1 θ) + ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g2 θ :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_add i1 i2
    unfold thA
    rw [e1, e2, e3, e4]
    ring
  have key : ∀ a : Fin 3,
      thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (R (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) =
        thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (F1 (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) +
        thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (F2 (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) +
        thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (F3 (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) +
        thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (F4 (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) +
        thA (fun θ => inner ℝ (F5 (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) := by
    intro a
    refine lin _ _ _ _ _ _ (fun θ => ?_) (h1 a) (h2 a) (h3 a) (h4 a) (h5 a)
    simp only [H0 θ, inner_add_left]
  simp only [thAvgVec, cyl2cart]
  rw [key 0, key 1, key 2]
  simp only [add_smul]

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G γ n0 c hn0 hlat ξ
  have hs : Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
  have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := (Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)).mpr (by norm_num)
  have hL : Lgc ≠ 0 := by unfold Lgc; intro h0; linarith
  have hT : Tgc ≠ 0 := by unfold Tgc; intro h0; linarith
  have hN : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have c1 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), (Jpow n Y).1 = Lgc ^ n * ((Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) +
      Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) * bgc := by
    intro n Y
    simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk]
    ring
  have c2 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), (Jpow n Y).2 = -(Lgc ^ n * ((Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) * bgc) +
      Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) := by
    intro n Y
    simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk]
    ring
  have hcomp : ∀ (m n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), Jpow m (Jpow n Y) = Jpow (m + n) Y := by
    intro m n Y

    · rw [c1 m, c1 (m + n), c1 n, c2 n, zpow_add₀ hL, zpow_add₀ hT]
      field_simp
      ring
    · rw [c2 m, c2 (m + n), c1 n, c2 n, zpow_add₀ hL, zpow_add₀ hT]
      field_simp
      ring
  have hid : ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, Jpow 0 Y = Y := by
    intro Y

    · rw [c1, zpow_zero, zpow_zero]

      ring
    · rw [c2, zpow_zero, zpow_zero]
      field_simp
      ring
  have hNinv : ∀ x : ℝ, x / (1 + bgc ^ 2) = x * (2 + Real.sqrt 2) / 4 := by
    intro x
    rw [div_eq_div_iff hN (by norm_num)]
    unfold bgc
    linear_combination (-x * Real.sqrt 2) * hs
  have hJ1 : ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, Jpow 1 Y = (3 * Y.1 + Y.2, Y.1 + 5 * Y.2) := by
    intro Y
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · rw [c1, zpow_one, zpow_one, hNinv, hNinv]
      unfold Lgc Tgc bgc
      linear_combination ((Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 + 4 * Real.sqrt 2 - 2) * Y.1 + 2 * (Real.sqrt 2 + 1) * Y.2) / 4 * hs
    · rw [c2, zpow_one, zpow_one, hNinv, hNinv]
      unfold Lgc Tgc bgc
      linear_combination (2 * (Real.sqrt 2 + 1) * Y.1 - (Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 - 4 * Real.sqrt 2 - 2) * Y.2) / 4 * hs
  have hint : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ i j : ℤ, ∃ i' j' : ℤ,
      Jpow (k : ℤ) ((i : ℝ), (j : ℝ)) = ((i' : ℝ), (j' : ℝ)) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro i j; exact ⟨i, j, by rw [Nat.cast_zero, hid]⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      intro i j
      obtain ⟨i', j', h'⟩ := ih i j
      refine ⟨3 * i' + j', i' + 5 * j', ?_⟩
      have e : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 1 + (k : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [e, ← hcomp 1 k, h', hJ1]
      push_cast
      rfl
  
  obtain ⟨a0, b0, hab⟩ := hlat
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Int.le.dest hn0
  have hJk : Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) c = Jpow (k : ℤ) (Jpow n0 c) := by
    rw [hcomp, ← hk, add_comm]
  obtain ⟨a1, b1, hJk'⟩ := hint k a0 b0
  have hJc : Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) c = ((a1 : ℝ), (b1 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [hJk, hab, hJk']
  
  have hadd : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y W : ℝ × ℝ), Jpow n (Y + W) = Jpow n Y + Jpow n W := by
    intro n Y W
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · rw [Prod.fst_add, c1 n (Y + W), c1 n Y, c1 n W, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add]
      ring
    · rw [Prod.snd_add, c2 n (Y + W), c2 n Y, c2 n W, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add]
      ring
  
  have hfr : ∀ (y : ℝ × ℝ) (a b : ℤ), frac0 (y + ((a : ℝ), (b : ℝ))) = frac0 y := by
    intro y a b
    have e1 : (y + ((a : ℝ), (b : ℝ))).1 = y.1 + (a : ℝ) := rfl
    have e2 : (y + ((a : ℝ), (b : ℝ))).2 = y.2 + (b : ℝ) := rfl
    unfold frac0
    rw [e1, e2, round_add_intCast, round_add_intCast]
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · show y.1 + (a : ℝ) - (((round y.1 + a : ℤ)) : ℝ) = y.1 - ((round y.1 : ℤ) : ℝ)
      push_cast
      ring
    · show y.2 + (b : ℝ) - (((round y.2 + b : ℤ)) : ℝ) = y.2 - ((round y.2 : ℤ) : ℝ)
      push_cast
      ring
  have hrect : ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (Y + c) = rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) Y := by
    intro Y
    unfold rectW
    rw [hadd, hJc]
    have e : Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y + ((a1 : ℝ), (b1 : ℝ)) - G.ctr γ =
        (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y - G.ctr γ) + ((a1 : ℝ), (b1 : ℝ)) := by abel
    rw [e, hfr]
  have hvco : ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) (Y + c) = vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) Y := by
    intro Y
    unfold vco etG
    rw [hrect]
  have hphi : ∀ x : Cyl, phiL5 B G γ (shY x c) = phiL5 B G γ x := by
    intro x
    unfold phiL5
    have e : (shY x c).2.2.2 = x.2.2.2 + c := rfl
    rw [e, hvco]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : Cyl, e = ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), c) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsh : ∀ η : Cyl, shY η c = η + e := by
    intro η
    rw [he]
    simp only [shY]
    ext <;> simp
  have hF : (fun x => phiL5 B G γ (x + e)) = phiL5 B G γ := by
    funext x
    rw [← hsh x, hphi x]
  have hfd : fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) (shY ξ c) = fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ := by
    rw [hsh ξ, ← fderiv_comp_add_right]
    exact congrArg (fun g => fderiv ℝ g ξ) hF
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · show DrC B γ.1 (phiL5 B G γ) (shY ξ c) = DrC B γ.1 (phiL5 B G γ) ξ
    unfold DrC dR
    rw [hfd]
    rfl
  · rfl
  · show DzC B γ.1 (phiL5 B G γ) (shY ξ c) = DzC B γ.1 (phiL5 B G γ) ξ
    unfold DzC dZ
    rw [hfd]

  · have k1 := Int.floor_le (φ l / Real.log Tgc)
    have k2 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (φ a / Real.log Tgc)
    have k3 : φ l / Real.log Tgc < φ a / Real.log Tgc + 3 := by
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hlT0, add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hlT0.ne']; linarith
    have k4 : ((⌊φ l / Real.log Tgc⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) < ((⌊φ a / Real.log Tgc⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) + 4 := by
      linarith
    have k5 : ⌊φ l / Real.log Tgc⌋ < ⌊φ a / Real.log Tgc⌋ + 4 := by exact_mod_cast k4
    omega

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (c : ℂ) (f : Fin 3 → Cyl → ℝ) (F : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f i) U) → (∀ η ∈ U, F η = fun i => c * ((f i η : ℝ) : ℂ)) → ∀ k : ℕ, NB h F k ξ ≤ ‖c‖ * ∑ i : Fin 3, NB h (f i) k ξ

signature.name: nb_vec_complex_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (c : ℂ) (f : Fin 3 → Cyl → ℝ) (F : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f i) U) → (∀ η ∈ U, F η = fun i => c * ((f i η : ℝ) : ℂ)) → ∀ k : ℕ, NB h F k ξ ≤ ‖c‖ * ∑ i : Fin 3, NB h (f i) k ξ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h U ξ c f F hU hξ hf hFG k
  have hfi : ∀ i, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (f i) ξ := fun i => (hf i).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)
  have hG : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => fun i : Fin 3 => c * ((f i η : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ := by
    refine contDiffAt_pi.mpr (fun i => ?_)
    exact contDiffAt_const.mul ((Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.contDiffAt).comp ξ (hfi i))
  have hev : F =ᶠ[nhds ξ] (fun η : Cyl => fun i : Fin 3 => c * ((f i η : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hξ) (fun η hη => hFG η hη)
  have hD : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F ξ =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η : Cyl => fun i : Fin 3 => c * ((f i η : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ :=
    (hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds
  have hgc : ∀ r : ℝ, (c • Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ) r = c * (r : ℂ) := by
    intro r
    simp [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hcomp : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (v : Fin k → Cyl),
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η : Cyl => fun i : Fin 3 => c * ((f i η : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ v i =
        c * ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (f i) ξ v : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro i v
    have e1 : (⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) i) ∘
        (fun η : Cyl => fun i : Fin 3 => c * ((f i η : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
        ⇑(c • Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ) ∘ f i := by
      funext η
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, hgc]
    have h1 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left
      (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) i) hG (i := k)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have h2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left
      (c • Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ) (hfi i) (i := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [e1, h2] at h1
    have h3 := congrArg (fun T => T v) h1
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply] at h3
    rw [← h3, hgc]
  have hNBnn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ NB h (f i) k ξ := fun i => norm_nonneg _
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ ‖c‖ * ∑ i : Fin 3, NB h (f i) k ξ :=
    mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hNBnn i))
  have key : ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η : Cyl => fun i : Fin 3 => c * ((f i η : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
      (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ ≤ ‖c‖ * ∑ i : Fin 3, NB h (f i) k ξ := by
    refine ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound hM0 (fun m => ?_)
    have hP : 0 ≤ ∏ j, ‖m j‖ := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _)
    refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hM0 hP)).mpr (fun i => ?_)
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, hcomp, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real]
    have hle : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (f i) ξ (fun j => Lnorm h ξ (m j))‖ ≤
        NB h (f i) k ξ * ∏ j, ‖m j‖ := by
      have := ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (f i) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)).le_opNorm m
      rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply] at this
      exact this
    have hs : NB h (f i) k ξ ≤ ∑ j : Fin 3, NB h (f j) k ξ :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => NB h (f j) k ξ) (fun j _ => hNBnn j) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    calc ‖c‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (f i) ξ (fun j => Lnorm h ξ (m j))‖
        ≤ ‖c‖ * (NB h (f i) k ξ * ∏ j, ‖m j‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ ‖c‖ * ((∑ j : Fin 3, NB h (f j) k ξ) * ∏ j, ‖m j‖) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs hP) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = (‖c‖ * ∑ j : Fin 3, NB h (f j) k ξ) * ∏ j, ‖m j‖ := by ring
  show ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ ≤ _
  rw [hD]
  exact key
