signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab), B.ok → ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, Kmat B G γ η = pcKm5 B γ.1 (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G γ hB ξ hξ
  
  have hbase0 : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} ∧
      ∀ (l : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => baseC B l (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) i)
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
    obtain ⟨hS, hBP⟩ := hB
    have hsc : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hA : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
      have hm : Continuous (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2)) := by fun_prop
      have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2)))
          {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} := by
        refine hsc.comp hm.continuousOn ?_
        intro s hs
        have hs' : s.2.2 < 1 := hs
        exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - s.2.2 by linarith⟩
      have hU : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
      have h1 := hc.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := B.qB))
      have h2 : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst
      have e : {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} =
          {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1} ∩ ({s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} ∩
            ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2))) ⁻¹'
              Iio B.qB) := by
        ext s
        simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_inter_iff, mem_preimage, mem_Iio, Function.comp]
      rw [e]
      exact h2.inter h1
    have hD : IsOpen (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      have hm : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)) := by fun_prop
      have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)))
          {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
        refine hsc.comp hm.continuousOn ?_
        intro w hw
        have hw' : w.2 < 1 := hw
        exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 by linarith⟩
      have hU : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
      have h1 := hc.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := B.qB))
      have e : simDomain B.h B.qB = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
          ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2))) ⁻¹' Iio B.qB := by
        ext w
        simp only [simDomain, mem_setOf_eq, mem_inter_iff, mem_preimage, mem_Iio, Function.comp]
      rw [e]
      exact h1
    have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(uB B)) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      have hAB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿B.AB) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := hBP.2.2.2.1.1
      have hBv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿B.BvB) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := hBP.2.2.2.1.2.1
      have hDA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z) (simDomain B.h B.qB) :=
        ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hD).1 hAB).2
      have hc : ∀ (v : ℝ³) (j : Fin 3),
          ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (v, (0:ℝ)) j) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
        intro v j
        have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (v, (0:ℝ))) (simDomain B.h B.qB) :=
          hDA.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
        exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h1
      let e0 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1
      let e1 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 1 1
      let e2 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 2 1
      have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e1, (0:ℝ)) 2 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e2, (0:ℝ)) 1) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e2, (0:ℝ)) 0 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e0, (0:ℝ)) 2) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e0, (0:ℝ)) 1 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e1, (0:ℝ)) 0) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) + (↿B.BvB) z) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
        refine ((((hc e1 2).sub (hc e2 1)).smul contDiffOn_const).add
          (((hc e2 0).sub (hc e0 2)).smul contDiffOn_const)).add
          (((hc e0 1).sub (hc e1 0)).smul contDiffOn_const) |>.add hBv
      refine hg.congr ?_
      rintro ⟨y, s⟩ hz
      have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s) :=
        (hAB.contDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have hpart : fderiv ℝ (fun w => B.AB w s) y =
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := by
        have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ³ => (w, s)) (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) y :=
          hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left y s
        have h2 : HasFDerivAt ((↿B.AB) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ => (w, s)))
            ((fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)) y :=
          HasFDerivAt.comp (g := ↿B.AB) y hdiff.hasFDerivAt h1
        exact h2.fderiv
      show curl3 (fun w => B.AB w s) y + B.BvB y s = _
      unfold curl3
      rw [hpart]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.inl_apply]
      rfl
    have frame : ∀ r z : ℝ, 0 < r → (rotPt r 0 z) 2 = z ∧
        eR (rotPt r 0 z) = EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) ∧
        eTh (rotPt r 0 z) = EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) := by
      intro r z hr
      have h0 : (rotPt r 0 z) 0 = r := by simp [rotPt]
      have h1 : (rotPt r 0 z) 1 = 0 := by simp [rotPt]
      have h2 : (rotPt r 0 z) 2 = z := by simp [rotPt]
      have hrad : rad (rotPt r 0 z) = r := by
        unfold rad
        rw [h0, h1]
        simp [Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
      refine ⟨h2, ?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold eR radVec
        rw [hrad, h0, h1, zero_smul, add_zero, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
      · unfold eTh azVec
        rw [hrad, h0, h1, neg_zero, zero_smul, zero_add, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
    let ψ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ³ × ℝ := fun s => (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1, s.2.2)
    have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ := by
      have hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1) := by
        unfold rotPt
        fun_prop
      exact hr.prodMk (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd)
    have hmaps : MapsTo ψ {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}
        (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      intro s hs
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hs
      show s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ((rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1) 2) (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB
      rw [(frame s.1 s.2.1 h1).1]
      exact ⟨h2, h3⟩
    refine ⟨hA, fun l i => ?_⟩
    have hcomp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((↿(uB B)) ∘ ψ)
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} :=
      hu.comp hψ.contDiffOn hmaps
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s => Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * inner ℝ (((↿(uB B)) ∘ ψ) s)
        ((![EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ), eZ] :
          Fin 3 → ℝ³) i))
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} :=
      contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.inner ℝ hcomp contDiffOn_const)
    refine hg.congr ?_
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨_, f2, f3⟩ := frame s.1 s.2.1 hs.1
    show Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * inner ℝ (uB B (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1) s.2.2)
        (![eR (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1), eTh (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1), eZ] i) = _
    rw [f2, f3]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨hΩ, hbase⟩ := hbase0
  set Ω := {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} with hΩe
  have hQ : 0 < Qb γ.1 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hsQ : 0 < Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQ
  have hRC : ∀ s ∈ Ω, pcRC5 γ.1 s ≠ 0 := fun s hs => div_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hs.1) hsQ.ne'
  have hRCs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pcRC5 γ.1) := by unfold pcRC5; fun_prop
  have hb : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcB5 B γ.1 i) Ω := fun i => hbase γ.1 i
  have hFa : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcFa5 B γ.1) Ω := (hb 1).div hRCs.contDiffOn hRC
  let sl : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ × ℝ :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).prod
      (((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))).prod
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))))
  have hslA : ∀ η : Cyl, HasFDerivAt (fun x : Cyl => (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1)) sl η := fun η => sl.hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp : ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (η : Cyl), (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ∈ Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω →
      ∀ d : Cyl, fderiv ℝ (fun η' : Cyl => f (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1)) η d =
        fderiv ℝ f (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) (d.1, d.2.1, d.2.2.1) := by
    intro f η hη h1 d
    have d1 := ((h1.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hη)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have h' : HasFDerivAt (fun η' : Cyl => f (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1)) _ η := d1.comp η (hslA η)
    rw [h'.fderiv]
    rfl
  have hs : (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ∈ Ω := hξ
  have e1 : DrC B γ.1 (Fang B γ.1) ξ = Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) *
      fderiv ℝ (pcFa5 B γ.1) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) :=
    congrArg (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * ·) (hcomp (pcFa5 B γ.1) ξ hs hFa (1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv))
  have e2 : DrC B γ.1 (fun η => baseC B γ.1 η 2) ξ = Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) *
      fderiv ℝ (pcB5 B γ.1 2) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) :=
    congrArg (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * ·) (hcomp (pcB5 B γ.1 2) ξ hs (hb 2) (1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv))
  unfold Kmat
  rw [e1, e2]
  rfl

by

      intro V _ _ U n hU hξ f g hf hg

    have hE0 : 0 ≤ E := le_trans (hNBnn b 0) (hE 0 (Nat.zero_le k))

    have hb' : ContDiffAt ℝ k b ξ := hb.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)

    obtain ⟨ub, hub, hbu⟩ := hb'.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)

    have hΦmaps : Set.MapsTo Φ O (Set.Ioi 0) := by
      intro z hz; rw [hΦdef]; rw [hOdef] at hz; exact hpos _ hz
    have hΦ0 : Φ 0 = f ξ := by
      rw [hΦdef]; show f (ξ + Lnorm h ξ 0) = f ξ; rw [map_zero, add_zero]
    have hCw : ∀ j ≤ i, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) (Set.Ioi 0) (Φ 0)‖ ≤ Cg := by
      intro j hj
      rw [hΦ0, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j isOpen_Ioi
        (show f ξ ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) from hpos ξ hξU)]
      exact hCgb j (le_trans hj hik)
    have hDw : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ i → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j Φ O 0‖ ≤ Dd ^ j := by
      intro j hj1 hji
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hO h0O, hΦdef, key f U ξ (Lnorm h ξ) hU hfU hξU j]
      exact hNBf j hj1 (le_trans hji hik)
    have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hinvs hΦ (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn hO.uniqueDiffOn hΦmaps h0O (C := Cg) (D := Dd) hCw hDw
    have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (f η)⁻¹) U := hinvs.comp hfU (fun η hη => hpos η hη)
    have hNBeq : NB h (fun η => (f η)⁻¹) i ξ =
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => (f (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z))⁻¹) 0‖ := by
      have := key (fun η => (f η)⁻¹) U ξ (Lnorm h ξ) hU hG hξU i
      unfold NB
      rw [this]
    have hEq : (fun z => (f (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z))⁻¹) = (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) ∘ Φ := by
      rw [hΦdef]; rfl
    have hfac : (i.factorial : ℝ) ≤ k.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le hik
    have hpow : Dd ^ i ≤ Dd ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ hDd1 hik
    have hDd0 : 0 ≤ Dd := by linarith
    calc NB h (fun η => (f η)⁻¹) i ξ
        = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i ((fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) ∘ Φ) 0‖ := by rw [hNBeq, hEq]
      _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) ∘ Φ) O 0‖ := by
          rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO h0O]
      _ ≤ (i.factorial : ℝ) * Cg * Dd ^ i := hFdB
      _ ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) * Cg * Dd ^ k :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfac hCg0) hpow (pow_nonneg hDd0 _)
            (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hCg0)
      _ = _ := by rw [hCg]
  
  intro k c D hc
  refine ⟨2 ^ k * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * (max 1 (1 / c)) ^ (k + 1)) *
    (max 1 (3 * 2 ^ k * (D * D))) ^ k) * (3 * 2 ^ k * (D * D) + |D|), ?_⟩
  intro h Sv U ξ n p K hU hξ hSv hn hp hK hc0 hbd j
  have hM1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ max 1 (3 * 2 ^ k * (D * D)) := le_max_left _ _
  have hMD : 3 * 2 ^ k * (D * D) ≤ max 1 (3 * 2 ^ k * (D * D)) := le_max_right _ _
  have hSv0 : 0 ≤ Sv := by linarith
  have hSS : 1 ≤ Sv * Sv := by nlinarith
  have hSS' : Sv ≤ Sv * Sv := by nlinarith
  have hnU := hU.mem_nhds hξ
  have cn : ∀ i, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (n i) ξ := fun i => (hn i).contDiffAt hnU
  have cp : ∀ i, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (p i) ξ := fun i => (hp i).contDiffAt hnU
  have cK : ∀ i i', ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (K i i') ξ := fun i i' => (hK i i').contDiffAt hnU
  have hEE : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k →
      3 * (2 ^ i * (D * Sv) * (D * Sv)) ≤ 3 * 2 ^ k * (D * D) * (Sv * Sv) := by
    intro i hi
    have h2 : (2:ℝ) ^ i ≤ 2 ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hi
    calc 3 * (2 ^ i * (D * Sv) * (D * Sv)) = 3 * 2 ^ i * ((D * Sv) * (D * Sv)) := by ring
      _ ≤ 3 * 2 ^ k * ((D * Sv) * (D * Sv)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (mul_self_nonneg _)
      _ = 3 * 2 ^ k * (D * D) * (Sv * Sv) := by ring
  have bN : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k →
      NB h (fun η => n 0 η * n 0 η + n 1 η * n 1 η + n 2 η * n 2 η) i ξ ≤
        3 * 2 ^ k * (D * D) * (Sv * Sv) := by
    intro i hi
    exact le_trans (dot3 h ξ n n i (D * Sv) (D * Sv) cn cn
      (fun l j' hj' => (hbd j' (by omega)).1 l) (fun l j' hj' => (hbd j' (by omega)).1 l)) (hEE i hi)
  have bA : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k →
      NB h (fun η => n 0 η * K 0 j η + n 1 η * K 1 j η + n 2 η * K 2 j η - p j η) i ξ ≤
        (3 * 2 ^ k * (D * D) + |D|) * (Sv * Sv) := by
    intro i hi
    have hd : NB h (fun η => n 0 η * K 0 j η + n 1 η * K 1 j η + n 2 η * K 2 j η) i ξ ≤
        3 * (2 ^ i * (D * Sv) * (D * Sv)) :=
      dot3 h ξ n (fun l => K l j) i (D * Sv) (D * Sv) cn (fun l => cK l j)
        (fun l j' hj' => (hbd j' (by omega)).1 l) (fun l j' hj' => (hbd j' (by omega)).2.2 l j)
    have cdot : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => n 0 η * K 0 j η + n 1 η * K 1 j η + n 2 η * K 2 j η) ξ :=
      (((cn 0).mul (cK 0 j)).add ((cn 1).mul (cK 1 j))).add ((cn 2).mul (cK 2 j))
    have hs : NB h (fun η => n 0 η * K 0 j η + n 1 η * K 1 j η + n 2 η * K 2 j η - p j η) i ξ ≤
        NB h (fun η => n 0 η * K 0 j η + n 1 η * K 1 j η + n 2 η * K 2 j η) i ξ + NB h (p j) i ξ :=
      (addle h ξ (fun η => n 0 η * K 0 j η + n 1 η * K 1 j η + n 2 η * K 2 j η) (p j) i cdot
        (cp j)).2
    have hpj := (hbd i hi).2.1 j
    have hDabs : D * Sv ≤ |D| * (Sv * Sv) :=
      le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self D) hSv0)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSS' (abs_nonneg D))
    have := hEE i hi
    nlinarith
  
  have hNon : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => n 0 η * n 0 η + n 1 η * n 1 η + n 2 η * n 2 η) U :=
    (((hn 0).mul (hn 0)).add ((hn 1).mul (hn 1))).add ((hn 2).mul (hn 2))
  have hNξ : 0 < n 0 ξ * n 0 ξ + n 1 ξ * n 1 ξ + n 2 ξ * n 2 ξ := lt_of_lt_of_le hc hc0
  have hVo : IsOpen (U ∩ (fun η => n 0 η * n 0 η + n 1 η * n 1 η + n 2 η * n 2 η) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0) :=
    hNon.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hU isOpen_Ioi
  have hξV : ξ ∈ U ∩ (fun η => n 0 η * n 0 η + n 1 η * n 1 η + n 2 η * n 2 η) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0 :=
    ⟨hξ, hNξ⟩
  have hDd1 : 1 ≤ max 1 (3 * 2 ^ k * (D * D)) * (Sv * Sv) := by nlinarith
  have hNBN : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k →
      NB h (fun η => n 0 η * n 0 η + n 1 η * n 1 η + n 2 η * n 2 η) i ξ ≤
        (max 1 (3 * 2 ^ k * (D * D)) * (Sv * Sv)) ^ i := by
    intro i hi1 hik
    refine le_trans (bN i hik) (le_trans ?_ (le_self_pow₀ hDd1 (by omega)))
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hMD (by linarith)
  have hinv := invle h c (max 1 (3 * 2 ^ k * (D * D)) * (Sv * Sv))
    (U ∩ (fun η => n 0 η * n 0 η + n 1 η * n 1 η + n 2 η * n 2 η) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0)
    (fun η => n 0 η * n 0 η + n 1 η * n 1 η + n 2 η * n 2 η) ξ k hVo hξV
    (hNon.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun η hη => hη.2) hc hc0 hDd1 hNBN
  have cN : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => n 0 η * n 0 η + n 1 η * n 1 η + n 2 η * n 2 η) ξ :=
    (((cn 0).mul (cn 0)).add ((cn 1).mul (cn 1))).add ((cn 2).mul (cn 2))
  have cNinv : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => (n 0 η * n 0 η + n 1 η * n 1 η + n 2 η * n 2 η)⁻¹) ξ :=
    cN.inv hNξ.ne'
  have cA : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun η => n 0 η * K 0 j η + n 1 η * K 1 j η + n 2 η * K 2 j η - p j η) ξ :=
    ((((cn 0).mul (cK 0 j)).add ((cn 1).mul (cK 1 j))).add ((cn 2).mul (cK 2 j))).sub (cp j)
  have hfinal := mulle h ξ (fun η => (n 0 η * n 0 η + n 1 η * n 1 η + n 2 η * n 2 η)⁻¹)
    (fun η => n 0 η * K 0 j η + n 1 η * K 1 j η + n 2 η * K 2 j η - p j η) k
    ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * (max 1 (1 / c)) ^ (k + 1)) *
      (max 1 (3 * 2 ^ k * (D * D)) * (Sv * Sv)) ^ k)
    ((3 * 2 ^ k * (D * D) + |D|) * (Sv * Sv)) cNinv cA hinv bA
  refine le_trans hfinal (le_of_eq ?_)
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
∀ {ι : Type} (h : ℝ) (P : ι → Cyl → Prop) (f g : ι → Cyl → ℝ),
    UJet5 h P f → UJet5 h P g →
    UJet5 h P (fun i η => f i η * g i η) ∧ UJet5 h P (fun i η => f i η + g i η)

signature.name: ujet5_ring_v5
signature.statement:
∀ {ι : Type} (h : ℝ) (P : ι → Cyl → Prop) (f g : ι → Cyl → ℝ),
    UJet5 h P f → UJet5 h P g →
    UJet5 h P (fun i η => f i η * g i η) ∧ UJet5 h P (fun i η => f i η + g i η)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ι h P f g hf hg
  obtain ⟨hfs, hfb⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨hgs, hgb⟩ := hg
  
  have mulb : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (a b : Cyl → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (A E : ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ a ξ →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ b ξ → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h a i ξ ≤ A) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h b i ξ ≤ E) → NB h (fun η => a η * b η) k ξ ≤ 2 ^ k * A * E := by
    intro ξ a b k A E ha hb hA hE
    have hNBnn : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V) (i : ℕ),
        0 ≤ NB h f i ξ := fun f i => norm_nonneg _
    have leib : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (U : Set Cyl) (n : ℕ),
        IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (g : Cyl → V), ContDiffOn ℝ n f U → ContDiffOn ℝ n g U →
        NB h (fun η => f η • g η) n ξ ≤
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h g (n - i) ξ := by
      intro V _ _ U n hU hξ f g hf hg
      unfold NB
      generalize Lnorm h ξ = L
      obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hs : IsOpen s := by
        rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
      have hO : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage L.continuous
      have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
        rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
      have hL0s : L 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
      have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
      have hsm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
          ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
        intro W _ _ F hF
        exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
          (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
      have hsmO : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
          ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by
        intro W _ _ F hF
        exact (hsm F hF).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
      have key : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
          ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n →
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0 =
            (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
        intro W _ _ F hF i hi
        have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O
        have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
          hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
        have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + z)) i hs h0s
        have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i ξ 0
        calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0
            = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑L) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
          _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
                (fun _ => L) := e2
          _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
                (fun _ => L) := by rw [map_zero]
          _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
                (fun _ => L) := by rw [e3]
          _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
      have hfg : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun η => f η • g η) U := hf.smul hg
      have hl := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_smul_le (hsmO f hf) (hsmO g hg) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O
        (n := n) le_rfl
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => f (ξ + L y) • g (ξ + L y)) n hO h0O] at hl
      rw [← key _ hfg n le_rfl]
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => (fun η => f η • g η) (ξ + L z)) 0‖
          = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f (ξ + L y) • g (ξ + L y)) 0‖ := rfl
        _ ≤ _ := hl
        _ = _ := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i hi
          have hik : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O,
            iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => g (ξ + L z)) (n - i) hO h0O,
            key f hf i hik, key g hg (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i)]
    have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := le_trans (hNBnn a 0) (hA 0 (Nat.zero_le k))
    have hE0 : 0 ≤ E := le_trans (hNBnn b 0) (hE 0 (Nat.zero_le k))
    have ha' : ContDiffAt ℝ k a ξ := ha.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hb' : ContDiffAt ℝ k b ξ := hb.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    obtain ⟨ua, hua, hau⟩ := ha'.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
    obtain ⟨ub, hub, hbu⟩ := hb'.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
    obtain ⟨O, hOsub, hOopen, hξO⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp (Filter.inter_mem hua hub)
    have haO : ContDiffOn ℝ k a O := hau.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).1)
    have hbO : ContDiffOn ℝ k b O := hbu.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).2)
    have l1 := leib O k hOopen hξO a b haO hbO
    have l1' : NB h (fun η => a η * b η) k ξ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
        (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB h a i ξ * NB h b (k - i) ξ := l1
    refine le_trans l1' ?_
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB h a i ξ * NB h b (k - i) ξ
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * A * E := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hA i hik) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
            (hE _ (Nat.sub_le k i)) (hNBnn _ _) (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hA0)
      _ = A * E * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; ring
      _ = 2 ^ k * A * E := by
          have hs : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) = 2 ^ k := by
            exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose k
          rw [hs]; ring
  
  have hSC : ∀ ξ, 1 ≤ SC h ξ := by
    intro ξ
    unfold SC
    have : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + |Real.log (qC h ξ)| := by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC h ξ))]
    exact one_le_pow₀ this
  
  have hsm : ∀ i ξ, P i ξ → ∃ U : Set Cyl, IsOpen U ∧ ξ ∈ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f i) U ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (g i) U := by
    intro i ξ hP
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hξU, hfU⟩ := hfs i ξ hP
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hξV, hgV⟩ := hgs i ξ hP
    exact ⟨U ∩ V, hU.inter hV, ⟨hξU, hξV⟩, hfU.mono Set.inter_subset_left,
      hgV.mono Set.inter_subset_right⟩
  refine ⟨⟨fun i ξ hP => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩, ⟨fun i ξ hP => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨U, hU, hξU, h1, h2⟩ := hsm i ξ hP
    exact ⟨U, hU, hξU, h1.mul h2⟩
  · choose Cf bf hCf using hfb
    choose Cg bg hCg using hgb
    refine ⟨2 ^ k * (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cf l|) * (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cg l|),
      (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bf l|) + (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bg l|),
      fun i ξ hP => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hξU, h1, h2⟩ := hsm i ξ hP
    have hS1 := hSC ξ
    have hS0 : 0 < SC h ξ := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hS1
    have bnd : ∀ (C bb : ℕ → ℝ) (F : Cyl → ℝ), (∀ j, NB h F j ξ ≤ C j * SC h ξ ^ bb j) →
        ∀ j, j ≤ k → NB h F j ξ ≤ (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |C l|) *
          SC h ξ ^ (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb l|) := by
      intro C bb F hF j hj
      have hjm : j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj)
      have e1 : |C j| ≤ ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |C l| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun l => |C l|) (fun l _ => abs_nonneg _) hjm
      have e2 : bb j ≤ ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb l| :=
        le_trans (le_abs_self _)
          (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun l => |bb l|) (fun l _ => abs_nonneg _) hjm)
      have p1 : 0 ≤ SC h ξ ^ bb j := Real.rpow_nonneg hS0.le _
      have p2 : 0 ≤ SC h ξ ^ (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb l|) := Real.rpow_nonneg hS0.le _
      have m : SC h ξ ^ bb j ≤ SC h ξ ^ (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb l|) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 e2
      calc NB h F j ξ ≤ C j * SC h ξ ^ bb j := hF j
        _ ≤ |C j| * SC h ξ ^ bb j := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) p1
        _ ≤ |C j| * SC h ξ ^ (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb l|) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left m (abs_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |C l|) *
              SC h ξ ^ (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb l|) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right e1 p2
    have hmb := mulb ξ (f i) (g i) k _ _ (h1.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξU))
      (h2.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξU)) (bnd Cf bf (f i) (fun j => hCf j i ξ hP))
      (bnd Cg bg (g i) (fun j => hCg j i ξ hP))
    refine le_trans hmb (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [Real.rpow_add hS0]
    ring
  · obtain ⟨U, hU, hξU, h1, h2⟩ := hsm i ξ hP
    exact ⟨U, hU, hξU, h1.add h2⟩
  · obtain ⟨C1, b1, hC1⟩ := hfb k
    obtain ⟨C2, b2, hC2⟩ := hgb k
    refine ⟨|C1| + |C2|, max b1 b2, fun i ξ hP => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hξU, h1, h2⟩ := hsm i ξ hP
    have hS1 := hSC ξ
    have hS0 : 0 < SC h ξ := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hS1
    have hfA : ContDiffAt ℝ k (f i) ξ :=
      (h1.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξU)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hgA : ContDiffAt ℝ k (g i) ξ :=
      (h2.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξU)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hadd : NB h (fun η => f i η + g i η) k ξ ≤ NB h (f i) k ξ + NB h (g i) k ξ := by
      have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => f i η + g i η) ξ =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (f i) ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (g i) ξ :=
        iteratedFDeriv_add_apply hfA hgA
      unfold NB
      rw [e1]
      have e2 : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (f i) ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (g i) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (f i) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) +
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (g i) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) := by
        ext m
        simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
      rw [e2]
      exact norm_add_le _ _
    have key : ∀ (C b : ℝ) (N : ℝ), N ≤ C * SC h ξ ^ b → b ≤ max b1 b2 →
        N ≤ |C| * SC h ξ ^ max b1 b2 := by
      intro C b N hN hb
      have p1 : 0 ≤ SC h ξ ^ b := Real.rpow_nonneg hS0.le _
      calc N ≤ C * SC h ξ ^ b := hN
        _ ≤ |C| * SC h ξ ^ b := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) p1
        _ ≤ |C| * SC h ξ ^ max b1 b2 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 hb) (abs_nonneg _)
    have k1 := key C1 b1 _ (hC1 i ξ hP) (le_max_left _ _)
    have k2 := key C2 b2 _ (hC2 i ξ hP) (le_max_right _ _)
    have e : (|C1| + |C2|) * SC h ξ ^ max b1 b2 =
        |C1| * SC h ξ ^ max b1 b2 + |C2| * SC h ξ ^ max b1 b2 := by ring
    rw [e]
    linarith

signature.name: ujet5_inv_v5
signature.statement:
∀ {ι : Type} (h : ℝ) (P : ι → Cyl → Prop) (f : ι → Cyl → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
    UJet5 h P f → 0 < c → (∀ i ξ, P i ξ → c ≤ f i ξ) → UJet5 h P (fun i η => (f i η)⁻¹)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ι h P f c hf hc hlow
  obtain ⟨hf1, hf2⟩ := hf
  
  have key : ∀ (F : Cyl → ℝ) (V : Set Cyl) (a : Cyl) (T : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl), IsOpen V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → a ∈ V → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro F V a T hV hF ha i
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
    have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  
  have hloc : ∀ i ξ, P i ξ → ∃ U : Set Cyl, IsOpen U ∧ ξ ∈ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f i) U ∧
      ∀ η ∈ U, 0 < f i η := by
    intro i ξ hi
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hξU, hfU⟩ := hf1 i ξ hi
    exact ⟨U ∩ f i ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0, hfU.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hU isOpen_Ioi,
      ⟨hξU, lt_of_lt_of_le hc (hlow i ξ hi)⟩, hfU.mono Set.inter_subset_left, fun η hη => hη.2⟩
  have hinvs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    (contDiffOn_inv ℝ).mono (fun x hx => Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mpr (ne_of_gt hx))
  
  have hinvb : ∀ (j : ℕ) (y : ℝ), c ≤ y →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) y‖ ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ) * (1 / c) ^ (j + 1) := by
    intro j y hy
    have hy0 : 0 < y := lt_of_lt_of_le hc hy
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate]
    have e : (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) = Inv.inv := rfl
    rw [e, iter_deriv_inv]
    have e2 : (-1 - (j:ℤ)) = -((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [e2, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow,
      one_mul, norm_inv, norm_pow, Real.norm_of_nonneg hy0.le, Real.norm_natCast]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    rw [one_div_pow, one_div]
    exact inv_anti₀ (pow_pos hc _) (pow_le_pow_left₀ hc.le hy _)
  refine ⟨fun i ξ hi => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨U, hU, hξU, hfU, hpos⟩ := hloc i ξ hi
    exact ⟨U, hU, hξU, hinvs.comp hfU (fun η hη => hpos η hη)⟩
  · 
    choose Cf bf hCf using hf2
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = max 1 (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cf j|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Bx, hBx⟩ : ∃ Bx : ℝ, Bx = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bf j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Cg, hCg⟩ : ∃ Cg : ℝ, Cg = (k.factorial : ℝ) * (max 1 (1 / c)) ^ (k + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hM1 : 1 ≤ M := by rw [hM]; exact le_max_left _ _
    have hBx0 : 0 ≤ Bx := by rw [hBx]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    refine ⟨(k.factorial : ℝ) * Cg * M ^ k, Bx * k, fun i ξ hi => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hξU, hfU, hpos⟩ := hloc i ξ hi
    have hS1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ SC h ξ := by
      unfold SC
      have : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + |Real.log (qC h ξ)| := by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC h ξ))]
      exact one_le_pow₀ this
    have hS0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ SC h ξ := by linarith
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = M * SC h ξ ^ Bx := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hSB1 : 1 ≤ SC h ξ ^ Bx := Real.one_le_rpow hS1 hBx0
    have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by rw [hD]; nlinarith
    have hNBf : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k → NB h (f i) j ξ ≤ D ^ j := by
      intro j hj1 hjk
      have hjm : j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
      have a1 := hCf j i ξ hi
      have a2 : Cf j * SC h ξ ^ bf j ≤ |Cf j| * SC h ξ ^ bf j :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hS0 _)
      have a3 : SC h ξ ^ bf j ≤ SC h ξ ^ Bx := by
        refine Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 (le_trans (le_abs_self _) ?_)
        rw [hBx]
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |bf j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) hjm
      have a4 : |Cf j| ≤ M := by
        rw [hM]
        exact le_trans (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cf j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) hjm)
          (le_max_right _ _)
      have a5 : |Cf j| * SC h ξ ^ bf j ≤ M * SC h ξ ^ Bx :=
        mul_le_mul a4 a3 (Real.rpow_nonneg hS0 _) (by linarith)
      calc NB h (f i) j ξ ≤ D := by rw [hD]; linarith
        _ ≤ D ^ j := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
    have hcy : c ≤ f i ξ := hlow i ξ hi
    have hCgb : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) (f i ξ)‖ ≤ Cg := by
      intro j hj
      refine le_trans (hinvb j (f i ξ) hcy) ?_
      rw [hCg]
      have m1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ max 1 (1 / c) := le_max_left _ _
      have b1 : (1 / c) ^ (j + 1) ≤ (max 1 (1 / c)) ^ (j + 1) :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (le_max_right _ _) _
      have b2 : (max 1 (1 / c)) ^ (j + 1) ≤ (max 1 (1 / c)) ^ (k + 1) :=
        pow_le_pow_right₀ m1 (by omega)
      have b3 : (j.factorial : ℝ) ≤ k.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le hj
      exact mul_le_mul b3 (b1.trans b2) (by positivity) (by positivity)
    
    obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set Cyl, O = (fun z => ξ + Lnorm h ξ z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hO : IsOpen O := by
      rw [hOdef]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add (Lnorm h ξ).continuous)
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ O := by
      rw [hOdef]; show ξ + Lnorm h ξ 0 ∈ U; rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact hξU
    obtain ⟨Φ, hΦdef⟩ : ∃ Φ : Cyl → ℝ, Φ = fun z => f i (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ O := by
      rw [hΦdef]
      exact hfU.comp (contDiff_const.add (Lnorm h ξ).contDiff).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hOdef] at hz; exact hz)
    have hΦmaps : Set.MapsTo Φ O (Set.Ioi 0) := by
      intro z hz; rw [hΦdef]; rw [hOdef] at hz; exact hpos _ hz
    have hΦ0 : Φ 0 = f i ξ := by
      rw [hΦdef]; show f i (ξ + Lnorm h ξ 0) = f i ξ; rw [map_zero, add_zero]
    have hCw : ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) (Set.Ioi 0) (Φ 0)‖ ≤ Cg := by
      intro j hj
      rw [hΦ0, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j isOpen_Ioi
        (show f i ξ ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) from hpos ξ hξU)]
      exact hCgb j hj
    have hDw : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j Φ O 0‖ ≤ D ^ j := by
      intro j hj1 hjk
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hO h0O, hΦdef, key (f i) U ξ (Lnorm h ξ) hU hfU hξU j]
      exact hNBf j hj1 hjk
    have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hinvs hΦ (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn hO.uniqueDiffOn hΦmaps h0O (C := Cg) (D := D) hCw hDw
    have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (f i η)⁻¹) U := hinvs.comp hfU (fun η hη => hpos η hη)
    have hNBeq : NB h (fun η => (f i η)⁻¹) k ξ =
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => (f i (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z))⁻¹) 0‖ := by
      have := key (fun η => (f i η)⁻¹) U ξ (Lnorm h ξ) hU hG hξU k
      unfold NB
      rw [this]
    have hEq : (fun z => (f i (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z))⁻¹) = (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) ∘ Φ := by
      rw [hΦdef]; rfl
    calc NB h (fun η => (f i η)⁻¹) k ξ
        = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) ∘ Φ) 0‖ := by rw [hNBeq, hEq]
      _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k ((fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) ∘ Φ) O 0‖ := by
          rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hO h0O]
      _ ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) * Cg * D ^ k := hFdB
      _ = (k.factorial : ℝ) * Cg * M ^ k * SC h ξ ^ (Bx * k) := by
          rw [hD, mul_pow, ← Real.rpow_natCast (SC h ξ ^ Bx) k, ← Real.rpow_mul hS0]
          ring

signature.name: nb_cvec5_v5
signature.statement:
∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (z : ℂ) (N : Fin 3 → Cyl → ℝ), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U →
    (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (N j) U) →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η j => z * ((N j η : ℝ) : ℂ)) U ∧
    ∀ k : ℕ, NB h (fun η j => z * ((N j η : ℝ) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤ ‖z‖ * ∑ j : Fin 3, NB h (N j) k ξ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h U ξ z N hU hξ hN
  set G : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ) := fun η j => z * ((N j η : ℝ) : ℂ) with hGdef
  set gc : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ := z • Complex.ofRealCLM with hgc
  have hgc_apply : ∀ r : ℝ, gc r = z * (r : ℂ) := by
    intro r
    simp [hgc, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have s1 : ∀ j : Fin 3, (fun η => G η j) = ⇑gc ∘ N j := by
    intro j
    funext η
    simp only [Function.comp, hgc_apply, hGdef]
  have hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G U := by
    refine contDiffOn_pi.mpr (fun j => ?_)
    rw [s1 j]
    exact gc.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (hN j)
  refine ⟨hA, ?_⟩
  intro k
  have hG : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ G ξ := hA.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)
  have hNj : ∀ j, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (N j) ξ := fun j => (hN j).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)
  have hk : ((k : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have s4 : ∀ (j : Fin 3) (v : Fin k → Cyl),
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k G ξ v j = gc (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (N j) ξ v) := by
    intro j v
    have ha := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left
      (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) j) hG (i := k) hk
    have hb := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left gc (hNj j) (i := k) hk
    have hc : (⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) j) ∘ G) =
        ⇑gc ∘ N j := by
      rw [← s1 j]; rfl
    rw [hc, hb] at ha
    have hd := congrArg (fun T => T v) ha
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp,
      ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply] at hd
    exact hd.symm
  have hNB0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ NB h (N i) k ξ := fun i => by unfold NB; exact norm_nonneg _
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ ‖z‖ * ∑ j : Fin 3, NB h (N j) k ξ :=
    mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hNB0 i))
  show ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k G ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ ≤ _
  refine ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound hM0 (fun m => ?_)
  have hQ : 0 ≤ ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
  refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hM0 hQ)).mpr (fun j => ?_)
  rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, s4, hgc_apply, norm_mul,
    Complex.norm_real]
  have h5 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (N j) ξ (fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m i))‖ ≤
      NB h (N j) k ξ * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := by
    have := ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (N j) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
      (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)).le_opNorm m
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply] at this
    unfold NB
    exact this
  have h6 : NB h (N j) k ξ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, NB h (N i) k ξ :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => hNB0 i) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  calc ‖z‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (N j) ξ (fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m i))‖
      ≤ ‖z‖ * (NB h (N j) k ξ * ∏ i, ‖m i‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h5 (norm_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ ‖z‖ * ((∑ i : Fin 3, NB h (N i) k ξ) * ∏ i, ‖m i‖) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h6 hQ) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = ‖z‖ * (∑ j : Fin 3, NB h (N j) k ξ) * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := by ring

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hB hG
  obtain ⟨hΩo, hbase⟩ := geom_slow_base_smooth_v5 B hB
  obtain ⟨l2, cr, Cr, hcr, hrep⟩ := rep_consts_v5 B G hB hG
  obtain ⟨l5, C5, h5⟩ := vco_nb_v5 B hB
  obtain ⟨l12, h12⟩ := slow_profile_dir_nb_v5 B hB
  choose C12 hC12 using h12
  choose C11 hC11 using inv_r_nb_v5 B hB
  obtain ⟨hh, hh1, hXa, -, -, -, -, hqB0, hqB1, -⟩ := hB.2.1
  have hr0 : 0 < G.r0 := hG.1.1
  have hr0' : G.r0 ≤ 1 / 100 := hG.1.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℕ → ℝ, A = fun k => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (|C12 j| + |C11 j|) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Cf, hCf⟩ : ∃ Cf : ℕ → ℝ, Cf = fun k =>
      |Cr| * |G.ustar| + |Cr| + 2 ^ k * (8 * |C5| * |Cr| * A k) + |Cr| * A k := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have main : ∀ (k : ℕ) (i : ℕ × Lab) (ξ : Cyl), GoodPt5 B G (l2 + l5 + l12 + n0) i ξ →
      (∃ U : Set Cyl, IsOpen U ∧ ξ ∈ U ∧ ∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => nPhi5 B G i.2 η j) U) ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η => nPhi5 B G i.2 η j) k ξ ≤ Cf k * SC B.h ξ ^ (1:ℝ) := by
    intro k i ξ hi
    obtain ⟨l0, γ⟩ := i
    obtain ⟨hl0, hAct, hlγ, hξl, hwin1, hwin2, hX1, hX2, hxi, het⟩ := hi
    have hl0' : l2 + l5 + l12 + n0 ≤ l0 := hl0
    have hlγ' : l0 ≤ γ.1 := hlγ
    have hAct' : ActiveL4 B G γ := hAct

  obtain ⟨Nr, hNr⟩ : ∃ Nr : Fin 3 → Cyl → ℝ, Nr = fun j η => ![(0:ℝ), 0, s2 η] j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ),
      N = fun _ _ η j => (-1 : ℂ) * ((Nr j η : ℝ) : ℂ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩

      rw [hsh, key]
    have hq : qC B.h (shY ξ c) = qC B.h ξ := rfl

    simp only

def viscGood5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : Prop :=
  ActiveL4 B G γ ∧ l0 ≤ γ.1 ∧ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 ∧ qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 ∧
  B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb ∧ |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 ∧
  |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8
noncomputable def dvF5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  dR B.h (fun η => dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) η) ξ + dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ / ξ.1 + dZ (fun η => dZ (phiL5 B G γ) η) ξ
noncomputable def viscA5 (B : BG) (w : WC) : WC := fun γ m η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • w γ m η
noncomputable def vDR5 (B : BG) (a : WC) : WC := fun γ m ξ => dR B.h (a γ m) ξ
noncomputable def vDZ5 (a : WC) : WC := fun γ m ξ => dZ (a γ m) ξ
noncomputable def vInt5 (a : WC) : WC := fun γ m ξ => (m : ℂ) • a γ m ξ
noncomputable def vCr5 (N : Fin 3 → ℂ) (a : WC) : WC := fun γ m ξ => crossC N (a γ m ξ)
noncomputable def vSm5 (μ : Lab → Cyl → ℂ) (a : WC) : WC := fun γ m ξ => μ γ ξ • a γ m ξ
noncomputable def vC5 (z : ℂ) : Lab → Cyl → ℂ := fun _ _ => z
noncomputable def vS5 (B : BG) : Lab → Cyl → ℂ := fun _ η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ)
noncomputable def vR5 : Lab → Cyl → ℂ := fun γ η => ((Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) / η.1 : ℝ) : ℂ)
noncomputable def vQ5 : Lab → Cyl → ℂ := fun γ _ => (((Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)
noncomputable def vK5 (B : BG) : Lab → Cyl → ℂ := fun γ _ => (((kb B.h γ.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
noncomputable def vN5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (i : Fin 3) : Lab → Cyl → ℂ :=
  fun γ η => ((nPhi5 B G γ η i : ℝ) : ℂ)
noncomputable def vD5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) : Lab → Cyl → ℂ := fun γ η => ((dvF5 B G γ η : ℝ) : ℂ)
noncomputable def visc5Terms (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (w : WC) : WC :=
  vSm5 (vC5 (-1)) (vSm5 (vS5 B) (vDR5 B (vDR5 B (viscA5 B w))))
  + vSm5 (vC5 (-1)) (vSm5 (vS5 B) (vSm5 vR5 (vSm5 vQ5 (vDR5 B (viscA5 B w)))))
  + vSm5 (vC5 (-1)) (vSm5 (vS5 B) (vDZ5 (vDZ5 (viscA5 B w))))
  + vSm5 (vC5 (-2 * Complex.I)) (vSm5 (vS5 B) (vSm5 (vK5 B) (vSm5 (vN5 B G 0)
      (vSm5 vQ5 (vInt5 (vDR5 B (viscA5 B w)))))))
  + vSm5 (vC5 (-2 * Complex.I)) (vSm5 (vS5 B) (vSm5 (vK5 B) (vSm5 (vN5 B G 2)
      (vSm5 vQ5 (vInt5 (vDZ5 (viscA5 B w)))))))
  + vSm5 (vC5 (-Complex.I)) (vSm5 (vS5 B) (vSm5 (vK5 B) (vSm5 (vD5 B G) (vInt5 (viscA5 B w)))))
  + vSm5 (vC5 (-1)) (vSm5 (vS5 B) (vSm5 vR5 (vSm5 vR5 (vSm5 vQ5 (vSm5 vQ5
      (vCr5 ![0, 0, 1] (vCr5 ![0, 0, 1] (viscA5 B w))))))))
  + vSm5 (vC5 (2 * Complex.I)) (vSm5 (vS5 B) (vSm5 (vK5 B) (vSm5 (vN5 B G 1) (vSm5 vR5 (vSm5 vQ5
      (vSm5 vQ5 (vCr5 ![0, 0, -1] (vInt5 (viscA5 B w)))))))))
def viscFacOK5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (μ : Lab → Cyl → ℂ) (β : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), viscGood5 B G l0 γ ξ → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (μ γ) ξ ∧
    ∀ c : ℝ × ℝ, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c → μ γ (shY ξ c) = μ γ ξ) ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), viscGood5 B G l0 γ ξ →
    NB B.h (μ γ) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * β) * SC B.h ξ ^ b

  have hpow : 0 < (2:ℝ) ^ (-((l':ℝ) - 1)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _
  have hqlt : qC B.h ξ < (2:ℝ) ^ (-((l':ℝ) - 1)) := by
    rw [← Real.log_lt_log_iff hq0 hpow, Real.log_rpow two_pos]; linarith
  have hloc : ∀ q' : ℝ, 0 < q' → q' < (2:ℝ) ^ (-((l':ℝ) - 1)) →
      coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ) ≤ coarseIdx B.h q' := by
    intro q' hq'0 hq'lt
    have hlog' : Real.log q' < -((l':ℝ) - 1) * Real.log 2 := by
      have := Real.log_lt_log hq'0 hq'lt
      rwa [Real.log_rpow two_pos] at this
    have hx' : ((l' - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) < -Real.log q' / Real.log 2 := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega), lt_div_iff₀ hl2]; push_cast; linarith
    have hb' : l' ≤ bandOf q' := by
      have := Nat.lt_ceil.mpr hx'
      rw [← hbof q' hq'0] at this; omega
    have e1 : coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ) = bandIdx B.h (l' - 4) := by unfold coarseIdx; rw [← hl']
    have e2 : coarseIdx B.h q' = bandIdx B.h (bandOf q' - 4) := rfl
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact hbmono (l' - 4) (bandOf q' - 4) (by omega) (by omega)
  
  have hO : IsOpen ({η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} ∩ {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
  have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
    hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
  have hφc : Continuous (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
      ({η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} ∩ {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
    intro η hη
    have h' : η.2.2.1 < 1 := hη.2
    exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - η.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
  have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
      (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
      ({η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} ∩ {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφc.continuousOn hmaps
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} ∩ {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
  have hξO : ξ ∈ ({η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} ∩ {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1}) := ⟨hξ'.1, hξ'.2.1⟩
  have hcA : ContinuousAt (qC B.h) ξ := hcont.continuousAt (hO.mem_nhds hξO)
  have E1 : ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, qC B.h η < (2:ℝ) ^ (-((l':ℝ) - 1)) :=
    hcA.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hqlt)
  have E2 : ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, η ∈ ({η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} ∩ {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
    hO.mem_nhds hξO
  filter_upwards [E1, E2] with η h1 h2
  have h2' : η.2.2.1 < 1 := h2.2
  have hqη : 0 < qC B.h η := (hok.1.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  exact hup _ _ (hloc _ hqη h1) ha

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs α : ℝ) (F : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → SimNorm B.h → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → InM B qs α F → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b d : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (1/2 : ℝ) * dZ F η) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α + 1)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d)

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs α : ℝ) (F : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → SimNorm B.h → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → InM B qs α F → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b d : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (1/2 : ℝ) * dZ F η) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α + 1)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs α F hok hSN hqs0 hqs1 hF k
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qs))
    have e : DomC B.h qs =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio qs := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  have hqpos : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ := fun ξ hξ =>
    (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ.2.1])).1
  have hqCs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      (contDiff_snd.fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
    exact h1.comp h2.contDiffOn (fun η (hη : η ∈ DomC B.h qs) =>
      ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith [hη.2.1])⟩)
  
  have key : ∀ {E G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup G]
      [NormedSpace ℝ G] (F : E → G) (V : Set E) (a : E) (T : Cyl →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → a ∈ V → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro E G _ _ _ _ F V a T hV hF ha i
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set E, s = (fun z : E => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : E) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
    have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  
  have leib : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (U : Set Cyl) (n : ℕ),
      IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (g : Cyl → V), ContDiffOn ℝ n f U → ContDiffOn ℝ n g U →
      NB B.h (fun η => f η • g η) n ξ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h f i ξ * NB B.h g (n - i) ξ := by
    intro ξ V _ _ U n hU hξ f g hf hg
    unfold NB
    generalize Lnorm B.h ξ = L
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage L.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
    have hL0s : L 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
    have hsm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have hsmO : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact (hsm F hF).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
    have key' : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n →
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0 =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF i hi
      have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O
      have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
        hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
      have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + z)) i hs h0s
      have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i ξ 0
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0
          = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑L) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := e2
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [map_zero]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [e3]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
    have hfg : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun η => f η • g η) U := hf.smul hg
    have hl := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_smul_le (hsmO f hf) (hsmO g hg) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O
      (n := n) le_rfl
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => f (ξ + L y) • g (ξ + L y)) n hO h0O] at hl
    rw [← key' _ hfg n le_rfl]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => (fun η => f η • g η) (ξ + L z)) 0‖
        = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f (ξ + L y) • g (ξ + L y)) 0‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ _ := hl
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        have hik : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O,
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => g (ξ + L z)) (n - i) hO h0O,
          key' f hf i hik, key' g hg (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i)]
  
  have hqpow : ∀ (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs,
      NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c) j ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ c := by
    intro c j
    have hN := hSN
    unfold SimNorm at hN
    choose C hC using hN
    obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ,
        A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |Polynomial.eval c (descPochhammer ℝ i)| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by rw [hAdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
    obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |C i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by
      have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k (_ : k ∈ Finset.range (j + 1)) => abs_nonneg (C k))
      rw [hDdef]; linarith
    refine ⟨(j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j, ?_⟩
    intro ξ hξD
    have hξD' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qs := hξD
    have hξ : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξD'.2.1
    have hq1 : qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 := le_trans hξD'.2.2.le hqs1
    have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) :=
        hS.2.2.2.1
      have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
        (contDiff_snd.fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
      exact h1.comp h2.contDiffOn (fun η (hη : η.2.2.1 < 1) =>
        ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith)⟩)
    have hqpos' : ∀ η : Cyl, η.2.2.1 < 1 → 0 < qC B.h η := fun η h =>
      (hS.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos' ξ hξ
    have hU : IsOpen {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd.snd.fst continuous_const
    obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : Cyl → ℝ, F = fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, hadef⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = qC B.h ξ ^ c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    suffices hmain : NB B.h F j ξ ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j * a by
      rw [hFdef, hadef] at hmain; exact hmain
    have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by rw [hadef]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
    have hFU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
      rw [hFdef]
      exact hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos' η hη).ne')
    obtain ⟨Pm, hPmdef⟩ : ∃ Pm : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
        Pm = ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))).prod
          (-((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
            (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hPapp : ∀ η : Cyl, Pm η = (η.2.1, -η.2.2.1) := by
      intro η; rw [hPmdef]; simp
    have hP1 : ‖Pm‖ ≤ 1 := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun η => ?_)
      rw [hPapp η, one_mul, Prod.norm_def (η.2.1, -η.2.2.1)]
      refine max_le ?_ ?_
      · exact (norm_fst_le η.2).trans (norm_snd_le η)
      · exact (norm_neg η.2.2.1).trans_le
          (((norm_fst_le η.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le η.2)).trans (norm_snd_le η))
    obtain ⟨Mq, hMqdef⟩ : ∃ Mq : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
        Mq = (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
          (qC B.h ξ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ, T = Mq.comp Pm := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨w0, hw0def⟩ : ∃ w0 : ℝ × ℝ, w0 = (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hW : IsOpen (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
    have hw0 : w0 ∈ (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := by
      rw [hw0def]; exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hid : ∀ v : Cyl, qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) = simScale B.h (w0 + T v).1 (w0 + T v).2 := by
      intro v
      have e1 : (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.1 = qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1 := by
        simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
      have e2 : (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 = qC B.h ξ * v.2.2.1 := by
        simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
      have e3 : T v = (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1, qC B.h ξ * (-v.2.2.1)) := by
        rw [hTdef, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hPapp v, hMqdef]
        simp [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
      rw [e3, hw0def]
      show simScale B.h (ξ.2.1 + (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.1) (1 - (ξ.2.2.1 + (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1)) =
        simScale B.h (ξ.2.1 + qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1) ((1 - ξ.2.2.1) + qC B.h ξ * (-v.2.2.1))
      rw [e1, e2]
      congr 1
      ring
    obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set Cyl, O = {v : Cyl | (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 < 1} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hOmem : ∀ v, v ∈ O ↔ (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 < 1 := by

          (hCq i ξ hξ).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _))
        have b2 : NB B.h (dZ F) (k - i) ξ ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) * (Cs * W) :=
          (hdZ ξ hξ (k - i)).trans
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hFb (k - i + 1) (by omega)) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _))
        calc (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ)) i ξ * NB B.h (dZ F) (k - i) ξ
            ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * (|Cq i| * qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ)) *
                (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) * (Cs * W)) :=
              mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) b2 (norm_nonneg _)
                (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _)))
          _ = (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cq i| * Cs * (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) * W) := by
              ring
          _ = (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cq i| * Cs * R := by rw [hexp]
    _ = K * Cs * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α + 1)) * SC B.h ξ ^ bs *
          edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← hK, hR]
        ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs α : ℝ) (F : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → SimNorm B.h → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → InM B qs α F → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b d : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (fun η => (qC B.h η ^ (-(1/2) : ℝ) * dZ (qC B.h) η) * F η) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α + 1)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d)

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs α : ℝ) (F : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → SimNorm B.h → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → InM B qs α F → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b d : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (fun η => (qC B.h η ^ (-(1/2) : ℝ) * dZ (qC B.h) η) * F η) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α + 1)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs α F hok hSN hqs0 hqs1 hF k
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qs))
    have e : DomC B.h qs =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio qs := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  have hqpos : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ := fun ξ hξ =>
    (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ.2.1])).1
  have hqCs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      (contDiff_snd.fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
    exact h1.comp h2.contDiffOn (fun η (hη : η ∈ DomC B.h qs) =>
      ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith [hη.2.1])⟩)
  
  have key : ∀ {E G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup G]
      [NormedSpace ℝ G] (F : E → G) (V : Set E) (a : E) (T : Cyl →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → a ∈ V → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro E G _ _ _ _ F V a T hV hF ha i
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set E, s = (fun z : E => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : E) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
    have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  
  have leib : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (U : Set Cyl) (n : ℕ),
      IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (g : Cyl → V), ContDiffOn ℝ n f U → ContDiffOn ℝ n g U →
      NB B.h (fun η => f η • g η) n ξ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h f i ξ * NB B.h g (n - i) ξ := by
    intro ξ V _ _ U n hU hξ f g hf hg
    unfold NB
    generalize Lnorm B.h ξ = L
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage L.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
    have hL0s : L 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
    have hsm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have hsmO : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact (hsm F hF).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
    have key' : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n →
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0 =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF i hi
      have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O
      have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
        hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
      have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + z)) i hs h0s
      have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i ξ 0
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0
          = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑L) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := e2
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [map_zero]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [e3]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
    have hfg : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun η => f η • g η) U := hf.smul hg
    have hl := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_smul_le (hsmO f hf) (hsmO g hg) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O
      (n := n) le_rfl
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => f (ξ + L y) • g (ξ + L y)) n hO h0O] at hl
    rw [← key' _ hfg n le_rfl]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => (fun η => f η • g η) (ξ + L z)) 0‖
        = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f (ξ + L y) • g (ξ + L y)) 0‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ _ := hl
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        have hik : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O,
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => g (ξ + L z)) (n - i) hO h0O,
          key' f hf i hik, key' g hg (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i)]
  
  have hqpow : ∀ (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs,
      NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c) j ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ c := by
    intro c j
    have hN := hSN
    unfold SimNorm at hN
    choose C hC using hN
    obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ,
        A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |Polynomial.eval c (descPochhammer ℝ i)| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by rw [hAdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
    obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |C i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by
      have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k (_ : k ∈ Finset.range (j + 1)) => abs_nonneg (C k))
      rw [hDdef]; linarith
    refine ⟨(j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j, ?_⟩
    intro ξ hξD
    have hξD' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qs := hξD
    have hξ : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξD'.2.1
    have hq1 : qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 := le_trans hξD'.2.2.le hqs1
    have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) :=
        hS.2.2.2.1
      have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
        (contDiff_snd.fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
      exact h1.comp h2.contDiffOn (fun η (hη : η.2.2.1 < 1) =>
        ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith)⟩)
    have hqpos' : ∀ η : Cyl, η.2.2.1 < 1 → 0 < qC B.h η := fun η h =>
      (hS.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos' ξ hξ
    have hU : IsOpen {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd.snd.fst continuous_const
    obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : Cyl → ℝ, F = fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, hadef⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = qC B.h ξ ^ c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    suffices hmain : NB B.h F j ξ ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j * a by
      rw [hFdef, hadef] at hmain; exact hmain
    have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by rw [hadef]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
    have hFU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
      rw [hFdef]
      exact hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos' η hη).ne')
    obtain ⟨Pm, hPmdef⟩ : ∃ Pm : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
        Pm = ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))).prod
          (-((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
            (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hPapp : ∀ η : Cyl, Pm η = (η.2.1, -η.2.2.1) := by
      intro η; rw [hPmdef]; simp
    have hP1 : ‖Pm‖ ≤ 1 := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun η => ?_)
      rw [hPapp η, one_mul, Prod.norm_def (η.2.1, -η.2.2.1)]
      refine max_le ?_ ?_
      · exact (norm_fst_le η.2).trans (norm_snd_le η)
      · exact (norm_neg η.2.2.1).trans_le
          (((norm_fst_le η.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le η.2)).trans (norm_snd_le η))
    obtain ⟨Mq, hMqdef⟩ : ∃ Mq : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
        Mq = (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
          (qC B.h ξ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ, T = Mq.comp Pm := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨w0, hw0def⟩ : ∃ w0 : ℝ × ℝ, w0 = (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hW : IsOpen (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
    have hw0 : w0 ∈ (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := by
      rw [hw0def]; exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hid : ∀ v : Cyl, qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) = simScale B.h (w0 + T v).1 (w0 + T v).2 := by
      intro v
      have e1 : (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.1 = qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1 := by
        simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
      have e2 : (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 = qC B.h ξ * v.2.2.1 := by
        simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
      have e3 : T v = (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1, qC B.h ξ * (-v.2.2.1)) := by
        rw [hTdef, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hPapp v, hMqdef]
        simp [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
      rw [e3, hw0def]
      show simScale B.h (ξ.2.1 + (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.1) (1 - (ξ.2.2.1 + (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1)) =
        simScale B.h (ξ.2.1 + qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1) ((1 - ξ.2.2.1) + qC B.h ξ * (-v.2.2.1))
      rw [e1, e2]
      congr 1
      ring
    obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set Cyl, O = {v : Cyl | (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 < 1} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hOmem : ∀ v, v ∈ O ↔ (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 < 1 := by
      intro v; rw [hOdef]; rfl
    have hcontO : Continuous (fun v : Cyl => (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1) :=
      ((continuous_const.add (Lnorm B.h ξ).continuous).snd.snd.fst)
    have hO : IsOpen O := by rw [hOdef]; exact isOpen_lt hcontO continuous_const
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ O := by
      rw [hOmem, map_zero, add_zero]; exact hξ
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψdef⟩ : ∃ ψ : Cyl → ℝ, ψ = fun v => qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) / qC B.h ξ :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ O := by
      rw [hψdef]
      exact (hqC.comp (contDiff_const.add (Lnorm B.h ξ).contDiff).contDiffOn
        (fun v hv => (hOmem v).1 hv)).div_const _
    have hψpos : ∀ v ∈ O, 0 < ψ v := by
      intro v hv; rw [hψdef]; exact div_pos (hqpos' _ ((hOmem v).1 hv)) hq0
    have hψ0 : ψ 0 = 1 := by
      rw [hψdef]
      show qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ 0) / qC B.h ξ = 1
      rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact div_self hq0.ne'
    have hψeq : ψ = (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ • (fun z : Cyl => simScale B.h (w0 + T z).1 (w0 + T z).2) := by
      rw [hψdef]; funext v
      show qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) / qC B.h ξ =
        (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * simScale B.h (w0 + T v).1 (w0 + T v).2
      rw [hid v, div_eq_inv_mul]
    have hΦ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : Cyl => simScale B.h (w0 + T z).1 (w0 + T z).2) 0 := by
