      (2 * S + Kv * E * S) + Kp * S := by
    refine le_trans (nbadd _ _ ξ k ((cA 1 _).add (cS _ _ 1 _)) cP) ?_
    refine add_le_add ?_ hPot
    refine le_trans (nbadd _ _ ξ k (cA 1 _) (cS _ _ 1 _)) ?_
    exact add_le_add (hdir2 1 wr hwr) (hVel _ 1 habs2)
  rw [← hqdef, ← hEdef, ← hSdef]
  have hfin : NB B.h (velRem5 B D γ m) k ξ ≤ 8 * S + 2 * (Kv * E * S) + Kp * S := by
    linarith
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hS0 (sub_nonneg.2 hE1), mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hKp0 hS0) (sub_nonneg.2 hE1)]

informal_problem.statement:
{V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (h : ℝ) (f : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → V)
    (ξ : Cyl) (k : ℕ) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)) :
    NB h (fun η : Cyl => f (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1)) k ξ ≤ sJet5 f (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (DqS5 h ξ) k

signature.name: nb_of_proj
signature.statement:
{V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (h : ℝ) (f : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → V)
    (ξ : Cyl) (k : ℕ) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)) :
    NB h (fun η : Cyl => f (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1)) k ξ ≤ sJet5 f (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (DqS5 h ξ) k

proof.tactics:
by
  let π : Cyl →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).prod
      (((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))).prod
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp
          ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
            (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))))
  have hπ : ∀ η : Cyl, π η = (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) := fun η => rfl
  have hfun : (fun η : Cyl => f (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1)) = f ∘ ⇑π := rfl
  
  have hπn : ‖π‖ ≤ 1 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun w => ?_)
    rw [hπ, one_mul]
    have h1 : ‖w.1‖ ≤ ‖w‖ := norm_fst_le w
    have h2 : ‖w.2.1‖ ≤ ‖w‖ := (norm_fst_le w.2).trans (norm_snd_le w)
    have h3 : ‖w.2.2.1‖ ≤ ‖w‖ :=
      ((norm_fst_le w.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le w.2)).trans (norm_snd_le w)
    rw [Prod.norm_def, Prod.norm_def]
    exact max_le h1 (max_le h2 h3)
  
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hfu⟩ := hf.contDiffOn (m := (k : ℕ∞ω)) (by exact_mod_cast le_top) (by simp)
  obtain ⟨t, htu, ht_open, hs0t⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hu
  have hft : ContDiffOn ℝ k f t := hfu.mono htu
  have hpre_open : IsOpen (π ⁻¹' t) := ht_open.preimage π.continuous
  have hξt : ξ ∈ π ⁻¹' t := hs0t
  have hchain := π.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right hft ht_open.uniqueDiffOn
    hpre_open.uniqueDiffOn hξt le_rfl
  have e1 : iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k (f ∘ ⇑π) (π ⁻¹' t) ξ = iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (f ∘ ⇑π) ξ :=
    iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hpre_open hξt
  have e2 : iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k f t (π ξ) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) :=
    iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k ht_open hs0t
  rw [e1, e2] at hchain
  have hmain : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η : Cyl => f (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1)) ξ =
      (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => π) := by
    rw [hfun]; exact hchain
  have e : ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).compContinuousLinearMap
      (fun _ => π)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) =
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ : Fin k => DqS5 h ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => π) := by
    ext v
    rfl
  unfold NB sJet5
  rw [hmain, e]
  refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
  rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hπn)

informal_problem.statement:
{E F₁ F₂ F₃ : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F₁]
    [NormedSpace ℝ F₁] [NormedAddCommGroup F₂] [NormedSpace ℝ F₂] [NormedAddCommGroup F₃] [NormedSpace ℝ F₃]
    (Bil : F₁ →L[ℝ] F₂ →L[ℝ] F₃) (f : E → F₁) (g : E → F₂) (x0 : E) (Λ : E →L[ℝ] E) (k : ℕ)
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x0) (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g x0) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => Bil (f x) (g x)) x0 ∧
      sJet5 (fun x => Bil (f x) (g x)) x0 Λ k ≤
        ‖Bil‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * sJet5 f x0 Λ i * sJet5 g x0 Λ (k - i)

signature.name: njet_bilinear
signature.statement:
{E F₁ F₂ F₃ : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F₁]
    [NormedSpace ℝ F₁] [NormedAddCommGroup F₂] [NormedSpace ℝ F₂] [NormedAddCommGroup F₃] [NormedSpace ℝ F₃]
    (Bil : F₁ →L[ℝ] F₂ →L[ℝ] F₃) (f : E → F₁) (g : E → F₂) (x0 : E) (Λ : E →L[ℝ] E) (k : ℕ)
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x0) (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g x0) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => Bil (f x) (g x)) x0 ∧
      sJet5 (fun x => Bil (f x) (g x)) x0 Λ k ≤
        ‖Bil‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * sJet5 f x0 Λ i * sJet5 g x0 Λ (k - i)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hBf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => Bil (f x)) x0 := Bil.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp x0 hf
  refine ⟨hBf.clm_apply hg, ?_⟩
  have hf' : ContDiffAt ℝ k f x0 := hf.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hg' : ContDiffAt ℝ k g x0 := hg.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  obtain ⟨uf, huf, hfu⟩ := hf'.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
  obtain ⟨ug, hug, hgu⟩ := hg'.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
  obtain ⟨O, hOsub, hOopen, hxO⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp (Filter.inter_mem huf hug)
  have hfO : ContDiffOn ℝ k f O := hfu.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).1)
  have hgO : ContDiffOn ℝ k g O := hgu.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).2)
  have hBO : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun x => Bil (f x) (g x)) O :=
    (Bil.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hfO).clm_apply hgO
  obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set E, s = (fun z : E => x0 + z) ⁻¹' O := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hs : IsOpen s := by
    rw [hs_def]; exact hOopen.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
  have hO : IsOpen (⇑Λ ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage Λ.continuous
  have h0s : (0 : E) ∈ s := by
    rw [hs_def]; show x0 + 0 ∈ O; rw [add_zero]; exact hxO
  have hL0s : Λ 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
  have h0O : (0 : E) ∈ ⇑Λ ⁻¹' s := hL0s
  have hsm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : E → W),
      ContDiffOn ℝ k F O → ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun z => F (x0 + z)) s := by
    intro W _ _ F hF
    exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
      (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
  have hsmO : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : E → W),
      ContDiffOn ℝ k F O → ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun z => F (x0 + Λ z)) (⇑Λ ⁻¹' s) := by
    intro W _ _ F hF
    exact (hsm F hF).comp Λ.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
  have key : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : E → W),
      ContDiffOn ℝ k F O → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (x0 + Λ z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F x0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ) := by
    intro W _ _ F hF i hi
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (x0 + Λ z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right Λ (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (x0 + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i x0 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (x0 + Λ z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (x0 + z)) ∘ ⇑Λ) (⇑Λ ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (x0 + z)) s (Λ 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Λ) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (x0 + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Λ) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (x0 + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Λ) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F x0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  have hl := ContinuousLinearMap.norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_le_of_bilinear Bil (hsmO f hfO)
    (hsmO g hgO) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O (n := k) le_rfl
  rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => Bil (f (x0 + Λ y)) (g (x0 + Λ y))) k hO h0O]
    at hl
  unfold sJet5
  rw [← key _ hBO k le_rfl]
  calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => (fun x => Bil (f x) (g x)) (x0 + Λ z)) 0‖
      = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => Bil (f (x0 + Λ y)) (g (x0 + Λ y))) 0‖ := rfl
    _ ≤ _ := hl
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f (x0 + Λ z)) i hO h0O,
        iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => g (x0 + Λ z)) (k - i) hO h0O,
        key f hfO i hik, key g hgO (k - i) (Nat.sub_le k i)]

informal_problem.statement:
{E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (g : E → ℝ) (x0 : E) (Λ : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (k : ℕ) (δ A : ℝ) (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g x0) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδg : δ ≤ |g x0|) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hbd : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → sJet5 g x0 Λ i ≤ A) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => (g x)⁻¹) x0 ∧
      sJet5 (fun x => (g x)⁻¹) x0 Λ k ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 2 * (1 + δ⁻¹) ^ (k + 1) * (1 + A) ^ k

signature.name: njet_inv
signature.statement:
{E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (g : E → ℝ) (x0 : E) (Λ : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (k : ℕ) (δ A : ℝ) (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g x0) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδg : δ ≤ |g x0|) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hbd : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → sJet5 g x0 Λ i ≤ A) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => (g x)⁻¹) x0 ∧
      sJet5 (fun x => (g x)⁻¹) x0 Λ k ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 2 * (1 + δ⁻¹) ^ (k + 1) * (1 + A) ^ k

proof.tactics:
by
  have hne : g x0 ≠ 0 := abs_pos.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hδ hδg)
  refine ⟨hg.inv hne, ?_⟩
  
  have hgk : ContDiffAt ℝ k g x0 := hg.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hgu⟩ := hgk.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
  obtain ⟨t, htu, ht, hxt⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hu
  have hgt : ContDiffOn ℝ k g t := hgu.mono htu
  obtain ⟨U, hUdef⟩ : ∃ U : Set E, U = t ∩ g ⁻¹' {(0:ℝ)}ᶜ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hU : IsOpen U := by
    rw [hUdef]; exact hgt.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage ht isOpen_compl_singleton
  have hxU : x0 ∈ U := by rw [hUdef]; exact ⟨hxt, hne⟩
  have hgU : ContDiffOn ℝ k g U := by rw [hUdef]; exact hgt.mono Set.inter_subset_left
  have hgne : ∀ η ∈ U, g η ∈ ({(0:ℝ)}ᶜ : Set ℝ) := by
    intro η hη; rw [hUdef] at hη; exact hη.2
  have hinvs : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) ({(0:ℝ)}ᶜ) := contDiffOn_inv ℝ
  
  have key : ∀ (F : E → ℝ) (V : Set E) (a : E) (T : E →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ k F V → a ∈ V → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro F V a T hV hF ha i hi
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set E, s = (fun z : E => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : E) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
    have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : E) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun z => F (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  
  have hinvb : ∀ (j : ℕ) (y : ℝ), δ ≤ |y| →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) y‖ ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ) * (δ⁻¹) ^ (j + 1) := by
    intro j y hy
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate]
    have e : (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) = Inv.inv := rfl
    rw [e, iter_deriv_inv]
    have e2 : (-1 - (j:ℤ)) = -((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [e2, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow,
      one_mul, norm_inv, norm_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs y, Real.norm_natCast]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    rw [inv_pow]
    exact inv_anti₀ (pow_pos hδ _) (pow_le_pow_left₀ hδ.le hy _)
  obtain ⟨Cg, hCg⟩ : ∃ Cg : ℝ, Cg = (k.factorial : ℝ) * (1 + δ⁻¹) ^ (k + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCgb : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) (g x0)‖ ≤ Cg := by
    intro j hj
    refine le_trans (hinvb j (g x0) hδg) ?_
    rw [hCg]
    have hi0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ δ⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hδ.le
    have m1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + δ⁻¹ := by linarith
    have b1 : (δ⁻¹) ^ (j + 1) ≤ (1 + δ⁻¹) ^ (j + 1) :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ hi0 (by linarith) _
    have b2 : (1 + δ⁻¹) ^ (j + 1) ≤ (1 + δ⁻¹) ^ (k + 1) :=
      pow_le_pow_right₀ m1 (by omega)
    have b3 : (j.factorial : ℝ) ≤ k.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le hj
    exact mul_le_mul b3 (b1.trans b2) (by positivity) (by positivity)
  
  obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set E, O = (fun z => x0 + Λ z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hO : IsOpen O := by
    rw [hOdef]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add Λ.continuous)
  have h0O : (0 : E) ∈ O := by
    rw [hOdef]; show x0 + Λ 0 ∈ U; rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact hxU
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦdef⟩ : ∃ Φ : E → ℝ, Φ = fun z => g (x0 + Λ z) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ k Φ O := by
    rw [hΦdef]
    exact hgU.comp (contDiff_const.add Λ.contDiff).contDiffOn
      (fun z hz => by rw [hOdef] at hz; exact hz)
  have hΦmaps : Set.MapsTo Φ O ({(0:ℝ)}ᶜ) := by
    intro z hz; rw [hΦdef]; rw [hOdef] at hz; exact hgne _ hz
  have hΦ0 : Φ 0 = g x0 := by
    rw [hΦdef]; show g (x0 + Λ 0) = g x0; rw [map_zero, add_zero]
  have hCw : ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) ({(0:ℝ)}ᶜ) (Φ 0)‖ ≤ Cg := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hΦ0, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j isOpen_compl_singleton
      (show g x0 ∈ ({(0:ℝ)}ᶜ : Set ℝ) from hne)]
    exact hCgb j hj
  have hDw : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j Φ O 0‖ ≤ (1 + A) ^ j := by
    intro j hj1 hjk
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hO h0O, hΦdef, key g U x0 Λ hU hgU hxU j hjk]
    have h1 : sJet5 g x0 Λ j ≤ A := hbd j hj1 hjk
    unfold sJet5 at h1
    calc _ ≤ A := h1
      _ ≤ 1 + A := by linarith
      _ ≤ (1 + A) ^ j := le_self_pow₀ (by linarith) (by omega)
  have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hinvs hΦ le_rfl
    isOpen_compl_singleton.uniqueDiffOn hO.uniqueDiffOn hΦmaps h0O (C := Cg) (D := 1 + A) hCw hDw
  have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun η => (g η)⁻¹) U := hinvs.comp hgU (fun η hη => hgne η hη)
  have hEq : (fun z => (g (x0 + Λ z))⁻¹) = (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) ∘ Φ := by
    rw [hΦdef]; rfl
  have hJeq : sJet5 (fun x => (g x)⁻¹) x0 Λ k =
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => (g (x0 + Λ z))⁻¹) 0‖ := by
    have := key (fun η => (g η)⁻¹) U x0 Λ hU hG hxU k le_rfl
    unfold sJet5
    rw [← this]
  calc sJet5 (fun x => (g x)⁻¹) x0 Λ k
      = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) ∘ Φ) 0‖ := by rw [hJeq, hEq]
    _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k ((fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) ∘ Φ) O 0‖ := by
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hO h0O]
    _ ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) * Cg * (1 + A) ^ k := hFdB
    _ = (k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 2 * (1 + δ⁻¹) ^ (k + 1) * (1 + A) ^ k := by rw [hCg]; ring

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hB R hR k

  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, -, -, -, -, hqB0, hqB1, -, -, -, -⟩ := hB.2.1
  have hNm := simscale_normalized_v4 B.h hh0 hh1 hS

  obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂0, hC₂⟩ := H2 (-(1 - B.h)) k

  obtain ⟨C₄, N, hC₄0, hN0, hC₄⟩ := t0pair_outer_bound B hB k
  refine ⟨2 ^ k * C₂ * R * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * C₄ * D ^ k), N, hN0, ?_⟩
  intro l ξ hdom hX1 hX2 hR1 hR2
  
  have hτ : 0 < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 := by linarith [hdom.2.1]
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).1
  have hq1 : qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 := le_trans hdom.2.2.le hqB1
  have hQb : 0 < Qb l := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hetaC : -1 < etaC B.h ξ ∧ etaC B.h ξ < 1 := by
    have hz := (hS.2.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).2
    have hp : 0 < qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _
    have hp2 : (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h)) ^ 2 = qC B.h ξ ^ (1 - 2 * B.h) := by
      rw [sq, ← Real.rpow_add hq0]; congr 1; ring
    have hz' : ξ.2.1 ^ 2 < (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h)) ^ 2 := by rw [hp2]; exact hz
    have habs := abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq hz' hp.le
    have he : etaC B.h ξ = ξ.2.1 / qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) := by
      rw [etaC, Real.rpow_neg hq0.le, div_eq_mul_inv ξ.2.1]
    rw [he]
    constructor
    · rw [lt_div_iff₀ hp]; linarith [neg_abs_le ξ.2.1]
    · rw [div_lt_iff₀ hp]; linarith [le_abs_self ξ.2.1]
  have hratio : Qb l / qC B.h ξ ≤ R := by
    have h1 := one_div_le_one_div_of_le (div_pos one_pos (by linarith) : (0:ℝ) < 1 / R) hR1
    rwa [one_div_div, one_div_one_div] at h1
  have hew : 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) := by
    unfold edgeWeight; split_ifs <;> positivity
  have hed : 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) := by
    have hX0 : 0 < XC B.h ξ := lt_trans hXa hX1
    unfold edgeDist
    exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX1))
      (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr hX2)))
  obtain ⟨P, hPdef⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = C₄ * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
      edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-N) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hP0 : 0 ≤ P := by rw [hPdef]; exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC₄0 hew) (Real.rpow_nonneg hed.le _)
  have hsJ0 : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → V) (i : ℕ),
      0 ≤ sJet5 f (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (DqS5 B.h ξ) i := by
    intro V _ _ f i; unfold sJet5; exact norm_nonneg _
  have hsum : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (P Q : ℝ), (∀ i, i ≤ n → 0 ≤ a i ∧ a i ≤ P) →
      (∀ i, i ≤ n → 0 ≤ b i ∧ b i ≤ Q) →
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * a i * b (n - i) ≤ 2 ^ n * P * Q := by
    intro n a b P Q ha hb
    have hP : 0 ≤ P := le_trans (ha 0 (Nat.zero_le _)).1 (ha 0 (Nat.zero_le _)).2
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * a i * b (n - i)
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * P * Q := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          have hi' : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          have h1 := ha i hi'
          have h2 := hb (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i)
          have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ n.choose i := Nat.cast_nonneg _
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1.2 hc) h2.2 h2.1 (mul_nonneg hc hP)
      _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ)) * P * Q := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = 2 ^ n * P * Q := by
          congr 2
          exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose n
  
  set Qp : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun s => simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) ^ (-(1 - B.h)) with hQpdef
  set w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ := fun s => (s.1 ^ 2 / (2 * simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2)),
    s.2.1 * simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))) with hwdef
  set T0p : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ := fun p => (B.T0th p.1 p.2, B.T0z p.1 p.2) with hT0pdef
  obtain ⟨Bil, hBil⟩ : ∃ Bil : ℝ →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ),
      Bil = (Qb l ^ (1 - B.h)) • ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hfun : (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => T0star4 B l (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, 0)) =
      fun x => Bil (Qp x) ((T0p ∘ w) x) := by
    funext s
    have hQ0 : 0 ≤ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) := Real.sInf_nonneg (fun x hx => le_of_lt hx.1)
    have e : (Qb l / simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2)) ^ (1 - B.h) =
        Qb l ^ (1 - B.h) * simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) ^ (-(1 - B.h)) := by
      rw [Real.div_rpow hQb.le hQ0, div_eq_mul_inv, Real.rpow_neg hQ0]
    rw [hBil]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, Function.comp_apply,
      smul_smul, hQpdef, hwdef, hT0pdef]
    show (Qb l / simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2)) ^ (1 - B.h) •
      (B.T0th (s.1 ^ 2 / (2 * simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2))) (s.2.1 * simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))),
       B.T0z (s.1 ^ 2 / (2 * simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2))) (s.2.1 * simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)))) = _
    rw [e]
  have hBn : ‖Bil‖ ≤ Qb l ^ (1 - B.h) := by
    rw [hBil]
    have h1 := norm_smul_le (Qb l ^ (1 - B.h))
      (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ : ℝ →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hQb.le _)] at h1
    exact h1.trans (mul_le_of_le_one_right (Real.rpow_nonneg hQb.le _) (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_lsmul_le))
  
  obtain ⟨hQps, hQpb⟩ := hC₂ ξ hdom.2.1 hq1
  obtain ⟨hws, hwb⟩ := hD ξ hdom.1 hdom.2.1 hq1 hX2
  obtain ⟨hTs, hTb⟩ := hC₄ (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) hX1 hX2 hetaC.1 hetaC.2
  have hcomp : ∀ i, i ≤ k → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (T0p ∘ w) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ∧
      sJet5 (T0p ∘ w) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (DqS5 B.h ξ) i ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) * P * D ^ k := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := sjet_comp_le T0p w (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (DqS5 B.h ξ) i P D hws hTs
      (fun j hj => by rw [hPdef]; exact hTb j (le_trans hj hi))
      (fun j hj1 hj2 => hwb j hj1 (le_trans hj2 hi))
    refine ⟨h1, le_trans h2 ?_⟩
    have hf : (i.factorial : ℝ) ≤ k.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le hi
    have hDp : D ^ i ≤ D ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ hD1 hi
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hf hP0) hDp (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hP0)
  have hcs := (hcomp 0 (Nat.zero_le _)).1
  rw [hfun]
  refine ⟨(njet_bilinear Bil Qp (T0p ∘ w) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (DqS5 B.h ξ) 0 hQps hcs).1, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  have hb := (njet_bilinear Bil Qp (T0p ∘ w) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (DqS5 B.h ξ) i hQps hcs).2
  have hs := hsum i (fun j => sJet5 Qp (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (DqS5 B.h ξ) j)
    (fun j => sJet5 (T0p ∘ w) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (DqS5 B.h ξ) j)
    (C₂ * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1 - B.h))) ((k.factorial : ℝ) * P * D ^ k)
    (fun j hj => ⟨hsJ0 _ j, hQpb j (le_trans hj hi)⟩)
    (fun j hj => ⟨hsJ0 _ j, (hcomp j (le_trans hj hi)).2⟩)
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose j : ℝ) * sJet5 Qp (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (DqS5 B.h ξ) j *
      sJet5 (T0p ∘ w) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (DqS5 B.h ξ) (i - j) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hsJ0 _ _)) (hsJ0 _ _))
  have hX0 : 0 ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) * P * D ^ k :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hP0) (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
  have hqp0 : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1 - B.h)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
  have hQR : Qb l ^ (1 - B.h) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1 - B.h)) ≤ R := by
    have e : Qb l ^ (1 - B.h) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1 - B.h)) = (Qb l / qC B.h ξ) ^ (1 - B.h) := by
      rw [Real.div_rpow hQb.le hq0.le, Real.rpow_neg hq0.le, div_eq_mul_inv]
    rw [e]
    calc (Qb l / qC B.h ξ) ^ (1 - B.h) ≤ R ^ (1 - B.h) :=

    _ ≤ Qb l ^ (1 - B.h) * (2 ^ i * (C₂ * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1 - B.h))) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * P * D ^ k)) :=
        mul_le_mul hBn hs hS0 (Real.rpow_nonneg hQb.le _)
    _ = 2 ^ i * C₂ * (Qb l ^ (1 - B.h) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1 - B.h))) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * P * D ^ k) := by ring
    _ ≤ 2 ^ k * C₂ * R * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * P * D ^ k) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hX0
        exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2i hC₂0) hQR
          (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hQb.le _) hqp0) (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hC₂0)
    _ = 2 ^ k * C₂ * R * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * C₄ * D ^ k) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
          edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-N) := by rw [hPdef]; ring

subgoal_signatures.name: sjet_comp_le
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {E F G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (g : F → G) (f : E → F) (x0 : E) (Λ : E →L[ℝ] E) (n : ℕ) (C D : ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x0 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g (f x0) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g (f x0)‖ ≤ C) → (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → sJet5 f x0 Λ i ≤ D ^ i) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (g ∘ f) x0 ∧ sJet5 (g ∘ f) x0 Λ n ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) * C * D ^ n

subgoal_signatures.name: simscale_rpow_sjet
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h p : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → (∀ i : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → simScale h z τ ≤ 1 → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2 ^ p) (z, τ)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => (simScale h z τ ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (simScale h z τ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖ ≤ C * simScale h z τ ^ p) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → qC h ξ ≤ 1 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => simScale h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) ^ p) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → sJet5 (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => simScale h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) ^ p) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (DqS5 h ξ) i ≤ C * qC h ξ ^ p

subgoal_signatures.name: xc_etac_sjet
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → (∀ (p : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → qC h ξ ≤ 1 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => simScale h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) ^ p) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → sJet5 (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => simScale h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) ^ p) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (DqS5 h ξ) i ≤ C * qC h ξ ^ p) → ∀ (Xb : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ D : ℝ, 1 ≤ D ∧ ∀ ξ : Cyl, 0 < ξ.1 → ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → qC h ξ ≤ 1 → XC h ξ < Xb → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.1 ^ 2 / (2 * simScale h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2)), s.2.1 * simScale h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) ^ (-(1/2 - h)))) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → sJet5 (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.1 ^ 2 / (2 * simScale h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2)), s.2.1 * simScale h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) ^ (-(1/2 - h)))) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (DqS5 h ξ) i ≤ D ^ i

subgoal_signatures.name: t0pair_outer_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 ≤ N ∧ ∀ X η : ℝ, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (B.T0th p.1 p.2, B.T0z p.1 p.2)) (X, η) ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (B.T0th p.1 p.2, B.T0z p.1 p.2)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ^ (-N)

subgoal_signatures.name: stp5_simscale_rpow_norm

subgoal_signatures.name: njet_bilinear
subgoal_signatures.statement:
{E F₁ F₂ F₃ : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F₁]
    [NormedSpace ℝ F₁] [NormedAddCommGroup F₂] [NormedSpace ℝ F₂] [NormedAddCommGroup F₃] [NormedSpace ℝ F₃]
    (Bil : F₁ →L[ℝ] F₂ →L[ℝ] F₃) (f : E → F₁) (g : E → F₂) (x0 : E) (Λ : E →L[ℝ] E) (k : ℕ)
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x0) (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g x0) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => Bil (f x) (g x)) x0 ∧

          _ ≤ (M * ∏ j, ‖m j‖) * L := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hμKr (mul_nonneg hM0 hpn)
          _ = M * L * ∏ j, ‖m j‖ := by ring
      · rw [MeasureTheory.integral_undef hint]
        have hz : (0 : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin i => ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (ℝ × ℝ)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => DqS5 B.h ξ) = 0 := by
          ext v <;> first | rfl | simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
        rw [hz, norm_zero]; exact mul_nonneg hM0 hL0.le
    rw [hrep]
    calc _ ≤ M * L := hfin
      _ ≤ |pf| * ‖Q‖ * (2 ^ k * (Y * Y)) * L := by
          rw [hM]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hQpn h2kY) hL0.le
      _ = |K0| * (‖Q‖ * (2 ^ k * (A * A))) * SC B.h ξ ^ (bA + bA) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_add (lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (hSC1 ξ)), hY, ← hpfL]; ring
  
  intro γ ξ hact hdom hη hXa hXb
  have hp := col (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) ξ hact hdom hη hXa hXb
  have hm := col (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) ξ hact hdom hη hXa hXb
  have hHP : HPair5 B G γ = fun s => (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) s, Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) s) := rfl
  rw [hHP]
  refine ⟨hp.1.prodMk hm.1, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  unfold sJet5
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_prodMk hp.1 hm.1 (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)]
  have e : ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true)) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).prod
      (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false)) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1))).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => DqS5 B.h ξ) =
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true)) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => DqS5 B.h ξ)).prod
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false)) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => DqS5 B.h ξ)) := by
    ext m <;> rfl
  rw [e, ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_prod]
  exact max_le (hp.2 i hi) (hm.2 i hi)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hrot : ∀ (h e t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (r z : ℝ), 0 < r →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeF5 h e t Y0 n c) (rotPt r 0 z) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeF5 h e t Y0 n (fun η i => Complex.I * c η i)) (rotPt r 0 z) →
      ∀ (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (a : Fin 3) (θ : ℝ),
      inner ℝ (curl3 (modeF5 h e t Y0 n c) (rotPt r θ z)) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a) =
        Real.cos (n * θ) * inner ℝ (curl3 (modeF5 h e t Y0 n c) (rotPt r 0 z)) (frameAt 0 (r, z, t, Y) a) +
        Real.sin (n * θ) * inner ℝ (curl3 (modeF5 h e t Y0 n (fun η i => Complex.I * c η i)) (rotPt r 0 z))
          (frameAt 0 (r, z, t, Y) a) := by
    have hc : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), rotZ5 φ y 0 = Real.cos φ * y 0 - Real.sin φ * y 1 ∧
        rotZ5 φ y 1 = Real.sin φ * y 0 + Real.cos φ * y 1 ∧ rotZ5 φ y 2 = y 2 := by
      intro φ y
      simp [rotZ5]
    have ext3 : ∀ u v : ℝ³, u 0 = v 0 → u 1 = v 1 → u 2 = v 2 → u = v := by
      intro u v h0 h1 h2
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      · exact h0
      · exact h1
      · exact h2
    have hinv : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), rotZ5 φ (rotZ5 (-φ) y) = y := by
      intro φ y
      obtain ⟨a0, a1, a2⟩ := hc φ (rotZ5 (-φ) y)
      obtain ⟨b0, b1, b2⟩ := hc (-φ) y
      apply ext3
      · rw [a0, b0, b1, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
        linear_combination y 0 * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ
      · rw [a1, b0, b1, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
        linear_combination y 1 * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ
      · rw [a2, b2]
    have hrad : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), rad (rotZ5 φ y) = rad y := by
      intro φ y
      obtain ⟨a0, a1, -⟩ := hc φ y
      unfold rad
      rw [a0, a1]
      congr 1
      linear_combination (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ
    have hlin : ∀ φ : ℝ, ∃ L : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³, ∀ v : ℝ³, L v = rotZ5 φ v := by
      intro φ
      let f : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
        { toFun := rotZ5 φ
          map_add' := fun u v => by
            apply ext3 <;> simp [hc] <;> ring
          map_smul' := fun a u => by
            apply ext3 <;> simp [hc] <;> ring }
      exact ⟨⟨f, f.continuous_of_finiteDimensional⟩, fun v => rfl⟩
    have hinner : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (u v : ℝ³), inner ℝ (rotZ5 φ u) (rotZ5 φ v) = inner ℝ u v := by
      intro φ u v
      have e : ∀ a b : ℝ³, inner ℝ a b = a 0 * b 0 + a 1 * b 1 + a 2 * b 2 := by
        intro a b
        simp [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [e, e]
      obtain ⟨a0, a1, a2⟩ := hc φ u
      obtain ⟨b0, b1, b2⟩ := hc φ v
      rw [a0, a1, a2, b0, b1, b2]
      linear_combination (u 0 * v 0 + u 1 * v 1) * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ
    have hpt : ∀ r φ z : ℝ, rotPt r φ z = rotZ5 φ (rotPt r 0 z) := by
      intro r φ z
      apply ext3 <;> simp [rotPt, hc] <;> ring
    have hframe : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), eR (rotZ5 φ y) = rotZ5 φ (eR y) ∧
        eTh (rotZ5 φ y) = rotZ5 φ (eTh y) ∧ rotZ5 φ eZ = eZ := by
      intro φ y
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · apply ext3 <;> simp [eR, radVec, hc, hrad] <;> ring
      · apply ext3 <;> simp [eTh, azVec, hc, hrad] <;> ring
      · apply ext3 <;> simp [eZ, hc]
    have hphase : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (y : ℝ³) (n : ℤ), 0 < rad y →
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf (rotZ5 φ y) : ℂ)) =
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (φ : ℂ)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ)) := by
      intro φ y n hy
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : ℂ, w = ⟨y 0, y 1⟩ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ : ∃ w' : ℂ, w' = ⟨rotZ5 φ y 0, rotZ5 φ y 1⟩ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hth : thetaOf y = w.arg := by rw [hw]; rfl
      have hth' : thetaOf (rotZ5 φ y) = w'.arg := by rw [hw']; rfl
      have hww : w' = Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * w := by
        obtain ⟨a0, a1, -⟩ := hc φ y
        apply Complex.ext
        · rw [Complex.mul_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im, hw, hw', a0]
        · rw [Complex.mul_im, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im, hw, hw', a1]
          simp only
          ring
      have hnorm : ‖w‖ = rad y := by
        rw [Complex.norm_eq_sqrt_sq_add_sq, hw]
        rfl
      have hw0 : ((‖w‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hnorm]
        exact_mod_cast hy.ne'
      have hnorm' : ‖w'‖ = ‖w‖ := by
        rw [hww, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
      have key : Complex.exp ((w'.arg : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
          Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp ((w.arg : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ hw0
        have h1 := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I w'
        have h2 := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I w
        rw [hnorm'] at h1
        calc ((‖w‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((w'.arg : ℂ) * Complex.I) = w' := h1
          _ = Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * w := hww
          _ = Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (((‖w‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((w.arg : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
              rw [h2]
          _ = _ := by ring
      have hpow : ∀ α : ℝ, Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (α : ℂ)) =
          Complex.exp ((α : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n := by
        intro α
        rw [← Complex.exp_int_mul]
        congr 1
        ring
      rw [hpow, hpow, hpow, hth, hth', key, mul_zpow]
    have hmode : ∀ (h e t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (φ : ℝ) (y : ℝ³),
        0 < rad y → modeF5 h e t Y0 n c (rotZ5 φ y) =
          rotZ5 φ (Real.cos (n * φ) • modeF5 h e t Y0 n c y +
            Real.sin (n * φ) • modeF5 h e t Y0 n (fun η i => Complex.I * c η i) y) := by
      intro h e t Y0 n c φ y hy
      have hP : ptOf (rotZ5 φ y) t (Yph h (rad (rotZ5 φ y)) t + Y0) =
          ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0) := by
        simp only [ptOf, hrad, (hc φ y).2.2]
      have hco : ∀ κ E : ℂ, (κ * (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (φ : ℂ)) * E)).re =
          Real.cos (n * φ) * (κ * E).re + Real.sin (n * φ) * (Complex.I * κ * E).re := by
        intro κ E
        have hx : Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (φ : ℂ)) =
            Complex.exp (((n * φ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
          congr 1
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [hx, show κ * (Complex.exp (((n * φ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * E) =
            Complex.exp (((n * φ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (κ * E) by ring,
          Complex.mul_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im,
          mul_assoc Complex.I, Complex.I_mul_re]
        ring
      obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hlin φ
      obtain ⟨f1, f2, f3⟩ := hframe φ y
      simp only [modeF5, cyl2cart]
      rw [hP, hphase φ y n hy, f1, f2]
      conv_lhs => rw [← f3]
      simp only [← hL, map_add, map_smul, hco]
      module
    have hcurl : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (F G : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (x : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ G x →
        F =ᶠ[nhds (rotZ5 φ x)] (fun y => rotZ5 φ (G (rotZ5 (-φ) y))) →
        curl3 F (rotZ5 φ x) = rotZ5 φ (curl3 G x) := by
      intro φ F G x hG hF
      obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hlin φ
      obtain ⟨L', hL'⟩ := hlin (-φ)
      have hx : L' (L x) = x := by
        rw [hL, hL']
        have := hinv (-φ) x
        rwa [neg_neg] at this
      have hfun : (fun y => rotZ5 φ (G (rotZ5 (-φ) y))) = ⇑L ∘ G ∘ ⇑L' := by
        funext y
        simp only [Function.comp, hL, hL']
      have hD : HasFDerivAt (⇑L ∘ G ∘ ⇑L') (L.comp ((fderiv ℝ G x).comp L')) (L x) := by
        have h1 : HasFDerivAt G (fderiv ℝ G x) (L' (L x)) := by
          rw [hx]
          exact hG.hasFDerivAt
        exact L.hasFDerivAt.comp (L x) (h1.comp (L x) L'.hasFDerivAt)
      have hDF : fderiv ℝ F (rotZ5 φ x) = L.comp ((fderiv ℝ G x).comp L') := by
        rw [hF.fderiv_eq, hfun, ← hL x]
        exact hD.fderiv
      have e0 : L' (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) =
          Real.cos φ • EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 - Real.sin φ • EuclideanSpace.single 1 1 := by
        rw [hL']
        apply ext3 <;> simp [hc]
      have e1 : L' (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) =
          Real.sin φ • EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 + Real.cos φ • EuclideanSpace.single 1 1 := by
        rw [hL']
        apply ext3 <;> simp [hc]
      have e2 : L' (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) = EuclideanSpace.single 2 1 := by
        rw [hL']
        apply ext3 <;> simp [hc]
      apply ext3
      · simp only [curl3, hDF, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, e0, e1, e2, map_add, map_sub, map_smul, hL]
        simp [hc]
        ring
      · simp only [curl3, hDF, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, e0, e1, e2, map_add, map_sub, map_smul, hL]
        simp [hc]
        ring
      · simp only [curl3, hDF, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, e0, e1, e2, map_add, map_sub, map_smul, hL]
        simp [hc]
        linear_combination (fderiv ℝ G x (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) 1 -
          fderiv ℝ G x (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) 0) * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ
    have hcl : ∀ (F1 F2 : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (a b : ℝ) (x : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ F1 x →
        DifferentiableAt ℝ F2 x →
        curl3 (fun y => a • F1 y + b • F2 y) x = a • curl3 F1 x + b • curl3 F2 x := by
      intro F1 F2 a b x h1 h2
      have h1' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => a • F1 y) x := h1.const_smul a
      have h2' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => b • F2 y) x := h2.const_smul b
      have hD : fderiv ℝ (fun y => a • F1 y + b • F2 y) x = a • fderiv ℝ F1 x + b • fderiv ℝ F2 x := by
        rw [fderiv_fun_add h1' h2', fderiv_fun_const_smul h1, fderiv_fun_const_smul h2]
      apply ext3 <;> simp [curl3, hD] <;> ring
    intro h e t Y0 n c r z hr hd1 hd2 Y a θ
    have hradx0 : rad (rotPt r 0 z) = r := by
      simp [rad, rotPt, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
    have hU : IsOpen {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y} := by
      apply isOpen_lt continuous_const
      unfold rad
      fun_prop
    have hmem : rotZ5 θ (rotPt r 0 z) ∈ {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y} := by
      show 0 < rad (rotZ5 θ (rotPt r 0 z))
      rw [hrad, hradx0]
      exact hr
    have hev : modeF5 h e t Y0 n c =ᶠ[nhds (rotZ5 θ (rotPt r 0 z))]
        (fun y => rotZ5 θ ((fun y' => Real.cos (n * θ) • modeF5 h e t Y0 n c y' +
          Real.sin (n * θ) • modeF5 h e t Y0 n (fun η i => Complex.I * c η i) y') (rotZ5 (-θ) y))) := by
      apply Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hmem)
      intro y hy
      have hy' : 0 < rad (rotZ5 (-θ) y) := by
        rw [hrad]
        exact hy
      have := hmode h e t Y0 n c θ (rotZ5 (-θ) y) hy'
      rw [hinv θ y] at this
      exact this
    have hGd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y' => Real.cos (n * θ) • modeF5 h e t Y0 n c y' +
        Real.sin (n * θ) • modeF5 h e t Y0 n (fun η i => Complex.I * c η i) y') (rotPt r 0 z) := by
      have := (hd1.const_smul (Real.cos (n * θ))).add (hd2.const_smul (Real.sin (n * θ)))
      exact this
    have h1 := hcurl θ _ _ (rotPt r 0 z) hGd hev
    rw [hcl _ _ _ _ _ hd1 hd2] at h1
    have hfr : frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a = rotZ5 θ (frameAt 0 (r, z, t, Y) a) := by
      fin_cases a
      · show eR (rotPt r θ z) = rotZ5 θ (eR (rotPt r 0 z))
        rw [hpt r θ z]
        exact (hframe θ _).1
      · show eTh (rotPt r θ z) = rotZ5 θ (eTh (rotPt r 0 z))
        rw [hpt r θ z]
        exact (hframe θ _).2.1
      · show eZ = rotZ5 θ eZ
        exact (hframe θ eZ).2.2.symm
    rw [hpt r θ z, h1, hfr, hinner, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left]
  
  have key : ∀ (qe qA : ℝ) (V W P : ℂ) (φ : ℝ), (qe : ℂ) * V = (qA : ℂ) * (W * P) →
      Real.cos φ * (qe * V.re) + Real.sin φ * (qe * (Complex.I * V).re) =
        qA * (W * (P * Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).re := by
    intro qe qA V W P φ hh
    have h2 : ((qe : ℂ) * V * Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re =
        ((qA : ℂ) * (W * (P * Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))).re := by
      rw [hh]; congr 1; ring
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im] at h2 ⊢
    linear_combination h2
  
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n0, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 hAw hvel
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hl0) hn0.le
  obtain ⟨hDopen, hqCs, hqpos, -, hdcal, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  
  have hi : ∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pq5Vw B G γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro γ m
    have hq1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-B.h)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      hqCs.rpow_const_of_ne (fun ξ hξ => (hqpos ξ hξ).ne')
    have hq2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-B.h))) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      (hdcal _ hq1).2.1
    have hs1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (-B.h) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (hq1.mul contDiffOn_const)).congr
        (fun η _ => (Complex.ofRealCLM_apply _).symm)
    have hs2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((dZ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-B.h)) η : ℝ) : ℂ))
        (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hq2).congr
        (fun η _ => (Complex.ofRealCLM_apply _).symm)
    have hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (velW5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := hvel.2.1 γ m
    have ha' := contDiffOn_pi.1 (hAw.2.1 γ m)
    have hrv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (![-((primState5 B G).Aw γ m η 1), (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η 0, 0] :
        Fin 3 → ℂ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
      refine contDiffOn_pi.2 (fun i => ?_)
      fin_cases i
      · first
        | exact (ha' 1).neg
        | simpa using (ha' 1).neg
      · first
        | exact ha' 0
        | simpa using ha' 0
      · first

    pq5Osc (pq5QOf B G (pq5Vw B G)) γ (2 * s) ξ =
      (1/2 : ℂ) • (pq5T B G γ s (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ s ξ) (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ s) ξ
        + pq5T B G γ s (fun i => starRingEnd ℂ (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ (-s) ξ i))
            (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ s) ξ)

    · intro h
      rw [sub_nonpos, div_le_div_iff₀ hsA hP]
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hlam
      calc lam * P ≤ lam * (A * Real.sqrt A) := this
        _ = lam * A * Real.sqrt A := by ring
  
  have r32 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ^ (3/2:ℝ) = x * Real.sqrt x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, show (3/2:ℝ) = 1 + 1/2 by norm_num, Real.rpow_add hx, Real.rpow_one]
  have mono : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≤ y → x * Real.sqrt x ≤ y * Real.sqrt y := by
    intro x y hx hxy
    rw [← r32 x hx, ← r32 y (lt_of_lt_of_le hx hxy)]
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow hx.le hxy (by norm_num)
  have hsco : ∀ w, sco B G γ w ^ 2 = G.ustar ^ 2 * (1/2 + w / Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) ^ 2 := by
    intro w
    unfold sco
    have : G.ustar / 2 + G.ustar * w / Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 = G.ustar * (1/2 + w / Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) := by
      ring
    rw [this, mul_pow, hsg, one_mul, mul_pow]
  
  have s2 : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (m : ℝ), (∀ w, 0 ≤ w → w ≤ m → 0 ≤ g w) → (∀ w, m ≤ w → g w ≤ 0) →
      ∫ w in m..v, g w ≤ 0 := by
    intro g m h1 h2
    rcases le_or_gt m v with hle | hlt
    · have h3 : 0 ≤ ∫ w in m..v, -g w :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hle (fun w hw => neg_nonneg.mpr (h2 w hw.1))
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_neg] at h3
      linarith
    · rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm]
      have h3 : 0 ≤ ∫ w in v..m, g w :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hlt.le (fun w hw => h1 w (le_trans hv hw.1) hw.2)
      linarith
  have hUr := r32 (1 + G.ustar ^ 2) (by linarith)
  unfold Penv5
  rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]
  apply s2
  · intro w h0 h1
    have hA : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + sco B G γ w ^ 2 := by linarith [sq_nonneg (sco B G γ w)]
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ w / Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 := div_nonneg h0 hL.le
    have ht1 : w / Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 ≤ 1/2 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hL]; linarith
    have ht2 : (1/2 + w / Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      have a1 : 0 ≤ 1/2 + w / Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 := by linarith
      have a2 : 1/2 + w / Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 ≤ 1 := by linarith
      exact pow_le_one₀ a1 a2
    have hAU : 1 + sco B G γ w ^ 2 ≤ 1 + G.ustar ^ 2 := by
      rw [hsco w]
      have := mul_le_of_le_one_right (sq_nonneg G.ustar) ht2
      linarith
    have hm := mono _ _ (by linarith) hAU
    rw [← hUr] at hm
    show 0 ≤ lam0_5 B G γ / Real.sqrt (1 + sco B G γ w ^ 2)
      - epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ))^2 * Bs5 B G γ ^ 2 * (1 + sco B G γ w ^ 2)
    rw [hBs]
    exact (key _ _ _ _ hlam hc hP hA).1 hm
  · intro w h1
    have hA : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + sco B G γ w ^ 2 := by linarith [sq_nonneg (sco B G γ w)]
    have ht1 : 1/2 ≤ w / Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hL]; linarith
    have ht2 : 1 ≤ (1/2 + w / Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) ^ 2 := by
      have a2 : 1 ≤ 1/2 + w / Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 := by linarith
      exact one_le_pow₀ a2
    have hAU : 1 + G.ustar ^ 2 ≤ 1 + sco B G γ w ^ 2 := by
      rw [hsco w]
      have := le_mul_of_one_le_right (sq_nonneg G.ustar) ht2
      linarith
    have hm := mono _ _ (by linarith) hAU
    rw [← hUr] at hm
    show lam0_5 B G γ / Real.sqrt (1 + sco B G γ w ^ 2)
      - epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ))^2 * Bs5 B G γ ^ 2 * (1 + sco B G γ w ^ 2) ≤ 0
    rw [hBs]
    exact (key _ _ _ _ hlam hc hP hA).2 hm

signature.name: etaL_tsupport_card_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl), SimScaleProps h → ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ∀ Γ : Finset Lab, (∀ γ ∈ Γ, ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ)) → Γ.card ≤ 162

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h ξ hS hξ Γ hΓ
  classical
  
  have hLc : ContinuousAt (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) ξ := by
    have hτ : 0 < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 := by linarith
    have hqpos : 0 < qC h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).1
    have hqcont : ContinuousAt (qC h) ξ := by
      have hU : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
      have hp : ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
        ⟨trivial, hτ⟩
      have hg : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) :=
        hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)
      have hk : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) ξ := by fun_prop
      have he : qC h = (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘
          (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
        funext η; rfl
      rw [he]
      exact ContinuousAt.comp hg hk
    exact hqcont.logb hqpos.ne'
  
  have hwin : ∀ (γ : Lab), ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) →
      |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) + (γ.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
      |chartR h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
      |chartZ h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
      |chartT h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
    intro γ hγ
    have s1 : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ → 1 < |φ ξ / μ - (j : ℝ)| →
        ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 := by
      intro μ j φ hφ h1
      have hψ : ContinuousAt (fun η => |φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)|) ξ :=
        ((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs
      have hev := (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : Cyl => (1:ℝ)) ξ).eventually_lt hψ h1
      filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
      have hsq : 1 < (φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)) ^ 2 := (one_lt_sq_iff_one_lt_abs _).mpr hη
      unfold sqPart bumpR
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), zero_div]
    have key : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ →
        (∀ η, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 → etaL h γ η = 0) → |φ ξ / μ - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
      intro μ j φ hφ himp
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      have hev := s1 μ j φ hφ hc
      apply (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mpr _) hγ
      filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
      exact himp η hη
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := key 1 (-(γ.1:ℤ)) (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) hLc
        (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul])
      simpa [div_one, sub_neg_eq_add] using this
    · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.1 (chartR h γ.1) (by unfold chartR; fun_prop)
        (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
    · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.1 (chartZ h γ.1) (by unfold chartZ; fun_prop)
        (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
    · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.2 (chartT h γ.1) (by unfold chartT; fun_prop)
        (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
  
  have hJmem : ∀ (y : ℝ) (j : ℤ), |y - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 → j ∈ Finset.Icc ⌈y - 1⌉ ⌊y + 1⌋ := by
    intro y j hj
    rw [abs_le] at hj
    exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨Int.ceil_le.mpr (by linarith [hj.2]),
      Int.le_floor.mpr (by linarith [hj.1])⟩
  have hJcard : ∀ y : ℝ, (Finset.Icc ⌈y - 1⌉ ⌊y + 1⌋).card ≤ 3 := by
    intro y
    rw [Int.card_Icc]
    have h1 := Int.floor_le (y + 1)
    have h2 := Int.le_ceil (y - 1)
    have h3 : (((⌊y + 1⌋ - ⌈y - 1⌉ : ℤ)) : ℝ) < 3 := by push_cast; linarith
    have h4 : ⌊y + 1⌋ - ⌈y - 1⌉ < 3 := by exact_mod_cast h3
    omega
  
  have hcount : ∀ (x : ℝ) (cR cZ cT : ℕ → ℝ) (D : Finset Lab),
      (∀ γ ∈ D, |x + (γ.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧ |cR γ.1 - (γ.2.1.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |cZ γ.1 - (γ.2.1.2.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧ |cT γ.1 - (γ.2.1.2.2:ℝ)| ≤ 1) → D.card ≤ 162 := by
    intro x cR cZ cT D hD
    have hsub : D ⊆ (Finset.Icc ⌈-x - 1⌉ ⌊-x + 1⌋).biUnion (fun L : ℤ =>
        ({L.toNat} : Finset ℕ) ×ˢ ((Finset.Icc ⌈cR L.toNat - 1⌉ ⌊cR L.toNat + 1⌋ ×ˢ
          (Finset.Icc ⌈cZ L.toNat - 1⌉ ⌊cZ L.toNat + 1⌋ ×ˢ
            Finset.Icc ⌈cT L.toNat - 1⌉ ⌊cT L.toNat + 1⌋)) ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset Bool))) := by
      rintro ⟨l, ⟨j1, j2, j3⟩, σ⟩ hγ
      obtain ⟨w0, wR, wZ, wT⟩ := hD _ hγ
      simp only at w0 wR wZ wT
      refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨(l:ℤ), hJmem _ _ ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Int.cast_natCast, show -x - (l:ℝ) = -(x + l) by ring, abs_neg]
        exact w0
      · rw [Int.toNat_natCast]
        exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_singleton_self _,
          Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hJmem _ _ wR,
            Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hJmem _ _ wZ, hJmem _ _ wT⟩⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩⟩
    refine (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans ?_
    refine Finset.card_biUnion_le.trans ?_
    have hterm : ∀ L ∈ Finset.Icc ⌈-x - 1⌉ ⌊-x + 1⌋,
        (({L.toNat} : Finset ℕ) ×ˢ ((Finset.Icc ⌈cR L.toNat - 1⌉ ⌊cR L.toNat + 1⌋ ×ˢ
          (Finset.Icc ⌈cZ L.toNat - 1⌉ ⌊cZ L.toNat + 1⌋ ×ˢ
            Finset.Icc ⌈cT L.toNat - 1⌉ ⌊cT L.toNat + 1⌋)) ×ˢ
              (Finset.univ : Finset Bool))).card ≤ 54 := by
      intro L _
      rw [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product,
        Finset.card_singleton, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_bool]
      have hm : (Finset.Icc ⌈cR L.toNat - 1⌉ ⌊cR L.toNat + 1⌋).card *
          ((Finset.Icc ⌈cZ L.toNat - 1⌉ ⌊cZ L.toNat + 1⌋).card *
            (Finset.Icc ⌈cT L.toNat - 1⌉ ⌊cT L.toNat + 1⌋).card) ≤ 3 * (3 * 3) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul (hJcard _) (Nat.mul_le_mul (hJcard _) (hJcard _))
      linarith
    refine (Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ 54 hterm).trans ?_
    rw [smul_eq_mul]
    have := hJcard (-x)
    omega
  exact hcount (Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ)) (fun n => chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ))
    (fun n => chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)) (fun n => chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)) Γ
    (fun γ hγ => hwin γ (hΓ γ hγ))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl), IsOpen U → ∀ (f g g' : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (i j : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g' U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (1/2 : ℝ) * (f η i * star (g η j) + f η i * g' η j).re) U ∧ ∀ ξ ∈ U, ∀ k : ℕ, NB h (fun η => (1/2 : ℝ) * (f η i * star (g η j) + f η i * g' η j).re) k ξ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose n : ℝ) * NB h f n ξ * (NB h g (k - n) ξ + NB h g' (k - n) ξ)

signature.name: pair_term_nb_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl), IsOpen U → ∀ (f g g' : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (i j : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g' U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (1/2 : ℝ) * (f η i * star (g η j) + f η i * g' η j).re) U ∧ ∀ ξ ∈ U, ∀ k : ℕ, NB h (fun η => (1/2 : ℝ) * (f η i * star (g η j) + f η i * g' η j).re) k ξ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose n : ℝ) * NB h f n ξ * (NB h g (k - n) ξ + NB h g' (k - n) ξ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h U hU f g g' i j hf hg hg'
  
  have leib : ∀ {F₁ F₂ : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F₁] [NormedSpace ℝ F₁] [NormedAddCommGroup F₂]
      [NormedSpace ℝ F₂] (Bil : F₁ →L[ℝ] F₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (p : Cyl → F₁) (q : Cyl → F₂),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U → ∀ ξ ∈ U, ∀ k : ℕ,
      NB h (fun η => Bil (p η) (q η)) k ξ ≤
        ‖Bil‖ * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose n : ℝ) * NB h p n ξ * NB h q (k - n) ξ := by
    intro F₁ F₂ _ _ _ _ Bil p q hp hq ξ hξ k
    unfold NB
    generalize Lnorm h ξ = L
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage L.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
    have hL0s : L 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
    have hsm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have hsmO : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact (hsm F hF).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
    have key : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → ∀ r : ℕ,
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ r (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0 =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ r F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF r
      have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + L z)) r hO h0O
      have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
        hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := r) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + z)) r hs h0s
      have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) r ξ 0
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ r (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0
          = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ r ((fun z => F (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑L) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ r (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := e2
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ r (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [map_zero]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ r (fun z => F (ξ + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [e3]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ r F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
    have hBO : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => Bil (p η) (q η)) U :=
      (Bil.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hp).clm_apply hq
    have hl := ContinuousLinearMap.norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_le_of_bilinear Bil (hsmO p hp)
      (hsmO q hq) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O (n := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => Bil (p (ξ + L y)) (q (ξ + L y))) k hO h0O]
      at hl
    rw [← key _ hBO k]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => (fun η => Bil (p η) (q η)) (ξ + L z)) 0‖
        = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => Bil (p (ξ + L y)) (q (ξ + L y))) 0‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ _ := hl
      _ = _ := by
        congr 1
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro n _
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => p (ξ + L z)) n hO h0O,
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => q (ξ + L z)) (k - n) hO h0O,
          key p hp n, key q hq (k - n)]
  
  let π1 : (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] ℂ := ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) i
  let π2 : (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] ℂ := ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) j
  let B1 : (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ (Fin 3 → ℂ) ℂ ℝ ((1/2:ℝ) • Complex.reCLM) ∘L
      (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℂ).bilinearComp π1 ((Complex.conjCLE : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ) ∘L π2)
  let B2 : (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ (Fin 3 → ℂ) ℂ ℝ ((1/2:ℝ) • Complex.reCLM) ∘L
      (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℂ).bilinearComp π1 π2
  have hB1 : ∀ u v : Fin 3 → ℂ, B1 u v = (1/2:ℝ) * (u i * star (v j)).re := by
    intro u v; rfl
  have hB2 : ∀ u v : Fin 3 → ℂ, B2 u v = (1/2:ℝ) * (u i * v j).re := by
    intro u v; rfl
  have hnb : ∀ (B : (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c : (Fin 3 → ℂ) → ℂ),
      (∀ v, ‖c v‖ ≤ ‖v‖) → (∀ u v, B u v = (1/2:ℝ) * (u i * c v).re) → ‖B‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro B c hc hB
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound₂ _ zero_le_one (fun u v => ?_)
    rw [hB, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/2)]
    have h1 : |(u i * c v).re| ≤ ‖u i‖ * ‖c v‖ :=
      (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (norm_mul _ _).le
    have h4 : ‖u i‖ * ‖c v‖ ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖v‖ :=
      mul_le_mul (norm_le_pi_norm u i) (hc v) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
    have h5 : 0 ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖v‖ := mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
    nlinarith
  have hB1n : ‖B1‖ ≤ 1 :=
    hnb B1 (fun v => star (v j))
      (fun v => by show ‖star (v j)‖ ≤ ‖v‖; rw [norm_star]; exact norm_le_pi_norm v j) hB1
  have hB2n : ‖B2‖ ≤ 1 :=
    hnb B2 (fun v => v j) (fun v => norm_le_pi_norm v j) hB2
  
  have hT : (fun η => (1/2 : ℝ) * (f η i * star (g η j) + f η i * g' η j).re) =
      fun η => B1 (f η) (g η) + B2 (f η) (g' η) := by
    funext η; rw [hB1, hB2, Complex.add_re]; ring
  have hP1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => B1 (f η) (g η)) U :=
    (B1.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hf).clm_apply hg
  have hP2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => B2 (f η) (g' η)) U :=
    (B2.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hf).clm_apply hg'
  rw [hT]
  refine ⟨hP1.add hP2, fun ξ hξ k => ?_⟩
  
  have hadd : NB h (fun η => B1 (f η) (g η) + B2 (f η) (g' η)) k ξ ≤
      NB h (fun η => B1 (f η) (g η)) k ξ + NB h (fun η => B2 (f η) (g' η)) k ξ := by
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => B1 (f η) (g η)) ξ := hP1.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)
    have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => B2 (f η) (g' η)) ξ := hP2.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((fun η => B1 (f η) (g η)) + (fun η => B2 (f η) (g' η))) ξ =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => B1 (f η) (g η)) ξ +
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => B2 (f η) (g' η)) ξ :=
      iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (h1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        (h2.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    have e0 : (fun η => B1 (f η) (g η) + B2 (f η) (g' η)) =
        (fun η => B1 (f η) (g η)) + (fun η => B2 (f η) (g' η)) := rfl
    unfold NB
    rw [e0, e1]
    have e2 : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => B1 (f η) (g η)) ξ +
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => B2 (f η) (g' η)) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => B1 (f η) (g η)) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) +
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => B2 (f η) (g' η)) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) := by
      ext v
      simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e2]
    exact norm_add_le _ _
  have l1 := leib B1 f g hf hg ξ hξ k
  have l2 := leib B2 f g' hf hg' ξ hξ k
  have S1nn : 0 ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose n : ℝ) * NB h f n ξ * NB h g (k - n) ξ :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun n _ =>
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)) (norm_nonneg _))
  have S2nn : 0 ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose n : ℝ) * NB h f n ξ * NB h g' (k - n) ξ :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun n _ =>
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)) (norm_nonneg _))
  have m1 := mul_le_of_le_one_left S1nn hB1n
  have m2 := mul_le_of_le_one_left S2nn hB2n
  have e : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose n : ℝ) * NB h f n ξ *
      (NB h g (k - n) ξ + NB h g' (k - n) ξ) =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose n : ℝ) * NB h f n ξ * NB h g (k - n) ξ +
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose n : ℝ) * NB h f n ξ * NB h g' (k - n) ξ := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro n _
    ring
  rw [e]
  linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G qs α a b H i j hok ha hH ξ0 hξ0
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qs))
    have e : DomC B.h qs =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio qs := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  have etaL_local_finite_v5 : ∀ (h : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → ∀ ξ0 : Cyl, ξ0.2.2.1 < 1 → ∃ N ∈ nhds ξ0, ∃ Γ : Finset Lab, ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ N → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) → γ ∈ Γ := by
    intro h hS ξ0 hξ0
    have hLc : ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ContinuousAt (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) ξ := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hτ : 0 < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 := by linarith
      have hqpos : 0 < qC h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).1
      have hqcont : ContinuousAt (qC h) ξ := by
        have hU : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
        have hp : ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
          ⟨trivial, hτ⟩
        have hg : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) :=
          hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)
        have hk : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) ξ := by fun_prop
        have he : qC h = (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘
            (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
          funext η; rfl
        rw [he]
        exact ContinuousAt.comp hg hk
      exact hqcont.logb hqpos.ne'
    have hwin : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (γ : Lab), ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) →
        |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) + (γ.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartR h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartZ h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartT h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
      intro ξ γ hξ hγ
      have s1 : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ → 1 < |φ ξ / μ - (j : ℝ)| →
          ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 := by
        intro μ j φ hφ h1
        have hψ : ContinuousAt (fun η => |φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)|) ξ :=
          ((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs
        have hev := (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : Cyl => (1:ℝ)) ξ).eventually_lt hψ h1
        filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
        have hsq : 1 < (φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)) ^ 2 := (one_lt_sq_iff_one_lt_abs _).mpr hη
        unfold sqPart bumpR
        rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), zero_div]
      have key : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ →
          (∀ η, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 → etaL h γ η = 0) → |φ ξ / μ - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
        intro μ j φ hφ himp
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have hev := s1 μ j φ hφ hc
        apply (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mpr _) hγ
        filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
        exact himp η hη
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have := key 1 (-(γ.1:ℤ)) (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) (hLc ξ hξ)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul])
        simpa [div_one, sub_neg_eq_add] using this
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.1 (chartR h γ.1) (by unfold chartR; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.1 (chartZ h γ.1) (by unfold chartZ; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.2 (chartT h γ.1) (by unfold chartT; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
    obtain ⟨L0, hL0⟩ : ∃ L0 : ℝ, L0 = Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hfin : (⋃ n ∈ Set.Iic ⌊2 - L0⌋₊, ({n} : Set ℕ) ×ˢ
        ((Set.Icc ⌈chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ⌈chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ⌈chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋) ×ˢ
          (Set.univ : Set Bool))).Finite := by
      refine Set.Finite.biUnion (Set.finite_Iic _) (fun n _ => ?_)
      exact (Set.finite_singleton n).prod (((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod
        ((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod (Set.finite_Icc _ _))).prod Set.finite_univ)
    have hI : ∀ (x c : ℝ) (j : ℤ), |x - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 → |x - c| < 1 → j ∈ Set.Icc ⌈c - 2⌉ ⌊c + 2⌋ := by
      intro x c j hj hc
      rw [abs_le] at hj
      rw [abs_lt] at hc
      exact ⟨Int.ceil_le.mpr (by linarith [hj.2, hc.1]), Int.le_floor.mpr (by linarith [hj.1, hc.2])⟩
    have hcR : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartR h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartR; fun_prop
    have hcZ : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartZ h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartZ; fun_prop
    have hcT : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartT h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartT; fun_prop
    have hch : ∀ (φ : Cyl → ℝ) (μ : ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ0 →
        ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, |φ ξ / μ - φ ξ0 / μ| < 1 := by
      intro φ μ hφ
      exact (((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs).eventually_lt continuousAt_const
        (by simp)
    have e1 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 :=
      (show ContinuousAt (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.2.2.1) ξ0 by fun_prop).eventually_lt
        continuousAt_const hξ0
    have e2 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) - L0| < 1 :=
      (((hLc ξ0 hξ0).sub continuousAt_const).abs).eventually_lt continuousAt_const
        (by simp [hL0])
    have e3 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊2 - L0⌋₊ + 1),
        |chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 := by
      rw [Filter.eventually_all_finset]
      intro n _
      exact (hch _ _ (hcR n)).and ((hch _ _ (hcZ n)).and (hch _ _ (hcT n)))
    refine ⟨{ξ | ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) - L0| < 1 ∧
        ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊2 - L0⌋₊ + 1),
        |chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1}, ?_,
      hfin.toFinset, ?_⟩
    · filter_upwards [e1, e2, e3] with ξ h1 h2 h3
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    rintro ⟨n, ⟨a, b, c⟩, σ⟩ ξ ⟨ht, hL, hC⟩ hγ
    obtain ⟨w0, wR, wZ, wT⟩ := hwin ξ _ ht hγ
    simp only at w0 wR wZ wT
    rw [abs_le] at w0
    rw [abs_lt] at hL
    have hn : n ≤ ⌊2 - L0⌋₊ := Nat.le_floor (by linarith [w0.2, hL.1])
    obtain ⟨cR, cZ, cT⟩ := hC n (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn))
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨n, hn, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨rfl, ⟨hI _ _ _ wR cR, hI _ _ _ wZ cZ, hI _ _ _ wT cT⟩, trivial⟩
  have hξ1 : ξ0.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ0.2.1
  obtain ⟨N, hN, Γ, hΓ⟩ := etaL_local_finite_v5 B.h hok.1 ξ0 hξ1
  have hT0 : ∀ γ m η, a γ m η = 0 →
      (1/2 : ℝ) * (a γ m η i * star (b γ m η j) + a γ m η i * b γ (-m) η j).re = 0 := by
    intro γ m η h
    have : a γ m η i = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
    rw [this]; simp
  refine ⟨interior N ∩ DomC B.h qs, isOpen_interior.inter hDopen,
    ⟨mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr hN, hξ0⟩, Set.inter_subset_right, Γ, fun η hη => ?_⟩
  have hoff : ∀ γ m, γ ∉ Γ → a γ m η = 0 := by
    intro γ m hγ
    by_contra hne
    exact hγ (hΓ γ η (interior_subset hη.1) (ha.2.2.2.1 γ m η hη.2 hne).2.1)
  have hin : ∀ γ, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, (1/2 : ℝ) * (a γ m η i * star (b γ m η j) + a γ m η i * b γ (-m) η j).re =
      ∑ m ∈ H, (1/2 : ℝ) * (a γ m η i * star (b γ m η j) + a γ m η i * b γ (-m) η j).re := by
    intro γ
    apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
    rw [Function.support_subset_iff']
    intro m hm
    exact hT0 γ m η (by rw [hH γ m (fun hh => hm (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hh))]; rfl)
  have hout : (Function.support fun γ => ∑ m ∈ H,
      (1/2 : ℝ) * (a γ m η i * star (b γ m η j) + a γ m η i * b γ (-m) η j).re) ⊆ ↑Γ := by
    rw [Function.support_subset_iff']
    intro γ hγ
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro m _
    exact hT0 γ m η (hoff γ m (fun hh => hγ (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hh)))
  unfold wmoPair5
  rw [finsum_congr hin, finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ hout]

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G γ ξ hB hξ hxi het
  
  have hbase0 : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} ∧
      ∀ (l : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => baseC B l (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) i)

    have hA : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by

        ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))) η :=
      hasFDerivAt_snd.fst
    have hX : HasFDerivAt (fun y : Cyl => y.1) (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) η :=
      hasFDerivAt_fst
    have hv : HasFDerivAt (fun y : Cyl => A * ℓ y + c) (A • ℓ) η :=
      (ℓ.hasFDerivAt.const_mul A).add_const c
    have hF := ((hY1.const_mul C1).add (hX.const_mul C2)).sub (hv.mul hPd)
    have hev : phiL5 B G γ =ᶠ[nhds η] ((fun y : Cyl => C1 * y.2.1) + (fun y : Cyl => C2 * y.1) -

      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hη) (fun y hy => ?_)
      show phiL5 B G γ y = C1 * y.2.1 + C2 * y.1 - (A * ℓ y + c) * pcPhi2_5 B G γ (y.1, y.2.1, y.2.2.1)
      have hP : pang5 B G γ * Fang B γ.1 y + pzr5 B G γ * baseC B γ.1 y 2 =
          pcPhi2_5 B G γ (y.1, y.2.1, y.2.2.1) := rfl
      rw [hℓ y]

      rw [hP, hAff y hy, hC1, hC2]
      unfold chartZ RC
      ring

    have key : ∀ d : Cyl, fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) η d = C1 * d.2.1 + C2 * d.1 -

      intro d

      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,

    have e0 : DrC B γ.1 (phiL5 B G γ) η = sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 * (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) := by
      have h1 := key ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)
      dsimp only at h1
      show Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) • fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) η ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) = _
      rw [smul_eq_mul, h1]
      linear_combination hC2' - (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * pcPhi2_5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) * A) *
        hlv (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1))
    have e2 : DzC B γ.1 (phiL5 B G γ) η = pzr5 B G γ - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 * (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) := by
      have h2 := key ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ))
      dsimp only at h2
      show Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) • fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) η ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) = _
      rw [smul_eq_mul, h2]
      linear_combination hC1' - (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * pcPhi2_5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) * A) * hl0
    unfold nPhi5
    rw [e0, e2]

by

  have s1 : ∀ (h : ℝ) (l : ℕ), 1 ≤ l → 0 < cib h l ∧ cib h l * (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
