    rw [hfr Y' hY', hTsub, hTsub, hlin, ha, hc0]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U : Set Cyl, U = (fun η : Cyl => η.2.2.2) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hUo : IsOpen U := by rw [hU]; exact hVo.preimage (by fun_prop)
  have hξU : ξ ∈ U := by rw [hU]; exact hYV
  have hev : (fun η : Cyl => vco B.h r0 γ c η.2.2.2) =ᶠ[nhds ξ]
      (fun η : Cyl => a * lamT η.2.2.2 + c0) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hξU) (fun η hη => by
      rw [hU] at hη; exact haff η.2.2.2 hη)
  have hNBeq : ∀ j : ℕ, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => vco B.h r0 γ c η.2.2.2) j ξ =
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => a * lamT η.2.2.2 + c0) j ξ := by
    intro j
    unfold NB
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds]
  
  obtain ⟨lT, hlTd⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ, f = (1 / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) •
      (bgc • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ + ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hlT : ∀ y, lT y = lamT y := by
    intro y; rw [hlTd]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', smul_eq_mul]
    unfold lamT; ring
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓd⟩ : ∃ f : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ, f = a • lT.comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)))) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hℓ : ∀ v : Cyl, ℓ v = a * lamT v.2.2.2 := by
    intro v; rw [hℓd]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', smul_eq_mul, hlT]
  have hgfun : (fun η : Cyl => a * lamT η.2.2.2 + c0) = fun η => ℓ η + c0 := by
    funext η; rw [hℓ]
  have hfd : ∀ x, fderiv ℝ (fun η : Cyl => a * lamT η.2.2.2 + c0) x = ℓ := by
    intro x; rw [hgfun]; exact (ℓ.hasFDerivAt.add_const c0).fderiv
  have hLn : ∀ v : Cyl, (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.2 = JpowL (-coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) v.2.2.2 :=
    fun v => rfl
  
  have hl1r : (1:ℝ) ≤ (γ.1 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hl
  have hl2 : (0:ℝ) < (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ 2 * Tgc ^ 4 * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hT4' : 0 ≤ Tgc ^ 4 * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hT4 : Tgc * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ Tgc ^ 4 * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_self_pow₀ hT1.le (by norm_num)) hl2.le
  have hinv0 : 0 ≤ 1 / cib B.h γ.1 := (one_div_pos.mpr hcpos).le
  
  have hk0 : NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => a * lamT η.2.2.2 + c0) 0 ξ ≤ 2 * Tgc ^ 4 * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have hb : NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => a * lamT η.2.2.2 + c0) 0 ξ ≤ |a * lamT ξ.2.2.2 + c0| := by
      unfold NB
      apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (abs_nonneg _)
      intro m
      rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply,
        Fin.prod_univ_zero, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hval : a * lamT ξ.2.2.2 + c0 = vco B.h r0 γ c ξ.2.2.2 := (haff ξ.2.2.2 hYV).symm
    rw [hval] at hb
    have hv : |vco B.h r0 γ c ξ.2.2.2| ≤ (1/8 + 1/100) * (1 / cib B.h γ.1) := by
      unfold vco
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hcpos, div_eq_mul_one_div]
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hinv0
      calc |etG B.h γ c ξ.2.2.2 + r0| ≤ |etG B.h γ c ξ.2.2.2| + |r0| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ 1/8 + 1/100 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hr0]; linarith
    have h1 : (1/8 + 1/100) * (1 / cib B.h γ.1) ≤ (1/8 + 1/100) * (Tgc * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcinv.le (by norm_num)
    have h2 : 0 ≤ Tgc * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
    linarith
  
  have hk1 : NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => a * lamT η.2.2.2 + c0) 1 ξ ≤ 2 * Tgc ^ 4 * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ 3/2 * |a| * Tgc ^ (-coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (abs_nonneg a)) (zpow_pos hT0 _).le
    have hb : NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => a * lamT η.2.2.2 + c0) 1 ξ ≤
        3/2 * |a| * Tgc ^ (-coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) := by
      unfold NB
      apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound hM0
      intro m
      rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, iteratedFDeriv_one_apply, hfd,
        Fin.prod_univ_one, hℓ, Real.norm_eq_abs, hLn, hJL, abs_mul, abs_mul,
        abs_of_pos (zpow_pos hT0 _)]
      have hY : ‖(m 0).2.2.2‖ ≤ ‖m 0‖ :=
        (norm_snd_le _).trans ((norm_snd_le _).trans (norm_snd_le _))
      have hX : |lamT (m 0).2.2.2| ≤ 3/2 * ‖m 0‖ := by linarith [hlamb (m 0).2.2.2]
      calc |a| * (Tgc ^ (-coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) * |lamT (m 0).2.2.2|)
          ≤ |a| * (Tgc ^ (-coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) * (3/2 * ‖m 0‖)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hX (zpow_pos hT0 _).le) (abs_nonneg a)
        _ = 3/2 * |a| * Tgc ^ (-coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) * ‖m 0‖ := by ring
    have hapos : 0 < a := by rw [ha]; exact div_pos (zpow_pos hT0 _) hcpos
    rw [abs_of_pos hapos] at hb
    have hz3 : Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1 + -coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) ≤ Tgc ^ (3:ℤ) :=
      zpow_le_zpow_right₀ hT1.le (by omega)
    have h3 : Tgc ^ (3:ℤ) = Tgc ^ 3 := zpow_natCast Tgc 3
    have he : a * Tgc ^ (-coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) =
        Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1 + -coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) * (1 / cib B.h γ.1) := by
      rw [ha, zpow_add₀ hT0.ne']; ring
    have hm : Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1 + -coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) * (1 / cib B.h γ.1) ≤
        Tgc ^ 3 * (Tgc * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
      rw [← h3]; exact mul_le_mul hz3 hcinv.le hinv0 (zpow_pos hT0 _).le
    have e4 : Tgc ^ 3 * (Tgc * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2) = Tgc ^ 4 * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
    have h5 : 3/2 * (a * Tgc ^ (-coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ))) ≤ 3/2 * (Tgc ^ 4 * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
      rw [he, ← e4]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm (by norm_num)
    have e5 : 3/2 * a * Tgc ^ (-coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) =
        3/2 * (a * Tgc ^ (-coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ))) := by ring
    rw [e5] at hb
    linarith
  
  have hk2 : ∀ j : ℕ, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => a * lamT η.2.2.2 + c0) (j + 2) ξ = 0 := by
    intro j
    have hz : iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j + 1 + 1) (fun η : Cyl => a * lamT η.2.2.2 + c0) ξ = 0 := by
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_right]
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, hfd, iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (by omega : j + 1 ≠ 0),
        Pi.zero_apply]
      exact LinearIsometryEquiv.map_zero _
    show NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => a * lamT η.2.2.2 + c0) (j + 1 + 1) ξ = 0
    unfold NB
    rw [hz]
    have e0 : (0 : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin (j + 1 + 1) => Cyl) ℝ).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) = 0 := by
      ext m
      simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e0, norm_zero]
  rw [hNBeq k]
  match k with
  | 0 => exact hk0
  | 1 => exact hk1
  | j + 2 => rw [hk2 j]; exact hC0

informal_problem.statement: ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (l l0 : ℕ), l1 ≤ l0 → l0 ≤ l → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb l → qC B.h ξ / Qb l < 4 → B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb → ∀ F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, (F = pcFa5 B l ∨ F = pcB5 B l 2) → NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) k ξ ≤ C ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ B.h

signature.name: slow_profile_dir_nb_v5
signature.statement: ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (l l0 : ℕ), l1 ≤ l0 → l0 ≤ l → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb l → qC B.h ξ / Qb l < 4 → B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb → ∀ F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, (F = pcFa5 B l ∨ F = pcB5 B l 2) → NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) k ξ ≤ C ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ B.h

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hB
  
  have nbdir : ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (F : Cyl → ℝ) (w : Cyl), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → ∀ k : ℕ,
      NB h (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm h ξ w)) k ξ ≤ ‖w‖ * NB h F (k + 1) ξ := by
    intro h U ξ F w hU hξ hF k
    have hFd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) ξ :=
      (hF.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)
    have hcomp : (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm h ξ w)) =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ (Lnorm h ξ w)) ∘ (fderiv ℝ F) := by
      funext η; rfl
    have hit : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm h ξ w)) ξ =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ (Lnorm h ξ w)).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ F) ξ) := by
      rw [hcomp]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left _ hFd (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hNB0 : 0 ≤ NB h F (k + 1) ξ := norm_nonneg _
    unfold NB
    rw [hit]
    apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hNB0)
    intro m
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply]
    have key : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ F) ξ (fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m i))) (Lnorm h ξ w) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ))
          (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w) := by
      rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right]
      have e1 : Fin.init (fun i : Fin (k+1) => Lnorm h ξ (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i)) =
          fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m i) := by
        funext i
        simp [Fin.init, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      rw [e1]
      simp only [Fin.snoc_last]
    rw [key]
    have hprod : ∏ i : Fin (k+1), ‖Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i‖ =
        (∏ i : Fin k, ‖m i‖) * ‖w‖ := by
      rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
      simp [Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ *
          ∏ i : Fin (k+1), ‖Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i‖ :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ = ‖w‖ * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ *
          ∏ i : Fin k, ‖m i‖ := by rw [hprod]; ring
  
  have hbase0 : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} ∧
      ∀ (l : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => baseC B l (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) i)
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
    obtain ⟨hS, hBP⟩ := hB
    have hsc : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hA : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
      have hm : Continuous (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2)) := by fun_prop
      have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2)))
          {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} := by
        refine hsc.comp hm.continuousOn ?_
        intro s hs
        have hs' : s.2.2 < 1 := hs
        exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - s.2.2 by linarith⟩
      have hU : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
      have h1 := hc.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := B.qB))
      have h2 : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst
      have e : {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} =
          {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1} ∩ ({s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} ∩
            ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2))) ⁻¹'
              Iio B.qB) := by
        ext s
        simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_inter_iff, mem_preimage, mem_Iio, Function.comp]
      rw [e]
      exact h2.inter h1
    have hD : IsOpen (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      have hm : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)) := by fun_prop
      have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)))
          {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
        refine hsc.comp hm.continuousOn ?_
        intro w hw
        have hw' : w.2 < 1 := hw
        exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 by linarith⟩
      have hU : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
      have h1 := hc.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := B.qB))
      have e : simDomain B.h B.qB = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
          ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2))) ⁻¹' Iio B.qB := by
        ext w
        simp only [simDomain, mem_setOf_eq, mem_inter_iff, mem_preimage, mem_Iio, Function.comp]
      rw [e]
      exact h1
    have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(uB B)) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      have hAB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿B.AB) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := hBP.2.2.2.1.1
      have hBv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿B.BvB) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := hBP.2.2.2.1.2.1
      have hDA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z) (simDomain B.h B.qB) :=
        ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hD).1 hAB).2
      have hc : ∀ (v : ℝ³) (j : Fin 3),
          ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (v, (0:ℝ)) j) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
        intro v j
        have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (v, (0:ℝ))) (simDomain B.h B.qB) :=
          hDA.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
        exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h1
      let e0 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1
      let e1 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 1 1
      let e2 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 2 1
      have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e1, (0:ℝ)) 2 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e2, (0:ℝ)) 1) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e2, (0:ℝ)) 0 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e0, (0:ℝ)) 2) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e0, (0:ℝ)) 1 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e1, (0:ℝ)) 0) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) + (↿B.BvB) z) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
        refine ((((hc e1 2).sub (hc e2 1)).smul contDiffOn_const).add
          (((hc e2 0).sub (hc e0 2)).smul contDiffOn_const)).add
          (((hc e0 1).sub (hc e1 0)).smul contDiffOn_const) |>.add hBv
      refine hg.congr ?_
      rintro ⟨y, s⟩ hz
      have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s) :=
        (hAB.contDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have hpart : fderiv ℝ (fun w => B.AB w s) y =
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := by
        have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ³ => (w, s)) (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) y :=
          hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left y s
        have h2 : HasFDerivAt ((↿B.AB) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ => (w, s)))
            ((fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)) y :=
          HasFDerivAt.comp (g := ↿B.AB) y hdiff.hasFDerivAt h1
        exact h2.fderiv
      show curl3 (fun w => B.AB w s) y + B.BvB y s = _
      unfold curl3
      rw [hpart]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.inl_apply]
      rfl
    have frame : ∀ r z : ℝ, 0 < r → (rotPt r 0 z) 2 = z ∧
        eR (rotPt r 0 z) = EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) ∧
        eTh (rotPt r 0 z) = EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) := by
      intro r z hr
      have h0 : (rotPt r 0 z) 0 = r := by simp [rotPt]
      have h1 : (rotPt r 0 z) 1 = 0 := by simp [rotPt]
      have h2 : (rotPt r 0 z) 2 = z := by simp [rotPt]
      have hrad : rad (rotPt r 0 z) = r := by
        unfold rad
        rw [h0, h1]
        simp [Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
      refine ⟨h2, ?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold eR radVec
        rw [hrad, h0, h1, zero_smul, add_zero, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
      · unfold eTh azVec

  intro h U ξ hU hξ f g hf hg k
  
  have leib : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (U : Set Cyl) (n : ℕ),
      IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (g : Cyl → V), ContDiffOn ℝ n f U → ContDiffOn ℝ n g U →
      NB h (fun η => f η • g η) n ξ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h g (n - i) ξ := by
    intro V _ _ U n hU hξ f g hf hg
    unfold NB
    generalize Lnorm h ξ = L
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage L.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
    have hL0s : L 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
    have hsm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have hsmO : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact (hsm F hF).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
    have key : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n →
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0 =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF i hi
      have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O
      have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
        hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
      have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + z)) i hs h0s
      have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i ξ 0
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0
          = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑L) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := e2
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [map_zero]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [e3]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
    have hfg : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun η => f η • g η) U := hf.smul hg
    have hl := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_smul_le (hsmO f hf) (hsmO g hg) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O
      (n := n) le_rfl
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => f (ξ + L y) • g (ξ + L y)) n hO h0O] at hl
    rw [← key _ hfg n le_rfl]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => (fun η => f η • g η) (ξ + L z)) 0‖
        = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f (ξ + L y) • g (ξ + L y)) 0‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ _ := hl
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        have hik : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O,
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => g (ξ + L z)) (n - i) hO h0O,
          key f hf i hik, key g hg (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i)]
  have hfk : ContDiffOn ℝ k f U := hf.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hgk : ContDiffOn ℝ k g U := hg.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hfa : ContDiffAt ℝ k f ξ := hfk.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)
  have hga : ContDiffAt ℝ k g ξ := hgk.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)
  refine ⟨?_, fun a b => ?_, fun a => ?_⟩
  · 
    have l1 := leib U k hU hξ f g hfk hgk
    have l1' : NB h (fun η => f η * g η) k ξ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
        (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h g (k - i) ξ := l1
    exact l1'
  · 
    unfold NB
    have hfa' : ContDiffAt ℝ k (fun η => a * f η) ξ := contDiffAt_const.mul hfa
    have hga' : ContDiffAt ℝ k (fun η => b * g η) ξ := contDiffAt_const.mul hga
    have e0 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => a * f η + b * g η) ξ =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => a * f η) ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => b * g η) ξ :=
      iteratedFDeriv_add_apply hfa' hga'
    have ea : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => a * f η) ξ = a • iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ := by
      have := iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply (a := a) hfa
      exact this
    have eb : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => b * g η) ξ = b • iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g ξ := by
      have := iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply (a := b) hga
      exact this
    rw [e0, ea, eb]
    have e2 : (a • iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ + b • iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) =
        a • (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) +
        b • (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) := by
      ext m; simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e2]
    refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  · 
    unfold NB
    have hle := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
      (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun _ : Cyl => a) ξ) (fun _ : Fin k => Lnorm h ξ)
    split_ifs with hk
    · subst hk
      rw [Fin.prod_univ_zero, mul_one, norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hle
      exact hle
    · have hz : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun _ : Cyl => a) ξ = 0 := by
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne hk a]; rfl
      rw [hz] at hle ⊢
      rw [norm_zero, zero_mul] at hle
      exact hle

informal_problem.statement: ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), 0 < ξ.1 → ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb l → B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ → NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb l) / η.1) k ξ ≤ C

signature.name: inv_r_nb_v5
signature.statement: ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), 0 < ξ.1 → ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb l → B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ → NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb l) / η.1) k ξ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hB k
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hB.2.1.2.2.1
  
  have key : ∀ {E G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup G]
      [NormedSpace ℝ G] (F : E → G) (V : Set E) (a : E) (T : Cyl →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → a ∈ V → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro E G _ _ _ _ F V a T hV hF ha i
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set E, s = (fun z : E => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : E) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
    have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ : ∃ ρ : ℝ, ρ = (Real.sqrt B.Xa)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨2 * (k.factorial : ℝ) * ρ ^ (k + 1), ?_⟩
  intro l ξ hr ht hwin hX
  have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hB.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hQ : 0 < Qb l := by unfold Qb; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = Real.sqrt (Qb l) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s = Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := by rw [hs]; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by rw [hc]; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  
  have hQ4 : Qb l ≤ 4 * qC B.h ξ := by
    have h1 : 1/4 * Qb l < qC B.h ξ := (lt_div_iff₀ hQ).mp hwin
    linarith
  have hc2 : c ≤ 2 * s := by
    rw [hc, hs]
    calc Real.sqrt (Qb l) ≤ Real.sqrt (4 * qC B.h ξ) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hQ4
      _ = Real.sqrt 4 * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num) _
      _ = 2 * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := by
          rw [show (4:ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]
  
  have hX0 : B.Xa / 2 < ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ) := hX
  have hX' : B.Xa / 2 * (2 * qC B.h ξ) < ξ.1 ^ 2 := (lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith)).mp hX0
  have hX2 : 0 < Real.sqrt B.Xa := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hXa
  have hkey : Real.sqrt B.Xa * s ≤ ξ.1 := by
    rw [hs, ← Real.sqrt_mul hXa.le]
    calc Real.sqrt (B.Xa * qC B.h ξ) ≤ Real.sqrt (ξ.1 ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith)
      _ = ξ.1 := Real.sqrt_sq hr.le
  have hsr : s * ξ.1⁻¹ ≤ ρ := by
    rw [hρ]
    calc s * ξ.1⁻¹ = (Real.sqrt B.Xa)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt B.Xa * s) * ξ.1⁻¹ := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hX2.ne', one_mul]
      _ ≤ (Real.sqrt B.Xa)⁻¹ * ξ.1 * ξ.1⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkey (inv_nonneg.mpr hX2.le))
            (inv_nonneg.mpr hr.le)
      _ = (Real.sqrt B.Xa)⁻¹ := by rw [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr.ne', mul_one]
  
  have hV : IsOpen {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst
  have hFV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => c / η.1) {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} :=
    contDiffOn_const.div contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun η (hη : 0 < η.1) => hη.ne')
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ : ∃ π : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ, π = ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hfun : ∀ z : Cyl, (fun η : Cyl => c / η.1) (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z) =
      (fun x : ℝ => c * x⁻¹) (ξ.1 + (s • π) z) := by
    intro z
    show c / (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z).1 = c * (ξ.1 + (s • π) z)⁻¹
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    congr 1
    rw [hπ, hs]; simp [Lnorm]
  have hfunEq : (fun z : Cyl => (fun η : Cyl => c / η.1) (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) =
      (fun z : Cyl => (fun x : ℝ => c * x⁻¹) (ξ.1 + (s • π) z)) := funext hfun
  have hinvS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => c * x⁻¹) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    contDiffOn_const.mul ((contDiffOn_id (s := Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))).inv
      (fun x (hx : (0:ℝ) < x) => hx.ne'))
  have e1 := key (fun η : Cyl => c / η.1) {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hV hFV hr k
  have e2 := key (fun x : ℝ => c * x⁻¹) (Set.Ioi 0) ξ.1 (s • π) isOpen_Ioi hinvS hr k
  have hNBeq : NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => c / η.1) k ξ =
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x : ℝ => c * x⁻¹) ξ.1).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => s • π)‖ := by
    unfold NB
    rw [← e1, hfunEq, e2]
  have hπ1 : ‖π‖ ≤ 1 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun η => ?_)
    rw [hπ]
    show ‖η.1‖ ≤ 1 * ‖η‖
    rw [one_mul]
    exact norm_fst_le η
  have hn : ‖s • π‖ ≤ s := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hs0]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right hs0 hπ1
  have hprod : ∏ _i : Fin k, ‖s • π‖ ≤ s ^ k := by
    rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hn k
  have hz : ξ.1 ^ ((-1 : ℤ) - (k : ℤ)) = ξ.1⁻¹ ^ (k + 1) := by
    rw [show ((-1 : ℤ) - (k : ℤ)) = -((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast,
      inv_pow]
  have hcm : iteratedDeriv k (fun x : ℝ => c * x⁻¹) ξ.1 =
      c * iteratedDeriv k (Inv.inv : ℝ → ℝ) ξ.1 := by
    rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field]
  have hd : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x : ℝ => c * x⁻¹) ξ.1‖ =
      c * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ξ.1⁻¹ ^ (k + 1)) := by
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, hcm, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate, iter_deriv_inv, hz,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, one_mul,
      Nat.abs_cast, abs_of_pos (pow_pos (inv_pos.mpr hr) _), abs_of_nonneg hc0]
  have hbound : NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => c / η.1) k ξ ≤
      c * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ξ.1⁻¹ ^ (k + 1)) * s ^ k := by
    rw [hNBeq]
    refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
    rw [hd]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod
      (mul_nonneg hc0 (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hr.le) _)))
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ s * ξ.1⁻¹ := mul_nonneg hs0 (inv_nonneg.mpr hr.le)
  have hpow : (s * ξ.1⁻¹) ^ (k + 1) ≤ ρ ^ (k + 1) := pow_le_pow_left₀ ht0 hsr _
  have hfac : (0:ℝ) ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hM : 0 ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) * ξ.1⁻¹ ^ (k + 1) * s ^ k :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hfac (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hr.le) _)) (pow_nonneg hs0 _)
  rw [← hc]
  calc NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => c / η.1) k ξ
      ≤ c * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ξ.1⁻¹ ^ (k + 1)) * s ^ k := hbound
    _ = c * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ξ.1⁻¹ ^ (k + 1) * s ^ k) := by ring
    _ ≤ (2 * s) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ξ.1⁻¹ ^ (k + 1) * s ^ k) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc2 hM
    _ = 2 * (k.factorial : ℝ) * (s * ξ.1⁻¹) ^ (k + 1) := by ring
    _ ≤ 2 * (k.factorial : ℝ) * ρ ^ (k + 1) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (by positivity)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ∀ (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), 0 < ξ.1 → ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → qC B.h ξ / Qb l < 4 → XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb → ∀ k : ℕ, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => RC l η) k ξ ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt B.Xb + 2

signature.name: rc_nb_v5
signature.statement: ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ∀ (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), 0 < ξ.1 → ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → qC B.h ξ / Qb l < 4 → XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb → ∀ k : ℕ, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => RC l η) k ξ ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt B.Xb + 2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hB l ξ hr ht hqQ hX k
  
  have key : ∀ {E G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup G]
      [NormedSpace ℝ G] (F : E → G) (V : Set E) (a : E) (T : Cyl →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → a ∈ V → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro E G _ _ _ _ F V a T hV hF ha i
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set E, s = (fun z : E => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : E) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
    have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap

    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  
  have hexp : ∀ (A : WC) (θ' : ℝ) (η : Cyl), (∀ γ m, A γ m η ≠ 0 → γ ∈ Γ ∧ m ∈ H) →
      waveV5 B G A θ' η = ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, (fun i => (modeCoef5 B G A γ m η i *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ)) : ℂ) * (θ' : ℂ))).re) := by
    intro A θ' η hA
    funext i
    have hph : ∀ γ m, A γ m η i * ephase5 B G γ m θ' η = modeCoef5 B G A γ m η i *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ)) : ℂ) * (θ' : ℂ)) := by
      intro γ m
      simp only [ephase5, modeCoef5]
      rw [mul_assoc (A γ m η i), ← Complex.exp_add]
      congr 2
      push_cast
      ring
    have hin : ∀ γ, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, A γ m η i * ephase5 B G γ m θ' η =
        ∑ m ∈ H, A γ m η i * ephase5 B G γ m θ' η := by
      intro γ
      apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
      rw [Function.support_subset_iff']
      intro m hm
      by_contra hne
      have hA0 : A γ m η ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hne (by simp [h0])
      exact hm (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (hA γ m hA0).2)
    have hout : (Function.support fun γ => ∑ m ∈ H, A γ m η i * ephase5 B G γ m θ' η) ⊆ ↑Γ := by
      rw [Function.support_subset_iff']
      intro γ hγ
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro m _
      by_contra hne
      have hA0 : A γ m η ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hne (by simp [h0])
      exact hγ (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (hA γ m hA0).1)
    simp only [waveV5, Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [finsum_congr hin, finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ hout, Complex.re_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
    rw [Complex.re_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
    rw [hph]
  
  have hcyl_sum : ∀ (y : ℝ³) {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      cyl2cart y (∑ j ∈ s, v j) = ∑ j ∈ s, cyl2cart y (v j) := by
    intro y ι s v
    let L : (Fin 3 → ℝ) →+ ℝ³ := AddMonoidHom.mk' (cyl2cart y) (fun c d => by
      simp only [cyl2cart, Pi.add_apply, add_smul]; abel)
    exact map_sum L v s
  
  have hcurl : ∀ (F F' : ℝ³ → ℝ³) {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → ℝ³ → ℝ³) (x : ℝ³),
      F' =ᶠ[nhds x] (fun y => F y + ∑ i ∈ s, g i y) → DifferentiableAt ℝ F x →
      (∀ i ∈ s, DifferentiableAt ℝ (g i) x) → curl3 F' x = curl3 F x + ∑ i ∈ s, curl3 (g i) x := by
    intro F F' ι s g x hev hF hg
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ F' x = fderiv ℝ F x + ∑ i ∈ s, fderiv ℝ (g i) x := by
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_fun_add hF (DifferentiableAt.fun_sum hg), fderiv_fun_sum hg]
    let cH : (ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) →+ ℝ³ := AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun L =>
      (L (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) 2 - L (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
      (L (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) 0 - L (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) 2) • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
      (L (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) 1 - L (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) 0) • EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))
      (by
        intro L1 L2
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, PiLp.add_apply, add_smul, sub_smul]
        abel)
    have e1 : ∀ G' : ℝ³ → ℝ³, curl3 G' x = cH (fderiv ℝ G' x) := fun G' => rfl
    have e2 : ∑ i ∈ s, curl3 (g i) x = ∑ i ∈ s, cH (fderiv ℝ (g i) x) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => e1 (g i))
    rw [e2, e1 F', e1 F, hfd, map_add, map_sum]
  intro θ a
  dsimp only
  
  obtain ⟨x, hxdef⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ³, x = rotPt r θ z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hx0 : x 0 = r * Real.cos θ := by rw [hxdef]; simp [rotPt]
  have hx1 : x 1 = r * Real.sin θ := by rw [hxdef]; simp [rotPt]
  have hx2 : x 2 = z := by rw [hxdef]; simp [rotPt]
  have hsq : x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
    rw [hx0, hx1]; linear_combination r ^ 2 * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ
  have hrad : rad x = r := by
    show Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) = r
    rw [hsq, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
  have hradd : DifferentiableAt ℝ rad x := by
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) x := by fun_prop
    exact h1.sqrt (by rw [hsq]; exact (pow_pos hr 2).ne')
  have hPx : ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t)) = (r, z, t, Y) := by
    simp [ptOf, hrad, hx2]
  have hPd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t))) x := by
    have hr1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => rad y ^ drx B.h) x :=
      hradd.rpow_const (Or.inl (by rw [hrad]; exact hr.ne'))
    have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => y 2) x := by fun_prop
    have h4 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t)) x :=
      ((hr1.smul_const vrv).add_const (t • vtv)).add_const _
    exact hradd.prodMk (h2.prodMk ((differentiableAt_const t).prodMk h4))
  have hq_d : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t)) x := by
    have hmem : ((x 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)) :=
      ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - t by linarith⟩
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (x 2, 1 - t) :=
      (hok.1.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt (hopen.mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => ((y 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ)) x := by fun_prop
    exact DifferentiableAt.comp (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) x h1 h2
  have hNx : N ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∈ nhds (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t))) := by
    rw [hPx]; exact Filter.inter_mem hN (hDopen.mem_nhds hξ)
  have hO : ∀ᶠ y in nhds x, 0 < rad y ∧ simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 ∧
      ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t)) ∈ N ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := by
    have e1 : ∀ᶠ y in nhds x, (0:ℝ) < rad y :=
      continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hradd.continuousAt (by rw [hrad]; exact hr)
    have e2 : ∀ᶠ y in nhds x, simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 :=
      hq_d.continuousAt.eventually_lt continuousAt_const (by rw [hx2]; exact hqξ)
    have e3 : ∀ᶠ y in nhds x, ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t)) ∈ N ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) :=
      hPd.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds hNx
    exact e1.and (e2.and e3)
  
  have hloc : ∀ (S' : CState) (A : WC) (Ψ : Cyl → ℝ), S'.Aw = A → S'.Psi = Ψ →
      (∀ η ∈ N ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ γ m, A γ m η ≠ 0 → γ ∈ Γ ∧ m ∈ H) →
      (fun y => AX5 B G l0 S' y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t))) =ᶠ[nhds x]
      (fun y => B.AB y t + ((∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, modeF5 B.h (1/2 - Aex B.h) t (Y - Yph B.h r t)
          (m * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G A γ m) y) +
        qC B.h (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t))) ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h) •
          (Ψ (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t))) • eTh y))) := by
    intro S' A Ψ hA hΨ hsupp'
    subst hA hΨ
    filter_upwards [hO] with y hy
    obtain ⟨hy1, hy2, hy3⟩ := hy
    have hcorr : corrOn B l0 y t := ⟨hy1, ht, hy2⟩
    simp only [AX5]
    rw [if_pos hcorr, smul_add, hexp S'.Aw (thetaOf y) _ (hsupp' _ hy3), hcyl_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
    congr 2
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
    rw [hcyl_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
    all_goals rfl
  have hTl := hloc T T.Aw T.Psi rfl rfl hsupp
  have hBl := hloc (wmoBase T) 0 T.Psi rfl rfl (fun _ _ γ m h => (h rfl).elim)
  
  have hz : ∀ (n : ℤ) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (y : ℝ³),
      modeF5 B.h (1/2 - Aex B.h) t (Y - Yph B.h r t) n (modeCoef5 B G (0 : WC) γ m) y = 0 := by
    intro n γ m y
    simp [modeF5, modeCoef5, cyl2cart]
  have hev : (fun y => AX5 B G l0 T y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t))) =ᶠ[nhds x]
      (fun y => AX5 B G l0 (wmoBase T) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t)) +
        ∑ p ∈ Γ ×ˢ H, modeF5 B.h (1/2 - Aex B.h) t (Y - Yph B.h r t) (p.2 * pint5 B G p.1)
          (modeCoef5 B G T.Aw p.1 p.2) y) := by
    filter_upwards [hTl, hBl] with y h1 h2
    rw [h1, h2]
    simp only [hz, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add, Finset.sum_product]
    abel
  
  have hPxr : 0 < rad x := by rw [hrad]; exact hr
  have hMD : ∀ γ m, DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeF5 B.h (1/2 - Aex B.h) t (Y - Yph B.h r t)
      (m * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G T.Aw γ m)) x := by
    intro γ m
    refine modeF5_differentiable_v5 B.h (1/2 - Aex B.h) t (Y - Yph B.h r t) (m * pint5 B G γ)
      (modeCoef5 B G T.Aw γ m) x hok.1 ht hPxr ?_
    rw [hPx]
    exact modeCoef5_differentiable_v5 B G hok hG (qsOf l0) α T.Aw hqB hT γ m _ hξ
  have hAB : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => B.AB y t) x := by
    have hmem2 : ((x 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)) :=
      ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - t by linarith⟩
    have hc1 : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) (x, t) := by
      have h1 : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (x 2, 1 - t) :=
        (hok.1.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt (hopen.mem_nhds hmem2)).continuousAt
      have h2 : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) (x, t) := by fun_prop
      exact ContinuousAt.comp (x := ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2)
        (f := fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) h1 h2
    have hmemN : simDomain B.h B.qB ∈ nhds ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) := by
      have e1 : ∀ᶠ w in nhds ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ), w.2 < 1 :=
        continuousAt_snd.eventually_lt continuousAt_const ht
      have e2 : ∀ᶠ w in nhds ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ), simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) < B.qB :=
        hc1.eventually_lt continuousAt_const (by
          show simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < B.qB
          rw [hx2]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hqξ hqB)
      filter_upwards [e1, e2] with w h1 h2
      exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have hcd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿B.AB) ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) :=
      (hok.2.2.2.2.1.1.contDiffAt hmemN).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have hpm : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => ((y, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) x :=
      differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const t)
    exact DifferentiableAt.comp (g := ↿B.AB) x hcd hpm
  have hΨ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => qC B.h (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t))) ^
      (1/2 - Aex B.h) • (T.Psi (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t))) • eTh y)) x := by
    have hqpos : 0 < simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) := (hok.1.1 _ (1 - t) (by linarith)).1
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h)) x :=
      hq_d.rpow_const (Or.inl hqpos.ne')
    have hPsi0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ T.Psi (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t))) := by
      rw [hPx]; exact (hP.1.contDiffAt (hDopen.mem_nhds hξ)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have h2 := hPsi0.comp x hPd
    have h3 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => eTh y) x := by
      have hi := hradd.inv (by rw [hrad]; exact hr.ne')
      have ha : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => azVec y) x := by unfold azVec; fun_prop
      exact hi.smul ha
    exact h1.smul (h2.smul h3)
  have hFbase : DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun y => AX5 B G l0 (wmoBase T) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t))) x := by
    rw [hBl.differentiableAt_iff]
    simp only [hz, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add]
    exact hAB.add hΨ
  have hcurlEq := hcurl (fun y => AX5 B G l0 (wmoBase T) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t)))
    (fun y => AX5 B G l0 T y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t)))
    (Γ ×ˢ H) (fun p => modeF5 B.h (1/2 - Aex B.h) t (Y - Yph B.h r t) (p.2 * pint5 B G p.1)
      (modeCoef5 B G T.Aw p.1 p.2)) x hev hFbase (fun p _ => hMD p.1 p.2)
  
  have hu : ∀ S' : CState, ucyl5 B G l0 S' θ (r, z, t, Y) a =
      inner ℝ (curl3 (fun y => AX5 B G l0 S' y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t))) x +
        BX B G l0 S' x t Y) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a) := by
    intro S'
    subst hxdef
    simp only [ucyl5, uX5, curlX, evOff, hrad]
  have hBX : BX B G l0 T x t Y = BX B G l0 (wmoBase T) x t Y := rfl
  rw [hu T, hu (wmoBase T), hcurlEq, hBX, ← hxdef]
  simp only [inner_add_left, sum_inner, Finset.sum_product]
  exact add_right_comm _ _ _

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have trig : ∀ (h e t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (r z : ℝ), 0 < r → DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeF5 h e t Y0 n c) (rotPt r 0 z) → DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeF5 h e t Y0 n (fun η i => Complex.I * c η i)) (rotPt r 0 z) → ∀ (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (a : Fin 3), ∃ A1 A2 : ℝ, ∀ θ : ℝ, inner ℝ (curl3 (modeF5 h e t Y0 n c) (rotPt r θ z)) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a) = Real.cos (n * θ) * A1 + Real.sin (n * θ) * A2 := by
    have hc : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), rotZ5 φ y 0 = Real.cos φ * y 0 - Real.sin φ * y 1 ∧
        rotZ5 φ y 1 = Real.sin φ * y 0 + Real.cos φ * y 1 ∧ rotZ5 φ y 2 = y 2 := by
      intro φ y
      simp [rotZ5]
    have ext3 : ∀ u v : ℝ³, u 0 = v 0 → u 1 = v 1 → u 2 = v 2 → u = v := by
      intro u v h0 h1 h2
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      · exact h0
      · exact h1
      · exact h2
    have hinv : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), rotZ5 φ (rotZ5 (-φ) y) = y := by
      intro φ y
      obtain ⟨a0, a1, a2⟩ := hc φ (rotZ5 (-φ) y)
      obtain ⟨b0, b1, b2⟩ := hc (-φ) y
      apply ext3
      · rw [a0, b0, b1, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
        linear_combination y 0 * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ
      · rw [a1, b0, b1, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
        linear_combination y 1 * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ
      · rw [a2, b2]
    have hrad : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), rad (rotZ5 φ y) = rad y := by
      intro φ y
      obtain ⟨a0, a1, -⟩ := hc φ y
      unfold rad
      rw [a0, a1]
      congr 1
      linear_combination (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ
    have hlin : ∀ φ : ℝ, ∃ L : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³, ∀ v : ℝ³, L v = rotZ5 φ v := by
      intro φ
      let f : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
        { toFun := rotZ5 φ
          map_add' := fun u v => by
            apply ext3 <;> simp [hc] <;> ring
          map_smul' := fun a u => by
            apply ext3 <;> simp [hc] <;> ring }
      exact ⟨⟨f, f.continuous_of_finiteDimensional⟩, fun v => rfl⟩
    have hinner : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (u v : ℝ³), inner ℝ (rotZ5 φ u) (rotZ5 φ v) = inner ℝ u v := by
      intro φ u v
      have e : ∀ a b : ℝ³, inner ℝ a b = a 0 * b 0 + a 1 * b 1 + a 2 * b 2 := by
        intro a b
        simp [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [e, e]
      obtain ⟨a0, a1, a2⟩ := hc φ u
      obtain ⟨b0, b1, b2⟩ := hc φ v
      rw [a0, a1, a2, b0, b1, b2]
      linear_combination (u 0 * v 0 + u 1 * v 1) * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ
    have hpt : ∀ r φ z : ℝ, rotPt r φ z = rotZ5 φ (rotPt r 0 z) := by
      intro r φ z
      apply ext3 <;> simp [rotPt, hc] <;> ring
    have hframe : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), eR (rotZ5 φ y) = rotZ5 φ (eR y) ∧
        eTh (rotZ5 φ y) = rotZ5 φ (eTh y) ∧ rotZ5 φ eZ = eZ := by
      intro φ y
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · apply ext3 <;> simp [eR, radVec, hc, hrad] <;> ring

    have hcurlEq : curl3 (fun y => AX5 B G l0 (wmoBase T) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t))) x =
        curl3 (fun y => B.AB y t) x + curl3 (modeF5 B.h (1/2 - Aex B.h) t (Y - Yph B.h r t) 0 cΨ) x := by
      have hfd : fderiv ℝ (fun y => AX5 B G l0 (wmoBase T) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t))) x =
          fderiv ℝ (fun y => B.AB y t) x + fderiv ℝ (modeF5 B.h (1/2 - Aex B.h) t (Y - Yph B.h r t) 0 cΨ) x := by
        rw [hloc.fderiv_eq, fderiv_fun_add hAB hMd]
      simp only [curl3, hfd, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, PiLp.add_apply]
      module
    have hu : ucyl5 B G l0 (wmoBase T) φ (r, z, t, Y) a =
        inner ℝ (curl3 (fun y => AX5 B G l0 (wmoBase T) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h r t))) x +
          BX B G l0 (wmoBase T) x t Y) (frameAt φ (r, z, t, Y) a) := by
      subst hxdef
      simp only [ucyl5, uX5, curlX, evOff, hrad]
    have hcx : corrOn B l0 x t := ⟨by rw [hrad]; exact hr, ht, by rw [hx2]; exact hqξ⟩
    have hptx : ptOf x t Y = (r, z, t, Y) := by simp [ptOf, hrad, hx2]
    have hBX : BX B G l0 (wmoBase T) x t Y =
        B.BvB x t + (qC B.h (r, z, t, Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) * T.bdir (r, z, t, Y)) • eTh x := by
      simp only [BX]
      rw [if_pos hcx, hptx]
      rfl
    refine ⟨by rw [← hxdef]; exact hMd, ?_⟩
    rw [hu, hcurlEq, hBX, ← hxdef]
    have huB : uB B x t = curl3 (fun w => B.AB w t) x + B.BvB x t := rfl
    rw [huB]
    simp only [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left]
    ring
  
  have hbg : ∀ φ : ℝ, inner ℝ (uB B (rotPt r φ z) t) (frameAt φ (r, z, t, Y) a) =
      ![r⁻¹ * B.Vb (simScale B.h z (1 - t)) (r ^ 2 / (2 * simScale B.h z (1 - t)))
          (z * simScale B.h z (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - B.h))),
        r⁻¹ * (r * simScale B.h z (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + B.h)) *
          B.Eb (simScale B.h z (1 - t)) (r ^ 2 / (2 * simScale B.h z (1 - t)))
            (z * simScale B.h z (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - B.h)))),
        simScale B.h z (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + B.h)) *
          B.Ub (simScale B.h z (1 - t)) (r ^ 2 / (2 * simScale B.h z (1 - t)))
            (z * simScale B.h z (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - B.h)))] a := by
    intro φ
    obtain ⟨hsq, h2, hrad⟩ := hgeo φ
    have hmem : ((rotPt r φ z, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB :=
      ⟨ht, by show simScale B.h ((rotPt r φ z) 2) (1 - t) < B.qB; rw [h2]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hqξ hqB⟩
    have hpos : 0 < (rotPt r φ z) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt r φ z) 1 ^ 2 := by rw [hsq]; positivity
    obtain ⟨hE, hU, hV⟩ := hok.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 (rotPt r φ z) t hmem hpos
    have hX : simX B.h (rotPt r φ z) t = r ^ 2 / (2 * simScale B.h z (1 - t)) := by
      unfold simX; rw [hsq, h2]
    have hEt : simEta B.h (rotPt r φ z) t = z * simScale B.h z (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - B.h)) := by
      unfold simEta; rw [h2]
    rw [hsq, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le] at hE
    simp only [hX, hEt, h2] at hE hU hV
    fin_cases a
    · show inner ℝ (uB B (rotPt r φ z) t) ((rad (rotPt r φ z))⁻¹ • radVec (rotPt r φ z)) = _
      rw [hrad, real_inner_smul_right]
      exact congrArg _ hV
    · show inner ℝ (uB B (rotPt r φ z) t) ((rad (rotPt r φ z))⁻¹ • azVec (rotPt r φ z)) = _
      rw [hrad, real_inner_smul_right]
      exact congrArg _ hE
    · show inner ℝ (uB B (rotPt r φ z) t) (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) = _
      have hU' : uB B (rotPt r φ z) t 2 = simScale B.h z (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 + B.h)) *
          B.Ub (simScale B.h z (1 - t)) (r ^ 2 / (2 * simScale B.h z (1 - t)))
            (z * simScale B.h z (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / 2 - B.h))) := hU
      rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, hU']
      simp
  
  have hinner3 : ∀ u v : ℝ³, inner ℝ u v = u 0 * v 0 + u 1 * v 1 + u 2 * v 2 := by
    intro u v
    simp [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have heth : ∀ φ : ℝ, inner ℝ (eTh (rotPt r φ z)) (frameAt φ (r, z, t, Y) a) = ![(0:ℝ), 1, 0] a := by
    intro φ
    obtain ⟨hsq, h2, hrad⟩ := hgeo φ
    have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
    fin_cases a
    · show inner ℝ (eTh (rotPt r φ z)) (eR (rotPt r φ z)) = 0
      rw [hinner3]
      simp [eTh, eR, azVec, radVec, hrad]
      ring
    · show inner ℝ (eTh (rotPt r φ z)) (eTh (rotPt r φ z)) = 1
      rw [hinner3]
      simp [eTh, azVec, hrad]
      field_simp
      linear_combination hsq
    · show inner ℝ (eTh (rotPt r φ z)) eZ = 0
      rw [hinner3]
      simp [eTh, eZ, azVec]
  
  have hd2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeF5 B.h (1/2 - Aex B.h) t (Y - Yph B.h r t) 0
      (fun η i => Complex.I * cΨ η i)) (rotPt r 0 z) := by
    rw [show modeF5 B.h (1/2 - Aex B.h) t (Y - Yph B.h r t) 0 (fun η i => Complex.I * cΨ η i) =
      fun _ => 0 from funext hM0]
    exact differentiableAt_const _
  obtain ⟨A1, A2, hA⟩ := trig B.h (1/2 - Aex B.h) t (Y - Yph B.h r t) 0 cΨ r z hr (hptw 0).1 hd2 Y a
  have hmode : inner ℝ (curl3 (modeF5 B.h (1/2 - Aex B.h) t (Y - Yph B.h r t) 0 cΨ) (rotPt r θ z))
      (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a) =
      inner ℝ (curl3 (modeF5 B.h (1/2 - Aex B.h) t (Y - Yph B.h r t) 0 cΨ) (rotPt r 0 z))
      (frameAt 0 (r, z, t, Y) a) := by
    rw [hA θ, hA 0]
    simp
  
  rw [(hptw θ).2, (hptw 0).2, hbg θ, hbg 0, heth θ, heth 0, hmode]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h e t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (C : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (r z : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → t < 1 → 0 < r → DifferentiableAt ℝ C (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) → (∀ a : Fin 3, inner ℝ (curl3 (modeF5 h e t Y0 n C) (rotPt r 0 z)) (frameAt 0 (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) a) = qC h (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) ^ e * (axV5 h e n C (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) a).re) ∧ axV5 h e n (fun η i => Complex.I * C η i) (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) = fun i => Complex.I * axV5 h e n C (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) i

signature.name: mode_curl_axis_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (h e t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (C : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (r z : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → t < 1 → 0 < r → DifferentiableAt ℝ C (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) → (∀ a : Fin 3, inner ℝ (curl3 (modeF5 h e t Y0 n C) (rotPt r 0 z)) (frameAt 0 (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) a) = qC h (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) ^ e * (axV5 h e n C (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) a).re) ∧ axV5 h e n (fun η i => Complex.I * C η i) (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) = fun i => Complex.I * axV5 h e n C (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) i

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h e t Y0 n C r z hS ht hr hC
  have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
  have ht1 : (0:ℝ) < 1 - t := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hQpos, -⟩ := hS.1 z (1 - t) ht1
  have hQne : simScale h z (1 - t) ≠ 0 := hQpos.ne'
  have hSo : (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) ∈ nhds (z, 1 - t) :=
    (isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds ⟨mem_univ _, ht1⟩
  have hSd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (z, 1 - t) :=
    (hS.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt hSo).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hSline : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, HasDerivAt
      (fun s : ℝ => simScale h ((z, 1 - t) + s • w).1 ((z, 1 - t) + s • w).2)
      (fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (z, 1 - t) w) 0 := by
    intro w
    have hl : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (z, 1 - t) + s • w) w 0 :=
      (((hasDerivAt_id' (0:ℝ)).smul_const w).const_add (z, 1 - t)).congr_deriv (one_smul ℝ w)
    exact hSd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) hl (by simp)
  have hL : dZ (fun η : Cyl => Real.log (qC h η)) (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (z, 1 - t) (1, 0) / simScale h z (1 - t) := by
    have hqd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => qC h η) (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) := by
      have hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => (η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1)) (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) := by
        fun_prop
      exact DifferentiableAt.comp (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2)
        (f := fun η : Cyl => (η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1)) _ hSd hf
    have hld := hqd.log hQne
    have hl : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ((r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) : Cyl) +
        s • ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) 0 :=
      (((hasDerivAt_id' (0:ℝ)).smul_const _).const_add _).congr_deriv (one_smul ℝ _)
    have h1 := hld.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) hl (by simp)
    have h2 := (hSline (1, 0)).log (by simpa using hQne)
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Real.log (qC h (((r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) : Cyl) +
        s • ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))))))
        (fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (z, 1 - t) (1, 0) / simScale h z (1 - t)) 0 := by
      refine (h2.congr_deriv (by simp)).congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s => ?_)
      simp [qC]
    exact h1.unique h3
  have hx00 : rotPt r 0 z 0 = r := by simp [rotPt]
  have hx01 : rotPt r 0 z 1 = 0 := by simp [rotPt]
  have hx02 : rotPt r 0 z 2 = z := by simp [rotPt]
  have hrad0 : rad (rotPt r 0 z) = r := by
    simp only [rad, hx00, hx01]; simp [Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
  have hptx0 : ptOf (rotPt r 0 z) t (Yph h (rad (rotPt r 0 z)) t + Y0) = (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) := by
    simp only [ptOf, hrad0, hx02]
  have hMdiff : ∀ (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (x : ℝ³), 0 < rad x →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeF5 h e t Y0 n c) x := by
    intro c x hrad hc
    have hcoord : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (y : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ => w i) y := by
      intro i y
      have h0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (ι := Fin 3) i) y :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt _
      rwa [EuclideanSpace.coe_proj] at h0
    have hradpos : 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.mp hrad
    have hradD : DifferentiableAt ℝ rad x := by
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) x :=
        ((hcoord 0 x).pow 2).add ((hcoord 1 x).pow 2)
      exact h1.sqrt hradpos.ne'
    have hinv : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => (rad y)⁻¹) x := hradD.inv hrad.ne'
    have hq : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => qC h (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) ^ e) x := by
      have hSo' : (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) ∈ nhds (x 2, 1 - t) :=
        (isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - t by linarith⟩
      have hSd' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (x 2, 1 - t) :=
        (hS.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt hSo').differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hgd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => (y 2, 1 - t)) x :=
        (hcoord 2 x).prodMk (differentiableAt_const _)
      have hcomp : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => simScale h (y 2) (1 - t)) x :=
        DifferentiableAt.comp (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2)
          (f := fun y : ℝ³ => (y 2, 1 - t)) x hSd' hgd
      have hpos : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≠ 0 := (hS.1 (x 2) (1 - t) (by linarith)).1.ne'
      exact hcomp.rpow_const (Or.inl hpos)
    have hP : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) x := by
      have h4 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => Yph h (rad y) t + Y0) x := by
        have h5 := ((hradD.rpow_const (p := drx h) (Or.inl hrad.ne')).smul_const vrv).add_const (t • vtv)
        exact h5.add_const Y0
      exact hradD.prodMk ((hcoord 2 x).prodMk ((differentiableAt_const t).prodMk h4))
    have hnormAll : ∀ y : ℝ³, ‖(⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)‖ = rad y := by
      intro y
      rw [Complex.norm_eq_sqrt_sq_add_sq]
      rfl
    have hE : DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun y : ℝ³ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))) x := by
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ³ → ℂ, g = fun y => ((rad y)⁻¹ : ℝ) • (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hz : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)) x := by
        have e1 : (fun y : ℝ³ => (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)) =
            fun y => Complex.ofRealCLM (y 0) + Complex.ofRealCLM (y 1) * Complex.I := by
          funext y
          rw [Complex.mk_eq_add_mul_I]
          simp
        rw [e1]
        exact (Complex.ofRealCLM.differentiableAt.comp x (hcoord 0 x)).add
          ((Complex.ofRealCLM.differentiableAt.comp x (hcoord 1 x)).mul_const Complex.I)
      have hgD : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x := by
        rw [hg]
        exact hinv.smul hz
      have hgx : g x ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hg]
        refine smul_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero hrad.ne') ?_
        intro h0
        have h1 := hnormAll x
        rw [h0, norm_zero] at h1
        linarith
      have hpow : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun u : ℂ => u ^ n) (g x) :=
        differentiableAt_zpow.mpr (Or.inl hgx)
      have hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y ^ n) x := (hpow.restrictScalars ℝ).comp x hgD
      refine hG.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [hradD.continuousAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hrad)] with y hy
      have hy' : 0 < rad y := hy
      have hne : ((rad y : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hy'.ne'
      have key := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)
      rw [hnormAll y] at key
      have hexp : Complex.exp (((thetaOf y : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = g y := by
        rw [hg]
        show _ = ((rad y)⁻¹ : ℝ) • (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)
        rw [Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_inv, eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq₀ hne]
        exact key
      calc Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))
          = Complex.exp ((n : ℂ) * ((thetaOf y : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
            congr 1
            ring
        _ = Complex.exp ((thetaOf y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n := Complex.exp_int_mul _ _
        _ = g y ^ n := by rw [hexp]
    have hcP : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0))) x :=
      hc.comp x hP
    have hv : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ =>
        (c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re) x := by
      intro i
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i) x :=
        differentiableAt_pi.1 hcP i
      have h2 := h1.mul hE
      exact Complex.reCLM.differentiableAt.comp x h2
    have heR : DifferentiableAt ℝ eR x := by
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ radVec x :=
        ((hcoord 0 x).smul_const _).add ((hcoord 1 x).smul_const _)
      exact hinv.smul h1
    have heTh : DifferentiableAt ℝ eTh x := by
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ azVec x :=
        ((hcoord 1 x).neg.smul_const _).add ((hcoord 0 x).smul_const _)
      exact hinv.smul h1
    have hcyl : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => cyl2cart y (fun i =>
        (c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re)) x :=
      (((hv 0).smul heR).add ((hv 1).smul heTh)).add ((hv 2).smul_const eZ)
    exact hq.smul hcyl
  have hMd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeF5 h e t Y0 n C) (rotPt r 0 z) :=
    hMdiff C _ (by rw [hrad0]; exact hr) (by rw [hptx0]; exact hC)
  obtain ⟨Qf, hQf⟩ : ∃ Qf : ℝ³ → ℝ, ∀ y, Qf y = qC h (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) ^ e :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ³ → Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ y i, G y i = (C (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i *
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hMc : ∀ y : ℝ³, modeF5 h e t Y0 n C y 0 =
        Qf y * (G y 0 * ((rad y)⁻¹ * y 0) - G y 1 * ((rad y)⁻¹ * y 1)) ∧
      modeF5 h e t Y0 n C y 1 = Qf y * (G y 0 * ((rad y)⁻¹ * y 1) + G y 1 * ((rad y)⁻¹ * y 0)) ∧
      modeF5 h e t Y0 n C y 2 = Qf y * G y 2 := by
    intro y
    simp only [hQf, hG]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [modeF5, cyl2cart, eR, eTh, eZ, radVec, azVec] <;> ring
  have hnormAll : ∀ y : ℝ³, ‖(⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)‖ = rad y := by
    intro y
    rw [Complex.norm_eq_sqrt_sq_add_sq]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨gd, hgd⟩ : ∃ gd : ℝ³ → Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ v i, gd v i =
      ((v 0) • dR h (fun η => C η i) (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) +
        (v 2) • dZ (fun η => C η i) (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) +
        C (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) i * ((n : ℂ) * (((v 1 / r : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I))).re :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨qd, hqd⟩ : ∃ qd : ℝ³ → ℝ, ∀ v, qd v = fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2)
      (z, 1 - t) (v 2, 0) * e * simScale h z (1 - t) ^ (e - 1) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hD : ∀ v : ℝ³,
      fderiv ℝ (modeF5 h e t Y0 n C) (rotPt r 0 z) v 0 = qd v * (C (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) 0).re +
        simScale h z (1 - t) ^ e * (gd v 0 - (C (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) 1).re * (v 1 / r)) ∧
      fderiv ℝ (modeF5 h e t Y0 n C) (rotPt r 0 z) v 1 = qd v * (C (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) 1).re +
        simScale h z (1 - t) ^ e * ((C (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) 0).re * (v 1 / r) + gd v 1) ∧
      fderiv ℝ (modeF5 h e t Y0 n C) (rotPt r 0 z) v 2 = qd v * (C (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) 2).re +
        simScale h z (1 - t) ^ e * gd v 2 := by
    intro v
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ : ∃ γ : ℝ → ℝ³, γ = fun s => rotPt r 0 z + s • v := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hγk : ∀ (s : ℝ) (k : Fin 3), γ s k = rotPt r 0 z k + s * v k := by
      intro s k; rw [hγ]; simp
    have hγ00 : γ 0 0 = r := by rw [hγk, hx00]; ring
    have hγ01 : γ 0 1 = 0 := by rw [hγk, hx01]; ring
    have hγ02 : γ 0 2 = z := by rw [hγk, hx02]; ring
    have hγd : ∀ k : Fin 3, HasDerivAt (fun s => γ s k) (v k) 0 := by
      intro k
      have e1 : (fun s => γ s k) = fun s => rotPt r 0 z k + s * v k := funext fun s => hγk s k
      rw [e1]
      exact (((hasDerivAt_id' (0:ℝ)).mul_const (v k)).const_add _).congr_deriv (one_mul _)
    have hρ0 : rad (γ 0) = r := by
      simp only [rad, hγ00, hγ01]; simp [Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
    have hρ : HasDerivAt (fun s => rad (γ s)) (v 0) 0 := by
      have e1 : (fun s => rad (γ s)) = fun s => Real.sqrt (γ s 0 * γ s 0 + γ s 1 * γ s 1) := by
        funext s; simp only [rad, pow_two]
      rw [e1]
      have h1 := (((hγd 0).mul (hγd 0)).add ((hγd 1).mul (hγd 1))).sqrt
        (by simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.mul_apply, hγ00, hγ01]; simp [hr0])
      refine h1.congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.mul_apply, hγ00, hγ01]
      have : Real.sqrt (r * r + 0 * 0) = r := by simp [Real.sqrt_mul_self hr.le]
      rw [this]; field_simp; try ring
    have hρi : HasDerivAt (fun s => (rad (γ s))⁻¹) (-(v 0) / r ^ 2) 0 := by
      have h1 := hρ.inv (by rw [hρ0]; exact hr0)
      rw [hρ0] at h1
      exact h1
    have ha : HasDerivAt (fun s => (rad (γ s))⁻¹ * γ s 0) 0 0 := by
      refine (hρi.mul (hγd 0)).congr_deriv ?_
      rw [hγ00, hρ0]; field_simp; try ring
    have hb : HasDerivAt (fun s => (rad (γ s))⁻¹ * γ s 1) (v 1 / r) 0 := by
      refine (hρi.mul (hγd 1)).congr_deriv ?_
      rw [hγ01, hρ0]; field_simp; try ring
    have ha0 : (rad (γ 0))⁻¹ * γ 0 0 = 1 := by rw [hρ0, hγ00]; field_simp
    have hb0 : (rad (γ 0))⁻¹ * γ 0 1 = 0 := by rw [hγ01]; ring
    have hQv : Qf (γ 0) = simScale h z (1 - t) ^ e := by
      rw [hQf]; simp only [qC, ptOf, hγ02]
    have hQd : HasDerivAt (fun s => Qf (γ s)) (qd v) 0 := by
      have h1 := (hSline (v 2, 0)).rpow_const (p := e) (Or.inl (by simpa using hQne))
      rw [hqd]
      refine (h1.congr_deriv (by simp)).congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s => ?_)
      simp only [hQf, qC, ptOf, hγk, hx02]
      simp
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : ℝ → ℂ, u = fun s => (((rad (γ s))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (((γ s 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((γ s 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hu0 : u 0 = 1 := by
      rw [hu]; simp only [hρ0, hγ00, hγ01]; simp [hr0]
    have hud : HasDerivAt u (((v 1 / r : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) 0 := by
      rw [hu]
      refine (hρi.ofReal_comp.mul ((hγd 0).ofReal_comp.add
        ((hγd 1).ofReal_comp.mul_const Complex.I))).congr_deriv ?_
      have hrC : (r : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hr0
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, hρ0, hγ00, hγ01]; push_cast; field_simp; try ring
    have hev : ∀ᶠ s in nhds (0:ℝ), Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf (γ s) : ℂ)) = u s ^ n := by
      filter_upwards [hρ.continuousAt (Ioi_mem_nhds (show (0:ℝ) < rad (γ 0) by rw [hρ0]; exact hr))]
        with s hs
      have hs' : 0 < rad (γ s) := hs
      have hne : ((rad (γ s) : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hs'.ne'
      have key := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I (⟨γ s 0, γ s 1⟩ : ℂ)
      rw [hnormAll (γ s)] at key
      have hexp : Complex.exp (((thetaOf (γ s) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = u s := by
        rw [hu]
        show _ = (((rad (γ s))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((γ s 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((γ s 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
        rw [← Complex.mk_eq_add_mul_I, Complex.ofReal_inv, eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq₀ hne]
        exact key
      calc Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf (γ s) : ℂ))
          = Complex.exp ((n : ℂ) * ((thetaOf (γ s) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by congr 1; ring
        _ = Complex.exp ((thetaOf (γ s) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n := Complex.exp_int_mul _ _
        _ = u s ^ n := by rw [hexp]
    have hΦ0 : Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf (γ 0) : ℂ)) = 1 := by
      rw [hev.self_of_nhds, hu0, one_zpow]
    have hΦ : HasDerivAt (fun s => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf (γ s) : ℂ)))
        ((n : ℂ) * (((v 1 / r : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) 0 := by
      have h1 := (hasDerivAt_zpow n (u 0) (Or.inl (by rw [hu0]; exact one_ne_zero))).comp (0:ℝ) hud
      rw [hu0, one_zpow, mul_one] at h1
      exact h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    have hP0 : ptOf (γ 0) t (Yph h (rad (γ 0)) t + Y0) = (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) := by
      simp only [ptOf, hρ0, hγ02]
    have hP : HasDerivAt (fun s => ptOf (γ s) t (Yph h (rad (γ s)) t + Y0))
        (v 0 • ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx h * r ^ (drx h - 1)) • vrv) +
          v 2 • ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))) 0 := by
      have hY : HasDerivAt (fun s => Yph h (rad (γ s)) t + Y0) ((v 0 * drx h * r ^ (drx h - 1)) • vrv) 0 := by
        have h1 := ((hρ.rpow_const (p := drx h) (Or.inl (by rw [hρ0]; exact hr0))).smul_const vrv).add_const
          (t • vtv)
        have h2 := h1.add_const Y0
        rw [hρ0] at h2
        exact h2
      have h3 := hρ.prodMk ((hγd 2).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_const (0:ℝ) t).prodMk hY))
      refine h3.congr_deriv ?_
      simp [smul_smul, mul_assoc]
    have hc : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasDerivAt (fun s => C (ptOf (γ s) t (Yph h (rad (γ s)) t + Y0)) i)
        (v 0 • dR h (fun η => C η i) (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) +
          v 2 • dZ (fun η => C η i) (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0)) 0 := by
      intro i
      have hCi : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => C η i) (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) := differentiableAt_pi.1 hC i
      have h1 := hCi.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) hP hP0.symm
      rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul] at h1
      exact h1
    have hGv : ∀ i, G (γ 0) i = (C (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) i).re := by
      intro i; rw [hG, hP0, hΦ0, mul_one]
    have hGd : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasDerivAt (fun s => G (γ s) i) (gd v i) 0 := by
      intro i
      have h1 := Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ) ((hc i).mul hΦ)
      rw [Complex.reCLM_apply, hP0, hΦ0, mul_one] at h1
      rw [hgd]
      refine h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s => ?_)
      simp only [hG, Function.comp_apply, Complex.reCLM_apply, Pi.mul_apply]
    have hline : ∀ k : Fin 3, HasDerivAt (fun s => modeF5 h e t Y0 n C (γ s) k)
        (fderiv ℝ (modeF5 h e t Y0 n C) (rotPt r 0 z) v k) 0 := by
      intro k
      have hγl : HasDerivAt γ v 0 := by
        rw [hγ]
        exact (((hasDerivAt_id' (0:ℝ)).smul_const v).const_add _).congr_deriv (one_smul ℝ v)
      have h0 : HasFDerivAt (modeF5 h e t Y0 n C) (fderiv ℝ (modeF5 h e t Y0 n C) (rotPt r 0 z)) (γ 0) := by
        rw [hγ]; simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]; exact hMd.hasFDerivAt
      exact (EuclideanSpace.proj k : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ)
        (h0.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ) hγl)
    have e0 : (fun s => modeF5 h e t Y0 n C (γ s) 0) = fun s => Qf (γ s) *
        (G (γ s) 0 * ((rad (γ s))⁻¹ * γ s 0) - G (γ s) 1 * ((rad (γ s))⁻¹ * γ s 1)) :=
      funext fun s => (hMc (γ s)).1
    have e1 : (fun s => modeF5 h e t Y0 n C (γ s) 1) = fun s => Qf (γ s) *
        (G (γ s) 0 * ((rad (γ s))⁻¹ * γ s 1) + G (γ s) 1 * ((rad (γ s))⁻¹ * γ s 0)) :=
      funext fun s => (hMc (γ s)).2.1
    have e2 : (fun s => modeF5 h e t Y0 n C (γ s) 2) = fun s => Qf (γ s) * G (γ s) 2 :=
      funext fun s => (hMc (γ s)).2.2
    have d0 := hQd.mul (((hGd 0).mul ha).sub ((hGd 1).mul hb))
    have d1 := hQd.mul (((hGd 0).mul hb).add ((hGd 1).mul ha))
    have d2 := hQd.mul (hGd 2)
    have l0 := hline 0
    rw [e0] at l0
    have l1 := hline 1
    rw [e1] at l1
    have l2 := hline 2
    rw [e2] at l2
    rw [l0.unique d0, l1.unique d1, l2.unique d2]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    all_goals simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, hQv, hGv, ha0, hb0]
    all_goals ring_nf
  have heR : eR (rotPt r 0 z) = EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 := by
    simp only [eR, radVec, hrad0, hx00, hx01, zero_smul, add_zero, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr0, one_smul]
  have heTh : eTh (rotPt r 0 z) = EuclideanSpace.single 1 1 := by
    simp only [eTh, azVec, hrad0, hx00, hx01, neg_zero, zero_smul, zero_add, smul_smul,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ hr0, one_smul]
  have hfr : ∀ a : Fin 3, frameAt 0 (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) a = EuclideanSpace.single a 1 := by
    intro a
    fin_cases a
    · exact heR
    · exact heTh
    · show eZ = _
      rfl
  refine ⟨fun a => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hfr a, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, one_mul, conj_trivial]
    have hq : qC h (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) = simScale h z (1 - t) := rfl
    rw [hq]
    have hf00 : fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (z, 1 - t) (0, 0) = 0 := by
      rw [Prod.mk_zero_zero, map_zero]
    obtain ⟨A0, A1, A2⟩ := hD (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1)
    obtain ⟨B0, B1, B2⟩ := hD (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1)
    obtain ⟨E0, E1, E2⟩ := hD (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1)
    fin_cases a
    · simp [curl3]
      rw [B2, E1]
      simp only [hgd, hqd, axV5]
      simp [hL, hf00, Prod.mk_zero_zero, Complex.mul_re, Complex.div_ofReal_re, Real.rpow_sub_one hQne]
      field_simp
      ring
    · simp [curl3]
      rw [E0, A2]
      simp only [hgd, hqd, axV5]
      simp [hL, hf00, Prod.mk_zero_zero, Complex.mul_re, Complex.div_ofReal_re, Real.rpow_sub_one hQne]
      field_simp
      ring
    · simp [curl3]
      rw [A1, B0]
      simp only [hgd, hqd, axV5]
      simp [hL, hf00, Prod.mk_zero_zero, Complex.mul_re, Complex.div_ofReal_re, Real.rpow_sub_one hQne]
      field_simp
      ring
  · have hCi : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => C η i) (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) :=
      fun i => differentiableAt_pi.1 hC i
    have hR : ∀ i, dR h (fun η => Complex.I * C η i) (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) =
        Complex.I * dR h (fun η => C η i) (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) := by
      intro i; simp only [dR]; rw [fderiv_const_mul (hCi i)]; rfl
    have hZ : ∀ i, dZ (fun η => Complex.I * C η i) (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) =
        Complex.I * dZ (fun η => C η i) (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) := by
      intro i; simp only [dZ]; rw [fderiv_const_mul (hCi i)]; rfl
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [axV5, hR, hZ] <;> ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (qs α : ℝ) (c : WC), qs ≤ B.qB → InWg5 B G qs α c → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ i : Fin 3, dR B.h (fun η => modeCoef5 B G c γ m η i) ξ = (dR B.h (fun η => c γ m η i) ξ + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * c γ m ξ i) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) ∧ dZ (fun η => modeCoef5 B G c γ m η i) ξ = (dZ (fun η => c γ m η i) ξ + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * c γ m ξ i) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)))

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (qs α : ℝ) (c : WC), qs ≤ B.qB → InWg5 B G qs α c → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ i : Fin 3, dR B.h (fun η => modeCoef5 B G c γ m η i) ξ = (dR B.h (fun η => c γ m η i) ξ + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * c γ m ξ i) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) ∧ dZ (fun η => modeCoef5 B G c γ m η i) ξ = (dZ (fun η => c γ m η i) ξ + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * c γ m ξ i) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG qs α c hqs hc γ m ξ hξ i
  
  have hcalc : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℂ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ) (a b : ℂ), DifferentiableAt ℝ f ξ →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ φ ξ → ∀ v : Cyl,
      fderiv ℝ (fun η => f η * Complex.exp (a * (b * (φ η : ℂ)))) ξ v =
        (fderiv ℝ f ξ v + a * b * ((fderiv ℝ φ ξ v : ℝ) : ℂ) * f ξ) *
          Complex.exp (a * (b * (φ ξ : ℂ))) := by
    intro f φ a b hf hφ v
    have hcst : HasFDerivAt (fun η => ((φ η : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Complex.ofRealCLM.comp (fderiv ℝ φ ξ)) ξ := by
      have h0 := Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp ξ hφ.hasFDerivAt
      exact h0
    have hL := (hcst.const_mul b).const_mul a
    have hE := hL.cexp
    have hP := hf.hasFDerivAt.mul hE
    rw [show (fun η => f η * Complex.exp (a * (b * (φ η : ℂ)))) =
      (f * fun x => Complex.exp (a * (b * (φ x : ℂ)))) from rfl, hP.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc' : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc'
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qs))
    have e : DomC B.h qs =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio qs := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  have hDn : DomC B.h qs ∈ nhds ξ := hDopen.mem_nhds hξ
  obtain ⟨hr, ht, hqξ⟩ := id hξ
  have hamp : DifferentiableAt ℝ (c γ m) ξ :=
    ((hc.2.1 γ m).contDiffAt hDn).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hci : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => c γ m η i) ξ := differentiableAt_pi.1 hamp i
  
  have hdich : (c γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ)) ∨
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ := by
    set v : Cyl → ℝ × ℝ := fun η => Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ with hv
    have hvc : Continuous v := by
      rw [hv]
      unfold Jpow
      fun_prop
    set U : Set Cyl := DomC B.h qs ∩ {η | |(v η).1 - (v ξ).1| < 1/8} ∩
      {η | |(v η).2 - (v ξ).2| < 1/8} with hU
    have hUo : IsOpen U :=
      (hDopen.inter (isOpen_lt ((hvc.fst.sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const)).inter
        (isOpen_lt ((hvc.snd.sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const)
    have hξU : ξ ∈ U := by
      refine ⟨⟨hξ, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · show |(v ξ).1 - (v ξ).1| < 1/8
        rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; norm_num
      · show |(v ξ).2 - (v ξ).2| < 1/8
        rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; norm_num
    have hUn : U ∈ nhds ξ := hUo.mem_nhds hξU
    by_cases hA : ∀ η ∈ U, c γ m η = 0
    · exact Or.inl (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hUn hA)
    · right
      push_neg at hA
      obtain ⟨η1, hη1U, hη1⟩ := hA
      have hη1D : η1 ∈ DomC B.h qs := hη1U.1.1
      obtain ⟨-, -, hxi, het, -, -⟩ := hc.2.2.2.1 γ m η1 hη1D hη1
      have hr0 : G.r0 ≤ 1/100 := hG.1.2.1
      have hb0 : 0 ≤ bgc := by unfold bgc; linarith [Real.one_lt_sqrt_two]
      have hb1 : bgc ≤ 1 := by
        unfold bgc
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
      have hden : (1 + bgc ^ 2) * (1 + bgc ^ 2)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity)
      have id1 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.1 = lamR w + bgc * lamT w := by
        intro w
        simp only [lamR, lamT, div_eq_mul_inv]
        linear_combination (-w.1) * hden
      have id2 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.2 = -(bgc * lamR w) + lamT w := by
        intro w
        simp only [lamR, lamT, div_eq_mul_inv]
        linear_combination (-w.2) * hden
      have key : ∀ (R T : ℝ), |R| ≤ G.r0 / 4 → |T| ≤ G.r0 →
          |R + bgc * T| ≤ 1/80 ∧ |-(bgc * R) + T| ≤ 1/80 := by
        intro R T hR hT
        obtain ⟨hR1, hR2⟩ := abs_le.mp hR
        obtain ⟨hT1, hT2⟩ := abs_le.mp hT

          nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hT2), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
        have e2 : -G.r0 ≤ bgc * T := by
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (show 0 ≤ T + G.r0 by linarith),
            mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
        have e3 : bgc * R ≤ G.r0 / 4 := by
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hR2), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
        have e4 : -(G.r0 / 4) ≤ bgc * R := by
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (show 0 ≤ R + G.r0 / 4 by linarith),
            mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
        exact ⟨abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
      have hround : ∀ (x : ℝ) (k : ℤ), |x - k| < 1/2 → round x = k := by
        intro x k hk
        rw [round_eq, Int.floor_eq_iff]
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hk
        constructor <;> linarith
      have hw1 : |lamR (frac0 (v η1))| ≤ G.r0 / 4 := hxi
      have hw2 : |lamT (frac0 (v η1))| ≤ G.r0 := het
      have hw := key _ _ hw1 hw2
