      have ex2 : (v η1).2 - ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ) =
          -(bgc * lamR (frac0 (v η1))) + lamT (frac0 (v η1)) := id2 (frac0 (v η1))
      have hx1 : |(v η1).1 - ((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1/80 := by rw [ex1]; exact hw.1
      have hx2 : |(v η1).2 - ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1/80 := by rw [ex2]; exact hw.2

        obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_lt.mp h1

        obtain ⟨b3, b4⟩ := abs_lt.mp g2

        obtain ⟨c3, c4⟩ := abs_le.mp hx2

        have r2 : round (v η).2 = round (v η1).2 :=
          hround _ _ (abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
        rw [hkk]

        rw [r1, r2]
        rfl
      have hbase : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => baseC B γ.1 η i) ξ := by
        intro i
        obtain ⟨hO, hsm⟩ := geom_slow_base_smooth_v5 B hok

      have hmd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl =>
          pzr5 B G γ * chartZ B.h γ.1 η / epsb B.h γ.1 + sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 * RC γ.1 η
          - (lamT (v η - kk) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 *
            (pang5 B G γ * Fang B γ.1 η + pzr5 B G γ * baseC B γ.1 η 2)) ξ := by

          pzr5 B G γ * chartZ B.h γ.1 η / epsb B.h γ.1 + sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 * RC γ.1 η

          rw [hfr η hη]

    hf.comp (contDiff_const.add (Lnorm B.h ξ).contDiff).contDiffOn (fun y hy => hy)
  have hp0 : p₀ + Lnorm B.h ξ (Θ 0) = pathPt B.h ξ ((ξ.1 ^ d + u) ^ (1 / d)) := by
    rw [hpid ξ u hs, hLw, hΘdef, hθdef, hp₀]
    simp only [Prod.fst_zero, Prod.snd_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, map_zero, Prod.mk_add_mk, zero_add,
      mul_inv_cancel_left₀ ha.ne']
  have hpm : pathPt B.h ξ ((ξ.1 ^ d + u) ^ (1 / d)) ∈ DomC B.h qs := hpath ξ hξ _ hρ0
  have hΘ0t : Θ 0 ∈ (fun y => p₀ + Lnorm B.h ξ y) ⁻¹' DomC B.h qs := by
    show p₀ + Lnorm B.h ξ (Θ 0) ∈ DomC B.h qs
    rw [hp0]; exact hpm
  have hs0 : IsOpen ((Prod.fst ⁻¹' Vθ : Set Cyl) ∩ Θ ⁻¹' ((fun y => p₀ + Lnorm B.h ξ y) ⁻¹' DomC B.h qs)) :=
    hΘs.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hV0 ht
  have h0s : (0:Cyl) ∈ (Prod.fst ⁻¹' Vθ : Set Cyl) ∩ Θ ⁻¹' ((fun y => p₀ + Lnorm B.h ξ y) ⁻¹' DomC B.h qs) :=
    ⟨h0V, hΘ0t⟩
  obtain ⟨Csum, hCsum⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ,
      c = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), NB B.h f i (pathPt B.h ξ ((ξ.1 ^ d + u) ^ (1 / d))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCb : ∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun y => f (p₀ + Lnorm B.h ξ y))
      ((fun y => p₀ + Lnorm B.h ξ y) ⁻¹' DomC B.h qs) (Θ 0)‖ ≤ Csum := by
    intro i hi
    have hmem : p₀ + Lnorm B.h ξ (Θ 0) ∈ DomC B.h qs := hΘ0t
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i ht hΘ0t, key f (DomC B.h qs) p₀ (Θ 0) (Lnorm B.h ξ) i hDo hf hmem,
      hp0, hCsum]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => NB B.h f i (pathPt B.h ξ ((ξ.1 ^ d + u) ^ (1 / d))))
      (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  have hDb : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i Θ
      ((Prod.fst ⁻¹' Vθ : Set Cyl) ∩ Θ ⁻¹' ((fun y => p₀ + Lnorm B.h ξ y) ⁻¹' DomC B.h qs)) 0‖ ≤ D ^ i := by
    intro i hi1 hik
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hs0 h0s]
    have hP := prodB θ Vθ i hVθ h0V hθs hi1
    have hTh := thetaB d u a ξ.1 i hd ha hr hs
    rw [← hθdef] at hTh
    rw [← hΘdef] at hP
    have hc2' := hC2 i ξ.1 u hr hs hτ
    have hX0 : 0 ≤ |iteratedDeriv i (fun s : ℝ => (s ^ d + u) ^ (1 / d)) ξ.1| := abs_nonneg _
    have hai : 0 ≤ a⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr ha.le
    have hpw : a ^ i ≤ (β * ξ.1) ^ i := pow_le_pow_left₀ ha.le hsqb i
    have hb2 : |iteratedDeriv i (fun s : ℝ => (s ^ d + u) ^ (1 / d)) ξ.1| * ξ.1 ^ i ≤
        |C2 i| * (Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xb) * a) :=
      hc2'.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hρ0.le).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hρ (abs_nonneg _)))
    have hθb : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i θ 0‖ ≤ M i := by
      refine hTh.trans ?_
      have hia : a⁻¹ * a = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ ha.ne'
      calc a⁻¹ * a ^ i * |iteratedDeriv i (fun s : ℝ => (s ^ d + u) ^ (1 / d)) ξ.1|
          ≤ a⁻¹ * (β * ξ.1) ^ i * |iteratedDeriv i (fun s : ℝ => (s ^ d + u) ^ (1 / d)) ξ.1| :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpw hai) hX0
        _ = a⁻¹ * β ^ i * (|iteratedDeriv i (fun s : ℝ => (s ^ d + u) ^ (1 / d)) ξ.1| * ξ.1 ^ i) := by
            ring

            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb2 (mul_nonneg hai (pow_nonneg hβ0 _))
        _ = (a⁻¹ * a) * (|C2 i| * β ^ i * Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xb)) := by ring

    have hMs : M i ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), M j :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hM0 j) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
    calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i θ 0‖ + 1 := hP
      _ ≤ D := by rw [hD]; linarith
      _ ≤ D ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
  have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hGs (hΘs.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (n := k)
    (by exact_mod_cast le_top) ht.uniqueDiffOn hs0.uniqueDiffOn (fun w hw => hw.2) h0s hCb hDb
  
  obtain ⟨U, hUdef⟩ : ∃ U : Set Cyl, U = DomC B.h qs ∩ {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1 ^ d + u} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hUo : IsOpen U := by
    rw [hUdef]
    exact hDo.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const
      ((continuous_fst.rpow_const (fun _ => Or.inr hd.le)).add continuous_const))
  have hFs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun η : Cyl => f ((η.1 ^ d + u) ^ (1 / d), η.2.1, η.2.2.1, η.2.2.2 + u • vrv)) U := by
    intro η hη
    rw [hUdef] at hη
    have hη1 : 0 < η.1 := hη.1.1
    have hη2 : 0 < η.1 ^ d + u := hη.2
    have hmem : ((η.1 ^ d + u) ^ (1 / d), η.2.1, η.2.2.1, η.2.2.2 + u • vrv) ∈ DomC B.h qs := by
      rw [← hpid η u hη2]; exact hpath η hη.1 _ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hη2 _)
    have hΦ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (fun η : Cyl => ((η.1 ^ d + u) ^ (1 / d), η.2.1, η.2.2.1, η.2.2.2 + u • vrv)) η :=
      (((contDiffAt_fst.rpow_const_of_ne hη1.ne').add contDiffAt_const).rpow_const_of_ne
        hη2.ne').prodMk

  have hξU : ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ 0 ∈ U := by
    rw [map_zero, add_zero, hUdef]; exact ⟨hξ, hs⟩
  have hk := key (fun η : Cyl => f ((η.1 ^ d + u) ^ (1 / d), η.2.1, η.2.2.1, η.2.2.2 + u • vrv))
    U ξ 0 (Lnorm B.h ξ) k hUo hFs hξU
  rw [map_zero, add_zero] at hk
  have hid : (fun z : Cyl => (fun η : Cyl => f ((η.1 ^ d + u) ^ (1 / d), η.2.1, η.2.2.1,
      η.2.2.2 + u • vrv)) (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) = (fun y => f (p₀ + Lnorm B.h ξ y)) ∘ Θ := by
    funext w
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    congr 1
    rw [hLw, hLw, hΘdef, hθdef, hp₀]
    simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.mk_add_mk, zero_add, mul_inv_cancel_left₀ ha.ne']
    refine Prod.ext rfl (Prod.ext rfl (Prod.ext rfl ?_))
    show ξ.2.2.2 + _ + u • vrv = ξ.2.2.2 + u • vrv + _
    abel
  calc NB B.h (fun η => f ((η.1 ^ d + u) ^ (1 / d), η.2.1, η.2.2.1, η.2.2.2 + u • vrv)) k ξ
      = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : Cyl => (fun η : Cyl => f ((η.1 ^ d + u) ^ (1 / d), η.2.1,
          η.2.2.1, η.2.2.2 + u • vrv)) (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) 0‖ := by
        unfold NB; rw [hk]
    _ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((fun y => f (p₀ + Lnorm B.h ξ y)) ∘ Θ) 0‖ := by rw [hid]
    _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k ((fun y => f (p₀ + Lnorm B.h ξ y)) ∘ Θ)

    _ ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) * Csum * D ^ k := hFdB
    _ = (k.factorial : ℝ) * D ^ k *
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), NB B.h f i (pathPt B.h ξ ((ξ.1 ^ d + u) ^ (1 / d))) := by
        rw [hCsum]; ring

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → 0 < drx B.h → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 →
     ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) →
     (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) →
     ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : Cyl × ℝ => if 0 < p.1.1 ^ drx B.h + p.2 then (1 / drx B.h) * (p.1.1 ^ drx B.h + p.2) ^ (1 / drx B.h - 1) *
         f ((p.1.1 ^ drx B.h + p.2) ^ (1 / drx B.h), p.1.2.1, p.1.2.2.1, p.1.2.2.2 + p.2 • vrv) else 0) (DomC B.h qs ×ˢ Set.univ) ∧
     ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ u : ℝ,
       (ξ.1 ^ drx B.h + u < (2 * B.Xa * qC B.h ξ) ^ (drx B.h / 2) ∨ (2 * B.Xb * qC B.h ξ) ^ (drx B.h / 2) < ξ.1 ^ drx B.h + u) →
       (fun η : Cyl => if 0 < η.1 ^ drx B.h + u then (1 / drx B.h) * (η.1 ^ drx B.h + u) ^ (1 / drx B.h - 1) *
         f ((η.1 ^ drx B.h + u) ^ (1 / drx B.h), η.2.1, η.2.2.1, η.2.2.2 + u • vrv) else 0) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun _ => (0:ℝ)

by

  have hd2 : 0 < d / 2 := by linarith

    have e : DomC B.h qs = {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ ({ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Set.Iio qs) := by
      ext ξ; rfl
    rw [e]
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).inter ho
  have hqD : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) := hqc.mono (fun ξ hξ => hξ.2.1)
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -⟩ := hok.2.1

  have hvan : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ u : ℝ,
      (η.1 ^ d + u < (2 * B.Xa * qC B.h η) ^ (d / 2) ∨ (2 * B.Xb * qC B.h η) ^ (d / 2) < η.1 ^ d + u) →

  · intro ξ hξ u hu
    have hsu : Continuous (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ d + u) :=
      (continuous_fst.rpow_const (fun _ => Or.inr hd.le)).add continuous_const
    rcases hu with hu | hu

      have hη2 : 0 < (2 * B.Xa * qC B.h η) ^ (d / 2) - (η.1 ^ d + u) := hη.2
      exact hvan η hη.1 u (Or.inl (by linarith))
    · have hgo : ContinuousOn (fun η : Cyl => (2 * B.Xb * qC B.h η) ^ (d / 2)) (DomC B.h qs) :=
        (continuousOn_const.mul hqD).rpow_const (fun _ _ => Or.inr hd2.le)
      have hNo : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs ∩
          (fun η : Cyl => (η.1 ^ d + u) - (2 * B.Xb * qC B.h η) ^ (d / 2)) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0) :=
        (hsu.continuousOn.sub hgo).isOpen_inter_preimage hDo isOpen_Ioi
      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hNo.mem_nhds ⟨hξ,
        (show 0 < (ξ.1 ^ d + u) - (2 * B.Xb * qC B.h ξ) ^ (d / 2) by linarith)⟩) (fun η hη => ?_)
      have hη2 : 0 < (η.1 ^ d + u) - (2 * B.Xb * qC B.h η) ^ (d / 2) := hη.2
      exact hvan η hη.1 u (Or.inr (by linarith))

signature.name: nb_param_integral_le_v4
signature.statement:
∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (K : Cyl → ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), IsOpen U →
     ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : Cyl × ℝ => K p.1 p.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) →
     ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ∫ u in Set.Icc a b, K η u) U ∧
     ∀ ξ ∈ U, ∀ k : ℕ, NB h (fun η => ∫ u in Set.Icc a b, K η u) k ξ ≤ ∫ u in Set.Icc a b, NB h (fun η => K η u) k ξ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h U K a b hU hK
  
  have PIC : ∀ {P E' F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
      [FiniteDimensional ℝ P] [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace ℝ E'] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E']
      [MeasurableSpace E'] [BorelSpace E'] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
      (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E') [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ]
      (U : Set P) (V K : Set E') (G : P → E' → F) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hK : IsCompact K)
      (hKV : K ⊆ V) (hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => G z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V)),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) x =
        ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ) := by
    intro P E' F _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ μ _ U V K G hU hV hK hKV hG
    have hO : IsOpen (U ×ˢ V) := hU.prod hV
    have hKm : MeasurableSet K := hK.isClosed.measurableSet
    have slice : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F'] (H : P → E' → F'),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) →
        ∀ x ∈ U, ContinuousOn (fun y => H x y) K := by
      intro F' _ _ H hH x hx
      have hc : Continuous (fun y : E' => ((x, y) : P × E')) := by fun_prop
      have h := ContinuousOn.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (f := fun y : E' => ((x, y) : P × E'))
        hH.continuousOn hc.continuousOn (fun y hy => ⟨hx, hKV hy⟩)
      exact h
    have param_fderiv : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F'] (H : P → E' → F'),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => H x' z.2) z.1) (U ×ˢ V) := by
      intro F' _ _ H hH p hp
      have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) p := hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hp)
      apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry (fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2)) (p, p.1) := by
        have e : Function.uncurry (fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2) =
            (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) ∘ (fun w : (P × E') × P => (w.2, w.1.2)) := rfl
        rw [e]
        apply ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (p, p.1)
        · simpa using hHa
        · fun_prop
      exact ContDiffAt.fderiv (f := fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2)
        (g := Prod.fst) h1 contDiffAt_fst (le_of_eq ENat.coe_top_add_one)
    have param_hasFDeriv : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F']
        (H : P → E' → F'), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) → ∀ x ∈ U,
        HasFDerivAt (fun x' => ∫ y in K, H x' y ∂μ) (∫ y in K, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => H x' y) x ∂μ) x := by
      intro F' _ _ H hH x hx
      have hHs := param_fderiv H hH
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU x hx
      have hsU : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ⊆ U :=
        (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
      have hsn : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ∈ nhds x := Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds x (by linarith)
      have hC : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ×ˢ K) := (isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod hK
      have hCsub : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ×ˢ K ⊆ U ×ˢ V := fun z hz => ⟨hsU hz.1, hKV hz.2⟩
      obtain ⟨Bd, hB⟩ := hC.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hHs.continuousOn.mono hCsub)
      refine hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (μ := μ.restrict K)
        (F := fun x' y => H x' y) (F' := fun x' y => fderiv ℝ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x')
        (bound := fun _ => Bd) hsn ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hx] with x' hx'
        exact (slice H hH x' hx').aestronglyMeasurable_of_isCompact hK hKm
      · exact (slice H hH x hx).integrableOn_compact hK
      · exact (slice (fun x' y => fderiv ℝ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x') hHs x hx).aestronglyMeasurable_of_isCompact
          hK hKm
      · exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hKm (fun y hy x' hx' => hB (x', y) ⟨hx', hy⟩)
      · exact continuousOn_const.integrableOn_compact hK
      · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hKm (fun y hy x' hx' => ?_)
        have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (x', y) :=
          hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds ⟨hsU hx', hKV hy⟩)
        have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x'' : P => ((x'', y) : P × E')) x' := by fun_prop
        have h2 := ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) x' hHa hc
        have : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x' := h2
        exact (this.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have hD0 : ∀ x y, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun x' => G x' y) x =
        (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm (G x y) := by
      intro x y; rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp]; rfl
    have hDs : ∀ (k : ℕ) x y, iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) (fun x' => G x' y) x =
        (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm
          (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') x) := by
      intro k x y; rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left]; rfl
    have D_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) (U ×ˢ V) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        have e : (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) =
            (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm ∘ (fun z : P × E' => G z.1 z.2) := by
          funext z; exact hD0 z.1 z.2
        rw [e]
        exact (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hG
      | succ k ih =>
        have e : (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) =
            (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm ∘
              (fun z : P × E' => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' z.2) x') z.1) := by
          funext z; exact hDs k z.1 z.2
        rw [e]
        have h2 := param_fderiv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') ih
        exact (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h2
    have formula : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) x =
        ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro x _
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp (f := fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ)]
        simp only [hD0]
        exact (ContinuousLinearEquiv.integral_comp_comm
          (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv (fun y => G x y)).symm
      | succ k ih =>
        intro x hx
        have hα : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) =ᶠ[nhds x]
            (fun x' => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x' ∂μ) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hx) ih
        have hβ := (param_hasFDeriv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x')
          (D_smooth k) x hx).fderiv
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left (f := fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ), Function.comp_apply,
          hα.fderiv_eq, hβ]
        simp only [hDs]
        have hL := ContinuousLinearEquiv.integral_comp_comm (μ := μ.restrict K) (𝕜 := ℝ)
          (E := P →L[ℝ] ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => P) F)
          (F := ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F)
          (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv
          (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') x)
        exact hL.symm
    have hsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U := by
      have key : ∀ m : ℕ, EqOn (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U)
          (fun x => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ) U := by
        intro m x hx
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hU hx]
        exact formula m x hx
      have hdiff : ∀ m : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℝ
          (fun x => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ) U :=
        fun m x hx => (param_hasFDeriv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x'' => G x'' y) x')
          (D_smooth m) x hx).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      exact contDiffOn_of_continuousOn_differentiableOn (n := ⊤)
        (fun m _ => ((hdiff m).continuousOn).congr (key m))
        (fun m _ => (hdiff m).congr (key m))
    exact ⟨hsmooth, formula⟩
  
  have hP := PIC MeasureTheory.volume U Set.univ (Set.Icc a b) K hU isOpen_univ isCompact_Icc
    (Set.subset_univ _) hK
  refine ⟨hP.1, fun ξ hξ k => ?_⟩
  have hform : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => ∫ u in Set.Icc a b, K η u) ξ =
      ∫ u in Set.Icc a b, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => K η u) ξ := hP.2 k ξ hξ
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ⟩ : ∃ Λ : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => Cyl) ℝ →L[ℝ]
      ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => Cyl) ℝ,
      ∀ g, Λ g = g.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) :=
    ⟨ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMapL (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ),
      fun g => ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMapL_apply _ _⟩
  have hN : ∀ u, NB h (fun η => K η u) k ξ = ‖Λ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => K η u) ξ)‖ := by
    intro u; rw [hΛ]; rfl
  have hRHS0 : 0 ≤ ∫ u in Set.Icc a b, NB h (fun η => K η u) k ξ :=
    MeasureTheory.setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Icc (fun u _ => norm_nonneg _)
  show ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => ∫ u in Set.Icc a b, K η u) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
    (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ ≤ _
  rw [hform]
  by_cases hint : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun u => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => K η u) ξ)
      (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b))
  · have hNi : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun u => NB h (fun η => K η u) k ξ)
        (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b)) := by
      have e : (fun u => NB h (fun η => K η u) k ξ) =
          fun u => ‖Λ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => K η u) ξ)‖ := funext hN
      rw [e]
      exact (Λ.integrable_comp hint).norm
    refine ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound hRHS0 (fun v => ?_)
    simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.integral_apply hint]
    calc ‖∫ u in Set.Icc a b, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => K η u) ξ (fun i => Lnorm h ξ (v i))‖
        ≤ ∫ u in Set.Icc a b, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => K η u) ξ (fun i => Lnorm h ξ (v i))‖ :=
          MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
      _ ≤ ∫ u in Set.Icc a b, NB h (fun η => K η u) k ξ * ∏ i, ‖v i‖ := by
          refine MeasureTheory.integral_mono_of_nonneg
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun u => norm_nonneg _)) (hNi.mul_const _)
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun u => ?_))
          have hle := ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm
            ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => K η u) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)) v
          rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply] at hle
          exact hle
      _ = (∫ u in Set.Icc a b, NB h (fun η => K η u) k ξ) * ∏ i, ‖v i‖ :=
          MeasureTheory.integral_mul_const _ _
  · rw [MeasureTheory.integral_undef hint]
    have hz : (0 : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => Cyl) ℝ).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) = 0 := by
      ext v; simp
    rw [hz, norm_zero]
    exact hRHS0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G _ l0 _ γ m ξ _ hne hη

  have hc : ∀ η : Cyl, etaL B.h γ η = 0 → W0c4 B G γ η = 0 := by

  have hline : ∀ s : ℝ, W0h4 B G γ m (ξ + s • dVdir B.h γ.1) = 0 := fun s =>

proof.tactics:
by

  refine ⟨n0, fun l0 hl0 hW0 hpw γ m => ?_⟩
  have hr1 : G.r0 ≤ 1/100 := hG.1.2.1
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 < B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hl0) hn0
  have hSP : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  have hqcont : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h4 := hSP.2.2.2.1
    have hm : MapsTo (fun η : Cyl => (η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1)) {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro η hη
      have hη' : η.2.2.1 < 1 := hη
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - η.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    exact (h4.comp (f := fun η : Cyl => (η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1)) (ContDiff.contDiffOn (by fun_prop)) hm).congr
      (fun η _ => rfl)
  have hT1o : IsOpen {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
  have hDo : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) = {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} ∩
        ({η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} ∩ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0)) := by

        {Y' : ℝ × ℝ | |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).1 - (K1 : ℝ)| < 1/2} ∩
        {Y' : ℝ × ℝ | |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).2 - (K2 : ℝ)| < 1/2} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hVo : IsOpen V := by
      rw [hV]
      exact (isOpen_lt ((hJc.fst).sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const).inter
        (isOpen_lt ((hJc.snd).sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const)
    have hYV : ξ0.2.2.2 ∈ V := by
      rw [hV]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · show |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ0.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1 - (K1 : ℝ)| < 1/2
        rw [← hw1e]; exact lt_trans hgood.1 (by norm_num)
      · show |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ0.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2 - (K2 : ℝ)| < 1/2
        rw [← hw2e]; exact lt_trans hgood.2 (by norm_num)
    have hfr : ∀ Y' ∈ V, rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) Y' =
        Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ - ((K1 : ℝ), (K2 : ℝ)) := by
      intro Y' hY'
      rw [hV] at hY'
      have r1 : round ((Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).1) = K1 := hround _ _ hY'.1
      have r2 : round ((Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).2) = K2 := hround _ _ hY'.2
      unfold rectW frac0
      rw [r1, r2]
      ext <;> simp
    obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U : Set Cyl, U = (fun η : Cyl => η.2.2.2) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hUo : IsOpen U := by
      rw [hU]
      exact hVo.preimage (by fun_prop)
    have hξU : ξ0 ∈ U := by rw [hU]; exact hYV
    have hUV : ∀ η ∈ U, η.2.2.2 ∈ V := by
      intro η hη
      rw [hU] at hη
      exact hη
    have hTo : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) := hDo.inter hUo
    
    have hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl =>
        (lamT (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ - ((K1 : ℝ), (K2 : ℝ))) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1) := by
      unfold lamT Jpow; fun_prop
    obtain ⟨φt, hφt⟩ : ∃ f : Cyl → ℝ, f = fun η : Cyl => pzr5 B G γ * chartZ B.h γ.1 η / epsb B.h γ.1 +
        sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 * RC γ.1 η -
        ((lamT (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ - ((K1 : ℝ), (K2 : ℝ))) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1) *
          (pang5 B G γ * Fang B γ.1 η + pzr5 B G γ * baseC B γ.1 η 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φt (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
      rw [hφt]
      exact (((contDiffOn_const.mul hchartZ.contDiffOn).div_const _).add
        (contDiffOn_const.mul hRC.contDiffOn)).sub
        (hv.contDiffOn.mul ((contDiffOn_const.mul hFang).add (contDiffOn_const.mul (hbase 2))))
    have hEq : ∀ η ∈ U, phiL5 B G γ η = φt η := by
      intro η hη
      rw [hφt]
      simp only [phiL5, vco, etG, hfr _ (hUV η hη)]
    have hN : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ η i) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) := by
      intro i
      fin_cases i
      · show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) *
          fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) η ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv))
          (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U)
        exact contDiffOn_const.mul (transfer _ hTo _ φt _ (fun η hη => hEq η hη.2)
          (hφ.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (hdR.mono Set.inter_subset_left))
      · show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => pang5 B G γ / RC γ.1 η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U)
        exact contDiffOn_const.div hRC.contDiffOn (fun η hη => hRCne η hη.1)
      · show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) *
          fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) η (((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) : Cyl)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U)
        exact contDiffOn_const.mul (transfer _ hTo _ φt (fun _ => (((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) : Cyl))
          (fun η hη => hEq η hη.2) (hφ.mono Set.inter_subset_left) contDiffOn_const)
    
    have hWT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (W0h4 B G γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) := hWs.mono Set.inter_subset_left
    have hPT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((primState5 B G).pw γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) :=
      hPs.mono Set.inter_subset_left
    have hρT : ∀ e : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (((rhoQ B γ η ^ e) : ℝ) : ℂ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) :=
      fun e => (hρs e).mono Set.inter_subset_left
    have hdVT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => dVc B γ.1 (W0h4 B G γ m) η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) :=
      hdV.mono Set.inter_subset_left
    have hKT : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Kmat B G γ η i j) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) :=
      fun i j => (hK i j).mono Set.inter_subset_left
    have hmv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (pulseMatC (Kmat B G γ η)).mulVec (W0h4 B G γ m η))
        (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) := by
      apply contDiffOn_pi.2
      intro i
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ∑ j : Fin 3, ((Kmat B G γ η i j : ℝ) : ℂ) * W0h4 B G γ m η j)
          (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) :=
        ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ => (hcast _ _ (hKT i j)).mul (contDiffOn_pi.1 hWT j))
      exact h1.congr (fun η _ => rfl)
    have hdd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => dDamp5 B G γ η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) := by
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 *
          ∑ i : Fin 3, nPhi5 B G γ η i * nPhi5 B G γ η i) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) :=
        contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => (hN i).mul (hN i)))
      exact h1.congr (fun η _ => rfl)
    have hnc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => nPhiC5 B G γ η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) :=
      contDiffOn_pi.2 (fun i => hcast _ _ (hN i))
    have hfin : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (((rhoQ B γ η ^ (Aex B.h + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        (dVc B γ.1 (W0h4 B G γ m) η + (pulseMatC (Kmat B G γ η)).mulVec (W0h4 B G γ m η)
          + ((m : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((dDamp5 B G γ η : ℝ) : ℂ)) • W0h4 B G γ m η)
        + ((((rhoQ B γ η ^ (1/2 : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ))
          * (primState5 B G).pw γ m η) • nPhiC5 B G γ η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) :=
      ((hρT _).smul ((hdVT.add hmv).add ((contDiffOn_const.mul (hcast _ _ hdd)).smul hWT))).add
        ((((hρT _).mul contDiffOn_const).mul hPT).smul hnc)
    exact ⟨U, hUo, hξU, hfin.congr (fun η _ => rfl)⟩
  · 
    have hfarN : ∃ N : Set Cyl, IsOpen N ∧ ξ0 ∈ N ∧
        ∀ η ∈ N, ¬ inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (2 * G.r0) η.2.2.2 := by
      rw [not_and_or, not_lt, not_lt] at hgood
      rcases hgood with h1 | h1
      · refine ⟨{η : Cyl | |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1 -
            (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ0.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1| < 1/24},
          isOpen_lt (hJη.fst.sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const, by simp, ?_⟩
        intro η hη hR
        have e1 : 1/12 ≤ |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ0.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1 -
            ((round (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ0.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1 : ℤ) : ℝ)| := h1
        have e2 : |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1 -
            ((round (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 3/100 := (hsmall _ hR).1
        have e3 := hfar _ _ e1 hη
        linarith
      · refine ⟨{η : Cyl | |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2 -
            (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ0.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2| < 1/24},
          isOpen_lt (hJη.snd.sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const, by simp, ?_⟩
        intro η hη hR
        have e1 : 1/12 ≤ |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ0.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2 -
            ((round (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ0.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)| := h1
        have e2 : |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2 -
            ((round (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 3/100 := (hsmall _ hR).2
        have e3 := hfar _ _ e1 hη
        linarith
    obtain ⟨N, hNo, hξ0N, hNR⟩ := hfarN
    have hc0 : ∀ η ∈ N, W0c4 B G γ η = 0 := by
      intro η hη
      unfold W0c4
      rw [if_neg (fun h => hNR η hη h.2)]
    have hW0z : ∀ η ∈ N, W0h4 B G γ m η = 0 := by
      intro η hη
      have h0 := hc0 η hη
      show (if m = 1 ∨ m = -1 then (fun i => ((W0c4 B G γ η i : ℝ) : ℂ)) else 0) = 0
      split_ifs
      · funext i
        simp [h0]
      · rfl
    have hp0 : ∀ η ∈ N, (primState5 B G).pw γ m η = 0 := by
      intro η hη
      have h0 := hc0 η hη
      show (((qC B.h η / Qb γ.1) ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * presW5 B G (W0c4 B G) γ m η = 0
      unfold presW5
      rw [h0]
      simp
    have hd0 : ∀ η ∈ N, dVc B γ.1 (W0h4 B G γ m) η = 0 := by
      intro η hη
      have hev : W0h4 B G γ m =ᶠ[nhds η] fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hNo.mem_nhds hη) hW0z
      unfold dVc
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    have hz : ∀ η ∈ N, princC5 B G γ m η = 0 := by
      intro η hη
      unfold princC5
      rw [hd0 η hη, hW0z η hη, hp0 η hη]
      simp
    exact ⟨N, hNo, hξ0N, (contDiffOn_const (c := (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ))).congr (fun η hη => hz η hη.2)⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (γ : Lab) (v : ℝ), ActiveL4 B G γ → 0 ≤ v → v ≤ Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 → Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 5 ≤ |v - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2| → Penv5 B G γ v ≤ Real.exp (-c * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2)

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (γ : Lab) (v : ℝ), ActiveL4 B G γ → 0 ≤ v → v ≤ Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 → Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 5 ≤ |v - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2| → Penv5 B G γ v ≤ Real.exp (-c * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨cl, Cl, hcl, hF⟩ := frame5_consts B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨⟨hr0, -, hu, -, hlmin⟩, -⟩ := hG
  
  have s1 : ∀ (h : ℝ) (l : ℕ), 1 ≤ l → 0 < cib h l ∧ cib h l * (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    intro h l hl
    have hL : (1:ℝ) ≤ (l:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hl
    have hL2 : (0:ℝ) < (l:ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hT1 : (1:ℝ) < Tgc := by
      unfold Tgc
      have := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
      linarith
    have hT0 : (0:ℝ) < Tgc := by linarith
    have hy0 : (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
      div_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _) hL2
    have hQ0 : 0 < Qb l := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _
    have hQp : 0 < Qb l ^ (1 + h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ0 _
    have hfl : ((bandIdx h l : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤
        Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2)) := Int.floor_le _
    have hz : Tgc ^ (bandIdx h l) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_intCast]
      calc Tgc ^ ((bandIdx h l : ℤ) : ℝ)
          ≤ Tgc ^ (Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2))) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hT1.le hfl
        _ = (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) := Real.rpow_logb hT0 hT1.ne' hy0
    have hQe : Qb l ^ (1 + h) * (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) = 1 := by
      unfold Qb
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num), ← Real.rpow_add two_pos]
      have e : -(l:ℝ) * (1 + h) + (1 + h) * (l:ℝ) = 0 := by ring
      rw [e, Real.rpow_zero]
    have hyL : (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) * (l:ℝ) ^ 2 =
        (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hL2.ne'
    refine ⟨mul_pos (zpow_pos hT0 _) hQp, ?_⟩
    unfold cib
    calc Tgc ^ (bandIdx h l) * Qb l ^ (1 + h) * (l:ℝ) ^ 2
        ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) * Qb l ^ (1 + h) * (l:ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hz hQp.le
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this hL2.le
      _ = ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) * (l:ℝ) ^ 2) * Qb l ^ (1 + h) := by ring
      _ = 1 := by rw [hyL, mul_comm]; exact hQe
  
  have win : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (L K v : ℝ), Continuous g → 0 < L → 0 ≤ K →
      (∀ w : ℝ, L / 2 ≤ w → g w ≤ 0) → (∀ w : ℝ, 6 * L / 10 ≤ w → g w ≤ -K) →
      (∀ w : ℝ, 0 ≤ w → w ≤ L / 2 → 0 ≤ g w) → (∀ w : ℝ, 0 ≤ w → w ≤ 4 * L / 10 → K ≤ g w) →
      0 ≤ v → L / 5 ≤ |v - L / 2| → ∫ w in (L / 2)..v, g w ≤ -(K * L / 10) := by
    intro g L K v hg hL hK h1 h2 h3 h4 hv0 hw
    have hi : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable g MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
      fun a b => hg.intervalIntegrable a b
    have hc : ∀ (c a b : ℝ), IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => c) MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
      fun c a b => continuous_const.intervalIntegrable a b
    rcases le_or_gt (L / 2) v with hv | hv
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)] at hw
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hi (L / 2) (6 * L / 10)) (hi (6 * L / 10) v)]
      have I1 : ∫ w in (L / 2)..(6 * L / 10), g w ≤ ∫ w in (L / 2)..(6 * L / 10), (0:ℝ) :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by linarith) (hi _ _) (hc 0 _ _)
          (fun w hw' => h1 w hw'.1)
      have I2 : ∫ w in (6 * L / 10)..v, g w ≤ ∫ w in (6 * L / 10)..v, (-K) :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by linarith) (hi _ _) (hc (-K) _ _)
          (fun w hw' => h2 w hw'.1)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_zero] at I1
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul] at I2
      have hp : 0 ≤ K * (v - 7 * L / 10) := mul_nonneg hK (by linarith)
      linarith
    · rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)] at hw
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm,
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hi v (4 * L / 10)) (hi (4 * L / 10) (L / 2))]
      have J1 : ∫ w in v..(4 * L / 10), K ≤ ∫ w in v..(4 * L / 10), g w :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by linarith) (hc K _ _) (hi _ _)
          (fun w hw' => h4 w (le_trans hv0 hw'.1) hw'.2)
      have J2 : 0 ≤ ∫ w in (4 * L / 10)..(L / 2), g w :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by linarith)
          (fun w hw' => h3 w (by linarith [hw'.1]) hw'.2)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul] at J1
      have hp : 0 ≤ K * (3 * L / 10 - v) := mul_nonneg hK (by linarith)
      linarith
  
  have ha1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + G.ustar ^ 2 := by linarith [sq_nonneg G.ustar]
  have ha0 : (0:ℝ) < 1 + G.ustar ^ 2 := by linarith
  have hA : 0 < (1 + G.ustar ^ 2) ^ (3/2:ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos ha0 _
  have hM : 0 < 19/100 * G.ustar ^ 2 := by have := pow_pos hu 2; linarith
  have hr32 : (1 + G.ustar ^ 2) ^ (3/2:ℝ) = (1 + G.ustar ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (1 + G.ustar ^ 2) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, show (3/2:ℝ) = 1 + 1/2 by norm_num, Real.rpow_add ha0, Real.rpow_one]
  have hsa : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 + G.ustar ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr ha0
  have hc0 : 0 < cl / (1 + G.ustar ^ 2) ^ (3/2:ℝ) := div_pos hcl hA
  refine ⟨cl / (1 + G.ustar ^ 2) ^ (3/2:ℝ) * (19/100 * G.ustar ^ 2) * (2 * G.r0) / 10,
    div_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos hc0 hM) (by linarith)) (by norm_num), ?_⟩
  intro γ v hAct hv0 _hvL hwin
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, hlam, -⟩ := hF γ hAct
  have hl1 : 1 ≤ γ.1 := by have := hAct.1; omega
  obtain ⟨hci, hciL⟩ := s1 B.h γ.1 hl1
  have hL : 0 < Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 := by unfold Lsb; exact div_pos (by linarith) hci
  have hLl : 2 * G.r0 * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 := by
    unfold Lsb
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hci]
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hciL (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * G.r0 by linarith)
    linarith
  have hlam0 : 0 < lam0_5 B G γ := lt_of_lt_of_le hcl hlam
  have hQb : 0 < Qb γ.1 := by unfold Qb; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hep : 0 < epsb B.h γ.1 := by unfold epsb; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQb _
  have hkb : (0:ℝ) < (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) := by
    unfold kb
    exact Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hep _))
  have hc : 0 < epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ))^2 := mul_pos hep (pow_pos hkb 2)
  have hBs : Bs5 B G γ ^ 2 = lam0_5 B G γ /
      (epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ))^2 * (1 + G.ustar ^ 2) ^ (3/2:ℝ)) := by
    unfold Bs5
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (div_nonneg hlam0.le (mul_pos hc hA).le)]
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = lam0_5 B G γ / (1 + G.ustar ^ 2) ^ (3/2:ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := by rw [hD]; exact div_nonneg hlam0.le hA.le
  have hcoef : epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ))^2 * Bs5 B G γ ^ 2 = D := by
    rw [hBs, hD]
    field_simp
  have hDa : D * (1 + G.ustar ^ 2) = lam0_5 B G γ / Real.sqrt (1 + G.ustar ^ 2) := by
    rw [hD, hr32]
    field_simp
  have hDl : cl / (1 + G.ustar ^ 2) ^ (3/2:ℝ) ≤ D := by
    rw [hD]; exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlam hA.le
  
  have key : ∀ w : ℝ,
      (1 + sco B G γ w ^ 2 ≤ 1 + G.ustar ^ 2 →

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (a : WC), (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (a γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → (m = 1 ∨ m = -1) ∧ SuppW B G γ ξ ∧ etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0) → (∀ k N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (a γ m) ξ‖ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (N : ℝ)) → ∀ (i : Fin 3), (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => a γ m η i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ)))) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) ∧ ∀ k N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => a γ m η i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ)))) ξ‖ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (N : ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  
  have core : ∀ (D U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (f : Cyl → ℂ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ) (c A Cp P : ℝ) (k : ℕ),
      IsOpen D → IsOpen U → ξ ∈ D → ξ ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f D → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ U → 1 ≤ A →
      (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k → |c| * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j φ ξ‖ ≤ A) →
      (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ‖ ≤ Cp * P) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => f η * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((c * φ η : ℝ) : ℂ))) ξ‖ ≤
        2 ^ k * (k.factorial : ℝ) * (Cp * P) * A ^ k := by
    intro D U ξ f φ c A Cp P k hD hU hξD hξU hf hφ hA hφb hfb
    have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ))) :=
      Complex.contDiff_exp.comp (contDiff_const.mul Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff)
    have hgd : ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ), iteratedDeriv n (fun s : ℝ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ))) s =
        Complex.I ^ n * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ)) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => intro s; simp
      | succ n ih =>
        intro s
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        have e : iteratedDeriv n (fun s : ℝ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ))) =
            fun s : ℝ => Complex.I ^ n * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ)) := funext ih
        rw [e]
        have h : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Complex.I ^ n * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ)))
            (Complex.I ^ n * (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ)) * (Complex.I * 1))) s := by
          apply HasDerivAt.const_mul
          apply HasDerivAt.cexp
          apply HasDerivAt.const_mul
          exact (hasDerivAt_id s).ofReal_comp
        rw [h.deriv]
        ring
    have hgn : ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ),
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun s : ℝ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ))) s‖ = 1 := by
      intro n s
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, hgd, norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_I, one_pow,
        one_mul, mul_comm]
      exact Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I s
    have hcφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => c * φ η) U := contDiffOn_const.mul hφ
    have hE : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((c * φ η : ℝ) : ℂ))) U :=
      hg.comp_contDiffOn hcφ
    have hEb : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((c * φ η : ℝ) : ℂ))) ξ‖ ≤
          (k.factorial : ℝ) * A ^ k := by
      intro j hj
      have hcomp := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le (n := j) (s := U) (t := Set.univ) (x := ξ)
        (C := 1) (D := A) hg.contDiffOn hcφ (by exact_mod_cast le_top) uniqueDiffOn_univ hU.uniqueDiffOn
        (Set.mapsTo_univ _ _) hξU
        (fun i _ => by rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_univ, hgn])
        (fun i hi1 hij => by
          rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hU hξU]
          have e : (fun η => c * φ η) = c • φ := by funext η; simp [smul_eq_mul]
          rw [e, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply ((hφ.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξU)).of_le
            (by exact_mod_cast le_top)), norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          exact le_trans (hφb i hi1 (le_trans hij hj)) (le_self_pow₀ hA (by omega)))
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hU hξU] at hcomp
      have e2 : ((fun s : ℝ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ))) ∘ fun η => c * φ η) =
          fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((c * φ η : ℝ) : ℂ)) := rfl
      rw [e2] at hcomp
      calc _ ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ) * 1 * A ^ j := hcomp
        _ ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) * A ^ k := by
          rw [mul_one]
          apply mul_le_mul (by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le hj) (pow_le_pow_right₀ hA hj)
            (by positivity) (by positivity)
    have hW : IsOpen (U ∩ D) := hU.inter hD
    have hξW : ξ ∈ U ∩ D := ⟨hξU, hξD⟩
    have hL := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le (n := k) (hf.mono Set.inter_subset_right)
      (hE.mono Set.inter_subset_left) hW.uniqueDiffOn hξW (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hW hξW] at hL
    refine le_trans hL ?_
    have hP0 : ∀ j ≤ k, 0 ≤ Cp * P := fun j hj => le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hfb j hj)
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i f (U ∩ D) ξ‖ *
          ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ (k - i) (fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((c * φ η : ℝ) : ℂ)))
            (U ∩ D) ξ‖
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * (Cp * P) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * A ^ k) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hW hξW, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (k - i) hW hξW]
          apply mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hfb i hik) (by positivity))
            (hEb (k - i) (Nat.sub_le k i)) (norm_nonneg _)
            (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (hP0 i hik))
      _ = 2 ^ k * (k.factorial : ℝ) * (Cp * P) * A ^ k := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul]
          have hs : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) = 2 ^ k := by
            exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose k
          rw [hs]
          ring
  
  obtain ⟨l3, h3⟩ := phiL5_jet_poly_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨l3 + n0, fun l0 hl0 a hsm hsupp hflat i => ?_⟩
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqs : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0.le
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by rw [hQb]; exact pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨hDo, hqCs, hqCpos, -, -, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  
  have hbase : ∀ (l : ℕ) (j : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => baseC B l ξ j) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro l j
    obtain ⟨-, hgs⟩ := geom_slow_base_smooth_v5 B hok
    have hπ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
      exact ⟨hξ'.1, hξ'.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ'.2.2 hqs⟩
    exact ((hgs l j).comp hπ.contDiffOn hmaps).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
  have hsm' : ∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => a γ m η i) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro γ m
    exact (contDiffOn_pi.mp (hsm γ m)) i
  have hconj1 : ∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => a γ m η i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) *
      ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ)))) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    wave_coef_phase_smooth_v5 B G (qsOf l0) (fun γ m η => a γ m η i) hG hbase hsm'
      (fun γ m ξ hξ hne => (hsupp γ m ξ hξ (fun h => hne (by simp [h]))).2.1)
  refine ⟨hconj1, fun k N => ?_⟩
  
  have hext : ∀ (F : Cyl → ℂ) (g : Cyl → ℝ) (S : Cyl → Prop),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → ContinuousOn g (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 ≤ g ξ) → (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), F η ≠ 0 → S η) →
      (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), S ξ → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F ξ‖ ≤ g ξ) →
      ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F ξ‖ ≤ g ξ := by
    intro F g S hF hg hg0 hFS hS ξ hξ
    have hFc : ContinuousOn (fun η => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F η‖) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      ((hF.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (m := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hDo.uniqueDiffOn).congr
        (fun x hx => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hDo hx).symm)).norm
    by_cases hA : ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, F η = 0
    · have h0 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F ξ = 0 := by
        have hE : F =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun _ => (0:ℂ) := hA
        rw [(hE.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
        have h := (iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun _ : Cyl => (0:ℂ)) = 0)
        exact congrFun h ξ
      rw [h0, norm_zero]
      exact hg0 ξ hξ
    · have hfr : ∃ᶠ η in nhds ξ, ¬ F η = 0 := Filter.not_eventually.mp hA
      have hfr2 : ∃ᶠ η in nhds ξ, η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ {η | F η ≠ 0} :=
        (hfr.and_eventually (hDo.mem_nhds hξ)).mono (fun η h => ⟨h.2, h.1⟩)
      have hcl : ξ ∈ closure (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ {η | F η ≠ 0}) :=
        mem_closure_iff_frequently.mpr hfr2
      exact ContinuousWithinAt.closure_le hcl
        ((hFc.continuousAt (hDo.mem_nhds hξ)).continuousWithinAt)
        ((hg.continuousAt (hDo.mem_nhds hξ)).continuousWithinAt)
        (fun y hy => hS y hy.1 (hFS y hy.1 hy.2))
  
  choose Cf Mf hMf hCf using h3
  obtain ⟨Cs, hCs1, hCs⟩ : ∃ Cs : ℝ, 1 ≤ Cs ∧ ∀ j ≤ k, |Cf j| ≤ Cs := by
    refine ⟨1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cf j|, ?_, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    · have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1)) => abs_nonneg (Cf j))
      linarith
    · have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cf j|)
        (fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1)) => abs_nonneg (Cf j))
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj))
      have h0 := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1)) => abs_nonneg (Cf j))
      linarith
  obtain ⟨Ms, hMs0, hMs⟩ : ∃ Ms : ℝ, 0 ≤ Ms ∧ ∀ j ≤ k, Mf j ≤ Ms := by
    refine ⟨∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), Mf j, Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hMf j), fun j hj => ?_⟩
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => Mf j) (fun j _ => hMf j)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj))
  obtain ⟨N', hN'⟩ : ∃ N' : ℕ, N' = N + ⌈(k : ℝ) * Ms⌉₊ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  choose Ca hCa using fun j => hflat j N'
  obtain ⟨C', hC'0, hC'⟩ : ∃ C' : ℝ, 0 ≤ C' ∧ ∀ j ≤ k, |Ca j| ≤ C' := by
    refine ⟨∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Ca j|,
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg (Ca j)), fun j hj => ?_⟩
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Ca j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg (Ca j))
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj))
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ 2 ^ k * (k.factorial : ℝ) * C' * Cs ^ k :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hC'0) (pow_nonneg (by linarith) k)
  refine ⟨2 ^ k * (k.factorial : ℝ) * C' * Cs ^ k, fun γ m ξ hξ => ?_⟩
  have hgc : ContinuousOn (fun η => 2 ^ k * (k.factorial : ℝ) * C' * Cs ^ k * qC B.h η ^ (N : ℝ))
      (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    continuousOn_const.mul (hqCs.continuousOn.rpow_const (fun x _ => Or.inr (Nat.cast_nonneg N)))
  have hg0 : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 ≤ 2 ^ k * (k.factorial : ℝ) * C' * Cs ^ k * qC B.h η ^ (N : ℝ) :=
    fun η hη => mul_nonneg hK0 (Real.rpow_nonneg (hqCpos η hη).le _)
  refine hext _ (fun η => 2 ^ k * (k.factorial : ℝ) * C' * Cs ^ k * qC B.h η ^ (N : ℝ))
    (fun η => a γ m η ≠ 0) (hconj1 γ m) hgc hg0 ?_ ?_ ξ hξ
  · intro η _ hne h
    exact hne (by simp [h])
  · intro ξ hξ hne
    obtain ⟨hm, hS, het⟩ := hsupp γ m ξ hξ hne
    have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqCpos ξ hξ
    have hq1 : qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 := le_trans hξ'.2.2.le hqs1
    obtain ⟨⟨U, hUo, hξU, hφU⟩, -⟩ := hCf 0 l0 γ ξ (by omega) hξ hS het
    have hpowM : 1 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (-Ms) :=
      Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hq0 hq1 (by linarith)
    have hA : 1 ≤ Cs * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Ms) := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hCs1 hpowM
    have habs : |(m : ℝ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ)| = (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) := by
      rw [abs_mul, Nat.abs_cast]
      rcases hm with rfl | rfl <;> simp
    have hφb : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k →
        |(m : ℝ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ)| * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (phiL5 B G γ) ξ‖ ≤ Cs * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Ms) := by
      intro j hj1 hjk
      rw [habs]
      have h1 := (hCf j l0 γ ξ (by omega) hξ hS het).2 hj1
      have h2 : qC B.h ξ ^ (-Mf j) ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (-Ms) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1 (by linarith [hMs j hjk])
      have h3 : Cf j ≤ Cs := le_trans (le_abs_self _) (hCs j hjk)
      calc _ ≤ Cf j * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Mf j) := h1
        _ ≤ Cs * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Ms) := mul_le_mul h3 h2 (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _) (by linarith)
    have hfb : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ‖ ≤ C' * qC B.h ξ ^ (N' : ℝ) := by
      intro j hj
      have hL : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j
          (⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) i) ∘ a γ m) ξ‖ ≤
          ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) i)‖ *
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (a γ m) ξ‖ :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left _
          ((hsm γ m).contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hξ)) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have hP : ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) i)‖ ≤ 1 :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun x => by simpa using norm_le_pi_norm x i)
      have hpN : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (N' : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
      have hb := hCa j γ m ξ hξ
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ‖ =
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j
              (⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) i) ∘ a γ m) ξ‖ := rfl
        _ ≤ 1 * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (a γ m) ξ‖ :=
            le_trans hL (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hP (norm_nonneg _))
        _ ≤ Ca j * qC B.h ξ ^ (N' : ℝ) := by rw [one_mul]; exact hb
        _ ≤ C' * qC B.h ξ ^ (N' : ℝ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_trans (le_abs_self _) (hC' j hj)) hpN
    have hcore := core (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) U ξ (fun η => a γ m η i) (phiL5 B G γ)
      ((m : ℝ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ)) (Cs * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Ms)) C' (qC B.h ξ ^ (N' : ℝ)) k
      hDo hUo hξ hξU (hsm' γ m) hφU hA hφb hfb
    have hfun : (fun η => a γ m η i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) *
        ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ)))) =
        (fun η => a γ m η i * Complex.exp (Complex.I *
          ((((m : ℝ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ)) * phiL5 B G γ η : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
      funext η
      rw [show (Complex.I * ((((m : ℝ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ)) * phiL5 B G γ η : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ)) by push_cast; ring]
    rw [hfun]
