    have hx' : dist ((x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) s0 < ε / 4 := hx
    rw [hGapp, hφ1 _ (le_of_lt hx'), one_mul]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs X1 : ℝ) (Φ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), B.ok → SimNorm B.h → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ (Set.Iio (Real.log qs) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, pbdPsi B.h ξ ∈ Set.Iio (Real.log qs) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => Φ (pbdPsi B.h ξ)) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, XC B.h ξ ≤ X1 → ∀ M : ℝ, (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j Φ (pbdPsi B.h ξ)‖ ≤ M) → NB B.h (fun ξ => Φ (pbdPsi B.h ξ)) k ξ ≤ K * M

signature.name: pbd_chain
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs X1 : ℝ) (Φ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), B.ok → SimNorm B.h → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ (Set.Iio (Real.log qs) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, pbdPsi B.h ξ ∈ Set.Iio (Real.log qs) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => Φ (pbdPsi B.h ξ)) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, XC B.h ξ ≤ X1 → ∀ M : ℝ, (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j Φ (pbdPsi B.h ξ)‖ ≤ M) → NB B.h (fun ξ => Φ (pbdPsi B.h ξ)) k ξ ≤ K * M

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs X1 Φ hok hSN hqs0 hqs1 hΦ
  have hS := hok.1
  have hpos : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ := fun ξ hξ =>
    (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ.2.1])).1
  have hWo : IsOpen {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_fst.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)) continuous_const)
  have hqW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have hlin : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) :=
      (contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_snd).prodMk
        (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_fst.comp (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd)))
    exact hS.2.2.2.1.comp hlin.contDiffOn
      (fun ξ hξ => ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith [hξ.2]⟩)
  have hDeq : DomC B.h qs = {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1} ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Set.Iio qs := by
    ext ξ
    exact ⟨fun h => ⟨⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩, h.2.2⟩, fun h => ⟨h.1.1, h.1.2, h.2⟩⟩
  have hO : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) := by
    rw [hDeq]; exact hqW.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hWo isOpen_Iio
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) :=
    hqW.mono (fun ξ hξ => ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1⟩)
  have hq_ne : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, qC B.h ξ ≠ 0 := fun ξ hξ => (hpos ξ hξ).ne'
  have hVo : IsOpen (Set.Iio (Real.log qs) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1) : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) :=
    isOpen_Iio.prod (isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo)
  
  have hmap : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs,
      pbdPsi B.h ξ ∈ (Set.Iio (Real.log qs) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1) : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) := by
    intro ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨hr, ht, hq⟩ := hξ
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hpos ξ ⟨hr, ht, hq⟩
    have hz2 : ξ.2.1 ^ 2 < qC B.h ξ ^ (1 - 2 * B.h) :=
      (hS.2.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show Real.log (qC B.h ξ) < Real.log qs
      exact Real.log_lt_log hq0 hq
    · show 0 < ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ)
      positivity
    · have ha : 0 < qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _
      have hsq : (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h)) ^ 2 = qC B.h ξ ^ (1 - 2 * B.h) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hq0.le]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring
      have habs : |ξ.2.1| < qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) :=
        abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq (by rw [hsq]; exact hz2) ha.le
      have heta : etaC B.h ξ = ξ.2.1 / qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) := by
        unfold etaC
        rw [Real.rpow_neg hq0.le, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
      have h1 : |etaC B.h ξ| < 1 := by
        rw [heta, abs_div, abs_of_pos ha, div_lt_one ha]
        exact habs
      exact abs_lt.mp h1
  
  have hpsi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pbdPsi B.h) (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => Real.log (qC B.h ξ)) (DomC B.h qs) := hqC.log hq_ne
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ)) (DomC B.h qs) :=
      ((contDiff_fst.pow 2).contDiffOn).div (contDiffOn_const.mul hqC)
        (fun ξ hξ => mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (hq_ne ξ hξ))
    have h3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.2.1 * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))) (DomC B.h qs) :=
      ((contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_snd).contDiffOn).mul (hqC.rpow_const_of_ne hq_ne)
    exact h1.prodMk (h2.prodMk h3)
  have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => Φ (pbdPsi B.h ξ)) (DomC B.h qs) :=
    hΦ.comp hpsi (fun ξ hξ => hmap ξ hξ)
  refine ⟨hmap, hsm, ?_⟩
  
  have key : ∀ {E F W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F]
      [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (G : F → W) (T : E →L[ℝ] F) (a : F)
      (V' : Set F) (i : ℕ), IsOpen V' → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G V' → a + T 0 ∈ V' →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => G (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G (a + T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro E F W _ _ _ _ _ _ G T a V' i hV' hF ha
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set F, s = (fun z => a + z) ⁻¹' V' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV'.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hOT : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have hAs : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [hs_def]; exact ha
    have hxO : (0:E) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hAs
    have hsm' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => G (a + T z)) i hOT hxO
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm' hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hOT.uniqueDiffOn hAs (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => G (a + z)) i hs hAs
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := G) i a (T 0)
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => G (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => G (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => G (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => G (a + z)) (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G (a + T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4]
  
  intro k
  choose Cs hCs using hSN
  obtain ⟨H0, hH0def⟩ : ∃ H0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,
      H0 = fun w => (Real.log w.1, w.2.1 ^ 2 * (w.1⁻¹ / 2), w.2.2 * w.1 ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hOo : IsOpen (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (ℝ × ℝ))) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_univ
  have hH0 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H0 (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (ℝ × ℝ))) := by
    have hne : ∀ w ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), w.1 ≠ 0 :=
      fun w hw => (Set.mem_Ioi.mp hw.1).ne'
    rw [hH0def]
    refine ContDiffOn.prodMk ?_ (ContDiffOn.prodMk ?_ ?_)
    · exact contDiff_fst.contDiffOn.log hne
    · exact ((contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_snd).pow 2).contDiffOn.mul
        ((contDiff_fst.contDiffOn.inv hne).div_const 2)
    · exact (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd).contDiffOn.mul
        (contDiff_fst.contDiffOn.rpow_const_of_ne hne)
  obtain ⟨cmax, hcmax⟩ : ∃ cmax : ℝ, cmax = Real.sqrt (2 * max X1 0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hKc : IsCompact (({(1:ℝ)} : Set ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) cmax ×ˢ Set.Icc (-1:ℝ) 1)) :=
    isCompact_singleton.prod (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)
  have hKO : ({(1:ℝ)} : Set ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) cmax ×ˢ Set.Icc (-1:ℝ) 1) ⊆
      Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := by
    intro w hw
    have h1 : w.1 = 1 := hw.1
    exact ⟨show (0:ℝ) < w.1 by rw [h1]; exact one_pos, Set.mem_univ _⟩
  have hBd : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ Bj : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ ({(1:ℝ)} : Set ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) cmax ×ˢ Set.Icc (-1:ℝ) 1),
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j H0 (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (ℝ × ℝ))) w‖ ≤ Bj := by
    intro j
    exact hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      ((hH0.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hOo.uniqueDiffOn).mono hKO)
  choose Bf hBf using hBd
  obtain ⟨CH, hCH⟩ : ∃ CH : ℝ, CH = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Bf j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨A1, hA1⟩ : ∃ A1 : ℝ, A1 = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cs i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Dg, hDg⟩ : ∃ Dg : ℝ, Dg = max A1 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℝ, E = (k.factorial : ℝ) * max 1 CH := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hkf1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ k.factorial := Nat.one_le_cast.mpr (Nat.factorial_pos k)
  have hE1 : 1 ≤ E := by
    rw [hE]
    nlinarith [le_max_left (1:ℝ) CH]
  have hDg1 : 1 ≤ Dg := by rw [hDg]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hCH0 : 0 ≤ CH := by rw [hCH]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
  refine ⟨(k.factorial : ℝ) * (E * Dg) ^ k, ?_⟩
  intro ξ0 hξ0 hX M hM
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ0 := hpos ξ0 hξ0
  have hτ0 : 0 < 1 - ξ0.2.2.1 := by linarith [hξ0.2.1]
  have hq1 : simScale B.h ξ0.2.1 (1 - ξ0.2.2.1) ≤ 1 := le_trans hξ0.2.2.le hqs1
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl, L = Lnorm B.h ξ0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hL1 : ∀ u : Cyl, (ξ0 + L u).1 = ξ0.1 + Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ0) * u.1 := by
    intro u; rw [hL]; rfl
  have hL2 : ∀ u : Cyl, (ξ0 + L u).2.1 = ξ0.2.1 + qC B.h ξ0 ^ (1/2 - B.h) * u.2.1 := by
    intro u; rw [hL]; rfl
  have hL3 : ∀ u : Cyl, (ξ0 + L u).2.2.1 = ξ0.2.2.1 + qC B.h ξ0 * u.2.2.1 := by
    intro u; rw [hL]; rfl
  obtain ⟨Dn, hDn⟩ : ∃ Dn : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
      Dn = (simScale B.h ξ0.2.1 (1 - ξ0.2.2.1) ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
        (simScale B.h ξ0.2.1 (1 - ξ0.2.2.1) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨P2, hP2⟩ : ∃ P2 : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
      P2 = ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))).prod
        (-((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hP2app : ∀ u : Cyl, P2 u = (u.2.1, -u.2.2.1) := by intro u; rw [hP2]; rfl
  have hP2n : ‖P2‖ ≤ 1 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound P2 zero_le_one (fun u => ?_)
    rw [hP2app, one_mul, Prod.norm_def]
    show max ‖u.2.1‖ ‖-u.2.2.1‖ ≤ ‖u‖
    rw [norm_neg]
    exact max_le ((norm_fst_le u.2).trans (norm_snd_le u))
      (((norm_fst_le u.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le u.2)).trans (norm_snd_le u))
  have hqL : ∀ u : Cyl, qC B.h (ξ0 + L u) =
      simScale B.h (((ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) + (Dn.comp P2) u).1
        (((ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) + (Dn.comp P2) u).2 := by
    intro u
    have e : (Dn.comp P2) u = (qC B.h ξ0 ^ (1/2 - B.h) * u.2.1, qC B.h ξ0 * (-u.2.2.1)) := by
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hP2app, hDn]; rfl
    rw [e]
    show simScale B.h (ξ0 + L u).2.1 (1 - (ξ0 + L u).2.2.1) =
      simScale B.h (ξ0.2.1 + qC B.h ξ0 ^ (1/2 - B.h) * u.2.1) (1 - ξ0.2.2.1 + qC B.h ξ0 * (-u.2.2.1))
    rw [hL2, hL3]
    congr 1
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨U, hUdef⟩ : ∃ U : Set Cyl, U = (fun u => ξ0 + L u) ⁻¹' DomC B.h qs := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hUo : IsOpen U := by rw [hUdef]; exact hO.preimage (continuous_const.add L.continuous)
  have h0U : (0:Cyl) ∈ U := by
    rw [hUdef]; show ξ0 + L 0 ∈ DomC B.h qs; rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact hξ0
  have huU : ∀ u ∈ U, ξ0 + L u ∈ DomC B.h qs := by intro u hu; rw [hUdef] at hu; exact hu
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ : ∃ ρ : Cyl → ℝ, ρ = fun u => (qC B.h ξ0)⁻¹ * qC B.h (ξ0 + L u) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hρU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ρ U := by
    rw [hρ]
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (hqC.comp (contDiff_const.add L.contDiff).contDiffOn
      (fun u hu => huU u hu))
  have hρpos : ∀ u ∈ U, 0 < ρ u := by
    intro u hu; rw [hρ]; exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hq0) (hpos _ (huU u hu))
  have hρ0 : ρ 0 = 1 := by
    rw [hρ]; show (qC B.h ξ0)⁻¹ * qC B.h (ξ0 + L 0) = 1
    rw [map_zero, add_zero, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0.ne']
  have hρeq : ρ = (qC B.h ξ0)⁻¹ • (fun z : Cyl =>
      simScale B.h (((ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) + (Dn.comp P2) z).1
        (((ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) + (Dn.comp P2) z).2) := by
    funext u
    rw [hρ]
    show (qC B.h ξ0)⁻¹ * qC B.h (ξ0 + L u) = (qC B.h ξ0)⁻¹ * _
    rw [hqL u]
  have hSfo : IsOpen ((Set.univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
  have hw0m : ((ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) + (Dn.comp P2) 0 ∈
      (Set.univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) := by
    rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, hτ0⟩
  have hGat : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : Cyl =>
      simScale B.h (((ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) + (Dn.comp P2) z).1
        (((ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) + (Dn.comp P2) z).2) 0 := by
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2)
        (((ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) + (Dn.comp P2) 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt (hSfo.mem_nhds hw0m)
    have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : Cyl => ((ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) + (Dn.comp P2) z) 0 :=
      (contDiff_const.add (Dn.comp P2).contDiff).contDiffAt
    exact ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2)
      (f := fun z : Cyl => ((ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) + (Dn.comp P2) z) (0:Cyl) h1 h2
  
  have hρjet : ∀ i : ℕ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i ρ 0‖ ≤ |Cs i| := by
    intro i
    have hk1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z : Cyl =>
        simScale B.h (((ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) + (Dn.comp P2) z).1
          (((ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) + (Dn.comp P2) z).2) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2)
          (ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Dn.comp P2) := by
      have := key (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Dn.comp P2)
        ((ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) _ i hSfo hS.2.2.2.1 hw0m
      rw [map_zero, add_zero] at this
      exact this
    have hfac : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2)
          (ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Dn.comp P2) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2)
          (ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Dn)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => P2) := by
      ext m
      simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
      rfl
    have hnorm : ∀ N : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin i => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ,
        ‖N.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => P2)‖ ≤ ‖N‖ := by
      intro N
      calc ‖N.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => P2)‖ ≤ ‖N‖ * ∏ _j : Fin i, ‖P2‖ :=
            ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _
        _ = ‖N‖ * ‖P2‖ ^ i := by rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
        _ ≤ ‖N‖ * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hP2n) (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = ‖N‖ := mul_one _
    have hb := hCs i ξ0.2.1 (1 - ξ0.2.2.1) hτ0 hq1
    rw [← hDn] at hb
    have hqs' : simScale B.h ξ0.2.1 (1 - ξ0.2.2.1) = qC B.h ξ0 := rfl
    rw [hqs'] at hb
    rw [hρeq, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply (hGat.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)), hk1,
      norm_smul, hfac, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hq0)]
    refine le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((hnorm _).trans hb) (inv_pos.mpr hq0).le) ?_
    rw [show (qC B.h ξ0)⁻¹ * (Cs i * qC B.h ξ0) = Cs i by field_simp]
    exact le_abs_self _
  
  obtain ⟨c, hcdef⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = Real.sqrt (2 * XC B.h ξ0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨e, hedef⟩ : ∃ e : ℝ, e = etaC B.h ξ0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨c0, hc0⟩ : ∃ c0 : ℝ, c0 = Real.log (qC B.h ξ0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hcK : c ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) cmax := by
    rw [hcdef, hcmax]
    exact ⟨Real.sqrt_nonneg _, Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith [le_max_left X1 0])⟩
  have heK : e ∈ Set.Icc (-1:ℝ) 1 := by
    rw [hedef]
    have := (hmap ξ0 hξ0).2.2
    exact ⟨this.1.le, this.2.le⟩
  
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : Cyl → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, g = fun u => (ρ u, (u.1, u.2.1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u : Cyl => (u.1, u.2.1)) :=
    contDiff_fst.prodMk (contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_snd)
  have hgU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U := by rw [hg]; exact hρU.prodMk hPc.contDiffOn
  obtain ⟨O1, hO1⟩ : ∃ O1 : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ),
      O1 = (fun w => ((0:ℝ), c, e) + w) ⁻¹' (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (ℝ × ℝ))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hO1o : IsOpen O1 := by rw [hO1]; exact hOo.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
  have hgmap : Set.MapsTo g U O1 := by
    intro u hu
    rw [hO1, hg]
    show ((0:ℝ), c, e) + (ρ u, (u.1, u.2.1)) ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    exact ⟨show (0:ℝ) < 0 + ρ u by rw [zero_add]; exact hρpos u hu, Set.mem_univ _⟩
  have hH1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => H0 (((0:ℝ), c, e) + w)) O1 := by
    rw [hO1]; exact hH0.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn (fun w hw => hw)
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : Cyl → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, J = fun u => H0 (((0:ℝ), c, e) + g u) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hJc : ((fun w => H0 (((0:ℝ), c, e) + w)) ∘ g) = J := by rw [hJ]; rfl
  
  have hform : ∀ u ∈ U, pbdPsi B.h (ξ0 + L u) = ((c0, (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) + J u := by
    intro u hu
    have hq' : 0 < qC B.h (ξ0 + L u) := hpos _ (huU u hu)
    rw [hJ, hH0def, hg, hρ]
    refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_)
    · show Real.log (qC B.h (ξ0 + L u)) =
        c0 + Real.log (0 + (qC B.h ξ0)⁻¹ * qC B.h (ξ0 + L u))
      rw [zero_add, Real.log_mul (inv_ne_zero hq0.ne') hq'.ne', Real.log_inv, hc0]
      ring
    · show (ξ0 + L u).1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h (ξ0 + L u)) =
        0 + (c + u.1) ^ 2 * ((0 + (qC B.h ξ0)⁻¹ * qC B.h (ξ0 + L u))⁻¹ / 2)
      have hc : Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ0) * c = ξ0.1 := by
        rw [hcdef, ← Real.sqrt_mul hq0.le]
        have : qC B.h ξ0 * (2 * XC B.h ξ0) = ξ0.1 ^ 2 := by
          unfold XC; field_simp
        rw [this, Real.sqrt_sq hξ0.1.le]
      have hs2 : Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ0) ^ 2 = qC B.h ξ0 := Real.sq_sqrt hq0.le
      rw [hL1, zero_add, zero_add, ← hc]
      have hsq : (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ0) * c + Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ0) * u.1) ^ 2 =
          qC B.h ξ0 * (c + u.1) ^ 2 := by linear_combination (c + u.1) ^ 2 * hs2
      rw [hsq]
      field_simp
    · show (ξ0 + L u).2.1 * qC B.h (ξ0 + L u) ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) =
        0 + (e + u.2.1) * (0 + (qC B.h ξ0)⁻¹ * qC B.h (ξ0 + L u)) ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))
      have ht : 0 < qC B.h ξ0 ^ (1/2 - B.h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _
      rw [hL2, zero_add, zero_add, hedef, Real.mul_rpow (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le) hq'.le,
        Real.inv_rpow hq0.le]
      unfold etaC
      rw [Real.rpow_neg hq0.le, inv_inv]
      field_simp
  
  obtain ⟨P, hPdef⟩ : ∃ P : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
      P = (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).prod
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPeq : (fun u : Cyl => (u.1, u.2.1)) = ⇑P := by funext u; rw [hPdef]; rfl
  have hPn : ‖P‖ ≤ 1 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound P zero_le_one (fun u => ?_)
    have : P u = (u.1, u.2.1) := by rw [hPdef]; rfl
    rw [this, one_mul, Prod.norm_def]
    exact max_le (norm_fst_le u) ((norm_fst_le u.2).trans (norm_snd_le u))
  have hPjet : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun u : Cyl => (u.1, u.2.1)) 0‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, i = m + 1 := ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [hPeq, ← norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ ⇑P = fun _ => P := by funext x; exact P.fderiv
    rw [hfd]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm | hm
    · subst hm; rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]; exact hPn
    · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (by omega)]; simp
  have hgjet : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g 0‖ ≤ Dg := by
    intro i hi1 hik
    have hρat : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ ρ 0 := hρU.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds h0U)
    rw [hg, iteratedFDeriv_prodMk hρat hPc.contDiffAt (by exact_mod_cast le_top),
      ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_prod]
    refine max_le ((hρjet i).trans ?_) ((hPjet i hi1).trans ?_)
    · rw [hDg, hA1]
      exact (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cs j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg (Cs j))
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hik))).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · rw [hDg]; exact le_max_right _ _
  
  have hJjet : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i J 0‖ ≤ (E * Dg) ^ i := by
    intro i hi1 hik
    have hmemK : ((0:ℝ), c, e) + g 0 ∈
        ({(1:ℝ)} : Set ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) cmax ×ˢ Set.Icc (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
      rw [hg]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show (0:ℝ) + ρ 0 = 1
        rw [zero_add, hρ0]
      · show c + (0:Cyl).1 ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) cmax
        rw [Prod.fst_zero, add_zero]; exact hcK
      · show e + (0:Cyl).2.1 ∈ Set.Icc (-1:ℝ) 1
        rw [Prod.snd_zero, Prod.fst_zero, add_zero]; exact heK
    have hC1 : ∀ j ≤ i, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j (fun w => H0 (((0:ℝ), c, e) + w)) O1 (g 0)‖ ≤ CH := by
      intro j hj
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun w => H0 (((0:ℝ), c, e) + w)) j hO1o (hgmap h0U),
        iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left,
        ← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := H0) j hOo (hKO hmemK)]
      refine (hBf j _ hmemK).trans ?_
      rw [hCH]
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Bf j|)
        (fun j _ => abs_nonneg (Bf j)) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)))
    have hD1 : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ i → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j g U 0‖ ≤ Dg ^ j := by
      intro j hj1 hji
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := g) j hUo h0U]
      exact (hgjet j hj1 (by omega)).trans (le_self_pow₀ hDg1 (by omega))
    have hF := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le (n := i) hH1 hgU (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      hO1o.uniqueDiffOn hUo.uniqueDiffOn hgmap h0U hC1 hD1
    rw [← hJc, ← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := (fun w => H0 (((0:ℝ), c, e) + w)) ∘ g) i hUo h0U]
    refine hF.trans ?_
    have hDgi : 0 ≤ Dg ^ i := pow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    have hfi : (i.factorial : ℝ) ≤ k.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le hik
    have h1 : (i.factorial : ℝ) * CH ≤ E := by
      rw [hE]; exact mul_le_mul hfi (le_max_right _ _) hCH0 (by linarith)
    calc (i.factorial : ℝ) * CH * Dg ^ i ≤ E * Dg ^ i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hDgi
      _ ≤ E ^ i * Dg ^ i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_self_pow₀ hE1 (by omega)) hDgi
      _ = (E * Dg) ^ i := (mul_pow E Dg i).symm
  
  obtain ⟨V1, hV1⟩ : ∃ V1 : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), V1 = (fun w => ((c0, (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) + w) ⁻¹'
      (Set.Iio (Real.log qs) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hV1o : IsOpen V1 := by rw [hV1]; exact hVo.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
  have hΦ1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => Φ (((c0, (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) + w)) V1 := by
    rw [hV1]; exact hΦ.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn (fun w hw => hw)
  have hJU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ J U := by rw [← hJc]; exact hH1.comp hgU hgmap
  have hJmap : Set.MapsTo J U V1 := by
    intro u hu
    rw [hV1]
    show ((c0, (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) + J u ∈ Set.Iio (Real.log qs) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)
    rw [← hform u hu]
    exact hmap _ (huU u hu)
  have hJ0 : ((c0, (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) + J 0 = pbdPsi B.h ξ0 := by
    rw [← hform 0 h0U, map_zero, add_zero]
  have hC2 : ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j (fun w => Φ (((c0, (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) + w))
      V1 (J 0)‖ ≤ M := by
    intro j hj
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun w => Φ (((c0, (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) + w)) j hV1o
      (hJmap h0U), iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left, hJ0]
    exact hM j hj
  have hD2 : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i J U 0‖ ≤ (E * Dg) ^ i := by
    intro i h1 h2
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := J) i hUo h0U]
    exact hJjet i h1 h2
  have hF2 := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le (n := k) hΦ1 hJU (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    hV1o.uniqueDiffOn hUo.uniqueDiffOn hJmap h0U hC2 hD2
  
  have hkey : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => Φ (pbdPsi B.h (ξ0 + L z))) 0 =
      (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun ξ => Φ (pbdPsi B.h ξ)) ξ0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
    have := key (fun ξ => Φ (pbdPsi B.h ξ)) L ξ0 (DomC B.h qs) k hO hsm
      (by rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact hξ0)
    rw [map_zero, add_zero] at this
    exact this
  have hev : (fun z => Φ (pbdPsi B.h (ξ0 + L z))) =ᶠ[nhds (0:Cyl)]
      ((fun w => Φ (((c0, (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) + w)) ∘ J) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds h0U) (fun u hu => by
      show Φ (pbdPsi B.h (ξ0 + L u)) = Φ (((c0, (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) + J u)
      rw [hform u hu])
  unfold NB
  rw [← hL, ← hkey, (hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds,
    ← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen
      (f := (fun w => Φ (((c0, (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) + w)) ∘ J) k hUo h0U]
  exact hF2.trans (le_of_eq (by ring))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h c s1 Xa Xb aa ab β : ℝ) (G : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xa → Xa < Xb → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)) → (∀ w ∈ Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1), (w.2.1 ≤ Xa ∨ Xb ≤ w.2.1) → G w = 0) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1), Xa < w.2.1 → w.2.1 < Xb → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m G w‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (β * w.1) * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab w.2.1 * edgeDist Xa Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pbdProf h c G) (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ (∀ w ∈ Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1), (w.2.1 ≤ Xa ∨ Xb ≤ w.2.1) → pbdProf h c G w = 0) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1), Xa < w.2.1 → w.2.1 < Xb → ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (pbdProf h c G) w‖ ≤ C * Real.exp ((β + h) * w.1) * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab w.2.1 * edgeDist Xa Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N)

signature.name: pbd_profile
signature.statement: ∀ (h c s1 Xa Xb aa ab β : ℝ) (G : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), 0 < Xa → Xa < Xb → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)) → (∀ w ∈ Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1), (w.2.1 ≤ Xa ∨ Xb ≤ w.2.1) → G w = 0) → (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1), Xa < w.2.1 → w.2.1 < Xb → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m G w‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (β * w.1) * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab w.2.1 * edgeDist Xa Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pbdProf h c G) (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ (∀ w ∈ Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1), (w.2.1 ≤ Xa ∨ Xb ≤ w.2.1) → pbdProf h c G w = 0) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1), Xa < w.2.1 → w.2.1 < Xb → ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (pbdProf h c G) w‖ ≤ C * Real.exp ((β + h) * w.1) * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab w.2.1 * edgeDist Xa Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h c s1 Xa Xb aa ab β G hXa hXab hG hGv hGb
  set V : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1) with hVdef
  have hVo : IsOpen V := isOpen_Iio.prod (isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo)
  have hle : ∀ i : ℕ, ((i : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := fun i => by exact_mod_cast le_top
  
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, E = fun y => Real.exp (h * y.1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨φ1, hφ1⟩ : ∃ φ1 : ℝ → ℝ, φ1 = fun x => Real.sqrt (2 * x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨φ2, hφ2⟩ : ∃ φ2 : ℝ → ℝ, φ2 = fun x => c * Real.sqrt (2 * x) / x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨G', hG'⟩ : ∃ G' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, G' = fun y => fderiv ℝ G y ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPeq : pbdProf h c G = fun y => E y * (φ1 y.2.1 * G' y + φ2 y.2.1 * G y) := by
    funext y
    rw [hE, hφ1, hφ2, hG']
    simp only [pbdProf]
    ring
  
  have hEs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ E := by rw [hE]; exact (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_fst).exp
  have hsq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * x)) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    (contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_id).sqrt
      (fun x hx => (mul_pos two_pos (show (0:ℝ) < x from hx)).ne')
  have hφ1s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ1 (Set.Ioi 0) := by rw [hφ1]; exact hsq
  have hφ2s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ2 (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    rw [hφ2]
    exact (contDiffOn_const.mul hsq).div contDiffOn_id (fun x hx => (show (0:ℝ) < x from hx).ne')
  have hπs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => y.2.1) V := (contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_snd).contDiffOn
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun y : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => y.2.1) V (Set.Ioi 0) := fun w hw => hw.2.1
  have hSs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => φ1 y.2.1) V := hφ1s.comp hπs hmaps
  have hRs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => φ2 y.2.1) V := hφ2s.comp hπs hmaps
  have hfdG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ G) V := hG.fderiv_of_isOpen hVo (by simp)
  have hG's : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G' V := by rw [hG']; exact hfdG.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hQs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => φ1 y.2.1 * G' y + φ2 y.2.1 * G y) V :=
    (hSs.mul hG's).add (hRs.mul hG)
  have hPs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pbdProf h c G) V := by
    rw [hPeq]; exact hEs.contDiffOn.mul hQs
  
  have hvan : ∀ w ∈ V, (w.2.1 ≤ Xa ∨ Xb ≤ w.2.1) → pbdProf h c G w = 0 := by
    intro w hw hX
    have hGw : G w = 0 := hGv w hw hX
    obtain ⟨s, X, η⟩ := w
    have hs : s < s1 := hw.1
    have hX0 : 0 < X := hw.2.1
    have hη : η ∈ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := hw.2.2
    have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => ((s, Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) X :=
      (hasDerivAt_const X s).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_id X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X η))
    have hGd : DifferentiableAt ℝ G (s, X, η) :=
      (hG.contDiffAt (hVo.mem_nhds hw)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have hd1 : HasDerivAt (G ∘ fun Y : ℝ => ((s, Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))
        (fderiv ℝ G (s, X, η) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) X :=
      hGd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt X hγ
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ G (s, X, η) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) = 0 := by
      rcases hX with hX | hX
      · have hev : (G ∘ fun Y : ℝ => ((s, Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin X (Set.Iic X)]
            fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
          filter_upwards [Ioc_mem_nhdsLE hX0] with Y hY
          show G (s, Y, η) = 0
          exact hGv (s, Y, η) ⟨hs, hY.1, hη⟩ (Or.inl (le_trans hY.2 hX))
        have h2 : HasDerivWithinAt (G ∘ fun Y : ℝ => ((s, Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) 0 (Set.Iic X) X :=
          (hasDerivWithinAt_const X (Set.Iic X) (0:ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
            (by show G (s, X, η) = 0; exact hGw)
        exact (uniqueDiffWithinAt_Iic X).eq_deriv _ hd1.hasDerivWithinAt h2
      · have hev : (G ∘ fun Y : ℝ => ((s, Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin X (Set.Ici X)]
            fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
          filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with Y hY
          show G (s, Y, η) = 0
          have hY' : X ≤ Y := hY
          exact hGv (s, Y, η) ⟨hs, show (0:ℝ) < Y from lt_of_lt_of_le hX0 hY', hη⟩
            (Or.inr (le_trans hX hY'))
        have h2 : HasDerivWithinAt (G ∘ fun Y : ℝ => ((s, Y, η) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) 0 (Set.Ici X) X :=
          (hasDerivWithinAt_const X (Set.Ici X) (0:ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
            (by show G (s, X, η) = 0; exact hGw)
        exact (uniqueDiffWithinAt_Ici X).eq_deriv _ hd1.hasDerivWithinAt h2
    simp only [pbdProf]
    rw [hfd, hGw]
    simp
  
  have hEb : ∀ (i : ℕ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i E w‖ ≤ |h| ^ i * Real.exp (h * w.1) := by
    intro i w
    have he : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (h * t)) := (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id).exp
    let π1 := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)
    have e : E = (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (h * t)) ∘ π1 := by rw [hE]; rfl
    rw [e, ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right π1 he w (hle i)]
    refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
    have hp : ∏ _i : Fin i, ‖π1‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_fst_le ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))
    have hn : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (h * t)) (π1 w)‖ =
        |h| ^ i * Real.exp (h * w.1) := by
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
      simp only [iteratedDeriv_exp_const_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_pow, Real.abs_exp]
      rfl
    rw [hn]
    calc |h| ^ i * Real.exp (h * w.1) * ∏ _i : Fin i, ‖π1‖ ≤ |h| ^ i * Real.exp (h * w.1) * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (by positivity)
      _ = _ := mul_one _
  
  have hxf : ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ (Set.Ioi 0) → ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ σ : ℝ,
      ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, Xa ≤ w.2.1 → w.2.1 ≤ Xb →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => φ y.2.1) w‖ ≤ σ := by
    intro φ hφ i
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i φ) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      (hφ.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (hle i) isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn).congr
        (fun x hx => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i isOpen_Ioi hx).symm)
    have hsub : Set.Icc Xa Xb ⊆ Set.Ioi 0 := fun x hx => lt_of_lt_of_le hXa hx.1
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hcont.mono hsub)
    refine ⟨σ, fun w h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    let π2 : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))
    have hU : IsOpen (π2 ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0) := isOpen_Ioi.preimage π2.continuous
    have hwU : w ∈ π2 ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0 := show (0:ℝ) < w.2.1 from lt_of_lt_of_le hXa h1
    have h1' := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right π2 hφ isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn
      hU.uniqueDiffOn hwU (i := i) (hle i)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hU hwU,
      iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i isOpen_Ioi (show π2 w ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) from hwU)] at h1'
    have e : (fun y : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => φ y.2.1) = φ ∘ π2 := rfl
    rw [e, h1']
    refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
    have hπn : ‖π2‖ ≤ 1 :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le _ _).trans
        (mul_le_one₀ (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_fst_le ℝ ℝ ℝ) (norm_nonneg _)
          (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_snd_le ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)))
    have hp : ∏ _i : Fin i, ‖π2‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hπn
    have hb : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i φ (π2 w)‖ ≤ σ := hσ _ ⟨h1, h2⟩
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i φ (π2 w)‖ * ∏ _i : Fin i, ‖π2‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i φ (π2 w)‖ * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ σ := by rw [mul_one]; exact hb
  
  have hdX : ∀ (i : ℕ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), w ∈ V →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G' w‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (i + 1) G w‖ := by
    intro i w hw
    have hb := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_clm_apply_const (hfdG w hw) hVo.uniqueDiffOn hw
      (c := ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) (n := i) (hle i)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hVo hw, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hVo hw] at hb
    have hv : ‖((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))‖ = 1 := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
    rw [hv, one_mul, norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv] at hb
    rw [hG']
    exact hb
  
  have hleib : ∀ (f g : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℕ) (a b : ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g V → w ∈ V →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f w‖ ≤ a) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g w‖ ≤ b) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f y * g y) w‖ ≤ 2 ^ n * a * b := by
    intro f g w n a b hf hg hw ha hb
    have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := (norm_nonneg _).trans (ha 0 (Nat.zero_le _))
    have hL := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hf hg hVo.uniqueDiffOn hw (n := n) (hle n)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hVo hw] at hL
    refine hL.trans ?_
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i f V w‖ *
          ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ (n - i) g V w‖
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * a * b := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          have hin : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hVo hw, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (n - i) hVo hw]
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ha i hin) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
            (hb (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i)) (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) ha0)
      _ = 2 ^ n * a * b := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul,
            show (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ)) = 2 ^ n by
              exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose n]
  
  have hedf : ∀ X, Xa < X → X < Xb → 0 < edgeDist Xa Xb X ∧ edgeDist Xa Xb X ≤ 1 := by
    intro X h1 h2
    have hX0 : 0 < X := lt_trans hXa h1
    unfold edgeDist
    exact ⟨lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr h1))
      (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr h2))), min_le_left _ _⟩
  have hew : ∀ X, 0 ≤ edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X := by
    intro X
    unfold edgeWeight
    split_ifs
    · positivity
    · exact le_rfl
  
  refine ⟨hPs, hvan, fun k => ?_⟩
  choose Cf Nf hCN using hGb
  choose σ1 hσ1 using hxf φ1 hφ1s
  choose σ2 hσ2 using hxf φ2 hφ2s
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (|σ1 l| + |σ2 l|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ : ∃ H : ℝ, H = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |h| ^ i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Cs, hCs⟩ : ∃ Cs : ℝ, Cs = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), |Cf m| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : ℝ, N = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), |Nf m| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by rw [hA]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)
  have hH0 : 0 ≤ H := by rw [hH]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)
  have hCs0 : 0 ≤ Cs := by rw [hCs]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)
  refine ⟨2 ^ k * H * (2 ^ k * A * Cs + 2 ^ k * A * Cs), N, fun w hw h1 h2 j hj => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hd0, hd1⟩ := hedf w.2.1 h1 h2
  have hE0 := hew w.2.1
  have heb : 0 < Real.exp (β * w.1) := Real.exp_pos _
  have heh : 0 < Real.exp (h * w.1) := Real.exp_pos _
  obtain ⟨W0, hW0⟩ : ∃ W0 : ℝ, W0 = Real.exp (β * w.1) * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab w.2.1 *
      edgeDist Xa Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hW00 : 0 ≤ W0 := by
    rw [hW0]; exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg heb.le hE0) (Real.rpow_nonneg hd0.le _)
  have hnw : 0 < w.2.1 := hw.2.1
  have hGm : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ k + 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m G w‖ ≤ Cs * W0 := by
    intro m hm
    have hmr : m ∈ Finset.range (k + 2) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
    have hC1 : Cf m ≤ Cs := (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hCs]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun m => |Cf m|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) hmr)
    have hN1 : Nf m ≤ N := (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hN]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun m => |Nf m|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) hmr)
    have hdN : edgeDist Xa Xb w.2.1 ^ (-Nf m) ≤ edgeDist Xa Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hd0 hd1 (neg_le_neg hN1)
    refine (hCN m w hw h1 h2).trans ?_
    calc Cf m * Real.exp (β * w.1) * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab w.2.1 * edgeDist Xa Xb w.2.1 ^ (-Nf m)
        ≤ Cs * Real.exp (β * w.1) * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab w.2.1 * edgeDist Xa Xb w.2.1 ^ (-Nf m) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC1 heb.le) hE0) (Real.rpow_nonneg hd0.le _)
      _ ≤ Cs * Real.exp (β * w.1) * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab w.2.1 * edgeDist Xa Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdN (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCs0 heb.le) hE0)
      _ = Cs * W0 := by rw [hW0]; ring
  have hG'b : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G' w‖ ≤ Cs * W0 :=
    fun i hi => (hdX i w hw).trans (hGm (i + 1) (by omega))
  have hSb : ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => φ1 y.2.1) w‖ ≤ A := by
    intro l hl
    have hlr : l ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
    refine (hσ1 l w h1.le h2.le).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans ?_)
    rw [hA]
    exact (le_add_of_nonneg_right (abs_nonneg _)).trans
      (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun l => |σ1 l| + |σ2 l|) (fun i _ => by positivity) hlr)
  have hRb : ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => φ2 y.2.1) w‖ ≤ A := by
    intro l hl
    have hlr : l ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
    refine (hσ2 l w h1.le h2.le).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans ?_)
    rw [hA]
    exact (le_add_of_nonneg_left (abs_nonneg _)).trans
      (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun l => |σ1 l| + |σ2 l|) (fun i _ => by positivity) hlr)
  have hCW0 : 0 ≤ Cs * W0 := mul_nonneg hCs0 hW00
  have hpw : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → (2:ℝ) ^ i ≤ 2 ^ k := fun i hi => pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hi
  have hQb : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y => φ1 y.2.1 * G' y + φ2 y.2.1 * G y) w‖ ≤
      2 ^ k * A * Cs * W0 + 2 ^ k * A * Cs * W0 := by
    intro i hi
    have hn := hVo.mem_nhds hw
    have e : (fun y => φ1 y.2.1 * G' y + φ2 y.2.1 * G y) =
        (fun y => φ1 y.2.1 * G' y) + (fun y => φ2 y.2.1 * G y) := rfl
    rw [e, iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (((hSs.mul hG's).contDiffAt hn).of_le (hle i))
      (((hRs.mul hG).contDiffAt hn).of_le (hle i))]
    have b1 := hleib _ _ w i A (Cs * W0) hSs hG's hw (fun l hl => hSb l (by omega))
      (fun l hl => hG'b l (by omega))
    have b2 := hleib _ _ w i A (Cs * W0) hRs hG hw (fun l hl => hRb l (by omega))
      (fun l hl => hGm l (by omega))
    have b3 : (2:ℝ) ^ i * A * (Cs * W0) ≤ 2 ^ k * A * Cs * W0 := by
      rw [show (2:ℝ) ^ k * A * Cs * W0 = 2 ^ k * A * (Cs * W0) by ring]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hpw i hi) hA0) hCW0
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (b1.trans b3) (b2.trans b3))
  have hEb' : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i E w‖ ≤ H * Real.exp (h * w.1) := by
    intro i hi
    have hir : i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
    refine (hEb i w).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ heh.le)
    rw [hH]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |h| ^ i) (fun i _ => by positivity) hir
  rw [hPeq]
  have hfin := hleib E _ w j (H * Real.exp (h * w.1)) (2 ^ k * A * Cs * W0 + 2 ^ k * A * Cs * W0)
    hEs.contDiffOn hQs hw (fun i hi => hEb' i (by omega)) (fun i hi => hQb i (by omega))
  refine hfin.trans ?_
  have hQ0 : 0 ≤ 2 ^ k * A * Cs * W0 + 2 ^ k * A * Cs * W0 := by positivity
  calc (2:ℝ) ^ j * (H * Real.exp (h * w.1)) * (2 ^ k * A * Cs * W0 + 2 ^ k * A * Cs * W0)
      ≤ 2 ^ k * (H * Real.exp (h * w.1)) * (2 ^ k * A * Cs * W0 + 2 ^ k * A * Cs * W0) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hpw j hj)
          (mul_nonneg hH0 heh.le)) hQ0
    _ = 2 ^ k * H * (2 ^ k * A * Cs + 2 ^ k * A * Cs) * Real.exp ((β + h) * w.1) *
          edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab w.2.1 * edgeDist Xa Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N) := by
        rw [hW0, show (β + h) * w.1 = β * w.1 + h * w.1 by ring, Real.exp_add]
        ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (s1 : ℝ), B.ok → s1 ≤ Real.log B.qB → s1 ≤ 0 → (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => B.T0th w.2.1 w.2.2) (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => B.T0z w.2.1 w.2.2) (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift B.Tth) (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift B.Tz) (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift B.Tth w - B.T0th w.2.1 w.2.2) (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift B.Tz w - B.T0z w.2.1 w.2.2) (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1))) ∧ (∀ w ∈ Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1), (w.2.1 ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ w.2.1) → B.T0th w.2.1 w.2.2 = 0 ∧ B.T0z w.2.1 w.2.2 = 0 ∧ logLift B.Tth w = 0 ∧ logLift B.Tz w = 0) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1), B.Xa < w.2.1 → w.2.1 < B.Xb → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift B.Tth w - B.T0th w.2.1 w.2.2) w‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (B.h * w.1) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift B.Tz w - B.T0z w.2.1 w.2.2) w‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (B.h * w.1) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N)) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1), B.Xa < w.2.1 → w.2.1 < B.Xb → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift B.Tth) w‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (0 * w.1) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift B.Tz) w‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (0 * w.1) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N))
