signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (s1 : ℝ), B.ok → s1 ≤ Real.log B.qB → s1 ≤ 0 → (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => B.T0th w.2.1 w.2.2) (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => B.T0z w.2.1 w.2.2) (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift B.Tth) (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift B.Tz) (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift B.Tth w - B.T0th w.2.1 w.2.2) (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift B.Tz w - B.T0z w.2.1 w.2.2) (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1))) ∧ (∀ w ∈ Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1), (w.2.1 ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ w.2.1) → B.T0th w.2.1 w.2.2 = 0 ∧ B.T0z w.2.1 w.2.2 = 0 ∧ logLift B.Tth w = 0 ∧ logLift B.Tz w = 0) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1), B.Xa < w.2.1 → w.2.1 < B.Xb → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift B.Tth w - B.T0th w.2.1 w.2.2) w‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (B.h * w.1) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift B.Tz w - B.T0z w.2.1 w.2.2) w‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (B.h * w.1) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N)) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1) 1), B.Xa < w.2.1 → w.2.1 < B.Xb → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift B.Tth) w‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (0 * w.1) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift B.Tz) w‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (0 * w.1) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B s1 hok hs1 hs10
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, -, hXa, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩, -, ⟨hT0s, hT0zs, hT0v, -, hT0b, -, -⟩, -, -, -, -, -,
    ⟨hTs, hTzs, hTv, hTb⟩, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2
  have hV0o : IsOpen (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hVo : IsOpen (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) := isOpen_Iio.prod hV0o
  have hVsub : Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) ⊆
      Set.Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
    Set.prod_mono (Set.Iio_subset_Iio hs1) subset_rfl
  have hsnd : Set.MapsTo (Prod.snd : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ) (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1))
      (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := fun w hw => hw.2
  
  have hP0 : ∀ T0 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿T0) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => T0 w.2.1 w.2.2) (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) :=
    fun T0 hT0 => hT0.comp contDiff_snd.contDiffOn hsnd
  have hP0th := hP0 B.T0th hT0s
  have hP0z := hP0 B.T0z hT0zs
  
  have hproj : ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) → ∀ (m : ℕ)
      (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), w.2 ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => f w.2) w‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f w.2‖ := by
    intro f hf m w hw
    let π := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)
    have hU : IsOpen (π ⁻¹' (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) := hV0o.preimage π.continuous
    have hwU : w ∈ π ⁻¹' (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := hw
    have h1 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right π hf hV0o.uniqueDiffOn
      hU.uniqueDiffOn hwU (n := ∞) (i := m) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hU hwU,
      iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hV0o (show π w ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 from hw)] at h1
    have e : (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => f w.2) = f ∘ π := rfl
    rw [e, h1]
    refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
    have hp : ∏ _i : Fin m, ‖π‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_snd_le ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (π w)‖ * ∏ _i : Fin m, ‖π‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (π w)‖ * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f w.2‖ := mul_one _
  
  have hvan : ∀ w ∈ Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1), (w.2.1 ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ w.2.1) →
      B.T0th w.2.1 w.2.2 = 0 ∧ B.T0z w.2.1 w.2.2 = 0 ∧ logLift B.Tth w = 0 ∧ logLift B.Tz w = 0 := by
    intro w hw hX
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := hT0v w.2.1 w.2.2 hw.2.1 hX
    obtain ⟨c, d⟩ := hTv (Real.exp w.1) w.2.1 w.2.2 hX
    exact ⟨a, b, c, d⟩
  
  have hGb : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1),
      B.Xa < w.2.1 → w.2.1 < B.Xb →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift B.Tth w - B.T0th w.2.1 w.2.2) w‖ ≤
        C * Real.exp (B.h * w.1) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift B.Tz w - B.T0z w.2.1 w.2.2) w‖ ≤
        C * Real.exp (B.h * w.1) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N) := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨C, N, hC⟩ := hTb m
    refine ⟨C, N, fun w hw hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
    have hw1 : w.1 < s1 := hw.1
    have hq : Real.exp w.1 < B.qB := by
      have h1 : w.1 < Real.log B.qB := lt_of_lt_of_le hw1 hs1
      calc Real.exp w.1 < Real.exp (Real.log B.qB) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr h1
        _ = B.qB := Real.exp_log hqB0
    have key := hC (Real.exp w.1) w.2.1 w.2.2 (Real.exp_pos _) hq hX1 hX2 hw.2.2.1 hw.2.2.2
    have hp : ((Real.log (Real.exp w.1), w.2.1, w.2.2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) = w := by rw [Real.log_exp]
    have he : Real.exp w.1 ^ B.h = Real.exp (B.h * w.1) := by rw [← Real.exp_mul, mul_comm]
    rw [hp, he] at key
    exact key
  
  have hedf : ∀ X, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb → 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ∧ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ≤ 1 := by
    intro X h1 h2
    have hX0 : 0 < X := lt_trans hXa h1
    unfold edgeDist
    exact ⟨lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr h1))
      (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr h2))), min_le_left _ _⟩
  have hew : ∀ X, 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X := by
    intro X
    unfold edgeWeight
    split_ifs
    · positivity
    · exact le_rfl
  
  have hLb : ∀ (T : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (T0 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿T0) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift T) (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) →
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (C1 N1 C0 N0 : ℝ) (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), w ∈ Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) →
      B.Xa < w.2.1 → w.2.1 < B.Xb →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift T w - T0 w.2.1 w.2.2) w‖ ≤
        C1 * Real.exp (B.h * w.1) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N1) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿T0) (w.2.1, w.2.2)‖ ≤
        C0 * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N0) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift T) w‖ ≤ (|C1| + |C0|) * Real.exp (0 * w.1) *
        edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-(max N1 N0)) := by
    intro T T0 hT0 hL m C1 N1 C0 N0 w hw hX1 hX2 hG h0
    have hP := hP0 T0 hT0
    have hGs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift T w - T0 w.2.1 w.2.2)
        (Set.Iio s1 ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) := hL.sub hP
    have hnhds := hVo.mem_nhds hw
    have hpr : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => T0 w.2.1 w.2.2) w‖ ≤
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿T0) (w.2.1, w.2.2)‖ := hproj (↿T0) hT0 m w hw.2
    have e : logLift T = (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift T w - T0 w.2.1 w.2.2) +
        (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => T0 w.2.1 w.2.2) := by
      funext w
      simp
    rw [e, iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((hGs.contDiffAt hnhds).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      ((hP.contDiffAt hnhds).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)), zero_mul, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
    obtain ⟨hd0, hd1⟩ := hedf w.2.1 hX1 hX2
    have hE := hew w.2.1
    have hw1 : w.1 < s1 := hw.1
    have he0 : 0 < Real.exp (B.h * w.1) := Real.exp_pos _
    have he1 : Real.exp (B.h * w.1) ≤ 1 :=
      Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hh0.le (by linarith))
    have hdN1 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N1) ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-(max N1 N0)) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hd0 hd1 (neg_le_neg (le_max_left _ _))
    have hdN0 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N0) ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-(max N1 N0)) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hd0 hd1 (neg_le_neg (le_max_right _ _))
    have hd1' : 0 ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N1) := Real.rpow_nonneg hd0.le _
    have hd0' : 0 ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N0) := Real.rpow_nonneg hd0.le _
    have a1 : C1 * Real.exp (B.h * w.1) ≤ |C1| := by
      calc C1 * Real.exp (B.h * w.1) ≤ |C1| * Real.exp (B.h * w.1) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) he0.le
        _ ≤ |C1| * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he1 (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = |C1| := mul_one _
    have k1 : C1 * Real.exp (B.h * w.1) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 *
          edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N1) ≤
        |C1| * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-(max N1 N0)) := by
      calc C1 * Real.exp (B.h * w.1) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 *
            edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N1) ≤
          |C1| * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N1) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right a1 hE) hd1'
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdN1 (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hE)
    have k0 : C0 * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N0) ≤
        |C0| * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-(max N1 N0)) := by
      calc C0 * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N0) ≤
          |C0| * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N0) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hE) hd0'
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdN0 (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hE)
    calc _ ≤ _ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ C1 * Real.exp (B.h * w.1) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 *
            edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N1) +
          C0 * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-N0) :=
            add_le_add hG (hpr.trans h0)
      _ ≤ |C1| * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-(max N1 N0)) +
          |C0| * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab w.2.1 * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb w.2.1 ^ (-(max N1 N0)) :=
            add_le_add k1 k0
      _ = _ := by ring
  refine ⟨⟨hP0th, hP0z, hTs.mono hVsub, hTzs.mono hVsub, (hTs.mono hVsub).sub hP0th,
    (hTzs.mono hVsub).sub hP0z⟩, hvan, hGb, ?_⟩
  intro m
  obtain ⟨C1, N1, hC1⟩ := hGb m
  obtain ⟨C0, N0, hC0⟩ := hT0b m
  refine ⟨|C1| + |C0|, max N1 N0, fun w hw hX1 hX2 => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · exact hLb B.Tth B.T0th hT0s (hTs.mono hVsub) m C1 N1 C0 N0 w hw hX1 hX2 (hC1 w hw hX1 hX2).1
      (hC0 w.2.1 w.2.2 hX1 hX2 hw.2.2.1 hw.2.2.2).1
  · exact hLb B.Tz B.T0z hT0zs (hTzs.mono hVsub) m C1 N1 C0 N0 w hw hX1 hX2 (hC1 w hw hX1 hX2).2
      (hC0 w.2.1 w.2.2 hX1 hX2 hw.2.2.1 hw.2.2.2).2

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → qs ≤ B.qB → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun ξ => dR B.h (pmrTh B B.T0th) ξ + 2 * pmrTh B B.T0th ξ / ξ.1 + sBase B 1 ξ) ξ = -pbdProf B.h 1 (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift B.Tth w - B.T0th w.2.1 w.2.2) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) ∧ nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun ξ => dR B.h (pmrTh B B.T0z) ξ + pmrTh B B.T0z ξ / ξ.1 + sBase B 2 ξ) ξ = -pbdProf B.h (1/2) (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift B.Tz w - B.T0z w.2.1 w.2.2) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) ∧ nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (sBase B 1) ξ = -pbdProf B.h 1 (logLift B.Tth) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) ∧ nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (sBase B 2) ξ = -pbdProf B.h (1/2) (logLift B.Tz) (pbdPsi B.h ξ)

signature.name: pbd_identities
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → qs ≤ B.qB → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun ξ => dR B.h (pmrTh B B.T0th) ξ + 2 * pmrTh B B.T0th ξ / ξ.1 + sBase B 1 ξ) ξ = -pbdProf B.h 1 (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift B.Tth w - B.T0th w.2.1 w.2.2) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) ∧ nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun ξ => dR B.h (pmrTh B B.T0z) ξ + pmrTh B B.T0z ξ / ξ.1 + sBase B 2 ξ) ξ = -pbdProf B.h (1/2) (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift B.Tz w - B.T0z w.2.1 w.2.2) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) ∧ nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (sBase B 1) ξ = -pbdProf B.h 1 (logLift B.Tth) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) ∧ nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (sBase B 2) ξ = -pbdProf B.h (1/2) (logLift B.Tz) (pbdPsi B.h ξ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs hok hqsB ξ hξ
  have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qs := hξ
  obtain ⟨hr, ht, hqs⟩ := hξ'
  have hBP := hok.2
  unfold BackgroundProps at hBP
  obtain ⟨-, -, ⟨hT0th, hT0z, -⟩, -, -, -, -, -, ⟨hTth, hTz, -⟩, -⟩ := hBP
  
  have E1 : ∀ q hh : ℝ, 0 < q → q ^ (2 * (1/2 + hh) + 1/2) = q * (Real.sqrt q * (q ^ hh * q ^ hh)) := by
    intro q hh hq
    rw [show (2 * (1/2 + hh) + 1/2 : ℝ) = 1 + (1/2 + (hh + hh)) by ring, Real.rpow_add hq,
      Real.rpow_add hq, Real.rpow_add hq, Real.rpow_one, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  have E2 : ∀ q hh : ℝ, 0 < q → q ^ (-(1 + hh)) = (q * q ^ hh)⁻¹ := by
    intro q hh hq
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hq.le, Real.rpow_add hq, Real.rpow_one]
  have E3 : ∀ q hh : ℝ, 0 < q → q ^ (-(2 + hh)) = (q ^ 2 * q ^ hh)⁻¹ := by
    intro q hh hq
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hq.le, Real.rpow_add hq, Real.rpow_two]
  have E4 : ∀ q hh : ℝ, 0 < q → q ^ (-(3 / 2 + hh)) = (q * (Real.sqrt q * q ^ hh))⁻¹ := by
    intro q hh hq
    rw [show (3 / 2 + hh : ℝ) = 1 + (1/2 + hh) by ring, Real.rpow_neg hq.le, Real.rpow_add hq,
      Real.rpow_add hq, Real.rpow_one, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  have E5 : ∀ q hh : ℝ, 0 < q → Real.exp (hh * Real.log q) = q ^ hh := by
    intro q hh hq
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hq, mul_comm]
  have E6 : ∀ q r : ℝ, 0 < q → 0 < r → Real.sqrt (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q))) = r / Real.sqrt q := by
    intro q r hq hr
    rw [show 2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) = (r / Real.sqrt q) ^ 2 by
        rw [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hq.le, mul_div_assoc', mul_div_mul_left _ _ (two_ne_zero' ℝ)],
      Real.sqrt_sq (div_nonneg hr.le (Real.sqrt_nonneg q))]
  have alg1 : ∀ (q r hh P V P0 V0 : ℝ), 0 < q → 0 < r →
      q ^ (2 * (1/2 + hh) + 1/2) * (q ^ (-(1 + hh)) * (P0 * (2 * r / (2 * q))) +
        2 * (q ^ (-(1 + hh)) * V0) / r + -(q ^ (-(2 + hh)) * (P + V / (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)))) * r) =
      -(Real.exp (hh * Real.log q) * Real.sqrt (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q))) *
        (P - P0 + 1 * (V - V0) / (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)))) := by
    intro q r hh P V P0 V0 hq hr
    rw [E1 q hh hq, E2 q hh hq, E3 q hh hq, E5 q hh hq, E6 q r hq hr]
    have hs0 : 0 < Real.sqrt q := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq
    have hsq : Real.sqrt q ^ 2 = q := Real.sq_sqrt hq.le
    have hQ : 0 < q ^ hh := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq hh
    generalize Real.sqrt q = s at hs0 hsq ⊢
    generalize q ^ hh = Q at hQ ⊢
    subst hsq
    have hs1 : s ≠ 0 := hs0.ne'
    have hQ1 : Q ≠ 0 := hQ.ne'
    have hr1 : r ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
    field_simp
    ring
  have alg2 : ∀ (q r hh P V P0 V0 : ℝ), 0 < q → 0 < r →
      q ^ (2 * (1/2 + hh) + 1/2) * (q ^ (-(1 + hh)) * (P0 * (2 * r / (2 * q))) +
        q ^ (-(1 + hh)) * V0 / r + -(Real.sqrt (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q))) * q ^ (-(3 / 2 + hh)) *
          (P + V / (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)))))) =
      -(Real.exp (hh * Real.log q) * Real.sqrt (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q))) *
        (P - P0 + 1/2 * (V - V0) / (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)))) := by
    intro q r hh P V P0 V0 hq hr
    rw [E1 q hh hq, E2 q hh hq, E4 q hh hq, E5 q hh hq, E6 q r hq hr]
    have hs0 : 0 < Real.sqrt q := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq
    have hsq : Real.sqrt q ^ 2 = q := Real.sq_sqrt hq.le
    have hQ : 0 < q ^ hh := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq hh
    generalize Real.sqrt q = s at hs0 hsq ⊢
    generalize q ^ hh = Q at hQ ⊢
    subst hsq
    have hs1 : s ≠ 0 := hs0.ne'
    have hQ1 : Q ≠ 0 := hQ.ne'
    have hr1 : r ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
    field_simp
    ring
  have alg3 : ∀ (q r hh P V : ℝ), 0 < q → 0 < r →
      q ^ (2 * (1/2 + hh) + 1/2) * (-(q ^ (-(2 + hh)) * (P + V / (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)))) * r) =
      -(Real.exp (hh * Real.log q) * Real.sqrt (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q))) *
        (P + 1 * V / (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)))) := by
    intro q r hh P V hq hr
    rw [E1 q hh hq, E3 q hh hq, E5 q hh hq, E6 q r hq hr]
    have hs0 : 0 < Real.sqrt q := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq
    have hsq : Real.sqrt q ^ 2 = q := Real.sq_sqrt hq.le
    have hQ : 0 < q ^ hh := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq hh
    generalize Real.sqrt q = s at hs0 hsq ⊢
    generalize q ^ hh = Q at hQ ⊢
    subst hsq
    have hs1 : s ≠ 0 := hs0.ne'
    have hQ1 : Q ≠ 0 := hQ.ne'
    have hr1 : r ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
    field_simp
  have alg4 : ∀ (q r hh P V : ℝ), 0 < q → 0 < r →
      q ^ (2 * (1/2 + hh) + 1/2) * -(Real.sqrt (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q))) * q ^ (-(3 / 2 + hh)) *
          (P + V / (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q))))) =
      -(Real.exp (hh * Real.log q) * Real.sqrt (2 * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q))) *
        (P + 1/2 * V / (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)))) := by
    intro q r hh P V hq hr
    rw [E1 q hh hq, E4 q hh hq, E5 q hh hq, E6 q r hq hr]
    have hs0 : 0 < Real.sqrt q := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq
    have hsq : Real.sqrt q ^ 2 = q := Real.sq_sqrt hq.le
    have hQ : 0 < q ^ hh := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq hh
    generalize Real.sqrt q = s at hs0 hsq ⊢
    generalize q ^ hh = Q at hQ ⊢
    subst hsq
    have hs1 : s ≠ 0 := hs0.ne'
    have hQ1 : Q ≠ 0 := hQ.ne'
    have hr1 : r ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
    field_simp
  
  have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hz2 : ξ.2.1 ^ 2 < qC B.h ξ ^ (1 - 2 * B.h) := (hok.1.2.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).2
  have hX : 0 < XC B.h ξ := div_pos (pow_pos hr 2) (by linarith)
  have hpow : (qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))) ^ 2 * qC B.h ξ ^ (1 - 2 * B.h) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hq.le, ← Real.rpow_add hq,
      show -(1/2 - B.h) * ((2:ℕ):ℝ) + (1 - 2 * B.h) = 0 by push_cast; ring, Real.rpow_zero]
  have hηsq : etaC B.h ξ ^ 2 < 1 := by
    have hP : 0 < (qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))) ^ 2 := pow_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _) 2
    have e : etaC B.h ξ ^ 2 = ξ.2.1 ^ 2 * (qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))) ^ 2 := by unfold etaC; ring
    rw [e]
    calc ξ.2.1 ^ 2 * (qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))) ^ 2
        < qC B.h ξ ^ (1 - 2 * B.h) * (qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))) ^ 2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hz2 hP
      _ = 1 := by rw [mul_comm]; exact hpow
  obtain ⟨hη1, hη2⟩ := abs_lt.mp ((sq_lt_one_iff_abs_lt_one _).mp hηsq)
  have hlogq : Real.log (qC B.h ξ) < Real.log B.qB := Real.log_lt_log hq (lt_of_lt_of_le hqs hqsB)
  have hD0 : ((XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨hX, hη1, hη2⟩
  have hw0 : pbdPsi B.h ξ ∈ Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := ⟨hlogq, hX, hη1, hη2⟩
  have hD0o : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hUo : IsOpen (Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) :=
    isOpen_Iio.prod (isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo)
  
  have hSd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) := by
    have hmem : ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    exact (hok.1.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt ((isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt
      (by simp)
  have hπ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) ξ := by fun_prop
  have hqd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (qC B.h) ξ := by
    have e : qC B.h = (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
      funext η; rfl
    rw [e]
    exact hSd.comp ξ hπ
  have hXd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (XC B.h) ξ := by
    have e : XC B.h = fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ 2 * (2 * qC B.h η)⁻¹ := by
      funext η; exact div_eq_mul_inv _ _
    rw [e]
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ 2) ξ := differentiableAt_fst.pow 2
    have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => 2 * qC B.h η) ξ := hqd.const_mul 2
    have h3 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => (2 * qC B.h η)⁻¹) ξ :=
      h2.inv (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hq.ne')
    exact h1.mul h3
  have hEd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (etaC B.h) ξ := by
    have e : etaC B.h = fun η : Cyl => η.2.1 * qC B.h η ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) := by
      funext η; rfl
    rw [e]
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => η.2.1) ξ := by fun_prop
    exact h1.mul (hqd.rpow_const (Or.inl hq.ne'))
  have hT0d : ∀ T0 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿T0) (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿T0) (XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) := fun T0 hT =>
    (hT.contDiffAt (hD0o.mem_nhds hD0)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hLd : ∀ T : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logLift T) (Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (logLift T) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) := fun T hT =>
    (hT.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hw0)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hT0thd := hT0d B.T0th hT0th
  have hT0zd := hT0d B.T0z hT0z
  have hLthd := hLd B.Tth hTth
  have hLzd := hLd B.Tz hTz
  
  have hsl0 : ∀ T0 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿T0) (XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y => T0 Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ) := fun T0 hTd =>
    DifferentiableAt.comp (g := ↿T0) (f := fun Y : ℝ => ((Y, etaC B.h ξ) : ℝ × ℝ)) (XC B.h ξ) hTd
      (differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const _))
  have slice : ∀ (G : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ G (pbdPsi B.h ξ) →
      (∀ Y', G (Real.log (qC B.h ξ), Y', etaC B.h ξ) = g Y') →
      HasDerivAt g (fderiv ℝ G (pbdPsi B.h ξ) (0, 1, 0)) (XC B.h ξ) := by
    intro G g hG hg
    have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun Y' : ℝ => ((Real.log (qC B.h ξ), Y', etaC B.h ξ) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))
        ((0, 1, 0) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (XC B.h ξ) :=
      (hasDerivAt_const _ _).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_id' _).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const _ _))
    have h1 := HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (XC B.h ξ) hG.hasFDerivAt hlin rfl
    have e : (G ∘ fun Y' : ℝ => ((Real.log (qC B.h ξ), Y', etaC B.h ξ) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) = g := funext hg
    rw [e] at h1
    exact h1
  have hLsl : ∀ T : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (logLift T) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) →
      HasDerivAt (fun Y => T (qC B.h ξ) Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (fderiv ℝ (logLift T) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) (0, 1, 0))
        (XC B.h ξ) := fun T hT =>
    slice (logLift T) (fun Y => T (qC B.h ξ) Y (etaC B.h ξ)) hT
      (fun Y' => by simp only [logLift, Real.exp_log hq])
  have hV : ∀ T : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, T (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) = logLift T (pbdPsi B.h ξ) := by
    intro T
    simp only [logLift, pbdPsi, Real.exp_log hq]
  have hG1 : fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift B.Tth w - B.T0th w.2.1 w.2.2) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) (0, 1, 0) =
      fderiv ℝ (logLift B.Tth) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) (0, 1, 0) - deriv (fun Y => B.T0th Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ) := by
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift B.Tth w - B.T0th w.2.1 w.2.2) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) :=
      hLthd.sub (DifferentiableAt.comp (g := ↿B.T0th) (f := Prod.snd) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) hT0thd
        differentiableAt_snd)
    have h1 := slice _ (fun Y => B.Tth (qC B.h ξ) Y (etaC B.h ξ) - B.T0th Y (etaC B.h ξ)) hd
      (fun Y' => by simp only [logLift, Real.exp_log hq])
    have h2 := (hLsl B.Tth hLthd).sub (hsl0 B.T0th hT0thd).hasDerivAt
    exact h1.unique h2
  have hG2 : fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift B.Tz w - B.T0z w.2.1 w.2.2) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) (0, 1, 0) =
      fderiv ℝ (logLift B.Tz) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) (0, 1, 0) - deriv (fun Y => B.T0z Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ) := by
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift B.Tz w - B.T0z w.2.1 w.2.2) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) :=
      hLzd.sub (DifferentiableAt.comp (g := ↿B.T0z) (f := Prod.snd) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) hT0zd
        differentiableAt_snd)
    have h1 := slice _ (fun Y => B.Tz (qC B.h ξ) Y (etaC B.h ξ) - B.T0z Y (etaC B.h ξ)) hd
      (fun Y' => by simp only [logLift, Real.exp_log hq])
    have h2 := (hLsl B.Tz hLzd).sub (hsl0 B.T0z hT0zd).hasDerivAt
    exact h1.unique h2
  have hPth : deriv (fun Y => B.Tth (qC B.h ξ) Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ) =
      fderiv ℝ (logLift B.Tth) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) (0, 1, 0) := (hLsl B.Tth hLthd).deriv
  have hPz : deriv (fun Y => B.Tz (qC B.h ξ) Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ) =
      fderiv ℝ (logLift B.Tz) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) (0, 1, 0) := (hLsl B.Tz hLzd).deriv
  
  have key : ∀ T0 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿T0) (XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) →
      dR B.h (pmrTh B T0) ξ = qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) *
        (deriv (fun Y => T0 Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ) * (2 * ξ.1 / (2 * qC B.h ξ))) := by
    intro T0 hTd
    have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (pmrTh B T0) ξ := by
      have e : pmrTh B T0 = fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-(1 + B.h)) *
          ((↿T0) ∘ (fun η : Cyl => ((XC B.h η, etaC B.h η) : ℝ × ℝ))) η := by
        funext η; rfl
      rw [e]
      exact (hqd.rpow_const (Or.inl hq.ne')).mul
        (DifferentiableAt.comp (g := ↿T0) (f := fun η : Cyl => ((XC B.h η, etaC B.h η) : ℝ × ℝ)) ξ hTd
          (hXd.prodMk hEd))
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : Cyl, v = (1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ξ + s • v) v 0 := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const v).const_add ξ
    have h7 : HasDerivAt ((pmrTh B T0) ∘ (fun s : ℝ => ξ + s • v)) (fderiv ℝ (pmrTh B T0) ξ v) 0 :=
      HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) hFd.hasFDerivAt hγ (by simp)
    have h8 : ((pmrTh B T0) ∘ (fun s : ℝ => ξ + s • v)) =
        fun s => qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * T0 ((ξ.1 + s) ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ)) (etaC B.h ξ) := by
      funext s
      have e1 : (ξ + s • v).1 = ξ.1 + s := by simp [hv]
      have e2 : (ξ + s • v).2.1 = ξ.2.1 := by simp [hv]
      have e3 : (ξ + s • v).2.2.1 = ξ.2.2.1 := by simp [hv]
      have eq : qC B.h (ξ + s • v) = qC B.h ξ := by
        unfold qC
        rw [e2, e3]
      have eqE : etaC B.h (ξ + s • v) = etaC B.h ξ := by
        unfold etaC
        rw [eq, e2]
      show qC B.h (ξ + s • v) ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * T0 (XC B.h (ξ + s • v)) (etaC B.h (ξ + s • v)) = _
      rw [eqE]
      unfold XC
      rw [eq, e1]
    have hu : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (ξ.1 + s) ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ)) (2 * ξ.1 / (2 * qC B.h ξ)) 0 := by
      have := (((hasDerivAt_id' (x := (0:ℝ))).const_add ξ.1).pow 2).div_const (2 * qC B.h ξ)
      convert this using 1
      simp
    have hc := HasDerivAt.comp_of_eq (0:ℝ) (hsl0 T0 hTd).hasDerivAt hu
      (by show XC B.h ξ = (ξ.1 + 0) ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ); rw [add_zero]; rfl)
    have hc' := hc.const_mul (qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1 + B.h)))
    rw [h8] at h7
    have hfin := h7.unique hc'
    show fderiv ℝ (pmrTh B T0) ξ (1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) = _
    rw [← hv]
    exact hfin
  
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ³, x = rotPt ξ.1 0 ξ.2.1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hx0 : x 0 = ξ.1 := by simp [hx, rotPt]
  have hx1 : x 1 = 0 := by simp [hx, rotPt]
  have hx2 : x 2 = ξ.2.1 := by simp [hx, rotPt]
  have hS : simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - ξ.2.2.1) = qC B.h ξ := by rw [hx2]; rfl
  have hSX : simX B.h x ξ.2.2.1 = XC B.h ξ := by
    unfold simX XC
    rw [hS, hx0, hx1]
    ring
  have hSE : simEta B.h x ξ.2.2.1 = etaC B.h ξ := by
    unfold simEta etaC
    rw [hS, hx2]
  have hrad : rad x = ξ.1 := by
    unfold rad
    rw [hx0, hx1]
    simp [Real.sqrt_sq hr.le, abs_of_pos hr]
  have haz : azVec x = ξ.1 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) := by
    unfold azVec
    rw [hx0, hx1, neg_zero, zero_smul, zero_add]
  have hf1 : frameAt 0 ξ 1 = EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) := by
    have e : frameAt 0 ξ 1 = eTh x := by rw [hx]; rfl
    rw [e, eTh, hrad, haz, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
  have hf2 : frameAt 0 ξ 2 = EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) := rfl
  have hstress : stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz x ξ.2.2.1 =
      (-(qC B.h ξ ^ (-(2 + B.h)) *
        (deriv (fun Y => B.Tth (qC B.h ξ) Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ)
          + B.Tth (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) / XC B.h ξ))) • azVec x
      + (-(Real.sqrt (2 * XC B.h ξ) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(3 / 2 + B.h)) *
        (deriv (fun Y => B.Tz (qC B.h ξ) Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ)
          + B.Tz (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) / (2 * XC B.h ξ)))) •
        EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) := by
    unfold stressDivField
    rw [hS, hSX, hSE]
  have hs1 : sBase B 1 ξ = -(qC B.h ξ ^ (-(2 + B.h)) *
      (fderiv ℝ (logLift B.Tth) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) (0, 1, 0) + logLift B.Tth (pbdPsi B.h ξ) / XC B.h ξ)) * ξ.1 := by
    unfold sBase
    rw [← hx, hstress, hf1, haz, hPth, hV B.Tth]
    simp [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left] <;> ring
  have hs2 : sBase B 2 ξ = -(Real.sqrt (2 * XC B.h ξ) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(3 / 2 + B.h)) *
      (fderiv ℝ (logLift B.Tz) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) (0, 1, 0) + logLift B.Tz (pbdPsi B.h ξ) / (2 * XC B.h ξ))) := by
    unfold sBase
    rw [← hx, hstress, hf2, haz, hPz, hV B.Tz]
    simp [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left] <;> ring
  
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) *
        (dR B.h (pmrTh B B.T0th) ξ + 2 * pmrTh B B.T0th ξ / ξ.1 + sBase B 1 ξ) =
      -(Real.exp (B.h * Real.log (qC B.h ξ)) * Real.sqrt (2 * XC B.h ξ) *
        (fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift B.Tth w - B.T0th w.2.1 w.2.2) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) (0, 1, 0) +
          1 * (logLift B.Tth (pbdPsi B.h ξ) - B.T0th (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ)) / XC B.h ξ))
    rw [key B.T0th hT0thd, hs1, hG1]
    exact alg1 (qC B.h ξ) ξ.1 B.h (fderiv ℝ (logLift B.Tth) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) (0, 1, 0))
      (logLift B.Tth (pbdPsi B.h ξ)) (deriv (fun Y => B.T0th Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ))
      (B.T0th (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ)) hq hr
  · show qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) *
        (dR B.h (pmrTh B B.T0z) ξ + pmrTh B B.T0z ξ / ξ.1 + sBase B 2 ξ) =
      -(Real.exp (B.h * Real.log (qC B.h ξ)) * Real.sqrt (2 * XC B.h ξ) *
        (fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => logLift B.Tz w - B.T0z w.2.1 w.2.2) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) (0, 1, 0) +
          1/2 * (logLift B.Tz (pbdPsi B.h ξ) - B.T0z (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ)) / XC B.h ξ))
    rw [key B.T0z hT0zd, hs2, hG2]
    exact alg2 (qC B.h ξ) ξ.1 B.h (fderiv ℝ (logLift B.Tz) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) (0, 1, 0))
      (logLift B.Tz (pbdPsi B.h ξ)) (deriv (fun Y => B.T0z Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ))
      (B.T0z (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ)) hq hr
  · show qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * sBase B 1 ξ =
      -(Real.exp (B.h * Real.log (qC B.h ξ)) * Real.sqrt (2 * XC B.h ξ) *
        (fderiv ℝ (logLift B.Tth) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) (0, 1, 0) + 1 * logLift B.Tth (pbdPsi B.h ξ) / XC B.h ξ))
    rw [hs1]
    exact alg3 (qC B.h ξ) ξ.1 B.h (fderiv ℝ (logLift B.Tth) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) (0, 1, 0))
      (logLift B.Tth (pbdPsi B.h ξ)) hq hr
  · show qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * sBase B 2 ξ =
      -(Real.exp (B.h * Real.log (qC B.h ξ)) * Real.sqrt (2 * XC B.h ξ) *
        (fderiv ℝ (logLift B.Tz) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) (0, 1, 0) + 1/2 * logLift B.Tz (pbdPsi B.h ξ) / XC B.h ξ))
    rw [hs2]
    exact alg4 (qC B.h ξ) ξ.1 B.h (fderiv ℝ (logLift B.Tz) (pbdPsi B.h ξ) (0, 1, 0))
      (logLift B.Tz (pbdPsi B.h ξ)) hq hr

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → ∀ (F : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (DomC B.h qs) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * NB B.h (dR B.h F) k ξ ≤ M * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(B.h * kapS)) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), NB B.h F i ξ

signature.name: dR_coarse_frame_bound_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → ∀ (F : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (DomC B.h qs) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * NB B.h (dR B.h F) k ξ ≤ M * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(B.h * kapS)) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), NB B.h F i ξ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs hok hqs0 hqs1 F hF k
  have hh : 0 < B.h := hok.2.1.1
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  have hΩo : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qs))
    have e : DomC B.h qs =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio qs := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  have hqpos : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ := fun ξ hξ =>
    (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ.2.1])).1
  
  have hJ : ∀ (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ), JpowL n (t • vrv) = (Lgc ^ n * t) • vrv := by
    intro n t
    have hD : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    simp only [JpowL, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', Jpow, vrv, vtv]
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.fst_add, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
      ring
    · simp only [Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.snd_add, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
      ring
  
  have hcoarse : ∀ h q : ℝ, 0 ≤ h → 0 < q → q ≤ 1 →
      Lgc ^ (coarseIdx h q) ≤ q ^ (-(drx h / 2 + h * kapS)) := by
    intro h q hh q0 hq1
    have hs2a : (1:ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := by
      have := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (show (1:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
      rwa [Real.sqrt_one] at this
    have hs2b : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := (Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)).mpr (by norm_num)
    have hL1 : 1 < Lgc := by unfold Lgc; linarith
    have hT1 : 1 < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; linarith
    have hL0 : 0 < Lgc := by linarith
    have hLl : 0 < Real.log Lgc := Real.log_pos hL1
    have hTl : 0 < Real.log Tgc := Real.log_pos hT1
    have hl2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
    obtain ⟨x, hxdef⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = Real.logb 2 (1 / q) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by
      rw [hxdef]; exact Real.logb_nonneg one_lt_two (one_le_one_div q0 hq1)
    have hx : x * Real.log 2 = -Real.log q := by
      rw [hxdef, Real.logb, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hl2.ne', one_div, Real.log_inv]
    have hb : bandOf q = ⌈x⌉₊ := by rw [hxdef]; rfl
    have hR : 0 ≤ (1 + h) * x * Real.log 2 / Real.log Tgc :=
      div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hx0) hl2.le) hTl.le
    have hstar : ((coarseIdx h q : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ (1 + h) * x * Real.log 2 / Real.log Tgc := by
      obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ : ∃ l : ℕ, l = bandOf q - 4 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hc : coarseIdx h q = bandIdx h l := by rw [hl]; rfl
      rw [hc]
      unfold bandIdx
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos l with h0 | hpos
      · have e : Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l:ℝ) ^ 2)) = 0 := by
          rw [h0]; simp
        rw [e, Int.floor_zero, Int.cast_zero]
        exact hR
      · have hl1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (l:ℝ) ^ 2 := one_le_pow₀ (by exact_mod_cast hpos)
        have hA : 0 < (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _
        have hAl : 0 < (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / (l:ℝ) ^ 2 := div_pos hA (by linarith)
        have h1 := Int.floor_le (Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / (l:ℝ) ^ 2))
        have h2 := Real.logb_le_logb_of_le hT1 hAl (div_le_self hA.le hl1)
        have h3 : Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ))) =
            (1 + h) * l * Real.log 2 / Real.log Tgc := by
          rw [Real.logb_rpow_eq_mul_logb_of_pos two_pos, ← Real.log_div_log]
          ring
        have hlx : (l:ℝ) ≤ x := by
          have e1 : l + 4 = bandOf q := by omega
          have e2 : ((⌈x⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) < x + 1 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one hx0
          have e3 : ((l:ℝ) + 4) = ((⌈x⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) := by rw [← hb]; exact_mod_cast e1
          linarith
        have h4 : (1 + h) * l * Real.log 2 / Real.log Tgc ≤
            (1 + h) * x * Real.log 2 / Real.log Tgc := by
          rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv]
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (inv_nonneg.mpr hTl.le)
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hl2.le
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlx (by linarith)
        linarith
    have hd : drx h / 2 + h * kapS = (1 + h) * (Real.log Lgc / Real.log Tgc) := by
      unfold drx; ring
    have hlq : Real.log q = -(x * Real.log 2) := by rw [hx]; ring
    rw [← Real.rpow_intCast, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hL0, Real.rpow_def_of_pos q0, Real.exp_le_exp,
      hd, hlq]
    calc Real.log Lgc * ((coarseIdx h q : ℤ) : ℝ)
        ≤ Real.log Lgc * ((1 + h) * x * Real.log 2 / Real.log Tgc) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstar hLl.le
      _ = -(x * Real.log 2) * -((1 + h) * (Real.log Lgc / Real.log Tgc)) := by ring
  
  have hshell : ∀ (d e q r X L Xa Xb a : ℝ) (j : ℕ), a = d - 1 - (j:ℝ) → 0 < q → 0 < Xa → Xa < X →
      X < Xb → 0 < r → r ^ 2 = 2 * q * X → 0 ≤ L → L ≤ q ^ (-(d / 2 + e)) →
      Real.sqrt q * (L * Real.sqrt q ^ j * r ^ a) ≤
        ((2 * Xa) ^ (a / 2) + (2 * Xb) ^ (a / 2)) * q ^ (-e) := by
    intro d e q r X L Xa Xb a j ha hq0 hXa' hX1 hX2 hr0 hr2 hL0 hL
    have hr : r ^ a = (2 * X) ^ (a / 2) * q ^ (a / 2) := by
      calc r ^ a = r ^ ((2:ℝ) * (a / 2)) := by congr 1; ring
        _ = (r ^ (2:ℝ)) ^ (a / 2) := Real.rpow_mul hr0.le _ _
        _ = (2 * X * q) ^ (a / 2) := by
            congr 1
            rw [Real.rpow_two, hr2]
            ring
        _ = (2 * X) ^ (a / 2) * q ^ (a / 2) := Real.mul_rpow (by linarith) hq0.le
    have hsq : Real.sqrt q = q ^ (1/2:ℝ) := Real.sqrt_eq_rpow q
    have hsqj : Real.sqrt q ^ j = q ^ ((j:ℝ) / 2) := by
      rw [hsq, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hq0.le]
      congr 1
      ring
    have e1 : q ^ (1/2:ℝ) * q ^ ((j:ℝ) / 2) * q ^ (a / 2) = q ^ (d / 2) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hq0, ← Real.rpow_add hq0]
      congr 1
      rw [ha]
      ring
    have key : Real.sqrt q * (L * Real.sqrt q ^ j * r ^ a) =
        (2 * X) ^ (a / 2) * (L * q ^ (d / 2)) := by
      rw [hr, hsqj, hsq, ← e1]
      ring
    have hLq : L * q ^ (d / 2) ≤ q ^ (-e) := by
      calc L * q ^ (d / 2) ≤ q ^ (-(d / 2 + e)) * q ^ (d / 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)
        _ = q ^ (-e) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_add hq0]
            congr 1
            ring
    have hE : (2 * X) ^ (a / 2) ≤ (2 * Xa) ^ (a / 2) + (2 * Xb) ^ (a / 2) := by
      rcases le_or_gt 0 (a / 2) with hs | hs
      · have h1 := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * X) (by linarith : 2 * X ≤ 2 * Xb) hs
        have h2 := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * Xa) (a / 2)
        linarith
      · have h1 := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * Xa)
          (by linarith : 2 * Xa ≤ 2 * X) hs.le
        have h2 := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * Xb) (a / 2)
        linarith
    rw [key]
    calc (2 * X) ^ (a / 2) * (L * q ^ (d / 2)) ≤ (2 * X) ^ (a / 2) * q ^ (-e) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLq (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
      _ ≤ ((2 * Xa) ^ (a / 2) + (2 * Xb) ^ (a / 2)) * q ^ (-e) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hE (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)
  
  have hphi : ∀ (p : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), 0 < ξ.1 →
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ p) j ξ ≤
        |Polynomial.eval p (descPochhammer ℝ j)| * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) ^ j * ξ.1 ^ (p - (j:ℝ)) := by
    intro p j ξ hr
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ, P = ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hPapp : ∀ η : Cyl, P η = η.1 := by intro η; rw [hP]; rfl
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      (contDiffOn_id (s := Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))).rpow_const_of_ne (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
    have hU : IsOpen (⇑P ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) := isOpen_Ioi.preimage P.continuous
    have hPξ : P ξ ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) := by rw [hPapp]; exact hr
    have hξU : ξ ∈ ⇑P ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) := hPξ
    have hfeq : (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ p) = (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) ∘ ⇑P := by
      funext η; simp only [Function.comp, hPapp]
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ p) ξ =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) ξ.1).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => P) := by
      rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ p) j hU hξU, hfeq,
        ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right P hg (uniqueDiffOn_Ioi 0) hU.uniqueDiffOn
          hPξ (i := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top),
        iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j isOpen_Ioi hPξ, hPapp]
    have e0 : ∀ v : Cyl, (Lnorm B.h ξ v).1 = Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * v.1 := by
      intro v; simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
    have hPL : ‖P.comp (Lnorm B.h ξ)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (fun v => ?_)

      exact h2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hNT (k - i + 1) (by omega))
        (mul_nonneg hΛ0.le (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))))
    have b3 : Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * (Λ * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) ^ i * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1 - (i:ℝ))) ≤
        Ef i * Q := by
      have hsh := hshell (drx B.h) (B.h * kapS) (qC B.h ξ) ξ.1 (XC B.h ξ) Λ B.Xa B.Xb
        (drx B.h - 1 - (i:ℝ)) i rfl hq0 hXa hX1 hX2 hr hX hΛ0.le
        (by rw [hΛ]; exact hcoarse B.h (qC B.h ξ) hh.le hq0 hq1)
      rw [← hQ] at hsh
      exact hsh.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hEi (by linarith))
    have hP0 : 0 ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * Kf i * (|drx B.h| * ‖vrv‖) * T :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC0 (hK0 i)) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))) hT0
    calc Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * ((k.choose i : ℝ) *
          NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) i ξ *
          NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) (k - i) ξ)
        ≤ Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * ((k.choose i : ℝ) *
          (Kf i * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) ^ i * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1 - (i:ℝ))) *
          (Λ * (|drx B.h| * ‖vrv‖) * T)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b1 hC0) b2
            (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hC0 hA0)) hs0.le
      _ = ((k.choose i : ℝ) * Kf i * (|drx B.h| * ‖vrv‖) * T) *
          (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * (Λ * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) ^ i * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1 - (i:ℝ)))) := by
          ring
      _ ≤ ((k.choose i : ℝ) * Kf i * (|drx B.h| * ‖vrv‖) * T) * (Ef i * Q) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b3 hP0
      _ = (k.choose i : ℝ) * (Kf i * (|drx B.h| * ‖vrv‖)) * Ef i * (Q * T) := by ring
  have hLb : Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) *
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) * fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) k ξ ≤
      S * (Q * T) := by
    calc Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) *
          NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) * fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) k ξ
        ≤ Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) *
          NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) i ξ *
          NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) (k - i) ξ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl hs0.le
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * ((k.choose i : ℝ) *
          NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) i ξ *
          NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) (k - i) ξ) := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
          (k.choose i : ℝ) * (Kf i * (|drx B.h| * ‖vrv‖)) * Ef i * (Q * T) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
      _ = S * (Q * T) := by rw [hS, Finset.sum_mul]
  have hfin : Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * NB B.h (dR B.h F) k ξ ≤ (1 + S) * Q * T := by
    calc Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * NB B.h (dR B.h F) k ξ
        ≤ Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * (NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm B.h ξ u1)) k ξ +
          NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) * fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) k ξ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsub hs0.le
      _ = Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm B.h ξ u1)) k ξ +
          Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) *
            NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) * fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) k ξ :=
          mul_add _ _ _
      _ ≤ Q * T + S * (Q * T) := add_le_add hG1b hLb
      _ = (1 + S) * Q * T := by ring
  rw [hQ, hT] at hfin
  exact hfin

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hB hG
  obtain ⟨cf, Cf, hcf, hFr⟩ := frame5_consts B G hB hG
  have hh0 : 0 < B.h := hB.2.1.1
  have hh1 : B.h < 1 / 100 := hB.2.1.2.1
  have hr0 : 0 < G.r0 := hG.1.1
  have hr1 : G.r0 ≤ 1 / 100 := hG.1.2.1
  have hu : 0 < G.ustar := hG.1.2.2.1
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ, W = (1 + G.ustar ^ 2) ^ (3/2:ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hW1 : 1 ≤ W := by
    rw [hW]; exact Real.one_le_rpow (by linarith [sq_nonneg G.ustar]) (by norm_num)
  have hW0 : 0 < W := by linarith
  obtain ⟨Cm, hCm⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = max Cf cf := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCfm : Cf ≤ Cm := by rw [hCm]; exact le_max_left _ _
  have hcfm : cf ≤ Cm := by rw [hCm]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hCm0 : 0 < Cm := by linarith
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ : ∃ k : ℝ, k = min cf (min (Real.sqrt (cf / (4 * W))) G.ustar) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hκ0 : 0 < κ := by
    rw [hκ]; exact lt_min hcf (lt_min (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (div_pos hcf (by linarith))) hu)
  have hκ1 : κ ≤ cf := by rw [hκ]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hκ2 : κ ≤ Real.sqrt (cf / (4 * W)) := by
    rw [hκ]; exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hκ3 : κ ≤ G.ustar := by rw [hκ]; exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ d : ℝ, d = max Cm (max (Real.sqrt Cm) (max G.ustar 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD1 : Cm ≤ D := by rw [hD]; exact le_max_left _ _
  have hD2 : Real.sqrt Cm ≤ D := by rw [hD]; exact (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hD3 : G.ustar ≤ D := by
    rw [hD]; exact (le_max_left _ _).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _))
  have tang : ∀ (x T c0 P Q Ss Su a b R Lv E1 E2 V V' : ℝ), V = c0 * Su * P + a * Q →
      V' = c0 * Ss * P + b * Q → 0 ≤ x → |c0| ≤ Cm → |P| ≤ 1 → |Q| ≤ 1 → |Ss - Su| ≤ E1 →
      |b - a| ≤ E2 → |T - x * V'| ≤ x * R / Lv → |T - x * V| ≤ x * (R / Lv + (Cm * E1 + E2)) := by
    intro x T c0 P Q Ss Su a b R Lv E1 E2 V V' hV hV' hx hc hP hQ hS hb hT
    have e : T - x * V = (T - x * V') + x * (c0 * (Ss - Su) * P + (b - a) * Q) := by
      rw [hV, hV']; ring
    have hE1 : 0 ≤ E1 := (abs_nonneg _).trans hS
    have hE2 : 0 ≤ E2 := (abs_nonneg _).trans hb
    have hC0 : 0 ≤ Cm := (abs_nonneg _).trans hc
    have h1 : |c0 * (Ss - Su) * P| ≤ Cm * E1 := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      calc |c0| * |Ss - Su| * |P| ≤ Cm * E1 * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hc hS (abs_nonneg _) hC0) hP (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hC0 hE1)
        _ = Cm * E1 := mul_one _
    have h2 : |(b - a) * Q| ≤ E2 := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |b - a| * |Q| ≤ E2 * 1 := mul_le_mul hb hQ (abs_nonneg _) hE2
        _ = E2 := mul_one _
    have h3 : |x * (c0 * (Ss - Su) * P + (b - a) * Q)| ≤ x * (Cm * E1 + E2) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hx]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add h1 h2)) hx
    rw [e]
    calc _ ≤ |T - x * V'| + |x * (c0 * (Ss - Su) * P + (b - a) * Q)| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ x * R / Lv + x * (Cm * E1 + E2) := add_le_add hT h3
      _ = x * (R / Lv + (Cm * E1 + E2)) := by ring
  have hsqrt : ∀ p q : ℝ, |Real.sqrt (1 + p ^ 2) - Real.sqrt (1 + q ^ 2)| ≤ |p ^ 2 - q ^ 2| := by
    intro p q
    have hA : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + p ^ 2) := Real.one_le_sqrt.mpr (by linarith [sq_nonneg p])
    have hB : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + q ^ 2) := Real.one_le_sqrt.mpr (by linarith [sq_nonneg q])
    have e : (Real.sqrt (1 + p ^ 2) - Real.sqrt (1 + q ^ 2)) *
        (Real.sqrt (1 + p ^ 2) + Real.sqrt (1 + q ^ 2)) = p ^ 2 - q ^ 2 := by
      have h1 := Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 + p ^ 2 by positivity)
      have h2 := Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 + q ^ 2 by positivity)
      linear_combination h1 - h2
    calc _ ≤ |Real.sqrt (1 + p ^ 2) - Real.sqrt (1 + q ^ 2)| *
          (Real.sqrt (1 + p ^ 2) + Real.sqrt (1 + q ^ 2)) :=
          le_mul_of_one_le_right (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
      _ = |p ^ 2 - q ^ 2| := by
          rw [← e, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (show (0:ℝ) < Real.sqrt (1 + p ^ 2) + Real.sqrt (1 + q ^ 2) by linarith)]
  obtain ⟨l2, M, h7⟩ := ptrack_base_compare5 B G hB hG
  obtain ⟨l3, M0, h8⟩ := ptrack_ref_compare5 B G hB hG M
  obtain ⟨Lst, Θ, Ct0, hΘ, hCt0, h9⟩ := ptrack_model5 κ D M0 hκ0
  refine ⟨l2 + l3 + ⌈Lst / (2 * G.r0)⌉₊ + 1, Cm * (9 * G.ustar ^ 2 / 4), cf * G.ustar ^ 2 / (2 * W),
    Real.exp (-Θ), Real.exp Θ, Ct0 / (2 * G.r0), Cm * (5 * G.ustar ^ 2 / 2) + G.ustar,
    div_pos (mul_pos hcf (pow_pos hu 2)) (by linarith), ?_, Real.exp_pos _,
    Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith), div_nonneg hCt0 (by linarith),
    add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCm0.le (by positivity)) hu.le, ?_⟩
  · calc cf * G.ustar ^ 2 / (2 * W) ≤ cf * G.ustar ^ 2 :=
          div_le_self (mul_nonneg hcf.le (sq_nonneg _)) (by linarith)
      _ ≤ Cm * (9 * G.ustar ^ 2 / 4) :=
          mul_le_mul hcfm (by linarith [sq_nonneg G.ustar]) (sq_nonneg _) hCm0.le
  intro γ ξ hl hact hdom hη
  have hl1 : 1 ≤ γ.1 := by omega
  have hl2 : l2 ≤ γ.1 := by omega
  have hl3 : l3 ≤ γ.1 := by omega
  have hℓ1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (γ.1 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hl1
  have hℓ0 : (0:ℝ) < (γ.1 : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hceil : Lst / (2 * G.r0) ≤ (γ.1 : ℝ) := by
    have h1 := Nat.le_ceil (Lst / (2 * G.r0))
    have h2 : ((⌈Lst / (2 * G.r0)⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (γ.1 : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (by omega : ⌈Lst / (2 * G.r0)⌉₊ ≤ γ.1)
    linarith
  obtain ⟨hcibl, hcibu, -, -⟩ := pulse5_scale_consts B.h G.r0 γ.1 hh0 hh1 hr0 hl1
  have hTgc : 0 < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; positivity
  have hcib0 : 0 < cib B.h γ.1 :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (div_pos one_pos (mul_pos hTgc (pow_pos hℓ0 2))) hcibl
  have hLlo : 2 * G.r0 * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 := by
    unfold Lsb; rw [le_div_iff₀ hcib0]
    have h1 := (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hℓ0 2)).mp hcibu
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * G.r0)
    linarith
  have hLhi : Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 ≤ 2 * Tgc * G.r0 * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    unfold Lsb; rw [div_le_iff₀ hcib0]
    have h1 := (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hTgc (pow_pos hℓ0 2))).mp hcibl
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * G.r0)
    linarith
  have hLst : Lst ≤ Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 := by
    have h1 : Lst ≤ 2 * G.r0 * (γ.1 : ℝ) := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)] at hceil; linarith
    have h2 : 2 * G.r0 * (γ.1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * G.r0 * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by rw [sq]; exact le_mul_of_one_le_right hℓ0.le hℓ1) (by linarith)
    linarith
  have hL0 : 0 < Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 := lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos (by linarith) (pow_pos hℓ0 2)) hLlo
  obtain ⟨hF0l, hF0u, hgl, hgu, hN1, hlaml, hlamu, hc0u, hc0l, -⟩ := hFr γ hact
  have hsg : sgn γ.2.2 = 1 ∨ sgn γ.2.2 = -1 := by unfold sgn; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have hsg2 : sgn γ.2.2 ^ 2 = 1 := by unfold sgn; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have hsga : |sgn γ.2.2| = 1 := by unfold sgn; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  
  have hQ0 : 0 < Qb γ.1 := by show (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ) ^ (-(γ.1:ℝ)); exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hQ1 : Qb γ.1 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(γ.1:ℝ)) ≤ 1; exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (by simp)
  have hε0 : 0 < epsb B.h γ.1 := by show 0 < Qb γ.1 ^ B.h; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ0 _
  have hε1 : epsb B.h γ.1 ≤ 1 := by show Qb γ.1 ^ B.h ≤ 1; exact Real.rpow_le_one hQ0.le hQ1 hh0.le
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = Real.sqrt (epsb B.h γ.1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hrp : 0 < r := by rw [hr]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hε0
  have hr1 : r ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hr]; calc Real.sqrt (epsb B.h γ.1) ≤ Real.sqrt 1 := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hε1
      _ = 1 := Real.sqrt_one
  have hr2 : r ^ 2 = epsb B.h γ.1 := by rw [hr]; exact Real.sq_sqrt hε0.le
  have hkb : kb B.h γ.1 = ⌈r⁻¹⌉₊ := by
    unfold kb; rw [Real.rpow_neg hε0.le, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← hr]
  have hk1 : r⁻¹ ≤ (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) := by rw [hkb]; exact Nat.le_ceil _
  have hk2 : (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) < r⁻¹ + 1 := by
    rw [hkb]; exact Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (inv_nonneg.mpr hrp.le)
  have hrr : r * r⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hrp.ne'
  have hx1 : 1 ≤ r * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk1 hrp.le; linarith
  have hx2 : r * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk2.le hrp.le
    rw [mul_add, hrr, mul_one] at this; linarith
  obtain ⟨ek, hekd⟩ : ∃ e : ℝ, e = epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hek : ek = (r * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by rw [hekd, mul_pow, hr2]
  have hek1 : 1 ≤ ek := by rw [hek]; exact one_le_pow₀ hx1
  have hek4 : ek ≤ 4 := by
    rw [hek]; have := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) hx2 2; norm_num at this; linarith
  have hEW : 1 ≤ ek * W := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hek1 hW1
  have hek0 : ek ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hW0' : W ≠ 0 := hW0.ne'
  have hBs2 : Bs5 B G γ ^ 2 = lam0_5 B G γ / (ek * W) := by
    unfold Bs5; rw [← hW, ← hekd]; exact Real.sq_sqrt (div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith))
  have hEB : ek * Bs5 B G γ ^ 2 = lam0_5 B G γ / W := by rw [hBs2]; field_simp
  have hBsl : κ ≤ Bs5 B G γ := by

        ⟨by simpa using hi0, norm_prod_le_iff.mpr
          ⟨(show ‖(qC B.h ξ)⁻¹‖ ≤ (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ from (Real.norm_of_nonneg hi0).le),

    rw [hdT]
    refine (nbdir B.h (DomC B.h qs) ξ G w hDopen hξ hG n).trans ?_
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hw (norm_nonneg _)
  have hdTs : ∀ (G : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (DomC B.h qs) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dTs5 G) (DomC B.h qs) := fun G hG =>
    (hG.fderiv_of_isOpen hDopen (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).clm_apply
      (contDiffOn_const (c := ((0, 0, 1, ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) : Cyl)))

  have hfs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-e) * nrm B e f η) (DomC B.h qs) :=

    have hq := hqpos η hη

  have hdTq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dTs5 (qC B.h)) (DomC B.h qs) := hdTs _ hqCs
  
  choose Cb hCb using hqpow (1 : ℝ)
  have hq1fun : (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ (1:ℝ)) = qC B.h := by
    funext η; exact Real.rpow_one _
  have hqb : ∀ i : ℕ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, NB B.h (qC B.h) i ξ ≤ |Cb i| * qC B.h ξ := by
    intro i ξ hξ
    have h3 := hCb i ξ hξ
    rw [hq1fun, Real.rpow_one] at h3
    exact h3.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (hqpos ξ hξ).le)
  have hwt : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, NB B.h (dTs5 (qC B.h)) j ξ ≤ |Cb (j + 1)| := by

          hdTle (qC B.h) hqCs ξ hξ j
      _ ≤ (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * (|Cb (j + 1)| * qC B.h ξ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hqb _ ξ hξ) (inv_nonneg.mpr hq.le)
      _ = |Cb (j + 1)| := by
          rw [mul_comm, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq.ne', mul_one]
  
  choose Cf bf df hCf using hF.2.2.2
  have hmerge : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ Cs bs ds : ℝ, 0 ≤ Cs ∧ ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ →
      XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → ∀ j, j ≤ k → NB B.h (nrm B e f) j ξ ≤ Cs * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * c) *
        SC B.h ξ ^ bs * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
          edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds)) := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨Cs, hCs⟩ : ∃ Cs : ℝ, Cs = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cf j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨bs, hbs⟩ : ∃ bs : ℝ, bs = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bf j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨ds, hds⟩ : ∃ ds : ℝ, ds = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |df j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hCs0 : 0 ≤ Cs := by rw [hCs]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have mem : ∀ j, j ≤ k → j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) :=
      fun j hj => Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj)
    have hCj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → Cf j ≤ Cs := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hCs]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cf j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    have hbj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → bf j ≤ bs := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hbs]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |bf j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    have hdj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → df j ≤ ds := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hds]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |df j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    refine ⟨Cs, bs, ds, hCs0, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 j hj => ?_⟩
    have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
    have hS1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
      unfold SC
      exact one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))])
    have hE : 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) := by
      unfold edgeWeight
      split_ifs
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      · exact le_rfl
    have hδ0 : 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) := by
      have hX : 0 < XC B.h ξ := lt_trans hXa hX1
      unfold edgeDist
      exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX1))
        (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr hX2)))
    have hδ1 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
    have hqa : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * c) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    have p3 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bs := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    have h1 := hCf j ξ hξ hX1 hX2
    have hb : SC B.h ξ ^ (bf j) ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bs := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 (hbj j hj)
    have hd : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df j) ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hδ0 hδ1 (neg_le_neg (hdj j hj))
    have p1 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ (bf j) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    have p2 : 0 ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df j) := Real.rpow_nonneg hδ0.le _
    calc NB B.h (nrm B e f) j ξ
        ≤ Cf j * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * c) * SC B.h ξ ^ (bf j) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
            edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df j) := h1
      _ = Cf j * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * c) * SC B.h ξ ^ (bf j) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
            edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df j)) := by ring
      _ ≤ Cs * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * c) * SC B.h ξ ^ (bf j) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
            edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df j)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hCj j hj)

      _ ≤ _ := by
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hCs0
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hqa) hE) hd p2
            (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hqa p3) hE)
  have hsh : ∀ (η : Cyl) (a : ℝ × ℝ), η + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), a) = shY η a := by
    intro η a
    rcases η with ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4⟩
    simp [shY]
  
  have hG1 : InM B qs c (fun η => qC B.h η * dTs5 (nrm B e f) η) := by
    refine ⟨hqCs.mul hdTF, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro ξ hξ a ha
      have hev : (fun x => nrm B e f (x + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), a))) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] nrm B e f := by

      rfl
    · intro ξ hξ hX

      have e2 : dTs5 (nrm B e f) ξ = 0 := by

      show qC B.h ξ * dTs5 (nrm B e f) ξ = 0
      rw [e2, mul_zero]
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨Cs, bs, ds, hCs0, hFb⟩ := hmerge (k + 1)
      obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cb i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨K * Cs, bs, ds, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
      have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
      obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ, W = qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * c) * SC B.h ξ ^ bs *
          edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hFW : ∀ j, j ≤ k + 1 → NB B.h (nrm B e f) j ξ ≤ Cs * W := fun j hj => by
        rw [hW]; exact hFb ξ hξ hX1 hX2 j hj
      have hl := leib ξ (DomC B.h qs) k hDopen hξ (qC B.h) (dTs5 (nrm B e f))
        (hqCs.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)) (hdTF.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      calc NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η * dTs5 (nrm B e f) η) k ξ

              NB B.h (qC B.h) i ξ * NB B.h (dTs5 (nrm B e f)) (k - i) ξ := hl
        _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cb i| * Cs * W := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro i hi

            have b1 : NB B.h (qC B.h) i ξ ≤ |Cb i| * qC B.h ξ := hqb i ξ hξ
            have b2 : NB B.h (dTs5 (nrm B e f)) (k - i) ξ ≤ (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * (Cs * W) :=
              (hdTle _ hFs ξ hξ (k - i)).trans
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hFW (k - i + 1) (by omega)) (inv_nonneg.mpr hq.le))
            calc (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h (qC B.h) i ξ * NB B.h (dTs5 (nrm B e f)) (k - i) ξ
                ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * (|Cb i| * qC B.h ξ) * ((qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * (Cs * W)) :=
                  mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) b2 (norm_nonneg _)
                    (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hq.le))
              _ = (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cb i| * Cs * W * (qC B.h ξ * (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹) := by ring
              _ = (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cb i| * Cs * W := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hq.ne', mul_one]
        _ = K * Cs * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * c) * SC B.h ξ ^ bs *
              edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← hK, hW]

  have hG2 : InM B qs c (fun η => dTs5 (qC B.h) η * nrm B e f η) := by
    refine ⟨hdTq.mul hFs, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro ξ hξ a ha

        simp [qC]
      have hd : dTs5 (qC B.h) (shY ξ a) = dTs5 (qC B.h) ξ := by
        unfold dTs5
        rw [← hsh ξ a, ← fderiv_comp_add_right, hqv]
      show dTs5 (qC B.h) (shY ξ a) * nrm B e f (shY ξ a) = dTs5 (qC B.h) ξ * nrm B e f ξ
      rw [hd, hF.2.1 ξ hξ a ha]
    · intro ξ hξ hX
      show dTs5 (qC B.h) ξ * nrm B e f ξ = 0
      rw [hF.2.2.1 ξ hξ hX, mul_zero]
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨Cs, bs, ds, hCs0, hFb⟩ := hmerge k
      obtain ⟨Ks, hKs⟩ : ∃ Ks : ℝ, Ks = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cb (i + 1)| :=
        ⟨_, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨Ks * Cs, bs, ds, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ, W = qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * c) * SC B.h ξ ^ bs *
          edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hFW : ∀ j, j ≤ k → NB B.h (nrm B e f) j ξ ≤ Cs * W := fun j hj => by
        rw [hW]; exact hFb ξ hξ hX1 hX2 j hj
      have hl := leib ξ (DomC B.h qs) k hDopen hξ (dTs5 (qC B.h)) (nrm B e f)
        (hdTq.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)) (hFs.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      calc NB B.h (fun η => dTs5 (qC B.h) η * nrm B e f η) k ξ
          ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) *
              NB B.h (dTs5 (qC B.h)) i ξ * NB B.h (nrm B e f) (k - i) ξ := hl
        _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cb (i + 1)| * (Cs * W) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro i _
            exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hwt i ξ hξ) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
              (hFW _ (Nat.sub_le k i)) (norm_nonneg _)
              (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _))
        _ = Ks * Cs * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * c) * SC B.h ξ ^ bs *
              edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← hKs, hW]
            ring
  
  refine hMc c c c 1 (-e) _ _ _ hG1 hG2 le_rfl le_rfl ?_
  intro ξ hξ
  have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
  have hN : DomC B.h qs ∈ nhds ξ := hDopen.mem_nhds hξ
  have hqd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (qC B.h) ξ := (hqCs.contDiffAt hN).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ f ξ := (hfs.contDiffAt hN).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hpow : HasFDerivAt (fun η => qC B.h η ^ e)
      ((e * qC B.h ξ ^ (e - 1)) • fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) ξ) ξ :=
    hqd.hasFDerivAt.rpow_const (Or.inl hq.ne')
  have hprod := hpow.mul hfd.hasFDerivAt
  have hfd' : fderiv ℝ (nrm B e f) ξ =
      (qC B.h ξ ^ e) • fderiv ℝ f ξ + f ξ • ((e * qC B.h ξ ^ (e - 1)) • fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) ξ) :=
    hprod.fderiv
  have hdTF' : dTs5 (nrm B e f) ξ =
      qC B.h ξ ^ e * dTs5 f ξ + f ξ * ((e * qC B.h ξ ^ (e - 1)) * dTs5 (qC B.h) ξ) := by
    unfold dTs5
    rw [hfd']
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have r1 : qC B.h ξ ^ (e + 1) = qC B.h ξ * qC B.h ξ ^ e := by
    rw [Real.rpow_add hq, Real.rpow_one]
    ring
  have r2 : qC B.h ξ * qC B.h ξ ^ (e - 1) = qC B.h ξ ^ e := by
    calc qC B.h ξ * qC B.h ξ ^ (e - 1) = qC B.h ξ ^ (1:ℝ) * qC B.h ξ ^ (e - 1) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_one]
      _ = qC B.h ξ ^ ((1:ℝ) + (e - 1)) := (Real.rpow_add hq _ _).symm
      _ = qC B.h ξ ^ e := by congr 1; ring
  show qC B.h ξ ^ (e + 1) * dTs5 f ξ =
    1 * (qC B.h ξ * dTs5 (nrm B e f) ξ) + (-e) * (dTs5 (qC B.h) ξ * (qC B.h ξ ^ e * f ξ))
  rw [hdTF']
  linear_combination (dTs5 f ξ) * r1 - (e * f ξ * dTs5 (qC B.h) ξ) * r2

by

  have hq : (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) = 1 := by
    rw [hrr, inv_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hr0)]
  have hcoord : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (z : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ => w i) z := by
    intro i z
    have h0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (ι := Fin 3) i) z :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt _
    rwa [EuclideanSpace.coe_proj] at h0
  have hnormAll : ∀ z : ℝ³, ‖(⟨z 0, z 1⟩ : ℂ)‖ = rad z := by
    intro z
    rw [Complex.norm_eq_sqrt_sq_add_sq]
    rfl
  
  have hph : ∀ (m : ℤ) (z : ℝ³), 0 < rad z →
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (thetaOf z : ℂ)) =
        ((((rad z)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((z 0 : ℂ) + (z 1 : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ^ m := by
    intro m z hz
    have hne : ((rad z : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hz.ne'
    have key := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I (⟨z 0, z 1⟩ : ℂ)
    rw [hnormAll z] at key
    have hexp : Complex.exp (((thetaOf z : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
        (((rad z)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((z 0 : ℂ) + (z 1 : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      rw [← Complex.mk_eq_add_mul_I, Complex.ofReal_inv, eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq₀ hne]
      exact key

        = Complex.exp ((m : ℂ) * ((thetaOf z : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
          congr 1
          ring
