      _ = _ := by rw [hexp]
  have hG0 : (((rad y)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((y 0 : ℂ) + (y 1 : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := by
    have h1 := hph 1 y hr
    rw [zpow_one] at h1
    rw [← h1]
    exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _
  
  have hcj : ∀ (F : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (aR aT aZ : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      (∀ v : ℝ³, fderiv ℝ F y v = ((y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1) * (rad y)⁻¹) • cyl2cart y aR +
        ((y 0 * v 1 - y 1 * v 0) * (rad y)⁻¹) • cyl2cart y aT + v 2 • cyl2cart y aZ) →
      curl3 F y = cyl2cart y ![aT 2 - aZ 1, aZ 0 - aR 2, aR 1 - aT 0] := by
    intro F aR aT aZ hJ
    unfold curl3
    simp only [hJ]
    refine PiLp.ext (fun i => ?_)
    fin_cases i
    · simp [cyl2cart, eR, eTh, eZ, radVec, azVec, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      ring
    · simp [cyl2cart, eR, eTh, eZ, radVec, azVec, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      ring
    · simp [cyl2cart, eR, eTh, eZ, radVec, azVec, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      linear_combination (aR 1 - aT 0) * hq
  
  have hradD : DifferentiableAt ℝ rad y :=
    (((hcoord 0 y).pow 2).add ((hcoord 1 y).pow 2)).sqrt hS.ne'
  have hFd : ∀ (m : ℤ) (d : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ d (ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0)) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => mvec5 h m d Y0 z s) y := by
    intro m d hd
    have hinv : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ³ => (rad z)⁻¹) y := hradD.inv hr0
    have hP : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ³ => ptOf z s (Yph h (rad z) s + Y0)) y := by
      have h4 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ³ => Yph h (rad z) s + Y0) y :=
        (((hradD.rpow_const (p := drx h) (Or.inl hr0)).smul_const vrv).add_const (s • vtv)).add_const Y0
      exact hradD.prodMk ((hcoord 2 y).prodMk ((differentiableAt_const s).prodMk h4))
    have hE : DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun z : ℝ³ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (thetaOf z : ℂ))) y := by
      have hz : DifferentiableAt ℝ
          (fun z : ℝ³ => (((rad z)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((z 0 : ℂ) + (z 1 : ℂ) * Complex.I)) y :=
        (Complex.ofRealCLM.differentiableAt.comp y hinv).mul
          ((Complex.ofRealCLM.differentiableAt.comp y (hcoord 0 y)).add
            ((Complex.ofRealCLM.differentiableAt.comp y (hcoord 1 y)).mul_const Complex.I))
      have hpow : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun u : ℂ => u ^ m)
          ((((rad y)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((y 0 : ℂ) + (y 1 : ℂ) * Complex.I)) :=
        differentiableAt_zpow.mpr (Or.inl hG0)
      have hG := (hpow.restrictScalars ℝ).comp y hz
      refine hG.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [hradD.continuousAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hr)] with z hz'
      exact hph m z hz'
    have hcP : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ³ => d (ptOf z s (Yph h (rad z) s + Y0))) y :=
      hd.comp y hP
    have hv : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ³ =>
        (d (ptOf z s (Yph h (rad z) s + Y0)) i *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (thetaOf z : ℂ))).re) y := by
      intro i
      exact Complex.reCLM.differentiableAt.comp y ((differentiableAt_pi.1 hcP i).mul hE)
    have heR : DifferentiableAt ℝ eR y :=
      hinv.smul (((hcoord 0 y).smul_const _).add ((hcoord 1 y).smul_const _))
    have heTh : DifferentiableAt ℝ eTh y :=
      hinv.smul (((hcoord 1 y).neg.smul_const _).add ((hcoord 0 y).smul_const _))
    exact (((hv 0).smul heR).add ((hv 1).smul heTh)).add ((hv 2).smul_const eZ)
  
  have hjet : ∀ (m : ℤ) (d : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ d (ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0)) → ∀ v : ℝ³,
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => mvec5 h m d Y0 z s) y v =
        ((y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1) * (rad y)⁻¹) • cyl2cart y (fun i =>
          (dR h (fun η => d η i) (ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re) +
        ((y 0 * v 1 - y 1 * v 0) * (rad y)⁻¹) • cyl2cart y (fun i =>
          (mthC m d (ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0)) i *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re) +
        v 2 • cyl2cart y (fun i =>
          (dZ (fun η => d η i) (ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re) := by
    intro m d hd v
    have hy0 : y + (0:ℝ) • v = y := by simp
    have hγi : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => (y + τ • v) i) (v i) 0 := by
      intro i
      have e : (fun τ : ℝ => (y + τ • v) i) = fun τ => y i + τ * v i := by
        funext τ
        simp
      rw [e]
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).mul_const (v i)).const_add (y i)
    have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => y + τ • v) v 0 := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const v).const_add y
    have hρ : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => rad (y + τ • v)) ((y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1) * (rad y)⁻¹) 0 := by
      have hf : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => (y + τ • v) 0 ^ 2 + (y + τ • v) 1 ^ 2)
          (2 * (y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1)) 0 := by
        have := ((hγi 0).pow 2).add ((hγi 1).pow 2)
        refine this.congr_deriv ?_
        simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hne : (y + (0:ℝ) • v) 0 ^ 2 + (y + (0:ℝ) • v) 1 ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hy0]
        exact hS.ne'
      refine (hf.sqrt hne).congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]
      show 2 * (y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1) / (2 * rad y) = _
      field_simp
    have hρ0 : 0 < rad (y + (0:ℝ) • v) := by
      rw [hy0]
      exact hr
    have hρinv : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => (rad (y + τ • v))⁻¹)
        (-((y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1) * (rad y)⁻¹) * (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2) 0 := by
      refine (hρ.inv hρ0.ne').congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
    have heR' : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => eR (y + τ • v))
        (((y 0 * v 1 - y 1 * v 0) * (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2) • eTh y) 0 := by
      have hrv : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => radVec (y + τ • v))
          (v 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
            v 1 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) 0 :=
        ((hγi 0).smul_const _).add ((hγi 1).smul_const _)
      refine (hρinv.smul hrv).congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]
      refine PiLp.ext (fun i => ?_)
      fin_cases i
      · simp [radVec, eTh, azVec]
        linear_combination (-((rad y)⁻¹ * v 0)) * hq
      · simp [radVec, eTh, azVec]
        linear_combination (-((rad y)⁻¹ * v 1)) * hq
      · simp [radVec, eTh, azVec]
    have heTh' : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => eTh (y + τ • v))
        ((-((y 0 * v 1 - y 1 * v 0) * (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2)) • eR y) 0 := by
      have hav : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => azVec (y + τ • v))
          ((-(v 1)) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
            v 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) 0 :=
        ((hγi 1).neg.smul_const _).add ((hγi 0).smul_const _)
      refine (hρinv.smul hav).congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]
      refine PiLp.ext (fun i => ?_)
      fin_cases i
      · simp [radVec, eR, azVec]
        linear_combination ((rad y)⁻¹ * v 1) * hq
      · simp [radVec, eR, azVec]
        linear_combination (-((rad y)⁻¹ * v 0)) * hq
      · simp [radVec, eR, azVec]
    
    have hΦ : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (thetaOf (y + τ • v) : ℂ)))
        (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (((y 0 * v 1 - y 1 * v 0) * (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))) 0 := by
      have hGd : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => (((rad (y + τ • v))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
            ((((y + τ • v) 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) + (((y + τ • v) 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I))
          (Complex.I * (((y 0 * v 1 - y 1 * v 0) * (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
            ((((rad y)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((y 0 : ℂ) + (y 1 : ℂ) * Complex.I))) 0 := by
        have ha := hρinv.ofReal_comp
        have hb := (hγi 0).ofReal_comp.add ((hγi 1).ofReal_comp.mul_const Complex.I)
        refine (ha.mul hb).congr_deriv ?_
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, zero_smul, add_zero]
        have hqC : ((rad y : ℂ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * ((y 0 : ℂ) ^ 2 + (y 1 : ℂ) ^ 2) = 1 := by
          exact_mod_cast hq
        push_cast
        linear_combination (((rad y : ℂ))⁻¹ ^ 3 * ((y 1 : ℂ) ^ 2 * (v 0 : ℂ) -
            (y 0 : ℂ) * (y 1 : ℂ) * (v 1 : ℂ))) * Complex.I_sq +
          (-(((rad y : ℂ))⁻¹ * ((v 0 : ℂ) + (v 1 : ℂ) * Complex.I))) * hqC
      have hzp : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℂ => u ^ m)
          ((m : ℂ) * ((((rad y)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((y 0 : ℂ) + (y 1 : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ^ (m - 1))
          ((((rad (y + (0:ℝ) • v))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
            ((((y + (0:ℝ) • v) 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) + (((y + (0:ℝ) • v) 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
        rw [hy0]
        exact hasDerivAt_zpow m _ (Or.inl hG0)
      have hcomp := hzp.comp (0:ℝ) hGd
      refine (hcomp.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_).congr_deriv ?_
      · filter_upwards [hρ.continuousAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hρ0)] with τ hτ
        exact hph m _ hτ
      · rw [hph m y hr, zpow_sub_one₀ hG0]
        have hinv1 : ((((rad y)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((y 0 : ℂ) + (y 1 : ℂ) * Complex.I))⁻¹ *
            ((((rad y)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((y 0 : ℂ) + (y 1 : ℂ) * Complex.I)) = 1 :=
          inv_mul_cancel₀ hG0
        linear_combination ((m : ℂ) *
          ((((rad y)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((y 0 : ℂ) + (y 1 : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ^ m * Complex.I *
          (((y 0 * v 1 - y 1 * v 0) * (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) * hinv1
    
    have hPd : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => ptOf (y + τ • v) s (Yph h (rad (y + τ • v)) s + Y0))
        (((y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1) * (rad y)⁻¹) •
            (((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx h * rad y ^ (drx h - 1)) • vrv) : Cyl) +
          v 2 • (((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) : Cyl)) 0 := by
      have h4 := (((hρ.rpow_const (p := drx h) (Or.inl hρ0.ne')).smul_const vrv).add_const
        (s • vtv)).add_const Y0
      have := hρ.prodMk ((hγi 2).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_const (0:ℝ) s).prodMk h4))
      refine this.congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [zero_smul, add_zero, hy0]
      ext <;> simp <;> ring
    have hζP : ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0) =
        (fun τ : ℝ => ptOf (y + τ • v) s (Yph h (rad (y + τ • v)) s + Y0)) 0 := by
      simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]
    have hdP := hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) hPd hζP
    have hci : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasDerivAt
        (fun τ : ℝ => d (ptOf (y + τ • v) s (Yph h (rad (y + τ • v)) s + Y0)) i)
        ((((y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1) * (rad y)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
            dR h (fun η => d η i) (ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0)) +
          ((v 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * dZ (fun η => d η i) (ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0))) 0 := by
      intro i
      have h1 := hasDerivAt_pi.1 hdP i
      refine h1.congr_deriv ?_
      have hpi := hasFDerivAt_pi'.1 hd.hasFDerivAt i
      have e1 : dR h (fun η => d η i) (ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0)) =
          fderiv ℝ d (ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0))
            ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx h * rad y ^ (drx h - 1)) • vrv) i := by
        rw [dR, hpi.fderiv]
        rfl
      have e2 : dZ (fun η => d η i) (ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0)) =
          fderiv ℝ d (ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) i := by
        rw [dZ, hpi.fderiv]
        rfl
      rw [e1, e2]
      simp only [map_add, map_smul, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Complex.real_smul]
    have hg : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasDerivAt
        (fun τ : ℝ => (d (ptOf (y + τ • v) s (Yph h (rad (y + τ • v)) s + Y0)) i *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (thetaOf (y + τ • v) : ℂ))).re)
        ((((((y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1) * (rad y)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
            dR h (fun η => d η i) (ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0)) +
          ((v 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * dZ (fun η => d η i) (ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0))) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ)) +
          d (ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0)) i *
            (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (((y 0 * v 1 - y 1 * v 0) * (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ)))).re) 0 := by
      intro i
      have := Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ) ((hci i).mul hΦ)
      refine this.congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [zero_smul, add_zero, Complex.reCLM_apply]
    have hFl := (((hg 0).smul heR').add ((hg 1).smul heTh')).add ((hg 2).smul_const eZ)
    have hFv := (hFd m d hd).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) hγ (by simp)
    have hFl' : HasDerivAt ((fun z => mvec5 h m d Y0 z s) ∘ fun τ : ℝ => y + τ • v) _ 0 := hFl
    rw [hFv.unique hFl']
    simp only [zero_smul, add_zero, cyl2cart, mthC, ptOf, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
      Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons,
      Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.intCast_re,
      Complex.intCast_im, Complex.div_ofReal_re, Complex.div_ofReal_im, smul_add, smul_smul]
    module
  
  have hdk : ∀ k ∈ K, DifferentiableAt ℝ (c k) (ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0)) :=
    fun k hk => ((hc k hk).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hζ)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  let Φ : (ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
    { toFun := fun L =>
        (L (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) 2 - L (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) 1) •
            EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (L (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) 0 - L (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) 2) •
            EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (L (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) 1 - L (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) 0) •
            EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)
      map_add' := by
        intro L M
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, PiLp.add_apply]
        module
      map_smul' := by
        intro r L
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply]
        module }
  have hΦ : ∀ H : ℝ³ → ℝ³, curl3 H y = Φ (fderiv ℝ H y) := fun H => rfl
  rw [hΦ, fderiv_fun_sum (fun k hk => hFd _ _ (hdk k hk)), map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k hk => ?_)
  rw [← hΦ, hcj _ _ _ _ (hjet (n k) (c k) (hdk k hk))]
  simp only [mvec5]
  congr 1
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
  simp only [mcurlC, mthC, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons,
    Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im,
    Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.intCast_re,
    Complex.intCast_im, Complex.div_ofReal_re, Complex.div_ofReal_im] <;>
  ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} (B : BG) (K : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℤ) (a : ι → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (p : ι → Cyl → ℂ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), IsOpen U → IsOpen O → (∀ η ∈ U, 0 < η.1) → (x, t) ∈ O → (∀ y s, (y, s) ∈ O → 0 < rad y ∧ ptOf y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y0) ∈ U ∧ uB B y s = cyl2cart y (fun i => ubase B (ptOf y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y0)) i)) → (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ubase B η i) U) → (∀ k ∈ K, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (a k) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (p k) U) → deriv (fun s => ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 x s) t - Δ (fun y => ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 y t) x + gradient (fun y => ∑ k ∈ K, msc5 B.h (n k) (p k) Y0 y t) x + fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 y t) x (uB B x t) + fderiv ℝ (fun y => uB B y t) x (∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 x t) = ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (mresC B (n k) (a k) (p k)) Y0 x t

signature.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} (B : BG) (K : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℤ) (a : ι → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (p : ι → Cyl → ℂ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), IsOpen U → IsOpen O → (∀ η ∈ U, 0 < η.1) → (x, t) ∈ O → (∀ y s, (y, s) ∈ O → 0 < rad y ∧ ptOf y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y0) ∈ U ∧ uB B y s = cyl2cart y (fun i => ubase B (ptOf y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y0)) i)) → (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ubase B η i) U) → (∀ k ∈ K, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (a k) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (p k) U) → deriv (fun s => ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 x s) t - Δ (fun y => ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 y t) x + gradient (fun y => ∑ k ∈ K, msc5 B.h (n k) (p k) Y0 y t) x + fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 y t) x (uB B x t) + fderiv ℝ (fun y => uB B y t) x (∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 x t) = ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (mresC B (n k) (a k) (p k)) Y0 x t

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ι B K n a p Y0 U O x t hU hO hUpos hxO hOm hub hap
  obtain ⟨hrx, hζ, huBx⟩ := hOm x t hxO
  have hJ := fun k (hk : k ∈ K) =>
    mode5_jet B.h (n k) (a k) (p k) Y0 U x t hU hUpos (hap k hk).1 (hap k hk).2 hrx hζ
  
  have hT : deriv (fun s => ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 x s) t =
      ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (fun η i => dT (fun η' => a k η' i) η) Y0 x t := by
    apply HasDerivAt.deriv
    exact HasDerivAt.fun_sum (fun k hk => (hJ k hk).2.2.2.2.2.1)
  
  have hlapsum : ∀ (S : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ³ → ℝ³), (∀ k ∈ S, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (f k) x) →
      Δ (fun y => ∑ k ∈ S, f k y) x = ∑ k ∈ S, Δ (f k) x := by
    classical
    intro S f
    induction S using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      intro _
      simp only [Finset.sum_empty]
      rw [InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_stdOrthonormalBasis]
      simp [iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
    | @insert j S hj ih =>
      intro hf
      have e : (fun y => ∑ k ∈ insert j S, f k y) = f j + (fun y => ∑ k ∈ S, f k y) := by
        funext y
        simp only [Finset.sum_insert hj, Pi.add_apply]
      rw [e, ContDiffAt.laplacian_add (hf j (Finset.mem_insert_self j S))
        (ContDiffAt.sum (fun k hk => hf k (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hk))),
        ih (fun k hk => hf k (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hk)), Finset.sum_insert hj]
  have hC2 : ∀ k ∈ K, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun z => mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 z t) x := fun k hk =>
    (mode5_smooth B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 U x t hU (hap k hk).1 hrx hζ).of_le (by norm_num)
  have hL : Δ (fun y => ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 y t) x =
      ∑ k ∈ K, Δ (fun z => mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 z t) x :=
    hlapsum K (fun k z => mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 z t) hC2
  
  have hG : gradient (fun y => ∑ k ∈ K, msc5 B.h (n k) (p k) Y0 y t) x =
      ∑ k ∈ K, gradient (fun z => msc5 B.h (n k) (p k) Y0 z t) x := by
    unfold gradient
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun k hk => (hJ k hk).2.1), map_sum]
  
  have hCv : fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 y t) x (uB B x t) =
      ∑ k ∈ K, fderiv ℝ (fun z => mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 z t) x
        (cyl2cart x (fun i => ubase B (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) i)) := by
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun k hk => (hJ k hk).1), ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, huBx]
  
  have hsl : {z : ℝ³ | (z, t) ∈ O} ∈ nhds x :=
    (hO.preimage (Continuous.prodMk continuous_id
      (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ³ => t))).mem_nhds hxO
  have hev : (fun y => uB B y t) =ᶠ[nhds x]
      (fun z => cyl2cart z (fun i => ubase B (ptOf z t (Yph B.h (rad z) t + Y0)) i)) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hsl (fun z hz => (hOm z t hz).2.2)
  have hSt : fderiv ℝ (fun y => uB B y t) x (∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 x t) =
      ∑ k ∈ K, fderiv ℝ (fun z => cyl2cart z (fun i => ubase B (ptOf z t (Yph B.h (rad z) t + Y0)) i)) x
        (mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 x t) := by
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, map_sum]
  
  have hsmul : ∀ (m : ℤ) (r : ℝ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)),
      r • mvec5 B.h m c Y0 x t = mvec5 B.h m (fun η i => (r : ℂ) * c η i) Y0 x t := by
    intro m r c
    simp only [mvec5, cyl2cart, smul_add, smul_smul, mul_assoc, Complex.re_ofReal_mul]
  have hlin : ∀ (m : ℤ) (c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 c7 c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)),
      (∀ i : Fin 3, c1 (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) i - c2 (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) i
        + c3 (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) i + (c4 (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) i
        + c5 (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) i + c6 (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) i)
        + c7 (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) i = c (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) i) →
      mvec5 B.h m c1 Y0 x t - mvec5 B.h m c2 Y0 x t + mvec5 B.h m c3 Y0 x t
        + (mvec5 B.h m c4 Y0 x t + mvec5 B.h m c5 Y0 x t + mvec5 B.h m c6 Y0 x t)
        + mvec5 B.h m c7 Y0 x t = mvec5 B.h m c Y0 x t := by
    intro m c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 c7 c hc
    have hre : ∀ i : Fin 3, (c (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) i *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re =
        (c1 (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re
        - (c2 (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re
        + (c3 (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re
        + ((c4 (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re
        + (c5 (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re
        + (c6 (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re)
        + (c7 (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re := by
      intro i
      rw [← hc i]
      simp only [add_mul, sub_mul, Complex.add_re, Complex.sub_re]
    simp only [mvec5, cyl2cart, hre]
    module
  rw [hT, hL, hG, hCv, hSt, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k hk => ?_)
  obtain ⟨-, -, hJR, hJT, hJZ, -, -, -, -⟩ := hJ k hk
  have hconv : fderiv ℝ (fun z => mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 z t) x
      (cyl2cart x (fun i => ubase B (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) i)) =
      ubase B (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) 0 •
          mvec5 B.h (n k) (fun η i => dR B.h (fun η' => a k η' i) η) Y0 x t
        + ubase B (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) 1 • mvec5 B.h (n k) (mthC (n k) (a k)) Y0 x t
        + ubase B (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) 2 •
          mvec5 B.h (n k) (fun η i => dZ (fun η' => a k η' i) η) Y0 x t := by
    unfold cyl2cart
    rw [map_add, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, map_smul, hJR, hJT, hJZ]
  rw [hconv, hsmul, hsmul, hsmul,
    mode5_lap1 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 U x t hU hUpos (hap k hk).1 hrx hζ,
    mode5_grad1 B.h (n k) (p k) Y0 U x t hU hUpos (hap k hk).2 hrx hζ,
    mode5_stretch1 B.h (n k) (a k) (ubase B) Y0 U x t hU hUpos hub hrx hζ]
  exact hlin (n k) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (fun i => by fin_cases i <;> simp [mresC, mthC] <;> ring)

subgoal_signatures.name: mode5_jet
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (p : Cyl → ℂ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ η ∈ U, 0 < η.1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p U → 0 < rad y → ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0) ∈ U → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => mvec5 h n c Y0 z s) y ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => msc5 h n p Y0 z s) y ∧ fderiv ℝ (fun z => mvec5 h n c Y0 z s) y (eR y) = mvec5 h n (fun η i => dR h (fun η' => c η' i) η) Y0 y s ∧ fderiv ℝ (fun z => mvec5 h n c Y0 z s) y (eTh y) = mvec5 h n (mthC n c) Y0 y s ∧ fderiv ℝ (fun z => mvec5 h n c Y0 z s) y eZ = mvec5 h n (fun η i => dZ (fun η' => c η' i) η) Y0 y s ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s' => mvec5 h n c Y0 y s') (mvec5 h n (fun η i => dT (fun η' => c η' i) η) Y0 y s) s ∧ fderiv ℝ (fun z => msc5 h n p Y0 z s) y (eR y) = msc5 h n (dR h p) Y0 y s ∧ fderiv ℝ (fun z => msc5 h n p Y0 z s) y (eTh y) = msc5 h n (fun η => Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (η.1 : ℂ) * p η) Y0 y s ∧ fderiv ℝ (fun z => msc5 h n p Y0 z s) y eZ = msc5 h n (dZ p) Y0 y s

subgoal_signatures.name: mode5_lap1
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (n : ℤ) (a : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ η ∈ U, 0 < η.1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U → 0 < rad y → ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0) ∈ U → Δ (fun z => mvec5 h n a Y0 z s) y = mvec5 h n (fun η => ![mlapC h n (fun η' => a η' 0) η - a η 0 / (η.1 : ℂ) ^ 2 - 2 * (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (η.1 : ℂ)) * a η 1 / (η.1 : ℂ), mlapC h n (fun η' => a η' 1) η - a η 1 / (η.1 : ℂ) ^ 2 + 2 * (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (η.1 : ℂ)) * a η 0 / (η.1 : ℂ), mlapC h n (fun η' => a η' 2) η]) Y0 y s

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (n : ℤ) (p : Cyl → ℂ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ η ∈ U, 0 < η.1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p U → 0 < rad y → ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0) ∈ U → gradient (fun z => msc5 h n p Y0 z s) y = mvec5 h n (fun η => ![dR h p η, Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (η.1 : ℂ) * p η, dZ p η]) Y0 y s

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (n : ℤ) (a : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (ub : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ η ∈ U, 0 < η.1) → (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ub η i) U) → 0 < rad y → ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0) ∈ U → fderiv ℝ (fun z => cyl2cart z (fun i => ub (ptOf z s (Yph h (rad z) s + Y0)) i)) y (mvec5 h n a Y0 y s) = mvec5 h n (fun η => ![a η 0 * ((dR h (fun η' => ub η' 0) η : ℝ) : ℂ) + a η 2 * ((dZ (fun η' => ub η' 0) η : ℝ) : ℂ) - ((ub η 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * a η 1 / (η.1 : ℂ), a η 0 * ((dR h (fun η' => ub η' 1) η : ℝ) : ℂ) + a η 2 * ((dZ (fun η' => ub η' 1) η : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((ub η 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * a η 1 / (η.1 : ℂ), a η 0 * ((dR h (fun η' => ub η' 2) η : ℝ) : ℂ) + a η 2 * ((dZ (fun η' => ub η' 2) η : ℝ) : ℂ)]) Y0 y s

      fin_cases i

      · exact c1
      · exact c2
    rw [hfun]
    have hs : (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) = 1 := by
      rw [← hr2]; field_simp
    refine PiLp.ext (fun j => ?_)
    fin_cases j <;>
      simp [cyl2cart, eR, eTh, eZ, radVec, azVec, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three] <;>
      first
      | linear_combination (uB B y s 0) * hs
      | linear_combination (-(uB B y s 0)) * hs
      | linear_combination (uB B y s 1) * hs
      | linear_combination (-(uB B y s 1)) * hs
  · 
    intro i
    have hsc : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hD : IsOpen (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      have hm : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)) := by fun_prop
      have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)))
          {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
        refine hsc.comp hm.continuousOn ?_
        intro w hw
        have hw' : w.2 < 1 := hw
        exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 by linarith⟩
      have hU : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
      have h1 := hc.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := B.qB))
      have e : simDomain B.h B.qB = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
          ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2))) ⁻¹' Iio B.qB := by
        ext w
        simp only [simDomain, mem_setOf_eq, mem_inter_iff, mem_preimage, mem_Iio, Function.comp]
      rw [e]
      exact h1
    have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(uB B)) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      have hAB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿B.AB) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := hBsm.1
      have hBv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿B.BvB) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := hBsm.2.1
      have hDA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z) (simDomain B.h B.qB) :=
        ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hD).1 hAB).2
      have hc : ∀ (v : ℝ³) (j : Fin 3),
          ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (v, (0:ℝ)) j) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
        intro v j
        have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (v, (0:ℝ))) (simDomain B.h B.qB) :=
          hDA.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
        exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h1
      let e0 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1
      let e1 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 1 1
      let e2 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 2 1
      have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e1, (0:ℝ)) 2 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e2, (0:ℝ)) 1) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e2, (0:ℝ)) 0 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e0, (0:ℝ)) 2) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e0, (0:ℝ)) 1 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e1, (0:ℝ)) 0) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) + (↿B.BvB) z) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
        refine ((((hc e1 2).sub (hc e2 1)).smul contDiffOn_const).add
          (((hc e2 0).sub (hc e0 2)).smul contDiffOn_const)).add
          (((hc e0 1).sub (hc e1 0)).smul contDiffOn_const) |>.add hBv
      refine hg.congr ?_
      rintro ⟨y, s⟩ hz
      have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s) :=
        (hAB.contDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have hpart : fderiv ℝ (fun w => B.AB w s) y =
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := by
        have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ³ => (w, s)) (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) y :=
          hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left y s
        have h2 : HasFDerivAt ((↿B.AB) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ => (w, s)))
            ((fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)) y :=
          HasFDerivAt.comp (g := ↿B.AB) y hdiff.hasFDerivAt h1
        exact h2.fderiv
      show curl3 (fun w => B.AB w s) y + B.BvB y s = _
      unfold curl3
      rw [hpart]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.inl_apply]
      rfl
    let ψ : Cyl → ℝ³ × ℝ := fun η => (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1, η.2.2.1)
    have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ := by
      have hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) := by
        unfold rotPt
        fun_prop
      exact hr.prodMk (contDiff_fst.comp (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd))
    have hmaps : MapsTo ψ {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1 ∧ η.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h η < B.qB} (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      intro η hη
      obtain ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩ := hη
      show η.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ((rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) 2) (1 - η.2.2.1) < B.qB
      rw [(frame η.1 η.2.1 e1).2.2.1]
      exact ⟨e2, e3⟩
    have hcomp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((↿(uB B)) ∘ ψ)
        {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1 ∧ η.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h η < B.qB} :=
      hu.comp hψ.contDiffOn hmaps
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => inner ℝ (((↿(uB B)) ∘ ψ) η)
        ((![EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ), eZ] :
          Fin 3 → ℝ³) i))
        {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1 ∧ η.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h η < B.qB} :=
      ContDiffOn.inner ℝ hcomp contDiffOn_const
    refine hg.congr ?_
    intro η hη
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, f2, f3⟩ := frame η.1 η.2.1 hη.1
    show inner ℝ (uB B (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) η.2.2.1)
        (![eR (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1), eTh (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1), eZ] i) = _
    rw [f2, f3]
    rfl

signature.name: plin5_cof_smooth
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ l0 : ℕ, qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 (primState5 B G).Aw → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 (primState5 B G).pw → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (cofA5 B G γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (cofP5 B G γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG l0 hqs hAw hpw γ m
  have hqsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have h4' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1
    have hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2.1
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    exact (h4'.comp hφ.contDiffOn hmaps).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
  have hqpos : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < qC B.h η := by
    intro η hη
    have h' : η.2.2.1 < 1 := hη.2.1
    exact (hok.1.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hqpow : ∀ c : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((qC B.h η ^ c : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro c
    have hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ c) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      hqsm.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos η hη).ne')
    exact (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hr).congr
      (fun η _ => by simp only [Function.comp_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply])
  
  have K : ∀ f : Cyl → ℂ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), f ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => f η *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))))
        (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro f hf hsupp
    set v : Cyl → ℝ × ℝ := fun η => Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ with hv
    have hvc : Continuous v := by
      rw [hv]
      unfold Jpow
      fun_prop
    have hbase : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => baseC B γ.1 η j)
        (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
      intro j
      obtain ⟨_, hsm⟩ := geom_slow_base_smooth_v5 B hok
      have hπ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) :=
        contDiff_fst.prodMk (contDiff_snd.fst.prodMk contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
      have hc := (hsm γ.1 j).comp hπ.contDiffOn
        (fun ξ (hξ : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0) =>
          (⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ.2.2 hqs⟩ : ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈
            {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}))
      exact hc.congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
    have hZ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => chartZ B.h γ.1 η) := by
      unfold chartZ
      exact contDiff_snd.fst.div_const _
    have hRC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => RC γ.1 η) := by
      unfold RC
      exact contDiff_fst.div_const _
    have hRCpos : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), RC γ.1 η ≠ 0 := by
      intro η hη
      have hr : 0 < η.1 := hη.1
      have : 0 < RC γ.1 η :=
        div_pos hr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _))
      exact this.ne'
    have hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Fang B γ.1 η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      ((hbase 1).div hRC.contDiffOn hRCpos).congr (fun η _ => rfl)
    apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    intro ξ₀ _
    set U' : Set Cyl := {η | |(v η).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8} ∩ {η | |(v η).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8}
      with hU'
    have hU'o : IsOpen U' :=
      (isOpen_lt ((hvc.fst.sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const).inter
        (isOpen_lt ((hvc.snd.sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const)
    have hξU : ξ₀ ∈ U' := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · show |(v ξ₀).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8
        rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; norm_num
      · show |(v ξ₀).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8
        rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; norm_num
    refine ⟨U', hU'o, hξU, ?_⟩
    by_cases hA : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U', f η = 0
    · refine (contDiffOn_const (c := (0:ℂ))).congr (fun p hp => ?_)
      have h0 := hA p hp
      simp [h0]
    · push_neg at hA
      obtain ⟨η1, ⟨hη1D, hη1U⟩, hη1⟩ := hA
      obtain ⟨-, -, hxi, het, -, -⟩ := hsupp η1 hη1D hη1
      have hr0 : G.r0 ≤ 1/100 := hG.1.2.1
      have hb0 : 0 ≤ bgc := by unfold bgc; linarith [Real.one_lt_sqrt_two]
      have hb1 : bgc ≤ 1 := by
        unfold bgc
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
      have hden : (1 + bgc ^ 2) * (1 + bgc ^ 2)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity)
      have id1 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.1 = lamR w + bgc * lamT w := by
        intro w
        simp only [lamR, lamT, div_eq_mul_inv]
        linear_combination (-w.1) * hden
      have id2 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.2 = -(bgc * lamR w) + lamT w := by
        intro w
        simp only [lamR, lamT, div_eq_mul_inv]
        linear_combination (-w.2) * hden
      have key : ∀ (R T : ℝ), |R| ≤ G.r0 / 4 → |T| ≤ G.r0 →
          |R + bgc * T| ≤ 1/80 ∧ |-(bgc * R) + T| ≤ 1/80 := by
        intro R T hR hT
        obtain ⟨hR1, hR2⟩ := abs_le.mp hR
        obtain ⟨hT1, hT2⟩ := abs_le.mp hT
        have hr0n : 0 ≤ G.r0 := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hT
        have e1 : bgc * T ≤ G.r0 := by
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hT2), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
        have e2 : -G.r0 ≤ bgc * T := by
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (show 0 ≤ T + G.r0 by linarith),
            mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
        have e3 : bgc * R ≤ G.r0 / 4 := by
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hR2), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
        have e4 : -(G.r0 / 4) ≤ bgc * R := by
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (show 0 ≤ R + G.r0 / 4 by linarith),
            mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
        exact ⟨abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
      have hround : ∀ (x : ℝ) (k : ℤ), |x - k| < 1/2 → round x = k := by
        intro x k hk
        rw [round_eq, Int.floor_eq_iff]
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hk
        constructor <;> linarith
      have hw1 : |lamR (frac0 (v η1))| ≤ G.r0 / 4 := hxi
      have hw2 : |lamT (frac0 (v η1))| ≤ G.r0 := het
      have hw := key _ _ hw1 hw2
      have ex1 : (v η1).1 - ((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ) =
          lamR (frac0 (v η1)) + bgc * lamT (frac0 (v η1)) := id1 (frac0 (v η1))
      have ex2 : (v η1).2 - ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ) =
          -(bgc * lamR (frac0 (v η1))) + lamT (frac0 (v η1)) := id2 (frac0 (v η1))
      have hx1 : |(v η1).1 - ((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1/80 := by rw [ex1]; exact hw.1
      have hx2 : |(v η1).2 - ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1/80 := by rw [ex2]; exact hw.2
      obtain ⟨kk, hkk⟩ : ∃ kk : ℝ × ℝ,
          kk = (((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ), ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hfr : ∀ η ∈ U', frac0 (v η) = v η - kk := by
        intro η hη
        have h1 : |(v η).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8 := hη.1
        have h2 : |(v η).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8 := hη.2
        have g1 : |(v η1).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8 := hη1U.1
        have g2 : |(v η1).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8 := hη1U.2
        obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_lt.mp h1
        obtain ⟨a3, a4⟩ := abs_lt.mp h2
        obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := abs_lt.mp g1
        obtain ⟨b3, b4⟩ := abs_lt.mp g2
        obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := abs_le.mp hx1
        obtain ⟨c3, c4⟩ := abs_le.mp hx2
        have r1 : round (v η).1 = round (v η1).1 :=
          hround _ _ (abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
        have r2 : round (v η).2 = round (v η1).2 :=
          hround _ _ (abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
        rw [hkk]
        unfold frac0
        rw [r1, r2]
        rfl
      have hT : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => lamT (v η - kk)) := by
        simp only [hv, lamT, Jpow, div_eq_mul_inv]
        fun_prop
      obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ M : Cyl → ℝ, M = fun η : Cyl =>
          pzr5 B G γ * chartZ B.h γ.1 η / epsb B.h γ.1 + sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 * RC γ.1 η
          - (lamT (v η - kk) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 *
            (pang5 B G γ * Fang B γ.1 η + pzr5 B G γ * baseC B γ.1 η 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hM : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ M (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
        rw [hMdef]
        exact ((((contDiffOn_const (c := pzr5 B G γ)).mul hZ.contDiffOn).div_const (epsb B.h γ.1)).add
          ((contDiffOn_const (c := sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2)).mul hRC.contDiffOn)).sub
          (((hT.contDiffOn.add (contDiffOn_const (c := G.r0))).div_const (cib B.h γ.1)).mul
            (((contDiffOn_const (c := pang5 B G γ)).mul hF).add
              ((contDiffOn_const (c := pzr5 B G γ)).mul (hbase 2))))
      have hmod : ∀ η ∈ U', phiL5 B G γ η = M η := by
        intro η hη
        have hvco : vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 = (lamT (v η - kk) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 := by
          show (lamT (frac0 (v η)) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 = _
          rw [hfr η hη]
        rw [hMdef]
        show phiL5 B G γ η = _
        unfold phiL5
        rw [hvco]
      have hMc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((M η : ℝ) : ℂ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
        (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hM).congr
          (fun p _ => by simp only [Function.comp_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply])
      have hE : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) *
          ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((M η : ℝ) : ℂ)))) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
        ((contDiffOn_const (c := Complex.I * (m : ℂ))).mul
          ((contDiffOn_const (c := (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ))).mul hMc)).cexp
      refine ((hf.mul hE).mono inter_subset_left).congr (fun p hp => ?_)
      have hpU : p ∈ U' := hp.2
      show f p * _ = _
      rw [hmod p hpU]
  constructor
  · refine contDiffOn_pi.2 (fun i => ?_)
    have hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η i) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      contDiffOn_pi.1 (hAw.2.1 γ m) i
    have hs : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (primState5 B G).Aw γ m ξ i ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ := by
      intro ξ hξ hne
      apply hAw.2.2.2.1 γ m ξ hξ
      intro h0
      apply hne
      simp [h0]
    refine ((hqpow (1/2 - Aex B.h)).mul (K _ hc hs)).congr (fun η _ => ?_)
    simp only [cofA5, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  · refine ((hqpow (-2 * Aex B.h)).mul
      (K _ (hpw.2.1 γ m) (fun ξ hξ hne => hpw.2.2.2.1 γ m ξ hξ hne))).congr (fun η _ => ?_)
    simp only [cofP5]
    ring

subgoal_signatures.name: geom_slow_base_smooth_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ B : BG, B.ok →
    IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} ∧
    ∀ (l : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => baseC B l (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) i)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → ∀ l0 : ℕ, InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 (primState5 B G).Aw → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 (primState5 B G).pw → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → ∃ (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (Γ : Finset Lab) (H : Finset ℤ), IsOpen O ∧ (x, t) ∈ O ∧ (∀ y s, (y, s) ∈ O → corrOn B l0 y s ∧ evOff B.h (pwrA5 B G l0) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y s = ∑ k ∈ Γ ×ˢ H, mvec5 B.h (k.2 * pint5 B G k.1) (cofA5 B G k.1 k.2) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y s ∧ evOff B.h (pwrP5 B G l0) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y s = ∑ k ∈ Γ ×ˢ H, msc5 B.h (k.2 * pint5 B G k.1) (cofP5 B G k.1 k.2) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y s) ∧ ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), (γ ∉ Γ ∨ m ∉ H) → linC5 B G γ m (ptOf x t Y) = 0

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → ∀ l0 : ℕ, InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 (primState5 B G).Aw → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 (primState5 B G).pw → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → ∃ (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (Γ : Finset Lab) (H : Finset ℤ), IsOpen O ∧ (x, t) ∈ O ∧ (∀ y s, (y, s) ∈ O → corrOn B l0 y s ∧ evOff B.h (pwrA5 B G l0) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y s = ∑ k ∈ Γ ×ˢ H, mvec5 B.h (k.2 * pint5 B G k.1) (cofA5 B G k.1 k.2) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y s ∧ evOff B.h (pwrP5 B G l0) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y s = ∑ k ∈ Γ ×ˢ H, msc5 B.h (k.2 * pint5 B G k.1) (cofP5 B G k.1 k.2) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y s) ∧ ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), (γ ∉ Γ ∨ m ∉ H) → linC5 B G γ m (ptOf x t Y) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok l0 hAw hpw x t Y hxt
  obtain ⟨Y', hY'⟩ : ∃ Y' : ℝ × ℝ, Y' = Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hY']
  have hxt' : 0 < rad x ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hxt
  
  have hEta : ∀ (h : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → ∀ ξ0 : Cyl, ξ0.2.2.1 < 1 → ∃ N ∈ nhds ξ0, ∃ Γ : Finset Lab,
      ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ N → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) → γ ∈ Γ := by
    intro h hS ξ0 hξ0
    have hLc : ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ContinuousAt (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) ξ := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hτ : 0 < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 := by linarith
      have hqpos : 0 < qC h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).1
      have hqcont : ContinuousAt (qC h) ξ := by
        have hU : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
        have hp : ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
          ⟨trivial, hτ⟩
        have hg : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) :=
          hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)
        have hk : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) ξ := by fun_prop
        have he : qC h = (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘
            (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
          funext η; rfl
        rw [he]
        exact ContinuousAt.comp hg hk
      exact hqcont.logb hqpos.ne'
    have hwin : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (γ : Lab), ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) →
        |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) + (γ.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartR h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartZ h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartT h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
      intro ξ γ hξ hγ
      have s1 : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ → 1 < |φ ξ / μ - (j : ℝ)| →
          ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 := by
        intro μ j φ hφ h1
        have hψ : ContinuousAt (fun η => |φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)|) ξ :=
          ((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs
        have hev := (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : Cyl => (1:ℝ)) ξ).eventually_lt hψ h1
        filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
        have hsq : 1 < (φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)) ^ 2 := (one_lt_sq_iff_one_lt_abs _).mpr hη
        unfold sqPart bumpR
        rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), zero_div]
      have key : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ →
          (∀ η, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 → etaL h γ η = 0) → |φ ξ / μ - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
        intro μ j φ hφ himp
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have hev := s1 μ j φ hφ hc
        apply (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mpr _) hγ
        filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
        exact himp η hη
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have := key 1 (-(γ.1:ℤ)) (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) (hLc ξ hξ)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul])
        simpa [div_one, sub_neg_eq_add] using this
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.1 (chartR h γ.1) (by unfold chartR; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.1 (chartZ h γ.1) (by unfold chartZ; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.2 (chartT h γ.1) (by unfold chartT; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
    obtain ⟨L0, hL0⟩ : ∃ L0 : ℝ, L0 = Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hfin : (⋃ n ∈ Set.Iic ⌊2 - L0⌋₊, ({n} : Set ℕ) ×ˢ
        ((Set.Icc ⌈chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ⌈chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ⌈chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋) ×ˢ
          (Set.univ : Set Bool))).Finite := by
      refine Set.Finite.biUnion (Set.finite_Iic _) (fun n _ => ?_)
      exact (Set.finite_singleton n).prod (((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod
        ((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod (Set.finite_Icc _ _))).prod Set.finite_univ)
    have hI : ∀ (x c : ℝ) (j : ℤ), |x - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 → |x - c| < 1 → j ∈ Set.Icc ⌈c - 2⌉ ⌊c + 2⌋ := by
      intro x c j hj hc
      rw [abs_le] at hj
      rw [abs_lt] at hc
      exact ⟨Int.ceil_le.mpr (by linarith [hj.2, hc.1]), Int.le_floor.mpr (by linarith [hj.1, hc.2])⟩
    have hcR : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartR h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartR; fun_prop
    have hcZ : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartZ h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartZ; fun_prop
    have hcT : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartT h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartT; fun_prop
    have hch : ∀ (φ : Cyl → ℝ) (μ : ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ0 →
        ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, |φ ξ / μ - φ ξ0 / μ| < 1 := by
      intro φ μ hφ
      exact (((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs).eventually_lt continuousAt_const
        (by simp)
    have e1 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 :=
      (show ContinuousAt (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.2.2.1) ξ0 by fun_prop).eventually_lt
        continuousAt_const hξ0
    have e2 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) - L0| < 1 :=
      (((hLc ξ0 hξ0).sub continuousAt_const).abs).eventually_lt continuousAt_const
        (by simp [hL0])
    have e3 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊2 - L0⌋₊ + 1),
        |chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 := by
      rw [Filter.eventually_all_finset]
      intro n _
      exact (hch _ _ (hcR n)).and ((hch _ _ (hcZ n)).and (hch _ _ (hcT n)))
    refine ⟨{ξ | ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) - L0| < 1 ∧
        ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊2 - L0⌋₊ + 1),
        |chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1}, ?_,
      hfin.toFinset, ?_⟩
    · filter_upwards [e1, e2, e3] with ξ h1 h2 h3
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    rintro ⟨n, ⟨a, b, c⟩, σ⟩ ξ ⟨ht, hL, hC⟩ hγ
    obtain ⟨w0, wR, wZ, wT⟩ := hwin ξ _ ht hγ
    simp only at w0 wR wZ wT
    rw [abs_le] at w0
    rw [abs_lt] at hL
    have hn : n ≤ ⌊2 - L0⌋₊ := Nat.le_floor (by linarith [w0.2, hL.1])
    obtain ⟨cR, cZ, cT⟩ := hC n (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn))
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨n, hn, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨rfl, ⟨hI _ _ _ wR cR, hI _ _ _ wZ cZ, hI _ _ _ wT cT⟩, trivial⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN, Γ, hΓ⟩ := hEta B.h hok.1 (ptOf x t Y) hxt'.2.1
  obtain ⟨⟨HA, -, hHA⟩, -, -, hSA, -⟩ := hAw
  obtain ⟨⟨Hp, -, hHp⟩, -, -, hSp, -⟩ := hpw
  
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  
  have hoff : ∀ η ∈ N, η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), (γ ∉ Γ ∨ m ∉ HA ∪ Hp) →
      (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η = 0 ∧ (primState5 B G).pw γ m η = 0 := by
    intro η hηN hηD γ m hγm
    constructor
    · by_contra hne
      rcases hγm with hγ | hm
      · exact hγ (hΓ γ η hηN (hSA γ m η hηD hne).2.1)
      · exact hne (congrFun (hHA γ m (fun h => hm (Finset.mem_union_left _ h))) η)
    · by_contra hne
      rcases hγm with hγ | hm
      · exact hγ (hΓ γ η hηN (hSp γ m η hηD hne).2.1)
      · exact hne (congrFun (hHp γ m (fun h => hm (Finset.mem_union_right _ h))) η)
  
  have hsum : ∀ (F : Lab → ℤ → ℂ), (∀ γ m, (γ ∉ Γ ∨ m ∉ HA ∪ Hp) → F γ m = 0) →
      ∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, F γ m = ∑ k ∈ Γ ×ˢ (HA ∪ Hp), F k.1 k.2 := by
    intro F hF
    rw [Finset.sum_product]
    show _ = ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ HA ∪ Hp, F γ m
    have hin : ∀ γ, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, F γ m = ∑ m ∈ HA ∪ Hp, F γ m := by
      intro γ
      apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
      intro m hm
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hm
      by_contra h
      exact hm (hF γ m (Or.inr (by simpa using h)))
    simp_rw [hin]
    apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
    intro γ hγ
    rw [Function.mem_support] at hγ
    by_contra h
    exact hγ (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun m _ => hF γ m (Or.inl (by simpa using h))))
  have hphase : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (θ : ℝ) (η : Cyl), ephase5 B G γ m θ η =
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) := by
    intro γ m θ η
    simp only [ephase5]
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have key : ∀ (q : ℝ) (A E X : ℂ), q * (A * (E * X)).re = ((q : ℂ) * (E * A) * X).re := by
    intro q A E X
    rw [show (q : ℂ) * (E * A) * X = (q : ℂ) * (A * (E * X)) by ring, Complex.re_ofReal_mul]
  have hcyl_sum : ∀ (y : ℝ³) {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      cyl2cart y (∑ j ∈ s, v j) = ∑ j ∈ s, cyl2cart y (v j) := by
    intro y ι s v
    let L : (Fin 3 → ℝ) →+ ℝ³ := AddMonoidHom.mk' (cyl2cart y) (fun c d => by
      simp only [cyl2cart, Pi.add_apply, add_smul]; abel)
    exact map_sum L v s
  
  have hexpand : ∀ (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), corrOn B l0 y s →
      (∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), (γ ∉ Γ ∨ m ∉ HA ∪ Hp) →
        (primState5 B G).Aw γ m (ptOf y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')) = 0 ∧
        (primState5 B G).pw γ m (ptOf y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')) = 0) →
      evOff B.h (pwrA5 B G l0) Y' y s = ∑ k ∈ Γ ×ˢ (HA ∪ Hp),
          mvec5 B.h (k.2 * pint5 B G k.1) (cofA5 B G k.1 k.2) Y' y s ∧
      evOff B.h (pwrP5 B G l0) Y' y s = ∑ k ∈ Γ ×ˢ (HA ∪ Hp),
          msc5 B.h (k.2 * pint5 B G k.1) (cofP5 B G k.1 k.2) Y' y s := by
    intro y s hc hz
    have hscale : ∀ (c : ℝ) (v : Fin 3 → ℝ), c • cyl2cart y v = cyl2cart y (fun i => c * v i) := by
      intro c v
      simp only [cyl2cart, smul_add, mul_smul]
    constructor
    · simp only [evOff, pwrA5, if_pos hc]
      rw [hscale]
      trans cyl2cart y (∑ k ∈ Γ ×ˢ (HA ∪ Hp), fun i =>
        (cofA5 B G k.1 k.2 (ptOf y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')) i *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((k.2 * pint5 B G k.1 : ℤ) : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re)
      · congr 1
        funext i
        simp only [waveV5, Finset.sum_apply]
        rw [hsum (fun γ m => (primState5 B G).Aw γ m (ptOf y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')) i *
            ephase5 B G γ m (thetaOf y) (ptOf y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')))
          (fun γ m h => by simp only [(hz γ m h).1, Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul]),
          Complex.re_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
        try dsimp only
        rw [hphase]
        simp only [cofA5, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        exact key _ _ _ _
      · rw [hcyl_sum]
        rfl
    · simp only [evOff, pwrP5, if_pos hc, waveS5, msc5]
      rw [hsum (fun γ m => (primState5 B G).pw γ m (ptOf y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')) *
          ephase5 B G γ m (thetaOf y) (ptOf y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')))
        (fun γ m h => by simp only [(hz γ m h).2, zero_mul]),
        Complex.re_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      try dsimp only
      rw [hphase]
      simp only [cofP5]
      exact key _ _ _ _
  
  have hZ : ∀ (W : Set Cyl) (f : Cyl → ℂ), IsOpen W → (∀ η ∈ W, f η = 0) →
      ∀ η ∈ W, fderiv ℝ f η = 0 := by
    intro W f hW hf η hη
    have hev : f =ᶠ[nhds η] fun _ => (0:ℂ) := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hη) hf
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    exact fderiv_const_apply _
  have hdR : ∀ (W : Set Cyl) (f : Cyl → ℂ), IsOpen W → (∀ η ∈ W, f η = 0) →
      ∀ η ∈ W, dR B.h f η = 0 := by
    intro W f hW hf η hη
    show fderiv ℝ f η _ = 0
    rw [hZ W f hW hf η hη, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
  have hdZ : ∀ (W : Set Cyl) (f : Cyl → ℂ), IsOpen W → (∀ η ∈ W, f η = 0) →
      ∀ η ∈ W, dZ f η = 0 := by
    intro W f hW hf η hη
    show fderiv ℝ f η _ = 0
    rw [hZ W f hW hf η hη, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
  have hdT : ∀ (W : Set Cyl) (f : Cyl → ℂ), IsOpen W → (∀ η ∈ W, f η = 0) →
      ∀ η ∈ W, dT f η = 0 := by
    intro W f hW hf η hη
    show fderiv ℝ f η _ = 0
    rw [hZ W f hW hf η hη, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
  have hcurl0 : ∀ (W : Set Cyl) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), IsOpen W → (∀ η ∈ W, c η = 0) →
      ∀ η ∈ W, mcurlC B.h n c η = 0 := by
    intro W n c hW hc η hη
    have hci : ∀ i, ∀ η' ∈ W, (fun η'' => c η'' i) η' = 0 := fun i η' hη' => by simp [hc η' hη']
    have h1 : ∀ i, c η i = 0 := fun i => by simp [hc η hη]

  have hres0 : ∀ (W : Set Cyl) (n : ℤ) (a : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (p : Cyl → ℂ) (ξ0 : Cyl), IsOpen W →

    intro W n a p ξ0 hW hξ0 ha hp

    have h5 : ∀ i, dR B.h (dR B.h (fun η'' => a η'' i)) ξ0 = 0 := fun i =>
      hdR W (dR B.h (fun η'' => a η'' i)) hW (fun η' hη' => hdR W (fun η'' => a η'' i) hW (hai i) η' hη') ξ0 hξ0
    have h6 : ∀ i, dZ (dZ (fun η'' => a η'' i)) ξ0 = 0 := fun i =>
      hdZ W (dZ (fun η'' => a η'' i)) hW (fun η' hη' => hdZ W (fun η'' => a η'' i) hW (hai i) η' hη') ξ0 hξ0
    have h7 : p ξ0 = 0 := hp ξ0 hξ0

    have hl : ∀ i, mlapC B.h n (fun η'' => a η'' i) ξ0 = 0 := by

    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [mresC, h1, h2, h3, h4, hl, h7, h8, h9]
  have hlin0 : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), (γ ∉ Γ ∨ m ∉ HA ∪ Hp) → linC5 B G γ m (ptOf x t Y) = 0 := by

        mresC B (m * pint5 B G γ) (mcurlC B.h (m * pint5 B G γ) (cofA5 B G γ m)) (cofP5 B G γ m)

    unfold rad
    fun_prop
  have hOopen : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2 ∧

    have h4 : ptOf w0.1 w0.2 (Yph B.h (rad w0.1) w0.2 + Y') ∈ interior N := hw0.2

    have e2 : ∀ᶠ w in nhds w0, w.2 < 1 :=

      have h2' : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) w0 := by fun_prop
      exact ContinuousAt.comp (x := w0) (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2)
        (f := fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) h1' h2'
    have e3 : ∀ᶠ w in nhds w0, simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) < qsOf l0 :=

    have hPc : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + Y')) w0 := by

signature.name: cib_band_bounds5
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (l : ℕ), 1 ≤ l → 1 / (Tgc * (l:ℝ) ^ 2) < cib h l ∧ cib h l ≤ 1 / (l:ℝ) ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h l hl
  have hL : (1:ℝ) ≤ (l:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hl
  have hL2 : (0:ℝ) < (l:ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hT1 : (1:ℝ) < Tgc := by
    unfold Tgc
    have := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
    linarith
  have hT0 : (0:ℝ) < Tgc := by linarith
  have hy0 : (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
    div_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _) hL2
  have hQ0 : 0 < Qb l := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _
  have hQp : 0 < Qb l ^ (1 + h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ0 _
  have hfl : ((bandIdx h l : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤
      Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2)) := Int.floor_le _
  have hfl2 : Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2)) - 1 <
      ((bandIdx h l : ℤ) : ℝ) := Int.sub_one_lt_floor _
  have hz : Tgc ^ (bandIdx h l) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_intCast]
    calc Tgc ^ ((bandIdx h l : ℤ) : ℝ)
        ≤ Tgc ^ (Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2))) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hT1.le hfl
      _ = (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) := Real.rpow_logb hT0 hT1.ne' hy0
  have hz2 : (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) / Tgc < Tgc ^ (bandIdx h l) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_intCast]
    calc (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) / Tgc
        = Tgc ^ (Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2)) - 1) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_sub hT0, Real.rpow_one, Real.rpow_logb hT0 hT1.ne' hy0]
      _ < Tgc ^ ((bandIdx h l : ℤ) : ℝ) := Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt hT1 hfl2
  have hQe : Qb l ^ (1 + h) * (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) = 1 := by
    unfold Qb
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num), ← Real.rpow_add two_pos]
    have e : -(l:ℝ) * (1 + h) + (1 + h) * (l:ℝ) = 0 := by ring
    rw [e, Real.rpow_zero]
  have hyL : (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) * (l:ℝ) ^ 2 =
      (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hL2.ne'
  have sB : cib h l ≤ 1 / (l:ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hL2]
    unfold cib
    calc Tgc ^ (bandIdx h l) * Qb l ^ (1 + h) * (l:ℝ) ^ 2
        ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) * Qb l ^ (1 + h) * (l:ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hz hQp.le
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this hL2.le
      _ = ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) * (l:ℝ) ^ 2) * Qb l ^ (1 + h) := by ring
      _ = 1 := by rw [hyL, mul_comm]; exact hQe
  have sA : 1 / (Tgc * (l:ℝ) ^ 2) < cib h l := by
    unfold cib
    have e1 : 1 / (Tgc * (l:ℝ) ^ 2) =
        (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) / Tgc * Qb l ^ (1 + h) := by
      generalize (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) = P at hQe ⊢
      generalize Qb l ^ (1 + h) = Q at hQe ⊢
      rw [div_div, div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_comm P Q, hQe]
      ring
    rw [e1]
    exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hz2 hQp
  exact ⟨sA, sB⟩

        (2 * B.Xb + 1) * ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (i.choose a : ℝ) * |Ci (i - a)| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hXCE : ∀ i : ℕ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (XC B.h) i ξ ≤ E i := by
      intro i ξ hξ hX
      rw [hEdef]
      exact hXCnb i ξ hξ hX
    
    have hφb : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc B.Xa B.Xb,

    have hchain : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ (m : ℕ) (A D : ℝ),

      have hχmaps : Set.MapsTo χ O (Set.Ioi 0) := by
        intro v hv

        rw [hχdef]; show XC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ 0) = _; rw [map_zero, add_zero]
      have hDχ : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i χ O 0‖ ≤ D ^ i := by
        intro i h1 h2

          key (XC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hDo hXCs hξ i]
        exact hD i h1 h2
      have hAχ : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i φ (Set.Ioi 0) (χ 0)‖ ≤ A := by
        intro i hi; rw [hχ0]; exact hA i hi
      have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hφ hχ (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
        (uniqueDiffOn_Ioi 0) hO.uniqueDiffOn hχmaps h0O (C := A) (D := D) hAχ hDχ
      have hNBeq : NB B.h (fun η => φ (XC B.h η)) m ξ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (φ ∘ χ) O 0‖ := by
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hO h0O, hχdef]
        unfold NB
        exact congrArg norm
          (key (fun η => φ (XC B.h η)) (DomC B.h qs) ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hDo hgs hξ m).symm
      rw [hNBeq]
      exact hFdB
    refine ⟨hqcs.mul hgs, fun k => ?_⟩
    choose Cq hCq using hqpow c
    obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |M i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |E i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by
      have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1)) => abs_nonneg (E i))
      rw [hDdef]; linarith
    have hMA : ∀ i ≤ k, M i ≤ A := by
      intro i hi
      have h2 : |M i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |M j| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |M j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
      rw [hAdef]; exact (le_abs_self _).trans h2
    have hED : ∀ i ≤ k, E i ≤ D := by
      intro i hi
      have h2 : |E i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |E j| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |E j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
      have h3 := le_abs_self (E i)
      rw [hDdef]; linarith
    refine ⟨∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
      (k.choose j : ℝ) * |Cq j| * (((k - j).factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ (k - j)), ?_⟩
    intro ξ hξ h1 h2
    have hq := hqpos ξ hξ
    have hpc : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ c := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    have hφm : ∀ m ≤ k, NB B.h (fun η => φ (XC B.h η)) m ξ ≤ (m.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ m := by
      intro m hm
      refine hchain ξ hξ m A D
        (fun i hi => (hM i (XC B.h ξ) ⟨h1.le, h2.le⟩).trans (hMA i (hi.trans hm)))
        (fun i hi1 hi2 => ?_)
      calc NB B.h (XC B.h) i ξ ≤ E i := hXCE i ξ hξ h2
        _ ≤ D := hED i (hi2.trans hm)
        _ ≤ D ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
    have hprod := hmul (DomC B.h qs) (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c)
      (fun η => φ (XC B.h η)) hDo hqcs hgs ξ hξ k
    refine hprod.trans ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ?_)
    have e1 : NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c) j ξ ≤ |Cq j| * qC B.h ξ ^ c :=
      (hCq j ξ hξ).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hpc)
    have e2 := hφm (k - j) (Nat.sub_le k j)
    calc (k.choose j : ℝ) * NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c) j ξ *
          NB B.h (fun η => φ (XC B.h η)) (k - j) ξ
        ≤ (k.choose j : ℝ) * (|Cq j| * qC B.h ξ ^ c) *
            (((k - j).factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ (k - j)) :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) e2 (norm_nonneg _)
            (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hpc))
      _ = (k.choose j : ℝ) * |Cq j| * (((k - j).factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ (k - j)) *
            qC B.h ξ ^ c := by ring
  
  
  have hh : 0 < B.h := hok.2.1.1
  have hh0 : B.h ≠ 0 := hh.ne'
  have hlin : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun X : ℝ => 2 * X) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id).contDiffOn
  have hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun X : ℝ => (2 * X) ^ (e / 2)) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    hlin.rpow_const_of_ne (fun X (hX : (0:ℝ) < X) => by positivity)
  obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ M : Cyl → ℝ,
      M = fun η => qC B.h η ^ (c + e / 2) * (2 * XC B.h η) ^ (e / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hMs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ M (DomC B.h qs) := by
    rw [hMdef]; exact (hprof _ (c + e / 2) hφ).1
  have hMb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ CM : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
      NB B.h M k ξ ≤ CM * qC B.h ξ ^ (c + e / 2) := by
    rw [hMdef]; exact (hprof _ (c + e / 2) hφ).2
  have heq : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs, qC B.h η ^ c * η.1 ^ e * f η = M η * f η := by
    intro η hη
    have hη' : 0 < η.1 ∧ η.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h η < qs := hη
    have hr : 0 < η.1 := hη'.1
    have hq : 0 < qC B.h η := hqpos η hη
    have hq0 : qC B.h η ≠ 0 := hq.ne'
    have h2X : 2 * XC B.h η = η.1 ^ 2 / qC B.h η := by
      show 2 * (η.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h η)) = η.1 ^ 2 / qC B.h η
      first
        | (field_simp; ring)
        | field_simp
    have hre : (η.1 ^ 2) ^ (e / 2) = η.1 ^ e := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hr.le]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    have hqe : qC B.h η ^ (c + e / 2) = qC B.h η ^ c * qC B.h η ^ (e / 2) :=
      Real.rpow_add hq c (e / 2)
    have hqe0 : qC B.h η ^ (e / 2) ≠ 0 := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _).ne'
    have hcancel : qC B.h η ^ (e / 2) * (η.1 ^ e / qC B.h η ^ (e / 2)) = η.1 ^ e := by

    rw [hMdef]
    show qC B.h η ^ c * η.1 ^ e * f η = qC B.h η ^ (c + e / 2) * (2 * XC B.h η) ^ (e / 2) * f η
    rw [h2X, Real.div_rpow (sq_nonneg _) hq.le, hre, hqe]
    calc qC B.h η ^ c * η.1 ^ e * f η
        = qC B.h η ^ c * (qC B.h η ^ (e / 2) * (η.1 ^ e / qC B.h η ^ (e / 2))) * f η := by
          rw [hcancel]
      _ = qC B.h η ^ c * qC B.h η ^ (e / 2) * (η.1 ^ e / qC B.h η ^ (e / 2)) * f η := by ring
  obtain ⟨F1, F2, F3, F4⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨(hMs.mul F1).congr heq, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ξ hξ a ha
    show qC B.h (shY ξ a) ^ c * (shY ξ a).1 ^ e * f (shY ξ a) = qC B.h ξ ^ c * ξ.1 ^ e * f ξ
    rw [F2 ξ hξ a ha]
    rfl
  · intro ξ hξ hX
    show qC B.h ξ ^ c * ξ.1 ^ e * f ξ = 0
    rw [F3 ξ hξ hX, mul_zero]
  · intro k
    choose CM hCM using hMb
    choose C b d hC using F4
    obtain ⟨Cs, hCs⟩ : ∃ Cs : ℝ, Cs = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |C j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨bs, hbs⟩ : ∃ bs : ℝ, bs = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |b j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨ds, hds⟩ : ∃ ds : ℝ, ds = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |d j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Ms, hMs'⟩ : ∃ Ms : ℝ, Ms = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |CM j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hCs0 : 0 ≤ Cs := by rw [hCs]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have hMs0 : 0 ≤ Ms := by rw [hMs']; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have mem : ∀ j, j ≤ k → j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) :=
      fun j hj => Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj)
    have hCj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → C j ≤ Cs := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hCs]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |C j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    have hbj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → b j ≤ bs := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hbs]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |b j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    have hdj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → d j ≤ ds := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hds]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |d j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    have hMj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → CM j ≤ Ms := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hMs']; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |CM j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    refine ⟨2 ^ k * Ms * Cs, bs, ds, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
    have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
    have hqc : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (c + e / 2) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    have hS1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
      unfold SC
      exact one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))])
    have hE : 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) := by
      unfold edgeWeight
      split_ifs
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      · exact le_rfl
    have hδ0 : 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) := by
      have hX : 0 < XC B.h ξ := lt_trans hXa hX1
      unfold edgeDist
      exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX1))
        (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr hX2)))
    have hδ1 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
    have hqa : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    have p3 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bs := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ, W = qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bs *
        edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hFb : ∀ j, j ≤ k → NB B.h f j ξ ≤ Cs * W := by
      intro j hj
      have h1 := hC j ξ hξ hX1 hX2
      have hb : SC B.h ξ ^ (b j) ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bs := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 (hbj j hj)
      have hd : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d j) ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hδ0 hδ1 (neg_le_neg (hdj j hj))
      have p1 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ (b j) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have p2 : 0 ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d j) := Real.rpow_nonneg hδ0.le _
      calc NB B.h f j ξ
          ≤ C j * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ (b j) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
              edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d j) := h1
        _ = C j * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ (b j) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
              edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d j)) := by ring
        _ ≤ Cs * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ (b j) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
              edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d j)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hCj j hj)

      rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]
      congr 1
      first

    have hev : (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c * η.1 ^ e * f η) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] (fun η => M η * f η) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hDo.mem_nhds hξ) heq
    have hNBeq : NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c * η.1 ^ e * f η) k ξ =
        NB B.h (fun η => M η * f η) k ξ := by
      unfold NB
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
    have hl := hmul (DomC B.h qs) M f hDo hMs F1 ξ hξ k
    calc NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c * η.1 ^ e * f η) k ξ
        = NB B.h (fun η => M η * f η) k ξ := hNBeq
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h M i ξ * NB B.h f (k - i) ξ := hl
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * (Ms * qC B.h ξ ^ (c + e / 2)) * (Cs * W) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          have hMi : NB B.h M i ξ ≤ Ms * qC B.h ξ ^ (c + e / 2) :=
            (hCM i ξ hξ hX1 hX2).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hMj i hik) hqc)

            (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hMs0 hqc))
      _ = 2 ^ k * (Ms * qC B.h ξ ^ (c + e / 2)) * (Cs * W) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul]
          have hs2 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) = 2 ^ k := by
            exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose k
          rw [hs2]
      _ = 2 ^ k * Ms * Cs * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α + (c + e / 2) / B.h)) * SC B.h ξ ^ bs *
            edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) := by
          rw [hexp, hW]; ring
