    have mem : ∀ j, j ≤ k → j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) :=
      fun j hj => Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj)
    have hCj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → Cf j ≤ Cs := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hCs]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cf j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    have hbj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → bf j ≤ bs := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hbs]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |bf j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    have hdj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → df j ≤ ds := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hds]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |df j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    refine ⟨Cs, bs, ds, hCs0, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 j hj => ?_⟩
    have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
    have hS1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
      unfold SC
      exact one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))])
    have hE : 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) := by
      unfold edgeWeight
      split_ifs
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      · exact le_rfl
    have hδ0 : 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) := by
      have hX : 0 < XC B.h ξ := lt_trans hXa hX1
      unfold edgeDist
      exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX1))
        (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr hX2)))
    have hδ1 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
    have hqa : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    have p3 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bs := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    have h1 := hCf j ξ hξ hX1 hX2
    have hb : SC B.h ξ ^ (bf j) ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bs := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 (hbj j hj)
    have hd : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df j) ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hδ0 hδ1 (neg_le_neg (hdj j hj))
    have p1 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ (bf j) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    have p2 : 0 ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df j) := Real.rpow_nonneg hδ0.le _
    calc NB B.h (nrm B e f) j ξ
        ≤ Cf j * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ (bf j) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
            edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df j) := h1
      _ = Cf j * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ (bf j) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
            edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df j)) := by ring
      _ ≤ Cs * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ (bf j) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
            edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df j)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hCj j hj)
            (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hqa p1) hE) p2)
      _ ≤ _ := by
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hCs0
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hqa) hE) hd p2
            (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hqa p3) hE)
  have hsh : ∀ (η : Cyl) (a : ℝ × ℝ), η + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), a) = shY η a := by
    intro η a
    rcases η with ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4⟩
    simp [shY]
  
  have hG1 : InM B qs (α - 1) (fun η => qC B.h η * dT (nrm B e f) η) := by
    refine ⟨hqCs.mul hdTF, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro ξ hξ a ha
      have hev : (fun x => nrm B e f (x + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), a))) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] nrm B e f := by
        filter_upwards [hDopen.mem_nhds hξ, hdeck ξ hξ a ha] with η hη hdη
        show nrm B e f (η + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), a)) = nrm B e f η
        rw [hsh η a]
        exact hF.2.1 η hη a hdη
      have hd : dT (nrm B e f) (shY ξ a) = dT (nrm B e f) ξ := by
        unfold dT
        rw [← hsh ξ a, ← fderiv_comp_add_right, hev.fderiv_eq]
      show qC B.h (shY ξ a) * dT (nrm B e f) (shY ξ a) = qC B.h ξ * dT (nrm B e f) ξ
      rw [hd]
      rfl
    · intro ξ hξ hX
      have h1 := shell_deriv_vanish_v5 B qs (nrm B e f) hok hFs hF.2.2.1 1 ξ hξ hX
      have e2 : dT (nrm B e f) ξ = 0 := by
        have := iteratedFDeriv_one_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := nrm B e f) (x := ξ)
          (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0, 0, 1, vtv) : Cyl))
        rw [h1] at this
        exact this.symm
      show qC B.h ξ * dT (nrm B e f) ξ = 0
      rw [e2, mul_zero]
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨Cs, bs, ds, hCs0, hFb⟩ := hmerge (k + 1)
      obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cb i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨K * Cs, bs, ds, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
      have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
      obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ, W = qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bs *
          edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, R = qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α - 1)) * SC B.h ξ ^ bs *
          edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hFW : ∀ j, j ≤ k + 1 → NB B.h (nrm B e f) j ξ ≤ Cs * W := fun j hj => by
        rw [hW]; exact hFb ξ hξ hX1 hX2 j hj
      have hexp : qC B.h ξ * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * W = R := by
        have r : qC B.h ξ * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) =
            qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α - 1)) := by
          calc qC B.h ξ * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α)
              = qC B.h ξ ^ (1:ℝ) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) := by
                rw [Real.rpow_one]
            _ = qC B.h ξ ^ ((1:ℝ) + (-(1 + B.h)) + B.h * α) := by
                rw [Real.rpow_add hq, Real.rpow_add hq]
            _ = qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α - 1)) := by congr 1; ring
        rw [hW, hR, ← r]
        ring
      have hl := leib ξ (DomC B.h qs) k hDopen hξ (qC B.h) (dT (nrm B e f))
        (hqCs.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)) (hdTF.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      calc NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η * dT (nrm B e f) η) k ξ
          ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) *
              NB B.h (qC B.h) i ξ * NB B.h (dT (nrm B e f)) (k - i) ξ := hl
        _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cb i| * Cs * R := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro i hi
            have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
            have b1 : NB B.h (qC B.h) i ξ ≤ |Cb i| * qC B.h ξ := hqb i ξ hξ
            have b2 : NB B.h (dT (nrm B e f)) (k - i) ξ ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * (Cs * W) :=
              (hdTle _ hFs ξ hξ (k - i)).trans
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hFW (k - i + 1) (by omega)) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _))
            calc (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h (qC B.h) i ξ * NB B.h (dT (nrm B e f)) (k - i) ξ
                ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * (|Cb i| * qC B.h ξ) * (qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * (Cs * W)) :=
                  mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) b2 (norm_nonneg _)
                    (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hq.le))
              _ = (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cb i| * Cs * (qC B.h ξ * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * W) := by ring
              _ = (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cb i| * Cs * R := by rw [hexp]
        _ = K * Cs * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α - 1)) * SC B.h ξ ^ bs *
              edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← hK, hR]
            ring
  
  have hG2 : InM B qs α (fun η => dTs5 (qC B.h) η * nrm B e f η) := by
    refine ⟨hdTq.mul hFs, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro ξ hξ a ha
      have hqv : (fun x => qC B.h (x + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), a))) = qC B.h := by
        funext x
        simp [qC]
      have hd : dTs5 (qC B.h) (shY ξ a) = dTs5 (qC B.h) ξ := by
        unfold dTs5
        rw [← hsh ξ a, ← fderiv_comp_add_right, hqv]
      show dTs5 (qC B.h) (shY ξ a) * nrm B e f (shY ξ a) = dTs5 (qC B.h) ξ * nrm B e f ξ
      rw [hd, hF.2.1 ξ hξ a ha]
    · intro ξ hξ hX
      show dTs5 (qC B.h) ξ * nrm B e f ξ = 0
      rw [hF.2.2.1 ξ hξ hX, mul_zero]
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨Cs, bs, ds, hCs0, hFb⟩ := hmerge k
      obtain ⟨Ks, hKs⟩ : ∃ Ks : ℝ, Ks = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cb (i + 1)| :=
        ⟨_, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨Ks * Cs, bs, ds, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ, W = qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bs *
          edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hFW : ∀ j, j ≤ k → NB B.h (nrm B e f) j ξ ≤ Cs * W := fun j hj => by
        rw [hW]; exact hFb ξ hξ hX1 hX2 j hj
      have hl := leib ξ (DomC B.h qs) k hDopen hξ (dTs5 (qC B.h)) (nrm B e f)
        (hdTq.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)) (hFs.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      calc NB B.h (fun η => dTs5 (qC B.h) η * nrm B e f η) k ξ
          ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) *
              NB B.h (dTs5 (qC B.h)) i ξ * NB B.h (nrm B e f) (k - i) ξ := hl
        _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Cb (i + 1)| * (Cs * W) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro i _
            exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hwt i ξ hξ) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
              (hFW _ (Nat.sub_le k i)) (norm_nonneg _)
              (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _))
        _ = Ks * Cs * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bs *
              edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← hKs, hW]
            ring
  
  refine hMc (α - 1) α (α - 1) 1 (-e) _ _ _ hG1 hG2 le_rfl (by linarith) ?_
  intro ξ hξ
  have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
  have hN : DomC B.h qs ∈ nhds ξ := hDopen.mem_nhds hξ
  have hqd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (qC B.h) ξ := (hqCs.contDiffAt hN).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ f ξ := (hfs.contDiffAt hN).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hpow : HasFDerivAt (fun η => qC B.h η ^ e)
      ((e * qC B.h ξ ^ (e - 1)) • fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) ξ) ξ :=
    hqd.hasFDerivAt.rpow_const (Or.inl hq.ne')
  have hprod := hpow.mul hfd.hasFDerivAt
  have hfd' : fderiv ℝ (nrm B e f) ξ =
      (qC B.h ξ ^ e) • fderiv ℝ f ξ + f ξ • ((e * qC B.h ξ ^ (e - 1)) • fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) ξ) :=
    hprod.fderiv
  have hdTF' : dT (nrm B e f) ξ =
      qC B.h ξ ^ e * dT f ξ + f ξ * ((e * qC B.h ξ ^ (e - 1)) * dT (qC B.h) ξ) := by
    unfold dT
    rw [hfd']
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hqT ξ hξ] at hdTF'
  have r1 : qC B.h ξ ^ (e + 1) = qC B.h ξ * qC B.h ξ ^ e := by
    rw [Real.rpow_add hq, Real.rpow_one]
    ring
  have r2 : qC B.h ξ * qC B.h ξ ^ (e - 1) = qC B.h ξ ^ e := by
    calc qC B.h ξ * qC B.h ξ ^ (e - 1) = qC B.h ξ ^ (1:ℝ) * qC B.h ξ ^ (e - 1) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_one]
      _ = qC B.h ξ ^ ((1:ℝ) + (e - 1)) := (Real.rpow_add hq _ _).symm
      _ = qC B.h ξ ^ e := by congr 1; ring
  show qC B.h ξ ^ (e + 1) * dT f ξ =
    1 * (qC B.h ξ * dT (nrm B e f) ξ) + (-e) * (dTs5 (qC B.h) ξ * (qC B.h ξ ^ e * f ξ))
  rw [hdTF']
  linear_combination (dT f ξ) * r1 - (e * f ξ * dTs5 (qC B.h) ξ) * r2

subgoal_signatures.name: mom_class_algebra_v4
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 →
    (∀ (α β γ c d : ℝ) (f g k : Cyl → ℝ), InM B qs α f → InM B qs β g → γ ≤ α → γ ≤ β →
      (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, k ξ = c * f ξ + d * g ξ) → InM B qs γ k) ∧
    (∀ (α β γ c d : ℝ) (F G K : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), InS B qs α F → InS B qs β G → γ ≤ α → γ ≤ β →
      (∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qs → K w = c * F w + d * G w) →

informal_problem.statement: ∀ {E F G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (g : F → G) (f : E → F) (x0 : E) (Λ : E →L[ℝ] E) (n : ℕ) (C D : ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x0 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g (f x0) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g (f x0)‖ ≤ C) → (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → sJet5 f x0 Λ i ≤ D ^ i) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (g ∘ f) x0 ∧ sJet5 (g ∘ f) x0 Λ n ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) * C * D ^ n

proof.tactics:
by
  intro E F G _ _ _ _ _ _ g f x0 Λ n C D hf hg hC hD
  refine ⟨hg.comp x0 hf, ?_⟩
  
  have hgn : ContDiffAt ℝ n g (f x0) := hg.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hgv⟩ := hgn.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
  obtain ⟨V, hVv, hV, hfxV⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hv
  have hgV : ContDiffOn ℝ n g V := hgv.mono hVv
  
  have hfn : ContDiffAt ℝ n f x0 := hf.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hfu⟩ := hfn.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
  obtain ⟨t, htu, ht, hxt⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hu
  have hft : ContDiffOn ℝ n f t := hfu.mono htu
  obtain ⟨U, hUdef⟩ : ∃ U : Set E, U = t ∩ f ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hU : IsOpen U := by
    rw [hUdef]; exact hft.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage ht hV
  have hxU : x0 ∈ U := by rw [hUdef]; exact ⟨hxt, hfxV⟩
  have hfU : ContDiffOn ℝ n f U := by rw [hUdef]; exact hft.mono Set.inter_subset_left

    intro y hy; rw [hUdef] at hy; exact hy.2

  have key : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F' : E → W) (V' : Set E) (a : E)
      (T : E →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen V' → ContDiffOn ℝ n F' V' → a ∈ V' → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F' (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F' a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro W _ _ F' V' a T hV' hF ha i hi
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set E, s = (fun z : E => a + z) ⁻¹' V' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV'.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : E) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V'; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
    have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : E) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F' (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F' (a + T z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F' (a + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F') i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F' (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F' (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F' (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F' (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F' (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F' a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  
  obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set E, O = (fun z => x0 + Λ z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hO : IsOpen O := by
    rw [hOdef]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add Λ.continuous)
  have h0O : (0 : E) ∈ O := by
    rw [hOdef]; show x0 + Λ 0 ∈ U; rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact hxU
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦdef⟩ : ∃ Φ : E → F, Φ = fun z => f (x0 + Λ z) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ n Φ O := by
    rw [hΦdef]
    exact hfU.comp (contDiff_const.add Λ.contDiff).contDiffOn
      (fun z hz => by rw [hOdef] at hz; exact hz)
  have hΦmaps : Set.MapsTo Φ O V := by
    intro z hz; rw [hΦdef]; rw [hOdef] at hz; exact hmapU _ hz
  have hΦ0 : Φ 0 = f x0 := by
    rw [hΦdef]; show f (x0 + Λ 0) = f x0; rw [map_zero, add_zero]
  have hCw : ∀ j ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j g V (Φ 0)‖ ≤ C := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hΦ0, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hV hfxV]
    exact hC j hj
  have hDw : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j Φ O 0‖ ≤ D ^ j := by
    intro j hj1 hjn
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hO h0O, hΦdef, key f U x0 Λ hU hfU hxU j hjn]
    have h1 : sJet5 f x0 Λ j ≤ D ^ j := hD j hj1 hjn
    unfold sJet5 at h1
    exact h1
  have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hgV hΦ le_rfl
    hV.uniqueDiffOn hO.uniqueDiffOn hΦmaps h0O (C := C) (D := D) hCw hDw
  have hEq : (fun z => (g ∘ f) (x0 + Λ z)) = g ∘ Φ := by
    rw [hΦdef]; rfl
  have hJeq : sJet5 (g ∘ f) x0 Λ n =
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => (g ∘ f) (x0 + Λ z)) 0‖ := by
    have := key (g ∘ f) U x0 Λ hU hgfU hxU n le_rfl
    unfold sJet5
    rw [← this]
  calc sJet5 (g ∘ f) x0 Λ n
      = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (g ∘ Φ) 0‖ := by rw [hJeq, hEq]
    _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ n (g ∘ Φ) O 0‖ := by
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hO h0O]
    _ ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) * C * D ^ n := hFdB

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h p : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → (∀ i : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → simScale h z τ ≤ 1 → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2 ^ p) (z, τ)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => (simScale h z τ ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (simScale h z τ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖ ≤ C * simScale h z τ ^ p) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → qC h ξ ≤ 1 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => simScale h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) ^ p) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → sJet5 (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => simScale h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) ^ p) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (DqS5 h ξ) i ≤ C * qC h ξ ^ p

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h p hS hC k
  choose Cf hCf using hC
  refine ⟨∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cf j|, Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _), ?_⟩
  intro ξ hξ hq1
  have hτ : 0 < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 := by linarith
  have hq0 : 0 < qC h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).1
  set G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun w => simScale h w.1 w.2 ^ p with hGdef
  have hU : IsOpen ((Set.univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
  have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G ((Set.univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) :=
    hS.2.2.2.1.rpow_const_of_ne (fun w hw => ((hS.1 w.1 w.2 hw.2).1).ne')
  set A : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ :=
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))).prod
      (-((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)))) with hAdef
  have hAapp : ∀ s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, A s = (s.2.1, -s.2.2) := fun s => rfl
  have hFeq : (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => simScale h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) ^ p) =
      fun s => G (((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) + A s) := by
    funext s
    rw [hAapp]
    show simScale h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) ^ p = simScale h (0 + s.2.1) (1 + -s.2.2) ^ p
    rw [zero_add, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
  have hw0 : ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) + A (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) = (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) := by
    rw [hAapp]
    exact Prod.ext (show (0:ℝ) + ξ.2.1 = ξ.2.1 by ring)
      (show (1:ℝ) + -ξ.2.2.1 = 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by ring)
  have hw0mem : ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) :=
    ⟨Set.mem_univ _, hτ⟩
  have hGat : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ G (((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) + A (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)) := by
    rw [hw0]; exact hG.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hw0mem)
  have hsm : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s => G (((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) + A s)) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) :=
    hGat.comp (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ((contDiff_const.add A.contDiff).contDiffAt)
  
  have key : ∀ (i : ℕ) (a : ℝ × ℝ) (x0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (V' : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen V' →
      ContDiffOn ℝ i G V' → a + A x0 ∈ V' →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => G (a + A z)) x0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G (a + A x0)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => A) := by
    intro i a x0 V' hV' hF ha
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set (ℝ × ℝ), s = (fun z => a + z) ⁻¹' V' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV'.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑A ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage A.continuous
    have hAs : A x0 ∈ s := by rw [hs_def]; exact ha
    have hxO : x0 ∈ ⇑A ⁻¹' s := hAs
    have hsm' : ContDiffOn ℝ i (fun z => G (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => G (a + A z)) i hO hxO
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right A hsm' hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hAs (i := i) le_rfl
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => G (a + z)) i hs hAs
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := G) i a (A x0)
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => G (a + A z)) x0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => G (a + z)) ∘ ⇑A) (⇑A ⁻¹' s) x0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => G (a + z)) s (A x0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => A) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => G (a + z)) (A x0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => A) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G (a + A x0)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => A) := by rw [e4]
  
  have hpt : ∀ v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, A (DqS5 h ξ v) =
      ((simScale h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
        (simScale h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)) (A v) := by
    intro v
    obtain ⟨v1, v2, v3⟩ := v
    simp only [hAapp, DqS5, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap', Prod.map_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, smul_eq_mul, qC]
    exact Prod.ext rfl (by ring)
  have hAn : ‖A‖ ≤ 1 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound A zero_le_one (fun s => ?_)
    rw [hAapp, one_mul, Prod.norm_def]
    refine max_le ?_ ?_
    · exact (norm_fst_le s.2).trans (norm_snd_le s)
    · show ‖-s.2.2‖ ≤ ‖s‖
      rw [norm_neg]; exact (norm_snd_le s.2).trans (norm_snd_le s)
  rw [hFeq]
  refine ⟨hsm, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  unfold sJet5
  rw [key i ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) _ hU (hG.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    (by rw [hw0]; exact hw0mem), hw0]
  have hfac : ∀ M : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin i => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ,
      (M.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => A)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => DqS5 h ξ) =
        (M.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ =>
          (simScale h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
            (simScale h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => A) := by
    intro M
    ext m
    simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    congr 1
    funext j
    exact hpt (m j)
  have hnorm : ∀ N : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin i => ℝ × ℝ) ℝ,
      ‖N.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => A)‖ ≤ ‖N‖ := by
    intro N
    calc ‖N.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => A)‖ ≤ ‖N‖ * ∏ _j : Fin i, ‖A‖ :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _
      _ = ‖N‖ * ‖A‖ ^ i := by rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      _ ≤ ‖N‖ * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hAn) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖N‖ := mul_one _
  have hqp : 0 ≤ qC h ξ ^ p := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le p
  rw [hfac]
  refine (hnorm _).trans ?_
  refine (hCf i ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ hq1).trans ?_
  calc Cf i * simScale h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) ^ p ≤ |Cf i| * qC h ξ ^ p :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hqp
    _ ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cf j|) * qC h ξ ^ p :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => abs_nonneg (Cf j))
            (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))) hqp

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → (∀ (p : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → qC h ξ ≤ 1 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => simScale h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) ^ p) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → sJet5 (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => simScale h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) ^ p) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (DqS5 h ξ) i ≤ C * qC h ξ ^ p) → ∀ (Xb : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ D : ℝ, 1 ≤ D ∧ ∀ ξ : Cyl, 0 < ξ.1 → ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → qC h ξ ≤ 1 → XC h ξ < Xb → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.1 ^ 2 / (2 * simScale h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2)), s.2.1 * simScale h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) ^ (-(1/2 - h)))) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → sJet5 (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.1 ^ 2 / (2 * simScale h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2)), s.2.1 * simScale h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) ^ (-(1/2 - h)))) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (DqS5 h ξ) i ≤ D ^ i

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h hS H2 Xb k
  
  have key : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → V)
      (a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (T : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)), ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro V _ _ F a T hF i
    have hF' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (a + z)) := hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id)
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right T hF' (0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (i := i)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDeriv ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) 0 := rfl
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  have hf0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => s.1 ^ 2 / 2) := (contDiff_fst.pow 2).div_const 2
  have hf2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => s.2.1) := contDiff_snd.fst
  
  have hfsq : ∀ ξ : Cyl, 0 < qC h ξ → ∀ a : ℕ,
      sJet5 (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => s.1 ^ 2 / 2) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (DqS5 h ξ) a ≤
        ξ.1 ^ 2 + qC h ξ := by
    intro ξ hq a
    obtain ⟨q, hqd⟩ : ∃ q : ℝ, q = qC h ξ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hsd⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s = Real.sqrt q := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hq' : 0 < q := by rw [hqd]; exact hq
    have hs2 : s ^ 2 = q := by rw [hsd]; exact Real.sq_sqrt hq'.le
    obtain ⟨p, hpdef⟩ : ∃ p : ℝ → ℝ, p = fun x => ξ.1 ^ 2 / 2 + ξ.1 * s * x + q / 2 * (x * x) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ p := by
      rw [hpdef]
      exact (contDiff_const.add (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id)).add
        (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_id.mul contDiff_id))
    have hcomp : (fun v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) + DqS5 h ξ v).1 ^ 2 / 2) =
        p ∘ ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)) := by
      funext v
      have e1 : (DqS5 h ξ v).1 = s * v.1 := by
        rw [hsd, hqd]; simp [DqS5, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
      rw [hpdef]
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', Prod.fst_add, e1]
      linear_combination (v.1 ^ 2 / 2) * hs2
    have e : iteratedFDeriv ℝ a (p ∘ ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ a (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => s.1 ^ 2 / 2) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => DqS5 h ξ) := by
      rw [← hcomp]
      exact key (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => s.1 ^ 2 / 2) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (DqS5 h ξ) hf0 a
    unfold sJet5
    rw [← e, ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)) hp (0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (i := a)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top), map_zero]
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
    have hprod : ∏ _i : Fin a, ‖ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_fst_le _ _ _)
    refine (mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) hprod).trans ?_
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs, ← hqd]
    have hd1 : deriv p = fun x => ξ.1 * s + q * x := by
      funext x
      rw [hpdef]
      have h := (((hasDerivAt_id' x).const_mul (ξ.1 * s)).const_add (ξ.1 ^ 2 / 2)).add
        (((hasDerivAt_id' x).mul (hasDerivAt_id' x)).const_mul (q / 2))
      have h' : HasDerivAt (fun x => ξ.1 ^ 2 / 2 + ξ.1 * s * x + q / 2 * (x * x))

by
  intro c b P hc hP

  have hbbp : b ≤ bp := by rw [hbp]; exact le_max_left b 0

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ) {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V) (g : Cyl → ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) → 0 < B.Xa → B.Xa < B.Xb → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) → ContinuousOn g (DomC B.h qs) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 ≤ g ξ) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, f ξ ≠ 0 → B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, f ξ ≠ 0 → B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ‖ ≤ g ξ) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ‖ ≤ g ξ

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ) {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V) (g : Cyl → ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) → 0 < B.Xa → B.Xa < B.Xb → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) → ContinuousOn g (DomC B.h qs) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 ≤ g ξ) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, f ξ ≠ 0 → B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, f ξ ≠ 0 → B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ‖ ≤ g ξ) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ‖ ≤ g ξ

by
  intro B qs V _ _ f g k hD hXa hXab hf hg hg0 hsupp hshell ξ hξ
  have hfc : ContinuousOn f (DomC B.h qs) := hf.continuousOn
  
  have hT : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs, f η ≠ 0 → η ∈ closure
      {ζ : Cyl | ζ ∈ DomC B.h qs ∧ f ζ ≠ 0 ∧ B.Xa < XC B.h ζ ∧ XC B.h ζ < B.Xb} := by
    intro η hη hne
    have hTo : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs ∩ f ⁻¹' {(0:V)}ᶜ) :=
      hfc.isOpen_inter_preimage hD isOpen_compl_singleton

    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hsupp η hη hne
    obtain ⟨X0, hX0⟩ : ∃ X0 : ℝ, X0 = XC B.h η := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hX0] at h1 h2

    let r : ℝ → ℝ := fun l => ((1 - l) * X0 + l * ((B.Xa + B.Xb) / 2)) / X0
    let φ : ℝ → Cyl := fun l => (Real.sqrt (r l) * η.1, η.2)
    have hrc : Continuous r := by
      show Continuous (fun l : ℝ => ((1 - l) * X0 + l * ((B.Xa + B.Xb) / 2)) / X0)
      fun_prop
    have hφc : Continuous φ := by
      show Continuous (fun l : ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (r l) * η.1, η.2) : Cyl))
      exact Continuous.prodMk ((Real.continuous_sqrt.comp hrc).mul continuous_const) continuous_const
    have hr0 : r 0 = 1 := by
      show ((1 - 0) * X0 + 0 * ((B.Xa + B.Xb) / 2)) / X0 = 1
      rw [sub_zero, one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero, div_self hX0pos.ne']
    have hφ0 : φ 0 = η := by
      show ((Real.sqrt (r 0) * η.1, η.2) : Cyl) = η
      rw [hr0, Real.sqrt_one, one_mul]
    have htend : Filter.Tendsto φ (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds η) := by
      have := hφc.tendsto 0
      rw [hφ0] at this
      exact this.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have hev : ∀ᶠ l in nhdsWithin (0:ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0), φ l ∈
        {ζ : Cyl | ζ ∈ DomC B.h qs ∧ f ζ ≠ 0 ∧ B.Xa < XC B.h ζ ∧ XC B.h ζ < B.Xb} := by
      filter_upwards [htend hTn, Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (zero_lt_one' ℝ)] with l hl hl01
      obtain ⟨hlD, hlne⟩ := hl
      have hl0 : 0 < l := hl01.1
      have hl1 : 0 < 1 - l := sub_pos.mpr hl01.2
      have hmpos : 0 < (B.Xa + B.Xb) / 2 := by linarith
      have hYpos : 0 < (1 - l) * X0 + l * ((B.Xa + B.Xb) / 2) := by
        nlinarith [mul_pos hl1 hX0pos, mul_pos hl0 hmpos]
      have hrnn : 0 ≤ r l := by
        show 0 ≤ ((1 - l) * X0 + l * ((B.Xa + B.Xb) / 2)) / X0
        exact div_nonneg hYpos.le hX0pos.le
      have hY : XC B.h (φ l) = (1 - l) * X0 + l * ((B.Xa + B.Xb) / 2) := by
        show (Real.sqrt (r l) * η.1) ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h (φ l)) = _
        have hq : qC B.h (φ l) = qC B.h η := rfl
        have hX : η.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h η) = X0 := by rw [hX0]; rfl
        rw [hq, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hrnn, mul_div_assoc, hX]
        show ((1 - l) * X0 + l * ((B.Xa + B.Xb) / 2)) / X0 * X0 = _
        exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hX0pos.ne'
      refine ⟨hlD, hlne, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hY]
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hl1.le (sub_nonneg.mpr h1), mul_pos hl0 (sub_pos.mpr hXab)]
      · rw [hY]
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hl1.le (sub_nonneg.mpr h2), mul_pos hl0 (sub_pos.mpr hXab)]
    exact mem_closure_of_tendsto htend hev
  
  have hFc : ContinuousOn (fun η => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f η‖) (DomC B.h qs) :=
    ((hf.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (m := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hD.uniqueDiffOn).congr
      (fun x hx => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hD hx).symm)).norm
  
  by_cases hA : ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, f η = 0
  · have h0 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ = 0 := by
      have hE : f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun _ => (0:V) := hA
      rw [(hE.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
      have h := (iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun _ : Cyl => (0:V)) = 0)
      exact congrFun h ξ
    rw [h0, norm_zero]
    exact hg0 ξ hξ
  · have hfr : ∃ᶠ η in nhds ξ, ¬ f η = 0 := Filter.not_eventually.mp hA
    have hfr2 : ∃ᶠ η in nhds ξ, η ∈ DomC B.h qs ∩ {η | f η ≠ 0} :=
      (hfr.and_eventually (hD.mem_nhds hξ)).mono (fun η h => ⟨h.2, h.1⟩)
    have hcl : ξ ∈ closure (DomC B.h qs ∩ {η | f η ≠ 0}) := mem_closure_iff_frequently.mpr hfr2
    have hsub : DomC B.h qs ∩ {η | f η ≠ 0} ⊆
        closure {ζ : Cyl | ζ ∈ DomC B.h qs ∧ f ζ ≠ 0 ∧ B.Xa < XC B.h ζ ∧ XC B.h ζ < B.Xb} :=
      fun η hη => hT η hη.1 hη.2
    have hξS := closure_mono hsub hcl
    rw [closure_closure] at hξS
    exact ContinuousWithinAt.closure_le hξS
      ((hFc.continuousAt (hD.mem_nhds hξ)).continuousWithinAt)
      ((hg.continuousAt (hD.mem_nhds hξ)).continuousWithinAt)
      (fun y hy => hshell y hy.1 hy.2.1 hy.2.2.1 hy.2.2.2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro F κ hF hper
  
  have PIC : ∀ {P E' F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
      [FiniteDimensional ℝ P] [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace ℝ E'] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E']
      [MeasurableSpace E'] [BorelSpace E'] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
      (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E') [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ]
      (U : Set P) (V K : Set E') (G : P → E' → F) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hK : IsCompact K)
      (hKV : K ⊆ V) (hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => G z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V)),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) x =
        ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ) := by
    intro P E' F _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ μ _ U V K G hU hV hK hKV hG
    have hO : IsOpen (U ×ˢ V) := hU.prod hV
    have hKm : MeasurableSet K := hK.isClosed.measurableSet
    have slice : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F'] (H : P → E' → F'),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) →
        ∀ x ∈ U, ContinuousOn (fun y => H x y) K := by
      intro F' _ _ H hH x hx
      have hc : Continuous (fun y : E' => ((x, y) : P × E')) := by fun_prop
      have h := ContinuousOn.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (f := fun y : E' => ((x, y) : P × E'))
        hH.continuousOn hc.continuousOn (fun y hy => ⟨hx, hKV hy⟩)
      exact h
    have param_fderiv : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F'] (H : P → E' → F'),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => H x' z.2) z.1) (U ×ˢ V) := by
      intro F' _ _ H hH p hp
      have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) p := hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hp)
      apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry (fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2)) (p, p.1) := by
        have e : Function.uncurry (fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2) =
            (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) ∘ (fun w : (P × E') × P => (w.2, w.1.2)) := rfl
        rw [e]
        apply ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (p, p.1)
        · simpa using hHa
        · fun_prop
      exact ContDiffAt.fderiv (f := fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2)
        (g := Prod.fst) h1 contDiffAt_fst (le_of_eq ENat.coe_top_add_one)
    have param_hasFDeriv : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F']
        (H : P → E' → F'), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) → ∀ x ∈ U,
        HasFDerivAt (fun x' => ∫ y in K, H x' y ∂μ) (∫ y in K, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => H x' y) x ∂μ) x := by
      intro F' _ _ H hH x hx
      have hHs := param_fderiv H hH
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU x hx
      have hsU : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ⊆ U :=
        (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
      have hsn : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ∈ nhds x := Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds x (by linarith)
      have hC : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ×ˢ K) := (isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod hK
      have hCsub : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ×ˢ K ⊆ U ×ˢ V := fun z hz => ⟨hsU hz.1, hKV hz.2⟩
      obtain ⟨Bd, hB⟩ := hC.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hHs.continuousOn.mono hCsub)
      refine hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (μ := μ.restrict K)
        (F := fun x' y => H x' y) (F' := fun x' y => fderiv ℝ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x')
        (bound := fun _ => Bd) hsn ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hx] with x' hx'
        exact (slice H hH x' hx').aestronglyMeasurable_of_isCompact hK hKm
      · exact (slice H hH x hx).integrableOn_compact hK
      · exact (slice (fun x' y => fderiv ℝ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x') hHs x hx).aestronglyMeasurable_of_isCompact
          hK hKm
      · exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hKm (fun y hy x' hx' => hB (x', y) ⟨hx', hy⟩)
      · exact continuousOn_const.integrableOn_compact hK
      · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hKm (fun y hy x' hx' => ?_)
        have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (x', y) :=
          hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds ⟨hsU hx', hKV hy⟩)
        have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x'' : P => ((x'', y) : P × E')) x' := by fun_prop
        have h2 := ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) x' hHa hc
        have : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x' := h2
        exact (this.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have hD0 : ∀ x y, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun x' => G x' y) x =
        (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm (G x y) := by
      intro x y; rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp]; rfl
    have hDs : ∀ (k : ℕ) x y, iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) (fun x' => G x' y) x =
        (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm
          (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') x) := by
      intro k x y; rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left]; rfl
    have D_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) (U ×ˢ V) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        have e : (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) =
            (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm ∘ (fun z : P × E' => G z.1 z.2) := by
          funext z; exact hD0 z.1 z.2
        rw [e]
        exact (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hG
      | succ k ih =>
        have e : (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) =
            (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm ∘
              (fun z : P × E' => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' z.2) x') z.1) := by
          funext z; exact hDs k z.1 z.2
        rw [e]
        have h2 := param_fderiv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') ih
        exact (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h2
    have formula : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) x =
        ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro x _
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp (f := fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ)]
        simp only [hD0]
        exact (ContinuousLinearEquiv.integral_comp_comm
          (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv (fun y => G x y)).symm
      | succ k ih =>
        intro x hx
        have hα : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) =ᶠ[nhds x]
            (fun x' => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x' ∂μ) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hx) ih
        have hβ := (param_hasFDeriv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x')
          (D_smooth k) x hx).fderiv
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left (f := fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ), Function.comp_apply,
          hα.fderiv_eq, hβ]
        simp only [hDs]
        have hL := ContinuousLinearEquiv.integral_comp_comm (μ := μ.restrict K) (𝕜 := ℝ)
          (E := P →L[ℝ] ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => P) F)
          (F := ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F)
          (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv
          (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') x)
        exact hL.symm
    have hsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U := by
      have key : ∀ m : ℕ, EqOn (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U)
          (fun x => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ) U := by
        intro m x hx
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hU hx]
        exact formula m x hx
      have hdiff : ∀ m : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℝ
          (fun x => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ) U :=
        fun m x hx => (param_hasFDeriv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x'' => G x'' y) x')
          (D_smooth m) x hx).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      exact contDiffOn_of_continuousOn_differentiableOn (n := ⊤)
        (fun m _ => ((hdiff m).continuousOn).congr (key m))
        (fun m _ => (hdiff m).congr (key m))
    exact ⟨hsmooth, formula⟩
  
  have per1 : ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℂ), Function.Periodic ψ 1 → ∀ b : ℝ,
      ∫ y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ψ (y + b) = ∫ y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ψ y := by
    intro ψ hψ b
    rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one,
      intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right, zero_add, add_comm 1 b,
      hψ.intervalIntegral_add_eq b 0, zero_add]
  
  have cell : ∀ (Φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ), Continuous Φ →
      (∀ (n m : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), Φ (Y + ((n : ℝ), (m : ℝ))) = Φ Y) →
      ∀ b : ℝ × ℝ, ∫ Z in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), Φ (Z + b) =
        ∫ Z in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), Φ Z := by
    intro Φ hΦ hp b
    have fub : ∀ Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ, Continuous Ψ →
        ∫ Z in (Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0:ℝ) 1), Ψ Z =
          ∫ x in Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∫ y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1, Ψ (x, y) := by
      intro Ψ hΨ
      rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod]
      exact setIntegral_prod Ψ
        ((hΨ.continuousOn).integrableOn_compact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc))
    rw [fub (fun Z => Φ (Z + b)) (hΦ.comp (continuous_id.add continuous_const)), fub _ hΦ]
    have h1 : ∀ x : ℝ, ∫ y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1, Φ ((x, y) + b) =
        ∫ y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1, Φ (x + b.1, y) := by
      intro x
      have hper1 : Function.Periodic (fun y => Φ (x + b.1, y)) 1 := by
        intro y
        have := hp 0 1 (x + b.1, y)
        simpa using this
      exact per1 _ hper1 b.2
    have hχ : Function.Periodic (fun u => ∫ y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1, Φ (u, y)) 1 := by
      intro u
      show ∫ y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1, Φ (u + 1, y) = ∫ y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1, Φ (u, y)
      congr 1
      funext y
      have := hp 1 0 (u, y)
      simpa using this
    rw [show (fun x => ∫ y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1, Φ ((x, y) + b)) =
        fun x => (fun u => ∫ y in Icc (0:ℝ) 1, Φ (u, y)) (x + b.1) from funext h1]
    exact per1 _ hχ b.1
  
  have rep : ∀ (H : Cyl → ℝ), Continuous H →
      (∀ (η : Cyl) (n m : ℤ), H (shY η ((n : ℝ), (m : ℝ))) = H η) → ∀ x : Cyl,
      fourY H x κ * Complex.exp ((2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) *
          ((κ.1 : ℂ) * (x.2.2.2.1 : ℂ) + (κ.2 : ℂ) * (x.2.2.2.2 : ℂ))) =
        ∫ Z in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), (H (x + (((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Z) : Cyl)) : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp (-(2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) * ((κ.1 : ℂ) * (Z.1 : ℂ) + (κ.2 : ℂ) * (Z.2 : ℂ))) := by
    intro H hH hHp x
    obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ : ∃ Φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ, Φ = fun Z => (H (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Z) : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp (-(2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) * ((κ.1 : ℂ) * (Z.1 : ℂ) + (κ.2 : ℂ) * (Z.2 : ℂ))) *
        Complex.exp ((2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) *
          ((κ.1 : ℂ) * (x.2.2.2.1 : ℂ) + (κ.2 : ℂ) * (x.2.2.2.2 : ℂ))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hL : fourY H x κ * Complex.exp ((2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) *
          ((κ.1 : ℂ) * (x.2.2.2.1 : ℂ) + (κ.2 : ℂ) * (x.2.2.2.2 : ℂ))) =
        ∫ Z in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), Φ Z := by
      rw [hΦ]
      unfold fourY
      exact (integral_mul_const _ _).symm
    have hHs : Continuous (fun Z : ℝ × ℝ => H (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Z)) := hH.comp (by fun_prop)
    have hΦc : Continuous Φ := by
      rw [hΦ]
      exact ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hHs).mul (Complex.continuous_exp.comp (by fun_prop))).mul
        continuous_const
    have hΦp : ∀ (n m : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), Φ (Y + ((n : ℝ), (m : ℝ))) = Φ Y := by
      intro n m Y
      rw [hΦ]
      dsimp only
      have hH' : H (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y + ((n : ℝ), (m : ℝ))) = H (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y) :=
        hHp (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y) n m
      rw [hH']
      congr 2
      rw [Complex.exp_eq_exp_iff_exists_int]
      refine ⟨-(κ.1 * n + κ.2 * m), ?_⟩
      simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add]
      push_cast
      ring
    have htr := cell Φ hΦc hΦp x.2.2.2
    rw [hL, ← htr]
    congr 1
    funext Z
    rw [hΦ]
    dsimp only
    have hpt : ((x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Z + x.2.2.2) : Cyl) = x + (((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Z) : Cyl) := by
      ext <;> simp [add_comm]
    rw [hpt, mul_assoc _ (Complex.exp _) (Complex.exp _), ← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 2
    simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add]
    push_cast
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ : ∃ G : Cyl → ℝ × ℝ → ℂ, G = fun x Z =>
      (F (x + (((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Z) : Cyl)) : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp (-(2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) * ((κ.1 : ℂ) * (Z.1 : ℂ) + (κ.2 : ℂ) * (Z.2 : ℂ))) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hrep : (fun x : Cyl => fourY F x κ *
      Complex.exp ((2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) * ((κ.1 : ℂ) * (x.2.2.2.1 : ℂ) + (κ.2 : ℂ) * (x.2.2.2.2 : ℂ)))) =
      fun x => ∫ Z in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), G x Z := by
    funext x
    rw [hG]
    exact rep F hF.continuous hper x
  have hGs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : Cyl × (ℝ × ℝ) => G z.1 z.2) (univ ×ˢ univ) := by
    rw [hG]
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : Cyl × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
      (F (z.1 + (((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), z.2) : Cyl)) : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp (-(2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) * ((κ.1 : ℂ) * (z.2.1 : ℂ) + (κ.2 : ℂ) * (z.2.2 : ℂ))))
      (univ ×ˢ univ)
    apply ContDiff.contDiffOn
    have hin : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : Cyl × (ℝ × ℝ) => z.1 + (((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), z.2) : Cyl)) := by

          Fin (n + 1 + 1) → Cyl) : Fin (n + 1 + 1 + 1) → Cyl) : Fin (n + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1) → Cyl) :
            Fin (n + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1) → Cyl) i‖ = ‖u‖ ^ 5 * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := by
      simp only [Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
      ring
    have hb := hG1 (n + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1) x
      (Fin.cons u (Fin.cons u (Fin.cons u (Fin.cons u (Fin.cons u m : Fin (n + 1) → Cyl) :
          Fin (n + 1 + 1) → Cyl) : Fin (n + 1 + 1 + 1) → Cyl) : Fin (n + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1) → Cyl) :
            Fin (n + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1) → Cyl)
    rw [e5, norm_mul, norm_pow, hprod] at hb
    exact hb
  
  have hu1 : ‖(((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) : Cyl)‖ = 1 := by
    simp [Prod.norm_def]
  have hu2 : ‖(((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) : Cyl)‖ = 1 := by
    simp [Prod.norm_def]
  have hl1 : ‖2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((κ.1 : ℂ) * ((((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) : ℝ × ℝ).1 : ℂ) +
      (κ.2 : ℂ) * ((((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) : ℝ × ℝ).2 : ℂ))‖ = 2 * Real.pi * |(κ.1 : ℝ)| := by
    simp [abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
  have hl2 : ‖2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((κ.1 : ℂ) * ((((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) : ℝ × ℝ).1 : ℂ) +
      (κ.2 : ℂ) * ((((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) : ℝ × ℝ).2 : ℂ))‖ = 2 * Real.pi * |(κ.2 : ℝ)| := by
    simp [abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
  have h2pi : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by linarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
  have hL : 0 < 1 + |(κ.1 : ℝ)| + |(κ.2 : ℝ)| := by positivity
  apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound
    (div_nonneg (by positivity) (pow_pos hL 5).le)
  intro m
  have hP : 0 ≤ ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
  have hN : 0 ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n M x m‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have hn0 := hG1 n x m
  have hk1 : |(κ.1 : ℝ)| ^ 5 * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n M x m‖ ≤
      |B0 (n + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1)| * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := by
    have h := hG3 ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) m
    rw [hl1, hu1, one_pow, one_mul] at h
    have ha : |(κ.1 : ℝ)| ^ 5 ≤ (2 * Real.pi * |(κ.1 : ℝ)|) ^ 5 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (le_mul_of_one_le_left (abs_nonneg _) h2pi) 5
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha hN).trans h
  have hk2 : |(κ.2 : ℝ)| ^ 5 * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n M x m‖ ≤
      |B0 (n + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1)| * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := by
    have h := hG3 ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) m
    rw [hl2, hu2, one_pow, one_mul] at h
    have ha : |(κ.2 : ℝ)| ^ 5 ≤ (2 * Real.pi * |(κ.2 : ℝ)|) ^ 5 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (le_mul_of_one_le_left (abs_nonneg _) h2pi) 5
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha hN).trans h
  have hL5 := hpow |(κ.1 : ℝ)| |(κ.2 : ℝ)| (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)
  have hfin : (1 + |(κ.1 : ℝ)| + |(κ.2 : ℝ)|) ^ 5 * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n M x m‖ ≤
      243 * (|B0 n| + 2 * |B0 (n + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1)|) * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := by
    calc (1 + |(κ.1 : ℝ)| + |(κ.2 : ℝ)|) ^ 5 * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n M x m‖ ≤
          243 * (1 + |(κ.1 : ℝ)| ^ 5 + |(κ.2 : ℝ)| ^ 5) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n M x m‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL5 hN
      _ = 243 * (‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n M x m‖ + |(κ.1 : ℝ)| ^ 5 * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n M x m‖ +
          |(κ.2 : ℝ)| ^ 5 * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n M x m‖) := by ring
      _ ≤ 243 * (|B0 n| * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ + |B0 (n + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1)| * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ +
          |B0 (n + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1)| * ∏ i, ‖m i‖) := by linarith
      _ = 243 * (|B0 n| + 2 * |B0 (n + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1)|) * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := by ring
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hL 5)]
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (U : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (f : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (A : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (s0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (Λ : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (L K Q I : ℝ) (P : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsOpen U → s0 ∈ U → 0 ≤ L → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => A w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → (∀ s ∈ U, ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt (fun v' => f (s, v')) (Matrix.mulVec (A s v) (f (s, v))) v) → (∀ v, 0 < P v) → 0 ≤ K → (∀ (x : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (w : ℝ), 0 ≤ w → w ≤ L → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w L, HasDerivAt x (Matrix.mulVec (A s0 v) (x v)) v) → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w L, ‖x v‖ ≤ K * (P v / P w) * ‖x w‖) → 0 ≤ Q → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => A s v) s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤ Q) → 0 ≤ I → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => f (s, 0)) s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤ I * P 0) → ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => f (s, v)) s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤ (1 + K) * (1 + I) * (3 * 2 ^ k * (1 + K) * (1 + L) * (1 + Q)) ^ k * P v

signature.name: tHjet_slow_propagation_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (U : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (f : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (A : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (s0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (Λ : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (L K Q I : ℝ) (P : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsOpen U → s0 ∈ U → 0 ≤ L → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => A w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → (∀ s ∈ U, ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt (fun v' => f (s, v')) (Matrix.mulVec (A s v) (f (s, v))) v) → (∀ v, 0 < P v) → 0 ≤ K → (∀ (x : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (w : ℝ), 0 ≤ w → w ≤ L → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w L, HasDerivAt x (Matrix.mulVec (A s0 v) (x v)) v) → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w L, ‖x v‖ ≤ K * (P v / P w) * ‖x w‖) → 0 ≤ Q → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => A s v) s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤ Q) → 0 ≤ I → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => f (s, 0)) s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤ I * P 0) → ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => f (s, v)) s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤ (1 + K) * (1 + I) * (3 * 2 ^ k * (1 + K) * (1 + L) * (1 + Q)) ^ k * P v

proof.tactics:
by
  intro U f A s0 Λ L K Q I P k hU hs0 hL hf hA hode hP hK hprop hQ hQb hI hIb
  obtain ⟨X, hXdef⟩ : ∃ X : ℝ, X = 3 * 2 ^ k * (1 + K) * (1 + L) * (1 + Q) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Y, hYdef⟩ : ∃ Y : ℝ, Y = (1 + K) * (1 + I) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have h2k : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ k := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
  have hX1 : 1 ≤ X := by
    rw [hXdef]
    have a1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 3 * 2 ^ k := by linarith
    have a2 := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le a1 (by linarith : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + K)
    have a3 := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le a2 (by linarith : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + L)
    exact one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le a3 (by linarith : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + Q)
  have hX0 : 0 ≤ X := by linarith
  have hY0 : 0 ≤ Y := by rw [hYdef]; exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hKIY : K * I ≤ Y := by
    have e : (1 + K) * (1 + I) = 1 + K + I + K * I := by ring
    rw [hYdef, e]; linarith
  have hKQL : 0 ≤ K * Q * L := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK hQ) hL
  
  have hclose : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k →
      K * (I + 3 * Q * L * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose i : ℝ) * (Y * X ^ i))) ≤ Y * X ^ j := by
    intro j hjk
    rcases j with _ | n
    · rw [Finset.sum_range_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, pow_zero, mul_one]
      exact hKIY
    · have hXn : 1 ≤ X ^ n := one_le_pow₀ hX1
      have hZ0 : 0 ≤ Y * X ^ n := mul_nonneg hY0 (by linarith)
      have hKI : K * I ≤ Y * X ^ n := hKIY.trans (le_mul_of_one_le_right hY0 hXn)
      have hsum1 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), ((n+1).choose i : ℝ) * (Y * X ^ i) ≤
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), ((n+1).choose i : ℝ) * (Y * X ^ n) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        have hi' : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_right₀ hX1 hi') hY0)
          (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      have hsum2 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), ((n+1).choose i : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ (n+1) := by
        have e : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1+1), ((n+1).choose i : ℝ) = 2 ^ (n+1) := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose (n+1)
        rw [← e, Finset.sum_range_succ (fun i => ((n+1).choose i : ℝ)) (n+1)]
        have : (0:ℝ) ≤ ((n+1).choose (n+1) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
        linarith
      have hsum3 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), ((n+1).choose i : ℝ) * (Y * X ^ n) ≤
          2 ^ (n+1) * (Y * X ^ n) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsum2 hZ0
      have hW : 1 + K * Q * L ≤ (1 + K) * (1 + L) * (1 + Q) := by
        have e : (1 + K) * (1 + L) * (1 + Q) =
            1 + K + L + Q + K * L + K * Q + L * Q + K * Q * L := by ring
        rw [e]
        have := mul_nonneg hK hL
        have := mul_nonneg hK hQ
        have := mul_nonneg hL hQ
        linarith
      have h2n : (2:ℝ) ^ (n+1) ≤ 2 ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hjk
      have hXbig : 1 + 3 * 2 ^ (n+1) * (K * Q * L) ≤ X := by
        have eX : X = 3 * 2 ^ k * ((1 + K) * (1 + L) * (1 + Q)) := by rw [hXdef]; ring
        have b1 : 3 * 2 ^ k * (1 + K * Q * L) ≤ X := by
          rw [eX]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hW (by positivity)
        have b2 : 2 ^ (n+1) * (K * Q * L) ≤ 2 ^ k * (K * Q * L) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2n hKQL
        have b3 : 3 * 2 ^ k * (1 + K * Q * L) = 3 * 2 ^ k + 3 * (2 ^ k * (K * Q * L)) := by ring
        have b4 : 3 * 2 ^ (n+1) * (K * Q * L) = 3 * (2 ^ (n+1) * (K * Q * L)) := by ring
        linarith
      have hA' : 3 * (K * Q * L) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), ((n+1).choose i : ℝ) * (Y * X ^ i)) ≤
          3 * (K * Q * L) * (2 ^ (n+1) * (Y * X ^ n)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hsum1.trans hsum3) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hKQL)
      have hB : (Y * X ^ n) * (1 + 3 * 2 ^ (n+1) * (K * Q * L)) ≤ (Y * X ^ n) * X :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hXbig hZ0
      calc K * (I + 3 * Q * L * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), ((n+1).choose i : ℝ) * (Y * X ^ i)))
          = K * I + 3 * (K * Q * L) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), ((n+1).choose i : ℝ) * (Y * X ^ i)) := by
            ring
        _ ≤ Y * X ^ n + 3 * (K * Q * L) * (2 ^ (n+1) * (Y * X ^ n)) := add_le_add hKI hA'
        _ = (Y * X ^ n) * (1 + 3 * 2 ^ (n+1) * (K * Q * L)) := by ring
        _ ≤ (Y * X ^ n) * X := hB
        _ = Y * X ^ (n+1) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
  
  have hWo : IsOpen (U ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) := hU.prod isOpen_univ
  have hmemW : ∀ v : ℝ, (s0, v) ∈ U ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) := fun v => ⟨hs0, trivial⟩
  have hfs : ∀ v : ℝ, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s => f (s, v)) s0 := by
    intro v
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f (s0, v) := hf.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds (hmemW v))
    exact h1.comp s0 ((contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt)
  have hAs : ∀ v : ℝ, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s => A s v) s0 := by
    intro v
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => A w.1 w.2) (s0, v) :=
      hA.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds (hmemW v))
    exact h1.comp s0 ((contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt)
  have hA0c : Continuous (fun v => A s0 v) := by
    have hc : ContinuousOn (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => A w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) := hA.continuousOn
    exact hc.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id) hmemW
  
  have hclaim : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L,
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => f (s, v)) s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤
        Y * X ^ j * P v := by
    intro j
    induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ j ih =>
      intro hjk v hv
      apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound
      · exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hY0 (pow_nonneg hX0 _)) (hP v).le
      intro m
      obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ : ∃ μ : ℝ, μ = ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hμ0 : 0 ≤ μ := by rw [hμ]; exact Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ),
          x = fun v' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => f (s, v')) s0 (fun i => Λ (m i)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ),
          r = fun v' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => Matrix.mulVec (A s v') (f (s, v'))) s0
            (fun i => Λ (m i)) - Matrix.mulVec (A s0 v') (x v') := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, S = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose i : ℝ) * (Y * X ^ i) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hS0 : 0 ≤ S := by
        rw [hS]
        exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
          (mul_nonneg hY0 (pow_nonneg hX0 _)))
      obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ, F = 3 * Q * S * μ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hF0 : 0 ≤ F := by
        rw [hF]; exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hQ) hS0) hμ0
      
      have hderiv : ∀ v' ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt x (Matrix.mulVec (A s0 v') (x v') + r v') v' := by
        intro v' hv'
        have h2 := slowjet_vderiv_comm_v5 U f s0 j v' hU hs0 hf
        have h3 := (ContinuousMultilinearMap.apply ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (Fin 3 → ℝ)
          (fun i => Λ (m i))).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt v' h2
        simp only [Function.comp_def, ContinuousMultilinearMap.apply_apply] at h3
        have heq : (fun s => deriv (fun v'' => f (s, v'')) v') =ᶠ[nhds s0]
            (fun s => Matrix.mulVec (A s v') (f (s, v'))) := by
          filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hs0] with s hs
          exact (hode s hs v' hv').deriv
        have hval : Matrix.mulVec (A s0 v') (x v') + r v' =
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => Matrix.mulVec (A s v') (f (s, v'))) s0 (fun i => Λ (m i)) := by
          simp only [hr]
          abel
        rw [hval, ← (heq.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds, hx]
        exact h3
      
      have hrb : ∀ v' ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, ‖r v'‖ ≤ F * P v' := by
        intro v' hv'
        have h := slowjet_leibniz_rem_v5 (fun s => A s v') (fun s => f (s, v')) s0 Λ j Q
          (fun i => Y * X ^ i * P v') (hAs v') (hfs v')
          (fun i _ hij => hQb i (hij.trans hjk) v' hv')
          (fun i hij => ih i hij (by omega) v' hv') m
        have hsum : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose i : ℝ) * (Y * X ^ i * P v') = S * P v' := by
          rw [hS, Finset.sum_mul]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
        have hrv : r v' = iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => Matrix.mulVec (A s v') (f (s, v'))) s0
            (fun i => Λ (m i)) - Matrix.mulVec (A s0 v')
              (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => f (s, v')) s0 (fun i => Λ (m i))) := by
          rw [hr, hx]
        rw [hrv]
        calc _ ≤ _ := h
          _ = 3 * Q * (S * P v') * μ := by rw [hsum, hμ]
          _ = F * P v' := by rw [hF]; ring
      
      have hx0 : ‖x 0‖ ≤ I * P 0 * μ := by
        have h := ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm
          ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => f (s, 0)) s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)) m
        simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply] at h
        rw [hx, hμ]
        exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hIb j hjk)
          (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)))
      
      have hD := slowjet_forced_duhamel_v5 (fun v => A s0 v) P L K F x r hA0c hP hK hF0 hprop
        hderiv hrb v hv
      have hq : ‖x 0‖ / P 0 ≤ I * μ := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (hP 0)]
        calc ‖x 0‖ ≤ I * P 0 * μ := hx0
          _ = I * μ * P 0 := by ring
      have hFv : F * v ≤ F * L := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv.2 hF0
      have hKP : 0 ≤ K * P v := mul_nonneg hK (hP v).le
      have h4 : ‖x v‖ ≤ K * P v * (I * μ + F * L) :=
        le_trans hD (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hKP)
      have h5 : K * (I + 3 * Q * L * S) ≤ Y * X ^ j := by rw [hS]; exact hclose j hjk

        by_cases hi : i ∈ S
        · rw [Finset.piecewise_eq_of_mem _ _ _ hi, hma, Prod.norm_def]
          show max ‖(m i).1‖ ‖(0 : ℝ)‖ ≤ ‖m i‖
          exact max_le (norm_fst_le _) (by simp)
        · rw [Finset.piecewise_eq_of_notMem _ _ _ hi, hmt, Prod.norm_def]
          show max ‖(0 : E)‖ ‖(m i).2‖ ≤ ‖m i‖
          exact max_le (by simp) (norm_snd_le _)
      have hzP : ∏ i, ‖S.piecewise ma mt i‖ ≤ ∏ i, ‖m i‖ :=
        Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun i _ => hz i)
      by_cases hS : S = Finset.univ
      · subst hS
        rw [Finset.piecewise_univ, hma]
        calc ‖T (fun i => ((m i).1, (0 : ℝ)))‖ ≤ α * ∏ i, ‖(m i).1‖ := hα (fun i => (m i).1)
          _ ≤ α * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun i _ => norm_fst_le _)) hα0
          _ ≤ (α + β) * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hP
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, j ∉ S := by
          by_contra h
          push_neg at h
          exact hS (Finset.eq_univ_iff_forall.mpr h)
        have h1 : (S.piecewise ma mt j).1 = 0 := by
          rw [Finset.piecewise_eq_of_notMem _ _ _ hj, hmt]
        calc ‖T (S.piecewise ma mt)‖ ≤ β * ∏ i, ‖S.piecewise ma mt i‖ := hβ _ j h1
          _ ≤ β * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hzP hβ0
          _ ≤ (α + β) * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hP
    calc ‖T m‖ = ‖∑ S : Finset (Fin (n + 1)), T (S.piecewise ma mt)‖ := by
          rw [← T.map_add_univ, ← hm]
      _ ≤ ∑ S : Finset (Fin (n + 1)), ‖T (S.piecewise ma mt)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ S : Finset (Fin (n + 1)), (α + β) * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun S _ => hterm S)
      _ = 2 ^ (n + 1) * (α + β) * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_finset, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
          push_cast
          ring
  
  
  have srG : ∀ (k : ℕ) (E : ℕ → ℝ) (Q Bm : ℝ), 0 ≤ Q → 0 ≤ Bm → E 0 ≤ Bm →
      (∀ n : ℕ, n + 1 ≤ k → E (n + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1) * (Bm + 3 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (n.choose i : ℝ) * Q * E (n - i))) →
      E k ≤ (4 ^ k * 3 * (1 + Q)) ^ k * Bm := by
    intro k E Q Bm hQ hB h0 hs
    obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ : ∃ X : ℝ, X = 4 ^ k * 3 * (1 + Q) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hX]
    have h4 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 4 ^ k := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    have hX1 : 1 ≤ X := by
      rw [hX]
      calc (1 : ℝ) = 1 * 1 * 1 := by norm_num
        _ ≤ 4 ^ k * 3 * (1 + Q) := by gcongr <;> linarith
    have main : ∀ n, n ≤ k → E n ≤ X ^ n * Bm := by
      intro n
      induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | _ n ih =>
        intro hn
        rcases n with _ | n
        · simpa using h0
        · have hih : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * Q * E (n - i) ≤
              (n.choose i : ℝ) * Q * (X ^ n * Bm) := by
            intro i hi
            have hi' : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
            have h1 : E (n - i) ≤ X ^ (n - i) * Bm := ih (n - i) (by omega) (by omega)
            have h2 : X ^ (n - i) ≤ X ^ n := pow_le_pow_right₀ hX1 (by omega)
            have h3 : E (n - i) ≤ X ^ n * Bm := h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 hB)
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hQ)
          have hsum : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * Q * E (n - i) ≤
              2 ^ n * Q * (X ^ n * Bm) := by
            calc _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * Q * (X ^ n * Bm) :=
                  Finset.sum_le_sum hih
              _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ)) * Q * (X ^ n * Bm) := by
                  rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
              _ = 2 ^ n * Q * (X ^ n * Bm) := by
                  rw [← Nat.cast_sum, Nat.sum_range_choose]
                  push_cast
                  ring
          have hXn : 1 ≤ X ^ n := one_le_pow₀ hX1
          have h2n : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ n := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
          have h5 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ n * 3 * X ^ n := by
            calc (1 : ℝ) = 1 * 1 * 1 := by norm_num
              _ ≤ 2 ^ n * 3 * X ^ n := by gcongr <;> linarith
          have h6 : Bm ≤ 2 ^ n * 3 * X ^ n * Bm := le_mul_of_one_le_left hB h5
          have h7 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * n + 1) ≤ 4 ^ k := by
            calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * n + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (2 * k) := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
              _ = 4 ^ k := by rw [pow_mul]; norm_num
          have h8 : 0 ≤ 3 * (1 + Q) * X ^ n * Bm := by positivity
          calc E (n + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1) * (Bm + 3 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
                (n.choose i : ℝ) * Q * E (n - i)) := hs n hn
            _ ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1) * (Bm + 3 * (2 ^ n * Q * (X ^ n * Bm))) := by gcongr
            _ ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1) * (2 ^ n * 3 * (1 + Q) * X ^ n * Bm) := by
                apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
                linarith
            _ = 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) * (3 * (1 + Q) * X ^ n * Bm) := by ring
            _ ≤ 4 ^ k * (3 * (1 + Q) * X ^ n * Bm) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h7 h8
            _ = X ^ (n + 1) * Bm := by rw [hX]; ring
    exact main k le_rfl
  
  
  obtain ⟨Λ', hΛ'⟩ : ∃ M : ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ),
      M = Λ.prodMap (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hΛ'] at hcoef ⊢
  obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ), O = U ×ˢ Set.univ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hOdef] at hf hA
  have hO : IsOpen O := by rw [hOdef]; exact hU.prod isOpen_univ
  have hx0 : ((s0, v) : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) ∈ O := by rw [hOdef]; exact ⟨hs0, trivial⟩
  have hBm0 : 0 ≤ Bm := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hslow 0 (Nat.zero_le _))
  obtain ⟨B, hB3, hB⟩ := mvG
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ, e = ((0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨g1, hg1⟩ : ∃ g : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ), g = fun w => fderiv ℝ f w e := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨g2, hg2⟩ : ∃ g : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ), g = fun w => B (A w.1 w.2) (f w) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsymm := symmG O f hO hf (s0, v) hx0
  
  have hpt : ∀ s ∈ U, ∀ v' ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, g1 (s, v') = g2 (s, v') := by
    intro s hs v' hv'
    have hsO : ((s, v') : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) ∈ O := by rw [hOdef]; exact ⟨hs, trivial⟩
    have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (s, v') :=
      (hf.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hsO)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => ((s, r) : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) v' :=
      (hasDerivAt_const v' s).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id v')
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun v'' => f (s, v'')) (fderiv ℝ f (s, v') ((0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) v' :=
      hfd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt v' hγ
    have h2 := h1.unique (hode s hs v' hv')
    rw [hg1, hg2]
    show fderiv ℝ f (s, v') e = B (A s v') (f (s, v'))
    rw [he, hB]
    exact h2
  have hfd' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) O := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).mp hf).2
  have hg1s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g1 O := by rw [hg1]; exact hfd'.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hg2s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g2 O := by
    rw [hg2]; exact (B.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hA).clm_apply hf
  
  have hjet : ∀ n : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g1 (s0, v) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (s0, v) := by
    intro n
    have hW : IsOpen (U ×ˢ Set.Ioo 0 L) := hU.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have heq : Set.EqOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g1) (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2) (U ×ˢ Set.Ioo 0 L) := by
      intro w hw
      have hev : g1 =ᶠ[nhds w] g2 := by
        filter_upwards [hW.mem_nhds hw] with w' hw'
        exact hpt w'.1 hw'.1 w'.2 (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hw'.2)
      exact (hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ n).eq_of_nhds
    have hcont : ∀ g : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g O →
        ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g) (U ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 L) := by
      intro g hg w hw
      have hwO : w ∈ O := by rw [hOdef]; exact ⟨hw.1, trivial⟩
      exact ((hg.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hwO)).continuousAt_iteratedFDeriv
        (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).continuousWithinAt
    have hsub : U ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 L ⊆ closure (U ×ˢ Set.Ioo 0 L) := by
      rw [closure_prod_eq, closure_Ioo hL.ne]
      exact Set.prod_mono subset_closure le_rfl
    exact heq.of_subset_closure (hcont g1 hg1s) (hcont g2 hg2s)
      (Set.prod_mono le_rfl Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self) hsub ⟨hs0, hv⟩
  have hg1comp : ∀ n : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g1 (s0, v) =
      (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (Fin 3 → ℝ) e).compContinuousMultilinearMap
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y) (s0, v)) := by
    intro n
    rw [hg1]
    exact (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (Fin 3 → ℝ) e).iteratedFDeriv_comp_left
      (hfd'.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hx0)) (i := n) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  
  have hlastslot : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (w : Fin (n + 1) → (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) (c : ℝ), w (Fin.last n) = c • e →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (s0, v) w = c • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (s0, v) (Fin.init w) := by
    intro n w c hw
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right, hw, ContinuousLinearMap.map_smul, ← hjet n, hg1comp n]
    rfl
  have htime : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (z : Fin (n + 1) → (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) (j : Fin (n + 1)), (z j).1 = 0 →
      ‖((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (s0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')) z‖ ≤
        ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (s0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')‖ * ∏ i, ‖z i‖ := by
    intro n z j hj
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)), σ = Equiv.swap j (Fin.last n) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : Fin (n + 1) → (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ, w = fun i => Λ' (z (σ i)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hT : ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (s0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')) z =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (s0, v) w := by
      rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, hw]
      exact (hsymm (n + 1) (fun i => Λ' (z i)) σ).symm
    have hwl : w (Fin.last n) = (z j).2 • e := by
      rw [hw, hσ, he]
      simp only [Equiv.swap_apply_right]
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_ <;> simp [hΛ', hj]
    have hy : Fin.init w = fun i => Λ' (z (σ (Fin.castSucc i))) := by
      rw [hw]; rfl
    rw [hT, hlastslot n w _ hwl, norm_smul, hy]
    have hle := ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (s0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ'))
      (fun i => z (σ (Fin.castSucc i)))
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply] at hle
    have hc : ‖(z j).2‖ ≤ ‖z (σ (Fin.last n))‖ := by
      rw [hσ, Equiv.swap_apply_right]; exact norm_snd_le _
    have hprod : ∏ i, ‖z i‖ = (∏ i : Fin n, ‖z (σ (Fin.castSucc i))‖) * ‖z (σ (Fin.last n))‖ := by
      rw [← Fin.prod_univ_castSucc (fun i => ‖z (σ i)‖)]
      exact (Equiv.prod_comp σ (fun i => ‖z i‖)).symm
    rw [hprod]
    have hG0 : 0 ≤ ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (s0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')‖ :=
      norm_nonneg _
    have hP0 : 0 ≤ ∏ i : Fin n, ‖z (σ (Fin.castSucc i))‖ :=
      Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
    calc ‖(z j).2‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (s0, v) (fun i => Λ' (z (σ (Fin.castSucc i))))‖
        ≤ ‖z (σ (Fin.last n))‖ * (‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (s0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Λ')‖ * ∏ i : Fin n, ‖z (σ (Fin.castSucc i))‖) :=
          mul_le_mul hc hle (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (s0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')‖ *
            ((∏ i : Fin n, ‖z (σ (Fin.castSucc i))‖) * ‖z (σ (Fin.last n))‖) := by ring
  
  have hslowpb : ∀ j : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => f (s, v)) s0 =
      (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f (s0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) := by
    intro j
    have hc : ((0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), v) + ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ s0 = (s0, v) := by simp
    have h1 := pbG O f ((0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), v) (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) s0 j hO hf
      (by rw [hc]; exact hx0)
    have hfun : (fun y => f (((0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), v) + ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ y)) =
        fun s => f (s, v) := by
      funext y; simp
    rw [hc, hfun] at h1
    exact h1
  have hslowb : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ k → ∀ a : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,
      ‖((iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f (s0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ'))
        (fun i => (a i, (0 : ℝ)))‖ ≤ Bm * ∏ i, ‖a i‖ := by
    intro n hn a
    have h1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun s => f (s, v)) s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)) a
    have h2 : ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f (s0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ'))
        (fun i => (a i, (0 : ℝ))) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun s => f (s, v)) s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)) a := by
      rw [hslowpb n]
      simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
      congr 1
      funext i
      rw [hΛ']
      simp
    rw [h2]
    exact h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hslow n hn)
      (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)))
  
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℕ → ℝ,
      E = fun n => ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f (s0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')‖ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hEn : ∀ n, E n = ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f (s0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')‖ :=
    fun n => by rw [hE]
  have hE0 : E 0 ≤ Bm := by
    rw [hEn]
    refine ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound hBm0 (fun m => ?_)
    have h1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun s => f (s, v)) s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ))
      (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)
    have h2 := hslow 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
    simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply,
      Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.prod_empty, mul_one] at h1 ⊢
    linarith
  have hrec : ∀ n : ℕ, n + 1 ≤ k → E (n + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1) * (Bm + 3 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      (n.choose i : ℝ) * Q * E (n - i)) := by
    intro n hn
    have hsb := sbG n ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (s0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')) Bm
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (s0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')‖ hBm0 (norm_nonneg _)
      (hslowb (n + 1) hn) (htime n)
    have hl := lbG B (fun w => A w.1 w.2) f O (s0, v) Λ' n hO hx0 hA hf
    have hG : ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (s0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')‖ ≤
        3 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * Q * E (n - i) := by
      rw [hg2]
      refine hl.trans ?_
      apply mul_le_mul hB3 _ (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)) (by norm_num)
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      have hi' : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
      rw [hEn]
      have hq := hcoef i (by omega)
      have hnn : 0 ≤ ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) f (s0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')‖ :=
        norm_nonneg _
      have hc0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq hc0) hnn
    rw [hEn (n + 1)]
    calc _ ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1) * (Bm + ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (s0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Λ')‖) := hsb
      _ ≤ _ := by gcongr
  have hfin := srG k E Q Bm hQ hBm0 hE0 hrec
  rw [hEn] at hfin
  exact hfin

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), 1 ≤ γ.1 → ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → 1 / (Tgc * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ cib B.h γ.1 ∧ (γ.1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (SC B.h ξ)

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), 1 ≤ γ.1 → ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → 1 / (Tgc * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ cib B.h γ.1 ∧ (γ.1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (SC B.h ξ)

proof.tactics:
by
  have cib_band_bounds5 : ∀ (h : ℝ) (l : ℕ), 1 ≤ l → 1 / (Tgc * (l:ℝ) ^ 2) < cib h l ∧ cib h l ≤ 1 / (l:ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    intro h l hl
    have hL : (1:ℝ) ≤ (l:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hl
    have hL2 : (0:ℝ) < (l:ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hT1 : (1:ℝ) < Tgc := by
      unfold Tgc
      have := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
      linarith
    have hT0 : (0:ℝ) < Tgc := by linarith
    have hy0 : (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
      div_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _) hL2
    have hQ0 : 0 < Qb l := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _
    have hQp : 0 < Qb l ^ (1 + h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ0 _
    have hfl : ((bandIdx h l : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤
        Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2)) := Int.floor_le _
    have hfl2 : Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2)) - 1 <
        ((bandIdx h l : ℤ) : ℝ) := Int.sub_one_lt_floor _
    have hz : Tgc ^ (bandIdx h l) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_intCast]
      calc Tgc ^ ((bandIdx h l : ℤ) : ℝ)
          ≤ Tgc ^ (Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2))) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hT1.le hfl
        _ = (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) := Real.rpow_logb hT0 hT1.ne' hy0
    have hz2 : (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) / Tgc < Tgc ^ (bandIdx h l) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_intCast]
      calc (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) / Tgc
          = Tgc ^ (Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2)) - 1) := by
            rw [Real.rpow_sub hT0, Real.rpow_one, Real.rpow_logb hT0 hT1.ne' hy0]
        _ < Tgc ^ ((bandIdx h l : ℤ) : ℝ) := Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt hT1 hfl2
    have hQe : Qb l ^ (1 + h) * (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) = 1 := by
      unfold Qb
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num), ← Real.rpow_add two_pos]
      have e : -(l:ℝ) * (1 + h) + (1 + h) * (l:ℝ) = 0 := by ring
      rw [e, Real.rpow_zero]
    have hyL : (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) * (l:ℝ) ^ 2 =
        (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hL2.ne'
    have sB : cib h l ≤ 1 / (l:ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hL2]
      unfold cib
      calc Tgc ^ (bandIdx h l) * Qb l ^ (1 + h) * (l:ℝ) ^ 2
          ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) * Qb l ^ (1 + h) * (l:ℝ) ^ 2 := by
            have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hz hQp.le
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this hL2.le
        _ = ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) * (l:ℝ) ^ 2) * Qb l ^ (1 + h) := by ring
        _ = 1 := by rw [hyL, mul_comm]; exact hQe
    have sA : 1 / (Tgc * (l:ℝ) ^ 2) < cib h l := by
      unfold cib
      have e1 : 1 / (Tgc * (l:ℝ) ^ 2) =
          (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) / Tgc * Qb l ^ (1 + h) := by
        generalize (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) = P at hQe ⊢
        generalize Qb l ^ (1 + h) = Q at hQe ⊢
        rw [div_div, div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_comm P Q, hQe]
        ring
      rw [e1]
      exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hz2 hQp
    exact ⟨sA, sB⟩
  have etaL_band_window_v5 : ∀ (h : ℝ) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), 0 < qC h ξ → etaL h γ ξ ≠ 0 → 1/2 < qC h ξ / Qb γ.1 ∧ qC h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 2 := by
    intro h γ ξ hq hη
    have h1 : sqPart 1 (-(γ.1:ℤ)) (Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ)) ≠ 0 := by
      unfold etaL at hη
      exact left_ne_zero_of_mul hη
    unfold sqPart at h1
    have h2 := (div_ne_zero_iff.mp h1).1
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) + (γ.1:ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hxe : Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) / 1 - (((-(γ.1:ℤ)):ℤ):ℝ) = x := by
      rw [hx]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hxe] at h2
