      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      exact h2 (Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos hc)
    have hlo : -1 < x := by nlinarith
    have hhi : x < 1 := by nlinarith
    have hr : qC h ξ / Qb γ.1 = (2:ℝ) ^ x := by
      unfold Qb
      rw [hx, Real.rpow_add (by norm_num), Real.rpow_logb (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hq,
        Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), div_inv_eq_mul]
    rw [hr]
    constructor
    · have h3 := Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) < 2) hlo
      rw [Real.rpow_neg_one] at h3
      have e : (2:ℝ)⁻¹ = 1 / 2 := by norm_num
      linarith
    · have h3 := Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) < 2) hhi
      rwa [Real.rpow_one] at h3
  intro B hB γ ξ hl hD heta
  refine ⟨(cib_band_bounds5 B.h γ.1 hl).1.le, ?_⟩
  have hD' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < B.qB := hD
  have hτ : 0 < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 := by linarith [hD'.2.1]
  have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hB.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).1
  have hw := (etaL_band_window_v5 B.h γ ξ hq heta).2
  have hQb : (0:ℝ) < Qb γ.1 := by
    unfold Qb
    exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hlogQ : Real.log (Qb γ.1) = -(γ.1 : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by
    unfold Qb
    rw [Real.log_rpow (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)]
  have hq2 : qC B.h ξ < 2 * Qb γ.1 := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hQb] at hw
    linarith
  have hlq : Real.log (qC B.h ξ) < Real.log (2 * Qb γ.1) := Real.log_lt_log hq hq2
  rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hQb.ne', hlogQ] at hlq
  have hlg : (1:ℝ)/2 < Real.log 2 := by
    have := Real.log_two_gt_d9
    norm_num at this ⊢
    linarith
  have hL1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (γ.1 : ℝ) := Nat.one_le_cast.mpr hl
  have hprod : ((γ.1 : ℝ) - 1) * (1/2) ≤ ((γ.1 : ℝ) - 1) * Real.log 2 :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlg.le (by linarith)
  have habs : -Real.log (qC B.h ξ) ≤ |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| := neg_le_abs _
  have hexp : ((γ.1 : ℝ) - 1) * Real.log 2 = (γ.1 : ℝ) * Real.log 2 - Real.log 2 := by ring
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (SC B.h ξ) = 1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| := by
    unfold SC
    exact Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)
  rw [hsq]
  have hexp2 : -(γ.1 : ℝ) * Real.log 2 = -((γ.1 : ℝ) * Real.log 2) := by ring
  rw [hexp2] at hlq
  linarith

by
  intro B G hB hG M hMs hM
  
  have key : ∀ {D E W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup D] [NormedSpace ℝ D] [NormedAddCommGroup E]
      [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : E → W) (V : Set E) (a : E)
      (T : D →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → a ∈ V → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro D E W _ _ _ _ _ _ F V a T hV hF ha i
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set E, s = (fun z : E => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩

      rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)

    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O

      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s

        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap

      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap

      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap

      (Φ : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin n => E) W) (T : D →L[ℝ] E) (Λ : D →L[ℝ] D)
      (Ln : E →L[ℝ] E) (R : D →L[ℝ] E), (∀ w, T (Λ w) = Ln (R w)) → ‖R‖ ≤ 1 →

        Complex.exp (-(2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) * ((k.1 : ℂ) * (Y.1 : ℂ) + (k.2 : ℂ) * (Y.2 : ℂ))))

    congr 1

          -(2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) * ((k.2 : ℂ) * (t : ℂ)) by ring, Complex.exp_add]
    ring
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℤ × ℤ → ℂ, ∀ k : ℤ × ℤ, c k =
      ∫ Z in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), (φ Z : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp (-(2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) * ((k.1 : ℂ) * (Z.1 : ℂ) + (k.2 : ℂ) * (Z.2 : ℂ))) :=

      Complex.exp ((2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) * ((k.1 : ℂ) * (Y.1 : ℂ) + (k.2 : ℂ) * (Y.2 : ℂ)))) (φ Y : ℂ) by

    rw [show u = fun n : ℤ => 1 / (1 + (n : ℝ) ^ 2) from funext hu]

  have hu1 : ∀ n, u n ≤ 1 := fun n => by
    rw [hu, div_le_one (by positivity)]

        Complex.exp (-(2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) * ((k1 : ℂ) * (s : ℂ))) := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩

    have hsm : Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖∫ y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, (φ (y, Y.2) : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp (-(2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) * ((n : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)))‖) := by

  have hmaj : Summable (fun k : ℤ × ℤ => M * (u k.1 * u k.2)) :=

  have h4 := (hF.prod_fiberwise hfib).unique H2
  rw [h4] at hF
  exact hF

    have I2 : ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), ((fderiv ℝ φ Y ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * E Y =
        (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (k.2 : ℂ)) *
          ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), (φ Y : ℂ) * E Y := by
      rw [fub _ (hPc _), fub _ hFc, ← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
      congr 1
      funext x
      exact lineY x
    have hlin : ∀ Y, fderiv ℝ φ Y w =
        w.1 * fderiv ℝ φ Y ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) + w.2 * fderiv ℝ φ Y ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) := by
      intro Y
      have e : w = w.1 • ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) + w.2 • ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) := by ext <;> simp
      calc fderiv ℝ φ Y w = fderiv ℝ φ Y (w.1 • ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) + w.2 • ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) := by rw [← e]
        _ = _ := by rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hlinC : ∀ Y, ((fderiv ℝ φ Y w : ℝ) : ℂ) * E Y =
        (w.1 : ℂ) * (((fderiv ℝ φ Y ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * E Y) +
          (w.2 : ℂ) * (((fderiv ℝ φ Y ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * E Y) := by
      intro Y
      rw [hlin Y]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hint : ∀ v : ℝ × ℝ, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun Y => ((fderiv ℝ φ Y v : ℝ) : ℂ) * E Y)
        (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) := fun v =>
      (hPc v).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)
    rw [show (fun Y => ((fderiv ℝ φ Y w : ℝ) : ℂ) * E Y) = fun Y =>
        (w.1 : ℂ) * (((fderiv ℝ φ Y ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * E Y) +
          (w.2 : ℂ) * (((fderiv ℝ φ Y ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * E Y) from funext hlinC]
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add ((hint _).const_mul _) ((hint _).const_mul _),
      MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, I1, I2]
    ring
  
  have pow5 : ∀ (a b X P : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → 0 ≤ X → X ≤ P →
      a ^ 5 * X ≤ P → b ^ 5 * X ≤ P → X * (1 + a + b) ^ 5 ≤ 729 * P := by
    intro a b X P ha hb hX hXP haP hbP
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = max 1 (max a b) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hc1 : 1 ≤ c := by rw [hc]; exact le_max_left _ _
    have hac : a ≤ c := by rw [hc]; exact le_trans (le_max_left a b) (le_max_right _ _)
    have hbc : b ≤ c := by rw [hc]; exact le_trans (le_max_right a b) (le_max_right _ _)
    have hcP : c ^ 5 * X ≤ P := by
      rcases max_choice 1 (max a b) with h1 | h1
      · rw [hc, h1, one_pow, one_mul]; exact hXP
      · rcases max_choice a b with h2 | h2
        · rw [hc, h1, h2]; exact haP
        · rw [hc, h1, h2]; exact hbP
    have h3 : (1 + a + b) ^ 5 ≤ (3 * c) ^ 5 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) (by linarith) 5
    have h4 : (3 * c) ^ 5 = 243 * c ^ 5 := by ring
    have hP0 : 0 ≤ P := le_trans hX hXP
    calc X * (1 + a + b) ^ 5 ≤ X * (243 * c ^ 5) := by
          rw [← h4]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hX
      _ = 243 * (c ^ 5 * X) := by ring
      _ ≤ 243 * P := by linarith
      _ ≤ 729 * P := by linarith
  
  have Jlin : ∀ (n : ℤ) (v : ℝ × ℝ), v.1 • Jpow n (1, 0) + v.2 • Jpow n (0, 1) = Jpow n v := by
    intro n v
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_ <;>
      simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd,
        smul_eq_mul] <;> ring
  have lnf : ∀ v : ℝ × ℝ, Lnorm h ξ ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), v) =
      ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Jpow (-(coarseIdx h (qC h ξ))) v) := by
    intro v
    have hJ : JpowL (-(coarseIdx h (qC h ξ))) v = Jpow (-(coarseIdx h (qC h ξ))) v := by
      rw [← Jlin]
      simp only [JpowL, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd']
    simp only [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap', Prod.map_apply, map_zero, hJ]
  
  have dot : ∀ e : ℝ × ℝ, (κ.1 : ℝ) * (Jpow (-(coarseIdx h (qC h ξ))) e).1 +
      (κ.2 : ℝ) * (Jpow (-(coarseIdx h (qC h ξ))) e).2 = (κ'.1 : ℝ) * e.1 + (κ'.2 : ℝ) * e.2 := by
    intro e
    have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := by rw [Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)]; norm_num
    have hL0 : (0:ℝ) < Lgc := by unfold Lgc; linarith
    have hT0 : (0:ℝ) < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; positivity
    have hD : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hx : Lgc ^ (coarseIdx h (qC h ξ)) ≠ 0 := zpow_ne_zero _ hL0.ne'
    have ht : Tgc ^ (coarseIdx h (qC h ξ)) ≠ 0 := zpow_ne_zero _ hT0.ne'
    have h1 : (κ.1 : ℝ) = (Jpow (coarseIdx h (qC h ξ)) ((κ'.1 : ℝ), (κ'.2 : ℝ))).1 := by rw [hκ]
    have h2 : (κ.2 : ℝ) = (Jpow (coarseIdx h (qC h ξ)) ((κ'.1 : ℝ), (κ'.2 : ℝ))).2 := by rw [hκ]
    rw [h1, h2]
    simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd,
      smul_eq_mul, zpow_neg]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have supb : ∀ (H : Cyl → ℝ) (c : ℝ), (∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, |H ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl)| ≤ c) →
      ‖fourY H ξ κ‖ ≤ c := by
    intro H c hc
    unfold fourY
    have hvol : (volume : Measure (ℝ × ℝ)) (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) = 1 := by
      rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod, Measure.prod_prod, Real.volume_Icc]; simp
    have hb : ∀ Y ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
        ‖(H ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp (-(2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) * ((κ.1 : ℂ) * (Y.1 : ℂ) + (κ.2 : ℂ) * (Y.2 : ℂ)))‖ ≤ c := by
      intro Y _
      rw [Complex.norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have hre : (-(2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          ((κ.1 : ℂ) * (Y.1 : ℂ) + (κ.2 : ℂ) * (Y.2 : ℂ))).re = 0 := by simp
      rw [hre, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
      exact hc Y
    have := norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := volume) (by rw [hvol]; exact ENNReal.one_lt_top) hb
    rw [measureReal_def, hvol] at this
    simpa using this
  
  have step : ∀ (v : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℕ) (w' : Fin n → Cyl),
      fourY (fun η => iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) g η (Fin.cons ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), v) w')) ξ κ =
        2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((κ.1 : ℂ) * (v.1 : ℂ) + (κ.2 : ℂ) * (v.2 : ℂ)) *
          fourY (fun η => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g η w') ξ κ := by
    intro v n w'
    have hPU : ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) ∈ U := by
      intro Y
      have e : shY ξ (Y - ξ.2.2.2) = ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) := by simp [shY]
      rw [← e]; exact hsat ξ hξ _
    have hDn : ∀ η ∈ U, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g) η := fun η hη =>
      (hg.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hη)).iteratedFDeriv_right (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hFn : ∀ η ∈ U, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun z => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g z w') η := by
      intro η hη
      first
      | exact (hDn η hη).continuousMultilinear_apply_const w'
      | exact (ContinuousMultilinearMap.apply ℝ (fun _ : Fin n => Cyl) ℝ w').contDiff.contDiffAt.comp η
          (hDn η hη)
    have hPc : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl)) :=
      contDiff_const.prodMk (contDiff_const.prodMk (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id))
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ : ∃ φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
        φ = fun Y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) w' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hφc' : φ = (fun z => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g z w') ∘
        (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl)) := by
      rw [hφ]; rfl
    have hφc : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ := by
      rw [hφc']
      exact contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr (fun Y => (hFn _ (hPU Y)).comp Y hPc.contDiffAt)
    have hφp : ∀ (p r : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), φ (Y + ((p:ℝ), (r:ℝ))) = φ Y := by
      intro p r Y
      have hev : (fun z => g (z + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((p:ℝ), (r:ℝ))))) =ᶠ[nhds ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl)] g := by
        filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds (hPU Y)] with z hz
        show g (z + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((p:ℝ), (r:ℝ)))) = g z
        have e : z + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((p:ℝ), (r:ℝ))) = shY z ((p:ℝ), (r:ℝ)) := by
          ext <;> simp [shY]
        rw [e]; exact hper z hz p r
      have e2 : ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y + ((p:ℝ), (r:ℝ))) : Cyl) =
          ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((p:ℝ), (r:ℝ))) := by
        ext <;> simp
      rw [hφ]
      show iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y + ((p:ℝ), (r:ℝ))) : Cyl) w' =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) w'
      rw [e2, ← iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right, (hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ n).eq_of_nhds]
    have hderiv : ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, fderiv ℝ φ Y v =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) (Fin.cons ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), v) w') := by
      intro Y
      have hPd : HasFDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl))
          ((0 : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).prod ((0 : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).prod ((0 : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).prod
            (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))))) Y :=
        (hasFDerivAt_const ξ.1 Y).prodMk ((hasFDerivAt_const ξ.2.1 Y).prodMk
          ((hasFDerivAt_const ξ.2.2.1 Y).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_id Y)))
      have hDd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g) ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) :=
        (hDn _ (hPU Y)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g z w') ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) :=
        (hFn _ (hPU Y)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      rw [hφc', fderiv_comp Y hFd hPd.differentiableAt, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hPd.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply]
      rw [fderiv_continuousMultilinear_apply_const_apply hDd, iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left,
        Fin.cons_zero, Fin.tail_cons]
    have key := cellIBP φ hφc hφp v κ
    simp only [hderiv] at key
    rw [hφ] at key
    unfold fourY
    exact key
  
  have hbd : ∀ (n : ℕ) (m : Fin n → Cyl) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), NB h g n ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) ≤ M →
      |iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) (fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m i))| ≤
        M * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := by
    intro n m Y hn
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have e : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) (fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m i)) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm h ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl))) m := rfl
    rw [e]
    calc _ ≤ NB h g n ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ ≤ M * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hn (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _))
  have G0 : ‖G‖ ≤ M * ∏ i, ‖w i‖ :=
    supb (fun η => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g η (fun i => Lnorm h ξ (w i))) _ (fun Y => hbd k w Y (hM Y).1)
  have fast : ∀ e : ℝ × ℝ, ‖e‖ = 1 →
      |(κ'.1 : ℝ) * e.1 + (κ'.2 : ℝ) * e.2| ^ 5 * ‖G‖ ≤ M * ∏ i, ‖w i‖ := by
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : ℝ × ℝ, u = Jpow (-(coarseIdx h (qC h ξ))) e := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨ε, hε⟩ : ∃ ε : Cyl, ε = ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), e) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℂ,
        c = 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((κ.1 : ℂ) * (u.1 : ℂ) + (κ.2 : ℂ) * (u.2 : ℂ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hLε : Lnorm h ξ ε = ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), u) := by rw [hε, lnf e, hu]
    have hεn : ‖ε‖ = 1 := by
      rw [hε, Prod.norm_def, Prod.norm_def, Prod.norm_def, he, norm_zero,
        max_eq_right (zero_le_one : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1), max_eq_right (zero_le_one : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1),
        max_eq_right (zero_le_one : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1)]
    have hcons : ∀ (n : ℕ) (m : Fin n → Cyl),
        (fun i => Lnorm h ξ ((Fin.cons ε m : Fin (n + 1) → Cyl) i)) =
          (Fin.cons ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), u) (fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m i)) : Fin (n + 1) → Cyl) := by
      intro n m
      have := Fin.comp_cons (⇑(Lnorm h ξ)) ε m
      rw [hLε] at this
      exact this
    have step' : ∀ (n : ℕ) (m : Fin n → Cyl),
        fourY (fun η => iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) g η
          (fun i => Lnorm h ξ ((Fin.cons ε m : Fin (n + 1) → Cyl) i))) ξ κ =
          c * fourY (fun η => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g η (fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m i))) ξ κ := by
      intro n m
      rw [hc]
      exact (congrArg (fun T : Fin (n + 1) → Cyl => fourY (fun η => iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) g η T) ξ κ)
        (hcons n m)).trans (step u n (fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m i)))
    have pc : ∀ (n : ℕ) (m : Fin n → Cyl),
        ∏ i, ‖(Fin.cons ε m : Fin (n + 1) → Cyl) i‖ = ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := by
      intro n m
      rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ]
      simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, hεn, one_mul]
    obtain ⟨m5, hm5⟩ : ∃ m5 : Fin (k + 5) → Cyl,
        m5 = Fin.cons ε (Fin.cons ε (Fin.cons ε (Fin.cons ε (Fin.cons ε w)))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have h5 : fourY (fun η => iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 5) g η (fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m5 i))) ξ κ =
        c * (c * (c * (c * (c * G)))) := by
      rw [hm5]
      exact (step' _ (Fin.cons ε (Fin.cons ε (Fin.cons ε (Fin.cons ε w))))).trans
        (congrArg (c * ·) ((step' _ (Fin.cons ε (Fin.cons ε (Fin.cons ε w)))).trans
        (congrArg (c * ·) ((step' _ (Fin.cons ε (Fin.cons ε w))).trans
        (congrArg (c * ·) ((step' _ (Fin.cons ε w)).trans
        (congrArg (c * ·) (step' k w))))))))
    have hprod : ∏ i, ‖m5 i‖ = ∏ i, ‖w i‖ := by
      rw [hm5]
      exact (pc _ (Fin.cons ε (Fin.cons ε (Fin.cons ε (Fin.cons ε w))))).trans
        ((pc _ (Fin.cons ε (Fin.cons ε (Fin.cons ε w)))).trans
        ((pc _ (Fin.cons ε (Fin.cons ε w))).trans
        ((pc _ (Fin.cons ε w)).trans (pc k w))))
    have hsup := supb (fun η => iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 5) g η (fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m5 i)))
      (M * ∏ i, ‖w i‖)
      (fun Y => (hbd (k + 5) m5 Y (hM Y).2).trans_eq (congrArg (fun t => M * t) hprod))
    rw [h5] at hsup
    have hcd : ((κ.1 : ℂ) * (u.1 : ℂ) + (κ.2 : ℂ) * (u.2 : ℂ)) =
        (((κ'.1 : ℝ) * e.1 + (κ'.2 : ℝ) * e.2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [← dot e, ← hu]
      first
      | (push_cast; ring)
      | push_cast
      | simp
    have hc' : c = ((2 * Real.pi * ((κ'.1 : ℝ) * e.1 + (κ'.2 : ℝ) * e.2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      rw [hc, hcd]
      first
      | (push_cast; ring)
      | push_cast
    have hge : |(κ'.1 : ℝ) * e.1 + (κ'.2 : ℝ) * e.2| ≤ ‖c‖ := by
      rw [hc', norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_one, abs_mul,
        abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi)]
      exact le_mul_of_one_le_left (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith [Real.pi_gt_three])
    have e5 : c * (c * (c * (c * (c * G)))) = c ^ 5 * G := by ring
    rw [e5, norm_mul, norm_pow] at hsup
    calc _ ≤ ‖c‖ ^ 5 * ‖G‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hge 5) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ _ := hsup
  have f1 := fast (1, 0) (by
    rw [Prod.norm_def, norm_one, norm_zero]; exact max_eq_left (zero_le_one : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1))
  have f2 := fast (0, 1) (by
    rw [Prod.norm_def, norm_one, norm_zero]; exact max_eq_right (zero_le_one : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1))
  simp only [mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add] at f1 f2
  have hfin := pow5 |(κ'.1 : ℝ)| |(κ'.2 : ℝ)| _ _ (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _) G0 f1 f2
  exact hfin.trans_eq (by ring)

subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h < 1/4 →
    (∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1/256 → 0 ≤ coarseIdx h q) ∧
    (∀ (n i j : ℤ), 0 ≤ n → ∃ i' j' : ℤ, Jpow n ((i : ℝ), (j : ℝ)) = ((i' : ℝ), (j' : ℝ))) ∧
    (∀ (m n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), Jpow m (Jpow n Y) = Jpow (m + n) Y) ∧

    (∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), bgc * (Jpow n Y).1 + (Jpow n Y).2 = Tgc ^ n * (bgc * Y.1 + Y.2)) ∧
    (∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → q < 2 * (2:ℝ) ^ (-(bandOf q : ℝ))) ∧
    (∀ q q' : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1/256 → 0 < q' → q' < 2 * (2:ℝ) ^ (-(bandOf q : ℝ)) →

  have shear : ∀ (h : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), Continuous h → (∀ Z : ℝ × ℝ, h (Z + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) = h Z) →
      ∀ (a : ℤ) (k : ℝ), a ≠ 0 →
      ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, h (Y.1, (a:ℝ) * Y.2 + k * Y.1) =
        ∫ Z in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, h Z := by
    intro h hc hp a k ha
    have hc' : Continuous (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => h (Y.1, (a:ℝ) * Y.2 + k * Y.1)) :=
      hc.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk
        ((continuous_const.mul continuous_snd).add (continuous_const.mul continuous_fst)))
    rw [fub _ hc', fub h hc]
    congr 1
    funext x
    exact per1 (fun y => h (x, y)) a (k * x) (hc.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))
      (fun y => by
        have := hp (x, y)
        simpa using this) ha
  
  have swp : ∀ f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
      ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, f (Y.2, Y.1) =
        ∫ Z in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, f Z := by
    intro f
    rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod]
    exact setIntegral_prod_swap (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) f
  
  have Ainv : ∀ g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, Continuous g →
      (∀ (Z : ℝ × ℝ) (i j : ℤ), g (Z + ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))) = g Z) →
      ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, g (3 * Y.1 + Y.2, Y.1 + 5 * Y.2) =
        ∫ Z in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, g Z := by
    intro g hg hp
    have h1c : Continuous (fun Z : ℝ × ℝ => g (Z.2, ((-14:ℤ):ℝ) * Z.1 + 5 * Z.2)) :=
      hg.comp (continuous_snd.prodMk
        ((continuous_const.mul continuous_fst).add (continuous_const.mul continuous_snd)))
    have h1p : ∀ Z : ℝ × ℝ, (fun Z : ℝ × ℝ => g (Z.2, ((-14:ℤ):ℝ) * Z.1 + 5 * Z.2))
        (Z + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) = (fun Z : ℝ × ℝ => g (Z.2, ((-14:ℤ):ℝ) * Z.1 + 5 * Z.2)) Z := by
      intro Z
      calc g ((Z + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))).2, ((-14:ℤ):ℝ) * (Z + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))).1 + 5 * (Z + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))).2)
          = g ((Z.2, ((-14:ℤ):ℝ) * Z.1 + 5 * Z.2) + (((1:ℤ):ℝ), ((5:ℤ):ℝ))) := by
            congr 1
            ext <;> push_cast [Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add] <;> ring
        _ = g (Z.2, ((-14:ℤ):ℝ) * Z.1 + 5 * Z.2) := hp _ 1 5
    have s1 := shear (fun Z : ℝ × ℝ => g (Z.2, ((-14:ℤ):ℝ) * Z.1 + 5 * Z.2)) h1c h1p 1 3 one_ne_zero
    have s2 := swp (fun W : ℝ × ℝ => g (W.1, ((-14:ℤ):ℝ) * W.2 + 5 * W.1))
    have hgp : ∀ Z : ℝ × ℝ, g (Z + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) = g Z := by
      intro Z
      have := hp Z 0 1
      simpa using this
    have s3 := shear g hg hgp (-14) 5 (by norm_num)
    calc ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, g (3 * Y.1 + Y.2, Y.1 + 5 * Y.2)
        = ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
            g ((Y.1, ((1:ℤ):ℝ) * Y.2 + 3 * Y.1).2,
              ((-14:ℤ):ℝ) * (Y.1, ((1:ℤ):ℝ) * Y.2 + 3 * Y.1).1 + 5 * (Y.1, ((1:ℤ):ℝ) * Y.2 + 3 * Y.1).2) := by
          congr 1
          funext Y
          congr 1
          ext <;> push_cast <;> ring
      _ = ∫ Z in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, g (Z.2, ((-14:ℤ):ℝ) * Z.1 + 5 * Z.2) := s1
      _ = ∫ W in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, g (W.1, ((-14:ℤ):ℝ) * W.2 + 5 * W.1) := s2
      _ = ∫ Z in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, g Z := s3
  
  have hsq2 : Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hsq0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
  have hsqlt : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := by nlinarith
  have hL : Lgc ≠ 0 := by unfold Lgc; intro h0; linarith
  have hT : Tgc ≠ 0 := by unfold Tgc; intro h0; linarith
  have hJ : ∀ (k : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), Jpow (k + 1) Y =
      (3 * (Jpow k Y).1 + (Jpow k Y).2, (Jpow k Y).1 + 5 * (Jpow k Y).2) := by
    intro k Y
    simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, Prod.mk_add_mk, smul_eq_mul, zpow_add_one₀ hL,
      zpow_add_one₀ hT]
    have hb : bgc = Real.sqrt 2 - 1 := rfl
    have hLd : Lgc = 4 - Real.sqrt 2 := rfl
    have hTd : Tgc = 4 + Real.sqrt 2 := rfl
    rw [hLd, hTd, hb, Prod.mk.injEq]
    constructor
    · linear_combination ((4 + Real.sqrt 2) ^ k * ((((Real.sqrt 2 - 1)) * Y.1 + Y.2) /
        (1 + (Real.sqrt 2 - 1) ^ 2))) * hsq2
    · linear_combination ((4 - Real.sqrt 2) ^ k * ((Y.1 - (Real.sqrt 2 - 1) * Y.2) /
        (1 + (Real.sqrt 2 - 1) ^ 2))) * hsq2
  have hJ0 : ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, Jpow 0 Y = Y := by
    intro Y
    ext <;> simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, Prod.mk_add_mk, smul_eq_mul, zpow_zero, one_mul] <;>
      field_simp <;> ring
  
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro g _ _
    simp [hJ0]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro g hg hp
    have hg' : Continuous (fun Z : ℝ × ℝ => g (3 * Z.1 + Z.2, Z.1 + 5 * Z.2)) :=
      hg.comp (((continuous_const.mul continuous_fst).add continuous_snd).prodMk
        (continuous_fst.add (continuous_const.mul continuous_snd)))
    have hp' : ∀ (Z : ℝ × ℝ) (i j : ℤ), (fun Z : ℝ × ℝ => g (3 * Z.1 + Z.2, Z.1 + 5 * Z.2))
        (Z + ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))) = (fun Z : ℝ × ℝ => g (3 * Z.1 + Z.2, Z.1 + 5 * Z.2)) Z := by
      intro Z i j
      calc g (3 * (Z + ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))).1 + (Z + ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))).2,
            (Z + ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))).1 + 5 * (Z + ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))).2)
          = g ((3 * Z.1 + Z.2, Z.1 + 5 * Z.2) + (((3 * i + j : ℤ):ℝ), ((i + 5 * j : ℤ):ℝ))) := by
            congr 1
            ext <;> push_cast [Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add] <;> ring
        _ = g (3 * Z.1 + Z.2, Z.1 + 5 * Z.2) := hp _ _ _
    have hih := ih _ hg' hp'
    calc ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, g (Jpow ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) Y)
        = ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
            g (3 * (Jpow (n:ℤ) Y).1 + (Jpow (n:ℤ) Y).2, (Jpow (n:ℤ) Y).1 + 5 * (Jpow (n:ℤ) Y).2) := by
          congr 1
          funext Y
          rw [Nat.cast_succ, hJ]
      _ = ∫ Z in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, g (3 * Z.1 + Z.2, Z.1 + 5 * Z.2) := hih
      _ = ∫ Z in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, g Z := Ainv g hg hp

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (P J : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (G : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ G → (∀ (s : ℝ) (Z : ℝ × ℝ) (i j : ℤ), G (s, Z + ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))) = G (s, Z)) → (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ J + 2 * P → ∀ x : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k G x‖ ≤ M) → ∀ m : ℤ × ℤ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => ∫ Z in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, (G (s, Z) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-(2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ((m.1 : ℂ) * (Z.1 : ℂ) + (m.2 : ℂ) * (Z.2 : ℂ))))) ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ J → ∀ s : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun s : ℝ => ∫ Z in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, (G (s, Z) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-(2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ((m.1 : ℂ) * (Z.1 : ℂ) + (m.2 : ℂ) * (Z.2 : ℂ))))) s‖ ≤ 4 ^ P * M / ((1 + |(m.1:ℝ)|) ^ P * (1 + |(m.2:ℝ)|) ^ P)

signature.name: box_coef_decay_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (P J : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (G : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ G → (∀ (s : ℝ) (Z : ℝ × ℝ) (i j : ℤ), G (s, Z + ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))) = G (s, Z)) → (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ J + 2 * P → ∀ x : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k G x‖ ≤ M) → ∀ m : ℤ × ℤ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => ∫ Z in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, (G (s, Z) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-(2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ((m.1 : ℂ) * (Z.1 : ℂ) + (m.2 : ℂ) * (Z.2 : ℂ))))) ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ J → ∀ s : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun s : ℝ => ∫ Z in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, (G (s, Z) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-(2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ((m.1 : ℂ) * (Z.1 : ℂ) + (m.2 : ℂ) * (Z.2 : ℂ))))) s‖ ≤ 4 ^ P * M / ((1 + |(m.1:ℝ)|) ^ P * (1 + |(m.2:ℝ)|) ^ P)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P J M G hG hper hM m
  
  obtain ⟨ex, hex⟩ : ∃ ex : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ, ∀ Z : ℝ × ℝ, ex Z = Complex.exp (-(2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I *
      ((m.1 : ℂ) * (Z.1 : ℂ) + (m.2 : ℂ) * (Z.2 : ℂ)))) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hexc : Continuous ex := by
    have e : ex = fun Z : ℝ × ℝ => Complex.exp (-(2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I *
        ((m.1 : ℂ) * (Z.1 : ℂ) + (m.2 : ℂ) * (Z.2 : ℂ)))) := funext hex
    rw [e]
    exact Complex.continuous_exp.comp ((continuous_const.mul
      ((continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst)).add
        (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd)))).neg)
  have hexn : ∀ Z : ℝ × ℝ, ‖ex Z‖ = 1 := by
    intro Z
    rw [hex]
    have e : -(2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ((m.1 : ℂ) * (Z.1 : ℂ) + (m.2 : ℂ) * (Z.2 : ℂ))) =
        ((-(2 * Real.pi * ((m.1:ℝ) * Z.1 + (m.2:ℝ) * Z.2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [e, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
  
  obtain ⟨cf, hcf⟩ : ∃ cf : (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ) → ℝ → ℂ, ∀ (F : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ) (s : ℝ),
      cf F s = ∫ Z in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, (F (s, Z) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-(2 * ↑Real.pi *
        Complex.I * ((m.1 : ℂ) * (Z.1 : ℂ) + (m.2 : ℂ) * (Z.2 : ℂ)))) := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hcf' : ∀ (F : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ) (s : ℝ),
      cf F s = ∫ Z in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, (F (s, Z) : ℂ) * ex Z := by
    intro F s
    rw [hcf]
    simp only [hex]
  have hfeq : (fun s : ℝ => ∫ Z in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, (G (s, Z) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-(2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ((m.1 : ℂ) * (Z.1 : ℂ) + (m.2 : ℂ) * (Z.2 : ℂ))))) = cf G :=
    funext fun s => (hcf G s).symm
  have hSq : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  have hSqm : MeasurableSet (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :=
    measurableSet_Icc.prod measurableSet_Icc
  have hvol : MeasureTheory.volume.real (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) = 1 := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_prod, Real.volume_Icc]
    simp
  
  have cfb : ∀ (F : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ) (C s : ℝ), (∀ Z : ℝ × ℝ, ‖F (s, Z)‖ ≤ C) → ‖cf F s‖ ≤ C := by
    intro F C s hF
    rw [hcf']
    have h := MeasureTheory.norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
      (s := Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (C := C) (f := fun Z => (F (s, Z) : ℂ) * ex Z)
      hSq.measure_lt_top (fun Z _ => by rw [norm_mul, hexn, mul_one, Complex.norm_real]; exact hF Z)
    rwa [hvol, mul_one] at h
  
  obtain ⟨Tv, hT⟩ : ∃ Tv : (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) → (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ) → (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ),
      ∀ v g y, Tv v g y = fderiv ℝ g y v := ⟨fun v g y => fderiv ℝ g y v, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  
  have step : ∀ (v : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) (g : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ), ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → ContDiff ℝ ∞ g →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Tv v g) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (Tv v g) x‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) g x‖) ∧
      ((∀ (s : ℝ) (Z : ℝ × ℝ) (i j : ℤ), g (s, Z + ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))) = g (s, Z)) →
        ∀ (s : ℝ) (Z : ℝ × ℝ) (i j : ℤ), Tv v g (s, Z + ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))) = Tv v g (s, Z)) := by
    intro v g hv hg
    have hTe : Tv v g = ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ g := by
      funext y
      rw [hT, Function.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply]
    have hd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ g) := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hg).2
    have hL : ‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v‖ ≤ 1 := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun A => ?_)
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply, one_mul]
      exact (A.le_opNorm v).trans (mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) hv)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hTe]
      exact (ContinuousLinearMap.contDiff _).comp hd
    · intro k x
      rw [hTe]
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v) ∘ fderiv ℝ g) x‖
          ≤ ‖ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ g) x‖ :=
            ContinuousLinearMap.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left _ hd.contDiffAt
              (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
        _ ≤ 1 * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ g) x‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) g x‖ := by rw [one_mul, norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
    · intro hp s Z i j
      rw [hT, hT]
      have hc : (fun y : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => g (y + ((0:ℝ), ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))))) = g := by
        funext y
        rcases y with ⟨a, b⟩
        show g ((a, b) + ((0:ℝ), ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ)))) = g (a, b)
        rw [Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero]
        exact hp a b i j
      have h2 := fderiv_comp_add_right (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := g) (x := (s, Z)) ((0:ℝ), ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ)))
      rw [hc, Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero] at h2
      rw [← h2]
  
  have iter : ∀ (v : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ), ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → ContDiff ℝ ∞ g →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ ((Tv v)^[n] g) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((Tv v)^[n] g) x‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + n) g x‖) ∧
      ((∀ (s : ℝ) (Z : ℝ × ℝ) (i j : ℤ), g (s, Z + ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))) = g (s, Z)) →
        ∀ (s : ℝ) (Z : ℝ × ℝ) (i j : ℤ), (Tv v)^[n] g (s, Z + ((i:ℝ), (j:ℝ))) = (Tv v)^[n] g (s, Z)) := by
    intro v n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro g _ hg
      exact ⟨hg, fun k x => le_rfl, fun hp => hp⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      intro g hv hg
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih g hv hg
      obtain ⟨k1, k2, k3⟩ := step v _ hv h1
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      refine ⟨k1, fun k x => (k2 k x).trans ?_, fun hp => k3 (h3 hp)⟩
      have h4 := h2 (k + 1) x
      rwa [show k + 1 + n = k + (n + 1) by omega] at h4
  
  have hasD : ∀ (f : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → ∀ s₀ : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (cf f) (cf (Tv ((1:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) f) s₀) s₀ := by
    intro f hf s₀
    have hfc : Continuous f := hf.continuous
    have hdf : Differentiable ℝ f := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hf).1
    have hdc : Continuous (fderiv ℝ f) := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hf).2.continuous
    have hslice : ∀ s : ℝ, Continuous (fun Z : ℝ × ℝ => (s, Z)) := fun s =>
      continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := ((isCompact_closedBall s₀ 1).prod hSq).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      hdc.continuousOn
    have hFc : ∀ s : ℝ, Continuous (fun Z : ℝ × ℝ => (f (s, Z) : ℂ) * ex Z) := fun s =>
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (hfc.comp (hslice s))).mul hexc
    have hF'c : ∀ s : ℝ, Continuous (fun Z : ℝ × ℝ =>
        ((fderiv ℝ f (s, Z) ((1:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ex Z) := fun s =>
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp ((hdc.comp (hslice s)).clm_apply continuous_const)).mul hexc
    have hbd : ∀ Z ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball s₀ 1,
        ‖((fderiv ℝ f (s, Z) ((1:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ex Z‖ ≤ B := by
      intro Z hZ s hs
      rw [norm_mul, hexn, mul_one, Complex.norm_real]
      have hn : ‖((1:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))‖ ≤ 1 := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
      refine ((fderiv ℝ f (s, Z)).le_opNorm _).trans ?_
      refine (mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) hn).trans ?_
      exact hB (s, Z) ⟨Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hs, hZ⟩
    have hderiv : ∀ (s : ℝ) (Z : ℝ × ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (f (s, Z) : ℂ) * ex Z)
        (((fderiv ℝ f (s, Z) ((1:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ex Z) s := by
      intro s Z
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (s, Z)) ((1:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) s :=
        (hasDerivAt_id s).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const s Z)
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (s, Z)) (fderiv ℝ f (s, Z) ((1:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))) s :=
        (hdf (s, Z)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s h1
      exact h2.ofReal_comp.mul_const (ex Z)

        (fun y : ℝ => Complex.exp (((lam * y : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * ((lam : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹)
        (Complex.exp (((lam * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) x := by
      intro x
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => lam * y) lam x := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul lam
      have h2 := ((h1.ofReal_comp).mul_const Complex.I).cexp.mul_const ((lam : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹
      convert h2 using 1
      rw [mul_assoc, hc1, mul_one]
    have hu : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc α β, HasDerivAt A (deriv A x) x := fun x _ => (hAd x).hasDerivAt
    have hEc : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((lam * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
      fun_prop
    have hibp := intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul (u := A) (u' := deriv A)
      (v := fun y : ℝ => Complex.exp (((lam * y : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * ((lam : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹)
      (v' := fun y : ℝ => Complex.exp (((lam * y : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      hu (fun x _ => hv x) (hcont.intervalIntegrable α β) (hEc.intervalIntegrable α β)
    beta_reduce at hibp
    rw [hsupp α (Or.inl le_rfl), hsupp β (Or.inr le_rfl), zero_mul, zero_mul, sub_zero,
      zero_sub] at hibp
    have hre : ∫ x in α..β, deriv A x * (Complex.exp (((lam * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        ((lam : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹) = (∫ x in α..β, deriv A x *
        Complex.exp (((lam * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) * ((lam : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹ := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => by ring)
    rw [hibp, hre, norm_neg, norm_mul]
    have hcn : ‖((lam : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹‖ = |lam|⁻¹ := by
      rw [norm_inv, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]
    rw [hcn]
    have hl : 0 < |lam| := abs_pos.mpr hlam
    calc ‖∫ x in α..β, deriv A x * Complex.exp (((lam * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ * |lam|⁻¹
        ≤ (β - α) * B / |lam| ^ p * |lam|⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hih (inv_nonneg.mpr hl.le)
      _ = (β - α) * B / |lam| ^ (p + 1) := by
          rw [pow_succ, div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv]
          ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (d s1 s2 : ℝ), 1 ≤ d → 0 < s1 → s1 < s2 → ∀ p : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (B : ℝ) (a : ℝ → ℂ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ a → (∀ s : ℝ, (s ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ s) → a s = 0) → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p → ∀ s : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv j a s‖ ≤ B) → ∃ A : ℝ → ℂ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ A ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, (x ≤ s1 ^ d ∨ s2 ^ d ≤ x) → A x = 0) ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv p A x‖ ≤ K * B) ∧ ∀ lam : ℝ, ∫ s in s1..s2, a s * Complex.exp (((lam * s ^ d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = ∫ x in (s1 ^ d)..(s2 ^ d), A x * Complex.exp (((lam * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)

signature.name: power_subst_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (d s1 s2 : ℝ), 1 ≤ d → 0 < s1 → s1 < s2 → ∀ p : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (B : ℝ) (a : ℝ → ℂ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ a → (∀ s : ℝ, (s ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ s) → a s = 0) → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p → ∀ s : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv j a s‖ ≤ B) → ∃ A : ℝ → ℂ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ A ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, (x ≤ s1 ^ d ∨ s2 ^ d ≤ x) → A x = 0) ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv p A x‖ ≤ K * B) ∧ ∀ lam : ℝ, ∫ s in s1..s2, a s * Complex.exp (((lam * s ^ d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = ∫ x in (s1 ^ d)..(s2 ^ d), A x * Complex.exp (((lam * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro d s1 s2 hd1 hs1 hs12 p
  
  have c3b : ∀ (a : ℝ → ℂ) (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℂ) (U : Set ℝ) (x : ℝ) (B D E : ℝ),
      IsOpen U → x ∈ U → ContDiff ℝ ∞ a → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → 1 ≤ D →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ p → ‖iteratedDeriv i a (ψ x)‖ ≤ B) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ p → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i ψ x‖ ≤ D ^ i) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ p → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g x‖ ≤ E) →
      ‖iteratedDeriv p (fun y => a (ψ y) * g y) x‖ ≤ 2 ^ p * (p.factorial : ℝ) * D ^ p * E * B := by
    intro a ψ g U x B D E hU hx ha hψ hg hD haB hψD hgE
    have hB : 0 ≤ B := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (haB 0 (Nat.zero_le _))
    have hE : 0 ≤ E := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hgE 0 (Nat.zero_le _))
    have hD0 : 0 < D := by linarith
    have hUd : UniqueDiffOn ℝ U := hU.uniqueDiffOn
    have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => a (ψ y)) U := ha.contDiffOn.comp hψ (Set.mapsTo_univ ψ U)
    have hfi : ∀ i, i ≤ p → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun y => a (ψ y)) U x‖ ≤
        (p.factorial : ℝ) * B * D ^ p := by
      intro i hi
      have h1 := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le (g := a) (f := ψ) (n := i) (s := U)
        (t := Set.univ) (x := x) (N := ∞)
        ha.contDiffOn hψ (by exact_mod_cast le_top) uniqueDiffOn_univ hUd (Set.mapsTo_univ ψ U) hx
        (C := B) (D := D)
        (fun j hj => by
          rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_univ, norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
          exact haB j (hj.trans hi))
        (fun j hj1 hj2 => by
          rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hU hx]
          exact hψD j hj1 (hj2.trans hi))
      have h2 : (i.factorial : ℝ) ≤ p.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le hi
      have h3 : D ^ i ≤ D ^ p := pow_le_pow_right₀ hD hi
      calc ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun y => a (ψ y)) U x‖
          = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (a ∘ ψ) U x‖ := rfl
        _ ≤ (i.factorial : ℝ) * B * D ^ i := h1
        _ ≤ (p.factorial : ℝ) * B * D ^ p :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 hB) h3 (pow_nonneg hD0.le _)
            (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hB)
    have hL := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hf hg hUd hx (n := p) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, ← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen p hU hx]
    refine hL.trans ?_
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p + 1), (p.choose i : ℝ) *
          ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun y => a (ψ y)) U x‖ * ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ (p - i) g U x‖
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p + 1), (p.choose i : ℝ) * ((p.factorial : ℝ) * B * D ^ p * E) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          have hi' : i ≤ p := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          rw [mul_assoc]
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
          rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (p - i) hU hx]
          exact mul_le_mul (hfi i hi') (hgE (p - i) (Nat.sub_le _ _)) (norm_nonneg _)
            (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hB) (pow_nonneg hD0.le _))
      _ = 2 ^ p * (p.factorial : ℝ) * D ^ p * E * B := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
          have hs : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p + 1), (p.choose i : ℝ) = 2 ^ p := by
            exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose p
          rw [hs]; ring
  
  have hd0 : 0 < d := by linarith
  have hs2 : 0 < s2 := hs1.trans hs12
  have hα : 0 < s1 ^ d := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hs1 d
  have hθ : 0 ≤ d⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hd0.le
  have hψs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ => y ^ d⁻¹) (Set.Ioi 0) := fun y hy =>
    (Real.contDiffAt_rpow_const_of_ne (ne_of_gt hy)).contDiffWithinAt
  have hgs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ => ((d⁻¹ * y ^ (d⁻¹ - 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ => d⁻¹ * y ^ (d⁻¹ - 1)) y :=
      contDiffAt_const.mul (Real.contDiffAt_rpow_const_of_ne (ne_of_gt hy))
    exact (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffAt y h1).contDiffWithinAt
  
  have hsub : Set.Icc (s1 ^ d) (s2 ^ d) ⊆ Set.Ioi 0 := fun x hx => lt_of_lt_of_le hα hx.1
  have hcpt : ∀ {G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (f : ℝ → G),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (Set.Ioi 0) → ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ R : ℝ,
        ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (s1 ^ d) (s2 ^ d), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ ≤ R := by
    intro G _ _ f hf i
    have hc := hf.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (m := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      (isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn)
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := s1 ^ d) (b := s2 ^ d)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hc.mono hsub)
    refine ⟨R, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i isOpen_Ioi (hsub hx)]
    exact hR x hx
  choose R hR using hcpt _ hψs
  choose Eb hEb using hcpt _ hgs
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p + 1), |R i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℝ, E = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p + 1), |Eb i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by
    rw [hD]; linarith [Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.range (p + 1)) => abs_nonneg (R i))]
  have hE0 : 0 ≤ E := by
    rw [hE]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg (Eb i))
  have hDb : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (s1 ^ d) (s2 ^ d), ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ p →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y : ℝ => y ^ d⁻¹) x‖ ≤ D ^ i := by
    intro x hx i hi1 hip
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y : ℝ => y ^ d⁻¹) x‖ ≤ R i := hR i x hx
      _ ≤ |R i| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (p + 1), |R j| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |R j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
            (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
      _ ≤ D := by rw [hD]; linarith
      _ ≤ D ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
  have hEbd : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (s1 ^ d) (s2 ^ d), ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ p →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y : ℝ => ((d⁻¹ * y ^ (d⁻¹ - 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)) x‖ ≤ E := by
    intro x hx i hip
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y : ℝ => ((d⁻¹ * y ^ (d⁻¹ - 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)) x‖ ≤ Eb i := hEb i x hx
      _ ≤ |Eb i| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ E := by
          rw [hE]
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Eb j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
            (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ 2 ^ p * (p.factorial : ℝ) * D ^ p * E :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
      (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _)) hE0
  refine ⟨2 ^ p * (p.factorial : ℝ) * D ^ p * E, hK0, ?_⟩
  intro B a ha hsupp hbd
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hbd 0 (Nat.zero_le _) 0)
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ → ℂ, A = fun x : ℝ =>
      if 0 < x then a (x ^ d⁻¹) * ((d⁻¹ * x ^ (d⁻¹ - 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) else 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hAx : ∀ x : ℝ, A x = if 0 < x then a (x ^ d⁻¹) * ((d⁻¹ * x ^ (d⁻¹ - 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) else 0 := by
    intro x; rw [hA]
  
  have hsuppA : ∀ x : ℝ, (x ≤ s1 ^ d ∨ s2 ^ d ≤ x) → A x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hAx]
    by_cases hx0 : 0 < x
    · rw [if_pos hx0, hsupp _ ?_, zero_mul]
      rcases hx with h | h
      · left
        calc x ^ d⁻¹ ≤ (s1 ^ d) ^ d⁻¹ := Real.rpow_le_rpow hx0.le h hθ
          _ = s1 := Real.rpow_rpow_inv hs1.le hd0.ne'
      · right
        calc s2 = (s2 ^ d) ^ d⁻¹ := (Real.rpow_rpow_inv hs2.le hd0.ne').symm
          _ ≤ x ^ d⁻¹ := Real.rpow_le_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hs2.le _) h hθ
    · rw [if_neg hx0]
  
  have hAs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro x
    by_cases hx0 : 0 < x
    · have hev : A =ᶠ[nhds x] fun y => a (y ^ d⁻¹) * ((d⁻¹ * y ^ (d⁻¹ - 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hx0)
          (fun y hy => by rw [hAx, if_pos (show (0:ℝ) < y from hy)])
      refine ContDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_ hev
      exact (ha.comp_contDiffAt x (Real.contDiffAt_rpow_const_of_ne hx0.ne')).mul
        (hgs.contDiffAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hx0))
    · have hev : A =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => (0:ℂ) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Iio_mem_nhds (show x < s1 ^ d by linarith [not_lt.mp hx0]))
          (fun y hy => hsuppA y (Or.inl (le_of_lt hy)))
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  have hz : iteratedDeriv p (fun _ : ℝ => (0:ℂ)) = fun _ => 0 := by
    funext x; rw [iteratedDeriv_const]; split_ifs <;> rfl
  refine ⟨A, hAs, hsuppA, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro x
    rcases lt_or_ge x (s1 ^ d) with hxa | hxa
    · have hev : A =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => (0:ℂ) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Iio_mem_nhds hxa) (fun y hy => hsuppA y (Or.inl (le_of_lt hy)))
      rw [hev.iteratedDeriv_eq, hz, norm_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg hK0 hB0
    rcases lt_or_ge (s2 ^ d) x with hxb | hxb
    · have hev : A =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => (0:ℂ) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hxb) (fun y hy => hsuppA y (Or.inr (le_of_lt hy)))
      rw [hev.iteratedDeriv_eq, hz, norm_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg hK0 hB0
    have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hα hxa
    have hev : A =ᶠ[nhds x] fun y => a (y ^ d⁻¹) * ((d⁻¹ * y ^ (d⁻¹ - 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hx0)
        (fun y hy => by rw [hAx, if_pos (show (0:ℝ) < y from hy)])
    rw [hev.iteratedDeriv_eq]
    have hmain := c3b a (fun y : ℝ => y ^ d⁻¹) (fun y : ℝ => ((d⁻¹ * y ^ (d⁻¹ - 1) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (Set.Ioi 0) x B D E isOpen_Ioi hx0 ha hψs hgs hD1 (fun i hi => hbd i hi _)
      (fun i h1 h2 => hDb x ⟨hxa, hxb⟩ i h1 h2) (fun i hi => hEbd x ⟨hxa, hxb⟩ i hi)
    refine hmain.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    ring
  · 
    intro lam
    have hpos : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc s1 s2, 0 < s := by
      intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hs12.le] at hs
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hs1 hs.1
    have hG : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => A x * Complex.exp (((lam * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) :=
      hAs.continuous.mul (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
        ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).mul continuous_const))
    have hcov : ∫ s in s1..s2, (d * s ^ (d - 1)) •
          (A (s ^ d) * Complex.exp (((lam * s ^ d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) =
        ∫ x in (s1 ^ d)..(s2 ^ d), A x * Complex.exp (((lam * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_deriv_smul_comp (a := s1) (b := s2)
        (f := fun s : ℝ => s ^ d) (f' := fun s => d * s ^ (d - 1))
        (g := fun x : ℝ => A x * Complex.exp (((lam * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I))
        (fun s hs => Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl (ne_of_gt (hpos s hs))))
        (continuousOn_const.mul (continuousOn_id.rpow_const
          (fun s hs => Or.inl (ne_of_gt (hpos s hs))))) hG
    rw [← hcov]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s hs
    have hsp := hpos s hs
    have hsd : 0 < s ^ d := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hsp d
    show a s * Complex.exp (((lam * s ^ d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
      (d * s ^ (d - 1)) • (A (s ^ d) * Complex.exp (((lam * s ^ d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I))
    rw [hAx, if_pos hsd, Real.rpow_rpow_inv hsp.le hd0.ne', ← Real.rpow_mul hsp.le,
      Complex.real_smul]
    have e : d * (d⁻¹ - 1) = -(d - 1) := by rw [mul_sub, mul_inv_cancel₀ hd0.ne']; ring
    have h1 : s ^ (d - 1) ≠ 0 := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hsp _).ne'
    have key : (d * s ^ (d - 1)) * (d⁻¹ * s ^ (d * (d⁻¹ - 1))) = 1 := by
      rw [e, Real.rpow_neg hsp.le, mul_mul_mul_comm, mul_inv_cancel₀ hd0.ne',
        mul_inv_cancel₀ h1, one_mul]
    have key' : ((d * s ^ (d - 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((d⁻¹ * s ^ (d * (d⁻¹ - 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) = 1 := by
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, key, Complex.ofReal_one]
    linear_combination (-(a s * Complex.exp (((lam * s ^ d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I))) * key'

by
  intro B G γ m ξ hAw hpw hW
  
  have gf1 : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (f : Cyl → W) (w : Cyl → Cyl),
      f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → (fun η => fderiv ℝ f η (w η)) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by

    rw [hη.fderiv_eq]

  have hdT : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℂ), f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → dT f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := fun f hf =>
    gf1 f (fun _ => (0, 0, 1, vtv)) hf
  have hdTsV : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℂ), f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → dTsV f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := fun f hf =>
    gf1 f (fun _ => (0, 0, 1, ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))) hf
  have hdVc : ∀ (l : ℕ) (F : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), F =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → dVc B l F =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := fun l F hF =>
    gf1 F (fun _ => dVdir B.h l) hF
  
  have hcomp : ∀ (F : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (i : Fin 3), F =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → (fun η => F η i) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
    intro F i hF
    filter_upwards [hF] with η h
    simp [h]
  
  have ev0 : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] (f : Cyl → W), f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → f ξ = 0 := by
    intro W _ f hf
    simpa using hf.eq_of_nhds
  
  have hmcurl : ∀ (n : ℤ) (C : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), C =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → mcurlC B.h n C =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
    intro n C hC
    filter_upwards [hC, hdZ _ (hcomp C 1 hC), hdZ _ (hcomp C 0 hC), hdR _ (hcomp C 2 hC),
      hdR _ (hcomp C 1 hC)] with η h0 h1 h2 h3 h4
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at h0 h1 h2 h3 h4
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [mcurlC, h0, h1, h2, h3, h4]
  
  have hmres : ∀ (n : ℤ) (a : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (p : Cyl → ℂ), a =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → p =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 →
      mresC B n a p ξ = 0 := by
    intro n a p ha hp
    have hai : ∀ i, (fun η => a η i) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := fun i => hcomp a i ha
    have v0 : ∀ i, a ξ i = 0 := fun i => ev0 _ (hai i)
    have vT : ∀ i, dT (fun η => a η i) ξ = 0 := fun i => ev0 _ (hdT _ (hai i))
    have vR : ∀ i, dR B.h (fun η => a η i) ξ = 0 := fun i => ev0 _ (hdR _ (hai i))
    have vZ : ∀ i, dZ (fun η => a η i) ξ = 0 := fun i => ev0 _ (hdZ _ (hai i))
    have vRR : ∀ i, dR B.h (dR B.h (fun η => a η i)) ξ = 0 := fun i => ev0 _ (hdR _ (hdR _ (hai i)))
    have vZZ : ∀ i, dZ (dZ (fun η => a η i)) ξ = 0 := fun i => ev0 _ (hdZ _ (hdZ _ (hai i)))
    have pv : p ξ = 0 := ev0 _ hp
    have pR : dR B.h p ξ = 0 := ev0 _ (hdR _ hp)
    have pZ : dZ p ξ = 0 := ev0 _ (hdZ _ hp)
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [mresC, mlapC, v0, vT, vR, vZ, vRR, vZZ, pv, pR, pZ]
  
  have hvelg : ∀ (c : WC), c γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → velC5 B G c γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
    intro c hc
    filter_upwards [hc, hdR _ (hcomp _ 0 hc), hdR _ (hcomp _ 1 hc), hdR _ (hcomp _ 2 hc),
      hdZ _ (hcomp _ 0 hc), hdZ _ (hcomp _ 1 hc), hdZ _ (hcomp _ 2 hc)] with η h0 r0 r1 r2 z0 z1 z2
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at h0 r0 r1 r2 z0 z1 z2
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [velC5, DrC, DzC, h0, r0, r1, r2, z0, z1, z2]
  
  have hwmo : wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hAw, hvelg _ hAw] with η h1 h2
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at h1 h2
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [wmoAmp5, velW5, h1, h2, rotC]
  have hA : ampA5 B G γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hwmo] with η h
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at h
    simp [ampA5, h]
  have hPP : presP5 B G γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hpw] with η h
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at h
    simp [presP5, h]
  have hD : (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • ampD5 B G γ' m' η) γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hwmo, hW] with η h1 h2
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at h1 h2
    simp [ampD5, h1, h2]
  
  have hrem : ∀ (a : WC) (P : WS) (d : WC), a γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → P γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 →
      d γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 →
      (remSlow5 B a + remPhase5 B G a + remPres5 B P + remVisc5 B G a + remBase5 B a + primOp5 B G d) γ m ξ
        = 0 := by
    intro a P d ha hP hd
    have hai : ∀ i, (fun η => a γ m η i) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := fun i => hcomp (a γ m) i ha
    have a0 : a γ m ξ = 0 := ev0 _ ha
    have v0 : ∀ i, a γ m ξ i = 0 := fun i => ev0 _ (hai i)
    have vS : ∀ i, dTsV (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ = 0 := fun i => ev0 _ (hdTsV _ (hai i))
    have vR : ∀ i, dR B.h (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ = 0 := fun i => ev0 _ (hdR _ (hai i))
    have vZ : ∀ i, dZ (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ = 0 := fun i => ev0 _ (hdZ _ (hai i))
    have vRR : ∀ i, dR B.h (fun η => dR B.h (fun η' => a γ m η' i) η) ξ = 0 := fun i =>
      ev0 _ (hdR _ (hdR _ (hai i)))
    have vZZ : ∀ i, dZ (fun η => dZ (fun η' => a γ m η' i) η) ξ = 0 := fun i =>
      ev0 _ (hdZ _ (hdZ _ (hai i)))
    have pR : dR B.h (P γ m) ξ = 0 := ev0 _ (hdR _ hP)
    have pZ : dZ (P γ m) ξ = 0 := ev0 _ (hdZ _ hP)
    have d0 : d γ m ξ = 0 := ev0 _ hd
    have dV : dVc B γ.1 (d γ m) ξ = 0 := ev0 _ (hdVc _ _ hd)
    have e1 : remSlow5 B a γ m ξ = 0 := by
      funext i
      simp [remSlow5, vS, vR, vZ]
    have e2 : remPhase5 B G a γ m ξ = 0 := by
      simp [remPhase5, a0]
    have e3 : remPres5 B P γ m ξ = 0 := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [remPres5, pR, pZ]
    have e4 : remVisc5 B G a γ m ξ = 0 := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [remVisc5, v0, vR, vZ, vRR, vZZ]
    have e5 : remBase5 B a γ m ξ = 0 := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [remBase5, v0]
    have e6 : primOp5 B G d γ m ξ = 0 := by
      simp [primOp5, d0, dV]
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    rw [e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6]
    simp
  
  have hC : cofA5 B G γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hAw] with η h
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at h
    simp [cofA5, h]
  have hP : cofP5 B G γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hpw] with η h
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at h
    simp [cofP5, h]
  have hL : linC5 B G γ m ξ = 0 := by
    have e : linC5 B G γ m ξ = (((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))⁻¹) •
        mresC B (m * pint5 B G γ) (mcurlC B.h (m * pint5 B G γ) (cofA5 B G γ m)) (cofP5 B G γ m) ξ := rfl
    rw [e, hmres _ _ _ (hmcurl _ _ hC) hP, smul_zero]
  have hWv : W0h4 B G γ m ξ = 0 := ev0 _ hW
  have hWd : dVc B γ.1 (W0h4 B G γ m) ξ = 0 := ev0 _ (hdVc _ _ hW)
  have hpv : (primState5 B G).pw γ m ξ = 0 := ev0 _ hpw
  have hPr : princC5 B G γ m ξ = 0 := by
    simp [princC5, hWv, hWd, hpv]
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
  rw [hL, hPr, sub_zero]
  exact (hrem _ _ _ hA hPP hD).symm

signature.name: amp_smooth_near5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (U : Set Cyl), B.ok → IsOpen U → U ⊆ DomC B.h B.qB → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (phiL5 B G γ) U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((primState5 B G).Aw γ m) U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((primState5 B G).pw γ m) U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (W0h4 B G γ m) U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ampA5 B G γ m) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ampD5 B G γ m) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (presP5 B G γ m) U

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G γ m U hok hU hUsub hφ hAw hpw hW
  have hpos : ∀ ξ ∈ U, 0 < ξ.1 := fun ξ hξ => (hUsub hξ).1
  
  have hdir : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h f) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ f) U := by
    intro V _ _ f hf
    have hDf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) U :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hf).2
    have hpow : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) U :=
      contDiff_fst.contDiffOn.rpow_const_of_ne (fun ξ hξ => (hpos ξ hξ).ne')
    have hY : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) U :=
      (contDiffOn_const.mul hpow).smul_const _
    have hvR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl =>
        ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)) U :=
      contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk hY))
    exact ⟨(hDf.clm_apply hvR).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl),
      (hDf.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)⟩
  
  have hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) U := by
    have h4' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1
    have hπ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) U (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := (hUsub hξ).2.1
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    exact (h4'.comp hπ.contDiffOn hmaps).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
  have hq0 : ∀ ξ ∈ U, 0 < qC B.h ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := (hUsub hξ).2.1
    exact (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hlogU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) U :=
    hq.log (fun ξ hξ => (hq0 ξ hξ).ne')
  have hℓ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η))) U :=
    (hdir _ hlogU).2
  have hcast : ∀ g : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((g η : ℝ) : ℂ)) U := by
    intro g hg
    exact (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hg).congr
      (fun η _ => by simp only [Function.comp_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply])
  
  have hQ : 0 < Qb γ.1 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hsQ : 0 < Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQ
  have hRC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => RC γ.1 η) U := by
    unfold RC
    exact (contDiff_fst.div_const _).contDiffOn
  have hRCne : ∀ η ∈ U, RC γ.1 η ≠ 0 := fun η hη => (div_pos (hpos η hη) hsQ).ne'
  have hRCi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (RC γ.1 η)⁻¹) U := hRC.inv hRCne
  
  have hn : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => nPhi5 B G γ ξ i) U := by
    obtain ⟨hdRφ, hdZφ⟩ := hdir _ hφ
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact (hdRφ.const_smul (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1))).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
    · exact ((contDiffOn_const (c := pang5 B G γ)).div hRC hRCne).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
    · exact (hdZφ.const_smul (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1))).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
  have hnc : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => ((nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) U :=
    fun i => hcast _ (hn i)
  
  have hAwi : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η j) U :=
    fun j => contDiffOn_pi.1 hAw j
  have hDr : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun ξ => DrC B γ.1 (fun η => (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η j) ξ) U :=
    fun j => ((hdir _ (hAwi j)).1.const_smul (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1))).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
  have hDz : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun ξ => DzC B γ.1 (fun η => (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η j) ξ) U :=
    fun j => ((hdir _ (hAwi j)).2.const_smul (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1))).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
  
  have hvel : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (velW5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ m) U := by
    refine contDiffOn_pi.2 (fun i => ?_)
    fin_cases i
    · exact (((contDiffOn_const (c := Complex.I * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ))).mul
        (((hnc 1).mul (hAwi 2)).sub ((hnc 2).mul (hAwi 1)))).sub (hDz 1)).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
    · exact ((((contDiffOn_const (c := Complex.I * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ))).mul
        (((hnc 2).mul (hAwi 0)).sub ((hnc 0).mul (hAwi 2)))).add (hDz 0)).sub (hDr 2)).congr
        (fun ξ _ => rfl)
    · refine ((((contDiffOn_const (c := Complex.I * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ))).mul
        (((hnc 0).mul (hAwi 1)).sub ((hnc 1).mul (hAwi 0)))).add (hDr 1)).add
        ((hAwi 1).mul (hcast _ hRCi))).congr (fun ξ _ => ?_)
      show Complex.I * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) *
          (((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (primState5 B G).Aw γ m ξ 1 -
            ((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (primState5 B G).Aw γ m ξ 0) +
          DrC B γ.1 (fun η => (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η 1) ξ +
          (primState5 B G).Aw γ m ξ 1 / ((RC γ.1 ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        Complex.I * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) *
          (((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (primState5 B G).Aw γ m ξ 1 -
            ((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (primState5 B G).Aw γ m ξ 0) +
          DrC B γ.1 (fun η => (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η 1) ξ +
          (primState5 B G).Aw γ m ξ 1 * (((RC γ.1 ξ)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv, Complex.ofReal_inv]
  
  have he3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (qC B.h η / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ)) U :=
    (hq.div_const _).rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (div_pos (hq0 η hη) hQ).ne')
  have he4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ)) U :=
    hq.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hq0 η hη).ne')
  have he6 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun η => B.h * qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) η) U :=
    ((contDiffOn_const (c := B.h)).mul he4).mul hℓ
  have hrot : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => rotC ((primState5 B G).Aw γ m η) i) U := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact (hAwi 1).congr (fun _ _ => rfl)
    · exact (hAwi 0).neg.congr (fun _ _ => rfl)
    · exact (contDiffOn_const (c := (0:ℂ))).congr (fun _ _ => rfl)
  have hw : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η i) U := by
    intro i
    exact (((hcast _ he3).mul (contDiffOn_pi.1 hvel i)).add
      ((hcast _ he6).mul (hrot i))).congr (fun _ _ => rfl)
  
  have he1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) U :=
    hq.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hq0 η hη).ne')
  have he2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-2 * Aex B.h)) U :=
    hq.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hq0 η hη).ne')
  have he5 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => rhoQ B γ η ^ (1/2:ℝ)) U :=
    he3.congr (fun _ _ => rfl)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine contDiffOn_pi.2 (fun i => ?_)
    exact ((hcast _ he1).mul (hw i)).congr (fun _ _ => rfl)
  · refine contDiffOn_pi.2 (fun i => ?_)
    exact ((hw i).sub ((hcast _ he5).mul (contDiffOn_pi.1 hW i))).congr (fun _ _ => rfl)
  · exact ((hcast _ he2).mul hpw).congr (fun _ _ => rfl)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (U : Set Cyl), B.ok → IsOpen U → U ⊆ DomC B.h B.qB → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (phiL5 B G γ) U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((primState5 B G).Aw γ m) U → ∀ ξ ∈ U, linC5 B G γ m ξ = ((((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))⁻¹) • mresC B (m * pint5 B G γ) (fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) • ampA5 B G γ m η) (fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) * presP5 B G γ m η) ξ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G γ m U hok hUo hUsub hφ hAw ξ hξ
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  have hqpos : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, 0 < qC B.h η := fun η hη =>
    (hS.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith [hη.2.1])).1
  have hqdiff : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, DifferentiableAt ℝ (qC B.h) η := by
    intro η hη
    have hmem : ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - η.2.2.1 by linarith [hη.2.1]⟩
    have hat : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt ((isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds hmem)
    have hp : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η' : Cyl => ((η'.2.1, 1 - η'.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) η := by fun_prop
    show DifferentiableAt ℝ ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
      (fun η' : Cyl => ((η'.2.1, 1 - η'.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))) η
    exact (hat.differentiableAt (by simp)).comp η hp
  have hQ : 0 < Qb γ.1 := by unfold Qb; positivity
  have hk : 0 < kb B.h γ.1 :=
    Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ _) _)
  have hk' : ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk.ne'
  have hsQ : (((Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQ).ne'
  
  have hgerm : ∀ (n : ℤ) (a a' : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (p : Cyl → ℂ), a =ᶠ[nhds ξ] a' →
      mresC B n a p ξ = mresC B n a' p ξ := by
    intro n a a' p hA
    have hloc : ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℂ) (y : Cyl), f =ᶠ[nhds y] g →
        dR B.h f y = dR B.h g y ∧ dZ f y = dZ g y ∧ dT f y = dT g y := by
      intro f g y hfg
      have e := hfg.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ)
      simp only [dR, dZ, dT, e, and_self]
    have hc : ∀ i : Fin 3, (fun η => a η i) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] (fun η => a' η i) := fun i =>
      hA.mono (fun η hη => congrFun hη i)
    have hRR : ∀ i : Fin 3, dR B.h (fun η => a η i) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] dR B.h (fun η => a' η i) := by
      intro i
      filter_upwards [(hc i).eventuallyEq_nhds] with y hy
      exact (hloc _ _ y hy).1
    have hZZ : ∀ i : Fin 3, dZ (fun η => a η i) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] dZ (fun η => a' η i) := by
      intro i
      filter_upwards [(hc i).eventuallyEq_nhds] with y hy
      exact (hloc _ _ y hy).2.1
    have hv : a ξ = a' ξ := hA.eq_of_nhds
    have h1 : ∀ i : Fin 3, dR B.h (fun η => a η i) ξ = dR B.h (fun η => a' η i) ξ :=
      fun i => (hloc _ _ ξ (hc i)).1
    have h2 : ∀ i : Fin 3, dZ (fun η => a η i) ξ = dZ (fun η => a' η i) ξ :=
      fun i => (hloc _ _ ξ (hc i)).2.1
    have h3 : ∀ i : Fin 3, dT (fun η => a η i) ξ = dT (fun η => a' η i) ξ :=
      fun i => (hloc _ _ ξ (hc i)).2.2
    have h4 : ∀ i : Fin 3, dR B.h (dR B.h (fun η => a η i)) ξ = dR B.h (dR B.h (fun η => a' η i)) ξ :=
      fun i => (hloc _ _ ξ (hRR i)).1
    have h5 : ∀ i : Fin 3, dZ (dZ (fun η => a η i)) ξ = dZ (dZ (fun η => a' η i)) ξ :=
      fun i => (hloc _ _ ξ (hZZ i)).2.1
    simp only [mresC, mlapC, hv, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5]
  
  have hprod : ∀ (g φ : Cyl → ℝ) (F : Cyl → ℂ) (e : ℝ) (a b : ℂ) (η v : Cyl), 0 < g η →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ g η → DifferentiableAt ℝ φ η → DifferentiableAt ℝ F η →
      fderiv ℝ (fun η' => ((g η' ^ e : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (a * (b * (φ η' : ℂ))) * F η')) η v =
        ((e * g η ^ (e - 1) * fderiv ℝ g η v : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (a * (b * (φ η : ℂ))) * F η) +
        ((g η ^ e : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (a * (b * (φ η : ℂ))) *
          (fderiv ℝ F η v + a * b * ((fderiv ℝ φ η v : ℝ) : ℂ) * F η)) := by
    intro g φ F e a b η v hg hgd hφd hFd
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun η' => g η' ^ e) ((e * g η ^ (e - 1)) • fderiv ℝ g η) η :=
      hgd.hasFDerivAt.rpow_const (Or.inl hg.ne')
    have h1c : HasFDerivAt (fun η' => ((g η' ^ e : ℝ) : ℂ))
        (Complex.ofRealCLM.comp ((e * g η ^ (e - 1)) • fderiv ℝ g η)) η :=
      Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp η h1
    have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun η' => ((φ η' : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Complex.ofRealCLM.comp (fderiv ℝ φ η)) η :=
      Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp η hφd.hasFDerivAt
    have h3 := (h2.const_mul b).const_mul a
    have h4 := h3.cexp
    have h5 := h4.mul hFd.hasFDerivAt
    have h6 := h1c.mul h5
    have h7 : HasFDerivAt
        (fun η' => ((g η' ^ e : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (a * (b * (φ η' : ℂ))) * F η')) _ η := h6
    rw [h7.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.mul_apply]
    push_cast
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨Cf, hCf⟩ : ∃ Cf : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ, Cf = fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
      (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) •
        (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hvec : ∀ v w : Fin 3 → ℂ, v 0 = w 0 → v 1 = w 1 → v 2 = w 2 → v = w := by
    intro v w h0 h1 h2
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact h0
    · exact h1
    · exact h2
  have hcurl : ∀ η ∈ U, mcurlC B.h (m * pint5 B G γ) Cf η =
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) • ampA5 B G γ m η := by
    intro η hη
    have hηD := hUsub hη
    have hr : 0 < η.1 := hηD.1
    have hq : 0 < qC B.h η := hqpos η hηD
    have hqd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (qC B.h) η := hqdiff η hηD
    have hφd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) η :=
      (hφ.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hη)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hAd : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η' => (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η' i) η := fun i =>
      differentiableAt_pi.1 ((hAw.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hη)).differentiableAt (by simp)) i
    
    have hqdir : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) η ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), w) = 0 := by
      intro w
      have hc : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => η + t • (((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), w) : Cyl))
          (((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), w) : Cyl) 0 := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const (((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), w) : Cyl)).const_add η
      have h := hqd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) hc (by simp)
      have hconst : (qC B.h ∘ fun t : ℝ => η + t • (((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), w) : Cyl)) =
          fun _ => qC B.h η := by
        funext t
        simp [qC]
      rw [hconst] at h
      exact h.unique (hasDerivAt_const 0 _)
    have hlog : dZ (fun η' => Real.log (qC B.h η')) η = dZ (qC B.h) η / qC B.h η := by
      have hl := hqd.hasFDerivAt.log hq.ne'
      simp only [dZ]
      rw [hl.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, div_eq_inv_mul]
    have hC : ∀ i : Fin 3, Cf η i = (((qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) *
          (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η i) := by
      intro i
      rw [hCf]
      rfl
    have hR : ∀ i : Fin 3, dR B.h (fun η' => Cf η' i) η = (((qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) *
          (dR B.h (fun η' => (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η' i) η + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) *
            ((dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) η : ℝ) : ℂ) * (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η i)) := by
      intro i
      have h := hprod (qC B.h) (phiL5 B G γ) (fun η' => (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η' i) (1/2 - Aex B.h)
        (Complex.I * (m : ℂ)) (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) η (1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)
        hq hqd hφd (hAd i)
      simp only [hqdir, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul, zero_add] at h
      rw [hCf]
      exact h
    have hZ : ∀ i : Fin 3, dZ (fun η' => Cf η' i) η =
        ((((1/2 - Aex B.h) * qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h - 1) * dZ (qC B.h) η) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) *
            (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η i) +
        (((qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) *
          (dZ (fun η' => (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η' i) η + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) *
            ((dZ (phiL5 B G γ) η : ℝ) : ℂ) * (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η i)) := by
      intro i
      have h := hprod (qC B.h) (phiL5 B G γ) (fun η' => (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η' i) (1/2 - Aex B.h)
        (Complex.I * (m : ℂ)) (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) η (0, 1, 0, 0) hq hqd hφd (hAd i)
      rw [hCf]
      exact h
    have e1 : qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h) = qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]
      congr 1
    have e2 : qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h - 1) =
        qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h) / qC B.h η := by
      rw [Real.rpow_sub_one hq.ne', e1]
    have e3 : (qC B.h η / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ) = qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) / Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) := by
      rw [Real.div_rpow hq.le hQ.le, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    have hq' : ((qC B.h η : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hq.ne'
    have hr' : ((η.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hr.ne'
    have hAex : (1/2 : ℝ) - Aex B.h = -B.h := by unfold Aex; ring
    refine hvec _ _ ?_ ?_ ?_
    all_goals
      simp only [mcurlC, ampA5, wmoAmp5, velW5, velC5, nPhi5, DrC, DzC, RC, rotC, pang5, Pi.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul, Complex.real_smul, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons, hC, hR, hZ, hlog, e1, e2, e3]
      generalize qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) = u
      generalize qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h) = w
      generalize Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) = Ev
      try simp only [hAex]
      push_cast
      field_simp
      ring
  have hV : mcurlC B.h (m * pint5 B G γ) Cf =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun η =>
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) • ampA5 B G γ m η := by
    filter_upwards [hUo.mem_nhds hξ] with η hη
    exact hcurl η hη
  
  have hP : (fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-2 * Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) *
        (primState5 B G).pw γ m η)) =
      fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) *
        presP5 B G γ m η := by
    funext η
    simp only [presP5]
    ring
  
  have hL : linC5 B G γ m ξ = ((((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))⁻¹) •
      mresC B (m * pint5 B G γ) (mcurlC B.h (m * pint5 B G γ) Cf)
        (fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-2 * Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) *
            (primState5 B G).pw γ m η)) ξ := by
    rw [hCf]
    rfl
  rw [hL, hP, hgerm _ _ _ _ hV]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (U : Set Cyl) (a : WC) (P : WS), B.ok → IsOpen U → U ⊆ DomC B.h B.qB → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (phiL5 B G γ) U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (a γ m) U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (P γ m) U → (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ubase B η i) U) → (∀ (l : ℕ) (η : Cyl) (i : Fin 3), baseC B l η i = Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * ubase B η i) → ∀ ξ ∈ U, ((((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))⁻¹) • mresC B (m * pint5 B G γ) (fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) • a γ m η) (fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) * P γ m η) ξ = (remSlow5 B a + remPhase5 B G a + remPres5 B P + remVisc5 B G a + remBase5 B a + primOp5 B G a) γ m ξ + ((((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ)) * (((Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ))) : ℝ) : ℂ) * P γ m ξ) • nPhiC5 B G γ ξ
