signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (U : Set Cyl) (a : WC) (P : WS), B.ok → IsOpen U → U ⊆ DomC B.h B.qB → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (phiL5 B G γ) U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (a γ m) U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (P γ m) U → (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ubase B η i) U) → (∀ (l : ℕ) (η : Cyl) (i : Fin 3), baseC B l η i = Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * ubase B η i) → ∀ ξ ∈ U, ((((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))⁻¹) • mresC B (m * pint5 B G γ) (fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) • a γ m η) (fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) * P γ m η) ξ = (remSlow5 B a + remPhase5 B G a + remPres5 B P + remVisc5 B G a + remBase5 B a + primOp5 B G a) γ m ξ + ((((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ)) * (((Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ))) : ℝ) : ℂ) * P γ m ξ) • nPhiC5 B G γ ξ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G γ m U a P hok hU hUsub hφ ha hP hub hrel ξ hξ
  have hpos : ∀ η ∈ U, 0 < η.1 := fun η hη => (hUsub hη).1
  have hr : 0 < ξ.1 := hpos ξ hξ
  have hQ : 0 < Qb γ.1 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hkpos : 0 < kb B.h γ.1 := by
    unfold kb epsb
    exact Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ _) _)
  
  have hdir : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h f) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ f) U := by
    intro V _ _ f hf
    have hDf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) U :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hf).2
    have hpow : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) U :=
      contDiff_fst.contDiffOn.rpow_const_of_ne (fun ξ hξ => (hpos ξ hξ).ne')
    have hY : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) U :=
      (contDiffOn_const.mul hpow).smul_const _
    have hvR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl =>
        ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)) U :=
      contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk hY))
    exact ⟨(hDf.clm_apply hvR).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl),
      (hDf.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)⟩
  have hdiff : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ η ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ f η := by
    intro V _ _ f hf η hη
    exact (hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hη)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hai : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => a γ m η i) U := fun i => contDiffOn_pi.1 ha i
  have hφd : ∀ η ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) η := hdiff _ hφ
  have haid : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ η ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => a γ m η i) η :=
    fun i => hdiff _ (hai i)
  have hPd : ∀ η ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ (P γ m) η := hdiff _ hP
  have hadξ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (a γ m) ξ := hdiff _ ha ξ hξ
  have hRφ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ)) ξ := hdiff _ (hdir _ hφ).1 ξ hξ
  have hZφ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (dZ (phiL5 B G γ)) ξ := hdiff _ (hdir _ hφ).2 ξ hξ
  have hRa : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (dR B.h (fun η => a γ m η i)) ξ :=
    fun i => hdiff _ (hdir _ (hai i)).1 ξ hξ
  have hZa : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (dZ (fun η => a γ m η i)) ξ :=
    fun i => hdiff _ (hdir _ (hai i)).2 ξ hξ
  have hV1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => ubase B η 1) ξ := hdiff _ (hub 1) ξ hξ
  have hV2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => ubase B η 2) ξ := hdiff _ (hub 2) ξ hξ
  
  have L1 : ∀ (φ : Cyl → ℝ) (g : Cyl → ℂ) (η v : Cyl), DifferentiableAt ℝ φ η →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ g η →
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (φ y : ℂ))) * g y) η v =
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (φ η : ℂ))) *
          (fderiv ℝ g η v + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((fderiv ℝ φ η v : ℝ) : ℂ) * g η) := by
    intro φ g η v hφη hgη
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ((φ y : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Complex.ofRealCLM.comp (fderiv ℝ φ η)) η :=
      Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp η hφη.hasFDerivAt
    have h2 := ((h1.const_mul (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ)).const_mul (Complex.I * (m : ℂ))).cexp
    have h3 := h2.fun_mul hgη.hasFDerivAt
    rw [h3.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have L2 : ∀ (w : Cyl → Cyl) (φ : Cyl → ℝ) (g : Cyl → ℂ),
      (∀ η ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ φ η) → (∀ η ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ g η) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => fderiv ℝ φ η (w η)) ξ →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => fderiv ℝ g η (w η)) ξ →
      fderiv ℝ (fun η => fderiv ℝ (fun y => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) *
          ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (φ y : ℂ))) * g y) η (w η)) ξ (w ξ) =
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (φ ξ : ℂ))) *
          (fderiv ℝ (fun η => fderiv ℝ g η (w η)) ξ (w ξ)
            + 2 * (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ)) * ((fderiv ℝ φ ξ (w ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
                fderiv ℝ g ξ (w ξ)
            + (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ)) *
                ((fderiv ℝ (fun η => fderiv ℝ φ η (w η)) ξ (w ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * g ξ
            + (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ)) ^ 2 * ((fderiv ℝ φ ξ (w ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 * g ξ) := by
    intro w φ g hφU hgU hDφ hDg
    have hev : (fun η => fderiv ℝ (fun y => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) *
          ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (φ y : ℂ))) * g y) η (w η)) =ᶠ[nhds ξ]
        (fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (φ η : ℂ))) *
          (fderiv ℝ g η (w η) + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) *
            ((fderiv ℝ φ η (w η) : ℝ) : ℂ) * g η)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hξ) (fun η hη => L1 φ g η (w η) (hφU η hη) (hgU η hη))
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun η => ((fderiv ℝ φ η (w η) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        (Complex.ofRealCLM.comp (fderiv ℝ (fun η => fderiv ℝ φ η (w η)) ξ)) ξ :=
      Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp ξ hDφ.hasFDerivAt
    have hH := hDg.hasFDerivAt.fun_add
      ((h1.const_mul (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ))).fun_mul (hgU ξ hξ).hasFDerivAt)
    rw [L1 φ _ ξ (w ξ) (hφU ξ hξ) hH.differentiableAt, hH.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have hT : ∀ i : Fin 3, dT (fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) *
      (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) * a γ m η i) ξ =
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) *
        (dTsV (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ + (((Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1 + B.h))) : ℝ) : ℂ) * dVc B γ.1 (a γ m) ξ i
          + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dT (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * a γ m ξ i) := by
    intro i
    have h := L1 (phiL5 B G γ) (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), vtv) (hφd ξ hξ) (haid i ξ hξ)
    have hT0 : (0:ℝ) < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; positivity
    have hzp := zpow_pos hT0 (bandIdx B.h γ.1)
    have hqp := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ (1 + B.h)
    have hcT : Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * (cib B.h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1))) = 1 := by
      unfold cib
      rw [Real.rpow_neg hQ.le, zpow_neg]
      field_simp
    have hv : (((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), vtv) : Cyl) = ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) +
        Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1 + B.h)) • dVdir B.h γ.1 := by
      unfold dVdir
      simp only [Prod.smul_mk, smul_zero, Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero, zero_add, smul_smul, hcT, one_smul,
        Prod.mk_zero_zero]
    have hcomp : fderiv ℝ (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ = (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i).comp (fderiv ℝ (a γ m) ξ) :=
      (hasFDerivAt_pi'.1 hadξ.hasFDerivAt i).fderiv
    have hc2 : fderiv ℝ (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ (dVdir B.h γ.1) = dVc B γ.1 (a γ m) ξ i := by
      rw [hcomp]; rfl
    have hsplit : fderiv ℝ (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), vtv) =
        dTsV (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ + (((Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1 + B.h))) : ℝ) : ℂ) * dVc B γ.1 (a γ m) ξ i := by
      rw [hv, map_add, map_smul, Complex.real_smul, hc2]
      rfl
    unfold dT
    rw [h, hsplit]
  have hR : ∀ i : Fin 3, dR B.h (fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) *
      (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) * a γ m η i) ξ =
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) *
        (dR B.h (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ
          + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * a γ m ξ i) :=
    fun i => L1 (phiL5 B G γ) (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ _ (hφd ξ hξ) (haid i ξ hξ)
  have hZ : ∀ i : Fin 3, dZ (fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) *
      (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) * a γ m η i) ξ =
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) *
        (dZ (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ
          + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * a γ m ξ i) :=
    fun i => L1 (phiL5 B G γ) (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ _ (hφd ξ hξ) (haid i ξ hξ)
  have hPR : dR B.h (fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) *
      (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) * P γ m η) ξ =
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) *
        (dR B.h (P γ m) ξ
          + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * P γ m ξ) :=
    L1 (phiL5 B G γ) (P γ m) ξ _ (hφd ξ hξ) (hPd ξ hξ)
  have hPZ : dZ (fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) *
      (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) * P γ m η) ξ =
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) *
        (dZ (P γ m) ξ
          + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * P γ m ξ) :=
    L1 (phiL5 B G γ) (P γ m) ξ _ (hφd ξ hξ) (hPd ξ hξ)
  have hRR : ∀ i : Fin 3, dR B.h (dR B.h (fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) *
      ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) * a γ m η i)) ξ =
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) *
        (dR B.h (dR B.h (fun η => a γ m η i)) ξ
          + 2 * (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ)) * ((dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              dR B.h (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ
          + (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ)) * ((dR B.h (dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ)) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              a γ m ξ i
          + (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ)) ^ 2 * ((dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
              a γ m ξ i) :=
    fun i => L2 (fun η => ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv))
      (phiL5 B G γ) (fun η => a γ m η i) hφd (haid i) hRφ (hRa i)
  have hZZ : ∀ i : Fin 3, dZ (dZ (fun η => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) *
      ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) * a γ m η i)) ξ =
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) *
        (dZ (dZ (fun η => a γ m η i)) ξ
          + 2 * (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ)) * ((dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              dZ (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ
          + (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ)) * ((dZ (dZ (phiL5 B G γ)) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              a γ m ξ i
          + (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ)) ^ 2 * ((dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
              a γ m ξ i) :=
    fun i => L2 (fun _ => ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)))
      (phiL5 B G γ) (fun η => a γ m η i) hφd (haid i) hZφ (hZa i)
  have hμ2 : (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ)) ^ 2 = -((m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, Complex.I_sq]; ring
  
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s = Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hσpos : 0 < σ := by rw [hσ]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQ
  have hσsq : σ ^ 2 = Qb γ.1 := by rw [hσ]; exact Real.sq_sqrt hQ.le
  obtain ⟨c1, hc1⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2 + B.h) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc1pos : 0 < c1 := by rw [hc1]; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ _
  have hQ1 : Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ)) = σ⁻¹ := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hQ.le, hσ, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  have hQ2 : Qb γ.1 ^ (-(Aex B.h + 1/2)) = (c1 * σ)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hQ.le, hc1, hσ, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_add hQ]
    congr 2
  have hn0 : nPhi5 B G γ ξ 0 = σ * dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ := by rw [hσ]; rfl
  have hn1 : nPhi5 B G γ ξ 1 = (pint5 B G γ : ℝ) / (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) / (ξ.1 / σ) := by rw [hσ]; rfl
  have hn2 : nPhi5 B G γ ξ 2 = σ * dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ := by rw [hσ]; rfl
  have hkR : (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hkpos.ne'
  have hQ3 : (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 * dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) / Qb γ.1 =
      (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ ^ 2 + dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ ^ 2) +
        (pint5 B G γ : ℝ) ^ 2 / ξ.1 ^ 2 := by
    simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, hn0, hn1, hn2]
    rw [← hσsq]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hFang : Fang B γ.1 = fun η => c1 * σ * (ubase B η 1 * (η.1)⁻¹) := by
    funext η
    unfold Fang RC
    rw [hrel, hc1, hσ, div_div_eq_mul_div]
    ring
  have hF0 : Fang B γ.1 ξ = c1 * σ * (ubase B ξ 1 * (ξ.1)⁻¹) := by rw [hFang]
  have hF1 : DrC B γ.1 (Fang B γ.1) ξ = σ * (c1 * σ * (ubase B ξ 1 * (-(ξ.1 ^ 2)⁻¹) +
      (ξ.1)⁻¹ * dR B.h (fun η => ubase B η 1) ξ)) := by
    have hinv : HasFDerivAt (fun η : Cyl => (η.1)⁻¹)
        ((-(ξ.1 ^ 2)⁻¹) • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) ξ :=
      (hasDerivAt_inv hr.ne').comp_hasFDerivAt ξ hasFDerivAt_fst
    have hprod := (hV1.hasFDerivAt.fun_mul hinv).const_mul (c1 * σ)
    unfold DrC dR
    rw [hFang, hprod.fderiv, ← hσ]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hF2 : DrC B γ.1 (fun η => baseC B γ.1 η 2) ξ = σ * (c1 * dR B.h (fun η => ubase B η 2) ξ) := by
    have hb : (fun η => baseC B γ.1 η 2) = fun η => c1 * ubase B η 2 := by
      funext η; rw [hrel, hc1]
    unfold DrC dR
    rw [hb, fderiv_const_mul hV2 c1, ← hσ]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hRC : RC γ.1 ξ = ξ.1 / σ := by unfold RC; rw [hσ]
  have hMV : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℂ, (pulseMatC (Kmat B G γ ξ)).mulVec v =
      ![((-2 * Fang B γ.1 ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * v 1,
        ((2 * Fang B γ.1 ξ + RC γ.1 ξ * DrC B γ.1 (Fang B γ.1) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * v 0,
        ((DrC B γ.1 (fun η => baseC B γ.1 η 2) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * v 0] := by
    intro v
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, pulseMatC, Kmat]
  
  have hr' : (ξ.1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hr.ne'
  have hk' : (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hkpos.ne'
  have hσ' : (σ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hσpos.ne'
  have hc1' : (c1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hc1pos.ne'
  have hE0 : Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) ≠ 0 :=
    Complex.exp_ne_zero _
  
  simp only [mresC, mlapC, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hT 0, hT 1, hT 2, hR 0, hR 1, hR 2, hZ 0, hZ 1, hZ 2, hRR 0, hRR 1, hRR 2, hZZ 0, hZZ 1, hZZ 2,
    hPR, hPZ, hμ2]
  generalize Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) = e at hE0 ⊢
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;>
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, remSlow5, remPhase5, remPres5, remVisc5, remBase5,
    primOp5, nPhiC5, eikP5, hMV, hQ1, hQ2, hQ3, hn0, hn1, hn2, hF1, hF0, hF2, hRC,
    Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons] <;>
  push_cast <;>
  field_simp <;>
  ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (qs : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl), B.ok → ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs → DifferentiableAt ℝ (ampD5 B G γ m) ξ → DifferentiableAt ℝ (W0h4 B G γ m) ξ → primOp5 B G (ampA5 B G) γ m ξ + ((((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ)) * (((Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ))) : ℝ) : ℂ) * presP5 B G γ m ξ) • nPhiC5 B G γ ξ = princC5 B G γ m ξ + primOp5 B G (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • ampD5 B G γ' m' η) γ m ξ

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (qs : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl), B.ok → ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs → DifferentiableAt ℝ (ampD5 B G γ m) ξ → DifferentiableAt ℝ (W0h4 B G γ m) ξ → primOp5 B G (ampA5 B G) γ m ξ + ((((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ)) * (((Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ))) : ℝ) : ℂ) * presP5 B G γ m ξ) • nPhiC5 B G γ ξ = princC5 B G γ m ξ + primOp5 B G (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • ampD5 B G γ' m' η) γ m ξ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G γ m qs ξ hok hξ hD hW
  have hS := hok.1
  have hT : IsOpen {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
    isOpen_lt continuous_snd.snd.fst continuous_const
  have hπq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) :=
    contDiff_snd.fst.prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h4 := hS.2.2.2.1
    have hc := h4.comp hπq.contDiffOn (fun ξ (hξ : ξ.2.2.1 < 1) =>
      (⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩ : (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) ∈ univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)))
    exact hc
  have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qs := hξ
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ'.2.1])).1
  have hQ0 : 0 < Qb γ.1 := by unfold Qb; positivity
  have hρ : rhoQ B γ ξ = qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 := rfl
  have hqd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (qC B.h) ξ :=
    (hqC.contDiffAt (hT.mem_nhds hξ'.2.1)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  
  have hr1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) ξ :=
    hqd.rpow_const (Or.inl hq0.ne')
  have hrho : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => rhoQ B γ η) ξ := by
    have e : (fun η => rhoQ B γ η) = fun η => qC B.h η * (Qb γ.1)⁻¹ := by
      funext η; simp only [rhoQ, div_eq_mul_inv]
    rw [e]; exact hqd.mul_const _
  have hr2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => rhoQ B γ η ^ (1/2:ℝ)) ξ := by
    have hne : rhoQ B γ ξ ≠ 0 := by rw [hρ]; exact (div_pos hq0 hQ0).ne'
    exact hrho.rpow_const (Or.inl hne)
  have hc1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ := by
    have := Complex.ofRealCLM.differentiableAt.comp ξ hr1
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using this
  have hc2' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => (((rhoQ B γ η ^ (1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ := by
    have := Complex.ofRealCLM.differentiableAt.comp ξ hr2
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using this
  have hc2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (((rhoQ B γ η ^ (1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ := hc1.mul hc2'
  
  have hinvq : ∀ t : ℝ, qC B.h (ξ + t • dVdir B.h γ.1) = qC B.h ξ := by
    intro t; simp [qC, dVdir]
  have hline : ∀ g : Cyl → ℂ, DifferentiableAt ℝ g ξ →
      (∀ t : ℝ, g (ξ + t • dVdir B.h γ.1) = g ξ) → fderiv ℝ g ξ (dVdir B.h γ.1) = 0 := by
    intro g hg hinv
    have hl : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ξ + t • dVdir B.h γ.1) (dVdir B.h γ.1) 0 := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const (dVdir B.h γ.1)).const_add ξ
    have e0 : ξ + (0:ℝ) • dVdir B.h γ.1 = ξ := by simp
    have hg' : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℝ g ξ) (ξ + (0:ℝ) • dVdir B.h γ.1) := by
      rw [e0]; exact hg.hasFDerivAt
    have h1 := hg'.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ) hl
    have h2 : (g ∘ fun t : ℝ => ξ + t • dVdir B.h γ.1) = fun _ => g ξ := by
      funext t; exact hinv t
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1.unique (hasDerivAt_const 0 (g ξ))
  have hz1 : fderiv ℝ (fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ (dVdir B.h γ.1) = 0 :=
    hline _ hc1 (fun t => by simp only [hinvq t])
  have hz2 : fderiv ℝ (fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (((rhoQ B γ η ^ (1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ (dVdir B.h γ.1) = 0 :=
    hline _ hc2 (fun t => by simp only [rhoQ, hinvq t])
  
  have hfun : ampA5 B G γ m = fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • ampD5 B G γ m η +
      ((((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((rhoQ B γ η ^ (1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • W0h4 B G γ m η := by
    funext η
    simp only [ampA5, ampD5]
    rw [smul_sub, mul_smul, sub_add_cancel]
  have hA : ampA5 B G γ m ξ = (((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • ampD5 B G γ m ξ +
      ((((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • W0h4 B G γ m ξ :=
    congrFun hfun ξ
  
  have hdA : dVc B γ.1 (ampA5 B G γ m) ξ =
      (((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • dVc B γ.1 (ampD5 B G γ m) ξ +
      ((((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) •
        dVc B γ.1 (W0h4 B G γ m) ξ := by
    rw [hfun]
    unfold dVc
    have hs1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • ampD5 B G γ m η) ξ :=
      hc1.smul hD
    have hs2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => ((((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (((rhoQ B γ η ^ (1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • W0h4 B G γ m η) ξ := hc2.smul hW
    rw [fderiv_fun_add hs1 hs2, fderiv_fun_smul hc1 hD, fderiv_fun_smul hc2 hW]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, hz1, hz2, zero_smul, add_zero]
  have hdD : dVc B γ.1 (fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • ampD5 B G γ m η) ξ =
      (((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • dVc B γ.1 (ampD5 B G γ m) ξ := by
    unfold dVc
    rw [fderiv_fun_smul hc1 hD]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, hz1, zero_smul, add_zero]
  
  have key : ∀ (h q Q : ℝ), 0 < q → 0 < Q →
      q ^ (2 * Aex h + 1/2) * Q ^ (-(1 + h)) * (q ^ (-Aex h) * (q / Q) ^ (1/2 : ℝ)) =
        (q / Q) ^ (Aex h + 1) ∧
      q ^ (2 * Aex h + 1/2) * Q ^ (-(Aex h + 1/2)) * (q ^ (-Aex h) * (q / Q) ^ (1/2 : ℝ)) =
        (q / Q) ^ (Aex h + 1) ∧
      q ^ (2 * Aex h + 1/2) * Q⁻¹ * (q ^ (-Aex h) * (q / Q) ^ (1/2 : ℝ)) =
        (q / Q) ^ (Aex h + 1) * Q ^ h ∧
      q ^ (2 * Aex h + 1/2) * Q ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ)) * q ^ (-2 * Aex h) = (q / Q) ^ (1/2 : ℝ) := by
    intro h q Q hq hQ
    have hqQ : 0 < q / Q := div_pos hq hQ
    have hinv : Q⁻¹ = Real.exp (-Real.log Q) := by rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hQ]
    simp only [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hq, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hQ, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hqQ, hinv,
      Real.log_div hq.ne' hQ.ne', ← Real.exp_add, Aex]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> congr 1 <;> ring
  obtain ⟨R1, R2, R3, R4⟩ := key B.h (qC B.h ξ) (Qb γ.1) hq0 hQ0
  rw [← hρ] at R1 R2 R3 R4
  have C1 := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ)) R1
  have C2 := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ)) R2
  have C3 := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ)) R3
  have C4 := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ)) R4
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_inv] at C1 C2 C3 C4
  
  simp only [primOp5, princC5, presP5, dDamp5, epsb, hA, hdA, hdD]
  ext i
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_smul,
    Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.ofReal_natCast]
  linear_combination (dVc B γ.1 (W0h4 B G γ m) ξ i) * C1
    + ((pulseMatC (Kmat B G γ ξ)).mulVec (W0h4 B G γ m ξ) i) * C2
    + (W0h4 B G γ m ξ i * (m : ℂ) ^ 2 * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) ^ 2 *
        ((dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) * C3
    + (nPhiC5 B G γ ξ i * (primState5 B G).pw γ m ξ * Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ)) * C4

informal_problem.statement: ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → q < B.qB → B.Xa / 2 ≤ X → X ≤ 2 * B.Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift B.Eb) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift B.Ub) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C

signature.name: outer_profile_bounds_v5
signature.statement: ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → q < B.qB → B.Xa / 2 ≤ X → X ≤ 2 * B.Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift B.Eb) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift B.Ub) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hok m
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, -, hXa, -, -, -, -, hqB0, hqB1, -, -, -, -⟩, ⟨hFs, hUs, -, hFb⟩, -, -, -, -,
    ⟨hEs, hUbs, -, hdev⟩, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2
  have hS : IsOpen (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hWo : IsOpen (Set.Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) :=
    isOpen_Iio.prod hS
  have hX0 : 0 < B.Xa / 2 := by linarith
  
  have hpt : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, p.1 ≠ 0 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1)) p := by
    intro p hp
    exact (contDiffAt_const.mul contDiffAt_fst).sqrt (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hp)
  have hsqS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1))
      (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
    fun p hp => (hpt p (ne_of_gt hp.1)).contDiffWithinAt
  have hMs : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Set.Icc (B.Xa / 2) (2 * B.Xb) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-1:ℝ) 1,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1)) p‖ ≤ M := by
    intro k
    have hK : IsCompact (Set.Icc (B.Xa / 2) (2 * B.Xb) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
      isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    have hc : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1)))
        (Set.Icc (B.Xa / 2) (2 * B.Xb) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
      refine continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt (fun p hp => ?_)
      exact (hpt p (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le hX0 hp.1.1))).continuousAt_iteratedFDeriv
        (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    exact hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hc
  choose Ms hMs using hMs
  choose MF hMF using hFb (B.Xa / 2) (2 * B.Xb) hX0
  obtain ⟨C7, hC7⟩ := hdev (B.Xa / 2) (2 * B.Xb) hX0 m
  have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) * |Ms i| * |MF (m - i)| :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)
  obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ,
      C = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) * |Ms i| * |MF (m - i)| + |MF m| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hP2s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1) * (↿B.F) p)
      (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := hsqS.mul hFs
  have hP2b : ∀ X η : ℝ, B.Xa / 2 ≤ X → X ≤ 2 * B.Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1) * (↿B.F) p) (X, η)‖ ≤ C1 := by
    intro X η h1 h2 h3 h4
    have hpS : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
      ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hX0 h1, h3, h4⟩
    have hL : ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1) * (↿B.F) p)
        (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (X, η)‖ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) *
          ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1))
            (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (X, η)‖ *
          ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ (m - i) (↿B.F) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (X, η)‖ :=
      norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hsqS hFs hS.uniqueDiffOn hpS (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hS hpS] at hL
    have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) *
          ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1))
            (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (X, η)‖ *
          ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ (m - i) (↿B.F) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (X, η)‖ ≤
        (m.choose i : ℝ) * |Ms i| * |MF (m - i)| := by
      intro i _
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hS hpS, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (m - i) hS hpS]
      have a := (hMs i (X, η) ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3.le, h4.le⟩).trans (le_abs_self _)
      have b := ((hMF (m - i) X η h1 h2 h3 h4).1).trans (le_abs_self _)
      have c : (0:ℝ) ≤ (m.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a c) b (norm_nonneg _)
        (mul_nonneg c (abs_nonneg _))
    calc _ ≤ _ := hL
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
      _ ≤ C1 := by rw [hC1]; linarith [abs_nonneg (MF m)]
  
  have hproj : ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) → ∀ (m : ℕ)
      (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), w.2 ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => f w.2) w‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f w.2‖ := by
    intro f hf m w hw
    let π := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)
    have hU : IsOpen (π ⁻¹' (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) := hS.preimage π.continuous
    have hwU : w ∈ π ⁻¹' (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := hw
    have h1 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right π hf hS.uniqueDiffOn
      hU.uniqueDiffOn hwU (n := ∞) (i := m) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hU hwU,
      iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hS (show π w ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 from hw)] at h1
    have e : (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => f w.2) = f ∘ π := rfl
    rw [e, h1]
    refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
    have hp : ∏ _i : Fin m, ‖π‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_snd_le ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (π w)‖ * ∏ _i : Fin m, ‖π‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (π w)‖ * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f w.2‖ := mul_one _
  
  refine ⟨|C7| + C1, ?_⟩
  intro q X η hq hqB hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2
  have hw : ((Real.log q, X, η) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈
      Set.Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
    ⟨Real.log_lt_log hq hqB, lt_of_lt_of_le hX0 hX1, hη1, hη2⟩
  have hnhds := hWo.mem_nhds hw
  have hsnd : Set.MapsTo (Prod.snd : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ)
      (Set.Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1))
      (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := fun w hw => hw.2
  have hPE : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * v.2.1) * B.F v.2.1 v.2.2)
      (Set.Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) :=
    hP2s.comp contDiff_snd.contDiffOn hsnd
  have hPU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => B.U v.2.1 v.2.2)
      (Set.Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) :=
    hUs.comp contDiff_snd.contDiffOn hsnd
  have hqp0 : 0 ≤ q ^ (2 * B.h) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
  have hqp1 : q ^ (2 * B.h) ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one hq.le (hqB.le.trans hqB1) (by linarith)
  have hC7a : C7 * q ^ (2 * B.h) ≤ |C7| :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hqp0).trans
      (mul_le_of_le_one_right (abs_nonneg _) hqp1)
  obtain ⟨hdE, hdU, -⟩ := hC7 q X η hq hqB hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2
  have hsplit : ∀ (L P : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (Set.Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P (Set.Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w => L w - P w) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C7 * q ^ (2 * B.h) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m P (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m L (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ |C7| + C1 := by
    intro L P hL hP h1 h2
    have e : L = (fun w => L w - P w) + P := by
      funext w
      simp
    rw [e, iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (((hL.sub hP).contDiffAt hnhds).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      ((hP.contDiffAt hnhds).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (h1.trans hC7a) h2)
  refine ⟨hsplit _ _ hEs hPE hdE ?_, hsplit _ _ hUbs hPU hdU ?_⟩
  · exact (hproj _ hP2s m _ hw.2).trans (hP2b X η hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2)
  · refine (hproj _ hUs m _ hw.2).trans (((hMF m X η hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2).2).trans ?_)
    rw [hC1]
    linarith [le_abs_self (MF m)]

signature.name: logqC_nb_v5
signature.statement: ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.log (qC B.h η)) i ξ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hok n hn
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB1, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  
  have simN : ∀ h : ℝ, SimScaleProps h → SimNorm h := by
    intro h hS
    obtain ⟨hS1, -, -, -, hS5⟩ := hS
    open Pointwise in
    have hom : ∀ μ z τ : ℝ, 0 < μ →
        simScale h (μ ^ (1/2 - h) * z) (μ * τ) = μ * simScale h z τ := by
      intro μ z τ hμ
      have key : ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p → μ * p - (μ ^ (1/2 - h) * z) ^ 2 * (μ * p) ^ (2 * h) =
          μ * (p - z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h)) := by
        intro p hp
        have sq : (μ ^ (1/2 - h)) ^ 2 = μ ^ (1 - 2 * h) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hμ.le]
          congr 1
          push_cast
          ring
        have split : μ ^ (1 - 2 * h) * μ ^ (2 * h) = μ := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hμ]
          have e : 1 - 2 * h + 2 * h = 1 := by ring
          rw [e, Real.rpow_one]
        rw [mul_pow, sq, Real.mul_rpow hμ.le hp.le]
        linear_combination (-(z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h))) * split
      have hset : {q : ℝ | 0 < q ∧ μ * τ ≤ q - (μ ^ (1/2 - h) * z) ^ 2 * q ^ (2 * h)} =
          μ • {p : ℝ | 0 < p ∧ τ ≤ p - z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h)} := by
        ext q
        rw [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem₀ hμ.ne', smul_eq_mul]
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
        have hq : q = μ * (μ⁻¹ * q) := by field_simp
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hq0, hle⟩
          have hp : 0 < μ⁻¹ * q := mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hμ) hq0
          refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
          rw [hq, key _ hp] at hle
          exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hle hμ
        · rintro ⟨hp, hle⟩
          refine ⟨by rw [hq]; exact mul_pos hμ hp, ?_⟩
          rw [hq, key _ hp]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle hμ.le
      unfold simScale
      rw [hset, Real.sInf_smul_of_nonneg hμ.le, smul_eq_mul]
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z T : ℝ, 0 < T → simScale h Z T = 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (Z, T)‖ ≤ C := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk | hk
      · subst hk
        refine ⟨1, fun Z T _ h1 => ?_⟩
        rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]
        show ‖simScale h Z T‖ ≤ 1
        rw [h1, norm_one]
      · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hS5 k hk
        refine ⟨C, fun Z T hT h1 => ?_⟩
        have := hC Z T hT h1.le
        rwa [h1, Real.one_rpow, mul_one] at this
    refine ⟨C, fun z τ hτ _ => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hQ0, -⟩ := hS1 z τ hτ
    obtain ⟨Q, hQd⟩ : ∃ Q, Q = simScale h z τ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hQd] at hQ0 ⊢
    obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ : ∃ Z : ℝ, Z = Q ^ (-(1/2 - h)) * z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ, T = Q⁻¹ * τ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hT0 : 0 < T := by rw [hT]; exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hQ0) hτ
    have hZT : simScale h Z T = 1 := by
      have := hom Q⁻¹ z τ (inv_pos.mpr hQ0)
      rw [Real.inv_rpow hQ0.le, ← Real.rpow_neg hQ0.le, ← hQd, inv_mul_cancel₀ hQ0.ne'] at this
      rw [hZ, hT]
      exact this
    have hzb : Q ^ (1/2 - h) * Z = z := by
      rw [hZ, ← mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hQ0]
      simp
    have hτb : Q * T = τ := by
      rw [hT]
      exact mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hQ0.ne' τ
    have hpa : 0 < Q ^ (1/2 - h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ0 _
    let e₁ : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 (Q ^ (1/2 - h)) hpa.ne')
    let e₂ : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 Q hQ0.ne')
    let L : (ℝ × ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) := e₁.prodCongr e₂
    let M : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 Q hQ0.ne')
    have hL : ∀ x : ℝ × ℝ, L x = (Q ^ (1/2 - h) * x.1, Q * x.2) := by
      intro x
      simp [L, e₁, e₂, mul_comm]
    have hM : ∀ y : ℝ, M y = Q * y := by
      intro y
      simp [M, mul_comm]
    have hfun : (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘ L =
        M ∘ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) := by
      funext w
      simp only [Function.comp, hL, hM]
      exact hom Q w.1 w.2 hQ0
    have hLclm : (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)) =
        (Q ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (Q • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro x
      apply Prod.ext
      · simp [hL]
      · simp [hL]
    have hLv : L (Z, T) = (z, τ) := by
      rw [hL]
      exact Prod.ext hzb hτb
    have hcomp : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘ L) (Z, T) =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (L (Z, T))).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ))) := by
      have := L.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2)
        uniqueDiffOn_univ (mem_univ (L (Z, T))) k
      rwa [preimage_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ] at this
    have key : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (z, τ)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ))) =
        (M : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (Z, T)) := by
      rw [← hLv, ← hcomp, hfun, M.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left]
    have hMn : ‖(M : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ ≤ Q := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hQ0.le fun y => ?_
      show ‖M y‖ ≤ Q * ‖y‖
      rw [hM, norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs Q, abs_of_pos hQ0]
    rw [← hLclm, key]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(M : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ *
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (Z, T)‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
      _ ≤ Q * C := mul_le_mul hMn (hC Z T hT0 hZT) (norm_nonneg _) hQ0.le
      _ = C * Q := mul_comm _ _
  have hN := simN B.h hS
  unfold SimNorm at hN
  choose C hC using hN
  
  have key : ∀ {E G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup G]
      [NormedSpace ℝ G] (F : E → G) (V : Set E) (a : E) (T : Cyl →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → a ∈ V → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro E G _ _ _ _ F V a T hV hF ha i
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set E, s = (fun z : E => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : E) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
    have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  
  obtain ⟨D0, hD0⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j Real.log (Set.Ioi 0) 1‖ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hlog : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Real.log (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    Real.contDiffOn_log.mono (fun x (hx : x ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) =>
      Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mpr (ne_of_gt hx))
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |C i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by
    have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k (_ : k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1)) => abs_nonneg (C k))
    rw [hDdef]; linarith
  refine ⟨(n.factorial : ℝ) * D0 * D ^ n, ?_⟩
  intro ξ hξD
  have hξD' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < B.qB := hξD
  have hξ : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξD'.2.1
  have hq1 : qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 := le_trans hξD'.2.2.le hqB1
  
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      (contDiff_snd.fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
    exact h1.comp h2.contDiffOn (fun η (hη : η.2.2.1 < 1) =>
      ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith)⟩)
  have hqpos : ∀ η : Cyl, η.2.2.1 < 1 → 0 < qC B.h η := fun η h =>
    (hS.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
  have hU : IsOpen {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd.snd.fst continuous_const
  
  obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : Cyl → ℝ, F = fun η : Cyl => Real.log (qC B.h η) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  suffices hmain : NB B.h F n ξ ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) * D0 * D ^ n by
    rw [hFdef] at hmain; exact hmain
  have hFU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    rw [hFdef]
    exact hqC.log (fun η hη => (hqpos η hη).ne')
  
  obtain ⟨Pm, hPmdef⟩ : ∃ Pm : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
      Pm = ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))).prod
        (-((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPapp : ∀ η : Cyl, Pm η = (η.2.1, -η.2.2.1) := by
    intro η; rw [hPmdef]; simp
  have hP1 : ‖Pm‖ ≤ 1 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun η => ?_)
    rw [hPapp η, one_mul, Prod.norm_def (η.2.1, -η.2.2.1)]
    refine max_le ?_ ?_
    · exact (norm_fst_le η.2).trans (norm_snd_le η)
    · exact (norm_neg η.2.2.1).trans_le
        (((norm_fst_le η.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le η.2)).trans (norm_snd_le η))
  obtain ⟨Mq, hMqdef⟩ : ∃ Mq : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
      Mq = (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
        (qC B.h ξ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ, T = Mq.comp Pm := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨w0, hw0def⟩ : ∃ w0 : ℝ × ℝ, w0 = (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hW : IsOpen (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
  have hw0 : w0 ∈ (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := by
    rw [hw0def]; exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
  
  have hid : ∀ v : Cyl, qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) = simScale B.h (w0 + T v).1 (w0 + T v).2 := by
    intro v
    have e1 : (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.1 = qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1 := by
      simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
    have e2 : (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 = qC B.h ξ * v.2.2.1 := by
      simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
    have e3 : T v = (qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1, qC B.h ξ * (-v.2.2.1)) := by
      rw [hTdef, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hPapp v, hMqdef]
      simp [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
    rw [e3, hw0def]
    show simScale B.h (ξ.2.1 + (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.1) (1 - (ξ.2.2.1 + (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1)) =
      simScale B.h (ξ.2.1 + qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1) ((1 - ξ.2.2.1) + qC B.h ξ * (-v.2.2.1))
    rw [e1, e2]
    congr 1
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set Cyl, O = {v : Cyl | (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 < 1} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hOmem : ∀ v, v ∈ O ↔ (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 < 1 := by
    intro v; rw [hOdef]; rfl
  have hcontO : Continuous (fun v : Cyl => (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1) :=
    ((continuous_const.add (Lnorm B.h ξ).continuous).snd.snd.fst)
  have hO : IsOpen O := by rw [hOdef]; exact isOpen_lt hcontO continuous_const
  have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ O := by
    rw [hOmem, map_zero, add_zero]; exact hξ
  obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : Cyl → ℝ, R = fun v => qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) / qC B.h ξ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ R O := by
    rw [hRdef]
    exact (hqC.comp (contDiff_const.add (Lnorm B.h ξ).contDiff).contDiffOn
      (fun v hv => (hOmem v).1 hv)).div_const _
  have hRpos : ∀ v ∈ O, 0 < R v := by
    intro v hv; rw [hRdef]; exact div_pos (hqpos _ ((hOmem v).1 hv)) hq0
  have hR0 : R 0 = 1 := by
    rw [hRdef]
    show qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ 0) / qC B.h ξ = 1
    rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact div_self hq0.ne'
  have hReq : R = (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ • (fun z : Cyl => simScale B.h (w0 + T z).1 (w0 + T z).2) := by
    rw [hRdef]; funext v
    show qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ v) / qC B.h ξ =
      (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * simScale B.h (w0 + T v).1 (w0 + T v).2
    rw [hid v, div_eq_inv_mul]
  have hΦ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : Cyl => simScale B.h (w0 + T z).1 (w0 + T z).2) 0 := by
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (w0 + T 0) := by
      rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact hS.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hw0)
    exact ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (f := fun z : Cyl => w0 + T z)
      (0 : Cyl) h1 (contDiff_const.add T.contDiff).contDiffAt
  
  have hDR : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i R O 0‖ ≤ D ^ i := by
    intro i hi1 hij
    have hcomp : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Mq.comp Pm) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Mq)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Pm) := by
      ext m; rfl
    have hCi : ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Mq)‖ ≤ C i * qC B.h ξ := by
      rw [hMqdef, hw0def]; exact hC i ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith) hq1
    have hprod : ∏ k : Fin i, ‖Pm‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hP1
    have hb1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Mq)) (fun _ : Fin i => Pm)
    have hb2 := hb1.trans ((mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) hprod).trans hCi)
    have hCiD : C i ≤ D := by
      have h2 : |C i| ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |C k| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => |C k|) (fun k _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hij))
      have h3 := le_abs_self (C i)
      rw [hDdef]; linarith
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO h0O, hReq,
      iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply (hΦ.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)),
      key (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) w0 T hW hS.2.2.2.1 hw0 i,
      norm_smul, hTdef, hcomp, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le)]
    calc (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * ‖((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Mq)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Pm)‖
        ≤ (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * (C i * qC B.h ξ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb2 (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le)
      _ = C i := by rw [mul_comm (C i), ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0.ne', one_mul]
      _ ≤ D := hCiD
      _ ≤ D ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
  
  have hRmaps : Set.MapsTo R O (Set.Ioi 0) := fun v hv => hRpos v hv
  have hEq : Set.EqOn (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z))
      ((fun _ : Cyl => Real.log (qC B.h ξ)) + Real.log ∘ R) O := by
    intro z hz
    have hRz := hRpos z hz
    have e : qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z) = qC B.h ξ * R z := by
      rw [hRdef]
      show _ = qC B.h ξ * (qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z) / qC B.h ξ)
      field_simp
    show F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z) = Real.log (qC B.h ξ) + Real.log (R z)
    rw [hFdef]
    show Real.log (qC B.h (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) = Real.log (qC B.h ξ) + Real.log (R z)
    rw [e, Real.log_mul hq0.ne' hRz.ne']
  have hlogR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Real.log ∘ R) O := hlog.comp hR hRmaps
  have hsplit : iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ n ((fun _ : Cyl => Real.log (qC B.h ξ)) + Real.log ∘ R) O 0 =
      iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ n (Real.log ∘ R) O 0 := by
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_add_apply contDiffWithinAt_const
      ((hlogR.contDiffWithinAt h0O).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O,
      iteratedFDerivWithin_const_of_ne (by omega : n ≠ 0)]
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply, zero_add]
  have hCg : ∀ j ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j Real.log (Set.Ioi 0) (R 0)‖ ≤ D0 := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hR0, hD0]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k Real.log (Set.Ioi 0) 1‖)
      (fun k _ => norm_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hlog hR (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn hO.uniqueDiffOn hRmaps h0O (C := D0) (D := D) hCg hDR
  have hNB : NB B.h F n ξ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) 0‖ := by
    unfold NB
    rw [key F {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hU hFU hξ n]
  calc NB B.h F n ξ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) 0‖ := hNB
    _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) O 0‖ := by
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hO h0O]
    _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ n ((fun _ : Cyl => Real.log (qC B.h ξ)) + Real.log ∘ R) O 0‖ := by
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_congr hEq h0O n]
    _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ n (Real.log ∘ R) O 0‖ := by rw [hsplit]
    _ ≤ _ := hFdB

informal_problem.statement: ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb → NB B.h (XC B.h) i ξ ≤ C ∧ NB B.h (etaC B.h) i ξ ≤ C

signature.statement: ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb → NB B.h (XC B.h) i ξ ≤ C ∧ NB B.h (etaC B.h) i ξ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hB i
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, hqB1, -, -, -, -⟩ := hB.2.1
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hB.1
  have SN : SimNorm B.h := simscale_normalized_v4 B.h hh0 hh1 hS
  have hqpos' : ∀ η : Cyl, η.2.2.1 < 1 → 0 < qC B.h η := fun η h =>
    (hS.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hqC' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      (contDiff_snd.fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)

subgoal_signatures.name: nb_real_algebra_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → ∀ k : ℕ, NB h (fun η => f η * g η) k ξ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h g (k - i) ξ ∧ (∀ a b : ℝ, NB h (fun η => a * f η + b * g η) k ξ ≤ |a| * NB h f k ξ + |b| * NB h g k ξ) ∧ (∀ a : ℝ, NB h (fun _ : Cyl => a) k ξ ≤ if k = 0 then |a| else 0)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (W : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (ξ : Cyl) (G : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (φ₁ φ₂ φ₃ : Cyl → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (C D : ℝ), IsOpen U → IsOpen W → ξ ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ₁ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ₂ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ₃ U → (∀ η ∈ U, (φ₁ η, φ₂ η, φ₃ η) ∈ W) → 1 ≤ D → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G (φ₁ ξ, φ₂ ξ, φ₃ ξ)‖ ≤ C) → (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → NB h φ₁ i ξ ≤ D ∧ NB h φ₂ i ξ ≤ D ∧ NB h φ₃ i ξ ≤ D) → NB h (fun η => G (φ₁ η, φ₂ η, φ₃ η)) k ξ ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) * C * (3 * D) ^ k

signature.name: nb_comp3_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (W : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (ξ : Cyl) (G : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (φ₁ φ₂ φ₃ : Cyl → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (C D : ℝ), IsOpen U → IsOpen W → ξ ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ₁ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ₂ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ₃ U → (∀ η ∈ U, (φ₁ η, φ₂ η, φ₃ η) ∈ W) → 1 ≤ D → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G (φ₁ ξ, φ₂ ξ, φ₃ ξ)‖ ≤ C) → (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → NB h φ₁ i ξ ≤ D ∧ NB h φ₂ i ξ ≤ D ∧ NB h φ₃ i ξ ≤ D) → NB h (fun η => G (φ₁ η, φ₂ η, φ₃ η)) k ξ ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) * C * (3 * D) ^ k

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h U W ξ G φ₁ φ₂ φ₃ k C D hU hW hξ hG hφ₁ hφ₂ hφ₃ hmaps hD hGb hNB
  have key : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (F' : Cyl → V),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F' U → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F' (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F' ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) := by
    intro V _ _ F' hF i
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑(Lnorm h ξ) ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage (Lnorm h ξ).continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
    have hT0s : Lnorm h ξ 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑(Lnorm h ξ) ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F' (ξ + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F' (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right (Lnorm h ξ) hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F' (ξ + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F') i ξ 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F' (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F' (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑(Lnorm h ξ)) (⇑(Lnorm h ξ) ⁻¹' s) 0 :=
          e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F' (ξ + z)) s (Lnorm h ξ 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F' (ξ + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F' (ξ + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F' ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) := by
          rw [e4, add_zero]
  have hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (φ₁ η, φ₂ η, φ₃ η)) U := hφ₁.prodMk (hφ₂.prodMk hφ₃)
  have hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => G (φ₁ η, φ₂ η, φ₃ η)) U :=
    hG.comp hΦ (fun η hη => hmaps η hη)
  obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set Cyl, O = (fun z => ξ + Lnorm h ξ z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hO : IsOpen O := by
    rw [hOdef]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add (Lnorm h ξ).continuous)
  have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ O := by
    rw [hOdef]; show ξ + Lnorm h ξ 0 ∈ U; rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact hξ
  have hsub : ∀ ψ : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ψ (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z)) O := by
    intro ψ hψ
    rw [hOdef]
    exact hψ.comp (contDiff_const.add (Lnorm h ξ).contDiff).contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
  have hat : ∀ ψ : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => ψ (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z)) 0 :=
    fun ψ hψ => (hsub ψ hψ).contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds h0O)
  have hnb : ∀ ψ : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U → ∀ i : ℕ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => ψ (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z)) 0‖ = NB h ψ i ξ := by
    intro ψ hψ i; unfold NB; rw [key ψ hψ i]
  obtain ⟨f, hfdef⟩ : ∃ f : Cyl → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,
      f = fun z => (φ₁ (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z), φ₂ (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z), φ₃ (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O := by
    rw [hfdef]; exact (hsub φ₁ hφ₁).prodMk ((hsub φ₂ hφ₂).prodMk (hsub φ₃ hφ₃))
  have hmapsf : Set.MapsTo f O W := by
    intro z hz; rw [hfdef]; rw [hOdef] at hz; exact hmaps _ hz
  have hf0 : f 0 = (φ₁ ξ, φ₂ ξ, φ₃ ξ) := by
    rw [hfdef]; simp only [map_zero, add_zero]
  have hCw : ∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i G W (f 0)‖ ≤ C := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hf0, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hW (hmaps ξ hξ)]
    exact hGb i hi
  have hDw : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i f O 0‖ ≤ (3 * D) ^ i := by
    intro i hi1 hik
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO h0O, hfdef]
    have e1 := iteratedFDeriv_prodMk (hat φ₁ hφ₁) ((hat φ₂ hφ₂).prodMk (hat φ₃ hφ₃))
      (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e2 := iteratedFDeriv_prodMk (hat φ₂ hφ₂) (hat φ₃ hφ₃) (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [e1, ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_prod, e2, ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_prod,
      hnb φ₁ hφ₁, hnb φ₂ hφ₂, hnb φ₃ hφ₃]
    obtain ⟨b1, b2, b3⟩ := hNB i hi1 hik
    have h3 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 3 * D := by linarith
    have hDD : D ≤ (3 * D) ^ i := le_trans (by linarith) (le_self_pow₀ h3 (by omega))
    exact max_le (b1.trans hDD) (max_le (b2.trans hDD) (b3.trans hDD))
  have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hG hf (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    hW.uniqueDiffOn hO.uniqueDiffOn hmapsf h0O (C := C) (D := 3 * D) hCw hDw
  have hEq : (fun z => G (φ₁ (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z), φ₂ (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z), φ₃ (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z))) =
      G ∘ f := by
    rw [hfdef]; rfl
  rw [← hnb _ hF k]
  calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => G (φ₁ (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z), φ₂ (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z),
          φ₃ (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z))) 0‖
      = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (G ∘ f) 0‖ := by rw [hEq]
    _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k (G ∘ f) O 0‖ := by
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hO h0O]
    _ ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) * C * (3 * D) ^ k := hFdB

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (d : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl), B.ok → ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ (d γ m) ξ → primOp5 B G (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • d γ' m' η) γ m ξ = (((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1 + B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • dVc B γ.1 (d γ m) ξ + (pulseMatC (prinMat5 B G γ m ξ)).mulVec (d γ m ξ)

signature.name: prin_small_pointwise_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (d : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl), B.ok → ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ (d γ m) ξ → primOp5 B G (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • d γ' m' η) γ m ξ = (((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1 + B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • dVc B γ.1 (d γ m) ξ + (pulseMatC (prinMat5 B G γ m ξ)).mulVec (d γ m ξ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G d γ m ξ hok hξ hdiff
  have hτ : (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 := by linarith
  have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).1
  have hQ : 0 < Qb γ.1 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  
  have hqd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (qC B.h) ξ := by
    have hS : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt ((isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds ⟨trivial, hτ⟩)
    have hS' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) :=
      hS.differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hπ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => (η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1)) ξ := by fun_prop
    have h : DifferentiableAt ℝ ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun η : Cyl => (η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1))) ξ := hS'.comp ξ hπ
    exact h
  have hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ :=
    Complex.ofRealCLM.differentiableAt.comp ξ (hqd.rpow_const (Or.inl hq.ne'))
  
  have hcv : fderiv ℝ (fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ (dVdir B.h γ.1) = 0 := by
    have hl : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ξ + t • dVdir B.h γ.1) (dVdir B.h γ.1) 0 := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const (dVdir B.h γ.1)).const_add ξ
    have h1 := hc.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) hl (by simp)
    have hconst : ((fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∘
        fun t : ℝ => ξ + t • dVdir B.h γ.1) =
        fun _ => (((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      funext t
      simp [dVdir, qC, Function.comp]
    rw [hconst] at h1
    exact h1.unique (hasDerivAt_const _ _)
  
  have hD : dVc B γ.1 (fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • d γ m η) ξ =
      (((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • dVc B γ.1 (d γ m) ξ := by
    unfold dVc
    have e : (fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • d γ m η) =
        (fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • d γ m := rfl
    rw [e, fderiv_smul hc hdiff]
    simp [hcv]
  
  have hM : pulseMatC (prinMat5 B G γ m ξ) =
      (((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1 + B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (pulseMatC (Kmat B G γ ξ) +
        ((((m : ℝ) ^ 2 * dDamp5 B G γ ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ)) := by
    ext i j
    simp only [pulseMatC, prinMat5, Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.add_apply,
      Matrix.one_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    split_ifs <;> simp only [mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_add]
  
  have hY : 0 < Qb γ.1 ^ B.h := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ _
  have hX : 0 < qC B.h ξ ^ (1 + B.h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _
  have hZ : 0 < qC B.h ξ ^ Aex B.h := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _
  have R1 : qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) = qC B.h ξ ^ (1 + B.h) * qC B.h ξ ^ Aex B.h := by
    rw [show 2 * Aex B.h + 1/2 = (1 + B.h) + Aex B.h by unfold Aex; ring, Real.rpow_add hq]
  have R2 : qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) = (qC B.h ξ ^ Aex B.h)⁻¹ := Real.rpow_neg hq.le _
  have R3 : Qb γ.1 ^ (1 + B.h) = Qb γ.1 * Qb γ.1 ^ B.h := by
    rw [Real.rpow_add hQ, Real.rpow_one]
  have R4 : Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1 + B.h)) = (Qb γ.1 * Qb γ.1 ^ B.h)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hQ.le, R3]
  have R5 : Qb γ.1 ^ (-(Aex B.h + 1/2)) = (Qb γ.1 * Qb γ.1 ^ B.h)⁻¹ := by
    rw [show Aex B.h + 1/2 = 1 + B.h by unfold Aex; ring, R4]
  have R6 : rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1 + B.h) = qC B.h ξ ^ (1 + B.h) / (Qb γ.1 * Qb γ.1 ^ B.h) := by
    unfold rhoQ
    rw [Real.div_rpow hq.le hQ.le, R3]
  have R7 : dDamp5 B G γ ξ = Qb γ.1 ^ B.h * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 *
      dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) := rfl
  have E1r : qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) =
      rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1 + B.h) := by
    rw [R1, R4, R2, R6]
    generalize qC B.h ξ ^ (1 + B.h) = X at hX ⊢
    generalize qC B.h ξ ^ Aex B.h = Z at hZ ⊢
    generalize Qb γ.1 ^ B.h = Y at hY ⊢
    field_simp
  have E2r : qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(Aex B.h + 1/2)) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) =
      rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1 + B.h) := by
    rw [R5, ← R4]
    exact E1r
  have E3r : ((m : ℝ) ^ 2 * (((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 * dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) /
      Qb γ.1 : ℝ))) * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) =
      rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1 + B.h) * ((m : ℝ) ^ 2 * dDamp5 B G γ ξ) := by
    rw [R1, R2, R6, R7]
    generalize qC B.h ξ ^ (1 + B.h) = X at hX ⊢
    generalize qC B.h ξ ^ Aex B.h = Z at hZ ⊢
    generalize Qb γ.1 ^ B.h = Y at hY ⊢
    field_simp
  have E1c : (((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1 + B.h))) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) = (((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1 + B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, E1r]
  have E2c : (((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((Qb γ.1 ^ (-(Aex B.h + 1/2))) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) = (((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1 + B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, E2r]
  have E3c : ((m : ℂ) ^ 2 * (((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 * dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) /
      Qb γ.1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) * (((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      (((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1 + B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((((m : ℝ) ^ 2 * dDamp5 B G γ ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_intCast, ← Complex.ofReal_pow, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_mul,
      ← Complex.ofReal_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, E3r]
  
  simp only [primOp5]
  rw [hD, Matrix.mulVec_smul, hM]
  simp only [Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  funext i
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  linear_combination (dVc B γ.1 (d γ m) ξ i) * E1c +
    ((pulseMatC (Kmat B G γ ξ)).mulVec (d γ m ξ) i) * E2c + (d γ m ξ i) * E3c

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (β : ℝ) (d : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β d → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β (fun γ m ξ => dVc B γ.1 (d γ m) ξ)

signature.name: inWg5_dVc_class_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (β : ℝ) (d : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β d → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β (fun γ m ξ => dVc B γ.1 (d γ m) ξ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lp, Hp⟩ := pulse_support_good_v5 B G hok hG
  refine ⟨lp + 7, fun l0 hl0 β d hd => ?_⟩
  have hh : 0 < B.h := hok.2.1.1
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  obtain ⟨hDo, hqpos⟩ : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < qC B.h ξ := by
    refine ⟨?_, fun ξ hξ => (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ.2.1])).1⟩
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  
  have hs2a : (1:ℝ) < Real.sqrt 2 := by
    have h := Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num) (show (1:ℝ) < 2 by norm_num)
    rwa [Real.sqrt_one] at h
  have hs2b : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := (Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)).mpr (by norm_num)
  have hT1 : 1 < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; linarith
  have hT0 : 0 < Tgc := by linarith
  have hbgc0 : 0 < bgc := by unfold bgc; linarith
  have hbgc1 : bgc < 1 := by unfold bgc; linarith
  
  have hJ : ∀ (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ), JpowL n (t • vtv) = (Tgc ^ n * t) • vtv := by
    intro n t
    have hD : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    simp only [JpowL, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', Jpow, vrv, vtv]
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.fst_add, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
      ring
    · simp only [Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.snd_add, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
      ring
  
  have hframe : ∀ (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb l →
      ∃ w : Cyl, Lnorm B.h ξ w = dVdir B.h l ∧ ‖w‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro l ξ hwin
    have hQ : 0 < Qb l := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _
    have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := by
      have h1 := mul_pos (show (0:ℝ) < qC B.h ξ / Qb l by linarith) hQ
      rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hQ.ne'] at h1
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j : ℕ, j = bandOf (qC B.h ξ) - 4 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hc : coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ) = bandIdx B.h j := by rw [hj]; rfl
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s = Qb l ^ (1 + B.h) * Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h j) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    
    have hP : 0 < (2:ℝ) ^ (l:ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _
    have hQP : Qb l = ((2:ℝ) ^ (l:ℝ))⁻¹ := by unfold Qb; exact Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num) _
    have hwin' : 1/4 < qC B.h ξ * (2:ℝ) ^ (l:ℝ) := by
      rw [hQP, div_inv_eq_mul] at hwin; exact hwin
    have hband : bandOf (qC B.h ξ) ≤ l + 2 := by
      unfold bandOf
      rw [Nat.ceil_le, Real.logb_le_iff_le_rpow one_lt_two (by positivity)]
      have e : (2:ℝ) ^ (((l + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) = 4 * (2:ℝ) ^ (l:ℝ) := by
        rw [Nat.cast_add, Real.rpow_add two_pos, Real.rpow_natCast]; ring
      rw [e, div_le_iff₀ hq]
      have e2 : 4 * (2:ℝ) ^ (l:ℝ) * qC B.h ξ = 4 * (qC B.h ξ * (2:ℝ) ^ (l:ℝ)) := by ring
      rw [e2]
      linarith
    have hjl : j ≤ l := by omega
    
    have hTj : Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h j) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (j:ℝ)) := by
      unfold bandIdx
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with h0 | hpos
      · have e : Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (j:ℝ)) / ((j:ℝ) ^ 2)) = 0 := by
          rw [h0]; simp
        rw [e, Int.floor_zero, zpow_zero, h0]
        simp
      · obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (j:ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
        rw [← hA]
        have hl1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (j:ℝ) ^ 2 := one_le_pow₀ (by exact_mod_cast hpos)
        have hA0 : 0 < A := by rw [hA]; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _
        have hAl : 0 < A / (j:ℝ) ^ 2 := div_pos hA0 (by linarith)
        have h1 := Int.floor_le (Real.logb Tgc (A / (j:ℝ) ^ 2))
        calc Tgc ^ ⌊Real.logb Tgc (A / (j:ℝ) ^ 2)⌋
            = Tgc ^ ((⌊Real.logb Tgc (A / (j:ℝ) ^ 2)⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_intCast _ _).symm
          _ ≤ Tgc ^ (Real.logb Tgc (A / (j:ℝ) ^ 2)) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hT1.le h1
          _ = A / (j:ℝ) ^ 2 := Real.rpow_logb hT0 hT1.ne' hAl
          _ ≤ A := div_le_self hA0.le hl1
    
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := by
      rw [hs]; exact mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hQ.le _) (zpow_pos hT0 _).le
    have hQr : Qb l ^ (1 + B.h) = (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l:ℝ) * (1 + B.h)) := by
      unfold Qb; rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num)]
    have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := by
      have hjl' : (j:ℝ) ≤ (l:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hjl
      have hex : -(l:ℝ) * (1 + B.h) + (1 + B.h) * (j:ℝ) = (1 + B.h) * ((j:ℝ) - l) := by ring
      calc s = (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l:ℝ) * (1 + B.h)) * Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h j) := by rw [hs, hQr]
        _ ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l:ℝ) * (1 + B.h)) * (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (j:ℝ)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hTj (Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _)
        _ = (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l:ℝ) * (1 + B.h) + (1 + B.h) * (j:ℝ)) := (Real.rpow_add two_pos _ _).symm
        _ ≤ 1 := by
            rw [hex]
            exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num)
              (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (by linarith) (by linarith))
    refine ⟨((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), s • vtv), ?_, ?_⟩
    · have e0 : ∀ v : Cyl, (Lnorm B.h ξ v).1 = Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * v.1 := by
        intro v; simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
      have e1 : ∀ v : Cyl, (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.1 = qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1 := by
        intro v; simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
      have e2 : ∀ v : Cyl, (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 = qC B.h ξ * v.2.2.1 := by
        intro v; simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
      have e3 : ∀ v : Cyl, (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.2 = JpowL (-coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) v.2.2.2 := by
        intro v; rfl
      have h1 : Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h j) ≠ 0 := (zpow_pos hT0 _).ne'
      have h2 : Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h l) ≠ 0 := (zpow_pos hT0 _).ne'
      refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_))
      · rw [e0]; simp [dVdir]
      · rw [e1]; simp [dVdir]
      · rw [e2]; simp [dVdir]
      · rw [e3]
        show JpowL (-coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) (s • vtv) = (cib B.h l * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx B.h l))) • vtv
        rw [hJ, hc, hs]
        congr 1
        unfold cib
        rw [zpow_neg, zpow_neg, mul_comm (Qb l ^ (1 + B.h)), ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ h1, one_mul,
          mul_comm (Tgc ^ bandIdx B.h l), mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ h2, mul_one]
    · have hv : ‖vtv‖ = 1 := by
        unfold vtv
        rw [Prod.norm_mk, Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_one, abs_of_pos hbgc0, max_eq_right hbgc1.le]
      rw [Prod.norm_mk, Prod.norm_mk, Prod.norm_mk]
      simp only [norm_zero, norm_nonneg, max_eq_right]
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hv, mul_one, abs_of_nonneg hs0]
      exact hs1
  
  have nbdir : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (F : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (w : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → ∀ k : ℕ,
      NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm B.h ξ w)) k ξ ≤ ‖w‖ * NB B.h F (k + 1) ξ := by
    intro ξ F w hξ hF k
    have hFd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) ξ :=
      (hF.fderiv_of_isOpen hDo (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hξ)
    have hcomp : (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm B.h ξ w)) =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (Fin 3 → ℂ) (Lnorm B.h ξ w)) ∘ (fderiv ℝ F) := by
      funext η; rfl
    have hit : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm B.h ξ w)) ξ =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (Fin 3 → ℂ) (Lnorm B.h ξ w)).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ F) ξ) := by
      rw [hcomp]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left _ hFd (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hNB0 : 0 ≤ NB B.h F (k + 1) ξ := norm_nonneg _
    unfold NB
    rw [hit]
    apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hNB0)
    intro m
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply]
    have key : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ F) ξ (fun i => Lnorm B.h ξ (m i))) (Lnorm B.h ξ w) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ))
          (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w) := by
      rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right]
      have e1 : Fin.init (fun i : Fin (k+1) => Lnorm B.h ξ (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i)) =
          fun i => Lnorm B.h ξ (m i) := by
        funext i
        simp [Fin.init, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      rw [e1]
      simp only [Fin.snoc_last]
    rw [key]
    have hprod : ∏ i : Fin (k+1), ‖Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i‖ =
        (∏ i : Fin k, ‖m i‖) * ‖w‖ := by
      rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
      simp [Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)‖ *
          ∏ i : Fin (k+1), ‖Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i‖ :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ = ‖w‖ * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)‖ *
          ∏ i : Fin k, ‖m i‖ := by rw [hprod]; ring
  
  have Gm : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∉ tsupport (d γ m) →
      (fun η => fderiv ℝ (d γ m) η (dVdir B.h γ.1)) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ) := by
    intro γ m ξ hts
    have h0 : d γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hts
    filter_upwards [h0.eventuallyEq_nhds] with η hη
    show fderiv ℝ (d γ m) η (dVdir B.h γ.1) = 0
    rw [hη.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  
  have hED : ∀ X : ℝ, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb → 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X := by
    intro X h1 h2
    have hX0 : 0 < X := lt_trans hXa h1
    unfold edgeDist
    exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr h1))
      (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr h2)))
  have key6 : ∀ (C x1 x2 x3 x4 x5 : ℝ), 0 ≤ x1 → 0 ≤ x2 → 0 ≤ x3 → 0 ≤ x4 → 0 ≤ x5 →
      C * x1 * x2 * x3 * x4 * x5 ≤ |C| * x1 * x2 * x3 * x4 * x5 ∧
        0 ≤ |C| * x1 * x2 * x3 * x4 * x5 := by
    intro C x1 x2 x3 x4 x5 h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
    have hx := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg h1 h2) h3) h4) h5
    constructor
    · calc C * x1 * x2 * x3 * x4 * x5 = C * (x1 * x2 * x3 * x4 * x5) := by ring
        _ ≤ |C| * (x1 * x2 * x3 * x4 * x5) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) hx
        _ = |C| * x1 * x2 * x3 * x4 * x5 := by ring
    · calc (0:ℝ) ≤ |C| * (x1 * x2 * x3 * x4 * x5) := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg C) hx
        _ = |C| * x1 * x2 * x3 * x4 * x5 := by ring
  obtain ⟨H, hH0, hHz⟩ := hd.1
  refine ⟨⟨H, hH0, fun γ m hm => ?_⟩, fun γ m => ?_, fun γ m ξ hξ c hc => ?_, fun γ m ξ hξ hne => ?_,
    fun k => ?_⟩
  · 
    funext ξ
    show fderiv ℝ (d γ m) ξ (dVdir B.h γ.1) = 0
    rw [hHz γ m hm]
    simp
  · 
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => fderiv ℝ (d γ m) ξ (dVdir B.h γ.1)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))
    exact ((hd.2.1 γ m).fderiv_of_isOpen hDo (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  · 
    show fderiv ℝ (d γ m) (shY ξ c) (dVdir B.h γ.1) = fderiv ℝ (d γ m) ξ (dVdir B.h γ.1)
    have hloc : ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, d γ m (shY η c) = d γ m η := by
      filter_upwards [hDo.mem_nhds hξ, deck_locally_stable_v5 B l0 hok (by omega) ξ hξ c hc]
        with η hη hdη
      exact hd.2.2.1 γ m η hη c hdη
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : Cyl, e = ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), c) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hsh : ∀ η : Cyl, shY η c = η + e := by
      intro η
      rw [he]
      simp only [shY]
      ext <;> simp
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (d γ m) (shY ξ c) = fderiv ℝ (d γ m) ξ := by
      have hev : (fun x => d γ m (x + e)) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] d γ m :=
        hloc.mono (fun η hη => by
          show d γ m (η + e) = d γ m η
          rw [← hsh η, hη])
      rw [hsh ξ, ← fderiv_comp_add_right]
      exact hev.fderiv_eq
    rw [hfd]
  · 
    by_cases hts : ξ ∈ tsupport (d γ m)
    · exact (Hp l0 (by omega) β d hd γ m ξ hξ hts).1
    · exact absurd (Gm γ m ξ hts).eq_of_nhds hne
  · 
    obtain ⟨C, b, dd, hC⟩ := hd.2.2.2.2 (k + 1)
    refine ⟨|C|, b, dd, fun γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
    have hk := key6 C (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * β)) (SC B.h ξ ^ b)
      (Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)))
      (edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-dd)) (Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2))
      (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by unfold SC; positivity) _)
      (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (hED _ hX1 hX2).le _)
      (by unfold Penv5; exact (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    show NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ (d γ m) η (dVdir B.h γ.1)) k ξ ≤ _
    by_cases hts : ξ ∈ tsupport (d γ m)
    · obtain ⟨w, hw, hwn⟩ := hframe γ.1 ξ (Hp l0 (by omega) β d hd γ m ξ hξ hts).2.2.2.1
      have h1 := nbdir ξ (d γ m) w hξ (hd.2.1 γ m) k
      rw [hw] at h1
      calc NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ (d γ m) η (dVdir B.h γ.1)) k ξ
          ≤ ‖w‖ * NB B.h (d γ m) (k + 1) ξ := h1
        _ ≤ NB B.h (d γ m) (k + 1) ξ := mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hwn
        _ ≤ _ := hC γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2
        _ ≤ _ := hk.1
    · have hev := Gm γ m ξ hts
      have hz : NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ (d γ m) η (dVdir B.h γ.1)) k ξ = 0 := by
        unfold NB
        rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
        have h0 : ((0 : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => Cyl) (Fin 3 → ℂ)).compContinuousLinearMap
            fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) = 0 := by
          ext v
          simp
        rw [h0, norm_zero]
      rw [hz]
      exact hk.2
