signature.name: inWg5_mat_mult_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ), B.ok → ∀ (α β : ℝ) (a : WC) (M : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → (∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) → ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => M γ m η i j) ξ) → (∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → ∀ c : ℝ × ℝ, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c → M γ m (shY ξ c) = M γ m ξ) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) → B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → ∀ i j : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η => M γ m η i j) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * β) * SC B.h ξ ^ b) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + β) (fun γ m ξ => (pulseMatC (M γ m ξ)).mulVec (a γ m ξ))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 hok α β a M ha hsm hdeck hbd
  
  obtain ⟨Bl, hBl⟩ : ∃ Bl : Fin 3 × Fin 3 → ℝ →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ),
      ∀ p s v, Bl p s v = fun t => if t = p.1 then (s : ℂ) * v p.2 else 0 := by
    refine ⟨fun p => LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
      ((LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap : ((Fin 3 → ℂ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ)) ≃ₗ[ℝ]
        ((Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ))).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ (fun (s : ℝ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ) => fun t => if t = p.1 then (s : ℂ) * v p.2 else 0)
          (fun s1 s2 v => by
            funext t; by_cases ht : t = p.1 <;> simp [ht] <;> ring)
          (fun c s v => by
            funext t; by_cases ht : t = p.1 <;> simp [ht, Complex.real_smul] <;> ring)
          (fun s v1 v2 => by
            funext t; by_cases ht : t = p.1 <;> simp [ht] <;> ring)
          (fun c s v => by
            funext t; by_cases ht : t = p.1 <;> simp [ht, Complex.real_smul] <;> ring)),
      fun p s v => rfl⟩
  have hmv : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
      (pulseMatC A).mulVec v = ∑ p, Bl p (A p.1 p.2) v := by
    intro A v
    funext t
    rw [Finset.sum_apply]
    simp only [hBl]
    fin_cases t <;>
      simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, pulseMatC, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have hz : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ, (pulseMatC A).mulVec (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ) = 0 :=
    fun A => Matrix.mulVec_zero _
  have hP : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), (fun ξ => (pulseMatC (M γ m ξ)).mulVec (a γ m ξ)) =
      fun η => ∑ p, Bl p (M γ m η p.1 p.2) (a γ m η) := by
    intro γ m; funext ξ; exact hmv _ _
  
  have hLeib : ∀ (f : Fin 3 × Fin 3 → Cyl → ℝ) (g : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (k : ℕ),
      IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → (∀ p, ContDiffOn ℝ k (f p) U) → ContDiffOn ℝ k g U →
      NB B.h (fun η => ∑ p, Bl p (f p η) (g η)) k ξ ≤
        ∑ p, ‖Bl p‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
          (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h (f p) i ξ * NB B.h g (k - i) ξ := by
    intro f g U ξ k hU hξ hf hg
    unfold NB
    generalize Lnorm B.h ξ = L
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage L.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
    have hL0s : L 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
    have hsm' : ∀ {Y : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y] (F : Cyl → Y),
        ContDiffOn ℝ k F U → ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
      intro Y _ _ F hF
      exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have hsmO : ∀ {Y : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y] (F : Cyl → Y),
        ContDiffOn ℝ k F U → ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by
      intro Y _ _ F hF
      exact (hsm' F hF).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
    have key : ∀ {Y : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y] (F : Cyl → Y),
        ContDiffOn ℝ k F U → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k →
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0 =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
      intro Y _ _ F hF i hi
      have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O
      have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L (hsm' F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
        hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
      have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + z)) i hs h0s
      have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i ξ 0
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0
          = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑L) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := e2
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [map_zero]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [e3]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
    have hfg : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun η => ∑ p, Bl p (f p η) (g η)) U :=
      ContDiffOn.sum (fun p _ => (contDiffOn_const.clm_apply (hf p)).clm_apply hg)
    have hT : ∀ p, ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun z => Bl p (f p (ξ + L z)) (g (ξ + L z))) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) :=
      fun p => (contDiffOn_const.clm_apply (hsmO _ (hf p))).clm_apply (hsmO _ hg)
    have hsumeq : (fun z => (fun η => ∑ p, Bl p (f p η) (g η)) (ξ + L z)) =
        ∑ p, (fun z => Bl p (f p (ξ + L z)) (g (ξ + L z))) := by
      funext z; simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
    have hdist : iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k (∑ p, (fun z => Bl p (f p (ξ + L z)) (g (ξ + L z))))
        (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 =
        ∑ p, iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k (fun z => Bl p (f p (ξ + L z)) (g (ξ + L z))) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 :=
      iteratedFDerivWithin_sum_apply hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O (fun p _ => (hT p) 0 h0O)
    have hper : ∀ p, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k (fun z => Bl p (f p (ξ + L z)) (g (ξ + L z)))
        (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0‖ ≤ ‖Bl p‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) *
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (f p) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L)‖ *
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) g ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L)‖ := by
      intro p
      have leib := (Bl p).norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_le_of_bilinear (hsmO _ (hf p)) (hsmO _ hg)
        hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O (n := k) le_rfl
      refine le_trans leib (le_of_eq ?_)
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f p (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O,
        iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => g (ξ + L z)) (k - i) hO h0O,
        key (f p) (hf p) i hik, key g hg (k - i) (Nat.sub_le k i)]
    rw [← key _ hfg k le_rfl, hsumeq, ← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hO h0O, hdist]
    exact le_trans (norm_sum_le _ _) (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun p _ => hper p))
  
  have hh0 : 0 ≤ B.h := hok.2.1.1.le
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  have hDq : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < qC B.h ξ ∧ qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 ∧ 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
    have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
      show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
      exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    intro ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨-, e2, e3⟩ := hξ
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
    refine ⟨hq0, by linarith, ?_⟩
    unfold SC
    have : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| := by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))]
    exact one_le_pow₀ this
  have hEdge : ∀ X : ℝ, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb → 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X ∧
      0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ∧ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ≤ 1 := by
    intro X e1 e2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, min_le_left _ _⟩
    · unfold edgeWeight
      split_ifs
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      · exact le_rfl
    · have hX : 0 < X := lt_trans hXa e1
      have l1 : 0 < Real.log (X / B.Xa) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr e1)
      have l2 : 0 < Real.log (B.Xb / X) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr e2)
      exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min l1 l2)
  obtain ⟨⟨H, H0, Hv⟩, sa, da, pa, ba⟩ := ha
  choose CN bN hN using hbd
  choose Ca bA dA hA using ba
  
  have comb : ∀ (k : ℕ) (q S E e P K : ℝ) (nN na : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < q → 1 ≤ S → 0 ≤ E → 0 < e →
      e ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ P → 0 ≤ K → (∀ i, 0 ≤ nN i) → (∀ j, 0 ≤ na j) →
      (∀ i, i ≤ k → nN i ≤ CN i * q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i)) →
      (∀ j, j ≤ k → na j ≤ Ca j * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA j) * E * e ^ (-(dA j)) * P) →
      K * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * nN i * na (k - i) ≤
        (K * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)|) *
          q ^ (B.h * (α + β)) *
          S ^ ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j|) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j|) * E *
          e ^ (-(∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dA j|)) * P := by
    intro k q S E e P K nN na hq hS hE he0 he1 hP0 hK hnN hna hbN hba
    have hS0 : 0 < S := by linarith
    obtain ⟨X, hXdef⟩ : ∃ X : ℝ, X = q ^ (B.h * (α + β)) *
        S ^ ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j|) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j|) * E *
        e ^ (-(∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dA j|)) * P := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * nN i * na (k - i) ≤
        (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)| * X := by
      intro i hi
      have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
      have hjk : k - i ≤ k := Nat.sub_le k i
      have hj : k - i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
      have pq1 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * β) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
      have pq2 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
      have pS1 : 0 ≤ S ^ (bN i) := Real.rpow_nonneg hS0.le _
      have pS2 : 0 ≤ S ^ (bA (k - i)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hS0.le _
      have pe : 0 ≤ e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) := Real.rpow_nonneg he0.le _
      have hA1 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i) := mul_nonneg pq1 pS1
      have hA2 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg pq2 pS2) hE) pe) hP0
      have a1 : nN i ≤ |CN i| * (q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i)) := by
        refine le_trans (hbN i hik) ?_
        rw [mul_assoc]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hA1
      have a2 : na (k - i) ≤
          |Ca (k - i)| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P) := by
        refine le_trans (hba (k - i) hjk) ?_
        have : Ca (k - i) * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P =
            Ca (k - i) * (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P) := by
          ring
        rw [this]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hA2
      have a3 : nN i * na (k - i) ≤ (|CN i| * (q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i))) *
          (|Ca (k - i)| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P)) :=
        mul_le_mul a1 a2 (hna _) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hA1)
      have hbsum : bN i + bA (k - i) ≤
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j|) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j| := by
        have s1 : |bN i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |bN j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) hi
        have s2 : |bA (k - i)| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |bA j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) hj
        linarith [le_abs_self (bN i), le_abs_self (bA (k - i))]
      have hdsum : dA (k - i) ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dA j| := by
        have s3 : |dA (k - i)| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dA j| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |dA j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) hj
        linarith [le_abs_self (dA (k - i))]
      have f1 : S ^ (bN i + bA (k - i)) ≤
          S ^ ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j|) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j|) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS hbsum
      have f2 : e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) ≤ e ^ (-(∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dA j|)) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge he0 he1 (neg_le_neg hdsum)
      have eq1 : q ^ (B.h * β) * q ^ (B.h * α) = q ^ (B.h * (α + β)) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]; congr 1; ring
      have pQ : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * (α + β)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
      have a4 : (q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i)) *
          (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P) ≤ X := by
        calc (q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i)) *
              (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P)
            = (q ^ (B.h * β) * q ^ (B.h * α)) * (S ^ (bN i) * S ^ (bA (k - i))) * E *
                e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P := by ring
          _ = q ^ (B.h * (α + β)) * S ^ (bN i + bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P := by
              rw [eq1, ← Real.rpow_add hS0]
          _ ≤ X := by
              rw [hXdef]
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hP0
              apply mul_le_mul _ f2 pe
                (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg pQ (Real.rpow_nonneg hS0.le _)) hE)
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hE
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left f1 pQ
      have hc : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      calc (k.choose i : ℝ) * nN i * na (k - i) = (k.choose i : ℝ) * (nN i * na (k - i)) := by ring
        _ ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * ((|CN i| * (q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i))) *
            (|Ca (k - i)| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a3 hc
        _ = (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)| * ((q ^ (B.h * β) * S ^ (bN i)) *
            (q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ (bA (k - i)) * E * e ^ (-(dA (k - i))) * P)) := by ring
        _ ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)| * X :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a4
              (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc (abs_nonneg _)) (abs_nonneg _))
    calc K * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * nN i * na (k - i)
        ≤ K * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)| * X :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum hterm) hK
      _ = _ := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hXdef]; ring
  
  have hV : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∉ tsupport (a γ m) →
      (fun η => (pulseMatC (M γ m η)).mulVec (a γ m η)) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ) := by
    intro γ m ξ hξ
    have h1 := (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq).1 hξ
    exact h1.mono (fun η hη => by
      show (pulseMatC (M γ m η)).mulVec (a γ m η) = 0
      rw [hη]
      exact hz _)
  have hKn : 0 ≤ ∑ p, ‖Bl p‖ := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun p _ => ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg _)
  refine ⟨⟨H, H0, fun γ m hm => ?_⟩, fun γ m => ?_, fun γ m ξ hξ c hc => ?_,
    fun γ m ξ hξ hne => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · funext ξ
    show (pulseMatC (M γ m ξ)).mulVec (a γ m ξ) = 0
    rw [Hv γ m hm]
    exact hz _
  · intro ξ hξ
    apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
    by_cases hts : ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m)
    · have ha' := (sa γ m).contDiffAt (hDopen.mem_nhds hξ)
      show ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => (pulseMatC (M γ m η)).mulVec (a γ m η)) ξ
      rw [hP γ m]
      exact ContDiffAt.sum (fun p _ =>
        (contDiffAt_const.clm_apply (hsm γ m ξ hξ hts p.1 p.2)).clm_apply ha')
    · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hV γ m ξ hts)
  · show (pulseMatC (M γ m (shY ξ c))).mulVec (a γ m (shY ξ c)) =
      (pulseMatC (M γ m ξ)).mulVec (a γ m ξ)
    rw [da γ m ξ hξ c hc]
    by_cases h0 : a γ m ξ = 0
    · rw [h0, hz, hz]
    · rw [hdeck γ m ξ hξ h0 c hc]
  · apply pa γ m ξ hξ
    intro h0
    apply hne
    show (pulseMatC (M γ m ξ)).mulVec (a γ m ξ) = 0
    rw [h0]
    exact hz _
  · refine ⟨(∑ p, ‖Bl p‖) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)|,
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j|) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j|,
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dA j|, fun γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hq0, hq1, hS1⟩ := hDq ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨hE, he0, he1⟩ := hEdge _ hX1 hX2
    have hPv : 0 ≤ Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by
      unfold Penv5
      exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
    show NB B.h (fun η => (pulseMatC (M γ m η)).mulVec (a γ m η)) k ξ ≤ _
    by_cases hts : ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m)
    · have hMk : ∀ p : Fin 3 × Fin 3, ∀ᶠ y in nhds ξ, ContDiffAt ℝ k (fun η => M γ m η p.1 p.2) y :=
        fun p => ((hsm γ m ξ hξ hts p.1 p.2).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).eventually (by simp)
      have hall : ∀ᶠ y in nhds ξ, ∀ p : Fin 3 × Fin 3, ContDiffAt ℝ k (fun η => M γ m η p.1 p.2) y :=
        Filter.eventually_all.2 hMk
      obtain ⟨O, hOsub, hOopen, hξO⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp (Filter.inter_mem hall (hDopen.mem_nhds hξ))
      have hMO : ∀ p : Fin 3 × Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun η => M γ m η p.1 p.2) O :=
        fun p y hy => ((hOsub hy).1 p).contDiffWithinAt
      have haO : ContDiffOn ℝ k (a γ m) O :=
        ((sa γ m).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).2)
      have hL := hLeib (fun p η => M γ m η p.1 p.2) (a γ m) O ξ k hOopen hξO hMO haO
      rw [hP γ m]
      refine le_trans hL ?_
      obtain ⟨Wt, hWt⟩ : ∃ Wt : ℝ, Wt = qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α + β)) *
          SC B.h ξ ^ ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bN j|) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bA j|) *
          Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) *
          edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-(∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |dA j|)) *
          Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨Sg, hSg⟩ : ∃ Sg : ℝ,
          Sg = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hcomb : ∀ p : Fin 3 × Fin 3, ‖Bl p‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
          (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h (fun η => M γ m η p.1 p.2) i ξ * NB B.h (a γ m) (k - i) ξ ≤
          ‖Bl p‖ * (Sg * Wt) := by
        intro p
        refine le_trans (comb k (qC B.h ξ) (SC B.h ξ)
          (Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)))
          (edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ)) (Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)) ‖Bl p‖
          (fun i => NB B.h (fun η => M γ m η p.1 p.2) i ξ) (fun j => NB B.h (a γ m) j ξ) hq0 hS1
          (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) he0 he1 hPv (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg _)
          (fun i => norm_nonneg _) (fun j => norm_nonneg _)
          (fun i _ => hN i γ m ξ hξ hts hX1 hX2 p.1 p.2) (fun j _ => hA j γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2))
          (le_of_eq ?_)
        rw [hWt, hSg]; ring
      calc _ ≤ ∑ p : Fin 3 × Fin 3, ‖Bl p‖ * (Sg * Wt) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun p _ => hcomb p)
        _ = (∑ p : Fin 3 × Fin 3, ‖Bl p‖) * (Sg * Wt) := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
        _ = _ := by rw [hWt, hSg]; ring
    · have hev := hV γ m ξ hts
      have h0 : NB B.h (fun η => (pulseMatC (M γ m η)).mulVec (a γ m η)) k ξ = 0 := by
        unfold NB
        rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
        have e : ((0 : Cyl → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => Cyl) (Fin 3 → ℂ)) ξ
            ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) = 0 := by
          ext m
          simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
        rw [e, norm_zero]
      rw [h0]
      have hC0 : 0 ≤ (∑ p, ‖Bl p‖) *
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |CN i| * |Ca (k - i)| :=
        mul_nonneg hKn (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ =>
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) (abs_nonneg _)))
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC0
        (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
        (Real.rpow_nonneg he0.le _)) hPv

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (l0 : ℕ), l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ActiveL4 B G γ → l0 ≤ γ.1 → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 → qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 → B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb → |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 → |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 → ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => prinMat5 B G γ m η i j) ξ ∧ NB B.h (fun η => prinMat5 B G γ m η i j) k ξ ≤ C * (1 + (m : ℝ) ^ 2) * SC B.h ξ ^ b ∧ ∀ c : ℝ × ℝ, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c → prinMat5 B G γ m (shY ξ c) i j = prinMat5 B G γ m ξ i j

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  have hSN : SimNorm B.h := simscale_normalized_v4 B.h hh0 hh1 hok.1
  obtain ⟨lK, HK⟩ := good_kmat_nb_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lN, HN⟩ := good_nphi5_nb_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lg, Hg⟩ := band_coarse_gap_v5 B.h hh0 hh1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  obtain ⟨hD1o, hq1sm, hq1pos, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B 1 hok
  
  have hrho : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (Q : ℝ), 0 < Q → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h 1,
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (qC B.h η / Q) ^ (1 + B.h)) k ξ ≤ K * (qC B.h ξ / Q) ^ (1 + B.h) := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := nb_qpow_v4 B 1 (1 + B.h) hok hSN one_pos le_rfl k
    refine ⟨|C0|, abs_nonneg _, fun Q hQ ξ hξ => ?_⟩
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (1 + B.h)) (DomC B.h 1) :=
      hq1sm.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hq1pos η hη).ne')
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = (Q ^ (1 + B.h))⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by rw [ha]; exact inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.rpow_nonneg hQ.le _)
    have hev : (fun η : Cyl => (qC B.h η / Q) ^ (1 + B.h)) =ᶠ[nhds ξ]
        (fun η => a * qC B.h η ^ (1 + B.h) + 0 * qC B.h η ^ (1 + B.h)) := by
      filter_upwards [hD1o.mem_nhds hξ] with η hη
      rw [Real.div_rpow (hq1pos η hη).le hQ.le, ha]
      ring
    have hNBeq : NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (qC B.h η / Q) ^ (1 + B.h)) k ξ =
        NB B.h (fun η => a * qC B.h η ^ (1 + B.h) + 0 * qC B.h η ^ (1 + B.h)) k ξ := by
      unfold NB
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
    have hlin := (nb_real_algebra_v5 B.h (DomC B.h 1) ξ hD1o hξ _ _ hg hg k).2.1 a 0
    rw [abs_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, abs_of_nonneg ha0] at hlin
    rw [hNBeq]
    refine le_trans hlin ?_
    have hq0 := hq1pos ξ hξ
    calc a * NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (1 + B.h)) k ξ ≤ a * (|C0| * qC B.h ξ ^ (1 + B.h)) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ ha0
          exact le_trans (hC0 ξ hξ)
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _))
      _ = |C0| * (qC B.h ξ / Q) ^ (1 + B.h) := by
          rw [Real.div_rpow hq0.le hQ.le, ha]; ring
  
  have hdot : ∀ (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (N : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (e A : ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U →
      (∀ t : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => N η t) U) →
      (∀ t : Fin 3, ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB B.h (fun η => N η t) i ξ ≤ A) →
      NB B.h (fun η => e * dotProduct (N η) (N η)) k ξ ≤ |e| * (3 * (2 ^ k * A * A)) := by
    intro U ξ N e A k hU hξ hN hA
    obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : Fin 3 → Cyl → ℝ, F = fun t η => N η t * N η t := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hF : ∀ t, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (F t) U := by
      intro t; rw [hFdef]; exact (hN t).mul (hN t)
    have hFb : ∀ t, NB B.h (F t) k ξ ≤ 2 ^ k * A * A := by
      intro t; rw [hFdef]
      exact nb_real_mul_le_v5 B.h ξ (fun η => N η t) (fun η => N η t) k A A
        ((hN t).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)) ((hN t).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)) (hA t) (hA t)
    obtain ⟨S1, hS1⟩ : ∃ S1 : Cyl → ℝ, S1 = fun η => 1 * F 0 η + 1 * F 1 η := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hS1c : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ S1 U := by
      rw [hS1]; exact (contDiffOn_const.mul (hF 0)).add (contDiffOn_const.mul (hF 1))
    have hS1b : NB B.h S1 k ξ ≤ 2 * (2 ^ k * A * A) := by
      have h := (nb_real_algebra_v5 B.h U ξ hU hξ (F 0) (F 1) (hF 0) (hF 1) k).2.1 1 1
      rw [abs_one, one_mul, one_mul] at h
      rw [hS1]; linarith [hFb 0, hFb 1]
    obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : Cyl → ℝ, S = fun η => 1 * S1 η + 1 * F 2 η := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hSc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ S U := by
      rw [hS]; exact (contDiffOn_const.mul hS1c).add (contDiffOn_const.mul (hF 2))
    have hSb : NB B.h S k ξ ≤ 3 * (2 ^ k * A * A) := by
      have h := (nb_real_algebra_v5 B.h U ξ hU hξ S1 (F 2) hS1c (hF 2) k).2.1 1 1
      rw [abs_one, one_mul, one_mul] at h
      rw [hS]; linarith [hFb 2]
    have hE := (nb_real_algebra_v5 B.h U ξ hU hξ S S hSc hSc k).2.1 e 0
    rw [abs_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] at hE
    have hfun : (fun η => e * dotProduct (N η) (N η)) = fun η => e * S η + 0 * S η := by
      funext η
      rw [hS, hS1, hFdef]
      simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    rw [hfun]
    exact le_trans hE (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSb (abs_nonneg e))
  
  have hekb : ∀ l : ℕ, |epsb B.h l * ((kb B.h l : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2| ≤ 4 := by
    intro l
    have hQl : 0 < Qb l := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
    have hQl1 : Qb l ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (by simp)
    have hε0 : 0 < epsb B.h l := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQl _
    have hε1 : epsb B.h l ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one hQl.le hQl1 hh0.le
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = epsb B.h l ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hx1 : 1 ≤ x := by
      rw [hx]; exact Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hε0 hε1 (by norm_num)
    have hx2 : epsb B.h l * x ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [hx, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hε0.le]
      have e2 : (-(1/2:ℝ)) * ((2:ℕ):ℝ) = -1 := by norm_num
      rw [e2, Real.rpow_neg_one, mul_inv_cancel₀ hε0.ne']
    have hk2 : ((kb B.h l : ℕ) : ℝ) < x + 1 := by
      rw [hx]; exact Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (Real.rpow_nonneg hε0.le _)
    have hkk : ((kb B.h l : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (2 * x) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by linarith) 2
    have hpos : 0 ≤ epsb B.h l * ((kb B.h l : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 := mul_nonneg hε0.le (sq_nonneg _)
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hpos]
    calc epsb B.h l * ((kb B.h l : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ epsb B.h l * (2 * x) ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkk hε0.le
      _ = 4 * (epsb B.h l * x ^ 2) := by ring
      _ = 4 := by rw [hx2]; ring
  
  refine ⟨lK + lN + lg + n0, fun k => ?_⟩
  choose CKf hCK using HK
  choose CNf hCN using HN
  choose Krf hKr0 hKr using hrho
  obtain ⟨AKc, hAKc⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |CKf i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ANc, hANc⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |CNf i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Arc, hArc⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = 16 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), Krf i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ADc, hADc⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = 12 * 2 ^ k * ANc ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hAK0 : 0 ≤ AKc := by rw [hAKc]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hAN0 : 0 ≤ ANc := by rw [hANc]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hAr0 : 0 ≤ Arc := by
    rw [hArc]; exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hKr0 i))
  have hAD0 : 0 ≤ ADc := by rw [hADc]; positivity
  refine ⟨2 ^ k * Arc * (AKc + ADc), 2, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 γ m hA hlγ ξ hξ hq1 hq2 hX1 hX2 hxi het i j
  
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0.le
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (by simp)
  have hξB : ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB := ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ.2.2 hqsB⟩
  have hξ1 : ξ ∈ DomC B.h 1 := ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ.2.2 hqs1⟩
  obtain ⟨hDo, hqsm, hqpos, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
  have hQ : 0 < Qb γ.1 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hS1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
    unfold SC
    have : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| := by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))]
    exact one_le_pow₀ this
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by linarith
  have hgap : coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ) ≤ bandIdx B.h γ.1 :=
    (Hg γ.1 l0 (qC B.h ξ) (by omega) hq0 hξ.2.2 hq1 hq2).1
  have hx16 : (qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1) ^ (1 + B.h) ≤ 16 := by
    have h0 : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 := (div_pos hq0 hQ).le
    have h5 := Real.rpow_le_rpow h0 hq2.le (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 + B.h)
    have h6 : (4:ℝ) ^ (1 + B.h) ≤ (4:ℝ) ^ (2:ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    have e : (4:ℝ) ^ (2:ℝ) = 16 := by rw [Real.rpow_two]; norm_num
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨U, hUo, hξU, -, hn, -, hKm⟩ := good_coeff_smooth_v5 B G γ ξ hok hξB hxi het
  have hWo : IsOpen (U ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := hUo.inter hDo
  have hξW : ξ ∈ U ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := ⟨hξU, hξ⟩
  have hrW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (qC B.h η / Qb γ.1) ^ (1 + B.h)) (U ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    ((hqsm.div_const (Qb γ.1)).rpow_const_of_ne
      (fun η hη => (div_pos (hqpos η hη) hQ).ne')).mono Set.inter_subset_right
  have hKW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Kmat B G γ η i j) (U ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    (hKm i j).mono Set.inter_subset_left
  have hnW : ∀ t : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ η t) (U ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    fun t => (hn t).mono Set.inter_subset_left
  have hDW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => dDamp5 B G γ η) (U ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have e : (fun η => dDamp5 B G γ η) = fun η => (epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) *
        (nPhi5 B G γ η 0 * nPhi5 B G γ η 0 + nPhi5 B G γ η 1 * nPhi5 B G γ η 1 +
          nPhi5 B G γ η 2 * nPhi5 B G γ η 2) := by

    rw [show (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (mvec5 h n C' Y0 z s) =
      mvec5 h n C' Y0 z s 2 by rw [EuclideanSpace.coe_proj], (hMc _ z).2.2]
    simp [msc5, hC']
  have hF' := hMdiff C' hc'd
  have hHas := (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp y hF'.hasFDerivAt
  have hPd : HasFDerivAt (fun z => msc5 h n p Y0 z s)
      ((EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp (fderiv ℝ (fun z => mvec5 h n C' Y0 z s) y)) y := by
    rw [hfun]; exact hHas
  have hPv : ∀ v : ℝ³, fderiv ℝ (fun z => msc5 h n p Y0 z s) y v =
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => mvec5 h n C' Y0 z s) y v 2 := by
    intro v
    rw [hPd.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, EuclideanSpace.coe_proj]
  obtain ⟨hC1, hC2, hC3⟩ := hdir c hcd
  obtain ⟨hP1, hP2, hP3⟩ := hdir C' hc'd
  refine ⟨hMdiff c hcd, hPd.differentiableAt, hC1, hC2, hC3, hTime, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hPv, hP1, (hMc _ y).2.2]
    simp [msc5, hC']
  · rw [hPv, hP2, (hMc _ y).2.2]
    simp [msc5, mthC, hC']
  · rw [hPv, hP3, (hMc _ y).2.2]
    simp [msc5, hC']

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c U → 0 < rad y → ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0) ∈ U → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => mvec5 h n c Y0 z s) y

signature.name: mode5_smooth
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c U → 0 < rad y → ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0) ∈ U → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => mvec5 h n c Y0 z s) y

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h n c Y0 U y s hU hc hy hmem
  
  
  have hpc : ∀ (Φ : ℝ × ℂ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ →
      (∀ (θ : ℝ) (e : ℂ), Φ (θ + 2 * Real.pi, e) = Φ (θ, e)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × ℂ => Φ (thetaOf p.1, p.2))
        ({y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y} ×ˢ (univ : Set ℂ)) := by
    intro Φ hΦ' hper
    have hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ (univ ×ˢ (univ : Set ℂ)) := hΦ'.contDiffOn
    set Z : ℝ³ → ℂ := fun y => (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ) with hZdef
    have hp0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => y 0) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
    have hp1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ³ => y 1) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
    have hZeq : Z = fun y => Complex.ofRealCLM (y 0) + Complex.ofRealCLM (y 1) * Complex.I := by
      funext y; apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hZdef]
    have hZ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Z := by
      rw [hZeq]
      exact (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp hp0).add
        ((Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp hp1).mul contDiff_const)
    have harg : ∀ z : ℂ, z ∈ Complex.slitPlane → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Complex.arg z := by
      intro z hz
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Complex.log z := (Complex.contDiffAt_log hz).restrict_scalars ℝ
      have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w => (Complex.log w).im) z :=
        Complex.imCLM.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp z h1
      have e : (fun w => (Complex.log w).im) = Complex.arg := by
        funext w; exact Complex.log_im w
      rwa [e] at h2
    have hbr : ∀ z : ℂ, z ≠ 0 → ∀ e : ℂ,
        Φ (Complex.arg z, e) = Φ (Complex.arg (-z) + Real.pi, e) := by
      intro z hz e
      rcases lt_trichotomy z.im 0 with h | h | h
      · rw [Complex.arg_neg_eq_arg_add_pi_of_im_neg h,
          show z.arg + Real.pi + Real.pi = z.arg + 2 * Real.pi by ring, hper]
      · have hre : z.re ≠ 0 := by
          intro hr; apply hz; exact Complex.ext (by simp [hr]) (by simp [h])
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hre with hr | hr
        · have h1 : z.arg = Real.pi := Complex.arg_eq_pi_iff.mpr ⟨hr, h⟩
          have h2 : (-z).arg = 0 :=
            Complex.arg_eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨by simp only [Complex.neg_re]; linarith, by simp [h]⟩
          rw [h1, h2, zero_add]
        · have h1 : z.arg = 0 := Complex.arg_eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨hr.le, h⟩
          have h2 : (-z).arg = Real.pi :=
            Complex.arg_eq_pi_iff.mpr ⟨by simp only [Complex.neg_re]; linarith, by simp [h]⟩
          rw [h1, h2, show Real.pi + Real.pi = 0 + 2 * Real.pi by ring, hper]
      · rw [Complex.arg_neg_eq_arg_sub_pi_of_im_pos h, sub_add_cancel]
    have hZne : ∀ y : ℝ³, 0 < rad y → Z y ≠ 0 := by
      intro y hy h
      have h0 : y 0 = 0 := by
        have := congrArg Complex.re h; simpa [hZdef] using this
      have h1 : y 1 = 0 := by
        have := congrArg Complex.im h; simpa [hZdef] using this
      simp [rad, h0, h1] at hy
    set N₁ : Set ℝ³ := Z ⁻¹' Complex.slitPlane with hN₁def
    set N₂ : Set ℝ³ := (fun y => -Z y) ⁻¹' Complex.slitPlane with hN₂def
    have hN₁ : IsOpen N₁ := Complex.isOpen_slitPlane.preimage hZ.continuous
    have hN₂ : IsOpen N₂ := Complex.isOpen_slitPlane.preimage hZ.continuous.neg
    have hcov : ∀ y : ℝ³, 0 < rad y → y ∈ N₁ ∨ y ∈ N₂ := by
      intro y hy
      by_cases h : Z y ∈ Complex.slitPlane
      · exact Or.inl h
      · right
        rw [Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff] at h
        push_neg at h
        have hre : (Z y).re ≠ 0 := fun hr =>
          hZne y hy (Complex.ext (by simp [hr]) (by simp [h.2]))
        show -Z y ∈ Complex.slitPlane
        rw [Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff]
        left
        simp only [Complex.neg_re]
        exact neg_pos.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne h.1 hre)
    have hα₁ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Complex.arg (Z y)) N₁ := fun y hy =>
      ((harg _ hy).comp y hZ.contDiffAt).contDiffWithinAt
    have hα₂ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Complex.arg (-Z y) + Real.pi) N₂ := fun y hy =>
      (((harg _ hy).comp y hZ.neg.contDiffAt).add contDiffAt_const).contDiffWithinAt
    have hcomp : ∀ (α : ℝ³ → ℝ) (N : Set ℝ³), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ α N →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × ℂ => Φ (α p.1, p.2)) (N ×ˢ (univ : Set ℂ)) := by
      intro α N hα
      have hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × ℂ => (α p.1, p.2)) (N ×ˢ (univ : Set ℂ)) :=
        (hα.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun p hp => hp.1)).prodMk contDiff_snd.contDiffOn
      exact hΦ.comp hψ (fun p hp => ⟨mem_univ _, hp.2⟩)
    apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    rintro ⟨y', e⟩ ⟨hy', he⟩
    rcases hcov y' hy' with h | h
    · refine ⟨N₁ ×ˢ univ, hN₁.prod isOpen_univ, ⟨h, mem_univ _⟩, ?_⟩
      exact ((hcomp _ N₁ hα₁).mono (fun q hq => ⟨hq.2.1, hq.1.2⟩)).congr (fun q _ => rfl)
    · refine ⟨N₂ ×ˢ univ, hN₂.prod isOpen_univ, ⟨h, mem_univ _⟩, ?_⟩
      refine ((hcomp _ N₂ hα₂).mono (fun q hq => ⟨hq.2.1, hq.1.2⟩)).congr (fun q hq => ?_)
      exact hbr (Z q.1) (hZne q.1 hq.1.1) q.2
  
  have hp : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x i) := fun i =>
    (EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
  have hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ => z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2) := ((hp 0).pow 2).add ((hp 1).pow 2)
  have hfy : (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mp hy).ne'
  have hrad : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ rad y := hf.contDiffAt.sqrt hfy
  have hradc : Continuous rad := Real.continuous_sqrt.comp hf.continuous
  
  have hinv : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => (rad z)⁻¹) y := hrad.inv hy.ne'
  have hradV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ radVec := by
    unfold radVec
    exact ((hp 0).smul contDiff_const).add ((hp 1).smul contDiff_const)
  have hazV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ azVec := by
    unfold azVec
    exact ((hp 1).neg.smul contDiff_const).add ((hp 0).smul contDiff_const)
  have heR : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ eR y := hinv.smul hradV.contDiffAt
  have heTh : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ eTh y := hinv.smul hazV.contDiffAt
  
  have hY : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => Yph h (rad z) s + Y0) y := by
    unfold Yph
    exact (((hrad.rpow_const_of_ne hy.ne').smul contDiffAt_const).add contDiffAt_const).add
      contDiffAt_const
  have hζ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => ptOf z s (Yph h (rad z) s + Y0)) y := by
    unfold ptOf
    exact hrad.prodMk ((hp 2).contDiffAt.prodMk (contDiffAt_const.prodMk hY))
  have hcAt : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ c (ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0)) :=
    hc.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hmem)
  have hcomp : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => c (ptOf z s (Yph h (rad z) s + Y0)) i) y := by
    intro i
    have h2 := (contDiffAt_pi.1 hcAt i).comp y hζ
    exact h2
  
  have hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => (p.2 * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (p.1 : ℂ))).re) :=
    Complex.reCLM.contDiff.comp (contDiff_snd.mul
      ((contDiff_const.mul (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp contDiff_fst)).cexp))
  have hper : ∀ (θ : ℝ) (e : ℂ),
      (e * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((θ + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ))).re =
        (e * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re := by
    intro θ e
    have hexp : Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((θ + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ) + (n : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [hexp, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I, mul_one]
  have hT := hpc (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => (p.2 * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (p.1 : ℂ))).re)
    hΦ hper
  have hopen : IsOpen ({z : ℝ³ | 0 < rad z} ×ˢ (univ : Set ℂ)) :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const hradc).prod isOpen_univ
  have hg : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => (c (ptOf z s (Yph h (rad z) s + Y0)) i *
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf z : ℂ))).re) y := by
    intro i
    have h1 := hT.contDiffAt (hopen.mem_nhds
      (show (y, c (ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0)) i) ∈ {z : ℝ³ | 0 < rad z} ×ˢ (univ : Set ℂ)
        from ⟨hy, mem_univ _⟩))
    have h2 := h1.comp y (contDiffAt_id.prodMk (hcomp i))
    exact h2
  
  exact (((hg 0).smul heR).add ((hg 1).smul heTh)).add ((hg 2).smul contDiffAt_const)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (n : ℤ) (a : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ η ∈ U, 0 < η.1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U → 0 < rad y → ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0) ∈ U → Δ (fun z => mvec5 h n a Y0 z s) y = mvec5 h n (fun η => ![mlapC h n (fun η' => a η' 0) η - a η 0 / (η.1 : ℂ) ^ 2 - 2 * (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (η.1 : ℂ)) * a η 1 / (η.1 : ℂ), mlapC h n (fun η' => a η' 1) η - a η 1 / (η.1 : ℂ) ^ 2 + 2 * (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (η.1 : ℂ)) * a η 0 / (η.1 : ℂ), mlapC h n (fun η' => a η' 2) η]) Y0 y s

signature.name: mode5_lap1
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (n : ℤ) (a : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ η ∈ U, 0 < η.1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U → 0 < rad y → ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0) ∈ U → Δ (fun z => mvec5 h n a Y0 z s) y = mvec5 h n (fun η => ![mlapC h n (fun η' => a η' 0) η - a η 0 / (η.1 : ℂ) ^ 2 - 2 * (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (η.1 : ℂ)) * a η 1 / (η.1 : ℂ), mlapC h n (fun η' => a η' 1) η - a η 1 / (η.1 : ℂ) ^ 2 + 2 * (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (η.1 : ℂ)) * a η 0 / (η.1 : ℂ), mlapC h n (fun η' => a η' 2) η]) Y0 y s

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h n a Y0 U y s hU hUpos ha hy hζ
  have hp0 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun _ : Cyl => (0 : ℂ)) U := contDiffOn_const
  
  have hai : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => a η i) U := contDiffOn_pi.1 ha
  have hfd : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℂ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) U := fun f hf =>
    hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (le_of_eq ENat.coe_top_add_one)
  have hvec : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun ξ : Cyl => (((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx h * ξ.1 ^ (drx h - 1)) • vrv) : Cyl)) U := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.1 ^ (drx h - 1)) U :=
      contDiffOn_fst.rpow_const_of_ne (fun ξ hξ => (hUpos ξ hξ).ne')
    exact contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk
      ((contDiffOn_const.mul h1).smul contDiffOn_const)))
  have hR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η i => dR h (fun η' => a η' i) η) U := by
    refine contDiffOn_pi.2 (fun i => ?_)
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => fderiv ℝ (fun η' => a η' i) ξ
      (1, 0, 0, (drx h * ξ.1 ^ (drx h - 1)) • vrv)) U
    exact (hfd _ (hai i)).clm_apply hvec
  have hZ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η i => dZ (fun η' => a η' i) η) U := by
    refine contDiffOn_pi.2 (fun i => ?_)
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => fderiv ℝ (fun η' => a η' i) ξ (0, 1, 0, 0)) U
    exact (hfd _ (hai i)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.1 : ℂ))⁻¹) U :=
    (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp contDiff_fst).contDiffOn.inv
      (fun ξ hξ => by simpa using (hUpos ξ hξ).ne')
  have hT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mthC n a) U := by
    have hk : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (ξ.1 : ℂ)) U := by
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
      exact contDiffOn_const.mul hinv
    have hk2 : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => a ξ i / (ξ.1 : ℂ)) U := by
      intro i
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
      exact (hai i).mul hinv
    refine contDiffOn_pi.2 (fun i => ?_)
    fin_cases i
    · show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (ξ.1 : ℂ) * a ξ 0 - a ξ 1 / (ξ.1 : ℂ)) U
      exact (hk.mul (hai 0)).sub (hk2 1)
    · show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (ξ.1 : ℂ) * a ξ 1 + a ξ 0 / (ξ.1 : ℂ)) U
      exact (hk.mul (hai 1)).add (hk2 0)
    · show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (ξ.1 : ℂ) * a ξ 2) U
      exact hk.mul (hai 2)
  
  have hrc : Continuous rad := by
    unfold rad
    fun_prop
  have hN : {z : ℝ³ | 0 < rad z ∧ ptOf z s (Yph h (rad z) s + Y0) ∈ U} ∈ nhds y := by
    have h1 : {z : ℝ³ | 0 < rad z} ∈ nhds y := (isOpen_lt continuous_const hrc).mem_nhds hy
    have hφ : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℝ³ => ptOf z s (Yph h (rad z) s + Y0)) y := by
      unfold ptOf Yph
      have hr : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℝ³ => rad z ^ drx h) y :=
        hrc.continuousAt.rpow_const (Or.inl hy.ne')
      have h2 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ³ => z 2) := by fun_prop
      exact hrc.continuousAt.prodMk (h2.continuousAt.prodMk (continuousAt_const.prodMk
        (((hr.smul continuousAt_const).add continuousAt_const).add continuousAt_const)))
    have h2 : (fun z : ℝ³ => ptOf z s (Yph h (rad z) s + Y0)) ⁻¹' U ∈ nhds y :=
      hφ.preimage_mem_nhds (hU.mem_nhds hζ)
    exact Filter.inter_mem h1 h2
  
  have hF2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun z => mvec5 h n a Y0 z s) y :=
    (mode5_smooth h n a Y0 U y s hU ha hy hζ).of_le (by norm_num)
  rw [frame_lap_identity _ y hy hF2]
  have evR : (fun z => fderiv ℝ (fun z => mvec5 h n a Y0 z s) z (eR z)) =ᶠ[nhds y]
      (fun z => mvec5 h n (fun η i => dR h (fun η' => a η' i) η) Y0 z s) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hN (fun z hz =>
      (mode5_jet h n a (fun _ : Cyl => (0 : ℂ)) Y0 U z s hU hUpos ha hp0 hz.1 hz.2).2.2.1)
  have evT : (fun z => fderiv ℝ (fun z => mvec5 h n a Y0 z s) z (eTh z)) =ᶠ[nhds y]
      (fun z => mvec5 h n (mthC n a) Y0 z s) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hN (fun z hz =>
      (mode5_jet h n a (fun _ : Cyl => (0 : ℂ)) Y0 U z s hU hUpos ha hp0 hz.1 hz.2).2.2.2.1)
  have evZ : (fun z => fderiv ℝ (fun z => mvec5 h n a Y0 z s) z eZ) =ᶠ[nhds y]
      (fun z => mvec5 h n (fun η i => dZ (fun η' => a η' i) η) Y0 z s) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hN (fun z hz =>
      (mode5_jet h n a (fun _ : Cyl => (0 : ℂ)) Y0 U z s hU hUpos ha hp0 hz.1 hz.2).2.2.2.2.1)
  rw [evR.fderiv_eq, evT.fderiv_eq, evZ.fderiv_eq,
    (mode5_jet h n _ (fun _ : Cyl => (0 : ℂ)) Y0 U y s hU hUpos hR hp0 hy hζ).2.2.1,
    (mode5_jet h n _ (fun _ : Cyl => (0 : ℂ)) Y0 U y s hU hUpos hT hp0 hy hζ).2.2.2.1,
    (mode5_jet h n _ (fun _ : Cyl => (0 : ℂ)) Y0 U y s hU hUpos hZ hp0 hy hζ).2.2.2.2.1,
    (mode5_jet h n a (fun _ : Cyl => (0 : ℂ)) Y0 U y s hU hUpos ha hp0 hy hζ).2.2.1]
  
  have hcomp : ∀ η : Cyl,
      (mlapC h n (fun η' => a η' 0) η - a η 0 / (η.1 : ℂ) ^ 2
          - 2 * (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (η.1 : ℂ)) * a η 1 / (η.1 : ℂ) =
        dR h (dR h (fun η' => a η' 0)) η
          + (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (η.1 : ℂ) * (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (η.1 : ℂ) * a η 0 - a η 1 / (η.1 : ℂ))
            - (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (η.1 : ℂ) * a η 1 + a η 0 / (η.1 : ℂ)) / (η.1 : ℂ))
          + ((η.1 : ℂ))⁻¹ * dR h (fun η' => a η' 0) η + dZ (dZ (fun η' => a η' 0)) η) ∧
      (mlapC h n (fun η' => a η' 1) η - a η 1 / (η.1 : ℂ) ^ 2
          + 2 * (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (η.1 : ℂ)) * a η 0 / (η.1 : ℂ) =
        dR h (dR h (fun η' => a η' 1)) η
          + (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (η.1 : ℂ) * (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (η.1 : ℂ) * a η 1 + a η 0 / (η.1 : ℂ))

        have e1 : (fun y : ℝ³ => (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)) =
            fun y => Complex.ofRealCLM (y 0) + Complex.ofRealCLM (y 1) * Complex.I := by
          funext y
          rw [Complex.mk_eq_add_mul_I]
          simp
        rw [e1]
        exact (Complex.ofRealCLM.differentiableAt.comp x (hcoord 0 x)).add
          ((Complex.ofRealCLM.differentiableAt.comp x (hcoord 1 x)).mul_const Complex.I)
      have hgD : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x := by
        rw [hg]
        exact hinv.smul hz
      have hgx : g x ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hg]
        refine smul_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero hr.ne') ?_
        intro h0
        have h1 := hnormAll x
        rw [h0, norm_zero] at h1
        linarith
      have hpow : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun u : ℂ => u ^ n) (g x) :=
        differentiableAt_zpow.mpr (Or.inl hgx)
      have hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y ^ n) x := (hpow.restrictScalars ℝ).comp x hgD
      refine hG.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [hradD.continuousAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hr)] with y hy
      have hy' : 0 < rad y := hy
      have hne : ((rad y : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hy'.ne'
      have key := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)
      rw [hnormAll y] at key
      have hexp : Complex.exp (((thetaOf y : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = g y := by
        rw [hg]
        show _ = ((rad y)⁻¹ : ℝ) • (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)
        rw [Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_inv, eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq₀ hne]
        exact key
      calc Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))
          = Complex.exp ((n : ℂ) * ((thetaOf y : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
            congr 1
            ring
        _ = Complex.exp ((thetaOf y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n := Complex.exp_int_mul _ _
        _ = g y ^ n := by rw [hexp]
    have hcP : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0))) x :=
      hc.comp x hP
    have hv : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ =>
        (c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re) x := by
      intro i
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i) x :=
        differentiableAt_pi.1 hcP i
      have h2 := h1.mul hE
      exact Complex.reCLM.differentiableAt.comp x h2
    have heR : DifferentiableAt ℝ eR x := by
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ radVec x :=
        ((hcoord 0 x).smul_const _).add ((hcoord 1 x).smul_const _)
      exact hinv.smul h1
    have heTh : DifferentiableAt ℝ eTh x := by
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ azVec x :=
        ((hcoord 1 x).neg.smul_const _).add ((hcoord 0 x).smul_const _)
      exact hinv.smul h1
    have hcyl : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => cyl2cart y (fun i =>
        (c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re)) x :=
      (((hv 0).smul heR).add ((hv 1).smul heTh)).add ((hv 2).smul_const eZ)
    exact hq.smul hcyl
  
  obtain ⟨ξ0, hξ0⟩ : ∃ ξ0 : Cyl, ξ0 = ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℂ, E = Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hξ0] at hc ⊢
  rw [← hE]
  
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ : ∃ γ : ℝ → ℝ³, γ = fun s => x + s • eR x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hγk : ∀ (s : ℝ) (k : Fin 3), γ s k = x k + s * eR x k := by
    intro s k; rw [hγ]; simp
  have heR0 : eR x 0 = (rad x)⁻¹ * x 0 := by simp [eR, radVec]
  have heR1 : eR x 1 = (rad x)⁻¹ * x 1 := by simp [eR, radVec]
  have heR2 : eR x 2 = 0 := by simp [eR, radVec]
  obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ : ∃ lam : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ s, lam s = 1 + s * (rad x)⁻¹ := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hlam' : ∀ s, lam s = (rad x + s) * (rad x)⁻¹ := by
    intro s; rw [hlam, add_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr.ne']
  have hlpos : ∀ s, -rad x < s → 0 < lam s := by
    intro s hs; rw [hlam']; exact mul_pos (by linarith) (inv_pos.mpr hr)
  have hlr : ∀ s, lam s * rad x = rad x + s := by
    intro s; rw [hlam', mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', mul_one]
  have hγ0 : ∀ s, γ s 0 = lam s * x 0 := by intro s; rw [hγk, heR0, hlam]; ring
  have hγ1 : ∀ s, γ s 1 = lam s * x 1 := by intro s; rw [hγk, heR1, hlam]; ring
  have hγ2 : ∀ s, γ s 2 = x 2 := by intro s; rw [hγk, heR2]; ring
  have hx01 : x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 = rad x ^ 2 :=
    (Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2)).symm
  
  have hrad_s : ∀ s, -rad x < s → rad (γ s) = rad x + s := by
    intro s hs
    have e : γ s 0 ^ 2 + γ s 1 ^ 2 = (rad x + s) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hγ0, hγ1, ← hlr s]
      linear_combination (lam s) ^ 2 * hx01
    show Real.sqrt (γ s 0 ^ 2 + γ s 1 ^ 2) = rad x + s
    rw [e, Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)]
  have hth_s : ∀ s, -rad x < s → thetaOf (γ s) = thetaOf x := by
    intro s hs
    have e : (⟨γ s 0, γ s 1⟩ : ℂ) = ((lam s : ℝ) : ℂ) * ⟨x 0, x 1⟩ := by
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hγ0, hγ1]
    show Complex.arg (⟨γ s 0, γ s 1⟩ : ℂ) = Complex.arg (⟨x 0, x 1⟩ : ℂ)
    rw [e, Complex.arg_real_mul _ (hlpos s hs)]
  have hcyl_s : ∀ s, -rad x < s → ∀ w : Fin 3 → ℝ, cyl2cart (γ s) w = cyl2cart x w := by
    intro s hs w
    have hk : (rad x + s)⁻¹ * lam s = (rad x)⁻¹ := by
      rw [hlam' s, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ (show (0:ℝ) < rad x + s by linarith).ne']
    have hrv : radVec (γ s) = lam s • radVec x := by
      simp only [radVec, hγ0, hγ1, smul_add, smul_smul]
    have hav : azVec (γ s) = lam s • azVec x := by
      simp only [azVec, hγ0, hγ1, smul_add, smul_smul, mul_neg]
    have heRs : eR (γ s) = eR x := by
      show (rad (γ s))⁻¹ • radVec (γ s) = (rad x)⁻¹ • radVec x
      rw [hrad_s s hs, hrv, smul_smul, hk]
    have heThs : eTh (γ s) = eTh x := by
      show (rad (γ s))⁻¹ • azVec (γ s) = (rad x)⁻¹ • azVec x
      rw [hrad_s s hs, hav, smul_smul, hk]
    simp only [cyl2cart, heRs, heThs]
  
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ → Cyl, g = fun s => (rad x + s, x 2, t, Yph h (rad x + s) t + Y0) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hpt : ∀ s, -rad x < s → ptOf (γ s) t (Yph h (rad (γ s)) t + Y0) = g s := by
    intro s hs
    rw [hg]
    simp only [ptOf, hrad_s s hs, hγ2]
  have hg0 : ξ0 = g 0 := by
    rw [hξ0, hg]
    simp only [ptOf, add_zero]
  
  have hEq : ∀ s, -rad x < s → modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c (γ s) =
      cyl2cart x (fun i => (c (g s) i * E).re) := by
    intro s hs
    unfold modeF5
    rw [hpt s hs, hth_s s hs, ← hE, hcyl_s s hs, Real.rpow_zero, one_smul]
  
  have hρ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => rad x + s) 1 0 := (hasDerivAt_id' (0:ℝ)).const_add (rad x)
  have hρp := hρ.rpow_const (p := drx h) (Or.inl (by rw [add_zero]; exact hr.ne'))
  have hY := ((hρp.smul_const vrv).add_const (t • vtv)).add_const Y0
  have hgd := hρ.prodMk ((hasDerivAt_const (0:ℝ) (x 2)).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_const (0:ℝ) t).prodMk hY))
  have hgw : HasDerivAt g ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx h * ξ0.1 ^ (drx h - 1)) • vrv) 0 := by
    rw [hg]
    refine hgd.congr_deriv ?_
    rw [hξ0]
    simp [ptOf]
  have hcg := hc.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) hgw hg0
  have ha : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasDerivAt (fun s => (c (g s) i * E).re) ((dR h c ξ0 i * E).re) 0 := by
    intro i
    have h1 := Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ) ((hasDerivAt_pi.1 hcg i).mul_const E)
    rw [Complex.reCLM_apply] at h1
    refine h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s => ?_)
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Complex.reCLM_apply]
  have hR : HasDerivAt (fun s => cyl2cart x (fun i => (c (g s) i * E).re))
      (cyl2cart x (fun i => (dR h c ξ0 i * E).re)) 0 :=
    (((ha 0).smul_const (eR x)).add ((ha 1).smul_const (eTh x))).add ((ha 2).smul_const eZ)
  
  have hγl : HasDerivAt γ (eR x) 0 := by
    rw [hγ]
    exact (((hasDerivAt_id' (0:ℝ)).smul_const (eR x)).const_add x).congr_deriv (one_smul ℝ _)
  have hγ0x : x = γ 0 := by rw [hγ]; simp
  have hline := hMd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) hγl hγ0x
  have hR' : HasDerivAt ((modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c) ∘ γ) (cyl2cart x (fun i => (dR h c ξ0 i * E).re)) 0 := by
    refine hR.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds (show -rad x < (0:ℝ) by linarith)] with s hs
    exact hEq s hs
  exact hline.unique hR'

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (x : ℝ³), SimScaleProps h → t < 1 → 0 < rad x → DifferentiableAt ℝ c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) → fderiv ℝ (modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c) x eZ = cyl2cart x (fun i => (dZ c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re)

signature.name: pq5_jet_Z
signature.statement: ∀ (h t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (x : ℝ³), SimScaleProps h → t < 1 → 0 < rad x → DifferentiableAt ℝ c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) → fderiv ℝ (modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c) x eZ = cyl2cart x (fun i => (dZ c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h t Y0 n c x hS ht hr hc
  have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c) x := by
    have hcoord : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (y : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ => w i) y := by
      intro i y
      have h0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (ι := Fin 3) i) y :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt _
      rwa [EuclideanSpace.coe_proj] at h0
    have hradpos : 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.mp hr
    have hradD : DifferentiableAt ℝ rad x := by
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) x :=
        ((hcoord 0 x).pow 2).add ((hcoord 1 x).pow 2)
      exact h1.sqrt hradpos.ne'
    have hinv : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => (rad y)⁻¹) x := hradD.inv hr.ne'
    have hq : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => qC h (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) ^ (0:ℝ)) x := by
      simp only [Real.rpow_zero]
      exact differentiableAt_const _
    have hP : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) x := by
      have h4 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => Yph h (rad y) t + Y0) x := by
        have h5 := ((hradD.rpow_const (p := drx h) (Or.inl hr.ne')).smul_const vrv).add_const (t • vtv)
        exact h5.add_const Y0
      exact hradD.prodMk ((hcoord 2 x).prodMk ((differentiableAt_const t).prodMk h4))
    have hnormAll : ∀ y : ℝ³, ‖(⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)‖ = rad y := by
      intro y
      rw [Complex.norm_eq_sqrt_sq_add_sq]
      rfl
    have hE : DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun y : ℝ³ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))) x := by
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ³ → ℂ, g = fun y => ((rad y)⁻¹ : ℝ) • (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hz : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)) x := by
        have e1 : (fun y : ℝ³ => (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)) =
            fun y => Complex.ofRealCLM (y 0) + Complex.ofRealCLM (y 1) * Complex.I := by
          funext y
          rw [Complex.mk_eq_add_mul_I]
          simp
        rw [e1]
        exact (Complex.ofRealCLM.differentiableAt.comp x (hcoord 0 x)).add
          ((Complex.ofRealCLM.differentiableAt.comp x (hcoord 1 x)).mul_const Complex.I)
      have hgD : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x := by
        rw [hg]
        exact hinv.smul hz
      have hgx : g x ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hg]
        refine smul_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero hr.ne') ?_
        intro h0
        have h1 := hnormAll x
        rw [h0, norm_zero] at h1
        linarith
      have hpow : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun u : ℂ => u ^ n) (g x) :=
        differentiableAt_zpow.mpr (Or.inl hgx)
      have hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y ^ n) x := (hpow.restrictScalars ℝ).comp x hgD
      refine hG.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [hradD.continuousAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hr)] with y hy
      have hy' : 0 < rad y := hy
      have hne : ((rad y : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hy'.ne'
      have key := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)
      rw [hnormAll y] at key
      have hexp : Complex.exp (((thetaOf y : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = g y := by
        rw [hg]
        show _ = ((rad y)⁻¹ : ℝ) • (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)
        rw [Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_inv, eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq₀ hne]
        exact key
      calc Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))
          = Complex.exp ((n : ℂ) * ((thetaOf y : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
            congr 1
            ring
        _ = Complex.exp ((thetaOf y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n := Complex.exp_int_mul _ _
        _ = g y ^ n := by rw [hexp]
    have hcP : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0))) x :=
      hc.comp x hP
    have hv : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ =>
        (c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re) x := by
      intro i
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i) x :=
        differentiableAt_pi.1 hcP i
      have h2 := h1.mul hE
      exact Complex.reCLM.differentiableAt.comp x h2
    have heR : DifferentiableAt ℝ eR x := by
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ radVec x :=
        ((hcoord 0 x).smul_const _).add ((hcoord 1 x).smul_const _)
      exact hinv.smul h1
    have heTh : DifferentiableAt ℝ eTh x := by
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ azVec x :=
        ((hcoord 1 x).neg.smul_const _).add ((hcoord 0 x).smul_const _)
      exact hinv.smul h1
    have hcyl : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => cyl2cart y (fun i =>
        (c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re)) x :=
      (((hv 0).smul heR).add ((hv 1).smul heTh)).add ((hv 2).smul_const eZ)
    exact hq.smul hcyl
  have hγk : ∀ (s : ℝ) (k : Fin 3), (x + s • eZ) k = x k + s * eZ k := by
    intro s k; simp
  have hz0 : eZ 0 = 0 := by simp [eZ]
  have hz1 : eZ 1 = 0 := by simp [eZ]
  have hz2 : eZ 2 = 1 := by simp [eZ]
  have hγ0 : ∀ s : ℝ, (x + s • eZ) 0 = x 0 := by intro s; rw [hγk, hz0]; ring
  have hγ1 : ∀ s : ℝ, (x + s • eZ) 1 = x 1 := by intro s; rw [hγk, hz1]; ring
  have hγ2 : ∀ s : ℝ, (x + s • eZ) 2 = x 2 + s := by intro s; rw [hγk, hz2]; ring
  have hrad : ∀ s : ℝ, rad (x + s • eZ) = rad x := by
    intro s; simp only [rad, hγ0, hγ1]
  have hth : ∀ s : ℝ, thetaOf (x + s • eZ) = thetaOf x := by
    intro s; simp only [thetaOf, hγ0, hγ1]
  have heR : ∀ s : ℝ, eR (x + s • eZ) = eR x := by
    intro s; simp only [eR, radVec, hrad, hγ0, hγ1]
  have heTh : ∀ s : ℝ, eTh (x + s • eZ) = eTh x := by
    intro s; simp only [eTh, azVec, hrad, hγ0, hγ1]
  have hpt : ∀ s : ℝ, ptOf (x + s • eZ) t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0) =
      ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0) + s • ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) := by
    intro s
    simp only [ptOf, hrad, hγ2]
    simp
  have hFγ : ∀ s : ℝ, modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c (x + s • eZ) =
      (c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0) + s • ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))) 0 *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re • eR x +
      (c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0) + s • ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))) 1 *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re • eTh x +
      (c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0) + s • ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))) 2 *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re • eZ := by
    intro s
    simp only [modeF5]
    rw [hrad, hpt, hth, Real.rpow_zero, one_smul]
    simp only [cyl2cart, heR, heTh]
  have hl : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0) +
      s • ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) 0 :=
    (((hasDerivAt_id' (0:ℝ)).smul_const _).const_add _).congr_deriv (one_smul ℝ _)
  have hcl := hc.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) hl (by simp)
  have hgi : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ =>
      (c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0) + s • ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))) i *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re)
      ((dZ c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) i *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re) 0 := by
    intro i
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ =>
        c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0) + s • ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))) i)
        (dZ c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) i) 0 := hasDerivAt_pi.1 hcl i
    have h2 := Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ)
      (h1.mul_const (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))))
    simp only [Complex.reCLM_apply, Function.comp_def] at h2
    exact h2
  have hγl : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => x + s • eZ) eZ 0 :=
    (((hasDerivAt_id' (0:ℝ)).smul_const eZ).const_add x).congr_deriv (one_smul ℝ eZ)
  have hF1 := hFd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) hγl (by simp)
  have hF2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c (x + s • eZ))
      (cyl2cart x (fun i => (dZ c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) i *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re)) 0 := by
    rw [funext hFγ]
    exact (((hgi 0).smul_const (eR x)).add ((hgi 1).smul_const (eTh x))).add ((hgi 2).smul_const eZ)
  exact hF1.unique hF2

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (x : ℝ³), SimScaleProps h → t < 1 → 0 < rad x → DifferentiableAt ℝ c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) → fderiv ℝ (modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c) x (eTh x) = cyl2cart x (fun i => (![Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ) * c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) 0 - c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) 1 / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ), Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ) * c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) 1 + c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) 0 / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ), Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ) * c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) 2] i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re)

signature.name: pq5_jet_Th
signature.statement: ∀ (h t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (x : ℝ³), SimScaleProps h → t < 1 → 0 < rad x → DifferentiableAt ℝ c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) → fderiv ℝ (modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c) x (eTh x) = cyl2cart x (fun i => (![Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ) * c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) 0 - c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) 1 / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ), Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ) * c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) 1 + c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) 0 / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ), Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ) * c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) 2] i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h t Y0 n c x hS ht hr hc
  
  have hMd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c) x := by
    have hcoord : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (y : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ => w i) y := by
      intro i y
      have h0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (ι := Fin 3) i) y :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt _
      rwa [EuclideanSpace.coe_proj] at h0
    have hradpos : 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.mp hr
    have hradD : DifferentiableAt ℝ rad x := by
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) x :=
        ((hcoord 0 x).pow 2).add ((hcoord 1 x).pow 2)
      exact h1.sqrt hradpos.ne'
    have hinv : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => (rad y)⁻¹) x := hradD.inv hr.ne'
    have hq : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => qC h (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) ^ (0:ℝ)) x := by
      have hSo' : (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) ∈ nhds (x 2, 1 - t) :=
        (isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - t by linarith⟩
      have hSd' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (x 2, 1 - t) :=
        (hS.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt hSo').differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hgd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => (y 2, 1 - t)) x :=
        (hcoord 2 x).prodMk (differentiableAt_const _)
      have hcomp : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => simScale h (y 2) (1 - t)) x :=
        DifferentiableAt.comp (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2)
          (f := fun y : ℝ³ => (y 2, 1 - t)) x hSd' hgd
      have hpos : simScale h (x 2) (1 - t) ≠ 0 := (hS.1 (x 2) (1 - t) (by linarith)).1.ne'
      exact hcomp.rpow_const (Or.inl hpos)
    have hP : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) x := by
      have h4 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => Yph h (rad y) t + Y0) x := by
        have h5 := ((hradD.rpow_const (p := drx h) (Or.inl hr.ne')).smul_const vrv).add_const (t • vtv)
        exact h5.add_const Y0
      exact hradD.prodMk ((hcoord 2 x).prodMk ((differentiableAt_const t).prodMk h4))
    have hnormAll : ∀ y : ℝ³, ‖(⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)‖ = rad y := by
      intro y
      rw [Complex.norm_eq_sqrt_sq_add_sq]
      rfl
    have hE : DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun y : ℝ³ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))) x := by
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ³ → ℂ, g = fun y => ((rad y)⁻¹ : ℝ) • (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hz : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)) x := by
        have e1 : (fun y : ℝ³ => (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)) =
            fun y => Complex.ofRealCLM (y 0) + Complex.ofRealCLM (y 1) * Complex.I := by
          funext y
          rw [Complex.mk_eq_add_mul_I]
          simp
        rw [e1]
        exact (Complex.ofRealCLM.differentiableAt.comp x (hcoord 0 x)).add
          ((Complex.ofRealCLM.differentiableAt.comp x (hcoord 1 x)).mul_const Complex.I)
      have hgD : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x := by
        rw [hg]
        exact hinv.smul hz
      have hgx : g x ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hg]
        refine smul_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero hr.ne') ?_
        intro h0
        have h1 := hnormAll x
        rw [h0, norm_zero] at h1
        linarith
      have hpow : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun u : ℂ => u ^ n) (g x) :=
        differentiableAt_zpow.mpr (Or.inl hgx)
      have hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y ^ n) x := (hpow.restrictScalars ℝ).comp x hgD
      refine hG.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [hradD.continuousAt (Ioi_mem_nhds hr)] with y hy
      have hy' : 0 < rad y := hy
      have hne : ((rad y : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hy'.ne'
      have key := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)
      rw [hnormAll y] at key
      have hexp : Complex.exp (((thetaOf y : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = g y := by
        rw [hg]
        show _ = ((rad y)⁻¹ : ℝ) • (⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)
        rw [Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_inv, eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq₀ hne]
        exact key
      calc Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))
          = Complex.exp ((n : ℂ) * ((thetaOf y : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
            congr 1
            ring
        _ = Complex.exp ((thetaOf y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n := Complex.exp_int_mul _ _
        _ = g y ^ n := by rw [hexp]
    have hcP : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0))) x :=
      hc.comp x hP
    have hv : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ =>
        (c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re) x := by
      intro i
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i) x :=
        differentiableAt_pi.1 hcP i
      have h2 := h1.mul hE
      exact Complex.reCLM.differentiableAt.comp x h2
    have heR : DifferentiableAt ℝ eR x := by
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ radVec x :=
        ((hcoord 0 x).smul_const _).add ((hcoord 1 x).smul_const _)
      exact hinv.smul h1
    have heTh : DifferentiableAt ℝ eTh x := by
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ azVec x :=
        ((hcoord 1 x).neg.smul_const _).add ((hcoord 0 x).smul_const _)
      exact hinv.smul h1
    have hcyl : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => cyl2cart y (fun i =>
        (c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re)) x :=
      (((hv 0).smul heR).add ((hv 1).smul heTh)).add ((hv 2).smul_const eZ)
    exact hq.smul hcyl
  have hr0 : rad x ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
  
  obtain ⟨ξ0, hξ0⟩ : ∃ ξ0 : Cyl, ξ0 = ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℂ, E = Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℂ, K = Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hξ0] at hc ⊢
  rw [← hE, ← hK]
  
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ : ∃ γ : ℝ → ℝ³, γ = fun s => x + s • eTh x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hγk : ∀ (s : ℝ) (k : Fin 3), γ s k = x k + s * eTh x k := by
    intro s k; rw [hγ]; simp
  have heT0 : eTh x 0 = (rad x)⁻¹ * -(x 1) := by simp [eTh, azVec]
  have heT1 : eTh x 1 = (rad x)⁻¹ * x 0 := by simp [eTh, azVec]
  have heT2 : eTh x 2 = 0 := by simp [eTh, azVec]
  have hγ0 : ∀ s, γ s 0 = x 0 - s * (rad x)⁻¹ * x 1 := by intro s; rw [hγk, heT0]; ring
  have hγ1 : ∀ s, γ s 1 = x 1 + s * (rad x)⁻¹ * x 0 := by intro s; rw [hγk, heT1]; ring
  have hγ00 : γ 0 = x := by rw [hγ]; simp
  have hx01 : x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 = rad x ^ 2 :=
    (Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2)).symm
  have hsq : ∀ s, γ s 0 ^ 2 + γ s 1 ^ 2 = rad x ^ 2 + s ^ 2 := by
    intro s
    rw [hγ0, hγ1]
    have hi : (rad x)⁻¹ * rad x = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hr0
    linear_combination (1 + s ^ 2 * (rad x)⁻¹ ^ 2) * hx01 + s ^ 2 * ((rad x)⁻¹ * rad x + 1) * hi
  have hρform : ∀ s, rad (γ s) = Real.sqrt (rad x ^ 2 + s ^ 2) := by
    intro s
    show Real.sqrt (γ s 0 ^ 2 + γ s 1 ^ 2) = _
    rw [hsq]
  have hρpos : ∀ s, 0 < rad (γ s) := by
    intro s
    rw [hρform]
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (pow_pos hr 2) (sq_nonneg s))
  have hρ0 : rad (γ 0) = rad x := by rw [hγ00]
  have hγd : ∀ k : Fin 3, HasDerivAt (fun s => γ s k) (eTh x k) 0 := by
    intro k
    have e1 : (fun s => γ s k) = fun s => x k + s * eTh x k := funext fun s => hγk s k
    rw [e1]
    exact (((hasDerivAt_id' (0:ℝ)).mul_const (eTh x k)).const_add _).congr_deriv (one_mul _)
  have hρ : HasDerivAt (fun s => rad (γ s)) 0 0 := by
    have e1 : (fun s => rad (γ s)) = fun s => Real.sqrt (rad x ^ 2 + s * s) := by
      funext s; rw [hρform, pow_two s]
    rw [e1]
    have h1 := (((hasDerivAt_id' (0:ℝ)).mul (hasDerivAt_id' (0:ℝ))).const_add (rad x ^ 2)).sqrt
      (by simp [hr0])
    refine h1.congr_deriv ?_
    simp
  have hρi : HasDerivAt (fun s => (rad (γ s))⁻¹) 0 0 := by
    have h1 := hρ.inv (hρpos 0).ne'
    refine h1.congr_deriv ?_
    simp
  have ha : HasDerivAt (fun s => (rad (γ s))⁻¹ * γ s 0) (-(x 1) / rad x ^ 2) 0 := by
    refine (hρi.mul (hγd 0)).congr_deriv ?_
    rw [hρ0, heT0]; ring
  have hb : HasDerivAt (fun s => (rad (γ s))⁻¹ * γ s 1) (x 0 / rad x ^ 2) 0 := by
    refine (hρi.mul (hγd 1)).congr_deriv ?_
    rw [hρ0, heT1]; ring
  
  have hP0 : ptOf (γ 0) t (Yph h (rad (γ 0)) t + Y0) = ξ0 := by rw [hγ00, hξ0]
  have hP : HasDerivAt (fun s => ptOf (γ s) t (Yph h (rad (γ s)) t + Y0)) 0 0 := by
    have hY := (((hρ.rpow_const (p := drx h) (Or.inl (hρpos 0).ne')).smul_const vrv).add_const
      (t • vtv)).add_const Y0
    have h3 := hρ.prodMk ((hγd 2).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_const (0:ℝ) t).prodMk hY))
    refine h3.congr_deriv ?_
    simp [heT2]
  have hc0 : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasDerivAt (fun s => c (ptOf (γ s) t (Yph h (rad (γ s)) t + Y0)) i) 0 0 := by
    intro i
    have h1 := hc.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) hP hP0.symm
    rw [map_zero] at h1
    exact hasDerivAt_pi.1 h1 i
  
  have hnormAll : ∀ y : ℝ³, ‖(⟨y 0, y 1⟩ : ℂ)‖ = rad y := by
    intro y; rw [Complex.norm_eq_sqrt_sq_add_sq]; rfl
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : ℝ → ℂ, u = fun s => (((rad (γ s))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (((γ s 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((γ s 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hexp : ∀ s, Complex.exp (((thetaOf (γ s) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = u s := by
    intro s
    have hne : ((rad (γ s) : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hρpos s).ne'
    have key := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I (⟨γ s 0, γ s 1⟩ : ℂ)
    rw [hnormAll (γ s)] at key
    rw [hu]
    show _ = (((rad (γ s))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((γ s 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((γ s 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    rw [← Complex.mk_eq_add_mul_I, Complex.ofReal_inv, eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq₀ hne]
    exact key
  have hev : ∀ s, Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf (γ s) : ℂ)) = u s ^ n := by
    intro s
    calc Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf (γ s) : ℂ))
        = Complex.exp ((n : ℂ) * ((thetaOf (γ s) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by congr 1; ring
      _ = Complex.exp ((thetaOf (γ s) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n := Complex.exp_int_mul _ _
      _ = u s ^ n := by rw [hexp]
  have hu0E : u 0 ^ n = E := by rw [← hev 0, hγ00, hE]
  have hu0 : u 0 ≠ 0 := by rw [← hexp 0]; exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _
  have hu0v : u 0 = (((rad x)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((x 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((x 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    rw [hu]; simp only [hγ00]
  have hud : HasDerivAt u (Complex.I / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ) * u 0) 0 := by
    rw [hu0v, hu]
    refine (hρi.ofReal_comp.mul ((hγd 0).ofReal_comp.add
      ((hγd 1).ofReal_comp.mul_const Complex.I))).congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [hγ00, heT0, heT1]
    push_cast
    linear_combination (-(((x 1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) * (((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ))⁻¹ ^ 2) * Complex.I_sq
  have hΦ : HasDerivAt (fun s => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf (γ s) : ℂ)))
      (K * E) 0 := by
    have h1 := (hasDerivAt_zpow n (u 0) (Or.inl hu0)).comp (0:ℝ) hud
    have e2 : (fun s => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf (γ s) : ℂ))) =
        fun s => u s ^ n := funext hev
    rw [e2]
    refine h1.congr_deriv ?_
    rw [hK, ← hu0E, zpow_sub_one₀ hu0]
    linear_combination ((n : ℂ) * Complex.I / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ) * u 0 ^ n) * (inv_mul_cancel₀ hu0)
  
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ³ → Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ y i, G y i = (c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i *
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hGv : ∀ i, G x i = (c ξ0 i * E).re := by
    intro i; rw [hG, hξ0, hE]
  have hGd : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasDerivAt (fun s => G (γ s) i) (c ξ0 i * (K * E)).re 0 := by
    intro i
    have h1 := Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ) ((hc0 i).mul hΦ)
    rw [Complex.reCLM_apply, hP0, zero_mul, zero_add] at h1
    refine h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s => ?_)
    simp only [hG, Function.comp_apply, Complex.reCLM_apply, Pi.mul_apply]
  have hMc : ∀ y : ℝ³, modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c y 0 =
        G y 0 * ((rad y)⁻¹ * y 0) - G y 1 * ((rad y)⁻¹ * y 1) ∧
      modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c y 1 = G y 0 * ((rad y)⁻¹ * y 1) + G y 1 * ((rad y)⁻¹ * y 0) ∧
      modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c y 2 = G y 2 := by
    intro y
    simp only [hG]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [modeF5, cyl2cart, eR, eTh, eZ, radVec, azVec] <;> ring
  have hrhs : ∀ w : Fin 3 → ℝ, cyl2cart x w 0 = w 0 * ((rad x)⁻¹ * x 0) - w 1 * ((rad x)⁻¹ * x 1) ∧
      cyl2cart x w 1 = w 0 * ((rad x)⁻¹ * x 1) + w 1 * ((rad x)⁻¹ * x 0) ∧ cyl2cart x w 2 = w 2 := by
    intro w
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [cyl2cart, eR, eTh, eZ, radVec, azVec] <;> ring
  
  have hγl : HasDerivAt γ (eTh x) 0 := by
    rw [hγ]
    exact (((hasDerivAt_id' (0:ℝ)).smul_const (eTh x)).const_add x).congr_deriv (one_smul ℝ _)
  have hlineF := hMd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) hγl hγ00.symm
  have hline : ∀ k : Fin 3, HasDerivAt (fun s => modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c (γ s) k)
      (fderiv ℝ (modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c) x (eTh x) k) 0 := fun k =>
    (EuclideanSpace.proj k : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ) hlineF
  have e0 : (fun s => modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c (γ s) 0) = fun s =>
      G (γ s) 0 * ((rad (γ s))⁻¹ * γ s 0) - G (γ s) 1 * ((rad (γ s))⁻¹ * γ s 1) :=
    funext fun s => (hMc (γ s)).1
  have e1 : (fun s => modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c (γ s) 1) = fun s =>
      G (γ s) 0 * ((rad (γ s))⁻¹ * γ s 1) + G (γ s) 1 * ((rad (γ s))⁻¹ * γ s 0) :=
    funext fun s => (hMc (γ s)).2.1
  have e2 : (fun s => modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c (γ s) 2) = fun s => G (γ s) 2 :=
    funext fun s => (hMc (γ s)).2.2
  have d0 := ((hGd 0).mul ha).sub ((hGd 1).mul hb)
  have d1 := ((hGd 0).mul hb).add ((hGd 1).mul ha)
  have l0 := hline 0
  rw [e0] at l0
  have l1 := hline 1
  rw [e1] at l1
  have l2 := hline 2
  rw [e2] at l2
  have hv0 := l0.unique d0
  have hv1 := l1.unique d1
  have hv2 := l2.unique (hGd 2)
  
  have hT0 : ((K * c ξ0 0 - c ξ0 1 / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ)) * E).re =
      (c ξ0 0 * (K * E)).re - (c ξ0 1 * E).re / rad x := by
    rw [← Complex.div_ofReal_re, ← Complex.sub_re]; congr 1; ring
  have hT1 : ((K * c ξ0 1 + c ξ0 0 / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ)) * E).re =
      (c ξ0 1 * (K * E)).re + (c ξ0 0 * E).re / rad x := by
    rw [← Complex.div_ofReal_re, ← Complex.add_re]; congr 1; ring
  have hT2 : ((K * c ξ0 2) * E).re = (c ξ0 2 * (K * E)).re := by
    congr 1; ring
  have comp0 : fderiv ℝ (modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c) x (eTh x) 0 =
      ((K * c ξ0 0 - c ξ0 1 / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ)) * E).re * ((rad x)⁻¹ * x 0) -
        ((K * c ξ0 1 + c ξ0 0 / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ)) * E).re * ((rad x)⁻¹ * x 1) := by
    rw [hv0, hT0, hT1]
    simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, hγ00, hGv, hρ0]
    field_simp
    ring
  have comp1 : fderiv ℝ (modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c) x (eTh x) 1 =
      ((K * c ξ0 0 - c ξ0 1 / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ)) * E).re * ((rad x)⁻¹ * x 1) +
        ((K * c ξ0 1 + c ξ0 0 / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ)) * E).re * ((rad x)⁻¹ * x 0) := by
    rw [hv1, hT0, hT1]
    simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, hγ00, hGv, hρ0]
    field_simp
    ring
  have comp2 : fderiv ℝ (modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c) x (eTh x) 2 = ((K * c ξ0 2) * E).re := by
    rw [hv2, hT2]
  have hR := hrhs (fun i => (![K * c ξ0 0 - c ξ0 1 / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ),
    K * c ξ0 1 + c ξ0 0 / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ), K * c ξ0 2] i * E).re)
  refine PiLp.ext fun k => ?_
  fin_cases k
  · exact comp0.trans hR.1.symm
  · exact comp1.trans hR.2.1.symm
  · exact comp2.trans hR.2.2.symm
