signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (V : WC), B.ok → (∀ γ m, m ≠ 1 → m ≠ -1 → V γ m = 0) → (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → V γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → ∃ (O : Set ℝ³) (Γ : Finset Lab), IsOpen O ∧ x ∈ O ∧ (∀ γ m, γ ∉ Γ → V γ m (ptOf x t Y) = 0) ∧ ∀ y ∈ O, corrOn B l0 y t ∧ cyl2cart y (waveV5 B G V (thetaOf y) (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)))) = ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ ({1, -1} : Finset ℤ), modeF5 B.h 0 t (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) (m * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m) y

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 V hok hVm hVsupp x t Y hxt
  obtain ⟨Y', hY'⟩ : ∃ Y' : ℝ × ℝ, Y' = Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hY']
  have hxt' : 0 < rad x ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hxt
  
  have hEta : ∀ (h : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → ∀ ξ0 : Cyl, ξ0.2.2.1 < 1 → ∃ N ∈ nhds ξ0, ∃ Γ : Finset Lab,
      ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ N → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) → γ ∈ Γ := by
    intro h hS ξ0 hξ0
    have hLc : ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ContinuousAt (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) ξ := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hτ : 0 < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 := by linarith
      have hqpos : 0 < qC h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).1
      have hqcont : ContinuousAt (qC h) ξ := by
        have hU : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
        have hp : ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
          ⟨trivial, hτ⟩
        have hg : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) :=
          hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)
        have hk : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) ξ := by fun_prop
        have he : qC h = (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘
            (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
          funext η; rfl
        rw [he]
        exact ContinuousAt.comp hg hk
      exact hqcont.logb hqpos.ne'
    have hwin : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (γ : Lab), ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) →
        |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) + (γ.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartR h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartZ h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartT h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
      intro ξ γ hξ hγ
      have s1 : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ → 1 < |φ ξ / μ - (j : ℝ)| →
          ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 := by
        intro μ j φ hφ h1
        have hψ : ContinuousAt (fun η => |φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)|) ξ :=
          ((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs
        have hev := (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : Cyl => (1:ℝ)) ξ).eventually_lt hψ h1
        filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
        have hsq : 1 < (φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)) ^ 2 := (one_lt_sq_iff_one_lt_abs _).mpr hη
        unfold sqPart bumpR
        rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), zero_div]
      have key : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ →
          (∀ η, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 → etaL h γ η = 0) → |φ ξ / μ - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
        intro μ j φ hφ himp
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have hev := s1 μ j φ hφ hc
        apply (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mpr _) hγ
        filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
        exact himp η hη
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have := key 1 (-(γ.1:ℤ)) (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) (hLc ξ hξ)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul])
        simpa [div_one, sub_neg_eq_add] using this
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.1 (chartR h γ.1) (by unfold chartR; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.1 (chartZ h γ.1) (by unfold chartZ; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.2 (chartT h γ.1) (by unfold chartT; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
    obtain ⟨L0, hL0⟩ : ∃ L0 : ℝ, L0 = Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hfin : (⋃ n ∈ Set.Iic ⌊2 - L0⌋₊, ({n} : Set ℕ) ×ˢ
        ((Set.Icc ⌈chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ⌈chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ⌈chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋) ×ˢ
          (Set.univ : Set Bool))).Finite := by
      refine Set.Finite.biUnion (Set.finite_Iic _) (fun n _ => ?_)
      exact (Set.finite_singleton n).prod (((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod
        ((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod (Set.finite_Icc _ _))).prod Set.finite_univ)
    have hI : ∀ (x c : ℝ) (j : ℤ), |x - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 → |x - c| < 1 → j ∈ Set.Icc ⌈c - 2⌉ ⌊c + 2⌋ := by
      intro x c j hj hc
      rw [abs_le] at hj
      rw [abs_lt] at hc
      exact ⟨Int.ceil_le.mpr (by linarith [hj.2, hc.1]), Int.le_floor.mpr (by linarith [hj.1, hc.2])⟩
    have hcR : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartR h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartR; fun_prop
    have hcZ : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartZ h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartZ; fun_prop
    have hcT : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartT h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartT; fun_prop
    have hch : ∀ (φ : Cyl → ℝ) (μ : ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ0 →
        ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, |φ ξ / μ - φ ξ0 / μ| < 1 := by
      intro φ μ hφ
      exact (((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs).eventually_lt continuousAt_const
        (by simp)
    have e1 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 :=
      (show ContinuousAt (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.2.2.1) ξ0 by fun_prop).eventually_lt
        continuousAt_const hξ0
    have e2 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) - L0| < 1 :=
      (((hLc ξ0 hξ0).sub continuousAt_const).abs).eventually_lt continuousAt_const
        (by simp [hL0])
    have e3 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊2 - L0⌋₊ + 1),
        |chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 := by
      rw [Filter.eventually_all_finset]
      intro n _
      exact (hch _ _ (hcR n)).and ((hch _ _ (hcZ n)).and (hch _ _ (hcT n)))
    refine ⟨{ξ | ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) - L0| < 1 ∧
        ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊2 - L0⌋₊ + 1),
        |chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1}, ?_,
      hfin.toFinset, ?_⟩
    · filter_upwards [e1, e2, e3] with ξ h1 h2 h3
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    rintro ⟨n, ⟨a, b, c⟩, σ⟩ ξ ⟨ht, hL, hC⟩ hγ
    obtain ⟨w0, wR, wZ, wT⟩ := hwin ξ _ ht hγ
    simp only at w0 wR wZ wT
    rw [abs_le] at w0
    rw [abs_lt] at hL
    have hn : n ≤ ⌊2 - L0⌋₊ := Nat.le_floor (by linarith [w0.2, hL.1])
    obtain ⟨cR, cZ, cT⟩ := hC n (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn))
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨n, hn, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨rfl, ⟨hI _ _ _ wR cR, hI _ _ _ wZ cZ, hI _ _ _ wT cT⟩, trivial⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN, Γ, hΓ⟩ := hEta B.h hok.1 (ptOf x t Y) hxt'.2.1
  
  have hoff : ∀ η ∈ N, η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ),
      (γ ∉ Γ ∨ m ∉ ({1, -1} : Finset ℤ)) → V γ m η = 0 := by
    intro η hηN hηD γ m hγm
    by_contra hne
    rcases hγm with hγ | hm
    · exact hγ (hΓ γ η hηN (hVsupp γ m η hηD hne).2.1)
    · simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, not_or] at hm
      exact hne (congrFun (hVm γ m hm.1 hm.2) η)
  
  have hsum : ∀ (F : Lab → ℤ → ℂ), (∀ γ m, (γ ∉ Γ ∨ m ∉ ({1, -1} : Finset ℤ)) → F γ m = 0) →
      ∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, F γ m = ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ ({1, -1} : Finset ℤ), F γ m := by
    intro F hF
    have hin : ∀ γ, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, F γ m = ∑ m ∈ ({1, -1} : Finset ℤ), F γ m := by
      intro γ
      apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
      intro m hm
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hm
      by_contra h
      exact hm (hF γ m (Or.inr (by simpa using h)))
    simp_rw [hin]
    apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
    intro γ hγ
    rw [Function.mem_support] at hγ
    by_contra h
    exact hγ (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun m _ => hF γ m (Or.inl (by simpa using h))))
  have hphase : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (θ : ℝ) (η : Cyl), ephase5 B G γ m θ η =
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) := by
    intro γ m θ η
    simp only [ephase5]
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have hcyl_sum : ∀ (y : ℝ³) {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      cyl2cart y (∑ j ∈ s, v j) = ∑ j ∈ s, cyl2cart y (v j) := by
    intro y ι s v
    let L : (Fin 3 → ℝ) →+ ℝ³ := AddMonoidHom.mk' (cyl2cart y) (fun c d => by
      simp only [cyl2cart, Pi.add_apply, add_smul]; abel)
    exact map_sum L v s
  
  have hexpand : ∀ (y : ℝ³), corrOn B l0 y t →
      (∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), (γ ∉ Γ ∨ m ∉ ({1, -1} : Finset ℤ)) →
        V γ m (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')) = 0) →
      cyl2cart y (waveV5 B G V (thetaOf y) (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y'))) =
        ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ ({1, -1} : Finset ℤ),
          modeF5 B.h 0 t Y' (m * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m) y := by
    intro y hc hz
    have hF : ∀ (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), modeF5 B.h 0 t Y' n c y =
        cyl2cart y (fun i => (c (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')) i *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re) := by
      intro n c
      simp only [modeF5, Real.rpow_zero, one_smul]
    trans cyl2cart y (∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ ({1, -1} : Finset ℤ), fun i =>
      (modeCoef5 B G V γ m (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')) i *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re)
    · congr 1
      funext i
      simp only [waveV5, Finset.sum_apply]
      rw [hsum (fun γ m => V γ m (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')) i *
          ephase5 B G γ m (thetaOf y) (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')))
        (fun γ m h => by simp only [hz γ m h, Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul]), Complex.re_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
      rw [Complex.re_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
      rw [hphase]
      simp only [modeCoef5]
      congr 1
      ring
    · rw [hcyl_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
      rw [hcyl_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
      exact (hF _ _).symm
  
  have hradc : Continuous rad := by
    unfold rad
    fun_prop
  have hOopen : IsOpen {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t ∧
      ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y') ∈ interior N} := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro y0 hy0
    have h1 : 0 < rad y0 := hy0.1.1
    have h2 : t < 1 := hy0.1.2.1
    have h3 : simScale B.h (y0 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hy0.1.2.2
    have h4 : ptOf y0 t (Yph B.h (rad y0) t + Y') ∈ interior N := hy0.2
    have e1 : ∀ᶠ y in nhds y0, (0:ℝ) < rad y :=
      continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hradc.continuousAt h1
    have hmem2 : ((y0 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)) :=
      ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - t by linarith⟩
    have hc1 : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t)) y0 := by
      have h1' : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (y0 2, 1 - t) :=
        (hok.1.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt ((isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds hmem2)).continuousAt
      have h2' : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => ((y 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ)) y0 := by fun_prop
      exact ContinuousAt.comp (x := y0) (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2)
        (f := fun y : ℝ³ => ((y 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ)) h1' h2'
    have e3 : ∀ᶠ y in nhds y0, simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 :=
      hc1.eventually_lt continuousAt_const h3
    have hPc : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')) y0 := by
      have hr1 : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => rad y ^ drx B.h) y0 :=
        hradc.continuousAt.rpow_const (Or.inl h1.ne')
      have h4' : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y') y0 :=
        ((hr1.smul continuousAt_const).add continuousAt_const).add continuousAt_const
      have h2'' : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => y 2) y0 := by fun_prop
      exact hradc.continuousAt.prodMk (h2''.prodMk (continuousAt_const.prodMk h4'))
    have e4 : ∀ᶠ y in nhds y0, ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y') ∈ interior N :=
      hPc.preimage_mem_nhds (isOpen_interior.mem_nhds h4)
    filter_upwards [e1, e3, e4] with y a1 a3 a4
    exact ⟨⟨a1, h2, a3⟩, a4⟩
  have hpx : ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y') = ptOf x t Y := by
    rw [hY']
    congr 1
    abel
  refine ⟨{y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t ∧ ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y') ∈ interior N},
    Γ, hOopen, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨hxt, ?_⟩
    show ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y') ∈ interior N
    rw [hpx]
    exact mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr hN
  · intro γ m hγ
    exact hoff _ (mem_of_mem_nhds hN) hxt γ m (Or.inl hγ)
  · intro y hy
    have hc : corrOn B l0 y t := hy.1
    have hi : ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y') ∈ interior N := hy.2
    exact ⟨hc, hexpand y hc (fun γ m h => hoff _ (interior_subset hi) hc γ m h)⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h n n' U c ξ θ i
  have F1 : Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((n + n' : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) =
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n' : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) := by
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have F2 : Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((n' - n : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n' : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) := by
    rw [← Complex.exp_conj, ← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, Complex.conj_I, map_intCast, Complex.conj_ofReal]
    push_cast
    ring
  have F3 : ∀ a, (((U a * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      (U a * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) +
        starRingEnd ℂ (U a) * starRingEnd ℂ (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)))) / 2 := by
    intro a
    rw [Complex.re_eq_add_conj, map_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [F1, F2]
  simp only [F3]
  generalize Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) = E
  generalize Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n' : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) = E'
  fin_cases i <;> simp [pq5TrM] <;> ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (x : ℝ³), 0 < rad x → c =ᶠ[nhds (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0))] 0 → fderiv ℝ (modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c) x = 0

signature.name: pq5_offdiag
signature.statement: ∀ (h t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (x : ℝ³), 0 < rad x → c =ᶠ[nhds (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0))] 0 → fderiv ℝ (modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c) x = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h t Y0 n c x hr hc
  have hrad : Continuous (fun y : ℝ³ => rad y) := by
    unfold rad
    have h0 : Continuous (fun y : ℝ³ => y 0) := by fun_prop
    have h1 : Continuous (fun y : ℝ³ => y 1) := by fun_prop
    exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp ((h0.pow 2).add (h1.pow 2))
  have hz : Continuous (fun y : ℝ³ => y 2) := by fun_prop
  have hpow : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => rad y ^ drx h) x :=
    hrad.continuousAt.rpow_const (Or.inl hr.ne')
  have hY : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => Yph h (rad y) t + Y0) x := by
    unfold Yph
    exact ((hpow.smul continuousAt_const).add continuousAt_const).add continuousAt_const
  have hζ : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) x := by
    unfold ptOf
    exact hrad.continuousAt.prodMk (hz.continuousAt.prodMk (continuousAt_const.prodMk hY))
  have hpull : ∀ᶠ y in nhds x, c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) = 0 :=
    hζ.tendsto.eventually hc
  have hloc : modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ³) := by
    filter_upwards [hpull] with y hy
    simp [modeF5, cyl2cart, hy]
  rw [hloc.fderiv_eq]
  exact fderiv_const_apply _

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (V : WC) (ξ : Cyl) (θ : ℝ) (Γ : Finset Lab), 0 < qC B.h ξ → (∀ γ m, γ ∉ Γ → V γ m ξ = 0) → (qC B.h ξ ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2))) • waveV5 B G (pq5QOf B G V) θ ξ = fun i => ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ ({1, -1} : Finset ℤ), ∑ m' ∈ ({1, -1} : Finset ℤ), ((1/2 : ℂ) * (pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') ξ i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ + m' * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) + pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (fun a => starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ a)) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') ξ i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m' * pint5 B G γ - m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)))).re

signature.name: pq5_regroup
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (V : WC) (ξ : Cyl) (θ : ℝ) (Γ : Finset Lab), 0 < qC B.h ξ → (∀ γ m, γ ∉ Γ → V γ m ξ = 0) → (qC B.h ξ ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2))) • waveV5 B G (pq5QOf B G V) θ ξ = fun i => ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ ({1, -1} : Finset ℤ), ∑ m' ∈ ({1, -1} : Finset ℤ), ((1/2 : ℂ) * (pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') ξ i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ + m' * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) + pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (fun a => starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ a)) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') ξ i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m' * pint5 B G γ - m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)))).re

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G V ξ θ Γ hq hΓ
  funext i
  
  have hE : ∀ (γ : Lab) (M : ℤ), pq5QOf B G V γ M ξ i * ephase5 B G γ M θ ξ =
      (((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ) *
        ∑ m ∈ ({1, -1} : Finset ℤ), ∑ m' ∈ ({1, -1} : Finset ℤ),
          ((if m + m' = M then pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ)
              (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') ξ i *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((M * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) else 0) +
           (if m' - m = M then pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ)
              (fun a => starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ a)) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') ξ i *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((M * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) else 0)) := by
    intro γ M
    have he : Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) ≠ 0 :=
      Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    have hph : ephase5 B G γ M θ ξ =
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((M * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) := by
      unfold ephase5
      rw [← Complex.exp_add]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    have key : ∀ (c S F : ℂ),
        c * (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))⁻¹ * S *
          (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) * F) =
        c * (S * F) := by
      intro c S F
      rw [show c * (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))⁻¹ * S *
          (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) * F) =
          c * (S * F) * ((Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))⁻¹ *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)))) by ring,
        inv_mul_cancel₀ he, mul_one]
    rw [hph]
    unfold pq5QOf
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.add_apply, ite_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
    rw [key]
    congr 1
    simp only [Finset.sum_mul, add_mul, ite_mul, zero_mul]
  
  have hsupp : ∀ γ : Lab, (Function.support fun M : ℤ => pq5QOf B G V γ M ξ i * ephase5 B G γ M θ ξ) ⊆
      ((({2, 0, -2} : Finset ℤ)) : Set ℤ) := by
    intro γ M hM
    by_contra hn
    apply hM
    simp only [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
      not_or] at hn
    show pq5QOf B G V γ M ξ i * ephase5 B G γ M θ ξ = 0
    rw [hE, Finset.sum_eq_zero, mul_zero]
    intro m hm
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro m' hm'
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hm hm'
    have h1 : m + m' ≠ M := by omega
    have h2 : m' - m ≠ M := by omega
    rw [if_neg h1, if_neg h2, add_zero]
  
  have hinner : ∀ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ M : ℤ, pq5QOf B G V γ M ξ i * ephase5 B G γ M θ ξ =
      (((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ) *
        ∑ m ∈ ({1, -1} : Finset ℤ), ∑ m' ∈ ({1, -1} : Finset ℤ),
          (pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') ξ i *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ + m' * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) +
            pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (fun a => starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ a))
              (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') ξ i *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m' * pint5 B G γ - m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))) := by
    intro γ
    rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (hsupp γ), Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun M _ => hE γ M),
      ← Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m hm => ?_)
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m' hm' => ?_)
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hm hm'
    have hm1 : m + m' ∈ ({2, 0, -2} : Finset ℤ) := by
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]; omega
    have hm2 : m' - m ∈ ({2, 0, -2} : Finset ℤ) := by
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]; omega
    rw [if_pos hm1, if_pos hm2, add_mul, sub_mul]
  
  have hTr0 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (U : Fin 3 → ℂ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), (∀ a, U a = 0) →
      pq5TrM B.h n U c ξ = 0 := by
    intro n U c hU
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [pq5TrM, hU]
  have hQ0 : ∀ γ, γ ∉ Γ → ∀ M, pq5QOf B G V γ M ξ = 0 := by
    intro γ hγ M
    unfold pq5QOf
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero, smul_zero]
    intro m _
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro m' _
    have hU : ∀ a, modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ a = 0 := fun a => by simp [modeCoef5, hΓ γ m hγ]
    have hU' : ∀ a, (fun i => starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ i)) a = 0 := fun a => by
      simp [hU a]
    rw [hTr0 _ _ _ hU, hTr0 _ _ _ hU']
    simp
  have hsuppΓ : (Function.support fun γ : Lab =>
      ∑ᶠ M : ℤ, pq5QOf B G V γ M ξ i * ephase5 B G γ M θ ξ) ⊆ (Γ : Set Lab) := by
    intro γ hγ
    by_contra hn
    apply hγ
    simp [hQ0 γ hn]
  
  have hc : qC B.h ξ ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) * (qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) / 2) = 1/2 := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hq.le]
    field_simp [(Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)).ne']
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, waveV5]
  rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ hsuppΓ, Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => hinner γ),
    Complex.re_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
  rw [Complex.re_ofReal_mul, ← mul_assoc, hc, Complex.re_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
  rw [Complex.re_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m' _ => ?_)
  rw [show (1/2 : ℂ) = ((1/2 : ℝ) : ℂ) by push_cast; ring, Complex.re_ofReal_mul]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (V : WC), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB → (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (V γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → V γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) → IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeCoef5 B G V γ m) ξ

signature.name: pq5_coef_diff
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (V : WC), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB → (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (V γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → V γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) → IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeCoef5 B G V γ m) ξ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 V hok hG hqs hVs hVsupp
  
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  refine ⟨hDopen, ?_⟩
  intro γ m ξ hξ
  have hDn : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∈ nhds ξ := hDopen.mem_nhds hξ
  obtain ⟨hr, ht, hqξ⟩ := id hξ
  
  have hamp : DifferentiableAt ℝ (V γ m) ξ :=
    ((hVs γ m).contDiffAt hDn).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hai : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => V γ m η i) ξ := differentiableAt_pi.1 hamp
  
  set v : Cyl → ℝ × ℝ := fun η => Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ with hv
  have hvc : Continuous v := by
    rw [hv]
    unfold Jpow
    fun_prop
  set U : Set Cyl := DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ {η | |(v η).1 - (v ξ).1| < 1/8} ∩
    {η | |(v η).2 - (v ξ).2| < 1/8} with hU
  have hUo : IsOpen U :=
    (hDopen.inter (isOpen_lt ((hvc.fst.sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const)).inter
      (isOpen_lt ((hvc.snd.sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const)
  have hξU : ξ ∈ U := by
    refine ⟨⟨hξ, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · show |(v ξ).1 - (v ξ).1| < 1/8
      rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; norm_num
    · show |(v ξ).2 - (v ξ).2| < 1/8
      rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; norm_num
  have hUn : U ∈ nhds ξ := hUo.mem_nhds hξU
  by_cases hA : ∀ η ∈ U, V γ m η = 0
  · 
    have hev : modeCoef5 B G V γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hUn (fun η hη => by
        funext i
        simp [modeCoef5, hA η hη])
    exact (differentiableAt_const _).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  · 
    push_neg at hA
    obtain ⟨η1, hη1U, hη1⟩ := hA
    have hη1D : η1 ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := hη1U.1.1
    obtain ⟨-, -, hxi, het, -, -⟩ := hVsupp γ m η1 hη1D hη1
    have hr0 : G.r0 ≤ 1/100 := hG.1.2.1
    
    have hb0 : 0 ≤ bgc := by unfold bgc; linarith [Real.one_lt_sqrt_two]
    have hb1 : bgc ≤ 1 := by
      unfold bgc
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
    have hden : (1 + bgc ^ 2) * (1 + bgc ^ 2)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity)
    have id1 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.1 = lamR w + bgc * lamT w := by
      intro w
      simp only [lamR, lamT, div_eq_mul_inv]
      linear_combination (-w.1) * hden
    have id2 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.2 = -(bgc * lamR w) + lamT w := by
      intro w
      simp only [lamR, lamT, div_eq_mul_inv]
      linear_combination (-w.2) * hden
    have key : ∀ (R T : ℝ), |R| ≤ G.r0 / 4 → |T| ≤ G.r0 →
        |R + bgc * T| ≤ 1/80 ∧ |-(bgc * R) + T| ≤ 1/80 := by
      intro R T hR hT
      obtain ⟨hR1, hR2⟩ := abs_le.mp hR
      obtain ⟨hT1, hT2⟩ := abs_le.mp hT
      have hr0n : 0 ≤ G.r0 := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hT
      have e1 : bgc * T ≤ G.r0 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hT2), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
      have e2 : -G.r0 ≤ bgc * T := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (show 0 ≤ T + G.r0 by linarith),
          mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
      have e3 : bgc * R ≤ G.r0 / 4 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hR2), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
      have e4 : -(G.r0 / 4) ≤ bgc * R := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (show 0 ≤ R + G.r0 / 4 by linarith),
          mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
      exact ⟨abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
    have hround : ∀ (x : ℝ) (k : ℤ), |x - k| < 1/2 → round x = k := by
      intro x k hk
      rw [round_eq, Int.floor_eq_iff]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hk
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hw1 : |lamR (frac0 (v η1))| ≤ G.r0 / 4 := hxi
    have hw2 : |lamT (frac0 (v η1))| ≤ G.r0 := het
    have hw := key _ _ hw1 hw2
    have ex1 : (v η1).1 - ((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ) =
        lamR (frac0 (v η1)) + bgc * lamT (frac0 (v η1)) := id1 (frac0 (v η1))
    have ex2 : (v η1).2 - ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ) =
        -(bgc * lamR (frac0 (v η1))) + lamT (frac0 (v η1)) := id2 (frac0 (v η1))
    have hx1 : |(v η1).1 - ((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1/80 := by rw [ex1]; exact hw.1
    have hx2 : |(v η1).2 - ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1/80 := by rw [ex2]; exact hw.2
    obtain ⟨kk, hkk⟩ : ∃ kk : ℝ × ℝ,

      have g2 : |(v η1).2 - (v ξ).2| < 1/8 := hη1U.2

    have hbase : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => baseC B γ.1 η i) ξ := by

      simp only [chartZ, div_eq_mul_inv]
      fun_prop
    have hRC : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => RC γ.1 η) ξ := by
      simp only [RC, div_eq_mul_inv]
      fun_prop
    have hRC0 : RC γ.1 ξ ≠ 0 := by

    have hT : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => lamT (v η - kk)) ξ := by

    have hmd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl =>
        pzr5 B G γ * chartZ B.h γ.1 η / epsb B.h γ.1 + sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 * RC γ.1 η

        (hRC.const_mul (sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar * 2⁻¹))).sub
        (((hT.add_const G.r0).mul_const (cib B.h γ.1)⁻¹).mul

    have hev : phiL5 B G γ =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun η : Cyl =>

      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hUn (fun η hη => ?_)

        show (lamT (frac0 (v η)) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 = _
        rw [hfr η hη]

      unfold phiL5
      rw [hvco]
    have hp : DifferentiableAt ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ := hmd.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    
    have hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => ((phiL5 B G γ η : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ :=

    have hE : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl =>

      ((hc.const_mul ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ))).const_mul (Complex.I * (m : ℂ))).cexp
    rw [differentiableAt_pi]
    intro i
    exact (hai i).mul hE

      calc bgc * |lamT w| ≤ (1/2) * (1/8) := mul_le_mul hbgc.2.le hetw.le (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        _ = 1/16 := by norm_num
    have hb2 : bgc * |lamR w| ≤ 1/16 := by
      calc bgc * |lamR w| ≤ (1/2) * (1/8) := mul_le_mul hbgc.2.le hxiw.le (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        _ = 1/16 := by norm_num
    have hb1' : |bgc * lamT w| ≤ 1/16 := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hbgc.1]; exact hb1
    have hb2' : |bgc * lamR w| ≤ 1/16 := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hbgc.1]; exact hb2
    have hw1 : |w.1| < 1/2 := by
      rw [hinv1]
      obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hxiw
      obtain ⟨c1', c2'⟩ := abs_le.mp hb1'
      exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hw2 : |w.2| < 1/2 := by
      rw [hinv2]
      obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hetw
      obtain ⟨c1', c2'⟩ := abs_le.mp hb2'
      exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    obtain ⟨K1, hK1⟩ : ∃ K : ℤ, K = round ((Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨K2, hK2⟩ : ∃ K : ℤ, K = round ((Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hw1e : w.1 = (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1 - (K1 : ℝ) := by
      rw [hw, hK1]; rfl
    have hw2e : w.2 = (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2 - (K2 : ℝ) := by
      rw [hw, hK2]; rfl
    have hround : ∀ (x : ℝ) (K : ℤ), |x - (K : ℝ)| < 1/2 → round x = K := by
      intro x K hx
      rw [round_eq, Int.floor_eq_iff]
      obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := abs_lt.mp hx
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hJc : Continuous (fun Y' : ℝ × ℝ => Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ) := by
      unfold Jpow; fun_prop
    obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ : ∃ V : Set (ℝ × ℝ), V =
        {Y' : ℝ × ℝ | |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).1 - (K1 : ℝ)| < 1/2} ∩
        {Y' : ℝ × ℝ | |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).2 - (K2 : ℝ)| < 1/2} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hVo : IsOpen V := by
      rw [hV]
      exact (isOpen_lt ((hJc.fst).sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const).inter
        (isOpen_lt ((hJc.snd).sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const)
    have hYV : ξ.2.2.2 ∈ V := by
      rw [hV]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · show |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1 - (K1 : ℝ)| < 1/2
        rw [← hw1e]; exact hw1
      · show |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2 - (K2 : ℝ)| < 1/2
        rw [← hw2e]; exact hw2
    have hfr : ∀ Y' ∈ V, rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) Y' =
        Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ - ((K1 : ℝ), (K2 : ℝ)) := by
      intro Y' hY'
      rw [hV] at hY'
      have r1 : round ((Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).1) = K1 := hround _ _ hY'.1
      have r2 : round ((Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).2) = K2 := hround _ _ hY'.2
      unfold rectW frac0
      rw [r1, r2]
      ext <;> simp
    obtain ⟨d0, hd0⟩ : ∃ d0 : ℝ, d0 = -(lamT (G.ctr γ) + lamT ((K1 : ℝ), (K2 : ℝ))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have haff : ∀ Y' ∈ V, etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) Y' = Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) * lamT Y' + d0 := by
      intro Y' hY'
      unfold etG
      rw [hfr Y' hY', hTsub, hTsub, hlin, hd0]
      ring
    obtain ⟨lT, hlTd⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ, f = (1 / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) •
        (bgc • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ + ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hlT : ∀ y, lT y = lamT y := by
      intro y; rw [hlTd]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', smul_eq_mul]
      unfold lamT; ring
    obtain ⟨Λ, hΛd⟩ : ∃ f : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ, f = Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) • lT.comp
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)))) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hΛ : ∀ v : Cyl, Λ v = Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) * lamT v.2.2.2 := by
      intro v; rw [hΛd]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', smul_eq_mul, hlT]
    obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U : Set Cyl, U = (fun η : Cyl => η.2.2.2) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hUo : IsOpen U := by rw [hU]; exact hVo.preimage (by fun_prop)
    have hξU : ξ ∈ U := by rw [hU]; exact hYV
    have hev : psiW B G γ =ᶠ[nhds ξ] (fun η : Cyl => Θ (Λ η + d0)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hξU) (fun η hη => by
        rw [hU] at hη
        show psiW B G γ η = Θ (Λ η + d0)
        rw [hpsi, haff η.2.2.2 hη, hΛ])
    have hgs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Θ (Λ η + d0)) :=
      hΘs.comp (Λ.contDiff.add contDiff_const)
    have hLn : ∀ v : Cyl, (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.2 = JpowL (-coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) v.2.2.2 :=
      fun v => rfl
    have hslope : ∀ v : Cyl, |Λ (Lnorm B.h ξ v)| ≤ 2 * Tgc ^ 3 * ‖v‖ := by
      intro v
      rw [hΛ, hLn, hJL, ← mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hT, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (zpow_pos hT0 _)]
      have hz3 : Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1 + -coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) ≤ Tgc ^ (3:ℤ) :=
        zpow_le_zpow_right₀ hT1.le (by omega)
      have h3 : Tgc ^ (3:ℤ) = Tgc ^ 3 := zpow_natCast Tgc 3
      have hY : ‖v.2.2.2‖ ≤ ‖v‖ :=
        (norm_snd_le _).trans ((norm_snd_le _).trans (norm_snd_le _))
      have hX : |lamT v.2.2.2| ≤ 3/2 * ‖v‖ := by linarith [hlamb v.2.2.2]
      have hT3 : 0 ≤ Tgc ^ 3 := by positivity
      calc Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1 + -coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) * |lamT v.2.2.2|
          ≤ Tgc ^ 3 * (3/2 * ‖v‖) := by
            rw [← h3]; exact mul_le_mul hz3 hX (abs_nonneg _) (by rw [h3]; exact hT3)
        _ ≤ 2 * Tgc ^ 3 * ‖v‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg v]
    refine ⟨hgs.contDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev, fun i hi => ?_, fun c hc => ?_⟩
    · rw [hNBev _ _ i ξ hev]
      refine (nbaff B.h Θ Λ d0 ξ i (K i) (2 * Tgc ^ 3) hΘs (hK i) (by positivity) hslope).trans ?_
      calc K i * (2 * Tgc ^ 3) ^ i ≤ |K i| * (2 * Tgc ^ 3) ^ i :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (by positivity)
        _ ≤ Mψ k := by
            rw [hMψ]
            exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |K j| * (2 * Tgc ^ 3) ^ j)
              (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity))
              (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
    · obtain ⟨a0, b0, hab⟩ := hc
      obtain ⟨kk, hkk⟩ := Int.le.dest hciN
      have hJk : Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) c = Jpow (kk : ℤ) (Jpow (coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) c) := by
        rw [hcomp, ← hkk, add_comm]
      obtain ⟨a1, b1, hJk'⟩ := hint kk a0 b0
      have hJc' : Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) c = ((a1 : ℝ), (b1 : ℝ)) := by
        rw [hJk, hab, hJk']
      have hrect : rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (ξ.2.2.2 + c) = rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 := by
        unfold rectW
        rw [hJadd, hJc']
        have e : Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 + ((a1 : ℝ), (b1 : ℝ)) - G.ctr γ =
            (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ) + ((a1 : ℝ), (b1 : ℝ)) := by abel
        rw [e, hfrI]
      rw [hpsi, hpsi]
      congr 1
      unfold etG
      rw [show (shY ξ c).2.2.2 = ξ.2.2.2 + c from rfl, hrect]
  
  refine ⟨lb, fun k => ⟨Mρ (Aex B.h + 1/2) k +
    4 ^ k * Mρ (Aex B.h + 1/2) k * Mψ k * Mρ (-(Aex B.h + 1)) k, 0, ?_⟩⟩
  intro l0 hl0 γ _ _ ξ hξ r1 r2 e1 e2
  have hξ' := hξ
  obtain ⟨-, ht, hqs⟩ := hξ'
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  have hq1 : qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hs1, hb1⟩ := hrho (Aex B.h + 1/2) k γ ξ ht hq1 r1 r2
  obtain ⟨hs2, hb2⟩ := hrho (-(Aex B.h + 1)) k γ ξ ht hq1 r1 r2
  obtain ⟨hps, hpb, hdk⟩ := hpsiA k l0 hl0 γ ξ hξ r1 r2 e1 e2
  have hP : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => rhoQ B γ η ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) * psiW B G γ η) ξ := hs1.mul hps
  have hR : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => rhoQ B γ η ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) * psiW B G γ η *
      rhoQ B γ η ^ (-(Aex B.h + 1))) ξ := hP.mul hs2
  have hA0 := hMρ0 (Aex B.h + 1/2) k
  have hE0 := hMψ0 k
  have hF0 := hMρ0 (-(Aex B.h + 1)) k
  have hPb : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB B.h (fun η => rhoQ B γ η ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) * psiW B G γ η) i ξ ≤
      2 ^ k * Mρ (Aex B.h + 1/2) k * Mψ k := by
    intro i hi
    refine (nbmul B.h ξ _ _ i _ _ hs1 hps (fun j hj => hb1 j (hj.trans hi))
      (fun j hj => hpb j (hj.trans hi))).trans ?_
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hi) hA0) hE0
  have hRb := nbmul B.h ξ _ _ k _ _ hP hs2 hPb (fun j hj => hb2 j hj)
  have e4 : (4:ℝ) ^ k = 2 ^ k * 2 ^ k := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
  have hX0 : 0 ≤ 4 ^ k * Mρ (Aex B.h + 1/2) k * Mψ k * Mρ (-(Aex B.h + 1)) k := by positivity
  rw [Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
  refine ⟨(hcast _ ξ hs1).1, (hcast _ ξ hR).1, ?_, ?_, hdk⟩
  · exact ((hcast _ ξ hs1).2 k).trans ((hb1 k le_rfl).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right hX0))
  · refine ((hcast _ ξ hR).2 k).trans (hRb.trans ?_)
    rw [e4]
    have : 2 ^ k * (2 ^ k * Mρ (Aex B.h + 1/2) k * Mψ k) * Mρ (-(Aex B.h + 1)) k =
        2 ^ k * 2 ^ k * Mρ (Aex B.h + 1/2) k * Mψ k * Mρ (-(Aex B.h + 1)) k := by ring
    rw [this]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_left hA0

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (F : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (y : ℝ³), 0 < rad y → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F y → Δ F y = fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ F z (eR z)) y (eR y) + fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ F z (eTh z)) y (eTh y) + (rad y)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ F y (eR y) + fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ F z eZ) y eZ

signature.name: frame_lap_identity
signature.statement: ∀ (F : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (y : ℝ³), 0 < rad y → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F y → Δ F y = fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ F z (eR z)) y (eR y) + fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ F z (eTh z)) y (eTh y) + (rad y)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ F y (eR y) + fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ F z eZ) y eZ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro F y hy hF
  have hS : 0 < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.mp hy
  have hr0 : rad y ≠ 0 := hy.ne'
  have hrr : y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 = rad y ^ 2 := (Real.sq_sqrt hS.le).symm
  have hq : (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) = 1 := by
    rw [hrr, inv_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hr0)]
  have hcoord : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (z : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ => w i) z := by
    intro i z
    have h0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (ι := Fin 3) i) z :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt _
    rwa [EuclideanSpace.coe_proj] at h0
  have hradD : DifferentiableAt ℝ rad y :=
    (((hcoord 0 y).pow 2).add ((hcoord 1 y).pow 2)).sqrt hS.ne'
  have hinv : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ³ => (rad z)⁻¹) y := hradD.inv hr0
  have heR : DifferentiableAt ℝ eR y :=
    hinv.smul (((hcoord 0 y).smul_const _).add ((hcoord 1 y).smul_const _))
  have heTh : DifferentiableAt ℝ eTh y :=
    hinv.smul (((hcoord 1 y).neg.smul_const _).add ((hcoord 0 y).smul_const _))
  
  have hfr : ∀ v : ℝ³,
      fderiv ℝ eR y v = ((y 0 * v 1 - y 1 * v 0) * (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2) • eTh y ∧
      fderiv ℝ eTh y v = (-((y 0 * v 1 - y 1 * v 0) * (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2)) • eR y := by
    intro v
    have hy0 : y + (0:ℝ) • v = y := by simp
    have hγi : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => (y + τ • v) i) (v i) 0 := by
      intro i
      have e : (fun τ : ℝ => (y + τ • v) i) = fun τ => y i + τ * v i := by
        funext τ
        simp
      rw [e]
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).mul_const (v i)).const_add (y i)
    have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => y + τ • v) v 0 := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const v).const_add y
    have hρ : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => rad (y + τ • v)) ((y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1) * (rad y)⁻¹) 0 := by
      have hf : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => (y + τ • v) 0 ^ 2 + (y + τ • v) 1 ^ 2)
          (2 * (y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1)) 0 := by
        have := ((hγi 0).pow 2).add ((hγi 1).pow 2)
        refine this.congr_deriv ?_
        simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hne : (y + (0:ℝ) • v) 0 ^ 2 + (y + (0:ℝ) • v) 1 ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hy0]
        exact hS.ne'
      refine (hf.sqrt hne).congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]
      show 2 * (y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1) / (2 * rad y) = _
      field_simp
    have hρ0 : 0 < rad (y + (0:ℝ) • v) := by
      rw [hy0]
      exact hy
    have hρinv : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => (rad (y + τ • v))⁻¹)
        (-((y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1) * (rad y)⁻¹) * (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2) 0 := by
      refine (hρ.inv hρ0.ne').congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
    have heR' : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => eR (y + τ • v))
        (((y 0 * v 1 - y 1 * v 0) * (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2) • eTh y) 0 := by
      have hrv : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => radVec (y + τ • v))
          (v 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
            v 1 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) 0 :=
        ((hγi 0).smul_const _).add ((hγi 1).smul_const _)
      refine (hρinv.smul hrv).congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]
      refine PiLp.ext (fun i => ?_)
      fin_cases i
      · simp [radVec, eTh, azVec]
        linear_combination (-((rad y)⁻¹ * v 0)) * hq
      · simp [radVec, eTh, azVec]
        linear_combination (-((rad y)⁻¹ * v 1)) * hq
      · simp [radVec, eTh, azVec]
    have heTh' : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => eTh (y + τ • v))
        ((-((y 0 * v 1 - y 1 * v 0) * (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2)) • eR y) 0 := by
      have hav : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => azVec (y + τ • v))
          ((-(v 1)) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
            v 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) 0 :=
        ((hγi 1).neg.smul_const _).add ((hγi 0).smul_const _)
      refine (hρinv.smul hav).congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]
      refine PiLp.ext (fun i => ?_)
      fin_cases i
      · simp [radVec, eR, azVec]
        linear_combination ((rad y)⁻¹ * v 1) * hq
      · simp [radVec, eR, azVec]
        linear_combination (-((rad y)⁻¹ * v 0)) * hq
      · simp [radVec, eR, azVec]
    have heR'' : HasDerivAt (eR ∘ fun τ : ℝ => y + τ • v) _ 0 := heR'
    have heTh'' : HasDerivAt (eTh ∘ fun τ : ℝ => y + τ • v) _ 0 := heTh'
    have h1 := heR.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) hγ (by simp)
    have h2 := heTh.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) hγ (by simp)
    exact ⟨h1.unique heR'', h2.unique heTh''⟩
  have hc1 : y 0 * eR y 1 - y 1 * eR y 0 = 0 := by
    simp [eR, radVec]
    ring
  have hc2 : (y 0 * eTh y 1 - y 1 * eTh y 0) * (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2 = (rad y)⁻¹ := by
    simp [eTh, azVec]
    linear_combination (rad y)⁻¹ * hq
  
  have hon : Orthonormal ℝ ![eR y, eTh y, eZ] := by
    rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
    intro i j
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [eR, eTh, eZ, radVec, azVec] <;>
      first
      | ring1
      | linear_combination hq
  have hsp : ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![eR y, eTh y, eZ]) :=
    (hon.linearIndependent.span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank (by simp)).ge
  have hlap : Δ F y = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y (eR y) (eR y) +
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y (eTh y) (eTh y) + fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y eZ eZ := by
    rw [InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_orthonormalBasis F (OrthonormalBasis.mk hon hsp)]
    simp only [OrthonormalBasis.coe_mk, Fin.sum_univ_three, iteratedFDeriv_two_apply,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two,
      Matrix.tail_cons]
  
  have hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y :=
    (hF.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hprod : ∀ (u : ℝ³ → ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ u y → ∀ w : ℝ³,
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ F z (u z)) y w =
        fderiv ℝ F y (fderiv ℝ u y w) + fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y w (u y) := by
    intro u hu w
    rw [fderiv_clm_apply hc hu]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp', Function.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]
  have hR : fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ F z (eR z)) y (eR y) =
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y (eR y) (eR y) := by
    rw [hprod eR heR, (hfr (eR y)).1, hc1, zero_mul, zero_smul, map_zero, zero_add]

    have hMδ : 1 * δ ≤ M * δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hM hδ0.le
    have hμ : 0 ≤ (σ * (n 0 - Bs * σ) - N2 * (n 1 + Bs * N2) + N1 * (n 2 - Bs * N1))
        + 4 * M * δ := by linarith
    have hD : Bs ^ 2 * (1 + σ ^ 2) - dotProduct n n ≤ 8 * M ^ 2 * δ := by
      have g1 := mul_nonneg hBs0.le hμ
      have g2 : Bs * (8 * M * δ) ≤ M * (8 * M * δ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hBsb (by positivity)
      have g3 := sq_nonneg (n 0 - Bs * σ)
      have g4 := sq_nonneg (n 1 + Bs * N2)
      have g5 := sq_nonneg (n 2 - Bs * N1)
      rw [hid]; linarith
    have hED : E * (Bs ^ 2 * (1 + σ ^ 2) - dotProduct n n) ≤ M * (8 * M ^ 2 * δ) := by
      calc E * (Bs ^ 2 * (1 + σ ^ 2) - dotProduct n n) ≤ E * (8 * M ^ 2 * δ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD hE0
        _ ≤ M * (8 * M ^ 2 * δ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hE1 (by positivity)
    have hq : 0 ≤ lam / Real.sqrt (1 + σ ^ 2) :=
      div_nonneg (by rw [hlam]; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    have hM3 : 0 ≤ M ^ 3 * δ := by positivity
    linarith

by
  intro B G hok hG

    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2

        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e' : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩

    rw [e']

    rw [hHz γ m hm]
    simp

    refine contDiffOn_pi.mpr (fun i => ?_)

      contDiffOn_pi.mp (ha.2.1 γ m) i
    exact (hai.fderiv_of_isOpen hDo (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).clm_apply (he.mono hsub)

    have hloc : ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, a γ m (shY η c) = a γ m η := by
      filter_upwards [hDo.mem_nhds hξ, deck_locally_stable_v5 B l0 hok (by omega) ξ hξ c hc]

    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : Cyl, v = ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), c) := ⟨_, rfl⟩

      ext <;> simp
    funext i
    have hev : (fun x => a γ m (x + v) i) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] (fun η => a γ m η i) :=
      hloc.mono (fun η hη => by

    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (fun η => a γ m η i) (shY ξ c) = fderiv ℝ (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ := by
      rw [hsh ξ, ← fderiv_comp_add_right]
      exact hev.fderiv_eq
    show fderiv ℝ (fun η => a γ m η i) (shY ξ c) (e (shY ξ c)) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ (e ξ)
    rw [hfd, hey ξ c]
  · 
    by_cases hts : ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m)

      have hev : (fun η => a γ m η i) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun _ => (0:ℂ) :=

      show fderiv ℝ (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ (e ξ) = 0
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp

by
  intro B hok k
  have hh : 0 < B.h := hok.2.1.1
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  
  have hJ : ∀ (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ), JpowL n (t • vrv) = (Lgc ^ n * t) • vrv := by
    intro n t
    have hD : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    simp only [JpowL, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', Jpow, vrv, vtv]
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.fst_add, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
      ring
    · simp only [Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.snd_add, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
      ring
  
  have hcoarse : ∀ h q : ℝ, 0 ≤ h → 0 < q → q ≤ 1 →
      Lgc ^ (coarseIdx h q) ≤ q ^ (-(drx h / 2 + h * kapS)) := by
    intro h q hh q0 hq1
    have hs2a : (1:ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := by
      have := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (show (1:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
      rwa [Real.sqrt_one] at this
    have hs2b : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := (Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)).mpr (by norm_num)
    have hL1 : 1 < Lgc := by unfold Lgc; linarith
    have hT1 : 1 < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; linarith
    have hL0 : 0 < Lgc := by linarith
    have hLl : 0 < Real.log Lgc := Real.log_pos hL1
    have hTl : 0 < Real.log Tgc := Real.log_pos hT1
    have hl2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
    obtain ⟨x, hxdef⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = Real.logb 2 (1 / q) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by
      rw [hxdef]; exact Real.logb_nonneg one_lt_two (one_le_one_div q0 hq1)
    have hx : x * Real.log 2 = -Real.log q := by
      rw [hxdef, Real.logb, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hl2.ne', one_div, Real.log_inv]
    have hb : bandOf q = ⌈x⌉₊ := by rw [hxdef]; rfl
    have hR : 0 ≤ (1 + h) * x * Real.log 2 / Real.log Tgc :=
      div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hx0) hl2.le) hTl.le
    have hstar : ((coarseIdx h q : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ (1 + h) * x * Real.log 2 / Real.log Tgc := by
      obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ : ∃ l : ℕ, l = bandOf q - 4 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hc : coarseIdx h q = bandIdx h l := by rw [hl]; rfl
      rw [hc]
      unfold bandIdx
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos l with h0 | hpos
      · have e : Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l:ℝ) ^ 2)) = 0 := by
          rw [h0]; simp
        rw [e, Int.floor_zero, Int.cast_zero]
        exact hR
      · have hl1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (l:ℝ) ^ 2 := one_le_pow₀ (by exact_mod_cast hpos)
        have hA : 0 < (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _
        have hAl : 0 < (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / (l:ℝ) ^ 2 := div_pos hA (by linarith)
        have h1 := Int.floor_le (Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / (l:ℝ) ^ 2))
        have h2 := Real.logb_le_logb_of_le hT1 hAl (div_le_self hA.le hl1)
        have h3 : Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ))) =
            (1 + h) * l * Real.log 2 / Real.log Tgc := by
          rw [Real.logb_rpow_eq_mul_logb_of_pos two_pos, ← Real.log_div_log]
          ring
        have hlx : (l:ℝ) ≤ x := by
          have e1 : l + 4 = bandOf q := by omega
          have e2 : ((⌈x⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) < x + 1 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one hx0
          have e3 : ((l:ℝ) + 4) = ((⌈x⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) := by rw [← hb]; exact_mod_cast e1
          linarith
        have h4 : (1 + h) * l * Real.log 2 / Real.log Tgc ≤
            (1 + h) * x * Real.log 2 / Real.log Tgc := by
          rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv]
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (inv_nonneg.mpr hTl.le)
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hl2.le
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlx (by linarith)
        linarith
    have hd : drx h / 2 + h * kapS = (1 + h) * (Real.log Lgc / Real.log Tgc) := by
      unfold drx; ring
    have hlq : Real.log q = -(x * Real.log 2) := by rw [hx]; ring
    rw [← Real.rpow_intCast, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hL0, Real.rpow_def_of_pos q0, Real.exp_le_exp,
      hd, hlq]
    calc Real.log Lgc * ((coarseIdx h q : ℤ) : ℝ)
        ≤ Real.log Lgc * ((1 + h) * x * Real.log 2 / Real.log Tgc) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstar hLl.le
      _ = -(x * Real.log 2) * -((1 + h) * (Real.log Lgc / Real.log Tgc)) := by ring
  
  have hshell : ∀ (d e q r X L Xa Xb a : ℝ) (j : ℕ), a = d - 1 - (j:ℝ) → 0 < q → 0 < Xa → Xa < X →
      X < Xb → 0 < r → r ^ 2 = 2 * q * X → 0 ≤ L → L ≤ q ^ (-(d / 2 + e)) →
      Real.sqrt q * (L * Real.sqrt q ^ j * r ^ a) ≤
        ((2 * Xa) ^ (a / 2) + (2 * Xb) ^ (a / 2)) * q ^ (-e) := by
    intro d e q r X L Xa Xb a j ha hq0 hXa' hX1 hX2 hr0 hr2 hL0 hL
    have hr : r ^ a = (2 * X) ^ (a / 2) * q ^ (a / 2) := by
      calc r ^ a = r ^ ((2:ℝ) * (a / 2)) := by congr 1; ring
        _ = (r ^ (2:ℝ)) ^ (a / 2) := Real.rpow_mul hr0.le _ _
        _ = (2 * X * q) ^ (a / 2) := by
            congr 1
            rw [Real.rpow_two, hr2]
            ring
        _ = (2 * X) ^ (a / 2) * q ^ (a / 2) := Real.mul_rpow (by linarith) hq0.le
    have hsq : Real.sqrt q = q ^ (1/2:ℝ) := Real.sqrt_eq_rpow q
    have hsqj : Real.sqrt q ^ j = q ^ ((j:ℝ) / 2) := by
      rw [hsq, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hq0.le]
      congr 1
      ring
    have e1 : q ^ (1/2:ℝ) * q ^ ((j:ℝ) / 2) * q ^ (a / 2) = q ^ (d / 2) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hq0, ← Real.rpow_add hq0]
      congr 1
      rw [ha]
      ring
    have key : Real.sqrt q * (L * Real.sqrt q ^ j * r ^ a) =
        (2 * X) ^ (a / 2) * (L * q ^ (d / 2)) := by
      rw [hr, hsqj, hsq, ← e1]
      ring
    have hLq : L * q ^ (d / 2) ≤ q ^ (-e) := by
      calc L * q ^ (d / 2) ≤ q ^ (-(d / 2 + e)) * q ^ (d / 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)
        _ = q ^ (-e) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_add hq0]
            congr 1
            ring
    have hE : (2 * X) ^ (a / 2) ≤ (2 * Xa) ^ (a / 2) + (2 * Xb) ^ (a / 2) := by
      rcases le_or_gt 0 (a / 2) with hs | hs
      · have h1 := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * X) (by linarith : 2 * X ≤ 2 * Xb) hs
        have h2 := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * Xa) (a / 2)
        linarith
      · have h1 := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * Xa)
          (by linarith : 2 * Xa ≤ 2 * X) hs.le
        have h2 := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * Xb) (a / 2)
        linarith
    rw [key]
    calc (2 * X) ^ (a / 2) * (L * q ^ (d / 2)) ≤ (2 * X) ^ (a / 2) * q ^ (-e) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLq (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
      _ ≤ ((2 * Xa) ^ (a / 2) + (2 * Xb) ^ (a / 2)) * q ^ (-e) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hE (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)
  
  have hphi : ∀ (p : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), 0 < ξ.1 →
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ p) j ξ ≤
        |Polynomial.eval p (descPochhammer ℝ j)| * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) ^ j * ξ.1 ^ (p - (j:ℝ)) := by
    intro p j ξ hr
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ, P = ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hPapp : ∀ η : Cyl, P η = η.1 := by intro η; rw [hP]; rfl
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      (contDiffOn_id (s := Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))).rpow_const_of_ne (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
    have hU : IsOpen (⇑P ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) := isOpen_Ioi.preimage P.continuous
    have hPξ : P ξ ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) := by rw [hPapp]; exact hr
    have hξU : ξ ∈ ⇑P ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) := hPξ
    have hfeq : (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ p) = (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) ∘ ⇑P := by
      funext η; simp only [Function.comp, hPapp]
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ p) ξ =

    have hqi : 0 ≤ (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le
    calc _ ≤ (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * NB B.h a (k + 1) ξ := h1
      _ ≤ (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * T := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hNT (k + 1) le_rfl) hqi
      _ ≤ (1 + S) * ((qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * T) := le_mul_of_one_le_left (mul_nonneg hqi hT0) (by linarith)
      _ = (1 + S) * (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * T := by ring
  
  have hZb : NB B.h (fun η i => dZ (fun η' => a η' i) η) k ξ ≤
      (1 + S) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) * T := by
    have e : NB B.h (fun η i => dZ (fun η' => a η' i) η) k ξ =
        NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ uz)) k ξ := by
      apply htr
      intro η hη
      rw [hLuz]
      exact hcv η hη _
    rw [e]
    have h1 := nbdir B.h (DomC B.h qs) ξ a uz hΩo hξ ha k
    rw [hnuz] at h1
    have hqi : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _).le
    calc _ ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) * NB B.h a (k + 1) ξ := h1
      _ ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) * T := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hNT (k + 1) le_rfl) hqi
      _ ≤ (1 + S) * (qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) * T) :=
          le_mul_of_one_le_left (mul_nonneg hqi hT0) (by linarith)
      _ = (1 + S) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) * T := by ring
  
  have hv : ∀ η : Cyl, ((1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) : Cyl) =
      Lnorm B.h ξ u1 + η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) • Lnorm B.h ξ u2 := by
    intro η
    rw [hLu1, hLu2]
    refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_))
    · simp
    · simp
    · simp
    · simp [smul_smul, mul_comm]
  have hRe : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs, (fun i => dR B.h (fun η' => a η' i) η) =
      fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u1) + η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) • fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2) := by
    intro η hη
    have h1 : (fun i => dR B.h (fun η' => a η' i) η) =
        fderiv ℝ a η ((1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) : Cyl) := hcv η hη _
    rw [h1, hv η, map_add, map_smul]
  have hRt : NB B.h (fun η i => dR B.h (fun η' => a η' i) η) k ξ =
      NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u1) +
        η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) • fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) k ξ :=
    htr _ _ k hRe
  
  have hFd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ a) (DomC B.h qs) :=
    ha.fderiv_of_isOpen hΩo (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hG1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u1)) (DomC B.h qs) :=
    hFd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hG2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) (DomC B.h qs) :=
    hFd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hfst : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => η.1) (DomC B.h qs) := contDiff_fst.contDiffOn
  have hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) (DomC B.h qs) :=
    hfst.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => ne_of_gt hη.1)
  have hφG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) • fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2))
      (DomC B.h qs) := hφ.smul hG2
  
  have hsub : NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u1) +
        η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) • fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) k ξ ≤
      NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u1)) k ξ +
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) • fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) k ξ := by
    have hn : DomC B.h qs ∈ nhds ξ := hΩo.mem_nhds hξ
    have hfun : (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u1) +
        η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) • fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) =
        (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u1)) +
        (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) • fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) := by
      funext η; rfl
    have ea : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u1) +
        η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) • fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) ξ =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u1)) ξ +
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) • fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) ξ := by
      rw [hfun]
      exact iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((hG1.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        ((hφG.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    unfold NB
    rw [ea]
    have eb : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u1)) ξ +
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) • fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) ξ
          ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u1)) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) +
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) • fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2))
          ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) := by
      ext m
      simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [eb]
    exact norm_add_le _ _
  
  have hG1b : Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u1)) k ξ ≤ Q * T := by
    have h1 := nbdir B.h (DomC B.h qs) ξ a u1 hΩo hξ ha k
    rw [hnu1] at h1
    calc Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u1)) k ξ
        ≤ Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * ((Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))⁻¹ * NB B.h a (k + 1) ξ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hs0.le
      _ = NB B.h a (k + 1) ξ := by rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hs0.ne', one_mul]
      _ ≤ T := hNT (k + 1) le_rfl
      _ ≤ Q * T := le_mul_of_one_le_left hT0 hQ1
  
  have hl := leib ξ (DomC B.h qs) k hΩo hξ (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1))
    (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) (hφ.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    (hG2.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
  have hX : ξ.1 ^ 2 = 2 * qC B.h ξ * XC B.h ξ := by
    have : XC B.h ξ = ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ) := rfl
    rw [this]
    field_simp
  have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * ((k.choose i : ℝ) *
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) i ξ *
      NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) (k - i) ξ) ≤
      (k.choose i : ℝ) * (Kf i * (|drx B.h| * ‖vrv‖)) * Ef i * (Q * T) := by
    intro i hi
    have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
    have hC0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hKi : Kf i = |Polynomial.eval (drx B.h - 1) (descPochhammer ℝ i)| := by rw [hKf]
    have hEi : (2 * B.Xa) ^ ((drx B.h - 1 - (i:ℝ)) / 2) + (2 * B.Xb) ^ ((drx B.h - 1 - (i:ℝ)) / 2)
        ≤ Ef i := by
      rw [hEf]; exact add_le_add (le_abs_self _) (le_abs_self _)
    have b1 : NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) i ξ ≤
        Kf i * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) ^ i * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1 - (i:ℝ)) := by
      rw [hKi]; exact hphi (drx B.h - 1) i ξ hr
    have hA0 : 0 ≤ Kf i * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) ^ i * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1 - (i:ℝ)) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hK0 i) (pow_nonneg hs0.le _)) (Real.rpow_nonneg hr.le _)
    have b2 : NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) (k - i) ξ ≤
        Λ * (|drx B.h| * ‖vrv‖) * T := by
      have h2 := nbdir B.h (DomC B.h qs) ξ a u2 hΩo hξ ha (k - i)
      rw [hnu2] at h2
      exact h2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hNT (k - i + 1) (by omega))
        (mul_nonneg hΛ0.le (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))))
    have b3 : Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * (Λ * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) ^ i * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1 - (i:ℝ))) ≤
        Ef i * Q := by
      have hsh := hshell (drx B.h) (B.h * kapS) (qC B.h ξ) ξ.1 (XC B.h ξ) Λ B.Xa B.Xb
        (drx B.h - 1 - (i:ℝ)) i rfl hq0 hXa hX1 hX2 hr hX hΛ0.le
        (by rw [hΛ]; exact hcoarse B.h (qC B.h ξ) hh.le hq0 hq1)
      rw [← hQ] at hsh
      exact hsh.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hEi (by linarith))
    have hP0 : 0 ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * Kf i * (|drx B.h| * ‖vrv‖) * T :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC0 (hK0 i)) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))) hT0
    calc Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * ((k.choose i : ℝ) *
          NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) i ξ *
          NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) (k - i) ξ)
        ≤ Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * ((k.choose i : ℝ) *
          (Kf i * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) ^ i * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1 - (i:ℝ))) *
          (Λ * (|drx B.h| * ‖vrv‖) * T)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b1 hC0) b2
            (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hC0 hA0)) hs0.le
      _ = ((k.choose i : ℝ) * Kf i * (|drx B.h| * ‖vrv‖) * T) *
          (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * (Λ * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) ^ i * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1 - (i:ℝ)))) := by
          ring
      _ ≤ ((k.choose i : ℝ) * Kf i * (|drx B.h| * ‖vrv‖) * T) * (Ef i * Q) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b3 hP0
      _ = (k.choose i : ℝ) * (Kf i * (|drx B.h| * ‖vrv‖)) * Ef i * (Q * T) := by ring
  have hLb : Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) *
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) • fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) k ξ ≤
      S * (Q * T) := by
    calc Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) *
          NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) • fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) k ξ
        ≤ Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) *
          NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) i ξ *
          NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) (k - i) ξ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl hs0.le
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * ((k.choose i : ℝ) *
          NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) i ξ *
          NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) (k - i) ξ) := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
          (k.choose i : ℝ) * (Kf i * (|drx B.h| * ‖vrv‖)) * Ef i * (Q * T) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
      _ = S * (Q * T) := by rw [hS, Finset.sum_mul]
  have hfin : Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * NB B.h (fun η i => dR B.h (fun η' => a η' i) η) k ξ ≤
      (1 + S) * Q * T := by
    rw [hRt]
    calc Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u1) +
          η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) • fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) k ξ
        ≤ Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * (NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u1)) k ξ +
          NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) • fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) k ξ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsub hs0.le
      _ = Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u1)) k ξ +
          Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) *
            NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1) • fderiv ℝ a η (Lnorm B.h ξ u2)) k ξ :=
          mul_add _ _ _
      _ ≤ Q * T + S * (Q * T) := add_le_add hG1b hLb
      _ = (1 + S) * Q * T := by ring
  
  have hpow : qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 + B.h * kapS)) = Q * (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))⁻¹ := by
    rw [hQ, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_neg hq0.le, ← Real.rpow_add hq0]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hRb : NB B.h (fun η i => dR B.h (fun η' => a η' i) η) k ξ ≤
      (1 + S) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 + B.h * kapS)) * T := by
    rw [hpow]
    have hsi : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hs0.le
    calc NB B.h (fun η i => dR B.h (fun η' => a η' i) η) k ξ
        = (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))⁻¹ *
          (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * NB B.h (fun η i => dR B.h (fun η' => a η' i) η) k ξ) :=
          (inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hs0.ne' _).symm
      _ ≤ (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))⁻¹ * ((1 + S) * Q * T) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfin hsi
      _ = (1 + S) * (Q * (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))⁻¹) * T := by ring
  rw [← hT]
  exact ⟨hTb, hRb, hZb⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (qs α δ : ℝ) (a F : WC), B.ok → InWg5 B G qs α a → (∃ H : Finset ℤ, (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧ ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → F γ m = 0) → (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (F γ m) (DomC B.h qs)) → (∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ c, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c → F γ m (shY ξ c) = F γ m ξ) → (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs → F γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (F γ m) k ξ ≤ M * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * δ) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), NB B.h (a γ m) i ξ) → InWg5 B G qs (α + δ) F

signature.name: inWg5_of_nb_dom_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (qs α δ : ℝ) (a F : WC), B.ok → InWg5 B G qs α a → (∃ H : Finset ℤ, (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧ ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → F γ m = 0) → (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (F γ m) (DomC B.h qs)) → (∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ c, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c → F γ m (shY ξ c) = F γ m ξ) → (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs → F γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (F γ m) k ξ ≤ M * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * δ) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), NB B.h (a γ m) i ξ) → InWg5 B G qs (α + δ) F

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G qs α δ a F hok ha hF1 hF2 hF3 hF4 hdom
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, ha5⟩ := ha
  refine ⟨hF1, hF2, hF3, hF4, fun k => ?_⟩
  choose Ca ba da hCa using ha5
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hdom k
  refine ⟨|M| * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), |Ca i|, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), |ba i|,
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), |da i|, fun γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qs := hξ
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ'.2.1])).1
  have hS1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
    unfold SC
    exact one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))])
  have hED : 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) := by
    have hX0 : 0 < XC B.h ξ := lt_trans hXa hX1
    unfold edgeDist
    exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX1))
      (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr hX2)))
  have hED1 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ≤ 1 := by
    unfold edgeDist
    exact min_le_left _ _
  have hP : 0 ≤ Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by
    unfold Penv5
    exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hew0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  set q := qC B.h ξ with hq
  set S := SC B.h ξ with hS
  set ew := Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) with hew
  set ed := edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) with hed
  set P := Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) with hPdef
  set R := Finset.range (k + 2) with hR
  set b' := ∑ i ∈ R, |ba i| with hb'
  set d' := ∑ i ∈ R, |da i| with hd'
  have hqa : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
  have hqd : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * δ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
  have hSb' : 0 ≤ S ^ b' := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
  have hedd' : 0 ≤ ed ^ (-d') := Real.rpow_nonneg hED.le _
  set W := q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ b' * ew * ed ^ (-d') * P with hW
  have hW0 : 0 ≤ W :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hqa hSb') hew0) hedd') hP
  have hord : ∀ i ∈ R, NB B.h (a γ m) i ξ ≤ |Ca i| * W := by
    intro i hi
    have hb : ba i ≤ b' := le_trans (le_abs_self _)
      (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |ba j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) hi)
    have hd : da i ≤ d' := le_trans (le_abs_self _)
      (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |da j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) hi)
    have h1 : S ^ ba i ≤ S ^ b' := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 hb
    have h2 : ed ^ (-da i) ≤ ed ^ (-d') :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hED hED1 (by linarith)
    have hSb : 0 ≤ S ^ ba i := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    have hedd : 0 ≤ ed ^ (-da i) := Real.rpow_nonneg hED.le _
    have h6 : Ca i * q ^ (B.h * α) ≤ |Ca i| * q ^ (B.h * α) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hqa
    have h5 : Ca i * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ ba i ≤ |Ca i| * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ b' :=
      mul_le_mul h6 h1 hSb (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hqa)
    have h4 : Ca i * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ ba i * ew ≤ |Ca i| * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ b' * ew :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h5 hew0
    have h3 : Ca i * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ ba i * ew * ed ^ (-da i) ≤
        |Ca i| * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ b' * ew * ed ^ (-d') :=
      mul_le_mul h4 h2 hedd (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hqa) hSb') hew0)
    have h7 : Ca i * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ ba i * ew * ed ^ (-da i) * P ≤
        |Ca i| * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ b' * ew * ed ^ (-d') * P :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h3 hP
    refine le_trans (hCa i γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2) (le_trans h7 (le_of_eq ?_))
    rw [hW]
    ring
  have hsum : ∑ i ∈ R, NB B.h (a γ m) i ξ ≤ (∑ i ∈ R, |Ca i|) * W := by
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum hord
  have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ R, NB B.h (a γ m) i ξ :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
  have hFb := hM γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2
  have hrp : q ^ (B.h * (α + δ)) = q ^ (B.h * α) * q ^ (B.h * δ) := by
    rw [mul_add, Real.rpow_add hq0]
  calc NB B.h (F γ m) k ξ ≤ M * q ^ (B.h * δ) * ∑ i ∈ R, NB B.h (a γ m) i ξ := hFb
    _ ≤ |M| * q ^ (B.h * δ) * ∑ i ∈ R, NB B.h (a γ m) i ξ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hqd) hsum0
    _ ≤ |M| * q ^ (B.h * δ) * ((∑ i ∈ R, |Ca i|) * W) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hqd)
    _ = |M| * (∑ i ∈ R, |Ca i|) * q ^ (B.h * (α + δ)) * S ^ b' * ew * ed ^ (-d') * P := by
        rw [hrp, hW]
        ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * ubase B η 0 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) ξ ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * ubase B η 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) ξ) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * ubase B η 0 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h) ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * ubase B η 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2)
