signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * ubase B η 0 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) ξ ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * ubase B η 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) ξ) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * ubase B η 0 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h) ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * ubase B η 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hok
  have hh0 : 0 < B.h := hok.2.1.1
  have hh1 : B.h < 1/100 := hok.2.1.2.1
  obtain ⟨-, -, hXa, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -, hqB0, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  have hXb : 0 < B.Xb := by linarith
  have hSN : SimNorm B.h := simscale_normalized_v4 B.h hh0 hh1 hok.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n0, fun l0 hl0 => ?_⟩
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqs0 : 0 < qsOf l0 := by rw [hQb]; positivity
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by rw [hQb]; exact pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hl0) hn0.le
  obtain ⟨hDo, -, hqpos, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  have hDsub : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ⊆ DomC B.h B.qB :=
    fun ξ hξ => ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ.2.2 hqsB⟩
  
  have hrep : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB,
      qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * ubase B ξ 0 =
        qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h) * (2 * XC B.h ξ) ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) *
          logLift B.Vb (Real.log (qC B.h ξ), XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) ∧
      qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * ubase B ξ 2 =
        qC B.h ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) * 1 *
          logLift B.Ub (Real.log (qC B.h ξ), XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) := by
    intro ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨hr, ht, hqB⟩ := hξ
    obtain ⟨hS1, -⟩ := hok.1
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, hVel, -⟩ := hok.2
    have hτ : 0 < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 := by linarith
    have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hS1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).1
    have hx0 : (rotPt ξ.1 0 ξ.2.1) 0 = ξ.1 := by simp [rotPt]
    have hx1 : (rotPt ξ.1 0 ξ.2.1) 1 = 0 := by simp [rotPt]
    have hx2 : (rotPt ξ.1 0 ξ.2.1) 2 = ξ.2.1 := by simp [rotPt]
    set x := rotPt ξ.1 0 ξ.2.1 with hx
    have hsc : simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - ξ.2.2.1) = qC B.h ξ := by rw [hx2]; rfl
    have hrr : x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 = ξ.1 ^ 2 := by rw [hx0, hx1]; ring
    have hpos : 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := by rw [hrr]; positivity
    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) = ξ.1 := by rw [hrr, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
    have hsimX : simX B.h x ξ.2.2.1 = XC B.h ξ := by
      unfold simX XC
      rw [hsc, hrr]
    have hsimEta : simEta B.h x ξ.2.2.1 = etaC B.h ξ := by
      unfold simEta etaC
      rw [hsc, hx2]
    have hmem : (x, ξ.2.2.1) ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB := by
      show ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - ξ.2.2.1) < B.qB
      rw [hsc]
      exact ⟨ht, hqB⟩
    obtain ⟨-, hU, hV⟩ := hVel x ξ.2.2.1 hmem hpos
    rw [hsimX, hsimEta, hsc] at hV
    rw [hsimX, hsimEta, hsc] at hU
    have hrad : rad x = ξ.1 := hsqrt
    have hb : ubase B ξ 0 = ξ.1⁻¹ * B.Vb (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) := by
      show inner ℝ (uB B x ξ.2.2.1) (frameAt 0 ξ 0) = _
      have hf : frameAt 0 ξ 0 = (rad x)⁻¹ • radVec x := rfl
      rw [hf, real_inner_smul_right, hrad]
      show ξ.1⁻¹ * inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => B.AB w ξ.2.2.1) x + B.BvB x ξ.2.2.1) (radVec x) = _
      rw [hV]
    have hu2 : ubase B ξ 2 = qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 + B.h)) * B.Ub (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) := by
      have hz : ∀ v : ℝ³, inner ℝ v eZ = v 2 := by
        intro v; simp [eZ, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
      show inner ℝ (uB B x ξ.2.2.1) (frameAt 0 ξ 2) = _
      have hf : frameAt 0 ξ 2 = eZ := rfl
      rw [hf, hz]
      show (curl3 (fun w => B.AB w ξ.2.2.1) x + B.BvB x ξ.2.2.1) 2 = _
      rw [hU]
    have hl : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, logLift g (Real.log (qC B.h ξ), XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) =
        g (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) := by
      intro g; unfold logLift; rw [Real.exp_log hq]
    have hqne : qC B.h ξ ≠ 0 := hq.ne'
    have h2X : 2 * XC B.h ξ = ξ.1 ^ 2 * (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ := by
      unfold XC
      field_simp
    have hphi : (2 * XC B.h ξ) ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) = ξ.1⁻¹ * qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) := by
      rw [h2X, Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.inv_rpow hq.le,
        Real.rpow_neg (sq_nonneg _), Real.rpow_neg hq.le, inv_inv]
      have h12 : (ξ.1 ^ 2) ^ (1/2:ℝ) = ξ.1 := by rw [← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
      rw [h12]
    have hA : qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) = qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h) * qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_add hq _ _
    have hE : qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 + B.h)) = qC B.h ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]
      congr 1
      unfold Aex
      ring
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hb, hl, hphi, hA]
      ring
    · rw [hu2, hl, ← mul_assoc, hE, mul_one]
  
  have hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun X : ℝ => (2 * X) ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun X : ℝ => 2 * X) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_id
    exact h2.rpow_const_of_ne (fun X hX => (mul_pos two_pos (Set.mem_Ioi.mp hX)).ne')
  have hφ1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun _ : ℝ => (1:ℝ)) (Set.Ioi 0) := contDiffOn_const
  have hPR := qpow_profile_nb_v4 B (qsOf l0) hok hSN hqs0 hqs1 (fun X : ℝ => (2 * X) ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)))
    (2 * Aex B.h) hφ
  have hPZ := qpow_profile_nb_v4 B (qsOf l0) hok hSN hqs0 hqs1 (fun _ : ℝ => (1:ℝ))
    (Aex B.h + 1/2) hφ1
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, ⟨-, hUbS, hVbS, hbd⟩, -⟩ := hok.2
  have hVbB : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → q < B.qB → B.Xa ≤ X → X ≤ B.Xb →
      -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift B.Vb) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbd B.Xa B.Xb hXa m
    exact ⟨C, fun q X η h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 => (hC q X η h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6).2.2⟩
  have hUbB : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → q < B.qB → B.Xa ≤ X → X ≤ B.Xb →
      -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift B.Ub) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := outer_profile_bounds_v5 B hok m
    exact ⟨C, fun q X η h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 =>
      (hC q X η h1 h2 (by linarith) (by linarith) h5 h6).2⟩
  have hΛV := bg_chart_nb_v5 B (logLift B.Vb) hok hVbS hVbB
  have hΛU := bg_chart_nb_v5 B (logLift B.Ub) hok hUbS hUbB
  
  have hprod : ∀ (P L : Cyl → ℝ) (c : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (DomC B.h B.qB) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
        NB B.h P k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ c) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
        NB B.h L k ξ ≤ C) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
        NB B.h (fun η => P η * L η) k ξ ≤ K * qC B.h ξ ^ c := by
    intro P L c hPs hLs hPb hLb k
    choose CP hCP using hPb
    choose CL hCL using hLb
    refine ⟨∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose j : ℝ) * |CP j| * |CL (k - j)|,
      fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
    have hq0 := hqpos ξ hξ
    have hQ : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ c := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
    have hLe := nb_mul_le_v4 B.h (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) P L hDo hPs (hLs.mono hDsub) ξ hξ k
    refine le_trans hLe ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j _
    have h1 : NB B.h P j ξ ≤ |CP j| * qC B.h ξ ^ c :=
      le_trans (hCP j ξ hξ hX1 hX2) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hQ)
    have h2 : NB B.h L (k - j) ξ ≤ |CL (k - j)| :=
      le_trans (hCL (k - j) ξ (hDsub hξ) hX1 hX2) (le_abs_self _)
    have h0' : 0 ≤ NB B.h L (k - j) ξ := norm_nonneg _
    calc (k.choose j : ℝ) * NB B.h P j ξ * NB B.h L (k - j) ξ
        ≤ (k.choose j : ℝ) * (|CP j| * qC B.h ξ ^ c) * |CL (k - j)| := by
          apply mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) h2 h0'
            (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hQ))
      _ = (k.choose j : ℝ) * |CP j| * |CL (k - j)| * qC B.h ξ ^ c := by ring
  
  have hcast : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (k : ℕ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ →
      NB B.h (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤ NB B.h f k ξ := by
    intro f ξ k hf
    have he : (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) = ⇑Complex.ofRealCLM ∘ f := by
      funext η; exact (Complex.ofRealCLM_apply (f η)).symm
    have hcomp : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (⇑Complex.ofRealCLM ∘ f) ξ =
        Complex.ofRealCLM.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left Complex.ofRealCLM hf (i := k)
        (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    unfold NB
    rw [he, hcomp]
    refine ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (norm_nonneg _) (fun v => ?_)
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply,
      Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, Complex.norm_real]
    have hb := ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)) v
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply] at hb
    exact hb
  have hcastS : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ := by
    intro f ξ hf
    have he : (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) = ⇑Complex.ofRealCLM ∘ f := by
      funext η; exact (Complex.ofRealCLM_apply (f η)).symm
    rw [he]
    exact (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff (n := ∞)).contDiffAt.comp ξ hf
  
  have hmRs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * ubase B η 0)
      (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    (hPR.1.mul (hΛV.1.mono hDsub)).congr (fun η hη => (hrep η (hDsub hη)).1)
  have hmZs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * ubase B η 2)
      (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    (hPZ.1.mul (hΛU.1.mono hDsub)).congr (fun η hη => (hrep η (hDsub hη)).2)
  refine ⟨fun ξ hξ => ⟨hcastS _ ξ (hmRs.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hξ)),
    hcastS _ ξ (hmZs.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hξ))⟩, fun k => ?_⟩
  
  obtain ⟨KR, hKR⟩ := hprod _ _ _ hPR.1 hΛV.1 hPR.2 hΛV.2 k
  obtain ⟨KZ, hKZ⟩ := hprod _ _ _ hPZ.1 hΛU.1 hPZ.2 hΛU.2 k
  refine ⟨|KR| + |KZ|, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · have hq0 := hqpos ξ hξ
    have hQ : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
    have hgerm : (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * ubase B η 0) =ᶠ[nhds ξ]
        (fun η => (qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h) * (2 * XC B.h η) ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) *
          logLift B.Vb (Real.log (qC B.h η), XC B.h η, etaC B.h η)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hDo.mem_nhds hξ) (fun η hη => (hrep η (hDsub hη)).1)
    have hNBeq : NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * ubase B η 0) k ξ =
        NB B.h (fun η => (qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h) * (2 * XC B.h η) ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) *
          logLift B.Vb (Real.log (qC B.h η), XC B.h η, etaC B.h η)) k ξ := by
      unfold NB
      rw [(hgerm.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
    have hK : KR ≤ |KR| + |KZ| := by linarith [le_abs_self KR, abs_nonneg KZ]
    calc NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * ubase B η 0 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) k ξ
        ≤ NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * ubase B η 0) k ξ :=
          hcast _ ξ k (hmRs.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hξ))
      _ = NB B.h (fun η => (qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h) * (2 * XC B.h η) ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) *
          logLift B.Vb (Real.log (qC B.h η), XC B.h η, etaC B.h η)) k ξ := hNBeq
      _ ≤ KR * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h) := hKR ξ hξ hX1 hX2
      _ ≤ (|KR| + |KZ|) * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK hQ
  · have hq0 := hqpos ξ hξ
    have hQ : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
    have hgerm : (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * ubase B η 2) =ᶠ[nhds ξ]
        (fun η => (qC B.h η ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) * 1) *
          logLift B.Ub (Real.log (qC B.h η), XC B.h η, etaC B.h η)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hDo.mem_nhds hξ) (fun η hη => (hrep η (hDsub hη)).2)
    have hNBeq : NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * ubase B η 2) k ξ =
        NB B.h (fun η => (qC B.h η ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) * 1) *

      unfold NB

    have hK : KZ ≤ |KR| + |KZ| := by linarith [le_abs_self KZ, abs_nonneg KR]
    calc NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * ubase B η 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) k ξ

          logLift B.Ub (Real.log (qC B.h η), XC B.h η, etaC B.h η)) k ξ := hNBeq
      _ ≤ KZ * qC B.h ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) := hKZ ξ hξ hX1 hX2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hok qs c _hqs0 hqs1
  have hh0 : 0 < B.h := hok.2.1.1
  have hh1 : B.h < 1/100 := hok.2.1.2.1
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  obtain ⟨hDo, hqC, hqpos, -, -, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B qs hok
  set f : Cyl → ℝ := fun η => qC B.h η ^ c with hf
  have hfOn : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) :=
    hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos η hη).ne')
  have hfAt : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ := fun ξ hξ =>
    hfOn.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hξ)
  have hcomp : (fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η ^ c : ℝ)) : ℂ)) = ⇑(Complex.ofRealCLM) ∘ f := by
    funext η
    simp [hf, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply]
  have hg1 : ‖(Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun x => by
      rw [Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, Complex.norm_real, one_mul])
  have hNB : ∀ (k : ℕ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs,
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (((qC B.h η ^ c : ℝ)) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤ NB B.h f k ξ := by
    intro k ξ hξ
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (⇑(Complex.ofRealCLM) ∘ f) ξ =
        (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ).compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left Complex.ofRealCLM (hfAt ξ hξ)
        (i := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [hcomp]
    unfold NB
    rw [e1]
    have e2 : ((Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
        (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)) := by
      ext v
      rfl
    rw [e2]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)‖ *
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hg1
  refine ⟨fun ξ hξ => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · rw [hcomp]
    exact (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ).contDiff.comp_contDiffAt ξ (hfAt ξ hξ)
  · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := tn_qpow_normalized_v5 B.h hh0 hh1 hS c k
    refine ⟨C, fun ξ hξ => ?_⟩
    have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qs := hξ
    exact (hNB k ξ hξ).trans (hC ξ hξ'.2.1 (hξ'.2.2.trans_le hqs1).le)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B P k hPq
  
  have leib : ∀ (h : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (U : Set Cyl) (n : ℕ),
      IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℂ), ContDiffOn ℝ n f U → ContDiffOn ℝ n g U →
      NB h (fun η => f η * g η) n ξ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h g (n - i) ξ := by
    intro h ξ U n hU hξ f g hf hg
    unfold NB
    generalize Lnorm h ξ = L
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage L.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
    have hL0s : L 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
    have hsm : ∀ (F : Cyl → ℂ),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
      intro F hF
      exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have hsmO : ∀ (F : Cyl → ℂ),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by
      intro F hF
      exact (hsm F hF).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
    have key : ∀ (F : Cyl → ℂ),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n →
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0 =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
      intro F hF i hi
      have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O
      have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
        hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
      have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + z)) i hs h0s
      have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i ξ 0
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0
          = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑L) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := e2
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [map_zero]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [e3]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
    have hfg : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun η => f η * g η) U := hf.mul hg
    have hl := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le (hsmO f hf) (hsmO g hg) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O
      (n := n) le_rfl
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => f (ξ + L y) * g (ξ + L y)) n hO h0O] at hl
    rw [← key _ hfg n le_rfl]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => (fun η => f η * g η) (ξ + L z)) 0‖
        = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f (ξ + L y) * g (ξ + L y)) 0‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ _ := hl
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        have hik : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O,
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => g (ξ + L z)) (n - i) hO h0O,
          key f hf i hik, key g hg (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i)]
  
  have R1 : ∀ (f g : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) (e1 e2 : ℝ) (w1 w2 : Lab → Cyl → ℝ),
      CUB5 B P k f e1 w1 → CUB5 B P k g e2 w2 →
      CUB5 B P k (cxMul5 f g) (e1 + e2) (fun γ ξ => w1 γ ξ * w2 γ ξ) := by
    intro f g e1 e2 w1 w2 hF hG
    obtain ⟨c1, hc1, H1⟩ := hF
    obtain ⟨c2, hc2, H2⟩ := hG
    refine ⟨2 ^ k * c1 * c2, by positivity, fun γ m ξ hP => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hq0, hq1⟩ := hPq γ m ξ hP
    obtain ⟨hw1, ⟨U1, hU1o, hU1ξ, hU1s⟩, B1⟩ := H1 γ m ξ hP
    obtain ⟨hw2, ⟨U2, hU2o, hU2ξ, hU2s⟩, B2⟩ := H2 γ m ξ hP
    have hUo : IsOpen (U1 ∩ U2) := hU1o.inter hU2o
    have hUξ : ξ ∈ U1 ∩ U2 := ⟨hU1ξ, hU2ξ⟩
    have hfs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f γ m) (U1 ∩ U2) := hU1s.mono Set.inter_subset_left
    have hgs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (g γ m) (U1 ∩ U2) := hU2s.mono Set.inter_subset_right
    refine ⟨mul_nonneg hw1 hw2, ⟨U1 ∩ U2, hUo, hUξ, hfs.mul hgs⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = c1 * qC B.h ξ ^ e1 * w1 γ ξ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℝ, E = c2 * qC B.h ξ ^ e2 * w2 γ ξ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by rw [hA]; exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc1 (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)) hw1
    have hE0 : 0 ≤ E := by rw [hE]; exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc2 (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)) hw2
    have l := leib B.h ξ (U1 ∩ U2) j hUo hUξ (f γ m) (g γ m)
      (hfs.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)) (hgs.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    have hsum : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1),
        (j.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h (f γ m) i ξ * NB B.h (g γ m) (j - i) ξ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) * A * E := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      have hij : i ≤ j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
      have b1 : NB B.h (f γ m) i ξ ≤ A := by rw [hA]; exact B1 i (hij.trans hj)
      have b2 : NB B.h (g γ m) (j - i) ξ ≤ E := by rw [hE]; exact B2 (j - i) ((Nat.sub_le j i).trans hj)
      have n2 : 0 ≤ NB B.h (g γ m) (j - i) ξ := norm_nonneg _
      have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ (j.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul b1 b2 n2 hA0) hc
    have hch : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ)) = 2 ^ j := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose j
    have hsum2 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) * A * E = 2 ^ j * A * E := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul, hch]
    have h2 : (2:ℝ) ^ j ≤ 2 ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hj
    have hAE : 0 ≤ A * E := mul_nonneg hA0 hE0
    have hrp : qC B.h ξ ^ (e1 + e2) = qC B.h ξ ^ e1 * qC B.h ξ ^ e2 := Real.rpow_add hq0 e1 e2
    show NB B.h (fun η => f γ m η * g γ m η) j ξ ≤
      2 ^ k * c1 * c2 * qC B.h ξ ^ (e1 + e2) * (w1 γ ξ * w2 γ ξ)
    rw [hrp]
    calc NB B.h (fun η => f γ m η * g γ m η) j ξ ≤ 2 ^ j * A * E := l.trans (hsum.trans hsum2.le)
      _ = 2 ^ j * (A * E) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 ^ k * (A * E) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 hAE
      _ = _ := by rw [hA, hE]; ring
  
  have R2 : ∀ (f g : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) (e : ℝ) (w : Lab → Cyl → ℝ), CUB5 B P k f e w → CUB5 B P k g e w →
      CUB5 B P k (cxAdd5 f g) e w ∧ CUB5 B P k (cxSub5 f g) e w := by
    intro f g e w hF hG
    obtain ⟨c1, hc1, H1⟩ := hF
    obtain ⟨c2, hc2, H2⟩ := hG
    have lin : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) (j : ℕ) (U : Set Cyl), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f γ m) U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (g γ m) U →
        NB B.h (fun η => f γ m η + g γ m η) j ξ ≤ NB B.h (f γ m) j ξ + NB B.h (g γ m) j ξ ∧
        NB B.h (fun η => f γ m η - g γ m η) j ξ ≤ NB B.h (f γ m) j ξ + NB B.h (g γ m) j ξ := by
      intro γ m ξ j U hU hξ hf hg
      have hfa : ContDiffAt ℝ j (f γ m) ξ :=
        (hf.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)
      have hga : ContDiffAt ℝ j (g γ m) ξ :=
        (hg.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)
      unfold NB
      constructor
      · have e0 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => f γ m η + g γ m η) ξ =
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (f γ m) ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (g γ m) ξ :=
          iteratedFDeriv_add_apply hfa hga
        rw [e0]
        have e2 : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (f γ m) ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (g γ m) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
            (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (f γ m) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) +
            (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (g γ m) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) := by
          ext v; simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
        rw [e2]; exact norm_add_le _ _
      · have e0 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => f γ m η - g γ m η) ξ =
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (f γ m) ξ - iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (g γ m) ξ :=
          iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply hfa hga
        rw [e0]
        have e2 : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (f γ m) ξ - iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (g γ m) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
            (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (f γ m) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) -
            (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (g γ m) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) := by
          ext v; simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
        rw [e2]; exact norm_sub_le _ _
    refine ⟨⟨c1 + c2, by linarith, fun γ m ξ hP => ?_⟩, ⟨c1 + c2, by linarith, fun γ m ξ hP => ?_⟩⟩
    · obtain ⟨hw1, ⟨U1, hU1o, hU1ξ, hU1s⟩, B1⟩ := H1 γ m ξ hP
      obtain ⟨_, ⟨U2, hU2o, hU2ξ, hU2s⟩, B2⟩ := H2 γ m ξ hP
      have hUo : IsOpen (U1 ∩ U2) := hU1o.inter hU2o
      have hUξ : ξ ∈ U1 ∩ U2 := ⟨hU1ξ, hU2ξ⟩
      have hfs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f γ m) (U1 ∩ U2) := hU1s.mono Set.inter_subset_left
      have hgs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (g γ m) (U1 ∩ U2) := hU2s.mono Set.inter_subset_right
      refine ⟨hw1, ⟨U1 ∩ U2, hUo, hUξ, hfs.add hgs⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩
      have hl := (lin γ m ξ j _ hUo hUξ hfs hgs).1
      have b1 := B1 j hj
      have b2 := B2 j hj
      show NB B.h (fun η => f γ m η + g γ m η) j ξ ≤ (c1 + c2) * qC B.h ξ ^ e * w γ ξ
      calc NB B.h (fun η => f γ m η + g γ m η) j ξ ≤ NB B.h (f γ m) j ξ + NB B.h (g γ m) j ξ := hl
        _ ≤ c1 * qC B.h ξ ^ e * w γ ξ + c2 * qC B.h ξ ^ e * w γ ξ := add_le_add b1 b2
        _ = (c1 + c2) * qC B.h ξ ^ e * w γ ξ := by ring
    · obtain ⟨hw1, ⟨U1, hU1o, hU1ξ, hU1s⟩, B1⟩ := H1 γ m ξ hP
      obtain ⟨_, ⟨U2, hU2o, hU2ξ, hU2s⟩, B2⟩ := H2 γ m ξ hP
      have hUo : IsOpen (U1 ∩ U2) := hU1o.inter hU2o
      have hUξ : ξ ∈ U1 ∩ U2 := ⟨hU1ξ, hU2ξ⟩
      have hfs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f γ m) (U1 ∩ U2) := hU1s.mono Set.inter_subset_left
      have hgs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (g γ m) (U1 ∩ U2) := hU2s.mono Set.inter_subset_right
      refine ⟨hw1, ⟨U1 ∩ U2, hUo, hUξ, hfs.sub hgs⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩
      have hl := (lin γ m ξ j _ hUo hUξ hfs hgs).2
      have b1 := B1 j hj
      have b2 := B2 j hj
      show NB B.h (fun η => f γ m η - g γ m η) j ξ ≤ (c1 + c2) * qC B.h ξ ^ e * w γ ξ
      calc NB B.h (fun η => f γ m η - g γ m η) j ξ ≤ NB B.h (f γ m) j ξ + NB B.h (g γ m) j ξ := hl
        _ ≤ c1 * qC B.h ξ ^ e * w γ ξ + c2 * qC B.h ξ ^ e * w γ ξ := add_le_add b1 b2
        _ = (c1 + c2) * qC B.h ξ ^ e * w γ ξ := by ring
  
  have R3 : ∀ (c : ℂ) (f : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) (e : ℝ) (w : Lab → Cyl → ℝ), CUB5 B P k f e w →
      CUB5 B P k (cxSmul5 c f) e w := by
    intro c f e w hF
    obtain ⟨c1, hc1, H1⟩ := hF
    refine ⟨‖c‖ * c1, mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hc1, fun γ m ξ hP => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hw, ⟨U, hUo, hUξ, hUs⟩, B1⟩ := H1 γ m ξ hP
    refine ⟨hw, ⟨U, hUo, hUξ, contDiffOn_const.mul hUs⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    have hfa : ContDiffAt ℝ j (f γ m) ξ :=
      (hUs.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hUξ)
    have e0 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (cxSmul5 c f γ m) ξ = c • iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (f γ m) ξ := by
      have := iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply (a := c) hfa
      exact this
    unfold NB
    rw [e0]
    have e2 : (c • iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (f γ m) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
        c • (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (f γ m) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) := by
      ext v; simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e2]
    have b1 := B1 j hj
    unfold NB at b1
    calc ‖c • (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (f γ m) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)‖
        ≤ ‖c‖ * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (f γ m) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)‖ := by
          apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
          intro v
          rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.smul_apply, norm_smul, mul_assoc]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ v) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ ‖c‖ * (c1 * qC B.h ξ ^ e * w γ ξ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b1 (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖c‖ * c1 * qC B.h ξ ^ e * w γ ξ := by ring
  
  have R4 : ∀ (f : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) (e e' : ℝ) (w w' : Lab → Cyl → ℝ), CUB5 B P k f e w → e' ≤ e →
      (∀ γ m ξ, P γ m ξ → w γ ξ ≤ w' γ ξ) → CUB5 B P k f e' w' := by
    intro f e e' w w' hF hee hww
    obtain ⟨c, hc, H⟩ := hF
    refine ⟨c, hc, fun γ m ξ hP => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hq0, hq1⟩ := hPq γ m ξ hP
    obtain ⟨hw, hU, Bd⟩ := H γ m ξ hP
    refine ⟨hw.trans (hww γ m ξ hP), hU, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    have h1 : qC B.h ξ ^ e ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ e' := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1 hee
    calc NB B.h (f γ m) j ξ ≤ c * qC B.h ξ ^ e * w γ ξ := Bd j hj
      _ ≤ c * qC B.h ξ ^ e' * w γ ξ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hc) hw
      _ ≤ c * qC B.h ξ ^ e' * w' γ ξ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hww γ m ξ hP) (mul_nonneg hc (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _))
  
  have R5 : ∀ (h : ℝ) (F : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (ξ : Cyl) (j : ℕ), (∀ i, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => F η i) ξ) →
      NB h F j ξ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, NB h (fun η => F η i) j ξ := by
    intro h F ξ j hF
    have hFa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F ξ := contDiffAt_pi.mpr hF
    have comp : ∀ i : Fin 3, iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => F η i) ξ =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) i).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j F ξ) := by
      intro i
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) i) hFa (i := j)
        (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    unfold NB
    have hT : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3,
        ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => F η i) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
    apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound hT
    intro v
    have hp : 0 ≤ ∏ t, ‖v t‖ := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun t _ => norm_nonneg _)
    rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hT hp)]
    intro i
    have e1 : ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)) v i =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => F η i) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)) v := by
      rw [comp i]
      simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e1]
    calc ‖((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => F η i) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)) v‖
        ≤ ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => F η i) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ *
            ∏ t, ‖v t‖ := ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ ≤ (∑ i : Fin 3,
            ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => F η i) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖) *
            ∏ t, ‖v t‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (Finset.single_le_sum
              (f := fun i => ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => F η i) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
                (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖)
              (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)) hp
  exact ⟨R1, R2, R3, R4, R5⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hok hSN
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  intro l0 _ S dPsi dv Hx hw hg hb k
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  have hqs0 : 0 < qsOf l0 := by unfold qsOf Qb; positivity
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    unfold qsOf Qb
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  obtain ⟨hUo, hqC, hqpos, -, hcalc, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  have hb' : InM B (qsOf l0) Hx (nrm B (Aex B.h) (momDbP B dPsi)) :=
    (mom_class_algebra_v4 B (qsOf l0) hok hqs0 hqs1).1 (Hx + 1) (Hx + 1) Hx 1 0 _ _ _ hb hb
      (by linarith) (by linarith) (fun ξ _ => by ring)
  
  have hdom : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
      0 < qC B.h ξ ∧ qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 ∧ 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ ∧ 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) ∧
      0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ∧ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ≤ 1 := by
    intro ξ hξ hX1 hX2
    have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
    refine ⟨hqpos ξ hξ, by linarith [hξ'.2.2], ?_, ?_, ?_, min_le_left _ _⟩
    · unfold SC
      exact one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))])
    · unfold edgeWeight
      split_ifs
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      · exact le_rfl
    · have hX : 0 < XC B.h ξ := lt_trans hXa hX1
      unfold edgeDist
      exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX1))
        (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr hX2)))
  
  have unnorm : ∀ (g : Cyl → ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) Hx (nrm B (Aex B.h) g) →
      ∃ C b d : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
        ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k + 1 → NB B.h g j ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h + B.h * Hx) *
          (SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
            edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d)) := by
    intro g hF
    have hFs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (nrm B (Aex B.h) g) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := hF.1
    have hps : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos η hη).ne')
    choose Cf bf df hCf using hF.2.2.2
    choose Kq hKq using nb_qpow_v4 B (qsOf l0) (-Aex B.h) hok hSN hqs0 hqs1
    obtain ⟨Cs, hCs⟩ : ∃ Cs : ℝ, Cs = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), |Cf j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨bs, hbs⟩ : ∃ bs : ℝ, bs = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), |bf j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨ds, hds⟩ : ∃ ds : ℝ, ds = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), |df j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Ks, hKs⟩ : ∃ Ks : ℝ, Ks = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), |Kq j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hCs0 : 0 ≤ Cs := by rw [hCs]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have hKs0 : 0 ≤ Ks := by rw [hKs]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have mem : ∀ j, j ≤ k + 1 → j ∈ Finset.range (k + 2) :=
      fun j hj => Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj)
    have hCj : ∀ j, j ≤ k + 1 → Cf j ≤ Cs := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hCs]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cf j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    have hbj : ∀ j, j ≤ k + 1 → bf j ≤ bs := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hbs]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |bf j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    have hdj : ∀ j, j ≤ k + 1 → df j ≤ ds := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hds]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |df j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    have hKj : ∀ j, j ≤ k + 1 → Kq j ≤ Ks := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hKs]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Kq j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    refine ⟨2 ^ (k + 1) * Ks * Cs, bs, ds, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hKs0) hCs0,
      fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 j hj => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hq, -, hS1, hE, hδ0, hδ1⟩ := hdom ξ hξ hX1 hX2
    have hqa : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * Hx) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    have hqA : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    obtain ⟨wv, hwv⟩ : ∃ wv : ℝ, wv = SC B.h ξ ^ bs * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
        edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have p3 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bs := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    have hwv0 : 0 ≤ wv := by
      rw [hwv]; exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p3 hE) (Real.rpow_nonneg hδ0.le _)
    have hFb : ∀ m, m ≤ k + 1 → NB B.h (nrm B (Aex B.h) g) m ξ ≤ Cs * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * Hx) * wv) := by
      intro m hm
      have h1 := hCf m ξ hξ hX1 hX2
      have hbm : SC B.h ξ ^ (bf m) ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bs := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 (hbj m hm)
      have hdm : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df m) ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hδ0 hδ1 (neg_le_neg (hdj m hm))
      have p1 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ (bf m) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have p2 : 0 ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df m) := Real.rpow_nonneg hδ0.le _
      calc NB B.h (nrm B (Aex B.h) g) m ξ
          ≤ Cf m * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * Hx) * SC B.h ξ ^ (bf m) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *

    have hTb : T ≤ ((k:ℝ) + 2) * (Ci * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h + B.h * Hx) * w) := by
      have h1 : T ≤ ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (j + 2), Ci * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h + B.h * Hx) * w := by
        rw [hT, hw]
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun l hl => hBi ξ hξ hX1 hX2 l (by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hl; omega))
      rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul] at h1
      have hjk : ((j + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (k:ℝ) + 2 := by
        have : (j:ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hj
        push_cast; linarith
      have hX0 : 0 ≤ Ci * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h + B.h * Hx) * w :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCi0 (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)) hw0
      exact h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hjk hX0)
    have hexp : qC B.h ξ ^ (-(B.h * kapS)) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h + B.h * Hx) =
        Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h + B.h * Hx - 1/2 - B.h * kapS) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_add hq0, ← Real.rpow_add hq0]
      congr 1; ring
    have hmain : Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * NB B.h (dR B.h (fun ζ => dUM5 B dPsi dv ζ i)) j ξ ≤
        Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * (Mb * ((k:ℝ) + 2) * Ci *
          qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h + B.h * Hx - 1/2 - B.h * kapS) * w) := by
      have h1 := hM j ξ hξ hX1 hX2
      rw [← hT] at h1
      calc Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * NB B.h (dR B.h (fun ζ => dUM5 B dPsi dv ζ i)) j ξ
          ≤ M j * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(B.h * kapS)) * T := h1
        _ ≤ Mb * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(B.h * kapS)) * T :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hMj j hj) hQ0) hT0
        _ ≤ Mb * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(B.h * kapS)) * (((k:ℝ) + 2) * (Ci * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h + B.h * Hx) * w)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hTb (mul_nonneg hMb0 hQ0)
        _ = Mb * ((k:ℝ) + 2) * Ci * w *
              (qC B.h ξ ^ (-(B.h * kapS)) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h + B.h * Hx)) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hexp]; ring
    have hfin := le_of_mul_le_mul_left hmain hs0
    rw [hw] at hfin
    calc NB B.h (fun η => ((dR B.h (dUM5 B dPsi dv) η i : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ
        ≤ NB B.h (fun η => dR B.h (dUM5 B dPsi dv) η i) j ξ :=
          hofR _ ξ j (hrs.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hξ))
      _ = NB B.h (dR B.h (fun ζ => dUM5 B dPsi dv ζ i)) j ξ := hNBe
      _ ≤ _ := hfin
  · obtain ⟨hξ, hX1, hX2⟩ := hgood γ m ξ hP
    obtain ⟨hq0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hdom ξ hξ hX1 hX2
    refine ⟨wnn ξ hξ hX1 hX2, ⟨_, hUo, hξ, hcx _ hzs⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    rw [show wtD5 B b d γ ξ = SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
      edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) from rfl]
    have hev : (fun η => dZ (dUM5 B dPsi dv) η i) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] dZ (fun ζ => dUM5 B dPsi dv ζ i) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hξ) (fun η hη => (hcomp_d η hη i).2)
    have hNBe : NB B.h (fun η => dZ (dUM5 B dPsi dv) η i) j ξ =
        NB B.h (dZ (fun ζ => dUM5 B dPsi dv ζ i)) j ξ := by
      unfold NB; rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds]
    have hexp : qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h + B.h * Hx) =
        qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h + B.h * Hx - 1/2 + B.h) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hq0]; congr 1; ring
    calc NB B.h (fun η => ((dZ (dUM5 B dPsi dv) η i : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ
        ≤ NB B.h (fun η => dZ (dUM5 B dPsi dv) η i) j ξ :=
          hofR _ ξ j (hzs.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hξ))
      _ = NB B.h (dZ (fun ζ => dUM5 B dPsi dv ζ i)) j ξ := hNBe
      _ ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) * NB B.h (fun ζ => dUM5 B dPsi dv ζ i) (j + 1) ξ := hdZ _ hsi ξ hξ j
      _ ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) * (Ci * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h + B.h * Hx) *
            (SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hBi ξ hξ hX1 hX2 (j + 1) (by omega)) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)
      _ = Ci * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h + B.h * Hx)) *
            (SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d)) := by
          ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hexp]

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG hSN
  obtain ⟨lP, hPs⟩ := pulse_support_good_v5 B G hok hG
  refine ⟨lP, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 S bw ca cm cd hSt k
  have hh : 0 < B.h := hok.2.1.1
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  have hqs0 : 0 < qsOf l0 := by unfold qsOf Qb; positivity
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    unfold qsOf Qb
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  obtain ⟨hUo, hqC, hqpos, -, hcalc, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  
  have hclm : ∀ {V W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup W]
      [NormedSpace ℝ W] (L : V →L[ℝ] W) (F : Cyl → V) (ξ : Cyl) (j : ℕ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F ξ →
      NB B.h (fun η => L (F η)) j ξ ≤ ‖L‖ * NB B.h F j ξ := by
    intro V W _ _ _ _ L F ξ j hF
    have hit : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => L (F η)) ξ =
        L.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j F ξ) :=
      L.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left hF (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    unfold NB
    rw [hit]
    have e : (L.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j F ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) = L.compContinuousMultilinearMap
          ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)) := by
      ext m; rfl
    rw [e]
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
  have hcomp : ∀ (F : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ) (ξ : Cyl) (i : Fin 3) (j : ℕ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F ξ →
      NB B.h (fun η => F η i) j ξ ≤ NB B.h F j ξ := by
    intro F ξ i j hF
    have h1 := hclm (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) i) F ξ j hF
    have h2 : ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) i)‖ ≤ 1 :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one
        (fun v => by rw [one_mul]; exact norm_le_pi_norm v i)
    have h3 : 0 ≤ NB B.h F j ξ := norm_nonneg _
    calc NB B.h (fun η => F η i) j ξ ≤ _ := h1
      _ ≤ 1 * NB B.h F j ξ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 h3
      _ = _ := one_mul _
  
  have hadd : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f g : Cyl → V) (ξ : Cyl) (j : ℕ),
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g ξ →
      NB B.h (fun η => f η + g η) j ξ ≤ NB B.h f j ξ + NB B.h g j ξ := by
    intro V _ _ f g ξ j hf hg
    have hfun : (fun η => f η + g η) = f + g := rfl
    have ea : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => f η + g η) ξ =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g ξ := by
      rw [hfun]
      exact iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (hf.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        (hg.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    unfold NB
    rw [ea]
    have eb : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) +
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) := by
      ext m
      simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [eb]
    exact norm_add_le _ _
  
  have nbdir : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl)
      (F : Cyl → V) (w : Cyl), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → ∀ k : ℕ,
      NB h (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm h ξ w)) k ξ ≤ ‖w‖ * NB h F (k + 1) ξ := by
    intro V _ _ h U ξ F w hU hξ hF k
    have hFd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) ξ :=
      (hF.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)
    have hcomp : (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm h ξ w)) =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ V (Lnorm h ξ w)) ∘ (fderiv ℝ F) := by
      funext η; rfl
    have hit : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm h ξ w)) ξ =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ V (Lnorm h ξ w)).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ F) ξ) := by
      rw [hcomp]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left _ hFd (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hNB0 : 0 ≤ NB h F (k + 1) ξ := norm_nonneg _
    unfold NB
    rw [hit]
    apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hNB0)
    intro m
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply]
    have key : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ F) ξ (fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m i))) (Lnorm h ξ w) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ))
          (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w) := by
      rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right]
      have e1 : Fin.init (fun i : Fin (k+1) => Lnorm h ξ (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i)) =
          fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m i) := by
        funext i
        simp [Fin.init, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      rw [e1]
      simp only [Fin.snoc_last]
    rw [key]
    have hprod : ∏ i : Fin (k+1), ‖Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i‖ =
        (∏ i : Fin k, ‖m i‖) * ‖w‖ := by
      rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
      simp [Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ *
          ∏ i : Fin (k+1), ‖Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i‖ :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ = ‖w‖ * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ *
          ∏ i : Fin k, ‖m i‖ := by rw [hprod]; ring
  
  have e0 : ∀ ξ : Cyl, ∀ v : Cyl, (Lnorm B.h ξ v).1 = Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * v.1 := by
    intro ξ v; simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
  have e1 : ∀ ξ : Cyl, ∀ v : Cyl, (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.1 = qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1 := by
    intro ξ v; simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
  have e2 : ∀ ξ : Cyl, ∀ v : Cyl, (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 = qC B.h ξ * v.2.2.1 := by
    intro ξ v; simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
  have e3 : ∀ ξ : Cyl, ∀ v : Cyl, (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.2 = JpowL (-coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) v.2.2.2 := by
    intro ξ v; rfl
  
  have hdZ : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (F : Cyl → V),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      ∀ j : ℕ, NB B.h (dZ F) j ξ ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) * NB B.h F (j + 1) ξ := by
    intro V _ _ F hFs ξ hξ j
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s = qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs0 : 0 < s := by rw [hs]; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _
    have hsi : 0 < s⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hs0
    obtain ⟨u0, hu0⟩ : ∃ u0 : Cyl, u0 = ((0:ℝ), s⁻¹, (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hLu : Lnorm B.h ξ u0 = ((0, 1, 0, 0) : Cyl) := by
      refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_))
      · rw [e0, hu0]; simp
      · rw [e1, ← hs, hu0]
        show s * s⁻¹ = 1
        exact mul_inv_cancel₀ hs0.ne'
      · rw [e2, hu0]; simp
      · rw [e3, hu0]
        exact map_zero _
    have hdZeq : dZ F = fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm B.h ξ u0) := by
      funext η
      unfold dZ
      rw [hLu]
    have hnu : ‖u0‖ = s⁻¹ := by
      rw [hu0]
      simp only [Prod.norm_def, norm_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hsi, max_self]
      rw [max_eq_left hsi.le, max_eq_right hsi.le]
    have hsinv : s⁻¹ = qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) := by
      rw [hs, ← Real.rpow_neg hq0.le]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [hdZeq]
    calc NB B.h (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm B.h ξ u0)) j ξ ≤ ‖u0‖ * NB B.h F (j + 1) ξ :=
          nbdir B.h (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ξ F u0 hUo hξ hFs j
      _ = qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h - 1/2) * NB B.h F (j + 1) ξ := by rw [hnu, hsinv]
  
  have leib : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (U : Set Cyl) (n : ℕ),
      IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (g : Cyl → V), ContDiffOn ℝ n f U → ContDiffOn ℝ n g U →
      NB B.h (fun η => f η • g η) n ξ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h f i ξ * NB B.h g (n - i) ξ := by
    intro ξ V _ _ U n hU hξ f g hf hg
    unfold NB
    generalize Lnorm B.h ξ = L
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG hSN
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨ls, hs⟩ := pulse_support_good_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lN, hN⟩ := good_nphi5_nb_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨ls + lN + n0, fun l0 hl0 S bw ca cm cd hSt k => ?_⟩
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqs0 : 0 < qsOf l0 := by rw [hQb]; positivity
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by rw [hQb]; exact pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 < B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0
  obtain ⟨hDo, hqC, hqpos, -, -, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  have hAw : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 S.Aw := hSt.1
  
  have hcastc : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (c : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ → ∀ j : ℕ,
      NB B.h (fun η => ((c * f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ ≤ |c| * NB B.h f j ξ := by
    intro ξ c f hf j
    have hLn : ‖(c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ))‖ ≤ |c| :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (abs_nonneg c) (fun x => by
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, norm_smul, Complex.norm_real,
          Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs])
    have hcomp : (fun η => ((c * f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) = ⇑(c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)) ∘ f := by
      funext η
      simp [Complex.ofRealCLM_apply]
    rw [hcomp]
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (⇑(c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)) ∘ f) ξ =
        (c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)).compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left (c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)) hf
        (i := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    unfold NB
    rw [e1]
    have e2 : ((c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
        (c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)) := by
      ext v
      rfl
    rw [e2]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ))‖ *
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hLn (norm_nonneg _)
  have hNBnn : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V) (j : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl),
      0 ≤ NB B.h f j ξ := by
    intro V _ _ f j ξ
    unfold NB
    exact norm_nonneg _
  have hNBc : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (z : ℂ) (j : ℕ), NB B.h (fun _ : Cyl => z) j ξ ≤ ‖z‖ := by
    intro ξ z j
    unfold NB
    refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with hk0 | hk'
    · subst hk0; simp
    · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne hk'.ne']; simp
  have hsm : ∀ (U : Set Cyl) (f : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) U := by
    intro U f hf
    have hcomp : (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) = ⇑(Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ) ∘ f := by
      funext η; simp [Complex.ofRealCLM_apply]
    rw [hcomp]
    exact (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hf
  
  have hsqb : ∀ (q Q : ℝ), 0 < q → 0 < Q → q < 4 * Q → (Real.sqrt Q)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * q ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) := by
    intro q Q hq hQ hq4
    have hsq : 0 < Real.sqrt q := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hq
    have h4 : Real.sqrt q ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt Q := by
      have e4 : Real.sqrt (4 * Q) = 2 * Real.sqrt Q := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num), show (4:ℝ) = 2 * 2 by norm_num,
          Real.sqrt_mul_self (by norm_num)]
      rw [← e4]
      exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hq4.le
    have e : q ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ)) = (Real.sqrt q)⁻¹ := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg hq.le, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    rw [e]
    calc (Real.sqrt Q)⁻¹ = 2 * (2 * Real.sqrt Q)⁻¹ := by
          rw [mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ two_ne_zero, one_mul]
      _ ≤ 2 * (Real.sqrt q)⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (inv_anti₀ hsq h4) (by norm_num)
  have hkb : ∀ (q : ℝ) (l : ℕ), 0 < q → q < 4 * Qb l → (kb B.h l : ℝ) ≤ 4 * q ^ (-(B.h / 2)) := by
    intro q l hq hq4
    have hQ : 0 < Qb l := by unfold Qb; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
    have hQ1 : Qb l ≤ 1 := by
      unfold Qb; exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (by simp)
    have hkx : (kb B.h l : ℝ) = (⌈Qb l ^ (-(B.h / 2))⌉₊ : ℝ) := by
      unfold kb epsb
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul hQ.le]
      congr 3
      ring
    have hx1 : 1 ≤ Qb l ^ (-(B.h / 2)) :=
      Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hQ hQ1 (by linarith)
    have hceil : (⌈Qb l ^ (-(B.h / 2))⌉₊ : ℝ) < Qb l ^ (-(B.h / 2)) + 1 :=
      Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by linarith)
    have hq4' : q / 4 ≤ Qb l := by linarith
    have hmono : Qb l ^ (-(B.h / 2)) ≤ (q / 4) ^ (-(B.h / 2)) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (div_pos hq (by norm_num)) hq4' (by linarith)
    have hsplit : (q / 4) ^ (-(B.h / 2)) = q ^ (-(B.h / 2)) * (4:ℝ) ^ (B.h / 2) := by
      rw [Real.div_rpow hq.le (by norm_num), Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 4), div_inv_eq_mul]
    have h42 : (4:ℝ) ^ (B.h / 2) ≤ 2 := by
      have h1 := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 4) (by linarith : B.h / 2 ≤ 1/2)
      have e : (4:ℝ) ^ (1/2 : ℝ) = 2 := by
        rw [← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, show (4:ℝ) = 2 * 2 by norm_num, Real.sqrt_mul_self (by norm_num)]
      linarith
    have hqp : 0 ≤ q ^ (-(B.h / 2)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    have hm2 : q ^ (-(B.h / 2)) * (4:ℝ) ^ (B.h / 2) ≤ q ^ (-(B.h / 2)) * 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h42 hqp
    rw [hkx]
    linarith
  
  have hgood : ∀ γ m ξ, goodX5 B l0 S γ m ξ →
      ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ 0 < qC B.h ξ ∧ qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 ∧
      ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB ∧ ActiveL4 B G γ ∧ l0 ≤ γ.1 ∧ 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 ∧
      qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 ∧ B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb ∧
      |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 ∧ |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 := by
    intro γ m ξ hP
    have hP' : ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ B.Xa < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < B.Xb ∧
        ξ ∈ tsupport (S.Aw γ m) := hP
    obtain ⟨hξ, -, -, hts⟩ := hP'
    have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
    obtain ⟨-, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7, a8⟩ := hs l0 (by omega) (1:ℝ) S.Aw hAw γ m ξ hξ hts
    have hB : ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB := ⟨hξ'.1, hξ'.2.1, by linarith [hξ'.2.2]⟩
    exact ⟨hξ, hξ'.1, hξ'.2.1, hqpos ξ hξ, by linarith [hξ'.2.2], hB, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7, a8⟩
  
  have M1 : CUB5 B (goodX5 B l0 S) k (fun _ _ η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun _ _ => 1) := by
    choose C1 hC1 using fun j => nb_qpow_v4 B (qsOf l0) (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) hok hSN hqs0 hqs1 j
    refine ⟨∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C1 j|, Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _),
      fun γ m ξ hP => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hξ, -, -, hq, -⟩ := hgood γ m ξ hP
    have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos η hη).ne')
    refine ⟨zero_le_one, ⟨_, hDo, hξ, hsm _ _ hf⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    have hjm : j ∈ Finset.range (k+1) := Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega)
    have hcl := hcastc ξ 1 _ (hf.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hξ)) j
    simp only [one_mul, abs_one] at hcl
    have hqp : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    calc NB B.h (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ
        ≤ NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) j ξ := hcl
      _ ≤ C1 j * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) := hC1 j ξ hξ
      _ ≤ |C1 j| * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hqp
      _ ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C1 j|) * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => abs_nonneg (C1 i)) hjm) hqp
      _ = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C1 j|) * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
  
  have M2 : CUB5 B (goodX5 B l0 S) k (fun _ _ η => (((η.1)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)) (-(1/2)) (fun _ _ => 1) := by
    choose C2 hC2 using fun j => inv_r_nb_v5 B hok j
    have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C2 j| := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    refine ⟨2 * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C2 j|, mul_nonneg zero_le_two hS0, fun γ m ξ hP => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hξ, hr, ht, hq, -, -, -, -, hlo, hhi, hX, -⟩ := hgood γ m ξ hP
    have hfs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (η.1)⁻¹) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      contDiff_fst.contDiffOn.inv (fun η hη => (hη.1).ne')
    refine ⟨zero_le_one, ⟨_, hDo, hξ, hsm _ _ hfs⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    have hjm : j ∈ Finset.range (k+1) := Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega)
    have hQ : 0 < Qb γ.1 := by unfold Qb; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
    have hsQ : 0 < Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hQ
    have hq4 : qC B.h ξ < 4 * Qb γ.1 := (div_lt_iff₀ hQ).1 hhi
    have ha := hsqb (qC B.h ξ) (Qb γ.1) hq hQ hq4
    have hid : (fun η : Cyl => (((η.1)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        fun η => (((Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1))⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) / η.1) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      funext η
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hsQ.ne', one_mul]
    have hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) / η.1) ξ :=
      contDiffAt_const.div contDiffAt_fst hr.ne'
    have hcl := hcastc ξ (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1))⁻¹ _ hg j
    rw [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 hsQ)] at hcl
    have hb := hC2 j γ.1 ξ hr ht hlo hX
    have hsum : |C2 j| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C2 j| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => abs_nonneg (C2 i)) hjm
    have hqp : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _

  have M3 : CUB5 B (goodX5 B l0 S) k (fun _ m _ => Complex.I * (m : ℂ)) 0 (fun _ _ => 1) := by
    obtain ⟨H, -, hH⟩ := hAw.1
    refine ⟨∑ m' ∈ H, |(m' : ℝ)|, Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _), fun γ m ξ hP => ?_⟩
    have hP' : ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ B.Xa < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < B.Xb ∧

      have h0 := hH γ m hm
      have hts := hP'.2.2.2

      simp at hts
    refine ⟨zero_le_one, ⟨Set.univ, isOpen_univ, Set.mem_univ _, contDiffOn_const⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    refine (hNBc ξ _ j).trans ?_
    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun m' : ℤ => |(m' : ℝ)|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) hmH
    have hnm : ‖Complex.I * (m : ℂ)‖ = |(m : ℝ)| := by
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_intCast]
    rw [hnm, Real.rpow_zero]
    calc |(m : ℝ)| ≤ ∑ m' ∈ H, |(m' : ℝ)| := hle
      _ = (∑ m' ∈ H, |(m' : ℝ)|) * 1 * 1 := by ring
  
  have M4 : ∀ i : Fin 3, CUB5 B (goodX5 B l0 S) k
      (fun γ _ η => (((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * nPhi5 B G γ η i : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (-(1/2) - B.h / 2) (fun _ ξ => SC B.h ξ) := by
    intro i

    have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C4 j| := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    refine ⟨8 * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C4 j|, mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hS0, fun γ m ξ hP => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hξ, -, -, hq, -, hξB, hact, hlγ, hlo, hhi, hX1, hX2, hxi, het⟩ := hgood γ m ξ hP
    obtain ⟨U, hUo, hξU, -, hUs, -, -⟩ := good_coeff_smooth_v5 B G γ ξ hok hξB hxi het
    have hSC : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by unfold SC; positivity
    refine ⟨hSC, ⟨U, hUo, hξU, hsm _ _ (contDiffOn_const.mul (hUs i))⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    have hjm : j ∈ Finset.range (k+1) := Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega)
    have hQ : 0 < Qb γ.1 := by unfold Qb; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
    have hq4 : qC B.h ξ < 4 * Qb γ.1 := (div_lt_iff₀ hQ).1 hhi
    have hQs : Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) = (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1))⁻¹ := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg hQ.le, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    have hκ0 : 0 ≤ (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) :=
      mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hQ.le _)
    have hqp : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2) - B.h / 2) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    have hκ : (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) ≤ 8 * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2) - B.h / 2) := by
      rw [hQs]
      have h1 := hkb (qC B.h ξ) γ.1 hq hq4
      have h2 := hsqb (qC B.h ξ) (Qb γ.1) hq hQ hq4
      have e : qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2) - B.h / 2) = qC B.h ξ ^ (-(B.h / 2)) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]
        congr 1
        ring
      rw [e]
      calc (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1))⁻¹
          ≤ (4 * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(B.h / 2))) * (2 * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) :=
            mul_le_mul h1 h2 (inv_nonneg.2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
              (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _))
        _ = 8 * (qC B.h ξ ^ (-(B.h / 2)) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) := by ring
    have hf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => nPhi5 B G γ η i) ξ := (hUs i).contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hξU)
    have hcl := hcastc ξ ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) _ hf j
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hκ0] at hcl
    have hb := hC4 j l0 (by omega) γ hact hlγ ξ hξ hlo hhi hX1 hX2 hxi het i
    have hsum : |C4 j| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C4 j| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => abs_nonneg (C4 i)) hjm
    have hb' : NB B.h (fun η => nPhi5 B G γ η i) j ξ ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C4 j|) * SC B.h ξ :=
      hb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ((le_abs_self _).trans hsum) hSC)
    calc NB B.h (fun η => (((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * nPhi5 B G γ η i : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ
        ≤ ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) * NB B.h (fun η => nPhi5 B G γ η i) j ξ := hcl
      _ ≤ (8 * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2) - B.h / 2)) * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C4 j|) * SC B.h ξ) :=
          mul_le_mul hκ hb' (hNBnn _ _ _) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hqp)
      _ = 8 * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C4 j|) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2) - B.h / 2) * SC B.h ξ := by ring
  exact ⟨M1, M2, M3, M4⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hok k
  have hh : 0 < B.h := hok.2.1.1
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  
  have nbdir : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl)
      (F : Cyl → V) (w : Cyl), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → ∀ k : ℕ,
      NB h (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm h ξ w)) k ξ ≤ ‖w‖ * NB h F (k + 1) ξ := by
    intro V _ _ h U ξ F w hU hξ hF k
    have hFd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) ξ :=
      (hF.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)
    have hcomp : (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm h ξ w)) =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ V (Lnorm h ξ w)) ∘ (fderiv ℝ F) := by
      funext η; rfl
    have hit : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm h ξ w)) ξ =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ V (Lnorm h ξ w)).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ F) ξ) := by
      rw [hcomp]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left _ hFd (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hNB0 : 0 ≤ NB h F (k + 1) ξ := norm_nonneg _
    unfold NB
    rw [hit]
    apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hNB0)
    intro m
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply]
    have key : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ F) ξ (fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m i))) (Lnorm h ξ w) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ))
          (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w) := by
      rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right]
      have e1 : Fin.init (fun i : Fin (k+1) => Lnorm h ξ (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i)) =
          fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m i) := by
        funext i
        simp [Fin.init, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      rw [e1]
      simp only [Fin.snoc_last]
    rw [key]
    have hprod : ∏ i : Fin (k+1), ‖Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i‖ =
        (∏ i : Fin k, ‖m i‖) * ‖w‖ := by
      rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
      simp [Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ *
          ∏ i : Fin (k+1), ‖Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i‖ :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ = ‖w‖ * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ *
          ∏ i : Fin k, ‖m i‖ := by rw [hprod]; ring
  
  have leib : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (U : Set Cyl) (n : ℕ),
      IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (g : Cyl → V), ContDiffOn ℝ n f U → ContDiffOn ℝ n g U →
      NB B.h (fun η => f η • g η) n ξ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h f i ξ * NB B.h g (n - i) ξ := by
    intro ξ V _ _ U n hU hξ f g hf hg
    unfold NB
    generalize Lnorm B.h ξ = L
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage L.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
    have hL0s : L 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
    have hsm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have hsmO : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact (hsm F hF).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
    have key' : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n →
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0 =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF i hi
      have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O
      have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
        hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
      have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + z)) i hs h0s
      have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i ξ 0
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0
          = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑L) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := e2
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [map_zero]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [e3]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
    have hfg : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun η => f η • g η) U := hf.smul hg
    have hl := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_smul_le (hsmO f hf) (hsmO g hg) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O
      (n := n) le_rfl
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => f (ξ + L y) • g (ξ + L y)) n hO h0O] at hl
    rw [← key' _ hfg n le_rfl]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => (fun η => f η • g η) (ξ + L z)) 0‖
        = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f (ξ + L y) • g (ξ + L y)) 0‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ _ := hl
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        have hik : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O,
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => g (ξ + L z)) (n - i) hO h0O,
          key' f hf i hik, key' g hg (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i)]
  
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  have hΩg : ∀ qs : ℝ, IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) := by
    intro qs
    have h4c := hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hm : MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hξ' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun ξ : Cyl => simScale B.h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1)) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
      h4c.comp (f := fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) (Continuous.continuousOn (by fun_prop)) hm
    have e : DomC B.h qs = {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ ({ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} ∩
        (fun ξ : Cyl => simScale B.h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1)) ⁻¹' Iio qs) := by
      ext ξ
      exact Iff.rfl
    rw [e]
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).inter
      (hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const) isOpen_Iio)
  have hqpg : ∀ qs : ℝ, ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h η := by
    intro qs η hη
    have hη' : 0 < η.1 ∧ η.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h η < qs := hη
    exact (hS.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith [hη'.2.1])).1
  have hJ : ∀ (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ), JpowL n (t • vrv) = (Lgc ^ n * t) • vrv := by
    intro n t
    have hD : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    simp only [JpowL, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', Jpow, vrv, vtv]
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.fst_add, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
      ring
    · simp only [Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.snd_add, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
      ring
  have hcoarse : ∀ h q : ℝ, 0 ≤ h → 0 < q → q ≤ 1 →
      Lgc ^ (coarseIdx h q) ≤ q ^ (-(drx h / 2 + h * kapS)) := by
    intro h q hh q0 hq1
    have hs2a : (1:ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := by
      have := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (show (1:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
      rwa [Real.sqrt_one] at this
    have hs2b : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := (Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)).mpr (by norm_num)
    have hL1 : 1 < Lgc := by unfold Lgc; linarith
    have hT1 : 1 < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; linarith
    have hL0 : 0 < Lgc := by linarith
    have hLl : 0 < Real.log Lgc := Real.log_pos hL1
    have hTl : 0 < Real.log Tgc := Real.log_pos hT1

  have hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv))
      (DomC B.h qs) :=
    contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk
      ((contDiffOn_const.mul h1').smul contDiffOn_const)))
  have ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => dR B.h P η) (DomC B.h qs) := hfd.clm_apply hw
  have hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => dZ P η) (DomC B.h qs) :=
    hfd.clm_apply (contDiffOn_const (c := ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))))
  have hvU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ![dR B.h P η, 0, dZ P η]) (DomC B.h qs) := by
    refine contDiffOn_pi.2 (fun i => ?_)
    fin_cases i
    · exact ha
    · exact contDiffOn_const
    · exact hc
  
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ, T = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), NB B.h f i ξ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hT0 : 0 ≤ T := by rw [hT]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
  have hNT : ∀ j, j ≤ k + 1 → NB B.h f j ξ ≤ T := fun j hj => by
    rw [hT]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => NB B.h f i ξ) (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj))
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ Q : ℝ, Q = qC B.h ξ ^ (-(B.h * kapS)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hQ1 : 1 ≤ Q := by
    rw [hQ]
    exact Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hq0 hq1
      (neg_nonpos.mpr (mul_nonneg hh.le (by unfold kapS; norm_num)))
  have hy0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ ^ (-2 * Aex B.h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _
  obtain ⟨Pi', hPi⟩ : ∃ Pi' : ℝ, Pi' = 2 ^ (k + 1) * (Cr * qC B.h ξ ^ (-2 * Aex B.h)) * T :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPi0 : 0 ≤ Pi' := by
    rw [hPi]; exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (mul_nonneg hCr0 hy0.le)) hT0
  
  have hNP : ∀ j, j ≤ k + 1 → NB B.h P j ξ ≤ Pi' := by
    intro j hj
    have h1 := hLB ξ (DomC B.h qs) j hΩo hξ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-2 * Aex B.h)) f
      (Cr * qC B.h ξ ^ (-2 * Aex B.h)) T (hpw _) hf
      (fun i hi => hCr ξ hξ1 hq1 hq0 i (by omega)) (fun i hi => hNT i (by omega))
    rw [hPs]
    refine h1.trans ?_
    rw [hPi]
    have h2 : (2:ℝ) ^ j ≤ 2 ^ (k + 1) := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hj
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (mul_nonneg hCr0 hy0.le)) hT0
  have hSP : ∀ i, i ≤ k → ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 2), NB B.h P j ξ ≤ ((k:ℝ) + 2) * Pi' := by
    intro i hi
    calc ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 2), NB B.h P j ξ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 2), Pi' :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j hj => hNP j (by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hj; omega))
      _ = ((i:ℝ) + 2) * Pi' := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]; push_cast; ring
      _ ≤ ((k:ℝ) + 2) * Pi' := by
          have : (i:ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hi
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hPi0
  
  have hs0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq0
  have hA : ∀ i, i ≤ k → NB B.h (fun η => dR B.h P η) i ξ ≤
      (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))⁻¹ * Mm * Q * (((k:ℝ) + 2) * Pi') := by
    intro i hi
    have h1 := hMf i qs P ξ hqs hPU hξ hX1 hX2
    rw [← hQ] at h1
    have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 2), NB B.h P j ξ :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _)
    have h2 : Mf i * Q * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 2), NB B.h P j ξ ≤
        Mm * Q * (((k:ℝ) + 2) * Pi') :=
      mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hMle i hi) (by linarith)) (hSP i hi) hS0
        (mul_nonneg hMm0 (by linarith))
    calc NB B.h (fun η => dR B.h P η) i ξ
        = (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * NB B.h (dR B.h P) i ξ) := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs0.ne', one_mul]
      _ ≤ (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))⁻¹ * (Mm * Q * (((k:ℝ) + 2) * Pi')) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h1.trans h2) (inv_nonneg.mpr hs0.le)
      _ = _ := by ring
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, t = qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by rw [ht]; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _
  obtain ⟨u3, hu3⟩ : ∃ u3 : Cyl, u3 = ((0:ℝ), t, (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have e0 : ∀ v : Cyl, (Lnorm B.h ξ v).1 = Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * v.1 := by
    intro v; simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
  have e1 : ∀ v : Cyl, (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.1 = qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * v.2.1 := by
    intro v; simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
  have e2 : ∀ v : Cyl, (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.1 = qC B.h ξ * v.2.2.1 := by
    intro v; simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
  have e3 : ∀ v : Cyl, (Lnorm B.h ξ v).2.2.2 = JpowL (-coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) v.2.2.2 := by
    intro v; rfl
  have hLu3 : Lnorm B.h ξ u3 = ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
    refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_))
    · rw [e0, hu3]; simp
    · rw [e1, hu3]
      show qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) * t = 1
      rw [ht, Real.rpow_neg hq0.le]
      exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _).ne'
    · rw [e2, hu3]; simp
    · rw [e3, hu3]
      exact map_zero _
  have hnu3 : ‖u3‖ = t := by
    rw [hu3, Prod.norm_mk, Prod.norm_mk, Prod.norm_mk]
    simp only [norm_zero, max_self]
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht0, max_eq_left ht0.le, max_eq_right ht0.le]
  have hcfun : (fun η => dZ P η) = fun η => fderiv ℝ P η (Lnorm B.h ξ u3) := by
    funext η; rw [hLu3]; rfl
  have hC : ∀ i, i ≤ k → NB B.h (fun η => dZ P η) i ξ ≤ t * Pi' := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hcfun]
    have h1 := nbdir B.h (DomC B.h qs) ξ P u3 hΩo hξ hPU i
    rw [hnu3] at h1
    exact h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hNP (i + 1) (by omega)) ht0.le)
  
  have hV : ∀ i, i ≤ k → NB B.h (fun η => ![dR B.h P η, 0, dZ P η]) i ξ ≤
      (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))⁻¹ * Mm * Q * (((k:ℝ) + 2) * Pi') + t * Pi' := fun i hi =>
    (hvec (dR B.h P) (dZ P) ξ i (ha.contDiffAt hn) (hc.contDiffAt hn)).trans
      (add_le_add (hA i hi) (hC i hi))
  have hL := hLB ξ (DomC B.h qs) k hΩo hξ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2))
    (fun η => ![dR B.h P η, 0, dZ P η]) (Cs * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2))
    ((Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))⁻¹ * Mm * Q * (((k:ℝ) + 2) * Pi') + t * Pi') (hpw _) hvU
    (fun i hi => hCs ξ hξ1 hq1 hq0 i hi) hV
  rw [← hQ, ← hT]
  refine hL.trans ?_
  
  have ex1 : qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))⁻¹ *
      qC B.h ξ ^ (-2 * Aex B.h) = 1 := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_neg hq0.le, ← Real.rpow_add hq0, ← Real.rpow_add hq0]
    have : 2 * Aex B.h + 1/2 + -(1/2) + -2 * Aex B.h = 0 := by ring
    rw [this, Real.rpow_zero]
  have ex2 : qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * t * qC B.h ξ ^ (-2 * Aex B.h) ≤ Q := by
    rw [ht, ← Real.rpow_add hq0, ← Real.rpow_add hq0]
    have : 2 * Aex B.h + 1/2 + -(1/2 - B.h) + -2 * Aex B.h = B.h := by ring
    rw [this]
    exact (Real.rpow_le_one hq0.le hq1 hh.le).trans hQ1
  have hN0 : 0 ≤ 2 ^ k * 2 ^ (k + 1) * Cs * Cr * T :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hCs0) hCr0) hT0
  calc 2 ^ k * (Cs * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) *
        ((Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))⁻¹ * Mm * Q * (((k:ℝ) + 2) * Pi') + t * Pi')
      = 2 ^ k * 2 ^ (k + 1) * Cs * Cr * T *
          (((k:ℝ) + 2) * Mm * Q * (qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))⁻¹ *
            qC B.h ξ ^ (-2 * Aex B.h)) +
          qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * t * qC B.h ξ ^ (-2 * Aex B.h)) := by
        rw [hPi]; ring
    _ ≤ 2 ^ k * 2 ^ (k + 1) * Cs * Cr * T * (((k:ℝ) + 2) * Mm * Q * 1 + Q) := by
        rw [ex1]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add le_rfl ex2) hN0
    _ = 2 ^ k * 2 ^ (k + 1) * Cs * Cr * (((k:ℝ) + 2) * Mm + 1) * Q * T := by ring
