signature.name: inWg5_dR_class_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (β : ℝ) (a : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β a → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β - 1 / (2 * B.h) - kapS) (fun γ m ξ => dR B.h (a γ m) ξ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨ls, hS⟩ := slow_deriv_struct_v5 B G hok hG
  refine ⟨ls, fun l0 hl0 β a ha => ?_⟩
  have hSP : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  have hh : 0 < B.h := hok.2.1.1
  have hh0 : B.h ≠ 0 := hh.ne'
  have hu : B.h * (1 / (2 * B.h)) = 1 / 2 := by field_simp
  have hexp : B.h * (-(1 / (2 * B.h)) - kapS) = -(1/2 + B.h * kapS) := by
    linear_combination (-1:ℝ) * hu
  have hq1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (by simp)
  have hq0 : 0 < qsOf l0 := by
    show (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ))
    exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hDo : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have h4c := hSP.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hm : MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hξ' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun ξ : Cyl => simScale B.h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1)) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
      h4c.comp (f := fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) (Continuous.continuousOn (by fun_prop)) hm
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) = {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ ({ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} ∩
        (fun ξ : Cyl => simScale B.h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1)) ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0)) := by
      ext ξ
      exact Iff.rfl
    rw [e]
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).inter
      (hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const) isOpen_Iio)
  
  have he1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv))
      {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} := by
    have hfst : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => η.1) {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} := contDiffOn_fst
    have hpow : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} :=
      hfst.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => ne_of_gt hη)
    have hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} :=
      (contDiffOn_const.mul hpow).smul contDiffOn_const
    exact contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk hs))
  obtain ⟨_S1, S2, S3, S4⟩ := hS l0 hl0 β a
    (fun η : Cyl => ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)) ha he1 (fun ξ c => rfl)
  
  have BR : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      dR B.h (a γ m) ξ = (fun i => dR B.h (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ) := by
    intro γ m ξ hξ
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (a γ m) ξ :=
      ((ha.2.1 γ m).contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hξ)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    funext i
    have h1 := (hasFDerivAt_pi'.1 hd.hasFDerivAt) i
    show fderiv ℝ (a γ m) ξ _ i = fderiv ℝ (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ _
    rw [h1.fderiv]
    rfl
  have C1 : ∃ H : Finset ℤ, (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧ ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → (fun γ m ξ => dR B.h (a γ m) ξ) γ m = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨H, hH0, hHa⟩ := ha.1
    refine ⟨H, hH0, fun γ m hm => ?_⟩
    funext ξ
    show dR B.h (a γ m) ξ = 0
    rw [hHa γ m hm]
    simp [dR]
  have C2 : ∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((fun γ m ξ => dR B.h (a γ m) ξ) γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    fun γ m => (S2 γ m).congr (fun ξ hξ => BR γ m ξ hξ)
  have C3 : ∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ c, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c →
      (fun γ m ξ => dR B.h (a γ m) ξ) γ m (shY ξ c) = (fun γ m ξ => dR B.h (a γ m) ξ) γ m ξ := by
    intro γ m ξ hξ c hc
    have hsh : shY ξ c ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := hξ
    show dR B.h (a γ m) (shY ξ c) = dR B.h (a γ m) ξ
    rw [BR γ m _ hsh, BR γ m ξ hξ]
    exact S3 γ m ξ hξ c hc
  have C4 : ∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → (fun γ m ξ => dR B.h (a γ m) ξ) γ m ξ ≠ 0 →
      SuppW B G γ ξ := by
    intro γ m ξ hξ hne
    apply S4 γ m ξ hξ
    intro h0
    apply hne
    show dR B.h (a γ m) ξ = 0
    rw [BR γ m ξ hξ]
    exact h0
  have C5 : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
      NB B.h ((fun γ m ξ => dR B.h (a γ m) ξ) γ m) k ξ ≤
        M * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (-(1 / (2 * B.h)) - kapS)) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), NB B.h (a γ m) i ξ := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := slow_deriv_nb_v5 B hok k
    refine ⟨M, fun γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
    have hev : (fun η => dR B.h (a γ m) η) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] (fun η i => dR B.h (fun η' => a γ m η' i) η) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hDo.mem_nhds hξ) (fun η hη => BR γ m η hη)
    have hb := (hM (qsOf l0) (a γ m) ξ hq0 hq1 (ha.2.1 γ m) hξ hX1 hX2).2.1
    have e1 : NB B.h (fun η => dR B.h (a γ m) η) k ξ =
        NB B.h (fun η i => dR B.h (fun η' => a γ m η' i) η) k ξ := by
      unfold NB
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
    show NB B.h (fun η => dR B.h (a γ m) η) k ξ ≤
        M * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (-(1 / (2 * B.h)) - kapS)) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), NB B.h (a γ m) i ξ
    rw [e1, hexp]
    exact hb
  have hfin := inWg5_of_nb_dom_v5 B G (qsOf l0) β (-(1 / (2 * B.h)) - kapS) a
    (fun γ m ξ => dR B.h (a γ m) ξ) hok ha C1 C2 C3 C4 C5
  have e2 : β + (-(1 / (2 * B.h)) - kapS) = β - 1 / (2 * B.h) - kapS := by ring
  rw [e2] at hfin
  exact hfin

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (α : ℝ) (a : WC) (e : Cyl → Cyl), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ e {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} → (∀ (ξ : Cyl) (c : ℝ × ℝ), e (shY ξ c) = e ξ) → (∃ H : Finset ℤ, (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧ ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (i : Fin 3), fderiv ℝ (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ (e ξ) = 0) ∧ (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ i => fderiv ℝ (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ (e ξ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) ∧ (∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ c, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c → (fun i => fderiv ℝ (fun η => a γ m η i) (shY ξ c) (e (shY ξ c))) = (fun i => fderiv ℝ (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ (e ξ))) ∧ (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → (fun i => fderiv ℝ (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ (e ξ)) ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ)

subgoal_signatures.name: slow_deriv_nb_v5

    rw [h.fderiv_eq]
  have dZc : ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℂ), f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] g → dZ f ξ = dZ g ξ := by
    intro f g h
    unfold dZ
    rw [h.fderiv_eq]
  have E3 : ∀ i : Fin 3, dR B.h (fun η => dR B.h (fun η' => viscA5 B w γ m η' i) η) ξ =
      dR B.h (fun η => dR B.h (viscA5 B w γ m) η) ξ i := by
    intro i
    have hev : (fun η => dR B.h (fun η' => viscA5 B w γ m η' i) η) =ᶠ[nhds ξ]
        (fun η => dR B.h (viscA5 B w γ m) η i) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hDo.mem_nhds hξ) (fun η hη => (swap1 _ η (hdiff η hη) i).1)
    rw [dRc _ _ hev]
    exact (swap1 _ ξ hdRa i).1
  have E4 : ∀ i : Fin 3, dZ (fun η => dZ (fun η' => viscA5 B w γ m η' i) η) ξ =
      dZ (fun η => dZ (viscA5 B w γ m) η) ξ i := by
    intro i

        (fun η => dZ (viscA5 B w γ m) η i) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hDo.mem_nhds hξ) (fun η hη => (swap1 _ η (hdiff η hη) i).2)
    rw [dZc _ _ hev]
    exact (swap1 _ ξ hdZa i).2
  
  have hQpos : 0 < Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _)
  have hKpos : 0 < kb B.h γ.1 := by
    unfold kb epsb
    exact Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos
      (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _) _) _)
  have hr0 : (ξ.1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hr.ne'
  have hQ0 : ((Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hQpos.ne'
  have hK0 : ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hKpos.ne'
  have hv1 : vDR5 B (viscA5 B w) γ m = fun η => dR B.h (viscA5 B w γ m) η := rfl
  have hv2 : vDZ5 (viscA5 B w) γ m = fun η => dZ (viscA5 B w γ m) η := rfl

    vD5, vInt5, vCr5, hv1, hv2, smul_eq_mul, E1, E2, E3, E4]
  simp only [vDR5, vDZ5]

  fin_cases i
  all_goals
    simp only [crossC, nPhi5, DrC, DzC, pang5, RC, dvF5, smul_eq_mul, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one,
      Fin.reduceFinMk, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two,
      Matrix.head_cons, Pi.smul_apply, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail, Function.comp_apply,
      Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.succ_one_eq_two]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∀ (c : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h 1 → 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb l → qC B.h ξ / Qb l < 4 → B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ → (ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((qC B.h η ^ c : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => ((qC B.h η ^ c : ℝ) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ c) ∧ (ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((Real.sqrt (Qb l) / η.1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => ((Real.sqrt (Qb l) / η.1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤ C) ∧ NB B.h (fun _ : Cyl => (((Real.sqrt (Qb l))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤ 2 * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ)) ∧ NB B.h (fun _ : Cyl => ((((kb B.h l : ℕ) : ℝ)) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤ 4 * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(B.h / 2))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hok c k
  have hh0 : 0 < B.h := hok.2.1.1
  have hh1 : B.h < 1/100 := hok.2.1.2.1
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  obtain ⟨hDo, hqC, hqpos, -, -, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B 1 hok
  obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := tn_qpow_normalized_v5 B.h hh0 hh1 hS c k
  obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := inv_r_nb_v5 B hok k
  refine ⟨max C1 C2, fun l ξ hξ hlo hhi hX => ?_⟩
  have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < 1 := hξ
  have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
  have hQ : 0 < Qb l := by unfold Qb; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hQ1 : Qb l ≤ 1 := by
    unfold Qb; exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (by simp)
  have hq4 : qC B.h ξ < 4 * Qb l := (div_lt_iff₀ hQ).1 hhi
  have hg1 : ‖(Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun x => by
      rw [Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, Complex.norm_real, one_mul])
  have hcast : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ ∧
      NB B.h (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤ NB B.h f k ξ := by
    intro f hf
    have hcomp : (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) = ⇑(Complex.ofRealCLM) ∘ f := by
      funext η; simp [Complex.ofRealCLM_apply]
    rw [hcomp]
    refine ⟨(Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ).contDiff.comp_contDiffAt ξ hf, ?_⟩
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (⇑(Complex.ofRealCLM) ∘ f) ξ =
        (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ).compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left Complex.ofRealCLM hf
        (i := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    unfold NB
    rw [e1]
    have e2 : ((Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
        (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)) := by
      ext v
      rfl
    rw [e2]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)‖ *
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hg1
  have hNBc : ∀ (z : ℂ), NB B.h (fun _ : Cyl => z) k ξ ≤ ‖z‖ := by
    intro z
    unfold NB
    refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk0 | hk'
    · subst hk0; simp
    · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne hk'.ne']; simp
  
  have hf1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c) ξ :=
    (hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos η hη).ne')).contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hξ)
  obtain ⟨hcd1, hnb1⟩ := hcast _ hf1
  have cl1 : NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => ((qC B.h η ^ c : ℝ) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤ max C1 C2 * qC B.h ξ ^ c :=
    hnb1.trans ((hC1 ξ hξ'.2.1 hξ'.2.2.le).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _)))
  
  have hf2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb l) / η.1) ξ :=
    contDiffAt_const.div contDiffAt_fst hξ'.1.ne'
  obtain ⟨hcd2, hnb2⟩ := hcast _ hf2
  have cl2 : NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => ((Real.sqrt (Qb l) / η.1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤ max C1 C2 :=
    hnb2.trans ((hC2 l ξ hξ'.1 hξ'.2.1 hlo hX).trans (le_max_right _ _))
  
  have cl3 : NB B.h (fun _ : Cyl => (((Real.sqrt (Qb l))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤
      2 * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ)) := by
    refine (hNBc _).trans ?_
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))]
    have hsq : 0 < Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hq
    have h4 : Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (Qb l) := by
      have e4 : Real.sqrt (4 * Qb l) = 2 * Real.sqrt (Qb l) := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num), show (4:ℝ) = 2 * 2 by norm_num,
          Real.sqrt_mul_self (by norm_num)]
      rw [← e4]
      exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hq4.le
    have e : qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ)) = (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))⁻¹ := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg hq.le, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    rw [e]
    calc (Real.sqrt (Qb l))⁻¹ = 2 * (2 * Real.sqrt (Qb l))⁻¹ := by
          rw [mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ two_ne_zero, one_mul]
      _ ≤ 2 * (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (inv_anti₀ hsq h4) (by norm_num)
  
  have cl4 : NB B.h (fun _ : Cyl => ((((kb B.h l : ℕ) : ℝ)) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤
      4 * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(B.h / 2)) := by
    refine (hNBc _).trans ?_
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
    have hkx : (kb B.h l : ℝ) = (⌈Qb l ^ (-(B.h / 2))⌉₊ : ℝ) := by
      unfold kb epsb
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul hQ.le]
      congr 3
      ring
    have hx1 : 1 ≤ Qb l ^ (-(B.h / 2)) :=
      Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hQ hQ1 (by linarith)
    have hceil : (⌈Qb l ^ (-(B.h / 2))⌉₊ : ℝ) < Qb l ^ (-(B.h / 2)) + 1 :=
      Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by linarith)
    have hq4' : qC B.h ξ / 4 ≤ Qb l := by linarith
    have hmono : Qb l ^ (-(B.h / 2)) ≤ (qC B.h ξ / 4) ^ (-(B.h / 2)) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity) hq4' (by linarith)
    have hsplit : (qC B.h ξ / 4) ^ (-(B.h / 2)) = qC B.h ξ ^ (-(B.h / 2)) * (4:ℝ) ^ (B.h / 2) := by
      rw [Real.div_rpow hq.le (by norm_num), Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 4), div_inv_eq_mul]
    have h42 : (4:ℝ) ^ (B.h / 2) ≤ 2 := by
      have h1 := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 4) (by linarith : B.h / 2 ≤ 1/2)
      have e : (4:ℝ) ^ (1/2 : ℝ) = 2 := by
        rw [← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, show (4:ℝ) = 2 * 2 by norm_num, Real.sqrt_mul_self (by norm_num)]
      linarith
    have hqp : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (-(B.h / 2)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    have hm2 : qC B.h ξ ^ (-(B.h / 2)) * (4:ℝ) ^ (B.h / 2) ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (-(B.h / 2)) * 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h42 hqp
    rw [hkx]
    linarith
  exact ⟨⟨hcd1, cl1⟩, ⟨hcd2, cl2⟩, cl3, cl4⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have nbdirR : ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (F : Cyl → ℝ) (w : Cyl), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → ∀ k : ℕ,
      NB h (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm h ξ w)) k ξ ≤ ‖w‖ * NB h F (k + 1) ξ := by
    intro h U ξ F w hU hξ hF k
    have hFd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) ξ :=
      (hF.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)
    have hcomp : (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm h ξ w)) =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ (Lnorm h ξ w)) ∘ (fderiv ℝ F) := by
      funext η; rfl
    have hit : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm h ξ w)) ξ =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ (Lnorm h ξ w)).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ F) ξ) := by
      rw [hcomp]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left _ hFd (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hNB0 : 0 ≤ NB h F (k + 1) ξ := norm_nonneg _
    unfold NB
    rw [hit]
    apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hNB0)
    intro m
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply]
    have key : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ F) ξ (fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m i))) (Lnorm h ξ w) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ))
          (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w) := by
      rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right]
      have e1 : Fin.init (fun i : Fin (k+1) => Lnorm h ξ (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i)) =
          fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m i) := by
        funext i
        simp [Fin.init, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      rw [e1]
      simp only [Fin.snoc_last]
    rw [key]
    have hprod : ∏ i : Fin (k+1), ‖Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i‖ =
        (∏ i : Fin k, ‖m i‖) * ‖w‖ := by
      rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
      simp [Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ *
          ∏ i : Fin (k+1), ‖Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i‖ :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ = ‖w‖ * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ *
          ∏ i : Fin k, ‖m i‖ := by rw [hprod]; ring
  
  have nb_dR_open_real_v5 : ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ (U : Set Cyl) (F : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl), IsOpen U → (∀ η ∈ U, 0 < η.1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → ξ ∈ U → 0 < qC B.h ξ → qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 → B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb → Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * NB B.h (dR B.h F) k ξ ≤ M * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(B.h * kapS)) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), NB B.h F i ξ := by
    intro B hok k
    have hh : 0 < B.h := hok.2.1.1
    have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
    have hJ : ∀ (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ), JpowL n (t • vrv) = (Lgc ^ n * t) • vrv := by
      intro n t
      have hD : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      simp only [JpowL, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', Jpow, vrv, vtv]
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
      · simp only [Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.fst_add, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
        ring
      · simp only [Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.snd_add, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
        ring
    have hcoarse : ∀ h q : ℝ, 0 ≤ h → 0 < q → q ≤ 1 →
        Lgc ^ (coarseIdx h q) ≤ q ^ (-(drx h / 2 + h * kapS)) := by
      intro h q hh q0 hq1
      have hs2a : (1:ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := by
        have := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (show (1:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
        rwa [Real.sqrt_one] at this
      have hs2b : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := (Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)).mpr (by norm_num)
      have hL1 : 1 < Lgc := by unfold Lgc; linarith
      have hT1 : 1 < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; linarith
      have hL0 : 0 < Lgc := by linarith
      have hLl : 0 < Real.log Lgc := Real.log_pos hL1
      have hTl : 0 < Real.log Tgc := Real.log_pos hT1
      have hl2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
      obtain ⟨x, hxdef⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = Real.logb 2 (1 / q) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by
        rw [hxdef]; exact Real.logb_nonneg one_lt_two (one_le_one_div q0 hq1)
      have hx : x * Real.log 2 = -Real.log q := by
        rw [hxdef, Real.logb, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hl2.ne', one_div, Real.log_inv]
      have hb : bandOf q = ⌈x⌉₊ := by rw [hxdef]; rfl
      have hR : 0 ≤ (1 + h) * x * Real.log 2 / Real.log Tgc :=
        div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hx0) hl2.le) hTl.le
      have hstar : ((coarseIdx h q : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ (1 + h) * x * Real.log 2 / Real.log Tgc := by
        obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ : ∃ l : ℕ, l = bandOf q - 4 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
        have hc : coarseIdx h q = bandIdx h l := by rw [hl]; rfl
        rw [hc]
        unfold bandIdx
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos l with h0 | hpos
        · have e : Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l:ℝ) ^ 2)) = 0 := by
            rw [h0]; simp
          rw [e, Int.floor_zero, Int.cast_zero]
          exact hR
        · have hl1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (l:ℝ) ^ 2 := one_le_pow₀ (by exact_mod_cast hpos)
          have hA : 0 < (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _
          have hAl : 0 < (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / (l:ℝ) ^ 2 := div_pos hA (by linarith)
          have h1 := Int.floor_le (Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / (l:ℝ) ^ 2))
          have h2 := Real.logb_le_logb_of_le hT1 hAl (div_le_self hA.le hl1)
          have h3 : Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ))) =
              (1 + h) * l * Real.log 2 / Real.log Tgc := by
            rw [Real.logb_rpow_eq_mul_logb_of_pos two_pos, ← Real.log_div_log]
            ring
          have hlx : (l:ℝ) ≤ x := by
            have e1 : l + 4 = bandOf q := by omega
            have e2 : ((⌈x⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) < x + 1 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one hx0
            have e3 : ((l:ℝ) + 4) = ((⌈x⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) := by rw [← hb]; exact_mod_cast e1
            linarith
          have h4 : (1 + h) * l * Real.log 2 / Real.log Tgc ≤
              (1 + h) * x * Real.log 2 / Real.log Tgc := by
            rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv]
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (inv_nonneg.mpr hTl.le)
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hl2.le
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlx (by linarith)
          linarith
      have hd : drx h / 2 + h * kapS = (1 + h) * (Real.log Lgc / Real.log Tgc) := by
        unfold drx; ring
      have hlq : Real.log q = -(x * Real.log 2) := by rw [hx]; ring
      rw [← Real.rpow_intCast, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hL0, Real.rpow_def_of_pos q0, Real.exp_le_exp,
        hd, hlq]
      calc Real.log Lgc * ((coarseIdx h q : ℤ) : ℝ)
          ≤ Real.log Lgc * ((1 + h) * x * Real.log 2 / Real.log Tgc) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstar hLl.le
        _ = -(x * Real.log 2) * -((1 + h) * (Real.log Lgc / Real.log Tgc)) := by ring
    have hshell : ∀ (d e q r X L Xa Xb a : ℝ) (j : ℕ), a = d - 1 - (j:ℝ) → 0 < q → 0 < Xa → Xa < X →
        X < Xb → 0 < r → r ^ 2 = 2 * q * X → 0 ≤ L → L ≤ q ^ (-(d / 2 + e)) →
        Real.sqrt q * (L * Real.sqrt q ^ j * r ^ a) ≤
          ((2 * Xa) ^ (a / 2) + (2 * Xb) ^ (a / 2)) * q ^ (-e) := by
      intro d e q r X L Xa Xb a j ha hq0 hXa' hX1 hX2 hr0 hr2 hL0 hL
      have hr : r ^ a = (2 * X) ^ (a / 2) * q ^ (a / 2) := by
        calc r ^ a = r ^ ((2:ℝ) * (a / 2)) := by congr 1; ring
          _ = (r ^ (2:ℝ)) ^ (a / 2) := Real.rpow_mul hr0.le _ _
          _ = (2 * X * q) ^ (a / 2) := by
              congr 1
              rw [Real.rpow_two, hr2]
              ring
          _ = (2 * X) ^ (a / 2) * q ^ (a / 2) := Real.mul_rpow (by linarith) hq0.le
      have hsq : Real.sqrt q = q ^ (1/2:ℝ) := Real.sqrt_eq_rpow q
      have hsqj : Real.sqrt q ^ j = q ^ ((j:ℝ) / 2) := by
        rw [hsq, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hq0.le]
        congr 1
        ring
      have e1 : q ^ (1/2:ℝ) * q ^ ((j:ℝ) / 2) * q ^ (a / 2) = q ^ (d / 2) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hq0, ← Real.rpow_add hq0]
        congr 1
        rw [ha]
        ring
      have key : Real.sqrt q * (L * Real.sqrt q ^ j * r ^ a) =
          (2 * X) ^ (a / 2) * (L * q ^ (d / 2)) := by
        rw [hr, hsqj, hsq, ← e1]
        ring
      have hLq : L * q ^ (d / 2) ≤ q ^ (-e) := by
        calc L * q ^ (d / 2) ≤ q ^ (-(d / 2 + e)) * q ^ (d / 2) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)
          _ = q ^ (-e) := by
              rw [← Real.rpow_add hq0]
              congr 1
              ring
      have hE : (2 * X) ^ (a / 2) ≤ (2 * Xa) ^ (a / 2) + (2 * Xb) ^ (a / 2) := by
        rcases le_or_gt 0 (a / 2) with hs | hs
        · have h1 := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * X) (by linarith : 2 * X ≤ 2 * Xb) hs
          have h2 := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * Xa) (a / 2)
          linarith
        · have h1 := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * Xa)
            (by linarith : 2 * Xa ≤ 2 * X) hs.le
          have h2 := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * Xb) (a / 2)
          linarith
      rw [key]
      calc (2 * X) ^ (a / 2) * (L * q ^ (d / 2)) ≤ (2 * X) ^ (a / 2) * q ^ (-e) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLq (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
        _ ≤ ((2 * Xa) ^ (a / 2) + (2 * Xb) ^ (a / 2)) * q ^ (-e) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hE (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)
    have hphi : ∀ (p : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), 0 < ξ.1 →
        NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ p) j ξ ≤
          |Polynomial.eval p (descPochhammer ℝ j)| * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) ^ j * ξ.1 ^ (p - (j:ℝ)) := by
      intro p j ξ hr
      obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ, P = ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
        ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hPapp : ∀ η : Cyl, P η = η.1 := by intro η; rw [hP]; rfl
      have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
        (contDiffOn_id (s := Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))).rpow_const_of_ne (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
      have hU : IsOpen (⇑P ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) := isOpen_Ioi.preimage P.continuous
      have hPξ : P ξ ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) := by rw [hPapp]; exact hr
      have hξU : ξ ∈ ⇑P ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) := hPξ
      have hfeq : (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ p) = (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) ∘ ⇑P := by
        funext η; simp only [Function.comp, hPapp]
      have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ p) ξ =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) ξ.1).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => P) := by
        rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ p) j hU hξU, hfeq,
          ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right P hg (uniqueDiffOn_Ioi 0) hU.uniqueDiffOn
            hPξ (i := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top),
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j isOpen_Ioi hPξ, hPapp]
      have e0 : ∀ v : Cyl, (Lnorm B.h ξ v).1 = Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * v.1 := by
        intro v; simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
      have hPL : ‖P.comp (Lnorm B.h ξ)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := by
        refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (fun v => ?_)
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hPapp, e0 v, norm_mul,
          Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_fst_le v) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      have hD : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) ξ.1‖ =
          |Polynomial.eval p (descPochhammer ℝ j)| * ξ.1 ^ (p - (j:ℝ)) := by
        rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate,
          Real.iter_deriv_rpow_const, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr _)]
      unfold NB
      rw [e1]
      have hcomp : ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) ξ.1).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => P)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) ξ.1).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => P.comp (Lnorm B.h ξ)) := by
        ext m; rfl
      rw [hcomp]
      have hprod : ∏ _i : Fin j, ‖P.comp (Lnorm B.h ξ)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) ^ j := by
        rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hPL j
      calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) ξ.1‖ * ∏ _i : Fin j, ‖P.comp (Lnorm B.h ξ)‖ :=
            ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun x : ℝ => x ^ p) ξ.1‖ * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) ^ j :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = _ := by rw [hD]; ring
    have leib : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (U : Set Cyl) (n : ℕ),
        IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (g : Cyl → V), ContDiffOn ℝ n f U → ContDiffOn ℝ n g U →
        NB B.h (fun η => f η • g η) n ξ ≤
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h f i ξ * NB B.h g (n - i) ξ := by
      intro ξ V _ _ U n hU hξ f g hf hg
      unfold NB
      generalize Lnorm B.h ξ = L
      obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hs : IsOpen s := by
        rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
      have hO : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage L.continuous
      have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
        rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
      have hL0s : L 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
      have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
      have hsm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
          ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
        intro W _ _ F hF
        exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
          (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
      have hsmO : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
          ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by

subgoal_signatures.name: nb_real_algebra_v5

    rw [hsplit, iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply (hLcc.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      (hWc.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
    exact norm_sub_le _ _
  
  have hDL : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (⇑Lc) ξ‖ ≤ ‖Lc‖ := by
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, k = j + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (⇑Lc) = fun _ => Lc := funext (fun y => Lc.fderiv)
    rw [hfd]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with hj | hj
    · subst hj
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]
    · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (by omega) Lc]
      simp
  have hLcn : ‖Lc‖ ≤ ‖A1‖ + ‖A2‖ := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity) (fun v => ?_)
    rw [hLc]
    have h1 : ‖v.2.1‖ ≤ ‖v‖ := (norm_fst_le v.2).trans (norm_snd_le v)
    have h2 : ‖v.1‖ ≤ ‖v‖ := norm_fst_le v
    calc ‖A1 * v.2.1 + A2 * v.1‖ ≤ ‖A1 * v.2.1‖ + ‖A2 * v.1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖A1‖ * ‖v.2.1‖ + ‖A2‖ * ‖v.1‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
      _ ≤ ‖A1‖ * ‖v‖ + ‖A2‖ * ‖v‖ :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (norm_nonneg _))
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (norm_nonneg _))
      _ = (‖A1‖ + ‖A2‖) * ‖v‖ := by ring
  have hD1 : Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2 - B.h) * epsb B.h γ.1 = Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2:ℝ) := by
    rw [epsb, ← Real.rpow_add hQ0]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hQhalf : Qb γ.1 ≤ Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2:ℝ) := by
    have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hQ0 hQ1 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) ≤ 1)
    rwa [Real.rpow_one] at this
  have hD1pos : 0 < Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2 - B.h) * epsb B.h γ.1 := by
    rw [hD1]; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ0 _
  have hD1inv : (Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2 - B.h) * epsb B.h γ.1)⁻¹ ≤ (Qb γ.1)⁻¹ := by
    rw [hD1]; exact inv_anti₀ hQ0 hQhalf
  have hsq : Qb γ.1 ≤ Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) := by
    rw [Real.le_sqrt hQ0.le hQ0.le, sq]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_left hQ0.le hQ1
  have hsqinv : (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1))⁻¹ ≤ (Qb γ.1)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ hQ0 hsq
  have hA1b : ‖A1‖ ≤ |Cr| * (2 * x) := by
    rw [hA1, norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hD1pos.le), Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact mul_le_mul (hpz.trans (le_abs_self _)) (hD1inv.trans hQinv.le)
      (inv_nonneg.2 hD1pos.le) (abs_nonneg _)
  have hsgn : |sgn γ.2.2| = 1 := by
    unfold sgn
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have hA2b : ‖A2‖ ≤ |Cr| * G.ustar / 2 * (2 * x) := by
    have e : |sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2| = |Bs5 B G γ| * G.ustar / 2 := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_mul, hsgn, one_mul, abs_of_pos hu, abs_two]
    have hB2 : |Bs5 B G γ| * G.ustar / 2 ≤ |Cr| * G.ustar / 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hBs.trans (le_abs_self _)) hu.le) (by norm_num)
    rw [hA2, norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)), Real.norm_eq_abs, e]
    exact mul_le_mul hB2 (hsqinv.trans hQinv.le) (inv_nonneg.2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
      (by have := abs_nonneg Cr; positivity)
  have hDLb : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (⇑Lc) ξ‖ ≤ |Cr| * (2 + G.ustar) * x := by
    have := hDL.trans (hLcn.trans (add_le_add hA1b hA2b))
    calc _ ≤ |Cr| * (2 * x) + |Cr| * G.ustar / 2 * (2 * x) := this
      _ = |Cr| * (2 + G.ustar) * x := by ring
  
  have hq3 : qC B.h ξ ^ (-3:ℝ) = x ^ 3 := by
    rw [show (-3:ℝ) = -((3:ℕ):ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_neg hq0.le, Real.rpow_natCast, hxdef, inv_pow]
  have hNB : NB B.h Wf k ξ ≤ |C4| * (4 * x ^ 2) := by
    rw [hWeq]
    refine (hC4 l0 γ ξ (by omega) hξ hS het).trans ?_
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (sq_nonneg _)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hℓ (abs_nonneg _))
  have hDW : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Wf ξ‖ ≤ (C0 * x ^ 3) ^ k * (|C4| * (4 * x ^ 2)) := by
    have hc := hconv ξ hq0 hq1 Wf k
    rw [hq3] at hc
    exact hc.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNB
      (pow_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (pow_nonneg hx0.le 3)) k))
  
  have hnorm : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (phiL5 B G γ) ξ‖ ≤
      |Cr| * (2 + G.ustar) * x + (C0 * x ^ 3) ^ k * (|C4| * (4 * x ^ 2)) :=
    hDk.trans (add_le_add hDLb hDW)
  have hx2 : x ^ 2 ≤ x ^ (3 * k + 3) := pow_le_pow_right₀ hx1 (by omega)
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ 3 * (|Cr| * (2 + G.ustar)) :=
    mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith))
  have hqM : qC B.h ξ ^ (-((3 * k + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ)) = x ^ (3 * k + 3) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hq0.le, Real.rpow_natCast, hxdef, inv_pow]
  rw [hqM]
  calc (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (phiL5 B G γ) ξ‖
      ≤ (3 * x) * (|Cr| * (2 + G.ustar) * x + (C0 * x ^ 3) ^ k * (|C4| * (4 * x ^ 2))) :=
        mul_le_mul hkb hnorm (norm_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    _ = 3 * (|Cr| * (2 + G.ustar)) * x ^ 2 + 12 * C0 ^ k * |C4| * x ^ (3 * k + 3) := by
        rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
        ring
    _ ≤ 3 * (|Cr| * (2 + G.ustar)) * x ^ (3 * k + 3) + 12 * C0 ^ k * |C4| * x ^ (3 * k + 3) :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx2 hL0) le_rfl
    _ = (3 * |Cr| * (2 + G.ustar) + 12 * C0 ^ k * |C4|) * x ^ (3 * k + 3) := by ring

by
  have core : ∀ (e : ℕ) (q r Xa Xb A a M c0 U0 rho : ℝ) (F Ft bEf bH : ℝ → ℝ),

      rho = r / Real.sqrt q → Real.sqrt Xa < rho → rho < 2 * Real.sqrt (2 * Xb) →

      a = A + 1/2 →
      (∀ s, Ft s = q ^ a * F s) →
      ContinuousOn Ft (Ioi 0) →
      (∀ s, 0 < s → (s ^ 2 / (2 * q) ≤ Xa ∨ Xb ≤ s ^ 2 / (2 * q)) → Ft s = 0) →
      Continuous bH →

      M = (∫ s in Ioi (0:ℝ), s ^ e * F s) →

        rho * ((∫ s in (0:ℝ)..rho, s ^ e * bH s) * (∫ u in c0..U0, u ^ e * Ft (u * r)) -
          ∫ u in c0..1, u ^ e * Ft (u * r)) ∧
      q ^ A * (-(r ^ e)⁻¹ * ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..r, s ^ e * (F s - bEf s * M)) =
        rho * ((∫ u in (1:ℝ)..U0, u ^ e * Ft (u * r)) -
          (∫ s in rho..(U0 * rho), s ^ e * bH s) * ∫ u in c0..U0, u ^ e * Ft (u * r)) := by
    intro e q r Xa Xb A a M c0 U0 rho F Ft bEf bH hq hr hXa hXab hrho hlo hhi hc0 hU0 ha hFt hFtc
      hsupp hbH hbE hM hsh
    have hsq : 0 < Real.sqrt q := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq
    have hsqne : Real.sqrt q ≠ 0 := hsq.ne'
    have hsq2 : Real.sqrt q ^ 2 = q := Real.sq_sqrt hq.le
    have hrho0 : 0 < rho := by rw [hrho]; exact div_pos hr hsq
    have hrq : r = rho * Real.sqrt q := by rw [hrho]; field_simp
    have hr2 : r ^ 2 = rho ^ 2 * q := by rw [hrq, mul_pow, hsq2]
    have hXb : 0 < Xb := by linarith
    have hρlo : Xa < rho ^ 2 := Real.lt_sq_of_sqrt_lt hlo
    have hρhi : rho ^ 2 < 8 * Xb := by
      have h1 := pow_lt_pow_left₀ hhi hrho0.le (two_ne_zero)
      have h2 : (2 * Real.sqrt (2 * Xb)) ^ 2 = 8 * Xb := by
        rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)]; ring
      linarith
    have hratio : 0 < Xa / Xb := div_pos hXa hXb
    have hratio' : 0 < Xb / Xa := div_pos hXb hXa
    have hc0pos : 0 < c0 := by rw [hc0]; exact div_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hratio) (by norm_num)
    have hc0sq : c0 ^ 2 * Xb = Xa / 16 := by

    have hc01 : c0 ≤ 1 := by

      have h2 := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h1
      rw [Real.sqrt_one] at h2

    have hU0pos : 0 < U0 := by rw [hU0]; exact mul_pos two_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hratio')
    have hU0sq : U0 ^ 2 * Xa = 4 * Xb := by
      rw [hU0, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hratio'.le]; field_simp; ring
    have h1U0 : 1 ≤ U0 := by
      have h1 : 1 ≤ Xb / Xa := (one_le_div hXa).mpr hXab.le
      have h2 := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h1
      rw [Real.sqrt_one] at h2
      rw [hU0]; linarith

    have hc0r : 0 < c0 * r := mul_pos hc0pos hr
    have hU0r : 0 < U0 * r := mul_pos hU0pos hr
    have hsuppL : ∀ s, 0 < s → s ≤ c0 * r → Ft s = 0 := by
      intro s hs hsr

      have h2 : (c0 * r) ^ 2 = c0 ^ 2 * rho ^ 2 * q := by rw [mul_pow, hr2]; ring

        funext s; rw [hbE s]
      rw [hfun]
      exact (continuous_pow e).mul (continuous_const.mul (hbH.comp (continuous_id.div_const _)))
    have hSub : ∀ v, (∫ s in (c0 * r)..(v * r), s ^ e * Ft s) =

      have h2 : (∫ x in c0..v, (x * r) ^ e * Ft (x * r)) =

        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
        congr 1
        funext u
        rw [mul_pow]; ring
      rw [h2] at h1
      calc (∫ s in (c0 * r)..(v * r), s ^ e * Ft s)
          = r * (r⁻¹ * ∫ s in (c0 * r)..(v * r), s ^ e * Ft s) := by field_simp
        _ = r * (r ^ e * ∫ u in c0..v, u ^ e * Ft (u * r)) := by rw [← h1]
        _ = r ^ (e + 1) * ∫ u in c0..v, u ^ e * Ft (u * r) := by ring
    have h0L : (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..(c0 * r), s ^ e * Ft s) = 0 := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hc0r.le]
      rw [setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioc (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ)) ?_]
      · simp
      · intro s hs
        simp [hsuppL s hs.1 hs.2]
    have int1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => s ^ e * Ft s) volume 0 (c0 * r) := by

    have hA : ∀ v, c0 ≤ v → IntervalIntegrable (fun s => s ^ e * Ft s) volume 0 (v * r) ∧

        rw [← pow_succ, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hq.le]

        push_cast
        ring

        ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..(v * rho), s ^ e * bH s := by
      intro v

      intro v hv

        rho * ((∫ s in (0:ℝ)..rho, s ^ e * bH s) * (∫ u in c0..U0, u ^ e * Ft (u * r)) -
          ∫ u in c0..1, u ^ e * Ft (u * r)) := by
      have h1 := hT 1 hc01
      simp only [one_mul] at h1
      rw [h1]

      have h4 : U0 ^ 2 * Xa * q = 4 * Xb * q := by rw [hU0sq]
      have h5 : 0 < Xb * q := mul_pos hXb hq
      exact (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith)
    have hne : -((U0 * r) ^ e)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := neg_ne_zero.mpr (inv_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hU0r.ne'))
    have hint := (mul_eq_zero.mp (hsh hXC)).resolve_left hne
    rw [hT U0 hc0U0] at hint
    have hz := (mul_eq_zero.mp hint).resolve_left
      (mul_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _) (pow_pos hr _)).ne'
    have hi1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun u : ℝ => u ^ e * Ft (u * r)) volume c0 1 := by
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      apply hφc.mono
      rw [uIcc_of_le hc01]
      exact fun x hx => lt_of_lt_of_le hc0pos hx.1
    have hi2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun u : ℝ => u ^ e * Ft (u * r)) volume 1 U0 := by
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      apply hφc.mono
      rw [uIcc_of_le h1U0]
      exact fun x hx => lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hx.1
    have hadd1 : (∫ u in c0..1, u ^ e * Ft (u * r)) + (∫ u in (1:ℝ)..U0, u ^ e * Ft (u * r)) =
        ∫ u in c0..U0, u ^ e * Ft (u * r) :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals hi1 hi2
    have hadd2 : (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..rho, s ^ e * bH s) + (∫ s in rho..(U0 * rho), s ^ e * bH s) =
        ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..(U0 * rho), s ^ e * bH s :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
        (hψc.intervalIntegrable 0 rho) (hψc.intervalIntegrable rho (U0 * rho))
    linear_combination hL - rho * hadd1 + rho * (∫ u in c0..U0, u ^ e * Ft (u * r)) * hadd2 -
      rho * hz
  intro B G l0 S α e hB he hFt hsh ξ hξ hlo hhi
  obtain ⟨r, z, t, Y⟩ := ξ
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -, hqB0, -, -, -, haa, hab⟩ := hB.2.1
  have hXab : B.Xa < B.Xb := by linarith
  have hr : 0 < r := hξ.1
  have ht : t < 1 := hξ.2.1
  have hqlt : qC B.h ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) < qsOf l0 := hξ.2.2
  have hq : 0 < qC B.h ((r, z, t, Y) : Cyl) := (hB.1.1 z (1 - t) (by linarith)).1
  have hdom : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ((s, z, t, (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) : Cyl) ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) :=
    fun s hs => (show 0 < s ∧ t < 1 ∧ qC B.h ((s, z, t, (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) : Cyl) < qsOf l0 from

  have hbH : Continuous (bHatE B e) := by

      (FE5 B G l0 S e (r', ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) -

∀ (h : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ0 : Cyl) (k : ℕ), IsOpen U → ξ0 ∈ U →

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h f U ξ0 k hU hξ0 hf hY hUY
  
  have key : ∀ {E F W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F]
      [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (G : F → W) (T : E →L[ℝ] F) (a : F)
      (V' : Set F) (i : ℕ), IsOpen V' → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G V' → a + T 0 ∈ V' →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => G (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G (a + T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro E F W _ _ _ _ _ _ G T a V' i hV' hF ha
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set F, s = (fun z => a + z) ⁻¹' V' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV'.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hOT : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have hAs : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [hs_def]; exact ha
    have hxO : (0:E) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hAs
    have hsm' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => G (a + T z)) i hOT hxO
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm' hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hOT.uniqueDiffOn hAs (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => G (a + z)) i hs hAs
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := G) i a (T 0)
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => G (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => G (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => G (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => G (a + z)) (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G (a + T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4]
  
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl, L = Lnorm h ξ0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hL1 : ∀ u : Cyl, (ξ0 + L u).1 = ξ0.1 + Real.sqrt (qC h ξ0) * u.1 := by
    intro u; rw [hL]; rfl
  have hL2 : ∀ u : Cyl, (ξ0 + L u).2.1 = ξ0.2.1 + qC h ξ0 ^ (1/2 - h) * u.2.1 := by
    intro u; rw [hL]; rfl
  have hL3 : ∀ u : Cyl, (ξ0 + L u).2.2.1 = ξ0.2.2.1 + qC h ξ0 * u.2.2.1 := by
    intro u; rw [hL]; rfl
  
  obtain ⟨Pj, hPj⟩ : ∃ Pj : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,
      Pj = (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).prod
        (((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
            (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))).prod
          ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp
            ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
              (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPjapp : ∀ v : Cyl, Pj v = (v.1, v.2.1, v.2.2.1) := by intro v; rw [hPj]; rfl
  have hPjn : ‖Pj‖ ≤ 1 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound Pj zero_le_one (fun v => ?_)
    have e : ‖((v.1, v.2.1, v.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)‖ = max ‖v.1‖ (max ‖v.2.1‖ ‖v.2.2.1‖) := by
      rw [Prod.norm_def, Prod.norm_def]
    rw [hPjapp, one_mul, e]
    exact max_le (norm_fst_le v) (max_le ((norm_fst_le v.2).trans (norm_snd_le v))
      (((norm_fst_le v.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le v.2)).trans (norm_snd_le v)))
  
  have hfac : ∀ v : Cyl, f (ξ0 + L v) = f (sgc5ch h ξ0 (0 + Pj v)) := by
    intro v
    rw [zero_add, hPjapp, ← hY (ξ0 + L v) 0, hL1, hL2, hL3]
    rfl
  have hfun : (fun v : Cyl => f (ξ0 + L v)) = (fun v : Cyl => f (sgc5ch h ξ0 (0 + Pj v))) :=
    funext hfac
  
  have hchd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => sgc5ch h ξ0 a) := by
    show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (ξ0.1 + Real.sqrt (qC h ξ0) * a.1,
      ξ0.2.1 + qC h ξ0 ^ (1/2 - h) * a.2.1, ξ0.2.2.1 + qC h ξ0 * a.2.2, (0 : ℝ × ℝ)))
    exact (contDiff_const.add (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_fst)).prodMk
      ((contDiff_const.add (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_snd))).prodMk
        ((contDiff_const.add (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd))).prodMk
          contDiff_const))
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ : ∃ V : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), V = {a | sgc5ch h ξ0 a ∈ U} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hVo : IsOpen V := by rw [hV]; exact hU.preimage hchd.continuous
  have hFV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => f (sgc5ch h ξ0 a)) V :=
    hf.comp hchd.contDiffOn (fun a ha => by rw [hV] at ha; exact ha)
  have hch0 : sgc5ch h ξ0 0 = (ξ0.1, ξ0.2.1, ξ0.2.2.1, (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) := by simp [sgc5ch]
  have h0V : (0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) + Pj 0 ∈ V := by
    rw [map_zero, add_zero, hV]
    show sgc5ch h ξ0 0 ∈ U
    rw [hch0]
    exact hUY ξ0 hξ0 0
  
  have e1 := key f L ξ0 U k hU hf (by rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact hξ0)
  rw [map_zero, add_zero] at e1
  have e2 := key (fun a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => f (sgc5ch h ξ0 a)) Pj 0 V k hVo hFV h0V
  rw [map_zero, add_zero] at e2
  have hEq : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ0) =
      (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => f (sgc5ch h ξ0 a)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Pj) := by
    rw [← hL, ← e1, ← e2, hfun]
  unfold NB
  rw [hEq]
  calc ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => f (sgc5ch h ξ0 a)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Pj)‖
      ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => f (sgc5ch h ξ0 a)) 0‖ * ∏ _j : Fin k, ‖Pj‖ :=
        ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _
    _ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => f (sgc5ch h ξ0 a)) 0‖ * ‖Pj‖ ^ k := by
        rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => f (sgc5ch h ξ0 a)) 0‖ * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hPjn) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => f (sgc5ch h ξ0 a)) 0‖ := mul_one _

by
  
  have PIC : ∀ {P E' F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
      [FiniteDimensional ℝ P] [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace ℝ E'] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E']
      [MeasurableSpace E'] [BorelSpace E'] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
      (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E') [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ]
      (U : Set P) (V K : Set E') (G : P → E' → F), IsOpen U → IsOpen V → IsCompact K →
      K ⊆ V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => G z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) x =
        ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ) := by
    intro P E' F _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ μ _ U V K G hU hV hK hKV hG
    have hO : IsOpen (U ×ˢ V) := hU.prod hV
    have hKm : MeasurableSet K := hK.isClosed.measurableSet
    have slice : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F'] (H : P → E' → F'),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) →
        ∀ x ∈ U, ContinuousOn (fun y => H x y) K := by
      intro F' _ _ H hH x hx
      have hc : Continuous (fun y : E' => ((x, y) : P × E')) := by fun_prop
      have h := ContinuousOn.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (f := fun y : E' => ((x, y) : P × E'))
        hH.continuousOn hc.continuousOn (fun y hy => ⟨hx, hKV hy⟩)
      exact h
    have param_fderiv : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F'] (H : P → E' → F'),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => H x' z.2) z.1) (U ×ˢ V) := by
      intro F' _ _ H hH p hp
      have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) p := hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hp)
      apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry (fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2)) (p, p.1) := by
        have e : Function.uncurry (fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2) =
            (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) ∘ (fun w : (P × E') × P => (w.2, w.1.2)) := rfl
        rw [e]
        apply ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (p, p.1)
        · simpa using hHa
        · fun_prop
      exact ContDiffAt.fderiv (f := fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2)
        (g := Prod.fst) h1 contDiffAt_fst (le_of_eq ENat.coe_top_add_one)
    have param_hasFDeriv : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F']

        HasFDerivAt (fun x' => ∫ y in K, H x' y ∂μ) (∫ y in K, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => H x' y) x ∂μ) x := by
      intro F' _ _ H hH x hx
      have hHs := param_fderiv H hH
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU x hx
      have hsU : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ⊆ U :=
        (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
      have hsn : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ∈ nhds x := Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds x (by linarith)
      have hC : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ×ˢ K) := (isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod hK
      have hCsub : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ×ˢ K ⊆ U ×ˢ V := fun z hz => ⟨hsU hz.1, hKV hz.2⟩
      obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hC.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hHs.continuousOn.mono hCsub)
      refine hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (μ := μ.restrict K)
        (F := fun x' y => H x' y) (F' := fun x' y => fderiv ℝ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x')
        (bound := fun _ => B) hsn ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hx] with x' hx'
        exact (slice H hH x' hx').aestronglyMeasurable_of_isCompact hK hKm
      · exact (slice H hH x hx).integrableOn_compact hK
      · exact (slice (fun x' y => fderiv ℝ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x') hHs x hx).aestronglyMeasurable_of_isCompact
          hK hKm
      · exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hKm (fun y hy x' hx' => hB (x', y) ⟨hx', hy⟩)
      · exact continuousOn_const.integrableOn_compact hK
      · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hKm (fun y hy x' hx' => ?_)
        have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (x', y) :=
          hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds ⟨hsU hx', hKV hy⟩)
        have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x'' : P => ((x'', y) : P × E')) x' := by fun_prop
        have h2 := ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) x' hHa hc
        have : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x' := h2
        exact (this.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have hD0 : ∀ x y, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun x' => G x' y) x =
        (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm (G x y) := by
      intro x y; rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp]; rfl
    have hDs : ∀ (k : ℕ) x y, iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) (fun x' => G x' y) x =
        (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm
          (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') x) := by
      intro k x y; rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left]; rfl
    have D_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) (U ×ˢ V) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        have e : (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) =
            (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm ∘ (fun z : P × E' => G z.1 z.2) := by
          funext z; exact hD0 z.1 z.2
        rw [e]
        exact (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hG
      | succ k ih =>
        have e : (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) =
            (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm ∘
              (fun z : P × E' => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' z.2) x') z.1) := by
          funext z; exact hDs k z.1 z.2
        rw [e]
        have h2 := param_fderiv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') ih
        exact (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h2
    have formula : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) x =
        ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro x _
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp (f := fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ)]
        simp only [hD0]
        exact (ContinuousLinearEquiv.integral_comp_comm
          (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv (fun y => G x y)).symm
      | succ k ih =>
        intro x hx
        have hα : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) =ᶠ[nhds x]
            (fun x' => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x' ∂μ) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hx) ih
        have hβ := (param_hasFDeriv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x')
          (D_smooth k) x hx).fderiv
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left (f := fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ), Function.comp_apply,
          hα.fderiv_eq, hβ]
        simp only [hDs]
        have hL := ContinuousLinearEquiv.integral_comp_comm (μ := μ.restrict K) (𝕜 := ℝ)
          (E := P →L[ℝ] ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => P) F)
          (F := ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F)
          (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv
          (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') x)
        exact hL.symm
    have hsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U := by
      have key : ∀ m : ℕ, EqOn (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U)
          (fun x => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ) U := by
        intro m x hx
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hU hx]
        exact formula m x hx
      have hdiff : ∀ m : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℝ
          (fun x => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ) U :=
        fun m x hx => (param_hasFDeriv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x'' => G x'' y) x')
          (D_smooth m) x hx).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      exact contDiffOn_of_continuousOn_differentiableOn (n := ⊤)
        (fun m _ => ((hdiff m).continuousOn).congr (key m))
        (fun m _ => (hdiff m).congr (key m))

  have key : ∀ {E F W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F]
      [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (G : F → W) (T : E →L[ℝ] F) (a : F)
      (V' : Set F) (i : ℕ), IsOpen V' → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G V' → a + T 0 ∈ V' →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => G (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G (a + T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro E F W _ _ _ _ _ _ G T a V' i hV' hF ha
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set F, s = (fun z => a + z) ⁻¹' V' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV'.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hOT : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have hAs : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [hs_def]; exact ha
    have hxO : (0:E) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hAs

    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => G (a + z)) i hs hAs
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := G) i a (T 0)
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => G (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => G (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => G (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap

      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => G (a + z)) (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G (a + T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4]
  intro B qs α F e hB hF k
  have hqpos : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ := fun ξ hξ =>
    (hB.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ.2.1])).1
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => qC B.h ξ) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) := by fun_prop
    have h2 := hB.1.2.2.2.1.comp h1.contDiffOn (s := {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1})
      (fun ξ hξ => Set.mk_mem_prod (Set.mem_univ _)
        (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by have : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ; linarith)))
    exact h2
  have hS0o : IsOpen {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).and (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
  have hqCc : ContinuousOn (fun ξ : Cyl => qC B.h ξ) {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
    (hqC.continuousOn).mono (fun ξ hξ => hξ.2)
  have hΩo : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have := hqCc.isOpen_inter_preimage hS0o (isOpen_Iio : IsOpen (Set.Iio qs))
    convert this using 1
    ext ξ
    simp only [DomC, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Iio]

  have hXCc : ContinuousOn (XC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have hc1 : ContinuousOn (fun ξ : Cyl => qC B.h ξ) (DomC B.h qs) :=
      hqCc.mono (fun ξ hξ => ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1⟩)
    show ContinuousOn (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ)) (DomC B.h qs)
    exact (continuous_fst.pow 2).continuousOn.div (continuousOn_const.mul hc1)
      (fun ξ hξ => (mul_pos two_pos (hqpos ξ hξ)).ne')
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hB.2.1.2.2.1
  have hFs := hF.1
  
  choose Cf bf df hf using hF.2.2.2
  obtain ⟨C0, hC0d⟩ : ∃ C0 : ℝ, C0 = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cf j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hbd⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ, b = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bf j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨d, hdd⟩ : ∃ d : ℝ, d = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |df j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C0 := by rw [hC0d]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hd0 : 0 ≤ d := by rw [hdd]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hmem : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) := fun i hi => Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
  have hNB : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
      NB B.h F i ξ ≤ C0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * sgc5w B d (XC B.h ξ) := by
    intro i hi ξ hξ h1 h2

      exact (le_abs_self _).trans

    have hbi : bf i ≤ b := by
      rw [hbd]
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans
        (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |bf j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (hmem i hi))
    have hdi : df i ≤ d := by
      rw [hdd]
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans
        (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |df j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (hmem i hi))

    have hS1 : SC B.h ξ ^ bf i ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ b := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hSC hbi
    have hSpos : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bf i := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    have hSbpos : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ b := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    have hD1 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df i) ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hδ hδ1 (by linarith)
    have hDpos : 0 ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df i) := Real.rpow_nonneg hδ.le _
    have a1 : Cf i * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) ≤ C0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCi hQ
    have a2 : Cf i * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bf i ≤
        C0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ b :=
      mul_le_mul a1 hS1 hSpos (mul_nonneg hC0 hQ)
    have a3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right a2 hEW
    have a4 := mul_le_mul a3 hD1 hDpos (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC0 hQ) hSbpos) hEW)
    refine (hf i ξ hξ h1 h2).trans (a4.trans (le_of_eq ?_))
    unfold sgc5w

  have hDcont : ∀ i : ℕ, ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F) (DomC B.h qs) := fun i =>
    (hFs.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hΩo.uniqueDiffOn).congr
      (fun x hx => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩo hx).symm)
  have hOo : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs ∩ XC B.h ⁻¹' (Iio B.Xa ∪ Ioi B.Xb)) :=
    hXCc.isOpen_inter_preimage hΩo (isOpen_Iio.union isOpen_Ioi)
  have hstrict : ∀ i : ℕ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ = 0 := by
    intro i ξ hξ hX

      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hOo.mem_nhds ⟨hξ, hX⟩) (fun η hη => ?_)
      have h2 : XC B.h η < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h η := hη.2

  have hray : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → ∀ i : ℕ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (gu u) 0‖ ≤

    ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ0 ∈ DomC B.h qs, sgc5rho B.h ξ0 ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xb) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => φ (sgc5rho B.h (sgc5ch B.h ξ0 a))) {a | (sgc5ch B.h ξ0 a).2.2.1 < 1} ∧
      ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => φ (sgc5rho B.h (sgc5ch B.h ξ0 a))) 0‖ ≤ C

signature.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), B.ok → qs ≤ 1 → (∀ (p : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → simScale B.h z τ ≤ 1 → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2 ^ p) (z, τ)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => (simScale B.h z τ ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (simScale B.h z τ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h z τ ^ p) →
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ0 ∈ DomC B.h qs, sgc5rho B.h ξ0 ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xb) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => φ (sgc5rho B.h (sgc5ch B.h ξ0 a))) {a | (sgc5ch B.h ξ0 a).2.2.1 < 1} ∧
      ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => φ (sgc5rho B.h (sgc5ch B.h ξ0 a))) 0‖ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs φ hB hqs1 hS8 hφ k
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hB.1
  
  have key : ∀ (F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (W : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (b : ℝ × ℝ) (T : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)),
      IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W → b ∈ W → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (b + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F b).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro F V a T hV hF ha i
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set (ℝ × ℝ), s = (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
    have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  
  choose Cs hCs using fun j : ℕ => hS8 (-(1/2)) j
  obtain ⟨K, hKdef⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cs j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := by
    rw [hKdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hCsK : ∀ j ≤ k, Cs j ≤ K := by
    intro j hj
    have h2 : |Cs j| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cs i| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cs i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj))
    rw [hKdef]; linarith [le_abs_self (Cs j)]
  obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, R = 2 * Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xb) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ R := by rw [hRdef]; positivity
  have hMex : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (-R) R, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i φ x‖ ≤ M := fun i =>
    isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (ContDiff.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (m := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top) hφ).continuousOn
  choose M hM using hMex
  obtain ⟨Cφ, hCφdef⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |M i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCφ0 : 0 ≤ Cφ := by
    rw [hCφdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hMC : ∀ i ≤ k, M i ≤ Cφ := by
    intro i hi
    have h2 : |M i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |M j| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |M j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
    rw [hCφdef]; linarith [le_abs_self (M i)]
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = 1 + 2 ^ k * (R + 1) * K := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by
    have : 0 ≤ 2 ^ k * (R + 1) * K := by positivity
    rw [hDdef]; linarith
  refine ⟨(k.factorial : ℝ) * Cφ * D ^ k, ?_⟩
  intro ξ0 hξ0 hρ
  have hξ0' : 0 < ξ0.1 ∧ ξ0.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ0 < qs := hξ0
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ0 := (hS.1 ξ0.2.1 (1 - ξ0.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ0'.2.1])).1
  have hq1 : qC B.h ξ0 ≤ 1 := le_trans hξ0'.2.2.le hqs1
  have hsq0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ0) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq0
  have hρ0pos : 0 < sgc5rho B.h ξ0 := div_pos hξ0'.1 hsq0
  have hρmem : sgc5rho B.h ξ0 ∈ Set.Icc (-R) R :=
    ⟨by linarith, by rw [hRdef]; exact hρ⟩
  
  obtain ⟨V, hVdef⟩ : ∃ V : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), V = {a | (sgc5ch B.h ξ0 a).2.2.1 < 1} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hVmem : ∀ a, a ∈ V ↔ ξ0.2.2.1 + qC B.h ξ0 * a.2.2 < 1 := by
    intro a; rw [hVdef]; exact Iff.rfl
  have hVo : IsOpen V := by
    have e : V = {a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | ξ0.2.2.1 + qC B.h ξ0 * a.2.2 < 1} := by
      ext a; exact hVmem a
    rw [e]
    exact isOpen_lt (continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul continuous_snd.snd)) continuous_const
  have h0V : (0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈ V :=
    (hVmem 0).2 (by simp only [Prod.snd_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]; exact hξ0'.2.1)
  
  obtain ⟨Pm, hPmdef⟩ : ∃ Pm : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
      Pm = ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))).prod
        (-((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPapp : ∀ a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, Pm a = (a.2.1, -a.2.2) := by
    intro a; rw [hPmdef]; simp
  have hP1 : ‖Pm‖ ≤ 1 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun a => ?_)
    rw [hPapp a, one_mul, Prod.norm_def (a.2.1, -a.2.2)]
    refine max_le ?_ ?_
    · exact (norm_fst_le a.2).trans (norm_snd_le a)
    · exact (norm_neg a.2.2).trans_le ((norm_snd_le a.2).trans (norm_snd_le a))
  obtain ⟨Mq, hMqdef⟩ : ∃ Mq : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
      Mq = (qC B.h ξ0 ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
        (qC B.h ξ0 • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ, T = Mq.comp Pm := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨w0, hw0def⟩ : ∃ w0 : ℝ × ℝ, w0 = (ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hTapp : ∀ a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, T a = (qC B.h ξ0 ^ (1/2 - B.h) * a.2.1, qC B.h ξ0 * (-a.2.2)) := by
    intro a
    rw [hTdef, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hPapp a, hMqdef]
    simp [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
  have hwT : ∀ a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, w0 + T a =
      (ξ0.2.1 + qC B.h ξ0 ^ (1/2 - B.h) * a.2.1, 1 - (ξ0.2.2.1 + qC B.h ξ0 * a.2.2)) := by
    intro a
    rw [hTapp a, hw0def, Prod.mk_add_mk]
    exact Prod.ext rfl (by
      show (1 - ξ0.2.2.1) + qC B.h ξ0 * (-a.2.2) = 1 - (ξ0.2.2.1 + qC B.h ξ0 * a.2.2)
      ring)
  have hWo : IsOpen (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
  have hSW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2)
      (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) := hS.2.2.2.1
  have hSpos : ∀ w ∈ (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), 0 < simScale B.h w.1 w.2 :=
    fun w hw => (hS.1 w.1 w.2 hw.2).1
  have hw0 : w0 ∈ (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := by
    rw [hw0def]; exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith [hξ0'.2.1])⟩
  have hmapsV : ∀ a ∈ V, w0 + T a ∈ (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := by
    intro a ha
    rw [hwT a]
    exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith [(hVmem a).1 ha])⟩
  have hqch : ∀ a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,
      qC B.h (sgc5ch B.h ξ0 a) = simScale B.h (w0 + T a).1 (w0 + T a).2 := by
    intro a; rw [hwT a]; rfl
  
  obtain ⟨G, hGdef⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, G = fun w => simScale B.h w.1 w.2 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hGW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) := by
    rw [hGdef]; exact hSW.rpow_const_of_ne (fun w hw => (hSpos w hw).ne')
  obtain ⟨Gt, hGtdef⟩ : ∃ Gt : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, Gt = fun a => G (w0 + T a) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hGtV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Gt V := by
    rw [hGtdef]
    exact hGW.comp (contDiff_const.add T.contDiff).contDiffOn (fun a ha => hmapsV a ha)
  have hGt0 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Gt 0 := hGtV.contDiffAt (hVo.mem_nhds h0V)
  obtain ⟨Y, hYdef⟩ : ∃ Y : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, Y = Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ0) • Gt := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hYV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Y V := by
    rw [hYdef]; exact hGtV.const_smul (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ0))
  have hcancel : Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ0) * qC B.h ξ0 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) = 1 := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_add hq0, add_neg_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
  have hYb : ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j Y 0‖ ≤ K := by
    intro j hj
    have hcomp : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j G w0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Mq.comp Pm) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j G w0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Mq)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Pm) := by
      ext m; rfl
    have hCj : ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j G w0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Mq)‖ ≤
        Cs j * qC B.h ξ0 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) := by
      rw [hMqdef, hw0def, hGdef]
      exact hCs j ξ0.2.1 (1 - ξ0.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ0'.2.1]) hq1
    have hprod : ∏ _i : Fin j, ‖Pm‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hP1
    have hb1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j G w0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Mq)) (fun _ : Fin j => Pm)
    have hb2 := hb1.trans ((mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) hprod).trans hCj)
    rw [hYdef, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply (hGt0.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)), hGtdef,
      key G (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) w0 T hWo hGW hw0 j, norm_smul, hTdef, hcomp,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).trans ?_
    rw [show Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ0) * (Cs j * qC B.h ξ0 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) =
      Cs j * (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ0) * qC B.h ξ0 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) by ring, hcancel, mul_one]
    exact hCsK j hj
  
  obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
      L = fun a => sgc5rho B.h ξ0 + ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) a := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hLs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L V := by
    rw [hLdef]; exact (contDiff_const.add (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).contDiff).contDiffOn
  have hℓ1 : ‖ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)‖ ≤ 1 :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun a => by
      rw [one_mul]; exact norm_fst_le a)
  have hLb : ∀ i : ℕ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i L 0‖ ≤ R + 1 := by
    intro i
    rw [hLdef]
    rcases i with _ | n
    · rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]
      show ‖sgc5rho B.h ξ0 + ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) 0‖ ≤ R + 1
      rw [map_zero, add_zero, Real.norm_of_nonneg hρ0pos.le]
      linarith [hρmem.2]
    · rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
      have hd : fderiv ℝ (fun a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => sgc5rho B.h ξ0 + ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) a) =
          fun _ => ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) := by
        funext z; rw [fderiv_const_add, ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
      rw [hd]
      rcases n with _ | n
      · rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]
        linarith
      · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (by omega : n + 1 ≠ 0), Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
        linarith
  
  obtain ⟨P, hPdef⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, P = fun a => sgc5rho B.h (sgc5ch B.h ξ0 a) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPeq : ∀ a ∈ V, P a = L a * Y a := by
    intro a ha
    have hs : 0 < simScale B.h (w0 + T a).1 (w0 + T a).2 := hSpos _ (hmapsV a ha)
    have e1 : P a = (ξ0.1 + Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ0) * a.1) /
        Real.sqrt (simScale B.h (w0 + T a).1 (w0 + T a).2) := by
      rw [hPdef, ← hqch a]; rfl
    have e2 : L a * Y a = (ξ0.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ0) + a.1) *
        (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ0) * (simScale B.h (w0 + T a).1 (w0 + T a).2) ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) := by
      rw [hLdef, hYdef, hGtdef, hGdef]; rfl
    rw [e1, e2, Real.rpow_neg hs.le, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, div_eq_mul_inv]
    have hc : Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ0) ≠ 0 := hsq0.ne'
    have h3 : (ξ0.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ0) + a.1) * (Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ0) *
        (Real.sqrt (simScale B.h (w0 + T a).1 (w0 + T a).2))⁻¹) =
        (ξ0.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ0) * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ0) + Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ0) * a.1) *
        (Real.sqrt (simScale B.h (w0 + T a).1 (w0 + T a).2))⁻¹ := by ring
    rw [h3, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hc]
  have hPV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P V := (hLs.mul hYV).congr hPeq
  have hPb : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j P V 0‖ ≤ D ^ j := by
    intro j hj1 hjk
    have hEq : Set.EqOn P (fun a => L a * Y a) V := fun a ha => hPeq a ha
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_congr hEq h0V j]
    have leib := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hLs hYV hVo.uniqueDiffOn h0V (n := j)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    refine leib.trans ?_
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i L V 0‖ *
          ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ (j - i) Y V 0‖
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) * (R + 1) * K := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => ?_)
          rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hVo h0V,
            iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (j - i) hVo h0V]
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hLb i) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
            (hYb (j - i) (by omega)) (norm_nonneg _)
            (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by linarith))
      _ = 2 ^ j * (R + 1) * K := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul]
          congr 2
          exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose j
      _ ≤ 2 ^ k * (R + 1) * K := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hK0
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by linarith)
          exact pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hjk
      _ ≤ D := by
          have : 0 ≤ 2 ^ k * (R + 1) * K := by positivity
          rw [hDdef]; linarith
      _ ≤ D ^ j := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
  
  have hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => φ (sgc5rho B.h (sgc5ch B.h ξ0 a)))
      {a | (sgc5ch B.h ξ0 a).2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h := hφ.comp_contDiffOn hPV
    rw [hPdef, hVdef] at h
    exact h
  
  have hP0 : P 0 = sgc5rho B.h ξ0 := by
    rw [hPdef]
    show sgc5rho B.h (sgc5ch B.h ξ0 0) = sgc5rho B.h ξ0
    have e : sgc5ch B.h ξ0 0 = (ξ0.1, ξ0.2.1, ξ0.2.2.1, (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) := by simp [sgc5ch]
    rw [e]; rfl
  have hφb : ∀ i ≤ k, ∀ i' ≤ i, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i' φ Set.univ (P 0)‖ ≤ Cφ := by
    intro i hi i' hi'
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_univ, hP0]
    exact (hM i' _ hρmem).trans (hMC i' (by omega))
  refine ⟨hA, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hφ.contDiffOn hPV (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    uniqueDiffOn_univ hVo.uniqueDiffOn (Set.mapsTo_univ _ _) h0V (n := i) (C := Cφ) (D := D)
    (hφb i hi) (fun i' h1 h2 => hPb i' h1 (by omega))
  have hFeq : iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun a : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => φ (sgc5rho B.h (sgc5ch B.h ξ0 a))) 0 =
      iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (φ ∘ P) V 0 := by
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hVo h0V, hPdef]; rfl
  rw [hFeq]
  refine hFdB.trans ?_
  exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le hi) hCφ0)
    (pow_le_pow_right₀ hD1 hi) (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _) (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hCφ0)

  have leibV : ∀ (f g : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g V → ∀ n : ℕ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f y * g y) 0‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (n.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f 0‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) g 0‖ := by
    intro f g hf hg n
    have hl := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hf hg hV.uniqueDiffOn h0 (n := n)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => f y * g y) n hV h0] at hl
    refine hl.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := f) i hV h0,
      iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := g) (n - i) hV h0]
  have hsum : ∀ n : ℕ, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) = 2 ^ n := by
    intro n
    exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose n
  
  have hBJ : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun a => Bt a * Jt a) 0‖ ≤ 2 ^ j * (Cb * CJ) := by
    intro j hj
    refine (leibV Bt Jt hB hJ j).trans ?_
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i Bt 0‖ *
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j - i) Jt 0‖
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) * (Cb * CJ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          have hij : i ≤ j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          rw [mul_assoc]
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
          exact mul_le_mul (bB i (hij.trans hj)) (bJ (j - i) ((Nat.sub_le j i).trans hj))
            (norm_nonneg _) hCb
      _ = 2 ^ j * (Cb * CJ) := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hsum]
  have hBJs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun a => Bt a * Jt a) V := hB.mul hJ
  have hGs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun a => Bt a * Jt a - It a) V := hBJs.sub hI
  have h2k : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ k := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
  
  have hG : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun a => Bt a * Jt a - It a) 0‖ ≤ 2 ^ k * (Cb * CJ + CI) := by
    intro j hj
    have ha : ContDiffAt ℝ j (fun a => Bt a * Jt a) 0 :=
      (hBJs.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds h0)
    have hb : ContDiffAt ℝ j It 0 :=
      (hI.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds h0)
    have e : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun a => Bt a * Jt a - It a) 0 =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun a => Bt a * Jt a) 0 - iteratedFDeriv ℝ j It 0 :=
      iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply ha hb
    rw [e]
    have h2j : (2 : ℝ) ^ j ≤ 2 ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hj
    have hCbJ : 0 ≤ Cb * CJ := mul_nonneg hCb hCJ
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun a => Bt a * Jt a) 0 - iteratedFDeriv ℝ j It 0‖
        ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun a => Bt a * Jt a) 0‖ + ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j It 0‖ :=
          norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ 2 ^ j * (Cb * CJ) + CI := add_le_add (hBJ j hj) (bI j hj)
      _ ≤ 2 ^ k * (Cb * CJ) + 2 ^ k * CI :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2j hCbJ) (le_mul_of_one_le_left hCI h2k)
      _ = 2 ^ k * (Cb * CJ + CI) := by ring
  
  have F1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun a => P a * (Bt a * Jt a - It a)) 0‖ ≤
      4 ^ k * Cp * (Cb * CJ + CI) := by
    refine (leibV P (fun a => Bt a * Jt a - It a) hP hGs k).trans ?_
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i P 0‖ *
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) (fun a => Bt a * Jt a - It a) 0‖
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * (Cp * (2 ^ k * (Cb * CJ + CI))) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          rw [mul_assoc]
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
          exact mul_le_mul (bP i hik) (hG (k - i) (Nat.sub_le k i)) (norm_nonneg _) hCp
      _ = 4 ^ k * Cp * (Cb * CJ + CI) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hsum]
          have h4 : (4 : ℝ) ^ k = 2 ^ k * 2 ^ k := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
          rw [h4]; ring
  refine ⟨F1, ?_⟩
  have e : (fun a => P a * (It a - Bt a * Jt a)) = -(fun a => P a * (Bt a * Jt a - It a)) := by
    funext a; simp only [Pi.neg_apply]; ring
  rw [e, iteratedFDeriv_neg_apply, norm_neg]
  exact F1

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (A0 : ℝ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (P : ℝ → ℝ) (L K F : ℝ) (y r : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)), Continuous A0 → (∀ v, 0 < P v) → 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ F → (∀ (x : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (w : ℝ), 0 ≤ w → w ≤ L → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w L, HasDerivAt x (Matrix.mulVec (A0 v) (x v)) v) → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w L, ‖x v‖ ≤ K * (P v / P w) * ‖x w‖) → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt y (Matrix.mulVec (A0 v) (y v) + r v) v) → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, ‖r v‖ ≤ F * P v) → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, ‖y v‖ ≤ K * P v * (‖y 0‖ / P 0 + F * v)
