signature.statement: ∀ (A0 : ℝ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (P : ℝ → ℝ) (L K F : ℝ) (y r : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)), Continuous A0 → (∀ v, 0 < P v) → 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ F → (∀ (x : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (w : ℝ), 0 ≤ w → w ≤ L → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w L, HasDerivAt x (Matrix.mulVec (A0 v) (x v)) v) → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w L, ‖x v‖ ≤ K * (P v / P w) * ‖x w‖) → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt y (Matrix.mulVec (A0 v) (y v) + r v) v) → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, ‖r v‖ ≤ F * P v) → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, ‖y v‖ ≤ K * P v * (‖y 0‖ / P 0 + F * v)

proof.tactics:
by
  have lode : ∀ (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (B : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (g : ℝ → E) (x0 : E), Continuous B → Continuous g → ∃ y : ℝ → E, y 0 = x0 ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt y (B v (y v) + g v) v := by
    intro E _ _ _ B g x0 hB hg
    have : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℝ E
    
    have retr : ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ ρ : E → E, (∀ x y, ‖ρ x - ρ y‖ ≤ 2 * ‖x - y‖) ∧
        (∀ x, ‖ρ x‖ ≤ ‖x‖) ∧ (∀ x, ‖ρ x‖ ≤ R) ∧ (∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ R → ρ x = x) := by
      intro R hR
      refine ⟨fun x => (R / max ‖x‖ R) • x, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x y
        have hmx : 0 < max ‖x‖ R := lt_max_of_lt_right hR
        have hmy : 0 < max ‖y‖ R := lt_max_of_lt_right hR
        obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = R / max ‖x‖ R := ⟨_, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ, b = R / max ‖y‖ R := ⟨_, rfl⟩
        have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by rw [ha]; exact div_nonneg hR.le hmx.le
        have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := by rw [ha]; exact (div_le_one hmx).2 (le_max_right _ _)
        have hyb : ‖y‖ ≤ max ‖y‖ R := le_max_left _ _
        have hab : |a - b| * ‖y‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by
          have e : a - b = a * (max ‖y‖ R - max ‖x‖ R) / max ‖y‖ R := by
            rw [ha, hb]; field_simp
          have hm := abs_max_sub_max_le_abs ‖y‖ ‖x‖ R
          have hn := abs_norm_sub_norm_le y x
          rw [norm_sub_rev] at hn
          rw [e, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha0, abs_of_pos hmy]
          have e2 : a * |max ‖y‖ R - max ‖x‖ R| / max ‖y‖ R * ‖y‖ =
              (a * (‖y‖ / max ‖y‖ R)) * |max ‖y‖ R - max ‖x‖ R| := by ring
          rw [e2]
          have h1 : ‖y‖ / max ‖y‖ R ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hmy).2 hyb
          have h2 : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ / max ‖y‖ R := div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hmy.le
          have h3 : a * (‖y‖ / max ‖y‖ R) ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
          calc a * (‖y‖ / max ‖y‖ R) * |max ‖y‖ R - max ‖x‖ R|
              ≤ 1 * |max ‖y‖ R - max ‖x‖ R| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h3 (abs_nonneg _)
            _ ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by linarith
        have e2 : a • x - b • y = a • (x - y) + (a - b) • y := by
          rw [smul_sub, sub_smul]; abel
        show ‖(R / max ‖x‖ R) • x - (R / max ‖y‖ R) • y‖ ≤ 2 * ‖x - y‖
        rw [← ha, ← hb, e2]
        calc ‖a • (x - y) + (a - b) • y‖ ≤ ‖a • (x - y)‖ + ‖(a - b) • y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = a * ‖x - y‖ + |a - b| * ‖y‖ := by
              rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ha0]
          _ ≤ 1 * ‖x - y‖ + ‖x - y‖ :=
              add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha1 (norm_nonneg _)) hab
          _ = 2 * ‖x - y‖ := by ring
      · intro x
        have hmx : 0 < max ‖x‖ R := lt_max_of_lt_right hR
        show ‖(R / max ‖x‖ R) • x‖ ≤ ‖x‖
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hR.le hmx.le)]
        have ha1 : R / max ‖x‖ R ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hmx).2 (le_max_right _ _)
        calc R / max ‖x‖ R * ‖x‖ ≤ 1 * ‖x‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha1 (norm_nonneg _)
          _ = ‖x‖ := one_mul _
      · intro x
        have hmx : 0 < max ‖x‖ R := lt_max_of_lt_right hR
        show ‖(R / max ‖x‖ R) • x‖ ≤ R
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hR.le hmx.le)]
        rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ hmx]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left _ _) hR.le
      · intro x hx
        show (R / max ‖x‖ R) • x = x
        rw [max_eq_right hx, div_self hR.ne', one_smul]
    
    have fwd : ∀ (r F : ℝ → E) (K ε T : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ ε → 0 ≤ T →
        (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivWithinAt r (F v) (Set.Icc (-T) T) v) →
        (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖F v‖ ≤ K * ‖r v‖ + ε) →
        ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) T, ‖r v‖ ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * T) * Real.exp (K * T) := by
      intro r F K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v hv
      have hcont : ContinuousOn r (Set.Icc 0 T) := fun x hx =>
        ((hd x ⟨by linarith [hx.1], hx.2⟩).continuousWithinAt).mono
          (Set.Icc_subset_Icc (by linarith) le_rfl)
      have h1 := norm_le_gronwallBound_of_norm_deriv_right_le (f := r) (f' := F)
        (δ := ‖r 0‖) (K := K) (ε := ε) (a := 0) (b := T) hcont
        (fun x hx => (hd x ⟨by linarith [hx.1], hx.2.le⟩).mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin
          (Icc_mem_nhdsGE_of_mem ⟨by linarith [hx.1], hx.2⟩)) le_rfl
        (fun x hx => hbd x ⟨by linarith [hx.1], hx.2.le⟩)
        v hv
      rw [sub_zero] at h1
      refine h1.trans ?_
      have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := hv.1
      have hvT : v ≤ T := hv.2
      have hδ : 0 ≤ ‖r 0‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have key : gronwallBound ‖r 0‖ K ε v ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * v) * Real.exp (K * v) := by
        rcases hK.eq_or_lt with h | h
        · subst h
          rw [gronwallBound_K0]
          simp
        · rw [gronwallBound_of_K_ne_0 h.ne']
          have hp := Real.exp_pos (K * v)
          have e1 : Real.exp (K * v) * Real.exp (-(K * v)) = 1 := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
          have e2 := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(K * v))
          have e2' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e2 hp.le
          have e3 : Real.exp (K * v) - 1 ≤ K * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by
            nlinarith
          have hc : ε / K * K = ε := div_mul_cancel₀ ε h.ne'
          have e4 : ε / K * (Real.exp (K * v) - 1) ≤ ε * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by
            calc ε / K * (Real.exp (K * v) - 1) ≤ ε / K * (K * v * Real.exp (K * v)) :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e3 (div_nonneg hε h.le)
              _ = ε / K * K * (v * Real.exp (K * v)) := by ring
              _ = ε * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by rw [hc]; ring
          nlinarith
      refine key.trans ?_
      apply mul_le_mul
      · nlinarith
      · exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      · nlinarith
    
    have gron : ∀ (r F : ℝ → E) (K ε T : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ ε → 0 ≤ T →
        (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivWithinAt r (F v) (Set.Icc (-T) T) v) →
        (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖F v‖ ≤ K * ‖r v‖ + ε) →
        ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖r v‖ ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * T) * Real.exp (K * T) := by
      intro r F K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v hv
      rcases le_or_gt 0 v with h0 | h0
      · exact fwd r F K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v ⟨h0, hv.2⟩
      · have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (Neg.neg : ℝ → ℝ) (Set.Icc (-T) T) (Set.Icc (-T) T) :=
          fun u hu => ⟨by linarith [hu.2], by linarith [hu.1]⟩
        have hd' : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivWithinAt (fun u => r (-u))
            ((fun u => -F (-u)) u) (Set.Icc (-T) T) u := by
          intro u hu
          have h2 : HasDerivWithinAt (r ∘ Neg.neg) ((-1:ℝ) • F (-u)) (Set.Icc (-T) T) u :=
            (hd (-u) (hmaps hu)).scomp u (hasDerivWithinAt_neg u (Set.Icc (-T) T)) hmaps
          have h3 : (-1:ℝ) • F (-u) = -F (-u) := by simp
          rw [h3] at h2
          exact h2
        have hbd' : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖(fun u => -F (-u)) u‖ ≤
            K * ‖(fun u => r (-u)) u‖ + ε := by
          intro u hu
          simp only [norm_neg]
          exact hbd (-u) (hmaps hu)
        have := fwd (fun u => r (-u)) (fun u => -F (-u)) K ε T hK hε hT hd' hbd' (-v)
          ⟨by linarith, by linarith [hv.1]⟩
        simpa only [neg_neg, neg_zero] using this
    
    have exI : ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∃ α : ℝ → E, α 0 = x0 ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivWithinAt α (B t (α t) + g t) (Set.Icc (-T) T) t := by
      intro T hT
      obtain ⟨CB, hCB⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := -T) (b := T)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        hB.continuousOn
      obtain ⟨Cg, hCg⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := -T) (b := T)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        hg.continuousOn
      obtain ⟨K, hKdef⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = max CB 0 + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨G, hGdef⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ, G = max Cg 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hK : 0 < K := by rw [hKdef]; linarith [le_max_right CB 0]
      have hG : 0 ≤ G := by rw [hGdef]; exact le_max_right _ _
      have hBK : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖B t‖ ≤ K := fun t ht => by
        rw [hKdef]; linarith [hCB t ht, le_max_left CB 0]
      have hgG : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖g t‖ ≤ G := fun t ht => by
        rw [hGdef]; exact (hCg t ht).trans (le_max_left _ _)
      obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, R = (‖x0‖ + G * T) * Real.exp (K * T) + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hR : 0 < R := by
        rw [hRdef]
        have h1 := Real.exp_pos (K * T)
        have h2 : 0 ≤ ‖x0‖ + G * T := add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hG hT.le)
        have h3 := mul_nonneg h2 h1.le
        linarith
      obtain ⟨ρ, hρL, hρn, hρR, hρid⟩ := retr R hR
      have hL0 : 0 ≤ K * R + G := add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK.le hR.le) hG
      have t0mem : (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T := ⟨by linarith, hT.le⟩
      have hPL : IsPicardLindelof (fun t x => B t (ρ x) + g t) (⟨0, t0mem⟩ : Set.Icc (-T) T) x0
          ((K * R + G) * T).toNNReal 0 (K * R + G).toNNReal (2 * K).toNNReal := by
        apply IsPicardLindelof.mk
        · intro t ht
          apply LipschitzWith.lipschitzOnWith
          rw [lipschitzWith_iff_norm_sub_le]
          intro x y
          rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (by linarith)]
          show ‖B t (ρ x) + g t - (B t (ρ y) + g t)‖ ≤ 2 * K * ‖x - y‖
          rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← map_sub]
          calc ‖B t (ρ x - ρ y)‖ ≤ ‖B t‖ * ‖ρ x - ρ y‖ := (B t).le_opNorm _
            _ ≤ K * (2 * ‖x - y‖) := mul_le_mul (hBK t ht) (hρL x y) (norm_nonneg _) hK.le
            _ = 2 * K * ‖x - y‖ := by ring
        · intro x _
          exact ((hB.clm_apply continuous_const).add hg).continuousOn
        · intro t ht x _
          rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ hL0]
          calc ‖B t (ρ x) + g t‖ ≤ ‖B t (ρ x)‖ + ‖g t‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ ‖B t‖ * ‖ρ x‖ + ‖g t‖ := add_le_add ((B t).le_opNorm _) le_rfl
            _ ≤ K * R + G := add_le_add (mul_le_mul (hBK t ht) (hρR x) (norm_nonneg _) hK.le)
                (hgG t ht)
        · rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ hL0, Real.coe_toNNReal _ (mul_nonneg hL0 hT.le)]
          have hmax : max (T - (0:ℝ)) ((0:ℝ) - -T) = T := by simp
          show (K * R + G) * max (T - (0:ℝ)) ((0:ℝ) - -T) ≤ (K * R + G) * T - ((0 : NNReal) : ℝ)
          rw [hmax, NNReal.coe_zero, sub_zero]
      obtain ⟨α, hα0, hα⟩ := hPL.exists_eq_forall_mem_Icc_hasDerivWithinAt₀
      have hα0' : α 0 = x0 := hα0
      have hbound := gron α (fun t => B t (ρ (α t)) + g t) K G T hK.le hG hT.le hα
        (fun t ht => by
          calc ‖B t (ρ (α t)) + g t‖ ≤ ‖B t (ρ (α t))‖ + ‖g t‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ ‖B t‖ * ‖ρ (α t)‖ + ‖g t‖ := add_le_add ((B t).le_opNorm _) le_rfl
            _ ≤ K * ‖α t‖ + G := add_le_add (mul_le_mul (hBK t ht) (hρn _) (norm_nonneg _) hK.le)
                (hgG t ht))
      rw [hα0'] at hbound
      refine ⟨α, hα0', fun t ht => ?_⟩
      have hin : ‖α t‖ ≤ R := by linarith [hbound t ht]
      have h2 : HasDerivWithinAt α (B t (ρ (α t)) + g t) (Set.Icc (-T) T) t := hα t ht
      rw [hρid _ hin] at h2
      exact h2
    
    have uniq : ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∀ α β : ℝ → E,
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivWithinAt α (B t (α t) + g t) (Set.Icc (-T) T) t) →
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivWithinAt β (B t (β t) + g t) (Set.Icc (-T) T) t) →
        α 0 = β 0 → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, α t = β t := by
      intro T hT α β hα hβ h0
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := -T) (b := T)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        hB.continuousOn
      have hlip : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T,
          LipschitzOnWith C.toNNReal (fun x => B t x + g t) Set.univ := by
        intro t ht
        apply LipschitzWith.lipschitzOnWith
        rw [lipschitzWith_iff_norm_sub_le]
        intro x y
        show ‖B t x + g t - (B t y + g t)‖ ≤ (C.toNNReal : ℝ) * ‖x - y‖
        rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← map_sub]
        exact ((B t).le_opNorm _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          ((hC t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)).trans (Real.le_coe_toNNReal C)) (norm_nonneg _))
      have hcα : ContinuousOn α (Set.Icc (-T) T) := fun t ht => (hα t ht).continuousWithinAt
      have hcβ : ContinuousOn β (Set.Icc (-T) T) := fun t ht => (hβ t ht).continuousWithinAt
      exact ODE_solution_unique_of_mem_Icc (v := fun t x => B t x + g t) (s := fun _ => Set.univ)
        hlip ⟨by linarith, hT⟩ hcα
        (fun t ht => (hα t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)).hasDerivAt (Icc_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2))
        (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _) hcβ
        (fun t ht => (hβ t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)).hasDerivAt (Icc_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2))
        (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _) h0
    
    choose α hα0 hα using fun n : ℕ => exI ((n:ℝ) + 1) (by positivity)
    have agree : ∀ n m : ℕ, n ≤ m → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ (n:ℝ) + 1 → α n t = α m t := by
      intro n m hnm t ht
      have hnm' : (n:ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.cast_le.mpr hnm
      have hsub : Set.Icc (-((n:ℝ) + 1)) ((n:ℝ) + 1) ⊆ Set.Icc (-((m:ℝ) + 1)) ((m:ℝ) + 1) :=
        Set.Icc_subset_Icc (by linarith) (by linarith)
      exact uniq ((n:ℝ) + 1) (by positivity) (α n) (α m) (hα n)
        (fun s hs => (hα m s (hsub hs)).mono hsub) ((hα0 n).trans (hα0 m).symm) t (abs_le.mp ht)
    refine ⟨fun t => α ⌈|t|⌉₊ t, hα0 _, fun v => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ : ∃ n0 : ℕ, n0 = ⌈|v|⌉₊ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hv : |v| ≤ (n0:ℝ) := by rw [hn0]; exact Nat.le_ceil _
    have hvlt := abs_lt.mp (show |v| < (n0:ℝ) + 1 by linarith)
    have hev : (fun t => α ⌈|t|⌉₊ t) =ᶠ[nhds v] α n0 := by
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds hvlt.1 hvlt.2] with t ht
      have htl : |t| < (n0:ℝ) + 1 := abs_lt.mpr ht
      have hk : |t| ≤ ((⌈|t|⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
      rcases le_total ⌈|t|⌉₊ n0 with h | h
      · exact agree _ _ h t (by linarith)
      · exact (agree _ _ h t htl.le).symm
    have hd : HasDerivAt (α n0) (B v (α n0 v) + g v) v :=
      (hα n0 v ⟨hvlt.1.le, hvlt.2.le⟩).hasDerivAt (Icc_mem_nhds hvlt.1 hvlt.2)
    show HasDerivAt (fun t => α ⌈|t|⌉₊ t) (B v (α ⌈|v|⌉₊ v) + g v) v
    rw [← hn0]
    exact hd.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  intro A0 P L K F y r hA0 hP hK hF hprop hy hr v hv
  
  have through : ∀ (M : ℝ → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (s : ℝ) (b : Fin 3 → ℝ), Continuous M →
      ∃ x : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ), x s = b ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt x (Matrix.mulVec (M t) (x t)) t := by
    intro M s b hM
    obtain ⟨z, hz0, hz⟩ := lode (Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (fun τ => LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Matrix.toLin' (M (τ + s)))) (fun _ => 0) b
      (by
        rw [continuous_clm_apply]
        intro u
        simp only [LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap', Matrix.toLin'_apply]
        exact (hM.comp (continuous_id.add continuous_const)).matrix_mulVec continuous_const)
      continuous_const
    refine ⟨fun t => z (t - s), by simp [hz0], fun t => ?_⟩
    have h1 := (hz (t - s)).comp_sub_const t s
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap', Matrix.toLin'_apply, sub_add_cancel,
      add_zero] at h1
    exact h1
  
  have dotd : ∀ (p q : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (p' q' : Fin 3 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt p p' t →
      HasDerivAt q q' t →
      HasDerivAt (fun τ => dotProduct (p τ) (q τ)) (dotProduct p' (q t) + dotProduct (p t) q') t := by
    intro p q p' q' t hp hq
    have hp' := hasDerivAt_pi.1 hp
    have hq' := hasDerivAt_pi.1 hq
    have h := HasDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun a _ => (hp' a).mul (hq' a))
    have e : dotProduct p' (q t) + dotProduct (p t) q' =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, (p' a * q t a + p t a * q' a) := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [e]
    exact h
  
  have alg : ∀ (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (ψ z : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      dotProduct (Matrix.mulVec (-(Matrix.transpose M)) ψ) z + dotProduct ψ (Matrix.mulVec M z) = 0 := by
    intro M ψ z
    rw [Matrix.neg_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_transpose, neg_dotProduct, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]
    exact neg_add_cancel _
  have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := hv.1
  have hvL : v ≤ L := hv.2
  have hPv := hP v
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ K * P v * (‖y 0‖ / P 0 + F * v) := by
    apply mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK hPv.le)
    exact add_nonneg (div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (hP 0).le) (mul_nonneg hF hv0)
  refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hR0).2 (fun i => ?_)
  have hMc : Continuous (fun t => -(Matrix.transpose (A0 t : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ))) :=
    (Continuous.matrix_transpose (A := fun t => (A0 t : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) hA0).neg
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψv, hψ⟩ := through (fun t => -(Matrix.transpose (A0 t : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)))
    v (Pi.single i 1) hMc
  
  have star : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ v → ∀ b : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      |dotProduct (ψ s) b| ≤ K * (P v / P s) * ‖b‖ := by
    intro s hs0 hsv b
    obtain ⟨x, hxs, hx⟩ := through (fun t => (A0 t : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) s b hA0
    have hd : ∀ τ : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun τ => dotProduct (ψ τ) (x τ)) 0 τ := by
      intro τ
      exact (dotd ψ x _ _ τ (hψ τ) (hx τ)).congr_deriv (alg (A0 τ) (ψ τ) (x τ))
    have hconst : ∀ a c : ℝ, dotProduct (ψ a) (x a) = dotProduct (ψ c) (x c) :=
      is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun τ => (hd τ).differentiableAt) (fun τ => (hd τ).deriv)
    have e1 : dotProduct (ψ s) b = x v i := by
      rw [← hxs, hconst s v, hψv, single_dotProduct, one_mul]
    have hb := hprop x s hs0 (le_trans hsv hvL) (fun t _ => hx t) v ⟨hsv, hvL⟩
    rw [hxs] at hb
    rw [e1, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact le_trans (norm_le_pi_norm (x v) i) hb
  
  have hGd : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) v, HasDerivWithinAt (fun τ => dotProduct (ψ τ) (y τ))
      (dotProduct (ψ t) (r t)) (Set.Icc 0 v) t := by
    intro t ht
    have htL : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 L := ⟨ht.1, le_trans ht.2 hvL⟩
    have h := dotd ψ y _ _ t (hψ t) (hy t htL)
    have e : dotProduct (Matrix.mulVec (-(Matrix.transpose (A0 t : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ))) (ψ t))
        (y t) + dotProduct (ψ t) (Matrix.mulVec (A0 t) (y t) + r t) = dotProduct (ψ t) (r t) := by
      have h0 := alg (A0 t) (ψ t) (y t)
      rw [dotProduct_add]
      linarith
    exact (h.congr_deriv e).hasDerivWithinAt
  
  have hGb : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ico (0:ℝ) v, ‖dotProduct (ψ t) (r t)‖ ≤ K * F * P v := by
    intro t ht
    have htL : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 L := ⟨ht.1, le_trans ht.2.le hvL⟩
    have hPt := hP t
    have h1 := star t ht.1 ht.2.le (r t)
    have h2 : K * (P v / P t) * ‖r t‖ ≤ K * (P v / P t) * (F * P t) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hr t htL) (mul_nonneg hK (div_nonneg hPv.le hPt.le))
    have hc : P v / P t * P t = P v := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hPt.ne'
    have h3 : K * (P v / P t) * (F * P t) = K * F * P v := by
      calc K * (P v / P t) * (F * P t) = K * F * (P v / P t * P t) := by ring
        _ = K * F * P v := by rw [hc]
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    linarith
  
  have hmvt : ‖dotProduct (ψ v) (y v) - dotProduct (ψ 0) (y 0)‖ ≤ K * F * P v * (v - 0) :=
    norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le_segment' hGd hGb v ⟨hv0, le_rfl⟩
  
  have hG0 := star 0 le_rfl hv0 (y 0)
  have hGv : dotProduct (ψ v) (y v) = y v i := by rw [hψv, single_dotProduct, one_mul]
  rw [hGv, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hmvt
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have htri := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (y v i) (dotProduct (ψ 0) (y 0))
  have e : K * (P v / P 0) * ‖y 0‖ + K * F * P v * (v - 0) =
      K * P v * (‖y 0‖ / P 0 + F * v) := by ring
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (U : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (g : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (s0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (j : ℕ) (v : ℝ), IsOpen U → s0 ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → HasDerivAt (fun v' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => g (s, v')) s0) (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => deriv (fun v'' => g (s, v'')) v) s0) v

signature.statement: ∀ (U : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (g : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (s0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (j : ℕ) (v : ℝ), IsOpen U → s0 ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → HasDerivAt (fun v' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => g (s, v')) s0) (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => deriv (fun v'' => g (s, v'')) v) s0) v

proof.tactics:
by
  intro U g s0 j v hU hs0 hg
  
  
  have symmG : ∀ {E V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup V]
      [NormedSpace ℝ V] (U : Set E) (f : E → V), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ z ∈ U,
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (w : Fin m → E) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)),
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z (w ∘ σ) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z w := by
    intro E V _ _ _ _ U f hU hf z hz m w σ
    have hperm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (n : ℕ)
        (A : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => E) W),
        (∀ (i : Fin n) (w : Fin (n + 1) → E), A (w ∘ Equiv.swap i.castSucc i.succ) = A w) →
        ∀ (w : Fin (n + 1) → E) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))), A (w ∘ σ) = A w := by
      intro W _ _ n A hA w σ
      have hσ : σ ∈ Submonoid.closure (Set.range fun i : Fin n => Equiv.swap i.castSucc i.succ) := by
        rw [Equiv.Perm.mclosure_swap_castSucc_succ]; exact Submonoid.mem_top σ
      induction hσ using Submonoid.closure_induction generalizing w with
      | mem x hx => obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx; exact hA i w
      | one => rfl
      | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
        rw [Equiv.Perm.coe_mul, ← Function.comp_assoc, hy, hx]
    have Q : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (g : E → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ (u : Fin (k + 2) → E) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (k + 2))),
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2) g y (u ∘ τ) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2) g y u := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro W _ _ g hg y hy u τ
        refine hperm 1 (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 g y) ?_ u τ
        intro i v
        have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        subst hi
        have hS : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ g y :=
          (hg.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)).isSymmSndFDerivAt
            (by rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]; exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply, iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
        simp only [Function.comp_apply]
        have h0 : Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 1).castSucc (0 : Fin 1).succ 0 = 1 := by decide
        have h1 : Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 1).castSucc (0 : Fin 1).succ 1 = 0 := by decide
        rw [h0, h1]
        exact hS.eq _ _
      | succ k ih =>
        intro W _ _ g hg y hy u τ
        have hgy : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g y := hg.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
        have hzero : ∀ v : Fin (k + 2 + 1) → E,
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y
              (v ∘ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (k + 2)).castSucc (0 : Fin (k + 2)).succ) =
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y v := by
          intro v
          have hg' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ g) U :=
            ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).mp hg).2
          rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right (n := k + 2), iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right (n := k + 2)]
          have hlast : (v ∘ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (k + 2)).castSucc (0 : Fin (k + 2)).succ)
              (Fin.last (k + 2)) = v (Fin.last (k + 2)) := by
            simp only [Function.comp_apply]
            rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne]
            · apply Fin.ne_of_val_ne; simp
            · apply Fin.ne_of_val_ne; simp
          have hinit : Fin.init (v ∘ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (k + 2)).castSucc (0 : Fin (k + 2)).succ) =
              Fin.init v ∘ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (k + 1)).castSucc (0 : Fin (k + 1)).succ := by
            funext l
            simp only [Fin.init, Function.comp_apply]
            congr 1
            rw [Function.Injective.map_swap (Fin.castSucc_injective _)]
            congr 1
          rw [hlast, hinit]
          exact congrArg (fun A => A (v (Fin.last (k + 2))))
            (ih (fderiv ℝ g) hg' y hy (Fin.init v)
              (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (k + 1)).castSucc (0 : Fin (k + 1)).succ))
        have hsucc : ∀ (j : Fin (k + 1)) (v : Fin (k + 2 + 1) → E),
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y (v ∘ Equiv.swap j.succ.castSucc j.succ.succ) =
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y v := by
          intro j v
          rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left (n := k + 2), iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left (n := k + 2)]
          have h0 : (v ∘ Equiv.swap j.succ.castSucc j.succ.succ) 0 = v 0 := by
            simp only [Function.comp_apply]
            rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne]
            · rw [← Fin.succ_castSucc]; exact (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm
            · exact (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm
          have htail : Fin.tail (v ∘ Equiv.swap j.succ.castSucc j.succ.succ) =
              Fin.tail v ∘ Equiv.swap j.castSucc j.succ := by
            funext l
            simp only [Fin.tail, Function.comp_apply]
            rw [Function.Injective.map_swap (Fin.succ_injective _), Fin.succ_castSucc]
          rw [h0, htail]
          have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2) g) y :=
            hgy.differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv
              (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (ENat.natCast_lt_top (k + 2)))
          rw [← fderiv_continuousMultilinear_apply_const_apply hd
                (Fin.tail v ∘ Equiv.swap j.castSucc j.succ) (v 0),
              ← fderiv_continuousMultilinear_apply_const_apply hd (Fin.tail v) (v 0)]
          congr 1
          apply Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq
          filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hy] with y' hy'
          exact ih g hg y' hy' _ _
        show iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y (u ∘ τ) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y u
        refine hperm (k + 2) (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y) ?_ u τ
        intro i v
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
        · exact hzero v
        · exact hsucc j v
    rcases m with _ | _ | k
    · congr 1; funext i; exact Fin.elim0 i
    · congr 1; funext i; simp only [Function.comp_apply]; congr 1
      exact Fin.ext (by have := (σ i).isLt; have := i.isLt; omega)
    · exact Q k f hf z hz w σ
  
  
  have pbG : ∀ {E E' V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup E']
      [NormedSpace ℝ E'] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (O : Set E) (h : E → V) (c : E)
      (M : E' →L[ℝ] E) (y0 : E') (n : ℕ), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h O → c + M y0 ∈ O →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => h (c + M y)) y0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n h (c + M y0)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => M) := by
    intro E E' V _ _ _ _ _ _ O h c M y0 n hO hh hc
    have hO1o : IsOpen {z : E | c + z ∈ O} := hO.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hh1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => h (c + z)) {z : E | c + z ∈ O} :=
      hh.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
    have hO2o : IsOpen (M ⁻¹' {z : E | c + z ∈ O}) := hO1o.preimage M.continuous
    have hy0 : y0 ∈ M ⁻¹' {z : E | c + z ∈ O} := hc
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := (fun z => h (c + z)) ∘ M) n hO2o hy0
    have e2 := M.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right hh1 hO1o.uniqueDiffOn hO2o.uniqueDiffOn hy0 (i := n)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => h (c + z)) n hO1o
      (show M y0 ∈ {z : E | c + z ∈ O} from hc)
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left] at e3
    show iteratedFDeriv ℝ n ((fun z => h (c + z)) ∘ M) y0 = _
    rw [← e1, e2, e3]
  
  
  obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ), O = U ×ˢ Set.univ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hOdef] at hg
  have hO : IsOpen O := by rw [hOdef]; exact hU.prod isOpen_univ
  have hmem : ∀ s ∈ U, ∀ r : ℝ, ((s, r) : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) ∈ O := by
    intro s hs r; rw [hOdef]; exact ⟨hs, trivial⟩
  obtain ⟨ι, hι⟩ : ∃ M : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ,
      M = ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ℝ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have star : ∀ (h : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h O → ∀ s ∈ U, ∀ r : ℝ,
      ∀ n : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun s' => h (s', r)) s =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n h (s, r)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => ι) := by
    intro h hh s hs r n
    have hcy : ∀ y : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, (((0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), r) : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) + ι y = (y, r) := by
      intro y; rw [hι]; simp
    have := pbG O h ((0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), r) ι s n hO hh (by rw [hcy]; exact hmem s hs r)
    simp only [hcy] at this
    exact this
  have p0O : ((s0, v) : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) ∈ O := hmem s0 hs0 v
  have hgp : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g (s0, v) := hg.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds p0O)
  have hΦd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g) (s0, v) :=
    hgp.differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (ENat.natCast_lt_top j))
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ, e = ((0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hγ : ∀ s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => ((s, r) : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ)) e v := by
    intro s; rw [he]; exact (hasDerivAt_const v s).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id v)
  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun r => iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g (s0, r))
      (fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g) (s0, v) e) v :=
    hΦd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt v (hγ s0)
  obtain ⟨Cι, hCι⟩ : ∃ C : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) (Fin 3 → ℝ)
      →L[ℝ] ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (Fin 3 → ℝ),
      C = ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMapL (fun _ => ι) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun v' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => g (s, v')) s0)
      (Cι (fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g) (s0, v) e)) v := by
    have h := Cι.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt v h1
    convert h using 1
    funext r
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, hCι, ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMapL_apply]
    exact star g hg s0 hs0 r j
  refine h2.congr_deriv ?_
  
  have hfd' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ g) O := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).mp hg).2
  obtain ⟨g1, hg1⟩ : ∃ g1 : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ), g1 = fun y => fderiv ℝ g y e :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hg1s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g1 O := by rw [hg1]; exact hfd'.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hg1comp : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g1 (s0, v) =
      (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (Fin 3 → ℝ) e).compContinuousMultilinearMap
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun y => fderiv ℝ g y) (s0, v)) := by
    rw [hg1]
    exact (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (Fin 3 → ℝ) e).iteratedFDeriv_comp_left
      (hfd'.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds p0O)) (i := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hderiv_eq : (fun s => g1 (s, v)) =ᶠ[nhds s0] (fun s => deriv (fun v'' => g (s, v'')) v) := by
    filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hs0] with s hs
    have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (s, v) :=
      (hg.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds (hmem s hs v))).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun v'' => g (s, v'')) (fderiv ℝ g (s, v) e) v :=
      hfd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt v (hγ s)
    rw [h3.deriv, hg1]
  rw [← (hderiv_eq.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds, star g1 hg1s s0 hs0 v j, hCι]
  ext m
  simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMapL_apply,
    ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
  rw [hg1comp, ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply]
  have hL : iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j + 1) g (s0, v)
      (Fin.cons e (fun i => ι (m i)) : Fin (j + 1) → (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) =
      fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g) (s0, v) e (fun i => ι (m i)) := by
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.tail_cons]
  have hR : iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j + 1) g (s0, v)
      (Fin.snoc (fun i => ι (m i)) e : Fin (j + 1) → (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun y => fderiv ℝ g y) (s0, v) (fun i => ι (m i)) e := by
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right, Fin.init_snoc, Fin.snoc_last]
  have hrot : (Fin.cons e (fun i => ι (m i)) : Fin (j + 1) → (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) ∘ finRotate (j + 1) =
      (Fin.snoc (fun i => ι (m i)) e : Fin (j + 1) → (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) := by
    funext i
    exact (congrFun (Fin.snoc_eq_cons_rotate (fun i => ι (m i)) e) i).symm
  have hsymm := symmG O g hO hg (s0, v) p0O (j + 1)
    (Fin.cons e (fun i => ι (m i)) : Fin (j + 1) → (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) (finRotate (j + 1))
  rw [← hL, ← hR, ← hrot]
  exact congrFun hsymm.symm _

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (a : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (y : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (s0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (Λ : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (j : ℕ) (Qa : ℝ) (Cy : ℕ → ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ a s0 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ y s0 → (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ j → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i a s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤ Qa) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < j → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i y s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤ Cy i) → ∀ m : Fin j → (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => Matrix.mulVec (a s) (y s)) s0) (fun i => Λ (m i)) - Matrix.mulVec (a s0) ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j y s0) (fun i => Λ (m i)))‖ ≤ 3 * Qa * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose i : ℝ) * Cy i) * ∏ i, ‖m i‖

signature.name: slowjet_leibniz_rem_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (a : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (y : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (s0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (Λ : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (j : ℕ) (Qa : ℝ) (Cy : ℕ → ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ a s0 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ y s0 → (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ j → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i a s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤ Qa) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < j → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i y s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤ Cy i) → ∀ m : Fin j → (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => Matrix.mulVec (a s) (y s)) s0) (fun i => Λ (m i)) - Matrix.mulVec (a s0) ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j y s0) (fun i => Λ (m i)))‖ ≤ 3 * Qa * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose i : ℝ) * Cy i) * ∏ i, ‖m i‖

proof.tactics:
by
  intro a y s0 Λ j Qa Cy ha hy hA hY m
  
  obtain ⟨Bil, hBn, hBap⟩ : ∃ B : (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ‖B‖ ≤ 3 ∧ ∀ (M : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (z : Fin 3 → ℝ), B M z = Matrix.mulVec M z := by
    let B0 : (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ) :=
      LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ (fun M z => Matrix.mulVec M z)
        (fun M1 M2 z => Matrix.add_mulVec M1 M2 z)
        (fun c M z => by ext i; simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc])
        (fun M z1 z2 => Matrix.mulVec_add M z1 z2)
        (fun c M z => by
          ext i
          simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => by ring))
    have hb : ∀ M z, ‖B0 M z‖ ≤ 3 * ‖M‖ * ‖z‖ := by
      intro M z
      refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)).2 (fun i => ?_)
      show ‖∑ j, M i j * z j‖ ≤ _
      calc ‖∑ j, M i j * z j‖ ≤ ∑ j, ‖M i j * z j‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖M‖ * ‖z‖ := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => by
            rw [norm_mul]
            exact mul_le_mul ((norm_le_pi_norm (M i) j).trans (norm_le_pi_norm M i))
              (norm_le_pi_norm z j) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
        _ = 3 * ‖M‖ * ‖z‖ := by simp; ring
    exact ⟨B0.mkContinuous₂ 3 hb, LinearMap.mkContinuous₂_norm_le _ (by norm_num) hb, fun M z => rfl⟩
  
  have lb : ∀ (f : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)) (g : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → (Fin 3 → ℝ)),
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f s0 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g s0 →
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun x => Bil (f x) (g x)) s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤
        ‖Bil‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) *
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ *
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j - i) g s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ := by
    intro f g hf hg
    have hf' : ContDiffAt ℝ j f s0 := hf.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hg' : ContDiffAt ℝ j g s0 := hg.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    obtain ⟨uf, huf, hfu⟩ := hf'.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
    obtain ⟨ug, hug, hgu⟩ := hg'.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
    obtain ⟨O, hOsub, hOopen, hxO⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp (Filter.inter_mem huf hug)
    have hfO : ContDiffOn ℝ j f O := hfu.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).1)
    have hgO : ContDiffOn ℝ j g O := hgu.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).2)
    have hBO : ContDiffOn ℝ j (fun x => Bil (f x) (g x)) O :=
      (Bil.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hfO).clm_apply hgO
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), s = (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) => s0 + z) ⁻¹' O :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hOopen.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑Λ ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage Λ.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show s0 + 0 ∈ O; rw [add_zero]; exact hxO
    have hL0s : Λ 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈ ⇑Λ ⁻¹' s := hL0s
    have hsm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ j F O → ContDiffOn ℝ j (fun z => F (s0 + z)) s := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have hsmO : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ j F O → ContDiffOn ℝ j (fun z => F (s0 + Λ z)) (⇑Λ ⁻¹' s) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact (hsm F hF).comp Λ.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
    have key : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ j F O → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ j →
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (s0 + Λ z)) 0 =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF i hi
      have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (s0 + Λ z)) i hO h0O
      have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right Λ (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
        hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
      have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (s0 + z)) i hs h0s
      have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i s0 0
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (s0 + Λ z)) 0
          = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (s0 + z)) ∘ ⇑Λ) (⇑Λ ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (s0 + z)) s (Λ 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => Λ) := e2
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (s0 + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => Λ) := by rw [map_zero]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (s0 + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => Λ) := by rw [e3]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
    have hl := ContinuousLinearMap.norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_le_of_bilinear Bil (hsmO f hfO)
      (hsmO g hgO) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O (n := j) le_rfl
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => Bil (f (s0 + Λ y)) (g (s0 + Λ y))) j hO h0O]
      at hl
    rw [← key _ hBO j le_rfl]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z => (fun x => Bil (f x) (g x)) (s0 + Λ z)) 0‖
        = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun y => Bil (f (s0 + Λ y)) (g (s0 + Λ y))) 0‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ _ := hl
      _ = _ := by
        congr 1
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        have hik : i ≤ j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f (s0 + Λ z)) i hO h0O,
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => g (s0 + Λ z)) (j - i) hO h0O,
          key f hfO i hik, key g hgO (j - i) (Nat.sub_le j i)]
  
  have hφ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s => a s - a s0) s0 := ha.sub contDiffAt_const
  have hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s => Bil (a s - a s0) (y s)) s0 :=
    (show ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s => Bil (a s - a s0)) s0 from
      Bil.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp s0 hφ).clm_apply hy
  have hT : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s => Bil (a s0) (y s)) s0 :=
    (Bil (a s0)).contDiff.contDiffAt.comp s0 hy
  have hfun : (fun s => Matrix.mulVec (a s) (y s)) =
      (fun s => Bil (a s - a s0) (y s)) + (fun s => Bil (a s0) (y s)) := by
    funext s
    rw [Pi.add_apply, ← ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ← map_add, sub_add_cancel, hBap]
  
  have hD : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => Matrix.mulVec (a s) (y s)) s0 (fun i => Λ (m i)) -
      Matrix.mulVec (a s0) (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j y s0 (fun i => Λ (m i))) =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => Bil (a s - a s0) (y s)) s0 (fun i => Λ (m i)) := by
    rw [hfun, iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (hg.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      (hT.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
    have e := (Bil (a s0)).iteratedFDeriv_comp_left hy (i := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e' : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => Bil (a s0) (y s)) s0 =
        (Bil (a s0)).compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j y s0) := e
    rw [e', ContinuousMultilinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply, hBap,
      add_sub_cancel_right]
  have hle : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => Bil (a s - a s0) (y s)) s0 (fun i => Λ (m i))‖ ≤
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => Bil (a s - a s0) (y s)) s0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Λ)‖ * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := by
    have h := ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => Bil (a s - a s0) (y s)) s0).compContinuousLinearMap
      (fun _ => Λ)).le_opNorm m
    simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply] at h
    exact h
  
  have h0 : ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun s => a s - a s0) s0).compContinuousLinearMap
      (fun _ => Λ)‖ = 0 := by
    apply le_antisymm _ (norm_nonneg _)
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, sub_self, norm_zero, zero_mul]
  have hφi : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≠ 0 →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun s => a s - a s0) s0 = iteratedFDeriv ℝ i a s0 := by
    intro i hi
    have e := iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply (ha.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      (contDiffAt_const : ContDiffAt ℝ i (fun _ => a s0) s0)
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne hi, Pi.zero_apply, sub_zero] at e
    exact e
  have hμ : 0 ≤ ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) *
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun s => a s - a s0) s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ *
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j - i) y s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
      (norm_nonneg _))
  have hS : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) *
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun s => a s - a s0) s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ *
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j - i) y s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤
      Qa * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose i : ℝ) * Cy i := by
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', h0, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose (i + 1) : ℝ) *
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (i + 1) (fun s => a s - a s0) s0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Λ)‖ *
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j - (i + 1)) y s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, Qa * ((j.choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * Cy (j - (i + 1))) := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => ?_)
          have hi' := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
          rw [hφi (i + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero i)]
          have hN := hA (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
          have hNy := hY (j - (i + 1)) (by omega)
          have hQa0 : 0 ≤ Qa := (norm_nonneg _).trans hN
          have hC0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (j.choose (i + 1) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
          calc (j.choose (i + 1) : ℝ) *
                ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (i + 1) a s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ *
                ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j - (i + 1)) y s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖
              ≤ (j.choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * Qa * Cy (j - (i + 1)) :=
                mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hN hC0) hNy (norm_nonneg _)
                  (mul_nonneg hC0 hQa0)
            _ = Qa * ((j.choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * Cy (j - (i + 1))) := by ring
      _ = Qa * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * Cy (j - (i + 1)) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = Qa * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose i : ℝ) * Cy i := by
          congr 1
          have r1 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * Cy (j - (i + 1)) =
              ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (fun l => (j.choose (j - l) : ℝ) * Cy l) (j - 1 - i) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
            have hi' := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
            have e1 : j - (j - 1 - i) = i + 1 := by omega
            have e2 : j - 1 - i = j - (i + 1) := by omega
            show (j.choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * Cy (j - (i + 1)) =
              (j.choose (j - (j - 1 - i)) : ℝ) * Cy (j - 1 - i)
            rw [e1, e2]
          refine r1.trans ((Finset.sum_range_reflect (fun l => (j.choose (j - l) : ℝ) * Cy l) j).trans ?_)
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l hl => ?_)
          show (j.choose (j - l) : ℝ) * Cy l = (j.choose l : ℝ) * Cy l
          rw [Nat.choose_symm (Finset.mem_range.mp hl).le]
  
  have hLb := lb (fun s => a s - a s0) y hφ hy
  rw [hD]
  calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => Bil (a s - a s0) (y s)) s0 (fun i => Λ (m i))‖
      ≤ ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => Bil (a s - a s0) (y s)) s0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Λ)‖ * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := hle
    _ ≤ (3 * (Qa * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose i : ℝ) * Cy i)) * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hμ
        exact hLb.trans (mul_le_mul hBn hS hS0 (by norm_num))
    _ = 3 * Qa * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose i : ℝ) * Cy i) * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := by ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (r1 r2 P : Cyl → ℂ) (Dv W : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (Km : Cyl → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (n : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (c0 : ℝ) (μ κ : ℂ) (k : ℕ) (R E M : ℝ), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ r1 U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ r2 U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Dv U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ W U → (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => Km η a b) U) → (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => n η a) U) → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB h r1 j ξ ≤ R ∧ NB h r2 j ξ ≤ R) → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB h Dv j ξ ≤ E ∧ NB h W j ξ ≤ E ∧ NB h P j ξ ≤ E) → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → (∀ a b : Fin 3, NB h (fun η => Km η a b) j ξ ≤ M) ∧ (∀ a : Fin 3, NB h (fun η => n η a) j ξ ≤ M)) → NB h (fun η => r1 η • (Dv η + (pulseMatC (Km η)).mulVec (W η) + (μ * ((c0 * dotProduct (n η) (n η) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • W η) + (r2 η * κ * P η) • (fun i => ((n η i : ℝ) : ℂ))) k ξ ≤ 8 ^ k * R * E * (1 + 3 * M + 3 * ‖μ‖ * |c0| * M ^ 2 + ‖κ‖ * M)

signature.name: nb_princ_shape
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (r1 r2 P : Cyl → ℂ) (Dv W : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (Km : Cyl → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (n : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (c0 : ℝ) (μ κ : ℂ) (k : ℕ) (R E M : ℝ), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ r1 U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ r2 U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Dv U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ W U → (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => Km η a b) U) → (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => n η a) U) → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB h r1 j ξ ≤ R ∧ NB h r2 j ξ ≤ R) → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB h Dv j ξ ≤ E ∧ NB h W j ξ ≤ E ∧ NB h P j ξ ≤ E) → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → (∀ a b : Fin 3, NB h (fun η => Km η a b) j ξ ≤ M) ∧ (∀ a : Fin 3, NB h (fun η => n η a) j ξ ≤ M)) → NB h (fun η => r1 η • (Dv η + (pulseMatC (Km η)).mulVec (W η) + (μ * ((c0 * dotProduct (n η) (n η) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • W η) + (r2 η * κ * P η) • (fun i => ((n η i : ℝ) : ℂ))) k ξ ≤ 8 ^ k * R * E * (1 + 3 * M + 3 * ‖μ‖ * |c0| * M ^ 2 + ‖κ‖ * M)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h U ξ r1 r2 P Dv W Km n c0 μ κ k R E M hU hξ hr1 hr2 hP hDv hW hKm hn HR HE HM
  have hUn : U ∈ nhds ξ := hU.mem_nhds hξ
  
  have nbnn : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V) (j : ℕ),
      0 ≤ NB h f j ξ := by
    intro V _ _ f j
    unfold NB
    exact norm_nonneg _
  have clm : ∀ {V V' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup V']
      [NormedSpace ℝ V'] (L : V →L[ℝ] V') (f : Cyl → V) (j : ℕ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ →
      NB h (fun η => L (f η)) j ξ ≤ ‖L‖ * NB h f j ξ := by
    intro V V' _ _ _ _ L f j hf
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (⇑L ∘ f) ξ = L.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ) :=
      L.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left hf (i := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e0 : (fun η => L (f η)) = ⇑L ∘ f := rfl
    unfold NB
    rw [e0, e1]
    have e2 : (L.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) =
        L.compContinuousMultilinearMap ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)) := by
      ext v
      rfl
    rw [e2]
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
  have add : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f g : Cyl → V) (j : ℕ),
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g ξ →
      NB h (fun η => f η + g η) j ξ ≤ NB h f j ξ + NB h g j ξ := by
    intro V _ _ f g j hf hg
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (f + g) ξ = iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g ξ :=
      iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (hf.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)) (hg.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    have e0 : (fun η => f η + g η) = f + g := rfl
    unfold NB
    rw [e0, e1]
    have e2 : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) +
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) := by
      ext v
      rfl
    rw [e2]
    exact norm_add_le _ _
  have pi3 : ∀ (F : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (j : ℕ) (X : ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F ξ → 0 ≤ X →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, NB h (fun η => F η i) j ξ ≤ X) → NB h F j ξ ≤ X := by
    intro F j X hF hX hi
    unfold NB
    refine ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound hX (fun m => ?_)
    rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hX (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun l _ => norm_nonneg _)))]
    intro i
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) i) ∘ F) ξ =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) i).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j F ξ) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left _ hF (i := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e0 : (fun η => F η i) = ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) i) ∘ F := rfl
    have e2 : ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)) m i =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => F η i) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)) m := by
      rw [e0, e1]
      rfl
    rw [e2]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => F η i) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ *
          ∏ l, ‖m l‖ := ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ ≤ X * ∏ l, ‖m l‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hi i) (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun l _ => norm_nonneg _))
  
  have leib : ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℂ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → ∀ kk : ℕ,
      NB h (fun η => f η * g η) kk ξ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (kk + 1), (kk.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h g (kk - i) ξ := by
    intro f g hf hg kk
    unfold NB
    generalize Lnorm h ξ = L
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage L.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
    have hL0s : L 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
    have hsm : ∀ F : Cyl → ℂ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
      intro F hF
      exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have hsmO : ∀ F : Cyl → ℂ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by
      intro F hF
      exact (hsm F hF).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
    have key : ∀ F : Cyl → ℂ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → ∀ i : ℕ,
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0 =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
      intro F hF i
      have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O
      have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
        hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + z)) i hs h0s
      have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i ξ 0
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0
          = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑L) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := e2
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [map_zero]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [e3]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
    have hfg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => f η * g η) U := hf.mul hg
    have leib0 := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le (hsmO f hf) (hsmO g hg) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O
      (n := kk) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => f (ξ + L y) * g (ξ + L y)) kk hO h0O] at leib0
    rw [← key _ hfg kk]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ kk (fun z => (fun η => f η * g η) (ξ + L z)) 0‖
        = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ kk (fun y => f (ξ + L y) * g (ξ + L y)) 0‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ _ := leib0
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O,
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => g (ξ + L z)) (kk - i) hO h0O,
          key f hf i, key g hg (kk - i)]
  obtain ⟨a2, ha2⟩ : ∃ a2 : ℝ, a2 = 2 ^ k := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ha1 : 1 ≤ a2 := by rw [ha2]; exact one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a2 := by linarith
  have mulu : ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℂ) (X Y : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ Y →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h f i ξ ≤ X ∧ NB h g i ξ ≤ Y) → ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k →
      NB h (fun η => f η * g η) j ξ ≤ a2 * X * Y := by
    intro f g X Y hf hg hX hY hb j hj
    refine (leib f g hf hg j).trans ?_
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h g (j - i) ξ
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) * X * Y := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          have hi' : i ≤ j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          have h1 := (hb i (by omega)).1
          have h2 := (hb (j - i) (by omega)).2
          have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ (j.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hc) h2 (nbnn g (j - i)) (mul_nonneg hc hX)
      _ = (2:ℝ) ^ j * X * Y := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul]
          congr 2
          exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose j
      _ ≤ a2 * X * Y := by
          rw [ha2]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hj) hX) hY
  have cmul : ∀ (c : ℂ) (f : Cyl → ℂ) (j : ℕ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ →
      NB h (fun η => c * f η) j ξ ≤ ‖c‖ * NB h f j ξ := by
    intro c f j hf
    have e := clm (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℂ c) f j hf
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply'] at e
    exact e.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_mul_apply_le ℝ ℂ c) (nbnn f j))
  have hg1 : ‖(Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun x => by
      rw [Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, Complex.norm_real, one_mul])
  have ofr : ∀ (g : Cyl → ℝ) (j : ℕ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g ξ →
      NB h (fun η => ((g η : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ ≤ NB h g j ξ := by
    intro g j hg
    have e := clm Complex.ofRealCLM g j hg
    simp only [Complex.ofRealCLM_apply] at e
    exact e.trans (mul_le_of_le_one_left (nbnn g j) hg1)
  have hp1 : ∀ b : Fin 3, ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) b)‖ ≤ 1 :=
    fun b => ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun x => by
      rw [one_mul]; exact norm_le_pi_norm x b)
  have prj : ∀ (F : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (b : Fin 3) (j : ℕ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F ξ →
      NB h (fun η => F η b) j ξ ≤ NB h F j ξ := by
    intro F b j hF
    have e := clm (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) b) F j hF
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply] at e
    exact e.trans (mul_le_of_le_one_left (nbnn F j) (hp1 b))
  
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ R := (nbnn r1 0).trans (HR 0 (Nat.zero_le _)).1
  have hE0 : 0 ≤ E := (nbnn W 0).trans (HE 0 (Nat.zero_le _)).2.1
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (nbnn (fun η => n η 0) 0).trans ((HM 0 (Nat.zero_le _)).2 0)
  
  have hntS : ∀ p : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((n η p : ℝ) : ℂ)) U := fun p =>
    (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (hn p)).congr (fun η _ => by simp)
  have hKtS : ∀ i b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((Km η i b : ℝ) : ℂ)) U := fun i b =>
    (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (hKm i b)).congr (fun η _ => by simp)
  have hWS : ∀ b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => W η b) U := fun b => contDiffOn_pi.1 hW b
  have hDvS : ∀ b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => Dv η b) U := fun b => contDiffOn_pi.1 hDv b
  have hKWS : ∀ i b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((Km η i b : ℝ) : ℂ) * W η b) U :=
    fun i b => (hKtS i b).mul (hWS b)
  have hnnS : ∀ p : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((n η p : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((n η p : ℝ) : ℂ)) U :=
    fun p => (hntS p).mul (hntS p)
  
  have bK : ∀ i b : Fin 3, ∀ j, j ≤ k → NB h (fun η => ((Km η i b : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ ≤ M :=
    fun i b j hj => (ofr (fun η => Km η i b) j ((hKm i b).contDiffAt hUn)).trans ((HM j hj).1 i b)
  have bn : ∀ p : Fin 3, ∀ j, j ≤ k → NB h (fun η => ((n η p : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ ≤ M :=
    fun p j hj => (ofr (fun η => n η p) j ((hn p).contDiffAt hUn)).trans ((HM j hj).2 p)
  have bW : ∀ b : Fin 3, ∀ j, j ≤ k → NB h (fun η => W η b) j ξ ≤ E :=
    fun b j hj => (prj W b j (hW.contDiffAt hUn)).trans (HE j hj).2.1
  have bDv : ∀ b : Fin 3, ∀ j, j ≤ k → NB h (fun η => Dv η b) j ξ ≤ E :=
    fun b j hj => (prj Dv b j (hDv.contDiffAt hUn)).trans (HE j hj).1
  have bKW : ∀ i b : Fin 3, ∀ j, j ≤ k →
      NB h (fun η => ((Km η i b : ℝ) : ℂ) * W η b) j ξ ≤ a2 * M * E :=
    fun i b => mulu _ _ M E (hKtS i b) (hWS b) hM0 hE0 (fun j hj => ⟨bK i b j hj, bW b j hj⟩)
  have bnn : ∀ p : Fin 3, ∀ j, j ≤ k →
      NB h (fun η => ((n η p : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((n η p : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ ≤ a2 * M * M :=
    fun p => mulu _ _ M M (hntS p) (hntS p) hM0 hM0 (fun j hj => ⟨bn p j hj, bn p j hj⟩)
  
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : Fin 3 → Cyl → ℂ, T = fun i η =>
      (((Km η i 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * W η 0 + ((Km η i 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * W η 1) + ((Km η i 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * W η 2 :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : Cyl → ℂ, S = fun η =>
      (((n η 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((n η 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((n η 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((n η 1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) +
        ((n η 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((n η 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ : ∃ X : Fin 3 → Cyl → ℂ, X = fun i η =>
      (Dv η i + T i η) + (μ * (c0 : ℂ)) * (S η * W η i) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hTS : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (T i) U := by
    intro i; rw [hT]; exact ((hKWS i 0).add (hKWS i 1)).add (hKWS i 2)
  have hSS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ S U := by
    rw [hS]; exact ((hnnS 0).add (hnnS 1)).add (hnnS 2)
  have hSWS : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => S η * W η i) U := fun i => hSS.mul (hWS i)
  have hCS : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (μ * (c0 : ℂ)) * (S η * W η i)) U :=
    fun i => (contDiffOn_const (c := μ * (c0 : ℂ))).mul (hSWS i)
  have hXS : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (X i) U := by
    intro i; rw [hX]; exact ((hDvS i).add (hTS i)).add (hCS i)
  have bT : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j, j ≤ k → NB h (T i) j ξ ≤ 3 * (a2 * M * E) := by
    intro i j hj
    rw [hT]
    beta_reduce
    have e1 := add (fun η => ((Km η i 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * W η 0 + ((Km η i 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * W η 1)
      (fun η => ((Km η i 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * W η 2) j
      (((hKWS i 0).add (hKWS i 1)).contDiffAt hUn) ((hKWS i 2).contDiffAt hUn)
    have e2 := add (fun η => ((Km η i 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * W η 0) (fun η => ((Km η i 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * W η 1) j
      ((hKWS i 0).contDiffAt hUn) ((hKWS i 1).contDiffAt hUn)
    have e3 := bKW i 0 j hj
    have e4 := bKW i 1 j hj
    have e5 := bKW i 2 j hj
    linarith
  have bS : ∀ j, j ≤ k → NB h S j ξ ≤ 3 * (a2 * M * M) := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hS]
    have e1 := add (fun η => ((n η 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((n η 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((n η 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((n η 1 : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (fun η => ((n η 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((n η 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) j
      (((hnnS 0).add (hnnS 1)).contDiffAt hUn) ((hnnS 2).contDiffAt hUn)
    have e2 := add (fun η => ((n η 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((n η 0 : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (fun η => ((n η 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((n η 1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) j
      ((hnnS 0).contDiffAt hUn) ((hnnS 1).contDiffAt hUn)
    have e3 := bnn 0 j hj
    have e4 := bnn 1 j hj
    have e5 := bnn 2 j hj
    linarith
  have h3M : 0 ≤ 3 * (a2 * M * M) := mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha0 hM0) hM0)
  have bSW : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j, j ≤ k →
      NB h (fun η => S η * W η i) j ξ ≤ a2 * (3 * (a2 * M * M)) * E :=
    fun i => mulu S (fun η => W η i) (3 * (a2 * M * M)) E hSS (hWS i) h3M hE0
      (fun j hj => ⟨bS j hj, bW i j hj⟩)
  have hμc : ‖μ * (c0 : ℂ)‖ = ‖μ‖ * |c0| := by rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have bC : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j, j ≤ k → NB h (fun η => (μ * (c0 : ℂ)) * (S η * W η i)) j ξ ≤
      ‖μ‖ * |c0| * (a2 * (3 * (a2 * M * M)) * E) := by
    intro i j hj
    rw [← hμc]
    exact (cmul _ _ j ((hSWS i).contDiffAt hUn)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (bSW i j hj) (norm_nonneg _))
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ 1 + 3 * M + 3 * ‖μ‖ * |c0| * M ^ 2 := by
    have := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg μ) (abs_nonneg c0)) (sq_nonneg M)
    linarith
  have hsq : a2 ≤ a2 ^ 2 := by rw [sq]; exact le_mul_of_one_le_left ha0 ha1
  have bX : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j, j ≤ k →
      NB h (X i) j ξ ≤ a2 ^ 2 * E * (1 + 3 * M + 3 * ‖μ‖ * |c0| * M ^ 2) := by
    intro i j hj
    rw [hX]
    beta_reduce
    have e1 := add (fun η => Dv η i + T i η) (fun η => (μ * (c0 : ℂ)) * (S η * W η i)) j
      (((hDvS i).add (hTS i)).contDiffAt hUn) ((hCS i).contDiffAt hUn)
    have e2 := add (fun η => Dv η i) (T i) j ((hDvS i).contDiffAt hUn) ((hTS i).contDiffAt hUn)
    have e3 := bDv i j hj
    have e4 := bT i j hj
    have e5 := bC i j hj
    have f1 : E ≤ a2 ^ 2 * E := le_mul_of_one_le_left hE0 (one_le_pow₀ ha1)
    have f2 : a2 * M * E ≤ a2 ^ 2 * M * E :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq hM0) hE0
    linarith
  have hY0 : 0 ≤ a2 ^ 2 * E * (1 + 3 * M + 3 * ‖μ‖ * |c0| * M ^ 2) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg ha0 2) hE0) hA0
  have bQ : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j, j ≤ k → NB h (fun η => P η * ((n η i : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ ≤ a2 * E * M :=
    fun i => mulu P _ E M hP (hntS i) hE0 hM0 (fun j hj => ⟨(HE j hj).2.2, bn i j hj⟩)
  have hQS : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => r2 η * (P η * ((n η i : ℝ) : ℂ))) U :=
    fun i => hr2.mul (hP.mul (hntS i))
  have gG : ∀ i : Fin 3, NB h (fun η => r1 η * X i η + κ * (r2 η * (P η * ((n η i : ℝ) : ℂ)))) k ξ ≤
      8 ^ k * R * E * (1 + 3 * M + 3 * ‖μ‖ * |c0| * M ^ 2 + ‖κ‖ * M) := by
    intro i
    have g1 := mulu r1 (X i) R _ hr1 (hXS i) hR0 hY0 (fun j hj => ⟨(HR j hj).1, bX i j hj⟩) k le_rfl
    have g2 := mulu r2 (fun η => P η * ((n η i : ℝ) : ℂ)) R (a2 * E * M) hr2 (hP.mul (hntS i)) hR0
      (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha0 hE0) hM0) (fun j hj => ⟨(HR j hj).2, bQ i j hj⟩) k le_rfl
    have g3 := (cmul κ _ k ((hQS i).contDiffAt hUn)).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left g2 (norm_nonneg κ))
    have e1 := add (fun η => r1 η * X i η) (fun η => κ * (r2 η * (P η * ((n η i : ℝ) : ℂ)))) k
      ((hr1.mul (hXS i)).contDiffAt hUn) (((contDiffOn_const (c := κ)).mul (hQS i)).contDiffAt hUn)
    have h8 : (8:ℝ) ^ k = a2 ^ 3 := by
      rw [ha2, ← pow_mul, mul_comm k 3, pow_mul]; norm_num
    have hZ : 0 ≤ ‖κ‖ * R * E * M :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg κ) hR0) hE0) hM0
    have f3 : a2 ^ 2 * (‖κ‖ * R * E * M) ≤ a2 ^ 3 * (‖κ‖ * R * E * M) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_right₀ ha1 (by norm_num)) hZ
    rw [h8]
    linarith
  
  have hcomp : ∀ (η : Cyl) (i : Fin 3), (r1 η • (Dv η + (pulseMatC (Km η)).mulVec (W η) +
      (μ * ((c0 * dotProduct (n η) (n η) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • W η) +
      (r2 η * κ * P η) • (fun i => ((n η i : ℝ) : ℂ))) i =
      r1 η * X i η + κ * (r2 η * (P η * ((n η i : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
    intro η i
    rw [hX, hT, hS]
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, pulseMatC,
      Matrix.map_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hfin0 : 0 ≤ 1 + 3 * M + 3 * ‖μ‖ * |c0| * M ^ 2 + ‖κ‖ * M := by
    have := mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg κ) hM0
    linarith
  refine pi3 _ k _ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · refine ContDiffOn.contDiffAt ?_ hUn
    refine contDiffOn_pi.2 (fun i => ?_)
    exact ((hr1.mul (hXS i)).add ((contDiffOn_const (c := κ)).mul (hQS i))).congr
      (fun η _ => hcomp η i)
  · exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hR0) hE0) hfin0
  · intro i
    refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) (gG i)
    exact congrArg (fun f : Cyl → ℂ => NB h f k ξ) (funext fun η => hcomp η i)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ubase B η i) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB B.h (fun η => ubase B η 0) j ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ)) ∧ NB B.h (fun η => ubase B η 1) j ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) ∧ NB B.h (fun η => ubase B η 2) j ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)

signature.name: ubase_nb_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ubase B η i) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB B.h (fun η => ubase B η 0) j ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ)) ∧ NB B.h (fun η => ubase B η 1) j ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) ∧ NB B.h (fun η => ubase B η 2) j ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hok
  have hh0 : 0 < B.h := hok.2.1.1
  have hh1 : B.h < 1/100 := hok.2.1.2.1
  obtain ⟨-, -, hXa, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -, hqB0, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  have hXb : 0 < B.Xb := by linarith
  have hSN : SimNorm B.h := simscale_normalized_v4 B.h hh0 hh1 hok.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n0, fun l0 hl0 => ?_⟩
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqs0 : 0 < qsOf l0 := by rw [hQb]; positivity
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by rw [hQb]; exact pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hl0) hn0.le
  obtain ⟨hDo, -, hqpos, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  have hDsub : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ⊆ DomC B.h B.qB :=
    fun ξ hξ => ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ.2.2 hqsB⟩
  
  have hrep : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB,
      ubase B ξ 0 = qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * (2 * XC B.h ξ) ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) *
          logLift B.Vb (Real.log (qC B.h ξ), XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) ∧
      ubase B ξ 1 = qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) * 1 *
          logLift B.Eb (Real.log (qC B.h ξ), XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) ∧
      ubase B ξ 2 = qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) * 1 *
          logLift B.Ub (Real.log (qC B.h ξ), XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) := by
    intro ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨hr, ht, hqB⟩ := hξ
    obtain ⟨hS1, -⟩ := hok.1
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, hVel, -⟩ := hok.2
    have hτ : 0 < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 := by linarith
    have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hS1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).1
    have hx0 : (rotPt ξ.1 0 ξ.2.1) 0 = ξ.1 := by simp [rotPt]
    have hx1 : (rotPt ξ.1 0 ξ.2.1) 1 = 0 := by simp [rotPt]
    have hx2 : (rotPt ξ.1 0 ξ.2.1) 2 = ξ.2.1 := by simp [rotPt]
    set x := rotPt ξ.1 0 ξ.2.1 with hx
    have hsc : simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - ξ.2.2.1) = qC B.h ξ := by rw [hx2]; rfl
    have hrr : x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 = ξ.1 ^ 2 := by rw [hx0, hx1]; ring
    have hpos : 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := by rw [hrr]; positivity
    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) = ξ.1 := by rw [hrr, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
    have hsimX : simX B.h x ξ.2.2.1 = XC B.h ξ := by
      unfold simX XC
      rw [hsc, hrr]
    have hsimEta : simEta B.h x ξ.2.2.1 = etaC B.h ξ := by
      unfold simEta etaC
      rw [hsc, hx2]
    have hmem : (x, ξ.2.2.1) ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB := by
      show ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - ξ.2.2.1) < B.qB
      rw [hsc]
      exact ⟨ht, hqB⟩
    obtain ⟨hE, hU, hV⟩ := hVel x ξ.2.2.1 hmem hpos
    rw [hsimX, hsimEta, hsc] at hV
    rw [hsimX, hsimEta, hsc] at hU
    rw [hsqrt, hsimX, hsimEta, hsc] at hE
    have hrad : rad x = ξ.1 := hsqrt
    have hb : ubase B ξ 0 = ξ.1⁻¹ * B.Vb (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) := by
      show inner ℝ (uB B x ξ.2.2.1) (frameAt 0 ξ 0) = _
      have hf : frameAt 0 ξ 0 = (rad x)⁻¹ • radVec x := rfl
      rw [hf, real_inner_smul_right, hrad]
      show ξ.1⁻¹ * inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => B.AB w ξ.2.2.1) x + B.BvB x ξ.2.2.1) (radVec x) = _
      rw [hV]
    have hu1 : ubase B ξ 1 = qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 + B.h)) * B.Eb (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) := by
      show inner ℝ (uB B x ξ.2.2.1) (frameAt 0 ξ 1) = _
      have hf : frameAt 0 ξ 1 = (rad x)⁻¹ • azVec x := rfl
      rw [hf, real_inner_smul_right, hrad]
      show ξ.1⁻¹ * inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => B.AB w ξ.2.2.1) x + B.BvB x ξ.2.2.1) (azVec x) = _
      rw [hE, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hr.ne']
    have hu2 : ubase B ξ 2 = qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 + B.h)) * B.Ub (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) := by
      have hz : ∀ v : ℝ³, inner ℝ v eZ = v 2 := by
        intro v; simp [eZ, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
      show inner ℝ (uB B x ξ.2.2.1) (frameAt 0 ξ 2) = _
      have hf : frameAt 0 ξ 2 = eZ := rfl
      rw [hf, hz]
      show (curl3 (fun w => B.AB w ξ.2.2.1) x + B.BvB x ξ.2.2.1) 2 = _
      rw [hU]
    have hl : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, logLift g (Real.log (qC B.h ξ), XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) =
        g (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) := by
      intro g; unfold logLift; rw [Real.exp_log hq]
    have h2X : 2 * XC B.h ξ = ξ.1 ^ 2 * (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ := by
      unfold XC
      field_simp
    have hphi : (2 * XC B.h ξ) ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) = ξ.1⁻¹ * qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) := by
      rw [h2X, Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.inv_rpow hq.le,
        Real.rpow_neg (sq_nonneg _), Real.rpow_neg hq.le, inv_inv]
      have h12 : (ξ.1 ^ 2) ^ (1/2:ℝ) = ξ.1 := by rw [← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
      rw [h12]
    have hhalf : qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]
      norm_num
    have hAx : Aex B.h = 1/2 + B.h := rfl
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hb, hl, hphi]
      calc ξ.1⁻¹ * B.Vb (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ)
          = (qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ)) * ξ.1⁻¹ *
              B.Vb (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) := by rw [hhalf, one_mul]
        _ = _ := by ring
    · rw [hu1, hl, mul_one, hAx]
    · rw [hu2, hl, mul_one, hAx]
  
  have hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun X : ℝ => (2 * X) ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun X : ℝ => 2 * X) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_id
    exact h2.rpow_const_of_ne (fun X hX => (mul_pos two_pos (Set.mem_Ioi.mp hX)).ne')
  have hφ1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun _ : ℝ => (1:ℝ)) (Set.Ioi 0) := contDiffOn_const
  have hP0 := qpow_profile_nb_v4 B (qsOf l0) hok hSN hqs0 hqs1 (fun X : ℝ => (2 * X) ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)))
    (-(1/2:ℝ)) hφ
  have hP1 := qpow_profile_nb_v4 B (qsOf l0) hok hSN hqs0 hqs1 (fun _ : ℝ => (1:ℝ))
    (-Aex B.h) hφ1
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, ⟨hEbS, hUbS, hVbS, hbd⟩, -⟩ := hok.2
  have hVbB : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → q < B.qB → B.Xa ≤ X → X ≤ B.Xb →
      -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift B.Vb) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbd B.Xa B.Xb hXa m
    exact ⟨C, fun q X η h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 => (hC q X η h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6).2.2⟩
  have hUbB : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → q < B.qB → B.Xa ≤ X → X ≤ B.Xb →
      -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift B.Ub) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := outer_profile_bounds_v5 B hok m
    exact ⟨C, fun q X η h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 =>
      (hC q X η h1 h2 (by linarith) (by linarith) h5 h6).2⟩
  have hEbB : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → q < B.qB → B.Xa ≤ X → X ≤ B.Xb →
      -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift B.Eb) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := outer_profile_bounds_v5 B hok m
    exact ⟨C, fun q X η h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 =>
      (hC q X η h1 h2 (by linarith) (by linarith) h5 h6).1⟩
  have hΛV := bg_chart_nb_v5 B (logLift B.Vb) hok hVbS hVbB
  have hΛE := bg_chart_nb_v5 B (logLift B.Eb) hok hEbS hEbB
  have hΛU := bg_chart_nb_v5 B (logLift B.Ub) hok hUbS hUbB
  
  have hprod : ∀ (P L : Cyl → ℝ) (c : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (DomC B.h B.qB) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
        NB B.h P k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ c) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
        NB B.h L k ξ ≤ C) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
        NB B.h (fun η => P η * L η) k ξ ≤ K * qC B.h ξ ^ c := by
    intro P L c hPs hLs hPb hLb k
    choose CP hCP using hPb
    choose CL hCL using hLb
    refine ⟨∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose j : ℝ) * |CP j| * |CL (k - j)|,
      fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
    have hq0 := hqpos ξ hξ
    have hQ : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ c := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
    have hLe := nb_mul_le_v4 B.h (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) P L hDo hPs (hLs.mono hDsub) ξ hξ k
    refine le_trans hLe ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j _
    have h1 : NB B.h P j ξ ≤ |CP j| * qC B.h ξ ^ c :=
      le_trans (hCP j ξ hξ hX1 hX2) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hQ)
    have h2 : NB B.h L (k - j) ξ ≤ |CL (k - j)| :=
      le_trans (hCL (k - j) ξ (hDsub hξ) hX1 hX2) (le_abs_self _)
    have h0' : 0 ≤ NB B.h L (k - j) ξ := norm_nonneg _
    calc (k.choose j : ℝ) * NB B.h P j ξ * NB B.h L (k - j) ξ
        ≤ (k.choose j : ℝ) * (|CP j| * qC B.h ξ ^ c) * |CL (k - j)| := by
          apply mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) h2 h0'
            (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hQ))
      _ = (k.choose j : ℝ) * |CP j| * |CL (k - j)| * qC B.h ξ ^ c := by ring
  
  have hs0 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ubase B η 0) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    (hP0.1.mul (hΛV.1.mono hDsub)).congr (fun η hη => (hrep η (hDsub hη)).1)
  have hs1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ubase B η 1) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    (hP1.1.mul (hΛE.1.mono hDsub)).congr (fun η hη => (hrep η (hDsub hη)).2.1)
  have hs2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ubase B η 2) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    (hP1.1.mul (hΛU.1.mono hDsub)).congr (fun η hη => (hrep η (hDsub hη)).2.2)
  refine ⟨?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hs0
    · exact hs1
    · exact hs2
  
  choose K0 hK0 using hprod _ _ _ hP0.1 hΛV.1 hP0.2 hΛV.2
  choose K1 hK1 using hprod _ _ _ hP1.1 hΛE.1 hP1.2 hΛE.2
  choose K2 hK2 using hprod _ _ _ hP1.1 hΛU.1 hP1.2 hΛU.2
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (|K0 j| + |K1 j| + |K2 j|) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => by positivity)
  have hCj : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → |K0 j| + |K1 j| + |K2 j| ≤
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (|K0 j| + |K1 j| + |K2 j|) := fun j hj =>

    have hNBeq : NB B.h (fun η => ubase B η 1) j ξ =
        NB B.h (fun η => (qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h) * 1) *

    have hK : K1 j ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (|K0 j| + |K1 j| + |K2 j|) := by
      have := hCj j hj
      linarith [le_abs_self (K1 j), abs_nonneg (K0 j), abs_nonneg (K2 j)]
    rw [hNBeq]
    exact le_trans (hK1 j ξ hξ hX1 hX2) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK hQ)
  · have hq0 := hqpos ξ hξ
    have hQ : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _

      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hDo.mem_nhds hξ) (fun η hη => (hrep η (hDsub hη)).2.2)
