proof.tactics:
by
  intro h U F hU hF hY ξ hξ hq k
  
  have yzero : ∀ (η : Cyl) (y : ℝ × ℝ), fderiv ℝ F η ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), y) = 0 := by
    intro η y
    by_cases hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F η
    · rw [← hd.lineDeriv_eq_fderiv]
      have hc : (fun t : ℝ => F (η + t • ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), y))) = fun _ => F η := by
        funext t
        rw [hY (η + t • ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), y)), hY η]
        simp
      unfold lineDeriv
      rw [hc]
      exact deriv_const _ _
    · rw [fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hd]
      rfl
  
  have dReq : dR h F = fun η => fderiv ℝ F η ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ × ℝ)) := by
    funext η
    unfold dR
    have e : ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx h * η.1 ^ (drx h - 1)) • vrv) =
        ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ × ℝ)) + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx h * η.1 ^ (drx h - 1)) • vrv) := by
      ext <;> simp
    rw [e, map_add, yzero, add_zero]
  have dZeq : dZ F = fun η => fderiv ℝ F η ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ × ℝ)) := rfl
  
  have e0 : ∀ v : Cyl, (Lnorm h ξ v).1 = Real.sqrt (qC h ξ) * v.1 := by
    intro v; simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
  have e1 : ∀ v : Cyl, (Lnorm h ξ v).2.1 = qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) * v.2.1 := by
    intro v; simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
  have e2 : ∀ v : Cyl, (Lnorm h ξ v).2.2.1 = qC h ξ * v.2.2.1 := by
    intro v; simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
  have e3 : ∀ v : Cyl, (Lnorm h ξ v).2.2.2 = JpowL (-coarseIdx h (qC h ξ)) v.2.2.2 := by
    intro v; rfl
  have sR0 : 0 ≤ qC h ξ ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
  have sZ0 : 0 ≤ qC h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - h)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
  have hwR : Lnorm h ξ (qC h ξ ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ)), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ × ℝ)) =
      ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ × ℝ)) := by
    refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_))
    · rw [e0]
      show Real.sqrt (qC h ξ) * qC h ξ ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ)) = 1
      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_add hq, add_neg_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
    · rw [e1]; simp
    · rw [e2]; simp
    · rw [e3]
      exact map_zero _
  have hwZ : Lnorm h ξ ((0:ℝ), qC h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - h)), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ × ℝ)) =
      ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ × ℝ)) := by
    refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_))
    · rw [e0]; simp
    · rw [e1]
      show qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) * qC h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - h)) = 1
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hq, add_neg_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
    · rw [e2]; simp
    · rw [e3]
      exact map_zero _
  have nR : ‖((qC h ξ ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ)), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ × ℝ)) : Cyl)‖ ≤ qC h ξ ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ)) := by
    simp only [Prod.norm_mk, norm_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg sR0]
    exact max_le le_rfl (max_le sR0 (max_le sR0 sR0))
  have nZ : ‖(((0:ℝ), qC h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - h)), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ × ℝ)) : Cyl)‖ ≤ qC h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - h)) := by
    simp only [Prod.norm_mk, norm_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg sZ0]
    exact max_le sZ0 (max_le le_rfl (max_le sZ0 sZ0))
  
  have hFd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) ξ :=
    (hF.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)
  have nbdir : ∀ (w : Cyl),
      NB h (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm h ξ w)) k ξ ≤ ‖w‖ * NB h F (k + 1) ξ := by
    intro w
    have hcomp : (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm h ξ w)) =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ (Lnorm h ξ w)) ∘ (fderiv ℝ F) := by
      funext η; rfl
    have hit : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm h ξ w)) ξ =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ (Lnorm h ξ w)).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ F) ξ) := by
      rw [hcomp]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left _ hFd (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hNB0 : 0 ≤ NB h F (k + 1) ξ := norm_nonneg _
    unfold NB
    rw [hit]
    apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hNB0)
    intro m
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply]
    have key : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ F) ξ (fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m i))) (Lnorm h ξ w) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ))
          (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w) := by
      rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right]
      have e1' : Fin.init (fun i : Fin (k+1) => Lnorm h ξ (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i)) =
          fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m i) := by
        funext i
        simp [Fin.init, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      rw [e1']
      simp only [Fin.snoc_last]
    rw [key]
    have hprod : ∏ i : Fin (k+1), ‖Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i‖ =
        (∏ i : Fin k, ‖m i‖) * ‖w‖ := by
      rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
      simp [Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ *
          ∏ i : Fin (k+1), ‖Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i‖ :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ = ‖w‖ * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ *
          ∏ i : Fin k, ‖m i‖ := by rw [hprod]; ring
  have hNB0 : 0 ≤ NB h F (k + 1) ξ := norm_nonneg _
  
  constructor
  · have h1 := nbdir (qC h ξ ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ)), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ × ℝ))
    rw [hwR] at h1
    rw [dReq]
    exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right nR hNB0)
  · have h1 := nbdir ((0:ℝ), qC h ξ ^ (-(1/2 - h)), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ × ℝ))
    rw [hwZ] at h1
    rw [dZeq]
    exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right nZ hNB0)

signature.name: inv_r_qnb_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∀ (qs : ℝ), 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (η.1)⁻¹) j ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hB qs hqs0 hqs1 k
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hB.2.1.2.2.1
  
  have key : ∀ {E G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup G]
      [NormedSpace ℝ G] (F : E → G) (V : Set E) (a : E) (T : Cyl →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → a ∈ V → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro E G _ _ _ _ F V a T hV hF ha i
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set E, s = (fun z : E => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : E) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
    have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ : ∃ ρ : ℝ, ρ = (Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xa))⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ := by rw [hρ]; exact inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  refine ⟨(k.factorial : ℝ) * (ρ + 1) ^ (k + 1), by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro ξ hξ hX1 hXb j hj
  have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qs := hξ
  have hr : 0 < ξ.1 := hξ'.1
  have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hB.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ'.2.1])).1
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s = Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hspos : 0 < s := by rw [hs]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := hspos.le
  
  have hX0 : B.Xa < ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ) := hX1
  have hX' : B.Xa * (2 * qC B.h ξ) < ξ.1 ^ 2 := (lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith)).mp hX0
  have h2Xa : 0 < 2 * B.Xa := by linarith
  have hX2 : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xa) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h2Xa
  have hkey : Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xa) * s ≤ ξ.1 := by
    rw [hs, ← Real.sqrt_mul h2Xa.le]
    calc Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xa * qC B.h ξ) ≤ Real.sqrt (ξ.1 ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by
          rw [show 2 * B.Xa * qC B.h ξ = B.Xa * (2 * qC B.h ξ) by ring]; exact hX'.le)
      _ = ξ.1 := Real.sqrt_sq hr.le
  have hsr : s * ξ.1⁻¹ ≤ ρ := by
    rw [hρ]
    calc s * ξ.1⁻¹ = (Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xa))⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xa) * s) * ξ.1⁻¹ := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hX2.ne', one_mul]
      _ ≤ (Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xa))⁻¹ * ξ.1 * ξ.1⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkey (inv_nonneg.mpr hX2.le))
            (inv_nonneg.mpr hr.le)
      _ = (Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xa))⁻¹ := by rw [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr.ne', mul_one]
  
  have hV : IsOpen {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst
  have hFV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (η.1)⁻¹) {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} :=
    contDiff_fst.contDiffOn.inv (fun η (hη : 0 < η.1) => hη.ne')
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ : ∃ π : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ, π = ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hfun : ∀ z : Cyl, (fun η : Cyl => (η.1)⁻¹) (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z) =
      (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) (ξ.1 + (s • π) z) := by
    intro z
    show (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z).1⁻¹ = (ξ.1 + (s • π) z)⁻¹
    congr 1
    rw [hπ, hs]; simp [Lnorm]
  have hfunEq : (fun z : Cyl => (fun η : Cyl => (η.1)⁻¹) (ξ + Lnorm B.h ξ z)) =
      (fun z : Cyl => (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) (ξ.1 + (s • π) z)) := funext hfun
  have hinvS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    (contDiffOn_id (s := Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))).inv (fun x (hx : (0:ℝ) < x) => hx.ne')
  have e1 := key (fun η : Cyl => (η.1)⁻¹) {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hV hFV hr j
  have e2 := key (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) (Set.Ioi 0) ξ.1 (s • π) isOpen_Ioi hinvS hr j
  have hNBeq : NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (η.1)⁻¹) j ξ =
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) ξ.1).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => s • π)‖ := by
    unfold NB
    rw [← e1, hfunEq, e2]
  have hπ1 : ‖π‖ ≤ 1 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun η => ?_)
    rw [hπ]
    show ‖η.1‖ ≤ 1 * ‖η‖
    rw [one_mul]
    exact norm_fst_le η
  have hn : ‖s • π‖ ≤ s := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hs0]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right hs0 hπ1
  have hprod : ∏ _i : Fin j, ‖s • π‖ ≤ s ^ j := by
    rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hn j
  have hz : ξ.1 ^ ((-1 : ℤ) - (j : ℤ)) = ξ.1⁻¹ ^ (j + 1) := by
    rw [show ((-1 : ℤ) - (j : ℤ)) = -((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast,
      inv_pow]
  have hd : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) ξ.1‖ =
      (j.factorial : ℝ) * ξ.1⁻¹ ^ (j + 1) := by
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate]
    show ‖deriv^[j] (Inv.inv : ℝ → ℝ) ξ.1‖ = _
    rw [iter_deriv_inv, hz, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow,
      one_mul, Nat.abs_cast, abs_of_pos (pow_pos (inv_pos.mpr hr) _)]
  have hbound : NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (η.1)⁻¹) j ξ ≤
      (j.factorial : ℝ) * ξ.1⁻¹ ^ (j + 1) * s ^ j := by
    rw [hNBeq]
    refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
    rw [hd]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hr.le) _))
  
  have hqs : qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ)) = s⁻¹ := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hq.le, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← hs]
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ s * ξ.1⁻¹ := mul_nonneg hs0 (inv_nonneg.mpr hr.le)
  have hu : (s * ξ.1⁻¹) ^ (j + 1) ≤ (ρ + 1) ^ (k + 1) :=
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ hu0 (hsr.trans (by linarith)) _).trans
      (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by linarith) (by omega))
  have hfac : (j.factorial : ℝ) ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr (Nat.factorial_le hj)
  have hmain : (j.factorial : ℝ) * (s * ξ.1⁻¹) ^ (j + 1) ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) * (ρ + 1) ^ (k + 1) :=
    mul_le_mul hfac hu (pow_nonneg hu0 _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  rw [hqs]
  calc NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (η.1)⁻¹) j ξ
      ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ) * ξ.1⁻¹ ^ (j + 1) * s ^ j := hbound
    _ = (j.factorial : ℝ) * ξ.1⁻¹ ^ (j + 1) * s ^ j * (s * s⁻¹) := by
        rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hspos.ne', mul_one]
    _ = (j.factorial : ℝ) * (s * ξ.1⁻¹) ^ (j + 1) * s⁻¹ := by ring
    _ ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) * (ρ + 1) ^ (k + 1) * s⁻¹ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmain (inv_nonneg.mpr hs0)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (qs α : ℝ) {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (a : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → V), B.ok → InWg5 B G qs α a → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → ∀ j : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (a γ m) ξ = 0

signature.name: inWg5_jet_vanish_off_shell_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (qs α : ℝ) {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (a : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → V), B.ok → InWg5 B G qs α a → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → ∀ j : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (a γ m) ξ = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G qs α V _ _ a hok hf γ m ξ hξ hoff j
  have hS0o : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
  have hcq : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := by
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    exact h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
  have hq0' : ∀ ξ ∈ ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}), 0 < qC B.h ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
    exact (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hDS : DomC B.h qs ⊆ {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
    fun ξ hξ => ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1⟩
  have hq0 : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ := fun ξ hξ => hq0' ξ (hDS hξ)
  have hDo : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have h3' := hcq.isOpen_inter_preimage hS0o (isOpen_Iio (a := qs))
    have e : DomC B.h qs =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Set.Iio qs := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  have hXCc : ContinuousOn (XC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have hc2 : ContinuousOn (fun ξ : Cyl => 2 * qC B.h ξ) (DomC B.h qs) :=
      continuousOn_const.mul (hcq.mono hDS)
    have hn : ContinuousOn (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.1 ^ 2) (DomC B.h qs) :=
      (continuous_fst.pow 2).continuousOn
    exact hn.div hc2 (fun ξ hξ => by have := hq0 ξ hξ; positivity)
  have hUo : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs ∩ XC B.h ⁻¹' (Set.Iio B.Xa ∪ Set.Ioi B.Xb)) :=
    hXCc.isOpen_inter_preimage hDo (isOpen_Iio.union isOpen_Ioi)
  have hvan : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs ∩ XC B.h ⁻¹' (Set.Iio B.Xa ∪ Set.Ioi B.Xb), a γ m η = 0 := by
    intro η hη
    by_contra hne
    have hS := hf.2.2.2.1 γ m η hη.1 hne
    have h1 : B.Xa ≤ XC B.h η := hS.2.2.2.2.1
    have h2 : XC B.h η ≤ B.Xb := hS.2.2.2.2.2
    rcases hη.2 with h | h
    · exact absurd (show XC B.h η < B.Xa from h) (not_lt.mpr h1)
    · exact absurd (show B.Xb < XC B.h η from h) (not_lt.mpr h2)
  have hjU : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs ∩ XC B.h ⁻¹' (Set.Iio B.Xa ∪ Set.Ioi B.Xb),
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (a γ m) η = 0 := by
    intro η hη
    have hev : a γ m =ᶠ[nhds η] (fun _ => (0:V)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hη) (fun y hy => hvan y hy)
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds]
    exact congrFun iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero η
  have hcont : ContinuousAt (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (a γ m)) ξ :=
    ((hf.2.1 γ m).contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hξ)).continuousAt_iteratedFDeriv
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hφc : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => ((s * ξ.1, ξ.2) : Cyl)) := by fun_prop
  have hT : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (a γ m) ((s * ξ.1, ξ.2) : Cyl)) (nhds 1)
      (nhds (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (a γ m) ξ)) := by
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ((s * ξ.1, ξ.2) : Cyl)) (nhds 1) (nhds ξ) := by
      have := hφc.tendsto 1
      simpa using this
    exact hcont.tendsto.comp h1
  have hXpos : 0 < XC B.h ξ := div_pos (pow_pos hξ.1 2) (by linarith [hq0 ξ hξ])
  have hφX : ∀ s : ℝ, XC B.h ((s * ξ.1, ξ.2) : Cyl) = s ^ 2 * XC B.h ξ := by
    intro s
    show (s * ξ.1) ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ) = s ^ 2 * (ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ))
    ring
  have hφD : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ((s * ξ.1, ξ.2) : Cyl) ∈ DomC B.h qs :=
    fun s hs => ⟨mul_pos hs hξ.1, hξ.2.1, hξ.2.2⟩
  rcases hoff with h | h
  · have hev : (fun s : ℝ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (a γ m) ((s * ξ.1, ξ.2) : Cyl))
        =ᶠ[nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Iio 1)] (fun _ => 0) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsLT (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1)] with s hs
      apply hjU
      refine ⟨hφD s hs.1, Or.inl ?_⟩
      show XC B.h ((s * ξ.1, ξ.2) : Cyl) < B.Xa
      rw [hφX]
      have hs2 : s ^ 2 < 1 := pow_lt_one₀ hs.1.le hs.2 two_ne_zero
      calc s ^ 2 * XC B.h ξ < 1 * XC B.h ξ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hs2 hXpos
        _ ≤ B.Xa := by rw [one_mul]; exact h
    have hT1 := hT.mono_left (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := Set.Iio 1))
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique hT1 (tendsto_const_nhds.congr' hev.symm)
  · have hev : (fun s : ℝ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (a γ m) ((s * ξ.1, ξ.2) : Cyl))
        =ᶠ[nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Ioi 1)] (fun _ => 0) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) < 2)] with s hs
      apply hjU
      refine ⟨hφD s (by linarith [hs.1]), Or.inr ?_⟩
      show B.Xb < XC B.h ((s * ξ.1, ξ.2) : Cyl)
      rw [hφX]
      have hs2 : 1 < s ^ 2 := one_lt_pow₀ hs.1 two_ne_zero
      calc B.Xb ≤ 1 * XC B.h ξ := by rw [one_mul]; exact h
        _ < s ^ 2 * XC B.h ξ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hs2 hXpos
    have hT1 := hT.mono_left (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := Set.Ioi 1))
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique hT1 (tendsto_const_nhds.congr' hev.symm)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (h : ℝ) (c : Cyl → ℝ) (g : Cyl → V) (O : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl), IsOpen O → ξ ∈ O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g O → ∀ k : ℕ, NB h (fun η => c η • g η) k ξ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB h c i ξ * NB h g (k - i) ξ

signature.name: nb_smul_leibniz_v5
signature.statement: ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (h : ℝ) (c : Cyl → ℝ) (g : Cyl → V) (O : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl), IsOpen O → ξ ∈ O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g O → ∀ k : ℕ, NB h (fun η => c η • g η) k ξ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB h c i ξ * NB h g (k - i) ξ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro V _ _ h c g O ξ hO hξ hc hg k
  have hck : ContDiffOn ℝ k c O := hc.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hgk : ContDiffOn ℝ k g O := hg.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have leib : ∀ {W' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W'] [NormedSpace ℝ W'] (U : Set Cyl) (n : ℕ),
      IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (G' : Cyl → W'), ContDiffOn ℝ n f U → ContDiffOn ℝ n G' U →
      NB h (fun η => f η • G' η) n ξ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h G' (n - i) ξ := by
    intro W' _ _ U n hU hξ f G' hf hG'
    unfold NB
    generalize Lnorm h ξ = L
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO' : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage L.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
    have hL0s : L 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
    have hsm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have hsmO : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact (hsm F hF).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
    have key : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n →
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0 =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF i hi
      have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + L z)) i hO' h0O
      have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
        hO'.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
      have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + z)) i hs h0s
      have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i ξ 0
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0
          = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑L) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := e2
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [map_zero]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [e3]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
    have hfg : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun η => f η • G' η) U := hf.smul hG'
    have hl := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_smul_le (hsmO f hf) (hsmO G' hG') hO'.uniqueDiffOn h0O
      (n := n) le_rfl
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => f (ξ + L y) • G' (ξ + L y)) n hO' h0O] at hl
    rw [← key _ hfg n le_rfl]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => (fun η => f η • G' η) (ξ + L z)) 0‖
        = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f (ξ + L y) • G' (ξ + L y)) 0‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ _ := hl
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        have hik : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f (ξ + L z)) i hO' h0O,
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => G' (ξ + L z)) (n - i) hO' h0O,
          key f hf i hik, key G' hG' (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i)]
  exact leib O k hO hξ c g hck hgk

    rcases min_choice 1 (min u v) with h | h
    · rw [hED, h, one_pow, div_one]
      linarith
    · rcases min_choice u v with h' | h'
      · rw [hED, h, h']
        have : c / u ^ 2 ≤ aa / u ^ 2 := by gcongr
        rw [hT]
        linarith
      · rw [hED, h, h']
        have : c / v ^ 2 ≤ ab / v ^ 2 := by gcongr
        rw [hT]
        linarith
  
  have hpow1 : e ^ (-d) ≤ (e⁻¹) ^ n := by
    have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge he0 he1 (show -(n:ℝ) ≤ -d by linarith)
    rw [Real.rpow_neg he0.le (n:ℝ), Real.rpow_natCast, ← inv_pow] at h
    exact h
  
  obtain ⟨x, hx_def⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = c / (2 * e ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by rw [hx_def]; positivity
  have hxe : x ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp x := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (x := x) hx0 n
  have hxn : x ^ n ≤ Real.exp x * (n.factorial : ℝ) := (div_le_iff₀ hfac).mp hxe
  have he2 : 0 < e ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hbase : (2 / c) * x = (e ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    rw [hx_def]
    field_simp
  have hee : e ^ 2 ≤ e := by
    calc e ^ 2 = e * e := sq e
      _ ≤ 1 * e := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he1 he0.le
      _ = e := one_mul e
  have hinv : e⁻¹ ≤ (e ^ 2)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ he2 hee
  have hpow2 : (e⁻¹) ^ n ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) * (2 / c) ^ n * Real.exp x := by
    calc (e⁻¹) ^ n ≤ ((e ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ n := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hinv n
      _ = (2 / c) ^ n * x ^ n := by rw [← mul_pow, hbase]
      _ ≤ (2 / c) ^ n * (Real.exp x * (n.factorial : ℝ)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxn (by positivity)
      _ = (n.factorial : ℝ) * (2 / c) ^ n * Real.exp x := by ring
  have hexp : Real.exp x ≤ Real.exp ((T + c) / 2) := by
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hx2 : x = (c / e ^ 2) / 2 := by rw [hx_def, div_div, mul_comm]
    rw [hx2]
    linarith
  
  rw [hW, ← he_def]
  have hE0 : 0 < Real.exp (-T / 2) := Real.exp_pos _
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) * (2 / c) ^ n := by positivity
  calc Real.exp (-T / 2) * e ^ (-d)
      ≤ Real.exp (-T / 2) * ((n.factorial : ℝ) * (2 / c) ^ n * Real.exp ((T + c) / 2)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hE0.le
        calc e ^ (-d) ≤ (e⁻¹) ^ n := hpow1
          _ ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) * (2 / c) ^ n * Real.exp x := hpow2
          _ ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) * (2 / c) ^ n * Real.exp ((T + c) / 2) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp hK0
    _ = (n.factorial : ℝ) * (2 / c) ^ n * (Real.exp (-T / 2) * Real.exp ((T + c) / 2)) := by ring
    _ = (n.factorial : ℝ) * (2 / c) ^ n * Real.exp (c / 2) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        have hs : -T / 2 + (T + c) / 2 = c / 2 := by ring
        rw [hs]

proof.tactics:
by
  intro c₀ a b K k N hc₀
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = 2 * (k:ℝ) + |a| + 2 * |b| + (N:ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ : ∃ Z : ℝ, Z = 2 * (|a| + 2 * |b| + (N:ℝ)) + M ^ 2 / (4 * c₀) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨max K 0 * Real.exp Z, mul_nonneg (le_max_right _ _) (Real.exp_pos _).le, ?_⟩
  intro l q hl h1 h2 h3
  have hQb : Qb l = (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l:ℝ)) := rfl
  have hQ0 : 0 < Qb l := by rw [hQb]; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hq0 : 0 < q := lt_trans (div_pos hQ0 (by norm_num)) h1
  have hlogq : Real.log q ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos hq0.le h3
  have hL0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (l:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg l
  have hlog2 : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)
    linarith
  have hlog4 : Real.log 4 = 2 * Real.log 2 := by
    rw [show (4:ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hlogQ : Real.log (Qb l / 4) = -((l:ℝ) + 2) * Real.log 2 := by
    rw [Real.log_div hQ0.ne' (by norm_num), hQb, Real.log_rpow (by norm_num), hlog4]
    ring
  have hlam : -Real.log q ≤ (l:ℝ) + 2 := by
    have hlt := Real.log_lt_log (div_pos hQ0 (by norm_num)) h1
    rw [hlogQ] at hlt
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog2 (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ (l:ℝ) + 2)
    linarith
  
  have F1 : (4:ℝ) ^ (k * l) ≤ Real.exp (2 * (k:ℝ) * (l:ℝ)) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_log (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 4 ^ (k * l)), Real.log_pow, hlog4]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    push_cast
    have hkl : (0:ℝ) ≤ (k:ℝ) * (l:ℝ) := by positivity
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog2 hkl
    nlinarith
  have F2 : q ^ a ≤ Real.exp (|a| * ((l:ℝ) + 2)) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hq0]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have e1 : 0 ≤ (-Real.log q) * (a + |a|) :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith [neg_abs_le a])
    have e2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlam (abs_nonneg a)
    nlinarith
  have habs : |Real.log q| = -Real.log q := abs_of_nonpos hlogq
  have F3 : ((1 + |Real.log q|) ^ 2) ^ b ≤ Real.exp (2 * |b| * ((l:ℝ) + 2)) := by
    rw [habs]
    have hS : 0 < 1 + -Real.log q := by linarith
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (pow_pos hS 2), Real.log_pow]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hl1 : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 + -Real.log q) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
    have hl2 : Real.log (1 + -Real.log q) ≤ -Real.log q := by
      have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hS
      linarith
    have e1 : Real.log (1 + -Real.log q) * b ≤ Real.log (1 + -Real.log q) * |b| :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_abs_self b) hl1
    have e2 : Real.log (1 + -Real.log q) * |b| ≤ ((l:ℝ) + 2) * |b| :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (abs_nonneg b)
    push_cast
    nlinarith
  have F4 : Real.exp (-(N:ℝ) * ((l:ℝ) + 2)) ≤ q ^ (N:ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hq0]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlam (Nat.cast_nonneg N : (0:ℝ) ≤ (N:ℝ))
    nlinarith
  
  have hsq : M * (l:ℝ) - c₀ * (l:ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2 / (4 * c₀) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * c₀ * (l:ℝ) - M)]
  have hML : M * (l:ℝ) = (2 * (k:ℝ) + |a| + 2 * |b| + (N:ℝ)) * (l:ℝ) := by rw [hM]
  have hexp : 2 * (k:ℝ) * (l:ℝ) + |a| * ((l:ℝ) + 2) + 2 * |b| * ((l:ℝ) + 2) - c₀ * (l:ℝ) ^ 2 - Z
      ≤ -(N:ℝ) * ((l:ℝ) + 2) := by
    rw [hZ]
    nlinarith
  
  have p1 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (4:ℝ) ^ (k * l) := by positivity
  have p2 : 0 ≤ q ^ a := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le a
  have p3 : 0 ≤ ((1 + |Real.log q|) ^ 2) ^ b := Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) b
  have hP0 : 0 ≤ (4:ℝ) ^ (k * l) * q ^ a * ((1 + |Real.log q|) ^ 2) ^ b *
      Real.exp (-c₀ * (l:ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p1 p2) p3) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hP : (4:ℝ) ^ (k * l) * q ^ a * ((1 + |Real.log q|) ^ 2) ^ b *
      Real.exp (-c₀ * (l:ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ Real.exp Z * q ^ (N:ℝ) := by
    calc (4:ℝ) ^ (k * l) * q ^ a * ((1 + |Real.log q|) ^ 2) ^ b * Real.exp (-c₀ * (l:ℝ) ^ 2)
        ≤ Real.exp (2 * (k:ℝ) * (l:ℝ)) * Real.exp (|a| * ((l:ℝ) + 2)) *
            Real.exp (2 * |b| * ((l:ℝ) + 2)) * Real.exp (-c₀ * (l:ℝ) ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul F1 F2 p2 (Real.exp_pos _).le) F3 p3 (by positivity))
            (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = Real.exp Z * Real.exp (2 * (k:ℝ) * (l:ℝ) + |a| * ((l:ℝ) + 2) +
            2 * |b| * ((l:ℝ) + 2) - c₀ * (l:ℝ) ^ 2 - Z) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
          congr 1
          ring
      _ ≤ Real.exp Z * Real.exp (-(N:ℝ) * ((l:ℝ) + 2)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexp) (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ ≤ Real.exp Z * q ^ (N:ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left F4 (Real.exp_pos _).le
  calc K * (4:ℝ) ^ (k * l) * q ^ a * ((1 + |Real.log q|) ^ 2) ^ b * Real.exp (-c₀ * (l:ℝ) ^ 2)
      = K * ((4:ℝ) ^ (k * l) * q ^ a * ((1 + |Real.log q|) ^ 2) ^ b *
          Real.exp (-c₀ * (l:ℝ) ^ 2)) := by ring
    _ ≤ max K 0 * ((4:ℝ) ^ (k * l) * q ^ a * ((1 + |Real.log q|) ^ 2) ^ b *
          Real.exp (-c₀ * (l:ℝ) ^ 2)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hP0
    _ ≤ max K 0 * (Real.exp Z * q ^ (N:ℝ)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP (le_max_right _ _)
    _ = max K 0 * Real.exp Z * q ^ (N:ℝ) := by ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (d : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (x : ℝ³), 0 < rad x → DifferentiableAt ℝ c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) → DifferentiableAt ℝ d (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => cyl2cart y (fun i => (c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re)) x ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => cyl2cart y (d (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)))) x ∧ fderiv ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => cyl2cart y (fun i => (c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re)) x (cyl2cart x (d (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)))) + fderiv ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => cyl2cart y (d (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)))) x (cyl2cart x (fun i => (c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re)) = cyl2cart x (fun i => (mcK5 h c d n (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re)

by
  intro h t Y0 n c d x hr hc hd
  have hcoord : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (y : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ³ => w i) y := by
    intro i y
    have h0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (ι := Fin 3) i) y :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt _
    rwa [EuclideanSpace.coe_proj] at h0
  have hradpos : 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.mp hr
  have hr0 : rad x ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
  have hradD : DifferentiableAt ℝ rad x := by
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) x :=
      ((hcoord 0 x).pow 2).add ((hcoord 1 x).pow 2)
    exact h1.sqrt hradpos.ne'

      have h5 := ((hradD.rpow_const (p := drx h) (Or.inl hr.ne')).smul_const vrv).add_const (t • vtv)

      rw [hg]

      rw [hg]

      exact key

          congr 1
          ring

  have heR : DifferentiableAt ℝ eR x := by
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ radVec x :=
      ((hcoord 0 x).smul_const _).add ((hcoord 1 x).smul_const _)
    exact hinv.smul h1
  have heTh : DifferentiableAt ℝ eTh x := by
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ azVec x :=
      ((hcoord 1 x).neg.smul_const _).add ((hcoord 0 x).smul_const _)

  have hcP : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0))) x := hc.comp x hP
  have hdP : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => d (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0))) x := hd.comp x hP
  have hvF : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ =>
      (c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re) x := by
    intro i
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i) x :=
      differentiableAt_pi.1 hcP i
    exact Complex.reCLM.differentiableAt.comp x (h1.mul hE)
  have hvD : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ³ => d (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i) x :=
    fun i => differentiableAt_pi.1 hdP i

      (c (ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0)) i *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re)) x :=
    (((hvF 0).smul heR).add ((hvF 1).smul heTh)).add ((hvF 2).smul_const eZ)

  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ³, ∀ w s, L w s = x + s • cyl2cart x w :=

  have hLk : ∀ w s (k : Fin 3), L w s k = x k + s * cyl2cart x w k := by
    intro w s k; rw [hL]; simp
  have hLd' : ∀ w (k : Fin 3), HasDerivAt (fun s => L w s k) (cyl2cart x w k) 0 := by
    intro w k
    have e1 : (fun s => L w s k) = fun s => x k + s * cyl2cart x w k := funext fun s => hLk w s k
    rw [e1]
    exact (((hasDerivAt_id' (0:ℝ)).mul_const _).const_add _).congr_deriv (one_mul _)
  have hv0 : ∀ w, cyl2cart x w 0 = w 0 * ((rad x)⁻¹ * x 0) - w 1 * ((rad x)⁻¹ * x 1) :=
    fun w => (hrhsAll x w).1
  have hv1 : ∀ w, cyl2cart x w 1 = w 0 * ((rad x)⁻¹ * x 1) + w 1 * ((rad x)⁻¹ * x 0) :=
    fun w => (hrhsAll x w).2.1
  have hv2 : ∀ w, cyl2cart x w 2 = w 2 := fun w => (hrhsAll x w).2.2
  have hne : ∀ w, rad (L w 0) ≠ 0 := by intro w; rw [hL0]; exact hr0
  have hρ : ∀ w, HasDerivAt (fun s => rad (L w s)) (w 0) 0 := by
    intro w
    have h1 := (((hLd' w 0).mul (hLd' w 0)).add ((hLd' w 1).mul (hLd' w 1))).sqrt
      (by simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.mul_apply, hL0]; rw [← pow_two, ← pow_two]; exact hradpos.ne')
    have e1 : (fun s => rad (L w s)) =
        fun s => Real.sqrt (L w s 0 * L w s 0 + L w s 1 * L w s 1) := by
      funext s; simp only [rad, pow_two]
    rw [e1]
    refine h1.congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.mul_apply, hL0, hv0 w, hv1 w]
    rw [show Real.sqrt (x 0 * x 0 + x 1 * x 1) = rad x by simp only [rad, pow_two]]
    rw [div_eq_iff (mul_pos two_pos hr).ne']
    linear_combination (2 * w 0 * (rad x)⁻¹) * hx01 + (2 * w 0 * rad x) * hq
  have ha : ∀ w, HasDerivAt (fun s => (rad (L w s))⁻¹ * L w s 0) (-(w 1) * x 1 / rad x ^ 2) 0 := by
    intro w
    refine (((hρ w).inv (hne w)).mul (hLd' w 0)).congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [Pi.inv_apply, hL0, hv0 w]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hb : ∀ w, HasDerivAt (fun s => (rad (L w s))⁻¹ * L w s 1) (w 1 * x 0 / rad x ^ 2) 0 := by
    intro w
    refine (((hρ w).inv (hne w)).mul (hLd' w 1)).congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [Pi.inv_apply, hL0, hv1 w]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hPth : ∀ w, HasDerivAt (fun s => ptOf (L w s) t (Yph h (rad (L w s)) t + Y0))
      (w 0 • ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx h * rad x ^ (drx h - 1)) • vrv) +
        w 2 • ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ))) 0 := by
    intro w
    have hY := ((((hρ w).rpow_const (p := drx h) (Or.inl (hne w))).smul_const vrv).add_const
      (t • vtv)).add_const Y0
    have h3 := (hρ w).prodMk ((hLd' w 2).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_const (0:ℝ) t).prodMk hY))
    refine h3.congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [hL0, hv2 w]
    refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_)) <;> simp [smul_smul, mul_assoc]
  have hpath : ∀ (w : Fin 3 → ℝ) {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ f (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) →
      HasDerivAt (fun s => f (ptOf (L w s) t (Yph h (rad (L w s)) t + Y0)))
        (w 0 • dR h f (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) + w 2 • dZ f (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0))) 0 := by
    intro w V _ _ f hf
    have h4 := hf.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) (hPth w) (by simp only [hL0])
    rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul] at h4
    exact h4
  have hΦ : ∀ w : Fin 3 → ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf (L w s) : ℂ)))
      (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((w 1 / rad x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))) 0 := by
    intro w
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : ℝ → ℂ, u = fun s => (((rad (L w s))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (((L w s 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((L w s 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hexpG : ∀ s, 0 < rad (L w s) →
        Complex.exp (((thetaOf (L w s) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = u s := by
      intro s hs
      have hne' : ((rad (L w s) : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hs.ne'
      have key := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I (⟨L w s 0, L w s 1⟩ : ℂ)
      rw [hnormAll (L w s)] at key
      rw [hu]
      show _ = (((rad (L w s))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((L w s 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((L w s 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      rw [← Complex.mk_eq_add_mul_I, Complex.ofReal_inv, eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq₀ hne']
      exact key
    have hevG : ∀ s, 0 < rad (L w s) →
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf (L w s) : ℂ)) = u s ^ n := by
      intro s hs
      calc Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf (L w s) : ℂ))
          = Complex.exp ((n : ℂ) * ((thetaOf (L w s) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by congr 1; ring
        _ = Complex.exp ((thetaOf (L w s) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n := Complex.exp_int_mul _ _
        _ = u s ^ n := by rw [hexpG s hs]
    have h0pos : 0 < rad (L w 0) := by rw [hL0]; exact hr
    have hu0E : u 0 ^ n = Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ)) := by
      rw [← hevG 0 h0pos, hL0]
    have hu0 : u 0 ≠ 0 := by rw [← hexpG 0 h0pos]; exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    have hu0v : u 0 = (((rad x)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((x 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((x 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      rw [hu]; simp only [hL0]
    have hud : HasDerivAt u (Complex.I * ((w 1 / rad x : ℝ) : ℂ) * u 0) 0 := by
      rw [hu0v, hu]
      refine ((((hρ w).inv (hne w)).ofReal_comp).mul (((hLd' w 0).ofReal_comp).add
        (((hLd' w 1).ofReal_comp).mul_const Complex.I))).congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [Pi.inv_apply, Pi.add_apply, hL0, hv0 w, hv1 w]
      push_cast
      linear_combination (-((w 1 : ℂ) * (x 1 : ℂ) * ((rad x : ℂ))⁻¹ ^ 2)) * Complex.I_sq
    have h1 := (hasDerivAt_zpow n (u 0) (Or.inl hu0)).comp (0:ℝ) hud
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s => u s ^ n) (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((w 1 / rad x : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))) 0 := by
      refine h1.congr_deriv ?_
      rw [← hu0E, zpow_sub_one₀ hu0]
      linear_combination (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((w 1 / rad x : ℝ) : ℂ) * u 0 ^ n) * inv_mul_cancel₀ hu0
    refine h2.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    filter_upwards [(hρ w).continuousAt (Ioi_mem_nhds h0pos)] with s hs
    exact hevG s hs
  have hgen : ∀ (g : ℝ³ → Fin 3 → ℝ) (w g' : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => cyl2cart y (g y)) x →
      (∀ i, HasDerivAt (fun s => g (L w s) i) (g' i) 0) →
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => cyl2cart y (g y)) x (cyl2cart x w) =
        cyl2cart x (fun i => g' i + w 1 / rad x * ![-(g x 1), g x 0, 0] i) := by
    intro g w g' hMd hg
    have hLl : HasDerivAt (L w) (cyl2cart x w) 0 := by
      have e : L w = fun s => x + s • cyl2cart x w := funext (hL w)
      rw [e]
      exact (((hasDerivAt_id' (0:ℝ)).smul_const (cyl2cart x w)).const_add x).congr_deriv (one_smul ℝ _)
    have hlineF := hMd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) hLl (hL0 w).symm
    have hline : ∀ k : Fin 3, HasDerivAt (fun s => cyl2cart (L w s) (g (L w s)) k)
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => cyl2cart y (g y)) x (cyl2cart x w) k) 0 := fun k =>
      (EuclideanSpace.proj k : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ) hlineF
    have e0 : (fun s => cyl2cart (L w s) (g (L w s)) 0) = fun s =>
        g (L w s) 0 * ((rad (L w s))⁻¹ * L w s 0) - g (L w s) 1 * ((rad (L w s))⁻¹ * L w s 1) :=
      funext fun s => (hrhsAll (L w s) (g (L w s))).1
    have e1 : (fun s => cyl2cart (L w s) (g (L w s)) 1) = fun s =>
        g (L w s) 0 * ((rad (L w s))⁻¹ * L w s 1) + g (L w s) 1 * ((rad (L w s))⁻¹ * L w s 0) :=
      funext fun s => (hrhsAll (L w s) (g (L w s))).2.1
    have e2 : (fun s => cyl2cart (L w s) (g (L w s)) 2) = fun s => g (L w s) 2 :=
      funext fun s => (hrhsAll (L w s) (g (L w s))).2.2
    have d0 := ((hg 0).mul (ha w)).sub ((hg 1).mul (hb w))
    have d1 := ((hg 0).mul (hb w)).add ((hg 1).mul (ha w))
    have l0 := hline 0
    rw [e0] at l0
    have l1 := hline 1
    rw [e1] at l1
    have l2 := hline 2
    rw [e2] at l2
    have hw0 := l0.unique d0
    have hw1 := l1.unique d1
    have hw2 := l2.unique (hg 2)
    have hR := hrhsAll x (fun i => g' i + w 1 / rad x * ![-(g x 1), g x 0, 0] i)
    have comp0 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => cyl2cart y (g y)) x (cyl2cart x w) 0 =
        cyl2cart x (fun i => g' i + w 1 / rad x * ![-(g x 1), g x 0, 0] i) 0 := by
      rw [hw0, hR.1]
      simp only [hL0, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]
      field_simp
      ring
    have comp1 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => cyl2cart y (g y)) x (cyl2cart x w) 1 =
        cyl2cart x (fun i => g' i + w 1 / rad x * ![-(g x 1), g x 0, 0] i) 1 := by
      rw [hw1, hR.2.1]
      simp only [hL0, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]
      field_simp
      ring
    have comp2 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => cyl2cart y (g y)) x (cyl2cart x w) 2 =
        cyl2cart x (fun i => g' i + w 1 / rad x * ![-(g x 1), g x 0, 0] i) 2 := by
      rw [hw2, hR.2.2]
      simp
    refine PiLp.ext fun k => ?_
    fin_cases k
    · exact comp0
    · exact comp1
    · exact comp2
  have hFl : ∀ (w : Fin 3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3), HasDerivAt (fun s =>
      (c (ptOf (L w s) t (Yph h (rad (L w s)) t + Y0)) i *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf (L w s) : ℂ))).re)
      (((w 0 • dR h c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) + w 2 • dZ c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0))) i *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ)) +
        c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) i * (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((w 1 / rad x : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ)))).re) 0 := by
    intro w i
    have hc0 := hasDerivAt_pi.1 (hpath w c hc) i
    have h1 := Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ) (hc0.mul (hΦ w))
    simp only [Complex.reCLM_apply, hL0] at h1
    refine h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s => ?_)
    rfl
  have hDl : ∀ (w : Fin 3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3), HasDerivAt (fun s =>
      d (ptOf (L w s) t (Yph h (rad (L w s)) t + Y0)) i)
      ((w 0 • dR h d (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) + w 2 • dZ d (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0))) i) 0 :=
    fun w i => hasDerivAt_pi.1 (hpath w d hd) i
  have hadd : ∀ u v : Fin 3 → ℝ, cyl2cart x u + cyl2cart x v = cyl2cart x (u + v) := by
    intro u v
    simp only [cyl2cart, Pi.add_apply, add_smul]
    abel
  have hξ1 : (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)).1 = rad x := rfl
  refine ⟨hFd, hDd, ?_⟩
  rw [hgen _ (d (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0))) _ hFd (hFl _),
    hgen _ (fun i => (c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) i *
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re) _ hDd (hDl _), hadd]
  generalize Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ)) = E
  congr 1
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [mcK5, hξ1, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.div_ofReal_re, Complex.div_ofReal_im] <;>
    ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl), 0 < ξ.1 → 0 < qC B.h ξ → DifferentiableAt ℝ (VwT5 B G S γ m) ξ → DifferentiableAt ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ → mcK5 B.h (modeCoef5 B G (VwT5 B G S) γ m) (dUM5 B dPsi dv) (m * pint5 B G γ) ξ = fun i => ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (crossCoefM5 B G S dPsi dv γ m ξ i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl), 0 < ξ.1 → 0 < qC B.h ξ → DifferentiableAt ℝ (VwT5 B G S γ m) ξ → DifferentiableAt ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ → mcK5 B.h (modeCoef5 B G (VwT5 B G S) γ m) (dUM5 B dPsi dv) (m * pint5 B G γ) ξ = fun i => ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (crossCoefM5 B G S dPsi dv γ m ξ i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G S dPsi dv γ m ξ hr hq hW hφ
  
  have hcalc : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℂ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ) (a b : ℂ), DifferentiableAt ℝ f ξ →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ φ ξ → ∀ v : Cyl,
      fderiv ℝ (fun η => f η * Complex.exp (a * (b * (φ η : ℂ)))) ξ v =
        (fderiv ℝ f ξ v + a * b * ((fderiv ℝ φ ξ v : ℝ) : ℂ) * f ξ) *
          Complex.exp (a * (b * (φ ξ : ℂ))) := by
    intro f φ a b hf hφ' v
    have hcst : HasFDerivAt (fun η => ((φ η : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Complex.ofRealCLM.comp (fderiv ℝ φ ξ)) ξ := by
      have h0 := Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp ξ hφ'.hasFDerivAt
      exact h0
    have hL := (hcst.const_mul b).const_mul a
    have hE := hL.cexp
    have hP := hf.hasFDerivAt.mul hE
    rw [show (fun η => f η * Complex.exp (a * (b * (φ η : ℂ)))) =
      (f * fun x => Complex.exp (a * (b * (φ x : ℂ)))) from rfl, hP.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have hpi : ∀ (F : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ), DifferentiableAt ℝ F ξ → ∀ (v : Cyl) (i : Fin 3),
      fderiv ℝ F ξ v i = fderiv ℝ (fun η => F η i) ξ v := by
    intro F hF v i
    rw [(hasFDerivAt_pi'.1 hF.hasFDerivAt i).fderiv]
    rfl
  
  have h0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => ((phiL5 B G γ η : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ :=
    Complex.ofRealCLM.differentiableAt.comp ξ hφ
  have hEd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η =>
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ)))) ξ :=
    ((h0.const_mul _).const_mul _).cexp
  have hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeCoef5 B G (VwT5 B G S) γ m) ξ :=
    differentiableAt_pi.2 (fun i => (differentiableAt_pi.1 hW i).mul hEd)
  
  have hrc : ∀ i : Fin 3, dR B.h (modeCoef5 B G (VwT5 B G S) γ m) ξ i =
      (dR B.h (VwT5 B G S γ m) ξ i + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) *
        ((dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * VwT5 B G S γ m ξ i) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) := by
    intro i
    simp only [dR]
    rw [hpi _ hc, hpi _ hW]
    exact hcalc (fun η => VwT5 B G S γ m η i) (phiL5 B G γ) (Complex.I * (m : ℂ)) (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ)
      (differentiableAt_pi.1 hW i) hφ _
  have hzc : ∀ i : Fin 3, dZ (modeCoef5 B G (VwT5 B G S) γ m) ξ i =
      (dZ (VwT5 B G S γ m) ξ i + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) *
        ((dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * VwT5 B G S γ m ξ i) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) := by
    intro i
    simp only [dZ]
    rw [hpi _ hc, hpi _ hW]
    exact hcalc (fun η => VwT5 B G S γ m η i) (phiL5 B G γ) (Complex.I * (m : ℂ)) (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ)
      (differentiableAt_pi.1 hW i) hφ _
  
  have hQb : 0 < Qb γ.1 := by unfold Qb; positivity
  have hs : Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) ≠ 0 := Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr hQb
  have hts : Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) = (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1))⁻¹ := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.rpow_neg hQb.le]
  have hkb : (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    have hpos : 0 < kb B.h γ.1 := by
      unfold kb
      apply Nat.ceil_pos.mpr
      unfold epsb
      exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQb _) _
    exact_mod_cast hpos.ne'
  have hr0 : (ξ.1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
  
  have hg0 : ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) * nPhi5 B G γ ξ 0 =
      (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ := by
    simp only [nPhi5, DrC, Matrix.cons_val_zero, smul_eq_mul, hts]
    field_simp
  have hg1 : ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) * nPhi5 B G γ ξ 1 =
      (pint5 B G γ : ℝ) / ξ.1 := by
    simp only [nPhi5, pang5, RC, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.head_cons, hts]
    field_simp
  have hg2 : ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) * nPhi5 B G γ ξ 2 =
      (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ := by
    simp only [nPhi5, DzC, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.head_cons, smul_eq_mul, hts]
    field_simp
  
  have hQinv : qC B.h ξ ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) = (qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2))⁻¹ :=
    Real.rpow_neg hq.le _
  have hQ : (qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _).ne'
  have hrz : (ξ.1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hr0
  have hkz : (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hkb
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  all_goals
    simp only [mcK5, crossCoefM5, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk, Fin.isValue,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons,
      Matrix.tail_cons, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hrc, hzc, hg0, hg1, hg2, hQinv]
    simp only [modeCoef5]
    generalize Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) = E
    generalize hQd : qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) = Q at hQ ⊢
    have hQc : (Q : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hQ
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (l0 : ℕ), B.ok → 60 ≤ l0 → ∀ (α : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) α f → ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ‖ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α - 2 * (n : ℝ) - 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B l0 hok hl0 α f hf n
  have hh0 : 0 < B.h := hok.2.1.1
  have hh1 : B.h < 1/100 := hok.2.1.2.1
  
  have hlog : ∀ b : ℝ, ∃ E : ℝ, 0 ≤ E ∧ ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1 →
      (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ (2 * b) ≤ E * q ^ (-(1:ℝ)) := by
    intro b
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : ℕ, N = ⌈2 * b⌉₊ + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hN0 : N ≠ 0 := by omega
    have hceil : (0:ℝ) ≤ (⌈2 * b⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hNR : (N:ℝ) = (⌈2 * b⌉₊ : ℝ) + 1 := by rw [hN]; push_cast; ring
    have hN1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ N := by linarith
    have h2b : 2 * b ≤ (N:ℝ) := by linarith [Nat.le_ceil (2 * b)]
    refine ⟨(1 + (N:ℝ)) ^ N, by positivity, fun q hq0 hq1 => ?_⟩
    have hlq : Real.log q ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos hq0.le hq1
    have habs : |Real.log q| = Real.log q⁻¹ := by rw [abs_of_nonpos hlq, Real.log_inv]
    have hqi : 1 ≤ q⁻¹ := (one_le_inv₀ hq0).mpr hq1
    have hNinv : (0:ℝ) < (N:ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (by linarith)
    have hle := Real.log_le_rpow_div (x := q⁻¹) (by positivity) hNinv
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : ℝ, u = q⁻¹ ^ ((N:ℝ)⁻¹) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hu1 : 1 ≤ u := by rw [hu]; exact Real.one_le_rpow hqi hNinv.le
    have hdiv : q⁻¹ ^ ((N:ℝ)⁻¹) / (N:ℝ)⁻¹ = N * u := by rw [div_inv_eq_mul, hu]; ring
    rw [hdiv] at hle
    have hy1 : 1 ≤ 1 + |Real.log q| := by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log q)]
    have hy : 1 + |Real.log q| ≤ (1 + (N:ℝ)) * u := by
      have e : (1 + (N:ℝ)) * u = u + N * u := by ring
      rw [habs, e]; linarith
    calc (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ (2 * b) ≤ (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ ((N:ℕ):ℝ) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hy1 h2b
      _ = (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ N := Real.rpow_natCast _ _
      _ ≤ ((1 + (N:ℝ)) * u) ^ N := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) hy N
      _ = (1 + (N:ℝ)) ^ N * u ^ N := mul_pow _ _ _
      _ = (1 + (N:ℝ)) ^ N * q ^ (-(1:ℝ)) := by
          rw [hu, Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow (by positivity) hN0, Real.rpow_neg_one]
  obtain ⟨A, b, hNB⟩ := inm_nb_uniform B (qsOf l0) α f hok hf n
  obtain ⟨E, hE0, hE⟩ := hlog b
  have hqs10 : qsOf l0 ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ (-(10:ℝ)) := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ (-(10:ℝ))
    apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num)
    have : (60:ℝ) ≤ l0 := by exact_mod_cast hl0
    linarith
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (by simp)
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ (4:ℝ) ^ n * |A| * E := by positivity
  refine ⟨(4:ℝ) ^ n * |A| * E, fun ξ hξ j hj => ?_⟩
  have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
  have q0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ'.2.1])).1
  have q1 : qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 := le_trans hξ'.2.2.le hqs1
  have q10 : qC B.h ξ < (2:ℝ) ^ (-(10:ℝ)) := lt_of_lt_of_le hξ'.2.2 hqs10
  have hP : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α - 2 * (n : ℝ) - 1) := Real.rpow_nonneg q0.le _
  by_cases hsh : B.Xa < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < B.Xb
  swap
  · have hoff : XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ := by
      rcases not_and_or.mp hsh with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (not_lt.mp h)
      · exact Or.inr (not_lt.mp h)
    rw [shell_deriv_vanish_v5 B (qsOf l0) f hok hf.1 hf.2.2.1 j ξ hξ hoff, norm_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg hC0 hP
  · obtain ⟨hn0, hT, -⟩ := (coarseIdx_arith_v5 B.h hh0 hh1).2 _ q0 q10
    have hinv := ipb5_lnorm_inv_bound B.h ξ hh0.le (by linarith) q0 q1 hn0 hT f j
    have hnb := hNB ξ hξ hsh.1 hsh.2 j hj
    have hy := hE (qC B.h ξ) q0 q1
    have hNBnn : 0 ≤ NB B.h f j ξ := by unfold NB; exact norm_nonneg _
    set q := qC B.h ξ with hq
    have hq2 : 1 ≤ q ^ (-(2:ℝ)) := Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos q0 q1 (by norm_num)
    have hQ1 : 1 ≤ 4 * q ^ (-(2:ℝ)) := by linarith
    have hQj : (4 * q ^ (-(2:ℝ))) ^ j ≤ (4 * q ^ (-(2:ℝ))) ^ n := pow_le_pow_right₀ hQ1 hj
    have hha : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg q0.le _
    have hyp : 0 ≤ (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ (2 * b) :=
      Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log q)]) _
    have hNB2 : NB B.h f j ξ ≤ |A| * q ^ (B.h * α) * (E * q ^ (-(1:ℝ))) := by
      calc NB B.h f j ξ ≤ A * q ^ (B.h * α) * (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ (2 * b) := hnb
        _ ≤ |A| * q ^ (B.h * α) * (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ (2 * b) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self A) hha) hyp
        _ ≤ |A| * q ^ (B.h * α) * (E * q ^ (-(1:ℝ))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg A) hha)
    have hQn0 : 0 ≤ (4 * q ^ (-(2:ℝ))) ^ n := pow_nonneg (by linarith) n
    have hexp : (4 * q ^ (-(2:ℝ))) ^ n * (|A| * q ^ (B.h * α) * (E * q ^ (-(1:ℝ)))) =
        (4:ℝ) ^ n * |A| * E * q ^ (B.h * α - 2 * (n : ℝ) - 1) := by
      have e1 : (q ^ (-(2:ℝ))) ^ n = q ^ (-(2:ℝ) * (n:ℝ)) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul q0.le]
      have e2 : q ^ (B.h * α - 2 * (n : ℝ) - 1) =
          q ^ (-(2:ℝ) * (n:ℝ)) * q ^ (B.h * α) * q ^ (-(1:ℝ)) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add q0, ← Real.rpow_add q0]
        congr 1
        ring
      rw [mul_pow, e1, e2]
      ring
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ‖ ≤ (4 * q ^ (-(2:ℝ))) ^ j * NB B.h f j ξ := hinv
      _ ≤ (4 * q ^ (-(2:ℝ))) ^ n * (|A| * q ^ (B.h * α) * (E * q ^ (-(1:ℝ)))) :=
        mul_le_mul hQj hNB2 hNBnn hQn0
      _ = _ := hexp

subgoal_signatures.name: ipb5_lnorm_inv_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl), 0 ≤ h → h ≤ 1/2 → 0 < qC h ξ → qC h ξ ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ coarseIdx h (qC h ξ) → Tgc ^ (coarseIdx h (qC h ξ)) ≤ qC h ξ ^ (-(2:ℝ)) → ∀ (g : Cyl → ℝ) (k : ℕ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g ξ‖ ≤ (4 * qC h ξ ^ (-(2:ℝ))) ^ k * NB h g k ξ

subgoal_signatures.name: inm_nb_uniform
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(B : BG) (qs α : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ) (hB : B.ok) (hf : InM B qs α f) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ A b : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k →
      NB B.h f j ξ ≤ A * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * (1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)|) ^ (2 * b)

subgoal_signatures.name: shell_deriv_vanish_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) → ∀ (k : ℕ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: coarseIdx_arith_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h < 1/100 → (1 ≤ drx h ∧ drx h ≤ 2) ∧ ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q < (2:ℝ) ^ (-(10:ℝ)) → 0 ≤ coarseIdx h q ∧ Tgc ^ (coarseIdx h q) ≤ q ^ (-(2:ℝ)) ∧ (64 * Tgc)⁻¹ * q ^ (-(h * kapS)) * (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ (-(2:ℝ)) ≤ Lgc ^ (coarseIdx h q) * q ^ (drx h / 2) ∧ ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ q' : ℝ, 0 < q' → |q' - q| < δ → coarseIdx h q ≤ coarseIdx h q'

The three edges point to FORMAL_PROVED nodes and nothing duplicates §10. The single new child is the blueprint's [CRUX] s1, verbatim, and the Divergence entry records s2 as inlined. I checked s1 by hand and it is true for arbitrary g. Lnorm is block-diagonal with explicit inverse diag(q^-1/2, q^-(1/2-h), q^-1, JpowL n), because Jpow n scales the (vrv,vtv) coordinates. The scalar slots are at most q^-2 since q<=1 and h>=0. Each Jpow-slot coordinate is at most |a|+|b| <= 4 Tgc^n ||Y|| <= 4 q^-2 ||v||. Factoring D^k g through M gives the (4q^-2)^k NB bound. It is a pointwise linear-algebra lemma, far easier than the class-uniform target.

    rw [he']
    have hq' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2))
        (simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < rad z.1}) :=
      hqcont.mono (fun z hz => hz.1.1)
    have hψ : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 - B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2),
          8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) - rad z.1 ^ 2) : ℝ × ℝ))
        (simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < rad z.1}) :=
      ((continuous_const.mul (hradc.pow 2)).continuousOn.sub (continuousOn_const.mul hq')).prodMk
        ((continuousOn_const.mul hq').sub (hradc.pow 2).continuousOn)
    exact hψ.isOpen_inter_preimage (hΩ.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hradc))
      (isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioi)
  
  have hmap : Set.MapsTo (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => ptOf z.1 z.2 (Yph B.h (rad z.1) z.2 + 0)) W
      (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨⟨ht1, hqlt⟩, hr0, -, -⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨hr0, ht1, hqlt⟩
  
  have hfac : ∀ z ∈ W, z.2 < 1 ∧ 0 < simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ∧
      simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ≤ 1 ∧
      B.Xa / 2 * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2 ∧
      z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb ∧ ‖z‖ ≤ 8 * B.Xb + 2 := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨⟨ht1, hqlt⟩, hr0, hlo, hhi⟩ := hz
    have hτ : 0 < 1 - z.2 := by linarith
    have hq0 := (hSP.1 (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) hτ).1
    have hq1 : simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ≤ 1 := le_trans hqlt.le hqs1
    have hrsq : rad z.1 ^ 2 = z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨hτq, hz2⟩ := hSP.2.1 (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) hτ
    have hpow1 : simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (1 - 2 * B.h) ≤ 1 :=
      Real.rpow_le_one hq0.le hq1 (by linarith)
    have hx2 : z.1 2 ^ 2 < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hz2 hpow1
    have hρ8 : z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb := by
      rw [← hrsq]
      calc rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) := hhi
        _ ≤ 8 * B.Xb * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq1 (by linarith)
        _ = 8 * B.Xb := mul_one _
    have hnx : ‖z.1‖ ^ 2 = z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2 + z.1 2 ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), Fin.sum_univ_three]
      simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    have hlt : ‖z.1‖ ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb + 1 := by rw [hnx]; linarith
    have hx : ‖z.1‖ ≤ 8 * B.Xb + 2 := by linarith [sq_nonneg (‖z.1‖ - 1)]
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ z.2 := by linarith
    have hnz : ‖z‖ ≤ 8 * B.Xb + 2 := by
      rw [Prod.norm_def, max_le_iff]
      refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht0]
      linarith
    exact ⟨ht1, hq0, hq1, by linarith, hρ8, hnz⟩
  have hq01 : ∀ w ∈ W, 0 < simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ∧ simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 :=
    fun w hw => ⟨(hfac w hw).2.1, (hfac w hw).2.2.1⟩
  
  have hbdd : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (φ : ℝ³ × ℝ → V),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ W,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k φ w‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K) := by
    intro V _ _ φ hφ k
    have hc : Continuous (fun z => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k φ z) :=
      hφ.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℝ³ × ℝ) (8 * B.Xb + 2)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      hc.continuousOn
    refine ⟨C, 0, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    rw [neg_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
    exact hC w (mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mpr (hfac w hw).2.2.2.2.2)
  
  have hadd : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f g : ℝ³ × ℝ → V),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ W,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K)) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ W,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g w‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => f z + g z) W ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ W,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => f z + g z) w‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K) := by
    intro V _ _ f g hf hg bf bg
    refine ⟨hf.add hg, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C1, K1, h1⟩ := bf k
    obtain ⟨C2, K2, h2⟩ := bg k
    refine ⟨|C1| + |C2|, max K1 K2, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    have hq := hq01 w hw
    have hmle : ((k : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
    have hnh : W ∈ nhds w := hWo.mem_nhds hw
    have hsum : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => f z + g z) w =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g w :=
      iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((hf.contDiffAt hnh).of_le hmle) ((hg.contDiffAt hnh).of_le hmle)
    rw [hsum]
    have e1 := (h1 w hw).trans (key2 C1 _ _ _ hq.1 hq.2 (neg_le_neg (le_max_left K1 K2)))
    have e2 := (h2 w hw).trans (key2 C2 _ _ _ hq.1 hq.2 (neg_le_neg (le_max_right K1 K2)))
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g w‖
        ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w‖ + ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g w‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ |C1| * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-max K1 K2) +
          |C2| * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-max K1 K2) := add_le_add e1 e2
      _ = (|C1| + |C2|) * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-max K1 K2) := by ring
  
  have hρc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2) :=
    ((hco 0).pow 2).add ((hco 1).pow 2)
  have hrho : ∀ p : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2) ^ p) W ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ W, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2) ^ p) w‖ ≤
        C * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K) := by
    intro p
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => s ^ p) (Ioi 0) :=
      fun _ hs => (Real.contDiffAt_rpow_const_of_ne (ne_of_gt hs)).contDiffWithinAt
    have hmT : Set.MapsTo (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2) W (Ioi 0) := by
      intro z hz
      have hf := hfac z hz
      have ha : 0 < B.Xa / 2 * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) := mul_pos (by linarith) hf.2.1
      exact mem_Ioi.mpr (lt_trans ha hf.2.2.2.1)
    have hnorm : ∀ (k : ℕ) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun s : ℝ => s ^ p) s‖ =
        |(descPochhammer ℝ k).eval p| * s ^ (p - k) := by
      intro k s hs
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate,
        Real.iter_deriv_rpow_const, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hs _)]
    have hgb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ W,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun s : ℝ => s ^ p) ((fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2) w)‖ ≤
          C * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K) := by
      intro k
      by_cases hpk : 0 ≤ p - k
      · refine ⟨|(descPochhammer ℝ k).eval p| * (8 * B.Xb) ^ (p - k), 0, fun w hw => ?_⟩
        have hf := hfac w hw
        have hs0 : 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 := hmT hw
        rw [neg_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
        show ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun s : ℝ => s ^ p) (w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2)‖ ≤ _
        rw [hnorm k _ hs0]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_le_rpow hs0.le hf.2.2.2.2.1.le hpk)
          (abs_nonneg _)
      · push_neg at hpk
        refine ⟨|(descPochhammer ℝ k).eval p| * (B.Xa / 2) ^ (p - k), k - p, fun w hw => ?_⟩
        have hf := hfac w hw
        have hs0 : 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 := hmT hw
        have ha0 : 0 < B.Xa / 2 * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) := mul_pos (by linarith) hf.2.1
        show ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun s : ℝ => s ^ p) (w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2)‖ ≤ _
        rw [hnorm k _ hs0]
        have h1 : (w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2) ^ (p - k) ≤
            (B.Xa / 2 * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ^ (p - k) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos ha0 hf.2.2.2.1.le hpk.le
        rw [Real.mul_rpow (by linarith) hf.2.1.le] at h1
        calc |(descPochhammer ℝ k).eval p| * (w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2) ^ (p - k)
            ≤ |(descPochhammer ℝ k).eval p| *
                ((B.Xa / 2) ^ (p - k) * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (p - k)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (abs_nonneg _)
          _ = |(descPochhammer ℝ k).eval p| * (B.Xa / 2) ^ (p - k) *
                simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-((k:ℝ) - p)) := by
              rw [neg_sub]; ring
    exact wt_comp_bound (fun s : ℝ => s ^ p) (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2)
      (fun w => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) W W (Ioi 0) hWo isOpen_Ioi subset_rfl hmT hq01 hg
      hρc.contDiffOn hgb (hbdd _ hρc)
  
  obtain ⟨u1, hu1⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ, f = fun z => (z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2) ^ (1/2 : ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨u4, hu4⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ, f = fun z => (z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2) ^ (1/2 * drx B.h) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ, f = fun z => (z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2) ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Aff, hAffd⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ³ × ℝ → Cyl, f = fun z => ((0:ℝ), z.1 2, z.2, z.2 • vtv) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨e1, he1⟩ : ∃ c : Cyl, c = ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨e4, he4⟩ : ∃ c : Cyl, c = ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), vrv) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨lsC, hlsC⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ →L[ℝ] Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl, L = ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨lsE, hlsE⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³, L = ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have sU1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u1 W := by rw [hu1]; exact (hrho _).1
  have bU1 : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ W,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k u1 w‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K) := by
    rw [hu1]; exact (hrho _).2
  have sU4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u4 W := by rw [hu4]; exact (hrho _).1
  have bU4 : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ W,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k u4 w‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K) := by
    rw [hu4]; exact (hrho _).2
  have sV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v W := by rw [hv]; exact (hrho _).1
  have bV : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ W,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k v w‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K) := by
    rw [hv]; exact (hrho _).2
  have hAff : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Aff := by
    rw [hAffd]
    exact contDiff_const.prodMk ((hco 2).prodMk (contDiff_snd.prodMk (contDiff_snd.smul contDiff_const)))
  have hI1 : ∀ x : ℝ³, rad x = (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) ^ (1/2 : ℝ) := fun x => Real.sqrt_eq_rpow _
  
  obtain ⟨sP1, bP1⟩ := wt_bilinear_bound lsC u1 (fun _ : ℝ³ × ℝ => e1)
    (fun w => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) W W hWo subset_rfl hq01 sU1 contDiffOn_const bU1
    (hbdd _ contDiff_const)
  obtain ⟨sP4, bP4⟩ := wt_bilinear_bound lsC u4 (fun _ : ℝ³ × ℝ => e4)
    (fun w => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) W W hWo subset_rfl hq01 sU4 contDiffOn_const bU4
    (hbdd _ contDiff_const)
  obtain ⟨sA1, bA1⟩ := hadd Aff (fun z => lsC (u1 z) e1) hAff.contDiffOn sP1 (hbdd _ hAff) bP1
  obtain ⟨sXi0, bXi0⟩ := hadd (fun z => Aff z + lsC (u1 z) e1) (fun z => lsC (u4 z) e4) sA1 sP4 bA1 bP4
  have hXi_eq : (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => ptOf z.1 z.2 (Yph B.h (rad z.1) z.2 + 0)) =
      fun z => (Aff z + lsC (u1 z) e1) + lsC (u4 z) e4 := by
    funext z
    have I2 : rad z.1 ^ drx B.h = (z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2) ^ (1/2 * drx B.h) := by
      rw [hI1, ← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity)]
    subst hu1 hu4 hAffd he1 he4 hlsC
    beta_reduce
    rw [← hI1, ← I2]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, ptOf, Yph, add_zero]
    ext <;> simp <;> ring
  have sXi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => ptOf z.1 z.2 (Yph B.h (rad z.1) z.2 + 0)) W := by
    rw [hXi_eq]; exact sXi0
  have bXi : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ W,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => ptOf z.1 z.2 (Yph B.h (rad z.1) z.2 + 0)) w‖ ≤
        C * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K) := by
    rw [hXi_eq]; exact bXi0
  
  have hAz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => azVec z.1) := by
    show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => -(z.1 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
      z.1 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ))
    exact ((hco 1).neg.smul contDiff_const).add ((hco 0).smul contDiff_const)
  obtain ⟨sE0, bE0⟩ := wt_bilinear_bound lsE v (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => azVec z.1)
    (fun w => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) W W hWo subset_rfl hq01 sV hAz.contDiffOn bV
    (hbdd _ hAz)
  have hE_eq : (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => eTh z.1) = fun z => lsE (v z) (azVec z.1) := by
    funext z
    have I3 : (rad z.1)⁻¹ = (z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2) ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) := by
      rw [hI1, Real.rpow_neg (by positivity)]
    subst hv hlsE
    simp only [eTh, ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, I3]
  have sE : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => eTh z.1) W := by rw [hE_eq]; exact sE0
  have bE : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ W,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => eTh z.1) w‖ ≤
        C * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K) := by
    rw [hE_eq]; exact bE0
  
  obtain ⟨sP0, bP0⟩ := simScale_rpow_wt_bound B.h e hSP hh0 (by linarith)
  have sP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e) W :=
    sP0.mono (fun z hz => (hfac z hz).1)
  have bP : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ W,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e) w‖ ≤
        C * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-K) := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, K, hC⟩ := bP0 k
    exact ⟨C, K, fun w hw => hC w (hfac w hw).1 (hfac w hw).2.2.1⟩
  
  refine ⟨hD, hWo, hmap, sXi, sE, sP, fun k => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨C1, K1, h1⟩ := bXi k
  obtain ⟨C2, K2, h2⟩ := bE k
  obtain ⟨C3, K3, h3⟩ := bP k
  refine ⟨|C1| + |C2| + |C3|, max K1 (max K2 K3), fun z hz => ?_⟩
  have hq := hq01 z hz
  have hpn : 0 ≤ simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-max K1 (max K2 K3)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.1.le _
  have hK1 : K1 ≤ max K1 (max K2 K3) := le_max_left _ _
  have hK2 : K2 ≤ max K1 (max K2 K3) := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hK3 : K3 ≤ max K1 (max K2 K3) := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have f1 := (h1 z hz).trans (key2 C1 _ _ _ hq.1 hq.2 (neg_le_neg hK1))
  have f2 := (h2 z hz).trans (key2 C2 _ _ _ hq.1 hq.2 (neg_le_neg hK2))
  have f3 := (h3 z hz).trans (key2 C3 _ _ _ hq.1 hq.2 (neg_le_neg hK3))
  have a1 := abs_nonneg C1
  have a2 := abs_nonneg C2
  have a3 := abs_nonneg C3
  refine ⟨f1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hpn),
    f2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hpn),
    f3.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hpn)⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: wt_comp_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {E F G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (g : F → G) (f : E → F) (ρ : E → ℝ) (Ω S : Set E) (T : Set F), IsOpen Ω → IsOpen T → S ⊆ Ω → MapsTo f Ω T → (∀ w ∈ S, 0 < ρ w ∧ ρ w ≤ 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g T → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g (f w)‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (g ∘ f) Ω ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (g ∘ f) w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)

subgoal_signatures.name: wt_bilinear_bound
