informal_problem.statement: ∀ {E F G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (g : F → G) (f : E → F) (Ω : Set E) (T : Set F), IsOpen Ω → IsOpen T → Set.MapsTo f Ω T → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g T → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : E) (ρ a Cg Cf K : ℝ), w ∈ Ω → 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ K → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g (f w)‖ ≤ Cg * ρ ^ a) → (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f w‖ ≤ Cf * ρ ^ (-K)) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (g ∘ f) w‖ ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) * Cg * (max 1 Cf) ^ n * ρ ^ (a - (n : ℝ) * K)

signature.name: ipb5_wexp_comp
signature.statement: ∀ {E F G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (g : F → G) (f : E → F) (Ω : Set E) (T : Set F), IsOpen Ω → IsOpen T → Set.MapsTo f Ω T → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g T → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : E) (ρ a Cg Cf K : ℝ), w ∈ Ω → 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ K → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g (f w)‖ ≤ Cg * ρ ^ a) → (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f w‖ ≤ Cf * ρ ^ (-K)) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (g ∘ f) w‖ ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) * Cg * (max 1 Cf) ^ n * ρ ^ (a - (n : ℝ) * K)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro E F G _ _ _ _ _ _ g f Ω T hΩ hT hmaps hg hf n w ρ a Cg Cf K hw hr0 hr1 hK hGb hFb
  have hfw : f w ∈ T := hmaps hw
  have hpos : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ ρ ^ c := fun c => (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr0 c).le
  have hP1 : 1 ≤ ρ ^ (-K) :=
    Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hr0 hr1 (by linarith)
  have hM1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ max 1 Cf := le_max_left _ _
  have hD1 : 1 ≤ max 1 Cf * ρ ^ (-K) := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hM1 hP1
  have hgbound : ∀ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i g T (f w)‖ ≤ Cg * ρ ^ a := by
    intro i hi
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hT hfw]
    exact hGb i hi
  have hfbound : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n →
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i f Ω w‖ ≤ (max 1 Cf * ρ ^ (-K)) ^ i := by
    intro i hi1 hi
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩ hw]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f w‖ ≤ Cf * ρ ^ (-K) := hFb i hi1 hi
      _ ≤ max 1 Cf * ρ ^ (-K) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) (hpos _)
      _ ≤ (max 1 Cf * ρ ^ (-K)) ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
  have hle : ((n : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hg hf hle hT.uniqueDiffOn
    hΩ.uniqueDiffOn hmaps hw hgbound hfbound
  rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hΩ hw] at hFdB
  refine hFdB.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  have e1 : (ρ ^ (-K)) ^ n = ρ ^ (-((n : ℝ) * K)) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hr0.le]
    congr 1 <;> ring
  have e2 : ρ ^ a * ρ ^ (-((n : ℝ) * K)) = ρ ^ (a - (n : ℝ) * K) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hr0]; congr 1 <;> ring
  rw [mul_pow, e1, ← e2]; ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ {E F G H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] H) (f : E → F) (g : E → G) (Ω : Set E), IsOpen Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g Ω → ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : E) (ρ a b Cf Cg : ℝ), w ∈ Ω → 0 < ρ → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f w‖ ≤ Cf * ρ ^ a) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g w‖ ≤ Cg * ρ ^ b) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) w‖ ≤ ‖B‖ * 2 ^ n * Cf * Cg * ρ ^ (a + b)

signature.name: ipb5_wexp_bilin
signature.statement: ∀ {E F G H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] H) (f : E → F) (g : E → G) (Ω : Set E), IsOpen Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g Ω → ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : E) (ρ a b Cf Cg : ℝ), w ∈ Ω → 0 < ρ → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f w‖ ≤ Cf * ρ ^ a) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g w‖ ≤ Cg * ρ ^ b) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) w‖ ≤ ‖B‖ * 2 ^ n * Cf * Cg * ρ ^ (a + b)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro E F G H _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ B f g Ω hΩ hf hg n w ρ a b Cf Cg hw hρ hbf hbg
  have hU : UniqueDiffOn ℝ Ω := hΩ.uniqueDiffOn
  have key := ContinuousLinearMap.norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_le_of_bilinear B hf hg hU hw
    (n := n) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hΩ hw] at key
  refine key.trans ?_
  have hsum : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ)) = 2 ^ n := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose n
  have hP0 : 0 ≤ Cf * ρ ^ a := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hbf 0 (Nat.zero_le _))
  have hfin : ‖B‖ * 2 ^ n * Cf * Cg * ρ ^ (a + b) =
      ‖B‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * ((Cf * ρ ^ a) * (Cg * ρ ^ b)) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hsum, Real.rpow_add hρ]; ring
  rw [hfin]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg B)
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_
  have hin : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
  rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩ hw, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (n - i) hΩ hw]
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n.choose i := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  calc (n.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f w‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) g w‖
      ≤ (n.choose i : ℝ) * (Cf * ρ ^ a) * (Cg * ρ ^ b) :=
        mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbf i hin) h0) (hbg (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i))
          (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg h0 hP0)
    _ = (n.choose i : ℝ) * ((Cf * ρ ^ a) * (Cg * ρ ^ b)) := by ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (l0 : ℕ) (e : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) → (∀ z ∈ {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < rad z.1 ∧ B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < 2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 ∧ rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)}, ipb5MV B l0 e f z = (simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e * f (ptOf z.1 z.2 (Yph B.h (rad z.1) z.2 + 0))) • eTh z.1 ∧ ipb5MS B l0 e f z = simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e * f (ptOf z.1 z.2 (Yph B.h (rad z.1) z.2 + 0))) ∧ ∀ z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0), z ∈ {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < rad z.1 ∧ B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < 2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 ∧ rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)} ∨ (ipb5MV B l0 e f =ᶠ[nhds z] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ³)) ∧ ipb5MS B l0 e f =ᶠ[nhds z] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)))

signature.name: ipb5_mean_window_reduction
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (l0 : ℕ) (e : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ), B.ok → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) → (∀ z ∈ {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < rad z.1 ∧ B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < 2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 ∧ rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)}, ipb5MV B l0 e f z = (simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e * f (ptOf z.1 z.2 (Yph B.h (rad z.1) z.2 + 0))) • eTh z.1 ∧ ipb5MS B l0 e f z = simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e * f (ptOf z.1 z.2 (Yph B.h (rad z.1) z.2 + 0))) ∧ ∀ z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0), z ∈ {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < rad z.1 ∧ B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < 2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 ∧ rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)} ∨ (ipb5MV B l0 e f =ᶠ[nhds z] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ³)) ∧ ipb5MS B l0 e f =ᶠ[nhds z] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B l0 e f hok hvan
  obtain ⟨-, -, hXa, hXa1, h12, h2Xb, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  have hXb : 0 < B.Xb := by linarith
  have hqpos : ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → 0 < simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) := fun w hw =>
    (hok.1.1 (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) (by linarith)).1
  have hqcont : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
    have hmap : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      (((EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.comp continuous_fst).prodMk
        (continuous_const.sub continuous_snd))
    refine hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.comp hmap.continuousOn ?_
    intro w hw
    exact ⟨mem_univ _, mem_Ioi.mpr (sub_pos.mpr hw)⟩
  have hΩ : IsOpen (simDomain B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have e : simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
        (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := rfl
    rw [e]
    exact hqcont.isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const) isOpen_Iio
  have hqcΩ : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2))
      (simDomain B.h (qsOf l0)) := hqcont.mono (fun w hw => hw.1)
  have hrad : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1 ^ 2) := by
    have p0 : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.1 0) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.comp continuous_fst
    have p1 : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.1 1) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.comp continuous_fst
    unfold rad
    exact (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp ((p0.pow 2).add (p1.pow 2))).pow 2
  
  have hzero : ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, (corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2 →
      XC B.h (ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + 0)) ≤ B.Xa ∨
        B.Xb ≤ XC B.h (ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + 0))) →
      ipb5MV B l0 e f w = 0 ∧ ipb5MS B l0 e f w = 0 := by
    intro w H
    by_cases hc : corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2
    · have hmem : ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + 0) ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) :=
        ⟨hc.1, hc.2.1, hc.2.2⟩
      have hf0 := hvan _ hmem (H hc)
      simp only [ipb5MV, ipb5MS, if_pos hc, hf0, mul_zero, zero_smul, and_self]
    · simp only [ipb5MV, ipb5MS, if_neg hc, and_self]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨hzΩ, hr, -, -⟩ := hz
    have hc : corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2 := ⟨hr, hzΩ.1, hzΩ.2⟩
    simp only [ipb5MV, ipb5MS, if_pos hc]
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · intro z hz
    have hQ : 0 < simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) := hqpos z hz.1
    
    have hO₁ : IsOpen (simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∩
        (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => B.Xa * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) - rad w.1 ^ 2) ⁻¹' Ioi 0) :=
      ((continuousOn_const.mul hqcΩ).sub hrad.continuousOn).isOpen_inter_preimage hΩ isOpen_Ioi
    have hO₂ : IsOpen (simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∩
        (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1 ^ 2 - 4 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ⁻¹' Ioi 0) :=
      (hrad.continuousOn.sub (continuousOn_const.mul hqcΩ)).isOpen_inter_preimage hΩ isOpen_Ioi
    have hXCeq : ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, XC B.h (ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + 0)) =
        rad w.1 ^ 2 / (2 * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) := fun w => rfl
    by_cases h1 : rad z.1 ^ 2 < B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)
    · right
      have hzO : z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∩
          (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => B.Xa * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) - rad w.1 ^ 2) ⁻¹' Ioi 0 :=
        ⟨hz, sub_pos.mpr h1⟩
      have hZ : ∀ w ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∩
          (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => B.Xa * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) - rad w.1 ^ 2) ⁻¹' Ioi 0,
          ipb5MV B l0 e f w = 0 ∧ ipb5MS B l0 e f w = 0 := by
        intro w hw
        apply hzero w
        intro _
        left
        have hqw := hqpos w hw.1.1
        have hw2 : 0 < B.Xa * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) - rad w.1 ^ 2 := hw.2
        have hpos : 0 < B.Xa * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) := mul_pos hXa hqw
        rw [hXCeq w, div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
        linarith
      exact ⟨Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO₁.mem_nhds hzO) (fun w hw => (hZ w hw).1),
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO₁.mem_nhds hzO) (fun w hw => (hZ w hw).2)⟩
    by_cases h2 : 4 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < rad z.1 ^ 2
    · right
      have hzO : z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∩
          (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1 ^ 2 - 4 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ⁻¹' Ioi 0 :=
        ⟨hz, sub_pos.mpr h2⟩
      have hZ : ∀ w ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∩
          (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1 ^ 2 - 4 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ⁻¹' Ioi 0,
          ipb5MV B l0 e f w = 0 ∧ ipb5MS B l0 e f w = 0 := by
        intro w hw
        apply hzero w
        intro _
        right
        have hqw := hqpos w hw.1.1
        have hw2 : 0 < rad w.1 ^ 2 - 4 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) := hw.2
        have hpos : 0 < B.Xb * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) := mul_pos hXb hqw
        rw [hXCeq w, le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]
        linarith
      exact ⟨Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO₂.mem_nhds hzO) (fun w hw => (hZ w hw).1),
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO₂.mem_nhds hzO) (fun w hw => (hZ w hw).2)⟩
    left
    push_neg at h1 h2
    have hpa : 0 < B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) := mul_pos hXa hQ
    have hpb : 0 < B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) := mul_pos hXb hQ
    have hr : 0 < rad z.1 := by
      rcases (Real.sqrt_nonneg (z.1 0 ^ 2 + z.1 1 ^ 2)).lt_or_eq with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso
        have h0 : rad z.1 = 0 := h.symm
        rw [h0] at h1
        linarith
    refine ⟨hz, hr, by linarith, by linarith⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → ∀ (l0 : ℕ), qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB → ∀ (a : WC) (H : Finset ℤ), (∀ γ m, m ∉ H → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), a γ m ξ = 0) → (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ ∧ etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0) → ∀ ξ0 ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∃ (T : Finset (Lab × ℤ)) (U : Set Cyl), IsOpen U ∧ ξ0 ∈ U ∧ T.card ≤ 162 * H.card ∧ (∀ t ∈ T, t.2 ∈ H ∧ ActiveL4 B G t.1 ∧ |Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ0) + (t.1.1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ γ m, (γ, m) ∉ T → ∀ ξ ∈ U ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), a γ m ξ = 0

signature.name: wpf_local_labels
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → ∀ (l0 : ℕ), qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB → ∀ (a : WC) (H : Finset ℤ), (∀ γ m, m ∉ H → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), a γ m ξ = 0) → (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ ∧ etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0) → ∀ ξ0 ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∃ (T : Finset (Lab × ℤ)) (U : Set Cyl), IsOpen U ∧ ξ0 ∈ U ∧ T.card ≤ 162 * H.card ∧ (∀ t ∈ T, t.2 ∈ H ∧ ActiveL4 B G t.1 ∧ |Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ0) + (t.1.1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ γ m, (γ, m) ∉ T → ∀ ξ ∈ U ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), a γ m ξ = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  intro B G hok l0 hqs a H hfin hsupp ξ0 hξ0
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  have hξ0' : 0 < ξ0.1 ∧ ξ0.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ0 < qsOf l0 := hξ0
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ0 := (hS.1 ξ0.2.1 (1 - ξ0.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ0'.2.1])).1
  
  have hqc : ContinuousAt (qC B.h) ξ0 := by
    have hmem : ((ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)) :=
      ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ0.2.2.1 by linarith [hξ0'.2.1]⟩
    have hg : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.continuousAt ((isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds hmem)
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    exact hg.comp (f := fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) hφ.continuousAt
  have hlogc : ContinuousAt (fun ξ => Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ)) ξ0 := by
    have := ((Real.continuousAt_log hq0.ne').comp hqc).div_const (Real.log 2)
    exact this
  
  obtain ⟨N, hNo, hξN, Γ, hΓ⟩ := etaL_locfin B.h (qsOf l0) hS ξ0 hξ0
  
  have hK : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (s : ℝ), sqPart μ j s ≠ 0 → |s / μ - (j:ℝ)| < 1 := by
    intro μ j s hne
    have hb : bumpR (s / μ - j) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hne
      unfold sqPart
      rw [h0, zero_div]
    unfold bumpR at hb
    by_contra hlt
    apply hb
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ |s / μ - j| := not_lt.mp hlt
    have h2 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (s / μ - j) ^ 2 := by
      calc (1:ℝ) = 1 * 1 := by norm_num
        _ ≤ |s / μ - j| * |s / μ - j| := mul_le_mul h1 h1 zero_le_one (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = (s / μ - j) ^ 2 := by rw [← sq, sq_abs]
    linarith
  
  have hWin : ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 →
      |Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ) + (γ.1 : ℝ)| < 1 ∧
      |chartR B.h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1 : ℝ)| < 1 ∧
      |chartZ B.h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.1 : ℝ)| < 1 ∧
      |chartT B.h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2 : ℝ)| < 1 := by
    intro γ ξ hne
    unfold etaL at hne
    obtain ⟨hA, hBC⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hne
    obtain ⟨hB12, hB3⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hBC
    obtain ⟨hB1, hB2⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hB12
    refine ⟨?_, hK _ _ _ hB1, hK _ _ _ hB2, hK _ _ _ hB3⟩
    have h0 := hK _ _ _ hA
    have e : Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ) / 1 - (((-(γ.1:ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℝ) =
        Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ) + (γ.1 : ℝ) := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [e] at h0
    exact h0
  
  obtain ⟨W, hWdef⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ → Finset ℤ, W = fun y => Finset.Icc ⌈y - 1⌉ ⌊y + 1⌋ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hWm : ∀ (y : ℝ) (z : ℤ), |y - (z:ℝ)| ≤ 1 → z ∈ W y := by
    intro y z hz
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_le.mp hz
    simp only [hWdef, Finset.mem_Icc]
    exact ⟨Int.ceil_le.mpr (by linarith), Int.le_floor.mpr (by linarith)⟩
  have hWc : ∀ y : ℝ, (W y).card ≤ 3 := by
    intro y
    simp only [hWdef]
    rw [Int.card_Icc]
    have h1 := Int.floor_le (y + 1)
    have h2 := Int.le_ceil (y - 1)
    have h3 : ((⌊y + 1⌋ - ⌈y - 1⌉ : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by push_cast; linarith
    have h4 : ⌊y + 1⌋ - ⌈y - 1⌉ ≤ 2 := by exact_mod_cast h3
    have h5 : ⌊y + 1⌋ + 1 - ⌈y - 1⌉ ≤ ((3:ℕ):ℤ) := by push_cast; omega
    exact Int.toNat_le.mpr h5
  
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ⟩ : ∃ Λ : Finset Lab, Λ = ((W (-Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ0))).image Int.toNat).biUnion
      (fun ℓ => ((W (chartR B.h ℓ ξ0 / Sb ℓ ^ (-3:ℤ))) ×ˢ ((W (chartZ B.h ℓ ξ0 / Sb ℓ ^ (-3:ℤ))) ×ˢ
        ((W (chartT B.h ℓ ξ0 / Sb ℓ ^ (-3:ℤ))) ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset Bool)))).image
        (fun z : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × Bool => ((ℓ, (z.1, z.2.1, z.2.2.1), z.2.2.2) : Lab))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΛcard : Λ.card ≤ 162 := by
    rw [hΛ]
    refine le_trans Finset.card_biUnion_le ?_
    refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (g := fun _ => 54) (fun ℓ _ => ?_)) ?_
    · refine le_trans Finset.card_image_le ?_
      rw [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_univ,
        Fintype.card_bool]
      calc _ ≤ 3 * (3 * (3 * 2)) :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul (hWc _) (Nat.mul_le_mul (hWc _) (Nat.mul_le_mul (hWc _) le_rfl))
        _ = 54 := by norm_num
    · simp only [Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul]
      have := le_trans (Finset.card_image_le (s := W (-Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ0))) (f := Int.toNat))
        (hWc (-Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ0)))
      omega
  have hmemΛ : ∀ γ : Lab, |Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ0) + (γ.1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 →
      |chartR B.h γ.1 ξ0 / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 →
      |chartZ B.h γ.1 ξ0 / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 →
      |chartT B.h γ.1 ξ0 / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 → γ ∈ Λ := by
    intro γ h0 h1 h2 h3
    rw [hΛ, Finset.mem_biUnion]
    refine ⟨γ.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.mem_image]
      refine ⟨(γ.1 : ℤ), hWm _ _ ?_, Int.toNat_natCast γ.1⟩
      have e : -Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ0) - (((γ.1 : ℤ)) : ℝ) =
          -(Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ0) + (γ.1 : ℝ)) := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [e, abs_neg]
      exact h0
    · rw [Finset.mem_image]
      refine ⟨(γ.2.1.1, γ.2.1.2.1, γ.2.1.2.2, γ.2.2), ?_, rfl⟩
      simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_univ, and_true]
      exact ⟨hWm _ _ h1, hWm _ _ h2, hWm _ _ h3⟩
  
  obtain ⟨S, hSdef⟩ : ∃ S : Lab × ℤ → Set Cyl,
      S = fun t => {ξ | ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ a t.1 t.2 ξ ≠ 0} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hSmem : ∀ t ξ, ξ ∈ S t ↔ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ a t.1 t.2 ξ ≠ 0 := by
    intro t ξ
    rw [hSdef]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : Finset (Lab × ℤ), T = (Γ ×ˢ H).filter (fun t => ξ0 ∈ closure (S t)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hTmem : ∀ t, t ∈ T ↔ (t.1 ∈ Γ ∧ t.2 ∈ H) ∧ ξ0 ∈ closure (S t) := by
    intro t
    rw [hTdef, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product]
  obtain ⟨U, hUdef⟩ : ∃ U : Set Cyl, U = N ∩ ⋂ t ∈ (Γ ×ˢ H) \ T, (closure (S t))ᶜ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hUo : IsOpen U := by
    rw [hUdef]
    exact hNo.inter (isOpen_biInter_finset (fun t _ => isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl))
  have hUmem : ∀ ξ, ξ ∈ U ↔ ξ ∈ N ∧ ∀ t ∈ (Γ ×ˢ H) \ T, ξ ∉ closure (S t) := by
    intro ξ
    rw [hUdef]
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_compl_iff]
  have hξU : ξ0 ∈ U := by
    rw [hUmem]
    refine ⟨hξN, fun t ht => ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_sdiff] at ht
    intro hcl
    apply ht.2
    rw [hTmem]
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_product.mp ht.1, hcl⟩
  have hvan : ∀ γ m, (γ, m) ∉ T → ∀ ξ ∈ U ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), a γ m ξ = 0 := by
    intro γ m hγm ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨hξU', hξD⟩ := hξ
    rw [hUmem] at hξU'
    by_contra hne
    by_cases hm : m ∈ H
    · by_cases hγ : γ ∈ Γ
      · have hmem : (γ, m) ∈ (Γ ×ˢ H) \ T :=
          Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hγ, hm⟩, hγm⟩
        exact hξU'.2 _ hmem (subset_closure ((hSmem _ _).mpr ⟨hξD, hne⟩))
      · have hts : ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL B.h γ) := (hsupp γ m ξ hξD hne).1.2.1
        exact hΓ γ hγ ξ hξU'.1 hts
    · exact hne (hfin γ m hm ξ hξD)
  
  have hTprop : ∀ t ∈ T, t.2 ∈ H ∧ ActiveL4 B G t.1 ∧
      |Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ0) + (t.1.1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
      |chartR B.h t.1.1 ξ0 / Sb t.1.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (t.1.2.1.1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
      |chartZ B.h t.1.1 ξ0 / Sb t.1.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (t.1.2.1.2.1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
      |chartT B.h t.1.1 ξ0 / Sb t.1.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (t.1.2.1.2.2 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨⟨-, htH⟩, hcl⟩ := (hTmem t).mp ht
    have hne : (S t).Nonempty := by
      by_contra h
      rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at h
      rw [h, closure_empty] at hcl
      exact hcl
    obtain ⟨ξ1, hξ1⟩ := hne
    obtain ⟨hξ1D, hξ1ne⟩ := (hSmem t ξ1).mp hξ1
    obtain ⟨hSW, hEt⟩ := hsupp t.1 t.2 ξ1 hξ1D hξ1ne
    obtain ⟨⟨hlmin, -⟩, -, -, -, hXa, hXb⟩ := hSW
    have hξ1D' : 0 < ξ1.1 ∧ ξ1.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ1 < qsOf l0 := hξ1D
    have hmemB : ξ1 ∈ DomC B.h B.qB := ⟨hξ1D'.1, hξ1D'.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ1D'.2.2 hqs⟩
    have hEtS : ∀ ξ ∈ S t, etaL B.h t.1 ξ ≠ 0 := fun ξ hξ =>
      (hsupp t.1 t.2 ξ ((hSmem t ξ).mp hξ).1 ((hSmem t ξ).mp hξ).2).2
    have key : ∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContinuousAt f ξ0 → (∀ ξ ∈ S t, f ξ < 1) → f ξ0 ≤ 1 := by
      intro f hf hlt
      exact ContinuousWithinAt.closure_le hcl hf.continuousWithinAt continuousWithinAt_const
        (fun ξ hξ => (hlt ξ hξ).le)
    refine ⟨htH, ⟨hlmin, ξ1, hmemB, hEt, hXa, hXb⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact key (fun ξ => |Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ) + (t.1.1 : ℝ)|)
        (continuous_abs.continuousAt.comp (hlogc.add continuousAt_const))
        (fun ξ hξ => (hWin t.1 ξ (hEtS ξ hξ)).1)
    · exact key (fun ξ => |chartR B.h t.1.1 ξ / Sb t.1.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (t.1.2.1.1 : ℝ)|)
        ((continuous_abs.comp (by unfold chartR; fun_prop)).continuousAt)
        (fun ξ hξ => (hWin t.1 ξ (hEtS ξ hξ)).2.1)
    · exact key (fun ξ => |chartZ B.h t.1.1 ξ / Sb t.1.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (t.1.2.1.2.1 : ℝ)|)
        ((continuous_abs.comp (by unfold chartZ; fun_prop)).continuousAt)
        (fun ξ hξ => (hWin t.1 ξ (hEtS ξ hξ)).2.2.1)
    · exact key (fun ξ => |chartT B.h t.1.1 ξ / Sb t.1.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (t.1.2.1.2.2 : ℝ)|)
        ((continuous_abs.comp (by unfold chartT; fun_prop)).continuousAt)
        (fun ξ hξ => (hWin t.1 ξ (hEtS ξ hξ)).2.2.2)
  
  have hsub : T ⊆ Λ ×ˢ H := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨htH, -, h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := hTprop t ht
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hmemΛ t.1 h0 h1 h2 h3, htH⟩
  have hcard : T.card ≤ 162 * H.card :=
    calc T.card ≤ (Λ ×ˢ H).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
      _ = Λ.card * H.card := Finset.card_product _ _
      _ ≤ 162 * H.card := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hΛcard
  exact ⟨T, U, hUo, hξU, hcard,
    fun t ht => ⟨(hTprop t ht).1, (hTprop t ht).2.1, (hTprop t ht).2.2.1⟩, hvan⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: etaL_locfin
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (h qs : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → ∀ ξ₀ ∈ DomC h qs, ∃ U : Set Cyl, IsOpen U ∧ ξ₀ ∈ U ∧
    ∃ T : Finset Lab, ∀ γ : Lab, γ ∉ T → ∀ ξ ∈ U, ξ ∉ tsupport (etaL h γ)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (γ : Lab) (q : ℝ), ActiveL4 B G γ → 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → |Real.logb 2 q + (γ.1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 → |(pint5 B G γ : ℝ)| ≤ K / q

signature.name: wpf_pint_bound
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (γ : Lab) (q : ℝ), ActiveL4 B G γ → 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → |Real.logb 2 q + (γ.1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 → |(pint5 B G γ : ℝ)| ≤ K / q

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨hr0, -, hu0, -, hlmin⟩ := hG.1
  obtain ⟨c, C, hc, hF⟩ := frame5_consts B G hok hG
  have hXb : 0 < B.Xb := by linarith
  have hc2 : 0 < 2 * G.r0 * c := mul_pos (mul_pos two_pos hr0) hc
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ 1 + G.ustar / (2 * G.r0 * c) := by
    have := div_nonneg hu0.le hc2.le
    linarith
  obtain ⟨Cp, hCp⟩ : ∃ Cp : ℝ, Cp = Real.sqrt (4 * B.Xb) * Real.sqrt C * (1 + G.ustar / (2 * G.r0 * c)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCp0 : 0 ≤ Cp := by
    rw [hCp]
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) hA0
  refine ⟨3 * Cp + 1, by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro γ q hAct hq0 hq1 hlog
  have hl1 : 1 ≤ γ.1 := by have := hAct.1; omega
  have hL : (1:ℝ) ≤ (γ.1 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hl1
  obtain ⟨hrep1, hrep2, -, hrep3, hrep4, -⟩ := hG.2.2.1 γ hAct
  obtain ⟨-, -, hcE, -, -, -, hlamC, -⟩ := hF γ hAct
  
  have hTgc : 1 < Tgc := by
    unfold Tgc
    have := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
    linarith
  have hTgc0 : 0 < Tgc := by linarith
  have hcib0 : 0 < cib B.h γ.1 := by
    unfold cib Qb
    exact mul_pos (zpow_pos hTgc0 _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _) _)
  have hcib1 : cib B.h γ.1 ≤ 1 := by
    have hLpos : (0:ℝ) < (γ.1 : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hX : 0 < (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (γ.1 : ℝ)) / (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
      div_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _) (pow_pos hLpos 2)
    have h1 : Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (γ.1 : ℝ)) / (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_intCast]
      calc Tgc ^ ((bandIdx B.h γ.1 : ℤ) : ℝ)
          ≤ Tgc ^ (Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (γ.1 : ℝ)) / (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2)) := by
            apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hTgc.le
            unfold bandIdx
            exact Int.floor_le _
        _ = _ := Real.rpow_logb hTgc0 hTgc.ne' hX
    have h2 : Qb γ.1 ^ (1 + B.h) = (2:ℝ) ^ (-((1 + B.h) * (γ.1 : ℝ))) := by
      unfold Qb
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2)]
      congr 1
      ring
    have hL2 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := one_le_pow₀ hL
    unfold cib
    rw [h2]
    calc Tgc ^ bandIdx B.h γ.1 * (2:ℝ) ^ (-((1 + B.h) * (γ.1 : ℝ)))
        ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (γ.1 : ℝ)) / (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (2:ℝ) ^ (-((1 + B.h) * (γ.1 : ℝ))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _)
      _ = 1 / (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← Real.rpow_add two_pos, add_neg_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
      _ ≤ 1 := by
          rw [div_le_one (by linarith)]
          exact hL2
  
  have hlogU : Real.logb 2 q + (γ.1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := (abs_le.mp hlog).2
  have heps0 : 0 < epsb B.h γ.1 := by
    unfold epsb Qb
    exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _) _
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s = epsb B.h γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := by rw [hs]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg heps0.le _
  have hkbdef : kb B.h γ.1 = ⌈s⌉₊ := by rw [hs]; rfl
  have hskb : s ≤ (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) := by rw [hkbdef]; exact Nat.le_ceil s
  have hkbs : (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) < s + 1 := by rw [hkbdef]; exact Nat.ceil_lt_add_one hs0
  have hs2 : s ^ 2 = (epsb B.h γ.1)⁻¹ := by
    rw [hs, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul heps0.le,
      show (-(1/2:ℝ)) * ((2:ℕ):ℝ) = -1 by norm_num, Real.rpow_neg_one]
  have hkb1 : 1 ≤ epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : s ^ 2 ≤ ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hs0 hskb 2

      rw [Real.rpow_sub two_pos, Real.rpow_one, Real.rpow_logb two_pos (by norm_num) hq0]

    have hLs2 : 2 * G.r0 ≤ Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 := by

    have hLE : 2 * G.r0 * c ≤ Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 * eN (g0r5 B G γ) :=

      _ = G.ustar / (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 * eN (g0r5 B G γ)) := by
          rw [div_eq_div_iff hden.ne' (mul_pos hLs0 hE0).ne']
          ring

  have hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam0_5 B G γ := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hD1 : 1 ≤ epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ))^2 * (1 + G.ustar^2) ^ (3/2:ℝ) := by

subgoal_signatures.name: frame5_consts

∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ (c C : ℝ), 0 < c ∧
    ∀ γ : Lab, ActiveL4 B G γ → c ≤ F0r5 B G γ ∧ F0r5 B G γ ≤ C ∧ c ≤ eN (g0r5 B G γ) ∧

by

  obtain ⟨c1, hc1def⟩ : ∃ c1 : ℝ, c1 = 1 + 3 * Λ * a := ⟨_, rfl⟩

  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by rw [hadef]; exact (inv_pos.2 hsXa).le
  have hc10 : 0 ≤ c1 := by
    have := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 3) hΛ0) ha0
    rw [hc1def]; linarith
  have hN : ∀ j : ℕ, (j : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := fun j => by exact_mod_cast le_top

  intro T β n Y₀ hβ

  have hu : ∀ (t : Lab × ℤ) (i : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞

  have hrinv : r⁻¹ ≤ a * Q⁻¹ := by

    rw [mul_inv, ← hadef] at h1

  have hWpt : ∀ (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ), Q ^ (c - 2 * (j : ℝ)) = Q ^ c * (Q⁻¹ ^ 2) ^ j := by
    intro c j
    rw [Real.rpow_sub hQ0, show (2 * (j : ℝ)) = ((2 * j : ℕ) : ℝ) by push_cast; ring,

  have hWb : ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j

subgoal_signatures.name: corr_domain_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (l0 : ℕ) (Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ), B.ok →
    IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + Y₀))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ rad {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ eR {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ eTh {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x}

subgoal_signatures.name: domc_open_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ) ∧ ContinuousOn (XC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dT f) (DomC B.h qs)) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → dR B.h f ξ = 0 ∧ dZ f ξ = 0 ∧ dT f ξ = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: simScale_phys_bounds_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, SimScaleProps h → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (p.1 2) (1 - p.2)) {p : ℝ³ × ℝ | p.2 < 1} ∧ (∀ p : ℝ³ × ℝ, p.2 < 1 → 0 < simScale h (p.1 2) (1 - p.2)) ∧ (∀ qs : ℝ, IsOpen (simDomain h qs)) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p : ℝ³ × ℝ, p.2 < 1 → simScale h (p.1 2) (1 - p.2) ≤ 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale h (p.1 2) (1 - p.2)) p‖ ≤ C * simScale h (p.1 2) (1 - p.2) ^ (1 - (k : ℝ))

subgoal_signatures.name: rpow_weight_bounds_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (Q : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Q O → (∀ p ∈ O, 0 < Q p) → (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ O, Q p ≤ 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Q p‖ ≤ C * Q p ^ (1 - (k : ℝ))) → ∀ e : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => Q p ^ e) O ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ O, Q p ≤ 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p => Q p ^ e) p‖ ≤ C * Q p ^ (e - 2 * (j : ℝ))

subgoal_signatures.name: wpf_leibniz_assembly
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {ι : Type} (O : Set E) (T : Finset ι) (W : E → ℝ) (u : ι → Fin 3 → E → ℂ) (v : ι → E → ℂ) (f : Fin 3 → E → ℝ³), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ W O → (∀ t i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (u t i) O) → (∀ t, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (v t) O) → (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f i) O) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => W x • ∑ t ∈ T, ∑ i : Fin 3, (u t i x * v t x).re • f i x) O ∧ ∀ (x : E) (k : ℕ) (Cw S A R : ℝ), x ∈ O → 0 ≤ Cw → 0 ≤ S → 0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ R → (∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j W x‖ ≤ Cw * S ^ j) → (∀ t ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (u t i) x‖ ≤ A * R ^ j) → (∀ t ∈ T, ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (v t) x‖ ≤ R ^ j) → (∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (f i) x‖ ≤ R ^ j) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x => W x • ∑ t ∈ T, ∑ i : Fin 3, (u t i x * v t x).re • f i x) x‖ ≤ 3 * (T.card : ℝ) * Cw * A * (S + 3 * R) ^ k

subgoal_signatures.name: wpf_coord_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 → ∀ (k : ℕ) (R : ℝ), ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (p : ℝ³ × ℝ), 0 < rad p.1 → rad p.1 ≤ R → (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph h (rad w.1) w.2 + Y₀)) p‖ ≤ (C / rad p.1) ^ j) ∧ ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ![eR w.1, eTh w.1, eZ] i) p‖ ≤ (C / rad p.1) ^ j

subgoal_signatures.name: wpf_phase_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (m : ℤ) (p : ℝ³ × ℝ), 0 < rad p.1 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((⟨w.1 0, w.1 1⟩ : ℂ) / (rad w.1 : ℂ)) ^ m) p ∧ ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((⟨w.1 0, w.1 1⟩ : ℂ) / (rad w.1 : ℂ)) ^ m) p‖ ≤ ((|(m : ℝ)| + 1) * C / rad p.1) ^ j

    have hL1 : (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ (2 * b) ≤ (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ (2 * bs) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hLg1 (by linarith)
    have hL0 : 0 ≤ (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ (2 * b) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    calc N ≤ C * q ^ x * (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ (2 * b) := hN
      _ ≤ |C| * q ^ x * (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ (2 * b) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) hqx) hL0
      _ ≤ Cs * q ^ x * (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ (2 * bs) :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC hqx) hL1 hL0 (mul_nonneg hCs0 hqx)
  refine ⟨2 ^ k * Cs ^ 2, 2 * bs, fun w hw1 hw2 => ?_⟩
  have hq0 : 0 < simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) := (hB.1.1 w.1 (1 - w.2) (by linarith)).1
  have hFi := fun i (hi : i ≤ k) =>
    bnd _ (CF i) (bF i) _ _ hq0 (hbi i hi).1 (hCi i hi).1 (hCF i w hw1 hw2)
  have hGi := fun i (hi : i ≤ k) =>
    bnd _ (CG i) (bG i) _ _ hq0 (hbi i hi).2 (hCi i hi).2 (hCG i w hw1 hw2)
  
  refine le_trans (leib _ w _ k hDo ⟨hw1, hw2⟩ F G (hFs.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    (hGs.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))) ?_
  set q := simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) with hq
  set Lg := 1 + |Real.log q| with hLg
  have hLg0 : 0 < Lg := by rw [hLg]; linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log q)]
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ Cs * q ^ (B.h * α) * Lg ^ (2 * bs) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCs0 (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)) (Real.rpow_nonneg hLg0.le _)
  calc _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * (Cs * q ^ (B.h * α) * Lg ^ (2 * bs)) *
          (Cs * q ^ (B.h * β) * Lg ^ (2 * bs)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hFi i hik) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
          (hGi _ (Nat.sub_le k i)) (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hA0)
    _ = (Cs * q ^ (B.h * α) * Lg ^ (2 * bs)) * (Cs * q ^ (B.h * β) * Lg ^ (2 * bs)) *
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; ring
    _ = 2 ^ k * Cs ^ 2 * q ^ (B.h * (α + β)) * Lg ^ (2 * (2 * bs)) := by
        have hs : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) = 2 ^ k := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose k
        rw [hs, show B.h * (α + β) = B.h * α + B.h * β by ring,
          show 2 * (2 * bs) = 2 * bs + 2 * bs by ring, Real.rpow_add hq0, Real.rpow_add hLg0]
        ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → (∀ (p : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → simScale B.h z τ ≤ 1 → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2 ^ p) (z, τ)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => (simScale B.h z τ ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (simScale B.h z τ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h z τ ^ p) → ∀ p : ℝ, InS B qs (p / B.h) (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ^ p)

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → (∀ (p : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → simScale B.h z τ ≤ 1 → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2 ^ p) (z, τ)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => (simScale B.h z τ ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (simScale B.h z τ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h z τ ^ p) → ∀ p : ℝ, InS B qs (p / B.h) (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ^ p)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs hB hqs0 hqs1 hS8 p
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hB.1
  have hh : 0 < B.h := hB.2.1.1
  have hne : B.h ≠ 0 := hh.ne'
  
  have key : ∀ (F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (V : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (a : ℝ × ℝ) (T : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)),
      IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → a ∈ V → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro F V a T hV hF ha i
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set (ℝ × ℝ), s = (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
    have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  have hW : IsOpen (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
  have hSp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun v : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h v.1 v.2 ^ p) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) :=
    hS.2.2.2.1.rpow_const_of_ne (fun v hv => (hS.1 v.1 v.2 hv.2).1.ne')
  have hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ((w.1, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
    contDiff_fst.prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd)
  refine ⟨?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · exact hSp.comp hφ.contDiffOn (fun w hw =>
      ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 by linarith [hw.1]⟩)
  · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hS8 p k
    refine ⟨C, 0, fun w hw1 hw2 => ?_⟩
    have ht : (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 := by linarith
    have hq1 : simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 := le_trans hw2.le hqs1
    
    obtain ⟨P, hPdef⟩ : ∃ P : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ),
        P = (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (-ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hPapp : ∀ v : ℝ × ℝ, P v = (v.1, -v.2) := by
      intro v; rw [hPdef]; rfl
    have hP1 : ‖P‖ ≤ 1 := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun v => ?_)
      rw [hPapp v, one_mul, Prod.norm_def (v.1, -v.2), Prod.norm_def v]
      exact max_le (le_max_left _ _) ((norm_neg v.2).trans_le (le_max_right _ _))
    obtain ⟨a, hadef⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ × ℝ, a = (w.1, 1 - w.2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have ha : a ∈ (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := by
      rw [hadef]; exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, ht⟩
    
    have hD : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ^ p) w =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun v : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h v.1 v.2 ^ p) a).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => P) := by
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ^ p) w
          = iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun v : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w + v).1 (1 - (w + v).2) ^ p) 0 := by
            have e1 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ)
              (f := fun u : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h u.1 (1 - u.2) ^ p) k w 0
            rw [add_zero] at e1
            exact e1.symm
        _ = iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun v : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h (a + P v).1 (a + P v).2 ^ p) 0 := by
            congr 1
            funext v
            rw [hPapp v, hadef]
            show simScale B.h (w.1 + v.1) (1 - (w.2 + v.2)) ^ p =
              simScale B.h (w.1 + v.1) ((1 - w.2) + -v.2) ^ p
            rw [show (1:ℝ) - (w.2 + v.2) = (1 - w.2) + -v.2 by ring]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun v : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h v.1 v.2 ^ p) a).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => P) := key (fun v : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h v.1 v.2 ^ p) _ a P hW hSp ha k
    
    obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ M : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ),
        M = (simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
          (simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hPM : ∀ v : ℝ × ℝ, P (M v) = M (P v) := by
      intro v
      rw [hMdef]
      simp [hPapp, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
    have hcomm : ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun v : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h v.1 v.2 ^ p) a).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => P)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => M) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun v : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h v.1 v.2 ^ p) a).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => M)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => P) := by
      ext m
      simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, hPM]
    have hCi : ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun v : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h v.1 v.2 ^ p) a).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => M)‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ^ p := by
      rw [hMdef, hadef]; exact hC w.1 (1 - w.2) ht hq1
    have hprod : ∏ i : Fin k, ‖P‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hP1
    have hb1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun v : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h v.1 v.2 ^ p) a).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => M)) (fun _ : Fin k => P)
    have he : B.h * (p / B.h) = p := by field_simp
    rw [he, mul_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one, hD, ← hMdef, hcomm]
    exact hb1.trans ((mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) hprod).trans hCi)

signature.name: stp5_ins_dz
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs α : ℝ) (F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), B.ok → InS B qs α F → InS B qs (α + 1 - 1 / (2 * B.h)) (fun w => fderiv ℝ F w (1, 0))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs α F hB hF
  obtain ⟨hFs, hFb⟩ := hF
  have hh : 0 < B.h := hB.2.1.1
  have hh0 : B.h ≠ 0 := hh.ne'
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hB.1
  
  have hD : IsOpen {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qs} := by
    have hT : IsOpen {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
    have hg : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2)) {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
      have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h v.1 v.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
        hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
      have h2 : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => (w.1, 1 - w.2)) {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
        (continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_const.sub continuous_snd)).continuousOn
      exact h1.comp h2 (fun w hw => ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 from sub_pos.mpr hw⟩)
    exact hg.isOpen_inter_preimage hT isOpen_Iio
  
  have hFd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qs} :=
    hFs.fderiv_of_isOpen hD (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  refine ⟨hFd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const, fun k => ?_⟩
  
  obtain ⟨C, b, hC⟩ := hFb (k + 1)
  refine ⟨C, b, fun w hw1 hw2 => ?_⟩
  have hwD : w ∈ {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qs} := ⟨hw1, hw2⟩
  have hFdw : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) w := hFd.contDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hwD)
  have hCw := hC w hw1 hw2
  have hq : 0 < simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) := (hS.1 w.1 (1 - w.2) (by linarith)).1
  set q := simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) with hqdef
  set Λ : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ :=
    (q ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (q • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) with hΛ
  
  have nbdir : ∀ v : ℝ × ℝ,
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (Λ v)) w).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤
        ‖v‖ * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F w).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ := by
    intro v
    have hcomp : (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (Λ v)) =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ (Λ v)) ∘ (fderiv ℝ F) := by
      funext y; rfl
    have hit : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (Λ v)) w =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ (Λ v)).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ F) w) := by
      rw [hcomp]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left _ hFdw (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hN0 : 0 ≤ ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F w).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ :=
      norm_nonneg _
    rw [hit]
    apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hN0)
    intro m
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply]
    have key : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ F) w (fun i => Λ (m i))) (Λ v) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F w).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ))
          (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => ℝ × ℝ) m v) := by
      rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right]
      have e1' : Fin.init (fun i : Fin (k+1) => Λ (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => ℝ × ℝ) m v i)) =
          fun i => Λ (m i) := by
        funext i
        simp [Fin.init, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      rw [e1']
      simp only [Fin.snoc_last]
    rw [key]
    have hprod : ∏ i : Fin (k+1), ‖Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => ℝ × ℝ) m v i‖ =
        (∏ i : Fin k, ‖m i‖) * ‖v‖ := by
      rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
      simp [Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F w).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ *
          ∏ i : Fin (k+1), ‖Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => ℝ × ℝ) m v i‖ :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ = ‖v‖ * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F w).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ *
          ∏ i : Fin k, ‖m i‖ := by rw [hprod]; ring
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ q ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
  have hΛv : Λ (q ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)), (0:ℝ)) = ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) := by
    rw [hΛ]
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap', Prod.map_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hq, add_neg_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
    · simp [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
  have nv : ‖((q ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)), (0:ℝ)) : ℝ × ℝ)‖ ≤ q ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) := by
    simp only [Prod.norm_mk, norm_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hc0]
    exact max_le le_rfl hc0
  have h1 := nbdir (q ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)), (0:ℝ))
  rw [hΛv] at h1
  have e2 : B.h * (1 / (2 * B.h)) = 1 / 2 := by field_simp
  have hexp : q ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) * q ^ (B.h * α) = q ^ (B.h * (α + 1 - 1 / (2 * B.h))) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]
    congr 1
    linear_combination e2
  refine le_trans h1 ?_
  calc ‖((q ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)), (0:ℝ)) : ℝ × ℝ)‖ *
        ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F w).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖
      ≤ q ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F w).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right nv (norm_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ q ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) * (C * q ^ (B.h * α) * (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ (2 * b)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hCw hc0
    _ = C * q ^ (B.h * (α + 1 - 1 / (2 * B.h))) * (1 + |Real.log q|) ^ (2 * b) := by
        rw [← hexp]; ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs α a : ℝ) (K : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → (∀ (α β : ℝ) (F G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), InS B qs α F → InS B qs β G → InS B qs (α + β) (fun w => F w * G w)) → (∀ p : ℝ, InS B qs (p / B.h) (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ^ p)) → (∀ (α : ℝ) (F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), InS B qs α F → InS B qs (α + 1 - 1 / (2 * B.h)) (fun w => fderiv ℝ F w (1, 0))) → InS B qs α K → InS B qs (α + 1) (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ^ (1/2 - a) * deriv (fun z' => simScale B.h z' (1 - w.2) ^ a * K (z', w.2)) w.1)

signature.name: stp5_ins_dz_gain
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs α a : ℝ) (K : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → (∀ (α β : ℝ) (F G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), InS B qs α F → InS B qs β G → InS B qs (α + β) (fun w => F w * G w)) → (∀ p : ℝ, InS B qs (p / B.h) (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ^ p)) → (∀ (α : ℝ) (F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), InS B qs α F → InS B qs (α + 1 - 1 / (2 * B.h)) (fun w => fderiv ℝ F w (1, 0))) → InS B qs α K → InS B qs (α + 1) (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ^ (1/2 - a) * deriv (fun z' => simScale B.h z' (1 - w.2) ^ a * K (z', w.2)) w.1)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs α a K hB hqs0 hqs1 H1 H2 H3 hK
  have hDo : IsOpen {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qs} := by
    have hc : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hB.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => (w.1, 1 - w.2)) :=
      continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_const.sub continuous_snd)
    have hs : IsOpen {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => (w.1, 1 - w.2)) {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.2 < 1}
        (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) := by
      intro w hw
      have hw' : w.2 < 1 := hw
      exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 by linarith⟩
    have hcomp : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2)) {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
      hc.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    exact hcomp.isOpen_inter_preimage hs isOpen_Iio
  have hQa := H2 a
  have hQb := H2 (1/2 - a)
  have hQaz := H3 _ _ hQa
  have hKz := H3 _ _ hK
  have hT1 := H1 _ _ _ _ hQb (H1 _ _ _ _ hQaz hK)
  have hT2 := H1 _ _ _ _ hQb (H1 _ _ _ _ hQa hKz)
  have hh : 0 < B.h := hB.2.1.1
  have hAS : ∀ (α β γ c d : ℝ) (F G K : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), InS B qs α F → InS B qs β G → γ ≤ α → γ ≤ β →
      (∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.2 < 1 → simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qs → K w = c * F w + d * G w) →
      InS B qs γ K := by
    have lin : ∀ (U : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (f g k : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
        (c d : ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U →
        (∀ x ∈ U, k x = c * f x + d * g x) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ k U ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ × ℝ) (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)), x ∈ U →
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n k x).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L)‖ ≤
            |c| * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L)‖ +
            |d| * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L)‖ := by
      intro U f g k c d hU hf hg hk
      have hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => c * f y + d * g y) U :=
        (contDiffOn_const.mul hf).add (contDiffOn_const.mul hg)
      refine ⟨hp.congr hk, ?_⟩
      intro n x L hx
      have hev : k =ᶠ[nhds x] (c • f + d • g) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => by simp [hk y hy, smul_eq_mul])
      have hfa : ContDiffAt ℝ n f x := (hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have hga : ContDiffAt ℝ n g x := (hg.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have heq : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n k x =
          c • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x + d • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x := by
        have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (c • f + d • g) x =
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (c • f) x + iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (d • g) x :=
          iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (hfa.const_smul c) (hga.const_smul d)
        rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ n).eq_of_nhds, e1,
          iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply hfa, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply hga]
      have hlin : (c • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x + d • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => L) =
          c • (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) +
          d • (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
        ext v; simp
      rw [heq, hlin]
      refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
      rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have wm : ∀ (C q α γ S b b' : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → γ ≤ α → 1 ≤ S → b ≤ b' →
        C * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ b ≤ |C| * q ^ (B.h * γ) * S ^ b' := by
      intro C q α γ S b b' hq0 hq1 hγ hS1 hb
      have h1 : q ^ (B.h * α) ≤ q ^ (B.h * γ) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hγ hh.le)
      have h2 : S ^ b ≤ S ^ b' := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 hb
      have h3 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
      have h4 : 0 ≤ S ^ b := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      calc C * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ b ≤ |C| * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ b :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) h3) h4
        _ ≤ |C| * q ^ (B.h * γ) * S ^ b' :=
            mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (abs_nonneg C)) h2 h4
              (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg C) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _))
    intro α β γ c d F G K hF hG hγα hγβ hK
    obtain ⟨F1, F2⟩ := hF
    obtain ⟨G1, G2⟩ := hG
    obtain ⟨hKsm, hKb⟩ := lin _ F G K c d hDo F1 G1 (fun w hw => hK w hw.1 hw.2)
    refine ⟨hKsm, fun n => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C₁, b₁, H₁⟩ := F2 n
    obtain ⟨C₂, b₂, H₂⟩ := G2 n
    refine ⟨|c| * |C₁| + |d| * |C₂|, max b₁ b₂, fun w hw1 hw2 => ?_⟩
    have hs0 : 0 < simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) := (hB.1.1 w.1 (1 - w.2) (by linarith)).1
    have hs1 : simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ≤ 1 := hw2.le.trans hqs1
    have hL : 1 ≤ 1 + |Real.log (simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2))| := by
      linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2)))]
    have k1 := (H₁ w hw1 hw2).trans (wm C₁ _ α γ _ (2 * b₁) (2 * max b₁ b₂) hs0 hs1 hγα hL
      (by linarith [le_max_left b₁ b₂]))
    have k2 := (H₂ w hw1 hw2).trans (wm C₂ _ β γ _ (2 * b₂) (2 * max b₁ b₂) hs0 hs1 hγβ hL
      (by linarith [le_max_right b₁ b₂]))
    have hk0 := hKb n w ((simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
        (simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)) ⟨hw1, hw2⟩
    exact hk0.trans ((add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k1 (abs_nonneg c))
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k2 (abs_nonneg d))).trans (le_of_eq (by ring)))
  refine hAS _ _ (α + 1) 1 1 _ _ _ hT1 hT2
    (le_of_eq (by ring)) (le_of_eq (by ring)) ?_
  intro w hw1 hw2
  obtain ⟨z, t⟩ := w
  have hw : ((z, t) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qs} :=
    ⟨hw1, hw2⟩
  have hn := hDo.mem_nhds hw
  have hdQa : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ^ a) (z, t) :=
    (hQa.1.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hn
  have hdK : DifferentiableAt ℝ K (z, t) := (hK.1.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hn
  have hprod := hdQa.hasFDerivAt.mul hdK.hasFDerivAt
  have hι : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (x, t)) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) z :=
    (hasDerivAt_id z).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const z t)
  have hch := hprod.comp_hasDerivAt z hι
  have hder : deriv (fun z' => simScale B.h z' (1 - t) ^ a * K (z', t)) z =
      (simScale B.h z (1 - t) ^ a • fderiv ℝ K (z, t) +
        K (z, t) • fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ^ a) (z, t))
        ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) := hch.deriv
  show simScale B.h z (1 - t) ^ (1/2 - a) * deriv (fun z' => simScale B.h z' (1 - t) ^ a * K (z', t)) z =
    1 * (simScale B.h z (1 - t) ^ (1/2 - a) *
      (fderiv ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) ^ a) (z, t) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) * K (z, t))) +
    1 * (simScale B.h z (1 - t) ^ (1/2 - a) *
      (simScale B.h z (1 - t) ^ a * fderiv ℝ K (z, t) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))))
  rw [hder]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs β : ℝ) (e : ℕ) (M : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → (∀ (p : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → simScale B.h z τ ≤ 1 → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2 ^ p) (z, τ)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => (simScale B.h z τ ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (simScale B.h z τ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h z τ ^ p) → InS B qs β M → InM B qs β (fun ξ : Cyl => bHatE B e (ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ)) * M (ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1))

signature.name: stp5_bhat_lift
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs β : ℝ) (e : ℕ) (M : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), B.ok → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → (∀ (p : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → simScale B.h z τ ≤ 1 → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2 ^ p) (z, τ)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => (simScale B.h z τ ^ (1/2 - B.h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (simScale B.h z τ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h z τ ^ p) → InS B qs β M → InM B qs β (fun ξ : Cyl => bHatE B e (ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ)) * M (ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B qs β e M hB hqs0 hqs1 hS8 hM
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, hXam1, hm12, -⟩ := hB.2.1
  have hSN : SimNorm B.h := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hS8 1 k
    refine ⟨C, fun z τ hτ hle => ?_⟩
    have := hC z τ hτ hle
    simp only [Real.rpow_one] at this
    exact this
  have hform : ∀ s : ℝ, bHatE B e s =
      Real.smoothTransition (1 - ((s - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) /
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2)) ^ 2) /
        (∫ u in (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1))..(Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)),
          bumpR ((u - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) /
            ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2))) /
        (∫ u in (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1))..(Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)), u ^ e * rhoHat B u) := by
    intro s
    rfl
  have hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (bHatE B e) := by
    have hfun := funext hform
    rw [hfun]
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => (s - (Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) + Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) / 2) /
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) - Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1)) / 2)) :=
      (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).div_const _
    have h2 := (contDiff_const (c := (1:ℝ))).sub (h1.pow 2)
    exact ((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp h2).div_const _).div_const _
  have hs12 : Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) < Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) :=
    Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hΦs : ∀ x, bHatE B e x ≠ 0 → Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) < x ∧ x < Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hform x] at hx
    set s1 := Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) with hs1
    set s2 := Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2) with hs2
    have hw : 0 < (s2 - s1) / 2 := by linarith
    set y := (x - (s1 + s2) / 2) / ((s2 - s1) / 2) with hy
    have hst : Real.smoothTransition (1 - y ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hx
      rw [h0, zero_div, zero_div]
    have hpos : 0 < 1 - y ^ 2 := by
      by_contra hle
      exact hst (Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (not_lt.mp hle))
    have hy2 : y ^ 2 < 1 := by linarith
    have hyabs : |y| < 1 := (sq_lt_one_iff_abs_lt_one y).mp hy2
    obtain ⟨hyl, hyu⟩ := abs_lt.mp hyabs
    have hxy : y * ((s2 - s1) / 2) = x - (s1 + s2) / 2 := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hw.ne'
    have hl : -1 * ((s2 - s1) / 2) < y * ((s2 - s1) / 2) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hyl hw
    have hu : y * ((s2 - s1) / 2) < 1 * ((s2 - s1) / 2) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hyu hw
    constructor
    · linarith
    · linarith
  have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : ℝ => (1:ℝ)) := contDiff_const
  have H := mom_profile_class_v4 B qs β (fun _ => 1) (bHatE B e) M hB hSN hqs0 hqs1 hψ hΦ hΦs hM
  have heq : (fun ξ : Cyl => bHatE B e (ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ)) * M (ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)) =
      (fun ξ : Cyl => (fun _ : ℝ => (1:ℝ)) (etaC B.h ξ) * M (ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) *
        bHatE B e (ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ))) := by
    funext ξ
    simp only [one_mul]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  exact H

subgoal_signatures.name: mom_profile_class_v4
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (qs α : ℝ) (ψ Φ : ℝ → ℝ) (G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), B.ok →
    SimNorm B.h → 0 < qs → qs ≤ 1 → ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ →
    (∀ x, Φ x ≠ 0 → Real.sqrt (2 * B.m1) < x ∧ x < Real.sqrt (2 * B.m2)) → InS B qs α G →
    InM B qs α (fun ξ => ψ (etaC B.h ξ) * G (ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) * Φ (ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ)))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h r0 : ℝ) (γ : Lab) (c : ℝ × ℝ), 0 < r0 → r0 ≤ 1/100 → inRect h γ c r0 (Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c - r0 • vtv)) ∧ ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (v : ℝ), ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c - r0 • vtv)) : Cyl) + (v - vco h r0 γ c (Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c - r0 • vtv))) • dVdir h γ.1 = ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c + (v * cib h γ.1 - r0) • vtv)) : Cyl)

signature.name: pulse_line_base5
signature.statement: ∀ (h r0 : ℝ) (γ : Lab) (c : ℝ × ℝ), 0 < r0 → r0 ≤ 1/100 → inRect h γ c r0 (Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c - r0 • vtv)) ∧ ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (v : ℝ), ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c - r0 • vtv)) : Cyl) + (v - vco h r0 γ c (Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c - r0 • vtv))) • dVdir h γ.1 = ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c + (v * cib h γ.1 - r0) • vtv)) : Cyl)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h r0 γ c hr0 hr01
  have hsq : (1:ℝ) < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.one_lt_sqrt_two
  have hs2' : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)]; norm_num
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ bgc := by unfold bgc; linarith
  have hb1 : bgc ≤ 1 := by unfold bgc; linarith
  have hD : (0:ℝ) < 1 + bgc ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hDne : (1 + bgc ^ 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := hD.ne'
  have hTg : (0:ℝ) < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; positivity
  have hLg : (0:ℝ) < Lgc := by unfold Lgc; linarith
  set n : ℤ := bandIdx h γ.1 with hn
  have hLn : Lgc ^ n * Lgc ^ (-n) = 1 := by
    rw [zpow_neg, mul_inv_cancel₀ (zpow_ne_zero _ hLg.ne')]
  have hTn : Tgc ^ n * Tgc ^ (-n) = 1 := by
    rw [zpow_neg, mul_inv_cancel₀ (zpow_ne_zero _ hTg.ne')]
  have hvtv1 : ∀ (w : ℝ × ℝ) (a : ℝ), (w + a • vtv).1 = w.1 + a * bgc := by
    intro w a; simp [vtv]
  have hvtv2 : ∀ (w : ℝ × ℝ) (a : ℝ), (w + a • vtv).2 = w.2 + a := by
    intro w a; simp [vtv]
  
  have hcoord : ∀ p t : ℝ, lamR (p • vrv + t • vtv) = p ∧ lamT (p • vrv + t • vtv) = t := by
    intro p t
    have e1 : (p • vrv + t • vtv).1 = p + t * bgc := by simp [vrv, vtv]
    have e2 : (p • vrv + t • vtv).2 = -(p * bgc) + t := by simp [vrv, vtv]
    unfold lamR lamT
    rw [e1, e2]
    constructor
    · rw [div_eq_iff hDne]; ring
    · rw [div_eq_iff hDne]; ring
  have hdec : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, lamR w • vrv + lamT w • vtv = w := by
    intro w
    have r1 : w.1 = lamR w + bgc * lamT w := by unfold lamR lamT; field_simp; ring
    have r2 : w.2 = -bgc * lamR w + lamT w := by unfold lamR lamT; field_simp; ring
    ext
    · simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.smul_fst, smul_eq_mul, vrv, vtv]
      rw [r1]; ring
    · simp only [Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul, vrv, vtv]
      rw [r2]; ring
  have hJ : ∀ (m : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), Jpow m Y = (Lgc ^ m * lamR Y) • vrv + (Tgc ^ m * lamT Y) • vtv :=
    fun _ _ => rfl
  have comp : ∀ X : ℝ × ℝ, Jpow n (Jpow (-n) X) = X := by
    intro X
    rw [hJ n (Jpow (-n) X), hJ (-n) X, (hcoord _ _).1, (hcoord _ _).2, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc,
      hLn, hTn, one_mul, one_mul, hdec]
  
  have s2 : ∀ (m : ℤ) (Z : ℝ × ℝ) (a : ℝ), Jpow m (Z + a • vtv) = Jpow m Z + (Tgc ^ m * a) • vtv := by
    intro m Z a
    have hc1 : (Z.1 + a * bgc - bgc * (Z.2 + a)) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) = (Z.1 - bgc * Z.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) := by
      congr 1; ring
    have hc2 : (bgc * (Z.1 + a * bgc) + (Z.2 + a)) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) =
        (bgc * Z.1 + Z.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) + a := by
      field_simp; ring
    unfold Jpow
    rw [hvtv1, hvtv2, hc1, hc2, mul_add, add_smul]
    abel
  
  have hround : ∀ (x : ℝ) (m : ℤ), |x - m| < 1/2 → round x = m := by
    intro x m hx
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hx
    rw [round_eq, Int.floor_eq_iff]
    constructor <;> linarith
  set Y0 : ℝ × ℝ := Jpow (-n) (c - r0 • vtv) with hY0
  have e1 : (c - r0 • vtv - c).1 = -(r0 * bgc) := by simp [vtv]
  have e2 : (c - r0 • vtv - c).2 = -r0 := by simp [vtv]
  have hrb : r0 * bgc ≤ r0 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb1 hr0.le; linarith
  have hrb0 : 0 ≤ r0 * bgc := mul_nonneg hr0.le hb0
  have q1 : round (-(r0 * bgc)) = 0 := by
    apply hround
    rw [Int.cast_zero, sub_zero, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hrb0]; linarith
  have q2 : round (-r0) = 0 := by
    apply hround
    rw [Int.cast_zero, sub_zero, abs_neg, abs_of_pos hr0]; linarith
  have hrw : rectW h γ c Y0 = (-(r0 * bgc), -r0) := by
    unfold rectW frac0
    rw [← hn, hY0, comp, e1, e2, q1, q2]
    simp

    unfold xiG
    rw [hrw]
    show (-(r0 * bgc) - bgc * -r0) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) = 0
    rw [show -(r0 * bgc) - bgc * -r0 = 0 by ring, zero_div]
  have het : etG h γ c Y0 = -r0 := by
    unfold etG
    rw [hrw]
    show (bgc * -(r0 * bgc) + -r0) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) = -r0
    rw [div_eq_iff hDne]; ring
  have hvco : vco h r0 γ c Y0 = 0 := by
    unfold vco
    rw [het, neg_add_cancel, zero_div]
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [hxi, abs_zero]; exact hr0.le
  · rw [het, abs_neg, abs_of_pos hr0]
  · intro ξ v
    have key : Jpow (-n) (c + (v * cib h γ.1 - r0) • vtv) =
        Y0 + v • ((cib h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-n)) • vtv) := by
      rw [show c + (v * cib h γ.1 - r0) • vtv = (c - r0 • vtv) + (v * cib h γ.1) • vtv by
        rw [sub_smul]; abel, s2, smul_smul, hY0]
      congr 2; ring
    rw [hvco, sub_zero, key]
    unfold dVdir
    rw [← hn]
    simp only [Prod.smul_mk, Prod.mk_add_mk, smul_zero, add_zero]

by

  have hp1 : p 1 = 0 := by rw [hp]; rfl

    have e : a 1 = pang5 B G γ / RC γ.1 ξ := by rw [ha]; rfl
    rw [e]
    have hRC : RC γ.1 ξ ≠ 0 := by
      unfold RC

    have hpint : (pint5 B G γ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Int.cast_ne_zero]

      exact_mod_cast h3.ne'
    have hpang : pang5 B G γ ≠ 0 := by unfold pang5; exact div_ne_zero hpint hkb
    exact div_ne_zero hpang hRC
  have hN : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => a + v • p) :=
    continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)
  have hd : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => dotProduct (a + v • p) (a + v • p)) := hN.dotProduct hN

      simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rw [hs, e1]

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hB hG lP
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hS2⟩ := pulse_slow_derivs5 B hB
  obtain ⟨M, ν, hν, hM0, hS3⟩ := pulse_frame_scalars5 B G hB hG lP

  have hr01 : G.r0 ≤ 1/100 := hG.1.2.1

  have t3 : ∀ a b c : ℝ, |a + b + c| ≤ |a| + |b| + |c| := fun a b c => by
    have h1 := abs_add_le a b
    have h2 := abs_add_le (a + b) c
    linarith
  have mb : ∀ a b X Y : ℝ, |a| ≤ X → |b| ≤ Y → |a * b| ≤ X * Y := fun a b X Y ha hb => by
    rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul ha hb (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans ha)
  
  have rank1 : ∀ (A N P Eb ν E : ℝ) (Km : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (n p y : Fin 3 → ℝ), 0 < ν → 0 ≤ E →
      E ≤ Eb → (∀ i j, |Km i j| ≤ A) → (∀ i, |n i| ≤ N) → ν ≤ n 1 ^ 2 → (∀ i, |p i| ≤ P) →
      ‖(-Km + (dotProduct n n)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec n (Matrix.vecMul n Km - p)).mulVec y -
        (E * dotProduct n n) • y‖ ≤ (3 * A + 3 * N * (3 * N * A + P) / ν + 3 * Eb * N ^ 2) * ‖y‖ := by
    intro A N P Eb ν E Km n p y hν hE0 hEb hA hN hn1 hP
    have hy : ∀ j, |y j| ≤ ‖y‖ := fun j => by
      have := norm_le_pi_norm y j

    have hP0 : 0 ≤ P := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hP 0)
    have hEb0 : 0 ≤ Eb := hE0.trans hEb
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d : ℝ, d = dotProduct n n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : Fin 3 → ℝ, w = Matrix.vecMul n Km - p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hd, ← hw]
    have hd3 : d = n 0 * n 0 + n 1 * n 1 + n 2 * n 2 := by
      rw [hd]; simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have hsq : ∀ i, n i * n i ≤ N * N := fun i => by
      rw [← abs_mul_abs_self]; exact mul_le_mul (hN i) (hN i) (abs_nonneg _) hN0
    have hdν : ν ≤ d := by
      have e : n 1 ^ 2 = n 1 * n 1 := sq _

      have := mul_self_nonneg (n 2)

    have hd0 : 0 ≤ d := by linarith
    have hdN : d ≤ 3 * N ^ 2 := by
      have := hsq 0
      have := hsq 1
      have := hsq 2

    have hdi0 : 0 ≤ d⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.2 hd0
    have hwj : ∀ j, |w j| ≤ 3 * N * A + P := by
      intro j

        rw [hw]; simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      rw [e]
      have h1 := t3 (n 0 * Km 0 j) (n 1 * Km 1 j) (n 2 * Km 2 j)
      have h2 := mb _ _ _ _ (hN 0) (hA 0 j)
      have h3 := mb _ _ _ _ (hN 1) (hA 1 j)
      have h4 := mb _ _ _ _ (hN 2) (hA 2 j)
      have h5 := abs_sub (n 0 * Km 0 j + n 1 * Km 1 j + n 2 * Km 2 j) (p j)
      have h6 := hP j

by
  have lode : ∀ (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (B : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (g : ℝ → E) (x0 : E), Continuous B → Continuous g → ∃ y : ℝ → E, y 0 = x0 ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt y (B v (y v) + g v) v := by
    intro E _ _ _ B g x0 hB hg
    have : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℝ E
    
    have retr : ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ ρ : E → E, (∀ x y, ‖ρ x - ρ y‖ ≤ 2 * ‖x - y‖) ∧
        (∀ x, ‖ρ x‖ ≤ ‖x‖) ∧ (∀ x, ‖ρ x‖ ≤ R) ∧ (∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ R → ρ x = x) := by
      intro R hR
      refine ⟨fun x => (R / max ‖x‖ R) • x, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x y
        have hmx : 0 < max ‖x‖ R := lt_max_of_lt_right hR
        have hmy : 0 < max ‖y‖ R := lt_max_of_lt_right hR
        obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = R / max ‖x‖ R := ⟨_, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ, b = R / max ‖y‖ R := ⟨_, rfl⟩
        have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by rw [ha]; exact div_nonneg hR.le hmx.le
        have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := by rw [ha]; exact (div_le_one hmx).2 (le_max_right _ _)
        have hyb : ‖y‖ ≤ max ‖y‖ R := le_max_left _ _
        have hab : |a - b| * ‖y‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by
          have e : a - b = a * (max ‖y‖ R - max ‖x‖ R) / max ‖y‖ R := by
            rw [ha, hb]; field_simp
          have hm := abs_max_sub_max_le_abs ‖y‖ ‖x‖ R
          have hn := abs_norm_sub_norm_le y x
          rw [norm_sub_rev] at hn
          rw [e, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha0, abs_of_pos hmy]
          have e2 : a * |max ‖y‖ R - max ‖x‖ R| / max ‖y‖ R * ‖y‖ =
              (a * (‖y‖ / max ‖y‖ R)) * |max ‖y‖ R - max ‖x‖ R| := by ring
          rw [e2]
          have h1 : ‖y‖ / max ‖y‖ R ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hmy).2 hyb
          have h2 : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ / max ‖y‖ R := div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hmy.le
          have h3 : a * (‖y‖ / max ‖y‖ R) ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
          calc a * (‖y‖ / max ‖y‖ R) * |max ‖y‖ R - max ‖x‖ R|
              ≤ 1 * |max ‖y‖ R - max ‖x‖ R| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h3 (abs_nonneg _)
            _ ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by linarith
        have e2 : a • x - b • y = a • (x - y) + (a - b) • y := by
          rw [smul_sub, sub_smul]; abel
        show ‖(R / max ‖x‖ R) • x - (R / max ‖y‖ R) • y‖ ≤ 2 * ‖x - y‖
        rw [← ha, ← hb, e2]
        calc ‖a • (x - y) + (a - b) • y‖ ≤ ‖a • (x - y)‖ + ‖(a - b) • y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = a * ‖x - y‖ + |a - b| * ‖y‖ := by
              rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ha0]
          _ ≤ 1 * ‖x - y‖ + ‖x - y‖ :=
              add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha1 (norm_nonneg _)) hab
          _ = 2 * ‖x - y‖ := by ring
      · intro x
        have hmx : 0 < max ‖x‖ R := lt_max_of_lt_right hR
        show ‖(R / max ‖x‖ R) • x‖ ≤ ‖x‖
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hR.le hmx.le)]
        have ha1 : R / max ‖x‖ R ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hmx).2 (le_max_right _ _)
        calc R / max ‖x‖ R * ‖x‖ ≤ 1 * ‖x‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha1 (norm_nonneg _)
          _ = ‖x‖ := one_mul _
      · intro x
        have hmx : 0 < max ‖x‖ R := lt_max_of_lt_right hR
        show ‖(R / max ‖x‖ R) • x‖ ≤ R
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hR.le hmx.le)]
        rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ hmx]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left _ _) hR.le
      · intro x hx
        show (R / max ‖x‖ R) • x = x
        rw [max_eq_right hx, div_self hR.ne', one_smul]
    
    have fwd : ∀ (r F : ℝ → E) (K ε T : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ ε → 0 ≤ T →
        (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivWithinAt r (F v) (Set.Icc (-T) T) v) →
        (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖F v‖ ≤ K * ‖r v‖ + ε) →
        ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) T, ‖r v‖ ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * T) * Real.exp (K * T) := by
      intro r F K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v hv
      have hcont : ContinuousOn r (Set.Icc 0 T) := fun x hx =>
        ((hd x ⟨by linarith [hx.1], hx.2⟩).continuousWithinAt).mono
          (Set.Icc_subset_Icc (by linarith) le_rfl)
      have h1 := norm_le_gronwallBound_of_norm_deriv_right_le (f := r) (f' := F)
        (δ := ‖r 0‖) (K := K) (ε := ε) (a := 0) (b := T) hcont
        (fun x hx => (hd x ⟨by linarith [hx.1], hx.2.le⟩).mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin
          (Icc_mem_nhdsGE_of_mem ⟨by linarith [hx.1], hx.2⟩)) le_rfl
        (fun x hx => hbd x ⟨by linarith [hx.1], hx.2.le⟩)
        v hv
      rw [sub_zero] at h1
      refine h1.trans ?_
      have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := hv.1
      have hvT : v ≤ T := hv.2
      have hδ : 0 ≤ ‖r 0‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have key : gronwallBound ‖r 0‖ K ε v ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * v) * Real.exp (K * v) := by
        rcases hK.eq_or_lt with h | h
        · subst h
          rw [gronwallBound_K0]
          simp
        · rw [gronwallBound_of_K_ne_0 h.ne']
          have hp := Real.exp_pos (K * v)
          have e1 : Real.exp (K * v) * Real.exp (-(K * v)) = 1 := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
          have e2 := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(K * v))
          have e2' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e2 hp.le
          have e3 : Real.exp (K * v) - 1 ≤ K * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by
            nlinarith
          have hc : ε / K * K = ε := div_mul_cancel₀ ε h.ne'
          have e4 : ε / K * (Real.exp (K * v) - 1) ≤ ε * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by
            calc ε / K * (Real.exp (K * v) - 1) ≤ ε / K * (K * v * Real.exp (K * v)) :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e3 (div_nonneg hε h.le)
              _ = ε / K * K * (v * Real.exp (K * v)) := by ring
              _ = ε * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by rw [hc]; ring
          nlinarith
      refine key.trans ?_
      apply mul_le_mul
      · nlinarith
      · exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      · nlinarith
    
    have gron : ∀ (r F : ℝ → E) (K ε T : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ ε → 0 ≤ T →
        (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivWithinAt r (F v) (Set.Icc (-T) T) v) →
        (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖F v‖ ≤ K * ‖r v‖ + ε) →
        ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖r v‖ ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * T) * Real.exp (K * T) := by
      intro r F K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v hv
      rcases le_or_gt 0 v with h0 | h0
      · exact fwd r F K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v ⟨h0, hv.2⟩
      · have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (Neg.neg : ℝ → ℝ) (Set.Icc (-T) T) (Set.Icc (-T) T) :=
          fun u hu => ⟨by linarith [hu.2], by linarith [hu.1]⟩
        have hd' : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivWithinAt (fun u => r (-u))
            ((fun u => -F (-u)) u) (Set.Icc (-T) T) u := by
          intro u hu
          have h2 : HasDerivWithinAt (r ∘ Neg.neg) ((-1:ℝ) • F (-u)) (Set.Icc (-T) T) u :=
            (hd (-u) (hmaps hu)).scomp u (hasDerivWithinAt_neg u (Set.Icc (-T) T)) hmaps
          have h3 : (-1:ℝ) • F (-u) = -F (-u) := by simp
          rw [h3] at h2
          exact h2
        have hbd' : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖(fun u => -F (-u)) u‖ ≤
            K * ‖(fun u => r (-u)) u‖ + ε := by
          intro u hu
          simp only [norm_neg]
          exact hbd (-u) (hmaps hu)
        have := fwd (fun u => r (-u)) (fun u => -F (-u)) K ε T hK hε hT hd' hbd' (-v)
          ⟨by linarith, by linarith [hv.1]⟩
        simpa only [neg_neg, neg_zero] using this
    
    have exI : ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∃ α : ℝ → E, α 0 = x0 ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivWithinAt α (B t (α t) + g t) (Set.Icc (-T) T) t := by
      intro T hT
      obtain ⟨CB, hCB⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := -T) (b := T)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        hB.continuousOn
      obtain ⟨Cg, hCg⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := -T) (b := T)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        hg.continuousOn
      obtain ⟨K, hKdef⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = max CB 0 + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨G, hGdef⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ, G = max Cg 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hK : 0 < K := by rw [hKdef]; linarith [le_max_right CB 0]
      have hG : 0 ≤ G := by rw [hGdef]; exact le_max_right _ _
      have hBK : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖B t‖ ≤ K := fun t ht => by
        rw [hKdef]; linarith [hCB t ht, le_max_left CB 0]
      have hgG : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖g t‖ ≤ G := fun t ht => by
        rw [hGdef]; exact (hCg t ht).trans (le_max_left _ _)
      obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, R = (‖x0‖ + G * T) * Real.exp (K * T) + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hR : 0 < R := by
        rw [hRdef]
        have h1 := Real.exp_pos (K * T)
        have h2 : 0 ≤ ‖x0‖ + G * T := add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hG hT.le)
        have h3 := mul_nonneg h2 h1.le
        linarith
      obtain ⟨ρ, hρL, hρn, hρR, hρid⟩ := retr R hR
      have hL0 : 0 ≤ K * R + G := add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK.le hR.le) hG
      have t0mem : (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T := ⟨by linarith, hT.le⟩
      have hPL : IsPicardLindelof (fun t x => B t (ρ x) + g t) (⟨0, t0mem⟩ : Set.Icc (-T) T) x0
          ((K * R + G) * T).toNNReal 0 (K * R + G).toNNReal (2 * K).toNNReal := by
        apply IsPicardLindelof.mk
        · intro t ht
          apply LipschitzWith.lipschitzOnWith
          rw [lipschitzWith_iff_norm_sub_le]
          intro x y
          rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (by linarith)]
          show ‖B t (ρ x) + g t - (B t (ρ y) + g t)‖ ≤ 2 * K * ‖x - y‖
          rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← map_sub]
          calc ‖B t (ρ x - ρ y)‖ ≤ ‖B t‖ * ‖ρ x - ρ y‖ := (B t).le_opNorm _
            _ ≤ K * (2 * ‖x - y‖) := mul_le_mul (hBK t ht) (hρL x y) (norm_nonneg _) hK.le
            _ = 2 * K * ‖x - y‖ := by ring
        · intro x _
          exact ((hB.clm_apply continuous_const).add hg).continuousOn
        · intro t ht x _
          rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ hL0]
          calc ‖B t (ρ x) + g t‖ ≤ ‖B t (ρ x)‖ + ‖g t‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ ‖B t‖ * ‖ρ x‖ + ‖g t‖ := add_le_add ((B t).le_opNorm _) le_rfl
            _ ≤ K * R + G := add_le_add (mul_le_mul (hBK t ht) (hρR x) (norm_nonneg _) hK.le)
                (hgG t ht)
        · rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ hL0, Real.coe_toNNReal _ (mul_nonneg hL0 hT.le)]
          have hmax : max (T - (0:ℝ)) ((0:ℝ) - -T) = T := by simp
          show (K * R + G) * max (T - (0:ℝ)) ((0:ℝ) - -T) ≤ (K * R + G) * T - ((0 : NNReal) : ℝ)
          rw [hmax, NNReal.coe_zero, sub_zero]
      obtain ⟨α, hα0, hα⟩ := hPL.exists_eq_forall_mem_Icc_hasDerivWithinAt₀
      have hα0' : α 0 = x0 := hα0
      have hbound := gron α (fun t => B t (ρ (α t)) + g t) K G T hK.le hG hT.le hα
        (fun t ht => by
          calc ‖B t (ρ (α t)) + g t‖ ≤ ‖B t (ρ (α t))‖ + ‖g t‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ ‖B t‖ * ‖ρ (α t)‖ + ‖g t‖ := add_le_add ((B t).le_opNorm _) le_rfl
            _ ≤ K * ‖α t‖ + G := add_le_add (mul_le_mul (hBK t ht) (hρn _) (norm_nonneg _) hK.le)
                (hgG t ht))
      rw [hα0'] at hbound
      refine ⟨α, hα0', fun t ht => ?_⟩
      have hin : ‖α t‖ ≤ R := by linarith [hbound t ht]
      have h2 : HasDerivWithinAt α (B t (ρ (α t)) + g t) (Set.Icc (-T) T) t := hα t ht
      rw [hρid _ hin] at h2
      exact h2
    
    have uniq : ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∀ α β : ℝ → E,
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivWithinAt α (B t (α t) + g t) (Set.Icc (-T) T) t) →
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivWithinAt β (B t (β t) + g t) (Set.Icc (-T) T) t) →

      intro T hT α β hα hβ h0
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := -T) (b := T)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        hB.continuousOn
      have hlip : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T,
          LipschitzOnWith C.toNNReal (fun x => B t x + g t) Set.univ := by
        intro t ht
        apply LipschitzWith.lipschitzOnWith
        rw [lipschitzWith_iff_norm_sub_le]
        intro x y
        show ‖B t x + g t - (B t y + g t)‖ ≤ (C.toNNReal : ℝ) * ‖x - y‖
