          ((hC t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)).trans (Real.le_coe_toNNReal C)) (norm_nonneg _))
      have hcα : ContinuousOn α (Set.Icc (-T) T) := fun t ht => (hα t ht).continuousWithinAt
      have hcβ : ContinuousOn β (Set.Icc (-T) T) := fun t ht => (hβ t ht).continuousWithinAt
      exact ODE_solution_unique_of_mem_Icc (v := fun t x => B t x + g t) (s := fun _ => Set.univ)
        hlip ⟨by linarith, hT⟩ hcα
        (fun t ht => (hα t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)).hasDerivAt (Icc_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2))
        (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _) hcβ
        (fun t ht => (hβ t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)).hasDerivAt (Icc_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2))
        (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _) h0
    
    choose α hα0 hα using fun n : ℕ => exI ((n:ℝ) + 1) (by positivity)
    have agree : ∀ n m : ℕ, n ≤ m → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ (n:ℝ) + 1 → α n t = α m t := by
      intro n m hnm t ht
      have hnm' : (n:ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.cast_le.mpr hnm
      have hsub : Set.Icc (-((n:ℝ) + 1)) ((n:ℝ) + 1) ⊆ Set.Icc (-((m:ℝ) + 1)) ((m:ℝ) + 1) :=
        Set.Icc_subset_Icc (by linarith) (by linarith)
      exact uniq ((n:ℝ) + 1) (by positivity) (α n) (α m) (hα n)
        (fun s hs => (hα m s (hsub hs)).mono hsub) ((hα0 n).trans (hα0 m).symm) t (abs_le.mp ht)
    refine ⟨fun t => α ⌈|t|⌉₊ t, hα0 _, fun v => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ : ∃ n0 : ℕ, n0 = ⌈|v|⌉₊ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hv : |v| ≤ (n0:ℝ) := by rw [hn0]; exact Nat.le_ceil _
    have hvlt := abs_lt.mp (show |v| < (n0:ℝ) + 1 by linarith)
    have hev : (fun t => α ⌈|t|⌉₊ t) =ᶠ[nhds v] α n0 := by
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds hvlt.1 hvlt.2] with t ht
      have htl : |t| < (n0:ℝ) + 1 := abs_lt.mpr ht
      have hk : |t| ≤ ((⌈|t|⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
      rcases le_total ⌈|t|⌉₊ n0 with h | h
      · exact agree _ _ h t (by linarith)
      · exact (agree _ _ h t htl.le).symm
    have hd : HasDerivAt (α n0) (B v (α n0 v) + g v) v :=
      (hα n0 v ⟨hvlt.1.le, hvlt.2.le⟩).hasDerivAt (Icc_mem_nhds hvlt.1 hvlt.2)
    show HasDerivAt (fun t => α ⌈|t|⌉₊ t) (B v (α ⌈|v|⌉₊ v) + g v) v
    rw [← hn0]
    exact hd.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  intro A0 P L K F y r hA0 hP hK hF hprop hy hr v hv
  
  have through : ∀ (M : ℝ → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (s : ℝ) (b : Fin 3 → ℝ), Continuous M →
      ∃ x : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ), x s = b ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt x (Matrix.mulVec (M t) (x t)) t := by
    intro M s b hM
    obtain ⟨z, hz0, hz⟩ := lode (Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (fun τ => LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Matrix.toLin' (M (τ + s)))) (fun _ => 0) b
      (by
        rw [continuous_clm_apply]
        intro u
        simp only [LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap', Matrix.toLin'_apply]
        exact (hM.comp (continuous_id.add continuous_const)).matrix_mulVec continuous_const)
      continuous_const
    refine ⟨fun t => z (t - s), by simp [hz0], fun t => ?_⟩
    have h1 := (hz (t - s)).comp_sub_const t s
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap', Matrix.toLin'_apply, sub_add_cancel,
      add_zero] at h1
    exact h1
  
  have dotd : ∀ (p q : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (p' q' : Fin 3 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt p p' t →
      HasDerivAt q q' t →
      HasDerivAt (fun τ => dotProduct (p τ) (q τ)) (dotProduct p' (q t) + dotProduct (p t) q') t := by
    intro p q p' q' t hp hq
    have hp' := hasDerivAt_pi.1 hp
    have hq' := hasDerivAt_pi.1 hq
    have h := HasDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun a _ => (hp' a).mul (hq' a))
    have e : dotProduct p' (q t) + dotProduct (p t) q' =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, (p' a * q t a + p t a * q' a) := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [e]
    exact h
  have dotdW : ∀ (p q : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (p' q' : Fin 3 → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (t : ℝ),
      HasDerivWithinAt p p' S t → HasDerivWithinAt q q' S t →
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun τ => dotProduct (p τ) (q τ))
        (dotProduct p' (q t) + dotProduct (p t) q') S t := by
    intro p q p' q' S t hp hq
    have hp' := hasDerivWithinAt_pi.1 hp
    have hq' := hasDerivWithinAt_pi.1 hq
    have h := HasDerivWithinAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun a _ => (hp' a).mul (hq' a))
    have e : dotProduct p' (q t) + dotProduct (p t) q' =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, (p' a * q t a + p t a * q' a) := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [e]
    exact h
  
  have alg : ∀ (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (ψ z : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      dotProduct (Matrix.mulVec (-(Matrix.transpose M)) ψ) z + dotProduct ψ (Matrix.mulVec M z) = 0 := by
    intro M ψ z
    rw [Matrix.neg_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_transpose, neg_dotProduct, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]
    exact neg_add_cancel _
  have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := hv.1
  have hvL : v ≤ L := hv.2
  have hPv := hP v
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ K * P v * (‖y 0‖ / P 0 + F * v) := by
    apply mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK hPv.le)
    exact add_nonneg (div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (hP 0).le) (mul_nonneg hF hv0)
  refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hR0).2 (fun i => ?_)
  have hMc : Continuous (fun t => -(Matrix.transpose (A0 t))) :=
    (Continuous.matrix_transpose (A := fun t => A0 t) hA0).neg
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψv, hψ⟩ := through (fun t => -(Matrix.transpose (A0 t)))
    v (Pi.single i 1) hMc
  
  have star : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ v → ∀ b : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      |dotProduct (ψ s) b| ≤ K * (P v / P s) * ‖b‖ := by
    intro s hs0 hsv b
    obtain ⟨x, hxs, hx⟩ := through (fun t => A0 t) s b hA0
    have hd : ∀ τ : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun τ => dotProduct (ψ τ) (x τ)) 0 τ := by
      intro τ
      exact (dotd ψ x _ _ τ (hψ τ) (hx τ)).congr_deriv (alg (A0 τ) (ψ τ) (x τ))
    have hconst : ∀ a c : ℝ, dotProduct (ψ a) (x a) = dotProduct (ψ c) (x c) :=
      is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun τ => (hd τ).differentiableAt) (fun τ => (hd τ).deriv)
    have e1 : dotProduct (ψ s) b = x v i := by
      rw [← hxs, hconst s v, hψv, single_dotProduct, one_mul]
    have hb := hprop x s hs0 (le_trans hsv hvL) (fun t _ => hx t) v ⟨hsv, hvL⟩
    rw [hxs] at hb
    rw [e1, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact le_trans (norm_le_pi_norm (x v) i) hb
  
  have hGd : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) v, HasDerivWithinAt (fun τ => dotProduct (ψ τ) (y τ))
      (dotProduct (ψ t) (r t)) (Set.Icc 0 v) t := by
    intro t ht
    have htL : t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L := ⟨ht.1, le_trans ht.2 hvL⟩
    have hsub : Set.Icc (0:ℝ) v ⊆ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L := Set.Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hvL
    have h := dotdW ψ y _ _ (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) v) t (hψ t).hasDerivWithinAt ((hy t htL).mono hsub)
    have e : dotProduct (Matrix.mulVec (-(Matrix.transpose (A0 t))) (ψ t))
        (y t) + dotProduct (ψ t) (Matrix.mulVec (A0 t) (y t) + r t) = dotProduct (ψ t) (r t) := by
      have h0 := alg (A0 t) (ψ t) (y t)
      rw [dotProduct_add]
      linarith
    exact h.congr_deriv e
  
  have hGb : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ico (0:ℝ) v, ‖dotProduct (ψ t) (r t)‖ ≤ K * F * P v := by
    intro t ht
    have htL : t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L := ⟨ht.1, le_trans ht.2.le hvL⟩
    have hPt := hP t
    have h1 := star t ht.1 ht.2.le (r t)
    have h2 : K * (P v / P t) * ‖r t‖ ≤ K * (P v / P t) * (F * P t) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hr t htL) (mul_nonneg hK (div_nonneg hPv.le hPt.le))
    have hc : P v / P t * P t = P v := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hPt.ne'
    have h3 : K * (P v / P t) * (F * P t) = K * F * P v := by
      calc K * (P v / P t) * (F * P t) = K * F * (P v / P t * P t) := by ring
        _ = K * F * P v := by rw [hc]
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    linarith
  
  have hmvt : ‖dotProduct (ψ v) (y v) - dotProduct (ψ 0) (y 0)‖ ≤ K * F * P v * (v - 0) :=
    norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le_segment' hGd hGb v ⟨hv0, le_rfl⟩
  
  have hG0 := star 0 le_rfl hv0 (y 0)
  have hGv : dotProduct (ψ v) (y v) = y v i := by rw [hψv, single_dotProduct, one_mul]
  rw [hGv, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hmvt
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have htri := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (y v i) (dotProduct (ψ 0) (y 0))
  have e : K * (P v / P 0) * ‖y 0‖ + K * F * P v * (v - 0) =
      K * P v * (‖y 0‖ / P 0 + F * v) := by ring
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ × ℝ), Continuous φ → (∀ (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (n m : ℤ), φ (Y + ((n : ℝ), (m : ℝ))) = φ Y) → ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, φ (Y + c) = ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, φ Y

signature.name: pm5_torus_shift_mean
signature.statement: ∀ (φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ × ℝ), Continuous φ → (∀ (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (n m : ℤ), φ (Y + ((n : ℝ), (m : ℝ))) = φ Y) → ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, φ (Y + c) = ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, φ Y

proof.tactics:
by
  intro φ c hφ hper
  have h1d : ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ), (∀ s : ℝ, ψ (s + 1) = ψ s) →
      ∫ s in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ψ (s + a) = ∫ s in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ψ s := by
    intro ψ a hψ
    have hP : Function.Periodic ψ 1 := hψ
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, MeasureTheory.integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one,
      intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right ψ a, zero_add, add_comm 1 a,
      hP.intervalIntegral_add_eq a 0, zero_add]
  have hK : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  have hI1 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun Y => φ (Y + c)) (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
      ((MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ).prod MeasureTheory.volume) := by
    rw [← MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod]
    exact (hφ.comp (continuous_id.add continuous_const)).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hK
  have hI2 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn φ (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
      ((MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ).prod MeasureTheory.volume) := by
    rw [← MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod]
    exact hφ.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hK
  rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod ℝ ℝ, MeasureTheory.setIntegral_prod _ hI1,
    MeasureTheory.setIntegral_prod _ hI2]
  have hinner : ∀ x : ℝ, ∫ y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, φ ((x, y) + c) =
      ∫ y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, φ (x + c.1, y) := by
    intro x
    have key := h1d (fun s => φ (x + c.1, s)) c.2 (fun s => by
      have h := hper (x + c.1, s) 0 1
      simp only [Int.cast_zero, Int.cast_one, Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero] at h
      exact h)
    exact key
  have hΦ : ∀ a : ℝ, (∫ y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, φ (a + 1, y)) = ∫ y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, φ (a, y) := by
    intro a
    congr 1
    funext y
    have h := hper (a, y) 1 0
    simp only [Int.cast_zero, Int.cast_one, Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero] at h
    exact h
  simp_rw [hinner]
  exact h1d (fun a => ∫ y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, φ (a, y)) c.1 hΦ

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState), B.ok → IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dT f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → dR B.h f ξ = 0 ∧ dZ f ξ = 0 ∧ dT f ξ = 0) → (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => ubase B ξ a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mcor5 B G l0 S a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Wcov5 B G l0 S a b) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ n m : ℤ, (∀ a : Fin 3, mcor5 B G l0 S a (shY ξ ((n : ℝ), (m : ℝ))) = mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 3, Wcov5 B G l0 S a b (shY ξ ((n : ℝ), (m : ℝ))) = Wcov5 B G l0 S a b ξ)) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → (∀ a : Fin 3, mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ = 0) ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 3, Wcov5 B G l0 S a b ξ = 0)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (grP5 B G l0 S) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ n m : ℤ, grP5 B G l0 S (shY ξ ((n : ℝ), (m : ℝ))) = grP5 B G l0 S ξ) ∧ (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → grP5 B G l0 S ξ = 0)

signature.name: pm5_grP5_regular
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState), B.ok → IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dT f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → dR B.h f ξ = 0 ∧ dZ f ξ = 0 ∧ dT f ξ = 0) → (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => ubase B ξ a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mcor5 B G l0 S a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Wcov5 B G l0 S a b) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ n m : ℤ, (∀ a : Fin 3, mcor5 B G l0 S a (shY ξ ((n : ℝ), (m : ℝ))) = mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 3, Wcov5 B G l0 S a b (shY ξ ((n : ℝ), (m : ℝ))) = Wcov5 B G l0 S a b ξ)) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → (∀ a : Fin 3, mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ = 0) ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 3, Wcov5 B G l0 S a b ξ = 0)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (grP5 B G l0 S) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ n m : ℤ, grP5 B G l0 S (shY ξ ((n : ℝ), (m : ℝ))) = grP5 B G l0 S ξ) ∧ (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → grP5 B G l0 S ξ = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 S hB hO hdiff hshellD hub hmc hWc hPer hShell
  obtain ⟨F1, hF1⟩ : ∃ F1 : Cyl → ℝ, F1 = fun η => 2 * ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η +
      mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η ^ 2 + Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 0 η := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨F2, hF2⟩ : ∃ F2 : Cyl → ℝ, F2 = fun η => ubase B η 0 * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η +
      ubase B η 2 * mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η + mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η * mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η +
      Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 0 η := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨F3, hF3⟩ : ∃ F3 : Cyl → ℝ, F3 = fun η => 2 * ubase B η 1 * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η +
      mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η ^ 2 + Wcov5 B G l0 S 1 1 η := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have key : ∀ ξ : Cyl, grP5 B G l0 S ξ = (0:ℝ) - dT (mcor5 B G l0 S 0) ξ
      - (dR B.h F1 ξ + F1 ξ / ξ.1) - dZ F2 ξ + F3 ξ / ξ.1
      + (lap0 B.h (mcor5 B G l0 S 0) ξ - mcor5 B G l0 S 0 ξ / ξ.1 ^ 2) := by
    intro ξ
    rw [hF1, hF2, hF3]
    rfl
  
  have hβs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mcor5 B G l0 S 0) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := hmc 0
  have hF1s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F1 (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    rw [hF1]
    exact (((contDiffOn_const.mul (hub 0)).mul (hmc 0)).add ((hmc 0).pow 2)).add (hWc 0 0)
  have hF2s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F2 (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    rw [hF2]
    exact ((((hub 0).mul (hmc 2)).add ((hub 2).mul (hmc 0))).add ((hmc 0).mul (hmc 2))).add
      (hWc 2 0)
  have hF3s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F3 (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    rw [hF3]
    exact (((contDiffOn_const.mul (hub 1)).mul (hmc 1)).add ((hmc 1).pow 2)).add (hWc 1 1)
  have hdiv : ∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => f ξ / ξ.1) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro f hf
    exact hf.div contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx.1)
  have hdiv2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => mcor5 B G l0 S 0 ξ / ξ.1 ^ 2)
      (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    hβs.div (contDiff_fst.pow 2).contDiffOn (fun x hx => pow_ne_zero 2 (ne_of_gt hx.1))
  have hlap : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (lap0 B.h (mcor5 B G l0 S 0)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have h := ((hdiff _ (hdiff _ hβs).1).1.add (hdiv _ (hdiff _ hβs).1)).add
      (hdiff _ (hdiff _ hβs).2.1).2.1
    exact h
  have hRHS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (0:ℝ) - dT (mcor5 B G l0 S 0) ξ
      - (dR B.h F1 ξ + F1 ξ / ξ.1) - dZ F2 ξ + F3 ξ / ξ.1
      + (lap0 B.h (mcor5 B G l0 S 0) ξ - mcor5 B G l0 S 0 ξ / ξ.1 ^ 2)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    ((((contDiffOn_const.sub (hdiff _ hβs).2.2).sub ((hdiff _ hF1s).1.add (hdiv F1 hF1s))).sub
      (hdiff _ hF2s).2.1).add (hdiv F3 hF3s)).add (hlap.sub hdiv2)
  have hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (grP5 B G l0 S) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    hRHS.congr (fun ξ _ => key ξ)
  
  have hshift : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (c : ℝ × ℝ), (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), f (shY η c) = f η) →
      ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), fderiv ℝ f (shY ξ c) = fderiv ℝ f ξ := by
    intro f c hf ξ hξ
    have hadd : ∀ η : Cyl, shY η c = η + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), c) := by
      intro η
      obtain ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4⟩ := η
      simp [shY]
    have hev : (fun η => f (η + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), c))) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] f :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hξ) (fun η hη => by
        show f (η + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), c)) = f η
        rw [← hadd η]
        exact hf η hη)
    rw [hadd ξ, ← fderiv_comp_add_right, hev.fderiv_eq]
  have hD : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (c : ℝ × ℝ), (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), f (shY η c) = f η) →
      ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dR B.h f (shY ξ c) = dR B.h f ξ ∧ dZ f (shY ξ c) = dZ f ξ ∧
        dT f (shY ξ c) = dT f ξ := by
    intro f c hf ξ hξ
    have h := hshift f c hf ξ hξ
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show fderiv ℝ f (shY ξ c) (1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * (shY ξ c).1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) =
        fderiv ℝ f ξ (1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)
      rw [h]
      all_goals rfl

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B g z t hB ht hc hp hs hT r hr
  have hq0 : 0 < simScale B.h z (1 - t) := (hB.1.1 z (1 - t) (by linarith)).1
  obtain ⟨-, -, hXa, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -⟩ := hB.2.1
  set q := simScale B.h z (1 - t) with hqdef
  set ρa := Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xa * q) with hρa
  set ρb := Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xb * q) with hρb
  have hρa0 : 0 < ρa := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (mul_pos (mul_pos two_pos hXa) hq0)
  have h2q : (0:ℝ) < 2 * q := by linarith
  set d := drx B.h with hd
  set χ := chiM B (XC B.h (r, z, t, 0)) with hχ
  set H : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun Y r' => g (r', z, t, Y + (r' ^ d - r ^ d) • vrv) with hH
  have hXC : ∀ (r' : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), XC B.h (r', z, t, Y) = r' ^ 2 / (2 * q) := fun r' Y => rfl
  
  have hsupp : ∀ (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (r' : ℝ), 0 < r' → (r' < ρa ∨ ρb < r') → H Y r' = 0 := by
    intro Y r' hr' h
    apply hs r' _ hr'
    rw [hXC]
    rcases h with h | h
    · left
      have h' := (Real.lt_sqrt hr'.le).mp h
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ h2q]; linarith
    · right
      have h' := (Real.sqrt_lt' hr').mp h
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ h2q]; linarith
  
  have hHc : ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry H) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) := by
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => p.2 ^ d) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) :=
      ContinuousOn.rpow_const continuous_snd.continuousOn (fun x hx => Or.inl (ne_of_gt hx.2))
    have hσ : ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => (p.2, p.1 + (p.2 ^ d - r ^ d) • vrv))
        (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) :=
      continuous_snd.continuousOn.prodMk
        (continuous_fst.continuousOn.add ((h1.sub continuousOn_const).smul continuousOn_const))
    exact hc.comp hσ (fun p hp => ⟨hp.2, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
  
  have hswap : ∀ I : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet I → I ⊆ Set.Ioi 0 →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun Y => ∫ r' in I, H Y r') (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ∧
      (∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∫ r' in I, H Y r') =
        ∫ r' in I, ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, H Y r' := by
    intro I hI hIpos
    have hK : IsCompact ((Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ×ˢ Set.Icc ρa ρb) :=
      (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).prod isCompact_Icc
    have hKc : ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry H)
        ((Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ×ˢ Set.Icc ρa ρb) :=
      hHc.mono (fun p hp => ⟨Set.mem_univ _, lt_of_lt_of_le hρa0 hp.2.1⟩)
    have hKi : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (Function.uncurry H)
        ((Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ×ˢ Set.Icc ρa ρb) :=
      hKc.integrableOn_compact hK
    have hSi : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (Function.uncurry H)
        ((Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ×ˢ I) := by
      refine hKi.of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero ((measurableSet_Icc.prod measurableSet_Icc).prod hI) ?_
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨⟨hp1, hp2⟩, hpK⟩ := hp
      apply hsupp p.1 p.2 (hIpos hp2)
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      exact hpK ⟨hp1, hcon.1, hcon.2⟩
    have hprod : MeasureTheory.Integrable (Function.uncurry H)
        ((MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)).prod
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict I)) := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_restrict, ← MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod]
      exact hSi
    exact ⟨hprod.integral_prod_left, MeasureTheory.integral_integral_swap hprod⟩
  
  have hinner : ∀ r' : ℝ, 0 < r' →
      (∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, H Y r') = yAvg g (r', z, t, 0) := by
    intro r' hr'
    have hφ : Continuous (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => g (r', z, t, Y)) :=
      hc.comp_continuous (Continuous.prodMk continuous_const continuous_id)
        (fun Y => ⟨hr', Set.mem_univ _⟩)
    exact hT (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => g (r', z, t, Y)) ((r' ^ d - r ^ d) • vrv) hφ
      (fun Y n m => hp r' Y n m hr')
  
  have hL : yAvg (Icut B g) (r, z, t, 0) = ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
      ((∫ r' in Set.Ioc 0 r, H Y r') - χ * ∫ r' in Set.Ioi 0, H Y r') := by
    show (∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, Icut B g (r, z, t, Y)) = _
    refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun (measurableSet_Icc.prod measurableSet_Icc)
      (fun Y _ => ?_)
    show (∫ r' in (0:ℝ)..r, H Y r') - χ * ∫ r' in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), H Y r' = _
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hr.le]
  obtain ⟨hPi, hPs⟩ := hswap (Set.Ioc 0 r) measurableSet_Ioc (fun x hx => hx.1)
  obtain ⟨hQi, hQs⟩ := hswap (Set.Ioi 0) measurableSet_Ioi (fun x hx => hx)
  rw [hL, MeasureTheory.integral_sub hPi (MeasureTheory.Integrable.const_mul hQi χ),
    MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, hPs, hQs,
    MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioc (fun r' hr' => hinner r' hr'.1),
    MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun r' hr' => hinner r' hr'),
    intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hr.le]

signature.name: pm5_moment_ibp
signature.statement: ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), 0 < a → a ≤ b → ContinuousOn F (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → (r < a ∨ b < r) → F r = 0) → (∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), F r) = 0 → (∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ 1 * ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..r, F s) = -(1/2) * ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ 2 * F r

proof.tactics:
by
  intro F a b ha hab hF hZ hM
  set Ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..r, F s with hΨ
  have hsub : Set.Icc a b ⊆ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) := fun x hx => lt_of_lt_of_le ha hx.1
  have hIab : IntegrableOn F (Set.Icc a b) := (hF.mono hsub).integrableOn_Icc
  have hzero : ∀ y, 0 < y → y ∉ Set.Icc a b → F y = 0 := by
    intro y hy hny
    apply hZ y hy
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    exact hny ⟨h.1, h.2⟩
  have hII : ∀ x, 0 < x → IntervalIntegrable F volume 0 x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hx.le]
    exact hIab.of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioc (fun y hy => hzero y hy.1.1 hy.2)
  have hΨa : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ a → Ψ r = 0 := by
    intro r hr0 hra
    show (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..r, F s) = 0
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hr0, MeasureTheory.integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo]
    rw [setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioo (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ))
      (fun x hx => hZ x hx.1 (Or.inl (lt_of_lt_of_le hx.2 hra)))]
    simp
  have hΨb : ∀ r, b ≤ r → Ψ r = 0 := by
    intro r hbr
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := by linarith
    show (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..r, F s) = 0
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hr0]
    have h1 : (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), F x) = ∫ x in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) r, F x := by
      apply setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi
        Set.Ioc_subset_Ioi_self
      intro x hx
      apply hZ x hx.1
      right
      have : ¬ x ≤ r := fun h => hx.2 ⟨hx.1, h⟩
      linarith [not_le.mp this]
    rw [← h1, hM]
  have hL : (∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ 1 * Ψ r) = ∫ r in a..b, r ^ 1 * Ψ r := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab, ← MeasureTheory.integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc]
    apply setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi hsub
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : 0 < x := hx.1
    rcases le_or_gt x a with h | h
    · rw [hΨa x hx0.le h, mul_zero]
    · have hbx : b < x := by
        by_contra h'
        push_neg at h'
        exact hx.2 ⟨h.le, h'⟩
      rw [hΨb x hbx.le, mul_zero]
  have hR : (∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ 2 * F r) = ∫ r in a..b, r ^ 2 * F r := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab, ← MeasureTheory.integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc]
    apply setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi hsub
    intro x hx
    rw [hzero x hx.1 hx.2, mul_zero]
  have hderiv : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt Ψ (F x) x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hab] at hx
    have hx0 : 0 < x := hsub hx
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hII x hx0)
      (hF.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter isOpen_Ioi x hx0)
      (hF.continuousAt (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds hx0))
  have hv : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2 / 2) x x := by
    intro x _
    have := (hasDerivAt_pow 2 x).div_const 2
    convert this using 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have hFab : IntervalIntegrable F volume a b := by
    apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hab]
    exact hF.mono hsub
  have hibp := intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul (u := Ψ)
    (v := fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2 / 2) (u' := F) (v' := fun x : ℝ => x) hderiv hv hFab
    (continuous_id.intervalIntegrable a b)
  beta_reduce at hibp
  rw [hΨa a ha.le le_rfl, hΨb b le_rfl] at hibp
  show (∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ 1 * Ψ r) = _
  rw [hL, hR]
  have e1 : (∫ r in a..b, r ^ 1 * Ψ r) = ∫ x in a..b, Ψ x * x := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro x _
    show x ^ 1 * Ψ x = Ψ x * x
    ring
  have e2 : (∫ x in a..b, F x * (x ^ 2 / 2)) = (1/2) * ∫ x in a..b, x ^ 2 * F x := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro x _
    show F x * (x ^ 2 / 2) = 1 / 2 * (x ^ 2 * F x)
    ring
  rw [e1, hibp, e2]
  ring

by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, hXa, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)

  intro l0 hl0 S Bo _hBo hIn _hT hSC

    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h ξ hh0 hh1 hq hhi hn hTn g k
  have hs2lt : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := (Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)).mpr (by norm_num)
  have hs2gt : 1 < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.one_lt_sqrt_two
  have hL : Lgc ≠ 0 := by unfold Lgc; intro h0; linarith
  have hTg : Tgc ≠ 0 := by unfold Tgc; intro h0; linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
  have hN : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have c1 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), (Jpow n Y).1 = Lgc ^ n * ((Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) +
      Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) * bgc := by
    intro n Y
    simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk]
    ring
  have c2 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), (Jpow n Y).2 = -(Lgc ^ n * ((Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) * bgc) +
      Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) := by
    intro n Y
    simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk]
    ring
  have hcomp : ∀ (m n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), Jpow m (Jpow n Y) = Jpow (m + n) Y := by
    intro m n Y
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · rw [c1 m, c1 (m + n), c1 n, c2 n, zpow_add₀ hL, zpow_add₀ hTg]
      field_simp
      ring
    · rw [c2 m, c2 (m + n), c1 n, c2 n, zpow_add₀ hL, zpow_add₀ hTg]
      field_simp
      ring
  have hid : ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, Jpow 0 Y = Y := by
    intro Y
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · rw [c1, zpow_zero, zpow_zero]
      field_simp
      ring
    · rw [c2, zpow_zero, zpow_zero]
      field_simp
      ring
  have hJ : ∀ (m : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), JpowL m Y = Jpow m Y := by
    intro m Y
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · simp only [JpowL, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', Prod.fst_add, Prod.smul_fst,
        smul_eq_mul]
      rw [c1, c1, c1]
      ring
    · simp only [JpowL, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_snd,
        smul_eq_mul]
      rw [c2, c2, c2]
      ring
  have hJinv : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), JpowL (-n) (JpowL n Y) = Y := by
    intro n Y
    rw [hJ, hJ, hcomp, neg_add_cancel, hid]
  
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ bgc := by unfold bgc; linarith
  have hb1 : bgc ≤ 1 := by unfold bgc; linarith
  have hc1 : 1 ≤ 1 + bgc ^ 2 := le_add_of_nonneg_right (sq_nonneg _)
  have hcpos : (0:ℝ) < 1 + bgc ^ 2 := by linarith
  have hLpos : 0 < Lgc := by unfold Lgc; linarith
  have hLT : Lgc ≤ Tgc := by unfold Lgc Tgc; linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
  
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = 4 * qC h ξ ^ (-(2:ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hQ1 : 1 ≤ qC h ξ ^ (-(2:ℝ)) :=
    Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hq hhi (by norm_num)
  have hqinvQ : (qC h ξ)⁻¹ ≤ qC h ξ ^ (-(2:ℝ)) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_neg_one]
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq hhi (by norm_num)
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := by rw [hK]; linarith
  have hQK : qC h ξ ^ (-(2:ℝ)) ≤ K := by rw [hK]; linarith
  have hqK : (qC h ξ)⁻¹ ≤ K := le_trans hqinvQ hQK
  
  have hsq0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (qC h ξ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq
  have hsq1 : Real.sqrt (qC h ξ) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← Real.sqrt_one]; exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hhi
  have hqsq : qC h ξ ≤ Real.sqrt (qC h ξ) := by
    have e := Real.mul_self_sqrt hq.le
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq1 hsq0.le
    nlinarith
  have hqe0 : 0 < qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _
  have hqqe : qC h ξ ≤ qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) := by
    have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq hhi (show 1/2 - h ≤ 1 by linarith)
    rwa [Real.rpow_one] at this
  have hi1 : (Real.sqrt (qC h ξ))⁻¹ ≤ K := le_trans (inv_anti₀ hq hqsq) hqK
  have hi2 : (qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h))⁻¹ ≤ K := le_trans (inv_anti₀ hq hqqe) hqK
  
  have hslot : ∀ (m : ℤ), 0 ≤ m → Tgc ^ m ≤ qC h ξ ^ (-(2:ℝ)) → ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ,
      ‖JpowL m Y‖ ≤ K * ‖Y‖ := by
    intro m hm hTm Y
    have hY1 : |Y.1| ≤ ‖Y‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_fst_le Y
    have hY2 : |Y.2| ≤ ‖Y‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_snd_le Y
    have hr : 0 ≤ ‖Y‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hdiv : ∀ x : ℝ, |x / (1 + bgc ^ 2)| ≤ |x| := by
      intro x
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hcpos]
      exact div_le_self (abs_nonneg _) hc1
    have hbY2 : |bgc * Y.2| ≤ ‖Y‖ := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hb0]
      calc bgc * |Y.2| ≤ 1 * ‖Y‖ := mul_le_mul hb1 hY2 (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = ‖Y‖ := one_mul _
    have hbY1 : |bgc * Y.1| ≤ ‖Y‖ := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hb0]
      calc bgc * |Y.1| ≤ 1 * ‖Y‖ := mul_le_mul hb1 hY1 (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = ‖Y‖ := one_mul _
    obtain ⟨a, ha_def⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = (Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb_def⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ, b = (bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have ha : |a| ≤ 2 * ‖Y‖ := by
      rw [ha_def]
      refine le_trans (hdiv _) ?_
      linarith [abs_sub (Y.1) (bgc * Y.2)]
    have hb : |b| ≤ 2 * ‖Y‖ := by
      rw [hb_def]
      refine le_trans (hdiv _) ?_
      linarith [abs_add_le (bgc * Y.1) (Y.2)]
    have hLn0 : 0 < Lgc ^ m := zpow_pos hLpos m
    have hTn0 : 0 < Tgc ^ m := zpow_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le hLpos hLT) m
    have hLTn : Lgc ^ m ≤ Tgc ^ m := zpow_le_zpow_left₀ hm hLpos.le hLT
    have hTnK : 4 * Tgc ^ m ≤ K := by rw [hK]; linarith
    have e1 := c1 m Y
    have e2 := c2 m Y
    rw [← ha_def, ← hb_def] at e1 e2
    have tL : |Lgc ^ m * a| ≤ Tgc ^ m * (2 * ‖Y‖) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hLn0]
      exact mul_le_mul hLTn ha (abs_nonneg _) hTn0.le
    have tT : |Tgc ^ m * b| ≤ Tgc ^ m * (2 * ‖Y‖) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hTn0]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hTn0.le
    have tTb : |Tgc ^ m * b * bgc| ≤ Tgc ^ m * (2 * ‖Y‖) := by
      rw [abs_mul (Tgc ^ m * b), abs_of_nonneg hb0]
      calc |Tgc ^ m * b| * bgc ≤ |Tgc ^ m * b| * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb1 (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = |Tgc ^ m * b| := mul_one _
        _ ≤ _ := tT
    have tLb : |-(Lgc ^ m * a * bgc)| ≤ Tgc ^ m * (2 * ‖Y‖) := by
      rw [abs_neg, abs_mul (Lgc ^ m * a), abs_of_nonneg hb0]
      calc |Lgc ^ m * a| * bgc ≤ |Lgc ^ m * a| * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb1 (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = |Lgc ^ m * a| := mul_one _
        _ ≤ _ := tL
    rw [hJ]
    refine norm_prod_le_iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, e1]
      calc _ ≤ |Lgc ^ m * a| + |Tgc ^ m * b * bgc| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ 4 * Tgc ^ m * ‖Y‖ := by linarith
        _ ≤ K * ‖Y‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hTnK hr
    · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, e2]
      calc _ ≤ |-(Lgc ^ m * a * bgc)| + |Tgc ^ m * b| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ 4 * Tgc ^ m * ‖Y‖ := by linarith
        _ ≤ K * ‖Y‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hTnK hr
  
  have hnorm4 : ∀ (a b c : ℝ) (d : ℝ × ℝ) (r : ℝ), ‖a‖ ≤ r → ‖b‖ ≤ r → ‖c‖ ≤ r → ‖d‖ ≤ r →
      ‖((a, b, c, d) : Cyl)‖ ≤ r := by
    intro a b c d r ha hb hc hd
    exact norm_prod_le_iff.mpr ⟨ha, norm_prod_le_iff.mpr ⟨hb, norm_prod_le_iff.mpr ⟨hc, hd⟩⟩⟩
  have hsc : ∀ (c x r : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → c ≤ K → ‖x‖ ≤ r → ‖c * x‖ ≤ K * r := by
    intro c x r hc hcM hx
    rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hc]
    exact mul_le_mul hcM hx (norm_nonneg _) hK0
  have hu1 : ∀ u : Cyl, ‖u.1‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := fun u => norm_fst_le u
  have hu2 : ∀ u : Cyl, ‖u.2.1‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := fun u => (norm_fst_le u.2).trans (norm_snd_le u)
  have hu3 : ∀ u : Cyl, ‖u.2.2.1‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := fun u =>
    ((norm_fst_le u.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le u.2)).trans (norm_snd_le u)
  have hu4 : ∀ u : Cyl, ‖u.2.2.2‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := fun u =>
    ((norm_snd_le u.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le u.2)).trans (norm_snd_le u)
  
  have hLap : ∀ u : Cyl, Lnorm h ξ u = (Real.sqrt (qC h ξ) * u.1, qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) * u.2.1,
      qC h ξ * u.2.2.1, JpowL (-(coarseIdx h (qC h ξ))) u.2.2.2) := fun u => rfl
  obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl,
      R = ((Real.sqrt (qC h ξ))⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
        (((qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h))⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
          (((qC h ξ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (JpowL (coarseIdx h (qC h ξ))))) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hRap : ∀ u : Cyl, R u = ((Real.sqrt (qC h ξ))⁻¹ * u.1, (qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h))⁻¹ * u.2.1,
      (qC h ξ)⁻¹ * u.2.2.1, JpowL (coarseIdx h (qC h ξ)) u.2.2.2) := by
    intro u; rw [hRdef]; rfl
  have hR : ∀ u : Cyl, ‖R u‖ ≤ K * ‖u‖ := by
    intro u
    rw [hRap]
    exact hnorm4 _ _ _ _ _ (hsc _ _ _ (inv_nonneg.mpr hsq0.le) hi1 (hu1 u))
      (hsc _ _ _ (inv_nonneg.mpr hqe0.le) hi2 (hu2 u))
      (hsc _ _ _ (inv_nonneg.mpr hq.le) hqK (hu3 u))
      (le_trans (hslot _ hn hTn u.2.2.2) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hu4 u) hK0))
  have hPR : ∀ u : Cyl, Lnorm h ξ (R u) = u := by
    intro u
    obtain ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ := u
    rw [hRap, hLap]
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
    refine ⟨mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hsq0.ne' a, mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hqe0.ne' b,
      mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hq.ne' c, hJinv _ d⟩
  have hRn : ‖R‖ ≤ K := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hK0 hR
  
  unfold NB
  obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A, A = iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g ξ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hAdef, ← hK]
  have hA : A = (A.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap
      (fun _ => R) := by
    ext m
    simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, hPR]
  have h1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
    (A.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)) (fun _ : Fin k => R)
  rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h1
  calc ‖A‖ = ‖(A.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => R)‖ := congrArg _ hA
    _ ≤ ‖A.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ * ‖R‖ ^ k := h1
    _ ≤ ‖A.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ * K ^ k :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hRn k) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = K ^ k * ‖A.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ := mul_comm _ _

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), B.ok → ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 → |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 → (∃ U : Set Cyl, IsOpen U ∧ ξ ∈ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (phiL5 B G γ) U) ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2) ξ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G γ ξ hok hξ hxi het
  obtain ⟨U, c, hUo, hξU, hUD, hmod⟩ := nPhi5_local_model_v5 B G γ ξ hok hξ hxi het
  have hAff : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl =>
      Tgc ^ bandIdx B.h γ.1 / cib B.h γ.1 * lamT η.2.2.2 + c) := by
    simp only [lamT]
    fun_prop
  have hVU : ∀ η ∈ U, vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 =
      Tgc ^ bandIdx B.h γ.1 / cib B.h γ.1 * lamT η.2.2.2 + c := fun η hη => (hmod η hη).1
  have hV : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2) ξ :=
    hAff.contDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hξU) hVU)
  have hVo : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2) U :=
    hAff.contDiffOn.congr hVU
  obtain ⟨-, hgs⟩ := geom_slow_base_smooth_v5 B hok
  have hπ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun η : Cyl => ((η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (DomC B.h B.qB)
      {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
    intro η hη
    have hη' : 0 < η.1 ∧ η.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h η < B.qB := hη
    exact ⟨hη'.1, hη'.2.1, hη'.2.2⟩
  have hbase : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => baseC B γ.1 η j) (DomC B.h B.qB) := by
    intro j
    exact ((hgs γ.1 j).comp hπ.contDiffOn hmaps).congr (fun η _ => rfl)
  have hRC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => RC γ.1 η) := by
    simp only [RC]
    fun_prop
  have hQ : 0 < Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _)
  have hRC0 : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, RC γ.1 η ≠ 0 := by
    intro η hη
    have hη' : 0 < η.1 ∧ η.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h η < B.qB := hη
    exact (div_pos hη'.1 hQ).ne'
  have hFang : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => Fang B γ.1 η) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
    (hbase 1).div hRC.contDiffOn hRC0
  have hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => pang5 B G γ * Fang B γ.1 η + pzr5 B G γ * baseC B γ.1 η 2)
      (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
    (contDiffOn_const.mul hFang).add (contDiffOn_const.mul (hbase 2))
  have hL : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => pzr5 B G γ * chartZ B.h γ.1 η / epsb B.h γ.1 +
      sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 * RC γ.1 η) := by
    simp only [chartZ, RC]
    fun_prop
  have hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (pzr5 B G γ * chartZ B.h γ.1 η / epsb B.h γ.1 +
      sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 * RC γ.1 η) -
      vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 * (pang5 B G γ * Fang B γ.1 η + pzr5 B G γ * baseC B γ.1 η 2)) U :=
    hL.contDiffOn.sub (hVo.mul (hP.mono hUD))
  exact ⟨⟨U, hUo, hξU, hφ⟩, hV⟩

by
  intro B G hok hG

  obtain ⟨hr0, hr01, -, -, -⟩ := hG.1

  choose Ccp hCcp using hCP

  obtain ⟨hDo, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B B.qB hok

  have hQb : ∀ l : ℕ, Qb l = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l := fun l => by

    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  refine ⟨lr + lv + lcp + n0, fun k => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℝ, E = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Ccp j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCE : ∀ j, j ≤ k → |Ccp j| ≤ E := by

    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Ccp j|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)

  intro l0 γ ξ hl0 hξ hS het
  have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ'.2.1])).1
  have hqs : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := hQb l0
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hqs]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0.le
  have hξB : ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB := ⟨hξ'.1, hξ'.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ'.2.2 hqsB⟩

  have hq1 : 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 := by linarith
  have hq2 : qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 := by linarith

  have hAct : ActiveL4 B G γ := ⟨hS.1.1, ξ, hξB, het, hS.2.2.2.2.1, hS.2.2.2.2.2⟩

  have hπ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop

  have eB2 : (fun η : Cyl => baseC B γ.1 η 2) = fun η : Cyl => pcB5 B γ.1 2 (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) := rfl

  have hPc := hPD.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hξB)

  have hmain : ∀ η ∈ U, eikP5 B G γ η = ubase B η 0 * (sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2) / Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 * (fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) + ubase B η 0 * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) + ubase B η 2 * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) := by
    intro η hη
    have hs : (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ∈ Ω := hUsub hη
    have d1 := ((hP2.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hs)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have hPd : HasFDerivAt (fun y : Cyl => pcPhi2_5 B G γ (y.1, y.2.1, y.2.2.1))
        ((fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1)).comp sl) η :=
      HasFDerivAt.comp (g := pcPhi2_5 B G γ) (f := fun x : Cyl => (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1)) η d1 (hslA η)
    have hY1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : Cyl => y.2.1)
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))) η :=
      hasFDerivAt_snd.fst
    have hX : HasFDerivAt (fun y : Cyl => y.1) (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) η :=
      hasFDerivAt_fst
    have hv : HasFDerivAt (fun y : Cyl => A * ℓ y + c) (A • ℓ) η :=
      (ℓ.hasFDerivAt.const_mul A).add_const c
    have hF := ((hY1.const_mul C1).add (hX.const_mul C2)).sub (hv.mul hPd)
    have hev : phiL5 B G γ =ᶠ[nhds η] ((fun y : Cyl => C1 * y.2.1) + (fun y : Cyl => C2 * y.1) -
        ((fun y : Cyl => A * ℓ y + c) * (fun y : Cyl => pcPhi2_5 B G γ (y.1, y.2.1, y.2.2.1)))) := by
      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hη) (fun y hy => ?_)
      show phiL5 B G γ y = C1 * y.2.1 + C2 * y.1 - (A * ℓ y + c) * pcPhi2_5 B G γ (y.1, y.2.1, y.2.2.1)
      have hP : pang5 B G γ * Fang B γ.1 y + pzr5 B G γ * baseC B γ.1 y 2 =
          pcPhi2_5 B G γ (y.1, y.2.1, y.2.2.1) := rfl
      rw [hℓ y]
      simp only [phiL5]
      rw [hP, hAff y hy, hC1, hC2]
      unfold chartZ RC
      ring
    have hfd := (hev.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ)).trans hF.fderiv
    have key : ∀ d : Cyl, fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) η d = C1 * d.2.1 + C2 * d.1 -
        (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) (d.1, d.2.1, d.2.2.1) +
          pcPhi2_5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) * (A * lamT d.2.2.2)) := by
      intro d
      rw [hfd, hAff η hη]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd',
        smul_eq_mul, hsld, hℓ]
    have hdT : dT (phiL5 B G γ) η = C1 * (0:ℝ) + C2 * (0:ℝ) -
        (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) +
          pcPhi2_5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) * (A * lamT vtv)) :=
      key ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), vtv)
    have hdR : dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) η = C1 * (0:ℝ) + C2 * (1:ℝ) -
        (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) +
          pcPhi2_5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) * (A * lamT ((drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv))) :=
      key ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)
    have hdZ : dZ (phiL5 B G γ) η = C1 * (1:ℝ) + C2 * (0:ℝ) -
        (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) +
          pcPhi2_5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) * (A * lamT (0 : ℝ × ℝ))) :=
      key ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ))
    have hΦ0 : pcPhi2_5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) =
        (pint5 B G γ : ℝ) / (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) *
          (Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2 + B.h) * ubase B η 1 / (η.1 / Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1))) +
        pzr5 B G γ * (Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2 + B.h) * ubase B η 2) := rfl
    have hΦ : pcPhi2_5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) =
        (pint5 B G γ : ℝ) / (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) *
          (Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2 + B.h) * ubase B η 1 * Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) / η.1) +
        pzr5 B G γ * (Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2 + B.h) * ubase B η 2) := by
      rw [hΦ0, div_div_eq_mul_div]
    unfold eikP5
    rw [hdT, hdR, hdZ, hlt, hlv, hl0, hΦ]
    linear_combination
      (-(ubase B η 1 * (pint5 B G γ : ℝ) / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * η.1) + ubase B η 2 * C1)) * hK +
      (ubase B η 2 * Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2 + B.h) * A) * hC1' + ubase B η 0 * hC2
  refine ⟨U, c, hUo, hξU, hUsub, fun η hη => ⟨?_, hmain η hη⟩⟩
  rw [← hA]
  exact hAff η hη

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hB hG
  have nbdir : ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (F : Cyl → ℝ) (w : Cyl), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → ∀ k : ℕ,
      NB h (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm h ξ w)) k ξ ≤ ‖w‖ * NB h F (k + 1) ξ := by
    intro h U ξ F w hU hξ hF k
    have hFd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) ξ :=
      (hF.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)
    have hcomp : (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm h ξ w)) =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ (Lnorm h ξ w)) ∘ (fderiv ℝ F) := by
      funext η; rfl
    have hit : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => fderiv ℝ F η (Lnorm h ξ w)) ξ =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ (Lnorm h ξ w)).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ F) ξ) := by
      rw [hcomp]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left _ hFd (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hNB0 : 0 ≤ NB h F (k + 1) ξ := norm_nonneg _
    unfold NB
    rw [hit]
    apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hNB0)
    intro m
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply]
    have key : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fderiv ℝ F) ξ (fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m i))) (Lnorm h ξ w) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ))
          (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w) := by
      rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right]
      have e1 : Fin.init (fun i : Fin (k+1) => Lnorm h ξ (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i)) =
          fun i => Lnorm h ξ (m i) := by
        funext i
        simp [Fin.init, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      rw [e1]
      simp only [Fin.snoc_last]
    rw [key]
    have hprod : ∏ i : Fin (k+1), ‖Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i‖ =
        (∏ i : Fin k, ‖m i‖) * ‖w‖ := by
      rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
      simp [Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ *
          ∏ i : Fin (k+1), ‖Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Cyl) m w i‖ :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ = ‖w‖ * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k+1) F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ *
          ∏ i : Fin k, ‖m i‖ := by rw [hprod]; ring
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hB.2.1
  obtain ⟨hr0, hr01, hus, -, -⟩ := hG.1
  obtain ⟨l2, cr, Cr, hcr, hR⟩ := rep_consts_v5 B G hB hG
  obtain ⟨l5, C5, hV⟩ := vco_nb_v5 B hB
  obtain ⟨l12, hP12⟩ := slow_profile_dir_nb_v5 B hB
  choose C12 hC12 using hP12
  obtain ⟨l3, hP3⟩ := chart_profile_nb_v5 B hB
  choose C3 hC3 using hP3
  obtain ⟨hU0s, hU0b⟩ := chart_radial_nb_v5 B hB
  choose C0 hC0 using hU0b
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  obtain ⟨hΩo, hBsm⟩ := geom_slow_base_smooth_v5 B hB
  set Ω : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) := {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}
    with hΩ
  refine ⟨l2 + l5 + l12 + l3 + n0, fun k => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
      (|C12 j| + 4 * |C3 (j + 1)| + |C3 j| + |C0 j|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCM : ∀ j, j ≤ k → |C12 j| + 4 * |C3 (j + 1)| + |C3 j| + |C0 j| ≤ M := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hM]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |C12 j| + 4 * |C3 (j + 1)| + |C3 j| + |C0 j|)
      (fun i _ => by positivity) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (by positivity) (hCM 0 (Nat.zero_le _))
  have hC12M : ∀ j, j ≤ k → |C12 j| ≤ M := by
    intro j hj
    have h1 := hCM j hj
    have h2 := abs_nonneg (C3 (j + 1))
    have h3 := abs_nonneg (C3 j)
    have h4 := abs_nonneg (C0 j)
    linarith
  have hC3sM : ∀ j, j ≤ k → 4 * |C3 (j + 1)| ≤ M := by
    intro j hj
    have h1 := hCM j hj
    have h2 := abs_nonneg (C12 j)
    have h3 := abs_nonneg (C3 j)
    have h4 := abs_nonneg (C0 j)
    linarith
  have hC3M : ∀ j, j ≤ k → |C3 j| ≤ M := by
    intro j hj
    have h1 := hCM j hj
    have h2 := abs_nonneg (C12 j)
    have h3 := abs_nonneg (C3 (j + 1))
    have h4 := abs_nonneg (C0 j)
    linarith
  have hC0M : ∀ j, j ≤ k → |C0 j| ≤ M := by
    intro j hj
    have h1 := hCM j hj
    have h2 := abs_nonneg (C12 j)
    have h3 := abs_nonneg (C3 (j + 1))
    have h4 := abs_nonneg (C3 j)
    linarith
  obtain ⟨K1, hK1⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = 2 ^ k * M * (2 * |Cr| * M) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hK10 : 0 ≤ K1 := by rw [hK1]; positivity
  obtain ⟨MX, hMX⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = 2 * |Cr| * M + 5 * K1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hMX0 : 0 ≤ MX := by rw [hMX]; positivity
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = |Cr| * (G.ustar / 2) * M + 2 ^ k * (4 * |C5|) * MX := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
  intro l0 γ ξ U a c hl0 hA hlγ hξ hq1 hq2 hX1 hX2 hxi het hUo hξU hUsub hloc
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0.le
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hQb]; exact pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hξB : ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB := ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ.2.2 hqsB⟩
  have hUsubB : U ⊆ DomC B.h B.qB := fun η hη =>
    ⟨(hUsub hη).1, (hUsub hη).2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le (hUsub hη).2.2 hqsB⟩
  have hUn : U ∈ nhds ξ := hUo.mem_nhds hξU
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hB.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ.2.1])).1
  have hqne : qC B.h ξ ≠ 0 := hq0.ne'
  have hqlt1 : qC B.h ξ < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hξ.2.2 hqs1
  have hS1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
    unfold SC
    have : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| := by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))]
    exact one_le_pow₀ this
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by linarith
  have hqh0 : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ B.h := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
  have hQ : 0 < Qb γ.1 := by unfold Qb; positivity
  have hl2 : (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * SC B.h ξ := by
    have hlt : qC B.h ξ < 4 * Qb γ.1 := by
      have := (div_lt_iff₀ hQ).mp hq2
      linarith
    have hlog : Real.log (qC B.h ξ) < Real.log (4 * Qb γ.1) := Real.log_lt_log hq0 hlt
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hQ.ne'] at hlog
    have hQlog : Real.log (Qb γ.1) = -(γ.1 : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by
      unfold Qb
      rw [Real.log_rpow (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)]
    have h4 : Real.log 4 = 2 * Real.log 2 := by
      rw [show (4:ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]
      norm_num
    have hneg : Real.log (qC B.h ξ) < 0 := Real.log_neg hq0 hqlt1
    have hl2g : (1:ℝ) / 2 < Real.log 2 := by
      have := Real.log_two_gt_d9
      linarith
    obtain ⟨a', ha⟩ : ∃ a' : ℝ, a' = |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have habs : a' = -Real.log (qC B.h ξ) := by rw [ha]; exact abs_of_neg hneg
    have ha0 : 0 < a' := by linarith
    have hl0' : (0:ℝ) ≤ (γ.1 : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have key : (γ.1 : ℝ) * Real.log 2 < 2 * Real.log 2 + a' := by
      rw [hQlog, h4] at hlog
      linarith
    have hlt2 : (γ.1 : ℝ) < 2 * (1 + a') := by
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      have h5 : 2 * (1 + a') * Real.log 2 ≤ (γ.1 : ℝ) * Real.log 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (by linarith)
      nlinarith [mul_pos ha0 (sub_pos.mpr hl2g)]
    unfold SC
