      have h2 : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) := by fun_prop
      refine h1.comp h2.continuousOn ?_
      intro ξ hξ
      exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by
        linarith [(show 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 from hξ).2]⟩
    have := hcq.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := B.qB))
    convert this using 1
    ext ξ
    simp only [DomC, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Iio]
    tauto
  have hΩo : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} :=
    hDo.preimage (show Continuous (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => ((s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) : Cyl)) by
      fun_prop)
  have hT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => G.tH γ p.1 p.2)
      ({s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
    (hG.2.2.2.2.2.2 γ).mono (fun p hp => hp.1)
  have hc : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => G.tH γ p.1 p.2 i)
      ({s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
    fun i => contDiffOn_pi.mp hT i
  have hGγ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ =>
      (G.tH γ p.1 p.2 0) • ((G.tH γ p.1 p.2 1, G.tH γ p.1 p.2 2) : ℝ × ℝ))
      ({s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
    (hc 0).smul ((hc 1).prodMk (hc 2))
  have hw : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) v ^ 2) := by
    unfold psiT
    exact (Real.smoothTransition.continuous.comp
      ((continuous_const.sub ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).abs)).div_const _)).pow 2
  have hI : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..(Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1),
      psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) v ^ 2 • ((G.tH γ s v 0) • ((G.tH γ s v 1, G.tH γ s v 2) : ℝ × ℝ)))
      {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} :=
    contDiffOn_infty.mpr (fun n => leib _ (fun v : ℝ => psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) v ^ 2) 0
      (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) hΩo hw n _ hGγ)
  refine (hI.const_smul ((1 + bgc^2) / 2 * (∫ u in (-G.r0)..G.r0, chig G.r0 u ^ 2) * cib B.h γ.1)).congr
    (fun s _ => ?_)
  show Hcol B G γ s = ((1 + bgc^2) / 2 * (∫ u in (-G.r0)..G.r0, chig G.r0 u ^ 2) * cib B.h γ.1) •
    ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..(Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1),
      psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) v ^ 2 • ((G.tH γ s v 0) • ((G.tH γ s v 1, G.tH γ s v 2) : ℝ × ℝ))
  unfold Hcol
  congr 1
  refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun v _ => ?_)
  simp only [smul_smul]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 → NB B.h (qC B.h) i ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ

signature.name: nb_qC_le_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 → NB B.h (qC B.h) i ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ

proof.tactics:
by
  suffices tn : ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h < 1/100 → SimScaleProps h → ∀ (p : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ,
      ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → qC h ξ ≤ 1 → NB h (fun η => qC h η ^ p) k ξ ≤ C * qC h ξ ^ p by
    intro B hB k
    have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hB.1
    obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, -⟩ := hB.2.1
    choose Ci hCi using fun i : ℕ => tn B.h hh0 hh1 hS 1 i
    have hfun : (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ (1:ℝ)) = qC B.h := funext fun η => Real.rpow_one _
    obtain ⟨C, hCdef⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Ci j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := by rw [hCdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    refine ⟨C, hC0, fun i hi ξ hξ hq => ?_⟩
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
    have h1 := hCi i ξ hξ hq
    rw [hfun, Real.rpow_one] at h1
    have hCiC : Ci i ≤ C := by
      have h2 : |Ci i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Ci j| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Ci j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
      rw [hCdef]; exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) h2
    exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCiC hq0.le)
  
  intro h _ _ hS
  
  have hN : SimNorm h := by
    obtain ⟨hS1, -, -, -, hS5⟩ := hS
    open Pointwise in
    have hom : ∀ μ z τ : ℝ, 0 < μ →
        simScale h (μ ^ (1/2 - h) * z) (μ * τ) = μ * simScale h z τ := by
      intro μ z τ hμ
      have key : ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p → μ * p - (μ ^ (1/2 - h) * z) ^ 2 * (μ * p) ^ (2 * h) =
          μ * (p - z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h)) := by
        intro p hp
        have sq : (μ ^ (1/2 - h)) ^ 2 = μ ^ (1 - 2 * h) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hμ.le]
          congr 1
          push_cast
          ring
        have split : μ ^ (1 - 2 * h) * μ ^ (2 * h) = μ := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hμ]
          have e : 1 - 2 * h + 2 * h = 1 := by ring
          rw [e, Real.rpow_one]
        rw [mul_pow, sq, Real.mul_rpow hμ.le hp.le]
        linear_combination (-(z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h))) * split
      have hset : {q : ℝ | 0 < q ∧ μ * τ ≤ q - (μ ^ (1/2 - h) * z) ^ 2 * q ^ (2 * h)} =
          μ • {p : ℝ | 0 < p ∧ τ ≤ p - z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h)} := by
        ext q
        rw [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem₀ hμ.ne', smul_eq_mul]
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
        have hq : q = μ * (μ⁻¹ * q) := by field_simp
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hq0, hle⟩
          have hp : 0 < μ⁻¹ * q := mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hμ) hq0
          refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
          rw [hq, key _ hp] at hle
          exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hle hμ
        · rintro ⟨hp, hle⟩
          refine ⟨by rw [hq]; exact mul_pos hμ hp, ?_⟩
          rw [hq, key _ hp]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle hμ.le
      unfold simScale
      rw [hset, Real.sInf_smul_of_nonneg hμ.le, smul_eq_mul]
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z T : ℝ, 0 < T → simScale h Z T = 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (Z, T)‖ ≤ C := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk | hk
      · subst hk
        refine ⟨1, fun Z T _ h1 => ?_⟩
        rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]
        show ‖simScale h Z T‖ ≤ 1
        rw [h1, norm_one]
      · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hS5 k hk
        refine ⟨C, fun Z T hT h1 => ?_⟩
        have := hC Z T hT h1.le
        rwa [h1, Real.one_rpow, mul_one] at this
    refine ⟨C, fun z τ hτ _ => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hQ0, -⟩ := hS1 z τ hτ
    obtain ⟨Q, hQd⟩ : ∃ Q, Q = simScale h z τ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hQd] at hQ0 ⊢
    obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ : ∃ Z : ℝ, Z = Q ^ (-(1/2 - h)) * z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ, T = Q⁻¹ * τ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hT0 : 0 < T := by rw [hT]; exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hQ0) hτ
    have hZT : simScale h Z T = 1 := by
      have := hom Q⁻¹ z τ (inv_pos.mpr hQ0)
      rw [Real.inv_rpow hQ0.le, ← Real.rpow_neg hQ0.le, ← hQd, inv_mul_cancel₀ hQ0.ne'] at this
      rw [hZ, hT]
      exact this
    have hzb : Q ^ (1/2 - h) * Z = z := by
      rw [hZ, ← mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hQ0]
      simp
    have hτb : Q * T = τ := by
      rw [hT]
      exact mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hQ0.ne' τ
    have hpa : 0 < Q ^ (1/2 - h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ0 _
    let e₁ : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 (Q ^ (1/2 - h)) hpa.ne')
    let e₂ : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 Q hQ0.ne')
    let L : (ℝ × ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) := e₁.prodCongr e₂
    let M : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 Q hQ0.ne')
    have hL : ∀ x : ℝ × ℝ, L x = (Q ^ (1/2 - h) * x.1, Q * x.2) := by
      intro x
      simp [L, e₁, e₂, mul_comm]
    have hM : ∀ y : ℝ, M y = Q * y := by
      intro y
      simp [M, mul_comm]
    have hfun : (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘ L =
        M ∘ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) := by
      funext w
      simp only [Function.comp, hL, hM]
      exact hom Q w.1 w.2 hQ0
    have hLclm : (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)) =
        (Q ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (Q • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro x
      apply Prod.ext
      · simp [hL]
      · simp [hL]
    have hLv : L (Z, T) = (z, τ) := by
      rw [hL]
      exact Prod.ext hzb hτb
    have hcomp : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘ L) (Z, T) =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (L (Z, T))).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ))) := by
      have := L.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2)
        uniqueDiffOn_univ (mem_univ (L (Z, T))) k
      rwa [preimage_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ] at this
    have key : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (z, τ)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ))) =
        (M : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (Z, T)) := by
      rw [← hLv, ← hcomp, hfun, M.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left]
    have hMn : ‖(M : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ ≤ Q := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hQ0.le fun y => ?_
      show ‖M y‖ ≤ Q * ‖y‖
      rw [hM, norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs Q, abs_of_pos hQ0]
    rw [← hLclm, key]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(M : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ *
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (Z, T)‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
      _ ≤ Q * C := mul_le_mul hMn (hC Z T hT0 hZT) (norm_nonneg _) hQ0.le
      _ = C * Q := mul_comm _ _
  
  intro c j
  unfold SimNorm at hN
  choose C hC using hN
  have key : ∀ {E G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup G]
      [NormedSpace ℝ G] (F : E → G) (V : Set E) (a : E) (T : Cyl →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → a ∈ V → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro E G _ _ _ _ F V a T hV hF ha i
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set E, s = (fun z : E => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : E) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
    have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ,
      A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |Polynomial.eval c (descPochhammer ℝ i)| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by rw [hAdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |C i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by
    have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k (_ : k ∈ Finset.range (j + 1)) => abs_nonneg (C k))
    rw [hDdef]; linarith
  refine ⟨(j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j, ?_⟩
  intro ξ hξ hq1
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC h η) {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      (contDiff_snd.fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
    exact h1.comp h2.contDiffOn (fun η (hη : η.2.2.1 < 1) =>
      ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith)⟩)
  have hqpos : ∀ η : Cyl, η.2.2.1 < 1 → 0 < qC h η := fun η h' =>
    (hS.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hq0 : 0 < qC h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
  have hU : IsOpen {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd.snd.fst continuous_const
  obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : Cyl → ℝ, F = fun η : Cyl => qC h η ^ c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨a, hadef⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = qC h ξ ^ c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  suffices hmain : NB h F j ξ ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j * a by
    rw [hFdef, hadef] at hmain; exact hmain
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by rw [hadef]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
  have hFU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    rw [hFdef]
    exact hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos η hη).ne')
  obtain ⟨Pm, hPmdef⟩ : ∃ Pm : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
      Pm = ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))).prod
        (-((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPapp : ∀ η : Cyl, Pm η = (η.2.1, -η.2.2.1) := by
    intro η; rw [hPmdef]; simp
  have hP1 : ‖Pm‖ ≤ 1 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun η => ?_)
    rw [hPapp η, one_mul, Prod.norm_def (η.2.1, -η.2.2.1)]
    refine max_le ?_ ?_
    · exact (norm_fst_le η.2).trans (norm_snd_le η)
    · exact (norm_neg η.2.2.1).trans_le
        (((norm_fst_le η.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le η.2)).trans (norm_snd_le η))
  obtain ⟨Mq, hMqdef⟩ : ∃ Mq : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
      Mq = (qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
        (qC h ξ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ, T = Mq.comp Pm := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨w0, hw0def⟩ : ∃ w0 : ℝ × ℝ, w0 = (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hW : IsOpen (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
  have hw0 : w0 ∈ (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := by
    rw [hw0def]; exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
  have hid : ∀ v : Cyl, qC h (ξ + Lnorm h ξ v) = simScale h (w0 + T v).1 (w0 + T v).2 := by
    intro v
    have e1 : (Lnorm h ξ v).2.1 = qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) * v.2.1 := by
      simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
    have e2 : (Lnorm h ξ v).2.2.1 = qC h ξ * v.2.2.1 := by
      simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
    have e3 : T v = (qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) * v.2.1, qC h ξ * (-v.2.2.1)) := by
      rw [hTdef, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hPapp v, hMqdef]
      simp [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
    rw [e3, hw0def]
    show simScale h (ξ.2.1 + (Lnorm h ξ v).2.1) (1 - (ξ.2.2.1 + (Lnorm h ξ v).2.2.1)) =
      simScale h (ξ.2.1 + qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) * v.2.1) ((1 - ξ.2.2.1) + qC h ξ * (-v.2.2.1))
    rw [e1, e2]
    congr 1
    ring
  obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set Cyl, O = {v : Cyl | (ξ + Lnorm h ξ v).2.2.1 < 1} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hOmem : ∀ v, v ∈ O ↔ (ξ + Lnorm h ξ v).2.2.1 < 1 := by
    intro v; rw [hOdef]; rfl
  have hcontO : Continuous (fun v : Cyl => (ξ + Lnorm h ξ v).2.2.1) :=
    ((continuous_const.add (Lnorm h ξ).continuous).snd.snd.fst)
  have hO : IsOpen O := by rw [hOdef]; exact isOpen_lt hcontO continuous_const
  have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ O := by
    rw [hOmem, map_zero, add_zero]; exact hξ
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψdef⟩ : ∃ ψ : Cyl → ℝ, ψ = fun v => qC h (ξ + Lnorm h ξ v) / qC h ξ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ O := by
    rw [hψdef]
    exact (hqC.comp (contDiff_const.add (Lnorm h ξ).contDiff).contDiffOn
      (fun v hv => (hOmem v).1 hv)).div_const _
  have hψpos : ∀ v ∈ O, 0 < ψ v := by
    intro v hv; rw [hψdef]; exact div_pos (hqpos _ ((hOmem v).1 hv)) hq0
  have hψ0 : ψ 0 = 1 := by
    rw [hψdef]
    show qC h (ξ + Lnorm h ξ 0) / qC h ξ = 1
    rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact div_self hq0.ne'
  have hψeq : ψ = (qC h ξ)⁻¹ • (fun z : Cyl => simScale h (w0 + T z).1 (w0 + T z).2) := by
    rw [hψdef]; funext v
    show qC h (ξ + Lnorm h ξ v) / qC h ξ =
      (qC h ξ)⁻¹ * simScale h (w0 + T v).1 (w0 + T v).2
    rw [hid v, div_eq_inv_mul]
  have hΦ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : Cyl => simScale h (w0 + T z).1 (w0 + T z).2) 0 := by
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (w0 + T 0) := by
      rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact hS.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hw0)
    exact ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (f := fun z : Cyl => w0 + T z)
      (0 : Cyl) h1 (contDiff_const.add T.contDiff).contDiffAt
  have hDψ : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ j → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ψ O 0‖ ≤ D ^ i := by
    intro i hi1 hij
    have hcomp : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Mq.comp Pm) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Mq)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Pm) := by
      ext m; rfl
    have hCi : ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Mq)‖ ≤ C i * qC h ξ := by
      rw [hMqdef, hw0def]; exact hC i ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith) hq1
    have hprod : ∏ k : Fin i, ‖Pm‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hP1
    have hb1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Mq)) (fun _ : Fin i => Pm)
    have hb2 := hb1.trans ((mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) hprod).trans hCi)
    have hCiD : C i ≤ D := by
      have h2 : |C i| ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |C k| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => |C k|) (fun k _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hij))
      have h3 := le_abs_self (C i)
      rw [hDdef]; linarith
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO h0O, hψeq,
      iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply (hΦ.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)),
      key (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) w0 T hW hS.2.2.2.1 hw0 i,
      norm_smul, hTdef, hcomp, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le)]
    calc (qC h ξ)⁻¹ * ‖((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Mq)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Pm)‖
        ≤ (qC h ξ)⁻¹ * (C i * qC h ξ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb2 (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le)
      _ = C i := by rw [mul_comm (C i), ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0.ne', one_mul]
      _ ≤ D := hCiD
      _ ≤ D ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
  have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    (contDiffOn_id (s := Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))).rpow_const_of_ne (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
  have hψmaps : Set.MapsTo ψ O (Set.Ioi 0) := fun v hv => hψpos v hv
  have hCg : ∀ i ≤ j, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) (Set.Ioi 0) (ψ 0)‖ ≤ A := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hψ0, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i isOpen_Ioi (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (zero_lt_one' ℝ)),
      norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate,
      Real.iter_deriv_rpow_const, Real.one_rpow, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, hAdef]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Polynomial.eval c (descPochhammer ℝ i)|)
      (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
  have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hg hψ (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn hO.uniqueDiffOn hψmaps h0O (C := A) (D := D) hCg hDψ
  obtain ⟨gl, hgldef⟩ : ∃ gl : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ, gl = a • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hgl : ‖gl‖ ≤ a := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ ha0 (fun x => le_of_eq (by
    rw [hgldef, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, norm_smul,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg ha0]))
  have hEq : Set.EqOn (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z)) (⇑gl ∘ ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) ∘ ψ)) O := by
    intro z hz
    have hψz := hψpos z hz
    have e : qC h (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z) = qC h ξ * ψ z := by
      rw [hψdef]
      show _ = qC h ξ * (qC h (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z) / qC h ξ)
      field_simp
    show F (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z) = gl (ψ z ^ c)
    rw [hFdef, hgldef, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    show qC h (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z) ^ c = a * ψ z ^ c
    rw [e, Real.mul_rpow hq0.le hψz.le, ← hadef]
  have hgψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) ∘ ψ) O := hg.comp hψ hψmaps
  have hNB : NB h F j ξ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z)) 0‖ := by
    unfold NB
    rw [key F {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} ξ (Lnorm h ξ) hU hFU hξ j]
  calc NB h F j ξ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z)) 0‖ := hNB
    _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z)) O 0‖ := by
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hO h0O]
    _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j (⇑gl ∘ ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) ∘ ψ)) O 0‖ := by
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_congr hEq h0O j]
    _ = ‖gl.compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) ∘ ψ) O 0)‖ := by
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_left gl (hgψ.contDiffWithinAt h0O)
          hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O (i := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)]
    _ ≤ ‖gl‖ * ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) ∘ ψ) O 0‖ :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
    _ ≤ a * ((j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j) := mul_le_mul hgl hFdB (norm_nonneg _) ha0
    _ = (j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j * a := by ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (p : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (y : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (A : ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ y U → (∀ η ∈ U, 0 < y η) → ξ ∈ U → 0 ≤ A → (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → NB h y i ξ ≤ A) → ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB h (fun η => y η ^ p) j ξ ≤ K * y ξ ^ p * (1 + A / y ξ) ^ k

signature.name: nb_rpow_bound_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (p : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (y : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (A : ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ y U → (∀ η ∈ U, 0 < y η) → ξ ∈ U → 0 ≤ A → (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → NB h y i ξ ≤ A) → ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB h (fun η => y η ^ p) j ξ ≤ K * y ξ ^ p * (1 + A / y ξ) ^ k

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have key : ∀ {E F W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F]
      [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (G : F → W) (T : E →L[ℝ] F) (a : F)
      (V' : Set F) (i : ℕ), IsOpen V' → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G V' → a + T 0 ∈ V' →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => G (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G (a + T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro E F W _ _ _ _ _ _ G T a V' i hV' hF ha
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set F, s = (fun z => a + z) ⁻¹' V' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV'.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hOT : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have hAs : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [hs_def]; exact ha
    have hxO : (0:E) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hAs
    have hsm' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => G (a + T z)) i hOT hxO
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm' hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hOT.uniqueDiffOn hAs (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => G (a + z)) i hs hAs
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := G) i a (T 0)
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => G (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => G (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => G (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => G (a + z)) (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G (a + T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4]
  
  intro p k
  obtain ⟨Cp, hCp⟩ : ∃ Cp : ℝ, Cp = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun t : ℝ => t ^ p) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) 1‖ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCp0 : 0 ≤ Cp := by rw [hCp]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
  have hCpi : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k →
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun t : ℝ => t ^ p) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) 1‖ ≤ Cp := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hCp]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum
      (f := fun i => ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun t : ℝ => t ^ p) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) 1‖)
      (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
  refine ⟨(k.factorial : ℝ) * Cp, mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hCp0, ?_⟩
  intro h U y ξ A hU hy hpos hξ hA hNB j hj
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl, L = Lnorm h ξ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hy0 : 0 < y ξ := hpos ξ hξ
  have hyi : 0 < (y ξ)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hy0
  have hξ' : ξ + L 0 ∈ U := by rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact hξ
  
  obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set Cyl, O = (fun z => ξ + L z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hOo : IsOpen O := by rw [hOdef]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add L.continuous)
  have h0O : (0:Cyl) ∈ O := by rw [hOdef]; exact hξ'
  have hOU : ∀ z ∈ O, ξ + L z ∈ U := by intro z hz; rw [hOdef] at hz; exact hz
  have hYO : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => y (ξ + L z)) O :=
    hy.comp (contDiff_const.add L.contDiff).contDiffOn (fun z hz => hOU z hz)
  
  have hK1 : ∀ i : ℕ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => y (ξ + L z)) 0‖ = NB h y i ξ := by
    intro i
    have e := key y L ξ U i hU hy hξ'
    rw [map_zero, add_zero] at e
    unfold NB
    rw [← hL, e]
  have hyp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => y η ^ p) U :=
    hy.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hpos η hη).ne')
  have hK2 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z => y (ξ + L z) ^ p) 0‖ = NB h (fun η => y η ^ p) j ξ := by
    have e : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z => y (ξ + L z) ^ p) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => y η ^ p) (ξ + L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) :=
      key (fun η => y η ^ p) L ξ U j hU hyp hξ'
    rw [map_zero, add_zero] at e
    unfold NB
    rw [← hL, e]
  
  obtain ⟨u, hudef⟩ : ∃ u : Cyl → ℝ, u = fun z => (y ξ)⁻¹ * y (ξ + L z) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have huO : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u O := by rw [hudef]; exact contDiffOn_const.mul hYO
  have hupos : ∀ z ∈ O, 0 < u z := by
    intro z hz; rw [hudef]; exact mul_pos hyi (hpos _ (hOU z hz))
  have hu0 : u 0 = 1 := by
    rw [hudef]
    show (y ξ)⁻¹ * y (ξ + L 0) = 1
    rw [map_zero, add_zero, inv_mul_cancel₀ hy0.ne']
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo u O (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) := fun z hz => hupos z hz
  have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun t : ℝ => t ^ p) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) :=
    contDiffOn_id.rpow_const_of_ne (fun t ht => (Set.mem_Ioi.mp ht).ne')
  have hueq : u = (y ξ)⁻¹ • (fun z => y (ξ + L z)) := by
    funext z; rw [hudef]; rfl
  have hYat : ∀ i : ℕ, ContDiffAt ℝ i (fun z => y (ξ + L z)) 0 :=
    fun i => (hYO.contDiffAt (hOo.mem_nhds h0O)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hAy : 0 ≤ A / y ξ := div_nonneg hA hy0.le
  have hD1 : 1 ≤ 1 + A / y ξ := by linarith
  have hDu : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ j →
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i u O 0‖ ≤ (1 + A / y ξ) ^ i := by
    intro i hi1 hij
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := u) i hOo h0O, hueq,
      iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply (hYat i), norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos hyi, hK1 i]
    have hb := hNB i hi1 (le_trans hij hj)
    calc (y ξ)⁻¹ * NB h y i ξ ≤ (y ξ)⁻¹ * A := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hyi.le
      _ = A / y ξ := by rw [div_eq_inv_mul]
      _ ≤ 1 + A / y ξ := by linarith
      _ ≤ (1 + A / y ξ) ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
  have hC : ∀ i ≤ j,
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun t : ℝ => t ^ p) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) (u 0)‖ ≤ Cp := by
    intro i hi; rw [hu0]; exact hCpi i (le_trans hi hj)
  
  have hF := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le (n := j) hg huO (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn hOo.uniqueDiffOn hmaps h0O hC hDu
  
  have hev : (fun z => y (ξ + L z) ^ p) =ᶠ[nhds (0:Cyl)]
      (y ξ ^ p) • ((fun t : ℝ => t ^ p) ∘ u) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hOo.mem_nhds h0O) (fun z hz => by
      have hYz : 0 < y (ξ + L z) := hpos _ (hOU z hz)
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, Function.comp_apply, hudef, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [← Real.mul_rpow hy0.le (mul_nonneg hyi.le hYz.le), mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hy0.ne'])
  have hgu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((fun t : ℝ => t ^ p) ∘ u) O := hg.comp huO hmaps
  have hguat : ContDiffAt ℝ j ((fun t : ℝ => t ^ p) ∘ u) 0 :=
    (hgu.contDiffAt (hOo.mem_nhds h0O)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hyp0 : 0 ≤ y ξ ^ p := Real.rpow_nonneg hy0.le p
  rw [← hK2, (hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply hguat,
    norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hyp0,
    ← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := (fun t : ℝ => t ^ p) ∘ u) j hOo h0O]
  have hfj : (j.factorial : ℝ) ≤ k.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le hj
  have hDj : (1 + A / y ξ) ^ j ≤ (1 + A / y ξ) ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ hD1 hj
  have hDj0 : 0 ≤ (1 + A / y ξ) ^ j := pow_nonneg (by linarith) _
  have h2 : (j.factorial : ℝ) * Cp * (1 + A / y ξ) ^ j ≤
      (k.factorial : ℝ) * Cp * (1 + A / y ξ) ^ k :=
    mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfj hCp0) hDj hDj0
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hCp0)
  refine le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hF hyp0) ?_
  refine le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hyp0) (le_of_eq ?_)
  ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (k : ℕ) (σ : Bool) (K aQ aR aP aS1 aS2 : ℝ) (Q R S1 S2 : Cyl → ℝ) (P : Cyl → (ℝ × ℝ) × (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Q U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ R U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ S1 U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ S2 U → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h Q i ξ ≤ aQ) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h R i ξ ≤ aR) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h P i ξ ≤ aP) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h S1 i ξ ≤ aS1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h S2 i ξ ≤ aS2) → NB h (fun η => K * (Q η * (if σ then (P η).2.2 * S2 η - (P η).2.1 * S1 η else (P η).1.1 * S1 η - (P η).1.2 * S2 η) * R η)) k ξ ≤ |K| * 4 ^ k * aQ * aP * (aS1 + aS2) * aR

signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (k : ℕ) (σ : Bool) (K aQ aR aP aS1 aS2 : ℝ) (Q R S1 S2 : Cyl → ℝ) (P : Cyl → (ℝ × ℝ) × (ℝ × ℝ)), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Q U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ R U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ S1 U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ S2 U → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h Q i ξ ≤ aQ) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h R i ξ ≤ aR) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h P i ξ ≤ aP) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h S1 i ξ ≤ aS1) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h S2 i ξ ≤ aS2) → NB h (fun η => K * (Q η * (if σ then (P η).2.2 * S2 η - (P η).2.1 * S1 η else (P η).1.1 * S1 η - (P η).1.2 * S2 η) * R η)) k ξ ≤ |K| * 4 ^ k * aQ * aP * (aS1 + aS2) * aR

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h U ξ k σ K aQ aR aP aS1 aS2 Q R S1 S2 P hU hξ hQ hR hP hS1 hS2 HQ HR HP HS1 HS2
  have hUn : U ∈ nhds ξ := hU.mem_nhds hξ
  have nbnn : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V) (j : ℕ),
      0 ≤ NB h f j ξ := by
    intro V _ _ f j
    unfold NB
    exact norm_nonneg _
  have clm : ∀ {V V' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup V']
      [NormedSpace ℝ V'] (L : V →L[ℝ] V') (f : Cyl → V) (j : ℕ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ →
      NB h (fun η => L (f η)) j ξ ≤ ‖L‖ * NB h f j ξ := by
    intro V V' _ _ _ _ L f j hf
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (⇑L ∘ f) ξ = L.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ) :=
      L.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left hf (i := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e0 : (fun η => L (f η)) = ⇑L ∘ f := rfl
    unfold NB
    rw [e0, e1]
    have e2 : (L.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) =
        L.compContinuousMultilinearMap ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)) := by
      ext v
      rfl
    rw [e2]
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
  have sub : ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ) (j : ℕ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g ξ →
      NB h (fun η => f η - g η) j ξ ≤ NB h f j ξ + NB h g j ξ := by
    intro f g j hf hg
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (f - g) ξ = iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ - iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g ξ :=
      iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply (hf.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)) (hg.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    have e0 : (fun η => f η - g η) = f - g := rfl
    unfold NB
    rw [e0, e1]
    have e2 : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ - iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) -
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) := by
      ext v
      rfl
    rw [e2]
    exact norm_sub_le _ _
  
  have leib : ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → ∀ kk : ℕ,
      NB h (fun η => f η * g η) kk ξ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (kk + 1), (kk.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h g (kk - i) ξ := by
    intro f g hf hg kk
    unfold NB
    generalize Lnorm h ξ = L
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage L.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
    have hL0s : L 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
    have hsm : ∀ F : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
      intro F hF
      exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have hsmO : ∀ F : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by
      intro F hF
      exact (hsm F hF).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
    have key : ∀ F : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → ∀ i : ℕ,
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0 =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
      intro F hF i
      have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O
      have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
        hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + z)) i hs h0s
      have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i ξ 0
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0
          = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑L) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := e2
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [map_zero]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [e3]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
    have hfg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => f η * g η) U := hf.mul hg
    have leib0 := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le (hsmO f hf) (hsmO g hg) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O
      (n := kk) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => f (ξ + L y) * g (ξ + L y)) kk hO h0O] at leib0
    rw [← key _ hfg kk]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ kk (fun z => (fun η => f η * g η) (ξ + L z)) 0‖
        = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ kk (fun y => f (ξ + L y) * g (ξ + L y)) 0‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ _ := leib0
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O,
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => g (ξ + L z)) (kk - i) hO h0O,
          key f hf i, key g hg (kk - i)]
  
  have mulu : ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ) (X Y : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → 0 ≤ X →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h f i ξ ≤ X) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h g i ξ ≤ Y) → ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k →
      NB h (fun η => f η * g η) j ξ ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ j * X * Y := by
    intro f g X Y hf hg hX hbf hbg j hj
    refine (leib f g hf hg j).trans ?_
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h g (j - i) ξ
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) * X * Y := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          have hi' : i ≤ j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          have h1 := hbf i (by omega)
          have h2 := hbg (j - i) (by omega)
          have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ (j.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hc) h2 (nbnn g (j - i)) (mul_nonneg hc hX)
      _ = (2:ℝ) ^ j * X * Y := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul]
          congr 2
          exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose j
  
  have cmul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ) (j : ℕ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ →
      NB h (fun η => c * f η) j ξ ≤ |c| * NB h f j ξ := by
    intro c f j hf
    have e := clm (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ c) f j hf
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply'] at e
    have hn : ‖ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ c‖ ≤ |c| := by
      have := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_mul_apply_le ℝ ℝ c
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    exact e.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hn (nbnn f j))
  
  have prj : ∀ (L : (ℝ × ℝ) × (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (j : ℕ), (∀ x, ‖L x‖ ≤ ‖x‖) →
      NB h (fun η => L (P η)) j ξ ≤ NB h P j ξ := by
    intro L j hx
    have hL : ‖L‖ ≤ 1 := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun x => by
      rw [one_mul]; exact hx x)
    exact (clm L P j (hP.contDiffAt hUn)).trans (mul_le_of_le_one_left (nbnn P j) hL)
  have b11 : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB h (fun η => (P η).1.1) j ξ ≤ aP := fun j hj =>
    (prj ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) (ℝ × ℝ))) j
      (fun x => (norm_fst_le x.1).trans (norm_fst_le x))).trans (HP j hj)
  have b12 : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB h (fun η => (P η).1.2) j ξ ≤ aP := fun j hj =>
    (prj ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) (ℝ × ℝ))) j
      (fun x => (norm_snd_le x.1).trans (norm_fst_le x))).trans (HP j hj)
  have b21 : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB h (fun η => (P η).2.1) j ξ ≤ aP := fun j hj =>
    (prj ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) (ℝ × ℝ))) j
      (fun x => (norm_fst_le x.2).trans (norm_snd_le x))).trans (HP j hj)
  have b22 : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB h (fun η => (P η).2.2) j ξ ≤ aP := fun j hj =>
    (prj ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) (ℝ × ℝ))) j
      (fun x => (norm_snd_le x.2).trans (norm_snd_le x))).trans (HP j hj)
  have hQ0 : 0 ≤ aQ := (nbnn Q 0).trans (HQ 0 (Nat.zero_le _))
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ aR := (nbnn R 0).trans (HR 0 (Nat.zero_le _))
  have hP0 : 0 ≤ aP := (nbnn P 0).trans (HP 0 (Nat.zero_le _))
  
  have main : ∀ (A X B Y : Cyl → ℝ) (x y : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ X U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ B U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Y U → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h A i ξ ≤ aP) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h X i ξ ≤ x) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h B i ξ ≤ aP) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h Y i ξ ≤ y) →
      NB h (fun η => K * (Q η * (A η * X η - B η * Y η) * R η)) k ξ ≤
        |K| * 4 ^ k * aQ * aP * (x + y) * aR := by
    intro A X B Y x y hA hX hB hY bA bX bB bY
    have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := (nbnn X 0).trans (bX 0 (Nat.zero_le _))
    have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := (nbnn Y 0).trans (bY 0 (Nat.zero_le _))
    have hAX : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => A η * X η) U := hA.mul hX
    have hBY : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => B η * Y η) U := hB.mul hY
    have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => A η * X η - B η * Y η) U := hAX.sub hBY
    have hQD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => Q η * (A η * X η - B η * Y η)) U := hQ.mul hD
    have hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => Q η * (A η * X η - B η * Y η) * R η) U := hQD.mul hR
    have bD : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ k → NB h (fun η => A η * X η - B η * Y η) n ξ ≤
        (2:ℝ) ^ n * (aP * (x + y)) := by
      intro n hn
      calc NB h (fun η => A η * X η - B η * Y η) n ξ
          ≤ NB h (fun η => A η * X η) n ξ + NB h (fun η => B η * Y η) n ξ :=
            sub _ _ n (hAX.contDiffAt hUn) (hBY.contDiffAt hUn)
        _ ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ n * aP * x + (2:ℝ) ^ n * aP * y :=
            add_le_add (mulu A X aP x hA hX hP0 bA bX n hn) (mulu B Y aP y hB hY hP0 bB bY n hn)
        _ = (2:ℝ) ^ n * (aP * (x + y)) := by ring
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ aQ * (aP * (x + y)) := mul_nonneg hQ0 (mul_nonneg hP0 (add_nonneg hx0 hy0))
    have bQD : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ k → NB h (fun η => Q η * (A η * X η - B η * Y η)) n ξ ≤
        (3:ℝ) ^ n * (aQ * (aP * (x + y))) := by
      intro n hn
      refine (leib Q _ hQ hD n).trans ?_
      calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * NB h Q i ξ *
            NB h (fun η => A η * X η - B η * Y η) (n - i) ξ
          ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * aQ * ((2:ℝ) ^ (n - i) * (aP * (x + y))) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro i hi
            have hi' : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
            have h1 := HQ i (by omega)
            have h2 := bD (n - i) (by omega)
            have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ (n.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
            exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hc) h2 (nbnn _ (n - i)) (mul_nonneg hc hQ0)
        _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (aQ * (aP * (x + y))) *
              ((1:ℝ) ^ i * (2:ℝ) ^ (n - i) * (n.choose i : ℝ)) :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
        _ = (aQ * (aP * (x + y))) * ((1:ℝ) + 2) ^ n := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← add_pow]
        _ = (3:ℝ) ^ n * (aQ * (aP * (x + y))) := by
            rw [show (1:ℝ) + 2 = 3 by norm_num]; ring
    have bF : NB h (fun η => Q η * (A η * X η - B η * Y η) * R η) k ξ ≤
        (4:ℝ) ^ k * (aQ * (aP * (x + y)) * aR) := by
      refine (leib (fun η => Q η * (A η * X η - B η * Y η)) R hQD hR k).trans ?_
      calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) *
            NB h (fun η => Q η * (A η * X η - B η * Y η)) i ξ * NB h R (k - i) ξ
          ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * ((3:ℝ) ^ i * (aQ * (aP * (x + y)))) * aR := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro i hi
            have hi' : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
            have h1 := bQD i hi'
            have h2 := HR (k - i) (by omega)
            have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
            exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hc) h2 (nbnn R (k - i))
              (mul_nonneg hc (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (by norm_num) i) hM0))
        _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (aQ * (aP * (x + y)) * aR) *
              ((3:ℝ) ^ i * (1:ℝ) ^ (k - i) * (k.choose i : ℝ)) :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
        _ = (aQ * (aP * (x + y)) * aR) * ((3:ℝ) + 1) ^ k := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← add_pow]
        _ = (4:ℝ) ^ k * (aQ * (aP * (x + y)) * aR) := by
            rw [show (3:ℝ) + 1 = 4 by norm_num]; ring
    calc NB h (fun η => K * (Q η * (A η * X η - B η * Y η) * R η)) k ξ
        ≤ |K| * NB h (fun η => Q η * (A η * X η - B η * Y η) * R η) k ξ :=
          cmul K _ k (hF.contDiffAt hUn)
      _ ≤ |K| * ((4:ℝ) ^ k * (aQ * (aP * (x + y)) * aR)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left bF (abs_nonneg K)
      _ = |K| * 4 ^ k * aQ * aP * (x + y) * aR := by ring
  have h11 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (P η).1.1) U := hP.fst.fst
  have h12 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (P η).1.2) U := hP.fst.snd
  have h21 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (P η).2.1) U := hP.snd.fst
  have h22 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (P η).2.2) U := hP.snd.snd
  cases σ
  · show NB h (fun η => K * (Q η * ((P η).1.1 * S1 η - (P η).1.2 * S2 η) * R η)) k ξ ≤
      |K| * 4 ^ k * aQ * aP * (aS1 + aS2) * aR
    exact main (fun η => (P η).1.1) S1 (fun η => (P η).1.2) S2 aS1 aS2 h11 hS1 h12 hS2 b11 HS1 b12 HS2
  · show NB h (fun η => K * (Q η * ((P η).2.2 * S2 η - (P η).2.1 * S1 η) * R η)) k ξ ≤
      |K| * 4 ^ k * aQ * aP * (aS1 + aS2) * aR
    rw [add_comm aS1 aS2]
    exact main (fun η => (P η).2.2) S2 (fun η => (P η).2.1) S1 aS2 aS1 h22 hS2 h21 hS1 b22 HS2 b21 HS1

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (γ : Lab) (η : Cyl), 0 < qC B.h η → 0 < yAmp4 B G γ η → Real.sqrt (epsb B.h γ.1) / 2 * sigAmp5 B G l0 S γ η = Qb γ.1 ^ (1 - B.h / 2) / 4 * (qC B.h η ^ (-1:ℝ) * (if γ.2.2 then ((hDetC B G γ η)⁻¹ • (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1), Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1))).2.2 * nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (sigE5 B G l0 S 2) η - ((hDetC B G γ η)⁻¹ • (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1), Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1))).2.1 * nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (sigE5 B G l0 S 1) η else ((hDetC B G γ η)⁻¹ • (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1), Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1))).1.1 * nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (sigE5 B G l0 S 1) η - ((hDetC B G γ η)⁻¹ • (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1), Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1))).1.2 * nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (sigE5 B G l0 S 2) η) * yAmp4 B G γ η ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)))

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (γ : Lab) (η : Cyl), 0 < qC B.h η → 0 < yAmp4 B G γ η → Real.sqrt (epsb B.h γ.1) / 2 * sigAmp5 B G l0 S γ η = Qb γ.1 ^ (1 - B.h / 2) / 4 * (qC B.h η ^ (-1:ℝ) * (if γ.2.2 then ((hDetC B G γ η)⁻¹ • (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1), Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1))).2.2 * nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (sigE5 B G l0 S 2) η - ((hDetC B G γ η)⁻¹ • (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1), Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1))).2.1 * nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (sigE5 B G l0 S 1) η else ((hDetC B G γ η)⁻¹ • (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1), Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1))).1.1 * nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (sigE5 B G l0 S 1) η - ((hDetC B G γ η)⁻¹ • (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1), Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1))).1.2 * nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (sigE5 B G l0 S 2) η) * yAmp4 B G γ η ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 S γ η hq hy
  have hQ : 0 < Qb γ.1 := by unfold Qb; positivity
  have K1 : Real.sqrt (epsb B.h γ.1) = Qb γ.1 ^ (B.h / 2) := by
    unfold epsb
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul hQ.le]
    congr 1
    ring
  have K2 : Qb γ.1 ^ (1 - B.h / 2) = Qb γ.1 ^ (B.h / 2) * Qb γ.1 * (epsb B.h γ.1)⁻¹ := by
    have e : (1 - B.h / 2) = B.h / 2 + 1 + (-B.h) := by ring
    rw [e, Real.rpow_add hQ, Real.rpow_add hQ, Real.rpow_one, Real.rpow_neg hQ.le]
    rfl
  have K3 : qC B.h η ^ (2 * B.h) = qC B.h η ^ (-1:ℝ) * qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]
    congr 1
    unfold Aex
    ring
  have K4 : yAmp4 B G γ η ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) = (Real.sqrt (yAmp4 B G γ η))⁻¹ := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hy.le, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  simp only [sigAmp5, sigPair5, nrm, hDetC, Prod.smul_mk, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [K1, K2, K3, K4]
  split_ifs <;> ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), l1 ≤ γ.1 → ActiveL4 B G γ → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) G.r0 ξ.2.2.2 → B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb → (∃ U : Set Cyl, IsOpen U ∧ ξ ∈ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => fun a c : Fin 3 => APhi5 B G γ η a c - (if a = c then dDamp5 B G γ η else 0)) U) ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => fun a c : Fin 3 => APhi5 B G γ η a c - (if a = c then dDamp5 B G γ η else 0)) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b

signature.name: aphi5_mat_nb_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), l1 ≤ γ.1 → ActiveL4 B G γ → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) G.r0 ξ.2.2.2 → B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb → (∃ U : Set Cyl, IsOpen U ∧ ξ ∈ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => fun a c : Fin 3 => APhi5 B G γ η a c - (if a = c then dDamp5 B G γ η else 0)) U) ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => fun a c : Fin 3 => APhi5 B G γ η a c - (if a = c then dDamp5 B G γ η else 0)) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hB hG
  
  have pile : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (h : ℝ) (F : Cyl → (Fin 3 → V))
      (ξ : Cyl) (k : ℕ), (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => F η i) ξ) →
      NB h F k ξ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, NB h (fun η => F η i) k ξ := by
    intro V _ _ h F ξ k hF
    have hFc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F ξ := contDiffAt_pi.mpr hF
    have hcomp : ∀ i : Fin 3, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => F η i) ξ =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i : (Fin 3 → V) →L[ℝ] V).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F ξ) := by
      intro i
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i : (Fin 3 → V) →L[ℝ] V) hFc (i := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, NB h (fun η => F η i) k ξ :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
    unfold NB
    apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound hsum0
    intro m
    rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hsum0 (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _)))]
    intro i
    have e : ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)) m i =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => F η i) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)) m := by
      rw [hcomp i]; rfl
    rw [e]
    refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _) ?_
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _))
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => NB h (fun η => F η i) k ξ)
      (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  
  have hh : 0 < B.h := hB.2.1.1
  have hebd : ∀ l : ℕ, |epsb B.h l * (kb B.h l : ℝ) ^ 2| ≤ 4 := by
    intro l
    have hQ0 : 0 < Qb l := by unfold Qb; positivity
    have hQ1 : Qb l ≤ 1 := by
      unfold Qb; exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (by simp)
    have hε0 : 0 < epsb B.h l := by unfold epsb; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ0 _
    have hε1 : epsb B.h l ≤ 1 := by unfold epsb; exact Real.rpow_le_one hQ0.le hQ1 hh.le
    have hx1 : 1 ≤ epsb B.h l ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) :=
      Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hε0 hε1 (by norm_num)
    have hkb : (kb B.h l : ℝ) < epsb B.h l ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) + 1 := by
      unfold kb; exact Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by linarith)
    have hx2 : (epsb B.h l ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) ^ 2 = (epsb B.h l)⁻¹ := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hε0.le]
      have : (-(1/2:ℝ)) * ((2:ℕ):ℝ) = -1 := by norm_num
      rw [this, Real.rpow_neg_one]
    have hk2 : (kb B.h l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (2 * epsb B.h l ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by linarith) 2
    have e1 : (2 * epsb B.h l ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) ^ 2 = 4 * (epsb B.h l)⁻¹ := by
      rw [mul_pow, hx2]; norm_num
    have e2 : epsb B.h l * (4 * (epsb B.h l)⁻¹) = 4 := by
      rw [mul_left_comm, mul_inv_cancel₀ hε0.ne', mul_one]
    have e3 : epsb B.h l * (kb B.h l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 4 := by
      calc epsb B.h l * (kb B.h l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ epsb B.h l * (4 * (epsb B.h l)⁻¹) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hk2.trans e1.le) hε0.le
        _ = 4 := e2
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hε0.le (sq_nonneg _))]
    exact e3
  have hr0' : G.r0 ≤ 1/100 := hG.1.2.1
  
  obtain ⟨l1, c, b0, hc, hgeo⟩ := nphi5_geometry_v5 B G hB hG
  choose Cg bg hgeoc using hgeo
  refine ⟨l1, fun k => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨A0, hA0⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cg j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bg j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hquot := fun i : ℕ => nb_pres_quot_v5 i c A0 hc
  choose Cq' hCq' using hquot
  obtain ⟨Cq, hCq⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cq' j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA00 : 0 ≤ A0 := by rw [hA0]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hβ0 : 0 ≤ β := by rw [hβ]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hCq0 : 0 ≤ Cq := by rw [hCq]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hCgj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → |Cg j| ≤ A0 := fun j hj => by
    rw [hA0]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cg i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  have hbgj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → |bg j| ≤ β := fun j hj => by
    rw [hβ]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |bg i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  have hCqj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → |Cq' j| ≤ Cq := fun j hj => by
    rw [hCq]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cq' i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  obtain ⟨Cent, hCent⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = A0 + 2 ^ k * A0 * Cq + 12 * 2 ^ k * A0 ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨9 * Cent, (β + |b0| / 2) * ((2 * k + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ), ?_⟩
  intro γ ξ hl hAct heta hD hR hX1 hX2
  set S := SC B.h ξ with hSdef
  have hS1 : 1 ≤ S := by
    show 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ
    unfold SC
    exact one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))])
  have hSpos : 0 < S := by linarith
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ S := hSpos.le
  have hgen : ∀ j, j ≤ k → Cg j * S ^ bg j ≤ A0 * S ^ β := by
    intro j hj
    have h1 : S ^ bg j ≤ S ^ β :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 ((le_abs_self _).trans (hbgj j hj))
    calc Cg j * S ^ bg j ≤ |Cg j| * S ^ bg j :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hS0 _)
      _ ≤ A0 * S ^ β := mul_le_mul (hCgj j hj) h1 (Real.rpow_nonneg hS0 _) hA00
  have HG := fun j => hgeoc j γ ξ hl hAct heta hD hR hX1 hX2
  have hNj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ i : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ η i) j ξ ≤ A0 * S ^ β :=
    fun j hj i => ((HG j).2.1 i).1.trans (hgen j hj)
  have hPj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ i : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => nPhiP5 B G γ η i) j ξ ≤ A0 * S ^ β :=
    fun j hj i => ((HG j).2.1 i).2.trans (hgen j hj)
  have hKj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ i i' : Fin 3,
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Kmat B G γ η i i') j ξ ≤ A0 * S ^ β :=
    fun j hj i i' => ((HG j).2.2.1 i i').trans (hgen j hj)
  
  obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = S ^ (|b0| / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Sv, hSv⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = S ^ (β + |b0| / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hlampos : 0 < lam := by rw [hlam]; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hSpos _
  have hSv1 : 1 ≤ Sv := by
    rw [hSv]; exact Real.one_le_rpow hS1 (by linarith [abs_nonneg b0])
  have hSv0 : 0 ≤ Sv := by linarith
  have hlamSv : lam * S ^ β = Sv := by
    rw [hlam, hSv, ← Real.rpow_add hSpos, add_comm]
  have hSβSv : S ^ β ≤ Sv := by
    rw [hSv]; exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 (by linarith [abs_nonneg b0])
  have hAle : A0 * S ^ β ≤ A0 * Sv := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSβSv hA00
  have hA0' : 0 ≤ A0 * S ^ β := mul_nonneg hA00 (Real.rpow_nonneg hS0 _)
  have hll2 : lam * lam = S ^ |b0| := by rw [hlam, ← Real.rpow_add hSpos, add_halves]
  
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : Fin 3 → Cyl → ℝ, n = fun i η => lam * nPhi5 B G γ η i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : Fin 3 → Cyl → ℝ, p = fun i η => lam * nPhiP5 B G γ η i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Cyl → ℝ, K = fun i j η => Kmat B G γ η i j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : Cyl → ℝ, g = fun η => nPhi5 B G γ η 0 * nPhi5 B G γ η 0 +
      nPhi5 B G γ η 1 * nPhi5 B G γ η 1 + nPhi5 B G γ η 2 * nPhi5 B G γ η 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ Q : Fin 3 → Cyl → ℝ, Q = fun j η =>
      (n 0 η * n 0 η + n 1 η * n 1 η + n 2 η * n 2 η)⁻¹ *
        (n 0 η * K 0 j η + n 1 η * K 1 j η + n 2 η * K 2 j η - p j η) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = epsb B.h γ.1 * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hgdot : g ξ = dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) := by
    rw [hg]; simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have hlow : c ≤ lam * lam * g ξ := by
    have h1 : 1 ≤ S ^ (|b0| + -b0) := Real.one_le_rpow hS1 (by linarith [le_abs_self b0])
    have h2 : S ^ (|b0| + -b0) = S ^ |b0| * S ^ (-b0) := Real.rpow_add hSpos _ _
    have h3 : c * S ^ (-b0) ≤ g ξ := by rw [hgdot]; exact (HG 0).1
    calc c ≤ c * (S ^ |b0| * S ^ (-b0)) := by rw [← h2]; exact le_mul_of_one_le_right hc.le h1
      _ = S ^ |b0| * (c * S ^ (-b0)) := by ring
      _ ≤ S ^ |b0| * g ξ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (Real.rpow_nonneg hS0 _)
      _ = lam * lam * g ξ := by rw [hll2]
  have hgξ : g ξ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0; rw [h0, mul_zero] at hlow; linarith
  
  have hll : lam * lam⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hlampos.ne'
  have key : ∀ x y z : ℝ, lam * x * (lam⁻¹ * lam⁻¹ * y * (lam * z)) = y * (x * z) := by
    intro x y z
    have h1 : lam * x * (lam⁻¹ * lam⁻¹ * y * (lam * z)) =
        (lam * lam⁻¹) * (lam * lam⁻¹) * (y * (x * z)) := by ring
    rw [h1, hll, one_mul, one_mul]
  have hid : ∀ (η : Cyl) (a c' : Fin 3), APhi5 B G γ η a c' - (if a = c' then dDamp5 B G γ η else 0) =
      (-1) * K a c' η + 1 * (n a η * Q c' η) + (-(if a = c' then e else 0)) * g η := by
    intro η a c'
    have hA : APhi5 B G γ η a c' = -Kmat B G γ η a c' + (g η)⁻¹ * (nPhi5 B G γ η a *
        (nPhi5 B G γ η 0 * Kmat B G γ η 0 c' + nPhi5 B G γ η 1 * Kmat B G γ η 1 c' +
          nPhi5 B G γ η 2 * Kmat B G γ η 2 c' - nPhiP5 B G γ η c')) := by
      rw [hg]
      simp only [APhi5, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring
    have hDd : dDamp5 B G γ η = e * g η := by
      rw [he, hg]; simp only [dDamp5, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring
    have hQ1 : Q c' η = (n 0 η * n 0 η + n 1 η * n 1 η + n 2 η * n 2 η)⁻¹ *
        (n 0 η * K 0 c' η + n 1 η * K 1 c' η + n 2 η * K 2 c' η - p c' η) := by rw [hQ]
    have hden : n 0 η * n 0 η + n 1 η * n 1 η + n 2 η * n 2 η = lam * lam * g η := by
      simp only [hn, hg] <;> ring
    have hnum : n 0 η * K 0 c' η + n 1 η * K 1 c' η + n 2 η * K 2 c' η - p c' η =
        lam * (nPhi5 B G γ η 0 * Kmat B G γ η 0 c' + nPhi5 B G γ η 1 * Kmat B G γ η 1 c' +
          nPhi5 B G γ η 2 * Kmat B G γ η 2 c' - nPhiP5 B G γ η c') := by
      simp only [hn, hK, hp] <;> ring
    have hna : n a η = lam * nPhi5 B G γ η a := by rw [hn]
    have hKa : K a c' η = Kmat B G γ η a c' := by rw [hK]
    rw [hQ1, hden, hnum, mul_inv, mul_inv, hA, hDd, hna, hKa, key]
    split_ifs <;> ring
  
  obtain ⟨U0, hU0o, hξU0, -, hNs, hPs, hKs⟩ := good_coeff_smooth_v5 B G γ ξ hB hD
    (lt_of_le_of_lt hR.1 (by linarith)) (lt_of_le_of_lt hR.2 (by linarith))
  have hgs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U0 := by
    rw [hg]; exact (((hNs 0).mul (hNs 0)).add ((hNs 1).mul (hNs 1))).add ((hNs 2).mul (hNs 2))
  set U := U0 ∩ g ⁻¹' {(0:ℝ)}ᶜ with hUdef
  have hUo : IsOpen U := hgs.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hU0o isOpen_compl_singleton
  have hξU : ξ ∈ U := ⟨hξU0, hgξ⟩
  have hUn : U ∈ nhds ξ := hUo.mem_nhds hξU
  have hNU : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ η i) U :=
    fun i => (hNs i).mono inter_subset_left
  have hPU : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => nPhiP5 B G γ η i) U :=
    fun i => (hPs i).mono inter_subset_left
  have hgU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U := hgs.mono inter_subset_left
  have hnU : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (n i) U := by
    intro i; rw [hn]; exact contDiffOn_const.mul (hNU i)
  have hpU : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (p i) U := by
    intro i; rw [hp]; exact contDiffOn_const.mul (hPU i)
  have hKU : ∀ i j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (K i j) U := by
    intro i j; rw [hK]; exact (hKs i j).mono inter_subset_left
  have hdenU : ∀ η ∈ U, n 0 η * n 0 η + n 1 η * n 1 η + n 2 η * n 2 η ≠ 0 := by
    intro η hη
    have hgη : g η ≠ 0 := Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mp hη.2
    have : n 0 η * n 0 η + n 1 η * n 1 η + n 2 η * n 2 η = lam * lam * g η := by
      simp only [hn, hg] <;> ring
    rw [this]
    exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hlampos.ne' hlampos.ne') hgη
  have hQU : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Q j) U := by
    intro j
    have hd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => n 0 η * n 0 η + n 1 η * n 1 η + n 2 η * n 2 η) U :=
      (((hnU 0).mul (hnU 0)).add ((hnU 1).mul (hnU 1))).add ((hnU 2).mul (hnU 2))
    have hdi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (n 0 η * n 0 η + n 1 η * n 1 η + n 2 η * n 2 η)⁻¹) U :=
      hd.inv hdenU
    have hnum : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => n 0 η * K 0 j η + n 1 η * K 1 j η + n 2 η * K 2 j η - p j η) U :=
      ((((hnU 0).mul (hKU 0 j)).add ((hnU 1).mul (hKU 1 j))).add ((hnU 2).mul (hKU 2 j))).sub (hpU j)
    rw [hQ]
    exact hdi.mul hnum
  have hEntU : ∀ a c' : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun η : Cyl => APhi5 B G γ η a c' - (if a = c' then dDamp5 B G γ η else 0)) U := by
    intro a c'
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (-1) * K a c' η + 1 * (n a η * Q c' η) +
        (-(if a = c' then e else 0)) * g η) U :=
      ((contDiffOn_const.mul (hKU a c')).add (contDiffOn_const.mul ((hnU a).mul (hQU c')))).add
        (contDiffOn_const.mul hgU)
    exact h1.congr (fun η _ => hid η a c')
  refine ⟨⟨U, hUo, hξU, contDiffOn_pi.mpr fun a => contDiffOn_pi.mpr fun c' => hEntU a c'⟩, ?_⟩
  
  have hlin : ∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ j, NB B.h f j ξ ≤ A0 * S ^ β →
      NB B.h (fun η => lam * f η) j ξ ≤ A0 * Sv := by
    intro f hf j hj
    have e1 : (fun η => lam * f η) = fun η => lam * f η + 0 * f η := by funext η; ring
    rw [e1]
    refine ((nb_real_algebra_v5 B.h U ξ hUo hξU f f hf hf j).2.1 lam 0).trans ?_
    rw [abs_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, abs_of_pos hlampos]
    calc lam * NB B.h f j ξ ≤ lam * (A0 * S ^ β) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hj hlampos.le
      _ = A0 * Sv := by rw [← hlamSv]; ring
  have hnb : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ i, NB B.h (n i) j ξ ≤ A0 * Sv := by
    intro j hj i; rw [hn]; exact hlin (fun η => nPhi5 B G γ η i) (hNU i) j (hNj j hj i)
  have hpb : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ i, NB B.h (p i) j ξ ≤ A0 * Sv := by
    intro j hj i; rw [hp]; exact hlin (fun η => nPhiP5 B G γ η i) (hPU i) j (hPj j hj i)
  have hKb : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ i i', NB B.h (K i i') j ξ ≤ A0 * Sv := by
    intro j hj i i'; rw [hK]; exact (hKj j hj i i').trans hAle
  have hlowU : c ≤ n 0 ξ * n 0 ξ + n 1 ξ * n 1 ξ + n 2 ξ * n 2 ξ := by
    have : n 0 ξ * n 0 ξ + n 1 ξ * n 1 ξ + n 2 ξ * n 2 ξ = lam * lam * g ξ := by
      simp only [hn, hg] <;> ring
    rw [this]; exact hlow
  have hQb : ∀ i, i ≤ k → ∀ c', NB B.h (Q c') i ξ ≤ Cq * Sv ^ (2 * k + 2) := by
    intro i hi c'
    have h1 := hCq' i B.h Sv U ξ n p K hUo hξU hSv1 hnU hpU hKU hlowU
      (fun j hj => ⟨fun i' => hnb j (by omega) i', fun i' => hpb j (by omega) i',
        fun i' i'' => hKb j (by omega) i' i''⟩) c'
    rw [hQ]
    refine h1.trans ?_
    calc Cq' i * Sv ^ (2 * i + 2) ≤ |Cq' i| * Sv ^ (2 * k + 2) :=

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (S : CState) (D : WC) (β1 β2 : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β1 S.Aw → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1/2) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β2 D → InM B (qsOf l0) (1/2) S.Psi → InM B (qsOf l0) (1/2) S.bdir → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → uX5 B G l0 S x t Y - pwrUB B x t Y = cyl2cart x (fun a => mcor5 B G l0 S a (ptOf x t Y)) + cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (cr5Vel B G S.Aw) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y)) ∧ sw5W B G l0 D x t Y = cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (cr5Vel B G D) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))

signature.name: cr5_field_rep
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (S : CState) (D : WC) (β1 β2 : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β1 S.Aw → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1/2) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β2 D → InM B (qsOf l0) (1/2) S.Psi → InM B (qsOf l0) (1/2) S.bdir → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → uX5 B G l0 S x t Y - pwrUB B x t Y = cyl2cart x (fun a => mcor5 B G l0 S a (ptOf x t Y)) + cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (cr5Vel B G S.Aw) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y)) ∧ sw5W B G l0 D x t Y = cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (cr5Vel B G D) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hrot : ∀ (h e t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (r z : ℝ), 0 < r →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeF5 h e t Y0 n c) (rotPt r 0 z) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeF5 h e t Y0 n (fun η i => Complex.I * c η i)) (rotPt r 0 z) →
      ∀ (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (a : Fin 3) (θ : ℝ),
      inner ℝ (curl3 (modeF5 h e t Y0 n c) (rotPt r θ z)) (frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a) =
        Real.cos (n * θ) * inner ℝ (curl3 (modeF5 h e t Y0 n c) (rotPt r 0 z)) (frameAt 0 (r, z, t, Y) a) +
        Real.sin (n * θ) * inner ℝ (curl3 (modeF5 h e t Y0 n (fun η i => Complex.I * c η i)) (rotPt r 0 z))
          (frameAt 0 (r, z, t, Y) a) := by
    have hc : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), rotZ5 φ y 0 = Real.cos φ * y 0 - Real.sin φ * y 1 ∧
        rotZ5 φ y 1 = Real.sin φ * y 0 + Real.cos φ * y 1 ∧ rotZ5 φ y 2 = y 2 := by
      intro φ y
      simp [rotZ5]
    have ext3 : ∀ u v : ℝ³, u 0 = v 0 → u 1 = v 1 → u 2 = v 2 → u = v := by
      intro u v h0 h1 h2
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      · exact h0
      · exact h1
      · exact h2
    have hinv : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), rotZ5 φ (rotZ5 (-φ) y) = y := by
      intro φ y
      obtain ⟨a0, a1, a2⟩ := hc φ (rotZ5 (-φ) y)
      obtain ⟨b0, b1, b2⟩ := hc (-φ) y
      apply ext3
      · rw [a0, b0, b1, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
        linear_combination y 0 * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ
      · rw [a1, b0, b1, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
        linear_combination y 1 * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ
      · rw [a2, b2]
    have hrad : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), rad (rotZ5 φ y) = rad y := by
      intro φ y
      obtain ⟨a0, a1, -⟩ := hc φ y
      unfold rad
      rw [a0, a1]
      congr 1
      linear_combination (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ
    have hlin : ∀ φ : ℝ, ∃ L : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³, ∀ v : ℝ³, L v = rotZ5 φ v := by
      intro φ
      let f : ℝ³ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
        { toFun := rotZ5 φ
          map_add' := fun u v => by
            apply ext3 <;> simp [hc] <;> ring
          map_smul' := fun a u => by
            apply ext3 <;> simp [hc] <;> ring }
      exact ⟨⟨f, f.continuous_of_finiteDimensional⟩, fun v => rfl⟩
    have hinner : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (u v : ℝ³), inner ℝ (rotZ5 φ u) (rotZ5 φ v) = inner ℝ u v := by
      intro φ u v
      have e : ∀ a b : ℝ³, inner ℝ a b = a 0 * b 0 + a 1 * b 1 + a 2 * b 2 := by
        intro a b
        simp [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [e, e]
      obtain ⟨a0, a1, a2⟩ := hc φ u
      obtain ⟨b0, b1, b2⟩ := hc φ v
      rw [a0, a1, a2, b0, b1, b2]
      linear_combination (u 0 * v 0 + u 1 * v 1) * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ
    have hpt : ∀ r φ z : ℝ, rotPt r φ z = rotZ5 φ (rotPt r 0 z) := by
      intro r φ z
      apply ext3 <;> simp [rotPt, hc] <;> ring
    have hframe : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), eR (rotZ5 φ y) = rotZ5 φ (eR y) ∧
        eTh (rotZ5 φ y) = rotZ5 φ (eTh y) ∧ rotZ5 φ eZ = eZ := by
      intro φ y
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · apply ext3 <;> simp [eR, radVec, hc, hrad] <;> ring
      · apply ext3 <;> simp [eTh, azVec, hc, hrad] <;> ring
      · apply ext3 <;> simp [eZ, hc]
    have hphase : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (y : ℝ³) (n : ℤ), 0 < rad y →
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf (rotZ5 φ y) : ℂ)) =
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (φ : ℂ)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ)) := by
      intro φ y n hy
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : ℂ, w = ⟨y 0, y 1⟩ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ : ∃ w' : ℂ, w' = ⟨rotZ5 φ y 0, rotZ5 φ y 1⟩ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hth : thetaOf y = w.arg := by rw [hw]; rfl
      have hth' : thetaOf (rotZ5 φ y) = w'.arg := by rw [hw']; rfl
      have hww : w' = Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * w := by
        obtain ⟨a0, a1, -⟩ := hc φ y
        apply Complex.ext
        · rw [Complex.mul_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im, hw, hw', a0]
        · rw [Complex.mul_im, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im, hw, hw', a1]
          simp only
          ring
      have hnorm : ‖w‖ = rad y := by
        rw [Complex.norm_eq_sqrt_sq_add_sq, hw]
        rfl
      have hw0 : ((‖w‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hnorm]
        exact_mod_cast hy.ne'
      have hnorm' : ‖w'‖ = ‖w‖ := by
        rw [hww, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
      have key : Complex.exp ((w'.arg : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
          Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp ((w.arg : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ hw0
        have h1 := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I w'
        have h2 := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I w
        rw [hnorm'] at h1
        calc ((‖w‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((w'.arg : ℂ) * Complex.I) = w' := h1
          _ = Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * w := hww
          _ = Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (((‖w‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((w.arg : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
              rw [h2]
          _ = _ := by ring
      have hpow : ∀ α : ℝ, Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (α : ℂ)) =
          Complex.exp ((α : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n := by
        intro α
        rw [← Complex.exp_int_mul]
        congr 1
        ring
      rw [hpow, hpow, hpow, hth, hth', key, mul_zpow]
    have hmode : ∀ (h e t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (φ : ℝ) (y : ℝ³),
        0 < rad y → modeF5 h e t Y0 n c (rotZ5 φ y) =
          rotZ5 φ (Real.cos (n * φ) • modeF5 h e t Y0 n c y +
            Real.sin (n * φ) • modeF5 h e t Y0 n (fun η i => Complex.I * c η i) y) := by
      intro h e t Y0 n c φ y hy
      have hP : ptOf (rotZ5 φ y) t (Yph h (rad (rotZ5 φ y)) t + Y0) =
          ptOf y t (Yph h (rad y) t + Y0) := by
        simp only [ptOf, hrad, (hc φ y).2.2]
      have hco : ∀ κ E : ℂ, (κ * (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (φ : ℂ)) * E)).re =
          Real.cos (n * φ) * (κ * E).re + Real.sin (n * φ) * (Complex.I * κ * E).re := by
        intro κ E
        have hx : Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (φ : ℂ)) =
            Complex.exp (((n * φ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
          congr 1
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [hx, show κ * (Complex.exp (((n * φ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * E) =
            Complex.exp (((n * φ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (κ * E) by ring,
          Complex.mul_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im,
          mul_assoc Complex.I, Complex.I_mul_re]
        ring
      obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hlin φ
      obtain ⟨f1, f2, f3⟩ := hframe φ y
      simp only [modeF5, cyl2cart]
      rw [hP, hphase φ y n hy, f1, f2]
      conv_lhs => rw [← f3]
      simp only [← hL, map_add, map_smul, hco]
      module
    have hcurl : ∀ (φ : ℝ) (F G : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (x : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ G x →
        F =ᶠ[nhds (rotZ5 φ x)] (fun y => rotZ5 φ (G (rotZ5 (-φ) y))) →
        curl3 F (rotZ5 φ x) = rotZ5 φ (curl3 G x) := by
      intro φ F G x hG hF
      obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hlin φ
      obtain ⟨L', hL'⟩ := hlin (-φ)
      have hx : L' (L x) = x := by
        rw [hL, hL']
        have := hinv (-φ) x
        rwa [neg_neg] at this
      have hfun : (fun y => rotZ5 φ (G (rotZ5 (-φ) y))) = ⇑L ∘ G ∘ ⇑L' := by
        funext y
        simp only [Function.comp, hL, hL']
      have hD : HasFDerivAt (⇑L ∘ G ∘ ⇑L') (L.comp ((fderiv ℝ G x).comp L')) (L x) := by
        have h1 : HasFDerivAt G (fderiv ℝ G x) (L' (L x)) := by
          rw [hx]
          exact hG.hasFDerivAt
        exact L.hasFDerivAt.comp (L x) (h1.comp (L x) L'.hasFDerivAt)
      have hDF : fderiv ℝ F (rotZ5 φ x) = L.comp ((fderiv ℝ G x).comp L') := by
        rw [hF.fderiv_eq, hfun, ← hL x]
        exact hD.fderiv
      have e0 : L' (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) =
          Real.cos φ • EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 - Real.sin φ • EuclideanSpace.single 1 1 := by
        rw [hL']
        apply ext3 <;> simp [hc]
      have e1 : L' (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) =
          Real.sin φ • EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 + Real.cos φ • EuclideanSpace.single 1 1 := by
        rw [hL']
        apply ext3 <;> simp [hc]
      have e2 : L' (EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) = EuclideanSpace.single 2 1 := by
        rw [hL']
        apply ext3 <;> simp [hc]
      apply ext3
      · simp only [curl3, hDF, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, e0, e1, e2, map_add, map_sub, map_smul, hL]
        simp [hc]
        ring
      · simp only [curl3, hDF, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, e0, e1, e2, map_add, map_sub, map_smul, hL]
        simp [hc]
        ring
      · simp only [curl3, hDF, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, e0, e1, e2, map_add, map_sub, map_smul, hL]
        simp [hc]
        linear_combination (fderiv ℝ G x (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) 1 -
          fderiv ℝ G x (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1) 0) * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ
    have hcl : ∀ (F1 F2 : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (a b : ℝ) (x : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ F1 x →
        DifferentiableAt ℝ F2 x →
        curl3 (fun y => a • F1 y + b • F2 y) x = a • curl3 F1 x + b • curl3 F2 x := by
      intro F1 F2 a b x h1 h2
      have h1' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => a • F1 y) x := h1.const_smul a
      have h2' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => b • F2 y) x := h2.const_smul b
      have hD : fderiv ℝ (fun y => a • F1 y + b • F2 y) x = a • fderiv ℝ F1 x + b • fderiv ℝ F2 x := by
        rw [fderiv_fun_add h1' h2', fderiv_fun_const_smul h1, fderiv_fun_const_smul h2]
      apply ext3 <;> simp [curl3, hD] <;> ring
    intro h e t Y0 n c r z hr hd1 hd2 Y a θ
    have hradx0 : rad (rotPt r 0 z) = r := by
      simp [rad, rotPt, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
    have hU : IsOpen {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y} := by
      apply isOpen_lt continuous_const
      unfold rad
      fun_prop
    have hmem : rotZ5 θ (rotPt r 0 z) ∈ {y : ℝ³ | 0 < rad y} := by
      show 0 < rad (rotZ5 θ (rotPt r 0 z))
      rw [hrad, hradx0]
      exact hr
    have hev : modeF5 h e t Y0 n c =ᶠ[nhds (rotZ5 θ (rotPt r 0 z))]
        (fun y => rotZ5 θ ((fun y' => Real.cos (n * θ) • modeF5 h e t Y0 n c y' +
          Real.sin (n * θ) • modeF5 h e t Y0 n (fun η i => Complex.I * c η i) y') (rotZ5 (-θ) y))) := by
      apply Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hmem)
      intro y hy
      have hy' : 0 < rad (rotZ5 (-θ) y) := by
        rw [hrad]
        exact hy
      have := hmode h e t Y0 n c θ (rotZ5 (-θ) y) hy'
      rw [hinv θ y] at this
      exact this
    have hGd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y' => Real.cos (n * θ) • modeF5 h e t Y0 n c y' +
        Real.sin (n * θ) • modeF5 h e t Y0 n (fun η i => Complex.I * c η i) y') (rotPt r 0 z) := by
      have := (hd1.const_smul (Real.cos (n * θ))).add (hd2.const_smul (Real.sin (n * θ)))
      exact this
    have h1 := hcurl θ _ _ (rotPt r 0 z) hGd hev
    rw [hcl _ _ _ _ _ hd1 hd2] at h1
    have hfr : frameAt θ (r, z, t, Y) a = rotZ5 θ (frameAt 0 (r, z, t, Y) a) := by
      fin_cases a
      · show eR (rotPt r θ z) = rotZ5 θ (eR (rotPt r 0 z))
        rw [hpt r θ z]
        exact (hframe θ _).1
      · show eTh (rotPt r θ z) = rotZ5 θ (eTh (rotPt r 0 z))
        rw [hpt r θ z]
        exact (hframe θ _).2.1
      · show eZ = rotZ5 θ eZ
        exact (hframe θ eZ).2.2.symm
    rw [hpt r θ z, h1, hfr, hinner, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left]
  
  have key : ∀ (qe qA : ℝ) (V W P : ℂ) (φ : ℝ), (qe : ℂ) * V = (qA : ℂ) * (W * P) →
      Real.cos φ * (qe * V.re) + Real.sin φ * (qe * (Complex.I * V).re) =
        qA * (W * (P * Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).re := by
    intro qe qA V W P φ hh
    have h2 : ((qe : ℂ) * V * Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re =
        ((qA : ℂ) * (W * (P * Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))).re := by
      rw [hh]; congr 1; ring
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im] at h2 ⊢
    linear_combination h2
  
  have hsc : ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (c : WC) (θ : ℝ) (η : Cyl) (i : Fin 3),
      qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G c) θ η i = waveV5 B G (cr5Vel B G c) θ η i := by
    intro B G c θ η i
    simp only [waveV5]
    rw [← Complex.re_ofReal_mul, mul_finsum]
    congr 1
    refine finsum_congr (fun γ => ?_)
    rw [mul_finsum]
    refine finsum_congr (fun m => ?_)
    rw [← mul_assoc]
    rfl
  
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lw, hw⟩ := wmo_velocity_split_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lp, hp⟩ := wave_theta_pair_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨lw + lp + n0, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 S D β1 β2 hAw hamp hD hPsi hbdir x t Y hxt
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0.le
  have hξ : ptOf x t Y ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := hxt
  
  have hn : ‖(⟨x 0, x 1⟩ : ℂ)‖ = rad x := by
    rw [Complex.norm_def, Complex.normSq_apply]
    show Real.sqrt (x 0 * x 0 + x 1 * x 1) = Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2)
    ring_nf
  have hcs : rad x * Real.cos (thetaOf x) = x 0 := by
    have h := Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg (⟨x 0, x 1⟩ : ℂ)
    rw [hn] at h
    exact h
  have hsn : rad x * Real.sin (thetaOf x) = x 1 := by
    have h := Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg (⟨x 0, x 1⟩ : ℂ)
    rw [hn] at h
    exact h
  have hrotx0 : rotPt (rad x) (thetaOf x) (x 2) = x := by
    ext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [rotPt, hcs, hsn]
  have hr2 : rad x ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hinv : (rad x)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) = 1 := by
    have hrx : 0 < rad x := hxt.1
    rw [← hr2]
    field_simp
  have hrec : ∀ v : ℝ³, cyl2cart x (fun a => inner ℝ v ((![eR x, eTh x, eZ] : Fin 3 → ℝ³) a)) = v := by
    intro v
    ext j
    fin_cases j
    · simp [cyl2cart, eR, eTh, eZ, radVec, azVec, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination (v 0) * hinv
    · simp [cyl2cart, eR, eTh, eZ, radVec, azVec, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination (v 1) * hinv
    · simp [cyl2cart, eR, eTh, eZ, radVec, azVec, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  constructor
  · 
    have hsplit : ∀ (θ : ℝ) (a : Fin 3), ucyl5 B G l0 S θ (ptOf x t Y) a =
        ucyl5 B G l0 (wmoBase S) 0 (ptOf x t Y) a +
          qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) θ (ptOf x t Y) a :=
      fun θ a => (hw l0 (by omega) S S.Aw S.pw β1 β1 hAw hAw hPsi hbdir (ptOf x t Y) hξ θ a).1
    obtain ⟨H, h0H, hH⟩ := hamp.1
    have hwp := hp l0 (by omega) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw)
      ⟨H, h0H, fun γ m hm => ⟨hH γ m hm, hH γ m hm⟩⟩
      (fun γ m => ⟨(hamp.2.1 γ m).continuousOn, (hamp.2.1 γ m).continuousOn⟩)
      (fun γ m ξ hξ' => ⟨hamp.2.2.2.1 γ m ξ hξ', hamp.2.2.2.1 γ m ξ hξ'⟩) (ptOf x t Y) hξ
    have hmc : ∀ a : Fin 3, mcor5 B G l0 S a (ptOf x t Y) =
        ucyl5 B G l0 (wmoBase S) 0 (ptOf x t Y) a - ubase B (ptOf x t Y) a := by
      intro a
      obtain ⟨hcont, hmean, -, -⟩ := hwp a a
      have hfe : (fun θ => ucyl5 B G l0 S θ (ptOf x t Y) a) = fun θ =>
          ucyl5 B G l0 (wmoBase S) 0 (ptOf x t Y) a +
            qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) θ (ptOf x t Y) a :=
        funext (fun θ => hsplit θ a)
      have hpi : (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have hm' : ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), waveV5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) θ (ptOf x t Y) a = 0 := by
        unfold thA at hmean
        rcases mul_eq_zero.1 hmean with h | h
        · exact absurd h (inv_ne_zero hpi)
        · exact h
      unfold mcor5 thA
      rw [hfe, intervalIntegral.integral_add (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _)

subgoal_signatures.name: wmo_velocity_split_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →
    ∀ (S : CState) (D : WC) (E : WS) (β1 β2 : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β1 S.Aw → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β2 D →
    InM B (qsOf l0) (1/2) S.Psi → InM B (qsOf l0) (1/2) S.bdir →
    ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ (θ : ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
      ucyl5 B G l0 S θ ξ a = ucyl5 B G l0 (wmoBase S) 0 ξ a +
        qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) θ ξ a ∧
      ucyl5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) θ ξ a = ucyl5 B G l0 (wmoBase S) 0 ξ a +
        qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G (S.Aw + D)) θ ξ a
