proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  
  obtain ⟨hh0, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, hqB1, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n0, fun l0 hl0 S D Vo Vn H h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 => ?_⟩
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hl0) hn0.le
  have hVoS : ∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Vo γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := fun γ m => (h1 γ m).1
  have hVnS : ∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Vn γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := fun γ m => (h1 γ m).2
  have hVoSupp : ∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → Vo γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ :=
    fun γ m ξ hξ => (h3 γ m ξ hξ).1
  have hVnSupp : ∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → Vn γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ :=
    fun γ m ξ hξ => (h3 γ m ξ hξ).2
  obtain ⟨hDo, hCoD⟩ := pq5_coef_diff B G l0 Vo hok hG hqB hVoS hVoSupp
  obtain ⟨-, hCnD⟩ := pq5_coef_diff B G l0 Vn hok hG hqB hVnS hVnSupp
  
  have hTrU : ∀ (n : ℤ) (U : Fin 3 → ℂ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (ξ : Cyl), (∀ a, U a = 0) →
      pq5TrM B.h n U c ξ = 0 ∧ pq5TrM B.h n (fun a => starRingEnd ℂ (U a)) c ξ = 0 := by
    intro n U c ξ hU
    constructor
    · funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [pq5TrM, hU]
    · funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [pq5TrM, hU]
  have hTrC : ∀ (n : ℤ) (U : Fin 3 → ℂ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (ξ : Cyl), (∀ a, c ξ a = 0) →
      (∀ a, dR B.h c ξ a = 0) → (∀ a, dZ c ξ a = 0) → pq5TrM B.h n U c ξ = 0 := by
    intro n U c ξ hc hr hz
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [pq5TrM, hc, hr, hz]
  have hev0 : ∀ (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (ξ : Cyl), c =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 →
      (∀ a, c ξ a = 0) ∧ (∀ a, dR B.h c ξ a = 0) ∧ (∀ a, dZ c ξ a = 0) := by
    intro c ξ h
    have hf : fderiv ℝ c ξ = 0 := by rw [h.fderiv_eq]; simp
    refine ⟨fun a => by rw [h.eq_of_nhds]; rfl, fun a => by simp [dR, hf], fun a => by simp [dZ, hf]⟩
  have hCev : ∀ (V : WC) γ m (ξ : Cyl), V γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → modeCoef5 B G V γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
    intro V γ m ξ h
    filter_upwards [h] with η hη
    funext i
    simp [modeCoef5, hη]
  have hCnz : ∀ γ M, M ∉ H → ∀ ξ, (∀ a, modeCoef5 B G Vn γ M ξ a = 0) ∧
      (∀ a, dR B.h (modeCoef5 B G Vn γ M) ξ a = 0) ∧ (∀ a, dZ (modeCoef5 B G Vn γ M) ξ a = 0) := by
    intro γ M hM ξ
    have hz : modeCoef5 B G Vn γ M = 0 := by
      funext η a
      simp [modeCoef5, (h2 γ M hM).2]
    exact hev0 _ ξ (by rw [hz])
  
  have hlab : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (γ : Lab), (∀ m, Vo γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0) → (∀ m, Vn γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0) →
      ∀ M, cr5Q B G l0 S H Vo Vn γ M ξ = 0 := by
    intro ξ γ ho hn M
    have hCo : ∀ m, ∀ a, modeCoef5 B G Vo γ m ξ a = 0 := fun m => (hev0 _ ξ (hCev Vo γ m ξ (ho m))).1
    have hCn := fun m => hev0 _ ξ (hCev Vn γ m ξ (hn m))
    have e1 : ∀ (V V' : WC), (∀ m a, modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ a = 0) → cr5WW B G H V V' γ M ξ = 0 := by
      intro V V' hV
      unfold cr5WW
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero, smul_zero]
      intro m _
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro m' _
      rw [(hTrU _ _ _ _ (hV m)).1, (hTrU _ _ _ _ (hV m)).2]
      simp
    have e3 : cr5MW B G l0 S Vn γ M ξ = 0 := by
      unfold cr5MW
      rw [hTrC _ _ _ _ (hCn M).1 (hCn M).2.1 (hCn M).2.2, (hTrU _ _ _ _ (hCn M).1).1, add_zero, smul_zero]
    simp only [cr5Q, Pi.add_apply]
    rw [e1 Vo Vn hCo, e1 Vn Vo (fun m => (hCn m).1), e3, add_zero, add_zero]
  
  obtain ⟨Hq, hHq1, hHq2, hHq3⟩ : ∃ Hq : Finset ℤ, (∀ m ∈ H, ∀ m' ∈ H, m + m' ∈ Hq) ∧
      (∀ m ∈ H, ∀ m' ∈ H, m' - m ∈ Hq) ∧ H ⊆ Hq :=
    ⟨(H ×ˢ H).image (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => p.1 + p.2) ∪ (H ×ˢ H).image (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => p.2 - p.1) ∪ H,
      fun m hm m' hm' => Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _
        (Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨(m, m'), Finset.mem_product.2 ⟨hm, hm'⟩, rfl⟩)),
      fun m hm m' hm' => Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_right _
        (Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨(m, m'), Finset.mem_product.2 ⟨hm, hm'⟩, rfl⟩)),
      Finset.subset_union_right⟩
  have hQz : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) γ M, M ∉ Hq → cr5Q B G l0 S H Vo Vn γ M ξ = 0 := by
    intro ξ γ M hM
    have hMH : M ∉ H := fun h => hM (hHq3 h)
    have hWWz : ∀ V V' : WC, cr5WW B G H V V' γ M ξ = 0 := by
      intro V V'
      unfold cr5WW
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero, smul_zero]
      intro m hm
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro m' hm'
      rw [if_neg (fun h => hM (by rw [← h]; exact hHq1 m hm m' hm')),
        if_neg (fun h => hM (by rw [← h]; exact hHq2 m hm m' hm')), add_zero]
    have hMWz : cr5MW B G l0 S Vn γ M ξ = 0 := by
      obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := hCnz γ M hMH ξ
      unfold cr5MW
      rw [hTrC _ _ _ _ c1 c2 c3, (hTrU _ _ _ _ c1).1, add_zero, smul_zero]
    simp only [cr5Q, Pi.add_apply, hWWz, hMWz, add_zero]
  have hphase : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (θ : ℝ) (η : Cyl), ephase5 B G γ m θ η =
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) := by
    intro γ m θ η
    simp only [ephase5]
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  
  have hregroup : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (θ : ℝ) (Γ : Finset Lab), 0 < qC B.h ξ →
      (∀ γ M, γ ∉ Γ → cr5Q B G l0 S H Vo Vn γ M ξ = 0) →
      (qC B.h ξ ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2))) • waveV5 B G (cr5Q B G l0 S H Vo Vn) θ ξ = fun i => ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, ∑ m' ∈ H, ((1/2 : ℂ) * (pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G Vo γ m ξ) (modeCoef5 B G Vn γ m') ξ i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ + m' * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) + pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (fun a => starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G Vo γ m ξ a)) (modeCoef5 B G Vn γ m') ξ i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m' * pint5 B G γ - m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)))).re + ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, ∑ m' ∈ H, ((1/2 : ℂ) * (pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G Vn γ m ξ) (modeCoef5 B G Vo γ m') ξ i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ + m' * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) + pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (fun a => starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G Vn γ m ξ a)) (modeCoef5 B G Vo γ m') ξ i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m' * pint5 B G γ - m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)))).re + ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, (pq5TrM B.h (m * pint5 B G γ) (cr5Mc B G l0 S ξ) (modeCoef5 B G Vn γ m) ξ i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re + ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, (pq5TrM B.h 0 (modeCoef5 B G Vn γ m ξ) (cr5Mc B G l0 S) ξ i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re := by
    intro ξ θ Γ hq hΓ
    funext i
    have hPh : ∀ γ M, cr5Ph B G γ M ξ * ephase5 B G γ M θ ξ =
        ((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((M * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) := by
      intro γ M
      have he := Complex.exp_ne_zero (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)))
      rw [hphase]
      unfold cr5Ph
      rw [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ he]
    have alg : ∀ (P e Sx q E : ℂ), P * e = q * E → (1/2 * P) * Sx * e = q * (1/2 * (Sx * E)) := by
      intro P e Sx q E h
      linear_combination (1/2 * Sx) * h
    have hWWs : ∀ (V V' : WC) (γ : Lab), ∑ M ∈ Hq, cr5WW B G H V V' γ M ξ i * ephase5 B G γ M θ ξ =
        ((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((1/2 : ℂ) * ∑ m ∈ H, ∑ m' ∈ H,
          (pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ) (modeCoef5 B G V' γ m') ξ i *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ + m' * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) +
            pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (fun a => starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ a))
              (modeCoef5 B G V' γ m') ξ i *

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (x : ℝ³), SimScaleProps h → t < 1 → 0 < rad x → DifferentiableAt ℝ c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) → fderiv ℝ (modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c) x (eTh x) = cyl2cart x (fun i => (![Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ) * c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) 0 - c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) 1 / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ), Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ) * c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) 1 + c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) 0 / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ), Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ) * c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) 2] i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re)

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (n n' : ℤ) (U : Fin 3 → ℂ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (ξ : Cyl) (θ : ℝ) (i : Fin 3), (pq5TrM h n' (fun a => (((U a * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re : ℝ) : ℂ)) c ξ i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n' : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re = ((1/2 : ℂ) * (pq5TrM h n' U c ξ i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((n + n' : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) + pq5TrM h n' (fun a => starRingEnd ℂ (U a)) c ξ i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((n' - n : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)))).re

subgoal_signatures.name: pq5_offdiag
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (x : ℝ³), 0 < rad x → c =ᶠ[nhds (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0))] 0 → fderiv ℝ (modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c) x = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: pq5_coef_diff
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (V : WC), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB → (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (V γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → V γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) → IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeCoef5 B G V γ m) ξ

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (F : Ext ℝ³) (Q : WC) (e : ℝ) (HQ : Finset ℤ), B.ok → (∀ γ M, M ∉ HQ → Q γ M = 0) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∃ T : Finset Lab, ∀ γ M, γ ∉ T → Q γ M ξ = 0) → (∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → F x t Y = (qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-e)) • cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G Q (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))) → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → F x t Y - thAvgVec F x t Y = (qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-e)) • cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (cr5Osc Q) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))

signature.name: cr5_osc_split
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (F : Ext ℝ³) (Q : WC) (e : ℝ) (HQ : Finset ℤ), B.ok → (∀ γ M, M ∉ HQ → Q γ M = 0) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∃ T : Finset Lab, ∀ γ M, γ ∉ T → Q γ M ξ = 0) → (∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → F x t Y = (qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-e)) • cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G Q (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))) → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → F x t Y - thAvgVec F x t Y = (qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-e)) • cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (cr5Osc Q) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 F Q e HQ _hok hH hT hF
  
  have hcirc : ∀ (a : WS) (ξ : Cyl) (r z : ℝ) (H : Finset ℤ)
      (T : Finset Lab), 0 < r → (0 : ℤ) ∉ H → (∀ γ m, m ∉ H → a γ m ξ = 0) → (∀ γ m, γ ∉ T → a γ m ξ = 0) →
      Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => waveS5 B G a (thetaOf (rotPt r θ z)) ξ) ∧
      thA (fun θ : ℝ => waveS5 B G a (thetaOf (rotPt r θ z)) ξ) = 0 := by
    intro a ξ r z H T hr hH0 hH hT
    have hpint : ∀ γ : Lab, pint5 B G γ ≠ 0 := by
      intro γ
      unfold pint5
      split_ifs with h
      · exact one_ne_zero
      · exact h
    have hphase : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (θ : ℝ), ephase5 B G γ m (thetaOf (rotPt r θ z)) ξ =
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) := by
      intro γ m θ
      have e0 : rotPt r θ z 0 = r * Real.cos θ := by simp [rotPt]
      have e1 : rotPt r θ z 1 = r * Real.sin θ := by simp [rotPt]
      have hc : (⟨rotPt r θ z 0, rotPt r θ z 1⟩ : ℂ) =
          (r : ℂ) * (Complex.cos (θ : ℂ) + Complex.sin (θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
        rw [e0, e1]
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [Complex.cos_ofReal_re, Complex.sin_ofReal_re]
      have hth : thetaOf (rotPt r θ z) = toIocMod Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ := by
        unfold thetaOf
        rw [hc]
        exact Complex.arg_mul_cos_add_sin_mul_I_eq_toIocMod hr θ
      have hn := self_sub_toIocMod Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ
      have hmod : toIocMod Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ =
          θ - ((toIocDiv Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
        rw [zsmul_eq_mul] at hn
        linarith
      have hth' : ((thetaOf (rotPt r θ z) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
          (θ : ℂ) - ((toIocDiv Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) := by
        rw [hth, hmod]
        push_cast
        ring
      have key : Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((pint5 B G γ : ℂ) *
            ((θ : ℂ) - ((toIocDiv Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) +
            (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)) =
          (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)) +
            Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) +
          ((-(m * pint5 B G γ * toIocDiv Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ) : ℤ) : ℂ) *
            (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      unfold ephase5
      rw [hth', key, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I, mul_one, Complex.exp_add]
    have hgen : ∀ (s : Finset (Lab × ℤ)) (c : Lab × ℤ → ℂ) (k : Lab × ℤ → ℤ), (∀ i ∈ s, k i ≠ 0) →
        Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => (∑ i ∈ s, c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re) ∧
        ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (∑ i ∈ s, c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re = 0 := by
      intro s c k hk
      have hcont : ∀ i, Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))) :=
        fun i => continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
          (continuous_const.mul Complex.continuous_ofReal))
      have hF : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => ∑ i ∈ s, c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))) :=
        continuous_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hcont i)
      refine ⟨Complex.continuous_re.comp hF, ?_⟩
      have h1 : ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (∑ i ∈ s, c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re =
          (∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            ∑ i ∈ s, c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re := by
        have := ContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_comp_comm Complex.reCLM
          (hF.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) 0 (2 * Real.pi))
        simpa only [Complex.reCLM_apply] using this
      rw [h1, intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun i _ => (hcont i).intervalIntegrable _ _)]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero, Complex.zero_re]
      intro i hi
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      have hw : Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
        mul_ne_zero Complex.I_ne_zero (Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr (hk i hi))
      rw [integral_exp_mul_complex hw]
      have e2 : Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) =
          (k i : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [e2, Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I]
      simp
    have hfin : ∀ θ' : ℝ, waveS5 B G a θ' ξ =
        (∑ p ∈ T ×ˢ H, a p.1 p.2 ξ * ephase5 B G p.1 p.2 θ' ξ).re := by
      intro θ'
      unfold waveS5
      congr 1
      have hin : ∀ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, a γ m ξ * ephase5 B G γ m θ' ξ =
          ∑ m ∈ H, a γ m ξ * ephase5 B G γ m θ' ξ := by
        intro γ
        apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
        intro m hm
        by_contra hmH
        exact (Function.mem_support.mp hm)
          (by rw [hH γ m (fun h => hmH (Finset.mem_coe.mpr h)), zero_mul])
      rw [finsum_congr hin, finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset (s := T)]
      · exact (Finset.sum_product T H (fun p : Lab × ℤ => a p.1 p.2 ξ * ephase5 B G p.1 p.2 θ' ξ)).symm
      · intro γ hγ
        by_contra hγT
        apply Function.mem_support.mp hγ
        exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun m _ => by
          rw [hT γ m (fun h => hγT (Finset.mem_coe.mpr h)), zero_mul])
    have hfun : (fun θ : ℝ => waveS5 B G a (thetaOf (rotPt r θ z)) ξ) = fun θ : ℝ =>
        (∑ p ∈ T ×ˢ H, (a p.1 p.2 ξ * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (p.2 : ℂ) *
          ((kb B.h p.1.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G p.1 ξ : ℂ)))) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((p.2 * pint5 B G p.1 : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re := by
      funext θ
      rw [hfin]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      rw [hphase]
      ring
    have hk : ∀ p ∈ T ×ˢ H, p.2 * pint5 B G p.1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro p hp
      have hp2 : p.2 ∈ H := (Finset.mem_product.mp hp).2
      have hne : p.2 ≠ 0 := fun h => hH0 (h ▸ hp2)
      exact mul_ne_zero hne (hpint p.1)
    obtain ⟨hC, hI⟩ := hgen (T ×ˢ H)
      (fun p => a p.1 p.2 ξ * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (p.2 : ℂ) *
        ((kb B.h p.1.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G p.1 ξ : ℂ))))
      (fun p => p.2 * pint5 B G p.1) hk
    rw [hfun]
    refine ⟨hC, ?_⟩
    simp only [thA, hI, mul_zero]
  
  have hsum : ∀ (F : Lab → ℤ → ℂ) (Γ : Finset Lab) (H : Finset ℤ),
      (∀ γ m, (γ ∉ Γ ∨ m ∉ H) → F γ m = 0) →
      ∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, F γ m = ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, F γ m := by
    intro F Γ H hF
    have hin : ∀ γ, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, F γ m = ∑ m ∈ H, F γ m := by
      intro γ
      apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
      intro m hm
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hm
      by_contra h
      exact hm (hF γ m (Or.inr (by simpa using h)))
    simp_rw [hin]
    apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
    intro γ hγ
    rw [Function.mem_support] at hγ
    by_contra h
    exact hγ (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun m _ => hF γ m (Or.inl (by simpa using h))))
  have hrot : ∀ r θ z : ℝ, 0 < r → rad (rotPt r θ z) = r ∧ rotPt r θ z 2 = z := by
    intro r θ z hr
    constructor
    · have h : (rotPt r θ z) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt r θ z) 1 ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
        simp [rotPt]
        rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, ← mul_add, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, mul_one]
      unfold rad
      rw [h, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
    · simp [rotPt]
  have hframe : ∀ (y : ℝ³), 0 < rad y → ∀ (v : Fin 3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
      inner ℝ (cyl2cart y v) (![eR y, eTh y, eZ] a) = v a := by
    intro y hy v a
    have hr2 : rad y ^ 2 = y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
    have hne : rad y ≠ 0 := hy.ne'
    have hs : (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) = 1 := by
      rw [← hr2]; field_simp
    fin_cases a <;>
      simp [cyl2cart, eR, eTh, eZ, radVec, azVec, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three] <;>
      first
      | linear_combination (v 0) * hs
      | linear_combination (v 1) * hs
  have hthA : ∀ (c z : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → thA f = 0 →
      thA (fun θ => c * (z + f θ)) = c * z := by
    intro c z f hf h0
    have hpi : (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hI : ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), f θ = 0 := by
      unfold thA at h0
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h0 with h | h
      · exact absurd h (inv_ne_zero hpi)
      · exact h
    unfold thA
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_add
      (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _) (hf.intervalIntegrable _ _),
      intervalIntegral.integral_const, hI, smul_eq_mul, sub_zero, add_zero]
    calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (c * (2 * Real.pi * z)) = c * z * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi)) := by
          ring
      _ = c * z := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hpi, mul_one]
  intro x t Y hxt
  have hxt' : 0 < rad x ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hxt
  have hξ : ptOf x t Y ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := hxt
  have hrx : 0 < rad x := hxt'.1
  obtain ⟨T, hTz⟩ := hT _ hξ
  have hQH : ∀ γ m, (γ ∉ T ∨ m ∉ insert (0:ℤ) HQ) → Q γ m (ptOf x t Y) = 0 := by
    intro γ m h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact hTz γ m h
    · have h' : m ∉ HQ := fun hm => h (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hm)
      rw [hH γ m h']
      rfl
  have hOH : ∀ γ m, (γ ∉ T ∨ m ∉ insert (0:ℤ) HQ) → cr5Osc Q γ m (ptOf x t Y) = 0 := by
    intro γ m h
    unfold cr5Osc
    split_ifs
    · rfl
    · exact hQH γ m h
  have hsplit : ∀ θ', waveV5 B G Q θ' (ptOf x t Y) =
      (fun i => (∑ γ ∈ T, Q γ 0 (ptOf x t Y) i).re) + waveV5 B G (cr5Osc Q) θ' (ptOf x t Y) := by
    intro θ'
    funext i
    have e1 : ∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, Q γ m (ptOf x t Y) i * ephase5 B G γ m θ' (ptOf x t Y) =
        ∑ γ ∈ T, ∑ m ∈ insert (0:ℤ) HQ, Q γ m (ptOf x t Y) i * ephase5 B G γ m θ' (ptOf x t Y) :=
      hsum _ T _ (fun γ m h => by simp only [hQH γ m h, Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul])
    have e2 : ∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, cr5Osc Q γ m (ptOf x t Y) i * ephase5 B G γ m θ' (ptOf x t Y) =
        ∑ γ ∈ T, ∑ m ∈ insert (0:ℤ) HQ,
          cr5Osc Q γ m (ptOf x t Y) i * ephase5 B G γ m θ' (ptOf x t Y) :=
      hsum _ T _ (fun γ m h => by simp only [hOH γ m h, Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul])
    show (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, Q γ m (ptOf x t Y) i * ephase5 B G γ m θ' (ptOf x t Y)).re =
      (∑ γ ∈ T, Q γ 0 (ptOf x t Y) i).re +
        (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, cr5Osc Q γ m (ptOf x t Y) i * ephase5 B G γ m θ' (ptOf x t Y)).re
    rw [e1, e2, ← Complex.add_re, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
    have h0H : (0:ℤ) ∈ insert (0:ℤ) HQ := Finset.mem_insert_self _ _
    have hind : Q γ 0 (ptOf x t Y) i = ∑ m ∈ insert (0:ℤ) HQ,
        (if m = 0 then Q γ m (ptOf x t Y) i else 0) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq', if_pos h0H]
    rw [hind, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
    by_cases hm : m = 0
    · subst hm
      simp [cr5Osc, ephase5]
    · simp [cr5Osc, hm]
  have hmean : thAvgVec F x t Y = cyl2cart x (fun a =>
      qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-e) * (∑ γ ∈ T, Q γ 0 (ptOf x t Y) a).re) := by
    unfold thAvgVec
    congr 1
    funext a
    have hfun : (fun θ => inner ℝ (F (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) =
        fun θ => qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-e) *
          ((∑ γ ∈ T, Q γ 0 (ptOf x t Y) a).re +
            waveS5 B G (fun γ m η => cr5Osc Q γ m η a) (thetaOf (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) (ptOf x t Y)) := by
      funext θ
      obtain ⟨hr, hzz⟩ := hrot (rad x) θ (x 2) hrx
      have hc : corrOn B l0 (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t := by
        show 0 < rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) ∧ t < 1 ∧
          simScale B.h ((rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0
        rw [hr, hzz]
        exact hxt'
      have hp : ptOf (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y = ptOf x t Y := by
        show (rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)), (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 2, t, Y) = (rad x, x 2, t, Y)
        rw [hr, hzz]
      rw [hF _ t Y hc, hp, real_inner_smul_left]
      have hf : frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a =
          ![eR (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)), eTh (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)), eZ] a := rfl
      rw [hf, hframe _ (by rw [hr]; exact hrx), hsplit]
      rfl
    have hm1 : ∀ γ m, m ∉ HQ.erase 0 → cr5Osc Q γ m (ptOf x t Y) a = 0 := by
      intro γ m hm
      unfold cr5Osc
      split_ifs with h0
      · rfl
      · have hm' : m ∉ HQ := fun h => hm (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨h0, h⟩)
        rw [hH γ m hm']
        rfl
    have hm2 : ∀ γ m, γ ∉ T → cr5Osc Q γ m (ptOf x t Y) a = 0 := by
      intro γ m hγ
      exact congrFun (hOH γ m (Or.inl hγ)) a
    obtain ⟨hcont, hz⟩ := hcirc (fun γ m η => cr5Osc Q γ m η a) (ptOf x t Y)
      (rad x) (x 2) (HQ.erase 0) T hrx (Finset.notMem_erase 0 HQ) hm1 hm2
    rw [hfun]
    exact hthA _ _ _ hcont hz
  rw [hmean, hF x t Y hxt, hsplit]
  simp only [cyl2cart, Pi.add_apply, add_smul, smul_add, smul_smul]
  abel

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (S : CState) (bw ca cm cd β : ℝ) (D : WC), StOrd5 B G l0 S bw ca cm cd → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 1/2) D → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β (velW5 B G D) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 2/5) (cr5MW B G l0 S (cr5Vel B G D))

signature.name: cr5_meanwave_class
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (S : CState) (bw ca cm cd β : ℝ) (D : WC), StOrd5 B G l0 S bw ca cm cd → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 1/2) D → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β (velW5 B G D) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 2/5) (cr5MW B G l0 S (cr5Vel B G D))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  have hSN : SimNorm B.h := simscale_normalized_v4 B.h hh0 hh1 hok.1
  obtain ⟨lA, hA⟩ := wmo_amp_class_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lF, hF⟩ := cr5mw_phase_free B G hok hG

noncomputable def cr5mwMat (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (ξ : Cyl) :
    Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  let P : Fin 3 → ℝ := fun a => nrm B (Aex B.h + 1/2) (dR B.h (mcor5 B G l0 S a)) ξ
  let Z : Fin 3 → ℝ := fun a => nrm B (Aex B.h + 1/2) (dZ (mcor5 B G l0 S a)) ξ
  let R : Fin 3 → ℝ := fun a => nrm B (Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun η => mcor5 B G l0 S a η / η.1) ξ
  !![P 0, -2 * R 1, Z 0; P 1 + R 1, R 0, Z 1; P 2, 0, Z 2]
noncomputable def cr5mwPF (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (w : WC) : WC := fun γ m ξ =>
  ((nrm B (Aex B.h) (mcor5 B G l0 S 0) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) • ((Complex.I * (m : ℂ) *
      ((Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * nPhi5 B G γ ξ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ)) • w γ m ξ)
  + ((nrm B (Aex B.h) (mcor5 B G l0 S 1) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) • ((Complex.I * (m : ℂ) *
      ((Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * nPhi5 B G γ ξ 1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) • w γ m ξ)
  + ((nrm B (Aex B.h) (mcor5 B G l0 S 2) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) • ((Complex.I * (m : ℂ) *
      ((Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * nPhi5 B G γ ξ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) • w γ m ξ)
  + ((nrm B (Aex B.h) (mcor5 B G l0 S 0) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
      (((Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (fun i => dR B.h (fun η => w γ m η i) ξ))
  + ((nrm B (Aex B.h) (mcor5 B G l0 S 2) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
      (((Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (fun i => dZ (fun η => w γ m η i) ξ))
  + ((nrm B (Aex B.h) (mcor5 B G l0 S 2) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
      (((-(Aex B.h) * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) • w γ m ξ)
  + (pulseMatC (cr5mwMat B G l0 S ξ)).mulVec (w γ m ξ)

  ∀ (l0 : ℕ), qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1/2) (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw) →
  ∀ (γ : Lab) (s : ℤ), (s = 1 ∨ s = -1) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
    pq5Osc (pq5QOf B G (pq5Vw B G)) γ (2 * s) ξ =
      (1/2 : ℂ) • (pq5T B G γ s (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ s ξ) (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ s) ξ
        + pq5T B G γ s (fun i => starRingEnd ℂ (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ (-s) ξ i))
            (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ s) ξ)

signature.name: pq5_phase_free
signature.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G →
  (∀ (γ : Lab) (M : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl), M ≠ 2 → M ≠ -2 → pq5Osc (pq5QOf B G (pq5Vw B G)) γ M ξ = 0) ∧
  ∀ (l0 : ℕ), qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1/2) (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw) →
  ∀ (γ : Lab) (s : ℤ), (s = 1 ∨ s = -1) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
    pq5Osc (pq5QOf B G (pq5Vw B G)) γ (2 * s) ξ =
      (1/2 : ℂ) • (pq5T B G γ s (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ s ξ) (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ s) ξ
        + pq5T B G γ s (fun i => starRingEnd ℂ (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ (-s) ξ i))
            (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ s) ξ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro γ M ξ h2 hm2
    unfold pq5Osc
    split_ifs with h0
    · rfl
    · unfold pq5QOf
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero, smul_zero]
      intro m hm
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero]
      intro m' hm'
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hm hm'
      rw [if_neg (show ¬ (m + m' = M) by omega), if_neg (show ¬ (m' - m = M) by omega), add_zero]
  · intro l0 hqs hW γ s hs ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨hΩo, hqCs, hqpos, -, -, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
    have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
    have hQb : 0 < Qb γ.1 := by unfold Qb; positivity
    have hkb : 0 < kb B.h γ.1 := by
      unfold kb
      exact Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by unfold epsb; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQb _) _)
    
    have hqd : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), HasFDerivAt (qC B.h) (fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) η) η := fun η hη =>
      ((hqCs.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hη)).hasFDerivAt
    have hchain : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ p : ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun x => qC B.h x ^ p)
        ((p * qC B.h η ^ (p - 1)) • fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) η) η :=
      fun η hη p => (hqd η hη).rpow_const (Or.inl (hqpos η hη).ne')
    have hdzp : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ p : ℝ,
        dZ (fun x => qC B.h x ^ p) η = p * qC B.h η ^ (p - 1) * dZ (qC B.h) η := by
      intro η hη p
      unfold dZ
      rw [(hchain η hη p).fderiv]
      rfl
    have hlog : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
        dZ (fun x => Real.log (qC B.h x)) η = (qC B.h η)⁻¹ * dZ (qC B.h) η := by
      intro η hη
      unfold dZ
      rw [((hqd η hη).log (hqpos η hη).ne').fderiv]
      rfl
    have hqR : fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) ξ (1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) = 0 := by
      have hl : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ξ + t • ((1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) : Cyl))
          ((1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) : Cyl) 0 := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const
          ((1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) : Cyl)).const_add ξ
      have h1 := (hqd ξ hξ).comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) hl (by simp)
      have hc : (qC B.h ∘ fun t : ℝ => ξ + t • ((1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) : Cyl))
          = fun _ => qC B.h ξ := by
        funext t
        simp [qC]
      rw [hc] at h1
      exact h1.unique (hasDerivAt_const 0 _)
    
    have hfac : ∀ (m : ℤ), ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), pq5Vw B G γ m η =
        ((qC B.h η ^ (-(Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η := by
      intro m η hη
      have hq := hqpos η hη
      have haq : qC B.h η ^ (-(Aex B.h)) * qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) = qC B.h η ^ (-B.h) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]; congr 1; unfold Aex; ring
      have E1 : qC B.h η ^ (-B.h) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) =
          qC B.h η ^ (-(Aex B.h)) * (qC B.h η / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ) := by
        rw [Real.div_rpow hq.le hQb.le, Real.rpow_neg hQb.le, ← haq]; ring
      have E2 : dZ (fun x => qC B.h x ^ (-B.h)) η =
          -(qC B.h η ^ (-(Aex B.h)) * (B.h * qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun x => Real.log (qC B.h x)) η)) := by
        rw [hdzp η hη, hlog η hη, Real.rpow_sub_one hq.ne', ← haq]; ring
      funext i
      simp only [pq5Vw, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, E1, E2, wmoAmp5, rotC]
      fin_cases i <;> simp [Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_neg] <;> ring
    
    have hD : ∀ (m : ℤ) (i : Fin 3),
        modeCoef5 B G (pq5Vw B G) γ m ξ i = ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-(Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ m ξ i *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) ∧
        dR B.h (modeCoef5 B G (pq5Vw B G) γ m) ξ i = ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-(Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          (dR B.h (fun η => wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η i) ξ + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) *
            (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ m ξ i) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) ∧
        dZ (modeCoef5 B G (pq5Vw B G) γ m) ξ i = ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-(Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          (dZ (fun η => wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ m η i) ξ + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) *
            (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ m ξ i
            - ((Aex B.h * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ m ξ i) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) := by
      intro m i
      have hK := modeCoef5_differentiable_v5 B G hok hG (qsOf l0) (1/2) _ hqs hW γ m ξ hξ
      have hph := wmo_phase_deriv_v5 B G hok hG (qsOf l0) (1/2) _ hqs hW γ m ξ hξ i
      have hF := (hchain ξ hξ (-(Aex B.h))).smul hK.hasFDerivAt
      have hev : modeCoef5 B G (pq5Vw B G) γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ]
          (fun x => qC B.h x ^ (-(Aex B.h))) • modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw) γ m := by
        filter_upwards [hΩo.mem_nhds hξ] with η hη
        funext j
        show modeCoef5 B G (pq5Vw B G) γ m η j = (qC B.h η ^ (-(Aex B.h))) •
          (modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw) γ m η j)
        simp only [modeCoef5, hfac m η hη, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Complex.real_smul]
        ring
      have hfd := hev.fderiv_eq.trans hF.fderiv
      have hbr : ∀ v : Cyl, (fderiv ℝ (modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw) γ m) ξ v) i =
          fderiv ℝ (fun η => modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw) γ m η i) ξ v := by
        intro v
        rw [(hasFDerivAt_pi'.1 hK.hasFDerivAt i).fderiv]
        rfl
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [modeCoef5, hfac m ξ hξ, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      · have h1 : dR B.h (modeCoef5 B G (pq5Vw B G) γ m) ξ i = qC B.h ξ ^ (-(Aex B.h)) •
            dR B.h (fun η => modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw) γ m η i) ξ := by
          unfold dR
          rw [hfd]
          simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
            ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, hqR, smul_zero, zero_smul, add_zero, Pi.smul_apply]
          rw [hbr]
        rw [h1, hph.1, Complex.real_smul]
        ring
      · have h1 : dZ (modeCoef5 B G (pq5Vw B G) γ m) ξ i = qC B.h ξ ^ (-(Aex B.h)) •
            dZ (fun η => modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw) γ m η i) ξ +
            ((-(Aex B.h)) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(Aex B.h) - 1) * dZ (qC B.h) ξ) •
              modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw) γ m ξ i := by
          unfold dZ
          rw [hfd]
          simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
            ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          rw [hbr]
        rw [h1, hph.2, hlog ξ hξ, Real.rpow_sub_one hq0.ne']
        simp only [modeCoef5, Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_neg,
          Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_inv]
        ring
    have hv : ∀ i, modeCoef5 B G (pq5Vw B G) γ s ξ i = ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-(Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ s ξ i *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) := fun i => (hD s i).1
    have hr := fun i => (hD s i).2.1
    have hz := fun i => (hD s i).2.2
    
    have ha0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ ^ (-(Aex B.h)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _
    have hP : qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) / 2 =
        Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) / 2 / (qC B.h ξ ^ (-(Aex B.h)) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(Aex B.h))) := by
      have h3 : qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * (qC B.h ξ ^ (-(Aex B.h)) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(Aex B.h))) =
          Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hq0, ← Real.rpow_add hq0, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]; congr 1; ring
      rw [← h3]
      field_simp
    have hQm : Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) = (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1))⁻¹ := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.rpow_neg hQb.le]
    have hac : ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-(Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr ha0.ne'
    have hsQ : ((Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
      Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQb).ne'
    have hkc : ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hkb.ne'
    have hrc : ((ξ.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hξ'.1.ne'
    have hcore : ∀ (u U : Fin 3 → ℂ), (∀ j, U j = ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-(Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * u j *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)))) →
        ((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) •
          pq5TrM B.h (s * pint5 B G γ) U (modeCoef5 B G (pq5Vw B G) γ s) ξ
        = ((1/2 : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))) •
          pq5T B G γ s u (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ s) ξ := by
      intro u U hU
      rw [hP]
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;>
        simp only [pq5TrM, pq5T, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hU, hv, hr, hz, crossC, dotProduct,
          Fin.sum_univ_three, nPhi5, DrC, DzC, pang5, RC, hQm, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
          Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk,
          Fin.isValue, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_inv, Complex.ofReal_neg,
          Complex.ofReal_natCast, Complex.ofReal_intCast, Int.cast_mul] <;>
        field_simp <;>
        push_cast <;>
        ring
    
    have h2s : 2 * s ≠ 0 := by rcases hs with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
    have hpair : ∀ (f g : ℤ → ℤ → (Fin 3 → ℂ)),
        (∑ m ∈ ({1, -1} : Finset ℤ), ∑ m' ∈ ({1, -1} : Finset ℤ),
          ((if m + m' = 2 * s then f m m' else 0) + (if m' - m = 2 * s then g m m' else 0))) =
        f s s + g (-s) s := by
      intro f g
      rw [Finset.sum_pair (by norm_num), Finset.sum_pair (by norm_num), Finset.sum_pair (by norm_num)]
      rcases hs with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num <;> abel
    have hp := hpair
      (fun m m' => pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G (pq5Vw B G) γ m ξ)
        (modeCoef5 B G (pq5Vw B G) γ m') ξ)
      (fun m m' => pq5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (fun i => starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G (pq5Vw B G) γ m ξ i))
        (modeCoef5 B G (pq5Vw B G) γ m') ξ)
    have hconjE : starRingEnd ℂ (Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((-s : ℤ) : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))
        = Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) := by
      rw [← Complex.exp_conj]
      congr 1
      simp only [map_mul, Complex.conj_I, map_intCast, map_natCast, Complex.conj_ofReal]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hU2 : ∀ j, (fun i => starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G (pq5Vw B G) γ (-s) ξ i)) j =
        ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-(Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (fun i => starRingEnd ℂ (wmoAmp5 B G (primState5 B G).Aw γ (-s) ξ i)) j *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) := by
      intro j
      simp only []
      rw [(hD (-s) j).1, map_mul, map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal, hconjE]
    have hEE : Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) =
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((2 * s : ℤ) : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) := by
      rw [← Complex.exp_add]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    have hsm : ∀ (x y : ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ), (x * y) • v = y • (x • v) := fun x y v => by
      rw [mul_comm, mul_smul]
    show (if 2 * s = 0 then 0 else pq5QOf B G (pq5Vw B G) γ (2 * s) ξ) = _
    rw [if_neg h2s]
    unfold pq5QOf
    rw [hp, hsm, smul_add, hcore _ _ hv, hcore _ _ hU2, ← smul_add, smul_smul, hEE]
    congr 1
    rw [mul_left_comm, inv_mul_cancel₀ (Complex.exp_ne_zero _), mul_one]

subgoal_signatures.name: domc_open_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ) ∧ ContinuousOn (XC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dT f) (DomC B.h qs)) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → dR B.h f ξ = 0 ∧ dZ f ξ = 0 ∧ dT f ξ = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: wmo_phase_deriv_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (qs α : ℝ) (c : WC), qs ≤ B.qB → InWg5 B G qs α c → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ i : Fin 3, dR B.h (fun η => modeCoef5 B G c γ m η i) ξ = (dR B.h (fun η => c γ m η i) ξ + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * c γ m ξ i) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) ∧ dZ (fun η => modeCoef5 B G c γ m η i) ξ = (dZ (fun η => c γ m η i) ξ + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * c γ m ξ i) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)))

subgoal_signatures.name: modeCoef5_differentiable_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (qs α : ℝ) (a : WC), qs ≤ B.qB → InWg5 B G qs α a → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeCoef5 B G a γ m) ξ

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 →
  ∀ (α β : ℝ) (c : ℂ) (a : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) (b : WC) (H' : Finset ℤ) (σ τ : ℤ → ℤ), (0 : ℤ) ∉ H' →
  InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β b →
  InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + β) (fun γ M ξ => if M ∈ H' then c • (a γ (σ M) ξ • b γ (τ M) ξ) else 0)

  InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β b →

proof.tactics:

      show (if m ∈ H' then c • (a γ (σ m) ξ • b γ (τ m) ξ) else 0) = 0
      rw [if_neg hm]
  · refine ⟨‖Bl‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Ca i| * |Cb (k - i)|,
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |ba j|) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bb j|,
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |da j|) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |db j|,
      fun γ M ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hq0, hS1⟩ := hDq ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨hE, he0, he1⟩ := hEdge _ hX1 hX2
    have hPv : 0 ≤ Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by
      unfold Penv5
      exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
    show NB B.h (fun ξ => if M ∈ H' then c • (a γ (σ M) ξ • b γ (τ M) ξ) else 0) k ξ ≤ _
    by_cases hcase : M ∈ H' ∧ ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ (σ M))
    · obtain ⟨hM, hts⟩ := hcase
      obtain ⟨hSW, -⟩ := hSupp γ (σ M) ξ hξ hts
      have hTgc : (0:ℝ) < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; positivity
      have hQb : 0 < Qb γ.1 := by unfold Qb; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
      have hcib : 0 < cib B.h γ.1 := by
        unfold cib; exact mul_pos (zpow_pos hTgc _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQb _)
      have hv : 0 ≤ vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 := by
        unfold vco
        apply div_nonneg _ hcib.le
        have h1 := hSW.2.2.2.1
        linarith [neg_abs_le (etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)]
      have hP1 : Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) ≤ 1 :=
        penv5_le_one_v5 B G γ _ hG.1.1 hv
      have haO : ContDiffOn ℝ k (a γ (σ M)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
        (sa γ (σ M)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have hbO : ContDiffOn ℝ k (b γ (τ M)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
        (sb γ (τ M)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have hL := hLeib (a γ (σ M)) (b γ (τ M)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ξ k hDopen hξ haO hbO
      rw [hP γ M hM]
      refine le_trans hL ?_
      exact comb k (qC B.h ξ) (SC B.h ξ) (Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)))
        (edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ)) (Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)) ‖Bl‖
        (fun i => NB B.h (a γ (σ M)) i ξ) (fun j => NB B.h (b γ (τ M)) j ξ) hq0 hS1
        (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (hE1 _) he0 he1 hPv hP1 (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg Bl)
        (fun i => norm_nonneg _) (fun j => norm_nonneg _)
        (fun i _ => hA i γ (σ M) ξ hξ hX1 hX2) (fun j _ => hB j γ (τ M) ξ hξ hX1 hX2)
    · have hev := hV γ M ξ (by
        by_cases hM : M ∈ H'
        · exact Or.inr (fun h => hcase ⟨hM, h⟩)
        · exact Or.inl hM)
      rw [hNB0 _ ξ k hev]
      have hC0 : 0 ≤ ‖Bl‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * |Ca i| * |Cb (k - i)| :=
        mul_nonneg (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg Bl) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ =>
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) (abs_nonneg _)))
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC0
        (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
        (Real.rpow_nonneg he0.le _)) hPv

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G qs α hok
  have hU : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have h4c := hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hm : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}
        (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hξ' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ
      exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn (fun ξ : Cyl => simScale B.h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1)) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
      h4c.comp (f := fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) (Continuous.continuousOn (by fun_prop)) hm
    have e : DomC B.h qs = {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ ({ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} ∩
        (fun ξ : Cyl => simScale B.h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1)) ⁻¹' Set.Iio qs) := by
      ext ξ
      exact Iff.rfl
    rw [e]
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).inter
      (hc.isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const) isOpen_Iio)
  have hNB : ∀ {V V' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup V']
      [NormedSpace ℝ V'] (L : V →L[ℝ] V') (f : Cyl → V) (k : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), ‖L‖ ≤ 1 →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (L ∘ f) ξ = L.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ) →
      NB B.h (L ∘ f) k ξ ≤ NB B.h f k ξ := by
    intro V V' _ _ _ _ L f k ξ hL he
    unfold NB
    rw [he]
    have e2 : (L.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) = L.compContinuousMultilinearMap
          ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)) := by
      ext v
      rfl
    rw [e2]
    calc _ ≤ ‖L‖ * _ := L.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _
      _ ≤ 1 * _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := one_mul _
  refine ⟨fun W j hW => ?_, fun a ha => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨⟨H, h0H, hH⟩, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := hW
    let p : (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] ℂ := ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) j
    have hpn : ‖p‖ ≤ 1 := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun x => by
      rw [one_mul]; exact norm_le_pi_norm x j)
    refine ⟨⟨H, h0H, fun γ m hm => ?_⟩, fun γ m => ?_, fun γ m ξ hξ c hc => ?_,
      fun γ m ξ hξ hne => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
    · funext ξ
      show W γ m ξ j = 0
      rw [hH γ m hm]
      rfl
    · show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (p ∘ W γ m) _
      exact p.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (h2 γ m)
    · exact congrArg (fun v => v j) (h3 γ m ξ hξ c hc)
    · apply h4 γ m ξ hξ
      intro h0
      apply hne
      show W γ m ξ j = 0
      rw [h0]
      rfl
    · obtain ⟨C, b, d, hC⟩ := h5 k
      refine ⟨C, b, d, fun γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
      refine le_trans ?_ (hC γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2)
      show NB B.h (p ∘ W γ m) k ξ ≤ _
      exact hNB p (W γ m) k ξ hpn (p.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left
        ((h2 γ m).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)) (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
  · obtain ⟨⟨H, h0H, hH⟩, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := ha
    have hcf : ∀ γ m, (fun ξ => starRingEnd ℂ (a γ (-m) ξ)) =
        (Complex.conjCLE : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ) ∘ a γ (-m) := by
      intro γ m
      funext ξ
      simp
    refine ⟨⟨H.image (fun x : ℤ => -x), ?_, fun γ m hm => ?_⟩, fun γ m => ?_,
      fun γ m ξ hξ c hc => ?_, fun γ m ξ hξ hne => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
    · intro h0
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h0
      have hx' : x = 0 := neg_eq_zero.mp hx0
      exact h0H (hx' ▸ hx)
    · have hm' : -m ∉ H := by
        intro h
        apply hm
        exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨-m, h, neg_neg m⟩
      funext ξ
      show starRingEnd ℂ (a γ (-m) ξ) = 0
      rw [hH γ (-m) hm']
      simp
    · show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => starRingEnd ℂ (a γ (-m) ξ)) _
      rw [hcf]
      exact (Complex.conjCLE : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (h2 γ (-m))
    · show starRingEnd ℂ (a γ (-m) (shY ξ c)) = starRingEnd ℂ (a γ (-m) ξ)
      rw [h3 γ (-m) ξ hξ c hc]
    · apply h4 γ (-m) ξ hξ
      intro h0
      apply hne
      show starRingEnd ℂ (a γ (-m) ξ) = 0
      rw [h0, map_zero]
    · obtain ⟨C, b, d, hC⟩ := h5 k
      refine ⟨C, b, d, fun γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
      refine le_trans ?_ (hC γ (-m) ξ hξ hX1 hX2)
      show NB B.h (fun ξ => starRingEnd ℂ (a γ (-m) ξ)) k ξ ≤ _
      rw [hcf]
      exact hNB _ (a γ (-m)) k ξ (le_of_eq Complex.conjCLE_norm)
        Complex.conjCLE.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G qs hok hqs1 V _ _
  have hh0 : 0 ≤ B.h := hok.2.1.1.le
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4 : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3 := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qs))
    have e : DomC B.h qs =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio qs := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩
        exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3
  have hDq : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ ∧ qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 ∧ 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨-, h2, h3⟩ := hξ
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
    refine ⟨hq0, by linarith, ?_⟩
    unfold SC
    have : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| := by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))]
    exact one_le_pow₀ this
  have hEdge : ∀ X : ℝ, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb → 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X ∧
      0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ∧ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ≤ 1 := by
    intro X h1 h2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, min_le_left _ _⟩
    · unfold edgeWeight
      split_ifs
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      · exact le_rfl
    · have hX : 0 < X := lt_trans hXa h1
      have l1 : 0 < Real.log (X / B.Xa) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr h1)
      have l2 : 0 < Real.log (B.Xb / X) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr h2)
      exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min l1 l2)
  
  have hW : ∀ (q Sv E e P C1 C2 b1 b2 d1 d2 a a1 a2 N1 N2 : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → 1 ≤ Sv → 0 ≤ E →
      0 < e → e ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ P → a ≤ a1 → a ≤ a2 →
      N1 ≤ C1 * q ^ (B.h * a1) * Sv ^ b1 * E * e ^ (-d1) * P →
      N2 ≤ C2 * q ^ (B.h * a2) * Sv ^ b2 * E * e ^ (-d2) * P →
      N1 + N2 ≤ (|C1| + |C2|) * q ^ (B.h * a) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P := by
    intro q Sv E e P C1 C2 b1 b2 d1 d2 a a1 a2 N1 N2 hq0 hq1 hS1 hE he0 he1 hP ha1 ha2 hN1 hN2
    have key : ∀ (C b d ai N : ℝ), a ≤ ai → N ≤ C * q ^ (B.h * ai) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P →
        b ≤ max b1 b2 → d ≤ max d1 d2 →
        N ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * a) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) := by
      intro C b d ai N hα hN hb hd
      have f1 : q ^ (B.h * ai) ≤ q ^ (B.h * a) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hα hh0)
      have f2 : Sv ^ b ≤ Sv ^ (max b1 b2) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 hb
      have f3 : e ^ (-d) ≤ e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge he0 he1 (neg_le_neg hd)
      have p1 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * ai) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
      have p2 : 0 ≤ Sv ^ b := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have p3 : 0 ≤ e ^ (-d) := Real.rpow_nonneg he0.le _
      have p1' : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * a) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
      have p2' : 0 ≤ Sv ^ (max b1 b2) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have m1 : q ^ (B.h * ai) * Sv ^ b ≤ q ^ (B.h * a) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) := mul_le_mul f1 f2 p2 p1'
      have m2 : q ^ (B.h * ai) * Sv ^ b * E ≤ q ^ (B.h * a) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right m1 hE
      have m3 : q ^ (B.h * ai) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) ≤
          q ^ (B.h * a) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) :=
        mul_le_mul m2 f3 p3 (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p1' p2') hE)
      have hWi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right m3 hP
      have hWi0 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * ai) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p1 p2) hE) p3) hP
      calc N ≤ C * q ^ (B.h * ai) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P := hN
        _ = C * (q ^ (B.h * ai) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P) := by ring
        _ ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * ai) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) hWi0
        _ ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * a) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hWi (abs_nonneg C)
    have k1 := key C1 b1 d1 a1 N1 ha1 hN1 (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
    have k2 := key C2 b2 d2 a2 N2 ha2 hN2 (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
    have e : (|C1| + |C2|) * q ^ (B.h * a) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P =
        |C1| * (q ^ (B.h * a) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) +
        |C2| * (q ^ (B.h * a) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) := by ring
    rw [e]
    linarith
  
  have hNB : ∀ (f1 f2 g0 : Cyl → V) (k : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl),
      ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f1 (DomC B.h qs) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f2 (DomC B.h qs) →
      (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs, g0 η = f1 η + f2 η) → NB B.h g0 k ξ ≤ NB B.h f1 k ξ + NB B.h f2 k ξ := by
    intro f1 f2 g0 k ξ hξ hf1 hf2 heq
    have hn : DomC B.h qs ∈ nhds ξ := hDopen.mem_nhds hξ
    have hev : g0 =ᶠ[nhds ξ] f1 + f2 := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hn (fun η hη => heq η hη)
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g0 ξ = iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ := by
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]

by

  refine ⟨lP, fun l0 hl0 α w hw => ?_⟩

  have hNB0 : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V) (i : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl),

    intro V _ _ c i ξ

    · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne hi.ne' c]
      have e : ((0 : Cyl → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin i => Cyl) V) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap

      rw [e, norm_zero]
      exact norm_nonneg _
  have hsmul : ∀ (c : ℂ) (f : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (ξ : Cyl) (i : ℕ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ →

    intro c f ξ i hf
    unfold NB
    have e : (fun η => c • f η) = c • f := rfl
    rw [e, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply (hf.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
    have e2 : (c • iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
        c • ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)) := by
      ext v

    rw [e2]
    exact norm_smul_le (α := ℂ) c ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ))
  have hcoe : ∀ (g : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (i : ℕ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g ξ →

      simp
    rw [e, ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left _ hg (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)]

  obtain ⟨hUo, hqs, hqpos, -, -, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B 1 hok

  have hq1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1

  have hD1 : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ DomC B.h 1 := by
    intro ξ hξ

  have hQpos : ∀ l : ℕ, 0 < Qb l := fun l => Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hsQ : ∀ l : ℕ, 0 < Real.sqrt (Qb l) := fun l => Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hQpos l)
  have hprod : ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℂ) (ξ : Cyl) (k : ℕ) (A1 A2 : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h 1) →

by

  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by

  have hDO : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := (domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok).1
  have hDq : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < qC B.h ξ := (domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok).2.2.1
  
  have key : ∀ (α : ℝ) (ρ : Lab → Cyl → ℝ) (a : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a →

      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 →
        qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 → NB B.h (ρ γ) k ξ ≤ C) →
      InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α
        (fun γ m ξ => dotProduct (fun i => ((ρ γ ξ * nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) (a γ m ξ)) := by
    intro α ρ a ha hρs hρY hρB
    have hsm : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) →
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ ((fun (γ : Lab) (_ : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) (i : Fin 3) =>
          ((ρ γ ξ * nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) γ m) ξ := by
      intro γ m ξ hξ hts
      obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hxi, het⟩ := hp l0 (by omega) α a ha γ m ξ hξ hts
      have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
      have hξB : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < B.qB :=
        ⟨hξ'.1, hξ'.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ'.2.2 hqsB⟩
      obtain ⟨U, hUo, hξU, -, hnU, -, -⟩ := good_coeff_smooth_v5 B G γ ξ hok hξB hxi het
      rw [contDiffAt_pi]
      intro i
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => ρ γ η * nPhi5 B G γ η i) ξ :=
        (hρs γ ξ hξ).mul ((hnU i).contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hξU))
      have h2 := (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff (n := ∞)).contDiffAt.comp ξ h1
      exact h2
    have hdk : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → ∀ c : ℝ × ℝ,
        IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c →
        (fun (γ : Lab) (_ : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) (i : Fin 3) => ((ρ γ ξ * nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) γ m (shY ξ c) =
        (fun (γ : Lab) (_ : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) (i : Fin 3) => ((ρ γ ξ * nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) γ m ξ := by
      intro γ m ξ hξ hne c hc
      have hts : ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) := subset_tsupport _ hne
      obtain ⟨-, -, -, hb1, hb2, -⟩ := hp l0 (by omega) α a ha γ m ξ hξ hts
      have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
      have hcb := (hb γ.1 l0 (qC B.h ξ) (by omega) (hDq ξ hξ) hξ'.2.2 hb1 hb2).1
      have hn := nPhi5_deck_v5 B G γ (coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) c hcb hc ξ
      funext i
      simp only [hρY γ ξ c, hn]
    have hnb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) →
        B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
        NB B.h ((fun (γ : Lab) (_ : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) (i : Fin 3) => ((ρ γ ξ * nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) γ m) k ξ
          ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * 0) * SC B.h ξ ^ b := by
      intro k
      choose Cr hCr using hρB
      refine ⟨3 * (2 ^ k * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cr j|) * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cn j|)), 1, ?_⟩
      intro γ m ξ hξ hts _ _
      obtain ⟨-, hact, hlγ, hb1, hb2, hX1', hX2', hxi, het⟩ := hp l0 (by omega) α a ha γ m ξ hξ hts
      have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
      have hξB : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < B.qB :=
        ⟨hξ'.1, hξ'.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ'.2.2 hqsB⟩
      obtain ⟨U, hUo, hξU, -, hnU, -, -⟩ := good_coeff_smooth_v5 B G γ ξ hok hξB hxi het
      have hSC0 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by unfold SC; positivity
      have hr : ∀ j, j ≤ k → NB B.h (ρ γ) j ξ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cr j| := by

        refine le_trans (hCr j γ ξ hξ hb1 hb2) (le_trans (le_abs_self _) ?_)
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cr j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)

        intro i j hj

        refine le_trans (le_abs_self _) ?_
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cn j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)

      have hprod : ∀ i : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η => ρ γ η * nPhi5 B G γ η i) k ξ ≤
          2 ^ k * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cr j|) * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cn j|) * SC B.h ξ) :=
        fun i => nb_real_mul_le_v5 B.h ξ (ρ γ) (fun η => nPhi5 B G γ η i) k _ _ (hρs γ ξ hξ)

      have hU' : IsOpen (U ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := hUo.inter hDO
      have hvec := nb_vec_complex_v5 B.h (U ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ξ 1
        (fun i η => ρ γ η * nPhi5 B G γ η i)
        (fun η i => ((ρ γ η * nPhi5 B G γ η i : ℝ) : ℂ)) hU' ⟨hξU, hξ⟩
        (fun i η hη => ((hρs γ η hη.2).contDiffWithinAt).mul ((hnU i).mono Set.inter_subset_left η hη))
        (fun η _ => by funext i; simp only [one_mul]) k
      rw [norm_one, one_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three] at hvec
      have e1 : qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * 0) = 1 := by rw [mul_zero, Real.rpow_zero]
      rw [e1, Real.rpow_one, mul_one]
      calc NB B.h (fun η i => ((ρ γ η * nPhi5 B G γ η i : ℝ) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤ _ := hvec
        _ ≤ 2 ^ k * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cr j|) * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cn j|) * SC B.h ξ)
            + 2 ^ k * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cr j|) * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cn j|) * SC B.h ξ)
            + 2 ^ k * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cr j|) * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cn j|) * SC B.h ξ) :=
          add_le_add (add_le_add (hprod 0) (hprod 1)) (hprod 2)
        _ = _ := by ring
    have hmain := inWg5_dot_mult B G l0 hok α 0 a
      (fun (γ : Lab) (_ : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) (i : Fin 3) => ((ρ γ ξ * nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) ha hsm hdk hnb

  have hR : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) 1 (fun γ m ξ => rotC ((primState5 B G).Aw γ m ξ)) := by

  obtain ⟨hMs, hMb⟩ := wmo_amp_multipliers_v5 B hok (qsOf l0) hq1
  have hdZ : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (c : ℝ × ℝ), dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) (shY ξ c) =
      dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) ξ := by
    intro ξ c
    have e1 : shY ξ c = ξ + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), c) := by
      rcases ξ with ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4⟩
      simp [shY]
    have e2 : (fun x : Cyl => Real.log (qC B.h (x + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), c)))) =
        fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η) := by
      funext x
      simp [qC]
    unfold dZ
    rw [e1, ← fderiv_comp_add_right]
    exact congrArg (fun g => fderiv ℝ g ξ (0, 1, 0, 0)) e2
  have hP2 := key 1 (fun _ ξ => B.h * qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) ξ) _ hR
    (fun γ ξ hξ => (hMs ξ hξ).2)
    (fun γ ξ c => by
      show B.h * qC B.h (shY ξ c) ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) (shY ξ c) = _
      rw [hdZ ξ c]
      rfl)
    (fun k => by
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hMb k
      exact ⟨C, fun γ ξ hξ _ _ => (hC ξ hξ).2⟩)
  refine ⟨hP1, hP2, fun γ m ξ hξ => ?_⟩
  
  have ht := htr γ ξ hξ
  simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three] at ht ⊢
  have htC : ((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((W0c4 B G γ ξ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) +
      ((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((W0c4 B G γ ξ 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) +
      ((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((W0c4 B G γ ξ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ)) ht
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_zero] at h
    exact h
  simp only [wmoAmp5, Pi.sub_apply, W0h4]
  generalize (qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ) = r1
  generalize B.h * qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) ξ = μ
  by_cases hm : m = 1 ∨ m = -1
  · simp only [hm, if_true, Complex.ofReal_mul]
    linear_combination (r1 : ℂ) * htC
  · simp only [hm, if_false, Pi.zero_apply, sub_zero, Complex.ofReal_mul]
    ring

signature.statement: ∀ r0 : ℝ, 0 < r0 → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => 1 - Real.smoothTransition (5/2 - 15 / (4 * r0) * |x|)) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun x : ℝ => 1 - Real.smoothTransition (5/2 - 15 / (4 * r0) * |x|)) x‖ ≤ K) ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, |x| < 2 * r0 / 5 → Real.smoothTransition (5/2 - 15 / (4 * r0) * |x|) = 1

proof.tactics:
by
  intro r0 hr0
  set F : ℝ → ℝ := fun x : ℝ => 1 - Real.smoothTransition (5/2 - 15 / (4 * r0) * |x|) with hF
  have ha : (0:ℝ) ≤ 15 / (4 * r0) := by positivity
  have hle1 : ∀ y : ℝ, |y| ≤ 2 * r0 / 5 → 1 ≤ 5/2 - 15 / (4 * r0) * |y| := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : 15 / (4 * r0) * |y| ≤ 15 / (4 * r0) * (2 * r0 / 5) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy ha
    have h2 : 15 / (4 * r0) * (2 * r0 / 5) = 3/2 := by field_simp; ring
    linarith
  have hle0 : ∀ y : ℝ, 2 * r0 / 3 ≤ |y| → 5/2 - 15 / (4 * r0) * |y| ≤ 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : 15 / (4 * r0) * (2 * r0 / 3) ≤ 15 / (4 * r0) * |y| :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy ha
    have h2 : 15 / (4 * r0) * (2 * r0 / 3) = 5/2 := by field_simp; ring
    linarith
  have hC : ∀ x : ℝ, |x| < 2 * r0 / 5 → Real.smoothTransition (5/2 - 15 / (4 * r0) * |x|) = 1 :=
    fun x hx => Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (hle1 x hx.le)
  have hU0 : IsOpen {y : ℝ | |y| < 2 * r0 / 5} := isOpen_lt continuous_abs continuous_const
  have hU1 : IsOpen {y : ℝ | 2 * r0 / 3 < |y|} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_abs
  have h0mem : (0:ℝ) ∈ {y : ℝ | |y| < 2 * r0 / 5} := by
    show |(0:ℝ)| < 2 * r0 / 5
    rw [abs_zero]; positivity
  have hF0 : F =ᶠ[nhds 0] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU0.mem_nhds h0mem) ?_
    intro y hy
    show 1 - Real.smoothTransition (5/2 - 15 / (4 * r0) * |y|) = 0
    rw [hC y hy, sub_self]
  have hF1 : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 * r0 / 3 < |x| → F =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => (1:ℝ) := by
    intro x hx
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU1.mem_nhds hx) ?_
    intro y hy
    have hy' : 2 * r0 / 3 < |y| := hy
    show 1 - Real.smoothTransition (5/2 - 15 / (4 * r0) * |y|) = 1
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (hle0 y hy'.le), sub_zero]
  have hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x = 0
    · subst hx
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hF0
    · have habs : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ => |y|) x := contDiffAt_abs hx
      have hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ => 5/2 - 15 / (4 * r0) * |y|) x :=
        contDiffAt_const.sub (contDiffAt_const.mul habs)
      have hS : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
          (fun y : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (5/2 - 15 / (4 * r0) * |y|)) x :=
        Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp x hg
      exact contDiffAt_const.sub hS
  have hB : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n F x‖ ≤ K := by
    intro n
    have hcont : Continuous (fun x => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n F x) :=
      hA.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    obtain ⟨C, hCb⟩ :=
      (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℝ) r0).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hcont.continuousOn
    refine ⟨max C 1, fun x => ?_⟩
    by_cases hx : |x| ≤ r0
    · have hmem : x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0:ℝ) r0 := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hx
      exact (hCb x hmem).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · have hx' : 2 * r0 / 3 < |x| := by
        have : r0 < |x| := lt_of_not_ge hx
        linarith
      rw [((hF1 x hx').iteratedFDeriv ℝ n).eq_of_nhds]
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with hn | hn
      · subst hn
        rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, norm_one]
        exact le_max_right _ _
      · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (by omega : n ≠ 0)]
        rw [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
        exact le_trans zero_le_one (le_max_right _ _)
  exact ⟨hA, hB, hC⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h γ c Y₀ hxi het
  have hbgc : 0 ≤ bgc ∧ bgc < 1/2 := by
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
    have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
    unfold bgc
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  have hDen : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : ℝ × ℝ, w = rectW h γ c Y₀ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hxiw : |lamR w| < 1/8 := by rw [hw]; exact hxi
  have hetw : |lamT w| < 1/8 := by rw [hw]; exact het
  have hinv1 : w.1 = lamR w + bgc * lamT w := by
    have e : lamR w + bgc * lamT w = (w.1 - bgc * w.2 + bgc * (bgc * w.1 + w.2)) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) := by
      unfold lamR lamT; ring
    rw [e, eq_div_iff hDen]
    ring
  have hinv2 : w.2 = lamT w - bgc * lamR w := by
    have e : lamT w - bgc * lamR w = (bgc * w.1 + w.2 - bgc * (w.1 - bgc * w.2)) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) := by
      unfold lamR lamT; ring
    rw [e, eq_div_iff hDen]
    ring
  have hb1 : bgc * |lamT w| ≤ 1/16 := by
    calc bgc * |lamT w| ≤ (1/2) * (1/8) := mul_le_mul hbgc.2.le hetw.le (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      _ = 1/16 := by norm_num
  have hb2 : bgc * |lamR w| ≤ 1/16 := by
    calc bgc * |lamR w| ≤ (1/2) * (1/8) := mul_le_mul hbgc.2.le hxiw.le (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      _ = 1/16 := by norm_num
  have hb1' : |bgc * lamT w| ≤ 1/16 := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hbgc.1]; exact hb1
  have hb2' : |bgc * lamR w| ≤ 1/16 := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hbgc.1]; exact hb2
  have hw1 : |w.1| < 1/2 := by
    rw [hinv1]
    obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hxiw
    obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := abs_le.mp hb1'
    exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hw2 : |w.2| < 1/2 := by
    rw [hinv2]
    obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hetw
    obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := abs_le.mp hb2'
    exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  obtain ⟨K1, hK1⟩ : ∃ K : ℤ, K = round ((Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y₀ - c).1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨K2, hK2⟩ : ∃ K : ℤ, K = round ((Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y₀ - c).2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hw1e : w.1 = (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y₀ - c).1 - (K1 : ℝ) := by
    rw [hw, hK1]; rfl
  have hw2e : w.2 = (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y₀ - c).2 - (K2 : ℝ) := by
    rw [hw, hK2]; rfl
  have hround : ∀ (x : ℝ) (K : ℤ), |x - (K : ℝ)| < 1/2 → round x = K := by
    intro x K hx
    rw [round_eq, Int.floor_eq_iff]
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := abs_lt.mp hx
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hJc : Continuous (fun Y' : ℝ × ℝ => Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y' - c) := by
    unfold Jpow; fun_prop
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ : ∃ V : Set (ℝ × ℝ), V =
      {Y' : ℝ × ℝ | |(Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y' - c).1 - (K1 : ℝ)| < 1/2} ∩
      {Y' : ℝ × ℝ | |(Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y' - c).2 - (K2 : ℝ)| < 1/2} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hVo : IsOpen V := by
    rw [hV]
    exact (isOpen_lt ((hJc.fst).sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt ((hJc.snd).sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const)
  have hYV : Y₀ ∈ V := by
    rw [hV]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show |(Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y₀ - c).1 - (K1 : ℝ)| < 1/2
      rw [← hw1e]; exact hw1
    · show |(Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y₀ - c).2 - (K2 : ℝ)| < 1/2
      rw [← hw2e]; exact hw2
  have hfr : ∀ Y' ∈ V, rectW h γ c Y' =
      Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y' - c - ((K1 : ℝ), (K2 : ℝ)) := by
    intro Y' hY'
    rw [hV] at hY'
    have r1 : round ((Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y' - c).1) = K1 := hround _ _ hY'.1
    have r2 : round ((Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y' - c).2) = K2 := hround _ _ hY'.2
    unfold rectW frac0
    rw [r1, r2]
    ext <;> simp
  have hlamT_lin : ∀ a b : ℝ × ℝ, lamT (a - b) = lamT a - lamT b := by
    intro a b
    simp only [lamT, Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub]
    ring
  have hlamJ : ∀ Y' : ℝ × ℝ, lamT (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y') = Tgc ^ bandIdx h γ.1 * lamT Y' := by
    intro Y'
    simp only [lamT, Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
    ring
  refine ⟨V, lamT c + lamT ((K1 : ℝ), (K2 : ℝ)), hVo, hYV, fun Y hY => ?_⟩
  simp only [etG]
  rw [hfr _ hY, hlamT_lin, hlamT_lin, hlamJ]
  ring

signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (l : ℕ), h ≤ 1 → 1 ≤ l → 0 ≤ coarseIdx h (qC h ξ) → ∀ w : Cyl, |Tgc ^ (bandIdx h l) * lamT ((Lnorm h ξ w).2.2.2)| ≤ 2 * (4:ℝ) ^ l * ‖w‖

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h ξ l hh hl hci w
  have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := (Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)).mpr (by norm_num)
  have hs1 : 1 < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.one_lt_sqrt_two
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ bgc := by unfold bgc; linarith
  have hb1 : bgc ≤ 1 := by unfold bgc; linarith
  have hc1 : 1 ≤ 1 + bgc ^ 2 := le_add_of_nonneg_right (sq_nonneg _)
  have hc0 : 0 < 1 + bgc ^ 2 := by linarith
  have hcne : 1 + bgc ^ 2 ≠ 0 := hc0.ne'
  have hT1 : 1 < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; linarith
  have hTpos : 0 < Tgc := by linarith
  have hTne1 : Tgc ≠ 1 := hT1.ne'
  
  have hJ1 : ∀ (m : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), (JpowL m Y).1 =
      Y.1 * (Jpow m (1, 0)).1 + Y.2 * (Jpow m (0, 1)).1 := by
    intro m Y
    simp only [JpowL, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', Prod.fst_add, Prod.smul_fst,
      smul_eq_mul]
  have hJ2 : ∀ (m : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), (JpowL m Y).2 =
      Y.1 * (Jpow m (1, 0)).2 + Y.2 * (Jpow m (0, 1)).2 := by
    intro m Y
    simp only [JpowL, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_snd,
      smul_eq_mul]
  have c1 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), (Jpow n Y).1 =
      Lgc ^ n * ((Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) + Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) * bgc := by
    intro n Y
    simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk]
    ring
  have c2 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), (Jpow n Y).2 =
      -(Lgc ^ n * ((Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) * bgc) + Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) := by
    intro n Y
    simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk]
    ring
  have heig : ∀ (m : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), lamT (JpowL m Y) = Tgc ^ m * lamT Y := by
    intro m Y
    unfold lamT
    rw [hJ1, hJ2, c1, c1, c2, c2]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hY : (Lnorm h ξ w).2.2.2 = JpowL (-(coarseIdx h (qC h ξ))) w.2.2.2 := rfl
  set ci := coarseIdx h (qC h ξ) with hci_def
  set N := bandIdx h l with hN
  set v := w.2.2.2 with hv
  have hLHS : Tgc ^ N * lamT ((Lnorm h ξ w).2.2.2) = Tgc ^ (N - ci) * lamT v := by
    rw [hY, heig, ← mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hTpos.ne', sub_eq_add_neg]
  
  have hpow1 : Tgc ^ (N - ci) ≤ Tgc ^ N :=
    zpow_le_zpow_right₀ hT1.le (by linarith)
  have hpos : 0 < Tgc ^ (N - ci) := zpow_pos hTpos _
  have hl1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (l : ℝ) := Nat.one_le_cast.mpr hl
  have hl2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (l : ℝ) ^ 2 := one_le_pow₀ hl1
  have hx : 0 < (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
    div_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _) (by positivity)
  have hfl : (N : ℝ) ≤ Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2)) := by
    rw [hN]; unfold bandIdx; exact Int.floor_le _
  have hpow2 : Tgc ^ N ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_intCast]
    calc Tgc ^ (N : ℝ) ≤ Tgc ^ (Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2))) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hT1.le hfl
      _ = _ := Real.rpow_logb hTpos hTne1 hx
  have hpow3 : (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / ((l : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) :=
    div_le_self (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _).le hl2
  have hpow4 : (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((2:ℝ) * (l:ℝ)) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (by linarith))
  have hpow5 : (2:ℝ) ^ ((2:ℝ) * (l:ℝ)) = (4:ℝ) ^ l := by
    rw [Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2), Real.rpow_two, Real.rpow_natCast]
    norm_num
  have hP : Tgc ^ (N - ci) ≤ (4:ℝ) ^ l := by
    linarith
  
  have hv1 : |v.1| ≤ ‖v‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_fst_le v
  have hv2 : |v.2| ≤ ‖v‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_snd_le v
  have hvw : ‖v‖ ≤ ‖w‖ := ((norm_snd_le w.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le w.2)).trans (norm_snd_le w)
  have hlam : |lamT v| ≤ 2 * ‖w‖ := by
    unfold lamT
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hc0]
    have hnum : |bgc * v.1 + v.2| ≤ 2 * ‖w‖ := by
      have ha := abs_add_le (bgc * v.1) v.2
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hb0] at ha
      have hbv : bgc * |v.1| ≤ ‖v‖ := by
        calc bgc * |v.1| ≤ 1 * |v.1| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb1 (abs_nonneg _)
          _ ≤ ‖v‖ := by linarith
      linarith
    exact (div_le_self (abs_nonneg _) hc1).trans hnum
  rw [hLHS, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hpos]
  calc Tgc ^ (N - ci) * |lamT v| ≤ (4:ℝ) ^ l * (2 * ‖w‖) :=
        mul_le_mul hP hlam (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    _ = 2 * (4:ℝ) ^ l * ‖w‖ := by ring
