signature.name: rhoQ_rpow_nb_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∀ (p : ℝ), (∀ (γ : Lab) (η : Cyl), η.2.2.1 < 1 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : Cyl => rhoQ B γ ζ ^ p) η) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 → 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 → qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 → NB B.h (fun ζ : Cyl => rhoQ B γ ζ ^ p) k ξ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  suffices tn : ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h < 1/100 → SimScaleProps h → ∀ (p : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ,
      ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → qC h ξ ≤ 1 → NB h (fun η => qC h η ^ p) k ξ ≤ C * qC h ξ ^ p by
    intro B hB p
    have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hB.1
    obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, -⟩ := hB.2.1
    have hqpos : ∀ η : Cyl, η.2.2.1 < 1 → 0 < qC B.h η := fun η h' =>
      (hS.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
    have hQb : ∀ l : ℕ, 0 < Qb l := fun l => Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
    have hU : IsOpen {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd.snd.fst continuous_const
    have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) :=
        hS.2.2.2.1
      have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
        (contDiff_snd.fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
      exact h1.comp h2.contDiffOn (fun η (hη : η.2.2.1 < 1) =>
        ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith)⟩)
    have hqCat : ∀ η : Cyl, η.2.2.1 < 1 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : Cyl => qC B.h ζ) η :=
      fun η hη => hqC.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hη)
    refine ⟨fun γ η hη => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
    · show ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : Cyl => (qC B.h ζ / Qb γ.1) ^ p) η
      exact ((hqCat η hη).div_const (Qb γ.1)).rpow_const_of_ne (div_pos (hqpos η hη) (hQb _)).ne'
    · obtain ⟨C', hC'⟩ := tn B.h hh0 hh1 hS p k
      refine ⟨|C'| * ((4:ℝ) ^ p + (1/4 : ℝ) ^ p), fun γ ξ hξ hq1 hr1 hr2 => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨a, hadef⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = (Qb γ.1 ^ p)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hQp : 0 < Qb γ.1 ^ p := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hQb _) _
      have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by rw [hadef]; exact inv_nonneg.mpr hQp.le
      have hev : (fun ζ : Cyl => rhoQ B γ ζ ^ p) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] (fun ζ : Cyl => a • qC B.h ζ ^ p) := by
        refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hξ) (fun η hη => ?_)
        show (qC B.h η / Qb γ.1) ^ p = a • qC B.h η ^ p
        rw [Real.div_rpow (hqpos η hη).le (hQb _).le p, smul_eq_mul, hadef, div_eq_inv_mul]
      have hFat : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : Cyl => qC B.h ζ ^ p) ξ :=
        (hqCat ξ hξ).rpow_const_of_ne (hqpos ξ hξ).ne'
      have hNBeq : NB B.h (fun ζ : Cyl => rhoQ B γ ζ ^ p) k ξ =
          a * NB B.h (fun ζ : Cyl => qC B.h ζ ^ p) k ξ := by
        unfold NB
        rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds,
          iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply' (hFat.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
        have e : (a • iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun ζ : Cyl => qC B.h ζ ^ p) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
            a • (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun ζ : Cyl => qC B.h ζ ^ p) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) := by
          ext m
          simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
        rw [e, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ha0]
      have hr0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 := div_pos (hqpos ξ hξ) (hQb _)
      have hrp : 0 ≤ (qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1) ^ p := Real.rpow_nonneg hr0.le _
      have hkey : a * (C' * qC B.h ξ ^ p) = C' * (qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1) ^ p := by
        rw [Real.div_rpow (hqpos ξ hξ).le (hQb _).le p, hadef, div_eq_inv_mul]
        ring
      have hbd : (qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1) ^ p ≤ (4:ℝ) ^ p + (1/4 : ℝ) ^ p := by
        rcases le_or_gt 0 p with hp | hp
        · have e1 := Real.rpow_le_rpow hr0.le hr2.le hp
          have e2 := Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/4) p
          linarith
        · have e1 := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/4) hr1.le hp.le
          have e2 := Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 4) p
          linarith
      rw [hNBeq]
      calc a * NB B.h (fun ζ : Cyl => qC B.h ζ ^ p) k ξ ≤ a * (C' * qC B.h ξ ^ p) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC' ξ hξ hq1) ha0
        _ = C' * (qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1) ^ p := hkey
        _ ≤ |C'| * (qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1) ^ p := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hrp
        _ ≤ |C'| * ((4:ℝ) ^ p + (1/4 : ℝ) ^ p) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbd (abs_nonneg _)
  
  intro h _ _ hS
  
  have hN : SimNorm h := by
    obtain ⟨hS1, -, -, -, hS5⟩ := hS
    open Pointwise in
    have hom : ∀ μ z τ : ℝ, 0 < μ →
        simScale h (μ ^ (1/2 - h) * z) (μ * τ) = μ * simScale h z τ := by
      intro μ z τ hμ
      have key : ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p → μ * p - (μ ^ (1/2 - h) * z) ^ 2 * (μ * p) ^ (2 * h) =
          μ * (p - z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h)) := by
        intro p hp
        have sq : (μ ^ (1/2 - h)) ^ 2 = μ ^ (1 - 2 * h) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hμ.le]
          congr 1
          push_cast
          ring
        have split : μ ^ (1 - 2 * h) * μ ^ (2 * h) = μ := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hμ]
          have e : 1 - 2 * h + 2 * h = 1 := by ring
          rw [e, Real.rpow_one]
        rw [mul_pow, sq, Real.mul_rpow hμ.le hp.le]
        linear_combination (-(z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h))) * split
      have hset : {q : ℝ | 0 < q ∧ μ * τ ≤ q - (μ ^ (1/2 - h) * z) ^ 2 * q ^ (2 * h)} =
          μ • {p : ℝ | 0 < p ∧ τ ≤ p - z ^ 2 * p ^ (2 * h)} := by
        ext q
        rw [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem₀ hμ.ne', smul_eq_mul]
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
        have hq : q = μ * (μ⁻¹ * q) := by field_simp
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hq0, hle⟩
          have hp : 0 < μ⁻¹ * q := mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hμ) hq0
          refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
          rw [hq, key _ hp] at hle
          exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hle hμ
        · rintro ⟨hp, hle⟩
          refine ⟨by rw [hq]; exact mul_pos hμ hp, ?_⟩
          rw [hq, key _ hp]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle hμ.le
      unfold simScale
      rw [hset, Real.sInf_smul_of_nonneg hμ.le, smul_eq_mul]
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ Z T : ℝ, 0 < T → simScale h Z T = 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (Z, T)‖ ≤ C := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk | hk
      · subst hk
        refine ⟨1, fun Z T _ h1 => ?_⟩
        rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]
        show ‖simScale h Z T‖ ≤ 1
        rw [h1, norm_one]
      · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hS5 k hk
        refine ⟨C, fun Z T hT h1 => ?_⟩
        have := hC Z T hT h1.le
        rwa [h1, Real.one_rpow, mul_one] at this
    refine ⟨C, fun z τ hτ _ => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hQ0, -⟩ := hS1 z τ hτ
    obtain ⟨Q, hQd⟩ : ∃ Q, Q = simScale h z τ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hQd] at hQ0 ⊢
    obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ : ∃ Z : ℝ, Z = Q ^ (-(1/2 - h)) * z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ, T = Q⁻¹ * τ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hT0 : 0 < T := by rw [hT]; exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hQ0) hτ
    have hZT : simScale h Z T = 1 := by
      have := hom Q⁻¹ z τ (inv_pos.mpr hQ0)
      rw [Real.inv_rpow hQ0.le, ← Real.rpow_neg hQ0.le, ← hQd, inv_mul_cancel₀ hQ0.ne'] at this
      rw [hZ, hT]
      exact this
    have hzb : Q ^ (1/2 - h) * Z = z := by
      rw [hZ, ← mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hQ0]
      simp
    have hτb : Q * T = τ := by
      rw [hT]
      exact mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hQ0.ne' τ
    have hpa : 0 < Q ^ (1/2 - h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ0 _
    let e₁ : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 (Q ^ (1/2 - h)) hpa.ne')
    let e₂ : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 Q hQ0.ne')
    let L : (ℝ × ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) := e₁.prodCongr e₂
    let M : ℝ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℝ (Units.mk0 Q hQ0.ne')
    have hL : ∀ x : ℝ × ℝ, L x = (Q ^ (1/2 - h) * x.1, Q * x.2) := by
      intro x
      simp [L, e₁, e₂, mul_comm]
    have hM : ∀ y : ℝ, M y = Q * y := by
      intro y
      simp [M, mul_comm]
    have hfun : (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘ L =
        M ∘ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) := by
      funext w
      simp only [Function.comp, hL, hM]
      exact hom Q w.1 w.2 hQ0
    have hLclm : (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)) =
        (Q ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (Q • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro x
      apply Prod.ext
      · simp [hL]
      · simp [hL]
    have hLv : L (Z, T) = (z, τ) := by
      rw [hL]
      exact Prod.ext hzb hτb
    have hcomp : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘ L) (Z, T) =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (L (Z, T))).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ))) := by
      have := L.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2)
        uniqueDiffOn_univ (mem_univ (L (Z, T))) k
      rwa [preimage_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ] at this
    have key : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (z, τ)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ))) =
        (M : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (Z, T)) := by
      rw [← hLv, ← hcomp, hfun, M.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left]
    have hMn : ‖(M : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ ≤ Q := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hQ0.le fun y => ?_
      show ‖M y‖ ≤ Q * ‖y‖
      rw [hM, norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs Q, abs_of_pos hQ0]
    rw [← hLclm, key]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(M : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ *
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (Z, T)‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
      _ ≤ Q * C := mul_le_mul hMn (hC Z T hT0 hZT) (norm_nonneg _) hQ0.le
      _ = C * Q := mul_comm _ _
  
  intro c j
  unfold SimNorm at hN
  choose C hC using hN
  have key : ∀ {E G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup G]
      [NormedSpace ℝ G] (F : E → G) (V : Set E) (a : E) (T : Cyl →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F V → a ∈ V → ∀ i : ℕ,
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
    intro E G _ _ _ _ F V a T hV hF ha i
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set E, s = (fun z : E => a + z) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hV.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑T ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage T.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : E) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show a + 0 ∈ V; rw [add_zero]; exact ha
    have hT0s : T 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑T ⁻¹' s := hT0s
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F (a + z)) s :=
      hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + T z)) i hO h0O
    have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right T hsm hs.uniqueDiffOn
      hO.uniqueDiffOn hT0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (a + z)) i hs h0s
    have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i a 0
    calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + T z)) 0
        = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (a + z)) ∘ ⇑T) (⇑T ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s (T 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := e2
      _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [map_zero]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (a + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => T) := by rw [e3]
      _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F a).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
  obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ,
      A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |Polynomial.eval c (descPochhammer ℝ i)| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by rw [hAdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |C i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by
    have := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k (_ : k ∈ Finset.range (j + 1)) => abs_nonneg (C k))
    rw [hDdef]; linarith
  refine ⟨(j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j, ?_⟩
  intro ξ hξ hq1
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC h η) {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      (contDiff_snd.fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
    exact h1.comp h2.contDiffOn (fun η (hη : η.2.2.1 < 1) =>
      ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith)⟩)
  have hqpos : ∀ η : Cyl, η.2.2.1 < 1 → 0 < qC h η := fun η h' =>
    (hS.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hq0 : 0 < qC h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
  have hU : IsOpen {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd.snd.fst continuous_const
  obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : Cyl → ℝ, F = fun η : Cyl => qC h η ^ c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨a, hadef⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = qC h ξ ^ c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  suffices hmain : NB h F j ξ ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j * a by
    rw [hFdef, hadef] at hmain; exact hmain
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by rw [hadef]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
  have hFU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    rw [hFdef]
    exact hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos η hη).ne')
  obtain ⟨Pm, hPmdef⟩ : ∃ Pm : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
      Pm = ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))).prod
        (-((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPapp : ∀ η : Cyl, Pm η = (η.2.1, -η.2.2.1) := by
    intro η; rw [hPmdef]; simp
  have hP1 : ‖Pm‖ ≤ 1 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun η => ?_)
    rw [hPapp η, one_mul, Prod.norm_def (η.2.1, -η.2.2.1)]
    refine max_le ?_ ?_
    · exact (norm_fst_le η.2).trans (norm_snd_le η)
    · exact (norm_neg η.2.2.1).trans_le
        (((norm_fst_le η.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le η.2)).trans (norm_snd_le η))
  obtain ⟨Mq, hMqdef⟩ : ∃ Mq : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ,
      Mq = (qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
        (qC h ξ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ, T = Mq.comp Pm := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨w0, hw0def⟩ : ∃ w0 : ℝ × ℝ, w0 = (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hW : IsOpen (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
  have hw0 : w0 ∈ (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := by
    rw [hw0def]; exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
  have hid : ∀ v : Cyl, qC h (ξ + Lnorm h ξ v) = simScale h (w0 + T v).1 (w0 + T v).2 := by
    intro v
    have e1 : (Lnorm h ξ v).2.1 = qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) * v.2.1 := by
      simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
    have e2 : (Lnorm h ξ v).2.2.1 = qC h ξ * v.2.2.1 := by
      simp [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
    have e3 : T v = (qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) * v.2.1, qC h ξ * (-v.2.2.1)) := by
      rw [hTdef, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hPapp v, hMqdef]
      simp [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap']
    rw [e3, hw0def]
    show simScale h (ξ.2.1 + (Lnorm h ξ v).2.1) (1 - (ξ.2.2.1 + (Lnorm h ξ v).2.2.1)) =
      simScale h (ξ.2.1 + qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) * v.2.1) ((1 - ξ.2.2.1) + qC h ξ * (-v.2.2.1))
    rw [e1, e2]
    congr 1
    ring
  obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set Cyl, O = {v : Cyl | (ξ + Lnorm h ξ v).2.2.1 < 1} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hOmem : ∀ v, v ∈ O ↔ (ξ + Lnorm h ξ v).2.2.1 < 1 := by
    intro v; rw [hOdef]; rfl
  have hcontO : Continuous (fun v : Cyl => (ξ + Lnorm h ξ v).2.2.1) :=
    ((continuous_const.add (Lnorm h ξ).continuous).snd.snd.fst)
  have hO : IsOpen O := by rw [hOdef]; exact isOpen_lt hcontO continuous_const
  have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ O := by
    rw [hOmem, map_zero, add_zero]; exact hξ
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψdef⟩ : ∃ ψ : Cyl → ℝ, ψ = fun v => qC h (ξ + Lnorm h ξ v) / qC h ξ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ O := by
    rw [hψdef]
    exact (hqC.comp (contDiff_const.add (Lnorm h ξ).contDiff).contDiffOn
      (fun v hv => (hOmem v).1 hv)).div_const _
  have hψpos : ∀ v ∈ O, 0 < ψ v := by
    intro v hv; rw [hψdef]; exact div_pos (hqpos _ ((hOmem v).1 hv)) hq0
  have hψ0 : ψ 0 = 1 := by
    rw [hψdef]
    show qC h (ξ + Lnorm h ξ 0) / qC h ξ = 1
    rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact div_self hq0.ne'
  have hψeq : ψ = (qC h ξ)⁻¹ • (fun z : Cyl => simScale h (w0 + T z).1 (w0 + T z).2) := by
    rw [hψdef]; funext v
    show qC h (ξ + Lnorm h ξ v) / qC h ξ =
      (qC h ξ)⁻¹ * simScale h (w0 + T v).1 (w0 + T v).2
    rw [hid v, div_eq_inv_mul]
  have hΦ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : Cyl => simScale h (w0 + T z).1 (w0 + T z).2) 0 := by
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (w0 + T 0) := by
      rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact hS.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hw0)
    exact ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (f := fun z : Cyl => w0 + T z)
      (0 : Cyl) h1 (contDiff_const.add T.contDiff).contDiffAt
  have hDψ : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ j → ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ψ O 0‖ ≤ D ^ i := by
    intro i hi1 hij
    have hcomp : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Mq.comp Pm) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Mq)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Pm) := by
      ext m; rfl
    have hCi : ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Mq)‖ ≤ C i * qC h ξ := by
      rw [hMqdef, hw0def]; exact hC i ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith) hq1
    have hprod : ∏ k : Fin i, ‖Pm‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hP1
    have hb1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Mq)) (fun _ : Fin i => Pm)
    have hb2 := hb1.trans ((mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) hprod).trans hCi)
    have hCiD : C i ≤ D := by
      have h2 : |C i| ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |C k| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => |C k|) (fun k _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hij))
      have h3 := le_abs_self (C i)
      rw [hDdef]; linarith
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hO h0O, hψeq,
      iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply (hΦ.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)),
      key (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) w0 T hW hS.2.2.2.1 hw0 i,
      norm_smul, hTdef, hcomp, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le)]
    calc (qC h ξ)⁻¹ * ‖((iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) w0).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Mq)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Pm)‖
        ≤ (qC h ξ)⁻¹ * (C i * qC h ξ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb2 (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le)
      _ = C i := by rw [mul_comm (C i), ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0.ne', one_mul]
      _ ≤ D := hCiD
      _ ≤ D ^ i := le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega)
  have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    (contDiffOn_id (s := Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))).rpow_const_of_ne (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
  have hψmaps : Set.MapsTo ψ O (Set.Ioi 0) := fun v hv => hψpos v hv
  have hCg : ∀ i ≤ j, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) (Set.Ioi 0) (ψ 0)‖ ≤ A := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hψ0, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i isOpen_Ioi (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (zero_lt_one' ℝ)),
      norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate,
      Real.iter_deriv_rpow_const, Real.one_rpow, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, hAdef]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Polynomial.eval c (descPochhammer ℝ i)|)
      (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
  have hFdB := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le hg hψ (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    isOpen_Ioi.uniqueDiffOn hO.uniqueDiffOn hψmaps h0O (C := A) (D := D) hCg hDψ
  obtain ⟨gl, hgldef⟩ : ∃ gl : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ, gl = a • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hgl : ‖gl‖ ≤ a := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ ha0 (fun x => le_of_eq (by
    rw [hgldef, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, norm_smul,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg ha0]))
  have hEq : Set.EqOn (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z)) (⇑gl ∘ ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) ∘ ψ)) O := by
    intro z hz
    have hψz := hψpos z hz
    have e : qC h (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z) = qC h ξ * ψ z := by
      rw [hψdef]
      show _ = qC h ξ * (qC h (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z) / qC h ξ)
      field_simp
    show F (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z) = gl (ψ z ^ c)
    rw [hFdef, hgldef, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    show qC h (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z) ^ c = a * ψ z ^ c
    rw [e, Real.mul_rpow hq0.le hψz.le, ← hadef]
  have hgψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) ∘ ψ) O := hg.comp hψ hψmaps
  have hNB : NB h F j ξ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z)) 0‖ := by
    unfold NB
    rw [key F {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} ξ (Lnorm h ξ) hU hFU hξ j]
  calc NB h F j ξ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z)) 0‖ := hNB
    _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j (fun z => F (ξ + Lnorm h ξ z)) O 0‖ := by
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hO h0O]
    _ = ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j (⇑gl ∘ ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) ∘ ψ)) O 0‖ := by
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_congr hEq h0O j]
    _ = ‖gl.compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) ∘ ψ) O 0)‖ := by
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_left gl (hgψ.contDiffWithinAt h0O)
          hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O (i := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)]
    _ ≤ ‖gl‖ * ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ c) ∘ ψ) O 0‖ :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
    _ ≤ a * ((j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j) := mul_le_mul hgl hFdB (norm_nonneg _) ha0
    _ = (j.factorial : ℝ) * A * D ^ j * a := by ring

by

  obtain ⟨lP, hPS⟩ := pulse_support_good_v5 B G hok hG

    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  obtain ⟨hOpen, hqCsm, hq0, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  have hQb : ∀ l : ℕ, 0 < Qb l := fun l => by unfold Qb; positivity
  have h42 : (4:ℝ) ^ (1/2:ℝ) = 2 := by
    rw [← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, show (4:ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num]
    exact Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)
  have hofR : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ := by
    intro f ξ hf

  have constNB : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (v : V) (k : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl),

    refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk0 | hk0
    · subst hk0
      simp [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]
    · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp hk0)]
      simp
  
  have M1 : ∀ (α : ℝ) (a : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a →
      InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α (fun γ m ξ => (((qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) • a γ m ξ) := by
    intro α a ha
    have sm : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) →

      intro γ m ξ hξ _

    (c : Lab → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (Bo : ℝ) (u0 : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℝ) (A0 AD : WC), B.ok → 7/10 ≤ Bo →
    (∀ (a b : WC) (α β : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β b →
      ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        Continuous (fun θ => waveV5 B G a θ ξ i) ∧ thA (fun θ => waveV5 B G a θ ξ i) = 0 ∧
        (∀ θ, waveV5 B G (a + b) θ ξ i = waveV5 B G a θ ξ i + waveV5 B G b θ ξ i) ∧
        thA (fun θ => waveV5 B G a θ ξ i * waveV5 B G b θ ξ j) = wmoPair5 a b i j ξ) →
    (∀ (a b : WC) (α β : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β b →
      ∀ i j : Fin 3, InM B (qsOf l0) (α + β) (wmoPair5 a b i j)) →
    (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ (θ : ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
      ucyl5 B G l0 S θ ξ a = u0 ξ a + qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G A0 θ ξ a ∧
      ucyl5 B G l0 S2 θ ξ a = u0 ξ a + qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G (A0 + AD) θ ξ a) →
    (∀ (d : Lab → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ (θ : ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
      tSum5 B G d a θ ξ = qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G (liftAmp5 B d) θ ξ a) →
    InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1/2) A0 → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (Bo - kapS) AD →
    InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1/2) (liftAmp5 B (W0c4 B G)) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (Bo - kapS) (liftAmp5 B c) →
    InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (17/25) (A0 - liftAmp5 B (W0c4 B G)) →
    InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (Bo + 1/2 - 2 * kapS) (AD - liftAmp5 B c) →
    (∀ a b : Fin 3, InM B (qsOf l0) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (dWc5 B G l0 S S2 a b)) ∧
      InM B (qsOf l0) 1 (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (Wcov5 B G l0 S a b))) ∧
    ∀ b : Fin 3, InM B (qsOf l0) (Bo + 17/25 - kapS)
      (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (fun ξ => dWc5 B G l0 S S2 0 b ξ - covPr5 B G c b ξ))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 S S2 c Bo u0 A0 AD hB hBo hTP hPC hRep hLW h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
  obtain ⟨P0, hP0⟩ : ∃ P : WC, P = liftAmp5 B (W0c4 B G) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨PD, hPD⟩ : ∃ P : WC, P = liftAmp5 B c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hP0] at h3 h5
  rw [← hPD] at h4 h6
  have hq1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (by simp)
  have hq0 : 0 < qsOf l0 := by
    show (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ))
    positivity
  have algM : ∀ (α β γ c d : ℝ) (f g k : Cyl → ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) α f → InM B (qsOf l0) β g →
      γ ≤ α → γ ≤ β → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), k ξ = c * f ξ + d * g ξ) →
      InM B (qsOf l0) γ k := by
    have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hB.1
    have hh : 0 < B.h := hB.2.1.1
    have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hB.2.1.2.2.1
    have hΩ : IsOpen {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qsOf l0} := by
      have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
        hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
      have hφ : Continuous (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ((w.1, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
        continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_const.sub continuous_snd)
      have hcomp : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2)) {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
        hcont.comp hφ.continuousOn (fun w hw => ⟨mem_univ _, by
          have hw' : w.2 < 1 := hw
          show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2
          linarith⟩)
      exact hcomp.isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const) isOpen_Iio
    have hD : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
      have hπ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
        (continuous_snd.fst).prodMk (continuous_snd.snd.fst)
      exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).inter (hΩ.preimage hπ)
    have lin : ∀ (U : Set Cyl) (f g k : Cyl → ℝ)
        (c d : ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U →
        (∀ x ∈ U, k x = c * f x + d * g x) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ k U ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Cyl) (L : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl), x ∈ U →
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n k x).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L)‖ ≤
            |c| * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L)‖ +
            |d| * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L)‖ := by
      intro U f g k c d hU hf hg hk
      have hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => c * f y + d * g y) U :=
        (contDiffOn_const.mul hf).add (contDiffOn_const.mul hg)
      refine ⟨hp.congr hk, ?_⟩
      intro n x L hx
      have hev : k =ᶠ[nhds x] (c • f + d • g) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => by simp [hk y hy, smul_eq_mul])
      have hfa : ContDiffAt ℝ n f x := (hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have hga : ContDiffAt ℝ n g x := (hg.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have heq : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n k x =
          c • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x + d • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x := by
        have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (c • f + d • g) x =
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (c • f) x + iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (d • g) x :=
          iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (hfa.const_smul c) (hga.const_smul d)
        rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ n).eq_of_nhds, e1,
          iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply hfa, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply hga]
      have hlin : (c • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x + d • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => L) =
          c • (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) +
          d • (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
        ext v; simp
      rw [heq, hlin]
      refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
      rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have wm : ∀ (C q α γ S b b' : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → γ ≤ α → 1 ≤ S → b ≤ b' →
        C * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ b ≤ |C| * q ^ (B.h * γ) * S ^ b' := by
      intro C q α γ S b b' hq0 hq1 hγ hS1 hb
      have h1 : q ^ (B.h * α) ≤ q ^ (B.h * γ) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hγ hh.le)
      have h2 : S ^ b ≤ S ^ b' := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 hb
      have h3 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
      have h4 : 0 ≤ S ^ b := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      calc C * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ b ≤ |C| * q ^ (B.h * α) * S ^ b :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) h3) h4
        _ ≤ |C| * q ^ (B.h * γ) * S ^ b' :=
            mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (abs_nonneg C)) h2 h4
              (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg C) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _))
    have kw : ∀ (γ q S W e : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → 1 ≤ S → 0 ≤ W → 0 < e → e ≤ 1 →
        ∀ (C₀ a b₀ d₀ b' d' : ℝ), γ ≤ a → b₀ ≤ b' → d₀ ≤ d' →
        C₀ * q ^ (B.h * a) * S ^ b₀ * W * e ^ (-d₀) ≤
          |C₀| * (q ^ (B.h * γ) * S ^ b' * W * e ^ (-d')) := by
      intro γ q S W e hq0 hq1 hS1 hW he0 he1 C₀ a b₀ d₀ b' d' ha hb hd
      have P := wm C₀ q a γ S b₀ b' hq0 hq1 ha hS1 hb
      have E : e ^ (-d₀) ≤ e ^ (-d') := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge he0 he1 (neg_le_neg hd)
      have hep : 0 ≤ e ^ (-d₀) := Real.rpow_nonneg he0.le _
      have hn : 0 ≤ |C₀| * q ^ (B.h * γ) * S ^ b' * W :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _))
          (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)) hW
      calc C₀ * q ^ (B.h * a) * S ^ b₀ * W * e ^ (-d₀)
          ≤ |C₀| * q ^ (B.h * γ) * S ^ b' * W * e ^ (-d₀) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right P hW) hep
        _ ≤ |C₀| * q ^ (B.h * γ) * S ^ b' * W * e ^ (-d') :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left E hn
        _ = _ := by ring
    intro α β γ c d f g k hf hg hγα hγβ hk
    obtain ⟨f1, f2, f3, f4⟩ := hf
    obtain ⟨g1, g2, g3, g4⟩ := hg
    obtain ⟨hksm, hkb⟩ := lin (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) f g k c d hD f1 g1 hk
    refine ⟨hksm, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro ξ hξ a ha
      have hsh : shY ξ a ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := hξ
      rw [hk _ hsh, f2 ξ hξ a ha, g2 ξ hξ a ha, hk ξ hξ]
    · intro ξ hξ hX
      rw [hk ξ hξ, f3 ξ hξ hX, g3 ξ hξ hX]
      ring
    · intro n
      obtain ⟨C₁, b₁, d₁, H₁⟩ := f4 n
      obtain ⟨C₂, b₂, d₂, H₂⟩ := g4 n
      refine ⟨|c| * |C₁| + |d| * |C₂|, max b₁ b₂, max d₁ d₂, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
      have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
      have hq0' : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ'.2.1])).1
      have hq1' : qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 := hξ'.2.2.le.trans hq1
      have hSC : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
        unfold SC
        exact one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))])
      have hEW : 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) := by
        unfold edgeWeight
        split_ifs
        · positivity
        · exact le_rfl
      have hX0 : 0 < XC B.h ξ := hXa.trans hX1
      have hE0 : 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) := by
        unfold edgeDist
        exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX1))
          (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr hX2)))
      have hE1 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ≤ 1 := by
        unfold edgeDist
        exact min_le_left _ _
      have k1 := (H₁ ξ hξ hX1 hX2).trans (kw γ _ _ _ _ hq0' hq1' hSC hEW hE0 hE1 C₁ α b₁ d₁
        (max b₁ b₂) (max d₁ d₂) hγα (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _))
      have k2 := (H₂ ξ hξ hX1 hX2).trans (kw γ _ _ _ _ hq0' hq1' hSC hEW hE0 hE1 C₂ β b₂ d₂
        (max b₁ b₂) (max d₁ d₂) hγβ (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
      have hk0 : NB B.h k n ξ ≤ |c| * NB B.h f n ξ + |d| * NB B.h g n ξ :=
        hkb n ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) hξ
      exact hk0.trans ((add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k1 (abs_nonneg c))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k2 (abs_nonneg d))).trans (le_of_eq (by ring)))
  have hk : kapS = 1 / 100000 := rfl
  
  have tAdd : ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous f → Continuous g →
      thA (fun θ => f θ + g θ) = thA f + thA g := by
    intro f g hf hg
    unfold thA
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (hf.intervalIntegrable _ _) (hg.intervalIntegrable _ _)]
    ring
  have tSmul : ∀ (r : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), thA (fun θ => r * f θ) = r * thA f := by
    intro r f
    unfold thA
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    ring
  have tConst : ∀ x : ℝ, thA (fun _ => x) = x := by
    intro x
    unfold thA
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, sub_zero, ← mul_assoc,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity), one_mul]
  have tMean : ∀ (x Q : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous w → thA w = 0 →
      thA (fun θ => x + Q * w θ) = x := by
    intro x Q w hw h0
    calc thA (fun θ => x + Q * w θ) = thA (fun _ => x) + thA (fun θ => Q * w θ) :=
          tAdd (fun _ => x) (fun θ => Q * w θ) continuous_const (continuous_const.mul hw)
      _ = x := by rw [tConst x, tSmul Q w, h0]; ring
  have tExp : ∀ f1 f2 g1 g2 : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous f1 → Continuous f2 → Continuous g1 →
      Continuous g2 →
      thA (fun θ => (f1 θ + f2 θ) * (g1 θ + g2 θ)) =
        thA (fun θ => f1 θ * g1 θ) + thA (fun θ => f1 θ * g2 θ) +
        thA (fun θ => f2 θ * g1 θ) + thA (fun θ => f2 θ * g2 θ) := by
    intro f1 f2 g1 g2 c1 c2 d1 d2
    calc thA (fun θ => (f1 θ + f2 θ) * (g1 θ + g2 θ))
        = thA (fun θ => (f1 θ * g1 θ + f1 θ * g2 θ) + (f2 θ * g1 θ + f2 θ * g2 θ)) := by
          congr 1; funext θ; ring
      _ = thA (fun θ => f1 θ * g1 θ + f1 θ * g2 θ) +
          thA (fun θ => f2 θ * g1 θ + f2 θ * g2 θ) :=
          tAdd (fun θ => f1 θ * g1 θ + f1 θ * g2 θ) (fun θ => f2 θ * g1 θ + f2 θ * g2 θ)
            ((c1.mul d1).add (c1.mul d2)) ((c2.mul d1).add (c2.mul d2))
      _ = _ := by
          rw [tAdd (fun θ => f1 θ * g1 θ) (fun θ => f1 θ * g2 θ) (c1.mul d1) (c1.mul d2),
            tAdd (fun θ => f2 θ * g1 θ) (fun θ => f2 θ * g2 θ) (c2.mul d1) (c2.mul d2)]
          ring
  have t3 : ∀ f g k : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous f → Continuous g → Continuous k →
      thA (fun θ => f θ + (g θ + k θ)) = thA f + thA g + thA k := by
    intro f g k hf hg hk'
    rw [tAdd f (fun θ => g θ + k θ) hf (hg.add hk'), tAdd g k hg hk']
    ring
  
  have key : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (Wcov5 B G l0 S a b) ξ = wmoPair5 A0 A0 a b ξ) ∧
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (dWc5 B G l0 S S2 a b) ξ =
        wmoPair5 A0 AD a b ξ + wmoPair5 AD A0 a b ξ + wmoPair5 AD AD a b ξ) ∧
      (∀ b : Fin 3, nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (fun ξ => dWc5 B G l0 S S2 0 b ξ - covPr5 B G c b ξ) ξ =
        wmoPair5 (A0 - P0) AD 0 b ξ + wmoPair5 P0 (AD - PD) 0 b ξ + wmoPair5 AD (A0 - P0) 0 b ξ +
        wmoPair5 (AD - PD) P0 0 b ξ + wmoPair5 AD AD 0 b ξ) := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := by
      have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
      exact (hB.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ'.2.1])).1
    have hKQ : qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h) * (qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [sq, ← Real.rpow_add hq, ← Real.rpow_add hq,
        show 2 * Aex B.h + (-Aex B.h + -Aex B.h) = 0 by ring, Real.rpow_zero]
    have cw : ∀ (X : WC) (α : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α X → ∀ i : Fin 3,
        Continuous (fun θ => waveV5 B G X θ ξ i) :=
      fun X α hX i => (hTP X X α α hX hX ξ hξ i i).1
    have zw : ∀ (X : WC) (α : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α X → ∀ i : Fin 3,
        thA (fun θ => waveV5 B G X θ ξ i) = 0 :=
      fun X α hX i => (hTP X X α α hX hX ξ hξ i i).2.1
    have pw : ∀ (X Y : WC) (α β : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α X → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β Y →
        ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        thA (fun θ => waveV5 B G X θ ξ i * waveV5 B G Y θ ξ j) = wmoPair5 X Y i j ξ :=
      fun X Y α β hX hY i j => (hTP X Y α β hX hY ξ hξ i j).2.2.2
    have cm : ∀ (X Y : WC) (α β : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α X → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β Y →
        ∀ i j : Fin 3, Continuous (fun θ => waveV5 B G X θ ξ i * waveV5 B G Y θ ξ j) :=
      fun X Y α β hX hY i j => (cw X α hX i).mul (cw Y β hY j)
    have sAD : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (θ : ℝ),
        waveV5 B G (A0 + AD) θ ξ i = waveV5 B G A0 θ ξ i + waveV5 B G AD θ ξ i :=
      fun i θ => (hTP A0 AD _ _ h1 h2 ξ hξ i i).2.2.1 θ
    have sA : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (θ : ℝ),
        waveV5 B G A0 θ ξ i = waveV5 B G P0 θ ξ i + waveV5 B G (A0 - P0) θ ξ i := by
      intro i θ
      have e := (hTP P0 (A0 - P0) _ _ h3 h5 ξ hξ i i).2.2.1 θ
      rwa [add_sub_cancel] at e
    have sD : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (θ : ℝ),
        waveV5 B G AD θ ξ i = waveV5 B G PD θ ξ i + waveV5 B G (AD - PD) θ ξ i := by
      intro i θ
      have e := (hTP PD (AD - PD) _ _ h4 h6 ξ hξ i i).2.2.1 θ
      rwa [add_sub_cancel] at e
    
    have mS : ∀ a : Fin 3, thA (fun θ => ucyl5 B G l0 S θ ξ a) = u0 ξ a := by
      intro a
      exact (congrArg thA (funext fun θ => (hRep ξ hξ θ a).1)).trans
        (tMean (u0 ξ a) (qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) (fun θ => waveV5 B G A0 θ ξ a)
          (cw A0 _ h1 a) (zw A0 _ h1 a))
    have uS2 : ∀ (θ : ℝ) (a : Fin 3), ucyl5 B G l0 S2 θ ξ a = u0 ξ a + qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) *
        (waveV5 B G A0 θ ξ a + waveV5 B G AD θ ξ a) := by
      intro θ a
      rw [(hRep ξ hξ θ a).2, sAD a θ]
    have mS2 : ∀ a : Fin 3, thA (fun θ => ucyl5 B G l0 S2 θ ξ a) = u0 ξ a := by
      intro a
      have z : thA (fun θ => waveV5 B G A0 θ ξ a + waveV5 B G AD θ ξ a) = 0 := by
        rw [tAdd _ _ (cw A0 _ h1 a) (cw AD _ h2 a), zw A0 _ h1 a, zw AD _ h2 a, add_zero]
      exact (congrArg thA (funext fun θ => uS2 θ a)).trans
        (tMean (u0 ξ a) (qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h))
          (fun θ => waveV5 B G A0 θ ξ a + waveV5 B G AD θ ξ a)
          ((cw A0 _ h1 a).add (cw AD _ h2 a)) z)
    
    have WS : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
        Wcov5 B G l0 S a b ξ = (qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) ^ 2 * wmoPair5 A0 A0 a b ξ := by
      intro a b
      have e : Wcov5 B G l0 S a b ξ = thA (fun θ => (qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) ^ 2 *
          (waveV5 B G A0 θ ξ a * waveV5 B G A0 θ ξ b)) := by
        unfold Wcov5
        rw [mS a, mS b]
        congr 1; funext θ
        rw [(hRep ξ hξ θ a).1, (hRep ξ hξ θ b).1]; ring
      rw [e, tSmul, pw A0 A0 _ _ h1 h1 a b]
    have WS2 : ∀ a b : Fin 3, Wcov5 B G l0 S2 a b ξ = (qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) ^ 2 *
        (wmoPair5 A0 A0 a b ξ + wmoPair5 A0 AD a b ξ + wmoPair5 AD A0 a b ξ +
          wmoPair5 AD AD a b ξ) := by
      intro a b
      have e : Wcov5 B G l0 S2 a b ξ = thA (fun θ => (qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) ^ 2 *
          ((waveV5 B G A0 θ ξ a + waveV5 B G AD θ ξ a) *
            (waveV5 B G A0 θ ξ b + waveV5 B G AD θ ξ b))) := by
        unfold Wcov5
        rw [mS2 a, mS2 b]
        congr 1; funext θ
        rw [uS2 θ a, uS2 θ b]; ring
      rw [e, tSmul, tExp _ _ _ _ (cw A0 _ h1 a) (cw AD _ h2 a) (cw A0 _ h1 b) (cw AD _ h2 b),
        pw A0 A0 _ _ h1 h1 a b, pw A0 AD _ _ h1 h2 a b, pw AD A0 _ _ h2 h1 a b,
        pw AD AD _ _ h2 h2 a b]
    refine ⟨fun a b => ?_, fun a b => ?_, fun b => ?_⟩
    · show qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h) * Wcov5 B G l0 S a b ξ = _
      rw [WS a b, ← mul_assoc, hKQ, one_mul]
    · show qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h) * (Wcov5 B G l0 S2 a b ξ - Wcov5 B G l0 S a b ξ) = _
      rw [WS2 a b, WS a b]
      linear_combination (wmoPair5 A0 AD a b ξ + wmoPair5 AD A0 a b ξ + wmoPair5 AD AD a b ξ) * hKQ
    · have eCov : covPr5 B G c b ξ = (qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) ^ 2 *
          (wmoPair5 P0 PD 0 b ξ + wmoPair5 PD P0 0 b ξ) := by
        have e : covPr5 B G c b ξ = thA (fun θ => (qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) ^ 2 *
            (waveV5 B G P0 θ ξ 0 * waveV5 B G PD θ ξ b +
              waveV5 B G PD θ ξ 0 * waveV5 B G P0 θ ξ b)) := by
          show thA (fun θ => covT5 B G (W0c4 B G) c 0 b θ ξ + covT5 B G c (W0c4 B G) 0 b θ ξ) = _
          congr 1; funext θ
          show tSum5 B G (W0c4 B G) 0 θ ξ * tSum5 B G c b θ ξ +
            tSum5 B G c 0 θ ξ * tSum5 B G (W0c4 B G) b θ ξ = _
          rw [hLW (W0c4 B G) ξ hξ θ 0, hLW c ξ hξ θ b, hLW c ξ hξ θ 0, hLW (W0c4 B G) ξ hξ θ b,
            ← hP0, ← hPD]
          ring
        rw [e, tSmul, tAdd _ _ (cm P0 PD _ _ h3 h4 0 b) (cm PD P0 _ _ h4 h3 0 b),
          pw P0 PD _ _ h3 h4 0 b, pw PD P0 _ _ h4 h3 0 b]
      have Y1 : wmoPair5 A0 AD 0 b ξ = wmoPair5 (A0 - P0) AD 0 b ξ + wmoPair5 P0 (AD - PD) 0 b ξ +
          wmoPair5 P0 PD 0 b ξ := by
        rw [← pw A0 AD _ _ h1 h2 0 b, ← pw (A0 - P0) AD _ _ h5 h2 0 b,
          ← pw P0 (AD - PD) _ _ h3 h6 0 b, ← pw P0 PD _ _ h3 h4 0 b,
          ← t3 _ _ _ (cm (A0 - P0) AD _ _ h5 h2 0 b)
            (cm P0 (AD - PD) _ _ h3 h6 0 b) (cm P0 PD _ _ h3 h4 0 b)]
        congr 1; funext θ
        simp only [sA 0 θ, sD b θ]; ring
      have Y2 : wmoPair5 AD A0 0 b ξ = wmoPair5 AD (A0 - P0) 0 b ξ + wmoPair5 (AD - PD) P0 0 b ξ +
          wmoPair5 PD P0 0 b ξ := by
        rw [← pw AD A0 _ _ h2 h1 0 b, ← pw AD (A0 - P0) _ _ h2 h5 0 b,
          ← pw (AD - PD) P0 _ _ h6 h3 0 b, ← pw PD P0 _ _ h4 h3 0 b,
          ← t3 _ _ _ (cm AD (A0 - P0) _ _ h2 h5 0 b)
            (cm (AD - PD) P0 _ _ h6 h3 0 b) (cm PD P0 _ _ h4 h3 0 b)]
        congr 1; funext θ
        simp only [sA b θ, sD 0 θ]; ring
      show qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h) *
        (Wcov5 B G l0 S2 0 b ξ - Wcov5 B G l0 S 0 b ξ - covPr5 B G c b ξ) = _
      rw [WS2 0 b, WS 0 b, eCov, Y1, Y2]
      linear_combination (wmoPair5 (A0 - P0) AD 0 b ξ + wmoPair5 P0 (AD - PD) 0 b ξ +
        wmoPair5 AD (A0 - P0) 0 b ξ + wmoPair5 (AD - PD) P0 0 b ξ + wmoPair5 AD AD 0 b ξ) * hKQ
  
  refine ⟨fun a b => ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun b => ?_⟩
  · have hK1 : InM B (qsOf l0) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS)
        (fun ξ => wmoPair5 A0 AD a b ξ + wmoPair5 AD A0 a b ξ) :=
      algM _ _ _ 1 1 _ _ _ (hPC A0 AD _ _ h1 h2 a b) (hPC AD A0 _ _ h2 h1 a b)
        (by linarith) (by linarith) (fun ξ _ => by (try dsimp only); ring)
    exact algM _ _ _ 1 1 _ _ _ hK1 (hPC AD AD _ _ h2 h2 a b) le_rfl (by linarith)
      (fun ξ hξ => by rw [(key ξ hξ).2.1 a b]; (try dsimp only); ring)
  · exact algM _ _ _ 1 0 _ _ _ (hPC A0 A0 _ _ h1 h1 a b) (hPC A0 A0 _ _ h1 h1 a b)
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (fun ξ hξ => by rw [(key ξ hξ).1 a b]; ring)
  · have T1 : InM B (qsOf l0) (Bo + 17/25 - kapS)
        (fun ξ => wmoPair5 (A0 - P0) AD 0 b ξ + wmoPair5 P0 (AD - PD) 0 b ξ) :=
      algM _ _ _ 1 1 _ _ _ (hPC _ _ _ _ h5 h2 0 b) (hPC _ _ _ _ h3 h6 0 b)
        (by linarith) (by linarith) (fun ξ _ => by (try dsimp only); ring)
    have T2 : InM B (qsOf l0) (Bo + 17/25 - kapS)
        (fun ξ => wmoPair5 (A0 - P0) AD 0 b ξ + wmoPair5 P0 (AD - PD) 0 b ξ +
          wmoPair5 AD (A0 - P0) 0 b ξ) :=
      algM _ _ _ 1 1 _ _ _ T1 (hPC _ _ _ _ h2 h5 0 b) le_rfl (by linarith)
        (fun ξ _ => by (try dsimp only); ring)
    have T3 : InM B (qsOf l0) (Bo + 17/25 - kapS)
        (fun ξ => wmoPair5 (A0 - P0) AD 0 b ξ + wmoPair5 P0 (AD - PD) 0 b ξ +
          wmoPair5 AD (A0 - P0) 0 b ξ + wmoPair5 (AD - PD) P0 0 b ξ) :=
      algM _ _ _ 1 1 _ _ _ T2 (hPC _ _ _ _ h6 h3 0 b) le_rfl (by linarith)
        (fun ξ _ => by (try dsimp only); ring)
    exact algM _ _ _ 1 1 _ _ _ T3 (hPC _ _ _ _ h2 h2 0 b) le_rfl (by linarith)
      (fun ξ hξ => by rw [(key ξ hξ).2.2 b]; (try dsimp only); ring)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (S : CState) (bw ca cm cd : ℝ), StOrd5 B G l0 S bw ca cm cd → ∀ (Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), corrOn B l0 x t → evOff B.h (dUX5 B G l0 S) Y₀ x t = cyl2cart x (fun a => mcor5 B G l0 S a (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) + qC B.h (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) a)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨ls, hsplit⟩ := wmo_velocity_split_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lp, hpair⟩ := wave_theta_pair_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lw, hw⟩ := wmo_amp_class_v5 B G hok hG
  have hB1 := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hB1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨ls + lp + lw + n0, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 S bw ca cm cd hSt Y₀ x t hxt
  have hSt' := hSt
  unfold StOrd5 at hSt'
  obtain ⟨c1, -, c3, c4, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, c16, -⟩ := hSt'
  
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0.le
  set Y := Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀ with hY
  have hξ : ptOf x t Y ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := ⟨hxt.1, hxt.2.1, hxt.2.2⟩
  
  have hc1' : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1/2 + 1/2) S.Aw := by
    have e : (1/2 + 1/2 : ℝ) = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [e]
    exact c1
  have hP := (hw l0 (by omega)).1 S.Aw (1/2) hc1' c16
  obtain ⟨H, H0, hH⟩ := hP.1
  
  have hpr := hpair l0 (by omega) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw)
    ⟨H, H0, fun γ m hm => ⟨hH γ m hm, hH γ m hm⟩⟩
    (fun γ m => ⟨(hP.2.1 γ m).continuousOn, (hP.2.1 γ m).continuousOn⟩)
    (fun γ m ξ hξ' => ⟨hP.2.2.2.1 γ m ξ hξ', hP.2.2.2.1 γ m ξ hξ'⟩)
    (ptOf x t Y) hξ
  
  have hUB : uB B x t = cyl2cart x (fun i => ubase B (ptOf x t Y) i) :=
    (ubase5_axisym B hok).1 x t Y ⟨hxt.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hxt.2.2 hqsB⟩ hxt.1
  
  have hrep : ∀ (θ : ℝ) (a : Fin 3), ucyl5 B G l0 S θ (ptOf x t Y) a =
      ucyl5 B G l0 (wmoBase S) 0 (ptOf x t Y) a +
        qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) θ (ptOf x t Y) a :=
    fun θ a => (hsplit l0 (by omega) S S.Aw S.pw 1 1 c1 c1 c3 c4 (ptOf x t Y) hξ θ a).1
  have hmean : ∀ a : Fin 3, thA (fun θ => ucyl5 B G l0 S θ (ptOf x t Y) a) =
      ucyl5 B G l0 (wmoBase S) 0 (ptOf x t Y) a := by
    intro a
    have hfe : (fun θ => ucyl5 B G l0 S θ (ptOf x t Y) a) = fun θ =>
        ucyl5 B G l0 (wmoBase S) 0 (ptOf x t Y) a +
          qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) θ (ptOf x t Y) a :=
      funext (fun θ => hrep θ a)
    have hpi : (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hz := (hpr a a).2.1
    unfold thA at hz
    have hI : ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), waveV5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) θ (ptOf x t Y) a = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hz with h | h
      · exact absurd h (inv_ne_zero hpi)
      · exact h
    have hkc : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) *
        waveV5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) θ (ptOf x t Y) a) :=
      continuous_const.mul (hpr a a).1
    unfold thA
    rw [hfe, intervalIntegral.integral_add (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _)
      (hkc.intervalIntegrable _ _), intervalIntegral.integral_const,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hI, mul_zero, add_zero,
      smul_eq_mul, sub_zero, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hpi, one_mul]
  
  have hn : ‖(⟨x 0, x 1⟩ : ℂ)‖ = rad x := by
    rw [Complex.norm_def, Complex.normSq_apply]
    show Real.sqrt (x 0 * x 0 + x 1 * x 1) = Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2)
    ring_nf
  have hc : rad x * Real.cos (thetaOf x) = x 0 := by
    have h := Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg (⟨x 0, x 1⟩ : ℂ)
    rw [hn] at h
    exact h
  have hs : rad x * Real.sin (thetaOf x) = x 1 := by
    have h := Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg (⟨x 0, x 1⟩ : ℂ)
    rw [hn] at h
    exact h
  have hrot : rotPt (rad x) (thetaOf x) (x 2) = x := by
    ext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [rotPt, hc, hs]
  have hr2 : rad x ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hr : 0 < rad x := hxt.1
  have hinv : (rad x)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) = 1 := by
    rw [← hr2]
    field_simp
  have hrec : ∀ v : ℝ³, cyl2cart x (fun a => inner ℝ v ((![eR x, eTh x, eZ] : Fin 3 → ℝ³) a)) = v := by
    intro v
    ext j
    fin_cases j
    · simp [cyl2cart, eR, eTh, eZ, radVec, azVec, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination (v 0) * hinv
    · simp [cyl2cart, eR, eTh, eZ, radVec, azVec, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination (v 1) * hinv
    · simp [cyl2cart, eR, eTh, eZ, radVec, azVec, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have hu : uX5 B G l0 S x t Y = cyl2cart x (fun a => ucyl5 B G l0 S (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y) a) := by
    have hfe : (fun a => ucyl5 B G l0 S (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y) a) =
        fun a => inner ℝ (uX5 B G l0 S x t Y) ((![eR x, eTh x, eZ] : Fin 3 → ℝ³) a) := by
      funext a
      show inner ℝ (uX5 B G l0 S (rotPt (rad x) (thetaOf x) (x 2)) t Y)
        ((![eR (rotPt (rad x) (thetaOf x) (x 2)), eTh (rotPt (rad x) (thetaOf x) (x 2)), eZ] :
          Fin 3 → ℝ³) a) = _
      rw [hrot]
    rw [hfe, hrec]
  
  have hL : evOff B.h (dUX5 B G l0 S) Y₀ x t = uX5 B G l0 S x t Y - uB B x t := rfl
  have hcmp : ∀ a : Fin 3, ucyl5 B G l0 S (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y) a =
      (mcor5 B G l0 S a (ptOf x t Y) + ubase B (ptOf x t Y) a) +
        qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y) a := by
    intro a
    rw [hrep]
    unfold mcor5
    rw [hmean a]
    ring
  rw [hL, hu, hUB]
  simp only [hcmp]
  simp only [cyl2cart, add_smul]
  abel

        qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) θ ξ a ∧

    (hok.1.1 (ptOf x t Y).2.1 (1 - (ptOf x t Y).2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ.2.1])).1
  have hFc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2)
      ((ptOf x t Y).2.1, 1 - (ptOf x t Y).2.2.1) :=

      ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - (ptOf x t Y).2.2.1 by linarith [hξ.2.1]⟩)
  have hqd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (qC B.h) (ptOf x t Y) := by
    have hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) (ptOf x t Y) := by
      fun_prop
    have hcomp : DifferentiableAt ℝ ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))) (ptOf x t Y) :=
      DifferentiableAt.comp (ptOf x t Y) (hFc.differentiableAt (by simp)) hg
    exact hcomp
  have hF := hqd.hasFDerivAt
  have hd1 : dZ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-B.h)) (ptOf x t Y) =
      (-B.h * qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-B.h - 1)) * dZ (qC B.h) (ptOf x t Y) := by
    unfold dZ
    rw [(hF.rpow_const (p := -B.h) (Or.inl hq.ne')).fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hd2 : dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) (ptOf x t Y) =
      (qC B.h (ptOf x t Y))⁻¹ * dZ (qC B.h) (ptOf x t Y) := by
    unfold dZ
    rw [(hF.log hq.ne').fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hA : qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) * qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (1/2:ℝ) =
      qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-B.h) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]
    congr 1
    unfold Aex
    ring
  have hcoef : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (i : Fin 3),
      ((qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) * wmoAmp5 B G D γ m (ptOf x t Y) i =
        ssh5Vw B G D γ m (ptOf x t Y) i := by
    intro γ m i
    have hQ : 0 < Qb γ.1 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
    have e1 : ((qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (((qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        ((qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-B.h) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul]
      congr 1
      rw [Real.div_rpow hq.le hQ.le, Real.rpow_neg hQ.le, div_eq_mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, hA]
    have e2 : ((qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ((B.h * qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) (ptOf x t Y) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        -((dZ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-B.h)) (ptOf x t Y) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_neg]
      congr 1
      rw [hd1, hd2, Real.rpow_sub_one hq.ne']
      calc qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) *
            (B.h * qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (1/2:ℝ) * ((qC B.h (ptOf x t Y))⁻¹ * dZ (qC B.h) (ptOf x t Y)))
          = B.h * (qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) * qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (1/2:ℝ)) *
              (qC B.h (ptOf x t Y))⁻¹ * dZ (qC B.h) (ptOf x t Y) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hA]; ring
    have hw : ∀ c : Fin 3 → ℂ, (![-(c 1), c 0, 0] : Fin 3 → ℂ) i = -(rotC c i) := by
      intro c
      fin_cases i <;> simp [rotC]
    simp only [wmoAmp5, ssh5Vw, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hw]
    linear_combination (velW5 B G D γ m (ptOf x t Y) i) * e1 + (rotC (D γ m (ptOf x t Y)) i) * e2
  have hwave : ∀ (θ : ℝ) (i : Fin 3),
      qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G D) θ (ptOf x t Y) i =
        waveV5 B G (ssh5Vw B G D) θ (ptOf x t Y) i := by
    intro θ i
    simp only [waveV5]
    rw [← Complex.re_ofReal_mul, mul_finsum]
    congr 1
    refine finsum_congr (fun γ => ?_)
    rw [mul_finsum]
    refine finsum_congr (fun m => ?_)
    rw [← mul_assoc, hcoef γ m i]
  have hdef : wIncX5 B G l0 D = sw5W B G l0 D := rfl
  show wIncX5 B G l0 D x t Y = _
  rw [hdef, hsw x t Y hxt]
  congr 1
  funext a
  exact (hwave (thetaOf x) a).symm

subgoal_signatures.name: ssh5_vel_rep
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (α β : ℝ) (D : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α D → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β (velW5 B G D) → (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ssh5Vw B G D γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) ∧ (∀ γ m, D γ m = 0 → ssh5Vw B G D γ m = 0) ∧ (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → ssh5Vw B G D γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) ∧ ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → sw5W B G l0 D x t Y = cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (ssh5Vw B G D) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (Mn : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℝ) (P Q : WC) (α β : ℝ) (U V : Ext ℝ³), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Mn (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α P → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β Q → (∀ (Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), corrOn B l0 x t → evOff B.h U Y₀ x t = cyl2cart x (fun a => Mn (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) a + qC B.h (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G P (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) a)) → (∀ (Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), corrOn B l0 x t → evOff B.h V Y₀ x t = cyl2cart x (fun a => qC B.h (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G Q (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) a)) → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → pwrTr B.h U V x t Y + pwrTr B.h V U x t Y = cyl2cart x (fun a => qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) * waveV5 B G (pchG5 B G Mn P Q) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y) a + pchZ5 B G Mn P Q (ptOf x t Y) a)

signature.name: pch5_transport_identity
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (Mn : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℝ) (P Q : WC) (α β : ℝ) (U V : Ext ℝ³), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Mn (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α P → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β Q → (∀ (Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), corrOn B l0 x t → evOff B.h U Y₀ x t = cyl2cart x (fun a => Mn (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) a + qC B.h (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G P (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) a)) → (∀ (Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), corrOn B l0 x t → evOff B.h V Y₀ x t = cyl2cart x (fun a => qC B.h (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G Q (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) a)) → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → pwrTr B.h U V x t Y + pwrTr B.h V U x t Y = cyl2cart x (fun a => qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) * waveV5 B G (pchG5 B G Mn P Q) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y) a + pchZ5 B G Mn P Q (ptOf x t Y) a)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lD, hLD⟩ := pq5_label_disjoint B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨lD + n0, fun l0 hl0 Mn P Q α β U V hMn hP hQ hU hV x t Y hc => ?_⟩
  
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0.le
  
  have hc' : 0 < rad x ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hc
  obtain ⟨hDopen, -, hqpos, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  obtain ⟨Y0, hY0⟩ : ∃ Y0 : ℝ × ℝ, Y0 = Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ⟩ : ∃ ξ : Cyl, ξ = ptOf x t Y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hζx : ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0) = ξ := by rw [hξ, hY0]; simp
  have hξD : ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := by rw [hξ]; exact hc
  have hq : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξD
  have hDn : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∈ nhds ξ := hDopen.mem_nhds hξD
  have hMnd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Mn ξ := (hMn.contDiffAt hDn).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hMnCd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (pchMnC5 Mn) ξ :=
    differentiableAt_pi.2 (fun i => Complex.ofRealCLM.differentiableAt.comp ξ (differentiableAt_pi.1 hMnd i))
  have hMnCd' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (pchMnC5 Mn) (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) := by
    rw [hζx]; exact hMnCd
  obtain ⟨HP, -, hHP⟩ := hP.1
  obtain ⟨HQ, -, hHQ⟩ := hQ.1
  have hHP' : ∀ γ m, m ∉ HP → P γ m = 0 := fun γ m hm => hHP γ m hm
  have hHQ' : ∀ γ m, m ∉ HQ → Q γ m = 0 := fun γ m hm => hHQ γ m hm
  
  have hTr0 : ∀ (γ : Lab) (k : ℤ) (bt : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ) (η : Cyl), pchTr5 B G γ k 0 bt η = 0 := by
    intro γ k bt η
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [pchTr5]
  have hfs : ∀ (a : WC) (θ : ℝ) (η : Cyl) (Γ : Finset Lab) (H : Finset ℤ),
      (∀ γ m, γ ∉ Γ → a γ m η = 0) → (∀ γ m, m ∉ H → a γ m η = 0) →
      ∀ i, waveV5 B G a θ η i = (∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, a γ m η i * ephase5 B G γ m θ η).re := by
    intro a θ η Γ H hΓ hH i
    unfold waveV5
    congr 1
    have hin : ∀ γ, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, a γ m η i * ephase5 B G γ m θ η =
        ∑ m ∈ H, a γ m η i * ephase5 B G γ m θ η := by
      intro γ
      apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
      intro m hm
      by_contra hmH
      apply hm
      have h0 : a γ m η = 0 := hH γ m (fun h => hmH (Finset.mem_coe.mpr h))
      simp [h0]
    simp only [hin]
    apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
    intro γ hγ
    by_contra hγΓ
    apply hγ
    have h0 : ∀ m, a γ m η = 0 := fun m => hΓ γ m (fun h => hγΓ (Finset.mem_coe.mpr h))
    simp [h0]
  have hsplit : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (θ : ℝ) (η : Cyl), ephase5 B G γ m θ η =
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) := by
    intro γ m θ η
    unfold ephase5
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have hcadd : ∀ (y : ℝ³) (u v : Fin 3 → ℝ), cyl2cart y u + cyl2cart y v = cyl2cart y (fun i => u i + v i) := by
    intro y u v
    simp only [cyl2cart, add_smul]
    abel
  
  have hlin : ∀ (a b d : Fin 3 → ℝ) (s1 s2 s3 : ℝ),
      s1 • cyl2cart x a + s2 • cyl2cart x b + s3 • cyl2cart x d =
        cyl2cart x (fun i => s1 * a i + s2 * b i + s3 * d i) := by
    intro a b d s1 s2 s3
    simp only [cyl2cart, add_smul, smul_add, smul_smul]
    abel
  have hjet : ∀ (n' : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (v : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ c (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y0)) →
      fderiv ℝ (modeF5 B.h 0 t Y0 n' c) x (cyl2cart x v) =
        cyl2cart x (fun i => (pq5TrM B.h n' (fun a => ((v a : ℝ) : ℂ)) c ξ i *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n' : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re) := by
    intro n' c v hcd
    have hR := pq5_jet_R B.h t Y0 n' c x hok.1 hc'.2.1 hc'.1 hcd
    have hZ := pq5_jet_Z B.h t Y0 n' c x hok.1 hc'.2.1 hc'.1 hcd
    have hT := pq5_jet_Th B.h t Y0 n' c x hok.1 hc'.2.1 hc'.1 hcd
    rw [hζx] at hR hZ hT
    have e1 : cyl2cart x v = v 0 • eR x + v 1 • eTh x + v 2 • eZ := rfl
    rw [e1, map_add, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, map_smul, hR, hZ, hT, hlin]
    congr 1
    funext i
    rw [← Complex.re_ofReal_mul, ← Complex.re_ofReal_mul, ← Complex.re_ofReal_mul,
      ← Complex.add_re, ← Complex.add_re]
    congr 1
    rw [hξ]
    fin_cases i <;> simp [pq5TrM, ptOf] <;> ring
  
  have hTr : ∀ (W : WC) (αW : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) αW W → ∀ (γ : Lab) (n : ℤ) (v : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      fderiv ℝ (modeF5 B.h 0 t Y0 (n * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G (pchAmp5 B W) γ n)) x (cyl2cart x v) =
        cyl2cart x (fun i => (pchTr5 B G γ n (fun a => ((v a : ℝ) : ℂ)) (pchAmp5 B W γ n) ξ i *
          ephase5 B G γ n (thetaOf x) ξ).re) := by
    intro W αW hW γ n v
    obtain ⟨hd, he⟩ := pch5_tr_phase B G hok hG (qsOf l0) αW W hqsB hW γ n (fun a => ((v a : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ hξD
    rw [hjet _ _ v (by rw [hζx]; exact hd), he]
    congr 1
    funext i
    beta_reduce
    rw [hsplit]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hcd : ∀ (W : WC) (αW : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) αW W → ∀ (γ : Lab) (n : ℤ),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeF5 B.h 0 t Y0 (n * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G (pchAmp5 B W) γ n)) x := by
    intro W αW hW γ n
    refine modeF5_differentiable_v5 B.h 0 t Y0 _ _ x hok.1 hc'.2.1 hc'.1 ?_
    rw [hζx]
    exact (pch5_tr_phase B G hok hG (qsOf l0) αW W hqsB hW γ n 0 ξ hξD).1
  have hF0d : DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeF5 B.h 0 t Y0 0 (pchMnC5 Mn)) x :=
    modeF5_differentiable_v5 B.h 0 t Y0 0 _ x hok.1 hc'.2.1 hc'.1 hMnCd'
  have hF0 : ∀ y, modeF5 B.h 0 t Y0 0 (pchMnC5 Mn) y = cyl2cart y (Mn (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y0))) := by
    intro y
    simp [modeF5, pchMnC5]
  
  obtain ⟨OP, ΓP, hOPo, hxOP, hOPc, hΓP, hexpP⟩ := pch5_local_modes B G l0 P α HP hok hP hHP' x t Y0 hc
  obtain ⟨OQ, ΓQ, hOQo, hxOQ, hOQc, hΓQ, hexpQ⟩ := pch5_local_modes B G l0 Q β HQ hok hQ hHQ' x t Y0 hc
  obtain ⟨Γ, hΓ⟩ : ∃ Γ : Finset Lab, Γ = ΓP ∪ ΓQ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPΓ : ΓP ⊆ Γ := by rw [hΓ]; exact Finset.subset_union_left
  have hQΓ : ΓQ ⊆ Γ := by rw [hΓ]; exact Finset.subset_union_right
  have hON : OP ∩ OQ ∈ nhds x := (hOPo.inter hOQo).mem_nhds ⟨hxOP, hxOQ⟩
  have hVslice : (fun y => evOff B.h V Y0 y t) =ᶠ[nhds x] fun y => ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ n ∈ HQ,
      modeF5 B.h 0 t Y0 (n * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G (pchAmp5 B Q) γ n) y := by
    filter_upwards [hON] with y hy
    rw [hV Y0 y t (hOQc y hy.2), hexpQ Γ hQΓ y hy.2]
  have hUslice : (fun y => evOff B.h U Y0 y t) =ᶠ[nhds x] fun y => modeF5 B.h 0 t Y0 0 (pchMnC5 Mn) y +
      ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ HP, modeF5 B.h 0 t Y0 (m * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G (pchAmp5 B P) γ m) y := by
    filter_upwards [hON] with y hy
    rw [hU Y0 y t (hOPc y hy.1), ← hexpP Γ hPΓ y hy.1, hF0, hcadd]
  
  have hDV : fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h V Y0 y t) x = ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ n ∈ HQ,
      fderiv ℝ (modeF5 B.h 0 t Y0 (n * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G (pchAmp5 B Q) γ n)) x := by
    rw [hVslice.fderiv_eq, fderiv_fun_sum (fun γ _ => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun n _ => hcd Q β hQ γ n))]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
    exact fderiv_fun_sum (fun n _ => hcd Q β hQ γ n)
  have hDU : fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h U Y0 y t) x = fderiv ℝ (modeF5 B.h 0 t Y0 0 (pchMnC5 Mn)) x +
      ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ HP, fderiv ℝ (modeF5 B.h 0 t Y0 (m * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G (pchAmp5 B P) γ m)) x := by
    rw [hUslice.fderiv_eq, fderiv_fun_add hF0d
      (DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun γ _ => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun m _ => hcd P α hP γ m))),
      fderiv_fun_sum (fun γ _ => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun m _ => hcd P α hP γ m))]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
    exact fderiv_fun_sum (fun m _ => hcd P α hP γ m)
  
  have hΓPz : ∀ γ m, γ ∉ Γ → P γ m ξ = 0 := by
    intro γ m hγ
    have h := hΓP γ (fun h => hγ (hPΓ h)) m
    rw [hζx] at h
    exact h.eq_of_nhds
  have hΓQz : ∀ γ m, γ ∉ Γ → Q γ m ξ = 0 := by
    intro γ m hγ
    have h := hΓQ γ (fun h => hγ (hQΓ h)) m
    rw [hζx] at h
    exact h.eq_of_nhds
  have hwv : ∀ (W : WC) (H : Finset ℤ), (∀ γ m, γ ∉ Γ → W γ m ξ = 0) → (∀ γ m, m ∉ H → W γ m = 0) →
      ∀ j, qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G W (thetaOf x) ξ j =
        (∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, pchAmp5 B W γ m ξ j * ephase5 B G γ m (thetaOf x) ξ).re := by
    intro W H hWΓ hWH j
    rw [hfs W (thetaOf x) ξ Γ H hWΓ (fun γ m hm => by rw [hWH γ m hm]; rfl) j, ← Complex.re_ofReal_mul,
      Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
    simp only [pchAmp5, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  obtain ⟨αU, hαUdef⟩ : ∃ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, v = fun a => Mn ξ a + qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G P (thetaOf x) ξ a :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨αV, hαVdef⟩ : ∃ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, v = fun a => qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) * waveV5 B G Q (thetaOf x) ξ a :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hUx : evOff B.h U Y0 x t = cyl2cart x αU := by rw [hU Y0 x t hc, hζx, hαUdef]
  have hVx : evOff B.h V Y0 x t = cyl2cart x αV := by rw [hV Y0 x t hc, hζx, hαVdef]
  have hαU : (fun a => ((αU a : ℝ) : ℂ)) = fun j => ((Mn ξ j +
      (∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ HP, pchAmp5 B P γ m ξ j * ephase5 B G γ m (thetaOf x) ξ).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    funext j
    simp only [hαUdef]
