signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (g : WC) (α : ℝ) (Zv : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℝ) (F : Ext ℝ³), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α g → (∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → F x t Y = cyl2cart x (fun a => qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) * waveV5 B G g (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y) a + Zv (ptOf x t Y) a)) → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → F x t Y - thAvgVec F x t Y = (qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2))) • cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G g (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok _hG
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  intro l0 _hl0 g α Zv F hg hF
  
  have hcirc : ∀ (a : WS) (ξ : Cyl) (r z : ℝ) (H : Finset ℤ)
      (T : Finset Lab), 0 < r → (0 : ℤ) ∉ H → (∀ γ m, m ∉ H → a γ m ξ = 0) → (∀ γ m, γ ∉ T → a γ m ξ = 0) →
      Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => waveS5 B G a (thetaOf (rotPt r θ z)) ξ) ∧
      thA (fun θ : ℝ => waveS5 B G a (thetaOf (rotPt r θ z)) ξ) = 0 := by
    intro a ξ r z H T hr hH0 hH hT
    have hpint : ∀ γ : Lab, pint5 B G γ ≠ 0 := by
      intro γ
      unfold pint5
      split_ifs with h
      · exact one_ne_zero
      · exact h
    have hphase : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (θ : ℝ), ephase5 B G γ m (thetaOf (rotPt r θ z)) ξ =
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) := by
      intro γ m θ
      have e0 : rotPt r θ z 0 = r * Real.cos θ := by simp [rotPt]
      have e1 : rotPt r θ z 1 = r * Real.sin θ := by simp [rotPt]
      have hc : (⟨rotPt r θ z 0, rotPt r θ z 1⟩ : ℂ) =
          (r : ℂ) * (Complex.cos (θ : ℂ) + Complex.sin (θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
        rw [e0, e1]
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [Complex.cos_ofReal_re, Complex.sin_ofReal_re]
      have hth : thetaOf (rotPt r θ z) = toIocMod Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ := by
        unfold thetaOf
        rw [hc]
        exact Complex.arg_mul_cos_add_sin_mul_I_eq_toIocMod hr θ
      have hn := self_sub_toIocMod Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ
      have hmod : toIocMod Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ =
          θ - ((toIocDiv Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
        rw [zsmul_eq_mul] at hn
        linarith
      have hth' : ((thetaOf (rotPt r θ z) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
          (θ : ℂ) - ((toIocDiv Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) := by
        rw [hth, hmod]
        push_cast
        ring
      have key : Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((pint5 B G γ : ℂ) *
            ((θ : ℂ) - ((toIocDiv Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) +
            (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)) =
          (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)) +
            Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) +
          ((-(m * pint5 B G γ * toIocDiv Real.two_pi_pos (-Real.pi) θ) : ℤ) : ℂ) *
            (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      unfold ephase5
      rw [hth', key, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I, mul_one, Complex.exp_add]
    have hgen : ∀ (s : Finset (Lab × ℤ)) (c : Lab × ℤ → ℂ) (k : Lab × ℤ → ℤ), (∀ i ∈ s, k i ≠ 0) →
        Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => (∑ i ∈ s, c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re) ∧
        ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (∑ i ∈ s, c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re = 0 := by
      intro s c k hk
      have hcont : ∀ i, Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))) :=
        fun i => continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
          (continuous_const.mul Complex.continuous_ofReal))
      have hF : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => ∑ i ∈ s, c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))) :=
        continuous_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hcont i)
      refine ⟨Complex.continuous_re.comp hF, ?_⟩
      have h1 : ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (∑ i ∈ s, c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re =
          (∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            ∑ i ∈ s, c i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re := by
        have := ContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_comp_comm Complex.reCLM
          (hF.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) 0 (2 * Real.pi))
        simpa only [Complex.reCLM_apply] using this
      rw [h1, intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun i _ => (hcont i).intervalIntegrable _ _)]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero, Complex.zero_re]
      intro i hi
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      have hw : Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
        mul_ne_zero Complex.I_ne_zero (Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr (hk i hi))
      rw [integral_exp_mul_complex hw]
      have e2 : Complex.I * (k i : ℂ) * ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) =
          (k i : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [e2, Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I]
      simp
    have hfin : ∀ θ' : ℝ, waveS5 B G a θ' ξ =
        (∑ p ∈ T ×ˢ H, a p.1 p.2 ξ * ephase5 B G p.1 p.2 θ' ξ).re := by
      intro θ'
      unfold waveS5
      congr 1
      have hin : ∀ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, a γ m ξ * ephase5 B G γ m θ' ξ =
          ∑ m ∈ H, a γ m ξ * ephase5 B G γ m θ' ξ := by
        intro γ
        apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
        intro m hm
        by_contra hmH
        exact (Function.mem_support.mp hm)
          (by rw [hH γ m (fun h => hmH (Finset.mem_coe.mpr h)), zero_mul])
      rw [finsum_congr hin, finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset (s := T)]
      · exact (Finset.sum_product T H (fun p : Lab × ℤ => a p.1 p.2 ξ * ephase5 B G p.1 p.2 θ' ξ)).symm
      · intro γ hγ
        by_contra hγT
        apply Function.mem_support.mp hγ
        exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun m _ => by
          rw [hT γ m (fun h => hγT (Finset.mem_coe.mpr h)), zero_mul])
    have hfun : (fun θ : ℝ => waveS5 B G a (thetaOf (rotPt r θ z)) ξ) = fun θ : ℝ =>
        (∑ p ∈ T ×ˢ H, (a p.1 p.2 ξ * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (p.2 : ℂ) *
          ((kb B.h p.1.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G p.1 ξ : ℂ)))) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((p.2 * pint5 B G p.1 : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))).re := by
      funext θ
      rw [hfin]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      rw [hphase]
      ring
    have hk : ∀ p ∈ T ×ˢ H, p.2 * pint5 B G p.1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro p hp
      have hp2 : p.2 ∈ H := (Finset.mem_product.mp hp).2
      have hne : p.2 ≠ 0 := fun h => hH0 (h ▸ hp2)
      exact mul_ne_zero hne (hpint p.1)
    obtain ⟨hC, hI⟩ := hgen (T ×ˢ H)
      (fun p => a p.1 p.2 ξ * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (p.2 : ℂ) *
        ((kb B.h p.1.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G p.1 ξ : ℂ))))
      (fun p => p.2 * pint5 B G p.1) hk
    rw [hfun]
    refine ⟨hC, ?_⟩
    simp only [thA, hI, mul_zero]
  
  have hrot : ∀ r θ z : ℝ, 0 < r → rad (rotPt r θ z) = r ∧ rotPt r θ z 2 = z := by
    intro r θ z hr
    constructor
    · have h : (rotPt r θ z) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt r θ z) 1 ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
        simp [rotPt]
        rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, ← mul_add, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, mul_one]
      unfold rad
      rw [h, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
    · simp [rotPt]
  have hframe : ∀ (y : ℝ³), 0 < rad y → ∀ (v : Fin 3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
      inner ℝ (cyl2cart y v) (![eR y, eTh y, eZ] a) = v a := by
    intro y hy v a
    have hr2 : rad y ^ 2 = y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
    have hne : rad y ≠ 0 := hy.ne'
    have hs : (rad y)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) = 1 := by
      rw [← hr2]; field_simp
    fin_cases a <;>
      simp [cyl2cart, eR, eTh, eZ, radVec, azVec, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three] <;>
      first
      | linear_combination (v 0) * hs
      | linear_combination (v 1) * hs
  have hthA : ∀ (c z : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → thA f = 0 →
      thA (fun θ => c * f θ + z) = z := by
    intro c z f hf h0
    have hpi : (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hI : ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), f θ = 0 := by
      unfold thA at h0
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h0 with h | h
      · exact absurd h (inv_ne_zero hpi)
      · exact h
    unfold thA
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add ((hf.const_mul c).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _), intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const, hI, smul_eq_mul, sub_zero, mul_zero, zero_add]
    rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hpi, one_mul]
  intro x t Y hxt
  have hxt' : 0 < rad x ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hxt
  have hξ : ptOf x t Y ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := hxt
  have hrx : 0 < rad x := hxt'.1
  obtain ⟨H, h0H, hH⟩ := hg.1
  
  have hloc : ∀ (h : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → ∀ ξ0 : Cyl, ξ0.2.2.1 < 1 → ∃ N ∈ nhds ξ0, ∃ Γ : Finset Lab,
      ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ N → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) → γ ∈ Γ := by
    intro h hS ξ0 hξ0
    have hLc : ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ContinuousAt (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) ξ := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hτ : 0 < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 := by linarith
      have hqpos : 0 < qC h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).1
      have hqcont : ContinuousAt (qC h) ξ := by
        have hU : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
        have hp : ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
          ⟨trivial, hτ⟩
        have hg : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) :=
          hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)
        have hk : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) ξ := by fun_prop
        have he : qC h = (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘
            (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
          funext η; rfl
        rw [he]
        exact ContinuousAt.comp hg hk
      exact hqcont.logb hqpos.ne'
    have hwin : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (γ : Lab), ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) →
        |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) + (γ.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartR h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartZ h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartT h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
      intro ξ γ hξ hγ
      have s1 : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ → 1 < |φ ξ / μ - (j : ℝ)| →
          ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 := by
        intro μ j φ hφ h1
        have hψ : ContinuousAt (fun η => |φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)|) ξ :=
          ((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs
        have hev := (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : Cyl => (1:ℝ)) ξ).eventually_lt hψ h1
        filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
        have hsq : 1 < (φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)) ^ 2 := (one_lt_sq_iff_one_lt_abs _).mpr hη
        unfold sqPart bumpR
        rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), zero_div]
      have key : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ →
          (∀ η, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 → etaL h γ η = 0) → |φ ξ / μ - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
        intro μ j φ hφ himp
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have hev := s1 μ j φ hφ hc
        apply (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mpr _) hγ
        filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
        exact himp η hη
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have := key 1 (-(γ.1:ℤ)) (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) (hLc ξ hξ)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul])
        simpa [div_one, sub_neg_eq_add] using this
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.1 (chartR h γ.1) (by unfold chartR; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.1 (chartZ h γ.1) (by unfold chartZ; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.2 (chartT h γ.1) (by unfold chartT; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
    obtain ⟨L0, hL0⟩ : ∃ L0 : ℝ, L0 = Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hfin : (⋃ n ∈ Set.Iic ⌊2 - L0⌋₊, ({n} : Set ℕ) ×ˢ
        ((Set.Icc ⌈chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ⌈chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ⌈chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋) ×ˢ
          (Set.univ : Set Bool))).Finite := by
      refine Set.Finite.biUnion (Set.finite_Iic _) (fun n _ => ?_)
      exact (Set.finite_singleton n).prod (((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod
        ((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod (Set.finite_Icc _ _))).prod Set.finite_univ)
    have hI : ∀ (x c : ℝ) (j : ℤ), |x - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 → |x - c| < 1 → j ∈ Set.Icc ⌈c - 2⌉ ⌊c + 2⌋ := by
      intro x c j hj hc
      rw [abs_le] at hj
      rw [abs_lt] at hc
      exact ⟨Int.ceil_le.mpr (by linarith [hj.2, hc.1]), Int.le_floor.mpr (by linarith [hj.1, hc.2])⟩
    have hcR : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartR h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartR; fun_prop
    have hcZ : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartZ h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartZ; fun_prop
    have hcT : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartT h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartT; fun_prop
    have hch : ∀ (φ : Cyl → ℝ) (μ : ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ0 →
        ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, |φ ξ / μ - φ ξ0 / μ| < 1 := by
      intro φ μ hφ
      exact (((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs).eventually_lt continuousAt_const
        (by simp)
    have e1 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 :=
      (show ContinuousAt (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.2.2.1) ξ0 by fun_prop).eventually_lt
        continuousAt_const hξ0
    have e2 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) - L0| < 1 :=
      (((hLc ξ0 hξ0).sub continuousAt_const).abs).eventually_lt continuousAt_const
        (by simp [hL0])
    have e3 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊2 - L0⌋₊ + 1),
        |chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 := by
      rw [Filter.eventually_all_finset]
      intro n _
      exact (hch _ _ (hcR n)).and ((hch _ _ (hcZ n)).and (hch _ _ (hcT n)))
    refine ⟨{ξ | ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) - L0| < 1 ∧
        ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊2 - L0⌋₊ + 1),
        |chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1}, ?_,
      hfin.toFinset, ?_⟩
    · filter_upwards [e1, e2, e3] with ξ h1 h2 h3
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    rintro ⟨n, ⟨a, b, c⟩, σ⟩ ξ ⟨ht, hL, hC⟩ hγ
    obtain ⟨w0, wR, wZ, wT⟩ := hwin ξ _ ht hγ
    simp only at w0 wR wZ wT
    rw [abs_le] at w0
    rw [abs_lt] at hL
    have hn : n ≤ ⌊2 - L0⌋₊ := Nat.le_floor (by linarith [w0.2, hL.1])
    obtain ⟨cR, cZ, cT⟩ := hC n (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn))
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨n, hn, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨rfl, ⟨hI _ _ _ wR cR, hI _ _ _ wZ cZ, hI _ _ _ wT cT⟩, trivial⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN, Γ, hΓ⟩ := hloc B.h hok.1 (ptOf x t Y) hxt'.2.1
  have hTz : ∀ γ m, γ ∉ Γ → g γ m (ptOf x t Y) = 0 := by
    intro γ m hγ
    by_contra hne
    exact hγ (hΓ γ (ptOf x t Y) (mem_of_mem_nhds hN) (hg.2.2.2.1 γ m (ptOf x t Y) hξ hne).2.1)
  have hmean : thAvgVec F x t Y = cyl2cart x (fun a => Zv (ptOf x t Y) a) := by
    unfold thAvgVec
    congr 1
    funext a
    have hfun : (fun θ => inner ℝ (F (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) =
        fun θ => qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) *
          waveS5 B G (fun γ m η => g γ m η a) (thetaOf (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) (ptOf x t Y)
          + Zv (ptOf x t Y) a := by
      funext θ
      obtain ⟨hr, hzz⟩ := hrot (rad x) θ (x 2) hrx
      have hc : corrOn B l0 (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t := by
        show 0 < rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) ∧ t < 1 ∧
          simScale B.h ((rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0
        rw [hr, hzz]
        exact hxt'
      have hp : ptOf (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y = ptOf x t Y := by
        show (rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)), (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 2, t, Y) = (rad x, x 2, t, Y)
        rw [hr, hzz]
      rw [hF _ t Y hc, hp]
      have hf : frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a =
          ![eR (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)), eTh (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)), eZ] a := rfl
      rw [hf, hframe _ (by rw [hr]; exact hrx)]
      rfl
    have hm1 : ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → g γ m (ptOf x t Y) a = 0 := by
      intro γ m hm
      rw [hH γ m hm]
      rfl
    have hm2 : ∀ γ m, γ ∉ Γ → g γ m (ptOf x t Y) a = 0 := by
      intro γ m hγ
      rw [hTz γ m hγ]
      rfl
    obtain ⟨hcont, hz⟩ := hcirc (fun γ m η => g γ m η a) (ptOf x t Y)
      (rad x) (x 2) H Γ hrx h0H hm1 hm2
    rw [hfun]
    exact hthA _ _ _ hcont hz
  rw [hmean, hF x t Y hxt]
  simp only [cyl2cart, add_smul, smul_add, smul_smul]
  abel

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (S : CState) (bw ca cm cd β : ℝ) (D : WC), StOrd5 B G l0 S bw ca cm cd → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 1/2) D → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β (velW5 B G D) → (∃ H : Finset ℤ, (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧ ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → pchG5 B G (fun ξ a => mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m = 0) ∧ (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pchG5 B G (fun ξ a => mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) ∧ (∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ c, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c → pchG5 B G (fun ξ a => mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m (shY ξ c) = pchG5 B G (fun ξ a => mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m ξ) ∧ (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → pchG5 B G (fun ξ a => mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ)

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (S : CState) (bw ca cm cd β : ℝ) (D : WC), StOrd5 B G l0 S bw ca cm cd → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 1/2) D → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β (velW5 B G D) → (∃ H : Finset ℤ, (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧ ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → pchG5 B G (fun ξ a => mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m = 0) ∧ (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pchG5 B G (fun ξ a => mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) ∧ (∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ c, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c → pchG5 B G (fun ξ a => mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m (shY ξ c) = pchG5 B G (fun ξ a => mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m ξ) ∧ (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → pchG5 B G (fun ξ a => mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lP, hPS⟩ := pulse_support_good_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lw, hw⟩ := wmo_amp_class_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨lB, hB⟩ := band_coarse_gap_v5 B.h hh0 hh1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨lP + lw + lB + n0 + 7, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 S bw ca cm cd β D hSt hD hDv
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0.le
  unfold StOrd5 at hSt
  obtain ⟨c1, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, c16, -, c18, c19, -, c21, -, -⟩ := hSt
  have hc1' : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1/2 + 1/2) S.Aw := by
    have e : (1/2 + 1/2 : ℝ) = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [e]
    exact c1
  have hP := (hw l0 (by omega)).1 S.Aw (1/2) hc1' c16
  have hQ := (hw l0 (by omega)).1 D β hD hDv
  
  have hT : IsOpen {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd.snd.fst continuous_const
  have hπq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) :=
    contDiff_snd.fst.prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h4 := hok.1.2.2.2.1
    exact h4.comp hπq.contDiffOn (fun ξ (hξ : ξ.2.2.1 < 1) =>
      (⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩ : (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) ∈ univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)))
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have h1 : IsOpen {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst
    have h2 := hqC.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hT (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ ({ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0)) := by
      ext ξ; exact Iff.rfl
    rw [e]; exact h1.inter h2
  have hqpos : ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → 0 < qC B.h ξ := fun ξ hξ =>
    (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hdom : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 :=
    fun ξ hξ => hξ
  have hDT : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ⊆ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} := fun ξ hξ => (hdom ξ hξ).2.1
  have ofR : ∀ {f : Cyl → ℝ} {s : Set Cyl}, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) s := fun hf =>
    (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hf).congr (fun η _ => by simp)
  have hdRZ : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (F : Cyl → V) (O : Set Cyl),
      IsOpen O → (∀ η ∈ O, 0 < η.1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F O →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h F) O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ F) O := by
    intro V _ _ F O hO hpos hF
    have hDf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) O :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hF).2
    have hpow : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) O :=
      contDiff_fst.contDiffOn.rpow_const_of_ne (fun ξ hξ => (hpos ξ hξ).ne')
    have hY : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) O :=
      (contDiffOn_const.mul hpow).smul_const _
    have hvR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl =>
        ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)) O :=
      contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk hY))
    exact ⟨(hDf.clm_apply hvR).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl),
      (hDf.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)⟩
  have hgr : ∀ (g : Cyl → ℝ) (α : ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (Aex B.h) g) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro g α hg
    have hqa : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      (hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (p := -Aex B.h) (fun ξ hξ => (hqpos ξ hξ).ne')).mono hDT
    refine (hqa.mul hg.1).congr (fun η hη => ?_)
    have hq := hqpos η (hDT hη)
    show g η = qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h) * (qC B.h η ^ Aex B.h * g η)
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hq, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero, one_mul]
  have hgd : ∀ (g : Cyl → ℝ) (α : ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B (Aex B.h) g) →
      ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ c, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h η) c → g (shY η c) = g η := by
    intro g α hg η hη c hc
    have h := hg.2.1 η hη c hc
    have hq := hqpos η (hDT hη)
    have h' : qC B.h η ^ Aex B.h * g (shY η c) = qC B.h η ^ Aex B.h * g η := h
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _).ne' h'
  have hMs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pchMnC5 (fun ξ a => mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    refine contDiffOn_pi.mpr (fun i => ?_)
    fin_cases i
    · exact ofR (hgr _ _ c21)
    · exact ofR (hgr _ _ c18)
    · exact ofR (hgr _ _ c19)
  have hMd : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ c, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h η) c →
      pchMnC5 (fun ξ a => mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) (shY η c) = pchMnC5 (fun ξ a => mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) η := by
    intro η hη c hc
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · show ((mcor5 B G l0 S 0 (shY η c) : ℝ) : ℂ) = ((mcor5 B G l0 S 0 η : ℝ) : ℂ)
      rw [hgd _ _ c21 η hη c hc]
    · show ((mcor5 B G l0 S 1 (shY η c) : ℝ) : ℂ) = ((mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η : ℝ) : ℂ)
      rw [hgd _ _ c18 η hη c hc]
    · show ((mcor5 B G l0 S 2 (shY η c) : ℝ) : ℂ) = ((mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η : ℝ) : ℂ)
      rw [hgd _ _ c19 η hη c hc]
  suffices key : ∀ (Mn : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℝ) (P Q : WC) (αP αQ : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) αP P →
      InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) αQ Q → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pchMnC5 Mn) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ c, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h η) c → pchMnC5 Mn (shY η c) = pchMnC5 Mn η) →
      (∃ H : Finset ℤ, (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧ ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → pchG5 B G Mn P Q γ m = 0) ∧
      (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pchG5 B G Mn P Q γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) ∧
      (∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ c, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c →
        pchG5 B G Mn P Q γ m (shY ξ c) = pchG5 B G Mn P Q γ m ξ) ∧
      (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → pchG5 B G Mn P Q γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) by
    exact key _ _ _ _ _ hP hQ hMs hMd
  intro Mn P Q αP αQ hP hQ hMs hMd
  
  have Z0' : ∀ (γ : Lab) (n : ℤ) (al : Fin 3 → ℂ) (bt : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ) (η : Cyl), al = 0 →
      pchTr5 B G γ n al bt η = 0 := by
    rintro γ n al bt η rfl
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [pchTr5]
  have Zev : ∀ (γ : Lab) (n : ℤ) (al : Fin 3 → ℂ) (bt : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ) (η : Cyl),
      bt =ᶠ[nhds η] (fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ)) → pchTr5 B G γ n al bt η = 0 := by
    intro γ n al bt η hev
    have h0 : bt η = 0 := hev.eq_of_nhds
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ bt η = 0 := by
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]; exact fderiv_const_apply _
    have hr : dR B.h bt η = 0 := by
      unfold dR; rw [hfd, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    have hz : dZ bt η = 0 := by
      unfold dZ; rw [hfd, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [pchTr5, h0, hr, hz]
  have AmpV : ∀ (X : WC) (γ : Lab) (k : ℤ) (η : Cyl), X γ k η = 0 → pchAmp5 B X γ k η = 0 := by
    intro X γ k η h
    show ((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) • X γ k η = 0
    rw [h, smul_zero]
  have Amp0ev : ∀ (X : WC) (γ : Lab) (k : ℤ) (η : Cyl), X γ k =ᶠ[nhds η] (fun _ => 0) →
      pchAmp5 B X γ k =ᶠ[nhds η] (fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ)) := by
    intro X γ k η h
    filter_upwards [h] with x hx
    exact AmpV X γ k x hx
  have EvZ : ∀ (X : WC) (γ : Lab) (k : ℤ) (η : Cyl), X γ k = 0 →
      pchAmp5 B X γ k =ᶠ[nhds η] (fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ)) := by
    intro X γ k η h
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => AmpV X γ k x (by simp [h]))
  have PairZ : ∀ (X Y : WC) (N : ℤ) (γ : Lab) (η : Cyl), (∀ m, X γ m η = 0 ∨
      (Y γ (N - m) =ᶠ[nhds η] (fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ)) ∧ Y γ (N + m) =ᶠ[nhds η] (fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ)))) →
      pchPair5 B G X Y N γ η = 0 := by
    intro X Y N γ η h
    unfold pchPair5
    apply finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
    intro m
    rcases h m with h | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · rw [Z0' γ (N - m) (X γ m η) (Y γ (N - m)) η h,
        Z0' γ (N + m) (fun i => star (X γ m η i)) (Y γ (N + m)) η (by funext i; simp [h])]
      simp
    · rw [Zev γ (N - m) _ _ η h1, Zev γ (N + m) _ _ η h2]
      simp
  have LocZero : ∀ (γ : Lab) (N : ℤ) (η : Cyl), (∀ m, P γ m =ᶠ[nhds η] (fun _ => 0)) →
      (∀ m, Q γ m =ᶠ[nhds η] (fun _ => 0)) → pchHar5 B G Mn P Q γ N η = 0 := by
    intro γ N η hPe hQe
    unfold pchHar5
    rw [Zev γ N (pchMnC5 Mn η) (pchAmp5 B Q γ N) η (Amp0ev Q γ N η (hQe N)),
      Z0' γ 0 (pchAmp5 B Q γ N η) (pchMnC5 Mn) η (AmpV Q γ N η (hQe N).eq_of_nhds),
      PairZ (pchAmp5 B P) (pchAmp5 B Q) N γ η (fun m => Or.inl (AmpV P γ m η (hPe m).eq_of_nhds)),
      PairZ (pchAmp5 B Q) (pchAmp5 B P) N γ η (fun m => Or.inl (AmpV Q γ m η (hQe m).eq_of_nhds))]
    simp
  obtain ⟨HP, hP0, hPv⟩ := hP.1
  obtain ⟨HQ, hQ0, hQv⟩ := hQ.1
  
  have HarZ : ∀ γ N η, N ∉ HQ → (∀ p ∈ HP, ∀ q ∈ HQ, p + q ≠ N) → (∀ p ∈ HP, ∀ q ∈ HQ, q - p ≠ N) →
      (∀ p ∈ HP, ∀ q ∈ HQ, p - q ≠ N) → pchHar5 B G Mn P Q γ N η = 0 := by
    intro γ N η h1 h2 h3 h4
    have e1 : pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B P) (pchAmp5 B Q) N γ η = 0 := by
      apply PairZ
      intro m
      by_cases hm : m ∈ HP
      · right
        exact ⟨EvZ Q γ _ η (hQv γ _ (fun hq => h2 m hm _ hq (by ring))),
          EvZ Q γ _ η (hQv γ _ (fun hq => h3 m hm _ hq (by ring)))⟩
      · left; exact AmpV P γ m η (by simp [hPv γ m hm])
    have e2 : pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B Q) (pchAmp5 B P) N γ η = 0 := by
      apply PairZ
      intro m
      by_cases hm : m ∈ HQ
      · right
        exact ⟨EvZ P γ _ η (hPv γ _ (fun hp => h2 _ hp m hm (by ring))),
          EvZ P γ _ η (hPv γ _ (fun hp => h4 _ hp m hm (by ring)))⟩
      · left; exact AmpV Q γ m η (by simp [hQv γ m hm])
    unfold pchHar5
    rw [Zev γ N _ _ η (EvZ Q γ N η (hQv γ N h1)),
      Z0' γ 0 _ _ η (AmpV Q γ N η (by simp [hQv γ N h1])), e1, e2]
    simp
  have hi : ∃ H : Finset ℤ, (0 : ℤ) ∉ H ∧ ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → pchG5 B G Mn P Q γ m = 0 := by
    refine ⟨(HQ ∪ (HP ×ˢ HQ).image (fun p => p.1 + p.2) ∪ (HP ×ˢ HQ).image (fun p => p.2 - p.1) ∪
      (HP ×ˢ HQ).image (fun p => p.1 - p.2)).erase 0, Finset.notMem_erase _ _, ?_⟩
    intro γ N hN
    funext η
    show pchG5 B G Mn P Q γ N η = 0
    by_cases hN0 : N = 0
    · simp [pchG5, hN0]
    have hmem : ∀ x ∈ (HQ ∪ (HP ×ˢ HQ).image (fun p => p.1 + p.2) ∪ (HP ×ˢ HQ).image (fun p => p.2 - p.1) ∪
        (HP ×ˢ HQ).image (fun p => p.1 - p.2)), x ≠ N := by
      intro x hx hxN
      subst hxN
      exact hN (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hN0, hx⟩)
    have h1 : N ∉ HQ := fun h => hmem N
      (Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ h))) rfl
    have h2 : ∀ p ∈ HP, ∀ q ∈ HQ, p + q ≠ N := fun p hp q hq => hmem _
      (Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_right _
        (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(p, q), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hp, hq⟩, rfl⟩))))
    have h3 : ∀ p ∈ HP, ∀ q ∈ HQ, q - p ≠ N := fun p hp q hq => hmem _
      (Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_right _
        (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(p, q), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hp, hq⟩, rfl⟩)))
    have h4 : ∀ p ∈ HP, ∀ q ∈ HQ, p - q ≠ N := fun p hp q hq => hmem _
      (Finset.mem_union_right _
        (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(p, q), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hp, hq⟩, rfl⟩))
    simp only [pchG5, if_neg hN0]
    rw [HarZ γ N η h1 h2 h3 h4, smul_zero]
  
  have hTS : ∀ γ N ξ, pchHar5 B G Mn P Q γ N ξ ≠ 0 →
      ∃ m, ξ ∈ tsupport (P γ m) ∨ ξ ∈ tsupport (Q γ m) := by
    intro γ N ξ hne
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    exact hne (LocZero γ N ξ (fun m => notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp (hcon m).1)
      (fun m => notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp (hcon m).2))
  have hiv : ∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → pchG5 B G Mn P Q γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ := by
    intro γ N ξ hξ hne
    have hH : pchHar5 B G Mn P Q γ N ξ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; apply hne; unfold pchG5; split_ifs <;> simp [h0]
    obtain ⟨m, hm | hm⟩ := hTS γ N ξ hH
    · exact (hPS l0 (by omega) αP P hP γ m ξ hξ hm).1
    · exact (hPS l0 (by omega) αQ Q hQ γ m ξ hξ hm).1
  
  have TrS : ∀ (γ : Lab) (n : ℤ) (O : Set Cyl) (al bt : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ), IsOpen O → (∀ η ∈ O, 0 < η.1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ al O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ bt O →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ η i) O) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => pchTr5 B G γ n (al η) bt η) O := by
    intro γ n O al bt hO hpos hal hbt hnO
    obtain ⟨hrb, hzb⟩ := hdRZ bt O hO hpos hbt

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (S : CState) (bw ca cm cd β : ℝ) (D : WC), StOrd5 B G l0 S bw ca cm cd → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 1/2) D → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β (velW5 B G D) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b d : ℝ, ∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (pchG5 B G (fun ξ a => mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (β + 2/5)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) * Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)

signature.name: pch5_coeff_bound
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (S : CState) (bw ca cm cd β : ℝ) (D : WC), StOrd5 B G l0 S bw ca cm cd → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 1/2) D → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β (velW5 B G D) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b d : ℝ, ∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (pchG5 B G (fun ξ a => mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (β + 2/5)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) * Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lT, hT⟩ := pch5_transversal B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lM, hMW⟩ := pch5_mw_bound B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lP, hPW⟩ := pch5_pw_bound B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lw, hw⟩ := wmo_amp_class_v5 B G hok hG
  refine ⟨lT + lM + lP + lw, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 S bw ca cm cd β D hS hD hDv k
  have hS' := hS
  unfold StOrd5 at hS'
  obtain ⟨c1, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, c16, -, c18, c19, -, c21, -, -⟩ := hS'
  have hh0 : 0 ≤ B.h := hok.2.1.1.le
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  have hDq : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < qC B.h ξ ∧ qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 ∧ 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
    have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
      show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
      exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    intro ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨-, e2, e3⟩ := hξ
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
    refine ⟨hq0, by linarith, ?_⟩
    unfold SC
    have : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| := by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))]
    exact one_le_pow₀ this
  have hEdge : ∀ X : ℝ, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb → 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X ∧
      0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ∧ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ≤ 1 := by
    intro X e1 e2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, min_le_left _ _⟩
    · unfold edgeWeight
      split_ifs
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      · exact le_rfl
    · have hX : 0 < X := lt_trans hXa e1
      have l1 : 0 < Real.log (X / B.Xa) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr e1)
      have l2 : 0 < Real.log (B.Xb / X) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr e2)
      exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min l1 l2)
  
  have hW : ∀ (q Sv E e P C1 C2 b1 b2 d1 d2 α α1 α2 N1 N2 : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → 1 ≤ Sv → 0 ≤ E →
      0 < e → e ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ P → α ≤ α1 → α ≤ α2 →
      N1 ≤ C1 * q ^ (B.h * α1) * Sv ^ b1 * E * e ^ (-d1) * P →
      N2 ≤ C2 * q ^ (B.h * α2) * Sv ^ b2 * E * e ^ (-d2) * P →
      N1 + N2 ≤ (|C1| + |C2|) * q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P := by
    intro q Sv E e P C1 C2 b1 b2 d1 d2 α α1 α2 N1 N2 hq0 hq1 hS1 hE he0 he1 hP0 ha1 ha2 hN1 hN2
    have key : ∀ (C b d αi N : ℝ), α ≤ αi → N ≤ C * q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P →
        b ≤ max b1 b2 → d ≤ max d1 d2 →
        N ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) := by
      intro C b d αi N hα hN hb hd
      have f1 : q ^ (B.h * αi) ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hα hh0)
      have f2 : Sv ^ b ≤ Sv ^ (max b1 b2) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 hb
      have f3 : e ^ (-d) ≤ e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge he0 he1 (neg_le_neg hd)
      have p1 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * αi) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
      have p2 : 0 ≤ Sv ^ b := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have p3 : 0 ≤ e ^ (-d) := Real.rpow_nonneg he0.le _
      have p1' : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
      have p2' : 0 ≤ Sv ^ (max b1 b2) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have m1 : q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) := mul_le_mul f1 f2 p2 p1'
      have m2 : q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E ≤ q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right m1 hE
      have m3 : q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) ≤
          q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) :=
        mul_le_mul m2 f3 p3 (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p1' p2') hE)
      have hWi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right m3 hP0
      have hWi0 : 0 ≤ q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p1 p2) hE) p3) hP0
      calc N ≤ C * q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P := hN
        _ = C * (q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P) := by ring
        _ ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * αi) * Sv ^ b * E * e ^ (-d) * P) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) hWi0
        _ ≤ |C| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hWi (abs_nonneg C)
    have k1 := key C1 b1 d1 α1 N1 ha1 hN1 (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
    have k2 := key C2 b2 d2 α2 N2 ha2 hN2 (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
    have e : (|C1| + |C2|) * q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P =
        |C1| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) +
        |C2| * (q ^ (B.h * α) * Sv ^ (max b1 b2) * E * e ^ (-(max d1 d2)) * P) := by ring
    rw [e]
    linarith
  
  have hNB : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f1 f2 g : Cyl → V) (k : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl),
      ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f1 (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f2 (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), g η = f1 η + f2 η) → NB B.h g k ξ ≤ NB B.h f1 k ξ + NB B.h f2 k ξ := by
    intro V _ _ f1 f2 g k ξ hξ hf1 hf2 heq
    have hn : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∈ nhds ξ := hDopen.mem_nhds hξ
    have hev : g =ᶠ[nhds ξ] f1 + f2 := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hn (fun η hη => heq η hη)
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g ξ = iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ := by
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
      exact iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((hf1.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        ((hf2.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    unfold NB
    rw [e1]
    have e2 : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f1 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) +
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f2 ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) := by
      ext m
      simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e2]
    exact norm_add_le _ _
  have hNB0 : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (k : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl),
      NB B.h (fun _ : Cyl => (0 : V)) k ξ = 0 := by
    intro V _ _ k ξ
    unfold NB
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
    have e : ((0 : Cyl → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => Cyl) V) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) = 0 := by
      ext m
      simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e, norm_zero]
  
  have hc1' : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (1/2 + 1/2) S.Aw := by
    have e : (1/2 + 1/2 : ℝ) = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [e]
    exact c1
  obtain ⟨hwA, -⟩ := hw l0 (by omega)
  have hP := hwA S.Aw (1/2) hc1' c16
  have hQ := hwA D β hD hDv
  have hTP := hT l0 (by omega) S.Aw (1/2) hc1' c16
  have hTQ := hT l0 (by omega) D β hD hDv
  have hMn : ∀ a : Fin 3, InM B (qsOf l0) 0.9 (nrm B (Aex B.h) (mcor5 B G l0 S a)) := by
    intro a
    fin_cases a
    · show InM B (qsOf l0) 0.9 (nrm B (Aex B.h) (mcor5 B G l0 S 0))
      obtain ⟨d1, d2, d3, d4⟩ := c21
      refine ⟨d1, d2, d3, fun j => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨C, b, d, hC⟩ := d4 j
      refine ⟨|C|, b, d, fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => le_trans (hC ξ hξ hX1 hX2) ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hq0, hq1, hS1⟩ := hDq ξ hξ
      obtain ⟨hE, he0, -⟩ := hEdge _ hX1 hX2
      have f1 : C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * 1.9) ≤ |C| * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * 0.9) :=
        calc C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * 1.9) ≤ |C| * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * 1.9) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)
          _ ≤ |C| * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * 0.9) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) hh0)) (abs_nonneg C)
      have hSb : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ b := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have hed : 0 ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) := Real.rpow_nonneg he0.le _
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right f1 hSb) hE) hed
    · exact c18
    · exact c19
  
  obtain ⟨sMW, bMW⟩ := hMW l0 (by omega) (fun ξ a => mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) (wmoAmp5 B G D) β hMn hQ
  obtain ⟨sPW, bPW⟩ := hPW l0 (by omega) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) (wmoAmp5 B G D) (1/2) β hP hQ hTP hTQ
  obtain ⟨C1, b1, d1, hb1⟩ := bMW k
  obtain ⟨C2, b2, d2, hb2⟩ := bPW k
  
  refine ⟨|C1| + |C2|, max b1 b2, max d1 d2, fun γ N ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hq0, hq1, hS1⟩ := hDq ξ hξ
  obtain ⟨-, he0, he1⟩ := hEdge _ hX1 hX2
  have hP0 : 0 ≤ Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by
    unfold Penv5
    exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hsplit : NB B.h (pchG5 B G (fun ξ a => mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ N) k ξ ≤
      NB B.h (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        (pchTr5 B G γ N (pchMnC5 (fun ξ a => mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) η) (pchAmp5 B (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ N) η +
          pchTr5 B G γ 0 (pchAmp5 B (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ N η) (pchMnC5 (fun ξ a => mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ)) η)) k ξ +
      NB B.h (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        (pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw)) (pchAmp5 B (wmoAmp5 B G D)) N γ η +
          pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B (wmoAmp5 B G D)) (pchAmp5 B (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw)) N γ η)) k ξ := by
    by_cases hN : N = 0
    · have hz : pchG5 B G (fun ξ a => mcor5 B G l0 S a ξ) (wmoAmp5 B G S.Aw) (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ N =
          fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ) := by
        funext η
        simp [pchG5, hN]
      rw [hz, hNB0]
      exact add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
    · refine hNB _ _ _ k ξ hξ (sMW γ N) (sPW γ N) (fun η _ => ?_)
      show (if N = 0 then 0 else _) = _
      rw [if_neg hN]
      simp only [pchHar5, smul_add]
      abel
  have hk : kapS = 1 / 100000 := rfl
  have hle : β + 2/5 ≤ 1/2 + β - kapS := by rw [hk]; linarith
  exact le_trans hsplit (hW _ _ _ _ _ C1 C2 b1 b2 d1 d2 (β + 2/5) (β + 2/5) (1/2 + β - kapS) _ _
    hq0 hq1 hS1 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) he0 he1 hP0 le_rfl hle (hb1 γ N ξ hξ hX1 hX2) (hb2 γ N ξ hξ hX1 hX2))

subgoal_signatures.name: pch5_transversal
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (c : WC) (β : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 1/2) c → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β (velW5 B G c) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β - kapS) (pchPh5 B G c)

subgoal_signatures.name: pch5_mw_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (Mn : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℝ) (Q : WC) (β : ℝ), (∀ a : Fin 3, InM B (qsOf l0) 0.9 (nrm B (Aex B.h) (fun ξ => Mn ξ a))) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β Q → (∀ (γ : Lab) (N : ℤ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (pchTr5 B G γ N (pchMnC5 Mn η) (pchAmp5 B Q γ N) η + pchTr5 B G γ 0 (pchAmp5 B Q γ N η) (pchMnC5 Mn) η)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b d : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (N : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (pchTr5 B G γ N (pchMnC5 Mn η) (pchAmp5 B Q γ N) η + pchTr5 B G γ 0 (pchAmp5 B Q γ N η) (pchMnC5 Mn) η)) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (β + 2/5)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) * Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)

subgoal_signatures.name: pch5_pw_bound

by
  intro B hB
  
  have geom : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} ∧
      ∀ (l : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => baseC B l (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) i)

    obtain ⟨hS, hBP⟩ := hB
    have hsc : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hA : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
      have hm : Continuous (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2)) := by fun_prop
      have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2)))
          {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} := by
        refine hsc.comp hm.continuousOn ?_
        intro s hs
        have hs' : s.2.2 < 1 := hs
        exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - s.2.2 by linarith⟩
      have hU : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
      have h1 := hc.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := B.qB))
      have h2 : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst
      have e : {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} =
          {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1} ∩ ({s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} ∩
            ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2))) ⁻¹'
              Iio B.qB) := by
        ext s
        simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_inter_iff, mem_preimage, mem_Iio, Function.comp]
      rw [e]
      exact h2.inter h1
    have hD : IsOpen (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      have hm : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)) := by fun_prop
      have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)))

      have hU : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
      have h1 := hc.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := B.qB))
      have e : simDomain B.h B.qB = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩

        ext w
        simp only [simDomain, mem_setOf_eq, mem_inter_iff, mem_preimage, mem_Iio, Function.comp]
      rw [e]
      exact h1
    have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(uB B)) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by

    have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ := by

    have hmaps : MapsTo ψ {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}

  have hUbd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (logLift B.Ub) (Real.log (qC B.h ξ), XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) :=
    (hUbs.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hp)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hO2 : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hp2 : (XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨hX0, hη1', hη2'⟩
  have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿B.F) (XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) :=
    (hFs.contDiffAt (hO2.mem_nhds hp2)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hUd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿B.U) (XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) :=
    (hUs.contDiffAt (hO2.mem_nhds hp2)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hproj : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (w.2.1, w.2.2))
      (Real.log (qC B.h ξ), XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) := by fun_prop
  have hFc : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => B.F w.2.1 w.2.2)
      (Real.log (qC B.h ξ), XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) :=
    DifferentiableAt.comp (g := ↿B.F) (f := fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (w.2.1, w.2.2)) _ hFd hproj
  have hUc : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => B.U w.2.1 w.2.2)
      (Real.log (qC B.h ξ), XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) :=
    DifferentiableAt.comp (g := ↿B.U) (f := fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (w.2.1, w.2.2)) _ hUd hproj
  have hsqd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * w.2.1))
      (Real.log (qC B.h ξ), XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) := by
    refine DifferentiableAt.sqrt ?_ h2X
    fun_prop
  have hPd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * w.2.1) * B.F w.2.1 w.2.2)
      (Real.log (qC B.h ξ), XC B.h ξ, etaC B.h ξ) := hsqd.mul hFc
  obtain ⟨b0E, b0U, -⟩ := hC0 (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) hq0 hdom.2.2 hX1 hX2 hη1' hη2'
  obtain ⟨b1E, b1U, -⟩ := hC1 (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) hq0 hdom.2.2 hX1 hX2 hη1' hη2'
  have hqp : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
  have hk0 : C0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h) ≤ K0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC0K hqp
  have hk1 : C1 * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h) ≤ K0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC1K hqp
  obtain ⟨hEdiff, hEval, hEder⟩ := slice B.Eb (fun X η => Real.sqrt (2 * X) * B.F X η) (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ)
    (etaC B.h ξ) (K0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h)) hq0 hEd hPd (b0E.trans hk0) (b1E.trans hk1)
  obtain ⟨hUdiff, -, hUder⟩ := slice B.Ub B.U (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ)
    (etaC B.h ξ) (K0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h)) hq0 hUbd hUc (b0U.trans hk0) (b1U.trans hk1)
  have hEval' : |B.Eb (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) -
      Real.sqrt (2 * XC B.h ξ) * B.F (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ)| ≤ K0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h) := hEval
  have hEder' : |deriv (fun Y => B.Eb (qC B.h ξ) Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ) -
      deriv (fun Y => Real.sqrt (2 * Y) * B.F Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ)| ≤ K0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h) := hEder
  
  have hFXd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun Y => B.F Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ) :=
    DifferentiableAt.comp (g := ↿B.F) (f := fun Y : ℝ => (Y, etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ) hFd (by fun_prop)
  have hsqrt : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * Y)) (1 / Real.sqrt (2 * XC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ) := by
    have := ((hasDerivAt_id' (XC B.h ξ)).const_mul 2).sqrt h2X
    convert this using 1
    exact (mul_div_mul_left (1:ℝ) (Real.sqrt (2 * XC B.h ξ)) two_ne_zero).symm
  have hprod : HasDerivAt (fun Y => Real.sqrt (2 * Y) * B.F Y (etaC B.h ξ))
      (1 / Real.sqrt (2 * XC B.h ξ) * B.F (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) +
        Real.sqrt (2 * XC B.h ξ) * deriv (fun Y => B.F Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ) :=
    hsqrt.mul hFXd.hasDerivAt
  have hPder : deriv (fun Y => Real.sqrt (2 * Y) * B.F Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ) =
      Real.sqrt (2 * XC B.h ξ) * deriv (fun Y => B.F Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ) +
        B.F (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) / Real.sqrt (2 * XC B.h ξ) := by
    rw [hprod.deriv]; ring
  rw [hPder] at hEder'
  
  obtain ⟨hFaLine, -⟩ := rep_line (fun Y => B.Eb (qC B.h ξ) Y (etaC B.h ξ))
    (Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 + B.h))) (qC B.h ξ) (Qb l) ξ.1
    (deriv (fun Y => B.Eb (qC B.h ξ) Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ)) hq0 hQ0 hr hEdiff.hasDerivAt
  obtain ⟨-, hBLine⟩ := rep_line (fun Y => B.Ub (qC B.h ξ) Y (etaC B.h ξ))
    (Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 + B.h))) (qC B.h ξ) (Qb l) ξ.1
    (deriv (fun Y => B.Ub (qC B.h ξ) Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ)) hq0 hQ0 hr hUdiff.hasDerivAt
  have hfdFa := line_fd (pcFa5 B l) _ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) _ hr hdFa hFaLine (by
    intro r' hr'
    show pcB5 B l 1 (r', ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) / pcRC5 l (r', ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) = _
    rw [(rep r' hr').1]
    rfl)
  have hfdB := line_fd (pcB5 B l 2) _ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) _ hr (hdB 2) hBLine (by
    intro r' hr'
    show pcB5 B l 2 (r', ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) = _
    rw [(rep r' hr').2])
  have hFaval : pcFa5 B l (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) = Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 + B.h)) *
      B.Eb (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) / (ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (Qb l)) := by
    show pcB5 B l 1 (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) / pcRC5 l (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) = _
    rw [(rep ξ.1 hr).1]
    rfl
  
  have hSa' : Sa ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * (ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ))) := by
    rw [hSadef]; apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt; rw [← hXe]; linarith
  have hSb' : Real.sqrt (2 * (ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * qC B.h ξ))) ≤ Sb := by
    rw [hSbdef]; apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt; rw [← hXe]; linarith
  have hK : 0 ≤ K0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h) := mul_nonneg hK00 hqp
  obtain ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4⟩ := r_alg (Qb l) (qC B.h ξ) ξ.1 (Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2 + B.h)))
    ((qC B.h ξ / Qb l) ^ (-(1 + B.h))) (B.F (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ))
    (deriv (fun Y => B.F Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ)) (deriv (fun Y => B.U Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ))
    (B.Eb (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ)) (deriv (fun Y => B.Eb (qC B.h ξ) Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ))
    (deriv (fun Y => B.Ub (qC B.h ξ) Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ)) (K0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h)) Sa Sb
    _ _ hQ0 hq0 hr haw hw0 hw4 hF0 hSa hSa' hSb' hK hEval' hEder' hUder rfl rfl
  rw [← hXe] at a2 a3
  
  have hP0 : 0 ≤ Qb l ^ B.h := Real.rpow_nonneg hQ0.le _
  have hK2 : K0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h) ≤ 2 * K0 * Qb l ^ B.h := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqQ hK00
    linarith
  have hCe : (8 * K0 / Sa + 8 * (Sb * K0 + K0 / Sa) + 8 * Sb * K0) * Qb l ^ B.h =
      8 * K0 / Sa * Qb l ^ B.h + 8 * (Sb * K0 + K0 / Sa) * Qb l ^ B.h + 8 * Sb * K0 * Qb l ^ B.h := by ring
  have m1 := mul_nonneg hA1 hP0
  have m2 := mul_nonneg hA2 hP0
  have m3 := mul_nonneg hA3 hP0
  have t1 : 4 * (K0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h)) / Sa ≤ 8 * K0 / Sa * Qb l ^ B.h := by
    calc 4 * (K0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h)) / Sa ≤ 4 * (2 * K0 * Qb l ^ B.h) / Sa := by gcongr
      _ = 8 * K0 / Sa * Qb l ^ B.h := by ring
  have t2 : 4 * (Sb * (K0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h)) + K0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h) / Sa) ≤
      8 * (Sb * K0 + K0 / Sa) * Qb l ^ B.h := by
    calc 4 * (Sb * (K0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h)) + K0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h) / Sa)
        ≤ 4 * (Sb * (2 * K0 * Qb l ^ B.h) + 2 * K0 * Qb l ^ B.h / Sa) := by gcongr
      _ = 8 * (Sb * K0 + K0 / Sa) * Qb l ^ B.h := by ring
  have t3 : 4 * Sb * (K0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h)) ≤ 8 * Sb * K0 * Qb l ^ B.h := by
    calc 4 * Sb * (K0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * B.h)) ≤ 4 * Sb * (2 * K0 * Qb l ^ B.h) := by gcongr
      _ = 8 * Sb * K0 * Qb l ^ B.h := by ring
  refine ⟨hdFa, hdB 2, hη1', hη2', ?_, ?_, ?_, a4⟩
  · rw [hFaval, hCe]
    linarith
  · rw [hfdFa, hCe]
    beta_reduce
    rw [← hXe]
    unfold shearA
    rw [show pcRC5 l (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) = ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (Qb l) from rfl]
    linarith
  · rw [hfdB, hCe]
    unfold shearB
    linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → 1/2 < qC B.h ξ / Qb l → qC B.h ξ / Qb l < 2 → B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb → |Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ (pcFa5 B l) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))| ≤ C * Qb l ^ B.h ∧ |Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ (pcB5 B l 2) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))| ≤ C * Qb l ^ B.h

signature.name: base_z_small5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → 1/2 < qC B.h ξ / Qb l → qC B.h ξ / Qb l < 2 → B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb → |Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ (pcFa5 B l) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))| ≤ C * Qb l ^ B.h ∧ |Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ (pcB5 B l 2) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))| ≤ C * Qb l ^ B.h

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hok
  
  have hout : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → q < B.qB → B.Xa / 2 ≤ X → X ≤ 2 * B.Xb →
      -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift B.Eb) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift B.Ub) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨⟨hh0, -, hXa, -, -, -, -, hqB0, hqB1, -, -, -, -⟩, ⟨hFs, hUs, -, hFb⟩, -, -, -, -,
      ⟨hEs, hUbs, -, hdev⟩, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2
    have hS : IsOpen (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hWo : IsOpen (Set.Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) :=
      isOpen_Iio.prod hS
    have hX0 : 0 < B.Xa / 2 := by linarith
    have hpt : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, p.1 ≠ 0 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1)) p := by
      intro p hp
      exact (contDiffAt_const.mul contDiffAt_fst).sqrt (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hp)
    have hsqS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1))
        (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
      fun p hp => (hpt p (ne_of_gt hp.1)).contDiffWithinAt
    have hMs : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Set.Icc (B.Xa / 2) (2 * B.Xb) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-1:ℝ) 1,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1)) p‖ ≤ M := by
      intro k
      have hK : IsCompact (Set.Icc (B.Xa / 2) (2 * B.Xb) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
        isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
      have hc : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1)))
          (Set.Icc (B.Xa / 2) (2 * B.Xb) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
        refine continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt (fun p hp => ?_)
        exact (hpt p (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le hX0 hp.1.1))).continuousAt_iteratedFDeriv
          (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      exact hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hc
    choose Ms hMs using hMs
    choose MF hMF using hFb (B.Xa / 2) (2 * B.Xb) hX0
    obtain ⟨C7, hC7⟩ := hdev (B.Xa / 2) (2 * B.Xb) hX0 m
    have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) * |Ms i| * |MF (m - i)| :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)
    obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ,
        C = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) * |Ms i| * |MF (m - i)| + |MF m| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hP2s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1) * (↿B.F) p)
        (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := hsqS.mul hFs
    have hP2b : ∀ X η : ℝ, B.Xa / 2 ≤ X → X ≤ 2 * B.Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1) * (↿B.F) p) (X, η)‖ ≤ C1 := by
      intro X η h1 h2 h3 h4
      have hpS : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
        ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hX0 h1, h3, h4⟩
      have hL : ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1) * (↿B.F) p)
          (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (X, η)‖ ≤
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) *
            ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1))
              (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (X, η)‖ *
            ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ (m - i) (↿B.F) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (X, η)‖ :=
        norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hsqS hFs hS.uniqueDiffOn hpS (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hS hpS] at hL
      have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) *
            ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1))
              (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (X, η)‖ *
            ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ (m - i) (↿B.F) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (X, η)‖ ≤
          (m.choose i : ℝ) * |Ms i| * |MF (m - i)| := by
        intro i _
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hS hpS, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (m - i) hS hpS]
        have a := (hMs i (X, η) ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3.le, h4.le⟩).trans (le_abs_self _)
        have b := ((hMF (m - i) X η h1 h2 h3 h4).1).trans (le_abs_self _)
        have c : (0:ℝ) ≤ (m.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
        exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a c) b (norm_nonneg _)
          (mul_nonneg c (abs_nonneg _))
      calc _ ≤ _ := hL
        _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
        _ ≤ C1 := by rw [hC1]; linarith [abs_nonneg (MF m)]
    have hproj : ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) → ∀ (m : ℕ)
        (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), w.2 ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => f w.2) w‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f w.2‖ := by
      intro f hf m w hw
      let π := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)
      have hU : IsOpen (π ⁻¹' (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) := hS.preimage π.continuous
      have hwU : w ∈ π ⁻¹' (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := hw
      have h1 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right π hf hS.uniqueDiffOn
        hU.uniqueDiffOn hwU (n := ∞) (i := m) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hU hwU,
        iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hS (show π w ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 from hw)] at h1
      have e : (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => f w.2) = f ∘ π := rfl
      rw [e, h1]
      refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
      have hp : ∏ _i : Fin m, ‖π‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Finset.prod_const]
        exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_snd_le ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (π w)‖ * ∏ _i : Fin m, ‖π‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (π w)‖ * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f w.2‖ := mul_one _
    refine ⟨|C7| + C1, ?_⟩
    intro q X η hq hqB hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2
    have hw : ((Real.log q, X, η) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈
        Set.Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
      ⟨Real.log_lt_log hq hqB, lt_of_lt_of_le hX0 hX1, hη1, hη2⟩

  obtain ⟨hE0, hU0⟩ := hA0 _ _ _ hqpos hqlt hXlo hXhi (abs_lt.mp heta).1 (abs_lt.mp heta).2
  obtain ⟨hE1, hU1⟩ := hA1 _ _ _ hqpos hqlt hXlo hXhi (abs_lt.mp heta).1 (abs_lt.mp heta).2
  rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hE0 hU0
  rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_one] at hE1 hU1
  obtain ⟨GE', hGE, hGEb⟩ := tC B.h Q (logLift B.Eb) ξ.2.1 D ξ.1 B.Xb |A0| |A1| hh0.le (by linarith)
    hD hqpos hDb hzb hXb' hdE (hE0.trans (le_abs_self _)) (hE1.trans (le_abs_self _))
  obtain ⟨GU', hGU, hGUb⟩ := tC B.h Q (logLift B.Ub) ξ.2.1 D ξ.1 B.Xb |A0| |A1| hh0.le (by linarith)
    hD hqpos hDb hzb hXb' hdU (hU0.trans (le_abs_self _)) (hU1.trans (le_abs_self _))
  rw [← hK] at hGEb hGUb
  
  have hrepr : ∀ y, Q y < B.qB →
      pcB5 B l 1 (ξ.1, y, ξ.2.2.1) = Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * (Q y ^ (-(1/2 + B.h)) *
        logLift B.Eb (Real.log (Q y), ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * Q y), y * Q y ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)))) ∧
      pcB5 B l 2 (ξ.1, y, ξ.2.2.1) = Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * (Q y ^ (-(1/2 + B.h)) *
        logLift B.Ub (Real.log (Q y), ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * Q y), y * Q y ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)))) := by
    intro y hy
    have hQy0 : 0 < Q y := by rw [hQy]; exact (hS1 _ _ hτ).1
    have hx0 : (rotPt ξ.1 0 y) 0 = ξ.1 := by simp [rotPt]
    have hx1 : (rotPt ξ.1 0 y) 1 = 0 := by simp [rotPt]
    have hx2 : (rotPt ξ.1 0 y) 2 = y := by simp [rotPt]
    have hmem : ((rotPt ξ.1 0 y, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB := by
      show ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ((rotPt ξ.1 0 y) 2) (1 - ξ.2.2.1) < B.qB
      rw [hx2, ← hQy]
      exact ⟨hDom.2.1, hy⟩
    have hpos : 0 < (rotPt ξ.1 0 y) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt ξ.1 0 y) 1 ^ 2 := by
      have h00 : (0:ℝ) ^ 2 = 0 := by norm_num
      rw [hx0, hx1, h00, add_zero]
      exact pow_pos hDom.1 2
    obtain ⟨hE, hU, -⟩ := hrep _ _ hmem hpos
    have hsimX : simX B.h (rotPt ξ.1 0 y) ξ.2.2.1 = ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * Q y) := by
      unfold simX
      rw [hx0, hx1, hx2, ← hQy]
      ring
    have hsimE : simEta B.h (rotPt ξ.1 0 y) ξ.2.2.1 = y * Q y ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)) := by
      unfold simEta
      rw [hx2, ← hQy]
    rw [hsimX, hsimE, hx2, ← hQy] at hE
    rw [hsimX, hsimE, hx2, ← hQy] at hU
    have hlE : logLift B.Eb (Real.log (Q y), ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * Q y), y * Q y ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))) =
        B.Eb (Q y) (ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * Q y)) (y * Q y ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))) := by
      show B.Eb (Real.exp (Real.log (Q y))) _ _ = _
      rw [Real.exp_log hQy0]
    have hlU : logLift B.Ub (Real.log (Q y), ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * Q y), y * Q y ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))) =
        B.Ub (Q y) (ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * Q y)) (y * Q y ^ (-(1/2 - B.h))) := by
      show B.Ub (Real.exp (Real.log (Q y))) _ _ = _
      rw [Real.exp_log hQy0]
    rw [hlE, hlU]
    constructor
    · have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt ((rotPt ξ.1 0 y) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt ξ.1 0 y) 1 ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hpos
      show Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => B.AB w ξ.2.2.1) (rotPt ξ.1 0 y) +
          B.BvB (rotPt ξ.1 0 y) ξ.2.2.1)
          ((Real.sqrt ((rotPt ξ.1 0 y) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt ξ.1 0 y) 1 ^ 2))⁻¹ • azVec (rotPt ξ.1 0 y)) = _
      rw [real_inner_smul_right, hE]
      field_simp
    · have hin : ∀ u : ℝ³, inner ℝ u (EuclideanSpace.single (2:Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) = u 2 := fun u => by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]; simp
      show Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => B.AB w ξ.2.2.1) (rotPt ξ.1 0 y) +
          B.BvB (rotPt ξ.1 0 y) ξ.2.2.1) (EuclideanSpace.single (2:Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) = _
      rw [hin, hU]
  have hV : Q ⁻¹' Iio B.qB ∈ nhds ξ.2.1 := hD.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (Iio_mem_nhds hqlt)
  have hevF : ∀ᶠ y in nhds ξ.2.1, pcFa5 B l (ξ.1, y, ξ.2.2.1) =
      (Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * Real.sqrt (Qb l) / ξ.1) * (Q y ^ (-(1/2 + B.h)) *
        logLift B.Eb (Real.log (Q y), ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * Q y), y * Q y ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)))) := by
    filter_upwards [hV] with y hy
    show pcB5 B l 1 (ξ.1, y, ξ.2.2.1) / (ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (Qb l)) = _
    rw [(hrepr y hy).1, div_div_eq_mul_div]
    ring
  have hevB : ∀ᶠ y in nhds ξ.2.1, pcB5 B l 2 (ξ.1, y, ξ.2.2.1) =
      Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * (Q y ^ (-(1/2 + B.h)) *
        logLift B.Ub (Real.log (Q y), ξ.1 ^ 2 / (2 * Q y), y * Q y ^ (-(1/2 - B.h)))) := by
    filter_upwards [hV] with y hy
    exact (hrepr y hy).2
  have hfF := tA (pcFa5 B l) _ _ ξ.1 ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1
    (hGE.const_mul (Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * Real.sqrt (Qb l) / ξ.1)) hevF
  have hfB := tA (pcB5 B l 2) _ _ ξ.1 ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 (hGU.const_mul (Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h))) hevB
  
  have hs0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (Qb l) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQb
  have hss : Real.sqrt (Qb l) * Real.sqrt (Qb l) = Qb l := Real.mul_self_sqrt hQb.le
  have hP0 : 0 < Qb l ^ B.h := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQb _
  have hQa : Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) = Real.sqrt (Qb l) * Qb l ^ B.h := by
    rw [Real.rpow_add hQb, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  have hGE2 : Qb l * |GE'| ≤ 2 * K := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQbq.le (abs_nonneg GE')
    linarith
  have hGU2 : Qb l * |GU'| ≤ 2 * K := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQbq.le (abs_nonneg GU')
    linarith
  have hr2 : Real.sqrt B.Xa * Real.sqrt (Qb l) ≤ ξ.1 := by
    rw [← Real.sqrt_mul hXa.le]
    have h1 : ξ.1 ^ 2 = 2 * Q ξ.2.1 * XC B.h ξ := by rw [hXv]; field_simp
    have h2 : B.Xa * (2 * Q ξ.2.1) ≤ XC B.h ξ * (2 * Q ξ.2.1) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hX1 (by linarith)
    have h3 : B.Xa * Qb l ≤ B.Xa * (2 * Q ξ.2.1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQbq.le hXa.le
    calc Real.sqrt (B.Xa * Qb l) ≤ Real.sqrt (ξ.1 ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
      _ = ξ.1 := Real.sqrt_sq hDom.1.le
  have hsr : Real.sqrt (Qb l) / ξ.1 ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt B.Xa := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hDom.1 hsXa]
    linarith
  have hsr0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (Qb l) / ξ.1 := div_nonneg hs0.le hDom.1.le
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * Real.sqrt (Qb l) / ξ.1 :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQb _).le hs0.le) hDom.1.le
  have hc1 : 0 ≤ Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQb _).le
  have hfin : 2 * K ≤ 2 * K + 2 * K / Real.sqrt B.Xa := by
    have : 0 ≤ 2 * K / Real.sqrt B.Xa := by positivity
    linarith
  constructor
  · rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hs0]
    calc Real.sqrt (Qb l) * |fderiv ℝ (pcFa5 B l) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))|
        ≤ Real.sqrt (Qb l) * |Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * Real.sqrt (Qb l) / ξ.1 * GE'| :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfF hs0.le
      _ = (Real.sqrt (Qb l) * Real.sqrt (Qb l) * |GE'|) * (Real.sqrt (Qb l) / ξ.1) * Qb l ^ B.h := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc0, hQa]; ring
      _ = (Qb l * |GE'|) * (Real.sqrt (Qb l) / ξ.1) * Qb l ^ B.h := by rw [hss]
      _ ≤ (2 * K) * (1 / Real.sqrt B.Xa) * Qb l ^ B.h :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul hGE2 hsr hsr0 (by linarith)) hP0.le
      _ ≤ (2 * K + 2 * K / Real.sqrt B.Xa) * Qb l ^ B.h := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hP0.le
          rw [mul_one_div]
          linarith
  · rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hs0]
    calc Real.sqrt (Qb l) * |fderiv ℝ (pcB5 B l 2) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))|
        ≤ Real.sqrt (Qb l) * |Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * GU'| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfB hs0.le
      _ = (Real.sqrt (Qb l) * Real.sqrt (Qb l) * |GU'|) * Qb l ^ B.h := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc1, hQa]; ring
      _ = (Qb l * |GU'|) * Qb l ^ B.h := by rw [hss]
      _ ≤ (2 * K) * Qb l ^ B.h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hGU2 hP0.le
      _ ≤ (2 * K + 2 * K / Real.sqrt B.Xa) * Qb l ^ B.h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfin hP0.le

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∃ L : ℝ, 0 ≤ L ∧ ∀ (X η ρ X0 η0 ρ0 : ℝ), B.Xa ≤ X → X ≤ B.Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → 1/2 ≤ ρ → ρ ≤ 2 → B.Xa ≤ X0 → X0 ≤ B.Xb → -1 < η0 → η0 < 1 → 1/2 ≤ ρ0 → ρ0 ≤ 2 → |ρ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X η - ρ0 ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X0 η0| + |ρ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X η * (-(shearA B.F X η)) - ρ0 ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X0 η0 * (-(shearA B.F X0 η0))| + |ρ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X η * shearB B.F B.U X η - ρ0 ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X0 η0 * shearB B.F B.U X0 η0| + |Real.sqrt (2 * X * ρ) - Real.sqrt (2 * X0 * ρ0)| ≤ L * (|X - X0| + |η - η0| + |ρ - ρ0|)

signature.name: rep_lip_transfer5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∃ L : ℝ, 0 ≤ L ∧ ∀ (X η ρ X0 η0 ρ0 : ℝ), B.Xa ≤ X → X ≤ B.Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → 1/2 ≤ ρ → ρ ≤ 2 → B.Xa ≤ X0 → X0 ≤ B.Xb → -1 < η0 → η0 < 1 → 1/2 ≤ ρ0 → ρ0 ≤ 2 → |ρ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X η - ρ0 ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X0 η0| + |ρ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X η * (-(shearA B.F X η)) - ρ0 ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X0 η0 * (-(shearA B.F X0 η0))| + |ρ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X η * shearB B.F B.U X η - ρ0 ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X0 η0 * shearB B.F B.U X0 η0| + |Real.sqrt (2 * X * ρ) - Real.sqrt (2 * X0 * ρ0)| ≤ L * (|X - X0| + |η - η0| + |ρ - ρ0|)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have PTB : ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ∃ (κ D : ℝ), 0 < κ ∧ κ < 2 ∧ κ ≤ D ∧
      ∀ X η : ℝ, B.Xa ≤ X → X ≤ B.Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        κ ≤ B.F X η ∧ B.F X η ≤ D ∧ κ ≤ shearA B.F X η ∧ shearA B.F X η ≤ D ∧
        |shearB B.F B.U X η| ≤ D ∧
        (2 + κ) * shearA B.F X η ≤ shearA B.F X η ^ 2 + shearB B.F B.U X η ^ 2 := by
    intro B hB
    have hBP := hB.2
    unfold BackgroundProps at hBP
    obtain ⟨⟨-, -, hXa, hXm1, hm12, hm2Xb, -⟩, ⟨hFs, hUs, hFpos, hbd⟩,
      ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, ⟨κ, hκ0, hκ2, hK⟩⟩, -⟩ := hBP
    have hXab : B.Xa < B.Xb := by linarith
    have hopen : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have slice : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
        ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun Y => f Y η) (Ioi 0) := by
      intro f hf η h1 h2
      have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, η)) := contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const
      exact hf.comp hg.contDiffOn (fun Y hY => ⟨hY, h1, h2⟩)
    have hderiv : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
        ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        |deriv (fun Y => f Y η) X| ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (↿f) (X, η)‖ := by
      intro f hf X η hX h1 h2
      have hmem : (X, η) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨hX, h1, h2⟩
      have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿f) (X, η) :=
        (hf.contDiffAt (hopen.mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hcurve : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => (Y, η)) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) X :=
        (hasDerivAt_id' X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X η)
      have hcomp := hdiff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt X hcurve
      have heq : deriv (fun Y => f Y η) X = fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) := hcomp.deriv
      rw [heq, norm_iteratedFDeriv_one, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc ‖fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))‖
          ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η)‖ * ‖((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))‖ := (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η)).le_opNorm _
        _ = ‖fderiv ℝ (↿f) (X, η)‖ := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
    have cont : ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ContinuousOn (fun X => B.F X η) (Ioi 0) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun X => shearA B.F X η) (Ioi 0) ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun X => shearB B.F B.U X η) (Ioi 0) := by
      intro η h1 h2
      have sF := slice B.F hFs η h1 h2
      have sU := slice B.U hUs η h1 h2
      have cF : ContinuousOn (fun X => B.F X η) (Ioi 0) := sF.continuousOn
      have dF : ContinuousOn (deriv fun Y => B.F Y η) (Ioi 0) :=
        sF.continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioi (by simp)
      have dU : ContinuousOn (deriv fun Y => B.U Y η) (Ioi 0) :=
        sU.continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioi (by simp)
      have hne : ∀ X ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ), B.F X η ≠ 0 := fun X hX => (hFpos X η hX h1 h2).ne'
      refine ⟨cF, ?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold shearA
        exact ((continuousOn_const.mul continuousOn_id).mul dF).div cF hne
      · unfold shearB
        exact (((Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).continuousOn).mul
          dU).div cF hne
    have clos : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn f (Ioi 0) → ContinuousOn g (Ioi 0) →
        (∀ X, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb → f X ≤ g X) → ∀ X, B.Xa ≤ X → X ≤ B.Xb → f X ≤ g X := by
      intro f g hf hg hle X h1 h2
      have hX0 : X ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) := show (0:ℝ) < X by linarith
      have hcl : X ∈ closure (Ioo B.Xa B.Xb) := by rw [closure_Ioo hXab.ne]; exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
      exact ContinuousWithinAt.closure_le hcl
        ((hf.continuousAt (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds hX0)).continuousWithinAt)
        ((hg.continuousAt (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds hX0)).continuousWithinAt)
        (fun y hy => hle y hy.1 hy.2)
    have alg : ∀ a b k : ℝ, 0 < a → k ≤ a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) - 2 → (2 + k) * a ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
      intro a b k ha h
      have h1 : a * (b / a) = b := by field_simp [ha.ne']
      have hid : a * (a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2)) = a ^ 2 + (a * (b / a)) ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [h1] at hid
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show 2 + k ≤ a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) by linarith) ha.le
      nlinarith
    obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := hbd B.Xa B.Xb hXa 0
    obtain ⟨C1', hC1'⟩ := hbd B.Xa B.Xb hXa 1
    obtain ⟨C1, hC1def⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = max C0 C1' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hC0le : C0 ≤ C1 := by rw [hC1def]; exact le_max_left _ _
    have hC1le : C1' ≤ C1 := by rw [hC1def]; exact le_max_right _ _
    refine ⟨κ, max κ (max C1 (max (2 * B.Xb * C1 / κ) (Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xb) * C1 / κ))),
      hκ0, hκ2, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
    intro X η h1 h2 h3 h4
    obtain ⟨cF, cA, cB⟩ := cont η h3 h4
    have hX0 : 0 < X := by linarith
    have L1 : κ ≤ B.F X η := clos (fun _ => κ) (fun X => B.F X η) continuousOn_const cF
      (fun X' a b => (hK X' η a b h3 h4).1) X h1 h2
    have L2 : κ ≤ shearA B.F X η := clos (fun _ => κ) (fun X => shearA B.F X η) continuousOn_const cA
      (fun X' a b => (hK X' η a b h3 h4).2.1) X h1 h2
    have L3 : (2 + κ) * shearA B.F X η ≤ shearA B.F X η ^ 2 + shearB B.F B.U X η ^ 2 :=
      clos (fun X => (2 + κ) * shearA B.F X η)
        (fun X => shearA B.F X η ^ 2 + shearB B.F B.U X η ^ 2)
        (continuousOn_const.mul cA) ((cA.pow 2).add (cB.pow 2))
        (fun X' a b => by
          obtain ⟨k1, k2, k3, -⟩ := hK X' η a b h3 h4
          exact alg _ _ κ (by linarith) k3) X h1 h2
    obtain ⟨b0F, -⟩ := hC0 X η h1 h2 h3 h4
    obtain ⟨b1F, b1U⟩ := hC1' X η h1 h2 h3 h4
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at b0F
    have dFb : |deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η) X| ≤ C1 :=
      ((hderiv B.F hFs X η hX0 h3 h4).trans b1F).trans hC1le
    have dUb : |deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η) X| ≤ C1 :=
      ((hderiv B.U hUs X η hX0 h3 h4).trans b1U).trans hC1le
    have Fb : |B.F X η| ≤ C1 := b0F.trans hC0le
    have hC1nn : 0 ≤ C1 := (abs_nonneg _).trans Fb
    have hFp : 0 < B.F X η := by linarith
    have hXb0 : 0 ≤ B.Xb := by linarith
    have U2 : shearA B.F X η ≤ 2 * B.Xb * C1 / κ := by
      unfold shearA
      have hd := abs_le.mp dFb
      have e1 : -2 * X * deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η) X ≤ 2 * B.Xb * C1 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hX0.le (show 0 ≤ deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η) X + C1 by linarith),
          mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ B.Xb - X by linarith) hC1nn]
      calc -2 * X * deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η) X / B.F X η ≤ 2 * B.Xb * C1 / B.F X η :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right e1 hFp.le
        _ ≤ 2 * B.Xb * C1 / κ :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hXb0) hC1nn) hκ0 L1
    have U3 : |shearB B.F B.U X η| ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * B.Xb) * C1 / κ := by
      unfold shearB
