        _ = 16 := by norm_num
    have := (convex_Icc (1/2:ℝ) 2).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
      (fun z hz => (hder z hz).differentiableAt) hb ⟨hx1, hx2⟩ ⟨hy1, hy2⟩
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
  
  have prodD : ∀ a b a' b' Ma Mb da db : ℝ, |a| ≤ Ma → |b'| ≤ Mb → |a - a'| ≤ da → |b - b'| ≤ db →
      |a * b - a' * b'| ≤ Ma * db + Mb * da := by
    intro a b a' b' Ma Mb da db ha hb hda hdb
    have e : a * b - a' * b' = a * (b - b') + b' * (a - a') := by ring
    rw [e]
    refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
    · rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul ha hdb (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans ha)
    · rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hb hda (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans hb)
  have hL1 : 0 ≤ 4 * Lp + 16 * D := by linarith
  have hL2 : 0 ≤ 4 * D * Lp + D * (4 * Lp + 16 * D) :=
    add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hLp0) (mul_nonneg hD0.le hL1)
  have hL3 : 0 ≤ (4 + 2 * B.Xb) / (2 * Real.sqrt B.Xa) := div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨(4 * Lp + 16 * D) + 2 * (4 * D * Lp + D * (4 * Lp + 16 * D)) +
      (4 + 2 * B.Xb) / (2 * Real.sqrt B.Xa), by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro X η ρ X0 η0 ρ0 hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2 hρ1 hρ2 hX01 hX02 hη01 hη02 hρ01 hρ02
  have hXS : |X - X0| ≤ |X - X0| + |η - η0| + |ρ - ρ0| := by
    linarith [abs_nonneg (η - η0), abs_nonneg (ρ - ρ0)]
  have hρS : |ρ - ρ0| ≤ |X - X0| + |η - η0| + |ρ - ρ0| := by
    linarith [abs_nonneg (η - η0), abs_nonneg (X - X0)]
  have hΔ : |X - X0| + |η - η0| ≤ |X - X0| + |η - η0| + |ρ - ρ0| := by
    linarith [abs_nonneg (ρ - ρ0)]
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ |X - X0| + |η - η0| + |ρ - ρ0| := by
    linarith [abs_nonneg (η - η0), abs_nonneg (X - X0), abs_nonneg (ρ - ρ0)]
  set S := |X - X0| + |η - η0| + |ρ - ρ0| with hS
  have hL := hlip X X0 η η0 hX1 hX2 hX01 hX02 hη1 hη2 hη01 hη02
  have hLS := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hΔ hLp0
  have n1 := abs_nonneg (B.F X η - B.F X0 η0)
  have n2 := abs_nonneg (shearA B.F X η - shearA B.F X0 η0)
  have n3 := abs_nonneg (shearB B.F B.U X η - shearB B.F B.U X0 η0)
  have dF : |B.F X η - B.F X0 η0| ≤ Lp * S := by linarith
  have dA : |shearA B.F X η - shearA B.F X0 η0| ≤ Lp * S := by linarith
  have dB : |shearB B.F B.U X η - shearB B.F B.U X0 η0| ≤ Lp * S := by linarith
  obtain ⟨F1, F2, A1, A2, B2, -⟩ := hbd X η hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2
  obtain ⟨F1', F2', A1', A2', B2', -⟩ := hbd X0 η0 hX01 hX02 hη01 hη02
  have aF : |B.F X η| ≤ D := by
    rw [abs_of_pos (show (0:ℝ) < B.F X η by linarith)]; exact F2
  have aF' : |B.F X0 η0| ≤ D := by
    rw [abs_of_pos (show (0:ℝ) < B.F X0 η0 by linarith)]; exact F2'
  have aA' : |-(shearA B.F X0 η0)| ≤ D := by
    rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos (show (0:ℝ) < shearA B.F X0 η0 by linarith)]; exact A2'
  obtain ⟨w1, w2⟩ := wle ρ hρ1
  have aw : |ρ ^ (-(1 + B.h))| ≤ 4 := by rw [abs_of_pos w1]; exact w2
  have dw : |ρ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) - ρ0 ^ (-(1 + B.h))| ≤ 16 * S :=
    (wlip ρ0 ρ hρ01 hρ02 hρ1 hρ2).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hρS (by norm_num))
  have T1 : |ρ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X η - ρ0 ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X0 η0| ≤
      4 * (Lp * S) + D * (16 * S) :=
    prodD _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ aw aF' dw dF
  have awF : |ρ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X η| ≤ 4 * D := by
    rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul aw aF (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
  have dA' : |-(shearA B.F X η) - -(shearA B.F X0 η0)| ≤ Lp * S := by
    rw [show -(shearA B.F X η) - -(shearA B.F X0 η0) = -(shearA B.F X η - shearA B.F X0 η0) by ring,
      abs_neg]
    exact dA
  have T2 := prodD _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ awF aA' T1 dA'
  have T3 := prodD _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ awF B2' T1 dB
  
  have ha : B.Xa ≤ 2 * X * ρ := by
    have := mul_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ X by linarith) (show (0:ℝ) ≤ ρ - 1/2 by linarith)
    linarith
  have hb : B.Xa ≤ 2 * X0 * ρ0 := by
    have := mul_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ X0 by linarith) (show (0:ℝ) ≤ ρ0 - 1/2 by linarith)
    linarith
  have sa : Real.sqrt B.Xa ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * X * ρ) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ha
  have sb : Real.sqrt B.Xa ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * X0 * ρ0) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hb
  have hsum : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * X * ρ) + Real.sqrt (2 * X0 * ρ0) := by linarith
  have hsd : Real.sqrt (2 * X * ρ) - Real.sqrt (2 * X0 * ρ0) =
      (2 * X * ρ - 2 * X0 * ρ0) / (Real.sqrt (2 * X * ρ) + Real.sqrt (2 * X0 * ρ0)) := by
    rw [eq_div_iff hsum.ne']
    linear_combination (Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * X * ρ by linarith)) -
      (Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * X0 * ρ0 by linarith))
  have hab : |2 * X * ρ - 2 * X0 * ρ0| ≤ (4 + 2 * B.Xb) * S := by
    have e : 2 * X * ρ - 2 * X0 * ρ0 = 2 * ρ * (X - X0) + 2 * X0 * (ρ - ρ0) := by ring
    rw [e]
    refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
    rw [abs_mul (2 * ρ) (X - X0), abs_mul (2 * X0) (ρ - ρ0),
      abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * ρ),
      abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * X0)]
    have k1 : 2 * ρ * |X - X0| ≤ 4 * S :=
      mul_le_mul (by linarith) hXS (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
    have k2 : 2 * X0 * |ρ - ρ0| ≤ 2 * B.Xb * S :=
      mul_le_mul (by linarith) hρS (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    linarith
  have T4 : |Real.sqrt (2 * X * ρ) - Real.sqrt (2 * X0 * ρ0)| ≤
      (4 + 2 * B.Xb) / (2 * Real.sqrt B.Xa) * S := by
    rw [hsd, abs_div, abs_of_pos hsum, div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    exact div_le_div₀ (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hS0) hab (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hfin : ((4 * Lp + 16 * D) + 2 * (4 * D * Lp + D * (4 * Lp + 16 * D)) +
      (4 + 2 * B.Xb) / (2 * Real.sqrt B.Xa)) * S =
      (4 * (Lp * S) + D * (16 * S)) +
      (4 * D * (Lp * S) + D * (4 * (Lp * S) + D * (16 * S))) +
      (4 * D * (Lp * S) + D * (4 * (Lp * S) + D * (16 * S))) +
      (4 + 2 * B.Xb) / (2 * Real.sqrt B.Xa) * S := by ring
  rw [hfin]
  linarith [T1, T2, T3, T4]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (A eg g1 g2 Bs u sg Ls v RC R0 RFa RB ZFa ZB pang ptil pz eps E : ℝ), 1 ≤ A → 0 < eg → eg ^ 2 = g1 ^ 2 + g2 ^ 2 → 1 / A ≤ eg → eg ≤ A → |Bs| ≤ A → |u| ≤ A → (sg = 1 ∨ sg = -1) → 1 ≤ Ls → 0 ≤ v → v ≤ Ls → 1 / A ≤ RC → |R0| ≤ A → 0 ≤ eps → eps ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ E → E ≤ 1 → ptil = R0 * (Bs * (-(eg⁻¹ * g2) - sg * u * g1 / (Ls * eg ^ 2))) → pz = Bs * (eg⁻¹ * g1 - sg * u * g2 / (Ls * eg ^ 2)) → |pang - ptil| ≤ eps → |R0 - RC| ≤ E → |RC * RFa - g1| ≤ E → |RB - g2| ≤ E → |ZFa| ≤ E → |ZB| ≤ E → |sg * Bs * u / 2 - v * (pang * RFa + pz * RB) - Bs * (sg * (u / 2 + u * v / Ls))| ≤ 30 * A ^ 5 * Ls * (eps + E) ∧ |pang / RC - Bs * (-(eg⁻¹ * g2))| ≤ 30 * A ^ 5 * (eps + E + 1 / Ls) ∧ |pz - v * (pang * ZFa + pz * ZB) - Bs * (eg⁻¹ * g1)| ≤ 30 * A ^ 5 * (1 / Ls + Ls * E) ∧ |-(pang * RFa + pz * RB)| ≤ 30 * A ^ 5 ∧ |-(pang * ZFa + pz * ZB)| ≤ 30 * A ^ 5

proof.tactics:
by
  intro A eg g1 g2 Bs u sg Ls v RC R0 RFa RB ZFa ZB pang ptil pz eps E hA heg heg2 hegl hegu hBs hu
    hsg hLs hv0 hvL hRCl hR0 heps0 heps1 hE0 hE1 hptil hpz hpe hRe hRFe hRBe hZF hZB
  
  have hmul : ∀ x y X Y : ℝ, |x| ≤ X → |y| ≤ Y → |x * y| ≤ X * Y := fun x y X Y hx hy => by
    rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hx hy (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans hx)
  have hadd : ∀ x y X Y : ℝ, |x| ≤ X → |y| ≤ Y → |x + y| ≤ X + Y := fun x y X Y hx hy =>
    abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [(abs_le.mp hx).1, (abs_le.mp hy).1],
      by linarith [(abs_le.mp hx).2, (abs_le.mp hy).2]⟩
  have hsub : ∀ x y X Y : ℝ, |x| ≤ X → |y| ≤ Y → |x - y| ≤ X + Y := fun x y X Y hx hy =>
    abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [(abs_le.mp hx).1, (abs_le.mp hy).2],
      by linarith [(abs_le.mp hx).2, (abs_le.mp hy).1]⟩
  
  have hA0 : 0 < A := by linarith
  have hp1 : A ≤ A ^ 5 := by
    have := pow_le_pow_right₀ hA (show 1 ≤ 5 by norm_num); rwa [pow_one] at this
  have hp2 : A ^ 2 ≤ A ^ 5 := pow_le_pow_right₀ hA (by norm_num)
  have hp3 : A ^ 3 ≤ A ^ 5 := pow_le_pow_right₀ hA (by norm_num)
  have hp4 : A ^ 4 ≤ A ^ 5 := pow_le_pow_right₀ hA (by norm_num)
  have h13 : A ≤ A ^ 3 := by
    have := pow_le_pow_right₀ hA (show 1 ≤ 3 by norm_num); rwa [pow_one] at this
  have h12 : A ≤ A ^ 2 := by
    have := pow_le_pow_right₀ hA (show 1 ≤ 2 by norm_num); rwa [pow_one] at this
  have h14 : 1 ≤ A ^ 4 := one_le_pow₀ hA
  have hA5 : 0 ≤ A ^ 5 := by positivity
  have hk0 : 0 < eg⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr heg
  have hku : eg⁻¹ ≤ A := by
    rw [one_div] at hegl; exact inv_le_of_inv_le₀ hA0 hegl
  have hkeg : eg⁻¹ * eg = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ heg.ne'
  have hRC0 : 0 < RC := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hRCl
  have hRCi0 : 0 < RC⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hRC0
  have hRCiu : RC⁻¹ ≤ A := by
    rw [one_div] at hRCl; exact inv_le_of_inv_le₀ hA0 hRCl
  have hRCinv : RC * RC⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hRC0.ne'
  have hL0 : 0 < Ls := by linarith
  have hLi0 : 0 < Ls⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hL0
  have hLi1 : Ls⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hLs
  have hsg1 : |sg| ≤ 1 := by rcases hsg with h | h <;> simp [h]
  have hg1 : |g1| ≤ eg := abs_le_of_sq_le_sq (by linarith [sq_nonneg g2]) heg.le
  have hg2 : |g2| ≤ eg := abs_le_of_sq_le_sq (by linarith [sq_nonneg g1]) heg.le
  have hg1A : |g1| ≤ A := hg1.trans hegu
  have hkA : |eg⁻¹| ≤ A := by rw [abs_of_pos hk0]; exact hku
  have hRCiA : |RC⁻¹| ≤ A := by rw [abs_of_pos hRCi0]; exact hRCiu
  have hLiA : |Ls⁻¹| ≤ Ls⁻¹ := le_of_eq (abs_of_pos hLi0)
  
  have hw1 : |eg⁻¹ * g1| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hk0]
    calc eg⁻¹ * |g1| ≤ eg⁻¹ * eg := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg1 hk0.le
      _ = 1 := hkeg
  have hw2 : |eg⁻¹ * g2| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hk0]
    calc eg⁻¹ * |g2| ≤ eg⁻¹ * eg := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg2 hk0.le
      _ = 1 := hkeg
  have ha : |sg * u * eg⁻¹ * Ls⁻¹| ≤ A ^ 2 * Ls⁻¹ := by
    have h3 := hmul _ _ _ _ (hmul _ _ _ _ (hmul _ _ _ _ hsg1 hu) hkA) hLiA
    calc _ ≤ 1 * A * A * Ls⁻¹ := h3
      _ = A ^ 2 * Ls⁻¹ := by ring
  have haA : |sg * u * eg⁻¹ * Ls⁻¹| ≤ A ^ 2 := by
    have : A ^ 2 * Ls⁻¹ ≤ A ^ 2 * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLi1 (by positivity)
    linarith
  have haw1 : |sg * u * eg⁻¹ * Ls⁻¹ * (eg⁻¹ * g1)| ≤ A ^ 2 * Ls⁻¹ * 1 := hmul _ _ _ _ ha hw1
  have haw2 : |sg * u * eg⁻¹ * Ls⁻¹ * (eg⁻¹ * g2)| ≤ A ^ 2 * Ls⁻¹ * 1 := hmul _ _ _ _ ha hw2
  
  obtain ⟨T, hTd⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ,
      T = Bs * (-(eg⁻¹ * g2) - sg * u * eg⁻¹ * Ls⁻¹ * (eg⁻¹ * g1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hptT : ptil = R0 * T := by rw [hptil, hTd]; ring
  have hpzT : pz = Bs * (eg⁻¹ * g1 - sg * u * eg⁻¹ * Ls⁻¹ * (eg⁻¹ * g2)) := by rw [hpz]; ring
  have hw2n : |-(eg⁻¹ * g2)| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_neg]; exact hw2
  have hBaw1 : |-(Bs * (sg * u * eg⁻¹ * Ls⁻¹ * (eg⁻¹ * g1)))| ≤ A * (A ^ 2 * Ls⁻¹ * 1) := by
    rw [abs_neg]; exact hmul _ _ _ _ hBs haw1
  have hBaw2 : |-(Bs * (sg * u * eg⁻¹ * Ls⁻¹ * (eg⁻¹ * g2)))| ≤ A * (A ^ 2 * Ls⁻¹ * 1) := by
    rw [abs_neg]; exact hmul _ _ _ _ hBs haw2
  have hTb : |T| ≤ 2 * A ^ 3 := by
    have h := hmul _ _ _ _ hBs
      (hsub _ _ _ _ hw2n (hmul _ _ _ _ haA hw1))
    rw [← hTd] at h
    linarith
  have hpzb : |pz| ≤ 2 * A ^ 3 := by
    have h := hmul _ _ _ _ hBs (hsub _ _ _ _ hw1 (hmul _ _ _ _ haA hw2))
    rw [← hpzT] at h
    linarith
  have hpang : |pang| ≤ 3 * A ^ 4 := by
    have h1 := hmul _ _ _ _ hR0 hTb
    rw [← hptT] at h1
    have h2 := hadd _ _ _ _ hpe h1
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at h2
    linarith
  
  have hRFa : |RFa| ≤ 2 * A ^ 2 := by
    have h1 := hadd _ _ _ _ hRFe hg1A
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at h1
    have h2 : |RC * RFa| ≤ 2 * A := by linarith
    have h3 := hmul _ _ _ _ hRCiA h2
    rw [inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hRC0.ne'] at h3
    linarith
  
  have hslope : T * g1 + pz * g2 = -(Bs * sg * u * Ls⁻¹) := by
    rw [hTd, hpzT]
    linear_combination (-(Bs * sg * u * Ls⁻¹) * (1 + eg⁻¹ * eg)) * hkeg
      + (Bs * sg * u * Ls⁻¹ * eg⁻¹ ^ 2) * heg2
  
  have hDeq : pang * RFa + pz * RB + Bs * sg * u * Ls⁻¹ =
      (pang - ptil) * RFa + T * (R0 - RC) * RFa + T * (RC * RFa - g1) + pz * (RB - g2) := by
    linear_combination hslope + RFa * hptT
  have hD : |pang * RFa + pz * RB + Bs * sg * u * Ls⁻¹| ≤ 2 * A ^ 5 * eps + 8 * A ^ 5 * E := by
    rw [hDeq]
    have h := hadd _ _ _ _ (hadd _ _ _ _ (hadd _ _ _ _ (hmul _ _ _ _ hpe hRFa)
      (hmul _ _ _ _ (hmul _ _ _ _ hTb hRe) hRFa)) (hmul _ _ _ _ hTb hRFe)) (hmul _ _ _ _ hpzb hRBe)
    have e1 : A ^ 2 * eps ≤ A ^ 5 * eps := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp2 heps0
    have e2 : A ^ 3 * E ≤ A ^ 5 * E := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp3 hE0
    linarith
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have heq : sg * Bs * u / 2 - v * (pang * RFa + pz * RB) - Bs * (sg * (u / 2 + u * v / Ls)) =
        -(v * (pang * RFa + pz * RB + Bs * sg * u * Ls⁻¹)) := by ring
    rw [heq, abs_neg]
    have hv : |v| ≤ Ls := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hv0]; exact hvL
    have h := hmul _ _ _ _ hv hD
    have n1 : 0 ≤ Ls * A ^ 5 * eps := by positivity
    have n2 : 0 ≤ Ls * A ^ 5 * E := by positivity
    linarith
  · 
    have heq : pang / RC - Bs * (-(eg⁻¹ * g2)) =
        (pang - ptil) * RC⁻¹ + (R0 - RC) * T * RC⁻¹
          + -(Bs * (sg * u * eg⁻¹ * Ls⁻¹ * (eg⁻¹ * g1))) := by
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
      linear_combination RC⁻¹ * hptT + T * hRCinv + hTd
    rw [heq]
    have h := hadd _ _ _ _ (hadd _ _ _ _ (hmul _ _ _ _ hpe hRCiA)
      (hmul _ _ _ _ (hmul _ _ _ _ hRe hTb) hRCiA))
      hBaw1
    have e1 : A * eps ≤ A ^ 5 * eps := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp1 heps0
    have e2 : A ^ 4 * E ≤ A ^ 5 * E := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp4 hE0
    have e3 : A ^ 3 * Ls⁻¹ ≤ A ^ 5 * Ls⁻¹ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp3 hLi0.le
    have n1 : 0 ≤ A ^ 5 * eps := by positivity
    have n2 : 0 ≤ A ^ 5 * E := by positivity
    have n3 : 0 ≤ A ^ 5 * Ls⁻¹ := by positivity
    rw [one_div]
    linarith
  · 
    have heq : pz - v * (pang * ZFa + pz * ZB) - Bs * (eg⁻¹ * g1) =
        -(Bs * (sg * u * eg⁻¹ * Ls⁻¹ * (eg⁻¹ * g2))) - v * (pang * ZFa + pz * ZB) := by
      linear_combination hpzT
    rw [heq]
    have hv : |v| ≤ Ls := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hv0]; exact hvL
    have hPsi := hadd _ _ _ _ (hmul _ _ _ _ hpang hZF) (hmul _ _ _ _ hpzb hZB)
    have h := hsub _ _ _ _ hBaw2 (hmul _ _ _ _ hv hPsi)
    have e1 : Ls * (A ^ 4 * E) ≤ Ls * (A ^ 5 * E) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp4 hE0) hL0.le
    have e2 : Ls * (A ^ 3 * E) ≤ Ls * (A ^ 5 * E) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp3 hE0) hL0.le
    have e3 : A ^ 3 * Ls⁻¹ ≤ A ^ 5 * Ls⁻¹ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp3 hLi0.le
    have n2 : 0 ≤ Ls * (A ^ 5 * E) := by positivity
    have n3 : 0 ≤ A ^ 5 * Ls⁻¹ := by positivity
    rw [one_div]
    linarith
  · 
    have heq : -(pang * RFa + pz * RB) =
        Bs * sg * u * Ls⁻¹ - (pang * RFa + pz * RB + Bs * sg * u * Ls⁻¹) := by ring
    rw [heq]
    have hc := hmul _ _ _ _ (hmul _ _ _ _ (hmul _ _ _ _ hBs hsg1) hu) hLiA
    have h := hsub _ _ _ _ hc hD
    have e1 : A ^ 5 * eps ≤ A ^ 5 := mul_le_of_le_one_right hA5 heps1
    have e2 : A ^ 5 * E ≤ A ^ 5 := mul_le_of_le_one_right hA5 hE1
    have e3 : A * 1 * A * Ls⁻¹ ≤ A ^ 2 := by

by
  intro B G hh0 _hh1

  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hev
  refine ⟨N, fun γ hγ => ?_⟩
  have hwe : Qb γ.1 ^ (B.h/2) = ((2:ℝ) ^ (-(B.h/2))) ^ γ.1 := by
    unfold Qb

      ← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2)]

    rw [hwe]

    unfold epsb

    linarith
  have hek : epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ))^2 =

    rw [heps]; ring
  have hl4 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 4 := by positivity

proof.tactics:
by
  have pulse_line_base5 : ∀ (h r0 : ℝ) (γ : Lab) (c : ℝ × ℝ), 0 < r0 → r0 ≤ 1/100 → inRect h γ c r0 (Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c - r0 • vtv)) ∧ ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (v : ℝ), ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c - r0 • vtv)) : Cyl) + (v - vco h r0 γ c (Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c - r0 • vtv))) • dVdir h γ.1 = ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c + (v * cib h γ.1 - r0) • vtv)) : Cyl) := by

    have hb1 : bgc ≤ 1 := by unfold bgc; linarith
    have hD : (0:ℝ) < 1 + bgc ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hDne : (1 + bgc ^ 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := hD.ne'
    have hTg : (0:ℝ) < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; positivity
    have hLg : (0:ℝ) < Lgc := by unfold Lgc; linarith

  have pulse_line_rect5 : ∀ (h r0 : ℝ) (γ : Lab) (c Y : ℝ × ℝ), 0 < r0 → r0 ≤ 1/100 → inRect h γ c r0 Y → ∀ v : ℝ, 0 ≤ v → v ≤ Lsb h r0 γ.1 → vco h r0 γ c (Y + (v - vco h r0 γ c Y) • ((cib h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx h γ.1))) • vtv)) = v ∧ inRect h γ c r0 (Y + (v - vco h r0 γ c Y) • ((cib h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx h γ.1))) • vtv)) := by

    have hWT' : |lamT (w + ((v - vco h r0 γ c Y) * cib h γ.1) • vtv)| ≤ r0 := by
      rw [hWT, abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
    have s3 : ∀ w' : ℝ × ℝ, |lamR w'| ≤ r0 → |lamT w'| ≤ r0 → |w'.1| < 1/2 ∧ |w'.2| < 1/2 := by
      intro w' h1 h2
      have r1 : w'.1 = lamR w' + bgc * lamT w' := by unfold lamR lamT; field_simp; ring
      have r2 : w'.2 = -bgc * lamR w' + lamT w' := by unfold lamR lamT; field_simp; ring
      have t1 : |bgc * lamT w'| ≤ r0 := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hb0]
        calc bgc * |lamT w'| ≤ 1 * |lamT w'| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb1 (abs_nonneg _)
          _ ≤ r0 := by rw [one_mul]; exact h2
      have t2 : |-bgc * lamR w'| ≤ r0 := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hb0]
        calc bgc * |lamR w'| ≤ 1 * |lamR w'| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb1 (abs_nonneg _)
          _ ≤ r0 := by rw [one_mul]; exact h1
      constructor
      · rw [r1]
        calc |lamR w' + bgc * lamT w'| ≤ |lamR w'| + |bgc * lamT w'| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ < 1/2 := by linarith
      · rw [r2]
        calc |-bgc * lamR w' + lamT w'| ≤ |-bgc * lamR w'| + |lamT w'| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ < 1/2 := by linarith
    obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := s3 (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) P - c - k) (by rw [hJ]; exact hWR) (by rw [hJ]; exact hWT')
    have d1 : |(Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) P - c).1 - k.1| < 1/2 := by
      simpa only [Prod.fst_sub] using c1
    have d2 : |(Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) P - c).2 - k.2| < 1/2 := by
      simpa only [Prod.snd_sub] using c2
    have hPw0 : rectW h γ c P = Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) P - c - k := by
      rw [hk1] at d1
      rw [hk2] at d2
      have q1 := hround _ _ d1
      have q2 := hround _ _ d2
      unfold rectW frac0
      rw [q1, q2]
      ext
      · simp only [Prod.fst_sub, hk1]
      · simp only [Prod.snd_sub, hk2]
    have hPw : rectW h γ c P = w + ((v - vco h r0 γ c Y) * cib h γ.1) • vtv := hPw0.trans hJ
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold vco etG
      rw [hPw, hWT, sub_add_cancel, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hκ.ne']
    · show |xiG h γ c P| ≤ r0 ∧ |etG h γ c P| ≤ r0
      unfold xiG etG
      rw [hPw]
      exact ⟨hWR, hWT'⟩
  intro h r0 γ c v hr0 hr1 hv
  obtain ⟨hY0, hline⟩ := pulse_line_base5 h r0 γ c hr0 hr1
  have hEq4 := congrArg (fun z : Cyl => z.2.2.2) (hline ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) v)
  have hEq : Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c - r0 • vtv) + (v - vco h r0 γ c (Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c - r0 • vtv))) •
      ((cib h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx h γ.1))) • vtv) =
      Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c + (v * cib h γ.1 - r0) • vtv) := by
    simpa [dVdir] using hEq4
  obtain ⟨hvco, hrect⟩ := pulse_line_rect5 h r0 γ c _ hr0 hr1 hY0 v hv.1 hv.2
  rw [hEq] at hvco hrect
  have hrect' : |xiG h γ c (Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c + (v * cib h γ.1 - r0) • vtv))| ≤ r0 ∧
      |etG h γ c (Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c + (v * cib h γ.1 - r0) • vtv))| ≤ r0 := hrect
  refine ⟨hrect, hvco, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith [hrect'.1]
  · linarith [hrect'.2]

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hB hG k
  have hr0 : 0 < G.r0 := hG.1.1
  have hr1 : G.r0 ≤ 1/100 := hG.1.2.1
  have hh : 0 < B.h := hB.2.1.1
  obtain ⟨hΩo, -⟩ := geom_slow_base_smooth_v5 B hB
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hlow⟩ := pulse5_nsq_lower_v5 B G hB hG
  obtain ⟨D, hD0, hDb⟩ := pulse5_slow_entries_nb_v5 B G hB hG k
  obtain ⟨C', hC'0, hC'⟩ := nb_aphi_entry_poly_v5 k c D hc
  obtain ⟨Cb, hCb0, hCb⟩ := pulse5_bcol_sjet_v5 B G hB hG c hc k
  refine ⟨max (max C' Cb) 0, ((2 * k + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ), ?_⟩
  intro γ ξ hact hdom hη hXa hXb
  
  let π : Cyl →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).prod
      (((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))).prod
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp
          ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
            (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))))
  let ι : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] Cyl :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).prod
      (((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))).prod
        (((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))).prod
          (0 : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ))))
  have hι : ∀ x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, ι x = (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2, ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) := fun x => rfl
  have hιn : ∀ x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, ‖ι x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
    intro x
    rw [hι]
    have h1 : ‖x.1‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := norm_fst_le x
    have h2 : ‖x.2.1‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := (norm_fst_le x.2).trans (norm_snd_le x)
    have h3 : ‖x.2.2‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := (norm_snd_le x.2).trans (norm_snd_le x)
    have h4 : ‖((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))‖ = 0 := by simp
    rw [Prod.norm_def, Prod.norm_def, Prod.norm_def, h4]
    exact max_le h1 (max_le h2 (max_le h3 (norm_nonneg _)))
  
  have hS6 : ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (A : ℝ), 0 ≤ A →

    intro f A hA hf hNB
    apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound hA
    intro m
    have hprod : 0 ≤ ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
    simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hA hprod)]
    intro a
    rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hA hprod)]
    intro b
    let P : (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=

        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => Fin 3 → ℝ) a)
    have hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (P ∘ f) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) :=
      P.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp _ hf
    have h1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (P ∘ f) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) =
        P.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)) :=
      P.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left hf (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have h1' : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (fun i => DqS5 B.h ξ (m i))) a b =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (P ∘ f) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (fun i => DqS5 B.h ξ (m i)) := by
      rw [h1]; rfl
    rw [h1']
    
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hfu⟩ := hg.contDiffOn (m := (k : ℕ∞ω)) (by exact_mod_cast le_top) (by simp)
    obtain ⟨t, htu, ht_open, hs0t⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hu
    have hft : ContDiffOn ℝ k (P ∘ f) t := hfu.mono htu
    have hpre_open : IsOpen (π ⁻¹' t) := ht_open.preimage π.continuous
    have hξt : ξ ∈ π ⁻¹' t := hs0t
    have hchain := π.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right hft ht_open.uniqueDiffOn
      hpre_open.uniqueDiffOn hξt le_rfl
    have e1 : iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k ((P ∘ f) ∘ ⇑π) (π ⁻¹' t) ξ =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((P ∘ f) ∘ ⇑π) ξ :=
      iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hpre_open hξt
    have e2 : iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ k (P ∘ f) t (π ξ) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (P ∘ f) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) :=
      iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k ht_open hs0t
    rw [e1, e2] at hchain
    have hfeq : (fun η : Cyl => f (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) a b) = (P ∘ f) ∘ ⇑π := rfl
    have key : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (P ∘ f) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (fun i => DqS5 B.h ξ (m i)) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((P ∘ f) ∘ ⇑π) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ))
          (fun i => ι (m i)) := by
      rw [hchain]; rfl
    rw [key]
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _).trans ?_
    have hpm : ∏ i, ‖ι (m i)‖ ≤ ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := by

    apply mul_le_mul _ hpm (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)) hA
    have := hNB a b
    rw [hfeq] at this
    exact this
  
  have hSC1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
    show 1 ≤ (1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)|) ^ 2
    exact one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))])
  have hSCb : SC B.h ξ ^ (((2 * k + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ)) = SC B.h ξ ^ (2 * k + 3) := Real.rpow_natCast _ _
  have hSCp1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ (2 * k + 3) := one_le_pow₀ hSC1
  have hCmax : 0 ≤ max (max C' Cb) 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hQb0 : 0 < Qb γ.1 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _
  have hQb1 : Qb γ.1 ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos one_le_two (by simp)
  have heps0 : 0 < epsb B.h γ.1 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQb0 _
  have heps1 : epsb B.h γ.1 ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one hQb0.le hQb1 hh.le
  have he : |epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ))^2| ≤ 4 := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = epsb B.h γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have ha1 : 1 ≤ a := by
      rw [ha]; exact Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos heps0 heps1 (by norm_num)
    have hka : ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) < a + 1 := by
      show ((⌈epsb B.h γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) < a + 1

    have hk0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hea : epsb B.h γ.1 * a ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [ha, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul heps0.le]
      norm_num

    have hk2 : ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * a ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hpos : 0 ≤ epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ))^2 := by positivity
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hpos]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk2 heps0.le]
  have hTgc : 0 < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; positivity
  have hcib : 0 < cib B.h γ.1 := by
    unfold cib; exact mul_pos (zpow_pos hTgc _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQb0 _)

    fun η hη => hη
  obtain ⟨hAs, hPsis, hKms, hMs⟩ := pulse5_slow_smooth_v5 B G γ hB
  refine ⟨fun v hv => ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have hEv : (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => fun i j : Fin 3 => (APhi5 B G γ (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, Jpow (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1)) (G.ctr γ + (v * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0) • vtv)) - dDamp5 B G γ (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, Jpow (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1)) (G.ctr γ + (v * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0) • vtv)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) i j) =ᶠ[nhds (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)]
        (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => fun i j : Fin 3 => pcM5 B G γ s v i j) := by

    have hMv : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => fun i j : Fin 3 => pcM5 B G γ s v i j)

    have hAnn : 0 ≤ C' * SC B.h ξ ^ (2 * k + 3) := mul_nonneg hC'0 (by linarith)
    refine (hS6 _ (C' * SC B.h ξ ^ (2 * k + 3)) hAnn hMv (fun a b => ?_)).trans ?_
    · have hNs : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => pcN5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) v i)
          (DomC B.h B.qB) := fun i =>
        ((hAs i).sub (contDiffOn_const.mul (hPsis i))).comp π.contDiff.contDiffOn hmaps
      have hPs : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => pcPsi5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) i)
          (DomC B.h B.qB) := fun i => (hPsis i).comp π.contDiff.contDiffOn hmaps
      have hKs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
          (fun η : Cyl => pcKm5 B γ.1 (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) i j) (DomC B.h B.qB) := fun i j =>
        (hKms i j).comp π.contDiff.contDiffOn hmaps
      have hl := hlow γ ξ hact hdom hη hXa hXb v hv
      have hcn : c ≤ pcN5 B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v 0 * pcN5 B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v 0 +
          pcN5 B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v 1 * pcN5 B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v 1 +
          pcN5 B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v 2 * pcN5 B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg (pcN5 B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) v 0)]
      have hq := hC' B.h (SC B.h ξ) (epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ))^2) (DomC B.h B.qB) ξ
        (fun i η => pcN5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) v i)
        (fun i η => pcPsi5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) i)
        (fun i j η => pcKm5 B γ.1 (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) i j) hUo hdom hSC1 he hNs hPs hKs hcn
        (fun j hj => hDb γ ξ hact hdom hη hXa hXb v hv j hj) a b
      convert hq using 2
      funext η
      simp only [pcM5, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
        Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.one_apply,
        Pi.sub_apply, Pi.neg_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    · rw [hSCb]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) (by linarith)
  · 
    have h0L : (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) := ⟨le_rfl, hL0⟩
    have hl0 := hlow γ ξ hact hdom hη hXa hXb 0 h0L
    have hbc := hCb γ ξ hact hdom hη hXa hl0
    calc _ ≤ Cb := hbc
      _ ≤ max (max C' Cb) 0 := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
      _ ≤ max (max C' Cb) 0 * SC B.h ξ ^ (((2 * k + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
          rw [hSCb]; exact le_mul_of_one_le_right hCmax hSCp1

      hgp.differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (ENat.natCast_lt_top j))
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ, e = ((0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hγ : ∀ s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => ((s, r) : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ)) e v := by
      intro s; rw [he]; exact (hasDerivAt_const v s).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id v)
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun r => iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g (s0, r))
        (fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g) (s0, v) e) v :=
      hΦd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt v (hγ s0)
    obtain ⟨Cι, hCι⟩ : ∃ C : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) (Fin 3 → ℝ)
        →L[ℝ] ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (Fin 3 → ℝ),
        C = ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMapL (fun _ => ι) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun v' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s => g (s, v')) s0)
        (Cι (fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g) (s0, v) e)) v := by
      have h := Cι.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt v h1
      convert h using 1
      funext r
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, hCι, ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMapL_apply]
      exact star g hg s0 hs0 r j
    refine h2.congr_deriv ?_
    have hfd' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ g) O := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).mp hg).2
    obtain ⟨g1, hg1⟩ : ∃ g1 : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ), g1 = fun y => fderiv ℝ g y e :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hg1s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g1 O := by rw [hg1]; exact hfd'.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have hg1comp : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g1 (s0, v) =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (Fin 3 → ℝ) e).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun y => fderiv ℝ g y) (s0, v)) := by
      rw [hg1]
      exact (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (Fin 3 → ℝ) e).iteratedFDeriv_comp_left
        (hfd'.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds p0O)) (i := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hderiv_eq : (fun s => g1 (s, v)) =ᶠ[nhds s0] (fun s => deriv (fun v'' => g (s, v'')) v) := by
      filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hs0] with s hs
      have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (s, v) :=
        (hg.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds (hmem s hs v))).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun v'' => g (s, v'')) (fderiv ℝ g (s, v) e) v :=
        hfd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt v (hγ s)
      rw [h3.deriv, hg1]
    rw [← (hderiv_eq.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds, star g1 hg1s s0 hs0 v j, hCι]
    ext m
    simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMapL_apply,
      ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [hg1comp, ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply]
    have hL : iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j + 1) g (s0, v)
        (Fin.cons e (fun i => ι (m i)) : Fin (j + 1) → (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) =
        fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g) (s0, v) e (fun i => ι (m i)) := by
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.tail_cons]
    have hR : iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j + 1) g (s0, v)
        (Fin.snoc (fun i => ι (m i)) e : Fin (j + 1) → (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun y => fderiv ℝ g y) (s0, v) (fun i => ι (m i)) e := by
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right, Fin.init_snoc, Fin.snoc_last]
    have hrot : (Fin.cons e (fun i => ι (m i)) : Fin (j + 1) → (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) ∘ finRotate (j + 1) =
        (Fin.snoc (fun i => ι (m i)) e : Fin (j + 1) → (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) := by
      funext i
      exact (congrFun (Fin.snoc_eq_cons_rotate (fun i => ι (m i)) e) i).symm
    have hsymm := symmG O g hO hg (s0, v) p0O (j + 1)
      (Fin.cons e (fun i => ι (m i)) : Fin (j + 1) → (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) (finRotate (j + 1))
    rw [← hL, ← hR, ← hrot]
    exact congrFun hsymm.symm _
  
  obtain ⟨Bil, hBn, hBap⟩ : ∃ B : (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ‖B‖ ≤ 3 ∧ ∀ (A : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (z : Fin 3 → ℝ), B A z = Matrix.mulVec A z := by
    let B0 : (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ) :=
      LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ (fun A z => Matrix.mulVec A z)
        (fun M1 M2 z => Matrix.add_mulVec M1 M2 z)
        (fun c A z => by ext i; simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc])
        (fun A z1 z2 => Matrix.mulVec_add A z1 z2)
        (fun c A z => by
          ext i
          simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => by ring))
    have hb : ∀ A z, ‖B0 A z‖ ≤ 3 * ‖A‖ * ‖z‖ := by
      intro A z
      refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)).2 (fun i => ?_)
      show ‖∑ j, A i j * z j‖ ≤ _
      calc ‖∑ j, A i j * z j‖ ≤ ∑ j, ‖A i j * z j‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖A‖ * ‖z‖ := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => by
            rw [norm_mul]
            exact mul_le_mul ((norm_le_pi_norm (A i) j).trans (norm_le_pi_norm A i))
              (norm_le_pi_norm z j) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
        _ = 3 * ‖A‖ * ‖z‖ := by simp; ring
    exact ⟨B0.mkContinuous₂ 3 hb, LinearMap.mkContinuous₂_norm_le _ (by norm_num) hb, fun A z => rfl⟩
  
  refine ⟨fun v => (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun s => Matrix.mulVec (M (s, v)) (T (s, v))) s0)
      (fun i => Λ (m i)) - Matrix.mulVec (M (s0, v))
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun s => T (s, v)) s0) (fun i => Λ (m i))), fun v hv => ?_⟩
  
  have hW : IsOpen (U ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) := hU.prod isOpen_univ
  have hTv : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s => T (s, v)) s0 :=
    (hT.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds ⟨hs0, Set.mem_univ v⟩)).comp s0
      ((contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt)
  have hMv : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s => M (s, v)) s0 :=
    (hM.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds ⟨hs0, Set.mem_univ v⟩)).comp s0
      ((contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt)
  constructor
  · 
    have h1 := vcomm U T s0 k v hU hs0 hT
    have hev : (fun s => deriv (fun v'' => T (s, v'')) v) =ᶠ[nhds s0]
        (fun s => Matrix.mulVec (M (s, v)) (T (s, v))) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hs0) (fun s hs => (hode s hs v hv).deriv)
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds] at h1
    have h2 := (ContinuousMultilinearMap.apply ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (fun i => Λ (m i))).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt v h1
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun w => (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun s => T (s, w)) s0) (fun i => Λ (m i)))
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun s => Matrix.mulVec (M (s, v)) (T (s, v))) s0) (fun i => Λ (m i))) v :=
      h2
    refine h3.congr_deriv ?_
    exact (add_sub_cancel _ _).symm
  · 
    have hφ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s => M (s, v) - M (s0, v)) s0 := hMv.sub contDiffAt_const
    have hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s => Bil (M (s, v) - M (s0, v)) (T (s, v))) s0 :=
      (show ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s => Bil (M (s, v) - M (s0, v))) s0 from
        Bil.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp s0 hφ).clm_apply hTv
    have hT2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun s => Bil (M (s0, v)) (T (s, v))) s0 :=
      (Bil (M (s0, v))).contDiff.contDiffAt.comp s0 hTv
    have hfun : (fun s => Matrix.mulVec (M (s, v)) (T (s, v))) =
        (fun s => Bil (M (s, v) - M (s0, v)) (T (s, v))) + (fun s => Bil (M (s0, v)) (T (s, v))) := by
      funext s
      rw [Pi.add_apply, ← ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ← map_add, sub_add_cancel, hBap]
    have hD : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun s => Matrix.mulVec (M (s, v)) (T (s, v))) s0 (fun i => Λ (m i)) -
        Matrix.mulVec (M (s0, v)) (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun s => T (s, v)) s0 (fun i => Λ (m i))) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun s => Bil (M (s, v) - M (s0, v)) (T (s, v))) s0 (fun i => Λ (m i)) := by
      rw [hfun, iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (hg.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        (hT2.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
      have e := (Bil (M (s0, v))).iteratedFDeriv_comp_left hTv (i := k) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have e' : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun s => Bil (M (s0, v)) (T (s, v))) s0 =
          (Bil (M (s0, v))).compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun s => T (s, v)) s0) := e
      rw [e', ContinuousMultilinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply, hBap,
        add_sub_cancel_right]
    have hle : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun s => Bil (M (s, v) - M (s0, v)) (T (s, v))) s0
        (fun i => Λ (m i))‖ ≤
        sJet5 (fun s => Bil (M (s, v) - M (s0, v)) (T (s, v))) s0 Λ k * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := by
      have h := ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun s => Bil (M (s, v) - M (s0, v)) (T (s, v))) s0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Λ)).le_opNorm m
      simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply] at h
      exact h
    have h0 : sJet5 (fun s => M (s, v) - M (s0, v)) s0 Λ 0 = 0 := by
      unfold sJet5
      apply le_antisymm _ (norm_nonneg _)
      refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, sub_self, norm_zero, zero_mul]
    have hφi : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≠ 0 →
        sJet5 (fun s => M (s, v) - M (s0, v)) s0 Λ i = sJet5 (fun s => M (s, v)) s0 Λ i := by
      intro i hi
      have e := iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply (hMv.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        (contDiffAt_const : ContDiffAt ℝ i (fun _ => M (s0, v)) s0)
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne hi, Pi.zero_apply, sub_zero] at e
      have e' : iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun s => M (s, v) - M (s0, v)) s0 =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun s => M (s, v)) s0 := e
      unfold sJet5
      rw [e']
    have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (k.choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * sJet5 (fun s => M (s, v)) s0 Λ (i + 1) *
        sJet5 (fun s => T (s, v)) s0 Λ (k - (i + 1)) :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
        (norm_nonneg _))
    have hsum : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) *
        sJet5 (fun s => M (s, v) - M (s0, v)) s0 Λ i * sJet5 (fun s => T (s, v)) s0 Λ (k - i) =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (k.choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * sJet5 (fun s => M (s, v)) s0 Λ (i + 1) *
          sJet5 (fun s => T (s, v)) s0 Λ (k - (i + 1)) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', h0, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [hφi (i + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero i)])
    
    have lb : ∀ (f : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)) (g : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → (Fin 3 → ℝ)),
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f s0 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g s0 →
        ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x => Bil (f x) (g x)) s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤
          ‖Bil‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) *
            ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ *
            ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) g s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ := by
      intro f g hf hg
      have hf' : ContDiffAt ℝ k f s0 := hf.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have hg' : ContDiffAt ℝ k g s0 := hg.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      obtain ⟨uf, huf, hfu⟩ := hf'.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
      obtain ⟨ug, hug, hgu⟩ := hg'.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
      obtain ⟨O, hOsub, hOopen, hxO⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp (Filter.inter_mem huf hug)
      have hfO : ContDiffOn ℝ k f O := hfu.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).1)
      have hgO : ContDiffOn ℝ k g O := hgu.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).2)
      have hBO : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun x => Bil (f x) (g x)) O :=
        (Bil.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hfO).clm_apply hgO
      obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), s = (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) => s0 + z) ⁻¹' O :=
        ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hs : IsOpen s := by
        rw [hs_def]; exact hOopen.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
      have hO : IsOpen (⇑Λ ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage Λ.continuous
      have h0s : (0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈ s := by
        rw [hs_def]; show s0 + 0 ∈ O; rw [add_zero]; exact hxO
      have hL0s : Λ 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
      have h0O : (0 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈ ⇑Λ ⁻¹' s := hL0s
      have hsm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → W),
          ContDiffOn ℝ k F O → ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun z => F (s0 + z)) s := by
        intro W _ _ F hF
        exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
          (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
      have hsmO : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → W),
          ContDiffOn ℝ k F O → ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun z => F (s0 + Λ z)) (⇑Λ ⁻¹' s) := by
        intro W _ _ F hF
        exact (hsm F hF).comp Λ.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
      have key : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → W),
          ContDiffOn ℝ k F O → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k →
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (s0 + Λ z)) 0 =
            (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ) := by
        intro W _ _ F hF i hi
        have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (s0 + Λ z)) i hO h0O
        have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right Λ (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
          hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
        have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (s0 + z)) i hs h0s
        have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i s0 0
        calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (s0 + Λ z)) 0
            = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (s0 + z)) ∘ ⇑Λ) (⇑Λ ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
          _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (s0 + z)) s (Λ 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
                (fun _ => Λ) := e2
          _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (s0 + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
                (fun _ => Λ) := by rw [map_zero]
          _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (s0 + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
                (fun _ => Λ) := by rw [e3]
          _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F s0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
      have hl := ContinuousLinearMap.norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_le_of_bilinear Bil (hsmO f hfO)
        (hsmO g hgO) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O (n := k) le_rfl
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => Bil (f (s0 + Λ y)) (g (s0 + Λ y))) k hO h0O]
        at hl
      rw [← key _ hBO k le_rfl]
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => (fun x => Bil (f x) (g x)) (s0 + Λ z)) 0‖
          = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => Bil (f (s0 + Λ y)) (g (s0 + Λ y))) 0‖ := rfl
        _ ≤ _ := hl
        _ = _ := by
          congr 1
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i hi
          have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f (s0 + Λ z)) i hO h0O,
            iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => g (s0 + Λ z)) (k - i) hO h0O,
            key f hfO i hik, key g hgO (k - i) (Nat.sub_le k i)]
    have hN : sJet5 (fun s => Bil (M (s, v) - M (s0, v)) (T (s, v))) s0 Λ k ≤
        ‖Bil‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) *
          sJet5 (fun s => M (s, v) - M (s0, v)) s0 Λ i * sJet5 (fun s => T (s, v)) s0 Λ (k - i) :=
      lb (fun s => M (s, v) - M (s0, v)) (fun s => T (s, v)) hφ hTv
    rw [hsum] at hN
    have hμ : 0 ≤ ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
    show ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun s => Matrix.mulVec (M (s, v)) (T (s, v))) s0 (fun i => Λ (m i)) -
        Matrix.mulVec (M (s0, v)) (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun s => T (s, v)) s0 (fun i => Λ (m i)))‖ ≤ _
    rw [hD]
    refine hle.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hμ)
    exact hN.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hBn hS0)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (α β : ℝ) (D : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α D → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β (velW5 B G D) → (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ssh5Vw B G D γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) ∧ (∀ γ m, D γ m = 0 → ssh5Vw B G D γ m = 0) ∧ (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → ssh5Vw B G D γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) ∧ ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → sw5W B G l0 D x t Y = cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (ssh5Vw B G D) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hrot : ∀ (h e t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (r z : ℝ), 0 < r →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeF5 h e t Y0 n c) (rotPt r 0 z) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeF5 h e t Y0 n (fun η i => Complex.I * c η i)) (rotPt r 0 z) →

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h e t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (C : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (r z : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → t < 1 → 0 < r → DifferentiableAt ℝ C (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) → (∀ a : Fin 3, inner ℝ (curl3 (modeF5 h e t Y0 n C) (rotPt r 0 z)) (frameAt 0 (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) a) = qC h (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) ^ e * (axV5 h e n C (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) a).re) ∧ axV5 h e n (fun η i => Complex.I * C η i) (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) = fun i => Complex.I * axV5 h e n C (r, z, t, Yph h r t + Y0) i

subgoal_signatures.name: wmo_phase_deriv_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (qs α : ℝ) (c : WC), qs ≤ B.qB → InWg5 B G qs α c → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ i : Fin 3, dR B.h (fun η => modeCoef5 B G c γ m η i) ξ = (dR B.h (fun η => c γ m η i) ξ + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * c γ m ξ i) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) ∧ dZ (fun η => modeCoef5 B G c γ m η i) ξ = (dZ (fun η => c γ m η i) ξ + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * c γ m ξ i) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)))

subgoal_signatures.name: wmo_mode_amp_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (c : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl), B.ok → 0 < ξ.1 → ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → (∀ i : Fin 3, dR B.h (fun η => modeCoef5 B G c γ m η i) ξ = (dR B.h (fun η => c γ m η i) ξ + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * c γ m ξ i) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)))) → (∀ i : Fin 3, dZ (fun η => modeCoef5 B G c γ m η i) ξ = (dZ (fun η => c γ m η i) ξ + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * c γ m ξ i) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)))) → ∀ i : Fin 3, ((qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) * axV5 B.h (1/2 - Aex B.h) (m * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G c γ m) ξ i = ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (wmoAmp5 B G c γ m ξ i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))

subgoal_signatures.name: domc_open_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ) ∧ ContinuousOn (XC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dT f) (DomC B.h qs)) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → dR B.h f ξ = 0 ∧ dZ f ξ = 0 ∧ dT f ξ = 0)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (w : Ext ℝ³) (V : WC) (H : Finset ℤ), (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (V γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ γ m, m ∉ H → V γ m = 0) → (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → V γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) → (∀ (γ γ' : Lab) (m m' : ℤ), γ ≠ γ' → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), V γ m ξ ≠ 0 → ξ ∉ tsupport (V γ' m')) → (∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → w x t Y = cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G V (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∃ T : Finset Lab, ∀ γ M, γ ∉ T → ssh5QOf B G H V γ M ξ = 0) ∧ ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → pwrTr B.h w w x t Y = (qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2))) • cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (ssh5QOf B G H V) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))

signature.name: ssh5_transport_rep
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (w : Ext ℝ³) (V : WC) (H : Finset ℤ), (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (V γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ γ m, m ∉ H → V γ m = 0) → (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → V γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) → (∀ (γ γ' : Lab) (m m' : ℤ), γ ≠ γ' → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), V γ m ξ ≠ 0 → ξ ∉ tsupport (V γ' m')) → (∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → w x t Y = cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G V (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))) → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∃ T : Finset Lab, ∀ γ M, γ ∉ T → ssh5QOf B G H V γ M ξ = 0) ∧ ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → pwrTr B.h w w x t Y = (qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2))) • cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (ssh5QOf B G H V) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  
  obtain ⟨hh0, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, hqB1, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n0, fun l0 hl0 w V H hVs hVm hVsupp hdisj hrep => ?_⟩
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hl0) hn0.le
  
  have hTr0 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (U : Fin 3 → ℂ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (ξ : Cyl), (∀ a, U a = 0) →
      ssh5TrM B.h n U c ξ = 0 := by
    intro n U c ξ hU
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [ssh5TrM, hU]
  have hQ0 : ∀ γ M ξ, (∀ m, V γ m ξ = 0) → ssh5QOf B G H V γ M ξ = 0 := by
    intro γ M ξ h
    unfold ssh5QOf
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero, smul_zero]
    intro m _
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro m' _
    have hU : ∀ a, modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ a = 0 := fun a => by simp [modeCoef5, h m]
    have hU' : ∀ a, (fun i => starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ i)) a = 0 := fun a => by
      simp [hU a]
    rw [hTr0 _ _ _ _ hU, hTr0 _ _ _ _ hU']
    simp
  
  obtain ⟨Hq, hHq1, hHq2⟩ : ∃ Hq : Finset ℤ, (∀ m ∈ H, ∀ m' ∈ H, m + m' ∈ Hq) ∧
      (∀ m ∈ H, ∀ m' ∈ H, m' - m ∈ Hq) :=
    ⟨(H ×ˢ H).image (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => p.1 + p.2) ∪ (H ×ˢ H).image (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => p.2 - p.1),
      fun m hm m' hm' => Finset.mem_union_left _
        (Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨(m, m'), Finset.mem_product.2 ⟨hm, hm'⟩, rfl⟩),
      fun m hm m' hm' => Finset.mem_union_right _
        (Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨(m, m'), Finset.mem_product.2 ⟨hm, hm'⟩, rfl⟩)⟩
  
  have hregroup : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (θ : ℝ) (Γ : Finset Lab), 0 < qC B.h ξ → (∀ γ m, γ ∉ Γ → V γ m ξ = 0) →
      (qC B.h ξ ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2))) • waveV5 B G (ssh5QOf B G H V) θ ξ = fun i =>
        ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, ∑ m' ∈ H, ((1/2 : ℂ) * (ssh5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') ξ i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ + m' * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) + ssh5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (fun a => starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ a)) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') ξ i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m' * pint5 B G γ - m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)))).re := by
    intro ξ θ Γ hq hΓ
    funext i
    have hE : ∀ (γ : Lab) (M : ℤ), ssh5QOf B G H V γ M ξ i * ephase5 B G γ M θ ξ =
        (((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ) *
          ∑ m ∈ H, ∑ m' ∈ H,
            ((if m + m' = M then ssh5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ)
                (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') ξ i *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((M * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) else 0) +
             (if m' - m = M then ssh5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ)
                (fun a => starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ a)) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') ξ i *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((M * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) else 0)) := by
      intro γ M
      have he : Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) ≠ 0 :=
        Complex.exp_ne_zero _
      have hph : ephase5 B G γ M θ ξ =
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((M * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) := by
        unfold ephase5
        rw [← Complex.exp_add]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring
      have key : ∀ (c S F : ℂ),
          c * (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))⁻¹ * S *
            (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) * F) =
          c * (S * F) := by
        intro c S F
        rw [show c * (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))⁻¹ * S *
            (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) * F) =
            c * (S * F) * ((Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))⁻¹ *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)))) by ring,
          inv_mul_cancel₀ he, mul_one]
      rw [hph]
      unfold ssh5QOf
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.add_apply, ite_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
      rw [key]
      congr 1
      simp only [Finset.sum_mul, add_mul, ite_mul, zero_mul]
    have hsupp : ∀ γ : Lab, (Function.support fun M : ℤ => ssh5QOf B G H V γ M ξ i * ephase5 B G γ M θ ξ) ⊆
        (Hq : Set ℤ) := by
      intro γ M hM
      by_contra hn
      apply hM
      show ssh5QOf B G H V γ M ξ i * ephase5 B G γ M θ ξ = 0
      rw [hE, Finset.sum_eq_zero, mul_zero]
      intro m hm
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro m' hm'
      have h1 : ¬ (m + m' = M) := fun he => hn (by rw [← he]; exact Finset.mem_coe.2 (hHq1 m hm m' hm'))
      have h2 : ¬ (m' - m = M) := fun he => hn (by rw [← he]; exact Finset.mem_coe.2 (hHq2 m hm m' hm'))
      rw [if_neg h1, if_neg h2, add_zero]
    have hinner : ∀ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ M : ℤ, ssh5QOf B G H V γ M ξ i * ephase5 B G γ M θ ξ =
        (((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ) *
          ∑ m ∈ H, ∑ m' ∈ H,
            (ssh5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') ξ i *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ + m' * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) +
              ssh5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (fun a => starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G V γ m ξ a))
                (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') ξ i *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m' * pint5 B G γ - m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ))) := by
      intro γ
      rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (hsupp γ), Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun M _ => hE γ M),
        ← Finset.mul_sum]
      congr 1
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m hm => ?_)
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m' hm' => ?_)
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
      rw [if_pos (hHq1 m hm m' hm'), if_pos (hHq2 m hm m' hm'), add_mul, sub_mul]
    have hsuppΓ : (Function.support fun γ : Lab =>
        ∑ᶠ M : ℤ, ssh5QOf B G H V γ M ξ i * ephase5 B G γ M θ ξ) ⊆ (Γ : Set Lab) := by
      intro γ hγ
      by_contra hn
      apply hγ
      have h0 : ∀ M, ssh5QOf B G H V γ M ξ = 0 := fun M => hQ0 γ M ξ (fun m => hΓ γ m hn)
      simp [h0]
    have hc : qC B.h ξ ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) * (qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) / 2) = 1/2 := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg hq.le]
      field_simp [(Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)).ne']
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, waveV5]
    rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ hsuppΓ, Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => hinner γ),
      Complex.re_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
    rw [Complex.re_ofReal_mul, ← mul_assoc, hc, Complex.re_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
    rw [Complex.re_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m' _ => ?_)
    rw [show (1/2 : ℂ) = ((1/2 : ℝ) : ℂ) by push_cast; ring, Complex.re_ofReal_mul]
  refine ⟨fun ξ hξ => ?_, fun x t Y hxt => ?_⟩
  · 
    have hfin := etaL_tsupport_finite B.h ξ hok.1 hξ.2.1
    refine ⟨hfin.toFinset, fun γ M hγ => hQ0 γ M ξ (fun m => ?_)⟩
    by_contra hne
    exact hγ ((Set.Finite.mem_toFinset hfin).mpr (hVsupp γ m ξ hξ hne).2.1)
  · 
    have hxt' : 0 < rad x ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hxt
    have hξD : ptOf x t Y ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := hxt
    have hq : 0 < qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) := (hok.1.1 (x 2) (1 - t) (by linarith [hxt'.2.1])).1
    obtain ⟨Y', hY'⟩ : ∃ Y' : ℝ × ℝ, Y' = Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hζx : ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y') = ptOf x t Y := by
      rw [hY']; simp
    obtain ⟨-, hCd⟩ := pq5_coef_diff B G l0 V hok hG hqB hVs hVsupp
    have hCdx : ∀ γ m, DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeCoef5 B G V γ m) (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y')) := by
      intro γ m
      rw [hζx]
      exact hCd γ m _ hξD
    
    obtain ⟨N, hN, Γ, hΓN⟩ := etaL_local_finite_v5 B.h hok.1 (ptOf x t Y) hxt'.2.1
    have hoffN : ∀ η ∈ N, η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ),
        (γ ∉ Γ ∨ m ∉ H) → V γ m η = 0 := by
      intro η hηN hηD γ m hγm
      by_contra hne
      rcases hγm with hγ | hm
      · exact hγ (hΓN γ η hηN (hVsupp γ m η hηD hne).2.1)
      · exact hne (congrFun (hVm γ m hm) η)
    have hsum : ∀ (F : Lab → ℤ → ℂ), (∀ γ m, (γ ∉ Γ ∨ m ∉ H) → F γ m = 0) →
        ∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, F γ m = ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, F γ m := by
      intro F hF
      have hin : ∀ γ, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, F γ m = ∑ m ∈ H, F γ m := by
        intro γ
        apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
        intro m hm
        rw [Function.mem_support] at hm
        by_contra h
        exact hm (hF γ m (Or.inr (by simpa using h)))
      simp_rw [hin]
      apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
      intro γ hγ
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hγ
      by_contra h
      exact hγ (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun m _ => hF γ m (Or.inl (by simpa using h))))
    have hphase : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (θ : ℝ) (η : Cyl), ephase5 B G γ m θ η =
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) := by
      intro γ m θ η
      simp only [ephase5]
      rw [← Complex.exp_add]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    have hcyl_sum : ∀ (y : ℝ³) {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → Fin 3 → ℝ),
        cyl2cart y (∑ j ∈ s, v j) = ∑ j ∈ s, cyl2cart y (v j) := by
      intro y ι s v
      let L : (Fin 3 → ℝ) →+ ℝ³ := AddMonoidHom.mk' (cyl2cart y) (fun c d => by
        simp only [cyl2cart, Pi.add_apply, add_smul]; abel)
      exact map_sum L v s
    have hexpand : ∀ (y : ℝ³), corrOn B l0 y t →
        (∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), (γ ∉ Γ ∨ m ∉ H) →
          V γ m (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')) = 0) →
        cyl2cart y (waveV5 B G V (thetaOf y) (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y'))) =
          ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H,
            modeF5 B.h 0 t Y' (m * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m) y := by
      intro y hc hz
      have hF : ∀ (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), modeF5 B.h 0 t Y' n c y =
          cyl2cart y (fun i => (c (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')) i *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re) := by
        intro n c
        simp only [modeF5, Real.rpow_zero, one_smul]
      trans cyl2cart y (∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, fun i =>
        (modeCoef5 B G V γ m (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')) i *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re)
      · congr 1
        funext i
        simp only [waveV5, Finset.sum_apply]
        rw [hsum (fun γ m => V γ m (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')) i *
            ephase5 B G γ m (thetaOf y) (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')))
          (fun γ m h => by simp only [hz γ m h, Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul]), Complex.re_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
        rw [Complex.re_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
        rw [hphase]
        simp only [modeCoef5]
        congr 1
        ring
      · rw [hcyl_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
        rw [hcyl_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
        exact (hF _ _).symm
    have hradc : Continuous rad := by
      unfold rad
      fun_prop
    have hOopen : IsOpen {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t ∧
        ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y') ∈ interior N} := by
      rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
      intro y0 hy0
      have h1 : 0 < rad y0 := hy0.1.1
      have h2 : t < 1 := hy0.1.2.1
      have h3 : simScale B.h (y0 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hy0.1.2.2
      have h4 : ptOf y0 t (Yph B.h (rad y0) t + Y') ∈ interior N := hy0.2
      have e1 : ∀ᶠ y in nhds y0, (0:ℝ) < rad y :=
        continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hradc.continuousAt h1
      have hmem2 : ((y0 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)) :=
        ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - t by linarith⟩
      have hc1 : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t)) y0 := by
        have h1' : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (y0 2, 1 - t) :=
          (hok.1.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt ((isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds hmem2)).continuousAt
        have h2' : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => ((y 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ)) y0 := by fun_prop
        exact ContinuousAt.comp (x := y0) (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2)
          (f := fun y : ℝ³ => ((y 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ)) h1' h2'
      have e3 : ∀ᶠ y in nhds y0, simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 :=
        hc1.eventually_lt continuousAt_const h3
      have hPc : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')) y0 := by
        have hr1 : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => rad y ^ drx B.h) y0 :=
          hradc.continuousAt.rpow_const (Or.inl h1.ne')
        have h4' : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y') y0 :=
          ((hr1.smul continuousAt_const).add continuousAt_const).add continuousAt_const
        have h2'' : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => y 2) y0 := by fun_prop
        exact hradc.continuousAt.prodMk (h2''.prodMk (continuousAt_const.prodMk h4'))
      have e4 : ∀ᶠ y in nhds y0, ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y') ∈ interior N :=
        hPc.preimage_mem_nhds (isOpen_interior.mem_nhds h4)
      filter_upwards [e1, e3, e4] with y a1 a3 a4
      exact ⟨⟨a1, h2, a3⟩, a4⟩
    have hxO : x ∈ {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t ∧ ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y') ∈ interior N} := by
      refine ⟨hxt, ?_⟩
      show ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y') ∈ interior N
      rw [hζx]
      exact mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr hN
    have hΓ : ∀ γ m, γ ∉ Γ → V γ m (ptOf x t Y) = 0 := fun γ m hγ =>
      hoffN _ (mem_of_mem_nhds hN) hxt γ m (Or.inl hγ)
    have hFx : ∀ (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), modeF5 B.h 0 t Y' n c x =
        cyl2cart x (fun i => (c (ptOf x t Y) i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re) := by
      intro n c
      simp only [modeF5, Real.rpow_zero, one_smul, hζx]
    have hFd : ∀ γ (m : ℤ), DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeF5 B.h 0 t Y' (m * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m)) x :=
      fun γ m => modeF5_differentiable_v5 B.h 0 t Y' _ _ x hok.1 hxt'.2.1 hxt'.1 (hCdx γ m)
    
    have hQdef : pwrTr B.h w w x t Y = fderiv ℝ (fun y => w y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')) x
        (w x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y')) := by
      rw [hY']; rfl
    
    have hslice : (fun y => w y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')) =ᶠ[nhds x]
        (fun y => ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H,
          modeF5 B.h 0 t Y' (m * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m) y) := by
      filter_upwards [hOopen.mem_nhds hxO] with y hy
      rw [hrep y t _ hy.1, hexpand y hy.1 (fun γ m h => hoffN _ (interior_subset hy.2) hy.1 γ m h)]
    
    have hD : fderiv ℝ (fun y => w y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')) x =
        ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H,
          fderiv ℝ (modeF5 B.h 0 t Y' (m * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m)) x := by
      rw [hslice.fderiv_eq, fderiv_fun_sum (fun γ _ => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun m _ => hFd γ m))]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
      exact fderiv_fun_sum (fun m _ => hFd γ m)
    
    have hu : w x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y') =
        ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H,
          modeF5 B.h 0 t Y' (m * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m) x :=
      hslice.eq_of_nhds
    
    have hoff : ∀ γ' γ (m' m : ℤ), γ ≠ γ' →
        fderiv ℝ (modeF5 B.h 0 t Y' (m' * pint5 B G γ') (modeCoef5 B G V γ' m')) x
          (modeF5 B.h 0 t Y' (m * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m) x) = 0 := by
      intro γ' γ m' m hne
      by_cases hV : V γ m (ptOf x t Y) = 0
      · have h0 : ∀ i, modeCoef5 B G V γ m (ptOf x t Y) i = 0 := fun i => by simp [modeCoef5, hV]
        rw [hFx]
        simp [cyl2cart, h0]
      · have hts := hdisj γ γ' m m' hne _ hξD hV
        have hev : modeCoef5 B G V γ' m' =ᶠ[nhds (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y'))] 0 := by
          rw [hζx]
          filter_upwards [notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hts] with η hη
          funext i
          simp [modeCoef5, hη]
        rw [pq5_offdiag B.h t Y' _ _ x hxt'.1 hev]
        simp
    
    have hlin : ∀ (a b d : Fin 3 → ℝ) (s1 s2 s3 : ℝ),
        s1 • cyl2cart x a + s2 • cyl2cart x b + s3 • cyl2cart x d =
          cyl2cart x (fun i => s1 * a i + s2 * b i + s3 * d i) := by
      intro a b d s1 s2 s3
      simp only [cyl2cart, add_smul, smul_add, smul_smul]
      abel
    have hjet : ∀ (n' : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (v : Fin 3 → ℝ),
        DifferentiableAt ℝ c (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y')) →
        fderiv ℝ (modeF5 B.h 0 t Y' n' c) x (cyl2cart x v) =
          cyl2cart x (fun i => (ssh5TrM B.h n' (fun a => ((v a : ℝ) : ℂ)) c (ptOf x t Y) i *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n' : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re) := by
      intro n' c v hc
      have hR := pq5_jet_R B.h t Y' n' c x hok.1 hxt'.2.1 hxt'.1 hc
      have hZ := pq5_jet_Z B.h t Y' n' c x hok.1 hxt'.2.1 hxt'.1 hc
      have hT := pq5_jet_Th B.h t Y' n' c x hok.1 hxt'.2.1 hxt'.1 hc
      rw [hζx] at hR hZ hT
      have e1 : cyl2cart x v = v 0 • eR x + v 1 • eTh x + v 2 • eZ := rfl
      rw [e1, map_add, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, map_smul, hR, hZ, hT, hlin]
      congr 1
      funext i
      rw [← Complex.re_ofReal_mul, ← Complex.re_ofReal_mul, ← Complex.re_ofReal_mul,
        ← Complex.add_re, ← Complex.add_re]
      congr 1
      fin_cases i <;> simp [ssh5TrM, ptOf] <;> ring
    
    obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ : ∃ X : Lab → ℤ → ℤ → Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ γ m m' i, X γ m m' i =
        ((1/2 : ℂ) * (ssh5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m (ptOf x t Y)) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') (ptOf x t Y) i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ + m' * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ)) + ssh5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (fun a => starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G V γ m (ptOf x t Y) a)) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') (ptOf x t Y) i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m' * pint5 B G γ - m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ)))).re :=
      ⟨fun γ m m' i => ((1/2 : ℂ) * (ssh5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m (ptOf x t Y)) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') (ptOf x t Y) i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ + m' * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ)) + ssh5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) (fun a => starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G V γ m (ptOf x t Y) a)) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') (ptOf x t Y) i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m' * pint5 B G γ - m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ)))).re,
        fun _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩
    have hTT : ssh5TrM = pq5TrM := rfl
    have hdiag : ∀ γ (m m' : ℤ),
        fderiv ℝ (modeF5 B.h 0 t Y' (m' * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m')) x
          (modeF5 B.h 0 t Y' (m * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m) x) = cyl2cart x (X γ m m') := by
      intro γ m m'
      rw [hFx (m * pint5 B G γ), hjet (m' * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') _ (hCdx γ m')]
      congr 1
      funext i
      rw [hX, hTT]
      exact pq5_trm_split B.h (m * pint5 B G γ) (m' * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G V γ m (ptOf x t Y))
        (modeCoef5 B G V γ m') (ptOf x t Y) (thetaOf x) i
    
    have hRHS : (qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2))) •
        cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (ssh5QOf B G H V) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y)) =
          cyl2cart x (fun i => ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ H, ∑ m' ∈ H, X γ m m' i) := by
      have hsm : ∀ (c : ℝ) (u : Fin 3 → ℝ), c • cyl2cart x u = cyl2cart x (c • u) := by
        intro c u
        simp only [cyl2cart, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_add, smul_smul]
      rw [hsm, hregroup (ptOf x t Y) (thetaOf x) Γ hq hΓ]
      simp only [hX]
    obtain ⟨Lc, hLc⟩ : ∃ Lc : (Fin 3 → ℝ) →+ ℝ³, ∀ u, Lc u = cyl2cart x u :=
      ⟨{ toFun := cyl2cart x
         map_zero' := by simp [cyl2cart]
         map_add' := fun u v => by simp only [cyl2cart, Pi.add_apply, add_smul]; abel },
        fun u => rfl⟩
    
    rw [hQdef, hD, hu, hRHS]
    simp only [sum_apply, map_sum]
    calc _ = ∑ γ' ∈ Γ, ∑ m' ∈ H, ∑ m ∈ H,
          cyl2cart x (X γ' m' m) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ' hγ' => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m' _ => ?_))
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem γ' hγ' ?_]
          · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => hdiag γ' m' m)
          · intro γ _ hne
            exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun m _ => hoff γ γ' m m' (Ne.symm hne))
      _ = _ := by
          simp only [← hLc, ← map_sum]
          congr 1
          funext i
          simp only [Finset.sum_apply]

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (x : ℝ³), SimScaleProps h → t < 1 → 0 < rad x → DifferentiableAt ℝ c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) → fderiv ℝ (modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c) x (eR x) = cyl2cart x (fun i => (dR h c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re)

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (x : ℝ³), SimScaleProps h → t < 1 → 0 < rad x → DifferentiableAt ℝ c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) → fderiv ℝ (modeF5 h 0 t Y0 n c) x (eTh x) = cyl2cart x (fun i => (![Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ) * c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) 0 - c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) 1 / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ), Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ) * c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) 1 + c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) 0 / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ), Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / ((rad x : ℝ) : ℂ) * c (ptOf x t (Yph h (rad x) t + Y0)) 2] i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re)
