proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG l0 α D H hq hW γ M ξ hξ
  obtain ⟨hΩ, hqC, hqpos, -, -, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  have hQb : 0 < Qb γ.1 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  
  have hs1 : ∀ (m : ℤ), ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ssh5Vw B G D γ m η =
      ((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) • wmoAmp5 B G D γ m η := by
    intro m η hη
    have hq0 := hqpos η hη
    have hne : qC B.h η ≠ 0 := hq0.ne'
    have hd : HasFDerivAt (qC B.h) (fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) η) η :=
      ((hqC.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hη)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have hdz : dZ (fun η' => qC B.h η' ^ (-B.h)) η =
        -B.h * qC B.h η ^ (-B.h) * dZ (fun η' => Real.log (qC B.h η')) η := by
      unfold dZ
      rw [(hd.rpow_const (p := -B.h) (Or.inl hne)).fderiv, (hd.log hne).fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [Real.rpow_sub_one hne]
      ring
    have hab : qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h) * qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) = qC B.h η ^ (-B.h) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hq0]; congr 1; unfold Aex; ring
    have hdiv : (qC B.h η / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ) = qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * (Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2:ℝ))⁻¹ := by
      rw [Real.div_rpow hq0.le hQb.le, div_eq_mul_inv]
    have hneg : Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) = (Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2:ℝ))⁻¹ := Real.rpow_neg hQb.le _
    funext i
    simp only [ssh5Vw, wmoAmp5, rotC, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hdz, hdiv, hneg, ← hab]
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
        Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons] <;>
      push_cast <;> ring
  have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
  have hq0 := hqpos ξ hξ
  have hne : qC B.h ξ ≠ 0 := hq0.ne'
  have hd : HasFDerivAt (qC B.h) (fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) ξ) ξ :=
    ((hqC.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hξ)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
  
  have hR0 : fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) ξ ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) = 0 := by
    have hL : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ξ + t • ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv))
        ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) 0 := by
      have h0 := ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const
        ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)).const_add ξ
      simpa using h0
    have hd' : HasFDerivAt (qC B.h) (fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) ξ)
        (ξ + (0:ℝ) • ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)) := by
      rw [zero_smul, add_zero]; exact hd
    have h1 := hd'.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ) hL
    have hc : (qC B.h ∘ fun t : ℝ => ξ + t • ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)) =
        fun _ => qC B.h ξ := by
      funext t
      simp [qC]
    rw [hc] at h1
    exact h1.unique (hasDerivAt_const _ _)
  have hgq : HasFDerivAt (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h))
      ((-Aex B.h * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h - 1)) • fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) ξ) ξ :=
    hd.rpow_const (Or.inl hne)
  have hgC : HasFDerivAt (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (Complex.ofRealCLM.comp ((-Aex B.h * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h - 1)) • fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) ξ)) ξ := by
    have h0 := Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp ξ hgq
    exact h0
  have hZw : -Aex B.h * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h - 1) * fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) ξ ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ × ℝ)) =
      -(qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) * (Aex B.h * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) ξ)) := by
    unfold dZ
    rw [(hd.log hne).fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Real.rpow_sub_one hne]
    ring
  
  have hjet : ∀ (m : ℤ) (i : Fin 3),
      dR B.h (modeCoef5 B G (ssh5Vw B G D) γ m) ξ i =
        ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) * dR B.h (fun η => modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m η i) ξ ∧
      dZ (modeCoef5 B G (ssh5Vw B G D) γ m) ξ i =
        ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (dZ (fun η => modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m η i) ξ -
          ((Aex B.h * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m ξ i) := by
    intro m i
    have hEq : modeCoef5 B G (ssh5Vw B G D) γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ]
        (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m := by
      filter_upwards [hΩ.mem_nhds hξ] with η hη
      funext j
      simp only [modeCoef5, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hs1 m η hη, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]
      rfl
    have hF : HasFDerivAt (modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m)
        (fderiv ℝ (modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m) ξ) ξ :=
      (modeCoef5_differentiable_v5 B G hok hG (qsOf l0) α (wmoAmp5 B G D) hq hW γ m ξ hξ).hasFDerivAt
    have hFi := (hasFDerivAt_pi'.1 hF i).fderiv
    have hfd := (hEq.fderiv_eq).trans (hgC.smul hF).fderiv
    constructor
    · show fderiv ℝ (modeCoef5 B G (ssh5Vw B G D) γ m) ξ
          ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) i =
        ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) * fderiv ℝ (fun η => modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m η i) ξ
          ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)
      rw [hfd, hFi]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply,
        Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hR0, mul_zero,
        Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
    · show fderiv ℝ (modeCoef5 B G (ssh5Vw B G D) γ m) ξ ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ × ℝ)) i =
        ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (fderiv ℝ (fun η => modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m η i) ξ
          ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ × ℝ)) -
          ((Aex B.h * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m ξ i)
      rw [hfd, hFi]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply,
        Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hZw]
      push_cast
      ring
  
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℤ → ℂ, ∀ k : ℤ,
      E k = Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) := ⟨_, fun k => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : ℂ, s = ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hval : ∀ (m : ℤ) (i : Fin 3), modeCoef5 B G (ssh5Vw B G D) γ m ξ i =
      s * (wmoAmp5 B G D γ m ξ i * E m) := by
    intro m i
    rw [hE, hs]
    show ssh5Vw B G D γ m ξ i * _ = _
    rw [hs1 m ξ hξ, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]
  have hdR' : ∀ (m : ℤ) (i : Fin 3), dR B.h (modeCoef5 B G (ssh5Vw B G D) γ m) ξ i =
      s * ((dR B.h (fun η => wmoAmp5 B G D γ m η i) ξ + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) *
        ((dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * wmoAmp5 B G D γ m ξ i) * E m) := by
    intro m i
    rw [(hjet m i).1, (wmo_phase_deriv_v5 B G hok hG (qsOf l0) α (wmoAmp5 B G D) hq hW γ m ξ hξ i).1, hE, hs]
  have hdZ' : ∀ (m : ℤ) (i : Fin 3), dZ (modeCoef5 B G (ssh5Vw B G D) γ m) ξ i =
      s * ((dZ (fun η => wmoAmp5 B G D γ m η i) ξ + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) *
        ((dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * wmoAmp5 B G D γ m ξ i) * E m -
        ((Aex B.h * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (wmoAmp5 B G D γ m ξ i * E m)) := by
    intro m i
    rw [(hjet m i).2, (wmo_phase_deriv_v5 B G hok hG (qsOf l0) α (wmoAmp5 B G D) hq hW γ m ξ hξ i).2, hE, hs]
    rfl
  have hEadd : ∀ a b : ℤ, E (a + b) = E a * E b := by
    intro a b
    rw [hE, hE, hE, ← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have hconj : ∀ (m : ℤ) (i : Fin 3), starRingEnd ℂ (modeCoef5 B G (ssh5Vw B G D) γ m ξ i) =
      s * (starRingEnd ℂ (wmoAmp5 B G D γ m ξ i) * E (-m)) := by
    intro m i
    have hsr : starRingEnd ℂ s = s := by rw [hs, Complex.conj_ofReal]
    have hEc : starRingEnd ℂ (E m) = E (-m) := by
      rw [hE, hE, ← Complex.exp_conj]
      congr 1
      simp only [map_mul, Complex.conj_I, Complex.conj_ofReal, map_intCast, map_natCast]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hval, map_mul, map_mul, hsr, hEc]
  
  have hkb : 0 < kb B.h γ.1 := by
    unfold kb epsb
    exact Nat.ceil_pos.2 (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQb _) _)
  have hK : (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hkb.ne'
  have hr0 : (ξ.1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hξ'.1.ne'
  have hQh : ((Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hQb).ne'
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by rw [hs]; exact_mod_cast (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _).ne'
  have hE0 : ∀ k, E k ≠ 0 := fun k => by rw [hE]; exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _
  have hQi : Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) = (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1))⁻¹ := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hQb.le, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  have hPC : ((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ((Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ) / (2 * (s * s)) := by
    have hP : qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * (qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) =
        Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hq0, ← Real.rpow_add hq0, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
      congr 1
      ring
    have ha : ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by rw [← hs]; exact hs0
    rw [← hP, hs]
    push_cast
    field_simp
  have hpair : ∀ (σ m' : ℤ) (u U : Fin 3 → ℂ), σ + m' = M → (∀ i, U i = s * (u i * E σ)) →
      (((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (M : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))⁻¹) •
        ssh5TrM B.h (m' * pint5 B G γ) U (modeCoef5 B G (ssh5Vw B G D) γ m') ξ =
      (1/2 : ℂ) • ssh5T B G γ m' u (wmoAmp5 B G D γ m') ξ := by
    intro σ m' u U hσ hU
    have h1 := hE0 σ
    have h2 := hE0 m'
    rw [← hE M, ← hσ, hEadd, hPC]
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp only [ssh5TrM, ssh5T, crossC, nPhi5, DrC, DzC, pang5, RC, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three,
        Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hU, hval, hdR', hdZ', hQi, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk,
        Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.tail_cons] <;>
      push_cast <;>
      field_simp <;>
      ring
  
  by_cases hM : M = 0
  · subst hM
    simp [ssh5Osc, ssh5PF]
  · simp only [ssh5Osc, ssh5PF, if_neg hM, ssh5QOf]
    rw [Finset.smul_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
    rw [Finset.smul_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m' _ => ?_)
    rw [smul_add, smul_add]
    congr 1
    · by_cases h1 : m + m' = M
      · rw [if_pos h1, if_pos h1]
        exact hpair m m' _ _ h1 (hval m)
      · rw [if_neg h1, if_neg h1, smul_zero, smul_zero]
    · by_cases h2 : m' - m = M
      · rw [if_pos h2, if_pos h2]
        exact hpair (-m) m' _ _ (by omega) (fun i => hconj m i)
      · rw [if_neg h2, if_neg h2, smul_zero, smul_zero]

subgoal_signatures.name: domc_open_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ) ∧ ContinuousOn (XC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dT f) (DomC B.h qs)) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → dR B.h f ξ = 0 ∧ dZ f ξ = 0 ∧ dT f ξ = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: wmo_phase_deriv_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (qs α : ℝ) (c : WC), qs ≤ B.qB → InWg5 B G qs α c → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, ∀ i : Fin 3, dR B.h (fun η => modeCoef5 B G c γ m η i) ξ = (dR B.h (fun η => c γ m η i) ξ + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * c γ m ξ i) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) ∧ dZ (fun η => modeCoef5 B G c γ m η i) ξ = (dZ (fun η => c γ m η i) ξ + Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * c γ m ξ i) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)))

subgoal_signatures.name: modeCoef5_differentiable_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (qs α : ℝ) (a : WC), qs ≤ B.qB → InWg5 B G qs α a → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeCoef5 B G a γ m) ξ

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (β : ℝ) (D : WC) (H : Finset ℤ), 1/2 ≤ β → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 1/2) D → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β (wmoAmp5 B G D) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 1/2 - kapS) (velRem5 B D) → (0 : ℤ) ∉ H → (∀ γ m, m ∉ H → D γ m = 0) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 2/5) (ssh5PF B G H (wmoAmp5 B G D))

signature.name: ssh5_quad_class
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (β : ℝ) (D : WC) (H : Finset ℤ), 1/2 ≤ β → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 1/2) D → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β (wmoAmp5 B G D) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 1/2 - kapS) (velRem5 B D) → (0 : ℤ) ∉ H → (∀ γ m, m ∉ H → D γ m = 0) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 2/5) (ssh5PF B G H (wmoAmp5 B G D))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨hh0, -, hXa, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨lP, hP⟩ := pq5_prod_class B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lR, hR⟩ := pq5_dR_class B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lZ, hZ⟩ := pq5_dZ_class B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lM, hM⟩ := pq5_mult_class B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lN, hN⟩ := ssh5_ndot_class B G hok hG
  refine ⟨lP + lR + lZ + lM + lN, fun l0 hl0 β D H hβ hD hW hVR _h0H _hHD => ?_⟩
  have hk : kapS = 1 / 100000 := rfl
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hq1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hQb]; exact pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  
  have hpos : ∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → 0 < simScale B.h z (1 - t) := fun z t ht =>
    (hok.1.1 z (1 - t) (by linarith)).1
  have key0 : ∀ (C q a a' : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → a' ≤ a →
      C * q ^ (B.h * a) ≤ |C| * q ^ (B.h * a') := by
    intro C q a a' hq0 hq1' haa
    calc C * q ^ (B.h * a) ≤ |C| * q ^ (B.h * a) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)
      _ ≤ |C| * q ^ (B.h * a') :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1'
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left haa hh0.le)) (abs_nonneg C)
  have hED : ∀ X : ℝ, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb → 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X := by
    intro X h1 h2
    have hX0 : 0 < X := lt_trans hXa h1
    unfold edgeDist
    exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr h1))
      (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr h2)))
  have hSC : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (b : ℝ), 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ b := by
    intro ξ b
    exact Real.rpow_nonneg (by unfold SC; positivity) b
  have hMono : ∀ (a : WC) (α α' : ℝ),
      α' ≤ α → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α' a := by
    intro a α α' hαα ha
    obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3, c4, c5⟩ := ha
    refine ⟨c1, c2, c3, c4, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, b, d, hC⟩ := c5 k
    refine ⟨|C|, b, d, fun γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
    have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hpos ξ.2.1 ξ.2.2.1 hξ'.2.1
    have hq1' : qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 := le_trans hξ'.2.2.le hq1
    refine le_trans (hC γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2) ?_
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by unfold Penv5; exact (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hED _ hX1 hX2) _).le
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (key0 C _ α α' hq0 hq1' hαα) (hSC ξ b)
  have hAddV := (@pq5_add_congr_class B G (qsOf l0) hok hq1 (Fin 3 → ℂ) _ _)
  have low : ∀ (a : WC) (α : ℝ), β + 2/5 ≤ α → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a →
      InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 2/5) a := fun a α h ha => hMono a α _ h ha
  have add2 : ∀ f g : WC, InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 2/5) f → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 2/5) g →
      InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 2/5) (fun γ m ξ => f γ m ξ + g γ m ξ) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    have h := hAddV.1 _ _ f g hf hg
    rwa [min_self] at h
  
  have hNd := hN l0 (by omega) (β + 1/2) D hD hVR
  generalize wmoAmp5 B G D = W at hW hNd ⊢
  
  have hua : ∀ j : Fin 3, InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β (fun γ m ξ => W γ m ξ j) := fun j =>
    (pq5_comp_conj_class B G (qsOf l0) β hok).1 W j hW
  have hub : ∀ j : Fin 3, InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β (fun γ m ξ => starRingEnd ℂ (W γ (-m) ξ j)) := fun j =>
    (pq5_comp_conj_class B G (qsOf l0) β hok).2 _ (hua j)
  have hNdb := (pq5_comp_conj_class B G (qsOf l0) (β + 1/2 - kapS) hok).2 _ hNd
  
  have hRc := hR l0 (by omega) β W hW
  have hZc := hZ l0 (by omega) β W hW
  obtain ⟨hJ1, hW2, hW3⟩ := hM l0 (by omega) β W hW
  have hZW := hAddV.1 _ _ _ _ hZc hW2
  
  have hG : ∀ p : ℤ × ℤ, ∃ g : WC, InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 2/5) g ∧ ∀ γ M ξ, g γ M ξ =
      (if M ∈ ({p.1 + p.2} : Finset ℤ).erase 0 then
        (1/2 : ℂ) • ssh5T B G γ p.2 (W γ p.1 ξ) (W γ p.2) ξ else 0) +
      (if M ∈ ({p.2 - p.1} : Finset ℤ).erase 0 then
        (1/2 : ℂ) • ssh5T B G γ p.2 (fun i => starRingEnd ℂ (W γ p.1 ξ i)) (W γ p.2) ξ else 0) := by
    intro p
    have ha0 : (0:ℤ) ∉ ({p.1 + p.2} : Finset ℤ).erase 0 := Finset.notMem_erase 0 _
    have hb0 : (0:ℤ) ∉ ({p.2 - p.1} : Finset ℤ).erase 0 := Finset.notMem_erase 0 _

          (f := fun ψ => ((rotPt (rad w) ψ (w 2), t, Yph B.h (rad w) t + Y0) : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))
          ((hptc _ _).prodMk continuous_const) (fun ψ => hcircw ψ)
      have h3 : Continuous (fun ψ => frameAt ψ (ptOf w t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + Y0)) a) := by
        have h2 : (fun ψ => frameAt ψ (ptOf w t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + Y0)) a) =
            fun ψ => rotZ ψ (EuclideanSpace.single a 1) := funext fun ψ => hfr ψ a
        rw [h2]; exact hrotc _
      have h4 : f a = fun ψ => (inner ℝ (uX5 B G l0 S (rotPt (rad w) ψ (w 2)) t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + Y0))
          (frameAt ψ (ptOf w t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + Y0)) a) : ℝ) := funext (hfa a)
      rw [h4]
      exact h1.inner h3
    have hWc : ∀ ψ, evOff B.h W Y0 (rotPt (rad w) ψ (w 2)) t =
        uX5 B G l0 S (rotPt (rad w) ψ (w 2)) t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + Y0) -
          rotZ ψ (thA (f 0) • EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 + thA (f 1) • EuclideanSpace.single 1 1 +
            thA (f 2) • EuclideanSpace.single 2 1) := by
      intro ψ
      have hr := hradpt (rad w) ψ (w 2) hρ
      have h2 := hp2 (rad w) ψ (w 2)
      have e1 : evOff B.h W Y0 (rotPt (rad w) ψ (w 2)) t =
          W (rotPt (rad w) ψ (w 2)) t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + Y0) := by
        show W _ t (Yph B.h (rad (rotPt (rad w) ψ (w 2))) t + Y0) = _
        rw [hr]
      rw [e1, ← hw _ t _ (hcircw ψ)]
      show uX5 B G l0 S (rotPt (rad w) ψ (w 2)) t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + Y0) -
          thAvgVec (uX5 B G l0 S) (rotPt (rad w) ψ (w 2)) t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + Y0) = _
      congr 1
      have hpt : ptOf (rotPt (rad w) ψ (w 2)) t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + Y0) =
          ptOf w t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + Y0) := by
        simp only [ptOf, hr, h2]
      have e2 : thAvgVec (uX5 B G l0 S) (rotPt (rad w) ψ (w 2)) t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + Y0) =
          cyl2cart (rotPt (rad w) ψ (w 2)) (fun a => thA (f a)) := by
        simp only [thAvgVec, hpt, hr, h2, hf]
      rw [e2]
      obtain ⟨h0', h1', h2'⟩ := hframe (rad w) ψ (w 2) hρ
      simp only [cyl2cart, h0', h1', h2', hrotadd, hrotsmul]
    obtain ⟨d, hd_def⟩ : ∃ d : ℝ³, d = rotZ (-thetaOf w) c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Gf, hG⟩ : ∃ Gf : ℝ → ℝ, Gf = fun ψ =>
        (inner ℝ (evOff B.h W Y0 (rotPt (rad w) ψ (w 2)) t) (rotZ ψ d) : ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hGapp : ∀ ψ, Gf ψ = (inner ℝ (evOff B.h W Y0 (rotPt (rad w) ψ (w 2)) t) (rotZ ψ d) : ℝ) := by
      intro ψ; rw [hG]
    have hGper : Function.Periodic Gf (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro ψ; rw [hGapp, hGapp, hptper, hrotper]
    have hd : d = d 0 • EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 + d 1 • EuclideanSpace.single 1 1 +
        d 2 • EuclideanSpace.single 2 1 := by
      apply hext <;> simp
    have hGform : ∀ ψ, Gf ψ = d 0 * f 0 ψ + d 1 * f 1 ψ + d 2 * f 2 ψ -
        (thA (f 0) * d 0 + thA (f 1) * d 1 + thA (f 2) * d 2) := by
      intro ψ
      rw [hGapp, hWc ψ, inner_sub_left, hrotinner]
      have hA : (inner ℝ (thA (f 0) • EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 + thA (f 1) • EuclideanSpace.single 1 1 +
          thA (f 2) • EuclideanSpace.single 2 1 : ℝ³) d : ℝ) =
          thA (f 0) * d 0 + thA (f 1) * d 1 + thA (f 2) * d 2 := by
        rw [hinner]; simp
      have hud : (inner ℝ (uX5 B G l0 S (rotPt (rad w) ψ (w 2)) t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + Y0)) (rotZ ψ d) : ℝ) =
          d 0 * f 0 ψ + d 1 * f 1 ψ + d 2 * f 2 ψ := by
        conv_lhs => rw [hd]
        rw [hrotadd, hrotadd, hrotsmul, hrotsmul, hrotsmul, ← hfr ψ 0, ← hfr ψ 1, ← hfr ψ 2,
          inner_add_right, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right,
          real_inner_smul_right]
        simp only [hfa]
      rw [hud, hA]
    have hi : ∀ a, IntervalIntegrable (f a) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      fun a => (hfc a).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hGint0 : ∫ ψ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Gf ψ = 0 := by
      have hGfun : Gf = fun ψ => d 0 * f 0 ψ + d 1 * f 1 ψ + d 2 * f 2 ψ -
          (thA (f 0) * d 0 + thA (f 1) * d 1 + thA (f 2) * d 2) := funext hGform
      rw [hGfun, intervalIntegral.integral_sub, intervalIntegral.integral_add, intervalIntegral.integral_add,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const]
      · simp only [thA, smul_eq_mul, sub_zero]
        have hpi : Real.pi ≠ 0 := Real.pi_ne_zero
        field_simp
        ring
      all_goals first
        | exact intervalIntegrable_const
        | exact (((hi 0).const_mul _).add ((hi 1).const_mul _)).add ((hi 2).const_mul _)
        | exact ((hi 0).const_mul _).add ((hi 1).const_mul _)
        | exact (hi 0).const_mul _
        | exact (hi 1).const_mul _
        | exact (hi 2).const_mul _
    have hcθ : ∀ θ, rotZ θ c = rotZ (θ + thetaOf w) d := by
      intro θ
      rw [hd_def, hrotcomp]
      congr 1
      ring
    calc ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (inner ℝ (evOff B.h W Y0 (rotZ θ w) t) (rotZ θ c) : ℝ)
        = ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Gf (θ + thetaOf w) := by
          apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
          intro θ _
          simp only [hGapp, hrw, hcθ]
      _ = ∫ ψ in (0 + thetaOf w)..(2 * Real.pi + thetaOf w), Gf ψ :=
          intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right Gf (thetaOf w)
      _ = ∫ ψ in (0:ℝ)..(0 + 2 * Real.pi), Gf ψ := by
          rw [show 2 * Real.pi + thetaOf w = (0 + thetaOf w) + 2 * Real.pi by ring]
          exact hGper.intervalIntegral_add_eq (0 + thetaOf w) 0
      _ = 0 := by rw [zero_add]; exact hGint0
  
  
  
  have key : ∀ (t : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (y₀ : ℝ³), corrOn B l0 y₀ t → ∀ c : ℝ³,
      IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => (inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h W Y0 y t) (rotZ θ y₀)
          (cyl2cart (rotZ θ y₀) (dU (ptOf (rotZ θ y₀) t (Yph B.h (rad (rotZ θ y₀)) t + Y0))))
        + fderiv ℝ (fun y => cyl2cart y (dU (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y0)))) (rotZ θ y₀)
          (evOff B.h W Y0 (rotZ θ y₀) t)) (rotZ θ c) : ℝ)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) ∧
      ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h W Y0 y t) (rotZ θ y₀)
          (cyl2cart (rotZ θ y₀) (dU (ptOf (rotZ θ y₀) t (Yph B.h (rad (rotZ θ y₀)) t + Y0))))
        + fderiv ℝ (fun y => cyl2cart y (dU (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y0)))) (rotZ θ y₀)
          (evOff B.h W Y0 (rotZ θ y₀) t)) (rotZ θ c) : ℝ) = 0 := by
    intro t Y0 y₀ hy₀ c
    have hU := hUopen t hy₀.2.1
    have hWfs' := hWfs t Y0
    have hDfs' := hDfs t Y0
    have hy : y₀ ∈ {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t} := hy₀
    obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := core2 {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t}
      (fun y => cyl2cart y (dU (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y0)))) y₀ c hU hDfs'
      (fun α w _ => hDeq t Y0 α w) (hUrot t) hy
    obtain ⟨hI1, hZ1⟩ := core1 {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t} (fun y => evOff B.h W Y0 y t) y₀
      (cyl2cart y₀ (dU (ptOf y₀ t (Yph B.h (rad y₀) t + Y0)))) c hU (hUrot t) hWfs'
      (fun w hw => hzero t Y0 w hw c) hy
    have hg2c : Continuous (fun θ => (inner ℝ (evOff B.h W Y0 (rotZ θ y₀) t) (rotZ θ c') : ℝ)) := by
      have h1 : Continuous (fun θ => evOff B.h W Y0 (rotZ θ y₀) t) :=
        hWfs'.continuousOn.comp_continuous (hrotc y₀) (fun θ => hUrot t θ y₀ hy)
      exact h1.inner (hrotc c')
    simp only [hDeq, inner_add_left, hc']
    refine ⟨hI1.add (hg2c.intervalIntegrable _ _), ?_⟩
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hI1 (hg2c.intervalIntegrable _ _), hZ1, hzero t Y0 y₀ hy₀ c', add_zero]
  
  
  
  intro x t Y hxt
  have hr : 0 < rad x := hxt.1
  have hy₀ : corrOn B l0 (rotPt (rad x) 0 (x 2)) t := hcirc t (rad x) (x 2) 0 hr hxt.2.1 hxt.2.2
  have hy0rot : ∀ θ, rotZ θ (rotPt (rad x) 0 (x 2)) = rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2) := by
    intro θ; rw [hrotpt, add_zero]
  have hcx : ∀ θ, crossXm B.h W D (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h W (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y t) (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))
          (cyl2cart (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) (dU (ptOf (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t
            (Yph B.h (rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)))))
        + fderiv ℝ (fun y => cyl2cart y (dU (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)))))
            (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) (evOff B.h W (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t) := by
    intro θ
    have hrθ : rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) = rad x := hradpt _ _ _ hr
    have hcθ : corrOn B l0 (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t := hcirc t (rad x) (x 2) θ hr hxt.2.1 hxt.2.2
    have hUn : {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t} ∈ nhds (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) :=
      (hUopen t hxt.2.1).mem_nhds hcθ
    have hDev : (fun y => evOff B.h D (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y t) =ᶠ[nhds (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))]
        (fun y => cyl2cart y (dU (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t))))) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hUn
        (fun y hy => hD y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) hy)
    have hDpt : evOff B.h D (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t =
        cyl2cart (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) (dU (ptOf (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t
          (Yph B.h (rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)))) :=
      hD _ t _ hcθ
    unfold crossXm
    rw [hrθ, hDev.fderiv_eq, hDpt, hrθ]
  have hcoef : ∀ a : Fin 3, IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => (inner ℝ (crossXm B.h W D (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y)
        (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a) : ℝ)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) ∧
      ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (inner ℝ (crossXm B.h W D (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y)
        (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a) : ℝ) = 0 := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨hI, hZ⟩ := key t (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) (rotPt (rad x) 0 (x 2)) hy₀ (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)
    simp only [hy0rot] at hI hZ
    have hfr : ∀ θ, frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a = rotZ θ (EuclideanSpace.single a 1) :=
      fun θ => hframeAt θ _ a hr
    simp only [hcx, hfr]
    exact ⟨hI, hZ⟩
  refine ⟨?_, fun a => (hcoef a).1⟩
  have hz : ∀ a : Fin 3, ∫ θ in (0:ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (inner ℝ (crossXm B.h W D (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y)
        (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a) : ℝ) = 0 := fun a => (hcoef a).2
  simp only [thAvgVec, thA, hz, mul_zero]
  simp [cyl2cart]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState), B.ok → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => uX5 B G l0 S p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) {p | corrOn B l0 p.1 p.2.1} → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => PX5 B G l0 S p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) {p | corrOn B l0 p.1 p.2.1} → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → ∀ a : Fin 3, IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => inner ℝ (resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (PX5 B G l0 S) (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)

signature.name: thp_res_integrable
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState), B.ok → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => uX5 B G l0 S p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) {p | corrOn B l0 p.1 p.2.1} → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => PX5 B G l0 S p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) {p | corrOn B l0 p.1 p.2.1} → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → ∀ a : Fin 3, IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => inner ℝ (resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (PX5 B G l0 S) (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) (frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 S hok huS hpS x t Y hxt a
  generalize uX5 B G l0 S = U at huS ⊢
  generalize PX5 B G l0 S = P at hpS ⊢
  
  have hNS : ∀ (ν : ℝ) (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)), IsOpen O →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(nsResidual ν u p)) O := by
    intro ν u p O hO hu hp
    have s1 : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : ℝ³ × ℝ → F) (x : ℝ³)
        (t : ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ f (x, t) →
        deriv (fun s => f (x, s)) t = fderiv ℝ f (x, t) ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ)) ∧
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => f (y, t)) x =
          (fderiv ℝ f (x, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := by
      intro F _ _ f x t hf
      constructor
      · have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ((x, s) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ)) t :=
          (hasDerivAt_const t x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id t)
        exact (hf.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hγ).deriv
      · exact (hf.hasFDerivAt.comp x (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left x t)).fderiv
    have s2 : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : ℝ³ × ℝ → F) (x : ℝ³)
        (t : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O → (x, t) ∈ O → ∀ a b : ℝ³,
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => f (y, t))) x a b =
          fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (x, t) (a, (0 : ℝ)) (b, (0 : ℝ)) := by
      intro F _ _ f x t hf hxt a b
      have hemb : Continuous (fun y : ℝ³ => ((y, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ)) :=
        continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const
      have hN : {y : ℝ³ | (y, t) ∈ O} ∈ nhds x := (hO.preimage hemb).mem_nhds hxt
      let Φ : (ℝ³ × ℝ →L[ℝ] F) →L[ℝ] (ℝ³ →L[ℝ] F) :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ ℝ³ (ℝ³ × ℝ) F).flip (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)
      have hΦ : ∀ M, Φ M = M.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := fun M => rfl
      have hev : fderiv ℝ (fun y => f (y, t)) =ᶠ[nhds x] fun y => Φ (fderiv ℝ f (y, t)) := by
        filter_upwards [hN] with y hy
        have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (y, t) :=
          (hf.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
        rw [hΦ]
        exact (s1 f y t hd).2
      have hDf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) O :=
        ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hf).2
      have hD2 : HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ f) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (x, t)) (x, t) :=
        ((hDf.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hxt)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
      have hg : HasFDerivAt (fun y => Φ (fderiv ℝ f (y, t)))
          (Φ.comp ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (x, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ))) x :=
        Φ.hasFDerivAt.comp x (hD2.comp x (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left x t))
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq, hg.fderiv]
      rfl
    have s3 : ∀ (g : ℝ³ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³), gradient g x = ∑ i : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ g x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) := by
      intro g x
      have h := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr' (gradient g x)
      rw [← h]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      simp only [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
      congr 1
      rw [real_inner_comm]
      exact InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply
    have s4 : ∀ (g : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (x : ℝ³), Δ g x = ∑ i : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) := by
      intro g x
      have h := congrFun (InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_orthonormalBasis g
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)) x
      rw [h]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
      simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
    have hDu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿u)) O :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hu).2
    have hD2u : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿u))) O :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hDu).2
    have hDp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (↿p)) O :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hp).2
    have hT3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿u)) z
        (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) O :=
      ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => (hD2u.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have hT4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (↿p) z
        (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) O :=
      ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => (hDp.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).smul contDiffOn_const
    have hJ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (nsJet ν u p) O := by
      unfold nsJet
      exact (((hDu.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).add
        (hDu.clm_apply (hu.prodMk contDiffOn_const))).sub (hT3.const_smul ν)).add hT4
    have hid : ∀ z ∈ O, (↿(nsResidual ν u p)) z = nsJet ν u p z := by
      rintro ⟨x, t⟩ hz
      have hu' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿u) (x, t) :=
        (hu.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hp' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿p) (x, t) :=
        (hp.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have e1 : deriv (fun s => u x s) t = fderiv ℝ (↿u) (x, t) ((0 : ℝ³), (1 : ℝ)) :=
        (s1 (↿u) x t hu').1
      have e2 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) x (u x t) =
          fderiv ℝ (↿u) (x, t) ((↿u) (x, t), (0 : ℝ)) := by
        have h2 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) x =
            (fderiv ℝ (↿u) (x, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := (s1 (↿u) x t hu').2
        rw [h2]
        rfl
      have e3 : Δ (fun y => u y t) x = ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (↿u)) (x, t)
          (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) := by
        rw [s4]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => s2 (↿u) x t hu hz _ _)
      have e4 : gradient (fun y => p y t) x = ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (↿p) (x, t)
          (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) := by
        have h2 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => p y t) x =
            (fderiv ℝ (↿p) (x, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := (s1 (↿p) x t hp').2
        rw [s3, h2]
        rfl
      show nsResidual ν u p x t = nsJet ν u p (x, t)
      rw [nsResidual, e1, e2, e3, e4]
      rfl
    exact hJ.congr hid
  
  have hσ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := hok.1.2.2.2.1
  have hcc : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x i) := fun i => contDiff_piLp_apply 2
  have hC3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
    have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      ((hcc 2).comp contDiff_fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd)
    have hmaps : MapsTo (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1}
        (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro w hw
      have hw' : w.2 < 1 := hw
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 by linarith⟩
    exact hσ.comp hg.contDiffOn hmaps
  have hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) := ((hcc 0).pow 2).add ((hcc 1).pow 2)
  have hC4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ rad {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} := by
    have h := hf.contDiffOn.sqrt (s := {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x}) (fun x hx => by
      have hx' : 0 < Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) := hx
      exact (Real.sqrt_pos.mp hx').ne')
    exact h
  have hradc : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1) :=
    Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (hf.continuous.comp continuous_fst)
  have hC1 : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} := by
    have h1 : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < rad w.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const hradc
    have h2 : IsOpen ({w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
        (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0)) :=
      hC3.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const) isOpen_Iio
    have e : {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | 0 < rad w.1} ∩
        ({w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
          (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0)) := by
      ext w; rfl
    rw [e]; exact h1.inter h2
  have hmapsR : MapsTo (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.1) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2}
      {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} := fun w hw => hw.1
  have c1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} :=
    hC4.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn hmapsR
  have c3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.2) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} :=
    contDiff_snd.contDiffOn
  
  obtain ⟨Y0, hY0⟩ : ∃ Y0 : ℝ × ℝ, Y0 = Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have c4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + Y0)
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} := by
    have hp := c1.rpow_const_of_ne (p := drx B.h) (fun w hw => ne_of_gt hw.1)
    exact ((hp.smul contDiffOn_const).add (c3.smul contDiffOn_const)).add contDiffOn_const
  have hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1, w.2, Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + Y0) : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} :=
    contDiffOn_fst.prodMk (contDiffOn_snd.prodMk c4)
  have hmaps : MapsTo
      (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1, w.2, Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + Y0) : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} {p : ℝ³ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | corrOn B l0 p.1 p.2.1} :=
    fun w hw => hw
  have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h U Y0)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} :=
    huS.comp hψ hmaps
  have hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h P Y0)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} :=
    hpS.comp hψ hmaps
  have hN := (hNS 1 _ _ _ hC1 hu hp).continuousOn
  
  have hcontC : ContinuousOn (fun y => resX B.h U P y t Y)
      {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t ∧ rad y = rad x} := by
    have hEq : ∀ y ∈ {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t ∧ rad y = rad x},
        resX B.h U P y t Y = nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h U Y0) (evOff B.h P Y0) y t := by
      intro y hy
      show nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h U (Y - Yph B.h (rad y) t))
        (evOff B.h P (Y - Yph B.h (rad y) t)) y t = _
      rw [hy.2, ← hY0]
    generalize nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h U Y0) (evOff B.h P Y0) = R at hN hEq
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun y => R y t) {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t ∧ rad y = rad x} :=
      hN.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn (fun y hy => hy.1)
    exact h1.congr hEq
  
  have hr : 0 < rad x := hxt.1
  have e0 : ∀ θ : ℝ, (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 0 = rad x * Real.cos θ := fun θ => by simp [rotPt]
  have e1 : ∀ θ : ℝ, (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 1 = rad x * Real.sin θ := fun θ => by simp [rotPt]
  have e2 : ∀ θ : ℝ, (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 2 = x 2 := fun θ => by simp [rotPt]
  have hrad : ∀ θ : ℝ, rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) = rad x := by
    intro θ
    have hsq : (rad x * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (rad x * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = rad x ^ 2 := by
      have hcs := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
      calc (rad x * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (rad x * Real.sin θ) ^ 2
          = rad x ^ 2 * (Real.cos θ ^ 2 + Real.sin θ ^ 2) := by ring
        _ = rad x ^ 2 := by rw [hcs, mul_one]
    rw [show rad (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) =
        Real.sqrt ((rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) 1 ^ 2) from rfl, e0, e1, hsq,
      Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
  have hmem : ∀ θ : ℝ, rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2) ∈ {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t ∧ rad y = rad x} := by
    intro θ
    refine ⟨⟨?_, hxt.2.1, ?_⟩, hrad θ⟩
    · rw [hrad θ]; exact hr
    · have h3 : simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hxt.2.2
      rw [e2 θ]; exact h3
  
  apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable
  have hc : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) := by
    unfold rotPt
    fun_prop
  have hφ : Continuous (fun θ => resX B.h U P (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2)) t Y) :=
    hcontC.comp_continuous hc hmem
  have hR : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => eR (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) := by
    have e : (fun θ : ℝ => eR (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) = fun θ : ℝ =>
        (rad x)⁻¹ • ((rad x * Real.cos θ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
          (rad x * Real.sin θ) • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) := by
      funext θ
      rw [eR, hrad θ, radVec, e0, e1]
    rw [e]
    fun_prop
  have hT : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => eTh (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) := by
    have e : (fun θ : ℝ => eTh (rotPt (rad x) θ (x 2))) = fun θ : ℝ =>
        (rad x)⁻¹ • (-(rad x * Real.sin θ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
          (rad x * Real.cos θ) • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) := by
      funext θ
      rw [eTh, hrad θ, azVec, e0, e1]
    rw [e]
    fun_prop
  have hframe : Continuous (fun θ => frameAt θ (ptOf x t Y) a) := by
    fin_cases a
    · exact hR
    · exact hT
    · exact continuous_const
  exact hφ.inner hframe

informal_problem.statement: ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {ι : Type} (O : Set E) (T : Finset ι) (W : E → ℝ) (u : ι → Fin 3 → E → ℂ) (v : ι → E → ℂ) (f : Fin 3 → E → ℝ³), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ W O → (∀ t i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (u t i) O) → (∀ t, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (v t) O) → (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f i) O) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => W x • ∑ t ∈ T, ∑ i : Fin 3, (u t i x * v t x).re • f i x) O ∧ ∀ (x : E) (k : ℕ) (Cw S A R : ℝ), x ∈ O → 0 ≤ Cw → 0 ≤ S → 0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ R → (∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j W x‖ ≤ Cw * S ^ j) → (∀ t ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (u t i) x‖ ≤ A * R ^ j) → (∀ t ∈ T, ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (v t) x‖ ≤ R ^ j) → (∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (f i) x‖ ≤ R ^ j) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x => W x • ∑ t ∈ T, ∑ i : Fin 3, (u t i x * v t x).re • f i x) x‖ ≤ 3 * (T.card : ℝ) * Cw * A * (S + 3 * R) ^ k
