signature.statement: ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {ι : Type} (O : Set E) (T : Finset ι) (W : E → ℝ) (u : ι → Fin 3 → E → ℂ) (v : ι → E → ℂ) (f : Fin 3 → E → ℝ³), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ W O → (∀ t i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (u t i) O) → (∀ t, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (v t) O) → (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f i) O) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => W x • ∑ t ∈ T, ∑ i : Fin 3, (u t i x * v t x).re • f i x) O ∧ ∀ (x : E) (k : ℕ) (Cw S A R : ℝ), x ∈ O → 0 ≤ Cw → 0 ≤ S → 0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ R → (∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j W x‖ ≤ Cw * S ^ j) → (∀ t ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (u t i) x‖ ≤ A * R ^ j) → (∀ t ∈ T, ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (v t) x‖ ≤ R ^ j) → (∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (f i) x‖ ≤ R ^ j) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x => W x • ∑ t ∈ T, ∑ i : Fin 3, (u t i x * v t x).re • f i x) x‖ ≤ 3 * (T.card : ℝ) * Cw * A * (S + 3 * R) ^ k

proof.tactics:
by
  intro E _ _ ι O T W u v f hO hW hu hv hf
  have hN : ∀ j : ℕ, (j : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := fun j => by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hre_fun : ∀ g : E → ℂ, (⇑Complex.reCLM ∘ g) = fun y => (g y).re := fun g => by
    funext y; simp [Complex.reCLM_apply]
  have hP : ∀ t i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => u t i y * v t y) O := fun t i => (hu t i).mul (hv t)
  have hRe : ∀ t i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (u t i y * v t y).re) O := by
    intro t i
    have h := Complex.reCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (hP t i)
    rw [hre_fun] at h
    exact h
  have hg : ∀ t i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (u t i y * v t y).re • f i y) O := fun t i =>
    (hRe t i).smul (hf i)
  have hgi : ∀ t, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, (u t i y * v t y).re • f i y) O := fun t =>
    ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => hg t i)
  have hSig : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ t ∈ T, ∑ i : Fin 3, (u t i y * v t y).re • f i y) O :=
    ContDiffOn.sum (fun t _ => hgi t)
  refine ⟨hW.smul hSig, ?_⟩
  intro x k Cw S A R hx hCw hS hA hR hWb hub hvb hfb
  have U : UniqueDiffOn ℝ O := hO.uniqueDiffOn
  
  have binom : ∀ (j : ℕ) (α X β Y : ℝ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ), 0 ≤ α → 0 ≤ X →
      (∀ m ≤ j, a m ≤ α * X ^ m) → (∀ m ≤ j, b m ≤ β * Y ^ m) → (∀ m, 0 ≤ b m) →
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose m : ℝ) * a m * b (j - m) ≤ α * β * (X + Y) ^ j := by
    intro j α X β Y a b hα hX ha hb hb0
    calc ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose m : ℝ) * a m * b (j - m)
        ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose m : ℝ) * (α * X ^ m) * (β * Y ^ (j - m)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro m hm
          have hmj : m ≤ j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hm)
          have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ j.choose m := Nat.cast_nonneg _
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ha m hmj) hc) (hb (j - m) (Nat.sub_le j m))
            (hb0 _) (mul_nonneg hc (mul_nonneg hα (pow_nonneg hX m)))
      _ = α * β * (X + Y) ^ j := by
          rw [add_pow, Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
          ring
  
  have hW' : ∀ m ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m W O x‖ ≤ Cw * S ^ m := fun m hm => by
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hO hx]; exact hWb m hm
  have hu' : ∀ t ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ m ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (u t i) O x‖ ≤ A * R ^ m :=
    fun t ht i m hm => by
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hO hx]; exact hub t ht i m hm
  have hv' : ∀ t ∈ T, ∀ m ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (v t) O x‖ ≤ 1 * R ^ m :=
    fun t ht m hm => by
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hO hx, one_mul]; exact hvb t ht m hm
  have hf' : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ m ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (f i) O x‖ ≤ 1 * R ^ m :=
    fun i m hm => by
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hO hx, one_mul]; exact hfb i m hm
  
  have hPb : ∀ t ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j ≤ k,
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j (fun y => u t i y * v t y) O x‖ ≤ A * (R + R) ^ j := by
    intro t ht i j hj
    refine (norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le (hu t i) (hv t) U hx (hN j)).trans ?_
    have h := binom j A R 1 R (fun m => ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (u t i) O x‖)
      (fun m => ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (v t) O x‖) hA hR
      (fun m hm => hu' t ht i m (hm.trans hj)) (fun m hm => hv' t ht m (hm.trans hj))
      (fun m => norm_nonneg _)
    refine h.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    ring
  
  have hReb : ∀ t ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j ≤ k,
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j (fun y => (u t i y * v t y).re) O x‖ ≤ A * (R + R) ^ j := by
    intro t ht i j hj
    have h1 := Complex.reCLM.norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_left
      ((hP t i).contDiffWithinAt hx) U hx (hN j)
    rw [Complex.reCLM_norm, one_mul, hre_fun] at h1
    exact h1.trans (hPb t ht i j hj)
  
  have hgb : ∀ t ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j ≤ k,
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j (fun y => (u t i y * v t y).re • f i y) O x‖ ≤
        A * (3 * R) ^ j := by
    intro t ht i j hj
    refine (norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_smul_le (hRe t i) (hf i) U hx (hN j)).trans ?_
    have h := binom j A (R + R) 1 R (fun m => ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (fun y => (u t i y * v t y).re) O x‖)
      (fun m => ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (f i) O x‖) hA (by linarith)
      (fun m hm => hReb t ht i m (hm.trans hj)) (fun m hm => hf' i m (hm.trans hj))
      (fun m => norm_nonneg _)
    refine h.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    ring
  
  have hgib : ∀ t ∈ T, ∀ j ≤ k,
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, (u t i y * v t y).re • f i y) O x‖ ≤
        3 * (A * (3 * R) ^ j) := by
    intro t ht j hj
    have e : (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, (u t i y * v t y).re • f i y) =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, (fun y => (u t i y * v t y).re • f i y) := by
      funext y; simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [e, iteratedFDerivWithin_sum_apply U hx
      (fun i _ => ((hg t i).contDiffWithinAt hx).of_le (hN j))]
    refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
    calc ∑ i : Fin 3, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j (fun y => (u t i y * v t y).re • f i y) O x‖
        ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, A * (3 * R) ^ j := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hgb t ht i j hj)
      _ = 3 * (A * (3 * R) ^ j) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
          norm_num
  
  have hSigb : ∀ j ≤ k,
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j (fun y => ∑ t ∈ T, ∑ i : Fin 3, (u t i y * v t y).re • f i y) O x‖ ≤
        (3 * (T.card : ℝ) * A) * (3 * R) ^ j := by
    intro j hj
    have e : (fun y => ∑ t ∈ T, ∑ i : Fin 3, (u t i y * v t y).re • f i y) =
        ∑ t ∈ T, (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, (u t i y * v t y).re • f i y) := by
      funext y; simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [e, iteratedFDerivWithin_sum_apply U hx
      (fun t _ => ((hgi t).contDiffWithinAt hx).of_le (hN j))]
    refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
    calc ∑ t ∈ T, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, (u t i y * v t y).re • f i y) O x‖
        ≤ ∑ t ∈ T, 3 * (A * (3 * R) ^ j) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun t ht => hgib t ht j hj)
      _ = (3 * (T.card : ℝ) * A) * (3 * R) ^ j := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
          ring
  
  have hfin := (norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_smul_le hW hSig U hx (hN k)).trans
    (binom k Cw S (3 * (T.card : ℝ) * A) (3 * R) (fun m => ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m W O x‖)
      (fun m => ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m
        (fun y => ∑ t ∈ T, ∑ i : Fin 3, (u t i y * v t y).re • f i y) O x‖)
      hCw hS hW' hSigb (fun m => norm_nonneg _))
  rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen k hO hx]
  refine hfin.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 → ∀ (k : ℕ) (R : ℝ), ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (p : ℝ³ × ℝ), 0 < rad p.1 → rad p.1 ≤ R → (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph h (rad w.1) w.2 + Y₀)) p‖ ≤ (C / rad p.1) ^ j) ∧ ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ![eR w.1, eTh w.1, eZ] i) p‖ ≤ (C / rad p.1) ^ j

signature.name: wpf_coord_bounds
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1 → ∀ (k : ℕ) (R : ℝ), ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (p : ℝ³ × ℝ), 0 < rad p.1 → rad p.1 ≤ R → (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph h (rad w.1) w.2 + Y₀)) p‖ ≤ (C / rad p.1) ^ j) ∧ ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ![eR w.1, eTh w.1, eZ] i) p‖ ≤ (C / rad p.1) ^ j

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h hh0 hh1 k R
  
  have hc : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x i) := fun i => contDiff_piLp_apply 2
  have hf2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) := ((hc 0).pow 2).add ((hc 1).pow 2)
  have hradc : Continuous rad := Real.continuous_sqrt.comp hf2.continuous
  have hUo : IsOpen {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} := isOpen_lt continuous_const hradc
  have hrn : ∀ x : ℝ³, 0 ≤ rad x := fun x => Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hrsq : ∀ x : ℝ³, rad x ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := fun x => Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hsm : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (i : Fin 3), (c • x) i = c * x i := fun c x i => by simp
  have hT0 : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³), (x + c • eZ) 0 = x 0 := fun c x => by simp [eZ]
  have hT1 : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³), (x + c • eZ) 1 = x 1 := fun c x => by simp [eZ]
  have hRh : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³), 0 < c → rad (c • x) = c * rad x := by
    intro c x hc0
    unfold rad
    rw [hsm, hsm, show (c * x 0) ^ 2 + (c * x 1) ^ 2 = c ^ 2 * (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) by ring,
      Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg c), Real.sqrt_sq hc0.le]
  have hVh : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³), radVec (c • x) = c • radVec x := by
    intro c x; unfold radVec; rw [hsm, hsm, smul_add, mul_smul, mul_smul]
  have hAh : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³), azVec (c • x) = c • azVec x := by
    intro c x; unfold azVec
    rw [hsm, hsm, show -(c * x 1) = c * -(x 1) by ring, smul_add, mul_smul, mul_smul]
  have hRt : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³), rad (x + c • eZ) = rad x := by
    intro c x; unfold rad; rw [hT0, hT1]
  have hVt : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³), radVec (x + c • eZ) = radVec x := by
    intro c x; unfold radVec; rw [hT0, hT1]
  have hAt : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³), azVec (x + c • eZ) = azVec x := by
    intro c x; unfold azVec; rw [hT0, hT1]
  have hinvh : ∀ (c r : ℝ), 0 < c → (c * r)⁻¹ * c = r⁻¹ := by
    intro c r hc0
    calc (c * r)⁻¹ * c = r⁻¹ * (c⁻¹ * c) := by rw [mul_inv]; ring
      _ = r⁻¹ := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hc0.ne', mul_one]
  have hnV : ∀ x : ℝ³, ‖radVec x‖ = rad x := by
    intro x; unfold radVec rad; rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]; simp
  have hnA : ∀ x : ℝ³, ‖azVec x‖ = rad x := by
    intro x; unfold azVec rad; rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]; simp [add_comm]
  have hnZ : ‖eZ‖ = 1 := by unfold eZ; simp
  have hneR : ∀ x : ℝ³, 0 < rad x → ‖eR x‖ = 1 := by
    intro x hx
    unfold eR
    rw [norm_smul, hnV, norm_inv, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hx, inv_mul_cancel₀ hx.ne']
  have hneTh : ∀ x : ℝ³, 0 < rad x → ‖eTh x‖ = 1 := by
    intro x hx
    unfold eTh
    rw [norm_smul, hnA, norm_inv, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hx, inv_mul_cancel₀ hx.ne']
  
  have hdrx : 0 < drx h := by
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
    have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
    have hs : Real.sqrt 2 ≤ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hL : 2 ≤ Lgc := by unfold Lgc; linarith
    have hT1' : 1 < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; linarith
    have hT6 : Tgc ≤ 6 := by unfold Tgc; linarith
    have hlogL : 1 / 2 ≤ Real.log Lgc := by
      have h1 := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < Lgc)
      have h2 : Lgc⁻¹ ≤ 1 / 2 := by rw [inv_le_comm₀ (by linarith) (by norm_num)]; linarith
      linarith
    have hlT0 : 0 < Real.log Tgc := Real.log_pos hT1'
    have hlT5 : Real.log Tgc ≤ 5 := by
      have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < Tgc); linarith
    have hρ : 1 / 10 ≤ Real.log Lgc / Real.log Tgc := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hlT0]; linarith
    have hk : kapS = 1 / 100000 := rfl
    unfold drx
    rw [hk]
    have : Real.log Lgc / Real.log Tgc ≤ (1 + h) * (Real.log Lgc / Real.log Tgc) := by
      have hp : 0 ≤ Real.log Lgc / Real.log Tgc := by linarith
      nlinarith
    nlinarith
  
  have homog : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : ℝ³ → V) (s : ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} →
      (∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³), 0 < c → f (c • x) = c ^ s • f x) →
      (∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³), f (x + c • eZ) = f x) →
      ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ Cj : ℝ, 0 ≤ Cj ∧ ∀ x : ℝ³, 0 < rad x →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f x‖ ≤ Cj * rad x ^ (s - j) := by
    intro V _ _ f s hf hH hT j
    have hN : ((j : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
    have hKcU : ({y : ℝ³ | rad y = 1} ∩ {y : ℝ³ | y 2 = 0}) ⊆ {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} :=
      fun y hy => by
        show 0 < rad y
        rw [hy.1]; exact one_pos
    have hKcc : IsCompact ({y : ℝ³ | rad y = 1} ∩ {y : ℝ³ | y 2 = 0}) := by
      apply Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded
      · exact (isClosed_eq hradc continuous_const).inter
          (isClosed_eq (hc 2).continuous continuous_const)
      · apply (Metric.isBounded_closedBall (x := (0:ℝ³)) (r := 1)).subset
        intro y hy
        rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
        have h1 : rad y = 1 := hy.1
        have h2 : y 2 = 0 := hy.2
        have hsq : y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← hrsq, h1]; norm_num
        rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, h2]
        rw [show y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 + (0:ℝ) ^ 2 = 1 by rw [hsq]; ring, Real.sqrt_one]
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f) ({y : ℝ³ | rad y = 1} ∩ {y : ℝ³ | y 2 = 0}) := by
      have h1 := hf.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin hN hUo.uniqueDiffOn
      exact (h1.congr (fun x hx => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hUo hx).symm)).mono hKcU
    obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := hKcc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hcont
    refine ⟨max C0 0, le_max_right _ _, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    set r := rad x with hr
    have hr0 : 0 < r := hx
    set v : ℝ³ := (-(r⁻¹ * x 2)) • eZ with hv
    set y : ℝ³ := r⁻¹ • x + v with hy
    have hy0 : y 0 = x 0 / r := by simp [hy, hv, eZ, div_eq_inv_mul]
    have hy1 : y 1 = x 1 / r := by simp [hy, hv, eZ, div_eq_inv_mul]
    have hy2 : y 2 = 0 := by simp [hy, hv, eZ]
    have hradY : rad y = 1 := by
      unfold rad
      rw [hy0, hy1, div_pow, div_pow, ← add_div, ← hrsq x, div_self (pow_pos hr0 2).ne',
        Real.sqrt_one]
    have hyU : 0 < rad y := by rw [hradY]; exact one_pos
    have hid : ∀ z : ℝ³, f z = r ^ s • f (r⁻¹ • z + v) := by
      intro z
      rw [hv, hT, hH r⁻¹ z (inv_pos.2 hr0), smul_smul, Real.inv_rpow hr0.le,
        mul_inv_cancel₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr0 s).ne', one_smul]
    set S : ℝ³ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
      (LinearEquiv.smulOfNeZero ℝ ℝ³ r⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero hr0.ne')).toContinuousLinearEquiv with hS
    have hSapp : ∀ z, S z = r⁻¹ • z := fun z => rfl
    have hfun : f = (fun u => r ^ s • f (u + v)) ∘ ⇑S := by
      funext z
      rw [Function.comp_apply, hSapp]
      exact hid z
    have e1 := ContinuousLinearEquiv.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right S (fun u => r ^ s • f (u + v))
      uniqueDiffOn_univ (mem_univ (S x)) j
    rw [preimage_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ] at e1
    have e2 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun u => r ^ s • f (u + v)) (S x) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun q => r ^ s • f q) y := by
      rw [hSapp]
      exact iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right (f := fun q => r ^ s • f q) j v (r⁻¹ • x)
    have hfy : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f y := hf.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hyU)
    have e3 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun q => r ^ s • f q) y = r ^ s • iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f y :=
      iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply' (hfy.of_le hN)
    have key : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f x =
        (r ^ s • iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f y).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => (S : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³)) := by
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f x
          = iteratedFDeriv ℝ j ((fun u => r ^ s • f (u + v)) ∘ ⇑S) x :=
            congrArg (fun g => iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g x) hfun
        _ = _ := e1
        _ = _ := by rw [e2, e3]
    have hSn : ‖(S : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³)‖ ≤ r⁻¹ :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (inv_nonneg.2 hr0.le) (fun z => le_of_eq (by
        show ‖r⁻¹ • z‖ = r⁻¹ * ‖z‖
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 hr0)]))
    have hrs : 0 < r ^ s := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr0 s
    rw [key]
    calc ‖(r ^ s • iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f y).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => (S : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³))‖
        ≤ ‖r ^ s • iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f y‖ * ∏ _i : Fin j, ‖(S : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³)‖ :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _
      _ ≤ (r ^ s * max C0 0) * r⁻¹ ^ j := by
          apply mul_le_mul _ _ (Finset.prod_nonneg fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)
            (mul_nonneg hrs.le (le_max_right _ _))
          · rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hrs]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((hC0 y ⟨hradY, hy2⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _)) hrs.le
          · rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
            exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hSn j
      _ = max C0 0 * r ^ (s - j) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_sub hr0, Real.rpow_natCast, inv_pow, div_eq_mul_inv]; ring
  
  have hlift : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (φ : ℝ³ → W),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} → ∀ (j : ℕ) (p : ℝ³ × ℝ), 0 < rad p.1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => φ w.1) p‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j φ p.1‖ := by
    intro W _ _ φ hφ j p hp
    have hU' : IsOpen ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) ⁻¹' {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x}) :=
      hUo.preimage (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ).continuous
    have hp' : (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) p ∈ {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} := hp
    have e := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)
      hφ hUo.uniqueDiffOn hU'.uniqueDiffOn hp' (i := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hU' hp, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hUo hp'] at e
    have e2 : (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => φ w.1) = φ ∘ (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := rfl
    rw [e2, e]
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
    have hp1 : ∏ _i : Fin j, ‖ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_fst_le ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) hp1
  
  have hSr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ rad {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} :=
    hf2.contDiffOn.sqrt (fun x hx => by
      have hx' : 0 < Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) := hx
      exact (Real.sqrt_pos.mp hx').ne')
  have hSd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => rad x ^ drx h) {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} :=
    hSr.rpow_const_of_ne (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
  have hinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (rad x)⁻¹) {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} :=
    hSr.inv (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
  have hrv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ radVec := by
    have h' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
        x 1 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) :=
      ((hc 0).smul contDiff_const).add ((hc 1).smul contDiff_const)
    exact h'
  have haz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ azVec := by
    have h' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => -(x 1) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
        x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) :=
      ((hc 1).neg.smul contDiff_const).add ((hc 0).smul contDiff_const)
    exact h'
  have hSe : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ eR {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} := hinv.smul hrv.contDiffOn
  have hSt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ eTh {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} := hinv.smul haz.contDiffOn
  
  have hm4 : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ Cj : ℝ, 0 ≤ Cj ∧ ∀ x : ℝ³, 0 < rad x →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j rad x‖ ≤ Cj * rad x ^ ((1:ℝ) - j) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun x : ℝ³ => rad x ^ drx h) x‖ ≤ Cj * rad x ^ (drx h - j) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j eR x‖ ≤ Cj * rad x ^ ((0:ℝ) - j) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j eTh x‖ ≤ Cj * rad x ^ ((0:ℝ) - j) := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨c1, c1p, h1⟩ := homog rad 1 hSr
      (fun c x hc0 => by rw [hRh c x hc0, Real.rpow_one, smul_eq_mul]) (fun c x => hRt c x) j
    obtain ⟨c2, c2p, h2⟩ := homog (fun x : ℝ³ => rad x ^ drx h) (drx h) hSd
      (fun c x hc0 => by
        show rad (c • x) ^ drx h = c ^ drx h • rad x ^ drx h
        rw [hRh c x hc0, Real.mul_rpow hc0.le (hrn x), smul_eq_mul])
      (fun c x => by
        show rad (x + c • eZ) ^ drx h = rad x ^ drx h
        rw [hRt c x]) j
    obtain ⟨c3, c3p, h3⟩ := homog eR 0 hSe
      (fun c x hc0 => by
        unfold eR
        rw [hRh c x hc0, hVh, smul_smul, hinvh _ _ hc0, Real.rpow_zero, one_smul])
      (fun c x => by unfold eR; rw [hRt, hVt]) j
    obtain ⟨c4, c4p, h4⟩ := homog eTh 0 hSt
      (fun c x hc0 => by
        unfold eTh
        rw [hRh c x hc0, hAh, smul_smul, hinvh _ _ hc0, Real.rpow_zero, one_smul])
      (fun c x => by unfold eTh; rw [hRt, hAt]) j
    refine ⟨c1 + c2 + c3 + c4, by positivity, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have p1 := Real.rpow_nonneg (hrn x) ((1:ℝ) - j)
    have p2 := Real.rpow_nonneg (hrn x) (drx h - j)
    have p3 := Real.rpow_nonneg (hrn x) ((0:ℝ) - j)
    exact ⟨(h1 x hx).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) p1),
      (h2 x hx).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) p2),
      (h3 x hx).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) p3),
      (h4 x hx).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) p3)⟩
  choose CC hCC0 hCC using hm4
  obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), CC j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by rw [hAdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hCC0 j)
  have hCA : ∀ j ≤ k, CC j ≤ A := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hAdef]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := CC) (fun i _ => hCC0 i) (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
  
  obtain ⟨L1, hL1⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ →L[ℝ] Cyl, ∀ a : ℝ, L a = (a, (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) :=
    ⟨(ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).smulRight ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))),
      fun a => by ext <;> simp⟩
  obtain ⟨L4, hL4⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ →L[ℝ] Cyl, ∀ a : ℝ, L a = ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), a • vrv) :=
    ⟨(ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).smulRight ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), vrv),
      fun a => by ext <;> simp⟩
  obtain ⟨Lin, hLin⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ³ × ℝ →L[ℝ] Cyl, ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ,
      L w = ((0:ℝ), w.1 2, w.2, w.2 • vtv) :=
    ⟨((EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)).smulRight ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) +
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ³ ℝ).smulRight ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), vtv),
      fun w => by ext <;> simp⟩
  
  obtain ⟨R', hR'def⟩ : ∃ R' : ℝ, R' = max R 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hR'1 : 1 ≤ R' := by rw [hR'def]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hRR' : R ≤ R' := by rw [hR'def]; exact le_max_left _ _
  obtain ⟨C1, hC1def⟩ : ∃ C1 : ℝ,
      C1 = ‖L1‖ * A * R' + ‖L4‖ * A * R' ^ drx h + ‖Lin‖ * R' ^ k := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hCdef⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = 1 + A + |C1| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hC1 : 1 ≤ C := by rw [hCdef]; have := abs_nonneg C1; linarith
  have hC1C : C1 ≤ C := by rw [hCdef]; have := le_abs_self C1; linarith
  have hAC : A ≤ C := by rw [hCdef]; have := abs_nonneg C1; linarith
  refine ⟨C, hC1, fun Y₀ p hp hR => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · 
    intro j hj1 hjk
    have hN : ((j : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
    have hr0 : 0 < rad p.1 := hp
    have hrR' : rad p.1 ≤ R' := le_trans hR hRR'
    have hrj : 0 < rad p.1 ^ j := pow_pos hr0 j
    have hrp : ∀ a : ℝ, rad p.1 ^ (a - j) = rad p.1 ^ a / rad p.1 ^ j := fun a => by
      rw [Real.rpow_sub hr0, Real.rpow_natCast]
    have cR : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1) p :=
      (hSr.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hp)).comp p contDiffAt_fst
    have cD : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1 ^ drx h) p :=
      (hSd.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hp)).comp p contDiffAt_fst
    have c1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (⇑L1 ∘ fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1) p := L1.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp p cR
    have c4 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (⇑L4 ∘ fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1 ^ drx h) p :=
      L4.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp p cD
    have cL : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (⇑Lin) p := Lin.contDiff.contDiffAt
    have cK : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun _ : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀)) p := contDiffAt_const
    have hΦ : (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph h (rad w.1) w.2 + Y₀)) =
        ((⇑L1 ∘ fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1) + (⇑L4 ∘ fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1 ^ drx h)) +
          (⇑Lin + fun _ : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀)) := by
      funext w
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Function.comp_apply, hL1, hL4, hLin, ptOf, Yph]
      ext <;> simp <;> ring
    have c14 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ ((⇑L1 ∘ fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1) +
        (⇑L4 ∘ fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1 ^ drx h)) p := c1.add c4
    have cLK : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (⇑Lin + fun _ : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y₀)) p := cL.add cK
    rw [hΦ, iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (c14.of_le hN) (cLK.of_le hN),
      iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (c1.of_le hN) (c4.of_le hN),
      iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (cL.of_le hN) (cK.of_le hN),
      iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (by omega : j ≠ 0), Pi.zero_apply, add_zero]
    have hBp := hCC j p.1 hp
    have b1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (⇑L1 ∘ fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1) p‖ ≤
        ‖L1‖ * A * R' / rad p.1 ^ j := by
      calc _ ≤ ‖L1‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1) p‖ :=
            L1.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left cR hN
        _ ≤ ‖L1‖ * (A * (R' / rad p.1 ^ j)) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (norm_nonneg _)
          refine ((hlift rad hSr j p hp).trans hBp.1).trans ?_
          rw [hrp 1, Real.rpow_one]
          exact mul_le_mul (hCA j hjk) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hrR' hrj.le)
            (div_nonneg hr0.le hrj.le) hA0
        _ = ‖L1‖ * A * R' / rad p.1 ^ j := by ring
    have b4 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (⇑L4 ∘ fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1 ^ drx h) p‖ ≤
        ‖L4‖ * A * R' ^ drx h / rad p.1 ^ j := by
      calc _ ≤ ‖L4‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => rad w.1 ^ drx h) p‖ :=
            L4.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left cD hN
        _ ≤ ‖L4‖ * (A * (R' ^ drx h / rad p.1 ^ j)) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (norm_nonneg _)
          refine ((hlift (fun x : ℝ³ => rad x ^ drx h) hSd j p hp).trans hBp.2.1).trans ?_
          rw [hrp (drx h)]
          exact mul_le_mul (hCA j hjk)
            (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Real.rpow_le_rpow hr0.le hrR' hdrx.le) hrj.le)
            (div_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hr0.le _) hrj.le) hA0
        _ = ‖L4‖ * A * R' ^ drx h / rad p.1 ^ j := by ring
    have bL : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (⇑Lin) p‖ ≤ ‖Lin‖ * R' ^ k / rad p.1 ^ j := by
      have hLinB : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (⇑Lin) p‖ ≤ ‖Lin‖ := by
        obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, j = n + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
        rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
        have hfd : fderiv ℝ (⇑Lin) = fun _ => Lin := funext (fun _ => Lin.fderiv)
        rw [hfd]
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
        · rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]
        · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (by omega) Lin]; simp
      have hrk : rad p.1 ^ j ≤ R' ^ k :=
        (pow_le_pow_left₀ hr0.le hrR' j).trans (pow_le_pow_right₀ hR'1 hjk)
      refine hLinB.trans ?_
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hrj]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrk (norm_nonneg _)
    have htot : ‖L1‖ * A * R' / rad p.1 ^ j + ‖L4‖ * A * R' ^ drx h / rad p.1 ^ j +
        ‖Lin‖ * R' ^ k / rad p.1 ^ j = C1 / rad p.1 ^ j := by
      rw [hC1def, add_div, add_div]
    refine le_trans (norm_add₃_le ..) ?_
    calc _ ≤ C1 / rad p.1 ^ j := by rw [← htot]; exact add_le_add (add_le_add b1 b4) bL
      _ ≤ C / rad p.1 ^ j := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hC1C hrj.le
      _ ≤ C ^ j / rad p.1 ^ j := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (le_self_pow₀ hC1 (by omega)) hrj.le
      _ = (C / rad p.1) ^ j := (div_pow C (rad p.1) j).symm
  · 
    have hr0 : 0 < rad p.1 := hp
    have hfr : ∀ g : ℝ³ → ℝ³, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} → (∀ x : ℝ³, 0 < rad x → ‖g x‖ = 1) →
        (∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g p.1‖ ≤ CC j * rad p.1 ^ ((0:ℝ) - j)) →
        ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => g w.1) p‖ ≤ (C / rad p.1) ^ j := by
      intro g hg hn hb j hjk
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with rfl | hj
      · rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, pow_zero]; exact (hn p.1 hp).le
      · have hrj : 0 < rad p.1 ^ j := pow_pos hr0 j
        refine ((hlift g hg j p hp).trans (hb j hjk)).trans ?_
        rw [Real.rpow_sub hr0, Real.rpow_zero, Real.rpow_natCast]
        calc CC j * (1 / rad p.1 ^ j) ≤ C * (1 / rad p.1 ^ j) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ((hCA j hjk).trans hAC) (by positivity)
          _ ≤ C ^ j * (1 / rad p.1 ^ j) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_self_pow₀ hC1 (by omega)) (by positivity)
          _ = (C / rad p.1) ^ j := by rw [div_pow]; ring
    intro i j hjk
    fin_cases i
    · show ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => eR w.1) p‖ ≤ (C / rad p.1) ^ j
      exact hfr eR hSe hneR (fun j _ => (hCC j p.1 hp).2.2.1) j hjk
    · show ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => eTh w.1) p‖ ≤ (C / rad p.1) ^ j
      exact hfr eTh hSt hneTh (fun j _ => (hCC j p.1 hp).2.2.2) j hjk
    · show ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun _ : ℝ³ × ℝ => eZ) p‖ ≤ (C / rad p.1) ^ j
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with rfl | hj
      · rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, pow_zero, hnZ]
      · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (by omega) eZ]
        simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
        exact pow_nonneg (div_nonneg (by linarith) hr0.le) j

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (m : ℤ) (p : ℝ³ × ℝ), 0 < rad p.1 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((⟨w.1 0, w.1 1⟩ : ℂ) / (rad w.1 : ℂ)) ^ m) p ∧ ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((⟨w.1 0, w.1 1⟩ : ℂ) / (rad w.1 : ℂ)) ^ m) p‖ ≤ ((|(m : ℝ)| + 1) * C / rad p.1) ^ j

signature.name: wpf_phase_bound
signature.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (m : ℤ) (p : ℝ³ × ℝ), 0 < rad p.1 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((⟨w.1 0, w.1 1⟩ : ℂ) / (rad w.1 : ℂ)) ^ m) p ∧ ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((⟨w.1 0, w.1 1⟩ : ℂ) / (rad w.1 : ℂ)) ^ m) p‖ ≤ ((|(m : ℝ)| + 1) * C / rad p.1) ^ j

proof.tactics:
by
  intro k
  
  obtain ⟨φ, hφdef⟩ : ∃ φ : ℂ → ℂ, φ = fun w => w / ((‖w‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hφ : ∀ w, φ w = w / ((‖w‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) := fun w => by rw [hφdef]
  have hφ0 : φ 0 = 0 := by rw [hφ]; simp
  have hφsm : ∀ z : ℂ, z ≠ 0 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ φ z := by
    intro z hz
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℂ => ((‖w‖ : ℝ) : ℂ)) z := by
      have := (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff (n := ∞)).contDiffAt.comp z (contDiffAt_norm ℝ hz (n := ∞))
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using this
    have hne : ((‖z‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hz)
    have h2 := contDiffAt_id.mul (h1.inv hne)
    convert h2 using 1
    funext w
    simp [hφ, div_eq_mul_inv]
  have hφnorm : ∀ z : ℂ, z ≠ 0 → ‖φ z‖ = 1 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hφ, norm_div, Complex.norm_real, norm_norm, div_self (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hz)]
  have hφinv : ∀ w, (φ w)⁻¹ = starRingEnd ℂ (φ w) := by
    intro w
    by_cases hw : w = 0
    · rw [hw, hφ0]; simp
    · rw [Complex.inv_def, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, hφnorm w hw]; simp
  
  have hscale : ∀ (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ), z ≠ 0 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j φ z‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j φ 1‖ / ‖z‖ ^ j := by
    intro j z hz
    have hzi : z⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hz
    have hu : φ z ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have := hφnorm z hz
      rw [h0, norm_zero] at this
      exact zero_ne_one this
    obtain ⟨g, hgdef⟩ : ∃ g : ℂ ≃L[ℝ] ℂ, g = (ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℂ (Units.mk0 z⁻¹ hzi)).restrictScalars ℝ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨h, hhdef⟩ : ∃ h : ℂ ≃L[ℝ] ℂ, h = (ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℂ (Units.mk0 (φ z) hu)).restrictScalars ℝ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hg : ∀ w, g w = w * z⁻¹ := fun w => by rw [hgdef]; rfl
    have hh : ∀ w, h w = w * φ z := fun w => by rw [hhdef]; rfl
    have hid : φ = ⇑h ∘ (φ ∘ ⇑g) := by
      funext w
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, hg, hh]
      by_cases hw : w = 0
      · rw [hw, zero_mul, hφ0, zero_mul]
      · have h1 : ((‖w‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hw)
        have h2 : ((‖z‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hz)
        simp only [hφ]
        rw [norm_mul, norm_inv]
        push_cast
        field_simp
    have hgz : g z = 1 := by rw [hg]; exact mul_inv_cancel₀ hz
    have hD : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j φ z = (h : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ).compContinuousMultilinearMap
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j φ 1).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => (g : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ))) := by
      have e1 := h.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left (f := φ ∘ ⇑g) (x := z) (i := j)
      have e2 := g.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right φ (uniqueDiffOn_univ (𝕜 := ℝ)) (mem_univ (g z)) j
      rw [preimage_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ, hgz] at e2
      rw [← hid] at e1
      rw [e1, e2]
    have hhn : ‖(h : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun w => ?_)
      rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe, hh, norm_mul, hφnorm z hz, one_mul, mul_one]
    have hgn : ‖(g : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖z‖⁻¹ := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg z)) (fun w => ?_)
      rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe, hg, norm_mul, norm_inv, mul_comm]
    rw [hD]
    calc ‖(h : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j φ 1).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => (g : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ)))‖
        ≤ ‖(h : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ)‖ *
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j φ 1).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => (g : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ))‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
      _ ≤ 1 * (‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j φ 1‖ * ∏ _i : Fin j, ‖(g : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ)‖) :=
          mul_le_mul hhn (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _)
            (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      _ ≤ 1 * (‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j φ 1‖ * (‖z‖⁻¹) ^ j) := by
          rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
          gcongr
      _ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j φ 1‖ / ‖z‖ ^ j := by rw [one_mul, inv_pow, div_eq_mul_inv]
  
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : (ℝ³ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℂ, ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, P w = ⟨w.1 0, w.1 1⟩ := by
    let Pl : (ℝ³ × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℂ :=
      { toFun := fun w => ⟨w.1 0, w.1 1⟩
        map_add' := by intro a b; apply Complex.ext <;> simp
        map_smul' := by intro c a; apply Complex.ext <;> simp }
    exact ⟨LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap Pl, fun w => rfl⟩
  have hPrad : ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, ‖P w‖ = rad w.1 := by
    intro w; rw [hP, Complex.norm_eq_sqrt_sq_add_sq]; rfl
  have hPn : ‖P‖ ≤ 1 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun w => ?_)
    rw [hPrad, one_mul]
    calc rad w.1 ≤ ‖w.1‖ := by
          rw [rad, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
          simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
          exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (sq_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ ‖w‖ := norm_fst_le w
  obtain ⟨S, hSdef⟩ : ∃ S : Set ℂ, S = {v : ℂ | v ≠ 0} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hSo : IsOpen S := by rw [hSdef]; exact isOpen_ne
  have hUo : IsOpen (⇑P ⁻¹' S) := hSo.preimage P.continuous
  have hlift : ∀ (F : ℂ → ℂ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F S → ∀ (q : ℝ³ × ℝ), P q ∈ S → ∀ j : ℕ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w => F (P w)) q‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j F (P q)‖ := by
    intro F hF q hq j
    have e := P.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right hF hSo.uniqueDiffOn hUo.uniqueDiffOn hq (i := j)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hUo hq, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hSo hq] at e
    have e' : (fun w => F (P w)) = F ∘ ⇑P := rfl
    rw [e', e]
    calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j F (P q)‖ * ∏ _i : Fin j, ‖P‖ :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j F (P q)‖ * 1 := by
          rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hPn) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := mul_one _
  
  have hpow : ∀ (U : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (f : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℂ) (x : ℝ³ × ℝ) (L : ℝ), IsOpen U → x ∈ U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ‖f x‖ ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ L →
      (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f x‖ ≤ L ^ j) →
      ∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun y => f y ^ n) x‖ ≤ (((n : ℝ) + 1) * L) ^ j := by
    intro U f x L hU hx hf hf1 hL hfj
    have hb : ∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ ≤ L ^ i := by
      intro i hi
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with h0 | h0
      · subst h0; rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, pow_zero]; exact hf1
      · exact hfj i h0 hi
    have hW : ∀ (i : ℕ) (g : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℂ), iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i g U x = iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g x :=
      fun i g => iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hU hx
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro j hj
      have e : (fun y => f y ^ 0) = fun _ => (1 : ℂ) := by funext y; simp
      rw [e]
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with h0 | h0
      · subst h0; rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]; simp
      · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp h0)]
        simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
        exact pow_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hL) _
    | succ n ih =>
      intro j hj
      have e : (fun y => f y ^ (n + 1)) = fun y => f y ^ n * f y := by funext y; rw [pow_succ]
      rw [e]
      have hfn : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => f y ^ n) U := hf.pow n
      have hmul := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hfn hf hU.uniqueDiffOn hx (n := j)
        (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      simp only [hW] at hmul
      have hR : (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * L = ((n : ℝ) + 1) * L + L := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hR, add_pow]
      refine le_trans hmul (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => ?_))
      have hij : i ≤ j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
      have h1 := ih i (le_trans hij hj)
      have h2 := hb (j - i) (le_trans (Nat.sub_le j i) hj)
      have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ (j.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      calc (j.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y => f y ^ n) x‖ *
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j - i) f x‖
          ≤ (j.choose i : ℝ) * (((n : ℝ) + 1) * L) ^ i * L ^ (j - i) := by
            apply mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hc) h2 (norm_nonneg _)
            exact mul_nonneg hc (pow_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hL) _)
        _ = (((n : ℝ) + 1) * L) ^ i * L ^ (j - i) * (j.choose i : ℝ) := by ring
  
  obtain ⟨C, hCdef⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i φ 1‖ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i φ 1‖ :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
  have hC1 : 1 ≤ C := by rw [hCdef]; linarith
  have hcj : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j φ 1‖ ≤ C ^ j := by
    intro j hj1 hjk
    have h1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j φ 1‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i φ 1‖ :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i φ 1‖) (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hjk))
    have h2 : C ≤ C ^ j := le_self_pow₀ hC1 (by omega)
    linarith
  refine ⟨C, hC1, ?_⟩
  intro m p hr
  have hPp : P p ∈ S := by
    rw [hSdef]
    show P p ≠ 0
    intro h0
    have := hPrad p
    rw [h0, norm_zero] at this
    linarith
  have hPp' : P p ≠ 0 := by rw [hSdef] at hPp; exact hPp
  have hφS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ S := fun v hv =>
    (hφsm v (by rw [hSdef] at hv; exact hv)).contDiffWithinAt
  
  have key : ∀ F : ℂ → ℂ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F S → (∀ v, v ≠ 0 → ‖F v‖ = 1) →
      (∀ (j : ℕ) (v : ℂ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j F v‖ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j φ v‖) →
      ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w => F (P w) ^ n) p ∧
        ∀ j ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w => F (P w) ^ n) p‖ ≤ (((n : ℝ) + 1) * (C / rad p.1)) ^ j := by
    intro F hF hF1 hFD n
    have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => F (P w)) (⇑P ⁻¹' S) :=
      hF.comp P.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun w hw => hw)
    refine ⟨(hG.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hPp)).pow n, ?_⟩
    apply hpow (⇑P ⁻¹' S) (fun w => F (P w)) p (C / rad p.1) hUo hPp hG
    · show ‖F (P p)‖ ≤ 1
      rw [hF1 _ hPp']
    · exact div_nonneg (by linarith) hr.le
    · intro j hj1 hjk
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w => F (P w)) p‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j F (P p)‖ :=
            hlift F hF p hPp j
        _ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j φ (P p)‖ := hFD j (P p)
        _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j φ 1‖ / ‖P p‖ ^ j := hscale j (P p) hPp'
        _ ≤ C ^ j / rad p.1 ^ j := by
            rw [hPrad]
            exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hcj j hj1 hjk) (pow_nonneg hr.le j)
        _ = (C / rad p.1) ^ j := (div_pow _ _ _).symm
  
  have hnR : ((m.natAbs : ℕ) : ℝ) = |(m : ℝ)| := by rw [Nat.cast_natAbs, Int.cast_abs]
  have hfun_eq : ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, (⟨w.1 0, w.1 1⟩ : ℂ) / (rad w.1 : ℂ) = φ (P w) := by
    intro w; rw [hφ, hPrad, hP]
  rcases le_or_gt 0 m with hm | hm
  · have hmn : m = ((m.natAbs : ℕ) : ℤ) := (Int.natAbs_of_nonneg hm).symm
    have hH : (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((⟨w.1 0, w.1 1⟩ : ℂ) / (rad w.1 : ℂ)) ^ m) =
        fun w => φ (P w) ^ m.natAbs := by
      funext w
      rw [hfun_eq, ← zpow_natCast, ← hmn]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := key φ hφS hφnorm (fun _ _ => rfl) m.natAbs
    rw [hH]
    refine ⟨h1, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    rw [← hnR, mul_div_assoc]
    exact h2 j hj
  · have hmn : m = -((m.natAbs : ℕ) : ℤ) := Int.eq_neg_natAbs_of_nonpos hm.le
    have hH : (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((⟨w.1 0, w.1 1⟩ : ℂ) / (rad w.1 : ℂ)) ^ m) =
        fun w => (⇑Complex.conjLIE ∘ φ) (P w) ^ m.natAbs := by
      funext w
      rw [hfun_eq, Function.comp_apply, Complex.conjLIE_apply, ← hφinv, inv_pow, ← zpow_natCast,
        ← zpow_neg, ← hmn]
    have hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (⇑Complex.conjLIE ∘ φ) S :=
      Complex.conjLIE.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hφS
    have hF1 : ∀ v, v ≠ 0 → ‖(⇑Complex.conjLIE ∘ φ) v‖ = 1 := by
      intro v hv
      rw [Function.comp_apply, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map, hφnorm v hv]
    have hFD : ∀ (j : ℕ) (v : ℂ),
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (⇑Complex.conjLIE ∘ φ) v‖ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j φ v‖ :=
      fun j v => LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left _ _ _ _
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := key _ hF hF1 hFD m.natAbs
    rw [hH]
    refine ⟨h1, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    rw [← hnR, mul_div_assoc]
    exact h2 j hj

informal_problem.statement: ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ubase B η 0) (DomC B.h B.qB) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb l → B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb → NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb l) * ubase B η 0) k ξ ≤ C

signature.statement: ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ubase B η 0) (DomC B.h B.qB) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb l → B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb → NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb l) * ubase B η 0) k ξ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hB
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, -, -, -, -, hqB0, hqB1, -, -, -, -⟩ := hB.2.1
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, hc6, ⟨-, -, hGV, hGVb⟩, -⟩ := hB.2
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hB.1
  
  have hqpos : ∀ η : Cyl, η.2.2.1 < 1 → 0 < qC B.h η := fun η h =>
    (hS.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hqC' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      (contDiff_snd.fst).prodMk (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
    exact h1.comp h2.contDiffOn (fun η (hη : η.2.2.1 < 1) =>
      ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith)⟩)
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
    hqC'.mono (fun η hη => hη.2.1)
  have hDo : IsOpen (DomC B.h B.qB) := by
    have hT : IsOpen {η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd.snd.fst continuous_const
    have h1 : IsOpen ({η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} ∩ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) ⁻¹' Iio B.qB) :=
      hqC'.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hT isOpen_Iio
    have h2 : IsOpen {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst
    have e : DomC B.h B.qB = {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1} ∩
        ({η : Cyl | η.2.2.1 < 1} ∩ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η) ⁻¹' Iio B.qB) := by
      ext η
      exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2⟩, fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2⟩⟩
    rw [e]; exact h2.inter h1
  have hne : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, qC B.h η ≠ 0 := fun η hη => (hqpos η hη.2.1).ne'
  have hφ1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Real.log (qC B.h η)) (DomC B.h B.qB) := hqC.log hne
  have hφ2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (XC B.h) (DomC B.h B.qB) := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ 2) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
      (contDiff_fst.pow 2).contDiffOn
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => 2 * qC B.h η) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
      contDiffOn_const.mul hqC
    exact (h1.div h2 (fun η hη => mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (hne η hη))).congr (fun η _ => rfl)
  have hφ3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (etaC B.h) (DomC B.h B.qB) := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => η.2.1) (DomC B.h B.qB) := contDiff_snd.fst.contDiffOn
    exact (h1.mul (hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (p := -(1/2 - B.h)) hne)).congr (fun η _ => rfl)
  have hWo : IsOpen (Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) :=
    isOpen_Iio.prod (isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo)
  have hmaps : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, (Real.log (qC B.h η), XC B.h η, etaC B.h η) ∈
      Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
    intro η hη
    have hqη := hqpos η hη.2.1
    have hs : 0 < qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - B.h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hqη _
    have hs2 : (qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - B.h)) ^ 2 = qC B.h η ^ (1 - 2 * B.h) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hqη.le]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
    have hz : η.2.1 ^ 2 < (qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - B.h)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hs2]; exact (hS.2.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith [hη.2.1])).2
    have habs := abs_lt.mp (abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq hz hs.le)
    have he : etaC B.h η = η.2.1 / qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - B.h) := by
      unfold etaC; rw [Real.rpow_neg hqη.le]; exact (div_eq_mul_inv _ _).symm
    refine Set.mk_mem_prod (Set.mem_Iio.mpr (Real.log_lt_log hqη hη.2.2))
      (Set.mk_mem_prod (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr ?_) (Set.mem_Ioo.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩))
    · exact div_pos (pow_pos hη.1 2) (mul_pos two_pos hqη)
    · rw [he, lt_div_iff₀ hs]; linarith
    · rw [he, div_lt_iff₀ hs]; linarith
  have hGVs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => logLift B.Vb (Real.log (qC B.h η), XC B.h η, etaC B.h η))
      (DomC B.h B.qB) := hGV.comp (hφ1.prodMk (hφ2.prodMk hφ3)) hmaps
  
  have hrep : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB,
      ubase B η 0 = η.1⁻¹ * logLift B.Vb (Real.log (qC B.h η), XC B.h η, etaC B.h η) := by
    intro η hη
    have hqη : 0 < qC B.h η := hqpos η hη.2.1
    have hx0 : (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) 0 = η.1 := by simp [rotPt]
    have hx1 : (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) 1 = 0 := by simp [rotPt]
    have hx2 : (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) 2 = η.2.1 := by simp [rotPt]
    have hsq : (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) 1 ^ 2 = η.1 ^ 2 := by
      rw [hx0, hx1]; ring
    have hrad : rad (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) = η.1 := by
      unfold rad; rw [hsq]; exact Real.sqrt_sq hη.1.le
    have hS2 : simScale B.h ((rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) 2) (1 - η.2.2.1) = qC B.h η := by
      rw [hx2]; rfl
    have hmem : ((rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1), η.2.2.1) ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB :=
      ⟨hη.2.1, by show simScale B.h ((rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) 2) (1 - η.2.2.1) < B.qB; rw [hS2]; exact hη.2.2⟩
    have hpos : 0 < (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) 0 ^ 2 + (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) 1 ^ 2 := by
      rw [hsq]; exact pow_pos hη.1 2
    obtain ⟨-, -, h6c⟩ := hc6 (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) η.2.2.1 hmem hpos
    have hsX : simX B.h (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) η.2.2.1 = XC B.h η := by
      unfold simX XC; rw [hsq, hS2]
    have hsE : simEta B.h (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) η.2.2.1 = etaC B.h η := by
      unfold simEta etaC; rw [hS2, hx2]
    rw [hS2, hsX, hsE] at h6c
    have hl : logLift B.Vb (Real.log (qC B.h η), XC B.h η, etaC B.h η) =
        B.Vb (qC B.h η) (XC B.h η) (etaC B.h η) := by
      unfold logLift; rw [Real.exp_log hqη]
    have e1 : ubase B η 0 =
        inner ℝ (curl3 (fun w => B.AB w η.2.2.1) (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) + B.BvB (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1) η.2.2.1)
          (eR (rotPt η.1 0 η.2.1)) := rfl
    rw [e1, hl, eR, real_inner_smul_right, h6c, hrad]
  have hinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => η.1⁻¹) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
    contDiff_fst.contDiffOn.inv (fun η hη => ne_of_gt hη.1)
  refine ⟨(hinv.mul hGVs).congr (fun η hη => hrep η hη), ?_⟩
  intro k
  
  choose CV hCV using hGVb (B.Xa / 2) (2 * B.Xb) (by linarith)
  have h4 : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, 1 ≤ i →
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.log (qC B.h η)) i ξ ≤ C := by
    intro i
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with hi | hi
    · exact ⟨0, fun ξ _ h => absurd h (by omega)⟩
    · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := logqC_nb_v5 B hB i hi
      exact ⟨C, fun ξ hξ _ => hC ξ hξ⟩
  choose C4 hC4 using h4
  choose C5 hC5 using xc_etac_nb_v5 B hB
  choose C10 hC10 using inv_r_nb_v5 B hB
  have hsum : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ) (j : ℕ), j ≤ k → |f j| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |f i| :=
    fun f j hj => Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |f i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  have hs0 : ∀ f : ℕ → ℝ, 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |f i| :=
    fun f => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨SG, hSG⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |CV i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |C4 i| +
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |C5 i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Sr, hSr⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |C10 i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hSG0 : 0 ≤ SG := by rw [hSG]; exact hs0 CV
  have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by rw [hD]; linarith [hs0 C4, hs0 C5]
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = (k.factorial : ℝ) * SG * (3 * D) ^ k := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨2 ^ k * Sr * E, ?_⟩
  intro l ξ hξU hw1 hX1 hX2
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξU.2.1
  have hgerm : ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ), (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, f η = g η) → ∀ j,
      NB B.h f j ξ = NB B.h g j ξ := by
    intro f g hfg j
    unfold NB
    rw [((Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hDo.mem_nhds hξU) hfg).iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds]
  have hat : ∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h B.qB) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ :=
    fun f hf => hf.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hξU)
  
  have hmξ := hmaps ξ hξU
  have hcomp : ∀ i, i ≤ k →
      NB B.h (fun η => logLift B.Vb (Real.log (qC B.h η), XC B.h η, etaC B.h η)) i ξ ≤ E := by
    intro i hi
    have h := nb_comp3_v5 B.h (DomC B.h B.qB) _ ξ (logLift B.Vb) (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η))
      (XC B.h) (etaC B.h) i SG D hDo hWo hξU hGV hφ1 hφ2 hφ3 hmaps hD1
      (fun m hm => ((hCV m (qC B.h ξ) (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ) hq0 hξU.2.2 hX1.le hX2.le
          hmξ.2.2.1 hmξ.2.2.2).2.2.trans (le_abs_self _)).trans
          (by rw [hSG]; exact hsum CV m (hm.trans hi)))
      (fun j hj1 hji => ⟨(hC4 j ξ hξU hj1).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans
          (by rw [hD]; linarith [hsum C4 j (hji.trans hi), hs0 C5])),
        ((hC5 j ξ hξU hX2).1).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans
          (by rw [hD]; linarith [hsum C5 j (hji.trans hi), hs0 C4])),
        ((hC5 j ξ hξU hX2).2).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans
          (by rw [hD]; linarith [hsum C5 j (hji.trans hi), hs0 C4]))⟩)
    refine h.trans ?_
    rw [hE]
    have hf : (i.factorial : ℝ) ≤ k.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le hi
    have h3 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 3 * D := by linarith
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hf hSG0) (pow_le_pow_right₀ h3 hi)
      (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _) (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hSG0)
  
  have hRi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb l) / η.1) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
    contDiffOn_const.div (by fun_prop) (fun η hη => ne_of_gt hη.1)
  rw [hgerm _ (fun η => (Real.sqrt (Qb l) / η.1) *
      logLift B.Vb (Real.log (qC B.h η), XC B.h η, etaC B.h η))
    (fun η hη => by rw [hrep η hη, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc]) k]
  exact nb_real_mul_le_v5 B.h ξ _ _ k Sr E (hat _ hRi) (hat _ hGVs)
    (fun j hj => (hC10 j l ξ hξU.1 hξU.2.1 hw1 hX1).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans
      (by rw [hSr]; exact hsum C10 j hj))) hcomp

subgoal_signatures.name: nb_comp3_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (W : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (ξ : Cyl) (G : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (φ₁ φ₂ φ₃ : Cyl → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (C D : ℝ), IsOpen U → IsOpen W → ξ ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ₁ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ₂ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ₃ U → (∀ η ∈ U, (φ₁ η, φ₂ η, φ₃ η) ∈ W) → 1 ≤ D → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G (φ₁ ξ, φ₂ ξ, φ₃ ξ)‖ ≤ C) → (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → NB h φ₁ i ξ ≤ D ∧ NB h φ₂ i ξ ≤ D ∧ NB h φ₃ i ξ ≤ D) → NB h (fun η => G (φ₁ η, φ₂ η, φ₃ η)) k ξ ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) * C * (3 * D) ^ k

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), B.ok → ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → (∃ k : ℝ × ℝ, ∀ᶠ Y' in nhds ξ.2.2.2, rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) Y' = Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ - k) → nPhi5 B G γ ξ = pcN5 B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) ∧ nPhiP5 B G γ ξ = -pcPsi5 B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ∧ Kmat B G γ ξ = pcKm5 B γ.1 (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)

signature.name: ptrack_closed_form5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), B.ok → ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → (∃ k : ℝ × ℝ, ∀ᶠ Y' in nhds ξ.2.2.2, rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) Y' = Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ - k) → nPhi5 B G γ ξ = pcN5 B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) ∧ nPhiP5 B G γ ξ = -pcPsi5 B G γ (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ∧ Kmat B G γ ξ = pcKm5 B γ.1 (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G γ ξ hB hξ hk
  have hslow : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} ∧
      ∀ (l : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => baseC B l (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) i)
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
    obtain ⟨hS, hBP⟩ := hB
    have hsc : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hA : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
      have hm : Continuous (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2)) := by fun_prop
      have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2)))
          {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} := by
        refine hsc.comp hm.continuousOn ?_
        intro s hs
        have hs' : s.2.2 < 1 := hs
        exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - s.2.2 by linarith⟩
      have hU : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
      have h1 := hc.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := B.qB))
      have h2 : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst
      have e : {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} =
          {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1} ∩ ({s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} ∩
            ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2))) ⁻¹'
              Iio B.qB) := by
        ext s
        simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_inter_iff, mem_preimage, mem_Iio, Function.comp]
      rw [e]
      exact h2.inter h1
    have hD' : IsOpen (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      have hm : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)) := by fun_prop
      have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)))
          {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
        refine hsc.comp hm.continuousOn ?_
        intro w hw
        have hw' : w.2 < 1 := hw
        exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 by linarith⟩
      have hU : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
      have h1 := hc.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := B.qB))
      have e : simDomain B.h B.qB = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
          ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2))) ⁻¹' Iio B.qB := by
        ext w
        simp only [simDomain, mem_setOf_eq, mem_inter_iff, mem_preimage, mem_Iio, Function.comp]
      rw [e]
      exact h1
    have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(uB B)) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      have hAB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿B.AB) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := hBP.2.2.2.1.1
      have hBv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿B.BvB) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := hBP.2.2.2.1.2.1
      have hDA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z) (simDomain B.h B.qB) :=
        ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hD').1 hAB).2
      have hc : ∀ (v : ℝ³) (j : Fin 3),
          ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (v, (0:ℝ)) j) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
        intro v j
        have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (v, (0:ℝ))) (simDomain B.h B.qB) :=
          hDA.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
        exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h1
      let e0 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1
      let e1 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 1 1
      let e2 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 2 1
      have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e1, (0:ℝ)) 2 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e2, (0:ℝ)) 1) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e2, (0:ℝ)) 0 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e0, (0:ℝ)) 2) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e0, (0:ℝ)) 1 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e1, (0:ℝ)) 0) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) + (↿B.BvB) z) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
        refine ((((hc e1 2).sub (hc e2 1)).smul contDiffOn_const).add
          (((hc e2 0).sub (hc e0 2)).smul contDiffOn_const)).add
          (((hc e0 1).sub (hc e1 0)).smul contDiffOn_const) |>.add hBv
      refine hg.congr ?_
      rintro ⟨y, s⟩ hz
      have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s) :=
        (hAB.contDiffAt (hD'.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have hpart : fderiv ℝ (fun w => B.AB w s) y =
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := by
        have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ³ => (w, s)) (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) y :=
          hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left y s
        have h2 : HasFDerivAt ((↿B.AB) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ => (w, s)))
            ((fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)) y :=
          HasFDerivAt.comp (g := ↿B.AB) y hdiff.hasFDerivAt h1
        exact h2.fderiv
      show curl3 (fun w => B.AB w s) y + B.BvB y s = _
      unfold curl3
      rw [hpart]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.inl_apply]
      rfl
    have frame : ∀ r z : ℝ, 0 < r → (rotPt r 0 z) 2 = z ∧
        eR (rotPt r 0 z) = EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) ∧
        eTh (rotPt r 0 z) = EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) := by
      intro r z hr
      have h0 : (rotPt r 0 z) 0 = r := by simp [rotPt]
      have h1 : (rotPt r 0 z) 1 = 0 := by simp [rotPt]
      have h2 : (rotPt r 0 z) 2 = z := by simp [rotPt]
      have hrad : rad (rotPt r 0 z) = r := by
        unfold rad
        rw [h0, h1]
        simp [Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
      refine ⟨h2, ?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold eR radVec
        rw [hrad, h0, h1, zero_smul, add_zero, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
      · unfold eTh azVec
        rw [hrad, h0, h1, neg_zero, zero_smul, zero_add, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
    let ψ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ³ × ℝ := fun s => (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1, s.2.2)
    have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ := by
      have hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1) := by
        unfold rotPt
        fun_prop
      exact hr.prodMk (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd)
    have hmaps : MapsTo ψ {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}
        (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      intro s hs
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hs
      show s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ((rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1) 2) (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB
      rw [(frame s.1 s.2.1 h1).1]
      exact ⟨h2, h3⟩
    refine ⟨hA, fun l i => ?_⟩
    have hcomp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((↿(uB B)) ∘ ψ)
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} :=
      hu.comp hψ.contDiffOn hmaps
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s => Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * inner ℝ (((↿(uB B)) ∘ ψ) s)
        ((![EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ), eZ] :
          Fin 3 → ℝ³) i))
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} :=
      contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.inner ℝ hcomp contDiffOn_const)
    refine hg.congr ?_
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨_, f2, f3⟩ := frame s.1 s.2.1 hs.1
    show Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * inner ℝ (uB B (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1) s.2.2)
        (![eR (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1), eTh (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1), eZ] i) = _
    rw [f2, f3]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨hΩ, hbase⟩ := hslow
  set Ω := {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} with hΩe
  have hQ : 0 < Qb γ.1 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hsQ : 0 < Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQ
  have hb2 : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hT : 0 < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; positivity
  have hci : 0 < cib B.h γ.1 := mul_pos (zpow_pos hT _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ _)
  have hci' : cib B.h γ.1 ≠ 0 := hci.ne'
  have hlamR : ∀ a : ℝ, lamT (a • vrv) = 0 := by
    intro a; simp only [lamT, vrv, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul]; rw [div_eq_iff hb2]; ring
  have hlamV : ∀ a : ℝ, lamT (a • vtv) = a := by
    intro a; simp only [lamT, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul]; rw [div_eq_iff hb2]; ring
  have hRC : ∀ s ∈ Ω, pcRC5 γ.1 s ≠ 0 := fun s hs => div_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hs.1) hsQ.ne'
  have hRCs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pcRC5 γ.1) := by unfold pcRC5; fun_prop
  have hb : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcB5 B γ.1 i) Ω := fun i => hbase γ.1 i
  have hFa : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcFa5 B γ.1) Ω := (hb 1).div hRCs.contDiffOn hRC
  have hP1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pcPhi1_5 B G γ) := by unfold pcPhi1_5 pcRC5; fun_prop
  have hP1on : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcPhi1_5 B G γ) Ω := hP1.contDiffOn
  have hP2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) Ω := (contDiffOn_const.mul hFa).add (contDiffOn_const.mul (hb 2))
  have hD : ∀ f : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → ∀ e : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s => fderiv ℝ f s e) Ω := by
    intro f hf e
    first
    | exact ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ).1 hf).2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    | exact (hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ (by simp)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    | exact (hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ le_rfl).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hA : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s => pcA5 B G γ s i) Ω := by
    intro i; fin_cases i
    · exact (contDiffOn_const.mul (hD _ hP1on _) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun s => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi1_5 B G γ) s ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) Ω)
    · exact (contDiffOn_const.div hRCs.contDiffOn hRC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun s => pang5 B G γ / pcRC5 γ.1 s) Ω)
    · exact (contDiffOn_const.mul (hD _ hP1on _) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun s => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi1_5 B G γ) s ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) Ω)
  have hPs : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s => pcPsi5 B G γ s i) Ω := by
    intro i; fin_cases i
    · exact (contDiffOn_const.mul (hD _ hP2 _) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun s => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) s ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) Ω)
    · exact (contDiffOn_const : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (0:ℝ)) Ω)
    · exact (contDiffOn_const.mul (hD _ hP2 _) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun s => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) s ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) Ω)
  
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hk
  obtain ⟨U, hUsub, hU, hYU⟩ := eventually_nhds_iff.mp hk
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = G.r0 - lamT (G.ctr γ) - lamT k := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hUv : ∀ Y' ∈ U, vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) Y' =
      (Tgc ^ bandIdx B.h γ.1 * lamT Y' + C) / cib B.h γ.1 := by
    intro Y' hY'
    rw [hC]
    simp only [vco, etG, hUsub Y' hY']
    simp only [Jpow, lamT, vrv, vtv, Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add,
      Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
    ring
  let sl : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ × ℝ :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).prod
      (((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))).prod
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))))
  have hslA : ∀ η : Cyl, HasFDerivAt (fun x : Cyl => (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1)) sl η := fun η => sl.hasFDerivAt
  let lT : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    (1 + bgc ^ 2)⁻¹ • (bgc • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ + ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)
  let Yp : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ := (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))
  let VL : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ := (Tgc ^ bandIdx B.h γ.1 / cib B.h γ.1) • (lT.comp Yp)
  have hVL : ∀ η : Cyl, VL η = Tgc ^ bandIdx B.h γ.1 / cib B.h γ.1 * lamT η.2.2.2 := by
    intro η
    show Tgc ^ bandIdx B.h γ.1 / cib B.h γ.1 * ((1 + bgc ^ 2)⁻¹ * (bgc * η.2.2.2.1 + η.2.2.2.2)) = _
    unfold lamT; ring
  have hcomp : ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (η : Cyl), (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ∈ Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω →
      ∀ d : Cyl, fderiv ℝ (fun η' : Cyl => f (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1)) η d =
        fderiv ℝ f (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) (d.1, d.2.1, d.2.2.1) := by
    intro f η hη h1 d
    have d1 := ((h1.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hη)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have h' : HasFDerivAt (fun η' : Cyl => f (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1)) _ η := d1.comp η (hslA η)
    rw [h'.fderiv]
    rfl
  have hs : (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ∈ Ω := hξ
  have hV : ∀ η : Cyl, η.2.2.2 ∈ U → vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 = VL η + C / cib B.h γ.1 := by
    intro η h; rw [hUv _ h, hVL]; ring
  have tmpl : ∀ (f1 f2 : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (η : Cyl), (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ∈ Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f1 Ω →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f2 Ω → ∀ d : Cyl,
      fderiv ℝ (fun η' : Cyl => f1 (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1) - (VL η' + C / cib B.h γ.1) *
          f2 (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1)) η d =
        fderiv ℝ f1 (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) (d.1, d.2.1, d.2.2.1) - ((VL η + C / cib B.h γ.1) *
          fderiv ℝ f2 (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) (d.1, d.2.1, d.2.2.1) + f2 (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) * VL d) := by
    intro f1 f2 η hη h1 h2 d
    have d1 := ((h1.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hη)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have d2 := ((h2.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hη)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have h' : HasFDerivAt (fun η' : Cyl => f1 (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1) - (VL η' + C / cib B.h γ.1) *
          f2 (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1)) _ η :=
      (d1.comp η (hslA η)).sub ((VL.hasFDerivAt.add_const (C / cib B.h γ.1)).mul (d2.comp η (hslA η)))
    rw [h'.fderiv]
    rfl
  have hWo : ∀ η : Cyl, (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ∈ Ω → η.2.2.2 ∈ U →
      {η' : Cyl | (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1) ∈ Ω ∧ η'.2.2.2 ∈ U} ∈ nhds η := by
    intro η hη hηU
    refine IsOpen.mem_nhds ?_ ⟨hη, hηU⟩
    exact (hΩ.preimage (show Continuous (fun η : Cyl => (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1)) by fun_prop)).inter
      (hU.preimage (show Continuous (fun η : Cyl => η.2.2.2) by fun_prop))
  have hN : ∀ η : Cyl, (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ∈ Ω → η.2.2.2 ∈ U →
      nPhi5 B G γ η = pcN5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2) := by
    intro η hη hηU
    have hev : phiL5 B G γ =ᶠ[nhds η] (fun η' : Cyl => pcPhi1_5 B G γ (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1) -
        (VL η' + C / cib B.h γ.1) * pcPhi2_5 B G γ (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hWo η hη hηU) (fun η' hη' => by
        show pcPhi1_5 B G γ (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1) - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η'.2.2.2 *
