signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ∃ Γ : Finset Lab, Γ.card ≤ 162 ∧ ∀ γ : Lab, ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) → γ ∈ Γ

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  intro h hS ξ0 hξ0
  have hq0 : 0 < qC h ξ0 := (hS.1 ξ0.2.1 (1 - ξ0.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hqc : ContinuousAt (qC h) ξ0 := by
    have hmem : ((ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)) :=
      ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ0.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hg : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (ξ0.2.1, 1 - ξ0.2.2.1) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.continuousAt ((isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds hmem)
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    exact hg.comp (f := fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) hφ.continuousAt
  have hlogc : ContinuousAt (fun ξ => Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ)) ξ0 := by
    have := ((Real.continuousAt_log hq0.ne').comp hqc).div_const (Real.log 2)
    exact this
  have hK : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (s : ℝ), sqPart μ j s ≠ 0 → |s / μ - (j:ℝ)| < 1 := by
    intro μ j s hne
    have hb : bumpR (s / μ - j) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hne
      unfold sqPart
      rw [h0, zero_div]
    unfold bumpR at hb
    by_contra hlt
    apply hb
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ |s / μ - j| := not_lt.mp hlt
    have h2 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (s / μ - j) ^ 2 := by
      calc (1:ℝ) = 1 * 1 := by norm_num
        _ ≤ |s / μ - j| * |s / μ - j| := mul_le_mul h1 h1 zero_le_one (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = (s / μ - j) ^ 2 := by rw [← sq, sq_abs]
    linarith
  have hWin : ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), etaL h γ ξ ≠ 0 →
      |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) + (γ.1 : ℝ)| < 1 ∧
      |chartR h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1 : ℝ)| < 1 ∧
      |chartZ h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.1 : ℝ)| < 1 ∧
      |chartT h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2 : ℝ)| < 1 := by
    intro γ ξ hne
    unfold etaL at hne
    obtain ⟨hA, hBC⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hne
    obtain ⟨hB12, hB3⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hBC
    obtain ⟨hB1, hB2⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hB12
    refine ⟨?_, hK _ _ _ hB1, hK _ _ _ hB2, hK _ _ _ hB3⟩
    have h0 := hK _ _ _ hA
    have e : Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) / 1 - (((-(γ.1:ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℝ) =
        Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) + (γ.1 : ℝ) := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [e] at h0
    exact h0
  obtain ⟨W, hWdef⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ → Finset ℤ, W = fun y => Finset.Icc ⌈y - 1⌉ ⌊y + 1⌋ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hWm : ∀ (y : ℝ) (z : ℤ), |y - (z:ℝ)| ≤ 1 → z ∈ W y := by
    intro y z hz
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_le.mp hz
    simp only [hWdef, Finset.mem_Icc]
    exact ⟨Int.ceil_le.mpr (by linarith), Int.le_floor.mpr (by linarith)⟩
  have hWc : ∀ y : ℝ, (W y).card ≤ 3 := by
    intro y
    simp only [hWdef]
    rw [Int.card_Icc]
    have h1 := Int.floor_le (y + 1)
    have h2 := Int.le_ceil (y - 1)
    have h3 : ((⌊y + 1⌋ - ⌈y - 1⌉ : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by push_cast; linarith
    have h4 : ⌊y + 1⌋ - ⌈y - 1⌉ ≤ 2 := by exact_mod_cast h3
    have h5 : ⌊y + 1⌋ + 1 - ⌈y - 1⌉ ≤ ((3:ℕ):ℤ) := by push_cast; omega
    exact Int.toNat_le.mpr h5
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ⟩ : ∃ Λ : Finset Lab, Λ = ((W (-Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ0))).image Int.toNat).biUnion
      (fun ℓ => ((W (chartR h ℓ ξ0 / Sb ℓ ^ (-3:ℤ))) ×ˢ ((W (chartZ h ℓ ξ0 / Sb ℓ ^ (-3:ℤ))) ×ˢ
        ((W (chartT h ℓ ξ0 / Sb ℓ ^ (-3:ℤ))) ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset Bool)))).image
        (fun z : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × Bool => ((ℓ, (z.1, z.2.1, z.2.2.1), z.2.2.2) : Lab))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΛcard : Λ.card ≤ 162 := by
    rw [hΛ]
    refine le_trans Finset.card_biUnion_le ?_
    refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (g := fun _ => 54) (fun ℓ _ => ?_)) ?_
    · refine le_trans Finset.card_image_le ?_
      rw [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_univ,
        Fintype.card_bool]
      calc _ ≤ 3 * (3 * (3 * 2)) :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul (hWc _) (Nat.mul_le_mul (hWc _) (Nat.mul_le_mul (hWc _) le_rfl))
        _ = 54 := by norm_num
    · simp only [Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul]
      have := le_trans (Finset.card_image_le (s := W (-Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ0))) (f := Int.toNat))
        (hWc (-Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ0)))
      omega
  have hmemΛ : ∀ γ : Lab, |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ0) + (γ.1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 →
      |chartR h γ.1 ξ0 / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 →
      |chartZ h γ.1 ξ0 / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 →
      |chartT h γ.1 ξ0 / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 → γ ∈ Λ := by
    intro γ h0 h1 h2 h3
    rw [hΛ, Finset.mem_biUnion]
    refine ⟨γ.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.mem_image]
      refine ⟨(γ.1 : ℤ), hWm _ _ ?_, Int.toNat_natCast γ.1⟩
      have e : -Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ0) - (((γ.1 : ℤ)) : ℝ) =
          -(Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ0) + (γ.1 : ℝ)) := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [e, abs_neg]
      exact h0
    · rw [Finset.mem_image]
      refine ⟨(γ.2.1.1, γ.2.1.2.1, γ.2.1.2.2, γ.2.2), ?_, rfl⟩
      simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_univ, and_true]
      exact ⟨hWm _ _ h1, hWm _ _ h2, hWm _ _ h3⟩
  refine ⟨Λ, hΛcard, fun γ hγ => ?_⟩
  have hcl : ξ0 ∈ closure (Function.support (etaL h γ)) := hγ
  have hEtS : ∀ ξ ∈ Function.support (etaL h γ), etaL h γ ξ ≠ 0 := fun ξ hξ => hξ
  have key : ∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContinuousAt f ξ0 →
      (∀ ξ ∈ Function.support (etaL h γ), f ξ < 1) → f ξ0 ≤ 1 := by
    intro f hf hlt
    exact ContinuousWithinAt.closure_le hcl hf.continuousWithinAt continuousWithinAt_const
      (fun ξ hξ => (hlt ξ hξ).le)
  exact hmemΛ γ
    (key (fun ξ => |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) + (γ.1 : ℝ)|)
      (continuous_abs.continuousAt.comp (hlogc.add continuousAt_const))
      (fun ξ hξ => (hWin γ ξ (hEtS ξ hξ)).1))
    (key (fun ξ => |chartR h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1 : ℝ)|)
      ((continuous_abs.comp (by unfold chartR; fun_prop)).continuousAt)
      (fun ξ hξ => (hWin γ ξ (hEtS ξ hξ)).2.1))
    (key (fun ξ => |chartZ h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.1 : ℝ)|)
      ((continuous_abs.comp (by unfold chartZ; fun_prop)).continuousAt)
      (fun ξ hξ => (hWin γ ξ (hEtS ξ hξ)).2.2.1))
    (key (fun ξ => |chartT h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2 : ℝ)|)
      ((continuous_abs.comp (by unfold chartT; fun_prop)).continuousAt)
      (fun ξ hξ => (hWin γ ξ (hEtS ξ hξ)).2.2.2))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → 60 ≤ l0 → ∀ (α : ℝ) (a : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (a γ m) ξ‖ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α - 2 * (n : ℝ) - 1)

signature.name: wv5_raw_coef_bound
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → 60 ≤ l0 → ∀ (α : ℝ) (a : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (a γ m) ξ‖ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α - 2 * (n : ℝ) - 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 hok hG hl0 α a ha n
  
  have hinvB : ∀ (h : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl), 0 ≤ h → h ≤ 1/2 → 0 < qC h ξ → qC h ξ ≤ 1 →
      0 ≤ coarseIdx h (qC h ξ) → Tgc ^ (coarseIdx h (qC h ξ)) ≤ qC h ξ ^ (-(2:ℝ)) →
      ∀ (g : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (k : ℕ),
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g ξ‖ ≤ (4 * qC h ξ ^ (-(2:ℝ))) ^ k * NB h g k ξ := by
    intro h ξ hh0 hh1 hq hhi hn hTn g k
    have hs2lt : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := (Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)).mpr (by norm_num)
    have hs2gt : 1 < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.one_lt_sqrt_two
    have hL : Lgc ≠ 0 := by unfold Lgc; intro h0; linarith
    have hTg : Tgc ≠ 0 := by unfold Tgc; intro h0; linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
    have hN : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have c1 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), (Jpow n Y).1 = Lgc ^ n * ((Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) +
        Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) * bgc := by
      intro n Y
      simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk]
      ring
    have c2 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), (Jpow n Y).2 = -(Lgc ^ n * ((Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) * bgc) +
        Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) := by
      intro n Y
      simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk]
      ring
    have hcomp : ∀ (m n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), Jpow m (Jpow n Y) = Jpow (m + n) Y := by
      intro m n Y
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
      · rw [c1 m, c1 (m + n), c1 n, c2 n, zpow_add₀ hL, zpow_add₀ hTg]
        field_simp
        ring
      · rw [c2 m, c2 (m + n), c1 n, c2 n, zpow_add₀ hL, zpow_add₀ hTg]
        field_simp
        ring
    have hid : ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, Jpow 0 Y = Y := by
      intro Y
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
      · rw [c1, zpow_zero, zpow_zero]
        field_simp
        ring
      · rw [c2, zpow_zero, zpow_zero]
        field_simp
        ring
    have hJ : ∀ (m : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), JpowL m Y = Jpow m Y := by
      intro m Y
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
      · simp only [JpowL, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', Prod.fst_add, Prod.smul_fst,
          smul_eq_mul]
        rw [c1, c1, c1]
        ring
      · simp only [JpowL, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_snd,
          smul_eq_mul]
        rw [c2, c2, c2]
        ring
    have hJinv : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), JpowL (-n) (JpowL n Y) = Y := by
      intro n Y
      rw [hJ, hJ, hcomp, neg_add_cancel, hid]
    have hb0 : 0 ≤ bgc := by unfold bgc; linarith
    have hb1 : bgc ≤ 1 := by unfold bgc; linarith
    have hc1 : 1 ≤ 1 + bgc ^ 2 := le_add_of_nonneg_right (sq_nonneg _)
    have hcpos : (0:ℝ) < 1 + bgc ^ 2 := by linarith
    have hLpos : 0 < Lgc := by unfold Lgc; linarith
    have hLT : Lgc ≤ Tgc := by unfold Lgc Tgc; linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = 4 * qC h ξ ^ (-(2:ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hQ1 : 1 ≤ qC h ξ ^ (-(2:ℝ)) :=
      Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hq hhi (by norm_num)
    have hqinvQ : (qC h ξ)⁻¹ ≤ qC h ξ ^ (-(2:ℝ)) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_neg_one]
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq hhi (by norm_num)
    have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := by rw [hK]; linarith
    have hQK : qC h ξ ^ (-(2:ℝ)) ≤ K := by rw [hK]; linarith
    have hqK : (qC h ξ)⁻¹ ≤ K := le_trans hqinvQ hQK
    have hsq0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (qC h ξ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq
    have hsq1 : Real.sqrt (qC h ξ) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← Real.sqrt_one]; exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hhi
    have hqsq : qC h ξ ≤ Real.sqrt (qC h ξ) := by
      have e := Real.mul_self_sqrt hq.le
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq1 hsq0.le
      nlinarith
    have hqe0 : 0 < qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _
    have hqqe : qC h ξ ≤ qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) := by
      have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq hhi (show 1/2 - h ≤ 1 by linarith)
      rwa [Real.rpow_one] at this
    have hi1 : (Real.sqrt (qC h ξ))⁻¹ ≤ K := le_trans (inv_anti₀ hq hqsq) hqK
    have hi2 : (qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h))⁻¹ ≤ K := le_trans (inv_anti₀ hq hqqe) hqK
    have hslot : ∀ (m : ℤ), 0 ≤ m → Tgc ^ m ≤ qC h ξ ^ (-(2:ℝ)) → ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ,
        ‖JpowL m Y‖ ≤ K * ‖Y‖ := by
      intro m hm hTm Y
      have hY1 : |Y.1| ≤ ‖Y‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_fst_le Y
      have hY2 : |Y.2| ≤ ‖Y‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_snd_le Y
      have hr : 0 ≤ ‖Y‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have hdiv : ∀ x : ℝ, |x / (1 + bgc ^ 2)| ≤ |x| := by
        intro x
        rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hcpos]
        exact div_le_self (abs_nonneg _) hc1
      have hbY2 : |bgc * Y.2| ≤ ‖Y‖ := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hb0]
        calc bgc * |Y.2| ≤ 1 * ‖Y‖ := mul_le_mul hb1 hY2 (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
          _ = ‖Y‖ := one_mul _
      have hbY1 : |bgc * Y.1| ≤ ‖Y‖ := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hb0]
        calc bgc * |Y.1| ≤ 1 * ‖Y‖ := mul_le_mul hb1 hY1 (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
          _ = ‖Y‖ := one_mul _
      obtain ⟨a, ha_def⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = (Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨b, hb_def⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ, b = (bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have ha : |a| ≤ 2 * ‖Y‖ := by
        rw [ha_def]
        refine le_trans (hdiv _) ?_
        linarith [abs_sub (Y.1) (bgc * Y.2)]
      have hb : |b| ≤ 2 * ‖Y‖ := by
        rw [hb_def]
        refine le_trans (hdiv _) ?_
        linarith [abs_add_le (bgc * Y.1) (Y.2)]
      have hLn0 : 0 < Lgc ^ m := zpow_pos hLpos m
      have hTn0 : 0 < Tgc ^ m := zpow_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le hLpos hLT) m
      have hLTn : Lgc ^ m ≤ Tgc ^ m := zpow_le_zpow_left₀ hm hLpos.le hLT
      have hTnK : 4 * Tgc ^ m ≤ K := by rw [hK]; linarith
      have e1 := c1 m Y
      have e2 := c2 m Y
      rw [← ha_def, ← hb_def] at e1 e2
      have tL : |Lgc ^ m * a| ≤ Tgc ^ m * (2 * ‖Y‖) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hLn0]
        exact mul_le_mul hLTn ha (abs_nonneg _) hTn0.le
      have tT : |Tgc ^ m * b| ≤ Tgc ^ m * (2 * ‖Y‖) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hTn0]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hTn0.le
      have tTb : |Tgc ^ m * b * bgc| ≤ Tgc ^ m * (2 * ‖Y‖) := by
        rw [abs_mul (Tgc ^ m * b), abs_of_nonneg hb0]
        calc |Tgc ^ m * b| * bgc ≤ |Tgc ^ m * b| * 1 :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb1 (abs_nonneg _)
          _ = |Tgc ^ m * b| := mul_one _
          _ ≤ _ := tT
      have tLb : |-(Lgc ^ m * a * bgc)| ≤ Tgc ^ m * (2 * ‖Y‖) := by
        rw [abs_neg, abs_mul (Lgc ^ m * a), abs_of_nonneg hb0]
        calc |Lgc ^ m * a| * bgc ≤ |Lgc ^ m * a| * 1 :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb1 (abs_nonneg _)
          _ = |Lgc ^ m * a| := mul_one _
          _ ≤ _ := tL
      rw [hJ]
      refine norm_prod_le_iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, e1]
        calc _ ≤ |Lgc ^ m * a| + |Tgc ^ m * b * bgc| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ 4 * Tgc ^ m * ‖Y‖ := by linarith
          _ ≤ K * ‖Y‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hTnK hr
      · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, e2]
        calc _ ≤ |-(Lgc ^ m * a * bgc)| + |Tgc ^ m * b| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ 4 * Tgc ^ m * ‖Y‖ := by linarith
          _ ≤ K * ‖Y‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hTnK hr
    have hnorm4 : ∀ (a b c : ℝ) (d : ℝ × ℝ) (r : ℝ), ‖a‖ ≤ r → ‖b‖ ≤ r → ‖c‖ ≤ r → ‖d‖ ≤ r →
        ‖((a, b, c, d) : Cyl)‖ ≤ r := by
      intro a b c d r ha hb hc hd
      exact norm_prod_le_iff.mpr ⟨ha, norm_prod_le_iff.mpr ⟨hb, norm_prod_le_iff.mpr ⟨hc, hd⟩⟩⟩
    have hsc : ∀ (c x r : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → c ≤ K → ‖x‖ ≤ r → ‖c * x‖ ≤ K * r := by
      intro c x r hc hcM hx
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hc]
      exact mul_le_mul hcM hx (norm_nonneg _) hK0
    have hu1 : ∀ u : Cyl, ‖u.1‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := fun u => norm_fst_le u
    have hu2 : ∀ u : Cyl, ‖u.2.1‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := fun u => (norm_fst_le u.2).trans (norm_snd_le u)
    have hu3 : ∀ u : Cyl, ‖u.2.2.1‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := fun u =>
      ((norm_fst_le u.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le u.2)).trans (norm_snd_le u)
    have hu4 : ∀ u : Cyl, ‖u.2.2.2‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := fun u =>
      ((norm_snd_le u.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le u.2)).trans (norm_snd_le u)
    have hLap : ∀ u : Cyl, Lnorm h ξ u = (Real.sqrt (qC h ξ) * u.1, qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h) * u.2.1,
        qC h ξ * u.2.2.1, JpowL (-(coarseIdx h (qC h ξ))) u.2.2.2) := fun u => rfl
    obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl,
        R = ((Real.sqrt (qC h ξ))⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
          (((qC h ξ ^ (1/2 - h))⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ) ∧ ContinuousOn (XC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dT f) (DomC B.h qs)) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → dR B.h f ξ = 0 ∧ dZ f ξ = 0 ∧ dT f ξ = 0)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (l0 : ℕ) (e : ℝ), B.ok → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (wv5Frame B e) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < rad z.1 ∧ B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < 2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 ∧ rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)} ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < rad z.1 ∧ B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < 2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 ∧ rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)}, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (wv5Frame B e) z‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-K)

signature.name: wv5_frame_bounds
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (l0 : ℕ) (e : ℝ), B.ok → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (wv5Frame B e) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < rad z.1 ∧ B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < 2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 ∧ rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)} ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < rad z.1 ∧ B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < 2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 ∧ rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)}, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (wv5Frame B e) z‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-K)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B l0 e hok
  obtain ⟨-, hWo, -, -, sTh, sQ, hcb⟩ := ipb5_mean_coord_bounds B l0 e hok
  set W : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ) := {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < rad z.1 ∧
    B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < 2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 ∧
    rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)} with hWdef
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (by simp)
  have hq : ∀ z ∈ W, 0 < simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ∧ simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ≤ 1 := by
    intro z hz
    have h1 : z.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < qsOf l0 := hz.1
    exact ⟨(hok.1.1 (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) (by linarith [h1.1])).1, le_trans h1.2.le hqs1⟩
  have key2 : ∀ (C a b q : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ 1 → b ≤ a → C * q ^ a ≤ |C| * q ^ b := by
    intro C a b q hq0 hq1 hba
    calc C * q ^ a ≤ |C| * q ^ a :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)
      _ ≤ |C| * q ^ b :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1 hba) (abs_nonneg C)
  have hmle : ∀ k : ℕ, ((k : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := fun k => by exact_mod_cast le_top
  
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³, ∀ v : ℝ³,
      J v = v 1 • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) - v 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) :=
    ⟨(EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) -
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)),
      fun v => rfl⟩
  have hrot : ∀ x : ℝ³, J (eTh x) = eR x := by
    intro x
    rw [hJ]
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [eR, eTh, radVec, azVec] <;> ring
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ : ∃ Φ : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ((Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³), ∀ (v : ℝ³) (c : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      Φ v c = c 0 • J v + c 1 • v :=
    ⟨(ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℝ (Fin 3 → ℝ) ℝ³
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 0)).comp J +
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℝ (Fin 3 → ℝ) ℝ³
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 1), fun v c => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Lz, hLz⟩ : ∃ Lz : ℝ →L[ℝ] ((Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³), ∀ (r : ℝ) (c : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      Lz r c = r • (c 2 • eZ) :=
    ⟨(ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).smulRight
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 2).smulRight eZ), fun r c => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Bil, hBil⟩ : ∃ Bil : ℝ →L[ℝ] ((Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³) →L[ℝ] ((Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³),
      ∀ (r : ℝ) (M : (Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ³), Bil r M = r • M :=
    ⟨ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ, fun r M => rfl⟩
  
  have hF : wv5Frame B e = fun z => Bil (simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e) (Φ (eTh z.1)) +
      Lz (simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e) := by
    funext z
    ext c : 1
    simp only [wv5Frame, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, hBil, hΦ, hLz, hrot]
    simp only [smul_add]
  
  have sG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => Φ (eTh z.1)) W := Φ.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn sTh
  have hgb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ W,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => Φ (eTh z.1)) z‖ ≤
        C * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-K) := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, K, hC⟩ := hcb k
    refine ⟨‖Φ‖ * C, K, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have h1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => Φ (eTh z.1)) z‖ ≤
        ‖Φ‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => eTh z.1) z‖ :=
      Φ.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left (sTh.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hz)) (hmle k)
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => Φ (eTh z.1)) z‖
        ≤ ‖Φ‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => eTh z.1) z‖ := h1
      _ ≤ ‖Φ‖ * (C * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-K)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC z hz).2.1 (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg Φ)
      _ = ‖Φ‖ * C * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-K) := by ring
  
  have hAB := wt_bilinear_bound Bil (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e)
    (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => Φ (eTh z.1)) (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)) W W hWo
    subset_rfl hq sQ sG
    (fun k => by
      obtain ⟨C, K, hC⟩ := hcb k
      exact ⟨C, K, fun z hz => (hC z hz).2.2⟩) hgb
  have sA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => Bil (simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e) (Φ (eTh z.1))) W := hAB.1
  have hAb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ W,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k
        (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => Bil (simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e) (Φ (eTh z.1))) z‖ ≤
        C * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-K) := hAB.2
  
  have sB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => Lz (simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e)) W :=
    Lz.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn sQ
  have hBb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ W,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => Lz (simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e)) z‖ ≤
        C * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-K) := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, K, hC⟩ := hcb k
    refine ⟨‖Lz‖ * C, K, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have h1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => Lz (simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e)) z‖ ≤
        ‖Lz‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e) z‖ :=
      Lz.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left (sQ.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hz)) (hmle k)
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => Lz (simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e)) z‖
        ≤ ‖Lz‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e) z‖ := h1
      _ ≤ ‖Lz‖ * (C * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-K)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC z hz).2.2 (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg Lz)
      _ = ‖Lz‖ * C * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-K) := by ring
  
  rw [hF]
  refine ⟨sA.add sB, fun k => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨C1, K1, hC1⟩ := hAb k
  obtain ⟨C2, K2, hC2⟩ := hBb k
  refine ⟨|C1| + |C2|, max K1 K2, fun z hz => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨q0, q1⟩ := hq z hz
  have hnh : W ∈ nhds z := hWo.mem_nhds hz
  have hsum : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => Bil (simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e) (Φ (eTh z.1)) +
        Lz (simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e)) z =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k
        (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => Bil (simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e) (Φ (eTh z.1))) z +
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => Lz (simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e)) z :=
    iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((sA.contDiffAt hnh).of_le (hmle k)) ((sB.contDiffAt hnh).of_le (hmle k))
  rw [hsum]
  have f1 := le_trans (hC1 z hz) (key2 C1 _ _ _ q0 q1 (show -max K1 K2 ≤ -K1 by linarith [le_max_left K1 K2]))
  have f2 := le_trans (hC2 z hz) (key2 C2 _ _ _ q0 q1 (show -max K1 K2 ≤ -K2 by linarith [le_max_right K1 K2]))
  calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k
        (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => Bil (simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e) (Φ (eTh z.1))) z‖ +
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => Lz (simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e)) z‖ :=
        norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ |C1| * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-max K1 K2) +
        |C2| * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-max K1 K2) := add_le_add f1 f2
    _ = (|C1| + |C2|) * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-max K1 K2) := by ring

subgoal_signatures.name: ipb5_mean_coord_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (l0 : ℕ) (e : ℝ), B.ok → IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ IsOpen {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < rad z.1 ∧ B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < 2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 ∧ rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)} ∧ Set.MapsTo (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => ptOf z.1 z.2 (Yph B.h (rad z.1) z.2 + 0)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < rad z.1 ∧ B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < 2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 ∧ rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)} (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => ptOf z.1 z.2 (Yph B.h (rad z.1) z.2 + 0)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < rad z.1 ∧ B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < 2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 ∧ rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => eTh z.1) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < rad z.1 ∧ B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < 2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 ∧ rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < rad z.1 ∧ B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < 2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 ∧ rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)} ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < rad z.1 ∧ B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < 2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 ∧ rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)}, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => ptOf z.1 z.2 (Yph B.h (rad z.1) z.2 + 0)) z‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-K) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => eTh z.1) z‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-K) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ e) z‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-K)

subgoal_signatures.name: wt_bilinear_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {E F G H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] H) (f : E → F) (g : E → G) (ρ : E → ℝ) (Ω S : Set E), IsOpen Ω → S ⊆ Ω → (∀ w ∈ S, 0 < ρ w ∧ ρ w ≤ 1) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g Ω → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) Ω ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => B (f z) (g z)) w‖ ≤ C * ρ w ^ (-K)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (z : ℝ³ × ℝ), z ∈ {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < rad z.1 ∧ B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < 2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 ∧ rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)} → ptOf z.1 z.2 (Yph B.h (rad z.1) z.2 + 0) ∈ closure {ξ : Cyl | ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ SuppW B G γ ξ} → ∃ U : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ), IsOpen U ∧ z ∈ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ephase5 B G γ m (thetaOf w.1) (ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + 0))) U ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ephase5 B G γ m (thetaOf w.1) (ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + 0))) z‖ ≤ C * (1 + |(m : ℝ)|) ^ k * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-K)

signature.name: wv5_phase_bound
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C K : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (z : ℝ³ × ℝ), z ∈ {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < rad z.1 ∧ B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < 2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 ∧ rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)} → ptOf z.1 z.2 (Yph B.h (rad z.1) z.2 + 0) ∈ closure {ξ : Cyl | ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ SuppW B G γ ξ} → ∃ U : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ), IsOpen U ∧ z ∈ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ephase5 B G γ m (thetaOf w.1) (ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + 0))) U ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ephase5 B G γ m (thetaOf w.1) (ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + 0))) z‖ ≤ C * (1 + |(m : ℝ)|) ^ k * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-K)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨la, hla⟩ := wv5_activeL4_of_suppW B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨l5, h5⟩ := wv5_phiL5_window_jet B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨Kp, hKp0, hKp⟩ := wpf_pint_bound B G hok hG
  choose C5 M5 hM5 h5' using h5
  refine ⟨la + l5, fun l0 hl0 k => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨CX, KX, hCX1, hKX0, hs9⟩ := wv5_slow_factor B l0 hok k
  obtain ⟨CA, KA, hCA1, hKA0, hs7⟩ := wv5_angular_bound B l0 hok k
  obtain ⟨Ch, hChdef⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |C5 i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Mh, hMhdef⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), M5 i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCh1 : 1 ≤ Ch := by
    have : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |C5 i| := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
    rw [hChdef]; linarith
  have hMh0 : 0 ≤ Mh := by rw [hMhdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hM5 i)
  have hCle : ∀ i, i ≤ k → |C5 i| ≤ Ch := by
    intro i hi

by

  have PIC : ∀ {P E' F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
      [FiniteDimensional ℝ P] [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace ℝ E'] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E']
      [MeasurableSpace E'] [BorelSpace E'] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
      (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E') [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ]
      (U : Set P) (V K : Set E') (G : P → E' → F) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hK : IsCompact K)
      (hKV : K ⊆ V) (hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => G z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V)),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U := by
    intro P E' F _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ μ _ U V K G hU hV hK hKV hG
    have hO : IsOpen (U ×ˢ V) := hU.prod hV
    have hKm : MeasurableSet K := hK.isClosed.measurableSet
    have slice : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F'] (H : P → E' → F'),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) →
        ∀ x ∈ U, ContinuousOn (fun y => H x y) K := by
      intro F' _ _ H hH x hx
      have hc : Continuous (fun y : E' => ((x, y) : P × E')) := by fun_prop
      have h := ContinuousOn.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (f := fun y : E' => ((x, y) : P × E'))
        hH.continuousOn hc.continuousOn (fun y hy => ⟨hx, hKV hy⟩)
      exact h
    have param_fderiv : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F'] (H : P → E' → F'),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => H x' z.2) z.1) (U ×ˢ V) := by
      intro F' _ _ H hH p hp
      have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) p := hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hp)
      apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry (fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2)) (p, p.1) := by
        have e : Function.uncurry (fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2) =
            (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) ∘ (fun w : (P × E') × P => (w.2, w.1.2)) := rfl
        rw [e]
        apply ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (p, p.1)
        · simpa using hHa
        · fun_prop
      exact ContDiffAt.fderiv (f := fun (q : P × E') (x' : P) => H x' q.2)
        (g := Prod.fst) h1 contDiffAt_fst (le_of_eq ENat.coe_top_add_one)
    have param_hasFDeriv : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F']
        (H : P → E' → F'), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (U ×ˢ V) → ∀ x ∈ U,
        HasFDerivAt (fun x' => ∫ y in K, H x' y ∂μ) (∫ y in K, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => H x' y) x ∂μ) x := by
      intro F' _ _ H hH x hx
      have hHs := param_fderiv H hH
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU x hx
      have hsU : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ⊆ U :=
        (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
      have hsn : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ∈ nhds x := Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds x (by linarith)
      have hC : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ×ˢ K) := (isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod hK
      have hCsub : Metric.closedBall x (δ / 2) ×ˢ K ⊆ U ×ˢ V := fun z hz => ⟨hsU hz.1, hKV hz.2⟩
      obtain ⟨Cb, hCb⟩ := hC.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hHs.continuousOn.mono hCsub)
      refine hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (μ := μ.restrict K)
        (F := fun x' y => H x' y) (F' := fun x' y => fderiv ℝ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x')
        (bound := fun _ => Cb) hsn ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hx] with x' hx'
        exact (slice H hH x' hx').aestronglyMeasurable_of_isCompact hK hKm
      · exact (slice H hH x hx).integrableOn_compact hK
      · exact (slice (fun x' y => fderiv ℝ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x') hHs x hx).aestronglyMeasurable_of_isCompact
          hK hKm
      · exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hKm (fun y hy x' hx' => hCb (x', y) ⟨hx', hy⟩)
      · exact continuousOn_const.integrableOn_compact hK
      · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hKm (fun y hy x' hx' => ?_)
        have hHa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) (x', y) :=
          hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds ⟨hsU hx', hKV hy⟩)
        have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x'' : P => ((x'', y) : P × E')) x' := by fun_prop
        have h2 := ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun z : P × E' => H z.1 z.2) x' hHa hc
        have : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x'' => H x'' y) x' := h2
        exact (this.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have hD0 : ∀ x y, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun x' => G x' y) x =
        (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm (G x y) := by
      intro x y; rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp]; rfl
    have hDs : ∀ (k : ℕ) x y, iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) (fun x' => G x' y) x =
        (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm
          (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') x) := by
      intro k x y; rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left]; rfl
    have D_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) (U ×ˢ V) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        have e : (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) =
            (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm ∘ (fun z : P × E' => G z.1 z.2) := by
          funext z; exact hD0 z.1 z.2
        rw [e]
        exact (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hG
      | succ k ih =>
        have e : (fun z : P × E' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) (fun x' => G x' z.2) z.1) =
            (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm ∘
              (fun z : P × E' => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' z.2) x') z.1) := by
          funext z; exact hDs k z.1 z.2
        rw [e]
        have h2 := param_fderiv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') ih
        exact (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h2
    have formula : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) x =
        ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro x _
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp (f := fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ)]
        simp only [hD0]
        exact (ContinuousLinearEquiv.integral_comp_comm
          (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ P F).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv (fun y => G x y)).symm
      | succ k ih =>
        intro x hx
        have hα : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ) =ᶠ[nhds x]
            (fun x' => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x' ∂μ) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hx) ih
        have hβ := (param_hasFDeriv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x')
          (D_smooth k) x hx).fderiv
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left (f := fun x' => ∫ y in K, G x' y ∂μ), Function.comp_apply,
          hα.fderiv_eq, hβ]
        simp only [hDs]
        have hL := ContinuousLinearEquiv.integral_comp_comm (μ := μ.restrict K) (𝕜 := ℝ)
          (E := P →L[ℝ] ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => P) F)
          (F := ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F)
          (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => P) F).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv
          (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun x'' => G x'' y) x') x)
        exact hL.symm
    have key : ∀ m : ℕ, EqOn (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (fun x => ∫ y in K, G x y ∂μ) U)
        (fun x => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ) U := by
      intro m x hx
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hU hx]
      exact formula m x hx
    have hdiff : ∀ m : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℝ
        (fun x => ∫ y in K, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x' => G x' y) x ∂μ) U :=
      fun m x hx => (param_hasFDeriv (fun x' y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x'' => G x'' y) x')
        (D_smooth m) x hx).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    exact contDiffOn_of_continuousOn_differentiableOn (n := ⊤)
      (fun m _ => ((hdiff m).continuousOn).congr (key m))
      (fun m _ => (hdiff m).congr (key m))
  
  have hU : IsOpen (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Metric.ball z0 ε ×ˢ Metric.ball t0 ε)) :=
    isOpen_Ioi.prod (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball)
  have hK : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc

    have h := PIC (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (ℝ × ℝ))
      (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Metric.ball z0 ε ×ˢ Metric.ball t0 ε)) Set.univ

      mcor5 B G l0 S 2 η * mcor5 B G l0 S 1 η + Wcov5 B G l0 S 2 1 η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=

        ((∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, s2 Y) +

        (∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, s4 Y) -
        (((∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, s5 Y) +
            (∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, s6 Y) / c +
            (∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, s7 Y)) -
          (∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, s8 Y) / c ^ 2) + k := by
    intro s1 s2 s3 s4 s5 s6 s7 s8 c k h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7 h8
    simp (disch := exact IC _ (by fun_prop)) only [MeasureTheory.integral_add, MeasureTheory.integral_sub,
      MeasureTheory.integral_div, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.setIntegral_const, hvol,
      one_smul] <;> ring
  have key : yAvg (EthP5 B G l0 S) ξ =

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (D : WC) (E : WS) (α β : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α D → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β E → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → sw5L B G l0 D E x t Y = qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) • cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (linG5 B G D E) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))

signature.name: slin5_mode_rep
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (D : WC) (E : WS) (α β : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α D → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β E → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → sw5L B G l0 D E x t Y = qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) • cyl2cart x (waveV5 B G (linG5 B G D E) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have cofS : ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ l0 : ℕ, qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB →
      ∀ (D : WC) (E : WS) (α β : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α D → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β E →
      ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (cofAG5 B G D γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (cofPG5 B G E γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro B G hok hG l0 hqs D E α β hDw hEw γ m
    have hqsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
      have h4' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
        hok.1.2.2.2.1
      have hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
      have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
          (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
        intro ξ hξ
        have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2.1
        exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
      exact (h4'.comp hφ.contDiffOn hmaps).congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
    have hqpos : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < qC B.h η := by
      intro η hη
      have h' : η.2.2.1 < 1 := hη.2.1
      exact (hok.1.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
    have hqpow : ∀ c : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((qC B.h η ^ c : ℝ) : ℂ))
        (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
      intro c
      have hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ c) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
        hqsm.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos η hη).ne')
      exact (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hr).congr
        (fun η _ => by simp only [Function.comp_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply])
    have K : ∀ f : Cyl → ℂ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
        (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), f ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => f η *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))))
          (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
      intro f hf hsupp
      set v : Cyl → ℝ × ℝ := fun η => Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ with hv
      have hvc : Continuous v := by
        rw [hv]
        unfold Jpow
        fun_prop
      have hbase : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => baseC B γ.1 η j)
          (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
        intro j
        obtain ⟨_, hsm⟩ := geom_slow_base_smooth_v5 B hok
        have hπ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) :=
          contDiff_fst.prodMk (contDiff_snd.fst.prodMk contDiff_snd.snd.fst)
        have hc := (hsm γ.1 j).comp hπ.contDiffOn
          (fun ξ (hξ : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0) =>
            (⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ.2.2 hqs⟩ : ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈
              {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}))
        exact hc.congr (fun ξ _ => rfl)
      have hZ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => chartZ B.h γ.1 η) := by
        unfold chartZ
        exact contDiff_snd.fst.div_const _
      have hRC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => RC γ.1 η) := by
        unfold RC
        exact contDiff_fst.div_const _
      have hRCpos : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), RC γ.1 η ≠ 0 := by
        intro η hη
        have hr : 0 < η.1 := hη.1
        have : 0 < RC γ.1 η :=
          div_pos hr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _))
        exact this.ne'
      have hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Fang B γ.1 η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
        ((hbase 1).div hRC.contDiffOn hRCpos).congr (fun η _ => rfl)
      apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
      intro ξ₀ _
      set U' : Set Cyl := {η | |(v η).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8} ∩ {η | |(v η).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8}
        with hU'
      have hU'o : IsOpen U' :=
        (isOpen_lt ((hvc.fst.sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const).inter
          (isOpen_lt ((hvc.snd.sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const)
      have hξU : ξ₀ ∈ U' := by
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · show |(v ξ₀).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8
          rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; norm_num
        · show |(v ξ₀).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8
          rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; norm_num
      refine ⟨U', hU'o, hξU, ?_⟩
      by_cases hA : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U', f η = 0
      · refine (contDiffOn_const (c := (0:ℂ))).congr (fun p hp => ?_)
        have h0 := hA p hp
        simp [h0]
      · push_neg at hA
        obtain ⟨η1, ⟨hη1D, hη1U⟩, hη1⟩ := hA
        obtain ⟨-, -, hxi, het, -, -⟩ := hsupp η1 hη1D hη1
        have hr0 : G.r0 ≤ 1/100 := hG.1.2.1
        have hb0 : 0 ≤ bgc := by unfold bgc; linarith [Real.one_lt_sqrt_two]
        have hb1 : bgc ≤ 1 := by
          unfold bgc
          nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
        have hden : (1 + bgc ^ 2) * (1 + bgc ^ 2)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity)
        have id1 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.1 = lamR w + bgc * lamT w := by
          intro w
          simp only [lamR, lamT, div_eq_mul_inv]
          linear_combination (-w.1) * hden
        have id2 : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, w.2 = -(bgc * lamR w) + lamT w := by
          intro w
          simp only [lamR, lamT, div_eq_mul_inv]
          linear_combination (-w.2) * hden
        have key : ∀ (R T : ℝ), |R| ≤ G.r0 / 4 → |T| ≤ G.r0 →
            |R + bgc * T| ≤ 1/80 ∧ |-(bgc * R) + T| ≤ 1/80 := by
          intro R T hR hT
          obtain ⟨hR1, hR2⟩ := abs_le.mp hR
          obtain ⟨hT1, hT2⟩ := abs_le.mp hT
          have hr0n : 0 ≤ G.r0 := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hT
          have e1 : bgc * T ≤ G.r0 := by
            nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hT2), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
          have e2 : -G.r0 ≤ bgc * T := by
            nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (show 0 ≤ T + G.r0 by linarith),
              mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
          have e3 : bgc * R ≤ G.r0 / 4 := by
            nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hR2), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
          have e4 : -(G.r0 / 4) ≤ bgc * R := by
            nlinarith [mul_nonneg hb0 (show 0 ≤ R + G.r0 / 4 by linarith),
              mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb1) hr0n]
          exact ⟨abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
        have hround : ∀ (x : ℝ) (k : ℤ), |x - k| < 1/2 → round x = k := by
          intro x k hk
          rw [round_eq, Int.floor_eq_iff]
          obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hk
          constructor <;> linarith
        have hw1 : |lamR (frac0 (v η1))| ≤ G.r0 / 4 := hxi
        have hw2 : |lamT (frac0 (v η1))| ≤ G.r0 := het
        have hw := key _ _ hw1 hw2
        have ex1 : (v η1).1 - ((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ) =
            lamR (frac0 (v η1)) + bgc * lamT (frac0 (v η1)) := id1 (frac0 (v η1))
        have ex2 : (v η1).2 - ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ) =
            -(bgc * lamR (frac0 (v η1))) + lamT (frac0 (v η1)) := id2 (frac0 (v η1))
        have hx1 : |(v η1).1 - ((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1/80 := by rw [ex1]; exact hw.1
        have hx2 : |(v η1).2 - ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1/80 := by rw [ex2]; exact hw.2
        obtain ⟨kk, hkk⟩ : ∃ kk : ℝ × ℝ,
            kk = (((round (v η1).1 : ℤ) : ℝ), ((round (v η1).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
        have hfr : ∀ η ∈ U', frac0 (v η) = v η - kk := by
          intro η hη
          have h1 : |(v η).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8 := hη.1
          have h2 : |(v η).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8 := hη.2
          have g1 : |(v η1).1 - (v ξ₀).1| < 1/8 := hη1U.1
          have g2 : |(v η1).2 - (v ξ₀).2| < 1/8 := hη1U.2
          obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_lt.mp h1
          obtain ⟨a3, a4⟩ := abs_lt.mp h2
          obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := abs_lt.mp g1
          obtain ⟨b3, b4⟩ := abs_lt.mp g2
          obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := abs_le.mp hx1
          obtain ⟨c3, c4⟩ := abs_le.mp hx2
          have r1 : round (v η).1 = round (v η1).1 :=
            hround _ _ (abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
          have r2 : round (v η).2 = round (v η1).2 :=
            hround _ _ (abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
          rw [hkk]
          unfold frac0
          rw [r1, r2]
          rfl
        have hT : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => lamT (v η - kk)) := by
          simp only [hv, lamT, Jpow, div_eq_mul_inv]
          fun_prop
        obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ M : Cyl → ℝ, M = fun η : Cyl =>
            pzr5 B G γ * chartZ B.h γ.1 η / epsb B.h γ.1 + sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 * RC γ.1 η
            - (lamT (v η - kk) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 *
              (pang5 B G γ * Fang B γ.1 η + pzr5 B G γ * baseC B γ.1 η 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
        have hM : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ M (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
          rw [hMdef]
          exact ((((contDiffOn_const (c := pzr5 B G γ)).mul hZ.contDiffOn).div_const (epsb B.h γ.1)).add
            ((contDiffOn_const (c := sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2)).mul hRC.contDiffOn)).sub
            (((hT.contDiffOn.add (contDiffOn_const (c := G.r0))).div_const (cib B.h γ.1)).mul
              (((contDiffOn_const (c := pang5 B G γ)).mul hF).add
                ((contDiffOn_const (c := pzr5 B G γ)).mul (hbase 2))))
        have hmod : ∀ η ∈ U', phiL5 B G γ η = M η := by
          intro η hη
          have hvco : vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 = (lamT (v η - kk) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 := by
            show (lamT (frac0 (v η)) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 = _
            rw [hfr η hη]
          rw [hMdef]
          show phiL5 B G γ η = _
          unfold phiL5
          rw [hvco]
        have hMc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((M η : ℝ) : ℂ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
          (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hM).congr
            (fun p _ => by simp only [Function.comp_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply])
        have hEx : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) *
            ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((M η : ℝ) : ℂ)))) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
          ((contDiffOn_const (c := Complex.I * (m : ℂ))).mul
            ((contDiffOn_const (c := (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ))).mul hMc)).cexp
        refine ((hf.mul hEx).mono inter_subset_left).congr (fun p hp => ?_)
        have hpU : p ∈ U' := hp.2
        show f p * _ = _
        rw [hmod p hpU]
    constructor
    · refine contDiffOn_pi.2 (fun i => ?_)
      have hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => D γ m η i) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
        contDiffOn_pi.1 (hDw.2.1 γ m) i
      have hs : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), D γ m ξ i ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ := by
        intro ξ hξ hne
        apply hDw.2.2.2.1 γ m ξ hξ
        intro h0
        apply hne
        simp [h0]
      refine ((hqpow (1/2 - Aex B.h)).mul (K _ hc hs)).congr (fun η _ => ?_)
      simp only [cofAG5, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    · refine ((hqpow (-2 * Aex B.h)).mul
        (K _ (hEw.2.1 γ m) (fun ξ hξ hne => hEw.2.2.2.1 γ m ξ hξ hne))).congr (fun η _ => ?_)
      simp only [cofPG5]
      ring
  
  have locM : ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → ∀ l0 : ℕ, ∀ (D : WC) (E : WS) (α β : ℝ),
      InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α D → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β E → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t →
      ∃ (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (Γ : Finset Lab) (H : Finset ℤ), IsOpen O ∧ (x, t) ∈ O ∧
        (∀ y s, (y, s) ∈ O → corrOn B l0 y s ∧
          evOff B.h (sw5A B G l0 D) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y s = ∑ k ∈ Γ ×ˢ H,
            mvec5 B.h (k.2 * pint5 B G k.1) (cofAG5 B G D k.1 k.2) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y s ∧
          evOff B.h (sw5P B G l0 E) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y s = ∑ k ∈ Γ ×ˢ H,
            msc5 B.h (k.2 * pint5 B G k.1) (cofPG5 B G E k.1 k.2) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y s) ∧
        ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), (γ ∉ Γ ∨ m ∉ H) → linG5 B G D E γ m (ptOf x t Y) = 0 := by
    intro B G hok l0 D E α β hDw hEw x t Y hxt
    obtain ⟨Y', hY'⟩ : ∃ Y' : ℝ × ℝ, Y' = Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hY']
    have hxt' : 0 < rad x ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hxt
    have hEta : ∀ (h : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → ∀ ξ0 : Cyl, ξ0.2.2.1 < 1 → ∃ N ∈ nhds ξ0, ∃ Γ : Finset Lab,
        ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ N → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) → γ ∈ Γ := by
      intro h hS ξ0 hξ0
      have hLc : ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ContinuousAt (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) ξ := by
        intro ξ hξ
        have hτ : 0 < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 := by linarith
        have hqpos : 0 < qC h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).1
        have hqcont : ContinuousAt (qC h) ξ := by
          have hU : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
          have hp : ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
            ⟨trivial, hτ⟩
          have hg : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) :=
            hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)
          have hk : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) ξ := by fun_prop
          have he : qC h = (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘
              (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
            funext η; rfl
          rw [he]
          exact ContinuousAt.comp hg hk
        exact hqcont.logb hqpos.ne'
      have hwin : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (γ : Lab), ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) →
          |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) + (γ.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
          |chartR h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
          |chartZ h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
          |chartT h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
        intro ξ γ hξ hγ
        have s1 : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ → 1 < |φ ξ / μ - (j : ℝ)| →
            ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 := by
          intro μ j φ hφ h1
          have hψ : ContinuousAt (fun η => |φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)|) ξ :=
            ((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs
          have hev := (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : Cyl => (1:ℝ)) ξ).eventually_lt hψ h1
          filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
          have hsq : 1 < (φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)) ^ 2 := (one_lt_sq_iff_one_lt_abs _).mpr hη
          unfold sqPart bumpR
          rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), zero_div]
        have key : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ →
            (∀ η, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 → etaL h γ η = 0) → |φ ξ / μ - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
          intro μ j φ hφ himp
          by_contra hc
          push_neg at hc
          have hev := s1 μ j φ hφ hc
          apply (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mpr _) hγ
          filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
          exact himp η hη
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have := key 1 (-(γ.1:ℤ)) (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) (hLc ξ hξ)
            (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul])
          simpa [div_one, sub_neg_eq_add] using this
        · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.1 (chartR h γ.1) (by unfold chartR; fun_prop)
            (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
        · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.1 (chartZ h γ.1) (by unfold chartZ; fun_prop)
            (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
        · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.2 (chartT h γ.1) (by unfold chartT; fun_prop)
            (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      obtain ⟨L0, hL0⟩ : ∃ L0 : ℝ, L0 = Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hfin : (⋃ n ∈ Set.Iic ⌊2 - L0⌋₊, ({n} : Set ℕ) ×ˢ
          ((Set.Icc ⌈chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ
            Set.Icc ⌈chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ
            Set.Icc ⌈chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋) ×ˢ

    apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset

    intro qe Ec M X hE

      ext ξ

  have hfd : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℂ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →

  have hvec : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => (((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) : Cyl))

  have hinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.1 : ℂ))⁻¹) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp contDiff_fst).contDiffOn.inv
      (fun ξ hξ => by simpa using (hDm ξ hξ).1.ne')
  have hmc : ∀ (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →

    have hci : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => c η i) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=

    have hk2 : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => c ξ i / (ξ.1 : ℂ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
      intro i

      exact (hci i).mul hinv
    refine contDiffOn_pi.2 (fun i => ?_)
    fin_cases i
    · show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => Complex.I * (n : ℂ) / (ξ.1 : ℂ) * c ξ 2 - dZ (fun η => c η 1) ξ) _

    · show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => dZ (fun η => c η 0) ξ - dR B.h (fun η => c η 2) ξ) _
      exact (hdZ _ (hci 0)).sub (hdR _ (hci 2))
    · show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => dR B.h (fun η => c η 1) ξ + c ξ 1 / (ξ.1 : ℂ)

  obtain ⟨hub, hubs⟩ := ubase5_axisym B hok

    intro i

  obtain ⟨O, Γ, H, hO, hxO, hOm, hvan⟩ := locM B G hok l0 D E α β hDw hEw x t Y hxt
  have hsl : ∀ y s, (y, s) ∈ O → {z : ℝ³ | (z, s) ∈ O} ∈ nhds y := fun y s h =>

  have hWS : ∀ y s, (y, s) ∈ O → evOff B.h (sw5W B G l0 D) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y s =

    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hsl x t hxO) (fun z hz => (hOm z t hz).2.2)
  have hres := mode5_linres B (Γ ×ˢ H) (fun k => k.2 * pint5 B G k.1)

  refine hres.trans ?_

  have hq : 0 < qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) := (hok.1.1 (x 2) (1 - t) (by linarith [(hcorr x t hxt).2.1])).1
  have hcs : ∀ (f : Lab × ℤ → Fin 3 → ℝ), ∑ k ∈ Γ ×ˢ H, cyl2cart x (f k) =

    intro f

    intro c v

  have hwave : waveV5 B G (linG5 B G D E) (thetaOf x) (ptOf x t Y) = fun i =>
      qC B.h (ptOf x t Y) ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * ∑ k ∈ Γ ×ˢ H,
        (mresC B (k.2 * pint5 B G k.1) (mcurlC B.h (k.2 * pint5 B G k.1) (cofAG5 B G D k.1 k.2))

          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((k.2 * pint5 B G k.1 : ℤ) : ℂ) * (thetaOf x : ℂ))).re := by

    rw [hph, hlin, hterm _ _ _ _ hEne]
  rw [hwave]
  simp only [mvec5, hY]
  rw [hcs, hscale, smul_smul, ← Real.rpow_add hq, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero, one_smul]

noncomputable def cofAG5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (D : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ) := fun η =>
  (((qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
    (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) • D γ m η)
noncomputable def cofPG5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (E : WS) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) : Cyl → ℂ := fun η =>
  (((qC B.h η ^ (-2 * Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) * E γ m η)

subgoal_signatures.name: mode5_curl
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} (h : ℝ) (K : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℤ) (c : ι → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ η ∈ U, 0 < η.1) → (∀ k ∈ K, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (c k) U) → 0 < rad y → ptOf y s (Yph h (rad y) s + Y0) ∈ U → curl3 (fun z => ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 h (n k) (c k) Y0 z s) y = ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 h (n k) (mcurlC h (n k) (c k)) Y0 y s

subgoal_signatures.name: mode5_linres
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} (B : BG) (K : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℤ) (a : ι → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (p : ι → Cyl → ℂ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), IsOpen U → IsOpen O → (∀ η ∈ U, 0 < η.1) → (x, t) ∈ O → (∀ y s, (y, s) ∈ O → 0 < rad y ∧ ptOf y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y0) ∈ U ∧ uB B y s = cyl2cart y (fun i => ubase B (ptOf y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y0)) i)) → (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ubase B η i) U) → (∀ k ∈ K, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (a k) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (p k) U) → deriv (fun s => ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 x s) t - Δ (fun y => ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 y t) x + gradient (fun y => ∑ k ∈ K, msc5 B.h (n k) (p k) Y0 y t) x + fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 y t) x (uB B x t) + fderiv ℝ (fun y => uB B y t) x (∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (a k) Y0 x t) = ∑ k ∈ K, mvec5 B.h (n k) (mresC B (n k) (a k) (p k)) Y0 x t

subgoal_signatures.name: ubase5_axisym
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → (∀ (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ) (Y0 : ℝ × ℝ), (y, s) ∈ simDomain B.h B.qB → 0 < rad y → uB B y s = cyl2cart y (fun i => ubase B (ptOf y s Y0) i)) ∧ ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ubase B η i) {η : Cyl | 0 < η.1 ∧ η.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h η < B.qB}

subgoal_signatures.name: geom_slow_base_smooth_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ B : BG, B.ok →
    IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} ∧
    ∀ (l : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => baseC B l (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) i)
      {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (D : WC) (E : WS) (Lh : WC) (α β δ : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α D → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β E → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) δ Lh → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (linG5 B G D E - princG5 B G Lh E) γ m ξ = (remSlow5 B (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • wmoAmp5 B G D γ' m' η) + remPhase5 B G (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • wmoAmp5 B G D γ' m' η) + remPres5 B (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-2 * Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * E γ' m' η) + remVisc5 B G (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • wmoAmp5 B G D γ' m' η) + remBase5 B (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • wmoAmp5 B G D γ' m' η) + primOp5 B G (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • ampDG5 B G D Lh γ' m' η)) γ m ξ

signature.name: slin5_rem_identity
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (D : WC) (E : WS) (Lh : WC) (α β δ : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α D → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β E → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) δ Lh → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (linG5 B G D E - princG5 B G Lh E) γ m ξ = (remSlow5 B (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • wmoAmp5 B G D γ' m' η) + remPhase5 B G (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • wmoAmp5 B G D γ' m' η) + remPres5 B (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-2 * Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * E γ' m' η) + remVisc5 B G (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • wmoAmp5 B G D γ' m' η) + remBase5 B (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • wmoAmp5 B G D γ' m' η) + primOp5 B G (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • ampDG5 B G D Lh γ' m' η)) γ m ξ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  obtain ⟨lP, hPS⟩ := pulse_support_good_v5 B G hok hG
  refine ⟨lP + n0, fun l0 hl0 D E Lh α β δ hAw hpw hW0 γ m ξ hξ => ?_⟩
  by_cases hsupp : ξ ∈ tsupport (D γ m) ∨ ξ ∈ tsupport (E γ m) ∨ ξ ∈ tsupport (Lh γ m)
  swap
  · 
    simp only [not_or] at hsupp
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hsupp
    have hAz : D γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 h1
    have hpz : E γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 h2
    have hWz : Lh γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 h3
    have gf1 : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (f : Cyl → W) (w : Cyl → Cyl),
        f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → (fun η => fderiv ℝ f η (w η)) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
      intro W _ _ f w hf
      filter_upwards [hf.eventuallyEq_nhds] with η hη
      rw [hη.fderiv_eq]
      simp [fderiv_zero]
    have hdR : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℂ), f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → dR B.h f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := fun f hf =>
      gf1 f (fun η => (1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)) hf
    have hdZ : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℂ), f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → dZ f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := fun f hf =>
      gf1 f (fun _ => (0, 1, 0, 0)) hf
    have hdT : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℂ), f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → dT f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := fun f hf =>
      gf1 f (fun _ => (0, 0, 1, vtv)) hf
    have hdTsV : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℂ), f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → dTsV f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := fun f hf =>
      gf1 f (fun _ => (0, 0, 1, ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))) hf
    have hdVc : ∀ (l : ℕ) (F : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), F =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → dVc B l F =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := fun l F hF =>
      gf1 F (fun _ => dVdir B.h l) hF
    have hcomp : ∀ (F : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (i : Fin 3), F =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → (fun η => F η i) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
      intro F i hF
      filter_upwards [hF] with η h
      simp [h]
    have ev0 : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] (f : Cyl → W), f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → f ξ = 0 := by
      intro W _ f hf
      simpa using hf.eq_of_nhds
    have hmcurl : ∀ (n : ℤ) (C : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), C =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → mcurlC B.h n C =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
      intro n C hC
      filter_upwards [hC, hdZ _ (hcomp C 1 hC), hdZ _ (hcomp C 0 hC), hdR _ (hcomp C 2 hC),
        hdR _ (hcomp C 1 hC)] with η h0 h1 h2 h3 h4
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at h0 h1 h2 h3 h4
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [mcurlC, h0, h1, h2, h3, h4]
    have hmres : ∀ (n : ℤ) (a : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (p : Cyl → ℂ), a =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → p =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 →
        mresC B n a p ξ = 0 := by
      intro n a p ha hp
      have hai : ∀ i, (fun η => a η i) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := fun i => hcomp a i ha
      have v0 : ∀ i, a ξ i = 0 := fun i => ev0 _ (hai i)
      have vT : ∀ i, dT (fun η => a η i) ξ = 0 := fun i => ev0 _ (hdT _ (hai i))
      have vR : ∀ i, dR B.h (fun η => a η i) ξ = 0 := fun i => ev0 _ (hdR _ (hai i))
      have vZ : ∀ i, dZ (fun η => a η i) ξ = 0 := fun i => ev0 _ (hdZ _ (hai i))
      have vRR : ∀ i, dR B.h (dR B.h (fun η => a η i)) ξ = 0 := fun i => ev0 _ (hdR _ (hdR _ (hai i)))
      have vZZ : ∀ i, dZ (dZ (fun η => a η i)) ξ = 0 := fun i => ev0 _ (hdZ _ (hdZ _ (hai i)))
      have pv : p ξ = 0 := ev0 _ hp
      have pR : dR B.h p ξ = 0 := ev0 _ (hdR _ hp)
      have pZ : dZ p ξ = 0 := ev0 _ (hdZ _ hp)
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [mresC, mlapC, v0, vT, vR, vZ, vRR, vZZ, pv, pR, pZ]
    have hvelg : ∀ (c : WC), c γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → velC5 B G c γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
      intro c hc
      filter_upwards [hc, hdR _ (hcomp _ 0 hc), hdR _ (hcomp _ 1 hc), hdR _ (hcomp _ 2 hc),
        hdZ _ (hcomp _ 0 hc), hdZ _ (hcomp _ 1 hc), hdZ _ (hcomp _ 2 hc)] with η h0 r0 r1 r2 z0 z1 z2
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at h0 r0 r1 r2 z0 z1 z2
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [velC5, DrC, DzC, h0, r0, r1, r2, z0, z1, z2]
    have hwmo : wmoAmp5 B G D γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hAz, hvelg _ hAz] with η h1 h2
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at h1 h2
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [wmoAmp5, velW5, h1, h2, rotC]
    have hA : (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • wmoAmp5 B G D γ' m' η) γ m
        =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hwmo] with η h
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at h
      simp [h]
    have hPP : (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-2 * Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * E γ' m' η) γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hpz] with η h
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at h
      simp [h]
    have hD : (fun γ' m' η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • ampDG5 B G D Lh γ' m' η) γ m
        =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hwmo, hWz] with η h1 h2
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at h1 h2
      simp [ampDG5, h1, h2]
    have hrem : ∀ (a : WC) (P : WS) (d : WC), a γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → P γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 →
        d γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 →
        (remSlow5 B a + remPhase5 B G a + remPres5 B P + remVisc5 B G a + remBase5 B a + primOp5 B G d) γ m ξ
          = 0 := by
      intro a P d ha hP hd
      have hai : ∀ i, (fun η => a γ m η i) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := fun i => hcomp (a γ m) i ha
      have a0 : a γ m ξ = 0 := ev0 _ ha
      have v0 : ∀ i, a γ m ξ i = 0 := fun i => ev0 _ (hai i)
      have vS : ∀ i, dTsV (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ = 0 := fun i => ev0 _ (hdTsV _ (hai i))
      have vR : ∀ i, dR B.h (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ = 0 := fun i => ev0 _ (hdR _ (hai i))
      have vZ : ∀ i, dZ (fun η => a γ m η i) ξ = 0 := fun i => ev0 _ (hdZ _ (hai i))
      have vRR : ∀ i, dR B.h (fun η => dR B.h (fun η' => a γ m η' i) η) ξ = 0 := fun i =>
        ev0 _ (hdR _ (hdR _ (hai i)))
      have vZZ : ∀ i, dZ (fun η => dZ (fun η' => a γ m η' i) η) ξ = 0 := fun i =>
        ev0 _ (hdZ _ (hdZ _ (hai i)))
      have pR : dR B.h (P γ m) ξ = 0 := ev0 _ (hdR _ hP)
      have pZ : dZ (P γ m) ξ = 0 := ev0 _ (hdZ _ hP)
      have d0 : d γ m ξ = 0 := ev0 _ hd
      have dV : dVc B γ.1 (d γ m) ξ = 0 := ev0 _ (hdVc _ _ hd)
      have e1 : remSlow5 B a γ m ξ = 0 := by
        funext i
        simp [remSlow5, vS, vR, vZ]
      have e2 : remPhase5 B G a γ m ξ = 0 := by
        simp [remPhase5, a0]
      have e3 : remPres5 B P γ m ξ = 0 := by
        funext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp [remPres5, pR, pZ]
      have e4 : remVisc5 B G a γ m ξ = 0 := by
        funext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp [remVisc5, v0, vR, vZ, vRR, vZZ]
      have e5 : remBase5 B a γ m ξ = 0 := by
        funext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp [remBase5, v0]
      have e6 : primOp5 B G d γ m ξ = 0 := by
        simp [primOp5, d0, dV]
      simp only [Pi.add_apply]
      rw [e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6]
      simp
    have hC : (fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) • D γ m η))
        =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hAz] with η h
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at h
      simp [h]
    have hP : (fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-2 * Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) * E γ m η))
        =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hpz] with η h
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at h
      simp [h]
    have hL : linG5 B G D E γ m ξ = 0 := by
      have e : linG5 B G D E γ m ξ = (((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))⁻¹) •
          mresC B (m * pint5 B G γ) (mcurlC B.h (m * pint5 B G γ)
            (fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
              (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) • D γ m η)))
            (fun η => (((qC B.h η ^ (-2 * Aex B.h)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) * E γ m η)) ξ :=
        rfl
      rw [e, hmres _ _ _ (hmcurl _ _ hC) hP, smul_zero]
    have hWv : Lh γ m ξ = 0 := ev0 _ hWz
    have hWd : dVc B γ.1 (Lh γ m) ξ = 0 := ev0 _ (hdVc _ _ hWz)
    have hpv : E γ m ξ = 0 := ev0 _ hpz
    have hPr : princG5 B G Lh E γ m ξ = 0 := by
      simp [princG5, hWv, hWd, hpv]
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
    rw [hL, hPr, sub_zero]
    exact (hrem _ _ _ hA hPP hD).symm
  
  have hS : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 < B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0
  have hDsub : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ⊆ DomC B.h B.qB := fun η hη => ⟨hη.1, hη.2.1, lt_trans hη.2.2 hqsB⟩
  have hDo : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have h4c := hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hm : MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hξ' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun ξ : Cyl => simScale B.h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1)) {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} :=
      h4c.comp (f := fun ξ : Cyl => (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1)) (Continuous.continuousOn (by fun_prop)) hm
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) = {ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ ({ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1} ∩
        (fun ξ : Cyl => simScale B.h ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1)) ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0)) := by
      ext ξ
      exact Iff.rfl
    rw [e]
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).inter
      (hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const) isOpen_Iio)
  have hgood : |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 ∧ |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 := by
    rcases hsupp with h | h | h
    · obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, h8, h9⟩ := hPS l0 (by omega) α _ hAw γ m ξ hξ h
      exact ⟨h8, h9⟩
    · obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, h8, h9⟩ := hPS l0 (by omega) β _ hpw γ m ξ hξ h
      exact ⟨h8, h9⟩
    · obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, h8, h9⟩ := hPS l0 (by omega) δ _ hW0 γ m ξ hξ h
      exact ⟨h8, h9⟩
  
  obtain ⟨_hΩ, hslowS⟩ := geom_slow_base_smooth_v5 B hok
  have hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
  have hbase : ∀ (l : ℕ) (j : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => baseC B l η j) (DomC B.h B.qB) := by
    intro l j
    exact ((hslowS l j).comp hp.contDiffOn (fun η hη => hη)).congr (fun η _ => rfl)
  have hrel : ∀ (l : ℕ) (η : Cyl) (i : Fin 3), baseC B l η i = Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * ubase B η i :=
    fun l η i => rfl
  have hub : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ubase B η i) (DomC B.h B.qB) := by
    intro i
    have hQ0 : Qb 0 ^ (1/2 + B.h) = 1 := by simp [Qb]
    refine (hbase 0 i).congr (fun η _ => ?_)
    rw [hrel 0 η i, hQ0, one_mul]
  
  have hbgc : 0 ≤ bgc ∧ bgc < 1/2 := by
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
    have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
    unfold bgc
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  have hDen : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : ℝ × ℝ, w = rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hxiw : |lamR w| < 1/8 := by rw [hw]; exact hgood.1
  have hetw : |lamT w| < 1/8 := by rw [hw]; exact hgood.2
  have hinv1 : w.1 = lamR w + bgc * lamT w := by
    have e : lamR w + bgc * lamT w = (w.1 - bgc * w.2 + bgc * (bgc * w.1 + w.2)) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) := by
      unfold lamR lamT; ring

      have hinv : Q⁻¹ = Real.exp (-Real.log Q) := by rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hQ]
      simp only [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hq, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hQ, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hqQ, hinv,
        Real.log_div hq.ne' hQ.ne', ← Real.exp_add, Aex]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> congr 1 <;> ring

    rw [← hρ] at R1 R2 R3 R4

    have C2 := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ)) R2
    have C3 := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ)) R3
    have C4 := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ)) R4

    simp only [primOp5, princG5, dDamp5, epsb, hA, hdA, hdD]
    ext i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_smul,
      Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.ofReal_natCast]
    linear_combination (dVc B γ.1 (Lh γ m) ξ i) * C1
      + ((pulseMatC (Kmat B G γ ξ)).mulVec (Lh γ m ξ) i) * C2
      + (Lh γ m ξ i * (m : ℂ) ^ 2 * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) ^ 2 *
          ((dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) * C3
      + (nPhiC5 B G γ ξ i * E γ m ξ * Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ)) * C4
  
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply]
  rw [e7, e8]
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq e9]

by

  have hmC : (m : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by rcases hm with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num

  have hform : ∀ i, princG5 B G (LSh5 B G l0 S) (pwScale B (presW5 B G (LSc5 B G l0 S))) γ m ξ i =

    intro i

    have hpw : pwScale B (presW5 B G (LSc5 B G l0 S)) γ m ξ = ((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (Complex.I / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ)) *

    have hI' : ∀ X : ℝ, ((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ)) *
        (((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ)) * ((X : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
        -(((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((X : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by

      have e : ((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ)) *

    unfold princG5

    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, nPhiC5, hm2, one_mul]

  have hkill : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, dVc B γ.1 (LSh5 B G l0 S γ m) ξ = (fun i => ((v i : ℝ) : ℂ)) →

  have halg : ∀ (n n' t : Fin 3 → ℝ) (K : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (d σ : ℝ) (i : Fin 3),

  have hJc : Continuous (fun Y' : ℝ × ℝ => Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ) := by

  obtain ⟨w1, hw1d⟩ : ∃ w : ℝ × ℝ, w = rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η1.2.2.2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
