      have r1 : round ((Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).1) = K1 := hround _ _ hY'.1
      have r2 : round ((Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).2) = K2 := hround _ _ hY'.2
      unfold rectW frac0
      rw [r1, r2]
      ext <;> simp
    obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U : Set Cyl, U = (fun η : Cyl => η.2.2.2) ⁻¹' V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hUo : IsOpen U := by
      rw [hU]
      exact hVo.preimage (by fun_prop)
    have hξU : ξ0 ∈ U := by rw [hU]; exact hYV
    have hUV : ∀ η ∈ U, η.2.2.2 ∈ V := by
      intro η hη
      rw [hU] at hη
      exact hη
    have hTo : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) := hDo.inter hUo
    
    have hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl =>
        (lamT (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ - ((K1 : ℝ), (K2 : ℝ))) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1) := by
      unfold lamT Jpow; fun_prop
    obtain ⟨φt, hφt⟩ : ∃ f : Cyl → ℝ, f = fun η : Cyl => pzr5 B G γ * chartZ B.h γ.1 η / epsb B.h γ.1 +
        sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 * RC γ.1 η -
        ((lamT (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ - ((K1 : ℝ), (K2 : ℝ))) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1) *
          (pang5 B G γ * Fang B γ.1 η + pzr5 B G γ * baseC B γ.1 η 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φt (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
      rw [hφt]
      exact (((contDiffOn_const.mul hchartZ.contDiffOn).div_const _).add
        (contDiffOn_const.mul hRC.contDiffOn)).sub
        (hv.contDiffOn.mul ((contDiffOn_const.mul hFang).add (contDiffOn_const.mul (hbase 2))))
    have hEq : ∀ η ∈ U, phiL5 B G γ η = φt η := by
      intro η hη
      rw [hφt]
      simp only [phiL5, vco, etG, hfr _ (hUV η hη)]
    have hN : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ η i) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) := by
      intro i
      fin_cases i
      · show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) *
          fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) η ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv))
          (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U)
        exact contDiffOn_const.mul (transfer _ hTo _ φt _ (fun η hη => hEq η hη.2)
          (hφ.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (hdR.mono Set.inter_subset_left))
      · show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => pang5 B G γ / RC γ.1 η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U)
        exact contDiffOn_const.div hRC.contDiffOn (fun η hη => hRCne η hη.1)
      · show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) *
          fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) η (((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) : Cyl)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U)
        exact contDiffOn_const.mul (transfer _ hTo _ φt (fun _ => (((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0 : ℝ × ℝ)) : Cyl))
          (fun η hη => hEq η hη.2) (hφ.mono Set.inter_subset_left) contDiffOn_const)
    
    have hWT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (c γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) := hWs.mono Set.inter_subset_left
    have hPT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (E γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) :=
      hPs.mono Set.inter_subset_left
    have hρT : ∀ e : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (((rhoQ B γ η ^ e) : ℝ) : ℂ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) :=
      fun e => (hρs e).mono Set.inter_subset_left
    have hdVT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => dVc B γ.1 (c γ m) η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) :=
      hdV.mono Set.inter_subset_left
    have hKT : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Kmat B G γ η i j) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) :=
      fun i j => (hK i j).mono Set.inter_subset_left
    have hmv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (pulseMatC (Kmat B G γ η)).mulVec (c γ m η))
        (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) := by
      apply contDiffOn_pi.2
      intro i
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ∑ j : Fin 3, ((Kmat B G γ η i j : ℝ) : ℂ) * c γ m η j)
          (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) :=
        ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ => (hcast _ _ (hKT i j)).mul (contDiffOn_pi.1 hWT j))
      exact h1.congr (fun η _ => rfl)
    have hdd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => dDamp5 B G γ η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) := by
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 *
          ∑ i : Fin 3, nPhi5 B G γ η i * nPhi5 B G γ η i) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) :=
        contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => (hN i).mul (hN i)))
      exact h1.congr (fun η _ => rfl)
    have hnc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => nPhiC5 B G γ η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) :=
      contDiffOn_pi.2 (fun i => hcast _ _ (hN i))
    have hfin : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (((rhoQ B γ η ^ (Aex B.h + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        (dVc B γ.1 (c γ m) η + (pulseMatC (Kmat B G γ η)).mulVec (c γ m η)
          + ((m : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((dDamp5 B G γ η : ℝ) : ℂ)) • c γ m η)
        + ((((rhoQ B γ η ^ (1/2 : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ))
          * E γ m η) • nPhiC5 B G γ η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) :=
      ((hρT _).smul ((hdVT.add hmv).add ((contDiffOn_const.mul (hcast _ _ hdd)).smul hWT))).add
        ((((hρT _).mul contDiffOn_const).mul hPT).smul hnc)
    exact ⟨U, hUo, hξU, hfin.congr (fun η _ => rfl)⟩
  · 
    have hfarN : ∃ N : Set Cyl, IsOpen N ∧ ξ0 ∈ N ∧
        ∀ η ∈ N, ¬ inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (2 * G.r0) η.2.2.2 := by
      rw [not_and_or, not_lt, not_lt] at hgood
      rcases hgood with h1 | h1
      · refine ⟨{η : Cyl | |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1 -
            (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ0.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1| < 1/24},
          isOpen_lt (hJη.fst.sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const, by simp, ?_⟩
        intro η hη hR
        have e1 : 1/12 ≤ |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ0.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1 -
            ((round (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ0.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1 : ℤ) : ℝ)| := h1
        have e2 : |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1 -
            ((round (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 3/100 := (hsmall _ hR).1
        have e3 := hfar _ _ e1 hη
        linarith
      · refine ⟨{η : Cyl | |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2 -
            (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ0.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2| < 1/24},
          isOpen_lt (hJη.snd.sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const, by simp, ?_⟩
        intro η hη hR
        have e1 : 1/12 ≤ |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ0.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2 -
            ((round (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ0.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)| := h1
        have e2 : |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2 -
            ((round (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 3/100 := (hsmall _ hR).2
        have e3 := hfar _ _ e1 hη
        linarith
    obtain ⟨N, hNo, hξ0N, hNR⟩ := hfarN
    have hr0 : 0 < G.r0 := hG.1.1
    have hSR : ∀ η : Cyl, SuppW B G γ η → inRect B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (2 * G.r0) η.2.2.2 := by
      intro η hS
      have hx : |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2| ≤ G.r0 / 4 := hS.2.2.1
      have he : |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2| ≤ G.r0 := hS.2.2.2.1
      exact ⟨le_trans hx (by linarith), le_trans he (by linarith)⟩
    have hO : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ N) := hDo.inter hNo
    have hcz : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ N, c γ m η = 0 := by
      intro η hη
      by_contra hne
      exact hNR η hη.2 (hSR η (hc.2.2.2.1 γ m η hη.1 hne))
    have hEz : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ N, E γ m η = 0 := by
      intro η hη
      by_contra hne
      exact hNR η hη.2 (hSR η (hE.2.2.2.1 γ m η hη.1 hne))
    have hd0 : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ N, dVc B γ.1 (c γ m) η = 0 := by
      intro η hη
      have hev : c γ m =ᶠ[nhds η] fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hη) hcz
      unfold dVc
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    have hz : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ N, princG5 B G c E γ m η = 0 := by
      intro η hη
      unfold princG5
      rw [hd0 η hη, hcz η hη, hEz η hη]
      simp
    exact ⟨N, hNo, hξ0N, (contDiffOn_const (c := (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ))).congr (fun η hη => hz η hη)⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (c : WC) (E : WS) (α β : ℝ), 0 ≤ α → 0 ≤ β → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α c → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β E → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b d : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (m = 1 ∨ m = -1) → SuppW B G γ ξ → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (princG5 B G c E γ m) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (-1:ℝ) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) * Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (c : WC) (E : WS) (α β : ℝ), 0 ≤ α → 0 ≤ β → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α c → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β E → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b d : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (m = 1 ∨ m = -1) → SuppW B G γ ξ → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (princG5 B G c E γ m) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (-1:ℝ) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) * Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨hh, hh1, hXa, -, -, -, -, hqB0, hqB1, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  have hr0 : 0 < G.r0 := hG.1.1
  have hr01 : G.r0 ≤ 1/100 := hG.1.2.1
  obtain ⟨lg, cg, b0, -, hgeo⟩ := nphi5_geometry_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  have hQbe : ∀ l : ℕ, Qb l = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l := fun l => by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hQbpos : ∀ l : ℕ, 0 < Qb l := fun l => by rw [hQbe]; positivity
  have hQb1 : ∀ l : ℕ, Qb l ≤ 1 := fun l => by
    rw [hQbe]; exact pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hsum : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ) (N i : ℕ), (∀ j, 0 ≤ f j) → i < N → f i ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, f j :=
    fun f N i hf hi => Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hf j) (Finset.mem_range.mpr hi)
  have hsum0 : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ), (∀ j, 0 ≤ f j) → 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, f j :=
    fun f N hf => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hf j)
  have henv : ∀ (c A Bb Bm sw Dd Dm Pv : ℝ), 0 ≤ A → A ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ Bb → Bb ≤ Bm → 0 ≤ sw → 0 ≤ Dd →
      Dd ≤ Dm → 0 ≤ Pv → c * A * Bb * sw * Dd * Pv ≤ |c| * (Bm * sw * Dm * Pv) := by
    intro c A Bb Bm sw Dd Dm Pv hA0 hA1 hB0 hB hs hD0 hD hP
    have hX : 0 ≤ A * Bb * sw * Dd * Pv :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hA0 hB0) hs) hD0) hP
    have e1 : c * A * Bb * sw * Dd * Pv = c * (A * Bb * sw * Dd * Pv) := by ring
    have h1 : A * Bb ≤ Bm := by
      calc A * Bb ≤ 1 * Bm := mul_le_mul hA1 hB hB0 zero_le_one
        _ = Bm := one_mul _
    have hBm0 : 0 ≤ Bm := le_trans hB0 hB
    have h2 : A * Bb * sw * Dd * Pv ≤ Bm * sw * Dm * Pv := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hP
      exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hs) hD hD0 (mul_nonneg hBm0 hs)
    rw [e1]
    calc c * (A * Bb * sw * Dd * Pv) ≤ |c| * (A * Bb * sw * Dd * Pv) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self c) hX
      _ ≤ |c| * (Bm * sw * Dm * Pv) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (abs_nonneg c)
  have hTgc1 : 1 < Tgc := by
    have : (1:ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := by
      have := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (show (1:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
      rwa [Real.sqrt_one] at this
    unfold Tgc; linarith
  have hTgc0 : 0 < Tgc := by linarith
  have hbgc : 0 < bgc ∧ bgc < 1 := by
    have h1 : (1:ℝ) < Real.sqrt 2 := by
      rw [show (1:ℝ) = Real.sqrt 1 by simp]
      exact Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have h2 : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := (Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)).mpr (by norm_num)
    unfold bgc; constructor <;> linarith
  have hJv : ∀ (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ), JpowL n (t • vtv) = (Tgc ^ n * t) • vtv := by
    intro n t
    have hD : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    simp only [JpowL, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', Jpow, vrv, vtv]
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.fst_add, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
      ring
    · simp only [Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.snd_add, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
      ring
  have hvtv : ‖vtv‖ = 1 := by
    unfold vtv
    rw [Prod.norm_mk, Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_one, abs_of_pos hbgc.1]
    exact max_eq_right hbgc.2.le
  have hTb : ∀ j : ℕ, Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h j) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (j:ℝ)) := by
    intro j
    unfold bandIdx
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with h0 | hpos
    · subst h0; simp
    · have hl1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (j:ℝ) ^ 2 := one_le_pow₀ (by exact_mod_cast hpos)
      have hA : 0 < (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (j:ℝ)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _
      have hAl : 0 < (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (j:ℝ)) / (j:ℝ) ^ 2 := div_pos hA (by linarith)
      rw [← Real.rpow_intCast]
      calc Tgc ^ ((⌊Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (j:ℝ)) / (j:ℝ) ^ 2)⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ)
          ≤ Tgc ^ (Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (j:ℝ)) / (j:ℝ) ^ 2)) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hTgc1.le (Int.floor_le _)
        _ = (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (j:ℝ)) / (j:ℝ) ^ 2 := Real.rpow_logb hTgc0 hTgc1.ne' hAl
        _ ≤ _ := div_le_self hA.le hl1
  refine ⟨lg + n0, fun l0 hl0 cw Ew α β hα hβ H1 H2 k => ?_⟩
  have hqs : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    show Qb l0 ≤ B.qB
    rw [hQbe]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0.le
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := le_trans hqs hqB1
  obtain ⟨hDo, hqCs, hqpos, -, -, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  choose Cw bw dw hW using H1.2.2.2.2
  choose Cp bp dp hPw using H2.2.2.2.2
  have hp1a : 0 < Aex B.h + 1 := by unfold Aex; linarith
  have hp1b : Aex B.h + 1 ≤ 2 := by unfold Aex; linarith
  choose K1 hK1 using qC_ratio_rpow_nb B hok (Aex B.h + 1) hp1a hp1b
  choose K2 hK2 using qC_ratio_rpow_nb B hok (1/2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  choose Cg bg hg using hgeo
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ⟩ : ∃ Λ : ℝ, Λ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), (|Cw i| + |Cp i|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨bE, hbE⟩ : ∃ bE : ℝ, bE = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), (|bw i| + |bp i|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨dE, hdE⟩ : ∃ dE : ℝ, dE = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), (|dw i| + |dp i|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Λg, hΛg⟩ : ∃ Λg : ℝ, Λg = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cg i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨bG, hbG⟩ : ∃ bG : ℝ, bG = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bg i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨R0, hR0⟩ : ∃ R0 : ℝ, R0 = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), 4 * (|K1 i| + |K2 i|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hab : ∀ (f g : ℕ → ℝ) (N i : ℕ), i < N →
      |f i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, (|f j| + |g j|) ∧ |g i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, (|f j| + |g j|) := by
    intro f g N i hi
    have h := hsum (fun j => |f j| + |g j|) N i (fun j => add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) hi
    exact ⟨le_trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (abs_nonneg _)) h,
      le_trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left (abs_nonneg _)) h⟩
  have hΛ0 : 0 ≤ Λ := by rw [hΛ]; exact hsum0 _ _ (fun j => add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _))
  have hΛg0 : 0 ≤ Λg := by rw [hΛg]; exact hsum0 _ _ (fun j => abs_nonneg _)
  have hbG0 : 0 ≤ bG := by rw [hbG]; exact hsum0 _ _ (fun j => abs_nonneg _)
  have hR00 : 0 ≤ R0 := by rw [hR0]; exact hsum0 _ _ (fun j => by positivity)
  refine ⟨8 ^ k * R0 * Λ * (1 + 7 * Λg + 12 * Λg ^ 2), bE + 2 * bG, dE, ?_⟩
  intro γ m ξ hξ hm hS hη hX1 hX2
  have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := hqpos ξ hξ
  have hq1 : qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 := le_trans hξ'.2.2.le hqs1
  obtain ⟨hρa, hρb⟩ := etaL_band_window_v5 B.h γ ξ hq0 hη
  have hQℓ := hQbpos γ.1

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (r1 r2 P : Cyl → ℂ) (Dv W : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (Km : Cyl → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (n : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (c0 : ℝ) (μ κ : ℂ) (k : ℕ) (R E M : ℝ), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ r1 U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ r2 U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Dv U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ W U → (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => Km η a b) U) → (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => n η a) U) → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB h r1 j ξ ≤ R ∧ NB h r2 j ξ ≤ R) → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB h Dv j ξ ≤ E ∧ NB h W j ξ ≤ E ∧ NB h P j ξ ≤ E) → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → (∀ a b : Fin 3, NB h (fun η => Km η a b) j ξ ≤ M) ∧ (∀ a : Fin 3, NB h (fun η => n η a) j ξ ≤ M)) → NB h (fun η => r1 η • (Dv η + (pulseMatC (Km η)).mulVec (W η) + (μ * ((c0 * dotProduct (n η) (n η) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • W η) + (r2 η * κ * P η) • (fun i => ((n η i : ℝ) : ℂ))) k ξ ≤ 8 ^ k * R * E * (1 + 3 * M + 3 * ‖μ‖ * |c0| * M ^ 2 + ‖κ‖ * M)

  ∀ (α : ℝ) (D : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α D → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α - kapS) (velRem5 B D) →
  InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α - kapS) (fun γ m ξ => dotProduct (wmoAmp5 B G D γ m ξ) (fun j => (nPhi5 B G γ ξ j : ℂ)))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨lp, hp⟩ := pulse_support_good_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lg, hg⟩ := good_nphi5_nb_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lb, hb⟩ := band_coarse_gap_v5 B.h hh0 hh1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  choose Cn hCn using hg
  refine ⟨lp + lg + lb + n0, fun l0 hl0 α D hD hVR => ?_⟩
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hq1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hQb]; exact pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0.le
  have hDO : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := (domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok).1
  have hDq : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < qC B.h ξ := (domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok).2.2.1
  
  have key : ∀ (α : ℝ) (ρ : Lab → Cyl → ℝ) (a : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a →
      (∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (ρ γ) ξ) →
      (∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) (c : ℝ × ℝ), ρ γ (shY ξ c) = ρ γ ξ) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 →
        qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 → NB B.h (ρ γ) k ξ ≤ C) →
      InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α
        (fun γ m ξ => dotProduct (fun i => ((ρ γ ξ * nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) (a γ m ξ)) := by
    intro α ρ a ha hρs hρY hρB
    have hsm : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) →
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ ((fun (γ : Lab) (_ : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) (i : Fin 3) =>
          ((ρ γ ξ * nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) γ m) ξ := by
      intro γ m ξ hξ hts
      obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hxi, het⟩ := hp l0 (by omega) α a ha γ m ξ hξ hts
      have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
      have hξB : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < B.qB :=
        ⟨hξ'.1, hξ'.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ'.2.2 hqsB⟩
      obtain ⟨U, hUo, hξU, -, hnU, -, -⟩ := good_coeff_smooth_v5 B G γ ξ hok hξB hxi het
      rw [contDiffAt_pi]
      intro i
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => ρ γ η * nPhi5 B G γ η i) ξ :=
        (hρs γ ξ hξ).mul ((hnU i).contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hξU))
      have h2 := (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff (n := ∞)).contDiffAt.comp ξ h1
      exact h2
    have hdk : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → ∀ c : ℝ × ℝ,
        IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c →
        (fun (γ : Lab) (_ : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) (i : Fin 3) => ((ρ γ ξ * nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) γ m (shY ξ c) =
        (fun (γ : Lab) (_ : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) (i : Fin 3) => ((ρ γ ξ * nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) γ m ξ := by
      intro γ m ξ hξ hne c hc
      have hts : ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) := subset_tsupport _ hne
      obtain ⟨-, -, -, hb1, hb2, -⟩ := hp l0 (by omega) α a ha γ m ξ hξ hts
      have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
      have hcb := (hb γ.1 l0 (qC B.h ξ) (by omega) (hDq ξ hξ) hξ'.2.2 hb1 hb2).1
      have hn := nPhi5_deck_v5 B G γ (coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) c hcb hc ξ
      funext i
      simp only [hρY γ ξ c, hn]
    have hnb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) →
        B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
        NB B.h ((fun (γ : Lab) (_ : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) (i : Fin 3) => ((ρ γ ξ * nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) γ m) k ξ
          ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * 0) * SC B.h ξ ^ b := by
      intro k
      choose Cr hCr using hρB
      refine ⟨3 * (2 ^ k * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cr j|) * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cn j|)), 1, ?_⟩
      intro γ m ξ hξ hts _ _
      obtain ⟨-, hact, hlγ, hb1, hb2, hX1', hX2', hxi, het⟩ := hp l0 (by omega) α a ha γ m ξ hξ hts
      have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
      have hξB : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < B.qB :=
        ⟨hξ'.1, hξ'.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ'.2.2 hqsB⟩
      obtain ⟨U, hUo, hξU, -, hnU, -, -⟩ := good_coeff_smooth_v5 B G γ ξ hok hξB hxi het
      have hSC0 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by unfold SC; positivity
      have hr : ∀ j, j ≤ k → NB B.h (ρ γ) j ξ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cr j| := by
        intro j hj
        refine le_trans (hCr j γ ξ hξ hb1 hb2) (le_trans (le_abs_self _) ?_)
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cr j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
      have hn : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j, j ≤ k → NB B.h (fun η => nPhi5 B G γ η i) j ξ ≤
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cn j|) * SC B.h ξ := by
        intro i j hj
        refine le_trans (hCn j l0 (by omega) γ hact hlγ ξ hξ hb1 hb2 hX1' hX2' hxi het i) ?_
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hSC0
        refine le_trans (le_abs_self _) ?_
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cn j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
      have hprod : ∀ i : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η => ρ γ η * nPhi5 B G γ η i) k ξ ≤
          2 ^ k * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cr j|) * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cn j|) * SC B.h ξ) :=
        fun i => nb_real_mul_le_v5 B.h ξ (ρ γ) (fun η => nPhi5 B G γ η i) k _ _ (hρs γ ξ hξ)
          ((hnU i).contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hξU)) hr (hn i)
      have hU' : IsOpen (U ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := hUo.inter hDO
      have hvec := nb_vec_complex_v5 B.h (U ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ξ 1
        (fun i η => ρ γ η * nPhi5 B G γ η i)
        (fun η i => ((ρ γ η * nPhi5 B G γ η i : ℝ) : ℂ)) hU' ⟨hξU, hξ⟩
        (fun i η hη => ((hρs γ η hη.2).contDiffWithinAt).mul ((hnU i).mono Set.inter_subset_left η hη))
        (fun η _ => by funext i; simp only [one_mul]) k
      rw [norm_one, one_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three] at hvec
      have e1 : qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * 0) = 1 := by rw [mul_zero, Real.rpow_zero]
      rw [e1, Real.rpow_one, mul_one]
      calc NB B.h (fun η i => ((ρ γ η * nPhi5 B G γ η i : ℝ) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤ _ := hvec
        _ ≤ 2 ^ k * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cr j|) * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cn j|) * SC B.h ξ)
            + 2 ^ k * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cr j|) * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cn j|) * SC B.h ξ)
            + 2 ^ k * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cr j|) * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cn j|) * SC B.h ξ) :=
          add_le_add (add_le_add (hprod 0) (hprod 1)) (hprod 2)
        _ = _ := by ring
    have hmain := inWg5_dot_mult B G l0 hok α 0 a
      (fun (γ : Lab) (_ : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) (i : Fin 3) => ((ρ γ ξ * nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) ha hsm hdk hnb
    rw [add_zero] at hmain
    exact hmain
  
  have hP1 := key (α - kapS) (fun γ ξ => (qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ)) _ hVR
    (fun γ ξ hξ => (rhoQ_rpow_nb_v5 B hok (1/2)).1 γ ξ hξ.2.1)
    (fun γ ξ c => rfl)
    (fun k => by
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (rhoQ_rpow_nb_v5 B hok (1/2)).2 k
      exact ⟨C, fun γ ξ hξ hb1 hb2 => hC γ ξ hξ.2.1 (hξ.2.2.le.trans hq1) hb1 hb2⟩)
  
  have hRot : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α (fun γ m ξ => rotC (D γ m ξ)) := by
    have e : (fun γ m ξ => rotC (D γ m ξ)) =
        (fun γ m ξ => crossC ((fun (_ : Lab) (_ : ℤ) (_ : Cyl) => (![0, 0, -1] : Fin 3 → ℂ)) γ m ξ)
          (D γ m ξ)) := by
      funext γ m ξ i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [crossC, rotC]
    have h := inWg5_cross_mult B G l0 hok α 0 D
      (fun (_ : Lab) (_ : ℤ) (_ : Cyl) => (![0, 0, -1] : Fin 3 → ℂ)) hD
      (fun _ _ _ _ _ => contDiffAt_const) (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl) (fun k => ⟨1, 0, fun γ m ξ _ _ _ _ => by
        simp only [mul_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
        show ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun _ : Cyl => (![0, 0, -1] : Fin 3 → ℂ)) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)‖ ≤ 1
        refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk | hk
        · subst hk
          rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Fin.prod_univ_zero, mul_one]
          refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg zero_le_one).mpr (fun i => ?_)
          fin_cases i <;> simp
        · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (by omega : k ≠ 0)]
          simp⟩)
    rw [add_zero] at h
    rw [e]
    exact h
  
  obtain ⟨hMs, hMb⟩ := wmo_amp_multipliers_v5 B hok (qsOf l0) hq1
  have hdZ : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (c : ℝ × ℝ), dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) (shY ξ c) =
      dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) ξ := by
    intro ξ c
    have e1 : shY ξ c = ξ + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), c) := by
      rcases ξ with ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4⟩
      simp [shY]
    have e2 : (fun x : Cyl => Real.log (qC B.h (x + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), c)))) =
        fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η) := by
      funext x
      simp [qC]
    unfold dZ
    rw [e1, ← fderiv_comp_add_right]
    exact congrArg (fun g => fderiv ℝ g ξ (0, 1, 0, 0)) e2
  have hP2 := key α (fun _ ξ => B.h * qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) ξ) _ hRot
    (fun γ ξ hξ => (hMs ξ hξ).2)
    (fun γ ξ c => by
      show B.h * qC B.h (shY ξ c) ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) (shY ξ c) = _
      rw [hdZ ξ c]
      rfl)
    (fun k => by
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hMb k
      exact ⟨C, fun γ ξ hξ _ _ => (hC ξ hξ).2⟩)
  
  have hsum := (@pq5_add_congr_class B G (qsOf l0) hok hq1 ℂ _ _).1 _ _ _ _ hP1 hP2
  have hk0 : (0:ℝ) < kapS := by
    show (0:ℝ) < 1 / 100000
    norm_num
  rw [min_eq_left (by linarith)] at hsum
  
  have efun : (fun γ m ξ => dotProduct (wmoAmp5 B G D γ m ξ) (fun j => (nPhi5 B G γ ξ j : ℂ))) =
      fun γ m ξ =>
        dotProduct (fun i => (((qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1) ^ (1/2:ℝ) * nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) (velRem5 B D γ m ξ) +
        dotProduct (fun i => ((B.h * qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) ξ *
          nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) (rotC (D γ m ξ)) := by
    funext γ m ξ
    simp only [wmoAmp5, velW5, velC5, velRem5, rotC, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons,
      Matrix.tail_cons, Complex.ofReal_mul]
    ring
  rw [efun]
  exact hsum

subgoal_signatures.name: inWg5_dot_mult
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ), B.ok → ∀ (α β : ℝ) (a : WC) (N : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → (∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (N γ m) ξ) → (∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → ∀ c : ℝ × ℝ, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c → N γ m (shY ξ c) = N γ m ξ) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) → B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (N γ m) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * β) * SC B.h ξ ^ b) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + β) (fun γ m ξ => dotProduct (N γ m ξ) (a γ m ξ))

subgoal_signatures.name: inWg5_cross_mult
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ), B.ok → ∀ (α β : ℝ) (a : WC)
    (N : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a →
    (∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (N γ m) ξ) →
    (∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → ∀ c : ℝ × ℝ, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c →
      N γ m (shY ξ c) = N γ m ξ) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) →
      B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (N γ m) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * β) * SC B.h ξ ^ b) →
    InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + β) (fun γ m ξ => crossC (N γ m ξ) (a γ m ξ))

subgoal_signatures.name: pulse_support_good_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (α : ℝ) (a : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → V), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) → SuppW B G γ ξ ∧ ActiveL4 B G γ ∧ l0 ≤ γ.1 ∧ 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 ∧ qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 ∧ B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb ∧ |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 ∧ |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8

subgoal_signatures.name: good_nphi5_nb_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (l0 : ℕ), l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (γ : Lab), ActiveL4 B G γ → l0 ≤ γ.1 → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 → qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 → B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb → |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 → |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 → ∀ i : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ η i) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ

subgoal_signatures.name: good_coeff_smooth_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), B.ok → ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 → |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 → ∃ U : Set Cyl, IsOpen U ∧ ξ ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ DomC B.h B.qB ∧ (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ η i) U) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => nPhiP5 B G γ η i) U) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Kmat B G γ η i j) U)

subgoal_signatures.name: band_coarse_gap_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h < 1/100 → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ (l l0 : ℕ) (q : ℝ), l1 ≤ l0 → 0 < q → q < qsOf l0 → 1/4 < q / Qb l → q / Qb l < 4 → coarseIdx h q ≤ bandIdx h l ∧ bandIdx h l ≤ coarseIdx h q + 3

subgoal_signatures.name: nPhi5_deck_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (n0 : ℤ) (c : ℝ × ℝ), n0 ≤ bandIdx B.h γ.1 → (∃ a b : ℤ, Jpow n0 c = ((a : ℝ), (b : ℝ))) → ∀ ξ : Cyl, nPhi5 B G γ (shY ξ c) = nPhi5 B G γ ξ

subgoal_signatures.name: nb_vec_complex_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (c : ℂ) (f : Fin 3 → Cyl → ℝ) (F : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f i) U) → (∀ η ∈ U, F η = fun i => c * ((f i η : ℝ) : ℂ)) → ∀ k : ℕ, NB h F k ξ ≤ ‖c‖ * ∑ i : Fin 3, NB h (f i) k ξ

subgoal_signatures.name: nb_real_mul_le_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (a b : Cyl → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (A E : ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ a ξ → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ b ξ → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h a i ξ ≤ A) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h b i ξ ≤ E) → NB h (fun η => a η * b η) k ξ ≤ 2 ^ k * A * E

subgoal_signatures.name: rhoQ_rpow_nb_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∀ (p : ℝ), (∀ (γ : Lab) (η : Cyl), η.2.2.1 < 1 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : Cyl => rhoQ B γ ζ ^ p) η) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 → 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 → qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 → NB B.h (fun ζ : Cyl => rhoQ B γ ζ ^ p) k ξ ≤ C

subgoal_signatures.name: wmo_amp_multipliers_v5

signature.name: psi5_state_fields_smooth
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (α1 α2 β1 β2 : ℝ) (Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α1 S.Aw → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α2 S.pw → InM B (qsOf l0) β1 S.Psi → InM B (qsOf l0) β2 S.bdir → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pmP5 B G l0 S) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2}

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 S α1 α2 β1 β2 Y₀ hok hG hqsB hAw hpw hPsi hbdir hpm
  obtain ⟨hΩo, hΨ, hQs, hrad, heR, heTh⟩ := corr_domain_v5 B l0 Y₀ hok
  set Ω : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ) := {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} with hΩdef
  set Ψ : ℝ³ × ℝ → Cyl := fun w => ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + Y₀) with hΨdef
  have hSP : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  have hBP := hok.2
  unfold BackgroundProps at hBP
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, ⟨hABs, hBvBs, hPBs⟩, -, -⟩ := hBP
  have hΩmem : ∀ w ∈ Ω, corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2 := fun w hw => hw
  have hΩsub : Ω ⊆ simDomain B.h B.qB := fun w hw =>
    ⟨(hΩmem w hw).2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le (hΩmem w hw).2.2 hqsB⟩
  have hΨmaps : MapsTo Ψ Ω (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := fun w hw => hw
  have hQpos : ∀ w ∈ Ω, 0 < simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) := fun w hw =>
    (hSP.1 (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) (by linarith [(hΩmem w hw).2.1])).1
  have hQΩ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) Ω :=
    hQs.mono (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).2.1)
  have hQp : ∀ p : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ p) Ω :=
    fun p => hQΩ.rpow_const_of_ne (fun w hw => (hQpos w hw).ne')
  have heRΩ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => eR w.1) Ω :=
    heR.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).1)
  have heThΩ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => eTh w.1) Ω :=
    heTh.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).1)
  have hbase : ∀ (l : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => baseC B l ξ i) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro l i
    have h1 := (geom_slow_base_smooth_v5 B hok).2 l i
    have hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      contDiff_fst.prodMk ((contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_snd).prodMk
        (contDiff_fst.comp (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd)))
    have hmaps : MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h3 : qC B.h ξ < B.qB := lt_of_lt_of_le hξ.2.2 hqsB
      exact ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, h3⟩
    have hcomp := h1.comp hp.contDiffOn hmaps
    refine hcomp.congr (fun ξ _ => ?_)
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, baseC]
  have hwave : ∀ a : WS, (∃ H : Finset ℤ, ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → a γ m = 0) →
      (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (a γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) →
      (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => waveS5 B G a (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w)) Ω := by
    intro a hHa ha hsupp
    obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ := hHa
    have hfac : ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, waveS5 B G a (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) =
        (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, a γ m (Ψ w) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) *
          ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ (Ψ w) : ℂ))) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ))).re := by
      intro w
      unfold waveS5
      congr 1
      refine finsum_congr (fun γ => finsum_congr (fun m => ?_))
      unfold ephase5
      have key : Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((pint5 B G γ : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ) +
          (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ (Ψ w) : ℂ)) =
          Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ (Ψ w) : ℂ)) +
          Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ) := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [key, Complex.exp_add]
      ring
    refine (wave_sum_assembly Ω (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) Ψ
      (fun γ m ξ => a γ m ξ * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))
      (fun γ m => m * pint5 B G γ) H hΩo (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).1) hΨ hΨmaps ?_ ?_
      (fun γ m => wave_coef_phase_smooth_v5 B G (qsOf l0) a hG hbase ha hsupp γ m)).congr
      (fun w _ => hfac w)
    · intro γ m hm ξ _
      simp [hH γ m hm]
    · intro ξ₀ hξ₀
      obtain ⟨U, hU, hξU, T, hT⟩ := etaL_locfin B.h (qsOf l0) hSP ξ₀ hξ₀
      refine ⟨U, hU, hξU, T, fun γ hγ m ξ hξ => ?_⟩
      by_contra hne
      have ha0 : a γ m ξ ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hne (by simp [h0])
      exact hT γ hγ ξ hξ.1 (hsupp γ m ξ hξ.2 ha0).2.1
  obtain ⟨HA, -, hHA⟩ := hAw.1
  have hW : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => waveS5 B G (fun γ m ξ => S.Aw γ m ξ i) (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w)) Ω := by
    intro i
    refine hwave (fun γ m ξ => S.Aw γ m ξ i) ⟨HA, fun γ m hm => ?_⟩
      (fun γ m => contDiffOn_pi.mp (hAw.2.1 γ m) i) (fun γ m ξ hξ hne => ?_)
    · funext ξ
      simp [hHA γ m hm]
    · exact hAw.2.2.2.1 γ m ξ hξ (fun h0 => hne (by simp [h0]))
  obtain ⟨HP, -, hHP⟩ := hpw.1
  have hWp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => waveS5 B G S.pw (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w)) Ω :=
    hwave S.pw ⟨HP, hHP⟩ hpw.2.1 hpw.2.2.2.1
  have hAeq : ∀ w ∈ Ω, (↿(evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) w = B.AB w.1 w.2 +
      simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h) •
        (waveS5 B G (fun γ m ξ => S.Aw γ m ξ 0) (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) • eR w.1 +
         waveS5 B G (fun γ m ξ => S.Aw γ m ξ 1) (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) • eTh w.1 +
         waveS5 B G (fun γ m ξ => S.Aw γ m ξ 2) (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) • eZ +
         S.Psi (Ψ w) • eTh w.1) := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' : corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2 := hw
    change B.AB w.1 w.2 + _ = _
    rw [if_pos hw']
    all_goals rfl
  have hBeq : ∀ w ∈ Ω, (↿(evOff B.h (BX B G l0 S) Y₀)) w = B.BvB w.1 w.2 +
      (simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-Aex B.h) * S.bdir (Ψ w)) • eTh w.1 := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' : corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2 := hw
    change B.BvB w.1 w.2 + _ = _
    rw [if_pos hw']
    all_goals rfl
  have hPeq : ∀ w ∈ Ω, (↿(evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) w = B.PB w.1 w.2 +
      (pmP5 B G l0 S (Ψ w) +
       simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-2 * Aex B.h) * waveS5 B G S.pw (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w)) := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' : corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2 := hw
    change B.PB w.1 w.2 + _ = _
    rw [if_pos hw']
    all_goals rfl
  have hAsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) Ω :=
    ContDiffOn.congr ((hABs.mono hΩsub).add ((hQp (1/2 - Aex B.h)).smul
      (((((hW 0).smul heRΩ).add ((hW 1).smul heThΩ)).add ((hW 2).smul (contDiffOn_const (c := eZ)))).add
        ((hPsi.1.comp hΨ hΨmaps).smul heThΩ)))) hAeq
  have hBsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (BX B G l0 S) Y₀)) Ω :=
    ContDiffOn.congr ((hBvBs.mono hΩsub).add
      (((hQp (-Aex B.h)).mul (hbdir.1.comp hΨ hΨmaps)).smul heThΩ)) hBeq
  have hPsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) Ω :=
    ContDiffOn.congr ((hPBs.mono hΩsub).add ((hpm.comp hΨ hΨmaps).add
      ((hQp (-2 * Aex B.h)).mul hWp))) hPeq
  have hUeq : evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y₀ = fun y s =>
      curl3 (fun w => evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) Y₀ w s) y + evOff B.h (BX B G l0 S) Y₀ y s := by
    funext y s
    simp only [evOff, uX5, curlX, add_sub_cancel_left]
  refine ⟨hAsm, ?_, hPsm⟩
  rw [hUeq]
  exact (curl_field_contDiffOn_bounded _ _ Ω Ω hΩo subset_rfl hAsm hBsm).1

  have hΨmaps : MapsTo Ψ Ω (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := fun w hw => hw
  have hQpos : ∀ w ∈ Ω, 0 < simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) := fun w hw =>
    (hSP.1 (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) (by linarith [(hΩmem w hw).2.1])).1
  have hQΩ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) Ω :=
    hQs.mono (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).2.1)
  have hQp : ∀ p : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ p) Ω :=
    fun p => hQΩ.rpow_const_of_ne (fun w hw => (hQpos w hw).ne')
  have heRΩ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => eR w.1) Ω :=
    heR.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).1)
  have heThΩ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => eTh w.1) Ω :=
    heTh.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).1)
  have hbase : ∀ (l : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => baseC B l ξ i) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro l i
    have h1 := (geom_slow_base_smooth_v5 B hok).2 l i
    have hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      contDiff_fst.prodMk ((contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_snd).prodMk
        (contDiff_fst.comp (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd)))
    have hmaps : MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h3 : qC B.h ξ < B.qB := lt_of_lt_of_le hξ.2.2 hqsB
      exact ⟨hξ.1, hξ.2.1, h3⟩
    have hcomp := h1.comp hp.contDiffOn hmaps
    refine hcomp.congr (fun ξ _ => ?_)
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, baseC]
  have hwave : ∀ a : WS, (∃ H : Finset ℤ, ∀ γ m, m ∉ H → a γ m = 0) →
      (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (a γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) →
      (∀ γ m ξ, ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → SuppW B G γ ξ) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => waveS5 B G a (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w)) Ω := by
    intro a hHa ha hsupp
    obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ := hHa
    have hfac : ∀ w : ℝ³ × ℝ, waveS5 B G a (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) =
        (∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, a γ m (Ψ w) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) *
          ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ (Ψ w) : ℂ))) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ))).re := by
      intro w
      unfold waveS5
      congr 1
      refine finsum_congr (fun γ => finsum_congr (fun m => ?_))
      unfold ephase5
      have key : Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((pint5 B G γ : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ) +
          (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ (Ψ w) : ℂ)) =
          Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ (Ψ w) : ℂ)) +
          Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ) := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [key, Complex.exp_add]
      ring
    refine (wave_sum_assembly Ω (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) Ψ
      (fun γ m ξ => a γ m ξ * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))))
      (fun γ m => m * pint5 B G γ) H hΩo (fun w hw => (hΩmem w hw).1) hΨ hΨmaps ?_ ?_
      (fun γ m => wave_coef_phase_smooth_v5 B G (qsOf l0) a hG hbase ha hsupp γ m)).congr
      (fun w _ => hfac w)
    · intro γ m hm ξ _
      simp [hH γ m hm]
    · intro ξ₀ hξ₀
      obtain ⟨U, hU, hξU, T, hT⟩ := etaL_locfin B.h (qsOf l0) hSP ξ₀ hξ₀
      refine ⟨U, hU, hξU, T, fun γ hγ m ξ hξ => ?_⟩
      by_contra hne
      have ha0 : a γ m ξ ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hne (by simp [h0])
      exact hT γ hγ ξ hξ.1 (hsupp γ m ξ hξ.2 ha0).2.1
  obtain ⟨HA, -, hHA⟩ := hD.1
  have hW : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => waveS5 B G (fun γ m ξ => D γ m ξ i) (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w)) Ω := by
    intro i
    refine hwave (fun γ m ξ => D γ m ξ i) ⟨HA, fun γ m hm => ?_⟩
      (fun γ m => contDiffOn_pi.mp (hD.2.1 γ m) i) (fun γ m ξ hξ hne => ?_)
    · funext ξ
      simp [hHA γ m hm]
    · exact hD.2.2.2.1 γ m ξ hξ (fun h0 => hne (by simp [h0]))
  obtain ⟨HP, -, hHP⟩ := hE.1
  have hWp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => waveS5 B G E (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w)) Ω :=
    hwave E ⟨HP, hHP⟩ hE.2.1 hE.2.2.2.1
  
  have hAeq : ∀ w ∈ Ω, (↿(evOff B.h (AincX5 B G l0 D) Y₀)) w =
      simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h) •
        (waveS5 B G (fun γ m ξ => D γ m ξ 0) (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) • eR w.1 +
         waveS5 B G (fun γ m ξ => D γ m ξ 1) (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) • eTh w.1 +
         waveS5 B G (fun γ m ξ => D γ m ξ 2) (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) • eZ) := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' : corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2 := hw
    show AincX5 B G l0 D w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + Y₀) = _
    unfold AincX5
    rw [if_pos hw']
    rfl
  have hAsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (AincX5 B G l0 D) Y₀)) Ω :=
    ContDiffOn.congr ((hQp (1/2 - Aex B.h)).smul
      ((((hW 0).smul heRΩ).add ((hW 1).smul heThΩ)).add ((hW 2).smul (contDiffOn_const (c := eZ))))) hAeq
  
  have hWeq : evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) Y₀ = fun y s =>
      curl3 (fun w => evOff B.h (AincX5 B G l0 D) Y₀ w s) y + (fun (_ : ℝ³) (_ : ℝ) => (0:ℝ³)) y s := by
    funext y s
    simp only [evOff, wIncX5, curlX, add_sub_cancel_left, add_zero]
  have h0sm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(fun (_ : ℝ³) (_ : ℝ) => (0:ℝ³))) Ω :=
    (contDiffOn_const (c := (0:ℝ³))).congr (fun _ _ => rfl)
  have hWsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) Y₀)) Ω := by
    rw [hWeq]
    exact (curl_field_contDiffOn_bounded _ _ Ω Ω hΩo subset_rfl hAsm h0sm).1
  
  have hPeq : ∀ w ∈ Ω, (↿(evOff B.h (pwIncX5 B G l0 E) Y₀)) w =
      simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ^ (-2 * Aex B.h) *
        waveS5 B G E (thetaOf w.1) (Ψ w) := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' : corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2 := hw
    show pwIncX5 B G l0 E w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + Y₀) = _
    unfold pwIncX5
    rw [if_pos hw']
    rfl
  have hPsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (pwIncX5 B G l0 E) Y₀)) Ω :=
    ContDiffOn.congr ((hQp (-2 * Aex B.h)).mul hWp) hPeq
  exact ⟨hAsm, hWsm, hPsm⟩
