informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (D : WC) (E : WS), IsOpen {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2} → (∀ (u₁ u₂ : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p₁ p₂ : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)), IsOpen O → (∀ z ∈ O, (↿u₁) z = (↿u₂) z) → (∀ z ∈ O, (↿p₁) z = (↿p₂) z) → ∀ z ∈ O, (↿(nsResidual 1 u₁ p₁)) z = (↿(nsResidual 1 u₂ p₂)) z) → (∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2}) → (∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2}) → (∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2}) → (∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (AincX5 B G l0 D) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2}) → (∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2}) → (∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (pwIncX5 B G l0 E) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2}) → (∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), corrOn B l0 x t → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => uB B y t) x) → (∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), AX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) x t Y = AX5 B G l0 S x t Y + AincX5 B G l0 D x t Y) → (∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), corrOn B l0 x t → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) - PX5 B G l0 S y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) - pwIncX5 B G l0 E y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t))) x) → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E)) (PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E)) x t Y = resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (PX5 B G l0 S) x t Y + LinT5 B G l0 D E x t Y + CrT5 B G l0 S D x t Y + SfT5 B G l0 D x t Y + gradient (fun y => PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) - PX5 B G l0 S y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) - pwIncX5 B G l0 E y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t))) x

signature.name: psi5_pointwise_split
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (D : WC) (E : WS), IsOpen {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2} → (∀ (u₁ u₂ : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p₁ p₂ : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)), IsOpen O → (∀ z ∈ O, (↿u₁) z = (↿u₂) z) → (∀ z ∈ O, (↿p₁) z = (↿p₂) z) → ∀ z ∈ O, (↿(nsResidual 1 u₁ p₁)) z = (↿(nsResidual 1 u₂ p₂)) z) → (∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2}) → (∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2}) → (∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2}) → (∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (AincX5 B G l0 D) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2}) → (∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2}) → (∀ Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(evOff B.h (pwIncX5 B G l0 E) Y₀)) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2}) → (∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ), corrOn B l0 x t → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => uB B y t) x) → (∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), AX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) x t Y = AX5 B G l0 S x t Y + AincX5 B G l0 D x t Y) → (∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), corrOn B l0 x t → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) - PX5 B G l0 S y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) - pwIncX5 B G l0 E y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t))) x) → ∀ x t Y, corrOn B l0 x t → resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E)) (PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E)) x t Y = resX B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (PX5 B G l0 S) x t Y + LinT5 B G l0 D E x t Y + CrT5 B G l0 S D x t Y + SfT5 B G l0 D x t Y + gradient (fun y => PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) - PX5 B G l0 S y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) - pwIncX5 B G l0 E y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t))) x

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  intro B G l0 S D E hCO hloc hA hU hP hAi hW hPi huBd hAadd hMd x t Y hxt
  have hxC : ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2} := hxt
  
  have hsl : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : ℝ³ → ℝ → F)
      (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) O → (y, s) ∈ O →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => f w s) y := by
    intro F _ _ f O y s hO hf hys
    exact ((hf.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hys)).comp y
      ((contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have hcurl_add : ∀ (F₁ F₂ : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (y : ℝ³), DifferentiableAt ℝ F₁ y →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F₂ y → curl3 (fun w => F₁ w + F₂ w) y = curl3 F₁ y + curl3 F₂ y := by
    intro F₁ F₂ y h1 h2
    unfold curl3
    rw [fderiv_fun_add h1 h2]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, PiLp.add_apply, add_sub_add_comm, add_smul]
    abel
  
  have hexp : ∀ (u w : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p π₁ π₂ : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (↿u) (x, t) →
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (↿w) (x, t) → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => p y t) x →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => π₁ y t) x → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => π₂ y t) x →
      nsResidual 1 (fun y s => u y s + w y s) (fun y s => p y s + π₁ y s + π₂ y s) x t =
        nsResidual 1 u p x t + nsResidual 1 w π₁ x t + gradient (fun y => π₂ y t) x +
          fderiv ℝ (fun y => w y t) x (u x t) + fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) x (w x t) := by
    intro u w p π₁ π₂ hu hw hp h1 h2
    have hus : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun y => u y t) x :=
      hu.comp x ((contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt)
    have hws : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun y => w y t) x :=
      hw.comp x ((contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt)
    have hut : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s => u x s) t :=
      (hu.comp t ((contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id).contDiffAt)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hwt : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s => w x s) t :=
      (hw.comp t ((contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id).contDiffAt)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hud : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => u y t) x := hus.differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hwd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => w y t) x := hws.differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hL : Δ (fun y => u y t + w y t) x = Δ (fun y => u y t) x + Δ (fun y => w y t) x :=
      hus.laplacian_add hws
    have hG : gradient (fun y => p y t + π₁ y t + π₂ y t) x =
        gradient (fun y => p y t) x + gradient (fun y => π₁ y t) x + gradient (fun y => π₂ y t) x := by
      simp only [gradient, fderiv_fun_add (hp.fun_add h1) h2, fderiv_fun_add hp h1, map_add]
    simp only [nsResidual]
    rw [deriv_fun_add hut hwt, fderiv_fun_add hud hwd, hL, hG]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, map_add, smul_add]
    abel
  
  show nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E)) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t))
      (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E)) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) x t =
    nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t))
      (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) x t +
    (nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t))
        (evOff B.h (pwIncX5 B G l0 E) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) x t
      - fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y t) x
          (evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) x t)
      + fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y t) x (uB B x t)
      + fderiv ℝ (fun y => uB B y t) x (evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) x t)) +
    (fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y t) x
        (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) x t - uB B x t)
      + fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y t - uB B y t) x
        (evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) x t)) +
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) y t) x
      (evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t) x t) +
    gradient (fun y => PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t))
      - PX5 B G l0 S y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t))
      - pwIncX5 B G l0 E y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t))) x
  have hMx := hMd x t Y hxt
  obtain ⟨Y', hY'⟩ : ∃ Y' : ℝ × ℝ, Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t = Y' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [hY']
  rw [hY'] at hMx
  
  have hUs : ∀ z ∈ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2},
      (↿(evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E)) Y')) z =
        (↿(fun y s => evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y' y s + evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) Y' y s)) z := by
    rintro ⟨y, s⟩ hz
    have hd1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) Y' w s) y :=
      hsl _ _ y s hCO (hA Y') hz
    have hd2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => evOff B.h (AincX5 B G l0 D) Y' w s) y :=
      hsl _ _ y s hCO (hAi Y') hz
    have e1 : evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E)) Y' y s =
        curl3 (fun w => AX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) w s (Yph B.h (rad w) s + Y')) y +
          BX B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y') := by
      show curl3 (fun w => AX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) w s
          (Yph B.h (rad w) s + (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y' - Yph B.h (rad y) s))) y +
          BX B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y') = _
      rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
    have e1S : evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y' y s =
        curl3 (fun w => evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) Y' w s) y +
          BX B G l0 S y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y') := by
      show curl3 (fun w => AX5 B G l0 S w s
          (Yph B.h (rad w) s + (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y' - Yph B.h (rad y) s))) y +
          BX B G l0 S y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y') = _
      rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
      rfl
    have e2 : evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) Y' y s =
        curl3 (fun w => evOff B.h (AincX5 B G l0 D) Y' w s) y := by
      show curl3 (fun w => AincX5 B G l0 D w s
          (Yph B.h (rad w) s + (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y' - Yph B.h (rad y) s))) y = _
      rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
      rfl
    have hfA : (fun w => AX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) w s (Yph B.h (rad w) s + Y')) =
        fun w => evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) Y' w s + evOff B.h (AincX5 B G l0 D) Y' w s := by
      funext w
      exact hAadd w s _
    have hcA : curl3 (fun w => evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) Y' w s + evOff B.h (AincX5 B G l0 D) Y' w s) y =
        curl3 (fun w => evOff B.h (AX5 B G l0 S) Y' w s) y +
          curl3 (fun w => evOff B.h (AincX5 B G l0 D) Y' w s) y :=
      hcurl_add _ _ y hd1 hd2
    have hBX : BX B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y') =
        BX B G l0 S y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y') := rfl
    show evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E)) Y' y s =
      evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y' y s + evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) Y' y s
    rw [e1, e1S, e2, hfA, hcA, hBX]
    abel
  
  have hPr : ∀ z ∈ {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 w.1 w.2},
      (↿(evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E)) Y')) z =
        (↿(fun y s => evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y' y s + evOff B.h (pwIncX5 B G l0 E) Y' y s +
          (PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')
            - PX5 B G l0 S y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')
            - pwIncX5 B G l0 E y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')))) z := by
    rintro ⟨y, s⟩ _
    show PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y') =
      PX5 B G l0 S y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y') + pwIncX5 B G l0 E y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y') +
        (PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')
          - PX5 B G l0 S y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')
          - pwIncX5 B G l0 E y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y'))
    ring
  have hL0 := hloc _ _ _ _ _ hCO hUs hPr (x, t) hxC
  have hL1 : nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E)) Y')
      (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E)) Y') x t =
      nsResidual 1 (fun y s => evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y' y s + evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) Y' y s)
        (fun y s => evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y' y s + evOff B.h (pwIncX5 B G l0 E) Y' y s +
          (PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')
            - PX5 B G l0 S y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')
            - pwIncX5 B G l0 E y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y'))) x t := hL0
  
  have hu2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (↿(evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y')) (x, t) :=
    ((hU Y').contDiffAt (hCO.mem_nhds hxC)).of_le (by norm_num)
  have hw2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (↿(evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) Y')) (x, t) :=
    ((hW Y').contDiffAt (hCO.mem_nhds hxC)).of_le (by norm_num)
  have hp1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y' y t) x :=
    hsl _ _ x t hCO (hP Y') hxC
  have hp2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (pwIncX5 B G l0 E) Y' y t) x :=
    hsl _ _ x t hCO (hPi Y') hxC
  have hE : nsResidual 1 (fun y s => evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y' y s + evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) Y' y s)
      (fun y s => evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y' y s + evOff B.h (pwIncX5 B G l0 E) Y' y s +
          (PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')
            - PX5 B G l0 S y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')
            - pwIncX5 B G l0 E y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y'))) x t =
      nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y') (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y') x t +
        nsResidual 1 (evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) Y') (evOff B.h (pwIncX5 B G l0 E) Y') x t +
        gradient (fun y => PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')
          - PX5 B G l0 S y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')
          - pwIncX5 B G l0 E y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y')) x +
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) Y' y t) x (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y' x t) +
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y' y t) x (evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) Y' x t) :=
    hexp (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y') (evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) Y') (evOff B.h (PX5 B G l0 S) Y')
      (evOff B.h (pwIncX5 B G l0 E) Y')
      (fun y s => PX5 B G l0 (waveAdd S D E) y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')
        - PX5 B G l0 S y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')
        - pwIncX5 B G l0 E y s (Yph B.h (rad y) s + Y')) hu2 hw2 hp1 hp2 hMx
  
  have hUd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y' y t) x :=
    hsl _ _ x t hCO (hU Y') hxC
  have hBd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => uB B y t) x := huBd x t hxt
  have hC1 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y' y t - uB B y t) x =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y' y t) x - fderiv ℝ (fun y => uB B y t) x :=
    fderiv_fun_sub hUd hBd
  have hC2 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) Y' y t) x
      (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y' x t - uB B x t) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) Y' y t) x (evOff B.h (uX5 B G l0 S) Y' x t) -
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => evOff B.h (wIncX5 B G l0 D) Y' y t) x (uB B x t) := map_sub _ _ _
  rw [hL1, hE, hC1, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, hC2]
  abel

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (l0 : ℕ) (g : Cyl → ℝ) (Mf : Ext ℝ), B.ok → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), DifferentiableAt ℝ g ξ) → (∀ (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ) (Y'' : ℝ × ℝ), corrOn B l0 y s → Mf y s Y'' = g (ptOf y s Y'')) → (∀ (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ) (Y'' : ℝ × ℝ), ¬ corrOn B l0 y s → Mf y s Y'' = 0) → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), corrOn B l0 x t → ∃ c0 c2 : ℝ, ∀ y : ℝ³, rad y = rad x → y 2 = x 2 → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => Mf w t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad y) t))) y ∧ gradient (fun w => Mf w t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad y) t))) y = c0 • eR y + c2 • eZ

signature.name: psi5_pm_grad_frame
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (l0 : ℕ) (g : Cyl → ℝ) (Mf : Ext ℝ), B.ok → (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), DifferentiableAt ℝ g ξ) → (∀ (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ) (Y'' : ℝ × ℝ), corrOn B l0 y s → Mf y s Y'' = g (ptOf y s Y'')) → (∀ (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ) (Y'' : ℝ × ℝ), ¬ corrOn B l0 y s → Mf y s Y'' = 0) → ∀ (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), corrOn B l0 x t → ∃ c0 c2 : ℝ, ∀ y : ℝ³, rad y = rad x → y 2 = x 2 → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => Mf w t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad y) t))) y ∧ gradient (fun w => Mf w t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad y) t))) y = c0 • eR y + c2 • eZ

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  intro B l0 g Mf hok hg hon hoff x t Y hxt
  obtain ⟨hr, ht, hs⟩ := hxt
  
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦdef⟩ : ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ a b, Φ a b =
      if (0 < a ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h b (1 - t) < qsOf l0) then
        g (a, b, t, Yph B.h a t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) else 0 :=
    ⟨fun a b => if (0 < a ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h b (1 - t) < qsOf l0) then
        g (a, b, t, Yph B.h a t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) else 0,
      fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  
  obtain ⟨κ, hκdef⟩ : ∃ κ : ℝ × ℝ → Cyl,
      κ = fun p => (p.1, p.2, t, Yph B.h p.1 t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hκd : DifferentiableAt ℝ κ (rad x, x 2) := by
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 ^ drx B.h) (rad x, x 2) :=
      differentiableAt_fst.rpow_const (Or.inl hr.ne')
    have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Yph B.h p.1 t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad x) t))
        (rad x, x 2) := by
      unfold Yph
      exact ((h1.smul_const vrv).add_const _).add_const _
    rw [hκdef]
    exact differentiableAt_fst.prodMk (differentiableAt_snd.prodMk
      ((differentiableAt_const t).prodMk h2))
  have hmem : κ (rad x, x 2) ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := by
    rw [hκdef]
    show 0 < rad x ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0
    exact ⟨hr, ht, hs⟩
  have hcompd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (g ∘ κ) (rad x, x 2) :=
    (hg _ hmem).comp _ hκd
  have hcont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h p.2 (1 - t)) := by
    have := hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.comp_continuous (f := fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.2, 1 - t))
      (by fun_prop) (fun p => ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - t by linarith⟩)
    exact this
  have hU : IsOpen ({p : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < p.1} ∩ {p : ℝ × ℝ | simScale B.h p.2 (1 - t) < qsOf l0}) :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).inter (isOpen_lt hcont continuous_const)
  have hΦd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Φ p.1 p.2) (rad x, x 2) := by
    refine hcompd.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    have hin : ((rad x, x 2) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ ({p : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < p.1} ∩
        {p : ℝ × ℝ | simScale B.h p.2 (1 - t) < qsOf l0}) := ⟨hr, hs⟩
    filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hin] with p hp
    obtain ⟨hp1, hp2⟩ := hp
    have hp1' : 0 < p.1 := hp1
    have hp2' : simScale B.h p.2 (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hp2
    rw [hΦdef, if_pos ⟨hp1', ht, hp2'⟩, hκdef]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ,
      L = fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Φ p.1 p.2) (rad x, x 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hlin : ∀ a b : ℝ, L (a, b) = a * L (1, 0) + b * L (0, 1) := by
    intro a b
    have e : ((a, b) : ℝ × ℝ) = a • ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) + b • ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) := by
      ext <;> simp
    rw [e, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  refine ⟨L (1, 0), L (0, 1), fun y hy hz => ?_⟩
  have hry : 0 < rad y := by rw [hy]; exact hr
  
  have hfun : (fun w => Mf w t (Yph B.h (rad w) t + (Y - Yph B.h (rad y) t))) =
      fun w => Φ (rad w) (w 2) := by
    funext w
    rw [hy, hΦdef]
    by_cases hc : corrOn B l0 w t
    · have hc' : 0 < rad w ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (w 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hc
      rw [if_pos hc', hon w t _ hc]
      rfl
    · have hc' : ¬ (0 < rad w ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (w 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0) := hc
      rw [if_neg hc', hoff w t _ hc]
  
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ, D = (rad y)⁻¹ •
      ((y 0) • (EuclideanSpace.proj (0:Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
        + (y 1) • (EuclideanSpace.proj (1:Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD : HasFDerivAt rad D y := by
    have hpos : 0 < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.mp hry
    have h0 := ((EuclideanSpace.proj (0:Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt (x := y)).pow 2
    have h1 := ((EuclideanSpace.proj (1:Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt (x := y)).pow 2
    have hsq := (h0.add h1).sqrt (by exact hpos.ne')
    refine hsq.congr_fderiv ?_
    rw [hDdef]
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
    have hp : ∀ i, (EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) v = v i := fun i => rfl
    have hq : ∀ i, (EuclideanSpace.proj i : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) y = y i := fun i => rfl
    have hr2 : Real.sqrt (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) = rad y := rfl
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, smul_eq_mul, hp, hq,
      Pi.add_apply, hr2]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hψ : HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ³ => (rad w, w 2))
      (D.prod (EuclideanSpace.proj (2:Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ)) y :=
    hD.prodMk ((EuclideanSpace.proj (2:Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt (x := y))
  have hpt : ((rad y, y 2) : ℝ × ℝ) = (rad x, x 2) := by rw [hy, hz]
  have hL : HasFDerivAt (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Φ p.1 p.2) L (rad y, y 2) := by
    rw [hpt, hLdef]
    exact hΦd.hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp := hL.comp y hψ
  have hF : HasFDerivAt (fun w => Φ (rad w) (w 2))
      (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ ℝ³ (L (1, 0) • eR y + L (0, 1) • eZ)) y := by
    refine hcomp.congr_fderiv ?_
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
    rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply]
    have hDv : D v = (rad y)⁻¹ * (y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1) := by rw [hDdef]; rfl
    have hP2 : (EuclideanSpace.proj (2:Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ) v = v 2 := rfl
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply, hDv, hP2, hlin]
    unfold eR radVec eZ
    simp only [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, map_one,
      one_mul]
    ring
  rw [hfun]
  refine ⟨hF.differentiableAt, ?_⟩
  exact (hasGradientAt_iff_hasFDerivAt.mpr hF).gradient

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (v D : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (q : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen O → (∀ (α : ℝ) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), (y, s) ∈ O → (rotZ α y, s) ∈ O) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿v) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿D) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿q) O → (∀ (α : ℝ) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), (y, s) ∈ O → v (rotZ α y) s = rotZ α (v y s)) → (∀ (α : ℝ) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), (y, s) ∈ O → D (rotZ α y) s = rotZ α (D y s)) → (∀ (α : ℝ) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), (y, s) ∈ O → q (rotZ α y) s = q y s) → ∀ (α : ℝ) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), (y, s) ∈ O → nsResidual 1 D q (rotZ α y) s + fderiv ℝ (fun w => v w s) (rotZ α y) (D (rotZ α y) s) + fderiv ℝ (fun w => D w s) (rotZ α y) (v (rotZ α y) s) = rotZ α (nsResidual 1 D q y s + fderiv ℝ (fun w => v w s) y (D y s) + fderiv ℝ (fun w => D w s) y (v y s))

signature.name: thp_ns_equivariant
signature.statement: ∀ (O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (v D : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (q : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen O → (∀ (α : ℝ) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), (y, s) ∈ O → (rotZ α y, s) ∈ O) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿v) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿D) O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿q) O → (∀ (α : ℝ) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), (y, s) ∈ O → v (rotZ α y) s = rotZ α (v y s)) → (∀ (α : ℝ) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), (y, s) ∈ O → D (rotZ α y) s = rotZ α (D y s)) → (∀ (α : ℝ) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), (y, s) ∈ O → q (rotZ α y) s = q y s) → ∀ (α : ℝ) (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ), (y, s) ∈ O → nsResidual 1 D q (rotZ α y) s + fderiv ℝ (fun w => v w s) (rotZ α y) (D (rotZ α y) s) + fderiv ℝ (fun w => D w s) (rotZ α y) (v (rotZ α y) s) = rotZ α (nsResidual 1 D q y s + fderiv ℝ (fun w => v w s) y (D y s) + fderiv ℝ (fun w => D w s) y (v y s))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro O v D q hO _hOinv _hvs hDs _hqs hvR hDR hqR α y s hys
  
  have hc0 : ∀ (β : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), rotZ β y 0 = Real.cos β * y 0 - Real.sin β * y 1 := by
    intro β y; simp [rotZ]
  have hc1 : ∀ (β : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), rotZ β y 1 = Real.sin β * y 0 + Real.cos β * y 1 := by
    intro β y; simp [rotZ]
  have hc2 : ∀ (β : ℝ) (y : ℝ³), rotZ β y 2 = y 2 := by
    intro β y; simp [rotZ]
  have hext : ∀ u v : ℝ³, u 0 = v 0 → u 1 = v 1 → u 2 = v 2 → u = v := by
    intro u v h0 h1 h2
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact h0
    · exact h1
    · exact h2
  have hinner : ∀ u v : ℝ³, (inner ℝ u v : ℝ) = u 0 * v 0 + u 1 * v 1 + u 2 * v 2 := by
    intro u v
    simp [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have Finv : ∀ (β : ℝ) (w : ℝ³), rotZ (-β) (rotZ β w) = w := by
    intro β w
    have hcs : Real.cos β ^ 2 + Real.sin β ^ 2 = 1 := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq β
    apply hext
    · rw [hc0, hc0, hc1, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
      linear_combination w 0 * hcs
    · rw [hc1, hc0, hc1, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
      linear_combination w 1 * hcs
    · rw [hc2, hc2]
  have F3 : ∀ w, rotZ (-α) (rotZ α w) = w := Finv α
  have F3' : ∀ w, rotZ α (rotZ (-α) w) = w := by
    intro w
    have := Finv (-α) w
    rwa [neg_neg] at this
  have F4 : ∀ u w : ℝ³, rotZ α (u + w) = rotZ α u + rotZ α w := by
    intro u w
    apply hext <;> simp [hc0, hc1, hc2] <;> ring
  have F5 : ∀ (c : ℝ) (u : ℝ³), rotZ α (c • u) = c • rotZ α u := by
    intro c u
    apply hext <;> simp [hc0, hc1, hc2] <;> ring
  have F6 : ∀ u w : ℝ³, inner ℝ (rotZ α u) (rotZ α w) = (inner ℝ u w : ℝ) := by
    intro u w
    have hcs : Real.cos α ^ 2 + Real.sin α ^ 2 = 1 := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq α
    rw [hinner, hinner, hc0, hc0, hc1, hc1, hc2, hc2]
    linear_combination (u 0 * w 0 + u 1 * w 1) * hcs
  let L : ℝ³ ≃ₗ[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
    { toFun := rotZ α
      invFun := rotZ (-α)
      map_add' := F4
      map_smul' := fun c u => by rw [RingHom.id_apply]; exact F5 c u
      left_inv := F3
      right_inv := F3' }
  let R : ℝ³ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] ℝ³ := L.isometryOfInner (fun a b => F6 a b)
  have hv' : ∀ w r, (w, r) ∈ O → v (R w) r = R (v w r) := fun w r h => hvR α w r h
  have hD' : ∀ w r, (w, r) ∈ O → D (R w) r = R (D w r) := fun w r h => hDR α w r h
  have hq' : ∀ w r, (w, r) ∈ O → q (R w) r = q w r := fun w r h => hqR α w r h
  show nsResidual 1 D q (R y) s + fderiv ℝ (fun w => v w s) (R y) (D (R y) s) +
      fderiv ℝ (fun w => D w s) (R y) (v (R y) s) =
    R (nsResidual 1 D q y s + fderiv ℝ (fun w => v w s) y (D y s) +
      fderiv ℝ (fun w => D w s) y (v y s))
  
  have hN : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ | (w, s) ∈ O} :=
    hO.preimage (Continuous.prodMk continuous_id continuous_const)
  have hT : IsOpen {r : ℝ | (y, r) ∈ O} :=
    hO.preimage (Continuous.prodMk continuous_const continuous_id)
  have eD : (fun w => D (R w) s) =ᶠ[nhds y] (fun w => R (D w s)) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hN.mem_nhds hys) (fun w hw => hD' w s hw)
  have ev : (fun w => v (R w) s) =ᶠ[nhds y] (fun w => R (v w s)) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hN.mem_nhds hys) (fun w hw => hv' w s hw)
  have eq : (fun w => q (R w) s) =ᶠ[nhds y] (fun w => q w s) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hN.mem_nhds hys) (fun w hw => hq' w s hw)
  have eT : (fun r => D (R y) r) =ᶠ[nhds s] (fun r => R (D y r)) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hT.mem_nhds hys) (fun r hr => hD' y r hr)
  
  have c2D : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun w => D w s) y :=
    ((hDs.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hys)).comp y
      ((contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffAt)).of_le (by norm_num)
  have dDt : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun r => D y r) s :=
    ((hDs.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hys)).comp s
      ((contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id).contDiffAt)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  
  have key1 : ∀ (f : ℝ³ → ℝ³) (w : ℝ³), (fun x => f (R x)) =ᶠ[nhds y] (fun x => R (f x)) →
      fderiv ℝ f (R y) (R w) = R (fderiv ℝ f y w) := by
    intro f w h
    have h1 := (R.toContinuousLinearEquiv).comp_right_fderiv (f := f) (x := y)
    have h2 := R.comp_fderiv (f := f) (x := y)
    have h3 : fderiv ℝ (f ∘ R.toContinuousLinearEquiv) y = fderiv ℝ (R ∘ f) y := h.fderiv_eq
    have := DFunLike.congr_fun (h1.symm.trans (h3.trans h2)) w
    exact this
  
  have key2 : ∀ (g : ℝ³ → ℝ), (fun x => g (R x)) =ᶠ[nhds y] g →
      gradient g (R y) = R (gradient g y) := by
    intro g h
    have hfd : ∀ w, fderiv ℝ g (R y) (R w) = fderiv ℝ g y w := by
      intro w
      have h1 := (R.toContinuousLinearEquiv).comp_right_fderiv (f := g) (x := y)
      have h3 : fderiv ℝ (g ∘ R.toContinuousLinearEquiv) y = fderiv ℝ g y := h.fderiv_eq
      have := DFunLike.congr_fun (h1.symm.trans h3) w
      exact this
    apply ext_inner_right ℝ
    intro u
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ : ∃ w, u = R w := ⟨R.symm u, (R.apply_symm_apply u).symm⟩
    rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.inner_map_map]
    simp only [gradient, InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply]
    exact hfd w
  
  have key3 : ∀ (f : ℝ³ → ℝ³), ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f y →
      (fun x => f (R x)) =ᶠ[nhds y] (fun x => R (f x)) → Δ f (R y) = R (Δ f y) := by
    intro f hf h
    let e : ℝ³ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ³ := R.toContinuousLinearEquiv
    have hstar : iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (f ∘ e) y =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (e y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => (e : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³)) := by
      have := e.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right f (uniqueDiffOn_univ (𝕜 := ℝ)) (mem_univ (e y)) 2
      rwa [Set.preimage_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ] at this
    let b := EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ
    have d2 : Δ (f ∘ e) y = Δ f (R y) := by
      rw [InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_orthonormalBasis (f ∘ e) b,
        InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_orthonormalBasis f (b.map R)]
      simp only [hstar, ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
        OrthonormalBasis.map_apply]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      exact congrArg (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (R y)) (by funext j; fin_cases j <;> rfl)
    have d3 : Δ (f ∘ e) y = Δ (fun x => R (f x)) y :=
      (InnerProductSpace.laplacian_congr_nhds h).eq_of_nhds
    have d1 : Δ (fun x => R (f x)) y = R (Δ f y) :=
      ContDiffAt.laplacian_CLM_comp_left (l := (e : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³)) hf
    rw [← d2, d3, d1]
  
  have T1 : deriv (fun r => D (R y) r) s = R (deriv (fun r => D y r) s) := by
    rw [eT.deriv_eq]
    exact (((R.toContinuousLinearEquiv : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³).hasFDerivAt).comp_hasDerivAt s
      dDt.hasDerivAt).deriv
  have T2 : fderiv ℝ (fun w => D w s) (R y) (D (R y) s) =
      R (fderiv ℝ (fun w => D w s) y (D y s)) := by
    rw [hD' y s hys]; exact key1 (fun w => D w s) (D y s) eD
  have T3 : Δ (fun w => D w s) (R y) = R (Δ (fun w => D w s) y) :=
    key3 (fun w => D w s) c2D eD
  have T4 : gradient (fun w => q w s) (R y) = R (gradient (fun w => q w s) y) :=
    key2 (fun w => q w s) eq
  have T5 : fderiv ℝ (fun w => v w s) (R y) (D (R y) s) =
      R (fderiv ℝ (fun w => v w s) y (D y s)) := by
    rw [hD' y s hys]; exact key1 (fun w => v w s) (D y s) ev
  have T6 : fderiv ℝ (fun w => D w s) (R y) (v (R y) s) =
      R (fderiv ℝ (fun w => D w s) y (v y s)) := by
    rw [hv' y s hys]; exact key1 (fun w => D w s) (v y s) eD
  
  simp only [nsResidual]
  rw [T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T6]
  simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_smul]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState), B.ok → qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB → (∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) → (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 < 2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ∨ 2 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) → fA5 B G l0 S x t = B.AB x t ∧ fB B G l0 S x t = B.BvB x t ∧ fP5 B G l0 S x t = B.PB x t) → ∀ m N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) → (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 < 2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ∨ 2 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fRes5 B G l0 S)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (N : ℝ)

signature.name: spb5_offshell_residual_flat
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState), B.ok → qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB → (∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) → (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 < 2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ∨ 2 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) → fA5 B G l0 S x t = B.AB x t ∧ fB B G l0 S x t = B.BvB x t ∧ fP5 B G l0 S x t = B.PB x t) → ∀ m N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x t, (x, t) ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) → (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 < 2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ∨ 2 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(fRes5 B G l0 S)) (x, t)‖ ≤ C * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) ^ (N : ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 S hok hqB hP5 m N
  have hSim : SimScaleProps B.h := hok.1
  have hBP := hok.2
  unfold BackgroundProps at hBP
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, hB8, hB9, -, -⟩ := hBP
  have hT0 := hB8.2.2.1
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hB9 m N
  refine ⟨C, fun x t hxt hoff => ?_⟩
  
  have hqcont : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
    have hmap : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      (((EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.comp continuous_fst).prodMk
        (continuous_const.sub continuous_snd))
    refine hSim.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.comp hmap.continuousOn ?_
    intro w hw
    exact ⟨mem_univ _, mem_Ioi.mpr (sub_pos.mpr hw)⟩
  have hΩ : IsOpen (simDomain B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have e : simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
        (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := rfl
    rw [e]
    exact hqcont.isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const) isOpen_Iio
  have hc01 : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2) :=
    (((EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.comp continuous_fst).pow 2).add
      (((EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.comp continuous_fst).pow 2)
  have hr1 : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
      w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 - 2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
    hc01.continuousOn.sub (continuousOn_const.mul hqcont)
  have hr2 : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
      w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 - 2 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} :=
    hc01.continuousOn.sub (continuousOn_const.mul hqcont)
  have hU1 := hr1.isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const)
    (isOpen_Iio : IsOpen (Iio (0:ℝ)))
  have hU2 := hr2.isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const)
    (isOpen_Ioi : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ)))
  obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ), O = simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∩
      (({w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
        w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 - 2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ⁻¹' Iio 0) ∪
       ({w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
        w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 - 2 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ⁻¹' Ioi 0)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hO : IsOpen O := by rw [hOdef]; exact hΩ.inter (hU1.union hU2)
  have hOa : ∀ w ∈ O, w ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧
      (w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 < 2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) ∨
        2 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2) := by
    intro w hw
    rw [hOdef] at hw
    obtain ⟨hwΩ, hw'⟩ := hw
    refine ⟨hwΩ, ?_⟩
    rcases hw' with h | h
    · left
      have : w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 - 2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) < 0 := h.2
      linarith
    · right
      have : 0 < w.1 0 ^ 2 + w.1 1 ^ 2 - 2 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2) := h.2
      linarith
  have hxt' : t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hxt
  have hz0 : ((x, t) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ O := by
    rw [hOdef]
    refine ⟨hxt, ?_⟩
    rcases hoff with h | h
    · left
      refine ⟨hxt'.1, ?_⟩
      show x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 - 2 * B.Xa * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < 0
      linarith
    · right
      refine ⟨hxt'.1, ?_⟩
      show 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 - 2 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t)
      linarith
  
  have hU : ∀ z ∈ O, (↿(fU5 B G l0 S)) z =
      (↿(fun y' s' => curl3 (fun w => B.AB w s') y' + B.BvB y' s')) z := by
    rintro ⟨y, s⟩ hz
    have hV : {w : ℝ³ | ((w, s) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ O} ∈ nhds y :=
      (hO.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mem_nhds hz
    have hev : (fun w => fA5 B G l0 S w s) =ᶠ[nhds y] fun w => B.AB w s :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hV (fun w hw => by
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hOa _ hw
        exact (hP5 w s h1 h2).1)
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hOa _ hz
    show curl3 (fun w => fA5 B G l0 S w s) y + fB B G l0 S y s =
      curl3 (fun w => B.AB w s) y + B.BvB y s
    rw [(hP5 y s h1 h2).2.1]
    simp only [curl3, hev.fderiv_eq]
  have hPeq : ∀ z ∈ O, (↿(fP5 B G l0 S)) z = (↿B.PB) z := by
    rintro ⟨y, s⟩ hz
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hOa _ hz
    exact (hP5 y s h1 h2).2.2
  
  have hloc : ∀ (u₁ u₂ : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p₁ p₂ : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ z ∈ O, (↿u₁) z = (↿u₂) z) → (∀ z ∈ O, (↿p₁) z = (↿p₂) z) →
      ∀ z ∈ O, (↿(nsResidual 1 u₁ p₁)) z = (↿(nsResidual 1 u₂ p₂)) z := by
    rintro u₁ u₂ p₁ p₂ hu hp ⟨y, s⟩ hz
    have hNt : {r : ℝ | ((y, r) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ O} ∈ nhds s :=
      (hO.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mem_nhds hz
    have hNx : {w : ℝ³ | ((w, s) : ℝ³ × ℝ) ∈ O} ∈ nhds y :=
      (hO.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mem_nhds hz
    have E1 : (fun r => u₁ y r) =ᶠ[nhds s] (fun r => u₂ y r) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hNt (fun r hr => hu (y, r) hr)
    have E2 : (fun w => u₁ w s) =ᶠ[nhds y] (fun w => u₂ w s) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hNx (fun w hw => hu (w, s) hw)
    have E3 : (fun w => p₁ w s) =ᶠ[nhds y] (fun w => p₂ w s) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hNx (fun w hw => hp (w, s) hw)
    have E0 : u₁ y s = u₂ y s := hu (y, s) hz
    have h4 : deriv (fun r => u₁ y r) s = deriv (fun r => u₂ y r) s := E1.deriv_eq
    have h5 : fderiv ℝ (fun w => u₁ w s) y = fderiv ℝ (fun w => u₂ w s) y := E2.fderiv_eq
    have h6 : Δ (fun w => u₁ w s) y = Δ (fun w => u₂ w s) y :=
      (InnerProductSpace.laplacian_congr_nhds E2).eq_of_nhds
    have h7 : gradient (fun w => p₁ w s) y = gradient (fun w => p₂ w s) y := E3.gradient_eq
    show nsResidual 1 u₁ p₁ y s = nsResidual 1 u₂ p₂ y s
    unfold nsResidual
    rw [h4, h5, h6, h7, E0]
  
  have hstress : ∀ z ∈ O, stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz z.1 z.2 = 0 := by
    rintro ⟨y, s⟩ hz
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hOa _ hz
    have h1' : s < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - s) < qsOf l0 := h1
    have hq0 : 0 < simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - s) := (hSim.1 (y 2) (1 - s) (by linarith [h1'.1])).1
    have hX : simX B.h y s < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < simX B.h y s := by
      unfold simX
      rcases h2 with h | h
      · left
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by linarith)]
        linarith
      · right
        rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]
        linarith
    have hnb : ∀ᶠ Y in nhds (simX B.h y s), Y ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ Y := by
      rcases hX with h | h
      · filter_upwards [isOpen_Iio.mem_nhds h] with Y hY using Or.inl (le_of_lt hY)
      · filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds h] with Y hY using Or.inr (le_of_lt hY)
    have hX' : simX B.h y s ≤ B.Xa ∨ B.Xb ≤ simX B.h y s := hX.imp le_of_lt le_of_lt
    have hd1 : deriv (fun Y => B.Tth (simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - s)) Y (simEta B.h y s))
        (simX B.h y s) = 0 := by
      have hev : (fun Y => B.Tth (simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - s)) Y (simEta B.h y s))
          =ᶠ[nhds (simX B.h y s)] fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
        hnb.mono (fun Y hY => (hT0 _ Y _ hY).1)
      rw [hev.deriv_eq]
      exact deriv_const _ _
    have hd2 : deriv (fun Y => B.Tz (simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - s)) Y (simEta B.h y s))
        (simX B.h y s) = 0 := by
      have hev : (fun Y => B.Tz (simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - s)) Y (simEta B.h y s))
          =ᶠ[nhds (simX B.h y s)] fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
        hnb.mono (fun Y hY => (hT0 _ Y _ hY).2)
      rw [hev.deriv_eq]
      exact deriv_const _ _
    have hv1 := (hT0 (simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - s)) (simX B.h y s) (simEta B.h y s) hX').1
    have hv2 := (hT0 (simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - s)) (simX B.h y s) (simEta B.h y s) hX').2
    show stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz y s = 0
    unfold stressDivField
    rw [hd1, hd2, hv1, hv2]
    simp
  
  have heq : ∀ z ∈ O, (↿(fRes5 B G l0 S)) z = (↿(fun (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ) =>
        nsResidual 1 (fun y' s' => curl3 (fun w => B.AB w s') y' + B.BvB y' s') B.PB y s -
          stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz y s)) z := by
    intro z hz
    have h1 := hloc _ _ _ _ hU hPeq z hz
    have h2 := hstress z hz
    have e : (↿(fun (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ) =>
        nsResidual 1 (fun y' s' => curl3 (fun w => B.AB w s') y' + B.BvB y' s') B.PB y s -
          stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz y s)) z =
        (↿(nsResidual 1 (fun y' s' => curl3 (fun w => B.AB w s') y' + B.BvB y' s') B.PB)) z -
          stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz z.1 z.2 := rfl
    rw [e, h2, sub_zero]
    exact h1
  have hev : (↿(fRes5 B G l0 S)) =ᶠ[nhds (x, t)] (↿(fun (y : ℝ³) (s : ℝ) =>
        nsResidual 1 (fun y' s' => curl3 (fun w => B.AB w s') y' + B.BvB y' s') B.PB y s -
          stressDivField B.h B.Tth B.Tz y s)) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hz0) heq
  rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
  exact hC x t ⟨hxt'.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hxt'.2 hqB⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 S bw ca cm cd hok hG hqB hSt
  have hpm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pmP5 B G l0 S) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    (state_cyl_smooth_v5 B G l0 S bw ca cm cd hok hG hqB hSt).2.2.2.2
  have hgr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (grP5 B G l0 S) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    (grP5_state_regular_v5 B G l0 S bw ca cm cd hok hG hqB hSt).1
  have hdc := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  have hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := hdc.2.1
  have hqpos : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < qC B.h η := hdc.2.2.1
  have hdR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h (pmP5 B G l0 S)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    (hdc.2.2.2.2.1 _ hpm).1
  have hrho : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (rhoP B) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := (rhoP_regular_v5 B (qsOf l0) hok).1
  have hSt' := hSt
  unfold StOrd5 at hSt'
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, hcalP, -⟩ := hSt'
  have hcalS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h) (calP5 B G l0 S))
      {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qsOf l0} := hcalP.1
  have hP : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
    (contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_snd).prodMk (contDiff_fst.comp (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd))
  have hPm : Set.MapsTo (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))
      {w : ℝ × ℝ | w.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h w.1 (1 - w.2) < qsOf l0} :=
    fun η hη => ⟨hη.2.1, hη.2.2⟩
  have hN : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun η : Cyl => nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h) (calP5 B G l0 S) (η.2.1, η.2.2.1))
      (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := hcalS.comp hP.contDiffOn hPm
  have hqe : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h))) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    hq.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos η hη).ne')
  have hH : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => dR B.h (pmP5 B G l0 S) η - grP5 B G l0 S η +
      rhoP B η * (qC B.h η ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h)) *
        nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h) (calP5 B G l0 S) (η.2.1, η.2.2.1)))
      (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := (hdR.sub hgr).add (hrho.mul (hqe.mul hN))
  have hRad : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (radRem5 B G l0 S) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    refine hH.congr (fun η hη => ?_)
    have hq0 := hqpos η hη
    have e : nrmS B (2 * Aex B.h) (calP5 B G l0 S) (η.2.1, η.2.2.1) =
        qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h) * calP5 B G l0 S η.2.1 η.2.2.1 := rfl
    have key : qC B.h η ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h)) *
        (qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h) * calP5 B G l0 S η.2.1 η.2.2.1) =
        calP5 B G l0 S η.2.1 η.2.2.1 := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hq0, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero, one_mul]
    unfold radRem5
    rw [e, key]
  have hξ := (corr_domain_v5 B l0 0 hok).2.1
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + 0))
      {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2} (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    fun w hw => ⟨hw.1, hw.2.1, hw.2.2⟩
  exact hRad.comp hξ hmaps

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B l0 hok m
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  
  have hc : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x i) := fun i => contDiff_piLp_apply 2
  have hf2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) := ((hc 0).pow 2).add ((hc 1).pow 2)
  have hradc : Continuous rad := Real.continuous_sqrt.comp hf2.continuous
  have hU0 : IsOpen {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} := isOpen_lt continuous_const hradc
  have hrsq : ∀ x : ℝ³, rad x ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := fun x => Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hsm : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (i : Fin 3), (c • x) i = c * x i := fun c x i => by simp
  have hT0 : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³), (x + c • eZ) 0 = x 0 := fun c x => by simp [eZ]
  have hT1 : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³), (x + c • eZ) 1 = x 1 := fun c x => by simp [eZ]
  have hRh : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³), 0 < c → rad (c • x) = c * rad x := by
    intro c x hc0
    unfold rad
    rw [hsm, hsm, show (c * x 0) ^ 2 + (c * x 1) ^ 2 = c ^ 2 * (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) by ring,
      Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg c), Real.sqrt_sq hc0.le]
  have hVh : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³), radVec (c • x) = c • radVec x := by
    intro c x; unfold radVec; rw [hsm, hsm, smul_add, mul_smul, mul_smul]
  have hRt : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³), rad (x + c • eZ) = rad x := by
    intro c x; unfold rad; rw [hT0, hT1]
  have hVt : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³), radVec (x + c • eZ) = radVec x := by
    intro c x; unfold radVec; rw [hT0, hT1]
  have hinvh : ∀ (c r : ℝ), 0 < c → (c * r)⁻¹ * c = r⁻¹ := by
    intro c r hc0
    calc (c * r)⁻¹ * c = r⁻¹ * (c⁻¹ * c) := by rw [mul_inv]; ring
      _ = r⁻¹ := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hc0.ne', mul_one]
  
  have homog : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : ℝ³ → V) (s : ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} →
      (∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³), 0 < c → f (c • x) = c ^ s • f x) →
      (∀ (c : ℝ) (x : ℝ³), f (x + c • eZ) = f x) →
      ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ Cj : ℝ, 0 ≤ Cj ∧ ∀ x : ℝ³, 0 < rad x →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f x‖ ≤ Cj * rad x ^ (s - j) := by
    intro V _ _ f s hf hH hT j
    have hN : ((j : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
    have hKcU : ({y : ℝ³ | rad y = 1} ∩ {y : ℝ³ | y 2 = 0}) ⊆ {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} :=
      fun y hy => by
        show 0 < rad y
        rw [hy.1]; exact one_pos
    have hKcc : IsCompact ({y : ℝ³ | rad y = 1} ∩ {y : ℝ³ | y 2 = 0}) := by
      apply Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded
      · exact (isClosed_eq hradc continuous_const).inter
          (isClosed_eq (hc 2).continuous continuous_const)
      · apply (Metric.isBounded_closedBall (x := (0:ℝ³)) (r := 1)).subset
        intro y hy
        rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
        have h1 : rad y = 1 := hy.1
        have h2 : y 2 = 0 := hy.2
        have hsq : y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← hrsq, h1]; norm_num
        rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, h2]
        rw [show y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 + (0:ℝ) ^ 2 = 1 by rw [hsq]; ring, Real.sqrt_one]
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f) ({y : ℝ³ | rad y = 1} ∩ {y : ℝ³ | y 2 = 0}) := by
      have h1 := hf.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin hN hU0.uniqueDiffOn
      exact (h1.congr (fun x hx => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hU0 hx).symm)).mono hKcU
    obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := hKcc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hcont
    refine ⟨max C0 0, le_max_right _ _, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    set r := rad x with hr
    have hr0 : 0 < r := hx
    set v : ℝ³ := (-(r⁻¹ * x 2)) • eZ with hv
    set y : ℝ³ := r⁻¹ • x + v with hy
    have hy0 : y 0 = x 0 / r := by simp [hy, hv, eZ, div_eq_inv_mul]
    have hy1 : y 1 = x 1 / r := by simp [hy, hv, eZ, div_eq_inv_mul]
    have hy2 : y 2 = 0 := by simp [hy, hv, eZ]
    have hradY : rad y = 1 := by
      unfold rad
      rw [hy0, hy1, div_pow, div_pow, ← add_div, ← hrsq x, div_self (pow_pos hr0 2).ne',
        Real.sqrt_one]
    have hyU : 0 < rad y := by rw [hradY]; exact one_pos
    have hid : ∀ z : ℝ³, f z = r ^ s • f (r⁻¹ • z + v) := by
      intro z
      rw [hv, hT, hH r⁻¹ z (inv_pos.2 hr0), smul_smul, Real.inv_rpow hr0.le,
        mul_inv_cancel₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr0 s).ne', one_smul]
    set S : ℝ³ ≃L[ℝ] ℝ³ :=
      (LinearEquiv.smulOfNeZero ℝ ℝ³ r⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero hr0.ne')).toContinuousLinearEquiv with hS
    have hSapp : ∀ z, S z = r⁻¹ • z := fun z => rfl
    have hfun : f = (fun u => r ^ s • f (u + v)) ∘ ⇑S := by
      funext z
      rw [Function.comp_apply, hSapp]
      exact hid z
    have e1 := ContinuousLinearEquiv.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right S (fun u => r ^ s • f (u + v))
      uniqueDiffOn_univ (mem_univ (S x)) j
    rw [preimage_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ, iteratedFDerivWithin_univ] at e1
    have e2 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun u => r ^ s • f (u + v)) (S x) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun q => r ^ s • f q) y := by
      rw [hSapp]
      exact iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right (f := fun q => r ^ s • f q) j v (r⁻¹ • x)
    have hfy : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f y := hf.contDiffAt (hU0.mem_nhds hyU)
    have e3 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun q => r ^ s • f q) y = r ^ s • iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f y :=
      iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply' (hfy.of_le hN)
    have key : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f x =
        (r ^ s • iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f y).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => (S : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³)) := by
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f x
          = iteratedFDeriv ℝ j ((fun u => r ^ s • f (u + v)) ∘ ⇑S) x :=
            congrArg (fun g => iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g x) hfun
        _ = _ := e1
        _ = _ := by rw [e2, e3]
    have hSn : ‖(S : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³)‖ ≤ r⁻¹ :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (inv_nonneg.2 hr0.le) (fun z => le_of_eq (by
        show ‖r⁻¹ • z‖ = r⁻¹ * ‖z‖
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 hr0)]))
    have hrs : 0 < r ^ s := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr0 s
    rw [key]
    calc ‖(r ^ s • iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f y).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => (S : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³))‖
        ≤ ‖r ^ s • iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f y‖ * ∏ _i : Fin j, ‖(S : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³)‖ :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _
      _ ≤ (r ^ s * max C0 0) * r⁻¹ ^ j := by
          apply mul_le_mul _ _ (Finset.prod_nonneg fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)
            (mul_nonneg hrs.le (le_max_right _ _))
          · rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hrs]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((hC0 y ⟨hradY, hy2⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _)) hrs.le
          · rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
            exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hSn j
      _ = max C0 0 * r ^ (s - j) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_sub hr0, Real.rpow_natCast, inv_pow, div_eq_mul_inv]; ring
  
  have hlift : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (φ : ℝ³ → W),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} → ∀ (j : ℕ) (p : ℝ³ × ℝ), 0 < rad p.1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => φ w.1) p‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j φ p.1‖ := by
    intro W _ _ φ hφ j p hp
    have hU' : IsOpen ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) ⁻¹' {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x}) :=
      hU0.preimage (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ).continuous
    have hp' : (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) p ∈ {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} := hp
    have e := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)
      hφ hU0.uniqueDiffOn hU'.uniqueDiffOn hp' (i := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hU' hp, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hU0 hp'] at e
    have e2 : (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => φ w.1) = φ ∘ (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := rfl
    rw [e2, e]
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
    have hp1 : ∏ _i : Fin j, ‖ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ³ ℝ‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_fst_le ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) hp1
  
  have hSr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ rad {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} :=
    hf2.contDiffOn.sqrt (fun x hx => by
      have hx' : 0 < Real.sqrt (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) := hx
      exact (Real.sqrt_pos.mp hx').ne')
  have hinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (rad x)⁻¹) {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} :=
    hSr.inv (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx)
  have hrv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ radVec := by
    have h' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ³ => x 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ) +
        x 1 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1:ℝ)) :=
      ((hc 0).smul contDiff_const).add ((hc 1).smul contDiff_const)
    exact h'
  have hSe : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ eR {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x} := hinv.smul hrv.contDiffOn
  have hm : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ Cj : ℝ, 0 ≤ Cj ∧ ∀ x : ℝ³, 0 < rad x →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j eR x‖ ≤ Cj * rad x ^ ((0:ℝ) - j) :=
    homog eR 0 hSe
      (fun c x hc0 => by
        unfold eR
        rw [hRh c x hc0, hVh, smul_smul, hinvh _ _ hc0, Real.rpow_zero, one_smul])
      (fun c x => by unfold eR; rw [hRt, hVt])
  choose CC hCC0 hCC using hm
  obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), CC j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by rw [hAdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hCC0 j)
  have hCA : ∀ j ≤ m, CC j ≤ A := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hAdef]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := CC) (fun i _ => hCC0 i) (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
  obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = 1 + B.Xa⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hXai : 0 < B.Xa⁻¹ := inv_pos.2 hXa
  have hM1 : 1 ≤ M := by rw [hMdef]; linarith
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by linarith
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ 2 ^ m * (A * M ^ m) :=
    mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (by norm_num) m) (mul_nonneg hA0 (pow_nonneg hM0 m))
  refine ⟨2 ^ m * (A * M ^ m), hK0, ?_⟩
  intro g x t a Cg hg hxt hlo hhi hgb
  set q := simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) with hqdef
  have hxt' : t < 1 ∧ q < qsOf l0 := hxt
  have hq0 : 0 < q := (hok.1.1 (x 2) (1 - t) (by linarith [hxt'.1])).1
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (by simp)
  have hq1 : q ≤ 1 := le_trans hxt'.2.le hqs1
  have hr2 : rad x ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := hrsq x
  have hrad : 0 < rad x := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (lt_trans (mul_pos hXa hq0) hlo)
  
  have hqM : q ≤ M * rad x := by
    rcases le_or_gt q (rad x) with h | h
    · calc q ≤ rad x := h
        _ = 1 * rad x := (one_mul _).symm
        _ ≤ M * rad x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hM1 hrad.le
    · have hr1 : rad x < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le h hq1
      have hrr : rad x ^ 2 ≤ rad x := by
        rw [sq]; exact mul_le_of_le_one_left hrad.le hr1.le
      have h1 : B.Xa * q < rad x := by linarith
      have h2 : q < B.Xa⁻¹ * rad x := by
        rw [← div_eq_inv_mul, lt_div_iff₀ hXa]; linarith
      have h3 : B.Xa⁻¹ * rad x ≤ M * rad x :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by rw [hMdef]; linarith) hrad.le
      linarith
  have hrinv : (rad x)⁻¹ ≤ M * q⁻¹ := by
    have e1 : (rad x)⁻¹ = q * (q⁻¹ * (rad x)⁻¹) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq0.ne', one_mul]
    have hrr : rad x * (rad x)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hrad.ne'
    have e2 : M * q⁻¹ = (M * rad x) * (q⁻¹ * (rad x)⁻¹) := by
      calc M * q⁻¹ = M * q⁻¹ * (rad x * (rad x)⁻¹) := by rw [hrr, mul_one]
        _ = (M * rad x) * (q⁻¹ * (rad x)⁻¹) := by ring
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hqM
      (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hq0.le) (inv_nonneg.2 hrad.le))
  have hqi : 1 ≤ q⁻¹ := (one_le_inv₀ hq0).mpr hq1
  have hβ1 : 1 ≤ M * q⁻¹ := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hM1 hqi
  
  have hE : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ m → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => eR z.1) (x, t)‖ ≤
      (A * M ^ m) * q ^ (-(m:ℝ)) := by
    intro i hi
    have h1 := hlift eR hSe i (x, t) hrad
    have h2 := hCC i x hrad
    have e : rad x ^ ((0:ℝ) - i) = (rad x)⁻¹ ^ i := by
      rw [Real.rpow_sub hrad, Real.rpow_zero, Real.rpow_natCast, inv_pow, one_div]
    have h3 : (rad x)⁻¹ ^ i ≤ (M * q⁻¹) ^ m :=
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ (inv_nonneg.2 hrad.le) hrinv i).trans (pow_le_pow_right₀ hβ1 hi)
    have e2 : (M * q⁻¹) ^ m = M ^ m * q ^ (-(m:ℝ)) := by
      rw [mul_pow, Real.rpow_neg hq0.le, Real.rpow_natCast, inv_pow]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => eR z.1) (x, t)‖
        ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i eR x‖ := h1
      _ ≤ CC i * rad x ^ ((0:ℝ) - i) := h2
      _ ≤ A * (M * q⁻¹) ^ m := by
          rw [e]
          exact mul_le_mul (hCA i hi) h3 (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hrad.le) i) hA0
      _ = (A * M ^ m) * q ^ (-(m:ℝ)) := by rw [e2]; ring
  
  have hqcont : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2))
      {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
    have hmap : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ((w.1 2, 1 - w.2) : ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      (((EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.comp continuous_fst).prodMk
        (continuous_const.sub continuous_snd))
    refine hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.comp hmap.continuousOn ?_
    intro w hw
    exact ⟨mem_univ _, mem_Ioi.mpr (sub_pos.mpr hw)⟩
  have hΩ : IsOpen (simDomain B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have e : simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
        (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => simScale B.h (w.1 2) (1 - w.2)) ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := rfl
    rw [e]
    exact hqcont.isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const) isOpen_Iio
  have hUo : IsOpen {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2} := by
    have e : {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2} =
        (Prod.fst ⁻¹' {x : ℝ³ | 0 < rad x}) ∩ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) := by
      ext z; exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2⟩, fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2⟩⟩
    rw [e]
    exact (hU0.preimage continuous_fst).inter hΩ
  have hEs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => eR z.1) {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2} :=
    hSe.comp contDiffOn_fst (fun w hw => hw.1)
  have hzU : (x, t) ∈ {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | corrOn B l0 z.1 z.2} := ⟨hrad, hxt'.1, hxt'.2⟩
  have hCg : 0 ≤ Cg := by
    have h0 := hgb 0 (Nat.zero_le m)
    have hqa : 0 < q ^ a := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 a
    have h00 : 0 * q ^ a ≤ Cg * q ^ a := by rw [zero_mul]; exact (norm_nonneg _).trans h0
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h00 hqa
  have bilin : ∀ (Bl : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) (f : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ) (g : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℝ³)
      (Ω : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)), IsOpen Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g Ω →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : ℝ³ × ℝ) (ρ a b Cf Cg : ℝ), w ∈ Ω → 0 < ρ →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f w‖ ≤ Cf * ρ ^ a) →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g w‖ ≤ Cg * ρ ^ b) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => Bl (f z) (g z)) w‖ ≤ ‖Bl‖ * 2 ^ n * Cf * Cg * ρ ^ (a + b) := by
    intro Bl f g Ω hΩ' hf hg' n w ρ a b Cf Cg hw hρ hbf hbg
    have hU : UniqueDiffOn ℝ Ω := hΩ'.uniqueDiffOn
    have key := ContinuousLinearMap.norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_le_of_bilinear Bl hf hg' hU hw
      (n := n) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hΩ' hw] at key
    refine key.trans ?_
    have hsum : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ)) = 2 ^ n := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose n
    have hP0 : 0 ≤ Cf * ρ ^ a := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hbf 0 (Nat.zero_le _))
    have hfin : ‖Bl‖ * 2 ^ n * Cf * Cg * ρ ^ (a + b) =
        ‖Bl‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * ((Cf * ρ ^ a) * (Cg * ρ ^ b)) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hsum, Real.rpow_add hρ]; ring
    rw [hfin]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg Bl)
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_
    have hin : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩ' hw, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (n - i) hΩ' hw]
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n.choose i := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    calc (n.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f w‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) g w‖
        ≤ (n.choose i : ℝ) * (Cf * ρ ^ a) * (Cg * ρ ^ b) :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbf i hin) h0) (hbg (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i))
            (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg h0 hP0)
      _ = (n.choose i : ℝ) * ((Cf * ρ ^ a) * (Cg * ρ ^ b)) := by ring
  have hL := bilin (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) g
    (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => eR z.1) _ hUo hg hEs m (x, t) q a (-(m:ℝ)) Cg (A * M ^ m) hzU hq0 hgb hE
  have hfun : (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³) (g z)
      (eR z.1)) = fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => g z • eR z.1 := by
    funext z; simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply]
  rw [hfun] at hL
  have hnl : ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³)‖ ≤ 1 :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_lsmul_le
  have e3 : a + -(m:ℝ) = a - (m:ℝ) := by ring
  rw [e3] at hL
  have hX : 0 ≤ 2 ^ m * Cg * (A * M ^ m) * q ^ (a - (m:ℝ)) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (by norm_num) m) hCg)
      (mul_nonneg hA0 (pow_nonneg hM0 m))) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)
  calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ => g z • eR z.1) (x, t)‖
      ≤ ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³)‖ * 2 ^ m * Cg * (A * M ^ m) *
          q ^ (a - (m:ℝ)) := hL
    _ = ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ³)‖ *
          (2 ^ m * Cg * (A * M ^ m) * q ^ (a - (m:ℝ))) := by ring
    _ ≤ 1 * (2 ^ m * Cg * (A * M ^ m) * q ^ (a - (m:ℝ))) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnl hX
    _ = 2 ^ m * (A * M ^ m) * Cg * q ^ (a - (m:ℝ)) := by ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → 1/2 < qC B.h ξ / Qb l → qC B.h ξ / Qb l < 2 → B.Xa / 2 ≤ XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ ≤ 2 * B.Xb → |pcFa5 B l (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) - (qC B.h ξ / Qb l) ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F (XC B.h ξ) (etaC B.h ξ)| ≤ C * Qb l ^ B.h ∧ |pcRC5 l (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) * (Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ (pcFa5 B l) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) - (qC B.h ξ / Qb l) ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * (2 * XC B.h ξ * deriv (fun Y => B.F Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ))| ≤ C * Qb l ^ B.h ∧ |Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ (pcB5 B l 2) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) - (qC B.h ξ / Qb l) ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * (Real.sqrt (2 * XC B.h ξ) * deriv (fun Y => B.U Y (etaC B.h ξ)) (XC B.h ξ))| ≤ C * Qb l ^ B.h ∧ pcRC5 l (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) = Real.sqrt (2 * XC B.h ξ * (qC B.h ξ / Qb l))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hB
  
  
  have geom : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} ∧
      ∀ (l : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => baseC B l (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) i)
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
    obtain ⟨hS, hBP⟩ := hB
    have hsc : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hA : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
      have hm : Continuous (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2)) := by fun_prop
      have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2)))
          {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} := by
        refine hsc.comp hm.continuousOn ?_
        intro s hs
        have hs' : s.2.2 < 1 := hs
        exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - s.2.2 by linarith⟩
      have hU : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
      have h1 := hc.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := B.qB))
      have h2 : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst

    rw [show pcRC5 l (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) = ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (Qb l) from rfl]
    linarith
  · rw [hfdB, hCe]
    linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → 1/2 < qC B.h ξ / Qb l → qC B.h ξ / Qb l < 2 → B.Xa / 2 ≤ XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ ≤ 2 * B.Xb → |Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ (pcFa5 B l) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))| ≤ C * Qb l ^ B.h ∧ |Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ (pcB5 B l 2) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))| ≤ C * Qb l ^ B.h

signature.name: base_z_win5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (l : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → 1/2 < qC B.h ξ / Qb l → qC B.h ξ / Qb l < 2 → B.Xa / 2 ≤ XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ ≤ 2 * B.Xb → |Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ (pcFa5 B l) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))| ≤ C * Qb l ^ B.h ∧ |Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ (pcB5 B l 2) (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))| ≤ C * Qb l ^ B.h

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hok
  
  have hout : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ q X η : ℝ, 0 < q → q < B.qB → B.Xa / 2 ≤ X → X ≤ 2 * B.Xb →
      -1 < η → η < 1 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift B.Eb) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (logLift B.Ub) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨⟨hh0, -, hXa, -, -, -, -, hqB0, hqB1, -, -, -, -⟩, ⟨hFs, hUs, -, hFb⟩, -, -, -, -,
      ⟨hEs, hUbs, -, hdev⟩, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2
    have hS : IsOpen (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hWo : IsOpen (Set.Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) :=
      isOpen_Iio.prod hS
    have hX0 : 0 < B.Xa / 2 := by linarith
    have hpt : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, p.1 ≠ 0 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1)) p := by
      intro p hp
      exact (contDiffAt_const.mul contDiffAt_fst).sqrt (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hp)
    have hsqS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1))
        (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
      fun p hp => (hpt p (ne_of_gt hp.1)).contDiffWithinAt
    have hMs : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Set.Icc (B.Xa / 2) (2 * B.Xb) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-1:ℝ) 1,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1)) p‖ ≤ M := by
      intro k
      have hK : IsCompact (Set.Icc (B.Xa / 2) (2 * B.Xb) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
        isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
      have hc : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1)))
          (Set.Icc (B.Xa / 2) (2 * B.Xb) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-1:ℝ) 1) := by
        refine continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt (fun p hp => ?_)
        exact (hpt p (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le hX0 hp.1.1))).continuousAt_iteratedFDeriv
          (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      exact hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hc
    choose Ms hMs using hMs
    choose MF hMF using hFb (B.Xa / 2) (2 * B.Xb) hX0
    obtain ⟨C7, hC7⟩ := hdev (B.Xa / 2) (2 * B.Xb) hX0 m
    have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) * |Ms i| * |MF (m - i)| :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)
    obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ,
        C = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) * |Ms i| * |MF (m - i)| + |MF m| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hP2s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1) * (↿B.F) p)
        (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := hsqS.mul hFs
    have hP2b : ∀ X η : ℝ, B.Xa / 2 ≤ X → X ≤ 2 * B.Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1) * (↿B.F) p) (X, η)‖ ≤ C1 := by
      intro X η h1 h2 h3 h4
      have hpS : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 :=
        ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hX0 h1, h3, h4⟩
      have hL : ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1) * (↿B.F) p)
          (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (X, η)‖ ≤
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) *
            ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1))
              (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (X, η)‖ *
            ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ (m - i) (↿B.F) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (X, η)‖ :=
        norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hsqS hFs hS.uniqueDiffOn hpS (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hS hpS] at hL
      have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) *
            ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * p.1))
              (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (X, η)‖ *
            ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ (m - i) (↿B.F) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) (X, η)‖ ≤
          (m.choose i : ℝ) * |Ms i| * |MF (m - i)| := by
        intro i _
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hS hpS, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (m - i) hS hpS]
        have a := (hMs i (X, η) ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3.le, h4.le⟩).trans (le_abs_self _)
        have b := ((hMF (m - i) X η h1 h2 h3 h4).1).trans (le_abs_self _)
        have c : (0:ℝ) ≤ (m.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
        exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a c) b (norm_nonneg _)
          (mul_nonneg c (abs_nonneg _))
      calc _ ≤ _ := hL
        _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
        _ ≤ C1 := by rw [hC1]; linarith [abs_nonneg (MF m)]
    have hproj : ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) → ∀ (m : ℕ)
        (w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), w.2 ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => f w.2) w‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f w.2‖ := by
      intro f hf m w hw
      let π := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)
      have hU : IsOpen (π ⁻¹' (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) := hS.preimage π.continuous
      have hwU : w ∈ π ⁻¹' (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := hw
      have h1 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right π hf hS.uniqueDiffOn
        hU.uniqueDiffOn hwU (n := ∞) (i := m) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hU hwU,
        iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen m hS (show π w ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 from hw)] at h1
      have e : (fun w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => f w.2) = f ∘ π := rfl
      rw [e, h1]
      refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
      have hp : ∏ _i : Fin m, ‖π‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Finset.prod_const]
        exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_snd_le ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (π w)‖ * ∏ _i : Fin m, ‖π‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f (π w)‖ * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f w.2‖ := mul_one _
    refine ⟨|C7| + C1, ?_⟩
    intro q X η hq hqB hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2
    have hw : ((Real.log q, X, η) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈
        Set.Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) :=
      ⟨Real.log_lt_log hq hqB, lt_of_lt_of_le hX0 hX1, hη1, hη2⟩
    have hnhds := hWo.mem_nhds hw
    have hsnd : Set.MapsTo (Prod.snd : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ)
        (Set.Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1))
        (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := fun w hw => hw.2
    have hPE : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * v.2.1) * B.F v.2.1 v.2.2)
        (Set.Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) :=
      hP2s.comp contDiff_snd.contDiffOn hsnd
    have hPU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => B.U v.2.1 v.2.2)
        (Set.Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) :=
      hUs.comp contDiff_snd.contDiffOn hsnd
    have hqp0 : 0 ≤ q ^ (2 * B.h) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    have hqp1 : q ^ (2 * B.h) ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one hq.le (hqB.le.trans hqB1) (by linarith)
    have hC7a : C7 * q ^ (2 * B.h) ≤ |C7| :=
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hqp0).trans
        (mul_le_of_le_one_right (abs_nonneg _) hqp1)
    obtain ⟨hdE, hdU, -⟩ := hC7 q X η hq hqB hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2
    have hsplit : ∀ (L P : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (Set.Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P (Set.Iio (Real.log B.qB) ×ˢ (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1)) →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w => L w - P w) (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C7 * q ^ (2 * B.h) →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m P (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ C1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m L (Real.log q, X, η)‖ ≤ |C7| + C1 := by
      intro L P hL hP h1 h2
      have e : L = (fun w => L w - P w) + P := by
        funext w
        simp
      rw [e, iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (((hL.sub hP).contDiffAt hnhds).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        ((hP.contDiffAt hnhds).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
      exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (h1.trans hC7a) h2)
    refine ⟨hsplit _ _ hEs hPE hdE ?_, hsplit _ _ hUbs hPU hdU ?_⟩
    · exact (hproj _ hP2s m _ hw.2).trans (hP2b X η hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2)
    · refine (hproj _ hUs m _ hw.2).trans (((hMF m X η hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2).2).trans ?_)
      rw [hC1]
      linarith [le_abs_self (MF m)]
  
  have tA : ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (g' r z t : ℝ), HasDerivAt g g' z →
      (∀ᶠ y in nhds z, f (r, y, t) = g y) →
      |fderiv ℝ f (r, z, t) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))| ≤ |g'| := by
    intro f g g' r z t hg heq
    by_cases hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (r, z, t)
    · have hl : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => ((r, y, t) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) z :=
        (hasDerivAt_const z r).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_id' z).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const z t))
      have h1 := hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt z hl
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (f ∘ fun y : ℝ => ((r, y, t) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) g' z :=
        hg.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
      exact le_of_eq (congrArg (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (h1.unique h2))
    · rw [fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hd]
      simp
  
  have tB : ∀ (h τ z D : ℝ) (Q : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h → h < 1/100 → HasDerivAt Q D z →
      (∀ y, Q y - y ^ 2 * Q y ^ (2 * h) = τ) → 0 < Q z → z ^ 2 < Q z ^ (1 - 2 * h) →
      |D| ≤ 3 * Q z ^ (1/2 + h) ∧ |z| < Q z ^ (1/2 - h) := by
    intro h τ z D Q hh0 hh1 hQ heq hq hz
    have hP : HasDerivAt (fun y => Q y - y ^ 2 * Q y ^ (2 * h))
        (D - (2 * z * Q z ^ (2 * h) + z ^ 2 * (D * (2 * h) * Q z ^ (2 * h - 1)))) z := by
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) (2 * z) z := by simpa using hasDerivAt_pow 2 z
      have h2 := hQ.rpow_const (p := 2 * h) (Or.inl hq.ne')
      exact hQ.sub (h1.mul h2)
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun y => Q y - y ^ 2 * Q y ^ (2 * h)) 0 z :=
      (hasDerivAt_const z τ).congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall heq)
    have hD := hP.unique hc
    have hpos1 : 0 < Q z ^ (2 * h - 1) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _
    have hprod : Q z ^ (1 - 2 * h) * Q z ^ (2 * h - 1) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hq, show (1 - 2 * h) + (2 * h - 1) = (0:ℝ) by ring, Real.rpow_zero]
    have hm1 : z ^ 2 * Q z ^ (2 * h - 1) < 1 := by
      calc z ^ 2 * Q z ^ (2 * h - 1) < Q z ^ (1 - 2 * h) * Q z ^ (2 * h - 1) :=
            mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hz hpos1
        _ = 1 := hprod
    have hlin : D * (1 - 2 * h * (z ^ 2 * Q z ^ (2 * h - 1))) = 2 * z * Q z ^ (2 * h) := by
      linear_combination hD
    have hhm : h * (z ^ 2 * Q z ^ (2 * h - 1)) ≤ h := mul_le_of_le_one_right hh0.le hm1.le
    have hfac : 2 / 3 ≤ 1 - 2 * h * (z ^ 2 * Q z ^ (2 * h - 1)) := by linarith
    have hb : 0 ≤ Q z ^ (1/2 - h) := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _).le
    have hzb : |z| < Q z ^ (1/2 - h) := by
      apply abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq _ hb
      rw [sq (Q z ^ (1/2 - h)), ← Real.rpow_add hq, show (1/2 - h) + (1/2 - h) = 1 - 2 * h by ring]
      exact hz
    refine ⟨?_, hzb⟩
    have h2h : 0 < Q z ^ (2 * h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _
    have habs : |D| * (1 - 2 * h * (z ^ 2 * Q z ^ (2 * h - 1))) = 2 * |z| * Q z ^ (2 * h) := by
      have := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => |x|) hlin
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 1 - 2 * h * (z ^ 2 * Q z ^ (2 * h - 1))),
        abs_of_pos h2h, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)] at this
      exact this
    have hqa : Q z ^ (1/2 + h) = Q z ^ (1/2 - h) * Q z ^ (2 * h) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hq]; congr 1; ring
    have h3 : 2 * |z| * Q z ^ (2 * h) ≤ 2 * Q z ^ (1/2 + h) := by
      rw [hqa]
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hzb.le h2h.le
      linarith
    have h4 : |D| * (2 / 3) ≤ |D| * (1 - 2 * h * (z ^ 2 * Q z ^ (2 * h - 1))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfac (abs_nonneg D)
    linarith
  
  have tC : ∀ (h : ℝ) (Q : ℝ → ℝ) (Φ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (z D r Xb C0 C1 : ℝ), 0 ≤ h → h ≤ 1/2 →
      HasDerivAt Q D z → 0 < Q z → |D| ≤ 3 * Q z ^ (1/2 + h) → |z| < Q z ^ (1/2 - h) →
      r ^ 2 / (2 * Q z) ≤ Xb →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ (Real.log (Q z), r ^ 2 / (2 * Q z), z * Q z ^ (-(1/2 - h))) →
      |Φ (Real.log (Q z), r ^ 2 / (2 * Q z), z * Q z ^ (-(1/2 - h)))| ≤ C0 →
      ‖fderiv ℝ Φ (Real.log (Q z), r ^ 2 / (2 * Q z), z * Q z ^ (-(1/2 - h)))‖ ≤ C1 →
      ∃ G' : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Q y ^ (-(1/2 + h)) *
          Φ (Real.log (Q y), r ^ 2 / (2 * Q y), y * Q y ^ (-(1/2 - h)))) G' z ∧
        |G'| * Q z ≤ 3 * C0 + 3 * (1 + Xb) * C1 := by
    intro h Q Φ z D r Xb C0 C1 hh0 hh1 hQ hq hD hz hX hΦ hC0 hC1
    have hq0 : Q z ≠ 0 := hq.ne'
    have hlg : HasDerivAt (fun y => Real.log (Q y)) (D / Q z) z := hQ.log hq0
    have hXd : HasDerivAt (fun y => r ^ 2 / (2 * Q y)) (-(r ^ 2 / (2 * Q z)) * (D / Q z)) z := by
      have h1 := (hasDerivAt_const z (r ^ 2)).div (hQ.const_mul 2) (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hq0)
      exact h1.congr_deriv (by field_simp; ring)
    have hη : HasDerivAt (fun y => y * Q y ^ (-(1/2 - h)))
        (1 * Q z ^ (-(1/2 - h)) + z * (D * (-(1/2 - h)) * Q z ^ (-(1/2 - h) - 1))) z :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' z).mul (hQ.rpow_const (Or.inl hq0))
    have hW := hlg.prodMk (hXd.prodMk hη)
    have hΦc := hΦ.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt z hW
    have hw : HasDerivAt (fun y => Q y ^ (-(1/2 + h))) (D * (-(1/2 + h)) * Q z ^ (-(1/2 + h) - 1)) z :=
      hQ.rpow_const (Or.inl hq0)
    have hG := hw.mul hΦc
    refine ⟨_, hG, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : ℝ, e = Q z ^ (h - 1/2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : ℝ, u = Q z ^ (-(1/2 + h)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have he0 : 0 < e := by rw [he]; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _
    have hu0 : 0 < u := by rw [hu]; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _
    have hqa : Q z ^ (1/2 + h) = e * Q z := by
      rw [he, show (1/2 + h : ℝ) = (h - 1/2) + 1 by ring, Real.rpow_add hq, Real.rpow_one]
    have hqb : Q z ^ (-(1/2 - h)) = e := by rw [he]; congr 1; ring
    have hqbpos : 0 < Q z ^ (1/2 - h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _
    have hbe : Q z ^ (1/2 - h) * e = 1 := by
      rw [← hqb, Real.rpow_neg hq.le, mul_inv_cancel₀ hqbpos.ne']
    have hue : u * (e * Q z) = 1 := by
      rw [hu, ← hqa, Real.rpow_neg hq.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _).ne']
    have hvq : Q z ^ (-(1/2 - h) - 1) = e / Q z := by
      rw [Real.rpow_sub_one hq0, hqb]
    have hwq : Q z ^ (-(1/2 + h) - 1) = u / Q z := by
      rw [Real.rpow_sub_one hq0, hu]
    have key : ∀ (Φ0 : ℝ) (L : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ), |Φ0| ≤ C0 → ‖L‖ ≤ C1 →
        |D * (-(1/2 + h)) * Q z ^ (-(1/2 + h) - 1) * Φ0 + Q z ^ (-(1/2 + h)) *
          L (D / Q z, -(r ^ 2 / (2 * Q z)) * (D / Q z),

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∃ L : ℝ, 0 ≤ L ∧ ∀ (X η ρ X0 η0 ρ0 : ℝ), B.Xa / 2 ≤ X → X ≤ 2 * B.Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → 1/2 ≤ ρ → ρ ≤ 2 → B.Xa / 2 ≤ X0 → X0 ≤ 2 * B.Xb → -1 < η0 → η0 < 1 → 1/2 ≤ ρ0 → ρ0 ≤ 2 → |ρ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X η - ρ0 ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X0 η0| + |ρ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * (2 * X * deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η) X) - ρ0 ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * (2 * X0 * deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η0) X0)| + |ρ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η) X) - ρ0 ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * (Real.sqrt (2 * X0) * deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η0) X0)| + |Real.sqrt (2 * X * ρ) - Real.sqrt (2 * X0 * ρ0)| ≤ L * (|X - X0| + |η - η0| + |ρ - ρ0|)
