signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG), B.ok → ∃ L : ℝ, 0 ≤ L ∧ ∀ (X η ρ X0 η0 ρ0 : ℝ), B.Xa / 2 ≤ X → X ≤ 2 * B.Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 → 1/2 ≤ ρ → ρ ≤ 2 → B.Xa / 2 ≤ X0 → X0 ≤ 2 * B.Xb → -1 < η0 → η0 < 1 → 1/2 ≤ ρ0 → ρ0 ≤ 2 → |ρ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X η - ρ0 ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X0 η0| + |ρ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * (2 * X * deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η) X) - ρ0 ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * (2 * X0 * deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η0) X0)| + |ρ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η) X) - ρ0 ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * (Real.sqrt (2 * X0) * deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η0) X0)| + |Real.sqrt (2 * X * ρ) - Real.sqrt (2 * X0 * ρ0)| ≤ L * (|X - X0| + |η - η0| + |ρ - ρ0|)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hB
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -⟩ := hB.2.1
  obtain ⟨hFs, hUs, -, hbd⟩ := hB.2.2.1
  have hXb0 : 0 < B.Xb := by linarith
  have ha0 : 0 < B.Xa / 2 := by linarith
  
  have core : ∀ (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), 0 < a →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
      (∀ X₀ X₁ : ℝ, 0 < X₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₀ ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (Function.uncurry F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (Function.uncurry U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) →
      ∃ C0 C1 C2 : ℝ, 0 ≤ C0 ∧ 0 ≤ C1 ∧ 0 ≤ C2 ∧
        ∀ X X' η η' : ℝ, a ≤ X → X ≤ b → a ≤ X' → X' ≤ b → -1 < η → η < 1 → -1 < η' → η' < 1 →
          |F X' η'| ≤ C0 ∧
          |F X η - F X' η'| ≤ C1 * (|X - X'| + |η - η'|) ∧
          |deriv (fun Y => F Y η') X'| ≤ C1 ∧
          |deriv (fun Y => F Y η) X - deriv (fun Y => F Y η') X'| ≤ C2 * (|X - X'| + |η - η'|) ∧
          |deriv (fun Y => U Y η') X'| ≤ C1 ∧
          |deriv (fun Y => U Y η) X - deriv (fun Y => U Y η') X'| ≤ C2 * (|X - X'| + |η - η'|) := by
    intro F U a b ha hFs hUs hbd
    obtain ⟨Cz, hCz⟩ := hbd a b ha 0
    obtain ⟨Ca, hCa⟩ := hbd a b ha 1
    obtain ⟨Cb, hCb⟩ := hbd a b ha 2
    have hO : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_Ioo
    have hSc : Convex ℝ (Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1) := (convex_Icc a b).prod (convex_Ioo (-1) 1)
    have hSO : ∀ z ∈ Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, z ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := fun z hz =>
      ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le ha hz.1.1, hz.2⟩
    have e1 : ‖((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))‖ = 1 := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
    have mvt : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry f) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) →
        (∀ X η : ℝ, a ≤ X → X ≤ b → -1 < η → η < 1 →
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (Function.uncurry f) (X, η)‖ ≤ max Ca 0 ∧
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (Function.uncurry f) (X, η)‖ ≤ max Cb 0) →
        ∀ X X' η η' : ℝ, a ≤ X → X ≤ b → a ≤ X' → X' ≤ b → -1 < η → η < 1 → -1 < η' → η' < 1 →
        |f X η - f X' η'| ≤ max Ca 0 * (|X - X'| + |η - η'|) ∧
        deriv (fun Y => f Y η) X = fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X, η) (1, 0) ∧
        |fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X, η) (1, 0)| ≤ max Ca 0 ∧
        |fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X, η) (1, 0) -
            fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X', η') (1, 0)| ≤ max Cb 0 * (|X - X'| + |η - η'|) := by
      intro f hs hb X X' η η' h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7 h8
      have hca : ∀ z ∈ Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry f) z :=
        fun z hz => hs.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds (hSO z hz))
      have hd1 : ∀ z ∈ Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, DifferentiableAt ℝ (Function.uncurry f) z :=
        fun z hz => (hca z hz).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hd2 : ∀ z ∈ Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
          DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f)) z := fun z hz =>
        ((hca z hz).fderiv_right (m := 1) (by simp)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have hb1 : ∀ z ∈ Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, ‖fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) z‖ ≤ max Ca 0 :=
        fun z hz => by
          rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_one]
          exact (hb z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2).1
      have hb2 : ∀ z ∈ Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1,
          ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f)) z‖ ≤ max Cb 0 := fun z hz => by
        rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_one, norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
        exact (hb z.1 z.2 hz.1.1 hz.1.2 hz.2.1 hz.2.2).2
      have hz : ((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h5, h6⟩
      have hz' : ((X', η') : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Icc a b ×ˢ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1 := ⟨⟨h3, h4⟩, h7, h8⟩
      have hnorm : ‖((X, η) : ℝ × ℝ) - (X', η')‖ ≤ |X - X'| + |η - η'| := by
        rw [Prod.mk_sub_mk, Prod.norm_def, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact max_le (le_add_of_nonneg_right (abs_nonneg _)) (le_add_of_nonneg_left (abs_nonneg _))
      have hC1 : 0 ≤ max Ca 0 := le_max_right _ _
      have hC2 : 0 ≤ max Cb 0 := le_max_right _ _
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have := hSc.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hd1 hb1 hz' hz
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
        exact this.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm hC1)
      · have hF := (hd1 _ hz).hasFDerivAt
        have hc : HasDerivAt (fun Y : ℝ => (id Y, η)) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) X :=
          (hasDerivAt_id X).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X η)
        exact (hF.comp_hasDerivAt X hc).deriv
      · calc |fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X, η) (1, 0)|
            = ‖fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X, η) (1, 0)‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
          _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X, η)‖ * ‖((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))‖ :=
              ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
          _ ≤ max Ca 0 := by rw [e1, mul_one]; exact hb1 _ hz
      · have := hSc.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hd2 hb2 hz' hz
        calc |fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X, η) (1, 0) -
              fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X', η') (1, 0)|
            = ‖(fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X, η) -
                fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X', η')) (1, 0)‖ := by
              rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
          _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X, η) - fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (X', η')‖ *
                ‖((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
          _ ≤ max Cb 0 * (|X - X'| + |η - η'|) := by
              rw [e1, mul_one]; exact this.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm hC2)
    have hbF : ∀ X η : ℝ, a ≤ X → X ≤ b → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (Function.uncurry F) (X, η)‖ ≤ max Ca 0 ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (Function.uncurry F) (X, η)‖ ≤ max Cb 0 := fun X η p q r s =>
      ⟨(hCa X η p q r s).1.trans (le_max_left _ _), (hCb X η p q r s).1.trans (le_max_left _ _)⟩
    have hbU : ∀ X η : ℝ, a ≤ X → X ≤ b → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (Function.uncurry U) (X, η)‖ ≤ max Ca 0 ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (Function.uncurry U) (X, η)‖ ≤ max Cb 0 := fun X η p q r s =>
      ⟨(hCa X η p q r s).2.trans (le_max_left _ _), (hCb X η p q r s).2.trans (le_max_left _ _)⟩
    refine ⟨max Cz 0, max Ca 0, max Cb 0, le_max_right _ _, le_max_right _ _, le_max_right _ _, ?_⟩
    intro X X' η η' h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7 h8
    obtain ⟨F1, F2, -, F4⟩ := mvt F hFs hbF X X' η η' h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7 h8
    obtain ⟨-, F2', F3', -⟩ := mvt F hFs hbF X' X η' η h3 h4 h1 h2 h7 h8 h5 h6
    obtain ⟨-, U2, -, U4⟩ := mvt U hUs hbU X X' η η' h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7 h8
    obtain ⟨-, U2', U3', -⟩ := mvt U hUs hbU X' X η' η h3 h4 h1 h2 h7 h8 h5 h6
    have hF0 : |F X' η'| ≤ max Cz 0 := by
      have := (hCz X' η' h3 h4 h7 h8).1
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      exact this.trans (le_max_left _ _)
    refine ⟨hF0, F1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [F2']; exact F3'
    · rw [F2, F2']; exact F4
    · rw [U2']; exact U3'
    · rw [U2, U2']; exact U4
  obtain ⟨C0, C1, C2, hC0, hC1, hC2, hW⟩ :=
    core B.F B.U (B.Xa / 2) (2 * B.Xb) ha0 hFs hUs hbd
  
  have wbd : ∀ (e x : ℝ), 0 ≤ e → 1/2 ≤ x → x ^ (-e) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ e := by
    intro e x he hx
    have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hx0.le, ← Real.inv_rpow hx0.le]
    apply Real.rpow_le_rpow (inv_nonneg.mpr hx0.le) _ he
    rw [inv_eq_one_div, div_le_iff₀ hx0]
    linarith
  have h8 : (2:ℝ) ^ (3:ℝ) = 8 := by
    rw [show (3:ℝ) = ((3:ℕ):ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_natCast]; norm_num
  have wle : ∀ x : ℝ, 1/2 ≤ x → 0 < x ^ (-(1 + B.h)) ∧ x ^ (-(1 + B.h)) ≤ 4 := by
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith) _, ?_⟩
    calc x ^ (-(1 + B.h)) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ (1 + B.h) := wbd _ _ (by linarith) hx
      _ ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ (2:ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
      _ = 4 := by rw [Real.rpow_two]; norm_num
  have wlip : ∀ x y : ℝ, 1/2 ≤ x → x ≤ 2 → 1/2 ≤ y → y ≤ 2 →
      |y ^ (-(1 + B.h)) - x ^ (-(1 + B.h))| ≤ 16 * |y - x| := by
    intro x y hx1 hx2 hy1 hy2
    have hder : ∀ z ∈ Set.Icc (1/2:ℝ) 2, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t ^ (-(1 + B.h)))
        (-(1 + B.h) * z ^ (-(1 + B.h) - 1)) z := fun z hz =>
      Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl (show (0:ℝ) < z by linarith [hz.1]).ne')
    have hb : ∀ z ∈ Set.Icc (1/2:ℝ) 2, ‖deriv (fun t : ℝ => t ^ (-(1 + B.h))) z‖ ≤ 16 := by
      intro z hz
      rw [(hder z hz).deriv, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      have e : -(1 + B.h) - 1 = -(2 + B.h) := by ring
      rw [e]
      have h1 : |-(1 + B.h)| ≤ 2 := by
        rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos (show (0:ℝ) < 1 + B.h by linarith)]; linarith
      have h2 : |z ^ (-(2 + B.h))| ≤ 8 := by
        rw [abs_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (show (0:ℝ) < z by linarith [hz.1]) _)]
        calc z ^ (-(2 + B.h)) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ (2 + B.h) := wbd _ _ (by linarith) hz.1
          _ ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ (3:ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
          _ = 8 := h8
      calc |-(1 + B.h)| * |z ^ (-(2 + B.h))| ≤ 2 * 8 :=
            mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        _ = 16 := by norm_num
    have := (convex_Icc (1/2:ℝ) 2).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
      (fun z hz => (hder z hz).differentiableAt) hb ⟨hx1, hx2⟩ ⟨hy1, hy2⟩
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
  have prodD : ∀ a b a' b' Ma Mb da db : ℝ, |a| ≤ Ma → |b'| ≤ Mb → |a - a'| ≤ da → |b - b'| ≤ db →
      |a * b - a' * b'| ≤ Ma * db + Mb * da := by
    intro a b a' b' Ma Mb da db ha hb hda hdb
    have e : a * b - a' * b' = a * (b - b') + b' * (a - a') := by ring
    rw [e]
    refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
    · rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul ha hdb (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans ha)
    · rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hb hda (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans hb)
  
  have hsXa : 0 < Real.sqrt B.Xa := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hXa
  have hsa : 0 < Real.sqrt (B.Xa / 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr ha0
  have hsb0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (4 * B.Xb) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hK1 : 0 ≤ 4 * C1 + C0 * 16 := by positivity
  have hK2 : 0 ≤ 4 * (4 * B.Xb * C2 + 2 * C1) + 4 * B.Xb * C1 * 16 := by positivity
  have hK3 : 0 ≤ 4 * (Real.sqrt (4 * B.Xb) * C2 + C1 / Real.sqrt B.Xa) +
      Real.sqrt (4 * B.Xb) * C1 * 16 := by positivity
  have hK4 : 0 ≤ (4 + 4 * B.Xb) / (2 * Real.sqrt (B.Xa / 2)) := by positivity
  refine ⟨(4 * C1 + C0 * 16) + (4 * (4 * B.Xb * C2 + 2 * C1) + 4 * B.Xb * C1 * 16) +
      (4 * (Real.sqrt (4 * B.Xb) * C2 + C1 / Real.sqrt B.Xa) + Real.sqrt (4 * B.Xb) * C1 * 16) +
      (4 + 4 * B.Xb) / (2 * Real.sqrt (B.Xa / 2)), by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro X η ρ X0 η0 ρ0 hX1 hX2 hη1 hη2 hρ1 hρ2 hX01 hX02 hη01 hη02 hρ01 hρ02
  have hXS : |X - X0| ≤ |X - X0| + |η - η0| + |ρ - ρ0| := by
    linarith [abs_nonneg (η - η0), abs_nonneg (ρ - ρ0)]
  have hρS : |ρ - ρ0| ≤ |X - X0| + |η - η0| + |ρ - ρ0| := by
    linarith [abs_nonneg (η - η0), abs_nonneg (X - X0)]
  have hΔ : |X - X0| + |η - η0| ≤ |X - X0| + |η - η0| + |ρ - ρ0| := by
    linarith [abs_nonneg (ρ - ρ0)]
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ |X - X0| + |η - η0| + |ρ - ρ0| := by
    linarith [abs_nonneg (η - η0), abs_nonneg (X - X0), abs_nonneg (ρ - ρ0)]
  set S := |X - X0| + |η - η0| + |ρ - ρ0| with hS
  set sXa := Real.sqrt B.Xa with hsXadef
  set sa := Real.sqrt (B.Xa / 2) with hsadef
  set sb := Real.sqrt (4 * B.Xb) with hsbdef
  obtain ⟨aF', dF0, aP', dP0, aQ', dQ0⟩ := hW X X0 η η0 hX1 hX2 hX01 hX02 hη1 hη2 hη01 hη02
  have dF : |B.F X η - B.F X0 η0| ≤ C1 * S := dF0.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hΔ hC1)
  have dP : |deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η) X - deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η0) X0| ≤ C2 * S :=
    dP0.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hΔ hC2)
  have dQ : |deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η) X - deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η0) X0| ≤ C2 * S :=
    dQ0.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hΔ hC2)
  obtain ⟨w1, w2⟩ := wle ρ hρ1
  have aw : |ρ ^ (-(1 + B.h))| ≤ 4 := by rw [abs_of_pos w1]; exact w2
  have dw : |ρ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) - ρ0 ^ (-(1 + B.h))| ≤ 16 * S :=
    (wlip ρ0 ρ hρ01 hρ02 hρ1 hρ2).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hρS (by norm_num))
  
  have T1 : |ρ ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X η - ρ0 ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F X0 η0| ≤
      4 * (C1 * S) + C0 * (16 * S) :=
    prodD _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ aw aF' dw dF
  
  have aG' : |2 * X0 * deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η0) X0| ≤ 4 * B.Xb * C1 := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * X0)]
    exact mul_le_mul (by linarith) aP' (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
  have dG : |2 * X * deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η) X - 2 * X0 * deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η0) X0| ≤
      (4 * B.Xb * C2 + 2 * C1) * S := by
    have e : 2 * X * deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η) X - 2 * X0 * deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η0) X0 =
        2 * X * (deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η) X - deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η0) X0) +
          deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η0) X0 * (2 * (X - X0)) := by ring
    rw [e]
    refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
    have k1 : |2 * X * (deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η) X - deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η0) X0)| ≤
        4 * B.Xb * (C2 * S) := by
      rw [abs_mul (2 * X), abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * X)]
      exact mul_le_mul (by linarith) dP (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    have k2 : |deriv (fun Y => B.F Y η0) X0 * (2 * (X - X0))| ≤ C1 * (2 * S) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul (2:ℝ), abs_two]
      exact mul_le_mul aP' (by linarith) (by linarith [abs_nonneg (X - X0)]) hC1
    have e2 : (4 * B.Xb * C2 + 2 * C1) * S = 4 * B.Xb * (C2 * S) + C1 * (2 * S) := by ring
    linarith
  have T2 := prodD _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ aw aG' dw dG
  
  have hs1 : sXa ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * X) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hs2 : sXa ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * X0) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hs3 : Real.sqrt (2 * X) ≤ sb := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hs4 : Real.sqrt (2 * X0) ≤ sb := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hsum : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * X) + Real.sqrt (2 * X0) := by linarith
  have hsd : Real.sqrt (2 * X) - Real.sqrt (2 * X0) =
      2 * (X - X0) / (Real.sqrt (2 * X) + Real.sqrt (2 * X0)) := by
    rw [eq_div_iff hsum.ne']
    linear_combination (Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * X by linarith)) -
      (Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * X0 by linarith))
  have hsdb : |Real.sqrt (2 * X) - Real.sqrt (2 * X0)| ≤ S / sXa := by
    rw [hsd, abs_div, abs_of_pos hsum, abs_mul, abs_two]
    calc 2 * |X - X0| / (Real.sqrt (2 * X) + Real.sqrt (2 * X0)) ≤ 2 * S / (2 * sXa) :=
          div_le_div₀ (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
      _ = S / sXa := mul_div_mul_left _ _ two_ne_zero
  have aH' : |Real.sqrt (2 * X0) * deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η0) X0| ≤ sb * C1 := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    exact mul_le_mul hs4 aQ' (abs_nonneg _) hsb0
  have dH : |Real.sqrt (2 * X) * deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η) X -
      Real.sqrt (2 * X0) * deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η0) X0| ≤ (sb * C2 + C1 / sXa) * S := by
    have e : Real.sqrt (2 * X) * deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η) X -
        Real.sqrt (2 * X0) * deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η0) X0 =
        Real.sqrt (2 * X) * (deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η) X - deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η0) X0) +
          deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η0) X0 * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) - Real.sqrt (2 * X0)) := by ring
    rw [e]
    refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
    have k1 : |Real.sqrt (2 * X) * (deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η) X - deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η0) X0)| ≤
        sb * (C2 * S) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
      exact mul_le_mul hs3 dQ (abs_nonneg _) hsb0
    have k2 : |deriv (fun Y => B.U Y η0) X0 * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) - Real.sqrt (2 * X0))| ≤
        C1 * (S / sXa) := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul aQ' hsdb (abs_nonneg _) hC1
    have e2 : (sb * C2 + C1 / sXa) * S = sb * (C2 * S) + C1 * (S / sXa) := by ring
    linarith
  have T3 := prodD _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ aw aH' dw dH
  
  have ha : B.Xa / 2 ≤ 2 * X * ρ := by
    have := mul_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ X by linarith) (show (0:ℝ) ≤ ρ - 1/2 by linarith)
    linarith
  have hb : B.Xa / 2 ≤ 2 * X0 * ρ0 := by
    have := mul_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ X0 by linarith) (show (0:ℝ) ≤ ρ0 - 1/2 by linarith)
    linarith
  have sa1 : sa ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * X * ρ) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ha
  have sb1 : sa ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * X0 * ρ0) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hb
  have hsum2 : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * X * ρ) + Real.sqrt (2 * X0 * ρ0) := by linarith
  have hsd2 : Real.sqrt (2 * X * ρ) - Real.sqrt (2 * X0 * ρ0) =
      (2 * X * ρ - 2 * X0 * ρ0) / (Real.sqrt (2 * X * ρ) + Real.sqrt (2 * X0 * ρ0)) := by
    rw [eq_div_iff hsum2.ne']
    linear_combination (Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * X * ρ by linarith)) -
      (Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * X0 * ρ0 by linarith))
  have hab : |2 * X * ρ - 2 * X0 * ρ0| ≤ (4 + 4 * B.Xb) * S := by
    have e : 2 * X * ρ - 2 * X0 * ρ0 = 2 * ρ * (X - X0) + 2 * X0 * (ρ - ρ0) := by ring
    rw [e]
    refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
    rw [abs_mul (2 * ρ) (X - X0), abs_mul (2 * X0) (ρ - ρ0),
      abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * ρ),
      abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * X0)]
    have k1 : 2 * ρ * |X - X0| ≤ 4 * S :=
      mul_le_mul (by linarith) hXS (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
    have k2 : 2 * X0 * |ρ - ρ0| ≤ 4 * B.Xb * S :=
      mul_le_mul (by linarith) hρS (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    linarith
  have T4 : |Real.sqrt (2 * X * ρ) - Real.sqrt (2 * X0 * ρ0)| ≤
      (4 + 4 * B.Xb) / (2 * sa) * S := by
    rw [hsd2, abs_div, abs_of_pos hsum2, div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    exact div_le_div₀ (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hS0) hab (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hfin : ((4 * C1 + C0 * 16) + (4 * (4 * B.Xb * C2 + 2 * C1) + 4 * B.Xb * C1 * 16) +
      (4 * (sb * C2 + C1 / sXa) + sb * C1 * 16) + (4 + 4 * B.Xb) / (2 * sa)) * S =
      (4 * (C1 * S) + C0 * (16 * S)) +
      (4 * ((4 * B.Xb * C2 + 2 * C1) * S) + 4 * B.Xb * C1 * (16 * S)) +
      (4 * ((sb * C2 + C1 / sXa) * S) + sb * C1 * (16 * S)) +
      (4 + 4 * B.Xb) / (2 * sa) * S := by ring
  rw [hfin]
  linarith [T1, T2, T3, T4]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (c : WC) (β : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 1/2) c → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β (velW5 B G c) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β - kapS) (pchPh5 B G c)

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (c : WC) (β : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 1/2) c → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β (velW5 B G c) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β - kapS) (pchPh5 B G c)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨lv, hv⟩ := velRem5_class B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lp, hp⟩ := pulse_support_good_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lg, hg⟩ := good_nphi5_nb_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lb, hb⟩ := band_coarse_gap_v5 B.h hh0 hh1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := visc5_scalar_factors_v5 B hok 0 0
  choose Cn hCn using hg
  refine ⟨lv + lp + lg + lb + n0, fun l0 hl0 c β hc _ => ?_⟩
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hq1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hQb]; exact pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0.le
  have hDO : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := (domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok).1
  have hDq : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < qC B.h ξ := (domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok).2.2.1
  
  have key : ∀ (α δ : ℝ) (ρ : Lab → Cyl → ℝ) (a : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a →
      (∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (ρ γ) ξ) →
      (∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) (c : ℝ × ℝ), ρ γ (shY ξ c) = ρ γ ξ) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 →
        qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 → B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ → NB B.h (ρ γ) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * δ)) →
      InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + δ)
        (fun γ m ξ => dotProduct (fun i => ((ρ γ ξ * nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) (a γ m ξ)) := by
    intro α δ ρ a ha hρs hρY hρB
    have hsm : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) →
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ ((fun (γ : Lab) (_ : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) (i : Fin 3) =>
          ((ρ γ ξ * nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) γ m) ξ := by
      intro γ m ξ hξ hts
      obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hxi, het⟩ := hp l0 (by omega) α a ha γ m ξ hξ hts
      have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
      have hξB : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < B.qB :=
        ⟨hξ'.1, hξ'.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ'.2.2 hqsB⟩
      obtain ⟨U, hUo, hξU, -, hnU, -, -⟩ := good_coeff_smooth_v5 B G γ ξ hok hξB hxi het
      rw [contDiffAt_pi]
      intro i
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => ρ γ η * nPhi5 B G γ η i) ξ :=
        (hρs γ ξ hξ).mul ((hnU i).contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hξU))
      have h2 := (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff (n := ∞)).contDiffAt.comp ξ h1
      exact h2
    have hdk : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → ∀ c : ℝ × ℝ,
        IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c →
        (fun (γ : Lab) (_ : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) (i : Fin 3) => ((ρ γ ξ * nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) γ m (shY ξ c) =
        (fun (γ : Lab) (_ : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) (i : Fin 3) => ((ρ γ ξ * nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) γ m ξ := by
      intro γ m ξ hξ hne c hc
      have hts : ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) := subset_tsupport _ hne
      obtain ⟨-, -, -, hb1, hb2, -⟩ := hp l0 (by omega) α a ha γ m ξ hξ hts
      have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
      have hcb := (hb γ.1 l0 (qC B.h ξ) (by omega) (hDq ξ hξ) hξ'.2.2 hb1 hb2).1
      have hn := nPhi5_deck_v5 B G γ (coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) c hcb hc ξ
      funext i
      simp only [hρY γ ξ c, hn]
    have hnb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) →
        B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
        NB B.h ((fun (γ : Lab) (_ : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) (i : Fin 3) => ((ρ γ ξ * nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) γ m) k ξ
          ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * δ) * SC B.h ξ ^ b := by
      intro k
      choose Cr hCr using hρB
      refine ⟨3 * (2 ^ k * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cr j|) * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cn j|)), 1, ?_⟩
      intro γ m ξ hξ hts _ _
      obtain ⟨-, hact, hlγ, hb1, hb2, hX1', hX2', hxi, het⟩ := hp l0 (by omega) α a ha γ m ξ hξ hts
      have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
      have hξB : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < B.qB :=
        ⟨hξ'.1, hξ'.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ'.2.2 hqsB⟩
      obtain ⟨U, hUo, hξU, -, hnU, -, -⟩ := good_coeff_smooth_v5 B G γ ξ hok hξB hxi het
      have hSC0 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by unfold SC; positivity
      have hqd : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * δ) := Real.rpow_nonneg (hDq ξ hξ).le _
      have hr : ∀ j, j ≤ k → NB B.h (ρ γ) j ξ ≤
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cr j|) * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * δ) := by
        intro j hj
        refine le_trans (hCr j γ ξ hξ hb1 hb2 hX1') (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hqd)
        refine le_trans (le_abs_self _) ?_
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cr j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
      have hn : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j, j ≤ k → NB B.h (fun η => nPhi5 B G γ η i) j ξ ≤
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cn j|) * SC B.h ξ := by
        intro i j hj
        refine le_trans (hCn j l0 (by omega) γ hact hlγ ξ hξ hb1 hb2 hX1' hX2' hxi het i) ?_
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hSC0
        refine le_trans (le_abs_self _) ?_
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cn j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
      have hprod : ∀ i : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η => ρ γ η * nPhi5 B G γ η i) k ξ ≤
          2 ^ k * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cr j|) * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * δ)) *
            ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cn j|) * SC B.h ξ) :=
        fun i => nb_real_mul_le_v5 B.h ξ (ρ γ) (fun η => nPhi5 B G γ η i) k _ _ (hρs γ ξ hξ)
          ((hnU i).contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hξU)) hr (hn i)
      have hU' : IsOpen (U ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := hUo.inter hDO
      have hvec := nb_vec_complex_v5 B.h (U ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ξ 1
        (fun i η => ρ γ η * nPhi5 B G γ η i)
        (fun η i => ((ρ γ η * nPhi5 B G γ η i : ℝ) : ℂ)) hU' ⟨hξU, hξ⟩
        (fun i η hη => ((hρs γ η hη.2).contDiffWithinAt).mul ((hnU i).mono Set.inter_subset_left η hη))
        (fun η _ => by funext i; simp only [one_mul]) k
      rw [norm_one, one_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three] at hvec
      rw [Real.rpow_one]
      calc NB B.h (fun η i => ((ρ γ η * nPhi5 B G γ η i : ℝ) : ℂ)) k ξ ≤ _ := hvec
        _ ≤ 2 ^ k * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cr j|) * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * δ)) *
              ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cn j|) * SC B.h ξ)
            + 2 ^ k * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cr j|) * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * δ)) *
              ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cn j|) * SC B.h ξ)
            + 2 ^ k * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cr j|) * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * δ)) *
              ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cn j|) * SC B.h ξ) :=
          add_le_add (add_le_add (hprod 0) (hprod 1)) (hprod 2)
        _ = _ := by ring
    exact inWg5_dot_mult B G l0 hok α δ a
      (fun (γ : Lab) (_ : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl) (i : Fin 3) => ((ρ γ ξ * nPhi5 B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) ha hsm hdk hnb
  
  have hVR := hv l0 (by omega) (β + 1/2) c hc
  
  have hRot : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (β + 1/2) (fun γ m ξ => rotC (c γ m ξ)) := by
    have e : (fun γ m ξ => rotC (c γ m ξ)) =
        (fun γ m ξ => crossC ((fun (_ : Lab) (_ : ℤ) (_ : Cyl) => (![0, 0, -1] : Fin 3 → ℂ)) γ m ξ)
          (c γ m ξ)) := by
      funext γ m ξ i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [crossC, rotC]
    have h := inWg5_cross_mult B G l0 hok (β + 1/2) 0 c
      (fun (_ : Lab) (_ : ℤ) (_ : Cyl) => (![0, 0, -1] : Fin 3 → ℂ)) hc
      (fun _ _ _ _ _ => contDiffAt_const) (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl) (fun k => ⟨1, 0, fun γ m ξ _ _ _ _ => by
        simp only [mul_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
        show ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun _ : Cyl => (![0, 0, -1] : Fin 3 → ℂ)) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)‖ ≤ 1
        refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk | hk
        · subst hk
          rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Fin.prod_univ_zero, mul_one]
          refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg zero_le_one).mpr (fun i => ?_)
          fin_cases i <;> simp
        · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (by omega : k ≠ 0)]
          simp⟩)
    rw [add_zero] at h
    rw [e]
    exact h
  
  obtain ⟨hMs, hMb⟩ := wmo_amp_multipliers_v5 B hok (qsOf l0) hq1
  have hdZ : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (c : ℝ × ℝ), dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) (shY ξ c) =
      dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) ξ := by
    intro ξ c
    have e1 : shY ξ c = ξ + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), c) := by
      rcases ξ with ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4⟩
      simp [shY]
    have e2 : (fun x : Cyl => Real.log (qC B.h (x + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), c)))) =
        fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η) := by
      funext x
      simp [qC]
    unfold dZ
    rw [e1, ← fderiv_comp_add_right]
    exact congrArg (fun g => fderiv ℝ g ξ (0, 1, 0, 0)) e2
  have hq12 : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ)) ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have e : (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ)) = fun η => Real.sqrt (qC B.h η) := by
      funext η; rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    rw [e]; exact (hMs ξ hξ).1
  have hcm : ∀ (a : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (k : ℕ), ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) → NB B.h (fun η => a * f η) k ξ ≤ |a| * NB B.h f k ξ := by
    intro a f ξ k hξ hf
    have h := (nb_real_algebra_v5 B.h _ ξ hDO hξ f f hf hf k).2.1 a 0
    simp only [zero_mul, add_zero, abs_zero] at h
    exact h
  have hNB0 : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℂ) (ξ : Cyl), NB B.h f 0 ξ = ‖f ξ‖ := by
    intro f ξ
    unfold NB
    rw [← ContinuousMultilinearMap.fin0_apply_norm (x := fun i => Fin.elim0 i),
      ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply]
  
  have mult : ∀ (g : Lab → Cyl → ℝ),
      (∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (g γ) ξ) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 →
        qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 → NB B.h (g γ) k ξ ≤ C) →
      (∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (fun η => (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * (qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * g γ η)) ξ) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 →
        qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 → B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ →
        NB B.h (fun η => (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * (qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * g γ η)) k ξ
          ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (-(1/2:ℝ)))) := by
    intro g hgs hgB
    have hsm : ∀ (γ : Lab), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (1/2:ℝ) * g γ η) ξ :=
      fun γ ξ hξ => (hq12 ξ hξ).mul (hgs γ ξ hξ)
    refine ⟨fun γ ξ hξ => contDiffAt_const.mul (hsm γ ξ hξ), fun k => ?_⟩
    choose Cg hCg using hgB
    choose Cs hCs using hMb
    have hSs : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cs j| := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have hSg : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cg j| := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have hT0 : 0 ≤ 2 ^ k * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cs j|) * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cg j|) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (by norm_num) _) hSs) hSg
    refine ⟨8 * (2 ^ k * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cs j|) * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cg j|)), ?_⟩
    intro γ ξ hξ hb1 hb2 hX

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, haa, hab⟩ := hok.2.1
  have hSN : SimNorm B.h := simscale_normalized_v4 B.h hh0 hh1 hok.1
  obtain ⟨lW, hWv⟩ := pch5_wave_factor B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lM, hMf⟩ := pch5_mean_factor B hok
  obtain ⟨lS, hSm⟩ := pch5_mw_smooth B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨ls, hs⟩ := pulse_support_good_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lN, hN⟩ := good_nphi5_nb_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨lW + lM + lS + ls + lN + n0, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 Mn Q β hMn hQ

    (g_regular_of_nrm_InM_v5 B (qsOf l0) (Aex B.h) 0.9 (fun ξ => Mn ξ a) hok (hMn a)).1
  refine ⟨fun γ N => hSm l0 (by omega) Mn Q β hMnS hQ γ N, ?_⟩
  intro k
  have hk : kapS = 1 / 100000 := rfl
  have hAx : Aex B.h = 1/2 + B.h := rfl
  have hhk : B.h * kapS = B.h / 100000 := by rw [hk]; ring
  have h09 : B.h * (0.9:ℝ) = B.h * (9/10) := by norm_num
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqs0 : 0 < qsOf l0 := by rw [hQb]; positivity
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by rw [hQb]; exact pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 < B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0
  obtain ⟨hDo, hqC, hqpos, -, -, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  have hDq : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < qC B.h ξ ∧ qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 ∧ 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨-, e2, e3⟩ := hξ
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
    refine ⟨hq0, by linarith, ?_⟩
    unfold SC
    have : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| := by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))]
    exact one_le_pow₀ this
  have hEdge : ∀ X : ℝ, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb → 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X ∧
      edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X ≤ 1 ∧ 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X := by
    intro X e1 e2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold edgeWeight
      split_ifs
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      · exact le_rfl
    · unfold edgeWeight
      split_ifs
      · apply Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr
        have t1 := div_nonneg haa.le (sq_nonneg (Real.log (X / B.Xa)))
        have t2 := div_nonneg hab.le (sq_nonneg (Real.log (B.Xb / X)))
        linarith
      · norm_num
    · have hX : 0 < X := lt_trans hXa e1
      have l1 : 0 < Real.log (X / B.Xa) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr e1)
      have l2 : 0 < Real.log (B.Xb / X) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr e2)
      exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min l1 l2)
  
  have hcastc : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (c : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ → ∀ j : ℕ,
      NB B.h (fun η => ((c * f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ ≤ |c| * NB B.h f j ξ := by
    intro ξ c f hf j
    have hLn : ‖(c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ))‖ ≤ |c| :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (abs_nonneg c) (fun x => by
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, norm_smul, Complex.norm_real,
          Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs])
    have hcomp : (fun η => ((c * f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) = ⇑(c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)) ∘ f := by
      funext η
      simp [Complex.ofRealCLM_apply]
    rw [hcomp]
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (⇑(c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)) ∘ f) ξ =
        (c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)).compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left (c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)) hf
        (i := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    unfold NB
    rw [e1]
    have e2 : ((c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
        (c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)) := by
      ext v
      rfl
    rw [e2]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ))‖ *
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hLn (norm_nonneg _)
  have hNBnn : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V) (j : ℕ) (ξ : Cyl),
      0 ≤ NB B.h f j ξ := by
    intro V _ _ f j ξ
    unfold NB
    exact norm_nonneg _
  have hNBc : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (z : ℂ) (j : ℕ), NB B.h (fun _ : Cyl => z) j ξ ≤ ‖z‖ := by
    intro ξ z j
    unfold NB
    refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with hk0 | hk'
    · subst hk0; simp
    · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne hk'.ne']; simp
  have hsm : ∀ (U : Set Cyl) (f : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) U := by
    intro U f hf
    have hcomp : (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) = ⇑(Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ) ∘ f := by
      funext η; simp [Complex.ofRealCLM_apply]
    rw [hcomp]
    exact (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hf
  have hsqb : ∀ (q Q : ℝ), 0 < q → 0 < Q → q < 4 * Q → (Real.sqrt Q)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * q ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) := by
    intro q Q hq hQ hq4
    have hsq : 0 < Real.sqrt q := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hq
    have h4 : Real.sqrt q ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt Q := by
      have e4 : Real.sqrt (4 * Q) = 2 * Real.sqrt Q := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num), show (4:ℝ) = 2 * 2 by norm_num,
          Real.sqrt_mul_self (by norm_num)]
      rw [← e4]
      exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hq4.le
    have e : q ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ)) = (Real.sqrt q)⁻¹ := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg hq.le, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    rw [e]
    calc (Real.sqrt Q)⁻¹ = 2 * (2 * Real.sqrt Q)⁻¹ := by
          rw [mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ two_ne_zero, one_mul]
      _ ≤ 2 * (Real.sqrt q)⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (inv_anti₀ hsq h4) (by norm_num)
  have hkb : ∀ (q : ℝ) (l : ℕ), 0 < q → q < 4 * Qb l → (kb B.h l : ℝ) ≤ 4 * q ^ (-(B.h / 2)) := by
    intro q l hq hq4
    have hQ : 0 < Qb l := by unfold Qb; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
    have hQ1 : Qb l ≤ 1 := by
      unfold Qb; exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (by simp)
    have hkx : (kb B.h l : ℝ) = (⌈Qb l ^ (-(B.h / 2))⌉₊ : ℝ) := by
      unfold kb epsb
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul hQ.le]
      congr 3
      ring
    have hx1 : 1 ≤ Qb l ^ (-(B.h / 2)) :=
      Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hQ hQ1 (by linarith)
    have hceil : (⌈Qb l ^ (-(B.h / 2))⌉₊ : ℝ) < Qb l ^ (-(B.h / 2)) + 1 :=
      Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by linarith)
    have hq4' : q / 4 ≤ Qb l := by linarith
    have hmono : Qb l ^ (-(B.h / 2)) ≤ (q / 4) ^ (-(B.h / 2)) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (div_pos hq (by norm_num)) hq4' (by linarith)
    have hsplit : (q / 4) ^ (-(B.h / 2)) = q ^ (-(B.h / 2)) * (4:ℝ) ^ (B.h / 2) := by
      rw [Real.div_rpow hq.le (by norm_num), Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 4), div_inv_eq_mul]
    have h42 : (4:ℝ) ^ (B.h / 2) ≤ 2 := by
      have h1 := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 4) (by linarith : B.h / 2 ≤ 1/2)
      have e : (4:ℝ) ^ (1/2 : ℝ) = 2 := by
        rw [← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, show (4:ℝ) = 2 * 2 by norm_num, Real.sqrt_mul_self (by norm_num)]
      linarith
    have hqp : 0 ≤ q ^ (-(B.h / 2)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    have hm2 : q ^ (-(B.h / 2)) * (4:ℝ) ^ (B.h / 2) ≤ q ^ (-(B.h / 2)) * 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h42 hqp
    rw [hkx]
    linarith
  have hgood : ∀ γ m ξ, pchMwP5 B l0 Q γ m ξ →
      ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ 0 < qC B.h ξ ∧ qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 ∧
      ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB ∧ ActiveL4 B G γ ∧ l0 ≤ γ.1 ∧ 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 ∧
      qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 ∧ B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb ∧
      |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 ∧ |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 := by
    intro γ m ξ hP
    have hP' : ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ B.Xa < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < B.Xb ∧
        ξ ∈ tsupport (Q γ m) := hP
    obtain ⟨hξ, -, -, hts⟩ := hP'
    have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
    obtain ⟨-, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7, a8⟩ := hs l0 (by omega) β Q hQ γ m ξ hξ hts
    have hB : ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB := ⟨hξ'.1, hξ'.2.1, by linarith [hξ'.2.2]⟩
    exact ⟨hξ, hξ'.1, hξ'.2.1, hqpos ξ hξ, by linarith [hξ'.2.2], hB, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7, a8⟩
  have M1 : CUB5 B (pchMwP5 B l0 Q) k (fun _ _ η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun _ _ => 1) := by
    choose C1 hC1 using fun j => nb_qpow_v4 B (qsOf l0) (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) hok hSN hqs0 hqs1 j
    refine ⟨∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C1 j|, Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _),
      fun γ m ξ hP => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hξ, -, -, hq, -⟩ := hgood γ m ξ hP
    have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos η hη).ne')
    refine ⟨zero_le_one, ⟨_, hDo, hξ, hsm _ _ hf⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    have hjm : j ∈ Finset.range (k+1) := Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega)
    have hcl := hcastc ξ 1 _ (hf.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hξ)) j
    simp only [one_mul, abs_one] at hcl
    have hqp : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    calc NB B.h (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ
        ≤ NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) j ξ := hcl
      _ ≤ C1 j * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) := hC1 j ξ hξ
      _ ≤ |C1 j| * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hqp
      _ ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C1 j|) * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => abs_nonneg (C1 i)) hjm) hqp
      _ = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C1 j|) * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
  have M2 : CUB5 B (pchMwP5 B l0 Q) k (fun _ _ η => (((η.1)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)) (-(1/2)) (fun _ _ => 1) := by
    choose C2 hC2 using fun j => inv_r_nb_v5 B hok j
    have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C2 j| := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    refine ⟨2 * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C2 j|, mul_nonneg zero_le_two hS0, fun γ m ξ hP => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hξ, hr, ht, hq, -, -, -, -, hlo, hhi, hX, -⟩ := hgood γ m ξ hP
    have hfs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (η.1)⁻¹) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      contDiff_fst.contDiffOn.inv (fun η hη => (hη.1).ne')
    refine ⟨zero_le_one, ⟨_, hDo, hξ, hsm _ _ hfs⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    have hjm : j ∈ Finset.range (k+1) := Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega)
    have hQ0 : 0 < Qb γ.1 := by unfold Qb; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
    have hsQ : 0 < Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hQ0
    have hq4 : qC B.h ξ < 4 * Qb γ.1 := (div_lt_iff₀ hQ0).1 hhi
    have ha := hsqb (qC B.h ξ) (Qb γ.1) hq hQ0 hq4
    have hid : (fun η : Cyl => (((η.1)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        fun η => (((Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1))⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) / η.1) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      funext η
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hsQ.ne', one_mul]
    have hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) / η.1) ξ :=
      contDiffAt_const.div contDiffAt_fst hr.ne'
    have hcl := hcastc ξ (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1))⁻¹ _ hg j
    rw [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 hsQ)] at hcl
    have hb := hC2 j γ.1 ξ hr ht hlo hX
    have hsum : |C2 j| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C2 j| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => abs_nonneg (C2 i)) hjm
    have hqp : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    show NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (((η.1)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ ≤ _
    rw [hid]
    calc _ ≤ (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1))⁻¹ * NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) / η.1) j ξ := hcl
      _ ≤ (2 * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C2 j|) :=
          mul_le_mul ha (hb.trans ((le_abs_self _).trans hsum)) (hNBnn _ _ _)
            (mul_nonneg zero_le_two hqp)
      _ = 2 * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C2 j|) * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * 1 := by ring
  have M3 : CUB5 B (pchMwP5 B l0 Q) k (fun _ m _ => Complex.I * (m : ℂ)) 0 (fun _ _ => 1) := by
    obtain ⟨H, -, hH⟩ := hQ.1
    refine ⟨∑ m' ∈ H, |(m' : ℝ)|, Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _), fun γ m ξ hP => ?_⟩
    have hP' : ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ B.Xa < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < B.Xb ∧
        ξ ∈ tsupport (Q γ m) := hP
    have hmH : m ∈ H := by
      by_contra hm
      have h0 := hH γ m hm
      have hts := hP'.2.2.2
      rw [h0, tsupport_zero] at hts
      simp at hts
    refine ⟨zero_le_one, ⟨Set.univ, isOpen_univ, Set.mem_univ _, contDiffOn_const⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    refine (hNBc ξ _ j).trans ?_
    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun m' : ℤ => |(m' : ℝ)|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) hmH
    have hnm : ‖Complex.I * (m : ℂ)‖ = |(m : ℝ)| := by
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_intCast]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (P Q : WC) (α1 α2 : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α1 P → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α2 Q → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α1 - kapS) (fun γ m ξ => ((qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * P γ m ξ 0 + ((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * P γ m ξ 1 + ((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * P γ m ξ 2)) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α2 - kapS) (fun γ m ξ => ((qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q γ m ξ 0 + ((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q γ m ξ 1 + ((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q γ m ξ 2)) → (∀ (γ : Lab) (N : ℤ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B P) (pchAmp5 B Q) N γ η + pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B Q) (pchAmp5 B P) N γ η)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b d : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (N : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B P) (pchAmp5 B Q) N γ η + pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B Q) (pchAmp5 B P) N γ η)) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) * Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (P Q : WC) (α1 α2 : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α1 P → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α2 Q → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α1 - kapS) (fun γ m ξ => ((qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * P γ m ξ 0 + ((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * P γ m ξ 1 + ((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * P γ m ξ 2)) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α2 - kapS) (fun γ m ξ => ((qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q γ m ξ 0 + ((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q γ m ξ 1 + ((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q γ m ξ 2)) → (∀ (γ : Lab) (N : ℤ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B P) (pchAmp5 B Q) N γ η + pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B Q) (pchAmp5 B P) N γ η)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b d : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (N : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B P) (pchAmp5 B Q) N γ η + pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B Q) (pchAmp5 B P) N γ η)) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) * Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lp, hPT⟩ := pch5_pair_term B G hok hG
  refine ⟨lp, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 P Q α1 α2 hP hQ hTP hTQ
  have hh0 : 0 ≤ B.h := hok.2.1.1.le
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  have hUo : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  
  have hPs := (pch5_star_class B G (qsOf l0) α1 hok).1 P hP
  have hQs := (pch5_star_class B G (qsOf l0) α2 hok).1 Q hQ
  have hTPs := (pch5_star_class B G (qsOf l0) (α1 - kapS) hok).2 _ hTP
  have hTQs := (pch5_star_class B G (qsOf l0) (α2 - kapS) hok).2 _ hTQ
  
  have I1 := hPT l0 hl0 P Q _ α1 α2 hP hQ hTP (fun γ m ξ _ => rfl)
  have I2 := hPT l0 hl0 (fun γ' m' ξ' i => star (P γ' m' ξ' i)) Q _ α1 α2 hPs hQ hTPs
    (fun γ m ξ _ => by simp only [Complex.star_def, map_mul, map_add, Complex.conj_ofReal])
  have I3 := hPT l0 hl0 Q P _ α2 α1 hQ hP hTQ (fun γ m ξ _ => rfl)
  have I4 := hPT l0 hl0 (fun γ' m' ξ' i => star (Q γ' m' ξ' i)) P _ α2 α1 hQs hP hTQs
    (fun γ m ξ _ => by simp only [Complex.star_def, map_mul, map_add, Complex.conj_ofReal])
  
  obtain ⟨HP, -, hHP⟩ := hP.1
  obtain ⟨HQ, -, hHQ⟩ := hQ.1
  have hfs := pch5_pair_finsum B G P Q HP HQ hHP hHQ
  
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : WC → WC → Lab → ℤ → ℤ → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ), ∀ X Y γ m n η,
      J X Y γ m n η = ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        pchTr5 B G γ n (pchAmp5 B X γ m η) (pchAmp5 B Y γ n) η :=
    ⟨fun X Y γ m n η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        pchTr5 B G γ n (pchAmp5 B X γ m η) (pchAmp5 B Y γ n) η, fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  have eJ : ∀ X Y γ m n, J X Y γ m n = fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
      pchTr5 B G γ n (pchAmp5 B X γ m η) (pchAmp5 B Y γ n) η :=
    fun X Y γ m n => funext (hJ X Y γ m n)
  have hJ1 : ∀ γ m n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (J P Q γ m n) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro γ m n; rw [eJ]; exact I1.1 γ m n
  have hJ2 : ∀ γ m n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (J (fun γ' m' ξ' i => star (P γ' m' ξ' i)) Q γ m n)
      (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro γ m n; rw [eJ]; exact I2.1 γ m n
  have hJ3 : ∀ γ m n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (J Q P γ m n) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro γ m n; rw [eJ]; exact I3.1 γ m n
  have hJ4 : ∀ γ m n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (J (fun γ' m' ξ' i => star (Q γ' m' ξ' i)) P γ m n)
      (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro γ m n; rw [eJ]; exact I4.1 γ m n
  
  obtain ⟨gP, hgP⟩ : ∃ g : Lab → ℤ → ℤ → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ), ∀ γ N m η,
      g γ N m η = (1/2 : ℂ) • J P Q γ m (N - m) η +
        (1/2 : ℂ) • J (fun γ' m' ξ' i => star (P γ' m' ξ' i)) Q γ m (N + m) η :=
    ⟨fun γ N m η => (1/2 : ℂ) • J P Q γ m (N - m) η +
        (1/2 : ℂ) • J (fun γ' m' ξ' i => star (P γ' m' ξ' i)) Q γ m (N + m) η,
      fun _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨gQ, hgQ⟩ : ∃ g : Lab → ℤ → ℤ → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ), ∀ γ N m η,
      g γ N m η = (1/2 : ℂ) • J Q P γ m (N - m) η +
        (1/2 : ℂ) • J (fun γ' m' ξ' i => star (Q γ' m' ξ' i)) P γ m (N + m) η :=
    ⟨fun γ N m η => (1/2 : ℂ) • J Q P γ m (N - m) η +
        (1/2 : ℂ) • J (fun γ' m' ξ' i => star (Q γ' m' ξ' i)) P γ m (N + m) η,
      fun _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hfs' : ∀ (γ : Lab) (N : ℤ) (η : Cyl),
      ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B P) (pchAmp5 B Q) N γ η +
        pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B Q) (pchAmp5 B P) N γ η) =
      (∑ m ∈ HP, gP γ N m η) + ∑ m ∈ HQ, gQ γ N m η := by
    intro γ N η
    rw [hfs γ N η]
    simp only [hgP, hgQ, hJ]
  have hgs : ∀ γ N m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gP γ N m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro γ N m
    rw [funext (hgP γ N m)]
    exact ((hJ1 γ m (N - m)).const_smul (1/2 : ℂ)).add ((hJ2 γ m (N + m)).const_smul (1/2 : ℂ))
  have hgsQ : ∀ γ N m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gQ γ N m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro γ N m
    rw [funext (hgQ γ N m)]
    exact ((hJ3 γ m (N - m)).const_smul (1/2 : ℂ)).add ((hJ4 γ m (N + m)).const_smul (1/2 : ℂ))
  have hsP : ∀ γ N, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ∑ m ∈ HP, gP γ N m η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    fun γ N => ContDiffOn.sum (fun m (_ : m ∈ HP) => hgs γ N m)
  have hsQ : ∀ γ N, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ∑ m ∈ HQ, gQ γ N m η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    fun γ N => ContDiffOn.sum (fun m (_ : m ∈ HQ) => hgsQ γ N m)
  refine ⟨fun γ N => ((hsP γ N).add (hsQ γ N)).congr (fun η _ => hfs' γ N η), ?_⟩
  
  intro k
  obtain ⟨C1, b1, d1, hb1⟩ := I1.2 k
  obtain ⟨C2, b2, d2, hb2⟩ := I2.2 k
  obtain ⟨C3, b3, d3, hb3⟩ := I3.2 k
  obtain ⟨C4, b4, d4, hb4⟩ := I4.2 k
  obtain ⟨bb, hbb⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = |b1| + |b2| + |b3| + |b4| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨dd, hdd⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = |d1| + |d2| + |d3| + |d4| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hb1' : b1 ≤ bb := by rw [hbb]; linarith [le_abs_self b1, abs_nonneg b2, abs_nonneg b3, abs_nonneg b4]
  have hb2' : b2 ≤ bb := by rw [hbb]; linarith [le_abs_self b2, abs_nonneg b1, abs_nonneg b3, abs_nonneg b4]
  have hb3' : b3 ≤ bb := by rw [hbb]; linarith [le_abs_self b3, abs_nonneg b2, abs_nonneg b1, abs_nonneg b4]
  have hb4' : b4 ≤ bb := by rw [hbb]; linarith [le_abs_self b4, abs_nonneg b2, abs_nonneg b3, abs_nonneg b1]
  have hd1' : d1 ≤ dd := by rw [hdd]; linarith [le_abs_self d1, abs_nonneg d2, abs_nonneg d3, abs_nonneg d4]
  have hd2' : d2 ≤ dd := by rw [hdd]; linarith [le_abs_self d2, abs_nonneg d1, abs_nonneg d3, abs_nonneg d4]
  have hd3' : d3 ≤ dd := by rw [hdd]; linarith [le_abs_self d3, abs_nonneg d2, abs_nonneg d1, abs_nonneg d4]
  have hd4' : d4 ≤ dd := by rw [hdd]; linarith [le_abs_self d4, abs_nonneg d2, abs_nonneg d3, abs_nonneg d1]
  refine ⟨((HP.card : ℝ) + (HQ.card : ℝ)) * (|C1| + |C2| + |C3| + |C4|), bb, dd, ?_⟩
  intro γ N ξ hξ hX1 hX2
  
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  have hξ' := hξ
  obtain ⟨-, e2, e3⟩ := hξ'
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hS1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
    unfold SC
    have : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| := by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))]
    exact one_le_pow₀ this
  have hX : 0 < XC B.h ξ := lt_trans hXa hX1
  have he0 : 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) := by
    have l1 : 0 < Real.log (XC B.h ξ / B.Xa) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX1)
    have l2 : 0 < Real.log (B.Xb / XC B.h ξ) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr hX2)
    exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min l1 l2)
  have he1 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
  have hP0 : 0 ≤ Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by
    unfold Penv5
    exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ, W = qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) * SC B.h ξ ^ bb *
      Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-dd) *
      Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hW0 : 0 ≤ W := by
    rw [hW]
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)
      (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) (Real.rpow_nonneg he0.le _)) hP0
  have key : ∀ (C b d e N0 : ℝ), b ≤ bb → d ≤ dd → e = B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS) →
      N0 ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ e * SC B.h ξ ^ b * Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) *
        edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) * Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) →
      N0 ≤ |C| * W := by
    intro C b d e N0 hb hd he hN
    rw [he] at hN
    have f2 : SC B.h ξ ^ b ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bb := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 hb
    have f3 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-dd) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge he0 he1 (neg_le_neg hd)
    have p0 : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
    have pS : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ b := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    have pS' : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bb := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    have pE : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have pD : 0 ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) := Real.rpow_nonneg he0.le _
    have m1 : qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b ≤
        qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) * SC B.h ξ ^ bb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left f2 p0
    have m2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right m1 pE
    have m3 := mul_le_mul m2 f3 pD (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p0 pS') pE)
    have m4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right m3 hP0
    have X0 : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b *
        Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) *
        Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p0 pS) pE) pD) hP0
    calc N0 ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b *
          Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) *
          Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := hN
      _ = C * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b *
          Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) *
          Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)) := by ring
      _ ≤ |C| * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b *
          Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) *
          Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) X0
      _ ≤ |C| * W := by rw [hW]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left m4 (abs_nonneg C)
  have hL := pch5_nb_lin B.h (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) hUo ξ hξ k
  have hhalf : ‖(1/2 : ℂ)‖ = 1/2 := by simp
  have c1 := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg C1) hW0
  have c2 := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg C2) hW0
  have c3 := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg C3) hW0
  have c4 := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg C4) hW0
  have hgb : ∀ m : ℤ, NB B.h (gP γ N m) k ξ ≤ (|C1| + |C2| + |C3| + |C4|) * W := by

The compiled glue uses every one of them: it applies pch5_pair_term four times, to (P,Q), (P*,Q), (Q,P) and (Q*,P); it uses star_class to get the conjugate families' classes, pair_finsum to turn the two finsums into Finset sums over HP and HQ, and nb_lin for the merge. The child is uniform in n because n outside H_Q makes the term vanish identically, and Pv^2<=Pv follows from SuppW together with the proved penv5_le_one_v5. The other three children are true and much easier: conjugation is a real-linear isometry, the finsum step is an exact identity (pchTr5 with al=0 is 0, and q^{-A} is real), and nb_lin is linearity of iteratedFDeriv. Blueprint sections 4 (M1-M7) and 5 (F1-F9) give concrete evidence and real falsification attempts. No child duplicates a section-10 lemma or restates an ancestor, and nothing is recycled. Note for pch5_pair_term's prover: the zero-slack rows leave no room for a second kapS loss.
