proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG j
  have hr0 : 0 < G.r0 := hG.1.1
  have hr01 : G.r0 ≤ 1/100 := hG.1.2.1
  have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := (Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)).mpr (by norm_num)
  have hs1 : 1 < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.one_lt_sqrt_two
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ bgc := by unfold bgc; linarith
  have hb1 : bgc ≤ 1 := by unfold bgc; linarith
  have hbc1 : 1 ≤ 1 + bgc ^ 2 := le_add_of_nonneg_right (sq_nonneg _)
  have hbc0 : 0 < 1 + bgc ^ 2 := by linarith
  have hT1 : 1 < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; linarith
  have hTpos : 0 < Tgc := by linarith
  have hc : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * Tgc ^ 3 := (mul_pos two_pos (pow_pos hTpos 3)).le
  
  obtain ⟨Θ, hΘ⟩ : ∃ Θ : ℝ → ℝ, Θ = fun x : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (5/2 - 15 / (4 * G.r0) * |x|) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΘx : ∀ x : ℝ, Θ x = Real.smoothTransition (5/2 - 15 / (4 * G.r0) * |x|) := fun x => by rw [hΘ]
  have ha : (0:ℝ) ≤ 15 / (4 * G.r0) := by positivity
  have hle1 : ∀ y : ℝ, |y| ≤ 2 * G.r0 / 5 → 1 ≤ 5/2 - 15 / (4 * G.r0) * |y| := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : 15 / (4 * G.r0) * |y| ≤ 15 / (4 * G.r0) * (2 * G.r0 / 5) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy ha
    have h2 : 15 / (4 * G.r0) * (2 * G.r0 / 5) = 3/2 := by field_simp; ring
    linarith
  have hle0 : ∀ y : ℝ, 2 * G.r0 / 3 ≤ |y| → 5/2 - 15 / (4 * G.r0) * |y| ≤ 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : 15 / (4 * G.r0) * (2 * G.r0 / 3) ≤ 15 / (4 * G.r0) * |y| :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy ha
    have h2 : 15 / (4 * G.r0) * (2 * G.r0 / 3) = 5/2 := by field_simp; ring
    linarith
  have hPl : ∀ x : ℝ, |x| < 2 * G.r0 / 5 → Θ x = 1 := fun x hx => by
    rw [hΘx]; exact Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (hle1 x hx.le)
  have hFar : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 * G.r0 / 3 < |x| → Θ x = 0 := fun x hx => by
    rw [hΘx]; exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (hle0 x hx.le)
  have hU0 : IsOpen {y : ℝ | |y| < 2 * G.r0 / 5} := isOpen_lt continuous_abs continuous_const
  have hU1 : IsOpen {y : ℝ | 2 * G.r0 / 3 < |y|} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_abs
  have hΘs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Θ := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x = 0
    · subst hx
      have h0mem : (0:ℝ) ∈ {y : ℝ | |y| < 2 * G.r0 / 5} := by
        show |(0:ℝ)| < 2 * G.r0 / 5
        rw [abs_zero]; positivity
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU0.mem_nhds h0mem) (fun y hy => hPl y hy))
    · have habs : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ => |y|) x := contDiffAt_abs hx
      have hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ => 5/2 - 15 / (4 * G.r0) * |y|) x :=
        contDiffAt_const.sub (contDiffAt_const.mul habs)
      rw [hΘ]
      exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp x hg
  have hΘ'cs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (deriv Θ) := (contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.mp hΘs).2
  have hΘd : Differentiable ℝ Θ := hΘs.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hD0 : ∀ x : ℝ, (|x| < 2 * G.r0 / 5 ∨ 2 * G.r0 / 3 < |x|) → deriv Θ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · have hev : Θ =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => (1:ℝ) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU0.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => hPl y hy)
      rw [hev.deriv_eq]; simp
    · have hev : Θ =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU1.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => hFar y hy)
      rw [hev.deriv_eq]; simp
  have hbound : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → (∀ x : ℝ, 2 * G.r0 / 3 < |x| → g x = 0) →
      ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x‖ ≤ K := by
    intro g hg hz n
    have hcont : Continuous (fun x => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x) :=
      hg.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    obtain ⟨C, hCb⟩ :=
      (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℝ) G.r0).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hcont.continuousOn
    refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, fun x => ?_⟩
    by_cases hx : |x| ≤ G.r0
    · have hmem : x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0:ℝ) G.r0 := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hx
      exact (hCb x hmem).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · have hx' : 2 * G.r0 / 3 < |x| := by
        have : G.r0 < |x| := lt_of_not_ge hx
        linarith
      have hev : g =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU1.mem_nhds hx') (fun y hy => hz y hy)
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ n).eq_of_nhds]
      have h0 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun _ : ℝ => (0:ℝ)) = 0 := iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero
      rw [h0, Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
      exact le_max_right _ _
  obtain ⟨K1, hK10, hK1⟩ := hbound Θ hΘs hFar j
  obtain ⟨K2, hK20, hK2⟩ := hbound (deriv Θ) hΘ'cs (fun x hx => hD0 x (Or.inr hx)) j
  
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ⟩ : ∃ Λ : ℤ → Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ, ∀ (N : ℤ) (η : Cyl), Λ N η = Tgc ^ N * lamT η.2.2.2 := by
    refine ⟨fun N => (Tgc ^ N) • ((((bgc / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ +
      (1 / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)).comp
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))))), fun N η => ?_⟩
    simp [lamT]
    ring
  refine ⟨(K1 + K2) * (2 * Tgc ^ 3) ^ j, mul_nonneg (add_nonneg hK10 hK20) (pow_nonneg hc _), ?_⟩
  intro γ ξ hl hDom hq hcb hc2 hxi het
  
  have hcb0 : 0 < cib B.h γ.1 :=
    mul_pos (zpow_pos hTpos _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by unfold Qb; positivity) _)
  have hk0 : cib B.h γ.1 ≠ 0 := hcb0.ne'
  have hr00 : G.r0 ≠ 0 := hr0.ne'
  have hcb1 : cib B.h γ.1 ≤ 1 := by
    have hl1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (γ.1 : ℝ) := Nat.one_le_cast.mpr hl
    have hl2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := one_le_pow₀ hl1
    have hx : 0 < (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (γ.1:ℝ)) / ((γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
      div_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _) (by positivity)
    have hfl : ((bandIdx B.h γ.1 : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤
        Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (γ.1:ℝ)) / ((γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2)) := by
      unfold bandIdx; exact Int.floor_le _
    have hpow2 : Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (γ.1:ℝ)) / ((γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_intCast]
      calc Tgc ^ ((bandIdx B.h γ.1 : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤
            Tgc ^ (Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (γ.1:ℝ)) / ((γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2))) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hT1.le hfl
        _ = _ := Real.rpow_logb hTpos hT1.ne' hx
    have hQ : Qb γ.1 ^ (1 + B.h) * (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (γ.1:ℝ)) = 1 := by
      unfold Qb
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2), ← Real.rpow_add two_pos,
        show -(γ.1:ℝ) * (1 + B.h) + (1 + B.h) * (γ.1:ℝ) = 0 by ring, Real.rpow_zero]
    have hQ0 : 0 ≤ Qb γ.1 ^ (1 + B.h) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by unfold Qb; positivity) _
    unfold cib
    calc Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) * Qb γ.1 ^ (1 + B.h)
        ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (γ.1:ℝ)) / ((γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2) * Qb γ.1 ^ (1 + B.h) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow2 hQ0
      _ = (Qb γ.1 ^ (1 + B.h) * (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (γ.1:ℝ))) / (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = 1 / (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 := by rw [hQ]
      _ ≤ 1 := by rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]; exact hl2
  
  have hslope : ∀ w : Cyl, |Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) (Lnorm B.h ξ w)| ≤ 2 * Tgc ^ 3 * ‖w‖ := by
    intro w
    rw [hΛ]
    have hJ1 : ∀ (m : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), (JpowL m Y).1 =
        Y.1 * (Jpow m (1, 0)).1 + Y.2 * (Jpow m (0, 1)).1 := by
      intro m Y
      simp only [JpowL, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', Prod.fst_add, Prod.smul_fst,
        smul_eq_mul]
    have hJ2 : ∀ (m : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), (JpowL m Y).2 =
        Y.1 * (Jpow m (1, 0)).2 + Y.2 * (Jpow m (0, 1)).2 := by
      intro m Y
      simp only [JpowL, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_snd,
        smul_eq_mul]
    have c1 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), (Jpow n Y).1 =
        Lgc ^ n * ((Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) + Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) * bgc := by
      intro n Y
      simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk]
      ring
    have c2 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), (Jpow n Y).2 =
        -(Lgc ^ n * ((Y.1 - bgc * Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) * bgc) + Tgc ^ n * ((bgc * Y.1 + Y.2) / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) := by
      intro n Y
      simp only [Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk]
      ring
    have heig : ∀ (m : ℤ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ), lamT (JpowL m Y) = Tgc ^ m * lamT Y := by
      intro m Y
      unfold lamT
      rw [hJ1, hJ2, c1, c1, c2, c2]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hY : (Lnorm B.h ξ w).2.2.2 = JpowL (-(coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ))) w.2.2.2 := rfl
    have hLHS : Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) * lamT ((Lnorm B.h ξ w).2.2.2) =
        Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1 - coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) * lamT w.2.2.2 := by
      rw [hY, heig, ← mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hTpos.ne', sub_eq_add_neg]
    have hP : Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1 - coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) ≤ Tgc ^ 3 := by
      calc Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1 - coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) ≤ Tgc ^ (3:ℤ) :=
            zpow_le_zpow_right₀ hT1.le (by omega)
        _ = Tgc ^ 3 := by simp
    have hpos : 0 < Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1 - coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) := zpow_pos hTpos _
    have hv1 : |w.2.2.2.1| ≤ ‖w.2.2.2‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_fst_le _
    have hv2 : |w.2.2.2.2| ≤ ‖w.2.2.2‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_snd_le _
    have hvw : ‖w.2.2.2‖ ≤ ‖w‖ := ((norm_snd_le w.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le w.2)).trans (norm_snd_le w)
    have hlam : |lamT w.2.2.2| ≤ 2 * ‖w‖ := by
      unfold lamT
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hbc0]
      have hnum : |bgc * w.2.2.2.1 + w.2.2.2.2| ≤ 2 * ‖w‖ := by
        have hsum := abs_add_le (bgc * w.2.2.2.1) w.2.2.2.2
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hb0] at hsum
        have hbv : bgc * |w.2.2.2.1| ≤ ‖w.2.2.2‖ := by
          calc bgc * |w.2.2.2.1| ≤ 1 * |w.2.2.2.1| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb1 (abs_nonneg _)
            _ ≤ ‖w.2.2.2‖ := by linarith
        linarith
      exact (div_le_self (abs_nonneg _) hbc1).trans hnum
    rw [hLHS, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hpos]
    calc Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1 - coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)) * |lamT w.2.2.2| ≤ Tgc ^ 3 * (2 * ‖w‖) :=
          mul_le_mul hP hlam (abs_nonneg _) (pow_pos hTpos 3).le
      _ = 2 * Tgc ^ 3 * ‖w‖ := by ring
  
  have hloc : ∀ (c Y₀ : ℝ × ℝ), |xiG B.h γ c Y₀| < 1/8 → |etG B.h γ c Y₀| < 1/8 →
      ∃ (W : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (d : ℝ), IsOpen W ∧ Y₀ ∈ W ∧
        ∀ Y ∈ W, etG B.h γ c Y = Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) * lamT Y - d := by
    intro c Y₀ hxi het
    have hbgc : 0 ≤ bgc ∧ bgc < 1/2 := by
      have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
      have hs2' : Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
      unfold bgc
      constructor <;> nlinarith
    have hDen : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : ℝ × ℝ, w = rectW B.h γ c Y₀ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hxiw : |lamR w| < 1/8 := by rw [hw]; exact hxi
    have hetw : |lamT w| < 1/8 := by rw [hw]; exact het
    have hinv1 : w.1 = lamR w + bgc * lamT w := by
      have e : lamR w + bgc * lamT w = (w.1 - bgc * w.2 + bgc * (bgc * w.1 + w.2)) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) := by
        unfold lamR lamT; ring
      rw [e, eq_div_iff hDen]
      ring
    have hinv2 : w.2 = lamT w - bgc * lamR w := by
      have e : lamT w - bgc * lamR w = (bgc * w.1 + w.2 - bgc * (w.1 - bgc * w.2)) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) := by
        unfold lamR lamT; ring
      rw [e, eq_div_iff hDen]
      ring
    have hb1' : bgc * |lamT w| ≤ 1/16 := by
      calc bgc * |lamT w| ≤ (1/2) * (1/8) := mul_le_mul hbgc.2.le hetw.le (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        _ = 1/16 := by norm_num
    have hb2' : bgc * |lamR w| ≤ 1/16 := by
      calc bgc * |lamR w| ≤ (1/2) * (1/8) := mul_le_mul hbgc.2.le hxiw.le (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        _ = 1/16 := by norm_num
    have hb1'' : |bgc * lamT w| ≤ 1/16 := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hbgc.1]; exact hb1'
    have hb2'' : |bgc * lamR w| ≤ 1/16 := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hbgc.1]; exact hb2'
    have hw1 : |w.1| < 1/2 := by
      rw [hinv1]
      obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hxiw
      obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := abs_le.mp hb1''
      exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hw2 : |w.2| < 1/2 := by
      rw [hinv2]
      obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hetw
      obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := abs_le.mp hb2''
      exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    obtain ⟨K1', hK1'⟩ : ∃ K : ℤ, K = round ((Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y₀ - c).1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨K2', hK2'⟩ : ∃ K : ℤ, K = round ((Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y₀ - c).2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hw1e : w.1 = (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y₀ - c).1 - (K1' : ℝ) := by
      rw [hw, hK1']; rfl
    have hw2e : w.2 = (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y₀ - c).2 - (K2' : ℝ) := by
      rw [hw, hK2']; rfl
    have hround : ∀ (x : ℝ) (K : ℤ), |x - (K : ℝ)| < 1/2 → round x = K := by
      intro x K hx
      rw [round_eq, Int.floor_eq_iff]
      obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := abs_lt.mp hx
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hJc : Continuous (fun Y' : ℝ × ℝ => Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - c) := by
      unfold Jpow; fun_prop
    obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ : ∃ V : Set (ℝ × ℝ), V =
        {Y' : ℝ × ℝ | |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - c).1 - (K1' : ℝ)| < 1/2} ∩
        {Y' : ℝ × ℝ | |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - c).2 - (K2' : ℝ)| < 1/2} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hVo : IsOpen V := by
      rw [hV]
      exact (isOpen_lt ((hJc.fst).sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const).inter
        (isOpen_lt ((hJc.snd).sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const)
    have hYV : Y₀ ∈ V := by
      rw [hV]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · show |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y₀ - c).1 - (K1' : ℝ)| < 1/2
        rw [← hw1e]; exact hw1
      · show |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y₀ - c).2 - (K2' : ℝ)| < 1/2
        rw [← hw2e]; exact hw2
    have hfr : ∀ Y' ∈ V, rectW B.h γ c Y' =
        Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - c - ((K1' : ℝ), (K2' : ℝ)) := by
      intro Y' hY'
      rw [hV] at hY'
      have r1 : round ((Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - c).1) = K1' := hround _ _ hY'.1
      have r2 : round ((Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - c).2) = K2' := hround _ _ hY'.2
      unfold rectW frac0
      rw [r1, r2]
      ext <;> simp
    have hlamT_lin : ∀ a b : ℝ × ℝ, lamT (a - b) = lamT a - lamT b := by
      intro a b
      simp only [lamT, Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub]
      ring
    have hlamJ : ∀ Y' : ℝ × ℝ, lamT (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y') = Tgc ^ bandIdx B.h γ.1 * lamT Y' := by
      intro Y'
      simp only [lamT, Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
      ring
    refine ⟨V, lamT c + lamT ((K1' : ℝ), (K2' : ℝ)), hVo, hYV, fun Y hY => ?_⟩
    simp only [etG]
    rw [hfr _ hY, hlamT_lin, hlamT_lin, hlamJ]
    ring
  obtain ⟨W, d, hWo, hξW, hW⟩ := hloc (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 (by linarith) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨Ω, hΩ⟩ : ∃ Ω : Set Cyl, Ω = {η : Cyl | η.2.2.2 ∈ W} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΩo : IsOpen Ω := by rw [hΩ]; exact hWo.preimage (by fun_prop)
  have hξΩ : ξ ∈ Ω := by rw [hΩ]; exact hξW
  have hF : ∀ η ∈ Ω, etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 = Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η + (-d) := by
    intro η hη
    rw [hΩ] at hη
    rw [hW _ hη, hΛ]
    ring
  
  have hclosed : ∀ η : Cyl, psiW B G γ η =
      Real.smoothTransition (5/2 - 15 / (4 * G.r0) * |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2|) := by
    intro η
    unfold psiW psiT Lsb vco
    congr 1
    have e1 : (etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 - 2 * G.r0 / cib B.h γ.1 / 2 =
        etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 / cib B.h γ.1 := by field_simp; ring
    rw [e1, abs_div, abs_of_pos hcb0]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hpsiΩ : ∀ η ∈ Ω, psiW B G γ η = Θ (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η + (-d)) := by
    intro η hη
    rw [hclosed, hF η hη, hΘx]
  
  have hchain : ∀ η : Cyl, fderiv ℝ (fun ζ : Cyl => Θ (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ζ + (-d))) η =
      deriv Θ (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η + (-d)) • Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) := by
    intro η
    have h1 : HasDerivAt Θ (deriv Θ (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η + (-d))) (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η + (-d)) :=
      (hΘd _).hasDerivAt
    have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun ζ : Cyl => Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ζ + (-d)) (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1)) η :=
      (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1)).hasFDerivAt.add_const (-d)
    exact (h1.comp_hasFDerivAt η h2).fderiv
  have hΛd : Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) (dVdir B.h γ.1) = cib B.h γ.1 := by
    rw [hΛ]
    have hlv : lamT vtv = 1 := by
      unfold lamT
      show (bgc * bgc + 1) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) = 1
      rw [div_eq_one_iff_eq hbc0.ne']
      ring
    have hsm : ∀ (a : ℝ) (v : ℝ × ℝ), lamT (a • v) = a * lamT v := by
      intro a v
      simp only [lamT, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have hTb : Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ≠ 0 := zpow_ne_zero _ hTpos.ne'
    show Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) * lamT ((cib B.h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1))) • vtv) = cib B.h γ.1
    rw [hsm, hlv, mul_one, zpow_neg, mul_left_comm, mul_inv_cancel₀ hTb, mul_one]
  have hpsiWd : ∀ η ∈ Ω, psiWd B G γ η = cib B.h γ.1 * deriv Θ (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η + (-d)) := by
    intro η hη
    have hev : psiW B G γ =ᶠ[nhds η] (fun ζ : Cyl => Θ (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ζ + (-d))) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hΩo.mem_nhds hη) (fun ζ hζ => hpsiΩ ζ hζ)
    unfold psiWd
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, hchain, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, hΛd, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  
  have hvcoΩ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2) Ω := by
    have hs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η + (-d) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1) :=
      (((Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1)).contDiff.add contDiff_const).add contDiff_const).div_const _
    refine hs.contDiffOn.congr (fun η hη => ?_)
    show vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 = (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η + (-d) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1
    unfold vco
    rw [hF η hη]
  have hpsiCD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (psiW B G γ) Ω :=
    (hΘs.comp ((Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1)).contDiff.add contDiff_const)).contDiffOn.congr
      (fun η hη => hpsiΩ η hη)
  have hpsidCD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (psiWd B G γ) Ω :=
    ((contDiff_const (c := cib B.h γ.1)).mul
      (hΘ'cs.comp ((Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1)).contDiff.add contDiff_const))).contDiffOn.congr
      (fun η hη => hpsiWd η hη)
  
  have hNBeq : ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ), f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] g → NB B.h f j ξ = NB B.h g j ξ := by
    intro f g hfg
    unfold NB
    rw [(hfg.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds]
  have hcomp : ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (K : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → (∀ x : ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j ψ x‖ ≤ K) →
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => ψ (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η + (-d))) j ξ ≤ K * (2 * Tgc ^ 3) ^ j := by
    intro ψ K hψ hK
    have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ => ψ (y + (-d))) := hψ.comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)
    have hfun : (fun η : Cyl => ψ (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η + (-d))) =
        (fun y : ℝ => ψ (y + (-d))) ∘ ⇑(Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1)) := rfl
    have h2 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η : Cyl => ψ (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η + (-d))) ξ =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun y : ℝ => ψ (y + (-d))) (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1)) := by
      rw [hfun]
      exact (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1)).iteratedFDeriv_comp_right hg ξ (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have h3 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun y : ℝ => ψ (y + (-d))) (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ j ψ (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ + (-d)) :=
      iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right j (-d) (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ)
    set Mm := iteratedFDeriv ℝ j ψ (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ + (-d)) with hMm
    set T : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ := (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1)).comp (Lnorm B.h ξ) with hT
    have e : (Mm.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1))).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) = Mm.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T) := by
      ext v
      rfl
    have h4 : NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => ψ (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η + (-d))) j ξ =
        ‖Mm.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T)‖ := by
      unfold NB
      rw [h2, h3, e]
    have h5 : ‖Mm.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => T)‖ ≤ ‖Mm‖ * ∏ _i : Fin j, ‖T‖ :=
      ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _
    have h6 : ‖T‖ ≤ 2 * Tgc ^ 3 := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hc (fun w => ?_)
      rw [hT, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact hslope w
    have hprod : ∏ _i : Fin j, ‖T‖ = ‖T‖ ^ j := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    have hpow : ‖T‖ ^ j ≤ (2 * Tgc ^ 3) ^ j := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h6 j
    have hMK : ‖Mm‖ ≤ K := hK _
    rw [h4]
    refine h5.trans ?_
    rw [hprod]
    exact mul_le_mul hMK hpow (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) j) ((norm_nonneg _).trans hMK)
  have hevW : psiW B G γ =ᶠ[nhds ξ] (fun η : Cyl => Θ (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η + (-d))) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hΩo.mem_nhds hξΩ) (fun η hη => hpsiΩ η hη)
  have hevWd : psiWd B G γ =ᶠ[nhds ξ]
      (fun η : Cyl => cib B.h γ.1 * deriv Θ (Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η + (-d))) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hΩo.mem_nhds hξΩ) (fun η hη => hpsiWd η hη)
  have hMle : ∀ K : ℝ, K ≤ K1 + K2 → K * (2 * Tgc ^ 3) ^ j ≤ (K1 + K2) * (2 * Tgc ^ 3) ^ j :=
    fun K hK => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK (pow_nonneg hc _)
  have hN1 : NB B.h (psiW B G γ) j ξ ≤ (K1 + K2) * (2 * Tgc ^ 3) ^ j := by
    rw [hNBeq _ _ hevW]
    exact (hcomp Θ K1 hΘs hK1).trans (hMle K1 (by linarith))
  have hb2 : ∀ x : ℝ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun y : ℝ => cib B.h γ.1 * deriv Θ y) x‖ ≤ K2 := by
    intro x
    have e : (fun y : ℝ => cib B.h γ.1 * deriv Θ y) = cib B.h γ.1 • deriv Θ := rfl
    rw [e, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply (hΘ'cs.contDiffAt.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)),
      norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hcb0]
    calc cib B.h γ.1 * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (deriv Θ) x‖ ≤ 1 * K2 :=
          mul_le_mul hcb1 (hK2 x) (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      _ = K2 := one_mul _
  have hN2 : NB B.h (psiWd B G γ) j ξ ≤ (K1 + K2) * (2 * Tgc ^ 3) ^ j := by
    rw [hNBeq _ _ hevWd]
    exact (hcomp (fun y : ℝ => cib B.h γ.1 * deriv Θ y) K2 (contDiff_const.mul hΘ'cs) hb2).trans
      (hMle K2 (by linarith))
  
  have hwin : |vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2| =
      |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| / cib B.h γ.1 := by
    unfold vco Lsb
    have e1 : (etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 - 2 * G.r0 / cib B.h γ.1 / 2 =
        etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 / cib B.h γ.1 := by field_simp; ring
    rw [e1, abs_div, abs_of_pos hcb0]
  have hL5 : Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 5 = (2 * G.r0 / 5) / cib B.h γ.1 := by unfold Lsb; ring
  have hL3 : Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 3 = (2 * G.r0 / 3) / cib B.h γ.1 := by unfold Lsb; ring
  have hW1 : |vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2| < Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 5 →
      |Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ + (-d)| < 2 * G.r0 / 5 := by
    intro h
    rw [hwin, hL5] at h
    rw [← hF ξ hξΩ]
    exact (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hcb0).mp h
  have hW2 : Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 3 < |vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2| →
      2 * G.r0 / 3 < |Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ + (-d)| := by
    intro h
    rw [hwin, hL3] at h
    rw [← hF ξ hξΩ]
    exact (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hcb0).mp h
  have hcontF : Continuous (fun η : Cyl => |Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η + (-d)|) :=
    continuous_abs.comp ((Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1)).continuous.add continuous_const)
  have hZ1 : (|vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2| < Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 5 ∨
      Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 3 < |vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2|) →
      NB B.h (psiWd B G γ) j ξ = 0 := by
    intro hcase
    have hξV : |Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ + (-d)| < 2 * G.r0 / 5 ∨
        2 * G.r0 / 3 < |Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ + (-d)| := hcase.imp hW1 hW2
    have hVo : IsOpen (Ω ∩ ({η : Cyl | |Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η + (-d)| < 2 * G.r0 / 5} ∪
        {η : Cyl | 2 * G.r0 / 3 < |Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η + (-d)|})) :=
      hΩo.inter ((isOpen_lt hcontF continuous_const).union (isOpen_lt continuous_const hcontF))
    have hev : psiWd B G γ =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hVo.mem_nhds ⟨hξΩ, hξV⟩) (fun η hη => by
        show psiWd B G γ η = 0
        rw [hpsiWd η hη.1, hD0 _ hη.2, mul_zero])
    rw [hNBeq _ _ hev]
    unfold NB
    have h0 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun _ : Cyl => (0:ℝ)) = 0 := iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero
    rw [h0]
    have e : ((0 : Cyl → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => Cyl) ℝ) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) = 0 := by
      ext m; simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e, norm_zero]
  have hZ2 : Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 3 < |vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2| →
      ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, psiW B G γ η = 0 ∧ psiWd B G γ η = 0 := by
    intro hcase
    have hξV := hW2 hcase
    have hVo : IsOpen (Ω ∩ {η : Cyl | 2 * G.r0 / 3 < |Λ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η + (-d)|}) :=
      hΩo.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hcontF)
    exact Filter.eventually_of_mem (hVo.mem_nhds ⟨hξΩ, hξV⟩) (fun η hη =>
      ⟨by rw [hpsiΩ η hη.1, hFar _ hη.2], by rw [hpsiWd η hη.1, hD0 _ (Or.inr hη.2), mul_zero]⟩)
  exact ⟨⟨Ω, hΩo, hξΩ, hvcoΩ, hpsiCD, hpsidCD⟩, hN1, hN2, hZ1, hZ2⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨l1s, hS⟩ := pulse_tw_struct_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lF, cA, hcA, hF⟩ := pulse_vco_frame_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lP, cP, bP, hcP, hbP, hP⟩ := pulse_prop_tsupp_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lJ, hJ⟩ := pulse_path_jets_v5 B G hok hG
  refine ⟨l1s + lF + lP + lJ, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 α f hf k
  obtain ⟨⟨H, -, hHv⟩, -, hSupp⟩ := hS l0 (by omega) α f hf
  obtain ⟨C, b, d, hC0, hJb⟩ := hJ l0 (by omega) α f hf k
  obtain ⟨M2, hM2⟩ : ∃ M2 : ℝ, M2 = ∑ m ∈ H, ((m : ℝ)) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hM20 : 0 ≤ M2 := by rw [hM2]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = 1 + cP + cA + C * (1 + M2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : ℝ, e = bP + |b| + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCM : 0 ≤ C * (1 + M2) := mul_nonneg hC0 (by linarith)
  have hA1 : 1 ≤ A := by rw [hA]; linarith
  have hcPA : cP ≤ A := by rw [hA]; linarith
  have hcAA : cA ≤ A := by rw [hA]; linarith
  have hCA : C * (1 + M2) ≤ A := by rw [hA]; linarith
  have he1 : 1 ≤ e := by rw [he]; linarith [abs_nonneg b]
  have hbPe : bP ≤ e := by rw [he]; linarith [abs_nonneg b]
  have hbe : b ≤ e := by rw [he]; linarith [le_abs_self b]
  refine ⟨(16 ^ (k + 2) * A) ^ (12 * (k + 1)) * C, e * ((12 * (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) + b, d, ?_⟩
  intro γ m ξ hξ ht h1 h2 hv0 hvL
  have hmH : m ∈ H := by
    by_contra hm
    rw [hHv γ m hm, tsupport_zero] at ht
    exact ht
  rcases hSupp γ m ξ hξ with hn | ⟨hm0, hAct, hlγ, hw1, hw2, -, -, hEta, hxi, hv0', hvL', U, J, Z, hU, hJo,
    hξU, -, hIJ, hpth, hZs, hAs, hGs, hZ0, hODE, hrep⟩
  · exact absurd ht hn
  have hpξ : pulsePth5 B G γ ξ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) = ξ := by simp [pulsePth5]
  obtain ⟨-, hxi8, het8, -⟩ := hpth ξ hξU _ (hIJ ⟨hv0', hvL'⟩)
  rw [hpξ] at hxi8 het8
  obtain ⟨O, c0, lam, hO, hξO, hvco, hslope, hLb⟩ := hF l0 γ ξ (by omega) hlγ hξ hw1 hw2 hxi8 het8
  have hXa : 0 < B.Xa := hok.2.1.2.2.1
  have hS1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
    unfold SC
    exact one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))])
  have hSpos : 0 < SC B.h ξ := by linarith
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := by
    obtain ⟨-, e2, -⟩ := hξ
    exact (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hed : 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) := by
    have hX0 : 0 < XC B.h ξ := lt_trans hXa h1
    unfold edgeDist
    exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr h1))
      (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX0).mpr h2)))
  have hPpos : ∀ v, 0 < Penv5 B G γ v := fun v => by unfold Penv5; exact Real.exp_pos _
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ : ∃ X : ℝ, X = A * SC B.h ξ ^ e := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hSe1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ e := Real.one_le_rpow hS1 (by linarith)
  have hSSe : SC B.h ξ ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ e := by
    calc SC B.h ξ = SC B.h ξ ^ (1:ℝ) := (Real.rpow_one _).symm
      _ ≤ _ := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 he1
  have hX1 : 1 ≤ X := by rw [hX]; nlinarith
  have hcAX : cA * SC B.h ξ ≤ X := by
    rw [hX]; exact mul_le_mul hcAA hSSe hSpos.le (by linarith)
  have hcPX : cP * SC B.h ξ ^ bP ≤ X := by
    rw [hX]
    exact mul_le_mul hcPA (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 hbPe) (Real.rpow_nonneg hSpos.le _)
      (by linarith)
  have hm2 : ((m : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ M2 := by
    rw [hM2]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i : ℤ => ((i : ℝ)) ^ 2) (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _) hmH
  have hArX : C * (1 + (m : ℝ) ^ 2) * SC B.h ξ ^ b ≤ X := by
    rw [hX]
    apply mul_le_mul _ (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 hbe) (Real.rpow_nonneg hSpos.le _)
      (by linarith)
    exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hC0) hCA
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ : ∃ I : ℝ, I = C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ b *
      Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hI0 : 0 ≤ I := by
    rw [hI]
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC0 (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _))
      (Real.rpow_nonneg hSpos.le _)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) (Real.rpow_nonneg hed.le _)
  have hvξ := hvco ξ hξO
  have hpos0 : 0 < lam ξ + c0 := by rw [← hvξ]; exact hv0
  have hposL : lam ξ + c0 < Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 := by rw [← hvξ]; exact hvL
  have hL : Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 ≤ X := le_trans hLb hcAX
  have hpathξ := fun v (hv : v ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1)) => hpth ξ hξU v (hIJ hv)
  have key := forced_pulse_jet_v5 U J Z
    (fun pv : Cyl × ℝ => projT5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ pv.1 pv.2) (srcHat B f γ m (pulsePth5 B G γ pv.1 pv.2)))
    (fun pv : Cyl × ℝ => pulseMatC (APhi5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ pv.1 pv.2)) -
      ((m : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((dDamp5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ pv.1 pv.2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ))
    (fun pv : Cyl × ℝ => pulseAr5 B G γ m (pulsePth5 B G γ pv.1 pv.2))
    ξ (Lnorm B.h ξ) lam c0 (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) X I (Penv5 B G γ) k hU hJo hξU hIJ hpos0 hposL hZs hAs hGs
    (fun pv i j => by
      simp only [pulseAr5, pulseMatC, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.map_apply,
        Matrix.one_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      split_ifs <;> push_cast <;> ring)
    hZ0 hODE hPpos hX1 hL hI0
    (fun w => le_trans (hslope w) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcAX (norm_nonneg w)))
    (fun x w hw0 hwL hx v hv => le_trans
      (hP l0 γ m ξ (by omega) hlγ hm0 hAct hξ hEta hw1 hw2 h1 h2 hxi hv0' hvL' x w hw0 hwL hx v hv)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcPX
        (div_nonneg (hPpos v).le (hPpos w).le)) (norm_nonneg _)))
    (fun j hj v hv => le_trans (hJb γ m ξ hlγ hAct hξ hw1 hw2 h1 h2 hv0' hvL' hpathξ j hj v hv).1 hArX)
    (fun j hj v hv => by rw [hI]; exact (hJb γ m ξ hlγ hAct hξ hw1 hw2 h1 h2 hv0' hvL' hpathξ j hj v hv).2)
  have hVo : IsOpen (U ∩ O ∩ {η : Cyl | |lam η + c0 - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2| < Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2}) :=
    (hU.inter hO).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
  have hξV : ξ ∈ U ∩ O ∩ {η : Cyl | |lam η + c0 - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2| < Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2} := by
    refine ⟨⟨hξU, hξO⟩, ?_⟩
    show |lam ξ + c0 - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2| < Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2
    rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hev : pulseTw5 B G f γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun η => Z (η, lam η + c0) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hVo.mem_nhds hξV) (fun η hη => by
      have h3 := hvco η hη.1.2
      have h4 : |vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2| < Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2 := by
        rw [h3]; exact hη.2
      show pulseTw5 B G f γ m η = Z (η, lam η + c0)
      rw [hrep η hη.1.1 h4, h3])
  have hNB : NB B.h (pulseTw5 B G f γ m) k ξ =
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => Z (η, lam η + c0)) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)‖ := by
    unfold NB
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
  rw [hNB]
  refine le_trans key (le_of_eq ?_)
  have hpow : (SC B.h ξ ^ e) ^ (12 * (k + 1)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b =
      SC B.h ξ ^ (e * ((12 * (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) + b) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_add hSpos, Real.rpow_mul hSpos.le, Real.rpow_natCast]
  rw [← hvξ, hX, hI, ← hpow]
  ring

subgoal_signatures.name: forced_pulse_jet_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (U : Set Cyl) (J : Set ℝ) (Z Gs : Cyl × ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (Ac : Cyl × ℝ → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) (Ar : Cyl × ℝ → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (p0 : Cyl) (Λ : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl) (lam : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c0 L X I : ℝ) (P : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsOpen U → IsOpen J → p0 ∈ U → Set.Icc 0 L ⊆ J → 0 < lam p0 + c0 → lam p0 + c0 < L → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Z (U ×ˢ J) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun pv : Cyl × ℝ => fun i j : Fin 3 => Ac pv i j) (U ×ˢ J) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Gs (U ×ˢ J) → (∀ pv i j, Ac pv i j = ((Ar pv i j : ℝ) : ℂ)) → (∀ p ∈ U, Z (p, 0) = 0) → (∀ p ∈ U, ∀ v ∈ J, HasDerivAt (fun v' => Z (p, v')) (Matrix.mulVec (Ac (p, v)) (Z (p, v)) - Gs (p, v)) v) → (∀ v, 0 < P v) → 1 ≤ X → L ≤ X → 0 ≤ I → (∀ w : Cyl, |lam (Λ w)| ≤ X * ‖w‖) → (∀ (x : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (w : ℝ), 0 ≤ w → w ≤ L → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w L, HasDerivAt x ((Ar (p0, v)).mulVec (x v)) v) → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w L, ‖x v‖ ≤ X * (P v / P w) * ‖x w‖) → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun pv : Cyl × ℝ => fun i j' : Fin 3 => Ar pv i j') (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ.prodMap (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖ ≤ X) → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j Gs (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ.prodMap (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖ ≤ I * P v) → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η : Cyl => Z (η, lam η + c0)) p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤ (16 ^ (k + 2) * X) ^ (12 * (k + 1)) * I * P (lam p0 + c0)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h U g hU hU0 hg hper ξ hξ
  set S : Set Cyl := {ξ : Cyl | (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1) ∈ U} with hSdef
  have hSo : IsOpen S :=
    hU.preimage (by fun_prop : Continuous fun η : Cyl => (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1))
  have hsl : ∀ ζ ∈ S, ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, ((ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) ∈ S := fun ζ hζ Y => hζ
  have hK : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  have hKm : MeasurableSet (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :=
    measurableSet_Icc.prod measurableSet_Icc
  have hslc : Continuous (fun p : Cyl × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((p.1.1, p.1.2.1, p.1.2.2.1, p.2) : Cyl)) := by
    fun_prop
  have sliceC : ∀ {F' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F'] (g : Cyl → F'),
      ContinuousOn g S → ∀ ξ ∈ S, Continuous (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl)) := by
    intro F' _ _ g hg ξ hξ
    have h := ContinuousOn.comp_continuous (g := g)
      (f := fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl)) hg (by fun_prop) (fun Y => hsl ξ hξ Y)
    exact h
  have intK : ∀ (g : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousOn g S → ∀ ξ ∈ S,
      IntegrableOn (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl))
        (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :=
    fun g hg ξ hξ => (sliceC g hg ξ hξ).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hK
  have regD : ∀ g : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g S →
      ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ g) S ∧ ∀ p ∈ S, HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℝ g p) p := fun g hg =>
    ⟨hg.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hSo (by simp), fun p hp =>
      ((hg.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hSo.mem_nhds hp)).hasFDerivAt⟩
  have LIN : ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ) (c d : ℝ), ContinuousOn f S → ContinuousOn g S → ∀ ξ ∈ S,
      yAvg (fun η => c * f η + d * g η) ξ = c * yAvg f ξ + d * yAvg g ξ := by
    intro f g c d hf hg ξ hξ
    simp only [yAvg]
    rw [integral_add (Integrable.const_mul (intK f hf ξ hξ) c) (Integrable.const_mul (intK g hg ξ hξ) d),
      integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl, ∀ x : Cyl, L x = (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, 0) :=
    ⟨(ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap (0 : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ)))), fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hslD : ∀ (x : Cyl) (Y : ℝ × ℝ),
      HasFDerivAt (fun x' : Cyl => ((x'.1, x'.2.1, x'.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl)) L x := by
    intro x Y
    have e : (fun x' : Cyl => ((x'.1, x'.2.1, x'.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl)) =
        fun x' => L x' + ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), Y) := by
      funext x'
      rw [hL]
      simp
    rw [e]
    exact L.hasFDerivAt.add_const _
  
  have DER : ∀ g : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g S → ∀ ξ ∈ S,
      HasFDerivAt (yAvg g) (∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
        (fderiv ℝ g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl)).comp L) ξ := by
    intro g hg ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨hgf, hgd⟩ := regD g hg
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hSo ξ hξ
    have hsU : Metric.closedBall ξ (δ / 2) ⊆ S :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
    have hsn : Metric.closedBall ξ (δ / 2) ∈ nhds ξ := Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds ξ (by linarith)
    have hC : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall ξ (δ / 2) ×ˢ (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)) :=
      (isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod hK
    have hcont : ContinuousOn
        (fun p : Cyl × (ℝ × ℝ) => (fderiv ℝ g ((p.1.1, p.1.2.1, p.1.2.2.1, p.2) : Cyl)).comp L)
        (Metric.closedBall ξ (δ / 2) ×ˢ (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)) := by
      have h1 : ContinuousOn
          (fun p : Cyl × (ℝ × ℝ) => fderiv ℝ g ((p.1.1, p.1.2.1, p.1.2.2.1, p.2) : Cyl))
          (Metric.closedBall ξ (δ / 2) ×ˢ (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)) :=
        hgf.comp hslc.continuousOn (fun p hp => hsl p.1 (hsU hp.1) p.2)
      exact h1.clm_comp continuousOn_const
    obtain ⟨Cb, hCb⟩ := hC.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hcont
    show HasFDerivAt (fun x : Cyl => ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
      g ((x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl)) _ ξ
    refine hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ)
      (μ := volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1))
      (F := fun x Y => g ((x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl))
      (F' := fun x Y => (fderiv ℝ g ((x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl)).comp L)
      (bound := fun _ => Cb) hsn ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · filter_upwards [hSo.mem_nhds hξ] with x hx
      exact (sliceC g hg.continuousOn x hx).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact intK g hg.continuousOn ξ hξ
    · exact ((sliceC _ hgf ξ hξ).clm_comp continuous_const).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hKm (fun Y hY x hx => hCb (x, Y) ⟨hx, hY⟩)
    · exact continuousOn_const.integrableOn_compact hK
    · exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hKm (fun Y _ x hx =>
        (hgd _ (hsl x (hsU hx) Y)).comp x (hslD x Y))
  have DERv : ∀ g : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g S → ∀ ξ ∈ S, ∀ v : Cyl,
      fderiv ℝ (yAvg g) ξ v = yAvg (fun η => fderiv ℝ g η (L v)) ξ := by
    intro g hg ξ hξ v
    rw [(DER g hg ξ hξ).fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply]
    · rfl
    · exact ((sliceC _ (regD g hg).1 ξ hξ).clm_comp continuous_const).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hK
  
  have FTC : ∀ (φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous φ' → (∀ s, HasDerivAt φ (φ' s) s) → φ 1 = φ 0 →
      ∫ s in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, φ' s = 0 := by
    intro φ φ' hc hd hp
    rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one,
      intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun s _ => hd s) (hc.intervalIntegrable 0 1), hp,
      sub_self]
  
  have YZ : ∀ g : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g S → ∀ ξ ∈ S,
      (∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y + ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) : Cyl) = g (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y)) →
      (∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) : Cyl) = g (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y)) →
      ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, yAvg (fun η => fderiv ℝ g η ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), w)) ξ = 0 := by
    intro g hg ξ hξ hp1 hp2 w
    obtain ⟨hgf, hgd⟩ := regD g hg
    obtain ⟨D1, hD1⟩ : ∃ D1 : Cyl → ℝ,
        D1 = fun η => fderiv ℝ g η ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨D2, hD2⟩ : ∃ D2 : Cyl → ℝ,
        D2 = fun η => fderiv ℝ g η ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hD1c : ContinuousOn D1 S := by rw [hD1]; exact hgf.clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have hD2c : ContinuousOn D2 S := by rw [hD2]; exact hgf.clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have hsplit : (fun η => fderiv ℝ g η ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), w)) = fun η => w.1 * D1 η + w.2 * D2 η := by
      funext η
      have e : ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), w) = w.1 • ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) +
          w.2 • ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) := by
        obtain ⟨w1, w2⟩ := w
        simp
      rw [hD1, hD2, e, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hI2 : yAvg D2 ξ = 0 := by
      show ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, D2 ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) = 0
      have hint : IntegrableOn (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => D2 ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl))
          (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod volume) := by
        rw [← Measure.volume_eq_prod]; exact intK D2 hD2c ξ hξ
      rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod ℝ ℝ, setIntegral_prod _ hint]
      have hin : ∀ a : ℝ, ∫ b in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, D2 ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (a, b)) : Cyl) = 0 := by
        intro a
        refine FTC (fun s => g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (a, s)) : Cyl))
          (fun s => D2 ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (a, s)) : Cyl)) ?_ ?_ ?_
        · exact (sliceC D2 hD2c ξ hξ).comp (by fun_prop : Continuous fun s : ℝ => ((a, s) : ℝ × ℝ))
        · intro s
          have hc : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (a, s)) : Cyl))
              ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) s :=
            (hasDerivAt_const s ξ.1).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_const s ξ.2.1).prodMk
              ((hasDerivAt_const s ξ.2.2.1).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_const s a).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' s))))
          have := (hgd ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (a, s)) : Cyl) (hsl ξ hξ (a, s))).comp_hasDerivAt s hc
          rw [hD2]
          exact this
        · have h := hp2 (a, 0)
          simp only [Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero, zero_add] at h
          exact h
      simp only [hin, integral_zero]
    have hI1 : yAvg D1 ξ = 0 := by
      show ∫ Y in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, D1 ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl) = 0
      rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod ℝ ℝ, ← setIntegral_prod_swap (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
        (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => D1 ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : Cyl))]
      have hint : IntegrableOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => D1 ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, z.swap) : Cyl))
          (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod volume) := by
        rw [← Measure.volume_eq_prod]
        exact ((sliceC D1 hD1c ξ hξ).comp continuous_swap).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hK
      rw [setIntegral_prod _ hint]
      have hin : ∀ a : ℝ, ∫ b in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, D1 ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (b, a)) : Cyl) = 0 := by
        intro a
        refine FTC (fun s => g ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (s, a)) : Cyl))
          (fun s => D1 ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (s, a)) : Cyl)) ?_ ?_ ?_
        · exact (sliceC D1 hD1c ξ hξ).comp (by fun_prop : Continuous fun s : ℝ => ((s, a) : ℝ × ℝ))
        · intro s
          have hc : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (s, a)) : Cyl))
              ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) s :=
            (hasDerivAt_const s ξ.1).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_const s ξ.2.1).prodMk
              ((hasDerivAt_const s ξ.2.2.1).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_id' s).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const s a))))
          have := (hgd ((ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, (s, a)) : Cyl) (hsl ξ hξ (s, a))).comp_hasDerivAt s hc
          rw [hD1]
          exact this
        · have h := hp1 (0, a)
          simp only [Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero, zero_add] at h
          exact h
      simp only [Prod.swap_prod_mk, hin, integral_zero]
    rw [hsplit, LIN D1 D2 w.1 w.2 hD1c hD2c ξ hξ, hI1, hI2]
    ring
  
  have PERs : ∀ g₀ : Cyl → ℝ, (∀ ζ ∈ S, ∀ n m : ℤ, g₀ (shY ζ ((n:ℝ), (m:ℝ))) = g₀ ζ) → ∀ ζ ∈ S,
      (∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, g₀ ((ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2.1, Y + ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) : Cyl) = g₀ (ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2.1, Y)) ∧
      (∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, g₀ ((ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2.1, Y + ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) : Cyl) = g₀ (ζ.1, ζ.2.1, ζ.2.2.1, Y)) := by
    intro g₀ hp ζ hζ
    refine ⟨fun Y => ?_, fun Y => ?_⟩
    · have h1 := hp _ (hsl ζ hζ Y) 1 0
      simp only [Int.cast_one, Int.cast_zero] at h1

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (pg : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (z0 t0 ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => pg p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ (Metric.ball z0 ε ×ˢ Metric.ball t0 ε)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun r => pg r z0 t0) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun r => deriv (fun t => pg r z0 t) t0) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun r => deriv (fun z => pg r z t0) z0) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun r => deriv (fun z => deriv (fun z' => pg r z' t0) z) z0) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => pg p.1 p.2 t0) (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Metric.ball z0 ε) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => pg p.1 z0 p.2) (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Metric.ball t0 ε) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => deriv (fun z' => pg p.1 z' t0) p.2) (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Metric.ball z0 ε)

signature.name: stp5z_slice_regular
signature.statement: ∀ (pg : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (z0 t0 ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => pg p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ (Metric.ball z0 ε ×ˢ Metric.ball t0 ε)) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun r => pg r z0 t0) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun r => deriv (fun t => pg r z0 t) t0) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun r => deriv (fun z => pg r z t0) z0) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun r => deriv (fun z => deriv (fun z' => pg r z' t0) z) z0) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => pg p.1 p.2 t0) (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Metric.ball z0 ε) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => pg p.1 z0 p.2) (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Metric.ball t0 ε) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => deriv (fun z' => pg p.1 z' t0) p.2) (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Metric.ball z0 ε)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro pg z0 t0 ε hε hPg
  have h0z : z0 ∈ Metric.ball z0 ε := Metric.mem_ball_self hε
  have h0t : t0 ∈ Metric.ball t0 ε := Metric.mem_ball_self hε
  set Ω := Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Metric.ball z0 ε ×ˢ Metric.ball t0 ε) with hΩdef
  have hΩo : IsOpen Ω := isOpen_Ioi.prod (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball)
  have memΩ : ∀ r z t : ℝ, 0 < r → z ∈ Metric.ball z0 ε → t ∈ Metric.ball t0 ε →
      ((r, z, t) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ω :=
    fun r z t hr hz ht => ⟨hr, hz, ht⟩
  have FLD : ∀ P' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P' Ω → ∀ v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => fderiv ℝ P' p v) Ω := fun P' hP' v =>
    (hP'.fderiv_of_isOpen hΩo (by simp)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have SDz : ∀ P' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P' Ω → ∀ r z t : ℝ, 0 < r →
      z ∈ Metric.ball z0 ε → t ∈ Metric.ball t0 ε →
      HasDerivAt (fun z' => P' (r, z', t)) (fderiv ℝ P' (r, z, t) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) z := by
    intro P' hP' r z t hr hz ht
    have hd := ((hP'.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
      (hΩo.mem_nhds (memΩ r z t hr hz ht))).hasFDerivAt
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun z' : ℝ => ((r, z', t) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) z :=
      (hasDerivAt_const z r).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_id' z).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const z t))
    exact hd.comp_hasDerivAt z hc
  have SDt : ∀ P' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P' Ω → ∀ r z t : ℝ, 0 < r →
      z ∈ Metric.ball z0 ε → t ∈ Metric.ball t0 ε →
      HasDerivAt (fun t' => P' (r, z, t')) (fderiv ℝ P' (r, z, t) ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) t := by
    intro P' hP' r z t hr hz ht
    have hd := ((hP'.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
      (hΩo.mem_nhds (memΩ r z t hr hz ht))).hasFDerivAt
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun t' : ℝ => ((r, z, t') : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) t :=
      (hasDerivAt_const t r).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_const t z).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' t))
    exact hd.comp_hasDerivAt t hc
  have embM : Set.MapsTo (fun r : ℝ => ((r, z0, t0) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (Set.Ioi 0) Ω :=
    fun r hr => memΩ r z0 t0 hr h0z h0t
  have SLc : ∀ g : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn g Ω →
      ContinuousOn (fun r => g (r, z0, t0)) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    fun g hg => hg.comp (by fun_prop : Continuous fun r : ℝ => ((r, z0, t0) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)).continuousOn embM
  have SLs : ∀ g : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g Ω →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun r => g (r, z0, t0)) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    fun g hg => hg.comp (by fun_prop : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun r : ℝ => ((r, z0, t0) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)).contDiffOn embM
  have mapsJ : Set.MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ((p.1, p.2, t0) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))
      (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Metric.ball z0 ε) Ω :=
    fun p hp => memΩ p.1 p.2 t0 hp.1 hp.2 h0t
  have mapsK : Set.MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ((p.1, z0, p.2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))
      (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Metric.ball t0 ε) Ω :=
    fun p hp => memΩ p.1 z0 p.2 hp.1 h0z hp.2
  have hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ((p.1, p.2, t0) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
  have hK : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ((p.1, z0, p.2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
  set Q : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p =>
    fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => pg p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) p ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) with hQdef
  have hQs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Q Ω := FLD _ hPg _
  have c1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun r => pg r z0 t0) (Set.Ioi 0) := SLs _ hPg
  have c2 : ContinuousOn (fun r => deriv (fun t => pg r z0 t) t0) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    (SLc _ (FLD _ hPg ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))).continuousOn).congr
      (fun r hr => (SDt _ hPg r z0 t0 hr h0z h0t).deriv)
  have c3 : ContinuousOn (fun r => deriv (fun z => pg r z t0) z0) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    (SLc _ (FLD _ hPg ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))).continuousOn).congr
      (fun r hr => (SDz _ hPg r z0 t0 hr h0z h0t).deriv)
  have hZZeq : ∀ r, 0 < r → deriv (fun z => deriv (fun z' => pg r z' t0) z) z0 =
      fderiv ℝ Q (r, z0, t0) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) := by
    intro r hr
    have hev : (fun z => deriv (fun z' => pg r z' t0) z) =ᶠ[nhds z0] (fun z => Q (r, z, t0)) := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds z0 hε] with y hy
      exact (SDz _ hPg r y t0 hr hy h0t).deriv
    rw [hev.deriv_eq]
    exact (SDz Q hQs r z0 t0 hr h0z h0t).deriv
  have c4 : ContinuousOn (fun r => deriv (fun z => deriv (fun z' => pg r z' t0) z) z0) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    (SLc _ (FLD _ hQs ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))).continuousOn).congr (fun r hr => hZZeq r hr)
  have c5 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => pg p.1 p.2 t0) (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Metric.ball z0 ε) :=
    hPg.comp hJ.contDiffOn mapsJ
  have c6 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => pg p.1 z0 p.2) (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Metric.ball t0 ε) :=
    hPg.comp hK.contDiffOn mapsK
  have c7 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => deriv (fun z' => pg p.1 z' t0) p.2)
      (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ Metric.ball z0 ε) := by
    refine (hQs.comp hJ.contDiffOn mapsJ).congr (fun p hp => ?_)
    exact (SDz _ hPg p.1 p.2 t0 hp.1 hp.2 h0t).deriv
  exact ⟨c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (pg : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (z0 t0 ε a b : ℝ) (k : ℕ), 0 < a → a < b → 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => pg p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ (Metric.ball z0 ε ×ˢ Metric.ball t0 ε)) → (∀ r z t : ℝ, 0 < r → (r ≤ a ∨ b ≤ r) → |z - z0| < ε → |t - t0| < ε → pg r z t = 0) → (∀ z t : ℝ, |z - z0| < ε → |t - t0| < ε → (∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ k * pg r z t) = 0) → (∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ k * deriv (fun t => pg r z0 t) t0) = 0 ∧ (∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ k * deriv (fun z => deriv (fun z' => pg r z' t0) z) z0) = 0

signature.name: stp5z_zero_moment
signature.statement: ∀ (pg : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (z0 t0 ε a b : ℝ) (k : ℕ), 0 < a → a < b → 0 < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => pg p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) (Set.Ioi 0 ×ˢ (Metric.ball z0 ε ×ˢ Metric.ball t0 ε)) → (∀ r z t : ℝ, 0 < r → (r ≤ a ∨ b ≤ r) → |z - z0| < ε → |t - t0| < ε → pg r z t = 0) → (∀ z t : ℝ, |z - z0| < ε → |t - t0| < ε → (∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ k * pg r z t) = 0) → (∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ k * deriv (fun t => pg r z0 t) t0) = 0 ∧ (∫ r in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ k * deriv (fun z => deriv (fun z' => pg r z' t0) z) z0) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro pg z0 t0 ε a b k ha hab hε hPg hvan hmom
  have bz : ∀ c δ x : ℝ, x ∈ Metric.ball c δ ↔ |x - c| < δ := fun c δ x => by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq]
  have h0z : |z0 - z0| < ε := by simp [hε]
  have h0t : |t0 - t0| < ε := by simp [hε]
  have LZ : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (O : Set ℝ) (x : ℝ), IsOpen O → x ∈ O → (∀ y ∈ O, g y = 0) →
      deriv g x = 0 := by
    intro g O x hO hx h
    have hev : g =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hx) h
    rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
  have RES : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (c d : ℝ), 0 < c → c ≤ a → b ≤ d →
      (∀ r, 0 < r → (r < a ∨ b < r) → f r = 0) →
      ∫ r in Ioi (0:ℝ), f r = ∫ r in Icc c d, f r := by
    intro f c d hc hca hbd h0
    apply setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi
    · intro x hx; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hc hx.1
    · intro x hx
      apply h0 x hx.1
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      exact hx.2 ⟨by linarith [hcon.1], by linarith [hcon.2]⟩
  have LB : ∀ (Φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (x0 δ : ℝ), 0 < δ →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Φ p.1 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Metric.ball x0 δ) →
      (∀ r x, 0 < r → (r ≤ a ∨ b ≤ r) → |x - x0| < δ → Φ r x = 0) →
      HasDerivAt (fun x => ∫ r in Ioi (0:ℝ), Φ r x)
        (∫ r in Ioi (0:ℝ), deriv (fun x => Φ r x) x0) x0 := by
    intro Φ x0 δ hδ hΦ hv
    have hUo : IsOpen (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Metric.ball x0 δ) := isOpen_Ioi.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hDc : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Φ p.1 p.2) p ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)))
        (Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Metric.ball x0 δ) :=
      (hΦ.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hUo (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have hDd : ∀ r x, 0 < r → |x - x0| < δ → HasDerivAt (fun x => Φ r x)
        (fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Φ p.1 p.2) (r, x) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) x := by
      intro r x hr hx
      have hmem : ((r, x) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Metric.ball x0 δ := ⟨hr, (bz _ _ _).2 hx⟩
      have hdiff := ((hΦ.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hUo.mem_nhds hmem)).hasFDerivAt
      have hc : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => ((r, x) : ℝ × ℝ)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) x :=
        (hasDerivAt_const x r).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' x)
      exact hdiff.comp_hasDerivAt x hc
    have hK : IsCompact (Icc a b ×ˢ Metric.closedBall x0 (δ/2)) :=
      isCompact_Icc.prod (isCompact_closedBall _ _)
    have hKU : Icc a b ×ˢ Metric.closedBall x0 (δ/2) ⊆ Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ Metric.ball x0 δ := fun p hp =>
      ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le ha hp.1.1, Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith) hp.2⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hDc.mono hKU)
    have hsn : Metric.ball x0 (δ/2) ∈ nhds x0 := Metric.ball_mem_nhds x0 (by linarith)
    have hab' : Icc a b ⊆ Ioi 0 := fun r hr => lt_of_lt_of_le ha hr.1
    have hball : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x0 (δ/2), |x - x0| < δ := by
      intro x hx
      have := (bz _ _ _).1 hx
      linarith
    have hx0 : |x0 - x0| < δ := by simp [hδ]
    have hFc : ∀ x, |x - x0| < δ → ContinuousOn (fun r => Φ r x) (Icc a b) := by
      intro x hx
      refine hΦ.continuousOn.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn ?_
      intro r hr
      exact ⟨hab' hr, (bz _ _ _).2 hx⟩
    have hD0c : ContinuousOn (fun r => fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Φ p.1 p.2) (r, x0) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)))
        (Icc a b) := by
      refine hDc.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn ?_
      intro r hr
      exact ⟨hab' hr, (bz _ _ _).2 hx0⟩
    obtain ⟨-, hLB⟩ := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (μ := volume.restrict (Icc a b)) (F := fun x r => Φ r x)
      (F' := fun x r => fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Φ p.1 p.2) (r, x) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)))
      (bound := fun _ => C) (x₀ := x0) hsn
      (Filter.eventually_of_mem hsn
        (fun x hx => (hFc x (hball x hx)).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Icc))
      ((hFc x0 hx0).integrableOn_Icc)
      (hD0c.aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Icc)
      (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Icc
        (fun r hr x hx => hC (r, x) ⟨hr, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx⟩))
      (continuousOn_const.integrableOn_Icc)
      (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Icc
        (fun r hr x hx => hDd r x (hab' hr) (hball x hx)))
    have hL : (fun x => ∫ r in Ioi (0:ℝ), Φ r x) =ᶠ[nhds x0] (fun x => ∫ r in Icc a b, Φ r x) := by
      filter_upwards [hsn] with x hx
      exact RES (fun r => Φ r x) a b ha le_rfl le_rfl
        (fun r hr h => hv r x hr (h.imp le_of_lt le_of_lt) (hball x hx))
    have hRv : ∀ r, 0 < r → (r < a ∨ b < r) → deriv (fun x => Φ r x) x0 = 0 := by
      intro r hr h
      apply LZ _ (Metric.ball x0 δ) x0 Metric.isOpen_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)
      intro y hy
      exact hv r y hr (h.imp le_of_lt le_of_lt) ((bz _ _ _).1 hy)
    have hR : (∫ r in Ioi (0:ℝ), deriv (fun x => Φ r x) x0) =
        ∫ r in Icc a b, fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Φ p.1 p.2) (r, x0) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) := by
      rw [RES _ a b ha le_rfl le_rfl hRv]
      exact setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc (fun r hr => (hDd r x0 (hab' hr) hx0).deriv)
    rw [hR]
    exact hLB.congr_of_eventuallyEq hL
  set Ω := Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Metric.ball z0 ε ×ˢ Metric.ball t0 ε) with hΩdef
  have hΩo : IsOpen Ω := isOpen_Ioi.prod (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball)
  have memΩ : ∀ r z t : ℝ, 0 < r → |z - z0| < ε → |t - t0| < ε → ((r, z, t) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ∈ Ω :=
    fun r z t hr hz ht => ⟨hr, (bz _ _ _).2 hz, (bz _ _ _).2 ht⟩
  have FLD : ∀ P' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P' Ω → ∀ v : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => fderiv ℝ P' p v) Ω := fun P' hP' v =>
    (hP'.fderiv_of_isOpen hΩo (by simp)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have SDz : ∀ P' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P' Ω → ∀ r z t : ℝ, 0 < r → |z - z0| < ε →
      |t - t0| < ε → HasDerivAt (fun z' => P' (r, z', t)) (fderiv ℝ P' (r, z, t) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) z := by
    intro P' hP' r z t hr hz ht
    have hd := ((hP'.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
      (hΩo.mem_nhds (memΩ r z t hr hz ht))).hasFDerivAt
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun z' : ℝ => ((r, z', t) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) z :=
      (hasDerivAt_const z r).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_id' z).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const z t))
    exact hd.comp_hasDerivAt z hc
  have hpow : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 ^ k) := contDiff_fst.pow k
  have TRI : ∀ x z1 : ℝ, |x - z1| < ε / 2 → |z1 - z0| < ε / 2 → |x - z0| < ε := by
    intro x z1 h1 h2
    rw [abs_sub_lt_iff] at h1 h2 ⊢
    constructor <;> linarith
  have DZ0 : ∀ r y, 0 < r → (r ≤ a ∨ b ≤ r) → |y - z0| < ε → deriv (fun z' => pg r z' t0) y = 0 :=
    fun r y hr h hy => LZ _ (Metric.ball z0 ε) y Metric.isOpen_ball ((bz _ _ _).2 hy)
      (fun w hw => hvan r w t0 hr h ((bz _ _ _).1 hw) h0t)
  set Q : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => pg p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) p ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))
    with hQdef
  have hQs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Q Ω := FLD _ hPg _
  have v1 : (∫ r in Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ k * deriv (fun t => pg r z0 t) t0) = 0 := by
    have hreg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 ^ k * pg p.1 z0 p.2) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Metric.ball t0 ε) :=
      hpow.contDiffOn.mul (hPg.comp (by fun_prop : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        ((p.1, z0, p.2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)).contDiffOn
        (fun p hp => memΩ p.1 z0 p.2 hp.1 h0z ((bz _ _ _).1 hp.2)))
    have hD := LB (fun r t => r ^ k * pg r z0 t) t0 ε hε hreg
      (fun r t hr h ht => by simp only [hvan r z0 t hr h h0z ht, mul_zero])
    have hu := hD.unique ((hasDerivAt_const t0 (0:ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq (by
      filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds t0 hε] with x hx
      exact hmom z0 x h0z ((bz _ _ _).1 hx)))
    simp only [deriv_const_mul_field] at hu
    exact hu
  have hJ : ∀ z1, |z1 - z0| < ε / 2 →
      (∫ r in Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ k * deriv (fun z => pg r z t0) z1) = 0 := by
    intro z1 hz1
    have hreg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 ^ k * pg p.1 p.2 t0)
        (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Metric.ball z1 (ε / 2)) :=
      hpow.contDiffOn.mul (hPg.comp (by fun_prop : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        ((p.1, p.2, t0) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)).contDiffOn
        (fun p hp => memΩ p.1 p.2 t0 hp.1 (TRI _ _ ((bz _ _ _).1 hp.2) hz1) h0t))
    have hD := LB (fun r z => r ^ k * pg r z t0) z1 (ε / 2) (by linarith) hreg
      (fun r z hr h hz => by simp only [hvan r z t0 hr h (TRI _ _ hz hz1) h0t, mul_zero])
    have hu := hD.unique ((hasDerivAt_const z1 (0:ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq (by
      filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds z1 (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < ε / 2)] with x hx
      exact hmom x t0 (TRI _ _ ((bz _ _ _).1 hx) hz1) h0t))
    simp only [deriv_const_mul_field] at hu
    exact hu
  have v5 : (∫ r in Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ k * deriv (fun z => deriv (fun z' => pg r z' t0) z) z0) = 0 := by
    have hreg0 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 ^ k * Q (p.1, p.2, t0))
        (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Metric.ball z0 (ε / 2)) :=
      hpow.contDiffOn.mul (hQs.comp (by fun_prop : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        ((p.1, p.2, t0) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)).contDiffOn
        (fun p hp => memΩ p.1 p.2 t0 hp.1 (by have := (bz _ _ _).1 hp.2; linarith) h0t))
    have hreg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 ^ k * deriv (fun z' => pg p.1 z' t0) p.2)
        (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Metric.ball z0 (ε / 2)) := by
      refine hreg0.congr (fun p hp => ?_)
      have hp2 : |p.2 - z0| < ε := by have := (bz _ _ _).1 hp.2; linarith
      show p.1 ^ k * deriv (fun z' => pg p.1 z' t0) p.2 = p.1 ^ k * Q (p.1, p.2, t0)
      rw [(SDz _ hPg p.1 p.2 t0 hp.1 hp2 h0t).deriv]
    have hD := LB (fun r z => r ^ k * deriv (fun z' => pg r z' t0) z) z0 (ε / 2) (by linarith) hreg
      (fun r z hr h hz => by simp only [DZ0 r z hr h (by linarith), mul_zero])
    have hu := hD.unique ((hasDerivAt_const z0 (0:ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq (by
      filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds z0 (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < ε / 2)] with x hx
      exact hJ x ((bz _ _ _).1 hx)))
    simp only [deriv_const_mul_field] at hu
    exact hu
  exact ⟨v1, v5⟩

by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n0, fun l0 hl0 S β D hW hmc γ m ξ hξ => ?_⟩
  
  have hQs : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]

    rw [hQs]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hl0) hn0.le
  obtain ⟨hΩ, hqC, hqpos, -, -, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  have hQb : 0 < Qb γ.1 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
  have hq0 := hqpos ξ hξ
  have hne : qC B.h ξ ≠ 0 := hq0.ne'
  have hd : HasFDerivAt (qC B.h) (fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) ξ) ξ :=
    ((hqC.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hξ)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
  
  have hR0 : fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) ξ ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) = 0 := by
    have hL : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ξ + t • ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv))
        ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) 0 := by
      have h0 := ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const
        ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)).const_add ξ
      simpa using h0
    have hd' : HasFDerivAt (qC B.h) (fderiv ℝ (qC B.h) ξ)

      rw [zero_smul, add_zero]; exact hd
    have h1 := hd'.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ) hL
    have hc : (qC B.h ∘ fun t : ℝ => ξ + t • ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)) =

    rw [hc] at h1
    exact h1.unique (hasDerivAt_const _ _)

    hd.rpow_const (Or.inl hne)

    unfold dZ
    rw [(hd.log hne).fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Real.rpow_sub_one hne]
    ring
  
  have hfun : modeCoef5 B G (cr5Vel B G D) γ m =
      (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m := by
    funext η j
    show _ = ((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) * modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m η j
    simp only [modeCoef5, cr5Vel, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hF : HasFDerivAt (modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m)

    (modeCoef5_differentiable_v5 B G hok hG (qsOf l0) β (wmoAmp5 B G D) hq hW γ m ξ hξ).hasFDerivAt

    intro i

    show fderiv ℝ (modeCoef5 B G (cr5Vel B G D) γ m) ξ

      Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hR0, mul_zero,

      ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (dZ (fun η => modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m η i) ξ -

    intro i

    show fderiv ℝ (modeCoef5 B G (cr5Vel B G D) γ m) ξ ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ × ℝ)) i =
      ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (fderiv ℝ (fun η => modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m η i) ξ
        ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ × ℝ)) -
        ((Aex B.h * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * modeCoef5 B G (wmoAmp5 B G D) γ m ξ i)
    rw [hfd, hFi]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply,
      Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hZw]

  have hval : ∀ i : Fin 3, modeCoef5 B G (cr5Vel B G D) γ m ξ i =

    intro i

    simp only [modeCoef5, cr5Vel, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hdR' : ∀ i : Fin 3, dR B.h (modeCoef5 B G (cr5Vel B G D) γ m) ξ i =
      ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((dR B.h (fun η => wmoAmp5 B G D γ m η i) ξ +
        Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        wmoAmp5 B G D γ m ξ i) * E) := by
    intro i
    rw [hjR i, (wmo_phase_deriv_v5 B G hok hG (qsOf l0) β (wmoAmp5 B G D) hq hW γ m ξ hξ i).1, hE]
  have hdZ' : ∀ i : Fin 3, dZ (modeCoef5 B G (cr5Vel B G D) γ m) ξ i =
      ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((dZ (fun η => wmoAmp5 B G D γ m η i) ξ +
        Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * ((dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        wmoAmp5 B G D γ m ξ i) * E -
        ((Aex B.h * dZ (fun η => Real.log (qC B.h η)) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (wmoAmp5 B G D γ m ξ i * E)) := by
    intro i

    rfl
  
  have ha : ∀ a : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt (mcor5 B G l0 S a) (fderiv ℝ (mcor5 B G l0 S a) ξ) ξ := fun a =>
    (((hmc a).contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hξ)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt

by

  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, -, -, -, -, -, haa, hab⟩ := hok.2.1

    obtain ⟨Ce, hCe0, -, hCe⟩ := stp5_edge_mono B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (max d 0) hXa hXab haa hab

  · have hMd : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => Mf η i j) ξ :=
      fun i j ξ hξ => (hM i j).1.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hξ)

            NB B.h (fun η => Mf η i j) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ b :=
          fun i j => hK _ (hM i j) k

        refine ⟨∑ i, ∑ j, Cij i j, ∑ i, ∑ j, |bij i j|, fun γ m ξ hξ _ hX1 hX2 i j => ?_⟩

            Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => Cij i j) (fun j _ => hC0 i j) (Finset.mem_univ j)

            Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |bij i j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
              (Finset.mem_univ j)
          have h2 : ∑ j, |bij i j| ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, |bij i j| :=
            Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => ∑ j, |bij i j|)
              (fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
          linarith
        have hqa : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg (hqp ξ hξ).le _
        have hSle : SC B.h ξ ^ bij i j ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ (∑ i, ∑ j, |bij i j|) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (hSC1 ξ) hble
        have hCs : 0 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, Cij i j := le_trans (hC0 i j) hCle
        calc NB B.h (fun η => Mf η i j) k ξ ≤ Cij i j * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bij i j :=
              hCij i j ξ hξ hX1 hX2
          _ ≤ (∑ i, ∑ j, Cij i j) * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ (∑ i, ∑ j, |bij i j|) :=
              mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCle hqa) hSle (hSC ξ _) (mul_nonneg hCs hqa))
    rw [add_comm β α] at H
    exact H

subgoal_signatures.name: domc_open_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ) ∧ ContinuousOn (XC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dT f) (DomC B.h qs)) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → dR B.h f ξ = 0 ∧ dZ f ξ = 0 ∧ dT f ξ = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: stp5_edge_mono
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (Xa Xb aa ab d : ℝ), 0 < Xa → Xa < Xb → 0 < aa → 0 < ab → 0 ≤ d → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ (∀ X X' : ℝ, ((Xa < X' ∧ X' ≤ X ∧ X ≤ Real.sqrt (Xa * Xb)) ∨ (Real.sqrt (Xa * Xb) ≤ X ∧ X ≤ X' ∧ X' < Xb)) → edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X' * edgeDist Xa Xb X' ^ (-d) ≤ C * (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-d))) ∧ (∀ X : ℝ, Xa < X → X < Xb → edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-d) ≤ C)

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ), B.ok → ∀ (α β : ℝ) (a : WC) (μ : Lab → Cyl → ℂ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → (∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (μ γ) ξ) → (∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), a γ m ξ ≠ 0 → ∀ c : ℝ × ℝ, IsDeck B.h (qC B.h ξ) c → μ γ (shY ξ c) = μ γ ξ) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ξ ∈ tsupport (a γ m) → B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (μ γ) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * β) * SC B.h ξ ^ b) → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α + β) (fun γ m ξ => μ γ ξ • a γ m ξ)
