informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h r0 : ℝ) (γ : Lab) (c : ℝ × ℝ), 0 < r0 → r0 ≤ 1/100 → (∀ (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (s : ℝ), |xiG h γ c Y| ≤ 4 * r0 → |etG h γ c Y + s * cib h γ.1| ≤ 4 * r0 → xiG h γ c (Y + s • ((cib h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx h γ.1))) • vtv)) = xiG h γ c Y ∧ etG h γ c (Y + s • ((cib h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx h γ.1))) • vtv)) = etG h γ c Y + s * cib h γ.1) ∧ (∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → a ≤ 2 * r0 → 0 ≤ b → b ≤ 2 * r0 → IsClosed {Y : ℝ × ℝ | |xiG h γ c Y| ≤ a ∧ |etG h γ c Y| ≤ b}) ∧ (∀ Y0 : ℝ × ℝ, |xiG h γ c Y0| < 2 * r0 → |etG h γ c Y0| < 2 * r0 → ∃ U : Set (ℝ × ℝ), IsOpen U ∧ Y0 ∈ U ∧ ∃ k : ℝ × ℝ, ∀ Y ∈ U, rectW h γ c Y = Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - k) ∧ (∀ (Y k : ℝ × ℝ) (s : ℝ), lamR (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) (Y + s • ((cib h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx h γ.1))) • vtv)) - c - k) = lamR (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - k) ∧ lamT (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) (Y + s • ((cib h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx h γ.1))) • vtv)) - c - k) = lamT (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - k) + s * cib h γ.1)

signature.name: pulse_rect_path_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (h r0 : ℝ) (γ : Lab) (c : ℝ × ℝ), 0 < r0 → r0 ≤ 1/100 → (∀ (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (s : ℝ), |xiG h γ c Y| ≤ 4 * r0 → |etG h γ c Y + s * cib h γ.1| ≤ 4 * r0 → xiG h γ c (Y + s • ((cib h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx h γ.1))) • vtv)) = xiG h γ c Y ∧ etG h γ c (Y + s • ((cib h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx h γ.1))) • vtv)) = etG h γ c Y + s * cib h γ.1) ∧ (∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → a ≤ 2 * r0 → 0 ≤ b → b ≤ 2 * r0 → IsClosed {Y : ℝ × ℝ | |xiG h γ c Y| ≤ a ∧ |etG h γ c Y| ≤ b}) ∧ (∀ Y0 : ℝ × ℝ, |xiG h γ c Y0| < 2 * r0 → |etG h γ c Y0| < 2 * r0 → ∃ U : Set (ℝ × ℝ), IsOpen U ∧ Y0 ∈ U ∧ ∃ k : ℝ × ℝ, ∀ Y ∈ U, rectW h γ c Y = Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - k) ∧ (∀ (Y k : ℝ × ℝ) (s : ℝ), lamR (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) (Y + s • ((cib h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx h γ.1))) • vtv)) - c - k) = lamR (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - k) ∧ lamT (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) (Y + s • ((cib h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx h γ.1))) • vtv)) - c - k) = lamT (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - k) + s * cib h γ.1)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h r0 γ c hr0 hr01
  
  have hs1 : 1 < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.one_lt_sqrt_two
  have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hbgc0 : 0 < bgc := by unfold bgc; linarith
  have hbgc1 : bgc < 1 := by unfold bgc; nlinarith
  have hD : (0:ℝ) < 1 + bgc ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hD' : (1:ℝ) + bgc ^ 2 ≠ 0 := hD.ne'
  have hTgc : Tgc ≠ 0 := by unfold Tgc; positivity
  
  have hlamR : ∀ (w : ℝ × ℝ) (t : ℝ), lamR (w + t • vtv) = lamR w := by
    intro w t
    simp only [lamR, vtv, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul]
    congr 1; ring
  have hlamT : ∀ (w : ℝ × ℝ) (t : ℝ), lamT (w + t • vtv) = lamT w + t := by
    intro w t
    simp only [lamT, vtv, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hshift : ∀ (n : ℤ) (a s : ℝ) (Y : ℝ × ℝ),
      Jpow n (Y + s • ((a * Tgc ^ (-n)) • vtv)) = Jpow n Y + (s * a) • vtv := by
    intro n a s Y
    have e : s • ((a * Tgc ^ (-n)) • vtv) = (s * a * Tgc ^ (-n)) • vtv := by
      rw [smul_smul]; ring_nf
    rw [e]
    have h1 := hlamR Y (s * a * Tgc ^ (-n))
    have h2 := hlamT Y (s * a * Tgc ^ (-n))
    unfold lamR at h1
    unfold lamT at h2
    have hTn : Tgc ^ n ≠ 0 := zpow_ne_zero n hTgc
    have hk : Tgc ^ n * (s * a * Tgc ^ (-n)) = s * a := by
      rw [zpow_neg]; field_simp
    unfold Jpow
    rw [h1, h2, mul_add, add_smul, hk, add_assoc]
  
  have hcoord : ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ, |w.1| ≤ |lamR w| + |lamT w| ∧ |w.2| ≤ |lamR w| + |lamT w| := by
    intro w
    have e1 : w.1 = lamR w + bgc * lamT w := by unfold lamR lamT; field_simp; ring
    have e2 : w.2 = -bgc * lamR w + lamT w := by unfold lamR lamT; field_simp; ring
    have hb : |bgc| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_of_pos hbgc0]; exact hbgc1.le
    have hm1 : |bgc * lamT w| ≤ |lamT w| := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) hb
    have hm2 : |-bgc * lamR w| ≤ |lamR w| := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_neg]; exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) hb
    constructor
    · calc |w.1| = |lamR w + bgc * lamT w| := by rw [← e1]
        _ ≤ |lamR w| + |bgc * lamT w| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ |lamR w| + |lamT w| := by linarith
    · calc |w.2| = |-bgc * lamR w + lamT w| := by rw [← e2]
        _ ≤ |-bgc * lamR w| + |lamT w| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ |lamR w| + |lamT w| := by linarith
  
  have hround : ∀ (x : ℝ) (k : ℤ), |x - k| < 1/2 → round x = k := by
    intro x k hx
    have h0 : round (x - k) = 0 := by
      rw [round_eq_zero_iff]
      rw [abs_lt] at hx
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have := round_add_intCast (x - k) k
    rw [sub_add_cancel, h0, zero_add] at this
    exact this
  have hfr : ∀ Y : ℝ × ℝ, rectW h γ c Y = Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c -
      ((((round (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c).1 : ℤ) : ℝ)), (((round (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c).2 : ℤ) : ℝ))) := by
    intro Y
    rfl
  have hnear : ∀ (Y : ℝ × ℝ) (k1 k2 : ℤ),
      |(Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ))).1| < 1/2 →
      |(Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ))).2| < 1/2 →
      rectW h γ c Y = Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ)) := by
    intro Y k1 k2 h1 h2
    rw [hfr, hround _ _ h1, hround _ _ h2]
  have hFc : Continuous (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c) := by
    unfold Jpow; fun_prop
  have hlRc : Continuous lamR := by unfold lamR; fun_prop
  have hlTc : Continuous lamT := by unfold lamT; fun_prop
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro Y s hx hy
    obtain ⟨k1, hk1⟩ : ∃ k : ℤ, k = round (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c).1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨k2, hk2⟩ : ∃ k : ℤ, k = round (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c).2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hf : rectW h γ c Y = Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ)) := by
      rw [hfr, hk1, hk2]
    have hgeq : Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) (Y + s • ((cib h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx h γ.1))) • vtv)) - c -
        ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ)) =
        (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ))) + (s * cib h γ.1) • vtv := by
      rw [hshift]; abel
    have hgR : lamR (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) (Y + s • ((cib h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx h γ.1))) • vtv)) - c -
        ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ))) = xiG h γ c Y := by
      rw [hgeq, hlamR]; unfold xiG; rw [hf]
    have hgT : lamT (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) (Y + s • ((cib h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx h γ.1))) • vtv)) - c -
        ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ))) = etG h γ c Y + s * cib h γ.1 := by
      rw [hgeq, hlamT]; unfold etG; rw [hf]
    have hb := hcoord (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) (Y + s • ((cib h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx h γ.1))) • vtv)) - c -
        ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ)))
    rw [hgR, hgT] at hb
    have hnr := hnear (Y + s • ((cib h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx h γ.1))) • vtv)) k1 k2
      (by linarith [hb.1]) (by linarith [hb.2])
    constructor
    · unfold xiG; rw [hnr]; exact hgR
    · unfold etG; rw [hnr]; exact hgT
  · 
    intro a b _ ha _ hb
    apply isClosed_of_closure_subset
    intro Y0 hY0
    obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U : Set (ℝ × ℝ),
        U = (fun Y : ℝ × ℝ => Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y0 - c) (1/10) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hUo : IsOpen U := by rw [hU]; exact Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage hFc
    have hY0U : Y0 ∈ U := by
      rw [hU]; show Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y0 - c ∈ Metric.ball (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y0 - c) (1/10)
      exact Metric.mem_ball_self (by norm_num)
    have hUd : ∀ Y ∈ U, dist (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c) (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y0 - c) < 1/10 := by
      intro Y hY
      rw [hU] at hY
      exact Metric.mem_ball.1 hY
    obtain ⟨Y1, hY1U, hY1S⟩ := _root_.mem_closure_iff.1 hY0 U hUo hY0U
    obtain ⟨k1, hk1⟩ : ∃ k : ℤ, k = round (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y1 - c).1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨k2, hk2⟩ : ∃ k : ℤ, k = round (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y1 - c).2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hf1 : rectW h γ c Y1 = Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y1 - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ)) := by
      rw [hfr, hk1, hk2]
    have hS1 : |xiG h γ c Y1| ≤ a ∧ |etG h γ c Y1| ≤ b := hY1S
    unfold xiG etG at hS1
    rw [hf1] at hS1
    have hc1 := hcoord (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y1 - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ)))
    have hd1 : ∀ p q : ℝ × ℝ, |p.1 - q.1| ≤ dist p q := fun p q => by
      rw [Prod.dist_eq, ← Real.dist_eq]; exact le_max_left _ _
    have hd2 : ∀ p q : ℝ × ℝ, |p.2 - q.2| ≤ dist p q := fun p q => by
      rw [Prod.dist_eq, ← Real.dist_eq]; exact le_max_right _ _
    have hUeq : ∀ Y ∈ U, rectW h γ c Y = Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ)) := by
      intro Y hY
      have hdY := hUd Y hY
      have hdY1 := hUd Y1 hY1U
      apply hnear Y k1 k2
      · have e : (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ))).1 =
            ((Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c).1 - (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y0 - c).1)
            - ((Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y1 - c).1 - (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y0 - c).1)
            + (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y1 - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ))).1 := by
          show _ - (k1 : ℝ) = _ + (_ - (k1 : ℝ)); ring
        rw [e]
        have t1 := (hd1 (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c) (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y0 - c)).trans_lt hdY
        have t2 := (hd1 (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y1 - c) (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y0 - c)).trans_lt hdY1
        have t3 := hc1.1
        rw [abs_lt] at t1 t2 ⊢
        rw [abs_le] at t3
        have u1 := abs_le.1 hS1.1
        have u2 := abs_le.1 hS1.2
        constructor <;> linarith [t1.1, t1.2, t2.1, t2.2, t3.1, t3.2, u1.1, u1.2, u2.1, u2.2,
          abs_nonneg (lamR (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y1 - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ)))),
          abs_nonneg (lamT (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y1 - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ))))]
      · have e : (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ))).2 =
            ((Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c).2 - (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y0 - c).2)
            - ((Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y1 - c).2 - (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y0 - c).2)
            + (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y1 - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ))).2 := by
          show _ - (k2 : ℝ) = _ + (_ - (k2 : ℝ)); ring
        rw [e]
        have t1 := (hd2 (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c) (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y0 - c)).trans_lt hdY
        have t2 := (hd2 (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y1 - c) (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y0 - c)).trans_lt hdY1
        have t3 := hc1.2
        rw [abs_lt] at t1 t2 ⊢
        rw [abs_le] at t3
        have u1 := abs_le.1 hS1.1
        have u2 := abs_le.1 hS1.2
        constructor <;> linarith [t1.1, t1.2, t2.1, t2.2, t3.1, t3.2, u1.1, u1.2, u2.1, u2.2,
          abs_nonneg (lamR (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y1 - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ)))),
          abs_nonneg (lamT (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y1 - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ))))]
    have hT : IsClosed {Y : ℝ × ℝ | |lamR (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ)))| ≤ a ∧
        |lamT (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ)))| ≤ b} :=
      (isClosed_le (hlRc.comp (hFc.sub continuous_const)).abs continuous_const).inter
        (isClosed_le (hlTc.comp (hFc.sub continuous_const)).abs continuous_const)
    have hsub : U ∩ {Y : ℝ × ℝ | |xiG h γ c Y| ≤ a ∧ |etG h γ c Y| ≤ b} ⊆
        {Y : ℝ × ℝ | |lamR (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ)))| ≤ a ∧
          |lamT (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ)))| ≤ b} := by
      rintro Y ⟨hYU, hYS⟩
      have hYS' : |xiG h γ c Y| ≤ a ∧ |etG h γ c Y| ≤ b := hYS
      unfold xiG etG at hYS'
      rw [hUeq Y hYU] at hYS'
      exact hYS'
    have hY0T := closure_minimal hsub hT (hUo.inter_closure ⟨hY0U, hY0⟩)
    show |xiG h γ c Y0| ≤ a ∧ |etG h γ c Y0| ≤ b
    unfold xiG etG
    rw [hUeq Y0 hY0U]
    exact hY0T
  · 
    intro Y0 hx hy
    obtain ⟨k1, hk1⟩ : ∃ k : ℤ, k = round (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y0 - c).1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨k2, hk2⟩ : ∃ k : ℤ, k = round (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y0 - c).2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hf : rectW h γ c Y0 = Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y0 - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ)) := by
      rw [hfr, hk1, hk2]
    unfold xiG at hx
    unfold etG at hy
    rw [hf] at hx hy
    have hb := hcoord (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y0 - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ)))
    refine ⟨{Y : ℝ × ℝ | |(Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ))).1| < 1/2} ∩
      {Y : ℝ × ℝ | |(Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ))).2| < 1/2}, ?_, ?_,
      ((k1 : ℝ), (k2 : ℝ)), ?_⟩
    · exact (isOpen_lt ((hFc.sub continuous_const).fst.abs) continuous_const).inter
        (isOpen_lt ((hFc.sub continuous_const).snd.abs) continuous_const)
    · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq]; linarith [hb.1]
      · rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq]; linarith [hb.2]
    · rintro Y ⟨h1, h2⟩
      exact hnear Y k1 k2 h1 h2
  · 
    intro Y k s
    rw [hshift]
    have e : Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y + (s * cib h γ.1) • vtv - c - k =
        (Jpow (bandIdx h γ.1) Y - c - k) + (s * cib h γ.1) • vtv := by abel
    rw [e, hlamR, hlamT]
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (f : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ0 : Cyl), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB → (∀ (γ' : Lab) (m' : ℤ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f γ' m') (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → ξ0 ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ0.2.2.2| < G.r0 / 2 → 0 ≤ vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ0.2.2.2 → vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ0.2.2.2 ≤ Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 → ∃ (V : Set Cyl) (z : Cyl → ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), IsOpen V ∧ pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0 ∈ V ∧ ∀ β ∈ V, z β 0 = 0 ∧ (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), HasDerivAt (z β) (pulseRhs5 B G f γ m (β + w • dVdir B.h γ.1) (z β w)) w) ∧ (∀ w : ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun p : Cyl × ℝ => z p.1 p.2) (β, w)) ∧ (∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), ∀ x y : Fin 3 → ℂ, ‖pulseRhs5 B G f γ m (β + w • dVdir B.h γ.1) x - pulseRhs5 B G f γ m (β + w • dVdir B.h γ.1) y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖) ∧ (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), pulseZsol5 B G f γ m β w = z β w)

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (f : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ0 : Cyl), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB → (∀ (γ' : Lab) (m' : ℤ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f γ' m') (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → ξ0 ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ0.2.2.2| < G.r0 / 2 → 0 ≤ vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ0.2.2.2 → vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ0.2.2.2 ≤ Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 → ∃ (V : Set Cyl) (z : Cyl → ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), IsOpen V ∧ pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0 ∈ V ∧ ∀ β ∈ V, z β 0 = 0 ∧ (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), HasDerivAt (z β) (pulseRhs5 B G f γ m (β + w • dVdir B.h γ.1) (z β w)) w) ∧ (∀ w : ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun p : Cyl × ℝ => z p.1 p.2) (β, w)) ∧ (∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), ∀ x y : Fin 3 → ℂ, ‖pulseRhs5 B G f γ m (β + w • dVdir B.h γ.1) x - pulseRhs5 B G f γ m (β + w • dVdir B.h γ.1) y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖) ∧ (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), pulseZsol5 B G f γ m β w = z β w)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 f γ m ξ0 hok hG hqsB hfs hξ0 hx hv0 hvL
  obtain ⟨hr0, hr01, -⟩ := hG.1
  
  have hQbpos : ∀ l : ℕ, 0 < Qb l := fun l => Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hTgc : 0 < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; positivity
  have hcib : ∀ l : ℕ, 0 < cib B.h l := fun l =>
    mul_pos (zpow_pos hTgc _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hQbpos l) _)
  have hLpos : 0 < Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 := div_pos (by linarith) (hcib γ.1)
  have hLc : Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 * cib B.h γ.1 = 2 * G.r0 := by
    unfold Lsb; rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hcib γ.1).ne']
  have hvco : ∀ (Y : ℝ × ℝ), etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) Y =
      vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) Y * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0 := by
    intro Y; unfold vco; rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hcib γ.1).ne']; ring
  
  have hshift : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (s : ℝ) (l : ℕ), ξ + s • dVdir B.h l =
      (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, ξ.2.2.2 + s • ((cib B.h l * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx B.h l))) • vtv)) := by
    intro ξ s l
    obtain ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ := ξ
    simp only [dVdir, Prod.smul_mk, Prod.mk_add_mk, smul_zero, add_zero]
  have hpth : ∀ (w : ℝ), pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0 + w • dVdir B.h γ.1 =
      ξ0 + (w - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ0.2.2.2) • dVdir B.h γ.1 := by
    intro w; unfold pulsePth5; rw [add_assoc, ← add_smul]; congr 2; ring
  have hpathD : ∀ w : ℝ, pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0 + w • dVdir B.h γ.1 ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := by
    intro w; rw [hpth, hshift]; exact hξ0
  have hgeo : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1),
      xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0 + w • dVdir B.h γ.1).2.2.2 =
        xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ0.2.2.2 ∧
      etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0 + w • dVdir B.h γ.1).2.2.2 =
        w * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0 := by
    intro w hw
    rw [hpth, hshift]
    have hwc0 : 0 ≤ w * cib B.h γ.1 := mul_nonneg hw.1 (hcib γ.1).le
    have hwc1 : w * cib B.h γ.1 ≤ 2 * G.r0 := by
      rw [← hLc]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hw.2 (hcib γ.1).le
    have he : etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ0.2.2.2 + (w - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ0.2.2.2) * cib B.h γ.1 =
        w * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0 := by rw [hvco]; ring
    have c2 := (pulse_rect_path_v5 B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) hr0 hr01).1 ξ0.2.2.2
      (w - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ0.2.2.2) (by linarith)
      (by rw [he]; exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
    exact ⟨c2.1, by rw [c2.2, he]⟩
  
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : Set (Set Cyl), S = {W : Set Cyl | IsOpen W ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ η i) W) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => nPhiP5 B G γ η i) W) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Kmat B G γ η i j) W)} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hSmem : ∀ W ∈ S, IsOpen W ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ η i) W) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => nPhiP5 B G γ η i) W) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Kmat B G γ η i j) W) := by
    intro W hW; rw [hS, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hW; exact hW
  obtain ⟨U, hUdef⟩ : ∃ U : Set Cyl, U = DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ ⋃₀ S := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hUo : IsOpen U := by
    rw [hUdef]; exact hDopen.inter (isOpen_sUnion (fun W hW => (hSmem W hW).1))
  have hUD : U ⊆ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := by rw [hUdef]; exact Set.inter_subset_left
  have hloc : ∀ (g : Cyl → ℝ), (∀ W ∈ S, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U := by
    intro g hg
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (⋃₀ S) := by
      apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
      intro x hxS
      obtain ⟨W, hWS, hxW⟩ := Set.mem_sUnion.1 hxS
      exact ⟨W, (hSmem W hWS).1, hxW, (hg W hWS).mono Set.inter_subset_right⟩
    rw [hUdef]; exact h1.mono Set.inter_subset_right
  have hn : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ η i) U := fun i =>
    hloc _ (fun W hW => (hSmem W hW).2.1 i)
  have hnP : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => nPhiP5 B G γ η i) U := fun i =>
    hloc _ (fun W hW => (hSmem W hW).2.2.1 i)
  have hK : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Kmat B G γ η i j) U := fun i j =>
    hloc _ (fun W hW => (hSmem W hW).2.2.2 i j)
  have hpathU : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1),
      pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0 + t • dVdir B.h γ.1 ∈ U := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨g1, g2⟩ := hgeo t ht
    have hD := hpathD t
    have hDB : pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0 + t • dVdir B.h γ.1 ∈ DomC B.h B.qB :=
      ⟨hD.1, hD.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hD.2.2 hqsB⟩
    have hx8 : |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0 + t • dVdir B.h γ.1).2.2.2| < 1/8 := by
      rw [g1]; linarith
    have hy8 : |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0 + t • dVdir B.h γ.1).2.2.2| < 1/8 := by
      rw [g2]
      have hwc0 : 0 ≤ t * cib B.h γ.1 := mul_nonneg ht.1 (hcib γ.1).le
      have hwc1 : t * cib B.h γ.1 ≤ 2 * G.r0 := by
        rw [← hLc]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht.2 (hcib γ.1).le
      rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
    obtain ⟨W, hWo, hW, -, h1, h2, h3⟩ := good_coeff_smooth_v5 B G γ _ hok hDB hx8 hy8
    have hWS : W ∈ S := by rw [hS, Set.mem_setOf_eq]; exact ⟨hWo, h1, h2, h3⟩
    rw [hUdef]
    exact Set.mem_inter hD (Set.mem_sUnion.2 ⟨W, hWS, hW⟩)
  
  obtain ⟨A, b, hAs, hbs, hAb⟩ :=
    pulse_rhs_family_v5 B G f γ m (qsOf l0) U hok hUo hUD (hfs γ m) hn hnP hK
  
  have hlc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0 + t • dVdir B.h γ.1) :=
    continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)
  have hKc : IsCompact ((fun t : ℝ => pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0 + t • dVdir B.h γ.1) ''
      Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1)) := isCompact_Icc.image hlc
  have hKU : ((fun t : ℝ => pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0 + t • dVdir B.h γ.1) ''
      Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1)) ⊆ U := by
    rintro _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩; exact hpathU t ht
  obtain ⟨δ0, hδ0, hthick⟩ := hKc.exists_thickening_subset_open hUo hKU
  
  have hne : 0 < ‖dVdir B.h γ.1‖ + 1 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨δ, hδdef⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, δ = δ0 / 2 / (‖dVdir B.h γ.1‖ + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by rw [hδdef]; positivity
  have hδe : δ * (‖dVdir B.h γ.1‖ + 1) = δ0 / 2 := by
    rw [hδdef]; exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hne.ne'
  have hσ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Real.smoothTransition := Real.smoothTransition.contDiff
  obtain ⟨χ, hχdef⟩ : ∃ χ : ℝ → ℝ, χ = fun w => w - (w - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) *
      Real.smoothTransition (2 * (w - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) / δ) - w * Real.smoothTransition (-2 * w / δ) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hχc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ := by
    rw [hχdef]
    exact (contDiff_id.sub ((contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).mul (hσ.comp
      ((contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)).div_const δ)))).sub
      (contDiff_id.mul (hσ.comp ((contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id).div_const δ)))
  have hχid : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), χ w = w := by
    intro w hw
    have a1 : 2 * (w - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) / δ ≤ 0 :=
      (div_le_iff₀ hδ).2 (by rw [zero_mul]; linarith [hw.2])
    have a2 : -2 * w / δ ≤ 0 := (div_le_iff₀ hδ).2 (by rw [zero_mul]; linarith [hw.1])
    rw [hχdef]; dsimp only
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos a1, Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos a2]
    ring
  have hχr : ∀ w : ℝ, χ w ∈ Set.Icc (-δ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 + δ) := by
    intro w
    rw [hχdef]; dsimp only
    have ha0 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (2 * (w - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) / δ)
    have ha1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (2 * (w - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) / δ)
    have hb0 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (-2 * w / δ)
    have hb1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (-2 * w / δ)
    rcases le_total w 0 with hw | hw
    · have a1 : 2 * (w - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) / δ ≤ 0 :=
        (div_le_iff₀ hδ).2 (by rw [zero_mul]; linarith)
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos a1]
      by_cases hb : 1 ≤ -2 * w / δ
      · rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le hb]
        constructor <;> nlinarith
      · push_neg at hb
        have hw2 : -2 * w < δ := by
          have := (div_lt_iff₀ hδ).1 hb; linarith
        constructor <;> nlinarith
    · have a2 : -2 * w / δ ≤ 0 := (div_le_iff₀ hδ).2 (by rw [zero_mul]; linarith)
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos a2]
      by_cases ha : 1 ≤ 2 * (w - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) / δ
      · rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le ha]
        constructor <;> nlinarith
      · push_neg at ha
        have hw2 : 2 * (w - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) < δ := by
          have := (div_lt_iff₀ hδ).1 ha; linarith
        rcases le_total w (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) with hw' | hw'
        · have a1 : 2 * (w - Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) / δ ≤ 0 :=
            (div_le_iff₀ hδ).2 (by rw [zero_mul]; linarith)
          rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos a1]
          constructor <;> nlinarith
        · constructor <;> nlinarith
  
  have htube : ∀ β ∈ Metric.ball (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0) (δ0 / 2),
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-δ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 + δ), β + t • dVdir B.h γ.1 ∈ U := by
    intro β hβ t ht
    obtain ⟨t', ht', htt⟩ : ∃ t' ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), |t - t'| ≤ δ := by
      rcases le_total t 0 with h | h
      · exact ⟨0, ⟨le_rfl, hLpos.le⟩, by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [ht.1]⟩
      · rcases le_total t (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) with h' | h'
        · exact ⟨t, ⟨h, h'⟩, by rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; exact hδ.le⟩
        · exact ⟨Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1, ⟨hLpos.le, le_rfl⟩,
            by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [ht.2]⟩
    apply hthick
    rw [Metric.mem_thickening_iff]
    refine ⟨pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0 + t' • dVdir B.h γ.1, ⟨t', ht', rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    have hid : β + t • dVdir B.h γ.1 - (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0 + t' • dVdir B.h γ.1) =
        (β - pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0) + (t - t') • dVdir B.h γ.1 := by rw [sub_smul]; abel
    rw [hid]
    have hb : ‖β - pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0‖ < δ0 / 2 := by rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact hβ
    have h2 : ‖(t - t') • dVdir B.h γ.1‖ ≤ δ * ‖dVdir B.h γ.1‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htt (norm_nonneg _)
    have h3 : δ * ‖dVdir B.h γ.1‖ ≤ δ0 / 2 := by rw [← hδe]; nlinarith
    calc ‖(β - pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0) + (t - t') • dVdir B.h γ.1‖
        ≤ ‖β - pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0‖ + ‖(t - t') • dVdir B.h γ.1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ < δ0 / 2 + δ0 / 2 := by linarith
      _ = δ0 := by ring
  
  obtain ⟨φ, hφdef⟩ : ∃ φ : Cyl × ℝ → Cyl, φ = fun p => p.1 + χ p.2 • dVdir B.h γ.1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hφc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ := by
    rw [hφdef]; exact contDiff_fst.add ((hχc.comp contDiff_snd).smul contDiff_const)
  have hφm : Set.MapsTo φ (Metric.ball (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0) (δ0 / 2) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) U := by
    intro p hp; rw [hφdef]; exact htube p.1 hp.1 (χ p.2) (hχr p.2)
  have h1le : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hAh : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (A ∘ φ) (Metric.ball (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0) (δ0 / 2) ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
    (hAs.comp hφc.contDiffOn hφm).of_le h1le
  have hbh : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (b ∘ φ) (Metric.ball (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ0 0) (δ0 / 2) ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
    (hbs.comp hφc.contDiffOn hφm).of_le h1le

    intro f f' e w heq hf'

    have e1 : NB B.h (f γ m) j ξ = NB B.h (f' γ m) j ξ := by

      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds]

  have hgen : ∀ (s : Cyl → ℝ) (E β : ℝ) (g : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) β g →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ s (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      (∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), NB B.h s j ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ E) →
      ∃ b0 d0 : ℝ, ∀ b d : ℝ, b0 ≤ b → d0 ≤ d → ∀ i : Fin 3,
        CUB5 B P k (fun γ m η => ((s η : ℝ) : ℂ) * g γ m η i) (E + B.h * β) (wtW5 B G b d) := by
    intro s E β g hg hs hsb
    obtain ⟨-, hgs, -, -, hgb⟩ := hg
    choose Cs hCs using hsb
    choose Cg bg dg hCg using hgb
    obtain ⟨Ss, hSsd⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, S = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cs j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Sg, hSgd⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, S = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cg j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨b0, hb0d⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, S = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |bg j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨d0, hd0d⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, S = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |dg j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hSs : 0 ≤ Ss := by rw [hSsd]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have hSg : 0 ≤ Sg := by rw [hSgd]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have hCs_le : ∀ t, t ≤ k → Cs t ≤ Ss := by
      intro t ht
      have htm : t ∈ Finset.range (k+1) := Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega)
      rw [hSsd]
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => abs_nonneg (Cs i)) htm)
    have hCg_le : ∀ t, t ≤ k → Cg t ≤ Sg := by
      intro t ht
      have htm : t ∈ Finset.range (k+1) := Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega)
      rw [hSgd]
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => abs_nonneg (Cg i)) htm)
    have hbg_le : ∀ t, t ≤ k → bg t ≤ b0 := by
      intro t ht
      have htm : t ∈ Finset.range (k+1) := Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega)
      rw [hb0d]

      intro t ht

    refine ⟨b0, d0, fun b d hb hd i => ?_⟩
    refine ⟨((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * 2 ^ k * Ss * Sg, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hSs) hSg,
      fun γ m ξ hPξ => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hξ, hX1, hX2⟩ := hPD γ m ξ hPξ
    obtain ⟨hq0, hq1, hS1⟩ := hDq ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨hEW, hED0, hED1⟩ := hEdge _ hX1 hX2
    have hPv : 0 ≤ Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by

    have hw0 : 0 ≤ wtW5 B G b d γ ξ := by
      unfold wtW5

    have hfs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((s η : ℝ) : ℂ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := hsm _ _ hs
    have hgi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => g γ m η i) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := contDiffOn_pi.1 (hgs γ m) i
    refine ⟨hw0, ⟨_, hDo, hξ, hfs.mul hgi⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    have hcs : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ s ξ := hs.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hξ)
    have hcg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (g γ m) ξ := (hgs γ m).contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hξ)
    have hqE : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ E := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
    have hqB : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * β) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
    have hSb : ∀ t, t ≤ k → NB B.h (fun η => ((s η : ℝ) : ℂ)) t ξ ≤ Ss * qC B.h ξ ^ E := by
      intro t ht
      exact (hofR ξ s hcs t).trans ((hCs t ξ hξ).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hCs_le t ht) hqE))
    have hWb : ∀ u, u ≤ k → NB B.h (fun η => g γ m η i) u ξ ≤

      intro u hu
      exact (hproj ξ (g γ m) i hcg u).trans ((hCg u γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2).trans
        (hmono _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hqB hS1 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hED0 hED1 hPv (hCg_le u hu)
          ((hbg_le u hu).trans hb) ((hdg_le u hu).trans hd) hSg))
    have hch : ∀ t ∈ Finset.range (j+1), ((j.choose t : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ k := by
      intro t ht
      have h1 : j.choose t ≤ 2 ^ j := by
        rw [← Nat.sum_range_choose j]
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun m => j.choose m) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) ht
      have h2 : 2 ^ j ≤ 2 ^ k := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hj

    have hA0 : 0 ≤ Ss * qC B.h ξ ^ E := mul_nonneg hSs hqE
    have hB0 : 0 ≤ Sg * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * β) * wtW5 B G b d γ ξ := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hSg hqB) hw0
    have hX0 : 0 ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ k * (Ss * qC B.h ξ ^ E) * (Sg * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * β) * wtW5 B G b d γ ξ) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hA0) hB0
    have hterm : ∀ t ∈ Finset.range (j+1), ((j.choose t : ℕ) : ℝ) * NB B.h (fun η => ((s η : ℝ) : ℂ)) t ξ *
        NB B.h (fun η => g γ m η i) (j - t) ξ ≤
        (2:ℝ) ^ k * (Ss * qC B.h ξ ^ E) * (Sg * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * β) * wtW5 B G b d γ ξ) := by
      intro t ht

    have hL := nb_mul_le_open B.h (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) hDo (fun η => ((s η : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (fun η => g γ m η i) hfs hgi ξ hξ j
    show NB B.h (fun η => ((s η : ℝ) : ℂ) * g γ m η i) j ξ ≤ _
    calc NB B.h (fun η => ((s η : ℝ) : ℂ) * g γ m η i) j ξ
        ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), ((j.choose t : ℕ) : ℝ) * NB B.h (fun η => ((s η : ℝ) : ℂ)) t ξ *
            NB B.h (fun η => g γ m η i) (j - t) ξ := hL
      _ ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (j + 1),
            (2:ℝ) ^ k * (Ss * qC B.h ξ ^ E) * (Sg * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * β) * wtW5 B G b d γ ξ) :=

          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : j + 1 ≤ k + 1)) hX0
      _ = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * 2 ^ k * Ss * Sg * qC B.h ξ ^ (E + B.h * β) * wtW5 B G b d γ ξ := by

  have hgerm : ∀ (x : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ) (η v : Cyl), η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → DifferentiableAt ℝ x η →

    intro x η v hη hx
    have he : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun ξ => qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) η :=
      ((hqC.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hη)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).rpow_const

    have hfun : (fun ξ => ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =

    have hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun ξ => ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ)) η := by
      rw [hfun]
      exact (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ).differentiableAt.comp η he
    have hfc : fderiv ℝ (fun ξ => ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ)) η =
        (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ).comp (fderiv ℝ (fun ξ => qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h)) η) := by
      rw [hfun, fderiv_comp η (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ).differentiableAt he,

    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_smul', Pi.smul_apply,

  have he : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
    hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos η hη).ne')
  obtain ⟨heR, heZ, -⟩ := hcalc _ he
  have hY : ∀ η : Cyl, (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) η =
      (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1, ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) := fun η => rfl
  have htn := tn_qpow_normalized_v5 B.h hh0 hh1 hok.1 (-Aex B.h)

          rw [show -Aex B.h - 1/2 = -(1/2 : ℝ) + -Aex B.h by ring, Real.rpow_add hq0]

  have hS2 : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      NB B.h (dZ (fun η : Cyl => qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h))) j ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h - 1/2 + B.h) := by

  obtain ⟨b1, d1, T1⟩ := hgen _ (-Aex B.h) α a ha he hS0
  obtain ⟨b2, d2, T2⟩ := hgen _ (-Aex B.h) (α - 1 / (2 * B.h) - kapS) _ haR he hS0
  obtain ⟨b3, d3, T3⟩ := hgen _ (-Aex B.h - 1/2) α a ha heR hS1
  obtain ⟨b4, d4, T4⟩ := hgen _ (-Aex B.h) (α - 1 / (2 * B.h)) _ haZ he hS0
  obtain ⟨b5, d5, T5⟩ := hgen _ (-Aex B.h - 1/2 + B.h) α a ha heZ hS2
  have h5 : ∀ x1 x2 x3 x4 x5 : ℝ, x1 ≤ |x1| + |x2| + |x3| + |x4| + |x5| ∧
      x2 ≤ |x1| + |x2| + |x3| + |x4| + |x5| ∧ x3 ≤ |x1| + |x2| + |x3| + |x4| + |x5| ∧
      x4 ≤ |x1| + |x2| + |x3| + |x4| + |x5| ∧ x5 ≤ |x1| + |x2| + |x3| + |x4| + |x5| := by

    have a4 := le_abs_self x4
    have a5 := le_abs_self x5

    have n2 := abs_nonneg x2
    have n3 := abs_nonneg x3

    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> linarith
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2, hb3, hb4, hb5⟩ := h5 b1 b2 b3 b4 b5
  obtain ⟨hd1, hd2, hd3, hd4, hd5⟩ := h5 d1 d2 d3 d4 d5
  refine ⟨|b1| + |b2| + |b3| + |b4| + |b5|, |d1| + |d2| + |d3| + |d4| + |d5|, fun i => ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: domc_open_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ) ∧ ContinuousOn (XC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dT f) (DomC B.h qs)) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → dR B.h f ξ = 0 ∧ dZ f ξ = 0 ∧ dT f ξ = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: cub5_algebra
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (P : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → Prop) (k : ℕ),
    (∀ γ m ξ, P γ m ξ → 0 < qC B.h ξ ∧ qC B.h ξ ≤ 1) →
    (∀ (f g : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) (e1 e2 : ℝ) (w1 w2 : Lab → Cyl → ℝ), CUB5 B P k f e1 w1 → CUB5 B P k g e2 w2 →
      CUB5 B P k (cxMul5 f g) (e1 + e2) (fun γ ξ => w1 γ ξ * w2 γ ξ)) ∧
    (∀ (f g : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) (e : ℝ) (w : Lab → Cyl → ℝ), CUB5 B P k f e w → CUB5 B P k g e w →
      CUB5 B P k (cxAdd5 f g) e w ∧ CUB5 B P k (cxSub5 f g) e w) ∧
    (∀ (c : ℂ) (f : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) (e : ℝ) (w : Lab → Cyl → ℝ), CUB5 B P k f e w →
      CUB5 B P k (cxSmul5 c f) e w) ∧
    (∀ (f : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) (e e' : ℝ) (w w' : Lab → Cyl → ℝ), CUB5 B P k f e w → e' ≤ e →
      (∀ γ m ξ, P γ m ξ → w γ ξ ≤ w' γ ξ) → CUB5 B P k f e' w') ∧
    (∀ (h : ℝ) (F : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (ξ : Cyl) (j : ℕ), (∀ i, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => F η i) ξ) →

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B hok
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  have hSN : SimNorm B.h := simscale_normalized_v4 B.h hh0 hh1 hok.1
  refine ⟨7, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 Mn hMn k
  have hk : kapS = 1 / 100000 := rfl
  have hqs0 : 0 < qsOf l0 := by unfold qsOf Qb; positivity
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    unfold qsOf Qb
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  obtain ⟨hUo, hqC, hqpos, -, hcalc, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  
  have hdom : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
      0 < qC B.h ξ ∧ qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 ∧ 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ ∧ 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) ∧
      0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ∧ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ≤ 1 := by
    intro ξ hξ hX1 hX2
    have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
    refine ⟨hqpos ξ hξ, by linarith [hξ'.2.2], ?_, ?_, ?_, min_le_left _ _⟩
    · unfold SC
      exact one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))])
    · unfold edgeWeight
      split_ifs
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      · exact le_rfl
    · have hX : 0 < XC B.h ξ := lt_trans hXa hX1
      unfold edgeDist
      exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX1))
        (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr hX2)))
  
  have unnorm : ∀ (e α : ℝ) (g : Cyl → ℝ), InM B (qsOf l0) α (nrm B e g) →
      ∃ C b d : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
        ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → NB B.h g j ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (-e + B.h * α) *
          (SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
            edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d)) := by
    intro e α g hF
    have hFs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (nrm B e g) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := hF.1
    have hps : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-e)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos η hη).ne')
    choose Cf bf df hCf using hF.2.2.2
    choose Kq hKq using nb_qpow_v4 B (qsOf l0) (-e) hok hSN hqs0 hqs1
    obtain ⟨Cs, hCs⟩ : ∃ Cs : ℝ, Cs = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cf j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨bs, hbs⟩ : ∃ bs : ℝ, bs = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |bf j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨ds, hds⟩ : ∃ ds : ℝ, ds = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |df j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Ks, hKs⟩ : ∃ Ks : ℝ, Ks = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Kq j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hCs0 : 0 ≤ Cs := by rw [hCs]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have hKs0 : 0 ≤ Ks := by rw [hKs]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have mem : ∀ j, j ≤ k → j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) :=
      fun j hj => Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj)
    have hCj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → Cf j ≤ Cs := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hCs]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cf j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    have hbj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → bf j ≤ bs := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hbs]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |bf j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    have hdj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → df j ≤ ds := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hds]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |df j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    have hKj : ∀ j, j ≤ k → Kq j ≤ Ks := fun j hj => (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      rw [hKs]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Kq j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (mem j hj))
    refine ⟨2 ^ k * Ks * Cs, bs, ds, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hKs0) hCs0,
      fun ξ hξ hX1 hX2 j hj => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hq, -, hS1, hE, hδ0, hδ1⟩ := hdom ξ hξ hX1 hX2
    have hqa : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    have hqA : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (-e) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq.le _
    obtain ⟨wv, hwv⟩ : ∃ wv : ℝ, wv = SC B.h ξ ^ bs * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
        edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have p3 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bs := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    have hwv0 : 0 ≤ wv := by
      rw [hwv]; exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p3 hE) (Real.rpow_nonneg hδ0.le _)
    have hFb : ∀ m, m ≤ k → NB B.h (nrm B e g) m ξ ≤ Cs * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * wv) := by
      intro m hm
      have h1 := hCf m ξ hξ hX1 hX2
      have hbm : SC B.h ξ ^ (bf m) ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ bs := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 (hbj m hm)
      have hdm : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df m) ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-ds) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hδ0 hδ1 (neg_le_neg (hdj m hm))
      have p1 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ (bf m) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have p2 : 0 ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df m) := Real.rpow_nonneg hδ0.le _
      calc NB B.h (nrm B e g) m ξ
          ≤ Cf m * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ (bf m) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
              edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df m) := h1
        _ = Cf m * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * (SC B.h ξ ^ (bf m) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
              edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df m))) := by ring
        _ ≤ Cs * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * (SC B.h ξ ^ (bf m) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
              edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df m))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hCj m hm) (mul_nonneg hqa (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg p1 hE) p2))
        _ ≤ Cs * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * wv) := by
            rw [hwv]
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hqa) hCs0
            exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbm hE) hdm p2 (mul_nonneg p3 hE)
    have hev : g =ᶠ[nhds ξ] (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-e) * nrm B e g η) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hξ) (fun η hη => by
        simp only [nrm]
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add (hqpos η hη), neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero, one_mul])
    have hNBe : NB B.h g j ξ = NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-e) * nrm B e g η) j ξ := by
      unfold NB; rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds]
    have hl := nb_mul_le_v4 B.h (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-e))
      (nrm B e g) hUo hps hFs ξ hξ j
    have hchoose : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) = 2 ^ j := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose j
    have h2 : (2:ℝ) ^ j ≤ 2 ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hj
    obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ : ∃ X : ℝ, X = Ks * qC B.h ξ ^ (-e) * (Cs * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * wv)) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hX0 : 0 ≤ X := by
      rw [hX]; exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hKs0 hqA) (mul_nonneg hCs0 (mul_nonneg hqa hwv0))
    have hexp : qC B.h ξ ^ (-e) * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) = qC B.h ξ ^ (-e + B.h * α) :=
      (Real.rpow_add hq _ _).symm
    rw [hNBe]
    calc NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-e) * nrm B e g η) j ξ
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-e)) i ξ *
            NB B.h (nrm B e g) (j - i) ξ := hl
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) * X := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          have hij : i ≤ j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          have b1 : NB B.h (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-e)) i ξ ≤ Ks * qC B.h ξ ^ (-e) :=
            (hKq i ξ hξ).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hKj i (by omega)) hqA)
          have b2 := hFb (j - i) (by omega)
          refine le_trans (mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) b2 (norm_nonneg _)
            (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hKs0 hqA))) (le_of_eq ?_)
          rw [hX]; ring
      _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ)) * X := by rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = 2 ^ j * X := by rw [hchoose]
      _ ≤ 2 ^ k * X := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 hX0
      _ = _ := by rw [hX, hwv, ← hexp]; ring
  
  have hf : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ => Mn ξ a) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := fun a =>
    (g_regular_of_nrm_InM_v5 B (qsOf l0) (Aex B.h) 0.9 _ hok (hMn a)).1
  have hfR : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h (fun ξ => Mn ξ a)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := fun a =>
    (hcalc _ (hf a)).1
  have hfZ : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ (fun ξ => Mn ξ a)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := fun a =>
    (hcalc _ (hf a)).2.1
  have hR := fun a : Fin 3 => wmo_rc_dR_v5 B hok hSN l0 hl0 (fun ξ => Mn ξ a) (Aex B.h) 0.9 (hMn a)
  have hZ := fun a : Fin 3 => wmo_rc_dZ_v5 B hok hSN l0 hl0 (fun ξ => Mn ξ a) (Aex B.h) 0.9 (hMn a)
  choose CM bM dM hCM0 hCM using fun a : Fin 3 => unnorm _ _ _ (hMn a)
  choose CR bR dRr hCR0 hCR using fun a : Fin 3 => unnorm _ _ _ (hR a)
  choose CZ bZ dZz hCZ0 hCZ using fun a : Fin 3 => unnorm _ _ _ (hZ a)
  
  obtain ⟨b, hbdef⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ, b = ∑ a : Fin 3, (|bM a| + |bR a| + |bZ a|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨d, hddef⟩ : ∃ d : ℝ, d = ∑ a : Fin 3, (|dM a| + |dRr a| + |dZz a|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hb3 : ∀ a : Fin 3, |bM a| + |bR a| + |bZ a| ≤ b := fun a => by
    rw [hbdef]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun a => |bM a| + |bR a| + |bZ a|) (fun i _ => by positivity)
      (Finset.mem_univ a)
  have hd3 : ∀ a : Fin 3, |dM a| + |dRr a| + |dZz a| ≤ d := fun a => by
    rw [hddef]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun a => |dM a| + |dRr a| + |dZz a|) (fun i _ => by positivity)
      (Finset.mem_univ a)
  have hbM : ∀ a, bM a ≤ b := fun a => by
    linarith [hb3 a, le_abs_self (bM a), abs_nonneg (bR a), abs_nonneg (bZ a)]
  have hbR : ∀ a, bR a ≤ b := fun a => by
    linarith [hb3 a, le_abs_self (bR a), abs_nonneg (bM a), abs_nonneg (bZ a)]
  have hbZ : ∀ a, bZ a ≤ b := fun a => by
    linarith [hb3 a, le_abs_self (bZ a), abs_nonneg (bM a), abs_nonneg (bR a)]
  have hdM : ∀ a, dM a ≤ d := fun a => by
    linarith [hd3 a, le_abs_self (dM a), abs_nonneg (dRr a), abs_nonneg (dZz a)]
  have hdR : ∀ a, dRr a ≤ d := fun a => by
    linarith [hd3 a, le_abs_self (dRr a), abs_nonneg (dM a), abs_nonneg (dZz a)]
  have hdZ : ∀ a, dZz a ≤ d := fun a => by
    linarith [hd3 a, le_abs_self (dZz a), abs_nonneg (dM a), abs_nonneg (dRr a)]
  have key : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
      ∀ (N C x bi di : ℝ), 0 ≤ C → bi ≤ b → di ≤ d →
      N ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ x *
        (SC B.h ξ ^ bi * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-di)) →
      N ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ x *
        (SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d)) := by
    intro ξ hξ hX1 hX2 N C x bi di hC hbi hdi H
    refine H.trans ?_
    obtain ⟨hq0, -, hS1, hEW, hED0, hED1⟩ := hdom ξ hξ hX1 hX2
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (mul_nonneg hC (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _))
    have hb2 : SC B.h ξ ^ bi ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ b := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 hbi
    have hd2 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-di) ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hED0 hED1 (neg_le_neg hdi)
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb2 hEW) hd2 (Real.rpow_nonneg hED0.le _)
      (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _) hEW)
  
  have hofR : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (j : ℕ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ →
      NB B.h (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ ≤ NB B.h f j ξ := by
    intro f ξ j hf
    have hc : (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) = ⇑Complex.ofRealCLM ∘ f := by
      funext η; simp only [Function.comp_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply]
    have hit : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ =
        Complex.ofRealCLM.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ) := by
      rw [hc]; exact ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left _ hf (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    unfold NB
    rw [hit]
    have e : (Complex.ofRealCLM.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) = Complex.ofRealCLM.compContinuousMultilinearMap
          ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)) := by
      ext m; rfl
    rw [e]
    calc _ ≤ ‖Complex.ofRealCLM‖ * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [Complex.ofRealCLM_norm, one_mul]
  have hcx : ∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := fun f hf =>
    (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hf).congr (fun η _ => by simp)
  
  have hcomp : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ i : Fin 3,
      dR B.h (pchMnC5 Mn) η i = ((dR B.h (fun ζ => Mn ζ i) η : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
      dZ (pchMnC5 Mn) η i = ((dZ (fun ζ => Mn ζ i) η : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro η hη i
    have hd : ∀ a : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun ζ => ((Mn ζ a : ℝ) : ℂ)) η := fun a =>
      ((hcx _ (hf a)).contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hη)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (pchMnC5 Mn) η =
        ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun a => fderiv ℝ (fun ζ => ((Mn ζ a : ℝ) : ℂ)) η) :=
      fderiv_pi (φ := fun a ζ => ((Mn ζ a : ℝ) : ℂ)) hd
    have hfi : fderiv ℝ (fun ζ => ((Mn ζ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) η =
        Complex.ofRealCLM.comp (fderiv ℝ (fun ζ => Mn ζ i) η) := by
      have hdi : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun ζ => Mn ζ i) η :=
        ((hf i).contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hη)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have e : (fun ζ => ((Mn ζ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) = ⇑Complex.ofRealCLM ∘ (fun ζ => Mn ζ i) := by
        funext ζ; simp only [Function.comp_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply]
      rw [e]
      exact (Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp η hdi.hasFDerivAt).fderiv
    unfold dR dZ
    constructor <;> simp only [hfd, ContinuousLinearMap.pi_apply, hfi, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      Complex.ofRealCLM_apply]
  have wnn : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
      0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) := by
    intro ξ hξ hX1 hX2
    obtain ⟨-, -, hS1, hEW, hED0, -⟩ := hdom ξ hξ hX1 hX2
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _) hEW) (Real.rpow_nonneg hED0.le _)
  
  refine ⟨b, d, fun i => ⟨⟨CM i, hCM0 i, fun γ m ξ hP => ?_⟩, ⟨CR i, hCR0 i, fun γ m ξ hP => ?_⟩,
    ⟨CZ i, hCZ0 i, fun γ m ξ hP => ?_⟩⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨hξ, hX1, hX2⟩ := hP
    refine ⟨wnn ξ hξ hX1 hX2, ⟨_, hUo, hξ, hcx _ (hf i)⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    show NB B.h (fun η => ((Mn η i : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ ≤ CM i * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h + B.h * 0.9) *
      (SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d))
    exact key ξ hξ hX1 hX2 _ _ _ _ _ (hCM0 i) (hbM i) (hdM i)
      ((hofR _ ξ j ((hf i).contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hξ))).trans (hCM i ξ hξ hX1 hX2 j hj))
  · obtain ⟨hξ, hX1, hX2⟩ := hP
    have hrs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => dR B.h (pchMnC5 Mn) η i) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      (hcx _ (hfR i)).congr (fun η hη => (hcomp η hη i).1)
    refine ⟨wnn ξ hξ hX1 hX2, ⟨_, hUo, hξ, hrs⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    have hev : (fun η => dR B.h (pchMnC5 Mn) η i) =ᶠ[nhds ξ]
        (fun η => ((dR B.h (fun ζ => Mn ζ i) η : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hξ) (fun η hη => (hcomp η hη i).1)
    have hNBe : NB B.h (fun η => dR B.h (pchMnC5 Mn) η i) j ξ =
        NB B.h (fun η => ((dR B.h (fun ζ => Mn ζ i) η : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ := by
      unfold NB; rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds]
    have h1 := hCR i ξ hξ hX1 hX2 j hj
    have hex : -(Aex B.h + 1/2) + B.h * (0.9 - kapS) = -Aex B.h + B.h * 0.9 - 1/2 - B.h * kapS := by ring
    rw [hex] at h1
    show NB B.h (fun η => dR B.h (pchMnC5 Mn) η i) j ξ ≤
      CR i * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h + B.h * 0.9 - 1/2 - B.h * kapS) *
      (SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d))
    rw [hNBe]
    exact key ξ hξ hX1 hX2 _ _ _ _ _ (hCR0 i) (hbR i) (hdR i)
      ((hofR _ ξ j ((hfR i).contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hξ))).trans h1)
  · obtain ⟨hξ, hX1, hX2⟩ := hP
    obtain ⟨hq0, hq1, hS1, hEW, hED0, -⟩ := hdom ξ hξ hX1 hX2
    have hzs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => dZ (pchMnC5 Mn) η i) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      (hcx _ (hfZ i)).congr (fun η hη => (hcomp η hη i).2)
    refine ⟨wnn ξ hξ hX1 hX2, ⟨_, hUo, hξ, hzs⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    have hev : (fun η => dZ (pchMnC5 Mn) η i) =ᶠ[nhds ξ]
        (fun η => ((dZ (fun ζ => Mn ζ i) η : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hξ) (fun η hη => (hcomp η hη i).2)
    have hNBe : NB B.h (fun η => dZ (pchMnC5 Mn) η i) j ξ =
        NB B.h (fun η => ((dZ (fun ζ => Mn ζ i) η : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ := by
      unfold NB; rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds]
    have h1 := hCZ i ξ hξ hX1 hX2 j hj
    have hyz : qC B.h ξ ^ (-(Aex B.h + 1/2) + B.h * (0.9 + 1 - kapS)) ≤
        qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h + B.h * 0.9 - 1/2) := by
      apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1
      have e1 : -(Aex B.h + 1/2) + B.h * (0.9 + 1 - kapS) - (-Aex B.h + B.h * 0.9 - 1/2) =
          B.h * (1 - kapS) := by ring
      have e2 : 0 ≤ B.h * (1 - kapS) := mul_nonneg hh0.le (by rw [hk]; norm_num)
      linarith
    have hw0 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ (bZ i) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
        edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-(dZz i)) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _) hEW) (Real.rpow_nonneg hED0.le _)
    have h2 : NB B.h (dZ (fun ζ => Mn ζ i)) j ξ ≤ CZ i * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h + B.h * 0.9 - 1/2) *
        (SC B.h ξ ^ (bZ i) * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) *
          edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-(dZz i))) :=
      h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyz (hCZ0 i)) hw0)
    show NB B.h (fun η => dZ (pchMnC5 Mn) η i) j ξ ≤
      CZ i * qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h + B.h * 0.9 - 1/2) *
      (SC B.h ξ ^ b * edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d))
    rw [hNBe]
    exact key ξ hξ hX1 hX2 _ _ _ _ _ (hCZ0 i) (hbZ i) (hdZ i)
      ((hofR _ ξ j ((hfZ i).contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hξ))).trans h2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨ls, hs⟩ := pulse_support_good_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨ls + n0, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 Mn Q β hMn hQ γ N
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 < B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0
  obtain ⟨hDo, hqC, hqpos, -, -, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  have hsm : ∀ (U : Set Cyl) (f : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) U := by
    intro U f hf
    have hcomp : (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) = ⇑(Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ) ∘ f := by
      funext η; simp [Complex.ofRealCLM_apply]
    rw [hcomp]
    exact (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hf
  
  have hdir : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ),
      (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv)) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    refine contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk ?_))
    exact (contDiffOn_const.mul (contDiffOn_fst.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => hη.1.ne'))).smul
      contDiffOn_const
  have hvec : ∀ f : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => dR B.h f η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => dZ f η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro f hf
    have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hDo).1 hf).2
    exact ⟨hfd.clm_apply hdir, hfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const⟩
  
  have htr : ∀ (V : Set Cyl) (n : ℤ) (al bt : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ),
      V ⊆ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((nPhi5 B G γ η i : ℝ) : ℂ)) V) →
      (∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => al η j) V) →
      (∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => bt η j) V) →
      (∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => dR B.h bt η j) V) →
      (∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => dZ bt η j) V) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => pchTr5 B G γ n (al η) bt η) V := by
    intro V n al bt hV hn ha hb hr hz
    have hg : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η =>
        (((((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) • nPhi5 B G γ η) j : ℝ) : ℂ)) V := by
      intro j
      refine ((contDiffOn_const (c := (((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ))).mul
        (hn j)).congr (fun η _ => ?_)
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Complex.ofReal_mul]
    have hρ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) V :=
      hsm V (fun η : Cyl => η.1) contDiffOn_fst
    have hρ0 : ∀ η ∈ V, ((η.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := fun η hη =>
      Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hV hη).1.ne'
    have hρi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (((η.1 : ℝ) : ℂ))⁻¹) V := hρ.inv hρ0
    have hph := (contDiffOn_const (c := Complex.I * (n : ℂ))).mul
      ((((ha 0).mul (hg 0)).add ((ha 1).mul (hg 1))).add ((ha 2).mul (hg 2)))
    have h0 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => pchTr5 B G γ n (al η) bt η 0) V := by
      refine (((((ha 0).mul (hr 0)).add ((ha 2).mul (hz 0))).add (hph.mul (hb 0))).sub
        (((ha 1).mul (hb 1)).mul hρi)).congr (fun η _ => ?_)
      simp only [pchTr5, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons, div_eq_mul_inv, Pi.inv_apply]
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => pchTr5 B G γ n (al η) bt η 1) V := by
      refine (((((ha 0).mul (hr 1)).add ((ha 2).mul (hz 1))).add (hph.mul (hb 1))).add
        (((ha 1).mul (hb 0)).mul hρi)).congr (fun η _ => ?_)
      simp only [pchTr5, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons, div_eq_mul_inv, Pi.inv_apply]
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => pchTr5 B G γ n (al η) bt η 2) V := by
      refine ((((ha 0).mul (hr 2)).add ((ha 2).mul (hz 2))).add (hph.mul (hb 2))).congr
        (fun η _ => ?_)
      simp only [pchTr5, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.head_cons]
    refine contDiffOn_pi.mpr (fun i => ?_)
    fin_cases i
    · exact h0
    · exact h1
    · exact h2
  
  have hoff : ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ ∉ tsupport (Q γ N) →
      (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (pchTr5 B G γ N (pchMnC5 Mn η)
        (pchAmp5 B Q γ N) η + pchTr5 B G γ 0 (pchAmp5 B Q γ N η) (pchMnC5 Mn) η)) =ᶠ[nhds ξ]
        (fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ)) := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have ha : Q γ N =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq).mp hξ
    have hA : pchAmp5 B Q γ N =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
      filter_upwards [ha] with y hy
      simp [pchAmp5, hy]
    filter_upwards [hA.eventuallyEq_nhds] with y hy
    have hy0 : pchAmp5 B Q γ N y = 0 := hy.eq_of_nhds
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (pchAmp5 B Q γ N) y = 0 := by
      rw [hy.fderiv_eq]
      exact fderiv_const_apply (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ)

  intro ξ hξ
  apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
  by_cases hts : ξ ∈ tsupport (Q γ N)
  · obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hxi, het⟩ := hs l0 (by omega) β Q hQ γ N ξ hξ hts
    have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
    have hξB : ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB := ⟨hξ'.1, hξ'.2.1, lt_trans hξ'.2.2 hqsB⟩
    obtain ⟨U, hUo, hξU, -, hUs, -, -⟩ := good_coeff_smooth_v5 B G γ ξ hok hξB hxi het
    have hVo : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) := hDo.inter hUo
    have hVD : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U ⊆ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := Set.inter_subset_left
    have hn : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((nPhi5 B G γ η i : ℝ) : ℂ))
        (DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ U) := fun i =>
      hsm _ (fun η => nPhi5 B G γ η i) ((hUs i).mono Set.inter_subset_right)
    have hMc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pchMnC5 Mn) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      contDiffOn_pi.mpr (fun j => hsm _ (fun η => Mn η j) (hMn j))
    have hW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pchAmp5 B Q γ N) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      (hsm _ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h))
        (hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos η hη).ne'))).smul (hQ.2.1 γ N)
    obtain ⟨hrM, hzM⟩ := hvec _ hMc
    obtain ⟨hrW, hzW⟩ := hvec _ hW

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 α f hf γ m ξ hξ hm hAct hxi hv0 hvL
  
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]; exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hl0) hn.le
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  have hcib : 0 < cib B.h γ.1 :=
    mul_pos (zpow_pos (by unfold Tgc; positivity) _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by unfold Qb; positivity) _)
  have hL0 : 0 < Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 := by
    unfold Lsb; exact div_pos (by linarith [hG.1.1]) hcib
  
  obtain ⟨W, hWo, hξW, hvW, hxiW, hpathW⟩ := pulse_path_geom_v5 B G γ ξ hG.1.1 hG.1.2.1 hxi hv0 hvL
  set L := Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 with hLd
  obtain ⟨U, hUdef⟩ : ∃ U : Set Cyl, U = DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ W := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hUo : IsOpen U := by rw [hUdef]; exact hDopen.inter hWo
  have hUD : U ⊆ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := by rw [hUdef]; exact Set.inter_subset_left
  have hUW : U ⊆ W := by rw [hUdef]; exact Set.inter_subset_right
  have hξU : ξ ∈ U := by rw [hUdef]; exact ⟨hξ, hξW⟩
  have hJJ0 : Set.Ioo (-(L/8)) (9 * L / 8) ⊆ Set.Ioo (-(L/2)) (3 * L / 2) :=
    fun t ht => ⟨by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩
  
  have hpth1 : ∀ (p : Cyl) (v : ℝ), (pulsePth5 B G γ p v).1 = p.1 ∧ (pulsePth5 B G γ p v).2.1 = p.2.1 ∧
      (pulsePth5 B G γ p v).2.2.1 = p.2.2.1 := by
    intro p v
    simp [pulsePth5, dVdir]
  have hpthD : ∀ p ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ∀ v : ℝ, pulsePth5 B G γ p v ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := by
    intro p hp v
    obtain ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩ := hpth1 p v
    have hp' : 0 < p.1 ∧ p.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h p.2.1 (1 - p.2.2.1) < qsOf l0 := hp
    show 0 < (pulsePth5 B G γ p v).1 ∧ (pulsePth5 B G γ p v).2.2.1 < 1 ∧
      simScale B.h (pulsePth5 B G γ p v).2.1 (1 - (pulsePth5 B G γ p v).2.2.1) < qsOf l0
    rw [e1, e2, e3]
    exact hp'
  
  have hI5 : ∀ (η' : Cyl) (x : Fin 3 → ℂ), pulseRhs5 B G f γ m η' x =
      (pulseMatC (APhi5 B G γ η') - ((m : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((dDamp5 B G γ η' : ℝ) : ℂ)) •
        (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ)).mulVec x - projT5 B G γ η' (srcHat B f γ m η') := by
    intro η' x
    unfold pulseRhs5
    rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  
  have hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : Cyl × ℝ => pulsePth5 B G γ w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : Cyl × ℝ => vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) w.1.2.2.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
      hvW.comp contDiffOn_fst (fun w hw => hUW hw.1)
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : Cyl × ℝ =>
      w.1 + (w.2 - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) w.1.2.2.2) • dVdir B.h γ.1) (U ×ˢ Set.univ)
    exact contDiffOn_fst.add ((contDiffOn_snd.sub h1).smul contDiffOn_const)
  have hUJo : IsOpen (U ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-(L/2)) (3 * L / 2)) := hUo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hΦc : ContinuousOn (fun w : Cyl × ℝ => pulsePth5 B G γ w.1 w.2)
      (U ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-(L/2)) (3 * L / 2)) :=
    (hΦ.mono (Set.prod_mono subset_rfl (Set.subset_univ _))).continuousOn
  
  have hloc : ∀ x ∈ U ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-(L/2)) (3 * L / 2), ∃ u : Set (Cyl × ℝ), IsOpen u ∧ x ∈ u ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun pv : Cyl × ℝ => fun i j : Fin 3 => (pulseMatC (APhi5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ pv.1 pv.2)) - ((m : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((dDamp5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ pv.1 pv.2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ)) i j)
        ((U ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-(L/2)) (3 * L / 2)) ∩ u) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun pv : Cyl × ℝ => projT5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ pv.1 pv.2) (srcHat B f γ m (pulsePth5 B G γ pv.1 pv.2)))
        ((U ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-(L/2)) (3 * L / 2)) ∩ u) := by
    intro x hx
    have hb := hpathW x.1 (hUW hx.1) x.2 hx.2.1 hx.2.2
    obtain ⟨O, hO, hηO, -, hM, hS⟩ := pulse_coef_point_smooth_v5 B G f γ m (qsOf l0)
      (pulsePth5 B G γ x.1 x.2) hok hqsB (hf.2.1 γ m) (hpthD x.1 (hUD hx.1) x.2) hb.1 hb.2.1
    obtain ⟨u, hudef⟩ : ∃ u : Set (Cyl × ℝ), u = (U ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-(L/2)) (3 * L / 2)) ∩
        (fun w : Cyl × ℝ => pulsePth5 B G γ w.1 w.2) ⁻¹' O := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hu : IsOpen u := by rw [hudef]; exact hΦc.isOpen_inter_preimage hUJo hO
    have hxu : x ∈ u := by rw [hudef]; exact ⟨hx, hηO⟩
    have hsub : ((U ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-(L/2)) (3 * L / 2)) ∩ u) ⊆ U ×ˢ Set.univ :=
      fun w hw => ⟨hw.1.1, Set.mem_univ _⟩
    have hmap : Set.MapsTo (fun w : Cyl × ℝ => pulsePth5 B G γ w.1 w.2)
        ((U ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-(L/2)) (3 * L / 2)) ∩ u) O := by
      intro w hw; rw [hudef] at hw; exact hw.2.2
    have hM' := hM.comp (hΦ.mono hsub) hmap
    have hS' := hS.comp (hΦ.mono hsub) hmap
    exact ⟨u, hu, hxu, hM', hS'⟩
  have hMat0 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun pv : Cyl × ℝ => fun i j : Fin 3 => (pulseMatC (APhi5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ pv.1 pv.2)) - ((m : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((dDamp5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ pv.1 pv.2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ)) i j)
      (U ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-(L/2)) (3 * L / 2)) :=
    contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn fun x hx => by
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hxu, h1, -⟩ := hloc x hx
      exact ⟨u, hu, hxu, h1⟩
  have hSrc0 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun pv : Cyl × ℝ => projT5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ pv.1 pv.2) (srcHat B f γ m (pulsePth5 B G γ pv.1 pv.2)))
      (U ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-(L/2)) (3 * L / 2)) :=
    contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn fun x hx => by
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hxu, -, h2⟩ := hloc x hx
      exact ⟨u, hu, hxu, h2⟩
  
  obtain ⟨χ, hχs, hχr, hχid⟩ := real_smooth_clamp_v5 (-(L/8)) (9 * L / 8) (L/4) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hΨ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : Cyl × ℝ => (w.1, χ w.2)) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
    contDiffOn_fst.prodMk (hχs.comp_contDiffOn contDiffOn_snd)
  have hΨm : Set.MapsTo (fun w : Cyl × ℝ => (w.1, χ w.2)) (U ×ˢ Set.univ)
      (U ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-(L/2)) (3 * L / 2)) := by
    intro w hw
    have h := hχr w.2
    exact ⟨hw.1, show -(L/2) < χ w.2 by linarith [h.1], show χ w.2 < 3 * L / 2 by linarith [h.2]⟩
  
  have hMatC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : Cyl × ℝ => fun i j : Fin 3 => (pulseMatC (APhi5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ w.1 (χ w.2))) - ((m : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((dDamp5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ w.1 (χ w.2)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ)) i j)
      (U ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
    have h := ContDiffOn.comp (f := fun w : Cyl × ℝ => (w.1, χ w.2)) hMat0 hΨ hΨm

  obtain ⟨A, hA, hAeq⟩ := cmat_clm_smooth_v5 (Cyl × ℝ) (U ×ˢ Set.univ)
    (fun w : Cyl × ℝ => pulseMatC (APhi5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ w.1 (χ w.2))) - ((m : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((dDamp5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ w.1 (χ w.2)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ)) hMatC
  obtain ⟨b, hbdef⟩ : ∃ b : Cyl × ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℂ), b = fun w => -(projT5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ w.1 (χ w.2))
      (srcHat B f γ m (pulsePth5 B G γ w.1 (χ w.2)))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b (U ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
    have h := (ContDiffOn.comp (f := fun w : Cyl × ℝ => (w.1, χ w.2)) hSrc0 hΨ hΨm).neg
    rw [hbdef]
    exact h
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hz0⟩ := linear_ode_param_smooth_gen5 Cyl (Fin 3 → ℂ) U A b hUo hA hb
  have hAt : ∀ (p : Cyl) (t : ℝ), -(L/8) ≤ t → t ≤ 9 * L / 8 → ∀ x : Fin 3 → ℂ, A (p, t) x =
      (pulseMatC (APhi5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ p t)) - ((m : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((dDamp5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ p t) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ)).mulVec x := by
    intro p t h1 h2 x
    have e := hAeq (p, t) x
    have hc : χ (p, t).2 = t := hχid t h1 h2
    rw [e]
    simp only [hc]
  have hbt : ∀ (p : Cyl) (t : ℝ), -(L/8) ≤ t → t ≤ 9 * L / 8 →
      b (p, t) = -(projT5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ p t) (srcHat B f γ m (pulsePth5 B G γ p t))) := by
    intro p t h1 h2
    have hc : χ (p, t).2 = t := hχid t h1 h2
    rw [hbdef]
    simp only [hc]
  
  have hIccJ : Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L ⊆ Set.Ioo (-(L/8)) (9 * L / 8) := by
    intro t ht
    have ht' : 0 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ L := ht
    show -(L/8) < t ∧ t < 9 * L / 8
    constructor <;> linarith [ht'.1, ht'.2]
  refine ⟨U, Set.Ioo (-(L/8)) (9 * L / 8), fun w => z w.1 w.2, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨hUo, isOpen_Ioo, hξU, hUD, hIccJ, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro p hp v hv
    exact ⟨hpthD p (hUD hp) v, hpathW p (hUW hp) v (by linarith [hv.1]) (by linarith [hv.2])⟩
  · exact hz.mono (Set.prod_mono subset_rfl (Set.subset_univ _))
  · exact hMat0.mono (Set.prod_mono subset_rfl hJJ0)
  · exact hSrc0.mono (Set.prod_mono subset_rfl hJJ0)
  · intro p hp
    exact (hz0 p hp).1
  · intro p hp v hv
    have h1 : -(L/8) ≤ v := le_of_lt hv.1
    have h2 : v ≤ 9 * L / 8 := le_of_lt hv.2
    have hd := (hz0 p hp).2 v
    rw [hAt p v h1 h2, hbt p v h1 h2, ← sub_eq_add_neg] at hd
    exact hd
  · 
    intro η hη hvη
    have hvη' := abs_lt.mp hvη
    have hv0' : 0 < vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 := by linarith [hvη'.1]
    have hvL' : vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 < L := by linarith [hvη'.2]
    have hgood : pulseGood5 B G γ m η := by
      refine ⟨hm, hAct, hxiW η (hUW hη), hv0'.le, hvL'.le, fun w _ => ?_⟩
      exact (nphi5_nsq_pos_v5 B G γ _ (lt_of_lt_of_eq (hUD hη).1 (hpth1 η w).1.symm)).ne'
    have hTw : pulseTw5 B G f γ m η =
        pulseZsol5 B G f γ m (pulsePth5 B G γ η 0) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2) := if_pos hgood
    have hI1 : ∀ w : ℝ, pulsePth5 B G γ η 0 + w • dVdir B.h γ.1 = pulsePth5 B G γ η w := by
      intro w
      unfold pulsePth5
      rw [add_assoc, ← add_smul, zero_sub, neg_add_eq_sub]
    have hRt : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, ∀ x : Fin 3 → ℂ,
        pulseRhs5 B G f γ m (pulsePth5 B G γ η 0 + t • dVdir B.h γ.1) x =
          A (η, t) x - projT5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ η t) (srcHat B f γ m (pulsePth5 B G γ η t)) := by
      intro t ht x
      rw [hI1 t, hI5, hAt η t (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.2])]
    have hAc : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => A (η, t)) (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L) :=
      hA.continuousOn.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn
        (fun t _ => ⟨hη, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
