informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (f : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (qs : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl), B.ok → IsOpen U → U ⊆ DomC B.h qs → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f γ m) (DomC B.h qs) → (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ η i) U) → (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => nPhiP5 B G γ η i) U) → (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Kmat B G γ η i j) U) → ∃ (A : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (b : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b U ∧ ∀ η ∈ U, ∀ Z : Fin 3 → ℂ, A η Z + b η = pulseRhs5 B G f γ m η Z

signature.name: pulse_rhs_family_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (f : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (qs : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl), B.ok → IsOpen U → U ⊆ DomC B.h qs → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f γ m) (DomC B.h qs) → (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ η i) U) → (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => nPhiP5 B G γ η i) U) → (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Kmat B G γ η i j) U) → ∃ (A : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (b : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b U ∧ ∀ η ∈ U, ∀ Z : Fin 3 → ℂ, A η Z + b η = pulseRhs5 B G f γ m η Z

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G f γ m qs U hok hUo hUD hf hn hnP hK
  have hQbpos : ∀ l : ℕ, 0 < Qb l := fun l => Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  
  have hnsq : ∀ η : Cyl, 0 < η.1 → 0 < dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ η) (nPhi5 B G γ η) := by
    intro η hη
    have hpint : (pint5 B G γ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      unfold pint5
      split_ifs with h
      · norm_num
      · exact_mod_cast h
    have hkb : (0:ℝ) < (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) := by
      have : 0 < kb B.h γ.1 :=
        Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hQbpos _) _) _)
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hRC : 0 < RC γ.1 η := div_pos hη (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hQbpos _))
    have h1 : nPhi5 B G γ η 1 ≠ 0 := by
      have e : nPhi5 B G γ η 1 = pang5 B G γ / RC γ.1 η := rfl
      rw [e]
      unfold pang5
      exact div_ne_zero (div_ne_zero hpint hkb.ne') hRC.ne'
    simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have := mul_self_pos.mpr h1
    linarith [mul_self_nonneg (nPhi5 B G γ η 0), mul_self_nonneg (nPhi5 B G γ η 2)]
  have hN0 : ∀ η ∈ U, dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ η) (nPhi5 B G γ η) ≠ 0 :=
    fun η hη => (hnsq η (hUD hη).1).ne'
  
  have hNs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ η) (nPhi5 B G γ η)) U := by
    have e : (fun η : Cyl => dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ η) (nPhi5 B G γ η)) =
        fun η => ∑ i : Fin 3, nPhi5 B G γ η i * nPhi5 B G γ η i := by
      funext η; rfl
    rw [e]
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => (hn i).mul (hn i))
  have hNinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ η) (nPhi5 B G γ η))⁻¹) U :=
    hNs.inv hN0
  have hAPhi : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => APhi5 B G γ η i j) U := by
    intro i j
    have e : (fun η : Cyl => APhi5 B G γ η i j) = fun η => -Kmat B G γ η i j +
        (dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ η) (nPhi5 B G γ η))⁻¹ * (nPhi5 B G γ η i *
          ((∑ k : Fin 3, nPhi5 B G γ η k * Kmat B G γ η k j) - nPhiP5 B G γ η j)) := by
      funext η
      simp only [APhi5, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct]
    rw [e]
    exact (hK i j).neg.add (hNinv.mul ((hn i).mul
      ((ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ => (hn k).mul (hK k j)).sub (hnP j))))
  have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => dDamp5 B G γ η) U := by
    have e : (fun η : Cyl => dDamp5 B G γ η) = fun η =>
        epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ))^2 * dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ η) (nPhi5 B G γ η) := rfl
    rw [e]; exact contDiffOn_const.mul hNs
  have ha : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => APhi5 B G γ η i j -
      (if i = j then (m:ℝ)^2 else 0) * dDamp5 B G γ η) U :=
    fun i j => (hAPhi i j).sub (contDiffOn_const.mul hD)
  
  have hqpos : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h η := fun η hη =>
    (hok.1.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith [hη.2.1])).1
  have hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) U := by
    have h4' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1
    have hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
      apply ContDiff.prodMk
      · exact contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_snd
      · exact contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_fst.comp (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd))
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) U (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := (hUD hξ).2.1
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    exact h4'.comp hφ.contDiffOn hmaps
  have hcast : ∀ {g : Cyl → ℝ}, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((g η : ℝ) : ℂ)) U := by
    intro g hg
    have := Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hg
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using this
  have hrho : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => rhoQ B γ η) U := hq.div_const _
  have hrpow : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => rhoQ B γ η ^ (-(Aex B.h + 1))) U :=
    hrho.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (div_pos (hqpos η (hUD hη)) (hQbpos _)).ne')
  have hsrc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => srcHat B f γ m η) U :=
    (hcast hrpow).smul (hf.mono hUD)
  have hnC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => nPhiC5 B G γ η) U :=
    contDiffOn_pi.2 (fun i => hcast (hn i))
  have hdot : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => dotProduct (nPhiC5 B G γ η) (srcHat B f γ m η)) U := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ∑ i : Fin 3, nPhiC5 B G γ η i * srcHat B f γ m η i) U
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => ((contDiffOn_pi.1 hnC) i).mul ((contDiffOn_pi.1 hsrc) i))
  have hnsqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => nsqC5 B G γ η) U := hcast hNs
  have hnsqinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => (nsqC5 B G γ η)⁻¹) U :=
    hnsqC.inv (fun η hη => by unfold nsqC5; exact_mod_cast hN0 η hη)
  have hproj : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => projT5 B G γ η (srcHat B f γ m η)) U := by
    have e : (fun η => projT5 B G γ η (srcHat B f γ m η)) = fun η => srcHat B f γ m η -
        (dotProduct (nPhiC5 B G γ η) (srcHat B f γ m η) * (nsqC5 B G γ η)⁻¹) • nPhiC5 B G γ η := by
      funext η; simp only [projT5, div_eq_mul_inv]
    rw [e]
    exact hsrc.sub ((hdot.mul hnsqinv).smul hnC)
  
  have hE : ∀ (c : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (Z : Fin 3 → ℂ) (k : Fin 3),
      ((∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, c i j • (ContinuousLinearMap.single ℝ (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) i).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) j)) Z) k =
        ∑ j : Fin 3, ((c k j : ℝ) : ℂ) * Z j := by
    intro c Z k
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.single_apply, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    fin_cases k <;> simp [Pi.single_apply, Complex.real_smul]
  refine ⟨fun η => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (APhi5 B G γ η i j -
      (if i = j then (m:ℝ)^2 else 0) * dDamp5 B G γ η) •
        (ContinuousLinearMap.single ℝ (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) i).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) j),
    fun η => -projT5 B G γ η (srcHat B f γ m η), ?_, hproj.neg, ?_⟩
  · exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ => (ha i j).smul contDiffOn_const))
  · intro η _ Z
    funext k
    rw [Pi.add_apply, hE (fun i j => APhi5 B G γ η i j -
      (if i = j then (m:ℝ)^2 else 0) * dDamp5 B G γ η) Z k]
    simp only [pulseRhs5, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.neg_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, pulseMatC,
      Matrix.map_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    fin_cases k <;> simp <;> push_cast <;> ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (P Q : WC) (T : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) (α1 α2 : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α1 P → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α2 Q → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α1 - kapS) T → (∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), T γ m ξ = ((qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * P γ m ξ 0 + ((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * P γ m ξ 1 + ((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * P γ m ξ 2)) → (∀ (γ : Lab) (m n : ℤ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • pchTr5 B G γ n (pchAmp5 B P γ m η) (pchAmp5 B Q γ n) η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b d : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m n : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • pchTr5 B G γ n (pchAmp5 B P γ m η) (pchAmp5 B Q γ n) η) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) * Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)

signature.name: pch5_pair_term
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (P Q : WC) (T : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) (α1 α2 : ℝ), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α1 P → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α2 Q → InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) (α1 - kapS) T → (∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), T γ m ξ = ((qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2:ℝ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * P γ m ξ 0 + ((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * P γ m ξ 1 + ((nPhi5 B G γ ξ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * P γ m ξ 2)) → (∀ (γ : Lab) (m n : ℤ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • pchTr5 B G γ n (pchAmp5 B P γ m η) (pchAmp5 B Q γ n) η) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C b d : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m n : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → NB B.h (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • pchTr5 B G γ n (pchAmp5 B P γ m η) (pchAmp5 B Q γ n) η) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) * SC B.h ξ ^ b * Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-d) * Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, haa, hab⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨lW, hWv⟩ := pch5_wave_factor B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨ls, hs⟩ := pulse_support_good_v5 B G hok hG
  refine ⟨lW + ls, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 P Q T α1 α2 hP hQ hT hTid
  have hk : kapS = 1 / 100000 := rfl
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqs0 : 0 < qsOf l0 := by rw [hQb]; positivity
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by rw [hQb]; exact pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨hDo, hqC, hqpos, -, -, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  have hDq : ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < qC B.h ξ ∧ qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 ∧ 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
    refine ⟨hqpos ξ hξ, by linarith [hξ'.2.2], ?_⟩
    unfold SC
    have : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| := by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))]
    exact one_le_pow₀ this
  have hEdge : ∀ X : ℝ, B.Xa < X → X < B.Xb → 0 ≤ edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X ∧
      edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab X ≤ 1 ∧ 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ∧ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb X ≤ 1 := by
    intro X e1 e2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, min_le_left _ _⟩
    · unfold edgeWeight
      split_ifs
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
      · exact le_rfl
    · unfold edgeWeight
      split_ifs
      · apply Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr
        have t1 := div_nonneg haa.le (sq_nonneg (Real.log (X / B.Xa)))
        have t2 := div_nonneg hab.le (sq_nonneg (Real.log (B.Xb / X)))
        linarith
      · norm_num
    · have hX : 0 < X := lt_trans hXa e1
      have l1 : 0 < Real.log (X / B.Xa) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr e1)
      have l2 : 0 < Real.log (B.Xb / X) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr e2)
      exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min l1 l2)
  have hPv0 : ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), 0 ≤ Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) := by
    intro γ ξ; unfold Penv5; exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hcastc : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (c : ℝ) (f : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ → ∀ j : ℕ,
      NB B.h (fun η => ((c * f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ ≤ |c| * NB B.h f j ξ := by
    intro ξ c f hf j
    have hLn : ‖(c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ))‖ ≤ |c| :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (abs_nonneg c) (fun x => by
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, norm_smul, Complex.norm_real,
          Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs])
    have hcomp : (fun η => ((c * f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) = ⇑(c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)) ∘ f := by
      funext η
      simp [Complex.ofRealCLM_apply]
    rw [hcomp]
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (⇑(c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)) ∘ f) ξ =
        (c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)).compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left (c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)) hf
        (i := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    unfold NB
    rw [e1]
    have e2 : ((c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
        (c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ)).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)) := by
      ext v
      rfl
    rw [e2]
    calc _ ≤ ‖(c • (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ))‖ *
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _ _
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hLn (norm_nonneg _)
  have hNBc : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (z : ℂ) (j : ℕ), NB B.h (fun _ : Cyl => z) j ξ ≤ ‖z‖ := by
    intro ξ z j
    unfold NB
    refine le_trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _) ?_
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with hk0 | hk'
    · subst hk0; simp
    · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne hk'.ne']; simp
  have hsm : ∀ (U : Set Cyl) (f : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) U := by
    intro U f hf
    have hcomp : (fun η => ((f η : ℝ) : ℂ)) = ⇑(Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ) ∘ f := by
      funext η; simp [Complex.ofRealCLM_apply]
    rw [hcomp]
    exact (Complex.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hf
  have hqsm : ∀ c : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ c) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := fun c =>
    hqC.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hqpos η hη).ne')
  have hAmpS : ∀ X : WC, (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (X γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) →
      ∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pchAmp5 B X γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := fun X hX γ m =>
    (hsm _ _ (hqsm (-Aex B.h))).smul (hX γ m)
  have hDer : ∀ f : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ f) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    intro f hf
    have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hDo (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hvR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ξ : Cyl => ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv))
        (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk (contDiffOn_const.prodMk
        ((contDiffOn_const.mul (contDiffOn_fst.rpow_const_of_ne (fun η hη => (hη.1).ne'))).smul
          contDiffOn_const)))
    exact ⟨hfd.clm_apply hvR, hfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const⟩
  
  have hph : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (η : Cyl), η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) →

  have hreQ : ∀ n (f : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) (e : ℝ) (w : Lab → Cyl → ℝ),
      CUB5 B (fun γ m ξ => ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ B.Xa < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < B.Xb ∧
        ξ ∈ tsupport (Q γ m)) k f e w → CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (fun γ _ η => f γ n η) e w := by
    intro n f e w hf
    obtain ⟨c, hc, H⟩ := hf
    refine ⟨c, hc, fun γ m ξ hp => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hξ, h1, h2, -, htQ⟩ := hPn n γ m ξ hp
    exact H γ n ξ ⟨hξ, h1, h2, htQ⟩
  have hqcub : ∀ n (c : ℝ), CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (fun _ _ η => ((qC B.h η ^ c : ℝ) : ℂ)) c
      (fun _ _ => 1) := by
    intro n c
    choose C1 hC1 using (qpow_cmult_nb_v5 B hok (qsOf l0) c hqs0 hqs1).2
    refine ⟨∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C1 j|, Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _),
      fun γ m ξ hp => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hξ, -, -, -, -⟩ := hPn n γ m ξ hp
    refine ⟨zero_le_one, ⟨_, hDo, hξ, hsm _ _ (hqsm c)⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    have hjm : j ∈ Finset.range (k+1) := Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega)
    have hqp : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ c := Real.rpow_nonneg (hDq ξ hξ).1.le _
    calc NB B.h (fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ c : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ ≤ C1 j * qC B.h ξ ^ c := hC1 j ξ hξ
      _ ≤ |C1 j| * qC B.h ξ ^ c := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hqp
      _ ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C1 j|) * qC B.h ξ ^ c :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => abs_nonneg (C1 i)) hjm) hqp
      _ = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |C1 j|) * qC B.h ξ ^ c * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
  obtain ⟨CR, hCR0, hCR⟩ := inv_r_qnb_v5 B hok (qsOf l0) hqs0 hqs1 k
  have hRc : ∀ n, CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k Rc (-(1/2)) (fun _ _ => 1) := by
    intro n
    refine ⟨CR, hCR0, fun γ m ξ hp => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hξ, h1, h2, -, -⟩ := hPn n γ m ξ hp
    have hfs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => (η.1)⁻¹) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) :=
      contDiff_fst.contDiffOn.inv (fun η hη => (hη.1).ne')
    refine ⟨zero_le_one, ⟨_, hDo, hξ, hsm _ _ hfs⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    have hcl := hcastc ξ 1 _ (hfs.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hξ)) j
    simp only [one_mul, abs_one] at hcl
    calc NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (((η.1)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)) j ξ ≤ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (η.1)⁻¹) j ξ := hcl
      _ ≤ CR * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) := hCR ξ hξ h1 h2 j hj
      _ = CR * qC B.h ξ ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
  have hcongr : ∀ n (f g : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) (e : ℝ) (w : Lab → Cyl → ℝ),
      CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k g e w →
      (∀ γ m η, η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → f γ m η = g γ m η) → CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k f e w := by
    intro n f g e w hg hfg
    obtain ⟨c, hc, H⟩ := hg
    refine ⟨c, hc, fun γ m ξ hp => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hξ, -, -, -, -⟩ := hPn n γ m ξ hp
    obtain ⟨hw, ⟨U, hU, hξU, hsU⟩, hb⟩ := H γ m ξ hp
    have hev : f γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] g γ m :=
      Filter.mem_of_superset (hDo.mem_nhds hξ) (fun η hη => hfg γ m η hη)
    refine ⟨hw, ⟨U ∩ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), hU.inter hDo, ⟨hξU, hξ⟩,
      (hsU.mono Set.inter_subset_left).congr (fun η hη => hfg γ m η hη.2)⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    have := hb j hj
    unfold NB at this ⊢
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds]
    exact this
  have hper : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ γ m ξ, pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n γ m ξ →
      NB B.h (pchPT5 B G P Q n γ m) k ξ ≤ c * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) * wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ γ ξ := by
    intro n
    obtain ⟨hmul, hadd, -, hweak, hvec⟩ := cub5_algebra B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (hPq n)
    have cQc : CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k Qc (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun _ _ => 1) := hqcub n _
    have cqa : CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k qa (-(Aex B.h + 1/2)) (fun _ _ => 1) := hqcub n _
    have cMc : CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (Mc n) 0 (fun _ _ => 1) := by
      refine ⟨|(n:ℝ)|, abs_nonneg _, fun γ m ξ hp => ⟨zero_le_one,
        ⟨Set.univ, isOpen_univ, Set.mem_univ _, contDiffOn_const⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩⟩
      refine (hNBc ξ _ j).trans ?_
      have hnm : ‖Complex.I * (n : ℂ)‖ = |(n : ℝ)| := by
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_intCast]
      rw [hnm, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one, mul_one]
    have cWp : ∀ i, CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (Wp i) (-Aex B.h + B.h * α1) (wtW5 B G b1 d1) :=
      fun i => hresP n _ _ _ (hWP i).1
    have cWq : ∀ i, CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (Wq n i) (-Aex B.h + B.h * α2) (wtW5 B G b2 d2) :=
      fun i => hreQ n _ _ _ (hWQ i).1
    have crWq : ∀ i, CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (rWq n i) (-Aex B.h + B.h * α2 - 1/2 - B.h * kapS)
        (wtW5 B G b2 d2) := fun i => hreQ n _ _ _ (hWQ i).2.1
    have czWq : ∀ i, CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (zWq n i) (-Aex B.h + B.h * α2 - 1/2)
        (wtW5 B G b2 d2) := fun i => hreQ n _ _ _ (hWQ i).2.2
    have cPhT : CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k PhT (-(Aex B.h + 1/2) + B.h * (α1 - kapS))
        (fun γ ξ => 1 * wtW5 B G b3 d3 γ ξ) := hmul qa T _ _ _ _ cqa (hTc n)
    have hfin : ∀ (f : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) (e : ℝ) (w : Lab → Cyl → ℝ), CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k f e w →
        B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS) - (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) ≤ e →
        (∀ γ m ξ, pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n γ m ξ → w γ ξ ≤ wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ γ ξ) →
        CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k f (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS) - (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) (wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ) :=
      fun f e w h1 h2 h3 => hweak f e _ w _ h1 h2 h3
    have hA2 : ∀ f g : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ,
        CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k f (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS) - (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) (wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ) →
        CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k g (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS) - (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) (wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ) →
        CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (cxAdd5 f g) (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS) - (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2))
          (wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ) :=
      fun f g hf hg => (hadd f g _ _ hf hg).1
    have hS2 : ∀ f g : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ,
        CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k f (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS) - (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) (wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ) →
        CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k g (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS) - (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) (wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ) →
        CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (cxSub5 f g) (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS) - (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2))
          (wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ) :=
      fun f g hf hg => (hadd f g _ _ hf hg).2
    have tR : ∀ a b : Fin 3, CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (cxMul5 (Wp a) (rWq n b))
        (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS) - (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) (wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ) := fun a b =>
      hfin _ _ _ (hmul _ _ _ _ _ _ (cWp a) (crWq b)) (by linarith) (hw12 n)
    have tZ : ∀ a b : Fin 3, CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (cxMul5 (Wp a) (zWq n b))
        (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS) - (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) (wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ) := fun a b =>
      hfin _ _ _ (hmul _ _ _ _ _ _ (cWp a) (czWq b)) (by linarith) (hw12 n)
    have tM : ∀ b : Fin 3, CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (cxMul5 (cxMul5 (Mc n) PhT) (Wq n b))
        (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS) - (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) (wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ) := fun b =>
      hfin _ _ _ (hmul _ _ _ _ _ _ (hmul _ _ _ _ _ _ cMc cPhT) (cWq b)) (by linarith)
        (fun γ m ξ hp => Eq.trans_le (by norm_num) (hw32 n γ m ξ hp))
    have tRr : ∀ a b : Fin 3, CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (cxMul5 (cxMul5 (Wp a) (Wq n b)) Rc)
        (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS) - (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) (wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ) := fun a b =>
      hfin _ _ _ (hmul _ _ _ _ _ _ (hmul _ _ _ _ _ _ (cWp a) (cWq b)) (hRc n)) (by linarith)
        (fun γ m ξ hp => Eq.trans_le (by norm_num) (hw12 n γ m ξ hp))
    have hE0 : CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (E0 n)
        (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS) - (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) (wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ) :=
      hS2 _ _ (hA2 _ _ (hA2 _ _ (tR 0 0) (tZ 2 0)) (tM 0)) (tRr 1 1)
    have hE1 : CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (E1 n)
        (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS) - (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) (wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ) :=
      hA2 _ _ (hA2 _ _ (hA2 _ _ (tR 0 1) (tZ 2 1)) (tM 1)) (tRr 1 0)
    have hE2 : CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (E2 n)
        (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS) - (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) (wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ) :=
      hA2 _ _ (hA2 _ _ (tR 0 2) (tZ 2 2)) (tM 2)
    have hcomp : ∀ E : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ,
        CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k E (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS) - (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) (wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ) →
        CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (cxMul5 Qc E) (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) (wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ) :=
      fun E hE => hweak _ _ _ _ _ (hmul Qc E _ _ _ _ cQc hE) (by linarith)
        (fun γ m ξ _ => le_of_eq (one_mul _))
    have hC0 : CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (fun γ m η => pchPT5 B G P Q n γ m η 0)
        (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) (wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ) :=
      hcongr n _ _ _ _ (hcomp _ hE0) (fun γ m η hη => heq0 n γ m η hη)
    have hC1 : CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (fun γ m η => pchPT5 B G P Q n γ m η 1)
        (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) (wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ) :=
      hcongr n _ _ _ _ (hcomp _ hE1) (fun γ m η hη => heq1 n γ m η hη)
    have hC2 : CUB5 B (pchPtP5 B l0 P Q n) k (fun γ m η => pchPT5 B G P Q n γ m η 2)
        (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) (wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ) :=
      hcongr n _ _ _ _ (hcomp _ hE2) (fun γ m η hη => heq2 n γ m η hη)
    obtain ⟨c0, hc0, H0⟩ := hC0
    obtain ⟨c1, hc1, H1⟩ := hC1
    obtain ⟨c2, hc2, H2⟩ := hC2
    refine ⟨c0 + c1 + c2, by linarith, fun γ m ξ hp => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨-, ⟨U0, hU0o, hU0ξ, hU0s⟩, B0⟩ := H0 γ m ξ hp
    obtain ⟨-, ⟨U1, hU1o, hU1ξ, hU1s⟩, B1⟩ := H1 γ m ξ hp
    obtain ⟨-, ⟨U2, hU2o, hU2ξ, hU2s⟩, B2⟩ := H2 γ m ξ hp
    have hv : NB B.h (pchPT5 B G P Q n γ m) k ξ ≤
        NB B.h (fun η => pchPT5 B G P Q n γ m η 0) k ξ +
        NB B.h (fun η => pchPT5 B G P Q n γ m η 1) k ξ +
        NB B.h (fun η => pchPT5 B G P Q n γ m η 2) k ξ := by
      have := hvec B.h (pchPT5 B G P Q n γ m) ξ k (by
        intro i
        fin_cases i
        · exact hU0s.contDiffAt (hU0o.mem_nhds hU0ξ)
        · exact hU1s.contDiffAt (hU1o.mem_nhds hU1ξ)
        · exact hU2s.contDiffAt (hU2o.mem_nhds hU2ξ))
      rwa [Fin.sum_univ_three] at this
    have e0 := B0 k le_rfl
    have e1 := B1 k le_rfl
    have e2 := B2 k le_rfl
    have hsum : c0 * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) * wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ γ ξ +
        c1 * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) * wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ γ ξ +
        c2 * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) * wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ γ ξ =
        (c0 + c1 + c2) * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) * wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ γ ξ := by ring
    linarith
  
  have hNB0 : ∀ (F : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ) (ξ : Cyl), F =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → NB B.h F k ξ = 0 := by
    intro F ξ hev
    unfold NB
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
    have hz : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (0 : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ) ξ = 0 := by
      have := (iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := Cyl) (F := Fin 3 → ℂ) (n := k))
      exact congrFun this ξ
    rw [hz]
    have e : ((0 : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => Cyl) (Fin 3 → ℂ))
        ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) = 0 := by
      ext v
      simp
    rw [e, norm_zero]
  have hoffQ : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m n : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∉ tsupport (Q γ n) →
      pchPT5 B G P Q n γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
    intro γ m n ξ hξ
    have ha : Q γ n =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq).mp hξ
    have hA : pchAmp5 B Q γ n =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
      filter_upwards [ha] with y hy
      simp [pchAmp5, hy]
    filter_upwards [hA.eventuallyEq_nhds] with y hy
    have hy0 : pchAmp5 B Q γ n y = 0 := hy.eq_of_nhds
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (pchAmp5 B Q γ n) y = 0 := by
      rw [hy.fderiv_eq]
      exact fderiv_const_apply (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ)
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [pchPT5, pchTr5, dR, dZ, hfd, hy0]
  have hoffP : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m n : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∉ tsupport (P γ m) →
      pchPT5 B G P Q n γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
    intro γ m n ξ hξ
    have ha : P γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq).mp hξ
    filter_upwards [ha] with y hy
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [pchPT5, pchTr5, pchAmp5, hy]
  
  choose cn hcn0 hcn using hper
  obtain ⟨HQ, -, hHQ⟩ := hQ.1
  refine ⟨∑ n ∈ HQ, cn n, bΩ, dΩ, fun γ m n ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
  show NB B.h (pchPT5 B G P Q n γ m) k ξ ≤ _
  have hCs : 0 ≤ ∑ n ∈ HQ, cn n := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun n _ => hcn0 n)
  have hq : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) := Real.rpow_nonneg (hDq ξ hξ).1.le _
  have hw0 := hwnn bΩ dΩ γ ξ hξ hX1 hX2
  have hRHS : (∑ n ∈ HQ, cn n) * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) * SC B.h ξ ^ bΩ *
      Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) * edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-dΩ) *
      Penv5 B G γ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) =
      (∑ n ∈ HQ, cn n) * qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * (α1 + α2 - kapS)) * wtW5 B G bΩ dΩ γ ξ := by
    unfold wtW5; ring
  rw [hRHS]
  by_cases htP : ξ ∈ tsupport (P γ m)
  · by_cases htQ : ξ ∈ tsupport (Q γ n)
    · have hnH : n ∈ HQ := by
        by_contra hn
        rw [hHQ γ n hn, tsupport_zero] at htQ
        simp at htQ
      have hb := hcn n γ m ξ ⟨hξ, hX1, hX2, htP, htQ⟩
      have hle : cn n ≤ ∑ n ∈ HQ, cn n := Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => hcn0 i) hnH
      exact hb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle hq) hw0)
    · rw [hNB0 _ ξ (hoffQ γ m n ξ htQ)]
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCs hq) hw0
  · rw [hNB0 _ ξ (hoffP γ m n ξ htP)]
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCs hq) hw0

pch5_pair_term.definitions:
noncomputable def pchPT5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (P Q : WC) (n : ℤ) : WC := fun γ m η =>
  ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • pchTr5 B G γ n (pchAmp5 B P γ m η) (pchAmp5 B Q γ n) η
def pchPtP5 (B : BG) (l0 : ℕ) (P Q : WC) (n : ℤ) : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → Prop := fun γ m ξ =>
  ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ B.Xa < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < B.Xb ∧ ξ ∈ tsupport (P γ m) ∧ ξ ∈ tsupport (Q γ n)

and_nodes.definitions_block:
noncomputable def pchPT5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (P Q : WC) (n : ℤ) : WC := fun γ m η =>
  ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • pchTr5 B G γ n (pchAmp5 B P γ m η) (pchAmp5 B Q γ n) η
def pchPtP5 (B : BG) (l0 : ℕ) (P Q : WC) (n : ℤ) : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → Prop := fun γ m ξ =>
  ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ B.Xa < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < B.Xb ∧ ξ ∈ tsupport (P γ m) ∧ ξ ∈ tsupport (Q γ n)

subgoal_signatures.name: cub5_algebra
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (B : BG) (P : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → Prop) (k : ℕ),
    (∀ γ m ξ, P γ m ξ → 0 < qC B.h ξ ∧ qC B.h ξ ≤ 1) →
    (∀ (f g : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) (e1 e2 : ℝ) (w1 w2 : Lab → Cyl → ℝ), CUB5 B P k f e1 w1 → CUB5 B P k g e2 w2 →
      CUB5 B P k (cxMul5 f g) (e1 + e2) (fun γ ξ => w1 γ ξ * w2 γ ξ)) ∧
    (∀ (f g : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) (e : ℝ) (w : Lab → Cyl → ℝ), CUB5 B P k f e w → CUB5 B P k g e w →
      CUB5 B P k (cxAdd5 f g) e w ∧ CUB5 B P k (cxSub5 f g) e w) ∧
    (∀ (c : ℂ) (f : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) (e : ℝ) (w : Lab → Cyl → ℝ), CUB5 B P k f e w →
      CUB5 B P k (cxSmul5 c f) e w) ∧
    (∀ (f : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → ℂ) (e e' : ℝ) (w w' : Lab → Cyl → ℝ), CUB5 B P k f e w → e' ≤ e →
      (∀ γ m ξ, P γ m ξ → w γ ξ ≤ w' γ ξ) → CUB5 B P k f e' w') ∧
    (∀ (h : ℝ) (F : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (ξ : Cyl) (j : ℕ), (∀ i, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => F η i) ξ) →
      NB h F j ξ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, NB h (fun η => F η i) j ξ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G qs α hok
  have hD : IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qs))
    have e : DomC B.h qs =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio qs := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  have s1 : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (L : V →L[ℝ] V), ‖L‖ ≤ 1 →
      ∀ (a : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → V), InWg5 B G qs α a →
        InWg5 B G qs α (fun γ m ξ => L (a γ m ξ)) := by
    intro V _ _ L hL a ha
    obtain ⟨⟨H, H0, hH⟩, sa, da, pa, ba⟩ := ha
    refine ⟨⟨H, H0, fun γ m hm => ?_⟩, fun γ m => ?_, fun γ m ξ hξ c hc => ?_,
      fun γ m ξ hξ hne => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
    · funext ξ
      show L (a γ m ξ) = 0
      rw [hH γ m hm, Pi.zero_apply, map_zero]
    · exact L.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (sa γ m)
    · show L (a γ m (shY ξ c)) = L (a γ m ξ)
      rw [da γ m ξ hξ c hc]
    · apply pa γ m ξ hξ
      intro h0
      apply hne
      show L (a γ m ξ) = 0
      rw [h0, map_zero]
    · obtain ⟨C, b, d, hC⟩ := ba k
      refine ⟨C, b, d, fun γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2 => ?_⟩
      refine le_trans ?_ (hC γ m ξ hξ hX1 hX2)
      have hf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (a γ m) ξ := (sa γ m).contDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hξ)
      have hit : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (⇑L ∘ a γ m) ξ =
          L.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (a γ m) ξ) :=
        L.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left hf (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      show NB B.h (⇑L ∘ a γ m) k ξ ≤ NB B.h (a γ m) k ξ
      unfold NB
      rw [hit]
      have e2 : (L.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (a γ m) ξ)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ) =
          L.compContinuousMultilinearMap ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (a γ m) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)) := by
        ext v; rfl
      rw [e2]
      calc _ ≤ ‖L‖ * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (a γ m) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)‖ := L.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _
        _ ≤ 1 * ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (a γ m) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ξ)‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = _ := one_mul _
  let Lv : (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ) :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun i => (Complex.conjCLE : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i))
  have hLv : ∀ (v : Fin 3 → ℂ) (i : Fin 3), Lv v i = star (v i) := by
    intro v i
    simp [Lv, Complex.star_def]
  have hLvn : ‖Lv‖ ≤ 1 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound Lv zero_le_one (fun v => ?_)
    rw [one_mul]
    refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg v)).2 (fun i => ?_)
    rw [hLv, Complex.star_def, Complex.norm_conj]
    exact norm_le_pi_norm v i
  refine ⟨fun a ha => ?_, fun T hT => ?_⟩
  · have h1 := s1 Lv hLvn a ha
    have e : (fun γ m ξ i => star (a γ m ξ i)) = (fun γ m ξ => Lv (a γ m ξ)) := by
      funext γ m ξ i
      exact (hLv _ _).symm
    rw [e]
    exact h1
  · have hn : ‖(Complex.conjCLE : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := le_of_eq Complex.conjCLE_norm
    have h1 := s1 (Complex.conjCLE : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ) hn T hT
    have e : (fun γ m ξ => star (T γ m ξ)) = (fun γ m ξ => (Complex.conjCLE : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ) (T γ m ξ)) := by
      funext γ m ξ
      simp [Complex.star_def]
    rw [e]
    exact h1

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (P Q : WC) (HP HQ : Finset ℤ), (∀ γ m, m ∉ HP → P γ m = 0) → (∀ γ m, m ∉ HQ → Q γ m = 0) → ∀ (γ : Lab) (N : ℤ) (η : Cyl), ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B P) (pchAmp5 B Q) N γ η + pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B Q) (pchAmp5 B P) N γ η) = (∑ m ∈ HP, ((1/2 : ℂ) • (((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • pchTr5 B G γ (N - m) (pchAmp5 B P γ m η) (pchAmp5 B Q γ (N - m)) η) + (1/2 : ℂ) • (((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • pchTr5 B G γ (N + m) (pchAmp5 B (fun γ' m' ξ' i => star (P γ' m' ξ' i)) γ m η) (pchAmp5 B Q γ (N + m)) η))) + (∑ m ∈ HQ, ((1/2 : ℂ) • (((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • pchTr5 B G γ (N - m) (pchAmp5 B Q γ m η) (pchAmp5 B P γ (N - m)) η) + (1/2 : ℂ) • (((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • pchTr5 B G γ (N + m) (pchAmp5 B (fun γ' m' ξ' i => star (Q γ' m' ξ' i)) γ m η) (pchAmp5 B P γ (N + m)) η)))

signature.name: pch5_pair_finsum
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (P Q : WC) (HP HQ : Finset ℤ), (∀ γ m, m ∉ HP → P γ m = 0) → (∀ γ m, m ∉ HQ → Q γ m = 0) → ∀ (γ : Lab) (N : ℤ) (η : Cyl), ((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B P) (pchAmp5 B Q) N γ η + pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B Q) (pchAmp5 B P) N γ η) = (∑ m ∈ HP, ((1/2 : ℂ) • (((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • pchTr5 B G γ (N - m) (pchAmp5 B P γ m η) (pchAmp5 B Q γ (N - m)) η) + (1/2 : ℂ) • (((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • pchTr5 B G γ (N + m) (pchAmp5 B (fun γ' m' ξ' i => star (P γ' m' ξ' i)) γ m η) (pchAmp5 B Q γ (N + m)) η))) + (∑ m ∈ HQ, ((1/2 : ℂ) • (((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • pchTr5 B G γ (N - m) (pchAmp5 B Q γ m η) (pchAmp5 B P γ (N - m)) η) + (1/2 : ℂ) • (((qC B.h η ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • pchTr5 B G γ (N + m) (pchAmp5 B (fun γ' m' ξ' i => star (Q γ' m' ξ' i)) γ m η) (pchAmp5 B P γ (N + m)) η)))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G P Q HP HQ hP hQ γ N η
  have h0 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (al : Fin 3 → ℂ) (bt : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ), (∀ i, al i = 0) →
      pchTr5 B G γ n al bt η = 0 := by
    intro n al bt hal
    have a0 := hal 0
    have a1 := hal 1
    have a2 := hal 2
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [pchTr5, a0, a1, a2]
  have hst : ∀ (X : WC) (m : ℤ), (fun i => star (pchAmp5 B X γ m η i)) =
      pchAmp5 B (fun γ' m' ξ' i => star (X γ' m' ξ' i)) γ m η := by
    intro X m
    funext i
    simp only [pchAmp5, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Complex.star_def, map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal]
  have hsupp : ∀ (X Y : WC) (HX : Finset ℤ), (∀ γ m, m ∉ HX → X γ m = 0) →
      pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B X) (pchAmp5 B Y) N γ η =
        ∑ m ∈ HX, ((1/2 : ℂ) • pchTr5 B G γ (N - m) (pchAmp5 B X γ m η) (pchAmp5 B Y γ (N - m)) η +
          (1/2 : ℂ) • pchTr5 B G γ (N + m) (fun i => star (pchAmp5 B X γ m η i))
            (pchAmp5 B Y γ (N + m)) η) := by
    intro X Y HX hX
    unfold pchPair5
    apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
    rw [Function.support_subset_iff']
    intro m hm
    have hm' : m ∉ HX := fun h => hm (Finset.mem_coe.mpr h)
    have hz : ∀ i, pchAmp5 B X γ m η i = 0 := by
      intro i
      simp [pchAmp5, hX γ m hm']
    rw [h0 _ _ _ hz, h0 _ _ _ (fun i => by simp [hz i])]
    simp
  rw [hsupp P Q HP hP, hsupp Q P HQ hQ, smul_add, Finset.smul_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
  congr 1 <;> refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_) <;>
    rw [smul_add, smul_comm _ (1/2 : ℂ), smul_comm _ (1/2 : ℂ), hst]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl), IsOpen U → ∀ ξ ∈ U, ∀ k : ℕ, (∀ (f g : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → NB h (fun η => f η + g η) k ξ ≤ NB h f k ξ + NB h g k ξ) ∧ (∀ (c : ℂ) (f : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → NB h (fun η => c • f η) k ξ ≤ ‖c‖ * NB h f k ξ) ∧ (∀ (s : Finset ℤ) (f : ℤ → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), (∀ i ∈ s, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f i) U) → NB h (fun η => ∑ i ∈ s, f i η) k ξ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, NB h (f i) k ξ)

signature.name: pch5_nb_lin
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl), IsOpen U → ∀ ξ ∈ U, ∀ k : ℕ, (∀ (f g : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → NB h (fun η => f η + g η) k ξ ≤ NB h f k ξ + NB h g k ξ) ∧ (∀ (c : ℂ) (f : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → NB h (fun η => c • f η) k ξ ≤ ‖c‖ * NB h f k ξ) ∧ (∀ (s : Finset ℤ) (f : ℤ → Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), (∀ i ∈ s, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f i) U) → NB h (fun η => ∑ i ∈ s, f i η) k ξ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, NB h (f i) k ξ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h U hU ξ hξ k
  have hn : U ∈ nhds ξ := hU.mem_nhds hξ
  have hcd : ∀ F : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → ContDiffAt ℝ k F ξ := fun F hF =>
    (hF.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hA : ∀ (f g : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U →
      NB h (fun η => f η + g η) k ξ ≤ NB h f k ξ + NB h g k ξ := by
    intro f g hf hg
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => f η + g η) ξ =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g ξ :=
      iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (hcd f hf) (hcd g hg)
    unfold NB
    rw [e1]
    have e2 : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) +
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) := by
      ext m
      simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e2]
    exact norm_add_le _ _
  refine ⟨hA, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro c f hf
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => c • f η) ξ = c • iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ :=
      iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply' (hcd f hf)
    unfold NB
    rw [e1]
    have e2 : (c • iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) =
        c • (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) := by
      ext m
      simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e2]
    exact norm_smul_le c ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ))
  · intro s f
    classical
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      intro _
      simp only [Finset.sum_empty]
      unfold NB
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
      have e : ((0 : Cyl → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => Cyl) (Fin 3 → ℂ)) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) = 0 := by
        ext m
        simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
      rw [e, norm_zero]
    | insert a s ha ih =>
      intro hs
      have hfa : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f a) U := hs a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
      have hs' : ∀ i ∈ s, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f i) U := fun i hi => hs i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
      have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ∑ i ∈ s, f i η) U :=
        ContDiffOn.sum (fun i hi => hs' i hi)
      have e : (fun η => ∑ i ∈ insert a s, f i η) = fun η => f a η + ∑ i ∈ s, f i η := by
        funext η
        rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
      rw [e, Finset.sum_insert ha]
      have h1 := hA (f a) (fun η => ∑ i ∈ s, f i η) hfa hG
      have h2 := ih hs'
      linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (qs α : ℝ) (a : WC), qs ≤ B.qB → InWg5 B G qs α a → ∀ (γ : Lab) (n : ℤ) (al : Fin 3 → ℂ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeCoef5 B G (pchAmp5 B a) γ n) ξ ∧ pq5TrM B.h (n * pint5 B G γ) al (modeCoef5 B G (pchAmp5 B a) γ n) ξ = fun i => pchTr5 B G γ n al (pchAmp5 B a γ n) ξ i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)))

signature.name: pch5_tr_phase
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (qs α : ℝ) (a : WC), qs ≤ B.qB → InWg5 B G qs α a → ∀ (γ : Lab) (n : ℤ) (al : Fin 3 → ℂ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeCoef5 B G (pchAmp5 B a) γ n) ξ ∧ pq5TrM B.h (n * pint5 B G γ) al (modeCoef5 B G (pchAmp5 B a) γ n) ξ = fun i => pchTr5 B G γ n al (pchAmp5 B a γ n) ξ i * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ)))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG qs α a hqs ha γ n al ξ hξ
  obtain ⟨hDopen, hqsm, hqpos, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B qs hok
  have hDn : DomC B.h qs ∈ nhds ξ := hDopen.mem_nhds hξ
  have hqd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (qC B.h) ξ := (hqsm.contDiffAt hDn).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hsR : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h)) ξ :=
    hqd.rpow_const (Or.inl (hqpos ξ hξ).ne')
  obtain ⟨sC, hsCdef⟩ : ∃ s : Cyl → ℂ, s = fun η => ((qC B.h η ^ (-Aex B.h) : ℝ) : ℂ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsC : DifferentiableAt ℝ sC ξ := by
    rw [hsCdef]
    have h0 := Complex.ofRealCLM.differentiableAt.comp ξ hsR
    exact h0
  have hamp : DifferentiableAt ℝ (a γ n) ξ :=
    ((ha.2.1 γ n).contDiffAt hDn).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hmc : DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeCoef5 B G a γ n) ξ :=
    modeCoef5_differentiable_v5 B G hok hG qs α a hqs ha γ n ξ hξ
  have e1 : ∀ i : Fin 3, (fun η => modeCoef5 B G (pchAmp5 B a) γ n η i) =
      fun η => sC η * modeCoef5 B G a γ n η i := by
    intro i; funext η; rw [hsCdef]
    simp only [modeCoef5, pchAmp5, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have e2 : ∀ i : Fin 3, (fun η => pchAmp5 B a γ n η i) = fun η => sC η * a γ n η i := by
    intro i; funext η; rw [hsCdef]
    simp only [pchAmp5, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hmc' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (modeCoef5 B G (pchAmp5 B a) γ n) ξ := by
    refine differentiableAt_pi.2 (fun i => ?_)
    rw [e1 i]
    exact hsC.mul (differentiableAt_pi.1 hmc i)
  have hb : DifferentiableAt ℝ (pchAmp5 B a γ n) ξ := by
    refine differentiableAt_pi.2 (fun i => ?_)
    rw [e2 i]
    exact hsC.mul (differentiableAt_pi.1 hamp i)
  have hcomp : ∀ (c : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Cyl) (i : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ c ξ →
      fderiv ℝ c ξ v i = fderiv ℝ (fun η => c η i) ξ v := by
    intro c v i hc
    rw [fderiv_apply hc i]
    rfl
  have hprod : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℂ) (v : Cyl), DifferentiableAt ℝ f ξ →
      fderiv ℝ (fun η => sC η * f η) ξ v = sC ξ * fderiv ℝ f ξ v + fderiv ℝ sC ξ v * f ξ := by
    intro f v hf
    have hP := hsC.hasFDerivAt.mul hf.hasFDerivAt
    rw [show (fun η => sC η * f η) = sC * f from rfl, hP.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have key : ∀ (v : Cyl) (i : Fin 3), fderiv ℝ (modeCoef5 B G (pchAmp5 B a) γ n) ξ v i =
      sC ξ * fderiv ℝ (fun η => modeCoef5 B G a γ n η i) ξ v +
        fderiv ℝ sC ξ v * modeCoef5 B G a γ n ξ i := by
    intro v i
    rw [hcomp _ v i hmc', e1 i, hprod _ v (differentiableAt_pi.1 hmc i)]
  have keyb : ∀ (v : Cyl) (i : Fin 3), fderiv ℝ (pchAmp5 B a γ n) ξ v i =
      sC ξ * fderiv ℝ (fun η => a γ n η i) ξ v + fderiv ℝ sC ξ v * a γ n ξ i := by
    intro v i
    rw [hcomp _ v i hb, e2 i, hprod _ v (differentiableAt_pi.1 hamp i)]
  have hbξ : ∀ i : Fin 3, pchAmp5 B a γ n ξ i = sC ξ * a γ n ξ i := fun i => by
    rw [hsCdef]; rfl
  have hR : ∀ i : Fin 3, dR B.h (modeCoef5 B G (pchAmp5 B a) γ n) ξ i =
      (dR B.h (pchAmp5 B a γ n) ξ i + Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) *
        ((dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * pchAmp5 B a γ n ξ i) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) := by
    intro i
    have w := (wmo_phase_deriv_v5 B G hok hG qs α a hqs ha γ n ξ hξ i).1
    simp only [dR] at w ⊢
    rw [key, keyb, w, hbξ]
    simp only [modeCoef5]
    ring
  have hZ : ∀ i : Fin 3, dZ (modeCoef5 B G (pchAmp5 B a) γ n) ξ i =
      (dZ (pchAmp5 B a γ n) ξ i + Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) *
        ((dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * pchAmp5 B a γ n ξ i) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) := by
    intro i
    have w := (wmo_phase_deriv_v5 B G hok hG qs α a hqs ha γ n ξ hξ i).2
    simp only [dZ] at w ⊢
    rw [key, keyb, w, hbξ]
    simp only [modeCoef5]
    ring
  have hval : ∀ j : Fin 3, modeCoef5 B G (pchAmp5 B a) γ n ξ j = pchAmp5 B a γ n ξ j *
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℂ))) := fun j => rfl
  
  have hQpos : 0 < Qb γ.1 := by unfold Qb; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _
  have hKpos : 0 < kb B.h γ.1 := by
    unfold kb epsb
    exact Nat.ceil_pos.2 (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQpos _) _)
  have hK0 : (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hKpos.ne'
  have hsq : 0 < Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hQpos
  have hr : 0 < ξ.1 := hξ.1
  have hQ : Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) = 1 := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_add hQpos]; norm_num
  have hn0 : nPhi5 B G γ ξ 0 = Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ := rfl
  have hn1 : nPhi5 B G γ ξ 1 =
      ((pint5 B G γ : ℝ) / (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ)) / (ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1)) := rfl
  have hn2 : nPhi5 B G γ ξ 2 = Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ := rfl
  have hgv : ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) • nPhi5 B G γ ξ =
      ![(kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ, (pint5 B G γ : ℝ) / ξ.1,
        (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j
    · show ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) * nPhi5 B G γ ξ 0 =
        (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ
      rw [hn0]
      linear_combination ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * dR B.h (phiL5 B G γ) ξ) * hQ
    · show ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) * nPhi5 B G γ ξ 1 = (pint5 B G γ : ℝ) / ξ.1
      rw [hn1]
      calc ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) *
            (((pint5 B G γ : ℝ) / (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ)) / (ξ.1 / Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1)))
          = (Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1)) * ((pint5 B G γ : ℝ) / ξ.1) *
              ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) / (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ)) := by
            simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv, inv_inv]; ring
        _ = (pint5 B G γ : ℝ) / ξ.1 := by rw [hQ, div_self hK0]; ring
    · show ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * Qb γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ))) * nPhi5 B G γ ξ 2 =
        (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ
      rw [hn2]
      linear_combination ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * dZ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ) * hQ
  refine ⟨hmc', ?_⟩
  funext i
  simp only [pq5TrM, pchTr5, hgv]
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue, Fin.reduceFinMk, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
      Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, hval, hR, hZ] <;>
    push_cast <;> ring

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (qs : ℝ), B.ok → IsOpen (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (qC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, 0 < qC B.h ξ) ∧ ContinuousOn (XC B.h) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h qs) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dR B.h f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dZ f) (DomC B.h qs) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (dT f) (DomC B.h qs)) ∧ (∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → f ξ = 0) → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, (XC B.h ξ < B.Xa ∨ B.Xb < XC B.h ξ) → dR B.h f ξ = 0 ∧ dZ f ξ = 0 ∧ dT f ξ = 0)
