proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G l0 a α H hok ha hH x t Y₀ hc
  have hxt' : 0 < rad x ∧ t < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (x 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hc
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  have hξ0D : ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀) ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := hc
  
  have hEta : ∀ (h : ℝ), SimScaleProps h → ∀ ξ0 : Cyl, ξ0.2.2.1 < 1 → ∃ N ∈ nhds ξ0, ∃ Γ : Finset Lab,
      ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ N → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) → γ ∈ Γ := by
    intro h hS ξ0 hξ0
    have hLc : ∀ ξ : Cyl, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ContinuousAt (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) ξ := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hτ : 0 < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 := by linarith
      have hqpos : 0 < qC h ξ := (hS.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) hτ).1
      have hqcont : ContinuousAt (qC h) ξ := by
        have hU : IsOpen (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi
        have hp : ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
          ⟨trivial, hτ⟩
        have hg : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) :=
          hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)
        have hk : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) ξ := by fun_prop
        have he : qC h = (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) ∘
            (fun η : Cyl => ((η.2.1, 1 - η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
          funext η; rfl
        rw [he]
        exact ContinuousAt.comp hg hk
      exact hqcont.logb hqpos.ne'
    have hwin : ∀ (ξ : Cyl) (γ : Lab), ξ.2.2.1 < 1 → ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL h γ) →
        |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) + (γ.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartR h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartZ h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.1:ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
        |chartT h γ.1 ξ / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
      intro ξ γ hξ hγ
      have s1 : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ → 1 < |φ ξ / μ - (j : ℝ)| →
          ∀ᶠ η in nhds ξ, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 := by
        intro μ j φ hφ h1
        have hψ : ContinuousAt (fun η => |φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)|) ξ :=
          ((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs
        have hev := (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : Cyl => (1:ℝ)) ξ).eventually_lt hψ h1
        filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
        have hsq : 1 < (φ η / μ - (j : ℝ)) ^ 2 := (one_lt_sq_iff_one_lt_abs _).mpr hη
        unfold sqPart bumpR
        rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), zero_div]
      have key : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (φ : Cyl → ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ →
          (∀ η, sqPart μ j (φ η) = 0 → etaL h γ η = 0) → |φ ξ / μ - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
        intro μ j φ hφ himp
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have hev := s1 μ j φ hφ hc
        apply (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mpr _) hγ
        filter_upwards [hev] with η hη
        exact himp η hη
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have := key 1 (-(γ.1:ℤ)) (fun η => Real.logb 2 (qC h η)) (hLc ξ hξ)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul])
        simpa [div_one, sub_neg_eq_add] using this
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.1 (chartR h γ.1) (by unfold chartR; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.1 (chartZ h γ.1) (by unfold chartZ; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      · exact key (Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ)) γ.2.1.2.2 (chartT h γ.1) (by unfold chartT; fun_prop)
          (fun η hη => by simp only [etaL, hη, zero_mul, mul_zero])
    obtain ⟨L0, hL0⟩ : ∃ L0 : ℝ, L0 = Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hfin : (⋃ n ∈ Set.Iic ⌊2 - L0⌋₊, ({n} : Set ℕ) ×ˢ
        ((Set.Icc ⌈chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ⌈chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋ ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ⌈chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - 2⌉ ⌊chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) + 2⌋) ×ˢ
          (Set.univ : Set Bool))).Finite := by
      refine Set.Finite.biUnion (Set.finite_Iic _) (fun n _ => ?_)
      exact (Set.finite_singleton n).prod (((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod
        ((Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod (Set.finite_Icc _ _))).prod Set.finite_univ)
    have hI : ∀ (x c : ℝ) (j : ℤ), |x - (j:ℝ)| ≤ 1 → |x - c| < 1 → j ∈ Set.Icc ⌈c - 2⌉ ⌊c + 2⌋ := by
      intro x c j hj hc
      rw [abs_le] at hj
      rw [abs_lt] at hc
      exact ⟨Int.ceil_le.mpr (by linarith [hj.2, hc.1]), Int.le_floor.mpr (by linarith [hj.1, hc.2])⟩
    have hcR : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartR h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartR; fun_prop
    have hcZ : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartZ h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartZ; fun_prop
    have hcT : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousAt (chartT h n) ξ0 := fun n => by unfold chartT; fun_prop
    have hch : ∀ (φ : Cyl → ℝ) (μ : ℝ), ContinuousAt φ ξ0 →
        ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, |φ ξ / μ - φ ξ0 / μ| < 1 := by
      intro φ μ hφ
      exact (((hφ.div_const μ).sub continuousAt_const).abs).eventually_lt continuousAt_const
        (by simp)
    have e1 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, ξ.2.2.1 < 1 :=
      (show ContinuousAt (fun ξ : Cyl => ξ.2.2.1) ξ0 by fun_prop).eventually_lt
        continuousAt_const hξ0
    have e2 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) - L0| < 1 :=
      (((hLc ξ0 hξ0).sub continuousAt_const).abs).eventually_lt continuousAt_const
        (by simp [hL0])
    have e3 : ∀ᶠ ξ in nhds ξ0, ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊2 - L0⌋₊ + 1),
        |chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 := by
      rw [Filter.eventually_all_finset]
      intro n _
      exact (hch _ _ (hcR n)).and ((hch _ _ (hcZ n)).and (hch _ _ (hcT n)))
    refine ⟨{ξ | ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ |Real.logb 2 (qC h ξ) - L0| < 1 ∧
        ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊2 - L0⌋₊ + 1),
        |chartR h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartR h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartZ h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartZ h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1 ∧
        |chartT h n ξ / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ) - chartT h n ξ0 / Sb n ^ (-3:ℤ)| < 1}, ?_,
      hfin.toFinset, ?_⟩
    · filter_upwards [e1, e2, e3] with ξ h1 h2 h3
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    rintro ⟨n, ⟨a, b, c⟩, σ⟩ ξ ⟨ht, hL, hC⟩ hγ
    obtain ⟨w0, wR, wZ, wT⟩ := hwin ξ _ ht hγ
    simp only at w0 wR wZ wT
    rw [abs_le] at w0
    rw [abs_lt] at hL
    have hn : n ≤ ⌊2 - L0⌋₊ := Nat.le_floor (by linarith [w0.2, hL.1])
    obtain ⟨cR, cZ, cT⟩ := hC n (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn))
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨n, hn, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨rfl, ⟨hI _ _ _ wR cR, hI _ _ _ wZ cZ, hI _ _ _ wT cT⟩, trivial⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN, Γ, hΓ⟩ := hEta B.h hok.1 (ptOf x t (Yph B.h (rad x) t + Y₀)) hxt'.2.1
  
  have hoff : ∀ η ∈ N, η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), γ ∉ Γ → a γ m η = 0 := by
    intro η hηN hηD γ m hγ
    by_contra hne
    exact hγ (hΓ γ η hηN (ha.2.2.2.1 γ m η hηD hne).2.1)
  
  have hsum : ∀ (Γ' : Finset Lab) (F : Lab → ℤ → ℂ), (∀ γ m, (γ ∉ Γ' ∨ m ∉ H) → F γ m = 0) →
      ∑ᶠ γ : Lab, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, F γ m = ∑ γ ∈ Γ', ∑ m ∈ H, F γ m := by
    intro Γ' F hF
    have hin : ∀ γ, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, F γ m = ∑ m ∈ H, F γ m := by
      intro γ
      apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
      intro m hm
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hm
      by_contra h
      exact hm (hF γ m (Or.inr (by simpa using h)))
    simp_rw [hin]
    apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
    intro γ hγ
    rw [Function.mem_support] at hγ
    by_contra h
    exact hγ (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun m _ => hF γ m (Or.inl (by simpa using h))))
  have hphase : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (θ : ℝ) (η : Cyl), ephase5 B G γ m θ η =
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (phiL5 B G γ η : ℂ))) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (θ : ℂ)) := by
    intro γ m θ η
    simp only [ephase5]
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have hcyl_sum : ∀ (y : ℝ³) {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      cyl2cart y (∑ j ∈ s, v j) = ∑ j ∈ s, cyl2cart y (v j) := by
    intro y ι s v
    let L : (Fin 3 → ℝ) →+ ℝ³ := AddMonoidHom.mk' (cyl2cart y) (fun c d => by
      simp only [cyl2cart, Pi.add_apply, add_smul]; abel)
    exact map_sum L v s
  
  have hexpand : ∀ (y : ℝ³) (Γ' : Finset Lab),
      (∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), (γ ∉ Γ' ∨ m ∉ H) → a γ m (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀)) = 0) →
      cyl2cart y (fun i => qC B.h (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀)) ^ (-Aex B.h) *
          waveV5 B G a (thetaOf y) (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀)) i) =
        ∑ γ ∈ Γ', ∑ m ∈ H, modeF5 B.h 0 t Y₀ (m * pint5 B G γ) (modeCoef5 B G (pchAmp5 B a) γ m) y := by
    intro y Γ' hz
    have hF : ∀ (n : ℤ) (c : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), modeF5 B.h 0 t Y₀ n c y =
        cyl2cart y (fun i => (c (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀)) i *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re) := by
      intro n c
      simp only [modeF5, Real.rpow_zero, one_smul]
    trans cyl2cart y (∑ γ ∈ Γ', ∑ m ∈ H, fun i =>
      (modeCoef5 B G (pchAmp5 B a) γ m (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀)) i *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((m * pint5 B G γ : ℤ) : ℂ) * (thetaOf y : ℂ))).re)
    · congr 1
      funext i
      simp only [waveV5, Finset.sum_apply]
      rw [hsum Γ' (fun γ m => a γ m (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀)) i *
          ephase5 B G γ m (thetaOf y) (ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀)))
        (fun γ m h => by simp only [hz γ m h, Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul]),
        ← Complex.re_ofReal_mul, Finset.mul_sum, Complex.re_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, Complex.re_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
      rw [hphase]
      simp only [modeCoef5, pchAmp5, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      congr 1
      ring
    · rw [hcyl_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
      rw [hcyl_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
      exact (hF _ _).symm
  
  have hradc : Continuous rad := by
    unfold rad
    fun_prop
  have hOopen : IsOpen {y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t ∧
      ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀) ∈ interior N} := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro y0 hy0
    have h1 : 0 < rad y0 := hy0.1.1
    have h2 : t < 1 := hy0.1.2.1
    have h3 : simScale B.h (y0 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 := hy0.1.2.2
    have h4 : ptOf y0 t (Yph B.h (rad y0) t + Y₀) ∈ interior N := hy0.2
    have e1 : ∀ᶠ y in nhds y0, (0:ℝ) < rad y :=
      continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hradc.continuousAt h1
    have hmem2 : ((y0 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ (univ ×ˢ Ioi (0:ℝ)) :=
      ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - t by linarith⟩
    have hc1 : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t)) y0 := by
      have h1' : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (y0 2, 1 - t) :=
        (hok.1.2.2.2.1.contDiffAt ((isOpen_univ.prod isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds hmem2)).continuousAt
      have h2' : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => ((y 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ)) y0 := by fun_prop
      exact ContinuousAt.comp (x := y0) (g := fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2)
        (f := fun y : ℝ³ => ((y 2, 1 - t) : ℝ × ℝ)) h1' h2'
    have e3 : ∀ᶠ y in nhds y0, simScale B.h (y 2) (1 - t) < qsOf l0 :=
      hc1.eventually_lt continuousAt_const h3
    have hPc : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀)) y0 := by
      have hr1 : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => rad y ^ drx B.h) y0 :=
        hradc.continuousAt.rpow_const (Or.inl h1.ne')
      have h4' : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀) y0 :=
        ((hr1.smul continuousAt_const).add continuousAt_const).add continuousAt_const
      have h2'' : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ³ => y 2) y0 := by fun_prop
      exact hradc.continuousAt.prodMk (h2''.prodMk (continuousAt_const.prodMk h4'))
    have e4 : ∀ᶠ y in nhds y0, ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀) ∈ interior N :=
      hPc.preimage_mem_nhds (isOpen_interior.mem_nhds h4)
    filter_upwards [e1, e3, e4] with y a1 a3 a4
    exact ⟨⟨a1, h2, a3⟩, a4⟩
  refine ⟨{y : ℝ³ | corrOn B l0 y t ∧ ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀) ∈ interior N},
    Γ, hOopen, ⟨hc, mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr hN⟩, fun y hy => hy.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro γ hγ m
    filter_upwards [hN, hDopen.mem_nhds hξ0D] with η hηN hηD
    exact hoff η hηN hηD γ m hγ
  · intro Γ' hΓ' y hy
    have hc' : corrOn B l0 y t := hy.1
    have hi : ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀) ∈ interior N := hy.2
    have hyD : ptOf y t (Yph B.h (rad y) t + Y₀) ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) := hc'
    refine hexpand y Γ' (fun γ m h => ?_)
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact hoff _ (interior_subset hi) hyD γ m (fun hg => h (hΓ' hg))
    · rw [hH γ m h]
      rfl

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (ξ : Cyl) (θ : ℝ) (Mv : Fin 3 → ℝ) (A Bw : WC) (Γ : Finset Lab) (HA HB HN : Finset ℤ), (∀ γ m, m ∉ HA → A γ m ξ = 0) → (∀ γ n, n ∉ HB → Bw γ n =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0) → (∀ (γ γ' : Lab) (m n : ℤ), γ ≠ γ' → A γ' m ξ ≠ 0 → Bw γ n =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0) → (∀ n ∈ HB, n ∈ HN) → (∀ n ∈ HB, ∀ m ∈ HA, n + m ∈ HN ∧ n - m ∈ HN) → ∀ i : Fin 3, ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ n ∈ HB, pchTr5 B G γ n (fun j => ((Mv j + (∑ γ' ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ HA, A γ' m ξ j * ephase5 B G γ' m θ ξ).re : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Bw γ n) ξ i * ephase5 B G γ n θ ξ = ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ N ∈ HN, (pchTr5 B G γ N (fun j => ((Mv j : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Bw γ N) ξ i + pchPair5 B G A Bw N γ ξ i) * ephase5 B G γ N θ ξ

signature.name: pch5_pair_regroup
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (ξ : Cyl) (θ : ℝ) (Mv : Fin 3 → ℝ) (A Bw : WC) (Γ : Finset Lab) (HA HB HN : Finset ℤ), (∀ γ m, m ∉ HA → A γ m ξ = 0) → (∀ γ n, n ∉ HB → Bw γ n =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0) → (∀ (γ γ' : Lab) (m n : ℤ), γ ≠ γ' → A γ' m ξ ≠ 0 → Bw γ n =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0) → (∀ n ∈ HB, n ∈ HN) → (∀ n ∈ HB, ∀ m ∈ HA, n + m ∈ HN ∧ n - m ∈ HN) → ∀ i : Fin 3, ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ n ∈ HB, pchTr5 B G γ n (fun j => ((Mv j + (∑ γ' ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ HA, A γ' m ξ j * ephase5 B G γ' m θ ξ).re : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Bw γ n) ξ i * ephase5 B G γ n θ ξ = ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ N ∈ HN, (pchTr5 B G γ N (fun j => ((Mv j : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Bw γ N) ξ i + pchPair5 B G A Bw N γ ξ i) * ephase5 B G γ N θ ξ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G ξ θ Mv A Bw Γ HA HB HN H1 H2 H3 H4 H5 i
  
  have hZ : ∀ (γ : Lab) (k : ℤ) (al : Fin 3 → ℂ) (bt : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ),
      (al = 0 ∨ bt =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0) → pchTr5 B G γ k al bt ξ = 0 := by
    intro γ k al bt h
    rcases h with h | h
    · subst h
      funext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [pchTr5]
    · have h0 : bt ξ = 0 := h.eq_of_nhds
      have hd : fderiv ℝ bt ξ = 0 := by
        rw [h.fderiv_eq]
        exact congrFun fderiv_zero ξ
      have hr : dR B.h bt ξ = 0 := by simp only [dR, hd, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
      have hz : dZ bt ξ = 0 := by simp only [dZ, hd, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
      funext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [pchTr5, h0, hr, hz]
  
  have hadd : ∀ (γ : Lab) (k : ℤ) (bt : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ) (u v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
      pchTr5 B G γ k (u + v) bt ξ = pchTr5 B G γ k u bt ξ + pchTr5 B G γ k v bt ξ := by
    intro γ k bt u v
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [pchTr5] <;> ring
  have hsmul : ∀ (γ : Lab) (k : ℤ) (bt : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (u : Fin 3 → ℂ),
      pchTr5 B G γ k (c • u) bt ξ = c • pchTr5 B G γ k u bt ξ := by
    intro γ k bt c u
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [pchTr5] <;> ring
  have hsum : ∀ {ι : Type} (γ : Lab) (k : ℤ) (bt : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ) (s : Finset ι)
      (f : ι → Fin 3 → ℂ), pchTr5 B G γ k (∑ x ∈ s, f x) bt ξ = ∑ x ∈ s, pchTr5 B G γ k (f x) bt ξ := by
    intro ι γ k bt s f
    classical
    refine Finset.induction_on s ?_ ?_
    · rw [Finset.sum_empty, Finset.sum_empty]
      exact hZ γ k 0 bt (Or.inl rfl)
    · intro a s ha ih
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, hadd, ih]
  
  have hph : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m n : ℤ), ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ * ephase5 B G γ n θ ξ = ephase5 B G γ (n + m) θ ξ ∧
      star (ephase5 B G γ m θ ξ) * ephase5 B G γ n θ ξ = ephase5 B G γ (n - m) θ ξ := by
    intro γ m n
    have e : ∀ k : ℤ, ephase5 B G γ k θ ξ = Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k : ℂ) *
        (((pint5 B G γ : ℝ) * θ + (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * phiL5 B G γ ξ : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
      intro k
      simp only [ephase5, Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_intCast,
        Complex.ofReal_natCast]
    simp only [e]
    constructor
    · rw [← Complex.exp_add]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    · rw [← starRingEnd_apply, ← Complex.exp_conj, ← Complex.exp_add]
      congr 1
      simp only [map_mul, Complex.conj_I, map_intCast, Complex.conj_ofReal]
      push_cast
      ring
  
  have hA : (fun j => ((Mv j + (∑ γ' ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ HA, A γ' m ξ j * ephase5 B G γ' m θ ξ).re : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
      (fun j => ((Mv j : ℝ) : ℂ)) + ∑ γ' ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ HA,
        (((1/2 : ℂ) * ephase5 B G γ' m θ ξ) • A γ' m ξ +
          ((1/2 : ℂ) * star (ephase5 B G γ' m θ ξ)) • (fun j => star (A γ' m ξ j))) := by
    funext j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.re_eq_add_conj]
    congr 1
    simp only [map_sum, map_mul, starRingEnd_apply, star_sum, star_mul']
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ' _ => ?_)
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
    ring
  
  have hshift : ∀ (d : ℤ) (F : ℤ → ℤ → ℂ), (∀ n ∈ HB, n + d ∈ HN) →
      (∀ N ∈ HN, N - d ∉ HB → F (N - d) N = 0) →
      ∑ N ∈ HN, F (N - d) N = ∑ n ∈ HB, F n (n + d) := by
    intro d F h1 h2
    have himg : HB.image (fun x => x + d) ⊆ HN := by
      intro N hN
      rw [Finset.mem_image] at hN
      obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := hN
      exact h1 n hn
    have hz : ∀ N ∈ HN, N ∉ HB.image (fun x => x + d) → F (N - d) N = 0 := by
      intro N hN hN'
      apply h2 N hN
      intro hc
      apply hN'
      rw [Finset.mem_image]
      exact ⟨N - d, hc, sub_add_cancel N d⟩
    have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun x => x + d) (HB : Set ℤ) := by
      intro x _ y _ hxy
      simpa using hxy
    rw [← Finset.sum_subset himg hz, Finset.sum_image hinj]
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_right]
  have hsub : HB ⊆ HN := by
    intro n hn
    exact H4 n hn
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ hγ => ?_)
  
  have hB : ∀ n : ℤ, pchTr5 B G γ n (fun j => ((Mv j + (∑ γ' ∈ Γ, ∑ m ∈ HA, A γ' m ξ j * ephase5 B G γ' m θ ξ).re : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Bw γ n) ξ i * ephase5 B G γ n θ ξ =
      pchTr5 B G γ n (fun j => ((Mv j : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Bw γ n) ξ i * ephase5 B G γ n θ ξ +
      ∑ m ∈ HA, ((1/2 : ℂ) * pchTr5 B G γ n (A γ m ξ) (Bw γ n) ξ i * ephase5 B G γ (n + m) θ ξ +
        (1/2 : ℂ) * pchTr5 B G γ n (fun j => star (A γ m ξ j)) (Bw γ n) ξ i * ephase5 B G γ (n - m) θ ξ) := by
    intro n
    rw [hA, hadd, hsum, Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem γ hγ]
    · rw [hsum]
      simp only [hadd, hsmul, Pi.add_apply, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, add_mul,
        Finset.sum_mul]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
      rw [← (hph γ m n).1, ← (hph γ m n).2]
      ring
    · intro γ' _ hne
      beta_reduce
      rw [hsum]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun m _ => ?_)
      rw [hadd, hsmul, hsmul]
      by_cases ha : A γ' m ξ = 0
      · have hab : (fun j => star (A γ' m ξ j)) = 0 := by
          funext j
          simp [ha]
        rw [hZ γ n _ _ (Or.inl ha), hZ γ n _ _ (Or.inl hab)]
        simp
      · have hb := H3 γ γ' m n (Ne.symm hne) ha
        rw [hZ γ n _ _ (Or.inr hb), hZ γ n _ _ (Or.inr hb)]
        simp
  
  have hP : ∀ N : ℤ, pchPair5 B G A Bw N γ ξ i = ∑ m ∈ HA,
      ((1/2 : ℂ) * pchTr5 B G γ (N - m) (A γ m ξ) (Bw γ (N - m)) ξ i +
        (1/2 : ℂ) * pchTr5 B G γ (N + m) (fun j => star (A γ m ξ j)) (Bw γ (N + m)) ξ i) := by
    intro N
    unfold pchPair5
    rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset (s := HA) _ ?_]
    · simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    · intro m hm
      simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq] at hm
      rw [Finset.mem_coe]
      by_contra hn
      apply hm
      have h0 : A γ m ξ = 0 := H1 γ m hn
      have h0' : (fun j => star (A γ m ξ j)) = 0 := by
        funext j
        simp [h0]
      rw [h0', hZ _ _ _ _ (Or.inl h0), hZ _ _ _ _ (Or.inl rfl)]
      simp
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => hB n)]
  simp only [hP, add_mul, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  · 
    refine Finset.sum_subset hsub (fun N _ hN => ?_)
    beta_reduce
    rw [hZ γ _ _ _ (Or.inr (H2 γ N hN))]
    simp
  · congr 1
    · rw [Finset.sum_comm (s := HB), Finset.sum_comm (s := HN)]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m hm => ?_)
      refine (hshift m (fun k N => (1/2 : ℂ) * pchTr5 B G γ k (A γ m ξ) (Bw γ k) ξ i *
        ephase5 B G γ N θ ξ) (fun n hn => (H5 n hn m hm).1) (fun N _ hN => ?_)).symm
      beta_reduce
      rw [hZ γ _ _ _ (Or.inr (H2 γ _ hN))]
      simp
    · rw [Finset.sum_comm (s := HB), Finset.sum_comm (s := HN)]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m hm => ?_)
      have h1 : ∀ n ∈ HB, n + -m ∈ HN := by
        intro n hn
        rw [← sub_eq_add_neg]
        exact (H5 n hn m hm).2
      have h2 : ∀ N ∈ HN, N - -m ∉ HB → (fun k N => (1/2 : ℂ) *
          pchTr5 B G γ k (fun j => star (A γ m ξ j)) (Bw γ k) ξ i * ephase5 B G γ N θ ξ) (N - -m) N = 0 := by
        intro N _ hN
        beta_reduce
        rw [hZ γ _ _ _ (Or.inr (H2 γ _ hN))]
        simp
      have := hshift (-m) (fun k N => (1/2 : ℂ) *
          pchTr5 B G γ k (fun j => star (A γ m ξ j)) (Bw γ k) ξ i * ephase5 B G γ N θ ξ) h1 h2
      simp only [sub_neg_eq_add, ← sub_eq_add_neg] at this
      exact this.symm

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (Mn : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℝ) (Bw : WC) (ξ : Cyl) (θ : ℝ) (Γ : Finset Lab) (H : Finset ℤ), DifferentiableAt ℝ Mn ξ → ∀ i : Fin 3, (pq5TrM B.h 0 (fun j => (((∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ n ∈ H, Bw γ n ξ j * ephase5 B G γ n θ ξ).re : ℝ) : ℂ)) (pchMnC5 Mn) ξ i).re = (∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ n ∈ H, pchTr5 B G γ 0 (Bw γ n ξ) (pchMnC5 Mn) ξ i * ephase5 B G γ n θ ξ).re

signature.name: pch5_mean_regroup
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (Mn : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℝ) (Bw : WC) (ξ : Cyl) (θ : ℝ) (Γ : Finset Lab) (H : Finset ℤ), DifferentiableAt ℝ Mn ξ → ∀ i : Fin 3, (pq5TrM B.h 0 (fun j => (((∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ n ∈ H, Bw γ n ξ j * ephase5 B G γ n θ ξ).re : ℝ) : ℂ)) (pchMnC5 Mn) ξ i).re = (∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ n ∈ H, pchTr5 B G γ 0 (Bw γ n ξ) (pchMnC5 Mn) ξ i * ephase5 B G γ n θ ξ).re

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G Mn Bw ξ θ Γ H hMn i
  let Lc : (Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ) :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun j : Fin 3 => Complex.ofRealCLM.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j))
  have hLc : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, Lc v = fun j => ((v j : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro v; funext j; simp [Lc]
  have hfun : pchMnC5 Mn = ⇑Lc ∘ Mn := by
    funext η j; simp [pchMnC5, Lc]
  have hder : ∀ v : Cyl, fderiv ℝ (pchMnC5 Mn) ξ v = Lc (fderiv ℝ Mn ξ v) := by
    intro v
    rw [hfun, fderiv_comp ξ Lc.differentiableAt hMn, ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    rfl
  have hdR : ∀ j, dR B.h (pchMnC5 Mn) ξ j = ((dR B.h Mn ξ j : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro j; unfold dR; rw [hder, hLc]
  have hdZ : ∀ j, dZ (pchMnC5 Mn) ξ j = ((dZ Mn ξ j : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro j; unfold dZ; rw [hder, hLc]
  have hrowPQ : ∀ U : Fin 3 → ℂ, pq5TrM B.h 0 U (pchMnC5 Mn) ξ i =
      U 0 * ((dR B.h Mn ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ) +
        U 1 * (((![-(Mn ξ 1) / ξ.1, Mn ξ 0 / ξ.1, 0] : Fin 3 → ℝ) i : ℝ) : ℂ) +
        U 2 * ((dZ Mn ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro U
    fin_cases i <;> simp [pq5TrM, hdR, hdZ, pchMnC5] <;> ring
  have hrowTr : ∀ (γ : Lab) (al : Fin 3 → ℂ), pchTr5 B G γ 0 al (pchMnC5 Mn) ξ i =
      al 0 * ((dR B.h Mn ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ) +
        al 1 * (((![-(Mn ξ 1) / ξ.1, Mn ξ 0 / ξ.1, 0] : Fin 3 → ℝ) i : ℝ) : ℂ) +
        al 2 * ((dZ Mn ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro γ al
    fin_cases i <;> simp [pchTr5, hdR, hdZ, pchMnC5] <;> ring
  rw [hrowPQ]
  have hsum : ∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ n ∈ H, pchTr5 B G γ 0 (Bw γ n ξ) (pchMnC5 Mn) ξ i * ephase5 B G γ n θ ξ =
      (∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ n ∈ H, Bw γ n ξ 0 * ephase5 B G γ n θ ξ) * ((dR B.h Mn ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ) +
        (∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ n ∈ H, Bw γ n ξ 1 * ephase5 B G γ n θ ξ) *
          (((![-(Mn ξ 1) / ξ.1, Mn ξ 0 / ξ.1, 0] : Fin 3 → ℝ) i : ℝ) : ℂ) +
        (∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ n ∈ H, Bw γ n ξ 2 * ephase5 B G γ n θ ξ) * ((dZ Mn ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    simp only [hrowTr, Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => by ring))
  rw [hsum]
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.re_mul_ofReal, Complex.ofReal_re]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (Mn : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℝ) (P Q : WC) (ξ : Cyl) (θ : ℝ) (Γ : Finset Lab) (HP HQ HN : Finset ℤ), 0 < qC B.h ξ → (∀ γ m, m ∉ HP → P γ m = 0) → (∀ γ m, m ∉ HQ → Q γ m = 0) → (∀ γ, γ ∉ Γ → ∀ m, P γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 ∧ Q γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0) → (∀ n ∈ HQ, n ∈ HN) → (∀ n ∈ HQ, ∀ m ∈ HP, n + m ∈ HN ∧ n - m ∈ HN) → (∀ n ∈ HP, ∀ m ∈ HQ, n + m ∈ HN ∧ n - m ∈ HN) → ∀ i : Fin 3, (∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ N ∈ HN, pchHar5 B G Mn P Q γ N ξ i * ephase5 B G γ N θ ξ).re = qC B.h ξ ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) * waveV5 B G (pchG5 B G Mn P Q) θ ξ i + pchZ5 B G Mn P Q ξ i

signature.name: pch5_har_assemble
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (Mn : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℝ) (P Q : WC) (ξ : Cyl) (θ : ℝ) (Γ : Finset Lab) (HP HQ HN : Finset ℤ), 0 < qC B.h ξ → (∀ γ m, m ∉ HP → P γ m = 0) → (∀ γ m, m ∉ HQ → Q γ m = 0) → (∀ γ, γ ∉ Γ → ∀ m, P γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 ∧ Q γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0) → (∀ n ∈ HQ, n ∈ HN) → (∀ n ∈ HQ, ∀ m ∈ HP, n + m ∈ HN ∧ n - m ∈ HN) → (∀ n ∈ HP, ∀ m ∈ HQ, n + m ∈ HN ∧ n - m ∈ HN) → ∀ i : Fin 3, (∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ N ∈ HN, pchHar5 B G Mn P Q γ N ξ i * ephase5 B G γ N θ ξ).re = qC B.h ξ ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) * waveV5 B G (pchG5 B G Mn P Q) θ ξ i + pchZ5 B G Mn P Q ξ i

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G Mn P Q ξ θ Γ HP HQ HN hq hP hQ hΓ h1 h2 h3 i
  
  have tr0 : ∀ (γ : Lab) (k : ℤ) (al : Fin 3 → ℂ) (bt : Cyl → Fin 3 → ℂ),
      (al = 0 ∨ bt =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0) → pchTr5 B G γ k al bt ξ = 0 := by
    intro γ k al bt h
    rcases h with h | h
    · subst h
      funext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [pchTr5]
    · have hv : bt ξ = 0 := h.eq_of_nhds
      have hd : fderiv ℝ bt ξ = 0 := by
        rw [h.fderiv_eq]
        first
          | simp
          | exact fderiv_const_apply 0
      have hR : dR B.h bt ξ = 0 := by simp [dR, hd]
      have hZ : dZ bt ξ = 0 := by simp [dZ, hd]
      funext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [pchTr5, hv, hR, hZ]
  
  have pair0 : ∀ (A Bw : WC) (N : ℤ) (γ : Lab),
      (∀ m : ℤ, A γ m ξ = 0 ∨ (Bw γ (N - m) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 ∧ Bw γ (N + m) =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0)) →
      pchPair5 B G A Bw N γ ξ = 0 := by
    intro A Bw N γ h
    unfold pchPair5
    apply finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
    intro m
    rcases h m with hm | ⟨ha, hb⟩
    · have hs : (fun j => star (A γ m ξ j)) = 0 := by
        funext j; simp [hm]
      rw [tr0 γ (N - m) (A γ m ξ) (Bw γ (N - m)) (Or.inl hm),
        tr0 γ (N + m) (fun j => star (A γ m ξ j)) (Bw γ (N + m)) (Or.inl hs)]
      simp
    · rw [tr0 γ (N - m) (A γ m ξ) (Bw γ (N - m)) (Or.inr ha),
        tr0 γ (N + m) (fun j => star (A γ m ξ j)) (Bw γ (N + m)) (Or.inr hb)]
      simp
  
  have amp1 : ∀ (W : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), W γ m = 0 → pchAmp5 B W γ m = 0 := by
    intro W γ m h; funext η; simp [pchAmp5, h]
  have amp1e : ∀ (W : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), W γ m = 0 → pchAmp5 B W γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 :=
    fun W γ m h => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun η => congrFun (amp1 W γ m h) η)
  have amp1v : ∀ (W : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), W γ m = 0 → pchAmp5 B W γ m ξ = 0 :=
    fun W γ m h => congrFun (amp1 W γ m h) ξ
  have amp2 : ∀ (W : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), W γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 → pchAmp5 B W γ m =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 := by
    intro W γ m h
    filter_upwards [h] with η hη
    simp [pchAmp5, hη]
  
  have hV : ∀ (γ : Lab) (N : ℤ), (γ ∉ Γ ∨ N ∉ HN) → pchHar5 B G Mn P Q γ N ξ = 0 := by
    intro γ N hγN
    have key : pchAmp5 B Q γ N =ᶠ[nhds ξ] 0 ∧
        pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B P) (pchAmp5 B Q) N γ ξ = 0 ∧
        pchPair5 B G (pchAmp5 B Q) (pchAmp5 B P) N γ ξ = 0 := by
      rcases hγN with hγ | hN
      · refine ⟨amp2 Q γ N (hΓ γ hγ N).2, pair0 _ _ N γ (fun m => Or.inl ?_),
          pair0 _ _ N γ (fun m => Or.inl ?_)⟩
        · exact (amp2 P γ m (hΓ γ hγ m).1).eq_of_nhds
        · exact (amp2 Q γ m (hΓ γ hγ m).2).eq_of_nhds
      · have hNQ : N ∉ HQ := fun h => hN (h1 N h)
        refine ⟨amp1e Q γ N (hQ γ N hNQ), pair0 _ _ N γ (fun m => ?_), pair0 _ _ N γ (fun m => ?_)⟩
        · by_cases hm : m ∈ HP
          · right
            have a1 : N - m ∉ HQ := fun h => hN (by simpa using (h2 (N - m) h m hm).1)
            have a2 : N + m ∉ HQ := fun h => hN (by simpa using (h2 (N + m) h m hm).2)
            exact ⟨amp1e Q γ _ (hQ γ _ a1), amp1e Q γ _ (hQ γ _ a2)⟩
          · left
            exact amp1v P γ m (hP γ m hm)
        · by_cases hm : m ∈ HQ
          · right
            have a1 : N - m ∉ HP := fun h => hN (by simpa using (h3 (N - m) h m hm).1)
            have a2 : N + m ∉ HP := fun h => hN (by simpa using (h3 (N + m) h m hm).2)
            exact ⟨amp1e P γ _ (hP γ _ a1), amp1e P γ _ (hP γ _ a2)⟩
          · left
            exact amp1v Q γ m (hQ γ m hm)
    obtain ⟨k1, k2, k3⟩ := key
    unfold pchHar5
    rw [tr0 γ N (pchMnC5 Mn ξ) (pchAmp5 B Q γ N) (Or.inr k1),
      tr0 γ 0 (pchAmp5 B Q γ N ξ) (pchMnC5 Mn) (Or.inl k1.eq_of_nhds), k2, k3]
    simp
  
  have hG : ∀ (γ : Lab) (N : ℤ), pchG5 B G Mn P Q γ N ξ i =
      if N = 0 then 0 else ((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * pchHar5 B G Mn P Q γ N ξ i := by
    intro γ N
    simp only [pchG5]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have hW : waveV5 B G (pchG5 B G Mn P Q) θ ξ i =
      (∑ γ ∈ Γ, ∑ N ∈ HN, pchG5 B G Mn P Q γ N ξ i * ephase5 B G γ N θ ξ).re := by
    simp only [waveV5]
    congr 1
    have hin : ∀ γ, ∑ᶠ N : ℤ, pchG5 B G Mn P Q γ N ξ i * ephase5 B G γ N θ ξ =
        ∑ N ∈ HN, pchG5 B G Mn P Q γ N ξ i * ephase5 B G γ N θ ξ := by
      intro γ
      apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
      intro N hN
      by_contra hNH
      apply hN
      beta_reduce
      rw [hG, hV γ N (Or.inr (fun h => hNH (Finset.mem_coe.mpr h)))]
      simp
    simp only [hin]
    apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
    intro γ hγ
    by_contra hγΓ
    apply hγ
    beta_reduce
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro N _
    rw [hG, hV γ N (Or.inl (fun h => hγΓ (Finset.mem_coe.mpr h)))]
    simp
  have hZ : pchZ5 B G Mn P Q ξ i = (∑ γ ∈ Γ, pchHar5 B G Mn P Q γ 0 ξ i).re := by
    simp only [pchZ5]
    congr 1
    apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
    intro γ hγ
    by_contra hγΓ
    apply hγ
    simp [hV γ 0 (Or.inl (fun h => hγΓ (Finset.mem_coe.mpr h)))]
  have hce : qC B.h ξ ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) * qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) = 1 := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hq.le]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq _))
  have hce' : ((qC B.h ξ ^ (-(2 * Aex B.h + 1/2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((qC B.h ξ ^ (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) = 1 := by
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, hce, Complex.ofReal_one]
  have hsplitN : ∀ γ, ∑ N ∈ HN, pchHar5 B G Mn P Q γ N ξ i * ephase5 B G γ N θ ξ =
      ∑ N ∈ HN, (if N = 0 then 0 else pchHar5 B G Mn P Q γ N ξ i) * ephase5 B G γ N θ ξ +
      pchHar5 B G Mn P Q γ 0 ξ i := by
    intro γ
    have e1 : ∀ N : ℤ, pchHar5 B G Mn P Q γ N ξ i * ephase5 B G γ N θ ξ =
        (if N = 0 then 0 else pchHar5 B G Mn P Q γ N ξ i) * ephase5 B G γ N θ ξ +
        (if N = 0 then pchHar5 B G Mn P Q γ N ξ i * ephase5 B G γ N θ ξ else 0) := by
      intro N; split_ifs <;> simp
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun N _ => e1 N), Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    congr 1
    simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq']
    split_ifs with h0
    · simp [ephase5]
    · simp [hV γ 0 (Or.inr h0)]
  rw [hW, hZ, ← Complex.re_ofReal_mul, Finset.mul_sum,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => hsplitN γ), Finset.sum_add_distrib, Complex.add_re]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun γ _ => ?_)
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun N _ => ?_)
  rw [hG]
  split_ifs
  · simp
  · linear_combination (-(pchHar5 B G Mn P Q γ N ξ i * ephase5 B G γ N θ ξ)) * hce'

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (P E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P] [FiniteDimensional ℝ P] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (U : Set P) (A : P × ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (b : P × ℝ → E) (z : P → ℝ → E), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 A (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 b (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → (∀ s ∈ U, z s 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (z s) (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v)) v) → ∀ s0 ∈ U, ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∃ r > 0, ∃ C : ℝ, Metric.ball s0 r ⊆ U ∧ ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball s0 r, ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖z s v - z s0 v‖ ≤ C * ‖s - s0‖

signature.name: linear_ode_param_lip
signature.statement: ∀ (P E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P] [FiniteDimensional ℝ P] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (U : Set P) (A : P × ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (b : P × ℝ → E) (z : P → ℝ → E), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 A (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 b (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → (∀ s ∈ U, z s 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (z s) (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v)) v) → ∀ s0 ∈ U, ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∃ r > 0, ∃ C : ℝ, Metric.ball s0 r ⊆ U ∧ ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball s0 r, ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖z s v - z s0 v‖ ≤ C * ‖s - s0‖

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P E _ _ _ _ _ _ U A b z hU hA hb hz s0 hs0 T hT
  
  have gron : ∀ (g g' : ℝ → E) (K ε : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ ε → (∀ v, HasDerivAt g (g' v) v) → g 0 = 0 →
      (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖g' v‖ ≤ K * ‖g v‖ + ε) →
      ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) T, ‖g x‖ ≤ ε * T * Real.exp (K * T) := by
    intro g g' K ε hK hε hd h0 hbd x hx
    have h1 := norm_le_gronwallBound_of_norm_deriv_right_le (f := g) (f' := g') (δ := 0) (K := K)
      (ε := ε) (a := 0) (b := T)
      (fun t _ => (hd t).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
      (fun t _ => (hd t).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (by rw [h0, norm_zero])
      (fun t ht => hbd t ⟨by linarith [ht.1], ht.2.le⟩) x hx
    rw [sub_zero] at h1
    refine h1.trans ?_
    rcases hK.eq_or_lt with hK0 | hKpos
    · rw [← hK0, gronwallBound_K0]
      simp only [zero_add, zero_mul, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.2 hε
    · rw [gronwallBound_of_K_ne_0 hKpos.ne']
      simp only [zero_mul, zero_add]
      have hpos := Real.exp_pos (K * x)
      have e1 : Real.exp (K * x) * Real.exp (-(K * x)) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Real.exp_zero]
      have e2 := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(K * x))
      have key : Real.exp (K * x) - 1 ≤ K * x * Real.exp (K * x) := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e2 hpos.le]
      have hexp : Real.exp (K * x) ≤ Real.exp (K * T) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.2 hK)
      have h3 : K * x * Real.exp (K * x) ≤ K * T * Real.exp (K * T) :=
        mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.2 hK) hexp hpos.le
          (mul_nonneg hK (le_trans hx.1 hx.2))
      calc ε / K * (Real.exp (K * x) - 1) ≤ ε / K * (K * T * Real.exp (K * T)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (key.trans h3) (div_nonneg hε hK)
        _ = ε * T * Real.exp (K * T) := by
            rw [show K * T * Real.exp (K * T) = K * (T * Real.exp (K * T)) by ring, ← mul_assoc,
              div_mul_cancel₀ ε hKpos.ne']
            ring
  
  have gron2 : ∀ (g g' : ℝ → E) (K ε : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ ε → (∀ v, HasDerivAt g (g' v) v) → g 0 = 0 →
      (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖g' v‖ ≤ K * ‖g v‖ + ε) →
      ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖g v‖ ≤ ε * T * Real.exp (K * T) := by
    intro g g' K ε hK hε hd h0 hbd v hv
    rcases le_or_gt 0 v with hv0 | hv0
    · exact gron g g' K ε hK hε hd h0 hbd v ⟨hv0, hv.2⟩
    · have hd' : ∀ u, HasDerivAt (fun u => g (-u)) (-(g' (-u))) u := by
        intro u
        have h := (hd (-u)).scomp u (hasDerivAt_neg u)
        rw [neg_one_smul] at h
        exact h
      have h := gron (fun u => g (-u)) (fun u => -(g' (-u))) K ε hK hε hd' (by simp [h0])
        (fun u hu => by
          rw [norm_neg]
          exact hbd (-u) ⟨by linarith [hu.2], by linarith [hu.1]⟩) (-v)
        ⟨by linarith, by linarith [hv.1]⟩
      simpa using h
  
  obtain ⟨r', hr', hr'U⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU s0 hs0
  obtain ⟨r, hr_def⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = r' / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hr : 0 < r := by rw [hr_def]; positivity
  have hcU : Metric.closedBall s0 r ⊆ U :=
    (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by rw [hr_def]; linarith)).trans hr'U
  have hbU : Metric.ball s0 r ⊆ U := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hcU
  
  have tube : ∀ {G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (f : P × ℝ → G),
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ∃ K L : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ 0 ≤ L ∧
        ∀ s ∈ Metric.closedBall s0 r, ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T,
          ‖f (s, τ)‖ ≤ K ∧ ‖f (s, τ) - f (s0, τ)‖ ≤ L * ‖s - s0‖ := by
    intro G _ _ f hf
    have hO : IsOpen (U ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) := hU.prod isOpen_univ
    have hSc : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall s0 r ×ˢ Set.Icc (-T) T) :=
      (isCompact_closedBall s0 r).prod isCompact_Icc
    have hSO : Metric.closedBall s0 r ×ˢ Set.Icc (-T) T ⊆ U ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) :=
      fun p hp => ⟨hcU hp.1, Set.mem_univ _⟩
    obtain ⟨K₀, hK₀⟩ := hSc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hf.continuousOn.mono hSO)
    obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀⟩ := hSc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      ((hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO le_rfl).mono hSO)
    refine ⟨max K₀ 0, max L₀ 0, le_max_right _ _, le_max_right _ _, fun s hs τ hτ =>
      ⟨(hK₀ (s, τ) ⟨hs, hτ⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩⟩
    have hconv : Convex ℝ (Metric.closedBall s0 r ×ˢ Set.Icc (-T) T) :=
      (convex_closedBall s0 r).prod (convex_Icc _ _)
    have hder : ∀ p ∈ Metric.closedBall s0 r ×ˢ Set.Icc (-T) T,
        HasFDerivWithinAt f (fderiv ℝ f p) (Metric.closedBall s0 r ×ˢ Set.Icc (-T) T) p := by
      intro p hp
      exact ((hf.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt
        (hO.mem_nhds (hSO hp))).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt
    have hbd : ∀ p ∈ Metric.closedBall s0 r ×ˢ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖fderiv ℝ f p‖ ≤ max L₀ 0 :=
      fun p hp => (hL₀ p hp).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have h := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasFDerivWithin_le hder hbd hconv
      (x := (s0, τ)) (y := (s, τ)) ⟨Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr.le, hτ⟩ ⟨hs, hτ⟩
    have hn : ‖(s, τ) - (s0, τ)‖ = ‖s - s0‖ := by
      simp only [Prod.mk_sub_mk, sub_self, Prod.norm_def, norm_zero]
      exact max_eq_left (norm_nonneg _)
    rw [hn] at h
    exact h
  have hz0c : Continuous (z s0) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 (fun v => ((hz s0 hs0).2 v).continuousAt)
  obtain ⟨Z₁, hZ₁⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := -T) (b := T)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    hz0c.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨KA, LA, hKA, hLA, hAb⟩ := tube A hA
  obtain ⟨Kb, Lb, -, hLb, hbb⟩ := tube b hb
  refine ⟨r, hr, (LA * max Z₁ 0 + Lb) * T * Real.exp (KA * T), hbU, ?_⟩
  intro s hs v hv
  have hsU := hbU hs
  have hsc : s ∈ Metric.closedBall s0 r := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hs
  have hderiv : ∀ τ, HasDerivAt (fun τ => z s τ - z s0 τ)
      (A (s, τ) (z s τ - z s0 τ) + (A (s, τ) - A (s0, τ)) (z s0 τ) + (b (s, τ) - b (s0, τ))) τ := by
    intro τ
    have h := ((hz s hsU).2 τ).sub ((hz s0 hs0).2 τ)
    convert h using 1
    simp only [map_sub, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
    abel
  have h0 : (fun τ => z s τ - z s0 τ) 0 = 0 := by simp [(hz s hsU).1, (hz s0 hs0).1]
  have hε : 0 ≤ (LA * max Z₁ 0 + Lb) * ‖s - s0‖ :=
    mul_nonneg (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hLA (le_max_right _ _)) hLb) (norm_nonneg _)
  have hbound : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T,
      ‖A (s, τ) (z s τ - z s0 τ) + (A (s, τ) - A (s0, τ)) (z s0 τ) + (b (s, τ) - b (s0, τ))‖ ≤
        KA * ‖z s τ - z s0 τ‖ + (LA * max Z₁ 0 + Lb) * ‖s - s0‖ := by
    intro τ hτ
    obtain ⟨hA1, hA2⟩ := hAb s hsc τ hτ
    obtain ⟨-, hb2⟩ := hbb s hsc τ hτ
    have hz1 : ‖z s0 τ‖ ≤ max Z₁ 0 := (hZ₁ τ hτ).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have e1 : ‖A (s, τ) (z s τ - z s0 τ)‖ ≤ KA * ‖z s τ - z s0 τ‖ :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hA1 (norm_nonneg _))
    have e2 : ‖(A (s, τ) - A (s0, τ)) (z s0 τ)‖ ≤ (LA * ‖s - s0‖) * max Z₁ 0 :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _).trans
        (mul_le_mul hA2 hz1 (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hLA (norm_nonneg _)))
    calc _ ≤ ‖A (s, τ) (z s τ - z s0 τ)‖ + ‖(A (s, τ) - A (s0, τ)) (z s0 τ)‖ +
          ‖b (s, τ) - b (s0, τ)‖ :=
          (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) le_rfl)
      _ ≤ KA * ‖z s τ - z s0 τ‖ + (LA * ‖s - s0‖) * max Z₁ 0 + Lb * ‖s - s0‖ :=
          add_le_add (add_le_add e1 e2) hb2
      _ = _ := by ring
  have h := gron2 (fun τ => z s τ - z s0 τ) _ KA _ hKA hε hderiv h0 hbound v hv
  refine h.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (P E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P] [FiniteDimensional ℝ P] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (U : Set P) (A : P × ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (b : P × ℝ → E) (z : P → ℝ → E) (s0 : P) (W : ℝ → P →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 A (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 b (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → (∀ s ∈ U, z s 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (z s) (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v)) v) → s0 ∈ U → (∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∃ r > 0, ∃ C : ℝ, Metric.ball s0 r ⊆ U ∧ ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball s0 r, ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖z s v - z s0 v‖ ≤ C * ‖s - s0‖) → W 0 = 0 → (∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt W ((A (s0, v)).comp (W v) + (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ E (z s0 v)).comp ((fderiv ℝ A (s0, v)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)) + (fderiv ℝ b (s0, v)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)) v) → ∀ v : ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun s => z s v) (W v) s0

signature.name: linear_ode_param_fderiv
signature.statement: ∀ (P E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P] [FiniteDimensional ℝ P] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (U : Set P) (A : P × ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (b : P × ℝ → E) (z : P → ℝ → E) (s0 : P) (W : ℝ → P →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 A (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 b (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → (∀ s ∈ U, z s 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (z s) (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v)) v) → s0 ∈ U → (∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∃ r > 0, ∃ C : ℝ, Metric.ball s0 r ⊆ U ∧ ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball s0 r, ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖z s v - z s0 v‖ ≤ C * ‖s - s0‖) → W 0 = 0 → (∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt W ((A (s0, v)).comp (W v) + (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ E (z s0 v)).comp ((fderiv ℝ A (s0, v)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)) + (fderiv ℝ b (s0, v)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)) v) → ∀ v : ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun s => z s v) (W v) s0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P E _ _ _ _ _ _ U A b z s0 W hU hA hb hz hs0 hLip hW0 hW v
  
  have fwd : ∀ (r : ℝ → E) (B : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (g : ℝ → E) (K ε T : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ ε → 0 ≤ T →
      (∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt r (B v (r v) + g v) v) → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖B v‖ ≤ K ∧ ‖g v‖ ≤ ε) →
      ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) T, ‖r v‖ ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * T) * Real.exp (K * T) := by
    intro r B g K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v hv
    have hcont : ContinuousOn r (Set.Icc 0 T) := fun x _ => (hd x).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have h1 := norm_le_gronwallBound_of_norm_deriv_right_le (f := r) (f' := fun x => B x (r x) + g x)
      (δ := ‖r 0‖) (K := K) (ε := ε) (a := 0) (b := T) hcont
      (fun x _ => (hd x).hasDerivWithinAt) le_rfl
      (fun x hx => by
        obtain ⟨hB, hg⟩ := hbd x ⟨by linarith [hx.1], hx.2.le⟩
        calc ‖B x (r x) + g x‖ ≤ ‖B x (r x)‖ + ‖g x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ ‖B x‖ * ‖r x‖ + ‖g x‖ := add_le_add ((B x).le_opNorm _) le_rfl
          _ ≤ K * ‖r x‖ + ε := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB (norm_nonneg _)) hg)
      v hv
    rw [sub_zero] at h1
    refine h1.trans ?_
    have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := hv.1
    have hvT : v ≤ T := hv.2
    have hδ : 0 ≤ ‖r 0‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have key : gronwallBound ‖r 0‖ K ε v ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * v) * Real.exp (K * v) := by
      rcases hK.eq_or_lt with h | h
      · subst h
        rw [gronwallBound_K0]
        simp
      · rw [gronwallBound_of_K_ne_0 h.ne']
        have hp := Real.exp_pos (K * v)
        have e1 : Real.exp (K * v) * Real.exp (-(K * v)) = 1 := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
        have e2 := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(K * v))
        have e2' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e2 hp.le
        have e3 : Real.exp (K * v) - 1 ≤ K * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by
          nlinarith
        have hc : ε / K * K = ε := div_mul_cancel₀ ε h.ne'
        have e4 : ε / K * (Real.exp (K * v) - 1) ≤ ε * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by
          calc ε / K * (Real.exp (K * v) - 1) ≤ ε / K * (K * v * Real.exp (K * v)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e3 (div_nonneg hε h.le)
            _ = ε / K * K * (v * Real.exp (K * v)) := by ring
            _ = ε * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by rw [hc]; ring
        nlinarith
    refine key.trans ?_
    apply mul_le_mul
    · nlinarith
    · exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)
    · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
    · nlinarith
  
  have gron : ∀ (r : ℝ → E) (B : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (g : ℝ → E) (K ε T : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ ε → 0 ≤ T →
      (∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt r (B v (r v) + g v) v) → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖B v‖ ≤ K ∧ ‖g v‖ ≤ ε) →
      ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖r v‖ ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * T) * Real.exp (K * T) := by
    intro r B g K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v hv
    rcases le_or_gt 0 v with h0 | h0
    · exact fwd r B g K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v ⟨h0, hv.2⟩
    · have hd' : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun u => r (-u))
          ((fun u => -B (-u)) u ((fun u => r (-u)) u) + (fun u => -g (-u)) u) u := by
        intro u
        have h2 : HasDerivAt (r ∘ Neg.neg) ((-1:ℝ) • (B (-u) (r (-u)) + g (-u))) u :=
          (hd (-u)).scomp u (hasDerivAt_neg u)
        have h3 : (-1:ℝ) • (B (-u) (r (-u)) + g (-u)) = (-B (-u)) (r (-u)) + -g (-u) := by
          simp
        rw [h3] at h2
        exact h2
      have hbd' : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖(fun u => -B (-u)) u‖ ≤ K ∧ ‖(fun u => -g (-u)) u‖ ≤ ε := by
        intro u hu
        simp only [norm_neg]
        exact hbd (-u) ⟨by linarith [hu.2], by linarith [hu.1]⟩
      have := fwd (fun u => r (-u)) (fun u => -B (-u)) (fun u => -g (-u)) K ε T hK hε hT hd' hbd' (-v)
        ⟨by linarith, by linarith [hv.1]⟩
      simpa only [neg_neg, neg_zero] using this
  
  obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU s0 hs0
  obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ, T = |v| + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hTpos : 0 < T := by rw [hTdef]; positivity
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := hTpos.le
  have hvT : v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T := by
    have h2 := neg_abs_le v
    have h3 := le_abs_self v
    rw [hTdef]
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hρ : 0 < ρ₀ / 2 := by linarith
  have hcl : Metric.closedBall s0 (ρ₀ / 2) ⊆ U :=
    (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
  have hKc : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall s0 (ρ₀ / 2) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-T) T) :=
    (isCompact_closedBall s0 _).prod isCompact_Icc
  have hKsub : Metric.closedBall s0 (ρ₀ / 2) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-T) T ⊆ U ×ˢ Set.univ :=
    fun w hw => ⟨hcl hw.1, Set.mem_univ _⟩
  have hO : IsOpen (U ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) := hU.prod isOpen_univ
  have hmemK : ∀ (h : P) (t : ℝ), ‖h‖ ≤ ρ₀ / 2 → t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T →
      ((s0 + h, t) : P × ℝ) ∈ Metric.closedBall s0 (ρ₀ / 2) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-T) T := by
    intro h t hh ht
    refine ⟨?_, ht⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left]
    exact hh
  have hs0K : ∀ t : ℝ, t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T →
      ((s0, t) : P × ℝ) ∈ Metric.closedBall s0 (ρ₀ / 2) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-T) T :=
    fun t ht => ⟨Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ.le, ht⟩
  have hdistK : ∀ (h : P) (u : ℝ), dist ((s0 + h, u) : P × ℝ) (s0, u) = ‖h‖ := by
    intro h u
    rw [Prod.dist_eq]
    simp only [dist_self, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left]
    exact max_eq_left (norm_nonneg _)
  
  have c2 : ∀ (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (G : P × ℝ → F),
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
        ∀ (h : P) (t : ℝ), ‖h‖ < δ → t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T →
          ‖G (s0 + h, t) - G (s0, t)‖ ≤ C * ‖h‖ ∧
          ‖G (s0 + h, t) - G (s0, t) - ((fderiv ℝ G (s0, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)) h‖
            ≤ η * ‖h‖ := by
    intro F _ _ G hG
    have hdiff : ∀ w ∈ U ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), HasFDerivAt G (fderiv ℝ G w) w := fun w hw =>
      (((hG.differentiableOn one_ne_zero) w hw).differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds hw)).hasFDerivAt
    have hDc : ContinuousOn (fun w => (fderiv ℝ G w).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ))
        (U ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
      (hG.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO le_rfl).clm_comp continuousOn_const
    have hDK := hDc.mono hKsub
    obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hDK
    have huc := Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp (hKc.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hDK)
    have hslice : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : P), ‖x‖ ≤ ρ₀ / 2 → t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T →
        HasFDerivAt (fun x' : P => G (s0 + x', t))
          ((fderiv ℝ G (s0 + x, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)) x := by
      intro t x hx ht
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun x' : P => ((s0 + x', t) : P × ℝ))
          (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ) x :=
        ((hasFDerivAt_id x).const_add s0).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_const t x)
      exact (hdiff _ (hKsub (hmemK x t hx ht))).comp x h1
    refine ⟨max C₀ 0, le_max_right _ _, fun η hη => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨δu, hδu, hδu'⟩ := huc η hη
    refine ⟨min (ρ₀ / 2) δu, lt_min hρ hδu, fun h t hh ht => ?_⟩
    have hhρ : ‖h‖ < ρ₀ / 2 := hh.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
    have hhu : ‖h‖ < δu := hh.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
    have hball' : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : P) ‖h‖, ‖x‖ ≤ ‖h‖ := fun x hx => by
      rwa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hx
    have hderiv : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : P) ‖h‖,
        HasFDerivWithinAt (fun x' : P => G (s0 + x', t))
          ((fderiv ℝ G (s0 + x, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ))
          (Metric.closedBall 0 ‖h‖) x := fun x hx =>
      (hslice t x ((hball' x hx).trans hhρ.le) ht).hasFDerivWithinAt
    have h0mem : (0 : P) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : P) ‖h‖ :=
      Metric.mem_closedBall_self (norm_nonneg _)
    have hhmem : h ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : P) ‖h‖ := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    constructor
    · have hbound : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : P) ‖h‖,
          ‖(fderiv ℝ G (s0 + x, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)‖ ≤ max C₀ 0 :=
        fun x hx => (hC₀ _ (hmemK x t ((hball' x hx).trans hhρ.le) ht)).trans (le_max_left _ _)
      have := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasFDerivWithin_le hderiv hbound
        (convex_closedBall _ _) h0mem hhmem
      simpa only [add_zero, sub_zero] using this
    · have hbound : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : P) ‖h‖,
          ‖(fderiv ℝ G (s0 + x, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ) -
            (fderiv ℝ G (s0, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)‖ ≤ η := by
        intro x hx
        have hx1 := hball' x hx
        have hd : dist ((s0 + x, t) : P × ℝ) (s0, t) < δu := by
          rw [hdistK]; exact lt_of_le_of_lt hx1 hhu
        have := hδu' _ (hmemK x t (hx1.trans hhρ.le) ht) _ (hs0K t ht) hd
        rw [dist_eq_norm] at this
        exact this.le
      have := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasFDerivWithin_le' hderiv hbound
        (convex_closedBall _ _) h0mem hhmem
      simpa only [add_zero, sub_zero] using this
  
  obtain ⟨CA, hCA, hcA⟩ := c2 (E →L[ℝ] E) A hA
  obtain ⟨_, _, hcb⟩ := c2 E b hb
  have hAc : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => A (s0, u)) :=
    hA.continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
      (fun u => ⟨hs0, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
  obtain ⟨L0, hL0⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := -T) (b := T)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hAc.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = max L0 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hL : 0 ≤ L := by rw [hLdef]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hLb : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖A (s0, u)‖ ≤ L := fun u hu => by
    rw [hLdef]; exact (hL0 u hu).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hy : Continuous (z s0) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun t => ((hz s0 hs0).2 t).continuousAt)
  obtain ⟨Y0, hY0⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := -T) (b := T)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hy.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨Y, hYdef⟩ : ∃ Y : ℝ, Y = max Y0 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hY : 0 ≤ Y := by rw [hYdef]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hYb : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖z s0 t‖ ≤ Y := fun t ht => by
    rw [hYdef]; exact (hY0 t ht).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, C, -, hbd⟩ := hLip T hTpos
  have hCp : 0 < |C| + 1 := by positivity
  
  have hkey : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ h : P, ‖h‖ < δ →
      ‖z (s0 + h) v - z s0 v - W v h‖ ≤ η * ‖h‖ := by
    intro η hη
    obtain ⟨C1, hC1def⟩ : ∃ C1 : ℝ, C1 = (1 + (CA + Y + 1) * T) * Real.exp (L * T) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hC1 : 0 < C1 := by
      rw [hC1def]
      have : 0 < 1 + (CA + Y + 1) * T := by nlinarith
      exact mul_pos this (Real.exp_pos _)
    obtain ⟨η', hη'def⟩ : ∃ η' : ℝ, η' = η / C1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hη' : 0 < η' := by rw [hη'def]; exact div_pos hη hC1
    obtain ⟨δA, hδA, hδA'⟩ := hcA η' hη'
    obtain ⟨δb, hδb, hδb'⟩ := hcb η' hη'
    have hδz : 0 < η' / (|C| + 1) := div_pos hη' hCp
    refine ⟨min (min δA δb) (min (ρ₀ / 2) (min r (η' / (|C| + 1)))),
      lt_min (lt_min hδA hδb) (lt_min hρ (lt_min hr hδz)), ?_⟩
    intro h hh
    have hhA : ‖h‖ < δA := hh.trans_le ((min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
    have hhb : ‖h‖ < δb := hh.trans_le ((min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
    have hhρ : ‖h‖ < ρ₀ / 2 := hh.trans_le ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
    have hhr : ‖h‖ < r :=
      hh.trans_le ((min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)))
    have hhz : ‖h‖ < η' / (|C| + 1) :=
      hh.trans_le ((min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)))
    have hsh : s0 + h ∈ U := hcl (by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left]; exact hhρ.le)
    have hshr : s0 + h ∈ Metric.ball s0 r := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left]; exact hhr
    obtain ⟨g, hgdef⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ → E, g = fun u =>
        (A (s0 + h, u) - A (s0, u)) (z (s0 + h) u - z s0 u) +
        (A (s0 + h, u) - A (s0, u) - ((fderiv ℝ A (s0, u)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)) h)
          (z s0 u) +
        (b (s0 + h, u) - b (s0, u) - ((fderiv ℝ b (s0, u)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)) h) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hrd : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun u => z (s0 + h) u - z s0 u - W u h)
        ((fun u => A (s0, u)) u ((fun u => z (s0 + h) u - z s0 u - W u h) u) + g u) u := by
      intro u
      have h1 := (hz (s0 + h) hsh).2 u
      have h2 := (hz s0 hs0).2 u
      have h3 := (hW u).clm_apply (hasDerivAt_const u h)
      refine ((h1.sub h2).sub h3).congr_deriv ?_
      rw [hgdef]
      simp only [map_sub, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply, map_zero, add_zero]
      abel
    have hgb : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖(fun u => A (s0, u)) u‖ ≤ L ∧
        ‖g u‖ ≤ η' * (CA + Y + 1) * ‖h‖ := by
      intro u hu
      refine ⟨hLb u hu, ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨eA1, eA2⟩ := hδA' h u hhA hu
      obtain ⟨-, eb2⟩ := hδb' h u hhb hu
      have ez' : ‖z (s0 + h) u - z s0 u‖ ≤ η' := by
        have e1 := hbd (s0 + h) hshr u hu
        rw [add_sub_cancel_left] at e1
        have e2 : C * ‖h‖ ≤ (|C| + 1) * ‖h‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [le_abs_self C]) (norm_nonneg _)
        have e3 : (|C| + 1) * ‖h‖ ≤ (|C| + 1) * (η' / (|C| + 1)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhz.le hCp.le
        have e4 : (|C| + 1) * (η' / (|C| + 1)) = η' := by field_simp
        linarith
      rw [hgdef]
      calc ‖(A (s0 + h, u) - A (s0, u)) (z (s0 + h) u - z s0 u) +
            (A (s0 + h, u) - A (s0, u) - ((fderiv ℝ A (s0, u)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)) h)
              (z s0 u) +
            (b (s0 + h, u) - b (s0, u) - ((fderiv ℝ b (s0, u)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)) h)‖
          ≤ ‖(A (s0 + h, u) - A (s0, u)) (z (s0 + h) u - z s0 u)‖ +
            ‖(A (s0 + h, u) - A (s0, u) - ((fderiv ℝ A (s0, u)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)) h)
              (z s0 u)‖ +
            ‖b (s0 + h, u) - b (s0, u) - ((fderiv ℝ b (s0, u)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)) h‖ :=
            norm_add₃_le
        _ ≤ ‖A (s0 + h, u) - A (s0, u)‖ * ‖z (s0 + h) u - z s0 u‖ +
            ‖A (s0 + h, u) - A (s0, u) - ((fderiv ℝ A (s0, u)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)) h‖ *
              ‖z s0 u‖ +
            ‖b (s0 + h, u) - b (s0, u) - ((fderiv ℝ b (s0, u)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)) h‖ :=
            add_le_add (add_le_add (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _)
              (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _)) le_rfl
        _ ≤ (CA * ‖h‖) * η' + (η' * ‖h‖) * Y + η' * ‖h‖ :=
            add_le_add (add_le_add
              (mul_le_mul eA1 ez' (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hCA (norm_nonneg _)))
              (mul_le_mul eA2 (hYb u hu) (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hη'.le (norm_nonneg _)))) eb2
        _ = η' * (CA + Y + 1) * ‖h‖ := by ring
    have hε : 0 ≤ η' * (CA + Y + 1) * ‖h‖ :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hη'.le (by linarith)) (norm_nonneg _)
    have hG : ‖z (s0 + h) v - z s0 v - W v h‖ ≤
        (‖z (s0 + h) 0 - z s0 0 - W 0 h‖ + η' * (CA + Y + 1) * ‖h‖ * T) * Real.exp (L * T) :=
      gron (fun u => z (s0 + h) u - z s0 u - W u h) (fun u => A (s0, u)) g L
        (η' * (CA + Y + 1) * ‖h‖) T hL hε hT hrd hgb v hvT
    have h0 : ‖z (s0 + h) 0 - z s0 0 - W 0 h‖ ≤ η' * ‖h‖ := by
      rw [(hz (s0 + h) hsh).1, (hz s0 hs0).1, hW0]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, sub_zero, norm_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg hη'.le (norm_nonneg _)
    calc ‖z (s0 + h) v - z s0 v - W v h‖
        ≤ (‖z (s0 + h) 0 - z s0 0 - W 0 h‖ + η' * (CA + Y + 1) * ‖h‖ * T) * Real.exp (L * T) := hG
      _ ≤ (η' * ‖h‖ + η' * (CA + Y + 1) * ‖h‖ * T) * Real.exp (L * T) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = η' * C1 * ‖h‖ := by rw [hC1def]; ring
      _ = η * ‖h‖ := by rw [hη'def, div_mul_cancel₀ η hC1.ne']
  
  rw [hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
  intro c hc
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ'⟩ := hkey c hc
  rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff]
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun h hh => ?_⟩
  rw [dist_zero_right] at hh
  exact hδ' h hh

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (U : Set Cyl) (J : Set ℝ) (Z Gs : Cyl × ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (Ac : Cyl × ℝ → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) (Ar : Cyl × ℝ → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (p0 : Cyl) (Λ : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl) (lam : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c0 L X I : ℝ) (P : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsOpen U → IsOpen J → p0 ∈ U → Set.Icc 0 L ⊆ J → 0 < lam p0 + c0 → lam p0 + c0 < L → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Z (U ×ˢ J) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun pv : Cyl × ℝ => fun i j : Fin 3 => Ac pv i j) (U ×ˢ J) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Gs (U ×ˢ J) → (∀ pv i j, Ac pv i j = ((Ar pv i j : ℝ) : ℂ)) → (∀ p ∈ U, Z (p, 0) = 0) → (∀ p ∈ U, ∀ v ∈ J, HasDerivAt (fun v' => Z (p, v')) (Matrix.mulVec (Ac (p, v)) (Z (p, v)) - Gs (p, v)) v) → (∀ v, 0 < P v) → 1 ≤ X → L ≤ X → 0 ≤ I → (∀ w : Cyl, |lam (Λ w)| ≤ X * ‖w‖) → (∀ (x : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (w : ℝ), 0 ≤ w → w ≤ L → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w L, HasDerivAt x ((Ar (p0, v)).mulVec (x v)) v) → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w L, ‖x v‖ ≤ X * (P v / P w) * ‖x w‖) → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun pv : Cyl × ℝ => fun i j' : Fin 3 => Ar pv i j') (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ.prodMap (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖ ≤ X) → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j Gs (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ.prodMap (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖ ≤ I * P v) → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η : Cyl => Z (η, lam η + c0)) p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤ (16 ^ (k + 2) * X) ^ (12 * (k + 1)) * I * P (lam p0 + c0)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro U J Z Gs Ac Ar p0 Λ lam c0 L X I P k hU hJ hp0 hIJ hv0 hvL hZs hAcs hGs hcast hZ0 hODE hP hX1 hLX hI hslope hprop hArJ hGJ
  have hX0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ X := by linarith
  have hL0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ L := by linarith
  have hv0I : lam p0 + c0 ∈ Set.Icc 0 L := ⟨hv0.le, hvL.le⟩
  have hv0J : lam p0 + c0 ∈ J := hIJ hv0I
  have hO : IsOpen (U ×ˢ J) := hU.prod hJ
  
  have hArs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun pv : Cyl × ℝ => fun i j' : Fin 3 => Ar pv i j') (U ×ˢ J) := by
    refine contDiffOn_pi.mpr (fun i => contDiffOn_pi.mpr (fun j' => ?_))
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun pv => Ac pv i j') (U ×ˢ J) :=
      contDiffOn_pi.mp (contDiffOn_pi.mp hAcs i) j'
    have h2 := Complex.reCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h1
    refine h2.congr (fun pv _ => ?_)
    simp [hcast]
  
  have hAcm : ∀ pv, Ac pv = (Ar pv).map (fun a : ℝ => (a : ℂ)) := by
    intro pv; ext i j'; simp [Matrix.map_apply, hcast]
  have hODE' : ∀ p ∈ U, ∀ v ∈ J, HasDerivAt (fun v' => Z (p, v'))
      (Matrix.mulVec ((Ar (p, v)).map (fun a : ℝ => (a : ℂ))) (Z (p, v)) - Gs (p, v)) v := by
    intro p hp v hv; rw [← hAcm]; exact hODE p hp v hv
  
  have hrestr : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (g : Cyl × ℝ → V),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (U ×ˢ J) → ∀ v ∈ J, ∀ j : ℕ,
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p : Cyl => g (p, v)) p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Λ.prodMap (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖ := by
    intro V _ _ g hg v hv j
    have hpt : (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ Cyl ℝ) p0 + ((0:Cyl), v) = (p0, v) := by simp
    have hmem : (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ Cyl ℝ) p0 + ((0:Cyl), v) ∈ U ×ˢ J := by
      rw [hpt]; exact ⟨hp0, hv⟩
    have h := (fpj_affine_pullback g (U ×ˢ J) (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ Cyl ℝ) ((0:Cyl), v) p0 Λ
      (Λ.prodMap (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)) (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ Cyl ℝ) j hO hmem hg
      (fun w => rfl)).2
    have hfun : (fun p : Cyl => g ((ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ Cyl ℝ) p + ((0:Cyl), v))) =
        fun p => g (p, v) := by
      funext p; simp
    rw [hfun, hpt] at h
    refine h.trans ?_
    have hn : ‖ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ Cyl ℝ‖ ^ j ≤ 1 :=
      pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_inl_le_one _ _ _)
    calc _ ≤ _ * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := mul_one _
  have hslowAr : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L,
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p : Cyl => fun i j' : Fin 3 => Ar (p, v) i j') p0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤ X :=
    fun j hj v hv => (hrestr _ hArs v (hIJ hv) j).trans (hArJ j hj v hv)
  have hslowG : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc 0 L,
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p : Cyl => Gs (p, w)) p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤ I * P w :=
    fun j hj w hw => (hrestr Gs hGs w (hIJ hw) j).trans (hGJ j hj w hw)
  
  have hslow := fpj_slow_jet U J Z Gs Ar p0 Λ L X X I P k hU hJ hp0 hIJ hZs hArs hGs hZ0 hODE' hP hX0
    hprop hX0 hslowAr hI hslowG
  have hXs1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (1 + X) * (1 + L) * 6 * 2 ^ k * (1 + X) :=
    one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le (one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le (one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le
      (one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le (by linarith) (by linarith)) (by norm_num))
      (one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num))) (by linarith)
  have hIP : 0 ≤ I * P (lam p0 + c0) := mul_nonneg hI (hP _).le
  have hBm0 : 0 ≤ ((1 + X) * (1 + L) * 6 * 2 ^ k * (1 + X)) ^ (k + 1) * I * P (lam p0 + c0) := by
    rw [mul_assoc]; exact mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _) hIP
  have hIPle : I * P (lam p0 + c0) ≤
      ((1 + X) * (1 + L) * 6 * 2 ^ k * (1 + X)) ^ (k + 1) * I * P (lam p0 + c0) := by
    rw [mul_assoc]; exact le_mul_of_one_le_left hIP (one_le_pow₀ hXs1)
  
  have hmix := fpj_mixed_jet U J Z Gs Ar p0 Λ X
    (((1 + X) * (1 + L) * 6 * 2 ^ k * (1 + X)) ^ (k + 1) * I * P (lam p0 + c0)) k (lam p0 + c0)
    hU hJ hp0 hv0J hZs hArs hGs hODE' hX0 hBm0
    (fun j hj => hArJ j hj _ hv0I) (fun j hj => (hGJ j hj _ hv0I).trans hIPle)
    (fun j hj => hslow j hj _ hv0I)
  
  have hpt : ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Cyl).prod lam) p0 + ((0:Cyl), c0) = (p0, lam p0 + c0) := by
    simp
  have hmem : ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Cyl).prod lam) p0 + ((0:Cyl), c0) ∈ U ×ˢ J := by
    rw [hpt]; exact ⟨hp0, hv0J⟩
  have hpb := (fpj_affine_pullback Z (U ×ˢ J) ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Cyl).prod lam) ((0:Cyl), c0) p0 Λ
    (Λ.prodMap (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)) ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Cyl).prod (lam.comp Λ)) k hO hmem hZs
    (fun w => rfl)).2
  have hfun : (fun p : Cyl => Z (((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Cyl).prod lam) p + ((0:Cyl), c0))) =
      fun η => Z (η, lam η + c0) := by
    funext p; simp
  rw [hfun, hpt] at hpb
  
  have hTn : ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Cyl).prod (lam.comp Λ)‖ ≤ X := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hX0 (fun w => ?_)
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply, Prod.norm_mk, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact max_le (le_mul_of_one_le_left (norm_nonneg w) hX1) (hslope w)
  have hTk : ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Cyl).prod (lam.comp Λ)‖ ^ k ≤ X ^ k :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hTn k
  
  have hA0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 4 ^ k * 4 * (1 + X) := mul_nonneg (by positivity) (by linarith)
  have hconst : (4 ^ k * 4 * (1 + X)) ^ (k + 1) * ((1 + X) * (1 + L) * 6 * 2 ^ k * (1 + X)) ^ (k + 1) *
      X ^ k ≤ (16 ^ (k + 2) * X) ^ (12 * (k + 1)) := by
    have h4k : (0:ℝ) ≤ 4 ^ k := by positivity
    have h16k1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 16 ^ k := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)

  have hL2 : (0:ℝ) < (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 := pow_pos (by linarith) 2
  have hcib : 0 < cib B.h γ.1 := mul_pos (zpow_pos hT0 _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ0 _)
  have hcibL : 1 / (Tgc * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2) < cib B.h γ.1 := by
    have hy0 : (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (γ.1:ℝ)) / ((γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
      div_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _) hL2
    have hQp : 0 < Qb γ.1 ^ (1 + B.h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ0 _
    have hfl2 : Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (γ.1:ℝ)) / ((γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2)) - 1 <
        ((bandIdx B.h γ.1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := Int.sub_one_lt_floor _
    have hz2 : (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (γ.1:ℝ)) / ((γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2) / Tgc < Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_intCast]
      calc (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (γ.1:ℝ)) / ((γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2) / Tgc
          = Tgc ^ (Real.logb Tgc ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (γ.1:ℝ)) / ((γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2)) - 1) := by
            rw [Real.rpow_sub hT0, Real.rpow_one, Real.rpow_logb hT0 hT1.ne' hy0]
        _ < Tgc ^ ((bandIdx B.h γ.1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt hT1 hfl2
    have hQe : Qb γ.1 ^ (1 + B.h) * (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (γ.1:ℝ)) = 1 := by
      unfold Qb
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num), ← Real.rpow_add two_pos]
      have e : -(γ.1:ℝ) * (1 + B.h) + (1 + B.h) * (γ.1:ℝ) = 0 := by ring
      rw [e, Real.rpow_zero]
    unfold cib
    have e1 : 1 / (Tgc * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2) =
        (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (γ.1:ℝ)) / ((γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2) / Tgc * Qb γ.1 ^ (1 + B.h) := by
      generalize (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + B.h) * (γ.1:ℝ)) = P at hQe ⊢
      generalize Qb γ.1 ^ (1 + B.h) = Q at hQe ⊢
      rw [div_div, div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_comm P Q, hQe]
      ring
    rw [e1]
    exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hz2 hQp
  have hIlt : 1 / cib B.h γ.1 < Tgc * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 :=
    (one_div_lt hcib (mul_pos hT0 hL2)).mpr hcibL
  
  have hq4 : qC B.h ξ < 4 * Qb γ.1 := by
    have := (div_lt_iff₀ hQ0).mp hw2
    linarith
  have hlogq : Real.log (qC B.h ξ) < Real.log 4 + Real.log (Qb γ.1) := by
    rw [← Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hQ0.ne']
    exact Real.log_lt_log hq0 hq4
  have hlogQ : Real.log (Qb γ.1) = -(γ.1:ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by
    unfold Qb
    rw [Real.log_rpow two_pos]
  have hlog4 : Real.log 4 = 2 * Real.log 2 := by
    rw [show (4:ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]
    norm_num
  rw [hlog4, hlogQ] at hlogq
  have hlq0 : Real.log (qC B.h ξ) ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos hq0.le hq1
  have habs : |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| = -Real.log (qC B.h ξ) := abs_of_nonpos hlq0
  have hl2 := Real.log_two_gt_d9
  have hlev : (γ.1:ℝ) ≤ 2 * (1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)|) := by
    rw [habs]
    by_cases hc : (γ.1:ℝ) ≤ 2
    · linarith
    · push_neg at hc
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hc.le) (show (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 - 1/2 by linarith)]
  have hsq : (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * SC B.h ξ := by
    calc (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (2 * (1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)|)) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hlev 2
      _ = 4 * SC B.h ξ := by unfold SC; ring
  have hIb : 1 / cib B.h γ.1 ≤ Tgc * (4 * SC B.h ξ) :=
    hIlt.le.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hT0.le)
  have hIpos : 0 < 1 / cib B.h γ.1 := one_div_pos.mpr hcib
  
  have hT4 : Tgc ≤ Tgc ^ 4 := le_self_pow₀ hT1.le (by norm_num)
  have hLsb : Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 ≤ 8 * Tgc ^ 4 * SC B.h ξ := by
    unfold Lsb
    rw [div_eq_mul_one_div]
    have h1 : 2 * G.r0 * (1 / cib B.h γ.1) ≤ 2 * G.r0 * (Tgc * (4 * SC B.h ξ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hIb (by linarith)
    have h2 : Tgc * SC B.h ξ ≤ Tgc ^ 4 * SC B.h ξ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hT4 (by linarith)
    have hTS : 0 ≤ Tgc * SC B.h ξ := mul_nonneg hT0.le (by linarith)
    have h3 : G.r0 * (Tgc * SC B.h ξ) ≤ 1/100 * (Tgc * SC B.h ξ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr1 hTS
    nlinarith
  
  have hbgc : 0 ≤ bgc ∧ bgc < 1/2 := by
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
    have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
    unfold bgc
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  have hDen : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : ℝ × ℝ, w = rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hxiw : |lamR w| < 1/8 := by rw [hw]; exact hxi
  have hetw : |lamT w| < 1/8 := by rw [hw]; exact het
  have hinv1 : w.1 = lamR w + bgc * lamT w := by
    have e : lamR w + bgc * lamT w = (w.1 - bgc * w.2 + bgc * (bgc * w.1 + w.2)) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) := by
      unfold lamR lamT; ring
    rw [e, eq_div_iff hDen]
    ring
  have hinv2 : w.2 = lamT w - bgc * lamR w := by
    have e : lamT w - bgc * lamR w = (bgc * w.1 + w.2 - bgc * (w.1 - bgc * w.2)) / (1 + bgc ^ 2) := by
      unfold lamR lamT; ring
    rw [e, eq_div_iff hDen]
    ring
  have hb1 : bgc * |lamT w| ≤ 1/16 := by
    calc bgc * |lamT w| ≤ (1/2) * (1/8) := mul_le_mul hbgc.2.le hetw.le (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      _ = 1/16 := by norm_num
  have hb2 : bgc * |lamR w| ≤ 1/16 := by
    calc bgc * |lamR w| ≤ (1/2) * (1/8) := mul_le_mul hbgc.2.le hxiw.le (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      _ = 1/16 := by norm_num
  have hb1' : |bgc * lamT w| ≤ 1/16 := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hbgc.1]; exact hb1
  have hb2' : |bgc * lamR w| ≤ 1/16 := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hbgc.1]; exact hb2
  have hw1' : |w.1| < 1/2 := by
    rw [hinv1]
    obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hxiw
    obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := abs_le.mp hb1'
    exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hw2' : |w.2| < 1/2 := by
    rw [hinv2]
    obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hetw
    obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := abs_le.mp hb2'
    exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  obtain ⟨K1, hK1⟩ : ∃ K : ℤ, K = round ((Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨K2, hK2⟩ : ∃ K : ℤ, K = round ((Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hw1e : w.1 = (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1 - (K1 : ℝ) := by
    rw [hw, hK1]; rfl
  have hw2e : w.2 = (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2 - (K2 : ℝ) := by
    rw [hw, hK2]; rfl
  have hround : ∀ (x : ℝ) (K : ℤ), |x - (K : ℝ)| < 1/2 → round x = K := by
    intro x K hx
    rw [round_eq, Int.floor_eq_iff]
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := abs_lt.mp hx
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hJc : Continuous (fun Y' : ℝ × ℝ => Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ) := by
    unfold Jpow; fun_prop
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ : ∃ V : Set (ℝ × ℝ), V =
      {Y' : ℝ × ℝ | |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).1 - (K1 : ℝ)| < 1/2} ∩
      {Y' : ℝ × ℝ | |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).2 - (K2 : ℝ)| < 1/2} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hVo : IsOpen V := by
    rw [hV]
    exact (isOpen_lt ((hJc.fst).sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt ((hJc.snd).sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const)
  have hYV : ξ.2.2.2 ∈ V := by
    rw [hV]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).1 - (K1 : ℝ)| < 1/2
      rw [← hw1e]; exact hw1'
    · show |(Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ).2 - (K2 : ℝ)| < 1/2
      rw [← hw2e]; exact hw2'
  have hfr : ∀ Y' ∈ V, rectW B.h γ (G.ctr γ) Y' =
      Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ - ((K1 : ℝ), (K2 : ℝ)) := by
    intro Y' hY'
    rw [hV] at hY'
    have r1 : round ((Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).1) = K1 := hround _ _ hY'.1
    have r2 : round ((Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y' - G.ctr γ).2) = K2 := hround _ _ hY'.2
    unfold rectW frac0
    rw [r1, r2]
    ext <;> simp
  
  have hlamT_lin : ∀ a b : ℝ × ℝ, lamT (a - b) = lamT a - lamT b := by
    intro a b
    simp only [lamT, Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub]
    ring
  have hlamJ : ∀ (n : ℤ) (Y' : ℝ × ℝ), lamT (Jpow n Y') = Tgc ^ n * lamT Y' := by
    intro n Y'
    simp only [lamT, Jpow, vrv, vtv, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hlin : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (u v : ℝ × ℝ), lamT (a • u + b • v) = a * lamT u + b * lamT v := by
    intro a b u v
    simp only [lamT, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hlamL : ∀ (n : ℤ) (y : ℝ × ℝ), lamT (JpowL n y) = Tgc ^ n * lamT y := by
    intro n y
    have e : JpowL n y = y.1 • Jpow n (1, 0) + y.2 • Jpow n (0, 1) := by
      simp [JpowL]
    rw [e, hlin, hlamJ, hlamJ]
    simp only [lamT]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = Tgc ^ bandIdx B.h γ.1 / cib B.h γ.1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = (G.r0 - lamT (G.ctr γ) - lamT ((K1 : ℝ), (K2 : ℝ))) / cib B.h γ.1 :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hAff : ∀ Y' ∈ V, vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) Y' = A * lamT Y' + c := by
    intro Y' hY'
    simp only [vco, etG]
    rw [hfr Y' hY', hlamT_lin, hlamT_lin, hlamJ, hA, hc]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨pY, hpY⟩ : ∃ pY : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ, pY =
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ℓT, hℓdef⟩ : ∃ ℓ : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ, ℓ =
    (bgc / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) • ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp pY) +
      (1 / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) • ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp pY) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hℓ : ∀ w : Cyl, ℓT w = lamT w.2.2.2 := by
    intro w
    rw [hℓdef, hpY]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd',
      smul_eq_mul, lamT]
    ring
  obtain ⟨lam, hlamdef⟩ : ∃ lam : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ, lam = A • ℓT := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hlamE : ∀ η : Cyl, lam η = A * lamT η.2.2.2 := by
    intro η
    rw [hlamdef, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, hℓ, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hE : Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) * Tgc ^ (-(coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ))) ≤ Tgc ^ 3 := by
    rw [← zpow_add₀ hT0.ne']
    calc Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1 + -(coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ))) ≤ Tgc ^ (3:ℤ) :=
          zpow_le_zpow_right₀ hT1.le (by omega)
      _ = Tgc ^ 3 := by norm_num
  have hE0 : 0 ≤ Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) * Tgc ^ (-(coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ))) :=
    mul_nonneg (zpow_pos hT0 _).le (zpow_pos hT0 _).le
  have hlamB : ∀ y : ℝ × ℝ, |lamT y| ≤ |y.1| + |y.2| := by
    intro y
    have hD0 : (0:ℝ) < 1 + bgc ^ 2 := by positivity
    unfold lamT
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hD0, div_le_iff₀ hD0]
    have h1 : |bgc * y.1 + y.2| ≤ bgc * |y.1| + |y.2| := by
      calc |bgc * y.1 + y.2| ≤ |bgc * y.1| + |y.2| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = bgc * |y.1| + |y.2| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hbgc.1]
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg y.1, abs_nonneg y.2, mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg bgc) (abs_nonneg y.1),
      mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg bgc) (abs_nonneg y.2),
      mul_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - bgc by linarith [hbgc.2]) (abs_nonneg y.1)]
  have hy12 : ∀ w : Cyl, |w.2.2.2.1| + |w.2.2.2.2| ≤ 2 * ‖w‖ := by
    intro w
    have hnY : ‖w.2.2.2‖ ≤ ‖w‖ :=
      (norm_snd_le w.2.2).trans ((norm_snd_le w.2).trans (norm_snd_le w))
    have a1 : |w.2.2.2.1| ≤ ‖w.2.2.2‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_fst_le _
    have a2 : |w.2.2.2.2| ≤ ‖w.2.2.2‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_snd_le _
    linarith
  refine ⟨(fun η : Cyl => η.2.2.2) ⁻¹' V, c, lam, hVo.preimage (by fun_prop), hYV, ?_, ?_, hLsb⟩
  · intro η hη
    rw [hlamE]
    exact hAff _ hη
  · intro w
    have hval : lam (Lnorm B.h ξ w) = (Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) * Tgc ^ (-(coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ)))) *
        (1 / cib B.h γ.1) * lamT w.2.2.2 := by
      rw [hlamE]
      have e : (Lnorm B.h ξ w).2.2.2 = JpowL (-(coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ))) w.2.2.2 := rfl
      rw [e, hlamL, hA]
      ring
    rw [hval, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hE0, abs_of_pos hIpos]
    have hT3 : (0:ℝ) ≤ Tgc ^ 3 := (pow_pos hT0 3).le
    calc Tgc ^ (bandIdx B.h γ.1) * Tgc ^ (-(coarseIdx B.h (qC B.h ξ))) * (1 / cib B.h γ.1) *
          |lamT w.2.2.2|
        ≤ Tgc ^ 3 * (Tgc * (4 * SC B.h ξ)) * (2 * ‖w‖) :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hE hIb hIpos.le hT3) ((hlamB _).trans (hy12 w)) (abs_nonneg _)
            (mul_nonneg hT3 (mul_nonneg hT0.le (by linarith)))
      _ = 8 * Tgc ^ 4 * SC B.h ξ * ‖w‖ := by ring

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lP', CP, bP', hP5⟩ := pulse_propagator_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨l1, hcont⟩ := path_coeff_cont5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, hXam1, hm12, hm2Xb, hXbXe, hqB0, hqB1, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  have hr0 : 0 < G.r0 := hG.1.1
  have hr01 : G.r0 ≤ 1/100 := hG.1.2.1
  obtain ⟨nq, hnq⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨lP' + l1 + nq + 1, |CP| * (2:ℝ) ^ |bP'|, |bP'| / 2, by positivity, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro l0 γ m ξ hl0 hlγ hm hAct hξ htsupp hw1 hw2 hX1 hX2 hxi hv0 hvL x w hw0 hwL hx v hv
  
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 < B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : nq ≤ l0)) hnq
  obtain ⟨hξ1, hξ2, hξ3⟩ := id hξ
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith)).1
  have hq1 : qC B.h ξ ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hξB : ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB := ⟨hξ1, hξ2, by linarith⟩
