proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨lV, cA, hcA, hV⟩ := pulse_vco_frame_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lG, hGap⟩ := band_coarse_gap_v5 B.h hh0 hh1
  obtain ⟨lA, hA⟩ := pulse_ar_nb_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lS, hS⟩ := pulse_src_nb_v5 B G hok hG
  refine ⟨lV + lG + lA + lS + 1, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 α f hf k
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have hU : IsOpen ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h' : ξ.2.2.1 < 1 := hξ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ξ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘
        (fun ξ : Cyl => ((ξ.2.1, 1 - ξ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)))
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) := hc
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ξ : Cyl | 0 < ξ.1} ∩ {ξ : Cyl | ξ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ξ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  choose Cf' bf' df' hfb using hf.2.2.2.2
  obtain ⟨CA, bA, hAk⟩ := hA k
  obtain ⟨CS, bS, hSk⟩ := hS k
  obtain ⟨Cf, hCf⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |Cf' i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨bf, hbf⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |bf' i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨df, hdf⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k+1), |df' i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCf0 : 0 ≤ Cf := by rw [hCf]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => abs_nonneg _
  have hbf0 : 0 ≤ bf := by rw [hbf]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => abs_nonneg _
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ (2 + cA) ^ k := pow_nonneg (by linarith) _
  have hCC0 : 0 ≤ (2 + cA) ^ k * (|CA| + |CS| * Cf) :=
    mul_nonneg hK0 (add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hCf0))
  refine ⟨(2 + cA) ^ k * (|CA| + |CS| * Cf), |bA| + |bS| + bf + (k:ℝ), df, hCC0, ?_⟩
  intro γ m ξ hlγ hAct hξ hw1 hw2 hX1 hX2 hv0 hvL hpath j hj v hv
  
  have hpth0 : pulsePth5 B G γ ξ (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) = ξ := by
    simp [pulsePth5]
  obtain ⟨-, hxi0, het0, -⟩ := hpath _ ⟨hv0, hvL⟩
  rw [hpth0] at hxi0 het0
  obtain ⟨O, c0, lam, hO, hξO, hvco, hslope, -⟩ := hV l0 γ ξ (by omega) hlγ hξ hw1 hw2 hxi0 het0
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ.2.1])).1
  obtain ⟨hg1, -⟩ := hGap γ.1 l0 (qC B.h ξ) (by omega) hq0 hξ.2.2 hw1 hw2
  obtain ⟨eh, hLe, heh, hfz⟩ := dvdir_lnorm_frame_v5 B.h γ.1 ξ (by omega) hg1
  obtain ⟨hqη, hXη, hSη, hLη⟩ : qC B.h (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ v) = qC B.h ξ ∧
      XC B.h (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ v) = XC B.h ξ ∧ SC B.h (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ v) = SC B.h ξ ∧
      Lnorm B.h (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ v) = Lnorm B.h ξ :=
    hfz ξ (v - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)
  obtain ⟨hηD, hxiη, hetη, hvη⟩ := hpath v hv
  have hw1η : 1/4 < qC B.h (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ v) / Qb γ.1 := by rw [hqη]; exact hw1
  have hw2η : qC B.h (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ v) / Qb γ.1 < 4 := by rw [hqη]; exact hw2
  have hXη1 : B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ v) := by rw [hXη]; linarith
  have hXη2 : XC B.h (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ v) < 2 * B.Xb := by rw [hXη]; linarith
  
  have hS1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
    unfold SC
    exact one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))])
  have hSpos : 0 < SC B.h ξ := by linarith
  have hed0 : 0 < edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) := by
    have hX : 0 < XC B.h ξ := lt_trans hXa hX1
    unfold edgeDist
    exact lt_min one_pos (lt_min (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hXa).mpr hX1))
      (Real.log_pos ((one_lt_div hX).mpr hX2)))
  have hed1 : edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
  have hP0 : 0 ≤ Penv5 B G γ v := by unfold Penv5; exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hQ0 : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
  have hE0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hD0 : 0 ≤ edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df) := Real.rpow_nonneg hed0.le _
  have hσ0 : 0 ≤ cA * SC B.h ξ := mul_nonneg hcA hSpos.le
  have hpj0 : 0 ≤ (2 + cA * SC B.h ξ) ^ j := pow_nonneg (by linarith) _
  have hSk0 : 0 ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ (k:ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hSpos.le _
  have hpow : (2 + cA * SC B.h ξ) ^ j ≤ (2 + cA) ^ k * SC B.h ξ ^ (k:ℝ) := by
    have h1 : 2 + cA * SC B.h ξ ≤ (2 + cA) * SC B.h ξ := by nlinarith
    have h2 : 1 ≤ (2 + cA) * SC B.h ξ := by nlinarith
    calc (2 + cA * SC B.h ξ) ^ j ≤ ((2 + cA) * SC B.h ξ) ^ j := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) h1 j
      _ ≤ ((2 + cA) * SC B.h ξ) ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ h2 hj
      _ = (2 + cA) ^ k * SC B.h ξ ^ (k:ℝ) := by rw [mul_pow, Real.rpow_natCast]
  have hm2 : 0 ≤ 1 + (m:ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    obtain ⟨⟨OA, hOA, hηOA, hsmA⟩, hbA⟩ :=
      hAk l0 (by omega) γ m hAct hlγ _ hηD hw1η hw2η hXη1 hXη2 hxiη hetη
    have hpbA := pulse_path_pullback_v5 B G γ ξ v
      (fun ζ : Cyl => fun i j' : Fin 3 => pulseAr5 B G γ m ζ i j') O OA lam c0 (cA * SC B.h ξ) eh j
      hO hξO hvco hOA hηOA hsmA hσ0 hslope hLe heh hLη
    have hN := hbA j hj
    rw [hSη] at hN
    have hN' : NB B.h (fun ζ : Cyl => fun i j' : Fin 3 => pulseAr5 B G γ m ζ i j') j
        (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ v) ≤ |CA| * (1 + (m:ℝ) ^ 2) * SC B.h ξ ^ bA :=
      le_trans hN (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hm2)
        (Real.rpow_nonneg hSpos.le _))
    have hexp : SC B.h ξ ^ bA * SC B.h ξ ^ (k:ℝ) ≤ SC B.h ξ ^ (|bA| + |bS| + bf + (k:ℝ)) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hSpos]
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 (by linarith [le_abs_self bA, abs_nonneg bS])
    have hc : |CA| * (2 + cA) ^ k ≤ (2 + cA) ^ k * (|CA| + |CS| * Cf) := by
      have e : (2 + cA) ^ k * (|CA| + |CS| * Cf) = |CA| * (2 + cA) ^ k + (2 + cA) ^ k * (|CS| * Cf) := by
        ring
      have : 0 ≤ (2 + cA) ^ k * (|CS| * Cf) := mul_nonneg hK0 (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hCf0)
      rw [e]; linarith
    calc _ ≤ NB B.h (fun ζ : Cyl => fun i j' : Fin 3 => pulseAr5 B G γ m ζ i j') j
          (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ v) * (2 + cA * SC B.h ξ) ^ j := hpbA
      _ ≤ (|CA| * (1 + (m:ℝ) ^ 2) * SC B.h ξ ^ bA) * ((2 + cA) ^ k * SC B.h ξ ^ (k:ℝ)) :=
          mul_le_mul hN' hpow hpj0
            (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hm2) (Real.rpow_nonneg hSpos.le _))
      _ = (|CA| * (2 + cA) ^ k) * (SC B.h ξ ^ bA * SC B.h ξ ^ (k:ℝ)) * (1 + (m:ℝ) ^ 2) := by ring
      _ ≤ ((2 + cA) ^ k * (|CA| + |CS| * Cf)) * SC B.h ξ ^ (|bA| + |bS| + bf + (k:ℝ)) *
            (1 + (m:ℝ) ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul hc hexp
            (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hSpos.le _) hSk0) hCC0) hm2
      _ = _ := by ring
  · 
    have key : ∀ (C C' q S S' sq e e' P N : ℝ), |C| ≤ C' → 0 ≤ q → 0 ≤ S → S ≤ S' → 0 ≤ sq →
        0 ≤ e → e ≤ e' → 0 ≤ P → N ≤ C * q * S * sq * e * P → N ≤ C' * (q * S' * sq * e' * P) := by
      intro C C' q S S' sq e e' P N hC hq0' hS hSS hsq he hee hP hN
      have hX : 0 ≤ q * S * sq * e * P :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hq0' hS) hsq) he) hP
      have h1 : C * q * S * sq * e * P ≤ |C| * (q * S * sq * e * P) := by
        rw [show C * q * S * sq * e * P = C * (q * S * sq * e * P) by ring]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) hX
      have ha : q * S * sq ≤ q * S' * sq :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSS hq0') hsq
      have ha' : 0 ≤ q * S' * sq := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hq0' (le_trans hS hSS)) hsq
      have h2 : q * S * sq * e * P ≤ q * S' * sq * e' * P :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul ha hee he ha') hP
      exact hN.trans (h1.trans (mul_le_mul hC h2 hX (le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hC)))
    have hWi : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB B.h (f γ m) i (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ v) ≤
        Cf * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bf * Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) *
          edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df) * Penv5 B G γ v) := by
      intro i hi
      have hir : i ∈ Finset.range (k+1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
      have h := hfb i γ m _ hηD (by rw [hXη]; exact hX1) (by rw [hXη]; exact hX2)
      rw [hqη, hXη, hSη, hvη] at h
      have hbi : bf' i ≤ bf := by
        rw [hbf]
        exact (le_abs_self _).trans
          (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |bf' j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) hir)
      have hdi : df' i ≤ df := by
        rw [hdf]
        exact (le_abs_self _).trans
          (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |df' j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) hir)
      have hCi : |Cf' i| ≤ Cf := by
        rw [hCf]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cf' j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) hir
      exact key _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hCi hQ0 (Real.rpow_nonneg hSpos.le _)
        (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 hbi) hE0 (Real.rpow_nonneg hed0.le _)
        (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hed0 hed1 (neg_le_neg hdi)) hP0 h
    have hW0 : 0 ≤ Cf * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bf *
        Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) *
        edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df) * Penv5 B G γ v) :=
      mul_nonneg hCf0 (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hQ0
        (Real.rpow_nonneg hSpos.le _)) hE0) hD0) hP0)
    obtain ⟨⟨OS, hOS, hηOS, hsmS⟩, hbS⟩ :=
      hSk l0 (by omega) γ hAct hlγ _ hηD hw1η hw2η hXη1 hXη2 hxiη hetη (f γ m) _
        (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) hDopen hηD (hf.2.1 γ m) hWi
    have hsmS' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : Cyl => projT5 B G γ ζ (srcHat B f γ m ζ)) OS := hsmS
    have hpbS := pulse_path_pullback_v5 B G γ ξ v
      (fun ζ : Cyl => projT5 B G γ ζ (srcHat B f γ m ζ)) O OS lam c0 (cA * SC B.h ξ) eh j
      hO hξO hvco hOS hηOS hsmS' hσ0 hslope hLe heh hLη
    have hN : NB B.h (fun ζ : Cyl => projT5 B G γ ζ (srcHat B f γ m ζ)) j (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ v) ≤
        CS * SC B.h ξ ^ bS * (Cf * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bf *
          Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) *
          edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df) * Penv5 B G γ v)) := by
      have h := hbS j hj
      rw [hSη] at h
      exact h
    have hN' := le_trans hN (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self CS)
      (Real.rpow_nonneg hSpos.le bS)) hW0)
    have hexpB : SC B.h ξ ^ bS * SC B.h ξ ^ bf * SC B.h ξ ^ (k:ℝ) ≤
        SC B.h ξ ^ (|bA| + |bS| + bf + (k:ℝ)) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hSpos, ← Real.rpow_add hSpos]
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS1 (by linarith [le_abs_self bS, abs_nonneg bA])
    have hc : (2 + cA) ^ k * (|CS| * Cf) ≤ (2 + cA) ^ k * (|CA| + |CS| * Cf) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith [abs_nonneg CA]) hK0
    have hR0 : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) *
        edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df) * Penv5 B G γ v :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hQ0 hE0) hD0) hP0
    calc _ ≤ NB B.h (fun ζ : Cyl => projT5 B G γ ζ (srcHat B f γ m ζ)) j (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ v) *
          (2 + cA * SC B.h ξ) ^ j := hpbS
      _ ≤ (|CS| * SC B.h ξ ^ bS * (Cf * (qC B.h ξ ^ (B.h * α) * SC B.h ξ ^ bf *
            Real.sqrt (edgeWeight B.Xa B.Xb B.aa B.ab (XC B.h ξ)) *
            edgeDist B.Xa B.Xb (XC B.h ξ) ^ (-df) * Penv5 B G γ v))) *
            ((2 + cA) ^ k * SC B.h ξ ^ (k:ℝ)) :=
          mul_le_mul hN' hpow hpj0

    rw [hS1]
    simp only [chartZ, RC]
    fun_prop
  
  have hshift : ∀ (F : Cyl → ℝ), (∀ (x : Cyl) (y : ℝ × ℝ), F (x + ((0, 0, 0, y) : Cyl)) = F x) →
      ∀ y : ℝ × ℝ, fderiv ℝ F (ξ + ((0, 0, 0, y) : Cyl)) = fderiv ℝ F ξ ∧
        (DifferentiableAt ℝ F (ξ + ((0, 0, 0, y) : Cyl)) ↔ DifferentiableAt ℝ F ξ) := by
    intro F hF y
    have e : (fun x => F (x + ((0, 0, 0, y) : Cyl))) = F := funext fun x => hF x y
    have h1 := fderiv_comp_add_right (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) (x := ξ) ((0, 0, 0, y) : Cyl)
    have h2 := differentiableAt_comp_add_right (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) (x := ξ) ((0, 0, 0, y) : Cyl)
    rw [e] at h1 h2
    exact ⟨h1.symm, h2.symm⟩
  
  obtain ⟨yt, hyt⟩ : ∃ yt : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ, yt = fun t => (t - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2) •
      ((cib B.h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1))) • vtv) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hpath : ∀ t : ℝ, pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t = ξ + ((0, 0, 0, yt t) : Cyl) := by
    intro t
    rw [hyt]
    simp only [pulsePth5, dVdir, Prod.smul_mk, smul_zero]
  have hfst : ∀ t : ℝ, (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t).1 = ξ.1 := by
    intro t
    rw [hpath t]
    simp
  
  have hn0 : ∀ η : Cyl, nPhi5 B G γ η 0 = Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) *
      fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) η (1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * η.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) := by
    intro η
    simp only [nPhi5, Matrix.cons_val_zero, DrC, dR, smul_eq_mul]
  have hn2 : ∀ η : Cyl, nPhi5 B G γ η 2 = Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) *
      fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) η (0, 1, 0, 0) := by
    intro η
    simp only [nPhi5, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.head_cons, DzC, dZ, smul_eq_mul]
  
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩ : ∃ ℓ : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ, ∀ w : Cyl, ℓ w = lam * lamT w.2.2.2 := by
    refine ⟨(lam / (1 + bgc ^ 2)) • (bgc • ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))))) +
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))))), fun w => ?_⟩
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp', Function.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst',
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', smul_eq_mul, lamT]
    ring
  have hV : ∀ (κ : ℝ) (x : Cyl), HasFDerivAt (fun η : Cyl => lam * lamT η.2.2.2 + κ) ℓ x := by
    intro κ x
    have e : (fun η : Cyl => lam * lamT η.2.2.2 + κ) = fun η => ℓ η + κ :=
      funext fun η => by rw [hℓ η]
    rw [e]
    exact ℓ.hasFDerivAt.add_const κ
  have hlr : ∀ c : ℝ, lamT (c • vrv) = 0 := by
    intro c
    unfold lamT vrv
    simp only [Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hℓr : ℓ ((1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) : Cyl) = 0 := by
    rw [hℓ]
    show lam * lamT ((drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv) = 0
    rw [hlr, mul_zero]
  have hℓz : ℓ ((0, 1, 0, 0) : Cyl) = 0 := by
    rw [hℓ]
    simp [lamT]
  
  have hloc : ∀ t ∈ J, ∃ κ : ℝ, lam * lamT (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t).2.2.2 + κ = t ∧
      phiL5 B G γ =ᶠ[nhds (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t)]
        fun η => S1 η - (lam * lamT η.2.2.2 + κ) * H η := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ := hk t ht
    refine ⟨κ, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hκ.self_of_nhds]
      exact hv t ht
    · exact hκ.mono fun η hη => by rw [hsplit η, hη]
  by_cases hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ H ξ
  · left
    refine ⟨Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ S1 ξ (1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv),
      Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ H ξ (1, 0, 0, (drx B.h * ξ.1 ^ (drx B.h - 1)) • vrv),
      Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ S1 ξ (0, 1, 0, 0),
      Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ H ξ (0, 1, 0, 0), ?_⟩
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨κ, hVt, hev⟩ := hloc t ht
    have hHd : DifferentiableAt ℝ H (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t) := by
      rw [hpath t]
      exact ((hshift H hHsh (yt t)).2).mpr hD
    have hder : HasFDerivAt (fun η => S1 η - (lam * lamT η.2.2.2 + κ) * H η)
        (fderiv ℝ S1 (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t) -
          ((lam * lamT (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t).2.2.2 + κ) • fderiv ℝ H (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t) +
            H (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t) • ℓ)) (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t) :=
      (hS1diff _).hasFDerivAt.fun_sub ((hV κ _).fun_mul hHd.hasFDerivAt)
    have key : fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t) =
        fderiv ℝ S1 ξ - (t • fderiv ℝ H ξ + H ξ • ℓ) := by
      rw [(hder.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).fderiv, hVt, hpath t, (hshift S1 hS1sh (yt t)).1,
        (hshift H hHsh (yt t)).1, hHsh]
    rw [hn0, hn2, key, hfst t]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hℓr, hℓz]
    constructor <;> ring
  · right
    intro t ht ht0
    obtain ⟨κ, hVt, hev⟩ := hloc t ht
    have hz : fderiv ℝ (phiL5 B G γ) (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t) = 0 := by
      apply fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt
      intro hφ
      apply hD
      have hVd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η : Cyl => lam * lamT η.2.2.2 + κ) (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t) :=
        (hV κ _).differentiableAt
      have hVne : lam * lamT (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t).2.2.2 + κ ≠ 0 := by rw [hVt]; exact ht0
      have hne : ∀ᶠ η in nhds (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t), lam * lamT η.2.2.2 + κ ≠ 0 :=
        hVd.continuousAt.eventually_ne hVne
      have hq : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun η => (S1 η - phiL5 B G γ η) * (lam * lamT η.2.2.2 + κ)⁻¹)
          (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t) :=
        ((hS1diff _).fun_sub hφ).fun_mul (hVd.fun_inv hVne)
      have hHd : DifferentiableAt ℝ H (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t) := by
        refine hq.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
        filter_upwards [hev, hne] with η h1 h2
        have h1' : phiL5 B G γ η = S1 η - (lam * lamT η.2.2.2 + κ) * H η := h1
        rw [h1', sub_sub_cancel, mul_comm (lam * lamT η.2.2.2 + κ) (H η), mul_inv_cancel_right₀ h2]
      rw [hpath t] at hHd
      exact (hshift H hHsh (yt t)).2.mp hHd
    rw [hn0, hn2, hz]
    simp

signature.name: pzs_lin_ode_zero5
signature.statement: ∀ (L C : ℝ) (A : ℝ → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) (Z : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, ∀ i j : Fin 3, ‖A t i j‖ ≤ C) → Z 0 = 0 → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, HasDerivWithinAt Z ((A t).mulVec (Z t)) (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L) t) → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, Z t = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro L C A Z hA hZ0 hD t ht
  have hcont : ContinuousOn Z (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L) := fun s hs => (hD s hs).continuousWithinAt
  have hderiv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ico (0:ℝ) L,
      HasDerivWithinAt Z ((A x).mulVec (Z x)) (Set.Ici x) x := by
    intro x hx
    exact (hD x (Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self hx)).mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin (Icc_mem_nhdsGE_of_mem hx)
  have hbound : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ico (0:ℝ) L, ‖(A x).mulVec (Z x)‖ ≤ (3 * C) * ‖Z x‖ + 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have hxI : x ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L := Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self hx
    have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hA x hxI 0 0)
    rw [add_zero]
    refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)).2 ?_
    intro i
    have e : (A x).mulVec (Z x) i = ∑ j, A x i j * Z x j := rfl
    rw [e]
    calc ‖∑ j, A x i j * Z x j‖ ≤ ∑ j, ‖A x i j * Z x j‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin 3, C * ‖Z x‖ := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro j _
          rw [norm_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul (hA x hxI i j) (norm_le_pi_norm (Z x) j) (norm_nonneg _) hC0
      _ = 3 * C * ‖Z x‖ := by
          simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
  have h0 : ‖Z 0‖ ≤ 0 := by rw [hZ0, norm_zero]
  have hg := norm_le_gronwallBound_of_norm_deriv_right_le hcont hderiv h0 hbound t ht
  rw [gronwallBound_ε0_δ0] at hg
  exact norm_le_zero_iff.mp hg

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (L c N P κ : ℝ) (μ : ℂ) (Km : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (n nP : ℝ → Fin 3 → ℝ), 0 < c → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, c ≤ dotProduct (n t) (n t) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 3, |n t i| ≤ N) ∧ ∀ i : Fin 3, |nP t i| ≤ P) → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, ∀ i j : Fin 3, ‖(pulseMatC (-Km + (dotProduct (n t) (n t))⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec (n t) (Matrix.vecMul (n t) Km - nP t)) - (μ * ((κ * dotProduct (n t) (n t) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ)) i j‖ ≤ C

signature.name: pzs_aphi_bound5
signature.statement: ∀ (L c N P κ : ℝ) (μ : ℂ) (Km : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (n nP : ℝ → Fin 3 → ℝ), 0 < c → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, c ≤ dotProduct (n t) (n t) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 3, |n t i| ≤ N) ∧ ∀ i : Fin 3, |nP t i| ≤ P) → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, ∀ i j : Fin 3, ‖(pulseMatC (-Km + (dotProduct (n t) (n t))⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec (n t) (Matrix.vecMul (n t) Km - nP t)) - (μ * ((κ * dotProduct (n t) (n t) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ)) i j‖ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro L c N P κ μ Km n nP hc hyp
  set Kb : ℝ := ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, |Km a b| with hKb
  set N' : ℝ := max N 0 with hN'
  have hKm : ∀ a b : Fin 3, |Km a b| ≤ Kb := by
    intro a b
    calc |Km a b| ≤ ∑ b' : Fin 3, |Km a b'| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun b' => |Km a b'|) (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
            (Finset.mem_univ b)
      _ ≤ Kb := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun a' => ∑ b' : Fin 3, |Km a' b'|)
          (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)) (Finset.mem_univ a)
  have hKb0 : 0 ≤ Kb := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hKm 0 0)
  have hN0 : 0 ≤ N' := le_max_right _ _
  refine ⟨Kb + N' * (3 * N' * Kb + |P|) / c + ‖μ‖ * |κ| * (3 * N' ^ 2), fun t ht i j => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hcs, hn, hp⟩ := hyp t ht
  set s := dotProduct (n t) (n t) with hs
  have hn' : ∀ k, |n t k| ≤ N' := fun k => le_trans (hn k) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hp' : ∀ k, |nP t k| ≤ |P| := fun k => le_trans (hp k) (le_abs_self _)
  have hs0 : 0 < s := lt_of_lt_of_le hc hcs
  have hsinv : s⁻¹ ≤ c⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ hc hcs
  have hsq : ∀ k, n t k * n t k ≤ N' * N' := by
    intro k
    rw [← abs_mul_abs_self]
    exact mul_le_mul (hn' k) (hn' k) (abs_nonneg _) hN0
  have hsle : s ≤ 3 * N' ^ 2 := by
    have : s = n t 0 * n t 0 + n t 1 * n t 1 + n t 2 * n t 2 := by
      simp [hs, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rw [this]; nlinarith [hsq 0, hsq 1, hsq 2]
  set w := Matrix.vecMul (n t) Km - nP t with hw
  have hwj : |w j| ≤ 3 * N' * Kb + |P| := by
    have e : w j = n t 0 * Km 0 j + n t 1 * Km 1 j + n t 2 * Km 2 j - nP t j := by
      simp [hw, Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have hk : ∀ k, |n t k * Km k j| ≤ N' * Kb := fun k => by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul (hn' k) (hKm k j) (abs_nonneg _) hN0
    rw [e]
    calc _ ≤ |n t 0 * Km 0 j + n t 1 * Km 1 j + n t 2 * Km 2 j| + |nP t j| := abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ |n t 0 * Km 0 j| + |n t 1 * Km 1 j| + |n t 2 * Km 2 j| + |nP t j| := by
          gcongr; exact abs_add_three _ _ _
      _ ≤ _ := by linarith [hk 0, hk 1, hk 2, hp' j]
  set A := -Km + s⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec (n t) w with hA
  have hAij : |A i j| ≤ Kb + N' * (3 * N' * Kb + |P|) / c := by
    have e : A i j = -Km i j + s⁻¹ * (n t i * w j) := by
      simp [hA, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply]
    rw [e]
    have h1 : |s⁻¹ * (n t i * w j)| ≤ c⁻¹ * (N' * (3 * N' * Kb + |P|)) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hs0)]
      apply mul_le_mul hsinv _ (by positivity) (inv_pos.mpr hc).le
      exact mul_le_mul (hn' i) hwj (abs_nonneg _) hN0
    calc _ ≤ |-Km i j| + |s⁻¹ * (n t i * w j)| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ Kb + c⁻¹ * (N' * (3 * N' * Kb + |P|)) := by rw [abs_neg]; linarith [hKm i j]
      _ = _ := by rw [div_eq_inv_mul]
  have hM1 : ‖pulseMatC A i j‖ = |A i j| := by
    simp [pulseMatC, Matrix.map_apply, Complex.norm_real]
  have hM2 : ‖((μ * ((κ * s : ℝ) : ℂ)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ)) i j‖ ≤
      ‖μ‖ * |κ| * (3 * N' ^ 2) := by
    rw [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_mul, abs_of_pos hs0]
    have h1 : ‖(1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) i j‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Matrix.one_apply]; split_ifs <;> simp
    have h2 : |κ| * s ≤ |κ| * (3 * N' ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsle (abs_nonneg _)
    calc ‖μ‖ * (|κ| * s) * ‖(1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) i j‖ ≤
          ‖μ‖ * (|κ| * (3 * N' ^ 2)) * 1 := by
          apply mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (norm_nonneg _)) h1 (norm_nonneg _)
            (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by ring
  rw [Matrix.sub_apply]
  calc _ ≤ ‖pulseMatC A i j‖ +
        ‖((μ * ((κ * s : ℝ) : ℂ)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ)) i j‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by rw [hM1]; linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (L n1 : ℝ) (n : ℝ → Fin 3 → ℝ), 0 < L → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, n t 1 = n1) → ((∃ a0 b0 a2 b2 : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, n t 0 = a0 - t * b0 ∧ n t 2 = a2 - t * b2) ∨ (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, t ≠ 0 → n t 0 = 0 ∧ n t 2 = 0)) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, dotProduct (n t) (n t) ≠ 0) → ∃ c N : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, c ≤ dotProduct (n t) (n t) ∧ ∀ i : Fin 3, |n t i| ≤ N

signature.name: pzs_nsq_lower5
signature.statement: ∀ (L n1 : ℝ) (n : ℝ → Fin 3 → ℝ), 0 < L → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, n t 1 = n1) → ((∃ a0 b0 a2 b2 : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, n t 0 = a0 - t * b0 ∧ n t 2 = a2 - t * b2) ∨ (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, t ≠ 0 → n t 0 = 0 ∧ n t 2 = 0)) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, dotProduct (n t) (n t) ≠ 0) → ∃ c N : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, c ≤ dotProduct (n t) (n t) ∧ ∀ i : Fin 3, |n t i| ≤ N

proof.tactics:
by
  intro L n1 n hL H1 H2 H3
  have hexp : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, dotProduct v v = v 0 * v 0 + v 1 * v 1 + v 2 * v 2 := by
    intro v
    simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have hpos : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, 0 < dotProduct (n t) (n t) := by
    intro t ht
    have h0 : 0 ≤ dotProduct (n t) (n t) := by
      rw [hexp]
      nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg (n t 0), mul_self_nonneg (n t 1), mul_self_nonneg (n t 2)]
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne h0 (Ne.symm (H3 t ht))
  rcases H2 with ⟨a0, b0, a2, b2, hA⟩ | hB
  · obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ,
        f = fun t => (a0 - t * b0) * (a0 - t * b0) + n1 * n1 + (a2 - t * b2) * (a2 - t * b2) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hfc : Continuous f := by rw [hf]; fun_prop
    have hdot : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, dotProduct (n t) (n t) = f t := by
      intro t ht
      rw [hexp, H1 t ht, (hA t ht).1, (hA t ht).2, hf]
    obtain ⟨ts, hts, hmin⟩ := (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L)).exists_isMinOn
      (Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr hL.le) hfc.continuousOn
    refine ⟨f ts, |a0| + L * |b0| + |n1| + |a2| + L * |b2|, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hdot ts hts]; exact hpos ts hts
    · intro t ht
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hdot t ht]; exact hmin ht
      · have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := ht.1
        have htL : t ≤ L := ht.2
        have hb0 : |t * b0| ≤ L * |b0| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ht0]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htL (abs_nonneg _)
        have hb2 : |t * b2| ≤ L * |b2| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ht0]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htL (abs_nonneg _)
        have q1 := abs_nonneg a0
        have q2 := abs_nonneg a2
        have q3 := abs_nonneg n1
        have q4 : 0 ≤ L * |b0| := mul_nonneg hL.le (abs_nonneg _)
        have q5 : 0 ≤ L * |b2| := mul_nonneg hL.le (abs_nonneg _)
        have r1 := neg_abs_le a0
        have r2 := le_abs_self a0
        have r3 := neg_abs_le (t * b0)
        have r4 := le_abs_self (t * b0)
        have r5 := neg_abs_le a2
        have r6 := le_abs_self a2
        have r7 := neg_abs_le (t * b2)
        have r8 := le_abs_self (t * b2)
        have c0 : |n t 0| ≤ |a0| + L * |b0| + |n1| + |a2| + L * |b2| := by
          rw [(hA t ht).1]
          exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        have c1 : |n t 1| ≤ |a0| + L * |b0| + |n1| + |a2| + L * |b2| := by
          rw [H1 t ht]; linarith
        have c2 : |n t 2| ≤ |a0| + L * |b0| + |n1| + |a2| + L * |b2| := by
          rw [(hA t ht).2]
          exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        intro i
        fin_cases i
        · exact c0
        · exact c1
        · exact c2
  · have hL0 : (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L := Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr hL.le
    have hLL : L ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L := Set.right_mem_Icc.mpr hL.le
    have hd0 := hpos 0 hL0
    have hn1 : 0 < n1 * n1 := by
      have h := hpos L hLL
      rw [hexp, (hB L hLL hL.ne').1, (hB L hLL hL.ne').2, H1 L hLL] at h
      nlinarith
    refine ⟨min (n1 * n1) (dotProduct (n 0) (n 0)), |n 0 0| + |n 0 2| + |n1|, lt_min hn1 hd0, ?_⟩
    intro t ht
    have a1 := abs_nonneg (n 0 0)
    have a2 := abs_nonneg (n 0 2)
    have a3 := abs_nonneg n1
    by_cases ht0 : t = 0
    · subst ht0
      refine ⟨min_le_right _ _, ?_⟩
      have c0 : |n 0 0| ≤ |n 0 0| + |n 0 2| + |n1| := by linarith
      have c1 : |n 0 1| ≤ |n 0 0| + |n 0 2| + |n1| := by rw [H1 0 hL0]; linarith
      have c2 : |n 0 2| ≤ |n 0 0| + |n 0 2| + |n1| := by linarith
      intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact c0
      · exact c1
      · exact c2
    · obtain ⟨e0, e2⟩ := hB t ht ht0
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hexp (n t), e0, e2, H1 t ht]
        have := min_le_left (n1 * n1) (dotProduct (n 0) (n 0))
        nlinarith
      · have c0 : |n t 0| ≤ |n 0 0| + |n 0 2| + |n1| := by rw [e0, abs_zero]; linarith
        have c1 : |n t 1| ≤ |n 0 0| + |n 0 2| + |n1| := by rw [H1 t ht]; linarith
        have c2 : |n t 2| ≤ |n 0 0| + |n 0 2| + |n1| := by rw [e2, abs_zero]; linarith
        intro i
        fin_cases i
        · exact c0
        · exact c1
        · exact c2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G γ ξ hL hdich
  set L := Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 with hLdef
  
  have DD : ∀ (F : Cyl → ℝ) (η e : Cyl) (a b : ℝ),
      (∀ᶠ s in nhds (0:ℝ), F (η + s • e) = a - s * b) → |fderiv ℝ F η e| ≤ |b| := by
    intro F η e a b hF
    by_cases hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F η
    · have hℓ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => η + s • e) e 0 := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const e).const_add η
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (F ∘ fun s : ℝ => η + s • e) (fderiv ℝ F η e) 0 :=
        hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hℓ (by simp)
      have hg : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => a - s * b) (-b) 0 := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).mul_const b).const_sub a
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (F ∘ fun s : ℝ => η + s • e) (-b) 0 :=
        hg.congr_of_eventuallyEq hF
      rw [h1.unique h2, abs_neg]
    · rw [fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hd]
      simp
  have hpath : ∀ t s : ℝ, pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t + s • dVdir B.h γ.1 = pulsePth5 B G γ ξ (t + s) := by
    intro t s
    simp only [pulsePth5]
    rw [add_assoc, ← add_smul]
    congr 2
    ring
  have hnP : ∀ (η : Cyl) (i : Fin 3), nPhiP5 B G γ η i =
      fderiv ℝ (fun η' => nPhi5 B G γ η' i) η (dVdir B.h γ.1) := fun _ _ => rfl
  have hF1 : ∀ w : ℝ, nPhi5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ w) 1 = pang5 B G γ / RC γ.1 ξ := by
    intro w
    show pang5 B G γ / RC γ.1 (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ w) = pang5 B G γ / RC γ.1 ξ
    simp [RC, pulsePth5, dVdir]
  have hbd : ∀ (t : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (a b : ℝ) (U : Set ℝ), U ∈ nhds (0:ℝ) →
      (∀ s ∈ U, nPhi5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ (t + s)) i = a - s * b) →
      |nPhiP5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t) i| ≤ |b| := by
    intro t i a b U hU h
    rw [hnP]
    apply DD _ _ _ a b
    filter_upwards [hU] with s hs
    show nPhi5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t + s • dVdir B.h γ.1) i = a - s * b
    rw [hpath]
    exact h s hs
  have hb1 : ∀ t : ℝ, |nPhiP5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t) 1| ≤ 0 := by
    intro t
    have := hbd t 1 (pang5 B G γ / RC γ.1 ξ) 0 Set.univ Filter.univ_mem
      (fun s _ => by rw [hF1]; ring)
    rw [abs_zero] at this
    exact this
  rcases hdich with ⟨a0, b0, a2, b2, hD⟩ | hN
  · refine ⟨|b0| + |b2|, fun t ht i => ?_⟩
    have hU : Set.Ioo (-L / 2 - t) (3 * L / 2 - t) ∈ nhds (0:ℝ) :=
      Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.2])
    have hJ : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-L / 2 - t) (3 * L / 2 - t), t + s ∈ Set.Ioo (-L / 2) (3 * L / 2) := by
      intro s hs
      exact ⟨by linarith [hs.1], by linarith [hs.2]⟩
    have hB0 := abs_nonneg b0
    have hB2 := abs_nonneg b2
    fin_cases i
    · show |nPhiP5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t) 0| ≤ _
      have := hbd t 0 (a0 - t * b0) b0 _ hU (fun s hs => by rw [(hD _ (hJ s hs)).1]; ring)
      linarith
    · show |nPhiP5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t) 1| ≤ _
      have := hb1 t
      linarith
    · show |nPhiP5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t) 2| ≤ _
      have := hbd t 2 (a2 - t * b2) b2 _ hU (fun s hs => by rw [(hD _ (hJ s hs)).2]; ring)
      linarith
  · refine ⟨∑ k : Fin 3, |nPhiP5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0) k|, fun t ht i => ?_⟩
    have hP0 : 0 ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, |nPhiP5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0) k| :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => abs_nonneg _)
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht.1 with h0 | hpos
    · subst h0
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => |nPhiP5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ 0) k|)
        (fun k _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    · have hV : Set.Ioo (-t) (3 * L / 2 - t) ∈ nhds (0:ℝ) :=
        Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith [ht.2])
      have hJ : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-t) (3 * L / 2 - t),
          t + s ∈ Set.Ioo (-L / 2) (3 * L / 2) ∧ t + s ≠ 0 := by
        intro s hs
        refine ⟨⟨by linarith [hs.1], by linarith [hs.2]⟩, ?_⟩
        have := hs.1
        intro h
        linarith
      fin_cases i
      · show |nPhiP5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t) 0| ≤ _
        have := hbd t 0 0 0 _ hV
          (fun s hs => by rw [(hN _ (hJ s hs).1 (hJ s hs).2).1]; ring)
        rw [abs_zero] at this
        linarith
      · show |nPhiP5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t) 1| ≤ _
        have := hb1 t
        linarith
      · show |nPhiP5 B G γ (pulsePth5 B G γ ξ t) 2| ≤ _
        have := hbd t 2 0 0 _ hV
          (fun s hs => by rw [(hN _ (hJ s hs).1 (hJ s hs).2).2]; ring)
        rw [abs_zero] at this
        linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (v : ℝ), B.ok → 0 < G.r0 → G.r0 ≤ 1/100 → v ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) → ∀ s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, ((s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, Jpow (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1)) (G.ctr γ + (v * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0) • vtv)) : Cyl) ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → nPhi5 B G γ (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, Jpow (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1)) (G.ctr γ + (v * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0) • vtv)) = pcN5 B G γ s v ∧ nPhiP5 B G γ (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, Jpow (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1)) (G.ctr γ + (v * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0) • vtv)) = -pcPsi5 B G γ s ∧ Kmat B G γ (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, Jpow (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1)) (G.ctr γ + (v * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0) • vtv)) = pcKm5 B γ.1 s ∧ APhi5 B G γ (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, Jpow (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1)) (G.ctr γ + (v * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0) • vtv)) - dDamp5 B G γ (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, Jpow (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1)) (G.ctr γ + (v * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0) • vtv)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) = pcM5 B G γ s v ∧ (v = 0 → Bcol5 B G γ (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, Jpow (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1)) (G.ctr γ + (v * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0) • vtv)) 1 = (![1, 0, 0] - (pcN5 B G γ s 0 0 / pcNt5 B G γ s) • pcKa5 B G γ s) + (1 * c0f5 B G γ * Real.sqrt (1 + sco B G γ 0 ^ 2)) • ![0, pcKa5 B G γ s 2, -(pcKa5 B G γ s 1)])

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (v : ℝ), B.ok → 0 < G.r0 → G.r0 ≤ 1/100 → v ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) → ∀ s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, ((s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, Jpow (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1)) (G.ctr γ + (v * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0) • vtv)) : Cyl) ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → nPhi5 B G γ (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, Jpow (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1)) (G.ctr γ + (v * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0) • vtv)) = pcN5 B G γ s v ∧ nPhiP5 B G γ (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, Jpow (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1)) (G.ctr γ + (v * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0) • vtv)) = -pcPsi5 B G γ s ∧ Kmat B G γ (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, Jpow (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1)) (G.ctr γ + (v * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0) • vtv)) = pcKm5 B γ.1 s ∧ APhi5 B G γ (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, Jpow (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1)) (G.ctr γ + (v * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0) • vtv)) - dDamp5 B G γ (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, Jpow (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1)) (G.ctr γ + (v * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0) • vtv)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) = pcM5 B G γ s v ∧ (v = 0 → Bcol5 B G γ (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, Jpow (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1)) (G.ctr γ + (v * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0) • vtv)) 1 = (![1, 0, 0] - (pcN5 B G γ s 0 0 / pcNt5 B G γ s) • pcKa5 B G γ s) + (1 * c0f5 B G γ * Real.sqrt (1 + sco B G γ 0 ^ 2)) • ![0, pcKa5 B G γ s 2, -(pcKa5 B G γ s 1)])

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G γ v hB hr0 hr1 hv s hη
  obtain ⟨-, hvco, hxi, het⟩ := pulse5_point_rect B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) v hr0 hr1 hv
  have hQ : 0 < Qb γ.1 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hsq : 0 < Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQ
  
  have hA : ∀ t : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, pcA5 B G γ t 0 = sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 ∧
      pcA5 B G γ t 2 = pzr5 B G γ := by
    intro t
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = pzr5 B G γ / Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2 - B.h) / epsb B.h γ.1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ, b = sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 / Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    let Λ : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
      a • ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))) +
        b • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)
    have hΛx : ∀ x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, Λ x = a * x.2.1 + b * x.1 := by
      intro x
      simp [Λ]
    have hΛ : pcPhi1_5 B G γ = ⇑Λ := by
      funext x
      rw [hΛx]
      simp only [pcPhi1_5, pcRC5]
      rw [ha, hb]
      ring
    have hd : fderiv ℝ (pcPhi1_5 B G γ) t = Λ := by rw [hΛ]; exact Λ.fderiv
    have he : Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2 - B.h) * epsb B.h γ.1 = Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) := by
      unfold epsb
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hQ, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
      congr 1
      ring
    constructor
    · show Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi1_5 B G γ) t ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) = _
      rw [hd, hΛx]
      simp only [mul_zero, mul_one, zero_add]
      rw [hb]
      field_simp
    · show Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi1_5 B G γ) t ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) = _
      rw [hd, hΛx]
      simp only [mul_zero, mul_one, add_zero]
      rw [ha, div_div, he]
      field_simp
  obtain ⟨s1, s2, s3⟩ := s
  dsimp only at hη ⊢
  generalize hYd : Jpow (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1)) (G.ctr γ + (v * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0) • vtv) = Y at hvco hxi het hη ⊢
  obtain ⟨U, c, -, hηU, -, hU⟩ := nPhi5_local_model_v5 B G γ (s1, s2, s3, Y) hB hη hxi het
  have hN0 := (hU _ hηU).2
  obtain ⟨U', -, hηU', -, hU'⟩ := nPhiP5_local_model_v5 B G γ (s1, s2, s3, Y) hB hη hxi het
  have hNP0 := hU' _ hηU'
  have hK : Kmat B G γ (s1, s2, s3, Y) = pcKm5 B γ.1 (s1, s2, s3) := kmat_slow_form_v5 B G γ hB _ hη
  dsimp only at hN0 hNP0
  rw [hvco] at hN0
  obtain ⟨hA0, hA2⟩ := hA (s1, s2, s3)
  have hN : nPhi5 B G γ (s1, s2, s3, Y) = pcN5 B G γ (s1, s2, s3) v := by
    rw [hN0]
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · show sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 - v * (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) *
          fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) (s1, s2, s3) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) =
          pcA5 B G γ (s1, s2, s3) 0 - v * pcPsi5 B G γ (s1, s2, s3) 0
      rw [hA0]
      rfl
    · show pang5 B G γ / RC γ.1 (s1, s2, s3, Y) = pang5 B G γ / pcRC5 γ.1 (s1, s2, s3) - v * 0
      rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
      rfl
    · show pzr5 B G γ - v * (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) *
          fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) (s1, s2, s3) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) =
          pcA5 B G γ (s1, s2, s3) 2 - v * pcPsi5 B G γ (s1, s2, s3) 2
      rw [hA2]
      rfl
  have hNP : nPhiP5 B G γ (s1, s2, s3, Y) = -pcPsi5 B G γ (s1, s2, s3) := by
    rw [hNP0]
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · rfl
    · show (0:ℝ) = -(0:ℝ)
      rw [neg_zero]
    · rfl
  have hM : APhi5 B G γ (s1, s2, s3, Y) - dDamp5 B G γ (s1, s2, s3, Y) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) =
      pcM5 B G γ (s1, s2, s3) v := by
    unfold APhi5 dDamp5 pcM5
    rw [hN, hNP, hK]
  refine ⟨hN, hNP, hK, hM, ?_⟩
  intro hv0
  subst hv0
  simp only [Bcol5, ntan5, hN, hvco]
  rfl

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h r0 : ℝ) (γ : Lab) (c : ℝ × ℝ) (v : ℝ), 0 < r0 → r0 ≤ 1/100 → v ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb h r0 γ.1) → inRect h γ c r0 (Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c + (v * cib h γ.1 - r0) • vtv)) ∧ vco h r0 γ c (Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c + (v * cib h γ.1 - r0) • vtv)) = v ∧ |xiG h γ c (Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c + (v * cib h γ.1 - r0) • vtv))| < 1/8 ∧ |etG h γ c (Jpow (-(bandIdx h γ.1)) (c + (v * cib h γ.1 - r0) • vtv))| < 1/8

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab), B.ok → (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => pcA5 B G γ s i) {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => pcPsi5 B G γ s i) {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => pcKm5 B γ.1 s i j) {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}) ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => fun i j : Fin 3 => pcM5 B G γ s v i j) {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}

signature.name: pulse5_slow_smooth_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab), B.ok → (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => pcA5 B G γ s i) {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => pcPsi5 B G γ s i) {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => pcKm5 B γ.1 s i j) {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}) ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => fun i j : Fin 3 => pcM5 B G γ s v i j) {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G γ hB
  have hSlow : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} ∧
      ∀ (l : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => baseC B l (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2, ((0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) i)
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
    obtain ⟨hS, hBP⟩ := hB
    have hsc : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hA : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
      have hm : Continuous (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2)) := by fun_prop
      have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2)))
          {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} := by
        refine hsc.comp hm.continuousOn ?_
        intro s hs
        have hs' : s.2.2 < 1 := hs
        exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - s.2.2 by linarith⟩
      have hU : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
      have h1 := hc.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := B.qB))
      have h2 : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst
      have e : {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} =
          {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1} ∩ ({s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} ∩
            ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2))) ⁻¹'
              Set.Iio B.qB) := by
        ext s
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Iio, Function.comp]
      rw [e]
      exact h2.inter h1
    have hD : IsOpen (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      have hm : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)) := by fun_prop
      have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)))
          {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
        refine hsc.comp hm.continuousOn ?_
        intro w hw
        have hw' : w.2 < 1 := hw
        exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 by linarith⟩
      have hU : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
      have h1 := hc.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := B.qB))
      have e : simDomain B.h B.qB = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
          ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2))) ⁻¹' Set.Iio B.qB := by
        ext w
        simp only [simDomain, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Iio, Function.comp]
      rw [e]
      exact h1
    have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(uB B)) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      have hAB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿B.AB) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := hBP.2.2.2.1.1
      have hBv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿B.BvB) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := hBP.2.2.2.1.2.1
      have hDA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z) (simDomain B.h B.qB) :=
        ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hD).1 hAB).2
      have hc : ∀ (v : ℝ³) (j : Fin 3),
          ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (v, (0:ℝ)) j) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
        intro v j
        have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (v, (0:ℝ))) (simDomain B.h B.qB) :=
          hDA.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
        exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h1
      let e0 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1
      let e1 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 1 1
      let e2 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 2 1
      have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e1, (0:ℝ)) 2 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e2, (0:ℝ)) 1) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e2, (0:ℝ)) 0 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e0, (0:ℝ)) 2) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e0, (0:ℝ)) 1 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e1, (0:ℝ)) 0) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) + (↿B.BvB) z) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
        refine ((((hc e1 2).sub (hc e2 1)).smul contDiffOn_const).add
          (((hc e2 0).sub (hc e0 2)).smul contDiffOn_const)).add
          (((hc e0 1).sub (hc e1 0)).smul contDiffOn_const) |>.add hBv
      refine hg.congr ?_
      rintro ⟨y, s⟩ hz
      have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s) :=
        (hAB.contDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have hpart : fderiv ℝ (fun w => B.AB w s) y =
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := by
        have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ³ => (w, s)) (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) y :=
          hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left y s
        have h2 : HasFDerivAt ((↿B.AB) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ => (w, s)))
            ((fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)) y :=
          HasFDerivAt.comp (g := ↿B.AB) y hdiff.hasFDerivAt h1
        exact h2.fderiv
      show curl3 (fun w => B.AB w s) y + B.BvB y s = _
      unfold curl3
      rw [hpart]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.inl_apply]
      rfl
    have frame : ∀ r z : ℝ, 0 < r → (rotPt r 0 z) 2 = z ∧
        eR (rotPt r 0 z) = EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) ∧
        eTh (rotPt r 0 z) = EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) := by
      intro r z hr
      have h0 : (rotPt r 0 z) 0 = r := by simp [rotPt]
      have h1 : (rotPt r 0 z) 1 = 0 := by simp [rotPt]
      have h2 : (rotPt r 0 z) 2 = z := by simp [rotPt]
      have hrad : rad (rotPt r 0 z) = r := by
        unfold rad
        rw [h0, h1]
        simp [Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
      refine ⟨h2, ?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold eR radVec
        rw [hrad, h0, h1, zero_smul, add_zero, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
      · unfold eTh azVec
        rw [hrad, h0, h1, neg_zero, zero_smul, zero_add, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
    let ψ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ³ × ℝ := fun s => (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1, s.2.2)
    have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ := by
      have hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1) := by
        unfold rotPt
        fun_prop
      exact hr.prodMk (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd)
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo ψ {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}
        (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      intro s hs
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hs
      show s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ((rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1) 2) (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB
      rw [(frame s.1 s.2.1 h1).1]
      exact ⟨h2, h3⟩
    refine ⟨hA, fun l i => ?_⟩
    have hcomp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((↿(uB B)) ∘ ψ)
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} :=
      hu.comp hψ.contDiffOn hmaps
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s => Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * inner ℝ (((↿(uB B)) ∘ ψ) s)
        ((![EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ), eZ] :
          Fin 3 → ℝ³) i))
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} :=
      contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.inner ℝ hcomp contDiffOn_const)
    refine hg.congr ?_
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨_, f2, f3⟩ := frame s.1 s.2.1 hs.1
    show Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * inner ℝ (uB B (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1) s.2.2)
        (![eR (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1), eTh (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1), eZ] i) = _
    rw [f2, f3]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨hΩ, hbase⟩ := hSlow
  set Ω := {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} with hΩe
  have hQ : 0 < Qb γ.1 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hsQ : 0 < Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQ
  have hkb : (0:ℝ) < (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) := by
    have : 0 < kb B.h γ.1 := Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ _) _)
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hpint : pint5 B G γ ≠ 0 := by
    unfold pint5; split_ifs with h
    · exact one_ne_zero
    · exact h
  have hpang : pang5 B G γ ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero (Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hpint) hkb.ne'
  have hRC : ∀ s ∈ Ω, pcRC5 γ.1 s ≠ 0 := fun s hs => div_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hs.1) hsQ.ne'
  have hRCs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pcRC5 γ.1) := by unfold pcRC5; fun_prop
  have hb : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcB5 B γ.1 i) Ω := fun i => hbase γ.1 i
  have hFa : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcFa5 B γ.1) Ω := (hb 1).div hRCs.contDiffOn hRC
  have hP1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pcPhi1_5 B G γ) := by unfold pcPhi1_5 pcRC5; fun_prop
  have hP1on : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcPhi1_5 B G γ) Ω := hP1.contDiffOn
  have hP2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) Ω := (contDiffOn_const.mul hFa).add (contDiffOn_const.mul (hb 2))
  have hD : ∀ f : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω → ∀ e : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s => fderiv ℝ f s e) Ω := by
    intro f hf e
    exact ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ).1 hf).2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hA : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s => pcA5 B G γ s i) Ω := by
    intro i; fin_cases i
    · exact (contDiffOn_const.mul (hD _ hP1on _) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun s => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi1_5 B G γ) s ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) Ω)
    · exact (contDiffOn_const.div hRCs.contDiffOn hRC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun s => pang5 B G γ / pcRC5 γ.1 s) Ω)
    · exact (contDiffOn_const.mul (hD _ hP1on _) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun s => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi1_5 B G γ) s ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) Ω)
  have hPs : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s => pcPsi5 B G γ s i) Ω := by
    intro i; fin_cases i
    · exact (contDiffOn_const.mul (hD _ hP2 _) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun s => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) s ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) Ω)
    · exact (contDiffOn_const : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (0:ℝ)) Ω)
    · exact (contDiffOn_const.mul (hD _ hP2 _) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun s => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) s ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) Ω)
  have hKm : ∀ k j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s => pcKm5 B γ.1 s k j) Ω := by
    intro k j
    fin_cases k <;> fin_cases j <;>
    first
    | exact (contDiffOn_const : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (0:ℝ)) Ω)
    | exact (contDiffOn_const.mul hFa : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s => -2 * pcFa5 B γ.1 s) Ω)
    | exact ((contDiffOn_const.mul hFa).add (hRCs.contDiffOn.mul (contDiffOn_const.mul (hD _ hFa _))) :
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s => 2 * pcFa5 B γ.1 s + pcRC5 γ.1 s *
          (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcFa5 B γ.1) s ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))) Ω)
    | exact (contDiffOn_const.mul (hD _ (hb 2) _) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun s => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcB5 B γ.1 2) s ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) Ω)
  have hN1 : ∀ s v, pcN5 B G γ s v 1 = pang5 B G γ / pcRC5 γ.1 s := by
    intro s v; show pang5 B G γ / pcRC5 γ.1 s - v * 0 = _; ring
  let Mf : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ := fun s v => pcM5 B G γ s v
  have hMs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => Mf w.1 w.2) (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo Prod.fst (Ω ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) Ω := fun w hw => hw.1
    have hKw : ∀ k j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => pcKm5 B γ.1 w.1 k j) (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
      fun k j => (hKm k j).comp contDiffOn_fst hmaps
    have hPw : ∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => pcPsi5 B G γ w.1 k) (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
      fun k => (hPs k).comp contDiffOn_fst hmaps
    have hNw : ∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2 k) (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
      fun k => ((hA k).comp contDiffOn_fst hmaps).sub (contDiffOn_snd.mul (hPw k))
    have hdot : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ =>
        dotProduct (pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2) (pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2)) (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
      show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ =>
        ∑ k, pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2 k * pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2 k) (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ)
      exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun k _ => (hNw k).mul (hNw k))
    have hne : ∀ w ∈ Ω ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ),
        dotProduct (pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2) (pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2) ≠ 0 := by
      intro w hw
      have h1 : pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2 1 ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hN1]; exact div_ne_zero hpang (hRC _ hw.1)
      have q1 := mul_self_pos.2 h1
      have q0 := mul_self_nonneg (pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2 0)
      have q2 := mul_self_nonneg (pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2 2)
      rw [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      exact ne_of_gt (by linarith)
    have hinv := hdot.inv hne
    rw [contDiffOn_pi]; intro i; rw [contDiffOn_pi]; intro j
    have hdK : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ =>
        dotProduct (pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2) (fun k => pcKm5 B γ.1 w.1 k j)) (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
      show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ =>
        ∑ k, pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2 k * pcKm5 B γ.1 w.1 k j) (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ)
      exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun k _ => (hNw k).mul (hKw k j))
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => -pcKm5 B γ.1 w.1 i j +
      (dotProduct (pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2) (pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2))⁻¹ * (pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2 i *
        (dotProduct (pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2) (fun k => pcKm5 B γ.1 w.1 k j) - -pcPsi5 B G γ w.1 j)) -
      epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ))^2 * dotProduct (pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2) (pcN5 B G γ w.1 w.2) *
        (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i j) (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ)
    exact (((hKw i j).neg).add (hinv.mul ((hNw i).mul (hdK.sub (hPw j).neg)))).sub
      ((contDiffOn_const.mul hdot).mul contDiffOn_const)
  refine ⟨hA, hPs, hKm, fun v => ?_⟩
  have hι : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s, v)) := contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const
  have hmaps' : Set.MapsTo (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s, v)) Ω (Ω ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
    fun s hs => ⟨hs, Set.mem_univ v⟩
  have hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((fun w : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => Mf w.1 w.2) ∘
      (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s, v))) Ω :=
    hMs.comp hι.contDiffOn hmaps'
  exact hc

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ D : ℝ, 0 ≤ D ∧ ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), ActiveL4 B G γ → ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → (∀ i : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => pcN5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) v i) j ξ ≤ D * SC B.h ξ) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => pcPsi5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) i) j ξ ≤ D * SC B.h ξ) ∧ (∀ i i' : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => pcKm5 B γ.1 (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) i i') j ξ ≤ D * SC B.h ξ)

signature.name: pulse5_slow_entries_nb_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ D : ℝ, 0 ≤ D ∧ ∀ (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), ActiveL4 B G γ → ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB → etaL B.h γ ξ ≠ 0 → B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1), ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → (∀ i : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => pcN5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) v i) j ξ ≤ D * SC B.h ξ) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => pcPsi5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) i) j ξ ≤ D * SC B.h ξ) ∧ (∀ i i' : Fin 3, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => pcKm5 B γ.1 (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) i i') j ξ ≤ D * SC B.h ξ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hB hG k
  obtain ⟨hΩo, hbase⟩ := geom_slow_base_smooth_v5 B hB
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, -, -, -, -, hqB0, hqB1, -, -, -, -⟩ := hB.2.1
  obtain ⟨hr0, hr01, hu0, -, hlmin⟩ := hG.1
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁0, hC₁⟩ := pulse5_consts_v5 B G hB hG
  choose C2 hC2 using slow_profile_nb_qB_v5 B hB
  choose Ci hCi using inv_r_nb_v5 B hB
  have hsum : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ) (j : ℕ), j ≤ k → |f j| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |f i| :=
    fun f j hj => Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |f i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  have hs0 : ∀ f : ℕ → ℝ, 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |f i| :=
    fun f => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨S2, hS2⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |C2 i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Si, hSi⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Ci i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = 4 * Real.sqrt B.Xb + 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hS20 : 0 ≤ S2 := by rw [hS2]; exact hs0 C2
  have hSi0 : 0 ≤ Si := by rw [hSi]; exact hs0 Ci
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ R := by rw [hR]; positivity
  obtain ⟨Aa, hAa⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = C₁ * G.ustar + C₁ + C₁ * Si := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Pp, hPp⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = 2 * C₁ * S2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Kk, hKk⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = 3 * S2 + 2 ^ k * R * S2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hAa0 : 0 ≤ Aa := by
    rw [hAa]
    have := mul_nonneg hC₁0.le hu0.le
    have := mul_nonneg hC₁0.le hSi0
    linarith
  have hPp0 : 0 ≤ Pp := by
    rw [hPp]
    have := mul_nonneg hC₁0.le hS20
    linarith
  have hKk0 : 0 ≤ Kk := by
    rw [hKk]
    have := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2) k) hR0) hS20
    linarith
  refine ⟨Aa + Pp + Kk, by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro γ ξ hact hξ hη hX1 hX2 v hv j hj
  obtain ⟨hBs, hpz, hpa, -, -, -, -⟩ := hC₁ γ hact
  
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hB.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ.2.1])).1
  obtain ⟨hw1, hw2⟩ := etaL_band_window_v5 B.h γ ξ hq0 hη
  have hw1' : 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 := by linarith
  have hw2' : qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 := by linarith
  have hXa2 : B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ := by linarith
  have hXb2 : XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb := by linarith
  have hqh0 : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ B.h := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
  have hqh1 : qC B.h ξ ^ B.h ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one hq0.le (le_trans hξ.2.2.le hqB1) hh0.le
  have hQ : 0 < Qb γ.1 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hQs : 0 < Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQ
  have hSC1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
    show 1 ≤ (1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)|) ^ 2
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))]
  
  have hl1 : 1 ≤ γ.1 := le_trans (by norm_num) (le_trans hlmin hact.1)
  have hl0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (γ.1:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hT6 : Tgc < 6 := by
    have : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)]; norm_num
    unfold Tgc; linarith
  have hT0 : 0 < Tgc := by unfold Tgc; positivity
  have hlpos : (0:ℝ) < (γ.1:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hl1
  have hTl : 0 < Tgc * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨hc1, -⟩ := cib_band_bounds5 B.h γ.1 hl1
  have hcib : 0 < cib B.h γ.1 := lt_trans (div_pos one_pos hTl) hc1
  have hc1' : 1 < cib B.h γ.1 * (Tgc * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2) := (div_lt_iff₀ hTl).1 hc1
  have hL : Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 ≤ (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 / 4 := by
    show 2 * G.r0 / cib B.h γ.1 ≤ _
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hcib (by norm_num)]
    have hcl : 0 < cib B.h γ.1 * (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 := mul_pos hcib (by positivity)
    have h6 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT6.le hcl.le
    nlinarith
  have hq2 : qC B.h ξ < 2 * Qb γ.1 := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hQ] at hw2; linarith
  have hlogQ : Real.log (Qb γ.1) = -(γ.1:ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by
    show Real.log ((2:ℝ) ^ (-(γ.1:ℝ))) = _
    rw [Real.log_rpow (by norm_num)]
  have hlogq : Real.log (qC B.h ξ) < Real.log 2 - (γ.1:ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by
    have := Real.log_lt_log hq0 hq2
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hQ.ne', hlogQ] at this
    linarith
  have habs : (γ.1:ℝ) / 2 ≤ 1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)| := by
    have hl2 := Real.log_two_gt_d9
    have hl2' := Real.log_two_lt_d9
    have h3 := neg_le_abs (Real.log (qC B.h ξ))
    have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl2.le hl0
    nlinarith
  have hSCl : (γ.1:ℝ) ^ 2 / 4 ≤ SC B.h ξ := by
    have h := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ (γ.1:ℝ) / 2) habs 2
    show _ ≤ (1 + |Real.log (qC B.h ξ)|) ^ 2
    nlinarith [h]
  have hvSC : v ≤ SC B.h ξ := le_trans hv.2 (le_trans hL hSCl)
  
  set Ω := {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} with hΩe
  have hU : IsOpen (DomC B.h B.qB) := by
    have e : DomC B.h B.qB = (fun x : Cyl => ((x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) ⁻¹' Ω := by
      ext η; exact Iff.rfl
    rw [e]
    exact hΩo.preimage (by fun_prop)
  have hπ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : Cyl => ((x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
  have hgerm : ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ), (∀ η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, f η = g η) →
      NB B.h f j ξ = NB B.h g j ξ := by
    intro f g hfg
    unfold NB
    rw [((Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hξ) hfg).iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds]
  have hat : ∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h B.qB) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f ξ :=
    fun f hf => hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)
  have hNB0 : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (i : ℕ), 0 ≤ NB B.h f i ξ := fun f i => by
    unfold NB; exact norm_nonneg _
  have hRC : ∀ s ∈ Ω, pcRC5 γ.1 s ≠ 0 := fun s hs => div_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hs.1) hQs.ne'
  have hRCs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pcRC5 γ.1) := by unfold pcRC5; fun_prop
  have hb : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcB5 B γ.1 i) Ω := fun i => hbase γ.1 i
  have hFa : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcFa5 B γ.1) Ω := (hb 1).div hRCs.contDiffOn hRC
  have hP : ∀ F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F Ω →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1)) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
    fun F hF => hF.comp hπ.contDiffOn (fun η hη => hη)
  have hDv : ∀ F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F Ω → ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) w)
        (DomC B.h B.qB) := by
    intro F hF w
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s => fderiv ℝ F s w) Ω :=
      (hF.fderiv_of_isOpen hΩo (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (h1.comp hπ.contDiffOn (fun η hη => hη))
  have hRi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) / η.1) (DomC B.h B.qB) :=
    contDiffOn_const.div (by fun_prop) (fun η hη => ne_of_gt hη.1)
  have hRCc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => RC γ.1 η) := by unfold RC; fun_prop
  
  have hFF : ∀ F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, (F = pcFa5 B γ.1 ∨ F = pcB5 B γ.1 2) → ∀ i, i ≤ k →
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1)) i ξ ≤ S2 ∧
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1)
        ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) i ξ ≤ S2 ∧
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1)
        ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) i ξ ≤ S2 := by
    intro F hF i hi
    obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := hC2 i γ.1 ξ hξ hw1' hw2' hXa2 hXb2 F hF
    have hc : C2 i ≤ S2 := (le_abs_self _).trans (by rw [hS2]; exact hsum C2 i hi)
    refine ⟨c1.trans hc, c2.trans hc, c3.trans ?_⟩
    calc C2 i * qC B.h ξ ^ B.h ≤ |C2 i| * qC B.h ξ ^ B.h :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hqh0
      _ ≤ |C2 i| * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqh1 (abs_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ S2 := by rw [mul_one, hS2]; exact hsum C2 i hi
  have hRib : ∀ i, i ≤ k → NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) / η.1) i ξ ≤ Si :=
    fun i hi => (hCi i γ.1 ξ hξ.1 hξ.2.1 hw1' hXa2).trans
      ((le_abs_self _).trans (by rw [hSi]; exact hsum Ci i hi))
  have hRCb : ∀ i, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => RC γ.1 η) i ξ ≤ R := fun i => by
    rw [hR]; exact rc_nb_v5 B hB γ.1 ξ hξ.1 hξ.2.1 hw2' hXb2 i
  
  have hconst : ∀ a : ℝ, NB B.h (fun _ : Cyl => a) j ξ ≤ |a| := by
    intro a
    refine ((nb_real_algebra_v5 B.h _ ξ hU hξ (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) (fun _ => (0:ℝ))
      contDiffOn_const contDiffOn_const j).2.2 a).trans ?_
    split_ifs
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact abs_nonneg a
  have hlin : ∀ f g : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h B.qB) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (DomC B.h B.qB) →
      ∀ a b : ℝ, NB B.h (fun η => a * f η + b * g η) j ξ ≤ |a| * NB B.h f j ξ + |b| * NB B.h g j ξ :=
    fun f g hf hg a b => (nb_real_algebra_v5 B.h _ ξ hU hξ f g hf hg j).2.1 a b
  have hsc : ∀ f : Cyl → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (DomC B.h B.qB) → ∀ a : ℝ,
      NB B.h (fun η => a * f η) j ξ ≤ |a| * NB B.h f j ξ := by
    intro f hf a
    have e : (fun η => a * f η) = fun η => a * f η + 0 * f η := by funext η; ring
    rw [e]
    refine (hlin f f hf hf a 0).trans ?_
    simp
  have hsg : |sgn γ.2.2| = 1 := by unfold sgn; split_ifs <;> simp
  
  have hA0 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => pcA5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) 0) (DomC B.h B.qB) ∧
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => pcA5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) 0) j ξ ≤ Aa := by
    have e : (fun η : Cyl => pcA5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) 0) =
        fun _ => sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 :=
      funext fun η => (pcA5_const_v5 B G γ _).1
    rw [e]
    refine ⟨contDiffOn_const, (hconst _).trans ?_⟩
    rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_mul, hsg, abs_of_pos hu0, abs_two]
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hBs hu0.le
    have := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg (Bs5 B G γ)) hu0.le
    have := mul_nonneg hC₁0.le hSi0
    rw [hAa]; linarith
  have hA2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => pcA5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) 2) (DomC B.h B.qB) ∧
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => pcA5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) 2) j ξ ≤ Aa := by
    have e : (fun η : Cyl => pcA5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) 2) = fun _ => pzr5 B G γ :=
      funext fun η => (pcA5_const_v5 B G γ _).2
    rw [e]
    refine ⟨contDiffOn_const, (hconst _).trans ?_⟩
    have := mul_nonneg hC₁0.le hu0.le
    have := mul_nonneg hC₁0.le hSi0
    rw [hAa]; linarith
  have hA1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => pcA5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) 1) (DomC B.h B.qB) ∧
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => pcA5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) 1) j ξ ≤ Aa := by
    have e : (fun η : Cyl => pcA5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) 1) =
        fun η => pang5 B G γ * (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) / η.1) + 0 * (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) / η.1) := by
      funext η
      show pang5 B G γ / (η.1 / Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1)) = _
      rw [div_div_eq_mul_div, mul_div_assoc]
      ring
    rw [e]
    refine ⟨(contDiffOn_const.mul hRi).add (contDiffOn_const.mul hRi), (hlin _ _ hRi hRi _ _).trans ?_⟩
    rw [abs_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
    have := mul_le_mul hpa (hRib j hj) (hNB0 _ _) hC₁0.le
    have := mul_nonneg hC₁0.le hu0.le
    rw [hAa]; linarith
  have hA : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => pcA5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) i) (DomC B.h B.qB) ∧
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => pcA5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) i) j ξ ≤ Aa := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hA0
    · exact hA1
    · exact hA2
  
  have hPhi2 : ∀ s ∈ Ω, fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) s =
      pang5 B G γ • fderiv ℝ (pcFa5 B γ.1) s + pzr5 B G γ • fderiv ℝ (pcB5 B γ.1 2) s := by
    intro s hs
    have d1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (pcFa5 B γ.1) s :=
      (hFa.contDiffAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hs)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have d2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (pcB5 B γ.1 2) s :=
      ((hb 2).contDiffAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hs)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have h := (d1.hasFDerivAt.const_mul (pang5 B G γ)).add (d2.hasFDerivAt.const_mul (pzr5 B G γ))
    have e : pcPhi2_5 B G γ = fun y => pang5 B G γ * pcFa5 B γ.1 y + pzr5 B G γ * pcB5 B γ.1 2 y := rfl
    rw [e]
    exact h.fderiv
  have hPsi0e : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, pcPsi5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) 0 =
      pang5 B G γ * (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcFa5 B γ.1) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) +
      pzr5 B G γ * (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcB5 B γ.1 2) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) := by
    intro η hη
    show Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [hPhi2 (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) hη]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hPsi2e : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, pcPsi5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) 2 =
      pang5 B G γ * (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcFa5 B γ.1) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) +
      pzr5 B G γ * (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcB5 B γ.1 2) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) := by
    intro η hη
    show Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) * fderiv ℝ (pcPhi2_5 B G γ) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [hPhi2 (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) hη]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hPs0 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => pcPsi5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) 0) (DomC B.h B.qB) ∧
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => pcPsi5 B G γ (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) 0) j ξ ≤ Pp := by

    fun f hf => hf.contDiffAt (hU'.mem_nhds hξ')
  
  have hnegPs : ∀ i j, NB h (fun η => -Ps i η) j ξ ≤ NB h (Ps i) j ξ := by
    intro i j
    have e1 : (fun η => -Ps i η) = (fun η => (-1) * Ps i η + 0 * Ps i η) := by

    rw [e1]
    have := (nb_real_algebra_v5 h U ξ hU hξ (Ps i) (Ps i) (hPs i) (hPs i) j).2.1 (-1) 0
    have hm1 : |(-1:ℝ)| = 1 := by norm_num

      (fun j' hj' => ⟨(hB j' (by omega)).1,
        fun i => (hnegPs i j').trans ((hB j' (by omega)).2.1 i), (hB j' (by omega)).2.2⟩) b

  have hprod : NB h (fun η => n a η * Q η) k ξ ≤ 2 ^ k * (D * Sv) * (Cs * Sv ^ (2 * k + 2)) :=

  have hsq : ∀ m, NB h (fun η => n m η * n m η) k ξ ≤ 2 ^ k * (D * Sv) * (D * Sv) := fun m =>

  have hsqs : ∀ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => n m η * n m η) U' := fun m => (hn' m).mul (hn' m)
  have hg01 : NB h (fun η => n 0 η * n 0 η + n 1 η * n 1 η) k ξ ≤

  have hdamp : NB h (fun η => e * g η * (if a = b then (1:ℝ) else 0)) k ξ ≤

    have e1 : (fun η => e * g η * (if a = b then (1:ℝ) else 0)) =

    funext η
    simp only [hQ_def, hW_def, hg_def]

  rw [eE]
  have h1 := (nb_real_algebra_v5 h U' ξ hU' hξ' _ _ hF' hDm' k).2.1 1 (-1)

        12 * 2 ^ k * D ^ 2 * Sv ^ (2 * k + 3) := by

subgoal_signatures.name: nb_pres_quot_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (c D : ℝ), 0 < c → ∃ C' : ℝ, ∀ (h Sv : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (n p : Fin 3 → Cyl → ℝ) (K : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Cyl → ℝ), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → 1 ≤ Sv → (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (n i) U) → (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (p i) U) → (∀ i j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (K i j) U) → c ≤ n 0 ξ * n 0 ξ + n 1 ξ * n 1 ξ + n 2 ξ * n 2 ξ → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → (∀ i, NB h (n i) j ξ ≤ D * Sv) ∧ (∀ i, NB h (p i) j ξ ≤ D * Sv) ∧ ∀ i i', NB h (K i i') j ξ ≤ D * Sv) → ∀ j : Fin 3, NB h (fun η => (n 0 η * n 0 η + n 1 η * n 1 η + n 2 η * n 2 η)⁻¹ * (n 0 η * K 0 j η + n 1 η * K 1 j η + n 2 η * K 2 j η - p j η)) k ξ ≤ C' * Sv ^ (2 * k + 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: nb_real_algebra_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → ∀ k : ℕ, NB h (fun η => f η * g η) k ξ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h g (k - i) ξ ∧ (∀ a b : ℝ, NB h (fun η => a * f η + b * g η) k ξ ≤ |a| * NB h f k ξ + |b| * NB h g k ξ) ∧ (∀ a : ℝ, NB h (fun _ : Cyl => a) k ξ ≤ if k = 0 then |a| else 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: nb_real_mul_le_v5
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (a b : Cyl → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (A E : ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ a ξ → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ b ξ → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h a i ξ ≤ A) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → NB h b i ξ ≤ E) → NB h (fun η => a η * b η) k ξ ≤ 2 ^ k * A * E

by

      ![1, -(z.2.1 / Real.sqrt ((z.2.2.2.1 / z.1) ^ 2 + z.2.2.2.2 ^ 2)) *
            (z.2.2.2.1 / z.1 / Real.sqrt ((z.2.2.2.1 / z.1) ^ 2 + z.2.2.2.2 ^ 2)) +
          z.2.2.1 * (z.2.2.2.2 / Real.sqrt ((z.2.2.2.1 / z.1) ^ 2 + z.2.2.2.2 ^ 2)),
        -(z.2.1 / Real.sqrt ((z.2.2.2.1 / z.1) ^ 2 + z.2.2.2.2 ^ 2)) *
