informal_problem.statement: ∀ (F0 E N1 N2 Bs s ek : ℝ) (t : Fin 3 → ℝ), N1 ^ 2 + N2 ^ 2 = 1 → Bs ≠ 0 → ((-!![0, -2 * F0, 0; 2 * F0 + E * N1, 0, 0; E * N2, 0, 0] + (dotProduct ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1])⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] (Matrix.vecMul ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] !![0, -2 * F0, 0; 2 * F0 + E * N1, 0, 0; E * N2, 0, 0])).mulVec t - (ek * dotProduct ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1]) • t) 0 = 2 * F0 * N1 / (1 + s ^ 2) * (N1 * t 1 + N2 * t 2) - 2 * F0 * N2 / (1 + s ^ 2) * ((-N2 * t 1 + N1 * t 2) + s * t 0) - ek * (Bs ^ 2 * (1 + s ^ 2)) * t 0 ∧ N1 * ((-!![0, -2 * F0, 0; 2 * F0 + E * N1, 0, 0; E * N2, 0, 0] + (dotProduct ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1])⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] (Matrix.vecMul ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] !![0, -2 * F0, 0; 2 * F0 + E * N1, 0, 0; E * N2, 0, 0])).mulVec t - (ek * dotProduct ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1]) • t) 1 + N2 * ((-!![0, -2 * F0, 0; 2 * F0 + E * N1, 0, 0; E * N2, 0, 0] + (dotProduct ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1])⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] (Matrix.vecMul ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] !![0, -2 * F0, 0; 2 * F0 + E * N1, 0, 0; E * N2, 0, 0])).mulVec t - (ek * dotProduct ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1]) • t) 2 = -(2 * F0 * N1 + E) * t 0 - ek * (Bs ^ 2 * (1 + s ^ 2)) * (N1 * t 1 + N2 * t 2)

signature.name: ptm_refid5
signature.statement: ∀ (F0 E N1 N2 Bs s ek : ℝ) (t : Fin 3 → ℝ), N1 ^ 2 + N2 ^ 2 = 1 → Bs ≠ 0 → ((-!![0, -2 * F0, 0; 2 * F0 + E * N1, 0, 0; E * N2, 0, 0] + (dotProduct ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1])⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] (Matrix.vecMul ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] !![0, -2 * F0, 0; 2 * F0 + E * N1, 0, 0; E * N2, 0, 0])).mulVec t - (ek * dotProduct ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1]) • t) 0 = 2 * F0 * N1 / (1 + s ^ 2) * (N1 * t 1 + N2 * t 2) - 2 * F0 * N2 / (1 + s ^ 2) * ((-N2 * t 1 + N1 * t 2) + s * t 0) - ek * (Bs ^ 2 * (1 + s ^ 2)) * t 0 ∧ N1 * ((-!![0, -2 * F0, 0; 2 * F0 + E * N1, 0, 0; E * N2, 0, 0] + (dotProduct ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1])⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] (Matrix.vecMul ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] !![0, -2 * F0, 0; 2 * F0 + E * N1, 0, 0; E * N2, 0, 0])).mulVec t - (ek * dotProduct ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1]) • t) 1 + N2 * ((-!![0, -2 * F0, 0; 2 * F0 + E * N1, 0, 0; E * N2, 0, 0] + (dotProduct ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1])⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] (Matrix.vecMul ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] !![0, -2 * F0, 0; 2 * F0 + E * N1, 0, 0; E * N2, 0, 0])).mulVec t - (ek * dotProduct ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1]) • t) 2 = -(2 * F0 * N1 + E) * t 0 - ek * (Bs ^ 2 * (1 + s ^ 2)) * (N1 * t 1 + N2 * t 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro F0 E N1 N2 Bs s ek t hNN hBs
  have hd : dotProduct ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] ![Bs * s, Bs * (-N2), Bs * N1] = Bs ^ 2 * (1 + s ^ 2) := by
    simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons]
    linear_combination Bs ^ 2 * hNN
  have hs : (1 + s ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have h1 : Bs * Bs⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hBs
  have h2 : (1 + s ^ 2) * (1 + s ^ 2)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hs
  have hDi : (Bs ^ 2 * (1 + s ^ 2))⁻¹ = Bs⁻¹ * Bs⁻¹ * (1 + s ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    rw [mul_inv, sq, mul_inv]
  rw [hd, hDi]
  constructor
  · simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.vecMul, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three,
      Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
      Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.empty_val', Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, Matrix.head_fin_const,
      smul_eq_mul]
    linear_combination (-2 * F0 * s * (1 + s ^ 2)⁻¹ * (N2 * t 0 + s * t 1) * (Bs * Bs⁻¹ + 1)) * h1
      + (-2 * F0 * (1 + s ^ 2)⁻¹ * t 1) * hNN + (-2 * F0 * t 1) * h2
  · simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.vecMul, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three,
      Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
      Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.empty_val', Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, Matrix.head_fin_const,
      smul_eq_mul]
    linear_combination (-E * t 0) * hNN

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B1 c δ ek : ℝ) (n nr ψ t : Fin 3 → ℝ) (K Kr : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), 0 ≤ B1 → 0 < c → 0 ≤ δ → δ ≤ 1 → δ ≤ c / (6 * (2 * B1 + 1)) → 0 ≤ ek → ek ≤ 4 → (∀ i, |nr i| ≤ B1) → (∀ i j, |Kr i j| ≤ B1) → c ≤ dotProduct nr nr → (∀ i, |n i - nr i| ≤ δ) → (∀ i, |ψ i| ≤ δ) → (∀ i j, |K i j - Kr i j| ≤ δ) → ∀ i : Fin 3, |((-K + (dotProduct n n)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec n (Matrix.vecMul n K + ψ)).mulVec t - (ek * dotProduct n n) • t) i - ((-Kr + (dotProduct nr nr)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec nr (Matrix.vecMul nr Kr)).mulVec t - (ek * dotProduct nr nr) • t) i| ≤ (1 + 12 * (2 * B1 + 1) + 2 / c * (3 * (B1 + 1) ^ 2 + 1 + B1 * (6 * B1 + 4)) + 6 * B1 * (3 * (B1 + 1) ^ 2 + 1) * (2 * B1 + 1) / c ^ 2) * δ * (|t 0| + |t 1| + |t 2|)

signature.name: ptm_pert5
signature.statement: ∀ (B1 c δ ek : ℝ) (n nr ψ t : Fin 3 → ℝ) (K Kr : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), 0 ≤ B1 → 0 < c → 0 ≤ δ → δ ≤ 1 → δ ≤ c / (6 * (2 * B1 + 1)) → 0 ≤ ek → ek ≤ 4 → (∀ i, |nr i| ≤ B1) → (∀ i j, |Kr i j| ≤ B1) → c ≤ dotProduct nr nr → (∀ i, |n i - nr i| ≤ δ) → (∀ i, |ψ i| ≤ δ) → (∀ i j, |K i j - Kr i j| ≤ δ) → ∀ i : Fin 3, |((-K + (dotProduct n n)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec n (Matrix.vecMul n K + ψ)).mulVec t - (ek * dotProduct n n) • t) i - ((-Kr + (dotProduct nr nr)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec nr (Matrix.vecMul nr Kr)).mulVec t - (ek * dotProduct nr nr) • t) i| ≤ (1 + 12 * (2 * B1 + 1) + 2 / c * (3 * (B1 + 1) ^ 2 + 1 + B1 * (6 * B1 + 4)) + 6 * B1 * (3 * (B1 + 1) ^ 2 + 1) * (2 * B1 + 1) / c ^ 2) * δ * (|t 0| + |t 1| + |t 2|)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B1 c δ ek n nr ψ t K Kr hB1 hc hδ0 hδ1 hδc hek0 hek4 hnr hKr hcν hn hψ hK i
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ, T = |t 0| + |t 1| + |t 2| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hti : |t i| ≤ T := by
    have h0 := abs_nonneg (t 0)
    have h1 := abs_nonneg (t 1)
    have h2 := abs_nonneg (t 2)
    rw [hT]
    fin_cases i
    · show |t 0| ≤ _; linarith
    · show |t 1| ≤ _; linarith
    · show |t 2| ≤ _; linarith
  rw [← hT]
  have hadd : ∀ a b : ℝ, |a + b| ≤ |a| + |b| := fun a b => abs_add_le a b
  have hsub : ∀ a b : ℝ, |a - b| ≤ |a| + |b| := fun a b => by
    have := hadd a (-b)
    rwa [← sub_eq_add_neg, abs_neg] at this
  have habs3 : ∀ a b d : ℝ, |a + b + d| ≤ |a| + |b| + |d| := fun a b d => by
    have h1 := hadd (a + b) d
    have h2 := hadd a b
    linarith
  have hmulle : ∀ a b x y : ℝ, |a| ≤ x → |b| ≤ y → |a * b| ≤ x * y := by
    intro a b x y ha hb
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul ha hb (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans ha)
  have hdot : ∀ (w : Fin 3 → ℝ) (M : ℝ), (∀ j, |w j| ≤ M) → |dotProduct w t| ≤ M * T := by
    intro w M hw
    have e : dotProduct w t = w 0 * t 0 + w 1 * t 1 + w 2 * t 2 := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rw [e, hT]
    have h0 := hmulle _ _ _ _ (hw 0) (le_refl |t 0|)
    have h1 := hmulle _ _ _ _ (hw 1) (le_refl |t 1|)
    have h2 := hmulle _ _ _ _ (hw 2) (le_refl |t 2|)
    have h3 := habs3 (w 0 * t 0) (w 1 * t 1) (w 2 * t 2)
    linarith
  have hnb : ∀ j, |n j| ≤ B1 + 1 := fun j => by
    have h := hadd (n j - nr j) (nr j)
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at h
    linarith [hn j, hnr j]
  have hKb : ∀ a b, |K a b| ≤ B1 + 1 := fun a b => by
    have h := hadd (K a b - Kr a b) (Kr a b)
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at h
    linarith [hK a b, hKr a b]
  have hs2 : ∀ j, |n j + nr j| ≤ 2 * B1 + 1 := fun j => by
    have h := hadd (n j) (nr j)
    linarith [hnb j, hnr j]
  
  have hνd : |dotProduct n n - dotProduct nr nr| ≤ 3 * δ * (2 * B1 + 1) := by
    have e : dotProduct n n - dotProduct nr nr = (n 0 - nr 0) * (n 0 + nr 0) +
        (n 1 - nr 1) * (n 1 + nr 1) + (n 2 - nr 2) * (n 2 + nr 2) := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    rw [e]
    have h0 := hmulle _ _ _ _ (hn 0) (hs2 0)
    have h1 := hmulle _ _ _ _ (hn 1) (hs2 1)
    have h2 := hmulle _ _ _ _ (hn 2) (hs2 2)
    have h3 := habs3 ((n 0 - nr 0) * (n 0 + nr 0)) ((n 1 - nr 1) * (n 1 + nr 1))
      ((n 2 - nr 2) * (n 2 + nr 2))
    linarith
  have h6 : 6 * δ * (2 * B1 + 1) ≤ c := by
    have hpos : (0:ℝ) < 6 * (2 * B1 + 1) := by positivity
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hpos] at hδc
    linarith
  have hνlow : c / 2 ≤ dotProduct n n := by
    have := (abs_le.mp hνd).1
    linarith
  have hνpos : 0 < dotProduct n n := by linarith
  have hνrpos : 0 < dotProduct nr nr := by linarith
  have hinv1 : |(dotProduct n n)⁻¹| ≤ 2 / c := by
    rw [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hνpos)]
    have := inv_anti₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < c / 2) hνlow
    rwa [inv_div] at this
  have hinv2 : |(dotProduct nr nr)⁻¹| ≤ c⁻¹ := by
    rw [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hνrpos)]
    exact inv_anti₀ hc hcν
  
  have hr : ∀ j, (Matrix.vecMul n K + ψ) j = n 0 * K 0 j + n 1 * K 1 j + n 2 * K 2 j + ψ j := by
    intro j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have hrr : ∀ j, Matrix.vecMul nr Kr j = nr 0 * Kr 0 j + nr 1 * Kr 1 j + nr 2 * Kr 2 j := by
    intro j
    simp only [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have hrd : ∀ j, |(Matrix.vecMul n K + ψ - Matrix.vecMul nr Kr) j| ≤ δ * (6 * B1 + 4) := by
    intro j
    rw [Pi.sub_apply, hr j, hrr j]
    have e : n 0 * K 0 j + n 1 * K 1 j + n 2 * K 2 j + ψ j -
        (nr 0 * Kr 0 j + nr 1 * Kr 1 j + nr 2 * Kr 2 j)
        = ((n 0 - nr 0) * K 0 j + nr 0 * (K 0 j - Kr 0 j)) +
          ((n 1 - nr 1) * K 1 j + nr 1 * (K 1 j - Kr 1 j)) +
          ((n 2 - nr 2) * K 2 j + nr 2 * (K 2 j - Kr 2 j)) + ψ j := by ring
    rw [e]
    have hX : ∀ a, |(n a - nr a) * K a j + nr a * (K a j - Kr a j)| ≤ δ * (B1 + 1) + B1 * δ :=
      fun a => by
        have h1 := hmulle _ _ _ _ (hn a) (hKb a j)
        have h2 := hmulle _ _ _ _ (hnr a) (hK a j)
        have h3 := hadd ((n a - nr a) * K a j) (nr a * (K a j - Kr a j))
        linarith
    have h0 := hX 0
    have h1 := hX 1
    have h2 := hX 2
    have h3 := hadd (((n 0 - nr 0) * K 0 j + nr 0 * (K 0 j - Kr 0 j)) +
          ((n 1 - nr 1) * K 1 j + nr 1 * (K 1 j - Kr 1 j)) +
          ((n 2 - nr 2) * K 2 j + nr 2 * (K 2 j - Kr 2 j))) (ψ j)
    have h4 := habs3 ((n 0 - nr 0) * K 0 j + nr 0 * (K 0 j - Kr 0 j))
      ((n 1 - nr 1) * K 1 j + nr 1 * (K 1 j - Kr 1 j))
      ((n 2 - nr 2) * K 2 j + nr 2 * (K 2 j - Kr 2 j))
    have h5 := hψ j
    linarith
  have hrb : ∀ j, |(Matrix.vecMul n K + ψ) j| ≤ 3 * (B1 + 1) ^ 2 + 1 := by
    intro j
    rw [hr j]
    have h0 := hmulle _ _ _ _ (hnb 0) (hKb 0 j)
    have h1 := hmulle _ _ _ _ (hnb 1) (hKb 1 j)
    have h2 := hmulle _ _ _ _ (hnb 2) (hKb 2 j)
    have h3 := hadd (n 0 * K 0 j + n 1 * K 1 j + n 2 * K 2 j) (ψ j)
    have h4 := habs3 (n 0 * K 0 j) (n 1 * K 1 j) (n 2 * K 2 j)
    have h5 := hψ j
    nlinarith
  have hrrb : ∀ j, |Matrix.vecMul nr Kr j| ≤ 3 * (B1 + 1) ^ 2 + 1 := by
    intro j
    rw [hrr j]
    have h0 := hmulle _ _ _ _ (hnr 0) (hKr 0 j)
    have h1 := hmulle _ _ _ _ (hnr 1) (hKr 1 j)
    have h2 := hmulle _ _ _ _ (hnr 2) (hKr 2 j)
    have h4 := habs3 (nr 0 * Kr 0 j) (nr 1 * Kr 1 j) (nr 2 * Kr 2 j)
    nlinarith
  have hDd : |dotProduct (Matrix.vecMul n K + ψ) t - dotProduct (Matrix.vecMul nr Kr) t|
      ≤ δ * (6 * B1 + 4) * T := by
    rw [← sub_dotProduct]
    exact hdot _ _ hrd
  have hDb : |dotProduct (Matrix.vecMul n K + ψ) t| ≤ (3 * (B1 + 1) ^ 2 + 1) * T := hdot _ _ hrb
  have hDrb : |dotProduct (Matrix.vecMul nr Kr) t| ≤ (3 * (B1 + 1) ^ 2 + 1) * T := hdot _ _ hrrb
  have hKp : |dotProduct (fun j => K i j - Kr i j) t| ≤ δ * T := hdot _ _ (fun j => hK i j)
  
  have hexp : ((-K + (dotProduct n n)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec n (Matrix.vecMul n K + ψ)).mulVec t -
      (ek * dotProduct n n) • t) i - ((-Kr + (dotProduct nr nr)⁻¹ •
      Matrix.vecMulVec nr (Matrix.vecMul nr Kr)).mulVec t - (ek * dotProduct nr nr) • t) i
      = -(dotProduct (fun j => K i j - Kr i j) t) +
        ((dotProduct n n)⁻¹ * (n i * dotProduct (Matrix.vecMul n K + ψ) t) -
          (dotProduct nr nr)⁻¹ * (nr i * dotProduct (Matrix.vecMul nr Kr) t)) -
        ek * (dotProduct n n - dotProduct nr nr) * t i := by
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
      Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
      Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Matrix.vecMul, Pi.add_apply]
    ring
  rw [hexp]
  set ν := dotProduct n n with hν
  set νr := dotProduct nr nr with hνr
  set D := dotProduct (Matrix.vecMul n K + ψ) t with hD
  set Dr := dotProduct (Matrix.vecMul nr Kr) t with hDr
  set Kp := dotProduct (fun j => K i j - Kr i j) t with hKp'
  have hPd : |n i * D - nr i * Dr| ≤
      δ * ((3 * (B1 + 1) ^ 2 + 1) * T) + B1 * (δ * (6 * B1 + 4) * T) := by
    have e : n i * D - nr i * Dr = (n i - nr i) * D + nr i * (D - Dr) := by ring
    rw [e]
    have h1 := hmulle _ _ _ _ (hn i) hDb
    have h2 := hmulle _ _ _ _ (hnr i) hDd
    have h3 := hadd ((n i - nr i) * D) (nr i * (D - Dr))
    linarith
  have hPr : |nr i * Dr| ≤ B1 * ((3 * (B1 + 1) ^ 2 + 1) * T) := hmulle _ _ _ _ (hnr i) hDrb
  have hQ : |ν⁻¹ * (n i * D) - νr⁻¹ * (nr i * Dr)| ≤
      2 / c * (δ * ((3 * (B1 + 1) ^ 2 + 1) * T) + B1 * (δ * (6 * B1 + 4) * T)) +
      B1 * ((3 * (B1 + 1) ^ 2 + 1) * T) * (3 * δ * (2 * B1 + 1)) * (2 / c * c⁻¹) := by
    have h1 : ν * ν⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hνpos.ne'
    have h2 : νr * νr⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hνrpos.ne'
    have e : ν⁻¹ * (n i * D) - νr⁻¹ * (nr i * Dr) =
        ν⁻¹ * (n i * D - nr i * Dr) + nr i * Dr * (νr - ν) * (ν⁻¹ * νr⁻¹) := by
      linear_combination (-(nr i * Dr) * ν⁻¹) * h2 + (nr i * Dr * νr⁻¹) * h1
    rw [e]
    have hνd' : |νr - ν| ≤ 3 * δ * (2 * B1 + 1) := by rw [abs_sub_comm]; exact hνd
    have k1 := hmulle _ _ _ _ hinv1 hPd
    have k2 := hmulle _ _ _ _ hinv1 hinv2
    have k3 := hmulle _ _ _ _ hPr hνd'
    have k4 := hmulle _ _ _ _ k3 k2
    have k5 := hadd (ν⁻¹ * (n i * D - nr i * Dr)) (nr i * Dr * (νr - ν) * (ν⁻¹ * νr⁻¹))
    linarith
  have hek : |ek| ≤ 4 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hek0]; exact hek4
  have hE : |ek * (ν - νr) * t i| ≤ 4 * (3 * δ * (2 * B1 + 1)) * T :=
    hmulle _ _ _ _ (hmulle _ _ _ _ hek hνd) hti
  have hfin := hsub (-Kp + (ν⁻¹ * (n i * D) - νr⁻¹ * (nr i * Dr))) (ek * (ν - νr) * t i)
  have hfin2 := hadd (-Kp) (ν⁻¹ * (n i * D) - νr⁻¹ * (nr i * Dr))
  rw [abs_neg] at hfin2

    have he : HasDerivAt (fun w => Real.exp (4 * Cm * w)) (Real.exp (4 * Cm * w) * (4 * Cm)) w :=
      h1.exp
    have hE : HasDerivAt (fun w => x w ^ 2 + y w ^ 2) (2 * x w * xd w + 2 * y w * yd w) w := by
      have h2 := (hx.pow 2).add (hy.pow 2)
      convert h2 using 1
      norm_num
    convert he.mul hE using 1
    ring
  have hG' : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, 0 ≤ Real.exp (4 * Cm * w) *
      (4 * Cm * (x w ^ 2 + y w ^ 2) + (2 * x w * xd w + 2 * y w * yd w)) := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨-, -, hbx, hby⟩ := hd w hw
    apply mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le
    have h1 : -(|x w| * |xd w|) ≤ x w * xd w := by rw [← abs_mul]; exact neg_abs_le _
    have h2 : -(|y w| * |yd w|) ≤ y w * yd w := by rw [← abs_mul]; exact neg_abs_le _
    have ha := abs_nonneg (x w)
    have hb := abs_nonneg (y w)
    have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbx ha
    have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hby hb
    have h5 := mul_nonneg hCm (sq_nonneg (|x w| - |y w|))
    rw [← sq_abs (x w), ← sq_abs (y w)]
    nlinarith
  have hmono : MonotoneOn (fun w => Real.exp (4 * Cm * w) * (x w ^ 2 + y w ^ 2)) (Set.Icc 0 L) := by
    refine monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg
      (f' := fun w => Real.exp (4 * Cm * w) *
        (4 * Cm * (x w ^ 2 + y w ^ 2) + (2 * x w * xd w + 2 * y w * yd w)))
      (convex_Icc 0 L) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro w hw
      exact (hG w hw).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · intro w hw
      rw [interior_Icc] at hw
      exact (hG w (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hw)).hasDerivWithinAt
    · intro w hw
      rw [interior_Icc] at hw
      exact hG' w (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hw)
  have h0L : (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc 0 L := ⟨le_rfl, hv.1.trans hv.2⟩
  have hle := hmono h0L hv hv.1
  simp only [mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, one_mul] at hle
  by_contra hneg
  push_neg at hneg
  nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (4 * Cm * v)]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (L cl R A k e rm : ℝ) (x y ρ ρd lam d α β r0 r1 : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < cl → 0 < k → 0 ≤ e → 0 ≤ R → e * (1 + R + k) ^ 2 + rm + A * k ^ 2 < 2 * cl * k → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, cl ≤ lam v ∧ |ρ v| ≤ R ∧ |α v| ≤ A ∧ |ρd v| ≤ rm ∧ α v * ρ v = lam v ∧ β v = lam v * ρ v ∧ |r0 v| ≤ e * (|x v| + |y v|) ∧ |r1 v| ≤ e * (|x v| + |y v|) ∧ 0 < x v ^ 2 + y v ^ 2) → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt ρ (ρd v) v ∧ HasDerivAt x (α v * y v - d v * x v + r0 v) v ∧ HasDerivAt y (β v * x v - d v * y v + r1 v) v) → 0 < x 0 → |y 0 - ρ 0 * x 0| ≤ k * x 0 → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, 0 < x v ∧ |y v - ρ v * x v| ≤ k * x v

signature.statement: ∀ (L cl R A k e rm : ℝ) (x y ρ ρd lam d α β r0 r1 : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < cl → 0 < k → 0 ≤ e → 0 ≤ R → e * (1 + R + k) ^ 2 + rm + A * k ^ 2 < 2 * cl * k → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, cl ≤ lam v ∧ |ρ v| ≤ R ∧ |α v| ≤ A ∧ |ρd v| ≤ rm ∧ α v * ρ v = lam v ∧ β v = lam v * ρ v ∧ |r0 v| ≤ e * (|x v| + |y v|) ∧ |r1 v| ≤ e * (|x v| + |y v|) ∧ 0 < x v ^ 2 + y v ^ 2) → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt ρ (ρd v) v ∧ HasDerivAt x (α v * y v - d v * x v + r0 v) v ∧ HasDerivAt y (β v * x v - d v * y v + r1 v) v) → 0 < x 0 → |y 0 - ρ 0 * x 0| ≤ k * x 0 → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, 0 < x v ∧ |y v - ρ v * x v| ≤ k * x v

proof.tactics:
by
  intro L cl R A k e rm x y ρ ρd lam d α β r0 r1 hcl hk he hR hmar hpt hder _hx0 hc0
  
  have bdry : ∀ (s xx yy rho al lm dd rd q0 q1 : ℝ), (s = 1 ∨ s = -1) → 0 < xx → cl ≤ lm →
      |rho| ≤ R → |al| ≤ A → |rd| ≤ rm → al * rho = lm → yy - rho * xx = s * k * xx →
      |q0| ≤ e * (|xx| + |yy|) → |q1| ≤ e * (|xx| + |yy|) →
      s * ((lm * rho * xx - dd * yy + q1) - (rd * xx + rho * (al * yy - dd * xx + q0)))
        - k * (al * yy - dd * xx + q0) < 0 := by
    intro s xx yy rho al lm dd rd q0 q1 hs hxx hlm hrho hal hrd hal_eq hyy hq0 hq1
    have hyy' : yy = rho * xx + s * k * xx := by linarith
    have hs2 : s ^ 2 = 1 := by rcases hs with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
    have hsabs : |s| = 1 := by rcases hs with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
    have hid : s * ((lm * rho * xx - dd * yy + q1) - (rd * xx + rho * (al * yy - dd * xx + q0)))
        - k * (al * yy - dd * xx + q0)
        = -2 * lm * k * xx - s * al * k ^ 2 * xx - s * rd * xx + s * q1 - (s * rho + k) * q0 := by
      rw [hyy']
      linear_combination (-dd * k * xx - al * rho * k * xx) * hs2
        - (s * rho * xx + 2 * k * xx) * hal_eq
    have hsum : |xx| + |yy| ≤ (1 + R + k) * xx := by
      have h1 : |yy| ≤ |rho * xx| + |s * k * xx| := by rw [hyy']; exact abs_add_le _ _
      simp only [abs_mul, hsabs, abs_of_pos hxx, abs_of_pos hk, one_mul] at h1
      rw [abs_of_pos hxx]
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrho hxx.le
      linarith
    have hE0 : e * (|xx| + |yy|) ≤ e * ((1 + R + k) * xx) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum he
    have t1 : cl * (k * xx) ≤ lm * (k * xx) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlm (mul_pos hk hxx).le
    have t2 : -(s * al) * (k ^ 2 * xx) ≤ A * (k ^ 2 * xx) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (mul_pos (pow_pos hk 2) hxx).le
      have := neg_le_abs (s * al)
      rw [abs_mul, hsabs, one_mul] at this
      linarith
    have t3 : -(s * rd) * xx ≤ rm * xx := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hxx.le
      have := neg_le_abs (s * rd)
      rw [abs_mul, hsabs, one_mul] at this
      linarith
    have t4 : s * q1 ≤ e * ((1 + R + k) * xx) := by
      have := le_abs_self (s * q1)
      rw [abs_mul, hsabs, one_mul] at this
      linarith
    have t5 : -((s * rho + k) * q0) ≤ (R + k) * (e * ((1 + R + k) * xx)) := by
      have h1 := neg_le_abs ((s * rho + k) * q0)
      rw [abs_mul] at h1
      have h2 : |s * rho + k| ≤ R + k := by
        have := abs_add_le (s * rho) k
        rw [abs_mul, hsabs, one_mul, abs_of_pos hk] at this
        linarith
      have h3 : |s * rho + k| * |q0| ≤ (R + k) * (e * ((1 + R + k) * xx)) :=
        mul_le_mul h2 (hq0.trans hE0) (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
      linarith
    have hm := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hmar hxx
    rw [hid]
    nlinarith [t1, t2, t3, t4, t5, hm]
  
  have rdec : ∀ (h : ℝ → ℝ) (E v : ℝ), HasDerivAt h E v → E < 0 →
      ∀ᶠ w in nhdsWithin v (Set.Ioi v), h w < h v := by
    intro h E v hh hE
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (slope h v) (nhdsWithin v (Set.Ioi v)) (nhds E) :=
      (hasDerivWithinAt_iff_tendsto_slope' (by simp)).mp hh.hasDerivWithinAt
    have h2 : ∀ᶠ w in nhdsWithin v (Set.Ioi v), slope h v w < 0 :=
      Filter.Tendsto.eventually_lt_const hE h1
    filter_upwards [h2, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with w hw hwv
    rw [slope_def_field] at hw
    have hp : 0 < w - v := sub_pos.mpr hwv
    have h3 : (h w - h v) / (w - v) * (w - v) < 0 * (w - v) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hw hp
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hp.ne', zero_mul] at h3
    linarith
  
  have hcont : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, ContinuousAt x v ∧ ContinuousAt y v ∧ ContinuousAt ρ v :=
    fun v hv => ⟨(hder v hv).2.1.continuousAt, (hder v hv).2.2.continuousAt,
      (hder v hv).1.continuousAt⟩
  have hpos : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, |y v - ρ v * x v| ≤ k * x v → 0 < x v := by
    intro v hv hc
    have hx : 0 ≤ x v := by
      by_contra hneg
      push_neg at hneg
      have := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hk hneg
      linarith [abs_nonneg (y v - ρ v * x v)]
    rcases hx.lt_or_eq with h | h
    · exact h
    · exfalso
      have h0 : x v = 0 := h.symm
      rw [h0, mul_zero, sub_zero, mul_zero] at hc
      have hy0 : y v = 0 := abs_nonpos_iff.mp hc
      have := (hpt v hv).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
      rw [h0, hy0] at this
      norm_num at this
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : Set ℝ, S = {w | |y w - ρ w * x w| ≤ k * x w} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hclosed : IsClosed (S ∩ Set.Icc 0 L) := by
    have hg : ContinuousOn (fun w => k * x w - |y w - ρ w * x w|) (Set.Icc 0 L) := by
      intro v hv
      obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := hcont v hv
      exact ((continuousAt_const.mul c1).sub ((c2.sub (c3.mul c1)).abs)).continuousWithinAt
    have := hg.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed isClosed_Icc (isClosed_Ici (a := (0:ℝ)))
    convert this using 1
    ext w
    rw [hS]
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Ici, Set.mem_setOf_eq, sub_nonneg]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, b⟩; exact ⟨b, a⟩
    · rintro ⟨a, b⟩; exact ⟨b, a⟩
  have hsub : Set.Icc 0 L ⊆ S := by
    apply hclosed.Icc_subset_of_forall_mem_nhdsWithin
    · rw [hS]; exact hc0
    · rintro v ⟨hvS, hvIco⟩
      have hv : v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L := Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self hvIco
      rw [hS] at hvS ⊢
      have hvS' : |y v - ρ v * x v| ≤ k * x v := hvS
      obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := hcont v hv
      have hxv := hpos v hv hvS'
      rcases hvS'.lt_or_eq with hlt | heq
      · have hgc : ContinuousAt (fun w => k * x w - |y w - ρ w * x w|) v :=
          (continuousAt_const.mul c1).sub ((c2.sub (c3.mul c1)).abs)
        have hev : ∀ᶠ w in nhds v, (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) w < (fun w => k * x w - |y w - ρ w * x w|) w :=
          continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hgc (show (0:ℝ) < k * x v - |y v - ρ v * x v| by linarith)
        filter_upwards [eventually_nhdsWithin_of_eventually_nhds hev] with w hw
        have hw' : (0:ℝ) < k * x w - |y w - ρ w * x w| := hw
        show |y w - ρ w * x w| ≤ k * x w
        linarith
      · obtain ⟨s, hs, hzs⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, (s = 1 ∨ s = -1) ∧ y v - ρ v * x v = s * k * x v := by
          rcases (abs_eq (mul_pos hk hxv).le).mp heq with h | h
          · exact ⟨1, Or.inl rfl, by rw [h]; ring⟩
          · exact ⟨-1, Or.inr rfl, by rw [h]; ring⟩
        obtain ⟨hd1, hd2, hd3⟩ := hder v hv
        obtain ⟨p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8, _⟩ := hpt v hv
        have hh : HasDerivAt (fun w => s * (y w - ρ w * x w) - k * x w)
            (s * ((β v * x v - d v * y v + r1 v) - (ρd v * x v + ρ v * (α v * y v - d v * x v + r0 v)))
              - k * (α v * y v - d v * x v + r0 v)) v :=
          ((hd3.sub (hd1.mul hd2)).const_mul s).sub (hd2.const_mul k)
        have hE : s * ((β v * x v - d v * y v + r1 v) - (ρd v * x v + ρ v * (α v * y v - d v * x v + r0 v)))
              - k * (α v * y v - d v * x v + r0 v) < 0 := by
          rw [p6]
          exact bdry s (x v) (y v) (ρ v) (α v) (lam v) (d v) (ρd v) (r0 v) (r1 v) hs hxv p1 p2 p3 p4
            p5 hzs p7 p8
        have hev1 := rdec _ _ v hh hE
        have hq : ContinuousAt (fun w => -s * (y w - ρ w * x w) - k * x w) v :=
          (continuousAt_const.mul (c2.sub (c3.mul c1))).sub (continuousAt_const.mul c1)
        have hqv : -s * (y v - ρ v * x v) - k * x v < 0 := by
          have hkx := mul_pos hk hxv
          rw [hzs]
          rcases hs with rfl | rfl <;> nlinarith
        have hev2 : ∀ᶠ w in nhds v, (fun w => -s * (y w - ρ w * x w) - k * x w) w < (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) w :=
          hq.eventually_lt continuousAt_const hqv
        have hhv : s * (y v - ρ v * x v) - k * x v = 0 := by
          rw [hzs]; rcases hs with rfl | rfl <;> ring
        filter_upwards [hev1, eventually_nhdsWithin_of_eventually_nhds hev2] with w hw1 hw2
        have hw1' : s * (y w - ρ w * x w) - k * x w < s * (y v - ρ v * x v) - k * x v := hw1
        have hw2' : -s * (y w - ρ w * x w) - k * x w < 0 := hw2
        rw [hhv] at hw1'
        show |y w - ρ w * x w| ≤ k * x w
        rw [abs_le]
        rcases hs with rfl | rfl
        · constructor <;> linarith
        · constructor <;> linarith
  intro v hv
  have hvS : |y v - ρ v * x v| ≤ k * x v := by
    have := hsub hv
    rw [hS] at this
    exact this
  exact ⟨hpos v hv hvS, hvS⟩

by
  intro L γ x xd μ hμ H v hv
  have hderiv : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L,
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun y => Real.log (x y) - ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..y, μ t)

      Real.log (x v) - (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..v, μ t) - Real.log (x 0) := by ring
  rw [e]
  exact hmvt

  have hagR : ∀ Y ∈ U, xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) Y = lamR (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y - G.ctr γ - k) := by
    intro Y hY; unfold xiG; rw [hk Y hY]
  have hagT : ∀ Y ∈ U, etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) Y = lamT (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) Y - G.ctr γ - k) := by
    intro Y hY; unfold etG; rw [hk Y hY]
  have hπ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : Cyl => p.2.2.2) := contDiff_snd.snd.snd
  have hπc : Continuous (fun p : Cyl => p.2.2.2) := hπ.continuous
  
  have hpath : ∀ p : Cyl, |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) p.2.2.2| < G.r0 / 2 → ∀ v : ℝ,
      -(Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2) < v → v < 3 * Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2 →
      |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (pulsePth5 B G γ p v).2.2.2| < 1/8 ∧
      |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) (pulsePth5 B G γ p v).2.2.2| < 1/8 ∧
      vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) (pulsePth5 B G γ p v).2.2.2 = v := by
    intro p hp v hv1 hv2
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s = v - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) p.2.2.2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hq : (pulsePth5 B G γ p v).2.2.2 =
        p.2.2.2 + s • ((cib B.h γ.1 * Tgc ^ (-(bandIdx B.h γ.1))) • vtv) := by
      rw [hs]; simp [pulsePth5, dVdir]
    have hetS : etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) p.2.2.2 + s * cib B.h γ.1 = v * cib B.h γ.1 - G.r0 := by
      rw [hs, sub_mul, hIv]; ring
    have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hv1 hcb
    have h2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hv2 hcb
    have e1 : -(Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2) * cib B.h γ.1 = -G.r0 := by linear_combination (-1/2:ℝ) * hIL
    have e2 : 3 * Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 / 2 * cib B.h γ.1 = 3 * G.r0 := by linear_combination (3/2:ℝ) * hIL
    rw [e1] at h1
    rw [e2] at h2
    have hbd : |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) p.2.2.2 + s * cib B.h γ.1| < 2 * G.r0 := by
      rw [hetS, abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
    obtain ⟨hx', he'⟩ := hA p.2.2.2 s (by linarith) (by linarith)
    rw [hetS] at hbd
    rw [hq]
    refine ⟨by rw [hx']; linarith, by rw [he', hetS]; linarith, ?_⟩
    unfold vco; rw [he', hetS, sub_add_cancel, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hcbne]
  
  refine ⟨(fun p : Cyl => p.2.2.2) ⁻¹' U ∩
      {p : Cyl | |lamR (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) p.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ - k)| < G.r0 / 2}, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (hUo.preimage hπc).inter (isOpen_lt (hℓR.continuous.comp hπc).abs continuous_const)
  · refine ⟨hξU, ?_⟩
    show |lamR (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) ξ.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ - k)| < G.r0 / 2
    rw [← hagR _ hξU]; linarith
  · have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : Cyl =>
        (lamT (Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) p.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ - k) + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1) :=
      ((hℓT.comp hπ).add contDiff_const).div_const _
    refine hg.contDiffOn.congr ?_
    intro p hp
    show (etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) p.2.2.2 + G.r0) / cib B.h γ.1 = _
    rw [hagT _ hp.1]
  · intro p hp
    rw [hagR _ hp.1]; exact hp.2
  · intro p hp v hv1 hv2
    have hp' : |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) p.2.2.2| < G.r0 / 2 := by rw [hagR _ hp.1]; exact hp.2
    exact hpath p hp' v hv1 hv2

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (f : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (qs : ℝ) (η : Cyl), B.ok → qs ≤ B.qB → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f γ m) (DomC B.h qs) → η ∈ DomC B.h qs → |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2| < 1/8 → |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2| < 1/8 → ∃ O : Set Cyl, IsOpen O ∧ η ∈ O ∧ O ⊆ DomC B.h qs ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η' : Cyl => fun i j : Fin 3 => (pulseMatC (APhi5 B G γ η') - ((m : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((dDamp5 B G γ η' : ℝ) : ℂ)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ)) i j) O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η' : Cyl => projT5 B G γ η' (srcHat B f γ m η')) O

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G f γ m qs η hok hqs hf hη hxi het
  obtain ⟨hDo, hqCs, hqCpos, -, -, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B qs hok
  have hηB : η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB := ⟨hη.1, hη.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hη.2.2 hqs⟩
  obtain ⟨U, hUo, hηU, -, hn, hnP, hK⟩ := good_coeff_smooth_v5 B G γ η hok hηB hxi het
  have hofR : ∀ (S : Set Cyl) (g : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g S →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ((g x : ℝ) : ℂ)) S := fun S g hg =>
    (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hg).congr (fun x _ => by simp)
  have hOD : U ∩ DomC B.h qs ⊆ DomC B.h qs := Set.inter_subset_right
  have hn' : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ x i) (U ∩ DomC B.h qs) :=
    fun i => (hn i).mono Set.inter_subset_left
  have hnP' : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : Cyl => nPhiP5 B G γ x i) (U ∩ DomC B.h qs) :=
    fun i => (hnP i).mono Set.inter_subset_left
  have hK' : ∀ i j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : Cyl => Kmat B G γ x i j) (U ∩ DomC B.h qs) :=
    fun i j => (hK i j).mono Set.inter_subset_left
  have hN : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : Cyl => dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ x) (nPhi5 B G γ x)) (U ∩ DomC B.h qs) := by
    have h := (((hn' 0).mul (hn' 0)).add ((hn' 1).mul (hn' 1))).add ((hn' 2).mul (hn' 2))
    refine h.congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have hNne : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ DomC B.h qs, dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ x) (nPhi5 B G γ x) ≠ 0 :=
    fun x hx => (nphi5_nsq_pos_v5 B G γ x (hOD hx).1).ne'
  have hNinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : Cyl => (dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ x) (nPhi5 B G γ x))⁻¹)
      (U ∩ DomC B.h qs) := hN.inv hNne
  refine ⟨U ∩ DomC B.h qs, hUo.inter hDo, ⟨hηU, hη⟩, hOD, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine contDiffOn_pi.2 (fun i => contDiffOn_pi.2 (fun j => ?_))
    have hR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : Cyl => -Kmat B G γ x i j +
        (dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ x) (nPhi5 B G γ x))⁻¹ *
        (nPhi5 B G γ x i * (nPhi5 B G γ x 0 * Kmat B G γ x 0 j + nPhi5 B G γ x 1 * Kmat B G γ x 1 j
          + nPhi5 B G γ x 2 * Kmat B G γ x 2 j - nPhiP5 B G γ x j))) (U ∩ DomC B.h qs) :=
      (hK' i j).neg.add (hNinv.mul ((hn' i).mul (((((hn' 0).mul (hK' 0 j)).add
        ((hn' 1).mul (hK' 1 j))).add ((hn' 2).mul (hK' 2 j))).sub (hnP' j))))
    have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : Cyl => epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ x) (nPhi5 B G γ x)) (U ∩ DomC B.h qs) := contDiffOn_const.mul hN
    have h := (hofR _ _ hR).sub (((contDiffOn_const (c := (m : ℂ) ^ 2)).mul (hofR _ _ hD)).mul
      (contDiffOn_const (c := (if i = j then (1 : ℂ) else 0))))
    refine h.congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    simp only [pulseMatC, APhi5, dDamp5, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
      Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.sub_apply,
      Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, smul_eq_mul]
  · have hQb : 0 < Qb γ.1 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
    have hrho : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : Cyl => rhoQ B γ x ^ (-(Aex B.h + 1))) (DomC B.h qs) :=
      (hqCs.div_const (Qb γ.1)).rpow_const_of_ne (fun x hx => (div_pos (hqCpos x hx) hQb).ne')
    have hsrc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => srcHat B f γ m x) (U ∩ DomC B.h qs) :=
      ((hofR _ _ hrho).smul hf).mono hOD
    refine contDiffOn_pi.2 (fun k => ?_)
    have hs : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => srcHat B f γ m x i) (U ∩ DomC B.h qs) :=
      fun i => contDiffOn_pi.1 hsrc i
    have hc : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : Cyl => ((nPhi5 B G γ x i : ℝ) : ℂ)) (U ∩ DomC B.h qs) :=
      fun i => hofR _ _ (hn' i)
    have hDc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : Cyl => ((dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ x) (nPhi5 B G γ x) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        (U ∩ DomC B.h qs) := hofR _ _ hN
    have hDinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun x : Cyl => (((dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ x) (nPhi5 B G γ x) : ℝ) : ℂ))⁻¹) (U ∩ DomC B.h qs) :=
      hDc.inv (fun x hx => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hNne x hx))
    have hS := (((hc 0).mul (hs 0)).add ((hc 1).mul (hs 1))).add ((hc 2).mul (hs 2))
    have h := (hs k).sub ((hS.mul hDinv).mul (hc k))
    refine h.congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    simp only [projT5, nPhiC5, nsqC5, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv,
      dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]

signature.statement: ∀ a b d : ℝ, a ≤ b → 0 < d → ∃ χ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ ∧ (∀ w, a - d ≤ χ w ∧ χ w ≤ b + d) ∧ ∀ w, a ≤ w → w ≤ b → χ w = w

proof.tactics:
by
  intro a b d hab hd
  refine ⟨fun w => a + (Real.smoothTransition ((w - (a - d)) / d) *
    Real.smoothTransition (((b + d) - w) / d)) * (w - a), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Real.smoothTransition := Real.smoothTransition.contDiff
    have hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ => (w - (a - d)) / d) :=
      (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).div_const d
    have hq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ => ((b + d) - w) / d) :=
      (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id).div_const d
    exact contDiff_const.add (((h1.comp hp).mul (h1.comp hq)).mul (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const))
  · intro w
    dsimp only
    have hA0 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg ((w - (a - d)) / d)
    have hA1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one ((w - (a - d)) / d)
    have hB0 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (((b + d) - w) / d)
    have hB1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (((b + d) - w) / d)
    set A := Real.smoothTransition ((w - (a - d)) / d) with hAdef
    set B := Real.smoothTransition (((b + d) - w) / d) with hBdef
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ A * B := mul_nonneg hA0 hB0
    have hr1 : A * B ≤ 1 := mul_le_one₀ hA1 hB0 hB1
    by_cases h0 : A * B = 0
    · rw [h0, zero_mul, add_zero]
      constructor <;> linarith
    · have hA : A ≠ 0 := fun h => h0 (by rw [h, zero_mul])
      have hB : B ≠ 0 := fun h => h0 (by rw [h, mul_zero])
      have hpA : 0 < (w - (a - d)) / d := by
        by_contra hc
        exact hA (Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (not_lt.mp hc))
      have hpB : 0 < ((b + d) - w) / d := by
        by_contra hc
        exact hB (Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (not_lt.mp hc))
      have hw1 : 0 < w - (a - d) := (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right hd).mp hpA
      have hw2 : 0 < (b + d) - w := (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right hd).mp hpB
      constructor
      · nlinarith [mul_nonneg hr0 hw1.le, mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hr1) hd.le]
      · nlinarith [mul_nonneg hr0 hw2.le,
          mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hr1) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ b + d - a)]
  · intro w h1 h2
    have e1 : Real.smoothTransition ((w - (a - d)) / d) = 1 :=
      Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hd]; linarith)
    have e2 : Real.smoothTransition (((b + d) - w) / d) = 1 :=
      Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hd]; linarith)
    simp only [e1, e2]
    ring

signature.name: cmat_clm_smooth_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (P : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P] (S : Set P) (M : P → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => fun i j : Fin 3 => M p i j) S → ∃ A : P → (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A S ∧ ∀ (p : P) (Z : Fin 3 → ℂ), A p Z = (M p).mulVec Z

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P _ _ S M hM
  let L : P → (Fin 3 → ℂ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ) := fun p =>
    { toFun := fun Z => (M p).mulVec Z
      map_add' := fun x y => Matrix.mulVec_add (M p) x y
      map_smul' := fun c Z => Matrix.mulVec_smul (M p) c Z }
  refine ⟨fun p => LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (L p), ?_, fun p Z => rfl⟩
  have hent : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => M p i j) S := by
    intro i j
    have h1 := contDiffOn_pi.mp hM i
    exact contDiffOn_pi.mp h1 j
  rw [contDiffOn_clm_apply]
  intro Z
  show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => (M p).mulVec Z) S
  rw [contDiffOn_pi]
  intro i
  have e : (fun p => (M p).mulVec Z i) = fun p => ∑ j : Fin 3, M p i j * Z j := by
    funext p
    simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  rw [e]
  exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ => (hent i j).mul contDiffOn_const)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (L K : ℝ) (R : ℝ → E → E) (y : ℝ → E), (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, ∀ x x' : E, ‖R t x - R t x'‖ ≤ K * ‖x - x'‖) → y 0 = 0 → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, HasDerivWithinAt y (R t (y t)) (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L) t) → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, Classical.epsilon (fun Z : ℝ → E => Z 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, HasDerivWithinAt Z (R w (Z w)) (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L) w) t = y t

signature.statement: ∀ (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (L K : ℝ) (R : ℝ → E → E) (y : ℝ → E), (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, ∀ x x' : E, ‖R t x - R t x'‖ ≤ K * ‖x - x'‖) → y 0 = 0 → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, HasDerivWithinAt y (R t (y t)) (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L) t) → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, Classical.epsilon (fun Z : ℝ → E => Z 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, HasDerivWithinAt Z (R w (Z w)) (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L) w) t = y t

proof.tactics:
by
  intro E _ _ L K R y hLip hy0 hyd t ht
  have hspec := Classical.epsilon_spec
    (p := fun Z : ℝ → E => Z 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L,
      HasDerivWithinAt Z (R w (Z w)) (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L) w) ⟨y, hy0, hyd⟩
  set Ze := Classical.epsilon (fun Z : ℝ → E => Z 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L,
      HasDerivWithinAt Z (R w (Z w)) (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L) w) with hZe
  obtain ⟨hZ0, hZd⟩ := hspec
  have hL : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ico (0:ℝ) L, LipschitzOnWith K.toNNReal (R τ) Set.univ := by
    intro τ hτ
    apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro x _ x' _
    rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, Real.coe_toNNReal']
    exact (hLip τ ⟨hτ.1, hτ.2.le⟩ x x').trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
  have hnhds : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ico (0:ℝ) L, Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L ∈ nhdsWithin τ (Set.Ici τ) := by
    intro τ hτ
    exact Filter.mem_of_superset (Icc_mem_nhdsGE hτ.2)
      (Set.Icc_subset_Icc hτ.1 le_rfl)
  have hEq := ODE_solution_unique_of_mem_Icc_right (v := R) (s := fun _ => Set.univ)
    (K := K.toNNReal) (f := Ze) (g := y) (a := 0) (b := L) hL
    (fun x hx => (hZd x hx).continuousWithinAt)
    (fun τ hτ => (hZd τ ⟨hτ.1, hτ.2.le⟩).mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin (hnhds τ hτ))
    (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
    (fun x hx => (hyd x hx).continuousWithinAt)
    (fun τ hτ => (hyd τ ⟨hτ.1, hτ.2.le⟩).mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin (hnhds τ hτ))
    (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
    (hZ0.trans hy0.symm)
  exact hEq ht

signature.name: linear_ode_param_smooth_gen5
signature.statement: ∀ (P E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P] [FiniteDimensional ℝ P] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (U : Set P) (A : P × ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (b : P × ℝ → E), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ∃ z : P → ℝ → E, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : P × ℝ => z w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) ∧ ∀ s ∈ U, z s 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (z s) (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v)) v

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P E _ _ _ _ _ _ U A b hU hA hb
  have hO : IsOpen (U ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) := hU.prod isOpen_univ
  
  have fwd : ∀ (G : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (r : ℝ → G) (B : ℝ → G →L[ℝ] G)
      (g : ℝ → G) (K ε T : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ ε → 0 ≤ T →
      (∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt r (B v (r v) + g v) v) → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖B v‖ ≤ K ∧ ‖g v‖ ≤ ε) →
      ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) T, ‖r v‖ ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * T) * Real.exp (K * T) := by
    intro G _ _ r B g K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v hv
    have hcont : ContinuousOn r (Set.Icc 0 T) := fun x _ => (hd x).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have h1 := norm_le_gronwallBound_of_norm_deriv_right_le (f := r) (f' := fun x => B x (r x) + g x)
      (δ := ‖r 0‖) (K := K) (ε := ε) (a := 0) (b := T) hcont
      (fun x _ => (hd x).hasDerivWithinAt) le_rfl
      (fun x hx => by
        obtain ⟨hB, hg⟩ := hbd x ⟨by linarith [hx.1], hx.2.le⟩
        calc ‖B x (r x) + g x‖ ≤ ‖B x (r x)‖ + ‖g x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ ‖B x‖ * ‖r x‖ + ‖g x‖ := add_le_add ((B x).le_opNorm _) le_rfl
          _ ≤ K * ‖r x‖ + ε := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB (norm_nonneg _)) hg)
      v hv
    rw [sub_zero] at h1
    refine h1.trans ?_
    have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := hv.1
    have hvT : v ≤ T := hv.2
    have hδ : 0 ≤ ‖r 0‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have key : gronwallBound ‖r 0‖ K ε v ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * v) * Real.exp (K * v) := by
      rcases hK.eq_or_lt with h | h
      · subst h
        rw [gronwallBound_K0]
        simp
      · rw [gronwallBound_of_K_ne_0 h.ne']
        have hp := Real.exp_pos (K * v)
        have e1 : Real.exp (K * v) * Real.exp (-(K * v)) = 1 := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
        have e2 := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(K * v))
        have e2' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e2 hp.le
        have e3 : Real.exp (K * v) - 1 ≤ K * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by
          nlinarith
        have hc : ε / K * K = ε := div_mul_cancel₀ ε h.ne'
        have e4 : ε / K * (Real.exp (K * v) - 1) ≤ ε * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by
          calc ε / K * (Real.exp (K * v) - 1) ≤ ε / K * (K * v * Real.exp (K * v)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e3 (div_nonneg hε h.le)
            _ = ε / K * K * (v * Real.exp (K * v)) := by ring
            _ = ε * v * Real.exp (K * v) := by rw [hc]; ring
        nlinarith
    refine key.trans ?_
    apply mul_le_mul
    · nlinarith
    · exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)
    · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
    · nlinarith
  
  have gron : ∀ (G : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (r : ℝ → G) (B : ℝ → G →L[ℝ] G)
      (g : ℝ → G) (K ε T : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ ε → 0 ≤ T →
      (∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt r (B v (r v) + g v) v) → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖B v‖ ≤ K ∧ ‖g v‖ ≤ ε) →
      ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖r v‖ ≤ (‖r 0‖ + ε * T) * Real.exp (K * T) := by
    intro G _ _ r B g K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v hv
    rcases le_or_gt 0 v with h0 | h0
    · exact fwd G r B g K ε T hK hε hT hd hbd v ⟨h0, hv.2⟩
    · have hd' : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun u => r (-u))
          ((fun u => -B (-u)) u ((fun u => r (-u)) u) + (fun u => -g (-u)) u) u := by
        intro u
        have h2 : HasDerivAt (r ∘ Neg.neg) ((-1:ℝ) • (B (-u) (r (-u)) + g (-u))) u :=
          (hd (-u)).scomp u (hasDerivAt_neg u)
        have h3 : (-1:ℝ) • (B (-u) (r (-u)) + g (-u)) = (-B (-u)) (r (-u)) + -g (-u) := by
          simp
        rw [h3] at h2
        exact h2
      have hbd' : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖(fun u => -B (-u)) u‖ ≤ K ∧ ‖(fun u => -g (-u)) u‖ ≤ ε := by
        intro u hu
        simp only [norm_neg]
        exact hbd (-u) ⟨by linarith [hu.2], by linarith [hu.1]⟩
      have := fwd G (fun u => r (-u)) (fun u => -B (-u)) (fun u => -g (-u)) K ε T hK hε hT hd' hbd' (-v)
        ⟨by linarith, by linarith [hv.1]⟩
      simpa only [neg_neg, neg_zero] using this
  
  have slice : ∀ (H : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup H] (f : P × ℝ → H) (s0 : P) (T : ℝ),
      ContinuousOn f (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → s0 ∈ U → ∃ ρ > 0, ∃ L : ℝ, 0 ≤ L ∧ Metric.ball s0 ρ ⊆ U ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Metric.ball s0 ρ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖f (s, t)‖ ≤ L) ∧
      ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, δ ≤ ρ ∧ ∀ s : P, dist s s0 < δ → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T,
        ‖f (s, t) - f (s0, t)‖ < ε := by
    intro H _ f s0 T hf hs0
    obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU s0 hs0
    have hρ : 0 < ρ₀ / 2 := by linarith
    have hcl : Metric.closedBall s0 (ρ₀ / 2) ⊆ U :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
    have hK : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall s0 (ρ₀ / 2) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-T) T) :=
      (isCompact_closedBall s0 _).prod isCompact_Icc
    have hsub : Metric.closedBall s0 (ρ₀ / 2) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-T) T ⊆ U ×ˢ Set.univ :=
      fun w hw => ⟨hcl hw.1, Set.mem_univ _⟩
    have hfK := hf.mono hsub
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hfK
    have huc := Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp (hK.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hfK)
    refine ⟨ρ₀ / 2, hρ, max C 0, le_max_right _ _, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hcl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro s hs t ht
      exact (hC (s, t) ⟨Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hs, ht⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hδ⟩ := huc ε hε
      refine ⟨min δ₀ (ρ₀ / 2), lt_min hδ₀ hρ, min_le_right _ _, ?_⟩
      intro s hs t ht
      have hs' : s ∈ Metric.closedBall s0 (ρ₀ / 2) :=
        Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr (hs.le.trans (min_le_right _ _))
      have hs0' : s0 ∈ Metric.closedBall s0 (ρ₀ / 2) := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ.le
      have hdeq : dist (s, t) (s0, t) = dist s s0 := by
        rw [Prod.dist_eq]; simp [dist_nonneg]
      have hd : dist (s, t) (s0, t) < δ₀ := by
        rw [hdeq]; exact hs.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
      have := hδ (s, t) ⟨hs', ht⟩ (s0, t) ⟨hs0', ht⟩ hd
      rwa [dist_eq_norm] at this
  
  have C0 : ∀ (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
      (A : P × ℝ → F →L[ℝ] F) (b : P × ℝ → F) (z : P → ℝ → F),
      ContinuousOn A (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContinuousOn b (U ×ˢ Set.univ) →
      (∀ s ∈ U, z s 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (z s) (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v)) v) →
      ContinuousOn (fun w : P × ℝ => z w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
    intro F _ _ _ A b z hA hb hsol
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨s0, v0⟩ := w
    have hs0 : s0 ∈ U := hw.1
    apply ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    rw [Metric.continuousAt_iff]
    intro η hη
    obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ, T = |v0| + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hT : 0 ≤ T := by rw [hTdef]; positivity
    have hy : Continuous (z s0) :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun t => ((hsol s0 hs0).2 t).continuousAt)
    obtain ⟨Y0, hY0⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := -T) (b := T)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hy.continuousOn
    obtain ⟨Y, hYdef⟩ : ∃ Y : ℝ, Y = max Y0 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hY : 0 ≤ Y := by rw [hYdef]; exact le_max_right _ _
    have hYb : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖z s0 t‖ ≤ Y := fun t ht => by
      rw [hYdef]; exact (hY0 t ht).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    obtain ⟨ρA, hρA, L, hL, hballA, hLb, hAc⟩ := slice (F →L[ℝ] F) A s0 T hA hs0
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, hbc⟩ := slice F b s0 T hb hs0
    obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = 2 * (1 + (Y + 1) * T) * Real.exp (L * T) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hD1 : 0 < 1 + (Y + 1) * T := by nlinarith
    have hD : 0 < D := by rw [hDdef]; exact mul_pos (mul_pos two_pos hD1) (Real.exp_pos _)
    obtain ⟨η', hη'def⟩ : ∃ η' : ℝ, η' = η / D := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hη' : 0 < η' := by rw [hη'def]; exact div_pos hη hD
    have hkey : (η' * (Y + 1) * T) * Real.exp (L * T) ≤ η / 2 := by
      have e : (η' + η' * (Y + 1) * T) * Real.exp (L * T) = η' * D / 2 := by rw [hDdef]; ring
      have e2 : η' * D / 2 = η / 2 := by rw [hη'def, div_mul_cancel₀ η hD.ne']
      have e3 : (η' * (Y + 1) * T) * Real.exp (L * T) ≤ (η' + η' * (Y + 1) * T) * Real.exp (L * T) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (Real.exp_pos _).le
      linarith
    obtain ⟨δA, hδA, hδAρ, hδA'⟩ := hAc η' hη'
    obtain ⟨δb, hδb, -, hδb'⟩ := hbc η' hη'
    obtain ⟨δt, hδt, hδt'⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hy.continuousAt (η / 2) (by linarith)
    refine ⟨min (min δA δb) (min δt 1), lt_min (lt_min hδA hδb) (lt_min hδt one_pos), ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨s, t⟩ hd
    rw [Prod.dist_eq] at hd
    have hds : dist s s0 < min (min δA δb) (min δt 1) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hd
    have hdt : dist t v0 < min (min δA δb) (min δt 1) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hd
    have hsA : dist s s0 < δA := hds.trans_le ((min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
    have hsb : dist s s0 < δb := hds.trans_le ((min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
    have htt : dist t v0 < δt := hdt.trans_le ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
    have ht1 : dist t v0 < 1 := hdt.trans_le ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
    have hsball : s ∈ Metric.ball s0 ρA := Metric.mem_ball.mpr (hsA.trans_le hδAρ)
    have hsU : s ∈ U := hballA hsball
    have htT : t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T := by
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at ht1
      have h1 := abs_lt.mp ht1
      have h2 := neg_abs_le v0
      have h3 := le_abs_self v0
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hw' : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun u => z s u - z s0 u)
        ((fun u => A (s, u)) u ((fun u => z s u - z s0 u) u) +
          (fun u => (A (s, u) - A (s0, u)) (z s0 u) + (b (s, u) - b (s0, u))) u) u := by
      intro u
      have h := ((hsol s hsU).2 u).sub ((hsol s0 hs0).2 u)
      refine h.congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [map_sub, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
      abel
    have hgb : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖(fun u => A (s, u)) u‖ ≤ L ∧
        ‖(fun u => (A (s, u) - A (s0, u)) (z s0 u) + (b (s, u) - b (s0, u))) u‖ ≤ η' * (Y + 1) := by
      intro u hu
      refine ⟨hLb s hsball u hu, ?_⟩
      have e1 := (hδA' s hsA u hu).le
      have e2 := (hδb' s hsb u hu).le
      show ‖(A (s, u) - A (s0, u)) (z s0 u) + (b (s, u) - b (s0, u))‖ ≤ η' * (Y + 1)
      calc ‖(A (s, u) - A (s0, u)) (z s0 u) + (b (s, u) - b (s0, u))‖
          ≤ ‖(A (s, u) - A (s0, u)) (z s0 u)‖ + ‖b (s, u) - b (s0, u)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖A (s, u) - A (s0, u)‖ * ‖z s0 u‖ + ‖b (s, u) - b (s0, u)‖ :=
            add_le_add (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _) le_rfl
        _ ≤ η' * Y + η' := add_le_add (mul_le_mul e1 (hYb u hu) (norm_nonneg _) hη'.le) e2
        _ = η' * (Y + 1) := by ring
    have hG := gron F (fun u => z s u - z s0 u) (fun u => A (s, u))
      (fun u => (A (s, u) - A (s0, u)) (z s0 u) + (b (s, u) - b (s0, u))) L (η' * (Y + 1)) T hL
      (mul_nonneg hη'.le (by linarith)) hT hw' hgb t htT
    have h0 : ‖z s 0 - z s0 0‖ = 0 := by
      rw [(hsol s hsU).1, (hsol s0 hs0).1, sub_zero, norm_zero]
    have hwt : ‖z s t - z s0 t‖ ≤ η / 2 := by
      refine le_trans ?_ hkey
      calc ‖z s t - z s0 t‖ ≤ (‖z s 0 - z s0 0‖ + η' * (Y + 1) * T) * Real.exp (L * T) := hG
        _ = (η' * (Y + 1) * T) * Real.exp (L * T) := by rw [h0, zero_add]
    have hyt : ‖z s0 t - z s0 v0‖ < η / 2 := by
      rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact hδt' htt
    show dist (z s t) (z s0 v0) < η
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    calc ‖z s t - z s0 v0‖ = ‖(z s t - z s0 t) + (z s0 t - z s0 v0)‖ := by rw [sub_add_sub_cancel]
      _ ≤ ‖z s t - z s0 t‖ + ‖z s0 t - z s0 v0‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ < η / 2 + η / 2 := by linarith
      _ = η := by ring
  
  have Q : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
      (A : P × ℝ → F →L[ℝ] F) (b : P × ℝ → F) (z : P → ℝ → F),
      ContDiffOn ℝ k A (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ k b (U ×ˢ Set.univ) →
      (∀ s ∈ U, z s 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (z s) (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v)) v) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun w : P × ℝ => z w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro F _ _ _ A b z hA hb hsol
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, contDiffOn_zero] at hA hb ⊢
      exact C0 F A b z hA hb hsol
    | succ k ih =>
      intro F _ _ _ A b z hA hb hsol
      rw [Nat.cast_succ] at hA hb ⊢
      have hle : (k : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 := le_self_add
      have h1le : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 := le_add_self
      
      have hz : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun w : P × ℝ => z w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
        ih F A b z (hA.of_le hle) (hb.of_le hle) hsol
      
      obtain ⟨A', hA'eq⟩ : ∃ A' : P × ℝ → (P →L[ℝ] F) →L[ℝ] (P →L[ℝ] F),
          ∀ w, A' w = ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ P F F (A w) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨b', hb'eq⟩ : ∃ b' : P × ℝ → (P →L[ℝ] F),
          ∀ w, b' w = (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ F (z w.1 w.2)).comp
              ((fderiv ℝ A w).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)) +
            (fderiv ℝ b w).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
      have hA' : ContDiffOn ℝ k A' (U ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
        rw [contDiffOn_clm_apply]
        intro V
        refine ((hA.of_le hle).clm_comp (contDiffOn_const (c := V))).congr (fun w _ => ?_)
        rw [hA'eq]
        rfl
      have hb' : ContDiffOn ℝ k b' (U ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
        have hdA : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun w => fderiv ℝ A w) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) := hA.fderiv_of_isOpen hO le_rfl
        have hdb : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun w => fderiv ℝ b w) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) := hb.fderiv_of_isOpen hO le_rfl
        have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun w => (fderiv ℝ A w).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ))
            (U ×ˢ Set.univ) := hdA.clm_comp contDiffOn_const
        have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun w => (fderiv ℝ b w).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ))
            (U ×ˢ Set.univ) := hdb.clm_comp contDiffOn_const
        rw [contDiffOn_clm_apply]
        intro p
        have h3 := ((h1.clm_apply (contDiffOn_const (c := p))).clm_apply hz).add
          (h2.clm_apply (contDiffOn_const (c := p)))
        refine h3.congr (fun w _ => ?_)
        rw [hb'eq]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply]
      
      have hW_ex : ∀ s, ∃ Ws : ℝ → (P →L[ℝ] F), s ∈ U →
          (Ws 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt Ws (A' (s, v) (Ws v) + b' (s, v)) v) := by
        intro s
        by_cases hs : s ∈ U
        · have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => ((s, t) : P × ℝ)) :=
            continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id
          have hmem : ∀ t : ℝ, ((s, t) : P × ℝ) ∈ U ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) :=
            fun t => ⟨hs, Set.mem_univ _⟩
          obtain ⟨y, hy0, hy⟩ := linear_ode_global_exists (P →L[ℝ] F) (fun t => A' (s, t))
            (fun t => b' (s, t)) 0 (hA'.continuousOn.comp_continuous hc hmem)
            (hb'.continuousOn.comp_continuous hc hmem)
          exact ⟨y, fun _ => ⟨hy0, hy⟩⟩
        · exact ⟨0, fun h => absurd h hs⟩
      choose W hW using hW_ex
      
      have hWc : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun w : P × ℝ => W w.1 w.2) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
        ih (P →L[ℝ] F) A' b' W hA' hb' (fun s hs => hW s hs)
      
      have hWsol : ∀ s ∈ U, ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (W s)
          ((A (s, v)).comp (W s v) + (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ F (z s v)).comp
            ((fderiv ℝ A (s, v)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)) +
            (fderiv ℝ b (s, v)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)) v := by
        intro s hs v
        have h := (hW s hs).2 v
        rw [hA'eq, hb'eq] at h
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.compL_apply] at h
        rw [← add_assoc] at h
        exact h
      
      have hD : ∀ w ∈ U ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), HasFDerivAt (fun w : P × ℝ => z w.1 w.2)
          ((W w.1 w.2).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ P ℝ) +
            (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ P ℝ).smulRight (A w (z w.1 w.2) + b w)) w := by
        rintro ⟨s0, v0⟩ ⟨hs0, -⟩
        have hm : ((s0, v0) : P × ℝ) ∈ U ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) := ⟨hs0, Set.mem_univ _⟩
        have hLip := linear_ode_param_lip P F U A b z hU (hA.of_le h1le) (hb.of_le h1le) hsol s0 hs0
        obtain ⟨r, hr, -, hrU, -⟩ := hLip 1 one_pos
        have hWd := linear_ode_param_fderiv P F U A b z s0 (W s0) hU (hA.of_le h1le) (hb.of_le h1le)
          hsol hs0 hLip (hW s0 hs0).1 (hWsol s0 hs0) v0
        obtain ⟨Fd, hF⟩ : ∃ Fd : P × ℝ → F, Fd = fun p => A p (z p.1 p.2) + b p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
        have hd : ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball s0 r, ∀ τ : ℝ, HasDerivAt (z s) (Fd (s, τ)) τ := by
          intro s hs τ
          rw [hF]
          exact (hsol s (hrU hs)).2 τ
        have hFc : ContinuousAt Fd (s0, v0) := by
          rw [hF]
          exact ((hA.continuousOn.continuousAt (hO.mem_nhds hm)).clm_apply
            (hz.continuousOn.continuousAt (hO.mem_nhds hm))).add
            (hb.continuousOn.continuousAt (hO.mem_nhds hm))
        have hfd : HasFDerivAt (fun p : P × ℝ => z p.1 p.2)
            ((W s0 v0).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ P ℝ) +
              (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ P ℝ).smulRight (Fd (s0, v0))) (s0, v0) := by
          have hlo := hWd.isLittleO
          refine HasFDerivAt.of_isLittleO ?_
          rw [Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
          intro c hc
          have h1 := (Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff.mp hlo) (c := c / 2) (by linarith)
          rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff] at h1
          obtain ⟨ρ₁, hρ₁, h1⟩ := h1
          rw [Metric.continuousAt_iff] at hFc
          obtain ⟨ρ₂, hρ₂, h2⟩ := hFc (c / 2) (by linarith)
          rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff]
          refine ⟨min r (min ρ₁ ρ₂), lt_min hr (lt_min hρ₁ hρ₂), ?_⟩
          rintro ⟨s, v⟩ hdist
          rw [Prod.dist_eq] at hdist
          obtain ⟨hs, hv⟩ := max_lt_iff.mp hdist
          simp only [lt_min_iff] at hs hv
          have hA2 : ‖z s v0 - z s0 v0 - W s0 v0 (s - s0)‖ ≤ c / 2 * ‖s - s0‖ := h1 hs.2.1
          have hB2 : ‖z s v - z s v0 - (v - v0) • Fd (s0, v0)‖ ≤ c / 2 * ‖v - v0‖ := by
            have key := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
              (f := fun τ => z s τ - τ • Fd (s0, v0)) (f' := fun τ => Fd (s, τ) - Fd (s0, v0))
              (s := Set.uIcc v0 v) (x := v0) (y := v) (C := c / 2) ?_ ?_ (convex_uIcc v0 v)
              Set.left_mem_uIcc Set.right_mem_uIcc
            · have e : z s v - z s v0 - (v - v0) • Fd (s0, v0) =
                  (z s v - v • Fd (s0, v0)) - (z s v0 - v0 • Fd (s0, v0)) := by
                rw [sub_smul]; abel
              rw [e]; exact key
            · intro τ _
              have h3 := (hd s hs.1 τ).sub ((hasDerivAt_id' τ).smul_const (Fd (s0, v0)))
              rw [one_smul] at h3
              exact h3.hasDerivWithinAt
            · intro τ hτ
              have hτ' : |τ - v0| ≤ |v - v0| := Set.abs_sub_left_of_mem_uIcc hτ
              have h4 : dist (s, τ) (s0, v0) < ρ₂ := by
                rw [Prod.dist_eq]
                refine max_lt hs.2.2 ?_
                rw [Real.dist_eq]
                rw [Real.dist_eq] at hv
                linarith [hv.2.2]
              rw [← dist_eq_norm]
              exact (h2 h4).le
          have hn1 : ‖s - s0‖ ≤ ‖(s, v) - (s0, v0)‖ := norm_fst_le ((s, v) - (s0, v0))
          have hn2 : ‖v - v0‖ ≤ ‖(s, v) - (s0, v0)‖ := norm_snd_le ((s, v) - (s0, v0))
          have hrw : z s v - z s0 v0 - ((W s0 v0).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ P ℝ) +
              (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ P ℝ).smulRight (Fd (s0, v0))) ((s, v) - (s0, v0)) =
              (z s v - z s v0 - (v - v0) • Fd (s0, v0)) + (z s v0 - z s0 v0 - W s0 v0 (s - s0)) := by
            simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
              ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd',
              ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, Prod.mk_sub_mk]
            abel
          show ‖z s v - z s0 v0 - ((W s0 v0).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ P ℝ) +
              (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ P ℝ).smulRight (Fd (s0, v0))) ((s, v) - (s0, v0))‖ ≤
              c * ‖(s, v) - (s0, v0)‖
          rw [hrw]
          calc _ ≤ ‖z s v - z s v0 - (v - v0) • Fd (s0, v0)‖ + ‖z s v0 - z s0 v0 - W s0 v0 (s - s0)‖ :=
                norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ c / 2 * ‖v - v0‖ + c / 2 * ‖s - s0‖ := add_le_add hB2 hA2
            _ ≤ c * ‖(s, v) - (s0, v0)‖ := by nlinarith
        rw [hF] at hfd
        exact hfd
      
      have hDk : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun w : P × ℝ =>
          (W w.1 w.2).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ P ℝ) +
            (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ P ℝ).smulRight (A w (z w.1 w.2) + b w)) (U ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
        (hWc.clm_comp contDiffOn_const).add
          (contDiffOn_const.smulRight (((hA.of_le hle).clm_apply hz).add (hb.of_le hle)))
      
      rw [contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO]
      refine ⟨fun w hw => (hD w hw).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt, fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact absurd h (by simp)
      · exact hDk.congr (fun w hw => (hD w hw).fderiv)
  
  have hz_ex : ∀ s, ∃ y : ℝ → E, s ∈ U →
      (y 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt y (A (s, v) (y v) + b (s, v)) v) := by
    intro s
    by_cases hs : s ∈ U
    · obtain ⟨y, h0, hy⟩ := linear_ode_global_exists E (fun t => A (s, t)) (fun t => b (s, t)) 0
        (hA.continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
          (fun t => ⟨hs, Set.mem_univ _⟩))
        (hb.continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
          (fun t => ⟨hs, Set.mem_univ _⟩))
      exact ⟨y, fun _ => ⟨h0, hy⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨0, fun h => absurd h hs⟩
  choose z hz using hz_ex
  refine ⟨z, ?_, fun s hs => hz s hs⟩
  rw [contDiffOn_infty]
  intro n
  exact Q n E A b z (contDiffOn_infty.1 hA n) (contDiffOn_infty.1 hb n) (fun s hs => hz s hs)

subgoal_signatures.name: linear_ode_param_fderiv
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (P E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P] [FiniteDimensional ℝ P] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (U : Set P) (A : P × ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (b : P × ℝ → E) (z : P → ℝ → E) (s0 : P) (W : ℝ → P →L[ℝ] E), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 A (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 b (U ×ˢ Set.univ) → (∀ s ∈ U, z s 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt (z s) (A (s, v) (z s v) + b (s, v)) v) → s0 ∈ U → (∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∃ r > 0, ∃ C : ℝ, Metric.ball s0 r ⊆ U ∧ ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball s0 r, ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖z s v - z s0 v‖ ≤ C * ‖s - s0‖) → W 0 = 0 → (∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt W ((A (s0, v)).comp (W v) + (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ E (z s0 v)).comp ((fderiv ℝ A (s0, v)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)) + (fderiv ℝ b (s0, v)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ P ℝ)) v) → ∀ v : ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun s => z s v) (W v) s0

by

by
  intro U J Z Gs Ar p0 Λ L K Q I P k hU hJ hp0 hIJ hZs hArs hGs hZ0 hODE hP hK hprop hQ hArJ hI hGJ
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ : ∃ X : ℝ, X = (1 + K) * (1 + L) * 6 * 2 ^ k * (1 + Q) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hO : IsOpen (U ×ˢ J) := hU.prod hJ
  have hZat : ∀ w ∈ J, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p : Cyl => Z (p, w)) p0 := fun w hw =>

  have hfd' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ Z) O := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).mp hZ).2
  
  have hjet : ∀ n : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g1 (p0, v) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (p0, v) := by
    intro n
    have hev : g1 =ᶠ[nhds ((p0, v) : Cyl × ℝ)] g2 := by
      filter_upwards [hO.mem_nhds hx0] with w hw
      exact hpt w hw
    exact (hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ n).eq_of_nhds
  have hg1comp : ∀ n : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g1 (p0, v) =
      (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (Fin 3 → ℂ) e).compContinuousMultilinearMap
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => fderiv ℝ Z y) (p0, v)) := by
    intro n
    rw [hg1]
    exact (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (Fin 3 → ℂ) e).iteratedFDeriv_comp_left
      (hfd'.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hx0)) (i := n) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  
  have hlastslot : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (w : Fin (n + 1) → Cyl × ℝ) (c : ℝ), w (Fin.last n) = c • e →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) Z (p0, v) w = c • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (p0, v) (Fin.init w) := by
    intro n w c hw
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right, hw, ContinuousLinearMap.map_smul, ← hjet n, hg1comp n]
    rfl
  have htime : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (z : Fin (n + 1) → Cyl × ℝ) (j : Fin (n + 1)), (z j).1 = 0 →
      ‖((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) Z (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')) z‖ ≤
        ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')‖ * ∏ i, ‖z i‖ := by
    intro n z j hj
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)), σ = Equiv.swap j (Fin.last n) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : Fin (n + 1) → Cyl × ℝ, w = fun i => Λ' (z (σ i)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hT : ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) Z (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')) z =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) Z (p0, v) w := by
      rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, hw]
      exact (hsymm (n + 1) (fun i => Λ' (z i)) σ).symm
    have hwl : w (Fin.last n) = (z j).2 • e := by
      rw [hw, hσ, he]
      simp only [Equiv.swap_apply_right]
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_ <;> simp [hΛ', hj]
    have hy : Fin.init w = fun i => Λ' (z (σ (Fin.castSucc i))) := by
      rw [hw]; rfl
    rw [hT, hlastslot n w _ hwl, norm_smul, hy]
    have hle := ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ'))
      (fun i => z (σ (Fin.castSucc i)))
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply] at hle
    have hc : ‖(z j).2‖ ≤ ‖z (σ (Fin.last n))‖ := by
      rw [hσ, Equiv.swap_apply_right]; exact norm_snd_le _
    have hprod : ∏ i, ‖z i‖ = (∏ i : Fin n, ‖z (σ (Fin.castSucc i))‖) * ‖z (σ (Fin.last n))‖ := by
      rw [← Fin.prod_univ_castSucc (fun i => ‖z (σ i)‖)]
      exact (Equiv.prod_comp σ (fun i => ‖z i‖)).symm
    rw [hprod]
    calc ‖(z j).2‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (p0, v) (fun i => Λ' (z (σ (Fin.castSucc i))))‖
        ≤ ‖z (σ (Fin.last n))‖ * (‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Λ')‖ * ∏ i : Fin n, ‖z (σ (Fin.castSucc i))‖) :=
          mul_le_mul hc hle (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')‖ *
            ((∏ i : Fin n, ‖z (σ (Fin.castSucc i))‖) * ‖z (σ (Fin.last n))‖) := by ring
  
  have hslowpb : ∀ j : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p : Cyl => Z (p, v)) p0 =
      (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j Z (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ Cyl ℝ) := by
    intro j
    have hc : ((0 : Cyl), v) + ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ Cyl ℝ p0 = (p0, v) := by simp
    have h1 := pbG O Z ((0 : Cyl), v) (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ Cyl ℝ) p0 j hO hZ
      (by rw [hc]; exact hx0)
    have hfun : (fun y => Z (((0 : Cyl), v) + ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ Cyl ℝ y)) =
        fun p : Cyl => Z (p, v) := by
      funext y; simp
    rw [hc, hfun] at h1
    exact h1
  have hslowb : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ k → ∀ a : Fin n → Cyl,
      ‖((iteratedFDeriv ℝ n Z (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ'))
        (fun i => (a i, (0 : ℝ)))‖ ≤ Bm * ∏ i, ‖a i‖ := by
    intro n hn a
    have h1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun p : Cyl => Z (p, v)) p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)) a
    have h2 : ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ n Z (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ'))
        (fun i => (a i, (0 : ℝ))) =
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun p : Cyl => Z (p, v)) p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)) a := by
      rw [hslowpb n]
      simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
      congr 1
      funext i
      rw [hΛ']
      simp
    rw [h2]
    exact h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hslow n hn)
      (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)))
  
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℕ → ℝ,
      E = fun n => ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n Z (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')‖ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hEn : ∀ n, E n = ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n Z (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')‖ :=
    fun n => by rw [hE]
  have hE0 : E 0 ≤ Bm := by
    rw [hEn]
    refine ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound hBm (fun m => ?_)
    have h1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun p : Cyl => Z (p, v)) p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ))
      (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)
    have h2 := hslow 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
    simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply,
      Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.prod_empty, mul_one] at h1 ⊢
    linarith
  have hh1s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => B (fun i j' => Ar w i j') (Z w)) O :=
    (B.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hA).clm_apply hZ
  have hrec : ∀ n : ℕ, n + 1 ≤ k → E (n + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1) * (2 * Bm + 3 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      (n.choose i : ℝ) * Q * E (n - i)) := by
    intro n hn
    have hsb := sbG n ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) Z (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')) Bm
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')‖ hBm (norm_nonneg _)
      (hslowb (n + 1) hn) (htime n)
    have hl := lbG B (fun pv : Cyl × ℝ => fun i j' : Fin 3 => Ar pv i j') Z O (p0, v) Λ' n hO hx0 hA hZ
    have hH : ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun w => B (fun i j' => Ar w i j') (Z w)) (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Λ')‖ ≤ 3 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * Q * E (n - i) := by
      refine hl.trans ?_
      apply mul_le_mul hB3 _ (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)) (by norm_num)
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      have hi' : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
      rw [hEn]
      have hq := hcoef i (by omega)
      have hnn : 0 ≤ ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) Z (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')‖ :=
        norm_nonneg _
      have hc0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq hc0) hnn
    have hsub : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (p0, v) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun w => B (fun i j' => Ar w i j') (Z w)) (p0, v) -
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ n Gs (p0, v) := by
      rw [hg2]
      exact iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply
        ((hh1s.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hx0)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        ((hG.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hx0)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    have hcsub : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ') =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun w => B (fun i j' => Ar w i j') (Z w)) (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Λ') -
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n Gs (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ') := by
      rw [hsub]
      exact ContinuousMultilinearMap.ext (fun m => by
        simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.sub_apply])
    have hGn : ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ')‖ ≤
        Bm + 3 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * Q * E (n - i) := by
      rw [hcsub]
      refine (norm_sub_le _ _).trans ?_
      have hg := hGj n (by omega)
      linarith
    rw [hEn (n + 1)]
    calc _ ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1) * (Bm + ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g2 (p0, v)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Λ')‖) := hsb
      _ ≤ _ := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
          linarith
  have hfin := srG k E Q Bm hQ hBm hE0 hrec
  rw [hEn] at hfin
  exact hfin

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (l0 : ℕ) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → ξ ∈ closure {η : Cyl | η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ SuppW B G γ η} → (∃ η : Cyl, η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ SuppW B G γ η) ∧ l0 ≤ γ.1 ∧ |Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ) + (γ.1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧ 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 ∧ qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 ∧ B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb ∧ |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 ∧ |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∀ (l0 : ℕ) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → ξ ∈ closure {η : Cyl | η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ SuppW B G γ η} → (∃ η : Cyl, η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ SuppW B G γ η) ∧ l0 ≤ γ.1 ∧ |Real.logb 2 (qC B.h ξ) + (γ.1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧ 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 ∧ qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 ∧ B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb ∧ |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 ∧ |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG l0 γ ξ hξ hcl
  have hU : IsOpen ({ζ : Cyl | 0 < ζ.1} ∩ {ζ : Cyl | ζ.2.2.1 < 1}) :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (qC B.h) ({ζ : Cyl | 0 < ζ.1} ∩ {ζ : Cyl | ζ.2.2.1 < 1}) := by
    have h4' : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hok.1.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hφ : Continuous (fun ζ : Cyl => ((ζ.2.1, 1 - ζ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun ζ : Cyl => ((ζ.2.1, 1 - ζ.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ))
        ({ζ : Cyl | 0 < ζ.1} ∩ {ζ : Cyl | ζ.2.2.1 < 1}) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) := by
      intro ζ hζ
      have h' : ζ.2.2.1 < 1 := hζ.2
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - ζ.2.2.1 by linarith⟩
    exact h4'.comp hφ.continuousOn hmaps
  have hDopen : IsOpen (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have h3' := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := qsOf l0))
    have e : DomC B.h (qsOf l0) =
        ({ζ : Cyl | 0 < ζ.1} ∩ {ζ : Cyl | ζ.2.2.1 < 1}) ∩ qC B.h ⁻¹' Iio (qsOf l0) := by
      ext ζ
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, e3⟩
        exact ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    rw [e]
    exact h3'
  have hqpos : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 0 < qC B.h η := by
    intro η hη
    have hη' : 0 < η.1 ∧ η.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h η < qsOf l0 := hη
    exact (hok.1.1 η.2.1 (1 - η.2.2.1) (by linarith [hη'.2.1])).1
  have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
  have hqcont : ContinuousAt (qC B.h) ξ := hcont.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds ⟨hξ'.1, hξ'.2.1⟩)
  have hXCc : ContinuousAt (XC B.h) ξ := by
    have h1 : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => η.1 ^ 2) ξ := (continuous_fst.pow 2).continuousAt
    have h2 : ContinuousAt (fun η : Cyl => 2 * qC B.h η) ξ := continuousAt_const.mul hqcont
    have h3 : 2 * qC B.h ξ ≠ 0 := by have := hqpos ξ hξ; positivity
    exact h1.div h2 h3
  
  have lim : ∀ {Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace Y] (g : Cyl → Y) (S' : Set Cyl) (T : Set Y),
      ContinuousAt g ξ → ξ ∈ closure S' → IsClosed T → (∀ η ∈ S', g η ∈ T) → g ξ ∈ T := by
    intro Y _ g S' T hg hcl' hT hmap
    have := hg.continuousWithinAt.mem_closure hcl' hmap
    rwa [hT.closure_eq] at this
  set S : Set Cyl := {η : Cyl | η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ SuppW B G γ η} with hSdef
  have hSS : ∀ η ∈ S, SuppW B G γ η := fun η hη => hη.2
  obtain ⟨η0, hη0⟩ := Set.Nonempty.of_closure ⟨ξ, hcl⟩
  have hne : ∃ η : Cyl, η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ SuppW B G γ η := ⟨η0, hη0.1, hη0.2⟩
  
  have htsE : ξ ∈ tsupport (etaL B.h γ) :=
    closure_minimal (fun η hη => (hSS η hη).2.1) (isClosed_tsupport _) hcl
  
  have hXa' : B.Xa ≤ XC B.h ξ :=
    lim (XC B.h) _ (Set.Ici B.Xa) hXCc hcl isClosed_Ici (fun η hη => (hSS η hη).2.2.2.2.1)
  have hXb' : XC B.h ξ ≤ B.Xb :=
    lim (XC B.h) _ (Set.Iic B.Xb) hXCc hcl isClosed_Iic (fun η hη => (hSS η hη).2.2.2.2.2)
  
  have hr0 : 0 < G.r0 := hG.1.1
  have hr1 : G.r0 ≤ 1/100 := hG.1.2.1
  have hbgc0 : 0 ≤ bgc := by
    unfold bgc; nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
  have hbgc1 : bgc ≤ 1 := by
    unfold bgc; nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
  have hinv : ∀ v : ℝ × ℝ, v.1 = lamR v + bgc * lamT v ∧ v.2 = -bgc * lamR v + lamT v := by
    intro v
    have hd : (1 + bgc ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    unfold lamR lamT
    constructor
    · field_simp; ring
    · field_simp; ring
  have hsmall : ∀ v : ℝ × ℝ, |lamR v| ≤ G.r0 / 4 → |lamT v| ≤ G.r0 →
      |v.1| ≤ 1/80 ∧ |v.2| ≤ 1/80 := by
    intro v h1 h2
    obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hinv v
    rw [abs_le] at h1 h2
    have p1 : bgc * lamT v ≤ bgc * G.r0 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2.2 hbgc0
    have p2 : bgc * (-G.r0) ≤ bgc * lamT v := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2.1 hbgc0
    have p3 : bgc * lamR v ≤ bgc * (G.r0/4) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1.2 hbgc0
    have p4 : bgc * (-(G.r0/4)) ≤ bgc * lamR v := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1.1 hbgc0
    have p5 : bgc * G.r0 ≤ G.r0 := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hbgc1) hr0.le]
    have p6 : bgc * (G.r0/4) ≤ G.r0/4 := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hbgc1) hr0.le]
    constructor
    · rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> nlinarith
    · rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> nlinarith
  have R : ∀ (x : ℝ) (j : ℤ), |x - j| < 1/2 → round x = j := by
    intro x j hx
    rw [round_eq, Int.floor_eq_iff]
    rw [abs_lt] at hx
    constructor <;> linarith
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : Cyl → ℝ × ℝ, w = fun η => Jpow (bandIdx B.h γ.1) η.2.2.2 - G.ctr γ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hwc : Continuous w := by rw [hw]; unfold Jpow; fun_prop
  have hxiw : ∀ η : Cyl, xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 = lamR (frac0 (w η)) := by
    intro η; rw [hw]; rfl
  have hetw : ∀ η : Cyl, etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 = lamT (frac0 (w η)) := by
    intro η; rw [hw]; rfl
  have hNo : IsOpen {η : Cyl | |(w η).1 - (w ξ).1| < 1/4 ∧ |(w η).2 - (w ξ).2| < 1/4} := by
    have h1 : IsOpen {η : Cyl | |(w η).1 - (w ξ).1| < 1/4} :=
      isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
    have h2 : IsOpen {η : Cyl | |(w η).2 - (w ξ).2| < 1/4} :=
      isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
    exact h1.inter h2
  have hξN : ξ ∈ closure ({η : Cyl | |(w η).1 - (w ξ).1| < 1/4 ∧ |(w η).2 - (w ξ).2| < 1/4} ∩ S) :=
    hNo.inter_closure ⟨by simp, hcl⟩
  have hfreeze : ∀ η ∈ {η : Cyl | |(w η).1 - (w ξ).1| < 1/4 ∧ |(w η).2 - (w ξ).2| < 1/4} ∩ S,
      frac0 (w η) = ((w η).1 - ((round (w ξ).1 : ℤ) : ℝ), (w η).2 - ((round (w ξ).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)) := by
    rintro η ⟨⟨hN1, hN2⟩, hηS⟩
    have hs := hSS η hηS
    have h1 := hs.2.2.1
    have h2 := hs.2.2.2.1
    rw [hxiw] at h1
    rw [hetw] at h2
    obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := hsmall _ h1 h2
    have b1' : |(w η).1 - ((round (w η).1 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1/80 := b1
    have b2' : |(w η).2 - ((round (w η).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1/80 := b2
    have r1 : round (w ξ).1 = round (w η).1 := by
      apply R
      rw [abs_lt] at hN1 ⊢
      rw [abs_le] at b1'
      constructor <;> linarith [hN1.1, hN1.2, b1'.1, b1'.2]
    have r2 : round (w ξ).2 = round (w η).2 := by
      apply R
      rw [abs_lt] at hN2 ⊢
      rw [abs_le] at b2'
      constructor <;> linarith [hN2.1, hN2.2, b2'.1, b2'.2]
    unfold frac0
    rw [r1, r2]
  have hu : frac0 (w ξ) =
      ((w ξ).1 - ((round (w ξ).1 : ℤ) : ℝ), (w ξ).2 - ((round (w ξ).2 : ℤ) : ℝ)) := rfl
  have hxi : |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ G.r0 / 4 := by
    rw [hxiw, hu]
    refine lim (fun η => |lamR ((w η).1 - ((round (w ξ).1 : ℤ) : ℝ),
      (w η).2 - ((round (w ξ).2 : ℤ) : ℝ))|) _ (Set.Iic (G.r0/4)) ?_ hξN isClosed_Iic ?_
    · apply Continuous.continuousAt; unfold lamR; fun_prop
    · intro η hη
      simp only [Set.mem_Iic]
      rw [← hfreeze η hη]
      have := (hSS η hη.2).2.2.1
      rw [hxiw] at this
      exact this
  have het : |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| ≤ G.r0 := by
