    rcases lt_trichotomy ξ'.2.2.1 1 with ht | ht | ht
    · have hD : ξ' ∈ DomC h qB := show 0 < ξ'.1 ∧ ξ'.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC h ξ' < qB from ⟨hr', ht, hq'B⟩
      exact ⟨ξ', hD, hne', hXa', hXb'⟩
    · obtain ⟨r', z', t', Y'⟩ := ξ'
      change t' = 1 at ht
      subst ht
      have hq0 : qC h (r', z', 1, Y') = simScale h z' 0 := by
        show simScale h z' (1 - 1) = _
        rw [sub_self]
      have hq0pos : 0 < simScale h z' 0 := by rw [← hq0]; exact hq'pos
      have hq0B : simScale h z' 0 < qB := by rw [← hq0]; exact hq'B
      have hc1 : |Real.logb 2 (simScale h z' 0) + (γ.1:ℝ)| < 1 := by rw [← hq0]; exact c1
      obtain ⟨X', hX'⟩ : ∃ X' : ℝ, X' = XC h (r', z', 1, Y') := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      rw [← hX'] at hXa' hXb'
      have hX'pos : 0 < X' := lt_of_lt_of_le hXa hXa'
      have hrq : Real.sqrt (2 * simScale h z' 0 * X') = r' := by
        have h11 : 2 * simScale h z' 0 * X' = r' ^ 2 := by
          rw [hX']
          unfold XC
          rw [hq0]
          field_simp
        rw [h11, Real.sqrt_sq hr'.le]
      have T := hcont z'
      have E1 : ∀ᶠ δ in nhdsWithin (0:ℝ) (Ioi 0), 0 < δ := self_mem_nhdsWithin
      have E2 : ∀ᶠ δ in nhdsWithin (0:ℝ) (Ioi 0), simScale h z' δ < qB := T.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hq0B)
      have E3 : ∀ᶠ δ in nhdsWithin (0:ℝ) (Ioi 0), |Real.logb 2 (simScale h z' δ) + (γ.1:ℝ)| < 1 := by
        have hg : ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ => |Real.logb 2 q + (γ.1:ℝ)|) (simScale h z' 0) :=
          ((Real.continuousAt_logb (b := 2) hq0pos.ne').add continuousAt_const).abs
        exact (hg.tendsto.comp T).eventually (gt_mem_nhds hc1)
      have E4 : ∀ᶠ δ in nhdsWithin (0:ℝ) (Ioi 0),
          |Real.sqrt (2 * simScale h z' δ * X') / Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1:ℝ)| < 1 := by
        have hg : Continuous (fun q : ℝ =>
            |Real.sqrt (2 * q * X') / Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.1:ℝ)|) := by fun_prop
        have hv : |Real.sqrt (2 * simScale h z' 0 * X') / Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) -
            (γ.2.1.1:ℝ)| < 1 := by
          rw [hrq]; exact c2
        exact ((hg.tendsto _).comp T).eventually (gt_mem_nhds hv)
      have E5 : ∀ᶠ δ in nhdsWithin (0:ℝ) (Ioi 0),
          |(1 - (1 - δ)) / Qb γ.1 / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2:ℝ)| < 1 := by
        have hg : Continuous (fun δ : ℝ =>
            |(1 - (1 - δ)) / Qb γ.1 / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2:ℝ)|) := by fun_prop
        have hv : |(1 - (1 - (0:ℝ))) / Qb γ.1 / Sb γ.1 ^ (-3:ℤ) - (γ.2.1.2.2:ℝ)| < 1 := by
          have h12 : (1 - (1 - (0:ℝ))) = 1 - 1 := by ring
          rw [h12]; exact c4
        exact ((hg.tendsto 0).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds).eventually (gt_mem_nhds hv)
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδB, hδ3, hδ4, hδ5⟩ := (E1.and (E2.and (E3.and (E4.and E5)))).exists
      have hqd : qC h (Real.sqrt (2 * simScale h z' δ * X'), z', 1 - δ, Y') = simScale h z' δ := by
        show simScale h z' (1 - (1 - δ)) = _
        rw [sub_sub_cancel]
      have hqdpos : 0 < simScale h z' δ := (hSim.1 z' δ hδ).1
      have hprod : 0 < 2 * simScale h z' δ * X' := mul_pos (mul_pos two_pos hqdpos) hX'pos
      have hXd : XC h (Real.sqrt (2 * simScale h z' δ * X'), z', 1 - δ, Y') = X' := by
        unfold XC
        rw [hqd]
        show Real.sqrt (2 * simScale h z' δ * X') ^ 2 / (2 * simScale h z' δ) = X'
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt hprod.le]
        have := hqdpos.ne'
        field_simp
      have hD : (Real.sqrt (2 * simScale h z' δ * X'), z', 1 - δ, Y') ∈ DomC h qB :=
        show 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * simScale h z' δ * X') ∧ 1 - δ < 1 ∧
            qC h (Real.sqrt (2 * simScale h z' δ * X'), z', 1 - δ, Y') < qB from
          ⟨Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hprod, by linarith, by rw [hqd]; exact hδB⟩
      refine ⟨_, hD, ?_, by rw [hXd]; exact hXa', by rw [hXd]; exact hXb'⟩
      rw [heta]
      exact ⟨by rw [hqd]; exact hδ3, hδ4, c3, hδ5⟩
    · exfalso
      exact hq'ne (hneg ξ'.2.1 (1 - ξ'.2.2.1) (by linarith))
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨hSim, hBP⟩ := hok
  obtain ⟨⟨hh0, hh1, hXa, -, -, -, -, hqB, -⟩, -⟩ := hBP
  obtain ⟨l1, hl1⟩ := key B.h B.Xa B.Xb B.qB hSim hh0 hh1 hXa hqB
  refine ⟨l1, fun l0 hl0 γ η hηD hS => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨hlmin, ξ', hne', hXa', hXb'⟩, hts, -, -, hXaη, -⟩ := hS
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξD, hne, hx1, hx2⟩ := hl1 l0 hl0 γ η hηD hts hXaη ξ' hne' hXa' hXb'
  exact ⟨hlmin, ξ, hξD, hne, hx1, hx2⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ (l0 : ℕ) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), l1 ≤ l0 → ActiveL4 B G γ → l0 ≤ γ.1 → ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 → qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 → B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb → |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 → |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 → (∃ U : Set Cyl, IsOpen U ∧ ξ ∈ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (phiL5 B G γ) U) ∧ (1 ≤ k → (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (phiL5 B G γ) ξ‖ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (-M))

signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ (l0 : ℕ) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl), l1 ≤ l0 → ActiveL4 B G γ → l0 ≤ γ.1 → ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 → qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 → B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb → |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 → |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 → (∃ U : Set Cyl, IsOpen U ∧ ξ ∈ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (phiL5 B G γ) U) ∧ (1 ≤ k → (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (phiL5 B G γ) ξ‖ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (-M))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨hr0, hr01, hu, -, -⟩ := hG.1
  obtain ⟨C0, hC0, hconv⟩ := nbg5_plain_le_nb B.h hh0 hh1
  obtain ⟨lr, cr, Cr, -, hR⟩ := rep_consts_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lv, Cv, hV⟩ := vco_nb_v5 B hok
  obtain ⟨lcp, hCP⟩ := chart_profile_nb_v5 B hok
  choose Ccp hCcp using hCP
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  obtain ⟨hDo, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B B.qB hok
  obtain ⟨-, hBsm⟩ := geom_slow_base_smooth_v5 B hok
  have hQb : ∀ l : ℕ, Qb l = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l := fun l => by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  refine ⟨lr + lv + lcp + n0, fun k => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℝ, E = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Ccp j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCE : ∀ j, j ≤ k → |Ccp j| ≤ E := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hE]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Ccp j|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  obtain ⟨C4, hC4def⟩ : ∃ C4 : ℝ, C4 = 2 ^ k * Cv * (2 * |Cr| * E) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨10 * |Cr| * (2 + G.ustar) + 80 * C0 ^ k * |C4|, ((3 * k + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ), Nat.cast_nonneg _, ?_⟩
  intro l0 γ ξ hl0 hAct hl0γ hξ hb1 hb2 hX1 hX2 hxi het8
  have hξ' : 0 < ξ.1 ∧ ξ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ξ < qsOf l0 := hξ
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hok.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ'.2.1])).1
  have hqs : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := hQb l0
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 ≤ B.qB := by
    rw [hqs]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0.le
  have hq1 : qC B.h ξ < 1 :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hξ'.2.2 (by rw [hqs]; exact pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
  have hξB : ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB := ⟨hξ'.1, hξ'.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hξ'.2.2 hqsB⟩
  have hQ0 : 0 < Qb γ.1 := by rw [hQb]; positivity
  have hQ1 : Qb γ.1 ≤ 1 := by rw [hQb]; exact pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨⟨U, hUo, hξU, hφU⟩, hVc⟩ := phiL5_local_form_v5 B G γ ξ hok hξB hxi het8
  refine ⟨⟨U, hUo, hξU, hφU⟩, fun hk => ?_⟩
  
  have hRc := hR γ hAct (by omega)
  have hpa : |pang5 B G γ| ≤ |Cr| := hRc.2.2.1.trans (le_abs_self _)
  have hpz : |pzr5 B G γ| ≤ |Cr| := hRc.2.1.trans (le_abs_self _)
  have hBs : |Bs5 B G γ| ≤ Cr := hRc.2.2.2
  
  have hVb : ∀ i, NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2) i ξ ≤ Cv * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
    fun i => hV γ G.r0 (G.ctr γ) l0 hr0.le hr01 (by omega) hl0γ ξ hξ hb1 hb2 hxi het8 i
  set Ω : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) := {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}
    with hΩ
  have hB2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcB5 B γ.1 2) Ω := hBsm γ.1 2
  have hB1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcB5 B γ.1 1) Ω := hBsm γ.1 1
  have hRC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcRC5 γ.1) Ω := by
    have : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pcRC5 γ.1) := by unfold pcRC5; fun_prop
    exact this.contDiffOn
  have hFa : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcFa5 B γ.1) Ω := by
    have := hB1.div hRC (fun s hs => by
      unfold pcRC5
      exact div_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hs.1) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQ0).ne')
    exact this
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun η : Cyl => ((η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (DomC B.h B.qB) Ω := by
    intro η hη
    simp only [hΩ, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    exact ⟨hη.1, hη.2.1, hη.2.2⟩
  have hπ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => ((η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
  have eFa : Fang B γ.1 = fun η : Cyl => pcFa5 B γ.1 (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) := rfl
  have eB2 : (fun η : Cyl => baseC B γ.1 η 2) = fun η : Cyl => pcB5 B γ.1 2 (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) := rfl
  have hFaD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Fang B γ.1) (DomC B.h B.qB) := by
    rw [eFa]; exact hFa.comp hπ.contDiffOn hmaps
  have hB2D : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => baseC B γ.1 η 2) (DomC B.h B.qB) := by
    rw [eB2]; exact hB2.comp hπ.contDiffOn hmaps
  have hPD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => pang5 B G γ * Fang B γ.1 η + pzr5 B G γ * baseC B γ.1 η 2)
      (DomC B.h B.qB) := (contDiffOn_const.mul hFaD).add (contDiffOn_const.mul hB2D)
  have hPc := hPD.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hξB)
  have hPb : ∀ i, i ≤ k →
      NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => pang5 B G γ * Fang B γ.1 η + pzr5 B G γ * baseC B γ.1 η 2) i ξ ≤
        2 * |Cr| * E := by
    intro i hi
    have hlin := (nb_real_algebra_v5 B.h (DomC B.h B.qB) ξ hDo hξB (Fang B γ.1)
      (fun η : Cyl => baseC B γ.1 η 2) hFaD hB2D i).2.1 (pang5 B G γ) (pzr5 B G γ)
    refine hlin.trans ?_
    obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := hCcp i γ.1 l0 (by omega) hl0γ ξ hξ hb1 hb2 hX1 hX2
    have hc := hCE i hi
    have f1 : NB B.h (Fang B γ.1) i ξ ≤ E := by
      rw [eFa]; exact a1.trans ((le_abs_self _).trans hc)
    have f2 : NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => baseC B γ.1 η 2) i ξ ≤ E := by
      rw [eB2]; exact a2.trans ((le_abs_self _).trans hc)
    have m1 : |pang5 B G γ| * NB B.h (Fang B γ.1) i ξ ≤ |Cr| * E :=
      mul_le_mul hpa f1 (norm_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)
    have m2 : |pzr5 B G γ| * NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => baseC B γ.1 η 2) i ξ ≤ |Cr| * E :=
      mul_le_mul hpz f2 (norm_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)
    linarith
  have hprod := nb_real_mul_le_v5 B.h ξ (fun η : Cyl => vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2)
    (fun η : Cyl => pang5 B G γ * Fang B γ.1 η + pzr5 B G γ * baseC B γ.1 η 2) k
    (Cv * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2) (2 * |Cr| * E) hVc hPc (fun i _ => hVb i) hPb
  have hVP : NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 *
      (pang5 B G γ * Fang B γ.1 η + pzr5 B G γ * baseC B γ.1 η 2)) k ξ ≤ C4 * (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    refine hprod.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [hC4def]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨x, hxdef⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by rw [hxdef]; exact inv_pos.2 hq0
  have hx1 : 1 ≤ x := by rw [hxdef]; exact (one_le_inv₀ hq0).2 hq1.le
  have hQinv : (Qb γ.1)⁻¹ < 4 * x := by
    have e : (qC B.h ξ)⁻¹ * (qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1) = (Qb γ.1)⁻¹ := by
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0.ne', one_mul]
    rw [← e, hxdef]
    have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hb2 (inv_pos.2 hq0)
    linarith
  have hkb : (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) ≤ 5 * x := by
    have hep : 0 ≤ epsb B.h γ.1 := Real.rpow_nonneg hQ0.le _
    have hE' : epsb B.h γ.1 ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) ≤ (Qb γ.1)⁻¹ := by
      rw [epsb, ← Real.rpow_mul hQ0.le, ← Real.rpow_neg_one]
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hQ0 hQ1 (by linarith)
    have hc := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (Real.rpow_nonneg hep (-(1/2:ℝ)))
    unfold kb
    linarith
  have hℓ : (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 16 * x ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : (γ.1 : ℝ) < 2 ^ γ.1 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_two_pow_self : γ.1 < 2 ^ γ.1)
    have h2 : (2:ℝ) ^ γ.1 = (Qb γ.1)⁻¹ := by rw [hQb, one_div, inv_pow, inv_inv]
    have h3 : (γ.1 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * x := by linarith
    have h0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ γ.1 := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    calc (γ.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 = (γ.1 : ℝ) * γ.1 := sq _
      _ ≤ (4 * x) * (4 * x) := mul_le_mul h3 h3 h0 (by linarith)
      _ = 16 * x ^ 2 := by ring
  
  obtain ⟨A1, hA1⟩ : ∃ A1 : ℝ, A1 = pzr5 B G γ * (Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2 - B.h) * epsb B.h γ.1)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨A2, hA2⟩ : ∃ A2 : ℝ, A2 = (sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2) * (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1))⁻¹ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Lc, hLc⟩ : ∃ Lc : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ, ∀ v : Cyl, Lc v = A1 * v.2.1 + A2 * v.1 :=
    ⟨A1 • ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))) +
      A2 • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)), fun v => by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨Wf, hWf⟩ : ∃ Wf : Cyl → ℝ, Wf = fun η => Lc η - phiL5 B G γ η := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hWeq : Wf = fun η : Cyl => vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) η.2.2.2 *
      (pang5 B G γ * Fang B γ.1 η + pzr5 B G γ * baseC B γ.1 η 2) := by
    rw [hWf]
    funext η
    rw [hLc]
    simp only [phiL5, chartZ, RC, hA1, hA2]
    ring
  have hsplit : phiL5 B G γ = ⇑Lc - Wf := by
    funext η
    rw [hWf]
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
    ring
  have hφc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (phiL5 B G γ) ξ := hφU.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hξU)
  have hLcc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (⇑Lc) ξ := Lc.contDiff.contDiffAt
  have hWc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Wf ξ := by rw [hWf]; exact hLcc.sub hφc
  have hDk : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (phiL5 B G γ) ξ‖ ≤
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (⇑Lc) ξ‖ + ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Wf ξ‖ := by
    rw [hsplit, iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply (hLcc.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      (hWc.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
    exact norm_sub_le _ _
  
  have hDL : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (⇑Lc) ξ‖ ≤ ‖Lc‖ := by
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, k = j + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (⇑Lc) = fun _ => Lc := funext (fun y => Lc.fderiv)
    rw [hfd]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with hj | hj
    · subst hj
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]
    · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (by omega) Lc]
      simp
  have hLcn : ‖Lc‖ ≤ ‖A1‖ + ‖A2‖ := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity) (fun v => ?_)
    rw [hLc]
    have h1 : ‖v.2.1‖ ≤ ‖v‖ := (norm_fst_le v.2).trans (norm_snd_le v)
    have h2 : ‖v.1‖ ≤ ‖v‖ := norm_fst_le v
    calc ‖A1 * v.2.1 + A2 * v.1‖ ≤ ‖A1 * v.2.1‖ + ‖A2 * v.1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖A1‖ * ‖v.2.1‖ + ‖A2‖ * ‖v.1‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
      _ ≤ ‖A1‖ * ‖v‖ + ‖A2‖ * ‖v‖ :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (norm_nonneg _))
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (norm_nonneg _))
      _ = (‖A1‖ + ‖A2‖) * ‖v‖ := by ring
  have hD1 : Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2 - B.h) * epsb B.h γ.1 = Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2:ℝ) := by
    rw [epsb, ← Real.rpow_add hQ0]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hQhalf : Qb γ.1 ≤ Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2:ℝ) := by
    have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hQ0 hQ1 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) ≤ 1)
    rwa [Real.rpow_one] at this
  have hD1pos : 0 < Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2 - B.h) * epsb B.h γ.1 := by
    rw [hD1]; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ0 _
  have hD1inv : (Qb γ.1 ^ (1/2 - B.h) * epsb B.h γ.1)⁻¹ ≤ (Qb γ.1)⁻¹ := by
    rw [hD1]; exact inv_anti₀ hQ0 hQhalf
  have hsq : Qb γ.1 ≤ Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1) := by
    rw [Real.le_sqrt hQ0.le hQ0.le, sq]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_left hQ0.le hQ1
  have hsqinv : (Real.sqrt (Qb γ.1))⁻¹ ≤ (Qb γ.1)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ hQ0 hsq
  have hA1b : ‖A1‖ ≤ |Cr| * (4 * x) := by
    rw [hA1, norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hD1pos.le), Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact mul_le_mul hpz (hD1inv.trans hQinv.le)
      (inv_nonneg.2 hD1pos.le) (abs_nonneg _)
  have hsgn : |sgn γ.2.2| = 1 := by
    unfold sgn
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have hA2b : ‖A2‖ ≤ |Cr| * G.ustar / 2 * (4 * x) := by
    have e : |sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2| = |Bs5 B G γ| * G.ustar / 2 := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_mul, hsgn, one_mul, abs_of_pos hu, abs_two]
    have hB2' : |Bs5 B G γ| * G.ustar / 2 ≤ |Cr| * G.ustar / 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hBs.trans (le_abs_self _)) hu.le) (by norm_num)
    rw [hA2, norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)), Real.norm_eq_abs, e]
    exact mul_le_mul hB2' (hsqinv.trans hQinv.le) (inv_nonneg.2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
      (by have := abs_nonneg Cr; positivity)
  have hDLb : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (⇑Lc) ξ‖ ≤ 2 * |Cr| * (2 + G.ustar) * x := by
    have := hDL.trans (hLcn.trans (add_le_add hA1b hA2b))
    calc _ ≤ |Cr| * (4 * x) + |Cr| * G.ustar / 2 * (4 * x) := this
      _ = 2 * |Cr| * (2 + G.ustar) * x := by ring
  
  have hq3 : qC B.h ξ ^ (-3:ℝ) = x ^ 3 := by
    rw [show (-3:ℝ) = -((3:ℕ):ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_neg hq0.le, Real.rpow_natCast, hxdef, inv_pow]
  have hNB : NB B.h Wf k ξ ≤ |C4| * (16 * x ^ 2) := by
    rw [hWeq]
    refine hVP.trans ?_
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (sq_nonneg _)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hℓ (abs_nonneg _))
  have hDW : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Wf ξ‖ ≤ (C0 * x ^ 3) ^ k * (|C4| * (16 * x ^ 2)) := by
    have hc := hconv ξ hq0 hq1 Wf k
    rw [hq3] at hc
    exact hc.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNB
      (pow_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (pow_nonneg hx0.le 3)) k))
  
  have hnorm : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (phiL5 B G γ) ξ‖ ≤
      2 * |Cr| * (2 + G.ustar) * x + (C0 * x ^ 3) ^ k * (|C4| * (16 * x ^ 2)) :=
    hDk.trans (add_le_add hDLb hDW)
  have hx2 : x ^ 2 ≤ x ^ (3 * k + 3) := pow_le_pow_right₀ hx1 (by omega)
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ 10 * (|Cr| * (2 + G.ustar)) :=
    mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith))
  have hqM : qC B.h ξ ^ (-((3 * k + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ)) = x ^ (3 * k + 3) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hq0.le, Real.rpow_natCast, hxdef, inv_pow]
  rw [hqM]
  calc (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (phiL5 B G γ) ξ‖
      ≤ (5 * x) * (2 * |Cr| * (2 + G.ustar) * x + (C0 * x ^ 3) ^ k * (|C4| * (16 * x ^ 2))) :=
        mul_le_mul hkb hnorm (norm_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    _ = 10 * (|Cr| * (2 + G.ustar)) * x ^ 2 + 80 * C0 ^ k * |C4| * x ^ (3 * k + 3) := by
        rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
        ring
    _ ≤ 10 * (|Cr| * (2 + G.ustar)) * x ^ (3 * k + 3) + 80 * C0 ^ k * |C4| * x ^ (3 * k + 3) :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx2 hL0) le_rfl
    _ = (10 * |Cr| * (2 + G.ustar) + 80 * C0 ^ k * |C4|) * x ^ (3 * k + 3) := by ring

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B l0 hok k
  obtain ⟨-, hWo, -, -, sE, -, hcb⟩ := ipb5_mean_coord_bounds B l0 0 hok
  set W : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ) := {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < rad z.1 ∧
    B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < 2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 ∧
    rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)} with hWdef
  
  have hgen : ∀ (Ω : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ)) (v : ℝ³ × ℝ → ℂ) (x : ℝ³ × ℝ) (kk : ℕ) (D : ℝ), IsOpen Ω →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v Ω → x ∈ Ω → 0 ≤ D → ‖v x‖ ≤ 1 →
      (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ kk → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i v x‖ ≤ D ^ i) →
      ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ kk → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun y => v y ^ n) x‖ ≤ ((1 + (n : ℝ)) * D) ^ j := by
    intro Ω v x kk D hΩ hv hx hD hv1 hvb n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro j hj
      simp only [pow_zero]
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with rfl | hj0
      · simp
      · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (by omega : j ≠ 0) (1:ℂ)]
        simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
        positivity
    | succ n ih =>
      intro j hj
      have hfun : (fun y => v y ^ (n+1)) = fun y => v y * v y ^ n := by funext y; ring
      rw [hfun]
      have h := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hv (hv.pow n) hΩ.uniqueDiffOn hx (n := j)
        (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hΩ hx] at h
      refine h.trans ?_
      have hvi : ∀ i, i ≤ kk → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i v x‖ ≤ D ^ i := by
        intro i hi
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with rfl | hi0
        · simpa [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] using hv1
        · exact hvb i hi0 hi
      calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i v Ω x‖ *
            ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ (j - i) (fun y => v y ^ n) Ω x‖
          ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) * D ^ i * ((1 + (n:ℝ)) * D) ^ (j - i) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro i hi
            have hij : i ≤ j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
            rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen i hΩ hx, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (j - i) hΩ hx]
            exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hvi i (by omega)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
              (ih (j - i) (by omega)) (norm_nonneg _)
              (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg hD _))
        _ = (D + (1 + (n:ℝ)) * D) ^ j := by
            rw [add_pow]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i _
            ring
        _ = ((1 + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * D) ^ j := by push_cast; ring
  
  obtain ⟨Lp, hLp⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℂ, ∀ v : ℝ³, L v = (v 1 : ℂ) - (v 0 : ℂ) * Complex.I :=
    ⟨(EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (1 : ℂ) +
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (-Complex.I), fun v => by
        simp [Complex.real_smul]; ring⟩
  obtain ⟨Lm, hLm⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℂ, ∀ v : ℝ³, L v = (v 1 : ℂ) + (v 0 : ℂ) * Complex.I :=
    ⟨(EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (1 : ℂ) +
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight Complex.I, fun v => by
        simp [Complex.real_smul]⟩
  
  have hangle : ∀ x : ℝ³, 0 < rad x →
      Complex.exp ((thetaOf x : ℂ) * Complex.I) = Lp (eTh x) ∧
      Complex.exp (((-thetaOf x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = Lm (eTh x) := by
    intro x hr
    have hnorm : ‖(⟨x 0, x 1⟩ : ℂ)‖ = rad x := by
      rw [Complex.norm_def, Complex.normSq_mk]
      unfold rad
      congr 1

    have hζ0 : (⟨x 0, x 1⟩ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h

      ring
    have hc : Real.cos (thetaOf x) = x 0 / rad x := by

      rw [Complex.cos_arg hζ0, hnorm]
    have hs : Real.sin (thetaOf x) = x 1 / rad x := by
      unfold thetaOf
      rw [Complex.sin_arg, hnorm]
    rw [hLp, hLm, h0, h1]
    constructor
    · rw [Complex.exp_mul_I, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin, hc, hs]
      push_cast
      ring
    · rw [Complex.exp_mul_I, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin, Real.cos_neg,
        Real.sin_neg, hc, hs]
      push_cast
      ring
  
  choose Cc Kc hcK using hcb
  obtain ⟨Kb, hKb⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Kc i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Cb, hCb⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cc i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hKb0 : 0 ≤ Kb := by rw [hKb]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hKle : ∀ i, i ≤ k → |Kc i| ≤ Kb := fun i hi => by
    rw [hKb]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Kc i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  have hCle : ∀ i, i ≤ k → |Cc i| ≤ Cb := fun i hi => by
    have : |Cc i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cc j| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cc j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
    rw [hCb]; linarith
  have hCb1 : 1 ≤ Cb := by
    have : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cc j| := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    rw [hCb]; linarith
  have hnLp := norm_nonneg Lp
  have hnLm := norm_nonneg Lm
  have hC1 : 1 ≤ (1 + ‖Lp‖ + ‖Lm‖) * Cb :=
    one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le (by linarith) hCb1
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (by simp)
  have hq : ∀ z ∈ W, 0 < simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ∧ simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ≤ 1 := by
    intro z hz
    have h1 : z.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < qsOf l0 := hz.1
    exact ⟨(hok.1.1 (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) (by linarith [h1.1])).1, le_trans h1.2.le hqs1⟩
  have hvsm : ∀ L : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℂ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => L (eTh w.1)) W :=
    fun L => L.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn sE
  have hvb : ∀ L : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℂ, ‖L‖ ≤ 1 + ‖Lp‖ + ‖Lm‖ → ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => L (eTh w.1)) z‖ ≤
        (1 + ‖Lp‖ + ‖Lm‖) * Cb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-Kb) := by
    intro L hL z hz i hi
    obtain ⟨q0, q1⟩ := hq z hz
    have hca : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => eTh w.1) z := sE.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hz)
    have h1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => L (eTh w.1)) z‖ ≤
        ‖L‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => eTh w.1) z‖ :=
      L.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left hca (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e1 := (hcK i z hz).2.1
    have hKi : -Kb ≤ -Kc i := by linarith [le_abs_self (Kc i), hKle i hi]
    have e2 : simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-Kc i) ≤ simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-Kb) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge q0 q1 hKi
    have hp : 0 ≤ simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-Kc i) := Real.rpow_nonneg q0.le _
    have hp' : 0 ≤ simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-Kb) := Real.rpow_nonneg q0.le _
    have e3 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => eTh w.1) z‖ ≤
        Cb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-Kb) :=
      calc _ ≤ Cc i * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-Kc i) := e1
        _ ≤ |Cc i| * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-Kc i) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hp
        _ ≤ Cb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-Kb) :=
            mul_le_mul (hCle i hi) e2 hp (by linarith)
    calc _ ≤ ‖L‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => eTh w.1) z‖ := h1
      _ ≤ (1 + ‖Lp‖ + ‖Lm‖) * (Cb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-Kb)) :=
          mul_le_mul hL e3 (norm_nonneg _) (by linarith)
      _ = _ := by ring
  refine ⟨(1 + ‖Lp‖ + ‖Lm‖) * Cb, Kb, hC1, hKb0, fun N => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg N
  have fin : ∀ L : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℂ, ‖L‖ ≤ 1 + ‖Lp‖ + ‖Lm‖ →
      (∀ w ∈ W, Complex.exp (Complex.I * (N : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ)) = L (eTh w.1) ^ n) →
      (∀ w ∈ W, ‖L (eTh w.1)‖ = 1) → |(N : ℝ)| = (n : ℝ) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (N : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ))) W ∧
      ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (N : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ))) z‖ ≤
          ((1 + |(N : ℝ)|) * ((1 + ‖Lp‖ + ‖Lm‖) * Cb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-Kb))) ^ j := by
    intro L hL hid hunit hNn
    refine ⟨((hvsm L).pow n).congr hid, fun z hz j hj => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨q0, q1⟩ := hq z hz
    have hS1 : 1 ≤ simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-Kb) :=
      Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos q0 q1 (by linarith)
    have hD1 : 1 ≤ (1 + ‖Lp‖ + ‖Lm‖) * Cb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-Kb) :=
      one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hC1 hS1
    have hev : (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (N : ℂ) * (thetaOf w.1 : ℂ))) =ᶠ[nhds z]
        (fun y : ℝ³ × ℝ => L (eTh y.1) ^ n) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hWo.mem_nhds hz) hid
    rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds, hNn]
    exact hgen W (fun w => L (eTh w.1)) z k
      ((1 + ‖Lp‖ + ‖Lm‖) * Cb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) ^ (-Kb)) hWo (hvsm L) hz
      (by linarith) (le_of_eq (hunit z hz))
      (fun i hi1 hik => (hvb L hL z hz i hik).trans (le_self_pow₀ hD1 (by omega))) n j hj
  rcases hn with hn | hn
  · refine fin Lp (by linarith) (fun w hw => ?_) (fun w hw => ?_) (by rw [hn]; simp)
    · rw [← (hangle w.1 hw.2.1).1, ← Complex.exp_nat_mul, hn]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    · rw [← (hangle w.1 hw.2.1).1]
      exact Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I _
  · refine fin Lm (by linarith) (fun w hw => ?_) (fun w hw => ?_) (by rw [hn]; simp)
    · rw [← (hangle w.1 hw.2.1).2, ← Complex.exp_nat_mul, hn]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    · rw [← (hangle w.1 hw.2.1).2]
      exact Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I _

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B l0 hok k
  
  have hcexp : ∀ (i : ℕ) (y : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ))) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun s : ℝ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ))) y‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro i y
    set g : ℝ → ℂ := fun s : ℝ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ)) with hg
    have hsm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g := by
      have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => Complex.I * (s : ℂ)) :=
        contDiff_const.mul Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff
      exact h1.cexp
    have hder : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt g (Complex.I * g s) s := by
      intro s
      have h := (((hasDerivAt_id s).ofReal_comp).const_mul Complex.I).cexp
      have e : Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((id s : ℝ) : ℂ)) * (Complex.I * ((1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          Complex.I * g s := by
        rw [hg]; simp only [id, Complex.ofReal_one, mul_one]; ring
      rw [e] at h
      exact h
    have hit : ∀ n : ℕ, iteratedDeriv n g = fun s => Complex.I ^ n * g s := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => funext s; simp
      | succ n ih =>
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, ih]
        funext s
        have := ((hder s).const_mul (Complex.I ^ n)).deriv
        rw [this]
        ring
    refine ⟨hsm, ?_⟩
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, hit i]
    simp only [hg, norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_I, one_pow, one_mul]
    rw [mul_comm, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
  obtain ⟨-, hWo, -, sXi, -, -, hcb⟩ := ipb5_mean_coord_bounds B l0 0 hok
  choose Cc Kc hcK using hcb
  set W : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ) := {z : ℝ³ × ℝ | z ∈ simDomain B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ 0 < rad z.1 ∧
    B.Xa * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) < 2 * rad z.1 ^ 2 ∧
    rad z.1 ^ 2 < 8 * B.Xb * simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2)} with hWdef
  set Ξ : ℝ³ × ℝ → Cyl := fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => ptOf w.1 w.2 (Yph B.h (rad w.1) w.2 + 0) with hΞdef
  obtain ⟨KX, hKX⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Kc i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨CX, hCX⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = max 1 (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cc i|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCX1 : 1 ≤ CX := by rw [hCX]; exact le_max_left _ _
  have hKX0 : 0 ≤ KX := by rw [hKX]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hKle : ∀ i, i ≤ k → |Kc i| ≤ KX := fun i hi => by
    rw [hKX]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Kc i|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  have hCle : ∀ i, i ≤ k → |Cc i| ≤ CX := fun i hi => by
    rw [hCX]
    exact le_trans (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Cc i|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))) (le_max_right _ _)
  refine ⟨CX, KX, hCX1, hKX0, ?_⟩
  intro φ U z Cφ M hU hz hzU hφs hCφ hM hφb
  set ρ := simScale B.h (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) with hρ
  have h1 : z.2 < 1 ∧ ρ < qsOf l0 := hz.1
  have hqs1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (by simp)
  have ρ0 : 0 < ρ := (hok.1.1 (z.1 2) (1 - z.2) (by linarith [h1.1])).1
  have ρ1 : ρ ≤ 1 := le_trans h1.2.le hqs1
  have hXi : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i Ξ z‖ ≤ CX * ρ ^ (-KX) := by
    intro i _ hi
    have hK : -KX ≤ -Kc i := by linarith [le_abs_self (Kc i), hKle i hi]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i Ξ z‖ ≤ Cc i * ρ ^ (-Kc i) := (hcK i z hz).1
      _ ≤ |Cc i| * ρ ^ (-Kc i) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (Real.rpow_nonneg ρ0.le _)
      _ ≤ |Cc i| * ρ ^ (-KX) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge ρ0 ρ1 hK) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ CX * ρ ^ (-KX) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hCle i hi) (Real.rpow_nonneg ρ0.le _)
  set V : Set (ℝ³ × ℝ) := W ∩ Ξ ⁻¹' U with hVdef
  have hVo : IsOpen V := sXi.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hWo hU
  have hzV : z ∈ V := ⟨hz, hzU⟩
  have hVmap : Set.MapsTo Ξ V U := fun w hw => hw.2
  set g : ℝ → ℂ := fun s : ℝ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (s : ℂ)) with hg
  have hgs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g := (hcexp 0 0).1
  have sE : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (g ∘ φ) U := hgs.comp_contDiffOn hφs
  have sXiV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ξ V := sXi.mono Set.inter_subset_left
  have hPM : 1 ≤ ρ ^ (-M) := Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos ρ0 ρ1 (by linarith)
  have hΛ : 1 ≤ Cφ * ρ ^ (-M) := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hCφ hPM
  have hpow : ∀ (K : ℝ) (n : ℕ), ρ ^ ((0:ℝ) - (n:ℝ) * K) = (ρ ^ (-K)) ^ n := by
    intro K n
    rw [show (0:ℝ) - (n:ℝ) * K = (-K) * (n:ℝ) by ring, Real.rpow_mul ρ0.le, Real.rpow_natCast]
  have hinner : ∀ i j : ℕ, i ≤ j → j ≤ k →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (g ∘ φ) (Ξ z)‖ ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ) * (Cφ * ρ ^ (-M)) ^ j := by
    intro i j hij hjk
    have h := ipb5_wexp_comp g φ U Set.univ hU isOpen_univ (Set.mapsTo_univ φ U) hgs.contDiffOn hφs
      i (Ξ z) ρ 0 1 Cφ M hzU ρ0 ρ1 hM
      (fun i' _ => by rw [Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]; exact (hcexp i' _).2)
      (fun i' h1 h2 => hφb i' h1 (by omega))
    rw [max_eq_right hCφ, hpow] at h
    refine h.trans ?_
    rw [show (i.factorial : ℝ) * 1 * Cφ ^ i * (ρ ^ (-M)) ^ i =
      (i.factorial : ℝ) * (Cφ * ρ ^ (-M)) ^ i by ring]
    have f1 : (i.factorial : ℝ) ≤ j.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le hij
    have f2 : (Cφ * ρ ^ (-M)) ^ i ≤ (Cφ * ρ ^ (-M)) ^ j := pow_le_pow_right₀ hΛ hij
    exact mul_le_mul f1 f2 (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hfun : (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (φ (Ξ w) : ℂ))) = (g ∘ φ) ∘ Ξ := rfl
  refine ⟨V, hVo, hzV, Set.inter_subset_left, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hfun]; exact sE.comp sXiV hVmap
  · intro j hjk
    rw [hfun]
    have h := ipb5_wexp_comp (g ∘ φ) Ξ V U hVo hU hVmap sE sXiV j z ρ 0
      ((j.factorial : ℝ) * (Cφ * ρ ^ (-M)) ^ j) CX KX hzV ρ0 ρ1 hKX0
      (fun i hi => by rw [Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]; exact hinner i j hi hjk)
      (fun i h1 h2 => hXi i h1 (by omega))
    rw [max_eq_right hCX1, hpow] at h
    refine h.trans ?_
    have hsplit : ρ ^ (-(M + KX)) = ρ ^ (-M) * ρ ^ (-KX) := by rw [neg_add, Real.rpow_add ρ0]
    rw [hsplit]
    have hfac : ((j.factorial : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le hjk) 2
    have hnn : 0 ≤ (Cφ * CX * (ρ ^ (-M) * ρ ^ (-KX))) ^ j :=
      pow_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith))
        (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg ρ0.le _) (Real.rpow_nonneg ρ0.le _))) _
    calc (j.factorial : ℝ) * ((j.factorial : ℝ) * (Cφ * ρ ^ (-M)) ^ j) * CX ^ j * (ρ ^ (-KX)) ^ j
        = (j.factorial : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Cφ * CX * (ρ ^ (-M) * ρ ^ (-KX))) ^ j := by ring

proof.tactics:
by
  intro A d μ w L x hwL hμ hd hd0 hx
  obtain ⟨δ, hδdef⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ → ℝ, δ = fun v => d (Set.projIcc w L hwL v : ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hδc : Continuous δ := by
    rw [hδdef]
    exact hd.comp_continuous (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_projIcc)
      (fun v => (Set.projIcc w L hwL v).2)
  have hδeq : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w L, δ v = d v := by
    intro v hv
    rw [hδdef]
    simp only [Set.projIcc_of_mem hwL hv]
  have hδ0 : ∀ v, 0 ≤ δ v := by
    intro v
    rw [hδdef]
    exact hd0 _ (Set.projIcc w L hwL v).2
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ → ℝ, D = fun v => ∫ s in w..v, δ s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD : ∀ v, HasDerivAt D (δ v) v := by
    intro v
    rw [hDdef]
    exact (hδc.integral_hasStrictDerivAt w v).hasDerivAt
  have hDw : D w = 0 := by
    rw [hDdef]
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_same
  have hDnn : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w L, 0 ≤ D v := by
    intro v hv
    rw [hDdef]
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hv.1 (fun s _ => hδ0 s)
  have hE : ∀ v, HasDerivAt (fun u => Real.exp ((μ - 1) * D u))
      (Real.exp ((μ - 1) * D v) * ((μ - 1) * δ v)) v :=
    fun v => ((hD v).const_mul (μ - 1)).exp
  have hE1 : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w L, 1 ≤ Real.exp ((μ - 1) * D v) :=
    fun v hv => Real.one_le_exp (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (hDnn v hv))
  refine ⟨fun v => Real.exp ((μ - 1) * D v) • x v, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [hDw]
  · intro v hv
    have h := (hE v).smul (hx v hv)
    refine h.congr_deriv ?_
    rw [hδeq v hv, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_smul]

    ring
  · intro v hv
    show ‖x v‖ ≤ ‖Real.exp ((μ - 1) * D v) • x v‖
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    exact le_mul_of_one_le_left (norm_nonneg _) (hE1 v hv)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨ln, c, hc0, Hn⟩ := good_nsq_lower_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1

  intro l0 γ η hl hlγ hAct hη hw1 hw2 hX1 hX2 hxi het

  have hηB : η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB := by
    obtain ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩ := hη

  obtain ⟨U, hUo, hηU, -, hn, hnP, hK⟩ := good_coeff_smooth_v5 B G γ η hok hηB hxi het
  have hn' : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun ζ : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ ζ i) U :=

  have hnP' : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun ζ : Cyl => nPhiP5 B G γ ζ i) U :=

  have hK' : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun ζ : Cyl => Kmat B G γ ζ i j) U :=
    fun i j => (hK i j).continuousOn
  have hnsq : ContinuousOn (fun ζ : Cyl => dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ζ) (nPhi5 B G γ ζ)) U := by
    have e : (fun ζ : Cyl => dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ζ) (nPhi5 B G γ ζ)) =
        fun ζ => ∑ i : Fin 3, nPhi5 B G γ ζ i * nPhi5 B G γ ζ i := by
      funext ζ; rfl
    rw [e]
    exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hn' i).mul (hn' i))
  have hcη : c ≤ dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ η) (nPhi5 B G γ η) :=
    Hn l0 (by omega) γ hAct hlγ η hη hw1 hw2 hX1 hX2 hxi het
  set W := U ∩ (fun ζ : Cyl => dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ζ) (nPhi5 B G γ ζ)) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (c/2) with hW
  have hWo : IsOpen W := hnsq.isOpen_inter_preimage hUo isOpen_Ioi

  have hWU : W ⊆ U := Set.inter_subset_left
  have hnsqW := hnsq.mono hWU
  have hinv : ContinuousOn (fun ζ : Cyl => (dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ζ) (nPhi5 B G γ ζ))⁻¹) W :=

  refine ⟨W, hWo, hηW, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine continuousOn_pi.mpr (fun i => continuousOn_pi.mpr (fun j => ?_))
    have e : (fun ζ : Cyl => APhi5 B G γ ζ i j) = fun ζ =>

    exact (continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => ((hn' k).mono hWU).mul ((hK' k j).mono hWU))).sub

  · show ContinuousOn (fun ζ : Cyl => epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ))^2 *

signature.statement: ∀ {E : Type} [TopologicalSpace E] (Gm : E → ℝ → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (S : Set E) (e0 : E) (w L : ℝ) (K : ℝ → ℝ) (y : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)), w ≤ L → e0 ∈ closure S → (∀ u ∈ Set.Icc w L, ∀ᶠ p in nhds (e0, u), ContinuousAt (fun q : E × ℝ => fun i j : Fin 3 => Gm q.1 q.2 i j) p) → (∀ᶠ e in nhds e0, e ∈ S → ∀ (x : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)), (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w L, HasDerivAt x ((Gm e v).mulVec (x v)) v) → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w L, ‖x v‖ ≤ K v * ‖x w‖) → (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w L, HasDerivAt y ((Gm e0 v).mulVec (y v)) v) → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc w L, ‖y v‖ ≤ K v * ‖y w‖

proof.tactics:
by
  intro E _ Gm S e0 w L K y hwL hcl H1 H2 H3 v hv
  
  have s0 : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (z : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ‖A.mulVec z‖ ≤ 3 * ‖(fun i j : Fin 3 => A i j)‖ * ‖z‖ := by
    intro A z
    have hA : ∀ i j, |A i j| ≤ ‖(fun i j : Fin 3 => A i j)‖ := by
      intro i j
      have h1 : ‖(fun j : Fin 3 => A i j)‖ ≤ ‖(fun i j : Fin 3 => A i j)‖ :=
        norm_le_pi_norm (fun i j : Fin 3 => A i j) i
      have h2 : ‖A i j‖ ≤ ‖(fun j : Fin 3 => A i j)‖ := norm_le_pi_norm (fun j : Fin 3 => A i j) j
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h2
      linarith
    have hz : ∀ j, |z j| ≤ ‖z‖ := fun j => by
      have := norm_le_pi_norm z j
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)).2 (fun i => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have e := abs_add_three (A i 0 * z 0) (A i 1 * z 1) (A i 2 * z 2)
    have m : ∀ j, |A i j * z j| ≤ ‖(fun i j : Fin 3 => A i j)‖ * ‖z‖ := fun j => by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul (hA i j) (hz j) (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
    linarith [m 0, m 1, m 2]
  
  have s1 : ∀ (A : ℝ → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (x0 : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ContinuousOn (fun t => fun i j : Fin 3 => A t i j) (Set.Icc w L) →
      ∃ x : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ), x w = x0 ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc w L, HasDerivAt x ((A t).mulVec (x t)) t := by
    intro A x0 hc
    obtain ⟨M', hM'⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hc
    obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = max M' 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by rw [hMdef]; exact le_max_right _ _
    obtain ⟨proj, hproj⟩ : ∃ p : ℝ → ℝ, p = fun t => max w (min L t) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hpI : ∀ t, proj t ∈ Set.Icc w L := fun t => by
      subst hproj; exact ⟨le_max_left _ _, max_le hwL (min_le_left _ _)⟩
    have hpid : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc w L, proj t = t := fun t ht => by
      subst hproj; simp only; rw [min_eq_right ht.2, max_eq_right ht.1]
    have hpc : Continuous proj := by
      subst hproj; exact continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min continuous_id)
    have hBc : Continuous (fun t => fun i j : Fin 3 => A (proj t) i j) :=
      hc.comp_continuous hpc hpI
    have hBb : ∀ t, ‖(fun i j : Fin 3 => A (proj t) i j)‖ ≤ M := fun t => by
      rw [hMdef]; exact (hM' _ (hpI t)).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, R = ‖x0‖ * Real.exp (3 * M * (L - w)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hR0 : ‖x0‖ ≤ R := by
      have : 1 ≤ Real.exp (3 * M * (L - w)) := Real.one_le_exp (by nlinarith)
      rw [hR]; nlinarith [norm_nonneg x0]
    have hRnn : 0 ≤ R := (norm_nonneg _).trans hR0
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → (Fin 3 → ℝ), P = fun z i => max (-R) (min R (z i)) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hPa : ∀ (z : Fin 3 → ℝ) i, |P z i| ≤ |z i| ∧ |P z i| ≤ R := by
      intro z i
      rw [hP]
      simp only
      have hl : -|z i| ≤ min R (z i) := le_min (by linarith [abs_nonneg (z i)]) (neg_abs_le _)
      refine ⟨abs_le.2 ⟨le_trans hl (le_max_right _ _), max_le (by linarith [abs_nonneg (z i)])
        ((min_le_right _ _).trans (le_abs_self _))⟩,
        abs_le.2 ⟨le_max_left _ _, max_le (by linarith) (min_le_left _ _)⟩⟩
    have hPl : ∀ (z z' : Fin 3 → ℝ) i, |P z i - P z' i| ≤ |z i - z' i| := by
      intro z z' i
      rw [hP]
      simp only
      rw [max_comm (-R), max_comm (-R)]
      refine (abs_max_sub_max_le_abs _ _ _).trans ?_
      refine (abs_min_sub_min_le_max _ _ _ _).trans ?_
      simp
    have hP1' : ∀ z, ‖P z‖ ≤ R := by
      intro z
      refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hRnn).2 (fun i => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact (hPa z i).2
    have hP2 : ∀ z z', ‖P z - P z'‖ ≤ ‖z - z'‖ := by
      intro z z'
      refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)).2 (fun i => ?_)
      rw [Pi.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      refine (hPl z z' i).trans ?_
      have := norm_le_pi_norm (z - z') i
      rwa [Pi.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have hP3 : ∀ z, ‖z‖ ≤ R → P z = z := by
      intro z hz
      rw [hP]
      funext i
      have := (norm_le_pi_norm z i).trans hz
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      have h1 := abs_le.1 this
      simp only

      have h2 : K * (P v / P t) * ‖r t‖ ≤ K * (P v / P t) * (F * P t) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hr t htL) (mul_nonneg hK (div_nonneg hPv.le hPt.le))
      have hc : P v / P t * P t = P v := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hPt.ne'
      have h3 : K * (P v / P t) * (F * P t) = K * F * P v := by
        calc K * (P v / P t) * (F * P t) = K * F * (P v / P t * P t) := by ring
          _ = K * F * P v := by rw [hc]
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      linarith
    have hmvt : ‖dotProduct (ψ v) (y v) - dotProduct (ψ 0) (y 0)‖ ≤ K * F * P v * (v - 0) :=
      norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le_segment' hGd hGb v ⟨hv0, le_rfl⟩
    have hG0 := star 0 le_rfl hv0 (y 0)
    have hGv : dotProduct (ψ v) (y v) = y v i := by rw [hψv, single_dotProduct, one_mul]
    rw [hGv, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hmvt
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have htri := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (y v i) (dotProduct (ψ 0) (y 0))
    have e : K * (P v / P 0) * ‖y 0‖ + K * F * P v * (v - 0) =
        K * P v * (‖y 0‖ / P 0 + F * v) := by ring
    linarith
  intro A0 P L K F y r hA0 hP hK hF hprop hy hr hy0 v hv
  have hL : (0:ℝ) ≤ L := le_trans hv.1 hv.2
  obtain ⟨A1, hA1def⟩ : ∃ A1 : ℝ → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      A1 = fun t => A0 (Set.projIcc 0 L hL t) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA1c : Continuous A1 := by
    rw [hA1def]
    exact hA0.comp_continuous (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_projIcc)
      (fun t => (Set.projIcc 0 L hL t).2)
  have hA1 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, A1 t = A0 t := by
    intro t ht
    rw [hA1def]
    show A0 (Set.projIcc 0 L hL t : ℝ) = A0 t
    rw [Set.projIcc_of_mem hL ht]
  have hprop1 : ∀ (x : ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (w : ℝ), 0 ≤ w → w ≤ L →
      (∀ u ∈ Set.Icc w L, HasDerivAt x ((A1 u).mulVec (x u)) u) →
      ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc w L, ‖x u‖ ≤ K * (P u / P w) * ‖x w‖ := by
    intro x w hw0 hwL hx
    apply hprop x w hw0 hwL
    intro u hu
    have hu' : u ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L := ⟨le_trans hw0 hu.1, hu.2⟩
    rw [← hA1 u hu']
    exact hx u hu
  have key : ∀ φ : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ z : ℂ, ‖φ z‖ ≤ ‖z‖) →
      ‖(fun i : Fin 3 => φ (y v i))‖ ≤ K * P v * F * v := by
    intro φ hφ
    let R : (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun i => φ.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i))
    have hR : ∀ u : Fin 3 → ℂ, R u = fun i => φ (u i) := fun u => rfl
    have hφmul : ∀ (a : ℝ) (z : ℂ), φ ((a : ℂ) * z) = a * φ z := by
      intro a z
      rw [← Complex.real_smul, φ.map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hRM : ∀ (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u : Fin 3 → ℂ),
        R ((M.map (fun a : ℝ => (a : ℂ))).mulVec u) = M.mulVec (R u) := by
      intro M u
      funext i
      simp only [hR, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.map_apply, map_sum, hφmul]
    have hder : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, HasDerivWithinAt (fun t => R (y t))
        ((A1 u).mulVec (R (y u)) + R (r u)) (Set.Icc 0 L) u := by
      intro u hu
      have h1 := R.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivWithinAt u (hy u hu)
      have h2 : R (((A0 u).map (fun a : ℝ => (a : ℂ))).mulVec (y u) + r u) =
          (A1 u).mulVec (R (y u)) + R (r u) := by
        rw [map_add, hRM, hA1 u hu]
      rw [h2] at h1
      exact h1
    have hrb : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) L, ‖R (r u)‖ ≤ F * P u := by
      intro u hu
      refine le_trans ?_ (hr u hu)
      rw [hR]
      refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)).2 (fun i => ?_)
      exact (hφ _).trans (norm_le_pi_norm (r u) i)
    have h := forced_duhamel_within5 A1 P L K F (fun t => R (y t)) (fun t => R (r t)) hA1c hP hK hF
      hprop1 hder hrb v hv
    have h0 : R (y 0) = 0 := by rw [hy0, map_zero]
    simp only [h0, norm_zero, zero_div, zero_add] at h
    show ‖R (y v)‖ ≤ K * P v * F * v
    calc ‖R (y v)‖ ≤ K * P v * (F * v) := h
      _ = K * P v * F * v := by ring
  have hre := key Complex.reCLM (fun z => by
    rw [Complex.reCLM_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact Complex.abs_re_le_norm z)
  have him := key Complex.imCLM (fun z => by
    rw [Complex.imCLM_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact Complex.abs_im_le_norm z)
  have hB : 0 ≤ 2 * K * P v * F * v :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hK) (hP v).le) hF) hv.1
  refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hB).2 (fun i => ?_)
  have h1 := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im (y v i)
  have h2 : |(y v i).re| ≤ K * P v * F * v := by
    have := (norm_le_pi_norm (fun j : Fin 3 => Complex.reCLM (y v j)) i).trans hre
    simpa [Complex.reCLM_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
  have h3 : |(y v i).im| ≤ K * P v * F * v := by
    have := (norm_le_pi_norm (fun j : Fin 3 => Complex.imCLM (y v j)) i).trans him
    simpa [Complex.imCLM_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (a : Cyl → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (z : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (p0 : Cyl) (Λ : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl) (j : ℕ) (Qa : ℝ) (Cy : ℕ → ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p => fun i l : Fin 3 => a p i l) p0 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ z p0 → (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ j → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun p => fun i' l : Fin 3 => a p i' l) p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤ Qa) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < j → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i z p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤ Cy i) → ∀ m : Fin j → Cyl, ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p => Matrix.mulVec ((a p).map (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ))) (z p)) p0) (fun i => Λ (m i)) - Matrix.mulVec ((a p0).map (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ))) ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j z p0) (fun i => Λ (m i)))‖ ≤ 3 * Qa * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose i : ℝ) * Cy i) * ∏ i, ‖m i‖

signature.name: fsj_leibniz_rem
signature.statement: ∀ (a : Cyl → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (z : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (p0 : Cyl) (Λ : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl) (j : ℕ) (Qa : ℝ) (Cy : ℕ → ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p => fun i l : Fin 3 => a p i l) p0 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ z p0 → (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ j → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun p => fun i' l : Fin 3 => a p i' l) p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤ Qa) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < j → ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i z p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤ Cy i) → ∀ m : Fin j → Cyl, ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p => Matrix.mulVec ((a p).map (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ))) (z p)) p0) (fun i => Λ (m i)) - Matrix.mulVec ((a p0).map (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ))) ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j z p0) (fun i => Λ (m i)))‖ ≤ 3 * Qa * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose i : ℝ) * Cy i) * ∏ i, ‖m i‖

proof.tactics:
by
  intro a z p0 Λ j Qa Cy ha hz hA hY m
  set A : Cyl → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ := fun p => fun i l : Fin 3 => a p i l with hAd
  
  obtain ⟨Bil, hBn, hBdef⟩ : ∃ B : (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ),
      ‖B‖ ≤ 3 ∧ ∀ (M : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (w : Fin 3 → ℂ),
        B M w = fun i => ∑ l, ((M i l : ℝ) : ℂ) * w l := by
    let B0 : (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℂ) :=
      LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ (fun (M : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (w : Fin 3 → ℂ) =>
          fun i => ∑ l, ((M i l : ℝ) : ℂ) * w l)
        (fun M1 M2 w => by
          funext i
          simp only [Pi.add_apply, Complex.ofReal_add, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => by ring))
        (fun c M w => by
          funext i
          simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Complex.ofReal_mul, Finset.smul_sum,
            Complex.real_smul]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => by ring))
        (fun M w1 w2 => by
          funext i
          simp only [Pi.add_apply, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => by ring))
        (fun c M w => by
          funext i
          simp only [Pi.smul_apply, Finset.smul_sum, Complex.real_smul]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => by ring))
    have hb : ∀ M w, ‖B0 M w‖ ≤ 3 * ‖M‖ * ‖w‖ := by
      intro M w
      refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)).2 (fun i => ?_)
      show ‖∑ l, ((M i l : ℝ) : ℂ) * w l‖ ≤ _
      calc ‖∑ l, ((M i l : ℝ) : ℂ) * w l‖ ≤ ∑ l, ‖((M i l : ℝ) : ℂ) * w l‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ l : Fin 3, ‖M‖ * ‖w‖ := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun l _ => by
            rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real]
            exact mul_le_mul ((norm_le_pi_norm (M i) l).trans (norm_le_pi_norm M i))
              (norm_le_pi_norm w l) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
        _ = 3 * ‖M‖ * ‖w‖ := by simp; ring
    exact ⟨B0.mkContinuous₂ 3 hb, LinearMap.mkContinuous₂_norm_le _ (by norm_num) hb,
      fun M w => rfl⟩
  have hBap : ∀ (p : Cyl) (w : Fin 3 → ℂ),
      Bil (A p) w = Matrix.mulVec ((a p).map (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ))) w := by
    intro p w
    rw [hBdef]
    funext i
    simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.map_apply, hAd]
  
  have lb : ∀ (f : Cyl → (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)) (g : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)),
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f p0 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g p0 →
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun x => Bil (f x) (g x)) p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤
        ‖Bil‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) *
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ *
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j - i) g p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ := by
    intro f g hf hg
    have hf' : ContDiffAt ℝ j f p0 := hf.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hg' : ContDiffAt ℝ j g p0 := hg.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    obtain ⟨uf, huf, hfu⟩ := hf'.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
    obtain ⟨ug, hug, hgu⟩ := hg'.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
    obtain ⟨O, hOsub, hOopen, hxO⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp (Filter.inter_mem huf hug)
    have hfO : ContDiffOn ℝ j f O := hfu.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).1)
    have hgO : ContDiffOn ℝ j g O := hgu.mono (fun x hx => (hOsub hx).2)
    have hBO : ContDiffOn ℝ j (fun x => Bil (f x) (g x)) O :=
      (Bil.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hfO).clm_apply hgO
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun w : Cyl => p0 + w) ⁻¹' O :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hOopen.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑Λ ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage Λ.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show p0 + 0 ∈ O; rw [add_zero]; exact hxO
    have hL0s : Λ 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑Λ ⁻¹' s := hL0s
    have hsm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ j F O → ContDiffOn ℝ j (fun w => F (p0 + w)) s := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun w hw => by rw [hs_def] at hw; exact hw)
    have hsmO : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ j F O → ContDiffOn ℝ j (fun w => F (p0 + Λ w)) (⇑Λ ⁻¹' s) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact (hsm F hF).comp Λ.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun w hw => hw)
    have key : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ j F O → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ j →
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w => F (p0 + Λ w)) 0 =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF i hi
      have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun w => F (p0 + Λ w)) i hO h0O
      have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right Λ (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
        hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
      have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun w => F (p0 + w)) i hs h0s
      have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i p0 0
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w => F (p0 + Λ w)) 0
          = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun w => F (p0 + w)) ∘ ⇑Λ) (⇑Λ ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun w => F (p0 + w)) s (Λ 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => Λ) := e2
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun w => F (p0 + w)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => Λ) := by rw [map_zero]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun w => F (p0 + w)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => Λ) := by rw [e3]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
    have hl := ContinuousLinearMap.norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_le_of_bilinear Bil (hsmO f hfO)
      (hsmO g hgO) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O (n := j) le_rfl
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => Bil (f (p0 + Λ y)) (g (p0 + Λ y))) j hO h0O]
      at hl
    rw [← key _ hBO j le_rfl]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun w => (fun x => Bil (f x) (g x)) (p0 + Λ w)) 0‖
        = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun y => Bil (f (p0 + Λ y)) (g (p0 + Λ y))) 0‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ _ := hl
      _ = _ := by
        congr 1
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        have hik : i ≤ j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun w => f (p0 + Λ w)) i hO h0O,
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun w => g (p0 + Λ w)) (j - i) hO h0O,
          key f hfO i hik, key g hgO (j - i) (Nat.sub_le j i)]
  
  have hφ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p => A p - A p0) p0 := ha.sub contDiffAt_const
  have hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p => Bil (A p - A p0) (z p)) p0 :=
    (show ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p => Bil (A p - A p0)) p0 from
      Bil.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp p0 hφ).clm_apply hz
  have hT : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p => Bil (A p0) (z p)) p0 :=
    (Bil (A p0)).contDiff.contDiffAt.comp p0 hz
  have hfun : (fun p => Matrix.mulVec ((a p).map (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ))) (z p)) =
      (fun p => Bil (A p - A p0) (z p)) + (fun p => Bil (A p0) (z p)) := by
    funext p
    rw [Pi.add_apply, ← ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ← map_add, sub_add_cancel, hBap]
  
  have hD : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p => Matrix.mulVec ((a p).map (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ))) (z p)) p0
        (fun i => Λ (m i)) -
      Matrix.mulVec ((a p0).map (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ))) (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j z p0 (fun i => Λ (m i))) =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p => Bil (A p - A p0) (z p)) p0 (fun i => Λ (m i)) := by
    rw [hfun, iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (hg.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      (hT.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
    have e := (Bil (A p0)).iteratedFDeriv_comp_left hz (i := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e' : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p => Bil (A p0) (z p)) p0 =
        (Bil (A p0)).compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j z p0) := e
    rw [e', ContinuousMultilinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply, hBap,
      add_sub_cancel_right]
  have hle : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p => Bil (A p - A p0) (z p)) p0 (fun i => Λ (m i))‖ ≤
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p => Bil (A p - A p0) (z p)) p0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Λ)‖ * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := by
    have h := ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p => Bil (A p - A p0) (z p)) p0).compContinuousLinearMap
      (fun _ => Λ)).le_opNorm m
    simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply] at h
    exact h
  
  have h0 : ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun p => A p - A p0) p0).compContinuousLinearMap
      (fun _ => Λ)‖ = 0 := by
    apply le_antisymm _ (norm_nonneg _)
    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, sub_self, norm_zero, zero_mul]
  have hφi : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≠ 0 →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun p => A p - A p0) p0 = iteratedFDeriv ℝ i A p0 := by
    intro i hi
    have e := iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply (ha.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      (contDiffAt_const : ContDiffAt ℝ i (fun _ => A p0) p0)
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne hi, Pi.zero_apply, sub_zero] at e
    exact e
  have hμ : 0 ≤ ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) *
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun p => A p - A p0) p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ *
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j - i) z p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
      (norm_nonneg _))
  have hS : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) *
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun p => A p - A p0) p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ *
      ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j - i) z p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤
      Qa * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose i : ℝ) * Cy i := by
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', h0, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose (i + 1) : ℝ) *
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (i + 1) (fun p => A p - A p0) p0).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Λ)‖ *
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j - (i + 1)) z p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, Qa * ((j.choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * Cy (j - (i + 1))) := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => ?_)
          have hi' := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
          rw [hφi (i + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero i)]
          have hN : ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (i + 1) A p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ ≤ Qa :=
            hA (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
          have hNy := hY (j - (i + 1)) (by omega)
          have hQa0 : 0 ≤ Qa := (norm_nonneg _).trans hN
          have hC0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (j.choose (i + 1) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
          calc (j.choose (i + 1) : ℝ) *
                ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (i + 1) A p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖ *
                ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j - (i + 1)) z p0).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ)‖
              ≤ (j.choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * Qa * Cy (j - (i + 1)) :=
                mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hN hC0) hNy (norm_nonneg _)
                  (mul_nonneg hC0 hQa0)
            _ = Qa * ((j.choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * Cy (j - (i + 1))) := by ring
      _ = Qa * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * Cy (j - (i + 1)) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = Qa * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose i : ℝ) * Cy i := by
          congr 1
          have r1 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * Cy (j - (i + 1)) =
              ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (fun l => (j.choose (j - l) : ℝ) * Cy l) (j - 1 - i) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
            have hi' := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
            have e1 : j - (j - 1 - i) = i + 1 := by omega
            have e2 : j - 1 - i = j - (i + 1) := by omega
            show (j.choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * Cy (j - (i + 1)) =
              (j.choose (j - (j - 1 - i)) : ℝ) * Cy (j - 1 - i)
            rw [e1, e2]
          refine r1.trans ((Finset.sum_range_reflect (fun l => (j.choose (j - l) : ℝ) * Cy l) j).trans ?_)
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l hl => ?_)
          show (j.choose (j - l) : ℝ) * Cy l = (j.choose l : ℝ) * Cy l
          rw [Nat.choose_symm (Finset.mem_range.mp hl).le]
  
  have hLb := lb (fun p => A p - A p0) z hφ hz
  rw [hD]
  calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p => Bil (A p - A p0) (z p)) p0 (fun i => Λ (m i))‖
      ≤ ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p => Bil (A p - A p0) (z p)) p0).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Λ)‖ * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := hle
    _ ≤ (3 * (Qa * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose i : ℝ) * Cy i)) * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hμ
        exact hLb.trans (mul_le_mul hBn hS hS0 (by norm_num))
    _ = 3 * Qa * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (j.choose i : ℝ) * Cy i) * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ := by ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (U : Set Cyl) (J : Set ℝ) (Z Gs : Cyl × ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (Ar : Cyl × ℝ → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (p0 : Cyl) (j : ℕ) (m : Fin j → Cyl), IsOpen U → IsOpen J → p0 ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Z (U ×ˢ J) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun pv : Cyl × ℝ => fun i j' : Fin 3 => Ar pv i j') (U ×ˢ J) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Gs (U ×ˢ J) → (∀ p ∈ U, ∀ v ∈ J, HasDerivAt (fun v' => Z (p, v')) (Matrix.mulVec ((Ar (p, v)).map (fun a : ℝ => (a : ℂ))) (Z (p, v)) - Gs (p, v)) v) → ∀ v ∈ J, HasDerivAt (fun v' => (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p : Cyl => Z (p, v')) p0) m) ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p : Cyl => Matrix.mulVec ((Ar (p, v)).map (fun a : ℝ => (a : ℂ))) (Z (p, v))) p0) m - (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p : Cyl => Gs (p, v)) p0) m) v

signature.statement: ∀ (U : Set Cyl) (J : Set ℝ) (Z Gs : Cyl × ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (Ar : Cyl × ℝ → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (p0 : Cyl) (j : ℕ) (m : Fin j → Cyl), IsOpen U → IsOpen J → p0 ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Z (U ×ˢ J) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun pv : Cyl × ℝ => fun i j' : Fin 3 => Ar pv i j') (U ×ˢ J) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Gs (U ×ˢ J) → (∀ p ∈ U, ∀ v ∈ J, HasDerivAt (fun v' => Z (p, v')) (Matrix.mulVec ((Ar (p, v)).map (fun a : ℝ => (a : ℂ))) (Z (p, v)) - Gs (p, v)) v) → ∀ v ∈ J, HasDerivAt (fun v' => (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p : Cyl => Z (p, v')) p0) m) ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p : Cyl => Matrix.mulVec ((Ar (p, v)).map (fun a : ℝ => (a : ℂ))) (Z (p, v))) p0) m - (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p : Cyl => Gs (p, v)) p0) m) v

proof.tactics:
by
  intro U J Z Gs Ar p0 j m hU hJ hp0 hZs hArs hGs hODE v hv
  
  
  have symmG : ∀ {E V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup V]
      [NormedSpace ℝ V] (U : Set E) (f : E → V), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ z ∈ U,
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (w : Fin m → E) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)),
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z (w ∘ σ) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z w := by
    intro E V _ _ _ _ U f hU hf z hz m w σ
    have hperm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (n : ℕ)
        (A : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => E) W),
        (∀ (i : Fin n) (w : Fin (n + 1) → E), A (w ∘ Equiv.swap i.castSucc i.succ) = A w) →
        ∀ (w : Fin (n + 1) → E) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))), A (w ∘ σ) = A w := by
      intro W _ _ n A hA w σ
      have hσ : σ ∈ Submonoid.closure (Set.range fun i : Fin n => Equiv.swap i.castSucc i.succ) := by
        rw [Equiv.Perm.mclosure_swap_castSucc_succ]; exact Submonoid.mem_top σ
      induction hσ using Submonoid.closure_induction generalizing w with
      | mem x hx => obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx; exact hA i w
      | one => rfl
      | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
        rw [Equiv.Perm.coe_mul, ← Function.comp_assoc, hy, hx]
    have Q : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (g : E → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ (u : Fin (k + 2) → E) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (k + 2))),
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2) g y (u ∘ τ) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2) g y u := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro W _ _ g hg y hy u τ
        refine hperm 1 (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 g y) ?_ u τ
        intro i v
        have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        subst hi
        have hS : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ g y :=
          (hg.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)).isSymmSndFDerivAt
            (by rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]; exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply, iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
        simp only [Function.comp_apply]
        have h0 : Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 1).castSucc (0 : Fin 1).succ 0 = 1 := by decide
        have h1 : Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 1).castSucc (0 : Fin 1).succ 1 = 0 := by decide
        rw [h0, h1]
        exact hS.eq _ _
      | succ k ih =>
        intro W _ _ g hg y hy u τ
        have hgy : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g y := hg.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
        have hzero : ∀ v : Fin (k + 2 + 1) → E,
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y
              (v ∘ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (k + 2)).castSucc (0 : Fin (k + 2)).succ) =
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y v := by
          intro v
          have hg' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ g) U :=
            ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).mp hg).2
          rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right (n := k + 2), iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right (n := k + 2)]
          have hlast : (v ∘ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (k + 2)).castSucc (0 : Fin (k + 2)).succ)
              (Fin.last (k + 2)) = v (Fin.last (k + 2)) := by
            simp only [Function.comp_apply]
            rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne]
            · apply Fin.ne_of_val_ne; simp
            · apply Fin.ne_of_val_ne; simp
          have hinit : Fin.init (v ∘ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (k + 2)).castSucc (0 : Fin (k + 2)).succ) =
              Fin.init v ∘ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (k + 1)).castSucc (0 : Fin (k + 1)).succ := by
            funext l
            simp only [Fin.init, Function.comp_apply]
            congr 1
            rw [Function.Injective.map_swap (Fin.castSucc_injective _)]
            congr 1
          rw [hlast, hinit]
          exact congrArg (fun A => A (v (Fin.last (k + 2))))
            (ih (fderiv ℝ g) hg' y hy (Fin.init v)
              (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (k + 1)).castSucc (0 : Fin (k + 1)).succ))
        have hsucc : ∀ (j : Fin (k + 1)) (v : Fin (k + 2 + 1) → E),
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y (v ∘ Equiv.swap j.succ.castSucc j.succ.succ) =
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y v := by
          intro j v
          rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left (n := k + 2), iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left (n := k + 2)]
          have h0 : (v ∘ Equiv.swap j.succ.castSucc j.succ.succ) 0 = v 0 := by
            simp only [Function.comp_apply]
            rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne]
            · rw [← Fin.succ_castSucc]; exact (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm
            · exact (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm
          have htail : Fin.tail (v ∘ Equiv.swap j.succ.castSucc j.succ.succ) =
              Fin.tail v ∘ Equiv.swap j.castSucc j.succ := by
            funext l
            simp only [Fin.tail, Function.comp_apply]
            rw [Function.Injective.map_swap (Fin.succ_injective _), Fin.succ_castSucc]
          rw [h0, htail]
          have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2) g) y :=
            hgy.differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv
              (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (ENat.natCast_lt_top (k + 2)))
          rw [← fderiv_continuousMultilinear_apply_const_apply hd
                (Fin.tail v ∘ Equiv.swap j.castSucc j.succ) (v 0),
              ← fderiv_continuousMultilinear_apply_const_apply hd (Fin.tail v) (v 0)]
          congr 1
          apply Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq
          filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hy] with y' hy'
          exact ih g hg y' hy' _ _
        show iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y (u ∘ τ) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y u
        refine hperm (k + 2) (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 2 + 1) g y) ?_ u τ
        intro i v
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
        · exact hzero v
        · exact hsucc j v
    rcases m with _ | _ | k
    · congr 1; funext i; exact Fin.elim0 i
    · congr 1; funext i; simp only [Function.comp_apply]; congr 1
      exact Fin.ext (by have := (σ i).isLt; have := i.isLt; omega)
    · exact Q k f hf z hz w σ
  
  
  have pbG : ∀ {E E' V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup E']
      [NormedSpace ℝ E'] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (O : Set E) (h : E → V) (c : E)
      (M : E' →L[ℝ] E) (y0 : E') (n : ℕ), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h O → c + M y0 ∈ O →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => h (c + M y)) y0 =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n h (c + M y0)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => M) := by
    intro E E' V _ _ _ _ _ _ O h c M y0 n hO hh hc
    have hO1o : IsOpen {z : E | c + z ∈ O} := hO.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hh1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => h (c + z)) {z : E | c + z ∈ O} :=
      hh.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
    have hO2o : IsOpen (M ⁻¹' {z : E | c + z ∈ O}) := hO1o.preimage M.continuous
    have hy0 : y0 ∈ M ⁻¹' {z : E | c + z ∈ O} := hc
    have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := (fun z => h (c + z)) ∘ M) n hO2o hy0
    have e2 := M.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right hh1 hO1o.uniqueDiffOn hO2o.uniqueDiffOn hy0 (i := n)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => h (c + z)) n hO1o
      (show M y0 ∈ {z : E | c + z ∈ O} from hc)
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left] at e3
    show iteratedFDeriv ℝ n ((fun z => h (c + z)) ∘ M) y0 = _
    rw [← e1, e2, e3]
  
  
  obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set (Cyl × ℝ), O = U ×ˢ J := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hOdef] at hZs hArs hGs
  have hO : IsOpen O := by rw [hOdef]; exact hU.prod hJ
  have hmem : ∀ s ∈ U, ∀ r ∈ J, ((s, r) : Cyl × ℝ) ∈ O := by
    intro s hs r hr; rw [hOdef]; exact ⟨hs, hr⟩
  obtain ⟨ι, hι⟩ : ∃ M : Cyl →L[ℝ] Cyl × ℝ, M = ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ Cyl ℝ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have star : ∀ (h : Cyl × ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℂ)), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h O → ∀ s ∈ U, ∀ r ∈ J,
      ∀ n : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun s' => h (s', r)) s =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n h (s, r)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => ι) := by
    intro h hh s hs r hr n
    have hcy : ∀ y : Cyl, (((0 : Cyl), r) : Cyl × ℝ) + ι y = (y, r) := by
      intro y; rw [hι]; simp
    have := pbG O h ((0 : Cyl), r) ι s n hO hh (by rw [hcy]; exact hmem s hs r hr)
    simp only [hcy] at this
    exact this
  have p0O : ((p0, v) : Cyl × ℝ) ∈ O := hmem p0 hp0 v hv
  
  
  have hcomm : HasDerivAt (fun v' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p : Cyl => Z (p, v')) p0)
      (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p : Cyl => deriv (fun v'' => Z (p, v'')) v) p0) v := by
    have hgp : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Z (p0, v) := hZs.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds p0O)
    have hΦd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j Z) (p0, v) :=
      hgp.differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (ENat.natCast_lt_top j))
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : Cyl × ℝ, e = ((0 : Cyl), (1 : ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hγ : ∀ s : Cyl, HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => ((s, r) : Cyl × ℝ)) e v := by
      intro s; rw [he]; exact (hasDerivAt_const v s).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id v)
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun r => iteratedFDeriv ℝ j Z (p0, r))
        (fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j Z) (p0, v) e) v :=
      hΦd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt v (hγ p0)
    obtain ⟨Cι, hCι⟩ : ∃ C : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => Cyl × ℝ) (Fin 3 → ℂ)
        →L[ℝ] ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => Cyl) (Fin 3 → ℂ),
        C = ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMapL (fun _ => ι) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun v' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s : Cyl => Z (s, v')) p0)
        (Cι (fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j Z) (p0, v) e)) v := by
      have h := Cι.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt v h1
      refine h.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [hJ.mem_nhds hv] with r hr
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, hCι, ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMapL_apply]
      exact star Z hZs p0 hp0 r hr j
    refine h2.congr_deriv ?_
    have hfd' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ Z) O := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).mp hZs).2
    obtain ⟨g1, hg1⟩ : ∃ g1 : Cyl × ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℂ), g1 = fun y => fderiv ℝ Z y e :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hg1s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g1 O := by rw [hg1]; exact hfd'.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have hg1comp : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g1 (p0, v) =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (Fin 3 → ℂ) e).compContinuousMultilinearMap
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun y => fderiv ℝ Z y) (p0, v)) := by
      rw [hg1]
      exact (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (Fin 3 → ℂ) e).iteratedFDeriv_comp_left
        (hfd'.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds p0O)) (i := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hderiv_eq : (fun s : Cyl => g1 (s, v)) =ᶠ[nhds p0]
        (fun s : Cyl => deriv (fun v'' => Z (s, v'')) v) := by
      filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hp0] with s hs
      have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Z (s, v) :=
        (hZs.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds (hmem s hs v hv))).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun v'' => Z (s, v'')) (fderiv ℝ Z (s, v) e) v :=
        hfd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt v (hγ s)
      rw [h3.deriv, hg1]
    rw [← (hderiv_eq.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds, star g1 hg1s p0 hp0 v hv j, hCι]
    ext w
    simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMapL_apply,
      ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [hg1comp, ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply]
    have hL : iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j + 1) Z (p0, v)
        (Fin.cons e (fun i => ι (w i)) : Fin (j + 1) → Cyl × ℝ) =
        fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j Z) (p0, v) e (fun i => ι (w i)) := by
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.tail_cons]
    have hR : iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j + 1) Z (p0, v)
        (Fin.snoc (fun i => ι (w i)) e : Fin (j + 1) → Cyl × ℝ) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun y => fderiv ℝ Z y) (p0, v) (fun i => ι (w i)) e := by
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right, Fin.init_snoc, Fin.snoc_last]
    have hrot : (Fin.cons e (fun i => ι (w i)) : Fin (j + 1) → Cyl × ℝ) ∘ finRotate (j + 1) =
        (Fin.snoc (fun i => ι (w i)) e : Fin (j + 1) → Cyl × ℝ) := by
      funext i
      exact (congrFun (Fin.snoc_eq_cons_rotate (fun i => ι (w i)) e) i).symm
    have hsymm := symmG O Z hO hZs (p0, v) p0O (j + 1)
      (Fin.cons e (fun i => ι (w i)) : Fin (j + 1) → Cyl × ℝ) (finRotate (j + 1))
    rw [← hL, ← hR, ← hrot]
    exact congrFun hsymm.symm _
  
  
  have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun v' => (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p : Cyl => Z (p, v')) p0) m)
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p : Cyl => deriv (fun v'' => Z (p, v'')) v) p0) m) v := by
    have h := (ContinuousMultilinearMap.apply ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => Cyl) (Fin 3 → ℂ) m).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt
      v hcomm
    simp only [Function.comp_def, ContinuousMultilinearMap.apply_apply] at h
    exact h
  
  
  have hev : (fun p : Cyl => deriv (fun v'' => Z (p, v'')) v) =ᶠ[nhds p0]
      (fun p : Cyl => Matrix.mulVec ((Ar (p, v)).map (fun a : ℝ => (a : ℂ))) (Z (p, v)) - Gs (p, v)) := by
    filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hp0] with p hp
    exact (hODE p hp v hv).deriv
  rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds] at h2
  
  
  have hmv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun pv : Cyl × ℝ => Matrix.mulVec ((Ar pv).map (fun a : ℝ => (a : ℂ))) (Z pv)) O := by
    refine contDiffOn_pi.mpr (fun i => ?_)
    have e : (fun pv : Cyl × ℝ => Matrix.mulVec ((Ar pv).map (fun a : ℝ => (a : ℂ))) (Z pv) i) =
        fun pv => ∑ l : Fin 3, ((Ar pv i l : ℝ) : ℂ) * Z pv l := by
      funext pv; simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.map_apply]
    rw [e]
    refine ContDiffOn.sum (fun l _ => ?_)
    refine ContDiffOn.mul ?_ (contDiffOn_pi.mp hZs l)
    have hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun pv : Cyl × ℝ => Ar pv i l) O :=
      contDiffOn_pi.mp (contDiffOn_pi.mp hArs i) l
    exact Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hA
  have hιv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : Cyl => ((p, v) : Cyl × ℝ)) := contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const
  have hf1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun p : Cyl => Matrix.mulVec ((Ar (p, v)).map (fun a : ℝ => (a : ℂ))) (Z (p, v))) p0 :=
    ContDiffAt.comp (g := fun pv : Cyl × ℝ => Matrix.mulVec ((Ar pv).map (fun a : ℝ => (a : ℂ))) (Z pv))
      p0 (hmv.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds p0O)) hιv.contDiffAt

      (fun p : Cyl => Matrix.mulVec ((Ar (p, v)).map (fun a : ℝ => (a : ℂ))) (Z (p, v)) - Gs (p, v)) p0 =

by

  have hTz : Tgc ^ (bandIdx h l) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ ((1 + h) * (l:ℝ)) / (l:ℝ) ^ 2 := by

    have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, NB h (fun η => F η i) k ξ :=

    intro m
    rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hsum0 (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _)))]
    intro i

        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun η => F η i) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)) m := by

    have hx1 : 1 ≤ epsb B.h l ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) :=
      Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hε0 hε1 (by norm_num)
    have hkb : (kb B.h l : ℝ) < epsb B.h l ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) + 1 := by
      unfold kb; exact Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by linarith)

      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hε0.le]
      have : (-(1/2:ℝ)) * ((2:ℕ):ℝ) = -1 := by norm_num

    linarith

  refine ⟨18 * Cs, ((2 * k + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ), ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 γ m hAct hlγ η hη hw1 hw2 hX1 hX2 hxi het

    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _

  have hηB : η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB := ⟨hη.1, hη.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hη.2.2 hqsB⟩

  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : Fin 3 → Cyl → ℝ, n = fun i ζ => nPhi5 B G γ ζ i := ⟨_, rfl⟩

    have hf0 : f γ 0 = 0 := hH γ 0 hH0
    simp [cutA, cutS, srcHat, projT5, ht0, hp0, hf0]
  · rw [hA]
    have hp := hP6 γ m hm ξ hξ
    simp only [cutS]
    rw [hp]
    simp only [cutA, srcHat, projT5]
    rw [Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.ofReal_one]
    exact key _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hag hbe Complex.I_mul_I
      (mul_inv_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero hkb (Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hm)))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (Bo : ℝ) (f tw : WC) (pr : WS) (τ : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) Bo f → PulseSol5 B G l0 Bo f tw pr → (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (τ γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), τ γ m ξ = (((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (dVc B γ.1 (cutA B G tw γ m) ξ - (pulseMatC (APhi5 B G γ ξ)).mulVec (cutA B G tw γ m ξ) + ((m : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((dDamp5 B G γ ξ : ℝ) : ℂ)) • cutA B G tw γ m ξ + ((psiW B G γ ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) • projT5 B G γ ξ (srcHat B f γ m ξ) + ((1 - psiW B G γ ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) • srcHat B f γ m ξ)) → ∀ k N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (τ γ m) ξ‖ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (N : ℝ)
