signature.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ l1 : ℕ, ∀ l0 : ℕ, l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (Bo : ℝ) (f tw : WC) (pr : WS) (τ : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) Bo f → PulseSol5 B G l0 Bo f tw pr → (∀ γ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (τ γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0))) → (∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), τ γ m ξ = (((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (dVc B γ.1 (cutA B G tw γ m) ξ - (pulseMatC (APhi5 B G γ ξ)).mulVec (cutA B G tw γ m ξ) + ((m : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((dDamp5 B G γ ξ : ℝ) : ℂ)) • cutA B G tw γ m ξ + ((psiW B G γ ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) • projT5 B G γ ξ (srcHat B f γ m ξ) + ((1 - psiW B G γ ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) • srcHat B f γ m ξ)) → ∀ k N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (τ γ m) ξ‖ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (N : ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨⟨hr0, -, -, -, hlmin⟩, -⟩ := id hG
  obtain ⟨lp, hp⟩ := pulse_support_good_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lg, hg⟩ := band_coarse_gap_v5 B.h hh0 hh1
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  obtain ⟨Mj, -, hMj⟩ := psiw_jet_v5 B G hok hG 0
  obtain ⟨hrsm, hrnb⟩ := rhoQ_rpow_nb_v5 B hok (Aex B.h + 1)
  choose Kf hKf using hrnb
  obtain ⟨C0, hC01, hpl0⟩ := nbg5_plain_le_nb B.h hh0 hh1
  refine ⟨lp + lg + n0 + 8, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 Bo f tw pr τ hf hPS hτs hτid k N
  
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 < B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : n0 ≤ l0)) hn0
  have hqs256 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1/256 := by
    rw [hQb]
    calc (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 ≤ (1/2) ^ 8 := pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega)
      _ = 1/256 := by norm_num
  obtain ⟨hDo, hqsm, hqpos, -⟩ := domc_open_calculus B (qsOf l0) hok
  
  have hFa : ∀ j M : ℕ, ∃ Cc : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      NB B.h (fun η => ((psiWd B G γ η : ℝ) : ℂ) • tw γ m η) j ξ ≤ Cc * qC B.h ξ ^ (M : ℝ) :=
    hPS.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hFb : ∀ j M : ℕ, ∃ Cc : ℝ, ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      NB B.h (fun η => ((1 - psiW B G γ η : ℝ) : ℂ) • srcHat B f γ m η) j ξ ≤ Cc * qC B.h ξ ^ (M : ℝ) :=
    hPS.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  choose Ca hCa using hFa
  choose Cb hCb using hFb
  obtain ⟨K, hKdef⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Kf i| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨A0, hA0def⟩ : ∃ A0 : ℝ, A0 = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (|Ca j (N + 3 * k)| + |Cb j (N + 3 * k)|) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := by rw [hKdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hA00 : 0 ≤ A0 := by rw [hA0def]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)
  obtain ⟨C, hCdef⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = C0 ^ k * 2 ^ k * K * A0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCnn : 0 ≤ C := by
    rw [hCdef]
    have : 0 ≤ C0 ^ k := pow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    positivity
  have hchoose : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ)) = 2 ^ k := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose k
  
  have key : ∀ (γ : Lab) (F Fa Fb : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (ζ : Cyl) (V : Set Cyl), IsOpen V → ζ ∈ V →
      V ⊆ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → 1/4 < qC B.h ζ / Qb γ.1 → qC B.h ζ / Qb γ.1 < 4 →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Fa V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Fb V →
      (∀ j, NB B.h Fa j ζ ≤ Ca j (N + 3 * k) * qC B.h ζ ^ ((N + 3 * k : ℕ) : ℝ)) →
      (∀ j, NB B.h Fb j ζ ≤ Cb j (N + 3 * k) * qC B.h ζ ^ ((N + 3 * k : ℕ) : ℝ)) →
      (∀ y ∈ V, F y = (((rhoQ B γ y ^ (Aex B.h + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (Fa y + Fb y)) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F ζ‖ ≤ C * qC B.h ζ ^ (N : ℝ) := by
    intro γ F Fa Fb ζ V hV hζ hVD hw1 hw2 hFaS hFbS hFaB hFbB hgerm
    have hζD : 0 < ζ.1 ∧ ζ.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h ζ < qsOf l0 := hVD hζ
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ζ := hqpos ζ (hVD hζ)
    have hq1 : qC B.h ζ < 1 := by linarith [hζD.2.2]
    have hn : V ∈ nhds ζ := hV.mem_nhds hζ
    have hrV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => rhoQ B γ y ^ (Aex B.h + 1)) V := fun y hy =>
      (hrsm γ y (show 0 < y.1 ∧ y.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h y < qsOf l0 from hVD hy).2.1).contDiffWithinAt
    have hev : F =ᶠ[nhds ζ] (fun y => rhoQ B γ y ^ (Aex B.h + 1) • (Fa + Fb) y) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hn (fun y hy => (hgerm y hy).trans (Complex.coe_smul _ _))
    have hNBeq : NB B.h F k ζ = NB B.h (fun y => rhoQ B γ y ^ (Aex B.h + 1) • (Fa + Fb) y) k ζ := by
      unfold NB
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
    have hleib := nb_smul_leibniz_v5 B.h (fun y => rhoQ B γ y ^ (Aex B.h + 1)) (Fa + Fb) V ζ hV hζ hrV
      (hFaS.add hFbS) k
    have hΦ : ∀ j, NB B.h (Fa + Fb) j ζ ≤ NB B.h Fa j ζ + NB B.h Fb j ζ := by
      intro j
      unfold NB
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_add_apply ((hFaS.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        ((hFbS.contDiffAt hn).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
      have e2 : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j Fa ζ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ j Fb ζ).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ζ) =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j Fa ζ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ζ) +
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j Fb ζ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h ζ) := by
        ext v
        simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
      rw [e2]
      exact norm_add_le _ _
    have hqN : 0 ≤ qC B.h ζ ^ ((N + 3 * k : ℕ) : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
    have hA : ∀ j ≤ k, NB B.h (Fa + Fb) j ζ ≤ A0 * qC B.h ζ ^ ((N + 3 * k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      intro j hj
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self (Ca j (N + 3 * k))) hqN
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self (Cb j (N + 3 * k))) hqN
      have hs : |Ca j (N + 3 * k)| + |Cb j (N + 3 * k)| ≤ A0 := by
        rw [hA0def]
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Ca j (N + 3 * k)| + |Cb j (N + 3 * k)|)
          (fun i _ => by positivity) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
      have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs hqN
      have h4 := hΦ j
      have h5 := hFaB j
      have h6 := hFbB j
      nlinarith
    have hKb : ∀ i ≤ k, NB B.h (fun y => rhoQ B γ y ^ (Aex B.h + 1)) i ζ ≤ K := by
      intro i hi
      refine le_trans (hKf i γ ζ hζD.2.1 hq1.le hw1 hw2) (le_trans (le_abs_self _) ?_)
      rw [hKdef]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |Kf i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
    have hS : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB B.h (fun y => rhoQ B γ y ^ (Aex B.h + 1)) i ζ *
        NB B.h (Fa + Fb) (k - i) ζ ≤ 2 ^ k * K * A0 * qC B.h ζ ^ ((N + 3 * k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      calc _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * (K * (A0 * qC B.h ζ ^ ((N + 3 * k : ℕ) : ℝ))) := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => ?_)
            have hi' := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
            rw [mul_assoc]
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
            exact mul_le_mul (hKb i (by omega)) (hA (k - i) (by omega))
              (by unfold NB; exact norm_nonneg _) hK0
        _ = 2 ^ k * K * A0 * qC B.h ζ ^ ((N + 3 * k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hchoose]
            ring
    have hfac : 0 ≤ (C0 * qC B.h ζ ^ (-3:ℝ)) ^ k :=
      pow_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)) _
    have e3 : (qC B.h ζ ^ (-3:ℝ)) ^ k * qC B.h ζ ^ ((N + 3 * k : ℕ) : ℝ) = qC B.h ζ ^ (N : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast (qC B.h ζ ^ (-3:ℝ)) k, ← Real.rpow_mul hq0.le, ← Real.rpow_add hq0]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F ζ‖ ≤ (C0 * qC B.h ζ ^ (-3:ℝ)) ^ k * NB B.h F k ζ := hpl0 ζ hq0 hq1 F k
      _ ≤ (C0 * qC B.h ζ ^ (-3:ℝ)) ^ k * (2 ^ k * K * A0 * qC B.h ζ ^ ((N + 3 * k : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by rw [hNBeq]; exact le_trans hleib hS) hfac
      _ = C * qC B.h ζ ^ (N : ℝ) := by
          rw [hCdef, mul_pow]
          linear_combination (C0 ^ k * 2 ^ k * K * A0) * e3
  
  have hloc : ∀ (α : ℝ) (a : WC), InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α a → ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      η ∈ tsupport (a γ m) → 1/4 < qC B.h η / Qb γ.1 ∧ qC B.h η / Qb γ.1 < 4 ∧
        ∃ O : Set Cyl, IsOpen O ∧ η ∈ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (psiW B G γ) O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (psiWd B G γ) O := by
    intro α a ha γ m η hη hts
    obtain ⟨hS, hA4, -, hw1, hw2, -, -, -, -⟩ := hp l0 (by omega) α a ha γ m η hη hts
    obtain ⟨-, -, hxi, het, -, -⟩ := hS
    have hη' : 0 < η.1 ∧ η.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h η < qsOf l0 := hη
    have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h η := hqpos η hη
    obtain ⟨hc1, hc2⟩ := hg γ.1 l0 (qC B.h η) (by omega) hq0 hη'.2.2 hw1 hw2
    have hγ1 : 1 ≤ γ.1 := by have := hA4.1; omega
    have hDB : η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB :=
      (⟨hη'.1, hη'.2.1, lt_trans hη'.2.2 hqsB⟩ : 0 < η.1 ∧ η.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h η < B.qB)
    obtain ⟨O, hO, hηO, -, hψO, hψdO⟩ :=
      (hMj γ η hγ1 hDB (by linarith [hη'.2.2]) hc1 hc2 (by linarith) het).1
    exact ⟨hw1, hw2, O, hO, hηO, hψO, hψdO⟩
  refine ⟨C, fun γ m ξ hξ => ?_⟩
  
  have hzg : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), τ γ m η ≠ 0 →
      η ∈ tsupport (cutA B G tw γ m) ∨ η ∈ tsupport (f γ m) := by
    intro η hη hne
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hcon
    have e1 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp h1
    have e2 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp h2
    have hd : dVc B γ.1 (cutA B G tw γ m) η = 0 := by
      unfold dVc
      rw [e1.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    have hc0 : cutA B G tw γ m η = 0 := e1.eq_of_nhds
    have hf0 : f γ m η = 0 := e2.eq_of_nhds
    apply hne
    rw [hτid γ m η hη, hd, hc0]
    simp [srcHat, hf0, projT5]
  
  obtain ⟨W, hWo, hWmem⟩ : ∃ W : Set Cyl, IsOpen W ∧ ∀ η, η ∈ W ↔ η ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∧ τ γ m η ≠ 0 :=
    ⟨DomC B.h (qsOf l0) ∩ τ γ m ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ,
      (hτs γ m).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hDo isOpen_compl_singleton, fun η => Iff.rfl⟩
  have hsmW : ∀ η ∈ W, 1/4 < qC B.h η / Qb γ.1 ∧ qC B.h η / Qb γ.1 < 4 ∧
      ∃ O : Set Cyl, IsOpen O ∧ η ∈ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (psiW B G γ) O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (psiWd B G γ) O := by
    intro η hη
    obtain ⟨hηD, hne⟩ := (hWmem η).1 hη
    rcases hzg η hηD hne with h | h
    · exact hloc Bo (cutA B G tw) hPS.1 γ m η hηD h
    · exact hloc Bo f hf γ m η hηD h
  
  have hgid : ∀ y ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      ((psiW B G γ y ≠ 0 ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (psiW B G γ) y) ∨ psiW B G γ =ᶠ[nhds y] (fun _ => (0:ℝ))) →
      τ γ m y = (((rhoQ B γ y ^ (Aex B.h + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        ((fun η => ((psiWd B G γ η : ℝ) : ℂ) • tw γ m η) y +
          (fun η => ((1 - psiW B G γ η : ℝ) : ℂ) • srcHat B f γ m η) y) := by
    intro y hy hcase
    rw [hτid γ m y hy]
    congr 1
    rcases hcase with ⟨hne, hd⟩ | h0
    · obtain ⟨htwd, hP5⟩ := hPS.2.2.2.2.1 γ m y hy hne
      have hHF : HasFDerivAt (fun z => ((psiW B G γ z : ℝ) : ℂ))
          (Complex.ofRealCLM.comp (fderiv ℝ (psiW B G γ) y)) y :=
        Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp y hd.hasFDerivAt
      have hdc : dVc B γ.1 (cutA B G tw γ m) y =
          ((psiW B G γ y : ℝ) : ℂ) • dVc B γ.1 (tw γ m) y + ((psiWd B G γ y : ℝ) : ℂ) • tw γ m y := by
        have hcut : cutA B G tw γ m = (fun z => ((psiW B G γ z : ℝ) : ℂ)) • tw γ m := by
          funext z
          rfl
        unfold dVc psiWd
        rw [hcut, fderiv_smul hHF.differentiableAt htwd, hHF.fderiv]
        simp
      rw [hdc, hP5, show cutA B G tw γ m y = ((psiW B G γ y : ℝ) : ℂ) • tw γ m y from rfl,
        Matrix.mulVec_smul]
      funext i
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    · have e1 : cutA B G tw γ m =ᶠ[nhds y] (fun _ => (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ)) :=
        h0.mono (fun z hz => by simp [cutA, hz])
      have hd0 : dVc B γ.1 (cutA B G tw γ m) y = 0 := by
        unfold dVc
        rw [e1.fderiv_eq]
        simp
      have hψ0 : psiW B G γ y = 0 := h0.eq_of_nhds
      have hψd0 : psiWd B G γ y = 0 := by
        unfold psiWd
        rw [h0.fderiv_eq]
        simp
      rw [hd0, show cutA B G tw γ m y = ((psiW B G γ y : ℝ) : ℂ) • tw γ m y from rfl]
      simp [hψ0, hψd0]
  
  have hsrc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (srcHat B f γ m) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => rhoQ B γ z ^ (-(Aex B.h + 1))) (DomC B.h (qsOf l0)) := fun z hz =>
      ((rhoQ_rpow_nb_v5 B hok (-(Aex B.h + 1))).1 γ z
        (show 0 < z.1 ∧ z.2.2.1 < 1 ∧ qC B.h z < qsOf l0 from hz).2.1).contDiffWithinAt
    refine (h1.smul (hf.2.1 γ m)).congr (fun z _ => ?_)
    simp only [srcHat, Pi.smul_apply', Complex.coe_smul]
  have hab : ∀ V : Set Cyl, IsOpen V → V ⊆ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) →
      (((∀ y ∈ V, psiW B G γ y ≠ 0) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (psiW B G γ) V ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (psiWd B G γ) V) ∨
        ∀ y ∈ V, psiW B G γ y = 0) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((psiWd B G γ η : ℝ) : ℂ) • tw γ m η) V ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ((1 - psiW B G γ η : ℝ) : ℂ) • srcHat B f γ m η) V := by
    intro V hV hVD htype
    rcases htype with ⟨hne, hψV, hψdV⟩ | h0
    · refine ⟨((hψdV.div hψV hne).smul ((hPS.1.2.1 γ m).mono hVD)).congr (fun z hz => ?_),
        (((contDiffOn_const (c := (1:ℝ))).sub hψV).smul (hsrc.mono hVD)).congr (fun z _ => ?_)⟩
      · simp only [Pi.smul_apply', Pi.div_apply, cutA, Complex.coe_smul, smul_smul]
        rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hne z hz)]
      · simp only [Pi.smul_apply', Complex.coe_smul]
    · have hψd0 : ∀ z ∈ V, psiWd B G γ z = 0 := by
        intro z hz
        have hev : psiW B G γ =ᶠ[nhds z] fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV.mem_nhds hz) (fun w hw => h0 w hw)
        unfold psiWd
        rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
        simp
      refine ⟨(contDiffOn_const (c := (0 : Fin 3 → ℂ))).congr (fun z hz => ?_),
        (hsrc.mono hVD).congr (fun z hz => ?_)⟩
      · simp [hψd0 z hz]
      · simp [h0 z hz]
  
  obtain ⟨Good, hGood⟩ : ∃ Good : Set Cyl, ∀ ζ, ζ ∈ Good ↔ ∃ V : Set Cyl, IsOpen V ∧ ζ ∈ V ∧ V ⊆ W ∧
      (((∀ y ∈ V, psiW B G γ y ≠ 0) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (psiW B G γ) V ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (psiWd B G γ) V) ∨
        ∀ y ∈ V, psiW B G γ y = 0) := ⟨_, fun ζ => Iff.rfl⟩
  have hdense : ∀ η ∈ W, η ∈ closure Good := by
    intro η hη

      have hν1 : ν + 1 ≤ (MH * K4 + 1) / Q := by
        rw [add_div, hνdef]
        linarith
      have hu : (ν + 1) ^ m ≤ (MH * K4 + 1) ^ m / Q ^ m := by
        rw [← div_pow]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) hν1 m
      have hP : Q ^ (-M) * Q ^ (N' : ℝ) / Q ^ m ≤ Q ^ (N : ℝ) := by
        have e1 : Q ^ (-M) * Q ^ (N' : ℝ) / Q ^ m = Q ^ (-M + (N' : ℝ) + (-(m : ℝ))) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_add hq0, Real.rpow_add hq0, Real.rpow_neg hq0.le (m : ℝ),
            Real.rpow_natCast Q m, div_eq_mul_inv]
        rw [e1]
        apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq0 hq1
        have hcM : M ≤ (⌈M⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil M
        rw [hN']
        push_cast
        linarith
      have hw0 : 0 ≤ Q ^ (-M) * A := mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _) hA0
      calc K * (T.card : ℝ) * (ν + 1) ^ m * Q ^ (-M) * A
          = (K * (T.card : ℝ) * (ν + 1) ^ m) * (Q ^ (-M) * A) := by ring
        _ ≤ (K * (162 * (H.card : ℝ)) * ((MH * K4 + 1) ^ m / Q ^ m)) * (Q ^ (-M) * A) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hw0
            exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcardR hK) hu
              (pow_nonneg (by linarith) m) (mul_nonneg hK hc'0)
        _ = K * (162 * (H.card : ℝ)) * (MH * K4 + 1) ^ m * A0 *
              (Q ^ (-M) * Q ^ (N' : ℝ) / Q ^ m) := by
            rw [hAdef]
            ring
        _ ≤ K * (162 * (H.card : ℝ)) * (MH * K4 + 1) ^ m * A0 * Q ^ (N : ℝ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP hC0
    · have hpU : (x, s) ∈ U0 ∪ U2 := by
        rw [hU0, hU2]
        rcases not_and_or.mp hsh with h | h
        · left
          refine ⟨hxs, ?_⟩
          show 0 < 2 * B.Xa * Q - rad x ^ 2
          linarith [not_le.mp h]
        · right
          refine ⟨hxs, ?_⟩
          show 0 < rad x ^ 2 - 2 * B.Xb * Q
          linarith [not_le.mp h]
      have hev : (↿(evOff B.h F Y₀)) =ᶠ[nhds (x, s)] fun _ => (0 : ℝ³) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((hU0o.union hU2o).mem_nhds hpU) (fun w hw => hZ0 Y₀ w hw)
      rw [(hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg hC0 (Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _)
  exact ⟨hF1', hF2, fun x t Y hxt hr => hzero x t Y hxt (Or.inl hr)⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lv, hv⟩ := velRem5_class B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lm, hm⟩ := pulse_mult_coeffs_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨C0, b0, hcb⟩ := hm 0
  obtain ⟨ls, hs⟩ := pulse_support_good_v5 B G hok hG
  refine ⟨lv + lm + ls, fun l0 hl0 α f tw pr hPS hD => ?_⟩
  have hq1 : qsOf l0 ≤ 1 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) ≤ 1
    exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (by simp)
  have hc : InWg5 B G (qsOf l0) α (cutA B G tw) := hPS.1
  have hP3 := hPS.2.2.1
  have hP4 := hPS.2.2.2.1
  
  have hcross : ∀ (n v : Fin 3 → ℂ) (a b N : ℂ), a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 →
      N = n 0 * n 0 + n 1 * n 1 + n 2 * n 2 → N ≠ 0 → n 0 * v 0 + n 1 * v 1 + n 2 * v 2 = 0 →
      (Complex.I * a * b) • crossC n ((Complex.I / (a * b * N)) • crossC n v) = v := by
    intro n v a b N ha hb hN hN0 hv
    have hk : Complex.I * a * b * (Complex.I / (a * b * N)) * N = -1 := by
      have habN : a * b * N ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero ha hb) hN0
      have e : Complex.I * a * b * (Complex.I / (a * b * N)) * N =
          (Complex.I * Complex.I) * ((a * b * N) / (a * b * N)) := by ring
      rw [e, div_self habN, Complex.I_mul_I]
      ring
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · show Complex.I * a * b * (n 1 * (Complex.I / (a * b * N) * (n 0 * v 1 - n 1 * v 0))
          - n 2 * (Complex.I / (a * b * N) * (n 2 * v 0 - n 0 * v 2))) = v 0
      linear_combination (Complex.I * a * b * (Complex.I / (a * b * N)) * n 0) * hv
        + (Complex.I * a * b * (Complex.I / (a * b * N)) * v 0) * hN - v 0 * hk
    · show Complex.I * a * b * (n 2 * (Complex.I / (a * b * N) * (n 1 * v 2 - n 2 * v 1))
          - n 0 * (Complex.I / (a * b * N) * (n 0 * v 1 - n 1 * v 0))) = v 1
      linear_combination (Complex.I * a * b * (Complex.I / (a * b * N)) * n 1) * hv
        + (Complex.I * a * b * (Complex.I / (a * b * N)) * v 1) * hN - v 1 * hk
    · show Complex.I * a * b * (n 0 * (Complex.I / (a * b * N) * (n 2 * v 0 - n 0 * v 2))
          - n 1 * (Complex.I / (a * b * N) * (n 1 * v 2 - n 2 * v 1))) = v 2
      linear_combination (Complex.I * a * b * (Complex.I / (a * b * N)) * n 2) * hv
        + (Complex.I * a * b * (Complex.I / (a * b * N)) * v 2) * hN - v 2 * hk
  have hcz : ∀ n : Fin 3 → ℂ, crossC n 0 = 0 := by
    intro n
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [crossC]
  have hkb : ∀ l : ℕ, (kb B.h l : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro l
    have h0 : 0 < kb B.h l := by
      unfold kb epsb Qb
      exact Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos
        (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _) _) _)
    exact_mod_cast h0.ne'
  
  have hsplit : ∀ (a : WC) (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Cyl), velW5 B G a γ m ξ =
      (Complex.I * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ)) • crossC (nPhiC5 B G γ ξ) (a γ m ξ)
        + velRem5 B a γ m ξ := by
    intro a γ m ξ
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [velW5, velC5, velRem5, crossC, nPhiC5] <;> ring
  
  have hcr : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      (Complex.I * (kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ)) • crossC (nPhiC5 B G γ ξ) (potOf5 B G tw γ m ξ)
        = cutA B G tw γ m ξ := by
    intro γ m ξ hξ
    by_cases hm0 : m = 0
    · subst hm0
      have h0 : tw γ 0 = 0 := (hP3 γ 0 rfl).1
      simp [cutA, h0]
    · have hpot : potOf5 B G tw γ m ξ = (Complex.I / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) * nsqC5 B G γ ξ)) •
          crossC (nPhiC5 B G γ ξ) (cutA B G tw γ m ξ) := by
        simp only [potOf5, if_neg hm0, cutA]
      by_cases hc0 : cutA B G tw γ m ξ = 0
      · rw [hpot, hc0, hcz, smul_zero, hcz, smul_zero]
      · have hts : ξ ∈ tsupport (cutA B G tw γ m) := subset_tsupport _ hc0
        obtain ⟨-, hA, hl, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ :=
          hs l0 (by omega) α (cutA B G tw) hc γ m ξ hξ hts
        have hN0 := (hcb l0 (by omega) γ m hA hl ξ hξ h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6).1
        have hNdef : nsqC5 B G γ ξ = nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 0 * nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 0
            + nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 1 * nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 1 + nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 2 * nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 2 := by
          simp [nsqC5, nPhiC5, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        have hNne : nsqC5 B G γ ξ ≠ 0 := by
          unfold nsqC5
          exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hN0
        have hdot : nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 0 * cutA B G tw γ m ξ 0 + nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 1 * cutA B G tw γ m ξ 1
            + nPhiC5 B G γ ξ 2 * cutA B G tw γ m ξ 2 = 0 := by
          have h4' := hP4 γ m ξ hξ
          simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three] at h4'
          simp only [cutA, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          linear_combination (((psiW B G γ ξ : ℝ) : ℂ)) * h4'
        rw [hpot]
        exact hcross (nPhiC5 B G γ ξ) (cutA B G tw γ m ξ) _ _ _ (hkb _)
          (Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hm0) hNdef hNne hdot
  
  have hpt : ∀ (γ : Lab) (m : ℤ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      (velW5 B G (potOf5 B G tw) - cutA B G tw) γ m ξ = velRem5 B (potOf5 B G tw) γ m ξ := by
    intro γ m ξ hξ
    show velW5 B G (potOf5 B G tw) γ m ξ - cutA B G tw γ m ξ = _
    rw [hsplit, hcr γ m ξ hξ]
    abel
  have hR := hv l0 (by omega) (α + 1/2) (potOf5 B G tw) hD
  obtain ⟨HD, h0D, hHD⟩ := hD.1
  obtain ⟨Hc, h0c, hHc⟩ := hc.1
  refine (pq5_add_congr_class B G (qsOf l0) hok hq1 (V := Fin 3 → ℂ)).2 (α + 1/2 - kapS)
    (velRem5 B (potOf5 B G tw)) (velW5 B G (potOf5 B G tw) - cutA B G tw) hR
    ⟨HD ∪ Hc, by simp [h0D, h0c], fun γ m hm => ?_⟩ hpt
  have eD : potOf5 B G tw γ m = 0 := hHD γ m (fun h => hm (Finset.mem_union_left _ h))
  have ec : cutA B G tw γ m = 0 := hHc γ m (fun h => hm (Finset.mem_union_right _ h))
  funext ξ j
  fin_cases j <;> simp [velW5, velC5, DrC, DzC, dR, dZ, eD, ec]

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, hqB0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hok.2.1
  obtain ⟨nq, hnq⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hqB0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  obtain ⟨lN, c, hc, hN⟩ := good_nsq_lower_v5 B G hok hG
  obtain ⟨lP, hP⟩ := good_nphi5_nb_v5 B G hok hG
  refine ⟨lN + lP + nq, fun k => ?_⟩
  choose Cn hCn using hP
  obtain ⟨D₀, hD₀⟩ : ∃ D₀ : ℝ, D₀ = 1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cn j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cn j| :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hD₀1 : 1 ≤ D₀ := by rw [hD₀]; linarith
  have hCnD : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → |Cn j| ≤ D₀ := by
    intro j hj
    have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cn j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega : j < k + 1))
    rw [hD₀]; linarith
  have hq := fun t : ℕ => nb_pres_quot_v5 t c D₀ hc
  choose Cq hCq using hq
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = D₀ + ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cq t| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsum1 : 0 ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |Cq t| :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hD₀D : D₀ ≤ D := by rw [hD]; linarith
  have hCqD : ∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ k → |Cq t| ≤ D := by
    intro t ht
    have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |Cq j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega : t < k + 1))
    rw [hD]; linarith
  refine ⟨D, by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro l0 hl0 γ hAct hlγ η hη hw1 hw2 hX1 hX2 hxi het
  have hQb : qsOf l0 = (1/2:ℝ) ^ l0 := by
    show (2:ℝ) ^ (-(l0:ℝ)) = _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), Real.rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have hqsB : qsOf l0 < B.qB := by
    rw [hQb]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega : nq ≤ l0)) hnq
  have hηB : η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB := by
    obtain ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩ := hη
    exact ⟨e1, e2, lt_trans e3 hqsB⟩
  obtain ⟨U₀, hU₀, hηU₀, -, hn0, -, -⟩ := good_coeff_smooth_v5 B G γ η hok hηB hxi het
  have hQeq : ∀ ζ : Cyl, dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ζ) (nPhi5 B G γ ζ) =
      nPhi5 B G γ ζ 0 * nPhi5 B G γ ζ 0 + nPhi5 B G γ ζ 1 * nPhi5 B G γ ζ 1 +
        nPhi5 B G γ ζ 2 * nPhi5 B G γ ζ 2 := by
    intro ζ
    simp [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have hQs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : Cyl => dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ζ) (nPhi5 B G γ ζ)) U₀ := by
    have h := (((hn0 0).mul (hn0 0)).add ((hn0 1).mul (hn0 1))).add ((hn0 2).mul (hn0 2))
    exact h.congr (fun ζ _ => hQeq ζ)
  have hcQ : c ≤ dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ η) (nPhi5 B G γ η) :=
    hN l0 (by omega) γ hAct hlγ η hη hw1 hw2 hX1 hX2 hxi het
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U : Set Cyl,
      U = U₀ ∩ (fun ζ : Cyl => dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ζ) (nPhi5 B G γ ζ)) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hUo : IsOpen U := by
    rw [hU]; exact hQs.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hU₀ isOpen_Ioi
  have hηU : η ∈ U := by
    rw [hU]; exact ⟨hηU₀, show (0:ℝ) < _ from lt_of_lt_of_le hc hcQ⟩
  have hUU₀ : U ⊆ U₀ := by rw [hU]; exact Set.inter_subset_left
  have hQne : ∀ ζ ∈ U, dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ζ) (nPhi5 B G γ ζ) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hU]; intro ζ hζ; exact ne_of_gt hζ.2
  have hnU : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ ζ i) U :=
    fun i => (hn0 i).mono hUU₀
  have huU : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun ζ : Cyl => (dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ζ) (nPhi5 B G γ ζ))⁻¹ * nPhi5 B G γ ζ i) U :=
    fun i => ((hQs.mono hUU₀).inv hQne).mul (hnU i)
  have hS1 : 1 ≤ SC B.h η := by
    unfold SC
    exact one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (qC B.h η))])
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ SC B.h η := by linarith
  have hSk : SC B.h η ≤ SC B.h η ^ (2 * k + 2) := by
    calc SC B.h η = SC B.h η ^ 1 := (pow_one _).symm
      _ ≤ _ := pow_le_pow_right₀ hS1 (by omega)
  have hnb : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      NB B.h (fun ζ : Cyl => nPhi5 B G γ ζ i) j η ≤ D₀ * SC B.h η := by
    intro j hj i
    have h1 := hCn j l0 (by omega) γ hAct hlγ η hη hw1 hw2 hX1 hX2 hxi het i
    exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_trans (le_abs_self _) (hCnD j hj)) hS0)
  have hNBneg : ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (j : ℕ), NB B.h (fun ζ => -(f ζ)) j η = NB B.h f j η := by
    intro f j
    unfold NB
    have e1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun ζ => -(f ζ)) η = -iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f η := by
      have e0 : (fun ζ => -(f ζ)) = -f := rfl
      rw [e0, iteratedFDeriv_neg_apply]
    rw [e1]
    have e2 : (-iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f η).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h η) =
        -((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f η).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm B.h η)) := by
      ext m
      simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e2, norm_neg]
  have hNB0 : ∀ j : ℕ, NB B.h (fun _ : Cyl => (0 : ℝ)) j η = 0 := by
    intro j
    unfold NB
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero]
    have e : ((0 : Cyl → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => Cyl) ℝ) η).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Lnorm B.h η) = 0 := by
      ext m
      simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e, norm_zero]
  have hD₀S : 0 ≤ D₀ * SC B.h η := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hS0
  refine ⟨U, hUo, hηU, hnU, huU, fun t ht i => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · exact le_trans (hnb t ht i) (le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hD₀D hS0)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSk (by linarith)))
  · have hfun : (fun ζ : Cyl => (nPhi5 B G γ ζ 0 * nPhi5 B G γ ζ 0 + nPhi5 B G γ ζ 1 * nPhi5 B G γ ζ 1 +
          nPhi5 B G γ ζ 2 * nPhi5 B G γ ζ 2)⁻¹ * (nPhi5 B G γ ζ 0 * 0 + nPhi5 B G γ ζ 1 * 0 +
          nPhi5 B G γ ζ 2 * 0 - -(nPhi5 B G γ ζ i))) =
        (fun ζ : Cyl => (dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ζ) (nPhi5 B G γ ζ))⁻¹ * nPhi5 B G γ ζ i) := by
      funext ζ
      rw [hQeq ζ]
      ring
    have hmain : NB B.h (fun ζ : Cyl => (dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ζ) (nPhi5 B G γ ζ))⁻¹ *
        nPhi5 B G γ ζ i) t η ≤ Cq t * SC B.h η ^ (2 * t + 2) := by
      rw [← hfun]
      exact hCq t B.h (SC B.h η) U η (fun a ζ => nPhi5 B G γ ζ a) (fun a ζ => -(nPhi5 B G γ ζ a))
        (fun _ _ _ => (0:ℝ)) hUo hηU hS1 hnU (fun a => (hnU a).neg) (fun _ _ => contDiffOn_const)
        (le_of_le_of_eq hcQ (hQeq η))
        (fun j hj => ⟨fun a => hnb j (by omega) a,
          fun a => by rw [hNBneg]; exact hnb j (by omega) a,
          fun _ _ => by rw [hNB0]; exact hD₀S⟩) i
    have hpow : SC B.h η ^ (2 * t + 2) ≤ SC B.h η ^ (2 * k + 2) := pow_le_pow_right₀ hS1 (by omega)
    have hp0 : 0 ≤ SC B.h η ^ (2 * t + 2) := pow_nonneg hS0 _
    calc _ ≤ Cq t * SC B.h η ^ (2 * t + 2) := hmain
      _ ≤ |Cq t| * SC B.h η ^ (2 * t + 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hp0
      _ ≤ D * SC B.h η ^ (2 * k + 2) := mul_le_mul (hCqD t ht) hpow hp0 (by linarith)

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom), B.ok → GeomPrim5 B G → ∃ (l1 : ℕ) (c : ℝ), 0 < c ∧ ∀ (l0 : ℕ), l1 ≤ l0 → ∀ (γ : Lab), ActiveL4 B G γ → l0 ≤ γ.1 → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 → qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1 < 4 → B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb → |xiG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 → |etG B.h γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2| < 1/8 → c ≤ dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ)

subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (c D : ℝ), 0 < c → ∃ C' : ℝ, ∀ (h Sv : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (n p : Fin 3 → Cyl → ℝ) (K : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Cyl → ℝ), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → 1 ≤ Sv → (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (n i) U) → (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (p i) U) → (∀ i j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (K i j) U) → c ≤ n 0 ξ * n 0 ξ + n 1 ξ * n 1 ξ + n 2 ξ * n 2 ξ → (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → (∀ i, NB h (n i) j ξ ≤ D * Sv) ∧ (∀ i, NB h (p i) j ξ ≤ D * Sv) ∧ ∀ i i', NB h (K i i') j ξ ≤ D * Sv) → ∀ j : Fin 3, NB h (fun η => (n 0 η * n 0 η + n 1 η * n 1 η + n 2 η * n 2 η)⁻¹ * (n 0 η * K 0 j η + n 1 η * K 1 j η + n 2 η * K 2 j η - p j η)) k ξ ≤ C' * Sv ^ (2 * k + 2)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (r a b : Cyl → ℝ) (δ : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (R N : ℝ), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ r U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b U → |δ| ≤ 1 → (∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ k → NB h r t ξ ≤ R) → (∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ k → NB h a t ξ ≤ N ∧ NB h b t ξ ≤ N) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : Cyl => r ζ * (δ - a ζ * b ζ)) U ∧ ∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ k → NB h (fun ζ : Cyl => r ζ * (δ - a ζ * b ζ)) t ξ ≤ 2 ^ k * R * (1 + 2 ^ k * N ^ 2)

signature.name: nb_proj_entry_v5
signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (r a b : Cyl → ℝ) (δ : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (R N : ℝ), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ r U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b U → |δ| ≤ 1 → (∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ k → NB h r t ξ ≤ R) → (∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ k → NB h a t ξ ≤ N ∧ NB h b t ξ ≤ N) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : Cyl => r ζ * (δ - a ζ * b ζ)) U ∧ ∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ k → NB h (fun ζ : Cyl => r ζ * (δ - a ζ * b ζ)) t ξ ≤ 2 ^ k * R * (1 + 2 ^ k * N ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h U ξ r a b δ k R N hU hξ hr ha hb hδ hR hN
  have hNBnn : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : Cyl → V) (i : ℕ),
      0 ≤ NB h f i ξ := fun f i => norm_nonneg _
  
  have leib : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (U : Set Cyl) (n : ℕ),
      IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (g : Cyl → V), ContDiffOn ℝ n f U → ContDiffOn ℝ n g U →
      NB h (fun η => f η • g η) n ξ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h g (n - i) ξ := by
    intro V _ _ U n hU hξ f g hf hg
    unfold NB
    generalize Lnorm h ξ = L
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage L.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
    have hL0s : L 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
    have hsm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have hsmO : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact (hsm F hF).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
    have key : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n →
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0 =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF i hi
      have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O
      have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
        hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
      have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + z)) i hs h0s
      have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i ξ 0
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0
          = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑L) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := e2
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [map_zero]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [e3]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
    have hfg : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun η => f η • g η) U := hf.smul hg
    have hl := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_smul_le (hsmO f hf) (hsmO g hg) hO.uniqueDiffOn h0O
      (n := n) le_rfl
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => f (ξ + L y) • g (ξ + L y)) n hO h0O] at hl
    rw [← key _ hfg n le_rfl]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => (fun η => f η • g η) (ξ + L z)) 0‖
        = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f (ξ + L y) • g (ξ + L y)) 0‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ _ := hl
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        have hik : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O,
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => g (ξ + L z)) (n - i) hO h0O,
          key f hf i hik, key g hg (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i)]
  
  have mulb : ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (A E : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → NB h f i ξ ≤ A) → (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → NB h g i ξ ≤ E) →
      NB h (fun η => f η * g η) n ξ ≤ 2 ^ n * A * E := by
    intro f g n A E hf hg hA hE
    have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := le_trans (hNBnn f 0) (hA 0 (Nat.zero_le n))
    have hfn : ContDiffOn ℝ n f U := hf.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hgn : ContDiffOn ℝ n g U := hg.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have l1 : NB h (fun η => f η * g η) n ξ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (n.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h g (n - i) ξ := leib U n hU hξ f g hfn hgn
    refine le_trans l1 ?_
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h g (n - i) ξ
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * A * E := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          have hik : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hA i hik) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
            (hE _ (Nat.sub_le n i)) (hNBnn _ _) (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hA0)
      _ = A * E * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; ring
      _ = 2 ^ n * A * E := by
          have hs : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) = 2 ^ n := by
            exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose n
          rw [hs]; ring
  
  have lin : ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (c d : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U →
      NB h (fun η => c * f η + d * g η) n ξ ≤ |c| * NB h f n ξ + |d| * NB h g n ξ := by
    intro f g n c d hf hg
    have hfa : ContDiffAt ℝ n f ξ :=
      (hf.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)
    have hga : ContDiffAt ℝ n g ξ :=
      (hg.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hξ)
    unfold NB
    have hfa' : ContDiffAt ℝ n (fun η => c * f η) ξ := contDiffAt_const.mul hfa
    have hga' : ContDiffAt ℝ n (fun η => d * g η) ξ := contDiffAt_const.mul hga
    have e0 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun η => c * f η + d * g η) ξ =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun η => c * f η) ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun η => d * g η) ξ :=
      iteratedFDeriv_add_apply hfa' hga'
    have ea : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun η => c * f η) ξ = c • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f ξ := by
      have := iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply (a := c) hfa
      exact this
    have eb : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun η => d * g η) ξ = d • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g ξ := by
      have := iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply (a := d) hga
      exact this
    rw [e0, ea, eb]
    have e2 : (c • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f ξ + d • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) =
        c • (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) +
        d • (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) := by
      ext m; simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e2]
    refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  
  have cst : ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ), NB h (fun _ : Cyl => c) n ξ ≤ if n = 0 then |c| else 0 := by
    intro n c
    unfold NB
    have hle := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
      (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun _ : Cyl => c) ξ) (fun _ : Fin n => Lnorm h ξ)
    split_ifs with hk
    · subst hk
      rw [Fin.prod_univ_zero, mul_one, norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hle
      exact hle
    · have hz : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun _ : Cyl => c) ξ = 0 := by
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne hk c]; rfl
      rw [hz] at hle ⊢
      rw [norm_zero, zero_mul] at hle
      exact hle
  
  have hab : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => a η * b η) U := ha.mul hb
  have he : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : Cyl => δ - a ζ * b ζ) U := contDiffOn_const.sub hab
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ R := le_trans (hNBnn r 0) (hR 0 (Nat.zero_le k))
  have hX0 : 0 ≤ 1 + 2 ^ k * N ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hABb : ∀ s : ℕ, s ≤ k → NB h (fun η => a η * b η) s ξ ≤ 2 ^ k * N ^ 2 := by
    intro s hs
    have h1 := mulb a b s N N ha hb (fun i hi => (hN i (le_trans hi hs)).1)
      (fun i hi => (hN i (le_trans hi hs)).2)
    have h2 : (2:ℝ) ^ s ≤ 2 ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hs
    have h3 : (2:ℝ) ^ s * N * N = 2 ^ s * N ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [h3] at h1
    exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (sq_nonneg N))
  have hEb : ∀ s : ℕ, s ≤ k → NB h (fun ζ : Cyl => δ - a ζ * b ζ) s ξ ≤ 1 + 2 ^ k * N ^ 2 := by
    intro s hs
    have heq : (fun ζ : Cyl => δ - a ζ * b ζ) =
        (fun η => 1 * (fun _ : Cyl => δ) η + (-1) * (fun η => a η * b η) η) := by
      funext η; ring
    have hl := lin (fun _ : Cyl => δ) (fun η => a η * b η) s 1 (-1) contDiffOn_const hab
    have hc : NB h (fun _ : Cyl => δ) s ξ ≤ 1 := by
      refine le_trans (cst s δ) ?_
      split_ifs
      · exact hδ
      · norm_num
    rw [heq]
    refine le_trans hl ?_
    rw [abs_one, abs_neg, abs_one, one_mul, one_mul]
    exact add_le_add hc (hABb s hs)
  refine ⟨hr.mul he, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  have h1 := mulb r (fun ζ : Cyl => δ - a ζ * b ζ) t R (1 + 2 ^ k * N ^ 2) hr he
    (fun i hi => hR i (le_trans hi ht)) (fun i hi => hEb i (le_trans hi ht))
  have h2 : (2:ℝ) ^ t ≤ 2 ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) ht
  refine le_trans h1 ?_
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 hR0) hX0

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (ρ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Cyl → ℝ) (g : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (k : ℕ) (M W : ℝ), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → (∀ i a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ρ i a) U) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → (∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ k → ∀ i a : Fin 3, NB h (ρ i a) t ξ ≤ M) → (∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ k → NB h g t ξ ≤ W) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : Cyl => fun i : Fin 3 => ∑ a : Fin 3, ((ρ i a ζ : ℝ) : ℂ) * g ζ a) U ∧ NB h (fun ζ : Cyl => fun i : Fin 3 => ∑ a : Fin 3, ((ρ i a ζ : ℝ) : ℂ) * g ζ a) k ξ ≤ 9 * 2 ^ k * M * W

signature.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl) (ρ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Cyl → ℝ) (g : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (k : ℕ) (M W : ℝ), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → (∀ i a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ρ i a) U) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → (∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ k → ∀ i a : Fin 3, NB h (ρ i a) t ξ ≤ M) → (∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ k → NB h g t ξ ≤ W) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : Cyl => fun i : Fin 3 => ∑ a : Fin 3, ((ρ i a ζ : ℝ) : ℂ) * g ζ a) U ∧ NB h (fun ζ : Cyl => fun i : Fin 3 => ∑ a : Fin 3, ((ρ i a ζ : ℝ) : ℂ) * g ζ a) k ξ ≤ 9 * 2 ^ k * M * W

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h U ξ ρ g k M W hU hξ hρ hg hρb hgb
  have hUn : U ∈ nhds ξ := hU.mem_nhds hξ
  
  have leib : ∀ {W' : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W'] [NormedSpace ℝ W'] (n : ℕ)
      (f : Cyl → ℝ) (G' : Cyl → W'), ContDiffOn ℝ n f U → ContDiffOn ℝ n G' U →
      NB h (fun η => f η • G' η) n ξ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h G' (n - i) ξ := by
    intro W' _ _ n f G' hf hG'
    unfold NB
    generalize Lnorm h ξ = L
    obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs : IsOpen s := by
      rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hO' : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage L.continuous
    have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
    have hL0s : L 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
    have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
    have hsm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
    have hsmO : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF
      exact (hsm F hF).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
    have key : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
        ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n →
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0 =
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
      intro W _ _ F hF i hi
      have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + L z)) i hO' h0O
      have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
        hO'.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
      have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + z)) i hs h0s
      have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i ξ 0
      calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0
          = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑L) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := e2
        _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [map_zero]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) 0).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => L) := by rw [e3]
        _ = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by rw [e4, add_zero]
    have hfg : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun η => f η • G' η) U := hf.smul hG'
    have hl := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_smul_le (hsmO f hf) (hsmO G' hG') hO'.uniqueDiffOn h0O
      (n := n) le_rfl
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun y => f (ξ + L y) • G' (ξ + L y)) n hO' h0O] at hl
    rw [← key _ hfg n le_rfl]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => (fun η => f η • G' η) (ξ + L z)) 0‖
        = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f (ξ + L y) • G' (ξ + L y)) 0‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ _ := hl
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        have hik : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => f (ξ + L z)) i hO' h0O,
          iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (f := fun z => G' (ξ + L z)) (n - i) hO' h0O,
          key f hf i hik, key G' hG' (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i)]
  
  have comp_eq : ∀ (F : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (j : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F ξ →
      ∀ m : Fin j → Cyl,
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => F η i) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)) m =
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ j F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)) m i := by
    intro F j i hF m
    have e : (fun η => F η i) =
        ⇑(ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) i) ∘ F := rfl
    rw [e, (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℂ) i).iteratedFDeriv_comp_left
      hF (i := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)]
    rfl
  have nb_le : ∀ (F : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (j : ℕ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F ξ →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, NB h (fun η => F η i) j ξ ≤ NB h F j ξ) ∧
        NB h F j ξ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, NB h (fun η => F η i) j ξ := by
    intro F j hF
    constructor
    · intro i
      unfold NB
      apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (norm_nonneg _)
      intro m
      rw [comp_eq F j i hF m]
      exact (norm_le_pi_norm _ i).trans (ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ m)
    · unfold NB
      have hT0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3,
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => F η i) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖ :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => norm_nonneg _
      apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound hT0
      intro m
      have hp : 0 ≤ ∏ s, ‖m s‖ := Finset.prod_nonneg fun s _ => norm_nonneg _
      apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hT0 hp)).2
      intro i
      rw [← comp_eq F j i hF m]
      refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ m).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hp)
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i : Fin 3 =>
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun η => F η i) ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ)‖)
        (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  
  have nb_add : ∀ (u v : Cyl → ℂ) (n : ℕ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ u ξ → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ v ξ →
      NB h (fun η => u η + v η) n ξ ≤ NB h u n ξ + NB h v n ξ := by
    intro u v n hu hv
    unfold NB
    have e : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun η => u η + v η) ξ =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ n u ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ n v ξ :=
      iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (hu.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
        (hv.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
    rw [e]
    have e2 : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n u ξ + iteratedFDeriv ℝ n v ξ).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) =
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n u ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) +
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n v ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Lnorm h ξ) := by
      ext m; simp [ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    rw [e2]; exact norm_add_le _ _
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hρb 0 (Nat.zero_le _) 0 0)
  have hga : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => g η a) U := fun a => contDiffOn_pi.1 hg a
  have hgat : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g ξ := hg.contDiffAt hUn
  have hgaW : ∀ a : Fin 3, ∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ k → NB h (fun η => g η a) t ξ ≤ W :=
    fun a t ht => ((nb_le g t hgat).1 a).trans (hgb t ht)
  have hT : ∀ i a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => ρ i a η • g η a) U :=
    fun i a => (hρ i a).smul (hga a)
  have hTb : ∀ i a : Fin 3, NB h (fun η => ρ i a η • g η a) k ξ ≤ 2 ^ k * M * W := by
    intro i a
    refine (leib k (ρ i a) (fun η => g η a) ((hρ i a).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      ((hga a).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))).trans ?_
    calc ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose s : ℝ) * NB h (ρ i a) s ξ *
          NB h (fun η => g η a) (k - s) ξ
        ≤ ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose s : ℝ) * (M * W) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro s hs
          have hsk : s ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hs)
          rw [mul_assoc]
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
          exact mul_le_mul (hρb s hsk i a) (hgaW a (k - s) (Nat.sub_le k s)) (norm_nonneg _) hM0
      _ = (∑ s ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose s : ℝ)) * (M * W) := by rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = 2 ^ k * M * W := by
          have hc : (∑ s ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose s : ℝ)) = 2 ^ k := by
            exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose k
          rw [hc]; ring
  have hΦeq : (fun ζ : Cyl => fun i : Fin 3 => ∑ a : Fin 3, ((ρ i a ζ : ℝ) : ℂ) * g ζ a) =
      (fun ζ : Cyl => fun i : Fin 3 => ∑ a : Fin 3, ρ i a ζ • g ζ a) := by
    funext ζ i
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Complex.real_smul.symm
  have hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : Cyl => fun i : Fin 3 => ∑ a : Fin 3, ρ i a ζ • g ζ a) U :=
    contDiffOn_pi.2 fun i => ContDiffOn.sum fun a _ => hT i a
  have hcomp : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      NB h (fun ζ : Cyl => ∑ a : Fin 3, ρ i a ζ • g ζ a) k ξ ≤ 3 * (2 ^ k * M * W) := by
    intro i
    have e : (fun ζ : Cyl => ∑ a : Fin 3, ρ i a ζ • g ζ a) =
        fun ζ => (ρ i 0 ζ • g ζ 0 + ρ i 1 ζ • g ζ 1) + ρ i 2 ζ • g ζ 2 := by
      funext ζ; exact Fin.sum_univ_three _
    rw [e]
    have hTa : ∀ a, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun η => ρ i a η • g η a) ξ :=
      fun a => (hT i a).contDiffAt hUn
    have h1 : NB h (fun ζ => (ρ i 0 ζ • g ζ 0 + ρ i 1 ζ • g ζ 1) + ρ i 2 ζ • g ζ 2) k ξ ≤
        NB h (fun η => ρ i 0 η • g η 0 + ρ i 1 η • g η 1) k ξ +
          NB h (fun η => ρ i 2 η • g η 2) k ξ :=
      nb_add _ _ k ((hTa 0).add (hTa 1)) (hTa 2)
    have h2 : NB h (fun η => ρ i 0 η • g η 0 + ρ i 1 η • g η 1) k ξ ≤
        NB h (fun η => ρ i 0 η • g η 0) k ξ + NB h (fun η => ρ i 1 η • g η 1) k ξ :=
      nb_add _ _ k (hTa 0) (hTa 1)
    linarith [hTb i 0, hTb i 1, hTb i 2]
  refine ⟨by rw [hΦeq]; exact hΦ, ?_⟩
  rw [hΦeq]
  have hb : NB h (fun ζ : Cyl => fun i : Fin 3 => ∑ a : Fin 3, ρ i a ζ • g ζ a) k ξ ≤
      ∑ i : Fin 3, NB h (fun ζ : Cyl => ∑ a : Fin 3, ρ i a ζ • g ζ a) k ξ :=
    (nb_le _ k (hΦ.contDiffAt hUn)).2
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hb
  linarith [hcomp 0, hcomp 1, hcomp 2]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (l : ℕ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb l → qC B.h ξ / Qb l < 4 → B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb → ∀ F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, (F = pcFa5 B l ∨ F = pcB5 B l 2) → NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1)) k ξ ≤ C ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) k ξ ≤ C ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ B.h

signature.statement: ∀ B : BG, B.ok → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (l : ℕ), ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, 1/4 < qC B.h ξ / Qb l → qC B.h ξ / Qb l < 4 → B.Xa / 2 < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < 2 * B.Xb → ∀ F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, (F = pcFa5 B l ∨ F = pcB5 B l 2) → NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1)) k ξ ≤ C ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) k ξ ≤ C ∧ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ B.h

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hAlg : ∀ (h : ℝ) (U : Set Cyl) (ξ : Cyl), IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → ∀ k : ℕ, NB h (fun η => f η * g η) k ξ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h g (k - i) ξ ∧ (∀ a b : ℝ, NB h (fun η => a * f η + b * g η) k ξ ≤ |a| * NB h f k ξ + |b| * NB h g k ξ) ∧ (∀ a : ℝ, NB h (fun _ : Cyl => a) k ξ ≤ if k = 0 then |a| else 0) := by
    intro h U ξ hU hξ f g hf hg k
    have leib : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (U : Set Cyl) (n : ℕ),
        IsOpen U → ξ ∈ U → ∀ (f : Cyl → ℝ) (g : Cyl → V), ContDiffOn ℝ n f U → ContDiffOn ℝ n g U →
        NB h (fun η => f η • g η) n ξ ≤
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * NB h f i ξ * NB h g (n - i) ξ := by
      intro V _ _ U n hU hξ f g hf hg
      unfold NB
      generalize Lnorm h ξ = L
      obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s : Set Cyl, s = (fun z : Cyl => ξ + z) ⁻¹' U := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hs : IsOpen s := by
        rw [hs_def]; exact hU.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
      have hO : IsOpen (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := hs.preimage L.continuous
      have h0s : (0 : Cyl) ∈ s := by
        rw [hs_def]; show ξ + 0 ∈ U; rw [add_zero]; exact hξ
      have hL0s : L 0 ∈ s := by rw [map_zero]; exact h0s
      have h0O : (0 : Cyl) ∈ ⇑L ⁻¹' s := hL0s
      have hsm : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
          ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s := by
        intro W _ _ F hF
        exact hF.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).contDiffOn
          (fun z hz => by rw [hs_def] at hz; exact hz)
      have hsmO : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
          ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) := by
        intro W _ _ F hF
        exact (hsm F hF).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
      have key : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : Cyl → W),
          ContDiffOn ℝ n F U → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n →
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0 =
            (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F ξ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L) := by
        intro W _ _ F hF i hi
        have e1 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + L z)) i hO h0O
        have e2 := ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right L (hsm F hF) hs.uniqueDiffOn
          hO.uniqueDiffOn hL0s (i := i) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
        have e3 := iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => F (ξ + z)) i hs h0s
        have e4 := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) i ξ 0
        calc iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + L z)) 0
            = iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i ((fun z => F (ξ + z)) ∘ ⇑L) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) 0 := e1.symm
          _ = (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i (fun z => F (ξ + z)) s (L 0)).compContinuousLinearMap

    have hsc : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0) :=
      hS.2.2.2.1.continuousOn
    have hA : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} := by
      have hm : Continuous (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2)) := by fun_prop
      have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2)))
          {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} := by
        refine hsc.comp hm.continuousOn ?_
        intro s hs
        have hs' : s.2.2 < 1 := hs
        exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - s.2.2 by linarith⟩
      have hU : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
      have h1 := hc.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := B.qB))
      have h2 : IsOpen {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst
      have e : {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} =
          {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1} ∩ ({s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | s.2.2 < 1} ∩
            ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (s.2.1, 1 - s.2.2))) ⁻¹'
              Iio B.qB) := by
        ext s
        simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_inter_iff, mem_preimage, mem_Iio, Function.comp]
      rw [e]
      exact h2.inter h1
    have hD : IsOpen (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      have hm : Continuous (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)) := by fun_prop
      have hc : ContinuousOn ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2)))
          {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := by
        refine hsc.comp hm.continuousOn ?_
        intro w hw
        have hw' : w.2 < 1 := hw
        exact ⟨mem_univ _, show (0:ℝ) < 1 - w.2 by linarith⟩
      have hU : IsOpen {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_snd continuous_const
      have h1 := hc.isOpen_inter_preimage hU (isOpen_Iio (a := B.qB))
      have e : simDomain B.h B.qB = {w : ℝ³ × ℝ | w.2 < 1} ∩
          ((fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale B.h w.1 w.2) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ × ℝ => (w.1 2, 1 - w.2))) ⁻¹' Iio B.qB := by
        ext w
        simp only [simDomain, mem_setOf_eq, mem_inter_iff, mem_preimage, mem_Iio, Function.comp]
      rw [e]
      exact h1
    have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(uB B)) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      have hAB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿B.AB) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := hBP.2.2.2.1.1
      have hBv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿B.BvB) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := hBP.2.2.2.1.2.1
      have hDA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z) (simDomain B.h B.qB) :=
        ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hD).1 hAB).2
      have hc : ∀ (v : ℝ³) (j : Fin 3),
          ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (v, (0:ℝ)) j) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
        intro v j
        have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (v, (0:ℝ))) (simDomain B.h B.qB) :=
          hDA.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
        exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j : ℝ³ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h1
      let e0 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1
      let e1 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 1 1
      let e2 : ℝ³ := EuclideanSpace.single 2 1
      have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ³ × ℝ =>
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e1, (0:ℝ)) 2 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e2, (0:ℝ)) 1) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e2, (0:ℝ)) 0 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e0, (0:ℝ)) 2) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) +
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e0, (0:ℝ)) 1 - fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) z (e1, (0:ℝ)) 0) •
              EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) + (↿B.BvB) z) (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
        refine ((((hc e1 2).sub (hc e2 1)).smul contDiffOn_const).add
          (((hc e2 0).sub (hc e0 2)).smul contDiffOn_const)).add
          (((hc e0 1).sub (hc e1 0)).smul contDiffOn_const) |>.add hBv
      refine hg.congr ?_
      rintro ⟨y, s⟩ hz
      have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s) :=
        (hAB.contDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have hpart : fderiv ℝ (fun w => B.AB w s) y =
          (fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) := by
        have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℝ³ => (w, s)) (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ) y :=
          hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left y s
        have h2 : HasFDerivAt ((↿B.AB) ∘ (fun w : ℝ³ => (w, s)))
            ((fderiv ℝ (↿B.AB) (y, s)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ³ ℝ)) y :=
          HasFDerivAt.comp (g := ↿B.AB) y hdiff.hasFDerivAt h1
        exact h2.fderiv
      show curl3 (fun w => B.AB w s) y + B.BvB y s = _
      unfold curl3
      rw [hpart]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.inl_apply]
      rfl
    have frame : ∀ r z : ℝ, 0 < r → (rotPt r 0 z) 2 = z ∧
        eR (rotPt r 0 z) = EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) ∧
        eTh (rotPt r 0 z) = EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) := by
      intro r z hr
      have h0 : (rotPt r 0 z) 0 = r := by simp [rotPt]
      have h1 : (rotPt r 0 z) 1 = 0 := by simp [rotPt]
      have h2 : (rotPt r 0 z) 2 = z := by simp [rotPt]
      have hrad : rad (rotPt r 0 z) = r := by
        unfold rad
        rw [h0, h1]
        simp [Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
      refine ⟨h2, ?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold eR radVec
        rw [hrad, h0, h1, zero_smul, add_zero, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
      · unfold eTh azVec
        rw [hrad, h0, h1, neg_zero, zero_smul, zero_add, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
    let ψ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ³ × ℝ := fun s => (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1, s.2.2)
    have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ := by
      have hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1) := by
        unfold rotPt
        fun_prop
      exact hr.prodMk (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd)
    have hmaps : MapsTo ψ {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB}
        (simDomain B.h B.qB) := by
      intro s hs
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hs
      show s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h ((rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1) 2) (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB
      rw [(frame s.1 s.2.1 h1).1]
      exact ⟨h2, h3⟩
    refine ⟨hA, fun l i => ?_⟩
    have hcomp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((↿(uB B)) ∘ ψ)
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} :=
      hu.comp hψ.contDiffOn hmaps
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun s => Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * inner ℝ (((↿(uB B)) ∘ ψ) s)
        ((![EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ), eZ] :
          Fin 3 → ℝ³) i))
        {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} :=
      contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.inner ℝ hcomp contDiffOn_const)
    refine hg.congr ?_
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨_, f2, f3⟩ := frame s.1 s.2.1 hs.1
    show Qb l ^ (1/2 + B.h) * inner ℝ (uB B (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1) s.2.2)
        (![eR (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1), eTh (rotPt s.1 0 s.2.1), eZ] i) = _
    rw [f2, f3]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨hΩo, hbase⟩ := hbase0
  intro k
  obtain ⟨Ck, hCk⟩ := chart k
  obtain ⟨C3, hC3⟩ := chart (k + 1)
  refine ⟨max Ck (2 * max C3 0), ?_⟩
  intro l ξ hξ hw1 hw2 hX1 hX2 F hF
  have hξB : ξ ∈ DomC B.h B.qB := hξ
  have hq0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ := (hB.1.1 ξ.2.1 (1 - ξ.2.2.1) (by linarith [hξ.2.1])).1
  have hQ : 0 < Qb l := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hsQ : 0 < Real.sqrt (Qb l) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQ
  have hsq : 0 < Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq0
  have hp0 : 0 < qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _
  have hQ4 : Qb l < 4 * qC B.h ξ := by
    have := (lt_div_iff₀ hQ).1 hw1
    linarith
  have hsqrt2 : Real.sqrt (Qb l) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hQ.le, Real.sq_sqrt hq0.le, Real.sqrt_nonneg (Qb l),
      Real.sqrt_nonneg (qC B.h ξ)]
  set Ω := {s : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < s.1 ∧ s.2.2 < 1 ∧ simScale B.h s.2.1 (1 - s.2.2) < B.qB} with hΩe
  have hRC : ∀ s ∈ Ω, pcRC5 l s ≠ 0 := fun s hs => div_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hs.1) hsQ.ne'
  have hRCs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pcRC5 l) := by unfold pcRC5; fun_prop
  have hb : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcB5 B l i) Ω := fun i => hbase l i
  have hFa : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcFa5 B l) Ω := (hb 1).div hRCs.contDiffOn hRC
  have hFs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F Ω := by
    rcases hF with rfl | rfl
    · exact hFa
    · exact hb 2
  let sl : Cyl →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ × ℝ :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).prod
      (((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)))).prod
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))))))
  have hslA : ∀ η : Cyl, HasFDerivAt (fun x : Cyl => (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1)) sl η := fun η => sl.hasFDerivAt
  have hD : IsOpen (DomC B.h B.qB) := by
    have e : DomC B.h B.qB = (fun x : Cyl => ((x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) ⁻¹' Ω := by
      ext η; exact Iff.rfl
    rw [e]
    exact hΩo.preimage (by fun_prop)
  have hGs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η : Cyl => F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1)) (DomC B.h B.qB) := by
    have hsm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : Cyl => ((x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    exact hFs.comp hsm.contDiffOn (fun η hη => hη)
  have hcomp : ∀ η ∈ DomC B.h B.qB, ∀ d : Cyl,
      fderiv ℝ (fun η' : Cyl => F (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1)) η d =
        fderiv ℝ F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) (d.1, d.2.1, d.2.2.1) := by
    intro η hη d
    have hη' : (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ∈ Ω := hη
    have d1 := ((hFs.contDiffAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hη')).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have h' : HasFDerivAt (fun η' : Cyl => F (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1)) _ η := d1.comp η (hslA η)
    rw [h'.fderiv]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨wR, hwR⟩ : ∃ w : Cyl, w = (Real.sqrt (Qb l) / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ), 0, 0, 0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨wZ, hwZ⟩ : ∃ w : Cyl, w = (0, Real.sqrt (Qb l) / qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h), 0, 0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hvR : (((Lnorm B.h ξ wR).1, (Lnorm B.h ξ wR).2.1, (Lnorm B.h ξ wR).2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) =
      Real.sqrt (Qb l) • ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) := by
    rw [hwR]
    simp only [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap', Prod.map_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, Prod.smul_mk, mul_one]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  have hvZ : (((Lnorm B.h ξ wZ).1, (Lnorm B.h ξ wZ).2.1, (Lnorm B.h ξ wZ).2.2.1) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) =
      Real.sqrt (Qb l) • ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) := by
    rw [hwZ]
    simp only [Lnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_prodMap', Prod.map_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, Prod.smul_mk, mul_one]
    congr 2
    field_simp
  have hNBeq : ∀ (f g : Cyl → ℝ), f =ᶠ[nhds ξ] g → NB B.h f k ξ = NB B.h g k ξ := by
    intro f g hfg
    unfold NB
    rw [(hfg.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds]
  have hgermR : (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))
      =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun η => fderiv ℝ (fun η' : Cyl => F (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1)) η (Lnorm B.h ξ wR) := by
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hD.mem_nhds hξB) (fun η hη => ?_)
    rw [hcomp η hη, hvR, ContinuousLinearMap.map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hgermZ : (fun η : Cyl => Real.sqrt (Qb l) * fderiv ℝ F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)))
      =ᶠ[nhds ξ] fun η => fderiv ℝ (fun η' : Cyl => F (η'.1, η'.2.1, η'.2.2.1)) η (Lnorm B.h ξ wZ) := by
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hD.mem_nhds hξB) (fun η hη => ?_)
    rw [hcomp η hη, hvZ, ContinuousLinearMap.map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hR2 : Real.sqrt (Qb l) / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) ≤ 2 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hsq]; exact hsqrt2
  have hpp : qC B.h ξ ^ B.h * qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) = Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hq0, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hZ2 : Real.sqrt (Qb l) / qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) ≤ 2 * qC B.h ξ ^ B.h := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hp0, mul_assoc, hpp]; exact hsqrt2
  have haR : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (Qb l) / Real.sqrt (qC B.h ξ) := by positivity
  have haZ : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (Qb l) / qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - B.h) := by positivity
  have hqh : 0 ≤ qC B.h ξ ^ B.h := Real.rpow_nonneg hq0.le _
  have hnR : ‖wR‖ ≤ 2 := by
    rw [hwR]
    simp only [Prod.norm_def, norm_zero, max_self, Prod.fst_zero, Prod.snd_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg haR]
    exact max_le hR2 (by norm_num)
  have hnZ : ‖wZ‖ ≤ 2 * qC B.h ξ ^ B.h := by
    rw [hwZ]
    simp only [Prod.norm_def, norm_zero, max_self, Prod.fst_zero, Prod.snd_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg haZ, abs_zero]
    exact max_le (by positivity) (max_le hZ2 (by positivity))
  have hNk : NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1)) k ξ ≤ Ck := by
    have hc := hCk l ξ hξ hw1 hw2 hX1 hX2
    rcases hF with rfl | rfl
    · exact hc.1
    · exact hc.2
  have hNk1 : NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1)) (k + 1) ξ ≤ max C3 0 := by
    have hc := hC3 l ξ hξ hw1 hw2 hX1 hX2
    rcases hF with rfl | rfl
    · exact hc.1.trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · exact hc.2.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hN0 : 0 ≤ NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1)) (k + 1) ξ := by
    unfold NB; exact norm_nonneg _
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ max C3 0 := le_max_right _ _
  refine ⟨hNk.trans (le_max_left _ _), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hNBeq _ _ hgermR]
    calc _ ≤ ‖wR‖ * NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1)) (k + 1) ξ :=
          nbdir B.h _ ξ _ wR hD hξB hGs k
      _ ≤ 2 * max C3 0 := mul_le_mul hnR hNk1 hN0 (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ max Ck (2 * max C3 0) := le_max_right _ _
  · rw [hNBeq _ _ hgermZ]
    calc _ ≤ ‖wZ‖ * NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => F (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1)) (k + 1) ξ :=
          nbdir B.h _ ξ _ wZ hD hξB hGs k
      _ ≤ (2 * qC B.h ξ ^ B.h) * max C3 0 := mul_le_mul hnZ hNk1 hN0 (by positivity)
      _ = 2 * max C3 0 * qC B.h ξ ^ B.h := by ring
      _ ≤ max Ck (2 * max C3 0) * qC B.h ξ ^ B.h :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) hqh

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B G hB hG
  
  have s2 : ∀ (h : ℝ) (l : ℕ), 0 ≤ h → 0 < epsb h l ∧ 1 ≤ ((kb h l : ℕ) : ℝ) ∧
      1 ≤ epsb h l * ((kb h l : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ∧ epsb h l * ((kb h l : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 4 := by
    intro h l hh
    have hQ0 : 0 < Qb l := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _
    have hQ1 : Qb l ≤ 1 :=
      Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    have he0 : 0 < epsb h l := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ0 _
    have he1 : epsb h l ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one hQ0.le hQ1 hh
    have hx1 : 1 ≤ epsb h l ^ (-(1/2:ℝ)) :=
      Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos he0 he1 (by norm_num)

import Mathlib
set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000

/-!
# Existence And Smoothness Of The Navier–Stokes Equation

Standalone comparator copied from:
https://github.com/google-deepmind/formal-conjectures/blob/8bf45ed70d48b2b2a501de9c00b26bfa38c573ee/FormalConjectures/Millenium/NavierStokes.lean

The upstream definitions, helper proofs, and breakdown alternatives (C) and (D)
are retained, including their intentional `sorry` challenge placeholders. The
imports, metadata attributes, namespace, and local notation are adapted for this
project. All utility dependencies are inlined; only Mathlib is imported.
Neither the proof root nor the submission imports this reference.

This file formalizes the Clay Mathematics Institute millennium problem concerning
the existence and smoothness of solutions to the Navier-Stokes equations in three
spatial dimensions. While the definitions are generalized to arbitrary dimension n,
the millennium problem specifically concerns the case n = 3.

## References
- [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Navier%E2%80%93Stokes_existence_and_smoothness)

## Main Theorems (Clay Millennium Problem for n = 3)

This reference states the two breakdown alternatives as a single conjunction:
- `navier_stokes_breakdown`: (C) Existence of breakdown scenario on ℝ³ **and**
  (D) Existence of breakdown scenario on ℝ³/ℤ³

## Variable conventions

Fefferman writes the velocity as $u(x,t)$, the initial velocity as $u^\circ(x)$, the
pressure as $p(x,t)$, the force as $f(x,t)$, and the viscosity as $\nu$. In Lean,
`u₀ : ℝ^n → ℝ^n` denotes the initial velocity, while `v : ℝ^n → ℝ → ℝ^n`
denotes the solution velocity. The curried order `v x t`, `p x t`, and `f x t`
keeps the source convention that position comes before time.

Since the Clay statement gives equation (1) on the closed time half-line $t \ge 0$,
the time derivative is encoded with `derivWithin` relative to `Set.Ici 0`.
-/

open ContDiff Set InnerProductSpace MeasureTheory
open scoped Laplacian

namespace NavierStokes.Comparator

-- Inlined notation from FormalConjecturesForMathlib.Geometry.Euclidean and Geometry.«3d».
local notation "ℝ^" n:65 => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)
local notation "ℝ³" => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)

variable {n : ℕ}

/--
The divergence $\nabla \cdot v$ of a vector field $v : \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}^n$
at a point $x$, computed as the trace of the Jacobian matrix.

In coordinates, $\nabla \cdot v = \sum_i \partial v_i / \partial x_i$.

This is available as the notation `∇⬝ v`. If `v` is not differentiable at `x`, then
`fderiv` is the zero map, so this definition has the corresponding junk value $0$.
-/
noncomputable
def divergence (v : ℝ^n → ℝ^n) (x : ℝ^n) : ℝ := (fderiv ℝ v x).trace ℝ (ℝ^n)

@[inherit_doc]
local notation "∇⬝" => divergence

/-- The divergence of a vector field is $0$ at points where `fderiv` has its junk value. -/
@[simp]
theorem divergence_of_not_differentiableAt {v : ℝ^n → ℝ^n} {x : ℝ^n}
    (hv : ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ v x) : ∇⬝ v x = 0 := by
  simp [divergence, fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hv]

/-- The divergence of the zero vector field is zero. -/
@[simp]
theorem divergence_zero (x : ℝ^n) : ∇⬝ (0 : ℝ^n → ℝ^n) x = 0 := by
  simp [divergence]

/-- The divergence of a constant vector field is zero. -/
@[simp]
theorem divergence_const (c : ℝ^n) (x : ℝ^n) :
    ∇⬝ (fun _ : ℝ^n => c) x = 0 := by
  simp [divergence]

/-- Divergence is additive at points where both vector fields are differentiable. -/
theorem divergence_add {v w : ℝ^n → ℝ^n} {x : ℝ^n}
    (hv : DifferentiableAt ℝ v x) (hw : DifferentiableAt ℝ w x) :
    ∇⬝ (fun y => v y + w y) x = ∇⬝ v x + ∇⬝ w x := by
  rw [divergence, fderiv_fun_add hv hw]
  exact map_add _ _ _

/-- Divergence commutes with scalar multiplication at differentiability points. -/
theorem divergence_smul (c : ℝ) {v : ℝ^n → ℝ^n} {x : ℝ^n}
    (hv : DifferentiableAt ℝ v x) : ∇⬝ (fun y => c • v y) x = c * ∇⬝ v x := by
  rw [divergence, fderiv_fun_const_smul hv c]
  simp [divergence]

/--
A function $f : \mathbb{R}^n \to \alpha$ is 1-periodic if it is periodic in each
coordinate with period $1$, i.e. $f(x + e_i) = f(x)$ for each unit vector $e_i$.
This captures functions on the $n$-torus $\mathbb{R}^n/\mathbb{Z}^n$.
-/
def IsOnePeriodic {α : Sort*} (f : ℝ^n → α) : Prop :=
  ∀ x i, f (x + EuclideanSpace.single i 1) = f x

/--
Basic conditions on initial velocity field for the Navier-Stokes equations
in $n$-dimensional space.

The initial velocity must be:
- Divergence-free (incompressibility condition: $\nabla \cdot u_0 = 0$)
- Smooth ($C^\infty$)

These conditions apply regardless of spatial dimension.
-/
structure InitialVelocityCondition (u₀ : ℝ^n → ℝ^n) : Prop where
  /-- The initial velocity field is divergence-free (equation 2).
      This is the incompressibility constraint for the fluid. -/
  div_free : ∀ x, ∇⬝ u₀ x = 0
  /-- The initial velocity field is smooth ($C^\infty$ in all variables). -/
  smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u₀

/--
Initial velocity conditions for the Navier-Stokes problem on all of $\mathbb{R}^n$.

In addition to being smooth and divergence-free, the velocity must decay
faster than any polynomial at spatial infinity (condition 4 in Fefferman's paper).

This condition ensures the velocity field has finite energy and reasonable
behavior as $\lVert x \rVert \to \infty$.
-/
structure InitialVelocityConditionDecay (u₀ : ℝ^n → ℝ^n) : Prop extends
    InitialVelocityCondition u₀ where
  /-- All derivatives of u₀ decay faster than any polynomial (condition 4).
  For any derivative order $m$ and any decay rate $K$, there exists a constant $C$
  such that $\lVert \partial^m u_0(x) \rVert \le C/(1+\lVert x \rVert)^K$. -/
  decay : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ K : ℝ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m u₀ x‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖x‖) ^ K

/--
Initial velocity conditions for the periodic Navier-Stokes problem on
$\mathbb{R}^n/\mathbb{Z}^n$.

The velocity must be smooth, divergence-free, and 1-periodic in each coordinate
(condition 8, part 1 in Fefferman's paper).
-/
structure InitialVelocityConditionPeriodic (u₀ : ℝ^n → ℝ^n) : Prop extends
    InitialVelocityCondition u₀ where
  /-- The initial velocity is 1-periodic in each direction (condition 8, part 1). -/
  isOnePeriodic : IsOnePeriodic u₀

/--
The basic smoothness condition on the external forcing term.

The force $f(x,t)$ must be smooth ($C^\infty$) in both space and time variables
for $t \ge 0$.
-/
structure ForceCondition (f : ℝ^n → ℝ → ℝ^n) : Prop where
  /-- The force is smooth on $\mathbb{R}^n \times [0,\infty)$. -/
  smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿f) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ici 0)

/--
Force conditions for the Navier-Stokes problem on all of $\mathbb{R}^n$.

The force must be smooth and decay faster than any polynomial
in both space and time (condition 5 in Fefferman's paper).
-/
structure ForceConditionDecay (f : ℝ^n → ℝ → ℝ^n) : Prop extends ForceCondition f where
  /-- All derivatives of f decay faster than any polynomial in space and time (condition 5).
  For any derivative order $m$ and any decay rate $K$, there exists $C$ such that
  $\lVert \partial^m_{x,t} f(x,t) \rVert \le C/(1+\lVert x \rVert+t)^K$ for
  $t \ge 0$. -/
  decay : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ K : ℝ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x, ∀ t ≥ 0,
    ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (↿f) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ici 0) (x, t)‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖x‖ + t) ^ K

/--
Force conditions for the periodic Navier-Stokes problem on
$\mathbb{R}^n/\mathbb{Z}^n$.

The force must be smooth, 1-periodic in space, and decay in time
(conditions 8, part 1 and 9 in Fefferman's paper).
-/
structure ForceConditionPeriodic (f : ℝ^n → ℝ → ℝ^n) : Prop extends ForceCondition f where
  /-- The force is 1-periodic in space for all times $t \ge 0$ (condition 8, part 1). -/
  isOnePeriodic : ∀ t ≥ 0, IsOnePeriodic (f · t)
  /-- All derivatives of f decay faster than any polynomial in time (condition 9). -/
  decay : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ K : ℝ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x, ∀ t ≥ 0,
    ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (↿f) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ici 0) (x, t)‖ ≤ C / (1 + t) ^ K

/--
A solution (v, p) to the Navier-Stokes equations in n-dimensional space
with viscosity $\nu$, initial velocity $u_0$, and external force $f$.

This structure captures the core requirements for a solution:
1. The velocity and pressure satisfy the Navier-Stokes PDE (equation 1)
2. The velocity remains divergence-free for all time (equation 2)
3. The initial condition is satisfied (equation 3)
4. The solution is smooth ($C^\infty$) for all time $t \ge 0$ (equations 6, 11)
-/
structure NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothness
    (nu : ℝ) (u₀ : ℝ^n → ℝ^n) (f : ℝ^n → ℝ → ℝ^n)
    (v : ℝ^n → ℝ → ℝ^n) (p : ℝ^n → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop where
  /-- The Navier-Stokes equation (equation 1):
  $\partial v/\partial t + (v \cdot \nabla)v = \nu\Delta v - \nabla p + f$. -/
  navier_stokes : ∀ x, ∀ t ≥ 0,
    derivWithin (v x ·) (Set.Ici 0) t + fderiv ℝ (v · t) x (v x t) =
      nu • Δ (v · t) x - gradient (p · t) x + f x t
  /-- Incompressibility constraint (equation 2): $\nabla \cdot v = 0$ for all
  $x$ and $t \ge 0$. -/
  div_free : ∀ x, ∀ t ≥ 0, ∇⬝ (v · t) x = 0
  /-- Initial condition (equation 3): $v(x,0) = u_0(x)$ for all $x$. -/
  initial_condition : ∀ x, v x 0 = u₀ x
  /-- The velocity field is smooth ($C^\infty$) on $\mathbb{R}^n \times [0,\infty)$
  (conditions 6, 11). -/
  velocity_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿v) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ici 0)
  /-- The pressure field is smooth ($C^\infty$) on $\mathbb{R}^n \times [0,\infty)$
  (conditions 6, 11). -/
  pressure_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ici 0)

/--
A solution to the Navier-Stokes equations on all of $\mathbb{R}^n$ with appropriate
decay and energy bounds.

In addition to the basic solution properties, we require:
- The velocity is in $L^2$ at each time $t \ge 0$ (finite kinetic energy)
- The total energy remains bounded for all time (condition 7)
-/
structure NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothnessRn
    (nu : ℝ) (u₀ : ℝ^n → ℝ^n) (f : ℝ^n → ℝ → ℝ^n)
    (v : ℝ^n → ℝ → ℝ^n) (p : ℝ^n → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop
  extends NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothness nu u₀ f v p where
  /-- The velocity is square-integrable at each time $t \ge 0$ (condition 7). -/
  integrable : ∀ t ≥ 0, MemLp (‖v · t‖) 2
  /-- The kinetic energy $\int \lVert v(x,t) \rVert^2\,dx$ remains uniformly bounded
  for all time (condition 7), where the integral is the Lebesgue integral. -/
  globally_bounded_energy : ∃ E, ∀ t ≥ 0, (∫ x : ℝ^n, ‖v x t‖ ^ 2) < E

/--
A solution to the Navier-Stokes equations on the $n$-torus $\mathbb{R}^n/\mathbb{Z}^n$.

The velocity must be 1-periodic in each spatial direction for all times (condition 10).
The pressure is also required to be 1-periodic, following the errata appended to the
Clay problem statement.
-/
structure NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothnessPeriodic
    (nu : ℝ) (u₀ : ℝ^n → ℝ^n) (f : ℝ^n → ℝ → ℝ^n)
    (v : ℝ^n → ℝ → ℝ^n) (p : ℝ^n → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop
  extends NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothness nu u₀ f v p where
  /-- The velocity is 1-periodic in space for all times $t \ge 0$ (condition 10). -/
  isOnePeriodic_velocity : ∀ t ≥ 0, IsOnePeriodic (v · t)
  /-- The pressure is 1-periodic in space for all times $t \ge 0$ (Clay errata). -/
  isOnePeriodic_pressure : ∀ t ≥ 0, IsOnePeriodic (p · t)


/-- (C) ∧ (D) Breakdown of Navier–Stokes solutions on both ℝ³ and ℝ³/ℤ³.

The first conjunct is the breakdown scenario (C) on ℝ³; the second conjunct is the
breakdown scenario (D) on the torus ℝ³/ℤ³. -/

noncomputable def nsResidual (ν : ℝ) (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ³) (t : ℝ) : ℝ³ :=
  deriv (fun s => u x s) t + fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y t) x (u x t)
    - ν • Δ (fun y => u y t) x + gradient (fun y => p y t) x


def BlowupPackage (ν T R : ℝ) (u : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) (p : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ³ → ℝ → ℝ³) : Prop :=
  0 < T ∧ 0 < R ∧
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿u) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿p) (univ ×ˢ Iio T) ∧
  ContDiff ℝ ∞ (↿f) ∧
  (∀ x t, t < T → R ≤ ‖x‖ → u x t = 0 ∧ p x t = 0) ∧
  (∀ x, u x 0 = 0) ∧
  (∀ x t, (R ≤ ‖x‖ ∨ t ≤ 0) → f x t = 0) ∧
  (∃ S : ℝ, ∀ x t, S ≤ t → f x t = 0) ∧
  (∀ x t, t < T → nsResidual ν u p x t = f x t) ∧
  (∀ x t, t < T → divergence (fun y => u y t) x = 0) ∧
