    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTz h Fo Uo)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    AdmBlk h (fun X => Real.exp (-(ab / Real.log (Xb / X) ^ 2))) (fun X => min 1 (Real.log (Xb / X)))
      (Ico Xg Xb) Fo Uo ∧
    (∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ RelaxCone h μ (Icc (XR * Real.exp (-5)) Xg2) Fo Uo))

def AxProf (h Pst XR Xa Xan Xa1 Xa2 Xh1 aa : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Fi Ui : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (0 < XR ∧ 0 < aa ∧ 0 < Xa ∧ Xa < Xan ∧ Xan < Xa1 ∧ Xa1 < Xa2 ∧ Xa2 < Xh1 ∧
      Xh1 < XR * Real.exp (-5)) ∧
  (∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Fi) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Ui) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < Fi X η) ∧
    (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Fi) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Ui) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, Xh1 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → Ui X η = 4 * η ∧ Fi X η = refFin Pst XR X η) ∧
  (∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ Fc Uc Pc : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ,
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Fc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Uc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Pc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xan →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Fc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Uc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Pc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      (∀ w : ℂ, |w.im| < ρ → -1 - ρ < w.re → w.re < 1 + ρ →
        ‖Fc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Uc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Pc k X w‖ ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
        Fc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => Fi Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Uc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => Ui Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Pc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => Pax η + profRadInt (fun x e => Fi x e ^ 2) Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ))) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
     profRadInt Ui (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η = profRadInt (fun _ e => 4 * e) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η ∧
     profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * Fi x e) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η =
       profRadInt (fun x e => 2 * x * refFin Pst XR x e) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η ∧
     profRadInt (fun x e => Ui x e * (2 * x * Fi x e)) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η =
       profRadInt (fun x e => 4 * e * (2 * x * refFin Pst XR x e)) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η ∧
     profRadInt (fun x e => Ui x e ^ 2 - x * Fi x e ^ 2) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η =
       profRadInt (fun x e => (4 * e) ^ 2 - x * refFin Pst XR x e ^ 2) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η ∧
     profRadInt (fun x e => Fi x e ^ 2) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η =
       profRadInt (fun x e => refFin Pst XR x e ^ 2) (XR * Real.exp (-5)) η) ∧
  (∀ F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < XR → -1 < η → η < 1 → F X η = Fi X η ∧ U X η = Ui X η) →
    (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ leadPi F 0 η = Pax η) →
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ Xa → -1 < η → η < 1 →
        leadStressTh h F U X η = 0 ∧ leadStressTz h F U X η = 0) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTh h F U)) (Ioo 0 XR ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTz h F U)) (Ioo 0 XR ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    AdmBlk h (fun X => Real.exp (-(aa / Real.log (X / Xa) ^ 2))) (fun X => min 1 (Real.log (X / Xa)))
      (Ioc Xa Xa2) F U ∧
    (∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ RelaxCone h μ (Icc Xa1 (XR * Real.exp (-5))) F U))

def JoinProf (h lam cinf cpatch Xa Xb Xv Xc p1 p2 m1 m2 aa ab Xan Xm Xm2 Xp2 Xp r1 r2 : ℝ)
    (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (0 < h ∧ h < 1 / 100 ∧ 0 < lam ∧ 0 < cinf ∧ 0 < cpatch ∧ 0 < aa ∧ 0 < ab ∧
      0 < Xa ∧ Xa < p1 ∧ p1 < p2 ∧ p2 < m1 ∧ m1 < m2 ∧ m2 < Xv ∧ Xv < Xc ∧ Xc < Xb ∧
      Xa < Xan ∧ Xan < Xm ∧ Xm < Xm2 ∧ Xm2 < Xp2 ∧ Xp2 < Xp ∧ Xp < r1 ∧ r1 < r2 ∧ r2 < p1) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, r1 ≤ X → X ≤ r2 → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      U X η = 0 ∧ Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η = cpatch * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam))) ∧
  ((∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → (X ≤ Xa ∨ Xb ≤ X) → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      leadStressTh h F U X η = 0 ∧ leadStressTz h F U X η = 0) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTh h F U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(leadStressTz h F U)) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧
  AdmBlk h (edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab) (edgeDist Xa Xb) (Ioc Xa Xm2 ∪ Ico Xp2 Xb) F U ∧
  (∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ RelaxCone h μ (Icc Xm Xp) F U) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → IntegrableOn (fun x => F x η ^ 2) (Ioi 0) ∧ ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * x * F x η) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η * (2 * x * F x η)) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2) volume 0 X ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => F x η ^ 2) volume 0 X) ∧
  (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η) ∧
    (∀ X₀ X₁ : ℝ, 0 < X₀ → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, X₀ ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)) ∧
  (∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F 0 η) ∧
    (∀ X₁ : ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ X₁ → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿F) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿U) (X, η)‖ ≤ C)) ∧
  (∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ Fc Uc Pc : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ,
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Fc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Uc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Pc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ Xan →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Fc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Uc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Pc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      (∀ w : ℂ, |w.im| < ρ → -1 - ρ < w.re → w.re < 1 + ρ →
        ‖Fc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Uc k X w‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖Pc k X w‖ ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
        Fc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => F Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Uc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => U Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Pc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => leadPi F Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ))) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, Xb ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → U X η = 0 ∧
      Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η = cinf * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X)) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, Xv ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → U X η = 0 ∧ profRadInt U X η = 0) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, ((p1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ p2) ∨ (m1 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ m2)) → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      U X η = 0 ∧ Real.sqrt (2 * X) * F X η = cpatch * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam))) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), U x η * (2 * x * F x η)) = 0 ∧
      (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (U x η ^ 2 - x * F x η ^ 2)) = 0 ∧
      (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (2 * x * F x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * cinf * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)))) = 0) ∧
  (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C N : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, Xc ≤ X → X < Xb → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) * F w.1 w.2 -
          cinf * w.1 ^ (-(1 / 2 + h)) * heatProfile h (2 * (1 - w.2 ^ 2) / w.1)) (X, η)‖ ≤
        C * edgeWeight Xa Xb aa ab X * edgeDist Xa Xb X ^ (-N))

noncomputable def patchF0 (lam cpatch η x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  cpatch * (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹ * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam)) / Real.sqrt (2 * x)

def repU (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (c : Fin 5 → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ := c 0 * β 0 x + c 1 * β 1 x

noncomputable def repF (lam cpatch : ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ) (c : Fin 5 → ℝ) (η x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  patchF0 lam cpatch η x + c 2 * γ 0 x + c 3 * γ 1 x + c 4 * γ 2 x

def LoopProperty : Prop :=
  ∀ μ A δ0 : ℝ, 0 < μ → 0 < A → 0 < δ0 →
  ∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ ∃ aL bL : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => aL z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2.1 z.2.2.2.1 z.2.2.2.2)
      {z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | μ / 2 < z.1 ∧ |z.2.2.2.1| < 2 * A} ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => bL z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2.1 z.2.2.2.1 z.2.2.2.2)
      {z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | μ / 2 < z.1 ∧ |z.2.2.2.1| < 2 * A} ∧
    (∀ a b p1 p2 : ℝ, μ / 2 < a → |p2| < 2 * A →
      (∀ φ : ℝ, aL a b p1 p2 (φ + 1) = aL a b p1 p2 φ ∧ bL a b p1 p2 (φ + 1) = bL a b p1 p2 φ) ∧
      (∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..1, aL a b p1 p2 φ) = a ∧ (∫ φ in (0:ℝ)..1, bL a b p1 p2 φ) = b ∧
      (2 + δ0 ≤ a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) → ∀ φ : ℝ, aL a b p1 p2 φ = a ∧ bL a b p1 p2 φ = b)) ∧
    (∀ a b p1 p2 φ : ℝ, μ ≤ a → a ≤ A → |b| ≤ A → |p1| ≤ A → |p2| ≤ A →
      μ ≤ p1 - b / a * p2 - 2 →
      μ ≤ coneUp (p1 - b / a * p2) (p2 + b / a * p1) - a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) →
      κ ≤ aL a b p1 p2 φ ∧
      κ ≤ aL a b p1 p2 φ * (1 + (bL a b p1 p2 φ / aL a b p1 p2 φ) ^ 2) - 2 ∧
      κ ≤ p1 - bL a b p1 p2 φ / aL a b p1 p2 φ * p2 - 2 ∧
      κ ≤ coneUp (p1 - bL a b p1 p2 φ / aL a b p1 p2 φ * p2)
            (p2 + bL a b p1 p2 φ / aL a b p1 p2 φ * p1)
        - aL a b p1 p2 φ * (1 + (bL a b p1 p2 φ / aL a b p1 p2 φ) ^ 2))

def RepairProperty : Prop :=
  ∀ lam cpatch r1 r2 : ℝ, 0 < lam → 0 < cpatch → 0 < r1 → r1 < r2 →
  ∃ (s1 s2 δ C : ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ) (γ : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ) (Φ : (Fin 5 → ℝ) → ℝ → (Fin 5 → ℝ)),
    r1 < s1 ∧ s1 < s2 ∧ s2 < r2 ∧ 0 < δ ∧
    (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (β i)) ∧ (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (γ j)) ∧
    (∀ i x, (x ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ x) → β i x = 0) ∧ (∀ j x, (x ≤ s1 ∨ s2 ≤ x) → γ j x = 0) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : (Fin 5 → ℝ) × ℝ => Φ p.1 p.2)
      (Metric.ball (0 : Fin 5 → ℝ) δ ×ˢ Ioo (-2) 2) ∧
    (∀ η : ℝ, Φ 0 η = 0) ∧
    ∀ (d : Fin 5 → ℝ) (η : ℝ), ‖d‖ < δ → -2 < η → η < 2 →
      ‖Φ d η‖ ≤ C * ‖d‖ ∧
      (∫ x in r1..r2, repU β (Φ d η) x) = d 0 ∧
      (∫ x in r1..r2, 2 * x * (repF lam cpatch γ (Φ d η) η x - patchF0 lam cpatch η x)) = d 1 ∧
      (∫ x in r1..r2, repU β (Φ d η) x * (2 * x * repF lam cpatch γ (Φ d η) η x)) = d 2 ∧
      (∫ x in r1..r2, (repU β (Φ d η) x ^ 2 - x * repF lam cpatch γ (Φ d η) η x ^ 2
          + x * patchF0 lam cpatch η x ^ 2)) = d 3 ∧
      (∫ x in r1..r2, (repF lam cpatch γ (Φ d η) η x ^ 2 - patchF0 lam cpatch η x ^ 2)) = d 4 ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, r1 ≤ x → x ≤ r2 → patchF0 lam cpatch η x / 2 ≤ repF lam cpatch γ (Φ d η) η x

def ProfileReg (h cinf Xb ε : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿F) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿U) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 → 0 < F X η) ∧

def AxCone (h μ : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=

      |axHs h j0 η * (deriv (fun e => Fr X e) η / Fr X η - Λ * axZeta h j0 σ η)| ≤
        2 * K * (axChi h j0 σ η + 1 / Λ) ∧
      |deriv (fun e => Fr X e) η / Fr X η - Λ * axZeta h j0 σ η| ≤ 2 * K) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ 110 → -1 - ρ1 / 2 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 + ρ1 / 2 →
      |Ur X η - (4 * η + j0)| ≤ 2 * K / Λ ∧ |deriv (fun e => Ur X e) η - 4| ≤ 2 * K / Λ) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 4 / Λ ≤ X → X ≤ 110 → -1 - ρ1 / 2 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 + ρ1 / 2 →
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => C * Fr X e) η| ≤ M k ∧
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => (C * Fr X e)⁻¹) η| ≤ M k ∧
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => psLead1 h Fr Ur X e) η| ≤ M k ∧
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => X * axNs h Pax Fr Ur X e / (1 - 2 * h * e ^ 2)) η| ≤ M k ∧
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => Ur X e) η| ≤ M k)

noncomputable def axKap (κ0 t1 y : ℝ) : ℝ := 1 - (1 - κ0) * sigA (y / t1)

noncomputable def axBeta (Λ om y : ℝ) : ℝ := 1 - sigA ((y - Real.log (25 * Λ)) / (om / 2))

noncomputable def axTheta (Λ om y : ℝ) : ℝ := sigA ((y - Real.log (25 * Λ) - om / 2) / (om / 2))

noncomputable def axShearA (h Λ t1 κ0 om : ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (y η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 - axTheta Λ om y) * axKap κ0 t1 y *
      psLead1 h (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) η + axTheta Λ om y * (4 / 5)

noncomputable def axSlopeU (h Λ t1 κ0 om : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (y η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(axBeta Λ om y * axKap κ0 t1 y * (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) *
      axNs h Pax (axRefF Λ t1 Fn) (axRefU Λ t1 Un) (4 / Λ * Real.exp y) η / (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2)) / 2

noncomputable def axProfF (h Λ t1 κ0 om : ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if X ≤ 4 / Λ then Fn X η else
    Fn (4 / Λ) η * Real.exp (-(1 / 2) * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ X, axShearA h Λ t1 κ0 om Fn Un y η)

noncomputable def axProfU (h Λ t1 κ0 om : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if X ≤ 4 / Λ then Un X η else
    Un (4 / Λ) η + ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..axLogY Λ X, axSlopeU h Λ t1 κ0 om Pax Fn Un y η

noncomputable def sqFlat (y : ℝ) : ℝ := if y ≤ 0 then 0 else Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2)

noncomputable def sqFlatD (y : ℝ) : ℝ := if y ≤ 0 then 0 else 2 / y ^ 3 * Real.exp (-1 / y ^ 2)

noncomputable def collarG (u : ℝ) : ℝ := (sqFlat u + sqFlat (1 - u))⁻¹

noncomputable def collarGam (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 * sqFlat (1 - u) + u ^ 3 * sqFlatD (1 - u)) / (sqFlat u + sqFlat (1 - u)) ^ 2

def collarGood (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (Ioo 0 (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
  ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Ioo 0 (11 / 8) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f p‖ ≤ C

noncomputable def collarFlatInt (ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.exp (-t) * ψ (p.1 / Real.sqrt (1 + p.1 ^ 2 * t), p.2)

noncomputable def collarXu (Xb v : ℝ) : ℝ := Xb * Real.exp (-(2 * v))

noncomputable def collarPsiTh (h cinf Xb : ℝ) (q : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  collarGam q.1 * (2 * (1 - 2 * h * q.2 ^ 2) * (tailHt h cinf (collarXu Xb q.1) q.2 -
    collarXu Xb q.1 * deriv (fun y => tailHt h cinf y q.2) (collarXu Xb q.1)) +
    collarXu Xb q.1 * tailHt h cinf (collarXu Xb q.1) q.2)

noncomputable def collarPsiE (h cinf ρ Xb : ℝ) (q : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  collarGam q.1 * (tailEh h cinf (collarXu Xb q.1) q.2 ^ 2 * tailFac ρ Xb (collarXu Xb q.1))

noncomputable def collarPsiXE (h cinf ρ Xb : ℝ) (q : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  collarGam q.1 * (collarXu Xb q.1 * tailEh h cinf (collarXu Xb q.1) q.2 ^ 2 *
    tailFac ρ Xb (collarXu Xb q.1))

noncomputable def collarBeta (h cinf ρ Xb : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ρ * collarGam p.1 * tailHt h cinf (collarXu Xb p.1) p.2 / (2 * collarXu Xb p.1) +
    p.1 ^ 3 * ρ * collarFlatInt (collarPsiTh h cinf Xb) p /
      (4 * collarXu Xb p.1 * (1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2))

noncomputable def collarBz (h cinf ρ Xb : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  p.2 * ρ * (collarFlatInt (collarPsiXE h cinf ρ Xb) p -
    collarXu Xb p.1 * collarFlatInt (collarPsiE h cinf ρ Xb) p) /
      ((1 - 2 * h * p.2 ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (2 * collarXu Xb p.1))

noncomputable def collarB8 (h cinf ρ Xb : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(ρ * collarG p.1 * tailEh h cinf (collarXu Xb p.1) p.2)

structure RfpPar where
  (Md Pst lam h ρ T1 Lh : ℝ) (Amp c1 c2 ca : ℝ → ℝ)

noncomputable def rfpY2 (Md : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.exp Md + 11

noncomputable def rfpY3 (Md lam : ℝ) : ℝ := rfpY2 Md + 1 + 60 * Real.log (1 / lam)

noncomputable def rfpY4 (Md lam : ℝ) : ℝ := rfpY3 Md lam + 13 / lam

noncomputable def rfpY5 (Md lam : ℝ) : ℝ := rfpY4 Md lam + 60 + 30 * Real.log (1 / lam)

noncomputable def rfpYb (Md lam T1 Lh : ℝ) : ℝ := rfpY5 Md lam + 2 + T1 + Lh + 3

noncomputable def rfpSigI (t : ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, sigA s

noncomputable def rfpBmp (t : ℝ) : ℝ := sigA (1 + t / (3 / 20)) * sigA (1 - t / (3 / 20))

noncomputable def rfpLam (P : RfpPar) (y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log P.Pst + y / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y - P.lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 P.Md)
    - (1 - P.lam) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam)
    + (1 - P.h) * rfpSigI (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam - 1 - P.T1)
    - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60) * Real.log 2
    + Real.log (tailFac P.ρ (Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)) (Real.exp y) / (1 - P.ρ))

noncomputable def rfpL5 (Md Pst lam : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log Pst + rfpY5 Md lam / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI (rfpY5 Md lam)
    - lam * rfpSigI (rfpY5 Md lam - rfpY2 Md) - Real.log 2

noncomputable def rfpTh (P : RfpPar) (y : ℝ) : ℝ := 1 - sigA ((y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam) / 60)

noncomputable def rfpKa (P : RfpPar) : ℝ :=
  (∫ y, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3)) /
    (∫ y, Real.exp (2 * rfpLam P y) * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1))

noncomputable def rfpPsi (P : RfpPar) (y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 3) - rfpKa P * rfpBmp (y - rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 1)

noncomputable def rfpR0 (ξ : ℝ) : ℝ := (∫ v in (0:ℝ)..ξ, sigA (50 * v)) * (1 - sigA (ξ - 10))

noncomputable def rfpRb (P : RfpPar) (y η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  P.Amp η * rfpR0 (P.lam * (y - rfpY3 P.Md P.lam)) + P.c1 η * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 3)
    + P.c2 η * rfpBmp (y - rfpY4 P.Md P.lam + 1)

noncomputable def rfpK (Md y : ℝ) : ℝ := if y ≤ 1 then 4 else 4 * (1 - sigA (Real.log y / Md))

noncomputable def rfpE (P : RfpPar) (y η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (rfpLam P y) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ (rfpTh P y) * Real.sqrt (1 + P.ca η * rfpPsi P y)

noncomputable def rfpF (P : RfpPar) (x η : ℝ) : ℝ := rfpE P (Real.log x) η / Real.sqrt (2 * x)

noncomputable def rfpU (P : RfpPar) (x η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  η * rfpK P.Md (Real.log x) + rfpE P (Real.log x) η * rfpRb P (Real.log x) η

noncomputable def rfpCp (P : RfpPar) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (rfpLam P (rfpY2 P.Md + 1) + (1 / 2 + P.lam) * (rfpY2 P.Md + 1))

noncomputable def rfpCi (P : RfpPar) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (rfpLam P (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh - 3) +
    (1 / 2 + P.h) * (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh - 3)) / (1 - P.ρ)

noncomputable def rfpXg (P : RfpPar) : ℝ := Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 1)

noncomputable def rfpXg2 (P : RfpPar) : ℝ := Real.exp (rfpY2 P.Md + 2)

noncomputable def rfpXk (P : RfpPar) (k : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.exp (rfpY3 P.Md P.lam - k)

noncomputable def rfpXv (P : RfpPar) : ℝ := Real.exp (rfpY4 P.Md P.lam)

noncomputable def rfpXb (P : RfpPar) : ℝ := Real.exp (rfpYb P.Md P.lam P.T1 P.Lh)

def RfpRegime (P : RfpPar) : Prop :=
  0 < P.Md ∧ Real.exp (Real.exp P.Md + 10) < P.Pst ∧ 0 < P.lam ∧ P.lam ≤ 1 / 100 ∧ 0 < P.h ∧
    P.h ≤ P.lam ^ 2 ∧ 0 < P.ρ ∧ P.ρ ≤ P.h / 800 ∧ 4 * Real.log (1 / P.h) ≤ P.T1 ∧ 0 ≤ P.Lh

def RfpClos (P : RfpPar) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P.Amp (Ioo (-2) 2) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P.c1 (Ioo (-2) 2) ∧
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P.c2 (Ioo (-2) 2) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P.ca (Ioo (-2) 2) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 → 9 / 10 ≤ P.Amp η ∧ P.Amp η ≤ 6 / 5 ∧
    |deriv P.Amp η| ≤ Real.sqrt P.lam ∧ |P.c1 η| + |deriv P.c1 η| ≤ P.lam ^ 20 ∧
    |P.c2 η| + |deriv P.c2 η| ≤ P.lam ^ 20) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -2 < η → η < 2 → |P.ca η| + |deriv P.ca η| ≤ P.lam ^ 20 ∧
    ∀ y : ℝ, |P.ca η * rfpPsi P y| ≤ 1 / 2) ∧
  P.ca 0 = 0 ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
    (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..rfpXv P, rfpU P x η) = 0 ∧
    (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), rfpU P x η * (2 * x * rfpF P x η)) = 0 ∧
    (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (rfpU P x η ^ 2 - x * rfpF P x η ^ 2)) = 0 ∧
    (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (2 * x * rfpF P x η - Real.sqrt (2 * x) * rfpCi P * x ^ (-(1 / 2 + P.h)))) = 0 ∧
    (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam), 2 * x * rfpF P x η) =
      ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.exp (rfpY5 P.Md P.lam), 2 * x * rfpF P x 0)

def RfpStrict (adm : Prop) (h : ℝ) (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (x η : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < F x η ∧ 0 < shearA F x η ∧ 0 < psLead1 h F U x η ∧
  0 < shearA F x η - shearB F U x η * (psLead2 h F U x η / psLead1 h F U x η) ∧
  0 < 2 - 2 * shearB F U x η * (psLead2 h F U x η / psLead1 h F U x η)
        - shearB F U x η ^ 2 / shearA F x η
        - (shearA F x η - 2) * (psLead2 h F U x η / psLead1 h F U x η) ^ 2 ∧
  (adm → 2 < shearA F x η * (1 + (shearB F U x η / shearA F x η) ^ 2))

def rfpPref (Q : RfpPar → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ M0 : ℝ, 0 < M0 ∧ ∀ Md : ℝ, M0 ≤ Md → ∃ P0 : ℝ, ∀ Pst : ℝ, P0 ≤ Pst →
    ∃ l0 : ℝ, 0 < l0 ∧ ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → lam ≤ l0 → ∃ h0 : ℝ, 0 < h0 ∧
      ∀ P : RfpPar, P.Md = Md → P.Pst = Pst → P.lam = lam → P.h ≤ h0 →
        RfpRegime P → RfpClos P → Q P

noncomputable def axEa (Λ t1 κ0 X : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if X ≤ 4 / Λ then 0 else (1 - κ0) * sigA (axLogY Λ X / t1)

def AxFlatFactor (h : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Λ t1 κ0 tf cB : ℝ) (Bθ Bz : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (F U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < tf ∧ tf ≤ t1 / 2 ∧ 0 < cB ∧ cB ≤ 1 ∧
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Bθ (Ioo (4 / Λ) (4 / Λ * Real.exp tf) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Bz (Ioo (4 / Λ) (4 / Λ * Real.exp tf) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
  (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ Cm : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Ioo (4 / Λ) (4 / Λ * Real.exp tf) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1,
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Bθ p‖ ≤ Cm ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m Bz p‖ ≤ Cm) ∧
  ∀ X η : ℝ, 4 / Λ < X → X < 4 / Λ * Real.exp tf → -1 < η → η < 1 →
    leadStressTh h F U X η = axEa Λ t1 κ0 X * Bθ (X, η) ∧
    axTz h Pax F U X η = axEa Λ t1 κ0 X * Bz (X, η) ∧
    cB ≤ F X η ∧ cB ≤ shearA F X η ∧
    2 + cB ≤ shearA F X η * (1 + (shearB F U X η / shearA F X η) ^ 2) ∧
    shearA F X η * (1 + (shearB F U X η / shearA F X η) ^ 2) ≤ 1 / cB ∧
    |shearB F U X η / shearA F X η| ≤ 1 / cB ∧
    cB ≤ Bθ (X, η) - shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * Bz (X, η) ∧
    |Bz (X, η) + shearB F U X η / shearA F X η * Bθ (X, η)| ≤ cB ^ 2 ∧
    Real.sqrt (Bθ (X, η) ^ 2 + Bz (X, η) ^ 2) ≤ 1 / cB

def osbGood (W S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z‖ ≤ C

noncomputable def axF0 (z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' n : ℕ, (-z / 2) ^ n / ((Nat.factorial n : ℝ) * (Nat.factorial (n + 1) : ℝ))

def AxRaw (h j0 σ : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Λ C K1 ρ1 : ℝ) (Kder : ℕ → ℝ) (Fn Un : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Fn) (Ioi (-1 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) ∧
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿Un) (Ioi (-1 / Λ) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 - ρ1) (1 + ρ1)) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 → 0 < Fn X η) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X < 9 / (2 * Λ) → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 →
      axSq h Fn Un X η * Fn X η =
        -2 * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * (X * iteratedDeriv 2 (fun Y => Fn Y η) X + 2 * deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) X) ∧
      axSn h Pax Fn Un X η =
        -2 * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * (X * iteratedDeriv 2 (fun Y => Un Y η) X + deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) X)) ∧
  (∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ Fc Uc Pc : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ Ck : ℝ,
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Fc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Uc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Pc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 (41 / (10 * Λ)) ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ∀ X : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Fc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Uc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Pc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      (∀ w : ℂ, |w.im| < ρ → -1 - ρ < w.re → w.re < 1 + ρ →
        ‖Fc k X w‖ ≤ Ck ∧ ‖Uc k X w‖ ≤ Ck ∧ ‖Pc k X w‖ ≤ Ck) ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
        Fc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => Fn Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Uc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => Un Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        Pc k X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => Pax η + profRadInt (fun x e => Fn x e ^ 2) Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ))) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 →
      |X * deriv (fun Y => Fn Y η) X / Fn X η -
          Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η * deriv axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η) / axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η)| ≤ K1 / Λ ∧
      |deriv (fun e => Fn X e) η / Fn X η - Λ * axZeta h j0 σ η -
          Λ * X * deriv (fun e => axChi h j0 σ e) η * deriv axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η) /
            axF0 (Λ * X * axChi h j0 σ η)| ≤ K1 / Λ ∧
      |Un X η - (4 * η + j0)| ≤ K1 / Λ ∧ |deriv (fun e => Un X e) η - 4| ≤ K1 / Λ ∧
      |deriv (fun Y => Un Y η) X + axZs h j0 Pax η / (2 * (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2))| ≤ K1 / Λ) ∧
  (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 41 / (10 * Λ) → -1 - ρ1 < η → η < 1 + ρ1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => C * Fn z.1 z.2) (X, η)‖ ≤ Kder m ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (C * Fn z.1 z.2)⁻¹) (X, η)‖ ≤ Kder m ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿Un) (X, η)‖ ≤ Kder m)

noncomputable def rfpY6 (P : RfpPar) : ℝ := rfpY5 P.Md P.lam + 2 + P.T1

noncomputable def rfpExtS (P : RfpPar) (x η : ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ s in Ioi x, s * rfpF P s η ^ 2

noncomputable def rfpExtQ (P : RfpPar) (x η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -1 + ((1 - P.h) * profRadInt (fun s e => 2 * s * rfpF P s e) x η
      - (1 / 2 - P.h) * η * profEtaD (profRadInt (fun s e => 2 * s * rfpF P s e)) x η) /
    (x * (2 * x * rfpF P x η))

noncomputable def rfpExtN (P : RfpPar) (x η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (4 * P.h * η * rfpExtS P x η - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (rfpExtS P) x η) / x
    + 4 * (1 / 2 + P.h) * η * leadPi (rfpF P) x η - (1 - η ^ 2) * profEtaD (leadPi (rfpF P)) x η

noncomputable def rinC (Md Pst lam y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Pst * Real.exp (y / 10 - 3 / 5 * rfpSigI y - lam * rfpSigI (y - rfpY2 Md))

noncomputable def rinMom (g : ℝ → ℝ) (X : ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..X, g x

noncomputable def rinQf (h : ℝ) (c k : ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(1 - (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x)) X / X)
  + ((1 - h + (1 / 2 - h) * (2 * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2))) * rinMom (fun x => Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x)) X

         * rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x) * (Real.sqrt (2 * x) * c (Real.log x))) X)
    / (X * (Real.sqrt (2 * X) * c (Real.log X)))

noncomputable def rinNf (h : ℝ) (c k : ℝ → ℝ) (X η : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(1 - (1 - 2 * h * η ^ 2) * rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x)) X / X) * k (Real.log X)
  + ((4 * h * η ^ 2 - 2 * (1 - η ^ 2)) * rinMom (fun x => k (Real.log x) ^ 2) X

noncomputable def pulseNForm (h η A A' a1 a1' a2 a2' p0 p1 p2 x e1 M0 M1 M2 KB K2 S0 S1 S2 S00 Pi Pi' : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let f := (1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹
  let fp := -(2 * η) * ((1 + η ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2
  let G := A * M0 + a1 * M1 + a2 * M2
  let G' := A' * M0 + a1' * M1 + a2' * M2
  let H := A ^ 2 * S0 + a1 ^ 2 * S1 + a2 ^ 2 * S2 - S00 / 2
  let H' := 2 * A * A' * S0 + 2 * a1 * a1' * S1 + 2 * a2 * a2' * S2
  let MM := η * KB + f * G
  let MMp := KB + fp * G + f * G'
  let SS := η ^ 2 * K2 + f ^ 2 * H
  let SSp := 2 * η * K2 + 2 * f * fp * H + f ^ 2 * H'
  let Rb := A * p0 + a1 * p1 + a2 * p2
  (-(1 - 2 * (1 / 2 - h) * η * (MM / x) - (1 - η ^ 2) * (MMp / x)) * (e1 * f * Rb)
    + ((1 / 2 - h) * (MM - η * MMp) + 4 * h * η * SS - (1 - η ^ 2) * SSp) / x
    + 4 * (1 / 2 + h) * η * Pi - (1 - η ^ 2) * Pi') / (e1 * f)

def AxRefPI (h j0 σ : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (Λ C K ρ1 : ℝ) (M : ℕ → ℝ) (Fr Ur : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=

      deriv (fun Y => Fr Y η) X ≤ 0 ∧
      0 < psLead1 h Fr Ur X η ∧

      |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => X * axNs h Pax Fr Ur X e / (1 - 2 * h * e ^ 2)) η| ≤ M k ∧

def axRect (s : ℝ) : Set ℂ := {w : ℂ | |w.im| < s ∧ -1 - s < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + s}


noncomputable def axRecStep (h j0 Λ : ℝ) (χ ζ ℓ z g : ℂ → ℂ)
    (pv : ℕ → (ℂ → ℂ) × (ℂ → ℂ)) (n : ℕ) : (ℂ → ℂ) × (ℂ → ℂ) :=
  let P : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun i => (pv i).1
  let V : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun i => (pv i).2
  let D : ℂ := 1 / 2 - (h : ℂ)
  let A : ℂ := 1 / 2 + (h : ℂ)
  let L : ℂ := (Λ : ℂ)
  let d : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => 1 - w ^ 2
  let Us : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => 4 * w + (j0 : ℂ)
  let H : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => D * w + d w * Us w
  let Ws : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => 1 - 4 * d w - 2 * D * w * Us w
  let δ0 : ℕ → ℂ := fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else 0
  let Uc : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun i w => δ0 i * Us w + V i w / L
  let Bc : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun i w => -(2 * D * w * V i w + d w * deriv (V i) w) / ((i : ℂ) + 1)
  let Wc : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun i w => δ0 i * Ws w + Bc i w / L
  let Hc : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun i w => δ0 i * H w + d w * V i w / L
  let c : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun m w => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), P i w * P (m - i) w
  let gc : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => if n = 0 then 0 else g w ^ 2 * c (n - 1) w
  let p : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => gc w / (n : ℂ)
  let R1 : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
    ((Wc i w + (h : ℂ) * δ0 i - 2 * (h : ℂ) * w * Uc i w + d w * ζ w * V i w) * P (n - i) w
      + ((n - i : ℕ) : ℂ) * Wc i w * P (n - i) w + Hc i w * deriv (P (n - i)) w)
  let S : ℂ → ℂ := fun w =>
    -(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((n - i : ℕ) : ℂ) * Wc i w * V (n - i) w)
      - A * (1 - 4 * w * Us w) * V n w
      + 2 * A * w / L * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), V i w * V (n - i) w)
      - H w * deriv (V n) w - 4 * d w * V n w
      - d w / L * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), V i w * deriv (V (n - i)) w)
      - d w * deriv p w + 4 * A * w * p w + 2 * w * gc w
  (fun w => (-χ w * P n w + ℓ w * R1 w / L) / (2 * ((n : ℂ) + 1) * ((n : ℂ) + 2)),
   fun w => (-(δ0 n * z w) - ℓ w * S w / L) / (2 * ((n : ℂ) + 1) ^ 2))


noncomputable def axRecList (h j0 Λ : ℝ) (χ ζ ℓ z g : ℂ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℕ → (ℂ → ℂ) × (ℂ → ℂ)
  | 0, _ => ((fun _ => 1), (fun _ => 0))
  | n + 1, k => if k ≤ n then axRecList h j0 Λ χ ζ ℓ z g n k
      else axRecStep h j0 Λ χ ζ ℓ z g (axRecList h j0 Λ χ ζ ℓ z g n) n

    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Fc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Uc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Pc k p.1 p.2)
      (Icc 0 Xan ×ˢ {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}) ∧

      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Pc k X) {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ} ∧
      (∀ w : ℂ, |w.im| < ρ → -1 - ρ < w.re → w.re < 1 + ρ →

def AxGlue (h Pst : ℝ) (Pax : ℝ → ℝ) (ε Bd C T θ Kb Ks MP s1 s2 : ℝ) (β : Fin 2 → ℝ → ℝ)

abbrev axgeGood {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (Ω S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (f : ℝ × ℝ → V) : Prop :=

def EtaJet (B : ℝ) (r : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ r (Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
  (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |iteratedDeriv m r η| ≤ K) ∧
  ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → |r η| ≤ B ∧ |deriv r η| ≤ B

def cStrip (ρ : ℝ) : Set ℂ := {w : ℂ | |w.im| < ρ ∧ -1 - ρ < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 + ρ}

def BgAnalytic (Xi : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ (ρ C : ℝ) (fc : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ), 0 < ρ ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => fc p.1 p.2) (Ioo 0 Xi ×ˢ cStrip ρ) ∧
    ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → X < Xi →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fc X) (cStrip ρ) ∧ (∀ w ∈ cStrip ρ, ‖fc X w‖ ≤ C) ∧
      ∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → fc X (η : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun Y => f Y η) X : ℝ) : ℂ)

def BgOrdPre (h ε Xm Xs Xi m1 m2 : ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(S k)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(G k)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (↿(W k)) (Ioi (-ε) ×ˢ Ioo (-1) 1)) ∧
  (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X η : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(S k)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(G k)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (↿(W k)) (X, η)‖ ≤ C) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, Xs ≤ X → S k X η = 0 ∧ G k X η = 0 ∧ W k X η = 0) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, m1 ≤ X → X ≤ m2 → G k X η = 0 ∧ bgUz (S k) X η = 0) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → -1 < η → η < 1 → bgResRad h S G W k X η = 0) ∧
  (∀ X η : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ Xm → -1 < η → η < 1 →
      bgResTh h S G W k X η = 0 ∧ bgResZ h S G W k X η = 0) ∧
  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 → (∫ X in Ioi (0:ℝ), X * G k X η) = 0) ∧
  BgAnalytic Xi (S k) ∧ BgAnalytic Xi (G k)

def BgOrdOK (h ε Xm Xs Xi m1 m2 : ℝ) (S G W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) : Prop :=

  (∀ η : ℝ, -1 < η → η < 1 →
      (∫ X in Ioi (0:ℝ), X * bgResTh h S G W k X η) = 0 ∧ (∫ X in Ioi (0:ℝ), bgResZ h S G W k X η) = 0)

    NB B.h (fun η : Cyl => (hDetC B G γ η)⁻¹ • (Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, true) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1),
        Hcol B G (γ.1, γ.2.1, false) (η.1, η.2.1, η.2.2.1))) k ξ ≤ C * SC B.h ξ ^ b
def SignedClass4 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (Bo : ℝ) : Prop :=
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo - kapS) (LSh4 B G l0 S) ∧
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) (potW B G (LSc4 B G l0 S)) ∧
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo - kapS) (velW B G (potW B G (LSc4 B G l0 S))) ∧
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo + 1/2 - 2 * kapS) (velW B G (potW B G (LSc4 B G l0 S)) - LSh4 B G l0 S) ∧
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) (Bo + 1/2 - kapS) (presW B G (LSc4 B G l0 S))
def StressMeansSame4 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Fin 3) (ξ : Cyl), ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0) → mcor B G l0 (stressStep4 B G l0 S) a ξ = mcor B G l0 S a ξ
def SignedCov4 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Prop :=
  ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), B.Xa < XC B.h ξ → XC B.h ξ < B.Xb →
    yAvg (fun η => thA (fun θ => covT B G (W0c4 B G) (LSc4 B G l0 S) 0 1 θ η +
      covT B G (LSc4 B G l0 S) (W0c4 B G) 0 1 θ η)) ξ = sigE B G l0 S 2 ξ ∧
    yAvg (fun η => thA (fun θ => covT B G (W0c4 B G) (LSc4 B G l0 S) 0 2 θ η +
      covT B G (LSc4 B G l0 S) (W0c4 B G) 0 2 θ η)) ξ = sigE B G l0 S 1 ξ

noncomputable def fourY (f : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) (k : ℤ × ℤ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ Y in (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1), (f (ξ.1, ξ.2.1, ξ.2.2.1, Y) : ℂ) *
    Complex.exp (-(2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) * ((k.1 : ℂ) * (Y.1 : ℂ) + (k.2 : ℂ) * (Y.2 : ℂ)))


noncomputable def TN (f : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  (∑' k : ℤ × ℤ, if k = 0 then (0:ℂ) else
    fourY f ξ k / (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((bgc * (k.1 : ℝ) + (k.2 : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
      Complex.exp ((2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) * ((k.1 : ℂ) * (ξ.2.2.2.1 : ℂ) + (k.2 : ℂ) * (ξ.2.2.2.2 : ℂ)))).re


noncomputable def dYt (f : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := fderiv ℝ f ξ (0, 0, 0, vtv)


open Classical in
noncomputable def shInd (B : BG) (f : Cyl → ℝ) : Cyl → ℝ :=
  fun ξ => if B.Xa < XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ < B.Xb then f ξ else 0


noncomputable def Tprim (B : BG) (e : ℕ) (g : Cyl → ℝ) : Cyl → ℝ :=
  fun ξ => ξ.1 ^ (-(e:ℝ)) * Icut B (fun η => η.1 ^ (e:ℝ) * g η) ξ


noncomputable def Arem (B : BG) (e : ℕ) (g : Cyl → ℝ) : Cyl → ℝ :=
  fun ξ => ξ.1 ^ (-(e:ℝ)) * dR B.h (fun η => chiM B (XC B.h η)) ξ *
    ∫ r' in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r' ^ (e:ℝ) * g (pathPt B.h ξ r')


noncomputable def dvT (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Cyl → ℝ :=
  shInd B (fun ξ => -TN (EthP B G l0 S) ξ)

noncomputable def gdT (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Cyl → ℝ :=
  shInd B (fun ξ => -TN (EzP B G l0 S) ξ)

noncomputable def PsiT (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Cyl → ℝ :=
  shInd B (Tprim B 1 (gdT B G l0 S))


noncomputable def tempState (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : CState :=
  ⟨S.Aw, S.pw, fun ξ => S.Psi ξ + nrm B (Aex B.h - 1/2) (PsiT B G l0 S) ξ,
    fun ξ => S.bdir ξ + nrm B (Aex B.h) (dvT B G l0 S) ξ⟩


def TInv (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (H : ℝ) : Prop :=
  InM B (qsOf l0) H (nrm B (Aex B.h) (dvT B G l0 S)) ∧ InM B (qsOf l0) H (nrm B (Aex B.h) (gdT B G l0 S)) ∧
  (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dYt (dvT B G l0 S) ξ = -(EthP B G l0 S ξ - yAvg (EthP B G l0 S) ξ) ∧
     dYt (gdT B G l0 S) ξ = -(EzP B G l0 S ξ - yAvg (EzP B G l0 S) ξ)) ∧
  (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), yAvg (dvT B G l0 S) ξ = 0 ∧ yAvg (gdT B G l0 S) ξ = 0)

def TPot (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (H : ℝ) : Prop :=
  InM B (qsOf l0) H (nrm B (Aex B.h - 1/2) (PsiT B G l0 S)) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) H (nrm B (Aex B.h) (fun ξ => dR B.h (PsiT B G l0 S) ξ + PsiT B G l0 S ξ / ξ.1)) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) (H + 1) (nrm B (Aex B.h) (fun ξ => -dZ (PsiT B G l0 S) ξ)) ∧
  (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dR B.h (PsiT B G l0 S) ξ + PsiT B G l0 S ξ / ξ.1
      = gdT B G l0 S ξ - Arem B 1 (gdT B G l0 S) ξ) ∧
  (∀ m N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
      NB B.h (nrm B (Aex B.h) (Arem B 1 (gdT B G l0 S))) m ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (N : ℝ)) ∧
  (∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), (B.m1 ≤ XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ ≤ B.m2) ∨ Arem B 1 (gdT B G l0 S) ξ = 0) ∧
  (∀ z t : ℝ, t < 1 → simScale B.h z (1 - t) < qsOf l0 →
      radMom (fun ξ => dR B.h (PsiT B G l0 S) ξ + PsiT B G l0 S ξ / ξ.1) 1 z t = 0)

def TMean (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) : Prop :=
  ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
    mcor B G l0 (tempState B G l0 S) 1 ξ = mcor B G l0 S 1 ξ + dvT B G l0 S ξ ∧
    mcor B G l0 (tempState B G l0 S) 2 ξ = mcor B G l0 S 2 ξ + (dR B.h (PsiT B G l0 S) ξ + PsiT B G l0 S ξ / ξ.1) ∧
    mcor B G l0 (tempState B G l0 S) 0 ξ = mcor B G l0 S 0 ξ - dZ (PsiT B G l0 S) ξ ∧
    ∀ a b : Fin 3, Wcov B G l0 (tempState B G l0 S) a b ξ = Wcov B G l0 S a b ξ

def TPres (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (H : ℝ) : Prop :=
  InM B (qsOf l0) H (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h) (fun ξ => pmP B G l0 (tempState B G l0 S) ξ - pmP B G l0 S ξ)) ∧
  InM B (qsOf l0) H (nrm B (2 * Aex B.h + 1/2) (fun ξ => grP B G l0 (tempState B G l0 S) ξ - grP B G l0 S ξ)) ∧
  ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), pmP B G l0 (tempState B G l0 S) ξ - pmP B G l0 S ξ =
    Icut B (fun η => (grP B G l0 (tempState B G l0 S) η - grP B G l0 S η)
      - rhoP B η * (calP B G l0 (tempState B G l0 S) η.2.1 η.2.2.1 - calP B G l0 S η.2.1 η.2.2.1)) ξ

def momUpd (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) : CState :=
  ⟨S.Aw, S.pw, fun ξ => S.Psi ξ + dPsi ξ, fun ξ => S.bdir ξ + dv ξ⟩

noncomputable def momDvP (B : BG) (dv : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := qC B.h ξ ^ (-Aex B.h) * dv ξ

noncomputable def momPsP (B : BG) (dPsi : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := qC B.h ξ ^ (1/2 - Aex B.h) * dPsi ξ

noncomputable def momDgP (B : BG) (dPsi : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  dR B.h (momPsP B dPsi) ξ + momPsP B dPsi ξ / ξ.1

noncomputable def momDbP (B : BG) (dPsi : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := -(dZ (momPsP B dPsi) ξ)

def MomShape (B : BG) (f : Cyl → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ ξ a, f (shY ξ a) = f ξ) ∧ ∀ ξ, f ξ ≠ 0 → B.m1 ≤ XC B.h ξ ∧ XC B.h ξ ≤ B.m2

def MomMeanId (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
    mcor B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 0 ξ = mcor B G l0 S 0 ξ + momDbP B dPsi ξ ∧
    mcor B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 1 ξ = mcor B G l0 S 1 ξ + momDvP B dv ξ ∧
    mcor B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) 2 ξ = mcor B G l0 S 2 ξ + momDgP B dPsi ξ ∧
    ∀ a c, Wcov B G l0 (momUpd S dPsi dv) a c ξ = Wcov B G l0 S a c ξ

noncomputable def momRg (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  let b : Cyl → ℝ := fun η => ubase B η 0
  let Gz : Cyl → ℝ := fun η => ubase B η 2
  let β : Cyl → ℝ := mcor B G l0 S 0
  let v : Cyl → ℝ := mcor B G l0 S 1
  let γz : Cyl → ℝ := mcor B G l0 S 2
  let db : Cyl → ℝ := momDbP B dPsi
  let dg : Cyl → ℝ := momDgP B dPsi
  let dw : Cyl → ℝ := momDvP B dv
  (0:ℝ) - dT db ξ - (dR B.h (fun η => 2 * b η * db η + 2 * β η * db η + db η ^ 2) ξ
      + (2 * b ξ * db ξ + 2 * β ξ * db ξ + db ξ ^ 2) / ξ.1)
    - dZ (fun η => b η * dg η + Gz η * db η + β η * dg η + γz η * db η + db η * dg η) ξ
    + (2 * v ξ * dw ξ + dw ξ ^ 2) / ξ.1 + (lap0 B.h db ξ - db ξ / ξ.1 ^ 2)

noncomputable def momDg (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  2 * ubase B ξ 1 * momDvP B dv ξ / ξ.1 + momRg B G l0 S dPsi dv ξ

noncomputable def momDgt (B : BG) (g : Cyl → ℝ) (η : Cyl) : ℝ := g η - rhoP B η * radMom g 0 η.2.1 η.2.2.1

noncomputable def momQth (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) (η : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  mcor B G l0 S 2 η * momDvP B dv η + mcor B G l0 S 1 η * momDgP B dPsi η + momDgP B dPsi η * momDvP B dv η

noncomputable def momQz (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (S : CState) (dPsi dv : Cyl → ℝ) (η : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  2 * mcor B G l0 S 2 η * momDgP B dPsi η + momDgP B dPsi η ^ 2


def SimNorm (h : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → simScale h z τ ≤ 1 →
    ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => simScale h w.1 w.2) (z, τ)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun _ => (simScale h z τ ^ (1/2 - h) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).prodMap
                  (simScale h z τ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ))‖ ≤ C * simScale h z τ

noncomputable def primState (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) : CState :=
  ⟨potW B G (W0c4 B G),
   fun γ m ξ => (((qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1) ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * presW B G (W0c4 B G) γ m ξ,
   fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0⟩

noncomputable def psiW (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  psiT (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1) (vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2)
noncomputable def psiWd (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  fderiv ℝ (psiW B G γ) ξ (dVdir B.h γ.1)
noncomputable def nPhiC (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℂ :=
  fun i => ((nPhi B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)
noncomputable def nsqC (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℂ :=
  ((dotProduct (nPhi B G γ ξ) (nPhi B G γ ξ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
noncomputable def pulseMatC (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ :=
  M.map (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ))

noncomputable def rhoQ (B : BG) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ := qC B.h ξ / Qb γ.1
noncomputable def srcHat (B : BG) (f : WC) : WC :=
  fun γ m ξ => ((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (-(Aex B.h + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • f γ m ξ
noncomputable def projT (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ) : Fin 3 → ℂ :=
  v - (dotProduct (nPhiC B G γ ξ) v / nsqC B G γ ξ) • nPhiC B G γ ξ
noncomputable def dVc (B : BG) (l : ℕ) (F : Cyl → (Fin 3 → ℂ)) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℂ :=
  fderiv ℝ F ξ (dVdir B.h l)

noncomputable def potOf (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (tw : WC) : WC := fun γ m ξ =>
  if m = 0 then 0 else
    (Complex.I / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) * nsqC B G γ ξ)) •
      crossC (nPhiC B G γ ξ) (((psiW B G γ ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) • tw γ m ξ)
noncomputable def cutA (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (tw : WC) : WC :=
  fun γ m ξ => ((psiW B G γ ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) • tw γ m ξ
noncomputable def cutS (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (pr : WS) : WS :=
  fun γ m ξ => ((psiW B G γ ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * pr γ m ξ

def waveAdd (S : CState) (D : WC) (E : WS) : CState := ⟨S.Aw + D, S.pw + E, S.Psi, S.bdir⟩

def FlatW {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (B : BG) (qs : ℝ)
    (a : Lab → ℤ → Cyl → V) : Prop :=
  ∀ k N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h qs, NB B.h (a γ m) k ξ ≤ C * qC B.h ξ ^ (N : ℝ)

def PulseSol (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (l0 : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (f tw : WC) (pr : WS) : Prop :=
  InWg B G (qsOf l0) α (cutA B G tw) ∧ InWg B G (qsOf l0) (α + 1/2) (cutS B G pr) ∧
  (∀ γ m, m = 0 → tw γ m = 0 ∧ pr γ m = 0) ∧
  (∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), dotProduct (nPhiC B G γ ξ) (tw γ m ξ) = 0) ∧
  (∀ γ m, ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0), psiW B G γ ξ ≠ 0 →
     DifferentiableAt ℝ (tw γ m) ξ ∧
     dVc B γ.1 (tw γ m) ξ = (pulseMatC (APhi B G γ ξ)).mulVec (tw γ m ξ)
        - ((m : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((dDamp B G γ ξ : ℝ) : ℂ)) • tw γ m ξ - projT B G γ ξ (srcHat B f γ m ξ)) ∧
  (∀ γ m, m ≠ 0 → ∀ ξ ∈ DomC B.h (qsOf l0),
     pr γ m ξ = ((rhoQ B γ ξ ^ (Aex B.h + 1/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I / ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ))) *
       ((dotProduct (nPhiC B G γ ξ) ((pulseMatC (Kmat B G γ ξ)).mulVec (tw γ m ξ))
         - dotProduct (fun i => ((nPhiP B G γ ξ i : ℝ) : ℂ)) (tw γ m ξ)
         + dotProduct (nPhiC B G γ ξ) (srcHat B f γ m ξ)) / nsqC B G γ ξ)) ∧
  FlatW B (qsOf l0) (fun γ m ξ => ((psiWd B G γ ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) • tw γ m ξ) ∧
  FlatW B (qsOf l0) (fun γ m ξ => ((1 - psiW B G γ ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) • srcHat B f γ m ξ)

noncomputable def F0r5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ :=
  (G.rep γ).2.2 ^ (-(1 + B.h)) * B.F (G.rep γ).1 (G.rep γ).2.1
noncomputable def g0r5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ × ℝ :=
  F0r5 B G γ • (-(shearA B.F (G.rep γ).1 (G.rep γ).2.1), shearB B.F B.U (G.rep γ).1 (G.rep γ).2.1)
noncomputable def Nfr5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ × ℝ := (eN (g0r5 B G γ))⁻¹ • g0r5 B G γ
noncomputable def Kfr5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ × ℝ := (-(Nfr5 B G γ).2, (Nfr5 B G γ).1)
noncomputable def lam0_5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (-(2 * F0r5 B G γ * (Nfr5 B G γ).1) * (2 * F0r5 B G γ * (Nfr5 B G γ).1 + eN (g0r5 B G γ)))
noncomputable def c0f5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ := lam0_5 B G γ / (2 * F0r5 B G γ * (Nfr5 B G γ).1)
noncomputable def Bs5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (lam0_5 B G γ / (epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ))^2 * (1 + G.ustar^2) ^ (3/2:ℝ)))
noncomputable def ptil5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ := R0r B G γ * Bs5 B G γ *
  ((Kfr5 B G γ).1 - sgn γ.2.2 * G.ustar * (g0r5 B G γ).1 / (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 * eN (g0r5 B G γ) ^ 2))
noncomputable def pzr5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ := Bs5 B G γ *
  ((Kfr5 B G γ).2 - sgn γ.2.2 * G.ustar * (g0r5 B G γ).2 / (Lsb B.h G.r0 γ.1 * eN (g0r5 B G γ) ^ 2))
noncomputable def pint5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℤ :=
  if round ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * ptil5 B G γ) = 0 then 1 else round ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ) * ptil5 B G γ)
noncomputable def pang5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) : ℝ := (pint5 B G γ : ℝ) / (kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ)
noncomputable def phiL5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  pzr5 B G γ * chartZ B.h γ.1 ξ / epsb B.h γ.1 + sgn γ.2.2 * Bs5 B G γ * G.ustar / 2 * RC γ.1 ξ
  - vco B.h G.r0 γ (G.ctr γ) ξ.2.2.2 * (pang5 B G γ * Fang B γ.1 ξ + pzr5 B G γ * baseC B γ.1 ξ 2)
noncomputable def nPhi5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  ![DrC B γ.1 (phiL5 B G γ) ξ, pang5 B G γ / RC γ.1 ξ, DzC B γ.1 (phiL5 B G γ) ξ]
noncomputable def nPhiP5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  fun i => dV B γ.1 (fun η => nPhi5 B G γ η i) ξ
noncomputable def APhi5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  -Kmat B G γ ξ + (dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ))⁻¹ •
    Matrix.vecMulVec (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (Matrix.vecMul (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (Kmat B G γ ξ) - nPhiP5 B G γ ξ)
noncomputable def dDamp5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
  epsb B.h γ.1 * ((kb B.h γ.1 : ℝ))^2 * dotProduct (nPhi5 B G γ ξ) (nPhi5 B G γ ξ)
noncomputable def ntan5 (B : BG) (G : CorrGeom) (γ : Lab) (ξ : Cyl) : ℝ :=
